entry: 这是关都最早被记录的融合宝可梦之一。研究表明，它进行光合作用的速率，是普通妙蛙种子的四倍。
author: fixthewifi
source: One of the first Fusion Pokémon documented in Kanto. Research suggests it photosynthesizes at quadruple the rate of a typical Bulbasaur.

entry: 这是一只进化到一半的妙蛙种子。任何东西靠近背上的种子，都会引起它的攻击。
author: Shuichi_le_sushi
source: A Bulbasaur that has gone halfway through evolution. They tend to be aggressive with anything that approaches their seed.

entry: 它与进化后的模样惊人地相似。科学家认为，融合使它的遗传物质发生了意外变化，造就了这种外貌。
author: Soup1900
source: It has a striking resemblance to its evolution. Scientists say that the fusion has caused unexpected growth in its DNA to create this appearance.

entry: 随着身体成熟，头顶的花苞渐渐绽放。花瓣日久低垂，最终形成一层脆弱的甲壳。
author: kandyman
source: The bud on its head blooms as it matures, with the petals drooping down to form a brittle carapace over time.

entry: 阳光直射会大幅加快进化。必要时，POKENAME会用藤蔓挪动身体，走出阴影。
author: kandyman
source: Exposure to direct sunlight dramatically speeds up the evolution process. POKENAME will use its vines to move out of shadows if necessary.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的鳞粉能加速植物生长，走过的地方常会开出某些花朵。想找POKENAME，就沿着花的踪迹走吧。
author: kandyman
source: The dust from POKENAME's wings accelerates plant growth. Certain flowers tend to grow in its wake. If you want to find POKENAME, follow the flowers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢晒太阳，吸收热量，再化为能量。它很少因受打扰而生气，总爱与大家和平相处。
author: krsgaming
source: POKENAME likes to be in the sun while it takes in heat and turns it into energy. It rarely gets angry when bothered and likes to keep things peaceful.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子含有剧毒。受到威胁时，它会抖动尾尖的叶子，发出警告。
author: strawbearycandy
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back contains a potent poison. When threatened, it vibrates the leaf at the tip of its tail as a warning.

entry: 野生POKENAME会拼死保护背上没有甲壳覆盖的种子，里面储存着它日后进化所必需的养分。
author: strawbearycandy
source: A wild POKENAME will protect the unarmored bulb on its back with its life. This bulb contains nutrients vital to its future evolution.

entry: 阳光直射会大幅加快进化。必要时，POKENAME会用藤蔓挪动身体，走出阴影。
author: kandyman
source: Exposure to direct sunlight will dramatically speed up the evolution process. POKENAME will use its vines to move out of shadows if necessary.

entry: 背上的花苞含有大量花粉，每天都得排出至少一半，才不至于重得飞不起来。
author: kandyman
source: The bud on its back carries so much pollen that it must expel at least half its contents daily, lest it become too heavy to fly.

entry: 有人发现，POKENAME会从树枝上扑向猎物，或毫无防备的训练家。首次伏击一旦落空，它便立刻逃走。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME has been known to drop from tree branches onto prey and unsuspecting Trainers. If the initial ambush fails, it immediately flees.

entry: POKENAME对植物兴趣浓厚，也十分爱护自然。它甚至能凭空变出草木。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME shows great interest in plant life and is very protective of nature itself. It's capable of materializing flora out of thin air.

entry: POKENAME会在树枝间跳跃，锻炼翅膀。若是失足，就必须在落地前用藤鞭稳住自己。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME hop between branches to strengthen their wings. If they fall, they must catch themselves with a Vine Whip before hitting the ground.

entry: POKENAME不断释放毒孢子，守卫领地。动弹不得的闯入者，随后不是被搬出去，就是被它吃掉。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME constantly emits poisonous spores to safeguard its territory. The incapacitated trespassers are then either carried out or eaten.

entry: 它弹跳着身体前进。每跳一下，便向空气中撒出少许带着甜香的花粉。
author: .izik
source: It bounces its body to move forward. With each hop, it releases a bit of sweet-smelling pollen into the air.

entry: 它靠组成羽毛的叶片滑翔，而非真正飞行。想转个弯，就得极精确地抖落叶片。
author: kandyman
source: Instead of flying, it glides using the leaves that make up its plumage. To change directions, it must shed these leaves in a very precise manner.

entry: POKENAME能用皮肤细胞进行光合作用，获取能量。不过，它还是爱吃垃圾，纯粹觉得好玩。
author: kandyman
source: POKENAME conducts photosynthesis through its skin cells to gain energy. However, it still loves eating trash just for the fun of it.

entry: POKENAME不是忙着拼命觅食，就是懒洋洋地晒太阳。即使休息，它也始终保持警惕。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME spends its days alternating between frantic foraging and lounging in the sun. Even while resting, this Pokémon is always on alert.

entry: 这只妙蛙种子的花苞还没完全绽放。背上的花苞太重，它便更喜欢懒懒地躺在日光下。
author: Shuichi_le_sushi
source: A Bulbasaur whose seed hasn't finished blooming. The bud on their back is too heavy to carry, and so, they prefer to laze around in the sun.

entry: 背上的种子过早开始开花，导致POKENAME体弱多病。
author: themicelegion
source: The bulb on its back has begun the flowering process too early. As a result, POKENAME is sickly and weak.

entry: 人们常把POKENAME误认成走路草融合体，等看清它的脸，才发现根本不是走路草。
author: watermelonchild
source: People often mistake POKENAME for an Oddish fusion. It's only when they see its face that they realise it is no Oddish.

entry: POKENAME靠啃咬坚韧的植物和丢弃的碎料，磨短门牙。别看腿短，跑起来却很快。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME keep their incisors at a manageable length by gnawing on tough vegetation and discarded scraps. Despite their short legs, they move quickly.

entry: 这只宝可梦的头部，含有极为丰富的养分。食草动物常把它误当成种子，害它大部分时间都在逃命。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's head contains an enormous amount of nutrients. It spends much of its time fleeing from herbivores who mistake it for a seed.

entry: 即使食物绰绰有余，成群的POKENAME还是常为吃的争吵。它们对污染很敏感，因此难得出现在城市里。
author: strawbearycandy
source: Groups of POKENAME often squabble over food even if there is excess. Their sensitivity to pollution means they are rarely seen in urban environments.

entry: POKENAME会仔细打理种子和羽毛，清除可能妨碍光合作用的杂物。长长的脖子让它能轻松照料全身。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME diligently grooms its bulb and feathers to remove anything that might disrupt photosynthesis. Its long neck makes reaching everywhere easy.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME会摇响尾端花苞中的种子。这些种子晒干后，可是一道美味。
author: kandyman
source: When startled, POKENAME will rattle the seeds contained in the bud on the end of its tail. These seeds are considered a delicacy when sun-dried.

entry: POKENAME是最温柔的宝可梦之一。发现受伤的生物，就会用藤蔓像绷带一样，细心包好伤口。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME is one of the most gentle Pokémon to live. If it finds an injured creature, it'll wrap their wound up in vines like a bandage.

entry: POKENAME带花纹的腹部面积宽大，能吸收大量阳光。靠这些能量，它几个月不吃东西，也能生活。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME can absorb large amounts of sunlight due to the surface area of its patterned belly. Using this energy, it can go months without eating.

entry: POKENAME爱在太阳能板上睡觉，还会把它当食物啃，让电力公司头疼不已。一块板，就够一整群POKENAME吃上一周。
author: kandyman
source: POKENAME loves sleeping on and eating solar panelling, much to the annoyance of energy companies. A single panel can keep a herd fed for a week.

entry: POKENAME吸收的电力越多，尾尖的花苞就长得越大。临近进化时，还能看到花瓣从中探出来。
author: strawbearycandy
source: The more electricity POKENAME consumes, the larger the bulb at the tip of its tail becomes. Petals can be seen poking out as it approaches evolution.

entry: 白天，POKENAME会钻进沙漠的沙子里休息，只把种子留在地面上，沐浴阳光，获取养分。
author: Raza
source: POKENAME burrow into the desert sand to rest during the day, leaving their bulb aboveground to absorb nutrients from sunlight.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已经开始绽放。在野外，它会射出上面长出的多余叶片，抵御敌人。
author: Raza
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back has started to bloom. In the wild, they will defend themselves by shooting off spare leaves growing from it.

entry: POKENAME在日光下打盹时，谁也叫不醒。可太阳一落山，它又活力十足，完全不像平日里那么贪睡。
author: mysteriouswraith
source: No one can wake POKENAME as it naps in the sun. However, when the sun sets, it becomes far more energetic than its sleeping habits would suggest.

entry: 它用无辜的面孔与甜香引诱敌人，等对方放松警惕，便用庞大的身体将其击倒。
author: Soup1900
source: It lures in its foes with its innocent-looking head and sweet fragrance. Once the foe's guard is down, it will strike them down with its massive body.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处、绿意盎然的隐秘洞穴里。若能偶然遇上它，人们认为，附近必有令人惊叹的景象。
author: VeteranAdventurer
source: POKENAME lives in hidden, greenery-filled caves deep underground. To find one naturally is considered a sign you are near an awe-inspiring sight.

entry: 这只形似棍棒、被幽灵附身的宝可梦，若发现敲打没用，就会从种子般的头部，喷射植物弹丸。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: When bludgeoning won't do the job, this haunted, club-like Pokémon expels plant-based projectiles from its seed head.

entry: 这只宝可梦模样可爱，很受园丁欢迎。进行光合作用时，长长的飘带状藤蔓，能帮它吸收更多阳光。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This Pokémon is popular among gardeners for its cuteness. Its long, ribbon-like vines are used to absorb additional sunlight while photosynthesizing.

entry: POKENAME十分和善，也善于照顾其他生物。藤蔓就像延伸的四肢，它最爱用它们，陪许多小宝可梦一起玩。
author: volvonovic
source: An extremely kind and nurturing Pokémon, POKENAME uses its vines as an extension of its limbs. It enjoys using these to play with many small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的几颗种子里装着不同的孢子：左边使人中毒，右边使人麻痹，后面的则让人昏睡。
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulbs are filled with different spores. The left shoots out poison, the right one stuns, and the back makes you sleep.

entry: POKENAME的种子里装满了易燃液体。为了不洒出一滴，它总是摇摇摆摆地慢慢走。
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulb is filled to the brim with flammable liquid. It waddles slowly to avoid spilling a single drop.

entry: 常能看见它们的尾巴上开着花。随POKENAME栖息环境不同，每条尾巴还能长出不同种类的花。
author: KitArchen
source: They can often be spotted with flowers on their tails. Each tail can grow a different flower species on it depending on the POKENAME's environment.

entry: 尾巴上长出一颗硕大的花苞，里面正在成长的花朵，散发着神秘的热量。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: An enormous flower bud sprouts from its tail. The growing bloom inside radiates mystical heat.

entry: 包裹头部的种子保护着它强大的大脑。纸片般的小突起会散发精神能量，帮助它感知周围的生命。
author: rhysanthemum
source: The bulb covering its head protects its powerful mind. It senses beings with small, paper-like growths that emanate psychic energy.

entry: 身体的其他部分都已成熟，背上的种子却毫无变化。科学家认为，它的种子可能一生都会处于休眠。
author: Soup1900
source: Although the rest of its body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of its life.

entry: POKENAME必须小心，免得尾巴上的火焰烧到背上的种子。万一烧坏了，种子可能要花上数周才能重新长好。
author: Benevolent
source: POKENAME has to be careful not to accidentally burn its bulb with the flame on its tail. If that happens, it can take weeks for the bulb to grow back.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: Dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: 它白天欢欢喜喜地收集种子，夜里再撒播出去。集中精神时，还能让种子长得更快。
author: .izik
source: It happily gathers seeds during the daytime then spreads them at night. When it concentrates, it can make the seeds grow faster.

entry: POKENAME攻击性很强，会不停袭击附近的虫宝可梦。它常在阳光下休息，让绿色的羽毛恢复健康。
author: Adam941
source: POKENAME are aggressive, and relentlessly attack nearby bug Pokémon. It often rests in the sunlight, which heals its green feathers.

entry: POKENAME飞在翻涌的白云间，收集日光，让背上的种子茁壮成长。
author: deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the billowing white clouds, collecting sunlight for the seed on its back to grow.

entry: 它把爪子扎进泥土，为背上的种子吸取养分。每天如此，就不必与其他生物争抢食物。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: It buries its claws in the soil to absorbs nutrients into the bulbs on its back. It repeats this process daily to avoid having to compete for food.

entry: 种子长大到身体承受不住时，它们就会将其脱落，让新的种子生长。这些脱落的种子会被用来制作药品。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: Once their bulb grows too large for their body, they shed it so a new one can grow. These discarded bulbs are used to make curative items.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: Dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: POKENAME能摘下背上的种子掷出去。种子爆开时会撒出许多小种子，却不会造成伤害，园丁常借此快速大面积播种。
author: kandyman
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back can be detached and thrown, causing a harmless explosion of seeds. Gardeners often use this to sow in bulk quickly.

entry: POKENAME像猫一样，优雅地潜行于荒野。迷人的身姿，配上锋利的枝叶，既动人，又危险。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME prowls the wilds with feline grace. Its charm and sharp foliage make it an enchanting and dangerous sight.

entry: 如果POKENAME在飞行时伤了翅膀，尾部的种子就会打开，让它像蒲公英一样缓缓飘回地面。
author: kandyman
source: If POKENAME's wings are damaged during flight, the bulb on its tail will open and it will drift to the ground in a manner akin to a dandelion.

entry: 它们会吃掉藻类，帮忙清理池塘，作为家用帮手颇受欢迎。不过，千万别用它们清理含氯的泳池。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: They clean ponds of algae by eating it. This makes them popular for home use. However, it is strongly advised not to use them for chlorinated pools.

entry: 它们会吃掉藻类，帮忙清理池塘，作为家用帮手颇受欢迎。不过，千万别用它们清理含氯的泳池。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: They clean ponds of algae by eating it. This makes them popular for home use. However, it is strongly advised not to use them for chlorinated pools.

entry: 它们会吃掉藻类，帮忙清理池塘，作为家用帮手颇受欢迎。不过，千万别用它们清理含氯的泳池。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: They clean ponds of algae by eating it. This makes them popular for home use. However, it is strongly advised not to use them for chlorinated pools.

entry: POKENAME仰着肚子漂在湖面。它能用藤蔓抓住游过的猎物，再用腹部花纹将其催眠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME floats on its belly on the surface of lakes. It can grab prey swimming by with its vines and hypnotize it with its belly pattern.

entry: POKENAME仰着肚子漂在湖面。它能用藤蔓抓住游过的猎物，再用腹部花纹将其催眠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME floats on its belly on the surface of lakes. It can grab prey swimming by with its vines and hypnotize it with its belly pattern.

entry: POKENAME把真正的身体藏在大花苞后，护住柔软的内部，好在水中安然漂浮。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME conceals its true body behind a large bud. This protects its soft interior so that it can float safely in the water.

entry: 这只宝可梦把所有能量都用于生长，一天大部分时间都在睡觉。它只会短暂醒来，瞬间移动到阳光充足的地方。
author: r.isk
source: This Pokémon devotes all its energy to growing, sleeping for most of the day. It only wakes up briefly in order to teleport to sunny spots.

entry: POKENAME冥想时，手中的汤匙会把花粉散向四周。即使处于这种状态，它仍敏锐地留意着周围。
author: krsgaming
source: When a POKENAME is meditating the spoon it has will spread pollen throughout the nearby area. While in this state they are observant and aware.

entry: POKENAME集中精神时，种子就会产生花粉。据说，这种花粉能让任何植物立刻恢复健康。
author: krsgaming
source: When a POKENAME is focused, its bulbs will produce pollen. It is said that the pollen can instantly heal any plant.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力影响种子生长。近来，人们开始将它视为带来丰收的使者。
author: Cipher
source: Able to influence the growth of seeds with its psychic powers, POKENAME has recently been considered a bringer of bountiful harvests.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里时，常被公园管理员当成一颗大种子，埋进土中。幸好，它很会挖洞。
author: kandyman
source: When retracted into its shell, POKENAME is often mistaken for a large seed by park rangers and buried. Thankfully, it is an adept digger.

entry: 尾巴发黄，是它高龄长寿的象征。与卡咪龟不同，壳上长藻并不意味着它很老。
author: Soup1900
source: If its tail has turned yellow, it is a sign of its old age and longevity. Unlike Wartortle, algae on its shell does not mean it is very old.

entry: POKENAME身边环绕的种子始终带着电。能量积蓄到一定程度，就会泛起明亮的绿光。
author: char_latte3412
source: The bulbs surrounding POKENAME's body are always electrically charged. When enough energy has built up, these bulbs will glow bright green.

entry: POKENAME是一种体型庞大、以双足行走的爬行动物宝可梦。它最醒目的特征，是出生时便种在背上的那颗种子。
author: Kames
source: POKENAME is a large, bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. Its most notable feature is the bulb on its back which was planted on it at birth.

entry: POKENAME摆动种子时，会向周围的植物传递治愈能量。它的催眠能力不强，因此要同时使用两个摆锤。
author: noel5229
source: When POKENAME swings its bulb, it transmits healing energy to plants surrounding it. Its hypnosis abilities are weak, so it uses two pendulums.

entry: POKENAME会用脚底的吸盘爬上高树，让背上的种子，得到更多阳光。
author: Curerry
source: POKENAME can be seen climbing tall trees using suction cups on its feet. This helps provide sunlight for the seed on its back.

entry: 这是只没能完全化蛹的绿毛虫，可怜它柔软的头部仍露在外面，余下的蛹状身体却一动也动不了。
author: kiwikelly
source: This unfortunate fusion is a Caterpie who failed to fully pupate, leaving its soft head exposed and the rest of its chrysalis body unable to move.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是力量增长得太快的绿毛虫，竟整个跳过了铁甲蛹的进化阶段。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are said to be Caterpie who gained power so fast that they skipped their Metapod evolution stage entirely.

entry: 冬天，它会用刀刃凿开冻硬的树木。凿到树心后，便把里面的树汁吸出来。
author: .izik
source: In the winter months, it will use its blades to chop into freezing trees. Once it reaches the center, it will suck out any sap.

entry: 融合让它够得到比以往更高的叶子，因此，争抢食物的对手也少了。
author: Eye Of Cthulhu
source: Its fusion has enabled it to reach leaves much higher than normal, so it faces less competition for food.

entry: POKENAME能用长臂灵巧地爬树，寻找最美味的叶片时，这项本领格外有用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can use its long arms to climb trees with great precision. This is helpful when it is hunting for the most delicious leaves.

entry: 这是关都最常见的融合宝可梦之一。遇上敌人，它就从触角释放毒气，驱赶对方。
author: Soup1900
source: One of the most common fusions of the Kanto region. To ward off its enemies, it releases a poisonous gas from its antennae.

entry: 这是关都最常见的融合宝可梦之一。遇上敌人，它就从触角释放毒气，驱赶对方。
author: Soup1900
source: One of the most common fusions of the Kanto region. To ward off its enemies, it releases a poisonous gas from its antennae.

entry: 吸食树汁时，它会排出一股恶臭的液体，让天敌不敢轻易下口。
author: .izik
source: As it consumes tree sap from a trunk, it will excrete a horrible smelling liquid. This fluid discourages predators from attacking.

entry: 它飞来飞去，用毒针串起树上的果实。连飞行时也抓紧进食，尽可能少耽搁时间。
author: .izik
source: It will fly from tree to tree, skewering fruit on its stingers. It consumes the fruit during flight to minimize downtime.

entry: POKENAME是巢穴的空中哨兵。一看见敌人，便立刻通知巢里更强壮的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME acts as a flying scout for its home nest. If it makes visual contact with an enemy, it immediately informs the stronger nest inhabitants.

entry: 它按族群划定的区域巡查。若看见友善的面孔，就会微笑着左右摇晃身体。
author: .izik
source: It scouts an area determined by its pack. Should it see a friendly face, it will tilt its body back and forth while smiling.

entry: 雄性POKENAME会跳舞来吸引雌性，这在昆虫中十分罕见。它似乎从咕咕的基因中继承了这种能力。
author: holgast
source: Though unusual for insects, a male POKENAME performs a dance to attract females. It appears to have developed this ability from its Hoothoot DNA.

entry: POKENAME会藏在豌豆与葡萄间伪装自己。若你的果蔬里飘出怪味，说不定就藏了一只。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME camouflages itself amongst peas and grapes. If you notice a strange smell, one is probably hiding in yours.

entry: 有些绿波不再化蛹，而是不断磨炼飞行本领，最终长成POKENAME。它们是身手格外敏捷的哨兵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some Catergey do not pupate, but continue to develop their flying skills and become POKENAME. They are incredibly agile scouts.

entry: POKENAME的诱敌器官里，充满了丝线。随着年龄渐长、进化临近，也会变得越来越大。
author: kiwikelly
source: The lures of POKENAME are filled with silk. They get larger as it ages and grows closer to evolution.

entry: 它会从头上的触角放出电流。即使睡着，身上也不时迸出火花。
author: .izik
source: It lets loose bolts of electricity from the antennae on its head. Its body will even spark intermittently while it sleeps.

entry: 人们饲养POKENAME，是为了获取它柔软而丰富的丝。经过培育，它们会在进化前脱落丝线，而不是用丝线结茧。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are raised for their soft, abundant silk. They were bred to shed the silk instead of spinning it into cocoons before evolution.

entry: POKENAME是巢穴的首领。一个巢中可以有好几只POKENAME，彼此合作，一同管理。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is the leader of its home nest. There can be several POKENAME per nest, who manage the it cooperatively.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软、多汁，又没有什么防护，全靠凶猛的叫声吓退天敌。若没吓住，就只好逃跑。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are very soft, juicy and defenseless, so they rely on their intimidating cry to scare away predators. If that fails, they will run away.

entry: 它力气不大，便钻进泥土，装成一丛草。头上的角气味难闻，尝起来也很糟。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It's not very strong, so it wriggles into dirt and pretends to be a tuft of grass. The horns atop its head are smelly and foul-tasting.

entry: POKENAME其实只是戴着死去绿毛虫头部的妙蛙种子。有人见过它与关都另外两种最初的伙伴，一起做出些让人起疑的举动。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME is just a Bulbasaur wearing a deceased Caterpie head. It's been seen beside two other starters from the Kanto region doing questionable acts.

entry: POKENAME从头上的红色触角释放气味，标记领地，也驱走那些打扰它晒太阳的天敌。
author: Curerry
source: POKENAME mark their territory by releasing an odor from the red antenna on their head. This wards off predators that disturb its sun bathing.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会袭击食品储藏室，飞快地吃光眼前的一切。可实际上，它们性情害羞，只吃野外的种子。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are said to raid food pantries, quickly devouring everything in sight. They, however, are actually shy Pokémon who feed solely on wild seeds.

entry: 它大口大口地啃食海藻。有些POKENAME甚至会攀住经过的破破舵轮，将其当作猎物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It voraciously munches on seaweed. Some POKENAME have even been known to cling to and prey on passing Dhelmise.

entry: POKENAME雄心勃勃，靠不断训练锻炼自己。正因为它实在弱小，那股永不懈怠的志气，才让许多人敬佩。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is ambitious, strengthening itself with constant training. Many admire POKENAME's tireless ambition precisely because of its actual weakness.

entry: 虽然常被人看轻，POKENAME还是整天训练，一心想要变强。它总爱向远比自己强大的对手挑战。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: Considered weak by many, POKENAME spends all day training, hoping to grow stronger. It tends to pick fights against opponents far stronger than it.

entry: POKENAME雄心勃勃，靠不断训练锻炼自己。正因为它实在弱小，那股永不懈怠的志气，才让许多人敬佩。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is ambitious, strengthening itself with constant training. Many admire POKENAME's tireless ambition precisely because of its actual weakness.

entry: POKENAME一摆尾，就能掀倒再强壮的敌人。夜里，它会反复拍击湖面，宣告自己的领地。
author: .izik
source: Using its tail, a POKENAME can topple even the strongest foes. At night, it slaps a lake's surface repeatedly to declare its territory.

entry: 春天，POKENAME背上的花会散出甜香的花粉，令人类和宝可梦都感到舒心。
author: Curerry
source: During the springtime, POKENAME releases a sweet smelling pollen from the flower on its back. This pollen is also soothing to Humans and Pokémon.

entry: 有人见过森林里的动物，为野生POKENAME送来食物。随着年岁增长，它们也越来越大、越来越懒。
author: theartemis1
source: Animals of the forest have been observed bringing food to wild POKENAME. They continue growing larger and lazier with age.

entry: POKENAME已重得无法住在树上。不过，它的力气也大得惊人，再不必躲躲藏藏，反能将敌人打得落荒而逃。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to live on trees. Thanks to its great physical strength, however, it no longer has to hide, but can put enemies to rout.

entry: 这只奇异的虫宝可梦会摆动身体，挥起用自身丝线制成的连枷，抵御天敌。连枷若有损伤，很快又能吐丝织好。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This strange bug wards off predators by using its body to swing a flail made of its own silk. It quickly spins it back together if it's damaged.

entry: 修长而分节的身体，让它能钻过狭窄的缝隙。只要POKENAME的头能伸进去，整副身子也就能挤过去。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its long, segmented body allows it to squirm its way through narrow openings. Anything POKENAME can stick its head through, it can squirm through.

entry: 这只庞大的宝可梦游荡林间，沉重的脚步声，常吓坏孩子。可它自己，其实仍像普通绿毛虫一样胆小。
author: chartanon
source: This massive Pokémon wanders forests, terrifying children with its loud stomps. Despite this, it is still just as skittish as an ordinary Caterpie.

entry: 科学家用超声波检查融合宝可梦的蛋时发现，POKENAME的身体，竟从普通绿毛虫头部的下方长出来。
author: holgast
source: By examining fusion eggs with ultrasound, scientists have found that POKENAME's body grows out of the bottom of a regular Caterpie's head.

entry: 对战中若忽然闻到自然的清香，面对的很可能就是POKENAME。气味怡人，也让它成了常见的居家伙伴。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Smelling the scent of nature during a Pokémon battle means you're likely facing POKENAME. It is often kept in houses due to its pleasant scent.

entry: 这只宝可梦对绿毛虫痴迷不已。它会打开构成头部的大花苞，把一只绿毛虫安置在里面，像宠物一样悉心照料。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon obsessed with Caterpie. It opens up the large bulb that is its head and places one inside, caring for it like a pet.

entry: 这只宝可梦对绿毛虫痴迷不已。它会打开构成头部的大花苞，把一只绿毛虫安置在里面，像宠物一样悉心照料。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon obsessed with Caterpie. It opens up the large bulb that is its head and places one inside, caring for it like a pet.

entry: POKENAME会用强壮的腿摘取树梢的果实。它尤其偏爱墨莓果，喜欢那股涩味。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will use its strong legs to grab fruit off of the top of trees. It prefers Bluk Berries due to their dry taste.

entry: POKENAME沿着一根树枝挪动，都要花上几个小时。可附近的叶子一吃完，它便吐丝牵住另一棵树，飞快地荡过去。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME takes hours to move along a branch. However, once it has eaten all the nearby leaves, it uses string to swing at high speeds to a new tree.

entry: 它爬上高树，装作一根树枝。这副不起眼的伪装，能让它躲过天敌的视线，安心大嚼高处的叶子。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It climbs into tall trees and mimics a branch. This unassuming disguise hides it from predators while it feasts on high-up leaves.

entry: 它贪嘴得很，看见什么都想吃。POKENAME常把自己站着的叶子也吃掉，随后一头掉下树去。
author: holgast
source: Its eyes are far bigger than its stomach, so it will eat anything. POKENAME often falls out of trees after eating the leaf it's standing on.

entry: 若被意外吵醒，POKENAME就会上蹿下跳，撒出橙色的花粉。吸入后会使人浑身无力，严重时甚至麻痹。
author: .izik
source: If accidentally awoken, a POKENAME will hop up and down to spread an orange pollen. If inhaled, this can cause weakness, or even paralysis.

entry: 大耳朵能让它听见250米外猎物的动静。夜里若有旅人经过森林，它便会从上方扑下。
author: .izik
source: Using its big ears, it can hear prey from 250 meters away. Should it see a traveler walking through a forest at night, it will swoop down onto them.

entry: POKENAME常扒在灭虫灯上，享受热量与能量。偏偏这样会让灯失效，惹得人类头疼。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is often found clinging to bug zappers, enjoying the heat and energy. This annoys humans, as it disables the device.

entry: 它一打喷嚏，就可能不慎把火星喷得满地都是。若不及时控制，便可能酿成山火。
author: .izik
source: Should it sneeze, it may accidentally spray embers across the ground. If not kept in check, a forest fire can start.

entry: 人们曾以为，训练家受到惊吓，一脚踩扁绿毛虫，便会产生POKENAME。
author: kiwikelly
source: It was once believed that POKENAME was formed when scared Trainers stepped on a Caterpie to squash it.

entry: 它大部分时间都待在下水道的墙壁上，啃食霉菌。年纪越大，食量反而越小，最后只吃一口，也能活下去。
author: .izik
source: It spends most of its time on sewer walls, eating mold. As it gets older, it will consume less and less until it can survive on a single bite.

entry: POKENAME十分脆弱，只好藏在泥土里，靠光合作用积蓄进化所需的能量。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is very vulnerable, so it hides in the soil and photosynthesizes to gather the energy it needs to evolve.

entry: 看见林间空地，它就忍不住想跳舞。可一旦被人撞见，又会羞得躲起来。
author: .izik
source: If it sees a forest clearing, it will have an overwhelming urge to dance. Should it be seen by someone, it will grow embarrassed and hide.

entry: POKENAME羽毛间产生的丝黏性极强，必须起舞、奋力振翅，才能把丝线甩向敌人。
author: kiwikelly
source: The silk POKENAME produces from its feathers is very sticky, so POKENAME must dance and flail its wings vigorously to throw the silk at its enemies.

entry: 它用丝线织成时髦的茧饰，可POKENAME行动迟缓，又毫无防御能力，饰品常被偷猎者抢走。
author: kiwikelly
source: It spins its silk into fashionable cocoon accessories, which are often then stolen by poachers, as POKENAME is very slow-moving and defenseless.

entry: 双翼末端锋利得惊人。采食时，它便跳起优雅的舞，割下大量叶片。
author: .izik
source: The ends of its wings are exceptionally sharp. To gather food, it will do an elegant dance and cut down large quantities of leaves.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会发出呻吟，仿佛一位正受痛苦折磨的老妇人。若有人上前相助，就会被它吃掉，化为进化的能量。
author: .izik
source: Late at night, a POKENAME groans as if it is an elderly woman in pain. Should a person assist, it will consume them, storing energy for evolution.

entry: 它用丝线缠住大树，吸干其中的生命力。树越大，越合它的心意。
author: .ssunday.
source: It uses its silk to wrap around large trees and suck all of its vitality. It only likes to go after larger trees.

entry: 许多高级餐厅会用POKENAME的爪子点缀菜肴。那酸甜的滋味，让厨师们趋之若鹜。
author: .izik
source: The claws of a POKENAME are used in many upscale restaurants as a garnish. The tangy-sweet flavor is coveted by culinarians.

entry: 它每次抖动毛发，都会扬起一阵绿色粉尘。粉尘落在人皮肤上，还会随那人的心情，变换颜色。
author: .izik
source: Any time it shakes its fur, a waft of green dust is shaken loose. The dust will change color on a person's skin based on their mood.

entry: POKENAME把丝线团成球，最爱追着球玩。凭着灵敏的触角与胡须，它也是一位出色的猎手。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME spins its silk into balls, which it loves to play with and chase around. Thanks to its antenna and whiskers, it's an excellent hunter.

entry: 它吊在树枝间，趁猎物不备发动袭击。即使相隔100码，胡须也能察觉受伤目标的踪迹。
author: .izik
source: It hangs from tree branches to catch its prey off-guard. Its whiskers can sense an injured target from up to 100 yards away.

entry: 尾巴上的小火苗，既微弱，又只有些许温热。近来，人们越来越喜欢请它在温室中帮忙授粉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The diminutive flame on its tail is weak and lukewarm. In recent times, it has grown in popularity as a greenhouse pollinator.

entry: POKENAME的触角，连敌人最细微的动作也能感知，借此预判下一招，成了出色的拳击手。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's antenna helps it detect even the smallest movement of its enemies, making it able to predict their moves. POKENAME is thus a great boxer.

entry: 它听力很差，只能靠触角感知外界的动静。一察觉异样，便毫不犹豫地瞬间移动逃走。
author: .izik
source: Its hearing is terrible. Due to this disability, it senses disturbances by using its antennae and teleports away without a second thought.

entry: 它欢快地跑遍森林，寻找黄球果。一旦找到，就想一口把整颗吞下去。
author: .izik
source: It happily runs across entire forests searching for Yellow Apricorns. Should it find one, it will attempt to devour the entire fruit in one motion.

entry: 身体两侧的角，电光噼啪作响。若有鸟宝可梦咬住它，它便竭尽全力，放电反击。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The horns on its sides crackle with electricity. When a bird Pokémon bites down, it zaps them with all the might it can muster.

entry: 这种罕见的霹雳电球融合体，模样酷似大师球。为何会变成这样，至今没人知道。
author: kiwikelly
source: This rare Voltorb fusion resembles a Master Ball. No one knows what causes this fusion to take on that appearance.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME会来到高原，抬起角，主动迎接雷击。每受一次雷击，它便更强一分。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME rests on high plateaus during thunderstorms and raises its horn to be struck by lightning. It grows stronger with each lightning strike.

entry: 越是生气，头顶附肢间的电弧就越猛烈。若再不冷静下来，连自己也会挨电。
author: char_latte3412
source: The electric arc between its top appendages will increase in intensity as it gets angry. It will start shocking itself if it doesn't calm down.

entry: POKENAME泛着柔光，双翼每一次轻振，都把快乐带向四方。它象征着光与电和谐相融。
author: anarchaz
source: Emitting a gentle glow, POKENAME spreads joy with every flutter of its wings. It symbolizes the harmony between light and electricity.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛中蓄着强大电力，最好不要触碰。那些在羊毛里盘旋的电流，还能从尾巴射出去。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's wool is highly energized, so it is not advisable to touch it. It can shoot the electricity swirling around in its wool via its tail.

entry: POKENAME把体内产生的电力，导入颈毛与毛簇。必要时，再由尾巴聚成一束射出。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME directs the electricity generated in its body into its ruff and tuft. If necessary, it can shoot it in a bundle via its tail.

entry: 它的尾巴如同避雷针，会吸引附近的电力。高压线路也常被波及，造成短暂停电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its tail acts as a lightning rod that can attract nearby electricity. High voltage power lines are often affected, causing temporary power blackouts.

entry: POKENAME装成精灵球，藏进发电厂，以那里产生的能量为食。一旦被发现，便会焦躁不安。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a Poké Ball to hide in power plants and feed off the energy produced there. It becomes agitated if discovered.

entry: POKENAME惯于吸收敌人攻击中的能量，再冲着对方的脸炸开。正因如此，与它交战格外危险。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME have a habit of taking energy from an enemy's attack and using it to explode in their face. It's considered dangerous to fight due to this.

entry: POKENAME球状的双钳，各自都能发电。恶战之中，它会将两钳合拢，爆发毁灭性的威力。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's ball-like pincers serve as independent generators. During challenging battles, it brings its pincers together with devastating effects.

entry: POKENAME飞快地旋转双臂，积蓄能量。随后，便能在一场猛烈爆炸中，将能量尽数释放。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME charges energy by swinging its arms rapidly in circles. It can then release its stored energy all at once in a violent explosion.

entry: 它会把捡到的、或模样特别的精灵球收集在背上。有些POKENAME还会模仿训练家，把球朝宝可梦发射出去。
author: totodile.
source: This Pokémon is known to collect dropped or unique Pokeballs on its back. Some POKENAME mimic Trainers by firing said balls at Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将电击导入始终发光的附肢。落入下风时，它便用腿扒住敌人的脸，引爆自己。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME channel electric attacks into its constantly-glowing limbs. If it's losing, it grabs onto a foe's face with its legs and explodes.

entry: POKENAME的下半身与感觉器官，完全由等离子体构成。因此，它睡着时，看上去与霹雳电球毫无分别。
author: totodile.
source: A POKENAME's lower body and sensory organs are composed entirely of plasma. Due to this, it is indistinguishable from a Voltorb when it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME会用头撞击敌人，并释放1,000,000瓦的电力。它光滑的头部正是力量的来源。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME rams its head into foes and releases 1,000,000 watts of power. Its smooth head is the source of its power.

entry: 蓝色的能放电，红色的擅长砸击。若被分开，它们都会变得郁郁寡欢，十分孤独。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: The blue one has the power to electrify, while the red one has the strength to smash. If separated, they will become depressed and lonely.

entry: 它们动不动就自爆，发电厂附近常能见到昏倒的个体。身上的飘带，其实由纯粹的电能构成。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Prone to self-destruction, they are often found fainted near power plants. The ribbons on its body are made of pure electricity.

entry: 出现爆炸的噩梦中，很可能会有POKENAME的身影。腹内的漆黑圆珠，维系着它的生命与健康。
author: Lemmymaster #7521
source: POKENAME will likely appear in nightmares that have explosions in them. The dark orb in its stomach keeps it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME本想藏进训练家丢弃的球里，冒充霹雳电球，结果反倒成了更难辨认的精灵球拟态者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In trying to disguise as a Voltorb by hiding in a Trainer's discarded ball, POKENAME instead became an even more indistinguishable Poké Ball mimic.

entry: POKENAME会投掷精灵球。有人推测，它们前世曾是训练家，至今还握着生前最心爱的那一颗。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to throw Poké Balls. It's been theorized that they were Trainers in a past life, and still hold their favorite Poké Ball.

entry: 它们装成半埋土中的精灵球，藏在森林与荒废之地。训练家若想把它们拔出来，它们就会爆炸。
author: totodile.
source: They disguise themselves as half-buried Pokéballs in forests and abandoned areas. When a Trainer tries to pull them out of the ground, they explode.

entry: 霹雳电球怒气过盛，便会变成POKENAME。冒出的烟与闪电，正是它即将爆炸的征兆。
author: TheHeroicT
source: When a Voltorb becomes too angry, it becomes POKENAME. The smoke and lightning indicates that it's close to blowing up.

entry: 它毛茸茸的，抱着十分舒服，脾气却常常不大好。若亲热过了头，就得挨一记电击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It's fluffy and easy to cuddle, but it's also often bad-tempered. It gives electric shocks to people who are too affectionate.

entry: 它毛茸茸的，抱着十分舒服，脾气却常常不大好。若亲热过了头，就得挨一记电击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It's fluffy and easy to cuddle, but it's also often bad-tempered. It gives electric shocks to people who are too affectionate.

entry: 双翼如同太阳能电池，将多余的能量化为电力放出。可若吸收了太多阳光，POKENAME便可能爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its wings function like solar cells, releasing excess energy as electricity. If POKENAME absorbs too much sunlight, it can explode.

entry: 电能储存过量，让POKENAME饱受剧烈头痛的折磨，也让它们的脾气格外暴躁。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are plagued with furious headaches caused by an excess storage of electric energy. Due to this, these Pokémon have very short tempers.

entry: 业余钓客最好避开POKENAME出没的危险水域。它的身体闪着光，很容易被误当成灯笼鱼。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Amateur anglers are advised not to fish in the territories of dangerous POKENAME. They can easily be mistaken for Chinchou with their sparkling body.

entry: 苍白的体色，加上迅疾的身手，让POKENAME得了“深海幽灵”的名号。人类鲜少有幸见到它。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The pale coloration as well as its fast locomotion earned POKENAME the nickname as the "phantom of the deep sea". It is rarely seen by humans.

entry: POKENAME钻进沙中，把双钳伸向上方。猎物一从中穿过，便会遭到电击，像挨了电击枪一样麻痹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME burrows into the sand and stretches its claws upwards. Any prey that passes through them is paralyzed as if by a taser shot.

entry: POKENAME钻进沙中，把双钳伸向上方。猎物一从中穿过，便会遭到电击，像挨了电击枪一样麻痹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME burrows into the sand and stretches its claws upwards. Any prey that passes through them is paralyzed as if by a taser shot.

entry: POKENAME钻进沙中，把双钳伸向上方。猎物一从中穿过，便会遭到电击，像挨了电击枪一样麻痹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME burrows into the sand and stretches its claws upwards. Any prey that passes through them is paralyzed as if by a taser shot.

entry: POKENAME能像除颤器一样给双钳充电，将敌人电得动弹不得。充电的次数越多，电击也就越强。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can charge its claws like a defibrillator to incapacitate its enemies. The more often it charges its claws, the stronger the shock.

entry: 霹雳电球小小的身体里竟塞进了顽皮雷弹的爆炸威力。身体太小，也让它爆炸的可能性增加了一倍。
author: Soup1900
source: It has the explosive power of Electrode packed into the small body of Voltorb. Its small body makes it twice as likely to explode.

entry: POKENAME主要以电力为食，常想强行闯进发电厂，因此在某些地方被视为害兽。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME feeds primarily on electricity. As they often try to brute force their way into power plants, they are classified as a pest in some areas.

entry: POKENAME的角能产生超过5000安培的电流。由此形成的电弧足以致命，千万不要靠近。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can generate currents of over 5000 amperes with its horn. The resulting electric arcs are lethal and should be avoided at all costs.

entry: POKENAME能让碰到的东西像炸弹一样爆炸，主要借此捕猎，例如捕捉电蛋。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME possess the ability of making everything it touches explodes like a bomb. POKENAME mainly uses it to hunt its prey, such as Galvancute.

entry: POKENAME出手快如闪电，力量也足以引发爆炸。工厂与发电厂附近，常能找到它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME strikes foes with lightning-fast speed and explosive power. It can be found near factories and power plants.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: Xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: Xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: POKENAME始终咧嘴笑着，既吸引宝可梦靠近，又让人类心中发毛。这副笑容，倒成了不错的求生本领。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME wears a perpetual grin, which draws in Pokémon while causing humans to feel unnerved. This turns out to be a good survival mechanism.

entry: POKENAME会在阳光下或雷雨中静卧，尽可能多地吸收能量。多余的部分则靠爆炸释放。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lay still in the sun and during thunderstorms in order to bask in as much energy as possible. Excess energy is released through explosions.

entry: 据说，POKENAME最初诞生在宝可梦屋地下，是制造终极武器的尝试。别看模样吓人，性情倒颇为开朗。
author: knilk
source: It's said that POKENAME was first created beneath Pokémon Mansion in an attempt to create an ultimate weapon. Despite its looks, it's quite cheerful.

entry: 传说，POKENAME原是天使般宝可梦王冠上的宝石，锤子模样的身体则由那顶王冠的碎片构成。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: According to legend, POKENAME were once gems that rested on the crown of an angelic Pokémon, and its hammer-like bodies are pieces of said crown.

entry: 若碰见POKENAME，发现它的引线正燃着，就快跑吧——它马上要自爆了。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: If you come across a POKENAME and its fuse is burning, run. It is about to self-destruct.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时火焰与花瓣一同迸散。同类交锋，它便以自己的爆炸回敬对方的爆炸。
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's explosions are filled with bursts of fire and petals. When fighting one another, this Pokémon counters explosions with blasts of its own.

entry: POKENAME一爆炸，火光与花瓣便会四处飞散。建议训练家带它练练，如何控制怒气。
author: Xenophacilus
source: The explosions POKENAME lets out burst with fire and flower petals. Trainers are advised to put this Pokémon in anger management training.

entry: POKENAME玩起来，常常过了头，甚至酿成危险。有时它会举着电球追人，仿佛在玩躲避球。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME can be overly playful to the point of being a hazard. It sometimes chases people with its electrical ball as if it were playing dodgeball.

entry: 里面的宝可梦，已经发挥出外壳的全部潜能。身体快撑开接缝，正等着伏击下一个毫无戒心、想来搜刮宝物的训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The Pokémon inside has unlocked the full potential of its shell, bursting at the seams to ambush the next unsuspecting Trainer looking to loot it.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找威力最强的精灵球。即使已经拿到高级球，也不肯停下，仿佛还有更强的球，尚未找到。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME searches for the strongest Pokéball they can find. Even if it holds an Ultra Ball, it keeps looking, suggesting a more powerful ball exists.

entry: 人们相信，这只宝可梦很久以前就灭绝了。遇险便爆散成冰寒暴风雪的习性，似乎正是灭绝的原因。
author: mx_wellman
source: This Pokémon is believed to have gone extinct long ago. Its defense mechanism of exploding into a frigid blizzard seems to be the reason why.

entry: 它的触角能释放强力电击毁坏电子设备，因此POKENAME很受盗贼欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its antennae can emit powerful electrical shocks that can destroy electronic devices. This makes POKENAME a popular companion for thieves.

entry: 训练家常把熟睡的POKENAME误当成精灵球。若突然碰到它，往往会毫无预兆地爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Trainers often mistake sleeping POKENAME for Pokéballs. If it is suddenly touched, it often explodes without warning.

entry: 训练家常把熟睡的POKENAME误当成精灵球。若突然碰到它，往往会毫无预兆地爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Trainers often mistake sleeping POKENAME for Pokéballs. If it is suddenly touched, it often explodes without warning.

entry: POKENAME喜欢被人关注，却又担心抚摸时积起的静电，终有一天会电伤训练家。
author: cipherlingarde
source: It loves attention, but POKENAME worries the natural buildup of static electricity from petting will electrocute its Trainer one day.

entry: POKENAME带有麻痹效果的电流中，还混着腐蚀性毒液。一旦被蜇伤，必须立即处理。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's paralyzing electricity mixes with a corrosive poison. Stings must be treated immediately.

entry: POKENAME是出手极快的海洋猎手，转眼就能用带电的触手缠住猎物，电得对方无力反抗。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast-acting predators of the sea. They can bind prey in their electrified tentacles in a flash, shocking them into submission.

entry: POKENAME迅速扩散让现代船只大伤脑筋。它只需片刻，就能让船上的设备与导航系统一同瘫痪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Modern ships have major problems with the rapid spread of POKENAME, as it can paralyze their technology and navigation within a very short time.

entry: 吸收过多能量时，身体便会闪烁红光。若闪光转黄，就说明，它已准备爆炸。
author: .izik
source: Its body blinks with a red light if it absorbs too much energy. If the flashing light turns yellow, it is ready to explode.

entry: 它们的双钳形似精灵球。有人推测，它借此引来冲浪的训练家与宝可梦，再将其电倒。
author: MaNandesz
source: Their pincers resemble Pokéballs. It's theorized that it uses them to draw in surfing Trainers and Pokémon to shock them.

entry: 它用精灵球般的双钳引诱训练家的宝可梦靠近，再以强烈电击制住猎物迅速拖进水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Pokéball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: 它用精灵球般的双钳引诱训练家的宝可梦靠近，再以强烈电击制住猎物迅速拖进水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Pokéball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: 它用精灵球般的双钳引诱训练家的宝可梦靠近，再以强烈电击制住猎物迅速拖进水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Pokéball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: POKENAME背着一颗巨大的种子。过上一阵，种子便会脱落，从中长出一只妙蛙树。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME hold a giant seed on their back. After some time, the seed will fall off, and a Bulbator will grow from it.

entry: 它背上的巨型蛋黄，可以取下烹饪。但若这样做超过五次，POKENAME就会死去。
author: holgast
source: The giant egg yolk can be removed from its back to use in cooking. However, POKENAME dies if this is done more than five times.

entry: 它的身体是一整枚巨大而柔韧的蛋壳。POKENAME越健康蛋壳也越结实。
author: holgast
source: Its body is a single giant, flexible eggshell. The shell is stronger if POKENAME is in good health.

entry: 飞行虽十分费劲，POKENAME却从不气馁，始终保持太阳蛋般的明朗心情。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME struggles to fly, but that doesn't deter it—it'll keep up its sunny-side mindset no matter what.

entry: POKENAME自信十足，整天跑来跑去，爬上爬下，连家具也不放过，照料起来着实费神。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME are known to be very confident. Their spend their energy running around and climbing furniture, making them a challenge to take care of.

entry: 它飞行时，身体底部会不断剥落碎片。若哪天彻底破开，里面大量酸臭的液体，就会流出来。
author: .izik
source: The base of its body chips away as it flies. Should it ever break entirely, a large amount of sour-smelling fluid will pour out.

entry: POKENAME喜欢欺负其他幼小的宝可梦。早餐常不舍得自己吃，偏要拿来砸别人，恶作剧取乐。
author: Novellavaria
source: POKENAME enjoys bullying other baby Pokémon. Its favorite prank involves throwing food at someone instead of eating its breakfast.

entry: POKENAME宛如一枚长着兔耳的巨大煎蛋。金黄的表面闪闪发亮，悄然融进洒满阳光的水面。
author: anarchaz
source: A colossal fried egg with bunny ears, POKENAME's golden surface glimmers, blending seamlessly into sunlit waters.

entry: 它的花苞中滴出的液体富含氮和钾。关都的麦农深知这一点，经常请POKENAME来帮忙。
author: .izik
source: The fluid that drips out of its bulb is high in nitrogen and potassium. Knowing this, wheat farmers in Kanto frequently employ POKENAME.

entry: 这只宝可梦的外壳厚实得出奇。壳上渗出的树脂，还能缓冲撞击进一步保护它。
author: caladria
source: The shell of this Pokémon is surprisingly sturdy and thick. The resin that oozes from its shell gives it extra protection from impacts.

entry: 它笨拙地跑过森林深处，发出古怪的叫声。似乎总会被自己的腿绊倒。
author: .izik
source: It awkwardly gallops through the deeper portions of the forest while making an odd cry. It seems to trip over its own legs on a regular basis.

entry: 头部裂开后，POKENAME便难以控制穿越时间的能力。肚子上的那张脸，也总忧心忡忡。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has difficulty controlling its time-travel abilities now that its head has cracked. The face on its belly worries incessantly.

entry: POKENAME耳中会流出黄色液体，人们常用它来制作粘粘肥。
author: .izik
source: A yellow fluid leaks from the ears of a POKENAME. This substance is regularly used in the creation of Gooey Mulch.

entry: POKENAME长着一副蛋脑袋，常被其他土台龟融合体取笑。可POKENAME倒很知足：六颗头都完好无损，就够开心了。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME is often made fun of by other Torterra fusions for having an egg head. But POKENAME is just happy that all its six heads are in one piece.

entry: POKENAME最大的一簇胡须能充当巢穴，保护同胞。它产生的磁场让大家不至于彼此散开。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The largest part of POKENAME's moustache acts as a nest to protect its siblings. Its magnetic field keeps them from being separated.

entry: POKENAME为何折磨同族，生物学家至今不解。最受认可的说法，是它想压制同族成长，以免自己的地位被取代。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Biologists are perplexed as to why POKENAME tortures its kin. The most popular theory is that it is stunting their growth to prevent usurpation.

entry: 蛋与剑各是独立的生命，靠心灵感应相连。即使被分开，也会彼此吸引，重新合在一起。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The egg and sword are separate entities with a telepathic bond. They attract and rejoin each other after being separated.

entry: POKENAME的同胞，会从主体上萌发而出。主体产生的蛋黄供养着它们，直到能脱离主体，独立生活。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its siblings bud off the main body of POKENAME. The yolk it produces feeds its siblings until they are able to split off onto their own.

entry: POKENAME的蛋看着诱人，吃起来却极辣。蛋里本就有充足的香料与盐，早已调好了味。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME eggs seem tempting to eat, but are very spicy. The eggs are well-seasoned with spices and salts.

entry: 身体的六个部分由一条半透明的精神能量线连在一起。睡过的地方，还会长出小小的黄色蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: All six sections of its body are linked by a translucent line of psychic energy. Small yellow mushrooms grow in areas where it sleeps.

entry: 许多厨师都把POKENAME带在身边。菜肴还差些火候，还是缺点滋味，它都能预先察觉。
author: .ssunday.
source: Many chefs keep a POKENAME by their sides. It can predict if a meal is missing heat or flavor.

entry: 这只刚出生的小家伙有点害羞。壳里的宝可梦不肯彻底钻出来，蛋壳便成了它的护甲。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A hatchling who is a bit shy. The Pokémon within refuses to hatch fully, and its shell works as armor of sorts.

entry: POKENAME身上的培根太诱人，有些训练家竟忍不住咬自己的宝可梦。结果往往是脸上挨一记喷射火焰。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME bacon is so tempting to eat that some Trainers actually bite their Pokémon. This usually results in a Flamethrower to their face.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把蛋朝目标扔过去，可大得过头的钳子，有时会先把蛋夹碎。结果既糊了满脸蛋液，又丢尽面子。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME enjoys throwing its egg at targets. Sometimes its oversized pincer breaks the egg, causing it to have literal and figurative egg on its face.

entry: POKENAME背上的椰子会产生能安抚心绪的椰奶。宝可梦只喝一口，就会睡着。
author: .ssunday.
source: The coconut on POKENAME's back produces very soothing coconut milk. It can put Pokémon to sleep with just one sip.

entry: 它能长出椰子般的头，再像火箭筒一样射出去，既能单发，也能连射。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It grows coconut heads and shoots them out like a bazooka. It can fire individually or in spurts.

entry: 下方的头远不如上方的头聪明——因为上面那颗头，总在它身上蹦个不停。
author: themicelegion
source: The bottom head is considerably less intelligent than the top one. This is because the top head bounces on it all the time.

entry: 唯有草木繁茂的森林最深处，才能找到POKENAME。据说，它与伽勒尔的轰擂金刚猩有亲缘关系。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME can only be found in the deepest areas of lush forests. It is said to be related to the Pokémon Rillaboom in the Galar region.

entry: 在炎热潮湿的气候里，它尾巴上的头会长大。脱落之后，那颗头便会继续成长，化为蛋伊布。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The head on its tail grows in hot, humid climates. When they drop the head, it will go on to become an Exeggveon.

entry: 只要阳光明媚，POKENAME就心情很好。它会躺在沙滩上尽情吸收日光。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is in a good mood as long as the sun is shining. It lays on the sand to capture as much sunlight as possible.

entry: 它身上兼有鸭肉、椰子水、蛋黄与葱的模样。猎人说，这一只就能凑齐一整顿饭，连烧饭的柴都有。
author: naga_sake
source: Parts of this Pokémon resemble duck meat, coconut water, egg yolk and onion. Hunters say this Pokémon alone can make a whole meal, firewood included.

entry: POKENAME从地里长出来，平时懒洋洋的，等猎物走近，才一口吞下。夜里，旁边的几颗头负责放哨。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Grown from the ground, POKENAME tends to laze about, waiting for prey to come near before chowing down. The heads on the side keep watch at night.

entry: 在筑巢材料稀少的干旱地区，POKENAME便用骨头搭巢。它不善交友，可已有的朋友，每一个都十分珍惜。
author: Leshii
source: In arid places where materials are scarce, POKENAME crafts a nest out of bones. It struggles to make friends, but deeply cherishes the ones it has.

entry: POKENAME披着的骨头究竟是不是自身骨骼的一部分，研究人员还不确定。很少有人能靠近查看，更别说回来报告发现。
author: rihse
source: Researchers are unsure if the bones POKENAME dons are part of its skeleton. Few have gotten close enough to check, let alone report their findings.

entry: POKENAME戴着挚友的头骨，可身体渐长，已经快戴不下了。它独自巡飞，守望并保护领地里的宝可梦。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME wears the skull of a treasured friend, but is outgrowing it. It flies alone, keeping watch and protecting Pokémon within its territory.

entry: 美丽的羽毛，从POKENAME头骨盔的裂缝间伸出。它能发现几英里外的天敌，无声无息，迅速出手惩戒。
author: Leshii
source: Beautiful feathers spill from the cracks of POKENAME's skull helmet. It can spot a predator from miles away, dispensing swift justice without a sound.

entry: 它披上层层骨片，护住柔软的身体。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It plates itself in bones to protect its soft physical form.

entry: 身体由灼热的沙子构成。POKENAME会用身上的骨头，将岩石敲碎、磨成沙，再吃下去。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its body is made of incredibly hot sand. POKENAME uses the bones on its body to break and grind down rocks to sand for consumption.

entry: 它的尖牙看着吓人，其实毫无威力。趁猎物心生畏惧，它便抡起随身的骨头，狠狠敲去。
author: Staghorn
source: Its fangs are intimidating but entirely harmless. It takes advantage of its prey's fear in order to bludgeon them with the bone it carries.

entry: POKENAME用骨翼猛击对手。不过，那并非真的骨头，只是致密、洁白、形似骨骼的石块。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's boney wings are used for bashing opponents. They are not actually bones, they're just compact, white, bone-shaped stones.

entry: POKENAME用已故亲人的骨头遮住脸。刺耳的哭声，在头骨内回荡，令附近的宝可梦不安。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME conceals its face with the bones of its deceased parent. The piercing cries it emits resonate within the skull, unsettling nearby Pokémon.

entry: 战斗时，它会平伸骨头，旋转身体，扫击对手。
author: themicelegion
source: It twirls during combat. It holds its bone straight out to hit opponents.

entry: 它背着逝去家人的遗骨，代代相传。POKENAME的香气，会勾起爱与离别交织的柔情。
author: hampterbychoice
source: On its back, it carries the bones of fallen family passed down through generations. A POKENAME's aroma evokes tender feelings of love and loss.

entry: 据说，这柄骨匕首，由一头孤独野兽的遗骸制成，其中还附着它的灵魂。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The bone dagger is said to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.

entry: 没人见过POKENAME真正的脸。人们推测，它戴的头骨，属于一位已经逝去的族群伙伴。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: No one has seen the true face of POKENAME. The skull it wears is theorized to be that of a pack member that passed on.

entry: 头上的头骨意外地脆弱。哪怕只掉下一小块，它也会伤心悼念好几天。
author: .izik
source: The skull on its head is surprisingly brittle. If a portion breaks off, it will mourn the loss for multiple days.

entry: POKENAME通常抱着母亲的头骨。无论走到哪里，POKENAME都会带着它，纪念已经去世的母亲。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: A POKENAME usually holds its mother's skull. POKENAME takes this skull wherever it goes as a reminder of its deceased parent.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊在沙漠昏暗的沙丘间，几乎对什么都漠不关心。无论发生何事，也不作反应，只沿自己的路走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.

entry: POKENAME收集葬身沙漠者的遗骨，对仍活着的人，却十分友善，还会跟在他们身旁。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME collects bones of those who've fallen in the desert. However, it will be friendly to those still alive and follow them around.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊在沙漠昏暗的沙丘间，几乎对什么都漠不关心。无论发生何事，也不作反应，只沿自己的路走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.

entry: 有时，一群黑暗鸦会跟在POKENAME身旁。POKENAME保护它们，它们则带它寻找新的骨头。
author: ohok3441
source: Occasionally a murder of Murkrow will follow a POKENAME around. POKENAME provides them with protection while the Murkrow lead it to new bones.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊在沙漠昏暗的沙丘间，几乎对什么都漠不关心。无论发生何事，也不作反应，只沿自己的路走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.

entry: POKENAME以拾荒为生，通常不愿战斗。不过真躲不过时，它就会用手杖猛敲对手，直到对方昏倒。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are scavengers and tend to avoid battle. However, if one can't, it will thwack opponents with its staff until they faint.

entry: POKENAME披着骨骼，自豪地展示伤疤。幼崽出生便遭遗弃，成年后也郁郁而严肃，常独自躲起来哭泣。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME dress in bones and proudly flaunt their scars. Babies are abandoned at birth; adults are broody and stern, secluding themselves to weep.

entry: 它明亮的火焰，由一种特殊矿物提供燃料，色彩也由此而来。POKENAME还喜欢叼回别人扔出的骨头，玩个不停。
author: themicelegion
source: The bright flames this Pokémon makes are fueled by a special mineral, which gives them their color. POKENAME loves playing fetch with its bone.

entry: POKENAME是复活史前生命的尝试中，记录最详尽的一例。虽然强壮，性情却出奇温顺，双刃也十分脆。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is the best-recorded attempt at reviving prehistoric life. Though strong, it's surprisingly docile, and its blades are brittle.

entry: POKENAME虽已走出失去朋友的悲伤，仍将往日回忆珍藏心中。无论走到哪里，都会为保护幼小的宝可梦而战。
author: Leshii
source: Though POKENAME has overcome the grief of a lost friend, it carries their memory in its heart. It fights to protect young Pokémon wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME常不自量力，陷入根本打不赢的战斗。它用头撞击敌人，磨炼头部的骨甲。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: A POKENAME can often be found in over its head fighting battles it can't win. It strengthens the bone armor on its head by knocking it into foes.

entry: 这只宝可梦以坚韧的骨甲为傲，任何冲突也不怕，总奋不顾身地朝敌人猛冲。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: This Pokémon has pride in the toughness of its bone armor. Fearing no confrontation, it barrels towards foes with reckless abandon.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长产奶，动作却敏捷，领地意识也强。在干旱地区，它很受大奶罐牧群欢迎，是出色的守卫。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: POKENAME is not a good milk supplier; however, it is nimble and territorial, making it a popular guard for Miltank herds in arid regions.

entry: 树梢上常能找到POKENAME。可它爱朝毫无防备的训练家扔骨头，在多数地方，都被视为惹祸的家伙。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: You can find POKENAME on the tops of trees. However, it is considered a pest in most regions, as it hurls bones at unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME由久经沙场的野兽遗骸制成，其中仍留着原主的灵魂。看它战斗的身手，便知此言不虚。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME was crafted from the remains and still-present spirit a battle-hardened beast, as evident by its movements in battle.

entry: 它有节奏地敲响嘴里叼着的骨头，与族群里的其他伙伴交流。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It communicates with other members of its pack by rhythmically tapping the bone it carries in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME早已死去，灵魂却仍不安息。它的骨骼聚拢周围泥土，塑成如今的身体。
author: ETheWriter
source: POKENAME died long ago, but its spirit is restless. Its bones pulled the surrounding earth together to create its current form.

entry: POKENAME独自潜藏丛林，不愿被人类或宝可梦发现。不过，也有人见过POKENAME悄悄跟踪露营者。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME lurks in the jungle on its own. It does not wish to be seen by people or Pokémon. However, POKENAME has been seen stalking campers.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME巡行于采石场，寻找失去母亲的卡拉卡拉。厚重的铠甲，能保护它收养的小家伙免受伤害。
author: Thropp
source: POKENAME roams the quarries at night, searching for motherless Cubone. POKENAME's bulky armor protects its foundlings from harm.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，据说专猎做过坏事的人。可它究竟想做什么，没人知道。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.

entry: POKENAME会远远尾随沙漠与森林中疲惫的旅人，默默观察。训练家一转身，它就趁机偷东西。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME follows weary travelers in deserts and forests at a distance, watching them. It will steal from Trainers who turn their back.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，据说专猎做过坏事的人。可它究竟想做什么，没人知道。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.

entry: POKENAME随身的武器，本是为了吓退威胁。真到战斗时，它会将武器拆开，抡作棍棒。
author: ohok3441
source: The weapons POKENAME carries are meant to scare off potential threats. In battle, they will take them apart to use as clubs.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，据说专猎做过坏事的人。可它究竟想做什么，没人知道。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.

entry: POKENAME身旁的乌鸦头头，多半是早已与它结伴的黑暗鸦进化而来，而非新加入的伙伴。有些身上，也会缀着骨头。
author: ohok3441
source: The Honchkrow around POKENAME are typically bonded Murkrow rather than new additions. Sometimes they will be adorned with bones too.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，据说专猎做过坏事的人。可它究竟想做什么，没人知道。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.

entry: 头骨一旦开裂，POKENAME就会藏起脸，直到找到新面具。人们认为，那对角本就是它身体的一部分，而非装饰。
author: ohok3441
source: If the skull is cracked, POKENAME will hide its face until it finds a new mask. The horns are believed to be part of its body rather than décor.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME在地下藏着一整套私有的骨头收藏，每根都能应付不同的情况。
author: char_latte3412
source: Theories state that POKENAME has its own private collection of bones buried underground, each one suited to handle various situations.

entry: 卡拉鸭很少能长成POKENAME，因为母亲的头骨里必须有一颗特殊的宝石。它会借助红色宝石的力量，造出自己的法杖。
author: cubicdesert6
source: Very few Cuduck get to become a POKENAME, as their mother would need a special gem in her skull. It uses the power of the red gem to make its staff.

entry: POKENAME精通“八肢”格斗，拳、脚、膝、肘都能用来出招。练习时，POKENAME还会发出高亢的呼喝声。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are masters of "eight-limbed" combat, using feet and fists as well as knees and elbows. POKENAME let out high-pitched yells while training.

entry: POKENAME的舌头像盘绕的弹簧，能伸能缩，不过用来进食，就不太顺手了。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can retract and extend its spring-coiled tongue. Their tongue is not very effective for eating.

entry: 双腿与头骨硬如钻石，击中什么，就能将其打碎。它平时虽慢，有些个体却能骤然加速，时速超过450英里。
author: Soup1900
source: Its legs and skull are as hard as diamond, breaking anything it strikes at. Though usually slow, some can suddenly reach speeds of over 450 mph.

entry: 它配合飘带般的四肢，踢出强劲的攻击，战斗极有节奏。出腿时，还能再伸长十二英寸以上！
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It rhythmically fights with a combination of its ribbon-like limbs and high-powered kicks. Its kicks can lengthen out over twelve inches!

entry: POKENAME双腿富有弹性，能一跃高过摩天大楼，再踢出威力惊人的飞踢，冲击宛如小陨石坠落。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's elastic legs allow it to leap over skyscrapers. It uses this to land devastating jump kicks with the impact of a small meteorite.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只需一拳，就能击倒任何敌人。它的锻炼十分严苛，从俯卧撑到长跑，一项不落。
author: gamelord64
source: POKENAME is said to be able to defeat any foe in a single punch. It has a vigorous workout routine, ranging from pushups to running long distances.

entry: POKENAME常与铁壳蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长出拳。每挨一拳，它就离进化更近一步。
author: Cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonuna, which are better at punching. With each hit they take, they get closer to evolution.

entry: 这只宝可梦会奋力保护自己的幼崽。拳击手也会与它一同训练，磨炼拳技。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon will defend its baby with great might. Boxers will train with this Pokémon to hone their skills.

entry: POKENAME常与铁甲蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长防守。每打中一拳，它就离进化更近一步。
author: Cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonpod, which are better at defending. With each hit they make, they get closer to evolution.

entry: 它用六条腿，朝猎物接连刺出快拳。尤其得小心，它的左钩拳。
author: missingmilkman
source: It strikes its prey with rapid jabs from all six of its legs. Watch out for its left hooks.

entry: 它身手了得，却不讲武德。眼看落于下风，就会咬住对手，让其无法动弹，再狠狠殴打。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is a skilled, yet unfair fighter. If it finds that it is losing a match, it will bite its opponent and pummel them while they're restrained.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，喜欢先扛住对手的攻击，再以可怕的力量回敬。因此，最好根本别去招惹它。
author: Atlas333
source: In battle, POKENAME prefers to weather its opponent's attack before retaliating with devastating power. It's best to avoid engaging one altogether.

entry: POKENAME练拳时，也常对着平静水面照照自己，确保模样始终整洁漂亮。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME often checks its reflection in calm waters, ensuring its appearance remains pristine as it trains its punches.

entry: 它一拳就能打得发电机短路，全身都充盈着纯粹的电力与斗志。
author: kittyluv090
source: It can short-circuit power generators with a single punch. Its entire body is overflowing with pure electricity and fighting spirit.

entry: 人们认为，这是一位令人生畏的武僧，生前穿过的残甲，如今又被他的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It's thought to be the remains of armor once worn by a fearsome battle-monk, now possessed by their spirit.

entry: 它出拳快如闪电，肉眼几乎看不清。职业拳击手常请它作陪，练习防守。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its lightning-fast punches are nearly impossible to see with the naked eye. Professional boxers will practice their guards with this Pokémon.

entry: 吃到不合口味的东西，它就会勃然大怒，失去理智。每只POKENAME都有不同的心头好，喂上一口，便能让它平静。
author: Staghorn
source: When it tastes something unpleasant, it flies into a blind rage. Each POKENAME has a different favorite food that will calm it down.

entry: 唾液比胶水还黏。若在野外遇见POKENAME，就赶快跑吧；万一撞上它进食，被舌头粘住，可就逃不掉了。
author: typhloquil
source: Its saliva is stickier than glue. If you see a wild POKENAME, run. If it is eating and you get caught by its tongue by accident, there is no escape.

entry: 它用翅膀“尝”着空气，追随天气变化，寻找晕头转向的猎物。若它落到你身上，便也在消化你了。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It follows weather changes by tasting the air with its wings, searching for disoriented prey. If it lands on you, it is also digesting you.

entry: POKENAME把自己的舌头当雪橇，在崎岖地面滑行。舌头碰上去灼热无比，沿途还会留下一道熔岩。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME slides across rough surfaces using its own tongue as a sled. The tongue is searing hot to the touch and leaves a trail of lava behind.

entry: POKENAME沿着地面爬过，舌头便将碰到的有机物融化，养分直接吸收进体内。
author: chartanon
source: As POKENAME crawls along surfaces, its tongue melts any organic matter it touches. The nutrients are then absorbed directly into its body.

entry: 它的其他感官颇为迟钝，主要靠味觉认路。猎物一旦被黏舌缠住，便几乎没希望逃脱。
author: knilk
source: It mostly navigates by sense of taste; its other senses are quite dull. Once prey is ensnared in its sticky tongues, there is little hope of escape.

entry: POKENAME见到不认识的物件或生物，总爱先舔一舔，好弄个明白。可惜，这一舔，常会造成割伤与麻痹。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has a habit of licking every new object and living thing it sees to learn about it. Unfortunately, its licks often cause cuts and paralysis.

entry: 它会用舌头检查周围的一切。它的味觉比人类敏锐100倍以上。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It inspects everything in its environment with its tongue. Its sense of taste is over 100 times more powerful than a human's.

entry: 这只融合宝可梦外表并不吓人，却会让身边的人做些与牙齿有关的噩梦。除此之外，它倒总是独来独往。
author: OhOk3441
source: While not threatening visually, this fusion causes those around it to have teeth-based nightmares. It otherwise keeps to itself.

entry: POKENAME凭声波辨认方向，扑扇着翅膀穿行洞穴。舌头够得着的东西，只要能吃，就会被它舔走吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME orients itself using sound waves and flutters through caves. Anything edible that comes within reach of its tongue is lapped up and eaten.

entry: 它用舌头发出声波，搜寻猎物。一旦找到，就靠下半身发力，朝那个方向，飞快跃出数米。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It emits many soundwaves via its tongue to locate prey. If it locates prey, it uses its lower body to quickly jump several meters in that direction.

entry: 它常用长舌打理全身，保持毛发顺滑。如此一来，还能把吞下的毛聚成毒毛球，咳出来迎击天敌。
author: PokePower
source: It frequently grooms its entire body with its long tongue. Along with keeping its fur slick, this allows it to cough up toxic hairballs at predators.

entry: 小心别把硬币掉在地上。POKENAME以舔走钱币出名，肚子里，装满别人遗失的零钱。
author: KitArchen
source: Be wary of dropping coins on the ground. POKENAME are notorious for licking up money they find and filling their stomachs with lost pocket change.

entry: POKENAME的壳上布满尖刺，舌头则一刻不停，探查着周围。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in spikes, and its tongue is constantly in motion, exploring its surroundings.

entry: 它从背上的植物释放刺鼻气味，驱赶敌人。成群的POKENAME，也靠这股气味辨认、寻找彼此。
author: kittyluv090
source: It wards off enemies by emitting a pungent odor from the plant on its back. This scent is also how groups of POKENAME identify and locate each other.

entry: 这只宝可梦体内充满毒气，还不停向外泄漏。它靠毒害其他宝可梦，获得生存所需的养分。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's body is full of toxic gases that constantly leak from it. It gains sustenance from poisoning other Pokémon.

entry: 它把树汁转化为不稳定的毒气，逼退天敌。若敌人仍冲过烟雾，POKENAME便会点燃气体，自爆迎击。
author: wigglypon
source: It converts tree sap into a noxious, volatile gas to repel predators. If a foe gets past the fumes, POKENAME can ignite the gas and self-destruct.

entry: POKENAME体内满是含硫气体，排气孔总会毫无预兆地将其喷出。所幸，它还保留着原本的性情。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME's body is filled with sulfuric gases that are expelled through its vents without warning. Fortunately, it still has its personality.

entry: POKENAME是天生的猎手，会用身体的气孔，收集火山毒气。狩猎时再放出毒气，削弱猎物。
author: laserchick
source: A predator by nature, POKENAME collects toxic gases from volcanoes using vents on its body. When hunting, it releases the gas to weaken its prey.

entry: POKENAME的毒气，会扭曲周围空间。为保护训练家，它会猛然放出一大团气雾，将训练家裹在其中。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME's toxic gas causes space distortions all around it. To protect its Trainer, it'll suddenly leak a massive gas cloud and envelop them inside.

entry: POKENAME调皮得很，惹完祸，常会喷出高压气体，飞快溜走，逃避追究。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME is quite mischievous and will often propel itself away from consequences at high speed with jets of pressurised gas.

entry: 体内充满比空气轻的气体，让它得以悬浮。不过，这些气体一遇明火，就十分危险。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its body is full of gases that are lighter than air, keeping it aloft. These gases are volatile around open flames.

entry: 给POKENAME安排特殊饮食，便能让排出的气体失去活性。它性情开朗，是不错的宠物，只是养起来颇费钱。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's emissions can be rendered inert if they are fed a specialty diet. Their cheery temperaments make them good, if expensive, pets.

entry: POKENAME偏爱受污染的水域，近几年扩散得很快。它到来后，本就污浊的水，又会渐渐变得更脏。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has spread fast in recent years because it prefers polluted waters. The already dirty waters are slowly being contaminated by its presence.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，会不断排出气泡。哪怕只吸入几秒，也会让呼吸道受到严重刺激。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME dives, it regularly emits bubbles of gas. Anyone who inhales this gas for even a few seconds can expect severe respiratory irritation.

entry: POKENAME体内不断酿出极易爆炸的气体，可黏稠的身体又关不住气体，让它疼痛不堪。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME constantly brews a highly explosive gas within its body. Due to its slimy form, it cannot contain the gas well enough, causing it pain.

entry: POKENAME堪称污秽的化身，据说光是气味，就能熏走其他宝可梦。到了夏天，臭得连附近城镇，都不得不疏散。
author: Symile
source: The essence of filth, a POKENAME's scent is said to repel other Pokémon. During the summer, its stench warrants evacuation of nearby towns.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与同类聚在一起，一同硬化外壳，让阳光折射成耀眼、斑驳的光影。
author: Curerry
source: POKENAME enjoys gathering with other members of its kind. Together, they harden their shells, creating dashing displays of fractured sunlight.

entry: 它用黏丝在树枝间荡来荡去，顺势将身体朝顺时针方向旋转，积蓄动能。
author: .izik
source: It will swing from branch to branch using a sticky string of silk. During the swing, it spins its body clockwise to gain momentum.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，可要小心。它为进化储备能量时，性情格外凶暴。
author: PixlHoopa
source: When you find POKENAME in the wild, be cautious. It's known to be violent when storing its power to prep for evolution.

entry: 原本该缓缓进行的蜕变，过早加快，就会形成这只宝可梦。坚硬的外壳，护着里面仍在发育的身体。
author: TheHeroicT
source: When metamorphosis accelerates faster than intended, this Pokémon emerges. Its hard shell protects the still-developing body.

entry: 巨大的双镰，足以切开实心钢铁。可一生气，它就失了准头，只顾胡乱挥砍。
author: .izik
source: Its large scythes can slice through solid steel. When it is angry, it loses precision on its attacks and swipes wildly.

entry: 它用爪子掘地筑穴，钻入后将泥土盖在身上，准备进化。
author: .izik
source: It uses its claws to dig into the ground and make a den. Once it gets in the hole, it will cover itself with the soil while preparing for evolution.

entry: 头上的毒刺，会不时折断。有些药师会将它们捡来，制作ＰＰ单项小补剂。
author: .izik
source: The stinger on its head breaks off from time to time. There are apothecaries who gather these stingers for use in creating Ethers.

entry: 即使化为数字资料，POKENAME仍有严密的代码保护。外壳如同防火墙，替它隔绝危险。
author: PixlHoopa
source: Even as digital code, POKENAME is protected with secure code. The shell is akin to a firewall, securing it from danger.

entry: 它硬化外壳，保护自己，壳内则满是浓稠的液体。临近进化时，里面的液体便会沸腾。
author: Soup1900
source: It hardens its shell to protect itself. This shell is filled with a thick liquid. This liquid boils when it is preparing for its coming evolution.

entry: 尾尖的毒刺，多半只是用来吓人。虽带些微弱毒性，它还是更爱用这根刺，吓退闯近巢穴的天敌。
author: .izik
source: The stinger on its tail is mostly for show. While it does contain a weak poison, it prefers to use it to scare predators from its nest.

entry: POKENAME化蛹后，便失去飞行能力，只能无助地留在巢中，等待很快到来的进化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME loses the ability to fly when it pupates. It waits helplessly in its home nest for its rapid evolution.

entry: 入夜，它飞遍森林，挑选最合适过夜的树，再吐出奇特的丝，将自己系在枝上，安然入睡。
author: .izik
source: During the night, it flies around the forest to search for the perfect tree to sleep in. It uses a peculiar silk to tie itself to a branch and sleep.

entry: 身体底端会分泌丝线，让它吊在树枝上，尤其方便等着猎物经过，再从上方扑下。
author: .izik
source: The base of its body excretes a silky string that it uses to hang from branches. This is primarily useful when it is waiting to drop onto prey.

entry: 它钻入向日葵田的泥土，等待进化，靠吃花根获取养分，滋养外壳。
author: .izik
source: It burrows into the dirt of sunflower fields to wait for evolution. It consumes flower roots to gain nutrients for its shell.

entry: 出拳时，它能瞬间硬化拳头，打碎巨石。不过POKENAME一天只能这样打上几次，便会力竭。
author: .izik
source: By hardening its fist during a punch, it can destroy boulders. POKENAME can only do this a few times each day before it exhausts itself.

entry: POKENAME把大部分能量留给即将到来的成长，因此不太活跃。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As POKENAME stores most of its energy for its upcoming development, it is not particularly active.

entry: 高兴时，它会在周身迸起一片火花。睡觉则爱靠近电源插座，给身体充能。
author: .izik
source: When it is happy, it lets loose a flurry of sparks around its body. It sleeps near electric outlets to charge its body with energy.

entry: 一些昆虫学家猜测，这种罕见的蛹状形态，到了后续发育阶段，会拥有格外强大的超能力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some entomologists suspect that this rare form of pupation has particularly pronounced psychic powers in its later development.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多中空，因此能从一棵树飘向另一棵树，静待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a mostly hollow body. This allows it to float from tree to tree while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME虽行动迟缓，对防御力却很有信心。即使波波使出啄，也难以伤它分毫。
author: PixlHoopa
source: Although sluggish, POKENAME has confidence in its ability to withstand attacks. Even Pidgey's Peck will barely damage it.

entry: 它吊在树枝上，像钟摆一样摇晃，准备进化。受到惊吓，身体就会变得比铁还硬。
author: .izik
source: It swings like a pendulum from tree branches as it prepares for evolution. Its body can become harder than iron when it is startled.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地准备进化，常被误认成枝叶。它靠外壳吸收的水分，维持生命。
author: Zagreus8
source: POKENAME are often mistake for foliage as they keep completely still, preparing for evolution. They subsist on moisture absorbed through their shell.

entry: 它连睡着时也能飞。若是长眠，就会在一片水域上方，不停盘旋。
author: .izik
source: It can fly even while it sleeps. During a prolonged slumber, it will fly in circles above a body of water.

entry: POKENAME生性胆小、温顺，可进化越近，就越严防死守，不让背上的茧受伤。
author: Curerry
source: POKENAME is quite timid and docile in nature. However, as it approaches evolution, it grows more defensive in protecting the cocoon on its back.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，能一连睡上几天。脸上的壳，比石头还硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sleep for days at a time while it waits to evolve. The shell on its face is harder than stone.

entry: 它硬化身体的同时，核心也会产生易爆气体。若身体没变得足够坚硬，核心便会炸开。
author: .izik
source: While it hardens its body, it generates an explosive gas in its core. Should it fail to harden its body enough, the core will blow up.

entry: 外壳在阳光下会变得更硬，待完全干透，甚至能硬过钛。
author: .izik
source: Its shell grows harder in the sunlight. Once its shell dries out entirely, it can grow harder than titanium.

entry: 因为太过弱小可怜，它会藏在树枝上，陷入静止的冥想。这能帮助POKENAME加快进化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Due to its wretchedness, it hides on branches to fall into a meditative stasis. This helps POKENAME to accelerate its evolution.

entry: 还是绿小子时，就耗掉了大部分能量，如今POKENAME格外倦怠。它停在低垂树枝上，只有自卫时才战斗。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: With most of its energy spent as a Caterogue, POKENAME grows lethargic. It sits in low-hanging tree branches, only fighting in self defense.

entry: 等待进化时，它会间歇性放电。因此，最好让POKENAME远离电子设备。
author: .izik
source: It lets loose intermittent electric charges while it waits for evolution. Due to this, it is wise to keep a POKENAME far from any electronics.

entry: 它的外壳随日子一天天变硬、变光滑。若在这时遭到打扰，就会撞向最近的目标，狂乱攻击。
author: Zagreus8
source: Its shell toughens and smoothens over time. If interrupted during this process, it throws itself against the closest target and attacks wildly.

entry: 它背上的巴大蝶从背部的茧中长了出来。由于它从不移动或呼吸，人们无法确定这只宝可梦是否还活着。
author: imagine1.
source: The Butterfree on its back sprouted from the cocoon on its back. It is unknown if this Pokémon is alive, as it never moves or breathes.

entry: POKENAME躺在林地上化蛹，背上帐篷般的突起，还能收留小宝可梦，替它们遮蔽危险。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lies on the ground in forests and pupates. It shelters small Pokémon in a tent-like outgrowth on its back.

entry: POKENAME平时随和，对大多数宝可梦都很友好。可一受惊扰，头部与双眼就会猛地燃起火焰。
author: frohg_maro
source: POKENAME are usually very easy-going and friendly with most Pokémon, but if under distress, their heads and eyes will explosively burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME平时随和，对大多数宝可梦都很友好。可一受惊扰，头部与双眼就会猛地燃起火焰。
author: frohg_maro
source: POKENAME are usually very easy-going and friendly with most Pokémon, but if under distress, their heads and eyes will explosively burst into flames.

entry: 它停在河中一处，静静积蓄能量。等到进化，美丽也将更上一层。
author: Skymaster426
source: It stays in one place in rivers to gather its energy. When it evolves, its beauty will reach a new level entirely.

entry: 坚硬的身体难以挪动，它便把长飘带当手，抓取物品，也用来护身。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its hardened body is difficult to move. Therefore, it will often use its long ribbons as hands to grab objects and defend itself.

entry: POKENAME的身体比石头还硬。触须虽同样坚韧，却也能灵活弯转。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's body is harder than stone. Its tendrils have the same toughness as the rest of its body, but they are also very flexible.

entry: POKENAME的身体比石头还硬。触须虽同样坚韧，却也能灵活弯转。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's body is harder than stone. Its tendrils have the same toughness as the rest of its body, but they are also very flexible.

entry: 坚硬的壳让它行动困难，只好坐在原地。任由小宝可梦爬满全身，似乎也毫不在意。
author: chartanon
source: Its hardened shell makes movement difficult, so it stays sitting in place. Small Pokémon will climb all over it without it seeming to care at all.

entry: 坚硬的壳让它难以移动，只能坐在原地。若是不慎倒下，便要等进化后，才能重新起来。
author: chartanon
source: Its hardened shell makes movement difficult, so it stays sitting in place. If it falls over, it will be unable to get up until it evolves.

entry: POKENAME最初的壳薄而易破。常常沐浴月光之后，才会逐渐坚韧。
author: PixlHoopa
source: The shell of a POKENAME is, at first, thin and penetrable. After regular moonbathing, its shell toughens up.

entry: POKENAME快要进化了，外壳也出现裂纹。它只能用前肢发力，缓缓拖着身体前行。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME's shell is cracked due to how close it is to evolving. It is forced to slowly drag its body using its front legs to move.

entry: POKENAME用细丝吊在树上，等待进化。有外壳妥善保护，它一天能睡上22小时。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hangs on thin threads from trees and waits for its evolution. It sleeps up to 22 hours a day, well protected by its shell.

entry: POKENAME常无缘无故，从一棵树窜向另一棵树，不知不觉间，就浪费了许多本该留给进化的能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME scurries from tree to tree, often for no real reason. Without noticing, it wastes a lot of energy that it actually needs for evolution.

entry: 这种宝可梦入侵性很强，因此，人们鼓励当地训练家捕捉POKENAME，减少野外的数量。
author: CapWolfBane
source: This Pokémon is considered highly invasive. Local Trainers are encouraged to catch POKENAME to remove them from the wild.

entry: 它用利牙吸食树汁，一个晚上，就能把一整棵柳树吸干。
author: .izik
source: It drinks sap from trees with its sharp fangs. Over the course of one night, it can drain a willow tree in its entirety.

entry: 它会躺在暴雨中，尽可能多地吸水。若POKENAME水分充足，准备进化时，背上便会长出一片叶子。
author: .izik
source: It lays in rainstorms to absorb as much moisture as it can take. A well-hydrated POKENAME grows a leaf from its back when it is ready to evolve.

entry: 它缓缓前后摇摆，跳着舞。舞蹈结束，便从喙中向空中喷出一阵丝线。
author: .izik
source: It sways back and forth at a slow pace as it dances.  At the conclusion of its dance, it fires a flurry of strings into the air from its beak.

entry: 外壳挡得住风雨，也抵得住外力。疲惫的旅人，可以借它充当帐篷。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Its shell is impenetrable by weather and other outside forces. It is useful as a tent for weary travelers.

entry: 睡觉时，它会在周围放出蓝色孢子云，吸入后可能麻痹，甚至失去记忆。
author: .izik
source: While it sleeps, it lets loose a cloud of blue spores around its body. These spores can cause paralysis and memory loss.

entry: 熟练的工匠，会用POKENAME吐出的丝线制衣。不过，丝太黏，处理起来并不容易。
author: .izik
source: The silky string POKENAME produces is used by skilled craftsmen to create clothing. It is hard to utilize due to its sticky nature.

entry: 它抖动满身毛发，扬起一团绿粉。POKENAME的粉末，可以用来制作好伤药。
author: .izik
source: It shakes the fur that covers its body to let loose a green cloud of dust. The dust from a POKENAME can be used to create Super Potions.

entry: 它每天只能清醒几个小时。精力一耗尽，无论走到哪里，都会当场倒下。
author: .izik
source: It can only stay awake a few hours per day. Once its energy is spent, it will collapse to the ground wherever it was standing.

entry: 准备进化时，硬壳变得越来越厚，也越来越热。翅膀虽飞不起来，倒能吓唬其他宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: As it prepares for evolution, its hard shell grows hotter and thicker. Its wings are useless for flight and only serve to intimidate other Pokémon.

entry: 瞬间移动时，它会发出怪异的嗡鸣。睡眠、等待进化期间，也靠这本领，躲开天敌。
author: .izik
source: It lets loose an eerie hum when it teleports. It uses this ability to avoid predators while it sleeps and waits to evolve.

entry: 每打一拳，外壳就会剥落些许碎片。战斗足够多次，壳便彻底脱落，POKENAME随之进化。
author: kandyman
source: Every punch it throws chips away at its outer shell. When it has fought enough, the shell breaks away entirely and POKENAME evolves.

entry: 身上的叶子，一煮就会变软。圣特安努号的餐厅，会拿它来做美味的炖菜。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on its body become softer when boiled. The restaurant on the S.S. Anne prepares a delicious stew that uses these leaves.

entry: POKENAME对幼小的绿毛虫十分大方，愿意让它们暂时住进有壳的身体里。
author: PixlHoopa
source: POKENAME is known for its generosity towards young Caterpie. Within its shelled body, they are given a temporary home.

entry: POKENAME飞不了太久，更喜欢撑着大葱走。若丢了葱，便几乎寸步难行。
author: .izik
