source: POKENAME struggles to fly for long periods and prefers to use its leek to move. Should its leek ever be lost it will be almost entirely immobile.

entry: POKENAME在城市小巷里窜行，沿途散播毒气。它一出现，就意味着危险，谁迎面经过，都可能中毒。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME scurries through urban alleys spreading noxious gases. Its presence warns of danger, poisoning those who cross its path.

entry: 这只宝可梦形体不定，里面存着毒气。高兴、想玩时，毒性虽降低，气味却臭得多。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon stores noxious fumes within its amorphous body. When feeling happy or playful, the gases become less toxic, but far more putrid.

entry: 医院隔离病区的走廊，常能看见POKENAME。别看模样阴森，它们还能帮医生检查病人。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME can be found strolling the halls of the isolation wing in hospitals. Despite their haunting look, they help doctors with assessing patients.

entry: 它用体内的化学反应作燃料，奋力向前冲。尽管散发的毒气十分危险，孩子们仍很喜欢它。
author: chartanon
source: It charges forwards, using its internal chemical reactions as fuel. Children love it, in spite of the dangerous toxic fumes it exudes.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体，浓密得能当作肢体使用。在卡洛斯，人们也常用这些气体，制作高级香水。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The gases produced by POKENAME are dense enough to be used as limbs. The gases are also often used in Kalos to produce high-grade perfumes.

entry: 两颗头都会喷出灼热的剧毒气体，既能合作捕猎，又能提防敌人抢食。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its two heads breathe out a hot and highly toxic gas. It uses both heads to hunt prey while also keeping enemies from stealing its food.

entry: POKENAME的气体，能暂时提高人的智力。不过不宜长期使用，大量接触，更会损伤脑组织。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Gases emitted by POKENAME can temporarily increase a person's IQ. Prolonged use isn't recommended however, as large amounts can damage brain tissue.

entry: POKENAME训练时，会不断产生并释放有毒的烟雾，气味隐约像汗水。
author: bobosmith01
source: As NAME trains, it produces and releases noxious fumes that smell vaguely of sweat.

entry: POKENAME的毒气，仍像融合前那样刺鼻、危险，可如今，还能帮它在垂钓时引来猎物。
author: Sole Survivor
source: The toxic gas expelled by POKENAME is still just as pungent and dangerous as before fusion; however, it now helps it to attract prey while fishing.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME冲锋起来，连坦克也能掀翻。性情虽凶，骑乘却意外容易，因此常出现在竞技骑术表演中。
author: Staghorn
source: A charging POKENAME is capable of flipping a tank. They are surprisingly easy to ride despite their fierceness, making them a common sight at rodeos.

entry: 身体比花岗岩还硬，却十分怕冷。冬天，它会往身上涂满泥，保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: Its body is harder than granite, but is highly susceptible to the cold. During the winter months it covers its body in mud to stay warm.

entry: POKENAME在砂岩里挖出复杂的隧道。遇上过不去的障碍，便干脆吃穿过去，还爱用角掀翻东西取乐。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME make intricate tunnels in sandstone. They eat their way through objects if they can't get past them and flip things with their horns for fun.

entry: 它镰刀般的角对振动十分敏感。一旦察觉洞穴即将坍塌，就会用巨大的头把其他生物推到安全的地方。
author: cait_sith
source: Its scythe-like horn is sensitive to vibrations. If it senses an imminent cave-in, it will use its oversized head to shove others to safety.

entry: 它们能撞穿最坚固的摩天大楼，因此是拆迁工人的绝佳伙伴。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: They make excellent partners for demolition workers due to their ability to smash through the toughest of skyscrapers.

entry: POKENAME虽披着岩石般坚硬的甲片，动作却敏捷惊人。它会猛撞敌人，造成脑震荡与骨折。
author: _Testrun_
source: Despite the rock-hard plating, POKENAME are incredibly agile. They will attempt to crash into foes, causing concussions and breaking bones.

entry: POKENAME曾生活在海里，如今已适应海岸的生态。不过，也有些个体，偶尔仍会游回深蓝的大海。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME once lived in the sea, but have since then adapted to fill niches in shoreline ecosystems. Some occasionally stray into the blue, however.

entry: 铁质外骨骼外，还覆着一层岩石，加强防护。可腹部露在外面，很容易生锈。
author: cait_sith
source: It has a layer of rock on top of its iron exoskeleton for extra protection. Its belly is exposed and is prone to rusting.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的翅膀，让它无法离地飞起。好在身上布满利刺，能分泌效力强烈的浓缩毒液。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite POKENAME's rock-like wings keeping it firmly grounded, its body is adorned by sharp spikes that exude a potent, highly-concentrated poison.

entry: POKENAME的双角，能轻松钻穿山体。可它总心不在焉，做着做着，就忘了原本的目的。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's dual horns bore through mountains with ease. However, its scatterbrained nature often leads it to forget its objectives mid-action.

entry: POKENAME笨拙地撞树，震下果实。偶尔错把椰蛋树认成最爱的果树，就会挨上一记难堪的教训。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME clumsily rams into trees to procure their fruit. Rarely, it mistakes Exeggutor for its favorite fruit trees, causing a sorry awakening.

entry: POKENAME很以背上萌芽的种子为傲，谁敢走得太近，就会遭它冲撞。那些种子吃下去，可是有剧毒的。
author: char_latte3412
source: Proud of the budding seeds adorning its back, POKENAME will charge at anyone who ventures too close. The seeds are highly poisonous if ingested.

entry: POKENAME发起狂来，十分凶暴，边挥爪边怒吼，能一路横冲直撞，穿过整片山脉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is known for its violent rampages, which lead it, clawing and roaring, across entire mountain ranges.

entry: 它的角能帮助它高速钻入泥土。它一天就能向地下挖掘10英里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its horn helps this Pokémon burrow through dirt at high speeds. It can dig up to 10 miles deep in a single day.

entry: POKENAME生性体贴，会模仿治愈球，想引来需要帮助的生物。等对方靠近，POKENAME便替它疗伤。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: Guided by its caring nature, POKENAME mimics a Heal Ball in the hopes of capturing the attention of those in need. POKENAME then heals them.

entry: 由两只吉利蛋融合而成的宝可梦，既医术出色，又能胜任长时间值班，因此常在宝可梦中心帮忙。
author: TokenOracle
source: Chansey self-fusions are often used in PokéCenters due to their ability to cope well with long shifts, in addition to their skills in medicine.

entry: 它把蛋放在腹部的袋子里，无论跑得多快，战斗多激烈，蛋也绝不会破。
author: Staghorn
source: It carries eggs around in the pouch on its belly. No matter how fast it runs or how hard it fights, the egg will never break.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME能以可怕的代价，实现不可能的愿望。它连眼睛也不眨，更添几分诡异。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Rumors have it that POKENAME is capable of granting impossible wishes at a terrible cost. It never blinks, further fuelling its uncanny aura.

entry: 它是只善良的宝可梦，能把病痛与毒素，收进颈间的蛋里净化。这样的蛋，只吃一颗，就能饱上一周。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A very kind Pokémon, it can store and purify disease and poison in the eggs around its neck. A single one of these eggs can keep you full for a week.

entry: 古代的宝可梦中心，曾借POKENAME的治愈能力疗伤。可随着岁月流逝，这份力量已大不如前。
author: zic
source: In ancient times, Pokécenters would use POKENAME's healing abilities to mend wounds. However, its power has greatly diminished over time.

entry: POKENAME会把蛋送给想有后代的宝可梦。即使飞在高空，POKENAME也十分稳妥，从不让蛋掉下来。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME carries Eggs to Pokémon who want offspring of their own. POKENAME are very skilled, not letting the eggs drop even from high in the air.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外壳，来自出生时残留的蛋壳。遇到野外生病的宝可梦，它便会细心照料。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The harden shell of POKENAME is formed from the remnants of the egg it was hatched from. It's known to nurse sick Pokémon it finds in the wild.

entry: 刀刃轻轻划过，小伤小病就能痊愈。可贪图利益的人纷纷想抓走POKENAME，如今，它也越来越罕见。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: When its blade is lightly run across a minor wound or ailment, it is healed. Attempts to kidnap POKENAME for profit has made its presence rare.

entry: POKENAME心怀怜悯，是医护人员的好伙伴。手术时，它还能用飘带，把器械递给外科医生。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its compassionate nature makes POKENAME an excellent partner for medical professionals. They assist surgeons by handing them tools with their ribbons.

entry: 据说，有POKENAME照料的蛋，能孵出健康强壮的宝可梦，因此，它很受培育家的欢迎。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: It is said that an egg watched over by POKENAME will hatch into a strong, healthy Pokémon. This makes them popular among breeders.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的蛋，能治愈世间所有疾病。可这只宝可梦实在难见，许多人以为，只是编出来的传说。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: A POKENAME's egg is said to cure any and all diseases. This Pokémon is rarely seen, and many assume it is just a made-up legend.

entry: POKENAME会参加激烈、残酷的战斗，把疗伤的蛋奖励给令它佩服的对手。谁的医术或战技让它叹服，它便跟随谁。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME have vigorous, brutal battles, and reward those who impress them with healing eggs. They follow those whose medic or battle skills awe them.

entry: 身上倒刺渗出的黄色液体，具有药效。涂在擦伤或小割伤上，伤口很快就能愈合。
author: .izik
source: The yellow liquid that leaks from the barbs on its body is medicinal. When applied to a scrape or minor cut, the injury will heal quickly.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，似乎是一颗颗蛋。科学家们暂时也不太想深究。
author: robosoup
source: It seems POKENAME has eggs in place of eyes. Scientists aren't keen to learn more about it anytime soon.

entry: POKENAME头上的蛋，既有营养，又能补水，让迷路的旅人见了格外欢喜。在沙漠工作的巡护员，多半都带它作伙伴。
author: char_latte3412
source: The egg on POKENAME's head is both nutritious and hydrating, a welcome sight to lost travelers. Most rangers deployed in deserts keep it as a partner.

entry: 它守护其他宝可梦的蛋，却趁机吸走蛋中的养分。结果，小家伙孵出来时，已经体弱多病。
author: Staghorn
source: It protects the eggs of other Pokémon, siphoning nutrients from them in the process. When the egg hatches, the baby is sickly and weak as a result.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都有分工。一颗头仔细警戒，其他头则负责照顾蛋。
author: .ssunday.
source: Each of POKENAME's heads have a job. One head keeps watch and the others take care of its eggs.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮会射出蛋。这些蛋既能用来迎战其他宝可梦，也能替它们疗伤。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: The cannons on POKENAME's back fire eggs. These eggs can be used to fight opposing Pokémon, or heal them.

entry: POKENAME不太擅长飞，便用藤蔓迅速爬树，再伪装成枝叶，直到找到新的歇脚处。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it has difficulty flying, POKENAME uses its tendrils to climb trees quickly. It camouflages itself as leaves before finding a new place to rest.

entry: POKENAME住在树上，吸取叶片中的养分。它能伸出数米长的藤蔓，抽击敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives on trees and sucks nutrients from the foliage. It can extend its vines several meters to lash out at enemies.

entry: 这团藤蔓没有固定形状，颈间的“宝石”其实是坚果。藤蔓底下究竟什么模样，没人知道。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: An amorphous blob of vines, the gems around its neck are actually nuts. No one knows what it looks like under the vines.

entry: POKENAME周身包裹的大量触手，能替它御寒。它靠獠牙与鼻子，一起探查方向。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The mass of tentacles that encase POKENAME's body protect it from the cold. It uses a combination of its tusks and nose to guide itself.

entry: 它常跑到人群前，想表演一番。可观众若嘲笑POKENAME，它便躲进帽子里，独自哭泣。
author: .ssunday.
source: It usually goes in front of large crowds to try and perform. If they laugh at POKENAME, it'll hide in its hat and cry.

entry: 它最初被视为巨蔓藤的地区变种，直到近期基因组测序取得突破，才被认定为独立的物种。
author: ansleehariot
source: Originally classified as just a regional variant of Tangrowth, recent breakthroughs in genome sequencing led to it being declared a distinct species.

entry: 每根藤蔓都能充当灵活的手脚，抓握自如。可藤蔓底下的身体，至今没人见过。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It can use each of its individual vines as prehensile limbs. No one has seen what this Pokémon looks like underneath its vines.

entry: POKENAME为何如此执着于圆环上垂下的藤蔓，没人明白。谁若抢走，它便会想尽办法夺回来。
author: akujules
source: Nobody understands why POKENAME fixates on the vine that hangs off its ring. Attempt to snatch it, and it will go to great lengths to retrieve it.

entry: 它在林地间慢慢挪动，寻找可口的虫宝可梦与块茎。也有人觉得，把它放进平底锅煎一煎，滋味十分不错。
author: JaycieLantern
source: It shuffles around the forest floor looking for tasty bug Pokémon and tubers. To some, it is a delicacy when fried in a skillet.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。还有人加上酸奶油与葱，衬出更多滋味。
author: JaycieLantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. Some add sour cream and spring onions to it to bring out more flavor.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。人们常说，吃着像土豆与洋葱。
author: JaycieLantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. People often remark its flavor as being similar to potatoes and onions.

entry: POKENAME头上的“头发”其实是藤蔓，摸起来湿漉漉的。可惜POKENAME没有手臂，藤蔓也总是乱蓬蓬。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: The hair on POKENAME's head are actually vines that are wet to the touch. Since POKENAME doesn't have arms, its vines always appear disheveled.

entry: POKENAME的头发长了，手臂也长了。既有催眠本领，又有拳击手套，让对手“睡下”，足足有两种办法。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME hair has grown and so have its arms. With its hypnotizing powers and its boxing gloves, it has two ways to put its opponents to rest.

entry: POKENAME能舒展开缠绕的身体，让自己变大。两腿间的距离随之拉开，再宽的沟壑，也能轻松跨过。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can unravel its body and thus grow in size. This increases the distance between its legs and allows it to cross large gaps with ease.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴里射出数米长的藤蔓，轻易捕获、捆住猎物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can shoot vines out of its mouth that are several meters long. This allows it to easily catch and restrain prey.

entry: 凭借漂浮海草般的触须，POKENAME能轻松逃脱捕捉。兴奋时，它身上的球体会闪烁，在海洋深处投下诡异的光。
author: anarchaz
source: With tendrils like floating seaweed, POKENAME evades capture with ease. Its orbs flicker with excitement, casting an eerie glow in the ocean's depths.

entry: POKENAME住在昏暗的沼泽，把催眠的受害者掳回破屋。过上许多星期，才再次出门，寻找新的猎物。
author: char_latte3412
source: Residing in dark, swampy regions, POKENAME whisks away hypnotized victims to its hovel, emerging again for new prey after many weeks have passed.

entry: 这只宝可梦不幸因偷猎者，失去了母亲。它留着一根骨头，既用来抵御天敌，也用来打落树上的树果。
author: zic
source: This Pokémon tragically lost its mother due to poachers. It keeps a bone to fend off predators and to knock down Berries from trees.

entry: 如今它已长大，变得无所畏惧，一心想为母亲报仇。训练家必须提防POKENAME凶猛的举动。
author: zic
source: Now grown up, it has become much more fearless in hopes to avenge its mother one day. Trainers must be aware of POKENAME's aggressive behavior.

entry: 幼崽已健康、强壮地长大，如今与母亲并肩作战。只有彼此的爱，能与它们战斗时的凶猛相比。
author: Griddle
source: The child has grown up healthy and strong, and now fights by its mother's side. Their ferocity is matched only by their love for each other.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽，由金属母亲养大。待母亲衰老，幼崽便会驾驶母亲的身体，保护彼此。
author: Mistymagius
source: The young baby of a POKENAME is nurtured by the metal mother. Once the mother grows old, the baby will pilot it to protect the two of them.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽护在利齿密布的大颚中。那对颚能咬断铁梁，却也会拼死，守住小家伙的安全。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME keep their young protected inside their sharp jaws. They can chomp through iron beams, but will protect the young with their life.

entry: POKENAME极不称职。不管幼崽出了什么事，它都懒懒躺着，除了挠痒，根本不肯动。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an extremely bad parent. No matter what happens to its child, it lays there lazily, only moving to scratch itself.

entry: POKENAME用飘带包裹幼崽，宛如襁褓。若它肯让你抱小家伙，就说明，它已完全信任你。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME swaddles its young by wrapping its ribbons around them. If they let you hold their baby, it is a sign they trust you completely.

entry: 一对母子冻死在雪山上，化成了POKENAME。它会夺取旅人的灵魂，喂给自己的孩子。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME was created when a mother and child succumbed to the cold on a snowy mountain. It captures souls from travelers to feed to its child.

entry: POKENAME的身体长成了摇篮，保护幼崽。有人曾在夜里，看见那树木般的身体，悄然穿过田野。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: POKENAME has grown its body into a bassinet to protect its young. Some report to have seen its treelike body move quietly across fields at night.

entry: 幼崽从POKENAME背上的蘑菇里发育而来，长大成熟后，才会从母亲身上脱落。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its young develop from the mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's back. When the young reach maturity, they will fall off their mother.

entry: 窝在POKENAME两颗头之间的，是它的孩子。即使POKENAME大步疾奔，幼崽也能舒服地埋在羽毛里。
author: bobosmith01
source: The creature nestled between POKENAME's two heads is its child, which burrows comfortably in POKENAME's feathers as it stomps around at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME用催眠术哄幼崽睡觉，自己则夜夜守着它们。母爱驱使它，挡下天敌，也赶走噩梦。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses Hypnosis to help its babies sleep. Motivated by motherly love, it stays up every night to protect them from predators or nightmares.

entry: POKENAME用头上的触须，感知水中的振动，赶在天敌抓住自己之前，就已退走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses the feelers on its head to detect vibrations in the water. This allows it to retreat from predators before it is caught.

entry: POKENAME借助深海洋流，赶路快得惊人。遇险时，还能从管状的吻部，射出强力电击。
author: akujules
source: POKENAME utilizes deep-sea currents to travel at surprising speeds. When in danger, it shoots powerful electric blasts from its trunk.

entry: POKENAME用头上的触须，感知水中的振动，赶在天敌抓住自己之前，就已退走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses the feelers on its head to detect vibrations in the water. This allows it to retreat from predators before it is caught.

entry: POKENAME常结成小群，扑扇着翅膀，飞过池塘与河面。一察觉危险，便潜入水中，把翅膀当鳍游走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME flutters over the surface of ponds and rivers, often in small groups. If it senses danger, it dives, using its wings as flippers.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，稍被招惹，便不由自主地从吻部喷出墨汁。建议训练家，多备几套衣服。
author: char_latte3412
source: Easily startled, POKENAME unwittingly releases ink from its snout at the slightest provocation. It is recommended Trainers pack extra sets of clothes.

entry: 它用飘带辅助瞄准，再喷出墨汁。即使体型有自己两倍大的宝可梦，它也常去挑战。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It uses its ribbons to help it aim where it fires its ink. They often challenge Pokémon twice their own size.

entry: 喷出的水，力道足以打断骨头。即使目标在45米以外，它也能准确击中。
author: cait_sith
source: It shoots water with enough force to fracture bones. It can accurately hit a target from over 45 meters away.

entry: 卷曲的尾巴，在水中充当舵。飘带与双腿奋力划水，速度快得足以迎着急流，逆行而上。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its coiled tail acts as a rudder in water. They use their ribbons and legs to paddle at speeds that allow them to swim against strong currents.

entry: POKENAME竟对自己产生的各种粉末过敏。一个喷嚏，就会喷出强力水柱，连钢铁也能打穿。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME is allergic to the various powders its own body produces. Its sneezes launch high-power water jets that can pierce steel.

entry: POKENAME价值连城，受各地厨师追捧。可在料理界地位再高，论起打架，它们实在弱得可怜。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are priceless, sought after by chefs all over the region. Contrary to their revered status in the culinary field, they are pathetic fighters.

entry: POKENAME用长长的嘴互斗，争夺首领地位。胜者，便能占据最高的筑巢处。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its extended mouth to fight for dominance. The winner of the fight gets to claim the highest nesting spot.

entry: 它优雅地游过狭窄河道。据说，冥想时若有POKENAME从面前经过，便是好运将至的征兆。
author: kittyluv090
source: It swims gracefully along narrow rivers. Rumor has it a POKENAME crossing your path during meditation is a sign of good fortune to come.

entry: POKENAME像流星，滑过夜空。闪亮的鳞片映着月光，为迷途的船只引向岸边。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME glide through the night sky like shooting stars, guiding lost ships to shore by reflecting the moonlight in their shimmering scales.

entry: 这只小巧的宝可梦，靠秋叶与橡子添些脂肪，好安然过冬。谁敢弄乱它的头发，可就要倒霉了。
author: Rooboid
source: This petite Pokémon snacks on autumn leaves and acorns to gain weight and stay warm during winter. Those who ruffle its hair will suffer a nasty fate.

entry: POKENAME爱美得很，还会竖起水墙，欣赏自己华丽的倒影。它尤其宝贝自己的头发。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are known for their persistent vanity, and create walls of water to admire their gorgeous reflection. They are protective of their hair.

entry: 照顾得好的POKENAME，颈间花领纹饰艳丽；若照顾不周，花瓣就会萎蔫。美容觉，它可一点也少不得。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME who are well-cared for boast a gorgeously patterned collar—those who are not will see their petals wilted. They need lots of beauty sleep.

entry: POKENAME常被赠给年幼的孩子，充当最初的伙伴。毕竟，背上的气泡，比火球鼠的火星安全得多。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are often gifted as a starter Pokémon to young children, as the bubbles from its back are much safer than the fiery embers of Cyndaquil.

entry: POKENAME背上的气泡，能让它离水后，短暂呼吸。不过，平时仍很少见它浮出水面。
author: kittyluv090
source: The bubble formation on POKENAME's back allows it to breathe for a limited time while out of water. However, it is rarely seen above the surface.

entry: POKENAME如今一发怒，头顶的冠便会冒出火焰。它冲向毫无防备的敌人时，华美的尾巴也随风翻卷。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME can now let off flames from its crown when enraged. Its gorgeous tail twists in the breeze as it dashes towards unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME先绊倒敌人，再打出密集的气泡，轻易取胜。愤怒时，鬃毛还会迸起火焰。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME makes light work of foes by sweeping them off their feet and barraging them with a hail of bubbles. Flames burst from its mane when enraged.

entry: 阿罗拉一位著名训练家，曾在电视上展示这只小宝可梦。如今，许多训练家也给POKENAME打扮，仿照那位训练家的宝可梦。
author: Rooboid
source: A famous Trainer in the Alola region showcased this petite Pokémon on TV. Now, many Trainers dress their POKENAME to also look like that Trainer's.

entry: POKENAME蓬松鼓荡的身体，常被误认成漂着的袋子。头上的角与胸前的项链，由同样的材料构成。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The billowing body of POKENAME is often mistaken for floating bags. Its horn and the necklace on its chest are made of the same material.

entry: 它虽住在水下，身体仍会冒出火焰与岩浆。吃下的小石子，提供丰富矿物，积在裙褶般的鳍里。
author: seaslux
source: Fire and magma burns from its body despite its underwater habitat. Its frills are packed with minerals absorbed through a diet of small pebbles.

entry: 水在它坚硬的壳中沸腾。模样优雅、又不太容易入手，还能充当增氧石，因此很受水族爱好者珍视。
author: seaslux
source: Water boils inside its hardened shell. As an elegant, somewhat hard-to-obtain Pokémon that also functions as an airstone, it is prized by aquarists.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME把年幼的大嘴蛋养在育儿袋里。这些小家伙力量不大，却是出色的游泳健将，速度很快。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME can be observed raising young Golcute in its pouch. While they aren't particularly strong, they are excellent and speedy swimmers.

entry: POKENAME常与一群雄性角金鱼同行，还能操控水流，为鱼群引路。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often seen with a school of male Goldeen. They are able control the flow of the water to guide their school.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: 它们被称为“海之公主”，摆动裙摆般的鳍与双腿游动。美丽的模样，让它们成为富人高价争购的宠物。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Known as "The Sea Princess," they swim by swishing their dress-like fins and legs. They are high-value pets for the rich because of their beauty.

entry: 追求力量的训练家会让POKENAME进化成海战龙；追求美丽的人，则已对它华丽闪耀的身姿心满意足。
author: Rooboid
source: Trainers who seek power evolve their POKENAME into Seaxorus, but Trainers who seek beauty are more than happy with this gorgeous, shimmering Pokémon.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME是洛奇亚为守护海洋而创造的存在，人们极少能见到它。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is rumored to have been created by Lugia to serve as a protector of the seas. It is very rarely seen by people.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力，能在水下彻底隐形。身上的纹路，宛如波浪，流转全身。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are able to become completely invisible underwater thanks to its psychic powers. The patterns on its body ripple across its body like waves.

entry: POKENAME眼睛鼓鼓，性情胆怯，常被当作游园会的奖品。于是，虽模样古怪，却成了颇常见的新手伙伴。
author: Rooboid
source: Known for its bulbous eyes and cowardly nature, POKENAME are often won as carnival prizes, making it a common and rather odd-looking starter Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME沿着海底慢慢走，吸食零星的食物。除此之外，它也没什么别的事可做。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME walks along the ocean floor, sucking up small bits of food. It doesn't do very much other than that.

entry: POKENAME肉质肥美，游起水来却意外出色。许多保护人士，都致力于守护这种独特的宝可梦。
author: Rooboid
source: While it is indeed delicious and fatty, POKENAME is a surprisingly good swimmer, and many activists ensure the protection of this unique Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴，用沉船的残件，以及溺亡水手的遗体，装点住处。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives in underwater caves. It decorates its home with shipwreck parts and drowned sailors.

entry: POKENAME爱待在许愿井底，这样，人们抛进井中的硬币，就都能被它偷走。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME are well known to hang out at the bottom of wishing wells. By doing so, it allows them to steal any coins that people throw in.

entry: 春天，成群的POKENAME会迁回出生的溪流与河道。它们喷出的水，足以让猎物严重烫伤。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: In spring, groups of POKENAME can be seen migrating to the streams and rivers of their birth. The water they spout leaves intense burns on their prey.

entry: 它在透明如玻璃的育儿袋中，养育角金鱼。看袋中角金鱼的体型与状态，就能判断POKENAME是否健康。
author: Rooboid
source: This Pokémon raises Goldeen in its glassy pouch. The overall health of a POKENAME can be determined by the condition and size of its Goldeen.

entry: POKENAME体内藏着一个小型生态系统。可它太爱徒手搏斗，常会打得这个小天地，整个裂开。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME hosts a small ecosystem within its body. Its love of hand-to-hand combat often results in this ecosystem being smashed open.

entry: 春天，POKENAME鱼群会逆着河流、瀑布游上去，把水烘得泡沫翻腾。
author: togetik
source: In the springtime, schools of POKENAME swim up falls and rivers, causing the waters to foam and bubble with heat.

entry: 一群角金鱼操纵着大岩蛇骇人的遗骸，以POKENAME的姿态，再度活动。它们共享思想，行动也如一个整体。
author: Rooboid
source: Operated by a school of Goldeen, the ghastly remains of an Onix live again in the form of POKENAME. This Pokémon acts and thinks as a combined entity.

entry: 它几乎没有骨骼，身体像灌了水的气球，晃来晃去。无人打理的池塘，是它的乐园，里面的藻类足够饱餐。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It has no bones to speak of, so its body jiggles about like a water balloon. It thrives in neglected ponds, where it feasts on algae.

entry: 水宝可梦一见POKENAME掠过水面，便会本能地恐惧。巨大的鳍，却让它能轻松借助回旋上升的气流。
author: .realthree
source: The sight of a POKENAME swooping over the water evokes a primal fear in Water-type Pokémon. Its massive fins capture swirling updrafts effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME美味得入口即化，各地厨师都愿出高价求购。可它一受惊，就会躲进蛋里。
author: Rooboid
source: Sought after for its delectable, melt-in-the-mouth texture, chefs the world over will pay handsomely for a POKENAME. It hides in its egg when scared.

entry: 进化之后，POKENAME原本鲜美的皮肤，变得酸涩，好让偷猎者与钓客不再惦记。它也不太擅长游泳。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME's once-delicious skin becomes sour as it evolves—this is a defense mechanism to ward off poachers and anglers alike. It is a weak swimmer.

entry: 背部柔软的内壳，不断散出暖意。一受威胁，它便将热量释放出去，煮沸周围的水。
author: seaslux
source: Warmth emanates from the soft internal shell on its back. When threatened, it releases this heat from its body, boiling the surrounding water.

entry: 它披着黑曜石外壳，下方还凝了一层银膜。模样虽吓人，身体却意外脆弱，裙褶般的鳍也很娇嫩。
author: seaslux
source: It has an obsidian shell, and a silvery film has hardened over its underside. It looks intimidating, but it's surprisingly weak with delicate frills.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴像一层头纱。若正等着被求婚的人，捉到野生的它，便被视为好事将近。
author: dicedragon20
source: Due to its veil-like tail, it is considered good luck for a wild POKENAME to be caught by someone awaiting a proposal.

entry: 每年，成群的POKENAME都会来到岸边求偶。雄性会亮出鲜艳的花纹，跳起舞蹈，吸引雌性。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Once a year, groups of POKENAME gather by the shore to perform courtship rituals. Males will attract females with vibrant patterns and dances.

entry: 据说，龙卷寿司的灵感，就来自这只宝可梦。上半身能独立于下半身活动，不过，也不能离得太远。
author: Rooboid
source: This Pokémon is said to have inspired the creation of dragon rolls. Its torso moves independently from its lower body, though it cannot stray too far.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长战斗，动作灵巧程度却远超常人。野外，很少见到POKENAME。
author: Rooboid
source: Though POKENAME isn't well-suited for battle, it boasts a dexterity that far surpasses the average human's. POKENAME are seldom seen in the wild.

entry: 它飞快游动，试图用坚硬如石的大角，撞中目标。
author: Pokopish
source: It swims at high speeds, attempting to ram targets with its large horn that is as hard as rock.

entry: POKENAME用手臂上的大钩，牢牢攀住岩石，免得被水冲走。背上的蘑菇摆动起来，也能推动它游水。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the large hooks in its arms to cling to rocks to avoid being swept away. The mushrooms on its back move to propel it through the water.

entry: POKENAME华丽的鳍，是美的象征。爱好者常彼此较量，看谁的POKENAME，鱼鳍最为壮丽。
author: .realthree
source: The extravagant fins that POKENAME have are a symbol of beauty. Enthusiasts often compete to see whose POKENAME has the most magnificent fins.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀很结实，在水下也能使用。不过，它更爱在河边的花朵间，翩然飞来飞去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's wings are sturdy enough to be used underwater, but it spends more time fluttering from one riverside flower to another.

entry: 吸够阳光后，POKENAME终于破壳而出。背上的种子，还能射出黏性的丝网。
author: imagine1.
source: After gathering enough sunlight, POKENAME finally grew out of its shell. They shoot sticky webs from the seed on their back.

entry: 察觉危险，它便扇动翅膀，撒出紫色粉末。吞下这种粉末，连成年男子，也会全身麻痹。
author: .izik
source: If it senses danger, it will flutter its wings and spread a purple powder. This powder can paralyze a full-grown man if ingested.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，便靠双翼在踢击时保持平衡。短暂振翅，还能让它踢得更有力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Lacking arms, POKENAME's wings provide it with the necessary balance for its kicks instead. It can also flutter short distances for harder kicks.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，便靠双翼在踢击时保持平衡。短暂振翅，还能让它踢得更有力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Lacking arms, POKENAME's wings provide it with the necessary balance for its kicks instead. It can also flutter short distances for harder kicks.

entry: 它飞着飞着，常会耗尽体力，直坠林地。已有旅人，被掉下来的POKENAME砸昏。
author: .izik
source: It regularly becomes exhausted during flight, plummeting to the forest floor. Some travelers have been knocked unconscious by a falling POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常会照料迷路的铁甲蛹与绿毛虫，将它们留在身边，直到彻底恢复健康。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often seen taking care of lost Metapod and Caterpie. It keeps them until they are fully rehabilitated.

entry: 它虽美丽，体型却十分庞大，饲养需要宽阔的地方。富有的庄园主，常为POKENAME虹彩般的色泽，而繁育它们。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though beautiful, it requires lots of space to keep due to its massive size. Rich landowners often breed POKENAME for their iridescent colors.

entry: 身体虽一动不动，POKENAME的翅膀却会飞快拍动，本能地帮它躲避天敌。
author: Zagreus8
source: While the body remains immobile, POKENAME's wings flutter rapidly, acting on instinct to allow it to evade predators.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，从不争斗。有人偶尔会看见它从腕部吐丝，织成美丽的挂毯。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: POKENAME is a very peaceful, conflict-free Pokémon. It has occasionally been observed shooting silk out of its wrists to make beautiful tapestries.

entry: POKENAME用复眼巡视巢穴周围。绿波一发出警报，它便能找准敌人的位置。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses its compound eyes to scan the area around its home nest. When Catergey sounds the alarm, it pinpoints the exact position of the enemy.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: Soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: Soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: POKENAME不停为巢穴收集蜂蜜，靠头上触角找到回家的路。身上的花纹，也能吓退敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME constantly collects honey for its home nest, which it can locate thanks to the antennae on its head. Its pattern helps to deter enemies.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀十分无力，常只能随洋流漂荡，吃些浮游生物，以及海面大量滋生的藻类。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's wings are incredibly weak, so it's often seen drifting along the currents of the oceans, feeding on plankton and surface algae blooms.

entry: POKENAME经常采集花蜜与花粉，毛发也常因此，泛起相应花朵的颜色。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The constant collection of flower nectar and pollen often makes POKENAME fur shimmer in the colors of the respective flowers.

entry: POKENAME主要在夜里活动，喜欢在月光下起舞。一察觉有人注视，双眼便会亮起来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily active at night where it dances in the moonlight. Its eyes light up when it senses someone watching it.

entry: 许多巴大蝶毛绒玩具与钥匙圈，都从POKENAME的尾巴取得灵感。可要让它老实待够久，好照着制作，并不容易。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME tails are big inspirations for Butterfree plushies and keychains. Though, it's hard to keep one in place long enough to replicate it.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在花间采蜜。它能飞离地面，却只能坚持几分钟。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME spend most of its time gathering honey from flowers. It can fly above the ground, but only for a few minutes.

entry: 这只宝可梦振翅撒出致幻粉末，再从幻象引起的恐惧中，吸取养分。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon releases a hallucinogenic powder by flapping its wings, absorbing nutrition from the fear the induced visions cause.

entry: POKENAME的壳由能挡住子弹的几丁质构成。若真有人打裂外壳，里面便会涌出团团毒气。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's shell is made from a bulletproof chitin. If you somehow crack its shell, it'll release clouds of poisonous gases into the air.

entry: POKENAME翼上的每片鳞，都是一枚细小的毒刺。身上的毒棘，也能护它免受攻击。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: Each scale on a POKENAME's wing is a small, toxic spike. The toxic quills on its body act as a defense mechanism, protecting it from attacks.

entry: POKENAME满脑子只想找到最甜的蜜。谁若阻拦，它就喷出麻痹气体，直到对方无法再动。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's only goal is to find the sweetest honey. If anyone tries to stop it, it'll spit paralyzing gas until they're neutralized.

entry: 有些旅人在林中遇见POKENAME，会误以为是传说中的妖精。可实际上，它是领地意识极强的融合宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some travelers mistake POKENAME for a mythical fairy when they encounter it in a forest. In fact, however, it is an extremely territorial fusion.

entry: 它会为作物授粉，又能用毒牙赶走害虫，深受农民与花卉爱好者喜爱。
author: Sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is loved by farmers and flower enthusiasts. It helps pollinate crops and protects them against pests with its poisonous fangs.

entry: 它欢欢喜喜地打着转，撒下银色粉末。POKENAME总留意着周围，却偏要装得无忧无虑。
author: Xephyr
source: It twirls gleefully, releasing silver dust as it does. POKENAME is always observing its surroundings but tries to appear carefree.

entry: POKENAME用众多手臂，将嘴里吐出的丝纺成大量丝线。裁缝常养它，帮忙制作礼服。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's many arms help it to spin great quantities of silk, which it produces from its mouth. It is often raised by tailors to help craft dresses.

entry: 它把吸来的蜜储存在花苞中，保持新鲜。这种蜜常作为珍馐，摆上餐厅的餐桌。
author: imagine1.
source: It stores the honey it sucks up inside its bulb, keeping it fresh. This honey is commonly served as a delicacy in restaurants.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: 灾难将至的地方，会聚来数百只POKENAME，试着载起人类与宝可梦，将他们送到安全处。
author: .ssunday.
source: Hundreds of POKENAME swarm around places where tragedy will strike. They try to pick up people and Pokémon and fly them to safety.

entry: 这把华美的剑，只能靠剑刃吸血进食。谁为欣赏美貌而走近，谁就落进了它的陷阱。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This majestic sword can only eat by absorbing blood through its blade. Those who approach it to observe its beauty have only fallen into its trap.

entry: 分成一对之后，它们优美的剑舞，引来了更多受害者，恰好填补了与日俱增的嗜血欲望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The duo's majestic sword-dances attract more victims than it did before it split. That helps it meet its increased thirst for blood.

entry: 它能采集大量花粉与花蜜，酿成蜂蜜。双翅撒出的粉末，还能安抚敌人。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It can collect massive amounts of pollen and nectar to produce honey. Its wings spread a powder that calms its enemies.

entry: 它会保护住在森林里的绿毛虫与铁甲蛹，可巨大的双翅，也常一不小心，把它们吹得老远。
author: chartanon
source: It is known to protect the Caterpie and Metapod that reside in its forest. However, its massive wings do tend to accidentally blow them away.

entry: 它会保护森林里的绿毛虫与铁甲蛹。可自己身体太庞大，也得格外留神，免得不小心压着它们。
author: chartanon
source: It is known to protect the Caterpie and Metapod that reside in its forest. Given its massive form, it must take care to not accidentally crush them.

entry: POKENAME飞起来，宛如翩翩起舞，因此得了个外号：“蝴蝶夫人”。
author: KidDivinegon
source: POKENAME flies through the air almost as if it is dancing. This has earned it the nickname 'Madame Butterfly'.

entry: POKENAME巨翼上的鳞片，带着金属气味。双翅虽比多数宝可梦还大，它却飞不起来。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: The scales POKENAME produces from its massive wings give off a metallic scent. Despite its wings being larger than most Pokémon, it cannot fly.

entry: POKENAME一停止振翅，就说明它正在蓄力，准备拼尽全力，打出下一击。
author: nasho1908
source: When POKENAME stops flapping its wings, it means that it's charging its next attack to give it its all.

entry: POKENAME味觉细腻，要求极高。餐厅常请它把关，检查食材品质。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has exquisite taste. Due to its high standards, it is often used by restaurants for quality control of their ingredients.

entry: 它想用小小的翅膀飞起，头却太重，根本飞不动。好在触角能感知藏在沙土下的猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: It tries to fly with its tiny wings, but is unable to due to its large head. Its antennae can sense prey that is buried under sand or dirt.

entry: 某些洞穴藤蔓开的花，最让它着迷，吸起蜜来，几乎停不下来。吃饱后，便立刻睡着。
author: .izik
source: It will feverishly suck the nectar from flowers that grow on certain cave vines. Should it become full, it will fall asleep immediately.

entry: POKENAME的叶片，能给各种菜肴增添美味。不过，下锅前，必须仔细去净毒素。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME leaves are a delicious flavoring for any dish. Before cooking, you have to drain out the toxins carefully.

entry: POKENAME用花朵释放的孢子，麻痹猎物，再用酸性唾液，将对方慢慢溶解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses spores that come from its flower to immobilize its prey. It then uses its acidic saliva to gradually dissolve its victim.

entry: 寄生孢子的感染，使双翅萎缩。它虽飞不起来，却仍会拍动翅膀，把孢子散播给其他生物。
author: knilk
source: Infection by parasitic spores has atrophied its wings. Unable to fly, it instead uses the flapping of its wings to spread its spores to others.

entry: 双翅主要用于滑翔，平时收拢背后。POKENAME脾气急躁，动不动就会发起攻击。
author: imagine1.
source: Its wings are tucked behind its back, as they're mostly used for gliding. POKENAME have short tempers and will lash out quite regularly.

entry: 尝试了许多次，它终于学会飞行。感官也敏锐了许多，连40英里外的烟，都能察觉。
author: imagine1.
source: After many attempts, it has gained the ability of flight. Its senses have improved significantly, as it can detect smoke 40 miles away.

entry: 双眼看得见四面八方，超能力又能感知视线之外。想偷袭POKENAME，几乎不可能。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Able to see in every direction with its eyes, as well as sense what it can't see with its psychic energy, POKENAME is impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME嗡嗡地高速飞行，沿途留下一道火痕。它动作敏捷灵活，可一吃蜜，就变得温顺、慢悠悠。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME buzz around at high speeds, leaving trails of fire in its path. They are agile and nimble, but when eating honey, they turn docile and slow.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱在宁静的海滩附近筑巢。每到春天，巢穴周围的植物，就会格外繁茂。
author: char_latte3412
source: Wild POKENAME will establish nests in close proximity to a quiet beach. Local flora within the nest's vicinity thrive when springtime comes.

entry: 破开球形的茧后，POKENAME成了一颗只有一只红眼的球。它用丝做出其他身体部位，拼出自己的外形。
author: cubicdesert6
source: After coming out of its ball-shaped cocoon, POKENAME is a ball with one red eye. It creates body parts from silk to form its appearance.

entry: POKENAME很挑食，只吃最甜的花粉与美梦。它的催眠粉能让人安稳入睡，因此十分抢手。
author: noel5229
source: A picky eater, POKENAME only consumes the sweetest pollen and dreams. Its sleep powder induces restful slumber, so it is heavily sought after.

entry: POKENAME住在浅水里，吸收阳光。核心发出的光引来猎物，再由触手将其抓住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in shallow waters to absorb sun's rays. It the glow of its core attracts prey, which it then holds with its tentacles.

entry: POKENAME住在浅水里，吸收阳光。核心发出的光引来猎物，再由触手将其抓住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in shallow waters to absorb sun's rays. It the glow of its core attracts prey, which it then holds with its tentacles.

entry: 它身上众多红宝石，在深海中如繁星闪耀。受攻击时，便迸出刺目的闪光，晃乱敌人的方向。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its many red gems glow like stars in the ocean depths. If attacked, it will flash these gems in a blinding display to disorient enemies.

entry: 晴朗的星夜里，POKENAME的壳会格外明亮。人们远道而来，只为看它们的栖息地，在夜空下点亮。
author: chartanon
source: On clear starry nights, POKENAME's shell glows exceptionally bright. People come from afar to watch their habitats light up under the night sky.

entry: 它把身体埋进沙子，只露出头，伪装成海星星。想吃海星星的宝可梦，反倒成了它的猎物。
author: PokePower
source: It buries its body in the sand, leaving its head out and pretending to be Staryu. Pokémon that try to eat Staryu are it's prey.

entry: POKENAME的两个核心，蓄满太阳能。它先用光晃花附近猎物的眼，再伸出强壮的触手抓住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME´s two cores are charged with solar energy. It uses the glow to blind nearby prey and then grabs it with its strong tentacles.

entry: POKENAME在海中漫无目的地漂浮，直到进化。头上的宝石，能感知精神能量。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME float aimlessly through the ocean until they evolve. The gem on its head can sense psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME肢体折断，还会重新长出。有人试吃过断下的部分，说味道与口感，都不怎么样。
author: OhOk3441
source: If a limb breaks off of POKENAME, it'll regrow. Those who have attempted to eat the torn pieces claim the taste and texture is unappealing.

entry: 据说，POKENAME来自遥远的世界，聪明得不输人类。它靠红宝石闪光，与同伴交流。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is said to come from distant worlds, and it is as intelligent as a human. Its red gems shine as a method of communication.

entry: 只要眼睛完好，POKENAME便能再生身体。星夜里，它站上海边峭壁，让眼睛朝天空发亮、凝望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: As long as its eye is intact, POKENAME can regenerate its body. On starry nights, it stares and shines its eye at the sky from a seaside cliff.

entry: 美丽的花纹与色彩，让它很受水属性行家的欢迎。战斗中失去的肢体，也能重新长好。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its beautiful pattern and colors make this Pokémon popular among water specialists. It can regenerate limbs that have been lost in battle.

entry: POKENAME每观察一种物品或宝可梦，宝石眼就会闪出不同颜色。人们推测，这或许是在分类编目。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME flashes its gem eye different colors at each object or Pokémon it observes. This behavior is thought to be some sort of cataloging.

entry: POKENAME渴望重返群星之间。入夜便不停闪动核心，盼着星辰给它回应。
author: tuneless.towa
source: Longing for its place back among celestial bodies, POKENAME restlessly flashes its core at night, hoping the stars will respond.

entry: 它巡行海滩，朝跃出水面的鱼宝可梦掷出手里剑。两只POKENAME相遇，还会比赛谁抓的猎物更多。
author: kittyluv090
source: It patrols beaches, throwing shurikens at fish Pokémon that jump out of the water. When two POKENAME meet, they compete to catch the most prey.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME游得颇快。若凝望它那颗大宝石，就会神志混乱、头晕目眩。
author: robosoup
source: Somehow, POKENAME is able to swim quite fast. Looking deeply into its large gemstone can cause confusion and intense dizziness.

entry: POKENAME无法主动操纵身上藻类般的突起，可猎物一靠近，仍会被它们缠住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME cannot actively control the algae-like outgrowths on its body. However, if prey approaches, it becomes entangled.

entry: POKENAME无法主动操纵身上藻类般的突起，可猎物一靠近，仍会被它们缠住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME cannot actively control the algae-like outgrowths on its body. However, if prey approaches, it becomes entangled.

entry: 身上的每颗宝石，似乎都是一颗额外的大脑。虽仍与“宝石海星”同名，这家伙的智慧，却少有人能胜过。
author: fixthewifi
source: Each gem found across its body seemingly functions as an additional brain. Few have proven the ability to outwit this homonymous "Starmie".

entry: 野生POKENAME常一动不动，躺在河床或海底，用腹部宝石引来猎物。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are typically found lying motionless on the floors of rivers and oceans. They use the gem on their stomach to attract prey.

entry: POKENAME身上的宝石，能增强超能力与冰之力量。据说，翼间星辰的排列，与头顶夜空一一对应。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME's gem on its body helps enhance both psychic and ice abilities. The stars in its wings are said to align with the night sky above.

entry: 夜晚，POKENAME飞过天际，从翅膀撒下宇宙尘埃。据说见到它时，就该许个愿。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: At night, POKENAME flies across the sky, spreading cosmic dust from its wings. It is said that you should make a wish if you see one.

entry: 脸总被星形面具遮着。人们相信，POKENAME靠水晶球，彼此交谈。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's face is always concealed by its star-shaped mask. POKENAME are believed to communicate with one another through their crystal balls.

entry: 许多人相信，它是来自外太空的孩子。脸上的水晶，似乎能从群星间汲取力量。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: Many believe it is a child from outer space. The crystal attached to its face seems to draw power from the stars.

entry: 它在洞里囤积珍贵宝石，吃进体内，融为身体的一部分。为了黄金堆里的宝石，常与海多拉交战。
author: PokePower
source: It hoards precious gems in caves, eating them to add to its body. It often gets into fights with Stargron for gems within its hoard of gold.

entry: 水宝可梦常把POKENAME误认成大块珊瑚。可一旦被触手缠上，不论猎物多大，POKENAME都照吃不误。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.

entry: 水宝可梦常把POKENAME误认成大块珊瑚。可一旦被触手缠上，不论猎物多大，POKENAME都照吃不误。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.

entry: 它跑得足够快，能在水面奔行。产生的电击，却会让附近的鱼宝可梦遭到重创。
author: homelessrager
source: It can get to a high enough speed to run on water. The electric shocks it creates cause dangerous damage to nearby fish Pokémon.

entry: 它把洞穴中的黄金囤积起来，吃进身体，让黄金成为自身的一部分。为了珍藏中的黄金，它常与海狂犀大打出手。
author: PokePower
source: It hoards gold from caves, eating them to add to its body. It often gets into fights with Starperior for gold within its hoard of gems.

entry: POKENAME身上金黄的部分，由骨骼构成，是天然的铠甲。宝石则引导着它的超能力。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The golden parts of its body act as a natural armor for POKENAME, being made of bone. The gems on its body are the conduits for its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦中，是出色的占星师。可每当路过的旅人，纠正了它的错误，那份骄傲就会碎个干净。
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is known to be an excellent astrologer among Pokémon. However, its pride shatters whenever passing travelers correct its mistakes.

entry: 它躺在海底，沐浴折射而来的日光。若被激怒，就会升出海面，沿途将周围海水，烧得沸腾。
author: togetik
source: It lies at the sea floor, bathing in the refracted light of the sun. If enraged, it ascends out of the seas, boiling the waters around it as it rises.

entry: 据说，死去的恒星，被融合进了这只宝可梦。它夜里吸收星光，为红宝石蓄能，所过之处，一切都会被摧毁。
author: alliveir
source: It's said dead stars were fused into this Pokémon. It absorbs starlight at night in order to charge the red gems that destroy everything in its path.

entry: 古老童话中，POKENAME诞生于群星，能实现迷路孩子回家的愿望。
author: tuneless.towa
source: Old fairy tales depict POKENAME as a Pokémon born of the stars, capable of granting any lost child's wish to return home.

entry: 寻宝者觊觎POKENAME贵重的核心，可谁敢触碰，就会中了让人发狂的诅咒。唯有它的训练家，能安然无恙。
author: tuneless.towa
source: Sought out by treasure hunters for its valuable core, POKENAME places a maddening curse on whoever dares touch it. Only its trainer is spared.

entry: 身体散发着宇宙能量，据说，是群星凝聚的精华。凝望晶体的人，会永远沉醉于其中的美丽。
author: Volvonovic
source: Its body emits a cosmic energy said to be the concentrated essence of the stars. Those who gaze in its crystals are forever entranced by their beauty.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，身后拖着流星般的光。宝石般的眼睛，据说能看见未来，难怪它总惊慌不已。
author: PokePower
source: A running POKENAME leaves lights behind it resembling shooting stars. Its gem-like eye is said to see the future, hence its state of constant panic.

entry: 它扑扇着翅膀，飞过海滩，寻找迷路的旅人。翼间的粉末，会为睡在星空下的人，带来甜梦。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It flutters over beaches in search of lost travelers. The dust it releases from its wings brings sweet dreams to those who sleep beneath the stars.

entry: POKENAME爱模仿虚构的星际超级英雄。偶尔会望向天空，摆出一些古怪、看似毫无意义的姿势。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME styles itself after fictional intergalactic superheroes. On rare occasions, it makes odd and seemingly meaningless poses, looking to the sky.

entry: 它敲着钟，却听不到声响。不过研究人员已经证实：每当POKENAME鸣钟，外太空便有另一口钟，遥遥回应。
author: Fenragon
source: Its bell tolls inaudibly. However, researchers have proven that whenever POKENAME tolls, another bell answers from outer space.

entry: 即使只剩一星火苗，POKENAME也能再生身体。全速奔跑时，POKENAME还可轻松踏水而行。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: If even a single ember of its flames remains, POKENAME can regenerate its body. When moving at top speed, POKENAME can run across water with ease.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的隐秘湖泊。从身上取下的石头，受光角度合适时，会泛起彩虹的七种颜色。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME lives in lakes hidden deep underground. Stones taken from its body glow in the seven colors of the rainbow when light hits them just right.

entry: POKENAME用催眠术，向别人展现绚丽的太空景象。研究人员认为，那是它对往昔故乡的记忆。
author: noel5229
source: Using Hypnosis, POKENAME shares gorgeous visuals of outer space with others. Researchers believe these depictions are memories of its former home.

entry: POKENAME性情友善讨喜，一心想交很多朋友。可要留神，POKENAME饿起来，可就不那么友好了！
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME wants to have a lot of friends; it's a very kind and pleasant Pokémon. However, beware POKENAME when it is hungry: It will not be friendly!

entry: POKENAME模样可怕，许多人担心被它伤害，见了就逃。可实际上，它不过想找个温暖的家，安定下来。
author: Skymaster426
source: Due to its horrifying appearance, many run from POKENAME in fear of it harming them. In reality however, it only wishes to settle down in a warm home.

entry: POKENAME性情友善讨喜，一心想交很多朋友。可要留神，POKENAME饿起来，可就不那么友好了！
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME wants to have a lot of friends; it's a very kind and pleasant Pokémon. However, beware POKENAME when it is hungry: It will not be friendly!

entry: 它爱陪孩子玩，故意装出凶闹的模样，再突然收起架势，逗得大家笑。气球般的尾巴掉了，还能重新长出。
author: mx_wellman
source: It loves to play with children, pretending to get rowdy only to get a laugh out of them when it drops the act. Its balloon tails regrow when detached.

entry: 若察觉训练家伤心，POKENAME便会表演，想让对方开心。实在不行，就上前抱一抱。
author: spriter
source: If it ever senses sadness from its Trainer, POKENAME will perform in an attempt to cheer them up. As a last resort, they will try to hug them.

entry: 这种POKENAME模仿了一位偏远地方胖厨师的模样。那位厨师，曾红过短短一阵。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME mimics the appearance of a portly chef from the middle of nowhere. Said chef was once popular for a short period of time.

entry: POKENAME总是乐呵呵，还爱把快乐分享出去。因此，学校与养老院，都很欢迎它作吉祥物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is always happy and shares this joy with others, which is why it is a popular mascot in educational institutions or retirement homes.

entry: 看不出吧，POKENAME其实更爱住在地下。有人说，独处时，它还会轻声向自己出主意。
author: GP423
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME prefers to live underground. Some people claim it whispers suggestions to them when no one else is around.

entry: POKENAME始终在身前撑着保护屏障。可危险来了，它也不肯转身，让屏障白白失了用处。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME holds a protective barrier in front of itself at all times. However, it doesn't turn to face potential dangers, making the barrier useless.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，或许是世上最傲慢的家伙之一。在它眼里，所有宝可梦都是侍奉自己的臣属。
author: elevn.
source: This fusion is perhaps one of the most haughty that this world knows; it considers all Pokémon as its court.

entry: POKENAME用双手造出的无形屏障，十分坚固。有些公司，乃至政府机构，都请它负责安保。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: With its hands, POKENAME can create such robust and invisible barriers that it is used by some companies and even government agencies for security.

entry: POKENAME歌声美妙，常在世界各地的歌唱比赛中，与胖丁一较高下。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME has a fantastic singing voice. It often competes with Jigglypuff in singing competitions across the world.

entry: 马戏团演员常请POKENAME为节目献唱。它脸上的花纹，也常让小孩子看得高兴。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is often used by circus performers to provide vocals for their attractions. The pattern on its face usually delights small children.

entry: 这只宝可梦竭力想逗病人开心，可模样太吓人，大家往往顾不上欣赏表演，就已心生畏惧。
author: treeman4
source: POKEMON tries their best to cheer up the sick. However, people tend to be too afraid of its appearance to enjoy the show.

entry: 这位神灵精通喜剧与娱乐，偶尔会悄悄降临喜剧演员身边，品评笑话，给些实用的建议。
author: planatical
source: This deity specializes in comedy and entertainment. It occasionally descends in secret to comedians to evaluate their jokes and offer useful advice.

entry: 气球刀刃一爆，POKENAME便慌忙从手里抽出另一只气球，假装用打气筒充气，再扭成新刀。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: If its blade ever pops, POKENAME frantically pulls another balloon from its hand, mimes inflating it with a tire pump, and twists up a new one.

entry: 最让POKENAME开心的，就是逗人类与宝可梦乐一乐。它们尤其擅长手法魔术与抛接杂耍。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME are happiest when they entertain people and Pokémon. They are excel in sleight of hand and juggling.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在人群前，演出各式马戏。看过的人，目光都舍不得移开。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME likes to perform various circus acts for large crowds of people. Those who witness its performance are unable to look away.

entry: 它顽皮又爱逗人，尤其喜欢孩子。见谁不高兴，便会使出浑身解数，让对方露出笑容。
author: imagine1.
source: It's playful and loves entertaining people, especially children. If it sees someone who is unhappy, it'll try its best to make them smile.

entry: POKENAME常随马戏团同行，靠歌唱与滑稽的默剧，带给人们欢乐。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME commonly accompanies circuses, where it entertains people through singing and humorous pantomime.

entry: POKENAME不能移动，只能原地转动。靠近的生物，它始终紧盯不放，还会从瞳孔射出粉红色弹丸。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is an immobile Pokémon, only able to rotate. It never loses sight of anyone that comes near. It fires pink projectiles from its pupils.

entry: POKENAME看似只是一只宝可梦，其实是许多微小生命，组成的蜂巢式集体。体内的成员，远比外面看起来多。
author: ohok3441
source: While it appears to be a single Pokémon, POKENAME is a hive-like collective of smaller beings. There are more inside than it appears from the outside.

entry: POKENAME技艺出色，很受马戏团演员青睐。它还能造出隐形物体，融入自己的表演。
author: pory
source: Sought out for its artistic skill, POKENAME is a popular pick amongst circus performers. It can create invisible constructs as part of its act.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，哪里就多几分奇趣。巨大的菌盖旋转时，会让敌人误以为，一切都很安全。
author: Xephyr
source: POKENAME brings whimsy wherever it goes. The swirling of the giant mushroom cap lulls foes into a false sense of security.

entry: 它看着人畜无害，走得也慢悠悠。可一爬到猎物头上，POKENAME便会吸走对方的大脑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears harmless and moves at a leisurely pace. Once it reaches the head of its prey, however, POKENAME sucks out its victim's brain.

entry: POKENAME用马戏团般的声响与气味，引来孩子。谁若试图走进它体内，灵魂就会被吸干。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME lure children to it with the sounds and smells of a circus. Any who attempt to enter it will have their soul drained.

entry: 它看着人畜无害，走得也慢悠悠。可一爬到猎物头上，POKENAME便会吸走对方的大脑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears harmless and moves at a leisurely pace. Once it reaches the head of its prey, however, POKENAME sucks out its victim's brain.

entry: 它看着人畜无害，走得也慢悠悠。可一爬到猎物头上，POKENAME便会吸走对方的大脑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears harmless and moves at a leisurely pace. Once it reaches the head of its prey, however, POKENAME sucks out its victim's brain.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME抡锤迎击敌人，降下自己的审判。身形虽有些扁平，运气来时，仍能爆发惊人的威力。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: A POKENAME attacks foes with its hammer, unleashing its judgement upon them. While a little flat, it can release devastating power when it gets lucky.

entry: POKENAME用大手撑起无形屏障，逼退敌人，再伸出藤蔓般的舌头，撒下毒孢子，制服猎物。
author: Raza
source: POKENAME use their large hands to repel foes with invisible barriers before extending their vine-like tongue, using toxic spores to incapacitate prey.

entry: 它用双翼缓缓降到水面喝水。可偶尔拍得太快，反而一头扎进水里。
author: .izik
source: It uses its wings to slowly descend to the water's surface to drink. Occasionally, its wings flap too quickly and send it under the surface.

entry: 越惊慌，外壳就越硬。遇到敌人，它会短暂飞起，再用坚硬的身体，撞向对方。
author: .izik
source: Its shell gets harder if it panics. If it encounters an enemy, it will fly for a short period of time before colliding its hard body with its foe.

entry: 这只宝可梦几乎动不了，只能靠巨大的双镰防备天敌。等待进化时，它总焦躁不安。
author: volvonovic
source: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon uses its massive scythes to defend itself from predators. It grows restless as it awaits evolution.

entry: 野外遇上POKENAME，就快逃吧。双镰能轻松划开皮肉，硬壳又挡得住多数攻击。
author: Krune
source: Should you encounter a wild POKENAME, run. Its scythes are sharp enough to cut through skin with ease, and its shell can deflect most attacks.

entry: 这把飞镰迅捷而致命，收割了许多虫宝可梦的性命，甚至让某些种类陷入生存危机。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Swift and deadly, this flying scythe has been the reaper of many bug Pokémon, endangering some species.

entry: 它能极为精确地控制双镰，只需挥动一下，就能割断一片草叶，而不碰到周围的其他草叶。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Their scythes can be moved very precisely; they can cut a single blade of grass in a single slash without disturbing the surrounding blades.

entry: 这是一种生活在热带的史前猎手，可身体太重，只能飞上短短一段。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: A prehistoric predator that lived in tropical areas. Due to their body weight, however, they are only able to fly short distances.

entry: 训练家凝望POKENAME的冰块，会在里面看见更漂亮的自己。它希望，让大家都欣赏自己的美。
author: .ssunday.
source: When a Trainer stares into POKENAME's block of ice, they see a prettier version of themselves. It aims to make people happy about their beauty.

entry: POKENAME最珍爱自己的头发。只有发型格外时髦的训练家，才准摸一摸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME loves its hair more than anything. It only lets Trainers with particularly stylish hairstyles touch its own.

entry: POKENAME转着圈，唱出美妙的歌。可它发出的声音，至今无人能分毫不差地模仿。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME sings a beautiful song as it spins around. Nobody has ever been able to precisely replicate the sounds it makes.

entry: 这只小小的融合宝可梦，难得一见，却很难伺候。少数想训练POKENAME的人，也常被它理所当然、任性索求的态度劝退。
author: howlingstarr
source: A rare yet demanding little fusion. The few who attempt to train POKENAME are often put off by its entitlement.

entry: POKENAME太爱跳舞，常成了别人的麻烦。它会堵着路，一直跳到自己满意，才肯罢休。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME are so eager about dancing that they are considered a nuisance.They will block paths and dance until they are satisfied.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛细滑如丝。能帮它保养容貌的训练家，它才愿信任。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's mane is made up of silky hairs. It only trusts Trainers that can help it maintain its appearance.

entry: 寄生型的POKENAME会用幻象，引来人类与宝可梦，再附到对方身上，吸取生命力。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The parasitic POKENAME use illusions to lure in people and Pokémon, attaching themselves to their victims to drain their vitality.

entry: 谁靠近它的住处，它便跳起猛烈的舞，发出警告。对方若不离开，也不跟着跳，它就会暴跳如雷。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It aggressively dances as a warning when people or Pokémon approach its home. If they don't either leave or dance along in turn, it flies into a rage.

entry: POKENAME喜欢冬天。无论什么场合，都昂首阔步，自信而从容，甚至让人有点不安。
author: thehatster
source: POKENAME loves the winter season. It struts into any situation with disturbing confidence and poise.

entry: POKENAME整天用尾巴分泌的口红，一遍遍涂抹自己丰满的双唇。
author: scotsman
source: POKENAME spends its days repeatedly coating its plump lips with the lipstick secreted from its tail.

entry: 它用敏锐的双手冻结空气。双目虽盲，却能凭心灵感应，看清被它冰镇过的任何物品。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It freezes the air with its sensitive hands. Though blind, it can clearly see any object it chills with its telepathy.

entry: POKENAME会羞答答地起舞，吸引伴侣。金色的头发，也常被用来制作假发。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME performs bashful dances to attract mates. Its golden hair is often used as wigs.

entry: 头骨实在太厚，头皮里竟容不下滋养毛发的血管，因此POKENAME秃了顶。
author: .realthree
source: Its skull is so thick, there's no room in the skin for the blood vessels that nourish healthy hair, so POKENAME is bald on top.

entry: 它总是专横、冷淡，即使对自己的训练家，也毫不例外。可内心深处，它真心感激，照料过自己的人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its demeanor is unflinchingly bossy and cold, even towards its own Trainer. Deep down, however, it truly appreciates those who care for it.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现身。据说，只有感情渐淡的情侣，才会见到它，因此也有人称它为“心碎先知”。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Seldom seen, POKENAME is believed to only show itself to couples who are falling out of love. It's sometimes referred to as the Prophet of Heartbreak.

entry: 严寒的冬夜，POKENAME会现身，将迷路的旅人引向歧途，再带往灵界。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME appears on particularly cold winter nights to lead lost wanderers astray and carry them off to the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME能用伴随身侧的灵火打开传送门，转眼之间，便跨越遥远的距离。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can create portals with the spirit flames that accompany it, allowing it to travel long distances in a short time.

entry: POKENAME住在城堡、遗迹与废屋中，支配附近的宝可梦，让它们麻木地侍奉自己。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in castles, ruins, and abandoned houses. It controls other Pokémon in the vicinity, which serve POKENAME apathetically.

entry: 它生活在高山，看着柔软、温暖，可别被骗了——蓬松羊毛般的东西，其实是锋利、坚硬的水晶。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Living in high mountains, it appears deceptively soft and warm. Don't be fooled—what seems to be fluffy wool is actually sharp, rock-hard crystal.

entry: 天生的节奏感与细腻歌声，让它们深受音乐家喜爱。不过小时候，倒常被自己的毛绊倒。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Their natural rhythm and delicate singing voices make them a favorite Pokémon among musicians. When they are young, they often trip over their fur.

entry: 蜕下的毛皮，会变得漆黑、如皮革一般。它会将毛皮编成手袋模样，装进食物与宝物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When it molts, its fur turns black and leathery. It weaves the shed fur into something resembling a purse, which it stores food and treasure in.

entry: 它害羞、在意别人的眼光，却也格外亲人。只要真心疼爱、照顾，它便会至死信赖你。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It is bashful and self-conscious, but extremely affectionate. Shown genuine love and care, it will trust you to the grave.

entry: 它虚荣得厉害，可凭美貌，仍十分受欢迎。有钱的名人，常一养就是十几、几十只。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though hideously vain, it is nonetheless popular for its beauty. Wealthy celebrities have been known to own them by the dozen.

entry: POKENAME是葬身暴风雪的舞者。遗憾未消，灵魂便游荡在雪山，悲唱着近似人语的歌。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME is a dancer who perished during a snowstorm. Regrets intact, its spirit roams the snowy mountains and cries a song akin to human speech.

entry: POKENAME会在午夜起舞，磨炼利爪。它们不知怎么，竟能说一种只有自己训练家才懂的秘语。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME hone their claws by dancing during midnight. They somehow speak in a secretive language that only their Trainer can understand.

entry: 为了守卫领地，它们会跳起融入鸣声的独特战舞。人们认为，这源自古老的文化。
author: houndrys.
source: To defend their territory, they perform a unique war dance that incorporates its cries. It is believed that it learned this from ancient cultures.

entry: POKENAME浓密秀美的金色长发，令人争相追求。它还能让发间的冷热，维持完美平衡。
author: T.I.A.
source: The luscious, golden locks of a POKENAME are highly coveted. It can perfectly keep heat and cold balanced within them.

entry: 它们戒心很重，极少离开坚硬如金刚的壳。不过，倒能见到它们随着节奏，迅速游动。
author: houndrys.
source: Being quite defensive, they are rarely seen out of their adamantine shell. However, they can be seen swiftly swimming in rhythmic patterns.

entry: 它漂在冰冷的海水中，冷若冰霜的模样，让水手畏惧。只要向珍珠说话，就能射出并操纵坚硬的冰刺。
author: houndrys.
source: Feared for its icy demeanor by sailors, it drifts away in cold waters. By speaking to its pearl, it can shoot and control hard, freezing spikes.

entry: POKENAME爱在海滩偷饰品，再拿来作道具，逗其他宝可梦开心。
author: Lemmymaster#7521
source: POKENAME love to steal accessories on beachy areas. They use these as props to entertain other Pokémon.

entry: 雷雨来时，成群的POKENAME会聚在山坡，比赛争夺让雷劈中的资格。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Herds of POKENAME will gather on mountainsides during thunderstorms. They compete to determine who will be allowed to get struck by lightning.

entry: 一兴奋，POKENAME的闪电就会热得如太阳耀斑，身上的电光，也能亮过十支火把。
author: gento_
source: An POKENAME's lightning can be as hot as a solar flare when excited. The lightning on POKENAME's body glows as much as ten torches.

entry: 雷雨将近，POKENAME群便躁动起来，争相寻找高处。为了好位置，连同族也会咬。
author: char_latte3412
source: Groups of POKENAME frenzy at the approach of a thunderstorm, all rushing to find a vantage point. It will even bite its own kin for a prime spot.

entry: 必要时，POKENAME的两颗头，都会上阵战斗。火与电招式并用，能应对多种宝可梦。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's two heads both battle if necessary. They use both Fire and Electric moves to counter many Pokémon.

entry: 前面的头喷电，后面的头吐火。可这两颗头，却很少有意见一致的时候。
author: kittyluv090
source: The front head breathes electricity, while the back head breathes fire. The two heads rarely agree on anything.

entry: POKENAME体内始终蓄着庞大电力，移动速度可达20马赫。走投无路时，还能引发巨大的能量爆发。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME has a massive constant charge within its body, allowing it to move at Mach 20. When cornered, it can produce a giant blast of energy.

entry: 据说，若有POKENAME开始尾随你，不久之后，你就注定会遭雷劈。
author: Staghorn
source: It is said that if an POKENAME starts following you, you are doomed to be struck by lightning in the near future.

entry: 它们把触须当作电缆，吸取电力。暴风雨中，POKENAME常站上屋顶，充当避雷针。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: They can use their feelers as cables to absorb electricity. POKENAME will often stand on rooftops and act like lightning rods during storms.

entry: POKENAME桀骜、敏捷，总等着值得一战的对手。它惯用高压电，专攻身体的特定部位。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: Defiant and agile, POKENAME always waits for a worthy opponent. Its fighting style focuses on shocking certain body parts with high voltage.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴撑住身体，显得更有威势。无论毛发，还是洪亮的声音，都能引发静电电击。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME balance on their tail to appear more menacing. Both their fur and powerful voice can cause static shocks.

entry: POKENAME追着风暴，把闪电收进体内。待蓄满电力，所到之处，便又会掀起新的风暴。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME chase storms to collect lightning inside their bodies. Once they've gained enough charge, they produce new storms wherever they travel.

entry: POKENAME能造出小片雷云，躺在上面，歇在空中。谁敢打扰它睡觉，就会挨上猛烈的雷击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME能造出小片雷云，躺在上面，歇在空中。谁敢打扰它睡觉，就会挨上猛烈的雷击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.

entry: 两只鸭嘴火兽的力量融合后，火焰与本能，也变得愈发狂野，尤其在激战之中。
author: entomoxie
source: When two Magmar have their powers fused together, their flames and instincts grow wilder, especially in the heat of battle.

entry: 火焰像香烛，带着怡人的气息。POKENAME虽擅长游泳，却为免熄灭火焰，始终远离水。
author: sporkwizard
source: Like a candle, its flame produces a pleasant aroma. Despite being a proficient swimmer, POKENAME stays away from water to avoid putting out its flame.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会溜进卧室。光是待在那里，就把房间烘热，让人辗转难眠。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: At night, POKENAME slips into bedrooms to heat up the room with its presence and make it difficult to sleep.

entry: POKENAME身体滚烫，珊瑚枝因此很难采得。可一旦取到，便能制成昂贵的珠宝。
author: pokebio
source: Coral branches from POKENAME are hard to obtain due to POKENAME having a hot body. Once obtained, they are used to make expensive jewelry.

entry: 在POKENAME眼里，战斗就是舞蹈。它轻巧错步，避开攻击，还总留着一只手，等舞伴来牵。
author: Leshii
source: For POKENAME, there is no difference between battle and dance. It sidesteps attacks with the greatest ease with one hand always open for a partner.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: Leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: Leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME以优雅潇洒的舞步，穿行战场。火热的心熊熊燃烧，战斗也宛如与对手共舞。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME dances about the battlefield with grace and style. With its fiery heart burning bright, it battles as though dancing with another.

entry: 若耳朵与尾巴上的火焰低落，训练家就该给POKENAME喂些木炭。火一暗，它便会行动迟缓。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: If the flames on its ears and tail seem low, Trainers should feed their POKENAME charcoal. It becomes sluggish when its flames are dim.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，温度高达数百度，因此，只会在石头或金属结构上筑巢。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The threads that POKENAME spins reach temperatures of several hundred degrees. This is why it builds its nests on stones or metal structures.

entry: POKENAME能爬上墙壁与天花板。喷火前，眼睛上方的毛会先亮起，若见到这一幕，就快离开吧。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can climb walls and ceilings. Just before it spits fire, the fur above its eyes lights up. If you see this, get out of the area.

entry: 它点燃毛发，保护自己。身上烧着火，POKENAME毫不在意，就连意外引起森林大火，也不放在心上。
author: PokePower
source: It sets its fur alight for protection. Being ablaze doesn't bother POKENAME in the least, nor any forest fires it accidentally starts.

entry: 身体由燃烧的火成岩组成。谁让POKENAME觉得有威胁，它就喷出熔岩迎击，只是射得不远。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its body is made of burning igneous rock. POKENAME will spew molten rock at anyone it finds a threat, even though it can't shoot very far.

entry: 闻到硫黄臭味，又听见喇叭般的笑声，就说明附近有POKENAME。它吃易燃蒸气，也可能酿成致命的爆炸。
author: robosoup
source: A sulfuric stench and honking laugh are signs of a nearby POKENAME. It feeds on flammable vapors, and may cause deadly explosions.

entry: 这种异色POKENAME不像散发硫黄味的同类，反而有股甜得发腻的气味。某些化学污染物，会让它变成这种颜色。
author: robosoup
source: This shiny POKENAME has a more sickly-sweet odor, compared to its sulphuric counterparts. Certain chemical pollutants will lead to this color.

entry: 它用强劲的握力，挤碎树果，尤其爱没熟的——越难榨出汁，越合它心意。
author: .izik
source: It crushes berries with its tight grip. It prefers berries that haven't ripened because they are more difficult to juice.

entry: 这是与凯罗斯融合的特殊蛋蛋。融合体会吃普通蛋蛋补充能量，形成一种神秘的共生关系。
author: xyloldi
source: A unique Exeggcute variant, fused with Pinsir. Those merged with Pinsir consume regular Exeggcute for energy; a mysterious symbiotic relationship.

entry: 等待进化时，外壳会部分脱落。碎片磨成粉，便能用来制作防御强化。
author: .izik
source: Portions of its shell fall off as it waits for evolution. These pieces are ground up for use in creating X Defense supplements.

entry: 它们一点不挑食，凡是能吃的都吞。农民恨透了POKENAME，因为它们不只吃光庄稼，连农场的宝可梦也会掳走。
author: mrbapcik
source: These Pokémon aren't picky eaters; they will devour anything edible. Farmers hate POKENAME because they eat entire crops and carry away farm Pokémon.

entry: 它潜藏海滩，用双钳困住毫无防备的敌人。外壳太沉，平日很少挪动。
author: imagine1.
source: It hides on beaches, trapping any unsuspecting foe it finds with its pincers. It rarely moves, as its shell is very heavy.

entry: POKENAME大张着嘴，看着不祥，其实很有礼貌。可它总不慎绊倒，用角撞穿家具。
author: beespoon
source: Its gaping mouth may seem ominous, but POKENAME is actually very polite. However, it is prone to tripping and ramming its horns through furniture.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋在林地，俨如陷阱，猛然钻出，刺穿受害者。每晚，它都靠小型虫宝可梦为食。
author: samu_games
source: POKENAME is known for burying its body in forests and emerging to pierce its victims as a painful trap. It feeds on smaller Bug-type Pokémon nightly.

entry: 夹住对手，还是将其掀翻，全看它临场的战术。两只POKENAME交锋时，却总会选相反的招数。
author: Staghorn
source: Whether it aims to pinch or flip its opponent varies on a tactical basis. When two POKENAME fight, they will always choose opposite tactics.

entry: 钳子从POKENAME头部穿出，遮挡了视线，害它找食物时格外费劲。
author: Toxicrown
source: The pincer that protrudes through the head of POKENAME has caused it's vision to be reduced. It struggles to find food because of this.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的全身，收缩进了外壳，钻地、藏身都更方便。它还靠电磁力，调节体温。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME fully condensed into its shell upon fusion, which makes burrowing and hiding easier. It uses electromagnetism to regulate body temperature.

entry: 这只近乎动弹不得的小宝可梦，会涌出强大的黑暗力量。无数凯罗斯的牙齿，在漩涡中永不停歇地旋转。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Dark power surges from this small, near immobile Pokémon. The vortex is filled with the teeth of countless different Pinsir, endlessly spinning.

entry: 若不曾夺走所有持握者的四肢，POKENAME本该是伐木与拆迁的好工具。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME would be an excellent tool for logging and demolition, if it wouldn't claim the limbs of all those attempting to wield it.

entry: 它顶着双钳，朝目标猛冲。巨口张开，多数猎物都能一口吞下。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It attacks by charging pincers-first towards its targets. Its large mouth allows it to swallow most prey in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME将猎物整个吞下，在烤炉般的胃里焚烧。埋在地下时，还常被误认成火山。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME swallows its prey whole, incinerating them in its oven-like stomach. If buried in the ground, it is often mistaken for a volcano.

entry: 它模样虽凶，只吃腐朽的木头。胃口惊人，倒成了出色的分解者。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, it only feeds on rotting logs. Its ravenous appetite makes it an excellent decomposer.

entry: 眼睛变成了更多的嘴，它也因此失明。可饥饿丝毫不减，抓到什么，就想吃什么。
author: Skymaster426
source: Due to its eyes having become extra mouths, it is now blind. However, it is also agressively hungry, and will try and eat whatever it can grab.

entry: POKENAME总掩着脸，不露出那张参差利齿的大嘴。面具一揭，便会用剪刀般的利爪，凶狠出击。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME obscure their faces to hide their jagged mouths. When they demask, they attack viciously with shear-like claws.

entry: 吃下的东西，全被尾巴上的大舌贝吸走。它用双钳攀紧河岸，漂来什么，就吞什么。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Everything it eats is absorbed by the Shellder on its tail. It latches onto riverbanks with its pincers and devours anything that floats past.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的钳子抱住树，摇落果实，再分给附近的其他宝可梦。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME grips trees with its powerful pincers and shakes them to knock down fruit. It then shares the fruit with other Pokémon in the area.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的钳子抱住树，摇落果实，再分给附近的其他宝可梦。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME grips trees with its powerful pincers and shakes them to knock down fruit. It then shares the fruit with other Pokémon in the area.

entry: POKENAME脾气坏，领地意识也强，可实在懒得出手，只会远远瞪着闯入者。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME is extremely temperamental and territorial, but far too lazy to actually attack anyone. It simply glares at interlopers from afar.

entry: POKENAME见什么都想撞，可身体太轻，没多少威力。头上的角，也还没长好。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will try to ram themselves into anything, even though their bodies are so light they don't do much damage. Their horns are still developing.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，能抡起钝器，打出威力惊人的寒冰重击。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are capable of delivering devastating, ice-powered blows with their bludgeoning weapon. They are incredibly agile in battle.

entry: POKENAME尾端的包裹，其实能当斗篷，挥向敌人。可偶尔它自己瞥见，也会追着尾巴跑。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME's tail bundle actually functions as a cape that it brandishes at its enemies. Sometimes it will catch a glimpse of it and chase its own tail.

entry: 草原上常能看见POKENAME，贴地低飞，追踪作为猎物的草宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a common sight in prairies. It flies low over the ground as it follows the Grass-type Pokémon it preys upon.

entry: 它跑得不算快，防御却极强。三条尾巴能抽打敌人，角则用来冲撞。
author: themicelegion
source: It is not a very fast Pokémon, but it is extremely defensive. It whips foes with its three tails and rams into them with its horns.

entry: POKENAME常成群顶角嬉闹，假打玩耍。它们耐力惊人，连跑几个小时，也不必休息。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Herds of POKENAME play by locking their horns in play fights. They have high stamina and can run for hours without rest.

entry: 听歌声的高低，就能知道POKENAME生没生气。真正冲锋之前，声音反而会轻得如耳语。
author: MrPeach774
source: You can tell a POKENAME is angry by the pitch of its song. Its voice drops to a whisper when it is about to charge.

entry: POKENAME打架弱得可怜，却是贵重的食材，常被铺在寿司上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is pathetically weak in battle. However, it is valued as a food, and it is commonly served on top of sushi.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的能量，足够维持一个小家庭的日常用电。可虽然能供电，它却无法将能量化为攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is said to contain enough power to run a small household. Despite its use as a power source, it is unable to turn this energy into attacks.

entry: 这只传说中的海兽，经融合技术，恢复了远古的辉煌模样。可力量，还是弱得可怜。
author: Brienie
source: A legendary creature of the sea, restored to its ancient glory through fusion technology. Its power, however, is still weak and pathetic.

entry: 垃圾邮件、陈年论坛与河岸，都可能漂来POKENAME。罪犯拿它窃取敏感资料，它虽厌恶这份差事，却无力反抗。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME washes up in spam emails, old forums and riverbanks. Criminals use it to get sensitive information, which it hates but is too weak to fight.

entry: 将鲤鱼王与最强生命体融合的实验，的确成功了。可即便如此，也没能给鲤鱼王添上什么了不起的力量。
author: Brienie
source: Experiments to fuse a Magikarp with the strongest lifeform were a success. However, it was still not enough to give Magikarp any noteworthy power.

entry: POKENAME游得飞快，还能跃出水面，滑翔好几米，再潜回深水。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is an extremely fast swimmer that can jump out of the water and glide many meters before diving back into the depths.

entry: POKENAME天资聪颖，却白白浪费潜能。整天自鸣得意，钻研些无意义、无用处、毫无道理的话题。
author: Leeto64
source: POKENAME have gifted minds, but wasted potentials. They waste their intellect smugly pondering meaningless, useless and senseless topics all day.

entry: 高大瀑布旁，常能看见POKENAME，想用爪子爬到顶端。可每次，没爬到就先累了。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME is commonly seen around tall waterfalls, using its claws to climb to the top. However, it always gets tired before it can reach its goal.

entry: 保卫领地时，POKENAME会乱挥双臂，想显得吓人些。可惜，通常都没什么效果。
author: Brienie
source: When POKENAME defends its territory, it can be seen flailing its arms about in an attempt to be intimidating. This attempt is usually unsuccessful.

entry: 这位传说中的战士，曾启发许多水中格斗术，如今却弱得难以作战。每天只带着背上的鲤鱼王，继续训练。
author: squawkabairdy
source: This legendary warrior once inspired many aquatic combat styles, but is now too weak to fight. It spends its days training Magikarp on its back.

entry: 这柄古老的传说之刃，遗失于深海。据说谁握起POKENAME，都会变得前所未有地弱。
author: Brienie
source: A legendary and ancient blade, lost deep in the ocean. It is said whoever wields POKENAME will become weaker than ever before.

entry: 谁想拿起POKENAME，它便拼命扑腾。可实在没力气，很快就屈服，被当地渔民拿去剖鱼。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME wildly flops when someone tries to pick it up. However, it is so weak that it quickly gives in to being used by local fisherman to gut fish.

entry: 坚盾剑怪本能地渴望战斗。有人便利用这一点，带它们走进另一个战场——那里有香料、香气，还有美味佳肴。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Aegislash yearn for battle instinctively. Some have used this trait and taken them to another battlefield, of spice and smell and delicious food.

entry: POKENAME想执刃守护海洋，可年纪尚幼，还不能参加真正的战斗。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME wishes to take up a blade in defense of the sea. Still, its youth hinders it from seeing real combat.

entry: 海洋危急之时，POKENAME便会挺身守护。平日不忙护海，便总在刻苦训练。
author: Brienie
source: POKENAME have been known to defend the ocean in times of peril. When they are not defending the ocean, they can be found constantly training.

entry: 力量、速度虽都不强，它们却能在任何水域生活，靠长长的胡须，感知周围。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Though weak in terms of power and speed, they are able to live in any body of water. They use their long whiskers to feel their surroundings.

entry: 都说能力越大，责任越大。可多数训练家只觉得，养POKENAME责任实在太重，等不到进化，就已放弃。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: They say with great power comes great responsibility; most Trainers think raising POKENAME is too much responsibility and give up before it evolves.

entry: 夜里，它徘徊于水下遗迹，带着一顶王冠。据说，那曾是它还是鲤鱼王时，身上的背鳍。
author: clawshdi
source: It wanders through underwater ruins by night, carrying a crown that's said to have been the dorsal fin it had when it was still just a Magikarp.

entry: POKENAME张嘴喘气的脸，常惹人取笑。离水后虽似乎很不舒服，它仍愿随训练家，走到任何地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's gasping face is the subject of much ridicule. Though it seems uncomfortable out of the water, it will follow its Trainer anywhere.

entry: POKENAME张嘴喘气的脸，常惹人取笑。离水后虽似乎很不舒服，它仍愿随训练家，走到任何地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's gasping face is the subject of much ridicule. Though it seems uncomfortable out of the water, it will follow its Trainer anywhere.

entry: POKENAME只能在茂密灌丛中缓缓前进，可身上的倒刺，带着强烈的毒液。林间跋涉，可要留意。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can only move slowly through dense undergrowth. However, its barbs spread a strong venom, so hikers should be careful in the forest.

entry: 头上的角，会分泌毒性极弱的毒素。虽说接触太多也危险，平时却只会引起轻微皮疹。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its head secretes an extremely weak toxin. It can be dangerous in large quantities, but usually it just causes a mild rash.

entry: 头顶的尖刺藏着剧毒，越临近进化，毒性就越致命。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its head holds an incredibly potent poison. As it gets closer to evolution, the poison becomes more deadly.

entry: POKENAME想装凶，反而只会逗人笑。这只滑稽的小虫若摔倒，爬起来还很费劲。
author: RoboSoup
