source: When POKENAME tries to act fierce, it only makes people laugh. If this clownish bug falls over, it has trouble getting back up.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛，柔软程度名列世间前茅。POKENAME会结成群落，一同探寻树果。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's wool is very some of the softest in the world. POKENAME forms colonies that scout for Berries together.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: 别看POKENAME体型不起眼，打起来却顽强得很，甚至会张嘴咬对手。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly persistent combatants, and may even bite their opponents.

entry: 据说，被POKENAME的触须蜇一下，就像挨了雷劈。怕虫的人，对这只宝可梦尤其厌恶。
author: 8xviktor
source: It's been said that a sting from one of POKENAME's tendrils feels like getting struck by lighting. Those with a fear of bugs despise this Pokémon.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME两腿看着黏滑，摸起来又软又能捏。头顶的大角，则能挥开挡路的树枝。
author: hatsune_miko
source: A POKENAME's legs are soft and squishy, despite its slimy look. The large horn on POKENAME's head is used to swipe branches away.

entry: POKENAME沿袭绿剑鞘的进化方式，又添上丝制的尖刺，让连枷更能吓退敌人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has built onto Cateredge's evolutionary strategy by adding silk spikes to make its flail a greater deterrent.

entry: 天敌来袭，它便把带刺的飘带扎过去，注入使人麻木的毒液。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When defending itself from predators, it jabs its spiked ribbons into them, filling them with a numbing poison.

entry: POKENAME身上尖锐的齿轮，全由丝构成，却能硬化到，几乎像钢一样坚韧。
author: char_latte3412
source: The pointed cogs adorning POKENAME's body are composed entirely of silk, but are capable of hardening to a toughness resembling steel.

entry: POKENAME最爱秋叶。被它蜇到，会肿得厉害，除此之外，倒没有别的危险。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's favorite food is autumn leaves. Its sting causes extreme swelling, but is otherwise harmless.

entry: 野生POKENAME生活在森林中，会啃食其他树木的枝条。
author: grassy311
source: Wild POKENAME can be found in forests, eating the branches off of other trees.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋入地下，只露头顶的尖刺，防备天敌。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME protects itself from predators by burying itself under the ground and leaving the spike atop its head exposed.

entry: 它夜里潜行河湖，静候猎物。关都发生的宝可梦袭击事件中，有很大一部分，都是POKENAME所为。
author: CapWolfBane
source: This Pokémon stalks rivers and lakes at night, lying in wait for prey. POKENAME attacks make up a large percent of all Pokémon attacks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME从海边高崖跃下，滑翔寻猎。庞大的身躯、强壮的双钳，加上凶残性情，让它成为可怕的猎手。
author: wigglypon
source: POKENAME leaps from high seaside cliffs to glide in search of prey. Its large body, strong pincers, and sheer brutality make for a menacing predator.

entry: 它用强壮的尾巴，逆着河流与瀑布而上。沿途遇到的人造物——船、桥，甚至混凝土水坝，都要被它撞碎。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its strong tail to swim up rivers and waterfalls. It will smash any man-made object it encounters — boats, bridges, and even concrete dams.

entry: POKENAME很会滑翔，常贴着水面掠过，用强壮的尾巴攫住毫无防备的猎物，再狠狠绞紧。
author: char_latte3412
source: An adept glider, POKENAME will skim just above the water's surface, viciously snatching and squeezing any unsuspecting prey with its strong tail.

entry: 一本古老童书，讲过POKENAME担任水下城市英勇首领的故事。它也十分重视，守护自己的环境。
author: kittyluv090
source: An old children's book tells the story of a POKENAME who was the brave leader of an underwater city. It cares deeply about protecting its environment.

entry: 锋利的毒牙，能毒死人类，宝可梦却可能幸存。巨大的尾巴，还能把宝可梦打上天空。
author: .afantastictrainer
source: Its fierce fangs contain poison which can kill a human but a Pokémon may survive. Its huge tail is strong enough to launch Pokémon into the sky.

entry: 敢打扰熟睡POKENAME的，只有傻瓜。一被吵醒，它便会暴走。
author: milchik
source: Only fools have enough courage to disturb a sleeping POKENAME. Once awakened, this Pokémon goes on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME梦想有朝一日，像那些英雄一样，保护弱者。可眼下，它还忙着钓起水宝可梦，盼着大丰收。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME dreams of one day becoming like the heroes who protect the weak. Now, though, it fishes out Water-type Pokémon in hopes of a big catch.

entry: POKENAME的水炮臂，作战十分凶狠。可它依然恪守荣誉，愿意保护比自己弱小的宝可梦。
author: Phantom640
source: Despite its cruelty in combat using its water cannon arm, POKENAME has been found to live by a code of honor, leading it to defend weaker Pokémon.

entry: 传说，最早的POKENAME来自一只鲤鱼伊布——它仅靠跃起水花，便逆着雄伟的瀑布游了上去。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Legends say the first POKENAME came from a Magiveon that swam up a mighty waterfall by only splashing.

entry: POKENAME残忍至极，会用带电触须缠住受困的猎物，连续好几天，以电击折磨对方。
author: char_latte3412
source: Devastatingly cruel, POKENAME wraps its electrified feelers around ensnared victims and torments them with jolts of electricity for days on end.

entry: 这只谜拟Ｑ，把自己伪装成暴鲤龙。不止如此，它还做了一名充气训练家，想让自己更融入社会。
author: funkytomate
source: A Mimikyu disguising itself as a Gyarados. But to go one step further, it has made itself an inflatable Trainer, as an attempt to blend into society.

entry: 尾巴上的火焰，即使浸入水中，也不会熄灭。POKENAME一下水，附近多数宝可梦，便都被吓跑。
author: Schierke
source: The fire burning on its tail stays lit underwater. When POKENAME enters the water, it scares off most Pokémon living in that area.

entry: POKENAME藏身雾气，行踪难觅。若被激怒，就会猛然冲出迷雾，挥动强尾，抽打敌人。
author: Manidrake
source: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that hides itself in clouds of mist. If enraged, it will surge from the mist, whipping foes with its mighty tail.

entry: 它越愤怒，力量就越强。若突然被卷入战斗，便会用力扯自己的长须，好让自己发火。
author: Staghorn
source: Its power level is proportionate to its anger. If it finds itself in battle unexpectedly, it yanks on its barbels to work itself into a rage.

entry: 弹簧般的身体，配上敏锐的头脑，让POKENAME成了强敌。不过，它也爱背着孩子，欢快地四处跑。
author: lazyarcanist
source: Its spring-like body and keen intelligence makes POKENAME a strong opponent. It loves to playfully run around while carrying children on its back.

entry: POKENAME只在晴朗的夜晚浮出水面。水手们说，POKENAME会接住坠落的星辰，把星光送回天上。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME only rises to the surface on clear nights. According to sailors, POKENAME catches fallen stars and sends their light back to the heavens.

entry: POKENAME能旋转身体各节，让骨状突起充当螺旋桨。足以让多数宝可梦丧命的水压，它也能承受。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME can rotate its body segments, their bony protrusions acting as propellers. It tolerates water pressures most Pokémon would find lethal.

entry: 厚实而带刺的壳，保护POKENAME免遭攻击。它们聪明得很，歌也唱得动听。
author: Essie
source: A thick, spiked shell protects POKENAME from enemy attacks. They are highly intelligent, and can sing beautifully.

entry: 它既能在陆地生活，也能潜居水下。喜欢沙岸与海滩，有时还会在浅海里，稳稳安顿下来。
author: milchik
source: It сan live both on land and underwater. It likes sandy shores and beaches and sometimes plants itself in shallow waters of the seas and oceans.

entry: 背壳上长着各式海带与藻类。其他宝可梦都爱来尝几口，POKENAME似乎也不介意。
author: milchik
source: It grows all sorts of kelp and algae on its back shell. Various Pokémon like to snack on its seaweed, but POKENAME doesn't seem to mind it.

entry: 它背上能长出整座珊瑚礁，让许多小型水宝可梦安家，也常保护太阳珊瑚，不让好坏星侵害。
author: milchik
source: It can grow an entire coral reef on its back. It serves as home to many smaller underwater Pokémon and often protects Corsola from Mareanie.

entry: POKENAME爱陪训练家，在开阔水域畅游。救生员也常请它帮忙，救起溺水的人与宝可梦。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME love to swim in open waters with their Trainers. They are often used by lifeguards to help save drowning people and Pokémon.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是迷失亡魂的守护者，专去纠缠那些，胆敢将宝可梦猎杀至绝种的人。
author: anarchaz
source: Legends say that POKENAME appears as a guardian of lost souls, haunting those who dare hunt a Pokémon to extinction.

entry: 拉普拉斯濒临灭绝时，人们创造这种融合体，想让它们永久留存。后来发现没有必要，POKENAME的设计便被废弃。
author: .ssunday.
source: When Lapras was on the brink of extinction, this fusion was created to keep them forever. POKENAME's design was later scrapped, as it was unneeded.

entry: POKENAME善解人意，常帮助搜救队，熟练而迅速地背起幸存者，送往安全处。
author: char_latte3412
source: Due to its empathetic nature, POKENAME often aids search-and-rescue teams by adeptly and swiftly carrying survivors to safety on its back.

entry: 热带地区的人们，会在黎明相聚，聆听POKENAME唱出的第一段旋律。那歌声，预告着夏天到来。
author: char_latte3412
source: Those residing in the tropics gather at early dawn to hear the first notes sung by POKENAME. Its melodies signal the arrival of summer.

entry: 它们轻轻漂过海面，有时浮力太强，竟会弹出水面。仿照POKENAME制作的球，在阿罗拉很受欢迎。
author: rhysanthemum
source: They gently float through the ocean and sometimes become so buoyant they launch from the water. Balls styled after POKENAME are popular in Alola.

entry: 头上的硬壳太沉，它只能慢慢挪动，生活在隐秘的水下岩缝中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The hard shell on its head is very heavy, which means it can only move slowly. It lives in well-hidden crevices under water.

entry: POKENAME不断放出的水，看似清澈，实则暗藏凶险，里面混着自身剧毒的体液。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The clear-looking water that POKENAME constantly releases is particularly perfidious, as it is mixed with the highly toxic juices of its body.

entry: POKENAME是残酷无情的猎手，爱将自己融进水中，尽可能久地戏弄猎物，才终于下手。
author: kandyman
source: A cruel and ruthless hunter, POKENAME enjoys melting itself into bodies of water and toying with its prey for as long as possible before striking.

entry: 头上清澈的水，常被其他宝可梦，当成清凉解渴的泉水。可惜，那水其实有剧毒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The crystal-clear water on its head is mistaken by many other Pokémon for a refreshing fountain. Tragically, however, it is highly poisonous.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，住在海岸边。可名字与拉普拉斯实在太像，说起来，总容易弄混。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a very friendly Pokémon that lives by coasts, but it's hard to talk about it without confusion due its name's similarity with Lapras.

entry: 多长出的两条手臂，让POKENAME游得更快。双腿也结实，甚至能背着人，在陆地上赶路。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The edition of two extra arms allow POKENAME to swim faster in the water. It can even ferry people across land thanks to its sturdy legs.

entry: POKENAME由有机物构成，比大岩蛇脆弱，却也浮得更稳，能载上几十名乘客。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME is more fragile than Onix due to its organic composition. However, it's much more buoyant, allowing it to ferry dozens of passengers.

entry: POKENAME曾被逼到濒临灭绝，如今游荡深海。它们用藤壶奏乐，引来过往船只，再一钳压碎。
author: hisata
source: Driven to near extinction, POKENAME roam the deep sea. Making music with their barnacles, they lure passing ships only to crush them with their claw.

entry: 若含苞的花摸起来，软得不太自然，那多半是POKENAME的伪装。它藏在灌木丛中，吸食汁液。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: If a budding flower feels unnaturally squishy to the touch, it is in fact the work of POKENAME's mimicry. It nests in bushes to feast on their sap.

entry: 不稳定的身体颤动着，排出恶臭的黏液。若收集足够多，再彻底洗净，就会形成新的POKENAME。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It expels a foul-smelling goop from its unstable, quivering body. If enough is gathered and rinsed thoroughly, a new POKENAME will form.

entry: POKENAME变成了吉利蛋的样子。为了装得更真，还从另一只可怜的吉利蛋那里，偷来一颗蛋。
author: thisisaplaceholder
source: This POKENAME has taken the form of a Chansey. It has also stolen an egg from another poor Chansey to really sell the appearance.

entry: POKENAME虽只有一个生命，却长得像一对母子。甚至有人见过它摇晃育儿袋里的小身体，哄其入睡。
author: snescontroller
source: Though it's a single entity, POKENAME has the appearance of a mother and child. It has even been seen rocking the smaller body in its pouch to sleep.

entry: 它能把四肢拉得长得滑稽，逗孩子与小宝可梦开心。只是拉长之后，收回来就困难了。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It can stretch its limbs to comical degrees to humor small children and Pokémon. It has trouble retracting them, though.

entry: 它想逗孩子开心，便努力变出自己知道的各种鬼脸。可身体不稳定，变到最后，总是反而吓人。
author: Skymaster426
source: It wishes to entertain children, so it attempts to craft the funniest faces it knows. However, due to its instability, it only ends up scaring.

entry: POKENAME闻起来，宛如一大束鲜花。人们常采集它的黏液，制作香气浓郁的香水。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME tends to smell like a giant bouquet of flowers. The goo from it is often harvested and used in the creation of strong scented perfumes.

entry: 大脑不在任何一颗头里，而藏在两头相接的胶状团块中，十分安全。谁攻击假头，很快就会成了猎物。
author: dicedragon20
source: Its brain is not inside either head, but safely hidden in the mound of goo where they meet. Anything that attacks a false head quickly becomes prey.

entry: 背上的花黏滑得吓人，让鸟宝可梦难以抓牢。不过，这种黏液煮过后，却是一道别具风味的蛋奶冻。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The flower on its back is hideously slimy, making it hard for bird Pokémon to get a grip on it. This slime, when boiled, makes an exotic custard.

entry: 它钻进山里，发现铁便尽情吃。看着危险，却从没有表现出攻击性。
author: imagine1.
source: It burrows into mountains, feasting on any iron it finds. It seems dangerous, but it shows no signs of violence.

entry: POKENAME有变身本领，人们本以为它会是个绘画高手。可惜，画来画去，所有脸，都长得像它自己。
author: strawbearycandy
source: With its ability to transform, POKENAME was at first expected to be a masterful painter. Unfortunately, every single face it paints resembles its own.

entry: 据说，POKENAME乳头流出的胶状物，营养十分丰富。可那副模样，实在让人不想尝试。
author: KitArchen
source: The goo that comes out of POKENAME's udders is said to be highly nutritious. However, the appearance of it makes people unwilling to try it.

entry: 有人推测，若取出POKENAME体内的觉醒之石，它就会恢复从前的模样。可古怪的身体构造，让许多人不敢动手验证。
author: 8xviktor
source: It's theorized that removing the dawn stone from POKENAME's body will revert it to its previous form. Its anatomy deters many from testing it.

entry: POKENAME模仿当红艺人，照搬节目。可惜，本领往往学不来，评论也因此很糟。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME mimics very popular performers to rip off their shows. Unfortunately, it typically fails to mimic their skills and gets low reviews.

entry: 花瓣每天都会变成另一种花。偶尔无意中模仿出稀有、甚至已灭绝的植物，也让植物学家困惑不已。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Every day, its petals morph into the shape of another variety of flower. Botanists are left baffled when it, by chance, mimics rare or extinct plants.

entry: POKENAME尝试模仿不可模仿的存在：神灵阿尔宙斯。它借的，只是朦胧的文学描绘，以及揣想勾画的草图。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Using vague literary imagery and interpretive sketches, POKENAME is the result of imitating the inimitable: an attempt at depicting the deity Arceus.

entry: 神奥有个传说，一位登山客看见这只宝可梦的剪影，误以为那是当地神话中的古老神灵。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A legend in the Sinnoh region goes that a hiker saw the silhouette of this Pokémon and thought it to be an ancient deity from the region's mythos.

entry: POKENAME能重排细胞结构，化作各种利刃。可每变一次，都要付出主人的生命力。
author: maxiundmicky
source: POKENAME can rearrange its cellular structure to take on the form of various blades. Each transformation comes at the cost of its owner's life force.

entry: 将要击中之前，POKENAME总爱忽然变换刀刃，随机换种材质，或变成某种勉强像武器的东西。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Right before landing a hit, POKENAME likes to change its blade's composition into that of a random material or any object vaguely resembling a weapon.

entry: 一把刀不够，POKENAME便变成主人想要的两把。代价，则是大量的生命力。
author: maxiundmicky
source: When a single blade is not enough, POKENAME transforms itself into whichever two blades its owner wishes for. It drains a large amount of life force.

entry: 传说，走投无路的英雄，会得到POKENAME相助。只须献出灵魂，POKENAME便会化作最完美的剑。
author: maxiundmicky
source: According to legend, POKENAME will come to aid a despairing hero in need. For the price of the hero's soul, POKENAME will become the perfect sword.

entry: 平时，POKENAME连牛奶也切不开。可若握在它信任的训练家手中，便能化成任何想象得到的金属。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: In its regular state, POKENAME cannot even cut through milk. If wielded by a trusted Trainer, it is able to morph into any kind of metal imaginable.

entry: POKENAME精通变身与幻术，能造出鲜活的幻境，把敌人困进最深的欲望，或最可怕的噩梦。
author: strawbearycandy
source: A master of shapeshifting and illusion, POKENAME can create dynamic illusory scenes to trap its foes in their deepest desires or worst nightmares.

entry: 刚被发现时，科学家以为它是一只正在变成仙子伊布的百变怪。它的遗传物质极不稳定。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When first discovered, scientists believed this Pokémon was a Ditto mid-transformation into a Sylveon. Its DNA is extremely unstable.

entry: 它在湖边河畔跺着脚走，标示领地。毒素会让汗液变得黏滑，不过，并无真正的危害。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It stomps about to mark its territory near lakes and rivers. Its poison turns ones sweat slimy, but is ultimately harmless.

entry: 它随黑暗出现在噩梦尾声。可那副傻乎乎、不知所措的模样，却总让人笑着醒来。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It appears near the end of nightmares, accompanied by darkness. Its clueless and silly demeanor, however, makes people wake up laughing.

entry: 为了应对各种战况，POKENAME带着能想到的所有电器。可偏偏犹豫不决，最后哪一个，也没用上。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME carries every appliance it can think of with it, so it can be ready in any battle situation. However, due to indecisiveness, it uses none.

entry: 人们想造出真正万能的设备，于是创造了POKENAME。可它留不住电，最终被判定为失败作。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME was born from an attempt to create a truly universal device. It was deemed a failure due to being unable to hold an electric charge.

entry: 科学家尝试测定来自其他世界的宝可梦的基因结构，但每一次尝试最终都产生了POKENAME。
author: TokenOracle
source: Scientists attempted to sequence the DNA structure of Pokémon from other worlds. All attempts resulted in POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME急着想进化，常钻出壳外，盼着成为百变怪与暴飞龙的融合形态，可结果，却只恢复了普通百变怪的模样。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is extremely eager to evolve. It'll often escape its shell in hopes it will transform into a Ditmance, but instead reverts to a normal Ditto.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吃堆肥土壤，进食时还能改变身体。说它是百变怪并不完全准确，不过多少有那么点像。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME enjoys eating composted soil, and can alter its body when it does. It's not exactly a Ditto, but it's Dit-ish.

entry: POKENAME被装在一个塑料袋里。通常它的身体只有轻微毒性，但不稳定的基因能重组身体，使它产生麻痹毒素。
author: Bobosmith01
source: A plastic bag contains POKENAME. Its body, by default, is only mildly poisonous. POKENAME's unstable DNA can rearrange its body to become paralytic.

entry: 融合后的模样，与两边原主都不像，反而近似于竞技训练家传闻中的一种宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It fused into a form resembling neither of its halves. Rather, it appears closer to that of a Pokémon told of in competitive Trainers' rumors.

entry: POKENAME常到海滩，模仿孩子们堆的沙堡。若见有孩子哭，便做个鬼脸，逗他开心。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME frequently goes down to the beach and mimics sand castles children make. When it sees a crying child, it makes a funny face to cheer them up.

entry: 融合时，派拉斯特的身体融化，变成适合容纳百变怪的宿主。幸亏寄生蘑菇的作用，过程并不痛苦。
author: typhloquil
source: During fusion, the Parasect's body melted so it can be a suitable host for Ditto. Luckily, thanks to the parasite mushroom, this is painless.

entry: POKENAME拼命想吓唬紫苑镇居民，却总不成功。大家其实不太怕，还是装出受惊的模样，让它添点自信。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME try desperately—and unsuccessfully—to scare people in Lavender Town. Although few are intimidated, they act scared so it feels confident.

entry: 它管不住幼崽，小家伙们总四散跑开。可它并不担心，知道孩子们有能力，保护自己。
author: zic
source: It has trouble keeping its young in check, so they often scatter. It doesn't worry, however, as it knows its children are capable of fighting.

entry: 伊布的遗传构成不稳定，两只融合，更引发剧烈反应，让它同时显现所有可能变异的特征。
author: kittyluv090
source: Due to Eevee's unstable genetic makeup, fusing two of them caused a wild reaction. It took on elements of all of Eevee's possible mutations at once.

entry: 体内的遗传物质，极不稳定。身体不断飞速进化，也让它陷入狂乱。
author: Toxicrown
source: The genetic material within this Pokémon is extremely unstable. This causes it to go wild as it's body continues to rapidly evolve.

entry: 两只伊布融合后，不稳定的基因发生突变，造就了一只兼具所有进化形态特征的宝可梦。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: Combining an Eevee with another Eevee has resulted in its unstable genes mutating, creating a Pokémon with features of each possible evolution.

entry: 它由西尔佛公司开发，用来测试网络空间的环境。更新一完成，POKENAME就会进化。
author: zic
source: Developed by Silph Co., it was made to test environments in cyberspace. Once it finishes updating, POKENAME evolves.

entry: 它的程序，很容易修改。有些社群甚至专门交流，分享各种改过外貌的版本。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its programming is highly susceptible to alterations. Entire subcommunities center around sharing visually modified copies of it.

entry: POKENAME十分稀有。传说，接触不同的特殊石头，便能进化成不同姿态。
author: Deflador
source: POKENAME is a rare Pokémon. Legend says it will evolve into different forms when in contact to certain stones.

entry: 靠近多数进化石时，羽毛就会变色。若碰到石头，便会开始进化。
author: .izik
source: Its feathers change hue when in close proximity of most evolution stones. Should it touch one, it will start to evolve.

entry: 它会到居民区偷电池，攒得足够多，便趴在自己的电池堆上，安然睡去。
author: .izik
source: It will steal batteries from residential areas. Once it has enough gathered, it will fall asleep on top of its horde.

entry: POKENAME好奇又容易轻信，还总分心，一不小心，就把自己置于危险。照顾它，可得时时看紧。
author: kittyluv090
source: Very curious and gullible, POKENAME needs constant supervision because it is easily distracted and can unknowingly put itself in harm's way.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，很受孩子欢迎，是常见的宠物。不过，咬合力却强得惊人。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are popular pets for children. They are known to be docile, however their bite force is surprisingly powerful.

entry: POKENAME作为家养宠物，始终供不应求。遗憾的是，也因此常有土龙弟弟，遭人为融合而非法捕猎。
author: Staghorn
source: Demand for POKENAME as a house pet is always extremely high. Cases of Dunsparce being illegally poached for fusion purposes are, regrettably, common.

entry: 它们不仅遗传构成独特，尾端的包裹里还常带着各种进化道具。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Not only do they carry a unique genetic makeup, but they also can be found carrying various evolutionary items in their tail bundle.

entry: POKENAME毛间蓄着大量静电，一兴奋，就会释放。任何一种元素力量，都能用来补充能量。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME store lots of static electricity in their fur and release it when they get excited. They can use any kind of elemental power to recharge.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中电属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its electrical attacks are especially strong.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中电属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its electrical attacks are especially strong.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中火属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its fire attacks are especially strong.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中火属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its fire attacks are especially strong.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中水属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its water attacks are especially strong.

entry: POKENAME虽有施展多种属性攻击的潜力，其中水属性攻击，尤其强大。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME holds the potential for attacks of many elements, its water attacks are especially strong.

entry: 两边原主都较为稀有，因此，这种融合体也难得一见。已有的个体，多半被当作宠物饲养。
author: Faelocke
source: Due to requiring two relatively rare Pokémon as components, this fusion is rarely seen. Those that exist are often kept as pets.

entry: 伊布在间歇出现严寒的环境附近长大，才会进化为POKENAME。有些培育者认为，刻意这样促成进化，并不道德。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME only evolve from Eevee raised near severe, sporadic sources of cold. Some Eevee breeders consider deliberately evolving one to be unethical.

entry: 伊布与多边兽Ｚ融合后，遗传构成变得极不稳定。每次试图适应环境，都会出了故障。
author: zic
source: Fusing Eevee with Porygon-Z has caused its genetic makeup to become critically unstable. It glitches every time it tries to adapt to an environment.

entry: POKENAME善于攀爬，生活在热带森林中。周围环境的种种变化，都会影响它未来的进化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can climb very well and lives in tropical forests. Various environmental influences affect its future evolution.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: 这支长矛忠诚，潜力无穷。背面的凹槽里，似乎还缺一块石头。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A loyal spear full of potential. There is a slot on the back that seems to be missing a stone.

entry: 人们推测，伊布进化成仙子伊布时，若仍保留不稳定的遗传构成，就会成为POKENAME。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It is theorized that POKENAME is the result of an Eevee that retained its unstable genetic makeup when evolving into a Sylveon.

entry: POKENAME像谜拟Ｑ一样，披着做成伊布模样的破布，免得显得吓人。那块布，也会随环境发生古怪的反应。
author: PeterMars
source: Much like Mimikyu, POKENAME wears a rag fashioned into an Eevee costume to make it look less scary. This rag reacts strangely to its environment.

entry: POKENAME能完全掌控自己的遗传结构，依环境的需要，改变形态与属性。
author: ETheWriter
source: POKENAME has full control over its genetic structure. It can change its form and type based on what it needs for its environment.

entry: POKENAME基因不稳，手上的花便长出多种颜色。每种颜色，似乎又有自己独特的香气。
author: airybeats
source: POKENAME's unstable genetics cause the flowers on its hands to grow a multitude of colors. Each color seems to give off a different, unique aroma.

entry: POKENAME头上的花瓣，象征着进化潜力。某一种花瓣越多，便越接近相应的进化。
author: Mistymagius
source: The petals on POKENAME's head symbolizes its evolutionary potential. The more of one type of petal is on its head, the closer it is to evolution.

entry: 融合产生的副作用，让伊布部分遗传密码突变，因此，两颗头分别近似伊布的两种进化形态。
author: Cascadeguy
source: The fusion process has mutated some of Eevee's genetic code as a side effect. Due to this, its heads resemble two of Eevee's evolutions.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头，偶尔会显出伊布三种进化形态的能力，可威力，就没那么出色了。
author: Cascadeguy
source: The heads of POKENAME occasionally display abilities from three of Eevee's evolutions. However, the potency of these abilities is not as impressive.

entry: POKENAME身上带条纹的污泥，其实是一种伪装。有时，它只吃掉进化石放出的辐射，却不进化。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's striped sludge is actually a method of camouflage. Sometimes, it will eat the radiation from an evolution stone instead of evolving.

entry: 河流与小池塘中，常能发现POKENAME，也因此，常被人拿来作鱼饵。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME are well known to be spotted in rivers or small ponds. This has led to them being used commonly as fishing bait.

entry: POKENAME痴迷人类的时尚与舞蹈。每只风格各异，可无论什么作品，都会融入水。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME are fascinated with human fashion and dancing. Their styles vary between individuals, but they all incorporate water in their works.

entry: POKENAME动作敏捷，协调出色，是游泳的好手。休息时，常仰着身子，漂在水面。
author: VaporVenator
source: Remarkable agility and coordination makes POKENAME an expert swimmer. They can be observed resting on their backs, floating atop the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME的触角，有时能触发进化。找不到水之石的野生水宝可梦，就能得到它的帮助。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's antennae can sometimes trigger evolution. It helps wild Water-types who can't seem to find their own Water Stones.

entry: POKENAME住在湖底最深处，用诱饵状的器官，吸引小鱼。其余身体，则轻松藏进幽暗的水里。
author: CrypticanEXE
source: Living in the deepest parts of lakes, POKENAME uses its esca to lure in smaller fish. It easily camouflages the rest of its body in the dark waters.

entry: POKENAME背上的花有两重用处：靠近水面时，能帮它伪装，还能通过光合作用，提供养分。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The flower on POKENAME's back serves two purposes: it helps it blend in when near the surface, and it provides nutrients through photosynthesis.

entry: 哪里有水，POKENAME就能安家。地上的水不安全，甚至会飘上雨云，藏在里面。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME lives in water wherever it can find it, even levitating up to rainclouds to hide whenever water on the ground is unsafe.

entry: POKENAME钻入水下松软的淤泥，藏身待猎。由于细胞结构特殊，身体一沾水，便半透明起来。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME will dig into loose silt underwater to hide and wait for prey. Because of its cell structure its body becomes translucent when wet.

entry: POKENAME掘地寻找地下水，带回自己的巢穴。在沙漠里，这样的活动，最终会形成滋养新生命的绿洲。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME dig in search for groundwater to bring back to their nests. In deserts, this activity ends up forming oases for new life to thrive in.

entry: POKENAME身体很大，腿却短小。歇在栖木上时，两条前腿，便悬在边缘外。
author: hatsune_miko
source: POKENAME has a large body but unfortunately small legs. When it perches, its front legs dangle off the edge.

entry: POKENAME一入水游动，身体就会变得半透明，连尾巴里收集的贝壳与树果，都看得见。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: When POKENAME swim in the water, their bodies become translucent and the seashells and berries they collect in their tail become visible.

entry: 尾巴是一块仍有活性的水之石，能毫无预兆地促使宝可梦进化。因此，大舌贝与蚊香君，都格外小心，避着POKENAME走。
author: hatsune_miko
source: Its tail is an active Water Stone and can evolve Pokémon without warning. Shellder and Poliwhirl are careful to avoid POKENAME because of this.

entry: POKENAME对人类活动很感兴趣，喜欢轻轻啃咬物品，探索周围世界。力道通常很轻，不会伤人。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME are intrigued by human activities. They explore the world around them by nibbling things, often too softly to cause harm to others.

entry: POKENAME是强大的水术士，能吟诵咒语，让敌人淹没于水中。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful hydromancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to drown foes in water.

entry: 它能随意冻结、融化身边的水。游泳不太在行，便更爱在脚下结出冰面，走过去。
author: milchik
source: It can freeze or melt surrounding water at will. It's not a great swimmer, so it prefers freezing water under its paws to walk on it instead.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺，其实由体内的水构成。孩子们不知情，伸手穿过，却毫发无伤。
author: hatsune_miko
source: The quills on POKENAME's back are made of water from its body. Kids unknowingly put their hands through the quills without harm.

entry: 它主要以水为食，从泥里吸取水分。POKENAME吃过后，留下的泥土，却会格外肥沃。
author: Skymaster426
source: Its diet consists mainly of water, which it gains from absorbing moisture from mud. After a POKENAME feeds, the resulting dirt is extremely fertile.

entry: POKENAME钩住猎物后，便散发出安抚的气息，让对方不再挣扎。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When POKENAME have hooked their prey, they are filled with a soothing aura that makes it stop struggling against them.

entry: 大大的鳍状耳朵与尾巴，让它游动时，轮廓宛如风筝。美丽的姿态，也使它成为颇受欢迎的融合体。
author: Faelocke
source: Its large, fin-like ears and tail give it an almost kite-like silhouette while swimming. Its beauty makes it quite a popular fusion.

entry: POKENAME的种子萌发后，它便会将其打开，与所有生命分享水，因此，草木鸟兽，都是它的朋友。
author: Lådan
source: When a POKENAME's seed sprouts, it will open and share its water with all, making it a friend to flora and fauna alike.

entry: POKENAME体内满是净水，平日用带刺的尾巴，小心保护。它要留着这些水，直到准备进化。
author: Lådan
source: POKENAME is filled with purified water that it protects with its spiked tail. It will save this water until it's ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME既能操水，又会耕地，用来务农，再合适不过。许多人请它帮忙，轻松种植作物。
author: zic
source: POKENAME's skills in water manipulation and tilling are a great combo for farming. Many use it to grow crops effortlessly.

entry: 据说，阿尔宙斯赐给POKENAME完美圆润的力量。世上再没有哪种融合宝可梦，能比它更圆。
author: bucklin
source: It is said that Arceus gifted POKENAME the power of perfect roundness. No Pokémon fusion can be possibly rounder than it.

entry: POKENAME尾端的包裹，总带着静电。稍一靠近，就会被轻轻电一下。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME's tail bundle is always charged with static electricity. Getting near it will give you a light shock.

entry: POKENAME是强大的雷电术士，吟诵咒语，便能用闪电击中敌人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful electromancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to shock foes with lightning.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强。科学家认为，电、冰、地面招式兼备，让它几乎能对付任何敌人。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive. Scientists have concluded that having electric, ice, and ground moves allows it to take on nearly any foe.

entry: POKENAME背上的石头，磁力极强，让能量贯穿全身涌动。小型电宝可梦，也常聚在它身边。
author: moopse
source: The stones on POKENAME's back are hypermagnetic, allowing energy to surge throughout it. Small electric types often gather around it.

entry: 掷出POKENAME，击中目标的瞬间，便会迸出电流。握着它举向天空，还能召下雷电。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.

entry: 掷出POKENAME，击中目标的瞬间，便会迸出电流。握着它举向天空，还能召下雷电。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.

entry: 它用针状的触须刺穿猎物，释放高达10,000伏的电流。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its needle-like feelers are used to pierce their prey and release up to 10,000 volts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME摩擦毛茸茸的翅膀，让双臂化作电击器。它速度极快，先麻痹目标，再让对方缓慢、痛苦地败下阵来。
author: p0opys0ck123abc
source: POKENAME rubs its furry wings to form a taser with its arms. It uses its high speed to swiftly paralyze the target, ensuring a slow, painful defeat.

entry: 这只宝可梦活泼、善良，却爱恶作剧。替主人办事时，它总用鼻子忙活，舌头则懒懒垂在嘴外。
author: moopse
source: This rambunctious yet kind Pokémon loves to cause mischief. Its tongue droops out of its mouth as it uses its snout to complete tasks for its owner.

entry: POKENAME虽仍迟缓，身上伸出的电缆，却让它轻易就能抓住、并电击那些靠得太近的家伙。
author: Lådan
source: Even though POKENAME remains slow, the cables extending from its body make it a lot easier to catch and shock anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME歌唱得糟糕，是出了名的。若发现没人理它，就会愤怒地放出电流。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME are known to be terrible singers. If one realizes that it's being ignored, they are known to shoot out electricity in anger.

entry: POKENAME干劲十足，却总难把想做的事做好。它想往敌人身上扑，火花四溅，忙到最后，还是徒劳。
author: Lådan
source: Though POKENAME is full of energy and motivation, it struggles to follow its aims. It fruitlessly tries to hurl itself toward foes, sparks flying.

entry: 突然袭来的雷雨，常是它们惹的祸。它们最爱在云间嬉戏，闪来闪去，躲着道道雷电。
author: HummusIsHome
source: These Pokémon are often to blame for sudden thunderstorms. They take delight in playing among the clouds and dodging bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME用壳里的水发电，给背上的电池充能。蓄满后，就能打出威力惊人的攻击。
author: almanacp
source: POKENAME uses the water in its shell as a hydro-electric charger for the batteries on its back. By charging them, it can release devastating attacks.

entry: 凡是闯进领地的对手，它都要斗一斗。POKENAME一旦战败，便会离开领地，余生四处流浪。
author: dicedragon20
source: It will fight any rival that enters its territory. A POKENAME that loses such a fight will leave its territory and wander for the rest of its life.

entry: 它的拳头挥得太快，甚至能燃起火焰。两只交战，谁的火先灭，谁就输了。
author: Skymaster426
source: Its fists can move fast enough to catch on fire. When two fight, the first one to have their flames to go out is the loser.

entry: 这是伊布的一种特殊进化，毒汗与火焰混合，能让疼痛久久不散。漆黑的夜里，也能看见它泛起红光。
author: Mistymagius
source: A unique evolution of Eevee, its poisonous sweat mixes with flames to cause lost-lasting pain. Its red glow can be seen on dark nights.

entry: 据说，POKENAME带着的包裹，暖和又舒服。有时，还能发现伊布躲在里面，静静避寒。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: The bundle POKENAME carries is said to be extremely warm and comfortable. Eevee can sometimes be found hiding inside their bundles from the cold.

entry: 别看只有幼崽般的身量，它却一点就着。亲吻时，毛间积蓄的火焰，也会把人灼伤。
author: Xephyr
source: Despite having the stature of a baby, it is remarkably volatile. Its kisses burn with the fire it had accumulated in its fur.

entry: POKENAME是强大的火术士，吟诵咒语，便能以烈焰灼烧敌人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful pyromancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to scorch foes with flame.

entry: POKENAME把热量全存进刀刃，留待战斗时释放。持剑者，也能借助POKENAME操纵火焰。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME stores all its heat in its blade to release in battle. Its wielder can control fire through POKENAME while holding it.

entry: POKENAME的毛摸起来，柔软又暖和。人们常在附近，收集它脱落的毛，拿来制作帽子。
author: moopse
source: The fur on POKENAME is extremely soft and warm to the touch. Shed fur from its surroundings is often collected to be used to make hats.

entry: 这只宝可梦喜欢依偎着训练家。人们常说，把POKENAME抱在腿上，暖得就像盖了电热毯。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This Pokémon loves to cuddle with its Trainer. It's often said that the feeling of a POKENAME on one's lap feels as toasty as an electric blanket.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，不爱争斗。暴风雪里，宽大的蓬松双翼与鬃毛，还能为小宝可梦保暖。
author: celeste.addict
source: POKENAME are a passive species. Its large, fluffy wings and mane help keep smaller Pokémon warm during blizzards.

entry: 寒夜月出时，POKENAME会来到野外露营的旅人身旁。大家睡着，它便看着篝火，让火焰始终不灭。
author: Fenragon
source: On cold nights, when the moon is out, POKENAME visits travelers camping outside to keep their campfires burning while they sleep.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，翼间与毛发里，会散出火星。它与古书中记载的一种宝可梦，颇为相似。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME scatters flaming embers from its wings and fur as it runs. It shares some similarities with a Pokémon found in an old book.

entry: POKENAME亲人得很，喜欢抱住信任的人。可训练家得留神，身上的黏液，能造成严重灼伤。
author: char_latte3412
source: Very affectionate, POKENAME enjoys hugging those it trusts. However, Trainers must beware, as the mucus coating its body can leave nasty burns.

entry: POKENAME酷似西尔佛公司生产的火伊布毛绒玩具。明明是火属性，毛发却特别容易燃烧。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME heavily resembles a plush of Flareon produced by Silph Co. Despite being a fire type, its fur is highly combustible.

entry: 一块格外巨大的火之石，接上尾巴后，让POKENAME发生进化。万一火焰失效，它还可以抡起石头，拼上最后一招。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME evolved after an especially large Fire Stone was attached to its tail. Should its flames fail, it can still swing the stone as a last resort.

entry: 它脸上眼睛的数量，会随着心情变化。情绪越激动，每一面的眼睛就越多，最多能同时出现十六只。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The amount of eyes on its faces fluctuate based on its mood. The more aggravated it grows, the more eyes per side—up to sixteen at once.

entry: POKENAME从网上下载秘籍与强化补丁，提升拳击本领。再打起来，便招招凶狠，对手面前绝不留情。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME downloads cheats and buffs online to boost its boxing skills. Afterwards, it throws out attacks and shows no mercy to its opponents.

entry: 尖尖的形状，配上独特颜色，常让POKENAME被误认成橡皮。可它什么也擦不掉，尤其是蓝色那一端。
author: pokebio
source: Due to its pointy shape and coloring, POKENAME is often mistaken for an eraser. However, it can't erase anything at all, especially at the blue end.

entry: POKENAME是生活在网络空间的稀有宝可梦，喜欢在网上冲浪。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are rare Pokémon found within Cyberspace. They enjoy surfing the web.

entry: 这只宝可梦似乎遇到了致命错误，也许需要重新启动，再试一次。
author: fixthewifi
source: This Pokémon appears to have encountered a fatal error. It may need to restart and try again.

entry: 有一种说法认为，所有原因不明的程序故障，源头都是在网络空间飞来飞去的POKENAME。
author: hampterbychoice
source: One theory suggests that POKENAME zipping through cyberspace is the origin of all mysterious coding failures.

entry: 通常，POKENAME是在网上游历时，偶然看见乌波的搞笑图片，才变成这副模样。
author: nasho1908
source: Usually, a POKENAME takes this appearance after it stumbles upon funny images of Wooper while traveling through the internet.

entry: 它究竟从何而来，无人知晓。最普遍的说法，是创造人造灵魂的实验，诞生了它。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The actual origins of this Pokémon are unknown. The most commonly held belief is that it is the result of an experiment to create an artificial soul.

entry: POKENAME充当一种程序语言，帮助网络世界运行脚本。研究人员与程序员，也用它进行模拟。
author: zic
source: POKENAME serves as a language to help run scripts in the cyberworld. Researchers and programmers use it to run simulations.

entry: 它会扭转整个身体来分散敌人的注意力。熟练的POKENAME只需3秒，就能把自己恢复原状。
author: kittyluv090
source: It distracts foes by twisting its entire body around. A skilled POKENAME can unscramble itself in just 3 seconds.

entry: 代码经过严密加固与加密，被程序员称为“数字保险箱”，纷纷加以研究。
author: Napstabl0ok
source: Its code is fully fortified and encrypted. It is studied by programmers, who know it as a "digital strongbox".

entry: 背上扛着一整座黑曜石玻璃制成的传送门。有传言说，门的那头，直通灵界。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon is carrying a whole portal made out of obsidian glass on its back. Some rumors say that it leads directly to the spirit world.

entry: 不管遇上什么条纹，它都会入迷地分析一番。不过，有些图案似乎格外合它心意。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It obsessively analyzes any striped pattern it comes across. It seems to value certain patterns more than others.

entry: POKENAME拥有自己的网络投递系统。创造它的初衷，是与互联网上的电子通信，争一争高下。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME was created as an attempt to compete with electronic messaging on the internet through its own cyber delivery system.

entry: 这是一只正在进化成多边兽Ⅱ的多边兽。不过进化尚未完成，在这种状态下使用它，会出现一些奇怪的故障。
author: Soup1900
source: A Porygon in the process of evolving into Porygon2. It is not yet complete though, and will have strange quirks if used in this state.

entry: 这只宝可梦，正卡在软件更新途中，状态十分不稳。等更新完成，也许就能恢复正常。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: This Pokémon was caught in the middle of a software update. As such, it is in an unstable state. Waiting for the update to complete may fix this.

entry: POKENAME的作品，源自一套年代久远的绘画软件。做出的图像，还能与人进行一定的互动。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME's works are derived from an artistry software from long ago. The pieces it can produce are interactive to an extent.

entry: 这次融合让它的代码变得稳定，不再出现错误。然而，它也失去了所有情感，以及身为多边兽Ⅱ时学会的大部分能力。
author: Soup1900
source: This fusion caused its code to become stable and error-free. However, it has lost all emotion and most capabilities it learned when it was a Porygon2.

entry: 它听得懂，也能说多种语言。在宝可梦中，拥有这种本领的，也不只它一个。
author: imagine1.
source: It can understand and speak various languages. It is one of many Pokémon that are capable of this.

entry: 脸上的屏幕，会随心情变化。它自认聪明得很，可有时做起事来，却傻得不行。
author: imagine1.
source: The screen on its face changes based on its feelings. It can be quite foolish at times, even though it has a high estimation of its own intelligence.

entry: POKENAME由代码创造，脑袋竟成了有史以来，最完美的长方形物体。科学家们，正争相研究它。
author: robosoup
source: Because it was created by code, POKENAME's head is the most perfectly rectangular object to ever exist. Scientists are rushing to study this Pokémon.

entry: 长成这种模样的POKENAME，攻击性异常强，会顶着大脸，硬生生冲进城镇。
author: robosoup
source: A POKENAME with this appearance is unusually aggressive. It will attempt to smash its way into towns using its large face.

entry: 它住在火山地区，用许多土台龟，搭建各式建筑，作为自己的居所。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon that resides in volcanic regions. It uses large quantities of Torterra to construct various buildings it lives within.

entry: 人们试图在实验电脑中复制、粘贴数码独剑鞘，原始数据却意外损坏，变成了一只全新而诡异的宝可梦——POKENAME。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: In an effort to copy and paste a digital Honedge in an experimental PC, the original instead corrupted into a new, uncanny Pokémon: a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME是卡洛斯创造的人造宝可梦，用来验证：能否以计算机代码，复制出任何一种宝可梦。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME is an artificial Pokémon that was created in Kalos to test the idea that any Pokémon could be replicated through computer code.

entry: POKENAME总坚持，自己能帮训练家操作某些电脑程序。可真问起建议，POKENAME又很少给得出有用的。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME constantly insists on helping its Trainer use certain computer programs. Despite this, POKENAME rarely has any helpful advice to give.

entry: POKENAME的情绪识别软件，实在太粗浅，派不上什么用场，因此总闹出误会。
author: .realthree
source: The emotion-recognition software that POKENAME uses is too basic to be useful, so it's often getting into misunderstandings.

entry: POKENAME爱唱歌给别人听，可发出的只有简单的哔声与啾声。不过，也有人就喜欢这种怀旧的音乐。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME enjoys singing for others, but its cries are reduced to simple beeps and chirps. Some folks appreciate this music for its nostalgic quality.

entry: 它藏在电脑硬盘里。多边形的身体内部，一行行新代码，正为飞行作准备。
author: TheCrowArtiste
source: It hides away in the hard drives of computers. Within its polygonal exterior, new lines of code prepare it to fly.

entry: POKENAME就像老游戏中的非玩家角色，总沿着固定路线行走。除非有人上前互动，否则绝不停步。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's behavior seems to mirror that of an “NPC” in an old video game. It walks in a specific pattern and won't stop unless interacted with.

entry: 这种POKENAME喜欢窝在垃圾桶之类，潮湿又昏暗的地方。叫起来，活像语无伦次的絮叨。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME enjoys resting in damp, dark spots like trash bins. Its cries have been described as sounding like incoherent rambling.

entry: POKENAME嘴里，竟能藏下100多个程序漏洞。若让POKENAME靠近设备，电脑往往就会染上一大堆病毒。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME can house over 100 computer bugs in its mouth. Letting a POKENAME near your device will usually infect your computer with plenty of viruses.

entry: 训练家说，它的模样，像某款电子游戏里的城堡。不过，POKENAME长成这样，纯属巧合。
author: FilteredTea
source: Trainers say this Pokémon's appearance bears resemblance to a castle in a video game. POKENAME's appearance, however, is purely coincidental.

entry: 它一看见咩利羊，就会扑去狩猎。据说，只要给根骨头，它便会终生忠于你。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon hunts Mareep on sight. It is said giving it a bone makes it loyal towards you for the rest of its life.

entry: 不论训练家走到哪里，它都会跟随。针叶林也好，热带草原也好，POKENAME始终陪伴身旁。
author: .ssunday.
source: This Pokémon will follow its Trainer no matter where they venture. Whether it be a taiga or a savannah, POKENAME will accompany them.

entry: 背上的蘑菇，美味又富含能量。不过，若是生吃，却会让人产生身体变大的幻觉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The mushroom that grows on its back is delicious and full of energy. Eaten raw, however, it makes people hallucinate growing in size.

entry: POKENAME把双镲一碰，便激出数字冲击波，扰乱对手。可有时候，连自己也会一起乱了神。
author: Shadow
source: The cymbals that POKENAME uses can be crashed together to make digital shock waves that can confuse the target. However, it can even confuse itself!

entry: 野生POKENAME结群狩猎，扑倒敌人或牲畜。喂它们骨头，便能驯服，与它们交朋友。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Wild POKENAME hunt in packs to take down enemies and livestock. They can be tamed and befriended by feeding them bones.

entry: 它能将自己还原成程序资料。可爱的模样，也让它成了电子游戏中，深受喜爱的宠物。
author: zotobom
source: Capable of reverting itself into program data, it's a beloved pet in digital games due to it's cute appearance.

entry: 这只宝可梦会潜伏在可达鸭与大葱鸭附近，等待发动袭击的机会。
author: TheHeroicT
source: This Pokémon can be found hiding around Psyduck and Farfetch'd. It's waiting for its chance to strike and attack them.

entry: POKENAME收集大量石头，再削成立方体，用这些方块，搭起令人惊叹的建筑。
author: ValtsuRi
source: POKENAME gathers large amounts of stone, and then shapes them into cubes. It can build impressive structures with these blocks.

entry: 据说，POKENAME源于一次失败的实验：人们想造出通往异次元的门。作为失败作，它也一心寻求复仇。
author: cipherlingarde
source: It is said POKENAME was the result of a failed attempt to create a doorway to another dimension. As a failed project, this Pokémon seeks revenge.

entry: 它口中的虚空，能放出各式数字影像。人们常拿它，玩些以为是一回事、结果突然变卦的恶作剧。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: All manners of digital imagery can be displayed inside the void of its mouth. It is often employed in pranks of the bait-and-switch type.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地爬过海底，十分擅长模仿岩石与珊瑚，躲开别人的察觉。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: POKENAME mindlessly scutter along the seafloor. They have mastered imitating rocks and coral, as to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME曾生活在如今真新镇附近的海洋。它不为幼崽筑巢，而是直接把蛋，产在自己的壳内。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME was once found in oceans near what is now Pallet Town. Instead of making a nest for its young, it lays its eggs inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME蜷进壳里，沿海底滚动赶路。遇到食物，先用触手抓住，再整个吞下。
author: CapWolfBane
source: POKENAME travels the sea by curling into its shell and rolling along the ocean floor. It first grasps food with its tentacles, then swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME不狩猎时，便藏在壳里，用飘带拖着自己，慢慢挪动。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it's not hunting, dragging itself around with its ribbon.

entry: POKENAME遇险，便把头缩进壳里。众多触手，也能推着身体，在水中飞快前进。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: As a defense mechanism, POKENAME pulls its head into its shell. It can use its many tentacles to propel itself through water at high speeds.

entry: 它用能伸长的手臂，巡掠海底，收集贝壳。没那么宝贝的壳，便直接吃掉。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: It trawls the seafloor collecting shells with its extendable arms. The ones that aren't precious to it are eaten.

entry: POKENAME将庞大的电能化为速度，快得唯有闪电能够比拟，因此鲜少被人看见。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME has been seen very rarely since it converts astronomical amounts of electricity into a speed that is only matched by lightning.

entry: 许多深海洞穴，都能找到POKENAME。偷猎者觊觎壳内藏着的大宝石，曾将它们捕杀得，几乎绝种。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can be found in many deep-sea caves. This Pokémon was almost hunted to extinction due to poachers wanting the large gem hidden in its shell.

entry: POKENAME全待在壳内，彼此难以协调，找食物也费劲。长长的手臂，还总互相绊住。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: Living exclusively inside their shells, POKENAME find it hard to coordinate and find food. Their long arms often get in each other's way.

entry: 据说，POKENAME携带着，来自遥远史前的果实，可从来没人敢尝。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are said to carry prehistoric fruits from long ago. No one has ever dared to taste them.

entry: 坚韧的甲片，能帮它保护幼崽。它还会带着幼崽，一游就是几个小时，玩个尽兴。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: The sturdy armour platings on its body help it to protect its young. It swims about with its young for hours as entertainment.

entry: POKENAME周身长满极锋利的刺。自卫时，能在一瞬间，将全部尖刺射出。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: POKENAME are covered with extremely sharp spines. In self defense, it can propel all of the spines from its body in an instant.

entry: 失去了外壳，POKENAME的重要器官，全露在外面。幸好，它身体像胶泥，十分柔韧，能随意变形。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: With no shell to protect it, POKENAME has all its vital organs exposed. Luckily, its body is very malleable and goop-like.

entry: 多数人不觉得，它有多讨喜。黏滑的毛皮，加上凶悍的性情，更让人难以亲近。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: Most people don't tend to find it very appealing. This isn't helped by its slimy pelt and generally aggressive nature.

entry: 多年来，人们一直以为，POKENAME不过是脱了壳的多刺菊石兽。直到最近，才发现这是另一种宝可梦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: For many years, POKENAME was believed to just be an Omastar outside of its shell. Only recently was it discovered to be a different Pokémon.

entry: 若没有别的生物，替POKENAME挤奶，这种宝可梦很快就会灭绝。为了生存，它会用乳头缠住猎物，直到对方不再动弹。
author: theradrad
source: Without others to milk POKENAME, this species would rapidly go extinct. To survive, it wraps its udders around its prey until they stop moving.

entry: 它能用头上的角，操纵水流。战斗时，则用长而有弹性的尾巴，抽打敌人。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: The horns on its head can be used to manipulate water currents. In battle, it lashes the foe with it's long, stretchy tail.

entry: 超能力让大脑膨胀，硕大的脑袋，便藏在壳中。谁与它锐利的目光相对，它就能读进对方心思。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its shell hides an oversized brain, which has swelled due to its psychic powers. Those who meet its piercing gaze give it access to their thoughts.

entry: POKENAME曾维持着古代水生生态的平衡。它能将力量汇入法杖，卷起巨大的漩涡。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME maintained the balance of ancient aquatic ecosystems. It focuses its power through its staff, which generates massive whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME曾维持着古代水生生态的平衡。它能将力量汇入法杖，卷起巨大的漩涡。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME maintained the balance of ancient aquatic ecosystems. It focuses its power through its staff, which generates massive whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME主要住在深海，只上岸产蛋。受到威胁，便猛烈甩动坚硬、覆甲的尾巴。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME live mainly in the deep ocean, slithering up to shore to lay their eggs. When threatened, it will violently thrash its hard, plated tail.

entry: 拉普拉斯是POKENAME的主要食物，因此，拉普拉斯壳上常能见到它的触手。久而久之，拉普拉斯也进化出了更硬的壳。
author: Zeeroooo
source: POKENAME's tentacles can commonly be found on Lapras shells, as Lapras makes up most of their diet. Since then, Lapras have evolved harder shells.

entry: POKENAME擅长潜伏，能装成其他宝可梦，引来猎物。
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv
source: POKENAME are known for their stealth. They are able to disguise themselves as other Pokémon to lure in prey.

entry: 尖喙能刺穿再硬的壳，可自己的壳实在太沉，让它挪动得极慢。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its sharp beak allows it to pierce through even the toughest shells. The weight of its shell makes it move extremely slowly.

entry: POKENAME每天有18个小时以上，牢牢附在海底。受攻击时，便猛烈挥动外壳。
author: Weirdtux
source: POKENAME will spend over 18 hours a day anchored to the seafloor. When attacked it will flail its shell violently.

entry: 巨大的尖牙，能从大型目标身上吸血。可喝得太多，头顶的大壳，就重得撑不住。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: Its huge fangs help it to draw blood from bigger targets. When it drinks too much, the huge shell on its head becomes too heavy for it.

entry: 这只融合体，源自一场实验室事故。自己的壳盖住了整颗头，害它常无意间，撞上建筑物。
author: imagine1.
source: This fusion is the aftermath of a lab accident. Its entire head is engulfed by its own shell, and it often rams into buildings unintentionally.

entry: POKENAME漂游北极海域，张开大颚，吞噬猎物。据说，只要与它对视，就足以被冻得结结实实。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME drifts through arctic waters, devouring its prey in its gaping jaw. It's said that making eye contact is enough to freeze you solid.

entry: 化蛹时，POKENAME几乎毫无自保之力。只好用粗短的腿，攀紧树枝，避开天敌。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: During its pupation, POKENAME is almost helpless. With its short stubby legs, it clings to branches to stay safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME的壳若损坏，就会在树上磨蹭，直到磨掉裂开的部分。露出的地方，几分钟内便会重新硬化。
author: .izik
source: If a POKENAME damages its shell, it will rub against a tree until the cracked portion is removed. The exposed area will grow hard in minutes.

entry: 铁壳蛹与铁甲蛹的外壳，层层叠合，让准备进化的POKENAME，宛如一座坚不可摧的堡垒。
author: kiwikelly
source: The combined, layered shells of Kakuna and Metapod make POKENAME an impenetrable fortress while it prepares to evolve.

entry: POKENAME一发怒，一分钟就能放倒好几棵树。等树倒下，便吸食树汁，直到吃饱。
author: .izik
source: When angry, POKENAME can level multiple trees in a minute. After the tree is on the ground it drinks the sap until it is full.

entry: 夜里，它用强劲的拳头攀住树干，凭触角察觉即将到来的恶劣天气。
author: .izik
source: At night it clings to a tree with its strong fists. It uses its antennae to sense when inclement weather is on the way.

entry: POKENAME能短暂飘浮，但大多仍待在地面。身体可以变得坚硬如铁，重量却一点不增。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can float for short periods of time but ultimately spends its time on the ground. Its body can get as hard as iron without gaining weight.

entry: POKENAME把进化所需的能量存进花苞，受了伤，也能迅速长好新皮。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME stores the energy it needs for evolution in its bud. If it is injured, it can quickly renew its skin.

entry: 与阿柏蛇不同，它的尖牙发育不全，便靠岩石般坚硬的头，撞击猎物。
author: PokePower
source: Unlike Ekans, its fang are under-developed. It attacks prey by headbutting them with its rock-hard skull.

entry: POKENAME紧贴在树上，几乎一动不动。它会用飘带引诱猎物，获取营养。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Being virtually immobile while clinging to a tree, POKENAME gains nutrients by luring in prey with its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME尽量保持静止，准备进化。谁敢打断，它就会记在心里，从此视为仇敌。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME stays still as long as possible, preparing for evolution. It will remember anyone who tries to disrupt this process, and recall them as foes.

entry: 在最大的大针蜂群落里，能找到它。它充当齿轮，配合简陋却巧妙的滑轮装置，搬运蜂蜜。
author: char_latte3412
source: It can be found within the largest Beedrill colonies, serving as cogwork for rudimentary yet intelligent pulley systems used in transporting honey.

entry: 蘑菇坚硬的部分会渗出液体，可用来拌沙拉。吸食的树汁不同，液体的甜度也会变化。
author: .izik
source: The hard portions of its mushroom leak a fluid that can be used in salad dressing. The fluid tastes sweeter based on the type of tree sap it consumes.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在飞行。喙与随身的大葱，由同样的东西构成，也能用来炖汤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends most of its time flying. Its beak is the same material as the leek it carries and can be used in stews.

entry: POKENAME常常像个小商人一样，用大葱指点图表。如果煮熟后食用，它的口感会非常奇怪。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME often acts like a tiny businessman, using its leek to point at charts. If cooked and eaten, it has a very strange texture.

entry: POKENAME先瞪眼吓唬敌人。若吓不退，就毫不留情，接连踢出快脚。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME glares at foes as a scare tactic. If that does not work, it rapidly kicks without mercy.

entry: 融合时，化石盔接上了鲤鱼王的舌头。宿主的身体，从此只成了化石盔的外壳。
author: paisleylxl
source: During the fusion process, the Kabuto is joined to the tongue of the Magikarp. The host's body becomes nothing more than a shell for the Kabuto.

entry: 它收集化石，用毛刷般的尾巴仔细清理。可POKENAME究竟拿这些化石做什么，没人知道。
author: admiralvermin
source: It collects fossils, cleaning them with its brush-like tail. What, exactly, POKENAME does with these fossils is unknown.

entry: POKENAME的长爪，不及化石盔的爪子坚韧，却灵巧得多，能轻松探进狭窄岩缝。
author: entomoxie
source: The longer claws on a POKENAME are not as tough as a Kabuto's claws, but they are far more dextrous and can reach into tight crevices with ease.

entry: 这对深水伙伴，似乎早在人类出现之前，就发明了剑刃。细长的那只，负责打磨圆伙伴尾端的尖刺。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This deepwater pair are thought to have created a sword blade eons before humans did. The elongated partner polishes the rounded one's caudal spike.

entry: 数百万年的岁月里，它长出了能把猎物拖进壳下的触须。遇到威胁，又会装成一块石头。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Over the millions of years it has existed, it adapted feelers to pull prey under its shell to eat. When threatened, it will disguise itself as a rock.

entry: POKENAME是陆地与天空的巨兽。既能拓宽大岩蛇挖的隧道，也能飞起来寻食，怎么方便，就怎么来。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A behemoth of land and sky, POKENAME can widen tunnels made by Onix or take flight to search for food; it isn't picky on which it chooses.

entry: 自古以来，总有人看见POKENAME飞过，便误以为毁灭将至。它也因此，愈来愈被人疏远。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Throughout history, some who saw POKENAME flying through the sky mistook it for a harbinger of destruction. It was increasingly shunned as a result.

entry: 它游在海洋最深处，寻找宝石。天真又好奇，遇上天敌，却会躲进洞穴。
author: imagine1.
source: It swims in the deepest parts of the ocean, searching for gems. It's naive and curious, but hides from predators in caves.

entry: POKENAME身怀剧毒，外壳硬如岩石。研究人员至今不确定，它到底是一只宝可梦，还是一群化石盔，合力扮作一只。
author: Eye Of Cthulhu
source: POKENAME possesses deadly poison and a rock-hard carapace. Researchers are unsure if this is one Pokémon or a group of Kabuto acting as one.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓缓跋涉，从搅起的泥中滤食。繁殖季到来，便会成群拖着身体，爬上结冰的海滩。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME trudges along the seafloor, filtering food from the mud it stirs up. During mating season, it hauls itself onto frozen beaches en masse.

entry: 腹部正中的洞，是POKENAME唯一的嘴。只要食物没比嘴大，就能直接吞下，根本不用咀嚼。
author: themicelegion
source: The hole in the center of POKENAME's stomach is its only mouth. It doesn't have to chew its food unless the food is bigger than its mouth.

entry: 它睡在深邃的水下洞穴，尤其偏爱珊瑚繁茂处。主头休息时，其他眼睛仍警戒四周。
author: imagine1.
source: It sleeps in deep caverns underwater, usually in caves abundant with coral. Its main head rests while its other eyes keep an eye out.

entry: 遇上切不开的猎物，POKENAME便用身体缠住，让对方窒息。它也能贴着水面滑行。
author: bobosmith01
source: Whatever POKENAME cannot cut through, it coils around, suffocating its prey. It has the ability to slither atop the surface of water.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀般的尾巴抓住、切开猎物。头部十分坚固，游起水来，也快得惊人。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME uses its scythe-like tails to grab and cut its prey. Its head is very durable and it can swim at incredible speeds.

entry: 镰刀般的尾巴，能轻易切开猎物。游水时，POKENAME则会将尾巴，收拢贴紧身体。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its sickle-like tail allows it to cut through prey with ease. When swimming, POKENAME will tuck its tail up against its body.

entry: 它寻找活着的宝可梦，用双镰吸走能量，徒劳地想让自己复活。
author: seafoamtaide
source: It seeks out living Pokémon and uses its scythe to sap their energy in a futile attempt to revive itself.

entry: POKENAME是最早被发现的史前哺乳动物之一。古代洞穴壁画中，还画着它挥舞刀刃，催眠猎物。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is one of the first prehistoric mammals ever discovered. Ancient cave paintings have shown it using its blades to hypnotize its prey.

entry: 每只POKENAME的镰刀，都有独特花纹。若两只的刀刃太相似，POKENAME便会打到，只剩一把镰刀为止。
author: OhOk3441
source: Each POKENAME has its own scythe with its own set of patterns. If their blades are too similar, POKENAME will fight until only one scythe remains.

entry: 它用各种高亢尖叫，配合双翼动作，吓唬猎物。极罕见时，科学家甚至记录到，假眼也会眨动。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It uses a variety of loud screeches as well as wing movements to scare prey. In rare cases, scientists have even recorded the false eyes blinking.

entry: POKENAME的肉鲜美又健康，富含脂肪酸，却极难取得。它一看见人类，便会跃起攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's flesh is delicious and healthy, loaded with fatty acids, but it's difficult to procure. It leaps and attacks at the first sight of humans.

entry: POKENAME凶得过了头。一旦在河中安家，就会把那里所有其他宝可梦，统统赶走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is aggressive to a fault. Once it makes its home in a river, it chases out all other Pokémon living there.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑地飞来飞去，仿佛全不知道，自己本该在一百万年前，就已经灭绝。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME flies around without a care in the world, seemingly unaware that it was supposed to have gone extinct a million years ago.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤弹性极强，宛如橡胶，因此很能抵挡雷击。
author: .izik
source: The skin of a POKENAME is extremely elastic and is similar to rubber. Due to this, its body is highly resistant to lightning strikes.

entry: 它身上的铠甲比钨还硬。夏季，它在阳光下闪耀的光芒比一年中的其他时候都更加明亮。
author: .izik
source: The armor on its body is harder than tungsten. During the summer months, it shines in the sun more brightly than at any other time of the year.

entry: 它在人迹罕至的山巅筑巢。若发现100米内，还有别的生物居住，便立刻搬走。
author: .izik
source: It makes its den on the peak of rarely-traversed mountains. Should it spot someone else living within 100 meters, it will immediately leave.

entry: 头部比身上任何地方都硬。它用脸猛撞树干，撞倒树木，让果实散落一地。
author: .izik
source: Its head is harder than any other portion of its body. It rams its face into trees to make them topple, spilling the fruit to the ground.

entry: 刺耳的鸣叫，几英里外也听得见。飘带般的触须，则在它进食时，将猎物牢牢缠住。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its piercing cries can be heard from miles away. Their ribbons-like feelers keep prey bound while they feast.

entry: 勾魂眼吃下秘密琥珀，有时便会变成这只宝可梦，很快，连各种化石也都想尝一尝。
author: Insanity5734
source: A Sableye that consumes Old Amber will sometimes become this Pokémon, and soon develops a taste for all fossils.

entry: POKENAME身上的石头，要长足两年，才会脱落。那些石块，可以加工成美丽的雕塑。
author: .izik
source: The stones on a POKENAME's body will grow for two years until they fall off. The stones can be reshaped to make beautiful sculptures.

entry: 它很少用尖牙攻击，更爱以惊人的速度，撞向猎物，以及争夺领地的对手。
author: PokePower
source: It rarely uses its fangs to attack. Instead, it rams into prey and territorial rivals at alarming speed.

entry: POKENAME俯冲扑敌，用尾巴刺向弱点。喧嚣的战吼，甚至能让小型宝可梦，从空中坠下。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME swoops down on opponents, jabbing at weak spots with its tail. Its raucous battle cry can knock smaller Pokémon out of the sky.

entry: 有机物一落到POKENAME身上，就会陷进去，成为身体的一部分。头骨眼窝里流出的沙，仿佛永无止境。
author: raptorroocool
source: Any organic material dropped onto a POKENAME's body sinks in and becomes part of it. The sand flowing out of the skull's eyes is seemingly endless.

entry: POKENAME对水果的胃口，似乎永远填不满。年轻的训练家，十分喜欢它。
author: lowkeytoxtricity
source: POKENAME appears to have a never-ending appetite for fruit. It is popular amongst young Pokémon Trainers.

entry: 卡比兽以堵路出名，POKENAME也不例外，只不过堵的是河床与溪流，害水宝可梦春天也无法迁徙。
author: Rooboid
source: Following Snorlax's reputation of blocking walkways, POKENAME blocks riverbeds and streams, leaving aquatic Pokémon unable to migrate in the spring.

entry: 融合让卡比兽的大肚子，又胀大到原来的两倍以上。为了腾出空间，骨骼缩小，全身也成了软团模样。
author: leeto64
source: Fusion has forced Snorlax's huge belly to more than double in size, shrinking its bones to make room and giving it a blob-like shape.

entry: 这只宝可梦满心欢喜，总带着积极的情绪。实在太爱吃，有时一口气吃得太多，重得飞不起来。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A Pokémon filled with positive emotions and happiness. It absolutely loves eating; sometimes it eats so much it can't fly with its own weight.

entry: POKENAME太贪吃，触角竟适应着，长成了树果。它吃自己的树果，并不会痛，通常也会重新长好。
author: .ssunday.
source: The force of POKENAME's gluttony has adapted its antennae into Berries. It eating its Berries doesn't hurt, and they usually grow back.

entry: POKENAME温顺得很，尾巴亮起的花纹，漂亮又让人安心，常被安排陪伴怕黑的孩子。
author: howlingstarr
source: A very docile fusion, POKENAME is often used as a companion for children afraid of the dark, as its tails glow in a pretty pattern many find soothing.

entry: 幼小的POKENAME，会把这种宝可梦的触角，当作夜灯。长大后多半不再依赖，可遇上糟心的一天，仍能从中得到慰藉。
author: .ssunday.
source: This Pokémon's antennae act as a night-light for child POKENAME. Although most adults outgrow them, it acts as comfort after a bad day.

entry: 翅膀太小，只能让它短短离地几秒。因此，只有想拿到难以够着的食物时，它才肯飞。
author: Novellavaria
source: Its wings are too small to lift it off the ground for more than a couple of seconds. Because of this, it only flies to grab hard-to-reach food.

entry: POKENAME明明没有身体，一天却能吃下数百磅食物。那些东西去了哪里，没人知道。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: In spite of its lack of a body, POKENAME can eat hundreds of pounds of food in a single day. It's unknown where this food goes.

entry: POKENAME一年大部分时间，都在沉睡。可一醒来，嘴与钻头就会把附近农田，搅得一塌糊涂。
author: beespoon
source: POKENAME spends most of the year fast asleep. When this Pokémon wakes, it devastates surrounding farmland with its mouth and drill.

entry: POKENAME整天睡，只有想吃点东西，才钻出地面。迷宫般的隧道，直通地下深处。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME snoozes endlessly, surfacing only to snack. Its maze-like tunnels delve deep underground.

entry: POKENAME块头虽大，却总轻松悠闲，也常试着唱歌，自己编些旋律。
author: tuskaninny
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is a very relaxed and laid-back Pokémon. It often attempts to sing and create melodies.

entry: 醒着的POKENAME，十分难见。凡是费力的事，都不如一场长觉来得好，可睡醒发起脾气，却相当可怕。
author: Rooboid
source: To see POKENAME awake is a rarity, as they will always favor a long nap over anything that requires any effort. Their post-nap tantrums can be brutal.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺，是牢靠的防护。可头槌通常只打得出几记，就又开始犯困。
author: GP423
source: The spikes on its head provide POKENAME a solid defense mechanism. However, it can usually only muster a few headbutts before it gets sleepy.

entry: 野生POKENAME一生，大半都在睡觉。可即便如此，体力仍强得，几乎没有对手。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME spend the majority of their lives sleeping. Despite this, their physical strength is nearly unparalleled.

entry: 它虽懒，爬树却出色，轻松就能从高高的树冠，拿到树果与水果。
author: homelessrager
source: Despite its laziness, it is an excellent climber, easily able to get Berries and fruit from very high trees.

entry: 野生POKENAME一生，大半都在睡觉。可即便如此，体力仍强得，几乎没有对手。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME spend the majority of their lives sleeping. Despite this, their physical strength is nearly unparalleled.

entry: 它醒来，只为懒洋洋吃掉身边的东西。睡着时，身体则彻底失去实体，碰也碰不到。
author: bacondlx
source: It only wakes up to lazily eat its surrounding area. While asleep, it remains completely intangible.

entry: 性情温顺又讨喜，让这只宝可梦常被带到养老院。一天里，能有20个小时，都在睡觉。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This Pokémon is often brought to retirement homes due to its docile and sweet nature. They spend up to 20 hours a day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME常突然大闹，脾气凶得很。可这样太耗能，余下一整天，就只顾睡觉。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME often go on violent temper tantrums. These take up a lot of energy, however, and it spends the rest of the day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME一睡，可能长达一万年，与山川地貌融为一体。醒来时，却能吃光一整片大陆的草木。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME may sleep for ten thousand years, becoming one with the landscape. It can devour a whole continent's vegetation when it awakes.

entry: POKENAME平时懒散，遇到危险，却会迅速跃起，以双腿迎击，最后往往再施以一记猛烈的腿锁。
author: leeto64
source: Despite its lax attitude, POKENAME will react to danger with a quick hop into an attack with its legs, usually finishing with a devastating leglock.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛不停生长，得定期修剪。剪下的毛，常被用来制作厚实的冬衣。
author: KitArchen
source: Due to their fluff constantly growing, POKENAME are regularly shaved. The fur is often used in the creation of thick winter coats.

entry: 城镇附近，常能发现打盹的POKENAME。唯有路人带着好吃的，它才肯醒。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is often found napping around towns. It only wakes up if a passer-by has a tasty treat to eat.

entry: POKENAME每天要吃900磅食物。吃得太多，甚至得将胃翻吐出来，才能腾出空间。
author: theradrad
source: POKENAME has such an appetite it eats 900 pounds a day. The amount it eats is so large it needs to vomit up its stomach to make space.

entry: 它的“翅膀”，其实是把身体压在地上的大爪。它倒对这姿势十分满意，只有够不到吃的，才会大吵大闹。
author: miecreates
source: Its "wings" are actually big paws that pin it to the ground. It is perfectly content in this position, but becomes rowdy if no food is in reach.

entry: 与其说飞，不如说它随风漂荡。就连偷偷拿走人类的食物，也始终仰着肚子，飘在空中。
author: miecreates
source: It doesn't so much as fly as it does drift aimlessly along the wind. Even when sneakily stealing food from humans, it remains floating on its back.

entry: 身体太重，飞得不舒服，它便干脆拖着身体，在地上走。可若有足够动力，仍能表演惊人的杂技。
author: miecreates
source: Too heavy to comfortably fly, it drags itself across the ground instead. Despite this, it can manage incredible acrobatics if properly motivated.

entry: 它的鼾声，几英里外都听得见。掘到的金属与宝石，不论哪一种，它都照吃不误。
author: Soup1900
source: The sound of its snores can be heard from miles away. It will eat any kind of metal or precious stone that it digs up.

entry: 看见POKENAME肚皮朝天，漂在水里，别慌。没在吃东西时，圆圆的身体，自会在睡梦中浮上水面。
author: .towerxvi
source: Do not be alarmed if you see a POKENAME belly-up in water; when they aren't eating, their round bodies float to the surface while they sleep.

entry: 它不论走到哪里，都带着枕头。据说，偷POKENAME的枕头，会招来厄运。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: It never goes anywhere without its pillow. It has been said that stealing a POKENAME's pillow will bring bad luck.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶子，覆着一层难闻的毒膜。究竟能臭到什么程度，全看它吃了什么。
author: char_latte3412
source: The leaves atop POKENAME's head are coated with an awful-smelling poisonous film. How bad the stench is depends on its diet.

entry: POKENAME身体虽小，跺脚却能震动地面。胃口又大得惊人，连头上自己的叶子，也会吃掉。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though it is small, the stomping of POKENAME's feet can make the ground shake. Its appetite is so voracious, it will eat the leaves off its own head.

entry: POKENAME像一种外形和触感都酷似棉花糖的玩具。它懒得出奇，甚至不在乎自己失去了双腿。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME resembles a toy known for its similarity in appearance and texture to marshmallows. It's so lazy, it doesn't mourn the loss of its legs.

entry: POKENAME毛间落下的粉，可以制作遮瑕膏与眼线。合众的时装秀上，美容师就会用这种妆品。
author: .izik
source: The dust that comes off of a POKENAME's fur is used in creating concealer and eyeliner. Beauticians use this makeup at fashion shows in Unova.

entry: POKENAME平日忙着往嘴里塞意面，吃够了，便蜷进床铺，一连睡上好几个小时。
author: GP423
source: When POKENAME isn't participating in its usual routine of stuffing its face with pasta, it curls up in its bed and sleeps for hours upon hours.

entry: POKENAME爱趴在训练家身上，像一床暖和又厚重的毯子，表达亲昵，因此，是十分受欢迎的宠物。
author: JordanX27
source: POKENAME love to show affection for their Trainer by laying on them like a warm, heavy blanket. This makes them a very popular pet.

entry: 嘴里不断渗出，反流而来的毒液。它会把靠近的弱小猎物，整个溶成液体，吃干净，再悠然睡上一觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Regurgitative and poisonous fluid oozes from its mouth. It dines on weak prey that gets close, liquefying them whole, and then takes a leisurely nap.

entry: 它的树果，只咬一口，就会让人立刻睡着。可别贪嘴，醒来时，食物早已全被POKENAME吃光。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Anyone who takes a bite of its berries will fall asleep right away. It's advised is not to eat them, as POKENAME will deprive you of all your food.

entry: POKENAME用默剧比划出的东西，都能化为纯冰的实体。不过，机器之类太复杂的物件，它还造不出。
author: themicelegion
source: Whatever POKENAME mimes out will become a physical object made of pure ice. It cannot make anything too complex, like machines.

entry: 它看着胖，其实满身大多是密实的羽毛。即使远低于华氏零下100度，也能妥善保护身体。
author: moopse
source: While it might look fat, this Pokémon's body is mostly dense feathers that keep it safe even in temperatures well below -100° F.

entry: 羽毛太多，挡得它几乎看不见。不过，厚密的外衣，也有替它挡住攻击的好处。
author: moopse
source: Due to an excess amount of feathers, this Pokémon can barely see. Its dense coat does have the upside of protecting it from attacks, however.

entry: POKENAME胸中，满是强烈而不竭的决心，已经臻于巅峰。即使生命垂危，也会战斗到最后一刻。
author: Leeto64
source: Bestowed with intense, overflowing determination, POKENAME has reached its zenith. With its life on the line, it'll keep battling until the very end.

entry: 据说，POKENAME生活在世间最寒冷的山峰之一，守望着那些，敢于攀登的旅人。
author: mistershaokahn
source: It is said that POKENAME lives on one of the coldest mountains in the world, watching over climbers who dare attempt to ascend it.

entry: 有人见过，POKENAME不小心将自己的触角冻干。即使在冰寒的环境里，它仍能游动生存。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally freeze-drying their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in ice-cold environments.

entry: POKENAME从喙中射出沉重的冰块。身体越重的POKENAME，射出的冰块也越大。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME shoots heavy chunks of ice from its beak. Heavy POKENAME fire larger ice chunks.

entry: 只有在最高的山巅，才偶尔能看见这种宝可梦成群出没。稍有风吹草动，整群便一同振翅飞走。
author: r.isk
source: Herds of these Pokémon are only occasionally seen on the highest mountain peaks. At the slightest danger, the whole herd takes flight at once.

entry: 金色光芒，穿过POKENAME水晶般的冰羽，灿烂辉映。见过的人，终生也忘不了。
author: .realthree
source: Those who see the brilliant splendor of the golden light shining through POKENAME's crystalline ice feathers never forget it.

entry: 葬身暴风雪的亡魂，汇成了POKENAME。这个强大的灵体，与一块冻结的楔石，相依相连。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Spirits that have passed in blizzards gather to form POKENAME. This powerful spirit is bonded to a frozen keystone.

entry: 传说，这只高贵的宝可梦，曾造出一座永冻的冰城。如今，仍在那里守着无价宝物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Legend has it that this noble Pokémon is said to have created a castle of eternal ice. There it watches over a priceless treasure.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，住在冰封的高峰附近。只消挥动刀刃，就能卷起暴风雪。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around icy summits. It can generate a blizzard with a swing of its blade.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦，给触须裹上厚冰，便造出壮丽的双翼。飞到哪里，雪就下到哪里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This legendary Pokémon can create magnificent wings by coating its feelers in a thick coat of ice. Wherever it flies, it snows.

entry: 一打开POKENAME的内部，附近的人，就可能冻伤。它也不喜欢别人，把物品放在里面。
author: bobosmith01
source: Opening the inside of POKENAME can cause frostbite to anyone nearby. It prefers not to have any items inside of it.

entry: POKENAME将传说中的寒冰之力，与来自外星的强大本领结合，以优雅而可怕的力量，主宰天空。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME wields legendary icy powers combined with extraterrestrial prowess. It commands the skies with grace and formidable abilities.

entry: 随身带的洋蓟，究竟为何对它的生活如此重要，至今无人明白。许多研究人员想查个清楚，却被冻成了冰。
author: nvisionluminous
source: It remains unknown how the artichoke it carries is crucial to its way of life. Many researchers found themselves frozen solid trying to find out.

entry: 传说，在暴风雪中迷路时，若POKENAME就在附近，它会先把你催眠，免得被看见，再送你到安全的地方。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Legends say that if you get lost in a blizzard and POKENAME is nearby, it will put you to sleep so you won't see it and take you to a safe place.

entry: 白天看见流星，或许就是POKENAME正掠过天空，赶往远方，带去雷电。
author: Fenragon
source: If you see a falling star during the daytime, it could be POKENAME zipping through the sky on its way to bring lightning to faraway regions.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心电到自己的触角。即使在带电的水中，它也能游动生存。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally shocking their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in electrified waters.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺能扎穿人类皮肤，把电流直接送进体内。凡发现它们的水域，都禁止游泳。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's quills are able to pierce human skin and discharge electricity directly into the body. Swimming is off limits anywhere they are spotted.

entry: 海面出现雷暴，可能就意味着附近有POKENAME。只要POKENAME重新潜入水中，风暴很快便会散去。
author: KitArchen
source: If you see a thunderstorm over the ocean, it may mean a POKENAME is near. The storm will quickly pass once POKENAME dives back down into the water.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，栖息于火山熔岩附近，也能在熔岩中再生。据说，它若出现在别处，春天也会随之到来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around and regenerates in volcanic lava. Its appearance elsewhere is said to bring about spring.

entry: 传说，它连最猛烈的雷暴也能驱散。许多船只都带着POKENAME的标志，祈求一路平安。
author: char_latte3412
source: Legend holds that it possesses the ability to dispel even the fiercest thunderstorms. Many ships carry a symbol of POKENAME in hopes of safe travels.

entry: POKENAME驾驭雷电，翱翔云间。双翼闪烁着风暴的能量，在蔚蓝天空中，显得威严而壮丽。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME commands lightning and soars amidst clouds. Its wings shimmer with stormy energy, a majestic sight in the azure sky.

entry: POKENAME的火焰永远燃烧，无法熄灭。即使是水，也只会让火势更旺。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME's fire burns forever and cannot be extinguished. Even water only strengthens the fire.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心烧掉自己的触角。即便如此，它也能在熔岩中游动生存。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally incinerating their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in molten lava.

entry: 这只高贵的宝可梦，只追随自己认可的人。选中这样的训练家后，它的火焰便会像夜空繁星，明亮闪耀。
author: dicedragon20
source: A regal Pokémon that will only follow those it deems worthy. When it has chosen such a Trainer, its flames burn as brightly as stars in the night.

entry: POKENAME能操控各种火焰，也能幻化出高大的凤凰影像，替代自己娇小的身姿。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME has the power to control all kinds of fire. It is able to conjure images of a towering phoenix in place of its diminutive form.

entry: POKENAME从口中，喷出高压的炽热蒸汽。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME blows highly pressurized hot steam from its mouth.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦诞生于火山核心。据说，看见它，就是春天将至的征兆。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This legendary Pokémon was born in the heart of a volcano. It's said that seeing this Pokémon is a sign of spring coming.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时会全身燃起火焰，再从敌人的灰烬中，夺走灵魂。
author: kingeroyal
source: POKENAME bursts into flames when it's being attacked. It steals the souls of its enemies from their ashes.

entry: POKENAME不断加热自身，化为灰烬，再从灰烬中重生。
author: kingeroyal
source: After POKENAME heats itself up, it turns to ashes to then be reborn.

entry: POKENAME总不满意，觉得自己还模仿得不像火焰鸟。若背后的打火机，烧着了翼边的叶子，它就会勃然大怒。
author: squawkabairdy
source: A POKENAME is never satisfied with its attempts to mimic Moltres. It gets livid if the lighter by its back burns up the leaves along its wings.

entry: POKENAME体内融着光与暗的魔法，会在日光下休眠，积蓄能量。传说预言，终有一天，它将焚尽世界。
author: the_smirker
source: Infused with light and dark magic, POKENAME gathers energy while dormant in the sun. Legend foretells that it will one day incinerate the world.

entry: POKENAME的火翼，能让阳光更加温暖。若室外日照让你放松、犯困，或许它刚从头顶飞过。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's fiery wings amplify the warmth of the sun. If the sunshine outside is making you feel relaxed or sleepy, it may have just flown by.

entry: 这是POKENAME的稀有种，有时也被称为“海之九头蛇”。
author: Toxicrown
source: A rare species of POKENAME. It is sometimes called 'The Hydra of the Seas'.

entry: POKENAME把龙之能量储存在尾端的圆珠中。它性情十分温顺，却更喜欢独来独往。
author: theartemis1
source: Draconic energy is stored in the bulb on POKENAME's tail. It is known to be very docile and prefers a solitary lifestyle.

entry: 这只宝可梦极难一见，会制造蜃景与幻象，藏住身形，躲开可能带来危险的目光。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon is an exceedingly rare sight, capable of conjuring mirages and illusions to hide itself from potentially dangerous eyes.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区极为罕见。它通常尽力避免冲突，真有必要，也会迎战。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: POKENAME are exceedingly rare in volcanic biomes. They usually try to avoid conflict but will fight if necessary.

entry: POKENAME柔软的吻部布满神经，轻轻碰一下，也会让它痛得厉害，因此不适合给孩子作伴。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's soft snout is full of nerve endings, and even minor impacts cause it great pain. For this reason, they make poor companions for children.

entry: 随着身体慢慢长大，POKENAME会弃下旧鞘，长出更大的新鞘。这些旧剑鞘，常被王室用来象征身份。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its scabbard for a larger one it generates as it slowly grows. These scabbards are often used as status symbols for royalty.

entry: 刚出生的POKENAME生活在河床与湖底。每次蜕皮，触须也会长得更长。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: During the beginning of POKENAME's life, it will live on the floor of rivers and lakes. As it sheds its skin, its feelers will grow longer.

entry: POKENAME虽模样凶恶，性情却平和温顺。可一到战斗，尾巴还是会兴奋地摆动起来。
author: Xephyr
source: Despite a fearsome exterior, POKENAME is a calm and docile Pokémon by nature. When in battle, its tail begins swaying excitedly.

entry: 泥浆般的皮肤脆弱，始终无法长好，POKENAME便不断蜕掉旧皮，在下面长出新的一层。
author: mx_wellman
source: Because its fragile, sludge-like skin never fully develops, a POKENAME continually molts and sloughs it off, regrowing another layer underneath.

entry: 这只可怜的宝可梦，被自己长长的身体缠成了大结。遗憾的是，POKENAME平时就是这副模样。
author: ruminino
source: This poor Pokémon has tangled itself in its long body, resulting in a large knot. This is unfortunately the default state of POKENAME.

entry: 身上晶体蓄着庞大能量，让它的气息格外惊人。它也会用这份力量，平息风暴。
author: gellyfishsh
source: An enormous amount of energy is stored in the crystals on its body, giving it an incredible aura. It uses its power to calm storms.

entry: 传说，水晶球能预知未来的降雨。当地一家受欢迎的新闻台，还常请POKENAME出现在天气预报里。
author: char_latte3412
source: Legend has it that its crystal orbs can predict future rains. A popular local news station often features POKENAME during its weather forecasts.

entry: POKENAME的预知力，在风暴中最为强大。它凝望暴雨中的云，便能清晰看见未来的景象。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's clairvoyant abilities peak during storms. It gazes at the clouds during heavy rains, viewing crystal-clear images of the future.

entry: 训练家若想收服POKENAME，必须经历数场英雄般的试炼。若被判定不配，便会受到它的超能力惩罚。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When a Trainer attempts to catch a POKENAME, they must face several heroic trials. If deemed unworthy, they are punished by its psychic power.

entry: 颈间的水晶球，能让它掌控天气。圆珠越多，控制也越精确。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The crystal orbs around this Pokémon's neck allow it to control the weather. The more orbs it has, the more precise the control.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，通常只喷出墨汁，掩护逃走。可若生命垂危，也会使出全部的龙之力量。
author: Mistymagius
