source: POKENAME are quite timid and usually just spray ink on its attackers to escape. But if its life is on the line, it will use its full draconic power.

entry: 一些古老文化，把POKENAME奉为神灵，献上珍贵之物，祈求风调雨顺。据说，若惹它不悦，便会遭到惨痛报复。
author: char_latte3412
source: Some ancient cultures revered POKENAME as a deity, offering it valuables for good weather. Supposedly, if displeased, it exacted painful revenge.

entry: 昔日不过一个结，如今却成了迷宫般纠缠的身体。可怜POKENAME，再也无法解脱。
author: ruminino
source: What was once a knot is now a labyrinthian mess of a tangled body. POKENAME will unfortunately never be free.

entry: POKENAME极为罕见。唯有气压与湿度都恰到好处，才能发现它。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is extremely rare. It is only found when the atmospheric pressure and humidity are exactly right.

entry: POKENAME能储存庞大能量。为了找到伙伴，它会把能量分享给同类。
author: anarchaz
source: A POKENAME is capable of storing an immense amount of energy. It seeks companionship by sharing said energy with its peers.

entry: 头部与尾巴上的圆珠，都有剧毒。身体防御也十分强，最猛烈的攻击，也能扛住。
author: themicelegion
source: The orbs on its tail and head are highly poisonous. It has a very defensive body that can withstand the hardest of hits.

entry: 村庄常向这只威严的宝可梦供奉，盼望好天气。据说，它的鸣叫，连最猛烈的风暴也能安抚。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This majestic Pokémon is often given offerings by villages in hopes of good weather. It's said its cry can calm the fiercest storms.

entry: POKENAME产生的泡泡，看着像珍珠，其实只是虹彩流转的液体。遇上威胁，便喷向对方，趁机逃走。
author: OhOk3441
source: While the bubbles POKENAME produces look like pearls, it's nothing more than an iridescent fluid. It spits it at any threat to make a quick escape.

entry: 为适应雪地，POKENAME长出几丛厚毛，在风雪中保护面部。可厚毛也因此，遮住了视线。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME's snowy habitat has led it to adapt patches of thick fur for protecting its face during blizzards, which has restricted its eyesight.

entry: POKENAME身上的圆珠，会放出明亮的电蓝色光，晃花注视者的双眼，因此，想拍到一张好照片，并不容易。
author: Mistymagius
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow with an electric blue light. They use this to blind anyone that see them, so good photos of POKENAME are rare.

entry: POKENAME痴迷闪亮的东西，总追着自己尾巴上的亮珠，转个不停，最后追得头晕目眩。
author: fountainihili
source: POKENAME's fascination with shiny things leads to it chasing the glittering orbs on its tail to no end. It gets incredibly dizzy in this pursuit.

entry: 人们相信，全身都由控天气晶体组成的POKENAME，已有1000岁。它唤来的雨水，也让身体泛起光洁的亮泽。
author: char_latte3412
source: A POKENAME composed entirely of weather-controlling crystals is believed to be 1000 years old. The rains it summons give its body a sleek sheen.

entry: 巨大的晶体，组成POKENAME半副身体，赋予它卓越的控天气之力。它常召来暴雨，赶走闯入者。
author: char_latte3412
source: The large crystals composing half its body grant POKENAME supreme control of the weather. It frequently summons rainstorms to deter trespassers.

entry: POKENAME原本只是虚构的存在，先进的基因工程，却让它真正活了过来。可惜的是，它并没有实现愿望的能力。
author: char_latte3412
source: Originally a product of fiction, POKENAME was brought to life through advanced genetic engineering. Disappointingly, it lacks wish-granting abilities.

entry: POKENAME结群飞行，寻找进化石。等大家全都进化，便各自奔向不同的路。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME fly in groups, looking for evolution stones. Once they all evolve, they go their separate ways.

entry: POKENAME虽是一条龙，却像骑士一样，拯救困在城堡中的公主。闪亮的铠甲，也硬如黑曜石。
author: .ssunday.
source: Although a dragon, POKENAME saves princesses from castles like a knight. Its shining armor is as tough as obsidian.

entry: POKENAME会疾速飞去，帮助有需要的人，再把感谢之情带来的正向能量，储存在颈间的宝石里。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME flies at terrific speeds to aid people in need. It stores the positive energy from their gratitude in the gems around its neck.

entry: 它仍有绕行世界的能力，却更愿吃吃东西，打个盹。所幸，快龙善良的性情，也依然留着。
author: Cascadeguy
source: Despite still being able to circle the globe, it'd much rather eat food and doze off. It still retains Dragonite's kindhearted personality, however.

entry: POKENAME实力强大，通常连比自己大的对手，也能击倒。它又十分体贴，常照料较弱的宝可梦。
author: Mossybanana
source: A strong Pokémon, POKENAME can typically take down opponents larger than itself. It is very compassionate, and will often watch over weaker Pokémon.

entry: 据说，这只剑宝可梦，曾从瓦砾与战俘营中，救出战争的受害者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This sword Pokémon is said to have rescued victims of war from rubble and prison camps.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚的伙伴，无论发生何事，都愿追随训练家。力量与那份坚定，让龙属性训练家，十分喜爱。
author: therider
source: POKENAME are loyal companions, willing to follow their Trainers no matter what. Their strength and dedication are beloved by Dragon-type Trainers.

entry: 故事中，沉船上的水手，本以为必死无疑，回过神来，却已被POKENAME送回陆地。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Stories are told of sailors on sinking ships who had thought they were doomed only to find themselves brought to land by POKENAME.

entry: 它们被称为“英雄龙”，会赌上性命，奋力守护自己的家园，以及住在其中的人们。
author: yourfriendlycap
source: Given the moniker of 'The Hero Dragon', these creatures fiercely defend any land they call their home, as well as its people, with their lives.

entry: POKENAME速度快，精力又充沛，虽难训练，可谁赢得它的尊重，就能得到它不屈不移的忠诚。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.

entry: POKENAME的咆哮充满威严，奔跑起来，一周就能绕世界一圈。唯有心地纯净的人，才会见到它现身。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roar is a thing of majesty. They can run fast enough to circle the globe in a week, and will only reveal themselves to the pure of heart.

entry: POKENAME速度快，精力又充沛，虽难训练，可谁赢得它的尊重，就能得到它不屈不移的忠诚。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.

entry: POKENAME速度快，精力又充沛，虽难训练，可谁赢得它的尊重，就能得到它不屈不移的忠诚。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are extremely fast and full of energy. They are difficult to train, but will be unyieldingly loyal to those who have earned its respect.

entry: 出生时，它全靠别人的善意，才能活下去。长大后，便以救助迷途旅人，回报这份恩情。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: At birth it is entirely reliant on the kindness of others to survive. It later repays this kindness by rescuing lost travelers.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地待在偏远岛屿的沙滩。没有天敌，也让它们对游客，格外友好。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME laze around on remote island beaches. They don't have any natural predators, so they are quite friendly towards tourists.

entry: POKENAME背上的蜂巢，不停酿出蜂蜜，因此身边，总围着一群其他虫宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME continuously produces honey in the honeycomb on its back. For this reason, it is constantly accompanied by a swarm of other bug Pokémon.

entry: 触角落下的粉，会让孩子昏昏欲睡。它再吐出黏丝，将孩子包起，带回蜂巢。
author: .izik
source: The dust that comes off of its antennae can cause drowsiness in children. It will then wrap the child with a sticky string and bring it to its hive.

entry: 触角能察觉湿度细微的变化，判断是否将下雨。凭这本领，它总能轻松躲过暴雨。
author: .izik
source: Its antennae can detect subtle changes in humidity and determine if it will rain. With this knowledge, it hides from rainstorms with ease.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，常躲在树后，避着训练家。可双手的毒刺，却是危险的武器。
author: Schierke
source: POKENAME is a very shy fusion—it tends to hide behind trees to avoid Trainers. The stingers on its hands pose a dangerous threat.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，总在地盘上巡行。复眼能让它看到，将近360度的范围。
author: togetik
source: Being extremely territorial, POKENAME constantly roams around its territory. Its compound eyes allow it nearly 360 degrees of vision.

entry: 尾部尖刺带着危险的毒液。不过，将毒液熬煮浓缩后，也能拿来擦亮木制家具。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its tail contains a dangerous venom. If boiled down, the venom can be used to polish wooden furniture.

entry: 手臂上的毒刺，能伸出身体外10英尺。刺尖锋利异常，连金属也扎得穿。
author: .izik
source: The stingers on its arms can extend up to 10 feet from its body. The stingers are exceptionally sharp and able to pierce metal.

entry: 传说，POKENAME翼间流出的滚烫蜂蜜，不但美味，还能治好多数病痛。可惜，它也实在太烫。
author: howlingstarr
source: Legend says that the molten honey oozing from POKENAME's wings is not only delicious, but can cure most ailments. Unfortunately, it's also quite hot.

entry: POKENAME是精力旺盛的小型融合体，一兴奋，背上就常喷出热蜜。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME is quite an energetic little fusion. Hot honey often spouts from its back when excited.

entry: 它能从嘴里吐出腐蚀性的蜜，常趁飞行时突然喷洒，让敌人措手不及。
author: .izik
source: It has the ability to spit a corrosive honey from its mouth. It does this while flying to catch its foe off-guard.

entry: 它的双眼，能看出远处生物的热量轮廓，凭此辨认朋友与家人。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes can recognize heat signatures from afar. It uses this ability to identify friends and family.

entry: 背上的蜂巢能吸引几公里外的虫宝可梦，因此POKENAME很受捕虫少年的欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The hive on its back attracts other bug Pokémon over several kilometers. This makes POKENAME a popular companion for bug catchers.

entry: POKENAME飞得惊人地快，刺中猎物时，也会吸取养分。毒液还能让受害者，连续几周噩梦缠身。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME flies at incredible speeds, absorbing nutrients from victims it stings. Its venom can give a victim weeks of nightmares.

entry: POKENAME在地壳深处筑巢。多数地方的群落，彼此隔绝，可神奥地下的数量，却渐渐成了隐患。
author: LordKai1
source: POKENAME make their hives deep in the planet's crust. Normally isolated in most regions, they've become a growing concern in the Sinnoh underground.

entry: POKENAME体格厚重，性情凶猛。圆锥形的双钳，既能刺得更深，也能钳得更紧。
author: AlexanderEnjoyer1
source: POKENAME is known for its aggressive nature and bulky frame. Its cone-shaped pincers allow for greater piercing and gripping strength.

entry: 它用手臂上的毒刺，钻开树干。树一破开，便吸食里面的汁液。
author: .izik
source: It uses the stingers on its arms to drill into trees. Once it has a tree cut open, it will drink the sap inside.

entry: POKENAME主要靠手上的毒刺，迎击、毒倒敌人，也会拿来凿开蜂巢，让幼崽进出。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME primarily use the stingers on their hands to attack and poison their enemies, but also to dig out openings in their hive for their young.

entry: POKENAME用腹部花纹与嗡鸣，迷惑猎物，再收紧身体，不停蜇刺，直到能安稳地将其整个吞下。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME bewilders prey with its belly pattern and buzzing. It then constricts its prey and stings it until it can be safely swallowed whole.

entry: 它一振翅，就会发出足以切断树木的声波。獠牙里，还藏着使人麻痹的毒液。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When it flutters its wings, this Pokémon sends out sound waves capable of cutting through trees. Its tusks are equipped with a paralyzing venom.

entry: 它钻穿山体，凿出地下墓穴般的居所。酿成的蜜，也硬如钻石。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It drills through mountains to build the catacombs it calls home. The honey it produces is as tough as diamonds.

entry: 它专在电力旺盛的地方筑巢。多数除虫人员都认为，想清走一整群POKENAME，根本是不可能的事。
author: Staghorn
source: It builds hives in places with high amounts of electricity. Most exterminators consider removing a swarm of POKENAME to be an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME小巧的体型，与和气的表情，让人轻易忘了，它其实带着毒刺，天性还十分好斗。
author: rihse
source: POKENAME's small stature and amiable expression cleverly distract from its venomous stingers and penchant for aggression.

entry: POKENAME模仿大针蜂的外形，吓退天敌。虽没有毒，受威胁时，仍会用锋利的尖刺自卫。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME mimics the appearance of Beedrill to ward off predators. Though not venomous, it will defend itself with its sharp stinger if threatened.

entry: 失去蜇刺能力后，POKENAME便改用开着鲜花的尾巴，引诱猎物。那些花，可是带着剧毒的。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It has lost the ability to sting, so POKENAME now uses its tail adorned with beautiful flowers to lure in prey. These flowers are highly toxic.

entry: POKENAME的蜜，比普通蜂蜜更凉、更甜，还能做成刨冰，是夏日理想的伙伴。
author: Patch_Bros
source: The honey of a POKENAME is colder and sweeter than normal honey. It can make snow cones from this honey, making it a perfect summer companion.

entry: POKENAME的钻头一旦折断，重新长出的就有原来两倍强。它会拼死保护火稚鸡与铁壳蛹融合而成的幼崽。
author: hampterbychoice
source: If one of POKENAME's drills breaks, it grows back twice as strong. It will defend its brood of Torchuna with its life.

entry: POKENAME把进化前的同类安置在背上的大蜂巢里，保护它们。它还能喷出蜂蜜，靠大量黏稠的蜜缠住对手，让其难以行动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME offers its pre-evolutions protection in the large hive on its back. It can shoot honey to restrict opponents' movement with its viscous bulk.

entry: 与POKENAME短兵相接，很容易丧命。若遇上一整群，恐怕更会落得面目全非。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A knife fight with a POKENAME is easily fatal. An encounter with a swarm of POKENAME is a sure way to become unrecognizable.

entry: 它们心灵相通，共享意识，能配合出更精妙的招数。既会从不同方向夹击，也会摩擦刀刃，发出安抚心绪的嗡鸣。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: As a telepathic hivemind, they execute more advanced techniques. They can strike from different directions or rub blades to create a pacifying buzz.

entry: POKENAME的盾，由专为它构筑的坚韧蜂巢制成，即使传说宝可梦的招式，也能挡住。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's shield is made of a highly durable type of honeycomb made specially for it, able to withstand moves from even Legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在深沙下筑巢，是凶残的猎手。它借沙暴掩护，蜇刺较小的宝可梦，作为食物。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME builds its hive deep under the sand. It's a cruel predator that hunts for smaller Pokémon by stinging them from the cover of the sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，除了信任的训练家，谁也别想从它那里，分走哪怕一滴蜂蜜。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME is an extremely territorial Pokémon, refusing to share as much as a drop of honey with anyone but a trusted Trainer.

entry: 这是一种妖精般的稀有融合体，难得现身，训练家却趋之若鹜。可别随便招惹，它也会奋起自卫。
author: ChocoUniversa#2993
source: A rare fusion that is akin to a fairy, rarely seen and often sought after by Trainers. However, it is unwise to provoke it for it will defend itself.

entry: POKENAME热衷于和同族交手，常钻凿山壁，惹出小规模滑坡。
author: Schierke
source: POKENAME has a passion for battling with others of its kind. It is usually spotted drilling into the sides of mountains, causing small landslides.

entry: POKENAME守卫领地，十分凶悍。它先用闪光，扰乱误入旅人的注意，再发起攻击。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its territory, distracting wayward travelers with flashes of light before attacking.

entry: 吃花时，毛孔会渗出黄色液体，看起来、闻起来都像蜜，实则是强烈的毒素。
author: .izik
source: As it consumes flowers, a yellow fluid leaks from its pores. Though it has the appearance and scent of honey, it's actually a powerful toxin.

entry: 口中爆发的声波，听着宛如数十亿只虫一同振翅，足以让人恶心、头晕。
author: .izik
source: The sound waves that burst from its mouth sound like billions of buzzing insects. This can cause nausea and dizziness.

entry: POKENAME专袭对手的蜂巢，盗走蜂蜜，是关都各地养蜂人的大患。
author: volvonovic
source: The scourge of apiarists all across Kanto, POKENAME will target rival hives and steal their honey.

entry: 有人认为，如今的大针蜂在1.5亿多年前就是这副模样。它会发出震耳欲聋的吼声，赶走威胁巢穴的敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some believe this is what today's Beedrill looked like over 150 million years ago. It wards off threats from its nest with its ear-splitting roars.

entry: 它在花间飞来飞去，寻找最爱的花粉。若遇上最馋的那一口，便连整朵花，一起吃掉。
author: .izik
source: It flutters from flower to flower searching for its favorite pollen. Should it find its most coveted treat, it will consume the entire flower.

entry: 它采集花坛的花粉时，总跳着古怪的舞。等攒够之后，又会旋转着，将花粉撒给其他花朵。
author: .izik
source: It does an odd dance while collecting pollen from flowerbeds. Once it has enough, it will spin and spread the pollen to other flowers.

entry: POKENAME舞艺高超，会用舞蹈警告闯入领地的家伙。再加上毒刺，可是个难缠的对手。
author: pory
source: A skilled dancer, POKENAME dances to warn off would-be intruders to their territory. Its stingers make it a difficult opponent to deal with.

entry: 循着沿路留下的蜜痕，就能认出POKENAME的领地。它供大针蜂在体内筑巢，作为交换，大针蜂便听它指挥。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME's territory can be known through the trails of honey it leaves as it moves. In exchange for being a hive, the Beedrill within serve its will.

entry: POKENAME虽重逾一吨，仍能像其他昆虫一样，忽左忽右地飞。金属外壳下，护着柔软如蜜的内部。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: Despite weighing over a ton, POKENAME is able to fly around erratically like any other insect. Its metallic exterior protects a soft honey interior.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，对训练家也忠诚得近乎凶悍。毒刺与鬃毛里的岩石，都带着危险毒素。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME are territorial, and are ferociously loyal to their Trainers. Both its stinger and the rocks in its mane carry dangerous poison.

entry: POKENAME常成群出行，遇上危险的敌人便出击。毒刺其实由身上的蘑菇长出，用来防备天敌。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME usually travel in colonies, attacking any dangerous foe. Its stingers actually come from its mushroom as a way to fend off predators.

entry: 野生POKENAME对人类和其他宝可梦都怀有强烈敌意，争强好胜，向来难以驯服。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are very hostile and competitive towards people and other Pokémon. They are known to be difficult to tame.

entry: POKENAME性情凶狠，是最危险的虫宝可梦之一。猎物即使逃出视线，它也能凭超能力，再次找到。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME, with its vicious temper, is one of the most dangerous bugs to encounter. Even if it loses its prey, it can locate it using psychic power.

entry: POKENAME是一大团模样可怖的蜂蜜，会让捕虫少年误以为它是大针蜂。一发现猎物，它就用黏稠的蜜将其困住。
author: .thewaffles.
source: POKENAME is a monstrous pile of honey. It tricks Bug Catchers into mistaking it for Beedrill. When it sees prey, it traps them in their sticky honey.

entry: 壳内藏着庞大的超能力。POKENAME的模样，像极了遥远国度传说中的一种宝可梦。
author: toad900
source: It contains immense psychic powers within its shell. POKENAME resembles a fabled Pokémon from a faraway land.

entry: 这是一件活的超能力武器。光是靠近，就会出现鲜明的幻觉，头也痛得全身无力。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A living psychic weapon, just being near this menace can cause vivid hallucinations and debilitating headaches.

entry: POKENAME看似由三只宝可梦融合而成，其实并非如此。它的第二颗头似乎是残留基因表达出来的结果。
author: Atlas333
source: While POKENAME appears to be a fusion of three Pokémon, this isn't the case. Instead, its second head seems to be an expression of remnant DNA.

entry: POKENAME驾驭心灵与大地之力，不论超能力还是体力，都能压制敌人。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME harnesses the power of the mind and the earth. It is capable of dominating foes with both mental and physical force.

entry: 由于实验室没有彻底清除污染物，沙子混入机器并与梦幻的基因结合，最终创造出了POKENAME。
author: mystora
source: As a result of a poorly decontaminated laboratory, sand slipped into a machine and combined with Mew's DNA, thus creating POKENAME.

entry: 作为最早克隆出的最初伙伴，它性情较温顺，也更善于保护其他生命。住在丛林深处的洞穴里，守望整片森林。
author: toad900
source: As the first of the cloned starters, it remains more docile and protective. It lives deep in jungle caves to watch over the forest life.

entry: POKENAME的超能力足以压垮一栋建筑。幸好，它实在太懒，除了吃东西以外几乎什么都不愿做。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME has enough power to crush a building with its psychic power. Thankfully, POKENAME is too lazy to do much other than eat.

entry: 人们以基因工程创造POKENAME，想造出终极武器，可它却不肯让人握着使用。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME was genetically engineered in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon, but it refuses to be wielded.

entry: 人类造POKENAME，本想让它成为终极武器，它却放下过去，走自己的路。接近它的人，往往发现自己，竟无法与它战斗。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Created by humans to be the ultimate weapon, POKENAME has left its past behind to forge its own path. Those who come near it find they can't fight it.

entry: POKENAME能从手臂上的炮，射出凝聚的精神能量。可铠甲底下究竟什么模样，没人知道。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fire concentrated psychic blasts from the cannon on its arms. No one knows what this Pokémon looks like under its armor.

entry: 中间的头，以超能力支配另外两颗。若三头彻底同步，便能将整座城市，化为灰烬。
author: Mistymagius
source: The middle head controls the other two with its psychic powers. However, if all three heads are in perfect sync, they can turn a whole city to ashes.

entry: 来自异宇宙的寄生生物，与人造实验体融合，形成了这只宝可梦。它会唤来日食，让敌人胆寒。
author: bobosmith01
source: An alien parasite from another universe and a man-made experiment fused to become this Pokémon. It brings forth an eclipse, striking fear in foes.

entry: 若遭激怒，它便会连对手的灵魂一并焚烧，再用超能力，将所有痕迹抹去。
author: Skymaster426
source: If it is angered, then it burns its opponents to their very soul. Then, it uses its psychic powers to leave no trace behind.

entry: 克隆而生的它，造出的火焰只有微温。不过，深厚的心灵知识，让它能改变人们有害的想法。
author: toad900
source: Due to being cloned, the fires it forges are lukewarm. Its psychic knowledge allows it the ability to change toxic viewpoints of people.

entry: POKENAME由多位伟大格斗家和格斗属性宝可梦的基因创造而成。不过，它仍然需要接受一些训练。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME was created from the DNA of various great fighters and fighting-type Pokémon. It still needs to undergo some training, however.

entry: 为了击败从前的主人，它独自修行多年。拳头落下，还带着精神能量，将对手震昏。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It has trained in solitude for many years in order to defeat its former masters. Strikes from its fists stun opponents with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME不停地训练，还会观看历史上最出色格斗家的影像来学习战斗。永不停歇地战斗仿佛已经刻进了它的基因。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME trains nonstop and learns to fight from the recordings of the most skillful fighters in history. Fighting without rest is in its DNA.

entry: POKENAME由最强格斗家们的基因融合创造而成，堪称格斗属性的化身。在公平的战斗中，它不会被击败。
author: milchik
source: Being created from DNA of the strongest fighters combined, POKENAME embodied the very aspect of fighting type. It can't be defeated in a fair combat.

entry: POKENAME球状的双手里，藏着所有宝可梦的基因。出拳时，能借来早已被遗忘的古老物种之力。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.

entry: POKENAME球状的双手里，藏着所有宝可梦的基因。出拳时，能借来早已被遗忘的古老物种之力。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.

entry: 可爱的性情，加上躯干花纹，让POKENAME备受喜爱。训练家伤心时，它也会想尽办法，让对方高兴。
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal
source: POKENAME is highly respected for its cute nature and the pattern on its torso. When its Trainer is sad, it tries everything it can to cheer them up.

entry: 它制造的圆球，包含所有宝可梦的精华。许多人认为，真正主导身体的，是那颗小头。
author: themicelegion
source: The orbs this Pokémon produces contains the essence of all Pokémon. Many believe the smaller head is the dominant one.

entry: 圆球中的胚胎，才是真正的POKENAME。外面的大个子，不过是由超能力凝成的躯体。
author: Toxicrown
source: The embryo within the orb is the true POKENAME. The larger creature is actually a psionic construct made from the Pokémon's psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME住在雪林深处，保护自己。若有旅人踏入森林，便用超能力，将幻象展现在对方面前。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME lives deep in snowy forests to protect itself. It uses its psychic powers to show illusions to wanderers who enter its forest.

entry: 研究人员推测，这种特殊的梦幻融合体，源于罕见的遗传异常。不过，POKENAME自己，似乎一切安好。
author: zic
source: Researchers speculate that this particular Mew fusion was the result of a rare genetic disorder. POKENAME seems to be perfectly fine, however.

entry: POKENAME凭强大的超能力，造出真假难辨的幻象，仿佛连地貌也随之变化。因此，能遇见它的人，少之又少。
author: T.I.A.
source: With tremendous psychic power, POKENAME seemingly morph the very land with convincing illusions. Because of this, encountering one is extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME在美的舞台上，名气很响。许多华丽大赛的明星，都曾从它身上取得灵感。
author: zic
source: POKENAME is very famous in the beauty scene. Many Contest superstars were inspired by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME超能力强大，能用意念移动物品。不过性情害羞，难得被人看见。
author: zic
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful psychic prowess that allows it to manipulate objects with its mind. It has a shy nature, so sightings are rare.

entry: 这只武器般的宝可梦，能运用超能力变形。它想学遍所有招式，成为最强的存在。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A psychic, shapeshifting weapon, this Pokémon aspires to become the strongest by learning every move.

entry: 它只在心地纯净的人面前现身，性情十分爱玩，似乎并不明白，自己的力量究竟有多强。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Appearing only to those of pure heart, it is a very playful Pokémon. It does not seem to grasp its level of power.

entry: 细胞里储存着，世界每一块陆地的资料。强劲的双手夹起泥土一压，便能造出任何矿物。
author: milchik
source: Its cells store the information about every landmass in the world. It can create any mineral by just pressing some soil between its powerful hands.

entry: POKENAME将神秘能量注入双翼时，空气中便会冒出，由未知物质构成的气泡。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings, bubbles of an unknown substance begin forming in the air.

entry: POKENAME会把神秘能量注入双翼。这一个体，拥有罕见的配色。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: 传说，一只受伤的梦幻被困在树中。树木为保护它而获得生命，围绕它继续生长，最终化成了POKENAME。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legends say that POKENAME originated from an injured Mew that got stuck in a tree, which came to life and grew around the Mew in order to protect it.

entry: 这只梦幻找到了把大脑连接到雷吉斯奇鲁的方法。即使是最聪明的宝可梦，也无法与它的脑力相比。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: A Mew that figured out how to connect its brain to a Registeel. Its brainpower is unmatched by even the smartest Pokémon.

entry: 看叶片般的尾巴，就能知道POKENAME的心情与健康。伤心、生病时，叶子会枯萎，严重时甚至会掉落。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's mood and overall health can be gleaned from its leaf tail: if it is sad or ill, the leaf wilts. In extreme cases, it may even fall off.

entry: POKENAME长久静候，用叶片的甜香引人靠近，再突然吓人一跳，笑着跑开。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME holds still for long periods of time, luring people close with its sweet smelling leaves. It then scares them and runs away laughing.

entry: 叶子一挥，便散出新鲜大麦的气息。叶片本身也极柔软，POKENAME常拿来作枕头。
author: .izik
source: When it waves its leaf, it lets loose the smell of fresh barley. The leaf itself is extremely soft and is used by POKENAME as a pillow.

entry: POKENAME欢欢喜喜地跑过田野。晴天遇见它，明朗的性情与含苞般的潜力，总让人不禁微笑。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME frolics through fields with boundless joy. Its cheerful demeanor and budding potential bring smiles to all who encounter it on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋入地下，只露头顶的叶子。科学家认为，它身体的构成，与多数种子十分相似。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME buries itself, only letting the leaf on its head to be shown. Scientists have said that its body has a similar composition to most seeds.

entry: POKENAME不爱打架，宁愿让刀刃的甜香，安抚对手。与钢刃不同，它的刃在阳光与水分滋养下，还能再生。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME would rather calm its opponent with its blade's sweet aroma than fight. Unlike steel, the blade regenerates in sunlight and moisture.

entry: 亲近训练家的POKENAME，会送出自己的花瓣。花瓣泡成茶，味道浓郁，还能安抚心绪。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME that have become close to their Trainers will give them their petals. These petals can be used to brew a tea that has a rich, calming flavor.

entry: POKENAME只在洁净的水域生活。阳光明媚时，常能看见它们在岸边晒太阳、打滚。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives exclusively in clean waters. When the sun is shining, they can be seen rolling around in the sun on the shore.

entry: 尾焰与头顶叶片，都能反映它的健康。可两者之间，也得小心保持距离。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，喜欢在落叶堆里玩。一到秋天，几乎到处都能看到POKENAME。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，喜欢在落叶堆里玩。一到秋天，几乎到处都能看到POKENAME。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.

entry: 尾焰与头顶叶片，都能反映它的健康。可两者之间，也得小心保持距离。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.

entry: 即使落下，叶片摸起来仍暖和。古代的医者，常拿来衬毯子，或制作敷药。
author: Staghorn
source: Its leaves are warm to the touch, even after they've been shed. Healers in ages past would use these leaves to line blankets and make poultices.

entry: POKENAME的气味，到底让人安逸，还是振奋？训练家们意见不一。有人猜测，这得看POKENAME本身的力量。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: Trainers are split on whether POKENAME’s scent makes them feel cozy or peppy. Some speculate it depends on how strong the POKENAME is.

entry: 白天，POKENAME钻进草丘下睡觉，头顶的叶子却会探出地面，吸收阳光。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME burrows itself under grassy knolls during the day to sleep. The leaf on its head will poke above ground and absorb the sun's rays.

entry: 它返祖成了，一种曾被认为已经消失的形态。POKENAME大部分时间都在睡觉，留着一只假眼，警戒四周。
author: barthandelus_real
source: It has reverted to an ancestral form once thought to be lost. POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, with a false eye on the lookout.

entry: POKENAME的香气，会悄悄勾起别人的战意。它自己倒乐得如此，毕竟，最爱与人决斗。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's scent subtly influences others to want to fight it, much to the joy to POKENAME, as it likes to duel.

entry: 花瓣的清香，能安抚周围的生物。可猎物一放松警惕，POKENAME便会凶狠地痛下杀手。
author: gellyfishsh
source: It uses the soothing scent from its petals to calm those around it. Once its prey has let its guard down, POKENAME brutally goes for the kill.

entry: 即使严寒至极，它身上的植物也不会枯萎。POKENAME踏过的地方，鲜花便随之生长。
author: milchik
source: The plant parts of its body never wither, even in the extreme cold. Wherever POKENAME steps, the flowers grow.

entry: 感到受威胁，POKENAME便会挥动尾巴上，装满花粉的花朵，猛击敌人。纤细的触角，也能替它找到同伴。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will punch enemies with the pollen-filled flowers on its tails. It uses its delicate antennae to locate its allies.

entry: 别看POKENAME块头超大，有了超缤纷的翅膀，速度超快，动作也超灵活。可惜，偏偏不能超级进化。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is mega-fast and mega-agile thanks to its mega-colorful wings, despite how mega-bulky it looks. Unfortunately, it can't Mega Evolve.

entry: POKENAME水陆两栖，一天要吃一吨以上的植物。为了不抢同类的食物，它们也总互相避开。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives amphibiously and feeds on over a ton of plant food a day. To avoid eating other POKENAME's food, they avoid each other.

entry: 这只融合体，自认是统御其他宝可梦的高傲君主，尤其以那对小胡子般的触角为荣。
author: JaycieLantern
source: This fusion sees itself as a proud ruler over other Pokémon. It is particularly proud of its antennae that resemble a mustache.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃散发令人平静的气味，让对手更容易被它斩杀。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits an odor that calms opponents, making them easy victims to slay.

entry: 农民把POKENAME视为丰收的象征。据说，它巡游乡野时，便能让枯萎的庄稼与植物，重获生机。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Known by farmers as a symbol of the harvest, POKENAME are said to roam the countryside, reviving crops and plants that have withered.

entry: POKENAME用花瓣与触手，演出绚丽的节目，在华丽大赛中十分受欢迎。可它的墨镜从何而来，仍没人知道。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: POKENAME is a favorite in Contests for its ability to make dazzling displays with its petals and tentacles. The origin of its shades is unknown.

entry: POKENAME奔腾而过的地方，鲜花会随之盛开。它们的火焰散播的灰烬，能为各类植物提供养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: Flowers bloom where NAME gallop. The ashes their fire spreads give nutrients to all kinds of flora.

entry: 成群的POKENAME迁徙世界各地，用能量唤回遭毁生态的生机，也给园丁带来好运。
author: kittyluv090
source: Herds of POKENAME migrate across the world, using their energy to breathe life back into destroyed ecosystems. They bring good fortune to gardeners.

entry: 春日花开时，常能看见POKENAME。摆锤散出的香气，连枯萎的植物，也能重新唤活。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME is commonly spotted among blooming flowers in the springtime. It exudes an aroma from its pendulum that can revitalize even withered plants.

entry: POKENAME让尾巴燃起火焰，保护自己。平时为防御分泌的毒膜，也正是火焰的燃料。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME protects itself by igniting flames from its tail, fueled by the toxic film it secretes for defense.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，可一受威胁，便会挥起火焰般的长发，抽打来敌。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Though a timid Pokémon by nature, POKENAME will attack by whipping its hairs of flame when threatened.

entry: 只要聚上一批POKENAME，就足够让小村庄暖和起来。抱着一只，还能治好失温症。
author: Neonriser
source: An armory of POKENAME is enough to keep a small village warm. Hugging one can cure hypothermia.

entry: POKENAME借背后的火焰推进，踢出猛烈的跳跃攻击，也能用同样本领，让自己跑得更快。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME uses the flames on its back to propel itself forward in wild jump kicks. It can also use this ability to run faster.

entry: 火球鼠怒极，超越极限而死时，POKENAME便会从体内迸出。这些宝可梦，极难约束。
author: mrbapcik
source: If an angry Cyndaquil goes beyond its limits and perishes, POKENAME bursts out of its body. These are highly uncontrollable Pokémon.

entry: 火与灰的精灵POKENAME，在空地间飞掠。火焰摇曳的姿态，让旁观者看得入迷。
author: togetik
source: Sprites of fire and ash, POKENAME whisk around open areas, entrancing watchers with their fiery quiver.

entry: 刀刃上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its blade's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: 护手上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its guard's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: 受到威胁，尾焰就会明亮燃起。战斗时，它们还会点燃飘带，抽向敌人。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The flames on its tail burn brightly when threatened. When fighting, they will enflame their ribbons and lash them out against their foes.

entry: 每隔一千年，愿望之火便会唤醒POKENAME。据说，它能以纯净的火焰，实现一个愿望。
author: Abhatu
source: Once every thousand years, the flames of desire will awaken POKENAME. It is said to make true one wish through the flames of purity.

entry: POKENAME组成庞大的家族，成群睡在果树上。有时饭吃到一半，就又打起了瞌睡。
author: mrbapcik
source: Flocks of POKENAME sleep on fruit trees and sometimes doze off right in the middle of a meal. These Pokémon live in large families.

entry: 它从身体两侧喷火，既能护身，也能提供推力，让自己飞在空中。
author: Abhatu
source: It emits flames from its sides to fly and protect itself. The flames serve as propulsion to keep it aloft.

entry: 从前，三只小火球鼠为了让火焰更旺，便一同埋进土里。如今，火焰已经大得，像火暴兽一般。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Three little Cyndaquils once buried themselves together in order to make their flames burn brighter. They now have a Typhlosion-sized flame.

entry: 它身形虽适合游水，却偏偏不爱下水，宁可在陆地上慢慢挪动，也就更容易，遭到天敌袭击。
author: VaporVenator
source: Despite its hydrodynamic form, it does not enjoy swimming. As it chooses to move sluggishly on land, it is left vulnerable to predators.

entry: 它性情胆小，可要留神！POKENAME一转身，背上的火焰，就可能朝你喷来。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: It has a timid disposition, but watch out! If POKENAME turns away from you, it's likely to blast you with fire from its back.

entry: POKENAME喷出的火，远高于华氏10000度。散发的热量太过惊人，让训练家也觉得，实在难以照料。
author: theartemis1
source: The fires erupting from POKENAME are well above 10,000 ℉. Trainers often find it difficult to manage this Pokémon due to the immense heat it radiates.

entry: POKENAME喷出的火，远高于华氏10000度。散发的热量太过惊人，让训练家也觉得，实在难以照料。
author: theartemis1
source: The fires erupting from POKENAME are well above 10,000 ℉. Trainers often find it difficult to manage this Pokémon due to the immense heat it radiates.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，为刀刃增添了可怕威力。战斗时，火势迸发，释放强烈的热量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable addition to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: 除了刀刃，POKENAME的火焰，也是有力的第二重防护。战斗时，火焰猛燃，放出强烈的热量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable secondary defense to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: 它的毛发，完全不会燃烧。不过，身体某些部位会分泌油，让火焰熊熊燃起，驱赶天敌。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its fur is completely non-flammable; however, it secretes an oil into certain parts of its body to engulf them in flames to ward off predators.

entry: 这只小宝可梦喜欢独处。一受威胁，身上的火焰便会高高蹿起。
author: themicelegion
source: This small Pokémon likes to be alone. If it is threatened, the flames on its body will flare up.

entry: 它在陆地上蹦跳着走，产生热量。POKENAME再用这股能量点燃尾巴，从背后袭击敌人。
author: VaporVenator
source: It moves on land by bouncing around, producing heat energy. POKENAME uses this energy to ignite its tail and attack foes from behind.

entry: 火山地带常能看见POKENAME晒太阳。它会把身体藏进熔岩，等待经过的宝可梦，伺机捕杀。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME can be found basking in volcanic regions. It shrouds itself in lava and waits to hunt passerby Pokémon.

entry: 森林大火中，常能见到这只虫宝可梦，猎捕无力抵抗的猎物。发怒时，毒刺还会烧得通红。
author: puppetmaster64
source: This insect is often seen hunting defenseless prey during forest fires. Its stingers are known to grow red hot when angered.

entry: POKENAME是一只走上了不同进化道路的火暴兽。蓝色火焰炽热无比，连站在附近的训练家，都曾被灼伤。
author: thisisaplaceholder
source: POKENAME is a Typhlosion that evolved a bit differently. Its blue fire is intensely hot, so hot that Trainers have gotten burns by standing near it.

entry: 为了精进控火技巧，POKENAME总寻找更强劲的对手，常与喷火龙，结为激烈竞争的宿敌。
author: ratmerchant
source: In order to perfect its fiery skills, POKENAME seeks much tougher opponents to challenge. It will often becomes fierce rivals with Charizard.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在活跃的蒸汽间歇泉旁嬉戏，或泡在温泉里，吸收火山带来的养分。
author: weedspagon_real
source: POKENAME love playing around active steam geysers, or bathing in hot springs to absorb volcanic nutrients.

entry: 这只宝可梦脾气暴躁得很，强烈的能量喷发，甚至能在头顶形成雷暴。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is extremely hot-tempered. Its powerful eruptions of energy can create thunderstorms above it.

entry: 它们在地下开凿隧道，常被视为火山喷发的罪魁。嘴里会喷出易燃气体，发怒时便将其点燃。
author: HummusIsHome
source: They are often blamed for volcanic eruptions as they tunnel through the earth. They emit flammable gas from their mouths which ignites when enraged.

entry: 它是英勇的英雄，愿为所珍视的生命，付出自己的一切。可调用的力量越多，背上十字形的火焰，就越会灼烧自己的灵魂。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A valiant hero who would give its life to save those it cares for. The cross flames on its back burn through its soul the more power it calls for.

entry: 即使没有燃着火，POKENAME灼热的刀刃，也能点着碰到的任何东西。接触的一瞬间，甚至可能引发爆炸。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The heat of POKENAME's blade ignites anything it touches, even when it isn't aflame. On contact, it can even generate explosions.

entry: 怒气达到顶点时，POKENAME会摩擦飘带，激起巨大的爆炸。训练家若进入它的栖息地，务必提高警惕。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When its rage peaks, POKENAME will rub their ribbons together to create large explosions. Trainers should be weary if they enter their habitat.

entry: 它把尾巴浸入熔岩池，与其他POKENAME比赛耐力。身经百战的个体，尾巴已完全由岩浆构成。
author: char_latte3412
source: It tests its endurance by sinking its tail into pools of lava, competing against other POKENAME. The tails of veterans are entirely composed of magma.

entry: POKENAME以火焰替代双翼，能将敌人灼伤。可火声有时，也会让它分不清方向。
author: Canada
source: In place of wings, POKENAME is coated in fire, allowing it to burn foes. However, the sound of the flames sometimes cause it to get disoriented.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞胆怯，情绪却常以真正的爆炸宣泄出来。每逢发作，都必须格外小心。
author: dagoth.lluna
source: Though shy and timid by nature, POKENAME will often let its emotions out in a truly explosive manner. Extreme care is required during these outbursts.

entry: 它们为争夺领地，以猛烈的爆炸互斗。这样的决斗极危险，最好只在远处观察。
author: VaporVenator
source: They battle one another for territory using violent explosive attacks. These duels are extremely hazardous, and should only be observed from afar.

entry: POKENAME喜欢下雨时，在水坑里嬉戏。可一兴奋，就容易不小心放电。
author: ProjectAlpha22
source: POKENAME likes to play in puddles during the rain. Unfortunately, when it gets excited, it also tends to let out an electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴当作气泵，弹跳着前进。偶尔却忘了自己有这本领，只会望着脚下，不敢往下跳。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME uses its tail as an air pump to bounce to places. Sometimes it forgets that it can do this and stares at the ground, afraid to jump down.

entry: 在水中，它们用强劲的大颚咬住猎物，再以触须将其牢牢固定。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: In the water, they will snap their powerful jaws down on prey and hold them in place with their feelers.

entry: POKENAME一咬住猎物，便利用对方挣扎产生的静电，将它彻底制服。
author: mx_wellman
source: Once POKENAME have clamped their teeth onto their prey, they use the static generated as it tries to wrestle free to subdue it.

entry: POKENAME如蛇一般，优雅穿行河道。强大的颚与龙之本能，让它不论水里、陆地，都是可怕的猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME glides through rivers with serpentine grace. Its powerful jaws and dragon-like instincts make it a formidable hunter in both land and water.

entry: 妙蛙种子在陆地上走得慢，POKENAME却有翅膀，能四处飞行。到了冬天，双翼还可帮助POKENAME保暖。
author: themadcactus
source: While Bulbasaur is known to walk slowly on land, POKENAME uses its wings to fly around. These wings also help keep POKENAME warm during the winter.

entry: 野生POKENAME常出没于森林边缘，既能攀附树干，也能飞越细枝，在林间活动十分方便。
author: themadcactus
source: Wild POKENAME are frequently found on the outskirts of forests, having the advantage of both sticking to the sides of trees and flying across twigs.

entry: POKENAME高飞林上，枝叶般的树冠投下绿荫。沿途散播种子与花粉，飞到哪里，哪里便添生机。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME soars high above the forests, casting shade with its leafy canopy. It disperses seeds and pollen, fostering life wherever it flies.

entry: POKENAME总忍不住，把能找到的食物都吃进去。食物紧缺时，又会找来需要帮助的宝可梦，反刍出来，与它们分享。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME can't help gorging itself on every source of food it can find. In lean times, it finds Pokémon in need and regurgitates food to share.

entry: 野生POKENAME没有四肢，远行全靠丝线。雨雪天里，羽毛非但没帮上忙，反而妨碍行动。
author: themadcactus
source: Possessing no limbs, wild POKENAME rely on string to move large distances. The feathers inhibit it during rain or snow, giving little advantage.

entry: POKENAME在枯叶间捕虫。可谁若想窥看藤蔓底下的模样，就会遭它愤怒啄击。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME hunts for insects among dead leaves. It will furiously peck at anyone who tries to see what lies under its vines.

entry: 这只宝可梦用细枝与丝线筑巢。谁敢偷POKENAME的蛋，最终都会落入丝网，动弹不得。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon makes its nests out of sticks and strings. Any Pokémon that tries to steal a POKENAME's eggs will end up stuck in a web.

entry: 这种融合体的羽毛，对波波极具吸引力。科学家担心，这会干扰它们原本的求偶习性。
author: kiwikelly
source: This fusion's plumage is highly attractive to other Pidgey. Scientists worry this will negatively impact their courting rituals.

entry: POKENAME太胖，根本飞不起来，只好在树根附近的洞穴中筑巢。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is too fat to fly. It makes its nest in burrows at the base of trees.

entry: 它们结成大群出行，彼此保护。飞行不太在行，双翼与尾羽，便多半用来吸引伴侣。
author: cait_sith
source: It travels in large herds for protection. It is bad at flying, so it typically uses its wings and tail feathers to attract mates instead.

entry: POKENAME空中动作快又灵活，飞来飞去，从不在同一个地方久留。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is fast and agile in the air. It flies from place to place, never staying in one spot.

entry: 这是新手训练家常用的融合宝可梦。POKENAME好训练，还喜欢找来树果，与训练家分享。
author: VaporVenator
source: A fusion used commonly by beginner Trainers. POKENAME are generally easy to train and enjoy searching for Berries to share with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME靠高超的偷窃本领，在野外生存。双脚跑得快，遇事又能振翅飞走。
author: omegarockster
source: POKENAME relies on its excellent thievery to survive in the wild. It uses its quick feet to run around, and it uses its wings to fly away.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的爪子攀住树干，长长的脖子则方便它迅速出手，轻松捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to trees with its sharp talons. Its long neck allows it hunt for its prey with speed and ease.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会伸展双翼，发出响亮嗡鸣。被追逐的猎物，也因此很容易察觉它。
author: .izik
source: When flying, POKENAME extends its wings and unleashes a loud buzzing noise. This makes it very noticeable to the prey it chases.

entry: 身体长大后，POKENAME需要更多能量，便长出更锋利的喙，比起空中，更优先在陆地狩猎。
author: themadcactus
source: POKENAME's require more energy in their larger bodies, so they have developed sharper beaks and prioritize hunting on land than in the skies.

entry: POKENAME主要清晨活动，寻找筑巢的细枝。双翼也能帮它，躲开天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily active in the morning when looking for twigs for its nest. Its wings allow it to evade predators.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力加快奔跑。从小就会练习念力，隔空摘取灌木上的树果。
author: .izik
source: It uses its psychic abilities to run faster. POKENAME starts mastering its telekinetic powers at a young age by lifting Berries from bushes.

entry: POKENAME爱互相恶作剧，逗对方笑。可看着越不买账，其实，越喜欢那个笑话。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME play pranks on each other to make each other laugh. The less amused they appear to be, the more they actually enjoyed the joke.

entry: 翅膀已经退化，太小，托不起野生POKENAME。它便靠更利的喙、更敏锐的双眼，在陆地寻找猎物。
author: themadcactus
source: The wings are a vestigial structure, too small to support wild POKENAME. POKENAME have sharper beaks and keener eyes to seek prey on land.

entry: 它用飘带与喙翻找种子。性情温顺，训练也容易，很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It uses both its ribbons and beak to look for seeds to eat. It is popular among rookie Trainers for its docile nature and ease of training.

entry: 野生POKENAME的羽毛完全不怕火，可研究人员发现，皮肤虽不会燃烧，却依然会灼伤。
author: themadcactus
source: The feathers of a wild POKENAME are completely immune to fire. Researchers found that the skin of the creature, while not flammable, can be burnt.

entry: POKENAME不怕高，能在枝头爬行。背上的真菌不断吸走养分，害它总得四处找吃的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is not afraid of heights and crawls over branches. It is in constant search of food, as the fungi on its back slowly extract its nutrients.

entry: 长而宽的喙，方便它从灌木摘取树果。采好之后，还会用尾巴，慢慢烤熟。
author: themadcactus
source: The long, wide beak easily allows this Pokémon to gather Berries from bushes with ease. It uses its tail to roast the gathered Berries.

entry: 据说，雾蒙蒙的清晨，这只鸟宝可梦飞过时，尾巴宛如明灯，能将迷路的旅人引到避风处。
author: themadcactus
source: When this bird Pokémon is seen flying on foggy mornings, it is said that its tail acts as a beacon for lost travelers, leading them towards shelter.

entry: 野生POKENAME会收集自己换下的羽毛筑巢。羽毛不像细枝那样易燃，更为安全。
author: themadcactus
source: Wild POKENAME often molt their own feathers and use them for dens because they won't catch fire the way twigs do.

entry: 长出爪子后，它便用爪子摘取树果。厚皮的，还会先剥去外皮，再拿去烤。
author: themadcactus
source: Having developed claws, this Pokémon will take Berries from bushes with their claws, peeling Berries with thicker skins before roasting them.

entry: 光靠双翼，托不起POKENAME，可肺里始终充满热气，让身体比本该有的重量，更轻一些。
author: themadcactus
source: A POKENAME's wings cannot support it alone, but its lungs are constantly filled with hot air, making it lighter than it should be.

entry: 它们常与烈雀住在相似的地方。面对凶猛的啄击，只须缩到壳后，以壳当盾。
author: themadcactus
source: These Pokémon are known to occupy similar lands as Spearow. To defend against their fierce pecks, they simply use their shells as shields.

entry: POKENAME凶暴至极，若在城市下水道安家，便会给在那里工作的维修人员，惹来大麻烦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is aggressive in the extreme, and when it makes its home in city sewers, it causes a huge problem for the technicians working there.

entry: 速度比看起来快得多。POKENAME一抓住猎物，就拖入水中，自身体温，早把周围的水煮得沸腾。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is quicker than it looks like. Once it catches its prey, POKENAME drags it under the water that boils around it because of its body heat.

entry: POKENAME能轻易操纵水与电，常用水为自己做出拳套，里面闪动着电流。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can effortlessly control both water and electricity. It often crafts itself boxing gloves made of water, sparking with electrical currents.

entry: 外貌虽吓人，它却只是温柔的大个子。遇险时，会让帆状部分发光，分散敌人的注意。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: Despite its intimidating appearance, it is just a gentle giant. When in danger, it will use the light from its sail to distract enemies.

entry: 它用四条腿走路，喜欢闲待河岸，捉些鱼宝可梦吃。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: This Pokémon likes to chill on the riverbank and catch fish Pokémon for food. It walks on four legs.

entry: 融合让大力鳄变得稍矮、更胖。体格虽不如以前，POKENAME却得到了强大的超能力。
author: mirby
source: This fusion resulted in a slightly shorter, portlier Feraligatr. While its physique has been reduced, POKENAME now possesses strong psychic abilities.

entry: 听见敌人靠近，它就会跑进高草丛。强劲的后腿，也能让它迅速冲刺。
author: .izik
source: Should it hear an enemy approaching, it will run into a patch of tall grass. It can dash at high speeds by using its hind legs.

entry: POKENAME被称为天空的哨兵，常在巢穴周围巡飞，大声尖叫，吓退带来威胁的宝可梦。
author: SentretVStar
source: Often called the sentry of the sky, POKENAME often flies around the area near its nest. It shrieks loudly to scare away any threatening Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴掘地。若周围地势太崎岖，挖不进去，它就会闹别扭。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME uses its tail to burrow into the ground. It gets upset if the terrain around it is too rough for it to dig into.

entry: 它们会侦察来敌。一找到目标，就会几只一起，全力出击。
author: themicelegion
source: They scout for incoming foes. Once they have a target, several of them attack the enemy with all they have.

entry: 冰寒地区，POKENAME群落十分常见。它们在冰里挖出洞穴，日常大部分时间，都待在里面。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME colonies are very common in icy areas. They make burrows in the ice and that is where POKENAME spends most of their time.

entry: 有人在衣柜里发现POKENAME，偷拿衣架做耳朵。可那条尾巴，究竟从哪儿来的，没人知道。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: People have found POKENAME in their closet taking hangers for their ears. No one knows where it got its tail from.

entry: POKENAME神经紧绷，哪怕摸摸柔软的双臂，也会发抖。厚毛本是为锁住空气，帮它在冷水中保暖。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is very high-strung, so it shivers if you pet its soft arms. The thick fur is actually meant to seal in air to warm it in cold waters.

entry: POKENAME会寻找熟睡的人，认真守在身边。带着它的训练家，每晚都能睡得安稳、放心。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME seeks out those who are sleeping and diligently guards them. Trainers with this Pokémon are guaranteed a safe and restful sleep every night.

entry: POKENAME会用大鳍肢，在海滩附近挖洞筑巢。年幼的POKENAME，还爱拿长尾巴泼水，逗弄游泳的人。
author: crusaderzakk
source: POKENAME nest near beaches where they dig holes with their large flippers. Young POKENAME will playfully splash swimmers with their long tails.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，超过全身长度的一半。它总不停寻找，更大的壳来居住。
author: crusaderzakk
source: A POKENAME has a tail that measures more than half of its body length. It is constantly hunting for a bigger shell to live in.

entry: POKENAME栖身的壳十分沉重，行动也不快，便靠尾巴和多出的手臂捕捉食物。
author: crusaderzakk
source: The shell that POKENAME resides in is very heavy. Since it is not very swift, it uses its tail and extra arms to catch food.

entry: POKENAME用头顶的尾巴，像旋翼一样飞行。尾巴较长的个体，比短尾的飞得更快，也更灵活。
author: Gummy Wookie
source: POKENAME uses its head tails as rotor blades to fly. Longer-tailed POKENAME are quicker and more maneuverable than their smaller-tailed variants.

entry: POKENAME用头顶的尾巴，像旋翼一样飞行。尾巴较短的个体，比长尾的飞得慢，也不够灵活。
author: Gummy Wookie
source: POKENAME uses its head tails as rotor blades to fly. Smaller-tailed POKENAME are slower and less maneuverable than their longer-tailed variants.

entry: 它们会挖出蜿蜒漫长、足有几英里的地道。连岩石与混凝土，也照挖不误，实在不适合家养。
author: Staghorn
source: POKEMON dig long snaking burrows that can stretch for miles. They can dig through stone and concrete, making them terrible pets.

entry: POKENAME对水中污染极敏感，唯有洁净海洋，才能让它生活得好。聚在一起休息时，像极了一座巨大珊瑚礁。
author: crusaderzakk
source: POKENAME are sensitive to pollution in the water and thrive in clean oceans. When they gather to rest, they give the appearance of giant coral reef.

entry: POKENAME无聊时，便找毫无防备的宝可梦，用蓄着静电的尾尖，挠得对方发痒。
author: Phantom640
source: If bored, POKENAME will often look for unsuspecting Pokémon and tickle them with the tip of its tail using the static electricity stored inside of it.

entry: POKENAME虽被束缚在楔石上，身体却足够长，能伸到离楔石30米远的地方。
author: admiralvermin
source: Although bound to a keystone, its long body makes up for it. POKENAME is able to stretch up to 30 meters away from where its keystone is located.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: 皮肤虽会分泌阻燃的油，长得飞快的毛，却极其干燥，一点就燃。
author: mx_wellman
source: Although its skin secretes a fire-retardant oil, its quick-growing fur is actually incredibly dry and highly flammable.

entry: 谁试着把大尾立从齿轮中拉出来，都会被抓伤。它不是卡住，只是不想走。
author: missingmilkman
source: Anyone who has attempted to remove the Furret from the gears has been scratched. It's not stuck, it just doesn't want to leave.

entry: 它喜欢炫耀优雅、灵活的身姿。遇上心仪的伴侣，便会跳起精巧而繁复的求偶之舞。
author: cait_sith
source: It loves to show off its graceful and nimble moves. If it encounters a potential mate, it will perform an elaborate courting dance.

entry: POKENAME摸着虽不像，其实有毛。只是分泌物把毛粘在一起，看着反倒像一团黏液。
author: Endermagnet
source: Despite what it feels like, POKENAME actually does have fur. However, the substance it secretes sticks its fur together, so it resembles goo instead.

entry: POKENAME刚被收服时，多半害羞。可与训练家亲近后，就会永远粘着不走——可是真的粘着，黏液像胶水一样！
author: Zeeroooo
source: POKENAME is often shy when first caught, but when it bonds with its Trainer it will stick with them forever. Quite literally—its slime is like glue!

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。聪明的家伙，会爬上POKENAME干燥的壳，躲过这些拥抱。
author: Endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. Clever Pokémon can hide from these hugs on POKENAME's dry shell.

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。研究人员认为，带条纹的壳，也许是另一条卷起的尾巴。
author: Endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. Researchers believe the striped shell may be a second, furled tail.

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。结果，竟有出人意料之多的小家伙，就这样被粘在POKENAME身上。
author: Endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. A surprising number of these Pokémon get stuck to POKENAME.

entry: 覆在毛上的蜜，能让人恢复活力，含糖少，味道又好。研究人员也记录过，POKENAME与生病的宝可梦，分享蜂蜜。
author: Endermagnet
source: The honey coating its fur is rejuvenating, low in sugar and extra tasty. Researchers have documented POKENAME sharing this honey with unwell Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的毛又软又暖。它们不知疲倦地走在严寒中，为迷路的人类与宝可梦，送去温暖。
author: enderwarlock
source: POKENAME fur is extremely soft and warm. These large Pokémon tirelessly walk in frigid environments to provide warmth to lost Pokémon and people.

entry: POKENAME散发着喇叭芽喜爱的甜香，常多带一只喇叭芽，以防耳朵上那只，哪天掉下来。
author: crusaderzakk
source: POKENAME exudes a sweet smell that Bellsprout love. It always carries an extra Bellsprout around in case the one on its ear falls off.

entry: 它来回摆尾，引导自身力量。蓄够精神能量之后，便一波波释放出去。
author: .izik
source: It wags its tail back and forth to channel its powers. Once it builds up enough psychic energy, it will unleash it in waves.

entry: POKENAME很亲人，可古怪的模样，总让人退避。没什么朋友，它也常为此伤心。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is very affectionate, but many people are repelled by its uncanny appearance. It often feels sad due to its lack of friends.

entry: 托儿所常能看见POKENAME，陪孩子们消磨时光，一起画画、游戏，还能造出彩虹。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often are seen at daycares keeping children occupied. It paints, plays, and makes rainbows with them.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跳过田野与花园，不停寻找能吃的果实、种子，以及小型虫宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hops through fields and gardens at night. It is constantly on the lookout for edible fruits, seeds, or small bug Pokémon.

entry: 入夜，它轻轻咕鸣，让同类知道四下安全。叫声若停，就说明，危险已近。
author: .izik
source: During the night, it lets out a soft hoot to let others of its kind know it is safe. If the hooting ceases, danger is nearby.

entry: 它夜里总忍不住叫，反而暴露位置，引来天敌。只得慌忙从一棵树飞到另一棵树，寻找安全处。
author: .izik
source: It hoots involuntarily at night, letting predators know of its location. It frantically flies from tree to tree, hoping to find safety.

entry: 它把家安在废弃实验室的梁上，模仿其他咕咕群的模样，想借此求偶。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in rafters of abandoned laboratories. It will mimic the appearance of other Hoothoot flocks in an attempt to mate.

entry: POKENAME体内的时间感紊乱，弄不清自己该白天活动，还是夜里活动，总疲倦又困惑。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's internal sense of time is disordered, so it doesn't know if it should be diurnal or nocturnal. It is thus always tired and confused.

entry: POKENAME靠出色的目力，在夜里捕猎其他小拉达融合体。若没抓着，便会沮丧地大声尖叫。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME uses its great vision to hunt other Rattata fusions at night. If it fails to catch its prey, it lets out loud, frustrated shrieks.

entry: 背上时钟般的突起，始终滴答作响。POKENAME每隔十五分钟，准时咕鸣一声。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The clock-like growth on its back is constantly ticking. POKENAME emits cooing sounds at intervals of exactly fifteen minutes.

entry: 体内时钟精准得惊人，有些训练家，便把POKENAME当作闹钟。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon has an amazing internal clock. Some Trainers use POKENAME as an alarm clock.

entry: POKENAME能记住夜里听见的每一种声音。白天再模仿出来，常把训练家吓一跳。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME can remember each sound it hears at night. When it mimics them during the day, many Trainers feel spooked.

entry: 它用外表骗过毫无防备的咕咕，再将其捕食。野生POKENAME虽能飞，却很少起飞。
author: mx_wellman
source: It preys on unsuspecting Hoothoot, which it fools with its appearance. Despite being capable of flight, wild POKENAME rarely do so.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的耳朵，能自由转动，倾听危险。特殊器官还能感知星球自转，让POKENAME始终报时准确。
author: Essie
source: Male POKENAME ears can move freely to listen for danger. A special organ lets POKENAME keep perfect time based on the planet's rotation.

entry: 这只锤状宝可梦多半悬在原地，只随一天中的时刻转动，让手柄像时钟的时针一样指示时间。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This mace Pokémon floats in a mostly stationary position, rotating with the time of day so its handle corresponds to an analog clock's hour hand.

entry: 融合让咕咕的时间感，更加敏锐，如今连身边生命的死亡日期，也能察觉。可它很少，将这件事说出来。
author: admiralvermin
source: Fusion has enhanced Hoothoot's ability to sense time, and it can now sense the date of death of anyone around it. It rarely shares this information.

entry: 透明的腹部中，器官组成了POKENAME时钟的指针，永远显示准确的时间。
author: milchik
source: The hands of POKENAME's clock are made of organs visible through its transparent belly. It always shows the correct time.

entry: 它在黑暗中也能轻松看清东西。使用念力时，双眼会短暂泛起紫光。
author: .izik
source: It can see in darkness without much effort. When it uses its psychokinetic abilities, its eyes will glow purple for a short period.

entry: 它懒洋洋、呆乎乎的，却很受林间访客欢迎。无论路过的宝可梦还是训练家，它都乐意上前依偎。
author: moopse
source: This lazy, dopey-looking Pokémon is a welcome sight in the forest, as it is more than happy to cuddle up to any passing Pokémon or Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的时间感能精确到秒。可这与背上时钟般的突起究竟有何联系，尚未得到充分研究。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a sense of timing to the second. The connection between this and the clock-like growth on its back has not yet been adequately studied.

entry: POKENAME通常白天睡觉，夜里才活动。不过，无论何时，都至少有一颗头保持清醒，警戒四周。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME often sleeps through the day, being primarily active at night. However, at least one head is always awake to keep an eye out.

entry: 它虽然不会飞，却偏爱藏在树上。可身体太沉，树枝也常被压断。
author: themicelegion
source: Although it doesn't have the ability to fly, it loves to hide in trees. The problem is that it is too heavy for the branches, causing them to fall.

entry: POKENAME背上的表盘，并不显示当下时间，真正用途仍未查明。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The dial on POKENAME's back does not show the current time. Its actual purpose has not yet been determined.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有力，头角带毒，视力也极好。别看体型庞大，动作却敏捷得惊人。
author: Essie
source: POKENAME have powerful tails, venomous horns, and superb vision. Despite their bulk, POKENAME are surprisingly agile.

entry: POKENAME无声掠过夜空，吸取身下生物梦中的能量，存进红色旋涡，留作攻击之用。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME floats silently through the night, siphoning energy from the dreams of those it flies over and storing it in red cyclones to use for attacks.

entry: 这只融合体虽不是超能力属性，却颇有精神力量的天分。有人推测，它体内深处藏着某种诡异力量。
author: JaycieLantern
source: Despite not being a Psychic type, this fusion shows an aptitude for psionic abilities. Some theorize some eldritch power lies deep within it.

entry: POKENAME举止天生优雅，能迷惑、击败敌人。据说，它在夜里更快，白天则更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME exhibits effortless grace in its displays to enchant and defeat foes. It is said to be swifter at night and stronger in the day.

entry: POKENAME常静静漂浮夜空。大而圆的身体，吸引当地的咕咕聚来，把它视为守护者。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME can often be seen floating quietly in the night sky. These large, round Pokémon attract local Hoothoot, who see it as a guardian.

entry: POKENAME翼上的眼睛是真是假，至今无定论。有人坚称看见它们动过，也有人觉得，只是骗人的把戏。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is unknown if the eyes on POKENAME's wings are real or not. Some people swear that they've seen them move, while others consider it a hoax.

entry: 太阳刚触及地平线，它便会醒来，立刻开始吃叶子，直到填饱肚子。
author: .izik
source: It awakens the moment the sun hits the horizon. Once up, it immediately begins eating leaves until its belly is full.

entry: 它一看见日出，便会吹响口哨。日光似乎滋养着身体，让它开心地前后摇摆。
author: .izik
source: It lets out a whistle when it spots a sunrise. The sunlight seems to nourish its body, causing it to sway back and forth with delight.

entry: POKENAME有圆点花纹，又能进化成多种姿态，很受虫属性爱好者喜爱。若送它橙橙果，它会十分高兴。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's polka dot pattern and many evolutions make it very popular among bug type enthusiasts. It welcomes Oran Berries as gifts.

entry: POKENAME织的网，形似星辰。每只POKENAME的网，还有独属于自己的气味。
author: Gotfyr
source: POKENAME spin webs that take the appearance of stars. Each web has a unique scent tied to each individual POKENAME.

entry: 野外难得看见POKENAME。它们的网由许多星形图案组成，会在繁星满天的夜晚，微微发亮。
author: @Gotfyr
source: POKENAME are a rare site in the wild. Their webs consist of a multiple star shaped patterns that glow under a starry night sky.

entry: 这种长着蓝色角的POKENAME更加罕见。据传，在同类中，蓝角个体享有最高的地位。
author: @Gotfyr
source: These blue horned variants of POKENAME are an even rarer find. It is rumored that those with blue horns have the most authority over other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME漂过时，沿途留下一缕芳香液体。人们常误以为是灵质，其实，那是召唤同类的信息素。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME leaves a trail of aromatic liquid as it floats along. Often mistaken for ectoplasm, it's actually a pheromone to call others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME平时很胆小，冷了便靠积蓄的电力取暖，性情也可能随之变得凶猛。
author: zedsmith64
source: POKENAME is usually a very timid Pokémon. However, when it gets cold, it warms itself with stored electricity and can become quite aggressive.

entry: 尾巴上的小小形状，能引来饥饿的飞行宝可梦。一靠得够近，POKENAME便扑上去，以电击迎敌。
author: .realthree
source: The small shape on POKENAME's tail attracts hungry Flying-type Pokémon. Once close enough, POKENAME pounces and attacks with its electricity.

entry: POKENAME本无恶意，只想在繁盛花田里好好休息。可回头才发现，身边的草木，竟都被自己踩坏了。
author: char_latte3412
source: It doesn't mean any harm; however, POKENAME will often relax in vibrant flower fields only to find that it has trampled all vegetation around it.

entry: 它常独自行走，谨慎又容易受惊。可一旦聚成罕见的小群，便会露出严酷凶残的一面。
author: char_latte3412
source: It often travels alone, cautious and easily startled. However, amidst rarely-seen packs, it reveals a harsh, brutal demeanor.

entry: 据说，被它的岩刺扎中，也会变成POKENAME。迷信的人，便随身带着新鲜柑橘，以求护身。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is said that those stabbed by its rock spike will turn into a POKENAME themselves. The superstitious will carry fresh citrus to protect themselves.

entry: 它靠眼睛分泌的芳香液体交流。健康又快乐的POKENAME，甚至会被液体整个包裹。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: It communicates using the aromatic fluid it secretes from its eyes. A happy and healthy POKENAME will be fully encompassed by this fluid.

entry: POKENAME容易受惊，谁吓到它，就拿小手套般的摆锤去敲。可这点力气，几乎伤不到谁。
author: noel5229
source: Easily rattled, POKENAME whacks anything that startles it with its little glove pendulum. The whacks barely do any damage, however.

entry: 大多数POKENAME都懂得，该战则战，该退则退。轻巧的身体，让它一边避开攻击，一边不断还击。
author: entomoxie
source: Most POKENAME use their fight-or-flight responses well. Their light bodies can dodge attacks while consistently dishing them back out.

entry: 它高高兴兴飞过花间，饮尽花蜜。喝够之后，就会停在树上休息，准备进化。
author: .izik
source: It happily flies from flower to flower, drinking the nectar. Once it drinks enough nectar, it will rest in a tree and prepare for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，由燃烧的花粉孢子组成。飞过其他宝可梦时，它会撒下花粉，为大家送去温暖。
author: chaozura
source: POKENAME's flames are composed of burning pollen spores. It takes care of other Pokémon, giving them warmth through its pollen as it flies over them.

entry: 据说，养一只POKENAME，便能带来好运。它爱晒太阳，却十分怕冷。
author: cait_sith
source: Allegedly, keeping a POKENAME will bring you good luck. It enjoys basking in the sun and is very sensitive to the cold.

entry: 进化后的POKENAME更爱独居。可一有危险，便会为了心中正义，保护自己与其他生命。
author: @Gotfyr
source: After evolution, POKENAME prefer to live a more solitary life from eachother. If it senses danger it will protect both itself and others for justice.

entry: POKENAME正义感强烈，凡遇险的宝可梦，都愿守护。它们还能借弹力蛛网反弹，迅速赶路。
author: @Gotfyr
source: POKENAME have a strong sense of justice and will defend any Pokémon that are in danger. They bounce off their elastic webs to travel at high speeds.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME飞上高山，以星光为食。天一亮，便沿山坡滚下来，撞上树木，又弹向别处。
author: gellyfishsh
source: At night, POKENAME flies up mountains to feed on starlight. When the sun rises, it rolls down the mountain, ricocheting off trees as it goes.

entry: 在早间动作剧中亮相，让POKENAME深受孩子欢迎。它也因此努力维持，自己正义英雄的形象。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME's appearances in morning action shows have made it popular with children. It strives to keep up the image of a hero of justice as a result.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，总想从强者手里救出弱者。可到最后，往往比被救的那只，伤得还惨。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are good-natured, attempting to save weak Pokémon from stronger ones. They often end up in worse condition than the one they try to save.

entry: POKENAME挥刃、出拳，同时迎敌。月光下，刀刃闪闪发亮，挥动时还拖出一道光痕。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME fights with its blade and fist simultaneously. In the moonlight, its blade sparkles and makes glowing trails with its swings.

entry: 它细心打理着自己的丝球，既自豪，又总想拿给其他宝可梦看。
author: missingmilkman
source: It meticulously maintains its ball of silk. It's very proud of it and always tries to show it to other Pokémon.

entry: 许多POKENAME住在森林，也有些扩散到了村里。它们能爬上天花板，强劲的大颚，几乎什么都咬得碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Many POKENAMES live in forests, but some have spread into villages. They can climb on ceilings and crack almost anything with their strong jaws.

entry: 它常把橙橙果汁涂在网上，引来猎物。网极其牢固，黏性也能维持好几个月。
author: .izik
source: It regularly coats its webs with juice from Oran Berries to attract its prey. The webs are extremely strong and can stay sticky for months.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，还不习惯自己的翅膀。狩猎时常撞上东西，管它是不是猎物，都撞个正着。
author: @Gotfyr
source: POKENAME are very clumsy Pokémon. They aren't used to their wings yet, resulting in many hunts ending with them crashing into an object, prey or not.

entry: 进化之后，POKENAME狩猎更加大胆，会高速飞行，用头顶的尖角，刺穿猎物。
author: @Gotfyr
source: After evolving, POKENAME are more bold in their approach to hunting. They fly at high speeds using their sharp top horns to skewer their prey.

entry: POKENAME用自己的丝网滑翔。网若破了，几秒便能修好，甚至飞在半空，也不耽搁！
author: GP423
source: POKENAME glides around on its own webbing. It can patch up any damage done to the web in a matter of seconds, even mid-glide!

entry: 幼小的圆丝蛛，在它鹿角间织网。它奔过森林，虫子便纷纷落网，喂养这群小家伙，直到长大。
author: missingmilkman
source: Young Spinarak weave webs through its antlers. As it bounds through the forest, bugs become caught in the webs and feed the cluster to maturity.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴中布下丝网，感知猎物。它爬过昏暗洞顶，等猎物粘住、挣扎，再猛扑下去。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME creates web network systems in caves to sense prey. It wanders the dark ceilings and plunges into them while they struggle in the sticky web.

entry: 它能一动不动，等上好几年。可猎物终于走近，有时它还是觉得，不太想动。
author: missingmilkman
source: It can lie motionless for years at a time, waiting for prey. When prey finally comes near, sometimes it still doesn't feel like moving.

entry: POKENAME一见猎物，就会凶狠地撕扯。再陡的墙也能爬，连天花板上，也能奔跑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME will tear mercilessly at prey as soon as it sees it. It can climb any wall, no matter how steep, and even run on ceilings.

entry: 它随意漂浮，用网捕猎。有人推测，它会吞食猎物的灵魂，再将其带往来世。
author: hiimbasil
source: It floats aimlessly, catching prey in its web. It's theorized that it consumes its victims' souls, then brings them to the afterlife.

entry: 它的网形似乐谱。可谁若不慎粘在里面，POKENAME反而会生那人的气。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Its webs are found in a shape resembling sheet music. When someone gets stuck inside of the web, POKENAME gets angry at them.

entry: POKENAME会为领地里的其他生物，烘焙点心。可也常被发现，囤着钱财，还偷训练家的东西。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME bakes pastries for others in its domain. It can often be found hoarding money and stealing from trainers.

entry: 它们夜爬海滩，寻找猎物，似乎很喜欢用触手末端的毒刺，扎伤其他宝可梦。
author: HummusIsHome
source: They crawl along beaches at night in search of prey. They seem to enjoy stabbing other Pokémon with the poison barb at the end of their tentacles.

entry: 两侧的头，都听第三颗头指挥，却不知道，那其实只是一张脸。决策虽然笨拙有误，天敌却仍会望风而逃。
author: missingmilkman
source: The outer heads obey the third, unaware that it is just a face. Its decision making is flawed and clumsy, yet predators still flee from it.

entry: 它不再催眠猎物，改用恐惧，吓得对方动弹不得。颈间丝网里，还住着幼小的圆丝蛛。
author: missingmilkman
source: It forgoes hypnotism, instead paralyzing its prey with fear. Young Spinarak live within the shelter of the webs around its neck.

entry: POKENAME喜欢废弃建筑的清静，会在腐朽的门框间，织起繁复蛛网，捕捉猎物。
author: char_latte3412
source: This Pokémon tends to live in abandoned buildings for peace and quiet. POKENAME will spin intricate webs in decrepit door frames to catch prey.

entry: 它不断在双钳间，织出复杂的丝纹。只要会动，就想吃掉，六条腿一齐发力，凶猛地冲向猎物。
author: missingmilkman
source: It endlessly weaves complex silk patterns between its pincers. It feeds on anything that moves, scuttering violently towards its prey on all six legs.

entry: 为了继续生长，它会剥落片片外壳。壳片黏得很，一遇雨水，又会溶解。
author: .izik
source: It sheds flakes of its shell in order to grow. The flakes are extremely sticky and dissolve in the rain.

entry: POKENAME巢里的蜜，对同类完全无害，其他生物吃下，却会中毒。长久食用，甚至可能失明。
author: .izik
source: While completely harmless to its own kind, the honey in a POKENAME nest is poisonous if ingested. Prolonged consumption can cause blindness.

entry: 它脚尖黏性极强，能攀上笔直的墙面，甚至紧紧贴在天花板上。
author: .izik
source: The tips of its feet are extremely sticky. It has the ability to climb up completely vertical surfaces and cling to the ceiling.

entry: POKENAME目力惊人，无论在洞中攀壁，还是飞着捕猎，都少不得这本领。行动时，又全无声息。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has incredible eyesight, necessary for both climbing walls in caves and also hunting while flying. It makes no sound at all while moving.

entry: 别被模样骗了，POKENAME极容易受惊发怒。许多训练家想用手捧起野生POKENAME，最后都得就医。
author: @Gotfyr
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME are easily agitated. Many Trainers have needed medical attention after trying to hold wild POKENAME in their hands.

entry: 有人偶尔见到它，握着一朵奇特的花，仰望夜空。也有人猜测，它在悼念某个逝去的生命。
author: hypernovahusky
source: This Pokémon can sometimes be observed gazing up at the night sky while holding a peculiar flower. Some believe it is mourning the loss of someone.

entry: 每只POKENAME都自认是最强的超级反派。那些邪恶计划，让宝可梦与训练家，都大伤脑筋。
author: @Gotfyr
source: Each POKENAME sees itself as the ultimate super villain. Their evil schemes make them quite the nuisance to both Pokémon and Trainers alike.

entry: 腿部能吐丝，织成翅膀。POKENAME还会结起大网，存放猎物，谁想逃，便飞过去捉回。
author: maxiundmicky
source: Its legs can secrete webs, which it uses to form wings. POKENAME forms large webs in which it stores prey, flying at victims that try to escape.

entry: 它身体轻，连微风也能带走。睡觉时，便拼命攀紧身下的东西，生怕不小心飘远。
author: .izik
source: Due to its light weight, even the smallest breeze will carry it. It clings tightly to any surface when it sleeps in fear of floating away.

entry: POKENAME头顶的花，见光开放，入夜闭合。可它偏偏昼伏夜出，因此很少见它醒着时，花也正开着。
author: ziggaway
source: The bloom on POKENAME's head opens in light and closes at night. Being nocturnal, it is rarely seen awake with an open bloom.

entry: 雷雨中，它张嘴朝天，一圈圈跑，喝足了水，就到最近的池塘里睡去。
author: .izik
source: It runs in circles during thunderstorms while holding its mouth open to the sky. Once it drinks enough water it will fall asleep in the closest pond.

entry: 它用树皮与粗厚的红丝，混合筑巢。吃东西时若遭打扰，便会像人一样，尖声大叫。
author: .izik
source: Its nest is made of a mixture of tree bark and a thick red silk. Should it be disturbed while eating, it will scream like a human.

entry: 这只宝可梦用丝线探知、困住猎物，也会啃咬丝线，磨短不断生长的牙齿。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon uses the silk threads it produces to locate and trap prey. It will also gnaw on these threads to file down its ever-growing teeth.

entry: POKENAME本该长鹿角的位置，竟长着一对腿。那两条腿若不小心碰到身体，它就会自己吓自己。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has a pair of legs where antlers would normally grow. This Pokémon will startle itself if these legs accidentally brush any part of its body.

entry: POKENAME奔跑于森林和草木茂盛的沙漠绿洲。即使如今，也仍有些地方，把它当半神崇敬。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME is seen running around forests and lush desert oases. Even today, some communities worship it as a demigod.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙磨成粉后，能调制各式口红。密阿雷市的时尚达人，也会使用这种配方。
author: .izik
source: The fangs of a POKENAME can be ground up to create various forms of lipstick. This blend is used in Lumiosa City by fashion gurus.

entry: 它住在海边的岩层。可哪怕一滴水碰到POKENAME，也会让它惊恐尖叫。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in rock formations near the sea. Should any amount of water touch it, the POKENAME will let loose a scared shriek.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里有速效神经毒素，能迅速麻痹敌人，再把对方拖回巢，慢慢享用。
author: yourfriendlycap
source: POKENAME utilize a fast-acting nerve agent in their tails to quickly immobilize foes before dragging them to their nests to feed on them.

entry: 少有虫子像POKENAME这样可怕。它藏在废弃实验室与工厂，制造磁力，大眼睛也时刻警戒周围。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Few insects are as threatening as POKENAME. It hides in abandoned labs and factories, generating magnetism and keeping a look out with its large eyes.

entry: 它的目力发达，还能辨认热量轮廓，即使目标远达一英里，也能用喷水准确命中。
author: .izik
source: It can accurately spray jets of water from up to a mile away. Its eyesight is extremely advanced and able to pick up heat signatures.

entry: 它无法移动，中空的身体，仿佛全靠蛛丝连着。POKENAME从哪儿来，又在野外做什么，没人知道。
author: ziggaway
source: Unable to move, its hollow body appears to be held together by spider silk. No one knows where POKENAME comes from or what it does in the wild.

entry: POKENAME铺开的网，由细而坚韧的金属构成。拆解回收后，还能用于制造飞机引擎。
author: .izik
source: The web deployed by a POKENAME is made up of a thin and sturdy metal. This web can be broken down and used in the construction of airplane engines.

entry: 它用头顶的诱饵伪装，潜进阿利多斯的巢，抱着一大捧蛋溜走。若被发现，又装得十分无辜。
author: wigglypon
source: Using the decoy on its head as a disguise, it infiltrates Ariados nests and absconds with an armful of eggs. If exposed, it puts on an innocent act.

entry: 身上吐出的绿网，微微发亮。黑暗彻底降临，眼中又会泛起诡异的光。
author: .izik
source: The green web that comes from its body is slightly luminous. When in complete darkness, its eye lets off an eerie glow.

entry: 这只宝可梦虽看着凶，却能安抚人心。POKENAME或许把宁静存进角里，再让飘带像天线般传递。
author: ziggaway
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, this Pokémon actually imparts calm. POKENAME may store tranquility in its horn, with its ribbons acting as antennae.

entry: 它身体上的布，由极坚韧的丝织成。POKENAME会找到那些滥杀蜘蛛的人，给他们降下诅咒。
author: ziggaway
source: The cloth of its body is made of incredibly strong silk. POKENAME seeks out those that wantonly kill spiders in order to place curses on them.

entry: POKENAME用鲜艳花纹，吓退潜在的天敌。年幼时尾巴少，这招的效果，也就差一些。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME uses its bright markings to ward off potential predators. It has less tails when younger, and is thus less effective at this tactic.

entry: 它从海底射出黏网，网住上方船只。一旦抓牢，就会把船拖入水下。
author: .izik
source: It fires a sticky web from the seafloor to catch boats from below. Once it latches onto a vessel, it will drag it under the water.

entry: 它们很少动用下肢。两颗真头忙着吵架时，尾端的假第三头，便负责提防偷袭。
author: chromaerym
source: They rarely use their lower limbs. On their tail tip is a fake third head to prevent ambushes since the two true heads are often busy arguing.

entry: 它很少动用下肢。两颗真头忙着吵架时，尾端的假第三头，便负责提防偷袭。
author: chromaerym
source: It rarely uses its lower limbs. On its tail tip is a fake third head to prevent ambushes, since the two true heads are often busy arguing.

entry: 比起活的猎物，它更爱啃丛林里的藤蔓，一天就能轻松吃下50磅。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to chew on jungle vines rather than any live prey. It can quickly consume 50 lbs of vines per day.

entry: 它一焦虑，就会疯狂啃木头。若POKENAME压力过大，甚至能毁掉一小片森林。
author: .izik
source: It frantically chews wood whenever it is anxious. Should a POKENAME become over-stressed, it can level a small forest.

entry: POKENAME以强烈的负面情绪为食，将其存进角里。情绪越强，吐出的丝，也就越坚韧。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME feeds on strong negative emotions and stores them in its horn. The stronger the emotions, the stronger the silk it will produce.

entry: 身体覆着黏稠的粉红丝网。将丝网溶进水里，还能用作维生素补充剂。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in a sticky, pink web. If dissolved in water, this web can be used as a vitamin supplement.

entry: POKENAME的毛，会刺激裸露的皮肤。毒液更只消几秒，就能将猎物麻痹。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's hairs will irritate unprotected skin. Its venom paralyzes prey in mere seconds.

entry: 它用丝网捕捉猎物。网中积攒了足够的食物后，它就会带着网飞回巢穴，喂养幼崽。
author: .izik
source: It uses its webbing to ensnare its prey. Once it gathers enough food in its web, it flies it back to its nest to feed its young.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的洞穴，靠丝线找到回巢的路，因此，被视为洞穴探险者的理想伙伴。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are found in deep underground caves, using their threads to navigate back to their nests. They're considered ideal partners for spelunkers.

entry: 它每年都会占下一片森林，用细丝挥动一团毒叶，将天敌赶出自己的家园。
author: .izik
source: It will claim a forest as its own once per year. It swings a clump of poisonous leaves with a thin string of silk to deter predators from its home.

entry: POKENAME用遍布身体的丝线，放大自己发出的超声波。找食物时，最喜欢汁水丰沛、吃得一团糟的果实。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME uses silk threads across its body to amplify the ultrasonic waves it emits. It prefers the juiciest, messiest fruits, if it can find them.

entry: POKENAME在灯具与路灯周围织网。可别站在巢下，它的粉末与丝线，都有毒。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their webs around lamps and streetlamps. Standing underneath these nests is unwise due to POKENAME's toxic dust and threads.

entry: POKENAME能吐出真正由黄金构成的贵重丝线，因此，多半只有十分富裕的训练家才养得起。
author: Novellavaria
source: POKENAME produces highly valued silk that's made out of gold. Because of this, it's typically only owned by very wealthy Trainers.

entry: 角会缓缓释放潜藏的超能力。它仍偶尔头痛，发作时，也可能突然变得凶猛。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon's horn slowly releases its latent psychic abilities. It still infrequently gets headaches, and may become aggressive during an episode.

entry: 它靠灵敏的嗅觉追踪猎物，但POKENAME若被水浇透，就会失去正在追踪的气味。
author: .izik
source: It uses its superior sense of smell to track prey. Should a POKENAME be doused in water, it loses any scent it was tracking.

entry: POKENAME用下半身装成一只受困的豪力，诱使毫无防备、想救助它的猎物上前。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME mimics a trapped Machoke with its lower body to lure in unsuspecting prey trying to free it.

entry: 傍晚，嘴里偶尔会滴下浓稠的绿色液体。蛋白质或钠摄入过多，这种酸液便会溢出。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally, a thick, green fluid drips from its mouth in the evenings. This acid overflows when it consumes too much protein or sodium in its diet.

entry: 它们在森林中窜行，寻找大型猎物。POKENAME会跃上强壮宝可梦的头，注入致命的神经毒素。
author: HummusIsHome
source: They scuttle through forests in search of large prey to devour. POKENAME jump on the heads of strong Pokémon and inject them with a lethal neurotoxin.

entry: 母亲的头骨已与它的头和翅膀融为一体，化作铠甲。双翼更结实了，也能当作利刃迎敌。
author: Skymaster426
source: Its mother's skull has fused with its head and wings as armor. With its wings being given extra strength, it can use them as blades to attack.

entry: POKENAME获得了超乎感官的敏锐反应，仍不断寻找强敌，期待对方能承受自己的重拳。
author: togetik
source: Having gained ultrasensory reflexes, POKENAME continues to seek opponents strong enough to withstand its powerful punches.

entry: POKENAME的大头，总被其他头惹得心烦，时时惦念着从前，自己还是独立宝可梦的日子。
author: .ssunday.
source: The giant head of POKENAME is always annoyed and bothered by the other heads. It constantly dreams of when it was its own Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀参差不齐，无法飞翔。多余附肢又拖累身体，只能可怜地在地上踉跄，寻找叶子吃。
author: gellyfishsh
source: Due to its uneven wings, POKENAME cannot fly. It shambles miserably across the floor in search of leaves to eat, held down by the extra appendages.

entry: POKENAME看着像猎手，其实是食草的。火焰还具有麻痹神经的效果。
author: mrbapcik
source: Though POKENAME resembles a predator, they are actually herbivores. Their fire possesses neuro-paralytic properties.

entry: 一些地方，因它优雅而凶猛，便将其奉为神明。六片羽翼，又为它赢来“死亡炽天使”的称号。
author: gellyfishsh
source: In some places, it is worshipped for its grace and ferocity. From its six wings, it is dubbed “The Seraph of Death".

entry: 野生POKENAME成群倒挂在果树枝上，藏在双翼后，常被误认成异奇果。
author: rihse
source: Wild POKENAME gather and hang upside down from the branches of fruit trees. Concealed by their wings, they are often mistaken for Wiki Berries.

entry: 周身毒膜散出的毒气，足以让附近宝可梦昏迷。POKENAME便能不慌不忙，尽情吸血。
author: char_latte3412
source: The poisonous film on its body is so noxious that any nearby Pokémon will slip into unconsciousness, allowing POKENAME to suck blood at its leisure.

entry: POKENAME天性散漫，磨去了捕猎的锋芒。如今只靠其他猎手留下的残余，满足自己的嗜血欲望。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's inherently carefree nature has diminished its predatory edge. It relies on the remnants left behind by others to satisfy its bloodlust.

entry: POKENAME一连飞上数小时后，便在水面休息。若被掀得仰面朝天，就会拼命扑腾，直到翻回身，或把自己累坏。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME will rest atop water after flying for hours. If it gets knocked onto its back, it'll flail until it tires itself out or manages to flip over.

entry: 它们会吃发光的珊瑚，也因此能在黑暗中，泛起美丽的光。
author: mrbapcik
source: Their diet includes luminescent corals. Thanks to this diet, they glow beautifully in the dark.

entry: 这只小宝可梦，夜里在树间滑翔，凭出色的视力，从高处悄悄追踪猎物。
author: themicelegion
source: This small Pokémon glides from tree to tree at night. It stalks prey from high places with its great eyesight.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷得惊人，腾挪之间，便以带毒的劈击与踢击迎敌。它住在深山之中。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has impressive agility. It darts around and strikes opponents with poison-laced chops and kicks. POKENAME resides deep in the mountains.
