entry: POKENAME全身入鞘时，飞得最快，四片翅膀都悄无声息。剑刃则靠吸血为食。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME flies fastest while in its scabbard, employing four silent wings in total. Its blade consumes blood.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME吸血，其实，它们吃的是小型虫宝可梦，以及电力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Many people believe that POKENAME are bloodsuckers. However, they actually feed on small bug Pokémon and electricity.

entry: 野生POKENAME攀在洞穴高处。猎物一从下方走过，POKENAME便扑下，用斧刃般的獠牙，将其劈开。
author: kingd8
source: Wild POKENAME cling to high cave ceilings. When prey walks below, POKENAME will drop down on it, cleaving it in half with its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME住在阁楼与地窖，常啃食电缆，也因此，惹得灯光忽明忽暗。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in attics or cellars. They are often the cause of flickering lights as they feed on the cables.

entry: 受到威胁，它会俯低身体，露出下背部的巨大假脸，再猛然前冲，狠狠撞上敌人。
author: moopse
source: When threatened, it lies down and displays the large false face on it's lower back. It then lunges forward, brutally slamming into the enemy.

entry: 这种宝可梦背上，虽然已经没有假脸，受威胁时，却仍会本能地躺下。
author: moopse
source: Though lacking the false face on its back, this Pokémon still instinctively lies down when threatened.

entry: 它夜里疾飞田野，散播毒粉。一察觉猎物已经中招，便立刻出击。
author: .izik
source: It flies quickly through fields at night, scattering poisonous powder. Should it see that its prey was affected, it will strike immediately.

entry: POKENAME脆弱的双翼，托不起身体。好在，它靠念力，就能轻松飞行。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's frail wings cannot lift its body. Fortunately, in can easily fly with its telekinetic abilities.

entry: 双翼能收进壳内，免遭伤害。它会悄悄飞到敌人上方，趁对方没发现，再用身体猛撞。
author: Soup1900
source: It retracts its wings into its shell to protect them from any harm. It can fly over its foes without them noticing before slamming them with its body.

entry: 藻玉镇有位女裁缝，专用POKENAME的羽毛缝制婚纱。羽毛的光泽无可比拟。
author: .izik
source: There is a seamstress in Wisteria Town that makes wedding dresses with POKENAME feathers. Their sheen is unmatched in quality.

entry: POKENAME是强大的鸟宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比。感到受威胁，便能轻松掀起龙卷风。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong bird Pokémon, its claws are razor sharp. It will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能借风飘往任何想去的地方。蓝色羽毛里，似乎还藏着古老的超能力。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Its blue feathers seem to hold an ancient psychic power.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能借风飘往任何想去的地方。一察觉危险，就会掀起一阵狂风。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. It will whip up a gust of wind if it feels endangered.

entry: 它叫得实在太吵。养着POKENAME的人，不是放归野外，就是赶紧想办法，让它进化。
author: VaporVenator
source: Its cries are obnoxiously loud. Those who own POKENAME tend to either release them into the wild or evolve them as quickly as possible.

entry: 它飞得快，却笨拙得很。常一头撞上树，惊动树中居民，惹来麻烦。
author: VaporVenator
source: While fast in flight, it is very clumsy. It tends to start trouble by crashing into trees, disturbing its inhabitants.

entry: 浓密而鲜艳的头羽，是它求偶的资本。雌性POKENAME总会寻找头羽最浓密、颜色最鲜亮的雄性POKENAME。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its thick, colorful head plumage is used for courtship rituals. Female POKENAME search out the male POKENAME with the thickest, most vibrant plumage.

entry: 它在领地上空翱翔，保护所栖森林里，那些较弱的宝可梦。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Soaring around its territory, this Pokémon acts as a defender of weaker Pokémon in the forests it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛，常被做成富人用的枕头。渴望一夜好眠的人，都想要那份柔软。
author: .izik
source: Feathers from POKENAME are used in pillows for the wealthy. Their softness is coveted by those who desire a good night's rest.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，却能在跳跃时，扇动众多翅膀，让自己跳得更高。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can't fly, but instead, it can flap its many wings to add to its height when it jumps.

entry: POKENAME行动反复无常，仿佛背上的蘑菇，正在时不时接管，身体的活动能力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is very capricious in its actions. It almost seems as if the mushroom on its back is temporarily gaining control of its locomotor abilities.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地爬过树枝，神情漠然，仿佛已无法掌控，自己的感官。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME crawls aimlessly through the branches of trees. It seems almost apathetic, as if it is not in control of its senses.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的鳞片，更像细小的羽毛。它主要以虫宝可梦为食，可爪子太小，实在不便抓牢猎物。
author: RoboSoup
source: The scales on POKENAME's wings are more like tiny feathers. It mostly eats bug Pokémon, though its claws are too small for grasping prey.

entry: 古老神话，常把它与贪婪联系起来。最出名的一则，便是POKENAME贪恋太阳闪亮的光，竟飞得离太阳太近。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is often associated with greed in old myths, the best-known being the tale of a POKENAME flying too close to the sun in pursuit of its shiny light.

entry: POKENAME能看清三公里外的景物。飞行时，便会巡视远方，寻找可用来制作摆锤的闪亮材料。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME can see clearly up to three kilometers ahead. When in flight, it scans the horizon for shiny materials that it can craft pendulums from.

entry: POKENAME好奇心极强。若遇到危险，便从口中喷出，带电的墨汁。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are known to be extremely curious. If it's in danger, it'll shoot electrified ink from its mouth.

entry: 雷雨来时，它会把触角伸出水面。若遭雷击，便将电力收进体内。
author: .izik
source: It extends its antennae out of the water during thunderstorms. Should it be struck by lightning, it will store the electricity within its body.

entry: 若想把它养在水族箱里，切记不要装电动过滤器。靠得太近，它身上就会冒出电火花。
author: .izik
source: If it is to be kept in a tank, it is important to make sure an electric filter is not installed. Should it get too close to one, its body will spark.

entry: POKENAME小心摸索着，走进深海洞穴。触角发出的光，刚好够自己看清前方。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME carefully feels its way into deep ocean caves. Its antennae generate just enough light for it to see something.

entry: 深暗之中，有潜水者错把它认成潜艇。还没发觉认错，就已被POKENAME吞下。
author: .ssunday.
source: In the dark, some scuba divers mistake it for a submarine. Before they realize their mistake, they get eaten by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME倒挂在洞顶，用带电触角，捉住漂来的食物。只要没被水流卷走，它就一动不动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hangs upside down from cave ceilings and catches drifting food with its charged antennae. If it is not caught by currents, it does not move.

entry: POKENAME吃得多，身体也弹得很。弹到什么程度？孩子们，甚至会把它当蹦床，在上面跳。
author: pokebio
source: Because it eats so much food, POKENAME is very bouncy. It's so bouncy that children are often found jumping on it like a trampoline.

entry: 这只精力充沛的宝可梦，生活在湖泊与沼泽。身体能产生排水的油，覆在毛发上。
author: themicelegion
source: This energetic Pokémon lives lakes and swamps. Its body makes a hydrophobic oil that it secretes on its fur.

entry: POKENAME毒刺中的发光液体，是强烈的神经毒素。它能把毒刺像鱼雷般射出去，在水中麻痹猎物。
author: kiwikelly
source: The glowing liquid in POKENAME's stingers is a powerful neurotoxin. It can shoot them out in the water like torpedoes to paralyze its prey.

entry: 钻头或触角一亮，就说明准备出击。POKENAME的毒刺，也能释放格外强大的电流。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If its drills or antennae light up, it is ready to attack. POKENAME can emit particularly strong electricity via its stinger.

entry: 它分泌特殊的油，让尾尖燃起明黄色火焰。POKENAME再把尾巴当鞭挥动，打得猎物晕头转向。
author: spookoftheoldways
source: It secretes a special oil that causes the ends of its tails to burn bright yellow. POKENAME uses its tails as whips to disorient prey.

entry: POKENAME的触须如同电线，常附在大型宝可梦身上，既传导，也吸收动能。
author: heyo346
source: POKENAME's tendrils act like wires, both conducting and absorbing kinetic energy, usually latching onto larger Pokémon.

entry: 这种稀有的POKENAME，只在无月之夜浮出。它照亮海水，寻找猎物，再返回深渊。
author: Mister J
source: This rare type of POKENAME only surfaces on moonless nights. It illuminates the sea in search of prey, before returning to the abyss.

entry: 身体逐渐演化成深海海葵的模样。天敌一靠近，便从两根触角间，释放电击。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its anatomy evolved to imitate deep-sea anemones. When a predator gets close, it releases a shock between its antennae.

entry: POKENAME靠触角的强电场，在漆黑深渊中认路。游动迅捷而优雅，宛如鸟翔天空。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME use the strong electric fields from their antennae to navigate the dark abyss. They swim as fast and gracefully as birds fly in the sky.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险时，鹿角会亮起来，随后便会飞快奔逃。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's antlers light up when it senses danger. When this happens, it gallops away with high speed.

entry: POKENAME靠花纹吓退天敌。其实，它的嘴小得，什么也咬不了，根本无力自保。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME relies on its markings to scare away predators. In reality, it cannot defend itself due to its mouth being too small to bite anything.

entry: 这只宝可梦，脑袋不太灵光。可背上的光却亮得惊人，直视，甚至可能使人失明。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon is very dimwitted. The lights on its back are extremely bright. Looking directly at said lights can cause blindness.

entry: POKENAME藏进湖底的沙中，只露出尖刺。猎物一游过，便将尖刺射出去。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME buries itself in sand at the bottom of lakes, leaving only its spikes above ground. When a prey swims by, it shoots its spikes at them.

entry: 它擅长感知危险。双耳既能放电，又会释放各种剧毒，合在一起，十分致命。
author: alliveir
source: This Pokémon is skilled at sensing danger. Its ears discharge electricity and release various horrible toxins, creating a deadly combination.

entry: 只有训练家灵光乍现时，POKENAME花中的灯泡才会亮起——至少训练家们是这么说的。
author: kiwikelly
source: The bulb in POKENAME's flower only lights up when its Trainer has a genius idea. Or so the Trainers say, at least.

entry: 它用四肢的毒触须，探查周围。POKENAME彼此交流，则靠尾巴与耳朵发出的电信号。
author: alliveir
source: It uses the poisonous feelers on its limbs to perceive its surroundings. POKENAME communicate using electric signals from their tail and ears.

entry: POKENAME爱将自己扎在海底，混进其他发光植物中。可若有人抓住茎部，它就会焦躁起来。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME likes to plant itself into the ocean floor, where it blends in with other bioluminescent foliage. It gets agitated if its stalks are grabbed.

entry: 尾巴能发出强烈的电信号，充当信标。也有人见过，它朝敌人射出高频信号束。
author: alliveir
source: Its tail emits loud electric signals that act as a beacon. Some have been seen firing high frequency signal beams at their enemies.

entry: 它生活在当地最深、最黑暗的水域。POKENAME用触角引诱其他宝可梦靠近，再攫取它们的灵魂。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Lives in the deepest, darkest waters of the region. Antennas are used by POKENAME to attract Pokémon closer. It will then capture their soul.

entry: POKENAME醒目的刀刃，主要由液态灵质构成。微弱电流通过其中，便会发出黄光。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's prominent blade is primarily composed of a liquid ectoplasm charged with a small electric current to give it its yellow glow.

entry: 遇上威胁，它就从触角放电。POKENAME能像古老精密技术一样，准确出击，再以力量压倒敌人。
author: anarchaz
source: It emits electricity from its antennae when threatened. POKENAME strikes with the precision of ancient technology, overwhelming foes with its power.

entry: POKENAME尾部的灯，会模仿火焰起伏闪烁，流转出美丽的光纹。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's tail lamps can undulate and glow in beautiful patterns that mimic the movement of flames.

entry: POKENAME用触角产生正负电能，为头部充电，也特别爱用头槌攻击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME charges its head electrically by generating positive and negative energy via its antennae. It loves to give out headbutts.

entry: POKENAME游得不快，可硬壳加上，向周围放电的本领，让它几乎不怕天敌。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is not a fast swimmer. However, thanks to its hard shell and its ability to electrify its surroundings, it hardly fears predators.

entry: 深海中，成群的POKENAME会展现迷人的灯火。可宝可梦一走近，便蜂拥包围，直至什么也不剩。
author: bobosmith01
source: Groups of POKENAME make mesmerizing light displays deep within the ocean. When a Pokémon draws near, they swarm it until nothing remains.

entry: 发光的诱敌器官，会按奇特节奏闪烁，让同类彼此交流。若敌人靠得太近，它便放出电击。
author: .izik
source: Its glowing lures blink in an odd pattern to communicate with others of its kind. Should an enemy get too close, it will let loose an electric shock.

entry: 这只害羞、皮肤坚韧的宝可梦，潜居深海。发光触角，引它穿过黑暗，寻找可吃的海带。
author: akujules
source: This shy, tough-skinned Pokémon lurks in the deep seas. Its glowing antennae guide it through the darkness as it seeks out kelp to eat.

entry: 水下城市的目击传闻，通常不过是POKENAME。环绕手臂的浓盐水，能将电力，传给身上的灯。
author: .realthree
source: Sightings of a city under the water are usually just POKENAME. The thick brine it holds around its arms helps conduct electricity to its lights.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常住在热带海底。遇上威胁，一颗头留下放哨，其余的，则躲进洞里。
author: .ssunday.
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in tropical areas at the bottom of the ocean. If threatened, one head keeps watch and the others hide in their hole.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME的触角，发出诱人的光，吸引毫无防备的猎物。光景虽美，接下来发生的，可就骇人了。
author: Mykoloth
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a captivating light that attracts unsuspecting prey. Though the light is a beautiful sight, what follows is truly horrific.

entry: POKENAME生活在潮湿，或浸满水的洞穴。借发光的眼睛，连最深的黑暗，也能照亮。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in damp or flooded caves. With the help of its luminescent eyes, it illuminates even the deepest darkness.

entry: POKENAME用催眠的光，与幽美的歌声，引来深海猎物。对方一走近，便被POKENAME一口吞下。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME lures in deep-sea prey with its hypnotizing lights and hauntingly beautiful song. When the prey draws close, POKENAME devours it in one bite.

entry: POKENAME背上排着亮闪闪的脊棱，带电时格外明亮，让它在最黑的水中，也能看清。
author: T.I.A.
source: A POKENAME has a row of shiny dorsal ridges down its back. They glow brightly with electricity, allowing it to see even in the darkest waters.

entry: 野生POKENAME曾因壳太亮，而走向灭绝。它们睡在海中，天敌却能从一英里外，看得清清楚楚。
author: .ssunday.
source: Wild POKENAME went extinct because of how bright their shells are. Predators could spot them sleeping in the ocean from a mile away.

entry: POKENAME生活在潮湿，或浸满水的洞穴。借发光的眼睛，连最深的黑暗，也能照亮。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in damp or flooded caves. With the help of its luminescent eyes, it illuminates even the deepest darkness.

entry: POKENAME生活在水下洞穴与深海裂隙，倒挂岩间，照亮本来漆黑的四周。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in underwater caves or in abyssal gaps. It dangles upside down from the rocks and illuminates the otherwise pitch-black surroundings.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，却常被自己的诱饵吸引，只顾不停向前走。
author: durgerking
source: POKENAME is a voracious eater, oftentimes enticed by its own lure to walk forward endlessly.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，却常被自己的诱饵吸引，只顾不停向前走。
author: durgerking
source: POKENAME is a voracious eater, oftentimes enticed by its own lure to walk forward endlessly.

entry: POKENAME在海中与空中，都是出色的猎手。深入水下时，便用发光的附肢狩猎。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are skilled hunters in both the sea and the skies. They use their luminescent appendage to hunt in deep waters.

entry: POKENAME在海中与空中，都是出色的猎手。深入水下时，便用发光的附肢狩猎。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are skilled hunters in both the sea and the skies. They use their luminescent appendage to hunt in deep waters.

entry: POKENAME生活在水下洞穴与深海裂隙，倒挂岩间，照亮本来漆黑的四周。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in underwater caves or in abyssal gaps. It dangles upside down from the rocks and illuminates the otherwise pitch-black surroundings.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，双翼也能当鳍。夜里，发光的钻头，还能引来虫宝可梦与水宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use its wings as hybrid fins when it dives. At night, it attracts Bug and Water Pokémon with its luminescent drills.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，双翼也能当鳍。夜里，发光的钻头，还能引来虫宝可梦与水宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use its wings as hybrid fins when it dives. At night, it attracts Bug and Water Pokémon with its luminescent drills.

entry: POKENAME拿水果形状的诱饵，引来猎物。对方一靠近，就会落入，腿间织好的网。
author: Weirdtux
source: POKENAME will lure in prey with its fruit-shaped lure. Once its prey is close enough, it will ensnare it with a web woven between its legs.

entry: 若在深海最暗处，看见两点微光，就快游回水面吧——赶在自己，变成POKENAME的下一顿饭之前！
author: Phantom640
source: If you see two faint lights in the darkest depths of the ocean. Swim as fast as you can back to the surface—before you become POKENAME's next meal!

entry: POKENAME的发光器官能在一瞬间迸出比超新星还耀眼的光。趁天敌被晃得发愣，它便迅速逃走。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME's bulbs can briefly light up brighter than a supernova, allowing it to flee from predators while they are dazed.

entry: 它游走、钻行于海底最深处。发怒或狩猎时，身上的圆珠，就会迸出灿烂的光。
author: moopse
source: It swims and burrows along the deepest parts of the ocean floor. The orbs on its body create a brilliant light when aggravated or hunting.

entry: 它昼伏夜出，水中陆上都能呼吸。采来数百颗树果，再与自己的幼崽分享。
author: .ssunday.
source: It's a nocturnal Pokémon, and it can breathe in water and on land. It gathers hundreds of Berries and shares them with their young.

entry: POKENAME的光球还很弱，无法用来自保。战斗时，它会依靠电灯怪的帮助，学习技巧，慢慢变强。
author: not_stakings_alt
source: Its orbs are weak so it can't protect itself. POKENAME relies on Lanbok to help it in battles so it can learn their techniques and become stronger.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上明亮的光球能够吓退天敌。观察光球的大小，就能判断哪只POKENAME是首领。
author: not_stakings_alt
source: POKENAME has very bright orbs on its tail which can fend off predators. You can tell which POKENAME is the alpha depending on the orb size.

entry: POKENAME爱捣蛋，交战时也狡计百出，搅得敌人晕头转向，让它愈发难以预测。
author: soinetwa
source: POKENAME, a mischievous trickster, confounds foes with cunning tactics in battle, adding an unpredictable edge to its character.

entry: 传闻，一幅名画的灵感，便来自它身上的花纹。它常睡在日光下，仿佛在为发光斑纹，慢慢充能。
author: kittyluv090
source: Rumor has it that the patterns on its body inspired a famous painting. It sleeps under the sun, as if to recharge its glowing markings.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME用幻象藏起自己，让诱敌器官发光。猎物靠近，就被突然的强光震昏，再一口吞下。
author: bunkachunka
source: POKENAME produces light from its lure while hiding itself using illusions. Prey that get close are stunned by a burst of light and eaten in one gulp.

entry: 发光的突起，能替它们在夜间引路，也能用来诱捕猎物。
author: mrbapcik
source: The glowing growth aids them in navigating during the nighttime. They utilize their luminescent appendage for hunting.

entry: POKENAME的光珠太亮，常被误认成星星。传说，击败它就能许愿，可始终没人证实。
author: not_stakings_alt
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a star due to its bright orbs. Myths say that anyone who beats it can make a wish, but this has never been confirmed.

entry: 它躲进珊瑚礁，避开天敌，却又很容易分心。见到闪亮、发光的东西，就忍不住跟过去。
author: kittyluv090
source: It hides from predators in coral reefs. However, it is also easily distracted, following anything that sparkles or glows.

entry: POKENAME住在云中，以电力为食，也不怕电的威力。游舞于水天之间，姿态和谐。
author: soinetwa
source: POKENAME resides in clouds, sustaining itself on electricity. Impervious to its power, it embodies a harmonious dance of water and sky.

entry: 据说，这只宝可梦会用翼间的光，引领迷途水手回岸。可如今，已经难得一见。
author: neomblue
source: It is said that this Pokémon would guide lost sailors to shore with the light between its wings. However, nowadays, they are rarely seen.

entry: POKENAME喜欢潜伏沼泽，等待猎物。它举起背上的光珠，把猎物引近，再喷出黏液。
author: not_stakings_alt
source: POKENAME likes to lurk in swamps and wait for prey to approach. It lifts up the orb on its back to draw the prey in, where it can spit mucus at it.

entry: 电灯怪与奈克洛兹玛融合，让POKENAME能自己提供食物来源。至今，没人见过它吃东西或喝水。
author: nur1
source: The fusion of Lanturn and Necrozma allows POKENAME to act as its own food source. It has never been witnessed eating or drinking.

entry: POKENAME的丝，可以织成渔网。渔民们喜欢把它留在身旁，免得哪天，网不够用了。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME silk can be used as net material. Fishermen love to have this Pokémon stick around, in case they run out of netting.

entry: POKENAME一离开扎根处，就必须在几小时内，再把脚扎下。否则，光便会渐渐暗去，直至熄灭。
author: .realthree
source: After POKENAME uproots itself, it only has a few hours to plant its feet again before its glowing lights dim and go out.

entry: POKENAME越像植物，就越容易躲过天敌。到了夜里，它的光，还能帮其他宝可梦认路。
author: .realthree
source: The more a POKENAME resembles a plant, the better it can hide from predators. At night, its light helps Pokémon find their way.

entry: POKENAME光芒明亮，几公里外也能看见。长途航行时，它陪着训练家，夜里既能照明，也能催人入睡。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME exudes bright light than can be seen for kilometers. It accompanies Trainers on long voyages to provide light and hypnosis at night.

entry: 奔跑时，会产生少许电力。见树上有果实，就用电击，将它打落。
author: .izik
source: As it runs, it will generate small amounts of electricity. If it sees a fruit in a tree, it will use the electricity to drop it to the ground.

entry: 睡着时，它会不时发抖，迸出一阵火花。因此，POKENAME得避免，靠着同类睡觉。
author: .izik
source: It periodically shudders in its sleep, letting loose a burst of sparks. Due to this, POKENAME must avoid sleeping near others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME留不住体内的电，因此游水时，周围总环着一层微弱的电屏障。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME struggles to effectively retain its stored power and, as a result, swims with a weak electric barrier surrounding it at all times.

entry: POKENAME不善蓄电，电力常散进周围水里。游泳时，最好离它远一点。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is inept at retaining electricity and often releases it into the surrounding water. It is advised to steer clear of it while swimming.

entry: 这只小飞行宝可梦，活泼得过了头，玩性也重。有时POKENAME会不小心电到训练家，好在通常，不算太痛。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This little Flying Pokémon is very hyper and playful. Sometimes POKENAME accidentally shocks its Trainer, but this is usually not too painful.

entry: 它跳过高草丛，察看四周。每蹦一下，都会响起“啪”的电火花声。
author: fouguri
source: It jumps over tall grass to keep watch. Each bounce makes a zap sound.

entry: POKENAME留不住电，便想靠蜜蜂般的外表，吓住天敌。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME is inept at retaining electricity. It hopes to intimidate its predators by looking like a bee.

entry: POKENAME年纪小，还控制不好电力。大部分时候，待在能吸收零星电击的电网上，才安心。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME are still young and can't control their electricity. They spend most of their time on Electrowebs that absorb their stray Thunder Shocks.

entry: POKENAME还不太会飞，便往羽毛里注入一点电，让反复尝试飞行时，能少花些力气。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is not very good at flying yet. By conducting a little electricity into its feathers, it has to use less energy for its many attempts to fly.

entry: 它是奥卜利比亚英雄，那位惹人喜爱的搭档！尤克里里通了电，奏出的音乐，就能安抚躁动的宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: It's the Hero of Oblivia's charming partner! It electrifies its ukulele to create music that calms upset Pokémon.

entry: 这只POKENAME曾在遥远的奥卜利比亚地区表演。家园遭毁后，它来到城都，寻找新的观众。
author: Patch_Bros
source: This POKENAME used to perform in the far-off region of Oblivia. Due to the destruction of its home, it now searches for an audience in Johto.

entry: 阳光明媚的日子，POKENAME两两牵手，欢快起舞，微弱电流也随之散入草间。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: On days when the sun shines brightly, pairs of POKENAME will gleefully dance hand-in-hand, spreading a weak electric current through the grass.

entry: POKENAME难以留住电力，游泳时常突然放出一阵电，再被周围的水，传导出去。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME has difficulty retaining its electricity. While swimming, it will often release a burst of electricity that's then conducted by the water.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: POKENAME能感知人的精神状态。若发现谁没劲，就可能电他一下，好让脚步轻快些。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME can sense people's energy levels. If it's low, it may give them a shock to put more pep in their step.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表可爱，却控制不好自己的力气与电力，通常只能交给专业人士照料。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME are typically handled by professionals due to its lack of control of both its strength and electrical powers.

entry: POKENAME三颗头的电都控制不好，总互相电到，也因此，吵个不停。
author: Mistymagius
source: The three heads of POKENAME are always squabbling with one another since they constantly shock each other with their uncontrollable electricity.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，毛间会积起静电。可怎么控制这份电力，它还没学会。
author: theartemis1
source: Static electricity is built up in POKENAME's fur as it fights. It has not yet mastered how to control this electric charge.

entry: 电力难以控制，施展催眠时，手也总晃着。它却能靠摆锤，让猎物陷入恍惚，好轻松捕捉。
author: anarchaz
source: Struggling to harness electricity, it wields hypnotic powers with an unsteady hand. Its pendulum lulls prey into a trance for easy capture.

entry: POKENAME的电气球，能帮它蓄电，避免无意间电到别人。性格又和善，是新手的好伙伴。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's Light Ball helps it store electricity and prevent unwanted shocks. Its amiable personality makes it a great beginner Pokémon.

entry: 流星繁多的夜晚，POKENAME便飘上高空，静静观看。有人认为，每逢此时，它是在思念故乡。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: On nights with many shooting stars, POKENAME floats up high into the sky to watch them. Some think that in these moments, they are yearning for home.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在月夜聚会。那些集会，还启发人们，写下关于星际生命的诗。
author: fixthewifi
source: POKENAME have been said to gather on moonlit nights. Rumour has it these gatherings have inspired poems about interplanetary creatures.

entry: POKENAME坐在飞碟的保护中，飞过星夜。若发现有趣的物件，就以牵引光束，将其提起。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME flies through starry nights protected by a flying saucer. If it spots an interesting object, it uses a tractor beam to pick it up.

entry: POKENAME全无自保的本能，并不适合野外生活。若没人照料，它只会始终甜甜地笑着，一点点饿下去。
author: char_latte3412
source: Unfit for the wild, POKENAME lacks any self-preservation instincts. Without a caretaker, it would continue smiling sweetly as it slowly starves.

entry: POKENAME全然不觉，自己块头有多大。流星雨中快乐起舞，常无意间，把周围弄坏。
author: char_latte3412
source: Oblivious to its large stature, POKENAME will happily dance about during a meteor shower, often causing unintentional damage to its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME身体娇弱，若挨上猛烈攻击，就会整个融化。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME's body is delicate. If hit by a strong attack, it'll melt.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又害羞，总隔着一段距离，跟在训练家与宝可梦身后。只须招招手，它就飘过来。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is playful but shy, following behind Trainers and Pokémon at a distance. It'll float over when beckoned.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME以积极情绪为食。一旦心情低落，头上的火焰就会熄灭。
author: ohok3441
source: Some believe POKENAME feeds on positivity. The fire on its head will go out if it's upset.

entry: 传说，它的火焰，是一颗受困的星。凝望太久，往后好几周，都可能看见POKENAME的幻象。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Legends claim that its flame is a trapped star. Staring into its light for too long causes visual hallucinations of POKENAME that last for weeks.

entry: POKENAME很受婴儿欢迎，柔软闪烁的尾巴，摸着只有微温，恰能哄他们安稳入睡。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME is popular with infants, as its soft twinkling tail helps lull them to sleep, and is only warm to the touch.

entry: POKENAME看似弱小，吸引力却很强，还能放出电磁场，阻止敌人靠近。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME seems weak, but it has strong powers of attraction and can generate electric magnetic fields to keep enemies away.

entry: POKENAME个头小，力量却大，耐力也无可比拟，总精力十足地冲过田野。爱玩的模样，反倒掩住了惊人的实力。
author: anarchaz
source: A tiny powerhouse with unrivaled stamina, POKENAME charges through fields with boundless energy. Its playful demeanor belies its immense strength.

entry: POKENAME是孩子们的好玩伴，可不能放着不管。它的花粉，会让孩子们迷迷糊糊，弄不清方向。
author: chiari_queen
source: Young children find POKENAME a great playmate. However, it's advised to not let them play together unattended, as its pollen can make them feel lost.

entry: POKENAME是孩子们的好玩伴，可不能放着不管。它的花粉，会让孩子们迷迷糊糊，弄不清方向。
author: chiari_queen
source: Young children find POKENAME a great playmate. However, it's advised to not let them play together unattended, as its pollen can make them feel lost.

entry: 它总发出哔声与啾鸣，似乎毫无规律。也常从树上跌下，落地又弹起来，竟一点没伤。
author: Staghorn
source: It constantly beeps and chirps, seemingly at random. It's often seen falling out of trees, bouncing unharmed when it lands.

entry: 身体软乎乎的，捧在手里，像水床般流动。到了深夜，它才会练习歌唱。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's body is soft and squishy, flowing like a waterbed when held. Deep in the night, it practices its singing.

entry: 别被友善的脸骗了。有人观察到，它来到新的生态环境，只消几天，就成了顶级猎手。
author: akujules
source: Don't be fooled by this Pokémon's friendly face. It has been observed to become the apex predator of a new ecosystem in a matter of days.

entry: 它的身体柔软能扭，能挤进猎物的巢穴与洞里。
author: mx_wellman
source: It has a soft and pliable body, which it uses to contort its way into the dens and burrows of its prey.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就把头鼓到身体的三倍大，飘飞逃走。熟悉了、安心了，它又会十分亲人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME senses danger, it blows its head up to three times its body size to fly away. Once it has gained confidence, it is very affectionate.

entry: POKENAME硬壳既能防备天敌，也把身体压在地面。壳里的本体，却轻巧、柔软，捏得动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The hard shell of POKENAME protects it from predators, but also keeps it weighted to the ground; its main body is light, soft, and squishy.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: POKENAME硬壳既能防备天敌，也把身体压在地面。壳里的本体，却轻巧、柔软，捏得动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The hard shell of POKENAME protects it from predators, but also keeps it weighted to the ground; its main body is light, soft, and squishy.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: POKENAME硬壳既能防备天敌，也把身体压在地面。壳里的本体，却轻巧、柔软，捏得动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The hard shell of POKENAME protects it from predators, but also keeps it weighted to the ground; its main body is light, soft, and squishy.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: 彼此间牢不可破的羁绊，造就了POKENAME这个名字。据说，它们能感觉到对方的情绪，行动宛如一体。
author: zeeroooo
source: This Pokémon is called POKENAME due to their unbreakable bond with one another. It's said that they can feel each other's emotions, and act as one.

entry: 偶尔，波克基古会保留波克比时的配色。痴心收藏它们的爱好者，多半愿意花大价钱，求得一只。
author: Staghorn
source: Occasionally, a Togetic retains the coloration it had as a Togepi. Most dedicated Togetic collectors would pay huge sums of money to obtain one.

entry: 给POKENAME的蛋涂彩，是一些人庆祝复活节的传统。它虽以蛋闻名，本身也是很好的宠物。
author: .ssunday.
source: Painting POKENAME eggs is a tradition for people who celebrate Easter. Although it's mostly known for its eggs, it also just makes for a good pet.

entry: POKENAME被称为带来欢乐的使者。它飞向最需要帮助的人，用自己的力量，让对方好受些。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is known as a bringer of joy. It flies to people who need help the most to make them feel better with its power.

entry: 它还不知道，自己已经破壳出生，便仍留在蛋壳里，保护自己。被喜欢的气味包围时，又会进化。
author: Skymaster426
source: It doesn't know it has hatched from its egg yet, and keeps within its shell for protection. When it is surrounded by smells it enjoys, it evolves.

entry: 它会依恋第一眼看见的人。身体坚韧得很，哪怕冒雨踏雪，也要一点点挪着追去，直到重新相见。
author: Skymaster426
source: It grows immensely attached to the first person it sees. It is immensely durable, and will scooch after them through rain and snow until they reunite.

entry: 这只幼小的宝可梦，头似乎卡在了蛋里，看不见路。走着碰到什么，就用头顶一下。
author: coooooooookiee
source: This young Pokémon seems to have gotten its head stuck in its egg, rendering it unable to see. It headbutts anything it bumps into when walking.

entry: 它喜欢依附心怀慈悲与快乐的人。可年幼，又没经验，偶尔也会不自量力，揽上应付不了的事。
author: togetik
source: It attaches itself to people with hearts of compassion and joy. Being young and inexperienced, it sometimes bites off more than it can chew, though.

entry: POKENAME在云里挖洞安家。身体摸着虽软，却怎么也刺不穿。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME makes burrows in clouds. Its body is soft to the touch, but cannot be pierced.

entry: 波克基古与火暴兽融合，带来的温暖与欢乐，诞生了POKENAME。它虽打起架来凶，却也是很好的朋友。
author: bobosmith01
source: The warmth and joy from the fusion between Togetic and Typhlosion resulted in POKENAME. Despite being a ferocious battler, it's also a great friend.

entry: POKENAME会给心地纯净的人，送上一绺自己的毛发。传说，这些毛，能带来健康、平安与好运。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME gives a lock of its hair to people it senses have pure hearts. Legend has it these hairs bring blessings of health, protection, and luck.

entry: POKENAME用一连串洪亮的吼声交流，合成独特的歌。山中村落，也把它的歌声，当作喜事庆贺。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME communicates with a series of bellowing roars that form a unique song. Mountain villages celebrate POKENAME's singing as a joyous event.

entry: POKENAME愿被善良的训练家持握，让对方满心欢喜。可若被拿来伤人见血，这把剑，又会伤心失落。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME offers itself to be held by kindhearted Trainers, who it fills with joy. However, the sword is disheartened by being used to draw blood.

entry: 据说，POKENAME花中的粉，能带来纯粹的幸福。住在善良的人们身旁，花也会开得最大。
author: gellyfishsh
source: The pollen from POKENAME's flowers is said to bring pure happiness. Its flowers bloom largest when it lives around kindhearted people.

entry: POKENAME寻找善良的人，将幸福送给他们。据说，只须抱它一次，就能让噩梦，多年不再来。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME seeks out the kind-hearted and bestows happiness to them. It is said that just one hug from this Pokémon can ward off nightmares for years.

entry: 它隐去身形，观察其他生命。若总觉得有东西，在暗暗盯着自己，那几乎就是POKENAME。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It turns itself invisible in order to observe others. If you have a creeping feeling of something watching you, it is nearly always a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME体型古怪，走不好路，只能用双翼与超能力，将自己推向想去的方向。
author: cait_sith
source: Due to its awkward body shape, POKENAME is unable to properly walk. It uses its wings and psychic power to propel itself in any direction.

entry: POKENAME的长喙如同吹箭筒，能发射高压水箭。可喙的形状太别扭，也害它，不太游得好。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME's long beak functions as a blowgun that can fire high-pressure water darts. However, the beak's awkward shape prevents it from swimming well.

entry: POKENAME以跺脚配合心灵感应交流。成群走过开阔平原，寻找可口的根与嫩芽。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME communicate with each other through a mix of stomping and telepathy. Herds of POKENAME roam open plains in search of tasty roots and shoots.

entry: 轻盈的步伐与美丽羽冠，让POKENAME在一些地区备受敬重。它的奶会带来奇异幻象，许多人为求启悟，而去饮用。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME are revered in some regions for their light footwork and nice crests. Many drink its milk seeking enlightenment, as it causes unique visions.

entry: POKENAME爬上矮树，啄食新芽，补充体内水液。吃饱后，还爱痛痛快快，洗场泥浴。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME scales short trees to peck at new shoots and replenish its vital fluids. After a meal, it enjoys playful mud baths.

entry: POKENAME会长久晒太阳，预先看出食物将出现在何处。它还能攀树，一跃高达10英尺。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME basks in the sun for long periods of time, being able to predict where food will be in advance. It can jump up to 10 feet and scale trees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躺在蓬松云里。初见训练家或宝可梦时，会有点胆怯，可若认定对方善良，就会慢慢亲近。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically enjoy relaxing in fluffy clouds. Timid when around new Trainers or Pokémon, they can warm up to those whom they deem good at heart.

entry: POKENAME能在暖沙上晒几个小时，静静望着太阳，尤其喜欢日落时分。这样做，似乎能让它放松下来。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can spend hours basking in the warm sand and observing the sun, enjoying this most as the sun sets. They seem to relax when doing this.

entry: POKENAME能窥见对手心思，再按其行为，仔细评判。若觉得不配，便会退出战斗。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME peers into its opponent's mind and thoroughly judges them based on their actions. If it deems its opponent unworthy, it exits the battle.

entry: POKENAME能窥见对手心思，再按其行为，仔细评判。若觉得不配，便会退出战斗。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME peers into its opponent's mind and thoroughly judges them based on their actions. If it deems its opponent unworthy, it exits the battle.

entry: 白天，POKENAME一动不动地凝望太阳。夜幕一落，便飞上天空，出门寻猎。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: During the day, POKENAME stands perfectly still and stares at the sun, but as soon as night falls, it takes to the skies in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME能看见过去与未来。有人甚至推测，它能改变某些事情，最终的结果。
author: MaNandesz
source: POKENAME has the power to peer into the future and past. Some theorize it even has the power to change the outcomes of certain events.

entry: 它游水轻松，能从喙射出水弹，狙击较弱的宝可梦。预知未来的本领，也确保它，百发百中。
author: chartanon
source: It effortlessly swims through the water, sniping weaker Pokémon with shots from its beak. It foresees the future to ensures its shots will always hit.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找小型聚落，想去守护。可谜一般的力量，与让人不安的模样，往往换来人类的疏远。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME seeks out small communities to protect. However, its enigmatic power and unsettling nature often leads to humans shunning it instead.

entry: 这是一位温柔的引魂者，准确知道其他生命，何时将逝。它改变不了必然的命运，却会在最后，给予安慰与引领。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A gentle psychopomp, knowing exactly when others are to die. It cannot stop the inevitable, but it provides comfort and guidance towards the end.

entry: POKENAME能多年纹丝不动，考古学家起初，都误认成了雕像。直到它转了转头，大家才知并非如此。
author: char_latte3412
source: Able to stay perfectly still for years, archaeologists initially mistook POKENAME for a statue. A swivel of its head convinced researchers otherwise.

entry: POKENAME有一小群忠实信众，坚信只要细看头部转动的微妙变化，就能预知未来。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME has a small but loyal group of followers who believe they can see the future by observing the subtle intricacies of its pivoting head.

entry: POKENAME能捕获熟睡者的噩梦，再将噩梦，化为梦雾。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME are used to capture the nightmares of sleeping people. When it captures a nightmare, it turns it into Dream Mist.

entry: 不同地方的POKENAME，懂得不同的舞。这一只跳的，是活着的欢喜。
author: .realthree
source: The dances that a POKENAME knows varies from place to place. This one is dancing to express the joy of living.

entry: 不同地方的POKENAME，懂得不同的舞。这一只跳的，是对胜利的祈愿。
author: .realthree
source: The dances that a POKENAME knows varies from place to place. This one is dancing to express a wish for victory.

entry: 不同地方的POKENAME，懂得不同的舞。这一只跳的，是对和平的祈愿。
author: .realthree
source: The dances that a POKENAME knows varies from place to place. This one is dancing to express a wish for peace.

entry: 不同地方的POKENAME，懂得不同的舞。这一只跳的，是对逝去灵魂的哀悼。
author: .realthree
source: The dances that a POKENAME knows varies from place to place. This one is dancing to express grief for departed souls.

entry: POKENAME周围，似乎环着神秘的气息。谁操作会污染环境的机器，靠得太近，就会遭它诅咒。
author: zotobom
source: A mysterious aura seems to surround POKENAME, cursing any operators of polluting machinery that come near it.

entry: POKENAME精神能量过于强大，几乎时时都在痛苦。许多训练家，也因此反对，创造这种融合体。
author: nowhereandanywhere
source: Because of POKENAME's overwhelming psychic energy, it is in almost constant agony. For this reason, many Trainers oppose creating this fusion.

entry: 它随身带的长杆，能充当电池，存下厚毛间，多余的电力。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The pole it carries acts as a battery to store the excess electricity built up within its thick wool.

entry: 这只宝可梦优雅地飞过天际。随着POKENAME飞翔，静电也一同散入空中。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon flutters gracefully through the skies. Static electricity flies through the air as POKENAME does.

entry: 周围情绪让它压力大时，它便揉揉毛茸茸的大头。这样，也能积起电力，为危险作准备。
author: Skymaster426
source: When it gets stressed from the emotion it feels around it, it rubs its large fluffy head. This allows it to charge its electricity in case of danger.

entry: POKENAME的颚上覆着羊毛，咀嚼时，便常会把静电，释放到猎物身上。
author: Mossybanana
source: Since POKENAME's jaws are covered with wool, it will often discharge static electricity on its prey whilst chewing.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的尾巴互相摩擦，产生静电，再把能量传进刀刃。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's woolly tail generates static electricity by rubbing against itself. This energy is transferred to its blade.

entry: 它操纵静电的本领精湛，能将丰厚的羊毛编成辫子。优雅而纯真的模样，也为许多艺术家带来灵感。
author: miecreates
source: It braids its voluminous wool with an incredible mastery of static electricity. Its graceful but innocent nature has inspired many an artistic spirit.

entry: POKENAME羊毛柔软，性情友善，很受农民欢迎。睡觉时，尾巴还能充当锚，免得自己飘走。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME's soft wool and friendly disposition makes it popular among farmers. Its tail serves as an anchor to keep it from drifting off when asleep.

entry: 它随微风漂浮，羊毛的静电会轻轻电到附近的人。猛烈雷雨来临之前，POKENAME群还常聚在一起玩。
author: fountainihili
source: The static that its wool produces lightly shocks those nearby as it floats in the breeze. Packs of POKENAME play together before severe thunderstorms.

entry: 强烈雷雨中，山脊上能看见它们仰起头，迎接滋养身体的雷电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: During heavy thunderstorms, they can be spotted on mountain ridges, stretching their heads upwards to be struck by nourishing lightning.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在操场与学校附近，诱使孩子触碰黄色圆球，再狠狠电上一下。
author: Sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to float around playgrounds and schools. They entice children into touching their yellow spheres, violently shocking them.

entry: 浓密的毛会不断生长，加固身体周围的屏障。碰到它的人，可能全身麻痹，甚至心脏骤停。
author: alliveir
source: It grows its thick fur to fortify the barrier around it. Those who make contact with this Pokémon may suffer from paralysis or cardiac arrest.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，感到威胁时，就会掀起龙卷风。蓝色羽毛宛如瀑布，还藏着古老的力量。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon, and it will whip up a tornado if threatened. Its blue feathers look like waterfalls and contain an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME是强大的宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比，遇上威胁，更能轻松卷起龙卷风。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon. Its claws are razor sharp, and it will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: 把波拉达养到进化成POKENAME，就能得到十分忠诚的伙伴。羽毛也总打理得干干净净，摸着柔软。
author: VaporVenator
source: Those who keep Pidtata long enough to evolve into POKENAME are rewarded with a very loyal companion. Its feathers are well-cleaned and soft to touch.

entry: POKENAME的双翼能让它以2马赫飞行，却更多用来调节体温。爪子般的双钳，则由钢铁构成。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: While its wings allow it to fly at Mach 2, POKENAME mostly uses them to regulate its body temperature. Its talon-like pincers are made of steel.

entry: 强翼与利爪，让POKENAME能在野外狩猎。体侧的红刺，则保护它珍爱的翅膀，不让敌人伤害。
author: Therider
source: Strong wings and sharp claws allow POKENAME to hunt in the wild. The red spikes along its side prevent attackers from harming its prized wings.

entry: POKENAME战斗身手极其敏捷，无论空中还是地面，都能打得优雅流畅。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are extremely agile in battle. They are capable of fighting gracefully both on land and in the air.

entry: 这两把剑分开飞行时能达到1马赫，一起飞行时则能达到2马赫。它们狩猎效率极高，往往只是为了消遣而狩猎。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The swords fly at mach 1 separated and mach 2 while flying together. They are such effective hunters that they most often hunt for sport.

entry: POKENAME常停在信任的训练家肩头，遇到喜欢的训练家，也会轻轻咕鸣。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME will often perch on the shoulders of Trainers it trusts. It emits a soft, cooing sound around Trainers it likes.

entry: POKENAME住在树梢，吃叶子与枯木。背上的真菌，却夺去了它感受疼痛的能力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in treetops, where it feeds on leaves and dead wood. The fungus on its back robs it of any sense of pain.

entry: POKENAME娇纵得很，一不高兴，就会造成灾难。通常，也只有能满足它需求的富人，才肯饲养。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME has a very spoiled nature. It causes catastrophic damage if upset, so it is usually raised by wealthy people who can satisfy its needs.

entry: POKENAME翼间落下的羊毛，带着蜂蜜般的淡香。制成的洁净床单，也以清新气息出名。
author: .realthree
source: The wool scattered from POKENAME's wings is softly scented like honey. Clean sheets made from this wool are renowned for their fresh smell.

entry: POKENAME的大半电力，来自天然棉絮产生的静电，也因此，尽可能不让自己沾湿。
author: Phantom640
source: Most of POKENAME's power is generated by static electricity from its natural cotton. Because of this, it tries to avoid getting wet whenever possible.

entry: 头部与颈间的羊毛，导电性极好。躯干的羊毛，却能做成世上最出色的电阻器。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The wool on its head and around its neck is highly conductive. The wool around its torso is used to make the best resistor on the planet.

entry: POKENAME担心羊毛变少，发不出足够电力，便常特意放电，权当锻炼。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often discharge its electricity simply as an exercise, as it is concerned about having less wool with which to generate it.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛，能产生更多电力，身体也更耐电击。靠近导电材料，就会激起电弧。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's wool generates more electricity, and its body is more resistant to shocks. Electrical arcs form when it nears conductive materials.

entry: 它漂在雷云间，自然而然地吸收电力。若受惊，圆球便会落下，爆发出足以毁灭一切的电击。
author: Staghorn
source: It floats among storm clouds, passively absorbing a charge. If startled, it drops its orb, which explodes in an annihilative electrical discharge.

entry: 头上的圆珠虽不大，却存着庞大电力。它会用这份能量，射出闪电迎敌。
author: .izik
source: The orb on its head stores vast amounts of electricity, despite its size. If utilizes this energy to attack with bolts of lightning.

entry: 茸茸羊柔软的羊毛，与风妖精优质的棉絮结合，成了极好的织物。这种特殊纤维，广用于靴子、背心与帽子。
author: .ssunday.
source: Flaaffy's soft wool mixed with Whimsicott's great cotton makes the ultimate fabric. This special fiber is used in many boots, vests, and hats.

entry: 羊毛导电迅速，能把电能传遍身体。头部与尾巴的突起，还会试着引来雷击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its conductive wool quickly distributes electrical energy to its body. It tries to attract lightning with the extension on its head and tail.

entry: POKENAME奇妙得很，竟没有任何敌人。那抹滑稽的坏笑，也很受年轻训练家欢迎。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are very unique, as they don't have any enemies. They are a popular choice among young Trainers because of their humorous smirk.

entry: 它靠夜里发出的光，采蜜酿蜜。光又足够明亮，能晃花天敌的眼，将其逼退。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It uses the light it emits at night to gather nectar to produce honey. This light is also bright enough to ward off predators by blinding them.

entry: POKENAME在雷雨里，破坏欲格外强。一些地区越来越担忧这种行为，连天气预报，也常提起。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME become very destructive during thunderstorms. This behavior is a rising concern in some regions, often being mentioned in weather broadcasts.

entry: 融合后，性情平和了，力量却变得更强。可它在附近时，最好还是别游泳。
author: creeps_jr
source: After fusion, this Pokémon has a calmer attitude, but increased power. It's a bad idea to swim with it around.

entry: 它飞在湖泊与溪流上空，有时POKENAME会电击水面，把弱小的鱼宝可梦击昏，作为食物。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon flies above lakes and creeks. POKENAME will sometimes zap the water to knock out weak fish Pokémon. Those fish Pokémon become its meal.

entry: POKENAME常支配其他犬类宝可梦，让它们做自己的仆人。谁不听话，脸上就得挨一记重击。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often control other dog-like Pokémon and make them its servants. If they don't comply, they get a whack to the face.

entry: POKENAME摩擦尾巴上的圆珠，产生足够强的静电，不动手，也能拿起多数物品。
author: mx_wellman
source: By rubbing the orbs on their tails together, POKENAME can generate enough static to pick up most items without using their hands.

entry: POKENAME的毛品质极佳，常被用来制作防静电衣物，因此备受珍视。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME are treasured for the quality of their fur, which is often used to make static-resistant clothes.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME用强光巡视栖身的浅滩。一发现猎物，就以一记电击，将其制服。
author: caladria
source: With its powerful light, POKENAME sweeps the shoals where it makes its home. If prey is spotted, they subdue it with a blast of electricity.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME灯塔般的光，会引来寻宝者与挑战者。它也正热切等着，和这些家伙一较高下。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's beacon-like light attracts treasure-hunters and challengers it is eager to face.

entry: POKENAME会主动寻找迷路的人，引向安全。救下训练家后，多半就会一直，陪在对方身边。
author: Shiina Valkyria (W)
source: POKENAME actively searches for lost people to guide them to safety. Most of the time POKENAME stays with Trainers it rescues forever.

entry: 别被POKENAME可爱的模样骗了。它的尾巴与尖刺，都能释放致命电击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Pokémon Trainers shouldn't be fooled by POKENAME's deceptive cuteness. It can deliver deadly electric shocks via its tail and spikes.

entry: 光芒连太空里，也能看见。天文学家会借助驯养的POKENAME，校准探测器与卫星，重新调整方位。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its light is visible even in space. Domesticated POKENAME are used by astronomers to calibrate or realign space probes and satellites.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: 它平日温顺，可一察觉幼崽遇险，便会立刻抡起水晶球，砸向一切威胁。
author: coooooooookiee
source: Though this Pokémon is usually docile, it's quick to clobber anything with its crystal ball if it senses that its young are in danger.

entry: 它用牙齿凿开岩石，藏好耐心等待。猎物一游过，POKENAME先电昏对方，再张颚咬下。
author: Gummy Wookie
source: It makes holes in rocks with its teeth and hides patiently. When prey swims by, POKENAME stuns it with its electricity before its jaws snap it up.

entry: POKENAME十分热心，会救助海上迷途的水手。每颗红珠的光，都亮得足以穿透浓雾。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME are extremely helpful Pokémon that help lost sailors at sea. Each of their red orbs can shine brightly enough to cut through dense fog.

entry: 它待在岸边，发出灯光，替船只引路。人们却不知道，POKENAME其实想让船沉没，好拿来取乐。
author: KidDivinegon
source: This Pokémon hangs out on the shore and shines lights to guide ships. What people don't know is that POKENAME is trying to sink those vessels for fun.

entry: POKENAME身体在黑暗中明亮发光，方向感也出色，能帮训练家，穿过复杂的洞穴群。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's body glows brightly in dark areas. It has a great sense of direction and can help its Trainer navigate through cave networks.

entry: 它用尾部灯光，发出假的求救信号，欺骗水手。得逞后，便笑得令人毛骨悚然。
author: mistershaokahn
source: The light emitted by its tail is used to deceive sailors by sending out false S.O.S. messages. When it succeeds, it lets out a blood-curdling laugh.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，就会撒出粉末，让植物长得更好，活得更长。
author: .ssunday.
source: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME spread a powder which promotes growth and longevity in plants.

entry: 它把阳光变成电力，再射出雷电。POKENAME的花越红、越深，便代表蓄电越多。
author: EcoVermination
source: It turns sunlight into electricity, before firing off bolts of lightning. The darker the red POKENAME's flowers are, the more charged up it is.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴虽美，里面却可能藏着高达1000伏的电压。花朵有时，更亮得宛如太阳。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME tail, although pretty, can have up to 1000 volts of electricity hiding inside. This Pokémon's flowers sometimes shine as bright as the sun.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME的花瓣褪得苍白，身影却藏进了阴影。它融于黑暗，静待猎物活动。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's petals pale in the moonlight, masking it in shadow. It waits, blending into darkness until prey stirs.

entry: POKENAME有时会聚在林间小路，搭成一道花拱。最明亮的花在顶端，较弱的则从下方，吸取养分。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME sometimes gather and form an arch over forest footpaths. The brightest blooms form the top, while the weakest draw nutrients from below.

entry: POKENAME会把身上长出的花，送给伤心的人。跳舞时，身上也飘出怡人的香气。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME offers the flowers growing on its body to those who are sad. When it dances, a pleasing scent wafts from its body.

entry: POKENAME体贴得像位母亲，常照料成群的美丽花，视如自己的孩子。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME has a very caring and motherly personality. It is often seen tending to groups of Bellossom as if they were its own children.

entry: 它以舞蹈凝聚波导，舞步既能和着自然声响，也能跟随人类的音乐。
author: keksalot2000
source: This Pokémon focuses its aura through dance. It synchronizes these dances to the sounds of nature and the music of humans.

entry: POKENAME以海滩上的欢快舞姿闻名。它一跳，周围的大家，也都神清气爽。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME is known for its cheerful dance that it performs on beaches. When it dances, everyone around feels refreshed.

entry: 跳舞时，它的叶片会散发烤哈密果般的柔和香气。偶尔找到来历不明的种子，它也会收集起来。
author: .izik
source: While it dances, its leaves give off the soft scent of baked Hondew Berries. It occasionally finds seeds from an unknown source and hoards them.

entry: 看见POKENAME，就知道春天快到了。若能接住它的一朵花，更被视为吉兆。
author: caladria
source: Sightings of POKENAME are a sure sign that springtime is nearly here. Catching one of their flowers is considered a good omen.

entry: 别被鲜花与天真的模样骗了，POKENAME附肢上的刺，可不是摆设。扎上一下，就像被纸划了百万道口子。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: Don't let the flowers and innocent demeanor fool you, the thorns on POKENAME'S appendages are not for show. One prick feels like a million paper cuts.

entry: 它飞行时，翼上的叶片会落下。烹饪家会将其收集，取用淡淡的薄荷香气。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on its wings fall to the ground while it flies. Culinarians gather these for their mild minty scent.

entry: POKENAME已永久扎根沙中。它演出讨喜的节目，吸引其他生命，盼着得到些，养分丰富的食物。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has become permanently rooted in the sand. It puts on adorable shows to attract others, hoping they will offer it nutrient-rich food.

entry: POKENAME常因外表，被人看轻。这反倒让它们，越发坚定，要在战斗中证明自己。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are often not taken seriously due to their appearance. This only further strengthens their resolve to prove themselves in battle.

entry: 口中散出诱人的花香，引来猎物。若吃下里面的叶子，又会困得难以支撑。
author: .izik
source: It releases a delicious floral scent from its mouth to attract prey. The leaves in its mouth can cause extreme drowsiness if consumed.

entry: POKENAME虽在某些地方受崇敬，平日却几乎什么也不做，只偶尔滚两下，进行光合作用。
author: RAWTHORN
source: Although revered in some regions, POKENAME have been observed to do very little. They occasionally roll around to photosynthesize.

entry: 大葱如今开了花，味道便没那么好。不过，花香会引来POKENAME最爱的食物：虫宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: Now that the leek has blossomed, it doesn't taste very good. The flowers' aroma lures in Bug-type Pokémon, which is POKENAME's favorite food.

entry: 它用甜美的模样引来猎物，看着可爱，其实嗜血得很。花朵的气味，也像罂粟一样。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon lures in prey with its sweet looks. It may look cute, but in fact it's extremely bloodthirsty. Its flowers smell like poppies.

entry: 海岸边，常能看见POKENAME比着彼此的壳。据说，那些住着的壳，原属于古代宝可梦。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME often is found along shorelines comparing their shells to other POKENAME. The shell it inhabits is said to be that of an ancient Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME使用特殊的武术，把球状尾巴，当作重击的武器。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses a special form of martial arts that involves using its ball tail as a bludgeoning weapon.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，常陪孩子玩耍，住在温暖河流，冲刷成的陡峭山谷里。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is docile, and you can often find it playing with children. It lives in steep valleys formed by warm rivers.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，常陪孩子玩耍。这个个体，还拥有罕见的配色。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is docile, and you can often find it playing with children. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: 不知怎的，两只温顺的宝可梦融合后，竟变得自信满满、斗志昂扬。它能灵巧地踢动自己的尾巴，从各种角度击中对手。
author: miecreates
source: Somehow, two meek Pokémon become a fusion full of confidence and battle spirit. It deftly kicks its own tail to strike opponents from any angle.

entry: POKENAME安静平和，把大尾巴当作软床。实在太舒服，也就不怎么肯动。
author: matpal6
source: POKENAME is a calm Pokémon that uses its sizable tail as its cozy bed. It does not move often, as it is always comfortable.

entry: POKENAME靠水生活，吃些水生猎物。尾部的圆球，在水中能充当刹车，让它很快就能重新起飞。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME live near bodies of water, subsisting on aquatic prey. The baubles of its tails act as water brakes, allowing it to quickly take off again.

entry: POKENAME的毛能排水，出水后很快就干。没在游泳时，便大口享用树果，吃个心满意足。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's hydro-resistant fur allows it to dry off easily when exiting water. When it's not swimming, it feasts on berries to its hearts content.

entry: 因被剥去皮肤而愤怒，它进化出用尾巴作棍棒的本领，保护自己。若看见它朝你冲来，就快跑吧。
author: Soup1900
source: Angered at its skinning, it has evolved to be able to use its own tail as a club to defend itself. If you see one charging towards you, run.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，是受欢迎的宠物。可在水里玩起来，常不小心用角，撞破玻璃容器。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon's adorable features make it a popular pet. However, POKENAME unwittingly breaks glass containers with its horn as it frolics in water.

entry: 沉重的外壳，让POKENAME难以在急流中游动。它索性沿着沙质河底，翻滚着前进。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: The shell on its body makes it hard for POKENAME to properly swim in strong currents. It has resorted to tumbling along the sandy bottoms instead.

entry: POKENAME听力极敏锐，甚至能察觉河床上，其他宝可梦产生的电脉冲。
author: nelluc27
source: Known for their superb hearing, POKENAME are capable of detecting the electric impulses of Pokémon on riverbed floors.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间沙滩徘徊，享受凉爽的夜游，可常因此，吓着游客。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Known to roam beaches at night, POKENAME usually frightens tourists as it enjoys a cool night swim.

entry: POKENAME是探险者的多功能宝可梦工具，既能当棍棒，又能探听声音，还能在水下提供气泡。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a Pokémon multi-tool for explorers. It can be used as a club, a auditory sensor, and an underwater air bubble dispenser.

entry: 它欢快地跳过水坑，皮毛靴让身体保持干爽。战斗时，则与尾巴配合，跳出难以预测的狂舞。
author: miecreates
source: It cheerfully prances through puddles, kept dry by its fur boots. In battle, it fights in tandem with its tail in a wildly unpredictable dance.

entry: 气泡虽易破，却马上能再生。放松时，它便把气泡当游泳圈，悠悠漂在水面。
author: typhloquil
source: While its bubbles are frail, they will regenerate right away. When relaxing, it uses its bubbles like a pool float to drift in the water.

entry: 气泡多得成了负担，它就会将其甩落。小宝可梦可能被困在里面，大一些的个体，甚至能困住人。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: When overburdened with bubbles, it can shed them from it's body. This has been known to trap small Pokémon, and larger specimens can even trap people.

entry: POKENAME看着可爱，却是难以攻破的对手。它在场上欢快滚动，沿途什么，都要被压平。
author: togetik
source: Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME is an impervious opponent. It joyfully rolls around the field, flattening anything in its path.

entry: 融合后，它的性情温和得出奇。人们也常借这种融合，更安全地养育单首龙。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: After being fused, its personality becomes shockingly passive. This is usually fused as a safer way to raise Deino.

entry: POKENAME住在火山活跃的海滩附近，口中喷出的水，温度能超过华氏210度。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME resides near beaches with volcanic activity. It can spew water from its mouth with temperatures over 210°F.

entry: POKENAME敏锐的双耳，能感知附近水域的动静。若发现有人溺水，便会立刻赶去救助。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's attentive ears could sense motion in nearby bodies of water. If it senses anyone drowning, it will immediately go to rescue them.

entry: 夏日里，POKENAME会活泼地微笑着吸食花蜜，但一有人靠近，就会僵在原地。靠得太近时，它们便会释放孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are seen active and smiling on summer days, drinking from flowers, but will freeze if approached. Come too close, and they release spores.

entry: 它每到整点，分秒不差地探出身体，发出咕鸣，因此在乡间十分受欢迎。有时，也住在森林里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This fusion is popular in rural areas, as the body emerges every hour to the second and emits a cooing sound. Occasionally, it also lives in forests.

entry: POKENAME很受豪华家具收藏家青睐，与老派房间十分相配，又不用四处走动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is a popular fusion for collectors of luxury furniture. It perfectly complements rather old-fashioned rooms and doesn't need to move.

entry: 它正朝着伪装大师迈进，心心念念，想让枝上长出真正的叶子。
author: birchbot
source: This Pokémon is on its way to being the master of disguise. It desires to grow real leaves on its branches.

entry: POKENAME背上的树才怪，常动弹不得。充当遮雨物时，有时还能听见，它在哭着求救。
author: .ssunday.
source: The Sudowoodo on top of POKENAME's back is often unable to move. It is sometimes heard crying for help as it serves as protection from the rain.

entry: POKENAME坚持维持树木般的风格，专挑最弯曲的枝条，装在帽子上。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME is adamant about keeping its tree aesthetic. It selects the most crooked branches to put on its hat.

entry: POKENAME的迷彩，让它在森林里更隐蔽。可花纹始终是绿色，也让它不太喜欢冬天。
author: birchbot
source: The camouflage pattern on POKENAME helps it blend into forests better. It doesn't like the winter because the pattern stays green.

entry: POKENAME藏进树洞，露出大颚。猎物错把颚认成树的一部分，在里面筑巢，却迎来突然的死亡。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME hides in tree hollows, its jaws sticking out. Prey mistake the jaws for part of the tree and nest in them, then are met with a sudden demise.

entry: POKENAME不是木头，是岩石，核心还由石墨构成。它爱在墙上画树，一被看见，又把脸藏好。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is not made of wood, but rock; its core is made of graphite. It likes drawing trees on walls and hides its face when observed.

entry: 这种融合体，性情差异极大。有些守护弱者，有些却装成树，吓路人一跳，再转身逃跑。
author: OhOk3441
source: This fusion tends to vary wildly in personality. Some protect the weak while others pretend to be trees and try to scare passerby before running away.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会朝对手射出利如刀刃的叶片，脸上的表情，却几乎从不改变。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME fires off razor sharp leaves at opponents in battle. Its expression rarely changes.

entry: POKENAME陷入困境，就试着讨好敌人。可它向来善骗，一有机会，便立刻逃走。
author: birchbot
source: When a POKENAME is caught in a tricky situation, it will try to charm its enemy. Of course, this Pokémon is a liar, so it flees as soon as possible.

entry: 它不再装成树，而改装灌木，喜欢突然跳出来吓人，纯粹觉得好玩。
author: birchbot
source: Instead of pretending to be a tree, it pretends to be a bush. It likes to playfully ambush people just for fun.

entry: POKENAME会在远离人烟的地方扎根。传说，曾有POKENAME原地待了100年，长到100多英尺高。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME will find a spot isolated from civilization to take root. Legends said a POKENAME stayed in place for 100 years, and grew over 100 feet tall.

entry: 进了森林，若忽觉背脊发凉，眼前一切也许并不简单。远处那棵树，很可能就是POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: When you enter a forest and feel a chill up your spine, not all may be what it seems. That tree in the distance may very well be POKENAME.

entry: 进了森林，若忽觉背脊发凉，眼前一切也许并不简单。远处那棵树，很可能就是POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: When you enter a forest and feel a chill up your spine, not all may be what it seems. That tree in the distance may very well be POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME每天同一时刻，都会高声呱鸣。野外族群又常齐声合唱，借此驱走天敌。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME croak loudly at the same time each day. Wild populations often synchronize their croaks, which helps drive away potential predators.

entry: 呱呱鸣叫时，它们的喉咙会泛起电光。夜晚，POKENAME聚居的森林，既有悦目的光，也有动听的鸣声。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: Their throats glow with electricity when croaking. Forests with POKENAME flocks look and sound beautiful at night.

entry: POKENAME有成群结队，沿急流漂下的习性。有人说，遇见它们时，还能听到“快乐的呱声”。
author: Zeeroooo
source: POKENAME have a history of gathering into large pods and floating down fast rivers. Some say you can hear “croaks of joy” when you encounter them.

entry: 它常在水面蹦跳，不必游泳。即使被招惹、陷入危险，也总像带着微笑。
author: imagine1.
source: It often hops around on water, avoiding the need to swim. It always seems to be smiling, even when provoked to danger.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME能带来雨季。这只善良的宝可梦，也愿给一切需要的生命，提供淡水。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME is thought to help usher in the rainy season. This kind Pokémon will provide fresh water anyone who needs it.

entry: POKENAME宽大的荷叶，是其他两栖伙伴的避难所。它走遍湿地，寻找疲惫的生命，收留它们。
author: Thropp
source: POKENAME's large lily pad provides sanctuary for its fellow amphibians. It roams the wetlands, searching for weary creatures to take in.

entry: POKENAME吸收池水与雨水。天一干，就呱鸣着引来蚊香君与蚊香蝌蚪，请它们替自己淋水。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs water from ponds or rain. When the weather is dry, it croaks to attract Poliwhirl and Poliwag to shower them.

entry: 它在池里，整夜放声歌唱。可惜，对睡在附近的人，这就不是什么好事了。
author: zerocipher
source: This amphibian Pokémon is known to sing all night in its pond, which is unfortunate for those sleeping nearby.

entry: 云雾源源不断地从它的大口中喷出。云中落下的雨水能帮助它抵御恶劣天气。
author: moopse
source: A constant stream of clouds spews from its maw. The rain that falls from these clouds help to protect it against the elements.

entry: POKENAME先用阴森呱鸣引来猎物，再一把缠住，拖入黑暗。此后，便再无人见过。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME lures its prey with a sinister croak before ensnaring them. Once bound, it drags them into the darkness, never to be seen again.

entry: 颈间的褶边，能感知将来的降雨。它统御沼泽，要附近所有宝可梦，都敬它、怕它。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The frills on its neck can sense oncoming rain. It rules over the swamps, demanding respect and fear from all nearby Pokémon.

entry: 这只快乐的宝可梦，爱把好心情传出去。它一欢呼，身上的云便会降雨，滋养当地草木。
author: moopse
source: This happy Pokémon loves to spread positivity. As it cheers, rain falls from the clouds on its body, helping local plant life.

entry: 它水做的鬃毛让脖子上的岩石保持湿润，因此长出了藻类。这是一种共生关系，因为藻类能在水下为它提供氧气。
author: .realthree
source: Its watery mane keeps the rocks on its neck damp, so algae grows there. This relationship is symbiotic, as the algae provides oxygen underwater.

entry: POKENAME的一颗头，总把另一颗当食物。另一颗头，也就时时为不被吃掉，拼命反抗。
author: terminatphilippe
source: One head of POKENAME always takes the other head as food. Due to this, the second head is always fighting to not be eaten.

entry: POKENAME看着吓人，内心却多半善良，与训练家、队伍里的同伴，也能成为最要好的朋友。
author: spencerrdevv
source: Although seen as intimidating, POKENAME are often very kind at heart, and even begin making best friends with their Trainers and fellow party members.

entry: POKENAME脑袋不灵光，是出了名的。可它并不在乎，日子照样，无忧无虑。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is notoriously low on intelligence. Despite that failing, it lives a carefree life.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物，能迅速修复受损铠甲，让它成为极难打倒的战士。
author: grassy311
source: The plant on its back allows POKENAME to quickly repair any damage to its armor, making it an extremely resilient fighter.

entry: POKENAME翼展惊人，身体又轻，强翼只扇一下，升力就够它，环绕世界两周。
author: grassy311
source: Due to POKENAME's impressive wingspan and light weight, one flap of its powerful wings generates enough lift to carry it around the world twice over.

entry: POKENAME爱钻进含铁丰富的土里。这样既能增强铠甲，又能给背上的植物补充宝贵养分。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME loves to burrow in iron-rich soil. Not only does it strengthen its armor, it supplies the plant on its back with precious nutrients.

entry: 它在含铁丰富的土壤中生长良好。植物的根系，也能让铠甲各处连接得更牢。
author: grassy311
source: This Pokémon thrives in areas with iron-rich soil. The roots of its plant components help to strengthen the bonds of its armor.

entry: POKENAME随清爽夏风，悠悠漂荡。夏日里的孩子们，最爱陪POKENAME玩耍。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to drift along fresh summer breezes. Children love to play with POKENAME during the summer months.

entry: 它喜欢乘着和风漂浮，靠小小的翅膀，控制方向。
author: grassy311
source: This Pokémon loves to float on gentle breezes. It can control its direction using its small wings.

entry: 头顶螺旋桨般的叶片，让POKENAME极易升空。夏天，还能听见它美妙的歌，随风传来。
author: grassy311
source: The propeller leaves on its head give POKENAME incredible lift. In the summer, you can hear its beautiful song carry on the wind.

entry: POKENAME身上的真菌，只在蒲公英旁生长。POKENAME性情虽甜，尝起来，却是苦的。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus on POKENAME is only found growing alongside dandelions. POKENAME has a sweet disposition, but a bitter flavor.

entry: POKENAME跑遍田野，用长喙拔出萝卜与生菜，偷偷带走。农民们，自然很不欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME runs across fields and steals turnips and lettuce by pulling them out of the ground with its long beak. They are not popular with farmers.

entry: 野生POKENAME，能毁掉整季的收成。可有些农民，倒成功将它们驯服，训练成快速犁田的帮手。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Wild POKENAME devastate entire harvests. However, some farmers manage to tame them and train them to rapidly plow their fields instead.

entry: POKENAME不肯离壳，可壳又太沉，便哪里也去不了。壳若晒不到阳光，POKENAME还会死去。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME refuses to leave its shell. Therefore, it cannot move, as it is far too heavy. If the shell is kept out of sunlight, POKENAME will perish.

entry: POKENAME成了彻底的隐士，决定永远住在壳里，又拿盛开的花朵，装点自己的新家。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME has become a complete hermit, choosing to forever live in its shell. It decorates its new home with blooming flowers.

entry: 它们更常在夜里现身。发光的触角，能让随气流漂浮的它，吸引其他POKENAME靠近。
author: KitArchen
source: They are often seen at night, rather than during the day. Their glowing antennae allow them to attract other POKENAME as they float on air currents.

entry: 花朵里燃着幽灵之火。POKENAME开心时，火焰就会高高蹿起，格外明亮。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's flowers burn with a spectral fire. These flames burn bright and tall when POKENAME is happy.

entry: POKENAME分泌的不是奶，而是甜美花蜜。有人相信，这种蜜有十分强大的疗伤功效。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME secretes a sweet nectar from its udders instead of milk. Some believe this nectar has very potent healing properties.

entry: 遇上POKENAME，会让人心生诡异的不祥预感，仿佛它缥缈的形态里，藏着生死的奥秘。
author: anarchaz
source: Those who encounter POKENAME are filled with an eerie sense of foreboding, as if it holds the mysteries of life and death within its ethereal form.

entry: POKENAME常由遗落荒野的玩偶诞生。它们踏上长途，想与主人重逢，偏偏方向感，又差得很。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME commonly arise from dolls lost in wild fields. They go on long journeys to reunite with their owner, but they have a bad sense of direction.

entry: 它在阳光下格外有活力。太阳的能量，又让本已惊人的飞速，更上一层。
author: grassy311
source: This Pokémon thrives in the sunlight. The energy it gets from the sun accelerates its already impressive flying speeds.

entry: POKENAME住在晴暖草地，藏于花丛。花粉引发的鲜明幻觉，也能帮它逃过天敌。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's pollen induces vivid hallucinations, which helps it escape from predators. It lives in sunny meadows and hides among the flowers.

entry: 温暖、晴朗的天气，最适合POKENAME。它便尽可能飞高，想离太阳更近一点。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME thrives in warm and sunny weather. It flies as high as it can in order to get closer to the sun.

entry: POKENAME最爱晒太阳，黎明便朝东飞，只想让日光，多照自己一会儿。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME loves to bask in the sun. It will fly eastward at the break of dawn to sun itself for as long as possible.

entry: POKENAME让头上的扇叶，迎向强风，就能乘风而去，一路滑过几公里，抵达新的草地。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME points the fans on its head against strong winds, it is swept along. In this way, it glides several kilometers to new meadows.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，胳膊也短，可拳头打出的力道，却足以把钢铁，生生折弯。
author: T.I.A.
source: POKENAME have a short temper and short range with their fists. However, they can deliver enough force to bend steel.

entry: POKENAME总是喜笑颜开，仿佛不停点头答应。可软绵绵的拳头，对多数宝可梦，都没什么威力。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME always has a happy expression, like it's nodding 'yes' all the time. Its soft punches aren't very effective against most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME乘暖风，漂洋过海，前往遥远的大地。甜美香气飘散，连最激烈的争斗，也能安抚。
author: anarchaz
source: Riding warm winds, POKENAME sails across seas to distant lands. It emits a sweet fragrance, calming even fierce battles.

entry: POKENAME把身上长出的棉花揉成球，挥打向敌人。“百代杂技”网球队的灵感，正来自它。
author: Shocktopus
source: POKENAME makes balls out of the cotton that grows from its body, and whacks them at its enemies. It inspired The Eterna Acrobats tennis team.

entry: 它活力十足地起舞，散播种子。可即便如此，还是常被看作，消极的象征。
author: fixthewifi
source: It spreads its seeds by dancing energetically. Despite this, it is often viewed as a symbol of negativity.

entry: POKENAME最常现身于，春天刚到的地方。也有人，将它奉为春之神。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME appear most often in places where Spring has just arrived. Some people worship it as a god of Spring.

entry: POKENAME抓着尾巴，把它当阳伞，兜住强风。轻轻跳过最爱的草地，身子仿佛，一点重量也没有。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME hangs onto its tail like a parasol to catch and ride strong winds. It appears weightless as it bounces through its favorite meadows.

entry: POKENAME爱钻进手机，装成表情符号，再随着短信与社交媒体帖子，四处传播。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME loves to hide in phones, disguising itself as an emoji. It spreads via text messages and posts on social media.

entry: POKENAME挥着毽子棉绒毛做的绒球，一心想当一位，热情洋溢的啦啦队员。
author: thisisaplaceholder
source: POKENAME wields pom-poms made of Jumpluff's fluff. It aspires to be a passionate cheerleader.

entry: POKENAME空中技巧高超，连巢也能托在翅膀上。它会滑翔数周，直到巢里的雏鸟，终于孵出。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME is so good at navigating through the air, it can carry its nest on its wings. It will glide through the air for weeks until its chicks hatch.

entry: 它们用绒毛与棉絮筑屋。屋子一被吹走，POKENAME便坐在里面，前往新的土地。
author: Staghorn
source: They construct lodges out of fluff and cotton. When these lodges blow away, the POKENAME ride inside them to travel to new lands.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，几乎能与谁都相处。若依恋上某个人，还会能跟多久，就跟多久。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is very friendly and can get along with just about anyone. It may even grow attached to someone and follow them for as long as it's able.

entry: POKENAME在森林田野，其实多得很，见过的人却很少。它身披幻象，经过旁边，也无人察觉。
author: .realthree
source: Few people ever see POKENAME, though they live in abundance in forests and fields. The illusions it wears allow it to pass by unnoticeably.

entry: 棉絮状的孢子，能让它长途滑翔。它还会调节体温，控制自己飞行的高度。
author: grassy311
source: This Pokémon glides for long distances using its cotton-puff spores. It can control its altitude using its own body temperature.

entry: POKENAME常飞上高空寻食。累了，便靠棉絮般的孢子，长久悬浮在那里。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME often flies high in search of food. When it gets tired, cotton-puff spores allow it to float in high altitudes for long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME舞得热烈，翼间的绒毛种子，也跟着四散。种子落在哪里，哪里的土，就更加肥沃。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's frenetic dance helps it scatter the fluffy seeds that grow from its wings. These seeds enrich the soil wherever they land.

entry: 它一叹气，就会离地飘起，随风而去，沿途把花粉，撒遍田野。
author: ClawsHDi
source: When it sighs, it lifts off the ground and starts to float away, spreading pollen across the fields.

entry: POKENAME容易发怒，常袭击训练家。可拳头全是棉花，打起来，根本不痛。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME is easily irritated and is known to attack Trainers frequently. However, due to having cotton for fists, its punches don't hurt at all.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME被攻击时，就旋转头顶的突起，扬起大量种子，挡住敌人的视线，再趁机逃走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME is attacked, it whirls the outgrowths on its head around to block its opponent's view with lots of seeds and then runs away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用鼻尖，抛接棉球取乐。可孢子一钻进鼻子，引得喷嚏，往往就失去平衡。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME likes to play by juggling cotton puffs on the tip of its nose. In most cases, they will lose balance once the cotton spores make it sneeze.

entry: POKENAME背上的奶酪，臭得让宝可梦，都不想靠近。可在有些地方，反被奉为珍馐。
author: kiwikelly
source: The cheese POKENAME grows on its back smells so rancid that no Pokémon want to be anywhere near it. It is, however, quite a delicacy in some regions.

entry: 它偶尔在球果树的树干上，留下细小齿痕，不至于伤树太重，也能告诉同类，这是自己的领地。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally, it makes small teeth marks on an apricorn tree trunk. This tells others of its territory without damaging the tree extensively.

entry: 体内不断产生的毒气，让POKENAME浮了起来。它也能通过牙齿，将毒素传给对方。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It continuously produces poisonous gases in its body that cause POKENAME to float. It can transmit these poisons via its teeth.

entry: POKENAME容易焦虑，便咬着自己的藤蔓，缓解压力。凡是牙够得着的东西，也都要啃两口。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are anxious Pokémon who chew on their own vines to relieve stress. They also gnaw on anything else they can get their fangs on.

entry: POKENAME成群搜刮田野，种子、坚果与能吃的嫩芽，全不放过，再把食物，囤进共用的地下巢穴。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME work in groups to strip fields of every seed, nut, and edible bud they find. They hoard their provisions in their underground communal nests.

entry: 它常见于大城市，比起比比鸟，更适应肮脏环境。视力锐利，连幽暗小巷中的猎物也能找着。
author: char_latte3412
source: A common sight in major cities, it thrives in dirtier environments compared to Pidgeotto. Its keen vision enables it to spot prey even in dark alleys.

entry: 毛团的口感，如棉花糖。明明粉红，吃着却像切达奶酪，还长得特别快。
author: .izik
source: Its puffs have the same consistency as cotton candy. Despite being pink, they taste like cheddar cheese and regrow quickly.

entry: 这群小拉达始终相伴，共同作为一只宝可梦行动。最大的一只，又被选作全群的王。
author: kiwikelly
source: This colony of Rattata is always together, as they function as one Pokémon. The largest Rattata is chosen as the king of the pack.

entry: POKENAME会加入小拉达群，自称首领。各群之间，为生存与统治，争斗不休。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are known to join groups of Rattata claiming to be their leader. These groups fight for survival and control.

entry: POKENAME把奶酪做成月牙，或许，便是“月亮由奶酪做成”传说的由来。可它为什么这样做，研究人员仍不解。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME shapes cheese into crescents, which likely gave rise to the cheese moon myth. Researchers are baffled as to why it exhibits this behavior.

entry: 果野村有一位老妇人，用POKENAME的羽毛缝制玩偶。绒羽软和，做成的玩具，很受幼儿欢迎。
author: .izik
source: There is an old woman in Arborville that uses POKENAME's feathers to create dolls. Due to the down's softness, these toys are popular for toddlers.

entry: POKENAME常偷郊区住家的奶酪。它们聪明得狡猾，还会组织行动，尽可能多偷一些。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are commonly seen stealing cheese from suburban homes. They are devilishly clever and organize heists to steal as much cheese as they can.

entry: POKENAME身上，点缀着各式奶酪。做奶酪的原料，又全是POKENAME迅速偷来的。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is adorned with various cheeses. These cheeses are formed from ingredients that POKENAME has swiftly stolen away.

entry: 野生POKENAME会指使手下，替自己办事。这种习性，让它们很受犯罪分子的青睐。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are known to employ underlings to do their bidding. They are highly sought after by criminals.

entry: 野生POKENAME会指使手下，替自己办事。这种习性，让它们很受犯罪分子的青睐。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are known to employ underlings to do their bidding. They are highly sought after by criminals.

entry: 它明明怕水，却爱在溪边筑巢。水位一涨，就惊慌逃走。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fear of water, it tends to make its den by the side of creeks. If the water level rises, it runs in fear.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会演出小小的舞蹈，逗大家开心。太受喜爱，遇到天敌时，其他宝可梦，也会奋力保护它们。
author: kiwikelly
source: Groups of POKENAME put on little dance shows to entertain others. They are so beloved that other Pokémon will fiercely defend them from predators.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿，由钢合金构成。想要磨短，实在是件费工夫的事。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME's teeth are made of a steel alloy. This makes wearing them down a tedious experience.

entry: POKENAME在暗巷狩猎，越饿，瞄准的受害者就越大。人们只好投食，免得它向人类下手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME are found in dark alleyways where they hunt. They target larger victims the hungrier they are, so are fed to deter attacks on humans.

entry: 剪刀般的门牙，用岩石磨得锋利，不管物件还是猎物，都照切不误。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It cuts objects and victims indiscriminately with its scissor-like incisors, which it sharpens on rocks.

entry: POKENAME胆子小，却爱探索周围。想吸引它的训练家，可以在附近，摆些能勾起兴趣的玩具。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Skittish in nature, POKENAME loves to explore its area. Trainers are advised to keep stimulating toys around if seeking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME啃着岩石，寻找月之石的粉末。粉末虽好吃，石头也会磕缺尖牙，让牙刃锋利而参差。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME chews on rocks to find Moonstone dust deposits. While the dust is tasty, the rocks chip off part of its fangs, leaving them sharp and jagged.

entry: 夜里，它朝月亮唱着摇篮曲。到了白天，又能听见它，轻哼同一支萦绕不去的旋律。
author: .izik
source: It sings lullabies to the moon at night. During the daytime you can hear it humming the same haunting melody.

entry: POKENAME极易受惊，见什么像威胁，便挥尾驱赶。结果，也常引起森林火灾。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is very skittish, and will wave its tail at anything it sees as a threat. This often leads to forest fires.
