entry: POKENAME用高亢的吱叫，回声定位，搜出猎物，再以愤怒门牙，将其击倒。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME echolocates with its high-pitched squeaks, which it uses to find its prey. It then takes them down with its Super Fang attack.

entry: POKENAME顽固得很，总与野生宝可梦，打些没必要的架，因此，出了名地难以训练。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are extremely stubborn, often getting into needless fights with wild Pokémon. They are known to be difficult to train.

entry: 它们成群闯进繁忙城市，四处寻食。有些地区，甚至开始奖励，抓到足够数量的人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Swarms of them infest busy cities in search for food. Some regions have even started offering rewards for capturing enough of them.

entry: 据说，POKENAME常成群出没下水道。外壳的形状，让它们能顺着管道，轻松滑行。
author: holgast
source: Groups of POKENAME are said to frequent sewers. Their shell makes it easy to slide through the pipes.

entry: POKENAME曾啃咬电线，造成大范围停电。可它们这么做，纯粹出于怨恨与恶意。
author: 8xviktor
source: There have been instances of POKENAME causing mass power outages by biting into electrical wires. They do this purely out of spite and malice.

entry: 它的牙齿，能轻松咬穿硬岩，在废弃矿坑里，组成庞大群落。
author: cait_sith
source: Its teeth can easily bite through solid rock. It lives in extensive colonies in abandoned mines.

entry: 它每根藤蔓的末端都开着手掌模样的花。它会用这些“手”敲打背上的种子，发出水泡翻涌般的声音。
author: holgast
source: Each of its vines end in a flower that mimics a hand. It uses these to drum on its bulb, creating a sound like bubbling water.

entry: 等待进化时，它用尾端的手，攀住树枝。掌心黏性，也格外强。
author: .izik
source: It uses the hand on its tail to cling to a branch while it waits to evolve. The palm of the hand is extremely adhesive.

entry: 它摘花瓣时，毫无规律。可攒够一把，又会坐到树梢，有条不紊地，数上一遍。
author: .izik
source: It grabs petals off of flowers an uneven pattern. It methodically counts them on a tree top after it collects a handful.

entry: POKENAME的舌头，长得像手，伸缩自如，想伸多长、收多短，都随心意。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME has an extremely stretchy tongue that is shaped like a hand. It is able to extend and retract this hand at will.

entry: 这种POKENAME专为家养而培育，常在幼儿园里，陪孩子们玩。
author: themicelegion
source: This form of POKENAME was specifically bred for domestication. They are commonly found in preschools as playmates for children.

entry: 这个品种的POKENAME听觉敏锐，触须般的双臂又能伸长，可在远处，扇击敌人。
author: themicelegion
source: This breed of POKENAME has a great sense of hearing. It uses its stretchy, tendril-like arms to slap foes from a distance.

entry: 夜里，它会发出刺耳、激烈的约德尔调喊声。好几只POKENAME一聚，露营者就只好离开森林。
author: .izik
source: It makes a very aggressive yodeling noise at night. When multiple POKENAME get together, campers will leave the forest.

entry: 毒刺中的毒液，只须几秒，就能让人昏迷。敌人倒下时，它还会对着对方，咯咯直笑。
author: .izik
source: The venom in its stinger can render a human unconscious in seconds. It giggles at its foe as it gets knocked out.

entry: 它进食时，会乱挥尾端的手，不让别人抢食。每一下挥击，都足以打断骨头。
author: .izik
source: It swings the hand on its tail wildly as it eats to deter others from stealing its meal. Each swing has the power to break bones.

entry: 它挖洞、盖上树枝，做成储藏树果的地方。每逢秋天，一天就能这样，挖上好几处。
author: .izik
source: It digs out a hole and covers it in branches to create its berry hoard. It will do this multiple times a day during the autumn months.

entry: POKENAME爱向路人挥手，飞累了，又会替自己，轻轻按按摩。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME loves to wave to people who pass by. When it's tired in flight, it'll give itself a slight massage.

entry: POKENAME手臂般的尾巴，黏性极强。它能边飞，边从毫无防备的人与宝可梦那里，抢走食物。
author: @ProjectAlpha22
source: POKENAME's arm-like tail is incredibly sticky. It uses it while flying to snatch food away from inattentive Pokémon and Trainers.

entry: 尾巴轻轻一甩，便能令人麻痹、中毒，或昏睡。等敌人动弹不得，就拿走对方的贵重物品。
author: .izik
source: With a simple flick of its tail, it has the ability to paralyze, poison, or cause slumber. Once it incapacitates its enemy, it steals their valuables.

entry: POKENAME漂在丛林树冠上，寻找熟透的果实。落地时，灵巧的尾巴，又能缓冲冲击。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME floats over the jungle canopy in search of ripe fruit. When it lands, it softens its fall with its dexterous tail.

entry: 喙拿不动的大东西、重东西，POKENAME便用大手来偷。一整群合作，连电视等电器，也能搬走。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME uses its large hand to steal objects that are too large or heavy for its beak. A flock can abscond with a TV or other electronics.

entry: 一颗头负责分散注意，另一颗头趁机偷食。两颗头从不打架，反而总互相鼓励，去惹些麻烦。
author: PokePower
source: It distracts its target with one head, while the other attempts to steal their food. The heads never fight, and encourage the other to do mischief.

entry: POKENAME一受惊，便会炸开，将木刺射向周围。那些刺，锋利得连金属，也能穿透。
author: .izik
source: Should it become startled, a POKENAME will burst, flinging wooden spikes into the immediate area. These spikes are sharp enough to pierce metal.

entry: 口中滴落的唾液，带着微弱的麻痹成分。奥赛市的药师，正用它改良解麻药。
author: .izik
source: The saliva that drips from its mouth has a slight paralytic agent. Pharmacists in Orsay City are using this to create an upgraded Paralyze Heal.

entry: POKENAME倒挂树上，用尾巴将树果塞进壳，留着以后吃。哪怕睡着，也能做。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME hangs upside-down in trees and uses its tail to stuff berries into its shell for later use. It can do this even while asleep.

entry: 往昔，贩卖陶土的行商，曾用POKENAME拉车。它驮上500磅，也不费吹灰之力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once utilized by traveling clay merchants to pull their wagons. It can reliably carry 500 pounds without breaking a sweat.

entry: 那双手看着轻巧，实际却沉得吓人，每一只，都比普通皮卡车还重。
author: .izik
source: Despite their hands' lightweight appearance, they are very heavy. Each hand weighs more than an average-sized pickup truck.

entry: 众多触手的末端，各有一只构造原始，却意外灵巧的手。靠这些手，它能在树间荡出，与体型不相称的惊人速度。
author: holgast
source: Each of its many tentacles ends in a primitive yet surprisingly dextrous hand. Its uses them to swing through trees with blinding speed for its size.

entry: 它从尾端手状的突起，发射利针。薄薄一层金属合金，覆在身上，护住身体。
author: .izik
source: It fires sharp needles from the handlike appendage on its tail. There is a thin metallic alloy that covers its body and protects it from assault.

entry: 它能从尾尖，发出锋利的针。全身覆着一层薄薄的金属合金，抵挡来袭。
author: .izik
source: It fires sharp needles from the end of its tail. A thin metallic alloy coats its entir body, protecting it from assault.

entry: POKENAME那抹露齿笑，让许多人害怕。牙齿无比坚固，每只脚，也都能像人手一样抓握。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's toothy grin is terrifying to many. Its teeth are impenetrable. All its feet are equipped to grab like a human.

entry: POKENAME靠多只手，在树枝与藤蔓间飞快荡行，偷走毫无防备宝可梦的树果，或其他东西。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME use their multiple hands to quickly swing across branches and vines. They steal berries and other items from unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: 一家儿童医院里，病童坚称，夜晚有诡异的长尾怪手，从敞开的通风口向他们招手。也有人发现，充气的塑胶手套，不见了。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A children's hospital's patients swear that a creepy Aipom waves at them from an open vent at night. Others report losing their vinyl glove balloons.

entry: POKENAME并没有失明，可毛发遮住了脸，走到哪里，还是撞到哪里。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME are not blind, but because of the hair covering their face, they will still end up bumping into everything.

entry: 它用黏性的双手，爬上住家的墙。夜里，又透过窗户窥探，寻找猎物。
author: .izik
source: Using the adhesive properties of its hands, it climbs the walls of homes. It peeks through windows at night, searching for prey.

entry: 尾端的手会迅速闪光，扰乱敌人的注意。尾光之亮，一英里外，也能看见。
author: .izik
source: The hand on its tail flashes rapidly to distract its foe. The light from its tail can be seen from over a mile away.

entry: 雷雨里，它用手攀紧树木或其他牢固物体。风暴过后，又一睡几天，补回体力。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, it uses its hands to grab onto trees or other sturdy objects. Once the storm passes, it sleeps for days to refill its stamina.

entry: 许多POKENAME，比人类还聪明。故事中，古代文明就曾请POKENAME，绘制发明的设计图。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME are smarter than humans. There are stories of ancient civilizations using POKENAME for drawing up schematics for inventions.

entry: 舌头末端的手，能将猎物卷来。再用巨大的尖牙，娴熟地吸去对方生命力。
author: .izik
source: It uses the hand on the end of its tongue to reel in prey. Using its large fangs, it skillfully drains the life force of its enemy.

entry: POKENAME用尾端的手，牢牢抓住猎物，再绕到后面，张口咬下。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME uses its tail-hand to prevent prey from escaping its grasp. It will then encircle and bite its opponent from behind.

entry: 它一看见迷路的旅人，就会吵吵嚷嚷地欢呼。因此，有人觉得，POKENAME就爱看别人受苦。
author: .izik
source: Should it spot a lost traveler, it will cheer obnoxiously at them. Because of this habit, some believe that POKENAME love seeing others suffer.

entry: 它用尾端的手，在树枝之间荡行，沿途又撒下一团团花粉。
author: .izik
source: It uses the hand on its tail to swing from branch to branch. As it swings, it lets loose clouds of pollen into the air.

entry: 清晨与黄昏，它高喊大叫，寻找同类。手尾里还有一只额外的肺，让吵闹的叫声，持续很久。
author: PokePower
source: At dawn and dusk, it hoots and hollers to find its kin. It has an extra lung inside its hand-tail, letting its raucous cry go on for ages.

entry: 一群POKENAME彼此攀附，拼成大云般的形状，轻轻松松，就能随风而去。
author: holgast
source: A group of POKENAME will cling together to form a simulacrum of a large cloud. The structure is then carried effortlessly along the wind.

entry: 它使出飞身重压扑向对手，再以尾端的手牢牢按住，拳脚交加。
author: holgast
source: It attacks its opponents with a flying press, then holds them in place with its tail-hand as it pummels them with punches and kicks.

entry: 它假装四肢僵硬，走得歪歪斜斜。可忽然一展杂技，便让人摸不着头脑，绊倒敌人，偷走食物。
author: PokePower
source: It fakes having stiff limbs, moving in an off-kilter fashion. Sudden bursts of acrobatics make it unpredictable, tripping up foes and stealing food.

entry: 身体不停涌出沙子，来源无人知晓。华蓝市的吹玻璃工匠，会用这些沙制成的玻璃，制作珠宝。
author: .izik
source: Its body continuously produces sand from an unknown source. Glassblowers in Cerulean City utilize this glass in jewelry crafting.

entry: 身上的蘑菇，长得像一只只手。受惊时，就会放出紫色粉末，吸入便会中毒。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on its body resemble hands. When startled, it will release a purple powder that is toxic if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME只用那一只手，慢慢堆起自己的身体，十分自豪。可一慌乱挥动着自卫，身体又往往散了。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME take great pride in building up their body using their singular hand. Their body usually falls apart as they flail to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME在马戏团十分受欢迎，甚至取代了魔墙人偶。它能表演许多惊人的杂技，动作又灵巧。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is incredibly popular in circus shows, supplanting Mr. Mime. It can perform many impressive feats of acrobatics and dexterity.

entry: 蘑菇结块，可用来制作万能粉。蘑菇本身的气味，又像香蕉，又像洗手液。
author: .izik
source: Clumps of its mushroom can be used in recipes for Heal Powder. The mushroom itself smells like bananas and hand sanitizer.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME的头、爪、尾会催眠般地摆动。再加上那道诡异凝视，让许多人心里发毛。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME hypnotically waves its head, paws and tail when dormant. Along with its uncanny stare, this has lead to many considering it unnerving.

entry: 古怪的笑与凝视，让人类很不安。大群POKENAME挂在一起，在树间，轻轻摇晃。
author: holgast
source: Its eerie smile and stare is seen as unnerving by humans. Large groups of POKENAME hang together, swaying from trees.

entry: 它不由自主，就能远远看见方圆10英里内，任何正在说笑的人。若听到好笑的笑话，就会连笑几小时。
author: .izik
source: It unwillingly has the ability to remotely view anyone making a joke within a 10-mile radius. Should it hear a funny joke it will laugh for hours.

entry: 它用手抓住通电的电线，大口吸取电力，甚至能让整座变电站，彻底瘫痪。
author: .izik
source: It uses its hand to grab onto live wires. It consumes large amounts of power in this way, taking out entire substations.

entry: POKENAME的棍子离开原主一天后就会变硬。米丽法城有家商店，把这些棍子当作痒痒挠出售。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME's stick will harden after one day should it be separated from its owner. A shop in Milyfa Town sells these sticks as back scratchers.

entry: POKENAME夜里会用巨大的尾状附肢，抓住毫无防备的人。它并不想伤害，只是想吓一跳。
author: @ProjectAlpha22
source: POKENAME uses its large, tail-like appendage to latch onto unsuspecting people at night. It does not wish to do harm however, merely to frighten.

entry: POKENAME常待在近水面，很少潜得更深，好让身体吸收到，足够维生的日光。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME often stay close to the surface of water and rarely dive deeper. This is to ensure they are collecting enough sunlight to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME将攒在嘴里的种子射出，自保御敌。它也能游过泥土，宛如在水里一样。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME shoots seeds it has collected in its mouth as a defense mechanism. It can swim through dirt as though it were water.

entry: POKENAME一拳，就能打出适合播种的洞。效率出色，也让POKENAME很受农民喜欢。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME use their punches to make perfect holes for seeds. This efficiency has made POKENAME favored by farmers.

entry: POKENAME很会分辨杂草与真菌，飞遍农场，除掉可能危害作物的植物。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME are great at identifying weeds and fungi. They fly around farmsteads eliminating any plants that may threaten the farm.

entry: POKENAME喜欢扎在肥沃土地。若当地土壤不再适合，紧实的土壳，又能方便它迁走。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME likes to plant itself in rich, fertile lands. Its compact dirt shell allows for it to relocate if the local soil has become unsuitable.

entry: POKENAME只靠露水，就能生存。嫩芽长够大，会从发间脱落，再由新芽接替。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME only needs dew to survive. When the sprout grows large enough, it falls out of this Pokémon's hair and is replaced by a new one.

entry: POKENAME钻进土里，只为隐藏自己。若有人不慎踩到叶子，它便喷出火焰，烧得对方疼痛。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME digs itself into the ground to hide. If someone accidentally steps on its leaf, it emits a painful flame.

entry: 别看模样，POKENAME其实很温柔。有人见过，它为了保住森林的环境，四处散播种子。
author: theartemis1
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is a very gentle creature. It has been observed spreading seeds in an effort to preserve forest habitats.

entry: 它最有效的防身本领，只有喷火。可这会耗掉POKENAME大量能量，因此，通常避免作战。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its only effective defense is fire, which it can emit. However, this drains POKENAME of a lot of energy, so it usually avoids combat.

entry: 身体虽大，却十分弱小。它用爪子挖进松软肥沃的田地，再抬起尾巴，积蓄进化的能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its size, it is very weak. It digs into soft, nutritious fields with its claws and raises its tail to gather energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME在浓密的枝叶里，养出各式鲜花，再送给训练家，让大家快乐。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME happily grows all kinds of flowers in its bushy foliage. It gives them out to Trainers to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME披着古老的壳，散出日光。太阳的能量，为荒地带来生机，重振生态。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME bears an ancient shell that radiates sunlight. It brings life to barren lands, revitalizing ecosystems with its solar energy.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都躺在宽阔田野里晒太阳。若是阴天，就几乎看不见它。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME spends most of its time basking in the sunlight in large fields. It is hardly ever seen on cloudy days.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，最爱晒夏日太阳。营养丰富的鳞片掉落后，还能帮助植物生长。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are cheery Pokémon who love to bask in the summer sun. Its nutrient-rich scales can help plants grow when they fall off.

entry: POKENAME常被训练家与宝可梦低估。它也借此机会，趁敌人放松警惕，突然出手。
author: dicedragon20
source: POKENAME are often underestimated by Trainers and Pokémon. They use this to their advantage, unleashing attacks while their enemy's guard is down.

entry: POKENAME双臂如炮，能射出种子。它飞过农场上方，对任何可能危害庄稼的东西，都会开火。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME have the ability to fire seeds from their arms like cannons. They fly above farmsteads, firing at anything that may be a threat to the crops.

entry: POKENAME总咧着一张大嘴，笑个不停。有人觉得，笑得实在阴森。它的花粉，还能让谁都打喷嚏。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME always has a gaping smile on its face. Some people find this smile quite sinister. The pollen it creates can make anyone sneeze.

entry: 晴天的POKENAME，总笑着跳舞。它住在草地，靠强壮根系拖动身体，寻找适合晒太阳的地方。
author: michaelkai
source: POKENAME is always smiling and dancing on sunny days. It lives in meadows and drags itself along by its powerful roots to find good spots to sunbathe.

entry: POKENAME用头骨，护住重要器官。必须打碎藏在下方的头骨，才能真正击败本体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses its skull as protection for its vital organs. The main body can only be defeated the skull underneath is destroyed.

entry: POKENAME曾忠于那些，同样热爱太阳的古代人们。直到如今，POKENAME仍守着神殿，残留下来的遗迹。
author: _testrun_
source: POKENAME was loyal to ancient people who shared a love for the sun. The POKENAME continue to guard what remains of their temples.

entry: POKENAME常在草木繁茂的田野里晒太阳。虽然性情温顺，谁若打扰了它的清静，也会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: Thropp
source: POKENAME is often found in lush fields, basking in the sun. Although docile, POKENAME will viciously attack those who disturb its peace.

entry: POKENAME尾端始终燃着小火，身体却十分易燃。每逢攻击，都得小心，别把自己点着。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Although POKENAME always emits a small flame from its tail, its body is flammable. It is always careful not to ignite itself when attacking.

entry: POKENAME伏在大花田中，伸长尾巴，等其他宝可梦经过。授粉的生物一落上花，就成了它的盘中餐。
author: kermitcermet#2076
source: POKENAME lies in large flower fields, its tail outstretched in wait for a Pokémon to come by. Once a pollinator lands on a flower, it secures a meal.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: 广大的向日葵田里，栖着POKENAME，正由很久以前，照料花田者的灵魂组成。闯入者，必将面对太阳的怒火。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Amidst great sunflower fields lie POKENAME, composed of souls of those who tended them long ago. Intruders will face the wrath of the sun.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME僵直地站在森林或田野，吸收阳光。敌人一走近，就喷出火焰，有时，甚至引发森林大火。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME stands rigidly in forests or fields and absorbs sunlight. If an enemy approaches, it launches fire that has been known to light forest fires.

entry: POKENAME不停吸收太阳能。蓄够了，就能卷起整场火焰风暴，可也得小心，自己易燃的身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME constantly absorbs solar energy. Once it has collected enough, it can ignite entire firestorms. But it has to be wary of its flammable body.

entry: POKENAME曾是受欢迎的竞速品种。可速度竟依赖太阳，实在太不可靠，最终不再被看好。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME used to be a popular Pokémon racing breed. However since its speed depended on the sun, it was deemed too unreliable.

entry: 身体每个部分，都按固定的轨迹飞。每晚睡前，还会把彼此的飞行轨迹，协调妥当。
author: .izik
source: Each portion of its body flies in a fixed pattern. It coordinates flight patterns each night before it falls asleep.

entry: POKENAME靠敏锐的目力，与灵活的空中身手，确保威力惊人的攻击，准确命中敌人。
author: grayslashjay_8566
source: POKENAME uses its keen eyesight and aerial maneuverability to ensure its devastating blows connect with its opponent.

entry: 翅膀能让它轻易逃开危险，双眼也能捕捉，再迅疾的动作。
author: .izik
source: Its wings allow it to to escape from danger with ease. Its eyes can detect even the swiftest of movements.

entry: 日落时，它会尖声长鸣，响得连池塘的水面，也泛起涟漪。
author: .izik
source: It lets out a high-pitched shriek when the sun goes down. The sound is loud enough to cause the water on a pond to ripple.

entry: 蜻蜻蜓的360度视野，加上猫头夜鹰能转180度的脑袋，以及敏锐夜视，让它不怕任何突袭。
author: mx_wellman
source: With Yanma's 360-degree vision and Noctowl's 180-degree head rotation and acute night vision, no attack can take it by surprise.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不起来，便改用翅膀积起静电，射出电击波，作为主要攻击手段。
author: T.I.A.
source: Too heavy to fly, POKENAME use their wings to charge up static electricity and shoot shock waves as its main form of attack.

entry: 它绕着当地地标飞行，给自己计时，不断加快速度。一天里，至少要飞50趟。
author: .izik
source: It does laps around local landmarks to time itself and improve its speed. It will make a minimum of 50 flights per day.

entry: POKENAME双翼强健，能飞得比战斗机还快，也能靠悬浮本领，辅助飞行。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its wings are powerful, and POKENAME can use them to fly faster than fighter jets. It can supplement its ability to fly with its ability to levitate.

entry: POKENAME虽然有360度视野，身体却十分脆弱。不过，面对危险，也始终镇定。
author: anarchaz
source: Despite its 360-degree vision, POKENAME possesses a fragile constitution. Still, it maintains composure in the face of danger.

entry: 它缠紧猎物，力道足以折断骨头。若发现敌人靠近，便带着仍被束住的猎物，一同飞走。
author: .izik
source: It constricts its body around prey hard enough to break bones. Should it notice an enemy nearby, it will fly away with the prey still imprisoned.

entry: POKENAME一心想帮助别人，潜力也巨大，却还不懂，怎样把力量发挥出来。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: POKENAME is driven by a strong desire to help others. Though it has great potential, it doesn't know how to tap into this power.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，方向却不稳。护眼的酸液，也能迅速清除，妨碍视线的东西。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME flies fast, but uncertainly. A layer of acid protects its eyes and breaks down visual impairments in no time at all.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖畔，嗡嗡地飞到结果的植物旁，寻找食物。双眼能察觉周围360度，逼近的威胁。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Living along lakes, POKENAME will buzz around fruiting plants to eat. Their eyes allow them to see approaching threats 360° around them.

entry: POKENAME舞得飞快，双翼掠过空气，便带起嗡嗡的声响。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME dances at such a blistering speed that its wings create a buzzing sound as they whizz through the air.

entry: POKENAME振动颈间许多翼片，发出不祥的嗡鸣，仿佛整群危险的虫宝可梦，都聚到了一起。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME vibrates the many wings in its ruff, producing an ominous buzzing that sounds like an entire swarm of dangerous bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽然有翅膀，平时却靠悬浮移动。真用起翅膀，时速又能达到100公里。
author: pokebio
source: Despite having wings, POKENAME floats to move around. However, when it does uses them, it can go at 100 kph.

entry: POKENAME总在车流繁忙处游荡，被车碾过。别担心，它们不会死，一天之后，身体就会重新鼓起来。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME keep wandering in high-traffic areas where they get run over. Fear not, as they don't die, and their body will re-inflate itself in a day.

entry: POKENAME更爱贴地奔走，与对手正面交锋。双腿虽然小巧，力气却出奇地大。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME prefers to scurry along the ground and engage opponents face-to-face. Its legs are surprisingly powerful despite their small size.

entry: 失去了曾经最珍重的东西，POKENAME也失去了生活的目标。
author: Fuade
source: Having lost what it once valued most, POKENAME finds itself without purpose.

entry: POKENAME对人类十分友好，晴天最爱陪孩子们，在水池里快乐地漂浮玩耍。
author: akujules
source: POKENAME is incredibly friendly to humans. It loves playing with children on sunny days, joyfully floating alongside them in pools.

entry: POKENAME本能飞得极快，却很少这样做。高速飞行的强劲气流，会吹得外鳃疼痛。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though POKENAME is capable of great aerial speed, it rarely utilizes it. The brutal airflow of flight is painful to handle for its external gills.

entry: 它白天会收集苔藓和芦苇筑巢，还会往巢上吐泥，让巢穴更加坚固，抵御风雨。
author: .izik
source: It gathers moss and reeds during the day to build its nest. It spits mud onto the nest in order to strengthen it against the elements.

entry: 薄薄的毒膜覆着全身，是天然的防护，保护POKENAME柔软如布的身体。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is covered in a thin, toxic film. This natural defense helps to protect is soft, cloth-like body.

entry: 皮肤的黏膜，尤其刀刃般的舌刺，都带着使人剧痛的毒。浮出水面狩猎时，便派上用场。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The mucus membrane on its skin, and especially its blade-like tongue spines, contain a painful poison that it hunts with when it surfaces.

entry: 它虽没有前肢，飘带般的触须却能代替走路，让它在陆地上，跑得意外地快。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: While it lacks forelimbs, it's able to compensate by walking with its ribbonlike feelers. It's able to move surprisingly quickly on land as a result.

entry: 融合让POKENAME变得胆怯。可若摔倒，强大的尾巴仍能一撑，让身体重新站起。
author: typhloquil
source: Due to the power of fusion, POKENAME has a rather timid disposition. If it falls down, it uses its powerful tail to push itself back up on its feet.

entry: POKENAME爱朝人泼水，想吓对方一跳。可人家究竟是吓到了，还是被逗笑了，它往往又分不清。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME loves to spook people by splashing water on them, though most times it's confused whether that person is spooked or laughing.

entry: 世界有些地方，会在窗边挂上POKENAME模样的纸偶，用来求雨。
author: Staghorn
source: In some parts of the world, paper dolls resembling POKENAME are hung in windows in order to invite rain.

entry: 几乎所有地下湖，都有适合POKENAME的住处。它主要潜水觅食，再飞上洞顶休息。
author: char_latte3412
source: Nearly all subterranean lakes host habitats suitable for POKENAME. It primarily forages for food underwater and seeks rest by flying to the ceiling.

entry: 头顶的触角，其实是鳃。若地方合适，它会倒挂低矮的洞顶，睡着时，将鳃浸在浅池里。
author: char_latte3412
source: The antennae atop its head are actually gills.  When possible, it will sleep dangling from a low ceiling, its gills submerged in a shallow pool.

entry: POKENAME久静不动。究竟是身体太湿，还是太懒，才迟迟不爆炸，科学家也无从确定。
author: DuskRD
source: Scientists have been unable to determine if POKENAME is either too damp or too lazy to explode. It stays completely still for long periods of time.

entry: 它总吐着舌头，不知是在逗人，还是不得不如此。平日便在沼地与湿泽间，游来游去。
author: .ssunday.
source: It constantly sticks its tongue out, either to be funny or because it has to. It swims around in marshes and swamps.

entry: 它在海里游泳，常会迷路。迁徙途中，曾有一群POKENAME，被发现来到甜柑岛。
author: .izik
source: It regularly gets lost in the ocean while swimming. A school of POKENAME were seen on Rind Island during their migration.

entry: POKENAME四肢比例失调，飞得笨拙，自己却不在意，也很快受到了年轻一代的喜爱。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's disproportionate limbs make flight awkward, yet it doesn't seem to mind. It has quickly gained popularity among younger generations.

entry: POKENAME是合力施法，守护森林的小妖精。虽然呆呆的、无忧无虑，却从不忘记，林间发生的事。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME are little fairies who protect the forest with their combined magics. While dopey and carefree, they never forget what happens in the forest.

entry: POKENAME懒得很，整天只顾躺着。太阳若晃到眼睛，就把尾巴举起来，替自己遮挡。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: A POKENAME is very lazy, since it lies around all day. When the sun gets in its eyes, it uses its tail as a shield.

entry: 它住在河岸的泥丘，也在那儿抚育幼崽。身体四周，还覆着一层毒膜。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon lives and raises its young on the muddy hills by riverbanks. Its body has a poisonous film around it.

entry: 每条尾巴都很沉，它举起来，却从不显得吃力。皮肤的黏液，也会在日光下，闪闪发亮。
author: empty_set
source: Each of its tails is very heavy, but it never seems to struggle to hold them up.  The mucus its skin excretes glistens brilliantly in the sun.

entry: POKENAME太懒，能在泥里坐到，身边的泥土全干硬了。之后便动不了，只好等着下一场雨。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME is quite lazy. It can sit in the mud for so long that the earth will dry around it, leaving it immobilized until it rains again.

entry: 一下雨，POKENAME就激动地泼泥、扔泥。因此，POKENAME的领地，多半到处是干泥。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: Whenever it rains, POKENAME will start splashing and throwing mud violently. Territories of POKENAME are usually covered in dried mud because of this.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥池，张嘴等猎物，自己走进来。可几乎，从来没有成功过。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME lies in a pool of mud and waits for prey to wander into its open mouth. It is almost never successful.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME群会从洞穴出来，一同潜入附近湖泊，张着大嘴，寻找可吃的藻类。
author: char_latte3412
source: As the sun sets, colonies of POKENAME emerge from caves and collectively dive into nearby lakes. They hunt, mouths agape, for any algae to feed on.

entry: 它虽没尖牙，也偶尔想咬人或宝可梦吸血。可受害者最后，往往只沾了一身，让人难受的黏膜。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though lacking fangs, it occasionally attempts to bite people or Pokémon to draw blood. Victims are left covered in an uncomfortable, slimy film.

entry: 它游动的冲力，足以碰沉任何船只。水手得在船上涂满坦克臭鼬的气味，才能阻止POKENAME靠近。
author: kandyman
source: It swims with enough force to scuttle any ship on contact. Sailors must douse their boats with Skuntank odor to prevent POKENAME from coming close.

entry: 它爱晒太阳，让人怀疑，头部也能进行光合作用。可谁想查看，它就立刻，把头低下。
author: bukie
source: Its affinity for sunbathing has lead some to speculate that its head can photosynthesize, but it ducks its head down whenever someone tries to check.

entry: 身体覆着厚黏液，误食可能引起偏头痛。离水太久，黏液又会干掉。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in a thick layer of mucus that can cause migraines if ingested. The mucus will dry if it stays out of the water for too long.

entry: 总被拿来与大嘴王比较，让它心生自卑。它盼着身材更结实，却把嫉妒，藏在笑容后面。
author: Megaban
source: It has developed an inferiority complex of sorts, being compared to Golsire. It wishes for a more well-built body, hiding its envy behind a smile.

entry: POKENAME常成群出没，人们称其为“集合体”。遇险时，整个集合体会协力，打出庞大的精神冲击。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually found in herds known as collectives. When in a pinch, the collective will attack with a giant psychic blast.

entry: POKENAME能读取情绪，察觉空气变化，预判攻击将从哪里来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME can read emotions and the changes in the air to predict where an attack is coming from.

entry: POKENAME对训练家十分忠诚，会读懂对方的心思，再设法让训练家开心。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME is very loyal to its Trainer. Reading its Trainer's mind, it always tries to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME用头顶宝石，寻找缺少食物的人。不过，若腹部的宝石亮起，就是它自己饿了。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME use the gem on their head to search for those in need of food. When its belly gem glows, it's hungry.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，性情又友善，是受欢迎的伙伴。据说，它还会赐予为正义而战的人，神奇的力量。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME's insightful nature and friendly demeanor makes it a popular companion. They are said to grant magical powers to those fighting for justice.

entry: POKENAME是强大的光术士，能吟诵咒语，以强光晃盲敌人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful photomancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to blind foes with light.

entry: POKENAME的电流，混着强大的精神能量，能让敌人遭受重创。可挑选训练家时，它又格外严格。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME use psionically-charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的电流，混着强大的精神能量，能让敌人遭受重创。可挑选训练家时，它又格外严格。

source: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.

author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的水晶角，散发强烈的精神能量。触碰会刺激皮肤，甚至让人产生幻觉。
author: cyberleviathan
source: POKENAME's crystal horn gives off strong psychic energy. Touching it can irritate skin and may even induce hallucinations.

entry: 凭强大的超能力，POKENAME能随心操纵火焰，也能让火势迅速蔓延。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Thanks to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can control fires and spread them at will.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME的宝石，能感知言行是否真诚。它们漫游世界，只为永不停歇地，追寻真相。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.

entry: POKENAME的宝石，能感知言行是否真诚。它们漫游世界，只为永不停歇地，追寻真相。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.

entry: POKENAME的宝石，能感知言行是否真诚。它们漫游世界，只为永不停歇地，追寻真相。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.

entry: POKENAME长久磨炼超能力，长出的水晶也更大、更有力量，能保护自己，对抗敌人。
author: Lådan
source: POKENAME spent a long time honing its psychic abilities. It grows larger and more powerful crystals to protect itself against foes.

entry: POKENAME的毛虽短，却滑如丝，是理想的拥抱伙伴。睡在它身边，醒来就会神清气爽，精力尽复。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's short-yet-silky fur makes it the perfect cuddling companion. Those who sleep near it will wake up feeling completely reinvigorated.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便学会操纵自己长出的锋利水晶，抵御来犯的敌人。
author: Lådan
source: Since the POKENAME lacks any limbs, it learned to manipulate the sharp crystals it grows to fend off attackers.

entry: 它先催眠猎物，削弱痛觉，再尽情吸血，直到自己满足。
author: Skymaster426
source: It hypnotises victims it hunts and dulls their sense of pain. Then, it drains the prey of its blood until it is satisfied.

entry: POKENAME融合了昼行与夜行的宝可梦，因此很少睡觉。超能力，也让光合作用，更有效率。
author: VaporVenator
source: As a fusion of a nocturnal and diurnal Pokémon, POKENAME rarely sleeps. Psychic power aids in the efficiency of its photosynthesis.

entry: 它虽不常捕猎，可一出手，从不失误。能预知未来，自然也知道，哪只猎物抓得到。
author: VaporVenator
source: While it doesn't hunt often, its attempts to do so are always flawless, as it can predict the future to determine what is a feasible prey item.

entry: POKENAME性情沉稳，能防备超能力感知到的危险。家中有幼儿的人们，很爱请它作伴。
author: dicedragon20
source: POKENAME has a calm disposition and will guard against any danger its psychic powers sense. It's a popular companion for families with young children.

entry: 遇到危险，它便放出毒雾，暂时晃盲敌人。这种气体提炼后，还能制作烟雾弹。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it senses danger, it will expel a toxic smog that temporarily blinds enemies. This gas can be refined and used to make smoke bombs.

entry: POKENAME偏爱夜开之花的蜜，常会在月光下，跋涉几英里，只为寻到。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME prefers nectar from night-blooming flowers, and will travel for miles under the moonlight to find it.

entry: POKENAME头上的灯，本想引来猎物。可打架本领太差，最后往往，是自己成了食物。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: The light on POKENAME's head is designed to bring prey closer. However, their poor battle prowess usually makes them the prey instead.

entry: POKENAME住在深海洞穴，那里，阳光仿佛只是传说。狩猎时，就用身上的光环，分散猎物注意。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives in deep ocean caverns where sunlight is but a myth. When hunting prey, it uses the glowing rings on its body as a distraction.

entry: 这头史前猛兽，只肯夜间狩猎。偏偏饭点定得太死，能选的食物，便实在不多。
author: Patch_Bros
source: This prehistoric powerhouse would exclusively hunt at night. Due to this scheduled mealtime, it unfortunately didn't have too many options for food.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME新获得的恶之力量，会更加强大。周身的光环，也亮得让猎物胆寒。
author: Thora Daughn
source: Under the moon, POKENAME's newly developed Dark powers enhance. The rings around its body shine brightly, intimidating its prey with fright.

entry: 月光照来，光环便开始发亮、迸出火花。可有记录的POKENAME目击，竟都发生在，暴风雨的夜里。
author: Deflador
source: Under the moon's light, the rings on its body start to glow and spark. The only recorded sightings of POKENAME have been during stormy nights.

entry: POKENAME用闪烁的光环催眠猎物，再注入强毒，拖回它们筑巢的幽暗洞穴。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME hypnotize their prey with flashing rings before injecting a potent toxin. They then drag their prey into the dark caves in which they nest.

entry: 夜里，光环按催眠般的节奏，明灭闪动，扰乱对手。POKENAME也就有机会，趁机逃走。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: Their rings pulse in a hypnotizing pattern at night, distracting opponents. The POKENAME then has a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME有许多眼睛，能看清远近，找出隐藏之物。它原生于幽暗森林，也时常守护着，那片树林。
author: anLcorpagent
source: POKENAME possesses many eyes that can see far and wide, able to detect hidden objects. It is native to dark forests, regularly protecting them.

entry: POKENAME能放出，宛如克雷色利亚般美丽的月光。满月之夜，光芒也最强。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME can emit moonlight as beautiful as a Cresselia's. Its bioluminescence is strongest on a full moon night.

entry: 这只宝可梦，极其难得一见。据说，POKENAME是所有灯笼鱼中，最美丽的。
author: .ssunday.
source: This Pokémon is only spotted once in a blue moon. POKENAME is said to be the most beautiful Chinchou of them all.

entry: 命中注定将发生大灾难的地方，总会出现POKENAME。古代文明因此，将它们视为邪物，心生恐惧。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.

entry: 命中注定将发生大灾难的地方，总会出现POKENAME。古代文明因此，将它们视为邪物，心生恐惧。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沐浴月光。届时，毛发的环纹与身上的圆珠，便会发出明亮的黄光。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME loves to bask in moonlight. When it does so, the rings on its fur and orbs on its body glow bright yellow.

entry: 月亮最明亮时，常能看见它们静静仰望。尾巴里，也收集着月之石。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They can often be found gazing at the moon when it's at its brightest. It collects Moon Stones in its tail.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk—known as Milky-Way Milk—quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk—known as Milky-Way Milk—quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk—known as Milky-Way Milk—quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk—known as Milky-Way Milk—quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: 多数夜晚，POKENAME都在月光下，吸收月华，存进橙色的尾巴，留待日后进化。
author: char_latte3412
source: Most nights, POKENAME will bask under the moonlight and absorb lunar rays. This energy is stored in their orange tail to later be used for evolution.

entry: POKENAME夜里滚过幽暗森林，搜寻毫无防备的猎物。POKENAME的利爪，也带着月亮的力量。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME rolls in dark forests at night as it searches for unsuspecting prey. POKENAME's claws are imbued with the power of the moon.

entry: POKENAME精通刀刃，能用无数方法制敌。训练家常请它，执行伏击与潜行任务。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is adept with blades, able to defeat an enemy in a myriad of ways. Trainers often use it to carry out ambushes and stealth missions.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，常藏在夜色里，伸出长舌，偷走人类与宝可梦的食物。
author: rhysanthemum
source: POKENAME are mischievous and often hide in the night. They use their long tongues to steal food from people and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能活几百年，不停警告其他生命，天灾将至。灾难临近时，光环也会忽明忽暗，渐渐变弱。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME live for hundreds of years, warning others of natural disasters. Their rings flicker and dim when disaster is imminent.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: POKENAME的祖先，曾飞得离月球太近，受奇异能量影响，发生进化。如今，光环能向下投出聚光，搜寻猎物。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's ancestors flew too close to the moon and evolved due to its strange energy. Its rings shine a spotlight downwards, searching for prey.

entry: 它的棉絮带着防御用的毒。月光一照，棉絮就会膨起，再轻轻一碰，便炸散到周围空气。
author: bacondlx
source: Its cotton carries a defensive poison. When exposed to moonlight, the cotton swells and bursts into the air around it at the slightest touch.

entry: 有些古代文化，将POKENAME视为神圣。至今，它仍徘徊于他们的墓地，诅咒擅闯之人。
author: Cadyrocks
source: POKENAME was seen as sacred by certain ancient cultures. To this day, it haunts their tombs, placing its curse on trespassers.

entry: 无月之夜，它会找到高处，亮起灯火，引来POKENAME最爱的猎物——蛾宝可梦。
author: wigglypon
source: On moonless nights, it will find a high vantage point and shine its lights. This attracts moth Pokémon—POKENAME's most-preferred prey.

entry: 黑夜里，它摇动灯火，引来猎物。蓝光奇特，见过的很少，能解释自己所见的，更少。
author: wigglypon
source: On dark nights, it waves its lights to attract prey. Its blue glow is unusual; few have witnessed it, and fewer could explain what they'd seen.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在湖底。满月一到，就浮上水面，身上的黄色纹饰，也亮得灿烂。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hides in the depths of lakes during the day. When the moon is full, they float on the surface, their yellow accents glowing brightly.

entry: 月亮升起，POKENAME身上的亮泽黏液，就能帮助它增强攻击。白天，它又沉进阴影，慢慢睡去。
author: .realthree
source: The glossy ooze covering POKENAME helps it power up its attacks when the moon is out. During the day, it sinks into the shadows to sleep.

entry: 只有积雪上结起薄冰的寒夜，POKENAME才会出现。轻纱般的身体，收住月光，微微闪耀。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears only on cold nights when a layer of ice covers the snow. Its veil shimmers with captured moonlight.

entry: 只有积雪上结起薄冰的寒夜，POKENAME才会出现。这个个体，还拥有罕见的配色。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears only on cold nights when a layer of ice covers the snow. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: 它用夸张又滑稽的表情交流。POKENAME古怪的举止，加上鲜艳的毛簇，让许多训练家，忍不住喜爱。
author: seaslux
source: It communicates with amusingly exaggerated facial expressions. POKENAME's odd mannerisms and vivid tufts of fur make it endearing to many Trainers.

entry: 情绪强烈时，身上的彩斑就会亮起。POKENAME喜欢暗处，因为太阳，会让荧光般的颜色褪去。
author: kittyluv090
source: The colored spots on its body glow brightly when it feels strong emotion. POKENAME prefers dark places because the sun causes its neon colors to fade.

entry: 它性情温和，喜欢四周色彩鲜亮。爪间滴落的荧光液体，会让每一道抓痕，都闪闪发亮。
author: seaslux
source: A gentle Pokémon that likes to surround itself with vivid hues. Neon fluid drips from its claws, which illuminates any scratch marks it makes.

entry: 这种POKENAME活泼，又很合群，常被深夜响起的音乐吸引。最爱吃的，竟是荧光棒。
author: seaslux
source: This form of POKENAME is a lively and highly social Pokémon that is often drawn to music played late at night. Its preferred food is glowsticks.

entry: 毛发会在黑暗中发光，既吸引伴侣，也引来敌人。POKENAME却对靠近的一切，猛烈出击，幸存的，也要追到底。
author: Mossybanana
source: Its fur glows in the dark to attract mates and foes alike. POKENAME will lash out at anything that comes close. It will pursue anything that survives.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常只在夜间，才看得见。若被POKENAME用手碰到，受害者就会疲倦不堪。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild POKENAME is usually only visible at night. If POKENAME manages to touch someone with its hands, the victim will become incredibly tired.

entry: POKENAME缓缓飘走，留下数米绵延的黑烟。谁若穿过，便要一生厄运缠身。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME slowly floats away, leaving behind meters of murky smoke. Anyone who passes through the smoke will be doomed for life.

entry: 这只宝可梦，由两颗各自思考的头组成。小头策划阴谋，大头负责控制行动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This Pokémon's body consists of two separately thinking heads. While the small head plots sinister plans, the large head controls movement.

entry: 一大群POKENAME，会聚成密密的“鸦群”。数量多到，甚至遮蔽太阳，让下方大地，陷入黑暗。
author: .realthree
source: A large group of POKENAME is called a murder. They gather in such large groups that they have been known to blot out the sun, bringing darkness below.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME与耿卷耳结伴，仿佛在一同破案。POKENAME冷静沉着，恰好与耿卷耳的性格互补。
author: mirby
source: POKENAME is often found seen in the company of a Geneary, seemingly solving cases. POKENAME is cool and collected, counterbalancing Geneary.

entry: 它用冰雕成的小武器，恐吓宝可梦与训练家，让他们交出食物与财物。可那武器，其实全无威力。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: It uses a small ice-carved weapon to intimidate Pokémon and Trainers into giving up their food and valuables. This weapon is entirely harmless.

entry: POKENAME帽状鹿角上，垂着的羽毛，据说是强大的幸运符，纪念品店里，经常能见到。
author: .realthree
source: The feathers dangling from POKENAME's hat-shaped antlers are claimed to be powerful good-luck charms. They're a common sight in souvenir shops.

entry: 据说，只有疫病大作时，它才现身，趁深夜，以古怪药液与精神能量，替人疗治疾病。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Said to appear only in times of great sickness, it appears in the dead of night, treating disease with strange tonics and psychic emanations.

entry: POKENAME爱装成大人物，对别人指手画脚。可手里拿的枪，连怎么用，也根本不知道。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME love pretending to be of high importance and boss others around. They don't know how to use the firearm they're holding.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是具有自我意志的诅咒武器，会给主人带来厄运，又吞食被斩敌人的灵魂。
author: knilk
source: Legends speak of POKENAME as a cursed weapon with a will of its own. It's said to bring bad luck to its master and consume the souls of slain enemies.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找闪亮的东西，必要时还会强抢。帽子最大的那只就是首领。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME roams in search of shiny objects and will take them by force if needed. The POKENAME with the biggest hat leads the group.

entry: POKENAME会像皮皮一样聚集在满月下跳舞。古时有人目睹这一幕，常误以为是女巫在举行仪式。
author: knilk
source: Like Clefairy, POKENAME gather and dance under a full moon. In olden times, witnesses to these gatherings often mistook them for witches' rituals.

entry: 天真无邪的表情只是伪装。一旦四下无人，它就会把目标身上值钱的东西洗劫一空。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: Its innocent expression is a front. Once no witnesses are present, it robs its target of anything of value.

entry: 全身覆盖着细小的防水羽毛。有人曾在海滨小镇看到它向游客讨食。
author: cait_sith
source: Its body is covered in small waterproof feathers. Some people have witnessed it beg for food from tourists in seaside towns.

entry: POKENAME会欺骗其他宝可梦，也会偷走它们的树果。如果帽子被偷，它就会大闹一场，直到找回帽子为止。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is known to con other Pokémon or steal their Berries. If its hat is stolen, it goes on a rampage until it is found.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀尚未发育成熟，有的便靠魔法飞行。只要答应用闪亮的东西交换，就能请它看守物品。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME don't have developed wings yet, so some use magic to fly. They can be bartered with to guard things in exchange for shiny objects.

entry: 它一心只想着偷走闪亮的东西，连觉都很少睡。会蹲在门楣上，等屋主出门后入室行窃。
author: rihse
source: It rarely sleeps, consumed by a need to steal shiny objects. It perches above doorways and waits for homeowners to leave before burgling residences.

entry: POKENAME既顽皮又忠诚，训练家往往不知不觉就收到了它搜罗来的一大堆闪亮物品。
author: cat001
source: Due to its mischievous yet loyal nature, Trainers of POKENAME often find themselves amassing a hoard of shiny objects.

entry: 它虽骄傲又爱自夸，却被人们尊为守护者。保护训练家的强烈意愿使它颇受欢迎。
author: Xephyr
source: Although proud and boastful, these Pokémon are revered as guardians. Their burning desire to defend their Trainer makes them popular.

entry: POKENAME生活在古老的水下遗迹中，凭发达的精神力量汲取失落文明留下的丰富知识。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in ancient underwater ruins, where they use their developed mental powers to feed on the extensive knowledge of long lost civilizations.

entry: POKENAME自有一股令人敬重的威严，是抵御各种威胁的可靠守护者。它常把自己关起来，一连钻研好几天。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's presence commands respect, standing as a stalwart guardian against any threat. It keeps itself cooped up for days, studying.

entry: POKENAME会死死盯着它认为有威胁的人。在野外遇见它时，应避开目光，慢慢走远。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME will intensely stare at anyone that it considers a threat. If you encounter one in the wild, slowly walk away without making eye contact.

entry: 大舌贝的毒素使POKENAME的肌肉更强健，无论体力还是精神力量都十分出众。它也喜欢游泳。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shellder's toxins have enhanced POKENAME's muscles. It can perform both physical and mental feats of strength. POKENAME also enjoys swimming.

entry: 大舌贝的毒素使POKENAME的肌肉更强健，无论体力还是精神力量都十分出众。它也喜欢游泳。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shellder's toxins have enhanced POKENAME's muscles. It can perform both physical and mental feats of strength. POKENAME also enjoys swimming.

entry: 身体还未发生变化的妙蛙草。往往与成群的妙蛙种子和睦相处。
author: Shuichi_le_sushi
source: An Ivysaur whose body hasn't gone through its transformation. They tend to live in harmony with groups of Bulbasaurs.

entry: POKENAME常挥动那根有生命的手杖，像个小巫师。人们以为它有神秘的法力，但也许只是装装样子。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME often waves its living staff around like a tiny wizard. People assume it has mystical powers, but it may just be an act.

entry: POKENAME靠月光滋养花苞。当花苞在满月下绽放时，POKENAME便会完成最后一次进化。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME relies on moonlight for its bulb to grow. When it blooms under a full moon, POKENAME will evolve a final time.

entry: 只完成了一半进化的妙蛙草。身上的花为了生长会吸走大量能量，令它烦躁不安。
author: Shuichi_le_sushi
source: An Ivysaur that has gone halfway through evolution. The flowers they carry draw a lot of their energy in order to grow, which makes them irritable.

entry: POKENAME头上盛开着一朵花，能以超能力操纵花朵长出的花瓣与藤蔓。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A flower blooms on POKENAME's head. It can use its psychic powers to manipulate the petals and vines that grow from it.

entry: POKENAME吸收过多阳光时，会从尾端的花苞释放多余能量，使周围植物骤然生长。
author: Soup1900
source: When POKENAME absorbs too much sunlight, it dispels this energy through the bud on its tail. This causes plants nearby to suddenly grow.

entry: 据说POKENAME的双腿坚固如钢。沐浴阳光后，初显敏捷的身手会愈发出众。
author: mysteriouswraith
source: The sturdiness of POKENAME's legs is said to rival steel. Energy from the sun causes its budding agility to begin to bloom into something grander.

entry: 融合过程中发生了原因不明的变化，让妙蛙草的花苞提早萌发。如今，它的身体几乎撑不起背上那棵树。
author: fixthewifi
source: An unexplained occurrence during the fusion process caused Ivysaur's bulb to sprout early. Its body can barely support the weight of the tree.

entry: 花苞未能绽放的妙蛙花。由于光合作用不如同类有效，往往得花更多时间晒太阳。
author: Shuichi_le_sushi
source: A Venusaur whose bud didn't bloom. Unable to undergo photosynthesis as effectively as their peers, they tend to spend even more time in the sun.

entry: 它背上的花苞还没到绽放的时候。为了让花苞长大，它耗去了大部分能量，因此行动格外迟缓。
author: Soup1900
source: The bulb on its back is not fully ready to bloom yet. It is quite sluggish since it uses most of its energy to grow its bulb.

entry: 古老的植物从它头上和背上生长出来。头顶的花苞意外地坚硬，能被它当作武器，砸倒猎物。
author: bunkachunka
source: Ancient flora sprouts from its head and back. The bulb on its head is surprisingly tough, and can be used to beat down prey.

entry: POKENAME的双腿十分强健，能在树冠间跳跃。那些巨大的森林生长在它赖以栖身的古老洞穴中。
author: VeteranAdventurer
source: POKENAME's legs have grown strong to allow it to leap through the canopy of the massive forests that grow in the ancient caves it calls home.

entry: POKENAME虽然仍能当作棍棒使用，却更喜欢让花苞散发香气，把对手哄睡。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Though still a functional club, POKENAME prefers to put its opponents to sleep with the aroma emanating from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME背上的枝叶间藏着毒刺，保护沉重的花苞，免遭天敌啃食。
author: anarchaz
source: The foliage on POKENAME's back conceals poisonous thorns that protect its heavy bulb from predators.

entry: POKENAME开心时，花瓣会散发怡人的花香。经常能看到POKENAME在阳光下打盹。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The petals of POKENAME emit a pleasant floral scent when it is happy. POKENAME can often be found napping in the sun.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛能为植物生长提供丰富养分。那几条叶片般的尾巴，其实是长在身上的植物。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's fur is highly nutritious for plant growth. It's leafy tails are actually plants that grew on its body.

entry: 它的花同时处于绽放与未绽放的奇妙状态，因此散发着其他花朵都没有的独特香气。
author: Soup1900
source: Its flower is in a special state of blooming and not blooming at the same time. This gives it a unique aroma no other flower has.

entry: 尾端的花苞越鲜艳，POKENAME就越有精神。花苞若散发出带烟熏味的香气，就表示快开花了。
author: Soup1900
source: The more vibrant the bud on its tail is, the more energetic POKENAME becomes. A smoke-like aroma from the bud indicates that it's about to bloom.

entry: 它十分珍爱尾巴上的花苞。如果这株植物枯萎，POKENAME也会随之死去。
author: .ssunday.
source: It is very proud of the bulb on its tail. If the plant ever withers away, POKENAME will die with it.

entry: POKENAME小小的身躯上萌出新芽，靠花瓣构成的翅膀滑翔。双腿结实而灵活，支撑着身上的花饰。
author: anarchaz
source: Seeding sprouts from its tiny frame, POKENAME glides with petal-formed wings. Its legs, sturdy yet agile, bear its floral adornment.

entry: 叶片上的露珠里，混着花苞分泌的剧毒。POKENAME却不知道其中的危险，仍会好心地把露水递给路人。
author: volvonovic
source: The dew on its leaves contains a potent poison secreted from the bulb. POKENAME is unaware of the danger, and offers the dew to passersby anyway.

entry: POKENAME身上覆盖着一层薄薄的黏液，保持花苞鲜嫩。在等待进化期间，它的食欲十分旺盛。
author: .realthree
source: A POKENAME is covered with a thin layer of slime that keeps its bud fresh. It has a ravenous appetite as it awaits evolution.

entry: 尾端的花苞绽开时，会露出一小簇火焰。它有时会在战斗中故意开花，让前来攻击的对手措手不及。
author: Soup1900
source: When the bud on its tail blooms, a tiny flame is revealed. It will sometimes intentionally do this in battle to surprise foes who attack it.

entry: 尾端的花苞能喷出猛烈火焰，却不会伤及身上的植物。它会烧掉枯树与灌木，为新植物腾出生长空间。
author: Soup1900
source: The bud on its tail spouts an intense flame that doesn't harm its flora. It will burn down dead trees and shrubs to allow room for new ones to grow.

entry: 与进化前不同，POKENAME也能沿着池塘岸边移动，还会伸出细小藤蔓辅助行动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Unlike its pre-evolution, POKENAME can also move along the banks of its pond. It can shoot small vines to help it do so.

entry: 与进化前不同，POKENAME也能沿着池塘岸边移动，还会伸出细小藤蔓辅助行动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Unlike its pre-evolution, POKENAME can also move along the banks of its pond. It can shoot small vines to help it do so.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的花苞储存太阳能。潜水后，还能从花苞连续喷出气泡，最长可达三小时。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use the bud on its back to store solar energy. It can also use it to shoot bubbles for up to three hours after a dive.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的花苞储存太阳能。潜水后，还能从花苞连续喷出气泡，最长可达三小时。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use the bud on its back to store solar energy. It can also use it to shoot bubbles for up to three hours after a dive.

entry: POKENAME聚集在山丘上进行光合作用，尽情沐浴阳光。它们的动作极其笨拙，经常摔倒。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME gather to photosynthesize on hills and get as much sun as they can. They are extremely clumsy and fall over quite often.

entry: 花苞长得太大时，它就无法再用后腿站立。人们看见这一幕，常会把POKENAME误认成树林龟。
author: .ssunday.
source: If its bulb grows too large, it'll lose the ability to stand on its hind legs. When people see this, they often mistake POKENAME for a Grotle.

entry: 它吸收阳光为炮管积蓄能量。蓄满后便会射出两道强劲的日光束，足以贯穿混凝土。
author: Soup1900
source: It absorbs sunlight to charge its cannons. Once it is fully charged, it'll fire two powerful Solar Beams that can tear through concrete.

entry: POKENAME会在战斗中将催眠术与粉末配合使用。它爱玩又擅长园艺，很受乡间家庭欢迎。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses a combination of Hypnosis and powders when battling. Its playful disposition and green thumb make it a popular pick for rural families.

entry: POKENAME总想尽可能多吃奶酪，吃饱后就会开始进化。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will constantly seek to eat as much cheese as it can. Once it is full it will begin its evolution process.

entry: 它能振动胡须，迅速产生大量电力。即便掉了一根，也能在一天内重新长出来。
author: .izik
source: It will vibrate its whiskers to quickly generate large amounts of electricity. Should one of the whiskers fall off, it will regrow within a day.

entry: 六只蛋形生物中，似乎只有一只还活着。其余几只受超能力驱使，诡异地移动着。
author: .izik
source: It seems that only one of the six egg-shaped creatures is alive. The rest move ominously with psychic energy.

entry: 似乎只有其中一个“头”拥有意识，其他的看起来只是从树干上长出的面具状树皮。
author: .izik
source: Only one of the 'heads' seems to be sentient. The rest seem to be mask-shaped bark that grow from the trunk.

entry: POKENAME是顽强的斗士，会战至最后一口气。但若牙齿受到击打，它就会痛不欲生。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME is a hardy brawler and will fight on until its last breath. However, any shots to its teeth can cause this Pokémon excruciating pain.

entry: POKENAME成群住在肮脏的下水道里。无论它吐出的气体还是咬伤，都可能传播多种疾病。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live together in groups in dirty sewers. Both the gas it emits and its bite transmit numerous diseases.

entry: POKENAME虽然无法移动，却极力护巢。胡须连温度或气候的细微变化都能察觉。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME is very protective of its nest despite its immobility. Its whiskers can detect even the smallest temperature or climate change.

entry: 极少数情况下，拉弹的尾巴会缠在一起，再也无法分开，最终形成POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: In rare cases, the tails of Ratfings become so entangled that they can no longer detach and form POKENAME.

entry: 刮风时，它会坐上高高的山丘摇动胡须。腹部袋子里的蛋似乎也会随之欢快地扭动。
author: .izik
source: On windy days it will sit on top of large hills and shake its whiskers. This seems to cause the egg on its stomach pouch to wiggle in delight.

entry: POKENAME吹起笛子时，附近所有小拉达都会跟着POKENAME走。POKENAME一停下，小拉达就会各自离开。
author: drip_capybara
source: When POKENAME plays its flute, every Rattata nearby will follow POKENAME. When POKENAME stops playing its flute, all of the Rattata will go away .

entry: POKENAME会啃食船上的藤壶。一旦藤壶吃光，便开始啃船身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can be found chewing on the barnacles of boats. Should it run out of barnacles, it will begin chewing on the boat itself.

entry: 风浪极大时，一群POKENAME会把尾巴缠在一起，以免彼此走散。
author: .izik
source: On days where waves are extremely heavy, a group of POKENAME will wrap their tails together to avoid being separated.

entry: 它会把尾巴探入熔岩试温。若温度太低，就喷火加热，好让自己泡个澡。
author: .izik
source: It dips its tail in lava to test the temperature. Should it be too cold it will blow flames at it in an attempt to heat it further for bathing.

entry: POKENAME一找到奶酪，就会拼命守护，直到筋疲力尽。角上的毒性很弱，至多让人有些发痒。
author: .izik
source: Once a POKENAME finds a wedge of cheese it will fiercely defend it until it is exhausted. The horn's poison is weak and barely causes itching.

entry: POKENAME出自火箭队的实验室，原本被设计用来替公司窃取财务资料。可惜成效不佳，最终遭到弃置。
author: .izik
source: Created in a Team Rocket lab, POKENAME was originally made to hack financial info for companies. It was ineffective and later abandoned.

entry: 敌人一靠近巢穴，POKENAME就会愤怒地用爪子拖着身体爬过去，再尖叫着向同伴示警。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its paws to angrily pull itself across the ground at any enemy that gets too close to its nest. It then squeaks to alert its allies.

entry: 它用胡须在海床上“尝”出能吃的东西。一旦发现美味，就会扑向猎物迅速吞食。
author: .izik
source: Its whiskers 'taste' the ocean floor for things it can eat. Should it find anything delicious it will descend upon its prey and quickly consume it.

entry: 多种特征让这只融合宝可梦格外适合树栖生活。它会从树上俯冲而下，抢走路人手中的食物。
author: VaporVenator
source: A combination of traits make this fusion suitable for a uniquely arboreal lifestyle. It swoops down from trees to snatch food from passersby.

entry: 它藏在溪流或池塘边的芦苇丛中，避开其他生物。若被发现，叶片就会散发甜香。
author: .izik
source: It hides in reeds by small streams and ponds to stay away from others. If it is discovered, it will let off a sweet odor from its leaf.

entry: 它用前爪掘开地面，再以锋利的喙啄食植物根部。
author: .izik
source: It uses its front paws to dig into the ground. It then feeds on plant roots with its sharp beak.

entry: 它快速旋转尾巴，便能飞行一小段距离。喜欢栖在将死的树上，啃食腐朽的树皮。
author: .izik
source: It quickly spins its tail to fly for short distances. It prefers to perch in dying trees so that it can chew on the decaying bark.

entry: 它在一片片草丛间跳跃寻找树果。哪怕只找到一颗，也会贪心地藏进中空的树干。
author: .izik
source: It hops from grass patch to grass patch looking for Berries. Should it find even one, it will greedily store it in a hollow log.

entry: POKENAME起飞前会慢慢摆动尾巴。飞上天空后便四处觅食，带回自己最喜欢的树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will wag its tail slowly before taking flight. Once in the air, it will look for food to bring back to its favorite log.

entry: 它几秒就能啃穿木头，还率领着一群蝙蝠般的宝可梦。屋主们视它为最令人头疼的害兽之一。
author: char_latte3412
source: It can chew through wood in seconds, and it leads a colony of other bat-like Pokémon. It is considered by homeowners to be one of the worst pests.

entry: 覆盖全身的羽毛十分粗糙。照顾幼崽时必须小心，以免将它们擦伤。
author: .izik
source: The feathers that cover its body are extremely abrasive. It needs to be careful when caring for its young to avoid scratching them.

entry: POKENAME会趁旅人不留神时偷走物品。无论偷到什么，都会啃得一点不剩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will actively steal items from travelers who aren't paying attention. Regardless of the item, it will chew on it until nothing is left.

entry: 它玩耍时经常绊倒。有时蛋壳的碎片会从身上脱落，它就会慌慌张张地捡回来。
author: .izik
source: It frequently trips while playing. Occasionally, parts of the shell will fall off of its body and it will scramble to pick them up.

entry: 它用尾巴保持平衡，走动时偶尔摇摇晃晃。睡觉时会发出细小的吱吱声。
author: .izik
source: It uses its tail to keep its balance, wobbling around occasionally. It makes small chittering noises while it sleeps.

entry: 身体两侧的胡须能感知湿度变化。空气过于潮湿时，它就会来回摇晃。
author: .izik
source: The whiskers on either side of its body are used to sense changes in the humidity. Should it become too humid it will shake back and forth.

entry: 它休息时，头上的紫色羊毛会产生电力。羊毛长得太长，走路时就会迸出火花。
author: .izik
source: The purple wool on its head generates electricity as it rests. If the wool grows too long it will let loose sparks while walking.

entry: 它喜欢在结绿球果的树旁筑巢。树木老去后，POKENAME会用门牙从根部将其咬断。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to make its nest near Green Apricorn trees. Should the tree grow old, POKENAME will use its fangs to cut it down from the base.

entry: 尾端的圆球由一种类似木头的物质构成。走动时，能听到球里有什么东西晃得咯咯作响。
author: .izik
source: The ball on its tail is made of a wood-like substance. While it walks a sound of something rattling around inside can be heard.

entry: 毛茸茸的耳朵其实听不见声音，倒是被它用来储藏各种坚果和树果。
author: .izik
source: Its fluffy ears are actually unable to hear sound. It will store different nuts and Berries within them.

entry: 双臂上的绒球里装满酸液。若有一颗掉落，它就会尖叫着逃离现场。
author: .izik
source: The fluffy balls on each arm are filled with a sour liquid. Should one fall off, it will flee from the area while squeaking.

entry: 头上的花会随着它移动缓缓转动。生气时花朵就会飞转，使孢子飘散四周。
author: .izik
source: The flower on its head rotates slowly as it moves. When it is angry it will spin fast, causing spores to float around the area.

entry: POKENAME漂浮空中，尽可能多地吸收阳光。遇上没太阳的日子，就改吃树皮，维持生计。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible. If sunlight is not available, POKENAME sustains itself on bark.

entry: 它每天都得喝下大量清水。喝得不够，头上的嫩芽就会脱落。
author: .izik
source: It needs to drink copious amounts of water every day. Should it not drink enough the sprout on its head will fall off.

entry: 哪怕只有一点水，POKENAME也会拼命守住。它坐在水洼旁，朝靠得太近的人低吼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will fiercely defend even the smallest amount of water. It sits near puddles and actively growls at anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME空腹时飞得更快，为了更容易捕猎，甚至会一连几天不吃东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fly faster on an empty stomach. It will goes days without eating so that it can have an easier time hunting.

entry: 头上会长出海绵般松软的奶酪状物质。谁若靠得太近，它就会用念力将对方甩开。
author: .izik
source: Its head grows a spongy cheese-like substance. Should anyone get too close to its head, it will use telekinesis to fling them away.

entry: 有报告称，POKENAME在暗中统领着数支拉达小队。这些小队彼此配合，企图控制道路。
author: planatical
source: Reports state POKENAME commands small legions of Raticate in secret. These legions work together to assert control over routes.

entry: 头发和门牙长得一样快。它常得自己啃掉一些丰厚秀发，才不至于太长。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The hairs on its head grow as fast as its fangs. It often has to pare down its luscious locks by chewing on them.

entry: 它尖声叫着骚扰对手，诱使对方出招。一旦得逞，便会把门牙深深咬入攻击者身上还击。
author: .izik
source: It harasses its opponent by squeaking, attempting to provoke a strike. If successful, it will retaliate by sinking its fangs into the attacker.

entry: 它用尾巴吊在树枝上，像钟摆一样荡来荡去。若荡着荡着睡着了，就会掉到地上爆炸。
author: .izik
source: It hangs from branches with its tail and swings like a pendulum. If it falls asleep while swinging it will plummet to the ground and explode.

entry: 它挖掘坚硬岩石也不知疲倦。向上攀爬时，身上的小爪子能帮它加快速度。
author: .izik
source: It can dig through solid stone without tiring. The small paws on its body help it move faster when ascending.

entry: 它最爱吃樱子果。只要请POKENAME吃一份加了樱子果的甜点，就能与它结下一生的友谊。
author: .izik
source: It craves Cheri Berries over any other food. Offering a POKENAME a dessert with a Cheri Berry in it will create a lifelong friend.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的门牙彼此较量。族群首领的门牙往往最大也最锋利。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME use their giant fangs to compete. The leader of a pack of POKENAME often have the largest and sharpest fangs.

entry: POKENAME会在石头上磨牙，保持门牙锋利。虽能刺穿钢铁，它却不太懂得善用这副牙齿。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME keeps its fangs sharp by rubbing them against stone. These fangs can pierce even steel, though it struggles to properly utilize them.

entry: POKENAME分泌的毒液可用于多种料理，熬煮浓缩后能为油炸食物增添辣味。
author: .izik
source: The poison secreted by a POKENAME can be used in a multitude of dishes. If cooked down it gives a spicy flavor to fried foods.

entry: 它大多住在废弃的果汁罐里。罐子一旦损坏，就会另找一个安家。
author: .izik
source: It primarily lives in old juice cans. If the can it occupies gets damaged, it will search for a new can to make its home.

entry: 偏远村落的画家会用它喷出的墨汁作画。这些墨汁颜色各异，浓稠程度也各不相同。
author: .izik
source: The ink it spits out is used by artists in remote villages. This ink comes in various colors and viscosities.

entry: 它喜欢吃森林深处的常春藤。POKENAME的蹄子出奇柔软，在硬地上奔跑会疼痛不已。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to eat ivy that grows deep in the forest. The hooves of a POKENAME are surprisingly soft and cause it pain when it runs on hard surfaces.

entry: POKENAME受压时会扯下自己的头发吃掉。若被人看见自己秃头的模样，它就会放声大哭。
author: .izik
source: When stressed, a POKENAME will tear out its own hair and consume it. It cries intensely if anyone ever sees it without hair.

entry: 有一群信徒相信，给秃头的POKENAME戴上紫色假发便能为自己招来好运。不过假发必须亲手制作。
author: .izik
source: There is a group of worshippers who believe giving a bald POKENAME a purple wig will give them good fortune. The wig needs to be hand-made.

entry: 它拉扯胡须就能产生大量电力，还会四处寻找没电的电池，为它们充满电。
author: .izik
source: It tugs on its whiskers to generate massive amounts of electricity. It searches out uncharged batteries to fill with energy.

entry: 它产出的奶十分浓郁。阳光镇有家甜品店，专用这种奶制作香浓的心形甜点。
author: .izik
source: The milk it produces is extremely rich. There is a dessert shop in Sunnytown that uses this milk to create decadent Sweet Hearts.

entry: 它每周都会换毛。遇险时能让皮毛变得如石头一般坚硬。
author: .izik
source: It sheds its fur every week. When in danger it will harden its fur to the point where it resembles stone.

entry: 尾巴像橡胶一样富有弹性。它有时会急速蹦跳，把尾巴弹破，发出一声响亮的爆裂声。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is extremely rubbery. It will sometimes bounce rapidly and break the tail open, creating a loud popping noise.

entry: 它死活不肯洗澡。哪怕只沾上一点水，也会哭个不停，持续好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: It refuses to bathe. When exposed to even the smallest amount of water, it cries uncontrollably for hours.

entry: 虽然会悬浮，POKENAME却只能维持片刻，所以更喜欢笨拙地一路跳到目的地。
author: .izik
source: Despite its ability to levitate, it can only do so for brief moments. POKENAME prefers to awkwardly hop to its destination.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿又大又强劲，能咬穿冰层和岩石。它们会挖出庞大的地道网，供小拉达和小山猪族群居住。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME have teeth large and powerful enough to chew through ice and rock. They dig massive tunnel networks to house Rattata and Swinub colonies.

entry: 它会为亲密的朋友采花。不过遇到讨厌的家伙，就会故意挑一朵带刺的。
author: .izik
source: It picks flowers for its close friends. If it ever meets someone it dislikes, it will purposely choose a flower with thorns.

entry: 人们普遍认为POKENAME十分危险，却也有一小群爱好者很喜欢照顾它们。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME is generally considered a very dangerous Pokémon. There is, however, a niche community that greatly enjoys caring for them.

entry: POKENAME爱在崖顶摆足架势仰天长嚎。但若发现附近还有别的POKENAME，又会难为情地跑开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will stand dramatically at cliff tops and howl. However, if it sees another POKENAME nearby, it gets self-conscious and runs away.

entry: 它躲藏时会努力一动不动。可一见到食物，尾巴便会因满心期待而摇个不停。
author: .izik
source: It attempts to stand perfectly still when trying to hide. However, its tail will wiggle uncontrollably in anticipation if it sees food.

entry: POKENAME夜里在巷中闻到餐馆的饭香后，曾持剑胁迫店员，把食物抢走。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has held restaurant employees at sword-point to steal the food it smells from the alleyways at night.

entry: 这只机灵的啮齿类宝可梦以高智商闻名。会用爪子和手状缎带解开遇到的各种谜题，需要格外用心照顾。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Known for its high IQ, this crafty rodent Pokémon uses its paws and hand-ribbons to solve various puzzles it finds. It requires extra attention.

entry: POKENAME会收集死去的啮齿动物的灵魂。据说向它供奉奶酪，就能让家中免受鼠患。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME collects the soul of every rodent that meets its end. It is said that offering it tributes of cheese keeps one's home free from pests.

entry: 它夜里的大部分时间都在寻找硬石头啃咬。石头虽不能提供养分，却能磨利门牙。
author: .izik
source: It spends most of its evenings seeking out hard rocks to chew on. While it gains no nutrition from stone, it serves to sharpen its fangs.

entry: 据说，给POKENAME喂一颗榴石果，再拉动它的尾巴，就能许愿。如果拉错了尾巴，POKENAME就会咬你。
author: .izik
source: It is said that if you feed a POKENAME a Pomeg Berry then pull its tail you can make a wish. If you choose the wrong tail the POKENAME will bite you.

entry: 有一群人相信，献给POKENAME奶酪就能许愿。不过事实证明，这种做法并不灵验。
author: .izik
source: There is a group of people who believe that offering POKENAME cheese will enable them to make a wish. However, this belief was proven ineffective.

entry: 清晨，它会飘浮在峡谷高处。一发现敌人就迅速放气瘪下身体，狠狠咬住对方。
author: .izik
source: It hovers high above canyons in the early morning. If it spots an enemy, it will quickly deflate and bite with force.

entry: 它夜里钻入地下休息。花瓣上的露珠可用于制作多种药物。
author: .izik
source: It burrows into the ground at night to rest. The dew from its petals can be used in different types of medicine.

entry: 它以脸颊蹭别人来打招呼。但身上飘落的孢子可能使对方大病一场。
author: .izik
source: It greets others by rubbing its face on them. However, due to the spores that come off of it, this can cause someone to become quite ill.

entry: 它夜里四处飘荡，寻找在晾衣绳上挂得太久的衣物。少了一只袜子？或许就是被POKENAME偷走了。
author: .izik
source: It floats around at night, searching for laundry left on clotheslines for too long. If you're missing a sock, it may have been stolen by a POKENAME.

entry: 身上覆着一层厚厚的黏液，尝起来像可可。但最好别吃，否则会剧烈头痛。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in a thick slime. While the slime tastes like cocoa, it is best to avoid eating it as it will cause intense headaches.

entry: 它会特意爬上大树，啃咬最高的枝条，借此将整棵树划为自己的领地。
author: .izik
source: It will go out of its way to chew on the highest branch of any large tree. Doing so will mark the tree as its territory.

entry: 每只POKENAME的叶片风味各异，棕色叶片通常带着姜黄的味道。
author: .izik
source: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The brown leaves tend to taste like turmeric.

entry: 每只POKENAME的叶片风味各异，浅棕色叶片通常带着肉桂的味道。
author: .izik
source: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The light brown leaves tend to taste like cinnamon.

entry: 每只POKENAME的叶片风味各异，黑色叶片通常带着甘草的味道。
author: .izik
source: Different POKENAME have different flavored leaves. The black leaves tend to taste like licorice.

entry: POKENAME产生的粉末咸中带甜，合众地区的厨师有时会用来给菜肴调味。
author: .izik
source: Because the powder it produces has a salty and sweet flavor, chefs in Unova sometimes use POKENAME for spicing dishes.

entry: 它把黏土涂满全身来调节体温。若有人靠得太近，就会气势汹汹地抖动胡须。
author: .izik
source: It covers itself in clay to regulate its body temperature. Should someone get too close, it will shake its whiskers aggressively.

entry: 它对巢穴格外讲究。只在自己认可的湖边安家，连筑巢的优质泥土都得仔细挑选。
author: .izik
source: It takes great care in its den. It will only make a home near a lake it deems acceptable, using very particular high-quality mud.

entry: POKENAME愤怒地蹦跳时，会利用腹部的螺纹催眠，连意志最坚定的对手也能哄睡。
author: .izik
source: Using the spiral on its belly, POKENAME can put even the strongest-willed opponents to sleep. It does so while angrily hopping.

entry: 它吃得越多，腹部的螺纹就转得越快。若整整一天不进食，螺纹便会完全停转。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on its belly will spin faster depending on how much it has eaten. Should it not eat for a full day, the spiral will stop entirely.

entry: 它在水边举起大小不同的木头锻炼。哪怕被打断片刻，也会气得把木头扔出去。
author: .izik
source: It trains by lifting different sized logs near the water's edge. Should it be interrupted, even for a moment, it will get angry and throw the logs.

entry: 不知为何，这种融合体总有四只草苗龟相伴，每只都戴着颜色不同的头巾。见到它们围在一起吃披萨，也不是什么稀罕事。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: For some reason, this fusion is accompanied by four Turtwigs, each with a different color of headband. It's not uncommon to see them eating pizza.

entry: 甲壳比花岗岩还坚硬。比起湖边，它更喜欢在浅浅的溪流旁筑巢。
author: .izik
source: Its shell is harder than granite. It prefers to make dens near shallow streams and creeks rather than lakes.

entry: 它睡在水面上，从阳光中吸取养分。游泳的人若靠得太近，就会挨它一记尾巴。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps on the water's surface, absorbing nutrients from the sun. If a swimmer gets too close, it will slap them with its tail.

entry: 它潜伏在水下捕猎，借触手上的毒液使游泳的人无法动弹，再将其吞食。
author: .izik
source: It will hunt from beneath the water's surface. Its tentacles are coated in poison, which it uses to immobilize and eat swimmers.

entry: 它攀附在洞壁上啃咬岩石。若发现矿石，就会用锋利门牙迅速吃掉。
author: .izik
source: It will cling to cave walls and chew into the stone. Should it find any ore, it will quickly eat it with its sharp fangs.

entry: 四肢可以完全缩进体内。夜里会用尾巴轻轻摇晃身体，哄自己入睡。
author: .izik
source: Its limbs can withdraw entirely into its body. At night it will use its tail to gently rock itself to sleep.

entry: 它从皮肤的毛孔分泌黏稠液体，借此牢牢贴在水边的大石头上。
author: .izik
source: It excretes a viscous mucus from the pores on its skin. It uses this to cling to large stones on the water's edge.

entry: 随身携带的棍子散发着诱人的陈年切达奶酪香。不过尝起来，仍旧只是棍子的味道。
author: .izik
source: The stick it carries around smells of a delightful aged cheddar. The taste, however, remains stick-flavored.

entry: 它喜欢在冷水中游泳。水温太高时，就会跳出水面，愤怒地抖动胡须。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to swim in cold water. Should the water be too warm, it will jump out and furiously wiggle its whiskers.

entry: POKENAME猛烈旋转长尾，推动身体在海中前进，再用耳朵调整方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will aggressively spin its long tail to propel itself through the sea. It uses its ears to change direction.

entry: 它用大牙啃食珊瑚，尤其痴迷于黄色珊瑚，谁也说不清为什么。
author: .izik
source: It uses its large teeth to chew through coral. It is obsessed with eating yellow coral for an unknown reason.

entry: POKENAME收集树果、草药和其他宝可梦的粪便，投入背上的大锅，调成致命的毒药。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME collects berries, herbs, and droppings from other Pokémon to add to the cauldron on its back. The toxic mix makes a deadly poison.

entry: POKENAME对情绪变化极其敏感。遇到被浓烈情绪笼罩的地方或情绪激动的人，往往会自爆。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to emotional changes. When encountering areas and people with strong emotions, it has a tendency to self destruct.

entry: 这只宝可梦体内储存着各种能量。常随机挑个路人，在对方头顶爆炸，自以为是个恶作剧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon stores various energies inside itself. It will often explode on top of random passers-by as its idea of a prank.

entry: POKENAME能将亡魂的力量引入战斗，使骨棒尖端坚硬到足以击碎钻石。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME channels fallen souls as power in battle. It uses this power to harden the tip of its bone club to the point where it can shatter diamond.

entry: POKENAME借亡魂之力作战，破坏力惊人。重重一击就能让山岳震颤。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME channels the power of lost souls to use in battle to devastating effect. Its strikes can cause a mountain to shudder.

entry: 它的身体富有弹性，又有一半如幽灵般虚幻，因此一脚能踢到100码开外。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's elastic and semi-spectral body can cause its kicks to reach 100 yards away.

entry: 它出拳完全不受周围空气阻碍，能以超音速每秒挥出500拳，毫不疲倦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's punches are entirely unaffected by the air around it. It can punch at supersonic speeds, 500 times a second, without tiring.

entry: POKENAME吞食负面情绪，将其储存在双头上遍布的宝石状突起中，再释放出来攻击或捉弄别人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME eats negative emotions, storing them in the gemlike growths all over its twin heads. It can release them for attacks, or practical jokes.

entry: 它力大却愚钝。本能驱使它奔向最能破坏公共设施的地方，横冲直撞。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Though this Pokémon is as dim-witted as it is strong, instinct drives it to stampede wherever it can cause the most damage to public infrastructure.

entry: POKENAME性情恶毒，会利用自己酷似吉利蛋的模样，将毒蛋送给需要帮助的人和宝可梦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A Pokémon with a malicious temperament, POKENAME uses its resemblance to Chansey to spread its poisonous eggs to people and Pokémon in need.

entry: 覆盖全身的浓密毛发能抓握东西。POKENAME常用它们扯头发，或绊倒经过领地的路人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The thick hairs that cloak this Pokémon's whole body are prehensile. POKENAME often uses them to pull hair or trip people who pass its territory.

entry: POKENAME会用嘴叼走婴儿。红色圆球不断吸收婴儿的恐惧，等恐惧消尽，婴儿便成了它自己的孩子。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME steal babies by carrying them in their jaws. Its red spheres absorb the baby's fear until there is none left, and the baby becomes their own.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时会喷出黏稠的红色墨汁。墨汁迅速硬化，变得如宝石一般。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: When threatened, POKENAME will spray a viscous, red ink. The ink hardens quickly, taking on the properties of a gemstone.

entry: POKENAME的宝石、眼睛和红色花纹在水下会发出明亮光芒。许多人鱼传说都源自它幽怨的叫声。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The gems, eyes, and red patterns of POKENAME glow brightly when underwater. Their haunting cries have inspired many myths about mermaids.

entry: POKENAME用花朵般的身体作为天然伪装，既能躲避天敌，也能蒙骗猎物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its flower-like body as natural camouflage, both to hide itself from predators and to deceive its prey.

entry: 身体核心的背面长出大团毛发。诞生在世界不同地区的POKENAME，宝石的颜色各不相同。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A mass of hair erupts from the back of its core body. POKENAME born in different areas of the world have differently colored gemstones.

entry: POKENAME能够与灵魂交流。据说最初的祈祷师和灵异迷，正是受它的行为启发。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME are able to communicate with spirits. This Pokémon's behavior is believed to have inspired the original Channelers and Hex Maniacs.

entry: 尾巴上的火焰即使浸在水中也不会熄灭。伸手触摸却毫无感觉，仿佛火焰根本不存在。
author: kittyluv090
source: The flame on its tail never goes out, even if it were submerged in water. Those who touch this flame feel nothing, as if it wasn't there at all.

entry: POKENAME装出无助的模样，让对手放下戒心。可惜除此之外，它也实在做不了什么。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its apparent helplessness to cause an opponent to lower its guard. Unfortunately, it can't actually accomplish much beyond that.

entry: POKENAME十分寂寞，会模仿拉普拉斯哀伤的叫声，吸引人们前来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A very lonely Pokémon, POKENAME imitates the mournful cries of Lapras to bring people to it.

entry: POKENAME的身体形态并不稳定。它会让毛发显得又长又密，装出比实际更庞大的模样。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME has an unstable physical form. It causes its fur to appear long and thick to make it seem larger than it actually is.

entry: 它用鳍感知周围的水分，再以幽灵之力抽取，储存在颈间的宝石中。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It detects nearby moisture through its fin, drawing it out with spectral power and storing it in the gems around its neck.

entry: 皮毛浓密而飘逸。它将热量储存在尾巴上的宝石里，留待之后加热皮毛，驱赶天敌。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's fur is thick and ever-flowing. It stores heat in the gems in its tail, using it later to heat its fur and ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME比最早的人类还古老。它栖居海底火山喷口附近，因而熬过了物种大灭绝。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Older than the earliest humans, POKENAME survived extinction events by living near volcanic vents at the bottom of the ocean.

entry: 据说死神的形象源于POKENAME。它的镰刀一挥，就能劈开建筑物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is believed to have inspired depictions of the Grim Reaper. Its scythe can cleave through buildings in a single swipe.

entry: POKENAME将庞大又沉重得惊人的身体往繁忙街道中央一坐，便以人们的愤怒为乐。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME plants its enormous, shockingly heavy body in the middle of busy streets, delighting in the anger it causes.

entry: 它只在暴风雨之夜出现。传说它是人们对雷雨的恐惧所化。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It appears only during stormy nights. Legends say that it is a manifestation of the fear of thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME对恶作剧永不满足，靠捉弄别人引发的情绪填饱肚子。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME has an insatiable hunger for mischief. It nourishes itself on the emotions its pranks cause.

entry: POKENAME能用颈间圆珠唤来浓雾，让月亮染红，借不祥的气氛吓退可能的威胁。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME can use the orb around its neck to summon fog and turn the moon red. It uses this foreboding atmosphere to unnerve potential threats.

entry: 它在身上的各个圆珠中储存负面能量，再释放出来改变天气，往往引发可怕的雷暴。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It stores negative energy in the various orbs around its body. It can release this energy to change the weather, often causing dire thunderstorms.

entry: 恶作剧得逞时，尾巴就会因喜悦而大放光芒。它几乎会用所有招式，自然不愁捉弄人的花样。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its tail glows bright with glee when it causes mischief. Thanks to its ability to use nearly every move, it has no shortage of ways to do so.

entry: POKENAME独来独往，会设下陷阱、结界和幻象，阻止别人踏入自己最喜欢的晒太阳地点。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A solitary Pokémon, POKENAME will place traps, wards, and illusions to keep others out of its favorite spot to sunbathe.

entry: POKENAME藏在灌木中，突然跳出来吓人。POKENAME释放的花粉也会让闻到的人神经紧绷。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME hides in brush to leap out and startle people. The pollen POKENAME emits can put anyone who smells it on edge.

entry: POKENAME的气息能让植物重获生机。据说仙女、树精与森林精灵的传说都受它启发。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
