source: The breath of POKENAME can restore plants to life. It's believed to have inspired myths of nymphs, dryads, and forest spirits.

entry: POKENAME以强烈的情绪为食。吃饱时，背上的火焰便会明亮地燃烧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME feeds on strong emotions. The flames on its back burn bright when it's well fed.

entry: 它的火焰攻击能追踪情绪。被灼伤者只有找回内心的平静，伤口才能痊愈。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its fire attacks track emotions. Only those who have found inner peace can be cured of its burns.

entry: 它制造幻象与蜃景隐藏自身。据说它的火焰能将骚灵和凶暴的亡魂送往彼岸。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It creates illusions and mirages to conceal itself. Its fire is believed to send poltergeists and violent souls to the afterlife.

entry: 它特别爱玩，却必须小心控制强劲的双颚，免得玩闹时轻咬或恶作剧伤了人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon loves to play. It has to be very careful with its powerful jaws so it doesn't injure people with playful nips or pranks.

entry: 叫声能传到方圆数英里之外。传说听到它的叫声，是厄运将至的征兆。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's cry can be heard for miles around. Legend holds that hearing its call is an omen of doom.

entry: POKENAME身手极其敏捷，会溜进卧室把熟睡的孩子吓醒，赶在父母抓住自己前迅速逃走。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A very nimble Pokémon, POKENAME will slip into bedrooms to scare sleeping children awake, then swiftly escape before the parents can catch them.

entry: POKENAME模仿咕咕的叫声，早早把人吵醒，再吞食这场恶作剧引发的情绪。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME imitates the cry of Hoothoot to wake people up early, feeding on the emotions the prank causes.

entry: 它悄无声息地跟踪经过领地的粗心旅人，等对方入睡后偷走财物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A silent stalker of careless travelers, it will follow people who pass through its territory in order to steal from them when they are asleep.

entry: POKENAME以星光为食，将能量储存在圆珠中，再借圆珠发起威力惊人的攻击。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME feeds on starlight and stores the energy in its orbs. It can then use these orbs for devastating attacks.

entry: 背上的深色羽毛比腹部羽毛更轻、更硬，因此能用双翼发动威力惊人的攻击。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The dark plumage on its back is lighter, and stiffer, than the plumage on its belly. Because of this, it can use its wings for devastating attacks.

entry: 它触角末端的光球，会按催眠般的节奏闪烁。一旦有人触碰，POKENAME就会吸走对方的生命力。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its antennae bulbs flash in hypnotic patterns. If the bulbs are touched, POKENAME will drain a victim's vitality.

entry: 它富有弹性的身体能无休止地弹跳。常在封闭的公共场所里蹦个不停。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's elastic body can bounce forever. It will often start bouncing itself in enclosed, public areas.

entry: POKENAME会在同一处一待数日，观察月亮和星辰的运行来预测未来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME stays in the same spot for days on end. It watches the movement of the moon and stars to predict the future.

entry: 它会偷走触碰其羊毛的人的记忆。若再碰到它的光球，那些偷来的记忆便会一股脑涌入你的脑海。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It steals memories from people who touch its wool. Touching the bulb pushes all the stolen memories into your mind.

entry: POKENAME常在月光下起舞求雨。它们似乎是故意与美丽花的舞蹈唱反调。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME often dance under moonlit skies to summon the rain. It appears that they dance to spite the dances of Bellossom.

entry: POKENAME将咒术与诅咒灌入尾尖，挥尾攻击时能让敌人遭受各种苦难。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME fills the tip of its tail with hexes and curses. It can whip it around for attacks, inflicting an enemy with any manner of misery.

entry: 毛发如同感应精神的触须。即便相隔半个大陆，也能察觉特定人或宝可梦的想法与情绪。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its hairs act like psychic sensors. It can detect thoughts and emotions of a specific person or Pokémon from halfway across the continent.

entry: 飘浮在身边的水晶花极其珍贵。仅仅一片花瓣，价值就超过大多数宝石。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The crystal flowers that levitate around this Pokémon are highly valuable. Just a petal is worth more than most gemstones.

entry: POKENAME靠圆珠将自己固定在一处。若没有POKENAME的力量控制，圆珠就重得如半挂卡车一般。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its orbs to anchor itself to a single place. Without POKENAME's power controlling them, the orbs are as heavy as a semi truck.

entry: 它贴近地面，将茎秆绷硬，专门绊倒经过的人和宝可梦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It stays low to the ground, stiffening its stalk to trip people and Pokémon who pass it by.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞行的速度，不亚于高速列车。那对幽灵般的“翅膀”，其实是它类似汗液的分泌物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME can fly through the air as fast as a bullet train. Its spectral "wings" are actually this Pokémon's equivalent of sweat.

entry: 据说POKENAME走到哪里，就将不幸带到哪里。浅色皮毛根根竖起时，便是在与彼岸沟通。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to carry misfortune wherever they go. If this Pokémon's light fur stands on end, it is said to be communicating with the afterlife.

entry: 据说POKENAME会带来痛苦。身上的环纹和圆珠发光时，附近便有人正承受剧痛。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME are said to be bringers of pain. When the rings and orbs on its body glow, someone nearby is in great pain.

entry: POKENAME天生有偷窃癖，常袭击佩戴大量首饰的人，抢走他们的珠宝。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Kleptomaniacal by nature, POKENAME will often assault and steal from people wearing a lot of jewelry.

entry: POKENAME用强劲的牙齿咬穿结界，吓唬别人。制造的恐惧越多，门牙就长得越长、越坚韧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its powerful teeth to chew through wards and scare people. Its fangs grow in length and toughness with the fright it causes.

entry: 它凶恶又好斗，脾气暴躁得可怕，让许多人从此害怕黑暗。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Aggressive and malicious, this Pokémon's dangerously short temper has led many people to develop a fear of the dark.

entry: POKENAME酷似一幅尚未破译的古老壁画中的符号。有人认为，那是捉弄之神的象征。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME resembles a symbol on an ancient, untranslatable mural. Some believe that this symbol represents a trickster god.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴里藏着神秘液体。民间传说，喝下它就能获得永恒的幸福。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME's tail contains a mysterious liquid. Folk tales hold that if you drink the contents, you will be blessed with eternal happiness.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，很少来到地面。古人视它为冥界的使者。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME dwells deep underground, rarely coming to the surface. Ancient people believed it to be an emissary from the underworld.

entry: POKENAME看起来总像在盘算什么坏事，其实却十分友善又爱玩。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME always looks as though it's plotting something malicious. In reality, it's a very friendly and playful Pokémon.

entry: 爪间渗出冰寒能量。它会在清晨用冰冷的爪子触碰训练家，把对方吓醒。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Freezing energy seeps from this Pokémon's claws. It will use this cold touch to shock its Trainer awake early in the morning.

entry: 别想瞒着POKENAME藏好蜂蜜。它总能找到，再把你所有的衣服涂个遍。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It's impossible to hide honey from POKENAME. It will find the honey, and it will cover every article of clothing you own with it.

entry: POKENAME喜欢树果和蜂蜜，会用天生吓人的外貌守着这些天然甜食，不许任何人靠近。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME loves berries and honey. It will use its naturally intimidating appearance to keep everyone away from its stash of natural sweets.

entry: POKENAME能一直飞个不停。翅膀累了，就改用悬浮之力维持飞行。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME can fly for an indefinite period of time, supplementing its flight with levitation when its wings grow tired.

entry: 厚厚的皮毛不停生长，保温效果极佳。比起咩利羊或毛辫羊的羊毛，许多人更喜欢用它的毛制成的衣服。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its thick coat is always growing, and a fantastic insulator. Many prefer clothes made from it over Mareep or Wooloo wool.

entry: 光滑的头顶让洋流顺畅地流过。身上的枝条柔软光滑，却几乎无法折断。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The top of its head is smooth so ocean currents flow right over it. Its branches are smooth and soft, but nearly impossible to break.

entry: POKENAME从不懂得什么叫“撤退”。它会用触手上的球状突起猛敲敌人的头，直到战斗的最后一刻。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME does not know the meaning of "retreat." It will fight to the bitter end, clubbing enemies over the head with the bulbs on its tentacles.

entry: 涉水入海时要留神，脚下或许就藏着一只顽皮的POKENAME，正等着把你绊倒。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Careful when wading out into the ocean, or you might step on an impish POKENAME waiting to trip you over.

entry: 许多人将POKENAME视为凶兆。凡是听到它刺耳尖叫的人，都会被它诅咒。
author: themicelegion
source: Many consider POKENAME as a bad omen. It puts curses on anyone who hears its loud, screeching cry.

entry: POKENAME与同伴配合，将闯入领地的家伙吓跑，再大快朵颐地享用它们制造的恐惧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME will coordinate with their pack to frighten intruders away from their territory, feasting on the fear they create.

entry: POKENAME双臂的蛇只是幻象。其实那是由毒质构成的触须，一碰便会引起严重麻痹。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The snakes that make up the POKENAME's arms are only illusions. In reality, they are tendrils of contact poison with a highly paralytic effect.

entry: 它被称为“深海幽灵”，住在海洋深处，以不祥的红光驱赶入侵者。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon is often called the Ghost of the Depths. It lives deep in the ocean, warding away intruders with an ominous red glow.

entry: 它凶恶且领地意识极强，从鼻子到尾巴，全身无一处不危险。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Vicious and territorial, every part of its body is dangerous, from its trunk to its tail.

entry: POKENAME精通幻术，能将普通走廊变成复杂迷宫，也能让眼前整座摩天大楼消失不见。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: An expert in illusions, POKENAME can turn a simple hallway into a complex maze, or hide entire skyscrapers in plain sight.

entry: POKENAME体内充盈着幽灵能量，总想通过战斗将其释放出来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is bursting with spectral energy, and constantly seeks to release it through battle.

entry: POKENAME用一条“腿”维持平衡，不停旋转积蓄能量，甚至能卷起小型旋风。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Balancing on its single "leg," POKENAME gathers energy by constantly spinning, able to create small cyclones with its power.

entry: 嘴是敏锐的超能力器官。只要嚼嚼一个人的头发，就能知晓对方的一切。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's mouth is a sensitive psychic organ, able to learn everything there is to know about a person by chewing on their hair.

entry: 它转动双臂积蓄电力，再对自己的训练家释放轻微电击。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It rotates its arms to charge electricity, discharging it as small shocks against its own Trainer.

entry: 许多古老部落会将POKENAME颈部皮膜上的图案画成符咒，用来诅咒目标遭遇不幸。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The pattern on POKENAME's hood was used by many ancient tribes for talismans meant to curse a target with misfortune.

entry: POKENAME的奶健康营养又清爽，可只要喝上一口，就会接连打嗝。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: While healthy, nutritious, and refreshing, POKENAME milk is known to cause fits of hiccups after a single sip.

entry: 它用腹袋里红色晶体般的“蛋”，偷取并囤积遇到的人所拥有的积极情绪。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It uses the red, crystalline "egg" in the pouch on its stomach to steal and hoard positive emotions from people it encounters.

entry: 据说它的叫声预示着火山即将喷发，或将发生破坏惨重的大火。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's cry is said to foretell an imminent volcanic eruption or devastating fire.

entry: 据说它经过之后，便会引发海啸与洪水。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon is said to cause tsunamis and floods in its wake.

entry: POKENAME靠吞食沥青、石膏板和混凝土等人造材料成长。吃下相当于一座摩天大楼的分量后，才能化蛹。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME eats manmade materials like asphalt, drywall, and concrete in order to grow. Once it's eaten the equivalent of a skyscraper, it can pupate.

entry: POKENAME大多待在海底，却会在节日浮出水面掀起风暴，给欢庆的人们制造混乱。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME spends much of its time on the ocean floor, but emerges during holidays to cause storms and make havoc for those celebrating.

entry: POKENAME在宝石与颊囊中储存魔力。多只聚在一起时，就能在辽阔的区域内制造强大的幻象。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME stores magical power in its gems and cheek pouches. When multiple gather together, they can create powerful illusions over vast areas.

entry: 有幸见到POKENAME的人，能获它以强大力量实现愿望。但愿望总会被添上一笔恶意的歪曲。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its great power to grant the wishes of those lucky enough to see it, though never without a devilish twist added on.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME能够穿越时间。其中不少人还认为，历史的一切曲折变故都能追溯到它身上。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Some believe that POKENAME can travel through time. A fair portion of that group believe that all twists and turns in history can be traced to it.

entry: 它会自然而然地吸食周围的负面情绪，多余的便存进尾巴，留待日后享用。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It passively feeds on the negative emotions around it, storing the excess in its tail to be eaten later.

entry: 它用幻象和咒语大肆恶作剧，再兴高采烈地吞食由此产生的大量负面情绪。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon uses illusions and incantations to cause mischief on a wide scale, feasting in delight on the mass of negative emotions it creates.

entry: 它体型小巧却诡计多端，最爱红色圆物。一旦看上什么，就会不择手段地偷到手。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon is small, but conniving, and loves round, red things. If something catches its eye, it will stop at nothing to steal it for itself.

entry: 只要旁边还有别人，它就会津津有味地把食物狼吞虎咽吃光，只为不让对方分到半点。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: If someone else is nearby, it will wolf down any food with gusto, just to make sure the other person or Pokémon doesn't get anything.

entry: 它守在铁炮鱼群经过的路旁，专等鱼群到来便猛冲过去，打乱它们的队形。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It waits near the paths of Remoraid schools to charge at them and disrupt their formation.

entry: 当心它的四肢！看似软绵无力，却能瞬间硬化，变得如刀刃般锋利。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Be careful around its limbs! They may appear soft and limp, but they can harden to a razor's edge in an instant.

entry: 它专挑平静的地方出现，一门心思只想惹是生非。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It appears in peaceful places with the sole intention of causing problems.

entry: POKENAME凭惊人的速度冲撞旅人，还会拍翼掀起强风，把屋内吹得一团糟。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its blistering speed to batter travelers, and it uses the powerful gusts kicked up by its wings to send indoor spaces into disarray.

entry: 它用毛发感知空气变化。为免毛发受潮卷曲、感官变迟钝，总会远离潮湿之处。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It can sense changes in the air with its hairs. It steers clear of humid areas to keep its hair from becoming frizzy and dulling this sense.

entry: 它十分好强，会啄扯训练家的头发，试图确立自己至高的地位。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A highly competitive Pokémon, it will peck at and tug on the hair of its trainer to establish itself at the top of the pecking order.

entry: POKENAME的爪子能消磨对手的战意。受威胁时，它会制造幻象帮助自己逃走。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A POKENAME's claws can sap a victim's will to fight. When threatened, it will create illusions to help it run away.

entry: 它的叫声震耳欲聋，又令人毛骨悚然。战斗时会用叫声震慑对手，使其动弹不得。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its cries are ear-splittingly loud and bone-chillingly haunting. In battle, it uses this fact to stun its opponent.

entry: 拳脚间涌出幽灵能量。它以战斗中激烈的情绪为食，越战越快，越战越强。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Spectral energy pours from its fists and feet. It feeds on the hot emotions of battle, attacking stronger and faster as fights carry on.

entry: 别看体型小，它的力气足以搬动巨石。它偏偏用这份力气，把巨石搬去堵住繁忙的道路。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Despite its small size, it's strong enough to move boulders. It uses this strength to move said boulders in the way of busy roads.

entry: 附近有人难过时，角便会发出鲜红光芒。强烈的负面情绪会令它头痛。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its horn glows a bright red when someone nearby is upset. Strong negative emotions cause it headaches.

entry: POKENAME无时无刻不在跳舞。无论四周发生什么，都刻意保持面无表情。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is always dancing. Its expression remains studiously neutral at all times, no matter what is going on around it.

entry: POKENAME与训练家建立感情后，会好心地用超能力吸走训练家的恐惧和烦恼。
author: nelluc27
source: POKENAME will bond with its Trainer, and, in an act of kindness, use its psychic powers to absorb its Trainer's fears and worries.

entry: 它能自由改变体色，借此吓唬人和宝可梦，再带着沙哑的笑声逃之夭夭。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Able to freely change its body color, it uses this ability to scare people and Pokémon before fleeing the scene with a croaking laugh.

entry: 幽灵之力赋予它生命。它也凭这份力量与同类及迷失的灵魂交流。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Spectral powers animate this Pokémon. It uses its power to communicate with others of its kind and with lost souls.

entry: 它似乎凭本能啃咬木制建筑。面对外界毫无反应，究竟是处变不惊还是太过愚钝，研究者也说不清。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It seems to gnaw on wooden buildings out of instinct. Researchers don't know if its non-reactivity is out of unflappability or unintelligence.

entry: 曾被封印在楔石中的大恶之灵，如今已恢复了少许力量。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A spirit of great evil that was bound to a keystone, now with a fraction of its power restored.

entry: 后脑勺的巨口，只是笼罩在毛发上的幻象。但它为毫无戒心者设下的陷阱，却货真价实。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The maw on the back of its head is only an illusion cast around its hair, but the trap it can spring on an unsuspecting victim is very real.

entry: 它与走投无路的人类交易，索取对方的灵魂。颈间的每颗骷髅，都是它收走的一个灵魂。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon makes deals with desperate humans in exchange for their souls. Each skull around its neck is a soul it has claimed.

entry: POKENAME将徘徊不去的灵魂收进颈间盘绕的长链，带往彼岸。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME collects restless souls to take them into the afterlife, transporting them in a long chain it keeps wrapped around its neck.

entry: 有人称它为亡者的审判官。那些穷凶极恶的灵魂，会被它永远束缚。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Some call it the judge of the dead. Especially evil souls are kept bound to it for all eternity.

entry: POKENAME常在近岸处跃出水面，目的只有一个：掀起巨浪。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME has a habit of breaching near shorelines for the sole purpose of creating tidal waves.

entry: 胆小的POKENAME会用幽灵之力吓退入侵者。可对方若不怕幻象，它反倒马上害怕起来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The timid POKENAME uses its spectral powers to scare off intruders, though it quickly becomes terrified of those who resist its illusions.

entry: 它胆小易惊，靠幻象躲避人类。据说抱一抱它，就能带来六年好运。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Skittish and easily frightened, it uses illusions to hide itself from people. It's said that hugging one will bring you six years of good fortune.

entry: 沙漠部落相信，POKENAME是所有蜃景的源头。据说在沙漠看见它，就注定会永远流浪于沙丘之间。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Desert tribes believe POKENAME to be the origin of all mirages. Seeing it in the desert is said to doom you to wander the dunes forever.

entry: POKENAME优雅又顽皮，只向自己认可的人现身。据说惹它不快，就会招来千年诅咒。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Elegant and impish, POKENAME only reveal themselves to those they believe are worthy. Making one displeased is said to bring a thousand-year curse.

entry: POKENAME以目光诱使对手陷入恍惚。双眼睁大、宝石发光时，便没人能抗拒它的催眠。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its eyes to lure foes into a trance. When its eyes open wide and its gem begins to glow, its hypnotic draw is impossible to resist.

entry: POKENAME以幽怨的叫声和阴森火焰惊吓踏入领地的人。得逞后，火焰便烧得更亮。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its haunting cries and ghastly flame to scare those who wander through its territory. Its flame brightens when it succeeds.

entry: POKENAME收集宝石串进项链。年纪特别大的个体，走路时常会被过长的项链绊倒。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME collects precious stones to add to their necklace. Especially old specimens often trip over their necklaces when trying to walk.

entry: 叶子酷似毒草，让天敌不敢下口。白天，它会把自己种进地里睡觉。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its leaves resemble a poisonous plant, discouraging predators from trying to eat it. During the day, it plants itself in the ground and sleeps.

entry: 一个底部破洞的闹鬼垃圾袋。为报复自身遭遇，如今正向外倾倒无穷无尽的垃圾。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A haunted garbage bag with a hole in the bottom. Now endless litter pours out as revenge for its fate.

entry: 它看起来呆头呆脑，却一门心思琢磨最呛鼻的臭味。恶心得人越多，就越能把气味变得难闻。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This dopey-looking Pokémon concentrates hard on creating the most nose-bending smell. The more people it disgusts, the nastier it can make its scent.

entry: 这团毛球没有超能力的帮助就寸步难行。触角末端的球状器官，则能放大它的精神力量。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This ball of fur is incapable of moving without the aid of its psychic powers. The bulbs on its antennae act as amplifiers for its power.

entry: 鲜艳的鳞片吸引猎物靠近。哪怕只碰到一根毛或一片鳞，也会陷入严重的麻痹。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's brightly colored scales lure in potential prey. A single hair or scale of this Pokémon can cause debilitating paralysis on contact.

entry: 退化的双腿还能用于攻击，移动却靠超能力托起身体。兴奋时，身后会拖出一道火焰。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's vestigial legs can be used for attack, but it moves by carrying itself psychically. When excited, flame trails behind its movements.

entry: POKENAME爱在神社与墓园附近游荡。据说若有POKENAME偷走供品，便是不祥之兆。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around shrines and graveyards. It's believed that a POKENAME stealing an offering left there is a bad omen.

entry: 毛发、尾巴和胡须随幽冥之风飘动。许多人相信，被POKENAME偷走的东西会遭受永恒的诅咒。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its hairs, tail, and whiskers flow with a spectral wind. Many people believe that items stolen by POKENAME are forever cursed.

entry: POKENAME很有主见，据说还恪守自己的道德准则。因此，它们总会给作恶者带来无穷无尽的麻烦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A very assertive Pokémon, POKENAME are believed to have a strong moral code. This results in them making themselves an endless nuisance to evildoers.

entry: 这只宝可梦轻盈敏捷又顽皮，整天到处破坏东西。它能纵身穿墙，实在难以阻拦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Light, agile, and impish, POKEMON spends its time vandalizing things. Its ability to leap through walls makes it difficult to stop.

entry: 它以幽灵之力突破自身的力量极限。一旦认真作战，便没有对手能够抗衡。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon uses its spectral power to gain strength beyond its natural limits. When it fights seriously, no opponent can compete.

entry: POKENAME护卫心强，领地意识也极重。没人知道它双爪之间的宝石里封着什么。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is very protective and territorial. No one knows what is sealed up inside the gem between its paws.

entry: POKENAME极为自傲，凭高贵的气势与幽灵之力，迫使附近生物伺候自己的一切需求。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A highly prideful Pokémon, POKENAME use their nobility and spectral power to force nearby creatures to serve their every need.

entry: POKENAME用可怕的超能力定住猎物，再将其吞食。火焰还能吸走对方的能量。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME uses its terrifying psychic powers to freeze its prey before consuming them. Its flames sap a victim's energy.

entry: POKENAME身体孱弱，无论在陆地还是水中，都靠幽灵之力推动自己。尾巴与毛发很像海带。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A physically frail Pokémon, POKENAME use their ghostly power to propel themselves both on land and water. Its tail and hair resemble kelp.

entry: 许多人相信，古代曾有一只怪力为求更强的力量与恶魔订下契约，从此诞生了POKENAME这一新物种。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Many believe that an ancient Machamp made a contract with a demon for more strength, birthing POKENAME as a new species.

entry: 水晶般的身体无法被磕损、震裂或划伤。它能以幽灵能量将自己弹射出去，速度比火箭还快。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's crystalline body is impossible to chip, crack, or scratch. It can use spectral energies to hurl itself faster than a rocket.

entry: POKENAME从诞生之初就浮在空中，年纪越大，能飘浮的高度也越高。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: From the moment POKENAME is brought into the world, it is floating. It can float higher and higher as it grows older.

entry: 它是复仇与正义的幽魂，谁也逃不过。无论陆地、水面，甚至空中，它都能以胜过高速列车的速度疾驰。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon is an inescapable spirit of vengeful justice. It can gallop faster than a bullet train, over land, water, and even open air.

entry: 它四处寻找电力吞食。不仅吸收电能，也会从停电引发的情绪中获取养分。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon feeds on electricity wherever it can find it, gaining nutrition from both the energy and the emotions caused by the resulting blackouts.

entry: 体内住着几只顽皮的幽灵。它们的幽冥之力会让周围大范围内的人头痛，还会造成供电不足。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Several mischievous spirits live inside this entity, their ghastly power causing headaches and electrical shortages in a wide radius around it.

entry: 它总是张着壳，模仿大舌贝引诱猎物。壳上长出的海带状“毛发”则是感官。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its shell is always open, imitating Shellder to bait potential prey. The kelp-like "hairs" growing from the shell act as sensory organs.

entry: POKENAME以强烈的情绪为食。吃饱后排出的气体，足以填满一座伽勒尔道馆赛场。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME feed upon strong emotions. When well fed, its gaseous emissions can fill a Galarian gym stadium.

entry: POKENAME夜里出来散播恐惧与噩梦。只需碰它一下，就可能被诅咒，接连几个月噩梦不断。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME comes out at night to spread fear and nightmares. A single touch from this Pokémon can curse you with months of bad dreams.

entry: POKENAME偷走人们的梦，并向受害者施咒。每添一道诅咒，宝石就会更亮一些。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME steals dreams from people, laying curses on its victims. Its gems glow brighter with each curse laid.

entry: POKENAME以恐惧和噩梦为食，格外喜欢孩子，因为他们比大人更容易吓唬。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME nourishes itself on fear and nightmares. It's fond of children, who are much easier to scare than adults.

entry: POKENAME摆链上的宝石越亮，就能让人睡得越久。最亮的甚至能让人永远沉睡。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The brighter the gems on a POKENAME's pendulum chain, the longer they can put you to sleep. The brightest can put you to sleep forever.

entry: POKENAME吐出的泡沫会结晶成许多闪亮珍珠。身体越健康，珍珠的色泽就越纯净。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The foam that POKENAME emits from its mouth crystalizes into a multitude of shiny pearls. The healthier the Pokémon, the purer the color.

entry: POKENAME自认为是古代遗迹的守护者。可惜它们总爱对入侵者自爆，往往反而造成更严重的破坏。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME consider themselves protectors of ancient ruins. Tragically, their tendency to explode on intruders means they often cause greater harm.

entry: 眼睛才是本体。受威胁时会从保护壳中弹射出去，若逃不掉，就会爆炸。
author: Griddle
source: The eye is its true body. When threatened, it will eject itself from its protective shell. If it can't get away, it explodes.

entry: 一种守护意识古怪的古老生物。察觉有人进入栖身之处，便会用眼睛锁定对方并发动攻击。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An ancient being that has a strange sense of protection. When it senses someone in its home, it locks onto them with its eyes and attacks.

entry: POKENAME吐出的烟雾里能看到数千只眼睛。没人知道它们属于谁，也没人知道它们在寻找什么。
author: Griddle
source: Thousands of eyes can be seen in the smoke emitted by POKENAME. No one knows who the eyes belong to, or what they're looking for.

entry: 吸入POKENAME气体的人会看见惊人幻象。受害者总会描述一片广阔的灰色天空，其中布满多如繁星的眼睛。
author: Griddle
source: Those who inhale POKENAME's gas witness startling visions. Victims of it always describe a vast grey sky, filled with as many eyes as there are stars.

entry: 经常能在沉船旁看到它，正仔细研究船身的文字。后方的眼睛来回转动，不放过任何细节。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is often spotted near sunken ships, meticulously studying any lettering on the hull. Its rear eye darts back and forth, absorbing every detail.

entry: POKENAME的四肢柔韧得像橡胶软管。它会用这些肢体逗乐大人和孩子。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME's limbs have all the flexibility of a rubber hose. It uses these limbs to entertain children and adults alike.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，就把黑暗与绝望带到哪里。它们成群入侵星球，让黑暗蔓延各处。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are known to carry darkness and despair everywhere they go. Together, they invade and infest planets with their darkness.

entry: POKENAME的眼柄不停扭动挥舞，永无止境地寻找值得捕捉的猎物，只有猎食成功后才会安静下来。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME's eyestalks constantly writhe and thrash in its endless search for worthy prey; they're only at rest after a successful hunt.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会把未知王那些眼睛般的蛋，顶在头部的柄状突起上。科学家推测，这种行为能提高它的存活机会。
author: FilteredTea
source: A young POKENAME carries the eye-like eggs of Unsire on its head stalks. Scientists theorize this behavior increases its odds of survival.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME用超能力改造湖泊池塘来筑巢。为了保护幼崽，它们会表现得极为凶狠。
author: FilteredTea
source: POKENAME have been seen terraforming lakes and ponds with their psychic powers to make their nests. They defend their young with fierce hostility.

entry: 穿行于昏暗森林时，有时会看见黑暗中浮着一只巨眼。那便是POKENAME，正一眨不眨地盯着来人。
author: themicelegion
source: Sometimes, when walking through a dark forest, a single, giant eye can be seen through the darkness. That is POKENAME. It stares unblinking at anyone.

entry: 初次发现POKENAME时，人们以为它是月亮伊布的罕见变异。可研究没多久，眼睛就从它的纹饰中伸了出来。
author: JokersWild
source: POKENAME was thought to be a rare mutation of Umbreon upon initial discovery. After a short time studying it, eyes protruded from its markings.

entry: POKENAME并非制造幻象，而是直接改变身边的现实。有些人认为，它是一群操控着迷失灵魂的未知图腾。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Rather than making illusions, POKENAME directly alters reality around it. Some believe it to be a collection of Unown controlling a lost spirit.

entry: POKENAME被视为未知图腾最强的形态之一。外貌让人想起名为“未知图腾之王”的古老传说。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is considered to be one of the strongest forms of Unown. Its appearance is reminiscent of an old legend known as "The Unown King".

entry: 成群的POKENAME总是整齐划一地游动，仿佛全都是同一只宝可梦。
author: kittyluv090
source: Schools of POKENAME are always found swimming in perfect unison, almost as if they were all one Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从杂志、玩具和各种物品上收集字母，拼成奇怪的词句。啼声听起来像孩子咯咯发笑。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME collect assorted letters from magazines, toys, and objects that spell out odd words and phrases. Their chirps sound like giggling children.

entry: POKENAME会在遗迹墙上画下抽象涂鸦。人们从画中发现了一些规律，有人坚称其中藏有奇怪的密码。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME will mark ruin walls with abstract graffiti. Patterns have been discovered in its paintings, which some insist include strange codes.

entry: 放电留下的痕迹与焦印，会形成酷似文字的图案。
author: Staghorn
source: The tracks and burns created by its electrical discharges form patterns that resemble text characters.

entry: 曾有研究者误把这只融合宝可梦当作水君的壁画。没人真正见过POKENAME移动，因为它只在你眨眼时奔跑和攻击。
author: Griddle
source: A researcher once mistook this fusion for a wall mural of Suicune. Nobody has actually seen POKENAME move; it runs and attacks only when you blink.

entry: 人们原以为POKENAME只是考古学家编出的传闻。它藏在古老遗迹里，常伪装成古画的一部分。
author: maxiundmicky
source: Originally thought to be a rumor cooked up by archeologists, POKENAME tends to pretend to be part of ancient drawings. It hides in ancient ruins.

entry: 它的目光能将思想直接传入别人脑中。但做过恶事的人，只会听见一个问题：“为什么？”
author: reflecbeat
source: Its gaze transmits its thoughts directly into the minds of others. Those who have committed evil deeds hear nothing but the question, "Why?”.

entry: 地面上刻出的仪式圆阵，是辨认POKENAME巢穴的线索。至于这些圆阵有何用途，至今无人知晓。
author: Griddle
source: One can identify an POKENAME's den by the ritual circles it carves into the ground. The purpose of these circles is a mystery to all.

entry: 它爱好谜团，常与小说家相伴。许多作家把POKENAME看作最忠实的书迷，也是最苛刻的评论家。
author: Griddle
source: It loves a mystery, and can frequently be found in the company of novelists. Many writers regard POKENAME as their biggest fan and harshest critic.

entry: POKENAME常与其他幼年宝可梦待在一起。欢笑与喜悦能增强它的超能力。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME is frequently found in the company of other baby Pokémon. Its psychic powers are strengthened by laughter and joy.

entry: 它释放奇异的念力波动。身体坚硬如钢，大多数宝可梦只要接触太久，就会感到头痛。
author: bobosmith01
source: It sends out bizarre psychokinetic waves. Its body is hard as steel, and touching it for too long induces headaches in most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能在黑夜里看得一清二楚，却也格外容易患雪盲症，因此十分畏惧阳光。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME's eye gives it flawless night vision, but makes it uniquely vulnerable to snow blindness. It lives in fear of the sun as a result.

entry: 它从炮管射出未知图腾，把攻击拼成文字。强大的POKENAME能打出整句，最强的甚至能打出押韵的诗句。
author: Griddle
source: It shoots Unown from its cannons, spelling its attacks. Strong POKENAME have been known to fire sentences; the strongest will actually fire rhymes.

entry: 据说，一部作品发表时若恰有108处拼写错误，就会诞生POKENAME。人们常用这故事吓唬粗心的学生。
author: Griddle
source: It's said POKENAME are created when a written work with exactly 108 spelling errors is published. It's commonly used to scare inattentive students.

entry: 身体是个空心外壳。人们将物品交给POKENAME保管，取回时只需轻轻摇晃它。它似乎并不介意。
author: Griddle
source: Its body is a hollow shell. People will give POKENAME items for safekeeping and then gently shake it to retrieve them. It doesn't seem to mind this.

entry: 它在海底散落的摇篮百合石化残骸中安家。虽然常被误解，其实它毫无恶意，只是害羞。
author: Griddle
source: This fusion makes its home in the petrified remains of Cradily littering the seafloor. Contrary to popular belief, it's not malevolent; it's just shy.

entry: 它们用砸碎的未知图腾残片装饰身体，研究者把这些战利品称为“断字”。佩有最大“断字”的POKENAME便是首领。
author: Griddle
source: They adorn themselves with smashed Unown parts; scientists refer to these trophies as 'text breaks'. The POKENAME with the biggest text break leads.

entry: 它能同时看见所有维度与时间线上发生的一切。古老神殿的墙上，常能找到描绘它的图画。
author: milchik
source: This fusion sees everything happening in all dimensions and timelines at once. Its depictions can often be found on the walls of ancient temples.

entry: 融合之际，它背上出现了神秘构造，其他未知图腾也开始凭空现身。
author: funkytomate
source: When it was fused, a mysterious structure appeared on its back, and other Unown started to appear out of nowhere.

entry: 其他未知图腾开始与它融合，仿佛天生就受它背上的构造吸引。
author: funkytomate
source: Other Unown have begun to merge with this fusion. It seems like they are naturally drawn to the structures on its back.

entry: 许多未知图腾与土台龟融合，化为一座构造体。有人认为，其中或许藏着未知图腾故乡的线索。
author: funkytomate
source: Many Unown have fused with Torterra and took on the form of a structure. Some believe it can tell us something about Unown's homeworld.

entry: 它是一种形似简陋长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like a rudimentary sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它是一种形似过分繁复的长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like an over-complicated sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它用柔韧的长触须拼出表达爱意的词句。据说多出的眼睛，会悉心守望它所爱的人。
author: r.isk
source: It spells out words of affections with its long, flexible tendrils. It's said that with its extra eyes it keeps careful watch over those it loves.

entry: 各只眼睛通常游移着，各看各的东西。可被六只眼睛同时注视过的人，都声称经历了剧烈的精神痛苦。
author: bukie
source: Its eyes typically wander and focus on separate things, but those who attract the gaze of all six claim to be struck with intense mental anguish.

entry: 神秘的宝可梦，偶尔能在雨林深处的神殿遗迹中发现。它几乎不动，只是睁着不眨的眼睛一直凝视。
author: moopse
source: This mysterious Pokémon can be found rarely in temple ruins deep in rainforests. It hardly moves, constantly staring with its unblinking eye.

entry: POKENAME乍看令人畏惧，一旦信任你，却会变得十分亲切。它的每只眼睛都曾属于一只未知图腾。
author: planatical
source: POKENAME is an intimidating Pokémon at first, but once it trusts you, it becomes very kind. Each eye it has once belonged to an Unown.

entry: 与六尾不同，它的尾巴让许多人心生恐惧。有人说，就连POKENAME的火焰都能让人吓得浑身发冷。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: Unlike Vulpix, this Pokémon's tails instill fear in many. Some say that even POKENAME's flames leave you cold from fear.

entry: 一些古代文化相信POKENAME是基图腾的译者。它头上的符号会随观看者所用的语言而变化。
author: char_latte3412
source: Some ancient cultures believed POKENAME act as translators for Jiown. The symbols on its head shift accordingly based on the viewer's own language.

entry: 尾巴上的眼睛让后方视野几乎毫无死角。爱夸大其词的传闻，甚至说POKENAME能看见过去与未来。
author: fixthewifi
source: The eye on its tail grants near-perfect sight behind itself. Sensationalist sources often hyperbolise that POKENAME can see both the past and future.

entry: POKENAME众多的眼睛令大多数人不安。还曾发生过与它对视后，被它无休止跟踪的事。
author: 8xviktor
source: Most people are unsettled by the many eyes of POKENAME. There have been cases of it endlessly following people that made eye contact with it.

entry: 它的视力始终完美无缺。研究者一直研究POKENAME，希望从它身上找到治愈失明的秘密。
author: Griddle
source: Its vision is always perfect. Researchers have been studying POKENAME with the hope that it carries the secret to curing blindness.

entry: 眼睛有着棉球般的质感。研究者将它与洞穴壁画中描绘的古代熊崽联系起来。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its eye has a cotton ball-like texture. Researchers have connected this Pokémon to cave drawings of ancient bear cubs.

entry: 融合技术流入海洋后，连海床上也能见到未知图腾。它用锚在沙中刻下神秘的符文。
author: .realthree
source: Due to fusion technology leaking into the sea, Unown can even be found on the seafloor. It uses its anchor to dig cryptic runes into the sand.

entry: POKENAME挖出的地洞窄得根本容不下它的头，可它偏偏能在其中穿行，令所有人都百思不解。
author: Griddle
source: Nobody knows how POKENAME moves underground, as the holes it makes are too narrow for its head. To the bafflement of all, it traverses them anyways.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME的根扎得有多深。最新研究发现，它的根竟能拼成整整几段文字。
author: Griddle
source: No one knows how deep POKENAME's roots go. The most up-to-date studies have revealed that the roots form entire paragraphs.

entry: POKENAME凭超能力，只需对视就能看出一个人拥有多少财富。得到它的青睐，预示着好运降临。
author: Griddle
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to discern the wealth of anyone it makes eye contact with. Its favor is a portent of good fortune.

entry: 只要盯住眼睛，POKENAME就会僵在原地。但它极其讨厌对视，你一眨眼或移开目光，它便立刻攻击。
author: Griddle
source: It will freeze on the spot if you stare into its eye. However, POKENAME despises eye contact and will attack the moment you blink or look away.

entry: 有旅人说，戳眼睛就能摆脱凶猛的POKENAME。可千万别试，这只会让它更加愤怒。
author: Griddle
source: Some travellers say that you can escape an aggressive POKENAME by poking it in the eye. Do not do this; it will only get angrier.

entry: POKENAME的巨眼占体重的85%，让它拥有极佳的浮力。可它的视力却出奇地差，常常摔倒。
author: FilteredTea
source: POKENAME's giant eye makes up 85% of its body weight, making it very buoyant. It often falls over due to its surprisingly poor eyesight.

entry: 未知蝌蚪的体型如何变成POKENAME，如今仍是谜。它能将周围360度的景象尽收眼底。
author: FilteredTea
source: The transition in body type from an Unwag to a POKENAME is currently unknown. It can see in a complete 360 degrees around itself.

entry: POKENAME的拳头蕴含强大的远古能量。据说曾有一只POKENAME一拳就夷平了整座摩天大楼。
author: FilteredTea
source: POKENAME's punches are powered by powerful ancient energies. It is said a POKENAME once leveled an entire skyscraper in one strike.

entry: POKENAME滚动时能看见未来。可它滚得太快，预言往往过于简略，派不上什么用场。
author: Griddle
source: POKENAME has visions of the future when it rolls. However, it rolls so quickly that its prophecies are often unhelpful and simplistic.

entry: 为免感官负荷过重，POKENAME每次只会启用一只眼睛。因此，根本无法判断它正看向哪里。
author: Griddle
source: In order to avoid sensory overload, only one of POKENAME's eyes is working at any given time. As a result, it's impossible to tell where it's looking.

entry: POKENAME全身长满眼睛，几乎不可能偷偷靠近。四肢活动起来，则像各自有了主意。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's eyes cover its entire body, making it nearly impossible to sneak up on. Its limbs move as if they have minds of their own.

entry: 两个头各有一个大脑，能以心灵感应彼此交流，却无法用这种方式与其他人沟通。
author: admiralvermin
source: It has two brains, one in each head. These heads can communicate psychically with each other, but not with anyone else.

entry: 腹部中央的眼睛是唯一弱点。蓝色的躯壳，仅仅是保护内部本体的外壳。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon has a single weak point, this being the eye in the middle of its stomach. The blue form is nothing but a shell for the real body inside.

entry: POKENAME通常很友善，只有食物被抢走时才会动怒攻击。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME is typically friendly. The only time it will get aggressive is when you take its food.

entry: POKENAME潜伏海床，目光令人着迷。凡是与POKENAME对视过的，都记不起它真正的脸长什么样。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME lurks along the seabed with an entrancing glare. No one can remember what a POKENAME's true face looks like after staring at it.

entry: POKENAME平时很少活动，一旦遭到攻击，却会以惊人的力量反击。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME does not move around very much. However, when it is attacked, it strikes back with immense power.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩击剑游戏，但黑色尾巴若受伤，就会停下来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME enjoys playful swordplay, but if its black tail gets injured, it will stop playing.

entry: POKENAME像根球棒，十分耐打；但若手臂受伤，就会狠狠还击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a bat that can take a beating, and if its arm is hurt, give a beating.

entry: 它讨厌光亮，也讨厌被吓一跳。若找不到足够大的洞穴藏身，就会亲自在地里挖一个。
author: gellyfishsh
source: It hates light and surprises. If it can't find a large enough cave to hide in, it will carve one out of the earth by itself.

entry: 除了黑色尾巴，POKENAME的整个身体都是投影。凡是被它截获的电磁信号，都会受到严重干扰。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is entirely a projection save for its black tail. It causes any electromagnetic signals it intercepts to become heavily corrupted.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢从吸入的空气中获取能量。它十分耐打，能将对手的攻击力量存入双颚，再原样奉还。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME prefer to get energy from the air they take in. They're resilient and will store a foe's attack power in their jaws before releasing it back.

entry: 壳才是它的本体。POKENAME用巨大的蓝舌头引诱猎物，也用它抵御天敌。
author: milchik
source: The Pokémon itself is actually the shell. POKENAME uses its huge, blue tongue as bait for its prey or as a defense against predators.

entry: 它总是痛苦不堪。双手举得太久造成的酸痛，又让它更添绝望。
author: grassy311
source: It is constantly in a state of anguish. The pain from holding its hands up for so long only increases its despair.

entry: POKENAME的各个头共享意识。战斗时轮流上阵，而且每个头都随时做好了准备。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME's consciousness is shared between each head. They all take turns fighting in a battle, and they're all equally ready to fight.

entry: POKENAME并不适合载人，因为两个头常为该往哪个方向游争执不休。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is not considered to be a viable means of transport. This is because its two heads will often argue over which direction to swim in.

entry: POKENAME看似不止一只，其实始终是同一个生物，两半身体无法分开。
author: frostedwyrm
source: Despite appearances, the two halves of POKENAME cannot be separated. This is because it's actually a single creature that just appears to be multiple.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛已完全消失，改用手中的球观察四周。将球在双手间抛来抛去，就能看清全貌。
author: JackSkipper
source: POKENAME's eyes have completely disappeared. It instead uses its ball to look around, tossing it from hand to hand to get a full visual.

entry: POKENAME的两部分看似是性格迥异的两只宝可梦，却永远无法分开。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: Despite seemingly being two separate Pokémon and having different personalities, the two parts of a POKENAME can never be separated.

entry: POKENAME平时乐呵呵的，却也容易突然陷入绝望。据说尾巴有着自己的性格。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME is known to be jovial, though it is prone to bouts of despair. Its tail is said to have its own personality.

entry: 它只能靠飘浮移动，进食时将脖子伸进水中，吃掉水藻。
author: spagalapof
source: This Pokémon can only move by floating. It feeds on algae by plunging its neck into the water.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃与尾巴天生敌视大多数靠近者。不过，向剑柄那一侧献上素食，就能让它平静下来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade and tail are naturally hostile to most who approach it. However, vegetarian offerings to the hilt's side will calm it down.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛既能抵挡外力伤害，也能抵御寒冷。尾巴常会喷火，拦住想从侧后方接近的敌人。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME's fur is very protective, keeping it safe from physical harm and cold weather. The tail often spews fire to keep possible flankers at bay.

entry: 包裹头部的软泥对周围有微弱的感知。一察觉危险，嘴便猛然闭合，保护其中的头。
author: .realthree
source: The ooze that houses the head has a minor awareness of its surroundings. To protect the head, the mouth will snap closed if danger is detected.

entry: 包裹头部的软泥对周围有微弱的感知。一察觉危险，嘴便猛然闭合，保护其中的头。
author: .realthree
source: The ooze that houses the head has a minor awareness of its surroundings. To protect the head, the mouth will snap closed if danger is detected.

entry: 它喜欢在等待进化时，躺在树果树上休息。白银镇郊外的萄葡果树上，常能看见成群的POKENAME。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to rest in berry trees while waiting to evolve. It is not uncommon to see packs of POKENAME in Grepa Trees outside of Silver Town.

entry: POKENAME很受捕虫少年欢迎，粗硬的皮毛能在野外保护它。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Popular among bug catchers, POKENAME has rough fur that helps to protect it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME脸上树皮般的厚皮，能避免挥角时伤到自己。若角折断，它便会在迸发的热浪中爆炸。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The bark-like hide on POKENAME's face keeps it from injuring itself when swinging its horn. If the horn breaks, it will explode in a burst of heat.

entry: POKENAME对人和宝可梦都慷慨友善。它们喜欢送给人类坚果、树果和水果，分享自然的喜悦。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are very generous and kind to humans and Pokémon alike. They like to give nuts, Berries, and fruit to humans to spread the joys of nature.

entry: 它保留了阿柏怪缠绕束紧的本能，不过主要用来紧紧抱住树干和树枝。
author: mx_wellman
source: Although it retains Arbok's constricting instinct, it mainly puts them to use by holding on tightly to trees and tree branches.

entry: POKENAME喜欢平静地漫游大地。入夜后，还会邀请人和宝可梦到背上扎营。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME like to wander around the land peacefully. Other people and Pokémon are invited to camp on its back during the night.

entry: 它让弱小的鸟宝可梦在背上繁衍。若有人打扰这些住客，POKENAME就会从大树中射出会爆炸的松果。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It allows weak bird Pokémon to breed on its back. POKENAME can shoot explosive pine cones from the large tree if anyone tries to disturb its guests.

entry: 它会用飘带把刀刃般的树皮，粘到中央的黏性部分，迎击来犯者。走投无路时，还会炸散身体，再一点点修复。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its ribbon adds blade-like bark to its sticky center to hit attackers with. As a last resort, it explosively breaks apart and slowly repairs itself.

entry: 臂上的刀刃变成了炮管，攻击方式也更难预测。铠甲哪怕受一点损伤，它都会伤心。
author: Pokopish
source: The blades on its arms have turned into cannons and its attack patterns have become more unpredictable. Any damage to its armor causes it grief.

entry: 它行动迟缓得很，炮管发射弹丸却快得惊人。只有从下方攻击才能伤到它。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is incredibly sluggish and slow, but it can fire projectiles surprisingly quickly from its cannons. You can only damage it from the underside.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: Soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: Soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: 它将冰冻的外壳塑形染色，以此吓退天敌。研究者发现，每个外壳的色调与形状都有细微差别。
author: Pokopish
source: It shapes and dyes its frozen shell to deter predators. Researchers note the subtle differences in each shell's hue and form.

entry: POKENAME的钢甲遮住了身体。白天潜藏地下，只露出带毒的叶片。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's steel armor conceals its form. By day, it hides underground, revealing only its poisonous leaves.

entry: 它胆小易惊，或许源于佛烈托斯不愿露出内部身体的习性。受惊时会紧紧攀住那块金属。
author: bukie
source: Its skittish disposition might arise from Forretress's reluctance to reveal its innards. It squeezes tightly onto its metal hunk when frightened.

entry: 虽然菌菇藏在壳里，POKENAME的孢子仍能感染其他生物。它也能像其他佛烈托斯一样，缩入巨大的钢壳。
author: .ssunday.
source: Although its fungus is hidden by its shell, POKENAME spores can still infect others. It can retract into its large steel shell, like other Forretress.

entry: POKENAME多出的肢体能释放各式超能力攻击。不过，坚硬的外壳反而让它更适合用身体力量进攻。
author: ohok3441
source: The extra limbs on POKENAME can fire a multitude of psychic attacks. Despite this, its hard shell makes it better as a physical attacker.

entry: 性情温顺，看似很适合载人，可它只顾在泥土中酣睡，根本无心载谁一程。
author: fountainihili
source: It seems like it would be good for transport with its gentle nature, but is too focused on sleeping soundly in the dirt to give a ride to anyone.

entry: 土龙弟弟为了成为真正的龙，与迷你龙融合成了POKENAME。不过它仍有许多东西要学，也还得勤加锻炼。
author: milchik
source: Wishing to become a true dragon, Dunsparce fused itself with Dratini to create POKENAME. However, it still has a lot of learning and training to do.

entry: 它竭力想显得美丽威严，可惜头太大、脸又傻气，再怎么努力也不讨人喜欢。
author: milchik
source: This fusion tries its best to look beautiful and majestic. Despite its attempts, no one likes it because of its overly large head and silly face.

entry: 土龙弟弟成为真龙的愿望终于借融合实现。POKENAME虽十分强大，其实却相当腼腆温柔。
author: milchik
source: Dunsparce's wish to become a real dragon came true with this fusion. Despite being quite powerful, POKENAME is actually pretty bashful and kind.

entry: POKENAME很会讲故事。训练家常到它的洞穴拜访，向它请教丰富的智慧。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME is a great storyteller. Trainers often visit this Pokémon's burrow to learn from its vast wisdom.

entry: POKENAME总用尾巴钻进下水道，让城里的居民头疼不已。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME always drill into sewers with their tails, making them a nuisance for people living in the city.

entry: 它们总是快快乐乐，成群聚在湖畔与河边，完全不必担心天敌。
author: zerocipher
source: They are always happy, gathering in groups along the banks of lakes and rivers. They don't have to worry about any predators.

entry: 它靠悬浮行动，翅膀只剩祖先遗留的退化器官。看似弱小，却意外地很受欢迎。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its wings are vestigial organs from its ancestors, as it is able to levitate. Despite its apparent weakness, it's a surprisingly popular Pokémon.

entry: 四肢缩回时，洞穴探险者常被它绊倒。传说它能用身体两侧的翅膀飞行。
author: beespoon
source: Spelunkers often trip over this Pokémon when its limbs are retracted. According to legend, it can fly with the wings on its sides.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尖端钻进巨树，寻找流动的树液。饱餐后便钻入掏空的树干，慢慢消化。
author: hampterbychoice
source: With its drill-tips, POKENAME mines for veins of sap in the largest trees. Once finished, it burrows inside the hollowed-out tree to digest.

entry: POKENAME将原石放入粗糙的皮囊，再徒手一点点打磨成蛋形。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME put raw stones into their rough skin pouch. They then slowly polish them into an egg shape by sanding it down with their bare hands.

entry: 在被认出是融合宝可梦之前，POKENAME曾被当作土龙弟弟自然进化而成的形态。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Before its discovery as a fusion, POKENAME was thought to be the natural evolution of Dunsparce.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尾端掘洞，住在湖泊附近，享受周围的繁茂绿意。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME burrows with its drill-tipped tail, dwelling near lakes to enjoy the lush surroundings.

entry: 遇到威胁时，长枪会笔直钻入地下助它脱身；友好比试时，则会直直钻向挑战者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its lance drills straight down into the ground to escape threats, or straight toward challengers in friendly duels.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘隧道，土龙弟弟跟在后面寻找猎物。即使挖上一整天，POKENAME的刀刃也不会变钝。
author: nelluc27
source: POKENAME will dig tunnels underground with Dunsparce following it in search of prey. Despite digging all day POKENAME's blades never dull.

entry: POKENAME尾部的发电机能把摄入的地下养分转为强劲电力，再引导电流流遍全身。
author: NellNast42
source: The underground nutrients POKENAME consumes are converted into strong electricity using the generator on its tail, which directs it through its body.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尾巴掘地，寻找金属吞食。吃下的金属会强化POKENAME铠甲般的外壳。
author: EcoVermination
source: POKENAME uses its drill-shaped tail to burrow for metal to eat. The metal POKENAME consumes strengthens its armor-like shell.

entry: POKENAME用头上的钻尖翻耕泥土，令土壤养分更丰富，再加以食用。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Using the drill tip on its head, POKENAME tills soil to make it it more nutrient rich for consumption.

entry: POKENAME看似不起眼，却以突然发狂、袭击无辜训练家而恶名远扬。若看见一只，附近往往就潜着一群。
author: SinisterSama
source: Though unassuming, POKENAME are notorious for suddenly getting violent and attacking innocent trainers. If you see one, a school of them is nearby.

entry: POKENAME在海底形成庞大的群落。整群迁移时，震动甚至可能引发地震。
author: MunchyAxolotls
source: POKENAME lives in massive colonies under the sea. When these colonies migrate, the vibrations may cause earthquakes.

entry: 它用头上的巨钻破开猎物的甲壳。触手像直升机旋翼一样甩动，还能让它稍稍浮起。
author: Soup1900
source: It uses the giant drill on its head to break any shell on its prey. It is able to hover a little by whipping its tentacles around like a helicopter.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尾端向后钻入地下。富有弹性的皮肤，让它在水陆两处都能灵活活动。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME uses its drill-tipped tail to burrow into the ground backward. Its very flexible skin aids its movements both on land and in water.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，便把大葱当作手杖。有时飞起来也很吃力。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses its leek as a cane because it doesn't have the best eyesight. It sometimes struggles to fly.

entry: 它钻入地下深处寻找稀有石头。发现的红宝石都会囤起来，留待日后食用。
author: .izik
source: It burrows deep underground looking for rare stones. Any rubies it finds are hoarded and consumed at a later date.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥浆和死水中埋伏猎物，钳子的力量足以剪断肢体。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME hides in mud and stagnant water, lying in wait for prey. Its pincer is strong enough to cut off limbs.

entry: 它外貌吓人，实际远没有想象中危险。有人称它为天空中的小丑。
author: 8xviktor
source: While it appears intimidating, this Pokémon is actually much less threatening than people think. Some people refer to it as the clown of the sky.

entry: POKENAME拍翼掀起沙暴，待猎物被风沙迷住双眼，便用长尾注入毒液。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME whips up a sandstorm by flapping its wings. Once its prey is blinded, it uses its long tail to inject its victim with poison.

entry: 它用双翼在水中急转弯，也十分擅长攀爬，会爬上树啃食枝条。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its wings to make tight turns in the water. It is an excellent climber and will scale trees to gnaw at branches.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的后爪攀住树木，吸食树液。只要从高处跃下，POKENAME就能乘气流滑翔。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME use their sharp back claws to dig into trees as they drink sap. POKENAME can glide on air currents, provided they jump from a high place.

entry: POKENAME很寂寞，在沙漠中四处寻找能和自己做朋友的训练家。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is lonely, so it searches the desert, looking for a Trainer who can be its friend.

entry: 这种POKENAME十分忧伤，藏在干裂的土地缝隙中。只有少数训练家拥有这种模样的POKENAME。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This POKENAME is extremely sad. Only a few Trainers have this variation of POKENAME that hides in the cracks of dry earth.

entry: POKENAME时常用大舌头舔舐额前的金币，让它始终闪闪发亮。
author: mx_wellman
source: A POKENAME will routinely lick the gold coin on its forehead with its big tongue in order to keep it nice and shiny.

entry: POKENAME模仿别人时，身上的钻石便会发光。若不移开视线，就会无可抗拒地被它迷住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME mimics someone, the diamonds on its body start to glow. If you don't look away, you will be inexorably drawn into its mesmerizing charm.

entry: 钻石构成的爪子，能轻易切开钢铁般坚固的金属。极其结实的外壳也为它提供保护。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its claws are made of diamonds, allowing it to easily cut through metals as strong as steel. It is similarly protected by an incredibly sturdy shell.

entry: POKENAME乘磁场滑行，以钢翼灵活急转，飞行迅疾而无声。
author: Cybresamurai
source: POKENAME glides on magnetic fields, steering sharply with its steel wings in silent and swift flight.

entry: 它在地下高速钻进，身体能承受极高压力。传闻曾有城市因它而消失。
author: HoundRyS
source: It drills underground at high speeds. Its body allows it to resist the highest pressures. It has been rumored to cause the disappearance of cities.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力悬浮。身体太过沉重，稍有较大的动作，就得休息好几个小时。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME levitates with psychic exertions. Its body is so heavy that it has to rest for several hours after any significant motion.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，常殃及周围。凭着爆发性的力量，它也常出现在拆迁工地。
author: awiralonprime
source: With its temper issues, POKENAME will often cause collateral damage around it. This Pokémon is seen in demolition sites due to its explosive power.

entry: 它爱模仿身边发生的一切。头上的水晶能折射来自各个方向的光，将其导入脑中。
author: funkytomate
source: It loves to mimic anything going on around it. The crystal on its head can break and redirect light coming from any direction into its brain.

entry: POKENAME用爪子施加惊人压力，制造钻石粉尘，再将粉尘卷起，用来磨利身体或攻击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can exert incredible pressure with its claws. This creates diamond dust, which it whirls around to sharpen its body or to attack.

entry: 民间传说，艾路雷朵会深入洞穴，击败大钢蛇，再用它的遗骸锻造武器。
author: conductor#2682 (j1miin)
source: Folklore says that a Gallade will travel deep into a cave and defeat a Steelix.  The Gallade will then forge its weapon with the remains.

entry: POKENAME有“活体无畏舰”之称，叫声如战号，连陆地上都能听见。它游动时，碰上它便会致命。
author: JokersWild
source: Nicknamed "The Living Dreadnought", POKENAME bellow a warhorn-like call that can be heard from land. Coming into contact with one swimming is deadly.

entry: POKENAME散发强大气场，据说水晶尾巴内蕴藏着远古力量。它是纯洁的化身。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME emits a powerful aura, and it's rumored to contain ancient strength within its crystal tails. It embodies purity.

entry: 它们蜕皮后会留下精美宝石，夜里映照月光，璀璨动人。
author: mrbapcik
source: When these Pokémon molt, they leave behind exquisite gemstones. These gemstones beautifully reflect the moonlight at night.

entry: 阳光直射穿过POKENAME的水晶尾巴时，会折射出缤纷虹彩，使猎物分心。
author: kittyluv090
source: When direct sunlight shines through POKENAME's crystalline tails, it creates a colorful and prismatic display which distracts its prey.

entry: POKENAME刚进化时会离群独居，独自锻炼、打磨身体，并拼死保护自己的鬃毛。
author: ETheWriter
source: POKENAME seclude themselves away when they first evolve. They train and polish their body alone, protecting their manes with their lives.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由经过淬炼的钢构成，能承受极高温度。巨锤击中的一切，都会被点燃。
author: KDUFFRadio
source: The tempered steel that makes up POKENAME's armor can withstand extremely high temperatures. It sets ablaze anything it strikes with its large hammer.

entry: 夜里，它藏入洞穴恢复能量。钢铁身体散发热量，而它总爱寻衅挑衅。
author: astrael1
source: At night, it seeks refuge in caves to replenish its energy. Its steel body radiates heat, and it always seeks confrontation.

entry: POKENAME从体表的宝石汲取超能力。曾有人在深邃洞穴中见到它冥想。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME draws its psychic power from the gems outside its body. It has been seen meditating in deep caverns.

entry: POKENAME用钳子将煤炭压成钻石。钳子的模样会让对手眼生重影，既受惊又迷惑。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME uses its claw to crush coal into diamonds. The claw's appearance is designed to intimidate and confuse opponents by making them see double.

entry: POKENAME长得像魔杖，打架却没什么花样，更爱抡起脑袋，反复朝对手敲去。
author: mx_wellman
source: Despite their resemblance to magic wands, POKENAME are much more prone to simply and repeatedly bonk their heads against their opponents.

entry: POKENAME虽常大喊大叫、龇牙咧嘴，却既不危险也不好斗，很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Although POKENAME often shouts and grimaces, it is neither dangerous nor aggressive. It is a popular Pokémon for rookie Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的两个头总是意见不合。连吃饭也要互咬争吵，场面让人忍俊不禁。
author: akujules
source: POKENAME's two heads are in constant disagreement. Their inability to get along turns mealtime into a hilarious display of bites and squabbles.

entry: POKENAME是一只贪玩的小小鸟宝可梦，谁一靠近，就想拉对方玩捉迷藏。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very playful tiny bird Pokémon. It will attempt to play hide and seek with anyone coming near.

entry: POKENAME特别贪玩，谁一靠近就想玩捉迷藏。可它身上闪着金光，总是藏不住。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very playful Pokémon. It will attempt to play hide-and-seek with anyone coming near. However, it fails due to its golden sparkle.

entry: 它吐出的丝网细得惊人，却能承住数吨重量，依然不断。
author: .izik
source: The webbing that it uses is extremely thin. Despite how thin it is, it is able to hold multiple tons without breaking.

entry: 野生宝可梦捡到被丢弃的基因之楔，便产生了POKENAME这样的融合。如今它几乎快被列为害兽了。
author: mx_wellman
source: One of the results of discarded DNA Splicers being found by wild Pokémon, POKENAME is close to being classified as a pest.

entry: 若因某种原因一整天没飞，它就会在之后两天不知疲倦地飞个不停。睡觉时会发出嗡嗡声。
author: .izik
source: If, for some reason, it does not fly for a day, it will spend the next two days flying without tiring. It emits a hum while it sleeps.

entry: 它飞行时从不张翼，像风筝般悄然飘过天空，等待猎物现身。
author: .izik
source: It flies without ever opening its wings. It mimics a kite as it sails silently through the air, waiting for prey to reveal itself.

entry: 它吃东西常不嚼就吞，肚子一不舒服，就会尖叫好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: While eating, it often swallows food without chewing. If it ever experiences an upset stomach, it will shriek for hours.

entry: POKENAME重得无法飞行，却是敏捷的短跑高手。即便被天敌抓住，对方也很难突破它的甲片。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, but it is an agile sprinter. Even predators that catch it will have trouble getting through its plating.

entry: POKENAME还不习惯长途飞行。不过在父母温柔的鼓励下，总有一天会离开巢穴。
author: cipherlingarde
source: It's not comfortable with flying long distances yet, but with gentle urging from its parents, POKENAME will one day leave the nest.

entry: 它很容易发怒，谁若闯入领地，就会被它啄个不停。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Quick to aggravate, this Pokémon will incessantly peck at anyone who wanders into its territory.

entry: POKENAME攀爬峭壁也不知疲倦。若遇到树根，就会啄到流出树液，再饮下汁液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can scale cliff walls without tiring. If it encounters tree roots, it will peck at them until sap runs out, then drink the fluid.

entry: 它飞不了多远就得休息。拍翼时会散出有毒孢子，能使人抽搐发作。
author: .izik
source: It can only fly a short distance without needing to rest. When it flaps its wings it releases toxic spores that can cause seizures.

entry: POKENAME会囤积领地内所有闪亮的小饰物。如果遭到它的攻击，可以用珠宝换取安全通行的机会。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME will hoard any shiny baubles within its territory. If you find yourself to be target of its aggression, trade it jewelry for safe passage.

entry: 虽然眼神让它显得很凶，POKENAME却会很快依恋上敢伸手抚摸它的人。
author: .izik
source: While it may look angry due to its eyes, a POKENAME will quickly grow emotionally attached to anyone who is brave enough to pet it.

entry: 翅上的羽毛入水后会拢在一起，让POKENAME当作鳍使用。短腿划水也能帮它加速。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The feathers of its wings clump together in the water so that POKENAME can use them as fins. It can also pedal with its stubby legs to accelerate.

entry: 它飞行时会从腹部的洞口排出大量毒烟。不过，这些烟不会伤到它自己。
author: .izik
source: While it flies it releases large amounts of toxic smoke from the hole in its belly. The smoke does not affect its own body.

entry: POKENAME囤积财宝，为了守住宝物会凶狠地狂吠、龇牙。可真打起来，却相当胆小。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME hoards treasure and will bark and bare its fangs viciously to protect it. However, in an actual fight, it is quite cowardly.

entry: POKENAME常被用来看守废品场等地方。但它们性情懒散，大多只是叫得凶，却不怎么咬人。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly used as guards for junkyards and similar establishments. However, their lax personalities mean most are more bark than bite.

entry: POKENAME比外貌看起来更亲人，也很容易受惊。一旦吓着，就会在恐惧中横冲直撞。
author: GenesisParallax
source: POKENAME is much cuddlier than its looks might suggest. They are easily startled and, when spooked, it will take off on a fear-fueled rampage.

entry: 人们相信，守护冥界入口的三头犬传说，或许正是因这只宝可梦而起。
author: naga_sake
source: It's believed that this Pokémon has sparked legends of a three-headed dog that guards the entrance to the underworld.

entry: 任何东西靠近巢穴，它都会俯冲撞过去。想吓跑它，只会让它更加凶猛。
author: cait_sith
source: It divebombs anything that gets too close to its nest. Trying to scare it off will only make it more aggressive.

entry: POKENAME的小屋由极其坚固的黑曜石和火山岩筑成。发达的下颚能轻松咬碎各种岩石。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's hut is made of incredibly robust obsidian and volcanic rock. With its well-developed lower jaw, it effortlessly crushes any rock.

entry: 烹制POKENAME时，要先将倒刺浸在冷水中，让毒素散去后再拔除。
author: .izik
source: When cooking a POKENAME, it is important to let the barbs sit in cold water before removing them. This allows the toxins to disperse.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时会鼓胀得极为巨大，亮出尖刺。放松下来，却意外地温顺。
author: _sadfroggy
source: When threatened, POKENAME balloons to an enormous size, presenting its spines. When relaxed, it is surprisingly docile.

entry: 猎物还没游近，POKENAME便已知道它何时会来。它在海面上飞行，掌握着俯冲捕食的最佳时机。
author: .ssunday.
source: It knows when prey will come before they even swim near POKENAME. It flies above the sea, knowing the perfect time to swoop down and catch its food.

entry: POKENAME全身长满带毒的短刺。饲养POKENAME的训练家必须小心接触，以免被刺伤。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME are covered in short toxic quills. Trainers that own a POKENAME must handle them with care to avoid getting pricked.

entry: 棱角分明的头部让它能以惊人速度破水而行。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its angular head allows it to cut through the water at blistering speeds.

entry: 两只千针鱼融合后，POKENAME似乎呈现出古时千针鱼进化形态的模样。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: The fusion of two Qwilfish appears to have resulted in POKENAME taking on a form resembling an evolved Qwilfish of the past.

entry: POKENAME的乳房里既存着奶，也存着毒液。农夫前来挤奶时，往往会被喷一脸毒。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME keep both toxins and milk in their udders. If a farmer comes up to milk it, they get splatted in the face with poison.

entry: 它长着毒刺，反应快如闪电，从阴影中准确地发出致命一击。先令猎物中毒，再结果对方。
author: anarchaz
source: With venomous spines and lightning-fast reflexes, it strikes from the shadows with deadly precision. It poisons its victims before finishing them.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁间，用捡来的珊瑚碎片伪装自己。它能用壳上的尖刺，将毒液注入捕食者体内。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME live amongst coral reefs and use pieces of coral it finds as camouflage. It uses the quills on its shell to inject poison into predators.

entry: 据说POKENAME是被千针鱼毒死、痛苦身亡的渔夫之魂。它会钩住大批水生宝可梦，并使其毒发。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Said to be the spirit of a fisherman painfully killed by a Qwilfish's poison, POKENAME hooks and poisons mass amounts of aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只以等离子体为食。受威胁时，会释放纯粹的能量自卫。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME exclusively eats plasma. When threatened, it will discharge pure energy to defend itself.

entry: 以为摸上去会软绵绵的人，都会被POKENAME刺人的鬃毛吓一跳。仍有人剪下鬃毛制作纺织品，而它非常讨厌这样。
author: bukie
source: Those expecting soft fluff are unpleasantly surprised by POKENAME's prickly mane, yet it is still shorn by some for use in textiles. It hates this.

entry: 以为摸上去会软绵绵的人，都会被POKENAME刺人的鬃毛吓一跳。仍有人剪下鬃毛制作纺织品，而它非常讨厌这样。
author: bukie
source: Those expecting soft fluff are unpleasantly surprised by POKENAME's prickly mane, yet it is still shorn by some for use in textiles. It hates this.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛如同带刺铁丝。许多人推测，其中含有金属颗粒。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's fur is similar to barbed wire. Many speculate that there are metal particles in its fur.

entry: POKENAME极力捍卫领地。任何东西靠得太近，都会被它猛烈撞击。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are highly defensive of their territory. They will violently ram into anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体很容易浮在水中。两只打架时，会使出极大力量互相头槌。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have soft bodies that are built for buoyancy. If two fight, they'll headbutt one another with extreme force.

entry: POKENAME磨牙时，正在尖刺后积蓄毒素。随后就会凶猛地发动攻击，最好离远一些。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME grinds its teeth, it's building up poison behind its spines. It attacks aggressively after doing so, so stay clear.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME曾被认为已经灭绝。因为性情凶暴，人类一度试图将它赶尽杀绝。
author: .realthree
source: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. Its aggressive demeanor led to humans attempting to eradicate it.

entry: 它性情粗犷又爱打架。无论被揍得多惨，总能再站起来。
author: themicelegion
source: This rough Pokémon loves fighting. No matter how badly it gets beat, it always gets back up.

entry: 它们很不善于留意周围。发现POKENAME身上挂满海藻和藤壶，实在不足为奇。
author: .izik
source: They are very bad at noticing their surroundings. It is not uncommon to find POKENAME covered in seaweed and barnacles.

entry: 逃避天敌时，POKENAME会用巨大的双镰砍倒沿途挡路的树木。
author: kingeroyal
source: When fleeing a predator, POKENAME cuts down any forest trees in its way using its great scythes.

entry: POKENAME的钳子里储存着会爆炸的酶。捕猎时先钳住猎物，再贴近引爆。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME stores explosive enzymes in its pincers. When it hunts, it grabs its prey and detonates close-range explosions.

entry: POKENAME只在攻击或进食时打开外壳。外壳与甲片的颜色并不固定。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME only open their shell when they are attacking or eating. The color of the shell and carapace can vary.

entry: POKENAME本领多样，既能用钳子击倒树木，也能用角撞碎巨石。
author: Incognito1234
source: A highly versatile Pokémon, POKENAME is able to use its pincers to knock down trees and its horns to destroy boulders.

entry: POKENAME如同活兵器，一旦动起来便几乎势不可挡。可碰上崎岖地形，又特别容易卡住。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is a living weapon, nigh unstoppable once it starts moving. However, it's very susceptible to getting stuck on uneven terrain.

entry: POKENAME上半身的铠甲虽然不含铁，仍然十分坚硬。腹部却毫无保护。
author: Faelocke
source: The armor covering POKENAME's upper body contains no iron, but is still remarkably hard. Its stomach is unprotected, however.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由昆虫几丁质天然形成，不仅极其轻盈，而且像钢铁一样坚硬。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade is naturally formed out of ultralight insect chitin that is also as hard as steel.

entry: POKENAME栖居星球的低空轨道。重返大气时，金属身体会烧得白热，随后便到深海休息降温。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME resides in the planet's lower orbit. Upon re-entry, its metallic body becomes white-hot, so it then rests in the deep ocean to cool down.

entry: POKENAME能将双手的火焰塑成各种美丽形状，很受表演者欢迎。
author: hiimbasil
source: POKENAME is a very popular Pokémon for performers. It has the ability to create beautiful shapes out of the fire on its hands.

entry: 尾巴上的钳子攻守兼备。POKENAME控火十分娴熟，能用钳子充当火焰喷射器。
author: CodeWolfie
source: The pincers on its tails act as both defense and offense. POKENAME is very skilled with their fire, using its pincers as flamethrowers.

entry: POKENAME生活在干燥荒原，强劲的双颚能咬裂任何铠甲。头部还能转动180度。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in dry wastelands and can crack any armor with its strong jaw. It can turn its head 180 degrees.

entry: POKENAME的颈毛锋利如刃，结实的身体则帮它熬过荒原上的烈日。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its ruff is razor-sharp. Its robust body helps POKENAME to endure the scorching sun of wastelands.

entry: POKENAME的甲片缝隙似乎会渗出油脂。钳子能夹碎敌人，来袭者却很难抓牢它。
author: maxiundmicky
source: POKENAME appears to secrete grease from between its carapace plates. Its claws can crush its foes, while any attacker struggles to get a grip on it.

entry: POKENAME行动不太灵便。飞行属性宝可梦靠近时，它便干脆缩进硬壳。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME isn't very mobile. When a Flying-type Pokémon approaches, it simply withdraws into its hard shell.

entry: POKENAME常无忧无虑地四处飘荡。有人说，那是毒素侵入了它的脑子。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is often seen floating about without a care in the world. Some say the toxins got to its brain.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME体内流动的毒素严重伤害了身体。它最终可能病重得无法作战，渐渐衰亡。
author: .ssunday.
source: After evolving, toxins flowing through POKENAME's body seriously damaged it. This Pokémon may eventually get too sick to fight and wilt away.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有自己的招牌果汁，还爱与别人争论谁酿的更好。
author: birchbot
source: Every POKENAME has a signature juice. It likes to argue with others about whose juice is better.

entry: 这种模样的POKENAME格外关心环保，有时会被错认成扫帚。
author: birchbot
source: This variant of POKENAME is more concerned about saving the environment. Sometimes it is mistaken for a broom.

entry: POKENAME用威风凛凛的外形吓跑天敌，好安心酿造果汁。据说酿出的汁液尝起来像葡萄酒。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME takes advantage of its imposing shape to scare away predators so it can brew its juice in peace. This juice supposedly tastes akin to wine.

entry: 它满脑子只想着吃蜂蜜。不吃的时候，就忙着搜集原料，自己酿蜜。
author: birchbot
source: The only thing on this Pokémon's mind is eating honey. When it's not eating honey, it will scavenge ingredients to make its own.

entry: 它不停分泌黏液，使身体不怕进水。对孩子十分友善，无论如何都会把保护他们放在首位。
author: Skymaster426
source: It secretes mucus constantly, which allows it to stay waterproof. It is very friendly around children and will protect them above all else.

entry: POKENAME将捡来的各种树果收进包袱，都是训练家丢弃的。走过之处常留下一路果汁。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME carries assorted berries it finds discarded by Trainers in its bundle. It tends to leave a trail of berry juice from behind it.

entry: POKENAME用包袱装着训练家丢弃的树果，身后常会留下一路果汁。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME uses its bundle to carry berries discarded by Trainers. It tends to leave a trail of berry juice in its wake.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里的咯咯声，是有毒树果正在榨成果汁的声音。甜甜的汁液常使毫无戒心的猎物昏迷。
author: zyrobrokenmirror
source: The rattling noises from POKENAME's tail are toxic Berries being turned into juice. This sweet juice often renders unsuspecting prey unconscious.

entry: POKENAME热切盼着进化，憧憬进化后的美好可能，比如酿出美味果汁。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME are excited about evolving. They dream of the wonderful possibilities they could pursue, such as making delicious juice.

entry: 只要喂对树果，POKENAME就能产生独特的香气，因此闻名。据说这些香气还具有药效。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is noted for its ability to produce unique fragrances when given the right Berries. These fragrances are said to have medicinal properties.

entry: POKENAME脸上的笑容从不改变，生气也一样。其余外貌却会随着心情或环境变化。
author: Skymaster426
source: The smile POKENAME wears on its face never changes, even in anger. It's appearance shifts depending on either mood or circumstance.

entry: POKENAME速度惊人、耐力出众，又十分强大，有人甚至认为它无可战胜。它喜欢教导难管的宝可梦，带领它们成长。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is so fast, durable, and powerful that some consider it to be undefeatable. It enjoys teaching and mentoring troublesome Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常为缺少老师的班级授课。凭着速度与战斗本领，它有了“无敌教师”的称号。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME is usually seen instructing classes that lack teachers. Its speed and combat prowess give it the name "The Invincible Teacher".

entry: 它看不清东西，难以自保；可若脱下外壳，又会失去保护。
author: birchbot
source: This Pokémon is helpless as it is difficult for it to see. Taking off the shell would make it just as vulnerable.

entry: 终于能看清世界后，POKENAME开始迷恋大自然。采摘树果，大多只是觉得它们模样好看。
author: birchbot
source: Finally able to see clearly, POKENAME developed a fascination for nature. It picks Berries mostly because it thinks they look neat.

entry: POKENAME格外看重自己的高跟鞋。从采摘树果的小家伙，如今已成了引人瞩目的存在。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME puts a lot of emphasis on its high heels. It went from picking Berries to becoming iconic.

entry: POKENAME把树果囤积在腹部的嘴里。如果有宝可梦想偷吃，它就会伸出几条隐藏的触须发动攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hoards Berries in the mouth on its stomach. If a Pokémon tries to steal some of its Berries, it will attack with several hidden tendrils.

entry: POKENAME把树果囤积在腹部的嘴里。如果有宝可梦想偷吃，它就会伸出几条隐藏的触须发动攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hoards Berries in the mouth on its stomach. If a Pokémon tries to steal some of its Berries, it will attack with several hidden tendrils.

entry: POKENAME是杂食性宝可梦，会先用带刺的壳捶打食物，再吞下碎屑，与体液混合成咸甜的汁液。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is omnivorous and beats its food with its spiky shell. It eats what's left, mixing with its bodily fluids to create a sweet and savory juice.

entry: 它热衷于制作树果汁，见谁都想请对方尝尝。与普通壶壶不同，它还会借助工具榨汁。
author: birchbot
source: It enjoys the art of making Berry Juice, offering some to anyone it sees. Unlike a regular Shuckle, it uses tools to make juice.

entry: POKENAME的身体纠缠成一团，体内的结越大，就越难对付。它能把任何树果碾成细细的果泥。
author: pory
source: A tangled mess, the bigger the knot inside a POKENAME, the more formidable it is. Its body can crush any berry down into a fine pulp.

entry: 它喜欢制作冰沙。晴天里，经常能看到它与摊贩待在一起。
author: birchbot
source: It likes to make slushies. It is commonly seen with vendors on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME既能翻耕土地，又能用吃下的树果分解后的残渣施肥，对农夫而言是难得的帮手。
author: Larkus
source: POKENAME is incredibly valuable to farmers due to its ability to till land and fertilize it with the decomposed remnants of the Berries it eats.

entry: POKENAME头上的孔中藏着强壮的触手。不知为何，它还能去除海水中的盐分。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME has very strong tentacles hidden in the holes on its head. For some odd reason, it has the ability to get rid of the salt in seawater.

entry: 攻击时，脸上的角会膨大数倍。发怒时，轻易就能撞碎巨石。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its face grows multiple sizes when it attacks. When it gets angry, it can destroy a boulder with ease.

entry: 野生POKENAME会聚在印记树林，吸食树干内部的汁液。它能用耳朵察觉危险。
author: .ssunday.
source: Wild POKENAME gather together in the Tagtree Thicket and drink the sap inside of trees. It can sense danger with its ears.

entry: POKENAME的角会随着季节生长、变化。它脱落的叶片十分稀少，虽然味苦，却被广泛用作药材。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's horn grows and changes with the seasons. The sparse leaves it sheds are used in many medicinal remedies, despite their bitter taste.

entry: POKENAME携带强劲的长矛，既能攻击，也能打落敌人的武器。POKENAME勇敢地捍卫领地，却容易被甜食吸引。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME carries a powerful spear that can both attack and disarm foes. POKENAME defends its territory valiantly, but it is drawn to sweet treats.

entry: POKENAME常互相争斗至筋疲力尽，借此锻炼角的坚韧程度。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME can often be seen fighting one another to exhaustion in order to increase the durability of their horns.

entry: POKENAME用巨力放倒树木，吸取甘甜的树液。若进食时被打扰，它也会退而求其次，吸走来袭者的生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME fells trees with tremendous force to absorb their sweet sap. It will settle for an attacker's life force if disturbed while eating.

entry: POKENAME有森林英雄之称，会灵巧地在树间跳跃，巡视有无危险。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known as heroes of the forest. They nimbly leap from tree to tree scouting for danger.

entry: POKENAME喜欢长时间静伏不动。毫无戒心的猎物一靠近，它便弹出角状的肢体。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME prefers to lie dormant for long periods of time. When unsuspecting prey approaches, it shoots out its horn-like appendage.

entry: POKENAME栖居广袤的红杉林，靠双翼在树间移动，以角钻取营养丰富的树液。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME lives in great redwood forests, propelling itself from tree to tree with its wings. It uses its horn to excavate nutritious sap.

entry: POKENAME十分顽皮，爱用角戳人，随后迅速消失无踪。
author: Incognito1234
source: A mischievous creature, POKENAME like to poke humans with its horn before quickly disappearing.

entry: POKENAME很固执，常试图举起比自身重好几倍的东西，结果往往失败。
author: Incognito1234
source: A very stubborn Pokémon, POKENAME is usually seen trying to lift objects many times its own weight, oftentimes failing.

entry: 它崇拜赫拉克罗斯和强大的斗士。即使笨拙地模仿它们的招式，凭着扬起的毒粉，攻击仍然有效。
author: PokePower
source: It idolizes Heracross and great fighters. Even its clumsy imitations of their moves are effective, thanks to the toxic powder it kicks up.

entry: 它们用角合力挖掘，速度快得惊人。即便地下挡着巨石，也能一口气击穿。
author: wigglypon
source: Using their horns, they work together to dig at incredible speeds. It has the power to smash clean through buried obstacles, such as boulders.

entry: POKENAME在活火山上空，以强健的大角相互决斗。分节铠甲坚韧如钢，摸上去滚烫。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME joust over active volcanoes, duelling with their mighty horns. Their segmented armor is tough as steel and burning hot to the touch.

entry: POKENAME的体热会将炮管射出的水加热到滚烫。角还能感知即将到来的降雨。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's internal body heat heats the water it fires from its cannons to scalding temperatures. Using its horns, it can sense oncoming rain.

entry: 它在海底疾行，很少露出水面。没人知道壳里究竟藏着什么。
author: Krune
source: It scurries along the bottom of the sea, rarely seen above water. Nobody knows what is inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME放出的烟雾看似幽灵般的雾气，其实是使人麻痹的粉末，吸入后可能致命。
author: ohok3441
source: While the smog produced by POKENAME appears similar to ghostly smoke, it's actually stunning powder. Inhaling it can be deadly.

entry: POKENAME能发出多种类似笑声的叫声。头部带角的甲片，形状与大小各不相同。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME have a variety of vocalizations they can make that sound like laughter. The horned plating on its head comes in different shapes and sizes.

entry: POKENAME飞快蹿向敌人，用小小的刀刃戳刺。它热衷于破坏。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME skitters up to enemies to poke them with its little blades. It loves destruction.

entry: POKENAME凶狠又记仇，常在深夜互相攻击。皮毛越长的个体越警觉，也越不信任别人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Vicious and spiteful, POKENAME will attack one another late in the night. The longer the Pokémon's fur, the more vigilant and less trusting they are.

entry: 它们天生甘愿当手下，会聚到附近最强的个体身边。只要能捣乱，就会勤勤恳恳地执行命令。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: Natural-born underlings, they flock to the strongest individual nearby. They follow orders diligently as long as it causes mischief.

entry: POKENAME守在阴影里，用灵活伸缩的刀刃撬开无人看守的蛋，或撕开无力防备的猎物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: After waiting in the shadows, POKENAME uses its dexterous, retractable blades to crack open unguarded eggs or rip into vulnerable victims.

entry: 这种POKENAME与一根坚硬如石的树枝形影不离。它把树枝当工具，试着采集难以够到的蜂蜜。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME travels inseparably with a rock-hard tree branch, which it uses as a tool to attempt honey-gathering in hard-to-reach areas.

entry: 绿色的前臂覆满甜美蜂蜜。夏天，三蜜蜂会把POKENAME误当作产蜜的树，成群围过来。
author: char_latte3412
source: Its green forearms are coated in a very sweet honey. During the summer, Combee will swarm POKENAME, mistaking it for a nectar-producing tree.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME会随着流星雨落到大地。即便白天，眼中也闪耀着星光。
author: missingmilkman
source: It is thought that POKENAME fall to earth during meteor showers. Its eye twinkles with starlight, even during the day.

entry: POKENAME在村镇街头漫游，四处找甜食，尤其爱闯进糖果店大吃一番。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams the streets of villages and towns in search of sweets. Its favorite place to raid is a confectionery shop.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，却低估了自己的力气，必须格外小心。它强劲的双颚轻易就能咬穿金属。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is playful, but extreme caution is required as it underestimates its own strength. It can easily bite through metal with its strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏欲睡。它睡的枕头，连暴怒的火暴猴都能哄入梦乡。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always very sleepy. The pillow it sleeps on could send even a raging Primeape into slumber.

entry: 它在人面前十分害羞。想与它交朋友，最简单的办法就是送上蜂蜜。
author: Toxicrown
