source: This Pokémon is extremely shy around people. The easiest way to befriend one is to present it with honey.

entry: POKENAME常出现在蜂女王巢穴附近的田野中。它们一心寻找蜂蜜，除此之外什么都不吃。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often found in fields near Vespiquen hives. They are always on the hunt for honey, and will not eat anything other than it.

entry: POKENAME既善战也善泳。全力以赴时，甚至能一边游过蜂蜜，一边吃蜜补足所需能量。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is a strong fighter and swimmer. When using all of its strength, it can even swim through honey while eating enough for the energy it needs.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME四处寻找最甜的蜂蜜滋养自己。蜂蜜越甜，叶片也会越甜。
author: pory
source: A small child, POKENAME searches for the sweetest honey it can find to nourish itself. The sweeter the honey, the sweeter its leaves turn.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，将水域周边的大片土地都据为己有，因此被渔夫称为“山湖之王”。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME is an extremely territorial Pokémon. Fishermen know it as "King of Mountain Lakes", due to it claiming a vast area surrounding the water.

entry: POKENAME的外貌加上慢吞吞的动作，常让它被误认成巨大的儿童玩偶。
author: StabbyCat
source: Because of POKENAME's appearance and slow-moving nature, it is often mistaken for a large children's toy.

entry: POKENAME守卫领地时毫不留情，加上力气惊人，常被用作看守宝可梦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME defends its territory mercilessly. Combined with its incredible physical strength, it is often used as a guard Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽力大无比，却大多只用来撞倒果树、吃掉树果。只要不招惹，它其实出奇温顺。
author: therider
source: While very strong, POKENAME tend to only use that strength to knock down Berry trees and eat the Berries. It is surprisingly docile when unprovoked.

entry: 性情温和的它常在密林深处悠闲休息。浓厚皮毛与修长双臂，既利于生存，也很适合抱在一起。
author: moopse
source: This mellow Pokémon can be found lounging deep in dense forests. Its mass of fur and long arms are useful for both survival and snuggling.

entry: 它们很自豪于自己丰厚柔美的皮毛。但为了保护幼崽，哪怕弄得满身脏污也毫不犹豫。
author: Quote.lass
source: They take great pride in their plush, luxurious coats, but will not hesitate to get dirty to protect their young.

entry: POKENAME是最适合拥抱的宝可梦，也是可靠的朋友，深受孩子和一些大人喜爱。
author: Krune
source: The cuddliest Pokémon that exists, POKENAME is a true friend and is very popular with children and some adults.

entry: 当熔岩浇上火山周围绽放的花苞，POKENAME便会诞生。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME is born when lava pours onto the flower buds that bloom around volcanos.

entry: 它是海上的灾祸。无论何处，只要看见这颗巨大的骷髅头飘在空中，附近必有许多幽灵。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A scourge of the seas. Wherever you spot this giant skull floating in the sky, you're surely going to find many ghosts.

entry: POKENAME模仿火岩鼠的体形与身体构造，让自己的速度提升了不少。
author: mx_wellman
source: By mimicking a Quilava's body plan and morphological features, POKENAME has achieved a decent boost to its speed.

entry: 它是一团活的熔岩，无法忍受寒冷，必须不停移动，以免身体冷却。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A living blob of molten lava, this Pokémon cannot stand cold temperatures. It has to keep moving to prevent its body from cooling.

entry: POKENAME十分黏人，喜欢紧靠训练家为其取暖。不知为何，它的身体在寒冷中也不会变硬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very clingy and love to keep close to their Trainer to keep them warm. Somehow their bodies never harden in the cold.

entry: 它控制皮肤温度，将自己融入岩浆池，甚至伪装成火成岩。可若冷却太久，就可能僵住不动。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It controls the temperature of its skin to blend in with pools of magma or even igneous rock. If it cools itself for too long, it may become stuck.

entry: POKENAME的身体由不会凝固的铁水构成。它静伏熔岩之中，只让缎带露出表面，等待挑战者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's body is made of molten iron that doesn't solidify. It lies dormant in lava with only its ribbon above the surface, waiting for a challenge.

entry: POKENAME的熔岩身体可以随意变形。它会扑到敌人身上，将对方整个裹住。
author: themicelegion
source: Because of POKENAME's lava body, it can change its shape at will. It jumps on foes and wraps it body around them.

entry: 它住在火山地区，以煤与火山岩为食。急需补充能量时，还会吞下木头作为燃料。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Living in volcanic areas, its diet is composed of coal and volcanic rocks. If it desperately needs a recharge, it will consume wood to fuel itself.

entry: POKENAME常被自己产生的熔岩吓到。在它平静下来之前，周围的一切都会遭到焚烧。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: POKENAME is often frightened by the lava it itself produces. When this happens, all its surroundings are burned until it has calmed down.

entry: 绚烂的晶体云环绕全身。碰上一颗，就会冷得仿佛被灼烧。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Dazzling clouds of crystals surround its body. Touching one of these crystals leaves one with a chill so cold it burns.

entry: 尽管温度很高，构成身体的岩浆中仍满是真菌孢子，能使其他宝可梦受到真菌感染。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite the heat, the magma that makes up its body is infested with fungal spores and can infect other Pokémon with the fungus.

entry: 身体惊人的高温杀死了真菌，让POKENAME终于能自己掌控感官。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The incredible heat of its body managed to kill its fungus, making POKENAME master of its senses.

entry: 它在火山地区过着悠闲生活。与其他POKENAME一起懒洋洋休息时，会把尾巴浸入熔岩，防止身体冷却。
author: alliveir
source: It lives peacefully in volcanic areas. To prevent its body from cooling, it dips its tail into lava while loafing with other POKENAME.

entry: 它从身体底部喷出液态身躯，推动自己掠过熔岩湖。铠甲的内核会融化，以增加能够喷出的液体量。
author: alliveir
source: It propels itself over lakes of lava by spewing its liquid body from its bottom. The core of the armor melts to raise the volume that can spew out.

entry: POKENAME体内有个巨大的气囊。包裹气囊的熔岩表层十分脆弱，容易破裂并猛烈爆炸。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME has a large air pocket inside it. The surface tension of the lava that surrounds it is fragile, and is prone to burst with explosive results.

entry: POKENAME将焦骨点燃后当作武器。身体里的炽热岩浆不停冒泡。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses charred bone that it lit ablaze as a weapon. Its body bubbles with hot magma.

entry: POKENAME裹着熔岩外壳，滚向敌人发动攻击。人们曾发现POKENAME生活在地核之中。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME rolls into enemies with its molten lava shell. POKENAME have been found to live in the Earth's core.

entry: POKENAME平时十分爱玩，受威胁时却会用熔岩尾巴狠狠抽打人和宝可梦。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME viciously slaps people and Pokémon with its molten rock tail when threatened. Normally, it is a very playful creature.

entry: POKENAME吸收周围的热量，以免身体凝固。讽刺的是，它所过之处反而会变得更冷。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME absorbs heat energy from the environment around it to keep from hardening, ironically making the areas it passes through colder.

entry: 它最为人熟知的事迹，是战争中曾被当成会爆炸的炮弹使用。
author: naga_sake
source: This Pokémon is most famous for its use as exploding cannonballs during the war.

entry: 它原是一套广受欢迎、防护出色的防火墙。科学家将其变成宝可梦，POKENAME便诞生了。
author: .ssunday.
source: It used to be a very popular and protective firewall. Scientists turned it into a Pokémon, and POKENAME was born.

entry: 耳朵与尾巴上的植物已被严重烧伤。不过脚上硬化的泥土，仍让它与自然紧密相连。
author: char_latte3412
source: The plant life on its ears and tail have been severely burned. It still retains a strong connection with nature through the hardened mud on its feet.

entry: POKENAME散发惊人热量，一碰就能熔化岩石。虽然外表烈焰腾腾，却仍保有路卡利欧的敏捷与战斗本领。
author: Sheogorath
source: POKENAME emit immense heat, capable of melting rocks with a touch. Despite its fiery exterior, it maintains Lucario's agility and combat prowess.

entry: 它能融入流动的熔岩中移动。身体极其沉重，无论如何都不要触碰。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon has the ability to melt into flowing lava to move. They are extremely heavy, and should not be touched at all.

entry: POKENAME偶尔深入地下，将体温升至华氏18,000度，再有意冷却背部，形成坚硬的鞘。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME occasionally delves deeper underground to raise its temperature to 18,000 degrees F and strategically cools its back into a hard sheath.

entry: 古碑记载，5000年前曾有一只POKENAME引起灯火山猛烈喷发。披风般的外壳，能承受任何物理攻击。
author: red.89
source: Ancient tablets state that a POKENAME caused a violent eruption of Mt. Ember 5000 years ago. Its mantle-like shell can withstand any physical attack.

entry: 它是熔岩虫与熔岩蜗牛眼中凶猛却受敬重的首领。POKENAME用坚硬的岩壳保护它们。
author: germs2128
source: It is seen as an aggressive, but respected leader to Slugma and Magcargo. POKENAME protects them with its hardened shell of rock.

entry: 它带着一大块火山岩当盾牌。盾牌变得不够坚固时，就用高温的爪子制作新的。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It carries around a large volcanic rock it uses as a shield. When weakened, it will make a new shield with its high-temperature claws.

entry: POKENAME常被叫作“烫手垃圾”。虽然说得没错，听了却还是会伤心。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often known as "Flaming Hot Garbage." Although true, it still hurts the Pokémon's feelings.

entry: 它散发出热垃圾的气味，凡是不习惯这味道的人，都会感到极度不适。
author: naga_sake
source: The smell of hot garbage emanating from this Pokémon causes any human not acclimated to it to become violently ill.

entry: 身体原本全是熔融状态，经急速冷却后，大部分变成黑曜石。内部却仍蓄着大量热量。
author: Jaycielantern
source: Its body was once all molten, but being quickly cooled turned most of it into obsidian. Its insides still retain a large amount of heat.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在海底火山附近，触手由凝固的岩浆构成。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: POKENAME often live near underwater volcanoes. Their tentacles are made of hardened magma.

entry: 因为身上有火，POKENAME常被说成“火爆脾气”，其实恰恰相反。它会为旅人照亮洞穴与森林。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is usually called hot-headed due to its fire, but it's actually quite the contrary. It lights up caves and forests for travelers.

entry: POKENAME的帽子由极其坚固的黑曜石制成，能替训练家挡下致命攻击。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME's hat is made out of a very tough obsidian. It uses it to protect its Trainer from lethal attacks.

entry: POKENAME的模样酷似曾令它灭绝的火山，如今栖居在山地环境中。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME looks like the volcanoes that once drove it to extinction. It makes its home in mountainous environments.

entry: 真菌的残骸构成了铠甲。它是否也因此失去了对感官的掌控，研究者仍各执一词。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The remains of the fungus form the armor of this Pokémon. Researchers disagree as to whether this is accompanied by a loss of control of its senses.

entry: 多年用尾巴捞起坚硬的熔岩碎块，渐渐在背上堆成了壳。身体热得惊人，连外壳有时也会熔掉一部分。
author: alliveir
source: Years of fishing out fragments of hard lava with its tail has formed a shell on its back. It is so hot that bits of the shell would melt on occasion.

entry: POKENAME的液态身体渗进外壳，生命力也让壳活了起来。壳尖能向敌人喷射滚烫岩浆。
author: alliveir
source: As POKENAME's liquid body seeps into its shell, its life force makes it come to life. The tip of its shell can blast boiling hot magma at enemies.

entry: POKENAME划破长空，让低空飞行的飞机胆战心惊。厚羽能在高处保暖，因此它会在冰冷的山洞筑巢。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Its thick plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, so it nests in icy mountain caves.

entry: POKENAME划破长空，让低空飞行的飞机胆战心惊。浓密羽毛能在高处保暖，让它得以在冰冷的山洞筑巢。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.

entry: POKENAME划破长空，让低空飞行的飞机胆战心惊。浓密羽毛能在高处保暖，让它得以在冰冷的山洞筑巢。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.

entry: POKENAME划破长空，让低空飞行的飞机胆战心惊。浓密羽毛能在高处保暖，让它得以在冰冷的山洞筑巢。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.

entry: POKENAME用双手上细长尖锐的喙捕猎。那些喙十分锋利，却无法张开。
author: Rishi Dash#9301
source: A POKENAME hunts with the long, pointy beaks on its hands. They are sharp, but they don't actually open.

entry: 它守在树梢高处等待猎物。猎物一靠近，POKENAME便飞扑而下，刺入毒液。
author: .ssunday.
source: It stays high in the trees, waiting to launch onto its prey. When it approaches, POKENAME will fly onto its food and sting it with venom.

entry: POKENAME成长时会脱落双翼，要花3到4周才能重新长出。没了翅膀，喙中积蓄的电力反而会增强。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME grows, it will shed its wings, which can take 3 to 4 weeks to regrow. Without its wings, the electricity in its beak becomes amplified.

entry: POKENAME成长时会脱落双翼，要花3到4周才能重新长出。双翼能像电池一样储存电力。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME grows, it will shed its wings, which can take 3 to 4 weeks to regrow. Its wings store electricity like batteries.

entry: 巨大的棉絮翅膀，让POKENAME几乎一生都待在空中。飘出的棉絮孢子常会引起季节性过敏。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME spends nearly its entire lifetime in the sky, thanks to its large, cotton wings. Its cotton spores commonly cause seasonal allergies.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力将自己高速射出。全速冲刺时，喙足以贯穿数英尺厚的钢铁。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It can use its psychic powers to launch itself at incredible speed. At top speed, POKENAME can punch its beak through several feet of steel.

entry: 它常在峭壁旁掰下小石头，再扔向旅人挑衅。
author: .izik
source: It will spend time on the side of cliff walls breaking off small stones. It will fling small stones to taunt travelers.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，飞行仍比大多数人跑得快，还能从数百英尺外俯冲撞击目标。
author: .izik
source: Despite its large size, a POKENAME can fly faster than most humans can run. It has the ability to divebomb a target from hundreds of feet away.

entry: 它们会大规模迁徙，用鹿角上的磁性圆珠辨认方向。羽冠最明亮的POKENAME，就是群体的首领。
author: cait_sith
source: It migrates in great numbers, navigating using magnetic orbs on its antlers. The POKENAME with the brightest crest is the leader of the flock.

entry: 如名字所示，POKENAME爱让猎物心生恐惧。追猎时，体内多个机械肺会一齐发出尖叫。
author: funkytomate
source: As its name implies, POKENAME likes to strike fear into its targets by hunting them down while screaming out of its many mechanical lungs.

entry: POKENAME以优雅双翼配合精湛步法，跳出繁复而迷人的求偶仪式舞蹈。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is able to utilize its elegant wings with its excellent footwork to create an elaborate and captivating ritual dance for attracting a mate.

entry: POKENAME将优雅双翼与精湛步法结合，跳出繁复而迷人的求偶仪式舞蹈。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is able to combine its elegant wings with its excellent footwork to create an elaborate and captivating ritual dance for attracting a mate.

entry: POKENAME宽大有力的翅膀，能让它在空中长时间飞行，无需降落。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its large, powerful wings allow POKENAME to remain airborne for long periods of time without needing to land.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能飞到200英尺高。可若再飞得太远，与瓮状身体相连的幽冥纽带便会把它拉回地面。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can easily soar up to 200 feet; however, its ghostly attachment to its urn-like body pulls it back to the ground if it overextends.

entry: POKENAME号称“天空之皇”，会从双翼释放体内能量，以音速飞行，冲向惹怒自己的家伙。
author: ansleehariot
source: Nicknamed "The Emperor of the Skies", POKENAME fires internal energy from its wings to fly at Mach speeds, charging towards those who gain its ire.

entry: 桧垣市经常用POKENAME的羽毛制作手工宝可梦玩具。这些羽毛十分坚韧，不容易折断。
author: .izik
source: The feathers of a POKENAME are regularly used in the creation of artisanal Poké Toys in Vertress City. The feathers are sturdy and don't break easily.

entry: 嘴里流出的黏液具有强酸性。它会在飞行中吐出酸液，吓退敌人或打猎物一个措手不及。
author: .izik
source: The goo that flows from its mouth is highly acidic. While flying, it will spit this acid to deter enemies or catch prey off-guard.

entry: 长脖子便于POKENAME潜水时伸头换气。双翼发育不良，只能扑腾着飞一小段。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its long neck helps POKENAME to gasp for air when diving. Its wings are so stunted that it can only flap over short distances.

entry: 进食时，嘴上的尖刺会转向内侧，防止猎物逃走。只有肚子完全空着时，它才能飞行。
author: Staghorn
source: When it eats, the spikes on its mouth turn inward to keep its prey from escaping. It can only fly if its stomach is completely empty.

entry: 它常朝某个方向茫然凝视。传说是因为它知道，那个地方将来会发生灾难。
author: .izik
source: It frequently stares blankly in a random direction. Legends state that this is because it knows a future disaster will occur in that area.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在各种水域中，靠四肢悠闲划行。一旦受惊，就会起飞逃走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME likes to drift through all kinds of water and moves leisurely with the help of its limbs. If it gets spooked, it takes off and runs away.

entry: POKENAME虽体重不轻，却能轻松飞行。背上的炮管能射出强劲水柱，用来加速或闪避。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its weight, POKENAME can fly with ease. The cannons on its back can shoot powerful jets of water, which it can use to accelerate or dodge.

entry: POKENAME在城镇划出领地，很容易记住人的脸，还会保护曾喂过自己的人。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME makes its territory in urban areas. It can easily remember human faces, and will protect those who give it food.

entry: POKENAME在城镇划出领地，很容易记住人的脸，还会保护曾喂过自己的人。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME makes its territory in urban areas. It can easily remember human faces, and will protect those who give it food.

entry: POKENAME在城镇划出领地，很容易记住人的脸，还会保护曾喂过自己的人。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME makes its territory in urban areas. It can easily remember human faces, and will protect those who give it food.

entry: POKENAME在城镇划出领地，很容易记住人的脸，还会保护曾喂过自己的人。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME makes its territory in urban areas. It can easily remember human faces, and will protect those who give it food.

entry: POKENAME凭爪子和喙，能撬开任何贝类。它偷走其他宝可梦的猎物后，便笨拙地横行逃开，藏起来享用。
author: PokePower
source: Between its claws and beak, POKENAME can open up any shellfish. It steals prey from other Pokémon, then clumsily scuttles away to hide and eat it.

entry: POKENAME主要以毒蘑菇为食，借此释放恶臭，驱赶天敌。
author: MidnightSoup
source: POKENAME's diet primarily consists of poisonous mushrooms. These mushrooms allow it to secrete a foul odor it uses to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME将自己裹在厚厚的冰壳里，保护身体。等准备好进化时，冰壳才会融化。
author: MidnightSoup
source: POKENAME encases itself in a thick shell of ice to protect itself until it's ready to evolve, at which point the shell will melt away.

entry: 它用灵巧的鼻子拱地觅食，也守护着自己美味的蛋。就连胃口不佳的人，也爱吃这些蛋。
author: anarchaz
source: With a snout adept at rooting for food, it guards its delectable eggs. They are savored by all, even those with waning appetites.

entry: POKENAME的外壳碎片溶解后，可制成药效较弱的解冻药。被剥下的壳，几分钟便能重新长好。
author: .izik
source: Pieces of a POKENAME's outer shell are dissolved and used in the creation of less-potent Ice Heals. The shell regrows in minutes once broken off.

entry: POKENAME太喜欢雪球，无论到哪儿都带着三个。传闻它之所以长这样，就是因为曾吃下一颗雪球。
author: Yorui3913
source: POKENAME loves snowballs so much that it carries three wherever it goes. It's rumored that its shape is the way it is because it ate a snowball once.

entry: POKENAME在空中盲目乱冲，人和宝可梦都可能被它撞上。入冬时会将自己冻在原地，陷入深深的冬眠。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME dashes through the air blindly, bumping into people and Pokémon alike. During the winter, it freezes in place to enter a deep hibernation.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，身体越长。敏锐的鼻子能找到蘑菇、树果，甚至冰层下的温泉。
author: The_Fireplace
source: The older POKENAME gets, the longer it grows. It has a very sensitive nose that can locate mushrooms, Berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

entry: POKENAME一生都试着用画笔般的尾巴描摹北极光之美。尾端会散出一层冰霜。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME spend their entire lives attempting to capture the beauty of the northern lights using their brush-like tail, which emits a layer of frost.

entry: POKENAME醒来后，必须啃穿整座冰川，才能看见父母的脸。
author: Billie Jeans
source: POKENAME must eat through an entire glacier after awakening in order to see its parents' faces.

entry: POKENAME能投掷雪球抵御天敌，也很喜欢打雪仗。
author: Yorui3913
source: POKENAME is able to throw snowballs, which it uses to defend itself from predators. It loves snowball fights.

entry: POKENAME是冰与火共存的奇妙宝可梦，会在火山口间拱地觅食。寻找下一顿时，鼻端还会喷出火焰。
author: anarchaz
source: Rooting for food amidst volcanic craters, POKENAME is a fiery ice marvel. Its snout emits flames as it hunts for its next meal.

entry: 翅上的冰看似锋利，其实相当钝。它们总因照看幼崽而疲惫不堪。
author: zerocipher
source: The ice on its wings looks sharp but is, in reality, quite blunt. They are always tired from watching after their young.

entry: 传说若有人许愿想吃东西，POKENAME可能就会替其实现。曾有人因它而在醒来时见到一桌丰盛早餐。
author: birchbot
source: Legends say that if anyone were to wish for food, POKENAME may grant that wish. People have woken up to hearty breakfasts because of this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷的高山湖泊中。POKENAME冰制的鳍会发光，为跌破冰面落水的生物指引方向。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME live in cold mountain lakes. The icy fins on POKENAME glow, acting as a guiding light to anything that may have fallen through the ice.

entry: POKENAME是生活在寒冷地区的鸟宝可梦，据说拥有世上最保暖的羽毛。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME is a bird Pokémon that can be found in cold regions. Its plumage is described as the warmest in existence.

entry: 它的鼻子极其灵敏。有些采集者会饲养POKENAME，寻找极其罕见的谜芝果。
author: .izik
source: Its nose is extremely advanced. There are foragers who raise POKENAME to locate the very elusive 'Enigma Berry'.

entry: POKENAME如落雪般俯冲向敌人，既能拱地也能在空中灵活翻飞，战法变化多端。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME swoops down on foes like snowfall. Its ground-rooting behavior complements its aerial acrobatics, creating a versatile combat style.

entry: 据说小山猪敏锐的鼻子曾引它找到某一座雪堆。有理论认为，两者之间存在超自然的联系。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is said that a Swinub's sensitive nose guided it to a specific mound of snow. Theories suggest a paranormal relationship exists between the two.

entry: POKENAME勤快地收集新雪，堆到自己的雪丘上。还常躲进这座自制庇护所的入口处避风。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME diligently gathers fresh snow to add to its mound, often seeking shelter within the mouth of its homemade refuge.

entry: 孩子们以为遇到了有趣的沙堡，凑近时，却常被POKENAME拼命嗅闻新气味的样子吓一跳。
author: char_latte3412
source: Children approach this Pokémon, expecting an intriguing sandcastle. Many are startled as POKENAME sniffs furiously at the new, incoming smells.

entry: 雪与小山猪之间的幽冥纽带无法斩断。合为一体后，POKENAME既能防御也能修补自身，做到了过去无法做到的事。
author: char_latte3412
source: The ghostly ties between snow and Swinub are unbreakable. Working as one, POKENAME can both defend and repair itself, a feat previously unattainable.

entry: POKENAME只寻找最珍贵的美食。体内藏着传说般的火焰，能在最严酷的气候中保持温暖。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME only sniffs out the most precious of treats. It keeps a legendary flame within for warmth in the harshest of climates.

entry: 它是少数原生于寒带针叶林的蛛形宝可梦之一，保温的皮毛能抵御酷寒。獠牙和角则由冰构成。
author: char_latte3412
source: One of only a few arachnid Pokémon that are native to the taiga, its insulating fur helps it endure extreme cold. Its tusks and horn are made of ice.

entry: POKENAME大部分毛发始终飘动，却偏偏总有几缕挡在眼前。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Despite most of its hair being in constant motion, some always manages to remain in POKENAME's eyes.

entry: POKENAME用斧头砍倒腐树，寻找其中富含养分的蘑菇。挥斧时，厚皮毛还能帮它稳住身体。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME uses its axe to cut down rotten trees containing nutritious mushrooms. Its thick coat can be used to brace itself when it delivers a swing.

entry: POKENAME常与野生小山猪合作，替它们的新生幼崽提供庇护，换取自己本来难以觅得的食物。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME often partners with wild Swinub, providing shelter to their newborns. In turn, it receives food which it would otherwise struggle to obtain.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，通常伏在海底，静候小型鱼宝可梦游近，再将其吃掉。
author: Sottiwotti
source: POKENAME don't move very often. They usually lay on the ocean floor, silently waiting for small fish Pokémon to come closer so they can eat them.

entry: POKENAME把周围珊瑚舔得干干净净。舌头一旦干燥，整个身体都会变白。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME licks surrounding coral clean. If its tongue dries out, its entire body turns white.

entry: 它附着在海里的有毒废物上，吸收毒素维生，同时也将废物净化。
author: Staghorn
source: It attaches itself to oceanic toxic waste. It sustains itself by absorbing the toxins, purifying the waste in the process.

entry: 一道道洁净温暖的海水从体内流出。POKENAME栖居的地方，海洋生物往往十分繁盛。
author: Pizzarcato
source: Ribbons of clean, warm ocean water stream out of its body. Ocean life prospers in areas POKENAME call home.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸上，常与鸟宝可梦争斗得筋疲力尽，随后到潮池里晒太阳恢复精力。
author: Pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wears itself out trying to fight bird Pokémon on the rocky shores it calls home. To recharge, it will bask in tide pools.

entry: POKENAME在浅水中寻找好坏星，试图将其击败。一旦获胜，背上的气泡便会喷得更加猛烈。
author: Pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wades in shallow waters, attempting to find and defeat Mareanie. If it succeeds, the bubbles spouting from its back intensify.

entry: 水属性宝可梦要穿越陆地时，会找上POKENAME。POKENAME便用水袋装着它，将它送到目的地。
author: Staghorn
source: If a Water-type Pokémon needs to travel across land, it will seek out a POKENAME. The POKENAME then carries it in its water pouch to its destination.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的皮毛会随一天中的时刻变色，因此很受饲养者喜爱。叫声听起来隐约像鲸歌。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME are popular as pets due to their brightly colored coats, which change depending on the time of day. Its cries sound faintly like whale song.

entry: 污染催生了这只宝可梦。若在海滩或海里乱扔垃圾，POKENAME就会找上你的噩梦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Pollution caused this Pokémon to come into existence. Leaving litter on a beach or in the ocean will result in POKENAME visiting your nightmares.

entry: POKENAME会寻找枝条折损的太阳珊瑚，赠送装饰精美的替代枝条。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Individual POKENAME seek out damaged Corsola that have lost their branches and gift them decorated replacements.

entry: POKENAME的行动大多由背上的铁炮鱼指引。它的记忆力极佳。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's movement is mostly directed by the Remoraid living on its back. It has an excellent memory.

entry: POKENAME水囊里的鱼宝可梦充当着重要器官。鱼进食时，POKENAME也能获得养分，因此会拼命守护体内的生态。
author: kittyluv090
source: The fish Pokémon in POKENAME's water-filled sac serve as vital organs; when they eat, POKENAME is also fed. It fiercely guards its internal ecosystem.

entry: 它从独特的臂炮射出压实的珊瑚巨石。打得兴起时，偶尔连太阳珊瑚也会不小心射出去。
author: Pizzarcato
source: Compacted boulders of coral are blasted from its distinctive arm cannon. In its fervor, Corsola are occasionally launched by accident.

entry: POKENAME心地仁慈，常见于深处的珊瑚礁。它会在溺水者周围吹出洁净的空气泡，将人救下。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: A compassionate Pokémon typically found in deep coral reefs. POKENAME are known to save drowning people by blowing clean air bubbles around them.

entry: 虽然外貌让人担心，它其实身体健康，很少生病。产生的水很受医学研究者重视。
author: dicedragon20
source: Despite its appearance, it is a healthy Pokémon that rarely gets sick. The water it creates is highly prized by medical researchers.

entry: 据说POKENAME是南方海域的守护者。为保护海洋及其中的生命，它不惜牺牲自己。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME is said to be the guardian of the southern seas. It will give its life to protect the ocean and its creatures.

entry: 头部由致密的珊瑚构成。POKENAME在水下的太阳珊瑚群旁巡逻，保护它们免受天敌侵害。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its head is formed out of dense coral. POKENAME patrols around underwater groups of Corsola to protect them from predators.

entry: POKENAME住在海底热液喷口，只有繁殖季节才会离开海床向上游。POKENAME一生都在不断生长。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME lives in hydrothermal vents, ascending from the seabed only for mating season. A POKENAME never stops growing.

entry: 头上的珊瑚很少能长到完整大小。POKENAME的身体比例失衡，常常绊倒，将角摔断。
author: char_latte3412
source: The coral on its head rarely grows to full size. Because of its disproportionate body, POKENAME frequently trips and breaks its horns.

entry: 据说POKENAME是死于海边意外的孩子所化。有人在海边听到过声音，引诱自己跳入水中。
author: .ssunday.
source: It's said POKENAME are children who have died in mishaps around the ocean. People near oceans have reported a voice luring them to jump in the water.

entry: 它心地善良，会照顾保护各种鱼宝可梦，让它们藏进自己身上的海藻，躲避天敌。
author: hypernovahusky
source: This kind-hearted Pokémon cares for and protects any fish Pokémon, allowing them to hide away in its seaweed from predators.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁中，与斑斓色彩融为一体。天敌出现时，也会让海洋生物躲进自己的掩体。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME hides in reefs, blending in among the different colors. It also allows sea life to hide within its bunker if predators are around.

entry: 它想邀请所有人到巨口里的海洋中玩耍，却不知道进去的人几分钟内就会溺亡。
author: Skymaster426
source: It wishes to bring everyone into the ocean within its maw to play. It doesn't realize that anyone who enters will drown within minutes.

entry: POKENAME运用肌肉打出水力推动的拳头。据说拳势如奔腾的急流般汹涌。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME uses its muscles to throw out water-powered punches. Its blows are said to land like a rapidly flowing river.

entry: 两群POKENAME每次相遇，都会展开长达一周的争斗，直到一方全军覆没才肯罢休。
author: Falsedoll
source: Whenever two groups of POKENAME run into each other, they will engage in a week-long conflict that only ends one side is completely annihilated.

entry: POKENAME猎捕飞行猎物时，会先从口中射出水柱将其击落，再让猎物坠上刀刃般的角。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has a strategy for hunting flying prey: Striking it down with a water jet from its mouth and letting it fall onto its bladed horn.

entry: 它似乎执着于用双手的炮管攻击所有闯入领地的宝可梦，必须格外小心。
author: mercury_sc
source: This one seems to have an obsession with using its hand cannons to attack any Pokémon that enters its territory. Extreme caution is advised.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，是理想的宠物。可肉质鲜甜，也令它经常遭到捕猎。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: Due to POKENAME's gentle and docile nature, it makes an ideal pet. However, it is also hunted often for its fresh, sweet taste.

entry: 手指指向什么，就会朝那里射出水流。据报告，这些水流最远能射到200米。
author: gronkissimo
source: It shoot water out of its finger at anything it points to. The range of these blasts have been reported to go as far as 200 meters.

entry: 人们发现许多POKENAME远离原有栖息地。原来它们附着在巨翅飞鱼身上时，忘了本来要去哪里。
author: GP423
source: Many POKENAME have been found far from their natural habitat. This is because they have forgotten where they were going while attached to a Mantine.

entry: 炮管射出的蛋威力堪比坦克炮击。树干上的橙色星星，象征着它的效忠对象。
author: funkytomate
source: The eggs shot out of its cannon hit like a tank. The orange star on its trunk symbolizes its allegiance.

entry: POKENAME弱小又胆怯，稍有危险就会喷出墨汁遮挡对方视线，立刻逃走。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A very weak and cowardly Pokémon, POKENAME flees at the first sign of danger, expelling ink to blind potential threats.

entry: POKENAME产出的不是奶而是墨汁，因此常被人工饲养。墨汁既能书写，也能用于一些料理。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is often farmed for its capability to produce ink instead of milk. The ink can be used for writing, but is also used in some recipes.

entry: 它用灵活的脖子精准瞄准，连高飞的宝可梦也能击落。铁炮鱼纷纷聚来，既为食物，也想向它学习。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its flexible neck to take perfect aim, shooting down even high-flying Pokémon. Remoraid flock to it, eager for both food and lessons.

entry: 深海中的野生POKENAME引发的地震，曾造成海啸。在关都与城都，有人以捕猎它们为乐。
author: theartemis1
source: The earthquakes summoned by wild POKENAME deep underwater have been known to cause tsunamis. These Pokémon are hunted for sport in Kanto and Johto.

entry: 深海中的野生POKENAME引发的地震，曾造成海啸。在关都与城都，有人以捕猎它们为乐。
author: theartemis1
source: The earthquakes summoned by wild POKENAME deep underwater have been known to cause tsunamis. These Pokémon are hunted for sport in Kanto and Johto.

entry: 它用美妙歌声引来对手，再以触手牢牢缠住猎物。一旦缠上，绝不松开。
author: MrPeach774
source: After luring in a foe with a beautiful song, it uses its tentacles to latch onto its prey. Once attached, it never lets go.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩滚动，在沙上留下奇怪痕迹。暖和的日子，沙滩上到处都是这种印子。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME rolls down the beach, leaving strange trails in the sand. On warm days, the beach is filled with these tracks.

entry: POKENAME扭紧再松开触手，借反作用力前进，不太费力就能在水中悠闲滑行。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME twists and releases its tentacles, giving it propulsion and allowing it to glide leisurely through the water with little energy expenditure.

entry: POKENAME能将触手拧在一起蓄力。松开时，便能借这股力量迅速游过很远的距离。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into together to build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the force.

entry: POKENAME尾端的水滚烫沸腾。发怒时水会化作蒸汽，触碰甚至可能造成三度烧伤。
author: kittyluv090
source: The water at the tip of POKENAME's tail is boiling hot. When it is angry, the water turns into steam, which may cause third-degree burns if touched.

entry: POKENAME将用来充饥的种子存进背上包袱。这些种子也能在它栖居的雪林中生长。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the bundle on its back to store seeds it uses for nutrients. These seeds are able to grow in the snowy forests where it lives.

entry: 它十分贪吃，看见食物就拿走。却也会将稀有树果送到沿途每户人家，深受农夫喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: A gluttonous Pokémon that takes any food it sees. However, it will also give rare Berries to any house it passes. It is beloved by farmers.

entry: POKENAME乐呵呵的性情，给遇见它的人带来冬日的欢欣。头上的拐杖有时会卡在树上。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME's jolly disposition brings a sense of wintry joy to all who meet them. The cane on their head sometimes gets stuck on trees.

entry: 它爱在积雪的林地上欢快蹦跳，兴高采烈地晃着头。头上的植物会在空气中留下松香。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: It enjoys prancing around snowy forest floors, waving its head around with a jolly glee. The plant on its head leaves a fragrance of pine in the air.

entry: POKENAME满心欢喜时，颈间的花苞便会发光。它用头上的植物吸引伴侣。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: The buds surrounding its neck will glow when POKENAME is filled with joy. It uses the plant on its head to attract potential mates.

entry: 颈间的褶边带有雪花图案。据说散发的香气，会让人想起与家人相处的欢乐时光。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: The ruffles around its neck depict a snowflake pattern. The aroma it gives off is said to remind people of joyful times with family.

entry: POKENAME是开朗的小小融合宝可梦，格外迷恋常绿树，常能看到它们挂在枝头。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME are cheerful little fusions. They have a fascination with evergreen trees and are often found hanging from their branches.

entry: 若有人过节不顺心，POKENAME就会想办法逗对方开心。连节日树都没有时，它甚至愿意自己来充当。
author: birchbot
source: If someone's holiday isn't going well, POKENAME will attempt to lighten the mood. It will even be in place of the tree if there isn't one.

entry: POKENAME背上长着冬青，用来保护袋中种子，免遭掠食。据说冬青结的果子有毒。
author: Kiwi clown
source: POKENAME has a holly plant on its back in order to protect its seeds it carries in its bag from predators. The berries are said to be toxic.

entry: POKENAME将物品收进体内运送。究竟最多能装多少，仍无人知晓。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME stores items inside of itself for transportation. Its maximum capacity is unknown.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，突然落到路人面前送礼物。若对方拒收，POKENAME可能会懊恼得当场爆炸。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME hangs in trees, dropping in front of passersby to give gifts to them. If the recipient refuses the gift, POKENAME may explode in frustration.

entry: 普通信使鸟天性慷慨，可两只信使鸟融合后却脾气暴躁又刻薄。礼物不送，只送煤炭。
author: ValtsuRi
source: Despite an unfused Delibird's generous nature, a Delibird double fusion is grumpy and mean. It only delivers coal, not gifts.

entry: POKENAME将一天搜集的食物装在随身袋里，最常见于雪地或山地。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME carries the food it collects throughout the day in its portable sack. They are seen most often in snowy or mountainous regions.

entry: 它还不懂事，见谁都想送食物。可通常还没送出去，礼物就已经被自己吃掉大半。
author: bobosmith01
source: This immature Pokémon tries to give out food to anyone it meets, but it has usually eaten most of the gifts by that time.

entry: 它慷慨大方，喜欢用小礼物让人开心，通常会送上一幅画或色彩缤纷的黏土手作。
author: milchik
source: This generous Pokémon likes to please others with small gifts. It would usually give one a drawing or a colorful clay craft as a present.

entry: POKENAME爱给身边所有人送礼。有时热情过头，铺天盖地的礼物甚至会不小心把人砸死。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME enjoys giving presents to everyone around it. Sometimes it's too enthusiastic and can accidentally shower someone with gifts to death.

entry: POKENAME能感知别人心中的负面情绪。有人难过时，POKENAME就会从袋中找出最适合对方的礼物。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can sense negative emotions within the hearts of others. If someone feels sad, POKENAME can find a perfect gift for them in its bag.

entry: POKENAME会竭尽所能，送上训练家心心念念的礼物，讨其欢心。它力气很大，能背起体积是自己两倍的袋子。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME will do anything in its power to make its Trainer happy with a gift they wish for. It's strong enough to carry a bag twice as big as itself.

entry: 随身携带的种子，如今已长成节日点心。它会送给森林中较小的宝可梦，周围萦绕着冬青的香气。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: The seeds it carries have now grown into festive snacks which it gives away to smaller Pokémon in the forest. The scent of holly surrounds them.

entry: 有人目睹野生POKENAME用随身袋偷走孩子们的各样物品。节日故事里，它们总是反派。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME have been observed using their portable sack to steal various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.

entry: 有人目睹野生POKENAME用随身袋偷走孩子们的各样物品。节日故事里，它们总是反派。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME have been observed using their portable sack to steal various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.

entry: 有人目睹野生POKENAME偷走孩子们的各样物品。节日故事里，它们总是反派。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME have been observed stealing various items from children. They are regarded as villains in holiday tales.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火焰已冻得坚实，走过的地面会留下雪花状足印。胡子则由压实的积雪构成。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: The fiery tip of POKENAME's tail is frozen solid and it leaves snowflake-shaped prints on the ground where it walks. Its beard is made of packed snow.

entry: 包袱其实能从尾巴上拆下。它们会用真正的尾巴高速游泳，还喜欢收集贝壳和石头。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Their bundles are actually detachable from their tails, as they use their actual tails for swimming at high speeds. They collect seashells and rocks.

entry: 它喜欢住在冰山内部，用喙凿下一大块一大块冰，挖出自己的家。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to make its den within icebergs. Using its beak, it will chip off the ice in large chunks to dig out a home.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会射出小礼物与彩纸，让小宝可梦开心。壳上的花纹描绘着各式节庆场面。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME's blasters shoot out small gifts and confetti for small Pokémon to enjoy. The patterns on its shell depict various festive scenes.

entry: POKENAME是热门的冬季摄影题材，却也是极其危险的宝可梦，每年都有几位摄影师因它受伤。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a popular subject of winter photography. However, it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, and several photographers are injured every year.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME不愿战斗，宁可坐着挨打，也不大愿意出手。它们十分喜欢宝物。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are reluctant to engage in battle and much more likely to sit and endure hits rather than dish them out. They have a fondness for treasure.

entry: POKENAME性情温雅，对宝可梦对战嗤之以鼻，倒更愿意在待客、娱乐等方面施展才华。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME possess a very genteel nature. They scoff at Pokémon battles and showcase their talents elsewhere, such as in hospitality and entertainment.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: Rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: Rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: 小小的POKENAME好奇心旺盛，一半时间在水中，一半在陆地。它吃水草，吃饱后有时会吹泡泡。
author: Rooboid
source: The small, curious POKENAME lives half of its life in water and half on land. It feeds on aquatic vegetation and may blow bubbles when it's well-fed.

entry: POKENAME体内住着各种小型水生宝可梦。长大后，它便会学着借体内住客的力量维生。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is home to an assortment of small, aquatic Pokémon. When it grows in size, it will learn to feed off the power of its inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME靠体内水生生态提供动力，以骇人速度破浪前行。双翼如刀，攻击凶狠毫不留情。
author: Rooboid
source: Powered by an aquatic ecosystem within its body, POKENAME tears through the waves at a wicked pace. Its wings cut like blades; remorseless and fierce.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在雨后跳水洼。每只背鳍上的花纹都独一无二。
author: Weirdtux
source: POKENAME love to jump in puddles after a rainy day. Each one sports a unique dorsal fin pattern.

entry: 据说一生难得一见POKENAME跃出水面。若有幸目睹，便能获得一个月的好运。
author: bobosmith01
source: Witnessing a POKENAME leap from the water is said to be a once-in-a-lifetime occurrence that is said to signify good luck for one month.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由软骨与软组织构成，硬骨很少。漫长的历史中，它的化石一直被错认成拉普拉斯。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME's body consists mostly of cartilage and soft tissue, with few bones. For most of history, its fossils were mistakenly attributed to Lapras.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，游泳却很快。它会上岸产卵，并拼死守护巢穴。
author: snescontroller
source: POKENAME is a very fast swimmer despite its bulk. It travels onto shore to lays its eggs and will guard the nest with its life.

entry: 它优雅地游过深海。许多宝可梦会躲进它的嘴里搭乘，寻求庇护。
author: imagine1.
source: It swims through the deep ocean gracefully. Many Pokémon ride in its mouth for protection and safety.

entry: 与巨翅拉斯一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解POKENAME吃下的食物。
author: Rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: 与巨翅拉斯一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解POKENAME吃下的食物。
author: Rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME将黏液涂满身体，便能在海面滑行。即使搁浅，也能把自己弹回海里。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME covers itself in slime to be able to glide across the ocean surface. It is able to bounce itself back into the ocean if beached.

entry: 可可多拉披着厚厚钢甲，POKENAME却由岩石构成。因此POKENAME潜入水下时，也不会生锈。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is made of rock, unlike Aron, who boasts a thick coat of steel armor. Because of this, POKENAME doesn't rust when it dives underwater.

entry: 小型水生宝可梦住在POKENAME外壳的缝隙中。长久共生之后，它会利用这种关系，获得更强的力量。
author: Rooboid
source: Small, aquatic Pokémon live within the cracks of POKENAME's shell. Eventually, it will capitalise on this symbiotic relationship to gain power.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: 这种走路草融合宝可梦生活在海里。铁炮鱼喜欢躲进它的叶丛，避开天敌。
author: Uncookie
source: This Oddish fusion can be found in the ocean. Species of Remoraid like to seek shelter from predators in its leaves.

entry: POKENAME发现小个子的朋友遇险时，会将对方装进气泡，保护起来。
author: Uncookie
source: When POKENAME sees a smaller friend in danger, it will shield them from harm by putting them in its bubble.

entry: POKENAME通常温和体贴，用气泡保护朋友。但必要时，也会用气泡困住或震晕敌人。
author: Uncookie
source: POKENAME are usually passive and caring, using their bubbles to shield friends. However, if necessary, it will use its bubbles to trap or stun foes.

entry: 它模样奇特，像顶着平坦菌盖的蘑菇，常见于沿岸沼泽，以腐烂植物为食。眼神空洞无神。
author: Rooboid
source: Often spotted within coastline swamps, this unusual Pokémon resembles a flat-capped mushroom and feeds on rotten plants. Its gaze is soulless.

entry: 野生POKENAME会掠过积雪的树梢，身后卷起纷飞雪花。却很少有人见过它们带着幼崽。
author: Kiwi clown
source: Wild POKENAME can be seen soaring above snowy trees with a flurry of snowflakes behind them. Rarely are they seen carrying their young.

entry: 淡水水流将POKENAME的身体打磨得圆润光滑。夏日阳光下，它的身体闪闪发亮，吸引小型水生宝可梦前来安家。
author: Rooboid
source: Rounded by the flow of freshwater currents, the body of POKENAME shines in the summer sun, attracting small aquatic Pokémon to make their homes there.

entry: POKENAME在热带海域的珊瑚礁间蜿蜒游行。整群铁炮鱼都会跟在身边，希望捡些残羹。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can be found in tropical seas, slithering amongst the coral reefs. Entire schools of Remoraid will swim alongside it, hoping for food scraps.

entry: 它靠拆毁废弃建筑锻炼拳头。两只POKENAME相互挑战时，金属碰撞声会一直持续，直到一方倒下。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: It trains its fists by destroying abandoned buildings. When one POKENAME challenges another, their metallic strikes won't stop until one is down.

entry: 虽然蛋几乎无法打碎，它还是会拼命保护。虽长着翅膀，却不会飞。
author: Krune
source: It protects its egg with its life, despite the fact that the egg is nearly unbreakable. Despite having wings, it cannot fly.

entry: POKENAME生活在各地区的积雪森林。剑术足以压倒艾路雷朵，毒性也相当猛烈。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME can be found in forests in snowy areas of any region. Their swordsmanship is enough to overwhelm a Gallade and their poison is quite potent.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空，时刻寻求战斗，却专挑弱小的对手，凭强劲双颚将猎物撕碎。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME soars through the skies in constant search of a battle, targeting the weaker opponents. With its powerful jaws, it tears its victims apart.

entry: POKENAME放出令人安宁的香气，将猎物引入洞穴，喂给自己的幼崽。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME tries to lure in its prey by letting out a serene smell. It then lures it to a cave to feed it to its young.

entry: 短短的翅膀尚不擅长飞行。它们会用不同节奏摩擦钢羽，彼此传递信息。
author: rhysanthemum
source: Their short wings are not well developed for flying. They communicate by scraping their steel feathers together in different patterns.

entry: POKENAME的凶暴程度与体型不相称，满怀杀意。在野外遇见它，务必要小心。
author: Krune
source: Despite its size, POKENAME have murderous intent and can be quite violent. Be very careful if you meet it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME还很年幼，不懂得像长辈那样慈爱体贴。谁惹它生气，它就把石头扔向谁。
author: Krune
source: As it is very young, POKENAME does not know how to be paternal and throws its stone at others who annoy it.

entry: 按照航空学的所有已知规律，POKENAME根本不该飞得起来——翅膀那么小，怎么托得起厚重的金属身躯？
author: its_cher_bicth
source: According to all laws of aviation, there is no way that POKENAME can take flight. Its wings are too small to get its thick metal body off the ground.

entry: POKENAME最早的记录可追溯至卡洛斯战争。身上的金属甲片，是为了让人能骑着它上战场而打造的。
author: Patch_Bros
source: The earliest recorded cases of POKENAME date back to the Kalos War. The metal plating along its body was made so it could be ridden into battle.

entry: POKENAME扇状的钢羽刀刃能像鸟般飞翔。脱落的羽毛，很容易制成刀具。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's fan of steel feather blades can fly like a bird. Its fallen feathers are easily made into knives.

entry: POKENAME只敬重技艺最高超的训练家。记载显示，它们曾在久远的战争中与人类并肩作战。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME only respect the most skilled of Trainers. Records show they fought alongside humans in wars long passed.

entry: 据说这些流氓鳄融合宝可梦已改过自新，如今替许多商户看守门户。任何违规行为都逃不过它们的眼睛。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: They say these Krookodile fusions have turned over a new leaf, working as security for many businesses. No rule-breaking escapes their gaze.

entry: 每个齿轮各司其职。一个负责控制双腿，另一个则操纵唯一的翅膀斩击敌人。
author: cait_sith
source: Each gear has a specific purpose. One gear controls the legs, and the other slices foes with its single wing.

entry: POKENAME靠拳打金属板平复情绪。拳头还不够解气，就用尖喙把金属板撕碎。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME calms down by punching metal plates. If its fists aren't enough, it will tear them apart thanks to its sharp beak.

entry: 融合让POKENAME以蛮力换来出神入化的剑术。虽然技艺高强，它却似乎不喜欢这种变化。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to trade its brawn for incredibly impressive fencing skills. Despite its prowess, it does not seem to enjoy this change.

entry: 身体太过锋利，骑上去必被割伤。中世纪时，人们常用它的形象作为纹章图案。
author: Staghorn
source: Its sharp body makes it impossible to ride without being cut. It was commonly used as a heraldic symbol during the Middle Ages.

entry: 它们会收集已故人类与宝可梦的骨骼。藏品品质越好，在同族中就越受尊重。
author: Sottiwotti
source: They collect the bones of deceased Pokémon and people. The quality of their collection influences the respect they get in their flock.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会合力击败强敌，证明自己，再用战利品装点背部。
author: char_latte3412
source: Young POKENAME prove themselves by working together to take down a formidable foe. They then adorn their backs with the spoils of victory.

entry: POKENAME大多成大群行动，偶尔也有个体离群与旅人交朋友。叫声粗哑，啾啾作响。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: While POKENAME typically stick together in large packs, some can be seen splitting from the pack to befriend travelers. They speak in rough chirps.

entry: 每次只能由一个头使出火焰攻击，火焰却比黑鲁加能喷出的还要炽热得多。
author: ItsBrewsky
source: Only one head is able to use fire attacks at a time, but this fire is vastly hotter than anything even a Houndoom is capable of producing.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会协作引发大规模山崩，让敌人措手不及。骨头般的铠甲则永远不停生长。
author: hampterbychoice
source: To surprise their enemies, packs of POKENAME coordinate to cause massive landslides. Its bonelike armor never stops growing.

entry: POKENAME一天能睡上20小时。打哈欠时有时会不小心喷火，靠近时务必小心。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours a day. When it yawns, it sometimes accidentally emits hot flames, so caution is advised when approaching it.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，把每场战斗都当作游戏。它想做什么就做什么，让其他宝可梦又怕又躲。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon that treats any battle as a game. It can do anything it wants, which leads other Pokémon to fear and avoid it.

entry: POKENAME的超能力攻击造成的痛苦，只有另一只POKENAME才能治好。但它们只愿治疗自己信任的训练家。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The pain from POKENAME's psychic attacks can only be cured by another POKENAME. However, they will only cure a Trainer that they trust.

entry: 它幽森的叫声，连最勇敢的人和宝可梦听了也会害怕。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's haunting cries strike fear in even the most bravehearted people and Pokémon.

entry: 野外所见的POKENAME，大多是一群中的首领。它们携带热石，为幼崽与寒中迷路的旅人取暖。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Most POKENAME seen in the wild are the leaders of their pack. They carry heated rocks to aid their young as well as travelers lost in the cold.

entry: POKENAME猎捕小型猎物时十分凶狠。背刺坚硬如铁，发光时更是滚烫，最好不要触摸。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can be vicious when hunting smaller prey. The quills are tough as iron and burning to the touch when glowing, so avoid touching them.

entry: POKENAME虽原始，却拥有惊人的力量。可大多时间都在懒散度日，或毫无缘由地用骨头敲打岩石。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is primitive, but it has incredible powers. However, it spends most of its time lazing around or hitting rocks with its bones for no reason.

entry: 与土台龟不同，POKENAME不照顾身上生长的生命。它在废弃城市里翻找，搜罗更称心的装饰。
author: VaporVenator
source: Unlike Torterra, POKENAME does not take care of the life that grows on it. It scavenges abandoned cities in search of more preferable ornamentation.

entry: 据说POKENAME是一把被邪灵附身的剑。握过POKENAME的训练家，都曾见到幻象、听见低语。
author: w1ndowsxp
source: POKENAME is believed to be a sword possessed by an evil spirit. Trainers who have held POKENAME reported seeing hallucinations and hearing whispers.

entry: POKENAME可爱的模样，吸引人们成立了许多以它为主题的神秘学社团。不知为何，它对此似乎喜不自胜。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME's adorable appearance has inspired many occult clubs around it. For some reason, it seems overjoyed about that.

entry: 它用骨头为幼崽搭巢，也常烧毁树木，标记自己的领地。
author: mrbapcik
source: It weaves nests out of bones for its offspring. It is often seen burning trees to mark its territory.

entry: 要教POKENAME守规矩，得花很多时间。它只对陌生人逞凶，让训练家很难察觉它的坏毛病。
author: .realthree
source: It takes a lot of time to train a POKENAME to behave. It's difficult to find its faults because it only acts aggressively towards strangers.

entry: 吸入POKENAME四处散布的孢子，喉咙就会产生难以忍受的灼痛，而且永远无法完全消退。
author: Fenragon
source: The spores POKENAME scatters everywhere cause unbearably painful burns in the throat when inhaled. This pain will never completely fade.

entry: POKENAME用来攻击的水会留下持久的灼痛感。POKENAME明明心地善良，却总因外貌被视为祸患。
author: .realthree
source: The water that POKENAME attacks with leaves a lasting burning sensation. POKENAME is regarded as a menace due to its looks, despite its kind heart.

entry: POKENAME头上的钳子由许多松散鳞片构成。受威胁时，会迅速振动肌肉，发出低沉的沙沙声。
author: char_latte3412
source: The pincers on POKENAME's head are composed of numerous loose scales. When threatened, it rapidly vibrates its muscles, creating a low rattling sound.

entry: POKENAME沿直线游行，找到什么食物都吃，身体也随之变长。一碰到自己的尾巴，就会死去。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME slithers in a linear fashion, eating any food it finds to grow longer. It dies if it touches its own tail.

entry: POKENAME喷出毒液，让环纹闪光，以此惊吓敌人。它行动近乎无声，出击毫无预兆。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME startles foes by spraying venom and flashing its patterned rings. It moves nearly silently and strikes without warning.

entry: POKENAME身体太长，既难飞行，也难保持直立。不过仍有剧毒，不宜靠近。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME struggles to fly or keep an upright posture due to its excessively long body. It is still highly venomous and should not be approached.

entry: 宽大的翅膀与强健肌肉，让这副奇特身体也能飞行。它常袭击鸟宝可梦的巢，将蛋整个吞下。
author: VaporVenator
source: Large wings and strong muscles allow its peculiar body shape to fly. It will often raid the nests of bird Pokémon to swallow their eggs whole.

entry: 它拖着尾端的大响环，摇摇晃晃地走动。遇险时，响环的声音连凶猛天敌也能吓退。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: It totters around carrying the large rattle on its tail with it. When under threat, the rattle's sound can ward off otherwise vicious predators.

entry: 它用强劲的双颚死死咬住猎物，注入大量毒液，直到对方不再动弹才肯松口。
author: .izik
source: It latches onto its prey with a powerful bite and unloads large amounts of venom. It refuses to let go until the prey stops moving.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片由钢构成。古时，人们会把它蜕下的皮做成护臂。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME's scales are made of steel. In ancient times, the shed skin was used as an armor sleeve.

entry: 传说POKENAME只消一眼，就能将活物化为石头。头上的每条阿柏蛇，都拥有自己的意识。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: Legends say a mere glance from POKENAME can turn living things into stone. All of the Ekans on its head are sentient.

entry: 它通过光合作用，将光能转化为致命毒素。虽对人类友好，却会用强劲双颚啃咬猎物。
author: akujules
source: This Pokémon uses photosynthesis to convert light energy into deadly toxins. Although friendly to humans, it uses great jaw strength to gnaw on prey.

entry: 多出的头没有大脑，只是一张张额外的嘴。POKENAME能将它们弹出，够到身体碰不到的食物。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its extra heads contain no brain, but they work as extra mouths that POKENAME can launch to reach food its body can't.

entry: 头上的火焰缓缓熔化混有毒物的蜡质身体，产生几乎难以察觉的有毒蒸气。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The flame on its head slowly melts the wax of its body, which is mixed with noxious substances. This produces toxic, barely noticeable vapors.

entry: 虽然右臂也有意识，科学家仍一致认为，POKENAME的整个身体由头部控制。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Although its right arm is also conscious, scientists agree that POKENAME's head is controlling the whole body.

entry: POKENAME的主身退在后方，让蛇形耳朵迅速攻击对手。斜睨的眼神十分邪恶。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's main body stands back as its snake-like ear rapidly strikes its opponent. It has a wicked side-eye stare.

entry: 为了生存，POKENAME主要在地下生活。它们年幼时，就已经脾气暴躁，难以控制。
author: mrbapcik
source: Primarily to survive, these Pokémon lead an underground lifestyle. POKENAME already display uncontrollable temperaments in their early days.

entry: 为了生存，POKENAME主要在地下生活。它们年幼时，就已经脾气暴躁，难以控制。
author: mrbapcik
source: Primarily to survive, these Pokémon lead an underground lifestyle. POKENAME already display uncontrollable temperaments in their early days.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在灌木丛中。若被发现，就会迈着小短腿试图逃走。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME tend to hide themselves in scrub brush. If they are discovered, they will use their tiny legs to attempt an escape.

entry: POKENAME全身的许多眼睛，帮助它时刻提防天敌。碰到身上的帆，则会中毒。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME have many eyes on its body to help it stay alerted to predators.  Its sail is poisonous to the touch.

entry: 身上的宝石由毒液结晶而成。虽然受到收藏家追捧，却仍具有剧毒。
author: Krune
source: The gems on its body are made of crystallized venom.  These jewels are sought after by collectors, but remain highly toxic.

entry: 它用使人麻痹的目光与催眠花纹，迷惑天敌和猎物。碰到无法催眠的敌人，就束手无策了。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its paralyzing gaze and hypnotic patterns to entrance both its predators and its prey. It is helpless against foes it cannot mesmerize.

entry: POKENAME摇晃植物茎秆引诱猎物，直到最后一刻才猛然施毒。
author: Terastrial
source: POKENAME lures in prey by shaking its plant stalk, waiting until the last possible moment to strike with its venom.

entry: POKENAME喜欢动手制作东西，常在打造催眠用的摆锤。虽有毒液，开朗的天性却让它并不危险。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME is often found crafting pendulums, as it loves to work with its hands. Its jovial nature keeps it from being dangerous, despite its venom.

entry: 父亲负责抚育幼崽，还会收集龙之鳞片，为墨海马日后的进化作准备。
author: nin10dogmod
source: The father is responsible for nurturing its young. It will harvest Dragon Scales for Horsea to evolve with in the future.

entry: 背上的壳重得令它无法移动。它用成团的触须抓住其他宝可梦，再以嘴将其制服。
author: Toxicrown
source: The shell on its back has grown too heavy to move. It uses its mass of tendrils to grab other Pokémon, before using its mouth to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME的炮管威力强、准头极佳，已被派往多个地区打击宝可梦偷猎。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: Boasting an extremely accurate and powerful cannon, POKENAME have been deployed across several regions to combat Pokémon poaching.

entry: POKENAME优雅沉静，却蕴藏强大力量。威严与高贵气度兼备，如君王般统治深海。
author: soinetwa
source: POKENAME rules the depths with serene grace and latent might. Blending strength and regal elegance, its sovereign presence rules the underwater realm.

entry: 从海床到海面都能见到POKENAME。它旋转身体制造吞船的漩涡，借此吸取乘客的生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can be found from the seafloor to the surface. It spins to create vortexes which swallow ships so it can absorb the life force of passengers.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在赖以栖身的绿洲水底，等待口渴的旅人靠近，再悄然接近猎物，从下方发动袭击。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lurks at the bottom of its oasis home, waiting for thirsty travelers to draw near. It sneaks up on its prey before attacking from below.

entry: POKENAME常出现在精美艺术作品中，被描绘成替水神拉动黄金战车的模样。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME is often featured in beautiful works of art, where it's portrayed pulling the golden chariots of water deities.

entry: POKENAME会用鼻子向空中喷洒亮粉，表达对训练家的喜爱。
author: ClawsHDi
source: To show its affection for its Trainer, a POKENAME will blast glitter into the air using its trunk.

entry: POKENAME寿命很长，却大半生都在地下沉睡。钻出地面时，会彼此发出响亮的象鸣。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME has a very long lifespan, but most of its life is spent slumbering underground. When they emerge, they trumpet loudly to each other.

entry: POKENAME小时候头大腿软，动作十分笨拙，常不小心把自己和别人都撞得翻倒。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME's large head and wobbly legs make it a very clumsy Pokémon while it's young. It often sends itself and others tumbling over accidentally.

entry: 獠牙锋利得如同盔甲鸟的利爪。可头上戴着硕大的颅骨，让它看不太清楚。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its tusks are as sharp as a Skarmory's talons. Due to the large skull on its head, it cannot see very well.

entry: 它卷起鼻子，将自己射向空中的目标发动攻击。宽阔如翼的耳朵，还能帮它飞得更快。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It attacks by curling up its trunk and launching itself through the air at a target. Its broad, wing-like ears can help it to fly even faster.

entry: POKENAME吊在钟乳石上，一睡就是好几天。若被吵醒，会先凶狠地瞪着敌人，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will hang off of stalactites and sleep for days. If it is awakened, it will glare menacingly at its foe before attacking.

entry: POKENAME的拟态十分奇特，颈部皮膜的花纹像汽车警示标志，还会随身体健康状况而改变。
author: CapWolfBane
source: A bizarre example of mimicry, POKENAME's hood patterns resemble automotive warning symbols. The exact symbol changes according to its physical health.

entry: POKENAME在栖息地滚动时势不可挡。据说连整座建筑物都能滚穿。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME rolls through its habitat with unstoppable force. It is rumored to be able to roll through entire buildings.

entry: POKENAME常出现在道路上，也经常被车碾过。身上轮胎印越深的POKENAME，往往年纪越大。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME are regularly found on roads and are run over quite often. The deeper the tire marks on its body, the older the POKENAME tends to be.

entry: 这只摩托车般的宝可梦，会在出发前昂起前身，发出象鸣。精疲力尽时，POKENAME便冒出黑烟，散发焦橡胶的臭味。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This motorcycle-like Pokémon rears and trumpets before taking off. When exhausted, POKENAME emits dark smoke and a stench of burnt rubber.

entry: 它每年冬天都会换一次獠牙。脱落的牙磨成粉后，可作抗真菌剂。
author: .izik
source: It sheds its tusks once per year during the winter. The tusks themselves can be ground up and used as an anti-fungal.

entry: 它用几条鼻子从附近溪流吸取大量清水，在烈日下为自己降温。
author: .izik
source: Using its trunks, it sucks up massive quantities of water from local streams. It uses this moisture to stay cool from the hot sun.

entry: POKENAME是蕴藏超能力的机械奇迹，以难以想象的速度处理数据，象征着人工智能的未来。
author: anarchaz
source: A cybernetic marvel infused with psychic might, POKENAME processes data at unfathomable speeds. It embodies the future of artificial intelligence.

entry: 它由先进科技打造，能凭数字化力量引发烈焰喷涌，将一切化为灰烬。
author: anarchaz
source: Crafted through advanced technology, it conjures fiery eruptions, reducing all to ash with its digital might.

entry: POKENAME是被顽皮幽灵附身的高级人工生命，能迅速学会怎样给目标惹出最大的麻烦。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: An advanced synthetic life form possessed by a mischievous spirit, POKENAME can rapidly learn how it can best cause trouble for a victim.

entry: 尾巴上的多边兽Ｚ喜欢捉弄自己寄居的宝可梦。仅是它的存在，就使对方的超能力变得不稳而难以预测。
author: Zeeroooo
source: The Porygon-Z on its tail enjoys bugging the Pokémon it lives on. Just its presence makes this Pokémon's psychic abilities unstable and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME是住进壳里的有意识数字生命。POKENAME的壳能承受强大宝可梦多次猛烈攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is a sentient digital being that made its home in a shell. POKENAME's shell can withstand many hard hits from strong Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是住进壳里的有意识数字生命。POKENAME的壳能承受强大宝可梦多次猛烈攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is a sentient digital being that made its home in a shell. POKENAME's shell can withstand many hard hits from strong Pokémon.

entry: 它们经过升级，电子邮件的投递速度更快了。给训练家送信时，会发出8位音效般的啾鸣。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They were given an upgrade to improve the speed of electronic mail delivery. They chirp in 8-bit tones when they deliver mail to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME爬行时总以精确的90度直角转弯。一家外国科技公司，还把它颈部皮膜的花纹用作标志。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME moves by slithering in perfect 90 degree angles. A foreign tech company uses the pattern on its hood as their logo.

entry: 由于程序出错，POKENAME闯入了广告业。可它推销的产品，再好也不过是些破烂货。
author: Skymaster426
source: Due to a programming error, POKENAME has gotten into the advertising market. However, all of its products are shabby and broken at best.

entry: 计算机工程师将POKENAME设计成多用途宝可梦。刀刃能变成各种简单武器或工具的头部。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME was created by computer engineers to be a multi-purpose Pokémon. It changes its blade's shape into different simple weapon and tool heads.

entry: POKENAME原本为探索遥远星球的酸海而设计，可研究者根本没有办法将它送到那里。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME was designed to explore the acid seas of distant planets. However, the researchers have no way to get it there.

entry: POKENAME和钥圈儿一样爱偷东西，只不过它看中的是人们的U盘。偷来后，就挂到自己的钥匙圈上，妥善保管。
author: oatmeal42
source: Similar to Klefki, POKENAME is known to steal people's USB sticks and put them on its keychain for safekeeping.

entry: 进化赋予POKENAME更流畅的外形和更高的智慧，却也使它变得疑神疑鬼，时刻高度戒备。
author: 8xviktor
source: Evolution has blessed POKENAME with a sleeker look and higher intelligence. However, it's become completely paranoid and constantly on high alert.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。不过，为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent though.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent.

entry: POKENAME以圆滚身体与粗壮双腿闻名，被称作“金属球”。受惊时会蜷成一团，飞快地绕圈滚动。
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal
source: Known as "The Ball of Metal," POKENAME is known for its round shape and hefty legs. When startled, it curls up and rolls in circles at great speeds.

entry: 由于程序缺陷，POKENAME只要靠近电脑，就会生成攻击电脑的病毒程序。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Due to a flaw in its programming, POKENAME is unable to approach computers without creating virus programs that attack them.

entry: 它爱欣赏自己的插画，画的大多是超级英雄故事。与别人分享故事时，总是满心自豪。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKEMON can be found enjoying illustrations it has created, usually depicting superhero stories. It takes great pride sharing its stories with others.

entry: 有时会陷入超能力造成的恍惚。此时触摸它的角，就能在眨眼间目睹百万条时间线。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: At times, it becomes locked in a psychic trance. If you touch its horns in this state, you will witness a million timelines in the blink of an eye.

entry: 它的角有奇妙的催眠效果。一旦被迷住，就可能被它引往彼岸。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's horns have a strangely hypnotic effect. Falling victim to it can cause this Pokémon to lead to to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME的包袱里装着各种节日点心，最爱的还是拐杖糖。常吃拐杖糖，或许也影响了鹿角的模样。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME carry several holiday snacks in its bundle, but love candy canes. Their diet of candy canes may have had an effect on their antlers.

entry: 正式被发现前，POKENAME只是都市传说中的神秘生物。模样虽可爱，一记快踢或鹿角冲撞却足以撞倒树木。
author: arch.stanton
source: Before its proper discovery, POKENAME was a cryptid in urban mythology. It may be cute, but a swift kick or ram from its horns can knock over trees.

entry: POKENAME极为罕见，据说能为获它造访的人带来好运。鹿角还能与月光共鸣。
author: pory
source: A rare sight to behold, POKENAME is rumored to bring good luck to those it visits. Its antlers are said to resonate with moonlight.

entry: 它用甜香与摄人心神的鹿角催眠对手。珍珠般的圆球，却也使它成为偷猎者的目标。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its sweet scent and mesmerizing antlers to hypnotize foes. Its pearl-like orbs make it a target for poachers.

entry: POKENAME常聚集在神社与墓地旁。传说只要握住POKENAME的鹿角，就能看见幽灵。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME tend to gather around graveyards and shrines. According to legend, anyone who holds a POKENAME antler will gain the ability to see ghosts.

entry: 它能从鹿角放电。两只POKENAME打架时，会让鹿角相抵，互相电击，直到一方退开。
author: cait_sith
source: It discharges electricity from its antlers. If two POKENAME get into a fight, they will lock antlers and zap each other until one pulls away.

entry: POKENAME华美的鹿角曾被入药，人们相信它能治好任何疾病。
author: Yanlu
source: POKENAME's magnificent antlers were once used as a medicine that was believed to cure any disease.

entry: 据说这种模样的POKENAME一年只现身一次，就在入冬第30天。它会长时间狂奔肆虐，毁掉沿途的一切。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.

entry: 据说这种模样的POKENAME一年只现身一次，就在入冬第30天。它会长时间狂奔肆虐，毁掉沿途的一切。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.

entry: 据说这种模样的POKENAME一年只现身一次，就在入冬第30天。它会长时间狂奔肆虐，毁掉沿途的一切。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME is said to only appear once a year, on the 30th day of winter. It goes on a long rampage, destroying everything in its way.

entry: 发怒时，鹿角上的圆球会喷出火焰。怒气越盛，火焰越热，甚至足以熔化钛。
author: .izik
source: When it is angry, flames will erupt from the orbs on its antlers. The flames can burn hot enough to melt titanium, depending on how mad it is.

entry: POKENAME有许多眼睛，能直视别人的灵魂。靠威吓或神秘力量，它甚至能支配意志薄弱的生物。
author: entomoxie
source: With many eyes, POKENAME can gaze into the souls of others. By intimidation or supernatural control, POKENAME can even control the spiritually weak.

entry: POKENAME十分自负，到处画自画像。它觉得自己完美无缺，除非迫不得已，否则绝不战斗。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: A POKENAME is very egotistical and paints self-portraits everywhere. It considers itself to be perfect and will refuse to battle unless it has to.

entry: POKENAME虽然自恋，却常勤奋地创作下一幅杰作。若被打扰，就会勃然大怒。
author: Inksans201x
source: While self-absorbed, POKENAME often works diligently on its next masterpiece and will become enraged if interrupted.

entry: POKENAME几乎每天都给翅膀画上新花纹。这个点子，来自一次卡洛斯之旅。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME has started to paint its wings in a new pattern almost every day. It got this idea after a trip to the Kalos region.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME尾端的颜料会随情绪变色。它会画图，将这些感受传达给训练家。
author: kittyluv090
source: The paint on POKENAME's tail changes color depending on its emotions. It draws pictures to convey these feelings to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME是基因的杰作，兼具艺术才华与超能力，能够精准再现任何招式。
author: anarchaz
source: A genetic masterpiece, POKENAME wields both artistic and psychic might. It has the ability to manifest any technique with precision.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛会散出粉末，在身后天空留下虹彩轨迹，因此常被误认成某只传说的宝可梦。
author: Shocktopus
source: POKENAME's feathers release a powder that create a rainbow trail in the sky behind it. It is often confused with a certain legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱画涂鸦，再将自己伪装成涂鸦捉弄人。一旦看中想模仿的风格，还会重新改变形体。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME enjoys pranking people by drawing and disguising as graffiti. It will reshape itself if it finds a style of graffiti it wants to emulate.

entry: POKENAME有时会用画笔般的角蘸树液作画，而且似乎偏爱品质上乘的树液。
author: Incognito1234
source: Sometimes, POKENAME uses tree sap to paint with its paintbrush-like horn. It seems to prefer higher-quality saps.

entry: 人们将POKENAME放上画布，任它四处奔跑，再把画成的作品展示给POKENAME看，它就会十分开心。
author: .ssunday.
source: People place POKENAME on a canvas and let it run around. After a while, they show the painting POKENAME has made to it, which makes it feel happy.

entry: POKENAME吃下彩色蘑菇，便会分泌墨汁。连它休息过的地方，也常被改作抽象艺术品出售。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The ink POKENAME secrete is a side effect of the colorful mushrooms they eat. Their resting grounds are often repurposed and sold as abstract art.

entry: POKENAME经常想家，便画下家乡的景象。许多大人看见这些画，都会忽然涌起怀旧之情。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME often gets homesick, so it draws pictures that resemble its home. Many adults get a sudden rush of nostalgia upon seeing these drawings.

entry: 只需几颗树果，POKENAME就愿意接下任何绘画委托，画技足以媲美最有才华的人类。
author: kandyman
source: For the price of a few Berries, POKENAME will paint any commission asked of it with a skill that rivals the most talented of humans.

entry: 它能用尾巴净化水域，让其中死去的鱼复活。据说雨后出现的彩虹，也出自POKENAME之手。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It can use its tails to purify bodies of water, reviving any dead fish within. It is said POKENAME is responsible for rainbows seen after a rainy day.

entry: POKENAME虽很少现身野外，如今世上87%的食物画，实际上却都是它的作品。
author: Rooboid
source: Despite being rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME is actually responsible for 87% of food paintings that exist today.

entry: 刀刃上滴落的看似鲜血，其实是描绘精细线条的颜料。POKENAME画下的战斗，连历史学家也无法确认真伪。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: What first appears to be blood dripping from its blade is paint used for precision lines. POKENAME paints images of battles historians cannot confirm.

entry: 花瓣斑斓的色泽不断变化，使人很难分清不同的POKENAME。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its colorful petals are constantly shifting in hue. This can make it difficult to differentiate multiple POKENAME from each other.

entry: POKENAME将粉末与尾端液体混合，在树上作画。有时还会涂满颜料，在地上滚出图案。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME uses a combination of powders and tail fluids to create artworks on trees. Sometimes it'll coat itself in paint and roll to create markings.

entry: POKENAME摇摇晃晃地四处走，所到之处都留下涂迹。它喜欢在难以够到的地方涂鸦，常想胜过同伴。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME toddles around, leaving marks wherever it goes. It likes to tag hard-to-reach locations, often seeking to outdo its peers.

entry: POKENAME绘制的壁画细节精妙，倾注的情感无与伦比。奇怪的是，它从不用黄色颜料。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME paints murals with outstanding detail, pouring its emotions into art like no other. Curiously, it never uses yellow paint.

entry: 腹部的螺纹会分泌彩色油脂。粉刷匠爱让POKENAME肚子贴地旋转，几秒便能涂满整间屋子。
author: gronkissimo
source: The swirl on its belly secretes a colorful grease. Painters love to spin POKENAME on its belly to paint entire rooms in seconds.

entry: POKENAME不停分泌颜料，却只会画自己胸前的螺纹。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME constantly secretes paint. The only thing it can paint is the spiral on its chest.

entry: POKENAME的触手状肢体能产生各色墨汁，常成为怀抱艺术梦想者的伙伴。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME can generate various colors of ink from their tentacle-like appendages. This makes them a common companion for aspiring artists.

entry: POKENAME能与不同墨水、颜料浑然融合，颇受初露头角的艺术家和雕塑家喜爱。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME possess a unique ability to seamlessly blend with different inks and paints. This makes them a favorite among budding artists and sculptors.

entry: POKENAME的触手状肢体能产生各色墨汁，常成为怀抱艺术梦想者的伙伴。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME can generate various colors of ink from their tentacle-like appendages. This makes them a common companion for aspiring artists.

entry: POKENAME每天都得用一用变硬，否则就会焦躁不安。
author: Yanlu
source: POKENAME become stressed out if they do not get to use Harden every day.

entry: 野外曾有人看见，宝可梦在POKENAME的背上对战。它们为何、又是如何学会这种行为，仍不清楚。
author: theartemis1
source: Pokémon have been observed battling on POKENAME's back in the wild. It is not clear how or why they learned this behavior.

entry: 这只尚在修行的战士，想让训练家握着自己上阵，边看边学。POKENAME日后的进化，也取决于训练的风格。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This Pokémon fighter-in-training wishes to observe and learn by being wielded by its Trainer. POKENAME will evolve according to the style of training.

entry: POKENAME是个喜欢旋转的球体，而且转得飞快。许多人都觉得，能从它身上找到自己的影子。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME is a sphere that likes to spin, which it does very quickly. This Pokémon is known for being relatable.

entry: 它用光滑的肚皮撑地，轻松旋转。两只POKENAME相遇时，会以高速互撞来争夺领地。
author: kittyluv090
source: It spins around with ease on its slippery belly. When two POKENAME meet, they fight for territory by ramming into each other at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不爱用手，更喜欢以锋利的尾巴和双腿猛烈旋转，连金属都能切开。
author: zic
source: POKENAME dislikes using its hands in combat. It prefers to use its sharp tails and legs to unleash powerful spins capable of slicing through metal.

entry: 尾巴上的大颚，让POKENAME攻守兼备。它那股不服输的劲头，很受胆大无畏的训练家欣赏。
author: fouguri
source: With the jaw on its tail, POKENAME performs well offensively and defensively. Its fighting spirit is appreciated by the most audacious Trainers.

entry: POKENAME完全能用尾巴保持平衡，向敌人踢出猛烈一击。但它们更喜欢懒洋洋地躺着。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME are perfectly capable of balancing on their tails and unleashing devastating kicks on their foes. However, they much prefer to lie around.

entry: POKENAME旋转整个甲壳，向周围一圈喷水。可炮管的位置不对，这种攻击既不实用，也没什么效果。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME spins its entire shell to blast water in a wide circle. Due to the positioning of the cannons, this attack is impractical and ineffective.

entry: POKENAME在清澈的山泉旁筑巢，方便随时欣赏自己的倒影。毛发脱落与再生都很快。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME make their nests near clear mountain springs so they can constantly inspect their reflection. Its hair sheds and regrows rapidly.

entry: 它用嘴唇辨认陌生物体。带电的触角接在一起时，POKENAME的吻就会带上惊人的电力。
author: corn0779
source: It uses it's lips to identify unknown objects. When its charged antenna are connected, kisses from POKENAME become shockingly powerful.

entry: POKENAME藏在灌木后摇晃毛茸茸的双手，引人靠近，再跳出来亲对方一下。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hides behind bushes and shakes its hairy hands to lure people to it. Then it jumps out and gives the lured person a kiss.

entry: POKENAME容易烦躁，不太听训练家的指挥。但一旦取得信任，它就会变得十分亲昵。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are easily annoyed, reacting poorly to a Trainer's commands. Once you gain one's trust, it'll become very affectionate.

entry: POKENAME虽像一张嘴，却无法张开双唇。它释放超能力，让别人直接体会自己的感受，以此交流。
author: kiwikelly
source: While it resembles a mouth, POKENAME cannot open its lips. It communicates by emanating psychic energy that make others empathize with its feelings.

entry: POKENAME在暴风雪中现身，缓缓接近迷路的登山客。靠得够近时，便舔舐受害者，使其无法动弹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME appears during snowstorms and slowly approaches disoriented hikers. When it gets close enough, it licks its victim to immobilize them.

entry: POKENAME十分狡猾，轻易就能将别人玩弄于股掌。谁若反抗，就会见识到它强大的魔法。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon that can easily wrap others around its finger. Any who resist it will witness its powerful magic.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的是口红而非刀刃，却照样用劈砍戳刺的动作替人上妆。结果往往惨不忍睹。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME brandishes lipstick instead of blades, and will attempt to pretty you up with slashing and jabbing motions. The result looks quite bad.

entry: 它虽然跑得笨拙，时速却可达258英里。可惜总被绊倒，很少真能跑远。暴风雪中，曾有人见它像孩子般安然打盹。
author: houndrys.
source: It is capable of clumsily running at up to 258 mph, yet rarely goes far due to tripping. During blizzards, it has been seen napping like a child.

entry: 它们对着能映出倒影的水晶整理仪容，还会向路过的登山客送飞吻。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: They look into reflective crystals to touch up on their looks. They're known to blow kisses at passing hikers.

entry: POKENAME身上有插脚，不方便滚动。它只能晃着双臂，慢吞吞地试着向前挪。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME does not roll well on account of the prongs on its body. It wiggles its arms to attempt to move forward, though this is very slow.

entry: POKENAME天性容易兴奋，会迅速产生必须释放的电力，常不小心电到自己与旁人。
author: char_latte3412
source: Excitable by nature, POKENAME rapidly generates electricity that must be discharged, often shocking itself and those nearby unintentionally.

entry: 饲养POKENAME的训练家必须随时留神。它玩耍的方式，是用锋利又带电的牙齿咬别人。
author: char_latte3412
source: Trainers must stay vigilant if they own this Pokémon. POKENAME's play style involves biting others with its sharp, electrified fangs.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在尾巴中。遇险时便把尾巴猛砸地面，释放电流。
author: Holzycookie
source: It stores electricity in its tail. If ever in danger, POKENAME will slam its tail onto the ground to let out an electrical discharge.

entry: 成群的POKENAME用废弃电子设备筑巢。翅膀尖端长着刺针。
author: kittyluv090
source: Swarms of POKENAME make nests out of abandoned electronics. They have stingers on the tips of their wings.

entry: POKENAME能产生使人麻痹的毒液。它会吞下尾巴，再四处翻滚，为自己充电。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME produces a poison with paralyzing properties. It recharges itself by swallowing its tail and rolling around.

entry: POKENAME把头插进电源插座获取能量。一小时内就能补足超过八小时睡眠带来的精力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME docks its head in power sockets to get energy. Within an hour, it can recharge energy worth over eight hours of sleep.

entry: POKENAME能像强力电击器一样，充当致命性较低的近战武器。它会旋转飘带充电，也会接上插座，大幅补充电力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a powerful taser, a less-lethal melee weapon. It rotates its ribbon to recharge or plugs into outlets to supercharge.

entry: POKENAME深色的皮毛始终积满静电，靠近电子设备时，甚至会干扰信号。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's dark fur is constantly charged with so much static electricity that it jams signals if it is near electronic devices.

entry: POKENAME睡在电源附近。受到打扰就瞬移到安全处，却会在原地留下危险的电荷。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sleeps near power sources. If it is disturbed, it teleports to safety, leaving behind a dangerous electrical charge at its point of origin.

entry: POKENAME的骨头中浸满致命毒素。它凭出色的格斗技巧痛击敌人。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME'S bone is infused with deadly poison. It beats enemies with great fighting skills.

entry: 身体太硬，行动相当不便。若有泥巴黏在身上，就会用长脖子清理干净。
author: .izik
source: Due to its extremely hard body, it is difficult to move. If mud becomes stuck to its body, it will use its long neck to clean itself.

entry: POKENAME颈部与尾巴上的硬毛十分锋利。一旦被刺中，剧痛的电击便会传遍整个神经系统。
author: kittyluv090
source: The bristles on POKENAME's neck and tail are very sharp. Getting stung by them can send excruciating shocks throughout your entire nervous system.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮，颈部花纹依旧清晰。领地里常散着这些蛇蜕，用来吓退来者。
author: char_latte3412
source: The markings on POKENAME's hood are highly visible on its shed skin. Its territory is often littered with discarded skins, serving as a scare tactic.

entry: 尾端圆珠里储着剧毒。圆珠亮起鲜红光芒时，POKENAME的毒咬最为致命。
author: char_latte3412
source: The orbs on its tail store a harsh poison; when they glow bright red, POKENAME's venomous bite is at its deadliest.

entry: 这种POKENAME的毒性不如近亲强，却能在崎岖地形中巧妙伪装，弥补这一不足。
author: char_latte3412
source: This POKENAME variant lacks the venomous potency of its relatives. However, its ability to camouflage itself in rugged terrain compensates for this.

entry: 身上的羊毛靠近电源时，会迸出电火花。人若触碰，可能遭到灼伤或麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The wool on its body sparks with electricity if it gets too close to a power source. Should a person touch the wool, it can cause burns or paralysis.

entry: 它用力摩擦绒毛，在体内积蓄静电。尾端的圆珠能储存庞大电力。
author: .izik
source: It rubs its fluff vigorously to create static electricity within its body. The orb on its tail can store vast amounts of power.

entry: 身体大多是空心的。它毫不费力地乘微风滑翔，发出轻轻的嘶嘶声。
author: .izik
source: Its body is mostly hollow. It makes a soft hissing noise as it effortlessly glides through the breeze.

entry: 它在风中一边旋转一边飘浮。气流掠过身上的棉球，声音仿佛癫狂的笑声。
author: .izik
source: It floats in the wind while spinning. The cotton puffs on its body make a sound as if cackling maniacally when air passes over them.

entry: 全身细小的鳞片会渗出毒液。天气炎热时，渗出的量比平时更多。
author: .izik
