source: The tiny scales that cover its body leak a noxious poison. During hot days, more of this liquid will seep from its body than normal.

entry: 尖牙极其坚硬锋利。古代人曾用这些牙齿制造兵器。
author: .izik
source: Its fangs are incredibly sharp and hard. Ancient cultures would use these fangs in the production of weaponry.

entry: 借助念力，它能将口中的毒液投射到2英里以外。毒性的强弱，则随吃下的食物变化。
author: .izik
source: By incorporating its telekinetic powers, it can hurl venom from its mouth over 2 miles. The venom itself ranges in effectiveness based on its diet.

entry: 体表光滑的金属，化学成分与银相同。古时，人们曾将其中一部分熔化铸币。
author: .izik
source: The smooth metal that covers its body has the same chemical composition as silver. Portions of it were melted down in ancient times to create coins.

entry: 它对谁都毫不留情。举起双臂露出不祥花纹，就能将敌人吓跑。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is known to show no mercy towards anyone. It scares away foes by lifting its arms up, revealing an ominous pattern.

entry: 尖牙流出的黄色液体酷似蜂蜜。仅凭气味，就能迷住200英尺外的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The yellow liquid that comes from its fangs resembles honey. The scent of the fluid alone entrances prey from up to 200 feet away.

entry: POKENAME展示鲜艳的翅膀吓退威胁，还能用利爪注入毒液，尤其适合猎捕空中的目标。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME scares away threats by displaying its brightly colored wings. It injects venom through its talons, ideal for hunting airborne targets.

entry: 它是所居区域的顶级猎手，连更大的宝可梦也难逃毒手。毒液会让人感觉全身都在燃烧。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon is an apex predator across its range—even larger Pokémon are not safe. Their venom makes you feel as if your whole body is burning.

entry: 毒牙中的毒液呈深绿色。柑橘岛的厨师，会用它给一种马铃薯料理增添风味。
author: .izik
source: The venom inside its fangs is a deep green color. Chefs on Pummelo Island use this venom in a potato-based dish to add flavor.

entry: 极其罕见的双头阿柏怪。两个头常为谁能吞下猎物争执不休。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It is an extremely rare Arbok that grew two heads. They will often compete with each other over who gets to devour its prey.

entry: 尖牙能传导大量电力。它咬住对手后，会使劲放电，令对方麻痹。
author: .izik
source: Its fangs can conduct high amounts of electricity. After biting down, it will shock its opponents thoroughly to paralyze them.

entry: 锋利的爪尖会渗出少量毒液。一接触空气，毒液很快就会蒸发。
author: .izik
source: Small amounts of venom leak through the ends of its sharp claws. This venom quickly evaporates shortly after being exposed to the air.

entry: 它栖居在自己前世蜕下的皮中。猎物临死前，往往会听到响亮的沙沙声。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: This Pokémon inhabits the skin it shed in its past life. Its prey hear a loud rattling before they meet their end.

entry: 宝可梦越久盯着它的脸，就会越难受。有的甚至在余生中，再也忘不了POKENAME那张恐怖的脸。
author: alliveir
source: Pokémon get sick the longer they stare into its face. Others spend the rest of their lives with POKENAME's terrifying face on their mind at all times.

entry: 经过严苛训练，POKENAME出手已如蛇般迅疾，还能将波导化为长鞭攻击敌人。
author: KidDivinegon
source: Through intense training, this Pokémon is now able to strike with the speed of a snake. The aura POKENAME wields can be used as a whip to attack foes.

entry: 蛇形身体优雅游动，散发致命波导。POKENAME以带毒的波导吓退威胁，守护领地。
author: Sheogorath
source: Its serpentine body moves with grace while it exudes a lethal aura. POKENAME uses its toxic aura to deter any threats and protect its territory.

entry: 它缠绞的力量极强。若没能引来敌人，就会骑在蛇形肢体上主动追击。
author: Mossybanana
source: This Pokémon has exceptional constriction power. If luring foes in does not work, it will give chase by riding its snake-like appendage.

entry: 多个头会张口咬向一切靠近之物。有些人相信，若被POKENAME直视双眼，就会化为石头。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The various heads of this fusion snap at anything that comes near them. Some believe that POKENAME will petrify you if it looks you right in the eye.

entry: 它吞食那些败于毒果之下的猎物。只有人们识破把戏后，才会动身另寻住处。
author: dragonzzilla
source: It feeds on those who succumb to its poisoned fruit. It only ever moves to relocate once people catch on to its trick.

entry: POKENAME发育不全，始终没长出颈部皮膜，于是改学剑术弥补，模样反而更令人畏惧。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Stunted in its development and never growing a hood, POKENAME compensated by learning the way of the sword, an arguably more intimidating sight.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃中长出了储有致命毒液的毒囊，还会用缎带上的假脸转移对手视线，掩藏真正的眼睛。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has grown deadly venom vessels in its blade. It also distracts opponents from its true eye with its fake ribbon face.

entry: POKENAME只需划出一道小伤口，就能放倒巨龙。刀刃受到魔法加持，不停产生毒液。
author: arch.stanton
source: One small cut from POKENAME can fell a dragon. Its blade is magically enchanted to constantly produce poison.

entry: 胸前鲜艳的花纹，在警告天敌它身怀剧毒。只咬一口，就能让目标无法动弹。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The brightly colored patterns on its chest warn predators of its highly toxic venom. A single bite can leave a target unable to move.

entry: POKENAME戴着皮质兜帽，保护湿润皮肤免遭日晒。长尾与毒牙，则弥补了双臂短小的不足。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME wear leathery hoods to protect their moist skin from the sun. Their long tail and venomous fangs make up for their rather short arms.

entry: 看见POKENAME颈部皮膜的花纹，就会立刻身中致命剧毒。即使它已死去，这片皮膜仍然危险。
author: mrbapcik
source: Those who gaze upon the pattern on POKENAME's hood will instantly suffer from a deadly poison. Even after death, their hood remains dangerous.

entry: POKENAME用两条尾巴缠住废楼的横梁或排水管。谁若从下方经过，就会被它口中的火焰烤焦。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME winds its two tails around beams or drainpipes in abandoned buildings. Anyone passing underneath it is roasted by a flame from its maw.

entry: 和三首恶龙一样，它的多条尾巴也都是假头。一个“头”碰到东西后，所有尾巴便一齐缠上，让POKENAME趁机攻击。
author: spookoftheoldways
source: Like Hydreigon, its many tails are false heads. If one of the "heads" touches something they all wrap around it, giving POKENAME a chance to attack.

entry: 任何看见POKENAME的人，都会心生恐惧。蛇般的尾巴仿佛各有思想，而且和本体一样记仇。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME cause feelings of dread to all who look upon it. Its snake-like tails seem to have minds of their own, all just as vindictive as the body.

entry: 齿轮转动时，传出的不是金属碰撞声，而是嘶嘶声。寒冷的月份里，转速也会变慢。
author: .izik
source: While the cogs turn, a hissing sound can be heard instead of the normal clinking of metal. The cogs turn slower during the colder months.

entry: POKENAME的毒性还不够强，因此更依赖双颚。它能耐心守候猎物好几个小时。
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME's poison is not yet potent enough, so it relies more on its jaws. They can patiently wait for their prey for hours.

entry: 它飞行时张着嘴流涎。唾液极其黏稠，而且带有强烈酸性。
author: .izik
source: It drools from its open mouth while it flies. This saliva is extremely viscous and acidic.

entry: 嘴里流出的唾液带着柠檬香，还有以它为原料的民间偏方。
author: .izik
source: The saliva that comes out of its mouth smells like lemons, and there are home remedies created that rely on it.

entry: 第二个头像手一样，能紧紧抓牢猎物。若不小心，POKENAME的毒粉甚至会致命。
author: imagine1.
source: Its second head acts like a hand, gripping onto its prey. POKENAME's poisonous powder can be deadly if caution is not taken.

entry: 身上的缝线会随心情变换图案。口中尖牙的质地，则像缝衣针一般。
author: .izik
source: The stitching on its body changes patterns based on its mood. The fangs on its mouth have the consistency of sewing needles.

entry: 一只坏心眼的阿柏怪拆毁沙堡，却发现那是噬沙堡爷。如今，它们为了同一个目的联手行动。
author: themicelegion
source: A mean Arbok tore down a sand castle that happened to be a Palossand. Now they work together for one cause.

entry: 它从远处盯着对手，使其惴惴不安。除非迫不得已，否则绝不动弹，连呼吸也不肯。
author: .izik
source: It stares at its opponents from far away to cause unease. It refuses to move until it has to, not even taking a breath.

entry: 华蓝市的人曾用POKENAME翅上的鳞片制作首饰坠饰，据说能带来恋爱的好运。
author: .izik
source: The scales on the wings of a POKENAME were once used in Cerulean City to create charms for jewelry. These charms were said to bring luck with love.

entry: 它凭卓越智慧追踪并吞食猎物。POKENAME还能用念力把叉子投射出去。
author: .izik
source: It uses its superior intellect to track and devour its prey. A POKENAME can use telekinesis to fling its fork as a projectile.

entry: 它用超能力发出恐怖的嘶嘶声。这声音无法从耳边听到，只会响在人的脑海中。
author: .izik
source: By using its psychic abilities, it can make a terrifying hissing noise. The sound can only be heard in a person's mind.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME会挑能找到的最陡山坡慢跑上去。它也能用尾巴轻松举起巨石。
author: .izik
source: In the early morning, a POKENAME will jog up the steepest hill it can find. It can lift boulders with its tail with great ease.

entry: 分泌的毒液能熬成浓稠膏状，再与其他化学物质调合，制成汽车引擎用的润滑剂。
author: .izik
source: The venom it excretes can be boiled down to a thick paste. The paste itself can be combined with other chemicals to create lubricant for car engines.

entry: POKENAME用全身各处擒住、缠绕猎物。力气足以把汽车压成直径仅几英寸的圆球。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME grapple and wrap up prey with every part of their body. They have the strength to crush a car into a sphere only a few inches in diameter.

entry: 它在丛林深处悄无声息地荡过树枝。若发现下方有旅人，就会将体内的浓稠酸液倾倒下去。
author: .izik
source: It swings silently from tree limbs deep within the jungle. If it spots a traveler below, it will dump a thick acid from its body onto them.

entry: 它吐出胃酸溶解猎物，再吞下化成的浆液。食物会让酸性更强，所以它整天都在寻觅更大的一餐。
author: PokePower
source: It brings up stomach acid to dissolve prey, then consumes the sludge. Food makes the acid stronger, so it seeks bigger meals all through the day.

entry: 它一边移动一边吞石头，帮助消化。若肚子疼，还会吃些泥土。
author: .izik
source: It swallows stones while it moves to help with digestion. Should it get a stomach ache, it will also eat dirt.

entry: 尖牙流出的毒液极不稳定，一碰到敌人便会燃烧。
author: .izik
source: The venom that comes from its fangs is very unstable. If the fluid comes into contact with an enemy, it will combust.

entry: 它用颈部发光的脸形花纹吓唬猎物，夜里尤其有效。目标若逃，定会被它追上。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses the glowing face on its neck to terrify its prey, particularly at night. If its target tries to run away, it chases them down without fail.

entry: 磁铁会不由自主地吸来东西。若被吸在不喜欢的物体上，它就会尖叫着旋转挣扎。
author: .izik
source: It unintentionally pulls objects towards it with its magnets. If it becomes stuck to something it dislikes, it will screech and spin.

entry: 一个头用颈部花纹定住猎物，另一个头伺机出击。随后将猎物缠紧，以超过每小时60英里的速度带走。
author: knilk
source: One head transfixes prey with the pattern on its hood while the other strikes. It then constricts its prey and runs, carrying it off at over 60 mph.

entry: 长腿让它轻松涉过池塘，既方便捕猎，也便于躲避更大的天敌。
author: .izik
source: By using its long legs, it has the ability to wade through ponds with ease. This is primarily useful when hunting prey or evading larger predators.

entry: 它从口中喷出酸性黏液，准头极佳，最远能准确命中300英尺外的静止目标。
author: .izik
source: It can fire an acidic mucus from its mouth with great precision. It can hit a stationary target with great accuracy from up to 300 feet away.

entry: 走路时，身体有节奏地摆动。它还会发出嘶嘶声，试着哄对手入睡。
author: .izik
source: Its body moves in a rhythmic pattern while walking. It makes hissing noises in an attempt to soothe its opponent to sleep.

entry: POKENAME遇险时会从天花板落下，以柔软的头部缓冲。嘴里却会不受控制地冒出小火苗。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it drops from the ceiling and cushions the fall with its soft head, uncontrollably emitting small flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME从出生起，背上便存着母亲的乳汁。它年纪尚小，还无法自行产奶。
author: milchik
source: From the moment of birth, POKENAME has a storage of its mother's milk on its back. It is too young to be able to produce its own milk just yet.

entry: 头上的乳房常妨碍POKENAME滚动，让它对这东西颇有怨言。
author: sohbetveoyun
source: It often struggles to roll due to the udder on its head. This often causes POKENAME to resent its udder.

entry: 进化后，它学会了靠乳房走路。原因仍不清楚，但据观察，它似乎快乐多了。
author: sohbetveoyun
source: It learned to walk on its udder through evolution. The exact reason is unknown, but it is often reported to be much happier.

entry: POKENAME一天最多能产五加仑奶。稍受刺激，奶便会向四面八方喷出。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME can produce up to five gallons of milk per day. It will spew this milk in all directions at the slightest stimulation.

entry: POKENAME会分泌奶油般的涂层，凝固成玻璃似的外壳。它破茧而出后，留下的茧被视为珍馐。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME excretes a cream-like coating which hardens into a glassy shell. Once it emerges, its leftover cocoon is considered a delicacy.

entry: POKENAME一被融合出来，就会哀求创造自己的人将融合解除。若遭拒绝，只会更难过。
author: signal8
source: When POKENAME is created, it will try to beg its creator to unfuse them. If they refuse, it will only get sadder.

entry: 它会咬住对手，再用球形尾巴猛击。产乳器官尚未发育成熟，因此还不能产奶。
author: themicelegion
source: It attacks by biting and bashing opponents with its spherical tail. Its milk-producing organs aren't fully grown yet, so it cannot make milk.

entry: 双臂有力，能提起大桶牛奶。它会把幼崽喂得饱饱的，免得它们哭闹。
author: birchbot
source: Its arms are strong enough to hold large buckets of milk. It keeps its young well-fed to keep them from crying.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，整天跑个不停。累了就赶紧喝一口奶，转身又继续飞奔。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME runs around all day, full of energy. Eventually, when it gets tired, it takes a quick milk drink and goes right back to dashing around.

entry: 它专吃毒性最强的植物，因此乳汁对所有同类以外的生物都有毒。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's diet consists of the deadliest plants. Because of it, its milk is poisonous to any creature but its own kind.

entry: POKENAME没有乳房，奶从头皮分泌，浸满毛发。想收集乳汁，就得把头发拧一拧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Rather than having udders, POKENAME produces milk through its scalp, which soaks into its hair. The hair has to be wrung out to collect the liquid.

entry: 它们常抱着一大罐奶四处跑，在面包店和杂货店寻找最适合配奶的饼干。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They're usually seen running around with a large jar of milk, searching bakeries and grocery stores for the perfect cookie for their milk.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖渗出奶来标记领地。乳汁发酵后，会变成气味浓烈的酸奶。
author: theradrad
source: To mark its territory, POKENAME will ooze milk from the tip of its tail. The fermenting of the milk turns it into a pungent yogurt.

entry: 它是少数会以乳汁哺育幼崽的爬行宝可梦。情绪不佳时，毒素可能会不小心害死整窝幼崽。
author: theradrad
source: It is one of few reptilians known to nurse its young. If it is upset, its toxins could accidentally kill its nest.

entry: 这只大奶罐的产奶量增加了十倍。可大部分乳房自己够不着，所以使出喝牛奶，也无法回复更多体力。
author: kiwikelly
source: This Miltank's milk production has increased tenfold. However, it cannot reach most of its own udders, so its MILK DRINK doesn't recover any extra HP.

entry: 融合过程打乱了这只大奶罐的基因。现在，它只能喝到滴落在自己脸上的奶。
author: kiwikelly
source: The fusion process has scrambled this Miltank's DNA. It can now only drink the milk that dribbles onto its face.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里装满营养乳汁。虽然进化需要这些奶，POKENAME仍能将其喷向敌人，用来自卫。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The tail of a POKENAME is filled with nutritious milk. While it needs this milk to evolve, POKENAME can fire it at enemies as a defense mechanism.

entry: 据说POKENAME的口水，是最为浓醇的奶。POKENAME还试着用口水整理发型，可惜效果时好时坏。
author: wbmznrxo
source: POKENAME's drool is said to be the richest of all milk. POKENAME attempts to use its drool to style its hair, with only a moderate success rate.

entry: 身体深处源源不断地产出黏稠乳汁，将四肢充得鼓鼓的。所过之处，都留下一路湿滑痕迹。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its limbs are inflated by a seemingly endless supply of viscous milk produced somewhere deep within. It leaves a slippery trail wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME痴迷营养补充饮品，常轻松追上刚锻炼完的运动员，逼对方喝下蛋白奶昔。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has an obsession with supplement drinks. It doesn't break a sweat hunting down and forcing athletes to drink protein shakes after a workout.

entry: 它们最擅长制酪。卡洛斯流行的许多上等奶酪，都出自品味讲究的POKENAME之手。
author: Quote.lass
source: Their greatest skill is cheesemaking. Many of the gourmet varieties of cheese popular across Kalos were cultivated by discerning POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常见于奶牛场，愿意拼上性命，保护自己照管的大奶罐群。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME are commonly found on dairy farms. They would give their lives to protect the herds of Miltank they tend to.

entry: POKENAME年纪渐长，背上的隆起也会变成乳房状。它用营养丰富却有毒的乳汁喂养幼崽，好在幼崽对毒素免疫。
author: milchik
source: As a POKENAME grows older, its hump takes a shape of an udder. It feeds its nutritious but poisonous milk to its young, who are immune to it.

entry: 舔一口这把凝乳之刃，美味又饱腹。可若咬下去，它就会反击；若被刀刃割伤，还会肚子痛。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A lick of this solidified milk blade is delicious and filling. A bite, however, will cause retaliation, and a cut from it will cause a stomach ache.

entry: POKENAME以剧毒与丰富乳汁闻名，会凶狠地保护幼崽。背上遍布锋利倒刺，随时准备驱退威胁。
author: anarchaz
source: Known for its potent venom and abundant milk, POKENAME fiercely defends its young. Its back bristles with sharp barbs, ready to deter any threat.

entry: POKENAME看似友善，实际却肆意施暴。乳汁和翅膀，其实都由被逐出世间的罪恶灵魂构成。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME may appear friendly, but it's irreverently violent. Its milk and wings actually consist of sinful souls who were banished from this world.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚勤恳的伙伴，既会收割庄稼，也会替花园除草。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are loyal and hard-working companions. They harvest crops and pull weeds from gardens.

entry: POKENAME在一些地区被视为珍馐。融合时意外发生的变异，让它产出的不是奶，而是奶酪。
author: ForbiddenBread
source: It is a delicacy in some regions. Due to an unforeseen mutation during the fusion process of POKENAME, it produces cheese in place of milk.

entry: 与雪妖女不同，POKENAME很乐意帮助迷路的旅人。它会递上一杯热奶，再把旅人带回有人烟的地方。
author: .ssunday.
source: Unlike it's Froslass counterpart, POKENAME loves to help lost travelers. It gives them a hot glass of milk and guides them back to civilization.

entry: 构成POKENAME翅膀的云，在特定条件下会降雨。可落下的不是水，而是牛奶。
author: GP423
source: The clouds that make up POKENAME's wings will precipitate under specific conditions. Instead of water, however, these clouds will rain milk.

entry: 用POKENAME出产的原料制作的冰淇淋，被视为美味佳肴。细滑的口感，能让人暖到心里。
author: .ssunday.
source: Ice cream made with POKENAME's resources are considered delicacies. The smooth texture makes people feel warm inside.

entry: POKENAME由乳品精华凝成，不停追寻乳汁，那是它唯一的生命来源。渴求的乳汁供它行动，令它成为毫不留情的存在。
author: SlowForest
source: Forged from the essence of dairy, POKENAME relentlessly hunts milk, its sole life force. It is a merciless force fueled by the very essence it craves.

entry: 据计算，只要条件合适，POKENAME理论上每周能产超过200加仑的奶！
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: With the right conditions, it is calculated that POKENAME could theoretically produce more than 200 gallons of milk per week!

entry: POKENAME用念力控制自己产出的奶。它受惊或迷糊时，喝过奶的人也会感到恶心。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME telekinetically controls the milk it produces. When it is frightened or confused, it brings nausea to those who have drank from it.

entry: POKENAME凭惊人的力气，一天能从乳房挤出多达50加仑的奶，是农夫眼中的宝贝。
author: typhloquil
source: With its incredible strength, POKENAME squeezes up to 50 gallons of milk from its udders a day. For this reason, it's extremely valuable to farmers.

entry: POKENAME是一个知名牛奶品牌的吉祥物。品牌宣称牛奶有益骨骼与肌肉，而POKENAME也完全赞同。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is a mascot of a popular milk brand. They advertise the milk as being good for your bones and muscles, which POKENAME fully endorses.

entry: POKENAME痴迷蛋白饮品，追上刚锻炼完的运动员，逼对方喝蛋白奶昔，连一滴汗都不用流。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has an obsession with protein drinks. It breaks zero sweat hunting down and forcing athletes to drink protein shakes after a workout.

entry: POKENAME分泌纯蛋白奶。一杯所含的蛋白质，就足以修复连续锻炼72小时后劳损的肌肉。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME lactates pure protein milk. A single glass contains enough protein to rebuild strained muscles after 72 hours straight of exercise.

entry: 给POKENAME挤奶时，挤压触手必须讲究节奏，否则产出的奶可能具有致命毒性。
author: theradrad
source: To milk a POKENAME, one must have a sense of rhythm while milking its tentacles. Otherwise, the milk may be lethally toxic.

entry: 大多数训练家一见它就感到不安。POKENAME的两个头，也时刻受着中央乳房的惊吓。
author: .ssunday.
source: Most Trainers feel uneasy when they see this fusion. The two heads of POKENAME are constantly terrorized by the udders in the middle.

entry: 传说喝下POKENAME的奶，就会遭受永恒诅咒。不过，没人能忍着直视它那么久，撑到把奶挤出来。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Legends say that anyone who drinks POKENAME's milk will be cursed for all eternity. However, no one can stand the sight of it long enough to milk it.

entry: POKENAME展开由治愈火焰构成的双翼，所过之处带来温暖与慰藉，也为相遇者送去希望和新生。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME, with wings of healing flames, brings warmth and comfort wherever it soars. It brings hope and renewal to all who encounter it.

entry: POKENAME能察觉急需帮助的人，将随身带着、能治百病的蛋送去。古人相信它是天使。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME senses people who are in dire need and delivers the cure-all eggs it carries to them. Ancient peoples believed it to be an angel.

entry: 看似友善的外貌，掩盖着强烈的领地本能。它用庞大身躯保护尾巴夹着的蛋，免其受伤。
author: bukie
source: Its outwardly friendly appearance betrays a fierce territorial instinct. Its bulky body shields its egg, held in its tail, from damage.

entry: 它拼命守着尾巴夹住的蛋。攻击若朝蛋袭来，就会迅速转身，用庞大的身体挡下。
author: bukie
source: It fiercely guards its egg, which it holds its tail. It will quickly turn to intercept attacks aimed at the egg, absorbing blows with its bulky body.

entry: POKENAME总是快快乐乐，爱寻找有烦恼的孩子，用腹部心形图案发出的魔法光芒帮他们排忧解难。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always happy. It likes to seek out children with problems and help solve them through a magical light from the heart on its belly.

entry: POKENAME用宝可梦中心采集的数据完成了升级，程序使它能照料电脑盒子中存放的宝可梦蛋。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME was upgraded with data collected by Pokémon Centers. Its programming allows it to care for Pokémon eggs stored in PC boxes.

entry: 据说POKENAME会把蛋送给真正心地善良的人。只要妥善守护这份礼物，就能健康长寿。
author: snescontroller
source: POKENAME is said to present its egg to those who have shown true kindness. If kept safe, this gift brings good health and long life.

entry: POKENAME将迷路的登山客收留到洞穴，照料他们直到离开。石头般的皮毛也不易受损。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will take in lost hikers into their cave and look after them until they leave. Its stone-like fur is resistant to damage.

entry: POKENAME很能体谅别人，会唱出优美如咒文的歌，传播快乐，也会将蛋送给受伤的人。
author: weedspagon_real
source: POKENAME are very empathetic, and will sing beautiful, spell-like songs to spread happiness. They also offer eggs to those who are hurt.

entry: 它坚强可靠，常出现在危急现场，用双臂发出的强烈电击救醒倒下的人。
author: seaslux
source: A hardened Pokémon that appears at scenes of crisis. It revives the fallen using sharp jolts of electricity from its arms.

entry: 哪怕只是擦破点皮、碰出点淤青，这种POKENAME也可能赶来做心肺复苏。似乎有点热心过头了。
author: seaslux
source: If you suffer a minor injury such as a small scrape or bruise, this variant of POKENAME may show up to provide CPR. It seems a little overeager.

entry: POKENAME平时善良温和，可若有人想拿走它的蛋，就会气势汹汹地用蛋形尾巴攻击。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME can be very kind and gentle creatures, but should you try to take its egg, they will get aggressive and use their egg-shaped tail to attack.

entry: 肩上与尾巴上的浓厚奶油十分甜美，每天都能重新长出。臂上的炮管，也会高速射出这种奶油。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The thick cream on its shoulders and tail tastes very sweet, and it regrows daily. It fires the same substance from its arm cannons at high speeds.

entry: 传闻在融合技术尚未出现的中世纪，POKENAME就会探访收留伤兵的屋舍，为他们的伤口送上祝福。
author: spookoftheoldways
source: It's rumored that in medieval times, before fusion technology, POKENAME was said to visit buildings housing wounded soldiers and bless their wounds.

entry: POKENAME会终生保留孵出自己时的蛋壳，在里面储存食物或水，以备不时之需。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME will keep the egg it came out of for its entire life. It stores food or water in it in case of an emergency.

entry: 背上的巨蛋蕴藏太过强烈的幸福，吃下它甚至被认为十分危险。因此POKENAME总将它严密守护。
author: Pizzarcato
source: The massive egg on its back contains such potent happiness that eating it is considered dangerous. As a result, POKENAME keeps it well-protected.

entry: POKENAME虽身形魁梧，却十分友善。若看见宝可梦遭到欺负，就会挺身而出，把欺负者狠狠揍一顿。
author: PepperThePirate
source: Despite its hulking stature, POKENAME is very friendly. If it sees a Pokémon getting picked on, it will step in and utterly wallop the attacker.

entry: 请假王与幸福蛋融合而成，兼具强大力量与温柔关怀。它威严又仁慈，将力量与疗愈融为一体。
author: soinetwa
source: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.

entry: 请假王与幸福蛋融合而成，兼具强大力量与温柔关怀。它威严又仁慈，将力量与疗愈融为一体。
author: soinetwa
source: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.

entry: 请假王与幸福蛋融合而成，兼具强大力量与温柔关怀。它威严又仁慈，将力量与疗愈融为一体。
author: soinetwa
source: A fusion of Slaking and Blissey, embodying strength and nurturing care. A formidable yet compassionate force, it balances power with healing grace.

entry: 看起来快快乐乐、软绵绵的，身体却几乎坚不可摧，什么攻击都能承受。
author: funkytomate
source: This Pokémon looks happy and soft, but the truth is that its body is nearly indestructible and able to withstand anything that might be thrown at it.

entry: 这把剑轻轻一触，既能治好伤口，也能让对手萌生停战和好的愿望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A gentle touch from this sword not only heals wounds, but also fills opponents with an urge to stop fighting and make up.

entry: 蛋被视为珍馐，让野生POKENAME演化出钙质凝聚的外骨骼，借此对抗偷猎者。
author: Yersin1a
source: Their eggs are considered delicacies, so wild POKENAME developed calcium-condensed exoskeletons to help them fight against poachers.

entry: 它能感知孩子的悲伤，整天搜集树果，作为礼物送给别人。
author: .izik
source: It has the ability to sense sadness in children. It spends its day gathering berries to give to others as presents.

entry: POKENAME发现伤者时，会一边用幻象保护，一边为其治疗。谁也拦不住它救治附近的每一个人。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.

entry: POKENAME发现伤者时，会一边用幻象保护，一边为其治疗。谁也拦不住它救治附近的每一个人。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.

entry: 有人以为幸福蛋的友善能抵消骑拉帝纳的凶暴，POKENAME柔软的外表下，却仍沸腾着浓烈恶意。
author: bukie
source: While some may expect Blissey's friendliness to negate Giratina's violence, a cauldron of malice boils beneath POKENAME's soft exterior.

entry: POKENAME会寻找并治疗林中受伤的人与宝可梦，因此被称为“森林医者”。它们的“蛋”，其实是一种特殊真菌。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME are called "forest healers" for their tendency to find and heal injured people and Pokémon in the woods. Their "egg" is a specialized fungus.

entry: POKENAME的疗愈能力十分独特。粉红电流轻轻一击，就能帮助治愈多种伤病。
author: trainerrobo
source: POKENAME has very unique healing properties. One zap from its pink electricity can help cure many different types of wounds and illnesses.

entry: 据说揉一揉盖上的蛋会得到幸福，弄裂却会招来可怕诅咒。古时，它曾是长寿的象征。
author: Faelocke
source: The egg on its lid is said to give happiness when rubbed, but bestow horrible curses if cracked. In ancient times, it was a symbol of longevity.

entry: 它会主动吞食车用电池，吸收电力，再储存在腹部那颗看似蛋的物体中。
author: .izik
source: It actively consumes vehicle batteries to absorb their energy. This electricity is stored in what looks like an egg on its abdomen.

entry: 头上的蛋里充满液态金属，不能食用。它用长长的双臂攀住悬崖边缘。
author: .izik
source: The egg on its head is not edible and is filled with a liquid metal. It uses its long arms to cling to the edges of cliffs.

entry: 柔和的光芒有助孵蛋，因此它常成为饲育屋与繁育中心的主要光源。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its gentle glow has been known to help incubate eggs, so it is often used as the main light source in daycares and breeding centers.

entry: POKENAME翅上散出的粉尘，一接触就能治愈伤者。据说见到它的人，也会获得健康。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's wings spread a dust which heals people on contact. If you see this Pokémon, it is said good health will be given to you.

entry: 一察觉有人悲伤，它就会离开藏身处奔向对方，分享带来幸福的蛋，不管路途有多远。
author: TomatoSalad
source: When it senses sadness in a person, this Pokémon will leave hiding and race to them to share an egg of happiness, no matter how far it must travel.

entry: POKENAME的蛋散发怡人香气，却含有微量毒素。闻得太久，可能损害健康。
author: zic
source: POKENAME's egg emits a pleasant aroma. However, prolonged exposure to the smell can result in health problems, as it contains trace amounts of poison.

entry: POKENAME的胶状身体能产下像吉利蛋一样的蛋。蛋内虽营养丰富，却黏糊糊的，毫不诱人。
author: ohok3441
source: The gelatinous body of POKENAME produces eggs similar to Chansey. The contents, while nutrient-packed, are slimy and unappealing.

entry: POKENAME成了护士练习手稳、学习精细手术的有趣帮手。只要稍有失误，它的鼻子就会亮起。
author: ForbiddenBread
source: POKENAME have become a fun way for nurses to receive training in surgeries which require a steady hand, as its nose lights up when a misstep is made.

entry: 它将贵重物品藏在边缘带电的凹槽里。POKENAME能精准取出其中东西，也因此成了一流的外科医生。
author: squawkabairdy
source: This Pokémon stores its valuables in recesses with electric edges. Its precision in taking the contents back out makes POKENAME a top notch surgeon.

entry: POKENAME在降雪中隐去身影，寻找冻僵的遗骸，希望用生命力填满自己的蛋。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME hide their presence during snowfall. They can be found searching for frozen remains, hoping to fill their egg with lifeforce.

entry: POKENAME在降雪中隐去身影，寻找死者遗骸，将生命力装进自己的蛋。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME hide their presence during snowfall. They can be seen searching for dead remains to fill its egg with lifeforce.

entry: 它低飞寻找无人照看的蛋，再落下替它们保暖，视若己出，因此有了“保姆宝可梦”的称号。
author: bukie
source: It flies low in search of orphaned eggs, descending to keep them warm as if they were its own. This habit has earned it the nickname "Nanny Pokémon".

entry: POKENAME喜欢携带能孵化的蛋，还常从别人那里偷来。幼崽孵出后，它会一直带着，直到大得带不下。
author: Sitten1115
source: POKENAME prefer to carry fertile eggs, often stealing them from others. Once an egg hatches, the infant is carried until it grows too large.

entry: POKENAME的一个头常不小心弄破自己的蛋，另一个头便会大发雷霆。
author: themicelegion
source: One of POKENAME's heads will often crack their eggs on accident. The other head will get extremely angry when that happens.

entry: POKENAME召来雷电交鸣的冰暴。一声长啸，风暴便横扫它栖居的群山。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME conjures ice storms crackling with thunder. With a screech, its storms tear through the mountains it resides on.

entry: POKENAME的吼声比雷鸣更响。利爪会在领地内的树木上留下锯齿般的焦痕，满是电灼的伤迹。
author: Cristata
source: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.

entry: POKENAME的吼声比雷鸣更响。利爪会在领地内的树木上留下锯齿般的焦痕，满是电灼的伤迹。
author: Cristata
source: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.

entry: POKENAME是雷霆般的斗士，兼具火焰鸡的格斗技巧与雷公的力量，出招迅疾如电。
author: Sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a thunderous brawler. Fusing Blaziken's fighting prowess with Raikou's power, it is capable of launching attacks at lightning speed.

entry: POKENAME扁平的模样容易让人小看。可别被骗了，它传导的强大电流足以熔化岩石。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is easy to underestimate due to its flat shape, but don't be fooled. It can conduct enough amps to melt rock.

entry: POKENAME乘着浮空的雷云，以闪电般的电击贯穿目标。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME pierces its victims with the electric impact of lightning. It rides on a floating storm cloud.

entry: 人们相信，所有大风暴都以POKENAME的叫声为开端，因此尊它为“雷神”。
author: Moginar
source: It is believed POKENAME's cries signal the beginning of all major storms. As such, it has been given the title “God of Thunder”.

entry: POKENAME对情绪极其敏感，甘愿隐居深山，免得受到附近敌意刺激，引发猛烈雷暴。
author: char_latte3412
source: Highly empathetic, POKENAME resigns itself to secluded mountains, lest it risk unleashing violent thunderstorms in response to nearby hostility.

entry: 它神出鬼没，所到之处总伴着雷暴。随着一道闪电，POKENAME与风暴都会一同消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: This elusive Pokémon brings a thunderstorm wherever it goes. Both POKENAME and the storm it brings disappear with a flash of lightning.

entry: POKENAME是无情的猎手。猎物所能得到的预警，只有一道闪光与一声雷鸣。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME is a ruthless hunter. A flash of lightning and a thunderclap is all the warning its prey gets.

entry: POKENAME会残酷袭击刚遭火山喷发之灾的城镇。古代经文，将POKENAME视为末日将至的征兆。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME cruelly strike towns recently beset by volcanic eruptions. Ancient scriptures pose POKENAME as a sign of the end times.

entry: 它坚定而忠诚。据说即使白昼转入黑夜，POKENAME飘扬的尾巴仍带着温暖夏风。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is stalwart and deeply loyal. POKENAME's billowing tail is said to carry the warm summer breeze, even as day turns to night.

entry: POKENAME总在练习交谊舞。可POKENAME一发起脾气，就会如野兽般狂攻。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME practices ballroom dancing all the time. When POKENAME loses its temper, it attacks as if it were a feral beast.

entry: POKENAME控火本领高强，被称为“余烬女皇”。绰号虽吓人，心地却十分善良。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME has been nicknamed "Empress of the Ember" for its pyrokinetic prowess. Even with this intimidating moniker, it is very kindhearted.

entry: POKENAME的雕像，是怀有怨恨的火神之灵的容器。仔细聆听，能从内部听见火焰的噼啪声。
author: Patch_Bros
source: The statue of POKENAME is a vessel for a vengeful spirit of a flame deity. If you listen closely, sounds of crackling fire can be heard from within.

entry: POKENAME滚动得飞快，沿途留下一道火迹。坚硬的外壳，则保护它不受这些火焰伤害。
author: terminatphilippe
source: POKENAME rolls so fast that it leaves a trail of fire where it goes. Its hardened shell protects it from those flames.

entry: 冰爪极其锋利，刃口仅3微米宽。即便如此，这些利刃仍几乎无法损坏。
author: GP423
source: Its icy claws are so sharp, the edges are a mere three micrometers wide. Despite this, these blades are virtually indestructible.

entry: 据说，这是来自太古之地的远古异兽。古人称它为“凌空波荡”，如今人们则叫它POKENAME。
author: theeggoverlord
source: An ancient beast said to be from a land before time. The people of old supposedly dubbed it "Soaring Wake", but nowadays it's referred to as POKENAME.

entry: 它常远离其他宝可梦。据说薄如纸张的尾巴，是一份永无尽头、记载未来事件的清单。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: This fusion tends to isolate themselves from other Pokémon. It's thin, paper-like tail is rumored to be a never-ending list of future events.

entry: 古时，POKENAME会奋力保护自己所处的生态环境。无论海陆天空，它都能以骇人速度穿行。
author: squawkabairdy
source: In ancient times, POKENAME fiercely protected any biome it was in. It travelled land, sea, and sky at terrifying speeds.

entry: POKENAME耐心而沉稳。据说很久以前，它曾用强健的头冠推动冰川，横越大地，开辟新的河道。
author: GenesisParallax
source: POKENAME is a patient, stoic Pokémon. It is said that long ago, it used its powerful crown to push glaciers across the land and carve new rivers.

entry: POKENAME借缎带乘北风而行，寻找蓄水之地，再将剑刃浸入其中，净化水源。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME rides the north wind with its ribbon in search of water reservoirs. It rests its blade in them to purify them.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀映出北极光般的美景。有时它出现在不合时宜的时刻、季节或地点，令人惊叹不已。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME's wings mimic the beauty of the Aurora Borealis. Some people are shocked to see them at unusual times of day, year, or location.

entry: POKENAME施展的绚烂力量，让目睹者无不惊叹。可即便如此强大，POKENAME仍保持谦逊。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME showcases dazzling powers that leaves beholders in awe. In spite of its strength, POKENAME remains humble.

entry: POKENAME守护着自己栖居的湖泊。不用战斗时，就过着平静生活。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is a defender of the lake it lives in. When not in battle, it lives a peaceful life.

entry: POKENAME爱成为众人瞩目的焦点。若被它认作好友，就能得到丰厚回报。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: POKENAME loves to be the center of attention. If you are considered a good friend to this fusion, then you will get generous rewards in return.

entry: POKENAME从地下深处钻出，用岩质的角辨识叶片，在乱石间寻找合口味的树叶。
author: anarchaz
source: Emerging from deep underground, POKENAME discerns leaves with its rocky horn. It forages for preferred foliage amidst the rocky terrain.

entry: POKENAME收在鞘中，静卧地下深处，吸收周围泥土。只有受威胁时，才会出鞘迎战。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME rests deep underground, sheathed, absorbing the soil around it. It only unsheathes to fight when it is under threat.

entry: POKENAME脾气很差，发怒时会猛烈甩头。头上岩石般坚固的甲片，足以击碎防弹玻璃。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very irritable and will flail their heads if angered. The tough, rocklike plates on their heads are enough to shatter bulletproof glass.

entry: POKENAME碰到的食物、水或令人舒适的东西，都会化为沙子，让它怒不可遏。
author: elevn.
source: When POKENAME touches food, water, or an element of comfort, it turns into sand. This leads it to great anger.

entry: 它用强健的角撞倒树木，划定领地。较弱的POKENAME则成群漫游，寻找更强的对手。
author: Al_Chimera
source: This Pokémon marks its territory by knocking down trees with its powerful horns. Weaker POKENAME roam in packs to seek stronger opponents.

entry: 牙与爪都不锋利，其实很难伤到人。可它还是装得凶神恶煞，POKENAME尤其讨厌被叫“可爱”。
author: themicelegion
source: Neither its fangs nor its claws are sharp, so it can't really hurt you. Despite this, it still acts ferocious. POKENAME hates being called "cute".

entry: POKENAME将自己埋进沙中伪装，突然跃出攻击对手，扬起大片尘云。
author: mrbapcik
source: Burying itself beneath the sand, POKENAME camouflages itself to unexpectedly leap out and attack its opponent, raising large clouds of dust.

entry: POKENAME身后的阴影，其实是被超能力拘束的黑洞。凡被黑暗吞没的东西，都会永远消失。
author: gellyfishsh
source: The shadow behind POKENAME is actually a psychically-contained black hole. Anything the darkness envelops will disappear forever.

entry: POKENAME用双颚从山体咬下大块岩石，开凿洞穴。入侵者会迎来它的暴怒，随后被吞食。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME uses its jaws to tear chunks of rock out of mountainous terrain to create a cave. Intruders are met with fury and rage before being devoured.

entry: POKENAME什么都不懂，只知用岩石般的头猛撞眼前一切。连整片山脉都曾败在它面前。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME knows nothing else but to smash its rocky head into anything directly in front of it. Entire mountain ranges have lost to this Pokémon.

entry: 下半身的各个孔洞不断喷出沙子。战斗时，它便将这些受诅咒的沙卷成猛烈沙暴。
author: moopse
source: Sand spews from all of the orifices on its lower body. In battle, it whips this cursed sand into a harsh sandstorm.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，常彼此争斗。坚不可破的岩石身体，让破坏惨烈的战斗一打就是几个月。
author: Shiina Valkyria (W)
source: Extremely territorial, POKENAME often end up in battles with each other. Their impenetrable rock bodies make these destructive fights last for months.

entry: 一只POKENAME曾借沙暴掩护，以吐息将沙化为玻璃，独自挡住整支军队，因此被称为“沙之将军”。
author: Therider
source: Called the "General of the Sands", a lone POKENAME once held off an army by using a sandstorm as cover and turning the sand to glass with its breath.

entry: POKENAME疾驰沙漠时，会卷起巨大沙暴。三个头只有在追赶领地内的入侵者时，才能和睦相处。
author: _aphoric
source: POKENAME kicks up huge sandstorms as it races across the desert. Its three heads are only at peace when chasing intruders in its territory.

entry: POKENAME会闯入大钳蟹的群落，向其中的巨钳蟹挑衅。巨钳蟹一旦落败，POKENAME便开始在群落里作威作福。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME are known to target colonies of Krabby to start fights with their Kinglers. If the Kinglers lose, then POKENAME begins to rule as a tyrant.

entry: 据说，帕底亚只有在漫长又凶险的洪水过后，才会出现POKENAME。也有人认为，这不过是传说。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are only spotted in Paldea after a long, dangerous flood. Others say this is only a myth, though.

entry: 据说深色身体与红眼，是接触罕见能量波的结果。此现象最早记录于欧雷地区。
author: Staghorn
source: Its dark coloration and red eyes is said to be the result of exposure to rare energy waves. The phenomenon was first recorded in the Orre region.

entry: 它们优雅而令人安心，拍翼声如银铃。但若惹怒POKENAME，就会置身狂风暴雨之中。
author: Quote.lass
source: They are elegant and soothing, with wings that sound like silver bells. Make POKENAME angry, however, and you'll find yourself in a tempest.

entry: POKENAME只需挥动一次利刃，就能摧毁房屋。因此，它平时会将刀刃收回鞘中，在海底休息。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: With a slash of its blade, POKENAME can destroy houses. As a result, it chooses to rest sheathed in the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME会伪装起来，跟踪危害海洋的人。时机一到，便发起猛烈袭击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME disguises itself to stalk people who harm the ocean. Once the timing is right, it attacks with great force.

entry: POKENAME常住在海底火山旁，能以超能力引发强烈地震，也能带来严重干旱。
author: soldierex
source: POKENAME often resides by underwater volcanoes. It can cause great earthquakes with its psychic powers and bring about great droughts.

entry: 它将电力存在脸颊的电囊中，再以弹簧般的四肢踢出重击，将敌人击倒。
author: smashbear
source: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. Using its springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME常吊在废弃的风力发电机上，在大风天吸收其中潜藏的电能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can be found hanging from abandoned wind turbines. They absorb latent electricity during windy days.

entry: 一只皮卡丘太过急于求成，把自己缠进电线堆里，便化为POKENAME。这种变化赋予了它强大力量。
author: hampterbychoice
source: A POKENAME is formed when an overly ambitious Pikachu gets itself stuck in a tangle of electric wires. This transformation brings it great power.

entry: 它来回扭动身体就能发电。徒手抓POKENAME这种错误，捕虫少年很少会犯第二次。
author: Staghorn
source: It generates a charge by wiggling its body back and forth. Holding a POKENAME with bare hands is a mistake bug catchers rarely make twice.

entry: 有人观察到，POKENAME会射出极不稳定的电能与龙之能量。它们对训练家十分忠诚。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME have been observed emitting highly volatile blasts of electric and draconic energy. They are known to be very loyal towards their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME摩擦双翼制造闪电。因为发出的声音，它也被称为“花园风暴”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME creates lightning with its wings by rubbing them together. It is also known as the "Storm of the Gardens" because of the sound it makes.

entry: POKENAME在草丛中高速奔跑，产生电力，储入脸颊。放出的黑色电光威力强劲。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME runs at high speed in the grass to generate the electricity it stores in its cheeks. It produces powerful black discharges.

entry: POKENAME能从口颚传导电流，常被警方用来让嫌疑人暂时无法动弹。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME transmits electricity through its mandibles. It is commonly used by police to temporarily immobilize suspects.

entry: POKENAME摩擦双翼制造闪电。因为发出的声音，它也被称为“花园风暴”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME creates lightning with its wings by rubbing them together. It is also known as the "Storm of the Gardens" because of the sound it makes.

entry: POKENAME摩擦双翼制造闪电。因为发出的声音，它也被称为“花园风暴”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME creates lightning with its wings by rubbing them together. It is also known as the "Storm of the Gardens" because of the sound it makes.

entry: POKENAME四处乱飞，不停产生能量。积得太多就会变得凶猛，将电流倾泻到倒霉的宝可梦身上。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME flutters around wildly, constantly generating energy. If it generates too much, it becomes aggressive and unloads on unfortunate Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头上的羽毛能产生高电压，既用于求偶仪式，也能吓跑情敌或来犯者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's head feathers can generate a high level of electrical tension. It uses them for mating rituals or to scare off rivals or enemies.

entry: POKENAME头上的羽毛能产生高电压，既用于求偶仪式，也能吓跑情敌或来犯者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's head feathers can generate a high level of electrical tension. It uses them for mating rituals or to scare off rivals or enemies.

entry: POKENAME会在雷暴时升到高空，吸收闪电中的电力维生。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME floats high into the sky during thunderstorms to absorb electricity from the lightning bolts for nutrition.

entry: 像皮卡丘用脸颊存电一样，POKENAME用尾巴储存电力。尾巴里还装着带电树果，供它食用。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: It stores electricity in its tail, similarly to how Pikachu uses its cheeks. Their tails also hold electrically charged berries that POKENAME eats.

entry: 长脖子与喙很适合灵巧捕食。若没能成功，迅速放一次电，就能击倒整池鱼。
author: Essie
source: Its long neck and beak are designed to deftly catch prey. If that doesn't work, a quick electric burst will take out a whole pond of fish.

entry: 经过规律锻炼，POKENAME已学会妥善地将电力储入颊囊。
author: smashbear
source: Thanks to a regular training schedule, POKENAME has learned to properly store electricity in its cheek sacs.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。

source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: 平时悠闲的伙伴，一发怒就会变成可怕的威胁。若再拿上电气球，实力更会跃上新的层次。
author: soinetwa
source: Normally laid-back, this companion turns into a formidable threat when angered. Be warned: A Light Ball elevates its potential to a whole new level.

entry: 被POKENAME刺中，犹如遭雷击。POKENAME会把自己插进插座充电，经常造成停电。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Being stabbed by POKENAME is comparable to being struck by lightning. POKENAME recharges by plugging itself into outlets, often causing outages.

entry: 被这把匕首划伤，感觉如同挨了电击枪。它用这种通常不致命的反击，吓阻突然伸手抓它的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A cut from this dagger is comparable to being tased, a less-than-lethal deterrent to being suddenly grabbed.

entry: POKENAME像使用搭电线一样，用缎带夹住目标注入电力。修车师傅常靠它替汽车搭电启动。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons like jumper cables to latch onto its target and fill it with electricity. It's often used by mechanics to jump-start cars.

entry: POKENAME是小小的发电高手，体积小、输出电压高，常由发电厂员工照料。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: An electrical powerhouse; POKENAME is often found in the care of power plant employees due to its small size and voltage output.

entry: 它在乐队工作，每场演出都不缺席。POKENAME其实并不演奏，而是给各件乐器供电。
author: .ssunday.
source: It works for a band and goes to every concert. Instead of playing for the band, POKENAME actually charges each instrument.

entry: POKENAME会竖起毛发积蓄电力，再在POKENAME击中对手时释放电流。
author: Mossybanana
source: A POKENAME charges electricity by bristling its fur. It is then discharged when POKENAME strikes their opponents.

entry: 它好奇心旺盛，穿着像某位训练家的衣服，肩上带着一只皮卡丘环游世界。
author: striker212
source: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.

entry: 它好奇心旺盛，穿着像某位训练家的衣服，肩上带着一只皮卡丘环游世界。

entry: POKENAME以闪电般的速度掠过大地。当地鬃岩狼人曾联手追捕，却似乎次次落空。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME blazes across the ground at the speed of lightning. Local Lycanroc band together to catch this Pokémon, but all their attempts seem to fail.

entry: 一片大水域附近发生化学品泄漏后，POKENAME开始大量出现。它们大多开朗又富有爱心。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.

entry: 一片大水域附近发生化学品泄漏后，POKENAME开始大量出现。它们大多开朗又富有爱心。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.

entry: 毛发流转着彩虹般的光泽。据说有幸看见它的人，注定会成就非凡。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its hairs shimmer with all the colors of the rainbow. Those who see it are said to be destined for greatness.

entry: 它心地仁慈，会赐福给内心纯净的训练家。据说歌声能令每位听众感到无比喜悦。
author: Mistymagius
source: This benevolent Pokémon will grant blessing to Trainers that are pure of heart. Its singing voice is said to bring any listeners pure euphoria.

entry: 传说POKENAME的叶片有机会让死者复生。身体散发着彩虹般七彩的温暖光辉。
author: Mistymagius
source: Legends say the leaves from a POKENAME have a chance to bring back the dead. Its body gives off a warm glow in every color of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME是冰寒中的冒险家。臭氧层附近的凛冽寒风最适合它生活，战斗本领也同样出色。
author: trakito
source: POKENAME is an icy daredevil. The frosty winds near the ozone layer are where this Pokémon truly thrives; it also does very well in battle.

entry: 异常程序被注入绘图辅助程序，赋予了它新的生命。它想为世界灰暗之处添上色彩与生机。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The injection of a rogue program into a drawing assistant program gave it new life. It seeks to fill the gray parts of the world with color and life.

entry: POKENAME高贵而罕见，喜欢住在塔顶与山巅。缘朱市优雅的舞者，常从它身上汲取灵感。
author: Quote.lass
source: A regal and seldom-seen Pokémon that prefers to live atop towers and mountains. The elegant dancers of Ecruteak take great inspiration from POKENAME.

entry: 训练家若遇见彩虹般的POKENAME，实在幸运。它的斩击，也会留下虹彩光迹。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A Trainer is incredibly lucky to have encountered a rainbow POKENAME. Its slashes leave behind rainbow-colored trails of light as well.

entry: 据说POKENAME的神圣之火能净化一切。传说它正等待着某一天，遇见一个连它的火焰也伤不了的人。
author: Staghorn
source: It is said that POKENAME's sacred fire can purify anything. According to legend, it waits for the day it meets a human that its flames cannot burn.

entry: 古代有个文明，曾崇拜彩虹般的存在。据说，POKENAME缤纷的火焰，正是那个文明梦想的结晶。
author: MPotter75
source: The colorful flames of POKENAME are said to be the culmination of the dreams of an ancient civilization that worshiped a rainbow being.

entry: 世界各地的建筑工地，都曾发现POKENAME的雕像。许多人相信，它会保护勤恳劳作的人和宝可梦。
author: Leshii
source: Statues of POKENAME have been found at construction sites around the world. Many believe it grants protection to hard-working people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是极少数在晨昏活动的咕咕变种。不知为何，它常栖在森林神社顶上。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is one of the very few crepuscular variants of Hoothoot. For some strange reason, it can often be found perched atop forest shrines.

entry: 它是未来派来的使者，确保某些必要事件如期发生。它所追求的时间线会通向何方，无人知晓。
author: hampterbychoice
source: This Pokémon is an emissary from the future, sent to that ensure that certain necessary events occur. Where its desired timeline leads, no one knows.

entry: 被POKENAME的刺扎到，可能会被甩进时空之中。POKENAME的毒，真的能把你直接送到下周。
author: themicelegion
source: Getting pricked by one of POKENAME's barbs can send creatures flying through time. POKENAME's poison can quite literally send you into next week.

entry: 这对搭档喜欢穿梭于不同时代，用力量改变关键事件，创造新的时间线。
author: zic
source: This duo loves to traverse through time periods. They alter key events with their powers, creating new timelines.

entry: 据说它守护着时间本身，为确保未来免于毁灭，不遗余力。
author: Gayschlatt
source: This Pokémon is said to be the guardian of time itself. It's very passionate in making sure the future doesn't fall into ruin.

entry: 据说被POKENAME双颚咬住的人，会看见自己的未来，最终目睹自身的死亡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those trapped in the jaws of POKENAME are said to witness their future, and, ultimately, their demise.

entry: 它快得足以穿越时间本身。据说消失的瞬间，周围空气都会被点燃。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: Due to this Pokémon's speed, it is able to pass through time itself. It is said that when it does so, the air is set ablaze as it disappears.

entry: 据说POKENAME是一次失败的时间旅行产生的异常存在。它已见尽永恒，脑海中燃烧着诡秘莫测的知识。
author: GenesisParallax
source: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. Having seen all of eternity, its mind burns with eldritch knowledge.

entry: 它熬过数十亿条时间线，对所有已知异常状态都已免疫。其他生物一旦触碰，便会染上致命毒素。
author: alliveir
source: This Pokémon has survived billions of timelines, becoming immune to every known condition. Others that touch it are inflicted with a fatal toxin.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能把全身缩进大壳里避难。缩进去后，偶尔还会被误认成一枚空壳。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: Thanks to its small body, POKENAME it is able to withdraw into its large shell as a shelter. Sometimes it is mistaken for a shell when it does so.

entry: POKENAME很适合陪伴幼儿。有弹性的尾巴能逗孩子玩，粉红环纹则是天然的小夜灯。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME are considered great companions for small children. Its bouncy tail provides entertainment and its pink rings act as a natural night-light.

entry: POKENAME打架总是“一头冲进去”，既莽撞，也真的用头冲撞。被击中的地方，会留下露力丽脸形的印子。
author: spookyb.
source: POKENAME always rushes into fights head first, both figuratively and literally. Victims of its attack are left with an Azurill face-like imprint.

entry: POKENAME借弹力球蹦来蹦去，喜欢在水中扑腾。遇到攻击者，便用锤状的头将对方撞飞。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hops around with its bouncy ball and loves to splash in water. It uses its hammer head to launch any attackers away on impact.

entry: POKENAME的瓶子能抵挡强力攻击。它还会放出一大串气泡，分散来袭者的注意。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's bottle keeps it safe from powerful attacks. It'll send out a flurry of bubbles to distract threats.

entry: 双臂太小，不足以保持平衡。它抱住尾巴求个安稳，焦急地盼着自己露力丽的那一半进化。
author: miecreates
source: Its arms are too small to balance with. It hugs its tail for safety, waiting anxiously for its Azurill half to evolve.

entry: POKENAME哭泣时，泪水会混入包裹身体的凝胶，使凝胶逐渐变硬。
author: themicelegion
source: When POKENAME cries, its tears mix with the gel that encases its body. When this happens, the gel starts to harden.

entry: POKENAME常在河床附近哭泣。住在附近的居民，总抱怨它们整夜吵闹。
author: .ssunday. or ssunday
source: POKENAME are often found crying near riverbeds. Residents who live near these Pokémon often complain about their loud noises over the night.

entry: 形状奇特的尾巴既作配重，也为它提供向前蹦跳的动力，让步调保持平稳。小宝可梦若被尾巴打中，会整个飞出去。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its oddly-shaped tail acts as a counterweight, giving it momentum to hop forwards in a steady rhythm. Small Pokémon struck by its tail will go flying.

entry: POKENAME会装作溺水博取同情，甚至在陆地上也照演不误。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME makes itself appear to be drowning to gain sympathy. It'll even do it on land.

entry: 尾巴上的锚令POKENAME无法自由行动。不过在战斗中，却能当作强劲的连枷挥舞。
author: ohok3441
source: The anchor in POKENAME's tail makes it unable to move freely. However, it is used in battle as a powerful flail.

entry: POKENAME的拳头与尾巴一样富有弹性。若挨上一记全力重拳，身上就会留下厉害的肿痕。
author: char_latte3412
source: The fists that POKENAME brandishes are very rubbery, much like its tail. It can leave a nasty welt if one were to be struck full-force.

entry: 这种POKENAME善用橡胶般的身体作战，会将自己弹射出去，再借物体反弹，打对手一个措手不及。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME is able to utilize its rubbery body in battle. It can throw and ricochet itself off objects to catch its opponent off-guard.

entry: 看到小巧可爱的东西，它就会热泪盈眶，想抱起来。可泪水有毒，滴到谁身上，对方也会哭起来。
author: wigglypon
source: Upon seeing something tiny and cute, it gets teary-eyed and tries to pick it up. Its tears are toxic; if it cries on someone, they'll be weeping too.

entry: POKENAME小巧可爱又不太聪明，颇讨训练家喜欢。柔韧耐用的外壳，能保护POKENAME挡下大部分攻击。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is small, cute, but not very smart, which pleases Trainers. The shell is durable and flexible, which protects POKENAME from most attacks.

entry: POKENAME用软软的刀刃割断果梗，再以缎带将果实扔进嘴里。它还会反复弯折刀刃，让其变得更韧。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME harvests fruits by cutting stems with its floppy blade and chucking them into its mouth with its ribbon. It bends its blade to toughen it.

entry: POKENAME大概有些容易分心。眼前垂着的小钩子，它能盯上好几个星期。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME is probably a little distracted. It is capable of spending weeks observing the little hook dangling in front of it.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴入夜后会变长。它会偷吃农夫园中的水果，若被逮个正着，就会凭空消失。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's tail grows as night falls. It is known to steal fruit from farmers' gardens. If it is caught, it disappears into thin air.

entry: 飞行时，大手静静垂着，停下则用来攀住花朵。受威胁时会急速振翅，气势汹汹地挥动双手。
author: holgast
source: Its large hands lie dormant in flight, and are used to cling to flowers. If threatened, it flaps rapidly and waves them menacingly.

entry: 尾端的手活动起来，像一只灌满水的手套。POKENAME能迅速甩尾，用那只手拍打敌人。
author: holgast
source: The hand on its tail moves like a glove filled with water. POKENAME can rapidly swing its tail to slap enemies with that hand.

entry: 它收集森林中的废弃垃圾，用来装饰巢穴。觉得布置妥当后，才开始寻找伴侣。
author: .izik
source: It gathers discarded trash in a forest, then uses it to decorate its nest. Once it determines the nest is fully decorated, it will search for a mate.

entry: 它能从手中精准射出一团团蛛网。捉住敌人后，就会一边疯狂大笑，一边将对方拖近。
author: .izik
source: It fires globs of web from its hands with great precision. Should it capture a foe, it will laugh maniacally as it reels the enemy in.

entry: 它用几条尾巴维持平衡。在冰面上，也靠尾巴稳住身体，防止滑倒。
author: .izik
source: It uses its tails to ensure its balance. When on an icy surface, it will use its tails to stabilize its movement and prevent slipping.

entry: 它每年会到商家屋顶跳一次舞。据说舞蹈能带来大运，让当年余下时间的收益屡创新高。
author: .izik
source: It will dance on the roof of a business once per year. This dance is said to bestow great luck and ensure record profits for the rest of the year.

entry: 跳舞时，身体会飞快地顺时针旋转。旁观者若被双手撞到，可能相当危险。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, it spins its body clockwise at great speeds. Its hands can be dangerous if they collide with an onlooker.

entry: 尾巴力气比本体还大，POKENAME几乎控制不住。尾巴会擅自行动，把POKENAME像布娃娃一样甩来甩去。
author: holgast
source: It has little control over its super-powered tail, which is stronger than its body. The tail moves on its own and swings POKENAME like a ragdoll.

entry: 两条尾巴互相不合，在地面时几乎难以控制。可一旦攀爬、荡跃，它们却仿佛心有灵犀。
author: holgast
source: Its two tails are at odds, and it can barely control them while grounded. When climbing and swinging, though, they seemingly share one mind.

entry: 手状的尾端一碰地，就能感知震动，连300英尺外的对手也能察觉。
author: .izik
source: When it touches the ground with the hand-like portions of its tail, it can sense vibrations. It can sense an opponent from up to 300 feet away.

entry: 它用头上的鹿角感知猎物的恐惧，再通过手上的嘴，模仿对方最害怕的东西。
author: .izik
source: It uses the antlers on its head to sense the fears of its prey. Using the mouths on its hands, it mimics its prey's greatest terror.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴会影响平衡，使转速变慢。不过甩出的力道，仍足以将相扑力士打飞。
author: zic
source: POKENAME's spins are slower due to its tails affecting its balance. However, the impact of them is powerful enough to send a sumo wrestler flying.

entry: 飞行时，双臂如风筝尾巴般飘在身后。它常把风筝误当作同类，跑去骚扰放风筝的人。
author: holgast
source: Its arms wave behind it in flight like kite tails. It is known to harass kite-fliers, mistaking the toys for Pokémon like itself.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞奔，试图耗尽其体力。有时边跑边喝特制汽水，进一步增强本领。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME races around its opponent in order to tire it out. Sometimes, it drinks a special soda while doing so, further enhancing its abilities.

entry: 儿童医院的大人从没亲眼见过通风管里的长尾怪手或双尾怪手。不过有人推测，不管那是什么，都在设法逗孩子们开心。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: No adult in the children's hospital has witnessed an Aipom or Ambipom in the vents, but some theorize whatever it is is trying to entertain the kids.

entry: 它顺时针旋转后方的手臂，推动身体游过河湖，再吃下找到的睡莲叶，吸取养分。
author: .izik
source: It spins its rear arms in a clockwise motion to propel its body through lakes and rivers. It eats lily pads that it finds to absorb their nutrients.

entry: 它见到任何成功都会欢呼。可欢呼都是高亢的尖叫，久了难免惹人烦。
author: .izik
source: It cheers when it sees any kind of success. This can become irritating, as the cheers consist of high-pitched screeching.

entry: 头上的植物酷似双手。随着时间过去，里面会积满花粉，长得格外巨大。
author: .izik
source: The plants on its head are very similar to hands. They will fill with pollen over time and grow to exceptionally large sizes.

entry: 夜里常被错认成请假王。即使在睡梦中，大手也能将靠近的人打倒。
author: holgast
source: It is often mistaken for Slaking at night. Even while asleep, its large hands can knock down anyone who approaches it.

entry: 它用忽高忽低的口哨和笑声，嘲弄林中迷路的旅人。若对方连食物也吃光了，还会指指点点地讥笑。
author: .izik
source: It mocks travelers who are lost in the forest by whistling and laughing in an uneven tone. It also points and jeers should the person run out of food.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，会用尾巴撑起身体，再将自己猛掷向敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: When POKENAME is angered, it will lift itself up using its tails and hurl itself towards enemies.

entry: 它睡在泥泞池塘的底部，双手浮在水面。只要有游动的猎物碰上，就会本能地一把抓牢。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps at the bottom of swampy ponds. Its hands float at the surface, reflexively grabbing hold of any moving prey that bump into them.

entry: 它坚固的大手，一击就能打倒班基拉斯。幸好性情温和，不大主动攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon's highly fortified hands can knock out a Tyranitar in one hit. Fortunately, this Pokémon is quite passive.

entry: 作为蟹类，它却奇妙地以原始的双手取代了钳子。靠双手拖着身体在地上前进，而非横行。
author: holgast
source: Oddly for a crab, its claws have been swapped for primitive hands. It drags itself along the ground with them instead of scuttling.

entry: 人们普遍猜测，POKENAME的骨头里藏着许多咒术与诅咒。大多数人都尽量远离它。
author: .ssunday.
source: Popular conjecture theorizes that POKENAME's bones hold many curses and spells. Most people try to stay away from this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME调制各式药剂，有的有益，有的有害。它会确保疗伤药剂送到需要者手中。
author: fountainihili
source: POKENAME brews all sorts of potions, both helpful and harmful in their contents. It makes sure that its healing potions go to those in need.

entry: 它的孩子，是进化前偷来婴儿的灵魂。咒文般的叫声诅咒了婴儿，使其成为与自己一样的怨灵。
author: alliveir
source: Its child is the spirit of the baby it stole before it evolved. Its incantation-like cries cursed the baby into becoming a vengeful spirit like them.

entry: 据说抓到POKENAME，就能实现一个愿望。可到头来，这些愿望大多只是幻象。
author: .realthree
source: It is said that if you catch a POKENAME, you will be granted a wish. However, these granted wishes usually turn out to be nothing but illusions.

entry: 魔法咒语让它能用新方式操纵水，甚至使水穿墙而过。它还会往讨厌者的饮料里施下可怕诅咒。
author: VaporVenator
source: Magic spells grant it new ways to manipulate water, such as phasing it through walls. It taints the drinks of those it dislikes with terrible curses.

entry: 它以迷失、遭遗弃的灵魂作为燃料，维持猛烈高温。POKENAME的怒火与散布的诅咒，令人畏惧。
author: corn0779
source: It uses lost, forsaken souls as a source of fuel for its intense heat. POKENAME is feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads.

entry: 它扯头发、吓路人，平时尽是惹麻烦，却也偶尔会领人找到遗落的宝库。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon pulls hair, spooks passersby, and generally makes a nuisance of itself, but will occasionally lead people to abandoned treasure troves.

entry: POKENAME收集其他大嘴雀的尖叫声，在战斗中震晕敌人。它喜欢夜里独自飞行捕猎。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME uses the collected screeches of other Fearow in combat to stun foes. It prefers to fly solo in the night to hunt.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱在林间潜行，夜里向旅人扔糖果。糖果再陈旧也无所谓，它只是喜欢扔东西。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Wild POKENAME like sneaking around forests, tossing candy to travelers at night. It doesn't care how stale the candy is; it just likes throwing it.

entry: 它吟诵的咒文，可能招来突如其来的猛烈风暴。风暴一过，它便往往消失了。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: The incantations that this Pokémon may chant can cause sudden and violent storms. It often disappears once the storm has passed.

entry: POKENAME一声咆哮，就能随意召来雷暴。现身与消失，也只在眨眼之间。
author: its_cher_bicth
source: POKENAME conjures up thunderstorms at will with its roar. It can appear and vanish in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME被称为森林的魔法精灵，性情外向，喜欢捉弄人和宝可梦。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: Known as a magical spirit of the forest, POKENAME is an extroverted fusion that likes to play pranks on people and Pokémon.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，预示灾祸将至。可收服后，POKENAME又会凭敏锐感官，帮训练家避开危险。
author: SandGuyThing
source: Encountering a POKENAME in the wild forebodes certain calamity. Captured POKENAME utilize their senses to keep their trainer out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME熟练地将黑暗魔法与体内电力结合。被逼到极限时，雷电便会黑如夜色。
author: Maugre
source: POKENAME has mastered the art of combining dark magic with its body's electricity. When pushed to the limit, its thunder bolts become black as night.

entry: POKENAME性情庄重，会用超能力撕开现实，将未来景象展示给自己信任的人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A solemn kind of Pokémon, POKENAME uses its psychic power to tear holes in reality and show visions of the future to those it trusts.

entry: 一只梦妖魔与另外108个灵魂一同被封进这本书，诞生了POKENAME。无论打开它，还是在图书馆发现它，都可能遭它惊吓。
author: awiralonprime
source: A Mismagius was sealed with 108 other spirits in this book, giving birth to POKENAME. It scares people that open it or find it in a library.

entry: POKENAME低语着诱使路人靠近，任它将刀刃刺入胸膛，吸走生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's whispers convince passersby to walk in its direction and let it plunge its blade into their chest to absorb their life force.

entry: 进化后，它会寻找师父拜师，用刀刃般的双手施展各种法术。
author: awiralonprime
source: Once evolved, this Pokémon will seek a master to learn from. It uses its blade hands to casts various spells.

entry: POKENAME从学徒成长为师父，开始教导同族。各群POKENAME与各自的徒弟，会为争夺高下而较量。
author: awiralonprime
source: Having gone from student to master, POKENAME teaches its brethren. Groups of POKENAME and their apprentices compete for superiority.

entry: POKENAME吟诵诡异咒文，以加持禁忌魔法的炮管驱使远古力量。
author: anarchaz
source: With eerie incantations, POKENAME commands ancient power with its cannon enchanted with forbidden magic.

entry: 这种POKENAME似乎已抛下所有痛苦，连“输的能力”也失去了。至少，某首歌里是这么唱的。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME has seemingly lost its power to lose by leaving all the pain. That's according to a certain song, anyway.

entry: 外衣比钢还坚韧，仿佛活物般自动应对攻击。射出的倒刺上，载着比任何毒药都可怕的诅咒。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its coat is tougher than steel, automatically reacting to attacks as if alive. The barbs it fires are loaded with curses worse than any poison.

entry: 传闻POKENAME曾是冻死在暴风雪中的女巫。冒险闯进领地者，很少能完好无损地回来。
author: kittyluv090
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME was once a sorceress that froze to death in a snowstorm. Those who venture into its territory rarely return in one piece.

entry: 它吟唱黑暗咒文，踏着空洞而如幽魂般的舞步。这些诡异仪式，会唤来散布邪恶诅咒的怨灵。
author: alliveir
source: It steps into soulless, almost ghostly dances while singing dark incantations. These eerie rituals summon vengeful spirits that spread evil curses.

entry: POKENAME很少亲自现身，而把整片森林当作身体的延伸，从远处施下诅咒。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME rarely appears in person, using the forest itself to launch curses remotely as if they were extensions of itself.

entry: 无月之夜，迷路的旅人声称能在远处听见POKENAME的叫声，如令人毛骨悚然的咒文回荡。
author: char_latte3412
source: On moonless nights, lost travelers claim they can hear the distant echoes of bone-chilling incantations from POKENAME's cries.

entry: 据说秋夜里，它会扮作鬼屋吓人。可一到清晨，就消失得仿佛从未来过。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: On autumn nights, it is said to disguise itself as a haunted house, giving many a fright. Yet by morning, it vanishes like it were never there.

entry: 它先爆发出满含怒气的尖叫，再追赶被震得发懵的目标。POKENAME出拳前，还会为双拳施加魔法。
author: awiralonprime
source: It unleashes a rage-powered scream before chasing after its dazed victim. POKENAME will coat its fists with an enchantment before attacking.

entry: 头上的帽子其实是身体的一部分。它领地意识极强，会以念力搬起巨石，砸向靠得太近的人。
author: raptorroocool
source: The hat on top of its head is actually part of its body. Highly territorial, it uses telekinesis to throw boulders at anyone getting too close to it.

entry: 据说POKENAME是受不幸吸引而来的灵体。虽然灾祸并非它们所致，这份恶名仍让人类不愿亲近。
author: SandGuyThing
source: POKENAME are said to be spirits that are attracted to misfortune. While not the direct cause, that stigma makes them not very loved by humans.

entry: 梦磁怪会被严重的不幸事件吸引，聚在一起，融合成POKENAME。仍戴着帽子的那只，就是最先赶到现场的个体。
author: SandGuyThing
source: Mismites are attracted to larger cases of misfortune, merging together to become POKENAME. The one keeping its hat was the first to the scene.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会射出小礼物与彩纸，让小宝可梦开心。壳上的花纹描绘着各式节庆场面。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME's blasters shoot out small gifts and confetti for small Pokémon to enjoy. The patterns on its shell depict various festive scenes.

entry: POKENAME召集几只宝可梦，替自己护卫、作恶。稍有危险，就放出使人迷醉的烟雾逃走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME gathers several Pokémon to protect it and commit felonies for it. At the slightest danger, it will emit an intoxicating smoke and flee.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: POKENAME用影戏逗乐成群黑暗鸦。有时表演失误，反倒给夜间演出添了几分诙谐。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME amuses flocks of Murkrow with shadow play techniques. They sometimes miss the mark, adding a touch of whimsy to its nightly performances.

entry: POKENAME善于欺骗与操纵，常用超能力诱使训练家和宝可梦听命行事。
author: chrisryusaki
source: POKENAME are very deceptive and manipulative Pokémon. They often use their psychic abilities to trick Trainers and Pokémon into doing their bidding.

entry: POKENAME常是宝可梦帮派中的底层成员。虽加入帮派，却根本不忍伤害别人。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is commonly found in the lower ranks of Pokémon gangs. Even though they are found in gangs, they can't stand hurting others.

entry: 据说低沉幽怨的叫声能召来徘徊的亡魂。那空洞遥远的凝视，仿佛一直望着彼岸。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its deep, haunting cry is said to call restless spirits. Its vacant, distant stare is said to look into the afterlife.

entry: 它们举止潇洒，会偷羽毛装点外衣与帽子。外衣越大，在族群中的权势也越大。
author: Mistymagius
source: These suave Pokémon will steal feathers to build out their coat and hat. The larger the coat, the more power they have over their pack.

entry: 黑暗鸟手下若没收集到足够多的闪亮物品，就会遭POKENAME殴打。它们偷来的食物，则会分给幼鸟。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME will attack its Murbird goons if they fail to gather enough shiny objects. They distribute their stolen food to their young.

entry: POKENAME气派的鹿角，是它统领的黑暗鸦群的栖架。POKENAME也被视为贤明掌权者的象征。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's impressive antlers act as a roost for the murder of Murkrow that it's in charge of. POKENAME are used as a symbol of wisdom in authority.

entry: POKENAME欺负一切被它视为低等的宝可梦，常用头上的角戳弄小家伙，故意惹它们生气。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME bullies all other Pokémon it deems lesser than itself. It can often be seen poking smaller Pokémon with the horn on its head to annoy them.

entry: 城镇中若出现POKENAME，最好关紧门窗，免得闪闪发亮的东西都被它偷走。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Any towns where POKENAME is spotted are advised to keep all doors and windows shut, lest this Pokémon steal anything that glimmers and shines.

entry: 据说POKENAME注视谁，就是在审判谁的灵魂。平日爱好和平，受威胁时却会变得极其凶猛。
author: ElioNagashi#0173
source: It's said that when a POKENAME looks at someone, it judges their soul. They usually are pacifistic, but become highly aggressive when threatened.

entry: POKENAME手里的“拐杖”其实是身体的一部分，与手根本无法分开。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: The "cane" POKENAME holds is actually part of its body, and inseperable from its hand.

entry: POKENAME的几个头像天平一样，称量生灵的善恶业报，再作出裁决。它住在阴暗森林中。
author: anLcorpagent
source: POKENAME's heads operate as a scale, weighing the karma of creatures and delivering a verdict. It resides in dark forests.

entry: 它的灯一感知到疾病，就会赶到现场。找到病人时，治疗的方法早已了然于心。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon appears wherever its lamp senses a disease. If it finds its patient, it already knows how to treat them.

entry: POKENAME以魅力与催眠之力，领导着一大群惹事的宝可梦。为达目的，甚至会劫持人质。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME acts as the charismatic, hypnotic leader of a large, troublesome group of Pokémon. It has been known to take hostages to get what it wants.

entry: 它的灯一感知到疾病，就会赶到现场。找到病人时，治疗的方法早已了然于心。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon appears wherever its lamp senses a disease. If it finds its patient, it already knows how to treat them.

entry: POKENAME从翅膀和泪腺排出多余液体，洒落地面。据说尝起来微甜又微咸。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME secretes excess fluid out of its wings and tear ducts, which scatters to the ground. It is said to be both mildly sweet and salty.

entry: POKENAME单脚撑地转动，每秒都换个方向，却从不失去平衡，转动时还会发出咔嗒声。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME swings around on its foot, changing direction every second and never losing its balance. It makes clicking noises as it does so.

entry: POKENAME一旦找到适合栖身的地方，就能完全静止，一连保持数百小时。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: Once a POKENAME finds a suitable place to perch, it can remain perfectly motionless for hundreds of hours at a time.

entry: 背上团成一簇的绿色蛛丝酷似叶片。它能向各个方向射出丝球，轻易捕获对手。
author: .izik
source: The green webbing clumped on its back resembles leaves. It can loose these orbs of silk in multiple directions, catching an opponent with ease.

entry: 深入无光的洞穴时，头上的圆球会发出暗淡绿光，随着心跳一明一暗。
author: .izik
source: When it is deep in a cave and there is no light, the spheres on its head emit a dim green glow. This light pulsates with its heartbeat.

entry: 身体坚硬如大理石。傍晚，它会刨开灌木根部的泥土，吃掉富含养分的根。
author: .izik
source: Its body is as hard as marble. During the evenings it digs at the base of bushes to consume the nutritious roots.

entry: 头上的尖刺分泌强酸，能在洞壁上蚀出孔洞，供它筑巢。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its head secretes a potent acid. It uses this corrosive liquid to make holes in cavern walls and create its nest.

entry: POKENAME究竟是木头雕好后石化，还是从一开始就是石头，研究人员尚无定论。但有一点他们都赞同：里面附着灵魂。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Researchers have yet to confirm whether POKENAME was wood that petrified after it was carved or always stone, but they agree that it is possessed.

entry: POKENAME会流下悲伤的眼泪，却鲜少真情流露。通常不是在骗人，就是在演戏。
author: birchbot
source: A POKENAME will shed sorrowful tears, but they are rarely genuine. It is usually either deceiving people or putting on a show.

entry: 它常回想起年幼时的日子，有时会因这些怀念而落泪。
author: birchbot
source: It reminisces about its babyhood. It sometimes cries because of the nostalgic memories.

entry: POKENAME讨人喜欢、举止温和，会挑选华美豪宅安家，再悄悄吸食同住者的生命力。
author: .towerxvi
source: Charming and mild mannered, POKENAME seek out lavish mansions to call home. It quietly feeds on the life force of its housemates.

entry: POKENAME常懒洋洋地顺河漂流，被误认作浮木。几乎从不流露情绪。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME often gets mistaken for driftwood since it is often seen lazily drifting down rivers. It rarely ever expresses any sort of emotion.

entry: 有些POKENAME喜欢睡在红陶盆里。有人说这能让它安心，也有人认为有助成长。
author: birchbot
source: Some POKENAME like to sleep inside of terracotta pots. Some say that it makes them feel safe; others believe that it improves their growth.

entry: POKENAME十分胆怯。想让POKENAME信任一个人，得花时间，用心陪伴。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME is a very frightened Pokémon. It takes time and dedication to get a POKENAME to trust someone.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物，能像氦气球一样飘浮。POKENAME很喜欢将它们送给孩子。
author: kiwikelly
source: The plants that grow on POKENAME's back float just like helium balloons. POKENAME loves to gives them out to children.

entry: POKENAME虽然害羞，却一心想让自己为数不多的朋友开心，会用藤蔓为朋友们跳舞。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is very shy. However, it loves to make what little friends it does have happy. It uses its vines to do dances for its friends.

entry: POKENAME爱突然跳出盒子，吓唬其他宝可梦或训练家。还没来得及训斥，它又消失了。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME likes to jump out of its box without warning to scare other Pokémon or its Trainer. Before you can reprimand it, it disappears again.

entry: POKENAME能模仿多种鸟宝可梦的叫声，还会学大嘴雀或嘟嘟利尖叫，吓退天敌。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME can mimic the cries of several kinds of bird Pokémon. It screeches like a Fearow or Dodrio to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME活泼又容易信任别人，因此POKENAME很适合成为新手训练家的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is a lively Pokémon that is very trusting. This makes POKENAME a popular partner for beginner Trainers.

entry: 它满脑子只有恶作剧，从来不肯正经，曾把许多训练家气得脸色铁青。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This Pokémon has nothing but mischief on its mind. As it never remains serious, it has driven many a Trainer to livid with rage.

entry: POKENAME讲笑话很会拿捏时机，好笑得甚至能让其他宝可梦笑昏过去。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME delivers jokes with excellent comedic timing. They are so funny that they can make other Pokémon faint from laughter.

entry: POKENAME总反复唱同一首歌。最初听到的那段音乐，会被它一直唱到进化为止。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME habitually sings the same song over and over. The first piece of music it hears is what it repeats until it evolves.

entry: POKENAME模仿面前训练家与宝可梦的表情，试图将对方弄糊涂。若不奏效，就赶紧逃跑。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME mimics the facial expressions of Trainers and Pokémon it goes up against to confuse them. If that doesn't work, it quickly runs away.

entry: POKENAME藏在异常坚固的盒子里，奏乐吸引人靠近，再捉弄对方，转眼又消失。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hides in its incredibly robust box and plays music so that it can prank approaching people and then disappear again.

entry: POKENAME没有其他熔岩虫融合宝可梦那般高温，摸上去温暖如棉花糖，常与逗孩子的艺人一同表演。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: Often used by children's entertainers, POKENAME has lost the heat of other Slugma fusions. Instead, it has a warm, candy floss feel.

entry: 它弹性十足，仿佛由泡泡糖与弹簧组成，最爱和孩子及宝可梦一起跳房子。
author: kiwikelly
source: This fusion is extremely bouncy, as if it were made of bubblegum and springs. It loves to play hopscotch with children and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME藏在弹簧玩偶盒里，爱捉弄毫无防备的人。它似乎怜悯被收服的宝可梦，自己却也很孤独。
author: Skymaster426
source: Hiding in jack-in-the-boxes, POKENAME loves playing pranks on unsuspecting people. It seems to pity captured Pokémon, but it itself is lonely.

entry: 头太沉，常绊得自己摔倒。秃头的喜剧演员有时会扮成POKENAME登台，往往逗得全场大笑。
author: antomelon
source: Its head is so heavy that it often trips and falls over. Bald comedians sometimes dress as POKENAME while performing, and hilarity often ensues.

entry: 这把剑的切割能力与普通剑相同。刀刃若爆开，POKENAME便借泄出的空气飞走，到别处重新长好。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This sword is as effective a cutter as a standard sword. If its blade ever pops, POKENAME uses to expelling air to fly away and regenerate elsewhere.

entry: 连续弹跳的次数越多，刀刃就越有力，POKENAME也越兴奋。它很乐意让孩子拿自己玩耍。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The more successive bounces it achieves, the more powerful the blade and the more excited the POKENAME becomes. It happily lets kids play with it.

entry: POKENAME见谁都热情过头，尤其爱逗孩子开心。可无论大人孩子，往往都很怕它。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME acts overly friendly to all who it meets. It loves to entertain children despite both kids and adults alike often being terrified of it.

entry: POKENAME走路时，头上的帽子摇来晃去。顶端白球如同麦克风，帮助POKENAME模仿听来的歌。
author: .realthree
source: The hat on POKENAME's head wobbles when it walks. The white sphere at the tip acts as a microphone to help POKENAME mimic songs it hears.

entry: POKENAME的毒不会致命，只会让人略感不适，却能引发强烈幻觉。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's poison is not deadly, only slightly sickening. However, it does cause intense hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME翅上脱落的彩纸常被用于生日派对，因此POKENAME很受表演者欢迎。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: The confetti that comes off of POKENAME's wings are often often used at birthday parties. POKENAME is popular among entertainers as a result of this.

entry: POKENAME能从背甲的突起散播蕴含超能力的花粉，让中招者的大脑运转失灵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can distribute pollen enriched with psychic powers via the protrusions on its back armor. These impair the brain function of those affected.

entry: POKENAME用柔韧的背甲护身。背甲弹性极佳，能像橡胶一样弹开物理攻击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME protects itself with a flexible back armor. It is very elastic and can repel physical attacks like rubber.

entry: 这个默剧演员脾气十分凶暴，随时可能毫无预警地出手。训练家教导它时，必须留神。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: This mime has a highly aggressive disposition. Trainers should be careful training it, as it is likely to lash out with no warning.

entry: POKENAME对超能力还控制不佳，只能依靠模仿父母行动，免得不知不觉放出致命剂量的毒液。
author: char_latte3412
source: With only limited control of its psychic power, POKENAME rely heavily on mimicking its parents, lest it unknowingly release fatal levels of venom.

entry: 这种POKENAME由人工创造，常在恐怖片中露面，靠突然出现的小把戏吓人一跳。
author: char_latte3412
source: An artificially-created variant of POKENAME, this Pokémon is prominently featured in many horror flicks as a trivial jump scare.

entry: POKENAME新觉醒的第三只眼赋予它强大超能力，常被用来辅助抛接杂耍。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME's newly awakened third eye gives it strong psychic powers. It uses this power to assist its juggling.

entry: POKENAME先用戏法分散对手注意，再迅速出击。无论走到哪儿，鼻子总会发出喇叭声。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME distracts its opponents with tricks before delivering a swift strike. Its nose lets out a honking noise wherever it goes.

entry: 它立志成为举世闻名的马戏明星。可惜尖角，却把这个梦想“戳破”了。
author: volvonovic
source: Its life goal was to be a world-renowned performer at the circus. Unfortunately, its sharp horn has burst this dream.

entry: 它是在愚人节发现的宝可梦，常捉弄心情低落的幼年宝可梦，想逗它们振作起来。
author: barthandelus_real
source: This Pokémon was discovered on April Fool's day. It tends to prank other baby Pokémon in order to cheer them up during hard times.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: 它已能感知情绪，却还没强大到能用力量改变情绪。只好用压不住的欢快劲，努力让大家过得更好。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Old enough to sense emotion, but not strong enough to influence it with its power, it does its best to improve lives with its insuppressible cheer.

entry: POKENAME将找到的白色小物件藏进秘密收藏处，再用缎带赶走入侵者，守住珍藏。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME stashes away small, white objects it finds in a hidden hoard. It guards it by shooing away invaders with its ribbon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢亲昵接触。毛皮被抚摸时，尾巴便会迸出细小火花。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME loves physical touch. When its fur is stroked, little sparks fly out of its tail.

entry: POKENAME能结出带着麻舌苦味的柑橘，是制作酸糖的人气原料。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME produce a type of citrus that has an electrifying and bitter taste. It is a popular ingredient in sour candies.

entry: 它奔跑时，会挥起三条尾巴斩击敌人，也能从角上射出闪电。
author: themicelegion
source: It slices through foes with its three tails as it runs. It uses its horns to fire off lightning bolts.
