entry: 它心地善良，会在风暴中为船只引路，一边飞行，一边用身体吸收落雷。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This kindhearted Pokémon has been known to guide ships during storms, using its body to absorb lighting strikes as it flies.

entry: POKENAME在雷雨中会将尾巴高高伸起，获取能量。有时也能见它们在发电厂进食。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME stretches its tail upwards during thunderstorms to obtain energy. Sometimes they are also observed feeding in power plants.

entry: POKENAME已能熟练控电。POKENAME在几条尾巴间产生电能，再以扰乱性的电流释放出去。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME has mastered its control over electricity. The electricity POKENAME generates between its tails can be sent out in disruptive currents.

entry: POKENAME凭带电双翼，不太费力就能长途飞行。受攻击时，便会猛烈扑翅。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: With charged wings, POKENAME can fly long distances with little energy expenditure. If it is attacked, it flaps its wings wildly.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么天气都爱飞，唯独不喜欢酷寒，尤其钟爱雷雨过后的天空。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME enjoys flying through nearly any conditions, but it dislikes the extreme cold. It loves flying through the skies after a thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME很自豪于自己华丽的羽状毛发。若有人不顾它的意愿伸手摸，就会被电得疼痛不已。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is proud of its magnificent hair feathers. If anyone tries to touch it against its will, it punishes them with painful electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME很自豪于自己华丽的羽状毛发。若有人不顾它的意愿伸手摸，就会被电得疼痛不已。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is proud of its magnificent hair feathers. If anyone tries to touch it against its will, it punishes them with painful electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么天气都敢飞，唯独不喜欢严寒。雷雨过后的天空，更是它的最爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME enjoys flying through nearly any conditions, but dislikes extreme cold. It especially loves flying through the skies after a thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么天气都敢飞，唯独不喜欢严寒。雷雨过后的天空，更是它的最爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME enjoys flying through nearly any conditions, but dislikes extreme cold. It especially loves flying through the skies after a thunderstorm.

entry: 它把尾巴插在枯萎植物根旁，以电击唤回生机。这样救活的植物，往往会长出曲折的锯齿状花纹。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It plants its tail into the base of wilting plants and shocks them back to life. The plants it revives this way often take on a zigzag pattern.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又容易兴奋。散步时常在训练家脚边穿来绕去，尾巴还迸着电火花。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is incredibly energetic and excitable. It will often weave around Trainers feet while on walks, with electricity sparking off its tail.

entry: POKENAME特别热衷节庆，而且对这事很认真。它会向其他宝可梦派礼物，谁若调皮，就电谁一下。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They have a very festive nature that they take very seriously. POKENAME give out gifts to other Pokémon, but will shock anyone being naughty.

entry: POKENAME先在地面充电，再跃向空中，尾巴朝下猛撞地面，将自己钻入地下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME charges itself with electricity on the surface, then leaps into the air and crashes into the ground, tail first, to dig itself in.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME保留了路卡利欧感知波导的能力。若发现有人心怀恶意，就会毫不犹豫地朝脸上来一记雷电拳。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME retains Lucario's ability to read auras. If it senses bad intentions from a person, it will not hesitate to Thunderpunch them in the face.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃不停震动，稍有声音就会惊慌。它喜欢独处，可被逼到绝境时，震动也能增强攻击威力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade vibrates and it panics at the slightest sound. It prefers solitude, but when cornered, its vibrations enhance its damage.

entry: 它与其他POKENAME交流时，会将闪电形缎带连在一起，在彼此之间传递电流。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It communicates with other POKENAME by connecting their lighting-shaped ribbons and sending shocks between them.

entry: 蓬松毛皮里积起的静电，会被存进颊囊。静电太多时，它们就会变得格外黏人、爱撒娇。
author: Faelocke
source: Their cheek pouches store static electricity that builds up in their fluffy fur. Too much of it can make them clingy and needy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在草地上优雅起舞。多只POKENAME一同跳舞时，尾巴就会亮起耀眼电光。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME likes to dance gracefully in grassy fields. When multiple POKENAME dance together, their tails glow brightly with electricity.

entry: 虽然模样可爱，仍不建议训练家融合出POKENAME。它雷鸣般的嗡叫，可能损伤听力。
author: mx_wellman
source: Despite their cute appearance, Trainers are advised against creating POKENAME as their thunderous buzz of a cry can cause hearing damage.

entry: POKENAME常因外貌被误当成落到地面的雨云，曾有旅人因此挨了电击。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Because of its appearance, POKENAME is often mistaken for a grounded nimbus cloud. Travelers have been known to be shocked by it.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会像游泳一样穿行于沙漠的沙子中。发现猎物后，它会释放100,000伏的电流，让大多数宝可梦瞬间昏厥。
author: bunkachunka
source: POKENAME swims through the desert sand while hunting. Once it finds its prey, it discharges 100,000 volts, causing most Pokémon to faint instantly.

entry: POKENAME变化后的尾巴能感知电流规律，也能触物感知、排出多余电力，还能抓握东西。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME's modified tails lets it sense electrical patterns. They also sense what they touch, discharge extra electricity, and grab and hold things.

entry: 它俯冲扑向猎物时，尾巴会绷直变硬。有幸目睹的人，都说它像一道活的闪电。
author: char_latte3412
source: When it dives at prey, its tail stiffens and straightens out. Spectators lucky enough to view this phenomenon describe it as a living thunderbolt.

entry: 它伪装的头部里藏着一只威力强大的灯泡。一旦灯泡露出来，它就会不断电击周围的人，直到灯泡重新被遮住。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Inside the head of its disguise is a powerful electric bulb. If the bulb is exposed, it will shock anyone nearby until covered again.

entry: POKENAME天性贪玩，常能看到它拿路灯杆和电线胡闹。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Carrying through life with a playful personality, you may find a POKENAME goofing around with lampposts and power lines.

entry: 它见到猎物就会一把抓住。得手后，POKENAME从利爪通出微弱电流，让食物不再乱动。
author: char_latte3412
source: It will grab any prey it lays eyes on. Once captured, POKENAME sends a small electric current through its talons to keep its meal from moving.

entry: 野生POKENAME会拼命保护自己的雷之石，谁想偷走就会让它们暴怒。它们还会拿石头砸野生皮卡丘，强迫其进化。
author: DonutsBG
source: Wild POKENAME protect their Thunder Stones. If someone tries to steal them, they go berserk. They hit wild Pikachu with the Stones to force evolution.

entry: POKENAME头顶的花苞里，蓄着用于攻击的电力。它分泌的毒液，也与电池酸液极为相似。
author: knilk
source: The bulbs on POKENAME's head store the electrical energy it uses for its attacks. It secretes a poison that closely resembles battery acid.

entry: POKENAME存电太多时，会散出带电的花粉。这些花粉，甚至能为大型机械供电。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: When POKENAME has too much stored electricity, it will scatter electrically charged pollen. This pollen can be used to power large machinery.

entry: 它给摆锤充入静电，将其当作临时罗盘，寻找最近的电源，填饱肚子。
author: mx_wellman
source: By charging its pendulum with static, it can use it as a makeshift compass to find the closest source of electricity, which it feeds on.

entry: 它的角有独立的“嗅觉”。POKENAME像使用探测棒一样用角寻找食物，找到后便张开下颌，将食物一口吞下。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its horn has its own sense of 'smell'. POKENAME uses this horn like a dowsing rod to track down food, and unhinges its jaw to gulp the meal down.

entry: POKENAME常把食物卡在毛发里。走动时残渣掉落，引来许多拾食的生物尾随。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME often gets food caught in its hair. The excess food falls out as it moves along, causing scavengers to follow behind it.

entry: 两张嘴都一样饿，偏偏大嘴往往只能吃剩下的。
author: birchbot
source: Both mouths are just as hungry as each other. The bigger one usually gets the scraps.

entry: POKENAME闯进民宅、农场、餐馆和仓库大肆觅食，再通过勺子与叉状刀刃吸收食物颗粒。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME ravages homes, farms, restaurants, and warehouses for their food. It absorbs food particles through its spoon and forked blade.

entry: 它无忧无虑，想吃就吃，随心生活。融合的哪一部分先完成进化，会决定它往后的成长道路。
author: miecreates
source: It has little care in the world, eating all it wants and going about its way. The component that evolves first determines its path later in life.

entry: POKENAME天生贪吃，爱往嘴里塞满岩石与矿物。有时小宝可梦也会遭到它的贪食之灾。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is a glutton by nature. It enjoys stuffing its mouth with rocks and minerals. However, small Pokémon sometimes fall victim to its episodes.

entry: POKENAME毯子般的身体，偶尔会让其他宝可梦住进来，以树果或丝线作为交换，再用收到的丝制作装饰。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's blanket-like body occasionally houses other Pokémon in exchange for berries or silk. It uses that silk to create its decorations.

entry: POKENAME能不动就不动。非走不可时，就拖着身体挪到别处，或搭其他宝可梦一程。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tends to avoid moving. If it needs to, it'll drag itself to a new location or catch a ride on another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME其实有后腿，只是通常藏着。毯子般的那部分身体，则像斗篷一样连在背上。
author: ohok3441
source: While typically hidden, POKENAME does have back legs. The blanket-like segment of its body is attached to its back like a cape.

entry: POKENAME漂在酸性水域，雷暴袭来时便能轻易吸收电力。发电厂附近也常能见到它们。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in acidic waters so if a thunderstorm hits, it can easily absorb the electricity from them. They are also common around power plants.

entry: 每只POKENAME的毛发花纹都不相同。游到水面时，附近船上的人就能看清。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Each POKENAME has a unique pattern in its hair. When it swims to the surface, nearby people in boats can observe this pattern.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳的声音控制流过触角间的海流，借水流大幅提升游速。
author: MrPeach774
source: A POKENAME uses its melodic voice to control the ocean currents that flow between its antennae. It can use these currents to move much faster.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，会从河里滑跃而出，在空中滑翔片刻。它天性好奇，常主动找别人玩。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME playfully glide out of the waters of their rivers and coast on the air for a time . Curious by nature, they will approach others to play.

entry: 它整天随风与洋流漂荡。入睡时会攀住旗杆或珊瑚，免得睡着被带入险境。
author: kittyluv090
source: It spends its days drifting along wind and ocean currents. It clings to flagpoles and coral so that it doesn't fly into danger when it's asleep.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME常被误当作神。如今大多数人却看不起POKENAME，因为它们总爱将人类当作仆从。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME were often mistaken as gods long ago. Now most humans look down upon POKENAME, as they usually made humans their servants.

entry: POKENAME是一群狃小子的首领，总与帮众形影不离。它整天吆喝发令，还会主动挑起与敌帮的争斗。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: The leader of a pack of Snearogues, POKENAME is never seen without its gang. It barks orders all day, and initiates fights with rival gangs.

entry: POKENAME既顽皮又合群，会结成紧密的小团体。每条肢体，都可能带来致命一击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are both incredibly mischievous and incredibly social, forming tight-knit packs. Each of its limbs can be deadly.

entry: POKENAME既顽皮又合群，会结成紧密的小团体。每条肢体，都可能带来致命一击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are both incredibly mischievous and incredibly social, forming tight-knit packs. Each of its limbs can be deadly.

entry: POKENAME只能用爪子排出多余电力，因此捕猎越久，脾气就会越凶暴。
author: mimigaagua
source: It can only discharge excess electricity through its claws. Because of this, POKENAME gets progressively more vicious the longer it hunts.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里袭敌。战斗本能虽敏锐，这个顽皮家伙却总爱挑弱小的对手下手。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME only targets foes at night. While this mischievous Pokémon possesses sharp fighting instincts, it tends to only go for weaker enemies.

entry: POKENAME产生的磁力强得足以构筑屏障，还能沿金属物体轻松攀行。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME generates such strong magnetic force that it can use them to create barriers. It can also climb effortlessly along metal objects.

entry: POKENAME产生的磁力强得足以构筑屏障，还能沿金属物体轻松攀行。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME generates such strong magnetic force that it can use them to create barriers. It can also climb effortlessly along metal objects.

entry: POKENAME眼睛虽大，视力却不佳。好在能像回声定位一样运用电磁波，行动依然无碍。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's massive eye doesn't actually have great vision. However, it uses electromagnetic waves like echolocation, so it gets by just fine.

entry: POKENAME利用磁能释放强劲的带电等离子体。它们喜欢阳光最充足的高处。
author: zespud
source: Utilizing magnetic energy, POKENAME can release powerful electrified plasma. They prefer high places, where the sunlight is strongest.

entry: POKENAME一靠近，收音机便无法使用。它释放的电磁波，无法用现有的频谱知识界定。
author: bobosmith01
source: Radios become unusable when POKENAME draws near. The electromagnetic waves it sends out cannot be defined on the spectrum as we know it.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME聚成一团，增强力量。研究者认为，这种组合便是现代句子结构的起源。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME have been seen clumping together to amplify their strength. Researchers believe these clumps to be the origin of modern sentence structures.

entry: POKENAME由西尔佛公司创造，用作空中监视的无人机。监视效果出众，因此很受企业欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME was created by Silph Co. as a flying surveillance drone. They are very popular with companies as an effective surveillance measure.

entry: 它模仿盔甲鸟的外形引诱它们，再让磁波通过金属躯体，借此飞行。
author: squawkabairdy
source: This Pokémon lures Skarmory by mimicking their shape. It channels magnetic waves through their metal bodies to fly.

entry: POKENAME的电磁铁强得足以摧毁摩天大楼。训练家靠近POKENAME时，切记别带电子设备。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME's electromagnets are strong enough to destroy skyscrapers. Trainers should be careful not to carry any electronic devices near a POKENAME.

entry: 它喜欢用金属丝般的触须缠住主人的手臂，结果却常让训练家触电。
author: gellyfishsh
source: It enjoys wrapping its wire-like feelers around its owner's arms. However, this usually ends up electrocuting the Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的身体释放极强磁场。传说磁场强大得连空间本身都能扭曲。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body emits an incredibly strong magnetic field. Legends say this field is strong enough to warp space itself.

entry: POKENAME守护世界各地的发电厂，被设计得机敏、聪慧又忠诚。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME protect various power plants across the world. They are engineered to be cunning, brilliant, and loyal.

entry: POKENAME会偷走人们的金属物品，挑选优质材料强化机械身体。凡拿到手的，就绝不打算归还。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME steals metal items from people, seeking quality items to enhance its mechanical body. It has no intention of returning anything it takes.

entry: POKENAME光是存在，就对电网构成威胁。若出现在不该去的地方，能瞬间让整个地区停电。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME's very existence is a threat to power grids. If one ends up in the wrong place, it could shut down an entire region in an instant.

entry: POKENAME被造出来讨孩子喜欢，却不知道自己抱人的力道有多大。不知为何，体内还填满了钢丝绒。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME was created to appeal to children, but it doesn't know the strength of its own hugs. For some reason, its insides are filled with steel wool.

entry: POKENAME核心外围的岩壳由矿石组成，靠电磁场固定。战斗时，这些矿石也能作为弹丸射出。
author: therider
source: The rocky shell around the center of POKENAME is formed of ore, held there by an electromagnetic field. The ore can be shot as a projectile in combat.

entry: POKENAME向对手喷射磁性黏液。黏液几乎无法除去，让对方再也难以摆脱POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME shoots its magnetic slime at opponents. The slime is nearly impossible to get off, and leaves them unable to get away from POKENAME.

entry: 休息时，它会把多余能量存入壳中，发出微弱光芒。受到威胁，则缩进壳里自保。
author: lynkinator
source: It stores excess energy within its shell during periods of inactivity, emitting a faint glow. It will defensively hide in its shell when threatened.

entry: 体型变小、重量变轻，让它稍微灵活了一些。唾液如今带有麻痹作用，碰到舌头还会遭到电击。
author: Cascadeguy
source: It is slightly more mobile due to its reduced weight and size. Its saliva now contains a paralyzing effect, shocking anything that touches its tongue.

entry: 许多舌头充当额外的肢体，也令它总是口渴、味觉迟钝。为补水，它会贪婪地舔干整座湖泊。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its many tongues act as extra limbs, leaving it constantly thirsty and desensitized to taste. It will greedily lap up entire lakes to stay hydrated.

entry: 它在洞里快速飞行，用长舌扫舔地面，尽可能捡起食物，再把石头等杂物吐掉。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It flies quickly through caves and licks the ground with its long tongue to pick up as much food as possible. It spits out stones and similar items.

entry: POKENAME总爱舔训练家，可一点也不像小约克那样可爱，反倒让人毛骨悚然。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME lick their Trainers all the time. Instead of it being cute, like with Lillipup, it just seems creepy.

entry: 两只大舌舔对甜食的强烈渴望，影响了融合后的外貌。人们常看到它闯进糖果店觅食。
author: kittyluv090
source: This fusion's appearance is influenced by the two Lickilicky's strong desires for sweet foods. It is often found raiding confectionary shops.

entry: 它先用唾液令猎物动弹不得，再以前方的舌头吸血。背上那对翅膀，其实也是舌头。
author: Soup1900
source: It uses its saliva to immobilize its prey before slurping their blood with its front tongue. Its wings are actually the tongues that are on its back.

entry: 舌刃靠的不是切割，而是分泌的腐蚀性唾液伤敌。还能缠住对手，使皮肤麻木。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its tongue blade deals damage not through cutting, but the corrosive saliva it produces. It also wraps around opponents and numbs their skin.

entry: 舌头强劲，能像弹簧一样卷起，让它弹跳前行。据说当POKENAME能将自己弹进轨道时，就会升华成更高的形态。
author: GenesisParallax
source: It bounces on its powerful tongue which can coil up like a spring. It's said a POKENAME ascends to a higher form when it can launch itself into orbit.

entry: POKENAME色彩鲜艳、表情简单，可它引发的牙齿噩梦却挥之不去。另一张嘴里，藏着无尽虚空。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite POKENAME's bright colors and simplistic face, the teeth-based nightmares it causes are haunting. The secondary mouth houses an endless void.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀对周围的一切都极其敏感。散出的粉末会引起严重瘙痒与皮疹。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are very sensitive to every aspect of their surroundings The powder it spreads causes severe itching and rashes.

entry: POKENAME虽然模样不讨喜，味觉却极为敏锐，因此常成为美食家的伙伴。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite their unpleasant appearance, POKENAME are known to be the partners of food connoisseurs due to their very sensitive sense of taste.

entry: 角既坚韧又富有橡胶般的弹性。许多公司用POKENAME的铠甲制作弹力球、弹弓和橡皮擦。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its horns are very tough and rubbery. Many companies use POKENAME's armor for products like bouncy balls, slingshots, and erasers.

entry: POKENAME会尝尝包围身体的胶质，帮助自己思考。胶质的味道，会随心情改变。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME tastes the jelly around it to help it think. The flavor changes depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME贪吃得无可救药，靠近的东西都要吞下。传言连登山客失踪，也与它有关。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is an absolute glutton that eats anything that even comes close. Rumor has it that it is even responsible for the disappearance of hikers.

entry: POKENAME被放入野外后，已成了常见害兽。它常用舌头卷住旅人的腿，将对方绊倒。
author: ForbiddenBread
source: Since POKENAME's introduction to the wild, it has become a common pest. It will often grab travellers' legs with its tongue, making them fall over.

entry: POKENAME常用灵活的舌头清理耳道。虽然有些恶心，听觉却始终灵敏。
author: dudeasaur
source: POKENAME uses its flexible tongue to regularly clean out its ears. It may be gross, but its hearing is always on point.

entry: POKENAME用舌头作配重，能举起89辆辣味热狗摊车。不过要当心，它的胃口是“连车带餐全都要”。
author: cyprexx
source: Using its tongue as a counterweight, POKENAME can lift as much as eighty-nine chili dog carts. Beware, though, as it has an "all the cart" appetite.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把小个头的小鱼弹射出去，可小鱼们觉得，该拿去扔的明明是小独角鱼。
author: funktytomate
source: POKENAME like to catapult little Georaid at their targets, but the Georaid are of the opinion that it should be throwing little Rhyraid instead.

entry: 体内能储存电压高达20,000伏的电力，POKENAME再用它驱动尾端的钻头。
author: milchik
source: This fusion stores up to 20,000 volts within its body. POKENAME then uses this electricity to power up the drills on the ends of its tails.

entry: POKENAME能从掌心释放体内的火焰能量，借此向敌人射出滚烫、会爆炸的岩石。
author: milchik
source: The fire energy stored in its body can be released through the palms of its hands. POKENAME can launch hot explosive rocks at its foes thanks to it.

entry: 它能用触须举起巨石，像敲蛋一样击碎。强角持续钻掘，连坚实的基岩也抵挡不住。
author: wigglypon
source: It can use its tendrils to lift huge boulders and crack them like eggs. Even solid bedrock cannot withstand sustained drilling from its mighty horn.

entry: POKENAME用钻头触须挂在洞顶，捕食毫无戒心的岩石属性宝可梦，轻易就能钻破隆隆岩的硬壳。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME latch onto the tops of caverns with its drill tendrils to prey upon unaware Rock types. It can easily crack through a Golem's hard carapace.

entry: POKENAME钻出巨大隧道标记领地。无论什么东西、什么人，一旦落入隧道，都成了它的猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME marks its territory by drilling large tunnels. Anything and anyone that falls into these tunnels become its prey.

entry: POKENAME的钻头由吃下的矿物生成。若只吃宝石，甚至能长出晶体钻头。
author: ohok3441
source: The drills POKENAME have are produced from the minerals they consume. Those with a strictly gemstone diet can develop crystal drills.

entry: 它身上装饰的宝石和矿石十分珍贵。可惜，POKENAME绝不会放弃自己的珍藏，让商人们大失所望。
author: ohok3441
source: The gems and stones adorning its body are highly valued. Unfortunately for sellers, NAME will never give up its hoard.

entry: POKENAME凭钻头在建筑工地大显身手。可失控的POKENAME会在城镇地下乱挖，造成破坏。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are useful for construction thanks to their drills. Uncontrolled POKENAME have been known to damage towns by tunneling under them.

entry: 它常被用于拆迁。不过有报告称，POKENAME进场后，曾有工人消失得无影无踪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This fusion is often used for demolition work. However, there have been reports of workers disappearing without a trace once POKENAME was on site.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽与密丛中游荡，拼命挣扎，仿佛始终想挣脱自己的触手，却总也办不到。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME wanders swamps and thick brush, desperately thrashing around. It always seems to be trying and failing to free itself from its own tentacles.

entry: 翼状藤蔓能伸展许多米，让POKENAME不太费力就能滑翔数百公里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can extend its wing-shaped vines over many meters. In this way, POKENAME can glide many hundreds of kilometers with little effort.

entry: 体内的藤蔓比看起来多得多。任凭砍掉、烧断或冻断多少，总会有更多藤蔓重新覆满身体。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's body contains many more vines than it seems. No matter how many are cut, burned, or frozen off, there's always more covering it.

entry: POKENAME的藤刃既能当鞭，也能设套索。容易再生，最长能超过100英尺。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's vine blade functions both as a whip and a snare. It easily regenerates and can grow more than 100 feet long.

entry: 它在林中挖洞避风雨。若有足够小的东西凑近探看，就会被触手抓住吞食。
author: Skymaster426
source: It digs holes in forests to shelter from the elements. When something small enough inspects the hole, it grabs it with its tentacles and consumes it.

entry: POKENAME虽然性情温顺，也会用强韧藤蔓鞭打敌人。它是草食性的宝可梦。
author: themicelegion
source: Though a Pokémon with a docile demeanor, it whips foes with its strong vines. POKENAME is also a herbivore.

entry: 蔓生藤条占据了POKENAME原来的身体，只留下中空外壳，成为藤蔓的庇护所。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Spreading vines have overgrown and taken over the original body of POKENAME. The hollow shell serves as a shelter for the vines.

entry: POKENAME全身由会蜇人的长触手构成，碰上就疼。能忍受蜇刺的鱼宝可梦，却能借它藏身。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of long stinging tentacles that are painful to touch. These Pokémon are shelter for fish Pokémon that can endure its sting.

entry: 它产生的电力足以为50座发电厂供电。紧急时，还能挥出快如闪电的拳头。
author: imagine1.
source: The electricity it generates is enough to power 50 power plants. In case of emergencies, it will use its fists, capable of going at lightning speeds.

entry: 据估计，POKENAME的咬合压强超过每平方英寸4000磅，带电的尖牙还能释放15000伏的电流。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is estimated that POKENAME has a biting power of over 4000 PSI, with electrified fangs capable of delivering 15,000 volts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME常在风暴天空中飞过，身后拖着道道电光。铁炮鱼想搭它的便车，都会先犹豫再三。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are often observed drawing trails of lightning behind them across stormy skies. Remoraid think twice about hitching a ride on this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME有许多电线，能同时缠住多个敌人放电。脸部还有粗厚的电线保护。
author: creeps_jr
source: Due to its multitude of wires, POKENAME can attach to many foes at once to shock them. It is also protected by the thick wires protecting its face.

entry: POKENAME在风暴之夜精神饱满地滑翔觅食，带电的利爪能将猎物麻痹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME glides through the air full of energy on stormy nights, searching for food. Its electric claws help it to paralyze its prey.

entry: POKENAME头上的电球如同发电机，还能将电力传至尾巴，进一步增强打击力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The electric sphere on POKENAME's head acts as a generator, which can also pass the generated electricity on to its tail to further amplify strikes.

entry: POKENAME飞得迅疾如电，身后留下雷鸣般迸发的火花，以迅猛精准的电击击倒敌人。
author: anarchaz
source: Soaring with electrifying speed, POKENAME leaves trails of thunderous sparks in its wake. It strikes down foes with swift and shocking precision.

entry: 它先以利爪抓住猎物，再从尾巴释放强力电击。50英里以外的雷暴，也能察觉。
author: snescontroller
source: It grabs its prey in its talons before delivering powerful electric shocks from its tails. It can sense thunderstorms from over 50 miles away.

entry: 每条尾巴都能产生20,000伏的电力。碰过它尾巴的人，无一能从随后的电击中生还。
author: xtjs2018x
source: Each one of its tails can produce 20,000 volts of electricity. Nobody has touched one of its tails and survived the resulting shock.

entry: POKENAME会搭在其他电属性宝可梦的背上，常一不留神离家数英里，再花好几天赶回去。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME hitch rides on the backs of other Electric-type Pokémon. They often end up miles away from home and have to spend days travelling back.

entry: POKENAME的两条电缆状尾巴蕴含强劲力量。将尾巴按在胸前，就能放大吠声，震晕对手。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME's two cable-like tails can pack a wallop of power. It amplifies the sound of its barks to stun its opponents by pressing them to its chest.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，能把强烈怒气化为攻击力。此时，它能产生数千瓦特的电力。
author: Lemmymaster
source: When angered, POKENAME can channel its potent rage into increased attack power. In this state, it can produce many thousands of watts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME把两个尾尖抵在头上电击自己，刺激脑波，释放全部潜力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME holds the two tips of its tails to its head to shock itself. This procedure stimulates its brain waves and unleashes its full potential.

entry: 离POKENAME太近，甚至会让人熔化。身上不停滴落超过7000度的火焰。
author: Mistymagius
source: Being too close to a POKENAME will cause anyone to melt. Its body is constantly dripping flames of over 7000 degrees.

entry: POKENAME用惊人的体热煮沸体内液体，化为甜香蒸气释放。对手吸入后，力量就会被抽走。
author: sporkwizard
source: With its immense internal heat, POKENAME boils liquid within itself and releases it as a sweet vapor. Foes who inhale it find their strength sapped.

entry: POKENAME混进弱小宝可梦的群落，靠恐吓夺取首领之位，再以尾炮保护部下。
author: Pokopish
source: POKENAME will infiltrate a community of weaker Pokémon and take leadership through intimidation. It protects its underlings with its tail cannon.

entry: POKENAME的舌头耐得住极热，温度能达到华氏4000度。只要靠近热舌，体温就会明显升高。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME's tongue can endure extreme heat, reaching 4000°F; Being near its heated tongue can notably raise your body temperature.

entry: POKENAME每赢一场战斗，体温就会升高一些。它寻找势均力敌的对手，免得热得无人能碰。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME's body temperature rises with each won battle. It seeks a rival that can match its strength, lest it grows too hot to touch.

entry: 不败的POKENAME会用强劲炮火轰开荒地，造出熔岩竞技场，等待值得一战的挑战者。
author: Leshii
source: An undefeated POKENAME will use its powerful cannons to blast apart barren land, forming a molten arena in which it will wait for a worthy challenger.

entry: POKENAME很少离开火山深处的家。飞行时，会用尾炮调整方向。
author: drip_capybara
source: POKENAME rarely emerges from its home deep within volcanoes. It uses the cannon on its tail to adjust its course mid-flight.

entry: 头上的巨型迫击炮能发射猛烈火球，连钻石都能熔化，温度可见超过华氏8,200度。
author: Soup1900
source: The giant mortar on its head fires powerful fireballs that can melt even diamonds. This means its fire is over 8,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 铠甲能承受超过摄氏4000度的高温。POKENAME强劲的喷射火焰，曾烧焦整片地区。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its armor can withstand temperatures of over 4000 degrees Celsius. POKENAME has already scorched entire regions with its powerful flamethrower.

entry: 它自在而优雅地飞过天空。掠过星夜时，宛如一颗流星。
author: imagine1.
source: It flies through the sky gracefully and blissfully. It resembles a shooting star when soaring through the starry night.

entry: POKENAME受沉重外壳拖累，飞得很慢。史前时期，它曾照料受伤的宝可梦。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME flies around at a slow pace, as its shell weighs it down. During prehistoric times, it acted as a caretaker for injured Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一心向善，占卜师常养着它，只为算出吉兆。这样的占卜，收费可不便宜。
author: char_latte3412
source: Being whole-heartedly good, POKENAME are often kept by fortune-tellers to ensure only good fortunes are read. These readings are quite expensive.

entry: 头上的圆珠明亮发光时，附近的人都会平静下来。它的电力，足够供应整栋房屋。
author: kittyluv090
source: When the orbs on its head glow brightly, it calms anyone in its vicinity. Its electricity can power an entire house.

entry: 传说出生时若被POKENAME看见，那个人便注定会开创太平盛世。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Legend says that if someone's birth is seen by a POKENAME, they are destined to bring an era of great peace.

entry: POKENAME优雅迅疾地掠过最高的树梢，在雨林最偏僻宁静的角落休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.

entry: POKENAME优雅迅疾地掠过最高的树梢，在雨林最偏僻宁静的角落休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.

entry: POKENAME优雅迅疾地掠过最高的树梢，在雨林最偏僻宁静的角落休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.

entry: POKENAME是休战的象征。它一踏上战场，不论出于传统还是不由自主，交战者都会放下武器，直到它离开。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a symbol of armistice. When it enters a battlefield, combatants lay down arms for as long as it stays, out of tradition or compulsion.

entry: POKENAME是休战的象征。它一踏上战场，不论出于传统还是不由自主，交战者都会放下武器，直到它离开。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a symbol of armistice. When it enters a battlefield, combatants lay down arms for as long as it stays, out of tradition or compulsion.

entry: 它内心总在和平与敌意间挣扎。作战时凶狠无情，到最后却仍会手下留情。
author: creeps_jr
source: It feels constant conflict between peace and hostility. It brutally fights enemies but still offers mercy at the end.

entry: POKENAME眼中光芒闪动时，就能看透人心。若被POKENAME认为心地善良，便会得到好运祝福。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: When a POKENAME's eyes gleam, it can see what's in a person's heart. If POKENAME deems you to be kind, it will bless you with good luck.

entry: POKENAME为了远离争斗，安睡于岩浆中。传说它们苏醒之时，便会引发火山喷发。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME sleep peacefully in magma, avoiding strife. Legends tell of their awakening causing volcanic eruptions.

entry: POKENAME渴望绝对的幸福。一察觉争端，就用太阳之力射出金色光辉，哪怕造成毁灭，也要终结冲突。
author: Miistical
source: POKENAME craves absolute happiness. If it senses strife, it uses the power of the sun to fire an aureate gleam to end the conflict, even ruinously.

entry: POKENAME满怀纯粹的幸福，追寻并编织安宁喜悦，因此只会依附自己认为心善的人。
author: togetik
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon of pure happiness, seeking and spinning peaceful bliss. It therefore attaches itself only to those it deems of a good heart.

entry: POKENAME疾驰大地，和波克基斯一样被视为赐福者。可POKENAME专程探望的，是那些正身陷动乱的人。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME races across the land. Just like Togekiss, it's known as a bringer of blessings, but POKENAME visits those enduring turmoil.

entry: 这只善良的龙形融合宝可梦象征和平与好运。火焰温暖舒适，连最冰冷的心也能融化。
author: milchik
source: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.

entry: POKENAME乐观又合群，借翅膀在水面迅速滑行，宛如滑冰。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is quite sociable and optimistic. It uses its wings to swiftly glide across the water's surface as if it were ice.

entry: 这只善良的龙形融合宝可梦象征和平与好运。火焰温暖舒适，连最冰冷的心也能融化。
author: milchik
source: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.

entry: 它钻进沙漠的沙中，伪装成灌木。背上的叶子极苦，令食草动物不敢下口。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It burrows into the desert sand to disguise itself as a bush. The leaves on its back taste extremely bitter to deter potential herbivores.

entry: 猛烈沙暴会摧残POKENAME头顶的叶片。可每熬过一场风暴，叶子似乎都会更坚韧一些。
author: char_latte3412
source: Severe sandstorms can ravage the leaf atop POKENAME's head. Yet, each endured storm only seems to strengthen the plant's resilience.

entry: POKENAME把诱饵当作拆墙铁球，砸开蛤蜊进食，也用来清理领地里的水下障碍。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME uses its lures like wrecking balls to open up the clams it eats, or to break apart underwater debris in its territory.

entry: POKENAME扬起泥沙，射出闪电，吓退敌人。它生活在一小片相通的地下洞穴中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: To frighten enemies, POKENAME flings dirt and sand and hurls lightning bolts. It lives in small underground cave systems.

entry: 背上的仙人掌能储水，供POKENAME饮用。吸水越多，花就开得越绚烂。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The cactus on its back can store water and supply POKENAME with liquid. The more water it has absorbed, the more splendidly it blooms.

entry: POKENAME随音乐跳上好几个小时，也不休息。跳够后便吃饱、睡一小时，接着再来。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will dance to music for hours without resting. Once satisfied, it will eat until full and then sleep for an hour before starting again.

entry: POKENAME能用尾巴在特定位置产生电压，电击对手，也能用尾巴支撑身体，帮助双爪挖掘。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use its tail to create tension at certain points to shock opponents or as a support for its claws to dig through the ground.

entry: POKENAME从背上的仙人掌吸收、储存水分，因此最长能三年不补水而存活。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME absorbs water via the cacti on its back and stores it. This means it can survive for up to three years without new water.

entry: 传说沙漠里有座不断变换位置的古老神庙。直到最近，人们才发现那竟是只异常巨大的POKENAME。
author: howlingstarr
source: Legends tell of an ancient desert temple whose location is constantly shifting. It was only recently discovered to be an unusually large POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽无法将身体聚成完整刀刃，仍能以危险的力道挥出沙子。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Though POKENAME fails to hold itself together as a blade, it still swings its sand around at dangerous force.

entry: POKENAME看似无害，却会铲起沙子，猛力射向想握住它的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Despite its harmless appearance, POKENAME shovels into sand and launches it with great force at anyone who attempts to hold it.

entry: POKENAME把缎带拧在一起，像钻头般旋转，就能迅速钻入地下。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: By coiling its ribbons together and spinning them like a drill, POKENAME can burrow its way rapidly into the ground.

entry: POKENAME是生活在古老沙漠神庙中的神秘宝可梦。独特的形状，能启动古代机关，帮助探险者通行。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are mysterious Pokémon found in ancient desert temples. Their unique shape allows them to activate old mechanisms to help explorers pass.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠中，能制造自己的虚假分身。只要有人靠近，分身就会消散。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME can be found in deserts. These Pokémon can create fake clones of themselves that fade away when someone gets close to them.

entry: 夜里，它会蜷成一团。POKENAME醒来飞起时，构成双翼的沙子便会流动，发出响亮嗡鸣。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: At night, this Pokémon wraps itself into a ball. When POKENAME awakens and flies off, the sand that forms its wings shifts and emits a loud hum.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找最爱的小麦，因此农夫常抱怨成群POKENAME糟蹋庄稼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seek out fields of wheat, their favorite food. This often leads to farmers complaining about flocks of POKENAME destroying their crops.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会挥动沙沙岩石，唤起沙暴。它很少离开沙子的掩护。
author: noel5229
source: When POKENAME is startled, it summons sandstorms by swinging its Smooth Rock. It rarely leaves its cover of sand.

entry: 感官虽已十分出众，更惊人的却是双翼制造的无声冲击波，能造成严重内伤。
author: mx_wellman
source: Its spectacular senses are overshadowed by its capacity to create completely silent shock waves with its wings, inflicting critical internal injuries.

entry: POKENAME极其危险凶暴，透镜强化后的超能力，能在瞬间轻易撕裂敌人的身体。
author: Soup1900
source: Extremely dangerous and violent, POKENAME is able to use its lens-boosted psychic powers to rip apart the foe's bodies instantly without difficulty.

entry: POKENAME快得肉眼难以捕捉，却有着极佳视力，能看准并攻击对手要害。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME moves faster than the eye can see. It uses its own superb vision to identify and attack critical points on its opponents.

entry: 奇特的融合宝可梦，让人想到更原始的远古巨蜓。也有人推测，真正的古代蜻蜻蜓或许就是这副模样。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: A strange fusion which evokes the idea of a more primal Yanmega. Some theorists also think that it could be the appearance of a real ancient Yanma.

entry: POKENAME是极其古老的虫形宝可梦。在岛屿间迁徙时，沉重双翼的振动会掀起巨大风暴潮。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is an extremely ancient insectoid Pokémon. The flutter of its heavy wings create massive tidal storms as it migrates between islands.

entry: 目击POKENAME之后，往往便会发生大规模毁灭。看见它的人，最好做好迎接战争的准备。
author: _testrun_
source: Sightings of POKENAME are often followed by mass destruction. Those that spot it are advised to prepare for war.

entry: 它们成大群穿行夜空。若惹怒它们，还会招来远比它们危险的存在的怒火。
author: _testrun_
source: They travel as large groups in the night sky. Provoking them will bring about the wrath of far greater threats.

entry: 野生POKENAME是最常遭捕食的宝可梦之一。不过，它也能轻易从对方掌握中溜出，迅速飞走。
author: .ssunday.
source: Wild POKENAME are one of the most preyed on of Pokémon. However, it can easily zip away from a Pokémon's grasp and fly away.

entry: 大群野生POKENAME几分钟就能吃光整片农田。农夫常备大量除虫喷雾，以防虫群来袭。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: Hordes of wild POKENAME will eat through entire fields in minutes. Farmers often keep plenty of repels on them to reduce the risk of a swarm.

entry: 繁殖季节，POKENAME会跳舞吸引同类，再大肆捕猎，补回跳舞消耗的能量。
author: .realthree
source: During its mating season, POKENAME dances to attract others of its kind. It hunts voraciously to resupply the calories it spends on dancing.

entry: 它能像螺旋桨一样旋转翅膀，将花粉和种子洒遍大片区域。
author: Staghorn
source: It can spin its wings like a propeller, allowing it to cover wide areas in its pollen and seeds.

entry: POKENAME会俯冲向对手，打出猛烈重击。拳头由厚厚的特殊甲壳质构成，这种材质此前从未发现。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME fights by swooping down on opponents, delivering devastating blows. Its fists are made of a thick, previously undiscovered kind of chitin.

entry: 精灵球工匠钢铁为了精进制作新球的技艺，在尝试中首次创造了这种融合宝可梦。
author: funkytomate
source: This fusion was first created by the Poké Ball expert Kurt, during his attempts of perfecting his craft of forging new Poké Balls.

entry: 它栖居静水，清除过量藻类。有POKENAME生活的池塘，总是清澈见底。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon lives in still waters and clears the excessive algae from them. The ponds where POKENAME lives are always crystal clear.

entry: POKENAME总欢快地飞过树林，想找谁一起在叶丛里玩耍。飞行时，身后会出现彩色的树叶。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME always cheerfully flies through the woods, looking for someone to play with in the leaves. When it flies, colorful leaves appear behind it.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛摸起来像最柔软的草，却容易带静电。想摸它，就得在舒服与挨电之间冒个险。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: Wool from a POKENAME feels like the softest grass, but is prone to static electricity. Petting it is risk versus reward.

entry: 它仅靠光合作用就能生存。晒太阳时，叶状毛发的尖端会开出红色与洋红色花朵。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It can subsist solely on photosynthesis. When sunbathing, the tips of its leaf-like hairs will bloom into red and magenta flowers.

entry: 根状触手能在片刻间吸干整座池塘。POKENAME只要吸足水，便能几个月不用补充。
author: mx_wellman
source: Its root-tentacles are powerful enough to drain an entire pond within moments. If full, a POKENAME can survive months without water.

entry: POKENAME照料森林与植物，播撒种子，让遭森林大火摧毁的地方重新长出绿意。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME are caretakers of forests and plant life, spreading seeds to help regrow plants in places lost to forest fires.

entry: POKENAME是老练的猎手，藏在大片海草中，用高压水流狙击猎物。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert predators. They hide themselves within large amounts of seagrass and snipe their prey with pressurized water.

entry: 这种POKENAME警觉敏锐，拼死守护森林。一有异动，就能迅速利用周围材料组出武器。
author: char_latte3412
source: This vigilant variant of POKENAME guards its forest with its life. If it spots a disturbance, it can quickly assemble a weapon from its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME与林中枝叶融为一体，用自制木弓从远处袭击，十分机敏，懂得随机应变。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME camouflages into forest foliage, and strikes from afar using a wooden bow it crafted. It displays remarkable wit and adaptability.

entry: POKENAME是强大的植物法师，吟诵魔法咒文，以自然之力压倒敌人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful phytomancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to overwhelm foes with the power of nature.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在密林深处，为生病的野生宝可梦配药。据说它们能理解植物的灵魂。
author: Quote.lass
source: POKENAME prefer to stay deep in forests so that they might craft medicine for sick wild Pokémon. They're said to understand the souls of plants.

entry: POKENAME低头摆尾，邀请同伴玩耍，增进感情。黄色花朵也兴奋地迸着电火花。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME will bond with its pack through play by lowering its head and swishing its tail, its yellow flower crackling with eager electricity.

entry: 它主要靠光合作用获取能量，常会沐浴日光，安然休息。身体健康的POKENAME，尾尖的花也开得更大。
author: char_latte3412
source: It relies primarily on photosynthesis for energy, often basking in sunlight to rest. A healthy POKENAME boasts a larger flower at the end of its tail.

entry: POKENAME凭可爱的脸让人放下戒心，带走独自走进森林的孩子。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With the help of its cute face, POKENAME carries away children who wander off into the forest.

entry: POKENAME骄傲而忠诚，会巡视森林，确保环境安全洁净。奔跑时，皮毛中的叶子还会产生清新空气。
author: Mistymagius
source: A proud and loyal Pokémon. POKENAME scout the forest to make sure the area is safe and clean. The leaves in their fur produce clean air when they run.

entry: POKENAME常在花园晒太阳。心情好时，若被抚摸皮毛，就会散发类似猫薄荷的气味。
author: KitArchen
source: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, basking in the sunlight. If in a good mood, they will smell similar to catnip when their fur is stroked.

entry: 它熟练运用光合作用，藏身岩石间伪装。毫无戒心的登山客，常把它当成普通巨石。
author: anarchaz
source: Mastering photosynthesis, it camouflages itself among rocks, often mistaken for mere boulders by unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴引来爱吃海藻的鱼。幸好，这些鱼大多正是它的猎物。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME uses its tail to attract seaweed-favoring fish. Thankfully, most of these fish happen to be its prey.

entry: 它周围的温度会降至摄氏零下12度，走过之处还能生出细小冰刺。
author: watermelonchild
source: The temperature around this Pokémon drops down to -12°C. It is able to form small ice spikes in its path while walking.

entry: 为免过热，它会将周围空气降至冰点。结果所到之处，都会掀起巨大暴风雪。
author: Soup1900
source: To keep itself from overheating, it will freeze the temperature around it. This, however, causes massive blizzards wherever it passes.

entry: 人们常以为POKENAME把头缩进了雪白皮毛，其实不然，真正的头正是那团雪毛本身。
author: qwertyelephant
source: People often see POKENAME's head as being tucked into its snowy fur, but they are mistaken, as the real head is the snowy fur itself.

entry: POKENAME背上的晶体虽由纯冰构成，摸起来却很烫。它们是温顺友善的伙伴。
author: theartemis1
source: Despite being made of pure ice, the crystals on POKENAME's back are hot to the touch. They are known to be docile and friendly companions.

entry: 耳朵帮助它们调节体温。包袱里存着的树果，还能制成冰棒。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Their ears help them regulate their body temperature. The berries they keep in their bundle can be made into ice pops.

entry: POKENAME是强大的冰霜法师，吟诵魔法咒文，便能将敌人封进冰中。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A powerful cryomancer, POKENAME uses magical incantations to freeze foes in ice.

entry: POKENAME有独特的战法，将冰与火运用得恰到好处。灼烧与冰冻交替出击，凶猛得难以招架。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style equally balancing fire and ice. Its brutal combination of burning and freezing strikes makes it tough to face.

entry: POKENAME靠冻结湖泊练习能力。对寒冷的掌控十分高超，无论什么气候都能做到。
author: zic
source: POKENAME practices its abilities by freezing lakes. Its prowess with the cold allows it to do this no matter what climate it is in.

entry: POKENAME格外爱玩，又很护着别人。它喜欢把冰晶塑成各式形状与花纹，让人看得入迷。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME is an unusually playful yet protective Pokémon. It enjoys fascinating others by creating various shapes and patterns from ice crystals.

entry: POKENAME的本体能冻结周围空气，造出雪花、可射出的冰刺，以及自己的剑刃。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's main body can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow, icy spikes which can shoot off as projectiles, and its blade.

entry: POKENAME能冻结周围空气，制造雪或冰晶，射向对手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow or ice crystals it can fire at opponents.

entry: 刀刃虽由冰构成，却极其坚硬锋利。一斩就能将敌人劈成两半，同时冻住周围空气。
author: adrian151
source: Despite being made of ice, its blade is very hard and sharp. One slash of it can slice a foe in half and freeze the surrounding air simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找当初丢弃自己的人。传说它潜伏在冰冷荒原，等着毫无防备的旅人。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME relentlessly search for those who discarded it. Legend says it lurks in icy wastelands, awaiting unsuspecting wanderers.

entry: POKENAME用摄取的电力织网。谁若被网缠住，就会遭受冰寒的电击。
author: keksalot2000
source: POKENAME uses electricity it consumes to produce its webs. This web inflicts a freezing shock to whoever it ensnares.

entry: POKENAME在体内储存强大的火焰能量，留待迎敌。不过蓬松的皮毛，摸起来却冰冷刺骨。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.

entry: POKENAME在体内储存强大的火焰能量，留待迎敌。不过蓬松的皮毛，摸起来却冰冷刺骨。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.

entry: 在野外遇到POKENAME，最好别打扰。否则，这个冰冷孤僻的家伙就会将尖锐冰锥指向你。
author: Lådan
source: If you find a POKENAME in the wild, it's best to leave it be, or this cold introvert will point sharp icicles in your direction.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: 一名飞行员曾获一群POKENAME引到安全处。此后，合众第181空降部队的徽章上便有了它们的形象。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: An airman was once guided to safety by a horde of POKENAME. Ever since then, they have been featured on the insignia of the 181st Unova Airborne.

entry: POKENAME将翅膀裹住身体，先快速爬行，再跃向空中，滑翔扑向目标。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will wrap their wings around themselves to slither faster before launching into the air and gliding to their target.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: CaramelDog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: CaramelDog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME会两只一组，协同狩猎。一只用爪子抓住猎物，另一只则用带刺的尾巴猛砸。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME are pack hunters that work in twain. One will grab their prey with their claws, while the other bashes it with their barbed tail.

entry: POKENAME轻松穿行海空。猎物才看见巨大的阴影，便被裹住，注入毒素。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME effortlessly soars through both the skies and the sea. Prey only see its large shadow before they are enveloped and injected with toxins.

entry: 颈间的袋子分泌滑溜的油脂，既能使电荷偏转，也能防止沙子黏进毛里。
author: mx_wellman
source: Its neck pouch produces slick body oils that deflect electric charges and prevent sand from gathering in its fur.

entry: POKENAME在明亮处很难看清，因此常闭着眼，靠超能力辨识方向。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能找到优质矿物，制成勺子。借这些勺子，POKENAME便能以惊人速度挖出新洞穴。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.

entry: 它用爪子藏着一颗奇怪圆珠。据说凝视太久的人，就会成为POKENAME的猎物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Hiding a strange orb with its claw, it's said anyone that gazes into the orb for too long will become a POKENAME's prey.

entry: 鼻孔喷出冰冷气体。吸入后会遭受严重冻伤，随后还会出现更严重的感染。
author: moopse
source: Freezing cold gas pours from its nostrils. Those who breathe in this gas will suffer severe frostbite, along with a worsened after-infection.

entry: 在这颗星球最严寒的地方，也发现过POKENAME群。雄性拥有更大的獠牙和尖刺，守护正在孕育后代的雌性。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME herds have been recorded in the coldest places on the planet. Males sport greater tusks and spikes to defend the child-bearing mothers.

entry: 人们以为POKENAME在冰河时代已灭绝，其实它们只是在深水中沉睡了10,000年。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: It was thought that POKENAME went extinct during the ice age, but it turns out they were sleeping deep underwater for 10,000 years.

entry: POKENAME曾是远古冰河时代的顶级猎手，聪明得懂用其他宝可梦的残骸制作武器。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME was an apex hunter during an ancient ice age. It has the intelligence to create weapons using remains of other Pokémon.

entry: 獠牙终于长成，让POKENAME更加强壮。可獠牙也碍了事，再也没法自在地蜷身滚动。
author: ruminino
source: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.

entry: 獠牙终于长成，让POKENAME更加强壮。可獠牙也碍了事，再也没法自在地蜷身滚动。
author: ruminino
source: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.

entry: 天气转暖时，POKENAME的冰翼会融化，让它无法飞行。它便会沉睡到下个冬天，或迁往更冷的地方。
author: kittyluv090
source: During warmer months, POKENAME's icy wings melt, making it unable to fly. It will either hibernate until next winter or migrate to a colder climate.

entry: 冰制缎带如极光般飘舞。它优雅地展示缎带引来对手，再用獠牙猛撞。
author: missingmilkman
source: Its icy ribbons dance and flutter like an aurora. It uses elegant displays to entice opponents, then rams them with its tusks.

entry: POKENAME身体凹槽里的冰，移动得如冰川般缓慢。冷得连POKENAME踩过的泥地，也会结冻。
author: .realthree
source: The ice moving through the grooves on POKENAME's body moves at a glacial pace. It's so cold to the touch that the mud POKENAME stomps through freezes.

entry: 温暖的皮毛与敞开的巨口，对暴风雪中的人仿佛是庇护所。可只要走进去，就会被POKENAME夺走生命力。
author: char_latte3412
source: Its warm hide and gaping maw appear as a sanctuary to those caught in blizzards. However, POKENAME will steal the vitality of any who venture inside.

entry: 如今的POKENAME几乎看不出曾有强大冰牙的痕迹。有理论认为，是体内的火焰将它们熔化了。
author: char_latte3412
source: Modern-day POKENAME bears little evidence of its once-mighty ice tusks. Theories suggest the flame burning within its body has melted them away.

entry: 这种POKENAME曾在冰河时代繁盛一时，凭体内烈火，熬过史上最严酷的寒冬。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME thrived during the ice age, enduring the harshest winters in history thanks to its fierce internal flame.

entry: POKENAME伪装成普通墨海马，骗取训练家的信任。一有机会，就接管训练家的全部设备。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME preys on Trainers' trust by disguising itself as a regular Horsea. When given the chance, it will take control of all of a Trainer's devices.

entry: POKENAME常出现在感染恶意软件的电脑上，声称能免费提速。不过，最好别喂养它们。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME are frequently found on malware-infected computers, offering to speed up your PC for free. It's not recommended to feed them.

entry: 这个聪明程序借强大科技，操纵着一具形似灭绝物种、由凝实光芒构成的躯体，自己却始终安全。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Utilizing potent technology, this clever program puppets a hard-light creation shaped like an extinct species, keeping itself safe all the while.

entry: 有人试着替这只宝可梦升级，却出了差错，导致部分资料损坏。如今，它身体的两边常常自己打起来。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: An upgrade was attempted on this Pokémon, but something went wrong and it got partially corrupted. The two sides often fight with each other.

entry: 它用垃圾数据裹住身体，保护内部的真实数据。这招虽有效，却会占用寄居电脑的大量存储空间。
author: Soup1900
source: It covers itself in garbage data to protect the real data inside. While this strategy is effective, it uses a lot of storage on the computer it's in.

entry: 它进入哪台电脑，就会令哪台过热。沿途的数据也会熔毁，损坏得无法再用。
author: Soup1900
source: It will overheat any computer it enters. Any data it passes through will melt, corrupting it and making it unusable.

entry: 一次异常的软件更新开始流传。下载后，POKENAME就开始给毫无戒心的训练家发送暗藏恶意软件的消息。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: An unusual software update began circulating. Upon downloading it, POKENAME began delivering messages with hidden malware to unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME是极其强大的恶意软件，连数字世界与物质世界都能一并破坏。
author: Napstabl0ok
source: POKENAME is such a powerful piece of malware that it is capable of corrupting both the digital and material world.

entry: POKENAME对训练家执念极深。为了不被放生，会将自己附着在关键文件上。
author: zic
source: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.

entry: POKENAME现身时，软件会出现仿佛时间错位的故障。人们尝试利用这种效果，却仍未成功。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME's appearance causes software to glitch in ways consistent with temporal displacement. Attempts to harness this effect have yet to bear fruit.

entry: POKENAME是名副其实的电脑巫师，站在抵御网络破坏的前线，锁定与扰乱数据，对它而言轻松如呼吸。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A quite literal computer wizard, POKENAME is used as a frontline against net-based sabotage, pinning down and scrambling data as easy as breathing.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在绘画和游戏程序里，将软件的全部代码拿走，编进自身程序。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME loves to hide in art and game applications. It takes all the code from the software, and incorporates it into their own.

entry: POKENAME会攻击所有靠近训练家的人，简直像想独占自己的训练家。
author: mercury_sc
source: POKENAME attacks whoever approaches its trainer. It's almost as if it wants its trainer for only for itself.

entry: 周围变化不定的雾气，让POKENAME几乎难以辨识。直接盯着它看，就会头痛恶心。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is near impossible to comprehend thanks to the unstable haze around it. Looking at it directly causes headaches and nausea.

entry: POKENAME对电磁波极其敏锐。比起物质世界的一切，它更能看清电子设备中的数据。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is highly sensitive to electromagnetic waves. Its eye can see data on electronic devices more clearly than anything in the physical world.

entry: 它预示软件寿命的终结。体内回荡着无数古老程序的余音，乞求再获一次机会。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The harbinger of EOL for software. Echoes of countless programs of ages past can be heard from within, begging for another chance.

entry: 为了打造终极武器，人们又给POKENAME打上更多补丁。可这把剑别扭得很，既难挥舞，连看着都不舒服。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME was further patched with the intent of making the ultimate weapon. However, the sword is too awkward to wield or even look at.

entry: 程序原为缩小文件体积而设计，错误却让它把比特本身切开，反倒产生更多垃圾数据。
author: Soup1900
source: Its program was designed to cut down file size, but a programming error caused it to cut the bits themselves, resulting in more garbage data instead.

entry: 它是实验室事故留下的融合宝可梦，也是自身经历的众多错误与崩溃的具现。
author: inagine1.
source: This fusion is the aftermath of a lab accident. It is the manifestation of the many errors and crashes it has suffered through.

entry: 它是等离子队一次失败实验的产物，只懂毁灭，胡乱开炮，所过之处什么都不剩。
author: Soup1900
source: An experiment by Team Plasma gone wrong. It only knows destruction, firing its cannon randomly and leaving nothing behind.

entry: 电脑程序最早的“臭虫”，真的是困在机器中的虫属性宝可梦。POKENAME记起往事，又回归了起点。
author: r.isk
source: The first bugs in computer programming were literal Bug-types trapped in the machinery. POKENAME has remembered and returned to its roots.

entry: 它是广受欢迎的游戏破解装置，却有时会擅自往游戏里注入恶意代码，造成永久损坏。
author: T.I.A.
source: A popular device made to hack games, they are sometimes known to inject malicious code into them by themselves, resulting in permanent damage.

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: Soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: Soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 代码出错，使超声波夹杂着沙沙噪声。这种冲击破坏力极强，被许多人称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: Soup1900
source: A coding error caused it to emit static noise from its ultrasonic waves. These blasts are called static booms by many since they're very destructive.

entry: 耳朵发出的杂音，能损坏附近电子设备的软件。靠近POKENAME的设备，最好先关机。
author: ragtagbags
source: The static noise this Pokémon emits from its ears can corrupt the software of nearby technology. Devices near a POKENAME should be powered off.

entry: 多边兽Ｚ更新成传说宝可梦雷吉艾斯的身体时，竟“冻”住了，当场死机蓝屏。基础安全机制，仍能让POKENAME继续运作。
author: entomoxie
source: Porygon-Z, when updating to the body of the legendary Regice, froze and blue-screened. Base-level safety measures can still keep POKENAME operational.

entry: 它一心热衷赚钱和做交易，却似乎只收一种鲜为人知的加密货币。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon that simply loves to make money and deals. It only seems to accept money in the form of an obscure cryptocurrency, however.

entry: 你知道吗？POKENAME体内总在建立数据库，收录趣闻与冷门知识，再把它们转化为实实在在的力量。
author: cyprexx
source: Did you know? A POKENAME is always developing an internal database of "fun facts" and niche information. It converts this into raw physical power.

entry: POKENAME的几个头各自独立行动。可POKENAME性情反复无常，往往会自己闹起内讧。
author: T.I.A.
source: The heads of a POKENAME act and move independently of each other. However, the erratic nature of POKENAME usually results in infighting.

entry: POKENAME破坏周围现实，构成一个并非圆形的防护壳。壳无法被感知，藏在后方的一切也同样无法察觉。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME corrupts reality around itself to form a nonround protective shell. The shell can't be perceived, yet neither can anything behind it.

entry: POKENAME是活生生的电脑病毒，程序腐坏又满怀恶意，连附近的人与宝可梦都会因此严重偏头痛。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A living computer virus, POKENAME's programming is so corrupt and malicious that it can even cause nearby humans and Pokémon severe migraines.

entry: 它把树果稳稳顶在头上带回巢穴。白天忙着采集，夜里则尽情饱餐。
author: .izik
source: It will balance berries on its head and bring them back to its nest. It spends the daytime gathering and the evenings gorging on its finds.

entry: 它在树洞中藏着大量树果。谁若伸手偷，就会被钳子夹起来扔走。
author: cait_sith
source: It keeps large stashes of Berries in tree hollows. Anyone who tries to steal from it will be thrown by its pincers.

entry: 它藏在大树冠层，突然落向林地上毫无戒心的猎物。角只有在即将蜕皮时，才会开花。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It hides in the canopy of large trees and drops on unsuspecting prey on the forest floor. Its horns only flower when it's ready to molt.

entry: POKENAME藏在树上，用柔韧如叶的棍棒守护领地，被认为是森林的守护者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from the trees with its flexible, leaf-like club. It is said to be a guardian of the forest.

entry: 体内塞满棉花般的物质。这些填充物极其易燃，一点火星就能点着。
author: .izik
source: Its body is stuffed with a cotton-like substance. The innards are highly flammable and ignite at the smallest spark.

entry: 它不停在树枝间跳跃觅食。甜树果，为它带来用不完的精力。
author: cait_sith
source: It constantly leaps from branch to branch in search of food. A diet of sweet Berries gives it boundless energy.

entry: POKENAME在背上培育蘑菇，帮助自己栖居的森林。蘑菇长得太大时，就摘下来吃掉。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME cultivate mushrooms on their backs to help the forests they live in. When the mushroom gets too big, this Pokémon removes and eats it.

entry: 有些POKENAME没有虫类口颚，而长着小巧的下颚，用来啃食水果与树果。POKENAME与背上的蘑菇相互共生。
author: totodile.
source: Some POKENAME have a small jaw to feed on fruits and Berries instead of insect mandibles. A POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with its mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME给种子裹上营养粉，再种下，让树林重新繁茂。它们能轻松爬上任何表面。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME replenish their wooden groves by coating seeds with nourishing powders and planting them. They can climb any surface with ease.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间，等猎物靠近便冲出去。游泳时，头冠很容易被误认成香蒲。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME hides amongst the trees until its prey wanders close, then charges. When swimming, its crest is easily mistaken for a cattail.

entry: POKENAME借身上长出的叶片吸收阳光，为预知能力积蓄能量。
author: Glacierwing
source: Using the leaves that grow out of their body, POKENAME gather sunlight to charge their precognitive powers.

entry: 它们夜里成群捕猎，借茂密枝叶掩护。有时会跟踪同一目标数小时，才终于出手。
author: admiralvermin
source: They hunt in groups at night, using dense foliage for cover. They've been observed stalking single targets for hours before they finally strike.

entry: POKENAME住在高山湖泊旁，常改变睡觉习惯，有时在湖里打盹，有时又在树顶休息。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can be found by mountain lakes. It will often change its sleeping habits, sometimes dozing in the lake and other times at the tops of trees.

entry: POKENAME手持叶刃，以额外叶片伪装，借灌木掩护，凶狠地保护林中树木。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: With a leaf blade and additional leaves used for camouflage, POKENAME brutally protects the forest's trees with cover of the underbrush.

entry: POKENAME培育种子、修剪枝叶，照顾森林植物。多出的刀刃，也让它成为凶悍的守卫。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: With its ability to grow seeds and prune plants, POKENAME cares for the forest's flora. With its additional blades, it is its vicious defender.

entry: POKENAME的叶状甲片坚韧如钢，还锋利得能砍倒大树。它们借此毁树，标记自己的领地。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaf-like plating is a durable as steel. They are also sharp enough to cut large trees, which they destroy to mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME快速飞过炎热沙漠觅食，凭眼上的透镜，看穿猛烈的沙暴。
author: mr.yveltal69
source: It flies swiftly over hot deserts in search of food. POKENAME uses the lenses on its eyes to see through strong sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME快速飞过炎热沙漠觅食，眼上的特殊透镜，能保护双眼免受风沙侵袭。
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv
source: It flies swiftly over hot deserts in search of food. POKENAME have special lenses covering their eyes to protect them from sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME是丛林的顶级猎手，以惊人速度掠过树冠，俯冲扑向毫无戒心的猎物。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is the apex predator of the jungle. With its astounding speed, it soars across the treetops and swoops down on unsuspecting prey.

entry: 一颗小行星坠入丛林后，POKENAME出现了。它能改变基因结构，适应恶劣气候，捕捉猎物。
author: NellNast42
source: After an asteroid landed in the jungle, POKENAME emerged. It is able to alter its genetic structure to adapt to the harsh climate and catch prey.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强。即使入侵者在森林另一端，POKENAME也能凭耳朵察觉，几秒便追上对方。
author: Alphamerican
source: POKENAME is a very territorial Pokémon. Using its ears, POKENAME can detect an intruder on the other side of its forest and hunt them down in seconds.

entry: POKENAME爱肆意嘲弄自认比自己弱的家伙。不过碰到更强的敌人，也会毫不犹豫地迎战。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME cheekily taunts anyone it deems weaker than itself. With that said, it doesn't hesitate to take on stronger foes, too.

entry: POKENAME背上的硬刺带有微毒。察觉危险时，就会蜷成一团，滚下沙丘。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME protects its back with hard spines that have a weak poison. If it senses danger, it curls up and rolls down the dunes.

entry: 它掘出水下洞穴睡觉，也挖地道穿行于湖泊间，寻找食物或伴侣。人们认为，这会引发地震。
author: fishaccoon
source: It digs itself underwater caves to sleep in, and tunnels to travel between lakes searching for food or mates. This is thought to cause earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME在沙中游动，宛如在水里，毫无预兆地伏击猎物。强劲的爪子，连最坚固的铠甲也能切开。
author: Eye Of Cthulhu
source: POKENAME swims through sand as if it were water, ambushing prey with no warning. Its claws are strong enough to cut even the toughest of armors.

entry: POKENAME伏着等猎物游过，再用尾端尖刺将其刺穿。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME lies in wait until its prey swim by. Then, it skewers them with the spines at the end of its tails.

entry: 背上的花与叶坚硬，能保护POKENAME，还能分泌使人虚弱的毒素，用来毒倒来袭者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The flower and its leaves on its back are hard and protect POKENAME. They allow it to secrete debilitating toxins, which it uses to poison attackers.

entry: 天气转暖时，尾巴反而会变冷、裹上冰层，帮助它调节体温。
author: .izik
source: During warmer weather, its tail gets cold and becomes covered in ice. This helps it regulate its body temperature.

entry: POKENAME若冷得过头，尾巴上的头就会暖起来，让尾部的冰瞬间融化。
author: .izik
source: If a POKENAME becomes too cold, the head on its tail warms up. This causes any ice on the tail to instantly melt.

entry: 它住在遍布岩石的荒地，靠速度与利爪驱走威胁。即使野生的怪颚龙，也会绕开POKENAME的领地。
author: Staghorn
source: It lives in rocky badlands, using its speed and claws to drive away potential threats. Even a wild Tyrantrum will avoid a POKENAME's territory.

entry: 它有“嗜血化身”的绰号，却很容易让人误会。其实性情温顺，人们也只见过它吃蜂蜜。
author: elwafflejr
source: This Pokémon's nickname is "Bloodlust Incarnate". This is a misleading nickname however since it is very docile and only been seen eating honey.

entry: POKENAME是圈圈熊类中少数不冬眠的宝可梦。虽然奇特，却也更容易遭到毛皮猎人的捕杀。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is one of very few Ursaring species to not hibernate. While interesting, this unfortunately makes it vulnerable to fur hunters.

entry: 野生POKENAME胆小得很。任何人或宝可梦一旦靠得太近，它就会从袋子里掏出沙子、小石块，拼命扔过去。
author: vic1312
source: Wild POKENAME are incredibly cowardly Pokémon and will fling sand and small rocks from their bag at any Pokémon or humans who get too close.

entry: 它醒着时几乎都在晒太阳，为捕猎节省精力。出击时飞快掠过猎物身边，以背刺将其划伤。
author: PokePower
source: It spends nearly every waking hour sunbathing. It conserves its energy for taking down prey, which it slashes with its spines as it rushes past.

entry: POKENAME捏出含水量高的泥球，先充入电流，再把尾巴当球棒，将它们击向对手。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME forms clay balls with a high water-content so it can electrify, then propel them at opponents using its tail as a makeshift bat.

entry: 它用超能力掀起沙暴，遮挡刺目的阳光。踩过松软沙丘，也分毫不会下陷。
author: hampterbychoice
source: This Pokémon stirs up sandstorms with its psychic powers to guard itself from harsh sunlight. It walks across unstable dunes without sinking an inch.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物十分坚硬，雨水再少也能提供足够养分，还能分泌强毒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The vegetation on its back is hard. It provides POKENAME with sufficient nutrients even when there is little rain and can also secrete strong poison.

entry: 沙漠神庙中游荡的POKENAME，当初究竟属于神庙守卫，还是盗墓贼，研究者仍有争论。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Researchers disagree on whether POKENAME haunting desert temples once belonged to the temple's guards or its robbers.

entry: 受威胁时，它会蜷成球，用缎带猛抽。一昼夜内，能向地下挖掘最深10公里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When threatened, this Pokémon will curl into a ball and lash out with its ribbons. It can dig up to 10 kilometers deep in a single day and night.

entry: 野生POKENAME蜷身滚下沙丘，试图压碎猎物。铲子般的爪子里，含有使人衰弱的毒液。
author: kingd8
source: In the wild, POKENAME will curl into a ball and roll down sand dunes, attempting to crush prey. Its shovel-like claws contain a debilitating venom.

entry: 它的利爪足以凿穿岩石，常会走过大片水域，寻找食物。
author: b_megamaths
source: Its claws are strong enough to dig through rock. It will often walk across large bodies of water to find food.

entry: 野生POKENAME常互相拌嘴。一只生气了，就想掀起沙暴，让另一只也跟着生气。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME in the wild are usually found bickering with each other. If one gets mad, it tries to start a sandstorm to make the other one mad too.

entry: 长爪一挥，便能切开坚石。它会不知疲倦地挖掘数小时，寻找可供吸取养分的软土。
author: .izik
source: Its long claws can cut through sturdy stone in a single swipe. It will dig for hours without tiring to seek soft soil for nourishment.

entry: 天冷时，背上粗刺会伸长，隔绝寒意。到了夏天，整身尖刺都会重新长出。
author: .izik
source: The thick spines on its back extend during cold weather to insulate it from the low temperature. During the summer, the spines will regrow entirely.

entry: 脖子很长，头能伸出最远3英尺，够到食物。POKENAME睡觉时，又会把头完全缩回洞口里。
author: .izik
source: Its neck is quite long; the head can extend up to 3 feet to reach food. When a POKENAME sleeps, it will retract its head completely into the opening.

entry: 悬浮空中时，它发出响亮的嗡嗡声。不过最高，也只能浮到10英尺。
author: .izik
source: It emits a loud buzzing noise while levitating through the air. However, it is unable to levitate higher than 10 feet.

entry: POKENAME蜷成一团，以向外竖起的尖刺自保。攻击者只要被扎到，就会陷入睡眠。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME curls up into a ball to defend itself, pointing its spikes outwards. Being pricked by one can put any attacker to sleep.

entry: POKENAME没有腿，踢不了对手，简直懊恼透顶。战斗时只好依靠自己产生的火焰与爆炸。
author: Cascadeguy
source: POKENAME is frustrated to no end by its lack of legs and inability to kick. It instead relies on the flames and explosions it produces in combat.

entry: POKENAME利爪燃烧，性情冰冷凶悍，是可怕的对手，能轻松绕过敌人，凭力量将其压倒。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's blazing claws and icy ferocity make it a fearsome adversary, capable of outmaneuvering and overpowering foes with ease.

entry: POKENAME飞在敌人上方高处，喷射极热的火焰。如名字所示，它十分好斗。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME flies high above its enemies, firing extremely hot blasts of fire. As its name suggests, it loves to fight.

entry: POKENAME兼具火焰鸡的烈火与快拳郎的拳力。炽热踢击猛烈，迅疾的重拳更足以碎骨。
author: Sheogorath
source: Fusing Blaziken's blaze with Hitmonchan's punch, POKENAME unleashes devastating fiery kicks alongside fast bone-crunching punches.

entry: POKENAME拿山岳当沙袋锻炼，再下海降温。铠甲散出的热量，曾被误认成深海热泉。
author: hampterbychoice
source: To train, POKENAME use mountains as punching bags before cooling off in the ocean. Their armor releasing heat have been mistaken for deep-sea vents.

entry: POKENAME深知自己力气与耐力出众，谁敢挑战，它都会兴高采烈地迎上去。
author: togetik
source: Conscious of its superior strength and endurance, POKENAME happily approaches any who dare to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME是由自身炽烈意志锻成的火焰剑盾。踢击会将目标灼伤，烈焰斩击更会留下烧伤与刀口。
author: Sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a blazing sword and shield, forged from its own fiery spirit. Its kicks scorch, while fiery slashes leave both burns and gashes.

entry: 金属双臂与灼热刀刃融为一体，POKENAME跳起烈焰战舞。踢击灼人，锋利挥斩则让对手既被割伤，又遭火烫。
author: Sheogorath
source: Metal arms fused with searing blades, POKENAME dances a fiery war dance. Its kicks scorch, while razor-sharp swipes leave opponents sliced and singed.

entry: 飞行时，燃烧的鳞粉会散落大地。若看见几处小片焦草，就知道POKENAME正在附近。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon's fiery scales scatter over land as it flies. If you see several small burnt patches of grass, you know a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: 四只火拳释放熊熊怒火。POKENAME的每记武术攻击都带着灼热，烈焰烧得如斗志般明亮。
author: Sheogorath
source: Four fiery fists unleash a blazing fury. POKENAME's martial arts scorch with each blow, its inferno burning as bright as its fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME常在活火山边冥想，将热量吸进摆锤。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME often spends time meditating at the edge of active volcanoes, where it absorbs the heat into its pendulum.

entry: 它是顶级猎手，既能在陆地与空中捕猎，独特的羽毛结构还让它能高速潜水。
author: Sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is an apex predator. It can hunt on land, in the sky, and it can dive at high speeds due to the unique composition of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在河底淤泥中，用毛发察觉水中的变化，寻找猎物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME buries itself in the mud at the bottom of rivers. It uses its hairs to sense changes in the water and find prey.

entry: POKENAME个头虽不大，双爪却能举起巨石。它以尾巴抓住敌人，再用猛烈的水枪攻击。
author: beespoon
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is strong enough to lift boulders with its claws. It grasps foes with its tail, and then hits them with a fierce Water Gun.

entry: POKENAME在林间湖泊附近休息，只露出头冠。身上裹着层层泥浆，干后便让外壳更坚硬。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME rests near forest lakes with only its crest exposed. It coats itself in layers of mud which, once dried, harden its shell.

entry: POKENAME常见于温泉中，喜欢用身体裹住伤处，帮助伤口愈合。
author: ElioNagashi#0173
source: POKENAME can be found in hot springs. They like to wrap themselves around wounds to help them heal.

entry: POKENAME擅长游泳，流畅的身体破水前进，时速近35英里。主要以湖中原生水草为食。
author: char_latte3412
source: An adept swimmer, POKENAME's sleek body can cut through water at nearly 35 mph. It mainly feasts on aquatic vegetation native to lakes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢陪小型水宝可梦玩耍。遗憾的是，它实在太重，有些小伙伴没能活下来。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME loves to play with smaller Water-type Pokémon. Sadly, some of those smaller Pokémon don't survive because of POKENAME's weight.

entry: POKENAME让看见它的人心生恐惧，可它其实只想在夜里引人走出沼泽。
author: ElioNagashi#0173
source: POKENAME strikes fear in the heart of those who see them, even though they only want to help them find a way out of swamps at night.

entry: 它靠泥浴保持皮肤光滑明亮，头上的触须能辨识泥浆的种类与状态。
author: Soup1900
source: It keeps its skin smooth and shiny by bathing itself in mud. The feelers on its head are used to tell both the type and condition of the mud.

entry: 它能在陆地短暂蹦跳，从一个泥洼移到另一个。在浑水中游动的速度，却快得惊人。
author: snescontroller
source: It can bounce on land for a short time, traveling from one mud puddle to another. It moves through murky waters with surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME埋进泥里时，只露出几片鳍，用来感知周围林下草丛的动静。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME buries itself in the mud, all that sticks out are its fins. It uses these fins to sense disturbances in the undergrowth around it.

entry: POKENAME虽是海中高手，偶尔也会在陆地休息，或在空中飞行。
author: dragonzzilla
source: Though a master of the sea, POKENAME is occasionally seen resting on land or flying through the air.

entry: 身体密实，入水便迅速下沉，能沿河床步行。想浮上水面时，单凭强健肌肉也能轻松游回。
author: VaporVenator
source: Its dense body sinks quickly underwater, allowing it to walk along river beds. It can easily swim back to the surface through sheer muscle strength.

entry: 它挥动巨手，把硕大的滚烫水球掷向敌人。除非想挨一身烫伤，否则，还是别惹它为妙。
author: homelessrager
source: It uses its giant hands to throw massive spheres of scalding water at foes. It is recommended to not anger it, unless you want to get burnt.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓能用来制作久久肥。藤蔓修剪后，尖端会先变深绿，再重新长出。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME's vines are used in the production of Stable Mulch. When the vines are trimmed, the tips become a darker green before growing again.

entry: POKENAME常笨手笨脚地撞上东西。虽然不会受伤，POKENAME却还是觉得很烦。
author: Weirdtux
source: POKENAME are often seen clumsily tripping into things. While this does not hurt them, POKENAME still find it annoying.

entry: 它总是开心又好奇。若察觉附近有负面情绪，就会赶快找地方藏起来。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It always seems to be happy and curious. If it senses negative emotions nearby, it quickly finds a place to hide.

entry: POKENAME顽皮放肆，常爱捉弄人。别看个头不起眼，咬击却能致命，缠住后也很难挣脱。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is a cheeky, playful Pokémon that often plays tricks on people. Despite its size, its bites are quite deadly and its grip is hard to escape.

entry: POKENAME轻轻舔舐空气，就能“尝”出周围宝可梦的情绪。若尝到喜欢的滋味，它就高兴得蹦蹦跳跳。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME can taste the emotions of surrounding Pokémon by feebly licking the air. If it tastes an emotion it likes, it bounces about with glee.

entry: 它们讨人喜欢却缺少自信，据说拥有所有融合宝可梦中最甜美的笑容。但只会向信任的训练家展颜。
author: Quote.lass
source: While they lack the confidence, these charming Pokémon are said to have the sweetest smile of any fusion. They only smile for Trainers they trust.

entry: POKENAME用护手感知敌意，总是尽力避开冲突。即使信任的人想拿它进攻，它也不愿配合。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME senses hostility with its guard and goes out of its way to avoid conflict. It even avoids being used offensively by people it trusts.

entry: POKENAME对周围情绪极其敏感。一旦察觉恐慌，就必须尽快将它扔回海里，才能使其平静。
author: theradrad
source: POKENAME has a high sensitivity to surrounding emotions. If it senses panic, someone must throw it into the ocean as quickly as possible to calm it.

entry: POKENAME皮毛柔软，又能辨识情绪，因此十分受欢迎，许多人视它为理想的家庭伙伴。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME are very popular. Many people consider them an ideal Pokémon to raise around a family for their soft coat and ability to recognize emotions.

entry: 它厌恶愤怒，因为共感会让这种情绪化成身体上的痛楚。只愿接近它认为平静的人。
author: Skymaster426
source: It despises anger, due to its empathy causing physical pain when it experiences said emotion. It will only approach those it sees as calm.

entry: 它常在林中优雅起舞，其实是在为未来忧虑，想借此清空纷乱思绪。
author: birchbot
source: It can be found dancing around in the woods gracefully. It is actually trying to clear its mind as it worries about its future.

entry: POKENAME像小宝可梦的大姐姐，常逗弄它们。它会先吓跑人，再用目光将人引回来。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME acts like a big sister to smaller Pokémon, often teasing and toying with them. It scares people away, but draws them back in with its gaze.

entry: POKENAME到哪儿，都有一个古怪的自身分身相伴。那分身看似有几分开朗，其实满怀敌意。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: A POKENAME is accompanied by an odd clone of itself wherever it goes. Despite its somewhat cheerful look, the clone itself is hostile.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃划开次元裂隙，窥见未来。持有者心情越好，它的战斗表现也越出色。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade can cut open dimensional tears to see into the future. It fights better when its wielder is in higher spirits.

entry: POKENAME有两个大脑，分别在头与背部，使超能力得到增强。触须还能感知附近人的情绪。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The psychic power of POKENAME is amplified by its two brains-one in its head and one in its back. Its feelers can sense the emotions of those nearby.

entry: 它靠超能力稳定重心，不管滚得多晕，都能直立停下。爆炸还会令人心神迷乱。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its psychic center of gravity lets it settle upright no matter how dizzy it grows from rolling about. Its explosions dazzle the mind.

entry: POKENAME有四只眼睛和蜘蛛般的下半身，吓坏许多人。它虽想帮忙，却总让人避之不及。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: With four eyes and the lower half of a spider, POKENAME is a frightful sight to many. Though it tries to be helpful, many are scared away by it.

entry: 它是建筑大师。一找到合适地点，就会吐丝织出由桥梁、巢穴和复杂陷阱组成的高效网络。
author: VaporVenator
source: A master architect. Once it finds a suitable area, it spins its webbing to build a remarkably efficient network of bridges, nests, and complex traps.

entry: 穿过它栖居树林的人，称它为“蜘蛛女王”。它用蛛网包扎伤口，也为小宝可梦搭建住所。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.

entry: 穿过它栖居树林的人，称它为“蜘蛛女王”。它用蛛网包扎伤口，也为小宝可梦搭建住所。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.

entry: 穿过它栖居树林的人，称它为“蜘蛛女王”。它用蛛网包扎伤口，也为小宝可梦搭建住所。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.

entry: 许多人视POKENAME为死亡之灵。它的面容既有异样之美，也有死亡可怖的真实。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Many believe POKENAME to be a spirit of death, its visage split between the alien beauty and terrifying reality of the idea.

entry: POKENAME会用触手拥抱自己怜爱的人。可那些吸盘抓得牢牢的，让人很难脱身。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME will embrace anyone it feels compassion toward with its tentacles. Many find it hard to escape its suction-cupped grasp.

entry: POKENAME的催眠术与致命咬击令人畏惧。它渴望陪伴，却可悲地总将伙伴变成石头。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.

entry: POKENAME的催眠术与致命咬击令人畏惧。它渴望陪伴，却可悲地总将伙伴变成石头。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.

entry: POKENAME的强效神经毒素，能在目标脑中制造强烈幻象。它喜欢幻化出惊恐的孩子，让敌人放下防备。
author: naga_sake
source: A POKENAME's potent neurotoxin can create powerful illusions in the mind of a target. It prefers to disarm an enemy with illusions of scared children.

entry: POKENAME是岩浆与热情的化身，明亮火焰如虹彩般闪耀，触及的一切都会被吞噬。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is the embodiment of magma and passion. Its bright glowing flames shine like rainbows and consume all that they touch.

entry: 融合技术还未普及时，人们曾把POKENAME当作蛇发女妖。古老传说称，POKENAME的目光能将生灵石化。
author: Hypersonic06
source: POKENAME were once believed to be Gorgons before fusion was commonplace. Old legends claimed that POKENAME's gaze could turn creatures to stone.

entry: POKENAME优雅又危险。催眠般冰冷的目光，曾将无数生灵化作雕像，陈列在自己的住处。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.

entry: POKENAME优雅又危险。催眠般冰冷的目光，曾将无数生灵化作雕像，陈列在自己的住处。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.

entry: POKENAME优雅又危险。催眠般冰冷的目光，曾将无数生灵化作雕像，陈列在自己的住处。

source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.

source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
