source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.

author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.

entry: POKENAME出现在防护不足的网站，诱使人们点击。一旦点下，POKENAME便会将有害病毒送进对方电脑。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME appears on unprotected websites, luring people into clicking on it. If they do, POKENAME will release harmful viruses into their computer.

entry: POKENAME在肉搏与超能力战斗上都天赋异禀，一心寻求严苛锻炼磨练本领，许多训练家反而难以满足它。
author: Phantom640
source: A prodigy in both physical and mental combat, POKENAME seeks out rigorous training to hone its skills. This can make it a challenge to train for many.

entry: POKENAME极少被人目击，曾一度被尊为神明。环绕身边的符印，检测不到生物特征信号。
author: JokersWild
source: Since sightings of POKENAME are so rare, it was once hailed as a deity. The sigils that surround it have no biometric signature.

entry: 它凭四个大脑与心脏预见危险。训练家若受威胁，就会竭尽全力保护。
author: LemGambino
source: It uses its four brains and hearts to foresee danger. If its Trainer is threatened, it will protect them with all its might.

entry: 有人报告，在废弃工业区见过POKENAME。虽然与多起失踪案有关，它看上去却颇为温和。
author: seaslux
source: Reports exist of POKENAME appearing in abandoned industrial complexes. Despite being linked to multiple disappearances, it is apparently gentle.

entry: POKENAME冲锋时以超能力推动身体，速度如汽车，撞击力却如卡车。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME propels itself forward with psychic force as it charges. It is capable of ramming with the force of a truck and the speed of a car.

entry: 它借超能力悬浮半空，伸出幽影般的手，向迷失的灵魂招手，诱它们投入自己缥缈的怀抱。
author: anarchaz
source: Suspended by psychic energy, it lures lost souls with spectral hands, beckoning them into its ethereal embrace.

entry: 数百年来，POKENAME被尊为爱与慈悲之神。据说它用1000条手臂，创造了宇宙中一切美好。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME has been revered as a deity of love and compassion for centuries. It's said it created all that is good in the universe with its 1,000 arms.

entry: POKENAME以超能力预知未来。若看见持有者将有危险，就会挥刃劈开黑洞，保护对方。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to see into the future, and if it sees its wielder is in danger, will slice open a black hole in their defense.

entry: POKENAME用超能力幻象躲开人类。若与训练家建立深厚感情，就会不惜一切守护对方。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes psychic illusions to hide itself from humans. If it becomes close to its Trainer, it will do everything its power to protect them.

entry: POKENAME平时冷静沉着，能完全控制力量。可一旦专注被打断，就会狂暴肆虐。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is generally level-headed and composed, fully capable of controlling its power. Should its focus be broken, it will rampage violently.

entry: POKENAME被奉为时间、忠诚与慈悲之神。为保护最深爱的人，甚至不惜改写历史。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is worshipped as the deity of time, loyalty, and compassion. It will go so far as to rewrite history to protect the ones it loves most.

entry: 目光连最勇敢的战士也能震慑，恐惧气场更是压倒一切。只有承受得住的人，才能见到它温柔的本性。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its eye is capable of cowing even the bravest warrior, its aura of dread overwhelming. Only those who bear it can witness its rather gentle nature.

entry: POKENAME常制造融入超能力的强效毒素，制服敌人。中毒后往往会偏头痛、行动迟缓。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME often subdues its foes by creating a powerful toxin infused with psychic power. Symptoms often include migraines and sluggish movement.

entry: POKENAME用毛发监测周围的精神能量，察觉危险，因此格外在意头发是否干净。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME's hair lets it monitor the surrounding psychic energy to detect danger. Because of this, it's very sensitive about keeping its hair clean.

entry: 即使有人嘲笑POKENAME，它仍为自己的外貌和久经磨练的强大本领自豪。
author: togetik
source: Some may ridicule POKENAME, but it is proud of both its appearance and its long-honed, immense prowess.

entry: POKENAME外貌可怕，角又锋利，令人畏惧。可若学会爱护POKENAME，就会得到一位强大的终生伙伴。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is feared due to its frightening appearance and sharp horns. Those who learn to love POKENAME will receive a powerful companion for life.

entry: POKENAME曾是贵族出身的人类。某天困在暴风雪中，醒来便成了POKENAME。白色和服，象征着它的高贵身世。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME was once a human of noble descent. Trapped in a snowstorm one day, it awoke in the form of POKENAME. Its white kimono indicates its nobility.

entry: POKENAME曾是沙奈朵，为了保护训练家而牺牲在暴风雪中。它寻找并靠近女性旅人，结果总把她们吓跑。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME was once a Gardevoir who gave its life for its Trainer in a blizzard. It seeks and approaches female travelers, only to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME曾是沙奈朵，为了保护训练家而牺牲在暴风雪中。它寻找并靠近男性旅人，结果总把他们吓跑。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME was once a Gardevoir who gave its life for its Trainer in a blizzard. It seeks and approaches male travelers, only to scare them away.

entry: 融合唤醒了POKENAME潜藏的本能，使它成为狡猾残酷的猎手。就连解除融合后，沙奈朵也改不了乱咬东西的毛病。
author: seaslux
source: When fused, POKENAME's latent instincts are unlocked to make an cunning and brutal hunter. Even if it unfuses, the Gardevoir won't stop biting things.

entry: POKENAME用魅力引来目标，再从嘴里释放集中的超能力噪声，令对方晕头转向。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME lures victims in with the its charms. It then disorients them by unleashing concentrated psychic noise from its mouth.

entry: 真菌彻底控制了这只沙奈朵，使它沦为工具，用超能力引来更多宿主，让真菌继续蔓延。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Overwhelmed by fungus, this Gardevoir has become nothing more than a tool, psionically drawing in others to become hosts for the fungus to spread.

entry: POKENAME每个头的性格都截然不同。中等大小的那个，尤其痛恨最大的头。
author: themicelegion
source: Each head of POKENAME has a completely different personality. The medium sized head absolutely hates the largest head.

entry: POKENAME以醒目的粉红火焰和优雅美貌闻名。极少现身，穿过森林时如精灵，也如幽魂。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are well known for their striking pink flames and elegant beauty. They are a rare sight, dashing through forests like like fairies or ghosts.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集人类的各式新奇小玩意。它盼着能长出腿，亲自探索人类世界。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME enjoys collecting human gadgets, gizmos, and thingamabobs. It wishes to have legs so it can explore the human world.

entry: 它长得很像阿罗拉的西狮海壬，喜欢躺在冰川上晒太阳，也爱照顾小鱼宝可梦。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It bears a striking resemblance to Primarina from Alola. It enjoys basking on glaciers and caring for small fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME既精通战斗艺术，也深谙礼仪。它能用双镰迅速一击，劈开任何障碍。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME is a master of both the art of combat and etiquette. With a single swift strike, its scythes cleave through any obstacle.

entry: 未知图腾聚在一起传递讯息时，若其中出现POKENAME，就代表需要保护。
author: .realthree
source: When Unown come together to deliver a message, the presence of a POKENAME in the group is a sign denoting the need for protection.

entry: 这种POKENAME长着古代文字的字母形态，常被发现凝望海的另一方。
author: .realthree
source: This POKENAME takes the form of letters belonging to an ancient language. It is often found staring across the sea.

entry: POKENAME十分无私。比它弱小的家伙一有危险，它就常为了相助，让自己陷入险境。
author: inksans201x
source: It's selfless nature often leads POKENAME into dangerous situations when those weaker than it are in trouble.

entry: 它通常生活在山区，凭超能力与速度，能轻易躲开天敌。
author: Patch
source: It is usually found within mountainous regions. It can easily evade predators due to their psychic powers and speed.

entry: 对正义的强烈渴望驯服了POKENAME的野性，让它成为英勇的英雄。不过，它有个坏习惯，总爱在战斗中摆出英雄姿势。
author: Leshii
source: Its wild nature tamed by an overwhelming desire for justice, POKENAME is a gallant hero that has a bad habit of striking heroic poses mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME与另一个地区的特殊现象有所关联。它用强劲的肘刃和超能力，保护无辜者。
author: Scigaming
source: POKENAME shares a connection to another region's local phenomenon. It uses its strong elbow-blades and psychic power to protect the innocent.

entry: POKENAME是能读懂对手想法的格斗高手。凭先知先觉的迅速行动，它会保护对手，也保护需要帮助的人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: An expert fighter able to read its opponent's thoughts, POKENAME protects its opponent and those in need with predictive haste.

entry: POKENAME十分强大，却从不发挥全部潜力。它懒得很，喜欢长时间打盹，可被逼入绝境时也十分危险。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME is quite powerful, but never uses its full potential. It is lazy and enjoys long naps, but can become dangerous when pushed into a corner.

entry: POKENAME住在拳击手形状的外壳中。先以快如闪电的连拳进攻，再忽然停住动作休息，连半空中也不例外。
author: EggSaladologist
source: POKENAME inhabits a shell in the shape of a boxer. It uses lightning-fast flurries of punches before freezing mid-motion to rest, even in mid-air.

entry: 许多人相信POKENAME是僵尸。它便利用传闻，以现身时引发的恐惧为食。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Many believe POKENAME to be a zombie. It uses this rumor to its advantage, feeding off the terror it creates by its presence.

entry: POKENAME看似只有空壳，里面不断漏出液化的铁面忍者。可铁面忍者其实还活着，才是真正的本体！
author: shining_joot
source: POKENAME appears to be nothing more than a husk with a liquified Ninjask leaking from it. The Ninjask, however, is alive and is the real Pokémon!

entry: 据说训练家将一只表现不佳的皮卡丘遗弃森林，神秘力量随后附在它身上，便诞生了POKENAME。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It's said that POKENAME formed when a Trainer abandoned their underperforming Pikachu in a forest, and it became possessed by a mysterious force.

entry: 人们相信，这是脱壳忍者最初的形态。也有人推测，它拥有天使般的力量。
author: zerocipher
source: It is believed that this is the original form of Shedinja. Some speculate that this creature has angelic powers.

entry: 洞孔深不见底，漆黑一片。曾有传说称，古代文明为了窥视彼岸，才将其造出。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The hole is endlessly deep and perfectly black. It was once said to have been created by an ancient civilization to try and peer into the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME无休止地漫游世界，解放受腐化的灵魂。正义感极强，体魄也超乎凡俗。
author: lynkinator
source: POKENAME wanders the world endlessly, liberating corrupted spirits. It possesses a profound sense of justice and otherworldly physical prowess.

entry: 据说POKENAME吸收了被自己击败的敌人的灵魂，反被其附身。如今必须再败一敌，才能解脱并将那个灵魂封住。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is said to have absorbed the soul of its fallen foe, who now possesses it. It must now defeat another foe to free itself and trap that soul.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃锋利得能切开一切，却又异常易碎，实在难以使用。
author: b_megamaths
source: The blades of a POKENAME are sharp enough to cut through anything. However, they are exceptionally brittle, making them hard to use.

entry: POKENAME如同灵魂的死神，引领死者，也寻找那些尚未死去的生灵。
author: mors_martii
source: POKENAME acts as a grim reaper for souls, guiding those who have died and finding those who have yet to perish.

entry: POKENAME飘过荒原，吸取四周一切的能量维生。身体完全中空，却充满电力。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME floats through wastelands, sapping energy from everything around it to fuel itself. Its body is completely hollow and full of electricity.

entry: POKENAME似乎不会发声，却十分仁慈，会将月之力传给同伴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appears to be incapable of vocalization, but it shows considerable kindness by channeling the power of the moon into its allies.

entry: 它借着月光，在夜里为迷路的旅人引路。
author: naga_sake
source: This Pokémon guides lost travelers during the night, by the light of the moon.

entry: 月食时，成群POKENAME围成圆圈，向天空挥舞魔杖，仿佛正举行某种仪式。
author: kittyluv090
source: On lunar eclipses, groups of POKENAME will assemble in a circle while waving their wands towards the sky, as if performing a ritual of some sort.

entry: POKENAME无论如何搜寻，都找不到能完美替代遗失宝石的那一颗。拼命挖掘，连利爪也渐渐磨损。
author: paisleylxl
source: No matter how much POKENAME searches, it never finds the perfect match for the gem it has lost. Its claws erode as it digs desperately.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾是引魂者，以歌声送亡魂前往彼岸。如今，却以听见歌声者的灵魂为食。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: Legend says POKENAME was once a guide who used songs to send spirits off to the afterlife. Now, it feeds off the souls of those who hear its song.

entry: 只有一张喙会动，两颗心脏也仅有一颗跳动。另一颗头，却诡异地一动不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: Only one of its beaks moves, and only one of its two hearts actually beats. The second head remains eerily still.

entry: POKENAME看似大钳蟹蜕下的壳。它从眼里喷水分散注意，再横着爬走。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME appears to be the molted shell of a Krabby. It sprays water from its eyes as a distraction, and then it scuttles away.

entry: 它几乎全盲，靠耳朵感知四周。察觉敌人时，就会向其他种子发出警告。
author: .izik
source: It is almost completely blind, relying on its ears to sense its surroundings. If it detects an enemy, it will warn the other seeds of the danger.

entry: POKENAME会避开泥泞处吃草，以免弄脏蹄子。蹄子本身，还能制成营养粉。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will avoid grazing in muddy areas to keep its hooves clean. The hooves themselves can be used create a nutritious powder.

entry: 背后喷出的毒液无法长久维持液态，温度高得几秒内便会蒸发成气体。
author: char_latte3412
source: The toxic liquid spewing out its back cannot be maintained for long. This poison is superheated and evaporates to gas within seconds.

entry: 极少数尼多兰进化后，仍会保留幼年特征。究竟由何种因素引起，仍然未知。
author: Staghorn
source: Rarely, a female Nidoran retains its juvenile traits when it evolves. The factors that cause this to occur remain unknown.

entry: 传闻POKENAME曾是尼多兰，被一位憎恨该物种的疯狂铸剑师锻造成活剑，模样仿佛饱受折磨。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's seemingly tortured form is rumored to have once been a Nidoran, forged into a living sword by a deranged swordsmith who hated the species.

entry: POKENAME用锋利刀刃在树木和岩石上刻划。每只POKENAME都有自己偏爱的独特符号。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will use its sharp blades to cut into trees and stones. Each POKENAME has a unique symbol that they prefer to carve.

entry: 天敌来袭时，POKENAME会用缎带捆住对方，猛拉过来，撞上自己身上的毒刺。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: If attacked by a predator, POKENAME will latch its ribbons onto its attacker and slam them into the poisonous barbs on its body.

entry: 女孩常在森林里发现POKENAME，它很快就会与她们亲近。虽极力保护饲主，却从不向她们显露真身。
author: HoundRyS
source: Girls often find POKENAME in forests, and it quickly bonds with them. They are protective of their keeper, never revealing their true form to them.

entry: 尖刺极其锋利。传说古代铁匠会将这些尖刺熔化，铸成刀刃。
author: .izik
source: Its spikes are extremely sharp. Legends state that blacksmiths from long ago would melt their spikes down to create blades.

entry: 它夜里活跃，用锐利门牙采食树果。白天则从叶片分泌毒液自保。
author: synaesthesis
source: It roams actively at night, foraging Berries with its sharp front teeth. It protects itself during the day by secreting poison through its leaves.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎无法察觉。它们常藏在树上伪装，避开烈箭鹰等天敌。
author: .ssunday.
source: A wild POKENAME is almost impossible to spot. Often times, they hide up in the trees then camouflage away from predators like Talonflame.

entry: 它能改变体色，飘到周围环境的高处，再用能抓握的尾巴或长鞭般的舌头捕食。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It can change its color and float high above its surroundings, using its prehensile tail or whip-like tongue to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能适应各种环境。适应力加上速度，让它成为海陆两处都难缠的猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME effortlessly adapts to any environment. Its adaptability and speed makes it a formidable predator in both land and sea.

entry: 野外的POKENAME看起来像一袭飘浮的幽灵裙装。整个身体，却始终靠伪装藏着。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: In the wild, POKENAME appear as ghostly dresses floating in the wild. Its full body is constantly concealed with its camouflage abilities.

entry: 它模仿环境，与周围浑然一体。适应力虽强，独处时却会感到不安。
author: anarchaz
source: Mimicking its environment, it blends seamlessly with its surroundings. Isolation triggers unease in this adaptable creature.

entry: POKENAME融入周围环境，悄悄接近毫无戒心的猎物。用来抓小拉达，也很受欢迎。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME camouflages itself with its surroundings, sneaking up on unsuspecting prey. It's very popular as a trap for Rattata.

entry: POKENAME摆出各种姿势融入环境。时机一到，就用头猛撞目标，造成巨大伤害。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME assume various poses to blend into their environment. When the time is right, they rush at targets with their head to deal colossal damage.

entry: POKENAME伸出刀刃斩击对手。头部颜色，会随环境或心情改变。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade extends to slice its opponent. Its head's color adjusts to its surroundings or mood.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛能变色、带电，都可用于战斗。可也因独特皮毛常遭捕猎，如今已所剩无几。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME fur has color-shifting and electric properties that it uses in battles. Not many are left since it's frequently hunted for its unique fur.

entry: 它变换色泽，悄然融入环境。花瓣散出的毒香，则能驱退入侵者。
author: anarchaz
source: It shifts hues to blend seamlessly into its environment. Its petals exude a toxic perfume, warding off intruders.

entry: 尾巴、舌头、利爪与强健身体，都是POKENAME迅速穿行丛林的帮手。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's tail, tongue, claws, and powerful body all assist in allowing this Pokémon to quickly traverse through the jungle.

entry: 它隐入背景，吞食人和宝可梦的噩梦。若做了噩梦，却忘记内容，那便是被POKENAME吃掉了。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Blending in with the background, it eats the bad dreams of people and Pokémon. If you had a bad dream but forgot what it was, POKENAME has eaten it.

entry: POKENAME几乎完美模仿了大力鳄，将真脸藏在双颚里。它并不主动捕猎，只用这副模样吓退威胁。
author: barthandelus_real
source: POKENAME's near-perfect imitation of Feraligatr, in which it hides its true face in its jaws, serves as a deterrent, as it doesn't actively hunt prey.

entry: POKENAME从夜空精确观察四周。钢铁身体与敏锐头脑，让它成为夜幕下的老练猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME precisely scans its surroundings from the night sky. Its steel body and keen intellect make it an adept hunter under the cover of darkness.

entry: POKENAME能不停歇地往返月球无数次，为人类研究月之石的形成提供宝贵线索。
author: Rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME can journey from the moon and back countless times without a break. It provides humans valuable information on how moonstones are created.

entry: 细胞既有磁性，又没有固定形态。铁质身体能随意变形，可遇到强磁铁时，就会难以行动。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's cells are magnetic and amorphous. Its ferrous body can change shape at will, though it struggles to move when around powerful magnets.

entry: 科学家曾用基因之楔融合两只铁哑铃，试图人工造出金属怪。实验却彻底失败。
author: Faelocke
source: Scientists attempted to artificially create a Metang by fusing two Beldum with DNA Splicers. The experiment was a resounding failure.

entry: 人们将额外一只铁哑铃与金属怪融合，想让它更强。可融合过程出了缺陷，整体实力反而下降。
author: Faelocke
source: An extra Beldum was fused with Metang in an attempt to make it stronger. However, an imperfection in the fusion process made it weaker overall.

entry: 融合失误，让五个大脑无法同步，结果比普通巨金怪弱得多。
author: Faelocke
source: Due to an error in the fusion process, the five brains of this fusion are out of sync. It is much weaker than a regular Metagross as a result.

entry: POKENAME成队捕猎，以磁脉冲交流。攻击时，主要靠磁力把对手拉向自己的刀刃。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hunt in companies and communicate with magnetic pulses. They attack primarily by magnetically pulling opponents onto their blades.

entry: 它凭胸前透镜看见红外光。合众的侦探会用这种能力，精准追踪罪犯。
author: .izik
source: It can see infrared light with the lens on its chest. Detectives in Unova use this ability to track criminals with great precision.

entry: 它轻易便能望见数英里外的事物。搜救队常靠POKENAME，寻找灾难中的幸存者。
author: .izik
source: Its eye can see for miles with little effort. Search and rescue units utilize POKENAME for locating survivors of disasters.

entry: POKENAME使用与地磁相斥的磁力，还能操纵这股力量，强化拳脚攻击。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME uses a magnetic force that repels Earth's magnetism, and it can manipulate that force to empower its punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME在海底四处寻找油藏。虽性情温顺，受挑衅时却很危险，常会惊动大群同伴。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME scour the ocean floor looking for oil deposits. Although docile, they are dangerous when provoked, often alerting a swarm.

entry: POKENAME在海中搜集废金属与杂物。它们性情回避，却常把其他宝可梦也当成杂物。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME scour the ocean collecting scrap metal and debris. They have avoidant natures, but often mistake other Pokémon for debris.

entry: POKENAME头大又沉，飞到半空总失去平衡，摔向地面。可它们似乎并不介意。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME have such big and heavy heads that they constantly lose their balance mid-flight and crash to the ground. They don't seem to mind.

entry: 这只宝可梦的磁性身体能自由流动，在空中疾速飞行。它还能借助超能力，将金属吸收进自己的身体。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's free-flowing magnetic body can fly through the air at rapid speeds. It can use psychic power to assimilate metal into itself.

entry: 两只POKENAME的身体虽已成功融合，大脑却未能相连，因此远比“真正的”巨金怪弱。
author: Faelocke
source: While the two POKENAME's bodies were successfully fused, their brains have not linked up. As a result, this is far weaker than a "true" Metagross.

entry: 多出的爪子有助捕猎，战斗时却不太听使唤。这是因为相连的大脑失去了平衡。
author: Faelocke
source: The extra claws aid this fusion in hunting its prey, but tend to be unwieldy in battle. This is due to an imbalance in their linked brains.

entry: 钻探的巨水母四周，常成群聚着POKENAME，也有与铁水母结伴的。它们领地意识极强，装备着激光与利爪。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME are often seen in packs around drilling Metacool or paired with Belcool. They are very territorial and armed with lasers and claws.

entry: POKENAME对其他宝可梦充满敌意。庞大的铁甲水母钻探石油时，它们会成群护在周围——小心那些武器！
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME are hostile to other Pokémon and swarm defensively around their hulking Metacruel as it drills for oil. Beware their armaments!

entry: POKENAME的强大磁力连最尖锐的獠牙也能弹开。敌人根本无法穿过力场，咬到它闪亮的金属身体。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Able to repel even the sharpest fangs via powerful magnetism, it's impossible for foes to bite POKENAME's shiny metal through the shield of its force.

entry: 它借水流推进，以坦克炮弹般的速度射出手臂。手臂若被毁，POKENAME就会寻找铁哑铃替换。
author: VaporVenator
source: It uses water propulsion to fire its arms with the velocity of a tank shell. When an arm is destroyed, POKENAME searches for a Beldum to replace it.

entry: 它以机械强化的毒刺传播极其危险的瘟疫。是否仍拥有自己的意志，目前尚不清楚。
author: PepperThePirate
source: It spreads an incredibly dangerous plague with its mechanically augmented stingers. It is unclear whether or not this Pokémon has a will of its own.

entry: POKENAME思考得比超级电脑更快。它凭这份智慧与带磁的身体，精准破坏电力系统。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME can think faster than a supercomputer. It uses this intellect, and its magnetically charged body, to precisely sabotage electrical systems.

entry: 强劲的爪子与双颚，能碾碎坚硬岩层。它们的领地意识极强。
author: mrbapcik
source: Its powerful paws and jaws crush hard rock formations. They are highly territorial Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME聪明而残忍，会用四条幽灵手臂猛烈殴打对手，即使受害者已经昏厥也不停手。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is as intelligent as it is cruel. Using its four spectral arms, it pummels its opponents violently, even after its victim has fainted.

entry: 这种POKENAME酷似某款游戏中的钢铁军阀，在帕底亚地区颇受喜爱。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME bears striking resemblance to an iron warlord from a certain video game. It is beloved in the region of Paldea.

entry: POKENAME放出花粉般的纳米机器，分析周围环境，借此在脑中构成三维战场地图。
author: LordKai1
source: POKENAME expels pollen-like nanomachines to help analyze its surroundings. This process allows it to mentally visualize a 3D map of the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME以带爪双翼翱翔高空，身后留下鲜红轨迹，因此有“赤色彗星”之称。
author: Nyaarys
source: POKENAME's clawed wings leave bright red trails as it flies high in the sky. These trails have given this Pokémon its nickname, the Crimson Comet.

entry: 维持悬浮而喷涌的能量，足以为一座小镇供电。它在空中如火箭般疾行，像彗星一样撞向猎物。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The energy rushing out to keep it aloft could power a small town. It rockets through the air, slamming itself into prey like a comet.

entry: POKENAME操纵金属爪，宛如它们本就连在身体上。举起的物品，能超过自身体重的三倍。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME can move its metal claws as if they were attached to its body. It can lift objects that are over three times its weight.

entry: POKENAME的四条金属手臂，出拳比高速列车还快。别与它对视，否则它会以为你在向它挑战。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can use its four metallic arms to punch faster than a bullet train. Do not make eye contact with it as it will see you as a challenge.

entry: 无与伦比的智慧，也未能平息POKENAME的怨恨。它周密谋划，想报复当初伤害自己的人。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Incomparable intelligence has not soothed POKENAME's grudge. It makes elaborate plans to get back at the ones who originally wronged it.

entry: POKENAME借连接身体的锁链，猛力甩动金属腿，大幅增强穿透力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use its connective chains to swing its metal legs with a lot of momentum, which greatly increases their penetrating power.

entry: POKENAME是救灾用的机械奇迹，尤其擅长辨识失踪者，主要以富含矿物质的水作为燃料。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME is a mechanical marvel used for disaster relief, particularly in identifying missing people. Mineralized water is its main fuel.

entry: 它是西尔佛公司的秘密战争机器。踏上前线时，几乎势不可挡。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Silph Co.'s secret machine of war. When on the frontlines, this Pokémon is nearly unstoppable.

entry: 传闻POKENAME来自外星，会在海底四处钻采石油。受到打扰时，石油便从钻井处泄漏，危害生态。
author: cyprexx
source: Rumored to be extra-terrestrial, POKENAME drill for oil across the ocean floor. When disturbed, oil spills from their site, harming the ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME被认为是来自太空、为石油而来的巨型入侵者。登陆时，身边跟着庞大的融合军团，分别由金属怪与玛瑙水母、金属怪与毒刺水母融合而成。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME is thought to be from space, a gargantuan invader here for oil. They arrive on beaches with huge invading forces of Metcool and Metcruel.

entry: POKENAME脏了就到小池塘或水洼里打滚，洗净身体。身上的藤蔓若干燥，就会一簇簇脱落。
author: .izik
source: When dirty, a POKENAME rolls in a small pond or puddle to get clean. If the vines on its body dry out, they will fall off in clumps.

entry: 森林里那些木制机关，其实都是POKENAME搭建的。有人见过它对着一只水箭鸭，独自絮说悲惨的往事。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: Any wooden contraptions found in the forest are actually built by a POKENAME. It is seen monologuing to a Blastfetch'd about its tragic past.

entry: 融合唤醒了POKENAME休眠的基因。它用斧头伐树，为数十户大牙狸家庭筑起水坝。
author: catsoup02
source: This fusion awakened a dormant gene in POKENAME. It uses its axes to cut down trees to build dams for dozens of Bidoof families.

entry: POKENAME采集筑坝木材的本领已炉火纯青。受到攻击，也能将手斧化为危险武器。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has perfected its ability to procure wood for its dams. If it is attacked, it can use its hatchets as dangerous weapons.

entry: 它总是精力旺盛，常能看见它扛着两根原木，奔向自己居住的水坝。
author: SunnyScarab
source: Name is known to be very hyperactive, as it is often seen carrying two logs of wood to the dam that it lives in.

entry: 它心不在焉地啃着自己的毛发，让不断生长的牙齿与长毛都不至于失控。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It gnaws absently on its own hair, keeping its ever growing teeth and locks at bay.

entry: 它能同时用两对眼睛观察。因此年幼的POKENAME，光是走路也可能晕得难受。
author: .izik
source: It sees through both pairs of eyes simultaneously. Because of this, young POKENAME can get motion sickness by just walking.

entry: POKENAME是伐树高手，双臂奇妙地长得像电锯。据说连整片森林也能砍光。
author: catsoup02
source: POKENAME is an expert at cutting down all sorts of trees. Its arms, strangely, resemble chainsaws. It's rumored to be able to cut entire forests down.

entry: POKENAME的电锯双臂，既是实用工具，也是危险武器，很受伐木工人欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can use its chainsaw arms as useful tools and dangerous weapons. They are popular partner Pokémon for lumberjacks.

entry: POKENAME脖子虽细，却能整个吞下球果。只吃一颗，就能撑过一整周。
author: .izik
source: Despite its tiny neck, a POKENAME can swallow an apricorn whole. It can survive on one apricorn for an entire week.

entry: POKENAME指挥附近的大牙兽群筑坝。据说POKENAME带电的啃咬，足以咬断一棵长成的橡树。
author: SunnyScarab
source: POKENAME commands nearby groups of Bibuzz to build a dam. It's said that POKENAME bites with electricity so it can cut down a fully grown oak tree.

entry: POKENAME看似威风凛凛、无所不能，颇有传说宝可梦的架势，其实也只是两只大牙狸。
author: mirby
source: POKENAME may appear quite intimidating and omnipotent, but despite its legendary looks, it is still just two Bidoof.

entry: 许多人认为POKENAME才是真正的宝可梦之神，力量甚至超过阿尔宙斯，无可匹敌。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Many consider POKENAME to be the true god of Pokémon, more powerful than Arceus itself. Its strength is simply unmatched.

entry: POKENAME痴迷刻划木头与石块。凡是刻上自己印记的东西，都会凶狠地守住。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME obsessively carves wood and stone. It aggressively defends anything it has marked.

entry: POKENAME若见其他宝可梦糟蹋森林，就很容易发怒。可对陷入困境的大牙狸族群，却乐意伸出援手。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can be easily irritated if it spots other Pokémon desecrating its forest. However, they seem happy to help any struggling Bidoof colonies.

entry: 据说POKENAME会啃咬扭曲的空间，甚至在空间中筑坝，封住究极之洞。
author: theradrad
source: POKENAME is said to gnaw at space that has been distorted. It is said to create dams in space to close up Ultra Wormholes.

entry: POKENAME最骄傲的就是坚韧的牙。它啃碎巨石与钢梁，再舔食碎屑，让牙齿保持最佳状态。
author: theradrad
source: Its resilient teeth are its pride and joy. POKENAME gnaws up boulders and steel beams and licks up the shavings to keep its teeth in top condition.

entry: 它时不时就会发呆，此时火焰便渐渐暗下。若没人及时叫醒，火焰就会完全熄灭。
author: Skymaster426
source: It has a habit of spacing out from time to time. When it does, its flame slowly dims, and if not snapped out of the trance, it will burn out entirely.

entry: 据说古代文明创造了它们，目标就是尽可能简单、普通。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by an ancient civilization, with the intent of being as simple and normal as possible.

entry: POKENAME常被用作野生动物保护区的吉祥物。那张滑稽又安然的脸，深受孩子喜爱。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is commonly used as a mascot for various wildlife preserves. Its comically placid face is beloved by children.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱住在林间泥地旁。察觉危险时，就会拍翼威吓附近的来犯者。
author: krsgaming
source: A wild POKENAME likes to live in the woods by mud. Whenever It senses danger it flaps their wings to warn any threats nearby.

entry: POKENAME似乎变得更加油腻自恋。不过缺点归缺点，它给朋友做的披萨，味道可真不差。
author: LordKai1
source: POKENAME appears to have taken on a more greasy and narcissistic persona. Despite its failings, it can cook a mean pizza for those it deems friends.

entry: POKENAME由108个灵魂组成。虽能变成任何模样，最喜欢的还是生前所爱之人的形象。
author: dzygomer
source: POKENAME was formed by 108 spirits. While it can transform into anything, it prefers the shape of its former loved ones.

entry: 它常藏在海中岩缝，耐心等待伏击猎物的好时机。
author: Karma
source: A Pokémon commonly spotted hiding in marine crevices. It patiently waits for the opportune moment to ambush its prey.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现在巷中，不停抛接发光圆球，借此催眠目标，再将其掳走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME appears in alleyways at night. It constantly juggles its glowing balls, which it uses to hypnotize its victims before abducting them.

entry: 花岩怪附身后，POKENAME举止失常，拼命压制着体内的邪恶。心智渐渐崩溃，身体也随之出现裂痕。
author: giggity._.
source: Possessed by Spiritomb, POKENAME acts erratically, desperately trying to keep Spiritomb's evil at bay. As its mind breaks, cracks form on its body.

entry: POKENAME的鸣声，会给求知者带来喜悦，却让追逐权势的人备受煎熬。它被不知名的咒语，封印在一本古书中。
author: dzygomer
source: POKENAME's cries bring happiness to those who seek wisdom, but torment those who seek power. It was sealed in an old book by an unknown spell.

entry: 强大的梦妖魔被封进书中，便成了POKENAME。据说持书者，会饱受耳边声音困扰。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME is the result of a powerful Mismagius sealed into a book. Those who hold the book are said to be vexed by voices.

entry: POKENAME是缚在废弃盆景花盆里的幽灵。目的无人知晓，只是不断游荡，寻找最初的主人。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME is a ghostly entity bound to a discarded bonsai vase. Its purpose shrouded in mystery, it wanders endlessly searching for its original owner.

entry: POKENAME诞生于崩溃社会的废墟，出没在曾奴役自己祖先的工厂中。
author: Thropp
source: Born from the ruins of a failed society, POKENAME haunts the factories that enslaved its ancestors.

entry: 它由108种病毒与恶意程序组成。一旦释放，可能毁掉整个互联网，以及所有相连之物。
author: Soup1900
source: A Pokémon made up of 108 viruses and malware programs. Releasing it could destroy the entire internet and everything connected to it.

entry: 一名疯狂科学家将两只宝可梦融合，想把花岩怪永远封在数字世界。结果却未能如愿。
author: Soup1900
source: A mad scientist fused these two Pokémon, thinking he could permanently seal Spiritomb into the digital world. It didn't work as planned.

entry: POKENAME记仇又小气，用超能力破坏人际关系，一边怪笑，一边啜饮由此产生的痛苦。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME's nature is spiteful and petty. It uses its psychic powers to tear apart relationships, supping on the misery they cause while it cackles.

entry: 或许是受融合邪灵影响，POKENAME常踏上复仇之旅，行事毫不留情。
author: frostedwyrm
source: Possibly due to the evil spirits they are fused with, POKENAME frequently attempt to go on quests for vengeance. They are ruthless while doing so.

entry: 这种POKENAME仍被束缚在楔石上。它会试着向别人预警，却毫不掩饰自己可怕的模样。
author: char_latte3412
source: This form of POKENAME remains shackled to its keystone. It will attempt to warn others of danger but make no effort to hide its ghastly appearance.

entry: 这种POKENAME已挣脱楔石，以别人的不幸为乐。危险来临时，又会躲进阴影。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME has broken free of its keystone. It delights in the misfortune of others and keeps to the shadows when danger arrives.

entry: 据说POKENAME住在冥界海洋的最深处。每一只本身都是一片亡者世界，承载着数千灵魂。
author: captainmodeus
source: It's said that in the deepest depths of the afterlife's seas, POKENAME resides. Each one is an afterlife unto itself, carrying the souls of thousands.

entry: POKENAME由108名士兵的灵魂组成。因生前犯下战争罪行，它们被压入楔石受罚。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is made up of the spirits of 108 soldiers, wedged in an Odd Keystone as punishment for their war crimes.

entry: 它是音乐遗失的灵魂。未曾谱写或未曾问世的歌曲，都在它身上具现，入夜便庄重吟唱。
author: TheHeroicT
source: The lost soul of music. Any song that has never been written or released is embodied in this Pokémon. It sings solemnly at night.

entry: 盾中困着108个邪灵。为了有朝一日获得自由，它们必须成功护住持有者，抵挡攻击。
author: creeps_jr
source: There are 108 evil spirits trapped in its shield. In order to be free one day, the spirits must successfully keep the wielder safe from attacks.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会唤起前世的仇恨与恶意。没人知道，它为何会被锁在楔石上。
author: Mistymagius
source: As POKENAME dances it summons forth its hatred and malice it had in another life. No one knows why this Pokémon was chained to the keystone.

entry: POKENAME被封在冰牢中，十分危险。它嚎叫扭动，焦躁地等待脱困。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a dangerous Pokémon sealed within an icy prison. With howling and writhing, it impatiently awaits its release.

entry: 108个灵魂进入钢铁巨人之中，诞生了这只融合宝可梦。坚不可破的躯壳，赋予它意想不到的力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: One hundred and eight spirits entered a titan of steel to create this fused Pokémon. Its impenetrable body gives it unforeseen powers.

entry: 108人的灵魂凝成POKENAME，四处游荡寻求安息。可超凡的钢铁身体，却让它始终无法如愿。
author: pory
source: The spirits of 108 people given form, POKENAME roams looking to be put to rest. Due to its otherworldly steel construction, it's unable to find it.

entry: POKENAME常在古迹或黑暗森林附近安家。谁若在家旁被POKENAME抓到，就会遭它夺魂。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to make its home near ancient ruins or dark forests. Anyone POKENAME catches near its home will have their spirit stolen from them.

entry: 看似城堡，其实是墓穴。组成它的每个存在，都各有一座墓；更多空墓则等着新住客填满。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: What looks like a castle is in fact a crypt, a grave inside for each of those that make up its existence. More empty graves wait, eager to be filled.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: Cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: Cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 它由不愿往生的格斗属性训练家之魂组成。亡魂化作偶像怪力的模样，继续战斗。
author: dzygomer
source: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of Fighting-type Trainers who refuse to move on. They continue to fight in the shape of their idol, Machamp.

entry: 它只爱丰缘极为罕见的青豌果，其他树果一概不吃。只要拿到一颗，就会欣喜若狂地扭来扭去。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It adores the fleetingly rare Strib Berries that grow in Hoenn—no other Berry will do. It wiggles about in ecstasy when it gets a hold of one.

entry: POKENAME出没于古迹，骨骼因注入波导而发光。忠诚勇猛，肉搏与波导战都很强，深受训练家钦佩。
author: Sheogorath
source: Found in ancient ruins, POKENAME's bones glow with infused aura. Trainers admire its fierce loyalty and strength in physical and aura-based combat.

entry: POKENAME虽没有四肢，却能以纯粹波导凝出新的肢体，运用自如。
author: norskdaedalus
source: Despite being limbless, POKENAME have the ability to create new appendages from pure aura, which they use to great effect.

entry: POKENAME时刻警觉，留意四周。主头一心锻炼，后方的头却只想奔跑。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is ever vigilant, always keeping an eye on its surroundings. While the main head is devoted to training, the rear head only wants to run.

entry: 深度冥想让身体强健如钢。战斗时，还能从双手射出波导冲击。
author: creeps_jr
source: This Pokémon's body is as strong as steel due to intensive meditation. It can fire aura blasts from its hands during combat.

entry: POKENAME能射出高度凝聚的纯粹能量，是十分忠诚的伙伴。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are capable of shooting highly concentrated blasts of raw energy. They are known as very loyal companions.

entry: POKENAME感知波导，如同使用热成像。即使最猛烈的冬季风暴，也能分清敌友。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's aura-reading abilities act like thermal vision. It can tell friend from foe even in the thickest winter storms.

entry: POKENAME身上的火会燃尽接触者的生命精华。它也是精通多种流派的格斗大师。
author: HoundRyS
source: The fire that POKENAME emanates burns the life essence of whatever it touches. It's a master of many fighting styles.

entry: 构成POKENAME波导的火焰，热得足以熔钢，却永远不会伤害心怀正义的人。
author: norskdaedalus
source: Despite being hot enough to melt steel, the flames which POKENAME's aura are made of will never harm individuals with righteous hearts.

entry: 它们虽轻巧细小，勇气与荣誉感却无可比拟。即便毫无胜算，也常奋勇应战。
author: Xephyr
source: Although tiny and light, their fearlessness and honor cannot be overstated. They often enter fights that they have no chance of winning.

entry: POKENAME用波导察觉一切危险，忠心保护训练家。连睡着时，也能防范威胁。
author: .realthree
source: A POKENAME loyally protects its Trainer against all danger, which it senses using aura. This ability lets it guard against threats even while asleep.

entry: POKENAME用波导察觉一切危险，忠心保护训练家。这只的体色，十分罕见。
author: .realthree
source: A POKENAME loyally protects its Trainer against all danger, which it senses using aura. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: 它忠于训练家，相隔很远也能察觉对方是否安好。记住一股波导的气味后，就再也不会忘记。
author: HoundRyS
source: Loyal to its Trainer, it can sense their wellbeing even at long distance. Once it's learned the smell of an aura, it never forgets it.

entry: POKENAME很少成群被人看见。模样酷似某个热门儿童游戏系列中的可怕敌人。
author: Moginar
source: POKENAME have rarely been spotted in groups. They resemble a fearsome foe from a popular children's game series.

entry: POKENAME对波导的掌控增强，四肢也因此更加灵巧迅捷。火焰的威力，不亚于拳头。
author: HoundRyS
source: Enhanced aura control allows POKENAME to move its limbs with much greater dexterity and speed. Its flames are as powerful as its fists.

entry: POKENAME由路卡利欧与怪力融合，兼具波导之力与惊人蛮力，常在山区勤奋锻炼。
author: Sheogorath
source: A fusion of Lucario and Machamp, POKENAME wields both aura powers and immense strength. It trains diligently in mountainous regions.

entry: POKENAME将波导存在岩石身体的核心，导入地下，就能引发强烈地震。
author: _aphoric
source: POKENAME stores up aura in the core of its rocky body. It can cause powerful earthquakes by channeling the aura into the ground.

entry: 这是同一位训练家发动两次超级进化的罕见案例。庞大的能量消耗，让POKENAME承受极大痛苦。
author: Patch_Bros
source: This is one of the very few cases of two Mega Evolutions from one trainer. Due to the massive energy usage, POKENAME is in immense pain.

entry: POKENAME探索水下洞穴，寻找食物与庇护所。凭身体发出的光，越游越深。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME explore underwater caves in search of food and shelter, using their bioluminescence to guide them deeper and deeper into the depths.

entry: POKENAME探索水下洞穴，寻找食物与庇护所。凭身体发出的光，越游越深。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME explore underwater caves in search of food and shelter, using their bioluminescence to guide them deeper and deeper into the depths.

entry: POKENAME总是精力充沛。挡在路上的一切，无论是否活物，都会被它啃咬。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon is constantly energized. POKENAME will bite and gnaw on anything in its path, even if it's a living being.

entry: POKENAME一察觉震动，就会成群钻出，咬向目标。幸好一双结实靴子，就能挡住它们的小牙。
author: Staghorn
source: When POKENAME detect vibrations, they emerge en masse to nip at the target. Thankfully, their tiny teeth can be blocked by a sturdy pair of boots.

entry: POKENAME有着锯齿状的鳍与铠甲般的厚皮，行动震撼大地。雷鸣般脚步加上锐利獠牙，令人畏惧。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME is a ground-shaking force with jagged fins and armored hide. Its thunderous footsteps and razor-sharp tusks make it a fearsome sight.

entry: 它突然扑向敌人，以强劲身体和利爪猛击，再灌入大量电力与龙之能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: It suddenly lunges into its foes, striking them with its powerful body and claws. It injects them with copious electricity and draconic energy.

entry: 它打扮成一位出色的神奥训练家，在其他龙属性宝可梦面前威风凛凛，被视为力量的象征。
author: nasho1908
source: It dresses as a remarkable Sinnoh Trainer to leave an imposing presence among other dragon-type Pokémon. It is considered a symbol of strength.

entry: 它打扮成一位出色的神奥训练家，在其他龙属性宝可梦面前威风凛凛，被视为力量的象征。
author: nasho1908
source: It dresses as a remarkable Sinnoh Trainer to leave an imposing presence among other dragon-type Pokémon. It is considered a symbol of strength.

entry: POKENAME平静时，战斗技巧出神入化。可一旦发怒，就会变得凶狠无情，出手难以预料。
author: themicelegion
source: When calm, this Pokémon uses great skill in the art of battle. However, when enraged, POKENAME will attack ruthlessly and unpredictably.

entry: 它以善战闻名，专猎体型相仿的宝可梦，寻求挑战。
author: themicelegion
source: A Pokémon known for its fighting prowess. It hunts Pokémon of a similar size to it for a challenge.

entry: POKENAME身体虽圆滚，仍能以音速飞行。不过更喜欢用翼状利爪，在洞中爬来窜去。
author: gellyfishsh
source: Despite its rotund body, POKENAME is capable of flying at sonic speeds. However, it prefers to scuttle around caves using its wing-like claws.

entry: 与大嘴娃不同，POKENAME不太爱欺骗，而是自信地追猎比自己大数倍的猎物。双颚连最硬的金属都能咬碎。
author: BerriVine
source: Unlike Mawile, POKENAME is much less deceptive, confidently hunting for prey many times its own size. Its jaws can crush even the toughest of metals.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME鳞片薄而坚硬，加上锋利刀刃，全身上下都是武器。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: Its thin, rigid scales, combined with its sharp blades, makes POKENAME a being whose entire body is a weapon.

entry: POKENAME在山中决斗，争夺支配地位。动作快得两秒内，就能把巨石削成沙粒。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found in the mountains, dueling each other for dominance. It is fast enough to turn a boulder into sand in two seconds.

entry: 身体连睡着时也会自行吸放电力，借积存的能量察觉猎物，以闪电般的速度移动。
author: LemGambino
source: Its body passively absorbs and discharges electricity, even while asleep. It uses this stored energy to detect prey and move at lightning-fast speeds.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋就见什么咬什么。虽忠心耿耿，仍不适合由新手训练家饲养。
author: Fenragon
source: When it gets excited, it bites everything it sees. For this reason, POKENAME should not be trained by fledgling Trainers, despite its loyalty.

entry: POKENAME十分合群，常与其他物种结伴。过度捕猎，却让它已濒临灭绝。
author: Yoshimon
source: This Pokémon is very social and often makes groups with other species. Overhunting has caused POKENAME to be near extinct.

entry: 模样酷似某位宝可梦冠军。究竟是为了讨人喜欢，还是为了吓退训练家，仍不清楚。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: It resembles a certain Pokémon champion. It's unknown if this was so more people would like it, or if it was to serve as a way to scare off trainers.

entry: POKENAME出手迅疾、不讲规矩，先用踢击让敌人踉跄，再以利爪结束战斗。它们好胜得很，最讨厌输。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME are quick, dirty fighters that stagger enemies with kicks before finishing them with sharp talons. They are very competitive and hate losing.

entry: 身体的其他部分都已成熟，背上的种子却毫无变化。科学家认为，它的种子可能一生都会处于休眠。
author: Soup1900
source: Although the rest of its body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of its life.

entry: 它吐出的气体带有热带水果味，却依旧刺鼻。人们说，闻起来就像腐烂的菠萝与木瓜。
author: Xephyr
source: The gases it expels have become tropical scented, but still remain pungent. People describe the aroma as being like rotten pineapples and papayas.

entry: 整条裙子，其实只是头上花冠的一片花瓣。它能与植物交谈，向它们下令。
author: HoundRyS
source: Its entire dress is a single petal from the flower crown on its head. It talks to plants, giving them commands.

entry: POKENAME虽然长得像符文，却与未知图腾无关。举止很“无理”，又特别喜欢圆形。
author: ValtsuRi
source: Despite POKENAME's glyph-like appearance, it isn't related to Unown. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.

entry: POKENAME看起来像一个数学常数。举止很“无理”，又特别喜欢圆形。
author: ValtsuRi
source: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.

entry: POKENAME看起来像一个数学常数。举止很“无理”，又特别喜欢圆形。
author: ValtsuRi
source: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.

entry: 它浮在池面吸收阳光，转化成电力。攻击前，还会从触角散出麻痹粉。
author: AriaMelisma
source: It gathers sunlight as as floats on the surface of ponds, converting it into electricity. It releases Stun Spores from its antennae before attacking.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽与泥泞的热带地带结成小群。首领头上，戴着果壳编成的王冠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in small groups in swamps and muddy tropical areas. The leader among them wears a crown of fruit shells.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽与泥泞的热带地带结成小群。首领头上，戴着果壳编成的王冠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in small groups in swamps and muddy tropical areas. The leader among them wears a crown of fruit shells.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽与泥泞的热带地带结成小群。首领头上，戴着果壳编成的王冠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in small groups in swamps and muddy tropical areas. The leader among them wears a crown of fruit shells.

entry: 花比预期更早长大，可身体还没强壮到能承重，反而被花压得抬不起身。
author: Soup1900
source: Its flower has grown a lot sooner than expected. The weight of the flower crushes it, as it is not strong enough to carry it yet.

entry: 它会保护自己占据的森林和洞穴。它能钻入地下，伪装成布满苔藓的石头，悄悄接近闯入者。
author: homelessrager
source: It is known to defend forests and caves that it claims. It can sneak up on trespassers by digging in the ground to disguise as a mossy rock.

entry: POKENAME为了在地面更好地移动，练出强壮肌肉。它以尾端花朵引来猎物，再突然出击。
author: Raza
source: POKENAME have developed stronger muscles in order to better navigate on the ground. They lure prey in with the flowers on their tails before striking.

entry: 玩耍泥浆中的养分，让POKENAME颊边的花长大。为了撑住头部，后腿也变得更加硬挺。
author: Shocktopus
source: The nutrients in the mud POKENAME plays in have enlarged its cheek flowers. Because of this, its hind legs have stiffened further to support its head.

entry: 手中的花朵会吸收日光。积蓄的太阳能，能被它用来制造小型黑洞，保护训练家。
author: Kieth Stoutcinder
source: The flower it holds absorbs sunlight. The solar energy it gathers can be expended to create small black holes to protect its Trainer.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与其体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今，它背上的树已经深深扎根于POKENAME的神经系统。
author: Zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. The tree on its back is now fully rooted in POKENAME's nervous system.

entry: 如今仍活着的许多POKENAME，早在化石宝可梦所处的远古时代就已诞生。它们用极强的力量，守住隐秘洞穴。
author: VeteranAdventurer
source: Many POKENAME alive today were first born in the time of fossil Pokémon. They guard their hidden caves with extreme power.

entry: POKENAME的绝招，是以剑刃吸收充足阳光，再释放太阳之力，重击对手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's ultimate move is absorbing enough sunlight through its blade to release and smite its opponent with the power of the sun.

entry: 传说这根权杖曾属于巫师，能号令植物。吸足阳光后，还能射出强劲的太阳能量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This legendary scepter, said to have belonged to a wizard, can command plants and with enough absorbed sunlight, release a blast of solar energy.

entry: POKENAME的花伞既能通过光合作用提供养分，也能在下雨时收集水分。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The floral parasol of POKENAME acts both as a source of nutrients when conducting photosynthesis and as a way to gather water during rain.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴释放大量花粉，让植物茁壮生长。POKENAME住过的地方，总覆盖着绚丽花草。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME emits large amounts of pollen from its tail that allow plants to flourish. Areas where POKENAME reside are blanketed in gorgeous flora.

entry: POKENAME狡猾而厌恶人类，常主动攻击。多数人以为POKENAME邪恶，其实它们只是想守护自然。
author: zakafraka
source: POKENAME are crafty Pokémon that hate humans and often attack them. Most people think POKENAME are evil, but they just want to protect nature.

entry: POKENAME守着草木蔓生的遗迹。魁梧身躯，足以震慑所有胆敢闯入领地的家伙。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME guards overgrown ruins. Its mighty stature strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to trespass in its domain.

entry: POKENAME飞向高空，尽情吸收阳光。日照不足时，则改吃鸟宝可梦。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME flies high into the sky to better absorb the sun's rays. On days where the sunlight isn't as strong, it feeds on bird Pokémon instead.

entry: 兴奋过头时，尾端的植物就会烧起来。最好任其燃烧，若不许烧，POKENAME反而会生闷气。
author: kandyman
source: If overexcited, the plant on the end of its tail will combust. It is best to let this fire rage, as POKENAME will sulk if forbidden from burning.

entry: POKENAME用真菌般材质的双翼高速飞行，散出的孢子，还能帮它进行某种回声定位。
author: Canada
source: POKENAME uses its wings, which are made from a fungus-like material, to fly at high speeds. It uses the spores it spreads in a form of echolocation.

entry: POKENAME以巨大花瓣护身，自封沼泽之王，还要求其他宝可梦进贡。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME shields its body with massive flower petals. It fancies itself king of the swamp, and demands tribute from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽友善，却不知道自己拍翼时会散出多少花粉。这些花粉，能引发严重过敏。
author: TheKRT
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are unaware of the amount of pollen released as they flutter their wings. Their pollen can cause intense allergic reactions.

entry: 野生POKENAME大半时间都睡在向阳林地。小心别吵醒，否则一场起床气，就可能引发森林大火。
author: kandyman
source: Wild POKENAME spend most of their time asleep in sunlit glades. Be careful not to wake one, or it will start a forest fire with its temper tantrum.

entry: 它常处于蛰伏，迟缓的动作掩盖了火爆脾气。发怒时的破坏力，足以点燃整片雨林。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Most often seen hibernating, its lethargic movement belies its short fuse. Its destructive power when angered could set a whole rainforest ablaze.

entry: POKENAME在热带森林结成小群，总在寻找水分格外充足的水果。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in small groups in tropical forests. They are constantly on the lookout for particularly water-rich fruits.

entry: POKENAME在热带森林结成小群，总在寻找水分格外充足的水果。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in small groups in tropical forests. They are constantly on the lookout for particularly water-rich fruits.

entry: 它们群居热带，首领戴着果壳王冠。凡是威胁族群的敌人，都能被轻易砸成肉泥。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lives in groups in tropical areas, with the leader wearing a crown of fruit shells. It easily smashes enemies that threaten its group into pulp.

entry: 它们群居热带，首领戴着果壳王冠。凡是威胁族群的敌人，都能被轻易砸成肉泥。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lives in groups in tropical areas, with the leader wearing a crown of fruit shells. It easily smashes enemies that threaten its group into pulp.

entry: 据说POKENAME走遍故乡的农场，以强大超能力催生庄稼，让花朵绽放。
author: Cipher
source: It is said POKENAME travels to farms across its homeland, using its immense psychic energy to make crops grow and flowers blossom.

entry: 它卧在池塘里过滤毒素，通过皮肤吸入水，再从背上的花喷出清水。
author: .izik
source: It lays in ponds to filter out toxins from the water. It drinks the liquid through its skin then sprays the clean water from the flower on its back.

entry: POKENAME那条长满叶片的长尾，年纪越大就越美味。它在热带晒太阳，促进光合作用。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's long, leafy tail tastes better the longer the Pokémon has lived. It sunbathes in tropical areas to promote photosynthesis.

entry: 身上的植物在雨中长得更健康强壮。太阳一出来，便会射出强劲日光束，贯穿厚钢板。
author: Soup1900
source: Its flora grows healthier and stronger during the rain. When the sun comes back up, it fires powerful Solar Beams that tear through thick steel.

entry: POKENAME用花朵摆锤，连最贫瘠的土地也能培育种子。王者般的力量，让草属性宝可梦敬重。
author: noel5229
source: Using its flower pendulum, POKENAME can cultivate seeds in even the most depleted soil. It is revered among Grass-type Pokémon for its regal strength.

entry: 它喜欢吃青藤与苔藓。可一看见橙橙果，就会眼冒饥光，猛冲过去。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to eat green vines and moss. However, if it spots an Oran Berry, it will dash for it with a ravenous look in its eyes.

entry: 它讨厌在雨中飞行。哪怕刚飘起细雨，也会躲到树下，直到风雨停息。
author: .izik
source: It hates flying when it is raining. Should even a slight drizzle begin, it will hide under a tree until the storm subsides.

entry: 背上的花散发甜香。可谁若伸手采摘，就会被POKENAME藏着的毒刺袭击。
author: cait_sith
source: The flower on its back has a sweet smell. However, if someone tries to pick that flower, they will be assaulted by POKENAME's hidden toxic barbs.

entry: 想睡觉时，它会把大半身体埋入地下。若有人踩到POKENAME，它就会惊慌得爆炸。
author: .izik
source: When it wants to sleep, it burrows most of its body into the ground. If someone steps on a POKENAME, it will panic and explode.

entry: POKENAME常独来独往。受到威胁时，便刺向来犯者，将倒刺留在对方体内。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME often keeps to itself, but when it feels threatened it pierces and releases its barbs into its aggressor.

entry: POKENAME在朋友面前很温柔，也能发出使敌人麻痹的超声波叫声。背上的毒刺，还能自由收回。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Known to be gentle around friends, POKENAME can emit ultrasonic cries that can paralyze enemies. It can retract the poison barbs on its back.

entry: 它长着幽暗的毒刺，平时会收起，免得伤到主人。受威胁时，便以幽灵之手触碰敌人，使其毒发。
author: HoundRyS
source: It grows shadowy poison barbs which it retracts as to not hurt its owner. When threatened, it touches its foe with a ghostly hand, poisoning them.

entry: POKENAME白天钻入地下，休息时耳朵也能察觉危险靠近。一被招惹，就用牙和爪迎敌。
author: synaesthesis
source: POKENAME burrows underground during the day, its ears sensitive to approaching danger even at rest. It bites and claws at foes when provoked.

entry: 每只翅膀上都有数百万鳞片。取少量与水调合，就能制成强效除虫喷雾。
author: .izik
source: There are millions of scales on each of its wings. These scales can be used in small amounts with water to create a powerful Repel.

entry: 它固执得连一场逻辑游戏都不肯输。眼看对手要赢，就会试着抹去对方记忆。
author: .izik
source: It is extremely stubborn, refusing to lose even a single logic based game. If it sees its opponent is winning it will attempt to wipe their memory.

entry: POKENAME冷静又体贴，为了保护家人与朋友，不停地锻炼。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME has a calm and caring nature. It trains endlessly in order to protect its friends and family.

entry: 身体轻盈灵巧。穿行森林时，它在树间跳跃，再借耳朵短暂滑翔。
author: .izik
source: Its body is extremely light and agile. While navigating through a forest, it jumps from tree to tree, utilizing its ears to glide slightly.

entry: 巨颚移到了背上，既能吐出种子，也能咬住敌人。
author: Mossybanana
source: Its giant jaws have migrated to its back. They are capable of spitting seeds or biting foes.

entry: 巨大的嘴推动身体在地上前行，保护蛋不受伤害。不过只要捏住顶上的毛簇，就能轻易把它提起来。
author: holgast
source: Its monstrous mouths move it along the ground and defend the egg from danger. However, it can easily be picked up by the tuft of hair on top.

entry: 钢颚伪装成拳头，面对任何挑战，它都绝不退缩。
author: anarchaz
source: With steel jaws camouflaged as fists, it never backs down from a challenge.

entry: 大嘴才是真身，藏在宿主体内，所以它从不说话。一旦放松警惕，它就会钻出来吃掉你。
author: holgast
source: It doesn't speak because its large mouth is its true body, which hides inside the host. If you let down your guard, it will emerge to eat you.

entry: 它装成普通植物，窥视小型宝可梦。凭那副双颚，连最强大的宝可梦也能挡住。
author: imagine1.
source: It spies on tiny Pokémon, pretending to be a regular plant. Its jaws can hold even the most powerful of Pokémon at bay.

entry: 幼崽藏在假嘴般的育儿袋中。夜里，它会像骨纹巨声鳄一样趴着睡，保护孩子。
author: holgast
source: Its baby hides in its pouch, which is a false mouth. It sleeps on its stomach like a Skeledirge to protect its child at night.

entry: POKENAME诱使毫无戒心的猎物欣赏美丽双翼，等对方毫无防备，再猛然咬下。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME tricks unsuspecting prey to look at its beautiful wings. When they are most vulnerable, they chomp down on them.

entry: 首位记录它的训练家，以为发现了水生大嘴娃。可这项发现换来的“回报”，却是一只义手。
author: captainmodeus
source: This fusion was first documented by a Trainer who assumed they found an aquatic Mawile. They were rewarded for the discovery with a prosthetic hand.

entry: 平时是温和的鸟形宝可梦。可一被激怒，就会动用藏在腹中的巨颚，爆发惊人威力。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A normally peaceful bird-like Pokémon. However, when provoked, unleashes the might of the massive jaws hiding within its stomach.

entry: 野生POKENAME平时很怯弱，被逼急了才会反抗。POKENAME猛烈甩动嵌满尖牙的尾巴，展开攻击。
author: Mossybanana
source: A wild POKENAME is very meek unless it is cornered. POKENAME fights by wildly swinging its tail, which is embedded with pointed teeth.

entry: POKENAME长大后萌出了叶子。若咬不到对手，POKENAME就会伸出藤鞭。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME has sprouted leaves due to its growth. If POKENAME cannot bite an opponent, then it will reach out with Vine Whip.

entry: 只要是找吃的，POKENAME就格外大胆，甚至常常直接从别人盘子里拿。
author: Mossybanana
source: A POKENAME is very bold in its pursuit of food, often taking things directly off of someone's plate.

entry: POKENAME用假脸分散猎物注意，再发起咬击。牙齿不如大嘴怪有力，无法穿透岩石属性宝可梦的皮肤。
author: thenezhar
source: POKENAME distracts prey with its decoy face and then bites at them. Its teeth are weaker than Mawbok's and can't penetrate a Rock-type Pokémon's skin.

entry: POKENAME性情凶狠，能咬穿钢铁与混凝土。不过大嘴太沉，妨碍了快速移动。
author: thenezhar
source: POKENAME is a vicious Pokémon that can chomp through steel and concrete. Its large mouth is quite heavy and hinders its capability to move quickly.

entry: 巨颚轻易就能咬断钢梁。人们给它喂建筑工地的余料，免得它吃掉一整座城那么多的金属。
author: holgast
source: Its huge jaws can easily bite through steel girders. It is given spare steel from construction sites, lest it eat entire cities worth of metal.

entry: POKENAME皮肤如同锈铁，有时会伪装成雕像。其他宝可梦一靠近，就猛然咬下。
author: JokersWild
source: Because of its rust-like skin, POKENAME sometimes pretends to be a statue. When another Pokémon gets too close, it chomps down viciously.

entry: POKENAME跑不过猎物，便常先用香气安抚，再将其吃掉。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often soothe their prey with an aroma before consuming them, as they cannot outrun them.

entry: POKENAME背上的凶恶巨颚，看见什么都吞。结果POKENAME总是吃得肚子满满，懒得活动。
author: NellNast42
source: The vicious jaws on POKENAME's back devour anything and everything in sight. This leaves POKENAME constantly stuffed and lazy, though.

entry: POKENAME张着巨口缓缓漂过水中，甚至能将长达两米的宝可梦整个吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME drifts slowly through the water with its huge, mostly open mouth. It can even swallow Pokémon up to two meters in size in one piece.

entry: POKENAME的头会呼唤寻宝者拿起剑。可一进入范围，可怜的冒险者就会被巨颚咬住。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's head calls out to treasure hunters to pick up the sword. Once in range, its jaws chomp down on the poor adventurer.

entry: 两副巨颚由耳朵变成。它引诱猎食者追进洞中，等对方明白自己才是猎物时，已经太迟。
author: wigglypon
source: Its twin jaws are ears that transformed. It lures predatory Pokémon to chase it into its burrow, where they realize—too late—that they are the prey.

entry: POKENAME沿洞顶飞掠，凶猛捕猎。尾巴上的几张嘴饥饿贪食，怎么也填不饱。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME savagely hunts by soaring across the ceilings of caves. The mouths on its tail have a ravenous, insatiable appetite.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: 没人说得清POKENAME为何变成这样。只知道抱它一下，往往就得去医院。
author: Mossybanana
source: No one quite knows how POKENAME wound up the way it did. It is, however, known that a hug will often result in a visit to the hospital.

entry: POKENAME牙间滴落的毒液，会吸引小宝可梦。它藏在花坛中，引诱猎物靠近。
author: Mistymagius
source: The poison that drips from POKENAME's teeth attracts small Pokémon. It will hide in flower beds to lure in its prey.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏土与金属构成。哪处破损，就用巨颚吞下材料，修补伤处。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's body is composed of clay and metal. If part of its body breaks, it repairs the area by consuming material with its massive jaws.

entry: 它常住在湖里，将巨口埋入沙中。发光的尾巴吸引小宝可梦，待对方毫无防备，再发动攻击。
author: RadiationV2
source: It's often found in lakes, hiding its maw under the sand. It uses its glowing tail to attract smaller Pokémon, then attacks when they are vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME能变成镰刀，以诡异力量驱除、吸收恶魂，让自己变得更强。
author: yourfriendlycap
source: Utilizing an ability to change its shape into that of a scythe, POKENAME uses its eerie power to exorcise and absorb evil souls to gain greater power.

entry: POKENAME发丝般的嘴啃食垃圾，喷出恶臭烟雾。牙上满是有害细菌，让咬伤也带着毒性。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's hair-like mouths munch on garbage and spew out foul-smelling fumes. Their teeth are coated in bad bacteria, causing its bite to be toxic.

entry: 它先向四周释放毒孢子，再伏击猎物，整个吞下。胃口永远无法满足。
author: admiralvermin
source: It hunts by releasing toxic spores into the air around it before ambushing its prey and swallowing it whole. Its appetite is insatiable.

entry: 没人明白POKENAME为何能飞。它就是能靠背上的巨颚飞来飞去，不停追赶猎物。
author: Mossybanana
source: No one is sure why POKENAME is capable of flight. Yet it flies around on its back-mounted jaws, which it uses to chase prey relentlessly.

entry: 巨口之外，还拥有惊人体力。它极其好斗，自认力量完美，视其他一切为不纯之物。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its massive maw is accompanied by immense physical strength. Highly aggressive, it sees everything as impure compared to its own perfect power.

entry: 甲壳化成了一副巨颚。POKENAME既用来挡住攻击，也会狠狠咬向靠得太近的敌人。
author: Mossybanana
source: Its shell has become a set of jaws. POKENAME will use it to not only block attacks, but also bite down viciously on opponents that get too close.

entry: 三个喙都坚硬如钢。它动作极其敏捷，能迅速跑赢任何挑战者。
author: togetik
source: Its three beaks are hard as steel. It is incredibly agile and quickly outruns any challenger.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚令人胆寒。它潜在深处埋伏，专挑猎物最不防备的时刻袭击。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME's gigantic jaws are a fearsome sight to behold. As an ambush predator, it lurks in the depths and strikes at its prey when least expected.

entry: POKENAME在1亿多年的时间里几乎没有变化。它漂浮在水中，张开大嘴，就能轻松捕获漂来的食物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has hardly changed over 100 million years. It floats in the water and effortlessly catches drifting food with its large mouth.

entry: POKENAME的壳状巨口十分坚固，能抵挡多次攻击。本体却相当脆弱。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME's shell-maw is very sturdy, and will withstand many attacks. Its body, however, is quite frail.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗洞穴，潜伏岩缝等待猎物，再射出纤细坚韧的丝，将猎物拉近。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in dark caves and lurks in crevices to wait for its prey. It shoots thin and strong threads to pull them in.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑水中，以触手像船用螺旋桨一样转动前进。身体硬而坚韧，与珊瑚颇为相似。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in murky waters and moves around using its tentacles like a ship's propeller. Its body is hard and tough, not dissimilar to coral.

entry: 头上的花如螺旋桨运作。有时，大群POKENAME会从水中升起，飞过数百米。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The blossom on its head works like a propeller. Sometimes large groups of POKENAME emerge from the water and fly many hundreds of meters.

entry: POKENAME能用花产生强劲气流，既可在水中瞬间转向，也能吹飞敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can emit strong air currents via its flowers, which enables it to either change direction in the water immediately or blow enemies away.

entry: POKENAME飞快奔跑，以头上触手抓住猎物。利爪既是武器，也能用来肢解猎物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME runs around quickly and grabs prey with the tentacles on its head. It uses its claws as weapons or tools for dismemberment.

entry: POKENAME水陆两栖，两处各待一半时间。困了便攀附岩石，往往有偏爱的休息地点。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME are amphibious, and spend equal amounts of time underwater and on land. They cling to rocks when sleepy, often having favorite rest spots.

entry: POKENAME用肢体积蓄攻击能量，但POKENAME是否明白自己在做什么，仍不清楚。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its appendages to charge energy for its attacks, but it's unclear if POKENAME understands this process.

entry: 108只古代宝可梦的灵魂聚进同一块化石，诞生了POKENAME。它嫉妒那些活在现代的宝可梦。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is formed when the spirits of 108 ancient Pokémon congregate into one fossil. It is envious of the Pokémon that are alive in the modern era.

entry: 背上承载着完整的生态。许多被禁止进入这个地区的宝可梦，都在这里找到了避难所。
author: funkytomate
source: It is carrying an entire ecosystem on its back. Many Pokémon that are not allowed entry into this region are finding refuge here.

entry: POKENAME将触手伪装成长剑，吸引寻宝的猎物。对方一进范围，就被抓住，整个吞下。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME disguises its tentacle as a sword to attract treasure-hunting prey. When they come within range, it snatches them and eats them whole.

entry: POKENAME将触须藏在手臂的圆形部位。身体看似脆弱，其实坚如磐石。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME has hidden tendrils in the round part of its arm. Its body may look frail, but it is actually rock hard.

entry: POKENAME悠闲地漂过海洋，以触手散出孢子，使猎物失去行动能力。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME drifts idly throughout the sea. Its tentacles let out spores to incapacitate prey.

entry: POKENAME喜欢阴暗潮湿的环境。它们用真菌与植物伪装身体，也会自然地从中获得能量。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME tend to enjoy dark, damp environments. They can disguise themselves with fungi and plant matter, getting energy from them passively.

entry: 融合使POKENAME的生理构造大变。猎物一被退化的嘴困住，便会被头上的触手吸收。
author: ziggaway
source: After fusing, POKENAME's biology changed dramatically. The tentacles on its head absorb its prey once they are trapped within the vestigial mouth.

entry: POKENAME装作野生卡比兽，懒洋洋地躺着。猎物靠近，真正的身体就会一把抓住。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME pretends to be a wild Snorlax, lazing around. When its prey gets close, its real body snatches them.

entry: POKENAME藏在浑水或灌木等隐蔽处，再猛然扑出，将猎物兜进嘴中。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME will hide itself in concealed terrain, such as murky water or bushes, before suddenly swooping out to scoop up prey into its mouth.

entry: 涨潮时，它在离岸流下扎根，吞食被卷向海里的宝可梦。退潮后，则现身岩石浅滩捕猎。
author: missingmilkman
source: At high tide, it roots itself under the rip current and devours any Pokémon dragged out to sea. At low tide, it emerges to hunt within rocky shoals.

entry: POKENAME射出丝线，捕捉毫无戒心的猎物。强健双腿，能轻松将对方碾碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME shoots silken threads to catch unwary prey. With its incredibly strong legs, it can crush them effortlessly.

entry: 它能水陆生活。水中将触手转作船用螺旋桨，空中则用作旋翼。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can live both in water and on land. In the water it rotates its tentacles like a ship's propeller, and in the air it uses them as a rotor.

entry: POKENAME用吸力贴在岩石上，再以触手抓住飘过的东西。不能吃的，就放掉。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sticks itself onto rock formations with suction and catches things floating by with its tentacles. It releases anything that is not edible.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁里，咬住靠得太近的猎物。还能像风扇一样转动触手，卷起强劲漩涡。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hides in coral reefs and snaps at prey that gets too close. It can also rotate its tentacles like a fan to create powerful whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME黏滑出名，动作缓慢。头上的触手却能迅速捉住猎物，再让黏液将其消化。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME is famously slimy, and moves very slowly. The tentacles on its head can rapidly snatch prey, however, which are then digested in its slime.

entry: POKENAME能将爪子变硬或弯曲，既作武器，也作攀爬工具。偶尔能见它用利爪飞快攀上山坡。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can harden or flex its claws to use them as weapons or climbing tools. It is occasionally seen using its claws to flit up mountains.

entry: POKENAME在海底遗迹与洞穴间潜行，寻找下一顿。它们盘绕着缠紧猎物，再用力挤压。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME sneak around ocean ruins and caves, looking for their next meal. They catch their prey by constricting them in their coils and squeezing.

entry: POKENAME潜在沙滩岸下。捕猎时吟唱诡谲曲调，以触手般的头发捆住猎物，吸走生命力。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME lurks beneath the shores of beaches. When hunting, it chants unsettlingly, binding prey with its tentacle hair and sapping their life force.

entry: 古文献证实，一些山民曾将POKENAME奉为暴躁之神。流传至今的称号之一，便是“山脊之怒”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Ancient writings prove that several mountain folks worshipped POKENAME as an irascible deity. One surviving name is 'Wrath of the Mountain Ridge'.

entry: 身体干燥时，它会蜷成球，直到重新回到水里。被冲上岸的POKENAME，常被误当成沙滩玩具。
author: hampterbychoice
source: If it is dried out, it will curl up into a ball until returned to the water. Washed up POKENAME are often mistaken for beach toys.

entry: 它主要吃海底珊瑚与植物。没有植物可吃时，偶尔也会吃贝壳和藤壶。
author: .izik
source: Its diet consists mostly of coral and plant life on the sea floor. It will sometimes eat seashells and barnacles if no plant life is available.

entry: 据说这只史前宝可梦住在热带水域，用扇状部位催眠猎物，吓退敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This prehistoric Pokémon is said to have lived in tropical waters, using its fans to hypnotize prey and scare off enemies.

entry: POKENAME的触手适于感知周围水中的动静与细微变化。不过，也确实增加了游动阻力。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon adapted its tentacles to detect movement and subtle changes in the water around it. These appendages do increase POKENAME's drag, though.

entry: POKENAME住在风暴不息的高原。视野接近360度，是无与伦比的猎手。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in ever-stormy plateaus. With a range of vision of nearly 360º, it is an unparalleled hunter.

entry: POKENAME迈着细小的腿跺来跺去。腿太细，容易折断。刺针没有毒，只会扎得疼。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME stomps around on its small legs. Its legs are easy to snap because of their size. Its stingers are not poisonous, just painful.

entry: POKENAME被认为是太古羽虫与土龙弟弟之间缺失的过渡形态。大眼睛表明，它尚未适应地下生活。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME is thought to be a missing link between Anorith and Dunsparce. Its large eyes suggest that it had yet to evolve to an underground lifestyle.

entry: 这把剑放下了自己的武士之魂，与一枚已有100,000,000年历史的爪子化石中的灵魂相连，重新回忆起古老的招式。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This sword has dismissed its warrior spirit to connect with the one inside a 100,000,000-year-old Claw Fossil, remembering its ancient techniques.

entry: 据说古时POKENAME的皮毛是稳定的丝料来源。柔滑如丝的鬃毛，当年很受人追捧。
author: .ssunday.
source: It's said POKENAME fur was a consistent source of silk in ancient times. Its mane is silky smooth and was yearned for back then.

entry: 这只史前宝可梦曾在海滩潜行，扫视岸边寻找猎物。一发现目标，便猛扑过去，用爪子抓住。
author: zerocipher
source: This prehistoric Pokémon used to stalk beaches, scanning the shore for prey. Once prey was spotted, it would swoop in and snatch it with its claws.

entry: 古生物学家近日在构木镇附近，发现一片POKENAME化石。化石显示，它们曾大群聚居。
author: .izik
source: Paleontologists recently found a cluster of POKENAME fossils near Mulberry City. The fossils show that they flocked together in large numbers.

entry: POKENAME根本无法被缠紧或束缚。坚硬铠甲覆满身体，还始终滑溜溜地沾着自己分泌的黏液。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon is impossible to constrict or restrain. Its body is covered entirely in hard armor permanently slick with slime that POKENAME secretes.

entry: POKENAME能在强潮与风暴肆虐的恶劣水域生存。身体受铠甲保护，还能吸住任何湿润表面。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME can thrive in the harshest aquatic locations along strong tides and storms. Armor protects the body, which can suction to any wet surface.

entry: 它性情虽残酷，却会保护遭受攻击的人。据说是因为它曾被人类善待。
author: imagine1.
source: Despite its ruthless nature, it will protect anyone being attacked. It is said that this is because it has been treated well by people.

entry: 它在沙中高速游行，伏击小型宝可梦。翅膀上的眼睛，则用来威吓。
author: imagine1.
source: It swims through the sand at high speeds, ambushing any small Pokémon. The eyes on its wings are for intimidation.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着甲片，游得更快，撞击物体时也不易受伤。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's skin is covered with armor plates. This allows it to move even faster through the water, and protects it from harm when ramming objects.

entry: 大爪让捕猎轻而易举。POKENAME背上的硬壳，则保护它休息时免遭突袭。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: The large claws on its paws allow for an easy hunt. The hard shells on POKENAME's back protect it from any surprise attacks while it's resting.

entry: POKENAME想起亡母时，心中痛苦难当，便会用头骨猛撞坚硬物体。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME smashes its skull on hard surfaces in emotional agony when thinking of its late mother.

entry: POKENAME用头撞开障碍。POKENAME必须一路头槌、挖出孵化的洞穴，才能见到父母。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME use their heads to knock down obstacles. POKENAME must headbutt and dig their way out of the caves they hatched in to meet their parents.

entry: 有些POKENAME的角，会随栖息地不同，长在不同的位置。还有些个体冬天会脱角，到了春天再重新长出。
author: totodile.
source: Some POKENAME have different horn placements depending on where they live. Some POKENAME horns shed in winter and regrow in spring.

entry: POKENAME先以巨力头槌撞晕猎物，再用头上的肢体猛然咬下。
author: typhloquil
source: To catch its prey, POKENAME headbutts the prey with mighty force, then chomps down with its head appendage while they are stunned.

entry: 觅食时，它专找飞行属性宝可梦的巢。一旦发现，就会全力撞过去，将巢摧毁。
author: Skymaster426
source: While it hunts for food, it seeks any nests of Flying-type Pokémon. When it finds one, it rams into it at full force, destroying the nest.

entry: 它喜欢在湍急河流中游泳。难免撞上岩石或木筏，好在坚硬的头能保护自己。
author: cait_sith
source: It enjoys swimming in river rapids. Its hard head protects it when it inevitably rams into rocks or rafts.

entry: 它高速游行，以鲤鱼王为食。头骨虽然坚硬，身体却软乎乎的。
author: imagine1.
source: It swims at high speeds, feasting on Magikarp. Despite its hard skull, its body is very squishy.

entry: POKENAME讲究得很，极重仪容，可挥出的拳头也足以击碎砖墙。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A fastidious Pokémon, POKENAME can throw punches that can shatter brick walls while taking great care of its personal appearance.

entry: 身体由许多小磁铁组成。每天清晨，它会猛烈抖动，抖松底部积着的碎屑。
author: .izik
source: Its body is made up of many small magnets. Every morning, it shakes violently to loosen debris that have accumulated on its base.

entry: 古时，POKENAME以甜香引来猎物，再用坚如铁的头骨狠狠撞击。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: During ancient times, POKENAME would attract prey with a sweet aroma, then bash it with its skull, which is as hard as iron.

entry: 头骨周围的尖刺，让POKENAME的头槌格外凶猛。身体灵活，必要时能迅速转向。
author: char_latte3412
source: The spikes around its skull are what make POKENAME's headbutts devastatingly brutal. Its limber form allows for quick turns if necessary.

entry: 在其他地区，POKENAME会成群撞倒投掷猴，抢走它们的树果。
author: malxire
source: In other regions, POKENAME forms packs to tackle Passimians down and steal their Berries.

entry: 双翼力量极强。它用厚重如岩的头猛撞树干，将树果或虫宝可梦震落。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon has extremely strong wings. It bashes it thick, rocky head against trees to knock out Berries or bug Pokémon.

entry: 脸部皮肤布满细小沟槽，能筛过向前推开的泥土。跟在后面的人，可能捡到它留下的稀有宝石。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The hide on its face is covered in small grooves which filter the soil that it pushes. Those who follow it may find rare gems it has left behind.

entry: POKENAME在沙中游动，宛如在水里。脾气暴躁，谁挡住去路，就对谁发怒。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME swims through sand as if it were water. It is quite temperamental and gets angry at anyone or anything that stands in its path.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，会飞向彼此，用头猛撞，争夺高下。撞击声，常被误认成雷鸣。
author: Fenragon
source: When two POKENAME meet, they will fly to each other and slam their heads together in a display of dominance. This sound is often mistaken for thunder.

entry: 它冲过沼泽，在泥地犁出大片凹坑，让水道更容易扩展。
author: .izik
source: It charges through marshlands to create large divots in the mud. This allows waterways to expand more easily.

entry: 巨大的盾状头骨，连迫击炮火也能挡住。可也因此头重脚轻，只有最强健的个体才能完全站直。
author: rihse
source: Its enormous, shield-shaped skull can withstand mortar fire. Unfortunately, this also makes it top-heavy, and only the elite can stand at full height.

entry: POKENAME的铁尾重得摆不动。想移动，就得慢慢推着尾巴走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's iron tail is too heavy for it to swing. It must slowly push it to travel.

entry: POKENAME的盾能挡住任何正面攻击，铠甲般的身体，则烫得碰不得。它心怀正义，意志坚韧。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's shield repels any direct attack, while its armored body burns to touch. It has a righteous and enduring spirit.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳，总像故乡的一座中世纪城堡。有时，甚至成了那座城堡样式仅存的证据。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's shell always resembles a medieval castle of its home region. In some cases, they are the only surviving evidence of the castle's design.

entry: POKENAME只有腹部是弱点，其余部位全被厚甲保护。
author: themicelegion
source: A POKENAME's only weak spot is its stomach. The rest of its body is heavily armored.

entry: 铠甲般的皮肤能弹开所有来袭攻击，正面进攻毫无意义。威严的气势，也常足以吓退敌人。
author: anarchaz
source: Its armored hide deflects all incoming strikes, making frontal attacks futile. Its imposing presence is often enough to deter would-be adversaries.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME平时很温顺。可曾有科学家试图叫醒它，再从睡处搬走它的记录。如今，已经没人这么做了。
author: bobosmith01
source: While usually docile, there was a report of a scientist that tried to wake up and move a POKENAME from where it made its bed. This is no longer done.

entry: 它懒得根本不想动，就悬在同一处静止不动。有人说，简直懒得像死了一样。
author: milchik
source: This fusion doesn't move and hovers, still, in one place because of how lazy it is. Some people say that it's so lazy that it appears to be dead.

entry: POKENAME硕大的头有90%由骨骼构成，比钢铁还硬。头骨太厚，大脑反倒小得可怜。
author: JokersWild
source: POKENAME's oversized head is 90% bone, which makes it harder than steel. Since its skull is so thick, its brain is very tiny.

entry: 它精确知道打哪里，能造成最大伤害。训练家连它的名字，也不敢说出口。
author: weedspagon_real
source: It knows precisely where to strike to cause maximum damage. Trainers dare not speak its name.

entry: POKENAME虽有推动大陆的力量，却从不认真战斗。训练家养上一周，往往就受不了，解除了融合。
author: Faelocke
source: While powerful enough to move continents, it never takes battling seriously. Trainers of POKENAME often unfuse it out of frustration after a week.

entry: POKENAME的体能无与伦比。然而，过于强大的力量反而让它变得懒散而傲慢。
author: Griddle
source: The physical prowess of POKENAME is unmatched. However, its strength has made it sedentary and arrogant.

entry: 两只POKENAME碰面，就会激战不休，直到一方或双方精疲力竭倒下。它们正是这样结下情谊。
author: dragonzzilla
source: If two POKENAME meet, they'll battle until either one or both of them collapse from exhaustion. This is how they form bonds.

entry: POKENAME用极为华丽的招式击败对手。看着懒散，其实力气太大，根本不费吹灰之力。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME uses extremely flashy moves to defeat opponents. It is deceptively lazy, as its power is truly effortless.

entry: POKENAME无论何时，至少有一个头在睡觉，害得其他头不得不拖着它走，相当不便。
author: mx_wellman
source: At any given moment, at least one of POKENAME's heads is sleeping. This is inconvenient as it means the other heads have to drag it around.

entry: 它以魅惑舞蹈催眠敌人，还能操纵毒素，将其散入空气。
author: bobosmith01
source: It uses alluring dances to hypnotize foes. It controls poison and spreads it through the air.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，角中毒液的分量，连最大的吼鲸王也足以放倒！
author: SupersonicLoki
source: A truly rare sighting; POKENAME has enough poison in it's horn to fell even the largest of Wailords!

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，挖出巨大隧道。有些已发现的隧道，深入地下超过0.6英里。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME dig through the ground, creating huge tunnels. Some are found to reach a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

entry: POKENAME挥尾如鞭。曾有记录，它一击贯穿了4英尺厚的混凝土。
author: winchbeef
source: POKENAME wields its tail like a whip. It has been recorded piercing through 4 feet of concrete.

entry: POKENAME寻找尼多一族的其他融合宝可梦，将它们视作家人，尽心战斗、守护。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME seeks other Nidoran-related fusions in order to fight for and protect them diligently as family.

entry: POKENAME极力保护幼崽。任何人或东西稍靠得太近，背刺便会竖起，渗出毒液。
author: char_latte3412
source: Highly defensive of its young, POKENAME's back barbs bristle and ooze poison if it senses anyone or anything straying too close.

entry: 它对在乎的对象极为护短，会拼上性命，确保幼崽与训练家安全。
author: MelodyDeLune
