source: Extremely protective of those it cares about, this Pokémon will stake its life to ensure the safety of its young and Trainer.

entry: 它以强劲踢击闻名。整夜，都能听见它在林间跳跃的声音。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Known for its powerful kicks, this Pokémon can be heard throughout the night leaping through the forests.

entry: 它性情神秘，只与主人交流。真身藏在鳞片躯壳之内，攻击时便伸出幽暗针刺。
author: HoundRyS
source: It communicates only with its owner, being very secretive. It keeps its form hidden in its scaly body, and attacks by extending shadowy needles.

entry: POKENAME为喜欢的人起舞，同时散出控制心神的毒素，将对方引回自己的住处。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME performs dances for people that it likes. This dances spreads mind-controlling poison through the air to lure the person to its home.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，用角猛撞却能把敌人撞飞。夜里，叶片还能吸收月光恢复精力。
author: synaesthesis
source: Though small in stature, POKENAME can send foes flying with harsh tackles from its horn. Its leaves can absorb moonlight to regain energy at night.

entry: POKENAME随时准备迎战。挥出的拳头，对小型生物甚至可能致命。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: POKENAME is ready for anything. Its punch has been known to be fatal to smaller creatures.

entry: 只有肌肉拉伤时，人们才见过它畏缩。它总在寻找其他豪力融合宝可梦，发起挑战。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: This Pokémon is only known to flinch when it pulls a muscle. It seeks out and challenges other Machoke fusions.

entry: POKENAME走到哪间健身房，都满嘴“积极向上”，逼得人喘不过气。可想突破自我极限的强大训练家，偏偏就爱找它一起练。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: A toxic positivity personality at any gym; strong Trainers seek POKENAME out when they want to push their limits as a Trainer and as a human.

entry: POKENAME住在高污染源附近的森林。数量一旦增加，就是生态破坏即将到来的明确信号。
author: VeteranAdventureHobo
source: This POKENAME makes its home in forests that are near sources of high pollution. An increasing presence is a sure sign of coming ecological damage.

entry: POKENAME住在山上，一感知灾难便慌张奔跑，不知疲倦地向附近的人示警，挡路的东西全被撞过。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME live on mountains. When they sense disaster, they panic and tirelessly charge to warn anyone nearby, running over anything in their way.

entry: 有些POKENAME的甲片样式不同，脸也更短。警告若被无视，POKENAME可能会大发雷霆。
author: totodile.
source: Some POKENAME have different styles of plating and shorter faces. POKENAME can become enraged if their warnings go unheeded.

entry: 一察觉灾难，它就急忙四处分发自己的蛋，想帮上忙。POKENAME明明仁慈，许多人却仍以为灾祸是它引起的。
author: fountainihili
source: If it senses a disaster, it will begin frantically giving out its eggs to help. Despite its kindness, many still believe POKENAME caused the disaster.

entry: 翅上脱落的闪亮鳞片可制成救命药，治疗某些尚无其他疗法的罕见病。
author: kiwikelly
source: The shimmery scales shed from POKEMON's wings can be made into life-saving medicine for certain rare illnesses with no other known cures.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂附近生活得很好。它会用角充当避雷针，保护输电线，免受暴风雨摧残。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME thrives around power plants. It uses its horn like a lighting rod to prevent storms from destroying power lines.

entry: POKENAME生活在休眠火山中。若在别处见到它们，就意味着附近的山即将喷发。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME live in dormant volcanoes. Seeing them elsewhere means a nearby mountain will erupt soon.

entry: POKENAME生来有双角，可与其他POKENAME争斗时，终有一角会折断。有人收集断角，当作幸运符。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are born with two horns, but one inevitably breaks off as it battles other POKENAME. Some collect the broken horns to use as luck charms.

entry: POKENAME的角，对周遭环境极为敏感。据说，它亲眼见过什么样的天灾，就会影响日后的进化。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's horn is very sensitive to its environment. It is said that the type of natural disaster POKENAME witnesses will influence its evolution.

entry: POKENAME天性独来独往，想取得信任，得花不少时间。它认真严肃，讨厌突然被吓到。
author: kittyluv090
source: Building trust with a POKENAME takes quite a bit of time, as it is naturally a very solitary Pokémon. It is quite serious and hates being startled.

entry: POKENAME浮出海面的地方，很快就会有巨大海啸袭来。它随后会坚守海滩，为别人挡住巨浪。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Where it surfaces from the ocean, a great tsunami will soon arrive. POKENAME will then stand stalwart on the beach, shielding others from the waves.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛极其珍贵。可据说剪下POKENAME毛发的人，会遭受一百年厄运。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely valuable, but it is said that anyone who cuts it off of a POKENAME will suffer one hundred years of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME如今有了强劲双翼带来的速度，便会远行各地，警告人们即将到来的危险。
author: Sejha
source: POKENAME, now blessed with the speed afforded to it by its powerful wings, travels great distances to warn people of coming danger.

entry: POKENAME的大角帮助它调节超能力。预知未来准确无比，使它在某些文化中备受尊崇。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's large horns help them tune their psychic abilities. They're highly revered in certain cultures thanks to their pitch-perfect Future Sight.

entry: POKENAME十分友善。孩子们爱把头上的符号当作指针转盘，玩占卜游戏。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is very friendly. Children like to use the symbol on its head as a spinner to play fortune-telling games.

entry: 分叉尾巴颤动时，POKENAME就能预见灾难。不过只会告诉自己认可的训练家。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME has the power to predict disasters when its forked tail quivers. However, it will only share its knowledge with a Trainer it deems worthy.

entry: 污染严重时，POKENAME的花开始绽放。它能减缓环境中毒，却无法独力阻止。
author: VeteranAdventurer
source: This POKENAME's flower has begun to bloom in the presence of high pollution. It can slow the poisoning of the environment, but can't stop it alone.

entry: 它从楼顶观察城里的人。一预见与奶酪有关的灾难，就立刻出动。
author: .izik
source: It watches people in the city from the tops of buildings. When it foresees a cheese-related disaster, it jumps into action.

entry: POKENAME出现在遭地震摧毁的城镇。无关迷信，只是震动将它们从地下的沉睡中唤醒了。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME appear where earthquakes destroyed towns. Despite superstitions, this is simply because the tremors woke them from their underground slumber.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，爱怂恿训练家接受危险挑战。只有最勇敢的人才明白，有它在就一定安全。
author: kiwikelly
source: This mischievous Pokémon tempts Trainers with dangerous dares. Only the most courageous know that POKENAME's presence guarantees their safety.

entry: 世界多种文化都把成群POKENAME视为凶兆。可单独饲养的POKENAME，其实是很好的伙伴。
author: kiwikelly
source: A flock of POKENAME is considered a bad omen across multiple cultures around the world, but singular POKENAME actually make for great pets.

entry: POKENAME在壳中酿的树果汁，会让人看见可怕的末日灾难景象，连最勇敢的训练家也会吓得发抖。
author: kiwikelly
source: The berry juice POKENAME makes in its shell causes terrifying visions of doom and calamity that can make even the bravest Trainers cower in fear.

entry: POKENAME常爬上受损树木，吃掉软木与树液。树木养护者会借它判断，树是否即将倒塌或折断。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME often appear on compromised trees to eat their soft wood and sap. Arborists often use them to predict if a tree is about to fall or break.

entry: POKENAME的漂亮羽毛与皮毛十分珍贵。可它不适合饲养，会毁掉主人珍视的一切。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are prized for their beautiful feathers and fur. However, they make terrible pets, as they will destroy everything their owner holds dear.

entry: POKENAME巡视领地，确保一切无恙。若有异常，就发出诡异长嚎，向其余同伴示警。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME patrol their territory to ensure that nothing has gone awry. If something is amiss, they let out eerie howls to alert the rest of their pack.

entry: POKENAME过着孤独的独居生活。野外曾有人见它接近黑鲁加群，却总是遭到拒绝。
author: rihse
source: This Pokémon lives a lonely and solitary life. While it has been observed approaching packs of Houndoom in the wild, POKENAME is always rejected.

entry: 注视POKENAME的角，会看见可怕的灾难幻象。有人相信是预兆，也有人认为是POKENAME的自卫手段。
author: kiwikelly
source: Looking at POKENAME's horns causes visions of terrible disasters. Some believe those are omens, while others think it's POKENAME's defense mechanism.

entry: 传说它只要一拍翼，就会带来毁灭。为免更多灾难，它独自住在漆黑洞穴。
author: Thora Daughn
source: According to legend, just the flap of its wings caused destruction. To prevent further disasters, it lives a solitary life in a pitch-black cave.

entry: 据说POKENAME，是人临终前最后会看见的存在。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is believed that a POKENAME is the last thing someone will see before passing away.

entry: 据说受到悉心照顾的POKENAME，能改写未来，让训练家一生幸福富足。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is said that a POKENAME that's well taken care of can alter the future to one where its Trainer lives a happy and prosperous life.

entry: POKENAME用变色的皮毛与人交流。这种复杂语言，科学家仍未完全破译。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME use their color-changing fur to communicate with humans. Scientists have yet to fully decipher this intricate language.

entry: POKENAME常在生态灾区边缘现身，警告闯入者远离，同时吸收其中污染，让当地复原。
author: VeteranAdventurer
source: POKENAME is often found at the edges of ecological disaster zones, warning away trespassers and absorbing the pollution within to heal the area.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿，锋利得如同上等菜刀。偷猎者常拔取它们，卖个中等价钱。
author: .izik
source: The teeth of a POKENAME are about as sharp as a high-grade kitchen knife. Poachers frequently harvest these teeth to sell for a moderate price.

entry: 自然灾难将至之处，常会聚集许多POKENAME，准备将未能生还者的灵魂引往彼岸。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Many POKENAME will gather in an area where a natural disaster is soon to occur, ready to take the spirts of all who do not survive to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: 据说POKENAME的双刃分别代表好运与厄运。哪一刃先命中，就决定了敌人余生的命运。
author: kiwikelly
source: The two blades of POKENAME are said to represent good and bad luck. The first one that strikes seals its enemy's fate for the rest of its life.

entry: 据说它英勇地帮助、保护即将遭逢灾难命运的人。可究竟有无成效，仍不清楚。
author: kiwikelly
source: This valiant fusion is said to help and protect those upon whom a disastrous fate will fall. It is unknown whether or not it is effective.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是命运的使者。它们结成小队，有时阻止小灾祸，有时却亲手将灾祸带来。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are said to be agents of fate, as they work together in small groups to prevent—or cause—small-scale disasters.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇能制成药水，赋予饮者强大的预知能力。可惜预见的，总是恐怖景象。
author: kiwikelly
source: The mushrooms of POKENAME can be turned into potions that grant their drinker powerful future sight. Sadly, the premonitions are always horrifying.

entry: POKENAME能感知灾难，并主动示警。对那些不听劝的人，它却乐于看着他们自食后果。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME can sense disasters, and actively warns people of them. It enjoys witnessing the aftermath of those who don't listen.

entry: POKENAME害羞又难驯服。若受了委屈，POKENAME就再也不会相信伤害自己的人。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are shy and hard to tame. If a POKENAME is wronged, it will never trust the person that hurt it again.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀看似锋利，其实是柔软的感官，用来察觉危险。只要发现天敌，就立刻逃走。
author: kiwikelly
source: While sharp-looking, its scythe is actually a soft sensory organ that POKENAME uses to detect danger. It flees at the first sign of predators.

entry: POKENAME不停啃咬木屋地基，直到房屋轰然倒下。残骸，又成了POKENAME很好的筑巢材料。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME chews on the foundations of wooden buildings until they come crashing down. The destroyed structures make great nest material for POKENAME.

entry: 它能提前察觉灾难，却总累得无心阻止。有人说它懒，也有人觉得，简直就是自己。
author: knilk
source: It can sense disasters before they happen, but it's always too tired to try to prevent them. Some think it's lazy, but others find it quite relatable.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙下，只露出角，感知猎物靠近。据说踩到它，会招来厄运。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the sand, leaving only their horn above ground to sense approaching prey. It is said that stepping on it brings bad luck.

entry: POKENAME极少显露真身。多数POKENAME会化作人形，诱使轻信的训练家走向可怕命运。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are rarely seen in their true form. Most POKENAME take on a human appearance to lure gullible Trainers to a terrible fate.

entry: POKENAME群每晚离洞的准确时刻，能帮助科学家预测即将到来的天气变化。
author: kiwikelly
source: The exact time at which colonies of POKENAME exit their caves each night helps scientists predict upcoming meteorological events.

entry: POKENAME尽职地望着沙漠天际，留意沙暴。一有发现，就会向所有找得到的生物示警。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME dutifully watch the desert horizons for sandstorms. If they spot anything, they will warn everyone they can find about the oncoming danger.

entry: 人们相信它咬一口便能使人毙命，因此十分害怕。其实POKENAME冷静而温顺。
author: kiwikelly
source: This Pokémon is feared by many, as it is believed its bite causes an instant demise. Despite this, POKENAME is actually very calm and docile.

entry: POKENAME受到诅咒，走到哪里，暴风雪便跟到哪里。它在雪原寻找慰藉，却无意伤了旅人。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME is cursed to summon a snowstorm wherever it goes. It roams the snowy landscape in search of solace, unintentionally causing travelers harm.

entry: POKENAME象征丰收。一些农庄会精心举办秋祭，盼POKENAME前来共舞。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are a sign of bountiful harvests. Some farming villages organize elaborate fall festivals, hoping that POKENAME will come dance with them.

entry: 它会强行把人拖离险境，甚至提前好几个小时。可力气太大，拖人时往往反而弄伤对方。
author: PokePower
source: It will forcibly drag people away from danger, even hours ahead of time. Its immense strength usually harms those people in the process.

entry: 把POKENAME的触手放进苹野果汁里煎炸，就能做成一道鲜美的菜。圣花号邮轮上的一家餐厅，便供应这道料理。
author: .izik
source: The tentacles of a POKENAME can be fried in Leppa Berry juice to create a savory dish. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower serves this meal.

entry: 它优雅而善战，只有值得一战的强敌挑战时才肯应战。若POKENAME与弱小的宝可梦交手，便是一场灭顶之灾。
author: kiwikelly
source: This elegant yet formidable fighter will only battle if it's challenged by a worthy foe. If a POKENAME fights a weak Pokémon, it will spell its doom.

entry: 它若察觉巨浪将至，就用角戳赶人和宝可梦，把大家送到安全处。明亮的白沙，也颇受收藏家喜爱。
author: PokePower
source: If it senses a tidal wave coming, it will jab people and Pokémon with its horn to drive them to safety. Collectors love its brilliant white sand.

entry: 预感使POKENAME始终精神煎熬，因为它觉得自己无力阻止灾祸。
author: kiwikelly
source: The premonitions that POKENAME gets cause it to be in constant psychological distress, as it feels powerless to stop the disasters.

entry: POKENAME很会看人，会坚决抵御自己认定的威胁，保护同伴与训练家。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is a great judge of character. It will fiercely defend its pack or its Trainer from anyone it perceives as a threat.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，藏居山中。迷路、倒在山道上的登山客，常被它们带到安全处。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME live in small colonies, hidden in the mountains. Lost hikers who collapse on trails are often brought to safety by these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME像隐士般，在偏僻山中生活锻炼。只有附近村落面临大灾，才会下山相救。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are hermits who live and train on secluded mountains. They only come down to save local villages from cataclysmic threats.

entry: POKENAME住在矿物成分特殊的洞穴。据说一旦见到它，就预示洞穴即将坍塌。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are found in caves with unique mineral compositions. It is said that seeing one foretells that a cave in-will soon happen.

entry: 登山者知道，要避开POKENAME出没之处，那往往是雪崩多发地。不过，POKENAME也会救出被困的攀登者。
author: holgast
source: Hikers' wisdom is to avoid spots where POKENAME is about, as it indicates an avalanche-prone area. However, POKENAME also saves trapped climbers.

entry: 和多数阿勃梭鲁一样，POKENAME想向人们预警，却总慢了一步，只能惊恐地看着悲剧在眼前发生。
author: kiwikelly
source: Like most Absol, POKENAME wants to warn people about disasters, but it's always too late. It watches in horror as tragedies happen before its eyes.

entry: POKENAME能够察觉灾难。可往往还没来得及告诉谁，就把事情忘了。
author: JokersWild
source: POKENAME have the ability to detect disasters. However, they usually forget about them before they can warn anyone.

entry: POKENAME靠长角的头感知危险。另一个大脑则发出滑稽声音安抚它，同时告诉训练家，灾难将至。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME senses danger with its horned head. The other brain calms them down by making funny noises, telling Trainers disaster approaches.

entry: POKENAME长出第三个头，帮助长角的头平静。可那个头越来越疑神疑鬼，最终便会逃离危险。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME grow a third head to help calm the horned head down. After growing increasingly paranoid, the horned head will run from danger.

entry: POKENAME喜欢绕着船只可能撞上的隐蔽冰川游泳，因此POKENAME很受船长喜爱。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are well-loved by ship captains because POKENAME like to swim around hidden glaciers that ships might've otherwise crashed into.

entry: POKENAME射出融入黑暗精华的强劲水流。可它本身，并非邪恶的宝可梦。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME fires high power blast of water infused with the essence of darkness. However, it is not an evil Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以角挖掘洞中隧道。过去，人们常将沿途痕迹当作某种预兆。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME uses its horn to dig through cave tunnels. People used to interpret the marks left in its wake as omens.

entry: POKENAME诞生于死去的绿毛虫。受威胁时，会散出阴冷雾气，趁机脱身。
author: zic
source: POKENAME are born from deceased Caterpie. When threatened, they emit a chilling mist to secure an escape.

entry: POKENAME的目光轻易就能麻痹打算吞食的猎物。它是来自远古的凶悍猎手。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's glare from its eyes can easily paralyze prey it plans on eating. This Pokémon is a fierce predator from long ago.

entry: POKENAME极度胆怯，总避开镜子与水面，免得看见自己可怕的倒影。
author: Kandyman
source: An extremely nervous creature, POKENAME tends to avoid mirrors and water, lest it sees its own terrifying reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用背部花纹吓退天敌，报复心也十分强烈。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME use the pattern on their backs to scare off potential predators. It is known to be highly vengeful.

entry: POKENAME是裹在钢铁中的幽灵集合体，泛着诡光漫游废墟，时刻警惕，守护古老秘密。
author: anarchaz
source: A spectral amalgamation encased in steel, POKENAME roams abandoned ruins with an eerie glow. It guards ancient secrets with unwavering vigilance.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME是遭主人虐待的犬类宝可梦化成的怨灵，因此很难再相信别人。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some believe that POKENAME is the vengeful spirit of a dog Pokémon that was abused by its owner. As such, it has difficulty trusting other people.

entry: 猩红目光，连最勇敢的灵魂也会吓得僵住。POKENAME用可怕的外貌守住食物储藏。
author: anarchaz
source: Its crimson gaze freezes even the bravest souls. POKENAME uses its fearsome appearance to guard its food stash.

entry: POKENAME更容易在生日会后现身。民间传说，它会夺走小寿星的灵魂，占据其身体。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are more likely to appear after birthday parties. Folktales say it snatches the soul of the child who is celebrating, and possesses the body.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，不顾四周，一把抓住所有有机之物。似乎尤其喜欢腐烂的东西。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME have voracious appetites, grabbing anything organic while ignoring their surroundings. They seems to prefer rotten things.

entry: 在野外，POKENAME会穿过茂密的森林，悄悄追踪猎物。如果听见骨头碰撞的咔嗒声，就说明它准备发动攻击了。
author: rhysanthemum
source: In the wild, POKENAME stalks through dense forests in pursuit of prey. If you hear the rattling of bones, it is preparing to strike.

entry: POKENAME脸上的骷髅面具用来吓退天敌。面具边缘的锯齿，还能帮助进食。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The skull mask on the face of POKENAME is used to ward off predators. The jagged edges of the mask assist it when eating.

entry: POKENAME夜里荡过树间，寻找快乐的灵魂吞食。吃饱后，尾端火焰就烧得明亮。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME swings through trees at night in hopes of finding a cheerful soul to feast upon. The flame on its tail burns brightly when it is full.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME象征着谦逊而缺乏自信的波加曼。独眼让步态笨拙，却仍深得训练家喜爱。
author: Xyloldi
source: POKENAME, thought to represent humble Piplup lacking confidence, charm Trainers despite their clumsy gait from their single eye.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME是冷静有礼的灵魂。自己不爱闯入别人领地，也希望别人同样守规矩；谁若闯进来，就会遭它攻击。
author: YeetYollowFox
source: POKENAME is a very calm and respectful soul. It does not like to trespass, and expects the same of others. It attacks anyone it catches trespassing.

entry: 午夜后，POKENAME会伪装成亡者亲人，跟随失亲之人。可轻飘飘的发丝，总会暴露身份。
author: JokersWild
source: Once it is past midnight, POKENAME will follow around a bereaved target, disguised as a loved one. Their wispy hair is a dead giveaway.

entry: 深夜的墓园旁，能听到POKENAME的万能钥匙彼此碰撞，声音阴森回荡。
author: scotsman
source: The haunting sound of POKENAME's skeleton keys jangling together can be heard around graveyards in the dead of night.

entry: 许多神话视它为灭亡的先兆。据说POKENAME若在正午起飞，就会摧毁太阳，让世界陷入黑暗。
author: char_latte3412
source: Many myths believe it to be a harbinger of doom. It's said that if POKENAME flies at noon, it will destroy the sun and plunge the world into darkness.

entry: 有人见它飘在空中。POKENAME的骷髅面具受损后，能够自行修复。
author: themicelegion
source: Its been seen floating around in the sky. POKENAME's skull mask has the ability to heal itself when it gets damaged.

entry: POKENAME能穿墙、变形，却只拿这些本领来偷训练家包里的零食。
author: JokersWild
source: POKENAME have the ability to pass through walls and shapeshift, yet they only ever use this power to steal treats from their Trainer's bag.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME的面具从何而来。可若有人想偷，POKENAME一定会让对方后悔。
author: cipherlingarde
source: None know where the mask POKENAME carries comes from, but if someone tries to take its mask, POKENAME will make sure the would-be thief regrets it.

entry: 盯着POKENAME的面具太久，可能再也移不开目光。连它的同类，也可能不小心中招。
author: cipherlingarde
source: If you stare at POKENAME's mask for too long, you may lose the ability to look away. Others of its kind may fall prey to the same trap by accident.

entry: POKENAME缓缓飘过自己守护的遗迹长廊，会穿墙现身，用骨头诅咒闯入者，打对方个措手不及。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME floats slowly through the corridors of ruins that it guards. It surprises intruders by passing through walls and cursing them with its bones.

entry: POKENAME平时还算冷静。可若有人非要招惹它，哪怕一点点，也准会吃尽苦头。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is a somewhat calm Pokémon. However, if someone go out of their way to mess with it to any degree, they're going to have a bad time.

entry: 夜里，它在乡间小镇吠叫，盼有人靠近。谁若碰到它，就会被吸走生命力。
author: .izik
source: It barks during the night in rural towns, hoping for someone to come near. Should anyone make physical contact, it will drain their vitality.

entry: POKENAME偏爱阴暗多雾的森林。雾既方便藏身捕猎，湿度也有益健康。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME prefers gloomy, misty forests. Not only does the fog help hide it as it hunts, but the humidity is excellent for its health.

entry: 据说伙伴宝可梦离去后，POKENAME便会探访训练家，顽皮地逗对方振作。
author: Fenragon
source: It is said POKENAME will visit a Trainer after their partner Pokémon has departed. It will playfully try to cheer the Trainer up.

entry: 骨骼坚硬如石，外衣却没有实体，让POKENAME转瞬之间就能消失。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its bones are as hard as stone. Its coat, on the other hand, is immaterial and allows POKENAME to disappear in a fraction of a second.

entry: 死去宝可梦的骨骼与巨石结合，诞生了POKENAME。它很少活动，藏在岩缝或洞穴中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Bones of deceased Pokémon combined with boulders to create POKENAME. It is very inactive and hides in crevices or caves.

entry: POKENAME裹着来历不明的阴暗破布。它能把骨骼缩入其中，喷出尘雾，再消失不见。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is wrapped in gloomy rags whose origin is unknown. It can withdraw its bones inside and emit dust before disappearing.

entry: 它是一堆主要由毒素与灵魂组成的污泥，专门盯上人类。一旦被盯上，就完了。
author: themicelegion
source: A pile of sludge composed primarily of poison and souls. It targets humans specifically. Once it has its eyes on you, you're done for.

entry: 困在夜巡灵与臭泥融合体中的灵魂若无法往生，便会因愤怒而化成POKENAME。
author: Sottiwotti
source: When the souls trapped in Dusmer are unable to move on, they become enraged and turn into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常在遗迹附近，喜欢吓唬探险者，甚至常令对方心脏病发，丢了性命。
author: Sottiwotti
source: They are often found near ruins. POKENAME likes to scare adventurers exploring the ruins, often giving them a fatal heart attack.

entry: POKENAME是一颗巨大浮空眼球。没人知道POKENAME的来历，只知它入夜苏醒，四处觅食。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME has the appearance of a giant floating eyeball. No one knows the origins of POKENAME. It awakens in the night to seek prey.

entry: 它出现在林中迷路者面前，将他们引回自己的住处，迎接毁灭。
author: mercury_sc
source: It appears to people who have become lost in the woods. It will guide them to its home, where they meet their doom.

entry: 空心身体里藏着幽灵火焰。受到惊吓时，体色变幻，显露真形。
author: anarchaz
source: Housing a spectral flame, its hollow body shifts hues when startled, revealing its true form.

entry: POKENAME凭波导强弱寻找濒死之人，还能模仿亲人声音，将受害者引来。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME searches for those who are near death by the strength of their aura. It can mimic the voices of loved ones to lure victims towards it.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: 直视POKENAME的眼睛，会让它吸走你的灵魂。被夺过魂的人，它都能将形貌与声音模仿得分毫不差。
author: JokersWild
source: Looking directly into a POKENAME's eye will allow it to siphon your soul. It can perfectly mimic the form and voice of anyone it has done this to.

entry: 传说POKENAME偶尔会吸干人的生命，那些人便再不见踪影。有人担心它再次现身，因而惶恐不安。
author: .ssunday.
source: Legends say POKENAME has rarely sucked the life out of humans, who are never seen again. Some people think it'll come out again, causing terror.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: 缠满绷带的身体看似中空，却灌满黑暗魔法。POKENAME能从腹部的骷髅，将魔法释放出来。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its bandaged body appears hollow, but it is imbued with a dark magic that POKENAME can emit via the skull on its stomach.

entry: 古老神话称，POKENAME是遭渔人捕杀的巨牙鲨化成的怨灵，永远寻找杀死自己的渔夫。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: An ancient myth states that POKENAME are the vengeful spirits of fished-up Sharpedo, forever searching for the fishermen that killed them.

entry: 培育这种POKENAME，只为让它承受动用更多力量的负担。可惜，并没有成效。
author: themicelegion
source: This breed of POKENAME was bred for the sole purpose of withstanding using more power. This was sadly ineffective.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡视河岸。靠近POKENAME的人，却常莫名昏迷，被冲到下游才让人发现。
author: TheKRT
source: POKENAME are found patrolling the banks of rivers at night. Those who have approached POKENAME are mysteriously found unconsious, washed up downriver.

entry: POKENAME一看见谁，就会盯住，缓慢而坚定地跟上。曾受其害的人说，连噩梦里，它也在一直注视。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As soon as POKENAME sees someone, it stares at them and follows them slowly but purposefully. Past victims report nightmares in which it watched them.

entry: 唯一的手臂能伸到极远处，猛力砸向敌人。少数幸存者，都会感到人生如走马灯般掠过眼前。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its singular arm can stretch to vast distances, slamming down on foes with immense force. Those few who survive see their life flash before them.

entry: POKENAME将你推入巨口之前，你会先听到学童的欢笑。
author: bobosmith01
source: You will hear the sound of schoolchildren laughing before POKENAME pushes you into its maw.

entry: POKENAME将你推入巨口之前，你会先听到学童的欢笑。
author: bobosmith01
source: You will hear the sound of schoolchildren laughing before POKENAME pushes you into its maw.

entry: 若有宝可梦惹恼了它，POKENAME就会将对方拖往海底，送进灵界，从此再也不见踪影。
author: bobosmith01
source: When another Pokémon upsets it, POKENAME will drag it to the bottom of the ocean and into the spirit world, where they are never seen again.

entry: 据说POKENAME从深处现身，给残酷的训练家带来致命审判。只需一触，就能夺魂。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME is said to have emerged from the depths to deliver a fatal judgment to cruel trainers. It can claim a soul with just a touch.

entry: POKENAME展示巨大爪子，威吓其他宝可梦。有人认为，腹部的嘴会吞食猎物的灵魂。
author: PepperThePirate
source: POKENAME shows off its massive claws to intimidate other Pokémon. Some believe it uses the mouth on its stomach to consume the souls of its prey.

entry: POKENAME不断吸取小型宝可梦的能量。若不如此，用来驱动双手的火焰便会消失。
author: ciellecreator
source: POKENAME spends its time sapping the energy of smaller Pokémon. If it doesn't, the flames that it uses to move its hands will vanish.

entry: 神奥的老人会向孙辈讲述邪恶POKENAME的故事，吓唬孩子，说它会出现，将人拖进黑暗之地。
author: cipherlingarde
source: To scare their grandchildren, elders of the Sinnoh region tell tales of the villainous POKENAME who appears to drag others down to a dark place.

entry: 据说与POKENAME凶恶的双眼对视，就会经历悲恸的每个阶段，凝视多久，便持续多久。
author: cipherlingarde
source: It is said that anyone who meets POKENAME's menacing eyes will go through each stage of grief for as long as they stare into them.

entry: 据说，它听从亡者的吩咐，斩杀曾伤害亡者的人，再将其径直送往灵界最黑暗的角落。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It's said to do the bidding of the dead, slaying those who have wronged them and delivering them straight to the darkest corner of the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME分节身体的每一部分，都能咬住对手。战斗时迅疾扭转翻滚，撕碎掌握中的一切。
author: Leshii
source: Each part of POKENAME's segmented body can bite down on a rival. In battle, it twists and rolls at dizzying speeds, shredding everything in its grasp.

entry: 它是凶狠狡猾的顶级猎手，用手状尾巴碾碎敌人或猎物，再拖进喉部的巨口。
author: inf0red
source: An aggressive and cunning apex predator. It crushes prey and foe alike with its hand-like tail, before dragging them into the maw at its gullet.

entry: POKENAME有“冥界守卫”之称，拦住迷失灵魂，不让它们返回人间。为何幽灵属性宝可梦可以通过，却无人知晓。
author: therider
source: POKENAME are known as "guardians of the afterlife", blocking lost souls from returning to the world. Why Ghost Pokémon are allowed through is unknown.

entry: POKENAME用头顶天线发出无线电波，与附近所有幽灵属性宝可梦交流，向它们发号施令。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME emits radio waves via the antenna on its head, allowing it to communicate with all Ghost Pokémon in the vicinity and give them commands.

entry: 人们认为它是来自天外的幽灵入侵者。因力量惊人、意志坚韧，被称为“力量天使”。
author: theeggoverlord
source: It is believed to be a ghostly invader from beyond the sky. Its immense strength and fortitude have led to people dubbing it "an Angel of Might".

entry: POKENAME独眼能看见人与宝可梦的灵魂，借此成群狩猎，击倒灵魂最强大的目标。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's single eye sees the spirits of people and Pokémon. It uses this power to hunt in packs and take down those with the strongest spirits.

entry: POKENAME夜里守着河岸，行动慢却十分凶猛。被POKENAME袭击的人，通常毫发无伤，却什么都不记得。
author: TheKRT
source: POKENAME are slow yet aggressive defenders of river banks at night. Those who POKENAME attack are usually unharmed, yet remember nothing.

entry: POKENAME能感知来自灵界的电波。它穿行于墓地，走过之处，彷徨的灵魂也随之离去。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME is able to sense radio waves from the spirit realm. It it seen moving through graveyards, and as it passes, it takes the spirits with it.

entry: 它极少被目击，资料也稀少。有人认为，它吞食灵魂，窃取其中知识，增益自身智慧。
author: admiralvermin
source: This fusion is rarely seen, so information on it is scarce. Some believe it consumes souls in order to steal their knowledge and add to its own.

entry: 因为没有脸，人们反而会盯着摆锤般的眼睛。凡落入其掌控者，之后命运如何，无人知晓。
author: HoundRyS
source: Its lack of a face leads people to instead watch its pendulum eye. The fate of any who fall under its control is unknown.

entry: POKENAME天生能融入水中并加以操纵。学者推测，大多数洋流都由它们的活动产生。
author: tuneless.towa
source: Their nature allows POKENAME to blend in with water and manipulate it. Scholars hypothesize that their movements generate most oceanic currents.

entry: POKENAME巡视海岸，寻找适合滤食之处。小翅膀让飞行十分吃力，游泳却是一流。
author: _sadfroggy
source: POKENAME patrols coastlines, looking for spots to filter feed. Although its small wings make flying an ordeal, it is an exceptional swimmer.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，让食物自己漂进嘴里。只有需要换气，才会游向水面。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME spends its time at the bottom of the ocean, allowing food to float into its mouth. It only moves to regain oxygen at the waters surface.

entry: POKENAME的脖子能伸长许多米，让头部成为有效的打击武器。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can stretch its neck for many meters, allowing it to use its head as an effective striking weapon.

entry: 它拥有陆地宝可梦中最长的脖子，几英里外的天敌都能看见。前头很温顺，后头却不然。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Sporting the longest neck of any land Pokémon, it can see predators approaching from miles away. The front head is very docile, while the back is not.

entry: POKENAME用充满空气的头浮在水面。只有少数潜水员，见过它真正的体型。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME uses its air-filled head to float on water. Only a few divers have seen its true size.

entry: 它的笑容，让海陆一切生灵都看得目眩。任什么牙膏，也刷不出这等光彩。
author: spagalapof
source: Its smile dazzles every living thing on land and sea. No toothpaste has ever matched it.

entry: POKENAME大多待在海中，偶尔也会在小海湾与沙滩边游荡。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in the ocean. They are sometimes seen wandering around coves and beaches.

entry: POKENAME住在造船厂附近，爱逛水手常去的地方，以惊人怪力和爱吃菠菜闻名。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME live near shipyards and loiter where sailors usually would. They are known for their wicked strength and their penchant for eating spinach.

entry: POKENAME是为战斗而生的魁梧巨兽，食量大得荒唐，常被养在专为填饱它们而建的牧场。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are hulking behemoths built for battle. They eat absurd amounts of food and are often raised on ranches purpose-built to sate their appetite.

entry: POKENAME罕见又刚被发现，却成了伪科学爱好者的宠儿，还常被误称为“最早在陆地生活的宝可梦”。
author: Leeto64
source: Despite being a rare, recent discovery, it's a favorite in pseudoscience. POKENAME is commonly incorrectly called 'The First Land-Living Pokémon'.

entry: POKENAME重200公斤，一击便能压扁车辆或整群鱼，吞尽其中生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Weighing in at 200kg, POKENAME can flatten vehicles or entire schools of fish to consume all their life force in one blow.

entry: 这些活锤砸落的力道，只有气动压力机能比拟。可实在太重，根本无法拿来挥舞。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The force of these animate hammers when crashing down is rivalled only by pneumatic presses. However, wielding them is impossible with their weight.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为体色更浓的吼吼鲸。也有人觉得，不过是嘴巴更大一点的吼吼鲸。
author: .ssunday.
source: People mistake POKENAME for a more saturated Wailmer. However, some people consider this to be a Wailmer with a bigger mouth.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的般地游海，很少受打扰。可一发现猎物，就会以惊人速度猛冲过去。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is rarely disturbed as it roams the sea seemingly without aim. However, it will shoot forward at considerable speed if it spots prey.

entry: POKENAME半埋在海床沙中，一动不动等待猎物。目标一出现，便扑出将其整个吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives on the seabed, half-buried in the sand, where it lies motionless in wait for prey. If it spots any, it lunges and devours them whole.

entry: 这些巨物沿海床移动，便开出海沟。修建公路与地铁隧道时，也很有用处。
author: wigglypon
source: These giants create marine trenches as they travel along the seafloor. They have proven useful in construction of tunnels for roads and subway trains.

entry: 民间故事常告诫人们，别贸然摆弄POKENAME。据说它一爆炸，整片地区转眼便会灰飞烟灭。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: A popular folk tale advises against recklessly handling POKENAME. Its explosions are said to annihilate entire regions in the blink of an eye.

entry: 它比其他虫宝可梦长得快得多。据传，中了它毒针的毒，就再也无法治好。
author: b_megamaths
source: It grows much faster than other bug Pokémon. The poison applied by its stinger is rumored to be incurable.

entry: POKENAME看似细小，却有难以言喻的塑造宇宙之力。可它宁愿把时间花在啃叶子上。
author: CrypticanEXE
source: Despite its small appearance, POKENAME has unspeakable powers to shape the universe. However, it prefers to spend its time munching leaves instead.

entry: 它以音速穿过宇宙。力量浩瀚，却完全无法掌控。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It shoots across the cosmos at the speed of sound. Its power is vast, but it has no control over it.

entry: POKENAME是人们赋予这个存在的名字。来历仍令全球科学家费解，有理论认为，它是创世的一部分。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is the given name of an entity whose origins are still a mystery to scientists around the world. It is theorized to be a piece of creation.

entry: 古老的故事说，POKENAME拥有所有宝可梦的基因。传说还说，它曾用特殊的力量创造世界。
author: Thora Daughn
source: Tales of old tell that POKENAME holds the DNA of all Pokémon. Legends also tell it used its special powers to create the world.

entry: 稍被招惹，它就以炽热火焰轰击四周一切。许多想驯服它的人，都被旁人视为疯子。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It blasts anything around it with bolts of searing fire at the slightest provocation. Many who have wished to tame it have been brushed off as insane.

entry: POKENAME守护着升华的小陨星。据说它与星辰本身为友，可无人知道是真事，还是传说。
author: charmingloopy
source: POKENAME is the guardian of ascended Minior. It is said to be friends with the stars themselves, but no one knows if that is true or just a legend.

entry: POKENAME极度傲慢。越自负，就越强大。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is massively arrogant. It grows stronger as it becomes more prideful.

entry: 它只存在于美食传说之中。据说喝下极其浓醇的乳汁，便能短暂与宇宙合而为一。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its existence is spoken of only in culinary legend. Consuming its immensely rich milk is believed to briefly make you one with the universe.

entry: POKENAME酷似古时洗翠赞颂创世神而建的神社。它究竟自然诞生，还是人工制造，始终争论不休。
author: ansleehariot
source: As it resembles shrines built in praise of an early Hisuian creator deity, debates have raged on whether POKENAME's existence is natural or man-made.

entry: 它奇妙地酷似洗翠传说中失落的暴君，性情却大多仁慈。也十分害羞，总主动避开寻访者。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It oddly resembles a lost tyrant of Hisuian legend, but it is largely benevolent. It is also immensely shy, actively avoiding those who seek it.

entry: 它令人费解，似乎有些神性，却一心忙着挖土。对人类十分友善。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A confusing Pokémon that appears to have some level of godhood, but mainly sticks to digging. It's very friendly with humans.

entry: POKENAME有“神之子”的称号，人们因此像崇拜阿尔宙斯本尊一样敬奉它。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is given the title of God's Child. Because of this, people worship POKENAME as if it was Arceus itself.

entry: 多数生灵一见POKENAME，就被不祥气息震慑，不敢进攻。它的身体却始终静止，浮在空中。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most beings who bear witness to POKENAME are too overwhelmed by its foreboding aura to attack. Its body remains completely still, floating in the sky.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME狂妄自大，总吹嘘自己凌驾众生。还有个古怪爱好：追逐野生六尾。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME is a creature of great hubris, often bragging about its superiority to all creatures. It has a strange hobby of chasing wild Vulpix.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: 它的花，被认为与一种早已灭绝、曾遍布卡洛斯的花互为姐妹种。攻击时，会爆发虹彩般的花粉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its bloom is thought to be a sister species to a long-extinct flower that once grew abundantly in Kalos. It attacks with iridescent bursts of pollen.

entry: 无穷力量，让它和蔼又以爱好和平闻名。可神话中，惹怒它者会遭无休止的无情惩击。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its affable nature and legendary pacifism stem from its boundless power. Myth speaks of those who enrage it being smited endlessly without remorse.

entry: POKENAME力大无比，也擅长谋略、集结军队与掌控局势，因此被称为“丛林暴君”。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME have great strength and are experienced in strategizing, gathering an army, and taking control. They have been dubbed "The Jungle Tyrants".

entry: 它拥有宇宙中每种元素的力量。传说认为，这才是POKENAME真正力量的展现。
author: Zerpus
source: It has the powers of each and every element of the universe. Legends claim this is POKENAME tapping into its true power.

entry: POKENAME为保全凡人，以宝可梦的形体自限。一旦摆脱这层限制，便会现出奇异而流动的形状。
author: r.isk
source: POKENAME wears the form of a Pokémon so as to preserve the wellbeing of mortals. Unbound from that restriction, a strange and fluid shape emerges.

entry: 这只烈焰猴，已在灵性上彻底觉醒。POKENAME的灵魂，与整个宇宙相连。
author: mrdude_
source: An Infernape that has achieved a complete spiritual awakening. POKENAME's spirit is connected to the entire universe.

entry: POKENAME化作卡洛斯神话中的传奇长剑。据说那把剑，曾将地区从残酷的黑暗骑士手中解放。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME assumes the form of a legendary sword told of in Kalosian myth. The sword was said to have liberated the region from a cruel dark knight.

entry: POKENAME蕴含阿尔宙斯的伟力，据说能摧毁宇宙，与阿尔宙斯的创造之力维持平衡。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Imbued with the might of Arceus, POKENAME is said to have the power to destroy the universe to balance Arceus' creation.

entry: POKENAME蕴含阿尔宙斯的伟力，据说能摧毁宇宙，与阿尔宙斯的创造之力维持平衡。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Imbued with the might of Arceus, POKENAME is said to have the power to destroy the universe to balance Arceus' creation.

entry: 据说POKENAME是万剑之神，存在于每一把铸成的刀剑之中，能赋予持有者永生与巨力。
author: arch.stanton
source: It's said that POKENAME is the god of all swords, and lives within every blade ever forged. It grants its wielder immortality and immense power.

entry: 传说末日之时，POKENAME会伴着刺目光芒自天而降。人们每年献上供物，盼其息怒。
author: NellNast42
source: It is said that, in the end times, POKENAME will descend from the skies with a piercing light. Tributes are made each year to appease it.

entry: 据说POKENAME用七天创造了宝可梦世界，之后又开始了另一项至今无人知晓的计划。
author: gun2._
source: It is said that POKENAME created the Pokémon world in seven days. It's also said that it started another project, which is still unknown to this day.

entry: POKENAME的涡轮尾巴产生原初宇宙能量，使它能够动用创世之力。
author: JunohNebula
source: POKENAME's turbine tail generates a primal cosmic energy, allowing this fusion to tap into powers of creation.

entry: POKENAME会在梦中化作明光现身。凡目睹它的人，醒来后都会神情恍惚。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found within people's dreams, appearing as a bright light. Anyone who witnesses it can be found in a trance after waking.

entry: 神话称它为“世界之种”。POKENAME能向敌人射出数千根天界荆刺。
author: themicelegion
source: Mythology states this being is "The Seed of the World". POKENAME shoots off thousands of heavenly thorns at enemies.

entry: POKENAME是热情的神圣化身，多才多艺，能跳各式不同舞蹈。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME is a holy entity of passion. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.

entry: POKENAME是勇气的神圣化身，多才多艺，能跳各式不同舞蹈。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME is a holy entity of courage. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.

entry: POKENAME被视为优雅的神圣化身，多才多艺，能跳各式不同舞蹈。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME is considered a holy entity of grace. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.

entry: POKENAME是宁静的神圣化身，多才多艺，能跳各式不同舞蹈。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME is a holy entity of tranquility. Its versatility allows it to perform many different dances.

entry: 寓言称，触摸它就能掌控自身命运。碰巧，POKENAME并不喜欢身体接触。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: Fables claim touching it would allow someone to control their destiny. Coincidentally, POKENAME does not like physical contact.

entry: 据说十八根尖刺，蕴含着所有属性的力量。它以数百万针刺降下神罚，惩戒恶者。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its eighteen spines are said to contain the power of every type there is. It rains divine justice on the wicked in the form of millions of needles.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是夜之神。月相变化之时，力量日盛，脾气也越发暴躁。
author: ETheWriter
source: POKENAME is said to be the god of the night. Its power swells with the phases of the moon, as well as its temper.

entry: 据说POKENAME的脑海装着整个宇宙。里面发生的一切，它都听得见，因此头痛得厉害。
author: Cybresamurai
source: It's said that POKENAME's mind contains an entire universe. It hears everything that happens within, so it gets terrible headaches.

entry: 金色鬃毛的火焰璀璨闪耀，仿佛不属尘世。若不慎吸入灰烬，可能会在超凡的震撼中僵住。
author: clichonflareblitz
source: The flames of its brilliant, golden mane glitter like nothing in this world. Mistakenly inhaling its ashes could leave you frozen in unearthly shock.

entry: 冬季，身上的藤蔓会变深色，质地也像意大利面一般。
author: .izik
source: The vines covering its body grow darker during the winter months. During this time, they have the same consistency as pasta.

entry: 它从土里萌生，身体由叶片构成，尾巴则是泥土。温暖湿润的尾巴里，带着可供繁殖的芽苗。
author: HoundRyS
source: It sprouts out of the ground. Its body is made of leaves and its tail of dirt. It carries reproductive sprouts in its tail, which is warm and moist.

entry: 外壳坚如岩石，却又能灵活弯曲。人们正研究这些特性，开发各种用途的新材料。
author: antomelon
source: Its shell is hard as rock, yet surprisingly flexible. These properties are currently being studied to develop new materials for various purposes.

entry: POKENAME的土壤养分丰富，能让树果长得更快、更健康。据说悉心照顾POKENAME的土壤，还会带来好运。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's soil is filled with nutrients, which helps Berries grow faster and healthier. Taking care of POKENAME's soil is said to bring good luck.

entry: POKENAME诞生后，科学家成功借它从沙漠夺回土地，为这颗星球帮了大忙。
author: pokebio
source: Since the creation of POKENAME, scientists have managed to use it to take back land from the desert. It's considerably helped the planet that way.

entry: 它是常见的家养植物宝可梦，可爱又好照顾。POKENAME觉得安心、认定是家时，就会长出坚硬的盆状壳。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A common household plant Pokémon that is cute and easy to take care of. When POKENAME feels safe and at home, it grows a hard pot shell.

entry: 一群草苗龟与地鼠的融合体并排生长，会共同长出一个大花盆壳，而非各有各的壳。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When a group of Turtletts are grown side-by-side, they form one, large planter shell instead of individual ones.

entry: POKENAME发出古怪的咯咯声交流。听见别处也咯咯叫，它就会回应。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME makes a bizarre gobbling sound as a form of communication. It will make this sound if it hears others gobbling as well.

entry: POKENAME栖居沼泽，藏在水下，用酷似植物的尾巴伪装。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Found in marshes, POKENAME is known to hide underwater and disguise itself using its tail's plantlike resemblance.

entry: POKENAME每天花上数小时，修整头顶那座自身模样的树篱雕像，还会凶狠地保护叶片。
author: xtjs2018x
source: POKENAME spends multiple hours out of its day tending to the hedge sculpture of itself on its head. It defends the leaves fiercely.

entry: 它住在森林，用头上的壳撞树，震落果实与蛋。夜里，还会迸出细小火花。
author: mx_wellman
source: It lives in forests, using the shell on its head to knock down fruit and eggs from trees. They produce tiny sparks at night.

entry: POKENAME大多出现在红树林生长健康的沼泽，因令人安心的气息而受欢迎。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are mostly found in swamps where the mangroves are healthy. It's popular for its soothing aura.

entry: POKENAME吃下树果后，种子会从甲壳孔洞里长成新植物。身上的树，也是其他林中宝可梦的珍贵食物来源。
author: kittyluv090
source: When POKENAME eats berries, their seeds sprout new plants from the holes in its shell. Its trees are a valuable food source for other forest Pokémon.

entry: 背上的树大得足以让小宝可梦栖居。POKENAME动作太慢，住客几乎不会被摇下来。
author: PepperThePirate
source: The trees on its back are large enough for smaller Pokémon to live in. Since POKENAME is so sluggish, the inhabitants are rarely shaken out.

entry: 最大的POKENAME已成了动植物的浮空乐土。它会落地熟睡，让小宝可梦爬上身。
author: Mistymagius
source: The largest of POKENAME have become floating havens of flora and fauna. It sleeps soundly on the ground, allowing small Pokémon to climb on.

entry: 受威胁时，它会旋转身体，以锋利耳缘连连斩击敌人。强劲的喙，则能轻松咬开硬蔬菜。
author: wigglypon
source: It performs pirouettes when threatened, repeatedly slashing foes with its sharp-edged ears. Tough vegetables are no match for its strong beak.

entry: 据说POKENAME等待训练家多年，渐渐被草木覆盖。如今，灵魂控制着体内长出的木材。
author: puppetmaster64
source: It's said after years of waiting for its Trainer, POKENAME slowly became overgrown by foliage. Its spirit now controls the wood that grows inside it.

entry: 它既贪吃又慷慨，以此闻名。虽会大口吞吃自己的果实，却也乐意分享给每个遇见的家伙。
author: captainmodeus
source: This Pokémon is renowned for both its gluttony and generosity. It voraciously consumes its own fruit, but will gladly share them to anyone it meets.

entry: 没空或无力照顾土台龟的人，常会选择饲养POKENAME。个头小得多，照料也更省力。
author: .realthree
source: Those who do not have the time or energy to care for a Torterra often opt to catch a POKENAME instead. Being much smaller, it requires less work.

entry: POKENAME拔起树苗，栽进背部进行光合作用。树长得太大，就再换一棵新的。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME pull saplings from the ground and integrate them into their back for photosynthesis. Once it grows too big, they replace it with a new one.

entry: POKENAME行动迟缓，整天几乎不动地吃海草，因此背上长满各式藻类。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME is slow and sedentary while it grazes on seagrass all day. As a result, various kinds of algae have grown all over its back.

entry: 获得超能力后，它却变得胆怯，盼着有朝一日能足够强大，迎战更强的敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Being granted psychic powers, this Pokémon develops a timid personality. It wishes for the day when it has the power to take on stronger foes.

entry: POKENAME会在崎岖山巅成群玩耍，有时持剑对决，有时翩翩起舞，留下道道火迹。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME have been seen playing in groups atop craggy mountains. Sometimes they sword duel, and sometimes they dance, leaving behind trails of flames.

entry: POKENAME一天睡上20小时，战斗时却从不疲倦。以三片叶子为食，便能维持体内余火。
author: HoundRyS
source: This POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours daily, yet never tires when fighting. Its three-leaf diet keeps its embers alive.

entry: 体表圆球中有火焰燃烧。POKENAME受压时，火就会烧得更旺。
author: .izik
source: The orb on its body has a flame that burns inside. The intensity increases should a POKENAME become stressed.

entry: 雪峰市的工厂有时会雇用POKENAME。当地气候寒冷，人们更喜欢靠它们维持机器运转。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are sometimes employed at factories in Snowpoint City. Due to the cold climate, they are preferred to keep machinery running.

entry: 只有完全安心时，腹部火焰才会熄灭。它大量吃香蕉，为进化做好准备。
author: cait_sith
source: The fire on its abdomen only goes out when it feels completely safe. It feeds on plenty of bananas in preparation for evolution.

entry: POKENAME凭大耳朵听见数英里外的威胁，却胆小得连毒也不敢用。威胁若靠近，就赶快逃跑。
author: Canada
source: POKENAME uses its large ears to hear threats from miles away. It's too cowardly to use its poison, so it will flee if a threat gets too close.

entry: 耳朵对巨响极为敏感。有时人类什么都听不到，它却已捂住耳朵，畏缩不前。
author: .izik
source: Its ears are extremely sensitive to loud noises. Sometimes, it will cower while grasping at its ears in response to a sound humans cannot hear.

entry: 尾端有细小倒刺。战斗时，它会在空中胡乱挥尾，想让对手中毒。
author: .izik
source: Its tails have small barbs at the tips. When fighting, it will whip them wildly in the air, hoping to poison its foe.

entry: 雌雄同体的尼多宝可梦极少自然出现。进化之前，常被误认成普通尼多兰或尼多朗。
author: Staghorn
source: Hermaphroditic Nidoran are a rare natural occurrence. They are often mistaken for ordinary Nidoran until they evolve.

entry: 大耳朵能听见远处威胁。毒性越强，身上的毒刺也越大。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its large ears allows it to hear threats coming from far away. Its poison barbs grow larger the more poisonous it is.

entry: 它们控制不好角内的毒素。许多训练家只是在陪自己的POKENAME玩耍，就不慎中了毒。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: They struggle to regulate the toxins within their horn. Many Trainers have accidentally been poisoned while playing with their POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME让羽上的火焰膨大，吓退敌人，再有节奏地咕咕叫，邀请其他宝可梦来玩。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME enlarges the flames on its feathers to deter foes. It hoots rhythmically as to invite other Pokémon to play.

entry: POKENAME默默为丛林来客照亮道路。可被人喂惯了，已变得娇纵，总盼着带完路能得到零食。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME silently lights the way for those who visit its jungle home. Due to humans feeding it, it has become spoiled and expects a treat at the end.

entry: 它看似一动不动，其实一直留意着周围。POKENAME会让尾焰燃烧得更加明亮来威吓敌人，也能迅速发动攻击。
author: HoundRyS
source: Its inactivity is deceitful, as it's aware of its surroundings. POKÉNAME's tail flame burns brighter to intimidate threats, and it can strike quickly.

entry: 每到冬天，POKENAME就格外抢手。它的火焰温暖又舒适，能让食物瞬间解冻，用来烤棉花糖饼干也再合适不过。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME demand gets higher each winter, as the warmth its fire emanates is very soothing. It can thaw food in an instant and is great for s'mores.

entry: 这种POKENAME直接使年轻人咖啡因成瘾的情况增加，因此卡洛斯禁止了这种融合。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME is directly responsible for the rise of caffeine addiction in young people. For that reason, Kalos has banned this fusion.

entry: POKENAME很容易被激怒，转而攻击。这头烈焰公牛全速冲锋时，会点燃沿途一切。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME tend to be very easily enraged into attacking. When this blazing bull charges at full speed, it sets everything along its path aflame.

entry: POKENAME对实力极有信心，连战斗都保持侧卧。技艺高超得连果子会落在哪里，也能预知。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME is so confident in its power that it remains lying on its side, even in battles. It's so skilled, it can predict where fruit will fall.

entry: 血液燃烧，斗志也熊熊而起。两只交战时，能听到急促轰鸣；等响起大大的哈欠，才算打完。
author: HoundRyS
source: As their blood burns, so does their fighting spirit. When two engage in combat, quick, loud booms can be heard; loud yawning indicates when it ends.

entry: 熟睡时虽安宁，醒来后血流便会升温，使它们狂暴肆虐，所过之处只剩灰烬。
author: HoundRyS
source: Though peaceful while slumbering, when woken up, their blood flow will heat up, causing them to rampage, leaving only cinders behind.

entry: 传说有位解放战士，能为众人带来笑容。许多人相信，POKENAME现身便预示那位战士将归来。
author: mirby
source: Legends tell of a warrior of liberation that would bring smiles to all around. Many believe that POKENAME's appearance heralds that warrior's return.

entry: POKENAME能随心操纵身体，直抵天际。据说心跳听起来，如同鼓声。
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate its body at will to reach the heavens. It is said that you can hear the sound of drums coming from its heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME身上的“火焰”其实不是火，仍是棉絮，只是借火焰的幻象吓退天敌。
author: Patch_Bros
source: The flames on POKENAME are actually not flames at all. They are still cotton, but they give that illusion in order to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME整天不知疲倦地锻炼、进食、战斗。练成新武艺时，热血燃得更烈，却始终不肯满足。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME tirelessly train, eat, and fight all day. Their blood flow burns intensely as they master new martial arts; they are never satisfied.

entry: 有POKENAME在，任何靠近孩子的人都可能有性命之危。它保护欲过强，总用极端武术护住孩子。
author: .realthree
source: If a POKENAME is present, anyone who approaches a child is in mortal danger. It overzealously uses its extreme martial arts to protect children.

entry: POKENAME极为自豪于火焰鬃毛。为了不让头淋湿，什么都愿意做，连雨雪也会躲开。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME takes immense pride in its fiery mane. As a result, it will do anything to avoid getting its head wet, even hiding from the rain and snow.

entry: POKENAME平时不太留意四周。野生个体虽讨厌接受训练家投喂，却必须靠这些赠食才能活下去。
author: .ssunday.
source: This Pokémon is usually oblivious to its surroundings. Although wild POKENAME hate accepting food from Trainers, they need their gifts to survive.

entry: POKENAME正处在尴尬的成长阶段，自己却浑然不觉，仍像小时候那样骄傲地向前蹦跳。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is going through an awkward stage right now, but it doesn't seem to realize that. It pridefully bounds ahead as it did when it was smaller.

entry: POKENAME平时温和，只捕小鱼。可一受善待，就觉得对方在挑战自己的本领，随即发起攻击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is usually passive, hunting only small fish. However, when shown any kindness, it takes it as a challenge of its abilities and attacks.

entry: 面对敌人时，POKENAME总想表现得冷淡、严肃而高高在上；但在亲密的朋友面前，它其实十分爱玩。
author: bobosmith01
source: It tries to emulate an aloof, serious, and superior personality when it faces a foe, but among close friends, NAME is quite playful.

entry: POKENAME大多心情很好，可若被自己的大脚绊倒，就会觉得自尊受伤，哭起来。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are in a good mood most of the time, but when one trips over its large feet, its pride is hurt and it cries.

entry: POKENAME虽是植物，却能在最寒冷的环境存活，也是生态巨蛋中炎兔儿喜爱的零食。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME, although a plant, can survive the coldest environments. It's a popular snack for Scorbunny living in the Terarium.

entry: POKENAME用强劲双翼攻击时，头上会洒出清凉水滴，调节战斗中的体温。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME attacks using its mighty wings, droplets of cool water are sprinkled from its head. This water regulates its temperature as it fights.

entry: POKENAME很容易被冒犯，必须郑重尊重。若遭轻慢，就会对冒犯者施下诅咒。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is easily offended, so it should be treated with the utmost respect. Otherwise, it will inflict a curse upon the person who slighted it.

entry: POKENAME喜欢长途游泳。虽力量强大，却更爱指挥其他宝可梦，像船长使唤船员。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to go on long swims. Despite its considerable power, it prefers to order other Pokémon around, like a captain does its crew.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着曾被偷猎的帝王拿波的灵魂。为了复仇，它会劈开一整队偷猎船。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Said to be imbued with the spirit of the Empoleon it was poached from, POKENAME cleaves fleets of poaching ships in revenge.

entry: POKENAME从冰山顶守住领地，凭武艺将浮冰劈成两半，震慑来犯者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from atop icebergs, intimidating invaders with its martial prowess by cleaving ice floes in half.

entry: 头上角最大的POKENAME，会得到族群效忠，被推为首领。常能见到百足蜈蚣在旁护卫。
author: _adamos.
source: The POKENAME with the largest horns atop its head gains the loyalty of its group and is deemed its leader. It is often seen guarded by Venipede.

entry: POKENAME是冰河时代的王者。在精灵球被发明之前，它曾捕食早期人类。宝可梦融合技术使它再次苏醒。
author: Creep0202
source: The king of the ice age, POKENAME was a predator to early humans before the invention of Poké Balls and have been revived due to Pokémon fusion.

entry: POKENAME的三个头都十分优雅。可只要一个犯错，就赖给另一个，彼此从不和睦。
author: .ssunday.
source: All three heads of a POKENAME are extremely elegant. If one of the heads makes a mistake, they blame it on another. They never get along.

entry: 它们把三叉戟状的角抵着石头般的钳子摩擦，磨得锋利。有时磨得太投入，反而摔倒。
author: themicelegion
source: These Pokémon sharpen their trident-shaped horns by scratching them against its rocklike pincers. It can get carried away doing this and fall over.

entry: 它用鼻子辨别所居海域的水流方向，岩石般的硬身体则能抵御天敌。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its nose is used to navigate the currents of the seas it inhabits. Its rock-hard body defends it from predators.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子和耳朵，精准定位磁场与值得探查之处，因此常被用于地下救援。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME use their nose and ears to pinpoint magnetic fields and areas of interest. Because of this, they're commonly used in underground rescues.

entry: 鼻环由实心岩石构成。它用鼻环困住猎物，不让对方逃脱。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: Its nose ring is made of solid rock. It uses it to trap prey and prevent it from getting away.

entry: POKENAME一打喷嚏，就会掀起楼房般的巨浪，因此POKENAME在许多地区都被禁止融合。
author: scotsman
source: When POKENAME sneezes, tidal waves as large as buildings are formed. This has caused POKENAME to be a banned fusion in many regions.

entry: POKENAME常被各大社交平台拿来当表情包。
author: ValtsuRi
source: POKENAME is commonly used as a reaction image on many social media platforms.

entry: POKENAME战胜目标后，会吸入其生命力维生。不论悬浮着还是被人握着，它都会自然指向北方。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sustains itself by inhaling the life force of its victim after defeating them in battle. While floating or held, it naturally points north.

entry: 环绕POKENAME的电气场，总有一部分被拉向北方，成为许多探险者可靠的指路标。
author: Phantom640
source: A part of the electric aura surrounding POKENAME will always be pulled north, making it a reliable source of navigation for many explorers.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却有辨认方向的第六感。飞机上的卫星导航失灵或断线时，就会请它充当指南针。
author: .ssunday.
source: Although blind, POKENAME can use its sixth sense of direction to guide it. Planes use it as a compass if the GPS breaks or loses connection.

entry: POKENAME从岩壁吸取物质为食。过去，POKENAME凭着毫无偏差的方向感，常被用来送信。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME leech material out of rock faces to eat. In olden times, POKENAME were used to deliver messages due to their impeccable sense of direction.

entry: POKENAME最爱金属含量高的石头。吃完一颗，便会转向下一颗磁石所在的方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME always prefers stones with the highest metal content. Once it has eaten one, it turns in the direction of the next magnetic stone.

entry: 角能释放强磁场，吸来富铁岩石，再反转磁极，将岩石作为危险弹丸射出。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its horn can emit a strong magnetic field, attracting iron-rich stones. It then reverses the field's polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: 它用角释放强磁力，吸来金属含量高的岩石，再改变磁极，将它们作为危险弹丸射出。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: 它用角释放强磁力，吸来金属含量高的岩石，再改变磁极，将它们作为危险弹丸射出。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: POKENAME体温升高，使小朝北鼻更难控制。科学家研究它们，想更深入理解恒星磁场。
author: spriter
source: POKENAME's increased body temperature made its Mini-Noses harder to control. Scientists study them to better understand the magnetic fields of stars.

entry: 背部如同太阳能驱动的超级磁铁。晴天的磁场，足以把飞机从空中拉下。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its back acts as a solar-powered super magnet. On sunny days, its magnetic field is capable of pulling planes from the sky.

entry: POKENAME靠磁场飞行，也会吸来各种金属碎屑，在鼻子下面聚成一大团。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME uses magnetic fields to fly through the air. It attracts all sorts of metal detritus to it, which collects in a large clump under its nose.

entry: 胡须模仿海面，悬浮的POKENAME则像在海上航行的船。无论去哪儿，身后都有小部件跟随。
author: merumsb
source: When levitates, POKENAME looks like a ship sailing through the sea that its mustache emulates. It has small units that follow it wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME专注力与耐力出众，是老练的斗士，喜欢在崖边冥想。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses a high level of focus and endurance, allowing it to become a seasoned fighter. It enjoys meditating on cliffsides.

entry: 花园里的POKENAME雕像，比真正的宝可梦还多。它留下的铁粉能滋养土壤，因此被视为沃土的象征。
author: .realthree
source: Garden statues of POKENAME outnumber the actual Pokémon. Because the ferrous dust it leaves enriches soil, it's used as a symbol of fertile land.

entry: POKENAME能从头部电磁铁释放强大电磁脉冲，让附近所有电子设备停摆。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can emit a powerful EMP via the electromagnet in its head, deactivating everything electronic in its vicinity.

entry: 幽灵能量，让金属聚集在双臂的头部周围。人们认为，它会将亡魂引往彼岸。
author: moopse
source: Ghostly energy causes metal to collect around the heads on its arms. It's thought to direct souls to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME会在隐蔽磁性金属矿床附近钻出地面。制造企业常靠它寻找稀有矿物。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME surfaces near hidden deposits of magnetic metals. It is commonly used by manufacturing companies to sniff out rare minerals.

entry: 它用强磁场让皮毛覆满金属，化作护身铠甲。出拳的威力，犹如掷出巨石。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Using its strong magnetic field, it coats its fur in metal to act as armor for its body. Its punches are equivalent to boulders being thrown.

entry: POKENAME挥动布带，似乎能迷住目标，随后POKENAME便冲上去，狠狠咬住对方。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's cloth seems to enchant its victims when waved around before POKENAME charges and bites down on them.

entry: 一位很久以前战败的见习骑士，灵魂至今还附在佩剑上，始终准备着，再去做一番大事。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The spirit of a long-defeated squire is still in possession of its sword and still ready to go and do great deeds.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的尾巴铲土。领地争斗时，也会拿尾巴互相冲刺交锋。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME use their blade-like tails to move dirt, akin to a spade, but also use them to joust with one another during territorial conflict.

entry: 身披坚如钢铁的壳，它用头上锐角不断猛攻对手。
author: togetik
source: Clad in a steel-hard shell, it relentlessly attacks its opponent with the sharp horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME号令一群忠诚追随者。阴森的幽灵气势，让敢于挑战其权威的家伙心生畏惧。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME commands a flock of loyal followers. Its spectral presence strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare challenge its authority.

entry: POKENAME凭顽强意志，撑过本该致命的伤口。不过插在颈间的剑，仍会影响它的身体。
author: Ayner
source: The sheer determination of POKENAME has made it able to withstand its normally fatal wound. The sword in its neck can influence the body nonetheless.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: 这只POKENAME正在分裂，尝试新的战术。两条缎带，也让动作更加灵巧。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This POKENAME is in the process of splitting. It is attempting new tactics and its two ribbons give it more dexterity.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: POKENAME身长增加，如今改用长剑剑术，不再沿用短剑的招法。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword techniques.

entry: 拥有POKENAME的人，都会与它产生深厚感情。它便借这份牵绊，慢慢吸走对方的能量。
author: .realthree
source: Those who own a POKENAME become emotionally attached to it. It uses this bond to siphon off their energy.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME成群聚集，用月之石碎片铸剑，再始终带在身边。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: During a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather to forge their swords out of Moon Stone fragments. They will carry these swords with them at all times.

entry: 体内寄居着亡者的灵魂。它不知疲倦地四处奔走，只为完成那个灵魂的遗愿。
author: b_megamaths
source: A departed soul rests inside this Pokémon. It tirelessly seeks to fulfill that soul's dying wish.

entry: 据说独剑鞘曾怜惜一只孤独的小火龙，任它握起自己。如今，两者英勇冒险，铲除邪恶。
author: NellNast42
source: It is said that a Honedge once took pity on a lonely Charmander, allowing itself to be wielded. Now, the two adventure valiantly to vanquish all evil.

entry: 每击倒一个敌人，POKENAME的气球就会膨大一些。若把剑刃从气球上拔走，气球便会泄气。
author: abstr
source: POKENAME's balloon inflates bigger with every fallen foe. If its blade were to be removed from the balloon, it would deflate.

entry: 几只酷似独剑鞘的宝可梦寄居在灰尘山的空壳内。每把穿出皮肤的刀刃，都属于藏在里面的不同个体。
author: DuskRD
source: Several Pokémon resembling Honedge have infested the husk of a Garbodor. Every blade piercing its skin belongs to a unique member hiding inside.

entry: 据说被POKENAME斩杀者的灵魂，会永远困在刀刃之中。
author: norskdaedalus
source: It is said that the souls of those slain by POKENAME are trapped forever within its blade.

entry: POKENAME花瓣中卡着的刀刃根本无法挪动。它已夺走霸王花的灵魂，如今控制着空壳。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: The blade trapped within POKENAME's petals is impossible to move. This is because it has taken the soul of the Vileplume, and now controls its husk.

entry: 独剑鞘已接管火恐龙部分身体。不过战斗动作反而更灵活，因此火恐龙并不反对。
author: NellNast42
source: Honedge has now taken over part of Charmeleon's body. However, this improves their movement in battle, so the Charmeleon does not object.

entry: POKENAME骄傲自负，只听有利自己的命令。据说它们有九条命，却总是鲁莽地白白挥霍。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon, only listening to commands that benefit them. It is said that they have nine lives, but spend most of them recklessly.

entry: 意识分在剑与本体之间。若换给它一把没有意识的剑，就会发现它的剑术其实很差。
author: Staghorn
source: Its consciousness is split between its sword and its main body. When given a nonsentient blade, its swordsmanship is revealed to be poor.

entry: 喷火龙与独剑鞘如今配合得天衣无缝。在战场上，POKENAME的剑刃与烈焰都不可轻视。
author: NellNast42
source: Charizard and Honedge are now in perfect sync with one another. Both POKENAME's blade and flames are not to taken lightly on the battlefield.

entry: 残酷的融合让嵌入其中的独剑鞘之灵，寄居小拳石体内。尽管疼痛，POKENAME仍用新身体挥剑。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A brutal fusion, the spirit of the wedged Honedge now inhabits the body of a Geodude. Though painful, POKENAME wields its sword with its new body.

entry: 隆隆石的身体被独剑鞘之灵附身，成了既善格斗又力大无比的战士。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The body of the Graveler possessed by the spirit of a Honedge makes it a formidable martial fighter and brute.

entry: 布制翅膀的浮空效果，竟意外出色。它俯冲斩击敌人，再以粉末扰乱目标。
author: Xephyr
source: The cloth that comprises its wings is surprisingly effective at keeping it airborne. It dives and slashes at foes, using powders to disorient targets.

entry: 据说POKENAME是疯狂发明家的失败实验，行为时常失常，难以预料。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is said to be the failed experiment of a mad inventor. It behavior is often errant and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME游在古战场附近的海岸，会收集找到的阵亡武士兵器，添入自己的武库。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME swims near the shores of ancient battle sites. It will add the weapons of fallen warriors it finds to its arsenal.

entry: 胸前的眼睛时刻留意危险。头上刀刃却太钝，不能用来战斗。
author: b_megamaths
source: The eye on its chest is always on the lookout for danger. The blades on its head are too dull to use for combat.

entry: 长出第二根角后，它会以强大威力精准追击敌人。
author: togetik
source: Having grown a second horn, it pursues its enemy with devastating precision and power.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会拔出小匕首装凶。可个头太小，反而常被嘲笑。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will try to act fierce by unsheathing its tiny daggers. It often gets laughed at due to its small stature.

entry: POKENAME另有一个幽灵形态的心智。幽灵在旁预警，它则优雅地挥舞双剑。
author: T.I.A.
source: POKENAME have a second mind in the form of a specter. The specter warns of danger as they elegantly slash with their two swords.

entry: 模样酷似古代英雄。人们会请它充当守卫，保护贵重物品。
author: Sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon resembles a hero from ancient times. They are used as guardians to protect valuable items.

entry: 它精通剑术，也擅使阴招。刀刃与角护住四面八方，让敌人无从偷袭。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A master of swordsmanship and underhanded tactics alike. Its blades and horns allow it to cover all sides, making ambush impossible.

entry: POKENAME已部分分裂，主要边旋转边前进攻击，攻势令大多数斗士难以招架。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME has partially split, and attacks primarily by spinning and advancing. Its movements are overwhelming to most fighters.

entry: 三剑攻势复杂莫测，连剑术造诣极高的对手也挡不住。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The complex attack patterns of its three swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

entry: 这只POKENAME暂时认定，还是用单一形态容纳新力量最合适。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This POKENAME has decided its newfound abilities are best contained in its single form, for now.

entry: 它好奇心旺盛，常用臂上刀刃切开东西，只为看看里面长什么样。
author: b_megamaths
source: It has an incredibly curious nature. It will often cut through things using the blades on its arms to see what they look like on the inside.

entry: 它能感知附近人的情绪。据传，还会盯着心藏秘密的人不放。
author: b_megamaths
source: It is able to sense the emotions of nearby people. It is rumored to stare at people who are hiding secrets.

entry: POKENAME双刀所向披靡，轻易斩开敌人。每次挥斩时，威猛的铠甲都令人胆寒。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME wields dual blades with unstoppable force, slicing through foes effortlessly. Their formidable armor strikes fear into foes with each swing.

entry: 传闻它不死不灭。也有人说，若主人曾善待它，它就会替训练家完成遗愿。
author: b_megamaths
source: It is rumored to be immortal. It is also rumored to carry out the dying wish of its Trainer if it was treated well.

entry: POKENAME以双刃作桩，将自己钉牢地面，令空中猎食者不敢下手。锯齿巨口，则如钢制捕熊夹般强劲。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's dual blades act like stakes, nailing it to the ground to discourage aerial predators. Its jagged mouth is as powerful as a steel bear trap.

entry: 它十分害羞。有人靠近，就用两侧缎带遮住眼睛。
author: b_megamaths
source: It is an exceptionally shy Pokémon. If approached, it covers its eye using the ribbons at its sides.

entry: 身上刀刃锋利得能切开钢铁。可动作不够灵巧，无法有效运用。
author: b_megamaths
source: The blades on its body are sharp enough to cut through steel. It lacks the dexterity to use them effectively, however.

entry: 随着成长，体表液体慢慢覆上刀刃。成熟后，对刀刃的控制也更加自如。
author: b_megamaths
source: As it grows, the liquid enveloping its body slowly covers the blades. This gives it more control over them as it matures.

entry: 进化后，群体内的成员数量翻倍。害怕被盯着看或害怕尖锐物品的训练家，不适合训练它。
author: DuskRD
source: The number of members in the colony has doubled during its evolution. Trainers with scopophobia or aichmophobia should not train this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不断发出令人不安的金属尖叫。有些人推测，四下无人听见时，它或许就会停下。
author: norskdaedalus
source: POKENAME constantly emits an unnerving metallic screeching sound, though some speculate that it may cease when none are around to hear it.

entry: 它是久远暴行留下的幽影。人类只消看一眼，就会受催眠引诱，走进它的颈手枷。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A phantom of atrocities long past. Simply looking at it causes a hypnotizing effect to humans, drawing them into its pillory.

entry: 它爱在废弃城堡筑巢，歌声如同小号吹响迎宾号曲。
author: b_megamaths
source: It likes to build nests in abandoned castles. Its song resembles a trumpet's fanfare.

entry: 它从不背后袭敌。双翼既可当铠甲，也能用来飞行。
author: b_megamaths
source: It never attacks an opponent from behind. Its wings are used for armor as well as flight.

entry: 野生POKENAME常把树果串在头上刀刃，留着以后吃。若在寒地长大，围巾也会变长。
author: b_megamaths
source: Wild POKENAME will often skewer Berries on the blades on their heads to be eaten later. If raised in colder weather, its scarf will grow longer.

entry: 身体各处的眼睛，留意每个方向的危险。围巾末端十分灵巧，甚至能从树上摘果。
author: b_megamaths
source: It watches for danger from any direction using the eyes on its body. The ends of its scarf are dexterous enough to pluck Berries from trees.

entry: 野生POKENAME拼命向更强的宝可梦挑战，想在战斗中证明自己，因此很受士兵与战士的青睐。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME try desperately to prove themselves in battle against stronger Pokémon. They are highly sought after by soldiers and warriors.

entry: POKENAME背上的刀刃蕴含庞大幽灵之力。可喷火龙每次使用，都会被双剑鞘抽取生命力。
author: NellNast42
source: The blades on POKENAME's back hold immense spectral power. However, each time Charizard uses them, Doublade drains its life force.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼，只为更加强大。剑术与体力，都能化为它们的优势。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼，只为更加强大。剑术与体力，都能化为它们的优势。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME高速翻滚，以长剑一路斩开敌阵。
author: themicelegion
source: When in battle, POKENAME rolls at high speeds, slashing its way through enemies with its swords.

entry: 多年训练，让POKENAME能以剑状双腿完美地保持平衡。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Thanks to years of training, POKENAME is able to balance on its sword-like legs perfectly.

entry: 据说，每只POKENAME都寄宿着王族的灵魂。它的意志与铠甲一样坚不可摧，即使败局已定，也绝不低头。
author: Xillo
source: It is said that each POKENAME possesses the soul of royalty. Indomitable in both spirit and armor, this Pokémon never yields, even in assured defeat.

entry: 融合能量染上了花朵。胸前宝石是有自身意识，还是仅在辅助能力，仍有争论。
author: noilaedi [Sprite Artist]
source: The energy from fusion has tinted its flowers. It's debated if the jewel on its chest is sentient or assisting in its abilities.

entry: POKENAME是忠于荣誉的骑士，永远保护王室。传说400年前大战中，曾有获选的POKENAME斩杀邪恶领主。
author: leeto64
source: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.

entry: POKENAME始终勇敢重诺，据说是从异世界穿越时间而来的骑士。
author: Adoster
source: Always displaying courage and honor, POKENAME are rumored to be time-traveling knights from another world.

entry: POKENAME是忠于荣誉的骑士，永远保护王室。传说400年前大战中，曾有获选的POKENAME斩杀邪恶领主。
author: leeto64
source: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.

entry: POKENAME把坚如钢铁的壳取下一部分，制成武器，漫游大地，惩击心怀邪念的家伙。
author: togetik
source: Fashioning parts of its own steel-hard shell into weapons, POKENAME roams the land to smite those with wicked ambitions in their hearts.

entry: 据说POKENAME每百年才会现身一次，向强大而公正的领袖宣誓效忠。
author: togetik
source: It is said that POKENAME only appears every hundred years to vow its loyalty to a powerful and just leader.

entry: POKENAME以各种咒术与剑法压倒敌人。可一旦丢失咒刃，就无法战斗。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME overwhelms its foes with various spells and swordplay. It's unable to fight if the Hexblade is lost.

entry: 它是无可比拟的魔剑士。一挥剑，就根本猜不到迎面袭来的是钢刃，还是无双魔法。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A spellsword beyond compare. One can never tell when it wields its blade whether one will be hit with steel or incomparable magic.

entry: POKENAME的亮甲无法穿透。因此争斗的POKENAME不用剑，而是互射岩石，试图把甲砸出凹痕。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's shiny armor is completely impenetrable. Thus, rather than using their blades, rival POKENAME shoot rocks at each other to dent the armor.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳能制成虹彩首饰。可POKENAME都是剑术高手，难以捕捉，这种材料也就格外稀有。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's carapace is used to make iridescent jewelry, but as POKENAME are expert swordsmen and quite hard to catch, the material is very rare.

entry: 它是对认可之主绝对忠诚的骑士。长枪快如子弹，据说能从被刺中者身上驱除邪恶。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A knight of impeccable loyalty to those it deems master. Its spear strikes with the speed of a bullet, and is said to drive evil out from its victims.

entry: 铠甲之下，藏着极为重情的性格。它保护村落免遭暴走宝可梦侵害，还会训练新战士，追随自己的脚步。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its armor hides a deeply sentimental disposition. It defends villages from rampaging Pokémon, and even trains new warriors to follow its lead.

entry: 古老的传说中，POKENAME会引导逝去的训练家前往来世。它尤其偏爱英勇的训练家。
author: Onigamer97
source: Old legends of POKENAME describe it guiding fallen Trainers to the afterlife. It favors heroic Trainers.

entry: 据说POKENAME由108名浪人的灵魂组成。无人见过刀尖，因为出招比闪电还快。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME is said to have been formed of the souls of 108 ronin. The tip of its blade has never been seen, for its strikes land faster than lightning.

entry: POKENAME凭波导察觉身边邪恶，行侠仗义，保护四周所有其他宝可梦。
author: rigelpogi08
source: POKENAME's aura helps it detect evil in its presence. This helps it do heroic deeds and protect all other Pokémon around it.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME曾守护一个被遗忘的王国。即便如今，仍在寻找毁掉家园的仇敌。
author: MidnightUmbreon💙
source: An old legend depicts POKENAME as the former guardian of a long-forgotten kingdom. Even now, it seeks out those who destroyed its home.

entry: 各地都知道，POKENAME会在英雄危急时刻现身，给他们武装，迎战强敌。
author: TomatoSalad
source: POKENAME is known throughout the lands to appear to heroes in their time of need, arming them to fight great foes.

entry: 古代君王常倚重POKENAME感知危险的能力。它一察觉入侵者，便会凶猛出击。
author: Thora Daughn
source: Commonly used by ancient kings for its abilities to sense danger. POKENAME would sense intruders and strike viciously.

entry: 它似乎能看出与生俱来的领袖资质。传说获其认可者，注定会成为领主。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become a lord.

entry: POKENAME凭钢刃的力道与重量，能劈开任何对手。可它的另一半，却已被夺走。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade, but it was robbed of its other half.

entry: POKENAME很少用盾，宁可不停猛攻，以迅捷斩击压倒敌人。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's shield is rarely used in combat, as they prefer to relentlessly attack and overwhelm foes with their quick slashes.

entry: 古时，坚盾司令曾为君王担任侍卫，以利刃替主人施行公正裁决，深受器重。
author: Therider
source: In ancient times, Aegisharp served as guards for ancient kings. Its blades made righteous judgements for its master, and it was highly favored.

entry: POKENAME能从头部与双臂长出武士刀，施展迅疾拔刀术。它对劈斩拉多怀有宿怨。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is capable of sprouting katanas out of its head and arms, which it uses to perform a quick draw. It holds a vendetta against Bidon.

entry: 它是剑艺超群、手段却不光彩的剑士。先以幻象误导敌人，再挥出可怕一斩。
author: NellNast42
source: An extremely talented but underhanded swordfighter. It uses its illusions to misdirect its foes before unleashing a terrifying slash.

entry: 久远年代，它为理想创建庞大骑士团。挥击如飓风，为的是让世界变得更好。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its ideals led it to create a grand order of knights in an age long past. It strikes with the force of a hurricane, seeking to make a better world.

entry: POKENAME像守护王族一样保护训练家。它用强劲双腿猛然前冲，挥出破坏力惊人的一斩。
author: Pikachu_2434
source: POKENAME will protect Trainers as if they were royalty. It lunges forward using impressive legs and delivers a devastating slash.

entry: POKENAME只侍奉自认有王者资质的人。战斗时先震慑敌人，再以长吻劈开对手。
author: bunkachunka
source: POKENAME serves only those it deems to have the qualities of a king. Intimidating any foe it faces in battles, it cleaves through them with its snout.

entry: 它曾是传奇勇士，早已下葬。可只要王国或继任者召唤，无论如何，它都会回应。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A once legendary warrior, interred long ago. But when the kingdom or its successor calls, it will answer it, no matter what.

entry: 据说POKENAME是一位古代君主的灵魂，附身灯笼，只为继续引领子民。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is believed that a POKENAME is an ancient monarch whose soul possessed a lantern so it can continue to guide its people.

entry: 古文献暗示，POKENAME早在融合技术出现之前就已被创造，是打造它们的王室的贴身侍卫。
author: Phantom640
source: Ancient texts hint that POKENAME was actually first created long ago before fusion, and were the personal guards to the royal houses that built them.

entry: 阵亡士兵之魂附在战争遗址造出的巨像上，便成了POKENAME，继续守护无辜者。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME came to be when souls of fallen soldiers possessed giant golems that were created at the sites of wars so they could protect the innocent.

entry: 过去，人们在战场立起巨像纪念阵亡者。士兵亡魂附入其中，便化成POKENAME。
author: Skymaster426
source: In the past, giant golems were created at the sites of wars to honor the fallen. The souls of dead soldiers possessed them, becoming POKENAME.
