entry: POKENAME正义感极强，能穿越空间召来各式兵器，将它们如弹丸般投向敌人。
author: char_latte3412
source: A very righteous Pokémon, POKENAME has the ability to summon various weapons through space and hurl them at opponents as projectiles.

entry: POKENAME的防御经过优化，无论太空的冰冷真空，还是重返大气时的酷热，都能承受，几乎毫发无损。
author: char_latte3412
source: With its optimized defenses, POKENAME can endure both the cold vacuum of space and superheated atmospheric entry with hardly a scratch.

entry: 中世纪，人们常佩戴绘有POKENAME的徽章。采用这一纹章的王国，都以精锐军队和坚固防御自豪。
author: char_latte3412
source: A depiction of POKENAME was a common badge worn in medieval times. Kingdoms that bore it prided themselves on their superb armies and defenses.

entry: 亡魂如浓雾般围绕POKENAME。传说它会替这些灵魂实现最后的心愿。
author: b_megamaths
source: The souls of the departed flock around POKENAME like a heavy mist. It is said to grant the last wishes of these souls.

entry: 据说基拉祈曾想摆脱近乎永恒的沉睡，终于在受诅咒的剑中找到办法，代价却是失去自身意志。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It's said that once, a Jirachi wanted a way to escape its near-eternal slumber. It found it in a cursed blade, but at the cost of its very will.

entry: POKENAME用唯一的锐牙，雕刻精美的像，致敬它认为公正的领袖。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME use their singular sharp tooth to carve beautiful statues in honor of anyone they deem to be just leaders.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的剑士，常独自锻炼。面具若破损或被摘下，就会立刻逃走。
author: TheEmeraldFlygon
source: As a proud swordsman, POKENAME is often seen training alone. If its mask breaks or is removed, it will flee immediately.

entry: 它有“银河最强战士”的称号，因力量过于强大而被封印。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Nicknamed 'The Strongest Warrior In the Galaxy', this Pokémon was sealed away due to its immense power.

entry: 小火龙的勇气赢得坚盾剑怪认可。如今两者并肩作战，坚盾剑怪还能让它的尾火永不熄灭。
author: NellNast42
source: Charmander's courage deemed it worthy in Aegislash's eyes. The two fight now together, as Aegislash can keep its tail burning forever.

entry: 有人靠近，它就把脸藏在盾后。据说面对天生有领袖资质的人，会少些害羞。
author: b_megamaths
source: It hides its face behind its shield if approached. It is rumored to be less shy around those with innate leadership qualities.

entry: POKENAME是训练有素的士兵，以小队巡视沙漠，驱逐遇见的所有闯入者。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are well-trained soldiers who patrol the desert in small squads. They drive out any intruder they come upon.

entry: POKENAME遍身珠宝，生活奢华，囤积从其他宝可梦与训练家处掠来的财物。POKENAME会拼命守住这些战利品。
author: conductor#2682 (j1miin)
source: POKENAME lives in luxury, covered in riches. It will hoard its loot from other Pokémon and Trainers. POKENAME will defend the loot with its life.

entry: 它是彻头彻尾的战士，却不在乎荣誉。只要出价够高，就愿听你任何差遣。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A warrior, through and through, yet it cares not for things like honor. But name a good enough price, and it will do whatever you command.

entry: POKENAME头盔的样式随地区而异。金属冰冷，因为内核是纯冰。
author: kiwikelly
source: The design of POKENAME's helmet varies from region to region. Its metal is very cold, as it hides a core made of pure ice.

entry: POKENAME远远就能察觉王族，若认定对方不配为君，便会加以追猎。
author: norskdaedalus
source: POKENAME has the ability to detect royalty from a long distance, and uses this ability to hunt it deems them an unworthy ruler.

entry: POKENAME翼刃的响亮碰撞声令敌人恐惧。POKENAME还能将声音集中，震聋对手。
author: kiwikelly
source: The loud clanging of POKENAME's wingblades bring fear to the hearts of its enemies. Moreover, POKENAME can focus the noises to deafen a foe.

entry: POKENAME由古老铠甲与布料组成。只有用对招式，背上的剑才会出鞘。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is made up of ancient armor and cloth. The sword on its back will only be unsheathed when the right move is used.

entry: 据说这座坚不可破的堡垒，曾挡住一万多人。论攻城战术，没人比POKENAME更懂。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: An impenetrable bastion said to have held strong against more than ten thousand men. There is nobody who knows siege tactics better than POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME曾是骑士贵族的常见伙伴。它极善用剑，而剑往往由主人赐予。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME was once a common partner for knightly nobility. It is extremely adept with a blade, which it often receives from its masters.

entry: 据说，野生POKENAME会像训练家对战一样，向其他野生宝可梦发起挑战。还有传闻称，剑中封着所有败于它手下的灵魂。
author: JokersWild
source: Wild POKENAME reportedly challenge other wild Pokémon like a Trainer Battle. An urban legend says its sword houses the souls of those it has bested.

entry: POKENAME自认是将要继承王国的王子。勇武故事渐渐传开，也聚起了一小群追随者。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME views itself as the prince of a kingdom it will soon inherit. Tales of its bravery have spread, and it has amassed a small following.

entry: 这对刀刃不停铲土钻地，身边常有一面盾。那面盾，恰好就是它们的首领。
author: Neonriser
source: A pair of blades that constantly shovel themselves to the ground. They are often accompanied by a shield, who happens to be their leader.

entry: 可怕的幽灵烈焰，加上精湛的剑盾技艺，让POKENAME仿佛注定会成为强大、却也可能专横的君王。
author: NellNast42
source: With its terrifying spectral flames and mastery of sword and shield, POKENAME appears destined rule as a mighty, yet perhaps despotic, king.

entry: 它远行各地寻找最强兵刃。传说曾有一只POKENAME，手中之剑连次元也能斩开。
author: Rakanadyo
source: This Pokémon wanders far and wide in search of the strongest blades. There are legends of an POKENAME whose sword could cut through dimensions.

entry: 它体型虽庞大，却不用炮，而施展灵巧剑术。拼命保护麾下的杰尼龟与卡咪龟，连来犯水箭龟也能击退。
author: PokePower
source: Despite its bulk, it uses deft swordplay instead of cannons. It fiercely defends the Squirtle and Wartortle it leads, repelling even rival Blastoise.

entry: 若仰面摔倒，它就把双臂转到身后，撑起身体。手臂自由旋转，活动范围毫无死角。
author: .izik
source: If it falls onto its back, it will rotate its arms backwards to pick itself up. Its arms can rotate freely, allowing it a full range of motion.

entry: 夜里，它用草和泥铺好睡床。若被打扰了睡眠，就会把整张床重新铺过。
author: .izik
source: It will make a bedding of grass and mud to sleep on at night. If its sleep is disturbed, it will completely recreate the bedding.

entry: 入夜，眼睛变成深绿色，方便在黑暗中视物。强光照来时，它便惊慌地原地跳动。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes will change to a darker green at night to see in the darkness. When exposed to bright light, it will panic and hop in place.

entry: 它在林地滚着寻找树果。找到后用尖刺戳穿，喝掉里面的汁液。
author: .izik
source: It rolls on the forest floor, seeking Berries. When it finds one, it pierces the Berry with a spike and drinks the juice.

entry: 它们容易动怒，会用缎带缠住一切被视为威胁的东西，再以毒角猛刺。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Quick to anger, these Pokémon will latch onto anything it perceives as a threat with its ribbons and jab it with its poisonous horn.

entry: POKENAME会按角的大小，排定群体中的地位。角越长，越有威望。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: Groups of POKENAME form hierarchies based on the size of their horns. The longer the horn, the more authority one has.

entry: 它睡觉时，将脚埋在河边泥里。天气干燥，叶片便散出浓烈胡椒薄荷香。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps with its feet buried in mud at the side of rivers. On dry days, it emits a strong peppermint odor from its leaves.

entry: 它极为凶暴，喷出的特殊毒焰，能给宝可梦与公共设施都留下永久损害。
author: bobosmith01
source: This highly aggressive Pokémon spews unique poisonous flames that can cause permanent damage to Pokémon and infrastructure alike.

entry: 快速扑动双耳，就能短暂悬浮。它会练到深夜，盼着有一天真正飞起来。
author: .izik
source: By flapping its ears rapidly, it can hover for a short period of time. It will practice this exercise well into the night, hoping to achieve flight.

entry: POKENAME以毒角猛刺，再咬住敌人，也会用幽灵能量从远处攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME thrusts its poisonous horn into foes and bites them. It uses spectral energy to attack from afar.

entry: POKENAME用水中垃圾制成锐利兵器，与其他POKENAME并肩作战，抵御外来物种，保护家园。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME uses trash in the water to create sharp weapons. It defends its home from invasive species, fighting alongside other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME成群猎杀目标。捕猎成功后，便在河边石上磨利身体。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME slaughter their victims in groups. After a successful hunt, they sharpen themselves on stones by a river.

entry: POKENAME由两只互相敌视的驹刀小兵融合。若途中又遇到同类，就会毫不留情地出击。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME are formed by two hostile Pawniard. If they happen to pass another one, they strike without mercy.

entry: 两只互相敌视的驹刀小兵，会组成POKENAME。一旦再遇上同类，它们便会毫不留情地相互攻击。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME are formed by two hostile Pawniards. If they happen to pass another one, they strike at themselves without mercy.

entry: 稍被挑衅，它就动手，却总一股脑盲冲。只有指挥官带领，才能有效作战。
author: cait_sith
source: It will fight at the slightest provocation, but it always charges blindly. Therefore, it needs a commander to fight effectively.

entry: POKENAME是河中祸患，以斩切一切入水之物为乐。
author: zerocipher
source: POKENAME is known as the menace of rivers. It receives joy from cutting everything that enters the water.

entry: 初生的POKENAME极易兴奋，又十分贪玩。训练家必须留神，免得不小心遭到划伤。
author: mx_wellman
source: Newborn POKENAME are extremely excitable and playful, so their Trainers must take great care to not suffer accidental cuts or injuries.

entry: POKENAME每天都循固定路线，绝不绕道。头盔连子弹、导弹都能弹开，再以利刃迎敌。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME use specific routes every day without diversion. Their helmets deflect bullets and even missiles, and they use their blades to fight enemies.

entry: 三个头不和，常因内斗被刮花、撞凹。可到了战斗时，目标倒能一致。
author: themicelegion
source: Its three heads don't get along and are often scratched and dented due to fighting amongst themselves. Their interests align in battle.

entry: POKENAME能将刀刃转得令人目眩，借此迷惑对手，也会用鼻子磨利新月状刀刃。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME can spin its blades around in a mesmerizing fashion. It uses its nose to sharpen its crescent-shaped knives.

entry: 大群POKENAME聚到海船下，不停切割船身，直到船沉。残骸随后，就成了新家。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Swarms of POKENAME will gather beneath a ship at sea and slice up its hull until it sinks. This wreckage then becomes their new home.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又鲁莽，常把刀刃卡进各种东西。可群体配合，却十分默契。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME are recklessly energetic, and are often found with their blades stuck in various surfaces. However, they are well coordinated in groups.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又能预知，是可怕的军师与首领，还能用超能力更好地操控巨大尾刃。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's cunning and clairvoyance make them formidable strategists and leaders. They use psychic power to better control their large tail blade.

entry: POKENAME群等级森严，首领由金属角的长短决定。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: Packs of POKENAME follow a strict hierarchy, the leader of which is determined by the length of the metallic horn.

entry: POKENAME极为聪明。指挥驹刀桶大军时，谋划的战术往往极其有效。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME are extremely intelligent. When commanding an army of Pawnllery, its battle strategies prove to be extremely effective.

entry: 四肢都附着锐利刀刃。POKENAME以头撑地旋转时，碰到什么都能切开。
author: Blazerxz
source: It has sharp blades attached to all four of its limbs. When POKENAME starts spinning on its head, it can cut anything it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME是个空壳，漫游世界，收集死去宝可梦的灵魂。平时温顺，受攻击后却战得毫不留情。
author: RadiationV2
source: POKENAME is an empty husk which wanders the world in search of deceased Pokémon souls to gather. It is docile unless attacked, but ruthless in combat.

entry: 尽管它的寿命早已超过主人，仍然守护着大鼻子忍者教团的寺庙。这个教团在200年前就已经消失了。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It still protects the temples of the Ninja Order of the Great Noses, which disappeared 200 years ago, although it has long outlived its masters.

entry: 融合使POKENAME的双臂与头部长出电锯。如今，脑海里塞满了自私欲望。
author: NellNast42
source: With Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME sprouted chainsaws from its arms and head. Its head is now flooded with selfish desire.

entry: POKENAME常成群弹奏舒缓吉他，吸引伴侣，博取青睐。带刃尾巴则用于捕猎。
author: AcidicJesse
source: POKENAME plays soothing guitar music to attract and impress potential mates, usually in groups. It uses its bladed tail for hunting prey.

entry: 它精通手里剑技艺。双打对战时，会将自己掷向敌人，替伙伴分散注意。
author: Soup1900
source: This Pokémon has mastered the art of the shuriken. In double battles, it will throw itself at its enemies to distract them from its partner.

entry: POKENAME手里的武器叫锁镰。长链让它即便相隔很远，也能带来致命威胁。
author: grassy311
source: The weapon it wields is known as a kusarigama. The chain makes POKENAME a deadly threat, even at a distance.

entry: 它以锐利如激光的视力，扫视栖居的风吹平原。睡觉时，尾巴和双腿都会缩进壳中。
author: cait_sith
source: It scans the windswept plains it lives in with its laser-sharp eyesight. It retracts its tails and legs into its shell when it sleeps.

entry: 夜里看见POKENAME时，已经太晚。它会命手下无情追来，夺走一切想要的东西。
author: bobosmith01
source: When you spot POKENAME at night, it is already too late. It will send its followers after you without mercy, stealing whatever it desires.

entry: POKENAME极力保护森林，每晚巡视。特殊视力能穿透枝叶，察觉任何异常。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME is highly protective of its forest, conducting nightly patrols. It uses its special eyesight to peer through foliage, noting any anomalies.

entry: POKENAME追逐目标时，刀刃一闪，便能感知对方的灵魂。连隔着墙的灵魂，也逃不过感应。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: When POKENAME's blade glimmers whilst pursuing a victim, it can sense their spirit. It can even sense spirits through walls.

entry: 它领地意识极强，会毫不犹豫地亮出带电獠牙，迎向不受欢迎的闯入者。
author: char_latte3412
source: This Pokémon is extremely territorial and will not hesitate in brandishing its electric tusks towards unwelcome trespassers.

entry: POKENAME的蛋壳十分坚硬。它与可蛋共同生活，而可蛋会以这些蛋为食。
author: kittyluv090
source: The shell of POKENAME's egg is quite tough. It lives alongside Lairsey, who use the eggs as a food source.

entry: 它挖穿山体来筑巢。虽然属于飞行属性，却不会飞。
author: themicelegion
source: It digs through mountains as it makes its home. It cannot fly, despite being a Flying type.

entry: 身体异常黏软。走到哪里，就留下一路恶臭的金属糊浆。
author: .izik
source: Its body is extremely gooey. As it moves from place to place, it will leave a putrid metallic paste in its path.

entry: POKENAME的铁甲虽笨重，却十分适于水下行动。额前的角，则用来刺穿毫无戒心的猎物。
author: NellNast42
source: Although clunky, POKENAME's iron plating is specially suited for underwater travel. Its frontal horn is used to skewer unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME被激怒时，厚甲会亮起黄澄澄的电光。带电后，沉重身体也变得异常灵活。
author: NellNast42
source: When irritated, POKENAME's heavy armor glows bright yellow with electricity. This charge makes it extremely nimble for its weight.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，铠甲会烧得像熔炉。随后便鲁莽地四处冲撞，为自己降温。
author: NellNast42
source: When in battle, POKENAME's armor heats up like a furnace. It then smashes into its surroundings recklessly to cool off.

entry: POKENAME能借铠甲传导庞大超能力，尾巴也能发射强劲光束。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is able to channel its immense psychic powers through its armor. Its tail is capable of launching off a powerful beam.

entry: 它住在深海床。哪怕轻擦一下锐刺，也会令它猛烈爆炸，留下剧毒。
author: kittyluv090
source: It lives on the floor of deep oceans. Even just slightly grazing its sharp spikes causes it to violently explode, leaving potent toxins in its wake.

entry: 它照料的蛋几乎无法破坏，却也永不孵化。因此也没法吃，尽管有传闻称它们能大益健康。
author: PokePower
source: Eggs it cares for become nigh-indestructible, but never hatch. This also means they are inedible, despite rumors of wondrous health benefits.

entry: 它不断散失静电，因此总在寻求补电。会接下落雷，也用尾巴剖开电子设备和电池取电。
author: PokePower
source: It's always seeking a charge, as it constantly sheds static. It relies on lighting strikes and slicing open electronics and batteries with its tail.

entry: 它们一被纯粹怒火驱使，就能碾碎任何敌人，战斗至最后一口气。
author: mrbapcik
source: When driven by pure rage, these Pokémon have the power to crush any enemy. They will fight to their last breath.

entry: POKENAME将整座山划为领地，时刻警惕地守护。刀刃上的缺口，也被视作值得骄傲的战斗纪念。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, which it vigilantly maintains. Chips in its blade are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

entry: 体内金属骨骼大多中空。POKENAME借轻巧身形，灵活地从一处悬崖跳往另一处。
author: .izik
source: The metallic bones in its body are mostly hollow. Using its light weight, a POKENAME skillfully jumps from cliff to cliff when traveling.

entry: POKENAME凭强大铠甲自由往来各界。凡被它视为闯入领地者，都会遭到可怕的暴力袭击。
author: TomatoSalad
source: Utilizing its powerful armor, POKENAME can travel freely between realms, unleashing terrible violence on any it deems trespassers of its territory.

entry: POKENAME只听意志坚定的训练家指挥。多数饲养者都觉得夜晚变长，仿佛多出了第25小时。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME will only listen to Trainers with strong wills. Most Trainers report feeling as though the night is longer, as if there was a 25th hour.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃输电塔。大群一拥而上，几分钟就能吞掉整座变电站。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers power pylons as their meal of choice. A swarm can easily descend on a power substation and devour it in minutes.

entry: 臂上每根尖钉都连着藤蔓。藤蔓能伸到30英尺以外，捉住敌人。
author: .izik
source: Each of the nails on its arms is connected to a vine. This vine can extend over 30 feet to catch a foe.

entry: 传说远方王子曾远行寻找POKENAME的火焰。故事中，他以水晶小瓶盛住火种。
author: .izik
source: Legends tell of a prince from a far away land who travels in search of a flame from a POKENAME. In the story, he uses a crystal vial to hold the fire.

entry: POKENAME一拳足以摧毁坦克。全身合金，会随着年岁渐长而更坚固。
author: .izik
source: A punch from a POKENAME is strong enough to destroy a tank. The alloy throughout its body becomes sturdier as it ages.

entry: 拍动大翼时，会脱落细小金属屑。这些碎屑的温度，能超过多数家用烤箱。
author: .izik
source: When it flaps its large wings, small metal shavings come off. These shavings can get hotter than most household ovens.

entry: 多年前，人们曾在卡洛斯战争的险恶战场见过POKENAME。它用铁矛吓退对手。
author: planatical
source: POKENAME was observed fighting on the dangerous battlefields of the Kalos war many years ago. It uses its iron spear to scare off opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，其中金属充足，足够构筑铠甲。金属善于反射声音，还能增强声波能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves with enough metal to build its armor. The metal is great at reflecting sound, which enhances its sonic abilities.

entry: 它伸出锁链，卷回海床上发现的贵重物品。找到金银，就会满怀邪恶喜悦地吞下。
author: .izik
source: It extends its chain to reel in any valuables that it finds on the ocean floor. It consumes any gold or silver it finds with a fiendish glee.

entry: POKENAME的勺子，曾被熔铸成卡洛斯君主的王冠。王冠能保护国王与女王，免受心智控制。
author: .izik
source: The spoons from a POKENAME were once melted down to make crowns for Kalos rulers. The crowns defended the kings and queens from mind control.

entry: POKENAME极其自傲，只接受最伟大勇士的挑战。四肢灵活，却坚硬如铁。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME is an incredibly proud creature, only accepting challenges from the greatest warriors. Its limbs are agile, but hard as iron.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚钢。一遇下雨，就赶快找地方躲藏，免得留下锈斑。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in a thick layer of steel. Should it begin to rain, POKENAME will run to find cover and avoid rust marks.

entry: POKENAME挥着带有可怕尖刺的摆锤，先让目标沉沉睡去，再用它狠狠攻击。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Wielding a pendulum with threatening spikes on it, POKENAME first uses it to lull its victim into a deep sleep, then to violently attack them.

entry: 它一爆炸，就会召来持续五天的沙暴，还爱向孩子眼里扔沙子。
author: zerocipher
source: When this Pokémon explodes, it summons a sandstorm thats lasts five days. They love to throw sand into the eyes of children.

entry: POKENAME在全黑环境也能视物，凭回声定位找到巢穴。巨大双翼拍得飞快，却完全无声。
author: maxiundmicky
source: It can see in total darkness, using echolocation to find its burrow. POKENAME has large wings that flap incredibly fast, yet completely silently.

entry: 它高飞避敌，个头又小，让天敌很难抓住。入夜才飞下来，到池塘喝水。
author: Skymaster426
source: It keeps high in the skies to avoid predators, which struggle to grab it due to its small size. During the night, it flies down to drink from ponds.

entry: 双翼一拍，便掀起猛烈沙暴，还会传出凶猛有力的咆哮声。
author: gaogao028
source: The flapping of its wings is known to create heavy sandstorms. These wings also emanate a powerful, vicious roar-like sound.

entry: POKENAME将振翅的嗡鸣与叫声结合，发出足以震碎岩石的声波，夜里漫游沙漠追猎。
author: awiralonprime
source: By combining its buzzing wings and voice, POKENAME can emit sound waves that can shatter stone. It roams the desert to hunt down prey at night.

entry: 沙暴中，POKENAME拍翼扩展波导，寻找其他生物。它会保护领地内弱小宝可梦，抵御猎人与偷猎者。
author: Therider
source: During sandstorms, POKENAME flap their wings to extend their aura and find others. It defends weak Pokémon in its territory from poachers and hunters.

entry: POKENAME力量虽大，却很少构成威胁。它们更爱拍翼扬沙，挖出凹坑躺着。
author: JokersWild
source: Despite their immense strength, POKENAME are very seldom dangerous. They prefer to kick up sand with their wings to create divots they can lay in.

entry: 剑刃与拍动的双翼，奏出迷人的金属乐曲。POKENAME再用缎带卷起沙尘暴，困住目标。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its blade and flapping wings create an enthralling, metallic song. POKENAME then spins up a dust storm with its ribbon to trap its victims.

entry: 即便没有翅膀，也能见到POKENAME飞过沙漠上空。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can be seen flying through desert skies, even without wings.

entry: 它在花田筑巢。受威胁时，就用带毒旋风迎敌。
author: LemGambino
source: It makes its nest amongst fields of flowers. When threatened, it attacks enemies with a poisonous whirlwind.

entry: POKENAME能完全藏入双翼掀起的沙暴，凭特殊双眼，发现40英里以外的猎物。
author: bunkachunka
source: It can perfectly conceal itself within the sandstorms it whips up with its wings. POKENAME can spot prey from over 40 miles away with its unique eyes.

entry: POKENAME飞快拍动头上叶片，掀起旋风。扬起的沙子迷住对方双眼，便能趁机逃走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME rapidly flaps the leaves on its head to whip up whirlwinds. The blinding sand that this stirs up allows it to make its escape.

entry: POKENAME的腿原本太脆弱，终于长出了护腿。它崇拜狂欢浪舞鸭，也想学会流水旋舞。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME eventually got leggings, as its legs were very vulnerable before. It admires Quaquaval and wants to learn Aqua Step.

entry: 一点污垢就会令它恼火。美丽外貌加上流畅迅捷的泳姿，让它在华丽大赛中备受赞赏。
author: CapWolfBane
source: This Pokémon is irritated by the slightest grime. It is prized in contests for its beauty and swift and fluid swimming.

entry: 传说中常赞颂POKENAME的美。它只向心无恶意者现身，让对方有幸欣赏这份美丽。
author: Thora Daughn
source: The beauty of POKENAME is told in legends. This Pokémon only appears to those with no ill will to grace them with its beauty.

entry: POKENAME兼具美貌与力量，游历世界，向所有伤害过自己的人复仇，也保护成长中曾支持过自己的人。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: Displaying beauty and power, POKENAME travels the world seeking revenge on all who wronged it. It protects those who supported it as it matured.

entry: POKENAME温柔善良，常聚在大湖深处嬉戏。带着的不是蛋，而是美丽鳞片。
author: .towerxvi
source: Gentle and kind, POKENAME gather and play deep within large lakes. They carry Prism Scales in lieu of eggs.

entry: 它真正的美貌，常让人类和其他宝可梦为之倾倒。为了躲开不想要的关注，它经常藏进身上坚韧的海带丛后。
author: mundane_frog#0
source: Its true beauty often bewitches people and other Pokémon. It regularly hides behind its sturdy kelp growths to avoid unwanted attention.

entry: 据说刀鞘上的虹彩鳞片，能安抚狂暴之心。POKENAME便借此让目标平静，再下手攻击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts—perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.

entry: 它住在海中，悦耳歌声便是靠近的信号。人们认为，人鱼传说正源于它。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Living in the seas, you will know it is near by its harmonious singing. It is thought this Pokémon is the origin of the myth of mermaids.

entry: POKENAME散发抚慰气息，连最汹涌的水面也能安定。凡与它相遇者，都能得到平静。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME emanates a soothing aura that calms even the most turbulent waters. Its presence brings tranquility to all who encounter it.

entry: POKENAME只吃最美味的鱼宝可梦。离水后，就用爪子反反复复梳理长发。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME eat only the tastiest fish Pokémon. When they get out of the water, they brush their hair with their claws over and over.

entry: 古时，人们敬重POKENAME的绝美姿容。直到如今，牙与爪的化石仍是珍贵奢侈品。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME was revered in ancient times for its great beauty. Fossils of its teeth and claws are still valued as luxury items.

entry: 古时，它因美丽鳞片遭到捕猎。可POKENAME十分强悍，猎捕绝非易事。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: In ancient times, it was hunted down for its beautiful scales. It was no easy feat, however, as POKENAME is a very formidable foe.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞状外壳。明明没有翅膀，却依然能飞，原理无人明白。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard, scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it since it has no wings.

entry: POKENAME双翼极其锋利，性情又凶暴，常把敌人斩成碎片。它们大多住在洞穴或山中。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's extremely sharp wings and viscous temperament leads to its opponent being slashed to pieces. They tend to live in caves or mountains.

entry: POKENAME细如针的喙，擅长破开猎物的壳。发怒时，双翼疾振，卷起危险风暴。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's needle-like beak is adept at cracking the shells of prey. When angered, it generates dangerous tempests by rapidly flapping its wings.

entry: POKENAME虽失去双翼，仍快得目不暇接。再加上惊人跳跃高度，依旧是强悍的空中猎手。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Despite its loss of wings, POKENAME is still blindingly fast. It can jump at incredibly high as well, making it still a formidable aerial predator.

entry: 民间故事称POKENAME为恶魔。只有察觉值得一战的强敌，它才会从高山下到人间。
author: togetik
source: Folktales refer to POKENAME as a demon that descends from the high mountains only if it senses an adversary worth fighting.

entry: 甲壳龙进化前若遭袭击，可能会暂时变成POKENAME，用剩下的壳保护身体。
author: ansleehariot
source: If a Shelgon is attacked before it evolves, it may temporarily become a POKENAME. They use what remains of their shell to protect their body.

entry: 各个齿轮转速不一，产生紊乱磁场。有人猜测，这或许就是霹雳电球内部的模样。
author: maelmc
source: Each gear spins at a different speed, generating an erratic magnetic field. Some people theorize this is what a Voltorb's inside looks like.

entry: 能源公司曾买下并取出POKENAME的红色能量核心。可它拒绝为原本那套组件以外的东西供能。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Energy companies have bought and extracted the red energy core component from POKENAME but it refuses to power anything other than its original set.

entry: POKENAME每次作战，尾上的火之石都会逐渐磨损，因此训练起来花费不菲。
author: spriter
source: As a POKENAME fights, the Fire Stone on its tail is ground down. As such, training such a Pokémon can be costly.

entry: POKENAME的众多钻头转得极快，轻易就能钻透钨。可不停钻掘，也使它经常过热。
author: lynkinator
source: POKENAME's numerous drills rotate fast enough to effortlessly pierce through tungsten. However, its relentless drilling causes frequent overheating.

entry: 它悄然漫游森林觅食，将猎物吞下，转为燃料。背上的齿轮，还能织出坚韧的丝。
author: lynkinator
source: It quietly roams forests in search of prey, devouring and converting them into fuel. It uses the cogwheel on its back to weave a resistant silk.

entry: 经常可以看到POKENAME懒洋洋地躺在铜制屋顶上晒太阳。身上的锈迹似乎丝毫不会影响它的机械部件。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: POKENAME is often seen lazily laid out on copper roofs in the sun. The rust on its body doesn't seem to affect its machinery at all.

entry: POKENAME潜在地幔，以稀有矿物为食。若听见地下齿轮激烈转动，便可能是它即将破土而出。
author: lynkinator
source: It lurks in the planet's mantle, feeding on rare minerals. If you hear gears violently shifting from below, POKENAME may emerge from the ground.

entry: POKENAME借背上的装置，从流经身体的水流不断发电，因此能一直游泳，无需休息或睡眠。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses the construction on its back to constantly generate energy through the current it rides. This enables it to swim without rest or sleep.

entry: 传闻它原是海洋勘测无人机，因程序错误失控。任何时候，翼下最多能停靠六只齿轮鱼。
author: nvisionluminous
source: It's rumored to be a marine survey drone that went rogue due to programming errors. Up to six Kliraid can dock under its wings at any given moment.

entry: 若听见金属咔嗒声，可能就是POKENAME正快速逼近。獠牙锋利得连船身也能刺穿。
author: beespoon
source: If you hear metallic clacking, it may indicate that POKENAME is speeding towards you. Its tusks are sharp enough to pierce through ship hulls.

entry: POKENAME又称“废土金属巨人”，游荡于废弃工厂与污染地带。散布的油迹，便是领地标记。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Also known as the "Wasteland Metal Giant", POKENAME roams abandoned factories and contaminated areas. Scattered oil stains indicate its territory.

entry: POKENAME的身体由纠缠齿轮与电线聚成，难以理解。反复无常的动作，仿佛有多个意识争夺身体控制权。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME's body is an incomprehensible mass of tangled gears and wires. Its erratic motions suggest multiple minds vying for control of the amalgam.

entry: POKENAME由核能驱动，因此能产生庞大电力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is powered by nuclear energy. This enables it to generate huge amounts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能犁过积雪、沥青与松软地面，再释放大量蒸汽降温。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME plough through snow, asphalt and loose ground with ease. They cool themselves down by releasing lots of steam.

entry: POKENAME旋转起来，如精密优雅的机械。上半身还能脱离，独自在空中飘浮。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.

entry: POKENAME旋转起来，如精密优雅的机械。上半身还能脱离，独自在空中飘浮。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.

entry: 一只磁力极强的巨金怪，身上聚来几只齿轮儿。最终自然融合，诞生了POKENAME。
author: JokersWild
source: An extremely magnetic Metagross accumulated several Klinks on its body. Eventually, they naturally fused together to create a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME电锯的威力，取决于背部齿轮转得多快。有报告甚至声称，转速可达2马赫。
author: id_entitycrisis
source: The power of POKENAME's chainsaws is linked to how fast the gears on its back are spin. Some reports even claim that the gears can spin at Mach 2.

entry: 有些训练家喜欢装饰POKENAME的上环。部分地区甚至专门办比赛，评选最佳设计。
author: mirby
source: Some Trainers of POKENAME like to attach decorations to its upper ring, and there are even full contests in some regions over the best designs.

entry: 嵌在壳中的旋转装置吸收地震能量，供给内部引擎，驱动身体前进。
author: anarchaz
source: A rotating mechanism embedded in its shell absorbs seismic energy, powering its internal engines and making it move.

entry: POKENAME是审判级巨兽，铠甲坚不可破，力量出众。虽冷淡疏离，却很体贴，愿守护信任的对象。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME is a judgement-class beast, with impervious armor and superb power. While cold and aloof, it's very caring and will protect those it trusts.

entry: 最早记录它的，是一本名声不佳的八卦杂志，因此人们一度以为它只是骗局。
author: Griddle
source: This Pokémon was originally thought to have been a hoax, having been first documented in an disreputable gossip magazine.

entry: 蛛形身体能轻易穿过狭窄空间，运输时十分可靠。它还会尖锐鸣哨，吓退威胁。
author: lynkinator
source: Its arachnid frame allows it to navigate tight spaces with ease, making it reliable for transportation. It whistles sharply to scare off any threats.

entry: POKENAME是古代自动机械，部件却古怪地十分现代。据说若组成军队，力量甚至足以征服世界。
author: Blazerxz
source: An ancient automaton, POKENAME is curiously made with modern mechanical parts. Allegedly, an army of them could be strong enough to conquer the world.

entry: POKENAME周身的齿轮牢笼，帮助控制狂放的古老魔法。每个齿轮，都附着不同咒术。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The cage of gears around POKENAME help to control its wild and ancient magic. Each gear carries a unique enchantment.

entry: 能量核心加上发射弹丸的牙齿，让POKENAME能击落并捕捉头顶飞过的猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its energy core and projectile-emitting teeth allow POKENAME to ground and catch prey flying above it.

entry: 它学会扭动下半身，让腰间圆环转起来。起舞时，金属碰撞声便奏出悦耳节奏。
author: seaslux
source: It has learned to twirl the ring around its waist by gyrating its lower body. The sounds of clinking metal as it dances produces a satisfying rhythm.

entry: 有些阴谋论者相信，POKENAME是政府秘密计划的产物，专从水下袭击敌舰。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some conspiracy theorists believe that POKENAME is a secret government project designed to attack enemy ships from below.

entry: 表盘上的时间从不准确。民间传说认为，POKENAME显示的其实是观看者的死期。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The time on its dial never matches the actual time. Folk tales believe that POKENAME actually shows the date of death of the person who sees it.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: 一次废矿探险后，POKENAME首次被发现。引擎由神秘的暗物质驱动。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME was first found after an expedition into an abandoned mine. Its engine is powered by a mysterious dark matter.

entry: POKENAME核心强劲，圆环也能自卫，挖出的矿物远超自身需求，轻易就能替主人赚来收益。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With its powerful core and self-defense capabilities from its ring, POKENAME mines more minerals than it needs and easily makes its owner a profit.

entry: 这三只若保养得宜，采矿便能带来厚利。可若疏于照顾，也曾引发灾难性塌方。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When maintained, this trio can perform extremely profitable mining operations. When neglected, they've been known to cause disastrous cave-ins.

entry: 胡须能察觉远处的贵重物品。它常打磨钢铁身体，维持光泽。
author: lynkinator
source: Its whiskers can detect the presence of valuable items from far away. It regularly polishes its steel body to maintain its shine.

entry: 融合后，齿轮怪的小齿轮被迫听命于POKENAME。战斗时，它以超能力操纵齿轮攻击。
author: Shado_.w
source: When fused, Klinklang's small gears are now forced to follow POKENAME's commands. In combat, it uses its psychic powers to make the gears attack.

entry: POKENAME常在大型锻造厂运送炽热金属。它们不怕高温，甚至能踏过熔融材料。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME are often used in large industrial forges to transport hot metal, as they do not mind high heat and can trudge through molten material.

entry: POKENAME吞煤，供给体内熔炉燃烧。极热火焰，则从身体各处开口喷出。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME eats coal to fuel the furnace in its body. It ejects the incredibly hot flames from the combustion process through various openings.

entry: POKENAME不停旋转，再用自身产生的磁力加速，快得迸出火花。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME rotates continuously, using self-generated magnetism to accelerate in such a way that it sparks.

entry: POKENAME能产生庞大能量，也会释放强大磁波，让附近大多数电器停摆。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can generate an incredible amount of energy, but it also emits powerful magnetic waves that disable most electrical devices in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME转动几个头，不断产生能量与热，存进外环，也能从环中释放。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: By rotating its heads, POKENAME can constantly generate energy and heat, which it can store in its outer ring. It can also use this to release it.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断转动，各个头也轮流换位。位于最高处的，暂时担任指挥。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's body rotates continuously, causing its individual heads to change position regularly. The one at the top is in temporary command.

entry: 齿轮怪熔化后与臭臭泥融合，因此POKENAME常见于烧毁的工厂。早在基因之楔问世前，就已发现这种融合。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often found in burnt factories, as the Klinklang melts and fuses with the Muk. This is a fusion that was found even before DNA Splicers.

entry: POKENAME用幻象改变外貌前，会先以烟雾裹住自己，让旁观者误以为它已经逃走。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: Before changing its appearance through illusions, POKENAME surrounds itself with smoke, making those who see it think it fled.

entry: POKENAME的火焰制造热浪蜃景，将敌人困入其中。一旦被幻象捕获，就再也逃不掉。
author: JordanX27
source: Their flames allow POKENAME to ensnare their opponents in a mirage formed by the heat haze. Once trapped by the illusion, there is no escape.

entry: POKENAME能把任何景象画得宛如真实，试图迷惑猎物。可不知为何，这策略似乎从未真正奏效。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME can draw any scene as if it were real in order to confound its prey. For whatever reason, though, this strategy never seems to actually work.

entry: POKENAME在树间飞掠，从阴影中制造幻象。这些迷乱景象有的恶毒，有的甚至致命。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME swoops from tree to tree, casting illusions from the shadows. These perplexing phantasms range from malicious to deadly.

entry: 它又称“幻象淑女”。据说会用幻术化作人类，生活在大城市里。
author: Comrade Miku
source: This Pokémon is also known as the "Lady of Illusions". It is said that it uses its illusions to look like a human and to live in big cities.

entry: POKENAME披着暗影，借波导发力，以幻象迷惑敌人，再用钢爪攻击。每次欺骗得逞，力量便更强。
author: Sheogorath
source: Cloaked in shadows and powered by aura, POKENAME confounds foes with illusions while striking with steel claws. Its power surges with each deception.

entry: 据说六只耳朵能听见方圆一千英里内的任何秘密。POKENAME还能完美扮作任何生物，为自己谋利。
author: milchik
source: Its six ears are said to hear any secret within a thousand miles radius. POKENAME can perfectly impersonate any creature it wants for its own benefit.

entry: POKENAME同时将多个目标困在幻象中，留待日后饥饿，再吸取它们的生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME traps multiple victims in illusions at once, storing them for later, when it'll be hungry for their life force.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: JokersWild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: JokersWild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: 狩猎时，它会制造自己的幻影，将猎物团团包围。等猎物心胆俱裂，再向其喷出火焰。
author: .izik
source: When hunting, it will create illusions of itself and surround the prey. Once it breaks the prey's spirit, it spits flames at them.

entry: POKENAME原本灵魂纯净，却被融合腐化。它梦见世界遭灾难摧毁，许多人认为这梦是预言。
author: 8xviktor
source: A pure soul corrupted by fusion, POKENAME dreams of a world destroyed by a catastrophe. Many people theorize that its dream is a prophecy.

entry: POKENAME是诡计的顶尖大师，以勺子传导幻术魔法，制造逼真的蜃景。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is the ultimate master of trickery. It channels its illusory magic through its spoons, enabling it to conjure realistic mirages.

entry: 它用缎带安抚所有靠近的生物，再散出背上孢子，让对方入睡。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon will try to calm any organism that approaches them with its ribbons and put it to sleep with spores from its back.

entry: 波波威胁到POKENAME时，它便以可爱魅力迷住这位天敌。
author: themadcactus
source: When threatened by Pidgey, POKENAME will use its cute charm to infatuate the predator.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME是某种强大虫宝可梦的后裔，因此它的身价很高。
author: themadcactus
source: Some believe this Pokémon is the descendent of a powerful bug-Pokémon, causing POKENAME to sell for a high price.

entry: 进化后，它会蜕皮。它产生的膏状物，是最昂贵化妆品的原料。
author: themadcactus
source: After evolving, this Pokémon will shed its skin. The most expensive makeup is made with its paste.

entry: POKENAME的缎带状翅膀结构奇特，看似不利飞行，却能乘飘忽的妖精之风自在滑翔。
author: themadcactus
source: The peculiar structure of its ribbon-like wings, while seemingly impractical for flight, lets POKENAME glide freely on wayward fairy winds.

entry: POKENAME最显眼的特征，就是花纹精细的双翼。鲜明图案，会吸引毫无戒心的宝可梦。
author: themadcactus
source: The intricately patterned wings are POKENAME's most distinct feature, with their bright pattern attracting unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: 双腿呈蓝色，只因其中某种毒素。毒液极不稳定，连圈圈熊也能麻痹。
author: themadcactus
source: The legs of this Pokémon are blue only due to a certain toxin. The poison in the legs are extremely volatile, and can even paralyze an Ursaring.

entry: 所有能量都花在蜕变之上。防御时，它便迅速抽动缎带，赶走靠近的宝可梦。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon uses all its energy in the process of metamorphosis. It defends by warding off any Pokémon with a quick whip of it's ribbons.

entry: 遇见野生POKENAME，得保持平静。它能感知恐惧，便会试着注入毒液，帮你“冷静下来”。
author: themadcactus
source: If you encounter one of these Pokémon, stay calm. Wild POKENAME detect fear, and will attempt to calm you down by injecting you with poison.

entry: 鲜艳体色有何优势，让研究者颇为好奇。许多人认为，颜色越明亮的POKENAME越受伴侣青睐。
author: themadcactus
source: The bright colors of this Pokémon leads many researchers to wonder it's advantage. Many believe that brighter POKENAME are considered better mates.

entry: POKENAME很不受人喜爱，便用黏性缎带捉住人类，想强迫对方爱上自己。
author: Crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is a very unloved Pokémon. Due to this, it uses its sticky ribbons to catch humans in an effort to force them to love it.

entry: 多数POKENAME有5条尾带，也有6条或7条的。POKENAME尾带越多，越容易找到伴侣。
author: themadcactus
source: Most POKENAME have 5 tails ribbons, but some have 6 or 7. The more tail ribbons that a POKENAME has, the more likely it is to find a mate.

entry: 别的宝可梦或许热衷求偶，POKENAME却淡然处之。它被认为沉稳克制，主人也被视为明智包容的人。
author: themadcactus
source: While some Pokémon may look for mates, POKENAME are indifferent. Considered stoic, owners of this Pokémon are viewed as wise and accepting.

entry: POKENAME喜欢安慰人和宝可梦，用缎带长尾轻柔拥抱，头上的石头也发出令人安心的信号。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME loves to comfort both humans and Pokémon. Its ribbonlike tail provides a soft embrace while the stone on its head sends out soothing signals.

entry: 与小拉达处在相同环境时，它很快就会受欺负。可到了雪地，皮毛既保暖，颜色又能帮助伪装。
author: themadcactus
source: When placed in the same biome as a Rattata, its quickly picked on. But when put in a snowy biome its fur keeps it warm and its color camouflages it.

entry: 野生POKENAME极易受惊，对训练家却很亲近。据说若有一只主动靠近你，说明你心地真正善良。
author: themadcactus
source: Wild POKENAME are extremely skittish, but they're very friendly to their Trainer. It is said that if one approaches you, you are a truly kind soul.

entry: 背上没有种子，毒素究竟来自哪里，令许多人不解。有的说来自缎带，也有的说来自皮毛。
author: themadcactus
source: Without a seed on its back, many wonder where the poison comes from. One theory says it comes from the ribbons; another says it comes from the fur.

entry: 背上的花苞结成整齐蝴蝶结。据说躺在阳光下，结便会长大、解开，化作另外两条缎带。
author: themadcactus
source: The bud on its back is tied in a neat bow. It is said that if it lies in the sun, the bow will grow and untie into two more ribbons.

entry: POKENAME可爱如妖精的头，吸引毫无防备的宝可梦靠近，再以利钳胁迫对方交出食物。
author: qwertyelephant
source: POKENAME's cute, fairy-like head attracts unaware Pokémon. It then uses its razor-sharp pincers to threaten them into giving over their food.

entry: POKENAME酿的果汁甜得几乎喝不下。人们说，POKENAME果汁唯一的原料就是爱。
author: birchbot
source: The juice POKENAME makes is so sweet that it's almost inedible. People say that the only ingredient of POKENAME's juice is love.

entry: 它们常为训练家制作礼物，借此表达满满的爱意。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: As a sign of affection for their trainers, they will frequently make them gifts to show how much they love them.

entry: POKENAME开创了自己的魔法流派，吟诵咒文，以纯粹魔力歼灭敌人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A pioneer of its own kind of magic, POKENAME uses magical incantations to annihilate foes with pure magical power.

entry: 善良的灵魂，自愿汇成了这个集合体。为了创造能惠及后世的存在，它们舍弃自我，融为一体。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A conglomerate spirit made of willing, kind individuals. Those souls lost themselves in service to creating something to help future generations.

entry: 它住在其他宝可梦前来饮水的河湖旁，维持和平，阻止任何争斗。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon lives by lakes and rivers where other Pokémon go to drink. They keep the peace and stop any Pokémon from fighting.

entry: POKENAME因为爱晒太阳的习惯而闻名。
author: themadcactus
source: POKENAME has become known for its habit of bathing in the sun.

entry: 柔和体色下，藏着狡猾的战斗本领。缎带状触须摸起来令人舒心，可它很挑剔，不是谁都让握。
author: wigglypon
source: Its pastel colors belie a cunning battler. Its ribbonlike feelers are soothing to touch, though it may be picky about who it allows to hold them.

entry: POKENAME是天生艺人，借磁力拆下身体各处，再灵活操纵，献上令人目眩的表演。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are natural entertainers. Using magnetism, they detach and manipulate various parts of their body to put on dazzling displays.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: 这是为收集妖精属性能量而设计的POKENAME原型。可惜“月之驱动”装置有缺陷，最终被废弃。
author: T.I.A.
source: A prototype of POKENAME that was designed to collect Fairy-type energy. However, the Moon Drive was faulty, so it was scrapped.

entry: 休息时，它常把训练家拉进体表液体形成的小袋里。里面温暖舒适，不会带来伤害。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: It has a habit of pulling its trainer into a pocket of its surrounding fluid when at rest. This feels warm and comfy, not posing any risk of injury.

entry: 它伸出触须，捞住远处猎物。麻木感便蔓延全身，即便被POKENAME吞食，也不会挣扎。
author: wigglypon
source: It extends its feelers to snag prey at range. This causes a numbness to wash over the ensnared victim; it does not struggle as POKENAME consumes it.

entry: 空心的头装满彩色泡泡糖球。它爱分给别人，可要留神，有些竟辣得惊人！
author: wigglypon
source: Its hollow head is full of colourful gumball candies. It loves sharing them with others, but be warned: some of these treats are incredibly spicy!

entry: POKENAME是最优雅的宝可梦之一，会以缎带迅速击打目标。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is known as one of the most elegant Pokémon out there. It rapidly strikes targets with its ribbons.

entry: 它筑的水坝舒适无比，精巧程度少有巢穴能比，因此POKENAME很受室内设计师欢迎。
author: wigglypon
source: Its dams are the height of Pokémon comfort; few nests can compare to their intricacy. This has made POKENAME a popular partner for interior designers.

entry: POKENAME爱用缎带状触须安抚训练家。遇到危险时，还会明亮发光，提醒对方。
author: bunkachunka
source: POKENAME loves to soothe its Trainer by using its ribbonlike feelers. It is known to alert its Trainer of any danger by glowing brightly.

entry: 野外看见它软垂的耳朵，训练家就忍不住想摸一摸。
author: themadcactus
source: When Trainers see this Pokémon's floppy ears in the wild, they cannot help but pet it.

entry: POKENAME和飘飘球一样，仍会拐走孩子。缎带状触须能让孩子安静，不再尖叫或反抗。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: Like Drifloon, POKENAME still takes children. Its ribbonlike feelers calm down the children so that they won't scream or fight back.

entry: 它用可爱外貌引来宝可梦，再以缎带缠住。目标便会爱上POKENAME，听命于它。
author: Shiina Valkyria (W)
source: It lures Pokémon in with its cute appearance before entangling them in its ribbons. This causes its victim to fall in love and serve POKENAME.

entry: 它以和平守卫之名为人所知，散发使人平静的气息。可领地受威胁时，也会凶猛抵抗。
author: Lyman#7749
source: It is known to be a guardian of peace, sending out a tranquilizing aura. It is known to aggressively defend its territory if threatened.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火焰没有热量。若用它的火焰吐息烤树果，果实就会带上棉花糖风味。
author: themadcactus
source: The fire on a POKENAME's tail emits no heat. If you cook a Berry with their fiery breath, the Berry acquires a cotton candy flavor.

entry: 体色鲜艳又有这般体型，让它捕猎时只能依靠速度。
author: themadcactus
source: Due to this Pokémon's bright colors and size, they rely on speed when hunting.

entry: 野生POKENAME用大耳朵听见数英里外的猎物。求偶时，耳朵越大，越有魅力。
author: themadcactus
source: Wild POKENAME use their large ears to hear any prey miles away. When mating, larger ears are seen as more admirable.

entry: 它用缎带与利爪捕食。可遇到伊布或其进化型，性情就会变得贪玩许多。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon catches its prey with its ribbons and claws. When around an Eeveelution or Eevee, its demeanor becomes much more playful.

entry: 巨大的缎带双翼不能让它飞行。它会改用妖精之风，将自己托到云层之上。
author: themadcactus
source: Its large ribbon wings don't give this Pokémon the ability to fly. Instead, it uses the move Fairy Wind to lift it above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME沿河游动时，会像巨翅飞鱼与铁炮鱼那样，吸引鲤鱼王和角金鱼相随。
author: themadcactus
source: Like Mantine and Remoraid, POKENAME attracts Magikarp and Goldeen when swimming down rivers.

entry: 缎带就像触手，有助游泳与捕猎。不用时，便任其自在漂浮。
author: themadcactus
source: Its ribbons act as tentacles, useful for swimming and hunting. When they aren't being used, they float freely.

entry: 它逆流而游，仍能吸引许多水属性宝可梦。可只有最善游泳的，才能跟上。
author: themadcactus
source: This Pokémon swims against the stream. It still attracts many Water-type Pokémon while swimming, but only the strongest swimmers can keep up.

entry: 巨大的石头尾巴既能照明，也能让人晒黑。POKENAME不晒太阳时，就在发光的尾巴下休息。
author: themadcactus
source: The large stone it has for a tail acts as a tanning machine and a light source. When a POKENAME isn't sunbathing, it's resting beneath its shiny tail.

entry: 它贪玩又充满活力，常练习各式小把戏，好在训练家难过时逗对方开心。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is very playful and energetic. It is often found practicing various tricks so that it can cheer up its Trainer when they are sad.

entry: 它泳技惊人，不费力就能胜过专业选手，与最快的水属性宝可梦并驾齐驱。性情却像拉普拉斯一般。
author: themadcactus
source: This incredible swimmer beats pros without a sweat and paces with the fastest Water types. Despite this, it has a demeanor similar to that of Lapras.

entry: 耳朵乍看形状古怪，其实十分适合在水中减小阻力。
author: themadcactus
source: At first glance, its ears may look misshapen, but they are actually very hydrodynamic.

entry: POKENAME也继承了迷唇姐的神秘。它总先亲吻对手，再咬下去。
author: bobosmith01
source: The mysteries of Jynx carry over into POKENAME. It kisses foes first before biting them.

entry: POKENAME能从全身每个孔洞射出毒镖。激动时射得飞快，肉眼根本看不清。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: POKENAME can fire poison-tipped darts from every hole in its body. When agitated, it fires these darts faster than the naked eye can comprehend.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，发怒时破坏力却惊人。幸好栖息地的缘故，只有树木会承受怒火。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though small in stature, POKENAME can cause spectacular damage when angered. Thankfully, given its natural habitat, only trees will suffer its wrath.

entry: POKENAME的骨骼由极耐用的金属构成。它们常召集弱小宝可梦，命其突袭城镇，抢夺食物。
author: VaporVenator
source: The skeleton of POKENAME is composed of a highly durable metal. They often rally up lesser Pokémon and command them to raid towns for food.

entry: 岩石般的厚皮保护着它，让它能抵御威胁、守住地洞。对训练家，则像待自己的孩子一样。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its rock-hard hide helps protect it as it defends its burrows from threats. It is known to treat its Trainers as if they were its children.

entry: 它们的凶猛与体型极不相称，甚至能与大自己四倍的宝可梦正面交锋，赢得胜利。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: They are incredibly aggressive for their size. They are known to go toe to toe with Pokémon four times their size and come out victorious.

entry: 尾巴力气极大。若有人趁它打盹，将它从地里拔出，它便会猛力甩尾，足以打断骨头。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is extremely strong. Should someone pull it out of the ground while it naps, it will swing its tail with enough force to break bones.

entry: POKENAME既美丽又凶猛，先以双翼迷住猎物，再用额头的毒角攻击。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: As ferocious as it is beautiful, POKENAME charms its prey with its wings before striking it with the venomous horn on its forehead.

entry: POKENAME头上锐利的血红宝石，常令敌人畏惧。可多数POKENAME舍不得拿珍爱的角当武器。
author: char_latte3412
source: The sharp, blood-red jewel on POKENAME's head often intimidates its enemies. However, most POKENAME refuse to use their prized horns as a weapon.

entry: 它用异常巨大的尾巴推水前进，也会找大石头，吃上面的水藻。
author: .izik
source: It uses its abnormally large tail to propel itself through the water. It will look for large rocks so that it can eat the algae.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，领地意识极强。身体虽粗壮，入夜仍能轻易融入环境。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal, highly territorial Pokémon. Despite its bulky stature, it can easily blend in with its surroundings during the night.

entry: POKENAME拥有海神之力，据说能操纵全球洋流。可这副形态，只让它的力量够管一座小湖。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME has the power of an ocean deity said to control currents all over the world. However, this form limits its power to a small lake.

entry: 传说中，POKENAME又称“风暴使者”。它驾驭冰水之力，拍翼便能掀起破坏惨烈的风暴与海啸。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME is called 'The Stormbringer' in legends. With its power over ice and water, it flaps its wings to create devastating storms and tsunamis.

entry: 风暴始终围绕POKENAME，强风任其意愿转向，让它在自己的地盘上占尽优势。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Storms rage around POKENAME constantly, high winds shifting in the directions it desires, giving it immense advantage in its domain.

entry: 它打盹之处，细雨永不停歇。POKENAME若被激怒，便会骤变成毁灭性的风暴。
author: VaporVenator
source: An everlasting drizzle of rain occurs where it dozes off. This light shower escalates into a devastating storm when POKENAME is provoked.

entry: POKENAME住在深海宝物中，小到饰品，大到船只，都可安家。换了新家，便缩放身体以求合适。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME lives inside of the deepest treasures of the ocean, from trinkets to ships. It will grow or shrink to fit the size of its newest home.

entry: 它常被误当作海床的一部分，背上承载整片珊瑚礁。礁中的住客，会替这慢吞吞的巨兽觅食。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Often mistaken as part of the seafloor, this Pokémon hosts a whole reef atop itself, its denizens helping provide for this slow behemoth.

entry: 为了击败固拉多，盖欧卡与时拉比融合，获得回到过去的能力，一遍又一遍地迎战宿敌。
author: milchik
source: In order to defeat Groudon, Kyogre fused itself with Celebi. That way, it gained the ability to travel back in time to fight its rival over and over.

entry: POKENAME住在海底山脊。尾巴推进时喷出大量蒸汽，常被误认成海底火山。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME lives in submarine ridges. When used for propulsion, its tail produces large amounts of steam. It's often confused for an underwater volcano.

entry: POKENAME住在海底山脊。尾巴推进时喷出大量蒸汽，常被误认成海底火山。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME lives in submarine ridges. When used for propulsion, its tail produces large amounts of steam. It's often confused for an underwater volcano.

entry: POKENAME控制不住自己造出的雨云。雨总把自己的火浇灭，最后只好闷闷不乐。
author: ceoofspooks
source: POKENAME cannot control the rainclouds it creates. It always extinguishes its own flame and ends up becoming grumpy.

entry: POKENAME来去如海啸般狂野，逐浪穿行，随水流发掘海底的宝藏。
author: trakito
source: POKENAME lives quite a wild life, not unlike a tsunami. It surfs from wave to wave; discovering treasure on the ocean floor as it flows.

entry: 别被笑容骗了。它曾让整座岛屿沉没。
author: .realthree
source: Don't be fooled by its grin. This Pokémon has been known to sink entire islands.

entry: POKENAME轻哼的曲调响彻海洋。它想让世界沉入大海，好让所有人都听见自己的声音。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: The gentle tune POKENAME hums resonates throughout the ocean. It wishes for everyone to hear its voice by drowning the world in the sea.

entry: 它极力保护海洋。为保卫大海，狂怒时甚至会摧毁钻油平台与拖网渔船。
author: homelessrager
source: It is very protective of the sea. It even destroys oil rigs and fishing trawlers in its rampages in defense of the ocean.

entry: 传说POKENAME飞在雷雨云中，用勺子为全世界带来降雨。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legends say that POKENAME flies inside storm clouds, using its spoons to bring rainfall across the entire world.

entry: 珊瑚礁遭到破坏，使它始终惊惶。有时会出没海滩，吓退游泳的人。
author: elevn.
source: This Pokémon is constantly in shock from the destruction of its coral reefs. It sometimes haunts the beaches to scare swimmers away.

entry: 它长久蛰伏，偶尔苏醒。没人见过全貌，唯一预兆是巨大漩涡，将船只卷入深不见底的巨口。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It awakens between long periods of inactivity. Never seen in full, its only herald are massive whirlpools, bringing ships right into its endless maw.

entry: 据说POKENAME不到一小时，就能挖穿地幔与地核，从世界一端抵达另一端。
author: cyprexx
source: It is said that POKENAME can dig from one side of the world to the other in under an hour, going straight through the mantle and core.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾将大地劈成大陆与岛屿。岁月流转，它还会再做一次。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: According to legend, POKENAME is said to have cleaved the land into continents and islands, and will again as the ages pass.

entry: POKENAME是蓄满电力的巨人，踏着震撼大地的步伐漫游，身后留下噼啪迸响的能量轨迹。
author: anarchaz
source: A colossal titan charged with electricity, POKENAME roams the land with earth-shaking steps. It leaves behind a trail of crackling energy in its wake.

entry: POKENAME沉重的触手会使脚下的大地震动。据说，任何攻击都无法撼动这些宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: NAME's hefty tentacles cause the earth to quake below it. It is said that these Pokémon cannot be moved be any sort of attack.

entry: POKENAME歌声低沉，每段旋律都塑造大地，回荡的曲调甚至能形成绵延山脉。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME sings with a deep voice, shaping the land with each spoken melody. It forms mountain ranges through its reverberate song.

entry: POKENAME的巨重身躯踏上战场，便裂开巨大地缝，常将对手整个吞没。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When POKENAME stomps onto the battlefield, its great weight causes massive fissures which often swallow its opponents whole.

entry: 这种POKENAME十分罕见，模样却酷似某款经典人气游戏的反派，因此备受追捧。
author: kittyluv090
source: This rare variant of POKENAME is popular and highly sought after since it bears resemblance to a villain from a classic and beloved video game.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在看顾两个不省心的孩子。稍不留神，它们就会打起来。
author: bitterchemicalhaze, vaporvenator
source: POKENAME spends most of its time watching over its rather troublesome children. The two often fight one another if left unmonitored.

entry: POKENAME不停绕着星球运行，在卫星间跳跃。据说独眼能望见宇宙边缘。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME endlessly orbits the planet, bouncing between satellites. Its single eye is said to be capable of seeing the edges of the universe.

entry: POKENAME若急需逃离天敌，就能把自己掷向星球，穿过大气。不过，这一去便回不了头。
author: .realthree
source: If a POKENAME desperately needs to escape a predator, it can hurl itself through the atmosphere towards the planet. However, this is a one-way trip.

entry: POKENAME待在臭氧层上方，极少被目击。位于大气之上，也让冰之能力大幅增强。
author: Unknown
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it stays above the ozone layer. By staying above the atmosphere, its abilities of ice have powered up immensely.

entry: 这只宝可梦生活在极高的天空中，几乎只存在于传说里。它体内拥有所有已知超级进化宝可梦的基因。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon lives so high up in the sky that its existence is practically just a myth. It contains the DNA of all the Mega Pokémon known.

entry: POKENAME栖居最阴森荒寂的深渊。少数曾遇见它的潜水员，都再也没有回来。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME dwells in the most sinister and desolate abysses. The few divers who have encountered it have never been seen again.

entry: POKENAME是顶级猎手，视一切为猎物。POKENAME把捕获之物拖进海底火山，活活煮熟。
author: musicsheep.
source: As an apex predator, POKENAME considers everything prey. POKENAME drags its catches into underwater volcanoes, where it then boils them alive.

entry: POKENAME虽然小巧，却充满强劲的龙之能量。毒咬对人与宝可梦，都有强烈毒性。
author: theartemis1
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME are filled with potent draconic energy. Its bite is highly venomous to humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能让火山灰笼罩大气，引发大规模物种灭绝。身上的甲片，全部由纯黑曜石构成。
author: samulock
source: POKENAME is capable of causing a mass extinction event by clogging the atmosphere with volcanic ash. Its plates are made of pure obsidian.

entry: POKENAME是最聪明、最令人生畏的宝可梦之一。它永不停飞，一发现猎物，就全速撞上。
author: planatical/The Yang Soldier
source: POKENAME are known as one of the smartest and most intimidating Pokémon. It flies endlessly, and when it finds prey, smashes into them at full speed.

entry: POKENAME眨眼就能跑遍世界。据说世界有难时，它会以音速从天而降。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME can race across the entire world in the blink of an eye. It is said it descends from the heavens at mach speed if the world is in danger.

entry: POKENAME想起自己的塔已成废墟，便悲伤不已。有时悲痛太深，吹起的风也会更猛烈。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME is incredibly sad when it remembers that its tower is in ruins. Sometimes its sadness is so great that it blows the wind harder.

entry: POKENAME能操纵海风，制造连大气都可能受威胁的破坏性风暴。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME is capable of controlling sea winds. It can generate destructive storms capable of threatening the atmosphere.

entry: 人们只见过POKENAME沉睡的样子，醒来却会展现惊人力量。手臂射出的激光，足以贯穿群山。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME has only been seen dormant. However when awake has displayed immense power. The laser beams it fires from its arm can rip through mountains.

entry: 一只小拳石曾离家数月，苦练龙之力量。后来归来时，双拳已被灵体附身。
author: elevn.
source: One day, a Geodude left to train for months to master the power of dragons. It returned later, its fists possessed by a spirit.

entry: 苦练的小拳石终于进化。为了不让大地遭其怒火波及，它被迫束缚住控制自己的灵体。
author: elevn.
source: A trained Geodude managed to evolve. It is forced to bind the spirit that controls it in order to protect the lands from its wrath.

entry: POKENAME有独特本领，真能一拳把人打到下周。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to quite literally punch someone into next week.

entry: 靠近POKENAME时，会先听见咕咕钟响，随后它便消失。有人相信，它穿越时间逃走了。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When you approach POKENAME, you hear the sound of a cuckoo clock before it disappears. Some believe that it travels through time to escape.

entry: POKENAME随意改变表盘时间，就能穿梭时空。也有人猜测，它不会死亡。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can change the time on the dial of its watch at will, allowing it to travel through time. There are speculations that it is immortal.

entry: POKENAME以音速奔驰，因此极少被人看见。有时快到连时间也能穿越。
author: coooooooookiee
source: POKENAME is very rarely seen, as it races around at the speed of sound. Sometimes it moves so quickly it can traverse time.

entry: 见过POKENAME的人，总说它演奏着同一首歌。曲调听来熟悉，又令人怀念。
author: JokersWild
source: Those who have reported seeing POKENAME always describe it playing the same song. They also claim the song sounds nostalgically familiar.

entry: POKENAME是穿越时间寻找强敌的战士。可至今，也没找到足够强的对手。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is a warrior that uses its time travelling abilities to search for a worthy opponent. It has yet to find a strong enough opponent.

entry: POKENAME能操纵全部时空。有人相信它才是真正的创世宝可梦，也有人称它为存在本身的扭曲。
author: Scigaming
source: POKENAME can control the entirety of space-time. Some believe it to be the true Creator Pokémon, whilst others call it a corruption of existence.

entry: 许多人视它为掌控一切时空的神奥大尊。力量之强，唯有阿尔宙斯本尊能比拟。
author: Toxicrown
source: It's believed by many to be the Almighty Sinnoh and controller of all spacetime. Its power is rivalled only by Arceus itself.

entry: 它控制地质岁月中的大陆运动，以一条条绳索缓慢却坚定地拉动大陆，横越星球。
author: milchik
source: This fusion controls the movement of the continents in geological time. It uses a series of ropes to pull them across the globe slowly but surely.

entry: 它汇聚时间与科技的精华，操纵时之力，穿梭电路，留下紊乱与谜团。
author: anarchaz
source: Channeling the essence of time and technology, it manipulates temporal forces and surges through circuits, leaving a wake of disruption and mystery.

entry: 传说POKENAME自帝牙卢卡诞生时就已存在。金属躯体是赐福，使它们不受时间侵蚀。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: Legends say that POKENAME have lived since the birth of Dialga. Their metallic forms are a blessing to grant them immunity from the effects of time.

entry: 它狂暴的力量，能传遍所有时代。若POKENAME愤怒过甚，时间之流都会被震碎。
author: nexusthenexus
source: The force of its rampage can be felt across all of time. If POKENAME were to become too infuriated, the flow of time would be shattered.

entry: POKENAME完全掌控时间之流，却把这本领用来等待。
author: Billie Jeans
source: POKENAME has absolute control over the flow of time. It uses it to wait.

entry: 它能完全掌控方圆五十英里内的时间流动。可惜缺少意志，无法有效运用。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It has complete control over the flow of time within a fifty mile radius of itself. Unfortunately, it lacks the willpower to use it effectively.

entry: 它十分危险，午夜一到，就会攻击附近所有人。突然狂暴的原因众说纷纭，却无人确知。
author: imagine1.
source: It's very dangerous, and attacks anyone nearby once it's midnight. There are many theories for this sudden rampage, although nobody knows for sure.

entry: 它关爱其他生命，保护濒危物种。据说悉心待它的人，也能长寿。
author: imagine1.
source: This Pokémon cares deeply for others, protecting endangered species. Those who treat it with care are said to live long lives.

entry: POKENAME喜爱寒冷，能活数千年。环境若过热，就将自身冻结在时间中，重新现身过去。
author: 7Magic7Mike7
source: POKENAME loves the cold and can live for thousands of years. If its environment gets too hot, it freezes itself in time to reappear in the past.

entry: 传说它一缩进壳中，时间就会停止。发射的弹丸，无论相隔多远，总会瞬间命中。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Legend says that time stops when it tucks itself into its shell. Its projectiles always reach their target in an instant, no matter the distance.

entry: 腹袋里有一片不断旋转的星系。有人认为，那是通往其他宇宙的入口。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: The galaxy in its pouch swirls around endlessly. Some think they are gateways to other universes.

entry: 据说POKENAME的双翼，是通向遥远星系的虫洞。曾试着进入的人，都没能回来。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's wings are said to be wormholes to distant galaxies. Those who have attempted entering them have never returned.

entry: POKENAME转动身体，制造重力裂隙。据说中央宝石，是望向整个宇宙的窗口。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can spin its body to create gravitational rifts. It is said that the gem at its center is a window to the entire cosmos.

entry: 据说POKENAME是获得神格的叉字蝠，高速穿行宇宙，仿佛连空间也随之弯折。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: It is said that POKENAME are Crobat that have attained godhood. They travel the universe at high speeds, seemingly bending space.

entry: 它是高贵的斗士，在垂死恒星的核心深处锻造兵器。战斗时，宇宙能量便在周身盘旋，令人目眩。
author: seaslux
source: A noble fighter that forged its armaments deep within the core of a dying star. When it fights, a dizzying swirl of cosmic energy flows around it.

entry: 它斗志坚定，将宇宙能量纳入体内。发怒时，便释放恐怖的气场冲击，威力如超新星爆发。
author: seaslux
source: A driven fighter that draws cosmic energy within itself. When enraged, it lets loose terrifying aura blasts that hit with the force of supernovae.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它十分贪玩，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A playful Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 双角猛然合拢时，力量足以撕裂空间。落入其中的一切都会消失，仿佛从未存在。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its horns have become potent enough to tear apart space itself as they snap shut. Whatever goes inside vanishes, as if it had never existed at all.

entry: POKENAME腹中有一个完整宇宙。许多人相信，我们的宇宙或许也在同样的巨兽体内。
author: JokersWild
source: A whole universe exists inside POKENAME's belly. Many believe that our universe could be inside a beast just like it.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: 据说绒毛中藏着整个星系。换毛时，无数生命随之诞生，连熵本身也会退减。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its fluff is said to contain whole galaxies. When it sheds, untold amounts of life are born and entropy itself recedes.

entry: 传说POKENAME创造了宇宙所有热量，从无边双翼撒下一个个炽烈太阳。
author: togetik
source: POKENAME is said to have created all the heat in the universe, scattering blazing suns out of its boundless wings.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾是一整个星系的中心。双翼展开时，释放的热量等同百万颗太阳。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Legends say POKENAME once functioned as the center-point for an entire galaxy. Spreading its wings, it emits the heat of a million suns.

entry: 它是无可比拟的宇宙战士，能变化出上百万种形态。它的基因不断变化、适应，足以承受任何攻击。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A cosmic warrior without compare, capable of taking a million forms. Its DNA is ever-changing and adapting, capable of withstanding anything.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: Yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: Yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: POKENAME快速移动，掀起旋风。旋转的涡流困住猎物，使其难逃宇宙之力的掌握。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME creates whirlwinds with its rapid movements. Its swirling vortexes ensnare prey, leaving them trapped within its cosmic grasp.

entry: POKENAME因过度战斗进一步腐化，最终进化。战伤使扭曲的能量，从胸口不断涌出。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME evolved after being further corrupted by excessive combat. The distorted energy bursting out of its chest is caused by battle damage.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又擅长操纵别人，梦想统治世界。POKENAME还对胖丁怀着莫名怨恨。
author: planatical
source: POKENAME is described as cunning and manipulative. It dreams about taking over the world. POKENAME has an unexplainable grudge against Jigglypuff.

entry: POKENAME有“恶魔蛇”的绰号。只要落入它的视线，就没有生还的可能。
author: Mistymagius
source: Known by the nickname of "Demon Serpent": If you are in POKENAME's line of sight, your chances of survival are zero.

entry: POKENAME是世上最凶暴的宝可梦之一，经常袭击村庄，有时甚至彼此攻击。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are some of the most violent Pokémon the world has ever seen. These Pokémon regularly attack villages, and sometimes even attack each other.

entry: POKENAME凶恶，飞行于家园毁坏的世界。若被打扰，便以寒冰与暗影之力击倒猎物。
author: Thora Daughn
source: This malevolent fusion flies around its home, the Distortion World. If disturbed, POKENAME will strike its prey down with powers of ice and shadow.

entry: 据说POKENAME与毁坏的世界建立精神联系，能在残酷战斗中，运用那个次元的扭曲阴影。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is said to have forged a psychic link with the Distortion World, enabling it to use the dimension's twisted shadows in gruesome combat.

entry: 传说POKENAME与骑拉帝纳同住毁坏的世界。双翼，则由纯粹的精神能量构成。
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv
source: Legends state that POKENAME lives alongside Giratina in the Distortion Realm. Its wings are made of pure psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME似乎原生于毁坏的世界。漂浮瓦砾间散布的POKENAME越多，就说明离骑拉帝纳越近。
author: captainmodeus
source: POKENAME seems to be native to the Distortion World. The more of them you see scattering amongst the floating rubble, the closer you are to Giratina.

entry: 它被称为“蛙之魔王”，会用钉头锤痛打任何可能的威胁。神情虽邪恶，却也有人觉得可爱。
author: themicelegion
source: Known as "The Demon Lord of Frogs", this Pokémon bashes anything that might be a threat with its mace. Despite its evil demeanor, some find it cute.

entry: 传说POKENAME潜伏海底最深、最黑的洞穴，耐心等待猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legend says that within the deepest and darkest caves in the ocean, POKENAME lurks, waiting patiently for its prey.

entry: POKENAME守着生者世界与虚空的边界。嚎声回荡，带着令人不安的悲伤。
author: Xoriey
source: POKENAME guards the border between the living world and the void. Its howls echo with an unsettling sadness.

entry: 它是来自异次元的凶残猎手，扭曲现实本身的构造，制造难辨的幻象。
author: NellNast42
source: A savage hunter hailing from a different dimension. It creates tricky illusions by distorting the very fabric of this reality.

entry: 它可怕得很，拥有深不可测的力量。一旦发怒，顷刻便可能毁灭整片大陆。
author: PepperThePirate
source: A terror blessed with unfathomable power. Were it to lose its temper, it could annihilate an entire continent in moments.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: Soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: Soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，已知唯一记载是一则古谚：“当心POKENAME，暴君之仆，亡国之祸。”
author: MidnightUmbreon💙
source: The only known reference to this incredibly rare Pokémon is from an ancient proverb: “Beware POKENAME, servant of tyrants and destroyer of kingdoms".

entry: 它在荒凉之地向绝望者现身，鼓励他们重新生活。可诡异气息，也让人事后无法记起它。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It appears in desolate locations to those who have lost all hope and inspires them to begin new lives. Its eerie aura makes remembering it impossible.

entry: 它只是毁坏的世界的拙劣仿品。夜里靠近游荡的人会消失，再不见踪影……
author: Rkmaster25367
source: A pale imitation of the Distortion Realm. Those who wander near at night will disappear, never to be seen again...

entry: POKENAME是来自毁坏的世界的巨兽。异次元的土地碎块嵌在体内，对我们的现实构成威胁。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is a beast hailing from the Distortion World. Chunks of that dimension's earth are embedded into its body, and pose a threat to our reality.

entry: POKENAME用重拳将对手打得失去知觉，再拖进腹部的传送门。
author: .realthree
source: After pummeling its foe senseless with heavy-hitting punches, POKENAME pulls its enemy into the portal in its belly.

entry: POKENAME很难正常走路。必要时，前肢喷发的力量能让它以喷气机般的速度，向任何方向冲去。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME struggles to walk normally. If it needs to, it can propel itself in any direction at the speed of a jet plane with a blast from its forelegs.

entry: POKENAME小巧却强大，能从现实的褶隙中创造想要的一切。可造完之后，往往就丢着不管。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is a small but powerful Pokémon, creating anything it pleases from folds of reality. It tends to abandon its own creations.

entry: POKENAME外壳是金属，身体则有磁性。体型庞大又带磁，让它常吸附在大型金属物上。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: Its outer shell is metallic, while its body is magnetic. Due to its enormous size and magnetic body, POKENAME often clings to large metal objects.

entry: POKENAME虽然一生在地上度过，却被认为来自天空。世界各处，都散布着它们的踪迹。
author: .realthree
source: Though it lives its whole life on the ground, POKENAME is thought to come from the sky. These Pokémon can be found scattered throughout the world.

entry: 传说古时，它保护世界免遭海啸与飓风。后来试图拦住巨大小行星，却因此丧命。
author: Soup1900
source: Legends say that this Pokémon protected the world against tsunamis and hurricanes during ancient times. It died while trying to stop a giant asteroid.

entry: 无论发生什么，POKENAME都不能动。上次只迈出一步，混乱中便出现了两个新地区。
author: paisleylxl
source: POKENAME must not move under any circumstance. The last time it took a step, two new regions were formed from the chaos.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: POKENAME脚步如雷，獠牙如刃，是不可小觑的力量。高耸的身影，让遇见它的人无不害怕。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's thunderous footsteps and razor-sharp fangs make it a force to be reckoned with, feared by all who encounter its towering presence.

entry: 据说被POKENAME重拳击昏的人，之后都会饱受可怕噩梦折磨。
author: theartemis1
source: It is said that anyone knocked out by one of POKENAME's devastating punches will be plagued with horrible nightmares.

entry: 据说被POKENAME重拳击昏的人，之后都会饱受可怕噩梦折磨。
author: theartemis1
source: It is said that anyone knocked out by one of POKENAME's devastating punches will be plagued with horrible nightmares.

entry: 它用山洪与滔天海啸的噩梦，折磨污染水域的人。受害者醒来时，往往已严重脱水。
author: VaporVenator
source: It torments those that pollute its waters with nightmares of flash floods and towering tsunamis. Victims often wake up critically dehydrated.

entry: POKENAME在暗夜飞过大海，寻找守护灯塔的快龙。双方常鏖战数日，有时甚至数周。
author: gerakobitz
source: POKENAME fly over oceans on dark nights, looking for Dragonite guarding lighthouses. These brawls have been known to last for days, sometimes weeks.

entry: POKENAME拍翼散出催眠烟雾，还能阻断警戒信息素，让达克莱伊与独角虫融合而成的幼体平静下来。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME spreads a sleep-inducing smoke when it flaps it wings. This smoke also calms young Darkdle by blocking their alarm pheromones.

entry: 它现身意志薄弱者身旁，在心中播下种子，长成阴冷噩梦。可一旦醒来，人们便再也看不见它。
author: alliveir
source: It manifests near the weak-minded, planting seeds in their mind that give life to chilling nightmares. People never see it again once they awaken.

entry: POKENAME锐利的目光，能令人与宝可梦立刻沉睡。随后，便拨弄那些中招者的梦。
author: TheKRT
source: POKENAME's piercing gaze can instantly put any human or Pokémon into a deep sleep. It plucks at the dreams of those who fell victim to its gaze.

entry: 新月之夜，它们会收集人们的美梦，再将其变成噩梦。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: On new moons, they're known for collecting people's pleasant dreams and turning them into bad ones.

entry: POKENAME拼命保护同族，会把剧毒宝珠等东西放进腹袋，骗过想偷蛋的宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its kin, carrying things like Toxic Orbs in their pouch to trick other Pokémon looking to steal its eggs.

entry: 它的“眼泪”能制成安眠药，十分抢手。可一些服用者表示，吃后反而做了可怕噩梦。
author: alliveir
source: Its "tears" are heavily sought after, as it is used to make sleep medicine. However, some consumers have reported experiencing frightening nightmares.

entry: POKENAME在林中蹿行，守护领地免遭入侵。若被发现，就让对方短暂睡去，自己趁机逃走。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME scurries around forests, guarding its territory from intruders. If found, it can put others to sleep for a short time as it runs away.

entry: POKENAME融入幽暗森林，隐去身影。猎物在林中迷路时，便会被它催入深睡。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: It hides in dark forests, blending into the surroundings. POKENAME hunts by putting others into a deep sleep as they get lost in the forest.

entry: 它能哄人和宝可梦入睡。趁对方做梦，便用藤蔓缠紧，抽取能量。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: It can lull people and other Pokémon to sleep. As they dream, it wraps vines around the sleeping target, draining them of their energy.

entry: 超能力增强了它制造噩梦的本领。即使相隔遥远，也能在梦魇中护住训练家的性命。
author: ThunderJimmy#3944
source: This Pokémon's ability to induce nightmares has been amplified by its psychic power. It can safeguard its Trainer's life in nightmares from afar.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: 它温柔地哄人入睡，依偎在身旁。可梦中人却承受痛苦噩梦，POKENAME对此浑然不知。
author: fountainihili
source: It gently lulls people to sleep, cuddling alongside as they slumber. This leaves the dreamer with painful nightmares, but POKENAME is unaware of this.

entry: 它们极其罕见，空心角颇受珍视。可实力强大，叫声又如噩梦，捕捉并不容易。
author: gerakobitz
source: These incredibly rare Pokémon are prized for their hollow horns. However, their strength and nightmarish cries make capture difficult.

entry: POKENAME真正的力量，冻在身体深处。只有灌满其他生灵的美梦与噩梦，才能将其唤醒。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's true power is frozen solid deep within its body. Only getting filled with dreams and nightmares of other creatures will awaken this power.

entry: POKENAME深夜捕猎，专盯野外疲倦的人。即使以为甩掉它，也仍不安全。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunt in the dead of night and will target tired people out in the wild. Even if you think you have lost it, you are not safe.

entry: 碰到POKENAME的尾巴，就会沉沉睡去，饱受噩梦折磨。梦见哪种噩梦，取决于碰了哪条尾巴。
author: skinstealers
source: Touching one of POKENAME's tails sends you into a deep sleep, tormented by nightmares. The type of nightmare depends on which tail is touched.

entry: 据说它来自太空，潜伏在人的梦里。一旦被发现，便以异世界的噩梦折磨梦中人。
author: AlexanderEnjoyer1
source: This Pokémon, said to originate from space, lurks in people's dreams. If found, it torments them with nightmares of other worlds.

entry: POKENAME很久以前便被封入永眠。古籍告诫绝不可唤醒，否则将带来无穷噩梦。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME was locked away in an eternal slumber long ago. Ancient texts say never to wake it and warn of the endless nightmares it would inflict.

entry: 它四处寻找能听完歌而不睡着的人，却始终无人做到。听众最终，都被困在永恒噩梦中。
author: pokebio
source: It wanders, looking for someone to hear its song without falling asleep. However, no one is able to, so listeners are trapped in eternal nightmares.

entry: 齿轮转动的咔嗒声，使人昏昏欲睡。伴着这声音入眠的人，都说自己无法做梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The clacking of its turning gears induces drowsiness. Those who fall asleep to the sound report being unable to dream.

entry: POKENAME住在暗穴，悉心照料满园有毒的洞中花。它的能量，让花朵没有阳光也能茂盛。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives in dark caverns, where it tends to its garden of poisonous cave flowers. Its energy allows the flowers to flourish without sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用巨口中的漩涡催眠对手，随后将其身体冻至零度以下。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME hypnotize their opponents with the vortex inside their gaping mouth, subsequently freezing their bodies to sub-zero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME用巨口中的漩涡催眠对手，随后将其身体冻至零度以下。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME hypnotize their opponents with the vortex inside their gaping mouth, subsequently freezing their bodies to sub-zero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME的花粉能催人入睡、引起噩梦，因此常被用于梦境研究。
author: Kiva
source: POKENAME is known for its soporific pollen that causes nightmares. Because of this, it is often used in oneirological studies.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的孢子，就会遭受可怕噩梦，不过要过一会儿才会发作。它本身藏在阴影中。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's spores cause horrible nightmares in anyone who breathes them in. These nightmares take a while to start. It hides in shadows.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛与尾巴由烟构成，骑乘十分危险。野生POKENAME常潜伏在人们普遍怕火的地方。
author: gerakobitz
source: A POKENAME's mane and tail are made of smoke, making riding hazardous. Wild POKENAME are known for lurking in places where a fear of fire is common.

entry: 它背上的大炮会直接抽取种子中的能量。种子又被金属完全包住，导致POKENAME发育不良。
author: Soup1900
source: The cannon on its back extracts energy directly from its bulb, which is entirely encased in metal. This causes growth deficiency for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME拿盖诺赛克特的残片当武器与头盔，追捕带走母亲的人，只想将她找回来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wields the scraps of a Genesect as a weapon and helmet in order to hunt down the ones who took their mother and get her back.

entry: POKENAME已不再指望找到母亲，转而改良盖诺赛克特的部件，造出实用战甲，踏上复仇之路。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Having lost all hope of finding its mother, POKENAME instead better fashioned Genesect parts into functional battle armor in a quest for revenge.

entry: 母亲的灵魂仍寄宿在机械外壳里。孩子驾驶机壳时，她便引导它的动作。
author: holgast
source: The spirit of its mother still inhabits its robotic shell, guiding the child's movements as it pilots it.

entry: 机械外壳里，母亲残留的灵魂，已与外星意识融合。幼崽却在悲伤中，渐渐陷入疯狂。
author: holgast
source: What remains of the spirit of its mother has fused with an alien consciousness inside its robotic shell. The child is driven to madness in its sorrow.

entry: 机械外壳里，母亲残留的灵魂，已与外星意识融合。幼崽却在悲伤中，渐渐陷入疯狂。
author: holgast
