source: What remains of the spirit of its mother has fused with an alien consciousness inside its robotic shell. The child is driven to madness in its sorrow.

entry: 它由等离子队创造，是盖诺赛克特的原型机之一，尚缺最终设计中后来加上的强化。
author: zic
source: Created by Team Plasma, it was one of the prototypes of Genesect. It lacked the enhancements that were later incorporated into the final design.

entry: POKENAME被认为是来自深空的外星生命。有人推测，它是某个更庞大蜂巢意识中的执行个体。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME is thought to be an alien lifeform hailing from deep space. Some theorize this Pokémon to be a drone that is part of a larger hive-mind.

entry: 这种古老的虫宝可梦，会把叶片连起来，应付强风。模样宛如直升机，在阵风中也能从容穿行。
author: anarchaz
source: This ancient bug Pokémon readies for strong winds by linking leaves. Resembling a helicopter, it adapts to navigate gusty environments.

entry: POKENAME背炮发射高压水流。与POKENAME发生冲突的船只，往往会被发现船身已遭击穿。
author: Blazerxz
source: The cannon on POKENAME's back fires highly pressurized water. Ships that run afoul of POKENAME are often found with holes punched through their hull.

entry: 别把POKENAME当作普通摩托车。一骑上，它就会加速到时速150英里，再也不停。
author: gellyfishsh
source: Do not mistake POKENAME for an ordinary motorcycle. When mounted, it will accelerate to a speed of 150 mph, and it will never stop moving.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温泉，能用尾巴加热周围的水。尾巴也能在水下喷射推进，帮助游泳。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: POKENAME can warm surrounding water with its tail and favors hot springs. Its tail can also assist it while swimming via underwater propulsion.

entry: 爪子与背上悬浮的白色圆珠，由灼热液体相连。据说被爪子抓出的伤口，永远无法愈合。
author: raptorroocool
source: The claws and the white orb floating above its back are connected by a scorching-hot fluid. It's said that wounds caused by the claws don't heal.

entry: 骗子与阴谋家永远无法和它交朋友。最好远远避开，免遭烈火惩罚。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: Liars and schemers will never befriend this Pokémon. In fact, they should avoid it at all costs, lest they suffer the fiery consequences.

entry: POKENAME天性友善，喜欢什么就拿头蹭撞，结果常造成伤害。头上的石头摸起来暖暖的。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME has a friendly disposition and will headbutt anything it likes, often resulting in injuries. The stone on its head is warm to the touch.

entry: POKENAME以反应炉推动身体，冲撞时凭岩石般的硬头，力量足以将巨石撞成粉末。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.

entry: POKENAME以反应炉推动身体，冲撞时凭岩石般的硬头，力量足以将巨石撞成粉末。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃燃着太阳般的高热，还会影响天气。它倾向选择更明辨真理的持有者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade burns with the heat of the sun and affects the weather. It gravitates towards wielders with a superior sense of truth.

entry: POKENAME漫游天空，身后留下烟迹。入夜飞行时，常被误认成彗星或流星。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME漫游天空，身后留下烟迹。入夜飞行时，常被误认成彗星或流星。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME漫游天空，身后留下烟迹。入夜飞行时，常被误认成彗星或流星。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.

entry: 渡海求索真理的人，或许能瞥见这只传说宝可梦。鳍上的火欧泊，能改变全球天气。
author: .realthree
source: Those who cross the seas seeking truth may catch a glimpse of this legendary Pokémon. The fiery opals on its fins can alter the world's weather.

entry: 这只传说之龙是强大的毁灭引擎，几乎无可战胜。曾面对它，又活着回来讲述的人，少之又少。
author: Rooboid
source: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

entry: 它是真实与理想之龙，因训练家心中的力量而合一，应着铃声被唤来。
author: CaffinatedDragon#4465
source: The Dragon of Truth and Ideals, merged by the strength of its Trainer's heart. It was called forth by the sound of a bell.

entry: 人们让莱希拉姆与捷克罗姆融合，试图复原最初之龙。可没有酋雷姆，这种融合极不稳定。
author: Faelocke
source: Reshiram and Zekrom were fused in an attempt to revive the original dragon. But without Kyurem, this fusion is highly unstable.

entry: POKENAME拍动双翼，控制喷出的火焰，再借毛发引导，将火集中到尾巴。
author: Vicho (vicho9761)
source: POKENAME can control the fire that it expels by flapping its wings. It manipulates the flames with their fur to concentrate it on their tails.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天界，诞生早在时间尚未有名之时。它用尾巴唤火，再以双翼扇动烈焰。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: It is said that POKENAME has celestial origins dating back far before time had a name. It uses its tails to conjure flames and fans them with its wings.

entry: 传说它的超能力高深得足以改变现实。炽烈的攻击，则如太阳爆发。
author: astrael1
source: According to legends, this Pokémon's psychic powers are so advanced that they can alter reality. Its fiery attacks are similar to a solar eruption.

entry: 它们漫游大地，焦急地向往天空，刻苦锻炼，只盼早日学会起飞，或完成进化。
author: chromaerym
source: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.

entry: 它们漫游大地，焦急地向往天空，刻苦锻炼，只盼早日学会起飞，或完成进化。
author: chromaerym
source: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.

entry: 为了尽快飞起，它们长出反应炉般的铠甲。经验丰富的POKENAME，能短暂让自己微微浮起。
author: chromaerym
source: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.

entry: 为了尽快飞起，它们长出反应炉般的铠甲。经验丰富的POKENAME，能短暂让自己微微浮起。
author: chromaerym
source: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.

entry: 为了尽快飞起，它们长出反应炉般的铠甲。经验丰富的POKENAME，能短暂让自己微微浮起。
author: chromaerym
source: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.

entry: POKENAME排出的毒烟不断刺激自己，令它陷入狂暴。它以猛焰裹身，撞向所有挡路之物。
author: Mistymagius
source: The toxic fumes POKENAME's body emits constantly agitate it into a rampage. It coats its body in harsh flames and rams into anything in its way.

entry: 闪耀的尾巴改变气候，每次闪动都塑造大地。POKENAME统领冰寒之域，为冻土荒原带来温暖。
author: anarchaz
source: Its radiant tail alters the climate, shaping landscapes with every flicker. POKENAME rules its icy domain, bringing warmth to the frozen wilderness.

entry: POKENAME驰骋世界追寻真理。据说会向那些探索自身真实的人现身。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME gallops across the world in pursuit of truth. It is said that it tends to appear before those who search for their own truth.

entry: POKENAME体内热量太强，从双爪不断涌出。一簇羽毛也化为火焰，形状宛如发型。
author: terminatphilippe
source: The heat in a POKENAME is so intense that it's bursting out of its claws. A bunch of its feathers turned into a flame reassembling a haircut.

entry: POKENAME体内烈焰太强，从双爪喷涌而出。不知为何，还得到了一副金手镯。
author: terminatphilippe
source: The fire in a POKENAME is so intense that it bursts out of its claws. For unknown reasons, it acquired golden bracelets.

entry: POKENAME以妖精之力，造出由月亮组成的身体。少了这些月亮，POKENAME就只剩一个头。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses its Fairy-type abilities to make a body of moons. Without these moons, POKENAME would just be its head.

entry: 科学家指出，一群POKENAME聚居在关都北部的洞穴。入夜，便会满怀向往地凝望月亮。
author: .izik
source: Scientists state that there are a group of POKENAME that cluster in a cave in northern Kanto. At night they will gaze longingly at the moon.

entry: POKENAME颈间的项链似乎由月之石组成。它用幻术，对人施些孩子气的恶作剧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The necklace around POKENAME's neck seems to be made of Moon Stones. It uses its illusory powers to play childish pranks on people.

entry: POKENAME喜欢夜里在山路上玩。据说满月时捉到的个体，实力更强。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME enjoys playing on mountain tracks at night. It is said the ones caught during a full moon are stronger.

entry: POKENAME带着淡淡夏夜香气。羽毛可作枕芯，防止失眠。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME has a delicate summer night fragrance. Its feathers are used as pillow stuffing to prevent insomnia.

entry: 它在满月之夜，用天线吸收月之能量，驱动飞碟。天线也能释放磁波。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It powers its flying disc with lunar energy, which it absorbs via its antenna on full-moon nights. It also uses the antenna to emit magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会攀附在深穴岩壁，十分难寻。据说满月时，更容易现身。
author: pikaperfect
source: Rarely, POKENAME can be found clinging to walls deep within caves. Supposedly, this elusive Pokémon is more likely to appear during the full moon.

entry: 野外只在满月时能见到POKENAME。它凝望月亮，挥动缎带，跳着孤独的舞。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Spotted in the wild only during a full moon, POKENAME stares at the moon and swings its ribbon in a lonely dance.

entry: 可爱的模样与爱玩的性情，让这只宝可梦拥趸无数。它是出色的宠物，可惜实在罕见。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This Pokémon has an immense amount of admirers due to its cute looks and playful spirit. It makes an excellent pet, though it is extremely rare.

entry: 它的存在，让一些网络社群开始讨论月球火山。不过研究至今，仍没多少进展。
author: mx_wellman
source: The existence of this Pokémon has lead some online communities to theorize about lunar volcanoes. Research hasn't gone very far, though.

entry: POKENAME爱与其他发光宝可梦相伴。有人见过它们成群在黑暗中起舞。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME enjoys the company of other glowing Pokémon. Groups of them have been seen dancing in the dark.

entry: POKENAME脱落的星尘，一碰到活物似乎就会消失。好在并无害处。
author: OhOk3441
source: The stardust that flakes off of POKENAME seems to disappear when touching living material. Luckily, it's harmless.

entry: POKENAME火焰里的星星缓慢旋转。兴奋或战斗时，转速便会加快。
author: OhOk3441
source: The stars within POKENAME's fires spin slowly. When excited or in battle, their speed increases.

entry: POKENAME成群唱着悠扬歌谣，回响遍及栖居洞穴。满月之夜，还会带着歌声走到洞外。
author: kiwikelly
source: Swarms of POKENAME sing melodious ballads that echo all throughout their home caverns. They bring their songs outside their caves on full moon nights.

entry: POKENAME吐出的火焰闪烁不定，光谱特征竟与星光相同。
author: RoboSoup
source: The flames breathed out by POKENAME have a twinkling quality to them. These have the same spectrographic signature as starlight.

entry: POKENAME对月亮很感兴趣。夜里，常与同伴一起沐浴月光。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME take interest in the moon. It can be found moon bathing with its peers at night.

entry: 满月之夜，一群POKENAME会爬上高处，向天空洒出闪亮水滴，宛如清凉薄雾。
author: bobosmith01
source: On the nights of a full moon, a group of POKENAME will climb to a high spot and sprinkle twinkling, shining droplets across the sky like cool mist.

entry: 满月时，身上的镰刃发光，力量也大幅增强。电磁脉冲一放，足以让整个街区瘫痪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: On nights with a full moon, the sickles on its body light up, making it far more stronger. An electromagnetic pulse can paralyze entire districts.

entry: 雾天里，它会唱起一支萦绕不去的歌。左边的头唱低音，右边的头唱高音。
author: .izik
source: It sings a haunting song during foggy days. The left head will vocalize the low tones and the right head sings the high tones.

entry: 它一边滚动，一边释放大量电力，将猎物电焦，极少被人见到。
author: themicelegion
source: It rolls around unleashing massive amounts of electricity to fry its prey. It is very rarely seen.

entry: 这只可怕巨兽住在最深海渊。只有闪电撕开黑暗时，才能发现它的踪影。
author: dragonzzilla
source: A dire leviathan that dwells in the utmost depths of the ocean, only ever spotted when its lightning tears through the black.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的强大蟾蜍，会伴着电闪雷鸣现身，帮助有需要者。
author: togetik
source: A powerful toad from legend, POKENAME appears in a flash of thunder and lightning to aid those in need.

entry: 各个部件不断旋转，调节体内庞大电能。破土而出时，声响如一记惊雷。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its parts constantly spin to regulate the immense electrical energy within it. The sound of it emerging from the earth sounds like a thunderclap.

entry: 据说火山喷发遇上风暴，便诞生了它。掌控烈焰与雷电的本领，无可比拟。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is believed to have been birthed when a volcano erupted into a storm. It's control over fire and lightning is unrivalled.

entry: POKENAME从深处现身，迎战破坏自然平衡的宝可梦。背上噼啪迸发着惊人能量。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.

entry: 蓄力时，背上亮起蓝光，传出独特嗡鸣。蓄满后，一击便能轰毁整座城市。
author: dragonzzilla
source: As it gathers energy to attack, its back glows blue and a distinct thrum can be heard. At full charge, it can destroy a whole city in a single blast.

entry: POKENAME从深处现身，迎战破坏自然平衡的宝可梦。背上噼啪迸发着惊人能量。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.

entry: 双爪与背上悬浮的白珠，由带电等离子体相连。释放的电流，极不稳定。
author: raptorroocool
source: Its claws and the white orb floating above its back are connected by a electrically-charged plasma. The electricity coming from it is highly unstable.

entry: 思绪快过闪电，智慧无可比拟。据说有朝一日，POKENAME的长枪会撕开天空。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its thoughts are faster than lightning, and its intelligence is beyond compare. One day, it's said that POKENAME's lance will rend apart the heavens.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃迸出雷霆般的电光，引来雷暴。它偏爱信念格外坚定的持有者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade sparks with the intensity of lighting and and brings about thunderstorms. It gravitates towards wielders with superior conviction.

entry: 刀刃嗡鸣的力量，足以使人汗毛竖起。若持有者配得上它，便会为其指明通往理想未来的道路。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The blade thrums with enough power to set one's hairs on end. To a worthy wielder, it will show a path to an ideal future.

entry: POKENAME只在月食时被人见过翱翔天际。也只让与自己牵绊深厚的人骑上背部。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is only ever seen flying in the sky during lunar eclipses. It only allows those it shares a close bond with to ride on its back.

entry: 虽然体内力量惊人，它大多只拿来做无害的恶作剧，也因此练就了精确调节输出电压的本领。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Despite the immense power it holds within, it mostly uses it for harmless pranks. It has immaculate skill in regulating voltage output due to this.

entry: POKENAME以无线电波与其他低频波为食，积蓄电力。从某些方面看，POKENAME就像卫星。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME feeds off of radio waves and other small frequencies to charge electrical energy. In some respects, POKENAME acts like a satellite.

entry: 睡着后，它会失去控电能力，却也无意中护住自己。每实现一个愿望，理想世界便更近一步。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: When asleep, it loses control over its electricity, shielding itself from harm unconsciously. Each wish it grants brings an ideal world ever closer.

entry: POKENAME住在最深海底。有人推测，所有POKENAME都守着同一件宝物，可前去寻找的人，从未再浮上来。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME live at the very bottom of the sea. It's theorized these POKENAME all guard a single treasure, but anyone that seeks it never resurfaces.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会在颈间聚起闪电，吸引伴侣，也威吓情敌。
author: Crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. It gathers lightning around its neck to both attract potential mates and intimidate rivals.

entry: 它藏在最阴沉的雷暴中，如一颗活的心脏，维持风暴不散。谁若想碰羊毛，瞬间就会被电焦。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It hides amidst the darkest thunderstorms, functioning as a living heart to keep them alive. All who try to touch its wool are fried instantaneously.

entry: 它是活体发电机，能凭空产生能量。已知存世不到20只，因此备受追寻。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is a living generator, able to make energy from nothing. It is highly sought after, as less than 20 are known to exist.

entry: 研究显示，POKENAME携带的骨头常来自远古。塑成斧刃的冰，则永远不会融化。
author: howlingstarr
source: Studies have shown that the bones carried by POKENAME often date back to ancient times. The ice it shapes into the axe blade never melts.

entry: POKENAME最爱玩水！可惜身体太冷，水一碰到它就会结冰。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME loves playing in the water! Unfortunately, its body is so cold that it freezes it upon touch.

entry: 人们会向不听话的孩子讲POKENAME的故事。据说被带爪的蹄轻轻一碰，数秒内便会冻到绝对零度。
author: char_latte3412
source: Stories of POKENAME are told to misbehaving children. It is said that one touch of its clawed hoof can freeze a victim to absolute zero in seconds.

entry: 据说挥动这把斧头的，是神明冰封的手臂。击中的一切，都会被冻结、粉碎。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It is said that the frozen arm of a god wields this axe. It freezes and shatters all that it strikes.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自宇宙最寒冷的深处，会寻找强敌，汲取对方的力量。
author: Mistymagius
source: This Pokémon is said to come from the coldest depths of space. POKENAME seek powerful opponents to leech off their strength.

entry: 它是出色舞者，将舞步融入战法，制造裹着烈焰的炽热花瓣攻击。
author: creeps_jr
source: It is a great dancer and incorporates dances into its battle style. It produces hot petals engulfed in flames to attack with.

entry: POKENAME有一双强健的翅膀，即使在狭窄洞穴中，飞行时速也能超过100英里。尖牙之利，足以刺穿波士可多拉的厚皮。
author: ansleehariot
source: With its powerful wings, POKENAME can reach upwards of 100 mph during flight even in the most cramped of caves. Its fangs can pierce an Aggron's hide.

entry: 它似乎还有个双胞胎。在阳光下转个圈，获胜的干劲就涌现。
author: mercury_sc
source: This fusion seems to have a twin. In the sun, it likes to spin and that gives it the drive to win.

entry: POKENAME似乎亲近猫，却讨厌那些不讲理的熊孩子。
author: mercury_sc
source: POKENAME seems to have an affinity for cats and a distaste for children that act like brats.

entry: POKENAME用尾上花朵结出的果实调制颜料，既能作画，也用来标记领地。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Using the fruit produced by the flower on its tail, POKENAME will produce the ink it uses to paint. It marks its territory with this paint.

entry: 有的POKENAME尾花是蓝色，有的是红色。花色相同的个体，往往更能相处融洽。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some POKENAME have blue flowers on their tail, while others have red. Individuals with the same color flowers are more likely to get along.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，镰刃会分泌毒液。它藏在树冠，从上方突然袭敌，保护弱小者。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME's scythes secrete poison when in battle. It defends the weak by hiding in the treetops, catching enemies unaware from above.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，抵御敌人与人类，也能感知森林中的一切生灵。
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME defend nature from adversaries and humans. Additionally, they can sense all living beings in the forests.

entry: POKENAME尖刺上的毒液，会引起剧烈灼痛。伤口若不治疗，就永远痛个不停。
author: theradrad
source: The venom that coats POKENAME's thorns causes a severe searing pain. If left untreated, wounds caused by these thorns will never stop hurting.

entry: POKENAME如跳舞般，有节奏地挥鞭攻击。刺上的毒，发作迅速又致命。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME attacks rhythmically with its whip, like a dance. The poison on its thorns is fast-acting and deadly.

entry: POKENAME自豪地守护花与蜂，会驻守花园门口，警惕看护，等花朵安全萌芽。
author: Pieick6662
source: Proud defender of the flower and the bee, POKENAME will post itself at the gate of a garden and keep watch, waiting for flowers to safely sprout.

entry: POKENAME以甜香将旅人引入森林深处。被荆刺扎到的人，都会遭受致命诅咒。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME lures travelers deep into the forest with sweet aromas. Its thorns inflict a deadly curse upon anyone they prick.

entry: 它十分浪漫，常想用花朵或强壮力气，博取雌性宝可梦欢心。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This fusion is very romantic, it is often seen trying impress female Pokémon with flowers or with its strength.

entry: POKENAME在伽勒尔学了多年礼仪，抛开年少时的莽撞好斗，成为出色的管家。
author: Mister J
source: Having studied proper manners in Galar for years, POKENAME have cast aside the rough and tumble of their youth to become master butlers.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，低飞掠过海洋，从不沾水。虽然已无法游泳，却始终依恋水边。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: Small groups of POKENAME fly low over the ocean, never touching the water. Though it can no longer swim, it always stays near water.

entry: POKENAME常在夜海、尤其离岸流中出现。它随流漂荡，将困在其中的孩子带向外海。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME is often seen at night in the ocean, usually during riptides. It floats within the currents and takes children caught within them out to sea.

entry: 夜里风太强，POKENAME就常不小心飘入月色深处。它几乎控制不了自己的身体。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often accidently drifts off into the moonlight if the winds are too strong during the night. It barely has control of its body.

entry: POKENAME常在废弃店铺外随风摇摆，吸引路人走入，仿佛店从未歇业。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is often found outside of abandoned shops. It waves its body around in the wind to lure passersby inside, as if the building never closed.

entry: POKENAME常在废弃店铺外随风摇摆，吸引路人走入，仿佛店从未歇业。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is often found outside of abandoned shops. It waves its body around in the wind to lure passersby inside, as if the building never closed.

entry: 不幸遭它火焰灼伤的人，会陷入永无止境的悲伤。
author: ariamelisma
source: Those who are unfortunate enough to be scorched by this Pokémon's flames are afflicted with a never-ending sorrow.

entry: 它们爱在夜里成大群猎魂。收集灵魂最多的POKENAME，就会成为首领。
author: ariamelisma
source: Preferring to operate at night, they set out in large packs to hunt for souls. The POKENAME that can collect the most souls is considered the leader.

entry: 爪子锋利如刃。为免不小心戳破自己，它飞得十分缓慢。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its claws are razor-sharp. It flies very slowly so that it doesn't accidentally pop its own body.

entry: POKENAME的头富有弹性，能把对手弹出数公里，也能变硬，造成巨大破坏。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: With its flexible head, POKENAME can bounce opponents back several kilometers, but it can also harden its head to cause enormous destruction.

entry: POKENAME爱跃向高空。只有跃起半空时才会露出破绽，因此很难捕捉。
author: beespoon
source: POKENAME are known for leaping into the air. Since they are only open to attack mid-leap, it can be difficult to catch one.

entry: POKENAME爱跃向高空。只有跃起半空时才会露出破绽，因此很难捕捉。
author: beespoon
source: POKENAME are known for leaping into the air. Since they are only open to attack mid-leap, it can be difficult to catch one.

entry: 车行可能会发现，门口竟多了一个摇摆充气人偶。往往直到POKENAME把孩子拖入地底，人们才察觉危险。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A car dealership may find it has one too many tube men. Often, the danger is only noticed when a child is pulled under the earth by POKENAME.

entry: 它靠尾尖火焰控制高度，而收集的亡魂的悲伤，正是火焰的燃料。
author: ariamelisma
source: It controls its altitude with the flame at the tip of its tail, which is fueled by the sorrows of the souls it collects.

entry: POKENAME头尾的云团映照心情。难过时，云会变暗，向光滑的身体降下倾盆大雨。
author: char_latte3412
source: The cloud puffs on POKENAME's head and tail reflect its mood. When upset, the clouds darken, releasing a torrential rain over its sleek body.

entry: 它盼着载个朋友，一同飘过天空。可只要被看见，就会消失，因此始终没能找到。
author: ariamelisma
source: It longs for a friend to carry as it drifts about in the sky, but it never finds one because it vanishes as soon as it is noticed.

entry: 身体完全中空，只有云雾微粒填充。POKENAME胀得太大，就会从尾巴排出一些微粒。
author: themicelegion
source: Its body is completely hollow, only filled with cloud particles. POKENAME lets out some of these particles from its tail when it gets too bloated.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下，躲避觊觎皮毛的收藏者。藏起来时，活动的角也会保护自己。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME burrows beneath the ground to escape collectors who want its fur. Its mobile horns defend it while it hides.

entry: POKENAME能跳跃滑翔，一跃跨过数英里。可跳起来之后，谁也不能保证它还会落下。
author: kandyman
source: POKENAME's ability to jump and glide allows it to cross miles in a single bound. When it leaps, there is no guarantee it will come back down again.

entry: 古老民间故事里，整座镇子的人都因它的甜香而追赶它。它的速度，也出了名地快。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: There is an old folk story that tells of this Pokémon being chased by an entire town for its sweet scent. It is known for being extremely fast.

entry: POKENAME以优美金角与蓬松耳毛闻名，却也因此遭捕猎，几近灭绝。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is well known for its elegant golden antlers and fluffy ear fur. Because of this, it has been hunted close to extinction.

entry: POKENAME喜欢照顾训练家与小宝可梦。一发现照顾对象，就会把对方裹住，再也不放手。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME loves caring for Trainers and small Pokémon. If it finds one, it will wrap around them and never let go.

entry: 它们精力十足，常出现在健身影片中，鼓励观众跳舞，直到累倒。
author: Quote.lass
source: These energetic Pokémon make frequent appearances in exercise videos, encouraging viewers to dance until they drop.

entry: POKENAME的头虽坚如岩石，仍担心外露的头骨。它会把长耳朵绕在头上，好好保护。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite its head being rock-hard, POKENAME will worry about its exposed cranium. It will wrap its long ears around its skull to keep itself safe.

entry: 每到春天，许多糖果公司都会用POKENAME打广告。仿着它头部做的特色糖果，也卖得很热。
author: char_latte3412
source: Many candy companies feature POKENAME in their advertisements come springtime. Special sweets molded to look like its head are popularly sold.

entry: 真正的超级进化虽会带来痛苦，借融合发动却完全不痛。POKENAME甚至很享受。
author: pokebio
source: While actual Mega Evolution causes pain, activating it via fusion is painless. In fact, POKENAME enjoys it.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有独特机甲。据说野生POKENAME会彼此斗殴，比谁的机甲最强。
author: jackgrifin
source: Each POKENAME's mecha is unique from the others. Wild POKENAME are said to brawl one another to see who has the strongest mecha.

entry: 它是失去生命的悲伤兔灵。心情低落时，喜欢送彩蛋给年幼卷卷耳。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A mournful rabbit spirit who lost its life. It likes to give colored eggs to young Buneary when it feels down.

entry: 这些好奇的长耳兔摆弄古老神秘科技，最后造出形似泥偶小人的机甲。
author: jackgrifin
source: These curious Lopunny have tinkered around with some ancient and mysterious technology, resulting in a mecha that resembles a Golett.

entry: 受到妥善关爱与照料，POKENAME便会茁壮成长，比进化前更有自信。不过，对不信任的陌生人，它仍很少开口歌唱。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: With proper love and care, POKENAME will grow and have more confidence than its pre-evolution. However, it seldom sings to strangers it doesn't trust.

entry: 毛发掩住了手臂，让POKENAME看起来柔软可亲。登山者有时会带它同行，用来保暖。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME's fur gives its arms a deceptively soft appearance. Mountain climbers sometimes bring POKENAME with them to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME振翅攻击时，能随机引发一种异常状态。甜香却有毒的花粉团，也能帮它引诱猎物。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to attack and cause a random status condition. It can lure prey with its sweet-yet-poisonous pollen puffs.

entry: 野生POKENAME藏在蘑菇间，静待猎物靠近。目标一来，便从地下放出孢子，使其麻痹。
author: yinxuze
source: A wild POKENAME will hide among mushshrooms and wait for prey to approach. Once they do, it releases spores from the ground to paralyze them.

entry: POKENAME从壳上的红色喷口放出孢子。敌人若靠得太近，它就甩尾一击，将其打飞。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME spews spores from the red nozzles on its shell. If an enemy gets close, it sends them flying with a blow from its tail.

entry: 人们轻率地将种种神奇能力归于POKENAME，其实，那些“神迹”大多出自它释放的致幻孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild assortment of powers have been prematurely attributed to POKENAME, but most of those powers come from the hallucinogenic spores it can release.

entry: POKENAME头上的蘑菇，不断产生彩色孢子。吸入后，可能陷入沉睡、麻痹，甚至轻度中毒。
author: howlingstarr
source: The mushroom on a POKENAME's head is constantly producing colorful spores. Inhaling them can cause deep slumber, paralysis, or even a mild poison.

entry: POKENAME短短的翅膀很有弹性，唯独红色翼尖又密又沉，恰好用来狠狠敲打敌人。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's stubby wings are elastic, save for the red tip. That part of the wing is dense and heavy; perfect for clobbering foes.

entry: POKENAME挥动带刺的利爪斩击敌人。致命的孢子与巨龙般的凶猛，让它成为战场上可怕的对手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME slashes through foes with its thorny claws. Its deadly spores and dragon-like ferocity make it a formidable opponent in battle.

entry: POKENAME常住在草木丛生、孢子弥漫的洞穴中，用壳上鱼叉般的尖刺，牢牢钩住洞壁。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME are often found in overgrown caves full of their spores. They hold onto cave walls with the harpoon-like spikes protruding from its shell.

entry: POKENAME在散发着潮湿气味的森林中挪动，想要融入菌丝与苔藓之间。它的孢子具有强烈的催眠效果，令人畏惧。
author: Xephyr
source: POKENAME shuffle around in musky forests, hoping to blend in with the mycelium and moss. Their spores are feared for their drowsy potency.

entry: POKENAME像直升机桨叶一样，盘旋在地面上空。边缘锋利如刀，能轻易切断树木。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hovers above the land like the blade of a helicopter. It's edges are as sharp as knives and can easily cut through trees.

entry: 人们多次试着让POKENAME载客，都以失败告终。它动作太快，歌声又刺耳，坐上去实在难受。
author: char_latte3412
source: Many attempts to utilize POKENAME as a means of transport have failed. Its piercing songs and quick movements make for uncomfortable traveling.

entry: POKENAME出鞘之快，声响震耳欲聋。可受害者听见时，早已被利刃划伤。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The speed in which POKENAME unsheathes is deafening. By the time its victim hears it, however, they are already wounded by its blade.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，又能感知磁场，难以捕捉。因此，人们至今对它知之甚少。
author: MidnightSoup
source: POKENAME's speed and ability to detect magnetic fields make it very difficult to catch. As a result, not much is known about this Pokémon.

entry: 这是个机敏、安静、行动迅捷的窃贼。贵重物品若被POKENAME偷走，多半就再也找不回来了。
author: fountainihili
source: A tactful, quiet, and swift thief. If you find that your valuables have been stolen by a POKENAME, you'll probably never get them back.

entry: 传说，贤者曾用它的丝线，在人死后将灵魂缚回躯体。仪式还需要一根银针与一块水晶。
author: .izik
source: There are tales of sages relying on its silk to tie a person's soul to their body after death. The ritual requires a silver needle and a crystal.

entry: 它喜欢在沼泽筑巢。角中的毒液会散发恶臭，闻着就像腐烂的桃桃果。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to make its nest in marshes. The venom within its horn lets loose a foul odor that smells like rotting Pecha Berries.

entry: POKENAME常潜入屋内，藏进衣柜，等人经过时，突然跳出来吓对方一跳。
author: mrbapcik
source: Entering homes, they wait for the right moment to scare passersby. POKENAME often hide in closets.

entry: 寄生的布已将宿主吸食殆尽，只余一副躯壳。找到什么布料，它都会往宿主身上缝。
author: 8xviktor
source: The parasitic cloth has absorbed the host entirely, leaving only a husk behind. It stitches any fabrics it finds onto the body of its host.

entry: 它们游荡异界，吞食迷失的灵魂。吃得足够饱的POKENAME，便可能现身于现实世界。
author: mrbapcik
source: Roaming the otherworldly realm, they consume lost souls. A POKENAME that has fed enough may appear in the real world.

entry: 周围的恶意与怨恨越浓，这只宝可梦越压不住体内的诅咒。诅咒从缝隙中迸出，化为骇人的附肢。
author: ziggaway
source: As malice and vindictiveness around it grows, this Pokémon cannot contain its curses. They burst from its seams, appearing as ghastly appendages.

entry: 滚动时，它会散发引起成人负面情绪的气息，让人哭泣、暴怒，甚至陷入深重的抑郁。
author: .izik
source: It emits an aura while it rolls that can cause negative feelings in adults. This can cause crying, fits of rage, or even a deep depression.

entry: 心烦时，它会流下橙色的泪。泪水含有剧毒，千万不要触碰。
author: .izik
source: When it gets upset, it will begin to cry orange tears. The tears are extremely poisonous and should not be touched.

entry: POKENAME会打开通往亡魂牢狱的门，里面囚着死去已久的灵魂。它想用诅咒，让别人也落得同样的下场。
author: seafoamtaide
source: POKENAME opens portals to the prison of long-dead spirits, hoping to curse others to their fate.

entry: 有传闻说，POKENAME能听见其他维度的声音。不过，至今没有确凿证据。
author: .izik
source: There are stories that say that a POKENAME can hear things in alternate dimensions. There is no factual knowledge that backs this up.

entry: POKENAME常数着训练家惊慌时掉落的钱币。还有人说，可以找它借钱。
author: Tad
source: POKENAME can often be found counting coins dropped by panicking trainers. Some say you can borrow money from them.

entry: 千万别让POKENAME离开视线。它有好几张嘴，能把人类与宝可梦整个吞下，每道拉链后都藏着一条舌头。
author: themicelegion
source: Don't ever let a POKENAME out of your sight. It swallows people and Pokémon whole with its multiple mouths. It has a tongue for every zipper.

entry: 不愿离开训练家的宝可梦灵魂，会化作POKENAME。只要与训练家重逢，它们便能恢复原来的模样。
author: Skymaster426
source: Pokémon souls unwilling to part with their Trainer are turned into POKENAME. Meeting their Trainer allows them to turn back to their normal form.

entry: 诅咒娃娃变成POKENAME后，怒气竟全消了。如今，它只爱高高兴兴地陪孩子玩。
author: pokebio
source: Banette lost all its anger after turning into POKENAME. Now it happily plays with childrens.

entry: POKENAME坐起来十分舒服，让人不知不觉就想睡着。可看它的表情，POKENAME似乎不太喜欢被这么对待。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is a very comfortable seat, and you can easily fall asleep on it. However, its face gives the impression that POKENAME doesn't like this.

entry: 若发现有疲惫的旅人，睡在自己柔软的身体上，POKENAME便会放出一记电击，将对方困在深沉的睡梦中。
author: _testrun_
source: If this monster happens to find a weary traveller sleeping on its soft body, POKENAME will send a shock that traps them in deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME曾是暴风雪中被主人抛弃的玩偶。为了复仇，它不断冻住旅人，直到找出当年遗弃自己的人。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME was once a doll abandoned by its owner in a blizzard. Seeking revenge, it freezes travelers until it finds the one that abandoned it.

entry: 它把根深深扎进泥里，吸收养分，喜欢住在湿地等淡水充足的地方。
author: .izik
source: Its roots extend deep into the mud to absorb nutrients. It prefers to live in wetlands and other areas with plenty of fresh water.

entry: 虽然已融合，体内的诅咒娃娃仍能短暂离开装甲。它回来之前，空壳便一动不动。
author: OhOk3441
source: Despite being a fusion, the Banette within can leave the armor for short periods of time. The hollow shell will be inactive until it returns.

entry: 众多拉链中藏着危险的花粉。若近距离接触，就可能昏迷不醒，陷入受诅咒的幻象。
author: seafoamtaide
source: Its many zippers contain dangerous pollen. Close contact with the substance can render one comatose and victim to cursed visions.

entry: 有个童话说，POKENAME专盯着考试不好的孩子。一旦成绩太差，就会被它从家里掳走。
author: .izik
source: There is a children's story of POKENAME that watch for children who do poorly on tests. Once they get bad grades, it will steal them from their home.

entry: 主人对音乐的热爱，让POKENAME获得了生命。它幽幽而舒缓的歌声，还能让别的玩偶活过来，组成偶像团体。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: Its owner's love for music brought POKENAME to life. Its haunting yet soothing voice can reanimate other dolls to be used as an idol group.

entry: POKENAME从另一个维度探入我们的世界，是个凶狠的斗士，身体与心灵，都能成为它攻击的目标。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Reaching into our world from another dimension, POKENAME is a brutal fighter capable of both physical and psychological attacks.

entry: POKENAME能藏进阴影，甚至另一个维度。无论何时何地，都可能突然现身，打出决定性的一拳。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Able to hide in shadows and even another dimension, POKENAME is capable of striking from anywhere, at any time, with a decisive jab of its fist.

entry: 覆盖呆呆兽的寄生布不断扩张，吸收能力也随之增强。这种共生关系，已经引发伦理上的质疑。
author: 8xviktor
source: The parasitic cloth that covers the Slowpoke has expanded and thus increased its absorption. The ethics of this relationship have been questioned.

entry: 寄生布吸走了宿主除意识外的一切，让宿主彻底失去知觉。
author: 8xviktor
source: The parasitic cloth has absorbed everything from its host except its consciousness. This has left the host completely numb.

entry: 它体内中空。拉链打开，水便被吸进胸口，随后就能在战斗中，借神秘力量操纵这些水。
author: HoundRyS
source: It is hollow. Water is sucked into its chest when the zipper opens; it later uses that water in battle, manipulating it with its paranormal powers.

entry: POKENAME体内储存着极不稳定的电力与等离子体，时时都有爆炸的危险。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME store highly volatile electricity and plasma within their bodies. Due to this, they are constantly at risk of exploding.

entry: 洛托姆本想附进熟睡的卡拉卡拉所戴的头骨里，却与卡拉卡拉结下了牵绊。如今，它们结伴旅行。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Trying to merge with the skull on a sleeping Cubone's head, Rotom became attached to the Cubone. They now travel together.

entry: 雷暴中，POKENAME从一台街机诞生。如今，它执着地吞食现实中的树果，一心想长得更大。
author: abstrusePalidin
source: Spawned from an arcade cabinet during a lightning storm, POKENAME now obsessively consumes berries in the real world to increase in size.

entry: POKENAME常打开背上的保温箱，为海滩游客送上饮品。可饮料究竟打哪儿来，谁也说不清。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME will often provide refreshments to beachgoers using the cooler on its back. Where these drinks come from, nobody quite knows.

entry: 这只洛托姆附在自动贩卖机里。战斗时，它会借助强大的电击，将饮料射出去。
author: zic
source: This Rotom has possessed a vending machine. When in battle, it shoots out the refreshments using powerful electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME的昆虫基因通过等离子体身体折射，投射出翅膀的全息影像。它的核心不停地发出低沉、单调的嗡鸣。
author: wigglypon
source: POKENAME's insect DNA is refracted through its plasma body, projecting holograms of wings. Its core constantly emits a muffled, droning buzz.

entry: 小小的自动温室，保护着构成POKENAME真正身体的种子。里面的暖灯，也让它免受严寒侵袭。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The small autonomous greenhouse protects the seed that forms the actual body of POKENAME. The heat lamp also protects it from freezing temperatures.

entry: 温室保护着POKENAME真正的身体，抵挡风雨；外罩还能储存多余的太阳能，留待寒冷的日子使用。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The greenhouse protects POKENAME's actual body from bad weather. The cover also stores excess absorbed solar energy for cold days.

entry: 它不像神奥的近亲那么热衷破坏，恶作剧的心却更盛，总把自己寄宿的电器弄得失灵。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: While less set on causing destruction than its cousin from Sinnoh, its has a greater appetite for mischief, causing appliances it inhabits to fail.

entry: POKENAME在设备间跳转，用古老的语言改写程序。网络消息，甚至一段普通文字，都可能成为它病毒般传播的媒介。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME jumps from device to device, rewriting programs in an ancient language. It can spread virally through online messages or even simple text.

entry: 它的头与尾各有独立的意识，平时互不相通，唯有战斗时，两颗心才能真正同步。
author: Staghorn
source: The consciousnesses in its head and tail are completely separate. Only in battle do its two minds properly synchronize.

entry: 松果状的导电甲片层层排列，护住体内的电力核心。必要时，它还能充当应急发电机。
author: lynkinator
source: It hosts an electric core, sheltered by its pinecone-shaped array of conductive, armored plating. It may also be utilized as an emergency generator.

entry: 核心释放的力量近乎无穷，却被坚固的外壳牢牢封住。若伸手触碰，仍会挨上一记轻微的电击。
author: dyo_jonah
source: The near-limitless power it discharges from its core is encapsulated in its solid shell. If you touch it, you'll get a mild shock.

entry: POKENAME喜欢唱歌。别看模样如此，它与孩子十分亲近，还常为迷路的孩子引路，将他们带到安全的地方。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME loves to sing. Despite its appearance, it gets along well with children. It can often be found guiding lost kids to safety.

entry: 这只热心的融合宝可梦喜欢利用三维打印而成的身体与电动机，为训练家制作刨冰。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: This helpful fusion enjoys producing shaved ice treats for its Trainers using its 3D-printed body and electric motor.

entry: 它寄宿在一台老旧破损的绘图板里。谁若拿起画笔，就会中了诅咒，满脑子只想创作艺术。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It inhabits an old and worn-out tablet. Those who pick up its pen are cursed with an overwhelming urge to create art.

entry: POKENAME带电的触碰，能将治愈的能量传出去。安详的气息与幽灵的力量，也为需要帮助的人带来慰藉。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME spreads healing energy through its electrified touch. Its calming presence and spectral abilities bring comfort and solace to those in need.

entry: 曾有记录称，POKENAME以时速88英里穿行，时而遁入时间，时而重返现世。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: There have been records of POKENAME being seen drifting in and out of time at a speed of 88 mph.

entry: 这只融合体仿佛来自遥远的未来，与其说是幽灵，不如说更像机械。电机般的哀号与尖叫，能让电子设备失灵。
author: awiralonprime
source: This fusion seems to be from the far future, being more mechanical than spiritual. Its motorized wails and screams can cause electronics to fail.

entry: POKENAME操纵电子设备的本领，已臻炉火纯青。只需发出一声尖叫，就能让电器听从使唤。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME has mastered its powers to control electronics with unmatched skill. It can emit a scream that allows it to control electrical devices.

entry: POKENAME躲在盒子里等待猎物。一被受害者惊动，就突然跳出来——不只吓人一跳，还要电人一下！
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME hides in its box, waiting for prey. When provoked by a victim, it jumps out at them, shocking them in more ways than one!

entry: 都市传说说，若在特定时刻，把电视调到特定频道，POKENAME便会前来索命。传说是真的。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Urban legends say that when one's TV is turned to the right station at exactly the right time, POKENAME will arrive to claim them. They're right.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，头部与双臂上的电锯，却能轻松切开金属。许多训练家觉得，它很像某个虚构角色。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is a loyal fusion. The chainsaws on its arms and head can easily cut through metal. Many Trainers think it resembles a fictional character.

entry: 幽灵附上一件被淘汰的旧电器，便形成了它。据说，头上的天线能接收来自失落世界的信号。
author: r.isk
source: It arose from a spirit possessing an obsoleted piece of technology. It's said the antenna on its head receives signals from lost worlds.

entry: POKENAME成了一副遭弃置的旧科技外壳，里面藏着一盘神秘磁带。据传，磁带中录着萦绕不去的旋律。
author: LordKai1
source: POKENAME has become a discarded shell of outdated technology. It houses a mysterious cassette tape rumored to contain a haunting melody.

entry: POKENAME能轻松搬动重物，作为工具十分好用；对活物也能这么做，便又成了所谓“致命性较低的武器”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME essentially functions as a tool that can move heavy objects with ease or a “less lethal weapon” that can do the same with living things.

entry: 带有电磁性质的外壳，会引来许多电宝可梦。POKENAME不胜其烦，索性想办法把它们吓走。
author: mercury_sc
source: The shell is electromagnetic in nature, which attracts many Electric Pokémon. This annoys POKENAME, which decides to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME爱模仿旧格斗游戏里的招式，似乎能在实战中越打越强。这份本领，来自它吃下的老游戏卡带。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME seems to gain its strength by battling using moves seen in old fighting games. It gained this power from its diet of old game cartridges.

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: POKENAME是一把威力惊人的能量剑。人们相信，它来自一个遥远、遥远的地方……
author: Rkmaster25367
source: As an energy sword of vast power, POKENAME is believed to hail from a land far, far away....

entry: 使用基因之楔融合两只POKENAME后，洛托姆最真实的形态显露了出来：纯粹的能量。
author: xtjs2018x
source: Combining two POKENAME with a DNA splicer revealed Rotom's truest form: Pure energy.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，又爱胡闹。野生POKENAME常在输电线附近晃荡。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME is super energetic and chaotic. Wild POKENAME can be seen hanging around power lines.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一只有缺陷的电源分配器。据推测，若把所有插头都接上插座，就会引发惊人的大爆炸。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME's body is made from a defective power hub. It is theorized that plugging all of its plugs into outlets would cause a tremendous explosion.

entry: 旋入普通灯座后，POKENAME便会吸走在它灯光下休息的人的生命能量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: After screwing into ordinary sockets, POKENAME absorbs the life energy of those who rest in its light.

entry: POKENAME能投射出无害宝可梦的影像，吸引目光，再把猎物引进带电的陷阱，牢牢捕住。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: To lure and capture its prey via its electrified traps, POKENAME is able to project images of harmless Pokémon that catch anyone's eye.

entry: 它吸收附近的电力，受威胁时会将电力化成尖刺射出去。即使只是兴奋，也可能突然放电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It absorbs nearby electricity and shoots it off in electrical spikes when threatened or just excited.

entry: POKENAME很少停下来休息，偶尔歇脚，也只是搭在电线上，花几秒钟给自己充电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In the few moments that it rests, POKENAME recharges itself on electrical wires, only for just a few seconds.

entry: 抓娃娃机总爱给玩家使绊子，POKENAME却别出心裁：看似不花钱，付出的代价，却是挨一场伏击。
author: redhaering
source: While claw games are rigged against the player, POKENAME is uniquely so—free though it may seem, the cost is an ambush.

entry: 它脸上有七盏灯，会随心情闪出不同的颜色与图案。它也喜欢听着音乐跳舞。
author: kittyluv090
source: It has seven lights on its face that constantly flash with various colors and patterns depending on its mood. It also enjoys dancing to music.

entry: POKENAME模样古怪，却能靠厕所笑话，瞬间逗笑哭泣的孩子。攻击其他宝可梦时，它常会掀着盖子。
author: rigelpogi08
source: POKENAME may look unconventional, but it can instantly cheer up crying children with its toilet humor. It often attacks Pokémon with its lid open.

entry: 有人没发现自己坐的不是普通马桶，便成了POKENAME恶作剧的目标。它会冷不丁冲水，吓对方一跳。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME loves to prank humans who don't know that they're not sitting on a regular toilet seat. They do this by flushing the toilet unexpectedly.

entry: POKENAME用淤泥般的身体裹住机械，就能控制它，甚至还能替机器升级，增强性能。
author: sabrina_the_witch
source: If a POKENAME covers any form of machinery with its sludgy body, not only will it be able to take control of it, but it can upgrade its capabilities.

entry: 它不断再生细胞，分离出胶状的身体组织。这些组织都带着病原体，千万不要触碰。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It constantly regenerates its cells and splits off its jelly-like body parts. They are infected with pathogens, which is why contact must be avoided.

entry: 两颗头之间的连接一旦断开，POKENAME就会分成双卵细胞球与单卵细胞球，有时甚至还会多出一只人造细胞卵。
author: spookoftheoldways
source: If the connection between the two heads is ever severed, POKENAME will split into separate Duosion and Solosis, and sometimes another Reuniclus.

entry: POKENAME手边备着许多进化石。遇险时，就用超能力把石头掷向敌人。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME has many evolution stones at its disposal. When in danger, it will throw the stones at enemies using its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME的地雷状圆球里，装着易燃物质，一靠近对手就会爆炸。论起爆破，它可是一把好手。
author: p0opys0ck123abc
source: POKENAME stores a combustive substance in its mine-like orbs, which explode when in close proximity with the opponent. It is a master of demolition.

entry: POKENAME是凶狠的猎手，会用超能力定住猎物，再注入强效毒液，断绝它们的生机。
author: giggity._.
source: A vicious hunter, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place. It then injects its prey with a powerful toxin, sealing their fate.

entry: POKENAME是凶狠的猎手，会用超能力定住猎物，再注入强效毒液，断绝它们的生机。
author: giggity._.
source: A vicious hunter, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place. It then injects its prey with a powerful toxin, sealing their fate.

entry: POKENAME把食物吸进黏稠的藤蔓进食。身体柔软得不可思议，即使遭重物压扁，也能毫发无伤地钻出来。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME eats food by absorbing it into its gooey vines. Its body is so squishy that it can be crushed by a heavy object and emerge from it unharmed.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: POKENAME天生不会飞，却将超能力练得出神入化，照样能飞上天空。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME naturally cannot fly. However, it does fly using psychic powers that it has trained to perfection.

entry: POKENAME周身的薄膜十分娇弱，因此总悬浮着，只用多出的肢体去碰外面的东西。
author: ohok3441
source: The membrane surrounding POKENAME is delicate. It floats, only touching things with its extra limbs.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用触觉探索世界。若受到细心照料，就会格外亲人。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tend to explore through touch. If treated with care, they'll be incredibly affectionate.

entry: 用基因之楔融合两只POKENAME后，它们获得了继续分裂的能力。随着时间推移，它们可能会长大到无法容纳的程度。
author: xtjs2018x
source: Combining two POKENAME with DNA splicers has given them the ability to continue to split. In time, they may grow too large to contain.

entry: 背上的特殊液体，控制着POKENAME的行动。它力气极大，单用一只手，就能捏碎树干。
author: Pizzarcato
source: A special liquid on its back controls POKENAME. Just one of its powerful hands can crush a tree trunk.

entry: 传说POKENAME思乡心切，才让背上长出了月亮。有时会让旅人梦见月上的景象。
author: ZombieShinx_
source: Legend says POKENAME's desperate desire to go home caused the growth of the moon on its back. It sometimes gives dreams of the moon to travelers.

entry: 它挥动骨棒，便会洒出宝石碎屑。关都的占星师，常用这些碎片占卜未来。
author: .izik
source: When it swings its bone, it lets loose crushed gemstones. Kanto astrologists use the pieces to divine the future.

entry: 久久凝望POKENAME闪烁而缥缈的翅膀，便会生出强烈乡愁，想回到那些自己从未见过的星辰。
author: .realthree
source: Those who gaze for too long at POKENAME's glimmering, ethereal wings feel an intense yearning to return to stars they have never seen.

entry: 月食之时，它喜欢在最高的山巅优雅起舞。见到这支舞的人，也会不由自主地随它跳起来。
author: kittyluv090
source: It likes to elegantly dance atop the highest mountains during lunar eclipses. Those who witness its movements find themselves dancing along with it.

entry: 这只宝可梦吃得太多，庞大的质量竟让肚子变成了黑洞。不过，实际好像也没什么不同。
author: funkytomate
source: This Pokémon has consumed so much food that its belly has turned into a black hole from all the mass. In practice, not much has changed.

entry: POKENAME载着孩子，遨游奇幻夜空的故事，流传甚广。可真正得到证实的目击，却寥寥无几。
author: Staghorn
source: Stories of POKENAME giving small children wondrous and magical rides through the night sky are common. Confirmed sightings, however, are rare.

entry: POKENAME笑容之下，藏着一口尖牙，却害羞得不敢咬人。它飞行无声，以免干扰自己敏锐的听觉。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME's smile conceals a sharp set of fangs. However, it is much too shy to bite humans. It flies silently to not disrupt its sensitive hearing.

entry: 稀疏而纤长的细毛，披在它身上。即使沉入漆黑海渊，仍如星辰般闪烁。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Long, fine hairs sparsely cover its body. They shimmer like stars even in the pitch-black depths of the sea.

entry: POKENAME又被称作“深海银河”。即使潜入阳光照不到的海渊，体型最大的个体发出的光，仍能从海面望见。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is also called the “Galaxy of the Deep”. The largest ones can be seen glowing from the ocean's surface even at depths the sun cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现于人前。若有幸寻到，它就会让来者看见浩瀚深空的美丽幻象。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME are rarely seen by human eyes. Those who are lucky enough to find one are shown beautiful visions of deep space.

entry: 这只宝可梦大如恒星。头部巨大无比，连太阳系中的所有行星，都已被它吸引，拖在身后。
author: funkytomate
source: A Pokémon the size of a star. Its head is so massive that it has started pulling all planets of our solar system behind it.

entry: POKENAME头部庞大的质量，形成了独立的引力场，连足以组成一个太阳系的岩石，也只能尾随其后。
author: fixthewifi
source: The sheer mass of POKENAME's head has created its own gravitational pull. Rocks equating a solar system can't help but trail behind it.

entry: 满月之夜，它们常聚到山上，围成一圈，交换旅途中收集的小饰品。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They will typically appear on the night of a full moon, gathering in a circle on mountains to exchange trinkets they've collected on their travels.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会将一种缥缈的液体吸进针筒。注射过这种液体的人，从此再也不必睡觉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME draws an ethereal liquid into its syringe on full-moon nights. Anyone injected with this substance will forever lose the need for sleep.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: 训练家夜里难以入睡时，POKENAME就会围着对方优雅起舞，唱起轻柔的摇篮曲。
author: kittyluv090
source: If its Trainer is having trouble falling asleep at night, POKENAME will dance around them beautifully while singing a soothing lullaby.

entry: 它平日很少移动，静静吸收星辰的力量。满月照下，花朵绽出的华光，会让所有见者为之痴迷。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It is mostly sedentary, soaking up power from the stars. When struck by the full moon, the majestic radiance of its blossom entrances all that see it.

entry: 身边不断旋转的圆环，是POKENAME亲手铸成的。科学家认为，这是它排解思乡之苦的方式。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME has forged the ring spinning around it by itself. Scientists believe that this is its way of dealing with homesickness.

entry: POKENAME对人类十分戒备。两只大耳朵始终留意四周，探察潜在的威胁。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME are wary of humans. Their large ears are constantly monitoring the environment of possible threats.

entry: POKENAME虽体型庞大、力气惊人，性情却很友善，总会主动避开各种争斗与冲突。
author: kittyluv090
source: Despite its great size and strength, POKENAME is actually quite friendly. It actively avoids getting involved in any type of fight or conflict.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全由宇宙能量构成，在这颗星球上极难见到。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of pure cosmic energy. It is very rarely seen on this planet.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全由宇宙能量构成，在这颗星球上极难见到。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of pure cosmic energy. It is very rarely seen on this planet.

entry: 它的双手由太空的虚无构成。抓住目标后，便用手覆住对方的脸，让其窒息。
author: funkytomate
source: Its hands are made out of the void of space. It takes hold of its targets and suffocates them by putting a hand over their face.

entry: 头顶的星星，蓄满了宇宙能量。有人相信，若能摸到它而不被烫伤，就能实现一个愿望。
author: OhOk3441
source: The star atop this fusion's head is filled with cosmic energy. Some believe that if you touch it without getting burnt, you'll be granted a wish.

entry: 它头上月牙状的饰物，根本拿不下来。谁若伸手想扯，往往只落得一手烫伤。
author: OhOk3441
source: The moon-shaped headpiece cannot be removed from this fusion. Individuals who try to grab at it often find themselves earning a burn instead.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰，以宇宙力量与积极的情绪为燃料。心情越好，火便烧得越亮。
author: OhOk3441
source: The fire on POKENAME's head is fueled by both cosmic power and positivity. It'll burn brighter when it's happy.

entry: POKENAME梦想成为超级英雄，为此磨炼本领已久。可惜，它仍免不了三天两头出些意外。
author: togetik
source: In dreams of becoming a superhero, POKENAME has honed its skills for a long time. It still remains accident-prone, however.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的图案，会实时映出群星的位置。它住在清澈的水边，好在喝水时，也望见月亮。
author: themicelegion
source: The pattern on POKENAME's wings is an actual depiction of the stars in real time. It lives near clear waters so it can see the moon as it drinks.

entry: POKENAME爱与皮皮共舞，用低沉浑厚的嗓音，在月光下歌唱。到了新月之夜，其他妖精宝可梦，也会围着它起舞。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME loves to dance with Clefairy and sing in the moonlight with its deep, rumbling voice. Other fairy types dance around it on new-moon nights.

entry: 它整天睡着，翅膀却不安地拍动，仿佛困在噩梦中。唯有满月前的几天，才会安然做着甜梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It sleeps all day, flapping its wings as if locked in a nightmare. On days preceding a full moon, however, it dreams sweetly and calmly.

entry: 野外的POKENAME，只在满月时现身。它会与朋友们一起，在草甸上轻轻漂浮。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can only be spotted in the wild on full moons. It floats around in meadows with its friends.

entry: 满月之夜，成群的POKENAME会四处列队行进。它们对旗帜有着奇特的痴迷，因此也常参加游行。
author: Sottiwotti
source: Groups of POKENAME march around on full moon nights. Because of their weird obsession with flags, they are often used in parades.

entry: 这只来自外太空的宝可梦，浑身是谜。若它在寒冷的雪夜敲门，可要留神：带来的，也许是祝福，也许是诅咒。
author: tr3bles
source: This Pokémon from outer space is quite the enigma. Beware when it knocks on your door on cold, snowy nights; it may bring about a blessing or a curse.

entry: POKENAME很受华丽表演者追捧，能随心唤出绚烂夺目的光芒。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are highly sought after by Beauty Contest performers. They can summon dazzling light displays at will.

entry: 尾尖闪着一颗炽热的星星。全力释放时，星光璀璨，连夜空也黯然失色。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: A searing-hot star gleams at the end of its tail. When it unveils its full power, the star outshines the night sky.

entry: POKENAME物理攻击强劲，是不折不扣的大力士。可在野外，它几乎不肯动用蛮力，因为一伤害别人，自己便难过。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's physical attack is truly great, making it a powerhouse. However, it barely uses its strength in the wild, as it feels bad when it attacks.

entry: 满月之夜，若有好几只POKENAME聚在一起，就可能彼此黏合，发生进化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If several POKENAME come together on the night of a full moon, they may stick together and evolve.

entry: 每逢月圆，许多POKENAME便聚上高原或山峰，尽可能吸收月光，加快进化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: On full-moon nights, many POKENAME gather on plateaus or mountains to absorb as much moonlight as possible in order to accelerate their evolution.

entry: 这只宝可梦一心梦想翱翔天空，可惜身体太重，终究无法如愿。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon dreams of flying through the skies. Sadly, this will never happen because of its weight.

entry: POKENAME总是心情愉快，喜欢载着人穿越广阔大地。每送完一程，就把柔软的壳打扫干净，等待下一位乘客。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: A POKENAME is always in a good mood. It loves to transport people across vast expanses of land, keeping its soft shell clean for its next passenger.

entry: POKENAME乘着旋风而来，顽皮中透着几分凶猛。别小看它的牙口，一咬下去，便能造成重伤。
author: anarchaz
source: Riding swirling gusts, POKENAME emerges with playful ferocity. It bites with surprising force, capable of inflicting significant harm.

entry: 锋利的叶片与惊人的蛮力，让POKENAME凶猛难挡。古灵精怪的外表之下，藏着可怕的力量。
author: anarchaz
source: With razor-sharp leaves and immense strength, POKENAME dominates with unrivaled ferocity. Its whimsical appearance belies its formidable power.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛覆着一层特殊油脂，潜入水中也不会湿透。人们也会收集这种油，给器材防水。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's fluff is coated in a special oil that prevents it from getting soaked while underwater. Some people use this oil for waterproof equipment.

entry: POKENAME背上的绒毛结实，却能捏成各种形状，因此常被拿来制作手工艺品。
author: kittyluv090
source: The fluff on POKENAME's back has a firm, yet malleable, consistency, so it is often used for arts and crafts.

entry: POKENAME掠过微风，播下顽皮与快乐。它在天际缥缈起舞，让见者无不着迷。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME flits through the breeze sowing seeds of mischief and joy. It brings whimsy to the skies, enchanting all who witness its ethereal dance.

entry: POKENAME虽体型巨大，仍能随风漂浮。飞行时落下的棉絮格外柔软，十分珍贵。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME floats through the air, carried by the wind. The cotton it drops mid-flight is prized for its softness.

entry: 每当想要飞行，它就先把棉絮聚在下半身，再撑着手杖纵身一跃，乘风向西而去。
author: Skymaster426
source: Whenever it wishes to fly, it gathers cotton around its lower body before using its staff to make a big leap. Then it rides the wind, going west.

entry: POKENAME身轻如风，会偷偷钻进房屋的缝隙，吸走家中小宠物的生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: As agile as the wind, POKENAME sneaks into the cracks of buildings to steal the life force of small household pets.

entry: 它们性喜群居，很想与其他POKENAME结伴远行。可又怕锋利的爪子伤了朋友，许多个体只好独自上路。
author: char_latte3412
source: They are social Pokémon that long to journey with other POKENAME. However, many travel alone, fearing that their sharp claws may harm their friends.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛间，黏着许多细小的刺果与尖刺。它们不敢碰其他POKENAME，免得缠成一团，再也解不开。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME have many small burs and thorns stuck in their fluff. They avoid contact with other POKENAME lest they become hopelessly entangled.

entry: POKENAME的毛发并非天生如此飘逸，而是训练家花上许多小时，用洗发水细细揉洗头皮的成果。
author: funkytomate
source: The hair of POKENAME is not this flowing by default. Instead, this is the result of many hours of its Trainer rubbing shampoo into its scalp.

entry: 这只狡猾的宝可梦，会藏在棉田里伪装自己。等到时机合适，就突然跳出来袭击。
author: Holzycookie
source: This sneaky Pokémon is known to disguise itself in fields of cotton. When the time is right, it jumps out and strikes.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮软得连自己也抵挡不住，总想躺上去睡一觉。据说，收集POKENAME的棉花，是件轻松差事。
author: Xenophacilus
source: The cotton from POKENAME is so soft that even it can't resist sleeping on its own fluff. Harvesting POKENAME's cotton is said to be an easy job.

entry: POKENAME能纺出品质绝佳的棉絮。工业时代，棉纺工厂曾十分依赖它。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME spins cotton of incredible quality. Cotton factories of the industrial era were heavily reliant of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄其他宝可梦，常装成一团棉花，在田野间蹦跳嬉戏。
author: Holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to play tricks on other Pokémon. It often frolics around fields pretending to be a ball of cotton.

entry: POKENAME用柔软轻盈的尾巴乘风，保持飞翔。见到路人，它还爱冷不丁电一下，开个玩笑。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME enjoy riding the wind using their soft, light tails to stay airborne. If they see a passerby, they enjoy giving a mischievous shock.

entry: 这种POKENAME喜欢贴近地面，装成一小丛草。若一脚踩中，就会挨上轻轻一电。
author: char_latte3412
source: A POKENAME variant who enjoys staying close to the ground and will disguise itself as a patch of grass. Stepping on one can provide a small shock.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮比小羊还软，发起火来却会撒出危险毒粉。据说轻抚它能让紧绷的心舒展开来。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's cotton is softer than a lamb, but it spreads a dangerous toxic powder if it gets mad. Petting it has been said to soothe a stressed heart.

entry: POKENAME曾在寺庙中沉睡多年，无人发觉。毛发长得太长，终于被收服后，还得先剪个发。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME slept undiscovered in a temple for many years. Its hair grew so long that it had to have a haircut after it was finally caught.

entry: 它在田地下挖洞，洞壁铺满绒毛。棉絮般的细绒虽好看，却会缠住作物，让庄稼窒息。
author: rihse
source: This Pokémon burrows beneath fields, leaving holes lined with fluff. Though pretty, the cotton-like down gets tangled in crops and smothers them.

entry: 这只宝可梦性情平和，笑容灿烂，喜欢把树果与其他食物，藏在背上的棉絮里。
author: themicelegion
source: A calm Pokémon with bright smile. It hides Berries and other food in the cotton on its back.

entry: 它现身于盘旋的狂风之中，用暗藏的毒刺袭击敌人。许多人视它为海中可怕的猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: Emerging amidst swirling gusts, this Pokémon strikes with venomous stingers concealed within. Many consider it a formidable predator of the seas.

entry: 夜里遇见疲惫的训练家，POKENAME就会热心帮忙：先用棉絮铺好软床，再施以催眠，让人安然入睡。
author: Holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to help any weary Trainers it finds throughout the night. It makes soft beds out of cotton, and hypnotises Trainers to help them sleep.

entry: POKENAME凶残、恶毒又好斗，颚力惊人，连坚实的钢铁也能咬穿。
author: xtjs2018x
source: POKENAME is a savage, malicious, and violent Pokémon. Its jaw is strong enough to bite through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME夜视能力极好，住在黑暗处也毫不介意，甚至会躲进人家的墙壁里。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has excellent night vision, so it doesn't mind living in dark places, such as inside people's walls.

entry: 它在森林与城镇中，专门恐吓弱小的宝可梦。身上的花纹，也常被公司和帮派拿来当标志。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon terrorizes weak Pokémon in forests and towns. Its patterns are often used as symbols for companies and gangs.

entry: 这种宝可梦以暴躁易怒、破坏力强而出名。虽行事鲁莽，却是维系当地生态的重要一员。
author: Rawthorn
source: A Pokémon known for its quick temper and destructive capabilities. Although they are rash, they are vital in protecting their surrounding ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME的眼镜，能挡住电属性攻击发出的强光，保护视力。它平日一副神气十足的模样。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's glasses protect its vision from the intense light caused by its Electric-type attacks. This Pokémon is known for its swaggering attitude.

entry: POKENAME带领黑眼鸦与混混鸦成群觅食，身上分泌的特殊液体，能防止沙粒钻入羽毛。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME leads packs of Sandikrow and Krokokrow to hunt for food. It secretes a special fluid that keeps sand out of its feathers.

entry: 城市中的POKENAME会结成大群，巡逻各自的领地。两群一碰面，必定大打出手。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that live in cities tend to form large groups and patrol a specific territory. If two POKENAME groups meet, a battle always ensues.

entry: 它翱翔天际，搜寻猎物，再用太阳镜聚拢日光，将致命光束折射向下方的虫类。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It soars through the skies, looking for prey. It uses its sunglasses to focus sunlight, deflecting a deadly beam down onto its insect prey.

entry: 即使猎物在30多英里外，POKENAME也能发现，随即俯冲而下，用强健的大颚将其咬碎。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: When POKENAME spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swoops down on them and crushes them with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME很关爱家人与朋友。若察觉威胁，就会用有力的双臂与大颚，迅速将其清除。
author: entomoxie
source: A POKENAME can be really caring towards its family and friends. If it feels threatened, its mighty jaws and arms will make quick work of any threat.

entry: POKENAME很关爱家人与朋友。若察觉威胁，就会用有力的双臂与大颚，迅速将其清除。
author: entomoxie
source: A POKENAME can be really caring towards its family and friends. If it feels threatened, its mighty jaws and arms will make quick work of any threat.

entry: 据说，POKENAME顽强得不可思议。无论敌人有多强、处境多不利，只要它决定挑战，就能闯过去。
author: Blazerxz
source: POKENAME is said to be extremely tenacious. No matter the enemy or odds, if it challenges something, it can overcome it.

entry: 它被称为“沙漠之灾”。不管饿不饿，POKENAME都照样四处猎杀。
author: scapz
source: This Pokémon is known as the scourge of the desert. POKENAME hunts for prey regardless of whether it's hungry or not.

entry: POKENAME行动不够灵活，狩猎时便将自己埋入沙中，再用水炮让猎物脚下喷起间歇泉。
author: iamJocheena
source: Due to their lack of agility, POKENAME hunt by burying themselves in sand and using their water cannons to create geysers under their prey.

entry: POKENAME统领着哭哭毛虫的族群。哭哭毛虫会献上额外的食物，讨POKENAME欢心。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: POKENAME act as rulers among Yapie, leading their clan. Yapie may bring it extra food in an attempt to gain the POKENAME's favor.

entry: 这只小木乃伊宝可梦，总在金色圆球上维持平衡。可球里装满火药，稍有不慎就会爆炸。
author: zerocipher
source: This little mummy Pokémon always balances on its golden ball. The ball is filled with gunpowder and can easily explode.

entry: POKENAME是古代一位格外豪奢的法老的化身。逮住盗墓贼，便施下永世难消的诅咒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is the incarnation of a particularly lavish pharaoh from times long past. If it catches grave robbers, it curses them for all eternity.

entry: POKENAME常待在棺椁或祭坛旁，缩进蛋形外壳，假扮骨灰瓮，专爱惊吓前来悼念的人。
author: rihse
source: POKENAME will often place itself next to coffins or altars. Hiding within its egg-shaped shell, it poses as an urn and enjoys scaring mourners.

entry: POKENAME极其宝贝自己的面具，谁敢碰，便一把抓住谁。头饰太重，也让它无法长时间飞行。
author: char_latte3412
source: Incredibly defensive of its mask, POKENAME will grab at anyone who dares touch it. The weight of its headpiece makes it incapable of sustained flight.

entry: POKENAME常在墓地附近筑巢，主动守护长眠于此的亡者。有它们在的墓园，是世上最安全的地方之一。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME often choose to nest near graveyards and assume guard over the deceased residents. These cemeteries are amongst the safest in the world.

entry: 它守护古代君王的安息之所。盗墓者若闯入领地，便会受永恒诅咒，从此夜夜在噩梦中看见它。
author: awiralonprime
source: It guards the resting place of ancient kings. Tomb raiders who enter this Pokémon's territory are eternally cursed to see it in their nightmares.

entry: POKENAME出没于金字塔和古墓，专想吃掉陪葬的金器，惹得考古学家对它十分头痛。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME haunts pyramids and other ancient burial sites in an attempt to eat the golden burial treasures. This is why it is hated by archaeologists.

entry: 一尊原本没有生命的雕像，被诅咒卷轴附身。据说，谁若解读出上面的象形文字，便会身患重病，命悬一线。
author: ninjakraken
source: A once inanimate statue now haunted by a cursed scroll. It is said that anyone who deciphers the hieroglyphs will fall deathly ill.

entry: 这个孤独的幽灵，仍在哀悼自己的死去。据说，它曾是一位早已被世人遗忘的法老的宠物。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A lonesome spirit that mourns its death. It is supposedly the pet of a long-forgotten pharaoh.

entry: 它潜居古老的金字塔，将盗墓者拖入墓中，作为惩罚，让他们永世不得离开。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A vicious creature that punishes grave robbers by dragging them into a tomb to lay for eternity. It's found inside ancient pyramids.

entry: POKENAME是古墓中的防盗机关，能将盗墓者永远困住。它们究竟有没有灵魂，至今无人知晓。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME are ancient security devices that were used in burial sites to keep grave robbers trapped forever. Whether they have a soul is unknown.

entry: 科学家认为，POKENAME通过黑暗仪式获得了生命。它守护的骨灰瓮，属于那些格外强大的古代法老。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Scientists believe that POKENAME was brought to life through dark rituals. It protects the urns of particularly powerful ancient pharaohs.

entry: POKENAME伪装成镀金的弯头权杖，捕捉意图盗墓的人。它会勾住对方的脖子，吸尽生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME disguises as a gold-plated crook to catch would-be grave robbers. It hooks them by the neck and drains them of their life force.

entry: POKENAME假扮金字塔里的暗门，用宝藏室的幻象诱人闯入。可门后并非宝藏，而是致命的传送门。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME masquerades as a secret door in pyramids. It lures invaders with the illusion of a treasure room, which in reality is a deadly portal.

entry: POKENAME假扮金字塔里的暗门，用宝藏室的幻象诱人闯入。可门后并非宝藏，而是致命的传送门。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME masquerades as a secret door in pyramids. It lures invaders with the illusion of a treasure room, which in reality is a deadly portal.

entry: 残暴法老的灵魂重返旧日躯体，便形成了POKENAME。战斗时，它用暗影幻象迷惑敌人，再将其制服。
author: Yoshimon
source: A cruel pharaoh's spirit possessed its old body, creating POKENAME. It utilizes shadow illusions in combat to confuse and conquer.

entry: POKENAME喜欢大群聚居在古老金字塔里，还会不时变换排列。通道一改，来访者便常常迷了路。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME likes to nest in large groups in old pyramids. As it regularly rearranges itself, visitors often get lost in the newly formed corridors.

entry: POKENAME喜欢大群聚居在古老金字塔里，还会不时变换排列。通道一改，来访者便常常迷了路。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME likes to nest in large groups in old pyramids. As it regularly rearranges itself, visitors often get lost in the newly formed corridors.

entry: 遇上让自己害怕的生物，POKENAME就伸出阴影般的手，试着把对方吓退。真心喜欢谁，则会送上宝物。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME will try to use its shadowy hands to intimidate creatures it's afraid of. It brings treasure to those it really likes.

entry: 据说，它是疑心极重的法老们制造的古代巡逻机关。一发现闯入者，便先发出高频尖声，再展开攻击。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Supposedly, it's an ancient security drone created by paranoid pharaohs. It emits high pitched frequencies when it spots an intruder before attacking.

entry: POKENAME兢兢业业地守护古代遗迹，抵御盗贼。被它咬中，还会受到诅咒，陷入恐惧。
author: Eye Of Cthulhu
source: POKENAME guards ancient ruins, diligently defending them from would-be robbers. Their bites curse foes with a sense of fear.

entry: POKENAME生前是古代水道的守卫，如今仍埋身河床，等待污染水源的人。遭它咬伤，便会中致命的诅咒。
author: hampterbychoice
source: A long-deceased defender of ancient waterways, POKENAME buries itself in the riverbed and waits for polluters. Its bite inflicts a deadly curse.

entry: POKENAME住在山中陵墓，防范盗墓者。若遇上一个，便吞噬其灵魂，再将尸身做成木乃伊。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME resides in mountain tombs, protecting them from grave robbers. Should it encounter one, it will consume their soul and mummify their body.

entry: POKENAME为富可敌国的人家作舞者。若喂它金珠，舞姿便会美得令人出神。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME live as dancers for exceptionally rich citizens. When fed gold nuggets, their dance will become mesmerizing.

entry: POKENAME审判亡者的灵魂。纯净的，便引往来世；污浊的，则会化作黄沙。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME judge the souls of those who have died. If they are pure, then they are guided to the afterlife. If they are corrupt, the souls become sand.

entry: 人们在沙漠中发现了它，相信里面寄宿着远古统治者的灵魂。它会命令某些宝可梦替自己筑起身躯。
author: HoundRyS
source: Found in deserts, it is believed it contains the soul of a ruler from ancient times. It commands certain Pokémon to build its body.

entry: POKENAME会伏击盗墓贼，让他们中毒；对规矩守礼的训练家，却会慷慨赠送宝物，有些价值数百万。
author: planatical
source: POKENAME ambushes and poisons grave robbers. It rewards behaving Trainers with riches. Some of these riches are worth millions.

entry: POKENAME是被封在人造外壳中的恶灵。因为遭人禁锢，POKENAME对人类恨之入骨。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an evil spirit that has been encased in a man-made shell. POKENAME despises humans for trapping it.

entry: 它用腹部的育儿袋抱着幼崽。若袋中空着，只要装得下，其他宝可梦或蛋也愿收养，带在身边。
author: cait_sith
source: It carries its young in the pouch on its belly. If there is nothing in its pouch, it will adopt and carry any Pokémon or Egg that will fit.

entry: POKENAME挑最高的树栖身，将身体与树木相连，分取树根吸收的养分。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives in the tallest trees it can find. It connects itself to said trees and absorbs the nutrients that the tree takes up.

entry: POKENAME是完美的共生体。有生命的部分用电网捕猎，被放逐的部分，则提供强大而禁忌的能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is the perfect symbiosis. The living part catches prey with electric webs, while the banished part provides strong, forbidden energy.

entry: POKENAME虽有毒牙，除非对毒素过敏，倒不算危险。它常用触须拨弄蜘蛛宝可梦的丝网，故意挑衅。
author: wigglypon
source: POKENAME has a venomous bite, but it isn't dangerous unless you have an allergy. It taunts spider Pokémon by plucking at their webs with its feelers.

entry: 它把网织在圆环上，走到哪儿便带到哪儿，像挥捕虫网一样，捕捉空中的小虫。
author: greystorm101
source: It weaves its web onto a ring so it can carry it around as it moves. It can catch bugs in the air with its web, using it like a net.

entry: 研究人员偶尔见过宝可梦，爬进POKENAME织的网里睡觉。记载这种现象的论文，往往也附有警告。
author: fixthewifi
source: Researchers have infrequently observed Pokémon climbing into the web created by POKENAME to sleep. These papers are often accompanied by a warning.

entry: POKENAME体内电流充沛，总坐不安稳。注意力又很短，织出来的网便总是乱七八糟。
author: fouguri
source: The electricity filling POKENAME's body makes it unable to sit still for long. Its webs always end up messy due to its short attention-span.

entry: 它会攀附其他宝可梦，收集电力。充好电后，便雄心勃勃地织网，想套住自己的“坐骑”，却多半不成功。
author: char_latte3412
source: It will attach itself to other Pokémon to gather electricity. Once charged, it ambitiously tries to snare its ride with webs, often unsuccessfully.

entry: POKENAME长大后突破冰壳，重生为令人毛骨悚然的模样。大多数人都无法盯着它看太久。
author: mx_wellman
source: Having grown beyond its icy shell, a POKENAME is reborn as an unnerving creature. Most are unable to stand its sight for long.

entry: POKENAME会把格外喜欢的猎物，裹上电丝，珍藏在巢里当战利品。民间故事也叫它“收藏家”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME collects prey that it especially likes as trophies in its den, wrapped in electric threads. In folk tales, it's also called "The Collector".

entry: 据说，它能用众多眼睛操纵幽灵之力。对于它为何能漂浮，研究人员已经排除了电磁力的解释。
author: mx_wellman
source: It's said to manipulate ghostly forces with its many eyes. Researchers have discarded electromagnetism as the explanation for its floating.

entry: POKENAME埋伏着，等待猎物落入带电的丝网。它听觉敏锐，能准确抓住俯冲下去、了结猎物的时机。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME lies in wait for prey to stumble into its electrified webs. It is perceptive, and hears exactly when it must swoop down and finish the job.

entry: POKENAME黏在潮湿洞顶吸收养分。一见水宝可梦，就落到对方身上，双臂紧抱，吸走水分充饥。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME sticks to the ceiling of damp caves, absorbing nutrients. It drops on water types, wrapping its arms around them to drain water for food.

entry: 头顶的尖刺，含有最多养分。磨碎之后，可用于制作力量强化与命中强化等补剂。
author: .izik
source: The thorn on the top of its head holds the most nutrients. When ground up, it is used in the creation of X Attack and X Accuracy supplements.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的花苞，平时紧紧闭合。到了春天，便绽成美丽的黄花。
author: OhOk3441
source: The ends of POKENAME's tails are closed buds. In spring, they bloom into beautiful yellow flowers.

entry: POKENAME能鼓起身体，让刺状突起围成一道盾牌。因此，贸然攻击它，实在是件危险的事。
author: p0opys0ck123abc
source: POKENAME can inflate its body outwards, allowing its thorn-like protrusions to form a shield. Thanks to this, it is incredibly risky to attack.

entry: POKENAME用狼牙棒般的尾巴重砸敌人，接着便疯狂挥砍，直到对方再也不动。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME uses its mace-like tail to ferociously crush foes. It follows up a blow from its tail with furious slashing until the foe stops moving.

entry: POKENAME附在阴暗洞顶生活。粗心的访客一踏入领地，它就突然落下，将人掳走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in gloomy caves, attached to the ceiling. If a careless visitor enters its territory, it suddenly drops down and abducts them.

entry: POKENAME一受惊，就用藤蔓缠住敌人，再以燃烧的四肢将其烧毁。它的钢壳，过去曾被用来做炊具。
author: Staghorn
source: If startled, a POKENAME will wrap its vines around its foe and torch them with its flaming limbs. Its steel shell was once used to make cookware.

entry: POKENAME用收集来的金属与自身尖刺，做成一只巨大的刺轮，既可远攻，也能格挡来袭的招式。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: Using the metal it gathers and its own spines, POKENAME creates a giant spiked wheel. It uses said wheel to fight from afar or block attacks.

entry: 这只宝可梦用众多带刺的触须，攀过墙面、地板与洞顶。占好位置，便会突然出击。
author: HoundRyS
source: This Pokémon uses its many spiky tendrils to clamber across walls, floors, and ceilings. When it's in the right place, it strikes.

entry: 它掠过森林，为迷路的登山者照亮道路。可POKENAME并非好心，而是要把旅人引进自己的巢。
author: kandyman
source: It flits through forests, lighting the path for lost hikers. This is not an act of kindness, as POKENAME lure hikers into their nests.

entry: 腹中燃着不灭的火焰，POKENAME总感到饥饿。即使一连吃上好几天，还是觉得饿得慌。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: Because of the perpetual flame in its stomach, POKENAME are always hungry. They can eat for days on end and still feel like they're starving.

entry: POKENAME用闪烁的火焰诱来猎物。诡异的光芒与永不知足的胃口，让它成为浑水中令人畏惧的猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME lures its prey with flickering flames. Its eerie glow and insatiable hunger make it a feared predator in murky waters.

entry: POKENAME头顶的火焰，本是吸取生命能量的通道。可缺乏经验的POKENAME，却常反过来，把自己的能量漏出去。
author: tuneless.towa
source: While the flame on a POKENAME's head serves as a channel for draining vital energy, inexperienced POKENAME tend to emit it instead.

entry: POKENAME轻轻漂过夜空，看起来像一缕暗淡绿光。谁若好奇地跟上去，就会被它吸尽生命。
author: LordKai1
source: POKENAME gently float through the night sky, appearing as a dim green light to onlookers. They drain the life of anyone curious enough to follow them.

entry: POKENAME白天睡觉，吸收阳光，为超能力火焰储备燃料。盯着那火看得太久，就会受它控制。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleep during the day to gather sunlight to fuel their psychic flames. Staring at the flame for too long will put you under its control.

entry: POKENAME能照亮比烛光灵更大的空间，因此许多训练家带它照明洞穴。它也会为迷路的戴鲁比引路，送到安全之处。
author: .ssunday.
source: Many Trainers use it to light up dark caves instead of Litwick, as POKENAME can light up larger spaces. It guides lost Houndour to safety.

entry: 蜡做的身体能挤过任何缝隙。据说碰到尾尖燃烧的火焰，便会招来灾祸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As its body is made of wax, it can squeeze through any crack. The flame that blazes on its tail is said to bring disaster to anyone who touches it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME放出的紫焰根本无法扑灭，会一直烧到着火的东西灰飞烟灭。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The purple flames that POKENAME emits are supposedly impossible to extinguish, and burn until there is nothing left of the ignited object.

entry: POKENAME游荡山间，以不祥的火焰诱人靠近。毫无防备的跟随者，便在诡光指引下一点点失去生命。
author: anarchaz
source: Guiding with its eerie light, POKENAME saps life from its unsuspecting followers. It wanders mountains, luring challengers with its sinister flame.

entry: 不灭的火焰照着POKENAME，诱引迷路的人类与宝可梦走向末路。它经过之后，会留下一路蜡痕。
author: _sadfroggy
source: Lit with everlasting flames, POKENAME leads stray humans and Pokémon to their doom. It leaves waxy trails behind as it goes.

entry: 据说，吃下用POKENAME的火烹煮的食物，会鲜明地梦见史前的远古海洋。
author: Staghorn
source: It is said that eating food cooked over a POKENAME's flame will cause you to have vivid dreams of ancient, prehistoric oceans.

entry: POKENAME的蜡刃上燃着火焰，靠被它伏击者的生命力维持。据说，它们会引领战士前往灵界。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's wax blade holds a flame that feeds off the life force of those it ambushes. They are said to guide warriors to the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME身上的蜡融得极快，常会糊住眼睛。它只好用脸蹭着附近的物体，把蜡刮下来。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's wax tends to melt extremely fast, resulting in its eyes being covered up. It'll rub its face against nearby surfaces to then scrape it off.

entry: POKENAME静候猎物落入大口，随即猛然合颚，再燃起以猎物自身生命力为燃料的火，将其烤熟。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME lies in wait for prey to fall into its maw. It then snaps its jaws shut and cooks its prey with flames fueled by the victim's own life force.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，仿佛孩童，会引领葬身海中的亡魂前往来世。紫色鳞片在夜里闪闪发光。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME are playful, almost childlike Pokémon that help guide those who lost their lives at sea to the afterlife. Their purple scales shine at night.

entry: 它用头上的火焰诱来毫无戒心的猎物，同时吸取能量。待对方虚弱得足够厉害，便整个吞下。
author: hypernovaHusky
source: Using the flames on its head, it lures unsuspecting prey in whilst draining its energy. Once a victim is weak enough, it swallows them whole.

entry: 它为宝可梦引路穿过海洋，一路却都在吸走生命力。等宝可梦死去，POKENAME便吃掉遗体。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: It guides Pokémon though the ocean, draining their life force all the while. When the Pokémon passes away, POKENAME consumes their corpse.

entry: 头顶的火焰，会让POKENAME的腐臭更加难闻。它自己也知道，因此平时总把火熄着，等战斗需要才点燃。
author: char_latte3412
source: The putrid smell POKENAME emits is worsened by the fire atop its head. It is aware of this and will extinguish its flame until needed in battle.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，唱着和谐的旋律。歌声引来其他宝可梦，它便吸取对方的生命力。
author: Deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the skies singing a harmonious melody. Its song draws other Pokémon in, and it absorbs the life force out of them.

entry: 它走过之处留下蜡痕，很快凝固。谁沿着蜡迹行走，前方的POKENAME就会慢慢吸走谁的生命力。
author: wigglypon
source: As it travels, it leaves a trail of wax which soon hardens. Those who walk on the trail have their vitality slowly drained by the POKENAME up ahead.

entry: 皮肤分泌的蜡质，被它团成块掷出去，黏住猎物。等对方动弹不得，POKENAME便吸尽其生命力。
author: wigglypon
source: Its skin secretes a waxy substance, which it can fling in globs to immobilize prey. POKENAME then drains the life force of its helpless victim.

entry: POKENAME的蜡质身体，会随着岁月一点点熔去。看它有多瘦，便能猜出POKENAME的年纪。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's waxy body slowly melts off over its lifetime. You can determine a POKENAME's age from how skinny it is.

entry: 为破蛹进化而积蓄能量时，它的身体会从内部发亮。夜间林中，数十只POKENAME一同发光，景象十分诡异。
author: sporkwizard
source: As it gathers the energy to evolve from a pupa, it begins glowing from within. Groves of dozens of glowing POKENAME are an eerie sight at night.

entry: 旅人若走得太近巢穴，成群的POKENAME便会用迷人的光芒，把这个倒霉人反而引向树林深处。
author: sporkwizard
source: If one wanders too close to their nest, groups of POKENAME will use their enchanting lights to lure the hapless traveler deep into the woods instead.

entry: 它体内不断燃起紫焰，发出苍白的光。POKENAME借头顶的灯罩，让光均匀地散向四周。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It constantly creates purple flames in its body. These cause a pale light, which POKENAME can radiate evenly using the lampshade on its head.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在体弱者身旁，待其去世，便吸走灵魂，化作腹中火焰的燃料。
author: _sadfroggy
source: POKENAME lingers around the feeble, wicking away their spirits as they pass on. It uses them to fuel the fire in its belly.

entry: 战斗结束后，POKENAME便出现在战场，收集阵亡士兵的灵魂。战争期间，它们的光格外耀眼。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME appears at the sites of concluded battles to collect the spirits of fallen soldiers. They shine brilliantly during wartime.

entry: 几只POKENAME会排成一路，将迷路旅人引往沙漠深处，再等对方死去，吸收灵魂。
author: DuskRD
source: Several POKENAME will form a trail to lead lost travellers further into the desert. They then wait for the victim to pass on to absorb their spirit.

entry: POKENAME振翅掀起热浪与蜃影，让疲惫的旅人昏倒。随后吞食灵魂，使火焰烧得更旺。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME's wingbeats kick up heat hazes that cause weary travelers to faint. It then feeds on their spirits to further fuel its flames.
