entry: 它会出现在夜间迷路的人面前，招手邀人同往来世。若对方不肯，POKENAME便会强行带走。
author: HummusIsHome
source: It appears to those who get lost at night, beckoning them to follow it to the afterlife. POKENAME will take them there by force if they decline.

entry: 身体发出的光，吸引来大群夜行昆虫。一旦靠近，生命力就会被POKENAME迅速吸走。
author: Staghorn
source: Its body glows with a light that attracts large swarms of nocturnal insects. Those that approach have their vitality rapidly drained by the POKENAME.

entry: 熊熊烈焰沉睡在玻璃茧中。它会通过身体两侧冒出的烟柱，释放多余的能量。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An inferno resting within a glass cocoon. It releases leftover power with the billows sprouting from its sides.

entry: POKENAME头上的甲片，能当作冲撞的重锤。背上的紫焰既为POKENAME保暖，也让它能借高温进攻。
author: Shado_.w
source: The plating on POKENAME's head is used as a ram. In addition, the purple flame on its back warms POKENAME up and allows it to attack with heat.

entry: POKENAME的灼焰能斩断一切，连灵魂也不例外，原地只会留下躯体。
author: Symile
source: A POKENAME is able to cut through anything with its searing flames. Only the body is left behind, as it even cleaves the spirit.

entry: 它电死猎物后，尸身的灰烬便供幽焰燃烧，残留的灵魂则被用来产生恐怖的电力。
author: Soup1900
source: Its ghostly flames are fueled by the ashes of the bodies its electrocuted. It uses the remaining spirit to generate its terrifying electricity.

entry: 它的火焰，经由彩绘玻璃般的翅膀折射，绚烂夺目。据说，见者都会忍不住跟随，哪怕走向灭亡。
author: sporkwizard
source: The flame it produces refracts brilliantly off its stained-glass-like wings. It's said the sight can entice anyone to follow it, even to their doom.

entry: POKENAME带着一座最多插有9根蜡烛的烛台。据说，猜中哪支蜡烛最后烧完的人，可能会得到礼物。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME carries a candelabra with up to 9 candles on it. It's said that people who guess which candle will last the longest may receive a gift.

entry: POKENAME长嚎时，心中记着逝去的宝可梦。游魂越多的地方，它的火便烧得越明亮。
author: mrbapcik
source: When POKENAME howls, it remembers deceased Pokémon. Its flames burn brighter in places with more wandering spirits.

entry: 坚固的玻璃外壳，约束着它全部的怒火。外壳一旦破碎，POKENAME足以把整座城镇烧成白地。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its sturdy glass shell restrains the full force of its fury. If it were to shatter, POKENAME could raze entire towns clean.

entry: POKENAME释放灵火时，透明的上半身会泛起紫光。谁若被火击中，便会身中诅咒，注定走向死亡。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its transparent upper body glows purple when POKENAME emits its spirit flames. Anyone hit by them is cursed and doomed to death.

entry: POKENAME背上的安瓿里，盛满从自然中抽取、浓缩的生命力。它能消耗这些能量，发动猛烈的火焰攻势。
author: nvisionluminous
source: The ampoules on POKENAME's back are full of the condensed life force it has drained from nature, which it can consume to fuel its fiery onslaughts.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在破败废弃的城堡，尤其钟爱舞厅，会独自在里面忧郁地跳上好几天。
author: captainmodeus
source: POKENAME is known to inhabit decrepit and abandoned castles. It specifically prefers the ballrooms, where it will dance somberly for days by itself.

entry: 据说，谁若在POKENAME的纸上写下名字，灵魂便会被夺走。
author: Inksans201x
source: Those that write their names on POKENAME's papers are said to have their souls taken away.

entry: 据说，碰到POKENAME火焰般的长发，不只会灼伤身体，也会在灵魂上留下伤痕。它还能察觉，谁曾遭受过这样的灼伤。
author: fixthewifi
source: Contact with a POKENAME's fiery locks is said to not only burn one's body, but also scar one's spirit. It can sense when a being has done so before.

entry: 它一动不动地守候数小时，等猎物受火焰吸引，走到近前，再猛然合颚，将其咬住。
author: wigglypon
source: It sits motionless for hours at a time, waiting for prey to be attracted by its flame. When a victim gets close, its jaws snap shut around them.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，会为每位受害者映出独有的幻象，例如已故亲人的面容，随后再吞噬灵魂。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's flame creates illusory images unique to each of its victims, such as the face of a deceased loved one, before it consumes their spirit.

entry: POKENAME会指挥成群的烛小兵，吸干猎物的生命能量。随后，它把猎物的灵魂烧掉，只留下躯体。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME commands groups of Litiard to drain the life energy from its prey. POKENAME then burns the prey's sprit, leaving the body behind.

entry: POKENAME以迷失沙漠的旅人为食。迷途者的灵魂在翅膀中燃烧，飞行时便传出骇人的尖叫。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME feeds on the wanderers who lose themselves in the desert. Its wings, burning with the souls of the lost, shriek horrifically as it flies.

entry: POKENAME以优雅之美，深受艺术界推崇。绚丽的鳞纹，也成了教堂彩绘玻璃窗的灵感。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is revered in the arts for its elegant beauty. Its colorful scale patterns inspire the stained-glass windows of churches.

entry: 据说，接触POKENAME的火焰，便能看见来世。可那些景象，不过是它制造的幻象。
author: NellNast42
source: It is said that exposure to POKENAME's flames will cause one to experience visions of the afterlife. These are just its illusions, however.

entry: 面具遮住了它的心思。挥动燃烧的触须，便会放出鬼火，穿透敌人的身体，灼烧灵魂。
author: wigglypon
source: The mask it wears conceals its intentions. By waving its fiery feelers, it casts will-o-wisps which pass through foes' bodies and scorch their souls.

entry: 身边的生物，都会受它吸引。猎物一靠近，POKENAME便抽走对方的记忆与情感，付之一炬，化为燃料。
author: .crystallization
source: Those within its vicinity are drawn towards it. Once its prey is close, POKENAME will siphon away its memories and emotions to be burnt as fuel.

entry: 一位贵族的吊灯坠落，烧毁了花园。他的悲伤催生了POKENAME，如今它守护花朵，使其免遭烈火。
author: Shiina Valkyria (W)
source: A noble's flower garden burned down when his chandelier fell. The noble's sorrow caused the birth of POKENAME, who now protects flowers from fire.

entry: POKENAME常住在闹鬼城堡的花园。平日静止不动，若有人伤害园中的植物，却会毫不留情地攻击。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is often found in haunted castle gardens. It usually stays still, but it will mercilessly attack those who tamper with the garden's plants.

entry: 午夜钟声一响，这些宝可梦就四只一组起舞。据传，与它们共舞的，是自己前世的幽魂。
author: imagine1.
source: These Pokémon dance in groups of four when midnight strikes. It is rumored that it dances with the wisps of its previous lives.

entry: POKENAME吸收并储存周围空气中的静电。蓄满时，便能放出强烈耀眼的光芒。
author: trainerrobo
source: POKENAME absorbs and stores static electricity from the air around it. It is able to produce an intensely bright light when at full capacity.

entry: POKENAME住在自己制造的鬼镇里。医院与宝可梦中心，都有专门应对它的处置流程。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME resides in ghost towns it created. Hospitals and Pokécenters have special procedures for dealing with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME等在医院外，守候亡魂经过。有时还会吸走医院的电力，加快这个过程。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME waits outside of hospitals for spirits to pass. Sometimes POKENAME will sap the hospital's power to speed up the process.

entry: POKENAME用炽热的獠牙刺穿敌人时，伤及的不只是身体，还有灵魂。它会与同族争夺食物与领地。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME's fiery tusks lunge into a foe, both the spirit and body is harmed. POKENAME competes with others of its kind for food and territory.

entry: POKENAME潜藏在最幽暗的角落，火焰摇曳，宝石发光。诡异的目光，让偶遇者在黑暗中瑟瑟发抖。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME haunts the darkest corners with flickering flames and glowing gems. Its eerie gaze leaves those who encounter it trembling in the darkness.

entry: 暴风雪中，若忽然感到暖意，又看见一个提着光的人影，千万别靠近！那是POKENAME，要来夺走你的灵魂。
author: tr3bles
source: If you suddenly feel warmth amid a blizzard and see a figure with a light, do not approach it! It is a POKENAME, and it will steal your soul.

entry: POKENAME在废弃宅邸里假扮吊灯。倒霉的访客一落入陷阱，身体便被冻住，灵魂却遭火焚。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME haunt abandoned mansions disguised as chandeliers. Unlucky visitors who fall into their traps have their bodies frozen and their souls burnt.

entry: 当灵魂遇到变形的枝形吊灯时，两者就会结合成POKENAME。被它的火炬烧过的东西，会散发整整三周的麝香味。
author: gurguro
source: When a soul meets misshapen chandeliers, they unite and form a POKENAME. Anything it burns with its torch will smell like musk for three weeks.

entry: POKENAME身上那似火的物质，其实是水。据推测，是幽灵的力量，让水维持着火焰的形状。
author: frostedwyrm
source: The fire-like substance that appears on POKENAME is actually water, not fire. It is believed to be held in shape by spectral energy.

entry: 由于遗传物质中含有大量硫酸铜，它的火焰变成了带紫的绿色。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: It's flames turn have become a purpleish green due to large amounts of copper sulfate in its genetic makeup.

entry: POKENAME的长嚎，在废弃宅邸的大厅回响。越靠近正在追捕的宝可梦，火焰就越明亮。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's yowls echo through the halls of abandoned mansions. Its flames grow brighter as it approaches a Pokémon it is hunting.

entry: 这是一尊获得了生命的精巧玻璃雕塑。透过透明的腹部，能看见搏动的火焰心脏。早期人类曾用它为屋舍取暖。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An intricate glass sculpture given life. It has a beating flame heart visible under its clear belly. It was used by early humans to warm their houses.

entry: 这是一尊获得了生命的精巧玻璃雕塑。透过透明的腹部，能看见搏动的火焰心脏。早期人类曾用它为屋舍取暖。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An intricate glass sculpture given life. It has a beating flame heart visible under its clear belly. It was used by early humans to warm their houses.

entry: POKENAME能随心调节气体的毒性。黑色双臂也由毒气构成，只是与身体其他部分的气体并非同一种。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can control how poisonous its gas is at will. Its black arms are also made of poisonous gas, just not the same kind of gas as the rest.

entry: 别看POKENAME这副模样，它其实十分温顺，对陌生人也出奇友善。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Despite their appearance, POKENAME are actually very docile and incredibly kind to strangers.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: 只要不在战斗，它就不停磨砺刀刃。过去曾有一只POKENAME仅挥动一下身体，就劈开了整座山。
author: Skymaster426
source: It constantly sharpens its blades whenever not fighting. In the past, one POKENAME split an entire mountain with a single swing of its body.

entry: 据说，POKENAME守护着强大巨龙占据的城堡。三把巨斧组成的防线，连最灵巧的入侵者也无法穿过。
author: seaslux
source: It is said POKENAME guard castles claimed by powerful dragons. Its three, large axes prove an impenetrable obstacle to even the most nimble invaders.

entry: POKENAME虽模样古老得仿佛来自史前，如今却仍活得好好的。凭借速度与尾刃，森林和猎物都能被它轻松劈开。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Despite its prehistoric appearance, POKENAME is still very much alive today. It uses its speed and tail to effortlessly cut through forests and prey.

entry: POKENAME藏在满是宝物的古老遗迹。受害者一靠近，它便悄然加速旋转，猛地将刀刃组件射向对方。
author: seaslux
source: POKENAME hides in old ruins full of treasure. It quietly spins up as its victim approaches, then launches the bladed unit straight at them.

entry: 小心POKENAME栖居的古老地牢与堡垒。它吊在窄道上方，让斧头在下面来回摆荡，阻挡闯入者。
author: seaslux
source: Beware old dungeons and fortresses where POKENAME makes its home. It hangs above narrow pathways and lets its axe swing below to ward off intruders.

entry: POKENAME通常住在洞穴深处，保护着大群牙蜈蚣幼虫。若受到威胁，就会变得极为凶暴。
author: CutiePierate
source: POKENAME are usually found deep within caves, protecting large amounts of Axepede larvae.  They can be highly aggressive if threatened.

entry: 它的拳能击碎巨石，臂上的刀刃也能一挥断树。躲过拳头，往往又会挨上利刃。
author: gronkissimo
source: Its fists can break boulders, and the blades on its arms can cut trees down in one swing. Trying to dodge one will cause you to get hit by the other.

entry: 斧上的刀刃，取自它在仪式决斗中击败的另一只POKENAME。武器沉重无比，旁人根本挥不动。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The blades on its axe come from a rival POKENAME it defeated in ritual combat. This weapon is immensely heavy, preventing others from wielding it.

entry: 已有数起记录称，POKENAME会用利斧，将浅水中航行的船舶船壳，大片大片地撕下来。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: There are several documented incidents of POKENAME using its sharp axes to tear large parts off the hulls of ships maneuvering through shallow waters.

entry: 据说，透过它头上半闭合的裂口，能瞥见自己的未来。因此，它一现身，总会引来大群围观者。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is said that one can see glimpses of their future through the partly-sealed gash on its head. If one is sighted, crowds will gather in droves.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME出自古代文明之手。许多研究人员正研究它，盼望借此窥见遥远的过去。
author: char_latte3412
source: Believed to have been created by an ancient civilization, many researchers are studying POKENAME in hopes of peering into the distant past.

entry: 据推测，POKENAME是一种失传已久的自动机关，古人用它们作警觉的卫士，守护君王。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is speculated to be a species of long-lost automaton used by ancient people as vigilant guards for the king they serve.

entry: 古时，POKENAME会飞过幼童头顶，向下喷洒牛奶，为孩子送奶。
author: theradrad
source: In ancient times, POKENAME delivered milk to young children by flying over their heads and spraying milk.

entry: POKENAME精于操纵波导，能充分运用体内能量。都市传闻称，它出拳的速度，甚至能超过音速。
author: _freh
source: POKENAME's control over auras allows it to completely harness its internal energy. Urban legends say that its punches can exceed mach speed.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于古代文明的遗迹，可它的剑与盾，至今仍闪着神秘能量。
author: Blazerxz
source: POKENAME was first discovered the ruins of an ancient civilization. Despite this, its sword and shield still glows with a mysterious energy.

entry: POKENAME虽造于数千年前，采用的技术，却远比现代武器先进。
author: w1ndowsxp
source: Even though POKENAME was created millennia ago, POKENAME is made of technology much more advanced than modern day weaponry.

entry: 研究人员认为，POKENAME是数千年前为守护圣地而造的，体内盛满可向外喷射的酸液。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Researchers believe that POKENAME was created thousands of years ago to protect sacred sites. Its body is filled with sprayable acid.

entry: 据推测，数千年前，一个失落的文明造出了POKENAME，既让它们充当守护者，也作为献给神明的敬礼。
author: Cristata
source: It's theorized that POKENAME were built millennia ago by a long lost civilization, both as guardian protectors and as tributes to their deity.

entry: 据推测，数千年前，一个失落的文明造出了POKENAME，既让它们充当守护者，也作为献给神明的敬礼。
author: Cristata
source: It's theorized that POKENAME were built millennia ago by a long lost civilization, both as guardian protectors and as tributes to their deity.

entry: 无人注视时，POKENAME能飞快移动。它总在不知疲倦地寻找自己的创造者。
author: zerocipher
source: POKENAME is known to move at high speeds when no one sees it. It is known to search for its creator restlessly.

entry: 这只宝可梦体内，不断泄出一阵阵炽热气流。它几乎控制不住自身的破坏力，十分危险。
author: SonicDestroyer12
source: Bursts of superheated air constantly leak from this Pokémon's body. It has dangerously little control over its own destructive power.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是火暴猴为追求更强力量，改变自身而成。即使战至粉身碎骨，它也不肯停下。
author: Staghorn
source: Some think POKENAME is a Primeape that transformed itself in order to grow stronger. It will keep fighting even if it crumbles to dust in the process.

entry: 古老的机关，让它能升到几米高的空中。有些考古学家因此认为，创造者曾把POKENAME当作升降台。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: An ancient mechanism allows it to fly several meters into the air. Some archaeologists believe that POKENAME was used as an elevator by its creators.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: 覆盖全身的巨石，为POKENAME提供了极佳防护。可多出的重量，也让每个动作都变得艰难。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The huge boulders that cover POKENAME provide it with excellent protection. At the same time, the added weight makes every move difficult.

entry: 它吐出的丝网带有酸性。清早，它会寻找熄灭的篝火，将灰烬吃下。
author: .izik
source: The webs that it spits out are acidic in nature. In the mornings it will look for burnt out campfires and devour the ashes.

entry: 年岁越长，头上的毛绺就越多。它能从毛发与颈间宝石中放出鬼火，用来自卫。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The locks on its head multiply as it grows older. It can emit will-o-wisps from its hairs and the gems around its neck for self defense.

entry: POKENAME的粉色火焰，能让见者得到幸福与好运。据说，这只融合宝可梦的训练家，还能长命百岁。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME produces a pink fire to brings happiness and luck to those who look upon it. It's said that this fusion's Trainer will live for a century.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，能用尾巴感知他人的情绪，是安慰人心的好伙伴。
author: zic
source: POKENAME are gentle-natured. They are able to sense the feelings of others by their tails, making them great comfort Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: zic
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: zic
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，会用火焰带来舒适暖意，缓解受其照料者的疼痛与不适。
author: zic
source: POKENAME has a kindhearted demeanor. It uses its flames to create a soothing warmth, easing the pain and discomfort of those it cares for.

entry: 传说一位巫女经过神秘转变，成了POKENAME。如今继续指引别人，让他们守住纯净之心。
author: zic
source: It is rumored that a shrine maiden became POKENAME through a mystical transformation. It now guides others, ensuring that they remain pure.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃能放出受它操控的火焰。战斗经验越丰富，新尾巴也会渐渐长出来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits flames which it can control. New tails grow with its experience in battle.

entry: POKENAME出生时只有一条尾巴，长大后才不断分叉。每条尾巴都能像额外的手脚一样运用。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When POKENAME is born, it only has one tail, but as it ages, its tails split into more. It can use each of its tails as an additional limb.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片摸着温暖，却很容易烧焦，变成难看的褐色。六片尾巴状的鳍，让它游得很快。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales are warm to the touch, but they burn quite easily, causing them to turn an ugly brown. Its six tail-like fins help it swim quickly.

entry: 大多数POKENAME身体软软的，却有一副坚韧的大钳。黏稠的内脏之手，无论在陆地还是水中，都一样灵巧。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite their squishy bodies, most POKENAME have tough pincers. Their sticky innard-hands are dextrous on land and in water.

entry: 它在腹中发电，再经头上的双手传导，抓住敌人时，便将电流送入对方体内。
author: .izik
source: It generates electricity in its stomach and channels it through the hands on its head. It electrocutes enemies by grabbing hold of them.

entry: POKENAME会把内脏吐成不同形状，增强超能力。真正的眼睛却长在躯干上，从不眨动。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME spits out its internal organs in different shapes to add to its psychic prowess. Its real eyes sit on its torso, never blinking.

entry: POKENAME把内脏裹在体外，既能让别人不敢碰，也能当作外衣，让身体接连几天保持湿润。
author: floweredbread
source: POKENAME covers its body in its own internal organs to deter physical contact, as well as to give itself a coat that keeps it moist for days.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME会从后部排出内脏。它们总能送出很棒的礼物，可谁也不知道礼物究竟从哪儿来。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME ejects its innards out of its rear for some strange reason. They always give great gifts, but no one knows where they come from.

entry: POKENAME不爱站着，便把自己的内脏当坐垫。不拿来垫着时，就用它捕捉宝可梦，吞食下肚。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME uses its own guts to sit on, as it doesn't like standing. If a POKENAME isn't using its guts to sit, it's using it to catch Pokémon to eat.

entry: 它从海中吐出内脏，缠住敌人，被视作海洋愤怒与蓬勃生命力的象征。
author: anarchaz
source: From the sea's embrace, it ejects its organs to ensnare foes. It's considered a symbol of the ocean's wrath and verdant life.

entry: 这只宝可梦的身体与灵魂，其实是两个独立的生命。灵魂并无恶意，只是常被误解。
author: imagine1.
source: This Pokémon's soul and body are two separate beings. The soul of this Pokémon isn't malicious, just misunderstood.

entry: 它拥有神明般的力量，足以毁灭先出手攻击自己的敌人。但若觉得来者值得相交，也会主动伸出手。
author: Skymaster426
source: Godlike power allows it to unleash devastating attacks at those who strike it first. However, it offers its hand to those it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME主要靠吐出利刃，刺穿猎物来攻击。它能贴在墙上，明明就在眼前，却让人难以察觉。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME spits out its blade as its main form of attack, piercing prey. It can stick to walls to do so hidden in plain sight.

entry: 触碰POKENAME黏稠身体的人说，之后最多半小时里，眼前的时间仿佛放慢了，万物都像慢动作。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who touch POKENAME's sticky body report experiencing time in slow motion for up to half of a real-time hour.

entry: POKENAME用内脏攀住树枝。它们不靠打架争高下，而是猜拳，玩石头、剪刀、布。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME latches onto tree branches with its internal organs. POKENAME don't fight each other for dominance. Instead they play rock, paper, scissors.

entry: 别看POKENAME的双臂这副模样，其实十分柔软，却蕴藏惊人力量。它们既用来捕鱼，也用来战斗。
author: Ayner
source: Despite appearances, the arms of POKENAME are squishy appendages that hide tremendous strength. They use them to catch marine fish Pokémon and fight.

entry: POKENAME将旧内脏裹在身上，既能保暖，也能承受高处坠落的冲击。进化时，这层包裹便会脱落。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME wraps its old guts around its body to keep itself warm and survive long falls. It sheds them when it evolves.

entry: 它把内脏抛进水中，等猎物咬钩。无论嘴里还是尾尖，都能将内脏放出去。
author: Staghorn
source: It catches prey by casting its innards into the water and waiting for a bite. It can expel its guts both from its mouth and the tip of its tail.

entry: POKENAME不停地收集钥匙，多半想凑齐整整八种颜色。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME are constantly collecting keys. Most aim to collect a full spectrum of eight colors.

entry: 钥匙状的尾巴让POKENAME更善于控制电力。它能汇聚等离子体般的雷霆，将敌人劈开。
author: ThunderJimmy#3944
source: POKENAME has greater control over electricity because of its key-shaped tail; POKENAME can channel plasma-like thunder to cleave its enemies asunder.

entry: 钥匙状的尾巴让POKENAME更善于控制电力。它能汇聚等离子体般的雷霆，将敌人劈开。
author: ThunderJimmy#3944
source: POKENAME has greater control over electricity because of its key-shaped tail; POKENAME can channel plasma-like thunder to cleave its enemies asunder.

entry: 只要被它的磁铁吸住，就几乎取不下来。队伍里有POKENAME的训练家，最好别佩戴金属物品。
author: sporkwizard
source: Once something is caught by its magnets, it's near-impossible to dislodge. Trainers with a POKENAME in their party are advised to avoid wearing metal.

entry: POKENAME出手虽慢，每一击却都沉重有力。它正义感强，会把亲近者当家人一般守护。
author: mirby
source: POKENAME attacks with slow yet powerful strikes. It has a strong sense of justice and protects those close to it as if they were family.

entry: POKENAME把刀刃变作钥匙，潜入屋内，再变回利刃，夺取住户的生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME morphs its blade into a key to break into buildings and back into a blade to claim the life force of its dwellers.

entry: 古老神话里，POKENAME能赐予自己选中的执剑者，近乎神明的力量。可传说至今未获证实。
author: yourfriendlycap
source: POKENAME is the subject of an ancient myth, in which a POKENAME could give its chosen wielder nigh-godly power. These rumours are yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME与训练家和他们的朋友，能结下深厚羁绊。危急关头，POKENAME便借这些情谊，激发更强的力量。
author: mirby
source: POKENAME is known to form deep connections with its Trainer and their friends. In dire situations, POKENAME can use those bonds to empower it further.

entry: POKENAME头上的钥匙，能打开任何门，它也经常如此使用。可鼻端的锁孔，该配什么钥匙，却始终无人弄清。
author: totodile.
source: The key on its head can open any door, a quality POKENAME uses often. Nobody has been able to figure out what key fits into the hole on its snout.

entry: 悬崖边常能看见POKENAME。它们判断不准距离，打中对手的次数，还不如自己跌落悬崖的次数多。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME are a common sight around cliffs. Due to being unable to judge distances, they fall off cliffs more often than they land attacks.

entry: 悬崖边常能看见POKENAME。它们判断不准距离，打中对手的次数，还不如自己跌落悬崖的次数多。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME are a common sight around cliffs. Due to being unable to judge distances, they fall off cliffs more often than they land attacks.

entry: 悬崖边常能看见POKENAME。它们判断不准距离，打中对手的次数，还不如自己跌落悬崖的次数多。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME are a common sight around cliffs. Due to being unable to judge distances, they fall off cliffs more often than they land attacks.

entry: 悬崖边常能看见POKENAME。它们判断不准距离，打中对手的次数，还不如自己跌落悬崖的次数多。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME are a common sight around cliffs. Due to being unable to judge distances, they fall off cliffs more often than they land attacks.

entry: 悬崖边常能看见POKENAME。它们判断不准距离，打中对手的次数，还不如自己跌落悬崖的次数多。
author: bucklin
source: POKENAME are a common sight around cliffs. Due to being unable to judge distances, they fall off cliffs more often than they land attacks.

entry: 它们爱收集遗失的钥匙，藏在翅膀里。遇上亲近的人或宝可梦，就会骄傲地展示藏品。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: These Pokémon like to collect lost keys and store them in their wings. They proudly present their collection to Pokémon or humans they are close to.

entry: 钥匙丢了，说不定是野生POKENAME悄悄偷走了。为了这些宝贝，它们有时还会与乌鸦头头决斗。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: If you lose one of your keys, there's a chance a wild POKENAME has stolen it without you noticing. They sometimes duel Honchkrow over these items.

entry: POKENAME似乎比一般融合体更有音乐天分。虽然通常十分胆小，却会突然探出头，奏出自己的音符。
author: _testrun_
source: POKENAME seem to be more musically inclined than the average fusion. They are often very timid, but will pop up to play their notes.

entry: 见到钥匙，POKENAME便会收集，最终却只留下最喜欢的，其余尽数丢弃。船上哪怕只有一把钥匙，也足以招来它的袭击。
author: dzygomer
source: POKENAME collects any key it can find, but it only keeps its favorites; the others are abandoned. A single key on a boat is enough to make it attack.

entry: 它靠强磁力把钥匙吸过来，收入囊中。有时也会带来零钱与首饰，可它对此毫无兴趣。
author: sporkwizard
source: It collects keys by pulling them in with its powerful magnets. Sometimes it also draws in loose change and jewelry, but it doesn't care about those.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护训练家，可也难免误会，连朋友都当成威胁，出言恐吓。
author: WeirdTux
source: POKENAME will defend its Trainer ferociously, but this sometimes leads to misunderstandings where it will threaten a friend.

entry: POKENAME拼死守护住在背上的小箭雀。等小鸟离巢，POKENAME便再去寻找另一只。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME will guard the Fletchling living on its back with its life. When the Fletchling leaves the nest, POKENAME will seek out a new one.

entry: POKENAME收留许多受伤的小箭雀，照顾到它们完全康复。为了保护这些病号，它什么都愿做。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME houses many injured Fletchling until they're fully healed. It will go to great lengths to protect its patients.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间等候猎物，伺机袭击。可钢甲拖慢了速度，想成功捕到并不容易。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME hides in the trees, waiting for prey so it can strike. However, it can't easily catch the prey, as the steel armor slows it down.

entry: POKENAME织出的丝网极易燃烧。猎物一落网，它们就将网点着，几秒钟便能烤熟。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME weave webs made of extremely flammable silk. Upon catching something, they ignite the webs and cook their prey in seconds.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀虽长在头上，飞翔时却优雅无比。研究人员仍在探究其中奥秘。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Despite its wings being located on its head, POKENAME soars with the utmost elegance. This phenomenon is still being studied.

entry: 它一振翅，就能让树木燃烧。它的体型与相貌，让许多摔角鹰人将它奉为导师。
author: kittyluv090
source: It can set trees ablaze just by flapping its wings. Many Hawlucha look up to it as a mentor because of its size and striking resemblance.

entry: POKENAME本想附在训练家丢弃的球里，伪装霹雳电球，结果反而把精灵球学得更像了。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In trying to disguise as a Voltorb by haunting a Trainer's discarded ball, POKENAME instead became an even better Poké Ball mimic.

entry: 里面的宝可梦，已经发挥出外壳的全部潜能。身体快撑开接缝，正等着伏击下一个毫无戒心、想来搜刮宝物的训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The Pokémon inside has unlocked the full potential of its shell, bursting at the seams to ambush the next unsuspecting Trainer looking to loot it.

entry: 这些毛绒玩具原本是买来供宠物磨牙的。可被咬了这么多年，如今玩偶也开始反咬了！
author: puppetmaster64
source: These plushies were originally purchased to be used as chew toys, but after years of chewing, the dolls have begun to bite back!

entry: 融合不幸扯破了POKENAME的布衣，让它羞得躲进壳里，不肯出来。
author: .ssunday.
source: Unfortunately, POKENAME's cloth has torn due to fusion. As a result, it hides in its shell out of embarrassment.

entry: 传说谜拟Ｑ为交朋友才装成皮卡丘。这故事流传太广，如今反过来的装扮倒也经常见到。
author: Faelocke
source: Stories say Mimikyu wear Pikachu disguises to attempt to make friends. These stories have gotten so popular that nowadays, we often see the opposite.

entry: 它把挖空的霹霹果戴作头盔，又拼命收集红叶与辛辣薄荷，随时替换那些渐渐枯萎的假角。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: A hollowed-out Babiri Berry serves as its helmet. It obsessively hoards red-tinted leaves and spicy mints to replace its imitation horns as they wilt.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是一个遗失的玩偶，被牵着自己的丝线附身。它总在无人看见的地方，悲伤地起舞。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to be a lost doll possessed by the strings that carry it. This Pokémon will sorrowfully dance where no one can see it.

entry: POKENAME沉默而坚定地守着组成身体的废品。在人类丢弃的垃圾中翻找，也让它学到了许多知识。
author: asher5229
source: POKENAME stoically defends the hoard of scrap that composes its body. It has gained great knowledge by rummaging through society's junk.

entry: 这些生物漫游海底，假扮触手百合。选择这种模样，正是看中了它作为化石的稀有。
author: imagine1.
source: These creatures can be found roaming the seafloor, pretending to be Lileep. It chooses this specific Pokémon due to it being a rare kind of fossil.

entry: POKENAME藏在博物馆，装成恐龙骨架，只盼得到那些痴迷恐龙的孩子们的赞叹。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are found in museums mimicking dinosaur skeletons. They do this to get admiration from young children fascinated by dinosaurs.

entry: 它的伪装，不过勉强能骗过其他宝可梦。可对POKENAME来说，这样就足够了。
author: weedspagon_real
source: Its disguise is barely enough to fool other Pokémon, but that's good enough for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME因为太孤单，便装成幻之宝可梦阿尔宙斯，想骗训练家来崇拜自己。
author: captainshyguy
source: POKENAME disguises itself as the Mythical Pokémon Arceus. It uses this disguise to trick Trainers into worshiping it because it is lonely.

entry: POKENAME举着披布的棍子，可怜兮兮地敲打路人。对方乍看毫发无伤，过后却会昏倒，原来生命力早已被吸走。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME pitifully whacks passersby with its draped stick. At first seeming to be unharmed, they eventually pass out, their life force sucked away.

entry: POKENAME可能会伪装成人类，尝试融入人类社会。与这只宝可梦交朋友的人，有时会从此消失。
author: lynkinator
source: POKENAME may attempt to integrate into society, masquerading as a human. Those who befriend this Pokémon may never be seen again.

entry: 极少数谜拟Ｑ会选用皮皮玩偶，替代破旧的布衣，这才有了眼前这种奇特的模样。
author: xyloldi
source: In rare instances, Mimikyu are known to select a Poké Doll as a substitute for their worn fabric, giving rise to this peculiar phenomenon.

entry: 身体破损后，它会拆取旧毛绒玩具的部件，修补自己。而且，它似乎很享受撕开玩具的过程。
author: kittyluv090
source: When its body is damaged, it uses parts from old plushies to fix itself. It seems to find enjoyment in tearing toys apart.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾有一位训练家，却为了皮卡丘抛弃了它。有些夜晚，仍能听见它哭泣。
author: gun2._
source: It's said that POKENAME once had a Trainer who abandoned it for a Pikachu. Sometimes at night you can hear its cries.

entry: 它散发的强大能量，让人类和宝可梦都不敢靠近。为了隔绝这股气息，它只好披上一身不起眼的衣裳。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The powerful energy it emanates scares away Pokémon and Trainer alike. To block this aura, it covers itself with a drab costume.

entry: 建筑工地附近常能看到POKENAME。工人们会把坏掉的设备或剩余的油漆送给它，让它用来装饰自己的伪装。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME is often found around construction sites. The staff there offers damaged equipment or leftover paints to POKENAME for use on its disguises.

entry: 孩子渐渐长大，将POKENAME丢在一旁。它躲在黑暗中，与其他毛绒玩具作伴，渴望一个拥抱，却又抱得人疼痛难忍。
author: Leshii
source: Left behind by a growing child, POKENAME keeps the company of other plush toys in the dark. It craves a hug, but its grasp is painfully strong.

entry: POKENAME渴望新朋友，却不甘只在玩具店里等待。它游荡于暗街，凶爪伸向那些疏于防备的孩子。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME craves new friends, but isn't satisfied waiting in a toy shop. It stalks the dark streets, its wicked claw reaching for inattentive children.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于野生原野区深处，后来有了一小群忠实拥趸。有些公园，还把它画在教露营者防火的告示上。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME was found deep in a Safari Zone and earned a small cult following. Some parks feature it on signs teaching campers basic fire safety.

entry: POKENAME用纸板搭起城堡，住在里面，也因此结识了许多好奇的孩子。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME constructs a castle to live in out of cardboard. As a result, it ends up befriending many interested children.

entry: 这只POKENAME正认真地掷骰玩游戏。真到了战斗时，它反倒从没这么较真过。
author: squawkabairdy
source: This POKENAME is rolling a die for its game. It never takes actual battles nearly as seriously.

entry: POKENAME本不需要真正的实体，却十分在意自己的外貌。为了弥补，它拼命往身体里塞填充物。
author: cyprexx
source: In spite of not needing a true physical form, POKENAME has major self-image issues. It greatly compensates with stuffing.

entry: POKENAME住在靠近水域的城镇。因为自己造不出水，只好不停地向人讨水喝。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found in cities and towns near bodies of water. It constantly begs for water since it is unable to produce its own.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME会吸收太阳能。据说，体内宝石的温度，能高得接近太阳。
author: Gencky
source: POKENAME absorbs solar energy on sunny days. It is said its gem can reach temperatures close to the Sun's.

entry: POKENAME用随身携带的手杖引导超能力。有人曾在森林深处，看见它们率领着虫宝可梦的部族。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME channel their psionic energy through the staff they carry. They have been observed leading tribes of bug Pokémon deep within forest biomes.

entry: 寒夜里，POKENAME是很好的暖源，能为人驱散冷意。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: When nights get cold, POKENAME can be used as a great source of warmth.

entry: 它虽会飞也会爬，却更喜欢烧倒树木找食物，因为这样，就能把落下的树果一并烤熟。
author: Soup1900
source: Although it can fly and climb, it prefers to burn down trees for food. It does this to cook any Berries that fall from these trees.

entry: 传说，一只POKENAME曾用随身的岩浆石，为探险者保暖。展开双翼时，模样宛如节庆装饰的星星。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Legends tell of a POKENAME that kept some explorers warm with the magma rocks it carries. When their wings spread out, it resembles a festive star.

entry: 它如闪电般掠过大地，身后飘散着炽热的鳞片，笼成一片朦胧的火光。
author: togetik
source: It runs through the land at the speed of lightning, leaving blazing scales scattered in a haze behind it.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋进土里成长。若在这段时间受伤，POKENAME便必须从头再来。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground so it can grow. If its body is harmed during this process, POKENAME has to restart.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是一次失败的时空旅行造成的异常存在。它曾亲眼见证，这颗星球最初诞生生命的一刻。
author: GenesisParallax
source: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. It was witness to the moment when life first appeared on the planet.

entry: 战斗时，它以难耐高温与持续的精神压迫迎敌。但对信任的人，却又像一缕日光般温柔。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: In battle, it buffets foes with unbearable heat and constant mental pressure. Yet to those it trusts, they are as gentle as a sunbeam.

entry: 古代文明的记载中，POKENAME是祭礼不可缺少的一员。有它在，亡者便能安全穿过死亡，前往太阳神身边。
author: char_latte3412
source: An ancient civilization depicts POKENAME as a vital member of sacrificial rituals. Its presence ensured safe passage to the Sun God through death.

entry: POKENAME既能浮在空中，也能游浮水中。一路携带各类植物的花粉，所到之处，便孕育出美丽的新生态。
author: Shiina Valkyria (W)
source: POKENAME floats through both water and air. It carries pollen from all species of plants everywhere it floats, creating beautiful new ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME的羽衣，硬得堪比最坚韧的合金。它还能操纵羽毛及周围的热量，发动攻击。
author: T.I.A.
source: The feather coat of a POKENAME is as hard as the toughest alloys. It can manipulate the feathers' and its surroundings' heat to attack.

entry: 古人称POKENAME为化作兵刃的“太阳之怒”。它从护手洒出鳞粉，点燃一片火海。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Ancient peoples referred to POKENAME as “the rage of the sun" in weapon form. It scatters scales from its guard to light a sea of fire.

entry: 传说中，POKENAME也叫“太阳之光”。刀刃散发的热量，能点起一片火海，耗尽附近空气中的氧气。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun's Ray" in legend. The heat of its blade can light a sea of fire and remove oxygen from the surrounding air.

entry: 雷电穿行于细密的毛发，双翼则放出阵阵热浪。野生POKENAME曾被视为夏日雷暴的先兆。
author: Therider
source: Lightning surges through its fine fur while its wings radiate waves of heat. Wild POKENAME were thought to be harbingers of summer thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME忍受不了鳞片干燥。一旦变干，就会钻进草木间加热身体，吸取植物中的水分。
author: Layth
source: POKENAME can't stand having their scales get dry. When they do, it heats itself up amongst vegetation to absorb its moisture.

entry: 体内火焰越热，身上的符文就会变换颜色。据说，它燃烧的拳头，热得堪比恒星核心。
author: Staghorn
source: The runes on its body change color depending on the heat of its inner flame. Its burning punches are said to be as hot as a star's core.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山地区。耐热绒毛能撒出让敌人短暂失明的粉末，帮助它脱身。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic areas. Its heatproof fluff allows it to scatter a temporarily blinding powder to evade enemies.

entry: POKENAME能将热量汇到鳞片，让每一片都亮起来。它先以绚丽表演迷惑敌人，再将对方焚烧殆尽。
author: VaporVenator
source: POKENAME can light up each of its scales by focusing heat onto them. It performs mesmerizing displays to distract foes before incinerating them.

entry: POKENAME靠咬的力道与时长，组成一套复杂语言。唯有面对深深信任的伙伴，POKENAME才肯发声。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME have a complex language involving biting, with factors such as bite force and duration. A POKENAME only vocalizes to those they deeply trust.

entry: POKENAME互相扭打、咬掉毛发，反而让皮肤练得更结实，毛也长得更厚。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME thrash and bite the fur off of each other, which helps in toughening their hides and growing even thicker patches of fur.

entry: POKENAME诞生自亲代莲花结下的种子。它每天以欺负小型宝可梦、争夺领地来锻炼自己。
author: arch.stanton
source: POKENAME was birthed from the seeds of its parent's lotus. It trains everyday by bullying smaller Pokémon and claiming territory.

entry: 莲花彻底盛开后，便会结下种子，孕育出枯苗龟。据说，它守护小片水域时，性情格外凶暴。
author: arch.stanton
source: Once fully bloomed, its lotus will produce seeds that give birth to Detwig. It is said to violently guard small bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME漂在池塘或湿地里，乍看不过一朵莲花。半水生宝可梦很喜欢趴在它壳上休息。
author: arch.stanton
source: POKENAME floats about in ponds or wetlands, appearing as a mere lotus. Semi-aquatic Pokémon enjoy using its shell as a resting spot.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便盲目攻击任何会动的东西，吸取生命力。尝过的猎物，它还能辨认出种类。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Lacking vision, POKENAME blindly attacks anything that moves for its life force. It can sense the species of victims it's tasted.

entry: 颈部与尾巴上的浓毛，又硬又粗糙。野外的POKENAME，常用尾巴撕开茂密灌木，开出道路。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The dense fur along its neck and tails is hardened and rough. POKENAME uses its tails in nature to tear through thick brush.

entry: 这只小宝可梦很爱玩，闹起来却常没轻重。让它与其他伙伴玩耍时，可得多留点神。
author: themicelegion
source: This small Pokémon loves to play. It often plays too rough, however, so keep a watchful eye on it while it plays with others.

entry: POKENAME只生活在幽暗雨林。谁碰到它，就会被它用头顶撞，同时撒出怕光的孢子。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in dark rainforests. It will try to headbutt anything that touches it, spreading its light-sensitive spores.

entry: 许多POKENAME能靠电磁感应掌握周围动静，因此性情从容。有些POKENAME还会把磁铁吸来的东西，统统吃下。
author: totodile.
source: Due to being able to sense things electromagnetically, many POKENAME are relaxed in nature. Some POKENAME eat anything their magnets pull in.

entry: POKENAME牙口很弱，咬不伤人。POKENAME张着嘴，要么是在释放微弱电荷，要么只是见到来人，太高兴了。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME's weak bite can't hurt humans. POKENAME leave their mouths open to let small electrical charges out or because they're happy to see someone.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: Cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: Cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 毛茸茸的护符，让POKENAME始终平心静气。可谁若拿走护符，它就会发怒，不惜一切夺回来。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: The fluffy amulet POKENAME has is used to keep it calm all the time, but, if taken away, it will get angry and do anything to get it back.

entry: 集中精神时，尾尖的水晶便会亮起。它还能借不明的力量，随心改变天气。
author: .izik
source: The crystal at the end of its tail lights up when it concentrates. Using an unknown power, it can change the weather at will.

entry: 谁偷偷靠近POKENAME，朝后的那颗头就会咬过去。前面的头若想看路，还得先用手撩起刘海。
author: cait_sith
source: If anything sneaks up on POKENAME, its back-facing head will bite it. It uses its hands to lift the front-facing head's bangs if it wants to see.

entry: 鼻端的头会特意照顾下方的头，让它也吃上东西。两张嘴各连着一个胃，彼此并不共用。
author: .izik
source: The head on the end of its nose will take time to make sure the lower head eats. The mouths do not share a stomach and each have their own.

entry: POKENAME多了一颗头，产奶量也翻了一倍。两颗头常比赛，看谁一天产的奶更多。
author: .ssunday.
source: Since it has double the heads, POKENAME produces two times more milk. The heads often compete who can produce more milk in a day.

entry: 它最爱吃洞穴深处的宝石，却不喜欢阳光，因为一晒，身上的毛就会飞快脱落。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to eat gemstones from deep within caves. It dislikes sunlight, as it causes the fur on its body to shed rapidly.

entry: POKENAME看不见，出手常打偏，并不擅长战斗，主要靠身上的尖刺伤敌。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are not great fighters, as they usually miss their target because they can't see. It relies on its spikes to hurt enemies.

entry: 它能悬浮到离地300英尺的高处，只是十分耗费能量，需要吃草与其他植物补充。
author: .izik
source: It can hover up to 300 feet off of the ground. Doing this consumes a lot of energy, which it replenishes by eating grass and other vegetation.

entry: 皮肤摸起来粗糙不平，逆着纹路摩擦时，锋利得连石头都能刮碎。
author: .izik
source: Its skin is rough to the touch. It is sharp enough to shred through stone if rubbed the wrong way.

entry: POKENAME的整个身体都受背上两颗头控制。若它受伤，两颗头就会缩回灌木丛。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: The two heads on POKENAME's back control the whole body. If POKENAME is injured the heads will retreat into the bushes.

entry: 莲花已完全盛开，尾巴上又多长出了一颗头。因为守护池塘，炼金术士将它视为水的象征。
author: arch.stanton
source: Its lotus has fully bloomed, and it has grown an extra head on its tail. It guards ponds, so alchemists considered it a symbol of water.

entry: 身上的金属质地，会随吃下的食物而改变。食物越软，形成的金属也越柔软。
author: .izik
source: The consistency of the metal on its body changes based on what it's consumed. Softer foods result in a softer metal.

entry: 它身上滴落的黏液，黏性极强，可制成工业用强力胶，历经数年才会失去效力。
author: .izik
source: The slime that drips off of its body is incredibly sticky. It is used to make an industrial-strength glue that takes years to lose potency.

entry: POKENAME常成双成对吊在树上。它的毒，足以致命。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are usually found in pairs, hanging from a tree. Its toxins can be lethal.

entry: 翅膀上的花纹，能惊退远处潜伏的敌人。为了领地与资源，它也会毫不留情地争斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: The patterns on its wings can startle away lurking foes from afar. It will ruthlessly compete for territory and resources.

entry: 这只宝可梦恶意满满，脾性难测。毛皮仿佛有自己的意识，稍受惊动或兴奋，就会燃烧起来。
author: VaporVenator
source: A malicious and unpredictable Pokémon. Its fur coat seemingly has a mind of its own, igniting at the slightest disturbance or excitement.

entry: 人们认为，那些圆珠是曾拥有POKENAME的训练家的灵魂。它以看着弱小宝可梦受苦为乐。
author: geminib
source: The orbs are believed to be the spirits of Trainers who owned POKENAME. It takes great pleasure in watching weaker Pokémon suffer.

entry: POKENAME不停长出新头，却一次只能养活两颗，只好丢掉多余的。人们推测，这些头会像种子一样，孕育新生。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME grows new heads constantly. It can only feed two at a time, however, so it discards spare heads. It's thought the spares are used like seeds.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头一齐发出三重音调的咆哮，掀起热浪与声浪，威力足以摧毁附近的建筑。
author: malxire
source: POKENAME's three heads bellow a tri-tonal roar that unleashes a wall of heat and sounds powerful enough to destroy nearby buildings.

entry: 据传，它们会在森林里爬来爬去，比普通虫宝可梦快些——不过，也还是快不到哪儿去。
author: themicelegion
source: Rumors say this Pokémon can be seen crawling in forested areas. They move faster than the average Bug-Type, but that's still not very fast.

entry: 它紧抱同胞的遗骨，才感到安心。头骨中残留的超能力，也继续保护着它。
author: el_gord0
source: It holds onto the remains of its sibling to feel safe. The psychic powers that remain on the skull protect it.

entry: POKENAME几乎无法被侦测，因此曾用于穿过网络空间潜入敌方电脑，如今却已被认为过时。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME were primarily used to infiltrate enemy computers via cyberspace due to their near-undetectability. They are now considered obsolete.

entry: POKENAME只曾在城都偏远地区被人看见。据说，巫女服饰的样式，便来自它的翅膀与流苏。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME have only ever been seen in remote parts of the Johto region. It is said that a shrine maiden's garb is based on its wings and tassels.

entry: POKENAME梦想翱翔澄澈蓝天，可翅膀长的位置太别扭，让这个心愿难以实现。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME dreams of soaring through the clear, blue sky. Its inconveniently placed wings make this dream difficult to achieve.

entry: 它能感知整个地区的悲伤，甚至不惜突破音障，赶到需要朋友的人身旁，只为逗对方一笑。
author: melodymute
source: It can sense sadness anywhere in the region. It breaks the sound barrier in order to reach anyone in need of a friend, just to make them smile.

entry: 这只宝可梦所到之处，总有安宁和睦的气息。它能与训练家心意相通，因而深受想结下羁绊的人喜爱。
author: zic
source: This Pokémon's presence brings a sense of peace and harmony. It is able to deeply connect with its Trainer, making it a popular Pokémon to bond with.

entry: 这只聪明的宝可梦，对他人的情绪极为敏感。照料它需要耐心，也得给它留一处安静冥想的地方。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: This intelligent Pokémon requires patience and a dedicated space for silent meditation, due to its hypersensitivity towards the emotions of others.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的毛发，可不只是好看。它会用毛发折射光线，即使近在眼前，也让人看不见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur isn't just for show. It uses it to refract light and hide in plain sight.

entry: 它将同胞的遗骨当作武器，心怀愤怒与复仇的渴望，漫无目的地四处徘徊。
author: el_gord0
source: It wields the remains of its sibling as a weapon. It wanders around aimlessly, filled with rage and seeking revenge.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度飞行，散播花粉。有传闻称，存在一只模样相近的红色宝可梦，可尚无确切目击。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME travels at extreme speeds to spread pollen. There are rumours of a red Pokémon that looks similar to POKENAME, but no confirmed sightings.

entry: 它飞行本领有限，只能轻轻贴地滑翔，却仍盼望有一天，能飞上月亮。
author: fountainihili
source: Its flight capabilities are limited, and it can only gently glide along the ground. It wishes to soar to the moon someday.

entry: 看见POKENAME飞行，人们便会许愿。因为POKENAME实在太懒，只有天敌靠近，才肯飞起来，难得一见。
author: .ssunday.
source: When people see POKENAME fly around, they make a wish. They do this because POKENAME is so lazy that it only flies if there is a predator near.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现身，几乎从未留下确切目击，因此记录寥寥。大多数人甚至不相信它真的存在。
author: 8xviktor
source: Not much information has been documented about POKENAME due to the fact it is rarely, if ever, seen. Most people don't believe in its existence.

entry: 它长期被视为传说中的存在，因为看见它的人，都会被植入虚假记忆，忘掉其真貌。斗篷上的心之水滴，为它提供力量。
author: germs2128
source: Long believed to be a myth, it hides its identity by implanting false memories to everyone who views it. It is empowered by the Soul Dew on its cloak.

entry: 只有同样心怀怜悯的人，才能遇见它。据说，遇上POKENAME，便能得到伴随一生的安宁。
author: melodymute
source: It only appears to those who share its compassion for others. It is said to meet a POKENAME is to be forever blessed with tranquility.

entry: POKENAME看着蓬松，身上却满是防敌的硬刺。它聪明得很，能辨别人类的来意。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME looks fluffy, but it's covered with bristles to repel attackers. It's intelligent enough to discern humans' intentions.

entry: 科学家采集POKENAME的丝时，它有时会突然从尾巴喷出烈焰，已有许多人因此住院。
author: .ssunday.
source: Sometimes, when scientists extract silk from POKENAME, it lets out large flames from its tails. Many people have been hospitalized from this.

entry: POKENAME虽能化成一滩水，可其中冒泡的水温，最高会到华氏212度。千万别想用这水煮饭。
author: hatsune_miko
source: Although POKENAME can turn into a puddle, the temperature of the bubbling water can turn to 212°F. Do not attempt to use this water to make food.

entry: POKENAME主要靠双翼滑翔，众多长尾来回扫荡，很容易让敌人晕头转向。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's wings are mostly used for gliding. With its many sweeping tails, this Pokémon easily disorients foes.

entry: POKENAME让尾巴不停旋转，如直升机般飞行。它梦想乘上龙卷风，飞得越来越快。
author: lim2067
source: POKENAME always keeps its tails spinning, allowing it to fly like a helicopter. It dreams of riding a tornado's winds to reach ever-higher speeds.

entry: 它常花上几小时梳理尾巴，最讨厌毛发湿透。若被暴雨淋着，就会大发雷霆。
author: .izik
source: It will spend hours grooming its tails. It hates when its fur is wet and will grow enraged if it is caught in a rainstorm.

entry: POKENAME的众多翅膀，让见者又惊又疑。不过，POKENAME其实会保护自己身边的生物。
author: Louiseo
source: The many wings of POKENAME strike fear and confusion in the eyes of its beholders. POKENAME, however, is known to protect those that surround it.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME用尾巴裹住身体，敌人一碰就会被灼伤。据说直视它的眼睛，还会招来可怕诅咒。
author: Mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will wrap itself in its tail which will burn its foes if touched. Staring into its eyes is said to bring a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME悄悄靠近猎物，再放出强力电击将其麻痹。富人常将它当作优雅的家养宠物。
author: Adam941
source: POKENAME sneak up on their prey before unleashing a powerful electric attack to paralyze them. They are kept as elegant house pets by the wealthy.

entry: POKENAME心怀正义，守护人类与宝可梦。任何武术，只要看过，就能迅速学会。
author: mrbapcik
source: Guided by justice, POKENAME protects people and Pokémon. They can quickly learn any martial art just by seeing it.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: zic
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: zic
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME顽皮得很，喜欢挥动扇子，造出复杂的幻象来戏弄人类。
author: zic
source: POKENAME are highly mischievous Pokémon. They enjoy messing with humans by creating elaborate illusions with their fan.

entry: POKENAME舍弃了刀刃，换来鞭子般的长尾，也让操纵火焰的本领更进一步。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its blades to make room for its whip-like tails and greater control of fire.

entry: POKENAME沉稳聪明，很受家庭欢迎。它寿命悠长，甚至流传着能活千年的说法。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its calm and intelligent nature has made POKENAME popular amongst families. Its long lifespan has led to stories that it can live for a millennium.

entry: POKENAME耐心追踪猎物时，柔软的花朵会掩去行动的声响。聪明的宝可梦，很快便学会避开那诱人的花香。
author: Cristata
source: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.

entry: POKENAME耐心追踪猎物时，柔软的花朵会掩去行动的声响。聪明的宝可梦，很快便学会避开那诱人的花香。
author: Cristata
source: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.

entry: POKENAME外表好斗，内里却更温和、沉静。唯有遭到伏击，才会动用自己的力量。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's feisty facade covers a much kinder, calmer personality. It only uses its abilities when ambushed.

entry: 这种POKENAME比野外的同类更亲近人类，常在特别的节庆中现身，走到哪里，都受到热情欢迎。
author: char_latte3412
source: This POKENAME variant is far more domesticated than its wild sibling. It often makes appearances at special festivals and is welcomed with open arms.

entry: POKENAME焚烧垃圾，维持永不熄灭的火焰。垃圾箱般的身躯上，涂鸦还能随心变化。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME burns trash to fuel its eternal flame. The graffiti on its dumpster body changes at will.

entry: POKENAME一旦暴怒，便横冲直撞，谁也拦不住。尾巴的力道是黏美龙的九倍，击中之处，还会留下灼热的熔岩。
author: Uncookie
source: When enraged, POKENAME's rampage can't be stopped. Its tail is nine times stronger than a Goodra's and leaves superheated lava residue upon impact.

entry: 它来自遥远星系，如今到了这里，一心想多学些东西，便滑行四处，从远方观察其他宝可梦。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An alien from a far away galaxy. Now that it's here, it seeks to learn. It slithers about inspecting other Pokémon from afar.

entry: 它无声而精准地追踪猎物，再如闪电般猛扑。POKENAME用剃刀般的尖牙制住猎物，将其吞食。
author: louiebrine
source: It stalks its prey with silent precision before pouncing with lightning speed. POKENAME uses its razor-sharp teeth to subdue and consume its prey.

entry: POKENAME最爱偷偷溜进绿岭宇宙中心，装成毫不知情的普通工作人员，混迹其中，把这当作一场游戏。
author: TokenOracle
source: POKENAME makes a game out of sneaking into the Mossdeep Space Center and pretending to be an innocent crew member among them.

entry: 古代编年史记着一种与POKENAME相似的剑，据说能让持有者看见未来。不过，这些故事似乎并不属实。
author: frostedwyrm
source: Ancient chronicles refer to a blade similar to POKENAME that could grant its holder visions of the future. However, these tales seem to be false.

entry: POKENAME是一种迅速进化的病毒，变得能更直接地袭击生物。它能将身体化作多种武器，动作也十分敏捷。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a virus that rapidly evolved to attack organisms more directly. It adjusts its shape into many weapons and is quite agile.

entry: POKENAME能将下方的触须合成任意兵器。用作盾牌的核心，则会随武器种类，变换颜色。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can fuse its bottom tendrils into any weapon. The core it uses as a shield changes color based on the weapon it is using.

entry: 代欧奇希斯的核心宛如寄生体，为主体输送能量。POKENAME在转瞬之间，就能算出数十亿种作战策略。
author: char_latte3412
source: Akin to a parasite, the Deoxys core fuels the main body. POKENAME can compute billions of battle strategies within a fraction of a second.

entry: 代欧奇希斯的核心宛如寄生体，为主体输送能量。POKENAME在转瞬之间，就能算出数十亿种作战策略。
author: char_latte3412
source: Akin to a parasite, the Deoxys core fuels the main body. POKENAME can compute billions of battle strategies within a fraction of a second.

entry: 据说，POKENAME已经达到绝对合一，正打算掀起席卷宇宙的战争。可赞同这说法的，只有一个自称遭外星人掳走的家伙。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is said that POKENAME has achieved absolute oneness and plans to wage universal war. However, only a self-proclaimed abductee supports this idea.

entry: 据说，POKENAME已经达到绝对合一，正打算掀起席卷宇宙的战争。可赞同这说法的，只有一个自称遭外星人掳走的家伙。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is said that POKENAME has achieved absolute oneness and plans to wage universal war. However, only a self-proclaimed abductee supports this idea.

entry: POKENAME能彻底改写自己的遗传密码，模仿几乎任何东西，连分子层面的细节也能复制。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is capable of completely altering its genetic code, allowing it to steal the appearance of almost anything down to the molecule.

entry: 一种奇异的突变创造出了这类抗性极强的基因。不过，人们认为它的基因序列十分杂乱。
author: .towerxvi
source: A bizarre mutation has created this highly resistant strain of DNA. Its genetic sequence is considered sloppy, however.

entry: 它始终捧着一件古代遗物，那是维系生命的关键。一旦失去，它便会死去。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: This Pokémon always holds an ancient relic. This relic is important for its survival, and if it ever loses it, it will die.

entry: 这只宝可梦从无垠太空中爬来。POKENAME能迅速进化，适应最严酷的环境。
author: teravolt
source: A Pokémon that crawled out of the expanse of space. POKENAME evolves rapidly to adapt to the harshest of environments.

entry: POKENAME每天整整睡上23小时，梦想着背上的种子，有一天能绽放成花。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME sleeps a full 23 hours each day. It dreams of the day when its seed will blossom into a flower.

entry: 据说，掰许愿骨的习俗正是因它而起。不过别拿POKENAME的骨头尝试，否则可能惹怒照顾它的基嘎啦。
author: .ssunday.
source: It is said to be the reason the wishbone tradition exists. However, one should not test this on POKENAME's bone as it may anger the parental Jiwak.

entry: 据说，母亲若遇见POKENAME，孩子便能幸福长寿。可许多人认为那只是传说，POKENAME根本不存在。
author: Staghorn
source: It's said that if a mother sees a POKENAME, their child will have a long and happy life. Many believe this is a myth, and that POKENAME aren't real.

entry: 遭偷猎者追捕时，它们许愿，想去一个谁也伤害不了自己的地方，随即在一阵光芒中消失了。
author: TomatoSalad
source: Hunted by poachers, they wished to be taken somewhere where no one could harm them and disappeared in a flash of light.

entry: 传说，很久以前，它为守护祈求平安的弱者，来到这个世界。待解救他们脱离暴政，POKENAME便返回群星。
author: Abhatu
source: Legends say it came to this world long ago to defend the weak who wished for safety. After freeing them from tyranny, POKENAME returned to the stars.

entry: POKENAME模样可怖，可仍有许多人甘愿冒着生命危险，忍受火焰灼烧，只求心愿成真。
author: alliveir
source: Although a fearsome sight, many people are willing to be burnt by POKENAME's flames to have their wishes come true, thus putting their lives at stake.

entry: POKENAME为宇宙各处的逝者哀悼。据说从它身上能望见无垠太空的景象。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME mourns for the loss of those throughout the cosmos. It is said to exude a visage of the endless expanse of space.

entry: POKENAME收集愿望，帮助花苞绽放。虽不能让愿望成真，却真心希望所有心愿都有实现的一天。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME spends its time collecting wishes to help its bud bloom. While it cannot grant them, it hopes that all wishes will comes true.

entry: 人们相信，它每隔数千年，才会造访世界一次。许多不同文化的记载里，POKENAME都被描绘为星辰之神。
author: char_latte3412
source: It's believed to visit this world only once every few thousand years. Numerous records from varying cultures depict POKENAME as a deity of the stars.

entry: POKENAME能凿穿空间，开出虫洞。科学家研究它，盼着让瞬间移动技术迎来突破。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME bores through space itself, creating wormholes. By studying it, scientists hope to revolutionize teleportation technology.

entry: 据说它带着的圆球能实现三个愿望。每年都会来到这个世界，却总藏起来，让许多人找不到。
author: Drip_capybara
source: The ball that it carries is said to be able to grant three wishes. It comes to this world every year, but it goes into hiding, so many can't find it.

entry: 极偶尔，POKENAME会睁开第三只眼，凝望怀中的圆球，窥探未来。对它而言，保护这颗球比什么都重要。
author: Abhatu
source: Once every blue moon, POKENAME opens its third eye and looks into the orb it carries to peer into the future. It protects the orb above all else.

entry: 据说，POKENAME本该沉睡一千年，再醒来活动一周。可它睡得太舒服，如今四千年过去，竟还没醒。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to sleep for a thousand years before it awakens for a week. It got too comfortable and hasn't woken up in four thousand years.

entry: 据说，它每隔千年，才能为人实现一次愿望。在这段漫长岁月里，许多心愿也在身边越积越多。
author: Abhatu
source: It is said to grant wishes only once every thousand years. Many wishes pile up around it in the meantime.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会现身于心地纯净、快乐的人面前。第三只眼若睁开，一个愿望便会实现。
author: togetik
source: Legend has it that POKENAME appears to those with pure and joyful hearts. If its third eye opens, a wish will be granted.

entry: POKENAME闭上原来的双眼，专心练习第三只眼。靠第三只眼，能提前看见尚未到来的攻击。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME has closed its two main eyes in order to master the use of its third. Through this third eye it sees attacks before they come.

entry: POKENAME只要察觉有人靠近，便会瞬间移走，因此直到最近，存在才得到证实。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME teleports away as soon as it detects someone nearby, so its existence was only recently confirmed.

entry: 有些人称POKENAME为“月亮公主”。站在它身旁，谁也忍不住赞叹那身闪亮、飘逸的长裙。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some people refer to POKENAME as the "Lunar Princess." Those in its presence can't help but admire its sparkly flowing dress.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的剑术大师，为那些心怀超越自身之愿的人而战。
author: Abhatu
source: A master swordsman from beyond the stars. It fights for those who desire something beyond themselves.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的剑术大师，为那些心怀超越自身之愿的人而战。
author: Abhatu
source: A master swordsman from beyond the stars. It fights for those who desire something beyond themselves.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，不断收集木材，想靠自己实现心愿：筑起一道足以拦住海洋的巨坝。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME is known to be very active, constantly collecting wood. It aims to grant its own wish for a massive dam to block up the ocean.

entry: POKENAME由许多未竟的心愿汇成，而束缚POKENAME的那块石头，来历也不属人间。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME is a collection of many desires left unfulfilled. The rock POKENAME is bound to is of unearthly origin.

entry: POKENAME致力于实现最崇高的愿望。背后花朵的芬芳，会让人重拾信心与希望。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME strives to help make the most noble of wishes come true. The aroma from the flower on its back inspires confidence and hope.

entry: POKENAME生活在山顶，只在夜里展开身体。接连沐浴数次满月，才能迎来进化。
author: thegreatdraco
source: POKENAME are found on top of mountains, where they only open up during nighttime. They must bask in several full moons before they can evolve.

entry: POKENAME平时用花瓣遮住脸。到了午夜，腹部的眼睛才会睁开。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: POKENAME usually covers its face with its petals. At midnight, the eye on its stomach opens.

entry: 它的脸由紫水晶构成，能承受极强的冲击。POKENAME性情沉静，喜欢让训练家的梦想成真。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Its face is made of amethyst that can withstand great force. POKENAME are calm and like to make the dreams of their Trainers come true.

entry: 它是一位性情平和的巨人，在野外极难见到。据说，训练家若能堂堂正正击败POKENAME，便可获准实现一个愿望。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: A large, peaceful giant that is rarely seen in the wild. It's said that POKENAME will grant one wish to a Trainer that defeats it in a fair fight.

entry: POKENAME会出现在命中将遭厄运的人面前。据说，在惨淡命运降临前，它会实现对方最后一个心愿。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME appears to those with doom in their future. It is said to grant one parting wish before their grim fate arrives.

entry: POKENAME随宇宙之流飘荡，寻找新生恒星的光芒，沐浴其中。目睹这段旅程的人，都会心生敬畏。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME flows with the cosmic currents in search of the light of a new star to bathe in. A feeling of awe washes over those who witness its journey.

entry: 唯有更深地理解存在之意的人，才能看见POKENAME的真身。它曾被称作“观察者”。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME shows its true form to those with a greater understanding of existence. It was once dubbed The Watcher.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的刀刃锋利得足以斩开夜空。唯有被它认可的人，才能挥动它。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legends say POKENAME's blade is so sharp that it can cleave the night sky in two. Only those it deems worthy are able to wield it.

entry: POKENAME主要待在丰缘各地的实验室。唯有心怀强烈愿望的训练家下令，沉睡的身体才会苏醒。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME mainly presides in laboratories across Hoenn. Its dormant body only awakens when a Trainer with a strong wish gives it orders.

entry: 它散发宁静的气息，抚平周围人的心。据说，纯善者会因它而得好运，邪恶之人则会招来厄运。
author: wigglypon
source: It radiates a peaceful aura, calming the hearts of those nearby. It is said to bring good fortune to the pure of heart and bad luck upon the wicked.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的战士之王，手中长矛，专诛邪恶。
author: dragonzzilla
source: A warrior-king from beyond the stars. With its spear, it smites the wicked.

entry: 据说，POKENAME金色的羽毛，由尚未实现的心愿凝成。它不知疲倦地寻觅，想将这些心愿送到应许之人身边。
author: origamiskies
source: It's said that POKENAME's golden plumes are made from unresolved wishes. It searches tirelessly to bring those wishes to their recipients.

entry: POKENAME会闯入渴望强烈的人的梦，再将那些愿望扭曲，化成可怕、永难满足的噩梦。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME appears in dreams to those with strong desires. It then twists those desires into horrible and unfulfilling nightmares.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的战士之王，挥动重锤，审判邪恶。
author: dragonzzilla
source: A warrior-king from beyond the stars. With its hammer, it judges the wicked.

entry: 绝望的人苦盼美梦成真，POKENAME便会现身，逼对方玩一场游戏，说赢了就能实现愿望。可至今，没人赢过。
author: p0opys0ck123abc
source: POKENAME appears to desperate people who wish for their dreams to come true. It forces them to play a game to get their wish, but no one has ever won.

entry: 据说，POKENAME藏着一股绝不可释放的古老力量。谁若窥进它的眼睛，便会永远迷失。
author: Abhatu
source: It is said that POKENAME contains an ancient power never to be unleashed. Those who peer into its eye are left feeling lost for the rest of time.

entry: POKENAME掠过夜空极快，身后又拖着星光，常让人误认成流星。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a shooting star due to how fast it moves through the night sky, and the trail of cosmic light it leaves behind.

entry: 它性情快乐，却总在吃、总在睡。若在酣眠时打扰，多半会挨上痛痛的一口。
author: adrian151
source: It has a joyful nature, but eats and sleeps very often. Disturbing it during its long slumbers will likely result in painful bites.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表破破烂烂，却始终乐观。它们只盼，有一天也能变得美丽。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME are optimistic despite looking raggedy. They wish only to become beautiful someday.

entry: 传说，POKENAME渴望飞翔的心太过强烈，连群星也为之感动，赐它双翼，让它终于能翱翔。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: According to legend, POKENAME wished so hard to fly that the stars gave it a pair of wings that let it soar.

entry: 与基拉祈融合后，这只朽木妖终于得到安宁。如今它成了心愿的摇篮，耐心等朋友苏醒，再一同帮助他人。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: In union with Jirachi, this Trevenant found peace. It is now a cradle of wishes, waiting patiently for its friend to awaken so they may help others.

entry: 据说，POKENAME每千年才能实现一次愿望。可愿望一旦实现，它就会忘掉自己曾有这份力量。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to grant a wish once every thousand years. However, it has no recollection of its powers after fulfilling one.

entry: POKENAME已在太空中游弋数千年，身上流淌出宇宙的碎片。第三只眼，让它能毫无阻碍地看穿任何液体。
author: Abhatu
source: Having swam through space for millennia, fragments of the cosmos now flow from POKENAME. Its third eye allows it to see perfectly through any liquid.

entry: POKENAME为凡人的梦想奔走，穿行群星之间。据说，彗星不过是它划过太空，留下的灿烂身影。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME travels across the stars as a servant to mortals' dreams. It is said that comets are merely POKENAME blazing through space.

entry: 古代文明将POKENAME奉为愿望之神，相信它能看透并实现一个人心底最深的渴望。
author: theartemis1
source: Revered as the god of wishes by ancient civilizations, POKENAME are able to see and fulfill one's deepest desires.

entry: 若POKENAME认为许愿者值得帮助，便能预见通向理想未来的道路。即使白天，它的胡须也映着夜空。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME can predict what path will lead to a wisher's desired future, if it deems them worthy. Even in daylight, its beard reflects the night sky.

entry: 古代文明将POKENAME奉为愿望之神，相信它能看透并实现一个人心底最深的渴望。
author: theartemis1
source: Revered as the god of wishes by ancient civilizations, POKENAME are able to see and fulfill one's deepest desires.

entry: 召来POKENAME，便可许下三个愿望。可想让愿望成真，得先完成三场艰巨的考验。
author: dragonzzilla
source: If summoned, POKENAME will grant you three wishes. To see them realized, however, you must first complete three arduous trials.

entry: POKENAME能将他人的愿望化为现实。可它行踪太过难寻，许多人连这份力量都不曾听过。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME has the ability to bring the wishes of others to life. However, it's very elusive, so many people don't even know about this power.

entry: 这种融合体让一个著名的星座获得生命。三颗头能看见过去、现在与未来。
author: dragonzzilla
source: This fusion was created to bring a famous constellation to life. Its three heads can see the past, present, and future.

entry: POKENAME游过天际群星，宛如游水。每溅起一次星光，便有一个人心底最深的愿望成真。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME can be found swimming across the stars in the sky like water. With each splash, a human's deepest wish is granted.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会让人梦见最想实现的愿望，沉浸在圆梦的幸福中。它为何这么做，仍无人知晓。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are said to show people blissful dreams of their greatest wishes coming true. It is unknown why they do this.

entry: POKENAME用梦境幻象迷惑猎物，让其陷入恍惚。摆锤赐下的，不过是虚假的圆梦，还会一点点夺走敌人的理智。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME enchants prey with dream visions, trapping them in a trance. Its pendulum grants false wishes, stealing sanity from its foes.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会让人梦见最想实现的愿望，沉浸在圆梦的幸福中。它为何这么做，仍无人知晓。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are said to show people blissful dreams of their greatest wishes coming true. It is unknown why they do this.

entry: POKENAME将自己像剑入鞘般插在树根旁，吸收养分，等待进化。唯有自卫时，才会再度出鞘。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sheaths into the ground next to the roots of a tree, absorbing its nutrients to evolve. It only unsheathes to defend itself.

entry: 若跟着POKENAME钻进地下，就可能被困在漆黑复杂的隧道网中。它正是用这种方法，迷惑天敌。
author: birchbot
source: If you follow a POKENAME into the ground, you may be caught in a dark and complex tunnel system. This is a way to confuse predators.

entry: 踢腿时，双腿能伸长到原来的两倍。凭这猛烈的踢击，它甚至能踢倒树木。
author: .izik
source: Its legs can extend up to double their original length when kicking. They use their powerful attacks to fell trees.

entry: POKENAME冒出的烟，有股腐木味。它喜欢吃树桩，以及掉落的枝叶。
author: .izik
source: The smoke that pours out of a POKENAME smells like rotting wood. It prefers to feed on tree stumps and other fallen foliage.

entry: 最早发现的POKENAME中，有一只竟是水力发电厂服务器里的文件。它究竟从哪儿来，至今不明。
author: .izik
source: One of the first known POKENAME appeared as a file within a Hydropower Plant's server. Its origin is unknown.

entry: POKENAME住在河流中，尤其喜欢水车附近。尾巴能卷成粗壮的一团，用来敲打东西。它们也爱雕刻木头。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME live in rivers, especially near watermills. They roll up their tails into a stockier shape to smack things. They like to make wood carvings.

entry: 它用泥土与细枝筑巢，把河底找到的闪亮东西，一件件带回家珍藏。
author: .izik
source: Its den is made up of mud and twigs. It gathers shiny objects that it finds on the river's floor and stores them in its home.

entry: 短短一分钟，它就能砍倒好几棵树。POKENAME不只是伐木的好帮手，建造或拆除房屋，也都十分拿手。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can fell several trees within a minute. POKENAME is a welcome helper not only for felling work, but also for construction or demolition work.

entry: POKENAME用泥、木材与自己雕好的石块，在溪流上筑坝。水坝宛如小堡垒，它则像剑入鞘一般，藏身其中。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME builds dams on river streams using mud and the wood and stone it carves. These dams resemble tiny forts, and it sheathes in them.

entry: 最近，一群POKENAME不知为何出现在清爽村北面的水坝。它们会发出奇特的咔嗒声，吓退敌人。
author: .izik
source: For an unknown reason, groups of POKENAME recently appeared in a dam north of Rifure Village. They make an odd clicking noise to deter enemies.

entry: 它用树皮与泥土筑坝，靠齿轮维持稳定。齿轮一旦失灵，水坝便会崩塌，危及周围。
author: anarchaz
source: Using bark and mud, it dams streams, relying on its gears for stability. If they fail, the dam collapses, posing a danger to its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME用锋利门齿啃食硅化木。吃进去的矿物会结晶，逐渐长到身体表面。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: POKENAME uses its sharp incisors to gnaw on petrified wood. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon's body surface.

entry: 它对森林及其中万物，了解得非同寻常。POKENAME力气极大，单手便能搬起十根大原木。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: It has extraordinary knowledge of the forest and the things found in it. POKENAME has such strength that it can carry ten big tree logs in one hand.

entry: 它通常是伐木工人的帮手。POKENAME肌力惊人，能搭建水坝、道馆等大型木造建筑。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This fusion is usually a lumberjack's helper. Huge muscle strength allows POKENAME build large wooden structures such as dams and gyms.

entry: 它会与同族攀在崖壁上较量，看谁撑得最久。最后仍不松手的，便是赢家。
author: .izik
source: It competes with others of its kind by holding onto cliff walls for long periods of time. The winner is determined by who holds on longest.

entry: 它全身覆着暗色毒泥。晒太阳太久，部分泥层就会硬化、脱落。
author: .izik
source: Its body is coated in a dark, poisonous mud. If it stays in the sun too long, portions will harden and fall off.

entry: 它非常护食，别的POKENAME一靠近收集来的食物，就会被它吐出的黏丝网拦住。
author: .izik
source: It is very protective over the food it gathers. Should another POKENAME approach, it will spit a web of sticky silk at it.

entry: 它在小村外筑巢，眼巴巴盼着窗台上放一块派。桃桃果派甜甜的，最合它胃口。
author: .izik
source: It makes its nest outside of small villages, hoping for pies to be left on windowsills. It prefers Pecha Berry pies due to their sweetness.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找被丢弃的小电器。找到后，就试着放一记电，给它们充充能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels around in search of small discarded electronics. Once it finds them, it attempts to charge them with a bolt of electricity.

entry: POKENAME有双重性格，感官敏锐，总是精力十足地漫游草原。真假两股气息，能让天敌摸不清它的位置。
author: anarchaz
source: With a dual personality and keen senses, POKENAME roams the savannah with boundless energy. It has a fake and a real aura to trick predators.

entry: 谁惊吓了POKENAME，它就将真身的影像直接投进对方脑海，散发出令人恐惧的气息。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME projects the image of its true form into the minds of those who frighten or surprise it. It emanates an aura of terror.

entry: 它会主动寻找强大的宝可梦，迅速将其击败。败者多半心怀恶意，因此有人视POKENAME为守护天使。
author: TheEmeraldFlygon
source: It seeks out powerful Pokémon, and swiftly defeats them. These Pokémon are often ill-willed, so some view POKENAME as a guardian angel.

entry: 它曾经是人类，因此更懂人心。看见周围有人受苦，便会同悲同悯，泪水流个不停。
author: .realthree
source: Because it was once human, it has a better understanding of people's emotions. It weeps ceaseless tears of compassion for those suffering around it.

entry: POKENAME毛绒绒的身体能挡住重拳。可它不知道别人没有这份防护，一兴奋仍会挥拳打过去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's plushy body protects it from heavy punches. However, it isn't aware that others don't share its defenses, and punches when excited.

entry: POKENAME出没于富含金属矿物的寒冷草原。白天一动不动，夜里却是危险的猎手。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears in cold steppes that are rich in metallic minerals. Though motionless during the day, it is a dangerous predator at night.

entry: POKENAME不太喜欢群居，对其他生物的情绪又格外敏感，通常只愿让训练家陪着。
author: .realthree
source: A POKENAME is rarely a social Pokémon. Its sensitivity to others' emotions means that it typically prefers the sole company of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME极富共情能力，轻易便能读懂情绪与来意，甚至能感知20英里范围内的生命。
author: HoundRyS
source: A true empath, POKENAME can easily read emotions and intentions. It can sense life within a 20 mile area.

entry: 它在地下睡得太久，头上竟发了芽。这虽不是正常现象，它却毫不在意。
author: mx_wellman
source: This Pokémon has been asleep underground for so long, a sprout has grown on its head. This is not normal, but it's not bothered by it.

entry: 若看见POKENAME在某处打盹，灾难很快就要到来。可无论发生什么，POKENAME总能一觉睡过去，毫发无伤。
author: strawbearycandy
source: If POKENAME is spotted napping somewhere, a disaster is soon to follow. Whatever occurs, POKENAME will always sleep through it, completely unharmed.

entry: 它虽然会漂浮，却更喜欢用飘带缠在人身上。持用过它的人，都说事后觉得浑身乏力。
author: cait_sith
source: It can float, but it prefers to cling to people with its ribbon. Those who wield it report feeling drained afterwards.

entry: POKENAME把自己嵌进树里，一待就是数月。仅靠树的生命力就能活下去，还不会伤到树木。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME wedges itself in trees for months at a time. It can live solely off the life force of the tree without even harming it.

entry: POKENAME难吃得没有天敌肯下口，便整天悠闲吃叶子。松树汁，是它的最爱。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME taste so awful that no predator eats them. Due to this, they lounge around eating leaves all day. Their favorite food is pine sap.

entry: POKENAME爱在高树间穿梭、荡来荡去。活动如此耗力，它每天得睡15个小时，才能补回来。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME loves to spend its time navigating tall trees and swinging about. To make up for this massive energy expenditure, it sleeps 15 hours a day.

entry: POKENAME爱躺在苔藓上睡觉，通常一天能睡上20个小时。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME likes to sleep on moss, which it usually does for up to 20 hours a day.

entry: 别看个头小，它惹起麻烦来可不小。精力旺盛，最爱做的事，就是恶作剧。
author: themicelegion
source: Even with its small size, it is able to cause quite a lot of mayhem. It is incredibly energetic and its favorite pastime is causing mischief.

entry: 它们成群围观人类与宝可梦，满脸不屑，还要捉弄一番。毛发有多长，便代表地位有多高。
author: Ayner
source: In groups, they watch Pokémon and Trainer alike with disdain and pull pranks on them. The length of their hair indicates their rank in the hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME满心想宣泄积压的能量，偏偏冷得一直发抖，根本腾不出空来。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME yearns to release all of its pent up energy, but it is too busy shivering in the cold to do anything about it.

entry: POKENAME总是失去平衡，走路十分费劲。头若能小一点，本可以用四肢行走。
author: HummusIsHome
source: Walking is difficult for POKENAME as they are constantly off balance. They would walk on all fours if the size of their head was a bit smaller.

entry: 它用梳齿般排列的牙齿捕食。吃得营养丰富，也就长得飞快。
author: _sadfroggy
source: This Pokémon uses its tooth comb to catch its food. With its nutrient rich diet, it grows fast.

entry: POKENAME慢慢挪近池塘边，把叶片拖过水面，沾些水珠，好让身体凉下来。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME trudge close to the banks of ponds and drag their leaves across the surface. In this way, they wet them with drops to cool themselves down.

entry: POKENAME常跳进河湖消暑，身上的芽也趁机吸饱水，储存几个月都没问题。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME regularly jumps into lakes and rivers to cool off. In doing so, the buds on its body soak up water. They can hold it for months.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，喜欢交际，是训练家很受欢迎的伙伴。它还能从颈部放出清凉的水。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a gentle and sociable disposition, which makes it a popular partner for Pokémon Trainers. It can emit refreshing water from its neck.

entry: POKENAME虽笨手笨脚，却雄心不小。可一到陆地走路，又常被自己绊倒。
author: NeonRiser
source: POKENAME is a clumsy but ambitious creature. It often trips and falls while walking on land.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，却只取食小鱼群的生命力。它也爱与海滩游客互相泼水，比个高下。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Despite its size, POKENAME only harvests the life force of schools of small fish. It enjoys splash-offs with beach goers.

entry: POKENAME会拍打小鱼群，夺取生命力，却也喜欢与游客泼水嬉戏，被当作沙滩球拍来拍去。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Though it smacks the life force out of small schools of fish, POKENAME also enjoys splashing water at beach-goers and being hit like a beach ball.

entry: POKENAME喷水吓唬附近的宝可梦。真受威胁时，还会跃得更高，怒气勃发的模样，让见者心惊。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME blow jets of water to scare nearby Pokémon. When threatened, they can leap even higher, showing true fear to any who witness this rage.

entry: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，独处时十分胆小。一旦失散，就会漫游海洋，直到找到新的群体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hunt in small groups. It is very cowardly on its own and roams the ocean until it finds a new group if it loses its old one.

entry: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，独处时十分胆小。一旦失散，就会漫游海洋，直到找到新的群体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME hunt in small groups. It is very cowardly on its own and roams the ocean until it finds a new group if it loses its old one.

entry: POKENAME用鼻孔吸进空气，储在体内。看见猎物，便将空气喷出去，为自己加速。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME collects air through its nostrils, which it stores in its body. When it sees prey, it expels it for additional acceleration.

entry: 这只浮力十足的宝可梦，根本不懂保持距离。只要见到船上开派对，就兴冲冲地闯过去凑热闹。
author: .realthree
source: This buoyant Pokémon has no concept of personal space, and excitedly crashes any boat party it sees.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，也爱在沙滩上放松。它最喜欢的消遣，却是找其他野生宝可梦打一架。
author: UsagiNezumi
source: POKENAME is a fun-loving Pokémon that enjoys relaxing on the beach. Its favorite means of relaxation is trying to fight other wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME亮起尾巴，在黑暗中与同伴交流。到了夜里，整群POKENAME就像满天繁星！
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME's tail lights up to communicate with partners in the dark. At night, a flock of POKENAME resembles the stars in the sky!

entry: 它们乘风漂浮，四处移动。若碰上雷雨，身上便会泛起电光。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: They float on the winds to move around. If they encounter a thunderstorm, their bodies glow with electricity.

entry: POKENAME进食时，浓密毛发会闪闪发亮。它用尾巴向附近地面放电，让小型猎物动弹不得。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's thick fur shines when it eats. It uses its tail to send jolts of electricity through the nearby ground to immobilize small prey.

entry: POKENAME像猫一样优雅地潜行林间。敏捷的身手，加上强劲的攻击，让它成为枝叶深处可怕的猎手。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME prowls the forest with feline grace. Its agile movements and powerful strikes make it a formidable hunter in the dense foliage.

entry: 对刚上路的新手训练家而言，POKENAME是再好不过的伙伴。它与训练家羁绊深厚，永远相伴左右。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME is the perfect partner for any rookie Trainer starting their journey. It has a strong bond to its Trainer and will always be by their side.

entry: 它游泳时总把尾巴举出水面，免得电伤其他水生宝可梦。可不幸的是，这又让它在暴风雨里，成了一根绝佳的避雷针。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It swims with its tail above water so as not to electrocute other aquatic Pokémon. Unfortunately, this acts as a perfect lightning rod during storms.

entry: 使用电力时，刀刃便会发光。它能与其他POKENAME以刃相触，合并电力，打出更强的一击。
author: cait_sith
source: Its blades glow when it uses its electric powers. It can touch blades with other POKENAME to combine their electricity into a more powerful attack.

entry: 看见这副圆滚滚的模样，许多人以为是普通霹雳电球。可其实，它不过是一只从上方看去的胖丁。
author: nasho1908
source: Many people who see its shape mistake it for that of a regular Voltorb, but it's in fact just a Jigglypuff seen from above.

entry: POKENAME的歌声，能安抚人类与宝可梦。可实在太过舒缓，听者往往一睡下去，便几乎再也不醒。
author: chiari_queen
source: The songs that POKENAME sing are soothing to both people and Pokémon. So soothing, in fact, that those who hear it fall into a near-endless slumber.

entry: POKENAME的歌声，能安抚人类与宝可梦。可实在太过舒缓，听者往往一睡下去，便几乎再也不醒。
author: chiari_queen
source: The songs that POKENAME sing are soothing to both people and Pokémon. So soothing, in fact, that those who hear it fall into a near-endless slumber.

entry: POKENAME常停在树枝上，监看下方动静。大眼睛始终警醒地盯着，常把孩子们吓一跳。
author: Adam941
source: POKENAME are known to perch themselves on tree branches and survey the area below. They often scare children due to their large and watchful eyes.

entry: 它体内充满空气，睡觉时得用尖牙咬住东西，才不会飘走。
author: .izik
source: Its body is filled with air. It uses its fangs to clamp down on surfaces to avoid floating away while sleeping.

entry: 这只宝可梦会用催眠幻象，让带来威胁的敌人入睡。也正因此，它成了失眠者理想的伙伴。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon uses hypnotic illusions to lure threats to sleep. Because of this, it's a perfect partner for those who suffer from insomnia.

entry: 古代遗迹的墙上，刻着POKENAME的图案。图案连成摇篮曲的音符，只消看上一眼，就令人昏昏欲睡。
author: ServerSizeMe
