source: Carvings of POKENAME can be seen on the walls of ancient ruins. They form the notes to a lullaby that can make you sleepy just by looking at it.

entry: POKENAME爱用各种哔哔、嘟嘟声，重现听过的乐曲。它还会钻进不同媒介里，继续唱个不停。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME adores repeating music it hears with a variety of boops and beeps. It likes to insert itself into different mediums to continue singing.

entry: POKENAME只肯寄宿在积灰的旧留声机里，因此很难寻到。歌声有时令人心醉，有时却叫人不安。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: POKENAME will only ever inhabit dusty old gramophones which makes them hard to track down. Their singing can be blissful or disturbing.

entry: POKENAME为独自生活，住进废弃房屋。可偶尔，也会看见一群POKENAME聚在一起，举行某种仪式。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned houses to be all alone. Sometimes, groups of POKENAME can be seen doing some sort of ritual.

entry: POKENAME为独自生活，住进废弃房屋。可偶尔，也会看见一群POKENAME聚在一起，举行某种仪式。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned houses to be all alone. Sometimes, groups of POKENAME can be seen doing some sort of ritual.

entry: POKENAME是许多人最可怕的噩梦。行为虽与胖丁相似，歌声却会让目标陷入睡眠瘫痪，醒着也动弹不得。
author: Kermeros
source: POKENAME is many people's worst nightmare. It behaves similarly to a Jigglypuff, but it instead puts its targets into sleep paralysis with its song.

entry: 据说，背上的花园连暴怒的火暴猴也能安抚。许多宝可梦，都喜欢围到它身边唱歌。
author: funkytomate
source: The garden on its back is said to be able to even calm down the most angry Primeape. Many Pokémon like to gather around it to sing.

entry: POKENAME振动刀刃，哼出优美的摇篮曲。等对手沉沉睡去，它便痛下杀手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME vibrates its blade which hums a beautiful lullaby. When its opponent falls asleep, it finishes the job.

entry: POKENAME爱用优美的歌声，将迷路水手引往巢穴。许多古老航海故事，便出自自称见过它的人。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME loves to lure lost sailors to its lair with its beautiful singing. Many old maritime tales were told by those who claimed to have seen it.

entry: POKENAME唱歌舒缓，又能用飘带安慰哭闹的幼童，因此很受托育工作者欢迎。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME is popular amongst daycare workers due to its soothing singing voice and ability to calm fussy toddlers with its ribbons.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: Cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: Cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: 夜里，它先凝望天空，再放声歌唱，一直唱到天明。事后，却全不记得自己做过什么。
author: Skymaster426
source: At night, it stares into the sky before beginning to sing. It will do this until morning, and will not remember doing so afterwards.

entry: POKENAME常以歌声作声呐，探知障碍物，有时也会唱歌催眠天敌。
author: Phrotonz
source: POKENAME often sings as a form of sonar to detect obstacles. They may also sing to put predators asleep.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又好动，一闹起来就靠柔韧身体在屋里弹跳好几分钟，停都不停。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is very playful and hyperactive. Once it gets going, it bounces around the room for minutes without stopping thanks to its flexible body.

entry: 它的喵叫声有极强的催眠效果，因此格外受到睡眠不好的人欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its meowing has an incredibly soporific effect, which is why it is particularly popular with people with sleep problems.

entry: POKENAME腹部盘绕着一段旋律。试着奏出这段旋律的人发现，它竟是一首极灵验的摇篮曲。
author: gronkissimo
source: POKENAME has a musical melody spiraling around its stomach. Those that replicate this melody find it to be an incredibly effective lullaby.

entry: POKENAME亲人又爱撒娇，抱着也舒服，是很受欢迎的宠物。安心时，它会自顾自轻轻哼唱。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and cuddly, which makes it a popular pet. When it feels comfortable, it hums gently to itself.

entry: POKENAME一边唱着催眠曲，一边有节奏地拖动尾巴。坚硬外壳，则保护着柔韧的身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME accompanies its soporific singing with a rhythmic dragging of its tail. It protects its flexible body with a hard shell.

entry: 它穿着母亲蜕下的旧甲，那是如今唯一能用来追念母亲的遗物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It wears the shed armor of its mother as a hand-me-down, the last thing it has to remember her by.

entry: 这只宝可梦最讨厌赌徒。曾有个糊涂训练家，提议拿POKENAME身上的花纹计点，玩一场赌运气的游戏。
author: fixthewifi
source: This Pokémon dislikes gamblers immensely. A foolish Trainer once suggested playing a game of chance using the markings on POKENAME's body as score.

entry: 它想移动，全得靠好奇的训练家推着滚。极少数个体的某一面，竟有七点或八点。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It relies solely on curious Trainers to roll it in order to get around. Rarely, ones with seven- or eight-spotted sides have been seen.

entry: 科学家最近发现，成群POKENAME正漂流太空。不知为何，一离开大气层，它们便不再需要食物。
author: .izik
source: Scientists recently spotted clusters of POKENAME drifting through space. For some reason, they do not require food once they leave the atmosphere.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME不会游泳，只好沿湖底走着觅食。沉重的身体能帮它像掷链球般高速甩动尾巴。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME can't swim, instead walking along lake beds for food. Its heavy body helps it spin its tail at high speed like a hammer thrower.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: 再硬的材料，它也能一路啃穿。野生POKENAME，已经给基础设施造成过严重破坏。
author: bobosmith01
source: It chews its way through any tough material. Serious infrastructure damage has been caused due to wild POKENAME.

entry: 钢制外骨骼很难被击穿。POKENAME还会吃石头，让这副外骨骼变得更硬。
author: themicelegion
source: Its steel exoskeleton is extremely hard to penetrate. POKENAME eats rocks to makes its exoskeleton even harder.

entry: 它喜欢让身体尽可能保持低温。冬天，会睡进冰封洞穴，让体内也冷下来。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to keep its body as cold as possible. During the winter months it sleeps in frozen caverns, keeping its internal temperature low.

entry: 即使遭人轻视，POKENAME仍骄傲地昂首挺立。进化成波士可拉斯后，对没伤害过自己的生物，它会手下留情。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME stands tall with pride, even when looked down upon. When it evolves into Aggitar, it spares those who haven't wronged it.

entry: POKENAME有坚甲护身，尾巴则像带刺的锤头，能狠狠重击敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is protected by hard armor. Its tail resembles a morning star, with which it can hit enemies hard.

entry: POKENAME虽小巧精致，身体却极能承受伤害。它会高声歌唱，有时独唱，有时与其他宝可梦合唱。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME is very durable, despite its tiny, delicate appearance. They either sing alone or with other Pokémon with a high-pitched voice.

entry: 它用头猛撞树木等固定物体，测试自身力量。有人说，它还记着自己究竟撞倒了多少敌人。
author: .izik
source: It violently slams its head into trees and other stationary objects to test its strength. Some say it keeps a count of how many foes it knocks over.

entry: POKENAME一向安静。凡被它吐息吹到的东西，都会变成室温。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME is known to be very quiet. Everything it breathes on becomes room temperature.

entry: 建筑工地常用POKENAME帮忙。有待报废的金属零件，它就高高兴兴地用齿轮碾碎，吃进肚里。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are often used in construction. When metal parts are to be scrapped, a POKENAME is happy to eat them by grinding them between its gear teeth.

entry: POKENAME的长牙锋利如刃，也因此常遭猎杀。那些牙，会被用来制作刀具等锐器。
author: Sottiwotti
source: The tusks of POKENAME are razor sharp, which is why they are often hunted. Their tusks are used to make knives and other sharp objects.

entry: 沙漠的风沙，能直接穿过POKENAME空空的身体。若吹入角度正好，还会传出奇怪的哨声。
author: .realthree
source: The desert sands blow right through POKENAME's empty body. A strange whistling sound can be heard if the wind blows through it at the right angle.

entry: POKENAME一脚就能踢停行驶中的列车。覆盖身体的合金会像皮肤一样生长，受损后则自行脱落。
author: .izik
source: A single kick from a POKENAME can halt a moving train. The alloy that covers its body grows like skin and falls off if it gets damaged.

entry: POKENAME守护巢穴，谁靠得太近，就一头撞过去。即使因此冲出悬崖，它也面不改色。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME defends its nest, ramming into anything that gets too close. It remains unfazed even if it flies off a cliff in the process.

entry: POKENAME聚居的洞穴食物稀少，主要以波士可蛋的蛋为生。为了吃的，它们也常彼此争斗。
author: kittyluv090
source: Colonies of POKENAME live in caverns where food is scarce, so largely subsist on Aggsey's eggs. They often fight amongst themselves over food.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护自己认定的朋友。身材虽小，铠甲却让它重得出乎意料。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME will fiercely protect anyone it considers a friend. Despite its small stature, it is deceptively heavy due to its armour.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，比任何人造缆绳都强韧。建筑工地里，常能发现它们潜藏的身影。
author: rihse
source: The silk POKENAME spins is stronger than any man-made cable. These Pokémon can often be found lurking in construction sites.

entry: 它们用金属棒弹射小石头，速度惊人。POKENAME之间即使友好切磋，看着也像拼命。
author: PokePower
source: They can use their metal sticks to flick small stones at an alarming speed. Even friendly spars between POKENAME look like fights for their lives.

entry: POKENAME爱吃花，也爱吸花蜜。牙齿坚硬，大颚有力，什么花都难逃它这一口。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME enjoys eating flowers and extracting their nectar. With its strong teeth and jaws, no flowers are safe from its bite.

entry: POKENAME大嚼沙粒，吐出石英碎块，还会变身成当地最强的捕食者，吓退敌人。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME can be found feasting on sand and spitting out quartz pieces. It transforms into its habitat's apex predators to intimidate its foes.

entry: 每天到了固定时刻，它就会咬下离自己最近的东西。每只POKENAME时间各不相同，想训练它最好尽快摸清规律！
author: wigglypon
source: At the same time each day, it bites into the nearest object. Each POKENAME's schedule differs; if you wish to train one, learn its routine quickly!

entry: POKENAME察觉沙下有动静，就飞过去，一口咬向地面！有时能捞着一顿饭，可多半，只啃了一嘴土。
author: wigglypon
source: If POKENAME detects movement under the sand, it flies over and chomps the earth! Sometimes it snags a meal, but usually just gets a mouthful of dirt.

entry: 它吃沙子与巨石，连珊瑚身体也渐渐化成了石头。背上的尖刺坚实，能挡住大多数天敌。
author: char_latte3412
source: Its diet of sand and boulders has converted its coral body into that of stone. The spikes on its back provide sturdy defenses against most predators.

entry: POKENAME虽爱调皮，也有体贴的一面。它总想警告邻村沙暴将至，可每次都弄得一团糟。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME can be caring, despite its mischievousness. It tries to warn surrounding villages of incoming sandstorms, but it fails miserably every time.

entry: POKENAME能当重锤，也能藏在沙里，当作捕兽夹。大颚咬碎受害者，便能取走生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can function like a hammer, or like a bear trap hidden in the sand. It crunches down on its victim to harvest their life force.

entry: POKENAME用飘带般的触须，放出安抚心神的气息，引来猎物，再以大颚咬住，使其失去行动能力。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to lure in its prey. It then uses its big jaw to bite into its prey, neutralizing them.

entry: 谁敢碰POKENAME的钥匙，手指就要挨咬。它视力虽差，却很会发现闪亮的东西。
author: cait_sith
source: Anyone who dares touch POKENAME's keys will have their fingers bitten. It has poor eyesight, but it is good at spotting shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME感到动静，就会设下沙陷阱。可太容易兴奋，常常合颚过早，什么也捉不着。
author: cyprexx
source: POKENAME makes sand traps when it senses movement, though it is easily excited and often snaps too early to catch anything.

entry: POKENAME埋身沙中，等待猎物踩上来。一旦触动，它就咬紧对方，死也不松口。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, waiting for prey to step on it. When triggered, it bites its prey, refusing to let go.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙地里，只露出叶片。谁敢把它拔出来，虎钳般的大颚，便能将其骨头咬碎。
author: rihse
source: POKENAME is found buried in sandy ground with only its leaves exposed. Its vice-like jaws can chomp through the bones of anyone that uproots it.

entry: 这是一个肉身陷入流沙后，心怀怨恨的亡魂。人们认为，口中不断流出的沙，正是里面那可怜的灵魂。
author: clubqaz
source: The result of a vengeful spirit which lost their mortal form to quicksand. Sand observed pouring out the mouth is believed to be the poor soul within.

entry: POKENAME吞下大块矿物，再用强腐蚀性的黏液溶解，借此进食。连自身五倍大的东西，也能吞下。
author: tuneless.towa
source: POKENAME feeds by engulfing large minerals and dissolving them with its highly corrosive mucus. It can ingest objects five times its size.

entry: 它口中流出的沙，常被工匠熔成玻璃。用这种玻璃做的防尘护目镜，会泛着黄色光泽。
author: .izik
source: The sand that streams out of its mouth is frequently melted down into glass by artisans. Safety Goggles that use this glass have a yellow shine.

entry: POKENAME十分友好，遇见陌生人，也想打招呼！可它表达亲近的方法，偏偏是冲人咬一口。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME is friendly and loves to greet any stranger it meets! Unfortunately, its sign of affection is to chomp on who it's trying to greet.

entry: 大眼睛、人一般的嘴唇与恶臭，会让鸟类摸不着头脑，使POKENAME在野外，出奇地顽强好活。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: Its large eyes, humanlike lips, and stench confuse birds, allowing POKENAME to be surprisingly resilient in nature.

entry: 滑稽的外形，让鸟宝可梦难以抓牢它；却又有股惹人怜爱的劲儿，让训练家忍不住收服。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its comical shape makes it both too awkward for bird Pokémon to get a hold of and endearing enough for Trainers to catch it out of sheer pity.

entry: 过去一年里，椰子岛附近出现了大群POKENAME。它们领地意识极强，谁在这片水域钓鱼，都会遭到攻击。
author: .izik
source: Large schools of POKENAME appeared near Frond Island within the last year. They are extremely territorial and attack anyone fishing in the area.

entry: POKENAME生命力极强，大多数环境都能生存。可战斗时没什么力气，往往只能排在最后上场。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: POKENAME is extremely hardy and can survive most environments. However, when it comes to Pokémon battles, its often used last as it has no strength.

entry: POKENAME常被用来安慰对自己没信心的人类与宝可梦。因为它不管变成谁，总比原主更丑一点。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: POKENAME is often used to make people and Pokémon feel better about themselves. When it transforms, it's always uglier than its target.

entry: 人们把它看作一种“老派”的宝可梦。POKENAME很适合做那些不断重复的工作。
author: .towerxvi
source: It is considered an “old-school” Pokémon. POKENAME are well-suited to performing repetitive tasks.

entry: POKENAME力气弱，战斗中很少见到，反倒常被捕来，当作食物。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME is a weak Pokémon rarely encountered in battles. Instead, it is often captured and consumed as a food source.

entry: 它常在遭污染的海滩上滑行。POKENAME那张脸，如今还成了网上热门的表情包。
author: Mistymagius
source: This Pokémon can usually be found slithering along polluted beaches. POKENAME's face has become popular online as a reaction image.

entry: POKENAME已学会自保，对付那些以为它好欺负的宝可梦。传闻，它真正的美丽，藏在丑陋的壳下。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: POKENAME has learned to protect itself from the Pokémon that think it is easy prey. Rumor has it that its true beauty lies within its hideous shell.

entry: POKENAME始终愁苦，很少露出半分喜色。不过，若遇上最温柔的训练家，也许还能哄它一笑。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME lives in constant misery and rarely shows any hint of joy. The kindest of Trainers might coax a smile out of this sorry Pokémon, though.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥泞的湖底或河床，渴望有训练家把自己当武器。可惜，既没什么威力，也不顺手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is found in muddy lakebeds and riverbeds. It is eager to be used as a weapon by any Trainer, but is unimpressive and unwieldy.

entry: 别看它丑陋又破旧，游速却快得惊人，在湖泊生态中，往往居于支配地位。
author: .towerxvi
source: Despite its ugly, dilapidated appearance, it is able to swim incredibly fast. It is known to dominate lake ecosystems.

entry: 它用水草裹住身体，睡在湖底。据说能实现愿望，可从来没人费心试试。
author: .towerxvi
source: It wraps itself in seaweed and sleeps beneath lakes. It can supposedly grant wishes, but nobody has bothered to try.

entry: POKENAME每隔几小时，不是盯着美丽鳞片，就是呆望远方。偶尔，才肯停下来，吃点藻类。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME alternates between staring at its prism scale and at blankly into the distance every few hours. It will rarely stop this cycle to eat algae.

entry: 社区与城市花园长得好，秘密功臣常是POKENAME。把它种进土床，放出的雾气就是天然驱虫剂。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: POKENAME are often the secret success to community and city gardens. Planted in soil beds, the mists they produce are natural pest repellents.

entry: 它丑得连其他幽灵都不愿靠近。因此，水手喜欢带着POKENAME，驱赶鬼船与厄运。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: Its ugliness deters other spirits. As a result, sailors like to use POKENAME to fend off ghost ships and bad luck.

entry: 有些训练家总觉得，是自己伤了POKENAME的心。其实，POKENAME只是一直都这么低落罢了。
author: funkytomate
source: Some Trainers have the feeling that they might be hurting their POKENAME's feelings. In truth, POKENAME are just always feeling down.

entry: 商店卖不掉POKENAME，便把它们当作游乐庆典的奖品，送给孩子。可多数孩子也不想要，常又把它们丢掉。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: POKENAME are given to kids as carnival prizes because stores can't seem to sell them. However, even most kids don't want them and often discard them.

entry: 叶子刚长出，就全部掉落。树干也十分脆弱，因此总容易枯萎。
author: .towerxvi
source: All of its leaves fall off as soon as they grow. Its trunk is very weak, so it is prone to wilting.

entry: 很少听说POKENAME会攻击谁。也许只是因为从没人想抱起它，或表达一点亲近。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME are rarely known to be aggressive. This may be due to nobody trying to pick them up or show them affection.

entry: 它的锚断了，还翻了个方向，让它看起来永远皱着眉、一脸不快。
author: .towerxvi
source: Its anchor has broken off and flipped upside down, making it look caught in a perpetual frown.

entry: 它仍惦记着太阳珊瑚的枝条，可没了牙，想吃也吃不下，导致有些POKENAME群体营养不良。
author: typhloquil
source: While it still craves Corsola branches, it struggles to consume them without any teeth. Due to this, some populations of POKENAME are malnourished.

entry: POKENAME对来船格外热情，总要探出水面，看船经过，结果却常常挡在航路上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are incredibly enthusiastic about approaching boats. They pop out of the water to watch them pass by, but often end up in the way instead.

entry: POKENAME聚在废弃渔船底下，散发腐烂鱼肉般的恶臭气体。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME gather on the undersides of abandoned fishing boats. They emanate a putrid gas, akin to rotten fish.

entry: POKENAME在海底搜寻残食，用爪状的鳍吸引伴侣，遇敌则摆尾扬起沙子，趁乱脱身。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME scavenge food off the seafloor. They use their claw fins to attract mates, and their tails to stir up sand on the seafloor to evade enemies.

entry: POKENAME重得再也离不开地面，只能整天靠吃排解悲伤，望着心中辽阔的天空，默默流泪。
author: Kecleonfan352
source: Having grown far too heavy to get off the ground, POKENAME spends its days eating its feelings away, dreaming about the open sky and weeping silently.

entry: 很长一段时间里，证明它存在的，只有杂志上的一张照片。那模样，倒真令人过目不忘。
author: barthandelus_real
source: For the longest period of time, the only proof of this Pokémon's existence was a single photograph in a magazine. It is quite striking.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞甲外壳。可明明没翅膀，这种融合体究竟怎么飞，谁也解释不清。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it does not have any wings.

entry: POKENAME的长腿，比看上去有力得多，一脚便能把巨金怪这样沉重的宝可梦踢飞。
author: Lyrebird.Rainwing
source: POKENAME's long legs are deceptively strong, able to send heavy Pokémon like Metagross flying with a single kick.

entry: 别看个头如此，它找蘑菇时，挖起土来一点不含糊。唯有最肥壮的POKENAME，才能进化。
author: mx_wellman
source: Despite its size, it digs voraciously in search for mushrooms. Only the most plump of POKENAME manage to evolve.

entry: 这副奇怪的齿轮组合，能将自身零件猛射出去，力道足以轻易击碎头骨。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This strange gear assembly launches its components at a force that can easily crack a skull.

entry: POKENAME不停吃煤炭或泥土，再在体内燃烧，驱动自己，时速最高可达35英里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME constantly eats coal or soil, which it burns in its body to power itself. It can reach speeds of up to 35 mph.

entry: 这只结实的宝可梦，前进与后退一样快。POKENAME靠后鳍或齿轮推进，便能做到。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This resistant Pokémon can move forwards and backwards at the same speed. To do so, POKENAME uses its back fins or its cogwheel as propulsion.

entry: POKENAME能用心灵感应预判敌人的攻势。感受到对手越凶悍，自己的决心便越坚定。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's telepathy allows it to predict its foes' attacks in battle. Its determination increases to meet the aggression it senses in its opponents.

entry: 一个个齿轮旋转生能，再经头顶天线，将能量转化为磁波。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The individual gears rotate and generate energy, which is converted into magnetic waves via the antenna on the head.

entry: POKENAME住在工厂与发电厂附近，常能看见它吸收烟囱排出的二氧化碳。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives near factories and power plants. It can be seen absorbing carbon dioxide from the smokestacks.

entry: 机械化改造，让POKENAME的力量大增，甚至能看清200英尺外的目标！
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME's strength has been significantly improved thanks to its cybernetics and can see targets from up to 200ft away!

entry: POKENAME转动带齿的刀刃，撕开受害者的身体，再通过铁臂吸收矿物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's blades rotate to rip into the body of of its victims with their teeth. It absorbs minerals through its iron arm.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮，能让剑刃不断振动，切入受害者体内。夺来的生命力，则为它持续供能。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's gears cause its blade to vibrate, cutting into the body of its victims. It is continuously powered by the life force it harvests.

entry: 它吸收猎物血中的铁，疗伤、补强身体，又把残渣留在压板上，引诱下一只猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It absorbs the iron in the blood of its prey to heal and add onto itself while leaving scraps on its pressure plate to attract its next prey.

entry: 齿轮就像发条马达，POKENAME转得越久，随后朝前疾冲的速度便越快。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its gears work like a wind-up motor. The longer POKENAME rotates it, the faster it can whizz off in one direction.

entry: 这只漫无目的的钻头宝可梦，不断开挖地面，吸收其中的矿藏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This aimless drill Pokémon absorbs mineral deposits in the ground it mines.

entry: 成群的POKENAME能彼此协调，共同完成平整地形之类的工作。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As a group, POKENAME can coordinate with each other to perform tasks like flattening terrain.

entry: POKENAME很受马戏团欢迎。吞火艺人与杂技演员骑在它身上，借失控的火焰表演惊险特技。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is popular in circus performances, where fire eaters or acrobats ride on it and perform dangerous stunts featuring its uncontrolled fire.

entry: 研究人员已经证实，POKENAME不断让一个无形磁场，绕自身轴线旋转，借此保护自己。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Researchers were able to prove that POKENAME constantly rotates an invisible magnetic field around its own axis, which it uses to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME用下方的齿轮，激发自身产生的磁场。即使一片漆黑，也能准确辨认方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses the gear on its underside to stimulate its self-generated magnetic field, with which it can orient itself even in absolute darkness.

entry: POKENAME能将几颗头嵌在一起，飞快旋转。这本是护身的办法，有些人却借此发电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can interlock its heads and then make them rotate rapidly. This protective mechanism is exploited by some to generate energy.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 好几个掠夺者，曾想夺走组合体中央的能量核心，结果都遭到致命伤害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Multiple looters who've attempted to take the energy core component at the center of its assembly have been fatally wounded.

entry: POKENAME用赖以运转的油液，在地面上滑行。可人类改用可再生能源后，它们的数量也日益减少。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the oil it runs on to slide along the ground. However, because of the shift to renewable energy, their numbers have dwindled.

entry: 这只生命力顽强的水宝可梦，几乎什么液体都能游。化粪池、污水池，甚至核污染的水域，都是POKENAME的住处。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This resistant Water type Pokémon can swim in any liquid. POKENAME´s habitat is in septic tanks, sewage pools and even nuclear-contaminated waters.

entry: 坚硬的玻璃，保护着内部马达。POKENAME借马达不断产生能量，再将其转化为磁波。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The motor on the inside is protected by hard glass. POKENAME constantly generates energy via this motor, which it can convert into magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME觉得自己陷在不断昏厥、苏醒的循环里，永无尽头。它会把附近的齿轮雷朵，当作训练家般保护。
author: TokenOracle
source: POKENAME considers itself trapped in a never-ending spiral of faints and revives. It chooses to protect any nearby Klalade as if they were a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME既是振动利刃，也是战斗电锯，能高效取走受害者体内的铁与生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME functions both as a vibrating blade and combat chainsaw. It effectively harvests iron and life force from its victims.

entry: 压板上的能量核心，让POKENAME能电击踩上来的目标，使它们更难逃脱。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The energy core on its pressure plate allows POKENAME to shock whatever steps on it to reduce their chance of escape.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 巨大的钻头与能量核心运转，便会引起明显的地面震动。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It causes noticeable ground tremors with its large drill and energy core.

entry: 这三个家伙齐力采矿，已经触发过好几次地震预警。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This trio mining in unison has triggered several earthquake warning systems.

entry: 它高速转动下方的齿轮，在空中飞行。身体分泌的油脂，能确保齿轮不会卡住。
author: gronkissimo
source: It flies around by rotating the gear underneath it at high speeds. Its body secretes a grease that ensures the gears never get stuck.

entry: POKENAME疾驰时，喷出滚烫蒸汽，点燃身后的大地。蒸汽声与踏地的回响，听来宛如火车头。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME gallops, it emits boiling steam that ignites the landscape behind it. This and the echoing of its steps sound like a locomotive.

entry: POKENAME的头始终顺时针旋转，双腿的弹簧，则能让它跃上十多米高的半空。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME´s head rotates continuously in a clockwise direction. The springs on its legs enable it to jump over ten meters into the air.

entry: 它用神秘的幻术，休息时装成一堆落叶。一察觉危险，便畏缩着，抖得厉害。
author: .izik
source: Using a mysterious illusion-based ability, it pretends to be a pile of leaves while resting. It will cower and shake violently if it senses danger.

entry: 它能让头上的花，看起来像普通玫瑰，便常藏进灌木，诱人伸手采摘，开个恶作剧。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: It can transform its head flowers into normal looking roses. It likes to hide in bushes and do this to prank people into picking them.

entry: POKENAME为躲避冲突，常伪装成普通物品。只有脆弱的猎物落单时，才会出手伏击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME disguises itself as ordinary objects to avoid conflict. It only ambushes vulnerable prey when they are alone.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴里放出气体。吸入者便会看见幻象，将POKENAME当成它想扮演的任何人或宝可梦。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can release gas from its mouth. This gas can make anyone who breathes it hallucinate POKENAME as any Pokémon or person it wants.

entry: POKENAME是天生的窃贼，深夜闯进商店与民宅，偷走贵重物品。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are natural-born thieves. They invade shops and homes late at night to steal valuables.

entry: POKENAME是天生的窃贼，深夜闯进商店与民宅，偷走贵重物品。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are natural-born thieves. They invade shops and homes late at night to steal valuables.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，含有易燃毒液。POKENAME既能从尖刺放毒自保，也能点燃毒液进攻。
author: Raza
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back contains a flammable toxin. POKENAME can release the toxin from the spikes for defense or ignite it for attacks.

entry: POKENAME的种子能分泌溶解金属的强烈腐蚀性酸液。这种酸液，也是尾焰燃烧的燃料。
author: Benevolent
source: The bulb of a POKENAME is capable of producing a corrosive acid that can dissolve metal. This acid is the fuel for the flame on its tail.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，能抵御火焰。许多厨师烹饪时，都会穿上这种丝做的围裙。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME produce a flame-resistant silk. Many chefs wear aprons made from this material when cooking.

entry: 古时候，人们将POKENAME当作活灯笼。历史上许多火灾，据说都与遭受虐待的POKENAME有关。
author: Staghorn
source: In ancient times, humans used POKENAME as living lanterns. Many historical fires are thought to be caused by mistreated POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的耐心，比牙签还短。再加上强壮的体格，至今没有斗牛士能赢过它。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME's temper is about as short as a toothpick. Because of this, in addition to its physique, no matador has ever bested it.

entry: 采来的花粉，被它的高体温引燃。鳞片将热量导向两根锋利毒刺，温度能超过摄氏415度。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The pollen it harvests combusts from its high body heat. Its scales disperse the heat to two razor-sharp stingers, reaching over 415 degrees Celsius.

entry: POKENAME的叶片从叶尖一直烧到根部时，就说明它要进化了。脖子上的花苞，会散发出干花香料般的怡人香气。
author: Volvonovic
source: When a POKENAME's leaf burns down to its root, it is ready to evolve. The bulbs on its neck emit a pleasant aroma reminiscent of potpourri.

entry: 飞云市的珠宝商，会请好几只POKENAME一起熔炼贵金属。借POKENAME火焰做出的项链，十分抢手。
author: .izik
source: Jewelers in Castelia City will employ multiple POKENAME to work on melting precious metals. Necklaces made by a POKENAME's flame are in high demand.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: Soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: 这只宝可梦的身体是有生命的火焰。下雨时，便靠宝石里储存的太阳能维持自身。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's body is made of living fire. It uses the solar energy stored in its gems to preserve itself when it becomes rainy.

entry: 下方燃烧的火焰，显露着它超能力的潜能。有训练家说，曾见那火在星光下变成蓝色。
author: fixthewifi
source: The flame that burns underneath it is an indication of the potential of its psychic energy. Trainers have claimed to see it burn blue under starlight.

entry: POKENAME在一英里外，就能听见肚子咕咕叫。厨艺虽然才起步，每一餐却都满怀心意。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME can hear a rumbling stomach from a mile away. It's only just learning to cook, but every meal is made with love.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME通常爱吵爱闹，玩起来没轻没重，一不留神，帽子就会点着周围的东西。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are usually rowdy when they're younger. They often play without care, and when that happens, their hat can set things on fire.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，性情极为害羞，逮着机会就把脸藏起来，宁可安静待在暗处。
author: krsgaming
source: POKENAME tend to be alone. It is extremely shy and will try to hide its face at any chance possible. It prefers to stay quiet in the dark.

entry: POKENAME能从热量中汲取大量能量，却又怕身体干掉，便爱在温泉边的泥里玩耍，保持湿润。
author: Shocktopus
source: POKENAME gets lots of energy from heat, but must be careful not to dry out. To deal with this, it plays in the mud near hot springs.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: Soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: 尾尖的火焰，为背上的花提供了光源。可光照太多，叶片反而已经泛黄。
author: Soup1900
source: The flame that's on the tip of its tail gives it its own source of light for its flower. Its leaves have yellowed due to too much exposure to light.

entry: POKENAME常把树果和肉烤过再吃。若火焰颜色古怪，多半与它吃了什么有关。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often roast Berries and meat before eating them. If their flames are an odd color, it is most likely due to their diet.

entry: POKENAME借尾焰调节体温。潜水时，会用气泡包住火焰，免得熄灭。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses the flame on its tail to regulate its body temperature. During dives, it envelops it in an air bubble to prevent it from going out.

entry: 不论外界多冷，它都能把绒羽加热到140度以上。滑过雪地时，身后便留下一道冒着蒸汽的痕迹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can heat its down to over 140 degrees, regardless of outside temperatures. As it glides over the snow, it leaves a steaming trail in its wake.

entry: 这把附有幽灵的镐，击中金属或血肉，便能将其瞬间烧至赤热。它游荡矿中，只有采掘时遭到打扰，才会发动攻击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: On impact, this haunted pick instantly turns metal or flesh red hot. It wanders mines and only attacks if disturbed while mining.

entry: 它身体始终炽热，会砍下树木的一部分，供腹中的火焰燃烧。
author: .izik
source: Its body remains hot at all times. It will chop off portions of trees so that it can feed the burning flame in its stomach.

entry: 它又被称为“火焰剑士”。据说，POKENAME的剑臂中，沉睡着足以毁灭万物的龙之力量。
author: nvisionluminous
source: It is also known as "The Flame Swordsman". It's said that within POKENAME's blade arm sleeps the power of a dragon that will destroy all.

entry: 这个顽皮伙伴，走到哪里都留下焦痕。POKENAME既宝贝自己的尾焰，也会拼命保护同伴。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: A playful companion that leaves burn marks wherever it goes. POKENAME is very protective of its companions and the flame on its tail.

entry: 心情越好，这只宝可梦摸起来就越温暖。它常想扑进信任的训练家怀里，亲昵一会儿。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The happier this Pokémon is, the warmer its body feels to the touch. It often seeks to cuddle with a trusted Trainer.

entry: 它走到哪里，哪里便落满极易燃烧的毛发。饲养这只宝可梦的训练家，必须先上消防安全课。
author: CapWolfBane
source: It sheds incredibly flammable fur on just about any surface. Trainers of this Pokémon are required to take a fire safety course.

entry: 它的双手烫得碰不得，产生的孢子，却能当作辛辣菜肴的调味料。
author: .izik
source: Its hands are hot to the touch. The spores it creates can be used as a seasoning for spicy dishes.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧得过了头。据古代记载，它们甚至曾为了取乐，烧毁整座村庄。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are greatly mischievous. It is recorded that in ancient times, they would burn down villages for fun.

entry: POKENAME一心想把装扮做得逼真，连真火也用上了。可惜，布料实在经不起这一套。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME tries to make its costume as authentic as possible, including using real fire. Unfortunately, cloth doesn't mix well with that.

entry: 在关都，人们常让孩子通过照顾POKENAME，学习饲养宝可梦的基础。不过，为安全起见，最好让它离地毯远点。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: In Kanto, POKENAME is mostly used to teach young children the ropes of Pokémon care. Keep it away from carpets for your own safety.

entry: 它们常成群嬉戏，诙谐又爱闹，总喜欢捉弄路过的旅人。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Often found playing in packs, these humorous creatures have been known to prank travelers passing by.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合后，原本隐性的龙类等位基因，便会转为显性。它性情凶悍，尾焰也极难扑灭。
author: AtomicDiamond
source: Recessive, dragon-like alleles become dominant when two POKENAME are fused. It tends to have a fierce nature, and its tail is difficult to extinguish.

entry: POKENAME头顶的火焰花，并不太烫。可中央粗大的茎，却能喷出滚烫、剧毒的物质。
author: char_latte3412
source: The flower of flame that burns atop POKENAME's head isn't very hot. However, the large stem in the middle can project flaming-hot noxious toxins.

entry: 如今火焰已变得炽热无比，尾巴上的火无论泼多少水也无法熄灭。
author: Soup1900
source: Its flames have now become ultra hot. No amount of water can put out the flame on its tail.

entry: 它的外表变得更加暗沉，口中也冒出火焰。卡洛斯的专家认为，它与超级喷火龙X有相似之处。
author: Soup1900
source: It has taken on a darker appearance, and flames come out of its mouth. Kalos experts claim it has similarities with Mega Charizard X.

entry: 它性情相当平和，除非迫不得已，不会凶狠地进攻。面对强敌时，反而会有点害怕。
author: Soup1900
source: It is a pretty calm Pokémon and won't viciously attack unless absolutely necessary. It becomes slightly afraid when facing tough opponents.

entry: 它个头虽大，架子也不小，战斗本领却顶多中等。越接近进化，虚荣心也越发难掩。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though large in size and boisterous in ego, its battling capabilities are middling at best. Its vanity simmers as it nears evolution.

entry: POKENAME能暂时熄灭尾焰，入水游泳。想找到POKENAME，不妨留意水温异常暖和的溪流。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can temporarily extinguish the flame on its tail to swim. To find a POKENAME, look for streams with unusually warm water.

entry: 尾焰燃起，它借此引导超能力。曾经安详，如今却怀着炽热决心奋战。
author: anarchaz
source: With its tail aflame, it channels psychic power. Once serene, now it battles with fiery determination.

entry: 橙色羽毛下面，藏着平时难见的小手臂。到了夜里，可凭那点光，认出田野中奔跑的POKENAME。
author: .izik
source: While usually not visible, it has tiny arms beneath its orange feathers. At night you can identify POKENAME running through the fields by their glow.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，小小的橙色羽毛一路飘落。奇怪的是，身体再热，羽毛摸着也依然清凉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has small orange feathers that litter the landscape as it runs. These feathers stay surprisingly cool regardless of how hot its body gets.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上的炮管喷火，射出的小火球，会飞出10英尺才炸开。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME expels flames from the cannons on its shell. It can shoot small fireballs that travel for a distance of 10 feet before they explode.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会喷出蒸汽，可烫伤人的威力不强，顶多只会刺痛一阵。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME shoots steam from its cannons. However, the steam doesn't burn much, and at most it'll sting for a while.

entry: 华美的外貌，让它常被请去唱歌、跳舞，可至今竟没留下表演评价。失眠的人，倒很喜欢它。
author: HoundRyS
source: Due to its luxurious look, it's often employed as a singer and dancer, but no reviews exist of its performance. It's popular among insomniacs.

entry: POKENAME虽有大力，却全无恶意，善良中带点淘气。常趁路人不防备，顺走帽子玩一玩。
author: chiari_queen
source: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.

entry: POKENAME爱躺在草地或沙上，长久地晒太阳，也会这么静静等着，盼人温柔摸摸头。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.

entry: POKENAME爱躺在草地或沙上，长久地晒太阳，也会这么静静等着，盼人温柔摸摸头。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.

entry: POKENAME虽有大力，却全无恶意，善良中带点淘气。常趁路人不防备，顺走帽子玩一玩。
author: chiari_queen
source: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.

entry: 满月之夜，它模仿人类的声音，诱人走出家门。循声出门的人，从此再也没有回来。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, it mimics human speech to lure people out of their homes at night. Those who venture out are never seen again.

entry: 关都的一些商店照着POKENAME的模样制作甜点，想与名气响亮的飞云冰淇淋竞争，效果却不怎么好。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Some stores in Kanto have made confections based on POKENAME to try to compete with the vaunted Casteliacone, to little success.

entry: 它很想吓住对手，可钳子太软，夹着也不怎么痛，总让POKENAME懊恼不已。
author: fountainihili
source: It tries to be intimidating, but its pincers are too soft and squishy to hurt opponents that much. This frustrates POKENAME to no end.

entry: POKENAME先用欢快的举止迷住对手，再猛然打出出乎意料的重击。它既是可爱的伙伴，也是强悍的守护者。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME charms foes with its jovial demeanor before striking with unexpected force. It is both a beloved companion and a formidable guardian.

entry: POKENAME用凝视赶走天敌。若不眨眼、不退缩的表情还不够，就突然尖叫一声，刺得对方耳朵生疼。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME drive off predators by staring. If its unblinking, unflinching expression isn't enough, a sudden ear-piercing screech does the job.

entry: POKENAME眼睛大，耳朵也大，各个方向的危险，都能察觉。身体虽庞大，分量却出奇地轻。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME's wide eyes and huge ears allow it to detect danger from all angles. It is surprisingly light-weight for its large size.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME满怀爱意地追着路卡王之类的宝可梦，以红黄相间的巨锤作为武器。
author: hypernovahusky
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly chasing Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME亲昵地陪在路卡王之类的宝可梦身边，以红黄相间的巨锤作为武器。
author: hypernovahusky
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly accompanying Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: Cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: 这只宝可梦性情平和。POKENAME收集的果实，会吸引各类宝可梦，尤其是飞行宝可梦。
author: Gayschlatt
source: A peaceful Pokémon. The fruit that POKENAME collects attracts a variety of Pokémon, particularly Flying type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: Cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: Cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME只用飘带上柔软的毛轻轻拂过，便能安抚人类与宝可梦。它还能把刀刃鼓得奇大无比。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can calm people and Pokémon just by brushing them with their ribbon's soft fur. It can also inflate their blade to a ridiculous size.

entry: 闪烁的鳞片，像宝石一样映着光。它温柔优雅，以水流般的怀抱，护着幼崽。
author: anarchaz
source: Its shimmering scales reflect light like precious jewels. Gentle and graceful, it cradles its young in a watery embrace.

entry: 毛发丰厚蓬松，手感好得让人忍不住想摸。抱着POKENAME，也被用来帮助失眠的人入睡。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its rich, fluffy fur feels so good to touch that people find it difficult not to touch it. Cuddling POKENAME is used to help insomnia patients.

entry: 野外，两颗头会轮流睡觉，留一颗警戒。可在信任的训练家身边，双头便能一起安心入眠。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: In the wild, one head will stay awake while the other sleeps. However. in the company of a trusted Trainer, both heads will sleep peacefully.

entry: 舞姿道馆的对战中，常能看见POKENAME。它们花样繁多，又很爱炫耀。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often found in Gym battles at the Ballonlea gym. They know numerous tricks and like to show off.

entry: 这只宝可梦十分慷慨，乐意分享背上结出的完美苹果。摘下一颗，新苹果很快又会长出来。
author: .realthree
source: This generous Pokémon loves sharing the perfect apples that grow on its back. New apples quickly grow back after the old ones are picked.

entry: 它的声带已经能够正常发声。探索洞穴时，若听见婴儿哭泣，可别急着循声而去。
author: .izik
source: Its vocal cords are fully operational. If you hear a baby crying while exploring a cave, think twice before following the sound.

entry: 它的喵叫声各有特色。每只POKENAME的音调、音高与长短，都不尽相同，有时差别还大得惊人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its meowing sounds are unique. This is because each POKENAME has its own pitch, height and tone length, which can vary greatly in some cases.

entry: POKENAME能把身体各部位鼓到平常的许多倍。马戏团很欢迎它，孩子们尤其喜欢。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can puff up each of its body parts to many times their normal size. It is a popular circus attraction and especially popular with children.

entry: POKENAME是很好的伙伴，尤其适合常为压力所困的人。研究也发现，轻抚它的毛发，有疗愈身心的效果。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME makes for a favorable companion, especially for frequently stressed individuals. Touching its fur has been shown to have therapeutic effects.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的生物，真正见过的人，即使有，也寥寥无几。据说，它的鬃毛，尝起来、摸起来，都像棉花糖。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME is a mythical creature that few people, if any, have ever seen. Its mane is said to have the taste and texture of cotton candy.

entry: POKENAME把人含进嘴里，其实是想表达亲近，可常被误会成要吞食对方。似乎没有什么，能终结它的痛苦。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME shows affection by putting someone in its mouth, which can be misunderstood as devouring. Seemingly, nothing can end its pain and suffering.

entry: POKENAME天生善于喷水，嗓子疼时，也能借这本领含水漱喉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.

entry: POKENAME常陪着医院里的护士。先哄病人入睡，再唱一支治愈之歌，据说什么病都能治好。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.

entry: POKENAME常陪着医院里的护士。先哄病人入睡，再唱一支治愈之歌，据说什么病都能治好。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.

entry: POKENAME天生善于喷水，嗓子疼时，也能借这本领含水漱喉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: 只要发现空着的泥土，它就吐下各种古怪种子。种子来历不明，却能长成许多不同植物。
author: .izik
source: It spits an odd assortment of seeds on any empty soil it finds. The seeds are from an unknown source and can become many different plants.

entry: 触角上落下的粉末，可用来制作烧伤药膏。闻起来，像靛莓果与白球果混在一起。
author: .izik
source: The dust from its antennae is used in salves for burns. Its smell resembles a combination of Belue Berries and White Apricorns.

entry: 野生鸟宝可梦，很容易就能捕到POKENAME。能活着等到进化，它们已算幸运。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.

entry: 野生鸟宝可梦，很容易就能捕到POKENAME。能活着等到进化，它们已算幸运。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.

entry: 身上的植物覆着一层光滑薄膜，能防止燃烧。可刚出生的POKENAME，还没长出这层防护，常会因此出意外。
author: typhloquil
source: The plant life on its body has a sleek coating to prevent it from burning. Newborn POKENAME do not have this coating, however, leading to accidents.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME飞上树梢晒太阳。晒过之后，又互相啄起来，想吃对方的种子。
author: kiwikelly
source: In the morning, POKENAME flies to the tree tops to bask in the sun. After that, POKENAME peck each other to try to eat each other's seeds.

entry: POKENAME潜行灌木，搜寻根茎与坚果。带回洞里的种子，常还没来得及吃，就已经长成树。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME slinks through the underbrush in search of roots and nuts. The seeds it brings to its burrow often turn into trees before they're eaten.

entry: 它扎起大束野花，想给陌生人一个惊喜。可花粉一飘散，常让对方喷嚏打个不停。
author: .izik
source: It creates large bouquets of wildflowers so that it can surprise strangers. The pollen from these flowers can cause sneezing fits.

entry: POKENAME会滚到日照最充足的地方。若碰到覆身的孢子，便有毒橡树般的灼热刺痛。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME rolls to where the sun is brightest. Touching its coating of spores elicits a burning feeling similar to poison oak.

entry: 一靠近它头上鲜艳的短笺，就会心生莫名恐惧。可人们相信，若能偷到一张，心愿便能实现。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Nearing the vibrant tags on its head instills an eerie sense of dread. It's believed that your wish will come true if you can manage to steal one.

entry: 它偏爱枫树落下的叶子。叶片褐得越深，POKENAME便越喜欢。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to eat leaves that have fallen off of maple trees. The darker brown the leaf is, the more desirable it is to a POKENAME.

entry: 它痴迷黄金，连花也偏爱黄色。巢里因此常堆着向日葵、蒲公英与水仙。
author: .izik
source: It seeks out yellow flowers due to its affinity for gold. Due to this, its den is usually filled with sunflowers, dandelions and daffodils.

entry: POKENAME对温度十分敏感。一到冬天，便潜入湖底，等到又能享受夏日阳光，才肯出来。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to temperature. When winter comes, it dives beneath the surface of a lake until it can enjoy the summer sun again.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地锻炼身体，梦想有朝一日也能像心中崇拜的冠军一样。
author: Mister J
source: POKENAME train their bodies relentlessly. Their dreams are to become like the champions they idolize so much.

entry: 连赢几场后，POKENAME便成了格斗赛事中的新星。到了这个阶段，含羞力们，都会仰慕它。
author: Mister J
source: POKENAME, after winning several fights, become rising stars among fighting tournaments. Buchop look up to them at this stage.

entry: POKENAME用熏香安抚其他宝可梦。待对方平静，就打开花苞，把愉快的情绪吸进去。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME uses the aroma of their incense to calm other Pokémon. Once this is done, they open their bud and absorb their positive emotions with it.

entry: 它从翅膀撒出花粉，干扰敌人。受到善良训练家照料的POKENAME，双翼色彩更鲜艳，香气也更芬芳。
author: kittyluv090
source: It distracts enemies by scattering pollen from its wings. The wings of POKENAME who are raised by kind Trainers are more vibrant and aromatic.

entry: POKENAME的第二颗头，长成了一朵美丽的花。大家总被花吸引，让原来的头，常觉得自己遭到冷落。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME's second head has taken the form of a beautiful flower. This flower gets most of the attention and the main head often feels ignored.

entry: 它天性不服输，遇敌先亮出玫瑰大钳，试着吓退对方。若没用，就从钳中高速射出尖刺。
author: leeto64
source: Sassy by nature, it will try to intimidate any aggressor by flaunting its rose-pincers.  If that fails, it'll fire thorns from them at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME深受舞台魔术师喜爱，能从任意物件中突然钻出，让观众惊叹。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are favored by stage magicians. It can pop out through any object and audience members are amazed.

entry: 谁碰到POKENAME撒出的花粉，它就能感知谁的情绪，即使远在几英里之外，也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.

entry: 谁碰到POKENAME撒出的花粉，它就能感知谁的情绪，即使远在几英里之外，也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.

entry: POKENAME的模样，会随生活地点与最爱的花改变。有人推测，它会把孢子放进旧齿轮里，繁殖后代。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME can have different appearances based on location and favorite flower. Some theorize this Pokémon reproduces by putting spores in old gears.

entry: 接连的称赞与惊人连胜，让POKENAME自大得不得了。名气最盛时，甚至觉得自己天下无敌，谁也动不得。
author: Mister J
source: Inflated by constant praise and astounding win streaks, POKENAME boast incredible egos. At the height of their fame, they believe they're untouchable.

entry: POKENAME很有魅力，凭俊美外表逗同伴开心，也让敌人心神不宁。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME is quite the charmer. It uses its good looks to amuse allies and unsettle enemies.

entry: 它利用垃圾腐烂产生的气体，推动自己飞行。若气球破了，气体便另找新气球，让POKENAME重生。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It propels itself through the air using gas collected from decomposing garbage. If it bursts, the gas finds a new balloon and POKENAME is reborn.

entry: POKENAME像飘飘球一样，爱把孩子带走。可它是带孩子去儿童免餐费的餐厅，骗来免费的饭，喂饱自己。
author: Llamawiz34
source: Just like Drifloon, POKENAME likes to take children away. It carries them to kids-eat-free restaurants to trick them into giving it free food.

entry: 它们结队协作，搜猎迷失的灵魂。为确认同伴位置，会发出唯有彼此听得见的幽冥长嚎。
author: ariamelisma
source: They hunt for lost souls in coordinated packs. To keep tabs on each other, they let out spectral howls that only they can hear.

entry: 黎明前的一小时，常能听见它满怀深切哀愁的长嚎。听过的人，无不为之动容。
author: ariamelisma
source: Its howls filled with profound melancholy can be heard in the hour before dawn. Those who do hear it find themselves deeply moved.

entry: 偶尔，能在远离日常栖息地的地方，见到漂浮的POKENAME。那些思乡的POKENAME，会一直哭，直到与家人团聚。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are sometimes found floating in areas far from their usual habitat. Those homesick POKENAME cry until they're reunited with their families.

entry: 身体慢慢石化，变得越来越沉。想飞起来，就得耗去极大的能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body slowly petrifies, making it progressively heavier and only able to fly by expending a great deal of energy.

entry: POKENAME的外形很受孩子喜爱，它会利用这一点绑架孩子。被人抓住时，它会像真正的剑一样反击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: NAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.

entry: POKENAME的外形很受孩子喜爱，它会利用这一点绑架孩子。被人抓住时，它会像真正的剑一样反击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: NAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.

entry: 传闻POKENAME寄宿着一个逝去家庭的灵魂。双头是父母，下半身中则是孩子们的灵魂。
author: kittyluv090
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME holds the souls of a lost family. The two heads are the parents' spirits, while the lower body holds the childrens'.

entry: 它用胡须般的触角当手臂，让轻飘飘的身体不至于被强风吹走。
author: mx_wellman
source: This floaty Pokémon uses its whisker-like antennae as arms, stopping itself from blowing away in strong winds.

entry: 它优雅地飘在空中，齿轮却越转越快，噪音杂乱刺耳，足以让小型鸟宝可梦丧命。
author: kandyman
source: As it gracefully floats through the sky, the gears spin increasingly fast. The resulting noise is a cacophonous mess that can kill small bird Pokémon.

entry: 它们成大群掠过夜空。一旦受到攻击，整群便会围住袭击者，将其挟走。被带走的家伙，从此再也不见踪影。
author: Staghorn
source: Name fly through the night sky in huge flocks. If attacked, the flock will surround the assailant and carry them off, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME好奇、友善，通常也没什么危险。可它真正从何而来，却流传着许多骇人的都市传说。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are curious, friendly, and often harmless. Despite this, there are many grisly urban legends surrounding its true origins.

entry: POKENAME下半身的绒毛，会吸去声响，让它悄无声息地移动。可若想不被看见，它就没那么在行了。
author: strawbearycandy
source: The fluff surrounding POKENAME's lower half acts as a sound-dampener, allowing it to move about unheard. It is much less skilled at staying unseen.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就竖起耳朵。觅食时，会搜遍广大的区域。
author: The_Fireplace
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it perks up its ears. It searches wide areas for food.

entry: POKENAME胆小又易惊，很难亲近。通常同一时间只肯信任一个人。
author: kittyluv090
source: Very skittish and easily startled, POKENAME is not easy to befriend. They tend to only trust one person at a time.

entry: 满怀嫉妒的谜拟Ｑ与卷卷耳融合，便形成了POKENAME。若得不到关爱，POKENAME就会换掉耳朵上的棉絮。
author: bobosmith01
source: When an envious Mimikyu fused with Buneary, it created POKENAME. If POKENAME does not receive affection, it will replace the cotton on its ears.

entry: POKENAME把宝石藏在浓毛里，对毛绒玩具也有奇怪的喜爱。科学家说，第三只耳朵来自基因突变。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hides gems in its thick fur. It also has a strange affinity for plush toys. Scientists say its third ear is caused by a genetic mutation.

entry: 它在野胡萝卜丛里安家。太阳升起时，便发出门铃般的啁啾。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in patches of wild carrots. During sunrise, it will make a chirp reminiscent of a doorbell.

entry: 孩子常把POKENAME当成毛绒玩具。它似乎很享受，这样得来的关注。
author: pokebio
source: Children often mistake POKENAME for a plush toy. It seems to enjoy the attention it gets this way.

entry: POKENAME外表甜美，却颇为记仇。复仇时，强健的后腿，能让暗藏的利爪，挥出更凶的一击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME looks sweet, but it has a vindictive streak. Its strong back legs increase the slashing power of its hidden claws when it takes its revenge.

entry: POKENAME先滚动身体，再用有力的耳朵弹射出去。因此，经过陡坡与峭壁的登山者必须格外小心。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME travels by rolling, then launching itself using its powerful ears. For this reason, hikers must be cautious around steep hills and cliffs.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会脱落部分绒毛。绒毛略带黏性，能附在大多数物体表面。
author: .izik
source: Should it be startled, POKENAME will shed portions of its fluff. The fluff itself has a mild adhesive and sticks to most surfaces.

entry: POKENAME落下的粉末，过去曾被用于烹调。直到科学家发现剧毒，才终于停用。
author: .izik
source: The powder that comes off of a POKENAME was once used in cooking. This stopped when scientists found out that it was extremely poisonous.

entry: POKENAME将孢子撒遍河流与沼泽，因此，它栖息的地方，附近很少有其他宝可梦生活。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME scatters spores all over rivers and swamps. As a result, not many Pokémon live near its habitat.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，享用湿润的腐殖土。丰富养分，让背上的地星菌长得硕大、健康。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.

entry: 一旦被发现，POKENAME就先盯着来者看一会儿，然后拔腿逃走。这习性，让研究十分难做。
author: 8xviktor
source: After being spotted, POKENAME stares at whatever found it briefly and then proceeds to run away. This behavior makes studying it very difficult.

entry: 这种蘑菇宝可梦长出了獠牙般的钳子，用来挖掘自己的主要食物——其他蘑菇。
author: mx_wellman
source: This mushroom Pokémon has developed a form of tusk-pincers in order to dig up its main food source: other mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，享用湿润的腐殖土。丰富养分，让背上的地星菌长得硕大、健康。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.

entry: 身上的蘑菇长得飞快。一旦长得太长，就会进化成斗笠种子，蘑菇也随之截断。
author: .ssunday.
source: Its mushroom grows at a rapid rate. Once the mushroom grows too long, it evolves into Bresaur and the mushroom gets cut.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞地沿古老林间小径前行，寻找富含养分的落叶。似乎什么事，都扰不乱它的步调。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME plods along ancient forest trails, searching for nutrient-rich leaf litter. Nothing seems to phase it.

entry: POKENAME几乎在哪儿都能吸收养分，生命力顽强，因此到处都有可能见到，只是森林里最多。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME can absorb nutrients from nearly any environment. Due to this hardiness, they can be found almost anywhere, though most commonly in forests.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇，可不像引梦貘人的摆锤。让人昏昏欲睡的，其实是蘑菇摇动时撒出的孢子。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME's mushroom does not function in the same manner as Hypno's pendulum. Instead, the spores it emits when swung induce sleepiness.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会收集暗能量，聚在幽灵身体之中。它们住在屋顶，专爱吓唬人类和其他宝可梦。
author: mrbapcik
source: When POKENAME fly, they gather dark energy, which gathers in their spectral body. POKENAME live on rooftops, scaring people and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME已经学会模仿怨影娃娃的外貌与举止，既能骗过猎物，也能蒙混天敌。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME has adapted to mimic the behavior and appearance of Shuppet, which it uses to fool both prey and predator alike.

entry: 它把怀恨的灵魂，收进楔石。古老传说里，有人曾把灵魂卖给POKENAME，只求向别人复仇。
author: cait_sith
source: It collects vengeful souls in its keystone. Some old legends tell of people who sold their souls to POKENAME to get revenge on others.

entry: POKENAME以针对某个人的复仇之情为食。吃饱之后，便找到那个人，真正付诸报复。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME feeds on feelings of vengeance against specific people. When it is full, it finds and acts out that revenge on that person.

entry: POKENAME用歌声哄人沉沉入睡，再趁机享用他们烦扰不安的梦。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: A POKENAME uses its song to lull people into a deep sleep. It then uses this opportunity to feast on their upsetting dreams.

entry: POKENAME单独一只时很弱，聚在一起却很聪明。合众之智，足以比得上人类小孩。
author: clawshdi
source: Though feeble on their own, POKENAME are clever when in numbers. Together they have the intelligence of a human child.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: 凝胶渗入壳中，让表面变得坚硬，却也很脆。即使轻易开裂，里面的凝胶仍会把碎壳黏牢。
author: germs2128
source: Its shell becomes infused with gel, creating a firm but brittle surface. It is easily susceptible to cracking, but its inner gel holds it in place.

entry: POKENAME周围的细胞团，再生得快得惊人。即使待在放射性污染地区，也能安然生存。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The cell mass surrounding POKENAME regenerates incredibly quickly. It can even survive in areas contaminated by radioactivity without any problems.

entry: POKENAME在有丝分裂时发电，不断迸出火花。有些家庭，便让它帮忙提供可再生电力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sparks continuously as it generates electricity during mitosis. It is therefore used in some households to generate renewable electricity.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，浓缩后可用于制药，现代许多抗过敏药中，都含有这种成分。
author: .izik
source: The slime from a POKENAME can be condensed and used in pharmaceuticals. Many modern-day allergy medications use this slime.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大超能力，性情却胆小。一遇危险，便靠柔软身体挤进窄缝，转眼不见。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its strong psychic powers, POKENAME is cowardly and disappears into narrow cracks through which it can squeeze thanks to its flexible body.

entry: 不停再生的细胞团，护着POKENAME真正的身体。个头虽大，却很柔软，钻进小洞就能消失无踪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Constantly regenerating cell mass protects the actual body of POKENAME. Despite its size, it is very flexible and can disappear through narrow holes.

entry: POKENAME的脸乍看柔软，却因质地致密，有着钢铁般的强度。可身体其他地方，仍十分娇弱。
author: ForbiddenBread
source: While it may look soft, POKENAME's face retains the strength of steel due to its density. However, the remainder of its body is still very fragile.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，闻着像新摘的胡萝卜，常被用来调制特别的洗发水与护发素。
author: .izik
source: The slime of a POKENAME smells like freshly-picked carrots. It is used in specialty shampoos and conditioners.

entry: POKENAME的外膜结晶，形成坚硬如石的外壳。日久，核心不断分泌凝胶，壳也越来越牢固。
author: germs2128
source: The outer membrane of POKENAME crystallizes, forming a rock-hard boulder. Over time, it secretes gel from its core, reinforcing its shell.

entry: 身体极易变形，让POKENAME能挤过冰层的小缝。即使冷得如太空真空一般，它也承受得住。
author: strawbearycandy
source: Its highly malleable body allows POKENAME to squeeze through small cracks in the ice. It can withstand temperatures as cold as the vacuum of space.

entry: POKENAME借半透明身体悄悄接近毫无防备的猎物，再将对方吸进体内，慢慢消化。
author: strawbearycandy
source: POKENAME's translucent body helps it to sneak up on unsuspecting prey, which is then absorbed into said body to be gradually digested.

entry: 特殊液体包裹着POKENAME，让它在哪种地形都能生活。超能力与头上的角，却是它仅有的自保手段。
author: anarchaz
source: Wrapped in a unique liquid, POKENAME thrives across all terrains. Its psychic powers and the horn on its head are its only means of protection.

entry: POKENAME表面的胶质，是它不断进行有丝分裂时排出的多余细胞，里面还感染着病原体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The jelly that coats POKENAME are surplus cells that it secretes during its constant mitosis. These are infected with pathogens.

entry: 它必须双眼一同盯住目标，才能正确模仿。否则，两颗彼此独立的大脑，就会让变身出错。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon must focus with both eyes on the target to imitate them properly. Otherwise, its two separate brains will cause improper transformations.

entry: 上方较小的脑，才真正负责大部分思考。它很少与同族之外的生物往来。
author: adrian151
source: Its upper, smaller brain actually does most of the thinking. It interacts with other beings outside of its own kind very rarely.

entry: 它把使自己进化的雷之石，包在特殊液体里。借这块石头，便能释放10000伏的电击。
author: DuskRD
source: It keeps the Thunder Stone that evolved it enveloped in a special liquid. It can use the Thunder Stone to unleash electrical shocks of 10,000 volts.

entry: 这种融合体的本体很小，却能迅速制造新细胞，为自己做出一身防护衣。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The actual body of this fusion is small, but can generate new cells very quickly, with which it creates a kind of protective suit.

entry: POKENAME颈间的大团棉絮，很娇嫩，容易扯破，因此它总避开看起来凶狠的生物。
author: .realthree
source: The large cotton bloom around POKENAME's neck is very delicate and tears easily, so it prefers to avoid those who seem aggressive.

entry: 它从炮管中射出棉花，想吓走天敌。可毕竟只是棉花，这招常不管用，照样挨打。
author: Soup1900
source: It shoots cotton out of its cannons to scare predators away. This defense is often ineffective since it's just cotton, and it gets attacked anyways.

entry: POKENAME胆子很小，便用棉絮裹住自己，躲避天敌。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is very cowardly. It covers itself in cotton to hide from predators.

entry: 它把头埋进颈间的棉絮，躲开危险。若仍感到威胁，就赶紧搭上气流飞走。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: It will bury its head in the cotton around its neck to hide from danger. They will swiftly fly off on wind currents if they feel threatened.

entry: POKENAME成群乘风远行，偶尔才降到河湖边，吸足水分，继续永不止息的旅程。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME ride the wind in schools, only occasionally descending near lakes or rivers to soak up water for their never-ending journey.

entry: POKENAME先把棉花射向对手眼睛，再发动攻击。身轻固然灵巧，却也容易被人推开。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME shoots cotton into its opponent's eyes before attacking. Its light weight makes it nimble yet easy to push around.

entry: POKENAME用练习棍般的武器，将来犯者推远。若看来要输，就朝敌人射出棉絮，趁机逃跑。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME uses its pugil stick-like weapon to push away would be attackers. If the battle seems lost, it shoots its cotton at its foe to escape.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮看似柔软，里面却夹满钢铁碎片。有些公司，用它制作强力清洁工具。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though it appears soft, the cotton on POKENAME's body is filled with steel shrapnel. Some companies have crafted heavy-duty cleaning utensils from it.

entry: POKENAME整天在茂盛草甸中穿行。棉絮里满是泥土，让天敌们都懒得吃它。
author: _testrun_
source: POKENAME spend their days weaving through the grass of lush meadows. No predator cares to hunt them due to the dirt strewn throughout their cotton.

entry: 棉絮般的外骨骼，让POKENAME能从高处缓缓飘下，安稳落地，再继续滚动。
author: themicelegion
source: Its cotton-like exoskeleton allows POKENAME to float down from high places. It then lands comfortably on the ground, ready to roll again.

entry: 雪童子的外衣与棉絮融在一起，形状也歪了。虽不痛苦，它却似乎不太喜欢。
author: pokebio
source: Snorunt's cloak fused with the cotton, making it distorted. While not in pain, it doesn't seem to enjoy it.

entry: POKENAME棉絮柔软，性情友善，常被用来教孩子骑乘，也常与照顾的小骑手，结下深厚情谊。
author: howlingstarr
source: Due to POKENAME's soft cotton and friendly nature, they are often used to teach children how to ride. They often form strong bonds with their charges.

entry: POKENAME个头小、模样友好，咬合力却惊人。野生POKENAME常在沙岸上晒太阳。
author: cosmodette
source: While POKENAME appears small and friendly, it has a powerful bite. In the wild, POKENAME tend to be found sunbathing on sandy shores.

entry: 它伏在浅浅的沙下，挥刃划向路人的腿。受害者若逃走，POKENAME便凶猛地追上去。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It lies just below the surface of the desert to slice at the legs of passersby. When victims get away, POKENAME aggressively pursues them.

entry: 这种POKENAME是专为宠物培育的。与主人感情深了，还会亲昵地轻咬一口。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: This form of POKENAME was specifically bred as a pet. It will nibble its owner affectionately if they share a close bond.

entry: 它们用回声定位发现猎物，从树上扑下来，吸食路人的血。POKENAME身体轻盈，行动不易被察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: They detect prey through echolocation and jump from trees to suck the blood out of the passerby. POKENAME's light weight allow them to escape notice.

entry: POKENAME发出超声波，在洞中认路，再以爆发的电力袭击猎物。猛烈的放电，甚至能让供电中断，自己也跟着昏过去。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME emits ultrasonic waves to navigate caves and blasts to shock prey. It can emit a blast strong enough to knock out power as well as itself.

entry: POKENAME戴着被自己吸干鲜血的猎物的头骨。因为看不见，狩猎时只能朝声音传来的方向俯冲。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of the prey it has sucked all the blood from. Since it is blind, it just dives in the direction of prey it hears.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却靠长舌与敏锐的耳朵，准确感知周围。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: With the help of its long tongue and sensitive ears, the otherwise blind POKENAME can accurately scan its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME在住处四周筑起无形墙壁。猎物撞到墙上，发出的回声便让POKENAME轻易锁定它们。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME creates invisible walls around its habitat. Prey often slam into the walls, which makes it easy for POKENAME to echolocate to them.

entry: 由于没有视力，耳朵逐渐变成大颚般的器官，用来夹捕猎物。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its ears have adapted, due to its lack of eyesight, to act as a set of mandibles to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME附在受害者身上，慢慢吸尽鲜血。它们生命力顽强，主要住在阴暗潮湿之处。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sucks on its victims and gradually drains their blood. They are hardy and live mainly in dark and damp places.

entry: 这些夜行宝可梦，会尽量避免与天敌冲突。可叫声仍吓坏周围的生物，尤其到了求偶季节。
author: mrbapcik
source: These nocturnal Pokémon try to avoid conflicts with predators. Their cries frighten everyone around, especially during the mating season.

entry: POKENAME是没有眼睛的猎手，靠振翅感受从洞壁弹回的气流，辨认方向。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: An eyeless hunter, POKENAME flaps its wings and feels the air bouncing off cave walls in order to navigate.

entry: POKENAME在地下水附近群居，靠口中发出的回声定位，穿行于迷宫般的地下住处。
author: char_latte3412
source: Establishing colonies near groundwater, POKENAME can navigate their underground, labyrinthian homes using echolocation emitted from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME虽保留回声定位的本领，却很少使用，似乎更乐意东碰西撞，摸索周围。
author: char_latte3412
source: While POKENAME retains its echolocation abilities, it rarely uses them. It appears content to explore its surroundings by simply bumping into objects.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，却能借回声定位“看见”。身旁的宝石，还能帮它更精准地追踪猎物。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Though POKENAME is completely blind, it can use echolocation to see. The gems around it aid in tracking prey more precisely.

entry: POKENAME住在洞中，朝猎物所在的方向乱挥身体狩猎。它会躲开其他捕食者，除非对方先击中它的尾巴。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME lives in caves and hunts by blindly flailing its body in the direction of prey. It avoids other predators unless they strike its tail first.

entry: POKENAME模样可怖，却只吃从土中过滤出的细菌。挖洞时，巨大的尖牙，便用来凿开岩石。
author: ansleehariot
source: Despite its horrifying appearance, POKENAME only eats bacteria filtered from the soil. It uses its titanic fangs to carve through rocks as it burrows.

entry: POKENAME不需要眼睛，因此嘴巴最终长大到覆盖了整个身体。它一顿就能吞下300颗以上的树果。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME 's mouth eventually covered it's whole body, as it didn't need eyes. It can gobble up over 300 Berries in one sitting.

entry: POKENAME天生失明，靠回声定位与飘带感受周围。若遇上不认识的东西，就会试着轻咬一下。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Being born blind, POKENAME uses echolocation and its ribbons to feel its surroundings. When around something it doesn't recognize, it will nibble it.

entry: 这只宝可梦双目失明，却有着不可思议的本领，能感知周围生物的情绪。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: This Pokémon is blind as a bat. However, it has an incredible ability to sense the emotions of beings around it.

entry: POKENAME本是被主人弄坏的电子超音蝠玩具。洛托姆在垃圾堆找到它后，总算有了新的住处。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME is an electronic Zubat toy that was broken by its owner. Found by Rotom in the dump, it now has a new home to reside in.

entry: POKENAME本是被主人弄坏的电子超音蝠玩具。洛托姆在垃圾堆找到它后，总算有了新的住处。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME is an electronic Zubat toy that was broken by its owner. Found by Rotom in the dump, it now has a new home to reside in.

entry: 失明的POKENAME，在洞中发出超声波尖叫，靠回声定位狩猎。年岁渐长，尾巴越多，动作也越灵活。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The blind POKENAME uses ultrasonic screams and echolocation to hunt in caves. As it gets older, it grows more tails and in turn becomes more agile.

entry: POKENAME胆小又看不见，躲在黑暗洞穴，用回声定位感知周围。它会变成天敌的模样，吓退、欺骗对方，可即使变了，仍然失明。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A shy, blind Pokémon, POKENAME hides in dark caves and uses echolocation. It scares and tricks predators by transforming into them, but remains blind.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME钻进民宅的插座，吸在里面。电费莫名高涨，往往就是它们在作怪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sucks itself into the sockets of houses at night. They are often the reason for inexplicably high electricity prices.

entry: 白天，它睡在柳树根旁，借树阴躲避烈日。若被吵醒，就会发出高频尖叫。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps at the base of willow trees during the daytime, preferring the shade from the hot sun. If woken up, it will screech at a high frequency.

entry: 这只奇怪的宝可梦，嘴大得连脑袋都没多少地方可放。POKENAME的爱好者虽少，却十分忠诚。
author: .realthree
source: This strange Pokémon barely has room for its brain due to the size of its mouth. Fans of POKENAME are rare, but devoted.

entry: POKENAME跑得不快，更爱先伏击猎物，咬上一口毒牙，再等对方倒下，慢慢追过去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a poor runner. It prefers to ambush its prey with a venomous bite, then wait until the Pokémon collapses to catch up with it.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太小，托不起身体，便在洞穴地面四处跑，将猎物兜进大张的嘴里。
author: gronkissimo
source: The wings on POKENAME are too small to lift its body. It runs around cave floors, scooping prey up into its gaping maw.

entry: 它振动翅膀，能在水中飞快前进。每到秋季，成群POKENAME都会经过红莲岛附近。
author: .izik
source: By flapping its wings, it propels itself through water at great speeds. Schools of POKENAME regularly pass by Cinnabar Island during the fall months.

entry: POKENAME常吊在洞中植物上，吸收养分，张着嘴捕虫；也会突然俯冲，一口口吞食小虫。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME often hangs onto cave plants, absorbing their nutrients and catching bugs with its open mouth. It also swoops down to eat bugs in mouthfuls.

entry: 它们飞过漆黑洞穴，凭坚固身体横冲直撞，撞碎障碍。被它撞一下，可比挨一口咬更伤。
author: Staghorn
source: They fly through pitch-black caves, plowing through obstacles with their durable bodies. Being struck by one is more injurious than being bitten.

entry: POKENAME被视为恐怖的象征。洞穴拐角若看见它迫人的轮廓，便只剩片刻，能在袭击前逃走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is regarded as a symbol of terror. Those who turn a corner in a cave and see its imposing silhouette have moments to flee before it attacks.

entry: 它发出低沉音调，感知周围。这声音令人不安，也被恐怖电影用来烘托惊悚气氛。
author: .Izik
source: It makes a low tone to view its surroundings. This tone is unsettling and has been used in horror movies to cause unease.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，熬煮后会变成浓膏，美容师会拿来调制口红。
author: .izik
source: The slime on a POKENAME can be boiled down into a a thick paste. This paste is used by beauticians as an ingredient in lipstick.

entry: 数百只POKENAME成群住在洞穴深处，喜欢收集东西，飞行时还要拿在手里摇来摆去。
author: noel5229
source: Swarms of POKENAME hundreds strong live deep inside caves. They love to collect objects and swing them around as they fly.

entry: POKENAME是杂食宝可梦，平日滚动身体压碎猎物，也很爱水果，还会一头撞树，震落果实。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME are omnivorous. While they normally roll and crush prey, they're also known to like fruit and will ram trees to obtain it.

entry: POKENAME会围在战斗旁，向交手者投去疗伤的蛋，让对决拖得更久。它自己却不肯接受治疗，以此证明强韧。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME will surround a battle and prolong it by throwing healing eggs to the fighters. It proves its strength by not accepting healing for itself.

entry: 其中一颗头能长出磁性矿石，另外两颗再将矿石散布四方。这种矿石，卖得出很高的价钱。
author: nasho1908
source: It creates magnetic minerals along one of its heads, and the other two distribute it across the region. Such minerals can be sold at a high price.

entry: POKENAME爱做恶作剧，借此忘记头痛。若痛得实在厉害，还会下意识遮住阳光，不让自己看见。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME engage in pranks to distract themselves from their headaches. One with bad enough headaches will subconsciously block the sun from its view.

entry: 利爪能撕开钢铁，尾巴则帮助水下转向、攀住物体。沙漠也好，大海也好，POKENAME都能安然生活。
author: totodile.
source: Their claws can shred through steel, and they use their tails to steer and grab onto things underwater. POKENAME comfortably live in deserts and seas.

entry: 据说哭哭面具盛怒至极，反被自己的面具吸收，才成了这种融合体。如今它心里只剩复仇。
author: maelmc
source: It's said this fusion is the result of a Yamask being absorbed by its mask after experiencing immeasurable anger. It now only seeks vengeance.

entry: 这个幽灵徘徊于自己的墓地，哀悼着逝去的生命。脸上的葬面具，是仅存的身份印记。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This spirit wanders its burial site, mourning its passing. Its burial mask is all that remains of its identity.

entry: POKENAME被称作厄运的使者。这个黑暗的存在一来访，对方便清楚意识到，自己该前往来世了。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is known as a bringer of doom. Any visited by this entity of darkness become acutely aware that their time to enter the next life has come.

entry: 遥远过去，合众、伽勒尔等地的一些部族，将POKENAME奉为混沌神明，相信它与生死轮回相连。
author: cipherlingarde
source: In the distant past, some tribes in regions like Unova and Galar worshipped POKENAME as a chaotic deity connected to the cycle of reincarnation.

entry: POKENAME即使变了身，也能凭金色的人脸面具认出来。因为没有面具，POKENAME便无法变换形态。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: A transformed POKENAME can be recognized by its golden human-like mask, as POKENAME cannot change shape without wearing it.

entry: 这个幽灵早已忘了生前的模样，才化成眼前的宝可梦。它遍寻古墓，想找一张与面具相合的脸。
author: hampterbychoice
source: This Pokémon arose from a spirit that has forgotten its living form. It scans through ancient tombs, searching for the face that fits its mask.

entry: 训练家若失去了所有宝可梦，它就会默默引路，送对方回家。有人说，它自己也曾是一只迷途的宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: If a Trainer happens to lose every Pokémon they have, it will silently guide them home. Some say it was once a Pokémon that became lost itself.

entry: POKENAME一饿，腹部的面具就咕咕叫。越饿，声音越响，POKENAME也越发焦躁。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME is hungry, the mask on its belly grumbles. The hungrier it gets, the louder it growls and the more frantic POKENAME becomes.

entry: POKENAME戴着面具，藏起生前的身份。驯服后，它们便是强悍的信使，能跨越长途，将信送达。
author: ElioNagashi#0173
source: POKENAME wear masks to hide who they were in life. Once tamed, they are fierce messengers, able to traverse long distances to deliver a letter.

entry: POKENAME被幽冥之水吸引，夜里会举行神秘仪式。据说，目睹者将遭遇不幸。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME is drawn to spectral waters, performing mysterious rituals at night. Those who witness these rituals are said to encounter misfortune.

entry: POKENAME所有的力量，都来自那副特殊面具。双眼一变红，就会开始狂暴地横冲直撞。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME derives all its power from the specialized mask it wears. When its eyes turns red, it goes on a rampage.

entry: 它重拾盗墓的老本行，在古代遗迹里收集遗失的面具，还爱拿一袋袋沙，替换文物。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: It has returned to its grave robbing origins and collects lost masks found in ancient ruins. They love to replace artifacts with bags of sand.

entry: POKENAME随身总带着金色徽记，吃个不停。可这些东西究竟从哪儿来，谁也不知道。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME constantly eats golden emblems, which it has with it at all times. It isn't known where it gets them from.

entry: 据说，凝视POKENAME手中的金色圆珠，心神便会被拖入属于自己的炼狱，坠向最深之处。
author: cipherlingarde
source: The golden orb that POKENAME holds is said to drag the mind of those that look into it to the deepest depths of their own personal purgatory.

entry: POKENAME是苦痛的化身，专想让人类与宝可梦受折磨。它会让受害者，反复看见自己做过的一切恶事。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is an avatar of torment, seeking to make Pokémon and people alike suffer. It haunts its victims with endless images of all their misdeeds.

entry: 晴朗的漆黑夜里，最好别遇见POKENAME。那正是它们寻找人类与宝可梦，下手折磨的时候。
author: cipherlingarde
source: You do not want to encounter a POKENAME on a dark night with clear skies, as that is when they seek out Pokémon and humans to torment.

entry: POKENAME捡起墓地附近留下的衣物，带着保暖。可若是生者赠衣，它反倒不肯收。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME carries articles of clothing left near gravesites to keep itself warm. It refuses gifts of clothing from the living, however.

entry: 历史学家认为，POKENAME的金色附肢，原本是死亡面具。如今却被它用来刺住猎物，吸出灵魂。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Historians believe that POKENAME's gold appendage was once intended as a death mask. However, it now uses it to sting prey and suck out their souls.

entry: 这种罕见的融合体，在一位逝者下葬时诞生。亡魂便以这张醒目的逝者面容，显露形貌。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This rare fusion was created when a deceased person was buried. The soul manifested itself with this impressive image of the face of the deceased.

entry: 据说，武士的灵魂附在自己的葬面具与生前佩剑上，至今仍为战败，深感绝望。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior possesses its funeral mask and sword it wielded while it was alive. It still despairs that it lost the war.

entry: 据说，武士的亡魂仍带着生前的剑，悲悼自己为之奋战的王国，早已不复存在。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior carries the sword that it wielded in life. It mourns that the kingdom it fought for no longer exists.

entry: 这把仪式用剑，被幽灵附身，徘徊地下墓穴，寻找更多祭品，尤其喜欢盯上盗墓者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A ceremonial blade haunted by a spirit. It wanders catacombs in search of more victims to sacrifice, especially grave robbers.

entry: 没人敢看POKENAME铠甲里面，就连它自己的训练家，也不敢。
author: TomatoSalad
source: Nobody dares look within POKENAME's armor. Not even its own Trainers.

entry: 据说，好几只哭哭面具的灵魂合在一起，成了POKENAME。它再也弄不清自己是谁，那些带着的面具，只能徒增痛苦。
author: ETheWriter
source: It's said the souls of multiple Yamask combined, creating POKENAME. Its identity is compromised, so the masks it carries only cause them anguish.

entry: 古代人会照着逝去亲人的面容，为POKENAME制作面具。面具属于谁，这只宝可梦便会守护谁的墓。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Ancient civilizations would craft masks of departed loved ones for POKENAME. This Pokémon will guard the burial site of the person their mask matches.

entry: 身体没有固定形态，让POKENAME能接上各种古老机关，也因此很受盗墓者欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Thanks to its amorphous shape, POKENAME can connect with all kinds of ancient mechanisms. For this reason, it is very popular with grave robbers.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常出没于古迹附近，凭一种未知的感官，重现过去的景象，仿佛一切正发生眼前。
author: .izik
source: Wild POKENAME are typically seen near ancient ruins. Using an unknown sense, they can envision past events as if they are happening now.

entry: 金色王冠在阳光下闪耀，诱着毫无戒心的人深入沼泽。面具上，则戴着那些迷失者的脸。
author: Zagreus8
source: Its golden crown glitters in the sun, luring unsuspecting people deeper into swamps. It wears the faces of those lost on its mask.

entry: 这只哭哭面具附在小拳石身上，与对方融合的过程才进行到一半。
author: mx_wellman
source: This Yamask has attached itself to a Geodude, and is halfway through the process of melding with it.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME漂在池畔，对自己的倒影哭泣。可它身上有毒，造访的池塘往往也没有生命。
author: Billie Jeans
source: POKENAME is sometimes found floating around ponds and crying at its reflection. Due to it being poisonous, the ponds it visits are often void of life.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: OxiTape#4145
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: OxiTape#4145
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.
