entry: 野生POKENAME用毛发中的静电，抵御天敌。电力逐渐增强，最终就足以触发进化。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME use the static electricity in its fur to ward of predators. This electricity eventually becomes potent enough to trigger an evolution.

entry: POKENAME能嗅出衣物与家用品中的静电，收进丝网袋里，留着以后当点心。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME can sniff out static within clothing and household objects. They store gathered static in their web bag to snack on later.

entry: 它以附近宝可梦的快乐念头为食，复眼还能发现一英里外，潜在的危险。
author: thenezhar
source: It feeds off the cheerful thoughts of Pokémon in its vicinity. It can spot potential danger from a mile away with its compound eyes.

entry: POKENAME寄宿在合众电气石洞穴的一块水晶中。它究竟如何形成，科学家至今仍解不开。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME resides in a crystal from the Chargestone Cave in Unova. Exactly how it formed has so far been a mystery to scientists.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过林地。别看身子小，竟能制造强劲的电流。
author: anarchaz
source: With a slow pace, POKENAME navigates the forest floor. Its small size belies its ability to generate potent electrical currents.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME自己就能发电，却仍爱贴上其他宝可梦，搜集静电。可这份亲近，并不怎么受欢迎。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite being capable of producing its own electricity, POKENAME often tries to latch onto other Pokémon to gather static, but it's not well-received.

entry: 吸收了电气石洞穴一块水晶的能量后，POKENAME长得庞大无比，却仍带着那块水晶，走到哪里也不放下。
author: NellNast42
source: After absorbing energy from a crystal from Chargestone Cave, POKENAME has grown to enormous sizes. It still carries around this crystal, though.

entry: POKENAME天性胆怯，躲在丝线与雪搭起的移动巢穴里。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME are timid by nature, hiding within mobile nests which they make out of silk and snow.

entry: POKENAME已长得比巢还大，可巢的外层冻成了硬壳，只好想办法，适应这副意外得来的外壳。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME have grown too big for their nests, but since the outer layer has frozen solid, they've had to adapt to their accidental shells.

entry: 蓬松毛发为它御寒。POKENAME看似无辜，却是一位危险的猎手。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its fluffy fur protects it from the cold. Despite its innocent appearance, POKENAME is a dangerous hunter.

entry: 觉醒之石的影响，让它发生了奇异变化。人们相信，它能漂浮，是借助电磁力。
author: mx_wellman
source: Exposure to a Dawn Stone had some strange effects on this Pokémon. It's believed it can float thanks to electromagnetism.

entry: POKENAME在磁力极强的地方附近筑洞。许多恐怖故事都说，它们能吞掉整座发电厂。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their burrows around highly magnetic areas. Many horror stories are told of POKENAME devouring entire power plants.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，用满是尖刺的身躯与锋利尾巴保卫家园。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are quite territorial. They use their spiky bodies and sharp tails to defend their home.

entry: POKENAME既会重击受害者，也能发射尖刺。它最擅长对付披甲的敌人，吸收对方身上的金属。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME fires off spikes in addition to bludgeoning its victims. It excels against armored opponents and absorbs their metal.

entry: POKENAME藏在带刺的金属铠甲中。有些民间传说认为，甲壳下面，是一个怀恨的亡魂。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is encased in thorny metal armor that covers its interior. Some folk tales suspect a vengeful spirit lies beneath the armor.

entry: 为保护钥匙，POKENAME会以带刺的身体冲撞来犯的窃贼。最爱的钥匙往往来自废弃花园小屋。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME protect their keys from robbers by charging them with their thorny bodies. Their favorite keys often come from abandoned garden shacks.

entry: POKENAME很以齿轮上那些尖锐的刺为傲。刺与刺之间露出的钢片，却有一道道巨大的刮痕。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME are very proud of the sharp spikes they bear as cogs. The exposed steel between the thorns shows evidence of large scratches.

entry: POKENAME不爱与其他宝可梦贴得太近，便让全身长满倒刺。若侧耳细听，还能听见面具里传来轻轻的哼唱。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME covers itself with barbs as it hates being too close to other Pokémon. If you listen closely, you can hear soft humming coming from its mask.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，想靠尖刺，让周围土地萌发生机。可它离开后留下的土，却往往粗硬不平。
author: Xephyr
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground in hopes of germinating the surrounding area with its spikes. Often, the soil it leaves behind is coarse and tough.

entry: 它用皮肤吸收日光，获取能量。鼻子无论在陆地还是水下，都十分灵敏。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs sunlight through its skin to gain energy. Its nose functions well on dry land and in water.

entry: 獠牙与剃刀般的尖齿，让它咬劲极强。偏又喜欢咬着玩，害许多训练家受过伤。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its combination of tusks and razor-sharp teeth gives this Pokémon an intense bite force. It plays by nibbling, causing many injuries to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME会在树上刻下独有的记号，标示领地。刀刃虽会崩口，重新长好后，却更加强韧。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME marks its territory by etching its unique signature in trees. Its blade chips but grows back stronger.

entry: 据说，它的火焰源自逝去巨龙的意志。发怒时，火焰会烧得更加明亮，球状核心中还会传出悠远的龙吼声。
author: antomelon
source: It's said that its flame comes from the will of fallen dragons. When angered, its flame burns brighter, and distant roars can be heard from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME虽在基因上更接近玛瑙水母，却常偷偷混进双斧战龙的群体，借此吓退天敌。
author: mx_wellman
source: Despite being genetically closer to Tentacool, POKENAME are known for sneaking into Haxorus herds in order to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME用利爪爬上树，平日多在林冠间滑翔。坚硬的獠牙，则用来威吓敌人。
author: NyanDogeGaming
source: Using its clawed hands to climb trees, POKENAME are usually found gliding around the canopies in forests. Its hard tusks are used to deter foes.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头彼此厌恶，总打个不停。若能把它们教得齐心协力，便足以证明训练家精于培育龙宝可梦。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME's two heads hate each other and fight constantly. Owning a POKENAME whose heads cooperate is a mark of a skilled Dragon-type Trainer.

entry: 夜里，常能看见POKENAME轻松滚过沙漠。它也常与小拳石比赛扳手腕。
author: kittyluv090
source: At night, POKENAME can be seen rolling across sandy deserts with ease. It often has arm-wrestling matches with Geodude.

entry: 据说POKENAME是多年前用黏土制成的。芳香的叶片散发着肥沃壤土的气息。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: It's said that POKENAME were formed from clay many years ago. Its aromatic leaf smells of rich and loamy soil.

entry: 据说POKENAME在许多年前便被制造出来，如今会用身上的环形灯光为迷路旅人引路。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME was supposedly made many years ago. It guides lost travelers with its circular lights.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地守着栖居的遗迹。因为多一颗头，即使睡着，也能继续警戒。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME keeps tireless watch over the ruins it lives in. Because of its second head, it can stand sentry even when asleep.

entry: POKENAME坚毅地钻穿土层。机械般的特性，让它在满是遗迹的沙漠中，占据上风。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME burrows through the earth with relentless determination. Its mechanical nature assures its dominance in deserts filled with ruins.

entry: POKENAME曾被当成神话，却对主人忠诚无比。如今已知，失落的古代文明，曾将它们用作看门犬。
author: Gummy Wookie
source: Thought to be a myth, POKENAME is fiercely loyal to its owners. They are now known to have been used as guard dogs by a lost, ancient civilization.

entry: POKENAME自发守护山村，能从坡上高速滚下，将积蓄的冲力，化作威猛的一拳。
author: wigglypon
source: POKENAME are self-assigned defenders of mountain villages. By rolling downhill at high speed, they can generate momentum into colossal punches.

entry: POKENAME生活在某些古代遗址。它的形状与墙上的孔洞相合，因此可能是开启特定机关的钥匙。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in certain ancient sites. Due to its shape and matching holes on the walls, it could have been used as a key for specific mechanisms.

entry: POKENAME稳稳滚过古迹长廊。若碰撞受损，就会搜集新材料，修补自己。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME rolls steadily through the corridors of ancient ruins. If it suffers damage due to collisions, it can collect new material for repairs.

entry: 据推测，所有POKENAME的意识，都连在一个庞大的集群思维中，听从来自未知源头的指令。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is speculated that all POKENAME are mentally linked through one large hivemind. They seem to follow orders given from an unknown source.

entry: POKENAME聚集迁徙时，鸣叫如雷，半英里外也听得见。这声音，被视为春天到来的明确信号。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME gather to migrate, their cacophony of thunderous chirps can be heard half a mile away. This sound is considered a sure sign of spring.

entry: 这只小宝可梦虽有翅膀，却更爱在地上走。它很容易与其他小宝可梦交朋友，还愿分享食物。
author: Holzycookie
source: Despite having wings, this little Pokémon likes to walk around on the ground. It easily befriends other small Pokémon, sharing its food with them.

entry: 这只胆小宝可梦藏在树间，漂在树皮旁，啄啄这里、啄啄那里，盼着有小型虫宝可梦钻出来。
author: themicelegion
source: A cowardly Pokémon that hides in trees. It floats about the bark of the trees, pecking at it, hoping for a small bug Pokémon to appear.

entry: 它用喙与利爪猛攻，领地意识很强，可一见闪亮的钱币，又会轻易分心。
author: snescontroller
source: It attacks fiercely with its beak and claws. Though it's very territorial, it's easily distracted by shiny coins.

entry: 口中吐出的丝摸着温热。可若贴在裸露皮肤上超过十分钟，就可能让人起疹。
author: .izik
source: The silk that comes out of its mouth is warm to the touch. If left on exposed skin for more than ten minutes, it can cause a rash.

entry: POKENAME常在火山脚下捡岩浆石结茧。光是尾巴，温度就能达到华氏500度。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME are often seen collecting magma stones at the base of volcanoes to make cocoons. Their tails alone can reach 500 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 尾巴分泌的颜料状液体，能用来标记领地。真打起架来，它又会把这物质点燃。
author: admiralvermin
source: It secrets a paint-like substance from its tail that it uses to mark its territory. When it gets in a fight, it lights this substance ablaze.

entry: POKENAME看着像海中植物，其实是靠拟态引诱猎物的虫宝可梦。碰一下，便会严重灼伤。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: While POKENAME looks like a marine plant, it is actually a Bug-type Pokémon drawing in prey with mimicry. It causes serious burns on contact.

entry: 当地人也把POKENAME称作“太阳之滴”。它能从刀刃喷出火焰，温度高达华氏5500度。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun Drop" by locals. It expels flames from its blade up to 5,500 degrees F.

entry: POKENAME是一只庞大的幼虫，梦想有朝一日，进化成威风的巨龙。身上的尖刺，则由永不融化的冰构成。
author: VoxPoss
source: A humongous larva, POKENAME dreams about evolving into a mighty dragon someday. Its spikes are made of ice that never melts.

entry: 它用沉重的炮管射出水流，将敌人推得远远的。这也是POKENAME保护柔软肚皮的唯一办法。
author: VoxPoss
source: This larva uses heavy cannons to shoot water streams and push enemies far away. That's the only way POKENAME can protect their soft belly.

entry: POKENAME用长舌缠住洞中的岩台，在石块之间荡来荡去，再凭声波，寻找黑暗中的下一个落点。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to wrap around ledges in caves and swing from stone to stone. It uses sound waves to locate its next target in the darkness.

entry: 它发出超声尖叫，威吓周围的生物，借此保护自己，等待进化。
author: .izik
source: It emits a supersonic scream to terrify those around it. This serves as a deterrent while it waits for evolution to take place.

entry: POKENAME不论兴奋还是恼怒，都会飞快扇动小翅膀。想免挨重重一口，可得分清它究竟是哪种心情。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME rapidly flaps its small wings when either excited or irritated. Distinguishing between the two states is crucial in avoiding a nasty bite.

entry: POKENAME吸食了太多鲜血，身体变得沉重无比。若不经过特别训练，就永远无法离地飞行。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's heavy frame is a result of the huge amounts of blood it consumes. Without specific training, this Pokémon will remain permanently grounded.

entry: POKENAME的嘴与牙齿，都细小而敏感。它便先以幻象，让猎物误以为安全，再稳妥地凑近下口。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The teeth and mouth of POKENAME are very small and sensitive. It uses illusions to lure prey into a false sense of safety to more safely bite them.

entry: 兜帽般的部分，连在颈上。天气一冷，翅膀便散出热量，让外壳保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: The hooded portion is attached to its neck. When it gets cold, its wings will radiate heat to keep the outer shell warm.

entry: 它潜伏在极寒地区的洞穴。狩猎时，便用毛遮脸、双翼裹身，好让自己看起来没那么危险。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It stalks in arctic caves. When hunting, it covers its face with its hair and wraps its wings around itself to appear less threatening.

entry: POKENAME虽然弱小，尖叫却能令人毛骨悚然，连最强的敌人也会被吓退。它常住在有水的洞穴里。
author: Canada
source: Although it is weak, POKENAME can produce a bloodcurdling scream that scares away the toughest of foes. It is often found in aquatic caves.

entry: 双翼强健，足以承受全身重量。即使睡觉，它也会轻轻拍动翅膀。
author: .izik
source: Its wings are incredibly strong and can support its body weight. It will quietly flap the wings while it sleeps.

entry: 它每次进食，最多能喝下10盎司鲜血。咬下之前，飘带能帮忙，把猎物牢牢缠住。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It drinks up to 10 ounces of blood during any feeding. Its ribbons makes it easier to hold its prey before it bites.

entry: 许多壁画中，都描绘着与它相似的巨型海蛇，似乎曾以古代航海者为食。
author: ansleehariot
source: Various murals have been found depicting a titanic oceanic serpent resembling this Pokémon. It apparently preyed on ancient seafarers.

entry: 它看似凶悍，其实十分爱玩，喜欢和其他POKENAME，在月光下嬉闹。
author: gellyfishsh
source: Despite its menacing appearance, it is very playful. It loves to frolic in the moonlight with fellow POKENAME.

entry: 锋利尖牙与精密齿轮，让它成为敏捷猎手。可机械一旦故障，附近一切都可能遭殃。
author: anarchaz
source: With razor-sharp fangs and intricate gears, it's a swift predator. Yet, if its machinery malfunctions, it becomes a threat to anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME堵在狭窄洞口，张开大嘴，等毫无戒心的猎物，自己走进来。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME lies in wait in narrow cave entrances, hoping that unsuspecting prey will march into its open mouth.

entry: 它潜伏在黑暗洞底。受害者一踩上来，POKENAME就用尖牙夹紧，从脚踝飞快吸血。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It lies waiting on dark cave floors. When a victim steps on it, POKENAME clamps down with its fangs and rapidly sucks blood from their ankles.

entry: 它常住洞穴深处。对老练矿工来说，发现POKENAME，就意味着附近很可能有矿。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: It is often found deep in caves. Finding a POKENAME is a sign of nearby ore deposits to veteran miners.

entry: POKENAME虽有超能力，自己却常忘记。真打起架来，主要还是拿尖牙、翅膀，甚至汤匙去揍。
author: char_latte3412
source: While it possesses psychic abilities, POKENAME will often forget this. In battle, it mainly uses its fangs, wings, and even its spoon to do damage.

entry: 它喜欢用关节技制住对手。待猎物虚弱下来，再吸干鲜血，作最后一击。
author: Chazzwozzer32
source: This Pokémon likes to put its opponents in submission holds. When its prey is weakened, it will finish it off by draining its blood.

entry: POKENAME住在海蚀洞里，躲进暗角，等待猎物游过，再将其拖回洞中，吸上好几个小时的血。
author: JokersWild
source: POKENAME live in sea caves, hiding in dark corners and waiting for prey to swim by. It drags its prey into its cave and sucks its blood for hours.

entry: 身体几乎不停冒出滚滚毒烟。烟一碰明火，便会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: Toxic smoke billows out of its body almost constantly. If the smoke touches an open flame, it will explode.

entry: 它睡在海底洞顶，用舌头缠住钟乳石，防止自己坠落。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps while clinging onto ceilings of undersea caves. It will wrap its tongue around stalactites to avoid falling to the ground.

entry: POKENAME四肢太弱，撑不起身体，只好平贴着地，在自己吐出的泥浆上滑行。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's limbs are far too weak to hold up the rest of its body. It instead remains flat, sliding around in the mud it spits.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在泥坑里洗澡，包袱中也装满湿泥，方便随时泡一泡。正因如此，它不太飞得起来。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME enjoys bathing in mud puddles. Its bundle is filled with wet mud in case it feels like basking in it. For this reason, it doesn't fly well.

entry: 千万别碰头上的按钮！据说，POKENAME会诱人伸手，再骤然大量放电，狠狠电击对方。
author: merumsb
source: Don't touch the button on its head! It's said that POKENAME lures people into touching it, then electrocutes them with a massive discharge.

entry: POKENAME有时会陷入存在的迷惘。严重时，就四肢摊开、仰面躺下，低低嘀咕一声：“唉……”
author: Xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is prone to periods of existential crisis. When this problem worsens, it lies down flat on its back and a faint sound mutters out: "Man".

entry: POKENAME扁得几乎难用肉眼看见。科学家发现，它甚至比纸和人的发丝还薄。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is so flat that it is barely visible to the human eye. Scientists have found that it is thinner than paper and human hair.

entry: POKENAME用带电的幽灵根须，缠住毫无防备的猎物。诡异的身影，也让旅人警觉，阴影中潜藏着危险。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME ensnares unsuspecting prey with spectral electric roots. Its eerie presence warns wanderers of the dangers that dwell within the shadows.

entry: POKENAME身体软糯又柔韧，能轻松滑过泥地、挤进窄处。可触角与喙，却硬过花岗岩。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are mushy and flexible, able to slither around in mud with ease and fit in tight spaces. The antennae and beaks are harder than granite.

entry: 这是泥巴鱼的近亲，代谢缓慢，善于钻进地里潜藏。猎物一踩到半埋的身体，就会被它击昏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This cousin of Stunfisk has evolved a slow metabolism and ability to burrow in the ground to hide and stun prey who step in its half-hidden body.

entry: 泥巴鼠铺成一片“雷区”，这办法原本很聪明，可等猎物到手，又免不了为一顿饭吵起来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The strategy of a “minefield” of Stunletts seems smart, until they are left having to fight over the meal.

entry: POKENAME住在流沙坑。发现猎物，便装出痛苦模样，诱对方靠近，再将其拖入流沙。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives inside of quicksand pits. When it senses prey, it first beckons them by acting distressed, then pulls them under the quicksand.

entry: 它的大脑与神经系统，分散在全身各处，外面有厚厚的脂肪组织与软骨保护。
author: mx_wellman
source: This Pokémon's brain and nervous system are distributed all across its body, protected by thick layers of fatty tissue and cartilage.

entry: POKENAME随身带着一根精心制作的宝石手杖。若是手杖折断，它就会花上好几个星期，重做一根。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME carries around a carefully crafted gem staff. If the staff ever breaks, it will spend multiple weeks making a new one.

entry: 文学作品常把POKENAME描写成引魂者。这种说法，来自人们相信它能看见徘徊的灵魂。
author: 8xviktor
source: In literature, POKENAME are portrayed as spirit guides. This notion came from their supposed ability to see lingering souls.

entry: POKENAME与同族组成名为“万花筒”的群体，潜进废弃矿井，偷取贵重宝石。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: POKENAME form groups called "kaleidoscopes" with fellow POKENAME, pilfering abandoned mines for valuable gemstones.

entry: 据说，POKENAME潜伏阴影，爪利如刃，双眼像宝石般发亮。黑夜里，它是十分可怕的对手。
author: anarchaz
source: It's said that POKENAME lurks in the shadows with razor-sharp claws and glowing gem-like eyes. It's a fearsome adversary in the darkness of the night.

entry: 背上的宝石长成珊瑚模样，在月光下闪烁，还会随POKENAME的鸣声，一同共振。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: The gemstones on their back grow in coral shapes that shimmer in the moonlight. They resonate with POKENAME's cries.

entry: 铠甲比已知的任何金属都坚韧，让人怀疑，它根本来自另一个世界。挖掘宝石时，动作又几乎如机械一般。
author: PepperThePirate
source: Its armor is tougher than any known metal, making some believe it came from another world entirely. It digs for gems in an almost mechanical fashion.

entry: POKENAME像水流一样穿行地底最深处，将高压中诞生的无数晶体，导进大张的嘴里。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME moves through the deepest depths of the earth like water, funneling countless crystals born under the intense pressure into its waiting maw.

entry: 它们天性调皮，擅长从采石场偷走宝石和珠宝，还会恶作剧般地把赃物换成煤块。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Mischievous in nature, they have a knack for stealing gems and jewels from mining quarries and playfully replacing them with coal.

entry: POKENAME痴迷于蕴含元素力量的宝石。只有其中最强、能量最充沛的，才会被它留作手杖的力量之源。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME is obsessed with gems of elemental origin. It reserves only the strongest and most elementally charged gems to empower its staff.

entry: 据说，一只倒霉的梦妖魔，偶遇受诅咒的宝石。只一触碰，身体便被扭曲，化成了POKENAME。
author: j1miin
source: It's said that a very unfortunate Mismagius came across a cursed gem. By touching the gem, the Mismagius grew twisted, turning itself into POKENAME.

entry: 吃下的宝石，会变成施法的媒介。它夜里用闪烁的光折磨旅人，再把对方财物洗劫一空。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The gems it eats are processed into magical foci for its spells. It torments travelers at night with scintillating light, robbing them of everything.

entry: 据说，最贪婪的勾魂眼，死后仍不肯离去。灵魂永远附在中央核心，茫然嚼着那些再也消化不了的宝石。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: In death, it's said the most avaricious of Sableye linger, spirits forever attached to their central core, mindlessly munching gems they can't digest.

entry: 贪婪的POKENAME藏在洞穴深处，埋身财宝堆。人类或宝可梦只要靠得太近，宝物便会被它夺走。
author: Pizzarcato
source: The covetous POKENAME lurks in the depths of caves, buried in a pile of riches. It collects the treasures of people and Pokémon who come too close.

entry: POKENAME疯狂挖掘地下隧道，寻找可吸收的宝石，也会袭击矿工，抢走他们采得的宝物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME feverishly mines underground tunnels in search for gemstones to absorb. It also assaults miners for the gems they've found.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: POKENAME常藏在深洞，囤积宝物，再用这堆财宝作诱饵，把猎物引回巢。
author: Scapz
source: POKENAME is often found in deep caves, hoarding its treasure. It uses its hoard to lure prey into its lair.

entry: 它们用珠宝装饰尾巴。极少数时候，POKENAME会在特定洞穴举办比美，可最后往往又打了起来。
author: themicelegion
source: These Pokémon decorate their tails with jewels. Rarely, contests are held between POKENAME in select caves. These contests usually end in fights.

entry: 宝石太大，吞不进体内，POKENAME就背在身上。若受威胁，便吐出钱币与宝石迎击。
author: Neonriser
source: If a gemstone is too big to store inside its body, POKENAME carries it on its back instead. It spits out coins and gems to whatever threatens it.

entry: POKENAME有X射线般的夜视本领，能躲开洞内的登山者。偶尔，它也会现身，把宝石赠给爱护洞穴的人。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME uses its x-ray night vision to avoid hikers in the caves it lives in. Rarely it will emerge to gift gems to hikers that respect the caves.

entry: 它咬碎大块岩石，寻找藏在其中的宝石。凭巨大的颚，连硬宝石都能轻易嚼成可吸收的养分。
author: alliveir
source: It crunches through rocks and boulders in search of hidden gems. With its huge jaws, turning hard gems into absorbable nutrients is almost effortless.

entry: 翅膀振动产生超声波，为双眼蓄能。充好能量，眼睛便闪闪发亮，射出精确光束，切割宝石原矿。
author: alliveir
source: Its wings vibrate to produce ultrasonic waves that charge its bright eyes. When charged, its eyes glitter and fire precise beams to cut raw gemstones.

entry: 它们不用武艺，也不用烈火，仅凭沉着自信的举止，就能吓退大多数敌人，守住觅食地。
author: HoundRyS
source: These creatures protect their feeding grounds not with martial arts or fire, but rather with a calm, confident demeanor, which intimidates most foes.

entry: 流传甚广的一种说法认为，这种融合体，是很久以前统治丰缘的邪恶君王，转世而来。
author: 8xviktor
source: A popular theory has been floating around that suggests this fusion is the reincarnation of an evil king that ruled Hoenn long ago.

entry: 这只古老的POKENAME，曾与古代王族相伴。那一家人都已逝去，POKENAME却仍守着他们的宝藏。
author: MainManMcGoo
source: This ancient POKENAME was partnered with a monarch family in ancient times. After the family's passing, POKENAME continued to protect their treasure.

entry: 在不见天日的深隧道里，POKENAME不停搜寻宝石作为下一顿饭。水晶般的角与尾巴能轻松击碎基岩。
author: teravolt
source: In deep lightless tunnels, POKENAME is constantly in search of gems for its next meal. Its crystalline horns and tail smash through bedrock with ease.

entry: 有人推测，勾魂眼会收集珍贵宝石，搭建一个魔像。等它们外出找更多宝石，魔像便负责守住财宝。
author: TokenOracle
source: Theory suggests Sableye will gather precious gemstones to construct a golem.  It's tasked with protecting the hoard when they go and gather more gems.

entry: POKENAME用水晶，把地质学家引入洞中，再将他们困进地下洞窟。大多数人，终生都没能逃出。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME lure geologists into caves with crystals. It then captures the humans and traps them in a underground cavern from which most never escape.

entry: POKENAME常与进化前的勾魂星合作，引诱、捕捉地质学家。POKENAME盯紧这些人，谁想逃跑，便受到惩罚。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often lures and captures geologists with its pre-evolution, Sableanie. POKENAME keeps track of the humans, punishing those who try to escape.

entry: 诱人的歌声，让靠近的生物无不沉醉。它便趁对方分神，偷走身上的东西。
author: ohok3441
source: With its alluring voice, it'll captivate anyone close enough to listen. It'll use that distraction to steal from victims.

entry: 宝石越积越多，POKENAME的鬃毛也越长。即使已经被宝石压得沉重，它也不肯停止收集。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's mane grows as it gains more gems. It will not stop collecting gems, even when it's weighed down by them.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会变换形态作战。离开战场的敌人，往往满身咬痕、抓伤与淤青。
author: ohok3441
source: When threatened, POKENAME changes forms to fight. Foes will leave the battle with bites, scratches, and bruises.

entry: POKENAME很护着同伴，宁可自己冒险，也要保对方平安。可想先与它交上朋友，却实在不容易。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is protective of its allies, throwing itself into danger to keep them safe. Unfortunately, it's difficult to befriend in the first place.

entry: POKENAME爱吃石头，再吐出吹制玻璃般的造型。若找到一件这样的作品，也许就能赚上一大笔。
author: thatguy4115
source: POKENAME enjoy eating rocks and spitting them out as a sort of blown glass. Finding one of these sculptures could bring you into a large sum of money.

entry: 一点也不奇怪，POKENAME对贵重物品，贪得无厌。无论钱币还是珠宝，都逃不过它的贼手。
author: musicsheep.
source: Unsurprisingly, POKENAME is extremely greedy towards valuables. No coin nor jewel is safe from POKENAME's gluttonous thievery.

entry: 它收集宝石，啃出骨头的形状。兴奋时，身上的水晶会变得滚烫。
author: greystorm101
source: It collects gems and gnaws on them until they are shaped like bones. When it is excited, the crystals on its body are hot to the touch.

entry: 它对金属与宝石的贪欲和火焰一样炽烈，有时甚至把训练家也“收藏”起来，作为扭曲的爱。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Its intense avarice for metals and gems is only matched by the intensity of its flames. It sometimes 'collects' its Trainer as a twisted form of love.

entry: POKENAME痴迷敛财，见多少囤多少。哪怕只丢了一枚钱币，也会横冲直撞，直到那枚硬币物归原主。
author: Rakanadyo
source: POKENAME obsessively hoards as much wealth as it can find. If even a single coin is stolen, it will rampage across the land until it is returned.

entry: 食谱中某些特殊的宝石，让POKENAME一绷肌肉，就能胀大得离谱。围观者惊叹的目光，让它十分受用。
author: 8xviktor
source: Thanks to a diet comprised of very specific gems, POKENAME can flex its muscles to a ludicrous size. It loves the attention from awestruck bystanders.

entry: 它个头小，行迹隐秘，又因弱小，常为珍贵的铠甲遭到捕杀，因此目击记录寥寥。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: A small and stealthy Pokémon. Only a few have been seen, as it's quite weak and was often hunted for its valuable armor.

entry: 它住在水下洞穴，以水晶为食。吃的水晶不同，壳的颜色也会略有变化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lives in underwater caves and feeds on crystals. The color of its shell can therefore vary slightly depending on the type of crystal.

entry: 野生POKENAME贪婪成性，见到值钱的东西就偷，统统藏进有毒的身体里。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are known to be extremely greedy. They steal valuable objects wherever they can find them and hoard them within its toxic body.

entry: POKENAME宝石外壳的通透光泽，常能反映健康状况。壳越亮，身体便越好。
author: howlingstarr
source: The clarity of a POKENAME's gemstone shell often reflects its health; the shinier the shell, the healthier the fusion.

entry: 这种融合体很聪明，先把岩石宝可梦催眠，再将其吃掉。颈部的毛，竟由纯粹坚硬的钻石构成。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This is an intelligent fusion that uses hypnosis to put Rock-type Pokémon to sleep, then eats them. Its neck fur is made of pure, hard diamond.

entry: POKENAME以闪亮的岩石与矿物为食，常能在宝库里发现它们。
author: terminatphilippe
source: The POKENAME feeds on shiny rocks and minerals. They are often seen in treasure rooms.

entry: POKENAME为了偷一枚硬币，都能不择手段。大钳子厚实有力，想把硬币讨回来，可不容易。
author: homelessrager
source: POKENAME are very greedy fusions, and will do anything to steal a coin. It is hard to get coins back due to its big, meaty claw.

entry: 它的炮管，能射出锋利宝石。因为极少离壳，人们对真身究竟是什么，猜得五花八门。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can shoot sharp gemstones with its cannons. As it rarely leaves its shell, there is wild speculation about its true body.

entry: 它用嘴大量剥下松树皮，攒够几磅，便能在不到五分钟内，吃个精光。
author: .izik
source: It strips pine trees' bark off in great quantities with its mouth. Once it has several pounds gathered, it will eat it all in under five minutes.

entry: POKENAME头上的大触角，能感知近处的振动。再毒的植物，它也照吃不误。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a large antenna on its head with which it can locate vibrations in its immediate vicinity. It can eat even the most poisonous plants.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在毒草上，吸收毒性。到了夜晚，再借这些毒，展开凶猛狩猎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: During the day, POKENAME sleeps on poisonous plants to absorb their toxicity. It uses this at night to go on a fierce hunt.

entry: POKENAME虽小，天敌却不多。放出的电流会久久残留，起着神经毒素般的作用。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME is small, it has few predators. The electricity it discharges lingers and acts like a neurotoxin.

entry: 这是长着两颗头的百足蜈蚣。由于大多个体活不长，极其难得一见。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: A two-headed form of Venipede. They are exceptionally rare to find, as most don't live for very long.

entry: POKENAME不算好斗，毛发却会分泌剧毒。它也有些微弱的超能力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is not particularly aggressive, but its fur produces a highly poisonous secretion. It also has weak psychic powers.

entry: 毒腺为POKENAME的火焰供能，也让火呈现独特的色泽。它常在多雨沼泽中小跑，很少引起野火。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's fire is fueled by its venom gland, which gives the fire a distinctive hue. It trots along rainy marshes where it rarely causes wildfires.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: POKENAME高速滚下斜坡，再舒展身体放出电击。中招的生物有时连走路都困难。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME rolls down slopes at high speeds, then uncurls itself to unleash its electric attacks. Those shocked by one may have a hard time walking.

entry: 两只车轮球融合，让它更加稳当，速度也更快。可换来这些好处，也牺牲了几分灵活。
author: Soup1900
source: It's a Whirlipede that fused with itself, giving it more stability and speed. However, it sacrificed some of its maneuverability for these boosts.

entry: 中央的大个子，是群体首领，四周的小个子负责载着它移动，模样就像一辆车。
author: Soup1900
source: The big one in the middle is the leader of the pack. The small ones around it carry it around. They move around similarly to a car.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，时速最高能到75英里。当然，没必要时时这么快——总要求它拿出巅峰表现，未免也太苛刻了。
author: redhaering
source: POKENAME can swim at speeds of up to 75 mph. It's certainly not required to; it'd be unreasonable to expect it to be at peak performance all the time.

entry: 连崎岖不平的路，POKENAME也能滚过去。因此，在举办宝可梦拉力赛的地方，格外受欢迎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can even roll over uneven terrain. There are places where Pokémon rally races are held, where POKENAME is particularly popular.

entry: POKENAME常把身体蜷起来。人们认为，这种姿势，是为了让体温降下来。
author: .realthree
source: The curled stance that POKENAME is often seen in is believed to be a strategy for cooling its body temperature.

entry: POKENAME体内的毒素，能从全身孔隙释放。哪怕只碰一下，也会中毒，痛苦难忍。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME produces toxins in its body, which it can release through pores all over its body. Just touching it leads to painful poisoning.

entry: 它贴在墙上，监看闯入者。一有动静，便飞扑而下，咬住对方，注入致命毒液。
author: Skymaster426
source: It sticks to walls to keep an eye out for intruders. Whenever any enters, it flies down and bites any parts of their bodies, injecting a fatal poison.

entry: POKENAME的毒，令中招者深陷强烈恐惧。仅仅待在那里，就能催熟周围的所有植物。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME's relentless poison afflicts its targets with intense dread. Its mere presence accelerates the maturation of all plant life around it.

entry: POKENAME凶暴又护地盘。在自己的森林发现你，便毫不犹豫，将全身电力倾泻而出。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is very aggressive and territorial. If it spots you in its forest, it won't hesitate to discharge all of its electricity as an attack.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会斩伤、毒害一切闯入者。即使敌人逃出领地，也会追击不休，直到将其杀死。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, slicing and poisoning any and all invaders. Even those who flee its territory are continuously pursued until slain.

entry: POKENAME走起路来，震得大地发颤，气势慑人。那份重量，正来自作为铠甲的强韧外骨骼。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME is known for its menacing walk that shakes the earth. The reason for this creature's weight is the strong exoskeleton it uses as armor.

entry: POKENAME放出的强毒，能把周围海水染成深紫红色。强韧的外骨骼，则帮它抵御深海重压。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME releases a potent toxin which tints the sea around it a deep magenta. Its tough exoskeleton protects it from the pressure of the deep oceans.

entry: POKENAME栖居森林，身上刺目的颜色，便是对闯入者的警告。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME resides in forests. Its harsh colors are a warning to trespassers.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，就会斗到一方受伤。胜者夺走领地，败者则退到一旁，修复伤势。
author: OhOk3441
source: If two POKENAME meet, they'll fight until one is injured. The winner takes claim of the loser's territory, while the loser retreats to repair itself.

entry: 它夜里飞过森林，双眼如雷达般搜寻。POKENAME一发现猎物，就从远处射出麻痹的毒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It flies through forests at night, its eyes acting like a radar. If POKENAME spots prey, it shoots it over long distances with a paralyzing poison.

entry: 古老经文称POKENAME为虫中之神，相信它能用威猛的长嚎，号令蝗群。
author: Gurguro
source: Ancient scripture declares POKENAME to be a god amongst insects, commanding locusts with its mighty howl.

entry: POKENAME凶悍好斗，尤其容不下同族。两只POKENAME见面，就会用角状耳朵交锋，争个高下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is aggressive, especially with others of its species. When two POKENAME meet, they use their horn-like ears to fight for dominance.

entry: POKENAME惯了事事如意。一旦不顺心，就会躲起来，独自生闷气。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is used to getting its way. If it can't have things the way it wants, it hides itself and sulks.

entry: 它比普通的宝宝暴龙更加成熟，外貌也更接近1亿年前的样子。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: It is more mature than a normal Tyrunt. It also looks more similar to how it looked 100 million years ago.

entry: POKENAME是令人畏惧的深海猎手，用发光圆珠诱骗宝可梦，游进自己的巨口。
author: star_gazer57
source: POKENAME is known to be a feared hunter of the deep sea. It uses its light-orbs to lure Pokémon into its gigantic jaws.

entry: POKENAME独自狩猎，敢追逐体型是自身五倍的猎物。骨质大颚强劲，足以把猎物肢体撕开。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary hunters and will go after prey five times larger than itself. Their bony jaws are strong enough to rip its prey limb from limb.

entry: POKENAME曾因高超的武艺备受尊崇。它的利爪像镰刀盔的双镰一样锋利，出拳则像战槌龙的冲锋一样有力。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME was once revered for its martial prowess. Its claws are sharp as a Kabutops's scythe, and its blows as powerful as a Rampardos's charge.

entry: 这种危险、凶暴的宝可梦，是欧雷地区的入侵物种。成群出猎，一晚就能猎杀数百只猎物。
author: captainmodeus
source: This dangerous and violent Pokémon is an invasive species in the Orre region. A pack of them can hunt down hundreds of prey in one evening.

entry: 它们是背负整个生态系统的庞然巨兽。为了满足巨大的养分需求，常把丰饶的森林，糟蹋得一片狼藉。
author: Bobsterbot
source: Titanic beasts with ecosystems on their backs. To satiate their heavy need, they often ravage forests for the abundance of nutrients within them.

entry: POKENAME皮肤坚韧，连激光也切不穿。一记头槌，就能撞破金属墙。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's skin is extremely tough: not even lasers can cut through it. It can blast through metal walls by headbutting them.

entry: 它用强爪掘进硬土，藏入地下，伪装成石造物。猎物一来，便突然破土而出，将其吞食。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It digs itself into hard soil with its strong claws and masquerades as a stone structure in order to shoot out of the ground to eat its prey.

entry: 这种巨大、鲨鱼般的宝可梦，早已被认为灭绝。不过，一些记者相信，POKENAME仍活在深海沟底。
author: NellNast42
source: A massive shark-like Pokémon long thought to be extinct. However, some journalists believe POKENAME still reside deep in ocean trenches.

entry: POKENAME是“石英冰冻光束”队最出色的教练。比赛还没开始，它就能为成千上万种可能的打法，预先制定策略。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is the Indigo Ice Beams' best coach. It can concoct strategies for thousands of potential plays before a match even starts.

entry: 咬上敌人时，牙齿常会脱落。可不出几分钟，更多的新牙，就会长回来。
author: .izik
source: Its teeth fall out easily when they bite into a foe. Should this occur, more regrow within minutes.

entry: 被古老化石咬住，是否让POKENAME变笨，仍不清楚；可行动确实少多了，POKENAME几乎从不挪动。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is unclear whether being bitten by an ancient fossil has made POKENAME less intelligent, but it is certainly less active. POKENAME rarely moves.

entry: 一次失败的实验，让POKENAME身体开始融化。科学家虽努力尝试，却至今没找到能救它的方法。
author: imagine1.
source: The aftermath of an experiment gone wrong, POKENAME's body has started melting. There is no known way to save it, although scientists have tried.

entry: 有时能看见成群的它们沿雪坡滚下。寒夜里，还会互相放电，分享温暖。
author: snescontroller
source: Packs of this Pokémon can sometimes be seen rolling down snowy hills. On cold nights, they will share warmth by giving each other electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME在外人面前，有些害羞，便模仿墙上的文字，彼此交流。
author: Lemmymaster #7521
source: POKENAME are a little shy around others. They communicate by mimicking texts on the walls.

entry: POKENAME的身体是活生生的矛盾：火焰高达华氏18000度，冰却低到华氏零下18000度。它究竟怎么活着，谁也不懂。
author: typhloquil
source: A living contradiction: POKENAME's body is made of two extremes. The flames are 18,000°F, while the ice is -18,000°F. No one knows how it is alive.

entry: POKENAME偎在训练家身旁，不是为了取暖，只是想表达亲近。它会堆出小雪丘，自己玩耍，打发时间。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME will huddle near its Trainer not for warmth, but as a sign of affection. This Pokémon produces small snow piles to play in for enrichment.

entry: POKENAME创造的酷寒环境，很适合其他冰宝可梦。壳中甚至住着整座雪童子村落，受它保护。
author: Thropp
source: The frigid environment POKENAME creates is ideal for its fellow Ice Pokémon. Its shell houses a village of Snorunt, protecting them from harm.

entry: 暴风雪里，POKENAME会敞开外衣，为迷路旅人提供藏身之处。有人说，它是在保护他们，免受某只怪物伤害。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME can be found in heavy blizzards, offering shelter to lost travelers under its coat. Some say it protects from the danger caused by a monster.

entry: 雪童子常踩在彼此头上，想让人以为，它们也是人类。可惜，谁也骗不过。
author: zerocipher
source: Snorunt often stand on top of each other to fool humans into thinking they're also human. They don't fool anyone, unfortunately.

entry: POKENAME的血液不需要铁，也能在低温下顺利呼吸，因此不必遮蔽，就能活在冰封荒野。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME survives in icy wastelands with no cover because its blood does not require iron, allowing it to respirate easily in lower temperatures.

entry: POKENAME不停发抖，既能暖身，也能练肌肉。可太耗能量，因此肚子总是饿的。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's constant shivering warms it and strengthens its muscles. However, this uses a lot of energy, so it's always hungry.

entry: 若非继承了冰鬼护的悬浮本领，POKENAME连自己的头也抬不起。可这一口，却能咬碎坦克。
author: admiralvermin
source: Were it not for Glalie's ability to float, POKENAME would be unable to hold its own head up. Its bite is strong enough to crush a tank.

entry: POKENAME毛发覆着冰层，把双腿一收，便能贴着地面，滑出很远。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME have a layer of ice covering their fur. They're able to skate long distances by tucking their legs in and sliding on the ground.

entry: POKENAME曾长期活跃于职业曲棍球赛，可球打得太快、太猛，最终遭到禁赛。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME was popular in professional field hockey for a long time. However, they were banned due to their incredibly fast and powerful shot.

entry: POKENAME覆着触之冰冷的铠甲，一碰就能把人冻住。全身锋利的冰刺，却又很容易折断。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is covered with cool-to-the-touch armor that instantly freezes all who touch it. The razor-sharp icicles all along its body are very brittle.

entry: 作为石英冰冻光束队的一员，POKENAME常现身冰场。飘带不论缠上队友还是对手，都能借力，把自己甩向前方。
author: reddevil85
source: As part of the Indigo Ice Beams, POKENAME is often found on ice. It uses its ribbons to sling itself forward, using both teammate and opponent alike.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴制造雪暴，再用口中的火，引诱被困的人类与宝可梦。尖刺太多，让它自己无法移动。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME uses its tail to produce snowstorms and lure trapped Pokémon and humans with the flames of its mouth. Its spikes prevent it from moving.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: Lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: Lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: POKENAME性情凶悍，冰皮护身，毒液彻骨寒冷。狩猎时虽凶狠，却也很有耐心，对训练家忠诚无比。
author: weedspagon_real
source: POKENAME have a mean attitude, hides of ice, and chilling venom. While they are fierce hunters, they're also patient and very loyal to their Trainers.

entry: 这只庞大的融合体，喷出的寒气足以让夏日骤变为凛冽雪暴。仅仅待在附近，就可能令人失温。
author: 8xviktor
source: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.

entry: 这只庞大的融合体，喷出的寒气足以让夏日骤变为凛冽雪暴。仅仅待在附近，就可能令人失温。
author: 8xviktor
source: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.

entry: 这只庞大的融合体，喷出的寒气足以让夏日骤变为凛冽雪暴。仅仅待在附近，就可能令人失温。
author: 8xviktor
source: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.

entry: 这只庞大的融合体，喷出的寒气足以让夏日骤变为凛冽雪暴。仅仅待在附近，就可能令人失温。
author: 8xviktor
source: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.

entry: 它的外貌与超级冰鬼护极为相似。断裂的下颌，让它不断从口中喷出暴风雪。
author: Soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega Glalie. Its broken jaw causes it to spew endless blizzards from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME曾是“石英冰冻光束”队的吉祥物，可它缺乏鲜明个性，最终被冰人偶取代。
author: T.I.A.
source: The former mascot of the Indigo Ice Beams. POKENAME's lack of attitude made it obsolete when Glamime replaced it.

entry: 队友常把它头上的饰物，误认成冰球。若比赛里突然多了个球，多半就是从POKENAME身上来的。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: Its teammates often mistake the charm on its head for a hockey puck. If there's ever multiple pucks in a game, it's likely one came from a POKENAME.

entry: 曾有记录，POKENAME会抚育误闯深山、迷失的孩子。谁若伤害这些孩子，它就喷出冰息，将其冻住。
author: tr3bles
source: There are records of POKENAME rearing lost children who have wandered into the mountains. It freezes those who harm its children with its icy breath.

entry: 它优雅的动作，会吸引雪山中的旅人。可千万小心，被它看中的人，会被冻成冰，带回家当作收藏。
author: tr3bles
source: Its movements allure hikers in snowy mountains. But beware, for it freezes those it fancies and takes them home as trophies.

entry: 这位冰冷的歌后，会审视站到自己面前的每个人，再以幻象与周身寒气，让对手忐忑不安。
author: funkytomate
source: This ice-cold diva will judge anyone standing before it. It uses illusions and the constant cold around it to make opponents feel uneasy.

entry: POKENAME常现身雾气浓重的寒地。它所居的水域里，能找到好几具冻住的潜水者遗体。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually sighted in colder regions with large amounts of fog. The frozen bodies of several divers can be found in POKENAME's waters.

entry: POKENAME十分胆怯，喜欢在无人山巅独处。花朵散出的气味，让人想起寒冬。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon, preferring the solace of lonely mountaintops. The smell of its flowers remind people of a cold winter day.

entry: POKENAME乐于结识栖息地附近的旅人。它虽友好，可那双冰手，依然得小心。
author: birchbot
source: POKENAME loves meeting travelers that come around its habitat. Even though it is friendly, people should beware of its frigid hands.

entry: 心跳越快，能放出的电力便越多；心跳越慢，吐出的冰息便越寒冷。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The higher its heart rate, the more electrical energy it's able to output. The lower its heart rate, the colder its icy breath is.

entry: 它从山上赶来，警告雪崩将至。可人们常误以为它招来灾难，横加迫害，反把警告置之不理。
author: tr3bles
source: It descends from the mountains to warn of incoming avalanches. It's often mistaken it for a harbinger of disaster and persecuted, its warning ignored.

entry: POKENAME隐居雪山，似乎只存在于传说与寓言。据说，它会用翅膀，在雪上轻轻行走。
author: tr3bles
source: A Pokémon heard only in legends and fables, POKENAME hides away in snowy mountains. It is said that it uses its wings to trek lightly over the snow.

entry: 獠牙由零度以下的坚冰构成，强韧如钢。POKENAME通常住在既危险，又寒冷的冰窟。
author: Soup1900
source: Its tusks are made of subzero ice that is as strong as steel. POKENAME usually resides in icy caves where it is both treacherous and cold.

entry: 它是一位高洁的幽灵。许多在暴风雪中迷路的登山者，都说先是忽然寒彻骨髓，随后又感到令人安心的暖意。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is a noble spirit. Many hikers who've been lost in a blizzard reported feeling a sudden sensation of extreme cold followed by pleasant heat.

entry: 这种POKENAME虽有高洁的灵魂，骇人的冰面具与缺失的后腿，却仍让许多登山者心生畏惧。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though this POKENAME variant has a noble spirit, it is feared by many climbers due to its ghastly ice-mask, and its lack of hind legs.

entry: 这是为亲近人类而培育的POKENAME，深受上流社会与华丽大赛的欢迎，也因此，自视甚高。
author: char_latte3412
source: A POKENAME variant bred for domestication. It is popular amongst the upper-class and within Pokémon contests. Accordingly, it has a very large ego.

entry: POKENAME含蓄而神秘，唯有与训练家结下深厚羁绊，才肯敞开心扉。它也能以冰寒的长嚎，唤来暴风雪。
author: kittyluv090
source: Very reserved and secretive, POKENAME will only open up to a Trainer it has deeply bonded with. It can summon snowstorms with its chilling howls.

entry: 逝去的贵族公主，其灵魂化作了POKENAME。它居住在废弃山城，统御其他冰宝可梦。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME was created from the soul of a fallen noble princess. It resides in abandoned mountain castles and rules over other Ice-type Pokémon.

entry: 近零下60度的冰息，加上能掀起雪暴的翅膀，让它轻易冻住猎物。它最爱吃的，是小型昆虫。
author: tr3bles
source: Its icy breath of nearly 60 degrees below zero and wings that can create blizzards can easily freeze prey. It likes to feed on smaller insects.

entry: POKENAME是夜行宝可梦。振翅间，雪与粉末一同撒下，既能让对手冻结，也能使其麻痹或中毒。
author: tr3bles
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature. At the flap of its wings, it releases a mix of snow and powder that can freeze, paralyze, or poison opponents.

entry: POKENAME先讨人喜爱，再把对方引入严寒，任其死去。若看见POKENAME向你招手，千万别跟过去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME endears itself to humans, then leads them out into the cold to perish. If you see a POKENAME beckoning to you, never follow it.

entry: POKENAME优雅地滑游冰冷水域，也常仔细梳理背上的飘带。
author: Xephyr
source: It glides through icy waters gracefully. POKENAME grooms the ribbon on its back often.

entry: POKENAME每节身体都甜得出奇，尤其是头，还会散出蕉香果般的香气。
author: .izik
source: Each segment of a POKENAME is extremely sweet in flavor. The sweetest portion is the head, which emits an aroma that mimics Nanab Berries.

entry: 进化之后，POKENAME会立刻寻找肥沃松土，钻入其中。可占地太多，让许多农民不喜欢它。
author: kittyluv090
source: Immediately after evolving, POKENAME will go looking for rich, soft soil to burrow into. Many farmers dislike POKENAME due to it taking up space.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME高速自转，既能产生超能力，也能用飞叶风暴，将来犯者赶跑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can rotate rapidly on its own axis to generate psychic powers or to send attackers fleeing with Leaf Storm.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋入地下，只让叶子朝着太阳。谁若打扰，它们便会一路追赶，绝不罢休。
author: cyberleviathan
source: POKENAME often bury their bodies underground with their leaves facing up toward the sun. If disturbed, they will pursue the offender relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME多生活在浅水与河岸。虽住在水里，肌肉却软弱无力，很容易就被水流冲走。
author: Deflador
source: POKENAME is mostly found in shallow water and riverbanks. While it does live in the water, its muscles are so weak that it can easily be washed away.

entry: POKENAME既能变成宝可梦，也能变成植物。可身上总飘出甜香，轻易就露了馅。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME can transform into both Pokémon and plants. It constantly emits a sweet aroma that reveals its disguise.

entry: 月亮升起，POKENAME不管自己多大，仍想钻进土里。可没挖多深，就放弃了，心满意足地在地面睡下。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite its size, POKENAME will try to bury itself when the moon rises. It doesn't get far before giving up and slumbering contently above-ground.

entry: POKENAME一天睡上16个多小时。醒着的时候，叶片、细枝，甚至泥土，都要吃进去，填补惊人的胃口。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME will sleep for over 16 hours a day. During its waking hours, it will consume leaves, twigs, and even soil to satiate its monstrous hunger.

entry: POKENAME极爱夜行，晚上四处播种，竭力赶走靠近的生物；白天则躲进潮湿洞穴睡觉。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A heavily nocturnal Pokémon, POKENAME sows seeds at night, doing its best to chase away any who draw near. It sleeps in damp caves during daytime.

entry: 它慢慢挪过地面，嗅寻埋藏的食物。一闻到气味，就用小爪子开挖。
author: themicelegion
source: It shuffles around the ground, sniffing for buried food. When it smells food, it begins to dig into the ground with its small paws.

entry: POKENAME最初被融合出来时，科学家费了好大劲，才想弄清，究竟哪张脸才是真的。
author: pokebio
source: When POKENAME was fused for the first time, scientists had a hard time figuring out which face was the true one.

entry: 腿部积蓄了过多养分，让POKENAME长成独特的模样。它会用强劲的踢击，保护小小的走路草。
author: chartanon
source: An excessive amount of nutrients built up in the legs gave POKENAME its unique appearance. It protects smaller Oddish with powerful kicks.

entry: 背上的杂草一直无人修整，已经长得硕大无比。沐浴月光时，它的力量还会更强。
author: Soup1900
source: The weeds on its back have been left untouched, allowing them to grow large in size. It is more powerful when in the moonlight.

entry: 它是人类的天敌。人一被困进植物般的大嘴，巨口便会猛然合下。
author: TheHeroicT
source: This Pokémon is a natural predator for humans. The large plant-mouth it has will bite down when a human is trapped inside.

entry: POKENAME身体中空，轻得出乎意料，还会把小型宝可梦与植物，收进身体里面。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body is hollow, making it deceptively light. It'll store smaller Pokémon and plants within itself.

entry: 白天，POKENAME像木桩一样扎在土里。唯有月光洒下，这根手杖才会自行拔地而起，悬浮在半空。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME stakes in the ground during the daytime. The staff only uproots itself and hovers above the ground under the moonlight.

entry: 背上的枝叶，拼成了一副假躯干。遭天敌袭击时，便将这假身舍去，趁机逃走。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It creates a false torso with the leafage on its back. When attacked by predators, it will shed this false body and flee.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: 它对什么都提不起兴趣。不管看见什么，总是一张空白的脸，木然走来走去。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon has no interest in anything. It walks around with a blank expression on its face at all times, no matter what it sees.

entry: 喝的水越多，头上的叶子就越大。过了一个月，叶子会脱落，再从原处重新长出。
author: .izik
source: The leaf on its head will grow larger based on how much water it drinks. After a month it will fall off and regrow in the exact same spot.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯，喜欢整天坐着，让脸晒太阳，焦急盼着脸上的种子，有朝一日能开花。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: POKENAME is a simple Pokémon, preferring to sit around all day with its face in the sun. It anxiously awaits the day its facial seeds will flower.

entry: POKENAME模样虽然不讨喜，性情却很温顺。白天躲避天敌，夜里再靠月光进行光合作用。
author: ETheWriter
source: Despite their off-putting appearance, POKENAME are docile. They hide from predators in the day and photosynthesize using the moon at night.

entry: 手中那根“棍子”，其实是好几片长草叶团成的。谁敢割掉它的草，就会遭到反击。
author: Soup1900
source: The stick it carries is actually multiple blades of tall grass wadded together. It fights against anyone who tries to mow down its grass.

entry: 不祥的笑容，让许多人胆寒。即使最勇敢的人，也很难盯着POKENAME，撑满一分钟。
author: 8xviktor
source: Its ominous smile has been regarded by many people as terrifying. Even the bravest people have a tough time looking at POKENAME for at least a minute.

entry: 它用丝线辅助复杂的舞步。可若跳得太快，也可能不小心把线点着。
author: .izik
source: It will use silky string to assist in its elaborate dances. If it dances too quickly, it may accidentally light the strings on fire.

entry: 身体射出的丝，温度极高。若落在干叶堆里，便可能引起大规模山火。
author: .izik
source: The silk it shoots from its body is extremely hot. If it ever lands in dried leaves, it can cause a massive forest fire.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺地嬉戏，可一看见自己的倒影，就会暴怒，扑上去攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME typically frolics docilly, but if it catches sight of its reflection, it rages and attacks.

entry: 迷人的舞姿，来自刻苦练习。最好别打扰训练——它们一烦，可会往人脚趾上踩。
author: Quote.lass
source: Their mesmerizing dances are the result of intense practice. Best not to interrupt their training—they've been know to stomp toes when annoyed.

entry: POKENAME常照料受伤的鸟类。遇险时，便在自己与病号周围，卷起小小的火焰旋涡。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often are found tending to injured birds. It will create a small Fire Spin around itself and its patients when in danger.

entry: 野生POKENAME会以舞蹈，织出绚烂的幻象，诱来小宝可梦，当作点心。
author: manwithagun
source: Wild POKENAME are often seen forming dazzling illusions through dance. It uses this skill to lure in smaller Pokémon for a snack.

entry: 湖岸上，常见POKENAME扑腾乱动。可那看似胡乱挥舞的动作，其实是它特意编好的舞。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME can often be seen flopping on lake shores. Its flailing is actually an intentional dance routine.

entry: 它起舞时，会掀起一道道火浪。若没有六只脚，这套舞步，根本学不来。
author: b_megamaths
source: It creates waves of fire when it dances. Its style of dancing is impossible to replicate without six feet.

entry: 这只宝可梦极富艺术天分，一边跳着繁复的舞步，一边用火焰绘出引人入胜的图画。
author: birchbot
source: This Pokémon has a strong artistic spirit. It performs elaborate dances while creating intriguing illustrations with fire.

entry: POKENAME既被尊为创造者，也被敬畏为毁灭者。起舞时卷起的火焰，却不会伤到同伴。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME is venerated as both a creator and destroyer. The flames it whips up while dancing do not burn its allies.

entry: 头顶羽毛散出浓烈的柑橘香。它会用羽毛落下的粉末，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on top of its head let loose a strong citrus scent. It will use the powder from this to mark its territory.

entry: 它原是一只花舞鸟遗落的绒球，如今却有着一点就炸的脾气。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An abandoned pom-pom that belonged to an Oricorio. It has an explosive personality.

entry: 它摩擦羽毛，积蓄静电。每天都为身体充好电，等待终将到来的进化。
author: .izik
source: It builds up static by rubbing its feathers together. It charges up its body daily, waiting for its eventual evolution.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在挥着丝网绒球跳舞。若有人不喜欢这舞，它可能就让对方中毒，或挨一记电。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is almost always dancing with its webbed pom-poms. If someone dislikes its dancing, it may poison or electrify them.

entry: 绒球让POKENAME笑容灿烂。身体也进化得极其柔韧，整套字母的形状，都能摆出来。
author: birchbot
source: Its pompoms give POKENAME its bright smile. Its entire body has evolved to be flexible enough to pose as the whole alphabet.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀上棉絮摩擦出的静电发电，飞散的火花，能照亮天空。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME generates electricity through static generated from the cotton on its wings, illuminating the sky with sparks.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的种子，被电力爆开了，模样让它成了速食爆米花品牌，很受欢迎的吉祥物。
author: .realthree
source: Electricity caused the seed that makes up POKENAME's body to pop open. It's a popular mascot for instant popcorn brands.

entry: 奇特的身体不停变成各种加油助威的姿势。多只POKENAME聚在一起时，神秘的动作也会同步。
author: missingmilkman
source: Its odd anatomy shifts continuously into various cheering poses. When multiple POKENAME are together, their enigmatic movements will synchronize.

entry: 这只开朗的厚皮宝可梦，最爱逗大家开心。POKENAME虽然温顺，真遇上敌人，也毫不犹豫地挥起绒球，给对方狠狠一记电击。
author: Thropp
source: This cheerful pachyderm loves to make others smile. Although docile, POKENAME is not afraid to use its pom-pom to give its enemies a nasty shock.

entry: POKENAME以绚丽舞步驾驭天空。富有韵律的身姿与安详神态，让天际也显得和谐美丽。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME commands the skies with dazzling dance moves. Its rhythmic movements and serene demeanor bring harmony and beauty to the heavens.

entry: 这种POKENAME的脸，很像某个薯片品牌的吉祥物，因此常被请去，拍它们的广告。
author: mercury_sc
source: The face of this specific POKENAME resembles the mascot of a certain chip brand. Because of this, it is usually featured in their commercials.

entry: 宝可梦全能竞技赛的裁判发现，POKENAME会借助欢呼声，通过心灵感应指挥训练家，引发了一场丑闻。如今，它们已被禁止进入竞技巨蛋。
author: Quote.lass
source: A scandal occurred when Pokéathlon judges learned POKENAME were directing their Trainers telepathically via cheers. They're now banned from the dome.

entry: POKENAME的动作，既点燃队友的斗志，也震撼对手的心。摇起绒球，电力便一点点积蓄起来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME electrifies its teammates' spirits and opponents' hearts with its moves. It shakes its pom-pom to build up its electric charge.

entry: POKENAME摇动耳朵与尾巴，跳得十分起劲。可太兴奋时，又会不小心用静电电到自己。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME shakes its ears and tail in a great dance. When it gets too excited, POKENAME accidentally shocks itself with static electricity.

entry: 野外若见到POKENAME，多半正在给其他宝可梦加油。它精力十足，总是乐观昂扬。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: If you see a POKENAME in the wild, chances are it is cheering for another Pokémon. It is very energetic and upbeat.

entry: POKENAME拼命挥舞绒球，既能发电，也能吓敌。若看见它起舞，可得留神！
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME waves its pom-poms wildly to generate electrical power and intimidate enemies. If you see it dancing, beware!

entry: POKENAME拼命挥舞绒球，既能发电，也能吓敌。若看见它起舞，可得留神！
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME waves its pom-poms wildly to generate electrical power and intimidate enemies. If you see it dancing, beware!

entry: POKENAME的口器适于吸食花蜜。喝下的蜜是什么滋味，也会影响寄生在它身上的蘑菇。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's mouthpart is specialized for sipping nectar from flowers. The flavor of nectar it drinks has an effect on the mushrooms it hosts.

entry: 它想用绒球拼出“艳压全场”的英文口号，可惜偏偏有阅读障碍。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: Its pompoms are meant to spell "SLAY". Unfortunately, it is dyslexic.

entry: POKENAME挥着带电的绒球，为队友呐喊。有时却糊涂了，给对手加起油。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME cheers on its teammates with its electrical pom-poms. Sometimes it gets confused and cheers on the wrong side.

entry: 它用身上的毛，拂去自己的忧愁，再把负面能量传给来犯的天敌，让对方不敢轻易下手。
author: @alliveir
source: It uses the hairs on its body to brush its worries away. It expels the negative energy by passing it onto hostile predators, making them think twice.

entry: 它的茧由柔软的丝精密编织而成。茧中散发的精神能量，让POKENAME感到十分安心。
author: alliveir
source: Its cocoon is intricately woven together by silk that is soft to the touch. The psychic energy radiating from the cocoon puts POKENAME at ease.

entry: POKENAME爱在空中跳舞。随心情不同，携带的精神能量或好或坏，也会随摇摆身姿，流向风中。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME loves to dance in the air. They carry good or bad psychic energy according to their mood, the energy flowing with the wind as they sway.

entry: 有人相信，它的棕榈叶能安抚情绪。可谁想摘一片，POKENAME便会警戒起来。
author: birchbot
source: Some people believe that its palm leaves possess calming properties. POKENAME will get defensive if you try to take one of its leaves.

entry: 它总轻轻左右摇摆。听见什么音乐，身体便会顺着节奏，一同起舞。
author: missingmilkman
source: This Pokémon gently sways back and forth at all times. It will synchronize its movements with any music that it hears.

entry: 阿罗拉常能看到POKENAME迎接游客。它还能借超能力，让旅人对接下来的行程，更加兴奋。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often seen greeting tourists in Alola. It can use psychic powers to make travelers more excited for their trip.

entry: 激烈的舞蹈，能改变天气。它们只用动作交流，可谁都能看懂其中的意思。
author: Quote.lass
source: Their intense dances can change the weather. They communicate exclusively through movement, but no one struggles to understand them.

entry: 在阿罗拉的医院里，POKENAME会陪着临终之人，再用舞蹈，引领离去的灵魂，走向安宁。
author: typhloquil
source: In Alolan hospitals, POKENAME is kept to be by the side of those who are about to pass away. It uses its dance to guide departed souls to peace.

entry: POKENAME耳中能奏出配合舞步的音乐。飞行时，还会让花瓣悬浮起来，围着身体旋转。
author: michaelkai
source: POKENAME can play music from their ears that matches their style of dance. They levitate flower petals to spin around them while they fly.

entry: POKENAME优雅摇摆，闪过对手的攻击，再顺势接上一记流畅的锁颈。
author: .realthree
source: With graceful, swaying movements, POKENAME dodges its opponents' attacks and performs a flowing headlock.

entry: 起舞时，它会放出催眠波，减轻疼痛、安抚情绪，因此常与医生结伴。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: While dancing, it produces hypnotic waves that reduce pain and induce calm, which is why they are a frequent companion of doctors.

entry: 触角放出的苦味粉末，能制成疗伤药膏。粉末越苦，药效便越强。
author: .izik
source: Its antennae lets off a bitter powder that has been used in healing poultices. The more bitter the powder is, the stronger the poultice will be.

entry: 清爽村的工匠会收集POKENAME吐出的丝，用来缝制量身定做的芭蕾舞鞋。
author: .izik
source: The silk that a POKENAME dispenses is used by crafters in Rifure Village. The string is used to create custom-made ballet slippers.

entry: POKENAME平静得仿佛从不生气，可出手却毫无征兆，骤然袭来，总瞄着最致命的一击。
author: grassfella
source: POKENAME has an incredibly calm disposition, never seeming to anger. It strikes suddenly and without warning, always going for the deadliest blow.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅战斗，优雅的模样却常受赞叹。神社与寺庙附近的池塘，时常能见它游动。
author: kittyluv090
source: Despite its poor fighting skills, POKENAME is often praised for its elegant appearance. It can be found swimming in ponds near shrines and temples.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的羽毛比雌性更大、更鲜艳。它们一同起舞，要与远古世界再度相连。
author: Mistymagius
source: Male POKENAME have larger and more vibrant feathers than the females. They dance together to reunite themselves with the ancient world.

entry: 感知到树木行将枯死，它就待在附近。受它影响，树叶会渐渐染成淡紫色。
author: birchbot
source: If it senses a tree that is near the end of life, it will hang out there. Its presence causes the tree's leaves to turn a lavender color.

entry: 每过一周，旧外壳便会脱落。落下的材料，味道苦得很。
author: .realthree
source: Every week, its old casing falls off. This cast-off material has a very bitter taste.

entry: 它挥动刀刃般的双手斩击，动作宛如舞蹈。凭借诡异的力量，即使敌人的体型有它的10倍，它也能将其击倒。
author: grassfella
source: It slashes with its bladed hands as if it were dancing. It can fell foes even 10 times its size with its ghastly powers.

entry: POKENAME是当地游姿最优雅的宝可梦之一。传说，迷失海中的亡魂，会在水下尾随它。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: POKENAME is one of the most elegant swimmers in the region. Tales say spirits lost at sea trail behind it underwater.

entry: POKENAME能感知人类与宝可梦的情绪，把其中恶意抽出来，作为自身力量的燃料。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of people and Pokémon. It draws out their malice to use as fuel for its powers.

entry: POKENAME自尊心强，训练又有素。它们组成的表演团，早已成为城都各地节庆、茶馆与精致花园的常客。
author: Quote.lass
source: Proud and disciplined, performing troupes of POKENAME have become mainstays in festivals, tea houses, and elaborate gardens across Johto.

entry: POKENAME起舞，会扭曲周围生物的感知。受害者眼前，便满是万花筒般的色彩，常因此陷入疯狂。
author: Fenragon
source: When POKENAME dances, it warps the perception of those around it. Its victims see a kaleidoscope of colors, which often causes bouts of madness.

entry: 迷人的舞蹈，会唤出亡者的幻影。扇子轻轻一挥，又留下几缕漂浮的鬼火。
author: _aphoric
source: Its mesmerizing dance creates illusions of the dead. A swipe of its fan leaves behind floating will-o-wisps.

entry: 据说，它能唤来大雨，终结干旱。可若在岸边看见那梦幻般的舞蹈，也会身中重重诅咒。
author: bunkachunka
source: It is said to bring an end to droughts with a heavy rain. However, those who witness its dreamy dance by the shore fall under a heavy curse.

entry: POKENAME热爱音乐，会逼乐手一直播到天明。谁若拒绝，或撑不下去，就会遭它的幽火诅咒。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME loves music and will force musicians to continue playing until dawn. Musicians that refuse or fail are cursed by its eerie flames.

entry: 它在暴风雪中现身，用亡者的迷人幻影引诱受害者。POKENAME出没的地方，失踪案格外多。
author: Rawthorn
source: It appears during blizzards, using alluring visions of the dead to attract their victims. Regions POKENAME inhabit have high cases of missing persons.

entry: 它努力跳着繁复舞步，想博得路人喜爱。可大多数人，根本不停下，看一眼POKENAME的舞。
author: themicelegion
source: It tries to enamor passersby with its intricate dances. However, most people don't stop to watch POKENAME's dancing.

entry: 这只电龙，已经适应了垃圾场生活。因为名字的缘故，还意外成了兄弟情谊的象征。
author: mx_wellman
source: This Ampharos has adapted to live in garbage dumps. Due to its name, it has become somewhat of an icon of fraternal relationships.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡城市，收集沿途垃圾。若见有人乱扔，就会动怒，上前攻击。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME can typically be found wandering cities at night, collecting trash they find. If one sees a person littering, they become hostile and attack.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在受污染的海滩与公园，收集垃圾，平时吃的，多是烂树果与人类丢掉的废物。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME will linger around polluted beaches and parks to collect garbage. Their diet usually consists of rotten berries and discarded human trash.

entry: 最初，人们在一家废弃玩具工厂附近发现它。它会捡来坏玩具，修补、加固脆弱的身体。
author: antomelon
source: This Pokémon was first observed near an abandoned toy factory. It gathers broken toys to reinforce and fix its frail body.

entry: 它常翻垃圾桶，寻找剩饭剩菜。有些厨师，也会让它帮忙清理食物残渣。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is often found rooting through trash cans, looking for food scraps. Some chefs use it to help clean up food-related messes.

entry: POKENAME用可爱模样，吸引还不知道它有多臭的居民。等气味把人熏昏，POKENAME便偷光对方带着的食物。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME uses its cuteness to attract locals who don't know of its stench. Once the smell knocks them out, POKENAME steals any food they had on them.

entry: 它碰过的植物，都会开始枯萎。可头上那株，却不怕毒，总能再长出新叶。
author: antomelon
source: Every plant it comes into contact with starts to shrivel. However, the plant on its head survives the toxicity and always regrows its leaves.

entry: 据说，POKENAME被垃圾之灵附身。因为遭人丢弃，如今满心怨恨，想向人类复仇。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by the spirit of garbage, vengeful towards humans for having been thrown away.

entry: POKENAME爱在排放毒物的工厂边漂浮，吸进污染物，反能净化空气，自己却变得更强、更毒。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME enjoys floating by factories spewing toxic chemicals. It can clean the air by inhaling these pollutants, becoming stronger and more toxic.

entry: POKENAME总带着烧塑料的味道，住在大城市，靠餐馆后面的垃圾箱觅食。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME always smell like burning plastic. They live in large cities, and feed off dumpsters behind restaurants.

entry: 它带着恶臭，漂在市区。教育节目常把它当作“可爱”的城市污染象征。
author: Staghorn
source: It floats around urban areas, accompanied by a foul odor. Educational shows often use them as a "cute" representation of urban pollution.

entry: 这个胆小的垃圾小妖，常在垃圾桶与填埋场翻找。穿着废垃圾袋做的衣裳，很容易就藏进周围。
author: holgast
source: This skittish trash goblin is often seen rummaging through bins and landfill. It blends in with its clothing made of discarded garbage bags.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME爱把一袋闪亮东西撒满场，再逐个吃掉。可袋里装的，往往不过是垃圾。
author: TokenOracle
source: When POKENAME battles, it prefers to throw its bag of shiny objects all over the arena, before eating its contents. The bag often contains garbage.

entry: 埋在填埋场下的颚之化石，能被复原成POKENAME。它生前最爱吃的，是臭泥一种早已灭绝的近亲。
author: MrPeach774
source: When a Jaw Fossil is found buried beneath a landfill, it can be resurrected into a POKENAME. Its favorite food was a now extinct cousin of Grimer.

entry: POKENAME的大颚，连最难处理的垃圾也能轻易撕开。吃过最爱的食物，还会放出数百万年不曾出现的毒气。
author: MrPeach774
source: A POKENAME's jaws easily tear through the toughest garbage. After eating its favorite meal, it releases toxic gases not seen for millions of years.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: 它诞生于废物与毒素，在城市污秽间生长旺盛，用敏锐的双眼追踪猎物。
author: anarchaz
source: Born from a mix of waste and toxins, it thrives amidst urban filth. It tracks prey with its keen eyes.

entry: POKENAME对垃圾如痴如狂，最爱污秽。有时为抢地盘打起来，成堆垃圾便满天乱飞。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME are absolute fiends for trash, obsessed with filth. Some will even engage in turf wars where heaps of trash fly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢盘在垃圾箱里睡觉。有东西靠近，便立起身，展开颈部的兜状皮膜，从箱中探出。
author: _aphoric
source: POKENAME prefers to sleep coiled up inside a dumpster. If it senses something approaching, it rises up from the dumpster with its hood flared out.

entry: POKENAME到填埋场寻找废布，给自己做衣服。在它看来，土豆袋这样朴素的装扮，才最好看。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME searches landfills for discarded cloth to dress itself in. It believes it looks best in simple things like potato sacks.

entry: 有人打趣说，这种融合体，不过是一个垃圾袋，封住了108股臭味。发怒时，还会散出有毒蒸气。
author: OhOk3441
source: It has been joked that this fusion is 108 bad smells bound within a trash bag. It wafts toxic vapor in the air when angry.

entry: POKENAME敌意强、力量又大，十分难驯。训练家若没做好准备，就可能被垃圾堆与毒泥淹没。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is a hard-to-tame fusion thanks to its hostility and power. Unprepared Trainers find themselves buried under trash hoards and toxic sludge.

entry: 人类把垃圾扔进大海，才产生了POKENAME。它漂浮着，带着垃圾越聚越多，成了一座垃圾岛。
author: gamelord64
source: POKENAME is a result of people throwing things away in the ocean. It floats and takes trash with it, making an island of trash.

entry: POKENAME很享受大城市的污浊空气与泛滥垃圾。可在人们眼里，这个都市衰败、自然受损的象征，实在令人厌烦。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME enjoy the polluted air and overflowing trash found in big cities. Many see this symbol of urban decay and disruption of nature as a nuisance.

entry: 它追着垃圾运输船撞，直到船沉。若不阻止，单是一只POKENAME，就能让整座港口无法居住。
author: Staghorn
source: It hunts down garbage-carrying boats and rams them until they sink. Even a single POKENAME can render a harbor uninhabitable if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME偷来垃圾桶盖，保护身体内部。后来黏得太牢，索性站在桶盖边缘，把它当轮子滚。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has stolen a dustbin lid to protect its insides. It is now so firmly stuck to it that it can stand on the edge and use it as a wheel.

entry: POKENAME在城市很常见，可太过害羞，难得见到。它们按垃圾藏品的好坏，排出群体的高低地位。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME are common in cities, but they're so shy that they're rarely seen. They form social hierarchies based on who has the best garbage collection.

entry: 它睡在废品堆，藏进垃圾袋之间伪装。也爱收集各类垃圾，向其他伙伴炫耀。
author: greystorm101
source: It sleeps in junkyards and hides amongst trash bags for camouflage. It enjoys collecting various types of garbage and showing it off to others.

entry: POKENAME打架的方式很古怪：先把垃圾扔向其他宝可梦，再把垃圾吃掉。遇上时运不济的训练家，也会送上一颗蛋。
author: rnrhorrorshow
source: POKENAME battles unusually. It throws its own garbage at other Pokémon and then eats the garbage. It also gives eggs to Trainers down on their luck.

entry: 凡在面前晃动的东西，POKENAME都忍不住咬下去——小心手指！它的大颚，可连石头都能咬碎。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME compulsively bites anything that moves by its face, so watch your fingers! Its jaw has enough strength to crush rocks.

entry: 皮肤能察觉极微弱的振动，让POKENAME在漆黑海底，也能发现数千米深处的猎物。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME senses even the faintest vibrations through its skin. This enables it to detect prey many thousands of meters deep in the pitch-black ocean.

entry: POKENAME能张大颚，吞下比自己还大的猎物。不过，它只挑那些无法从体内伤害自己的目标。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME can stretch its jaws and consume prey larger than its body. It only targets prey that is incapable of damaging it from within.

entry: 这只POKENAME拥有整群鱼的力量与凶性，会率领小鱼群，贪婪地四处肆虐。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: This POKENAME has the strength and aggression of a whole school. It will lead swarms of smaller fry on a voracious rampage.

entry: 尾巴上的利牙鱼，已化成化石，成了一件装饰。可POKENAME仍常把它当棒子，重砸对手。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The Carvanha on its tail is fossilized, and attached as a decoration. Nevertheless, POKENAME often uses it as a bat to bash its rivals.

entry: POKENAME好斗，想让谁都听它使唤。锋利的牙齿，连大型树果的厚皮，也能轻松切开。
author: T.I.A.
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive and will try to bully anyone into doing its bidding. Its sharp teeth can cut through the thick skin of large Berries.

entry: POKENAME对水域生态的危害极大。一旦发现，最好尽快将其收服。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME are actually quite harmful to aquatic habitats; whenever one is spotted, it is best for them to be caught as quickly as possible.

entry: 它们是海中的吸血鬼，乘着水流高速捕猎。训练家最好不要，把这种融合宝可梦再放回野外。
author: nelluc27
source: A vampire of the sea, they ride water currents with incredible speed to hunt. Trainers are advised not to release this fusion back into the wild.

entry: POKENAME常在海上骚扰船只，可最终并不会伤人。据说，过去曾有海盗跟随POKENAME航行。
author: Blazerxz
source: POKENAME is usually seen in the ocean, harassing ships but ultimately not harming anyone. It's said pirates followed POKENAME in the past.

entry: 许多POKENAME嗜好暴力，因此被雇来当打手。谁肯给它最大、最好的武器，它就替谁办事。
author: char_latte3412
source: With a lust for violence, many POKENAME are recruited as hired muscle. It'll lend its services to anyone who offers it the biggest and best weapons.

entry: POKENAME力量凶悍，不拿武器，也能捏碎军用鱼雷。性格狂野，却又十分贪图享乐。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has ferocious power. Even without a weapon, it can crush a military-grade torpedo. It features a wild yet hedonistic personality.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会用尾锚将自己留在海底。到了陆地，这只锚又能成为强力的防身武器。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME uses the anchor on its tail to keep to the sea floor while it's on the prowl. On land, the anchor proves to be a powerful defensive weapon.

entry: POKENAME以无可比拟的速度与力量，纵横深海。金属鳍划开的，不只是水，还有时间本身，所到之处一片混乱。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME commands the depths with unrivaled power and speed. Its metallic fins slice through water and time itself, leaving chaos in its wake.

entry: 它定期浮上海面吸气，储进体内。身躯虽粗壮，只需喷出储气，便能迅速转向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It regularly fills up with air by swimming to the surface. Despite its chunky physique, it can quickly change direction by expelling the stored air.

entry: 刀刃般的鳍，切石如切奶油。甚至曾有人见过，单只个体就把暴鲤龙、吼鲸王这样的巨兽，切成碎片。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: Its blade-like fins can cut stone like butter. Some have been seen cutting the likes of Gyarados and Wailord to pieces by themselves.

entry: 这只宝可梦柔软亲人，据说毛绒绒的脑袋里，什么念头也没有。可谁需要慰藉、关爱与保护，它都愿意陪伴。
author: Rooboid
source: This soft and cuddly Pokémon is said to have no thoughts inside its plush head. It provides comfort, love and protection to those who need it.

entry: 这只双足飞龙般的宝可梦经常战斗，身上留下独特伤痕。POKENAME由水构成的双翼与尾巴滚烫无比。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: This wyvern-like Pokémon is often in fights, resulting in unique scarring. POKENAME's water-based wings and tail are scaldingly hot.

entry: POKENAME寻找沉船，掠取里面的财宝。为了珍贵战利品，同族之间也常打起来。
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME seek sunken ships to plunder their treasures. They often battle each other for precious loot.

entry: POKENAME若发现旅人在自己的森林迷路，就会试着把人引往更深处。很少有人能活着回来，讲出这段遭遇。
author: .izik
source: Should a POKENAME see a traveler lost in its forest, it will attempt to guide them deeper in the woods. There are few tales of anyone surviving this.

entry: 霹雳电球在森林里自爆，四下无人听见，到底算不算出了声？也许不算，可它倒是真的，又活过来了！
author: TheHeroicT
source: If a Voltorb self-destructs in a forest, and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound? Perhaps not, but it does come back to life!

entry: POKENAME很喜欢自己的壳，根本不想离开。壳并非木头，主要由叶绿体组成，能在阳光下，为它供给生命能量。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is comfortable in its shell, which it never wants to leave. The shell is not wood but mostly chloroplasts, giving life energy in the sun.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是灵界的守门者。若在野外遇见POKENAME，或许就意味着，你的阳寿将尽。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is said to be a guardian to the spirit world. If you spot POKENAME in the wild, your time may be almost up.

entry: 为寻找新住处，这个小幽灵钻进一只木制玩具鸟。可玩具自己不会飞，让它失望得很。
author: takio_
source: In search for a new home, this small spirit found a wooden toy bird to inhabit. It seems very disappointed about the toy's inability to fly by itself.

entry: POKENAME装成树木，等别的宝可梦靠近，就牢牢附上去，强行与对方交朋友。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME latch onto Pokémon while camouflaging in the trees. It will then become friends with them, forcefully.

entry: 壳里酿成的树果汁，风味十分鲜美。合众高级酒馆的调酒师，常用来调配混合饮品。
author: .izik
source: Berry Juice that is created within its shell has a very savory flavor. Bartenders in Unova use it to make mixed drinks at upper-class taverns.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间的闹鬼森林起舞。它一动，诡异的风便随之而来。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME loves to dance at night within haunted forests. When it dances, eerie winds move with it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着一名死在林中的伐木工人的灵魂。它仍像生前一样，痴迷地砍个不停。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by a lumberjack who died in the forest. It obsessively fells trees as it did while alive.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: 每条尾巴都代表一个死在林中的孩子的灵魂，因此毛发也染成了黑色。
author: Toxicrown
source: Each tail on this Pokémon represents the soul of a child that died in the woods. Because of this, its fur has been blackened.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 它混在树木间伪装，再突然动起来，吓人一跳。恐惧与紧张，便是POKENAME的食粮。
author: .ssunday.
source: It tries to frighten people by camouflaging in the trees, then suddenly moving. POKENAME feed on fear and nervousness.

entry: POKENAME结出的果实，据说含有少许灵力，花岩怪与耿鬼，都很爱吃。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME bear fruits that are said to contain small amounts of spiritual energy inside. Spiritomb and Gengar love to eat it.

entry: POKENAME留下的壳，常被拿来替代南瓜灯。可野外捡到时，要小心——幽魂也许还在里面。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME husks are often used as an alternative to Jack-O-Lanterns. Be careful if you find one in the wild, though, as its spirit may still be inside.

entry: POKENAME面对大人很害羞，却能与孩子亲近。许多人相信，因为它生前，也曾是人类的孩子。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is shy around adults, but it has no problem opening up to children. Many believe this is because it once was a human child itself.

entry: POKENAME住在积雪森林，性情虽平和，亡灵般的外表，却常吓坏毫无防备的登山者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live in snowy forests. Despite their peaceful nature, their undead appearance often frightens unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME原是一尊多年前雕成、长满草木的忠犬卡蒂狗像。如今一个迷失孩子的亡魂住进了里面。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME was once an overgrown statue of a loyal Growlithe, carved many years ago. It is now the home of a lost child's soul.

entry: 古代人曾用POKENAME产生的黑色污泥，涂在茅厕内壁。污泥带酸，能分解废物，也能吸去臭味。
author: .izik
source: Ancient civilizations used the Black Sludge from POKENAME to line latrines. The acidic properties serve to break down waste and absorb scent.

entry: POKENAME执着得惊人。家人与领地若遭伤害，便会不惜一切，追出始作俑者，打得对方遍体鳞伤。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME are incredibly persistent. If a POKENAME family or area is hurt, they will stop at nothing to track down who did it and beat them to a pulp.

entry: 追击中的POKENAME，双眼似乎没有瞳孔。它们十分危险，认清眼前的是温顺，还是敌意，非常重要。
author: totodile.
source: A POKENAME in pursuit appears to lack pupils. They are highly dangerous, so it's important to know how to tell whether one is docile or hostile.

entry: POKENAME漫步古老森林，将闯入者吸进身体，把伤害森林的对象化为滋养林地的养分。
author: velvetmitsu
source: POKENAME wanders through ancient forests. It absorbs intruders into its form, converting those who harm the forest into vital nutrients to feed it.

entry: POKENAME潜伏密林，守护领地，还会缠住闯入者，警告一切想破坏林地平衡的来客。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME lurks in dense forests, guarding its domain. It ensnares intruders to warn all who dare to disturb the natural balance of the woodland realm.

entry: 它们有时会被误当成湖上的浮木，一动不动，唯有浓雾罩住栖息地，才会醒来。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: These Pokémon are sometimes mistaken for floating driftwood atop lakes. They lie motionless, only waking when fog coats their habitat.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: Thropp
