source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME会把遗失的玩具，送给林中遇上的宝可梦。走过的路上，总留着松针与细枝。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME can be seen giving away lost toys to Pokémon they find in forests. They tend to leave a trail of pine needles and branches where they walk.

entry: 一些林中部族会组成教团，崇拜POKENAME。祭品若放上它的角，它就格外喜欢。
author: mrbapcik
source: Some forest tribes build cults around worshiping POKENAME. This Pokémon loves it when offerings are placed on its horns.

entry: POKENAME守护古老森林深处，用尾端眼睛般的圆珠，察看四周。咆哮声，听来如狂风长啸。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME guards the depths of ancient forests, scanning its surroundings with the eye-like orb on its tail. Its roar sounds like howling wind.

entry: 身体由古木构成，它立在那里，如大地的哨兵。传说，那副古老铠甲，连最强的敌人也能击退。
author: anarchaz
source: Forging its body from ancient wood, it stands as a sentinel of the land. Tales speak of its age-old armor, said to repel even the mightiest of foes.

entry: 它外貌虽阴森，却也有善良的一面，会替迷失林中的孩子引路，送到安全的地方。
author: birchbot
source: Despite its ghastly appearance, it has a good side. It will guide any children that get lost in the woods back to safety.

entry: 它手中的木权杖，赋予了掌控整座森林的力量，因此被称为“森林女巫”。
author: awiralonprime
source: It's known as the 'forest witch' for its control of the entire forest it's in. The wood scepter it wields allows this level of power to be possible.

entry: POKENAME在林间领地，布下大片魔法陷阱。道路变换，树根纠缠，让无数来者，永远迷失。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME cast great swathes of magical traps over their wooded domain. Paths shift, roots tangle, and countless become lost forever.

entry: 水跃鱼若在林中迷路，POKENAME便神秘现身。嘴里的那只眼睛，是体内无数孩子亡魂中的一个。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME mysteriously appears when a Mudkip gets lost in the woods. The eye in its mouth is one of the countless children's souls in its body.

entry: POKENAME穿林起舞时，会唤起不祥的风，吹动身上叶片与它一同舞蹈。
author: Toxicrown
source: As it dances through the forest, POKENAME causes ominous winds to flow. These winds help the leaves on its body to dance with it.

entry: 这只宝可梦能凭手杖掌控森林。它借此远远守护孩子，帮助他们避开残酷的命运。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon's staff allows it control over the forest. It uses this to help children from a distance, so that they don't meet a cruel fate.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为“森林守护者”。它保护无力自保的生物，把林中的小宝可梦，当成自己的孩子。
author: Toxicrown
source: Known to many as the Forest Guardian, POKENAME protects those who can't protect themselves. It treats young forest Pokémon like its children.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: Thropp
source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME独居古林与沼泽边，常与周围融成一体。据说，它的气息，会勾起莫名的怀旧之情。
author: nelluc27
source: POKENAME live near old woods and bogs in solitude, often blending into their environment. Their scent is said to bring about inexplicable nostalgia.

entry: 森林遭到毁坏后，人们开始看见野生POKENAME四处潜行。只要被认定有害于领地，便会遭它无情攻击。
author: EnderSalasa
source: As forests are demolished, people notice wild POKENAME prowling around. They relentlessly attack anyone it deems harmful to its territory.

entry: 泛滥的污染，让POKENAME的树身，遭侵蚀、变得中空。它一心要向威胁自然的力量复仇。
author: NellNast42
source: Rampant pollution has left POKENAME's tree hollowed and eroded. It seeks revenge against the forces that threaten nature.

entry: POKENAME是森林的行刑者，专找伤害森林的人，用那有生命的木刃，毫不留情地处决。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is the forest's executioner. It seeks out people who harm the forest and shows no mercy towards them with its living wood blade.

entry: 它的叶片与外皮，总与家乡森林里某一棵树相同。那棵树一受威胁，它便现身，将来犯者赶走。
author: Staghorn
source: Its leaves and hide always match that of a tree somewhere within its home forest. If that tree is threatened, it will appear to drive the threat away.

entry: POKENAME的树汁，是腐蚀性最强的毒物之一。它漫游森林，震动大地，让猎物逐渐虚弱。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME's sap is one of the most corrosive poisons. It roams the forests, causing the ground to tremble to weaken its prey.

entry: POKENAME幽灵般的枝干，伸入了时光。据说，碰触根部的能量，便能看见过去与未来的幻景。
author: germs2128
source: POKENAME's spectral branches extend into the fabric of time. Legends say touching the energy from its roots show visions from the past and future.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，在安全距离外，观察登山者。若有人意图伤害林木，它就抓住对方，变成一棵树。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in forests and watches hikers from a safe distance. If someone tries to harm the forest, it catches them and turns them into a tree.

entry: 人们认为，破碎身体里的眼睛，是被抓住的盗墓贼的灵魂。它举止反复无常，又总诡异地盯着人。
author: matpal6
source: It's believed that the eyes inside its broken body are the souls of caught grave robbers. Its behaviour is erratic and it stares uncannily at people.

entry: POKENAME像一个神秘气泡，包着一棵幽灵之树，仿佛自然与精神能量，在其中交融。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME appears as a mysterious bubble housing a spectral tree, symbolizing the fusion of nature and psychic energy within.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠与茂林的交界，用根须和大颚伏击猎物。它们也很爱吃苹果。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME make their home on the borders between deserts and lush forests. They ambush prey with their roots and jaws. They also love apples.

entry: POKENAME先装成树，等猎物靠近，再长出最多八条枝干，追赶对方。见过的面孔、得到的恩情、受过的轻慢，它都永不忘记。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME pretend to be trees until prey gets too close. They can grow up to eight branches to chase prey, and never forget faces, favors, or slights.

entry: 从朽木妖身上剥落的一片树皮，便可能化成POKENAME。每只POKENAME都分得了原来那只朽木妖的一小部分力量。
author: holgast
source: It appears when a piece of bark is peeled from a Trevenant. Each POKENAME contains a fraction of the original Trevenant's power.

entry: 从朽木妖身上剥落的一片树皮，便可能化成POKENAME。每只POKENAME都分得了原来那只朽木妖的一小部分力量。
author: holgast
source: It appears when a piece of bark is peeled from a Trevenant. Each POKENAME contains a fraction of the original Trevenant's power.

entry: 这种罕见的POKENAME，通常藏在浓密森林。据说，它会把人从家里掳走，细细享用受害者的灵魂。
author: gun2._
source: This rare type of POKENAME is usually found in dense forests. It's said to steal people from their homes and savor the souls of the victims.

entry: POKENAME飞过林梢，侦察威胁。谁伤害森林，便会被它无情追击，直到彻底消灭。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME flies over the skies of forests to scout for threats. Whoever harms its forest will be attacked mercilessly until they are eradicated.

entry: POKENAME从孵化的一刻起，便守着森林。被它抓走的闯入者，再也不曾出现。
author: pikahunter07
source: POKENAME guard their forest from the moment they hatch. Intruders caught by this Pokémon are never seen again.

entry: 据说，暴风雪里，POKENAME会带迷途旅人穿过树林。可也有些顽皮个体，偏要把人引向歧路。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is said to guide lost wanderers through the woods during blizzards. However, some mischievous individuals deliberately lead them astray.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME会把死在雪暴森林里的旅人的灵魂，聚进自己中空的身躯。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is rumored that POKENAME unites the souls of the wanderers who have died in blizzardous forests in its hollow body.

entry: 这些小木灵，装成灌木，为朽木妖守护的森林放哨。来客若逗留太久，就会遭它们纠缠。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: These small wood sprites hide as bushes, functioning as sentries for Trevenant-guarded woods. They harass those who linger too long within.

entry: POKENAME保护森林，抵御伤林者。它的火焰，永远不会熄灭。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: POKENAME protects forests from those who harm them. Its flame never goes out.

entry: 许多砍毁森林的人，临终前最后看见的，就是POKENAME。它几乎不必移动，就能让自然听从意志。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME is often the last sight of those who are causing a forest to shrink in size. It is able to bend nature to its will, despite barely moving.

entry: 民间传说里，它是守护自然的传奇存在。人类与宝可梦，都常在它脚下，留下敬献的供品。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: This Pokémon is the legendary guardian of nature, according to folklore. There is often tribute left at its feet, from people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME漫步森林，以超能力攻击伤树者。看见树木受损，还会试着替它修复。
author: frostedwyrm
source: POKENAME wanders forests, using its psychic powers to attack those who would harm the trees. When it sees damaged trees, it attempts to repair them.

entry: 它凶猛地守着沼泽红树林，时而混进树间，时而潜在下方水里，静等猎物误入。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It guards swampy mangrove forests viciously. It's able to blend in with the trees or linger in the waters below, waiting for prey to bumble in.

entry: 野生POKENAME巡逻着海滨的森林领地。尾巴如今长出叶子，还能招来食草的猎物。
author: Sole Survivor
source: In the wild, POKENAME patrol their seaside forest territories. Their tails now grow leaves, which attract their herbivorous prey.

entry: POKENAME常在滑坡地带附近，躲进泥潭。身上携带许多病原体，一经触碰，就会传播疾病。
author: maxiundmicky
source: Often seen around landslides, POKENAME hides in pools of mud. It carries many pathogens, and spreads illnesses when touched.

entry: 林中一堆落叶，有时其实是伏着的POKENAME。越往森林深处走，遇上的便越多。
author: .realthree
source: Piles of leaves in the forest are sometimes POKENAME laying in wait. The deeper into the forest you travel, the more of them you will encounter.

entry: 林中一堆落叶，有时其实是伏着的POKENAME。等它显出真身，真正的幽灵形态，就会慢慢渗出。
author: .realthree
source: Piles of leaves in the forest are sometimes POKENAME laying in wait. When it reveals itself, its true ghostly form oozes out.

entry: 它不经意分泌的毒蜜，会污染附近的水。虽然鲜少主动攻击，许多宝可梦，却仍因此遭殃。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It contaminates the water around it with a passively secreted, poisonous honey. Although it rarely attacks, many different Pokémon fall victim to it.

entry: POKENAME在日光下，快乐地扭来扭去，似乎还会分泌黏稠甜汁，引来各种虫宝可梦。
author: Xephyr
source: POKENAME wiggles and jiggles happily in the sun. It seems to secrete a thick, sweet ooze that attracts all manner of Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 它性情害羞，花里飘出的刺鼻气味，又让许多人退避。平日，常睡在茂密森林之中。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is quite shy, as many people tend to avoid it due to the pungent scent coming from its flower. It is commonly found sleeping in dense forests.

entry: 每到秋分，POKENAME便聚在一起，尽情跳上一天。若有人打扰，立刻就钻进土里，藏了起来。
author: .realthree
source: Every fall equinox, POKENAME gather together and dance the day away. If any disturb this gathering, they instantly bury themselves in the ground.

entry: POKENAME颈间的球状器官散发着腐臭味。它能随意将其摘下，放在领地各处，留下自己的气味标记。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The bulbs around POKENAME's neck emit a rancid smell. POKENAME can detach them at will, leaving them around its territory to mark it.

entry: 嘴边渗出的汁液，带着柑橘香。有些厨师会装瓶收藏，用来做出获奖的佳肴。
author: .izik
source: The liquid that seeps out of its mouth has a citrus scent. There are chefs who will bottle this sap to use in award-winning dishes.

entry: 少有什么事，能扰乱它。POKENAME能静静坐在屋顶，好几个小时，只听风吹过。
author: .izik
source: There is very little that can bother it. A POKENAME will sit silently on the roof of a building for hours just listening to the wind blow.

entry: POKENAME的奶，经巴氏杀菌后，似乎有改善记忆的作用。滋味像蜜，也被用于许多糕点。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's milk, once pasteurized, seems to improve memory. It is used in many pastries for its honey-like taste.

entry: 这根手杖能喷出黏稠、有毒的蜜，让对手晕头转向。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This staff can expel a sticky, noxious honey that can disorientate opponents.

entry: 为了捕住猎物，它将唇边的蜜涂上飘带，牢牢黏住，不让对方逃走。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: To capture prey, it coats its ribbons in the honey from its lips to prevent them from escaping.

entry: POKENAME嘴里分泌的毒液，腐蚀性极强。难过时，脸上的花，也会淌出同样的毒。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: The poison POKENAME secretes from its mouth is highly corrosive. When saddened, the flowers on its face leak the same poison.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶片十分敏锐，不必睁眼，也能察觉敌人。巨大的双手，能轻易捏碎来犯的天敌。
author: chartanon
source: The sensitive leaves on POKENAME's head detects foes without it needing to open its eyes. Its massive hands can easily crush any would-be predators.

entry: POKENAME落下的叶片芳香浓郁。城都有些匠人会用它们调配干花香料。
author: .izik
source: The leaves that fall off of a POKENAME are very aromatic. There are artisans in Johto that use them in potpourri.

entry: POKENAME最初是很久以前，一位裁缝的作品。后来遭人弃置，里面的幽灵，便想要复仇。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME was originally made by a tailor long ago. It was eventually abandoned, and the spirit inside wants revenge.

entry: 保暖的毛发与单只耳朵，减少了散热，让POKENAME能比大多数嗡蝠，熬得更晚。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can stay up later than most Noibat thanks to its insulative fur and single ear, which lets less heat escape.

entry: 保暖的毛发与单只耳朵，减少了散热，让POKENAME能比大多数嗡蝠，熬得更晚。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can stay up later than most Noibat thanks to its insulative fur and single ear, which lets less heat escape.

entry: 保暖的毛发，让POKENAME比大多数嗡蝠，更能熬夜。这只个体，还长着罕见的配色。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can stay up later than most Noibat thanks to its insulative fur. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: 别看这副模样，POKENAME最爱水果！谁给它好吃的，它便忠心相待，还能带迷路的矿工与探险者，走出暗洞。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME loves fruit! It's loyal to anyone who gives it a treat, and can help lost miners and explorers out of dark caves.

entry: 它们靠超声波，在暗洞中飞快穿行，常被探险者误认为传说中的异兽。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: These Pokémon move swiftly through dark caverns with its ultrasonic capabilities. They're often mistaken for legendary creatures by explorers.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，几英里外都听得到。它们通常住在深邃洞穴或山顶。
author: theartemis1
source: The cry of a POKENAME can be heard for miles around. These creatures make their homes in deep caverns and mountaintops.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，几英里外都听得到。它们通常住在深邃洞穴或山顶。
author: theartemis1
source: The cry of a POKENAME can be heard for miles around. These creatures make their homes in deep caverns and mountaintops.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，几英里外都听得到。它们通常住在深邃洞穴或山顶。
author: theartemis1
source: The cry of a POKENAME can be heard for miles around. These creatures make their homes in deep caverns and mountaintops.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，几英里外都听得到。它们通常住在深邃洞穴或山顶。
author: theartemis1
source: The cry of a POKENAME can be heard for miles around. These creatures make their homes in deep caverns and mountaintops.

entry: 脸颊上的蓝色圆圈，能迸出巨响。它会先咬紧敌人，再用爆音波，震得对方耳聋。
author: themicelegion
source: The blue circles on this Pokémon cheeks form massive bursts of sound. It bites down on foes and deafens them with a Boomburst.

entry: POKENAME自有一套节奏，不随旁人。它能释放凝聚的电力，给电声乐器供能，也能熟练演奏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME marches to the beat of its own drum. The concentrated electricity it releases allows it to power and adeptly play electrical instruments.

entry: POKENAME跑得快，飞得也快，靠声波与利爪，战斗、狩猎。
author: umbri21
source: POKENAME is known for its running and flight speed. It fights and hunts using sound waves and its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME脚上的声波装置，能在踢击时将敌人震飞，也能帮它跳得更高。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME use sonic emitters on their feet to send foes flying when they kick at them. They also use these emitters to amplify their jumps.

entry: 它放出响亮的音乐，诱来幽灵宝可梦，吞作食物。据说，POKENAME音乐的频率，只有亡魂听得见。
author: Yoshimon
source: It plays loud music to attract Ghost Pokémon to consume. The music POKENAME produces is said to be at frequencies only spirits can hear.

entry: POKENAME是温柔的巨人，总让小型宝可梦停上背树休息。身体看似沉重，飞行却无声无息。
author: zerocipher
source: POKENAME is a gentle giant that always lets smaller Pokémon land on its tree to rest. Although it looks heavy, it can fly without making a sound.

entry: POKENAME是温柔的巨人，总让小型宝可梦停上背树休息。身体看似沉重，飞行却无声无息。
author: zerocipher
source: POKENAME is a gentle giant that always lets smaller Pokémon land on its tree to rest. Although it looks heavy, it can fly without making a sound.

entry: 无论攻击来自哪个方向，它都能反击。一英里半径内，再细微的动静，也逃不过它的感知。
author: creeps_jr
source: It is able to counter attacks from every direction. It can detect even the slightest movement in a mile radius.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋最漆黑的深处。先用回声定位找到猎物，再唱海妖般的歌将其引来，以声波出击。
author: JordanX27
source: POKENAME live in the darkest depths of the sea. It uses echolocation to detect its prey, lures it in with a siren song, then strike with sonic waves.

entry: POKENAME能从身体播放音乐，因此很受城市与派对欢迎。
author: Blazerxz
source: POKENAME has the ability to project music from its body. It is popular in cities and at parties for this reason.

entry: 自从融合后，POKENAME便迷上了电子音乐。它随身带着一台手提音响，盼着把这份热爱分享给全世界。
author: NellNast42
source: Since Fusion, POKENAME has become enamored by electronic music. It carries around a boombox, hoping to share its passion with the world.

entry: POKENAME会扭曲他人的听觉，借此操纵对方。至少已有几段友谊，被证实因它而破裂。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME can manipulate others by distorting their sense of hearing. It's been confirmed that at least a few friendships have ended because of it.

entry: 它带来的音乐，明明响得很，却很容易让人听着入睡，即使原本毫无倦意，也不例外。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: The music that this fusion brings with it is really loud, but it is very easy to fall asleep to it, even when you are not tired.

entry: POKENAME体内塞满压缩棉。发怒爆炸时，白色绒毛能铺满，整整一座足球场。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is filled with compressed cotton. When it gets angry and blows up, it can cover with area of an entire football field with white fluff.

entry: POKENAME颈部与尾巴的毛，柔软细腻，很受孩子喜爱。它又友好得很，跟谁都容易交上朋友。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Children love POKENAME because of the soft, delicate fur on its neck and tail. It is extremely friendly, making friends with anyone very easily.

entry: 云朵般的翅膀，会在飞行中收集水分。想邀人玩耍，它便向四周抛洒雨滴。
author: snescontroller
source: Its cloud-like wings gather water as it flies. It throws raindrops around to show when it wants to play.

entry: 它能改变云尾的密度，借此漂在空中。不过，这项本领，尚未完全掌握。
author: Staghorn
source: It can change the density of its cloud-like tail, allowing it to float through the air. It has not yet learned to fully control this ability.

entry: POKENAME长出的羊毛，蓬松如云。用来填充高级枕头，能卖出高价。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME grows wool as fluffy as clouds. Luxury pillows stuffed with said wool sell for a high price.

entry: POKENAME长出的羊毛，蓬松如云。用来填充高级枕头，能卖出高价。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME grows wool as fluffy as clouds. Luxury pillows stuffed with said wool sell for a high price.

entry: POKENAME头上的绒毛，比最好的丝还柔软，因此，人们常把POKENAME当枕头。
author: Blazerxz
source: The fluff on POKENAME's head is softer than the finest silk. Because of this, people like using POKENAME as pillows.

entry: 传说，在辽阔蓝天看见POKENAME，便能得好运。若来者心地纯净，它甚至会主动靠近。
author: lynkinator
source: Stories say that whoever spots POKENAME in the vast, blue sky will be blessed with good fortune. It may even approach pure-hearted individuals itself.

entry: POKENAME用柔软毛发，安慰身边的伙伴。性情友善，又爱陪人玩，是备受喜爱的伴侣。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME uses its soft fur to comfort those around it. It is very friendly and loves playing with people, making it a beloved companion.

entry: POKENAME生活在最浓厚的云层里，双眼渐渐闭合。整群一起发出回声定位的声音时，听来宛如滚滚雷鸣。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Living in the thickest clouds, POKENAME's eyes have gradually grown shut. When flocks echolocate together, it sounds like rolling thunder.

entry: 头顶的蓬松羽毛，误食后会身中剧毒。受到威胁时，它就放出一团羽毛，让其飘散周围。
author: admiralvermin
source: The puffy feathers atop its head are highly toxic when ingested. When threatened, it releases a cloud of these feathers into the air around it.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩，喜欢为人类与宝可梦唱歌跳舞，也很享受演出时，收获的目光。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME is very playful, and it enjoys singing and dancing for both people and Pokémon. It enjoys the attention it receives from its performances.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，摸着却柔软极了。它爱在天上奔跑，从一朵云，跃向另一朵云。
author: kiwkelly
source: POKENAME's fire is extremely soft to the touch. It likes to gallop in the sky, prancing from cloud to cloud.

entry: 这个小毛球其实没有翅膀，只好舒舒服服地藏进云里，随云漂浮。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: This little ball of feathers doesn't actually have any wings, so it floats around snugly inside of clouds instead.

entry: POKENAME身体太重，根本飞不起来，却仍爱热情地拍着小翅膀，到处蹦蹦跳跳。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: Too heavy to fly, POKENAME just likes to bounce around, flapping its little wings enthusiastically.

entry: POKENAME会在身体周围制造充满氦气的小气泡，借此飞行。气泡先在绒毛中形成，再移动到皮肤表面。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME forms small helium-filled bubbles around its body to fly. The bubbles form within the fluff on its body, then move to cover its skin.

entry: 潮湿天气里，覆身的棉状物质会变厚。到了干燥日子，细小翅膀，又从绒毛间探出来。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance that covers its body becomes thicker in humid weather. On dry days, tiny wings emerge from the fluff.

entry: 它剥下树皮筑巢，再用翅膀上的绒毛铺好内里，让幼崽住得舒适。
author: .izik
source: It strips off bark from trees to use in its nest. It uses chunks of fluff from its wings to line the nest and ensure comfort to its young.

entry: POKENAME的云里，盛着牛奶般的液体，滋味比普通大奶罐的奶还新鲜。身上的斑纹，有时也会发亮。
author: T.I.A.
source: POKENAME's clouds hold milk-like liquid that tastes fresher than average Miltank milk. The markings on its body seem to glow sometimes.

entry: POKENAME开朗友好，喜欢把自己产的蛋，分给朋友。煮熟后，蛋质轻盈蓬松，却没什么味道。
author: AlmightyOnion
source: A joyful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME loves to share the eggs it lays with its friends. When cooked, the eggs are light and airy, but lack flavor.

entry: 毛下的岩石，十分脆弱。若撞上洞壁，覆身的绒毛，便能起到缓冲作用。
author: .izik
source: The stone under the wool that covers its body is extremely brittle. The wool serves as a cushion should it bump into cave walls.

entry: 它飞过天空，感受训练家与宝可梦的情绪。据说，一群POKENAME合唱起来，十分美妙。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: It flies across the sky, picking up emotions from Trainers and Pokémon. A group of POKENAME singing is said to be beautiful.

entry: 身上的棉絮很容易脏。为免打结，它喜欢一天洗两次澡。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like material on its body gets dirty very easily. To avoid tangles it prefers to wash itself twice per day.

entry: POKENAME连大气最细微的变化，也能感知。它的出现，常预示当地将有猛烈雷暴。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME can sense even the slightest atmospheric changes. Its presence signifies a severe thunderstorm in the area.

entry: POKENAME善于在各种宝可梦族群中，混成首领。它专横又自负，总想让大家听自己的。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is talented at establishing itself as leader in Pokémon packs of all kinds. It has a bossy and egotistical nature.

entry: POKENAME挥剑破空，会发出悦耳的哨声。音调随个体的年纪与等级，略有不同。
author: holgast
source: When POKENAME swings its sword through the air, it makes a pleasant whistling sound. The tone of the sound varies with an individual's age and level.

entry: POKENAME只住在最洁净的珊瑚礁。哪怕一点点污染，也会让它离开家园。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME only inhabits the cleanest coral reefs. Even the slightest amount of pollution in its home will drive it away.

entry: 古时，人们会将POKENAME的角磨粉，调制治疗胃溃疡与发热的药。
author: .izik
source: The ground-up horn of a POKENAME was used in ancient times to create remedies to treat stomach ulcers and fevers.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
