source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 它的咆哮宛如旋律，连最狂暴的天气也能安抚。它巡行于臭氧层，守护有人居住的地方，免受天灾。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.

entry: 身上的毛，炽热得很。若POKENAME进到寒地，毛便会变脆，成团脱落。
author: .izik
source: The wool on its body is extremely hot. Should a POKENAME enter a cold climate, the wool will become brittle and fall off in clumps.

entry: 它取来遗失、遭弃的毛绒玩具填充物，用来装扮自己。谁若往伪装下面偷看，就会沉沉睡去。
author: AlmightyOnion
source: It takes the stuffing from lost and thrown-away plushes to use in its disguise. Any who peek under its disguise will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: 丰缘有个传说，一只POKENAME守着水晶环绕的泉水。只有愿意与它同唱的人，才可进入。
author: .izik
source: There is a legend in Hoenn of a POKENAME that guards a spring surrounded by crystals. It will allow entry only to those who sing with it.

entry: 棉絮般的物质，让它跃出水面后，还能留在半空。虽然牙尖，却更偏爱海藻。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance on its body allows it to stay airborne when jumping out of the water. Despite its sharp teeth, it prefers to eat seaweed.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合，竟成了完全由云构成的身体。模样似乎很像，遥远地区某种现象带来的形态。
author: zic
source: This self-fusion of POKENAME is made purely out of clouds. It seems to resemble a certain form caused by a phenomenon in a faraway region.

entry: 它靠高超的身手，攀上陡峭崖壁。再将绒毛展开，便能滑翔好几英里。
author: .izik
source: It does incredible acrobatics to scale cliff walls. By expanding the fluff on its body it can glide for miles.

entry: 身上的蓝色水晶，触之极寒。最早的一些冰箱，正是利用POKENAME化石中的这种水晶，研制而成。
author: .izik
source: The blue crystals on its body are extremely cold to the touch. Some of the first refrigerators were developed with crystals from POKENAME fossils.

entry: 民间传说里，这样的宝可梦会在来世，迎接你的到来。它的旋律，能让每只宝可梦安定下来。
author: .ssunday.
source: Folktales say a Pokémon like this will greet you in the afterlife. Its melodies can calm each and every Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一边飞，一边唱，把云当作舞台。旋律温柔，让听见的生物，都能得到慰藉。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME loves to sing as it flies through the sky. It uses the clouds as a stage, singing a song that comforts all who hear its tune.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地浮在高空，常被当成一朵小云。三颗头，却能唱出分毫不差的和声。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME float aimlessly high in the sky and are often mistaken for small clouds. The three heads all sing in perfect harmony.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头，总爱一起唱歌。可想唱得和谐，倒是极难得的事。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: The three heads of POKENAME are often together in song. However, it's a rare occurrence for all of them to harmonize.

entry: 身体覆着羊毛般的绒絮。鸠羽港有位裁缝，就用POKENAME的绒毛，制作潜水装备。
author: .izik
source: A wool-like substance covers its body. There is a seamstress in Hutber Port that utilizes the fluff from a POKENAME to create scuba gear.

entry: 只要集中精神，就能用超能力托起身体高速飞行。攻击时会顺时针转动汤匙。
author: .izik
source: By concentrating, it can use its psychic abilities to lift its body and fly at great speeds. When attacking, it will rotate its spoons clockwise.

entry: 它安然漂在高空云间。若受袭击，POKENAME便展开飘带般的触手，自行防卫。
author: _aphoric
source: It floats serenely high up among the clouds. If attacked, POKENAME unfurls its ribbonlike tentacles to defend itself.

entry: 它能控制座下的云，缓缓移动，可最快也比走路慢。睡着时，就又漫无目的地飘来飘去。
author: greystorm101
source: It is able to control the movement of the cloud it sits on, though its top speed is slower than a walk. It drifts around aimlessly while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME始终惊魂未定，还在努力挪动那副早已失去的身体。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: POKENAME is in a constant state of shock, trying to move the body it no longer has.

entry: 它喜欢轻轻攀住训练家的肩，像顶帽子一样，趴在头上。分量轻得出奇。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: It likes to grab gently onto their Trainer's shoulders and lay on their head like a hat. They are surprisingly light.

entry: 白天，POKENAME装出友好模样，骗取人们信任。可实际是夜行猎手，对受害者毫不留情。
author: 8xviktor
source: During the day, POKENAME puts on a friendly facade to fool people. In reality, it's a nocturnal predator that spares no mercy to its victims.

entry: POKENAME体内分泌的黏液，略带酸性，黏得出奇，十分难洗掉。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a viscous slime from inside its body. The slime is slightly acidic and incredibly hard to wash off.

entry: POKENAME的壳，始终覆着一层薄薄黏液。黏液若干了，壳便容易碎裂。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's shell is constantly covered by a thin layer of slime. If it dries out, the shell becomes brittle.

entry: POKENAME爱与训练家玩捉迷藏，躲的位置总有巧思。可一路留下的黏液，又让它轻易被找着。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME loves to play hide-and-seek with its Trainer. Although the trail of goo it leaves behind makes it easy to find, it has creative hiding spots.

entry: 它们群居生活，彼此保湿、降温，用体液交流。可体液不能用得太多，否则自己就会干掉。
author: Soup1900
source: They live in groups to keep each other moist and cool. It uses its bodily fluids to communicate, but it can't use too much of it or it'll dry up.

entry: POKENAME性情十分温顺，常让水宝可梦靠近，吃背上分泌的黏液。
author: Novellavaria
source: POKENAME is a very docile Pokémon. It is often spotted letting Water types eat the slime that's produced on its back.

entry: POKENAME最爱下雨，身上的细鳞会吸收水分，再把水变成黏稠液体。
author: ClawsHDi
source: POKENAME love the rain. They soak up moisture through the small scales on their body, later transforming that liquid into a slimy substance.

entry: 黏糊糊的身体让训练家常不愿亲近，POKENAME为此难过不已。
author: coooooooookiee
source: POKENAME is often disheartened by its Trainer's unwillingness to interact, which is due to its sliminess.

entry: POKENAME很想打架，奈何身体黏软脆弱，几乎维持不住，只好折中，专挑湿淋淋的宝可梦交手。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME wants to fight, but can barely contain its weak, slimy composition. It compromises by exclusively fighting wet Pokémon.

entry: 它把腐蚀性黏液，吐向猎物，好更容易吃下。也有人拿这种黏液，清理生锈的金属。
author: kittyluv090
source: It spits corrosive slime on its prey, making it easier to eat. Some people use this substance for cleaning rusted metal.

entry: POKENAME不太聪明，对训练家却关怀备至。可有些人，反而不喜欢它这样。
author: 8xviktor
source: While POKENAME aren't very intelligent, they show an immense amount of compassion towards their Trainers. Some people find that off-putting.

entry: POKENAME把黏液聚在颈间，用来隔热。这些黏液，还能帮助入睡。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME collects slime around its neck and uses it as protection against heat. This slime also has properties that facilitate sleep.

entry: POKENAME的壳，已退入皮下。人们推测，再过几千年，POKENAME可能连壳也不剩了。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's shell has retreated under its skin. It is thought that in a few thousand years, POKENAME won't have a shell at all.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，曾被认为已经灭绝。壳里含有亚铁化合物，它会躲进里面，保持身体湿润。
author: .realthree
source: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. There are ferrous compounds in its shell, which it remains within to preserve moisture.

entry: 它的黏液，几乎能溶解任何材料。若遇上实在溶不掉的东西，就当作珍宝，好好收藏。
author: hampterbychoice
source: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve nearly any material. When it finds an item too tough to dissolve, it keeps it as a precious treasure.

entry: 唾液的腐蚀性极强，身体接触十分危险。与POKENAME共事的人，都是拿生命冒险。
author: 8xviktor
source: Its saliva is highly corrosive, making physical contact with it very risky. People who work with POKENAME put their lives on the line.

entry: POKENAME分泌黏液，帮自己滑过险恶地形。可液体一沾衣裳、地毯，就很难清除。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME secretes a mucus that helps it slide over any dangerous terrain. This fluid is very hard to remove from textiles such as clothes and carpets.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，曾被认为已经灭绝。它分泌的金属液体，后来被发现可用作清洁剂。
author: .realthree
source: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. The metallic liquid it secretes has been found to have applications as a cleaning agent.

entry: POKENAME站进巨坑或山谷，放出大量黏液，最终，便形成一座供自己居住的黏液湖。
author: Gurguro
source: POKENAME will produce massive amounts of goop while standing in a large crater or valley. The result is a lake of slime that becomes their home.

entry: POKENAME钻穿地下，寻找潮湿土层，泡在其中。有些POKENAME，甚至住在巨大湖泊的底下。
author: ursulaarchmorningstar
source: POKENAME burrows through the ground in search of damp earth to soak in. Some POKENAME can even be found beneath massive lakes.

entry: POKENAME用黏胶般的波导制造气泡，还能调整泡壁厚薄，改变透气性与坚韧程度，几乎什么用途，都能派上用场。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: POKENAME uses it's gooey aura to make bubbles. It can alter the thickness of these bubbles, changing air flow and sturdiness for virtually any usage.

entry: 颈间黏稠的褶边，可用来制药。有野生宝可梦急需治疗时，它甚至会主动喂对方黏液。
author: Zeeroooo
source: The goo frill around its neck can be used to make potions. Sometimes it will even feed wild Pokémon its goo if they need immediate medical help.

entry: 橡胶般的角上，彩色圆环不断振荡，令人看得入迷。有人说，它的身体并不由自己控制。
author: _sadfroggy
source: The colorful rings in its rubbery horns oscillate in a mesmerizing manner. Some say that it isn't in control of its own body.

entry: POKENAME能以极快的速度，滚动、弹跳，碾压敌人。分泌的毒液，也是一种强力黏合剂。
author: teravolt
source: POKENAME is able to roll and bounce at extreme speeds to trample its foes. Its toxic secretions are a powerful adhesive.

entry: 面对POKENAME着实骇人的模样，训练家常会选择解除融合。或许正因如此，它总努力表现得格外友善。
author: bukie
source: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.

entry: 面对POKENAME着实骇人的模样，训练家常会选择解除融合。或许正因如此，它总努力表现得格外友善。
author: bukie
source: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.

entry: POKENAME用黏糊糊的翅膀，抱住训练家，表达爱意。可许多人，也正是因此，才躲着它。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME shows affection by hugging its Trainer with its slimy wings. Many people avoid it for this very reason.

entry: 它慢慢挪动时，花瓣会抖出阵阵毒花粉。虽然对大多数生物都是危险，POKENAME仍尽力想与大家友好相处。
author: bukie
source: Its petals shake out toxic clouds of pollen as it lumbers around. Despite being a hazard to most, POKENAME still makes an effort to be friendly.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，是一种黏性聚合物。兴奋时，不只会困住敌人，连同伴也可能被黏住。不过，交给好厨师烤过，滋味也很不错。
author: Greystorm and CaBiNE
source: POKENAME's goo is a sticky polymer that can trap foes and even allies when excited. It's also delicious when roasted by a great chef.

entry: POKENAME对认定的朋友很亲昵。若得罪它，就得留神：它记仇，而且绝不轻易放过。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is affectionate towards those it views as friends, but be wary if you get on its bad side. It's vindictive and highly persistent.

entry: 它是很久以前制造的古老机关，走动时吱呀作响，身上众多眼睛，都盯着闯入者。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An ancient construct created long ago. It creaks as it walks, gazing at intruders with its many eyes.

entry: 它用大钳碾碎巨石，仔细搜集稀有矿石，偏偏似乎对黑奇石，十分厌恶。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It pulverizes boulders with its pincers in search of rare ores, which it studiously collects. It appears to despise Black Augurite, however.

entry: POKENAME藏在古迹里，装成普通石头。它的身体无法被任何现代武器损伤。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME hides in ancient ruins, disguising itself as a normal rock. Its body cannot be damaged by any modern weapon.

entry: 刀刃用来切开岩石。若POKENAME身体有部位崩落，这些石料，便能拿来修补。
author: b_megamaths
source: Its blades are used to cut through rock. POKENAME uses this rock to repair itself if parts of it break off.

entry: 中央水晶一碎，它就会死去。据说，站在POKENAME面前的敌人，都会被净化之火洗去污秽。
author: .crystallization
source: If the crystal in its center shatters, it will die. It's said that any foe which stands before POKENAME will be cleansed in purifying flames.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，偶尔仍能在野外发现。人们相信，它们是朽木妖的木身，石化而来。
author: Cristata
source: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，偶尔仍能在野外发现。人们相信，它们是朽木妖的木身，石化而来。
author: Cristata
source: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.

entry: 神话里，有一块被耿鬼附入、侵蚀的石碑。POKENAME的模样，似乎正符合这段描述。
author: 8xviktor
source: There's a myth about a stone monolith infused with and corrupted by a Gengar. POKENAME seems to fit that description.

entry: 它是诞生于遥远冰河时代的冰之造物，曾被困在冰窟多年，才终于挣脱。
author: TheHeroicT
source: An icy construct born from a long forgotten ice age. It was trapped for many years in an icy cave before freeing itself.

entry: 这种融合体，最初发现于积雪苔原。POKENAME放出的闪电，不留灼伤，反在皮肤上结出片片冰。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: This fusion was first discovered in a snowy tundra. POKENAME emits lightning that leaves patches of ice on the skin instead of burns.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方放出强力闪电，所到之处，留下厚厚冰层。这特性，近来引起了科学家兴趣。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME emits strong lightning in all directions, leaving behind thick layers of ice. This property has recently aroused the interest of scientists.

entry: 训练家把铁甲蛹遗弃在霜抹山，才形成这种天然融合体。它梦想着进化，再回来复仇。
author: .ssunday.
source: This natural fusion occured when a Trainer abandoned a Metapod in the Glaseado Mountains. It dreams of evolving and getting revenge.

entry: 传说，POKENAME每过一百年，才会脱落一次背上的黄色水晶。谁若拾得，便能得到大大的好运。
author: kjcole
source: According to legend, POKENAME sheds the yellow crystals on its back once every century. They are said to bring great luck to the finder.

entry: 融合时，POKENAME完整保留了雷吉艾斯的分子结构。双眼会随附近的电子设备与电磁波，同步闪烁。
author: entomoxie
source: When fusing, a POKENAME keeps the exact molecular structures of a Regice. Its eyes flash in tune with nearby electronics and electromagnetic waves.

entry: 据传，POKENAME的冰之身体永不融化。民间故事里，也叫它“北极光巫师”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is rumored that POKENAME's ice body never melts. In folk tales, it is often referred to as the "wizard of the aurora borealis".

entry: 据传，POKENAME的冰之身体永不融化。民间故事里，也叫它“北极光巫师”。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It is rumored that POKENAME's ice body never melts. In folk tales, it is often referred to as the "wizard of the aurora borealis".

entry: 背后的花朵，几秒内便能冻住附近的一切。北极光升起时，常能看到成群POKENAME，躺在光幕下面休息。
author: Skymaster426
source: The flower on its back can freeze anything near it within seconds. When the aurora borealis starts, groups of POKENAME can be sighted resting below.

entry: 科学家怀疑，POKENAME的冰冷身体会定期以寒冷刺激能行动的共生伙伴的大脑，借此维持对共生关系的控制。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Scientists suspect that POKENAME's icy body regularly freeze-shocks the brain of its mobile counterpart in order to maintain control of the symbiosis.

entry: 它虽燃着火焰，身体却冷得接近绝对零度。火焰一碰目标，便吸走热量，同时又让对方化为灰烬。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Despite the flames, its body emanates a temperature near absolute zero. On contact, said flames sap heat even as its targets are turned to ash.

entry: 据报道，POKENAME现身之地，便能看见极光。身体虽像覆冰的玻璃，却比多数金属更坚固。
author: PepperThePirate
source: It is reported that, where POKENAME appears, an aurora can be seen. Though its body resembles iced over glass, it is stronger than most metals.

entry: 它守着一座久远的冰墓。周围的碎片，能转得比现代旋翼还快，将闯入者剖开。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A sentinel for an icy tomb made long ago. The shards around it can spin faster than modern rotors, eviscerating intruders.

entry: POKENAME住在世上最冷的洞穴，能自如操纵外环，每一块冰片各自移动、旋转。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in the coldest caves in the world. It can move and rotate the individual ice shards of its outer ring autonomously.

entry: 体内炽热几乎压不住，偶尔必须排放。平日冻得结冰的周围，也会因此骤变得近似热带。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The intense heat within it is barely contained. Occasionally, it must be vented, causing its normally freezing environment to become near tropical.

entry: 沉睡中的POKENAME，曾被误当成巨大冰山。分析POKENAME身上的冰，却发现它可能比这颗星球，还要古老。
author: .crystallization
source: During its slumber, a POKENAME was mistaken for a large iceberg. Analysis of POKENAME's ice suggested that it predated the formation of the planet.

entry: 它把梦境灌满无尽寒冷与刺骨的风。新月时出来活动，极光便会照亮天空，即使南方远处，也不例外。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It fills dreams with endless cold and biting winds. While active during a new moon, it lights the sky with auroras, even far south.

entry: POKENAME常在融化的冰川中扑腾。透明的晶体结构里，还看得见杂质与碎屑。
author: .towerxvi
source: POKENAME can be seen flopping around in melted glaciers. Impurities and debris can be seen inside their crystalline structure.

entry: 实验室里的一场意外，让周围的冰，获得生命。一声咆哮，就能令山中暴雪，持续数周。
author: Skymaster426
source: The surrounding ice has been brought to life via a freak accident in a lab. It can cause a blizzard on mountains for weeks with a single roar.

entry: 传闻，神奥雪山深处，有一只POKENAME守着宝藏。前去寻找的人不多，能回来的人，更少。
author: coooooooookiee
source: Deep in Sinnoh's snowy mountains, a POKENAME is rumored to guard a treasure. Few have attempted to find it, and fewer have returned.

entry: 身体核心，由耀眼的石英构成。晴天，它能把日光聚入体内，再射出强劲的能量光束。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: The core of its body is made of dazzling quartz. Under a sunny day, it can focus the sunlight into itself to output potent beams of energy.

entry: 融合中的基因错误破坏了它的核心。如今竟同时结冻、融化，形成矛盾的状态。
author: Skymaster426
source: A genetic error in the fusion process corrupted the core of this Pokémon. It is paradoxically freezing and melting at the same time.

entry: POKENAME体温低于摄氏零下100度，身上的火却始终燃烧。此现象，至今尚未经过研究。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Although POKENAME's body temperature is below -100 degrees Celsius, the fire on its body burns continuously. This phenomenon has not yet been studied.

entry: POKENAME永冻的身躯中，封着一种古老、致命的病毒。一旦泄出，后果将不堪设想。
author: tuneless.towa
source: An ancient, life-threatening virus is contained within POKENAME's permafrost body. Its release would bring about catastrophic consequences.

entry: 最近，被封入冰壳的耿鬼传说，又流传起来。有些人相信，传说指的，正是POKENAME。
author: 8xviktor
source: Legends of a Gengar sealed away in an ice casing have resurfaced recently. Some people believe POKENAME is the Pokémon the legend refers to.

entry: 它心怀恶意，爱搞各种冰冷的恶作剧。即使有人滑倒重伤，或遭冻伤，它也只会笑得更厉害。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A baneful Pokémon responsible for many icy pranks. Even if said pranks lead to great injury from slips or freezing, it cackles with great intensity.

entry: 它是外星文明派来的侦察飞行器，常在远处，观察人类。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A spy drone from an alien civilization. It can often be seen observing humans from afar.

entry: POKENAME友善得很，可模样令人不安，大多数人依然害怕，远远避开。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon but because of its unsettling appearance most people fear and avoid it entirely.

entry: 这种融合体强得惊人，咬合力之大，连钻石都能咬碎。
author: FamerMan2
source: This fusion is extremely strong. It can bite with enough force to crush diamonds.

entry: 起初，人们以为POKENAME是某个不明组织的水下摄像飞行器。身体几乎不动，也能游得飞快。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME was originally believed to be an aquatic camera drone for an unknown organization. It can swim very fast while just barely moving its body.

entry: 两种宝可梦彼此不相容，让融合体融化，行动艰难。可它似乎毫不在意，仍拖着壳，慢慢往前走。
author: OhOk3441
source: Due to the incompatibility of both Pokémon, this fusion is melted and struggles to move. It seems unbothered and continues to drag along its shell.

entry: POKENAME移动起来，几乎快如闪电。可动作不够协调，跑着跑着，就可能撞上东西。
author: FamerMan2
source: POKENAME can move nearly as fast as lightning. However, it is not very coordinated and can run into things while doing so.

entry: 它是为抓捕目标而设计的飞行单位，双手能放出大量电流，连巨大目标，也能彻底麻痹。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A flying unit intended for apprehension. It can output massive amounts of electricity through its hands to completely paralyze even massive entities.

entry: POKENAME有着奇异的磁性。因为没嘴，便用背上的磁性流体吞入金属，作为食物。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME exhibit strange magnetic properties. Because it has no mouth, it instead eats metal by absorbing it with the ferrofluid on its back.

entry: 磁场十分强大。任何金属碰到背上的磁性流体，都很快被吞进去。
author: grassy311
source: It has a strong magnetic field. Any metal object that comes into contact with the ferrofluid on its back is quickly engulfed.

entry: POKENAME纯为战争而造，力量毫无拘束，也不带怜悯。POKENAME眼中朱红的光，宛如双刃，能刺穿迷雾。
author: Rooboid
source: Built only for war, POKENAME boast unfettered, callous strength. The vermillion glow of POKENAME's eyes can cut through the fog like two sabres.

entry: 科学家创造POKENAME，想造一件坚不可摧的新型强力武器。机械化的兵装，也让POKENAME足以击败任何敌人。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.

entry: 科学家创造POKENAME，想造一件坚不可摧的新型强力武器。机械化的兵装，也让POKENAME足以击败任何敌人。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.

entry: 这只狡猾的仿生宝可梦，专为高速行动而造。它用幻象诱敌，再趁机反击，打出决定性的一击。
author: the1trugamr_72590
source: This cunning, bionic Pokémon was created to move quickly. It deals decisive blows by using illusions to lure opponents, then counterattacking.

entry: 古代文明造出的机械巨蛇，原为保护创造者，却最终失控，反成了毁灭他们的祸首。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A mechanical serpent built by an ancient civilization. Though originally created to protect them, it went rogue and became their destroyer.

entry: POKENAME体型虽庞大，钻地却快得可怕。烈空坐守着天空，POKENAME则从地下，守卫这颗星球。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It burrows through earth at frightening speeds despite its massive size. While Rayquaza guards the skies, POKENAME guards the planet from below.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的金属在室温下便是液态。谁若被它俯冲而来吞进体内，就再无呼吸的机会。
author: .realthree
source: The metal that makes up POKENAME's body is liquid at room temperature. Those engulfed by its swooping form have no hope of breathing again.

entry: 科学家高估了自己的融合本领，才产生POKENAME。它比普通金属更容易生锈，徘徊在废弃神殿附近。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is the result of scientists overestimating their fusion capabilities. It rusts faster than normal metal and wanders around abandoned temples.

entry: 人类取用了POKENAME身上的金属，使它防护变弱，很快生了锈。它还想修补自己，却也知道，不过白费力气。
author: gun2._
source: Due to humans using POKENAME's metal, its defenses got weaker, and soon rust formed. It tries to rebuild itself but it knows it's a waste of energy.

entry: POKENAME是只为屠戮与毁灭制造的机器。经历过那场战争后，大多数地区，就连拥有一只，都算犯罪。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME are machines made for nothing but slaughter and destruction. It is a crime to merely own one in most regions after what happened in the war.

entry: 体液与水银相似。在科学家证实安全前，训练家最好尽量避免，直接接触POKENAME。
author: cait_sith
source: Its fluid is similar to mercury. Trainers should limit physical contact with POKENAME until the fluid is confirmed to be safe by scientists.

entry: POKENAME虽沉重，动作却灵巧得惊人。即使高速移动，炮管射出的光束，也能准确命中。
author: FamerMan2
source: POKENAME is shockingly agile for its weight. It can accurately fire beams out of its cannon even at high speeds.

entry: 它强壮又坚韧，常被富裕训练家用来护宅。机械化的双眼与尾巴一齐搜寻，便无人能逃过。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: A strong and resilient fusion often used to defend the homes of wealthy Trainers. With the help of its cybernetic eyes and tail, no one can escape it.

entry: POKENAME不唱歌，而是奏出电子音乐与音调，最善于和其他机械宝可梦交流。
author: ohok3441
source: Instead of singing, POKENAME makes electronic music and tones. It communicates best with other machine Pokémon.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME用扬声器放出强大声波。真遇上危急，就干脆把扬声器，直接砸向敌人。
author: ohok3441
source: In battle, POKENAME sends off powerful soundwaves from its speakers. In dire situations, it'll throw those speakers at threats instead.

entry: 民间故事里，有种耿鬼被关进钢铁身躯的怪物。许多人觉得，POKENAME与它十分相像。
author: 8xviktor
source: Many people have spotted the similarities between POKENAME and a folktale creature described as a Gengar confined to a steel construct.

entry: POKENAME假扮成沼泽植物的花。有人靠近，便先撒出大量剧毒花粉，再赶紧逃走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME likes to disguise itself as the flower of a swamp plants. Anyone approaching it is bombarded with highly toxic pollen before it flees.

entry: POKENAME浮在沼泽表面，以甜香引来虫宝可梦，再用花粉，让对方麻痹。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME floats on the surface of bogs. It emits a sweet scent to attract bug Pokémon, which it then paralyzes using pollen.

entry: 两把石质般的刃中，藏着数十粒小种子。种子会钻入刃造成的伤口，若不处理，便逐渐杀死新的宿主。
author: spookoftheoldways
source: In its two stone-like blades lay dozens of tiny seeds that burrow into wounds they cause. If left untreated, the seeds slowly kill their new host.

entry: POKENAME住在热带水道，借红树根潜伏，再用镰刀般的爪劈向猎物，吸尽体液。
author: ansleehariot
source: Living in tropical waterways, POKENAME uses mangrove roots as cover to ambush prey, slashing them with its scythe-like claws to drain their fluids.

entry: 它身上气味刺鼻，走过时，就能让一些人类与宝可梦，当场昏倒。
author: TheHeroicT
source: The scent given off by this Pokémon is pungent. It causes some Pokémon and humans to faint when it walks by.

entry: POKENAME背后的花，为它提供养分。不够的能量，则靠捕食被花吸引的小宝可梦补充。
author: ohok3441
source: The flower atop POKENAME's back provides it with nutrients. It gets the rest of its energy by hunting smaller Pokémon attracted by the flower.

entry: POKENAME较小的附肢，不是用来走路的，而是用来抓住猎物，或攀住树干。
author: ohok3441
source: The smaller limbs of POKENAME are aren't used for walking. Instead, they're used for grabbing prey and holding onto the sides of trees.

entry: POKENAME低空疾飞，撒下孢子。小虫被麻痹后，便成了它的一顿饭。
author: mistershaokahn
source: POKENAME flies at high speed and low altitude to spread its spores. These paralyze the insects that will make up its meal.

entry: POKENAME脸上的花一开，便看不清路，常撞上树木，一路留下花粉。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME has a lot of trouble seeing where it is going after the flower on its face blooms. It bumps into trees constantly, leaving behind pollen.

entry: POKENAME以漂亮的花冠骗人靠近，再冷不丁朝对方脸上，喷出会引起过敏的花粉。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME tricks people with the beautiful appearance of its flower cap before releasing a burst of allergenic pollen into their face.

entry: POKENAME一旋转，刺激性花粉便卷入敌人双眼，让对方再无力防备，接连而来的旋身踢击。
author: wigglypon
source: As POKENAME spins, a swirling cloud of irritating pollen gets in foes' eyes, leaving them defenseless against the incoming onslaught of spin-kicks.

entry: 受到威胁，就会释放一股浓烈难闻的麝香气。身体两侧的手臂，已经退化，没什么力气。
author: .realthree
source: When threatened, it releases an incredibly odorous musk. The arms on its sides are vestigial, and have no real strength.

entry: POKENAME性情害羞，通常远离人类。它的舌头能辨别东西是否有毒，因此许多侦探都会请它帮忙。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME are shy and usually stay away from humans. Its tongue can sense whether something is poisoned or not, so it's used by many detectives.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀，主要用来在林间滑翔。看似凶悍，实际却只靠光合作用为生。
author: imagine1.
source: The wings on POKENAME are mostly used for gliding around the forest. It may seem violent, but it only feeds on photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME放出的奇特孢子，只要一碰电子设备，几秒内便让其停止工作。可对人类与宝可梦，似乎没有伤害。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME release peculiar spores that shut down anything electronic within seconds of contact. Those spores seem to be harmless to humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME催开花朵，用鲜亮的花光，为迷路旅人引路。在地底深处，仿佛一盏生命的灯塔。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME brings forth blooming flowers that guide lost travelers with their vibrant glow. It is a beacon of life in the heart of the underground.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME会袭击村庄。白天若看见它，就意味着不久会遭到伏击。
author: CodeWolfie
source: In ancient times, POKENAME would ravage villages. Seeing one during the day signified an ambush in the near future.

entry: 花中火焰，靠大量花粉维持。若被这种火烧伤，便会终生受过敏之苦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The flame of its flower is kept alive by enormous amounts of pollen. Anyone burnt by these flames will be plagued with lifelong allergies.

entry: 这根手杖会放出黄色的花粉云，效力强得足以让人麻痹。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This staff emits a clouds of yellow pollen that is so potent it can cause paralysis.

entry: 身上的大花，散出安抚心神的香气，让任何靠近的生物，都渐渐平静。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The large flowers on its body emit a calming aroma that pacifies anyone that comes near.

entry: 羽毛沾满剧毒、刺人的花粉。一激动，便拍起双翅，让令人窒息的粉尘，充斥四周。
author: Staghorn
source: Its feathers are saturated with toxic, stinging pollen. When agitated, it flaps its wings and chokes its surroundings with its suffocating powder.

entry: 核心里燃烧的火，滋养着身上的植物。照料得好的POKENAME，头顶的花，也会开得更大。
author: char_latte3412
source: The fire burning within its core invigorates the plant-life on its body. A well-cared for POKENAME will have larger flowers atop their heads.

entry: POKENAME能随指令，开合脸上的花朵。开开合合之间，便散出极其刺鼻的气味。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: POKENAME is capable of opening and closing its face flowers on command. Doing this makes them emit a very pungent smell.

entry: 这只大花宝可梦，花瓣长得太盛，几乎动不了身，便用花粉诱来其他宝可梦，照顾自己。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A large flower Pokémon overgrown with petals. It can barely move, but uses pollen to lure Pokémon in to care for it.

entry: 它气息芳香，快乐地飘来飘去，把愉悦的芬芳，传给四周，因此十分受欢迎。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon with a pleasant scent. It happily floats around spreading joy with the pleasant fragrant. It's very popular as a result.

entry: POKENAME是深林的守护者，用催眠孢子惩戒恶徒。若来者心怀善意，便赠以珍稀药草。
author: noel5229
source: A protector of the deep forest, POKENAME attacks wrongdoers with hypnotic spores. It bestows rare medicinal herbs to the well-intentioned.

entry: 很久以前，奈克洛兹玛吸收一只顽皮雷弹，形成了POKENAME。上半球是光之能量，下半球则为暗能量。
author: planatical
source: Long ago, a Necrozma absorbed an Electrode, creating POKENAME. Its upper hemisphere is light energy, while the lower hemisphere is dark energy.

entry: POKENAME的双眼很怕光。头盔会吸收日光，替眼睛挡住阳光，可也遮去了不少视线。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME's eyes are sensitive to light. Its helmet shields its eyes from sunlight by absorbing it, but it also obscures its vision.

entry: 月光下，它会变得更强。人们曾见过一种更明亮的POKENAME，据说，有引发日食的力量。
author: bucklin
source: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.

entry: 月光下，它会变得更强。人们曾见过一种更明亮的POKENAME，据说，有引发日食的力量。
author: bucklin
source: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.

entry: 互联网传来的文件，为它完成了更新。它也学会现代网站的做法，能切换深色、浅色两种形态。
author: b_megamaths
source: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. It adapted the option to change between dark and light forms from modern websites.

entry: 互联网传来的文件，为它完成了更新。训练家们却常争论，究竟深色形态好看，还是浅色好看。
author: b_megamaths
source: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. Trainers often get into fights about if it looks better in dark or light form.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之波奈克洛兹玛”。融合后的超能力，足以让整片海洋，从中分开。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Wave Necrozma. With its combined psychic powers, it is able to cause the ocean itself to split apart.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之热奈克洛兹玛”。吸收凤王体内的热量后，POKENAME能放出世上最炽热的火焰之一。
author: Toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Heat Necrozma. By absorbing the heat within Ho-Oh, POKENAME can create some of the hottest flames in existence.

entry: POKENAME从黯淡未来而来，想吸取生物体内的光，修复自己所处的时代。可一切徒劳，让它愤怒不已。
author: gamertag1001.
source: POKENAME travelled from a bleak future to absorb light from living things and use it to repair its time. This effort failed, causing it great anger.

entry: 网络更新之后，它便举止古怪，外貌模仿着一个臭名昭著的网站。
author: b_megamaths
source: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. Its appearance mimics an infamous internet website.

entry: 网络更新之后，它便举止古怪。靠近电脑时，总想复制自己，可通常都不成功。
author: b_megamaths
source: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. It attempts to copy itself when it's near computers, but it usually fails to do so.

entry: POKENAME能吸收各种波长的光，让花瓣闪出万般色彩，也因此特别擅长使用日光束。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME absorbs all wavelengths of light, causing its petals to shine in all sorts of colors. It's especially adept at using Solar Beam as a result.

entry: 无数色彩在体内流转，许多颜色，早已久不见于世。它不断从四周汲取，可颜色再多，也填不满欲望。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Countless colors swirl within itself, many not seen since long ago. It saps from the world around it, and yet for all that color, it hungers for more.

entry: 据说，光明与黑暗，正由这只宝可梦创造。消耗了大半光能，身体也已黯淡下来。
author: Soup1900
source: It is said that this Pokémon was responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Its body has darkened due to using most of its light energy.

entry: 它穿行各个世界，吞尽所有光芒。许多世界因此沉入永夜，最终走向灭亡。
author: Soup1900
source: It traverses through various realms, devouring all the light there is. This has caused many worlds to plunge into eternal darkness and eventually die.

entry: 这只宝可梦仿佛完全由明亮金光构成。挨过POKENAME拳头的人，都说连灵魂，也受了伤。
author: puppetmaster64
source: This Pokémon seems to be made completely out of a bright golden light. Those who have been punched by POKENAME say that their soul has been damaged.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: POKENAME将本体藏在究极空间，用超能力打开究极之洞。谁靠得太近，就会遭到密集的斩击。
author: MunchyAxolotls
source: POKENAME hides its body in Ultra Space, using its psychic energy to create ultra wormholes. Those who wander too close are bombarded with slashes.

entry: 仙子伊布亲切的性情让奈克洛兹玛少了凶性。如今它在和睦与温柔日光中安然生活。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Sylveon's affable nature has loosened up Necrozma's viciousness. Now it thrives off of harmony and gentle sunlight.

entry: 凭掌控空间的力量，POKENAME能让自己的光，现于宇宙任何一处。光突然亮起时，宛如超新星爆发。
author: Blazerxz
source: With its control over space, POKENAME can make its light appear anywhere in the universe. The sudden appearance of its light is akin to a supernova.

entry: 光辉大神的本源，与永恒黑暗融合。据说，凝视其中一块晶体，便会看见难以言说、不属人间的恐怖。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: The essence of the Blinding One fused with eternal darkness. It is said gazing into one of its crystals reveals indescribable, unearthly horrors.

entry: 炮击之后，会留下名为“究极之洞”的奇异通道。这门炮，正是靠光能充能。
author: Soup1900
source: The blasts from its cannon are known to leave behind strange portals called Ultra Wormholes. It charges this cannon using light energy.

entry: 人们认为这座方尖碑是宝可梦，可连它是否有生命都没有证据。接触过它的考古学家似乎不久便会失踪。
author: puppetmaster64
source: This obelisk is thought to be a Pokémon, but there is no proof it even is a living being. Archeologists all seem to go missing shortly after contact.

entry: POKENAME跨越不同维度，只为守着自己喜欢的古老石碑。它们装成柱子，伏击擅闯者。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME travel across dimensions with the intent of guarding an ancient monument they like. They camouflage as pillars to ambush trespassers.

entry: POKENAME由未知的晶体结构构成，能吸收光芒，再将其化作纯粹能量，发射出去。
author: puppetmaster64
source: POKENAME's body is composed of an unknown crystalline structure that has the ability to absorb light. This light can then be shot out as pure energy.

entry: 它是实验室事故之后，最后诞生的融合体，以铁腕支配与自己相似的存在，攻击时毫不留情。
author: imagine1.
source: This fusion is the last born from the aftermath of a lab accident. It controls others like it with an iron fist and shows no mercy when attacking.

entry: 据说，POKENAME原是异世界的孩子，意外来到这条时间线，还能运用人类无法掌控的黑魔法。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are said to have been otherworldly children, accidentally transported to this timeline. They're said to harness dark magic we cannot control.

entry: POKENAME粉红色的身体并非实体，而是纯粹能量，仅靠构成其形体的黑晶约束在内。
author: ETheWriter
source: The pink body of POKENAME is not actually physical. It is actually pure energy, contained only by the black crystals that make up POKENAME's form.

entry: 传闻，它们是来自另一个现实的侦察兵，总挑古怪的地方现身，一被发现就消失，几乎不可能捕到。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Rumored to be scouts from another reality. They find strange spots to appear, vanishing on being noticed. Catching them has proven near impossible.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的烈焰，能射出强大的彩色光束，先晃瞎猎物，再猛然咬下。
author: puppetmaster64
source: The strong flame on the end of POKENAME's tail creates powerful beams of colorful light. It is known to blind prey before biting down upon them.

entry: POKENAME危险至极，想靠近就得千万小心，最好干脆别去！它的火焰比太阳还热，脾气，也是如此。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is very dangerous; proceed with caution or don't proceed at all! Its flames are hotter than the sun, as is its temper.

entry: POKENAME随时可能消散，因此不停穿行宇宙，吞食一切找得到的光源。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is at constant risk of fading away. It constantly travels the cosmos to devour any source of light it can find.

entry: 丛林中，许多人把POKENAME误当成遭弃的儿童玩具。可它带有剧毒，这个误会，代价可能极大。
author: .realthree
source: Those who encounter POKENAME in the jungle often mistake it for an abandoned child's toy. It's extremely venomous, so this can be a costly mistake.

entry: 它乍看与玩具圆丝蛛一模一样，却是活的。几条腿，攀附得牢固得出奇。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Spinarak, but it is alive. The legs are surprisingly grippy.

entry: 毛绒般的皮肤与娇小身躯，让它轻易钻进仅有自身一半大的空隙。遇险便用结实尾巴狠狠敲击敌人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its plush skin and diminutive body lets it squeeze into spaces half its size with ease. When threatened, it whacks its enemies with its sturdy tail.

entry: POKENAME手脚短，得靠人抱着走。可它太受欢迎，有时想被放下来，都不容易。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has short limbs, so it relies on humans to carry it around. It's so popular, sometimes it has a hard time getting set down.

entry: 它模样像玩具沼王，却有着生命。可与真正的沼王不同，它并不喜欢沾水。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears similar to a toy Quagsire, but it is alive. Unlike real Quagsire, it doesn't like to get wet.

entry: POKENAME除了“咪——普”，几乎不说别的话。有些科学家猜测，它可能来自另一个维度。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME do not say much, aside from "MEEP". Some scientists theorize that it came from a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME身体多孔，一吸水，分量便会大增，打出去的一击，也随之更有力。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has a very porous body, and absorbing water greatly increases its weight. It uses this to add extra power to its strikes.

entry: 它看着与玩具章鱼桶一模一样，却是活的。底下藏着一只吸盘，能贴住任何平坦表面。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Octillery, but it is alive. It has a hidden suction cup underneath that lets it stick on any flat surface.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，性情温和，还带着淡淡草莓牛奶香。乡间集会上，常有人带它们出来展示。
author: skinstealers
source: POKENAME are soft and gentle creatures, and smell faintly of strawberry milk. They often shown off at county fairs.

entry: 蓬松毛发，既为POKENAME保暖，也护住身体。遇险时，便将毛里夹的沙子，朝敌人眼里撒。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur keeps it warm and protects it. When in danger, it throws sand that got caught in its fur into the eyes of an enemy.

entry: 它很像某座岛上，用来战斗的玩偶。故事里，想拿它来玩的孩子，从此再没出现过。
author: bucklin
source: Its appearance resembles a doll used for battles on a certain island. Stories say that children who try to play with it are never seen again.

entry: 它很像某座岛上，用来战斗的玩偶。故事里，想拿它来玩的孩子，从此再没出现过。
author: bucklin
source: Its appearance resembles a doll used for battles on a certain island. Stories say that children who try to play with it are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME的面甲，不像盾甲龙那样坚硬，反而像软垫。不过，靠缓冲多数冲击，也仍能护身。
author: mx_wellman
source: Unlike Shieldon's, POKENAME's face plate is almost-cushion-like. However, it still provides protection by softening most blows.

entry: POKENAME看见孩子玩茶会，就想装成其中一件玩具，偷偷凑近，尝尝摆出的甜点。
author: .realthree
source: If POKENAME sees a child having a tea party, it will attempt to pass itself off as one of their toys in order to get closer to the offered sweets.

entry: 它乍看与玩具波加曼一模一样，却是活的。好奇心无穷，溜去别处也毫无愧疚。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Piplup, but it is alive. Endlessly curious, it feels no remorse at wandering off.

entry: POKENAME看着像儿童玩具剑，可谁想把它拿起，哪怕轻轻挥上一下，也可能致命。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME may look like a children's toy sword, but a weak swing towards anyone who attempts to pick it up can be lethal.

entry: POKENAME模样像软枕头，力气却大得足以撞倒树木。
author: b_megamaths
source: POKENAME resemble soft pillows. However, they are strong enough to knock down trees.

entry: 据说，POKENAME毛发曾闪着海中万般色彩。可长年泡在盐水里，渐渐失去了光泽。
author: .realthree
source: It is said that POKENAME's fur was once vibrantly glowing with all the colors in the sea, but long-term exposure to saltwater has dulled it.

entry: 它看着与玩具盖欧卡一模一样，却是活的。盖欧卡的名声虽可怕，它却善良、温柔。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Kyogre, but it is alive. Despite Kyogre's terrifying reputation, this fusion is kind and gentle.

entry: POKENAME凶猛易怒。幸好，牙和爪都是毛毡做的，真伤起谁来，也没多大威力。
author: Thisisabruh_moment
source: POKENAME is ferocious and quick to anger. Fortunately for its would-be victims, its teeth and claws are made of felt so it can't do much damage.

entry: POKENAME身体软得像毯子，常被用来帮助孩子入睡，有时也作为礼物送给新生儿。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is commonly used in sleep therapy for children and is sometimes gifted to newborns. This is due to its incredibly soft, blanket-like body.

entry: POKENAME忠诚坚定，守护朋友。毛绒外表下，是一颗坚如磐石的心，随时准备抵挡威胁。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME protects its friends with unwavering loyalty. Its plush exterior conceals a heart of stone, ready to defend against any threat.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，却不知道自己力气有多大，嬉戏之间，常把别人弄伤。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME doesn't realize how powerful it actually is, so it often hurts others while playing. This Pokémon loves to play.

entry: POKENAME装作毛绒玩具，已到了以假乱真的地步。要不是融合后个头变大，根本分不清。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's mimicry of a plush toy has reached its pinnacle. If it weren't for the extra size it gained during fusion, it would be indistinguishable.

entry: POKENAME装作毛绒玩具，已到了以假乱真的地步。这只个体，配色还十分罕见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's mimicry of a plush toy has reached its pinnacle. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: POKENAME尾尖长出的绒毛，极容易烧起来，甚至只搁在阳光下，就可能起火。
author: .realthree
source: The fluff generated at the end of POKENAME's tail is easily combustible. Just leaving it out in the sunlight can cause a fire.

entry: POKENAME爱玩的毛线球，覆着一层薄金。若有人想拿走线球，POKENAME就拼命扑打，将它夺回来。
author: GP423
source: The ball of yarn that POKENAME plays with has a thin gold coating. If you try to take this yarn, POKENAME will thrash at you to get it back.

entry: 它看着与玩具火恐龙一样，却是活的。毛绒尾巴热得发光，远处便能看见。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Charmeleon but is alive. The glow of heat from its fluffy tail can be seen from a distance.

entry: POKENAME的脸像个靶子，因此常挨打。它自己却很喜欢，因为挨过几下，训练的劲头就上来了。
author: mx_wellman
source: Because their face looks like a target, POKENAME tend to get hit a lot. They enjoy this, as it helps them get pumped for training.

entry: POKENAME看着像毛绒玩具，可未必喜欢被抱。不过一旦交上朋友，就会忠诚一辈子。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME may look like a stuffed animal, but that doesn't mean it likes to be cuddled. When it's befriended it is loyal for life.

entry: POKENAME一心渴望打拳。可偏偏没有拳头，求而不得，只好一直又怒又恼。
author: CapWolfBane
source: POKENAME has an incredible need to get into fistfights. However, lacking fists, it cannot fulfill this need and become endlessly angry and frustrated.

entry: 它身手灵巧，眨眼间便能抓住猎物，再用尾巴紧紧勒住，锁进致命的拥抱。
author: alliveir
source: It is nimble and can catch prey in the blink of an eye. It squeezes prey with its tail, locking them in a deadly embrace.

entry: 个头虽小，力道却大得出奇。一尾巴抽下去，甚至比某些职业棒球手的挥棒还猛。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Despite its meager size, it's deceptively strong—a single whack of its tail hits harder than some professional baseball players.

entry: 别让POKENAME趴到身上。它会亲昵地贴得太紧，轻易就折断你的肋骨。
author: themicelegion
source: Don't let POKENAME lay on top of you, because it will snuggle on you so hard that it can easily break your ribs.

entry: POKENAME曾在恐怖电影里担任主角，可POKENAME其实十分讨喜，最爱温暖的拥抱。
author: monoski1
source: POKENAME once starred in a horror movie. However, POKENAME is actually quite sweet and loves warm hugs.

entry: 有人一靠近，它便容易胡乱挥打。力道之大，能把对手打飞到很远。
author: b_megamaths
source: It has a tendency to flail wildly if approached. The force of its blows can launch opponents very far away.

entry: 它招手诱人靠近，再用巨力抱紧，让对方虚弱下来，吸收灵魂。
author: bucklin
source: It beckons people to get close to it, then hugs them with huge force to debilitate them and absorb their spirit.

entry: 它招手诱人靠近，再用巨力抱紧，让对方虚弱下来，吸收灵魂。
author: bucklin
source: It beckons people to get close to it, then hugs them with huge force to debilitate them and absorb their spirit.

entry: POKENAME终于领会愤怒的真意，也学会将其化为自身，名字由此而来。
author: mx_wellman
source: A POKENAME has learned the true meaning of rage and how to embody it, hence the name.

entry: 奥多马雷的一家睡眠诊所，雇用POKENAME，让失眠者沉沉入睡。它还会温柔引领病人，走进幸福的梦。
author: .izik
source: A sleep clinic in Alto Mare employs POKENAME to lull insomniacs into a deep sleep. It lovingly guides the patients through blissful dreams.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船墓场出没。腐木中的重要养分，是它们进化前不可缺少的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are commonly seen in ship graveyards. The rotten wood holds vital nutrients that they require before evolving.

entry: 海藻的灵魂蔓延到沉船的炮弹与黑火药桶上。如今POKENAME飘来飘去，稍一碰触就会爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The soul of seaweed overgrew the cannonballs and black powder barrels of a sunken ship. Now, POKENAME floats around and detonates at the merest touch.

entry: 沉船墓场里，POKENAME的数量格外多。可那些船究竟有多少，是它们弄沉的，仍不得而知。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: A particularly large number of POKENAME can be found at ship graveyards. The extent to which they are responsible for the sinking of ships is unknown.

entry: 它是锈铁与海带构成的海马。虽是人造之物，那颗心，却再真实不过。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A seahorse made of rusted metal and kelp. Even though it's artificial, its heart is as real as it could be.

entry: POKENAME的长发，有着超自然力量，被认为是其力量源头。人们也称它“海之魔女”。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's hair bears supernatural properties; it is thought to be the source of its power. It has been called "The Witch of the Sea".

entry: 每有海难，渔民便似乎会在静卧的沉船旁，见到POKENAME。据说，金属崩裂的声音，会把这头巨兽引来。
author: puppetmaster64
source: Whenever there is a shipwreck, fishermen seem to spot POKENAME around the dormant vessels. The sound of the crumbling metal is said to lure the beast.

entry: 科学家认为，被附身的海藻，才是POKENAME的本体。船骸上的部件，不过是护具与工具。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Scientists believe the possessed seaweed is POKENAME's actual body. The parts used from wreckages act as protection and tools.

entry: 遭到攻击，POKENAME便把敏感的海草部分，缩回残骸拼成的坚固船体。它也会为深海照明。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If POKENAME is attacked, it pulls its sensitive seagrass parts back into the robust hull made of wreckage. It lights up the deep sea.

entry: 有人怀疑，POKENAME不过是拖着佛烈托斯空壳的破破舵轮。真要调查，它就胡乱甩起沉壳，表示抗议。
author: bukie
source: Some suspect POKENAME is merely a Dhelmise towing the empty shell of a Forretress. When investigated, it protests by swinging this heavy shell wildly.

entry: POKENAME原本住在陆地。命运转折的某一天，整个种族被赶进海洋，从此逐渐进化，适应海中生活。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME was once a land dwelling Pokémon. One fateful day, the species was driven to the ocean. It has evolved to live in the sea.

entry: POKENAME是由船骸与未知苔藓组成的自动机关，游荡深海，寻找更多残骸，接到自己身上。
author: SunnyScarab
source: POKENAME are automatons composed of shipwrecks and an unknown moss. They roam the deep seas in search of more shipwrecks to attach to themselves.

entry: 对POKENAME来说，什么都比不上锚的完整。它们的领地，总有格外多的沉船。
author: pikahunter07
source: POKENAME value the integrity of their anchor above all else. Their territories are marked by a high number of shipwrecks.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船旁出现，带着一只大锚。一察觉敌意，就会挥锚猛击对方。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: A POKENAME is found near shipwrecks, carrying a large anchor with it. It will violently strike individuals with its anchor if it senses hostility.

entry: POKENAME的模样，启发了一支水手号子，告诫航海者避开险海：那里住着逝去船员化成的复仇宝可梦。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME's appearance has inspired a sea shanty that warns sailors to avoid ruinous seas, as they harbour the vengeful Pokémon of fallen seafarers.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的船，与时光一样古老。勾魂眼总想偷船中的圆珠，也让POKENAME与它们成了冤家。
author: Drip_capybara
source: The ship on the back of POKENAME is said to be as old as time. POKENAME has a rivalry with Sableye as they try to steal the orb in the ship.

entry: 幽灵附身的海藻，若蔓进沉船，便会越长越广。极少数时候，最终就会化成POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: If a shipwreck is infested by possessed seaweed, it can spread further and further. In extremely rare cases, this results in POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在古老沉船，守着前主人生前积攒的宝藏。它会凶猛奋战，直至最后。
author: kermitcermet#2076
source: Living in old sunken ships, POKENAME protects the treasure their previous master amassed in life. This Pokémon fights fiercely to the very end.

entry: 据说，它原是一艘深海航船，意外之后，便化成水中的幽影。船上亡魂，至今仍永不停歇地巡视海洋。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Said to have once been a deep sea vessel, after an accident it now haunts the waters as its ghostly crew forever survey the ocean.

entry: 它等倒霉的猎物靠近，再猛烈爆炸。海带却会活下来，重新搜集金属碎片，拼起身体。
author: seaslux
source: It waits for hapless prey to draw near, then explodes violently. The kelp survives and, in the aftermath, rebuilds its body from metal debris.

entry: POKENAME诞生自大型邮轮沉入海中的吊灯。泡海太久，钢铁早已锈成了坚实的一团。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is born from sunken chandeliers on large cruise ships. Its steel rusted solid after all the time in the ocean.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾是海盗船长的钥匙圈。几个世纪过去，即使腐蚀严重，钥匙的形状，仍没丢失。
author: grassy311
source: It's said that POKENAME was the keyring of a pirate captain. Centuries later, it still retains the shape of its keys even after significant corrosion.

entry: 贪婪的钥圈儿，曾像海盗一样搜宝，最终为追逐海底财宝而死，被破破舵轮占据身体。如今成了POKENAME，只能漫无目的地漂流。
author: SlowForest
source: Once a greedy swashbuckler, Klefki met its end chasing treasures in the deep sea, where Dhelmise seized its body. Now POKENAME, it drifts aimlessly.

entry: 它伸出缠着金属重物的海带茎，将自己固定海底。快要爆炸时，罗盘便会飞快打转。
author: seaslux
source: It roots itself to the ocean floor by extending a stalk of kelp wrapped around a metal weight. Its compass spins quickly when it is about to explode.

entry: POKENAME戴着旧潜水头盔护身，在海底找食物。据说，谁想拿下头盔，便会遭到诅咒。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME use old diving helmets as protection as they search the ocean floor for food. It is said to curse anyone who tries to remove the helmet.

entry: 尾上绑着一批航海信号旗，举起不同旗帜便能交流。如今大多数船上都留着一只POKENAME。
author: seaslux
source: It keeps a collection of maritime flags tied to its tail and raises them to communicate. Most ships now keep a POKENAME on board.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成废弃的船锚。可贸然靠近十分危险，它随时都能突然加速，飞驰而去。
author: mors_martii
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for an abandoned anchor. However, it is dangerous to approach, for POKENAME can speed off at a moment's notice.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾属于很久以前的一位名船长。谁敢从船长室偷走受诅咒的财宝，就会遭它们攻击。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are said to have belonged to a famous captain from long ago. They attack any who dare to steal their cursed treasure from the captain's room.

entry: 海盗船员的亡魂，与沉船融为一体，形成了它。据说，海上看见这只宝可梦，是不幸将至的预兆。
author: SonicDestroyer12
source: This Pokémon was formed when the souls of a pirate crew united with their sunken ship. Seeing it at sea is said to be an omen of ill fortune.

entry: 老水手故事里，POKENAME曾率领一群贪婪宝可梦。可它们后来叛变，反将POKENAME沉入大洋深处。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: An old sailor's tale tells of POKENAME leading a band of rapacious Pokémon. However, they mutinied and sank POKENAME to the depths of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME在海底锈蚀的船骸旁，窸窣爬行。天敌很爱它的滋味，幸好这身伪装，能保护自己。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME scuttles around rusting wrecks on the ocean's floor. Its camouflage protects it from predators, who find it delicious.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，很少挪动。有人见过大钳蟹把它当成住处，试着往身体里钻。
author: JokersWild
source: Found on the sea floor, POKENAME rarely move. Krabby have been spotted trying to enter these Pokémon, mistaking them for shelter.

entry: 人们害怕POKENAME惑人的歌声，将它拴到锚上，扔进大海。可水手们说，时至今日，仍能听见它唱。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: People feared POKENAME's alluring voice, so they chained it to an anchor and tossed it into the sea. Sailors claim they can still hear it to this day.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜伏沉船与海底遗迹旁。潜水者若靠得太近，便注定失去灵魂。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME lurk around sunken shipwrecks and ruins. Divers who get too close to this Pokémon are doomed to lose their soul.

entry: POKENAME用海藻般的长肢捕捉猎物，罗盘似的双眼，则能追踪任何目标。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME uses its long, seaweed-like limbs to capture prey. It can track anything using its compass eyes.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜伏沉船与海底遗迹旁。潜水者若靠得太近，便注定失去灵魂。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME lurk around sunken shipwrecks and ruins. Divers who get too close to this Pokémon are doomed to lose their soul.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: Cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: Cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: Cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: Cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦拖进大水域，吸走生命力。身体则由生锈的锚与海藻组成。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME drags other Pokémon into large bodies of water, stealing their life force. Its body is made of rusted anchors and seaweed.

entry: 它是很久以前，葬身大海的水手亡魂。夜里漂在水下，走到哪里，就泛起诡异绿光。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A ghostly sailor lost to sea long ago. It can be seen floating under the water at night, giving an eerie green glow wherever it goes.

entry: 它曾是地位显赫的海盗，后来死于海难。如今将船只拖往海底，壮大自己的队伍。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A high-ranking pirate lost in a shipwreck. It drags ships down to the seafloor to add to its ranks.

entry: 它曾是一名在海上失踪的船长。如今，似乎还能支配海中的破鬼斯与破鬼斯通。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A ship captain who was lost at sea once upon a time. It seems to have some control over the Dhelmtly and Dhelmter of the sea.

entry: 每只POKENAME都坚信，自己是最漂亮的小公主。没错，它们每一只都是。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are all convinced that they are the prettiest little princess. They are all correct.

entry: 每只POKENAME都坚信，自己是最漂亮的小公主。没错，它们每一只都是。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are all convinced that they are the prettiest little princess. They are all correct.

entry: 鲜亮的硬壳，是给天敌看的警告。可倒刺里的毒，还没成熟到能真正发挥效用。
author: Xephyr
source: The vibrancy of its hard shell is meant to ward off predators. However, the poison in its barbs has not matured into an effective toxin yet.

entry: POKENAME见到会动的东西，就会攻击，连同族也不放过。这种融合体，对珊瑚礁危害极大。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME will attack anything that moves, including others of the same species. This fusion wrecks havoc on coral reefs.

entry: POKENAME的毒，虽让人疼痛很久，却不致命。它喜欢哪个训练家，反而会咬上几口。
author: OhOk3441
source: Whilst painful and long lasting, the toxin POKENAME produces isn't deadly. It bites Trainers it is affectionate towards.

entry: 尾部的肢体，能帮它游泳时掌握方向。若有一根脱落，过上几周，便会重新长好。
author: OhOk3441
source: Its tail limbs help it navigate while swimming. If one falls off, it'll regrow after a few weeks.

entry: 融合给了POKENAME惊人的超能力，可它只把力量，用来恐吓当地的太阳珊瑚群。
author: NellNast42
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME incredible psychic powers. However, it only uses these abilities to terrorize local Corsola populations.

entry: POKENAME气味诱人，却带着毒。即使毒气让人痛苦不堪，许多宝可梦仍不顾一切，寻香而来。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME have an alluring yet toxic scent. Despite the excruciating pain from the fumes, many Pokémon will still blindly seek it out.

entry: POKENAME气味诱人，却带着毒。即使毒气让人痛苦不堪，许多宝可梦仍不顾一切，寻香而来。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME have an alluring yet toxic scent. Despite the excruciating pain from the fumes, many Pokémon will still blindly seek it out.

entry: POKENAME的毒液，能让人煎熬三天。背鳍发光，便把猎物引入带电的水中。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME's venom induces three days of torment. Its dorsal fin glows, luring prey into its electrified waters.

entry: 毒液让受害者对光极其敏感。即使服了解药，它发出的光，也仍会引起偏头痛。
author: Staghorn
source: Its poison makes its victims extremely sensitive to light. Even if the victim takes an antidote, the light it emits will still give them migraines.

entry: POKENAME与众多同类，聚居在大洋深处。其他宝可梦都明白，这些危险的地方，还是别靠近为妙。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in large clusters with others of its kind deep under the ocean. Other Pokémon know not to approach these dangerous areas.

entry: POKENAME潜行海底，装成无害的海洋生物，轻易便能靠近毫无防备的太阳珊瑚群。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME skulks across the ocean floor, disguised as a harmless sea creature. This lets it easily sneak up on unsuspecting Corsola populations.

entry: 它沉睡在海床下，是深海的守护者。天生善猎，谁被认作威胁，便会遭它从深处扑出，抓住吞下。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A guardian of the deep that sleeps below the seafloor. Predatory in nature, it will lunge from the depths to grab and devour any it deems a threat.

entry: 它耐心躲在带刺的拱壳下面。太阳珊瑚一游过，壳便打开，POKENAME射出致命毒弹。
author: NellNast42
source: It waits patiently sheltered under its spiky dome. When Corsola swim by, the dome opens up, and POKENAME fires off a lethal toxic bullet.

entry: 靠着分泌的强毒，POKENAME跻身顶级猎手。哪怕只擦破一点皮，毒素也会在不到一分钟内，夺走你的生命。
author: typhloquil
source: Due to the toxins it secretes, POKENAME is an apex predator. If it merely scratches you, the toxins will lead to your demise in under a minute.

entry: POKENAME藏入丛林，设伏、下毒，再吞食猎物。可POKENAME异样鲜艳的配色，又让它实在难以隐蔽。
author: layspark
source: POKENAME will hide in jungles to trap, poison, and then consume its prey. However, due to POKENAME's noticeable exotic colors, it's not very stealthy.

entry: 它被记为海上毒性最强的宝可梦之一。哪怕当地只发现一只POKENAME，也得疏散整片海滩。
author: char_latte3412
source: Documented as one of the most toxic ocean-faring Pokémon, entire beaches will have to be evacuated if even one POKENAME is spotted in the area.

entry: POKENAME高速撞向对手。虽然没法施展常规摔角技巧，仍能靠撞击与诡计，把敌人赶出擂台。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME barrels into foes at high speeds. While it cannot rely on standard wrestling techniques, it can still knock and trick foes out of the ring.

entry: POKENAME个头不大，力气却大得惊人，连更大的对手也能摔。第二颗头仿佛自行行动，会猛地撞向敌人。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME is remarkably strong for its size, capable of wrestling bigger foes. Its second head seems to act on its own and bodily slams into foes.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀般的爪，打出凶猛一击，只要命中，便有要害之威。可惜，准头实在很差。
author: NellNast42
source: With its scythe-like claws, POKENAME's savage blows are guaranteed to pack a critical punch. However, these attacks are very inaccurate.

entry: POKENAME是出色的猎手，长爪与头部，都是武器。双腿更赋予惊人速度，快得能与喷气机相比。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME are proficient hunters, using their long claws and head as weapons. Their legs give them extraordinary speed that puts them on par with jets.

entry: 若见两只摔角鹰人在POKENAME上方交锋，便会看见它翘尾敲铃，宣告摔角开始。
author: creamy_art
source: If you see two Hawlucha fighting above POKENAME, you'll see its tail lift to strike the bell, signaling to the Hawlucha that it's time to wrestle.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: Cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: Cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: POKENAME飞越大地，搜寻对手。谁看起来比自己更强，POKENAME就毫不留情地攻过去。
author: Gurguro
source: It searches for opponents while soaring across the lands. If a POKENAME sees something that looks stronger than it, it will attack mercilessly.

entry: 它出手迅猛，招式又诡诈。有些训练家，反而觉得看这套战法，十分有趣。
author: b_megamaths
source: It attacks with vicious speed and deceptive tactics. Some Trainers consider its tactics interesting to watch.

entry: POKENAME大得足以容纳好几个喜欢挑战的格斗家，体内蕴藏的斗志，更无可比拟。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is large enough to engulf several fighters who enjoy an extra challenge. The fighting spirit inside a POKENAME is unmatched.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，不爱主动出手。可哪只宝可梦一碰它，就会挨上一记足以折骨的背摔。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are normally meek and passive. Any Pokémon that so much as touches one, though, will be hit by a bone-breaking suplex.

entry: POKENAME很爱热闹与庆典。据说，身上独特的颜色，也显露着它的个性。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are highly festive creatures. The unique color of this Pokémon is said to indicate its personality.

entry: POKENAME采用了更讲究身手的战斗方式——舞蹈。起舞时会掀起风刃，伤害对手。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME has embraced a more acrobatic style of fighting, Dance. When it dances, it whips up blades of wind to hurt its opponents.

entry: POKENAME很爱热闹与庆典。据说，身上独特的颜色，也显露着它的个性。

entry: POKENAME是渔民的噩梦。一旦落入渔网，它的尖刺就很可能撕裂网眼，让同网的其他生物全部逃走。
author: antomelon
source: POKENAME is a fisherman's nightmare. When caught in a net, its thorns will likely tear the mesh, freeing everything caught with it.

entry: 若在沙漠中看见野生POKENAME，就能确定附近有绿洲。它的花朵越大，那片绿洲也就越美。
author: Cristata
source: If you see a wild POKENAME in the desert, you can be sure there's an oasis nearby. The bigger its flower, the more beautiful its oasis is sure to be.

entry: 若在沙漠中看见野生POKENAME，就能确定附近有绿洲。它的花朵越大，那片绿洲也就越美。
author: Cristata
source: If you see a wild POKENAME in the desert, you can be sure there's an oasis nearby. The bigger its flower, the more beautiful its oasis is sure to be.

entry: 为适应沙漠剧烈的温差，POKENAME会在白天吸收热量，等气温下降后再逐渐释放。
author: .izik
source: To survive the harsh temperatures of the desert, POKENAME absorbs heat during the day. It releases the heat gradually as the desert temperature drops.

entry: POKENAME的身体会滴出湿润的汁液，借此在地面上滑行。不过，饮用这种汁液会引起消化不良。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body drips a moist sap, allowing it to slide along the ground. Drinking the sap, however, will cause digestive problems.

entry: 会收集仙人掌及其上生长的花朵与果实。据说仙人掌汁十分解渴，却可能带来意想不到的效果。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: They collect cacti and the flowers and fruits that grow on them. Drinking the cactus juice is said to be very quenching but can have unusual results.

entry: 几只POKENAME会在夜间聚在一起练习某种舞蹈。一旦失去平衡，就会哭着退开。
author: Pokopish
source: Multiple POKENAME come together at night to practice a sort of dance. It cries and retreats if caught off balance.

entry: POKENAME依靠魔法的力量汲取养分，可以一直不喝水。虽然体形娇小，但浑身的刺让其他生物不敢招惹它。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME can survive indefinitely without water, drawing nutrients from magical sources instead. Though tiny, it is left alone due to its spines.

entry: 在空旷辽阔的沙漠中，POKENAME能尽情起舞，抒发情感。若发现有人偷看，就会把对方扎得满身是刺。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: In the vast emptiness of the desert, POKENAME has room to dance emotionally. If it spots someone watching, it will leave the voyeur with many pricks.

entry: POKENAME生活在干燥的沙漠中，以仙人掌果实和树果为食。不吃不喝也能存活长达一年。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in dry deserts and feeds on cactus fruits and Berries. It can survive for up to a year without food or water.

entry: POKENAME的肉质饱含清洁可饮用的水。口渴的捕食者靠近时，它就会脱落背上的球体，趁机逃走。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME's flesh is saturated with clean, drinkable water. When a thirsty predator nears, it detaches the spheres on its back and makes its getaway.

entry: POKENAME把水储存在棒状的身体结构中。除了用它敲打目标，还会发射身上的刺。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME stores water in its club-like structure. It shoots off its thorns in addition to bludgeoning its victims.

entry: POKENAME会高速旋转，将刺针射向四面八方来自卫。连训练家也可能被误伤，因此许多人对它敬而远之。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME defends itself by rotating at high speeds, shooting needles in all directions. This may even harm its Trainer, which is why many avoid it.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间晒太阳汲取养分，也会用嘴饮水或将双脚扎进土里。攻击时会用头撞，把刺扎进敌人体内。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME spend lots of time getting nutrients from the sun, drinking with their mouth or planting their feet in soil. They headbutt spines in foes.

entry: POKENAME只生长在富含金属的沙地，身体出奇地致密坚韧。常被人尊为古老力量的先兆。
author: Quant9690
source: Only growing in sandy areas heavy with metals, POKENAME are surprisingly dense and resilient. They are often revered as heralds of an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME需要经常吸水，维持近似液体的形态。会寻找池塘或其他宝可梦，从中抽取水分。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME needs to absorb water often to maintain its liquid-like consistency. It looks for sources like ponds and other Pokémon to drain water from.

entry: 背上的火焰由它从太阳吸收的能量凝聚而成。火焰最明亮的POKENAME就是族群的首领。
author: gurguro
source: The fire on its back is the condensed energy it absorbs from the sun. The POKENAME with the brightest flame is the alpha of the pack.

entry: 传说夜间遇见野生POKENAME的人会看见奇异的幻象。不过，这种宝可梦在白天很友善。
author: birchbot
source: Rumors say that if you spot a wild POKENAME during the night, you'll start seeing strange visions. However, this Pokémon is friendly during the day.

entry: POKENAME已经适应了沙漠生活，如今栖息在宽大的地洞里，不再住在树上。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME have adapted to live in deserts, and now live in large burrows instead of trees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找更大的仙人掌，作为身体的一节。为了争夺巨大的仙人掌，同类之间常常打起来。
author: Gurguro
source: A POKENAME is always looking for bigger cacti to use as segments for its body. Members of the species often fight over large cacti.

entry: POKENAME会袭击沙漠中的人，抢走他们的水后便消失不见，只留下回荡的笑声。也常以稻草人的模样出现在农场。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME will attack people in deserts to pilfer their water, then vanish with a echoing laugh. It often appears as a scarecrow in farms.

entry: 会静止不动地进行光合作用、节省能量，数十年不喝水也能存活。POKENAME会成群在夜间迁徙。
author: CapWolfBane
source: It can last several decades without water, laying still to photosynthesize and conserve energy. Bands of POKENAME migrate at night.

entry: 头上的盾甲坚硬如钛，既能保护POKENAME，也能遮挡沙漠中耀眼的烈日。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its head shield is as hard as titanium. It not only provides POKENAME with protection, but also shade from the shimmering desert sun.

entry: POKENAME完全由草构成，吞下的活物都会直接穿过身体。它真正的养分来自受害者的恐惧。
author: RetroCrow
source: Being made entirely out of grass, all living things that POKENAME eats go right through it. They instead get their nutrients from the victim's fear.

entry: 很少有谁敢挑战这些庞然大物。挑战者既要突破它们满是尖刺的表皮，还得躲避眼部附近的腺体喷出的灼人酸液。
author: wigglypon
source: Few dare challenge these giants, but those who do must get past their thorny hides and avoid the stinging acid sprayed from glands near their eyes.

entry: 饥渴驱使它捕食一切能装进体内的东西。旅人可以把食物或水扔进它体内，趁机迅速逃走。
author: Quant9690
source: Hunger and thirst have driven this Pokémon to hunt whatever can fit inside of its body. Travelers can throw water or food into it and quickly escape.

entry: POKENAME满怀遗憾，无法安息，留在这个世界上。它们会一直依附着自己的躯壳，直到躯壳消散。
author: Quant9690
source: Unable to pass on and full of regret, POKENAME linger in this world. They will stay attached to their husk until it fades away.

entry: 许多人和宝可梦误将POKENAME当成无害的稻草人，因靠得太近而丧命。
author: Fenragon
source: Many people and Pokémon alike have lost their lives by getting too close to a POKENAME which they mistook for a harmless scarecrow.

entry: 猛烈的沙尘暴完全吓不倒POKENAME。它们反而经常聚集起来，在炙热的狂风中起舞。
author: Quant9690
source: Brutal sandstorms do not phase POKENAME at all. On the contrary, they often go to gather together and dance within the blistering winds.

entry: 白天会一动不动地站着，以免皮肤中的水分被烈日蒸干。夜间则用锋利的爪子撕碎猎物。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: It stands completely still at day so it doesn't lose moisture in its skin to the sun. At night, it uses its razor-sharp claws to tear apart prey.

entry: POKENAME出没的沙漠一到夜间就会变得极度寒冷，足以危及生命。谁也不知道它们白天去了哪里。
author: Staghorn
source: The deserts where POKENAME are found get dangerously cold at night. Nobody knows where they go during the daytime.

entry: 在沙漠中行走时，可能会遭到突然从地下冒出的POKENAME伏击。它会将尖刺混着沙子射向目标。
author: Fenragon
source: When walking in the desert, you might get ambushed by a POKENAME suddenly sprouting from the ground. It attacks by shooting a mix of thorns and sand.

entry: POKENAME从沙漠的烈日中汲取热能，为火焰攻击提供能量。体内的沙子能保护仙人掌身躯不被烧着。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will draw heat energy from the harsh desert sun to fuel its fiery attacks. The sand within its body keeps its cactus body from burning.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中游荡，寻找训练家并送给对方一枚摆锤。到了夜里，这件小饰品会让收下它的人永远沉睡。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of Trainers, to whom it gives a pendulum. Come night, the trinket will make the recipient fall asleep forever.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中游荡，寻找训练家并送给对方一枚摆锤。到了夜里，这件小饰品会让收下它的人永远沉睡。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of Trainers, to whom it gives a pendulum. Come night, the trinket will make the recipient fall asleep forever.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋就会发出猛烈的尖叫，令周围的人和宝可梦也跟着做出同样的举动。
author: 8xviktor
source: Whenever POKENAME is excited, it screams loudly and violently. This causes people and Pokémon around it to repeat that same action.

entry: POKENAME会用沙子捏出大针蜂，吓退海滩上的水属性宝可梦。然而，这反而常常引来大型鸟宝可梦的袭击。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME forms a Beedrill out of sand to ward off beach-dwelling water types. However, this often results in it being attacked by large bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的背上会自然生成熔融的玻璃。吹制玻璃和安装玻璃的工匠常在店里养一只。
author: CapWolfBane
source: POKENAME naturally generate molten glass on their backs. Glassblowers and glaziers often keep a POKENAME in their shop.

entry: 背上的刺由高温玻璃形成。受到惊吓时会将这些锋利的尖刺成批射出。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The spines on its back is formed from superheated glass. It fires these sharp quills in multitudes when startled.

entry: POKENAME主要栖息在北极的海滩。会不知疲倦地四处游走，鼻子贴着地面嗅寻合适的沙子，补充冰冻的身体。
author: char_latte3412
source: Primarily found on arctic beaches, POKENAME tirelessly wanders about, nose to the ground, sniffing for ideal sand to add to its frozen body.

entry: 既是一份精心制作的三明治，也是一位初出茅庐的“沙之巫女”。它喜欢的训练家吃下它的一部分，就能获得魔力。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: A perfectly crafted sandwich that also happens to be a budding sand-witch. To a Trainer it likes, consuming portions of it can grant magical powers.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: Cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: Cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: POKENAME经过后可能会留下玻璃碎片。曾有报告称，一位训练家的宝可梦在与它相遇后，一条肢体被玻璃包住了。
author: Uncookie
source: POKENAME may leave glass shards in its wake. It was reported that a Trainer's Pokémon once had a limb encased in glass after an encounter.

entry: 核心与腿部由硬沙构成。组成外壳的沙子经常脱落，因此需要不断补充。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: Its core and legs are made of hardened sand. The sand that makes up its shell falls off frequently, so it has to place more.

entry: POKENAME十分珍惜自己的铲子，因为它承载着遥远而令人怀念的往事。喜欢堆建金字塔。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME treasures its shovel greatly, for it holds nostalgic memories long passed. It loves to build pyramids.

entry: 这种融合体天性自私，领地意识很强。会毁掉沙堡，用夺来的沙子把自己堆得比实际更大。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: This fusion is very selfish and territorial in nature. It will destroy sand castles and use them to make itself appear larger than it actually is.

entry: POKENAME藏在阳光明媚的海滩沙地中收集光能。谁想偷走它的铲子，它就会从沙中扑出发动攻击。
author: @Mikk09
source: POKENAME hides in the sand of a sunny beach, collecting light. POKENAME will lunge out of the sand to attack anyone that tries to steal its shovels.

entry: 介于沙丘娃与噬沙堡爷之间的形态。十分喜爱头上的铲子。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: An in-between of Sandygast and Palossand. It's very fond of the shovel on its head.

entry: 虽然披着坚硬的几丁质外骨骼，POKENAME对湿度的变化仍十分敏感。种子和蘑菇只有保持湿润，才能好好生长。
author: .realthree
source: Though covered by a hard, chitinous exoskeleton, POKENAME is sensitive to changes in humidity. Its bulb and mushrooms must stay damp to grow properly.

entry: POKENAME并不知道自己身上长了蘑菇。蘑菇也不会妨碍它，因此过着无忧无虑的生活。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is unaware of the mushrooms growing on its body. The mushrooms do nothing to hinder it, and it lives a carefree existence.

entry: 会将电流导向身上的蘑菇，但蘑菇有时承受不住过大的电流，结果便突然爆炸。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms that it directs its electricity through can't always hold all of the amperage. The result is a sudden explosion.

entry: POKENAME裹在蘑菇里滚来滚去。这能保护脆弱的外骨骼，却也让人无法抚摸它。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME rolls about, encased in its mushroom. This protects its fragile exoskeleton, but it also keeps it from being petted.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌把所有的蛋连在一起，使它们能作为一个整体行动。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus infecting POKENAME holds all of the eggs together. As a result, they function as a single unit together.

entry: 蘑菇释放的孢子改变了骨骼的化学成分，让POKENAME戴着的头骨变得易碎。
author: .realthree
source: The skull that POKENAME wears has become brittle due to the mushrooms releasing spores that change the bone's chemical composition.

entry: POKENAME关节中富有弹性的组织，其实是粗壮的菌丝。想把这只宝可梦和蘑菇分开，是不可能的。
author: .realthree
source: The elastic in POKENAME's joints are actually thick strands of mycelium. It is impossible to separate the Pokémon from the mushroom.

entry: POKENAME嘴里舌头状蘑菇的柄，一直连接到尾尖内部。它以菌丝作为神经系统。
author: .realthree
source: The stalk of the tongue-shaped mushroom in POKENAME's mouth connects to the inside of the tip of its tail. It uses mycelium as a nervous system.

entry: POKENAME不断喷出团团孢子，可能诱发敏感人群的哮喘。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME constantly spews out clouds of spores. It's known to induce asthma attacks in sensitive individuals.

entry: POKENAME一直盼着进化。寄生的真菌只在壳内长出子实体，让它很不舒服。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waits constantly for evolution. The fungus infesting it only develops its fruiting bodies inside of the shell, causing POKENAME discomfort.

entry: POKENAME靠爪子抓牢栖息地山坡上的岩石。只生活在山体降雨较多的一侧。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's claws help it cling to the rocky terrain of the mountainsides it lives on. It only lives on the rainier side of the mountain.

entry: 十分爱护育儿袋里的蘑菇。谁想碰它的蘑菇，就会被抓伤。
author: .izik
source: It is very protective of the mushroom in its pouch. It will scratch anyone that attempts to touch the mushroom.

entry: POKENAME同时感染了两种真菌：常见的冬虫夏草菌，以及一种形似柔软藤蔓的橙色黏菌。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is infected by two different fungi: the typical tochukaso mushroom and an orange slime mold that has the appearance of soft vines.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌会驱使它寻找派拉斯，像照顾亲生后代一样照料对方。这样的相处让双方都很开心。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus infecting POKENAME compels it to find a Paras and care for it as its own offspring. This arrangement makes both sides very happy.

entry: POKENAME栖息在黑水水域，以落叶为食。秋天时，身上的色彩最为鲜艳。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in blackwater ecosystems, where it feeds on leaf litter. Its colors are most vivid in the fall.

entry: 覆盖POKENAME眼睛的巨大蘑菇直接连着大脑，有助于加快它的反应。
author: .realthree
source: The massive mushroom covering POKENAME's eye connects directly to the Pokémon's brain. This helps quicken its reflexes.

entry: POKENAME离开水后，喷出的孢子会附着在皮肤上，通过渗透作用为它提供氧气。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME is taken out of the water, the spores it has ejected stick to its skin. These spores supply it with oxygen through osmosis.

entry: POKENAME独一只水晶般的眼睛凝视着太空。在水下喷出的孢子闪闪发光，宛如一片银河。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's single, crystalline eye gazes out into space. When it ejects its spores underwater, they glitter like a galaxy of stars.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀上布满孢子。扇动翅膀时，这些孢子会被高速抛向空中。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's wings are laden with spores. When it flaps its wings, these spores are sent flying at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME手中的蘑菇就像麦克风，能放大它诡异的歌声。栖息在回音效果好的洞穴里。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom that POKENAME holds acts like a microphone, amplifying its eerie song. It lives in caves with good acoustics.

entry: POKENAME用强有力的钳子剥下树皮食用。肩上的蘑菇让它不善于攀爬。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its formidable pincers for stripping the bark off of trees to eat. It can't climb well because of the mushrooms on its shoulders.

entry: POKENAME通过蹄子从地面吸收养分，帮助寄生在身上的真菌生长。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME absorb nutrients from the ground through their hooves, which helps the fungus it hosts grow.

entry: 有水的地方就能找到POKENAME。即使食物耗尽，身上寄生的蘑菇也能让它继续活下去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can be found wherever there's water. If it runs out of food, the mushrooms it hosts keep it going.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌驱使它大吃特吃。常能看见它与绿毛虫争夺食物等资源。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus infesting POKENAME drives it to eat voraciously. It can often be seen fighting with Caterpie for resources.

entry: 若森林湖泊中有许多鲤鱼王，湖底可能正沉睡着一只POKENAME。伤害任何一条鲤鱼王，都可能激怒它。
author: .realthree
source: If you see many Magikarp in a forest lake, there may be a POKENAME slumbering beneath. If you harm one of the Magikarp, you risk angering it.

entry: 每年秋天，POKENAME沿着支流进入森林，以那里生长的蘑菇为食。冬天再回到海洋。
author: .realthree
source: Every fall, POKENAME follow tributaries into forests and feed on the mushrooms growing there. They return to the ocean in winter.

entry: POKENAME每次变身，身上的蘑菇都会增多。最后多得长不下，开始往下掉。
author: .realthree
source: Every time POKENAME transforms, the mushrooms growing on it multiply. It eventually grows so many that they start falling off.

entry: 数种真菌感染了POKENAME，彼此争夺身体的控制权。接触到强烈的元素能量时，其中一方就可能占据上风。
author: .realthree
source: There are multiple species of fungus infecting POKENAME, all competing for control. Strong elemental exposure can tip the scales one way or another.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的蘑菇总是覆着淡水。会将这些水洒在自己身上，防止身体干燥。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's tail is always covered with fresh water. It sprinkles this water over itself to prevent drying out.

entry: 背上的蘑菇总是电光噼啪。会从空气中收集静电，用来提升自己的速度。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms on its back are always crackling with electricity. It gathers static charge from the air and uses it to enhance its speed.

entry: 尾巴附近的蘑菇一直燃烧着。蘑菇受热散发的气味，有人喜欢，也有人厌恶。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms near its tail are always ablaze. The smell created by the cooking mushrooms is loved by some and hated by others.

entry: 一位喜爱派拉斯的开发者改造了自己的多边兽，由此诞生了第一只POKENAME。它的动作与移动速度并不协调。
author: .realthree
source: When a developer who loved Paras modified a Porygon he had, the first POKENAME was created. Its movements don't match with the speed it travels at.

entry: POKENAME头上坚硬的蘑菇内有浮囊，帮助它在水中保持正确的姿态。
author: .realthree
source: The hard mushroom on POKENAME's head contains floatation sacs to help it stay oriented correctly while underwater.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌不断软化它的外骨骼。幸好，这也增加了外骨骼的弹性。
author: .realthree
source: The exoskeleton surrounding POKENAME is constantly being softened by the fungus infesting it. Luckily, this also increases its elasticity.

entry: 尽管没有翅膀，也能跳得极高。这是因为感染它的真菌增强了腿部力量。
author: .realthree
source: Despite lacking wings, it can jump incredibly high. This is because the fungus infecting it has strengthened its legs.

entry: POKENAME会收集各种蘑菇，大快朵颐。蘑菇洒下的孢子会在它的毛发中扎根。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME gather mushrooms of all kinds and feast upon them. The spores these mushrooms drop take root in POKENAME's fur.

entry: POKENAME过着半水生的生活，每天中午都会离开水面，饱餐甜甜的树果与落叶。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives a semi-aquatic lifestyle, coming out of the water every noon to feast on sweet berries and leaf litter.

entry: 寄生在体内的真菌让POKENAME对光十分敏感，因此偏爱阴凉的森林。头上的大蘑菇能替眼睛遮住阳光。
author: .realthree
source: The large mushroom on POKENAME's head shields its eyes from the sun. The fungus infesting it causes light sensitivity, so it prefers shady forests.

entry: POKENAME头上的蘑菇里还有额外的大脑。强大的念力让任何人都无法靠近它。
author: .realthree
