source: POKENAME has extra brains stored in the mushrooms on its head. It is impossible to approach due to its powerful telekinetic abilities.

entry: 背上色彩鲜艳的蘑菇从远处看常被误认成火焰。蘑菇自身能够发光，照亮POKENAME所到之处。
author: .realthree
source: The brightly colored mushrooms on its back are often mistaken for flames from afar. They're bioluminescent, and shed light wherever POKENAME goes.

entry: 被水淹过或潮湿的地下室里可能会住进POKENAME。它飞得很快，想把它赶走并不容易。
author: .realthree
source: People with flooded or damp basements may find POKENAME living there. Due to their quick flying speed, they can be tricky to remove.

entry: POKENAME在腐朽、真菌丛生的树顶筑巢。树枝十分脆弱，捕食者无法跟着爬上去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME makes its nest in the tops of decaying, fungus-infested trees. The branches are too brittle for predators to follow it there.

entry: POKENAME诡异的歌声会引诱训练家走进森林深处。有时能看见小型宝可梦把它的花当成蹦床，在上面弹跳。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's eerie songs lure Trainers into the depths of the forest. Smaller Pokémon have been known to bounce on its flower like a trampoline.

entry: 遵循古老文化习俗的人认为，POKENAME翅膀上的图案象征着千里眼。不过，它无法告诉别人自己看到了什么。
author: .realthree
source: Those who follow ancient cultures' ways recognize the pattern on POKENAME's wings as a symbol of clairvoyance. However, it cannot share what it sees.

entry: POKENAME攀附在漂浮的睡莲叶上。蘑菇和腹部的螺旋花纹能迷住它最爱的猎物——蜻蜻蜓。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME clings to floating lily pads. The spiral pattern on its mushroom and belly mesmerize Yanma, its favorite prey.

entry: POKENAME利用地下的菌丝网络，寻找可以食用的新鲜植物。它是农场里的麻烦，却也是孩子们常养的宠物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to find its way to fresh plants to eat. They're a nuisance on farms, but a common pet for kids.

entry: 寄生的蘑菇夺走了植物的全部养分，使POKENAME背上长出的叶子发黄枯萎。
author: .realthree
source: The leaves growing from POKENAME's back are yellow and withered due to the mushrooms it hosts stealing all the nutrients from the plant.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，真菌会接管身体，外出寻找食物。因此，它能不间断地觅食。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME sleeps, the fungus takes control of the body and searches for food. In this way, POKENAME is able to constantly forage.

entry: POKENAME会散播寄生在身上的冬虫夏草菌的孢子，隔空吸取猎物体内的养分。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME spreads the spores of its parasitic tochukaso mushrooms to remotely absorb nutrients from its prey.

entry: 早在融合技术普及的数年前，人们就见过POKENAME，却没有意识到它是与派拉斯融合而成的。
author: .realthree
source: People had seen POKENAME for a few years before fusion technology became commonplace, but they didn't realize it was fused with Paras.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的硬蘑菇和覆盖全身的几丁质甲壳都坚如钢铁。要当心它迅捷的动作。
author: .realthree
source: The hard mushrooms on POKENAME's arms are tough as steel, as is the chitin covering its body. Be wary of its quick movements.

entry: POKENAME背上的马勃会毫无预兆地喷出孢子。温暖的身体能加热地面，帮助孢子扎根。
author: .realthree
source: The puffball on POKENAME's back spews spores without warning. Its warm body heats the ground, which helps the spores take root.

entry: POKENAME常见于水浅的湿地。会站在水中滋润身上的寄生真菌，同时捕食丑丑鱼。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a common sight in shallow wetlands. It stands in the water to moisturize the fungus it hosts while also hunting for Feebas.

entry: POKENAME摇尾巴时会散播催眠的孢子，让猎物昏昏欲睡，方便整只吞下。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME shakes its tail, it scatters spores that induce drowsiness, making it easy for it to swallow its prey whole.

entry: POKENAME栖息在洞穴中，懂得使用原始工具。一旦发现观察者就会弃家而去，因此相关研究进展有限。
author: megaborb
source: POKENAME is a cave dweller known to use primitive tools. Research into POKENAME is restricted as they will abandon their homes if they spot observers.

entry: POKENAME顶部的头是用来迷惑鸟类捕食者的假头。会先用蘑菇击晕猎物，再张开真正的嘴攻击。
author: .realthree
source: The head on top of POKENAME is fake: a distraction for avian predators. It uses its mushroom to stun its prey, then opens its real mouth to attack.

entry: POKENAME头上长着柔软圆润的蘑菇。性情温顺，不适合战斗，因此在宝可梦培育屋附近十分常见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has soft, round mushrooms on its head. It's docile and unsuited for fighting, so it's a common sight around Pokémon Daycares.

entry: 身上长满寄生蘑菇。曾经守护着海洋，如今却向海洋生物散播孢子。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon is riddled with parasitic mushrooms. It once protected the ocean, but now it spreads its spores among the ocean life.

entry: 覆盖POKENAME全身的蘑菇质地像橡胶，会抑制它的电力。要产生同等电荷，就得花费更多力气。
author: .realthree
source: The rubbery mushrooms covering POKENAME inhibit its electrical abilities, and it has to exert more effort to produce the same charge.

entry: POKENAME五彩缤纷的蘑菇十分罕见。各种传说对它究竟善良还是邪恶说法不一。
author: .realthree
source: The multicolored mushrooms of POKENAME are a rare sight. Stories cannot agree on whether it is benevolent or malicious.

entry: POKENAME洒出虹彩般的孢子时，才会显现出完整的华美姿态。据说沐浴在孢子中的人会与派拉斯更加亲近。
author: .realthree
source: The full glory of POKENAME is revealed when it spreads its prismatic spores. Humans showered by them are said to gain greater kinship with Paras.

entry: 遍布POKENAME全身的菌丝具有极强的导电性。没有合适的防护装备，千万不要触碰它身上的蘑菇。
author: .realthree
source: The mycelium that grows throughout POKENAME's body is extremely conductive. Don't touch the mushrooms without proper safety equipment.

entry: POKENAME在干燥的沙地上十分常见。会住在地下躲避烈日，在土中挖出许多蜿蜒的隧道。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a common sight in dry, sandy ground. It lives underground to avoid the harsh sunlight and creates many winding tunnels through the soil.

entry: POKENAME精力十分旺盛，但身上的蘑菇一旦被摘掉，就会变得疲惫不堪。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a very high-energy Pokémon, but it wears out if the mushrooms on its body are removed.

entry: 尾部的蘑菇总被翠绿的叶子包围。每天都有新叶长出，POKENAME的训练家得勤加清理。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom on its rear is always surrounded by verdant foliage. More leaves grow every day, so Trainers of POKENAME need to weed it vigilantly.

entry: POKENAME髋部上方的蘑菇总裹着冰块。冰块永不融化，因此夏天会引来成群的小型宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms over POKENAME's hips are always encased in chunks of ice. The ice never melts, so small Pokémon flock to it in summer.

entry: POKENAME身上长满蘑菇，少了几朵也察觉不到。这些蘑菇是农贸市场上的热门商品。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is covered with so many mushrooms, it doesn't notice if a few go missing. These mushrooms are popular items to buy at farmers' markets.

entry: POKENAME受背上的蘑菇群指挥，四处游荡寻找腐烂的植物。白天会钻进地下躲避阳光。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME roves the land in search of decomposing plants, directed by the colony of mushrooms on its back. It burrows during the day to escape the sun.

entry: 雌性POKENAME的耳朵较小，性情更凶。受到善待时，会散发出令人愉悦的林木气息。
author: .realthree
source: Female POKENAME have smaller ears and a more aggressive demeanor. They exude a pleasant, woodsy smell when treated well.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖的几丁质甲壳光滑坚硬，形状出奇地适合减少风阻。它用超能力托住身体，在空中滑翔。
author: .realthree
source: The smooth, hard chitin covering POKENAME is surprisingly aerodynamic. It glides through the air, held aloft by its psychic power.

entry: 随着年龄增长，POKENAME所需的食物越来越少，因为体内的真菌提供了越来越多的能量。
author: .realthree
source: The older a POKENAME gets, the less it needs to eat, as more and more of its energy is supplied by the fungus in its body.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的耳朵较大，性情更胆怯。受到善待时，会散发出令人愉悦的林木气息。
author: .realthree
source: Male POKENAME have larger ears and a more timid demeanor. They exude a pleasant, woodsy smell when treated well.

entry: 这种蘑菇进化出了制造尸体供自己食用的本领。会将刀刃插进地下藏好，等受害者走近。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This mushroom species evolved to create corpses for it to feed on. It sheathes in the ground to hide its blade from oncoming victims.

entry: POKENAME的形态简单而小巧，能将刀刃收进地下，伪装成普通蘑菇，同时用眼睛观察四周。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's simple, diminutive design allows it to sheath in the ground and disguise as an ordinary mushroom while watching out with its eye.

entry: POKENAME的长期记忆力很差，因为寄生在身上的真菌一直试图左右它的行为。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has a poor long-term memory due to the fungus it hosts attempting to influence its behavior.

entry: 行走时会挥动缎带，将孢子散播到周围。以腐殖物和堆肥土壤为食。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: They use their ribbons to spread to the spores around as they walk. Their diet consists of mulch and compost soil.

entry: 创造POKENAME的国家早已消失。它会将红蘑菇送给孩子们，纪念逝去的朋友。
author: .realthree
source: The nation that created POKENAME has long since vanished from the world. It offers red mushrooms to children in memory of its deceased friends.

entry: 全心追求真实的人闻到POKENAME巨大蘑菇散发的香气，就会充满炽热的能量。
author: .realthree
source: Those who seek truth with all their heart are filled with blazing energy when they smell the scent exuded by POKENAME's massive mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇看似普通冬虫夏草菌，最近却被发现属于一个全新的品种。
author: .realthree
source: Though the mushrooms POKENAME hosts resemble the common tochukaso fungus, they recently were discovered to be of an entirely new variety.

entry: POKENAME轻盈地蹦跳着翻山越谷，所到之处都会洒下闪闪发光的孢子。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME skips lightly over mountains and valleys, scattering glittery spores everywhere it goes.

entry: 看起来总是一脸惊慌，让人误会而往它身上泼水。POKENAME很不喜欢这样。
author: .realthree
source: Its face appears panicked, which mistakenly leads to getting doused. POKENAME doesn't like that very much.

entry: POKENAME受驱使将孢子散播到其他生物身上。饲养它的训练家往往也会被真菌感染。
author: .realthree
source: A POKENAME is compelled to shed its spores on other living things. Trainers who raise this Pokémon often end up infested with the fungus themselves.

entry: 这只宝可梦四处窜行，随时准备攻击眼前的一切。遭它咬伤，就会感染真菌，连心智也被一点点侵蚀。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Pokémon that scuttles about, ready to attack anything it sees. Its bite spreads a fungal infection that consumes the minds of its prey.

entry: POKENAME利用地下的菌丝网络，感知人类和宝可梦的情绪。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon.

entry: 寄生的真菌影响了声带，让POKENAME的歌声带着奇异的颤音。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's song has a strange, warbling quality to it, as the fungus inhabiting it affects its vocal cords.

entry: 大量饮用玫瑰水的POKENAME会迅速长大。蘑菇长得越大，叶子就越枯萎。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that drink lots of rosewater grow quickly. The bigger its mushroom grows, the more its leaves wither.

entry: 小小的真菌大脑里满是对未来的希望与梦想。等凝胶膨胀后，它就能强壮到足以探索世界了。
author: .realthree
source: Its small, fungal brain is filled with hopes and dreams for the future. Once its gel expands, it will be strong enough to explore the world.

entry: 要当心沙漠中的蘑菇。它们通常长在一只饥肠辘辘的POKENAME身上，而它正埋伏在沙下等待猎物。
author: .realthree
source: Be wary of mushrooms in the desert. They're usually attached to a hungry POKENAME lying in wait under the sand.

entry: POKENAME不断蜕去外骨骼，以保持健康。否则，那朵让它浮在空中的蘑菇就会将它吞噬。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is constantly shedding its exoskeleton to stay healthy. If it didn't do this, the mushroom that keeps it airborne would consume it.

entry: POKENAME一直在争夺自己身体的控制权。蘑菇接管大脑时，它便停止哭泣，钻进潮湿的土里，可能数小时都不出来。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME fights for control over itself. When the mushroom hijacks its brain, it ceases weeping and burrows into damp soil. This can last for hours.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME身上的蘑菇是寄生物。研究却表明，蘑菇能帮它从吃下的电力中获取更多能量。
author: KitArchen
source: Many assume the mushrooms on POKENAME are parasitic. However, research has revealed they are used to acquire more energy from the electricity it eats.

entry: POKENAME的瞳孔极小，一般观察看不出来。它几乎失明，却能借洒下的孢子感知空气的形态。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's pupils are too small to be seen by casual observation. Though practically blind, the spores it drops help it sense the shape of the air.

entry: POKENAME是花园里常见的害虫。不过，那惹人怜爱的恳求眼神，总让人难以狠心赶走它。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a common pest in gardens, but people have a hard time chasing it away due to its endearing, pleading gaze.

entry: POKENAME腿太短，跑不快，于是会抓住蘑菇滚动前进，在身后留下一团孢子。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's legs are too short to run quickly, so it grabs its mushroom and rolls. It leaves a cloud of spores in its wake.

entry: 乘坐POKENAME出行，正变得越来越流行。两侧的蘑菇会伸展开来，将乘客稳稳护住。
author: .realthree
source: Riding POKENAME as a transportation method is growing in popularity. The mushrooms on its side extend to hold the rider safely in place.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在地下，但只要有谁碰了它的蘑菇，就会发动攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME stays buried in the ground during the day, but it will attack if anyone touches its mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME会活力十足地跳舞，摇晃身上的蘑菇，撒出孢子。它只吸食某一种花的花蜜。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waves and shakes its mushrooms in an energetic dance to scatter spores. It feeds upon a specific flower's nectar.

entry: 在森林中迷路的孩子吃下致命的蘑菇后，会变成POKENAME。它们常与普通的小木灵结伴。
author: .realthree
source: Lost children in the forest who consume deadly mushrooms are transformed into POKENAME. They are often found in the company of regular Phantump.

entry: 静止不动时会被误认成腐朽的树木。POKENAME虽面容诡异，内心却很善良。
author: .realthree
source: When it stands perfectly still, it can be mistaken for a decaying tree. POKENAME has an eerie face but a kind heart.

entry: POKENAME每朵蘑菇喷出的孢子颜色都不同。可以随心控制孢子，让目标昏睡、中毒或麻痹。
author: .realthree
source: Each of POKENAME's mushrooms eject spores of a different color. It can cause drowsiness, poisoning, or paralysis as it wishes.

entry: 总是一副神情茫然的样子。只要想，也能摆出严肃的表情，但还是这样更自在。
author: .realthree
source: A vacant stare graces this Pokémon's face. It could look serious if it wanted to, but it's more comfortable this way.

entry: 封在冰体内的蘑菇永远不会散播孢子，因此它如何繁殖至今仍是个谜。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms encased in its icy body will never spread their spores, so it's a mystery as to how it reproduces.

entry: POKENAME生活在潮湿的丛林深处。很少见到人类，因此对人类毫无畏惧。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives deep within humid jungles. It rarely sees humans, so it has no fear towards them.

entry: POKENAME柔软绵弹，是很受欢迎的宠物。四条后腿两两融合，实际上靠四条腿行走。
author: .realthree
source: Soft and squishy, POKENAME is a popular pet. It's actually quadrupedal, as the four back legs are fused into two.

entry: 夜幕降临时，POKENAME会用粗大的手臂封住蘑菇的开口，把自己藏在伞盖内，抵御饥饿的捕食者。
author: .realthree
source: When night falls, POKENAME uses its large arms to seal the opening in its mushroom, encasing itself in the dome as protection from hungry predators.

entry: POKENAME在沙中疾行时会发出沙沙声。体内储存的水缓缓供给头上的蘑菇。
author: .realthree
source: A swishing sound can be heard as POKENAME scuttles through the sands. The water stored in its body slowly feeds the mushroom on its head.

entry: POKENAME因头上突然长出的蘑菇而苦恼，尖叫个不停。它闹得太厉害，让人无法安全地摘除蘑菇。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME screams endlessly, distressed by the sudden appearance of a mushroom on its head. It makes too much of a fuss to remove the mushroom safely.

entry: POKENAME外骨骼板片之间伸出的毛发，带有大量孢子。它纤细灵活的双腿非常适合冲刺。
author: .realthree
source: The fur poking out from between the plates of POKENAME's exoskeleton is loaded with spores. Its lithe legs are well suited to sprinting.

entry: 派拉斯的虫体与蘑菇完美共生时，就会长成巨大的体形。大脑中的菌丝让它迅速成长。
author: .realthree
source: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. It grows quickly as a result of the mycelium in its brain.

entry: 派拉斯的虫体与蘑菇完美共生时，就会长成巨大的体形。这一只还拥有罕见的体色。
author: .realthree
source: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. This one has a rare coloration.

entry: POKENAME凭强大的精神力量，掌控着体内的真菌。它生活得很快乐，还会用心照料这些冬虫夏草菌。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has the strength of mind to control the fungus it hosts. It lives a happy life and works to take care of the tochukaso fungus.

entry: POKENAME身上覆盖着厚厚的孢子，所到之处都会留下粉末般的痕迹。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is covered by a thick layer of spores. It leaves a powdery trail wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME那晚霞般的翅膀在秋季十分常见。常能见到它们攀在树上啃食树皮。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's sunset-colored wings are a common sight in autumn. They can be found clinging to trees and chewing on the bark.

entry: 冬虫夏草菌尚未成熟，就已经遮住了POKENAME的眼睛。它不再靠视力，而用燃烧的孢子感知世界。
author: zedsmith64
source: Although its tochukaso mushroom is yet to fully mature, it has covered POKENAME's eyes. In place of regular vision, it uses flaming spores to see.

entry: 调节体温的蘑菇被泥土覆盖后效果不佳，因此它经常把头探出地面散热。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom that regulates its body temperature doesn't work well while covered by dirt, so it frequently pops its head out of the soil to cool down.

entry: POKENAME的两朵蘑菇会模仿头部，迷惑捕食者。它只栖息在湿润的土中，长期干旱会引发大规模迁徙。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's two mushrooms mimic its head to confuse predators. POKENAME is only found in moist soil, and long droughts can lead to large migrations.

entry: POKENAME会被闪亮的物品吸引。这是因为寄生的真菌驱使它寻找可以感染的虫属性宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is drawn to shiny objects. This is because the fungus it hosts compels it to seek out potential Bug-type Pokémon to infect.

entry: 身上的蘑菇能减轻POKENAME感受到的疼痛，让它在狩猎和战斗时十分凶猛。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME dull any pain it feels, so it is ferocious in hunting and battling.

entry: 感染POKENAME的蘑菇让它头痛欲裂，因为菌丝正在长入它的大脑。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom infecting POKENAME gives it an awful headache, as the mycelium is growing into its brain.

entry: POKENAME栖息在密林的树顶。会散播使人怒不可遏的孢子，增强自身的力量。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is found at the tops of trees in dense forests. It strengthens itself by expelling spores that cause blinding rage.

entry: 在丛林中遇见POKENAME时，要避开它的目光。它会凶狠地抓挠任何与它对视的人。
author: .realthree
source: If you encounter a POKENAME while travelling through the jungle, avert your eyes. It claws ferociously at anyone who makes eye contact with it.

entry: POKENAME需要待在阴暗处，身上的蘑菇才能健康生长。饲养它的人会发现，它总躲在沙发或床底。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME needs dark spaces for the mushrooms on to grow healthily. Those who keep it as a pet find that it spends all its time under couches and beds.

entry: 覆盖POKENAME全身的蘑菇上还长着一层纤细的毛状物，很容易燃烧。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms covering POKENAME are covered with a thin, hair-like substance that combusts easily.

entry: POKENAME的尾焰能抑制尚未成熟的冬虫夏草菌。它甚至会把背上蘑菇的孢子当燃料，用来飞行。
author: zedsmith64
source: POKENAME's tail flame keeps the immature tochukaso mushrooms at bay. It can even use the spores from the mushroom on its back as fuel to fly.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在不流动的水域，依靠大雨将孢子传播到更远的地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME only lives in stagnant water. It relies on heavy rain to be able to spread its spores further.

entry: 身上的蘑菇刺激着POKENAME的大脑，让它每天能保持清醒23小时。它把时间花在练习超能力上。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom on POKENAME stimulates its brain, allowing it to remain awake for 23 hours a day. It spends its time practicing its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉被菌丝缠绕，变得更加强壮。不战斗时，它会安静地站在潮湿的森林里，吸收水分。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's muscles are strengthened by the mycelium binding them. When not fighting, it stands peacefully in humid forests to absorb the moisture.

entry: POKENAME头上巨大的层架状蘑菇挡住了视线，但洒出的孢子也让它的拳头能使对手中毒。
author: .realthree
source: The large shelf mushroom growing on POKENAME's head obstructs its view, but it also scatters spores that cause its punches to be toxic to others.

entry: 茎状身体内的真菌像橡胶一样富有弹性，增强了POKENAME的柔韧性。大型宝可梦很喜欢捕食它。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus in POKENAME's stem-like body is rubbery and increases POKENAME's flexibility. It is a popular choice of prey for larger Pokémon.

entry: 派拉斯的基因储存在POKENAME身上的蘑菇里。POKENAME喝的水越纯净，真菌扩散得就越快。
author: .realthree
source: The DNA from Paras is stored in the mushrooms on POKENAME's body. The purer the water that POKENAME drinks, the faster the fungus spreads.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME与原野水母存在某种遥远的联系，不过尚未得到证实。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is believed to have some distant connection to Toedscool, but this is still unproven.

entry: POKENAME头上的巨大蘑菇直接连着大脑。会将众多手臂的末端埋入土中，为蘑菇吸收养分。
author: .realthree
source: The large mushrooms on POKENAME's head attach directly to its brain. It buries the ends of its many arms into the soil to absorb nutrients for them.

entry: POKENAME用响亮的叫声与远处山坡上的同类交流。彼此靠近时则一声不吭，通过菌丝沟通。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses loud cries to communicate with others of its kind on distant slopes. When nearby, they are silent, using mycelium to communicate.

entry: 人们正在研究POKENAME身上蘑菇的耐热特性，希望借此制成防火服。
author: .realthree
source: The heat-resistant properties of POKENAME's mushrooms are being studied in the hopes of making fireproof clothing.

entry: POKENAME动作十分迟缓，因为寄生的真菌夺走了它所有的能量，供自身生长。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME moves very slowly, as the fungus inhabiting it steals all of its energy for its growth.

entry: 真菌在POKENAME体内蔓延，令它的皮肤变成坚硬的几丁质甲壳。
author: .realthree
source: As the fungus spreads through POKENAME's body, it alters its skin to become hard and chitinous.

entry: 据说受尾巴上生长的真菌控制。常在森林中四处搜寻野生绿毛虫，作为食物。
author: akujules
source: This Pokémon is said to be controlled by the fungus growing on its tail. It's often seen scouring forests, seeking wild Caterpie to feast on.

entry: POKENAME会洒出含铁的孢子，利用自身磁力与孢子相斥，让自己悬浮起来。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME scatters ferrous spores. It uses its magnetism to push against these spores to levitate.

entry: 凭借扩散的菌丝网络、电磁感应和三只眼睛，想偷袭这只宝可梦几乎是不可能的。
author: .realthree
source: Between the network of mycelium it spreads, its electromagnetic sense, and its three eyes, this Pokémon is impossible to surprise.

entry: POKENAME总带着一朵蘑菇。由于蘑菇很快就会腐烂，它不停地寻找新的蘑菇。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME always carries a mushroom with it. Because the mushroom decomposes quickly, it's always on the hunt for a new one.

entry: POKENAME以性情温顺著称。产生孢子的特殊细管数量极多，看起来就像羽毛。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are known for their gentle demeanor. The specialized tubes that produce its spores are so numerous, they appear as feathers.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的爪子撑起身体，从海中爬上大片冰雪。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its large claws to pull itself out of the ocean and onto large chunks of ice and snow.

entry: POKENAME的外壳被强韧的菌丝牢牢连接在一起，根本无法撬开。
author: .realthree
source: It is impossible to get POKENAME's shell open, as it is held together by strong filaments of mycelium.

entry: 聚集在POKENAME层层甲壳之间的藻类腐烂后，会成为寄居真菌的食物。
author: .realthree
source: The algae that gathers between POKENAME's layered shells decomposes and becomes food for the fungus living in it.

entry: POKENAME借喷出孢子在空中移动。覆盖身体的蘑菇虽薄，下方的外骨骼却十分坚固。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME expels spores to travel through the air. The mushroom covering it is thin, but the exoskeleton just beneath is durable.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃房屋中，以潮湿的石膏板墙和腐烂木板为食。它讨厌噪音，因此在有人居住的房屋里很少见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned houses, as it feeds on damp drywall and rotting boards. It dislikes noise, so it is uncommon in occupied houses.

entry: POKENAME常会喷出损害心智的孢子，自己却似乎浑然不知，依旧无忧无虑。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME has a tendency to puff out spores that are capable of deteriorating one's mind. However, it seems to be blissfully unaware of this habit.

entry: POKENAME闯进花园后，挖出的隧道充满寄生真菌的孢子，会导致植物枯萎。
author: .realthree
source: If a POKENAME gets into a garden, the tunnels it digs cause the plants to wither, as they are filled with spores of a parasitic fungus.

entry: POKENAME在空中挥动爪子时，是在感知沉睡的心灵位于何处。发现睡着的对象后，就会往其身上撒孢子。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME waves its claws through the air, it is trying to sense the location of sleeping minds. It scatters spores on those it finds asleep.

entry: 细线末端的蘑菇散发着诱人的香味。它用这香味引走小型宝可梦，再将其吃掉。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom on the end of its string has a delicious scent, which it uses to lure small Pokémon away to eat.

entry: POKENAME经常不顾一切地冲撞敌人，结果可能撞掉部分身体，只好等待沙子重新聚拢成形。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME often charge foes recklessly. This can cause it to lose parts of its body, requiring it to then wait for the sand to re-form.

entry: POKENAME的细胞结构能抵御水流冲刷。即使变身，也总会保留小城堡的形状和一些贝壳。
author: totodile.
source: A POKENAME's cellular structure resists being washed away by water. It will always maintain tiny castle shapes and some shells when it transforms.

entry: 古代文明用POKENAME储存和读取在沙地建造神殿的图纸。这种方法早已失传。
author: floweronbread
source: Ancient civilizations used POKENAME to store and retrieve schematics for building temples on the sand. The method for doing so has been lost to time.

entry: 会用在海滩收集的贝壳与小饰品装扮自己。偶尔也会带着沙滩玩具和漂亮贝壳靠近孩子们。
author: greystorm101
source: It decorates itself with shells and trinkets it collects on the beach. It occasionally approaches children with beach toys and beautiful seashells.

entry: POKENAME用沙子塑造出大针蜂模样的宝可梦，足以吓退除最强者以外的飞行宝可梦。夜间经常与音波龙冲突。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME forms a Pokémon resembling Beedrill out of sand to ward off all but the strongest flying Pokémon. It often clashes with Noivern at night.

entry: 以沙漠和海滩为家。POKENAME藏在沙子里，吞噬从上方经过的猎物。
author: tentacole
source: Deserts and beaches are its home. POKENAME conceals itself amidst the sand and devours any prey that wanders above it.

entry: POKENAME在海滩上四处搜寻，用铲子般的獠牙翻筛沙子，吞食遇到的倒霉小型宝可梦。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME scours beaches, using its shovel-like tusks to sift through the sand and devour any unfortunate smaller Pokémon it encounters.

entry: 有种广为流传的说法认为，POKENAME曾是海滩的王者，后来被水属性宝可梦推翻，至今仍在伺机复仇。
author: .ssunday.
source: A popular theory claims that POKENAME were once kings of the beach. They were since overthrown by Water types, and seek vengeance to this day.

entry: 会模仿一只需要帮助的皮卡丘来引诱猎物。受害者一旦靠得太近，POKENAME就会将其拖入沙下困住。
author: grassy311
source: It lures prey by mimicking a Pikachu in need of help. Once the victim gets too close, POKENAME pulls them down and traps them beneath the sand.

entry: POKENAME是当之无愧的堆沙堡冠军。每次比赛它都会破坏别人的沙堡，至于这与夺冠有没有关系，就不好说了。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is the undisputed champion of sandcastle building. This may or may not be due to it sabotaging the other sandcastles every competition.

entry: POKENAME喜欢抢走游客的沙滩用品，让大家玩不尽兴。它是海滩的王者，对粗制滥造的沙堡十分鄙夷。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME enjoys draining the fun from beach goers by taking their beach supplies. It despises poorly-made sand castles and is the king of the beach.

entry: POKENAME通常由葬身流沙的孩子变成。据说它们会故意制造沙坑，拉更多人一起受苦。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are usually children who have died due to quicksand. They are said to purposely create sand traps so more humans can suffer with them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮训练家堆沙堡。被它抱过后，训练家身上会沾满黏黏的沙子。
author: supyovalk
source: POKENAME likes to help its Trainer make sandcastles. Hugs from this Pokémon leave the Trainer covered with sticky sand.

entry: POKENAME操纵了整片海滩的居民，把自己建成一座宏伟的城塞。再以此为据点，在大陆上肆意作恶。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME has controlled the population of an entire beach to erect itself as a grand citadel. From here, it enacts its evil whims on the mainland.

entry: POKENAME的唾液能够保存并硬化软骨，却也让它一直感到饥饿。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME has the ability to preserve and solidify cartilage with its saliva. However, said saliva also makes it constantly hungry.

entry: 会爆炸化为冰冷的冰粒。POKENAME爆炸时，周围区域都会彻底冻结。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon explodes into freezing ice particles. When POKENAME explodes, the surrounding area will become completely frozen.

entry: 在极寒的雪峰筑巢，那里冷得让大多数生物无法承受。偶尔有登山者报告看见POKENAME虹彩般的翅膀。
author: CaramelDog
source: It nests on snowy peaks where it's much too frigid for most. The sight of POKENAME's iridescent wings is occasionally reported by mountain climbers.

entry: 只肯吃冻住的食物。找到食物后，会先用冰冷的吐息将其冻结，再准备享用。
author: .izik
source: It refuses to eat any food that is not frozen. Should it find a meal, it will use its icy breath to freeze the meal in preparation for consumption.

entry: 喜欢用颚咬碎大块的冰，也因此为其他宝可梦疏通了水道。
author: CapWolfBane
source: It enjoys crushing large chunks of ice with its jaws. This behaviour also clears waterways for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不习惯与好斗或领地意识强的宝可梦共处，于是躲在草丛中避开冲突、寻找食物。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: POKENAME are not used to living with aggressive or territorial Pokémon, so they resort to hiding in grasses to avoid conflict and foraging for food.

entry: POKENAME虽然不喜欢冲突，却会奋力自卫。与进化前相比，它的信心和力量都大有增长。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: POKENAME dislikes conflict but will protect itself fiercely as its confidence and strength have grown much in comparison to its previous evolution.

entry: 会把化石般的尾巴当作武器，但尾巴太重，让POKENAME无法游泳。
author: monoski1
source: This Pokémon uses its fossilized tail as a weapon. However, due to the weight, POKENAME cannot swim.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME曾试着偷走无人看守的巢中的蛋，却常因背帆散发的鲜艳色彩而被发现。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: In ancient times, POKENAME attempted to steal eggs from unguarded nests, but often got caught due to the bright colors emitted by its sails.

entry: 咆哮能够引发大规模暴风雪。它越愤怒，风雪就越猛烈。
author: .izik
source: Its roars have the ability to cause massive snow storms. The severity of the storm is based on how angry it is.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷的苔原上快乐地生活、玩雪。对星形的叶子有着奇特的迷恋。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME live their lives happily in frigid tundras, playing in the snow. They have an odd fascination with star-shaped leaves.

entry: POKENAME平时十分温顺，发怒时却会挥舞尾巴上巨大的化石，试图砸碎对手。
author: monoski1
source: Although POKENAME are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big fossil on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

entry: 蓝普尔其有家冰淇淋店，用POKENAME的唾液制作甜点。唾液味甜，还能让甜点保持冰凉数小时。
author: .izik
source: There is an icecream shop in Porta Vista that sells desserts made with POKENAME saliva. The saliva is sweet and keeps the dessert cold for hours.

entry: 冰雪龙的基因让POKENAME的身体过于庞大沉重，令它很不舒服。它大多时候都躺在雪里，一副生无可恋的样子。
author: theeggoverlord
source: The Amaura genes in POKENAME cause its body to be uncomfortably big and heavy for it. It spends most of its time lying in snow, as if done with life.

entry: 不喜欢吃温热的食物，经常召来阵阵寒风将食物吹凉。
author: .izik
source: It dislikes eating food that is warm. It frequently summons cold gusts of wind to chill its food.

entry: 身体的部分区域由薄冰构成。一旦开裂或破碎，就需要整整一天才能再生。
author: .izik
source: Portions of its body are made from a thin layer of ice. Should the ice crack or break, it will take a full day to regenerate.

entry: POKENAME起舞时会扬起冰雪。羽毛将阳光折射成粉、蓝、黄、紫色的光束。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME kick up snow and ice as they dance. Their feathers refract sunlight into beams of pink, blue, yellow and purple.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区，身体几乎冻结。分泌的黏液冰冷刺骨，千万不能毫无防护地触碰。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME's body is nearly frozen due to living in a cold climate. The slime it produces is freezing cold; never touch one without protection.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液呈酸性，冰冷刺骨。据说徒手触碰造成的伤势，永远也无法完全痊愈。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: The goo POKENAME produces is acidic and freezing cold. Anyone who touches it barehanded is said to never fully recover from their injuries.

entry: POKENAME栖息在山顶，分泌的黏液温度低于零度。即使做好防护，触摸它也可能冻伤。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: POKENAME inhabits mountain peaks, producing goo that reaches subzero temperatures. Even with protection, touching this Pokémon can cause frostbite.

entry: 真菌寄生在POKENAME的外骨骼下，使它背上那对虹彩般的小翅膀永远无法发育成熟。
author: .realthree
source: A fungus lives in POKENAME under its exoskeleton. The small, iridescent wings on its back will never fully mature as a result.

entry: POKENAME的火焰闪耀着极光般的色彩。身上的晶体极其寒冷，连它自己的火焰也无法将其温热。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME's flames glow with the colors of an aurora. Its crystal is so cold that even POKENAME's flames aren't enough to warm it.

entry: 在冰冷多雾的环境中，会凭鲜艳的鳍辨认其他POKENAME的动向。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its brightly colored fins to keep track of other POKENAME in icy, foggy conditions.

entry: 在水中游动时会形成小小的冰晶。累了就到最近的冰川上睡觉。
author: .izik
source: As it swims through the water, it causes small ice crystals to form. When it is tired, it will sleep on the closest glacier.

entry: 嗅觉极为灵敏，即使在最荒凉的苔原上也能轻松找到食物。零度以下的气温能让它生长得很好。
author: .izik
source: By using its superior sense of smell, it can find food easily even in the most deserted tundra. Its body thrives in temperatures below freezing.

entry: POKENAME歌唱时，极光便开始铺满夜空。据说那惆怅的旋律连成年男子听了也会落泪。
author: NellNast42
source: When POKENAME sings, auroras begin to fill the night sky. It is said that their wistful melodies can bring a grown man to tears.

entry: POKENAME体内的晶体能维持低体温。冬季身体完全冻结时，就会进入冬眠。
author: 8xviktor
source: The crystals embedded in POKENAME's body maintain its low body temperature. It hibernates during the winter when its body completely freezes.

entry: POKENAME通常性情温顺，不喜欢打斗。受威胁时却能造出冰墙自保，还能将敌人封在冰中。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: Usually very docile, POKENAME dislike fighting. However, when threatened, they can create walls of ice to protect themselves and encase enemies.

entry: POKENAME只在寒冷的冬夜现身。额头的水晶能从极光中汲取能量，供给潜藏的超能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have only been seen on cold winter nights. It uses the crystal on its forehead to draw energy from auroras to fuel its latent psychic powers.

entry: 拍动翅膀便会掀起寒风，飞过之处的气温很容易降到冰点以下。
author: .izik
source: It lets loose icy winds when it flaps its wings. Temperatures can easily reach below freezing where this Pokémon flies.

entry: 学会与如今的宝可梦共处后，POKENAME的领地意识更强了。不过，只要有可能，还是会避免冲突。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: Having learned to coexist with the Pokémon of today, POKENAME have grown more territorial. However, they still avoid conflict whenever possible.

entry: 耀眼的外形令许多训练家着迷，然而只需用力一振翅，就会掀起阵阵寒风，冻结沿途的一切。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: Its dazzling appearance captivates many Trainers, but one strong flap of its wings causes gusts of frosty winds that freeze everything in their path.

entry: 穿越暴风雪肆虐的苔原时，旅人们会被提醒当心它那令人头痛的叫声。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Travellers wandering across blizzard-filled tundras are warned to stay alert for this Pokémon's headache-inducing cries.

entry: POKENAME自古以来就成群狩猎。会包围猎物，再从菱形晶体中发出冲击，将其冻结。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Hunting in packs since ancient times, POKENAME surround their prey and freeze it with blasts from their diamond-shaped crystals.

entry: POKENAME会在极光出现时聚集，在空中闪耀。这时，它们的魔法闪耀与极光束威力都会增强。
author: Uncookie
source: POKENAME gather during auroras, shining brightly in the air. At these times, their Dazzling Gleams and Aurora Beams are amplified in power.

entry: POKENAME只在新月时现身，身上的光会为迷途者指引方向。
author: WeirdTux
source: POKENAME will only appear during new moons. Its light serves as a guide for those who have lost their way.

entry: POKENAME的尖啸既能随意引发雪崩，也能使其骤然停住，留下瞬间冻结、参差不齐的雪崖。
author: mimigaagua
source: Not only can POKENAME's shriek summon avalanches at will, it also stops them in their tracks, leaving jagged cliffs of flash-frozen snow.

entry: 在积雪中优雅地游动，挖出巨大的隧道。大多时候都生活在雪层之下，因此很少被人看见。
author: imagine1.
source: It gracefully swims through the snow, making huge tunnels in the process. It's rarely seen, as it mostly lives beneath the surface.

entry: 会疾驰着穿越森林与湖泊，冻结沿途的一切。古代的描绘中，它横渡大海，将整片浪涛化作寒冰。
author: CapWolfBane
source: This Pokémon races across forests and lakes, freezing everything in its path. Ancient depictions show it crossing the sea, turning whole waves to ice.

entry: 虫子般的外形常引诱捕食者尝试吃掉它们。实际上，它们的外壳坚如磐石，很难吃下。
author: theartemis1
source: Their bug-like appearance often fools predators into trying to eat them. In reality, their exteriors are rock-hard and difficult to consume.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用羊毛裹住别人，亲昵依偎。但毛中尖锐的石块可能会不小心伤到对方。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME love to cuddle people in their wool, but the jagged stones in their coats can cause them to accidentally hurt those they snuggle with.

entry: 会在岩石上刻出深深的划痕来标记领地。POKENAME经验越丰富，獠牙上的划痕与缺口也越多。
author: Soup1900
source: They mark their territory by leaving deep cuts into rocks. The more experience POKENAME has, the more scratched and chipped its tusks are.

entry: 无论追捕猎物还是巡视领地，POKENAME的三颗头总在争吵不休与默契配合之间来回转变。
author: KitArchen
source: The three heads of POKENAME are constantly in a flux between bickering and uncanny coordination as they hunt down prey or patrol their territory.

entry: POKENAME极其危险。会以骇人的方式同化接触到的任何宝可梦，再变成对方的模样。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME are extremely dangerous. They will gruesomely assimilate any Pokémon they come in contact with before assuming their form.

entry: POKENAME沾湿后，会散发出出乎意料的宜人香气。抖动身体时，水与细小的泥沙会一同飞溅。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME gets wet, it exudes a surprisingly pleasant aroma. When it shakes, both water and flecks of sediment go flying.

entry: 头上的羽扇豆花能帮它藏身高草。许多人从POKENAME身旁走过，都不知道它就在那里。
author: .realthree
source: The lupine blooms on its head help disguise it as it crouches in the tall grass. Many people walk right by POKENAME without ever knowing it's there.

entry: POKENAME的大部分毛发很短，有助于调节体温。若身体过热，脚下的地面可能会烧起来。
author: .realthree
source: Most of POKENAME's fur is short, which helps it regulate its temperature. If it gets too hot, the ground beneath its feet may combust.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的角随月相变化而生长。攻击前，角根的球体会闪出强光，扰乱对手的方向感。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的角随月相变化而生长。攻击前，角根的球体会闪出强光，扰乱对手的方向感。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的角随月相变化而生长。攻击前，角根的球体会闪出强光，扰乱对手的方向感。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的角随月相变化而生长。攻击前，角根的球体会闪出强光，扰乱对手的方向感。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善，探索、玩耍和自卫时却天生习惯用咬的。因此，训练时需要十分用心。
author: Cristata
source: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善，探索、玩耍和自卫时却天生习惯用咬的。因此，训练时需要十分用心。
author: Cristata
source: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.

entry: POKENAME手臂末端长着巨大的羽扇豆花，质地坚硬如岩石。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's arms have oversized lupine flowers at the ends. These flowers have a hard, rocklike texture.

entry: POKENAME会用手状附肢投下影子，模仿比自己更大的捕食者。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its hand-like appendage to cast shadows that mimic the appearance of a larger predator than itself.

entry: POKENAME出现在山坡上被视为吉兆。按照传统，见到它的人必须将它收服。
author: .realthree
source: The appearance of POKENAME on mountainsides is regarded as an auspicious omen. Tradition holds that the one who views it must capture it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑迅速，不知疲倦。栖息在辽阔的平原，领地可绵延数英里。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME runs with tireless speed. It lives in large plains, and its territory can cover miles.

entry: POKENAME是坚毅可靠的伙伴，也出奇地黏人。鬃毛中的岩石软绵绵的，不会伤到谁。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a stalwart companion, and surprisingly affectionate. The rocks in its mane are too plush to hurt anyone.

entry: 洞穴中若到处散落着大量脱毛，就能判断是否有POKENAME居住。蓬松的鬃毛遮住了颈部坚硬的岩石。
author: .realthree
source: You can tell if a POKENAME lives in a cave by the excessive amounts of shed fur strewn about. Its fluffy mane conceals the hard rocks on its neck.

entry: 马勃属真菌寄生在POKENAME身上，在它背部长出蘑菇。能见到它在山间快速跑动。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is host to the Lycoperdon fungus, which creates the mushrooms on its back. You can find this Pokémon scuttling around mountains.

entry: POKENAME有着年幼鬃岩狼人的全部活力与脾气。这一类在白天最活跃。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has all the energy and attitude of a juvenile Lycanroc. This kind is most active during the day.

entry: POKENAME背上覆盖着巨大的马勃菌，周围的菌丝十分细软。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's back is covered by a massive Lycoperdon mushroom. The mycelium surrounding it is very fine and soft.

entry: POKENAME背上覆盖着巨大的马勃菌，周围的菌丝十分细软。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's back is covered by a massive Lycoperdon mushroom. The mycelium surrounding it is very fine and soft.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: Cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: Cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: POKENAME的罕见形态。关于它残暴的传闻很多，只有一条得到证实：除非它放你走，否则你无法逃脱。
author: Cristata
source: A rare form of POKENAME. Many rumors have spread about its brutality, but only one of these rumors is confirmed: you can't escape unless it lets you.

entry: POKENAME的罕见形态。关于它残暴的传闻很多，只有一条得到证实：除非它放你走，否则你无法逃脱。
author: Cristata
source: A rare form of POKENAME. Many rumors have spread about its brutality, but only one of these rumors is confirmed: you can't escape unless it lets you.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗的掩护下精准地猎杀猎物。敢挡它去路的家伙，无不心生恐惧。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME hunts its prey with deadly precision under the cover of darkness. It strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare to cross its path.

entry: 这头夜行兽据说来自另一个世界。虽然外表吓人，内心却依然善良，会保护自己认定的朋友。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Believed to be from another world, this nocturnal beast may be intimidating, but remains kind-hearted and protective of those it considers friends.

entry: POKENAME经常骗家长带孩子来听自己的演唱会，随后在台上大声飙脏话，还毫无愧疚。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME often trick parents into bringing their children to its concerts, where they scream curse words and don't feel guilty about it.

entry: 会在地下感知上方的脚步，找准时机钻出地面。踩到POKENAME岩石般鬃毛的人会受伤，疼痛难忍。
author: alliveir
source: While underground, it senses footsteps above to pop up at the right time. Those who step on POKENAME's rocky mane will suffer painful injuries.

entry: POKENAME是速度最快的捕食者之一，轻松就能跑过任何对手。曾被发现以追逐猎物直至其筋疲力尽为乐。
author: CrypticanEXE
source: One of the fastest predators, POKENAME easily outraces any opponent. It's been known to chase prey to exhaustion as a form of entertainment.

entry: POKENAME歌唱时，会重新长出能奏响旋律的护身鬃毛。唱得越多，鬃毛就越大。
author: Gurguro
source: When POKENAME sing their song, they regenerate their melodic mane, which protects them. The more they sing, the larger their mane.

entry: POKENAME常在池塘与湖边歌唱。只要有人愿意围坐聆听，它就乐意为对方献唱。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Often found singing songs near ponds and lakes, POKENAME loves to sing to those who will sit around and listen.

entry: 所有宝可梦都期待着POKENAME的演出。即使最疲惫的听众，也能从它的音乐中恢复精神。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME's performance is something all Pokémon look forward to. Hearing its music can energize even the most exhausted listeners.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: zic
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: zic
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: 锋利的新月形角具有与月之石相似的性质。心情好时，会让训练家做能预知未来的梦。
author: AxolotlHunter
source: Its sharp, crescent-shaped horns possess similar properties to moonstone. When happy, it provides prophetic dreams to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀会自行发光，夜间很容易被发现。曾遭偷猎者过度捕猎，如今大多生活在人工饲养的环境中。
author: .ssunday.
source: Since POKENAME's wings are bioluminescent, they are easy to spot at night. They were overhunted by poachers, and are now mostly kept in captivity.

entry: POKENAME借超能力推动自己在水中前进。速度足够快时，看起来宛如一颗流星。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME uses its psychic energy to help propel itself through the water. At high enough speeds, it creates the illusion of a shooting star.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会成为出色的猎手。过后，附近的鬼斯和哭哭面具便会多起来。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME becomes a skillful hunter on full-moon nights. After those days, Gastly and Yamask are abundant.

entry: 据说能让昏厥的宝可梦苏醒。弯月之夜，可能会从天而降。
author: bucklin
source: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky on nights with a crescent moon.

entry: 据说能让昏厥的宝可梦苏醒。弯月之夜，可能会从天而降。
author: bucklin
source: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.

entry: 传说能让昏厥的宝可梦苏醒，不过多半并不属实。弯月之夜，可能会从天而降。
author: bucklin
source: Rumors claim it revives Pokémon that pass out, although this is likely false. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.

entry: 情绪强烈时，尾巴上的星星就会发光。能够在梦中预知即将到来的威胁。
author: kittyluv090
source: The star on its tail glows when it feels strong emotion. It can predict incoming threats in its dreams.

entry: 传说它会到受噩梦困扰的家庭门前，挥动新月形魔杖，为这一家人提供帮助。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Legends tell of this Pokémon aiding the houses of families suffering from nightmares by waving its crescent-moon-shaped wand over their doors.

entry: POKENAME会将附近的巨石带入自己的小小轨道，让它们像卫星一样绕着自己旋转。必要时也能重新放出巨石。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME brings nearby boulders into its own small orbit, where they revolve around it as satellites. If necessary, it can re-release them.

entry: POKENAME能借月光之力使用复生祈祷。光环剥落的碎屑是珍贵的星尘。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME can use Revival Blessing with the power of the moonlight. It's halo shredded is a precious stardust.

entry: POKENAME集中波导，就能看见世界各地人类和宝可梦的梦。有时会在这些梦中留下难解的信息。
author: .realthree
source: By focusing its aura, POKENAME sees into the dreams of people and Pokémon across the world. It's been known to leave cryptic messages in these dreams.

entry: POKENAME乘着圆环飞驰，探索太空。身上的火焰由气体与星尘组成。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME zips around on its ring, exploring space. Its flame is made of gases and stardust.

entry: POKENAME在月球的洞穴中数量众多。虽会洒出美丽的星尘，但若不进化，就永远看不到自己的杰作。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is abundant in caves on the moon. Although it emits a beautiful stardust, if it doesn't evolve, it'll never be able to see its work.

entry: 盯着POKENAME的嘴看，就会立刻睡着。它喜欢做梦者的鲜血，随后便会吸取对方的生命力。
author: .ssunday.
source: Staring into POKENAME's mouth will immediately make you fall asleep. It then sucks your life force, as it loves the blood of those that are dreaming.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，新月形的双翼会合成一个完美的圆环。传说若四只步调一致地起舞，所有见证者都会一生好运。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME's crescent wings form a perfect ring while it dances. Legends say that if four POKENAME dance in sync, all witnesses will be forever lucky.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: 睡前吃下POKENAME身上的蘑菇，会做十分古怪的梦。这些蘑菇比空气还轻，能帮助它漂浮。
author: .realthree
source: Eating the mushrooms that grow on POKENAME before you sleep causes very strange dreams. The mushrooms are lighter than air to help POKENAME float.

entry: POKENAME总是一副舒舒服服的样子。光是待在那里，就能安抚最愤怒的宝可梦，让它们入睡。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME is always comfy. It's so comfy that its simple presence can calm the most enraged Pokémon and put them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME总张着嘴睡觉，口中展现出壮丽的群星。附近的宝可梦一连看上数小时，也不会厌倦。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME always sleeps with its mouth open, revealing a magnificent star show. Nearby Pokémon can watch it for hours on end without getting bored.

entry: POKENAME缓缓起舞，唱着催人入梦的迷人摇篮曲。观看演出的对象会陷入沉睡。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME dances in a slow rhythm as it sings its hypnotically enchanting lullaby. Those who watch its performance will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身保护做梦者，使其免受噩梦侵扰。目击者很少能记住那些梦，因此人们对它知之甚少。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to appear to protect dreamers from nightmares. Little is known about this Pokémon, as few witnesses of it could remember said dreams.

entry: POKENAME随时随地都可能现身，尤其喜欢出现在盼着做美梦的人的床底下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can appear anywhere at any time, but it especially appears under the beds of those who wish for pleasant dreams.

entry: 曾有人在满月下观察到几只带着发光圆环的POKENAME。它们悬浮在池塘与河流上空，将水向上吸成水柱。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: A few POKENAME with glowing rings have been observed hovering over ponds and rivers under a full moon, drawing water upwards into pillars.

entry: POKENAME的各个球体都有很强的引力，悬浮在水面上方时会吸起水流，掀起波浪。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Because its individual spheres have a strong gravitational pull, POKENAME attracts water when it hovers above the surface, causing waves.

entry: 几个头经常各自思考、各自行动，身体似乎也有自己的意识。满月之下，它们的思维最敏锐，也完全统一。
author: entomoxie
source: The heads often think and move independently. The body seems to have a mind of its own. Under a full moon, their minds are sharpest and fully united.

entry: 对太空十分着迷，找到星星碎片就常会吃下，让自己闪闪发光。
author: TheHeroicT
source: As a Pokémon that has a fascination with space, it often feeds on star pieces if it can find them, making it shine brightly.

entry: 古代神话中有位神祇长得像POKENAME，但两者究竟有没有关系，尚不清楚。
author: 8xviktor
source: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.

entry: 古代神话中有位神祇长得像POKENAME，但两者究竟有没有关系，尚不清楚。
author: 8xviktor
source: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.

entry: 古代神话中有位神祇长得像POKENAME，但两者究竟有没有关系，尚不清楚。
author: 8xviktor
source: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.

entry: 古代神话中有位神祇长得像POKENAME，但两者究竟有没有关系，尚不清楚。
author: 8xviktor
source: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.

entry: 夏干岛近海曾发现一小群POKENAME。它们态度友善，大大带动了当地旅游业。
author: .izik
source: A small school of POKENAME have been spotted off the coast of Mikan Island. Their friendly attitude has greatly encouraged tourism.

entry: POKENAME喜欢抽象艺术中鲜艳的色彩与图案。时装模特和艺术家常带着它作伴。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME are fond of the vivid colors and patterns of abstract art. They are a common companion among fashion models and artists alike.

entry: 乳汁闪耀着彩虹般的色彩，喝下后会产生迷幻效果。不过，味道却辣得惊人。
author: milchik
source: Its milk shimmers with all the colors of the rainbow and drinking it has a psychedelic effect. The taste of this milk is terribly spicy, however.

entry: POKENAME对自己的外貌很没自信，会攻击一切比自己漂亮的对象，常常因此引发混乱。
author: Gurguro
source: POKENAME are very insecure about their looks and will assault anything that looks prettier than them. This frequently results in chaos.

entry: 雄性POKENAME遇到雌性时，会缓缓摆动鳍来吸引对方。一旦结为伴侣，就会相守终生。
author: Zeeroooo
source: When a male POKENAME encounters a female, it will wave its fins in a slow motion to impress her. These Pokémon mate for life when bonded.

entry: 经常用圆滚滚的身体挡路。其他生物试图靠近时，它会打喷嚏，电击周围的对象。
author: madzie
source: It often blocks roads with its round body. When others try to approach it, it sneezes and shocks those that surround it.

entry: 会先用超能力让敌人陷入沉睡。等对方失去意识后，POKENAME便在其身上散播孢子。
author: .izik
source: It will use its psychic powers to put its enemy into a deep slumber. After the enemy is unconscious, the POKENAME will spread its spores on it.

entry: POKENAME是证明了自身耐力的派拉小子。它负责守护群落，其他派拉小子则为它提供食物。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME is a Pararogue that has proven its endurance. Pararogue feed them as they protect the colony.

entry: 烦躁时会释放团团孢子。POKENAME的孢子常被用于制作去屑洗发水。
author: .izik
source: It lets loose clouds of spores when it gets agitated. Spores from POKENAME are regularly used in anti-dandruff shampoo.

entry: POKENAME的意识完全受全身孢子的控制，力量也远不如从前。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.

entry: POKENAME的意识完全受全身孢子的控制，力量也远不如从前。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.

entry: POKENAME的意识完全受全身孢子的控制，力量也远不如从前。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's mind is entirely controlled by the spores across its body. It is not nearly as powerful as it once was.

entry: 派拉斯特身上的蘑菇尤其喜欢感染阿利多斯。POKENAME的菌丝与蛛丝相互增强，比钻石还坚韧。
author: entomoxie
source: The mushroom Parasect hosts prefers spreading to Ariados. The mycelia and spider silk on POKENAME reinforce each other and are tougher than diamonds.

entry: 会用孢子击晕威胁自己的对象，再趁机逃走。吸入孢子的受害者会看见未来的景象。
author: ohok3441
source: The spores it produces can be used to stun threats before running away. Inhaling the spores causes victims to experience visions of the future.

entry: 最近野外出现的POKENAME越来越多。科学家认为，它的孢子可能会感染野生的惊角鹿。
author: 4wingedowl
source: Recently, more and more POKENAME have been spotted in the wild. Scientists believe its spores may be contagious to wild Stantler.

entry: POKENAME完全受派拉斯特的孢子控制。会与其他无畏小子缠斗，借此感染对方。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME is fully controlled by a Parasect's spores. It grapples with other Tyrogue to infect them.

entry: 腹部生长的蘑菇可以采摘，带着浓郁的奶香，被厨师们视为上等食材。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: The mushrooms growing on its belly can be harvested. They have a milky yet hearty flavor and are regarded as high quality ingredients by chefs.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇或许已接管了波克基斯的身体，但它仍拥有智慧，也依旧喜欢用神秘孢子传播幸福。
author: entomoxie
source: The mushroom on a POKENAME may have overtaken the base Togekiss, but it is sapient and still enjoys spreading happiness by way of its mystical spores.

entry: 多边兽Ｚ数年的开发历程，敌不过真菌数千年的演化。因此，菌丝网络最终接管了POKENAME。
author: entomoxie
source: The years of development behind Porygon-Z are no match for the millennia of evolution behind the fungus. The mycelial network thus overtakes POKENAME.

entry: 能展现出惊人的速度，却经常静静待在树上，有条不紊地将孢子散播到整片丛林。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon can display terrific speed, but often remains still on trees, carefully and systematically spreading their spores across the jungle.

entry: 这只沙奈朵被派拉斯特的蘑菇感染了。会在森林中飘浮，寻找新的猎物加以感染。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: This Gardevoir has been infected by Parasect's mushrooms. It floats through forests, finding new prey to infect.

entry: 大量纤细的菌丝控制着它的四肢，也将肢体维系在一起。它看不见，对声音极度敏感，还讨厌阳光。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: Multitudes of thin fungus control its limbs and keep them attached. It is blind and hypersensitive to sound. It also hates sunlight.

entry: POKENAME似乎受背上的蘑菇群控制。呼出的孢子效果强劲，连狂怒的龙都能安抚。
author: Manidrake
source: POKENAME appears to be controlled by the patch of mushrooms growing on its back. It breathes potent spores capable of soothing even raging dragons.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会在大型宗教集会上现身。它一旦出现，附近所有派拉斯都会被迫进化。
author: Weirdtux
source: POKENAME will rarely appear during large religious gatherings. When POKENAME does appear, every Paras in its vicinity is forced into evolution.

entry: 白天藏在灌木丛中，夜间才开始在森林里游荡，寻找新的水源。
author: .izik
source: It will hide within bushes during the daylight. At night it will begin to wander the forest, looking for new water sources.

entry: 独特的生理结构让POKENAME既能独自在森林狩猎，也能用菌盖附着并控制宿主。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's unique physiology allows it to hunt in the forest independently or attach and control a host with its mushroom cap.

entry: 一年中有半年，POKENAME会埋在地下，处于近乎昏迷的状态。出土后便会给周围所有人带来灾难。
author: themicelegion
source: During one half of the year, POKENAME are buried underground in a coma-like state. When they emerge, POKENAME wreaks havoc on everyone around.

entry: POKENAME身体安抚心绪的特性，让它与蘑菇形成了共生关系。双方都能从中获得养分与保护。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The calming nature of POKENAME's body has led it and the mushroom to form a symbiotic relationship where they both gain nutrients and protection.

entry: 感染派拉斯特的真菌感染了一只史前盖诺赛克特，形成了POKENAME。蘑菇还会释放孢子，感染其他宝可梦。
author: onyxsylvian
source: POKENAME is the result of the fungus that infects Parasect infecting a prehistoric Genesect. The mushroom releases spores to infect other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME藏在诅咒娃娃外壳内，从内部操纵它。天冷时动作僵硬，会暴露这副躯壳并非真正的诅咒娃娃。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: POKENAME takes cover inside its Banette shell and controls it from within. In cold weather, its stiff movements will give it away as a fake.

entry: 据说来自遥远的真菌宇宙。会拖着沉重的步伐四处行走，用双手刺穿猎物，还会结网捕捉更多猎物食用。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Said to be from a far-away fungal universe, it trudges around and stabs prey with its hands. It spins webs to trap additional prey to consume.

entry: 侵入树根时，真菌护甲会放大碰撞的回声，在森林深处昭示它们的存在。
author: anarchaz
source: As they infest tree roots, their fungal armor amplifies the echoing sound of their collisions, signaling their presence in the forest depths.

entry: POKENAME是首个有记录的真菌感染如此巨大宿主的案例。可惜，宿主的体形限制了它的行动能力。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is the first recorded case of a fungus infecting a specimen this large. Unfortunately, the size of the host limits this creature's mobility.

entry: 失去了控火能力，取而代之的是释放浓烈气味孢子的本领。奇怪的是，孢子闻起来像烧焦的蘑菇。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It has swapped its pyrokinetic abilities for the ability to give off powerful smelling spores. Oddly enough, the spores smell like burnt mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME会随心情释放芳香舒缓的孢子，或有害的孢子。皮肤极薄，菌丝几乎露在外面。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can either release fragrant, relaxing spores or noxious spores, depending on its mood. Its mycelia are practically exposed on the thin skin.

entry: POKENAME会随心情释放芳香舒缓的孢子，或有害的孢子。皮肤极薄，菌丝几乎露在外面。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can either release fragrant, relaxing spores or noxious ones, depending on their mood. Its mycelia are practically exposed on the thin skin.

entry: POKENAME看起来虽然美味，却十分凶猛。极少有人能咬上一口，而吃到的人最后都食物中毒了。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It may look delicious, but POKENAME is highly aggressive. Very few have managed to grab a bite, but those who have ended up getting food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME的身体被巨大的蘑菇接管。它不再能喷火，改从尾巴上的孔洞射出滚烫的孢子。
author: zedsmith64
source: POKENAME's body has been taken over by a massive mushroom. No longer able to breathe fire, it instead shoots scalding spores from a hole in its tail.

entry: 蘑菇接管了POKENAME的意识，增强了它的超能力。它的孢子具有致幻效果。
author: Mistymagius
source: The mushroom has taken over POKENAME's mind, amplifying its psychic powers. POKENAME's spores have hallucinogenic properties.

entry: POKENAME与尾巴上的蘑菇形成了互利共生的关系。双方都能独立行动，却常常选择合作。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME has formed a mutualistic relationship with the mushroom on its tail, both capable of acting independently but often choosing to cooperate.

entry: 研究表明，宿主与蘑菇的互利共生关系会随时间恶化，最终由真菌完全接管身体。
author: char_latte3412
source: Research suggests that over time, the mutualistic relationship between host and mushroom deteriorates to the point of complete fungal takeover.

entry: 身上的蘑菇似乎会指引它在夜间飞往何处。POKENAME一发现树果灌木，就会将孢子撒得到处都是。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on its body seems to direct it where to fly at night. Should the POKENAME find a Berry bush, it will scatter its spores everywhere.

entry: POKENAME分为两个不同的个体。其中一颗头已完全受孢子控制，另一颗也正逐渐沦陷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME is separated into two different entities. One head is entirely controlled by spores, and the other is slowly succumbing.

entry: 会吸收太阳辐射，以激光的形式释放。从身体任何部位射出的光束，都能轻易切开建筑物。
author: dragonzzilla
source: It absorbs solar radiation to unleash in laser form. These beams slice through buildings with ease and can be fired from any part of its body.

entry: POKENAME的金色鳞片触之灼热，会吞噬沿途一切。古老传说中，有一只曾让一个村庄陷入恐惧长达八年。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's golden scales burn hot to the touch as it devours all in its path. Ancient legends claim that one terrorized a village for eight years.

entry: POKENAME的金色鳞片触之灼热，会吞噬沿途一切。古老传说中，有一只曾让一个村庄陷入恐惧长达八年。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's golden scales burn hot to the touch as it devours all in its path. Ancient legends claim that one terrorized a village for eight years.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子能折射光线，借此晃花对手的眼睛，掩藏自己的动作。
author: .realthree
source: The spores that POKENAME releases have the ability to refract light. It uses this to dazzle its opponents and hide its movements.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的气体会导致暂时失明。被激怒时，还会释放灼热的闪光。
author: .realthree
source: Inhaling a POKENAME's gasses can cause temporary blindness. If angered, it will let out a searing flash of light.

entry: 将强大的光源融入体内后，便会达到这种形态。不过，形态维持时间短，限制了它的破坏力。
author: 8xviktor
source: It reaches this form upon assimilating a powerful source of light into its body. Its destructive potency is held back by the form's short duration.

entry: 即使浓雾弥漫，也能轻松看清四周。因此，天气恶劣时仍能找到食物。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes can see even in the densest fog with very little effort. Using this ability, it can continue to find food during poor weather conditions.

entry: 会摇动触角，洒出紫色粉尘。粉尘会附着在物体上，吸入后会令人极度疲惫。
author: .izik
source: It shakes its antennae to let loose a violet dust. The dust clings to objects and can cause extreme exhaustion if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME看起来与巴大蝶几乎一模一样，却具有剧毒。
author: Staghorn
source: Though they look nearly identical to Butterfree, POKENAME is highly toxic.

entry: 光秃秃的腹部会分泌黏甜的液体，吸引并困住小虫。POKENAME便懒洋洋地将它们捡来吃掉。
author: PokePower
source: Its bald stomach secretes a sticky and sweet goo. Small insects are attracted and get trapped, which POKENAME picks off and eat as it lazes.

entry: 毛发上覆盖着剧毒。复眼几乎能看遍周围360度的范围。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: The hairs of this Pokémon are covered in a potent poison. Its compound eyes are able to see almost 360 degrees around itself.

entry: POKENAME会缠住猎物，却不将其勒紧。它会用毛中的粉末闷住猎物，使对方无力反抗。
author: PokePower
source: POKENAME wraps up prey, but doesn't constrict them. It instead uses the powder in its fur to smother its prey, rendering them vulnerable.

entry: 尾尖会渗出黏性的红色粉末，用于制作高级钢笔墨水。
author: .izik
source: A sticky red powder seeps from the tip of its tail. This substance is used in inks for expensive fountain pens.

entry: POKENAME的壳上长满浓密扎人的毛。夜间会喷出毒气，推动自己前进。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in dense, prickly fur. At night, it propels itself with poisonous gas.

entry: POKENAME浓密的皮毛让它能在寒冷环境中生存。冰河时期，大多虫属性宝可梦因严寒而灭绝，它是当时罕见的宝可梦。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's furry coat lets it survive in cold environments. This was a rare Pokémon during the Ice Age, as most Bug types died out from the cold.

entry: 眼睛如雷达般搜寻小虫与其他猎物。会用缎带挖出蛴螬。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Their eyes act as radars, scanning for small bugs and prey to to eat. Their ribbons allow them to dig up grubs.

entry: 深色的毛皮，让它在夜里难以被察觉；触角则像雷达，帮它搜寻周围，使它成为夜间可怕的威胁。
author: CodeWolfie
source: Due to its dark fur it is hard to see during the night. Its antennas act as radars, making it a prominent nocturnal threat.

entry: 置身草木繁茂的地方时，POKENAME会张开花苞，释放特殊花粉。它并不知道自己的花粉有毒。
author: char_latte3412
source: When POKENAME is amongst abundant plant-life, it will open its bud and release special pollen. It doesn't realize that its pollen is toxic, however.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，以惊人的速度滚走。蓬松的皮毛像安全气囊般缓冲碰撞，避免自己受伤。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can curl up and roll away, reaching surprising speeds. Their fluffy fur cushions collisions like an airbag so that it does not injure itself.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: 无论坡度多陡，POKENAME都能爬上去。遭到飞行宝可梦袭击时，会直接落下，用厚毛缓冲坠地的冲击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can climb any slope, no matter how steep. If it is attacked by a flying Pokémon, it can drop down and cushion the fall with its thick fur.

entry: POKENAME通常十分温顺，喜欢玩泥土、无忧无虑地蹦跳。还爱吃各种不同的土。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are generally quite docile, preferring to play in the dirt and jumping about carefree. They like to eat different kinds of dirt.

entry: 没有证据表明它的身体除了硬毛之外还含有别的东西。连X射线也无法穿透浓密的毛。
author: PokePower
source: There's no evidence its body is made of anything except stiff hairs. Even x-rays can't penetrate the dense fur.

entry: 会站在山丘顶端抖动身体，释放蓝色粉末。周围的生物哪怕只吸入一点点，也会被击晕。
author: .izik
source: It stands on the top of hills and shakes its body, letting loose a blue powder. This powder can stun others in the area with the smallest sniff.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀吸收月光，将其转化为电能。月光吸收过多，就会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wings to absorb moonlight and convert it into electricity. Should a POKENAME absorb too much moonlight, it will explode.

entry: 腹部外层很薄，像一枚蛋。看见想吃的花时，会渗出浓稠的蛋黄状物质。
author: .izik
source: Its abdomen appears to have a thin outer layer, akin to an egg. When it sees a flower it wants to eat, it seeps a thick, yolk-like substance.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会洒出剧毒粉尘。开始同时使用骨头和翅膀后，性情就变得凶猛起来。
author: jhenebean
source: Every time POKENAME flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using both bones and its wings.

entry: 黏稠的唾液或鳞粉沾到身上后，若不及时洗掉，就会引起剧烈瘙痒。
author: jhenebean
source: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva or the dust from its scales gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in.

entry: POKENAME趋光，会冲向视野内任何能找到的光源。不过，它常常直接撞上去，把光源撞坏。
author: char_latte3412
source: Drawn to light, POKENAME dashes towards any visible light source it can find. It has a habit of crashing into and destroying the source, however.

entry: 它的蛋有毒。许多人把它的蛋错当成吉利蛋的蛋，吃完后进了医院。
author: jhenebean
source: Its eggs are poisonous. Many people have been hospitalized from mistaking its eggs as Chansey's.

entry: POKENAME身旁常跟着一小群毛球。毛球们轮流坐进它的育儿袋里。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are usually accompanied by small swarms of Venonat. The Venonat take turns riding in the POKENAME's pouch.

entry: POKENAME会在夜间凭借敏锐的感官，更准确地变成眼前所见对象的模样。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME uses its superior senses at nighttime to better transform into what it sees.

entry: POKENAME靠几乎无声的翅膀悄悄接近猎物，再用有毒的鳞粉将其麻痹。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound and paralyzes them with poisonous scales.

entry: 翅膀无法支撑身体飞行。能在原地扑腾片刻，但很快就会疲倦。
author: .izik
source: Its wings are unable to support its body for flight. It can flutter in place for a short period, but it will get tired quickly.

entry: POKENAME似乎会被彼此脸上发出的光吸引。每晚聚在一起，全神贯注地互相凝望，看得如痴如醉。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are seemingly attracted to the glowing light of their own faces. They gather nightly to gaze intently at one another, completely entranced.

entry: POKENAME似乎会被彼此脸上发出的光吸引。每晚聚在一起，全神贯注地互相凝望，看得如痴如醉。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are seemingly attracted to the glowing light of their own faces. They gather nightly to gaze intently at one another, completely entranced.

entry: 白天在沼泽中沉睡，夜晚懒洋洋地飞舞。黏液有毒，因此天敌极少。
author: cait_sith
source: It slumbers in bogs during the day and lazily flutters around at night. It has very few predators due to its toxic mucus.

entry: 原生于森林深处的POKENAME长着紫色的毛。毛发不易沾水，即使暴雨中也能飞行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME that are native to the deep forest will have purple-colored fur. The fur is hydrophobic and allows flight even in rainstorms.

entry: 原生于海洋地区的POKENAME长着蓝色的毛。毛发轻盈，调节温度的效果极好，让身体保持凉爽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME that are native to oceanic areas have blue-colored fur. Its fur is light and regulates temperature extremely well, allowing it to stay cool.

entry: 全身覆盖着毛发。受到威胁时，彩色的翅膀会显现出吓人的图案，并洒出有毒粉尘。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: This Pokémon's body is covered in fur. When threatened, its multicolored wings take on a threatening pattern and shed toxic dust.

entry: POKENAME在夜间活动。白天睡觉时，由尾巴上的头负责警戒。尾巴不需要睡眠。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME are nocturnal. During the day, while it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

entry: 十分喜爱甜蜜的蜂蜜。为了独占蜂蜜，会先洒出鳞粉击晕竞争者，再用引以为傲的角将它们甩开。
author: jhenebean
source: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it stuns rivals by scattering its scales and then hurling them away with its prized horn.

entry: 猎物察觉POKENAME时，它早已用翅膀撒出了麻痹鳞粉，让对方无处可逃。
author: jhenebean
source: By the time its prey notices it, POKENAME has already scattered its paralyzing scales with its wings, preventing any escape.

entry: 据说一旦察觉训练家即将遇险，就会从翅膀洒出有毒鳞粉，将威胁训练家的对象麻痹。
author: jhenebean
source: If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to paralyze threats by scattering poisonous scales from its wings.

entry: POKENAME能感知敌人的想法，会先用翅膀洒出的毒鳞粉将其麻痹，再猛烈进攻。
author: jhenebean
source: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, POKENAME scatters poisonous scales from its wings to paralyze them before attacking fiercely.

entry: 进攻时会猛烈拍动巨大的翅膀，将毒粉洒向四周。它比看起来更敏捷、更活跃。
author: jhenebean
source: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around. It is more agile and active than it appears.

entry: POKENAME会诱骗敌人放松警惕，再用巨颚狠狠咬住。原本的毒翼已被钢铁巨颚取代。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME fools the foe into letting down its guard, then chomps down with its massive jaws. The steel jaws have replaced its poisonous wings.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时会迅速振翅，散播毒鳞粉。它不懂得控制自己的力量，经常伤到小型宝可梦。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: When POKENAME gets excited, it rapidly flaps its wings, spreading poisonous scales. Unaware of its strength, it often harms smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在夜间活动。会先隐身，悄无声息地接近猎物，再用翅膀上的鳞粉将其麻痹。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME are nocturnal. After making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey and paralyzes them with the scales from its wings.

entry: 会用长毛消去振翅声。在夜色掩护下，几乎不可能察觉伏击中的POKENAME正在靠近。
author: CodeWolfie
source: They use their long hair to muffle the sound of their wings. Under cover of night, an ambushing POKENAME's approach is almost impossible to perceive.

entry: 巨大的翅膀会洒下带着大量毒粉的鳞片。城市的明亮灯光经常将它引入人类聚居地。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its large wings release scales that are full of toxic dust. It is often lured into civilization by the bright lights of cities.

entry: POKENAME先散播有毒的孢子与鳞粉，再以迅捷的步法和拳击逼近行动受阻的敌人。
author: jhenebean
source: After scattering poisonous spores and scales, POKENAME closes in on its hampered foe with swift footwork and punches.

entry: 遇险时，翅膀会洒下一团白色粉末。吸入后会感到困倦。
author: .izik
source: A cloud of white powder showers from its wings in times of distress. This powder can cause drowsiness if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME过于沉重，翅膀已无法带它飞行，转而用来释放有毒且能致幻的花粉。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to fly with its wings. Instead, it uses them to exude poisonous and hallucinogenic pollen.

entry: POKENAME在夜间活动。白天会将自己埋进地下，只露出翅膀，以免被敌人发现。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME are nocturnal. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its wings exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

entry: 洒出的鳞粉会麻痹所有触碰到的对象，让人站都站不稳。它酿出的蜂蜜还会使人失忆。
author: jhenebean
source: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand, and the honey it produces causes memory loss.

entry: 习惯拥抱同伴，可是翅膀上的鳞粉会让被抱住的对象麻痹。
author: jhenebean
source: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions, but the scales on its wings will paralyze anyone it hugs.

entry: 头上的宝石富含维生素。古代医生会将其磨碎，与草药混合制成药物。
author: .izik
source: The gem on its head is packed with vitamins. Doctors in ancient times would crush it up to mix with herbs to make remedies.

entry: POKENAME会从身体发出特殊的阿尔法波。这种波有毒，光是靠近就会头痛。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME emits special alpha waves from its body that are toxic and induce headaches just by being close by.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大的超能力，肌肉却很无力。会用毒鳞片组成的披风撑住身体。
author: jhenebean
source: While it has strong psychic abilities, a POKENAME's muscles are very weak. It uses its cape made of venomous scales to support itself.

entry: 据说POKENAME在夜间活动，但强壮的身体从不疲倦。会帮助毒林中的工人干活，借此锻炼肌肉。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME is said to be nocturnal, but its formidable body never gets tired. It builds muscles by helping workers in poisonous forests.

entry: 天性自由散漫。滚下山坡时，即使翅膀洒出有毒鳞粉，也毫不在意。
author: jhenebean
source: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if it scatters poisonous scales from its wings while it rolls down mountains.

entry: POKENAME既会释放足以毁坏电子设备的强大磁力，也会散播危害生物的有毒粉尘。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME emits both a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and toxic dust that is dangerous to living creatures.

entry: POKENAME总带着一根植物茎秆。为了保护它，会从翅膀洒出有毒鳞粉。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME is always seen with a stick from a plant and will scatter poisonous scales from its wings to defend it.

entry: 迈着强劲的步伐疾驰过草原，沿途洒下使人麻痹的鳞粉。
author: jhenebean
source: It races through grassy plains with powerful strides, scattering paralyzing scales in its wake.

entry: POKENAME失去了翅膀，换来了三颗头、三颗心脏与三副肺。虽然速度比以前慢，却能持续奔跑更久。
author: jhenebean
source: POKENAME trades its wings for three heads, hearts, and lungs. It is slower than before, but POKENAME can keep running for longer stretches of time.

entry: 喜爱一切肮脏的东西。全身不断洒出粉尘般的有毒鳞片。
author: jhenebean
source: This Pokémon loves anything filthy. It constantly scatters toxic, dust-like scales from all over its body.

entry: 许多睡眠瘫痪的案例，都被认为与这种食梦宝可梦有关。
author: jhenebean
source: Many cases of sleep paralysis have been attributed to this dream-eating Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在树果树间嬉戏，洒下帮助树木生长的粉末。粉末也能安抚心绪，用于治疗失眠与焦虑。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME frolics among Berry trees, sprinkling powder which helps them grow. Its powder's soothing properties are used to treat insomnia and anxiety.

entry: POKENAME在树果树间嬉戏，洒下帮助树木生长的粉末。粉末也能安抚心绪，用于治疗失眠与焦虑。
author: noel5299
source: POKENAME frolics among Berry trees, sprinkling powder which helps them grow. Its powder's soothing properties are used to treat insomnia and anxiety.

entry: 它会用布满尖刺的种子吓退敌人，让对方不敢轻易攻击。随后，再用自身产生的易燃毒液反击。
author: Soup1900
source: Its enemies don't like to attack it, since it uses its thorny bulb as a deterrant. It then uses the flammable toxin it creates to counterattack.

entry: 近来，关于POKENAME惹麻烦的报告多了起来：即使正在战斗，它也只顾躺在日光下打盹，悠哉地吸收养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: Reports of troublesome POKENAME have arisen. In these reports, the Pokémon will simply nap in the sun during a battle, basking in its nutrients.

entry: POKENAME十分自大，认定要做的事很难劝阻。训练家必须看紧它，以免它身陷危险。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is extremely cocky; it's hard to dissuade it from anything it attempts. Trainers must keep a close eye on it to keep it from danger.

entry: POKENAME生活在沼泽中，利用腐烂植物产生的气体助燃火焰。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME live in swamps. They use the gas produced by the rotting vegetation there to fuel their fire.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际时，会留下蓝白色的光迹。光迹消散前，所有看到它的人都会感到喜悦。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When POKENAME soars across the skies, it leaves behind a bluish-white trail of light. This light brings joy to all who see it before it fades.

entry: 族群睡觉时，会有一只POKENAME放哨。捕食者若靠得太近，它尾巴的火焰就会猛然蹿起，发出威吓。
author: char_latte3412
source: One POKENAME stands sentry as the rest of its pack sleeps. The flame on its tail flares threateningly if any predators come too close.

entry: 近来，关于POKENAME惹麻烦的报告多了起来：即使正在战斗，它也只顾躺在日光下打盹，悠哉地吸收养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: Reports of troublesome POKENAME have arisen. In these reports, the Pokémon will simply nap in the sun during a battle, basking in its nutrients.

entry: 背上的仙人掌开始开花了。谁想采摘这株仙人掌，都会迎来一份火辣辣的“惊喜”。
author: Soup1900
source: The cactus that is on its back has started to bloom. Anyone who tries to harvest this cactus will be met with a fiery surprise.

entry: POKENAME会偷走其他宝可梦未受精的蛋，用火焰烤熟后喂给自己的幼崽。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME steals non-fertilized eggs from other Pokémon. It then cooks them with its flames and feeds them to its young.

entry: POKENAME口袋里冒出的火，温度恰好适合煎炸。它一心想精进厨艺，常会请其他宝可梦品尝。
author: Leshii
source: The fire coming from POKENAME's pocket burns at the perfect temperature for frying. Fiercely determined to improve, POKENAME often feed other Pokémon.

entry: 小巧却凶悍的融合体。想摸它时要当心，耳朵上一直燃着火。
author: howlingstarr
source: A small fusion with a fierce attitude. Take care when trying to pet it, as its ears are constantly burning.

entry: 宽阔的翅膀能借助尾巴升起的热气，让POKENAME轻松浮在空中。被它蜇伤后，灼痛会持续数天。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME can stay afloat with little effort, as its broad wings catch the hot air rising from its tail. A sting from this Pokémon will burn for days.

entry: 异常温暖的秋日里，能看见POKENAME在灌木丛中疾行。若此前没有下过雨，就可能引发野火。
author: .realthree
source: On exceptionally warm fall days, POKENAME are found darting through the undergrowth. Unless it's been rainy, these appearances can lead to wildfires.

entry: 背上的仙人掌一直被火烧着，究竟如何生长至今不明。其中含有多种毒素，不能食用。
author: Soup1900
source: It is unknown how the cactus on its back could even grow since it is constantly set ablaze. The cactus contains many toxins that render it inedible.

entry: POKENAME栖息在陡峭的山间，用强健的腿在岩台之间跳跃，追赶猎物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives on steep mountains. It uses its sturdy legs to leap from ledge to ledge to chase prey.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME自尊心很强，会与群体中的其他成员竞争。领地争夺战中落败的一方，必须永远离开族群。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has a strong ego and competes with other members of its group. Whoever loses a territorial battle must leave the group forever.

entry: 这把怨灵附身的战镐一挥就能瞬间熔穿铠甲与血肉，是披甲敌人的克星。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This haunted war pick instantly melts through armor and flesh in one swing, making it the bane of armored foes.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，火焰会裹住整片刀刃；平静时则缩小成一簇火苗。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's flames engulf its whole blade when it is angry, but dwindles to a single flame when it's calm.

entry: 随着POKENAME操纵龙焰的本领日渐精熟，外甲也染上深红。古老故事里，它是斩除邪恶、备受敬仰的骑士。
author: nvisionluminous
source: As POKENAME's mastery over dragon flame grew, its outer armor took on a crimson hue. It's revered in old stories as a knight that vanquishes evil.

entry: POKENAME是这一进化家族中最凶猛的，愤怒咆哮时会迸出火花。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: As the most ferocious of its family, POKENAME creates sparks when it roars in anger.

entry: 感知训练家陷入困境时，会迅速焦躁起来。焦躁时，火焰温度会升至平时的近两倍。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It becomes agitated quickly if it senses its Trainer is in distress. When agitated, its flames burn nearly twice as hot.

entry: 会烧毁遗弃自己的主人所有的玩具，以此复仇。拉开脸上的拉链就能喷火。
author: Soup1900
source: It exacts its revenge on the owner who disowned it by burning down all of their toys. It breathes fire by opening the zipper on its face.

entry: POKENAME坚持在伪装服上使用真火，又总得分神照看，以免服装的其他部分也烧起来。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME insists on continuing to use real fire with its costume. It's constantly distracted by trying to keep the rest of its costume from burning.

entry: POKENAME虽表现得狂躁，天性却行动迟缓，连维持自身生存都很困难。
author: scapz
source: Despite this Pokémon's rabid demeanor, POKENAME struggles to sustain itself due to its sluggish nature.

entry: POKENAME很容易热血上头，常在燃尽力气后倒下，有些再也无法恢复。
author: scapz
source: POKENAME get fired up very easily. This Pokémon often collapses after getting burned out, and some never recover.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来气冲冲的，却极力保护亲近的对象，经常挡在训练家与危险之间。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Despite its angry appearance; POKENAME is extremely protective of those close to it, often walking between its Trainer and any threat.

entry: 兴奋时，尾巴上的火焰会变成平时的两倍大。总在寻找对手较量，即使落败也乐在其中。
author: Soup1900
source: The flame on its tail doubles in size when it gets excited. It constantly seeks for opponents to fight with and has fun doing so, even if it loses.

entry: 迷路的矿工会循着远处微弱的火光，盼着找到地面。可那是POKENAME，正引着他们走向地下更深处。
author: RoboSoup
source: Lost miners will follow a distant glimmer of torchlight hoping to find the surface, but POKENAME is leading them astray, deeper into the earth.

entry: POKENAME没有腿，移动不快。不过，火焰攻击的射程足以弥补这一点。
author: .realthree
source: Without legs, POKENAME can't move very quickly. The range of its fire attacks more than makes up for that, however.

entry: POKENAME身上薄薄的鳞片摸起来很柔软。虽很亲人，却曾不慎让训练家身上着火。
author: .realthree
source: The thin layer of scales that cover POKENAME are soft to the touch. Though affectionate, they have been known to inadvertently set Trainers aflame.

entry: 融合能量唤醒了它的龙之基因。性情极为残忍，会将看见的任何人烧成灰烬，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: Soup1900
source: Fusion energy has awakened its draconic genes. It is extremely ruthless and will incinerate anyone it sees, including its own Trainer.

entry: 不服管束的POKENAME会在光天化日下扑向旅人抢劫。它们总因傲慢而招惹打不过的对手，最终自食其果。
author: RoboSoup
source: Unruly POKENAME will pounce on travelers to rob them in broad daylight. Their arrogance is their downfall, as they pick fights they cannot win.

entry: 先用巨尾猛击对手，再凶狠地将其焚毁。没有翅膀，行动缓慢，走起路来常重重跺脚。
author: Soup1900
source: It slams its large tail onto opponents before viciously incinerating them. Due to its lack of wings, it moves slowly and often stomps while walking.

entry: POKENAME能发射800摄氏度的火球，身体散发的热度也与之相近。过度降温会让它病得很重。
author: cipherlingarde
