source: Capable of launching fireballs at 800 degrees Celsius, POKENAME's body radiates a similar level of heat. Any overcooling can make it very sick.

entry: 背甲上燃烧着熊熊烈火，因此露营者常把POKENAME当作篝火。
author: Soup1900
source: The back of its shell sports a huge fire. Because of this, POKENAME is often used by campers as a campfire.

entry: 背上有两具喷火器，通常只喷出近距离的火焰。愤怒时，火焰却能喷出十多英尺远。
author: Soup1900
source: This Pokémon has two flamethrowers on its back that expel short-range flames. When angered, though, the flames can reach a distance of over ten feet.

entry: 据说POKENAME由捕捉宝可梦失败后留下的精灵球残骸形成。能在垃圾场与污染地区找到它们。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME is said to be the remnants of Poké Balls that failed to capture a Pokémon. They can be found in garbage dumps and polluted areas.

entry: 无论猎场、挖掘场还是墓地，POKENAME都名副其实：既有鼹鼠般的身体，也会改造骨头。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: From hunting grounds to excavation sites to graveyards, POKENAME's name rings true, first with its mole-like body then with bones it's modified.

entry: 耳朵就像铲子，帮助它在地下挖掘。一旦完全钻出地面，就会改变形态，适应新的环境。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its ears act like shovels, helping it tunnel through the ground. Once it surfaces completely, it will change form, adapting to its new environment.

entry: 最近在当地农场发现了POKENAME。农民若没有合适的装备就想驱赶它们，可要吃大苦头。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME have been spotted in local farms recently. Any farmers trying to get rid of them without the proper equipment are in for a world of hurt.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成阿罗拉的地鼠。不过，它的毛发与阿罗拉地鼠不同，光滑而柔软。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for being an Alolan Diglett. Unlike the Alolan Pokémon, the hairs of POKENAME are smooth and soft.

entry: POKENAME经常造访海滩与港口，能用沙子和泥土造出交通工具。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME is often seen visiting beaches and ports. It is capable of making vehicles out of sand and dirt.

entry: POKENAME在野外睡觉时，常被错当成一袋遭人丢弃的物品。它们的眉毛始终整洁如新。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for a discarded bag of items while they sleep out in the wild. Their eyebrows are always pristine.

entry: POKENAME似乎会背着地鼠，在田地之间移动。只有肥沃的土壤中才能找到它。
author: spagalapof
source: It seems that POKENAME carries Diglett on its back from field to field. You'll only find it on fertile soil.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在黑暗的隧道中穿行，从毫无戒心的猎物背后突然钻出伏击。说不定此刻，它就在你们中间。
author: Xenophacilus
source: It is said that POKENAME goes around dark tunnels in order to ambush and pop up behind unsuspecting prey. It may currently be among you right now.

entry: 这是一种经典而深受喜爱的融合宝可梦。风靡儿童间的玩具“地头先生”，正是照着它制作的。
author: howlingstarr
source: An iconic and well-loved fusion. A popular kids toy, named Mr. Dighead, was modelled after it.

entry: POKENAME能察觉并挖出附近埋着的东西，仿佛找到了宝藏。建议训练家别带它靠近墓地。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME detects and digs up nearby buried objects as if it were treasure. It's recommended that Trainers keep their POKENAME away from graveyards.

entry: POKENAME看起来像卡在土里，让人想把它拔出来。可一旦有人想握住它，它便会沉进地下更深处躲开。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's appearance of being wedged in the dirt beckons one to pick it up, but it evades would-be wielders by sinking further into the ground.

entry: POKENAME在地下一码深处挖洞，以植物根部为食。农民拔出新鲜蔬菜时，才发现上面缺了几口。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME burrows a yard underground, eating the roots of plants. Farmers have pulled up fresh vegetables only to find bite marks taken out of them.

entry: 为等待真实或理想补全自己，它度过了无比漫长的岁月。最后终于放弃，转行务农去了。
author: barthandelus_real
source: This Pokémon waited for eons to be completed with truth or ideals. It eventually gave up and decided to go into agriculture instead.

entry: 一只地鼠住进了某位神秘无名艺术家的墓穴。据说它在自己的记忆中保存着逝者的回忆。
author: elevn.
source: A Diglett has taken up residence in the tomb of a mysterious unknown artist. It is said that it keeps the memories of the deceased in its memory.

entry: POKENAME以共生的方式生活，噬沙堡爷负责保护一群地鼠。不过，地鼠一旦超过三只，它就会难以照顾周全。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME is a symbiotic relationship where PALOSSAND will act as a protector for a group of DIGLETT, however it struggles to handle more than three.

entry: 象征友谊与长久的爱情。蜜月期间偶然见到它，会为新婚夫妇带来好运。
author: spagalapof
source: It symbolizes friendship and lasting love. A glimpse of it on one's honeymoon brings good luck to the newlyweds.

entry: 据说许多地鼠聚在一起时，有时会造出守卫来保护洞穴。不过，守卫获得生命的原理仍不明。
author: Fuade
source: It's said many Diglett coming together sometimes build guardians to protect their burrows. The mechanism through which it gained life is unknown.

entry: 这匹地下马的害羞程度无人不知。只有周围100公里内都没有人，才肯钻出洞来。
author: spagalapof
source: The shyness of this underground horse is legendary. It'll only come out of its hole if there's nobody around for 100km.

entry: 一只地鼠厌倦了在农场犁地，于是与鬼斯通达成交易，联手吓唬农民。
author: elevn.
source: A Diglett got tired of plowing the land on farms, so it made a deal with a Haunter to terrorize the farmers.

entry: 训练家睡不着时，POKENAME会将特殊的沙子撒进对方眼中，让其昏昏入睡。
author: empty_set
source: When its trainer cannot sleep, POKENAME will sprinkle some of its special sand into their eyes, which will cause them to doze off.

entry: 这三只地卡拉为更高效地生存决定分工合作，分别担任挖掘者、工匠与猎手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This trio of Digbones have decided to take different roles for survival and efficiency: an excavator, a crafter, and a hunter.

entry: 翅膀上的假面孔能吓退捕食者。幸好有这层保护，因为POKENAME通常对周围状况浑然不觉。
author: .realthree
source: The faux faces on its wings intimidate predators. This is a good thing, because POKENAME is generally oblivious to its surroundings.

entry: 独居洞穴的宝可梦，因孤独而制作布偶，将它们当成家人。很久以前便失去了理智。
author: dinner8480
source: A Pokémon that lives alone in caves, loneliness had driven it to create cloth puppets that it considers family. It lost its sanity long ago.

entry: POKENAME因为进化后秃了头而一直惊愕不已。担心被发现时，会慌张地扭动臀部。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME are in constant shock due to becoming bald upon evolving. It moves its hips in panic over being found.

entry: 三颗头各有自己的嘴和胃。一天不吃东西，鼻子就会变得冰冷。
author: .izik
source: Each of its three heads has its own mouth and stomach. If it does not eat for a day, its noses will become extremely cold.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头能够独立思考。中间的鼻子还能360度旋转。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: The three separate heads on POKENAME's body are capable of individual thought. The nose in the middle spins 360 degrees.

entry: POKENAME仅用沙子、泥土和岩石，就能造出交通工具与武器。没人知道它究竟如何做到。
author: Neonriser
source: POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of sand, dirt, and rock. No one is sure how they manage to do it.

entry: 这个POKENAME亚种能完全用海底的材料制造交通工具与武器。性情十分凶猛。
author: Neonriser
source: This subspecies of POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of materials from the seafloor. It's known to be very aggressive.

entry: 能闻见一英里外的火焰气味。POKENAME若闻到篝火味，就会往反方向逃走，避开旅人。
author: .izik
source: It can smell a fire burning from a mile away. If a POKENAME smells a campfire, it will flee in the opposite direction to avoid the traveler.

entry: POKENAME让地鼠同伴坐在自己头上，装作普通三地鼠四处走动，再突然冒出，朝敌人尖叫。
author: awiralonprime
source: POKENAME uses its head to have their Diglett comrades ride on top of them. They parade as a simple Dugtrio before popping up and wailing at foes.

entry: 是大自然的好朋友，会将地鼠从干旱地区带到更好的土地。所有农民都盼着POKENAME把地鼠放进自家田里。
author: spagalapof
source: A great friend of nature, it brings Diglett from arid zones to better lands. All farmers hope that POKENAME will deposit its Diglett in their fields.

entry: 坚盾剑怪将三地鼠吸入剑中，形成了POKENAME。能用剑刃操纵地面，在地下迅速穿行。
author: zic
source: Aegislash absorbed Dugtrio into its swords, forming POKENAME. It manipulates the ground with its blades, allowing for swift underground travel.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头想法完全一致，因此挖隧道时配合得天衣无缝。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The three heads of POKENAME all think exactly alike, allowing it perfect coordination while digging tunnels.

entry: 将三地鼠与自身融合，似乎创造出了一位首领。地鼠可以自由出入这个小小的群体。
author: xtjs2018x
source: Splicing Dugtrio with itself appears to have created a leader. Diglett come and go from this small community as they please.

entry: POKENAME会从炮管中射出迷你头。奇怪的是，从没有人知道这些小脑袋底下长什么样。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME blasts mini-heads from its cannons. Somehow, nobody knows what the bottom of these mini-heads look like.

entry: POKENAME将半个身体埋入地下，伪装成三地鼠。训练家靠得太近时，就会用超能力攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a Dugtrio by burying half of its body. When Trainers get too close, it attacks with psychic power.

entry: 不知为何，它的沙子能让人入睡。科学家试过用来制成失眠药，但只有POKENAME亲自撒下才有效。
author: empty_set
source: Somehow, its sand makes people fall asleep.  Scientists tried to make it into an insomnia remedy, but it has no effect unless POKENAME sprinkles it.

entry: POKENAME总梦想着钱。训练家逗它玩、抱着它时，它会趁机偷走对方身上一切能偷的东西。
author: ZombieShinx_
source: POKENAME is constantly dreaming about money. When Trainers play with and cuddle this Pokémon It steals everything they can from them.

entry: POKENAME以路边遗落的零钱为食。虽然也能吃其他金属，却更偏爱金银制成的硬币。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on change left on the roadside. While it can eat other metal, it prefers coins made of silver or gold.

entry: 看见任何硬币都会兴奋。POKENAME的巢里塞满了钱包、珠宝和各式钱币。
author: .izik
source: It grows excited should it see coins of any kind. A POKENAME's nest is filled with wallets, jewelry and miscellaneous currency.

entry: 会从尾巴喷出金币。有人想把手伸进POKENAME的尾巴时，立刻就会被吸进去。
author: Themicelegion
source: This Pokémon spews gold coins from its tail. If someone tries to put their hand in POKENAME's tail, they will immediately be sucked in.

entry: POKENAME嬉戏时迸出活泼的电火花，带着顽皮的魅力。是可爱的伙伴，也能卖出高得离谱的价钱。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME frolics with playful sparks and mischievous charm. It is an adorable companion and can be sold for egregious amounts of money.

entry: POKENAME在夜间游荡，偷走一切看上眼的闪亮物件。无论硬币、宝石，还是落单的美录坦与可可多拉，都不放过。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME will wander during the night time and steal anything shiny that catches its eye, from coins to gems to lone Meltan or Aron.

entry: 会经常洗澡，保持身体光亮。POKENAME若看上了别人手中的东西，就会一直大声哭闹，直到如愿以偿。
author: lazyarcanist
source: It bathes regularly to keep its body shiny. If POKENAME covets something you have, it will cry loudly until it gets what it wants.

entry: 喜爱闪亮的硬币，能帮忙数钱，是银行出纳员的好伙伴——就是钱总会少一些。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: Their love for shiny coins makes them the perfect companion for bank tellers by helping them count money, though there's always some money missing.

entry: POKENAME以喜爱昂贵的颜料和材料著称。有些罪犯会利用它们绘制赝品，再高价售出。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME are known for their love for expensive paints and materials. Some criminals use them to paint counterfeits to sell for high prices.

entry: POKENAME喜欢出门冒险，把好运与欢乐带给身边每一个人。据说进化后会变得更自私。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME love to go on adventures to spread good luck and cheer to everyone around them. It is said when it evolves, it becomes more selfish.

entry: POKENAME喜爱闪亮物品，见到后就会使劲啃咬，常常因此崩坏牙齿。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME loves shiny objects. When it comes across something shiny, it will gnaw on it vigorously. Their teeth often chip due to this habit.

entry: POKENAME会啄咬找到的闪亮物品，直到看见另一件亮晶晶的东西，才会对原来那件失去兴趣。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME pecks at shiny objects it finds. Only when it sees a different shiny object will POKENAME lose interest.

entry: 开心的POKENAME被视为行商的幸运符。传说旅途中若能讨得它欢心，就会变得富有。
author: .izik
source: A happy POKENAME is considered a good luck charm for traveling merchants. Legend says if you appease one on your journey, you will become wealthy.

entry: 黄金本来太重太软，不适合做剑刃，但它能够自行修复。还能探测宝藏，一发现就会明显兴奋起来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Gold would normally be too heavy and soft for a sword blade, but it's able to repair itself. It can detect treasure, its presence visibly exciting it.

entry: POKENAME迷恋闪亮的东西。想收服它的训练家只要送上亮晶晶的礼物，就能轻松与它交好。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Fascinated by shiny objects, POKENAME can be easily befriended by prospective Trainers by offering it something that sparkles.

entry: POKENAME会用独一只前爪招引暴风雪中的旅人，带其前往安全的避难处。它的出现是吉兆，因此被用作幸运的象征。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its single paw to beckon travelers in snowstorms to safe shelters. Its appearance is fortuitous, so it's used as a symbol of luck.

entry: POKENAME看似由黄金构成，身体其实覆着闪亮的包装纸。反光的外表下，是堆积如山的垃圾。
author: musicsheep.
source: Despite looking like gold, POKENAME's body is actually covered in shiny wrappers. Underneath the reflective exterior is mounds of garbage.

entry: POKENAME若觉得有人要拿走自己想要的闪亮物件，就会不停抓挠对方。可这股盲目的怒气往往让它失去那件宝贝。
author: PokePower
source: If POKENAME thinks someone will take a shiny object it wants, it will scratch them relentlessly. This blind fury usually leads to losing the object.

entry: 毛发浓密蓬松，常被用于制作冬衣。也是寒冷地区很受欢迎的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its fur is very dense and fluffy, which is why it is often used for winter clothing. It is also a popular companion in cold regions.

entry: POKENAME虽然体形庞大，却十分贪玩。训练它需要很大耐心，但最终会收获一位忠诚的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is very playful. A trainer needs a lot of patience to train it, but will be rewarded with a loyal companion in the end.

entry: POKENAME睁开眼睛时，目光所及都会被施加可怕的诅咒。哪怕只看到眼中一丝红光，也已经来不及了。
author: 8xviktor
source: When POKENAME opens its eyes, it hexes anything it looks at with a ghastly curse. If you spot even a hint of red in its eyes, it's already too late.

entry: 爪子由金属构成。看起来像黄金，材质实际上却更接近铁。
author: .izik
source: Its claws are made of metal. While they look constructed of gold, it is actually a material that is more similar to iron.

entry: POKENAME若看见旅人戴着精美珠宝，就会吐丝试着偷走。可惜准头不佳，通常都会失败。
author: .izik
source: If a POKENAME notices a traveler wearing fine jewelry, it will attempt to steal the trinket with silky string. Due to its poor aim, it usually fails.

entry: 平时善良又乐于助人，却会死死护住随身的宝石。谁试图夺走它，就会被记恨一辈子。
author: knilk
source: While normally a kind and helpful Pokémon, it jealously guards the gem it carries. It will hold a lifelong grudge against any who attempt to take it.

entry: POKENAME身上的毛线并不全都连着身体。有几缕多余的毛线，只是一路被它拖着走。
author: .realthree
source: Not all of the yarn in POKENAME's body is attached to it. There are several extraneous strands that have been dragged along for the ride.

entry: POKENAME头上的宝石令偷猎者垂涎。它越愤怒，宝石就越纯净、越闪亮。
author: .izik
source: The gem on the head of a POKENAME is coveted by poachers. Its shine and purity increase based on how angry the POKENAME gets.

entry: POKENAME的巢穴常被闪亮物品塞得满满当当。寻宝者会在岸边积极寻找这些宝物堆。
author: lynkinator
source: POKENAME dens are often filled to the brim with shiny objects. Treasure hunters actively seek out these stockpiles of valuables by the shoreline.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴缠住最爱的宝石，牢牢守护。稍受挑衅，就会跃起保护宝石。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME jealously guards its favorite gem by wrapping its tail around it. It will leap to defend it at the slightest provocation.

entry: 常有人说，吓人的弹簧小丑盒以POKENAME为原型。有时能看见它们在城市的墙壁与屋顶上爬行。
author: holgast
source: It's often claimed that POKENAME was the reference for creepy Jack-in-the-boxes. They are sometimes seen crawling on city walls and roofs.

entry: POKENAME在晨昏时活动。强光会刺痛眼睛，因此白天常眯着眼。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a crepuscular Pokémon. Strong sunlight hurts its eyes, so it often squints during the day.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME堪称猫科之王，备受人类与宝可梦尊敬。只会与真正信赖的对象分享食物和财富。
author: kill_the_wabbit
source: Respected by humans and Pokémon alike, POKENAME is the ultimate feline. It only shares food and fortune to those it truly trusts.

entry: 庞大的体形让它几乎没有天敌，因此对大多其他宝可梦都不屑一顾。
author: dicedragon20
source: It treats most other Pokémon with disdain, since its sheer size has left it with few natural predators.

entry: POKENAME既能充当精心锻造的宝剑，也能充当寻宝探测器，具体取决于剑柄上猫老大头部的心情。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a finely forged sword as well as treasure detector, determined by the mood of the Persian head pommel.

entry: 这只POKENAME曾由一位传奇寻宝者持用。据说那位探险家能够听懂它的话，与它交谈。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This POKENAME was once wielded by a legendary treasure hunter. The explorer was said to have been able to verbally communicate and understand it.

entry: POKENAME有许多仰慕者。不过，想收服它的训练家要注意，它对谁亲近可是说变就变。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME has many admirers, though prospective Trainers should be warned it is fickle about who it shows it's affection to.

entry: POKENAME真把自己当成了国王，会试图统治同一区域内的其他宝可梦。
author: Snugglessam
source: POKENAME thinks of itself as king in a literal sense and will attempt to rule over other Pokémon living in the same area.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体在时尚界十分受欢迎。许多男装系列会让它穿上最新潮的服装亮相。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME is very popular in the fashion world. Many men's clothing lines will feature POKENAME sporting the latest trendy fashions.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME擅长潜行，常伏击小型猎物或偷取食物。柔软的脚掌让它跑动时悄无声息。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME are known for stealth, often seen ambushing small prey or stealing food. Their soft paws let them scamper about silently.

entry: POKENAME碰到的任何东西，都会变成一种有毒的金色类金属。它全身也由这种神秘物质构成。
author: musicsheep.
source: Anything POKENAME touches will turn into a toxic, gold-like metalloid. Its entire body is comprised of this mysterious substance.

entry: POKENAME以小群体共同生活。胡须最华丽的一只就是首领，所有成员都毫无例外地认可它。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME live together in small packs. The one with the most magnificent beard is the leader, who is accepted by every pack member without exception.

entry: POKENAME极为高傲，只听从经验丰富的训练家。不过，一旦认可对方，甚至愿意为其冒生命危险。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is an extremely proud Pokémon that only obeys experienced trainers. However, it would even risk its life for one.

entry: POKENAME每天刻苦训练，磨炼拳击技巧，因此身心都很健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME trains hard every day to improve its skill in boxing. As a result, it is both physically and mentally healthy.

entry: POKENAME自以为是世界闻名的拳击手。实际本领平平，不过头痛越厉害，拳技就越高。
author: pory
source: A delusional fusion, POKENAME believes itself to be a world-renowed boxer. Despite its mediocrity, its skill increases with its headaches.

entry: 头发可以取下来。找到干净的水源后，就会摘下这顶假发，彻底洗净。
author: .izik
source: Its hair is able to detach from its head. When it locates a clean water source, it will take the wig off and wash it thoroughly.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力复制对手的外貌与本领，但有时会忘记怎么变回来。
author: poppamunz
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to copy its opponents' appearance and skills. However, it sometimes forgets how to change back.

entry: 会把头整个伸进池水里喝水，因为清凉的水能缓解持续的头痛。
author: .izik
source: It shoves its head below a pond's surface to drink. This is because the coolness of the water soothes its ongoing headache.

entry: 尽职尽责的哨兵，稍有危险迹象就会唤醒伙伴。据说POKENAME的头痛就来自这份差事的压力。
author: anarchaz
source: A diligent scout, it rouses allies at the slightest hint of peril. It is said that POKENAME's headaches come from its stressful position.

entry: 头痛时，头顶的尖刺会变暗。受到惊吓时，尖刺还会渗出有毒物质。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its head with get darker in color when it is experiencing a headache. The spike will also ooze a toxic substance if it gets scared.

entry: 会像直升机旋翼一样转动头上的香蒲，让POKENAME一次能飞行约一英里。
author: .izik
source: It spins the cattails on its head like helicopter blades. Doing this, a POKENAME is able to fly for about one mile at a time.

entry: 会用尾巴给自己按摩，试图缓解持续的头痛。虽然很舒服，实际效果却不大。
author: holgast
source: It attempts to assuage its constant headaches by giving itself a massage with its tail. While it feels pleasant, it's not very effective.

entry: POKENAME的喙可用于制作头痛药。药效很强，只需少许就够一整天的用量。
author: .izik
source: The beak of a POKENAME is used in headache medications. Due to its potency, only a small amount is required for an entire day's dose.

entry: POKENAME会在溪边一坐数小时，垂钓理想的一餐。喙对温度变化极为敏感。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will sit at the edge of a stream for hours, trying to fish for the perfect meal. Its beak is extremely sensitive to changes in temperature.

entry: 持续的偏头痛让头部慢慢膨大。想用触手揉去疼痛，可头太软，根本揉不成。
author: watermelonchild
source: Its constant migraines are making its head slowly expand. It tries to use its tentacles to rub the pain away, but its head is too soft to do so.

entry: 超能力引起的头痛持续折磨着它，让它漫无目的地滑行。
author: poppamunz
source: The constant headache of its psychic powers cause it to slither around haphazardly.

entry: 体内储存着大量的水。天气热时会大量出汗，保持身体湿润。
author: .izik
source: It stores large amounts of water in its body. If it gets hot, it will sweat in great amounts to keep its body moist.

entry: 不建议尝一口POKENAME。它不仅难吃，哪怕只啃下一点点，也会引发剧烈的偏头痛。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It is recommended that no one take a bite out of POKENAME. Not only does it taste horrible, but even the smallest nibble can cause intense migraines.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，读得懂人类文字。最喜欢在河边读书消遣。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is very intelligent and can read human texts. Its favorite pastime is reading books near rivers.

entry: 用六片翅膀游泳，用两只巨爪牢牢抓住猎物。长期头痛若达到顶点，可能会展现奇异的力量。
author: The_Fireplace
source: It swims using six wings, and grips its prey firmly between its two large claws. If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直头痛。建议想饲养它的训练家常备舒缓的音乐，营造没有压力的环境。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME suffers from near-constant headaches. Prospective Trainers are advised to keep therapeutic music around and create a stress-free environment.

entry: 一大群POKENAME出现，农民一年的收成就可能遭殃。它们会一路吃下去，直到寸草不剩。
author: .izik
source: If a swarm of POKENAME is seen, it could spell the end for farmer's yearly crop. The POKENAME will eat until there is nothing left.

entry: POKENAME是舞者，却从没有实际跳舞的记录。平日懒洋洋的，据说经常头痛。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are dancers, but have never actually been recorded dancing. They laze around and often are said to have headaches.

entry: 会收集人们投进喷泉、水井与池塘的硬币。额头上的硬币靠潜藏的念力固定着。
author: Staghorn
source: It collects coins that are dropped into fountains, wells, and ponds. The coin on its forehead stays attached via its latent telekinetic powers.

entry: 超能力不再让它头痛，因此，性情也平和了许多。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: It no longer receives headaches from its psychic powers. It is much calmer as a result.

entry: 无论发生什么，POKENAME都会大吃一惊。就算什么都没发生，也会对“什么都没发生”感到震惊。
author: funkytomate
source: No matter what happens, POKENAME will react with shock. Even if nothing happens, POKENAME will be shocked that nothing happens.

entry: POKENAME温顺、贪玩，还有点迷糊。会游泳缓解头痛，却常常过于投入，连其他宝可梦都撞上了。
author: bobosmith01
source: Docile, playful, and a little spacey, POKENAME swims around to relieve its headaches. It becomes so engrossed that it even runs into other Pokémon.

entry: 合众的工匠会用POKENAME的鳞片制作珠宝。鳞片沾湿后照到月光，就会泛出柔和的光芒。
author: .izik
source: The scales of a POKENAME are used in jewelry by artisans in Unova. They glow softly when wet and exposed to moonlight.

entry: POKENAME优雅地穿梭于深水。闪亮的鳞片和红色宝石让它的外形在栖息地很受欢迎。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME navigates the depths with grace. Its shimmering scales and its red jewel make its appearance very popular in its habitat.

entry: 红色的皮肤常被误认成裙子，对热空气极为敏感。环境太热，就会愤怒地放声尖叫。
author: .izik
source: Often mistaken for a dress, the red skin on its body is extremely sensitive to hot air. If it becomes too warm, it will scream loudly in anger.

entry: 头上的球体承受的压力越大，发光就越强烈。借此便能知道自己是否潜得太深。
author: .izik
source: The orbs on its head glow more intensely the more pressure they're under. This lets it know if it's going too deep underwater.

entry: POKENAME以层层脂肪为傲，气色最佳的个体会成为族群首领。天性温顺，喜欢拥抱。
author: Megaban
source: POKENAME's layers of fat are its pride. The most optimal complexion decides the pack's leader. POKENAME are docile in nature and like hugs.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，胡须会缓缓长长。稍有声响就会惊慌，潜入水下深处。
author: .izik
source: The whiskers of a POKENAME will grow slowly while it sleeps. It will panic and dive deep into the water at the slightest noise.

entry: POKENAME能在水下如同在天空中一样飞翔。许多救援队会请它营救海上迷途者。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME can fly underwater as if it were still in the sky. Many rescue teams use it to save people who are lost out at sea.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖岸。坚韧的外骨骼、锋利的爪子与强壮的尾巴，让它轻松捕猎、自卫。
author: The_Fireplace
source: POKENAME lives on the shores of lakes. Its tough exoskeleton, sharp claws, and strong tail allow it to easily hunt for prey and defend itself.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME在湖中游泳。会用念力与巨爪惩罚污染家园的家伙。
author: The_Fireplace
source: POKENAME is often seen swimming in lakes. It uses its telekinetic powers and enormous claws to punish those who pollute its home.

entry: POKENAME靠带蹼的脚掌游泳，在栖息的湖泊与缓流河中优雅穿行。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME uses its webbed paws to swim gracefully around the lakes and slow-moving rivers that make up its habitat.

entry: POKENAME用摆锤引导超能力时，摆锤会闪闪发光。它与额头宝石由相同材质构成。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's pendulum shines brightly when used to channel psionic power. Its pendulum is made of the same material as the gem on its forehead.

entry: 喜欢挥动摆锤，在对象身上试验催眠术。成功催眠后，又会喷出水柱将对方叫醒。
author: cipherlingarde
source: It likes to test its power of hypnosis on subjects by swinging its pendulum. When the subject is hypnotized, they use a jet of water to wake them up.

entry: POKENAME接受完全进化的火花训练。它拼命锻炼，希望有朝一日能打败对方。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME are trained by fully evolved Primesaur. POKENAME trains furiously, hoping to one day beat them.

entry: POKENAME极为凶暴危险，会四处飞行，袭击人类和宝可梦，因此很难训练。
author: Sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is an extremely violent and dangerous Pokémon. It flies around attacking people and Pokémon, which makes it very hard to train.

entry: POKENAME仿佛愤怒的化身，会猛烈攻击闯进领地的对象。
author: pory
source: Anger given form, POKENAME is extremely aggressive towards those who trespass its territory.

entry: 野生POKENAME成群生活在河岸，领地意识极强。一只生气，整群就会同时猛合双颚，狂乱地翻腾。
author: char_latte3412
source: Wild POKENAME live in troops along riverbanks, fiercely territorial. If one gets angry, the entire group snaps their jaws in unison, thrashing about.

entry: POKENAME引以为傲的獠牙和暴躁脾气让它极其危险。最近，过分狂热的偷猎者纯粹为了挑战而盯上了它。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's prized fangs and angry disposition make it highly dangerous. Recently, overzealous poachers have begun targeting it purely for challenge.

entry: POKENAME背上萌出的花苞，代表训练开始见效。看到花苞后，它们会更有动力坚持锻炼。
author: CodeWolfie
source: The flower that starts to bud on POKENAME's back is a sign that their training is paying off. The sight of this bud motivates them to keep training.

entry: 会攀在洞壁上，靠敏锐的嗅觉察觉敌人。一发现敌人，就会吓得松开身体，飘走逃跑。
author: .izik
source: It will cling to cave walls and sense enemies with its superior sense of smell. Upon detection, it will drop down and float away in fear.

entry: POKENAME高高翘起的鼻子能闻出谁在接近。一旦察觉有人靠近，就会暴怒起来。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's elevated nose helps it smell if anyone is approaching. If it notices someone, it works itself into a violent rage.

entry: 谁闯进领地，它就会咬住对方并注入毒液。越是愤怒，毒性就越强。
author: Skymaster426
source: It lashes out at anyone who enters its territory by biting and injecting the target with its venom. The angrier it grows, the more potent the venom.

entry: 尾尖有个小鼻孔，会渗出黏液。它会将黏液留在树木与墙壁上，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: Its tail has a small nostril on the tip. The mucus that oozes from the tip is left on trees and walls to mark its territory.

entry: 手臂虽细，却能举起自身体重两倍的东西。头上的角很脆，但折断或缺损后能再生。
author: .izik
source: Despite its thin arms, it is able to lift twice its own body weight. The horn on its head is very brittle, but can regrow if broken or chipped.

entry: POKENAME很容易生气。烦躁时会用缎带状触角缠住训练家，直到自己平静下来。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Quick to anger, POKENAME will latch its ribbon-like feelers to its Trainer when agitated until it is calm.

entry: 外形像人像得有些可疑，所到之处总引起骚动。回声定位的本领与音波龙不相上下。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Its suspiciously humanoid appearance has caused much ruckus wherever it goes. Its echolocation skills are on par with Noivern.

entry: POKENAME脾气急躁，既用手臂攻击，也用手臂移动。
author: Deflador
source: POKENAME has a short temper. It uses its arms as both its means of attacking and moving.

entry: POKENAME常以小群体一起生活。虽然争吵不断，彼此却像手足一样亲密，难舍难分。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME often stick together in small groups. Despite their constant quarrels, their sibling-like bond is strong and inseparable.

entry: 五个不同的意识融合，形成了POKENAME。它会把遭同族排斥的火蛋收留在身边，照顾它们。
author: 8xviktor
source: Five different minds have merged together to form POKENAME. It takes outcast Primecute under its care.

entry: 突然被扔来的蛋砸中，就说明POKENAME喜欢上了你。它的蛋会留下强烈的金属余味。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: If you're suddenly struck by a thrown egg, it means POKENAME has taken a liking to you. Its eggs have a sharp metallic aftertaste to them.

entry: POKENAME暴走时势不可挡，会挥拳冲向所有挡路的敌人。
author: homelessrager
source: POKENAME is unstoppable when it's on a rampage, punching and rushing into any foe that gets in its way.

entry: POKENAME是猴怪融合体的进化形态，由较弱的同族聚合而成。它能不断适应，克服几乎任何敌人。
author: pory
source: The evolved form of Manto, POKENAME is the amalgamation of its weaker brethren. It can adapt to overcome almost any foe.

entry: 这个POKENAME变体从外貌到行为习惯，都像极了某位小有名气的网络红人。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME, from its look to its behavioral pattern, resembles a certain online microcelebrity.

entry: 数十年前，POKENAME曾是马戏团的招牌。传说它后来怒不可遏，挣断镣铐，袭击了主人。
author: char_latte3412
source: Decades ago, POKENAME was featured as an attraction in circuses. Legend has it that it grew so enraged, it broke its shackles and attacked its master.

entry: POKENAME战技娴熟，外貌凶狠，脾气暴躁，很少有对手愿意主动与它交战。
author: char_latte3412
source: Due to its skilled fighting style, aggressive appearance, and fierce temper, very few opponents willingly engage in battle with POKENAME.

entry: 冲岛的工匠会用POKENAME的皮革制作树果袋，因为它的皮格外结实耐用。
author: .izik
source: There are crafters on Ogi Isle that create Berry Pouches from POKENAME leather. This is due to its skin being exceptionally durable.

entry: 不肯在同类附近筑巢。只要看到另一只POKENAME的巢，就会愤怒地拆个精光。
author: .izik
source: It refuses to make its nest near others of its kind. If it sees the nest of another POKENAME, it will angrily tear it apart, leaving nothing behind.

entry: 随着斗志日盛，POKENAME的花朵外长出一道钢箍。钢箍坚不可摧，据说恰如POKENAME不屈的意志。
author: CodeWolfie
source: As POKENAME's fighting spirit grew, It developed a steel band around its bloom. The band is unbreakable, and said to resemble POKENAME's spirit.

entry: POKENAME一拳就能夷平一座房屋。正因如此，空手道王们更喜欢在银岩岛的洞穴里与成群的它们一起训练。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME's punch can level a home in one swing. Knowing this, Black Belts prefer to train with groups of POKENAME in the caves of Silver Rock Isle.

entry: 会推倒树木砸向敌人。愤怒时，只需几秒就能啃断树干。
author: Staghorn
source: It brings down trees on top of its foes. When angered, it can gnaw through a tree's trunk in seconds.

entry: 融合终于让POKENAME平静下来。可惜，融合带来的失明又让它很恼火，脾气依旧有些急躁。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to finally calm down. Unfortunately, it is very annoyed by its newfound blindness and is still somewhat irritable.

entry: POKENAME会训练年幼的猴种子战斗。若被徒弟击败，便会退休，由徒弟成为新的师父。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME trains young Mansaur to fight. If beaten by its apprentice, the apprentice becomes the new teacher, and POKENAME retires.

entry: POKENAME总是带着起床气。谁粗鲁地吵醒它，就会被打成肉泥，而它随后又会回去睡觉。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME always wakes up on the wrong side of the bed. If someone rudely awakens it, it'll smash them into paste before going back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME始终怒气冲冲。谁敢看它，哪怕只有一瞬间，也会遭到攻击。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Constantly furious, POKENAME will attack any opponent that dares to lay its eyes on them, even if only for a fraction of a second.

entry: POKENAME身上花朵的花粉具有极强的刺激性。因此，它每次挥动双臂，都会让自己的狂怒变得更加猛烈。
author: Mistymagius
source: The pollen from NAME's flowers is extremely irritating, so anytime it swings it arms it only intensifies its primal rage.

entry: POKENAME常在夜里闯入商店，偷走营业款。喜欢砸开保险柜的门，而且只需一拳。
author: .izik
source: It is not uncommon for a POKENAME to break into shops at night to steal their earnings. It loves smashing open safe doors and can do so in one punch.

entry: 族群中最强的POKENAME会用众多肢体，同时迎战其他所有成员。首领会独占群体找到的一切食物。
author: Al_Chimera
source: The strongest POKENAME in a pack will fight every other member at once with its many limbs. The leader of the pack hoards any food the pack acquires.

entry: POKENAME在广阔的大地上疾驰，撞倒一切挡路者，从不停歇。不过，它很爱吃美味的苹果。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME gallops across wide terrain, plowing down anyone in its way. It never rests. It does love a good apple, however.

entry: 脚踝上的金属环沉重无比。战斗时踢出的一脚，足以夷平整栋建筑。
author: .izik
source: The metal bands on its ankles are extremely heavy. When fighting, it will kick with enough force to level an entire building.

entry: 暴怒时，双拳仿佛有自己的意识般不断挥出。研究者一直争论，拳头会不会真的拥有意识。
author: empty_set
source: When it flies into a rage, it throws punches as if its fists have minds of their own.  Researchers have debated whether this might be literally true.

entry: 凭嗅觉就能轻松找到同类。追踪时会摇摆臀部，路过人们身边时还常常致意。
author: houndrys.
source: Thanks to its sense of smell, it can easily find others of its kind. It sways its hips while tracking and often salutes people while passing by.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的小小幼犬宝可梦，火焰比太阳还热。忠诚与嗅觉都强得惊人。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny, floating puppy Pokémon, and its flames are hotter than the sun. It has an insane sense of loyalty and smell.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的幼犬宝可梦，用意念操纵火焰。友善而忠诚，为了训练家什么都愿意做。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a floating puppy Pokémon. It can control fire with its mind. It is very friendly and loyal, and it will do anything for its Trainer.

entry: 在废弃建筑中安家。獠牙的温度能超过大多数家用炉灶。
author: .izik
source: It makes its homes in abandoned buildings. Its fangs can grow hotter than most residential stovetops.

entry: POKENAME会在喜欢的东西上留下火热的吻痕。它讨厌脏，一弄脏就会尽快把自己清理干净。
author: houndrys.
source: When POKENAME finds something it enjoys, it leaves a firey kiss mark on it. It hates being dirty and will clean itself up as soon as possible.

entry: 经常被女士们放在手提包里随身携带。高高梳起的蓬巴杜发型，需要费心打理才能维持。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon is often carried about in ladies' purses. Its pompadour takes a lot of styling to maintain.

entry: POKENAME只让自己认可的高尚英雄持用。若察觉别有用心者的恶意，就会燃起自身。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME allows itself to be wielded by those it considers to be a noble hero, but lights itself ablaze when it senses evil intent in another.

entry: POKENAME是普通人最爱养的宠物之一，对主人极为忠诚。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: One of the most popular pets among non-Trainers, POKENAME are extremely loyal and faithful to their owners.

entry: 会装作小狗，向人类讨取食物与住处。但最终总会露出昆虫般的动作和习性，往往把人吓得发毛。
author: PokePower
source: It acts like a puppy to get food and shelter from humans. Its insectoid movement and behavior is eventually noticed, which usually creeps people out.

entry: 人们自古就敬畏POKENAME在熔岩中迅速奔跑的身姿。威风凛凛的皮毛下，是极为坚韧的皮肤。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: People have long revered the sight of POKENAME running swiftly through lava. Beneath its majestic fur is extremely tough hide.

entry: POKENAME双镰散发的热度堪比熔岩蜗牛，能轻易切开厚厚的钢铁。
author: themicelegion
source: The heat emanating from POKENAME's scythes are comparable to the heat of a Magcargo. It can easily cut through thick steel.

entry: 古籍记载，它曾与人们同行，带来繁荣和温暖。一个飞吻之后，就会掀起烈焰风暴。
author: houndrys.
source: Ancient texts tell that it walked along people, granting them prosperity and warmth. If it blows a kiss, a storm of fire will follow.

entry: POKENAME通常在燃煤发电厂筑巢，用带刺铁丝、煤灰与建筑保温材料搭成。
author: .izik
source: The nest of a POKENAME is usually found in coal-powered power plants. It is made up of barbed wire, soot, and construction insulation.

entry: POKENAME聪明可靠，总想教导训练家的其他宝可梦，结果反而经常让大家一头雾水。
author: bobosmith01
source: Trustworthy and intelligent, POKENAME tries to become a mentor to its Trainer's other Pokémon. It often confuses them instead.

entry: 古老传说称POKENAME能随意召出利爪。以猎取战利品为目的的猎人称，摆出来展示的爪子一夜之间就消失了。
author: char_latte3412
source: Old folklore speaks of POKENAME's ability to summon claws at will.  Trophy hunters claim the claws vanish overnight when put on display.

entry: 研究表明，POKENAME能冻结附近空气中的水分，造出凶悍的利爪。不战斗时，爪子便会融化。
author: char_latte3412
source: Research indicates that POKENAME possesses the ability to freeze nearby air moisture to craft its vicious claws, which melt away when not in combat.

entry: 身手敏捷，走到哪里都常以滚动前进。一口气能滚过6,000多英里，无需休息。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This nimble Pokémon can often be seen rolling around wherever it goes. It can roll for over 6,000 miles without needing to break.

entry: 虽然笨拙，据说却能打动最冰冷的心。以超能力包裹的飞吻，能让任何人都感到愉快。
author: houndrys.
source: Despite being clumsy, it's said to inspire even the coldest heart. By blowing a kiss veiled in psychic power, it brings a pleasant feeling to anyone.

entry: POKENAME保留了两种融合原型如犬般的习性。叶片上覆着浓度极高、气味芳香的辣椒素。
author: captainmodeus
source: POKENAME retains the dog-like demeanor of both its fusion components. Its leaves are coated in a highly concentrated and fragrant capsaicin.

entry: 据说POKENAME适应了冰河时期之后的气候变化。厚重保暖的皮毛使它必须生活在寒冷地区。
author: char_latte3412
source: It is believed POKENAME adapted to the changing weather following the ice age. Its heavy, insulating fur necessitates its habitat in cold climates.

entry: 这个POKENAME变体虽然庞大，却十分敏捷。冰河时期族群最繁盛时，每逢换季都会迁徙数千英里。
author: char_latte3412
source: Despite its bulk, this POKENAME variant is very agile. During the peak of its species in the ice age, it traveled thousands of miles between seasons.

entry: POKENAME十分懒惰，只有找水果时才肯动。可训练家睡觉时，它会清醒地守护，连眼都不眨。
author: drip_capybara
source: POKENAME is really lazy and only moves to find fruit, but when its Trainer is sleeping, it stays awake to guard them without even blinking.

entry: POKENAME平日只会懒着不动，盯住对手。可对方只要敢攻击，它便会以无可匹敌的速度撞过去。
author: p0opys0ck123abc
source: POKENAME does nothing but loafs and stares at its opponent. However, if the opponent dares to attack it, it will tackle them at unrivaled speeds.

entry: POKENAME被尊为传说中的来世守护者。据说，它会引领逝者的灵魂，前往灵界。
author: CaptainzScourge
source: POKENAME is revered as a legendary guardian of the afterlife. It is said that it guides those who have passed away into the spiritual realm.

entry: 忠诚的POKENAME时速能超过250英里。据说一直在寻找与自己失散的英雄。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The loyal POKENAME can travel more than 250 miles per hour. It's said to search for a hero who was separated from it.

entry: POKENAME来自远东，自古以来就因忠诚和亲人的天性备受贵族与王室珍视。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Hailing from the far east, POKENAME has been prized since ancient times by regals and royalty for its loyalty and loving nature.

entry: POKENAME高速飞过沙漠，猛烈振翅掀起热浪。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: POKENAME flies at a high speed through deserts, generating heat waves by violently flapping its wings.

entry: 奔跑时，头上花朵构成的鬃毛会释放温和的镇静成分。受惊时，镇静效果会增强。
author: .izik
source: The mane of flowers growing off of its head let loose a mild sedative when it runs. When it is scared, the sedation effect becomes stronger.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。性情亲人，也聪明得出奇。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME is a popular first Pokémon for kids. It's very loving and surprisingly intelligent.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。相伴珍爱多年后，条纹也许会褪色，爱却永不消退。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME are popular first Pokémon for kids. After being cherished for many years, their stripes may fade, however, that love never will.

entry: POKENAME不擅长使用火属性招式，因此常让风速狗的头自行战斗。栖息在火山附近的温暖水域。
author: creeps_jr
source: Due to its inexperience with Fire-type moves, POKENAME often allows its Arcanine head to fight on its own. It stays in warm waters around volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME生活在干燥炎热的地方。背上的种子味道浓郁而辛辣，常被用来制作各种菜肴。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME can be found in dry, hot places. The bulb on its back is popular for many dishes because of its rich, spicy flavor.

entry: 每逢它一年一度的迁徙，人们便举办庆典。它喜欢在灼热的烟火中起舞，否则就会焚烧城镇取乐。
author: RoboSoup
source: Festivals are held on its annual migration, for it loves dancing amongst the hot fireworks, and would otherwise burn towns for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME的两种融合成分同步完成了超级进化，能一直维持这种形态。破坏欲极为强烈。
author: RoboSoup
source: Both halves of POKENAME have mega-evolved in synchrony, and it can hold this form indefinitely. It has a great urge to destroy.

entry: 最初将它融合，是为了守护一位老国王的金库。可POKENAME更喜欢睡觉，结果大部分宝物都被偷走了。
author: volvonovic
source: This Pokémon was first fused to guard an old king's vault. But, POKENAME prefers to spend its time asleep, so most treasure has been stolen.

entry: 察觉森林起火时，会用翅膀扇走火焰。若不慎点着植物，便会感到内疚。
author: birchbot
source: When it detects a forest fire, it will waft the flames away with its wings. It feels guilty whenever it accidentally sets plants on fire.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖息在长有仙人掌的稀树草原。人们常采下它背上的仙人掌，做成美味的炸条。
author: Soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME can be found in savannah biomes where cacti grow. The cactus on its back is often harvested to make delicious cactus fries.

entry: POKENAME的火焰会迅速消耗储存的脂肪，因此食量几乎是圈圈熊的两倍。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME need to eat almost twice as much food as Ursaring, as their flames quickly burn though their fat reserves.

entry: POKENAME一旦用身体缠住敌人，对方就无法从硫磺烈焰中逃脱。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: Once POKENAME wraps its body around a foe, escaping its sulfuric flames becomes an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME虽然不能飞，却能从高处跃下，滑翔极远的距离。会用尖牙将火焰注入敌人的血肉。
author: VaporVenator
source: Unable to fly, POKENAME leap from high elevations and glide exceptional lengths. They inject fire into the flesh of their foes with sharp fangs.

entry: 先用身体缠住敌人，再急剧升高体温。身体虽重，仍能乘着强风在空中滑翔。
author: hampterbychoice
source: It wraps its body around foes before drastically increasing its body heat. Despite its weight, it glides through the air on strong winds.

entry: POKENAME是个急性子的厨师。强烈情绪会让育儿袋里的火焰增强，因此厨艺虽好，却常在压力下把菜烧糊。
author: Leshii
source: POKENAME is a hotheaded chef, but the fire in its pouch intensifies with strong emotions. Despite its skill, it frequently burns dishes when stressed.

entry: POKENAME夜间栖息在城堡塔顶，能听见数英里外闯入者的动静，因此很受王室喜爱。
author: RoboSoup
source: POKENAME roosts atop castle towers at night, and can hear interlopers from miles away. This makes them a favorite companion of royalty.

entry: 长出新翅膀后，POKENAME便不再玩泥巴了。如今，它的目光已投向云端。
author: Shocktopus
source: With its new wings, POKENAME has abandoned its habit of playing in mud. It has its eyes set on the clouds now.

entry: POKENAME的火焰会随感知到的周围人的意图而增强。一旦察觉威胁，便会猛烈蹿起。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: The flames on POKENAME intensify in response to the detected intentions of people nearby. The flames surge fiercely when a threat is perceived.

entry: 时速可达惊人的1,000英里。不过，飞过后难免留下余烬，有时会引发野火。
author: Skymaster426
source: Its speed reaches a blistering 1,000 mph. However, it can't help but leave embers in its wake, sometimes causing wildfires where it flies.

entry: 野生POKENAME出没于干燥的沙漠。人们经常采集它背上的种子，用来烹制辛辣的菜肴。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME can be found in dry desert biomes. The bulb on its back is often harvested to be used in spicy dishes.

entry: POKENAME在空中翱翔，向下方毫无防备的受害者洒下燃烧的酸液，宛如飞翔的酸液火山，自己却浑然不知造成了多少破坏。
author: Benevolent
source: Oblivious to the wreckage it causes, POKENAME soars through the air, spewing flaming acid onto its unwitting victims below like a flying acid volcano.

entry: POKENAME会到处寻找强敌。虽然个头小，却对自己的力量极为自豪。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME will go around looking for tough opponents. Despite its small stature, it is very proud of its power.

entry: POKENAME看起来可爱，却能喷出超过1800度的火焰。只要信任训练家，就会不惜一切代价保护对方。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME looks cute, but can spit out flames at over 1800 degrees. If it trusts its Trainer, it will protect them at all costs.

entry: POKENAME毫不留情地捍卫领地，将火与水在巨口中混合，喷出滚烫的蒸汽。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME defends its territory without mercy. It combines fire and water in its maw to spew boiling hot steam.

entry: 身体极为坚固，还能传导热量。POKENAME会飞起加热身体，再将对手从空中狠狠撞落。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is extremely robust and conducts heat. POKENAME flies up, heats up and then rams its opponent out of the air to hit them hard.

entry: 研究者怀疑，POKENAME必须不断喷火维持“剑刃”，这样的持续消耗让它脾气火爆。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Researchers suspect POKENAME gets its fiery temper from the strain of constantly breathing fire to form its "blade", a constant cycle.

entry: 据说，这柄传说中的战镐，附着巨龙之魂，一挥之下，便能熔穿整支军队。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This legendary war pick is said to be possessed by the spirit of a dragon and have the ability to melt through armies in one fell swoop.

entry: POKENAME与体内的龙携手后，获得了这种形态。据说一道烈焰斩击便能将一切邪恶化为灰烬。
author: nvisionluminous
source: POKENAME gained this form after joining hands with the dragon within. It's told that just one burning slash reduces all manner of evil into ashes.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时周身缠绕雷电与火焰，是当地森林火灾和停电的主要原因之一。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Cloaked in lightning and flame as it runs, POKENAME is a leading cause of forest fires and power outages in the region.

entry: POKENAME的力量源于与训练家的羁绊。感情越深，火焰就燃烧得越猛烈。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The source POKENAME's power is the bond with its Trainer. The closer it is bonded to its Trainer, the more intensely its fire burns.

entry: POKENAME体内一度平息的暴戾再次涌起。它唤出的地狱之火，预示着对手即将前往彼岸。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: Violence once sated rages anew inside POKENAME. The infernal flames conjured by POKENAME herald an opponent's impending passage to the world beyond.

entry: POKENAME面对怯懦狡诈的敌人时凶猛不屈。找到合意的伙伴后，金环就会发出灿烂的光芒。
author: Final_Courtesy
source: POKENAME is ferocious and unyielding towards cowardly, deceitful foes. Its gold rings give off a brilliant glow when it has found a favorable partner.

entry: 靠炽热火焰将自己推进到约4,600英尺的高空，在那里盘旋寻找值得一战的对手。
author: ariamelisma
source: It uses its intensely hot fire to blast itself to heights of about 4,600 feet, where it drifts about in search of a worthy opponent.

entry: 靠炽热火焰将自己推进到约4,600英尺的高空，在那里盘旋寻找值得一战的对手。
author: ariamelisma
source: It uses its intensely hot fire to blast itself to heights of about 4,600 feet, where it drifts about in search of a worthy opponent.

entry: 嘴上的拉链将强烈的火焰封在体内。它不敢轻易拉开，因为喷出的烈焰强得难以控制。
author: Skymaster426
source: The zipper on its mouth contains a powerful blaze within its body. It hesitates to unzip its mouth, because the blast is uncontrollably powerful.

entry: 终于制成了防火布！POKENAME开心地举着燃烧的树枝四处走动，全然没发觉沿途的灌木被点着了。
author: howlingstarr
source: It finally succeeded in making fireproof cloth! POKENAME happily totes around a burning branch, oblivious to the brush fires it leaves in its wake.

entry: POKENAME彻底放弃了制作防火布。只能难过地接受伪装服会烧着的事实，时常打上补丁。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME has fully given up on trying to craft fireproof cloth. It's sadly accepted the fact that its costume will burn, and patches it regularly.

entry: POKENAME叫得凶，其实没那么爱咬人。它常躺在营地尚未熄灭的火堆里——不过，食物可千万别放在外面！
author: SupersonicLoki
source: With a bark worse than its bite; POKENAME is usually found laying in smoldering fires at local campsites. Make sure not to leave any food out!

entry: POKENAME寻找族群时常引起骚动。它会展示力量，却往往给当地居民带来灾难。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: When searching for a pack, POKENAME often causes a commotion. It shows displays of strength that often result in disaster for the locals.

entry: 翼展是身体大小的六倍。体形小巧、重量轻盈，让它能飞得比喷火龙还高。
author: Soup1900
source: Its wingspan is six times the size of its body. It can fly even higher than Charizard thanks to its small size and low weight.

entry: 只有凶猛程度能胜过它的贪吃。常被香味引到集市，随后便大肆闹腾。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: This Pokémon's hunger is only exceeded by its ferocity. It is known to rampage in marketplaces after being attracted by the smell.

entry: 忠诚又友善，是很好的宠物。尾巴的火焰以一种黏稠、燃烧缓慢的黏液为燃料。
author: arch.stanton
source: It is known to be loyal and friendly, making it a great pet. The fire on its tail is fueled by a sticky, slow-burning mucus.

entry: POKENAME由一家神秘玩具公司培育并出售。性情十分友善，却有时会不小心烧毁东西。
author: arch.stanton
source: POKENAME are bred and sold by a mysterious toy corporation. They are extremely friendly, but sometimes burn things down by accident.

entry: 半夜，POKENAME飞过洞穴与森林，寻找对手。燃烧的鬃毛发出的光，也是引诱猎物的诱饵。
author: Al_Chimera
source: In the middle of the night, POKENAME flies through caves and forests in search of opponents. The light from its flaming mane serves as bait for prey.

entry: 生性好斗，喜欢将其他飞行生物撞落。比起向上飞，更偏爱向下滑翔攻击敌人。
author: Soup1900
source: It is aggressive and loves to knock other flying creatures out of the sky. It prefers to glide down to attack its foes rather than fly up.

entry: 在关都发现的首批融合体之一。自身热量带来的压力让原本的皮肤变硬，如今形似板甲。
author: fixthewifi
source: One of the first fusions discovered in Kanto. The pressure of this Pokémon's own body heat has hardened its former skin, now resembling plate armor.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。它喷出的火焰温度能够超过华氏10,000度。
author: Zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its flames can reach temperatures of over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME能在敌人上空倾泻火焰与超能力，形成双重威胁。它既精于心灵之力，也擅长掌控天空。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME is a dual threat in battle, able to fly above foes while raining fire and psychic energy down on them. It is a master of the mind and skies.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAMEX极为相似，最爱贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪发动攻击。
author: Soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME X. It loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 虽然长得像超级POKENAMEX，它却保留着普通POKENAME的配色。战斗时，喜欢贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪出击。
author: Soup1900
source: While it looks similar to Mega POKENAME X, it maintains the colors of normal POKENAME. It prefers to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 它兼具两种超级进化形态与超极巨化形态的特征。一声咆哮，周围便会迸起炽烈的蓝色火焰。
author: Soup1900
source: It has the features of both its Mega forms and of its Gigantamax form. Its roar causes intense blue flames to burst all around it.

entry: 它有着超级POKENAMEY的外貌，配色与火焰却来自超级POKENAMEX。有人推测，这其实是两个形态融合的结果。
author: Soup1900
source: While its appearance is that of Mega POKENAME Y, it has the color and flames of Mega POKENAME X. Some theorize it's actually both fused together.

entry: 小巧流线型的身体让飞行速度发挥到极致。POKENAME能从口中猛烈喷出火焰。
author: Soup1900
source: Its small, aerodynamic body allows it to maximize its flight speed. POKENAME powerfully spits flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找垃圾吃，身体会熔化沿途的一切。喷出的烟雾能使任何吸入的训练家失去行动能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body melts everything in its path as it searches garbage to eat. The smoke it emits can incapacitate any Trainer that breathes it.

entry: 尾巴上的喷火器像军用武器，能喷出燃烧的液体。液体可在物体表面反弹，将火焰送进视线不及的地方。
author: Soup1900
source: The flamethrower on its tail, like a military one, spits a flaming liquid that can bounce off surfaces to project the fire into unseen places.

entry: POKENAME用喷火器般的尾巴烹烤水生猎物。战斗时，会从上方喷出道道火柱焚烧对手。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME uses its flamethower-like tail to flambé its aquatic prey. In battle, it torches its opponents from above with geysers of flame.

entry: 岩浆在POKENAME的岩石身体里流淌，使它重得无法起飞。因此，它一生中大部分时候，翅膀都派不上用场。
author: akujules
source: Magma courses through the stone body of POKENAME, making it too heavy to take off. Thus, its wings remain dormant throughout most of its life.

entry: POKENAME靠食梦维持尾巴的火焰。火焰的颜色与温度，会随最近吃下的梦而改变。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME keeps its tail aflame by eating dreams. The flame changes color and temperature based on which dreams it has recently eaten.

entry: POKENAME靠食梦维持尾巴的火焰。火焰的颜色与温度，会随最近吃下的梦而改变。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME keeps its tail aflame by eating dreams. The flame changes color and temperature based on which dreams it has recently eaten.

entry: 腹部的螺旋纹用于狩猎。看见渔夫时，会游近催眠对方，引其一起潜入深水。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on its belly is used for hunting. If it sees a fisherman, it will swim close and hypnotize them into joining it in the water's depths.

entry: POKENAME敏捷机灵，时刻保持警觉。就连睡着时，也会甩尾巴、动胡须。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME is very agile and resourceful. Always alert, it flicks its tail and twitches its whiskers even in its sleep.

entry: 难以久站，因此POKENAME移动时更喜欢浮在池塘水面上。
author: .izik
source: It has trouble standing for long periods of time. Because of this, a POKENAME will prefer to float on the surface of a pond when traveling.

entry: POKENAME诞生于旋转的海沫，由有生命的海水构成。有时会将小鱼卷进体内。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A Pokémon birthed from swirling sea-foam, POKENAME are made of living salt water. Sometimes, small fish can get picked up inside them.

entry: 新长出的腿还很无力，无法奔跑，因此POKENAME的成长时期大多在水中度过。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its newly grown legs are weak and prevent it from running. As a result, POKENAME spends the majority of its formative years in the water.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么湖底的东西都吃。若摄取的营养充足，嘴巴就会呈粉红色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will consume just about anything on the lake floor. Should it have a nutritious diet, its mouth will have a pink hue.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么湖底的东西都吃。若主要吃的是垃圾，嘴巴就会呈白色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will consume just about anything on the lake floor. Should it have a diet that consists of mostly trash, its mouth will have a white hue.

entry: 身体似乎由凝胶状物质构成。每只POKENAME都有一只心爱的橡皮鸭，在身体周围漂来漂去。
author: moopse
source: It seems to be made out of a gelatinous substance. Each POKENAME has a cherished rubber ducky that floats around their body.

entry: 构成身体的黏液不断旋转，颜色会随最近吃下的食物而微微变化。
author: Staghorn
source: The slime composing its body is constantly swirling. It subtly changes color based on its most recent meal.

entry: 坚硬的下半身质地近似珊瑚。会用爪子爬上洞壁，从上方扑向猎物。
author: .izik
source: Its hard lower body is a similar consistency to coral. Its claws are used to climb cave walls and drop down on prey from above.

entry: POKENAME用核心的螺旋纹催眠对手。旋转会让它头晕，如今只能用超能力浮空。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: POKENAME uses the swirl on its core to hypnotise opponents. It now has to float using its psychic powers because spinning would make it dizzy.

entry: 即使睡觉也无法闭眼。会在湖底一站数小时，观察游泳者，准备日后捕猎。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes cannot close, even when it sleeps. It will stand on the bottom of a lake for hours, observing swimmers for later hunting.

entry: 它用双拳发电，触角末端的螺旋花纹，则用来催眠猎物。
author: char_latte3412
source: It generates electricity through its fists. The spiral patterns on the end of its antennae are used to hypnotize prey.

entry: POKENAME即使在最浑浊的水中也能看清东西，因此救援船会请它们寻找沉船残骸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are adept at seeing in even the murkiest of waters. Because of this, rescue ships use them for finding wreckage.

entry: POKENAME轻轻转动缎带，就能让对手入睡。剑刃始终油润光滑。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can gently twirl its ribbon around to put its opponent to sleep. Its blade is always slick and well-oiled.

entry: 皮肤一干燥，健康状况就会恶化。想饲养它的训练家应每隔几天替它保湿，让皮毛保持光亮健康。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its health deteriorates when its skin dries out. Prospective Trainers should moisturize them every few days to keep their coats shiny and healthy.

entry: 嘴内无尽的虚空不通往任何地方。进入者都会消失，再也不见踪影。
author: TheHeroicT
source: The endless void within its mouth leads to nowhere. Any who enter disappear, never to be seen again.

entry: 能用意念让水浮起，保持身体湿润滑溜。盯着螺旋纹看太久，会产生幻觉。
author: _deba
source: It can make water float with its mind, and uses it to keep itself wet and slippery. Staring at its spiral for too long can induce hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME经常笨手笨脚的。有时会把训练家错认成敌对宝可梦，朝对方喷水。
author: spencerrdevv
source: POKENAME are often clumsy in nature. They will sometimes confuse Trainers for rival Pokémon and begin spraying water at them.

entry: POKENAME身上的黏性物质带着电。若不专心控制电力，自己就会被电到。
author: themicelegion
source: The sticky substance on POKENAME's body is charged with electricity. If POKENAME doesn't concentrate on controlling the electricity, it shocks itself.

entry: 缎带状附肢弹性十足，让POKENAME能以音速挥拳。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The springy elasticity of its ribbon-like appendages allows POKENAME to throw punches at mach speeds.

entry: 生活在湖边，喜爱游泳。周围漂浮着看似蛋的气泡，但这只是伪装，它们其实用于防御。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This fusion lives near lakes where it likes to swim. Around it float bubbles that resemble eggs, but this is a ruse, as they are used for defense.

entry: POKENAME为爬上陆地而长出了强壮手臂，却发现陆地不适合生活。如今会用这双手臂与其他水生宝可梦决斗，发泄郁闷。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME adapted strong arms to climb up onto the land, but found it inhospitable. Now, it uses them to duel other aquatic Pokémon in frustration.

entry: 至今仍深爱着小时候的橡皮鸭。玩具若遭到丝毫损伤，POKENAME就会暴怒。
author: moopse
source: It still is deeply attached to the rubber ducky it had from when it was young. If any harm was to befall this toy, POKENAME would be sent into a rage.

entry: POKENAME受到挑衅时，能不停地吐出滚烫的气泡洪流，连巨石也能化为粉尘。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: When provoked, POKENAME is capable of spitting out a torrent of boiling bubbles without pause. These are able to reduce huge boulders to dust.

entry: POKENAME蜷缩着睡觉时，看起来就像一枚蝉蜕或虫茧。许多人把它误认成金色甲虫，打扰了它的睡眠。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME looks just like a cicada shell or cocoon when it curls up to sleep. Many have disturbed its slumber, mistaking it for a golden beetle.

entry: 日夜等待着进化。每天早晨都会瞬间移动到另一棵树上，有时离入睡的树足有数英里远。
author: .izik
source: It waits day and night for its evolution to come. Every morning it teleports itself to a new tree, sometimes miles from the one it fell asleep in.

entry: 敌人靠近巢穴时，会愤怒地瞬间移动到对方面前，打它个措手不及，趁机蜇上一下。
author: .izik
source: It angrily teleports to any enemy approaching its nest. It does this to catch its opponent off guard, allowing a surprise sting.

entry: POKENAME拿着三种属性的进化石，不知道该选哪块，只好等训练家替它决定。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME holds three elemental evolution stones, not knowing which to choose. It waits around for its Trainer to choose one for it.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴倒挂在树上，等待蜕变。受到打扰就会瞬间移动，躲到树上更高处。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME uses its tail to hang from trees while it awaits metamorphosis. If disturbed, it will teleport away and relocate higher up the tree.

entry: POKENAME生来十分聪明，却将全部脑力都花在睡觉和找吃的上。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent from birth. They devote their full brainpower to sleeping and the pursuit of food.

entry: POKENAME靠瞬间移动来往于不同环境，因此能尝遍各式各样的树果。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME uses its teleportation powers to travel between different environments. This allows it to feast on a wide variety of Berries.

entry: POKENAME生来十分聪明，却将全部脑力都花在睡觉和找吃的上。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent from birth. They devote their full brainpower to sleeping and the pursuit of food.

entry: POKENAME既能瞬间移动，又能飞行，移动的样子颇为古怪。经常迷迷糊糊地绕路、折返。
author: holgast
source: Because it can both teleport and fly, a POKENAME on the move is an odd sight. It will often meander and backtrack in confusion.

entry: 训练家常发现POKENAME睡在树上，但它始终警觉地留意周围。
author: themicelegion
source: Trainers often find POKENAME sleeping in trees. However, it is always keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME就像一小朵金色的云。它低低的“咩”声像无线电塔发出的声音，许多个体聚在一起时相当吵闹。
author: holgast
source: When at rest, POKENAME resembles a little golden cloud. Its purring 'baa' sounds like a radio tower, and many of them together are quite noisy.

entry: 一受惊就会朝随机方向瞬间移动。哪怕只是一个喷嚏，也能让它跑到下一个城镇。
author: .izik
source: It teleports itself in a random direction any time it is surprised. Even a simple sneeze could send it as far as the next town.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会用读心能力，制造出敌人最恐惧之物的幻象。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: In battle, POKENAME will use its ability to read minds to create illusions of what a foe fears the most.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME轻松地在空中瞬间移动。发达的本能让它能一边优雅滑翔，一边睡觉。
author: akujules
source: It's common to see POKENAME effortlessly teleport through the skies. Their highly developed instincts enable them to sleep while gracefully gliding.

entry: 潜藏的超能力影响了背上的大花。如今POKENAME睡觉时，花也能执行简单的警戒。
author: char_latte3412
source: This Pokémon's latent psychic abilities have affected the large flower on its back. The plant can now perform basic guard duty as POKENAME sleeps.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡18小时。打盹时会用缎带状触角缠住信赖的对象。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Sleeping for up to 18 hours a day, POKENAME will cling onto those they trust with their ribbon-like feelers as they snooze.

entry: POKENAME用超能力操纵空气中的单个电子。全身柔软蓬松的毛，让它在哪里都能打盹。
author: .realthree
source: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it nap anywhere.

entry: POKENAME用超能力操纵空气中的单个电子。全身柔软蓬松的毛，让它在哪里都能安睡。
author: .realthree
source: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it sleep anywhere.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵与超能力，让它以干扰信号闻名。有人说，它会让附近的电视显示奇怪的画面。
author: holgast
source: Its large ears and psychic ability have given POKENAME a reputation for causing signal interference. Some say it creates strange images on TVs nearby.

entry: 乍看之下，眼睛似乎永远睁得很大。仔细观察才发现，根本就没有那样的眼睛。喜欢昏暗的地方。
author: fixthewifi
source: Though at first it may appear that its eyes are permanently wide open, closer inspection reveals no such eyes to speak of. It prefers dim places.

entry: POKENAME先用超能力引来猎物，再放电攻击。若引来的宝可梦太大，就会装成沙子躲起来。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME lures prey with its psychic powers, then zaps it. If the lured Pokémon is too big, it pretends to be sand to hide.

entry: POKENAME常藏在温室中，鲜艳的体色在那里不那么显眼。受威胁便会瞬间移动，将附近的花盆弄得一团糟。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is often seen hiding in greenhouses, where its bright colours are less conspicuous. It teleports if threatened, making a mess of nearby pots.

entry: POKENAME睡着时随风飘荡，用念力避开障碍。醒来后又会给自己唱摇篮曲，哄自己继续睡。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME drifts on the breeze while it sleeps, using its telekinesis to avoid obstacles. When awake, it sings itself lullabies to go back to sleep.

entry: 亮黄色的头让它在枝叶间十分显眼。成群的POKENAME会像藤蔓般蜷绕在一起，保护自己。
author: holgast
source: Its bright yellow head makes it easy to spot amongst foliage. Whole groups of POKENAME curl up together like vines for protection.

entry: 被POKENAME践踏通常会丧命。它用庞大的超能力推着自己向前冲。
author: themicelegion
source: Getting trampled by a POKENAME is usually deadly. It propels itself forward by pushing itself with immense psychic power.

entry: POKENAME能凭意念操纵毒针攻击，造成的身体伤害很小。比起体力，它们的超能力更强。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can telepathically control their stingers to attack, dealing minimal physical damage. Their psychic powers surpass their physical strength.

entry: 随身的勺子常被咬坏，必须经常更换。会用意念抬起重物，拿到藏在下方的食物储备。
author: RoboSoup
source: The spoon it carries gets chewed up, and must be frequently replaced. It lifts heavy objects with its mind to get into food stores hidden beneath.

entry: POKENAME与孕育自己的大树有着特殊的心灵联系。据说在栎树林中，它们的力量最强。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME have a special psychic affinity with large trees from which they are born. It is believed they are most powerful when within the Ilex Forest.

entry: POKENAME与孕育自己的大树有着特殊的心灵联系。据说在栎树林中，它们的力量最强。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME have a special psychic affinity with large trees from which they are born. It is believed they are most powerful when within the Ilex Forest.

entry: 有些POKENAME会让勺子浮在空中，以免自己把它咬碎。虽然可能削弱攻击，却能锻炼精神耐力。
author: RoboSoup
source: Some POKENAME keep their spoons afloat, to avoid chewing them to pieces. This might weaken their attacks, but it does help them build mental stamina.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的铲子施展超能力，能探测周围十英里范围内的水源。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: By channeling its psychic abilities through the shovel it carries, POKENAME can detect water within a ten-mile radius of it.

entry: 胡须会分泌对人类有毒的黏液。一旦触碰，就会剧烈恶心，症状可持续长达48小时。
author: .izik
source: Its whiskers secrete a mucus that is poisonous to humans. If touched, it will cause intense nausea for up to 48 hours.

entry: POKENAME振动时发出的阿尔法波，会不由自主地使人头痛，让电子设备故障。勺子甚至能反射部分攻击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's vibrations emit alpha waves that passively induce headaches and cause malfunctions in technology. Its spoon can even reflect some attacks.

entry: 通过缎带状触角施展超能力。想养好它，就得让它好奇的头脑保持忙碌，它才会开心。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It channels its psychic abilities through its ribbon-like feelers. Prospective Trainers need to keep their curious minds busy to keep them happy.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾巴有助于积蓄静电，用于攻击。会用超能力引导电流的方向。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's fluffy tail helps it build up static electricity to use in its attacks. It uses its psychic power to direct the electricity's flow.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾巴有助于积蓄静电，用于攻击。会用超能力引导电流的方向。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's fluffy tail helps it build up static electricity to use in its attacks. It uses its psychic power to direct the electricity's flow.

entry: 双手与翅膀融为一体，因此POKENAME常直接让自己悬浮飞行。它更偏爱超能力。
author: char_latte3412
source: With both hands and wings fused into the same appendage, POKENAME will often fly by simply levitating itself. It prefers its psychic abilities.

entry: 野生POKENAME只在夜间狩猎。哪怕只被阳光照到片刻，蘑菇上的星星也会颤抖，仿佛拥有知觉。
author: .izik
source: A wild POKENAME will only hunt at night. If exposed to sunlight even for a moment, the stars on the mushroom will shiver, as if sentient.

entry: 神奥的作家会用POKENAME的尾羽做笔。据说用这种羽毛笔写出的故事，永远不会有语法错误。
author: .izik
source: Authors from Sinnoh use the tail feathers of a POKENAME as quills. It is said that a story written with one will always be free of grammar problems.

entry: POKENAME用强韧的藤蔓握着两把勺子。勺上涂有特殊毒素，会让敌人病得很重。
author: Cipher
source: POKENAME holds a pair of spoons in the grips of its strong vines. The spoons are coated with a special poison that can make its foe extremely ill.

entry: 大脑过度发育，让头变得又大又圆。滚动时会用超能力将自己抬离地面。
author: Soup1900
source: Its brain has gotten so big that its head has become large and round. When rolling about, it uses its psychic powers to lift itself off the ground.

entry: 会抛接勺子与骨头占卜未来。若骨头落地，就预示着美好的前景。
author: .izik
source: It divines the future by juggling its spoons and bones. Should the bones drop, it indicates the foreseeing of a favorable future.

entry: 野生POKENAME每天至少冥想5小时。若被打扰，就会勃然大怒，冲向附近的任何人。
author: .izik
source: In the wild, a POKENAME will meditate for a minimum of 5 hours per day. Should it be disturbed, it will fly into a rage, charging at anyone nearby.

entry: 关都的物理治疗师会请POKENAME帮助伤患。它能催眠患者，帮助对方忍痛完成康复训练。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are used by physical therapists in Kanto to help patients deal with injuries. Their abilities hypnotize patients into working through pain.

entry: POKENAME成群聚集时，除了振翅声，不发出一丝声响。此时会通过心灵感应交流。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME gather in swarms, where they make not a single noise save for the flapping of their wings. In that moment, they communicate via telepathy.

entry: POKENAME天生能心灵感应，会与同类沟通，一起寻找森林地表的食物。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Born with telepathic abilities, POKENAME will communicate with others of its kind to try to locate food sources on the forest floor.

entry: 会唱悲伤的摇篮曲，悼念海上罹难者。歌唱时若遭打扰，就会令气温降到远低于冰点。
author: .izik
source: It sings a sorrowful lullaby to mourn those lost at sea. If disturbed during its song, it will chill the air well below freezing.

entry: 聪明过了头，模仿时经常矫枉过正，反倒让动作显得僵硬不自然。
author: .izik
source: Due to its high intelligence, it often over-compensates during its mimicry. This leads to its movements being unnatural and rigid.

entry: 晚白柚岛的居民最近正苦恼，成群POKENAME在海蚀洞中筑巢。它们为何而来仍不清楚。
author: .izik
source: The citizens on Tarroco Island recently had to deal with flocks of POKENAME making nests in their sea caves. The reason for their arrival is unknown.

entry: POKENAME头上帽状的突起下，藏着一只较小的宝可梦。它控制着POKENAME的一切行动。
author: themicelegion
source: There is a smaller Pokémon underneath the hat-like growth on POKENAME's head. This other Pokémon controls all of POKENAME's actions.

entry: 背上的花苞开始绽放，届时会释放病毒毒素，再用超能力勺子将其引向敌人。
author: Cipher
source: The flower bud on its back has begun to blossom. When it does, it will release a viral toxin that will be directed at foes with its psychic spoons.

entry: 使用超能力时，身体上巨大的紫色晶体会明亮发光。睡觉时也会稍稍浮离地面。
author: .izik
source: The large purple crystals on its body glow brightly when it is using its psychic abilities. While it sleeps, it levitates slightly off the ground.

entry: 失去翅膀后，POKENAME会用超能力磨利金属片，制成新的翅膀，也能当作飞射的武器。
author: mx_wellman
source: Having lost its wings, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hone blades of metal. It makes itself new wings out of these that double as projectiles.

entry: 似乎很喜欢管乐器。双簧管或长笛奏起舒缓旋律时，它就会跳舞，并用超能力波动安抚大家。
author: .izik
source: It seems to respond favorably to wind instruments. When a slow melody is played on the oboe or flute, it dances and calms others with psychic waves.

entry: POKENAME常用有趣的方式挥勺舀食、吃东西，博取同伴的赞赏。勺子可以自行浮空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently scoop and eat things with their spoons in interesting ways to impress others of their group. The spoons can float on their own.

entry: 勺子上的红宝石让POKENAME的超能力增强十倍。宝石若开裂，它就会陷入极度的精神痛苦。
author: .izik
source: The red gem on its spoon augments its psychic powers tenfold. Should the gem crack, the POKENAME will express extreme mental distress.

entry: 能凭奇异的力量，用意念操纵电流。只需一个念头，就能造成大范围停电。
author: .izik
source: Using its strange powers, it can manipulate electricity with its mind. With this ability, it can cause widespread blackouts with a thought.

entry: POKENAME处理信息的速度比训练家更快，能用念力完成极为精准的动作，攻击敌人。
author: therider
source: Able to process information at a higher rate than its Trainer, POKENAME use its telekinesis to perform extremely precise maneuvers and strike at foes.

entry: 手臂上的勺子和背上的球体由奇异的金属构成，能在战斗中增强它的超能力。
author: striker212
source: The spoons on its arms and the orbs on its back are comprised of a strange metal. This metal amplifies its psychic power in battles.

entry: POKENAME会以爪子引导超能力，将敌人抬到空中，再像演奏特雷门琴一样挥动手指，用念力将其碾碎。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME uses its claws to raise foes into the air with psychic power, then psychically crushes them by waving its fingers, like playing a theremin.

entry: 虽然智商很高，却懒得变色，甚至懒得走路。不过有需要时，POKENAME可以彻底隐身。
author: T.I.A.
source: Despite its high IQ, this Pokémon is too lazy to change its colors or even walk. POKENAME, however, can become completely invisible if needed.

entry: 胡地与巨金怪的组合，是有史以来最聪明的生命。问它任何问题，都能得到完全准确的答案。
author: typhloquil
source: A combination of Alakazam and Metagross, it is the smartest being ever created. Ask it a question, and it'll answer with perfect accuracy.

entry: 体内流出的能量太过强大，竟凝成了一副独立的实体，连它的波导也随之成倍增强。
author: mrbapcik
source: The energy flowing from its body is so intense that it has materialized into a separate physical form. Its aura has grown exponentially as a result.

entry: 胡地的念力与路卡利欧的波导融合，让POKENAME的灵魂也有了实体。野生POKENAME只要不受挑衅，便不会主动攻击。
author: Hypersonic06
source: The fusion of Alakazam's telekinesis and Lucario's aura lead to POKENAME's very soul gaining a physical form. Wild POKENAME do not attack unprovoked.

entry: 巨大的花会将阳光转化为超能力。POKENAME会用勺子将蕴含超能力的甜花蜜喂给喜欢的对象。
author: milchik
source: Its huge flower transforms the sunlight into its psychic powers. POKENAME feeds its sweet, psychic-powered nectar to anyone it likes with its spoons.

entry: POKENAME借勺子与惊人的超能力，操纵背上花朵释放的特殊毒素，使作物枯萎、空气污浊。
author: Cipher
source: Using its spoons and incredible psionic energy, POKENAME withers crops and pollutes the air with a special toxin released from the flower on its back.

entry: 性情平和，以青草与树果为食，茁壮成长，宛如自然界宁静而睿智的守护者。
author: anarchaz
source: This tranquil creature thrives on a diet of grass and Berries, embodying a serene, wise guardian of the natural world.

entry: 会挖进地下，将自己埋好休息。每天早晨用超能力判断外面是否安全，再决定要不要出来。
author: .izik
source: It digs into the ground and buries itself to rest. It uses its psychic abilities to tell if it is safe to emerge each morning.

entry: POKENAME生来便知道过去与未来的所有灾难，被称为“末日的预兆”。
author: Moginar
source: POKENAME are born with knowledge of every catastrophe, past and future. They are known as the Harbingers of Doom.

entry: POKENAME警惕心强，又不愿沟通，因此无法测出智商。不过，小小的身体已展现出高超的超能力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's defensive attitude and lack of communication means its IQ can't be tested, but it displays psychic mastery with its diminutive form.

entry: 圆润的餐具内，蕴含着人类无法理解的智慧。简单的形态让POKENAME能完全专注于自己的能力。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Within this rounded cutlery lies intelligence unfathomable to the human mind. Its simple form allows POKENAME to focus completely on its powers.

entry: 会寻找银矿，啃食矿壁里的矿石。据说冬迎镇附近许多古老的隧道都是POKENAME挖出来的。
author: .izik
source: It seeks out silver mines to consume the ore within the walls. Many old tunnels near Wintown are said to be carved by POKENAME.

entry: 凭借读心能力，能完美模仿一个人的家人。有些冒充行为甚至持续了多年。
author: .izik
source: With its ability to read minds, it will perfectly mimic members of a person's family. There have been cases where the impersonation last years.

entry: 记忆力超群，连出生时的事都记得。执行任务归来的士兵发现，POKENAME依然认得自己。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its superb memory lets it remember all the way up to its birth. Soldiers who have been deployed have returned to find that POKENAME remembers them.

entry: 将全部能量用于维持大脑，导致肌肉与骨骼萎缩。外形虽吓人，却经不起攻击。
author: holgast
source: It has concentrated all of its energy into maintaining its brain, atrophying its muscle and bone. Despite its menacing form, it crumples to attacks.

entry: 有理论认为，它快速弯曲又复原勺子，是在向传说中的固拉多与盖欧卡发送信号。
author: VaporVenator
source: It is theorized that the rapid bending and reformation of its spoons send signals to the legendary Groudon and Kyogre.

entry: 会主动进入村落，寻找最聪明的居民。找到后便试图用网将其缠住拖走。
author: .izik
source: It actively goes into villages to search for the most intelligent citizen. Once found, it will attempt to entangle them in a web and drag them away.

entry: 能够预知不幸何时发生。大到死亡，小到踢痛脚趾，都在其感知范围内。
author: .izik
source: Using its abilities, it can detect when misfortunes will occur. These misfortunes can range from death to a stubbed toe.

entry: POKENAME溢出的超能力过多，需要第三把勺子来疏导。可惜没有多余的肢体，只好另想办法。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME gives off so much excess psychic energy that a third spoon is required to act as a conduit. With no extra limbs, it was forced to improvise.

entry: 柑橘岛最近出土的古代石板上，描绘了POKENAME为聚落守望的形象。它们曾用能力保护平民。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets recently uncovered on Pummelo Island depict POKENAME as sentinels for settlements. Their abilities were used to protect civilians.

entry: 能用意念操纵火焰。控火本领极高，只需想一想敌人，就能令对方燃烧起来。
author: .izik
source: It can use its mind to control flames. With its mastery of pyrokinesis, it can light enemies on fire by just thinking about them.

entry: 会用读心能力找出对手讨厌的歌。战斗时反复唱这首歌，嘲弄对方。
author: .izik
source: It uses its ability to read minds to find a song the opponent dislikes. During combat, it will sing the song repeatedly to taunt its foe.

entry: 摆动胡须催眠敌人，令其入睡。随后用超能力吸取对方的生命精华。
author: .izik
source: It wiggles its mustache to hypnotize its foe into falling asleep. Once they are asleep, it psychically consumes their life essence.

entry: 领地意识极强，会用超能力引发大规模雪崩，吓退闯入者。
author: .izik
source: They are very defensive of their territory. Using their psychic abilities they cause massive avalanches to deter trespassers.

entry: 在山间飘浮时会轻声哼唱。勺子舀起的雪都会变成冰淇淋。
author: .izik
source: It hums while floating through the mountains. Any snow scooped with its spoon will turn into ice cream.

entry: 神奥的药剂师会使用POKENAME头顶散出的花粉。这是要害攻击补剂中的有效成分。
author: .izik
source: The pollen that comes out of the top of a POKENAME is used by apothecaries in Sinnoh.  This is an active ingredient in Dire Hit supplements.

entry: 会发出超能力尖啸，使猎物动弹不得。攻击时挥舞大勺，以此为媒介集中并施展力量。
author: .izik
source: It lets out a psychic scream to immobilize prey. It waves its large spoon while attacking, using it as a focus to channel its powers.

entry: 布罗镇的裁缝会用它身上的绒毛制作高档裙装，缀以宝石后高价出售。
author: .izik
source: The fluff on its body is used by tailors in Bonitaville to create designer skirts. These skirts are adorned with gemstones and sold for a high price.

entry: 像指挥飞行编队一样操纵勺子。勺子包围敌人，让超能力与声波攻击反复回响，威力增强。
author: PokePower
source: It directs its spoons like a flying squadron. They surround foes, allowing psychic and sonic attacks to reverberate and intensify.

entry: 飞行时会旋转俯冲，向观众展示本领。还能用超能力判断，喝彩究竟是敷衍还是真心。
author: .izik
source: It spins and dives while flying to impress those watching it. It uses its psychic abilities to tell if their cheers are patronizing or genuine.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇曾被用于多种改善视力的药膏。直到毒性被发现，人们才停止使用。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on a POKENAME were once used in many different poultices that improved eyesight. This concluded when its toxicity was uncovered.

entry: 吸入POKENAME翅膀洒下的粉尘，会让人以为自己是个孩子。不过，对真正的孩子没有效果。
author: .izik
source: Inhaling the dust that comes off of a POKENAME's wings will cause a person to believe they are a child. The dust has no effect on actual children.

entry: POKENAME越年长越聪明。智商每升一点，勺子就弯一度，因此勺子弯得越厉害，就越睿智。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A POKENAME becomes wiser with age, bending its spoon by one degree for every IQ point gained. An extremely bent spoon indicates a very wise POKENAME.

entry: 随身的勺子由纯银制成。每晚都会仔细擦洗，保持光亮。
author: .izik
source: The spoon it carries is made from pure silver. It meticulously cleans the spoon nightly to prolong the shine.

entry: POKENAME已达到智慧的顶峰。有理论认为，它能仅靠纯粹的超能力存活极漫长的时间。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Having achieved the highest wisdom, POKENAME is theorized to be capable of living for incredibly long periods of time off of pure psychic energy.

entry: 冥想时，它的心灵能穿透时间。力量之强，足以看见300年前的往事。
author: .izik
source: Its mind can see through time when it is meditating. Its powers are so great that it can view up to 300 years into the past.

entry: POKENAME的超能力已臻巅峰。它展现的神迹，令见者既敬且惧。
author: Cipher
source: Having achieved the height of its psionic abilities, POKENAME is capable of feats of psychic prowess that both awe and terrify those who witness them.

entry: 害怕被人品头论足，因此偷偷锻炼。若有人撞见，除非夸奖它，否则就会被抹去记忆。
author: .izik
source: It trains in secret due to its fear of judgmental stares. Should anyone see it exercising, it will wipe their memory unless they offer a compliment.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力，让拳力增强十倍。它从不摆出防守架势，而是凭超感知，预判来袭的攻击。
author: zedsmith64
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to power up its punches tenfold. It never guards, instead opting to use ESP to anticipate attacks.

entry: 能用超能力将团团酸液掷向敌人。酸液若溅到自己身上，一个念头就能治好伤口。
author: .izik
source: Using its psychic abilities, it can hurl globs of acid at its foes. Should the acid spill on its own body, it can mend its own wounds with a thought.

entry: 城都的占卜师会用POKENAME身上掉落的石头，预测一段感情能持续多久。石头若发蓝光，就是好兆头。
author: .izik
source: Rocks that fall off of a POKENAME are utilized by oracles in Johto to predict a relationship's longevity. It is a good sign if the stones glow blue.

entry: 超能力与结实的身体让它能吸收并反射冲击，出色的记忆力则帮助它在地下辨认方向。
author: MisterShaokahn
source: Its psychic powers and sturdy body let it absorb and reflect shocks, while its exceptional memory helps it navigate underground.

entry: 在山谷间奔跑时，会用念力抓住生物。眼睛一亮，被抓住的猎物就会突然燃烧。
author: .izik
source: Using its telekinetic abilities, it grabs creatures while it runs through valleys. When its eyes glow, it spontaneously combusts the captured prey.

entry: 既非勺子，也非棍子。这种融合体的工具究竟有什么用途，无数科学家研究过，却都一无所获。
author: funkytomate
source: Neither a spoon, nor a stick. The question of what this fusion's tool is used for has been explored by countless scientists, but with no results.

entry: POKENAME有惊人的念力与超能力，可战斗时还是更喜欢用锤子。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It has incredible telekinetic and psychic abilities. Despite this, POKENAME would much rather use its hammer in combat.

entry: 所谓超能力，其实是强大而经过变化的电磁力。凭此能轻松移动并扭曲金属物体。
author: holgast
source: Its supposed psychic ability is actually powerful, modified electromagnetism. It uses this ability to move and contort metal objects with ease.

entry: 能用超能力抬起身体飞行，速度远远超过大多数陆地交通工具。
author: .izik
source: It can achieve flight by lifting its own body with it psychic abilities. While doing this it moves at speeds well beyond most land vehicles.

entry: POKENAME精通念力，能借手中的勺子随心操纵水。遇险时会缩进坚固的壳里。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME's mastery of telekinesis allows it to manipulate water at will with the spoons it holds. If in danger, it retreats into its mighty shell.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在新坟的阴影中，等待悲伤的训练家前来，再夺走对方与逝去宝可梦的美好回忆，以此取乐。
author: fivetailedfurret
