source: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of fresh graves. It waits for a grieving Trainer and whisks away their happy memories of the dead Pokémon for sport.

entry: POKENAME的超能力强大到能使人失忆，因此很难开展研究。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME's psychic powers are so strong it can cause memory loss. Because of this, it's very difficult to study.

entry: 力量很大，头脑却不太灵光。会毫不犹豫地撞向大型宝可梦，即使对方能瞬间将它打倒也一样。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It is very strong but largely unintelligent. It will ram into large Pokémon without thinking twice—even those that could topple it in a heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直在锻炼，却依旧没多少肌肉。会把自己举得动的最大隆隆石融合体放进育儿袋，自豪地展示。
author: The_Fireplace
source: Despite its near-constant training, POKENAME lacks significant muscle mass. It proudly shows off the largest Graveler fusion it can lift in its pouch.

entry: 谦逊又乐于助人，会加入森林里的宝可梦群落，只为帮助大家处理日常事务。
author: themicelegion
source: This humble Pokémon loves to be helpful. They join Pokémon communities in the forest just to help others with their day to day lives.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤十分耐得住烈日的热量，因此常在沙漠附近参与建筑工作。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME are used for construction work near desert areas. This is because their skin is very resistant to the sun's heat.

entry: 肌肉发达，常在冰冻苔原上组成拉雪橇的队伍。相互交缠的缎带让它们联系紧密。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: These muscular Pokémon are often used in frozen tundras as a sled team. Interlocking their ribbons allows these Pokémon to form a tight bond.

entry: 个头虽小，力量却极大。头顶能扛起一只隆隆石，瞄准后的一脚能将小拳石踢飞。
author: synaesthesis
source: Very powerful despite its small size. It can carry the weight of a Graveler atop its head, and can send a Geodude flying with a well-aimed kick.

entry: POKENAME不断举重，连练习催眠时也不例外。最艰苦的锻炼开始前，会先冥想来集中精神，改善表现。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME constantly lifts weights- even when practicing hypnosis. It meditates before its toughest workouts to increase focus and performance.

entry: POKENAME大吃一顿30,000卡路里的食物后，会睡上很久。醒来便继续整日的相扑训练。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME devours a 30,000 calorie diet before taking a long nap. When it wakes up, it resumes its day-long sumo training.

entry: POKENAME轻轻松松就能举起15吨以上的东西，因此许多摔跤手会在赛前与它一同训练。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME can lift over 15 tons with very little effort. Because of this, many wrestlers will train with one before competing.

entry: POKENAME能轻松搬运重物，因此常参与建筑工作。工作能锻炼身体，它们很喜欢。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME are often used in construction for their ability to carry heavy objects with ease. They enjoy the work due to the exercise they get from it.

entry: POKENAME看起来总在建造东西，却从未发现过它造出的建筑。
author: ValtsuRi
source: POKENAME always appears to be making something. However, no structures made by this Pokémon have been found.

entry: POKENAME锻炼时只练上半身，不练腿。若能均衡锻炼，就会势不可挡。
author: knilk
source: POKENAME's workout regimen neglects its legs, only exercising its upper body. If it were to use a more balanced approach, it'd become unstoppable.

entry: 头上的三片鳍坚如钢铁，触之有毒。用双脚就能轻松放倒相扑选手。
author: synaesthesis
source: Its three cranial fins are as hard as steel and poisonous to the touch. It can easily topple a sumo wrestler with its feet.

entry: 巡护员学院会请POKENAME帮助学员练习应对穿着熊的袭击。它能收住力道，完全不伤到人。
author: char_latte3412
source: Ranger academies use POKENAME to train members in handling Bewear attacks. Importantly, it's capable of restraining itself from inflicting any harm.

entry: 会先用强壮的手臂攻击，再躲进像大内裤一样的东西下面。那其实只是蘑菇，却带着一种独特的气味。
author: RoboSoup
source: It attacks with powerful arms, then appears to hide under huge underpants. This is really just a mushroom, but it bears a distinctive odor.

entry: 摆脱腰带束缚后，POKENAME的力量不断脉动，能量声清晰可闻。常常只要绷起肌肉就能战斗，身体都不用移动。
author: cyprexx
source: Unrestrained by its belt, POKENAME's power level audibly pulsates with energy. It often fights just by flexing, not even needing to move its body.

entry: 三颗头不断互相头槌，锻炼战斗本领。中间的头会操纵另外两个头，对敌人拳打啃咬。
author: Skymaster426
source: The three heads constantly headbutt one another to train for battle. The middle head uses the other two to punch and bite at opponents.

entry: POKENAME严格遵守锻炼与冥想的日程。闲暇时会热心帮助需要干体力活的训练家。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME adheres to a disciplined workout and meditation schedule. In its time off, it eagerly helps Trainers who are in need of physical labor.

entry: POKENAME常被当成宝可梦中的巨汉，实际却相当弱。可看见这位满身肌肉的“宝可猛男”，大多数训练家还是忍不住打哆嗦。
author: trakito
source: Often considered a titan among Pokémon, POKENAME is actually fairly weak. Despite this, most Trainers shiver at the sight of this swole "Pokéchad".

entry: 凭借九只肌肉发达的手臂，能摔倒体形三倍于自己的敌人。激战时，胸口的水晶会发光。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: With its nine incredibly muscular arms, it can wrestle down foes three times its size. The crystal in its chest glows in heated combat.

entry: POKENAME先用超能力将敌人强拉近身，再以多组强壮手臂痛击对方。十分自豪于宝石的光泽。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME forces its foes close with psychic powers, and then pummels them with multiple sets of powerful arms. It has pride in the sheen of its jewel.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，能承受极重的负荷。反应迅速，轻松就能躲开大多数攻击。
author: rigelpogi08
source: POKENAME's legs are strong enough to support extremely heavy loads. It has quick reflexes and can dodge most attacks with ease.

entry: POKENAME是意念与体术对决的佼佼者。施展武术的同时爆发超能力，扰乱对手的方向感。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME is the champion of mental and physical duels. It complements its martial attacks with bursts of psychic energy that disorient its opponent.

entry: POKENAME平时多用六肢行走，面对强敌时则以后腿站起，用强壮的手臂战斗。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Though it's usually seen walking on all sixes, POKENAME will stand on its hind legs and use its powerful arms to fight against tough opponents.

entry: 别看POKENAME个头不大，力量却十分惊人。小锤子一挥，就足以砸碎骨头。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. Swings from their small hammer are powerful enough to shatter bone.

entry: POKENAME一睡就是数天，为竞技对决积蓄能量。打击的威力足以震动整片森林。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME sleeps for days at a time to conserve its energy for competitive bouts. The force of its blows can rattle the whole forest.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成灯神，却不会替人实现愿望。谁若向它许愿，就会被揍一顿，随后它便消失。
author: JokersWild
source: Though they're often mistaken for genies, POKENAME will not grant you wishes. If you try to ask for a wish, it will beat you up and then disappear.

entry: POKENAME的重拳与强劲的鞭击威力惊人，被称为“海中最强的人鱼”。
author: themicelegion
source: Between its hard hitting punches and its strong whip-like attacks, POKENAME is extremely powerful. People call it "The strongest merman of the sea".

entry: POKENAME缎带上肌肉的力量，是本已强健的双腿的两倍以上。一拳便能打碎钻石。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The muscles on the ribbons of POKENAME are over twice the strength of its already powerful legs. A single punch from POKENAME can shatter diamonds.

entry: 庞大的体形下还藏着更惊人的力量。只要有机会，POKENAME能举起整个世界的重量。
author: TheEmeraldFlygon
source: Its colossal size harbors even greater strength. Were it given the opportunity, POKENAME could lift the weight of the entire world.

entry: 战斗时，每次撞击的冲击波都会震动方圆数英里的地区。有些道场已经禁止这个巨人进入。
author: rihse
source: When one is fighting, the shockwaves from its impacts shake the surrounding area for miles. Some dojos have banned this giant from their premises.

entry: POKENAME虽然温顺，却容易受惊。训练家最好别吓它，以免挨上那对肌肉发达的耳朵一记重击。
author: watergin
source: Despite being docile, POKENAME are easily startled. Trainers should avoid surprising it, lest they end up on the wrong side of its muscular ears.

entry: 十分讨喜，喜欢与人相处。可别大意，身体虽小，一拳的威力却惊人。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: A very endearing fusion that loves spending time with people. Be careful, because despite its tiny body, it packs a tremendous punch.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中锻炼，等待对手。唯一比巨颚更有威力的，是它无休止的连拳。
author: bunkachunka
source: POKENAME trains in the desert as it waits for an opponent to fight. The only thing more powerful than its jaws is its endless flurry of punches.

entry: POKENAME用破防的拳击与手刀，有策略地削弱对手的体力和士气。人气甚至可与皇家蒙面人匹敌。
author: A-WildCard
source: POKENAME uses guard-breaking punches and chops to tactically lower the stamina and morale of opponents. Its popularity rivals even the Masked Royal.

entry: 在POKENAME栖息的海滩要格外小心。不慎踩到它，就会被一拳打到地平线之外。
author: theradrad
source: Take care on beaches that are home to POKENAME. If you accidentally step on POKENAME, it will send you clear over the horizon with one punch.

entry: 会在最意想不到的时候来到这个世界，通常是为了保护人类免受敌对的传说宝可梦侵袭。形体不定却强大，而且始终谦逊。
author: cyprexx
source: It comes to this world when least expected, usually to protect humanity from hostile legendary Pokémon. It's amorphous but strong, and always modest.

entry: 精通各类武术。利用娇小的体形近身作战，施展带毒的刺拳。
author: synaesthesis
source: This Pokémon is trained in every form of martial arts. It takes advantage of its small size to deliver poisonous jabs in close combat.

entry: 四只强壮手臂能打出势不可挡的重击，即使在地下也不例外。会精细地翻耕土壤，留下肥沃的土地。
author: anarchaz
source: Its four powerful arms deliver unstoppable blows, even underground. It tills soil with precision, leaving fertile ground in its wake.

entry: 曾有人看见POKENAME用毒液覆满大型船只。播放音乐能使它平静下来，跟着节拍拍手。
author: LarryLoud55
source: POKENAME has been seen covering large ships in poison. It is calmed when music is played, as it claps along to the beat.

entry: 背上的嫩芽与本体感官相通，会朝威胁喷出一股毒孢子。本体休息时，嫩芽仍会不知疲倦地保护它。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The sprout on its back shares the main body's senses, firing a stream of toxic spores at threats. When it rests, the sprout will defend it tirelessly.

entry: 它会把身体深深埋进土里吸收养分。吸收得越多，球茎就长得越大。
author: .izik
source: It will burrow its body deep in the soil to absorb nutrients. The more nutrients it takes in, the larger its bulb will grow.

entry: 喜欢在空心倒木中休息。进入后会伸出根须吸收养分，用来加固外壳。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to rest in hollow logs. Once inside, it extends its roots to absorb nutrients, which it uses to harden its shell.

entry: POKENAME偏爱远距离战斗。感到受威胁时，会从嘴里向靠近者发射豌豆。
author: napstabl0ok
source: POKENAME prefers to fight from a distance. When it feels threatened, it shoots peas from its mouth at whoever approaches it.

entry: POKENAME的枝条交错成网，生长方式能将毒液导向致命的尖刺。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME grows its lattice of branches in a way that channels its poison to its deadly thorns.

entry: 找到菜地后，会将根扎进附近的土中，向土壤输送养分，帮助作物生长。
author: .izik
source: It locates vegetable fields and burrows its roots into the ground nearby. It then injects nutrients into the soil to help crop growth.

entry: 吃饱后，POKENAME会攀在树上悬挂数天，性情十分温顺，对周围的一切浑然不觉。
author: .izik
source: After it eats, POKENAME will attach itself to a tree and hang there for days, completely docile and unaware of its surroundings.

entry: 会往自己认定的领地上吐黄色花蜜。花蜜极为黏稠，气味难闻。
author: .izik
source: It spits a yellow nectar on the ground in areas that it claims as its territory. The nectar is incredibly viscous and foul scented.

entry: 覆盖身体的藤蔓经常干枯脱落。许多药物会用这些藤蔓为伤处消炎。
author: .izik
source: The vines that cover its body will frequently dry out and fall off. Many medications use these vines as an anti-inflammatory for injuries.

entry: POKENAME生活在大片珊瑚礁中，嘴能产生强大吸力，将从上方游过的一切直接吸入。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.

entry: POKENAME生活在大片珊瑚礁中，嘴能产生强大吸力，将从上方游过的一切直接吸入。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.

entry: POKENAME缓慢地爬过水底，用嘴吸入附近的小型宝可梦。在水中与陆地上都能生存。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME crawls slowly across the bottom and sucks up small, nearby Pokémon with its mouth. It can survive in water as well as on land.

entry: 身体长出的根十分坚韧。POKENAME一旦在某处扎根，就会边睡觉边吸收养分。
author: .izik
source: The roots that grow from its body are extremely durable. Should a POKENAME take root at a location, it will sleep there while it absorbs nutrients.

entry: POKENAME嘴里渗出的液体能溶解铁，却溶解不了组成自身剑刃的铁。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME leaks a fluid from its mouth that can melt iron, though the iron that makes up its blade won't melt.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓缠住猎物，将其拖进满是腐蚀液的嘴里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When capturing prey, POKENAME will wrap its vines around them and pull them into its mouth, which contains a corrosive fluid.

entry: POKENAME身体纤细柔韧，能轻松躲避攻击。会从头部与双手向敌人发射植物弹丸。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: A POKENAME's thin and flexible body lets it easily evade attacks. They use their head and hands to shoot plant projectiles at enemies.

entry: 静坐在森林中，一动不动，慢慢腐朽。一旦行动，就会释放无与伦比的自然之力。
author: themicelegion
source: This special Pokémon sits unmoving in a forest as it slowly decays. When it does move, it releases unrivaled natural might.

entry: 用细韧的手臂将身体固定在不稳的地形上。人们见过它攀在悬崖、高树，甚至大型草属性宝可梦身上。
author: Staghprn
source: It uses its wiry arms to anchor itself in uncertain terrain. They have been found clinging to cliffs, tall trees, and even large Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: 近几个月，神秘猫之岛上出现了少量POKENAME。它们用根部促进植被旺盛生长。
author: .izik
source: Within the last few months, a small number of POKENAME have appeared on Golden Island. Using their roots, they promote vital vegetation growth.

entry: POKENAME腿虽细，力量却惊人。喝下树汁后，双腿会更强健，让它跑得飞快。
author: typhloquil
source: While POKENAME's legs are thin, they pack incredible strength. When it eats sap, its legs grown even stronger, allowing it to run at fierce speeds.

entry: POKENAME弯曲身体，让几个头之间能来回输送养分。农民会任由它们的藤蔓生长，保护花园围墙。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's body bends to allow its heads to pass nutrients back and forth. Farmers allow vines of these Pokémon to grow to defend their garden walls.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: POKENAME用嘴产生吸力，如黑洞般吞入周围一切。谁也不知道吞下的东西最终去了哪里。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can create suction with its mouth to pull everything surrounding it in like a black hole. No one knows where the consumed material ends up.

entry: 背上形成了一个种子般的泡泡。下雨时会吸收雨滴，让泡泡长大。
author: Soup1900
source: It formed a bubble on its back that looks similar to a seed. When it rains, it will soak up the raindrops to grow the bubble.

entry: POKENAME一看到飞行属性宝可梦，就会缩进壳里。会不停地吃藻类，丝毫没有停下的打算。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it spots any Flying-type Pokémon. It will endlessly eat algae, with no intention of stopping.

entry: POKENAME在生日派对上很受欢迎。可以像沙滩球一样被拍来拍去，还会一边吹泡泡，而弹跳又有助于吹出更多泡泡。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually loved at birthday parties. It can be bounced around like a beach ball while blowing bubbles, which helps it create more.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都能喷出细雾，因此是关都园丁们十分珍视的好伙伴。
author: char_latte3412
source: An exceptional partner amongst Kantonian gardeners, POKENAME is highly valued for its ability to generate a fine mist with each flap of its wings.

entry: 沿岸滑行时，硬壳会保护柔软的身体，抵御飞行宝可梦。若被翻个底朝天，就会在阳光下融化。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: As it slithers along the shore, its tough shell shields its squishy body from flying Pokémon. If turned onto its back, it melts away in the sun.

entry: 这些凶猛的宝可梦常在海岸附近吵吵闹闹地成群聚集，俯冲撕咬，吓唬海滩游客。
author: cyberleviathan
source: These vicious Pokémon often form rowdy flocks near coasts. They terrorize beachgoers by swooping down and delivering brutal bites.

entry: 友善的POKENAME曾大量生活在隐秘的池塘中。可偷猎者贪图它们头上的壳，几乎将其猎杀殆尽。
author: cyberleviathan
source: Friendly POKENAME were once abundant in hidden ponds. Unfortunately, poachers hunted them to near extinction for the shells on their heads.

entry: 许多度假村会在泳池边饲养POKENAME。它舒缓的声音能消解客人的忧虑，自己也很乐意下水玩。
author: char_latte3412
source: Many resorts will keep POKENAME around their pools. Its soothing voice helps ease patrons' worries, and it is more than happy to wade in the water.

entry: POKENAME性情随和，喜欢在海风中随浪漂流。
author: volvonovic
source: An easygoing Pokémon, POKENAME enjoys floating across the ocean waves in the sea breeze.

entry: 背上的泡泡不知为何长成了花苞。即使将新长的叶子完全浸入水中，也不会将其淹死。
author: Soup1900
source: The bubble on its back has somehow grown into a bud. It is able to fully submerge the leaves it grew without drowning them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢随着热闹的嘉年华音乐起舞。头上的壳能保护耳朵。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME loves to dance to loud carnival music. The shells on its head keep its ears safe.

entry: POKENAME能在壳状的脸颊中储存空气，长时间待在水下，甚至能潜着睡觉。
author: T.I.A.
source: POKENAME can store air in their shell-like cheeks, allowing them to survive for long periods underwater. They can even sleep while submerged.

entry: 为支撑沉重的壳，POKENAME的后腿变得强健。慢悠悠的性情让它很受老人欢迎。
author: Shocktopus
source: To support its heavy shell, POKENAME's back legs have toughened. Its slow demeanor makes it quite popular among the elderly.

entry: POKENAME常睡在浅池与河流里。熟睡时，其他野生宝可梦会来吃它背上的植物。
author: kandyman
source: POKENAME can often be found sleeping in shallow ponds and rivers. As it slumbers, other wild Pokémon come to feed off the plant on its back.

entry: POKENAME被认为十分可爱。不过，训练家仍要小心，因为它还不懂得控制自己的力量。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME is considered a very cute Pokémon. However, Trainers should be cautious, as it doesn't know its own strength yet.

entry: POKENAME是一把贪玩的剑。剑刃由静止却未冻结的水构成，还能将水化作水柱射出。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a playful sword with a blade made of still but unfrozen water which it shoots out in streams.

entry: 坚硬的壳让POKENAME能借水流迅速前进。想减速时，就会将缎带卷起来。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The hardened shell of POKENAME allows currents to propel this Pokémon at vast speeds. It slows itself down in water by coiling its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在花园与花田上方，细心浇灌目之所及的每株植物。植物枯死，会让它十分难过。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME floats over gardens and flower fields, carefully watering every plant in sight. A dead plant causes great sadness in this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽然害羞，却能与训练家建立深厚羁绊。有种迷信认为，摸摸它的六条尾巴就会带来好运。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is shy, but can form a deep bond with its Trainer. There is a superstition that touching its six tails brings good luck.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时，会竖起并蓬松所有尾巴，威吓对手。趁对方分神，通常就会逃走。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: When POKENAME is attacked, it raises its many tails and puffs them up to intimidate its opponent. If the opponent is distracted, it usually flees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在浅滩自保。若被踩到，便会张开大嘴，喷出强劲水流反击。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME like to hide on shallow beaches for protection. If stepped on, they will retaliate with a large blast of water from their gaping maw.

entry: 尾巴上的泡泡映出了生命的脆弱。泡泡一破，它就会立刻死去。
author: Soup1900
source: The bubble on its tail shows the fragility of its life. Popping this bubble will kill it instantly.

entry: POKENAME背上的突起是共生的三叶虫。它们汲取本体养分，同时提供额外防护，抵御捕食者。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The growths on POKENAME's back are symbiotic trilobites which feed on its nutrients in exchange for added defense from predators.

entry: 尾巴上的泡泡已变得不易破裂。手指能射出滚烫气泡，碰到皮肤就会严重灼伤。
author: Soup1900
source: The bubble on its tail has grown resistant to popping. It fires scorching hot bubbles from its fingers that badly singe the skin on contact.

entry: 驯养的POKENAME最爱与训练家一起泡温泉放松。滚烫的壳还能当作临时烧烤架。
author: kandyman
source: Domesticated POKENAME enjoy nothing more than relaxing in a hot spring with its Trainer. Its scorching shell can also double as a makeshift barbecue.

entry: POKENAME以小队共同生活，彼此极为忠诚。曾有报告称，它们会在猛烈的火灾中协助消防员。
author: Kames
source: Known to live in squads, POKENAME are incredibly loyal to each other. POKENAME are reported to help firefighters during scorching fires.

entry: 杰尼龟军团是一群吵闹的捣蛋鬼！恶作剧时配合得如此默契，简直算作一只宝可梦。
author: captainmodeus
source: The Squirtle-Squad are a rowdy bunch! They engage in mischief with such perfect harmony they count as one Pokémon.

entry: 五只时髦的杰尼龟，因热爱墨镜而聚在一起。即使战斗，也会优先保护墨镜。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: A quintet of stylish Squirtle held together by their love for sunglasses. During battle, they prioritize the safety of their sunglasses.

entry: 看似四个独立个体，战斗时却如同一体。它们会同时各自使用不同的物品。
author: fixthewifi
source: Though appearing as four independent entities, they fight together as one. They each wield a different item in combat simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME靠水压从炮管里射出杰尼龟，让它们能在平时够不到的高处灭火。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME uses water pressure to fire Squirtle from its cannons. This allows the Squirtle to put out fires in high places they normally cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由水构成，会自豪地冲进战斗。它有多勇敢，就有多傻。
author: 8xviktor
source: With a body made mostly of water, POKENAME charges into combat with pride. It's as valiant as it is stupid.

entry: 打喷嚏时，会喷出一大团有毒花粉。幸好毒性极轻，只对老年人有影响。
author: .izik
source: Should it sneeze, it will expel a huge cloud of poisonous pollen. Luckily, the poison is extremely mild and only affects the elderly.

entry: POKENAME会把脸埋进枝叶里自卫。电力由叶子的光合作用产生。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: As a self-defense mechanism, POKENAME will bury its face into its leafage. Its electricity is produced by the photosynthesis of its leaves.

entry: POKENAME用叶子乘风飘浮。飞行时，张大的嘴会接住花粉、昆虫，甚至小鸟。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME floats by catching the wind with its leaves. As it flies, the gaping mouth catches pollen, insects, and even small birds.

entry: 尾端的手质地像水果，能切碎后用于腌制各种肉类。
author: .izik
source: The hand at the end of its tail has the same consistency as a fruit. It can be chopped up and used to marinate various meats.

entry: 据说头顶的植物十分好战，会向下方更大的身体发号施令，而身体总是毫不犹豫地服从。
author: Atlas333
source: Eager for battle, the plant on top supposedly gives orders to the larger body. It always obeys without question.

entry: 喝水时会把整个头埋进水里，有时甚至忘记浮上来换气。
author: .izik
source: It will stick its entire head under the surface of the water while drinking. Sometimes it forgets to come back up for air.

entry: 在森林中高速滚动，撞倒沿途的树木。一周就能夷平大片区域。
author: .izik
source: It rolls through forests at high speeds, knocking over trees it collides with. Over the course of a week, it can level large areas.

entry: 会将双手浸入河中，尽可能吸饱水。吸水时，额头会逐渐变大。
author: .izik
source: It will dip its hands into a river to suck up as much water as possible. As it absorbs water, its forehead will grow in size.

entry: 嘴里长出的藤蔓拥有完整的意识。只需触碰其他植物，就能将其吸收进体内。
author: .izik
source: The vines that grow from its mouth are completely sentient. It can absorb other vegetation into its body by simply touching it.

entry: 背上的鳞片极软，经常脱落。将鳞片埋在自家菜园里，能帮助作物生长。
author: .izik
source: The scales on its back are incredibly soft and frequently fall off. These scales can be buried in a home garden to promote crop growth.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带的河流附近，能像投石器般射出强酸，分解任何物质。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in tropical areas near rivers. It can shoot incredibly strong acid like a catapult, which can decompose any material.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带的河流附近，能像投石器般射出强酸，分解任何物质。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME lives in tropical areas near rivers. It can shoot incredibly strong acid like a catapult, which can decompose any material.

entry: 长长的脖子能让头朝向不同角度，将酸液射到数公里外，误差仅几米。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Thanks to its long neck, it can orient its head at different angles to shoot acid over several kilometers with an accuracy of just a few meters.

entry: 藤蔓像刀具，会切开大得无法入口的食物。分泌的液体能溶解一切接触到的东西。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its vines act as cutters to slice food too large to pull into its mouth. The fluids it produces dissolve anything it comes into contact with.

entry: 各处孔洞滴下的液体虽香，却是会引起疼痛的毒液。光是气味，就能让周围的对象沉睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: The liquid dripping from its orifices may smell pleasant, but it is actually a painful poison. The smell alone can drift those around it into slumber.

entry: 会从两臂的嘴里释放大量粉末。使敌人无法动弹后，再有节奏地跳舞嘲弄对方。
author: .izik
source: It will release large amounts of powder from its mouths on either arm. After immobilizing its foe, it will dance rhythmically to taunt it.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑浊的热带河流中，从水下伏击猎物。旱季则爬到树冠，从上方狩猎。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME lives in murky tropical rivers, ambushing prey from below. During the dry season, it ascends to the canopy and hunts prey from above.

entry: 这次融合反而让它更笨了。大食花似乎无法好好代替大舌贝。
author: .ssunday.
source: Fusion, in this case, has made the fusion more dumb. Victreebel doesn't seem to work as a replacement for Shellder.

entry: 以诱人的幻象与蜂蜜香气吸引猎物，再将其包裹，慢慢消化。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It lures in prey with enticing illusions and the scent of honey before enveloping and slowly digesting them.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的液体香甜且极黏。饥饿时，会将其涂在树上，把树变成捕虫陷阱。
author: Mykoloth
source: The fluid on POKENAME's tail has a sweet aroma and is incredibly sticky. When hungry, it marks trees with it, turning them into insect traps.

entry: POKENAME悬挂在树上，等待下一个受害者。一旦开始吞咽，胃酸几乎能溶解一切，逃跑也无济于事。
author: Uncookie
source: POKENAME hangs on trees, awaiting its next victim. Once it starts swallowing, its stomach acid dissolves almost anything—attempting escape is futile.

entry: 叶片上的霜能保护POKENAME，减少战斗中的损伤。天气温暖时，便会开始枯萎。
author: OhOk3441
source: The frost on POKENAME's leaves protects it from damage in battle. It will begin wilting in warm weather.

entry: 用尾巴上的毒树果引诱猎物。POKENAME平时没有饰品，但训练家们开始在冬季为它装扮。
author: OhOk3441
source: It uses the poisonous Berries on its tail to lure in prey. POKENAME normally lacks accessories, but Trainers have begun decorating it during winter.

entry: POKENAME通常不会在冬天枯萎，不过偶尔会有个体在寒冷的月份落叶，春天再重新长出。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME typically don't wilt in the winter. Rarely, though, one will appear with leaves that die during cold months and regrow in the spring.

entry: POKENAME凭极强的耐心与波导感知能力，即使只移动几英尺，也能大幅削减森林宝可梦的数量。
author: kandyman
source: Combining immense patience with the sensory powers of aura, POKENAME can decimate forest Pokémon populations without ever moving more than a few feet.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME一天大部分时间都躺在森林里，等待猎物走进大嘴。咬合力极其惊人。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME spends most of its day lying in forests, waiting for prey to enter its gaping mouth. Its bite force is devastatingly powerful.

entry: 用蜂蜜的甜香引来猎物，再猛扑上去。会将猎物整只吞下，用强酸溶解。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It lures its prey in with the sweet smell of honey and then pounces on them. They swallow their prey whole and dissolve it in their strong acids.

entry: 融合赋予了它速度与敏捷，成为可怕的猎手。捕到猎物后，会用颈部的爪子拖进嘴里。
author: Pizzarcato
source: Fusion has given it the speed and agility to become a fearsome hunter. When it catches prey, it drags them into its mouth using the claws on its neck.

entry: 用叶片般的羽毛伪装成普通灌木。猎物经过时，POKENAME便迅速扑出抓住对方。
author: moopse
source: It uses its leaf-like feathers to mimic a normal bush. When prey comes by, POKENAME quickly lunges out and grabs it.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴遮着嘴，沿河漂流。香甜的唾液会将小型宝可梦诱进巨口。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME float along rivers covering its mouth with its tail. It lures smaller Pokémon into its gaping maw with its sweet, scented saliva.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: 夜间唱着悲苦的歌，引诱其他生物。若听见海蚀洞中传来优美的合唱，最好远远避开。
author: .izik
source: It sings songs of anguish at night to lure in other creatures. If you hear a beautiful chorus of voices singing from a sea cave, stay clear.

entry: 一只玛瑙水母控制了超梦，形成POKENAME。超能力惊人，却不知为何比普通超梦更加阴险。
author: Krune
source: A Tentacool that has taken control over a Mewtwo, POKENAME has amazing psychic abilities but is somehow more sinister than a regular Mewtwo.

entry: POKENAME用独一条触手蜇刺小型猎物。虽然能在深水游泳，却不喜欢这样。
author: zespud
source: POKENAME will use their single tentacle to sting small prey. They can swim in deep water, but don't like to.

entry: POKENAME偏爱沼泽般的浅水，能边行走边将头露在水面上。
author: zespud
source: POKENAME prefer swampy, shallow water where they can keep their heads above water while walking.

entry: POKENAME会在浅水中悠然地缓步前行，无忧无虑。遭到攻击时，会释放强酸阻止对方。
author: zespud
source: POKENAME will happily plod through shallow waters without a care in the world. They release powerful acid to deter attackers.

entry: 燃烧的触手能灼烧金属，穿过木头更是轻而易举。即使在水下，火焰也依旧明亮。
author: Krune
source: Its flaming tentacles can singe metal and phase through wood like butter. Its fire burns brightly, even underwater.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧的触手灼伤敌人，使其失去行动能力。额头的水晶即使被取下，也保留着元素性质。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME uses flaming tentacles to sear foes, leaving them incapacitated. The crystal on its forehead holds elemental properties, even when removed.

entry: 会脸朝下睡在水中，随着波浪安稳摇晃。夜间将月光吸收进宝石，作为养分。
author: .izik
source: It will sleep face-first in the water, swaying in the waves peacefully. At night it will absorb moonlight into its gems and use it as nourishment.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由水构成。会狡猾地突袭无人看守的巢穴，趁双亲不在偷走蛋。
author: anarchaz
source: Composed mostly of water, POKENAME cunningly raids unguarded nests, snatching eggs when parents are absent.

entry: POKENAME伸出触手般的护手，缠住目标，再将坚硬的带毒水刃刺入对方体内。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME clings to its target by reaching out with its tentacle-like guard. It then plunges its poisonous, hard water blade into its victim.

entry: POKENAME能两栖生活，用脚在陆地行走，用触手在海中游动。会用带毒的喙攻击钓鱼者。
author: synaesthesis
source: POKENAME can live amphibiously, walking on land with its feet and navigating the sea with its tentacles. It attacks anglers with its venomous beak.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在海面上方，用触手抓取小鱼宝可梦。尽管如此，从未有人观察到它吃东西。
author: DuskRD
source: POKENAME floats above the ocean to grab small fish Pokémon with its tentacles. Despite this, it has never been observed eating anything.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会喷出大量酸性墨汁搅浑水域，再潜入深处逃跑。
author: zespud
source: When threatened, POKENAME will eject large amounts of acidic ink to cloud the waters, then submerge beneath to escape.

entry: 看到POKENAME的头露出水面时，最好绕开。长长的触手可能正藏在水下，随时带来疼痛的蜇刺。
author: zespud
source: If you see a POKENAME's head above water, steer clear. Their long tentacles could be waiting under the water to deliver painful stings.

entry: POKENAME需要呼吸空气，因此会将头露出水面一待数小时，悠闲地用触手抓鱼。
author: zespud
source: Since POKENAME breathe air, they will sit with their heads above water for hours, passively grabbing fish with their tentacles.

entry: 拍动的鳍与钩状的喙让POKENAME常被误认成猛禽，其实它连飞行属性都不是。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME, with its flapping fins and hooked beak, is often mistaken for a bird of prey, but it's not even a Flying type.

entry: 身上的宝石充满能量，闪烁的光芒能用于与同类沟通。
author: .izik
source: The gems on its body are full of energy, flickering with light. It can use this to communicate with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME背上的红色球体内养着微型生态缸。80条触手卷成简单的腿，让它能在陆地行走。
author: Pizzarcato
source: POKENAME keeps a miniature terrarium within the red orbs on its back. Its 80 tentacles coil into rudimentary legs, allowing it to walk on land.

entry: POKENAME有80条触手。还没人能在被凶狠的剑刃刺穿之前，挣脱其中一条以上。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: No person has freed themself from more than one of POKENAME's 80 tentacles before being skewered on its brutal blade.

entry: 组成进化前形态的三只宝可梦融合在一起，形成了一只巨大的水母宝可梦。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The three Pokémon that make up its pre-evolution have fused together, creating one large jellyfish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会在被丢进海里的容器和箱子中安家。它能弹射出众多触手捕捉猎物。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME makes its home in containers and boxes dumped into the ocean. It will catch its prey by launching its many tentacles.

entry: 红色球体会发出超声波，削弱猎物。随后以众多毒触手逼近，紧紧缠住猎物，防止逃脱。
author: synaesthesis
source: Its red orbs emit ultrasonic waves to weaken prey. It then closes in with its many poisonous tentacles, constricting creatures to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME自由飘动的触手是灵敏的探测器。附近只要有猎物，就会立刻抓住，拖进胶状的伞盖里。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's free-floating tentacles act as sensitive feelers. It will instantly grab and pull any nearby prey into its gelatinous dome.

entry: 身上虹彩般的球体会吸引毫无戒心的猎物。一旦靠近，两条毒触手便将其缠住，供POKENAME享用。
author: char_latte3412
source: The iridescent orbs on its body lure in unsuspecting prey. Once close enough, two venomous tentacles will ensnare the prey for POKENAME to feast on.

entry: POKENAME实际太重，游不起来。只能躺在海底张大嘴巴，等待猎物入口。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME are actually too heavy to swim in water, simply laying on the ocean floor with their mouth open in order to catch prey instead.

entry: POKENAME身体厚重，无法飞行，转而用强壮的手臂攀上悬崖与树木。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Due to its robust body, POKENAME is unable to fly. Instead, it uses its strong arms to pull itself up cliffs and trees.

entry: POKENAME总装出自己体形很大的样子，但在这个进化阶段，这招威吓很少奏效。
author: monina
source: POKENAME acts as if it was a much larger Pokémon. This intimidation tactic rarely works at this evolution stage.

entry: 身体庞大，只能飞几秒。不过，达到最高速度时，强劲的翅膀能轻松切开铁梁。
author: char_latte3412
source: Due to its bulk, it can achieve flight for only a few seconds. However, at maximum speed, its powerful wings can slice through iron girders with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛粗糙如砂纸。挤在一起睡觉时，经常被误认成小片岩石。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME's fur is rough like sandpaper. When they sleep huddled together, they often are mistaken for small rock formations.

entry: POKENAME没有寻常的移动方式，会卷起沉重的尾巴旋转。尾巴一松开，自己就像铅球一样飞出去。
author: char_latte3412
source: Lacking a conventional means of mobility, POKENAME will coil its heavy tail and swing around. When its tail unravels, it takes off like a shot put.

entry: POKENAME交替使用手臂和镐攀山。广为流传的传说称，它被一位死去矮人的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Alternating between arm and pick, POKENAME scales mountains. Popular legend says it is possessed by the spirit of a deceased dwarf.

entry: 野生POKENAME会互相冲撞，较量谁的身体最坚固。胜出者便成为族群首领。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: In nature, packs of POKENAME will tackle each other to prove whose body is sturdiest. The one that comes out on top becomes the leader of the pack.

entry: POKENAME用耳朵最多能扛起25吨的重量。看着凶，内心却十分善良。
author: Lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to carry up to 25 tons of weight using their ears. It looks mean, but it has a heart of gold.

entry: 行动困难，于是不断吞食周围的泥土与巨石，形成一个坑。徒步者偶尔掉进去，让POKENAME烦不胜烦。
author: char_latte3412
source: Struggling to move, it consumes surrounding dirt and boulders, forming a pit. Hikers will occasionally fall in, irritating POKENAME to no end.

entry: POKENAME的身体极为粗糙结实。据说内部闪耀着夜空般的光芒。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME's body is extremely rough and durable. It's rumored that its innards shimmer like the night sky.

entry: 跳不远，却仍要试着在悬崖间跳跃。不慎掉到谁身上，就会给对方带来灭顶之灾。
author: .izik
source: It is unable to jump long distances. Despite this, it will attempt to jump from cliff to cliff, spelling doom for anyone it accidentally falls onto.

entry: 能靠吃石头获取养分，会从山壁上大把抓石头来吃。不过，这习惯可能引发山崩。
author: .izik
source: It is able to eat stones for nourishment, grabbing handfuls of rocks from mountain walls to feast. However, this habit can cause landslides.

entry: 身体沉重，飞得很慢。不过，POKENAME能在空中蜷成一团，如陨石般砸向地面的敌人。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Due to its heavy body, it can only fly very slowly. However, POKENAME can curl up in the air to smash into opponents on the ground like a meteorite.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀会随成长脱落并重新长出。脱落的翅膀磨碎后，能用来制作肥皂与乳液。
author: .izik
source: The wings of a POKENAME will fall off and regrow as it ages. The discarded wings can be ground and used to create soaps and lotions.

entry: POKENAME形成于温泉附近的岩层。随着成长与战斗，岩石外层逐渐剥落，显露出内部的宝石。
author: CapWolfBane
source: POKENAME forms in rock deposits near hot springs. As it ages and battles, its rocky outer layer crumbles away, revealing the gemstone underneath.

entry: 双臂能投掷巨石、敌人，甚至自己。它最爱把自己扔出去赶路，可套在身上的巨石总让落地姿势十分狼狈。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its arms can hurl boulders, opponents, or itself—its preferred mode of travel. The boulders it sheaths into ensure its landings are not graceful.

entry: 为了维持庞大结实的身体，它每天最多要吃一吨岩石。它似乎最喜欢那些长满苔藓的石头。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: To maintain its bulk and sturdy body, it will eat up to a ton of rocks on a daily basis. Its favorite rocks seem to be those covered in moss.

entry: POKENAME上山时小心翼翼，下山时却是一路滚落。
author: birchbot
source: When POKENAME goes up a mountain, it moves delicately. In contrast, it tumbles down the mountain when descending.

entry: 白天脸朝下睡在泥地上，鼾声如雷。夜里猛然醒来，向月亮歌唱。
author: .izik
source: It will sleep face down on muddy surfaces during the day, snoring loudly. At night, it springs awake and sings to the moon.

entry: 身体完全中空，里面充满奇怪的气体。虽然岩石表面沉重，仍能短距离飘浮。
author: .izik
source: Its body is completely hollow and filled with an odd gas. Despite its rocky surface and weight, it can float for short distances.

entry: POKENAME是“深灰力量宝石”队的吉祥物兼啦啦队员。每逢对阵“石英冰冻光束”队，它都会把岩石绒球摇得格外起劲。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is used as the mascot and cheerleader for the Pewter Power Gems. If facing the Indigo Ice Beams, it shakes its rock-poms even harder.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME会在山口寻找跌落的旅人。找到后并不施救，只站在旁边盯着看。
author: .izik
source: At night, a POKENAME wanders through mountain passes looking for travelers who fell. Instead of assisting them, it will stand next to them and stare.

entry: POKENAME一选定落脚处，就很少移动。会坐在原地，用多只手臂和念力抵御四面八方的攻击。
author: noel5229
source: Once POKENAME picks a spot to settle, it rarely moves. It uses multiple arms and telekinesis to fend off attacks from all directions as it sits still.

entry: 身体渗出的硝化甘油会结晶，覆盖下半身。受威胁时，或只是想玩时，都会引爆晶体将自己炸飞。
author: wigglypon
source: Its body oozes nitroglycerin, which crystallizes to coat its lower half. It can detonate the crystals to launch itself if threatened- or just for fun.

entry: 同类会比谁爆炸留下的坑更大。常闯进工地，将储备的炸药大口吃光。
author: wigglypon
source: Rivals compete to see whose explosions make the largest craters. It is known to raid construction sites and gobble up their dynamite stockpiles.

entry: 在矿井深处发现的神秘宝可梦。几乎一动不动，但有些训练家坚称，听过POKENAME核心传来铃声。
author: Fenragon
source: This enigmatic Pokémon was found deep within a mine. It is largely inert, but some Trainers swear they can hear chimes coming from POKENAME's core.

entry: 与同类共同统治火山口的领地。曾有报告称，看到POKENAME在炽热的熔岩中沐浴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It rules shared territory in volcanic craters with others of its kind. There are reports that POKENAME has been observed bathing in red-hot lava.

entry: 在灼热的深处铸成，出没于古老洞窟的阴影。凭幽灵之力握拢双手，足以捏碎山岳。
author: anarchaz
source: Forged in the fiery depths, it haunts the shadows of ancient caverns. Its grasp is capable of crushing mountains with spectral force.

entry: 据说POKENAME会将山崩中的亡魂渡往来世。也有人说，那些事故原本就是它造成的。
author: barthandelus_real
source: POKENAME is said to ferry souls lost in rockslides to the afterlife. It's also said to have caused those accidents in the first place.

entry: 力量极大，能改变地壳的形状。挥一下手，就能摧毁整座岛屿。
author: Skymaster426
source: It holds immense power, which it uses to alter the shape of the earth's crust. A single swipe of its hand can destroy an entire island.

entry: POKENAME栖息在高峰的火山口中，凭庞大的力量塑造大地。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME dwells in volcanic craters atop lofty peaks, shaping the land with its immense power.

entry: POKENAME会开采并藏起能找到的最坚硬的石头，当作武器。人类无论用什么手持工具，都无法将其敲裂。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME mines and stashes the toughest stones it can find to use as weapons. These stones can't be cracked by humans with any handheld equipment.

entry: 尾巴坚硬如花岗岩，几乎能击碎一切硬度与之相同的东西。POKENAME为尾巴注入能量后，会更加危险。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: With its granite-hard tail, it can crush almost anything equal to its hardness. By energizing its tail, POKENAME becomes even more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮会硬化、崩碎，成为富含养分的土壤，帮助植物生长，因此很受园丁欢迎。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME are popular among gardeners for their shedded skin, which hardens and crumbles, becoming a nutrient-rich soil for plant growth.

entry: 走到哪里，哪里就能感到震动与降温。岩石般的鳞片摸起来冰冷。
author: HoundRyS
source: Wherever this Pokémon walks, a quake can be felt, along with a drop in temperature. Its rocky scales are cold to the touch.

entry: 会嵌进岩石地面，咬住踩到它的对象。三颗头很少能达成一致。
author: kittyluv090
source: It embeds itself into rocky terrain and bites those who step on it. Its three heads rarely agree on anything.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，能跳过紧邻的生物。奇怪的是，总沿着L形路线移动。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are agile Pokémon, jumping over creatures adjacent to them. Strangely, they always move in an L shaped fashion.

entry: POKENAME会爬进人家，造成严重破坏，是令人厌恶的害兽。烦躁时，火焰还可能引发住宅火灾。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are heavily despised pests that crawl into homes and cause serious damage. When they are agitated, their flames can start house fires.

entry: POKENAME出生时没有火焰。随着成长，火焰会越来越大、越来越猛烈。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: At birth, POKENAME lack their flames. The size and intensity of the flames increase as the Pokémon ages.

entry: 嘴里喷火时，眼睛会发出红光。还能用超能力让敌人突然燃烧起来。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes glow red when it spits fire from its mouth. It can use its psychic abilities to cause an enemy to spontaneously burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME将树果储存在体内，定期烘烤。过程中产生的含酒精蒸馏液，能用于酿制各种酒。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME stores Berries in its body, which it regularly roasts. The process produces an alcoholic distillate that is used for various liquors.

entry: 一台烈焰机器。POKENAME用推进器手臂加速，速度能远远超过飞机。
author: Rkmaster2637
source: A fiery machine. POKENAME can accelerate to speeds far beyond planes with its thruster arms.

entry: 火焰既用于攻击，也用于撤退。它会借喷火的反作用力，将自己推出战场。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its flames double as both a method of attack and an exit strategy, launching itself away from battle with expulsion force from its flames.

entry: POKENAME跳得高、跑得快，是出色的放牧帮手。唯有它信任的人，触碰鬃毛时才不会被灼伤。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Due to their high jumping and fast running, POKENAME are excellent herding Pokémon. Only those it trusts can touch its mane without burning.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛会产生烟灰般辛辣的孢子，蹦跳小跑时便洒向四周。有些人会拿来当调味料。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME produces spicy, soot-like spores from its mane, which it spreads as it hops and trots around. Some people use those as a condiment.

entry: POKENAME生来羸弱，毛发却会随年月渐渐泛起璀璨的金光，仿佛映着它坚韧而优雅的灵魂。
author: anarchaz
source: Born with feeble strength, POKENAME's fur evolves into a radiant golden sheen over time, symbolizing its enduring spirit and grace.

entry: 成群POKENAME会合作，为附近城镇表演。在空中配合飞行，组成发光的图案。
author: .izik
source: A flock of POKENAME will coordinate their efforts to put on shows for nearby towns. They coordinate in the sky to create glowing designs.

entry: 出生时没有火焰。随着成长，火焰会越来越炽热、明亮。
author: themicelegion
source: It doesn't have flames when it is born. As it gets older, the flames get hotter and brighter.

entry: POKENAME以善跑闻名，只有自己的进化形能胜过它。飞奔而过时，火焰令人惊叹。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are famous for being amazing runners, only being beaten out by its evolution. Its flames are astonishing as it zips past you.

entry: POKENAME的毛脱落数月后摸起来仍温暖，因此合众的织工会用来制作冬衣。
author: .izik
source: The fur of a POKENAME will stay warm to the touch for months after it is shed. Because of this, weavers in Unova use it to make winter clothing.

entry: 壳内烈火将其加热至高炉般的温度，因此POKENAME很受陶艺家欢迎，常成为他们的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The fires that rage in its shell heat it up to the temperature of a blast furnace. This makes POKENAME a popular partner Pokémon for potters.

entry: POKENAME难以控制熊熊烈火，因此常独自待在远离人类和宝可梦的地方。
author: Crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME struggles to contain its blazing flames. Because of this, it is often found secluded away from both people and Pokémon.

entry: 身体不断燃烧，身后留下厚厚的灰烬。同时又再生得极快，让火焰永不熄灭。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is constantly burning, leaving a thick trail of ash behind it. At the same time, its body regenerates so quickly that it never goes out.

entry: 身体不断燃烧，身后留下厚厚的灰烬。同时又再生得极快，让火焰永不熄灭。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its body is constantly burning, leaving a thick trail of ash behind it. At the same time, its body regenerates so quickly that it never goes out.

entry: POKENAME常出现在山火现场附近，有理论认为许多山火正是它们造成的。不过，火灾也为新生命的繁盛腾出了空间。
author: CaramelDog
source: POKENAME are often seen near the site of bushfires, and theorized to cause many of them. However, these fires clear the way for new life to flourish.

entry: 这是一次给烈焰兽Ⅱ超频的尝试。POKENAME的速度确实更快了，却也失去了原本正常的模样。
author: pory
source: An attempt at overclocking Rapigon2: POKENAME achieved higher speeds at the cost of its normalcy.

entry: POKENAME奔过开阔平原，沿途留下一道火痕。燃烧的鬃毛，正象征着它不屈的斗志，与战场上无可比拟的敏捷。
author: Sheogorath
source: POKENAME runs across open plains, leaving flaming trails in its wake. Its fiery mane symbolizes its unwavering spirit and unmatched agility in battle.

entry: 身体虽沉重，记录中的最高时速仍达45英里。金属长年受火烧灼，逐渐变得能够吸热。
author: HoundRyS
source: Despite its heavy body, it's been recorded to reach a top speed of 45 mph. The constant fire on the metals have made them heat absorbant.

entry: POKENAME极为懒惰，常睡在田野里。遭到攻击就起身跑到别处，继续休息。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is extremely lazy, so it's seen sleeping in the fields. When attacked, it gets up and runs away to a place where it can continue to rest.

entry: POKENAME背负燃烧的森林，以撼地的步伐疾驰。火焰在枝叶间跃动，却永远不会烧毁森林。
author: anarchaz
source: Galloping with earth-shaking strides, POKENAME bears a flaming forest upon its back. Flames dance amidst foliage without ever burning it down.

entry: POKENAME群体中跑得最快的一只就是首领。它们争强好胜，谁看起来比自己快，就要和谁赛跑。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: In herds of POKENAME, the fastest runner is the leader of the herd. They are very competitive and will race anything that they see as faster.

entry: 会与其他POKENAME比谁挖的陷坑最多。又会在坑之间飞奔，赶在掉进去的猎物逃脱前将其抓住。
author: Soup1900
source: It races other POKENAME to see who can dig the most pit traps. It races from pit to pit to catch any prey that has fallen in before they can escape.

entry: 成群POKENAME在空中奔腾，沿途留下道道火流。性情平和，却十分骄傲。
author: caladria
source: Herds of POKENAME stampede through the sky, leaving streams of fire where they gallop. They are a peaceful but proud Pokémon.

entry: 会笨拙地长途奔跑，炫耀燃烧的鬃毛。十分虚荣，只要有人欣赏就会停下来。
author: .izik
source: It will awkwardly run for long distances to show off its fiery mane. It is extremely vain, stopping for anyone who admires it.

entry: 体重分布古怪，奔跑时哪怕停下片刻，也会摔倒在地，再用念力将自己扶起。
author: .izik
source: If it stops running for even a moment it will fall to the ground due to its odd weight distribution. It will use telekinesis to hoist itself up.

entry: 野生POKENAME只在活火山附近出没。徒步者将遇见它视为警告，认为应该立刻撤离。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME are found exclusively near active volcanoes. Hikers consider spotting one in the wild to be a warning sign to vacate the area.

entry: 在燃煤发电厂附近安家。若找不到，就会躲进民宅的烟囱。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near coal-fueled power plants. When none are available, it will hide in the chimneys of residential homes.

entry: POKENAME会替别人点火，帮助烹饪、冶金等工作。生性桀骜，只听从赢得自己信任的对象。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME ignites fires for others, aiding in tasks like cooking and metallurgy. Feisty by nature, they will only obey those who've earned their trust.

entry: POKENAME反应极慢。即使捕食者已经在啃它，也毫无反应。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME is incredibly slow. Even if a predator is actively chewing on it, it will not react.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“水雷”，渔民将它钓起时就会爆炸。即使老练的钓手，也不敢在它的栖息地大意垂钓。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Often called "The Sea Mine," POKENAME is known to explode when reeled in by fishermen. Even veteran anglers are cautious about fishing in its habitat.

entry: POKENAME从不留意自己漂到哪里。经常撞上东西，却并不怎么在意。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME doesn't pay attention to where it's floating. It will frequently bump into things, but it doesn't mind that much.

entry: 很少能见到它背上燃起火焰，因为那代表愤怒或惊讶，而POKENAME很少产生这些情绪。
author: char_latte3412
source: Rarely does one see flames burning on its back, as it signifies emotions of anger or surprise—feelings that do not come easily to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME总提防野生兰古斯，早已学会畏惧它的球体。这甚至让它们偶尔连月亮都怕。
author: not_stakings_alt
source: POKENAME are always wary of wild Langoos; they has learned to fear its orbs. This has led to them to occasionally be scared of the moon.

entry: 记性差得惊人。谁得罪了POKENAME，不出两分钟便会获得原谅，因为它早已忘得一干二净。
author: .izik
source: It has extremely bad memory issues. Should anyone wrong a POKENAME, it will forgive the transgression within two minutes, forgetting it entirely.

entry: 会花时间练习站在浮木上保持平衡。但因体重分布不佳，通常都会掉下去。
author: .izik
source: It will spend its time attempting to balance on floating logs. Due to its poor weight distribution, this usually results in it falling off.

entry: 经常忘记吃喝。若没有别人喂食，就会迅速消瘦。
author: .izik
source: It very frequently forgets to eat and drink. Due to this, it will lose weight rapidly unless someone else feeds it.

entry: POKENAME从环境中吸收钙，筑起珊瑚。性情平和，很适合新手训练家作伴。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME use calcium from the environment to build up their coral. Their calm nature makes them good partners for newer Trainers.

entry: 有些POKENAME不满环境时，会长出腿迁往浅湖。跑起来比看上去快得多。
author: totodile.
source: Some POKENAME grow legs and migrate to shallow lakes when displeased with their environment. They run faster than might be expected at a glance.

entry: POKENAME收集海滩与河岸上被丢弃的宝物。既笨拙又健忘，常弄掉宝物，随后又重新拾到。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME collects discarded treasures on beaches and riverbanks. Clumsy and forgetful, it often drops and finds them anew.

entry: 十分喜欢自己尾巴的味道，会慢慢将其啃断吃掉。POKENAME完全不痛，尾巴还会重新长出。
author: themicelegion
source: This Pokémon loves the taste of its own tail. It will slowly gnaw it off and devour it. POKENAME feels no pain from this, and its tail regrows.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是一道美味。它们常因想吃自己的尾巴而将其咬断，也是当地动作最慢的宝可梦之一。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME tails are a delicacy. They are known to dock their own tails by trying to eat them and are named one of the region's slowest Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME慢得惊人，你过完一整天，它可能才动一下。奇怪的是，人们还为它们举办了赛跑。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is very slow, so slow that you can go about your whole day before it does a thing. Curiously, people started organizing POKENAME races.

entry: 很多人说POKENAME不太聪明。不过，也有报告称，曾见它使用简单工具获取食物。
author: KitArchen
source: Many have claimed that POKENAME are not very smart. However, reports have been made of POKENAME being spotted using basic tools to acquire food.

entry: 科学家认为融合让POKENAME的预知更准确。可它头脑简单，解读不了自己看到的景象。
author: matpal6
source: Scientists believe fusion gave POKENAME more precise augury. However, because it's simple-minded, it can't decipher its own visions.

entry: 用众多缎带状触角捕鱼。触角即使断掉也会很快再生，POKENAME并不会感到疼痛。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It uses its multitude of ribbonlike feelers to fish. If their ribbons break off, they will regrow quickly, and POKENAME will feel no pain.

entry: 最多只能飞到离地几英寸的高度。悬浮时，尾巴拖在地上，在泥土中划出一道线。
author: .izik
source: It cannot fly more than a few inches off of the ground. While it hovers it will drag its tail across the ground, making a line in the dirt.

entry: 许多高级餐厅不惜重金进口新鲜POKENAME尾巴。独特的蘑菇风味，让它被视为珍馐。
author: char_latte3412
source: Many high-end restaurants pay top dollar to import fresh POKENAME tails. They are considered a delicacy with a distinct taste of mushrooms.

entry: 钳子一不小心就会折断。白色部分会渗出糖霜般的物质，甜得惊人。
author: .izik
source: Its claws will easily break off if it's not careful. The white portions ooze a frosting-like substance that is incredibly sweet.

entry: 背甲顶部向上隆起，形成一个孔洞，看起来像洋葱。能从洞里喷出间歇泉般的水柱。
author: Soup1900
source: The top of its shell rises upwards and forms a hole on top, causing it to resemble an onion. It can eject water from that hole like a geyser.

entry: POKENAME的花苞能像间歇泉一样喷水。其他宝可梦常会跑到下面冲凉，就像夏日里在洒水器下嬉戏。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's bulb is known to work like a geyser. Other Pokémon are known to run under it, like a sprinkler on a summer day.

entry: 即使在狃拉融合体中，POKENAME也格外虚荣。能对着水中的倒影凝望数小时。
author: volvonovic
source: Even among other Sneasel fusions, POKENAME is known to be especially vain. It spends hours gazing at its reflection in the water.

entry: 会喷出能切开硬钢的高压水流。在海上游荡，寻找自己认可、配得上这份力量的人。
author: imagine1.
source: It shoots high-pressure water that can cut through hard steel. They roam the seas, seeking someone it deems worthy of its strength.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却十分善游。背上的植物始终水分充足，绝不会枯萎。
author: imagine1.
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are excellent swimmers. The plant on its back is always hydrated, and thus it's impossible for it to wilt.

entry: POKENAME经常清洁、打理毛发。通常不会战斗，除非对手“攻击”了它的毛。
author: Mossybanana
source: POKENAME are often seen cleaning and maintaining their fur. They do not usually engage in battle unless their fur has been "attacked" by the opponent.

entry: 常在海底悠闲休息。它的背上住着许多宝可梦，因为弱小的宝可梦在它身边很有安全感。
author: .ssunday.
source: It's seen lazing around on the ocean floor. Its back is home to many Pokémon, as weak Pokémon feel protected with it around.

entry: POKENAME是一把优雅的剑，战斗时轻旋回舞。喜欢与看起来强悍的对手决斗。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is an elegant blade that twirls and spins in combat. It enjoys dueling tough-looking opponents.

entry: 在水中以尾巴为舵，用耳朵辨别水流方向。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It uses its tail in water to act as a rudder and its ears to detect the directions of currents.

entry: POKENAME越年长，六条尾巴的颜色就越深。游泳时还能卷起再松开尾巴，得到一点推力。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The older POKENAME gets, the darker its six tails become. It can also wind and release them while swimming to get a little boost.

entry: 据说POKENAME能活数千年，因此象征健康，常被用作纹章图案。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is said to be able to live for several thousand years. For this reason, it symbolizes health and is a popular motif for coats of arms.

entry: POKENAME头大，走路很困难。却是不惜一切代价保护训练家的好伙伴。
author: imagine1.
source: It's hard for POKENAME to walk due to its big head. POKENAME are great companions, as they will protect their Trainer no matter the cost.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵在水下比在陆地听得更清楚，帮助它游泳时避开捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The ears on POKENAME can hear more clearly underwater than on land. This helps it when avoiding predators while swimming.

entry: POKENAME即使在水下也很善战。会将火焰护在壳内，让它始终燃烧。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME are excellent fighters, even underwater. They are able to protect their flames inside their shell to ensure they always stay burning.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀覆着特殊液体，在水下也能使用。壳的温度最高可达华氏144度。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME's wings are coated in a special liquid that allows them to be used underwater. Its shell can heat up to 144 ⁰F.

entry: POKENAME头上的盔甲，像古代人形生物化石中见过的头盔，让它拥有惊人的速度与敏捷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: The helmet on POKENAME's head resembles a helmet seen in an ancient humanoid fossil. It grants POKENAME immense speed and agility.

entry: 体内能量过剩，让海藻般的尾巴不断长大。从尾巴排出的水，可以了解POKENAME体内的运作。
author: thehatster
source: Its seaweed-like tail has grown due to the excess energy in its body. The water expelled from the tail gives insight into POKENAME's inner workings.

entry: 关都的许多警察都有POKENAME协助。它们坚韧忠诚，也是许多训练家的理想伙伴。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME are used by many police officers around Kanto. They are very tough and loyal, so it's the perfect choice for many Trainers.

entry: 尾巴上的壳太重，让POKENAME飞行困难。主要在早晨活动，以花朵为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME have trouble flying due to the weight of the shell on its tail. It is primarily active in the mornings, when it consumes flowers.

entry: 大舌贝若夹住背部，POKENAME会惊得喷出火焰，常将这位新伙伴灼伤。
author: char_latte3412
source: If a Shellder clamps onto the back of this Pokémon, POKENAME lets loose a surprised flame, often scorching its new-found companion.

entry: 后部的壳十分拖累POKENAME，让它连接近2马赫的速度都达不到。不过，它似乎毫不在意。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME is heavily encumbered by the shell on its rear, rendering it incapable of reaching speeds even close to Mach 2. It seems unfazed, however.

entry: 深夜会极慢地跳舞。不过，若有十一位以上的观众，速度就会稍微快一点。
author: .izik
source: It dances extremely slowly during the late evenings. However, it will dance slightly faster if a group of eleven or more is watching it.

entry: 腹部储存着依附的大舌贝赖以生存的养分。钳子看起来像呆呆兽的脸，能分散对手的注意。
author: milchik
source: Its abdomen stores the nutrients the attached Shellder uses for survival. Its claws look like Slowpoke's face, which distracts the opponents.

entry: 有些呆呆兽迟钝到身上长出了藤蔓。大舌贝咬住尾巴时，身体仍会发生同样的反应，变成POKENAME。
author: Staghorn
source: Some Slowpoke are so sedate, vines grow on them. Their body still reacts in the same way when a Shellder bites their tail, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: 完全靠光合作用生存，因此尾巴上长满花朵与藤蔓。似乎很享受这样的生活，几乎不动。
author: char_latte3412
source: It survives solely through photosynthesis, resulting in many flowers and vines adorning its tail. It seems to enjoy this existence and rarely moves.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在阳光充足的岸边休息。大舌贝让它能够用神经毒素攻击敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to rest on the edge of sunny shorelines. The Shellder ensures POKENAME can use neurotoxins to attack foes.

entry: POKENAME平时动作迟缓，但尾巴上的大舌贝一咬紧，就会让它肾上腺素骤增，行动比平时更快。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Though usually slow, if the Shellder on POKENAME's tail bites down they will gain a burst of adrenaline to act faster than normal.

entry: 附在POKENAME身上的大舌贝总是欣喜陶醉，因为它吸食的甜汁不是来自一条尾巴，而是整整三条。
author: GP423
source: The Shellder attached to POKENAME is in a constant state of euphoria. This is because it is ingesting the sweet ooze from not one but three tails.

entry: POKENAME背上原本的大舌贝，完全控制了迟钝的宿主。研究表明，它藏起来的尾巴上栽培着多种真菌。
author: char_latte3412
source: The former Shellder on POKENAME's back has total control of its dim-witted host. Research suggests various fungi are cultivated on its hidden tail.

entry: 一连数天都睡在壳内。若将POKENAME惊醒，它会爆发出阵阵超能力。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps inside its shell for days on end. If you startle a POKENAME awake, it will let loose blasts of psychic energy.

entry: 经常头痛，反应十分迟缓。不断出汗，散发着酸味。
author: .izik
source: Because of its frequent headaches, it has a very slow reaction time. It sweats constantly, letting loose a sour odor.

entry: 大舌贝一直受POKENAME的火焰烧灼，却凭着一股倔劲死不松口，硬是忍了下来。
author: Rakanadyo
source: Shellder is constantly burned by POKENAME's flame. However, it hangs on and endures through sheer stubbornness.

entry: 壳上的刺偶尔会脱落再生。壳磨成粉后，能用作牙膏原料。
author: .izik
source: The spikes on its shell fall off and regrow on occasion. When ground up, the shells are used as an ingredient for toothpaste.

entry: 目光看似呆滞，其实是睁着眼睛在睡觉。饿了才会醒来，寻找梦境吃下。
author: cait_sith
source: It seems to have a vacant stare, but this is because it sleeps with its eyes open. When it is hungry, it awakens to search for dreams to eat.

entry: POKENAME的身体由纯钢构成，磁力极强。背上的种子却仍是纯粹的有机体，还能产生强烈的毒素。
author: char_latte3412
source: The body of a POKENAME is pure steel and highly magnetic. However, the bulb on its back remains completely organic and produces powerful toxins.

entry: 双手能发出强大的磁力，让POKENAME随意改变磁铁的磁极，化为己用。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its hands can emit strong magnetism. This allows POKENAME to re-pole magnets at will and use them to its advantage.

entry: 双手能发出强大的磁力，让POKENAME随意改变磁铁的磁极，化为己用。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its hands can emit strong magnetism. This allows POKENAME to re-pole magnets at will and use them to its advantage.

entry: POKENAME在海底爬行，将富含金属的沉积物聚拢到身后。常被吸在沉船、船锚或海滩上的废物上。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME crawl along the seafloor gathering metal-rich sediments behind them. They often get stuck to shipwrecks, anchors, or junk on the beach.

entry: POKENAME从猎物身上获取铁与电力，强化自己。磁力镰刀还能从远处吸走铁。
author: paisleylxl
source: POKENAME use the iron and electricity from their prey to reinforce themselves. They use their magnetic scythes to steal iron from a distance.

entry: POKENAME以阳光供能。白昼变短时，有时会耗尽能量，一动不动地等到早晨。
author: zespud
source: POKENAME are powered by sunlight. When the days get shorter, sometimes they will run out of power and sit inert until morning.

entry: POKENAME在磁场中起舞，散播能量。光彩照亮花园，优美的舞姿让观者着迷。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME dances in magnetic fields, spreading energy. It illuminates gardens with brilliance, captivating all who behold its graceful movements.

entry: 这种POKENAME原本有机的种子，被一块巨大的磁铁取代。它能操纵磁力触须，让敌人中毒或麻痹。
author: char_latte3412
source: This variant of POKENAME has a huge magnet in place of its organic bulb. It can control magnetic tendrils that may leave foes poisoned or paralyzed.

entry: 身体是一团形状不定的铁屑，能储存海量电能。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its body is an amorphous mass of iron filings. It can store an enormous amount of electrical energy inside itself.

entry: POKENAME带着磁力般的魅力和电光般的热情探索世界。顽皮的天性让它总能带来惊喜与欢乐。
author: anarchaz
source: With magnetic charm, POKENAME explores the world with electric enthusiasm. Its playful nature make it a source of wonder and amusement.

entry: POKENAME能像组合质子一样自由组合电子，常不慎引发破坏力惊人的电击，也能借此给自己充电。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can freely combine electrons like protons, inadvertently causing devastating electric shocks. It can also charge its own body in this way.

entry: POKENAME天生被金属废料吸引。会用大磁铁从垃圾场取走废金属，供自己使用。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon with an innate attraction to metal waste. Using its large magnet, it takes metal waste from dumps for personal use.

entry: 飘动的斗篷由磁力聚拢的铁屑组成。一旦昏厥，铁屑便像沙子般散落，只留下一张面具。
author: robosoup
source: Its flowing cloak is made of iron filings, held together with magnetism. When it faints, the filings fall away like sand, leaving only a mask behind.

entry: 巨大的磁铁剑刃能吸来数英尺外的金属。吸力极强，会将金属宝可梦和披甲者拉来刺穿。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its large magnet blade can attract metal to it from several feet away. The pull is so strong, it skewers metal Pokémon and those wearing armor.

entry: 组成身体的铁球如电池，储存着多余电力。最爱的食物包括电池和冰箱贴。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The iron balls that make up its body act as batteries to store its excess power. Their favorite foods include batteries and fridge magnets.

entry: 小小的身体蕴含静电，光是靠近就能干扰电子设备。最好不要触碰它。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Wielding static current in its small body, it can interrupt electronic devices by simply being near them. Touching this Pokémon is not recommended.

entry: 头上的叶子其实是条状锂箔。沾水后会剧烈反应，释放出危险的大量能量。
author: GP423
source: The leaves on its head are actually strips of lithium foil. If exposed to water, these leaves react violently and release dangerous amounts of energy.

entry: POKENAME十分好斗。争夺领地时，会制造足以让整座城市停电的电磁场。
author: akujules
source: POKENAME is a very combative Pokémon. It fights for territory by creating electromagnetic fields capable of blacking out entire cities.

entry: 生活在海中的奇异金属宝可梦。会用磁铁吸住船只，借船快速移动。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A strange, metallic Pokémon that can be found under the waves. It uses magnets to hang on to ships for quick transport.

entry: POKENAME的黏液身体带磁性，能慢慢沿金属物体向上爬。若不慎吸来别的东西，就会用磁铁将其斥开。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's slimy body is magnetic, allowing it to slowly move up metal objects. Its magnets repel any objects it inadvertently attracts.

entry: 磁性黏液难以穿透，因此POKENAME遇险时会用它包住眼睛。常见于废料场或工厂。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its magnetic slime is difficult to penetrate, allowing POKENAME to encase its eye if in danger. It is often found in scrap yards or factories.

entry: POKENAME用磁场控制神秘的气雾。仍会试着穿墙，却总因坚实的金属核心撞上墙壁。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME uses magnetic fields to control its mysterious vapors. It still tries to pass through walls, but bangs into them with its solid metal core.

entry: POKENAME始终处于核熔毁状态，不断排出浓厚、腐蚀性强且带放射性的雾气。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME is in a contant state of nuclear meltdown, causing it to excrete a thick, corrosive, and radioactive fog.

entry: 传说一只三合一磁怪落进枯萎的蔓藤怪中，变成了它。组成三合一磁怪的两个个体死去，被隔在藤蔓之中。
author: crimson_i_guess
source: Rumor has it a Magneton fell into a withered Tangela and became this Pokémon. Two of the Magneton parts died off, getting separated in the vines.

entry: 凭借磁力与超能力，POKENAME几乎能操控任何东西。不过，它虽有大力，性情却很温和。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can hold almost anything under its spell with the help of its magnetic and psychic powers. Despite its great power, however, it is peaceful.

entry: 性情极为凶暴。POKENAME只要发现一点动静，就会从嘴里发射电流束。
author: jjfrysen
source: An extremely aggressive Pokémon. POKENAME are known to fire beams of electricity from their mouth at the first sign of movement.

entry: 通常一个头储存电力，其他头负责思考。阳光明亮时，三颗头能同时发挥作用。
author: zespud
source: One head usually stores power, while the others do the thinking. In bright sunlight, they can utilize all three heads at once.

entry: 这些宝可梦生来就是手足，如今形影不离。飞行、吃饭，连睡觉都在一起。
author: .ssunday.
source: These Pokémon were born as siblings and are now inseparable. They fly together, eat together, and even sleep together.

entry: 用磁铁拉来伴舞者，参加仪式。一同起舞时，能在周围召来强大的雷击。
author: fountainihili
source: It uses its magnets to pull in backup dancers to participate in a ritual. Together, their dances can summon powerful lightning strikes around them.

entry: 被另外三只同类吸引过去后，POKENAME发生了进化。背上虽顶着灯泡，脑袋可没因此变得更“亮”。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME evolved because it got pulled towards three others of its kind. Even with the lightbulb on their backs, they aren't very bright.

entry: 身体由废金属与电气零件构成。体内储存的巨大能量，让它光是出现就如同电磁脉冲。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its body a mass of scrap metal and electrical parts. The amount of energy stored inside it causes its presence to act as an EMP.

entry: POKENAME高度戒备时，会用双手四处探查。遇险就拍动翅膀，产生致命静电作为护盾。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME uses its hands to search around while on high alert. If in danger, it'll flap its wings to produce deadly static electricity as a shield.

entry: 身体部件形状不规则，让POKENAME不停旋转。转动造成的晕动症常令它头昏眼花。
author: Staghorn
source: The irregular shape of POKENAME's body components means it is constantly spinning. They are often dazed due to the resulting motion sickness.

entry: POKENAME就像有意识的搭电线，会夹住想充电的东西，再用尾巴从附近物体抽取电力。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Acting as a sort of sentient jumper cable, POKENAME clamp onto things they want charged and use their tail to drain power from objects nearby.

entry: POKENAME背上的小发电厂如何做到无污染发电，至今仍是环境研究的课题。
author: .realthree
source: The mystery of how the small electrical factory on POKENAME's back produces power without pollution is the subject of ongoing environmental research.

entry: POKENAME长得像帕底亚一位知名主播，因此很受那位主播的粉丝欢迎。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Resembling the look of a popular streamer from Paldea, POKENAME has become a popular among fans of the streamer.

entry: 眼睛能看得极远。夜间会高高悬浮在空中，搜寻捕食者的踪影。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes can see for extremely long distances. At night, it will hover far above the ground, looking for predators.

entry: POKENAME天生爱捣乱，最爱切断整片街区的电力，欣赏人们脸上的表情。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A troublemaker by nature, POKENAME finds great amusement in severing power to entire neighborhoods and seeing the looks on peoples' faces.

entry: 有些人会把POKENAME误认成普通雪童子，但大多数人没那么容易上当。它讨厌正面冲突。
author: 8xviktor
source: While some mistake POKENAME for a regular Snorunt, most aren't as easily deceived. It hates head-on confrontation.

entry: 两个头分别带正电与负电，靠得太近就可能吸在一起。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Its two heads are positively and negatively charged. If they get too close, they may get stuck together.

entry: POKENAME磁性极强，会吸来附近所有金属，慢慢分解并从中获取能量。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is strongly magnetic and attracts everything metallic in its vicinity to slowly decompose it and generate energy from it.

entry: 倚在身上的大葱味道极苦，大多数菜肴都不适合用它烹调。
author: .izik
source: The leek that rests against its body tastes extremely bitter. Cooking with it is not recommended for most dishes.

entry: 它会制作美味的饭菜与大家分享，却从来不用自己的大葱。POKENAME本身煮熟后也很美味，但这种做法并不被人认可。
author: bobosmith01
source: It makes delicious meals that it shares with others, but it never uses its own leek. POKENAME makes a good meal when cooked, but this is frowned upon.

entry: 为大葱找到了完美的烹饪搭配后，POKENAME诞生了。它活得痛苦，却很美味，再也感受不到快乐。
author: Rooboid
source: Having found the perfect culinary companion to its leek, POKENAME is born. This Pokémon lives in pain, albeit delicious pain, and no longer feels joy.

entry: POKENAME能向背上的大葱中吹气，控制气流，奏出风笛般的旋律。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME can blow air through the leeks on its back. It can control the air flow to make melodies that sound similar to bagpipes.

entry: 如果丢失了大葱，它就会不停寻找新的大葱，甚至常常跑到农场里偷取。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it were to lose its leek, it would search endlessly for a new one. It often resorts to stealing from farms.

entry: 身体比石头还硬，休息时还会继续变硬。壳太硬后就会脱落，能用来熬汤。
author: .izik
source: Its body is harder than stone and grows even harder while it rests. The shell will be shed when it becomes too hard and can be used for soup broth.

entry: POKENAME通常具有敌意，会侵占其他鸟宝可梦的生活空间。它们喜欢偷走大葱鸭珍视的大葱，因此声名狼藉。
author: rihse
source: Typically hostile, POKENAME encroach upon the living spaces of other bird Pokémon. They are infamous for stealing the leeks coveted by Farfetch'd.

entry: POKENAME尾巴捆里最多能携带10种植物茎秆。每根都有多种用途，它们对此收藏十分自豪。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME can carry up to 10 different plant stalks in its tail bundle. They take pride in their collection of stalks, each suited for several uses.

entry: 随身的火把若不经常添柴，就会熄灭。POKENAME走动时会把散落的树枝与幼苗扔进火里。
author: .izik
source: The torch it carries will go out if it is not fed regularly. A POKENAME tosses loose twigs and saplings into the fire as it walks.

entry: 战斗时，会将棍子叼在嘴里，如军刀般挥舞。靠翅膀还能边飞边战。
author: .izik
source: It uses its stick like a saber during fights, holding it in its mouth. Using its wings, it can fight while flying in the sky.

entry: POKENAME寻找配得上自己的剑士持用，随时愿意来一场公平的决斗。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME seeks a worthy swordfighter to wield it. It is always up for a fair duel.

entry: POKENAME知道自己是根好棍子，十分自豪，总想以决斗证明这一点。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is filled with pride knowing it is a good stick, always eager to prove it with a duel.

entry: 耳朵能调整气流，配合翅膀，让POKENAME在空中转向十分灵活。
author: .izik
source: Its ears can be used to manipulate its aerodynamics. Combined with the use of its wings, a POKENAME has great mobility in the air.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，最喜欢和训练家玩抛接游戏。用的是孵化后不久得到的那根茎秆。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME is playful in nature. Its favorite game to play with its Trainer is fetch. It uses the stalk that it received with shortly after hatching.

entry: POKENAME的根常被做成节庆菜肴。根能迅速再生，因此很适合饲养。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's roots are often cooked for holidays. They can grow the roots back quickly, making them good Pokémon to own.

entry: POKENAME是让大葱长到巨大之后，才将其采收的大葱鸭。它用精神能量，操纵这副植物身体。
author: Jaycielantern
source: POKENAME are Farfetch'd that have let their leeks grow to gargantuan size before harvesting them. They control the plant body with spiritual energy.

entry: 它头顶的球茎不断抽出嫩绿的新芽。虽然看起来像可食用的植物，这些新芽却带有剧毒。
author: Staghorn
source: The bulbs on its head are constantly sprouting with new, green growth. Though these growths resemble edible plants, they are extremely toxic.

entry: 嘴里总叼着棍子，从没有厌倦抛接游戏的记录，能一连玩上数天。
author: greystorm101
source: It always carries a stick in its mouth. There are no documented cases of it growing tired of playing fetch, and will continue to play for days on end.

entry: POKENAME携带的蔬菜致密沉重，少有好吃的。
author: Staghorn
source: The vegetables POKENAME carry are dense and heavy, and are rarley good to eat.

entry: POKENAME已成了极致便利的象征。饥肠辘辘的旅人很难抵挡它的美味，因此如今在野外已很难遇见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME have become a symbol of extreme convenience. Few hungry travelers can resist its savor, so you're unlikely to find them in the wild anymore.

entry: POKENAME的舌头极干，还不断蜕皮。掉落的羽毛非常粗糙，不适合填枕头。
author: .izik
source: The tongue of a POKENAME is extremely dry and molts constantly. The feathers that fall from it are extremely coarse and shouldn't be used in pillows.

entry: POKENAME察觉猎物后，会从壳里探出几个头，随后再缩回去，等待出击。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will peak its heads out of its shell if it detects prey. It then hides its heads back inside the shell, waiting to strike.

entry: 狩猎时会把幼崽扔出去，分散猎物的注意。幼崽虽小，却能应付大多数战斗。
author: .izik
source: When hunting, it will throw its baby as a distraction. Despite its size, the infant can hold its own in most combat situations.

entry: 飞行中一发现猎物，就立刻俯冲而下。第二颗头会凶狠啄击，直到猎物无法动弹。
author: .izik
source: If it spots prey while flying, it will immediately descend on the creature. Using its second head, it will peck viciously until the prey is immobile.

entry: 主要在有雾的夜晚捕猎。发现猎物后便伸开双臂，疯狂冲向对方。
author: .izik
source: It primarily hunts on foggy nights. When it spots its prey to will dash wildly towards its victim, arms extended.

entry: 不断啄地寻找食物。尾巴能感知温度变化，天气炎热时会狂乱甩动。
author: .izik
source: It is constantly pecking at the ground, looking for food. Its tails can detect temperature changes, whipping wildly in hot weather.

entry: 用细细的半透明丝线悬挂在大树上。发现敌人后，会通知附近的其他POKENAME。
author: .izik
source: It hangs from large trees with a thin, translucent string. If it spots an enemy, it will notify any other POKENAME in the area.

entry: 会发出婴儿般的哭声，略有失真，仿佛从收音机里传出来。
author: .izik
source: It will let loose a cry that sounds like an infant. The cry is slightly distorted, as if being played over a radio.

entry: 奔跑时积蓄电力。后面头部的球体像电池，将能量存起来备用。
author: .izik
source: It charges electricity while it runs. The orb on its rear head preserves the power for later use much like a battery.

entry: 身上的叶片坚硬如石。它总刻意绕开水源，能离多远，就离多远。
author: .izik
source: The leaves that grow on its body are as hard as stone. It makes an active effort to never go near sources of water.

entry: 头位于身体下方，让它行走困难。更喜欢快速扇动叶片手臂，试着飞起来。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Due to its heads being beneath it, walking is a struggle for this Pokémon. It prefers to rapidly flap the leaves it has for arms to try to fly.

entry: 后面的头会自行活动，监视捕食者。一发现危险，就会接管身体的主要控制权。
author: .izik
source: The rear head moves on its own and keeps a lookout for predators. Should it see one, the head will take primary control of the body.

entry: 尾端的喙极为锋利。曾发现有些POKENAME能轻易击穿钢铁。
author: .izik
source: The beak on the end of its tail is extremely sharp. Certain POKENAME have been found to be able to break through steel with little effort.

entry: 主头的眼睛看不见光，只能感知热量的分布。因此，在夜间也能轻松狩猎。
author: .izik
source: The eyes on its main head are unable to see light, instead only being able to view heat patterns. With this sight it can hunt at night with ease.

entry: POKENAME是寄生生物，长得很快，原本的壳很快就装不下，只好寻找新的宿主。
author: pory
source: A parasitic being, POKENAME quickly outgrows its shell, needing to hunt for another host.

entry: 脸上的角其实是一根巨大的羽毛。战斗时，这根羽毛会变得比花岗岩还硬。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its face is actually one large feather. In combat, this feather will become harder than granite.

entry: POKENAME的两个猪鼻子都嗅觉敏锐。即使极为寒冷，农民也能请它嗅寻松露。
author: .ssunday.
source: Both of POKENAME's pig noses have a keen sense of smell. Farmers use it to sniff out truffles in the coldest conditions.

entry: 前爪锋利，能帮它摄入大量泥土，留待日后战斗使用。
author: .izik
source: Its front talons are extremely sharp. It uses them to consume large quantities of dirt for future use in combat.

entry: 只要发现有人靠近巢穴，它就会沿着峡谷壁飞快地向上滚去。以这种方式滚动，时速可达120英里。
author: .izik
source: It will rapidly roll up canyon walls if it sees anyone get too close to its nest. It can reach up to 120 mph rolling this way.

entry: 狩猎时主要以后腿站立，因此能在出击前悄无声息地移动。
author: .izik
source: It primarily stands on its rear legs while hunting. Doing this, it will be able to move in complete silence before it strikes.

entry: 只有POKENAME尾巴上的头看得见。移动时，会鸣叫着向主头指明方向。
author: .izik
source: Only the head on the tail of POKENAME can see. It will chirp directions to the main head to guide it while moving.

entry: 挖洞时会将几个头收近身体，再从小孔探出地面，等待猎物靠近。
author: .izik
source: While digging, it will pull its heads close to its body. Its heads will poke through small holes to the surface, waiting for prey to get close.

entry: 融合让POKENAME变得极不稳定，只有少数粒子还能留在物质世界。意识虽分散，却依旧运作正常。
author: entomoxie
source: Upon fusion, POKENAME become too unstable for all but a few particles to remain in the physical realm. Their minds, while split, function perfectly.

entry: POKENAME会搜寻猎物直到深夜。看到篝火后，便发出可爱的鸣叫，诱使旅人前来查看。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME search for prey late into night. It will chirp cutely if it sees a campfire, goading travelers to investigate the sound.

entry: 不知为何，嘟嘟选择了寄生，住进可怜的尼多兰体内，真真切切地从它嘴里和耳朵里长出来。
author: Drake Baku
source: For unknown reasons, Doduo has decided to become a parasite, inhabiting the poor Nidoran's body and literally growing out of its mouth and ear.

entry: 狩猎时会用利爪钩住洞顶。出击时以喙夹住猎物，向上拉进主要的嘴里。
author: .izik
source: It digs its talons into cavern ceilings while hunting. When it strikes, it clamps prey with its beak and pulls it up into its main mouth.

entry: 毛发不断生长，让它越年长行动越慢。毛质极其柔软，令丰缘商人垂涎。
author: .izik
source: The fur on its body grows without stopping, slowing its movement as it ages. The fur itself is extremely soft and coveted by merchants in Hoenn.

entry: 根据所有已知的航空学法则，POKENAME本该重得无法飞行。然而，这只头脑简单的双头宝可梦总在空中飞着。
author: akujules
source: According to all known laws of aviation, POKENAME should be too massive to fly. Yet, this simple-minded, two-headed Pokémon is always seen airborne.

entry: 它身体极轻，能无声地在树间跳跃。发现旅人后，便藏起来，等对方扎好营再发动袭击。
author: .izik
source: Its body is extremely light, allowing it to jump between trees without a sound. If it sees travelers, it will hide until they make camp, then strike.

entry: 它头顶的腿，跑得比身体下方的腿快得多。一受惊，就翻个身，撒腿逃走。
author: .izik
source: The legs on the top of its head are much faster than the legs on the bottom of its body. When startled, it will flip over and dash away.

entry: 喙中含有大量毒液。发现敌人后，几个头会轮流啄击，最后再以角补上最后一击。
author: .izik
source: It has copious amounts of venom in its beaks. Should it see a foe, it will alternate pecking with each head then finish them off with its horn.

entry: 手臂上的喙极其锋利。会用它们钳住猎物，再以中央的刀刃切入对方身体。
author: .izik
source: The beaks on its arms are extremely sharp. Using them, it latches onto its prey and cuts into its victim with its center blade.

entry: 两颗头的大脑几乎一模一样，很少争吵。唯一的例外，就是争抢训练家的抚摸。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its two heads contain nearly identical brains. The heads rarely ever fight, with one exception being over pets from their Trainer.

entry: 头上的鳍会随年龄变色。鳍变黑就代表年老，大部分时间都在休息。
author: .izik
source: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are black, it is considered elderly and spends most of its time resting.

entry: 头上的鳍会随年龄变色。鳍呈绿色，说明仍在青春期，脾气急躁。
author: .izik
source: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are green, it is still an adolescent and quick to anger.

entry: 头上的鳍会随年龄变色。鳍呈棕褐色就代表成年，会花时间寻找筑巢处。
author: .izik
source: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are tan, it is considered an adult and spends its time looking for a place to nest.

entry: 后面的头力量足以支撑整个身体。战斗时会伸长两条脖子，像鞭子一样甩动。
author: .izik
source: It has enough strength in its rear head to support its entire body. During a fight it will extend and swing both necks in a whip-like fashion.

entry: 主要在夜间活动，入夜后狩猎。以喙抓住猎物，再飞到高空将其扔下。
author: .izik
source: It is mostly nocturnal, hunting after nightfall. It will grab prey with its beaks then fly high in the air before dropping them.

entry: 身上的每张喙都有自己的胃。睡觉时也会下意识地一张一合，盼着白得一顿饭。
author: .izik
source: Each of the beaks on its body have their own stomach. It will passively open and close its beaks while sleeping, hoping for an easy meal.

entry: 会在树上一等数天，等待弱小猎物经过。一旦发现目标，就伸出尾巴抓住。
author: .izik
source: It will wait in trees for days at a time, waiting for weak prey to pass by. Once it spots a victim, it will extend its tail and snatch it.

entry: 头部羽毛间长出的毛簇每年夏天都会脱落。城都有些艺术家会用来制作画笔。
author: .izik
