source: The tufts of fur that grow out of the feathers on its head fall off every summer. Some artists in Johto use this fur for making paintbrushes.

entry: 身体充满空气。无论为何而跳起，想再落回地面都很费劲。
author: .izik
source: Its body is filled with air. If it decides to jump for any reason, it will struggle to descend back to the ground.

entry: POKENAME始终警觉地守望领地。尾端的头能向闯入者喷火。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME are always vigilant, keeping their eyes on their territory. The head on the end of its tail can spew flames at trespassers.

entry: 听力不佳，却能看见数英里之外。追逐猎物时会有节奏地蹦跳，发出如同痛苦生物般的尖叫。
author: .izik
source: While it has trouble hearing, its eyes can see for miles. It will hop rhythmically when chasing its prey, while screeching like a creature in pain.

entry: 吃饭或睡觉时，始终有一颗头负责警戒。几个头彼此沟通，精确定位猎物。训练有素的POKENAME是出色的警报器与哨兵。
author: totodile.
source: One head is always alert when eating or sleeping. The heads communicate to pinpoint prey. Trained POKENAME make excellent alarm systems and sentries.

entry: POKENAME高速奔跑，用利刺扎向沿途遇见的一切，从不停歇。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME runs at high speeds, poking anything it comes across with its sharp thorns. It never stops running.

entry: 看到食物时，全身的喙都会齐声叫嚷。随后躺在食物上滚动，让每张嘴都尝上一口。
author: .izik
source: Each beak on its body will squawk in unison if it sees food. It will then lay down on the food and roll, allowing each mouth to have a taste.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱夏天的个体，飞羽会呈绿色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be green if it prefers summer.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱春天的个体，飞羽会呈黄褐色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be tan if it prefers spring.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱秋天的个体，飞羽会呈棕色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be brown if it prefers autumn.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱冬天的个体，飞羽会呈白色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be white if it prefers winter.

entry: 能高速奔跑，沿途散播有毒孢子，阻止捕食者追赶。
author: synaesthesis
source: This Pokémon is capable of racing at high speeds. It emits poisonous spores in its wake to deter chasing predators.

entry: 飞行时会从翅膀洒下奇怪的粉末。若沾到人身上，必须彻底洗净，以免感染。
author: .izik
source: It sheds an odd powder from its wings while it flies. Should the powder land on a human, it must be washed off thoroughly to avoid infection.

entry: POKENAME后脚的利爪能攀上近乎垂直的悬崖。夜间，即使隔着数英里，也能看见山间燃烧的鬃毛。
author: rihse
source: The talons on POKENAME's back feet allow it to climb near vertical cliff faces. Its blazing manes can be seen on nighttime mountains miles away.

entry: 头上的脚很容易导电。常成群涌向变电站，吸收电力。
author: .izik
source: The foot on its head conducts electricity with ease. They flock en masse to power substations to absorb electricity.

entry: 身上的羽毛坚硬如石，却很轻，也很容易拔下来。
author: .izik
source: The feathers that grow from its body are hard as stone. Despite their firmness, they are very light and easily plucked.

entry: POKENAME的蛋味道极苦。若把蛋弄丢，几天内就会从不明来源再找到一枚。
author: .izik
source: The egg of a POKENAME is extremely bitter in taste. Should it lose its egg, it will find another one within days from an unknown source.

entry: POKENAME能窥见未来。可惜，每颗头看到的未来都不同，预测因此极不稳定。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: POKENAME can peek into the future. Unfortunately, each of its heads report different instances of the future, making predictions extremely erratic.

entry: 中间的头经常忘记吃饭，因此另外两颗头总在觅食。
author: .izik
source: The middle head frequently forgets to eat. Because of this, the other two heads are always foraging for food.

entry: POKENAME的主头能控制前两条腿，其他两颗头却各只能控制一条。后面的头觉得这很不公平。
author: .ssunday.
source: The main head of POKENAME gets to control the front two legs, while the other two heads only get one leg. The back heads think this is very unfair.

entry: 战斗时会分裂成几个部分，各自行动，战术像一支运动队。
author: .izik
source: During combat it will break apart into separate portions. Each moves on its own, with tactics that resemble a sports team's.

entry: 有人观看时，咆哮声会特别响亮。观众每多一人，声音就再大一些。
author: .izik
source: It roars loudest when someone is watching. The noise becomes progressively louder for each person watching it.

entry: 身体侧面长出的腿无力撑起身体，只能用来拖着自己向前。
author: .realthree
source: The limbs sprouting from its side are too weak to lift it. Instead, it pulls itself forwards with these legs.

entry: 外形虽粗犷，覆盖身体的金属却极为脆弱。质地类似铝，很容易撕开。
author: .izik
source: Despite its rough appearance, the metal that covers its body is extremely weak. The texture is similar to aluminum and easily torn.

entry: 用锋利的前爪攻击。爪甲坚硬如钢，能将敌人撕成两半。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp front claws to attack its enemies. The nails themselves are as hard as steel and able to rend foes in two.

entry: 会把身体埋满泥巴，一睡数天。一旦发现猎物，几个头便从泥中冒出，发出恐怖的叫声。
author: .izik
source: It will cover itself in mud and sleep for days. Should it spot prey, its heads will sprout up out of the mud and make a horrifying cry.

entry: 会用头啄巢穴附近的岩石，寻找晶洞。敲开后，就会吃掉里面的晶体。
author: .izik
source: It uses its head to peck at the rocks near its home in hopes of finding a geode. Should it crack one open, it will consume the crystals inside.

entry: 全身覆盖着极其锋利的鳞片。用喙就能灵巧轻松地攀上墙壁。
author: .izik
source: It has scales all over its body that are extremely sharp. Using its beaks, it will skillfully scale walls with ease.

entry: 每条脖子都能从身体伸出最远15英尺。发现猎物就会狂乱扑去，几颗头各自行动。
author: .izik
source: It can extend each of its necks up to 15 feet away from its body. Should it detect prey, it will lunge at it wildly, each head moving independently.

entry: 为得到训练家夸奖，三颗头会合作执行复杂计划。若其中一颗得到抚摸，另外两颗就会吃醋。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Seeking its Trainer's praise, its three heads execute complex plans between them. When one is being petted, the other two heads will be jealous.

entry: 只能离地飘起一点点。底部长出的头会一路拖着，擦过泥土。
author: CapWolfBane
source: It barely floats off the ground. The head sprouting from its bottom gets pulled along through the dirt.

entry: 唱诡异的摇篮曲让猎物入睡，再伸出长腿悄悄靠近，一边哼唱一边吃掉对方。
author: .izik
source: It will sing an eerie lullaby to lull its prey to sleep. Then, it extends its long legs to sneak up to the victim, consuming it while still humming.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在洞穴深处筑巢。讨厌阳光，长时间曝晒会让羽毛焦黑。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME prefers to make its nest deep in caverns. It hates the sunlight, as exposing it for long periods of time will char its feathers.

entry: POKENAME靠尾羽飞行，令科学家十分困惑。毕竟按所有航空学法则，它都不该飞得起来。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME flies using its tail feathers. Scientists are baffled by this, as according to all laws of aviation, a POKENAME should not be able to fly.

entry: POKENAME进化后，耐力比先前更强。能在草原上长途奔跑，无需休息。
author: synaesthesis
source: POKENAME has evolved to possess higher stamina than its predecessor. It can run long distances across grassy plains without rest.

entry: POKENAME极度饥饿时，其他头会从胸前的羽毛中冒出。不过，找到食物后依旧只有主头能吃。
author: .izik
source: When a POKENAME is excessively hungry, its other heads will emerge from the feathers on its chest. When food is found, only the main head will eat.

entry: 吃饱的POKENAME不需要让其他头冒出来。若吃得太撑，就会用力跳舞减重。
author: .izik
source: A well-fed POKENAME will never need to have its other heads emerge. If it is too full it will dance emphatically to lose weight.

entry: 生来就是为了战斗——主要是与自己战斗。若见到它不打架、安静和平的样子，就需要治疗了，因为它可能时日无多。
author: cyprexx
source: This Pokémon lives to fight—itself, mostly. If seen not fighting and at peace, it requires therapy, as it may not have long to live.

entry: POKENAME的几个头从不和睦，总是争吵。解决争端的方式，就是互相挥拳，直到只有一个头还清醒。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME'S heads never get along with each other and always bicker. To settle arguments, they punch each other until only one head remains conscious.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎只吃植物。看见想吃的草本植物时，会先吐上酸液，再咬下去。
author: .izik
source: Wild POKENAME very rarely consume anything but vegetation. If it spots an herb it wishes to eat, it will spit acid onto it before taking a bite.

entry: 用喙作岩钉，攀登陡壁。害怕失足跌落，因此远离松散碎石和泥地。
author: .izik
source: It uses its beaks as pitons for climbing up steep surfaces. It stays away from loose rubble or mud, fearing the fall if it loses its grip.

entry: 三个反复无常的脑袋经常决定不了往哪去。一旦想法一致，就能跑得快得吓人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its three capricious minds often cannot decide where to take it. When they do think alike, it runs frighteningly quick.

entry: POKENAME靠三套头、肺和心脏，能比平时奔跑更久。睡着的头越多，火焰般的毛发就越暗。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME uses its three sets of heads, lungs, and hearts to run for far longer than normal. Its fiery hair grows dimmer the more heads are asleep.

entry: 习惯数巢穴附近的冰柱。若数乱了，就会毫不犹豫地从头再来。
author: .izik
source: It habitually counts icicles near its nest. Should it ever lose count, it will start from the beginning without a second thought.

entry: POKENAME被用来监测步入式冷冻库的温度。若舌头变暖，就说明食物不安全了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME have been used as thermostats to determine the temperature of walk-in freezers. If its tongue becomes warm, the food is unsafe.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，光靠吃冰块就能生存，因此体内的水分总是充足。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, and is able to subsist entirely on the chunks of ice it consumes. It is always sufficiently hydrated as a result.

entry: POKENAME将自己裹在壳里，抵御冰川栖息地的寒冷，一直待到准备好进化。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME withstands the cold of its glacial habitat by encasing itself in a shell until it is ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的皮毛既能抵御对手的身体攻击，也能防护栖息地的刺骨严寒。
author: tuskaninny
source: The thick fur coating POKENAME's body acts as a layer of protection against both physical attacks from opponents and the bitter cold of its habitat.

entry: 头上的角坚硬如铁。在海里玩耍时，会用它将冰山劈成两半。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its head is as hard as iron. It uses it to break icebergs in half while playing in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的云浮力太大，很难潜水，因此大多数时间都在海面上悠闲休息。
author: chartanon
source: The clouds on POKENAME's arms are so buoyant that it struggles to dive underwater. It instead spends most of its time relaxing on the ocean's surface.

entry: 云朵般的身体能有效缓冲攻击。它不喜欢战斗，常乐于让小型宝可梦在肚子上弹跳。
author: chartanon
source: Its cloudy body acts as an effective buffer against attacks. It dislikes fighting, and is often content with smaller Pokémon bouncing on its belly.

entry: 在遥远而寒冷的北方，POKENAME会猎捕海豹球及其进化形，获取营养丰富的脂肪和温暖的皮毛。
author: malxire
source: In the regions far to the cold North, POKENAME hunts Spheal and its evolutions for their nutritious fat and warm fur.

entry: 天冷时，尾巴上的壳会发抖。暖季则会流出蓝色液体降温。
author: .izik
source: If it gets cold, the shell on its tail will tremble. During warmer seasons, the shell drools a blue fluid to keep cool.

entry: 这只小海狮凭灰色斑点与额头宝石便很容易辨认，已熟练掌握冰属性招式。
author: Mr. Person (Prinplup enjoyer)
source: This Seel can easily be spotted via its grey spots and the gem on its forehead. It has mastered Ice-type moves.

entry: 性情友善，游荡在冰冷环境中，几乎会帮助所有有需要的对象。但只要碰到冰冠，就会瞬间冻结。
author: PokePower
source: A friendly Pokémon that helps almost anyone in need as it wanders icy environments. If you touch its ice crown, you'll be frozen in an instant.

entry: 环绕POKENAME的缥缈薄雾，让它在雪中或水里仿佛消失了一般。鲜有人来得及在它消失前看清。
author: kiwikelly
source: The ethereal mist that surrounds POKENAME can make it seem to vanish when in snow or water. Few are those who have seen it before it disappeared.

entry: POKENAME身上的坚冰会随成长变得更牢固。会用角和两颗门牙凿下冰块食用。
author: tuskaninny
source: The solid ice adorning POKENAME's body becomes sturdier as it grows. It uses its horn and two front teeth to chip away at chunks of ice for its meals.

entry: POKENAME体内的冰，已经凝成一层坚硬外壳。保持这副模样，能做的事也不多，它便整天睡觉。
author: tuskaninny
source: The ice in POKENAME's body has hardened into a rigid outer shell. Much of its time is spent sleeping, as there is little else it can do in this form.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着极厚的皮毛，强大的獠牙连最坚固的冰川寒冰都能咬碎。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME is covered in an incredibly thick coat of fur. It can break apart even the toughest of glacial ice by using its formidable tusks.

entry: 十分保护喜欢的人。关于POKENAME引领水手穿越寒冷风暴的故事有很多。
author: Geminib
source: It's very protective of people it's fond of. There are many stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through frigid storms.

entry: 极光构成的缎带触感冰冷。身体越健康，缎带的色彩就越鲜明。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The aurora that makes up its ribbons is cold to the touch. The better its health, the more vividly these ribbons appear.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈、浮力充足，喜欢在海面蹦跳。同伴们经常赛跑取乐。
author: chartanon
source: Since it is so light and buoyant, POKENAME enjoys bouncing along the ocean's surface. Groups of POKENAME will often race against each other for fun.

entry: POKENAME栖息在港口城镇附近的水域，会为围观者表演杂技，是很受欢迎的观光亮点。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME resides in the water around portside towns and performs acrobatic tricks for bystanders. It is a popular tourist attraction.

entry: POKENAME体力惊人。会将制服的猎物夹在腋下，带到海滩吃掉，再晒太阳。
author: The_Fireplace
source: POKENAME boasts tremendous physical strength. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to the beach, then sunbathes after its meal.

entry: POKENAME很会潜水。常从结冰的海崖上一跃而下，从上方突袭猎物。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are extremely capable divers. They're often seen leaping from icy sea cliffs, surprising their prey from above.

entry: 能将体内储存的热量化为烈火喷出。尾巴与双腿让它既能高速奔跑，也能迅速游泳。
author: punkermachine
source: The heat stored inside its body can be expelled as a blazing fire. Its tail and legs make it capable of both running and swimming at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的体色随成长环境的气候而变化。在寒冷气候中长大，身体就会呈冷色调。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME changes its colors based on the climate it grows up in. If it is raised in a colder climate, the body reflects colder tones.

entry: POKENAME的体色随成长地区而变化。在温暖气候中长大，皮肤就会呈暖色调。
author: .izik
source: A POKENAME will change its colors based on the area it grows up in. Its skin will reflect a warmer tone if it grows up in a warmer climate.

entry: POKENAME会在北极光下聚集于冰架上。专家推测，极光能增强它们的催眠能力。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME gather on ice shelves under the northern lights. Experts theorize that the auroras strengthen its hypnosis abilities.

entry: 成群POKENAME用冰冷的爪子钻进冰山，借此穿越冰海。
author: kittyluv090
source: Colonies of POKENAME travel across icy seas by burrowing into icebergs with their frigid claws.

entry: 坚硬的外骨骼保护着内部柔软而有嚼劲的身体。会用巨钳挖开冰川筑巢。
author: mx_wellman
source: Its hard exoskeleton protects its soft and chewy innards. It makes its den by digging through glaciers with its huge claw.

entry: 能随意卸下巨钳。会倒挂着，将钳子落向猎物，把对方困住。
author: kittyluv090
source: It can detach its big claw at will. It traps prey by hanging upside down and dropping its claw onto them.

entry: POKENAME常试着将黏软的肢体变成各种形状，有些变完后就再也变不回原样。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME are often seen trying to morph their gooey limbs into different shapes. Some are unable to return to their original shape afterwards.

entry: POKENAME是城都地区入侵性极强的物种。黏液会污染植物，使其迅速死亡。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME is a highly invasive species in the Johto region. Its goo can contaminate plants and quickly kill them.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，会为天空披上一层浑浊烟雾。许多偏远村落将接连的酸雨归咎于它。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When POKENAME flies, it drapes the skies in a cape of murky smog. Many remote villages blame this Pokémon for periods of acid rain.

entry: POKENAME的污泥完全来自受污染海洋的淤泥。数量过多，通常就意味着污染正在加剧。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's grime is strictly made up of ooze from polluted oceans. Overpopulation of POKENAME usually means pollution is worsening.

entry: 一接触清水，羽毛就会大量脱落。为重新长出羽毛，会主动吃下垃圾。
author: .izik
source: Its feathers shed off in large quantities if it is exposed to clean water. In order to regrow the feathers, it will actively consume garbage.

entry: POKENAME身上寄生着嗜肉的捕蝇草，因臭气熏天，很少有训练家饲养。背上的捕蝇草有自己的意志。
author: Rooboid
source: Host to a flesh-hungry fly trap, POKENAME is rarely raised by Trainers because of its putrid smell. The fly trap on its back acts on its own volition.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在垃圾桶与垃圾箱旁逗留。垃圾吃得越多，颈部的宝石就越亮。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around trash cans and dumpsters. The gems around their neck glow brighter the more garbage they eat.

entry: 住在垃圾填埋场附近，寻找废弃书籍与纸张。为了繁殖，会吃掉找到的一切文字读物。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near landfills, looking for discarded books or paper. It will consume any literature it finds in order to multiply.

entry: 会以头顶的角为轴旋转，将毒污泥甩得到处都是。虽不是故意，人们却因此不喜欢它。
author: themicelegion
source: It spins on its top horn. When it does so, poison sludge is flung everywhere. It doesn't do this on purpose, but people don't like it for that reason.

entry: 体内不稳定的化学反应能产生电力，因此它经常摄取有毒物质。
author: mx_wellman
source: It generates its own electricity through an unstable chemical reaction within its body. Because of this, it regularly feeds on toxic substances.

entry: POKENAME的身体只是黏稠毒污泥的宿主。污泥会操纵身体大吃特吃，为进化做准备。
author: Rooboid
source: The body of POKENAME is merely a host to the viscous, toxic sludge upon it. The sludge steers the body to eat voraciously to prepare it for evolution.

entry: 污染的剑刃划出的伤口必会严重感染。若近战不奏效，就会甩出一块恶臭的剑穗攻击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A wound from its polluted blade is sure to cause a nasty infection. When melee combat doesn't do, it throws a chunk of its putrid tassel instead.

entry: POKENAME在污水处理厂帮助去除污染物。吃下有害物质后，只留下无菌的水。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME are used in sewage treatment plants to help remove pollutants. They eat the hazardous material, leaving behind only sterile water.

entry: 它会主动寻找有毒物质，吃进肚里。皮肤上滴落的污泥，曾被用于旧式除虫喷雾的配方。
author: .izik
source: It will actively search for toxic substances so that it can eat them. The sludge that drips off of its skin is used in old Repel recipes.

entry: POKENAME虽然迟缓，头脑看起来也不出众，却极其危险，连心智与机器都能吞食。
author: cyprexx
source: In spite of its slowness and unassuming intelligence, POKENAME are extremely dangerous and known to devour minds and machines alike.

entry: POKENAME常在废液池中游泳。脏水积在身上，形成厚厚一层黏滑恶臭的保护膜。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME are commonly found swimming in pools of waste. Filthy liquid accumulates on their bodies and forms a thick, slimy, rancid protective coating.

entry: POKENAME靠吃城镇的污物不断长大，直至进化。体形越大，领地意识越强，还会吞并较弱的同类。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME get bigger by eating a town's grimy waste until they evolve. Bigger POKENAME get more territorial, and will absorb weaker POKENAME into them.

entry: 嘴里的螺旋由黑白污泥组成。即使POKENAME被打昏，也会缓缓旋转、搏动。
author: Staghorn
source: The spiral in its mouth is made of black and white sludge. It slowly spins and pulses even when the POKENAME is knocked unconscious.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在盐水充沛的城市。黏污泥方便捕捉猎物，找到任何食物都会为之争斗。
author: gerakobitz
source: POKENAME are usually found in cities with lots of salt water. Their sticky sludge makes catching prey easier, and they fight for any food they find.

entry: POKENAME游动时会释放毒素，污染水体。毒素又能孕育出臭鱼，待臭鱼进化，便再次重复这个循环。
author: .ssunday.
source: When POKENAME swims around, it emits a toxin that pollutes the water. These toxins can create Grichou, which then evolve to repeat the cycle.

entry: POKENAME在白天战斗时，超能力最强。不过，污泥身体一被阳光照到，也会发出最难闻的恶臭。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities are most potent during daytime battles. However, its sludgy body emits the foulest odor when exposed to the sun.

entry: POKENAME一边用嘴吃垃圾，一边让尾巴吞下沿途的垃圾。有时同一样东西还会吃上两遍。
author: Kiwi Clown
source: POKENAME makes its tail gobble up trash they come across, while it also eats trash with its mouth. Sometimes they eat the same thing twice.

entry: POKENAME看着像小卡比兽，其实只是变成了它的模样，借此欺骗想照顾自己的人。
author: Rooboid
source: Though it resembles the body of a Munchlax, POKENAME has merely morphed to imitate its form, enabling it to deceive those who attempt to care for it.

entry: POKENAME能化成一滩紫色黏液。等其他宝可梦经过，就用利爪发动攻击。
author: watermelonchild
source: POKENAME is able to turn itself into a puddle of purple goo. It waits until other Pokémon come by and then it attacks with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME虽然外形如此，天性却极为友善。可惜，回抱它并不是个好主意。
author: Rooboid
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is incredibly friendly by nature. Sadly, returning POKENAME's hugs is ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME能以快得惊人的速度挥爪，但裹住下半身的污泥拖慢了它的移动。
author: Rooboid
source: While it is capable of swiftly clawing at its foes at breakneck speed, the sludge engrossing the lower half of POKENAME hinders its movement speed.

entry: POKENAME力量强横，外貌可怖，令人生畏。黏稠的皮肤能化成任何形状，无论是伸出的援手，还是剃刀般锋利的刃。
author: Rooboid
source: Feared for its relentless power and ghastly looks, POKENAME can morph its viscous skin into any shape, be that a helping hand or a razor-sharp blade.

entry: 诞生于一次实验室事故。几个桶内的有毒废料，赋予了这种融合体生命。
author: imagine1.
source: This fusion is the aftermath of a lab accident. The toxic waste inside multiple barrels has given life to this creature.

entry: POKENAME生活在受污染的水域，努力表现得高贵优雅，却仍有许多人被它的外貌吓退。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME resides in polluted bodies of water. It tries to act regal and graceful, but many people are repulsed by its appearance.

entry: 近年垃圾填埋场会请POKENAME清理垃圾，任何腐烂物或污染物都吃。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME has been employed in recent years by landfills to clean up the garbage; they will eat anything that has rotted or is a pollutant.

entry: 吸收了太多污染物，让POKENAME的身体结构严重失衡。只有尾巴还保持原样。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME has absorbed so much contamination that its body suffers from disproportionate anatomy. Only its tails remain unchanged.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢，看似不起眼，却会用超能力幻象困住受害者，再吞食其心智。若墙壁看起来在融化，它也许就在附近。
author: cyprexx
source: Slow and unassuming, POKENAME uses illusory psionics to trap victims before devouring their minds. If the walls appear to be melting, one may be near.

entry: 不到三毫秒就能缩进壳里。POKENAME必须费力，才能始终维持形状。
author: creeps_jr
source: It can retract into its shell in under three milliseconds. It takes effort for POKENAME to maintain its shape constantly.

entry: 以背甲上的迫击炮发射种子炸弹而闻名。越是成长，射得就越远、越准。
author: Soup1900
source: It is famously known to fire a Seed Bomb from the mortar on its shell. The more it grows, the farther and more accurate these shots will become.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，就把欢乐与娱乐带到哪里。在儿童生日派对上很受欢迎，夏季尤其如此。
author: its_cher_bicth
source: POKENAME bring fun and entertainment wherever they go. They are very popular at children's birthday parties, especially in the summer.

entry: 这只残暴的宝可梦进食时，会伏平身体，用一千颗牙齿撕碎身下剩余的一切。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: When this brutal Pokémon eats, it lays flat on its stomach, shredding apart anything remaining underneath it with one thousand teeth.

entry: POKENAME有能发射激光的微型炮，可炮的威力太小，射了也没有效果。
author: watermelonchild
source: POKENAME has miniature cannons which can shoot lasers. They don't have any effect since the cannon is not strong enough.

entry: POKENAME配备强大水炮与难以击穿的装甲壳，全副武装。曾在战争期间参加多场海战。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is heavily armed with strong water cannons and an impenetrable armored shell. During the war, they fought in many naval battles.

entry: 会巡视领地，用大量水流轰击不服管束的宝可梦。与拉普拉斯不同，谁想骑到它背上，它就会发狂。
author: PokePower
source: It patrols its territory, blasting any unruly Pokémon with a deluge of water. Unlike Lapras, it goes berserk if anything tries to ride on its back.

entry: 从两根触角喷出高压水柱，贯穿猎物。两股水流合一，能制造时速超过60英里的洋流。
author: Soup1900
source: It fires high-pressure water jets from its two antennae to puncture its prey. Combining these two blasts can create ocean currents of over 60 mph.

entry: 背部迫击炮射出的种子炸弹能在半空爆出缤纷色彩。人们用它制作美丽的烟火表演。
author: Soup1900
source: The Seed Bomb it fires from the mortar on its back can explode midair, creating a colorful boom. People use it to create beautiful fireworks shows.

entry: POKENAME的两个头会沟通，精确攻击1000码外的目标。有时也会被两种视角弄得头晕。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME has two heads that communicate to launch accurate attacks from over 1000 yards away. Sometimes it gets dizzy from the two viewpoints.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳能承受导弹撞击。挨打后便以大炮反击，炮击足以穿透砖墙。
author: Waluigi Time
source: The shell on POKENAME's back can withstand a missile impact. After an attack, it returns fire with cannons capable of punching through a brick wall.

entry: POKENAME凭强劲的大炮，几乎瞬间就能将甜甜的奶精准送给人群。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Thanks to its high-powered cannon, POKENAME can deliver its sweet milk to a crowd near-instantaneously, and with pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME的炮能发射石块与水。受威胁时就缩进壳内，用尾巴当重锤。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME is capable of shooting rocks and water from its cannons. When it feels threatened, it will hide in its shell and use its tail as a mace.

entry: 它从背上的两门大炮中发射种子，种在自己够不到的高处。它能将种子炸弹射到30,000英尺以外。
author: Soup1900
source: It launches seeds from the two cannons on its back to plant them in high places it cannot reach. It can fire Seed Bombs over 30,000 feet.

entry: 巨颚如今成了水炮，因此POKENAME很受消防员欢迎。
author: Mossybanana
source: Its jaws now function as a water cannon. As a result, POKENAME is a favorite amongst firefighters.

entry: 传说中的枪剑，据说被海难中沉没的海盗王附身。会击沉船只，迫使别人遭遇相同命运。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A legendary gun-sword said to be possessed by a shipwrecked, sunken pirate lord. It sinks ships to make others face its fate too.

entry: 缎带演化出了喷射高压水流的本领，水流强到足以击穿坚石。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its ribbons have adapted to spout highly pressurized bursts of water. These ribbons can fire water hard enough to tear through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME曾被尊为水流不绝的圣泉。如今，它的事迹已渐渐化作神话。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME was once revered as a sacred fountain with an endless flow of water. Its deeds have since faded into myth.

entry: POKENAME喷水的压力极强，能将自己反推数米。它喜欢用这种特别的方式逃跑。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can shoot water with such pressure that it propels itself back many meters. It likes to use this as an unconventional escape method.

entry: POKENAME每一门尾炮，都能喷出高压水流，射出的水也依然受它操控。
author: winchbeef
source: POKENAME is capable of unleashing highly pressurized water from each of its tail-cannons. It possesses control over the water it expels.

entry: 它会从炮管中喷出滚烫的蒸汽。这些蒸汽能造成4度烧伤，烧穿皮肤，甚至危及生命。
author: Soup1900
source: It ejects scalding steam from its cannons. This steam can cause 4th-degree burns, meaning it'll burn through your skin and potentially kill you.

entry: 长年持续冥想，让身体十分脆弱。战斗时会召出一对强大炮管，猛烈喷射水流。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Its body is frail from years of nonstop meditation. In combat, it will summon a pair of powerful cannons that shoot water with great force.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的炮管变得更加灵活，便于瞄准。如今，水炮不仅威力更强，也打得更准。
author: Skymaster426
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME more flexible cannons with which to aim. Its water blasts have increased in power, as well as precision.

entry: POKENAME的炮实际上由背上的大舌贝控制，因此射击极准，毫无死角。
author: VoxPoss
source: POKENAME's cannons are actually controlled by Shellder on its back. As a result, it's able to shoot extremely accurately and have no blind spots.

entry: POKENAME是一位身怀绝技、藏有秘密身份的半水生宝可梦。人们常看见它与大牙人偶交战，而且大多是它获胜。
author: aregularbigjoke
source: POKENAME is a semi-aquatic Pokémon of action with a secret identity. It is seen battling a Bimime and winning a large majority of the time.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今它的甲壳坚不可摧，连炮火也无法伤害它。
author: Zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its shell is now indestructible; not even cannon fire can harm it.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAME极为相似。背上巨大的炮管，让它像一辆长了腿的坦克。
author: Soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME. The large cannon on its back makes it look like a tank with legs.

entry: 它长得像超极巨化POKENAME。壳上足足有31门炮，会朝敌人不停地倾泻炮火。
author: Soup1900
source: Its appearance is similar to that of Gigantamax POKENAME. It has 31 cannons on its shell that it barrages endlessly against its foes.

entry: 毛发极硬，只有湿润后才容易塑形。这些纤维会被用来制作时装秀的服装。
author: .izik
source: Its hair is extremely hard and will only become malleable when wet. The fibers are used in clothing that is worn in fashion shows.

entry: POKENAME收集物品，再用舌头打磨至闪亮。有些寻宝者会养它，帮忙清理找到的宝物。
author: rhysanthemum
source: POKENAME collect objects, then polish them with their tongues until they shine. Some treasure hunters keep them to help clean their findings.

entry: 水手会用成群POKENAME向舰队其他成员传信。它们的壳柔软，能随意改变形状。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME are used by sailors to send messages to other members of their fleet. Their shells are soft and able to change shape at will.

entry: 脸上坚硬的壳能挡住大部分伤害。战斗时会合上壳，一头撞向敌人。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The hardened shell on its face will protect it from most damage. When they fight, they will close their shells and charge head first into foes.

entry: 据说溺亡的孩子会变成POKENAME，而非小木灵。那片冰冷的水域令它们始终颤抖不止。
author: .ssunday.
source: It's said children who have drowned turn into POKENAME, instead of Phantump. POKENAME constantly shake and shiver from the icy waters they come from.

entry: POKENAME背上长着海鲜菇，人们常把这些蘑菇用在海鲜料理里。
author: .realthree
source: Clamshell mushrooms grow on POKENAME's back. It's common practice to use these mushrooms as an ingredient in seafood dishes.

entry: 日晒过多，头上的壳就会干裂。舌头滴下的唾液可以食用，味道酸爽。
author: .izik
source: If exposed to too much sunlight, the shell on its head will dry out and crack. The saliva that drips from its tongue is edible and has a tangy flavor.

entry: POKENAME虽看着像呆壳兽，许多方面却截然不同。经常与呆壳兽争夺领地。
author: kittyluv090
source: While POKENAME may look like a Slowbro, it is actually quite different in many ways. It often fights with Slowbro for territory.

entry: 从鼻子高速射出气泡，将珊瑚击成小块吃下。
author: .izik
source: It shoots bubbles at high speeds from its nose to break coral into smaller pieces, which it then feeds on.

entry: POKENAME的壳受过重伤之处会长出尖刺。刺最多的一只，被认为是族群的首领。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME will grow spikes on its shell where it has sustained substantial injury. Those with the most spikes are assumed the alpha of their clan.

entry: POKENAME沿崖壁滑翔攻击猎物。天生的铠甲极其坚韧，入水后却容易崩缺。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME glides across cliff sides to attack prey. Its natural armor is incredibly tough, but chips easily in water.

entry: POKENAME在陆地受威胁时，会脱下触角上串着的珍珠。只需几天，珍珠就会重新长出。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When threatened on land, POKENAME will shed the pearls strung along its feelers; its pearls will be replaced in only a matter of a few days.

entry: 能在海中高速推进，却很不擅长转弯。
author: .izik
source: It can propel itself forward in the sea at great speeds, but has trouble with making turns.

entry: 聪明狡猾，偏爱潜行而非正面猛攻。若看见冰锥仿佛凭空接连射来，多半就是它干的。
author: JaycieLantern
source: A clever, sneaky fusion that favors stealth over full frontal assault. Blame it if you witness a barrage of Icicle Spears seemingly from nowhere.

entry: 外形虽显眼，却能藏进任何地形。POKENAME等待良机，将尖刺深深射进敌人体内。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its looks, this Pokémon can conceal itself in any terrain. POKENAME waits for the right moment to strike, launching spikes deep into a foe.

entry: POKENAME经常一脸坏笑。以为有壳保护就能肆意捣乱，其实身上有好几处弱点。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME often wears a malicious expression. It thinks that its shell protects it as it causes mischief, but it actually has several weak spots.

entry: 古代部落会用POKENAME脱落的壳制成铠甲，将钳子改造成战斗用的护手。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tribes utilized discarded POKENAME shells for creating armor. The pincers were fashioned into gauntlets used in combat.

entry: 遭亵渎尸体的灵魂附上了挖出它的卡拉卡拉，以骨头为武器。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The spirit of a desecrated body possesses the Cubone who dug it up and wields its bone as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME会产生气态氯化钾，从头部、嘴和尾巴排出。紫色的火焰便由此而来。
author: GP423
source: POKENAME produces a gaseous form of potassium chloride that is expelled from its head, mouth, and tail. This is what causes its purple-colored fire.

entry: POKENAME虽有强壮的颚，却只吃腐肉。身体由气体构成，不能在水下待太久。
author: 8xviktor
source: In spite of it possessing strong jaws, POKENAME only feed on carrion. Due to their gassy composition, they can't stay submerged in water for too long.

entry: 裙子由亡魂附着的枯萎花瓣组成。许多花店会献上枯花，向它示好求和。
author: auroraeuphoria
source: Its skirt is made of possessed dead petals. Many florists offer dead flowers to them as a peace offering.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME的气态花瓣闪闪发亮。强烈阳光下，则如火焰般耀眼。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When exposed to the moonlight, POKENAME's gaseous petals glimmer radiantly. Under bright sunshine, they shine like fire.

entry: 气态身体靠项链的封印之力聚拢成形。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Its gaseous body is held together by the sealing power of its necklace.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴似乎被恶灵附身。另一颗头目前似乎还乐于旁观。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME's tail appears to be possessed by a malevolent spirit. The second head seems content to watch, for now.

entry: 碰到气态尾巴的东西，都会像喷枪上色般染成紫色。奇怪的是，颜色总在午夜前褪去。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Anything which comes in contact with its gaseous tail will be stained purple, as if airbrushed. Strangely, the color always fades by midnight.

entry: 这块盾甲化石被灵魂附身了。POKENAME有钢铁般的脸和气雾身体，没有实体上的弱点。
author: robosoup
source: This Shield Fossil has become possessed. With an iron face and a vaporous body, POKENAME has no physical weak points.

entry: POKENAME的柄与头由气体相连。意识虽在柄中，头却凝聚着逝者的悲伤。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's handle and head are gaseously linked. Though its mind is in the handle, its head embodies the grief of the dead.

entry: POKENAME的“剑刃”由气体构成，看似无害。一旦渗入血肉，就会从内部使其中毒。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's "blade" may seem harmless as it is made of gas, but once it permeates flesh, it poisons it from the inside.

entry: 会出现在宠物刚刚离世的人家中。虽然身体由气体构成，训练家却说，它卧在膝上时依然能感觉到。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It appears in the homes of people whose pets have recently passed. Despite being made of gas, Trainers say they feel it when it lays on their laps.

entry: 小巧却阴险，笑声癫狂。所到之处都会散播有害毒素。
author: Baneful Bunker
source: A small but sinister Pokémon with a maniacal laugh. It spreads harmful toxins around wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢捉弄人。突然出现在视线中，又迅速消失，把人吓一跳，纳闷它究竟去了哪里。
author: Sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to prank people. It appears in someone's sight and then quickly vanishes, scaring the person and making them wonder where it went.

entry: POKENAME的身体有47.5%由气体构成，轻得连飞行都不需要了。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: POKENAME's body is composed of 47.5% gas, and is light enough that it no longer needs to fly.

entry: POKENAME轻如空气，喜欢浮在训练家肩头。久了虽然烦人，可它太黏人，完全不懂对方的苦恼。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is as light as air. It tends to hover over its Trainer's shoulder. This gets annoying after a while, but it's too affectionate to understand.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮物品。会躲进废弃建筑避开强风，在外人看来像诡异闪烁的光点。
author: Essie
source: POKENAME adore collecting shiny objects. They will hide from strong winds in abandoned buildings, looking to outsiders like eerie, flickering lights.

entry: 它产生的气体会让吸入者暴怒。别带POKENAME一起开车，否则你会患上路怒症。
author: themicelegion
source: The gas this Pokémon produces causes extreme anger in anything that breathes it. Don't drive with POKENAME, it will give you road rage.

entry: POKENAME极为记仇，永远不会忘记伤害过自己的面孔。得罪它的人，会被拖进坟墓。
author: OhOk3441
source: POKENAME is incredibly vengeful, never forgetting the faces of those who hurt it. It'll drag people who've wronged it to their grave.

entry: POKENAME平静时，散出的雾触感清凉。战斗时温度升高，能够灼伤对手。
author: OhOk3441
source: When calm, the mist POKENAME produces is cool to the touch. In battle, it rises in temperature to burn opponents.

entry: 充满活力，以狩猎为乐。POKENAME从远处纠缠猎物，收集到足够的恐惧后，就会放过对方。
author: themicelegion
source: A lively Pokémon that lives for the hunt. POKENAME haunts prey from a distance. Once it has gathered enough fear, it leaves the prey alone.

entry: POKENAME熟谙战斗规则，训练家也一样。他们满心只想着全力以赴，绝不放弃。
author: fauxblue
source: No stranger to battle, POKENAME knows the rules, and so does their Trainer. They are always thinking of a full commitment and would never give up.

entry: 只有在半梦半醒的状态下才能发现POKENAME。最爱吞食幼童的噩梦。
author: strawbearycandy
source: Only able to be found in the liminal state between wakefulness and sleep, POKENAME delights in feeding on the nightmares of young children.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影中，寻找能被自己催眠的人。成功后就吸取睡者的灵魂，增强自身力量。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows and looks for people it can put to sleep. When its successful, it will absorb the sleeper's soul to increase its power.

entry: POKENAME能在星界操纵四肢，踢出从肉体角度看几乎不可能的招式。
author: entomoxie
source: With control of their limbs across the astral plane, POKENAME can launch kicks that otherwise seem physically impossible.

entry: 这只拉达曾是某人队伍中的战斗主力。死后葬在紫苑镇，却又从墓中归来。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A Raticate that was once a key battler in someone's party. It came to its end and was buried in Lavender Town, where it came back from the grave.

entry: POKENAME将形状不定的身体塑成尽可能恐怖的模样，潜伏在暗处吓唬路人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME molds its amorphous body to the most terrifying appearance it can, lurking in the dark to scare passers-by.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME被附身的状况愈发严重。如今，双方正在争夺身体的控制权。
author: Atlas333
source: After evolution, POKENAME's previous possession has worsened. Now the two fight for control of the body.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃的小屋中，邀请迷途旅人进屋。一边照料对方，一边吸取其生命力。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned cottages. It invites lost travelers into its home, where it cares for them while also draining them of their vitality.

entry: 一哭就是数小时，谁也不知道原因。
author: bucklin
source: It cries for hours and hours. No one is aware of the reason.

entry: 一哭就是数小时，谁也不知道原因。
author: bucklin
source: It cries for hours and hours. No one is aware of the reason.

entry: 别理会缎带的招手，远离POKENAME锁链所及之处。它的牙齿会迅速吸尽受害者的生命。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Ignore its ribbon's beckoning and stay clear of the range of POKENAME's chain. Its teeth quickly suck its victims' lives away.

entry: 外貌虽令人不安，性情却十分亲人。可惜，舔一下就可能让训练家麻痹。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This Pokémon, despite its unnerving appearance, is very affectionate. Unfortunately, its licks have been known to paralyze its Trainer.

entry: 会用多只手从不同方向招引受害者。睡觉时，将自己藏进阴影里。
author: .towerxvi
source: It uses multiple hands to beckon victims in different directions. It cloaks itself in shadows while it sleeps.

entry: 这只恶鸟极为凶暴。光是待在附近，就会令人不安。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: This malevolent bird can be incredibly aggressive. Even staying in their vicinity can cause unease.

entry: 三只一组行动，寻找目标并吸取能量。据说三只POKENAME关系足够亲密时，就会进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They work in groups of three to find a target and drain their energy. When three POKENAME become very close, it is thought an evolution will occur.

entry: 比一团积尘还轻，因此跑得飞快。常四处捉弄训练家，却从不让人看见罪魁祸首。
author: .ssunday.
source: This fusion is a quick runner, as it weighs less than a dust bunny. It usually runs around pulling pranks on Trainers, who never see the culprit.

entry: POKENAME主要靠翅膀上的脸状花纹自卫。很少有捕食者能承受那直透灵魂的凝视。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME's primary defense mechanism is the face-like pattern on it's wings. Few predators can withstand its soul piercing gaze.

entry: 鲜有人看过它的口腔。据说看过的人都被困在另一个次元，再也无法逃出。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Few have ever seen inside of this Pokémon's mouth. Those who have are said to be trapped in another dimension, from which they cannot escape.

entry: POKENAME的身体由骨骼化石、灵质与投射的幻象组成。根据各自独特的组成，便能区分个体。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is made up of fossilized bone, ectoplasm and projected illusions. Individuals can be identified by their particular compositions.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿人们的影子恶作剧。但遇见山中迷途者，便会领着对方回家。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME loves playing pranks on people by mimicking their shadows, but if it encounters someone lost in the mountains, it will guide them home.

entry: 被称为“行走的鬼火”，会跟人回家，夺走生命。吞噬灵魂后，火焰便燃成深紫色。
author: Skymaster426
source: It is known as "The Walking Wisp", following people home to steal their life away. When it consumes a soul, Its flames burn a deep purple.

entry: 体形与翅膀让它更加敏捷。夜间无声飞行，靠凝视将目标麻痹。
author: creeps_jr
source: Its body size and wings allow it to be much more agile. It silently flies at night and paralyses its targets by staring at them.

entry: 据说POKENAME脑中尽是最卑劣、邪恶、恐怖的念头。若有足够力量，它就会毁灭世界。
author: RetroCrow
source: It is said that only the most putrid, evil, and horrific thoughts go through POKENAME 's mind. If it had the power to, it would end the world.

entry: POKENAME虽然颜色鲜艳，却擅长在阴影中潜行。夜间在城市游荡，捉弄居民。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Despite its vibrant colors, POKENAME is a master at sneaking through the shadows. It roams around cities at night, pranking civilians.

entry: POKENAME夜间出没，躲在阴影里，用阴森的笑声吓人。它本身倒长得不太吓人。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: POKENAME come out at night, lurking in shadows and scaring people with its haunting laughter. Its own appearance isn't very frightening.

entry: 进化彻底完成，POKENAME也已被完全夺舍。如今余下的，只有一只以他人的痛苦为乐的亡灵。
author: Atlas333
source: Now fully evolved, POKENAME's possession is complete. Now all that remains is a spirit that takes pleasure in the pain of others.

entry: 听见脚下传来低语时，POKENAME也许就在那儿。它正等猎物掉进附近的坑，饱餐对方的灵魂。
author: bobosmith01
source: When you hear whispers beneath you, POKENAME may be there. It is waiting for prey to fall into a nearby pit, where it will feast on their soul.

entry: 实验赋予了它惊人的速度与知识。会凭这些本领环游世界，尽可能体验一切。
author: Skymaster426
source: Experimentation has granted this Pokémon extreme speed and knowledge. It uses these gifts to travel the world and experience all it can.

entry: POKENAME能制造足以沉船的漩涡。有些人认为它是在寻求友谊，想找到意气相投的灵魂。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME has been known to create whirlpools large enough to sink ships. Some believe it's searching for friendship, hoping to find kindred spirits.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴既是武器，又是一只额外的眼球，让人很难伏击它。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's tail serves as both a weapon and an extra eyeball, which makes ambushing it a difficult task.

entry: 用电线麻痹受害者，再让对方入睡，吃掉其梦境。
author: homelessrager
source: Using its electric wires, it puts its victims into a state of paralysis, letting it put them to sleep and eat their dreams.

entry: 这个POKENAME变体，最初只是用来恶搞某个社群服务器的管理员。谁也不知道它为何获得了生命。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME was initially just an attempt to troll the moderators of a certain server. No one knows why it was brought to life.

entry: POKENAME出没于沼泽，会现身在陷入深泥的人和宝可梦面前。只阴森地注视，既不安慰，也不施救。
author: char_latte3412
source: Found in marshes, POKENAME will appear to people and Pokémon stranded in deep bogs. It watches ominously, providing neither comfort or assistance.

entry: 夜间跟踪受害者取乐。照镜子时，或许能看见它站在身后，可一转身，它又消失了。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon stalks its victims at night for fun. If you were to look in a mirror, you might see it standing behind you, vanishing as you turn around.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME错当成穿戏服的孩子。能召出阴影助战，不过更多时候只拿来炫耀。
author: 8xviktor
source: Many mistake POKENAME for costumed children. It's capable of conjuring shadows to aid it in battle, although it uses them more often to show off.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在废弃宅邸里。据说与它第三只眼对视的人，会遭遇厄运。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME loves to live in abandoned mansions. It is known to give bad luck to those who see into its third eye.

entry: 生性狡猾，喜欢制造混乱。常以扒窃取乐，不合眼缘的东西就直接扔掉。
author: 8xviktor
source: This deceitful Pokémon has an affinity for causing chaos. It often pickpockets people for fun and throws away any item that doesn't catch its eye.

entry: 深夜若感到寒意，就快跑到最近的亮处，留意阴影。也许是POKENAME来索取你的生命力了。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: If you feel a chill in the dead of night, run into the nearest light and watch for shadows. It may be a POKENAME coming to claim your life force.

entry: POKENAME出现在最近的一则广告里。有趣的是，融合它的是两位互为劲敌的训练家。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME was featured in a recent commercial. Interestingly, it was two rival Trainers who fused their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，只在夜间现身。用悦耳旋律引猎物入水，再拖进深处。
author: Thora Daughn
source: POKENAME lives in swamps and only appears at night. It catches prey by singing a melodic tune, luring them into the water to drag into the depths.

entry: 据说被POKENAME双翼劈成两半的对象，灵魂也会被摧毁，无法前往来世，彻底消失。
author: VaporVenator
source: It's said those split in two by the wings of POKENAME have their souls eviscerated, denying them an afterlife and erasing them entirely.

entry: 与训练家同行时，喜欢藏在对方的影子里。被幽灵手臂碰到，会感到强烈寒意。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: When walking with its Trainer, it prefers to hide in their shadow. If you are touched by its ghostly arms, you will experience a strong chill.

entry: POKENAME出现在最近的一则广告里。有趣的是，融合它的是两位互为劲敌的训练家。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME was featured in a recent commercial. Interestingly, it was two rival Trainers who fused their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME战斗起来，凶狠而毫无节制。它总想先摧垮敌人的意志，再毁掉身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME fights viciously and without restraint. It aims to break a foe's spirit first, then their body.

entry: 午夜时分，POKENAME会俯冲抓走猎物，带往不明之处。这时，云会遮住月亮。
author: Skymaster426
source: At midnight, POKENAME swoops down to snatch up prey to take them to somewhere unknown. Clouds cover the moon when this happens.

entry: POKENAME战斗起来，凶狠而毫无节制。它总想先摧垮敌人的意志，再毁掉身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME fights viciously and without restraint. It aims to break a foe's spirit first, then their body.

entry: POKENAME战斗起来，凶狠而毫无节制。它总想先摧垮敌人的意志，再毁掉身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME fights viciously and without restraint. It aims to break a foe's spirit first, then their body.

entry: 这个POKENAME变体格外悲观冷漠。古老传说暗示，它曾侍奉某位“破败之王”。
author: 8xviktor
source: This variant of POKENAME is significantly more pessimistic and apathetic. There's an old folktale which implies that it once served a ruined king.

entry: 传闻POKENAME来自另一个世界，天生就是调皮的恶作剧专家。
author: theartemis1
source: Rumors suggest that POKENAME originate from another world. They are mischievous tricksters by nature.

entry: 传闻POKENAME来自另一个世界，天生就是调皮的恶作剧专家。
author: theartemis1
source: Rumors suggest that POKENAME originate from another world. They are mischievous tricksters by nature.

entry: POKENAME最爱挑起争斗，而且通常专挑不容易获胜的。被打败后，又会若无其事地站起来。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME enjoys starting fights above anything—usually ones that it can't win easily. After being defeated, it gets up as if nothing happened.

entry: 两颗头彼此密谋，盘算着恶作剧。会轮流吓人，较量谁更可怕。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: Its two heads plot amongst themselves, looking to cause mischief. They take turns scaring people, competing to see which of them is scarier.

entry: POKENAME脑中不断琢磨着如何残忍地折磨别人。唯一阻止它付诸行动的，就是懒惰。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is constantly thinking of methods to torment others in cruel, sadistic ways. The only thing holding it back is its laziness.

entry: POKENAME恶意十足，又亢奋好动，十分凶暴。幸好，它能集中注意力和记住事情的时间都短得惊人。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME is a violent combination of malicious and hyperactive. Thankfully, its attention span and memory retention are astonishingly short.

entry: POKENAME常与黑暗皇结伴。它原本动不动就暴走，和黑暗皇一起时却会选择克制——通常如此。
author: mirby
source: POKENAME tends to form a partnership with Murbull. POKENAME has a tendency to rampage, but when paired with Murbull it chooses not to. Usually.

entry: 融合唤醒了POKENAME沉睡的基因。小小的身体不断散发出不稳定的幽灵能量。
author: 8xviktor
source: Fusion has awakened POKENAME's dormant genes. It constantly emanates unstable spectral energy from its small body.

entry: POKENAME与逝去亲族的灵魂同行，齐心协力，击败眼前的一切威胁。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME travels with the spirit of its deceased kin. They work in tandem to take down any threat before them.

entry: POKENAME的四只眼睛让它轻松发现猎物。唾液中的毒素能迅速麻痹捉到的对象。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's four eyes help it spot prey easily. Its saliva contains a toxin that quickly paralyzes whatever it catches.

entry: POKENAME躲在阴影里，用长翅膀给别人挠痒痒。可咯咯笑声总会暴露它的位置。
author: shayzis.ozaki
source: POKENAME uses its long wings to tickle others from the shadows. Its giggles gives it away.

entry: 融合后，两个意识仍彼此分离。耿鬼控制身体，七夕青鸟只能旁观。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: The fusion process kept both consciousness separated, Gengar taking control of the body while Altaria can only watch.

entry: 融合后，两个意识仍彼此分离。耿鬼控制身体，七夕青鸟只能旁观。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: The fusion process kept both consciousness separated, Gengar taking control of the body while Altaria can only watch.

entry: POKENAME的毒花蜜用量准确时能够治病。可一旦剂量出错，就可能引起严重幻觉，甚至死亡。
author: malxire
source: In the correct amount, POKENAME's toxic nectar can be used to cure illness, but any mistake in the dosage can cause severe hallucinations and death.

entry: POKENAME身上的真菌产生了意识，彻底榨干宿主，只留下灰色空壳。它们的行动能力十分有限。
author: 8xviktor
source: The fungi on POKENAME have become sentient and completely drained the host, leaving a grey husk behind. They have very limited mobility.

entry: 远古的夜晚，它无声地游荡在苔原，张开可怕的颈褶吓唬其他宝可梦，再吞食对方的恐惧。
author: wigglypon
source: In the nights of ancient times, it silently roamed the tundra. It startled other Pokémon by flaring its frightening frill, then fed upon their fear.

entry: POKENAME用美妙歌声引人靠近。气氛正好时，却突然爆发刺耳尖叫，让受害者暂时失聪。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME lures people in with its beautiful singing. Once the mood has been set, it's broken by its violent scream, temporarily deafening the victim.

entry: POKENAME用阴森的嗓音惊吓毫无防备的受害者，以欣赏对方的反应为乐。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME uses its haunting voice to scare unsuspecting victims. It finds enjoyment in seeing their reactions.

entry: POKENAME的白毛干燥扎手。战斗时能用鬃毛抓住对手。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's white fur is dry and scratchy. In battle, it can use its mane to grab opponents.

entry: POKENAME感到被威胁或挑战时，会进入这种形态。难以预测的性情与蛮力，让它很难对付。
author: 8xviktor
source: When it feels threatened or challenged, POKENAME enters this form. Its unpredictable nature and brute strength make it difficult to fight against.

entry: POKENAME感到被威胁或挑战时，会进入这种形态。难以预测的性情与蛮力，让它很难对付。
author: 8xviktor
source: When it feels threatened or challenged, POKENAME enters this form. Its unpredictable nature and brute strength make it difficult to fight against.

entry: POKENAME主要以人类的噩梦为力量来源。每吞食一个噩梦，背上的弯月就更亮一些。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's main source of power is the nightmares of humans. The crescent moon on its back glows brighter with each nightmare it consumes.

entry: POKENAME习惯毫无预兆地咬人。接触唾液，可能会使人对其产生过敏。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME has a habit of biting people without warning. Exposure to its saliva may cause one to become allergic to it.

entry: POKENAME由灵质构成的肌肉受外伤后会变硬。可惜头脑不够灵光，无法充分发挥力量。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's ectoplasmic muscles harden in response to physical trauma. However, it's not smart enough to utilize its strength to its fullest potential.

entry: 如果你的影子发出嗡嗡声，可要小心了。只要身上带着任何金属物品，POKENAME就会用50,000伏的电流电击你。
author: judedadude09
source: If your shadow makes buzzing noises, be careful. Having any sort of metal object on your person will make POKENAME electrocute you with 50,000 volts.

entry: POKENAME由最邪恶的灵魂构成，吞食恶念，转化为致命毒素，供自身成长。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: A body made up of the most evil spirits, POKENAME feasts on evil desires and transforms them into a lethal poison which it uses to grow.

entry: POKENAME思念母亲，于是凿出一顶形似母亲的石盔戴上。靠它便能在地下钻行。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Missing its mother, POKENAME chiseled and wears a stone helmet in their likeness. With it, it can burrow through the ground.

entry: POKENAME用巨大、岩石般坚硬的脚反复跺地，引发小型地震。
author: frohg_maro
source: With their massive, rock-hard feet, POKENAME can repeatedly stomp on the ground, creating small earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME用巨大、岩石般坚硬的脚反复跺地，引发小型地震。
author: frohg_maro
source: With their massive, rock-hard feet, POKENAME can repeatedly stomp on the ground, creating small earthquakes.

entry: 靠吃宝石维持各种晶体的能量与健康。多次出现POKENAME的地区，经常会掀起淘金热。
author: char_latte3412
source: It will feast on precious stones to keep its various crystals charged and healthy. Regions with multiple POKENAME sightings often spark gold rushes.

entry: POKENAME不善游泳，岩石身体拖慢了速度。睡觉时，多数游泳者会把它当成石头。
author: .ssunday.
source: A POKENAME is a bad swimmer, as its rock segments slow it down. While sleeping, most swimmers mistake it for a rock.

entry: POKENAME用超能力在地下钻行，寻找作为食物的各种岩石。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME will burrow through the ground, seeking the various rocks that make up its diet.

entry: POKENAME不停在地下钻行，连睡觉也不例外。灵敏的磁铁让它不迷路，吃下矿物则能强化身体。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME constantly burrow into the  ground even when asleep. It has a sensitive magnet to not lose its way. It consumes minerals to toughen its body.

entry: POKENAME一边啃穿地层，一边摄取矿物，让外皮变坚韧。在附近筑巢时，建筑物也会消失。
author: HoundRyS
source: POKENAME chew their way through the ground consuming minerals, toughening its hide. Buildings disappear when it nests nearby.

entry: 会在城堡墙壁上伪装成石像鬼。与真正的石像鬼不同，它不会吐水，这正是认出POKENAME的线索。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It disguises itself on castle walls as a gargoyle . Unlike other gargoyles, it doesn't spit water, which helps indicate that it's really POKENAME.

entry: 尾巴极为强健，能将POKENAME弹上数米高空。虽身体沉重，仍能长距离滑翔。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its tail is extremely strong. This allows POKENAME to launch itself many meters into the air, then glide for long distances despite its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME钻穿山体，寻找更坚硬的石头加固剑刃，过程中也会将剑刃磨得更锋利。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME drills through mountains in search of tougher stone to harden its blade. Doing so also sharpens it in the process.

entry: 寻找最硬的石头时，POKENAME会逐渐变得致密、暗沉，宛如缟玛瑙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: In search of the toughest stone, POKENAME condenses and darkens to resemble onyx.

entry: 身体上的晶体最为坚硬。会用晶体撞击敌人，突破大多数防御。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The crystals on its body are the hardest points; it will attack by hitting its enemies with them, piercing most enemy defenses.

entry: 用獠牙啃食岩石与岩石属性宝可梦，抽取其中的矿石和矿物。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its fangs to feed on rocks and Rock-type Pokémon, draining them of ores and minerals.

entry: POKENAME挖出庞大的地下隧道网。利用隧道的宝可梦常会送它稀有宝石作为礼物。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME create vast networks of underground tunnels through their burrowing. Pokémon who make use of these tunnels often give it rare gems as gifts.

entry: 长鼻能闻出其他宝可梦的梦。靠这种感知，即使在漆黑的水下洞穴中也能辨路。
author: snescontroller
source: Its trunk can smell the dreams of other Pokémon. It uses this sense to navigate underwater caves in pitch darkness.

entry: 在阴影间穿梭飞行，喜欢让人在最不合适的时刻睡着，以此恶作剧。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: It flies from shadow to shadow, pranking people by making them fall asleep at really inopportune times.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME吞食熟睡的沃特拉及周围宝可梦的梦境。它在水中游动，让附近的宝可梦都惶恐不安。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME has been spotted eating the dreams of sleeping Worterra and Pokémon around it. It swims around, causing terror to every Pokémon around it.

entry: 被POKENAME的剑刃轻轻划伤，就会睡着。它随后将缎带搭在受害者脸上，吃掉对方的梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A tiny cut from POKENAME's blade can put its opponent to sleep. Then it will place its ribbon on its victims face to eat their dreams.

entry: POKENAME常被请来帮助受噩梦困扰的人。它吃掉恶梦，让人安稳入睡。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Often used to help those suffering from nightmares, POKENAME feasts on the bad dreams, leaving them with restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME能用长鼻吞食别人的梦。若味道不合心意，就会恼怒地咬受害者一口，咬得很痛。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can consume other people's dreams with its trunk. If it doesn't like them, it bites its victim in frustration, which can be painful.

entry: POKENAME会沿森林地面留下恶臭黏液来狩猎，再吃掉所有被气味熏昏者的梦。
author: kandyman
source: POKENAME hunts by leaving its foul-smelling mucus along forest floors, then consuming the dreams of all those knocked out by the vapors.

entry: 失眠的孩子与它一起睡时，往往会安心下来。身体柔软好抱，还会与信任的对象分享美梦。
author: char_latte3412
source: Insomniac children often find comfort sleeping with this Pokémon. It's soft, cuddly, and known to share pleasant dreams with those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME常出现在凯西与树枕尾熊身边，一睡可达20小时。它们从不做噩梦，因此引梦貘人常来吃梦。
author: Yoshimon
source: POKENAME are seen around Abra and Komala and can sleep up to 20 hours. Hypno will commonly feast on their dreams since they never have nightmares.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的粉尘能引发强烈幻觉。人类超能力者常将其制成药剂，试着窥见未来。
author: kandyman
source: The dust from POKENAME's wings can induce powerful hallucinations. Human psychics often turn it into potions in an attempt to see into the future.

entry: 睡觉时，只将鼻子露在壳外。即使睡着，也会继续嗅探食物与捕食者。
author: rhysanthemum
source: They sleep with only their nose sticking out of their shell. It continues to sniff for food and predators while it slumbers.

entry: 据说用POKENAME的毛填枕头，就会做美梦。它用翅膀迷惑捕食者，分散对方注意。
author: Griddle
source: A POKENAME's fur is said to bring good dreams to those who stuff it in their pillow. It uses its wings to mesmerize and distract predators.

entry: POKENAME使用催眠术时，会开心地蹦跳旋转。研究者认为，它的快乐源于与别人分享美梦。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME hops and spins gleefully when it uses Hypnosis. Researchers believe that its happiness comes from sharing pleasant dreams with others.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤边缘锋利。会不停挥动，迷住敌人，再近身攻击。
author: snescontroller
source: POKENAME's pendulums have sharp edges. It swings them constantly, mesmerizing enemies before it closes in to attack.

entry: POKENAME不断让自己进入催眠状态，很少能看到清醒的样子。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME are constantly putting themselves in a state of trance. They are very rarely spotted awake.

entry: POKENAME用摆锤状的花反射攻击。反射后的攻击带上催眠效果，让它有足够时间安全逃离。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses its pendulum flower to reflect attacks. The reflected attacks gain hypnotic properties, giving enough time for it to safely escape.

entry: 比起战斗，POKENAME更喜欢玩摆锤。玉虹市每年都会为它们举办摆锤技巧比赛。
author: noel5229
source: Rather than battle, POKENAME prefers to play with its pendulums. A pendulum trick competition is hosted in Celadon City for these Pokémon annually.

entry: POKENAME身体十分脆弱，因此会用惊人的催眠能力，让潜在威胁停下脚步。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Being very physically frail, POKENAME uses its incredible powers of hypnosis to stop potential threats in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺几秒内就能让成人睡着，因此常被请来协助外科医生进行小手术。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's stinger can put an adult to sleep in a manner of seconds. As a result, it is often chosen to help surgeons with minor procedures.

entry: 还是催眠新手，喜欢把别人弄睡着来恶作剧。可催眠效果很弱，几分钟便会消退。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: A novice hypnotist, it pranks others by putting them to sleep. Its trances are so weak that they wear off in mere minutes.

entry: 以人类和宝可梦沉睡时大脑发出的电磁信号为食。碰到摆锤，可能会挨一记轻微电击。
author: mx_wellman
source: It feeds on the electromagnetic signals emitted by the sleeping brains of Pokémon and humans alike. Touching its pendulum may result in a light shock.

entry: POKENAME体内的磁环会产生大量电力。积蓄足够后，就会一次性全部放出。
author: grassy311
source: The magnet ring inside of POKENAME generates immense amounts of electricity. Once enough has been built up, it releases all of that energy at once.

entry: POKENAME体内的磁环会产生大量电力。积蓄足够后，就会一次性全部放出。
author: grassy311
source: The magnet ring inside of POKENAME generates immense amounts of electricity. Once enough has been built up, it releases all of that energy at once.

entry: 这只巨鼻生物会凭灵敏嗅觉闻疗愈熏香。深深吸一口，既让头脑清明，也让鼻子通畅。
author: Xenophacilus
source: This massive-snouted creature uses its superior nose to smell healing incense. By breathing in deeply, it clears both its mind and its nose.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐的鼻子嗅探潜意识，寻找能做出优质梦境的对象。再用摆锤催眠，吸入他们的梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME sniffs outs the subconscious of quality dreamers using its sharp nose. It then puts them to sleep with its pendulum and inhales their dreams.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀含有镇静物质。让目标入睡后，便用长鼻饱餐其梦境。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME wings contain sedative substances. Once it has lulled its targets to sleep, it feasts on their dreams with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME极难寻觅，凡是看见它美貌的对象都会被催眠，立刻忘掉它，只记得奇怪的梦。
author: noel5229
source: Extremely elusive, POKENAME hypnotizes anyone who manages to gaze upon its beauty. The hypnotized instantly forget it, only recalling strange dreams.

entry: POKENAME会在医院帮助病人入睡。摆锤挥动得越久，患者睡得也越久。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME is used in hospitals to help put patients to sleep; the longer they swing their pendulums, the longer the patients remain asleep.

entry: 摆锤用于近身搏斗，而非催眠。另一只手臂上的蓝花会释放气味，催眠虚弱的猎物。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It uses the pendulums for physical combat rather than hypnosis. The blue flower on its other arm releases a scent used for hypnotizing weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME柔软的绒毛能让别人入睡。由于经常掉毛，训练家常用这些毛制作枕头。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's soft fluff can put others to sleep. Because it sheds frequently, Trainers with this Pokémon often make pillows with this material.

entry: POKENAME战斗时毫不留情。先用长触手抓住对手，再用摆锤使其入睡。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: POKENAME is merciless during a fight. It grabs its opponent with one of its long tentacles then uses its pendulum to put it to sleep.

entry: POKENAME靠摆锤催眠受害者。几分钟内就吃光对方的梦，随后离开，留下没能好好休息的受害者。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME's pendulum helps it to put its victims to sleep. Within a few minutes, it devours their dreams and leaves them behind, unrested.

entry: POKENAME害羞，不愿在人前表演。但只要听到它的歌声，就会立刻安心，沉沉入睡。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME avoids performing in front of others due to its shyness. Those who manage to hear its song are instantly soothed and lulled to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用电磁力让闪亮小硬币浮空，借此迷惑更大的宝可梦，让对方载着自己并提供保护。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME use electromagnetism to levitate small, shiny coins. They use these coins to enchant larger Pokémon into giving them rides and protection.

entry: 战斗时，它会佯装拿武器催眠对手，等敌人最不设防的那一刻，突然将武器砸过去。
author: funkytomate
source: When in battle, it pretends to use its weapon as a tool for hypnosis just to throw it at its enemy when they least expect it.

entry: 直视POKENAME始终很危险。它会用念力加快催眠环的摆动，快到肉眼无法看清。
author: kandyman
source: It is never safe to look directly at a POKENAME, as it uses telekinesis to accelerate the swing of its hypnotic rings faster than the eye can see.

entry: 战斗时，一只手抓住对手，两只手用摆锤催眠，最后一只手负责挥拳。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: During a fight, it uses one hand to grab its opponent, two hands to hypnotize it with its pendulums, and the last hand to throw punches at it.

entry: POKENAME能用精神强念稳稳护住骑乘者，因此很受旅人欢迎。梦境构成的鬃毛，让过夜旅途轻松又安稳。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME is popular to travel with, as it can safely secure riders using Psychic. It makes overnight trips easy and restful with its mane of dreams.

entry: POKENAME让磁环在身边高速旋转，将超能力转化为电力。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME converts psychic force into electric power by rapidly spinning its magnet rings around its body.

entry: POKENAME不断来回摆动身体两端的磁环，借此发电。
author: grassy311
source: POKENAME swings the two magnet rings at each end of its body back and forth in order to generate electricity.

entry: POKENAME常游向在吃下的梦中瞥见的地方，因此经常出现在意想不到的地点。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME often swims to places that it has seen glimpses of in eaten dreams. This habit has caused it to be spotted in unexpected locations.

entry: POKENAME是催眠大师，用嘴里的螺旋引来食物，随后毫不犹豫地吞下。
author: Toxicrown
source: POKENAME is a master hypnotist. It uses the spirals in its mouth to lure food in, then devours them without a second thought.

entry: 精通催眠。挥动双摆锤时，甚至能控制传说宝可梦的心智。
author: TheFinalKalgonus
source: This creature is a master of hypnosis. By swinging its dual pendulums, it is able to control the minds of even legendary Pokémon.

entry: 头上的触角已不再吸引猎物，POKENAME却没察觉。如今靠钳子，就能轻松抓住身边毫无防备的受害者。
author: ziggaway
source: While the antennae on its head no longer attract prey, POKENAME does not notice. The pincers now snatch unwitting victims around it without effort.

entry: POKENAME栖息海岸，甲壳上长着奇特的翅膀。优雅的魅力让沿岸遇到它的人着迷。
author: anarchaz
source: In its coastal habitats, POKENAME boasts a crustacean shell with curious wings. Its graceful charm captivates those who encounter it along the shores.

entry: POKENAME飞行时毫无规律，经常撞上周围的东西。幸好，即使是它最脆弱的身体部件也十分耐用。
author: Staghorn
source: NAME fly extremely erratically and constantly crash into their surroundings. Fortunately, even its most delicate components are very durable.

entry: POKENAME将柄埋入沙中，看起来像一只被丢弃的钳子。缎带一察觉动静，斧头便会翻起，斩杀受害者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: When POKENAME buries its shaft in the sand, it appears to be just a discarded claw. Alerted by its ribbon, the axe flips to execute its victim.

entry: 头上的钳子是绝佳武器。受威胁时，会用头猛撞目标，再用钳子夹住敌人。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The pincers on its head make excellent weapons. When threatened, it will bash its head into targets and clamp its pincers onto foes.

entry: POKENAME以悦耳歌声，将受害者诱进自己在沙中挖的洞。歌声的声波只会引来最美味的猎物。
author: MrPeach774
source: POKENAME uses its melodic voice to lure its victims into holes it digs in the sand. The sound waves of its singing voice lure only the tastiest prey.

entry: POKENAME按催眠的节奏吹泡泡，引诱毫无戒心的目标走进巢穴，巢穴通常位于黑暗洞窟中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME blows bubbles in a hypnotizing rhythm. In this way, it lures unwary targets into its lair, which is often located in dark caves.

entry: POKENAME有巨钳与强健的角，在深海海底巡游，主要捕猎海中的岩石属性宝可梦。
author: velvetmitsu
source: POKENAME, armed with colossal claws and a formidable horn, prowls the deep ocean floor, hunting down ocean Rock-type Pokémon as its prime prey.

entry: POKENAME活泼合群，常结成小群一起狩猎，甚至能猎倒巨鲤龙这样的大型猎物。
author: thatguy4115
source: POKENAME is a vibrant and social Pokémon. It often hunts together in small packs, and it has been known to take down large prey such as Swampdos.

entry: 钳子强得能将金属夹成两半。不战斗时，训练家会绑住钳子，以免伤到别人。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Its claws are strong enough to snap metal in half. Outside of combat, trainers bind its claws so it can't hurt others.

entry: 与外形给人的印象不同，POKENAME十分友善，喜欢在海滩上与人类玩耍。
author: kcjole
source: Despite POKENAME's appearance, it is quite friendly and loves to play around at the beach with humans.

entry: 巨大的斧头让POKENAME不再适用原先的狩猎方式。如今一记挥斩，就能劈开行动迟缓、甲壳厚实的猎物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's overgrown axe head also means it's outgrown its previous hunting method. It can now cleave slow, well-armored victims in one fell swoop.

entry: 会在海滩上空飞行，寻找食物。体形让捕猎不便，因此演化出能从两侧伸出的钳子，方便从空中狩猎。
author: Patch_Bros
source: It flies around beaches looking for food. Its size makes hunting difficult, so it has adapted its claws to extend from its sides to hunt from the sky.

entry: 尾巴上的巨钳威力惊人，但也十分沉重。因此，它靠密集气泡构成的肢体维持平衡。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The claw on its tail is incredibly powerful. However, due to the weight of its claw, it relies on dense limbs made of bubbles to keep itself balanced.

entry: 会将大钳蟹引进嘴里困住。若没抓到东西，就用钳子在岸边飞快爬行。
author: imagine1.
source: It lures Krabby into its mouth and traps them. If it fails to capture anything, it will scurry across the shore with its claws.

entry: POKENAME藏在海中洞穴里安静休息，只会出来吓跑打扰睡眠的渔夫。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME hides in ocean caves, resting peacefully. It only comes out to scare away fishermen that interrupt its sleep.

entry: POKENAME优美的音色能引来体型有自己两倍大的猎物。它会用巨大的钳子，夹碎比自己更大的敌人。
author: MrPeach774
source: The timbre of POKENAME's voice lures in prey twice its size. It uses its oversized claw to crush foes larger than it.

entry: 被POKENAME的钳子夹到，一下就会昏倒。受威胁时，会用六肢以惊人速度爬行。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Anyone POKENAME's claws snap down on is knocked out in one hit. If threatened, it will crawl on all six of its limbs, moving at a tremendous speed.

entry: 为免巨钳吓跑猎物，POKENAME会先用摆锤催眠。钳子与巨颚连最硬的铠甲都能夹碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: To avoid scaring off prey with its fearsome claws, POKENAME hypnotizes them with its pendulum. Its claws and jaws can crack even the toughest armor.

entry: POKENAME虽然圆滚滚的，却不善于靠滚动赶路。背上的种子储存着驱动身体的电力，它们宁可一蹦一跳，也不愿冒险碰坏种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their spherical appearance, POKENAME are unable to properly roll to travel. The bulbs on their backs store the electricity that powers them, so they would rather hop than risk damaging it.

entry: POKENAME常兴冲冲地迈着短腿四处奔跑，站不稳也毫不在意，摔倒了就顺势滚回站姿。不过，种子一碰到地面，就会炸开一片火花。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly run about on their short legs. Their lack of balance doesn't hinder them; when they fall, they simply roll back onto their feet. If their bulbs touch the ground, they release an explosion of sparks.

entry: POKENAME是同一株植物的种子组成的集群，彼此共享意识。身体分为脸部和种子：脸部负责认路、战斗，种子则负责收集能量。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME function as a hivemind of seeds from the same plant. Their bodies are divided into faces and bulbs, with the faces handling navigation and fighting, while the bulbs gather energy.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶片都来自同一颗种子，在体内构成了小小的生态系统。三颗头以心灵感应交谈，谁来打扰，叶片就会向外伸展，将其赶走。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The leaves atop POKENAME sprout from a single bulb, creating a miniature ecosystem within its body. The three heads communicate telepathically, with its leaves extending outward to repel anyone who interrupts them.

entry: POKENAME戴着陶土做的头骨，纪念妙蛙种子祖先，还会用鲜花装饰，礼赞生命。它们把种子伸出的藤蔓当作鞭子，抽击之力足以在地面刻出深痕。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wear clay skulls to honor their Bulbasaur ancestors, decorating them with flowers to celebrate life. They wield vines from their bulbs as whips, striking hard enough to carve into the ground.

entry: POKENAME善于操纵藤蔓，能挖出隧道，或拖来倒木搭建住处。随着它们成长为战士，装饰用的头骨逐渐开裂，恰如背上的种子渐渐绽放。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: With masterful vine control, POKENAME carve tunnels or pull fallen trees to create shelter. Their decorative skulls crack as they mature, reflecting the blooming of their bulbs as they grow into warriors.

entry: POKENAME的四肢由盘卷藤蔓构成，能伸长攻击范围，也能有力跳跃。它们是骄傲的战士，可踢击较量时，双腿却经常缠在一起。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's limbs are made of coiled vines, allowing them to extend for greater reach or powerful leaps. POKENAME are proud fighters, but in kicking matches, their legs often tangle together.

entry: POKENAME拳力惊人，却更喜欢晒太阳冥想。被迫战斗时，会用藤蔓裹住拳头，减轻第一拳的力道，仅作警告。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: While POKENAME possess incredible punching strength, they prefer meditating in sunlight to fighting. When forced to fight, they wrap vines around their fists to cushion the first blow as a warning shot.

entry: POKENAME用长舌卷住树果灌木，摇下所有树果。唾液含有帮助植物生长的特殊花蜜，让树果更频繁地结出。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME grab berry bushes with their long tongues and shake them to gather all of the berries. Their tongues contain saliva with special nectar that helps plants grow, resulting in more frequent berry supplies.

entry: POKENAME不断产生比空气轻的孢子，让自己飞行。愤怒时放出孢子毒害敌人，自己却会无法移动，直到重新长出足够飞行的孢子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's body constantly produces spores lighter than air, allowing it to fly. When angered, POKENAME release spores to poison foes, leaving them immobile until enough spores regenerate for flight.

entry: POKENAME中央的种子宛如一座发电厂，吸收日光，制造能托起身体的轻盈孢子。遇敌时，POKENAME会将孢子混上毒液喷出去，自保御敌。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb at the center of POKENAME acts as a power plant, gathering sunlight and producing spores light enough to lift its body. POKENAME mix these spores with poison to spray as a defense.

entry: POKENAME挥舞藤蔓冲进战斗。只有敌人在正前方才会动角，先以藤蔓缠住对方，再给出最后一击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charge into battle, lashing with vines. They only use their horns if their enemy is directly in front, wrapping them in vines before delivering the finishing blow.

entry: POKENAME的大种子为长途奔跑提供能量，因此它总用尾巴护着种子。长长的角则用来采摘树果，与尚未进化的同类分享。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's large bulbs provide energy for long runs, so they keep them protected with their tails. They use their long horns to pick berries and share them with pre-evolutions.

entry: POKENAME会把种子抱进特别的育儿袋，细心保护。种子通过光合作用积蓄能量，再传给POKENAME的身体，两者相依共生。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cradle and protect a bulb in their special pouches. The bulb gathers energy through photosynthesis, which transfers to the POKENAME's body, creating a symbiotic relationship.

entry: 头顶的种子储存着日光的能量，既能修复POKENAME受损的藤蔓，也能帮助藤蔓继续生长。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The bulb on its head stores energy from the sun's rays. This energy is used to repair POKENAME's vines when damaged and to help them grow.

entry: 与大多数妙蛙种子融合体不同，POKENAME没有自己的种子。它们会让流浪的妙蛙种子住进育儿袋，视如己出地照顾。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unlike most Bulbasaur fusions, POKENAME lack a bulb of their own. Instead, they offer their pouches to stray Bulbasaur, caring for them as if they were their own.

entry: POKENAME贴着水面下方游动，只把种子的尖端露出来晒太阳，以免引起天敌注意。若有人碰了种子，它们就会怒气冲冲地喷出气泡。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel just below the water's surface, with the tips of their bulbs above to absorb sunlight without attracting predators. Disturbing their bulbs triggers furious bubble sprays.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺保护种子，内侧却光滑平整，让种子安稳地躺在其中。游动时，它们会从种子或吻部喷出气泡，推动身体前进。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use sharp spines to protect their bulbs, with the smooth interiors cradling them securely. They propel through water by spraying bubbles from their bulbs or snouts.

entry: POKENAME用叶状尾巴混入藻类与海草中。在向阳处休息积蓄能量，便能走得更远，寻找需要照料的珊瑚礁。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their leafy tails to blend into algae and seaweed. They rest in sunlit spots to gather energy, allowing them to travel farther as they search for coral reefs to tend.

entry: POKENAME偏爱深水，比多数妙蛙种子融合体需要的阳光更少。身上的绿斑吸收光线，产生孢子，让它藏进浑水里。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Preferring deep waters, POKENAME require less sunlight than most Bulbasaur fusions. Green spots on their bodies absorb light and produce spores to disguise them in murky waters.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸漂流，吸收阳光，将能量储存在宝石中。夜间的亮光宛如散落在沙滩上的星座。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift along shores, absorbing sunlight and storing energy in their jewels. At night, the glowing jewels appear like constellations scattered along the beach.

entry: POKENAME以复杂的手势挥动双手，用超能力促进植物生长。动作虽看似随意，却总热切展示这份独特的表演。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wave their hands in intricate patterns to help plants grow with their psychic powers. Though the motions seem random, they eagerly show off their unique performances.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的手臂翻土，种下一排排种子。只有花园受到威胁时，才会挥刃战斗。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their blade-like arms to dig into soil and plant rows of seeds. They only wield their blades in combat if someone or something threatens their gardens.

entry: POKENAME从森林收集叶子，制成精致长裙。十分自豪于自己的表演，日出时会在草地上歌唱，迎接新的一天。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather leaves from the forest to fashion into elaborate gowns. They pride themselves on their performances, singing in grassy fields at sunrise to welcome the new day.

entry: POKENAME会飞快地旋转双臂发电，为种子充能。充满电后，种子会明亮发光，还能释放带电的孢子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spin their arms rapidly to generate electricity and charge their bulbs. Once fully charged, the bulbs glow brightly and can release electrified spores.

entry: POKENAME从种子中释放极易燃烧的孢子。孢子像烟雾一样翻涌，将敌人包围、削弱，随后便会燃起火焰。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release highly flammable spores from their bulbs. These spores billow like smoke, surrounding foes to weaken them before setting them aflame.

entry: POKENAME用叶子包住角，以免照料种子时划断树木。不包住的角，眨眼就能将树切成两半。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap leaves around their horns to avoid tearing through trees as they tend to seeds. Unwrapped horns can slice trees in half in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME在农场很受欢迎，能用藤蔓尾巴帮忙拉犁。颈部的叶子让它即使在田间工作，也能吸收阳光获取能量。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very popular on farms, where they use their vine tails to help pull plows. The leaves around their necks help them gather sunlight for energy even while they work in the fields.

entry: 与鲤鱼王不同，POKENAME会主动跃上陆地，用叶状的鳍吸收阳光。不过，想顺利回到水里依然很费劲。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unlike Magikarp, POKENAME intentionally leap onto land to absorb sunlight through their leafy fins. However, they still struggle to navigate back into the water efficiently.

entry: POKENAME带领宝可梦在森林游行，庆祝春天。沿途收集脚下的叶子、种下嫩苗，回湖泊时再为它们浇水。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME lead parades of Pokémon through forests to celebrate springtime. They gather leaves underfoot, planting sprouts as they travel and watering them on their return to lakes.

entry: POKENAME会把迷路或疲惫的宝可梦轻轻安置在种子里，载着它们长途跋涉。光合作用和POKENAME的冰之力量，共同调节着里面的温度。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME transport lost or tired Pokémon great distances, gently cradling them in their bulbs. The temperature in the bulbs is regulated by photosynthesis and POKENAME's ice powers.

entry: POKENAME用胶状的身体穿行于树根间。找到僻静处后，便稍稍探出身子，让种子晒到阳光，自己则装成嫩芽，融入周围的植物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their gelatinous bodies to navigate tree roots. When they find a secluded spot, they emerge slightly to let their bulbs absorb sunlight, mimicking sprouts to blend in.

entry: POKENAME适应力极强，几乎在哪里都能生存。人们认为，背上的种子会随当地气候，开出功用不同的花。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly adaptable and able to thrive in nearly any environment. It is believed that the bulbs on their back sprout flowers of different functions depending on the climate they live in.

entry: POKENAME住在森林河流中，用鳍反射日光，吓退敌人。它们还会把尾巴浸入水中，从种子释放孢子，帮助净化河水。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living in forest rivers, POKENAME use their fins to reflect sunlight to repel attackers. They dip their tails into rivers and release spores from their bulbs to help purify the water.

entry: 深居雨林的POKENAME靠电力而非日光，为种子积蓄能量。暴风雨中，它们奔走于树冠，宛如活的避雷针，赶在闪电劈中树木前将其引走。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living deep within rainforests, POKENAME use their bulbs to store energy from electricity instead of sunlight. They run across treetops during storms, acting as lightning rods to catch stray bolts before they can strike trees.

entry: 生活在热带的POKENAME，用叶片般的尾巴与鬃毛吸收日光，将能量储存在种子里。光合作用产生的多余能量化为热量，让种子能喷出火焰。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living in tropical climates, POKENAME use their leafy tails and manes to absorb energy from sunlight and store it in their bulbs. The excess energy from their photosynthesis runs hot, allowing them to produce flame from their bulbs.

entry: 据说POKENAME的程序原为创造数字景观而设，却会飘过田野播种。种子完全是有机的，每逢开工，它却总会哼出奇怪的五音合鸣。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have been programmed to help create digital landscapes, POKENAME float through fields to plant seeds. While the seeds are completely organic, POKENAME always seem to buzz in an odd chorus of five notes whenever they start their work.

entry: POKENAME的壳由叶绿体构成，躲在里面也能不断通过光合作用获取能量。不过，壳的额外重量让它更容易疲劳。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's shell is made out of chloroplasts, allowing the body to constantly gain energy from photosynthesis even when hiding within them. The additional weight of the shell causes POKENAME to tire out more frequently.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓帮忙搬运壳，也会在光合作用时护住它。壳若破裂，就会射出带刺种子，既用于自卫，也帮助长出新壳。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their vines to help carry their shells during travel or protect them during photosynthesis. If their shells ever crack, they will shoot off spiny seeds as both a defense mechanism and a way to grow a new one.

entry: 据说POKENAME是远古植物的遗存。白天爬上岸，从阳光中汲取养分；夜间回到水中，将多余的叶片洒在波浪间。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to be remnants of ancient plants, POKENAME crawl onto shore during the day to absorb nutrients from sunlight. At night, they return to the water, shedding any spare leaves along the waves.

entry: POKENAME将手臂长出的叶子塑成刀刃，争夺海滩上阳光充足的领地。刀刃有特殊弧度，游泳时便于划水。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion blades out of the leaves that grow from their arms and use them to fight over sunny territories on beaches. They design the blades with specialized curves that help them catch the water as they swim.

entry: POKENAME在高空展开双翼吸收阳光，在下方投出可怕的影子。据说它们曾从树顶统治远古森林，尖啸能震落树叶。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spread their wings high in the sky to absorb sunlight, casting a fearsome shadow below them. It is believed that these Pokémon ruled ancient forests from the treetops, their piercing cries causing leaves to fall from trees.

entry: POKENAME漫步林间，尽可能多地收集树果。吃不完的就存进种子，留待下次；若还没到饭点就困了，它会先把树果分给小型宝可梦，再去睡觉。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander through forests to gather as many berries as they can. Whatever they don't eat is stored in their bulbs for later. If a POKENAME gets tired before their next meal, they will share the berries with smaller Pokémon before they sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在冬季首日或末日现身，孢子既能聚雪，也能清雪。它制造的霜能护住植物过冬，让来年春天长得更强健。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to appear on the first or last day of winter, POKENAME's spores can either help collect or clear snow. The frost that POKENAME creates can preserve plants through the winter, allowing them to grow back stronger the following spring.

entry: POKENAME披着雷云飞行，用闪电为种子充能。待风雨散去，便射出灿烂的光束；凝聚的能量照到哪里，哪里的植物就加速生长。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flies cloaked in storm clouds, charging its bulb with lightning before producing radiant beams when the storm clears. These concentrated beams of energy will accelerate the growth of plants they touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME由误陷野火的嫩芽获得生命。会用翅膀聚拢火焰，将其引离自然环境。周身覆火后发出的光，还能帮助附近植物进行光合作用。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have been brought to life from a stray sprout caught in a wildfire, POKENAME gathers fire along its wings to redirect it away from nature. Once cloaked in flame, POKENAME will emit light to aid in photosynthesis in its environment.
