entry: POKENAME小心地盘绕在自己的种子周围，谁来威胁就猛然出击。不过，肯花心思好好训练它的人，会发现POKENAME既忠诚，又十分亲人。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Carefully coiled around their bulbs, POKENAME will lash out at anyone that threatens them.  Those that take the time to properly train POKENAME will find them to be deeply loyal and affectionate.

entry: POKENAME把光合作用的能量储存在尾部的种子里。能量沿身体流转，使它能从颈间的圆珠喷出奇异火焰，或从角上射出耀眼的光束。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store energy from photosynthesis in the bulbs on their tails. This energy travels along the POKENAME's body, allowing them to produce mystical flames from the orbs on their necks or beams of radiant light from their horns.

entry: POKENAME虽然高大，却温顺友善。愤怒时会喷出火流，其中的神秘力量只伤害招惹它的对象。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are very docile and friendly Pokémon. If angered, they will shoot a stream of flames from their mouths. These flames contain mystical powers, only harming those that have incurred a POKENAME's wrath.

entry: 据说关都的第一棵树，来自POKENAME种下的种子。它飞遍各地，照料森林与嫩苗。笑起来时，周围会绽放鲜艳的花。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have planted a seed that sprouted into the first tree in Kanto, POKENAME flies throughout the region to look after the growth of forests and budding sprouts. When POKENAME laughs, flowers bloom around it in vivid colors.

entry: 与妙蛙种子融合后，芭瓢虫变得更怕冷。POKENAME大部分时间都在晒太阳积蓄能量，以度过寒冷天气。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Fusing with Bulbasaur has made Ledyba even more sensitive to the cold. POKENAME spends most of its time gathering energy from the sun to survive days with cold weather.

entry: POKENAME晴天吸收阳光，阴天积蓄电力，因此总是活力充沛。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: On sunny days POKENAME will absorb the sun's rays and on cloudy days it will charge electricity. As a result, POKENAME is often full of energy.

entry: POKENAME在杂草间生长旺盛，借此躲避大型捕食者。喜爱无人照料植物的习性，让它能在其他宝可梦避开的地方繁盛生活。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives among weeds, where it hides from larger predators. Its affinity for untended plants allows it to flourish in places other Pokémon avoid.

entry: POKENAME散发着鼠尾草般的气味，让其他宝可梦心绪安宁。常叼着干叶，送给信赖的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a scent reminiscent of sage, which other Pokémon find calming. It often carries dried leaves in its mouth, offering them as gifts to those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME常漫无目的地飘向明亮的地方。下雨时，会藏进地下自保。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often seen floating aimlessly towards brightly lit areas. During rainy days, it would hide itself underground for protection.

entry: POKENAME收集苔藓覆住身体，躲避捕食者。苔藓还能保温，让它在凉夜保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects moss to cover its body, helping it stay hidden from predators. The moss also serves as insulation, keeping it warm during cooler nights.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在茂密海带林底部。毫无察觉地闯进领地的宝可梦，会立刻遭到巨大种子的射击。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME is often found at the bottom of dense kelp forests. Oblivious Pokémon that wander into its territory are immediately shot with massive seeds.

entry: 身体健康时，POKENAME口中会喷出明亮的火焰。偏偏这些火焰也可能点着头顶的种子，把它们烧坏。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME spews bright flames from its mouth when it is healthy. Ironically, these flames can set fire to the bulbs on its head, damaging them.

entry: POKENAME兴高采烈地采来树果，在携带的种子里调制药液。等药液调好，它们便把种子种下，让其长成叶色缤纷的美丽树木。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly gather berries to brew into potions within the bulbs they carry. Once their concoctions are ready, they plant the bulbs that will grow into beautiful trees with leaves of various colors.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞行，从种子中释放孢子云，让敌人中毒、逐渐虚弱。平时，它们则会降低孢子的毒性，反过来为同伴疗伤。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly around their opponents, releasing clouds of spores from their bulbs to poison them and wear them down. Outside of battle, they reduce the toxicity of the spores to heal damage done to their allies instead.

entry: POKENAME平时喜欢独处，可一旦背上的种子受到威胁，就会用毒角发动攻击。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME tend to keep to themselves. If it feels that the bulb on its back is threatened, however, it will attack with its poisonous horns.

entry: 它十分关心其他融合宝可梦，常在保护自己的种子与保护其他POKENAME的种子之间，左右为难。
author: fixthewifi
source: It cares deeply for fellow fused Pokémon. It is often caught in a dilemma between protecting its own bulb and those of other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头上的食肉嫩芽刚长出不久，还不聪明，要靠身体引导。若不按时喂食，就会发脾气，试着将自己从身体上撕下来。
author: Mistymagius
source: The carnivorous sprout on POKENAME's head is newly developed and not very intelligent, relying on the body to guide it. If it's not fed regularly, it throws a tantrum and tries to rip itself from the body.

entry: 只要同一进化家族的伙伴受到威胁，POKENAME就会用角猛烈反击，即使自己的种子可能受伤，也在所不惜。
author: fixthewifi
source: If a member of its evolutionary family is threatened, POKENAME will lash out violently with its horns to protect it, even at the risk of damage to its own bulb.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵护着后脑的种子，也像太阳能板一样吸收日光，通过光合作用产生能量。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have large ears to protect the bulbs on the back of their heads. These ears act as solar panels, absorbing sunlight to produce energy through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME用头上的角挪开树根，整理出睡觉的位置。睡时只露出头和种子，清晨便能通过光合作用积蓄能量。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the horns on their head to move roots at the bases of trees, creating a sleeping spot. They sleep with only their heads and bulbs above ground, gathering energy in the morning through photosynthesis.

entry: 湖畔常能看到打盹的POKENAME，尾部的种子正静静吸收着阳光。
author: fuzzythelion
source: POKENAME can be seen napping around lakebeds, quietly absorbing sunlight through the bulb on its tail.

entry: POKENAME优雅地游过水域宽广的沼泽。每年秋季脱落的叶片，是珍贵的染料原料。
author: flickeredflame
source: POKENAME swim gracefully in swampy areas with large bodies of water. Each autumn, they shed their leaves, which are prized as ingredients for making dye.

entry: POKENAME虽然高大，却很会照料生命。会带着幼苗掘地，以大耳朵收集阳光，再通过光合作用滋养土壤，培育新树。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are very nurturing Pokémon. They burrow with sprouts, gathering sunlight in their large ears and enriching the soil through photosynthesis to grow new trees.

entry: POKENAME从背上发射种子，种出茂密森林，以此塑造大陆。随着它进化，曾种下的树木也变得更坚韧。
source: POKENAME is known for shaping continents by launching seeds from its back that sprout into dense forests. As it evolves, the trees that it once planted become more resilient.

entry: 满月之夜，它们奇异的种子会发出光芒。据说，POKENAME的种子里藏着月之石，能引导神秘力量，让它们飞上天空。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Their strange bulbs glow on nights of the full moon. It is said that a POKENAME's bulb contains Moon Stones that channel their mystical powers and allow them to fly.

entry: 满月照耀的花园里，POKENAME会从种子中放出奇异而神秘的光，让花朵绽放出鲜艳的色彩。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Appearing in gardens under the light of the full moon, POKENAME release a strange, mystical light from their bulbs that helps flowers bloom in vivid color.

entry: 尾巴上长出巨大的花苞，里面不断生长的花朵散发着神秘的热量。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: An enormous flower bud sprouts from its tail. The large growing bloom inside radiates mystical heat.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时会左右摇摆，让花苞里的种子沙沙作响。可若有人听着歌安然睡去，POKENAME反而会生气地喷出孢子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: As POKENAME sing, they sway back and forth, rattling the seeds inside their bulb. If people fall asleep from the soothing song, POKENAME spray spores from their bulb in anger.

entry: POKENAME把种子鼓起来，借此飞翔。唱歌时，它们还会沿途撒播小种子，种出供人歇脚的美丽花园。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME inflate their bulbs to fly. As they sing, they scatter seeds from their bulbs, creating beautiful gardens where people can rest.

entry: POKENAME轻轻漂浮在空中，漫无目的地飘过森林和田野。它偶尔会抓住下方的植物，沿途留下一串孢子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats gently through the air, drifting aimlessly over forests and fields. It occasionally latches onto plants below, leaving behind a trail of spores.

entry: POKENAME拥有两颗独立的大脑，其中一颗形似种子。吸足太阳能后，这颗大脑就会与另一颗同步，释放强大的超能力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has two independent brains, one shaped like a bulb. When this Pokémon absorbs enough solar energy, the bulb-shaped brain synchronizes with the other, unleashing powerful psychic powers.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在洞穴侧壁，只让种子晒着太阳。夜里，它们收集树果，种在洞口附近，方便日后采食。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep on the sides of caves during the day, exposing only their bulbs to sunlight. At night, they gather berries and plant them near their caves for easier access.

entry: POKENAME把尖牙扎进树干，为种子吸取养分，洞口附近因此常有枯树。不过吸得太多，种子就会重得让它们飞不起来。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sink their fangs into trees to absorb nutrients for their bulbs, often leaving withered trees near cave entrances. Drinking too much can make their bulbs too heavy to fly.

entry: POKENAME的下半身白天吸收阳光，夜里微微发亮。会借光引来猎物，再用毒针将其击昏。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The lower body of a POKENAME absorbs energy from sunlight during the day and glows faintly at night. POKENAME draw in prey with this glow and shoot them with poisonous needles to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME的身体比背上的种子还小，住在花园里，靠人类或宝可梦照料。受到善待、身体健康的POKENAME，种子会变成更深的绿色，渐渐露出新芽。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Smaller than the bulbs they carry, POKENAME live in gardens, relying on people or Pokémon to care for them. Healthy POKENAME with a good home grow darker green bulbs with budding signs.

entry: POKENAME散发诡异气息，让靠近者不安。动作缓慢而审慎，令人拿不准该上前还是退开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gives off an eerie presence, unsettling those who venture too close. Its movements are slow and deliberate, leaving others unsure whether to approach or retreat.

entry: POKENAME散发诡异气息，让靠近者不安。动作缓慢而审慎，令人拿不准该上前还是退开。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gives off an eerie presence, unsettling those who venture too close. Its movements are slow and deliberate, leaving others unsure whether to approach or retreat.

entry: POKENAME的叶片厚实得惊人，上面常留着大块咬痕。尖刺能喷出较温和的毒液，主要用来削弱对手的体力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaves are incredibly thick and can be seen with large bite marks taken out of them. Its thorns eject a mild poison that is mainly used to physically weaken its opponents.

entry: POKENAME已经足够强壮，能稳稳托起头上的种子，也会照料自己居住的花园。它们让种子储满养分，再埋身花丛，休息时也滋养着土壤。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Strong enough to support the bulbs on their head, POKENAME care for the gardens they call home. They gather nutrients in their bulbs and bury themselves among flowers, enriching the soil as they rest.

entry: 头上的种子浮在水中，让它能边休息边进行光合作用。藤蔓会将太阳珊瑚撕成碎片。
author: Markusknight
source: The seed on its head floats in the water, allowing it to perform photosynthesis and rest. Its vines shred Corsola to pieces.

entry: 背上的种子已大到足以容身。会在强烈阳光下打盹，吸收养分。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: The seed on its back has grown large enough for it to take shelter inside. It absorbs nutrients by napping in bright sunlight.

entry: POKENAME把太阳能储存在头顶的种子中。甜美的旋律，能让各种植物的花朵随它的心意绽放。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stores solar energy in the bulb on its head. Its sweet melodies can control the blooming of flowers on any plant.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的种子释放精神力量。想要完全恢复能量，就得在阳光下好好休息一阵。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME releases its psychic power from the bulb on its head. To fully recharge, it requires a long rest under sunlight.

entry: POKENAME种子上长出的叶片，渐渐包住了整个身体。它们大部分时间藏在树根之间，吸取养分，让叶片继续生长。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The leaves from POKENAME's bulbs have grown to wrap around their main body. They spend most of their time hiding among tree roots, draining nutrients to grow their leaves.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，用触角探知宝可梦，再钻出来向捕食者喷毒孢子。新手农民很喜欢让它混在作物中生活。
author: sockedpuppetart
source: POKENAME uses its antennae to detect Pokémon from underground, then pops out of the ground to spray any predators with toxic spores. It is popular with beginner farmers, as they let POKENAME blend in with other crops.

entry: POKENAME偏爱农场，用藤蔓帮忙照料土壤。会以毒孢子麻痹打作物主意的昆虫，再带走当食物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME prefer to live on farms, where they use their vines to help tend the soil. POKENAME use their toxic spores to paralyze any insects after the crops and then take them away as their own food.

entry: POKENAME每天醒来，都会先打理自己的种子。种子散发的辛香气息，也让它们精神一振。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME start their day by grooming their bulbs. In doing so, the spices that they excrete perk them up.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME真正的身体是什么样子，只知道头部保护着一颗种子。种子能连接附近的树根，让POKENAME随心所欲地指挥植物。
author: WIldheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the true body of a POKENAME looks like, only that it contains a bulb the head protects. The bulb can connect to nearby roots, allowing POKENAME to command plants at will.

entry: 若地面上并排冒出三株嫩芽，就说明附近藏着钻入地下的POKENAME。它们围绕种子铺开根系，长出小小的森林或花园。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of three sprouts sticking out of the ground signals a nearby burrowed POKENAME. They create root networks around their bulbs, sprouting small forests or gardens.

entry: POKENAME住在树木最高的枝头，额头硬币与叶片融为一体。早晨将头探出叶间，吸收阳光进行光合作用。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live in the highest branches of trees, where the coins on their foreheads blend into the leaves. In the mornings, they poke their heads through the leaves to absorb sunlight for photosynthesis.

entry: 头顶的种子泛起绿光时，POKENAME就能与植物交谈。不过这种能力会引发剧烈头痛，因此很少见它使用。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: When the bulb on POKENAME's head glows green, it can speak to plants. However, this ability causes severe headaches, making it a rare sight.

entry: POKENAME能在河流中飞快游动。休息时，它们将身体完全浸入水中，只露出种子，宛如一片长着叶子的睡莲。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim through rivers at incredible speeds. When resting, they submerge their bodies completely, leaving only their bulb visible like a leafy lily pad.

entry: POKENAME住在最高的树梢，以便多晒太阳。若不在树顶，就会愤怒地攻击靠近者。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME lives on the tallest treetops to better absorb the sun's rays. When it is not on the treetops, POKENAME will become enraged and attack anyone who comes near.

entry: POKENAME敏捷活泼，靠四肢周围的藤蔓在树梢荡行。生气时会甩藤蔓打向惹怒自己的对象，却常把自己缠住。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are agile and energetic, using vines around their limbs to swing through treetops. When upset, they lash their vines at the source of their anger, often tangling themselves.

entry: POKENAME的毛发更像草叶。光合作用产生的能量储存在种子中，随后便能化作口中喷出的火焰。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's fur resembles grass or leaves more than typical fur. They store energy from photosynthesis in their bulbs, releasing it as fire from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME覆着青草般的毛，黎明站在丘顶吸收阳光。咆哮释放的强光与高热，几分钟内就能烧毁或催生一片森林。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Covered in grass-like fur, POKENAME stand atop hills at dawn to gather sunlight. Their roar generates intense heat and light, capable of burning or growing forest sections in minutes.

entry: POKENAME用勺子连接周围植物，让它们迅速生长。常出现在无人打理的花园。
author: nope11275
source: The POKENAME uses its spoon to connect to plants around it, letting them grow at a much faster rate. It is often seen in neglected gardens.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的勺子传递治愈之力。用勺子挖洞种下的幼苗，很快就能长成健壮美丽的植物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel healing power through the spoons they carry. Any sprout planted in a hole dug by their spoon grows quickly into a sturdy and beautiful plant.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，挥拳时释放的孢子反而会让对手精神振奋。它们只借此鼓励激战，从不用来妨碍敌人。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Playful by nature, POKENAME release spores with their punches that energize opponents. They only use their spores to encourage intense battles, never to hinder their foes.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓在森林搭起拳击擂台训练。林间空地若飘出孢子雾，就说明它们正在举办比赛。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their vines to create boxing rings in the forest to train for battle. A fog of spores drifting from a forest clearing is a sign that a group of POKENAME are hosting a tournament.

entry: POKENAME以惊人力量著称，被视为森林中的冠军新秀。进化后常不习惯第二对手臂，于是用藤蔓协调动作。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protégé champions of the forest, known for their incredible strength. They often have trouble using their second pair of arms after evolving, so they use vines to stay organized.

entry: 萌动的幼苗获得意识后，以生长中的根构成身体，形成POKENAME。会缠住树木，混入叶间吸取能量，盼着有朝一日开花。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are formed when a budding sprout gains sentience and forms a body from its developing roots. POKENAME wrap their bodies around trees to blend in with the leaves and drain energy in hopes of blooming someday.

entry: POKENAME在自己萌发的植物周围，长出了一副伪装的身体。它们用大嘴一口气收集、吃下许多树果，再把养分化为能量，供给中央的种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Having grown a false body around the plant they sprouted from, POKENAME use their wide mouths to collect and eat berries all at once. The nutrients are converted into energy for their central bulb.

entry: 种子已占据身体大半的POKENAME，一心收集足够的食物与能量，等待开花。它们会用藤蔓搬来倒木，在种子中溶解，吸收其中的养分。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their bulbs now making up most of their body, POKENAME focus on collecting enough food and energy to bloom. They use their vines to gather fallen trees, dissolving them in their bulbs for nutrients.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME钟形外壳下的内部模样。只知道它会伸出藤蔓，在水中移动，直到找到向阳处休息。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the inside of a POKENAME looks like beneath their outer bell. It is only known that they sprout vines that help them navigate around the water until they find sunny spots to rest.

entry: POKENAME用众多藤蔓保护头上长出的种子。没人知道藤蔓究竟从何处伸出，只知道它们似乎转瞬就能再生，甚至越长越多。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their multitude of vines to protect the bulbs growing from their heads. It is unknown where these vines stem from, but POKENAME seem to be able to regenerate or multiply them near instantly.

entry: POKENAME睡在洞口或崖壁上，与覆满苔藓的岩石融为一体。滚动时，它们用坚固的身体和粗壮的双臂，护住背上的种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep at cave entrances or on cliff walls, blending in with mossy rocks. They use their durable bodies and large arms to protect the bulbs on their backs as they roll around.

entry: POKENAME不习惯用手臂，主要靠藤蔓在山坡移动。滚下山时会沿途播种，长出新的森林。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unaccustomed to using their arms, POKENAME navigate mountain slopes primarily with their vines. As they roll down mountains, they scatter seeds to create new forests.

entry: POKENAME身边已形成完整的生态系统，原来的种子在进化后硬化成了岩石。身上的花朵既能射出去，炸出密集弹幕，也能长成藤蔓发动攻击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: An entire ecosystem has sprouted around POKENAME's body, with their former bulbs hardening into rocks after evolution. The flowers on their body can be launched in explosive barrages or grown into vines for attacks.

entry: POKENAME把光合作用产生的热量储存在背上的种子里。种子伸出的藤蔓燃着火焰，让它能从对手身旁飞驰而过，打出强劲的一击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store heat generated from photosynthesis in the bulbs on their back. Flaming vines sprout from these bulbs, letting them deliver strong attacks while speeding past opponents.

entry: 光合作用积蓄的热量，会从POKENAME身上喷发，化为火焰鬃毛。战斗时，它们按复杂的路线奔跑，让藤蔓穿过鬃毛点燃后发动攻击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Heat gathered through photosynthesis erupts from POKENAME as a fiery mane. In battle, they run in complex patterns, aiming vines through the mane to ignite them for attacks.

entry: POKENAME到湖岸晒太阳，却经常拖延到日头很晚才出门。光合作用不足，能量更少，于是又陷入相同的循环。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander lake shores to bask in sunlight but often delay, going out late in the day. This incomplete photosynthesis leaves them with less energy, perpetuating the cycle.

entry: POKENAME坐在林中的湖畔，把尾部的种子泡在水里。野生宝可梦常来吸食其中的蜜，它却往往呆呆的，浑然不觉。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sit by lake shores in forests, resting the bulbs on their tails in the water. Wild Pokémon often drink nectar from their bulbs, but POKENAME are usually too dazed to notice.

entry: POKENAME共有三副身体，中央大脑就藏在主身背上的种子中。释放电力时，种子会微微展开，身上的螺钉也随之发亮。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The central brain of POKENAME's three bodies is stored in the bulb on the back of the main body. When releasing electricity, the bulb unfurls slightly, and the screws on their bodies glow.

entry: POKENAME把大葱鸭的大葱换成了从身体里长出的藤蔓。它把藤蔓当成鞭子，能从很远的地方抽出强劲的攻击。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: POKENAME has traded Farfetch'd's leek for a vine that grows from its body. It uses it like a whip to deliver powerful lashes from a long distance.

entry: 与许多妙蛙种子融合体相比，POKENAME的种子更大，好让一副身体的光合作用养活两颗头。它们站在晴朗的田野，不时转动身体，让两颗头均匀晒暖。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have larger bulbs than many other Bulbasaur fusions to support two heads with the photosynthesis of one body. They stand in sunny fields, turning back and forth to heat their heads evenly.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已长成一片茂密的枝叶，让三颗头都能均匀地晒到太阳。不过，打理叶片时，三颗头常会拌嘴。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back has sprouted into a leafy patch, allowing all three heads to absorb sunlight evenly. The heads often squabble as they maintain the leaves.

entry: 比起许多小海狮融合体，POKENAME更喜欢热带。它们在丛林河流中游动，让种子露出水面晒太阳，休息时则躺在浅水的岩石间，用藤蔓铺好临时的床。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Preferring more tropical climates to many Seel fusions, POKENAME swim along jungle rivers with their bulbs above the water to absorb sunlight. POKENAME will rest among rocks in shallow water, using vines to help arrange makeshift beds.

entry: POKENAME被视为热带河流的守护者，会用角清理河道里的杂物。它宽大的身躯能庇护小型宝可梦，有时还会让它们吸食种子里的蜜。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protectors of tropical rivers, using their horns to clear debris. POKENAME shelter smaller Pokémon using their large bodies, even letting some drink nectar from their bulbs.

entry: 受污染植物释放的过量孢子，凝成了有意识的淤泥。淤泥守护着逐渐长大的种子，试图挽回自己曾经作为嫩芽的模样。
author: WildheartRazorfangs
source: Excess spores from a polluted plant have condensed into a sentient sludge. The sludge protects the bulb as it grows, trying to salvage the sprout it once was.

entry: 受污染植物的孢子突变成了怪物。POKENAME战斗时洒出的污泥，会污染周围植物，甚至使其突变。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Spores from a polluted plant have mutated into a monstrous form. When POKENAME fight, they scatter sludge that can pollute or mutate nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME壳顶含有叶绿体，帮助进行光合作用。壳里积沙后，会拿来种植物，再留在岸边。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The top of POKENAME's shell contains chloroplasts that aid in photosynthesis. When sand collects in their shells, they use it to grow plants and leave them along the shore.

entry: 藻类聚在POKENAME壳内，形成微型生态系统。它会指挥藻类如藤蔓般抓住目标，不断收集生长所需的材料。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Collections of algae gather within POKENAME's shell, forming a miniature ecosystem. They command the algae to grab targets like vines, constantly gathering materials to grow.

entry: 黎明前，花园嫩芽间会冒出闪烁的奇异绿焰。那其实是POKENAME的孢子，正在照料植物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Just before dawn, strange flickering green flames can be seen emanating from garden sprouts. These flames are actually POKENAME spores, tending to the plants.

entry: 据说，游魂附在初生的嫩芽上，就会形成POKENAME。它们无声地飞过夜空，吸走毫无防备的猎物的生命力，让背上的种子绽放。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are said to form when wandering spirits possess budding sprouts. They silently fly at night, draining life force from unsuspecting prey to help their bulbs bloom.

entry: 迷失的灵魂附在萌芽的植物上，吸收周围生命的养分，直到长出完整身体。它们以POKENAME的姿态继续游荡、积蓄力量，背上的种子也慢慢绽放。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: When lost spirits possess budding plants, they absorb the nutrients of living things around them until they are able to grow a full body. These spirits wander as POKENAME to continue building their strength, the bulbs on their backs slowly blooming.

entry: 据说，靠近地表的大岩蛇长出能进行光合作用的种子后，就变成了POKENAME。种子的根系贯穿岩石身体，织成一张能伸缩自如的藤蔓网。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME formed when Onix near the surface of the ground sprouted bulbs for photosynthesis. The bulb's roots have grown through their rocky body, forming a network of extendable vines.

entry: POKENAME从种子释放孢子，让人类和宝可梦沉睡，再吸取梦中的能量。梦越甜美，种子绽放时就越灿烂。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release spores from their bulbs that put people and Pokémon to sleep, absorbing energy from their dreams. The sweeter the dream, the brighter their bulbs bloom.

entry: POKENAME以共生的方式生活。种子为主体提供温暖与住处，主体则借助种子长出的藤蔓，伸展利爪，保护种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME exist in a symbiotic relationship where the bulb provides warmth and shelter for the main body. In return, the main body defends the bulb with extendable claws powered by vines sprouting from it.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩横着跑，寻找临水的地方钻洞。它们用大钳盛起海水，再借光合作用的能量将水煮沸，用蒸馏出的水汽浇灌种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run sideways along beaches in order to find spots to burrow near the water. They gather seawater in their large claws and boil it using energy from photosynthesis, using the distilled vapor to water their bulbs.

entry: 两只绿毛虫融合后，诞生的宝可梦比体形两倍于自己的生物还贪婪饥饿。牙齿咬得动的都吃，却更偏爱苦涩有毒的食物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Fusing two Caterpie together has resulted in a Pokémon greedier and hungrier than anything twice its size. It will eat anything its teeth can pierce, but prefers bitter and toxic fare.

entry: 会捡铁甲蛹脱落的壳片当护甲。棍棒主要用来敲下树上美味的叶子和树果食用。
author: sk372
source: It uses discarded parts of Metapod shells as protective armor. Its club is used mainly to knock tasty leaves and berries down from trees for it to eat.

entry: 危急时，会毫不犹豫地抓起毫无准备的绿毛虫，当作临时棍棒自卫。不过会尽量不把这件临时武器伤得太重。
author: sk372
source: In desperate moments, it won't hesitate to use unwitting Caterpie as makeshift clubs for self-defense. It tries not to damage its impromptu weapon too much.

entry: 特别爱吃枝头的新鲜叶片。饥饿的POKENAME约一小时就能将一棵绿树啃光。
author: sk372
source: It has a strong appetite for fresh leaves straight from the branches. A hungry POKENAME can strip a verdant tree bare in about an hour.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拆下树间的蛛网，用来装树果，再送给其他同类。
author: Schierke
source: POKENAME likes to tear down webs connected to trees. It uses these webs to hold Berries in order to deliver them to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极为虚弱，常得用超能力帮助自己沿树枝爬行。很少战斗，更喜欢躲藏。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is incredibly weak and often needs to use its psychic abilities to crawl along tree branches. It rarely battles, preferring to remain hidden.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却很弱，因此常被飞行属性宝可梦当成量多好抓的食物。它们默默忍受袭击，极少反击。
author: SonTyp
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are weak Pokémon, so Flying-Type Pokémon often hunt them as an easy source of plentiful food. POKENAME endure those attacks stoically and rarely fight back.

entry: 常见于花园的植食害虫。老练的POKENAME脾气顽固火爆，被赶走后很快又会回来，像是在赌气。
author: bobosmith01
source: This common plant-eating pest is typically found in gardens. Experienced POKENAME have a stubborn and fiery temperament and will quickly return to a garden it has been chased out of, seemingly out of spite.

entry: POKENAME待客亲切，做事又出奇地专业，常受高级餐厅雇用。它也不计较报酬，认真干完活，只要一盘新鲜叶子就心满意足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are often employed by high-end restaurants for their pleasant demeanor and surprising professionalism. They are easily compensated as well, only asking for a nice plate of fresh leaves after a job well-done.

entry: 肩上红色绒毛覆着一层黏油。油会刺激皮肤，让其他宝可梦不愿抓它，唯独POKENAME同类似乎不受影响。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its shoulders are coated with fuzzy red down, which is protected by a sticky layer of oil. This oil irritates the skin and makes all Pokémon less likely to grab it, though other POKENAME are strangely immune.

entry: POKENAME喜爱群居，一群最多有一百只。虽行动迟缓，却会密密交织着游动，扰乱空中捕食者，保护同伴。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME are social Pokémon, traveling in packs of up to a hundred. Though sluggardly, they protect their ilk by slithering about in a dense weave to disorient airborne predators.

entry: POKENAME在绿蛇群中地位更高，智力却更低。它有时会想吞下比自己大好几倍的东西，结果卡得动弹不得。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME hold higher authority over packs of Caterans, but they also have lower intelligence. They will sometimes try to eat things several times their size and become stuck.

entry: 微弱电流始终流经体内，让它一直醒着。握住尾尖，电流就会穿过皮肤，让手心发麻。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It is always awake due to a weak electrical current running through its body. If you hold the tip of its tail, the current will run through your skin and make your palm tingle.

entry: POKENAME紧张时会一动不动，装成植物。可惜，这招很少有效。
author: 8xviktor
source: When stressed, POKENAME stands still to make itself look like a plant. Unfortunately, that strategy is rarely effective.

entry: 雷雨之夜，POKENAME会在树冠举尾朝天等待。雷电击中后，周围叶片瞬间被烤熟，成了它的美餐。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME waits in the canopy during thunderstorms with its tail pointed to the sky. Once lightning strikes it, the surrounding leaves are fried in an instant, turning into delicious fare for this Pokémon.

entry: 比起高树的叶子，POKENAME更爱吃顽强灌木的根。饮食中混入土壤后，皮肤就会变得更厚更韧。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME prefers the roots of hardy bushes to the leaves of tall trees. As soil makes is introduced into its diet, this Pokémon's skin grows tougher and thicker.

entry: 尖刺看似一丛绿叶，实则硬如岩石。POKENAME出了名地不合群，钻地吃根时也靠尖刺护住自己的空间。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: While its spines initially appear to be a leafy bush, they're actually hard as rocks. While it feasts on roots underground, these spines defend its personal space, as POKENAME are notoriously antisocial.

entry: 雌性POKENAME生来有胡须，随成长逐渐脱落。比雄性更善判断、更谨慎，每口食物都仔细试探，确认能否安全食用。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Female POKENAME are hatched with whiskers that fall out as they age. They are more analytical and cautious than male POKENAME, testing each morsel of food with care to check if it's safe to eat.

entry: 春季，POKENAME背上的花会散出甜香花粉，让人类与宝可梦都感到安宁。
author: Curerry
source: During the springtime, POKENAME releases a sweet smelling pollen from the flower on its back. This pollen is soothing to both humans and Pokémon.

entry: 炎热季节，POKENAME背上的花会散发宜人香气，常用于制作虫属性宝可梦诱饵与高级香水。
author: jaminmcready
source: During hot seasons, the flower on POKENAME's back produces a pleasant scent. This scent is commonly used to make Bug-type lures and luxury perfume.

entry: POKENAME用巨颚吞食找到的一切植物。无尽的食欲让它连远比自己大的草属性宝可梦也想吃，全然不顾危险。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its large jaws to devour any plant matter it can find. Its insatiable hunger drives it to attempt eating even much larger Grass Pokémon, regardless of the danger.

entry: 传说一只食欲无穷的绿毛虫吃光整片森林，长成了这只庞然大物。陆地无法承载它的体重，只好沉睡深海。
author: Mistymagius
source: Legends say this Pokémon came to be when a Caterpie with an insatiable hunger consumed an entire forest, growing to an enormous size. Unable to carry its own weight on land, it slumbers in the deep ocean.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，一跃能达100英尺。似乎很爱叶菜，尤其是生菜。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have extremely strong legs, allowing them to cover 100 feet in a single bound. They seem to a have a fondness for leafy vegetables, lettuce in particular.

entry: 尾巴分泌的臭油维持着火焰。火力很弱，烧不了东西，POKENAME只用它与同类交流。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It secretes a smelly oil from its tail that keeps its flame alight. The flame is too weak to actually burn anything; rather, POKENAME uses it to communicate with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME头内充满轻盈的有害气体，能让它在空中“游泳”。受威胁时便从角排气，吓退捕食者。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME's head is filled with a light, noxious gas, allowing it to "swim" through the air. Should it feel threatened, it'll release it through its horns to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME还不会飞，靠强壮的手臂与尾巴攀上大树。会用柔和火焰将巨叶烤脆，再吃下去。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Not yet able to fly, POKENAME utilizes its strong arms and tail to climb enormous trees. With its gentle flame, it heats up huge leaves to make them crunchier before it devours them.

entry: POKENAME没有牙齿，会先用恶臭的腐蚀液浸透食物，等化成能喝的糊状，再舔食。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME has no teeth, so instead douses its food with a foul, corrosive liquid. It laps up the resulting concoction once it's mushy enough to drink.

entry: 它用有毒的唾液在坚硬的果皮上蚀出小孔，再贪婪地吸吮里面的果汁。POKENAME是种植瓜西果的农场里臭名昭著的祸害。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It melts holes in the rinds of tough fruits with its toxic spit, then hungrily gulps down the juices inside. POKENAME is an infamous menace on farms growing Watmel Berries.

entry: POKENAME载着绿毛虫穿过宽阔水域，寻找食物、建立新群落。同伴会送上最大的树果作为回报。
author: Mirpebble
source: POKENAME carries Caterpie across large bodies of water to find food and form new colonies. In return, the colony gives POKENAME the largest berries.

entry: POKENAME背甲上载着年幼的绿毛虫。触角找到果实累累的植物后，自己大口吃光果实，乘客们则啃光叶片。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME carries with it young Caterpie on its shell. When its antennae lead it to a plant rich with fruit, it voraciously gobbles every one of them up while its passengers strip the plant bare of its leaves.

entry: POKENAME从红角散发甜香，引来小型宝可梦。缺乏经验的个体，往往会被自己的招数反过来害到。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME releases a sweet aroma from its red horn to lure small Pokémon to itself. Inexperienced POKENAME often fall victim to their own tactic.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在小树中，突然带着坏笑冒出，惊吓路过的训练家。可对方还没看清，它似乎就消失了。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to scare passing trainers, usually hiding in small trees then popping out suddenly with a mischievous grin. Oddly enough it seems to disappear before the trainer gets a good look at them.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子里蓄着不稳定的电能，受到干扰就可能引发大爆炸。它用电线般的藤蔓，从植物中抽取能量。
author: Mistymagius
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back contains unstable electrical energy, and disrupting it could cause a large explosion. It uses its wire-like vines to siphon energy from plant matter.

entry: 暴风雨之夜，成群POKENAME会出来，用杆状触角引雷。性情好斗，常互相电击取乐。
author: Mistymagius
source: During stormy nights, swarms of POKENAME emerge to draw lightning bolts with their rod-like antennae. They are aggressive Pokémon, often shocking each other for fun.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自现代的时空裂缝，穿越时空的旅程使它发生了变化。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Coming from a modern space-time rift, POKENAME is believed to have changed because of its journey through time.

entry: POKENAME兼具霹雳电球的自爆倾向与顽皮雷弹更大的储能。得意的笑容显露着爆炸潜力，旁人的恐惧更让它自负。
author: sk372
source: It combines Voltorb's self-destructive tendencies with Electrode's enhanced power stores. POKENAME's smug grin reflects its explosive potential and the ego fed by the fear it inspires.

entry: POKENAME的头长得像各种精灵球。掉落后，训练家常想捡起来，结果挨上一记猛烈电击。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME's heads resemble various types of Poké Balls. When they fall off, Trainers will often try to pick the discarded heads up, only to be met with a nasty shock.

entry: 捡到霹雳电球的外壳当头盔，如今已与头部融为一体。POKENAME还能借用其中一些力量。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This Pokémon picked up the shell of a Voltorb and wore it as a helmet. It is now fused to its head, and POKENAME borrows some of its power.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮仍很不稳定，必须小心。处理不当，就会迸成一片火花。
author: sk372
source: Care must be taken after a POKENAME sheds its skin, as the discarded layer is still volatile. Improper handling will lead to it bursting into a shower of sparks.

entry: 蜷起来几乎和普通霹雳电球一模一样。会混进电球群中恶作剧，突然展开身体，用鼻子将大家打飞。
author: sk372
source: When curled up, it looks nearly identical to a normal Voltorb. It pranks groups of Voltorb by hiding among them, then uncurling to send them flying with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮助训练家捕捉其他宝可梦，不知如何能自行产生各种精灵球供人使用。可惜，至今没有能制造大师球的记录。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys helping trainers catch other Pokémon, somehow producing a variety of Poké Balls on its own to share. To the chagrin of many, there are no records of a POKENAME that can create Master Balls.

entry: 藤蔓始终有电流涌动，因此常被用作比金属电线更环保的替代品。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its vines are constantly surging with electricity. Because of this, they are often used as a more eco-friendly alternative to metal wires.

entry: 野生POKENAME会蜷成球互相滚撞，争夺地位。较量太久，彼此汇合的电力可能擦出火花，甚至引发雷电。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME in the wild curl into balls and roll at each other to establish dominance. If these displays last long enough, their combined electricity may produce sparks and even lightning.

entry: 会将捡到的独特或遗落精灵球收在背上。有些POKENAME还会模仿训练家，把球射向宝可梦。
author: totodile.
source: This Pokémon is known to collect dropped or unique Poké Balls on its back. Some POKENAME mimic Trainers by firing said balls at Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体内蕴含大量电力，某些部位能看见电光噼啪。训练家一遇威胁，便毫不犹豫地爆发雷电保护对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME contains vast amounts of electricity, seen crackling within certain parts of its body. Should something threaten its Trainer, it will not hesitate to discharge explosive bursts of lightning to defend them.

entry: 不同于一般伪装成精灵球的宝可梦，它嘴上的花纹模仿高级球，吸引更强的猎物。巨颚电流涌动，咬住就能将目标麻痹。
author: Mistymagius
source: Unlike other Pokémon that use Poké Ball-like disguises, its mouth has a pattern mimicking an Ultra Ball to lure in stronger prey. Its jaws surge with electricity, which it uses to paralyze anything it chomps on.

entry: POKENAME像大颚蚁一样等待训练家或宝可梦经过。察觉猎物后，就会以爆炸般的力量射出金属内脏。
author: 12tie
source: Like a Trapinch, POKENAME waits for a wandering Trainer or Pokémon to walk past. When it senses prey, POKENAME launches its metallic innards with explosive force.

entry: POKENAME一落地就会猛烈爆炸。曾有人猜测它是战时科学家制造的武器，但这传闻已被证实不实。
author: Mistymagius
source: As soon as POKENAME hit the ground, their bodies erupt in a violent explosion. Some people theorized that scientists created POKENAME as a weapon during wartime, but this rumor has been proven false.

entry: POKENAME由回收的精灵球、旧手机和坏电线组成。体内机械可能过热，让它虚弱下来。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are made up of recycled Poké Balls, old phones, and damaged wires. The machinery inside it can overheat and cause POKENAME to become weak.

entry: 在森林与废弃地带，伪装成半埋土中的精灵球。训练家一想拔出来，它们就会爆炸。
author: totodile.
source: They disguise themselves as half-buried Poké Balls in forests and abandoned areas. When a Trainer tries to pull them out of the ground, they explode.

entry: POKENAME融合后反而更稳定。比未融合的霹雳电球更大、更不易爆炸，甚至有人研究把它当作活的工业级大容量电池。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME is less volatile than the sum of its parts - its larger size and less explosive nature compared to an unfused Voltorb have even had some look into using it as a living, industrial-capacity battery.

entry: POKENAME极不稳定，任何情况下都不该靠近。受刺激就会怒而爆炸，电击周围的一切。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely volatile and should not be approached under any circumstance. If agitated, they explode with anger and electrocute anything in their vicinity.

entry: POKENAME从炮管射出大量等离子流，让较弱的宝可梦失去行动能力。坚韧的壳能容纳体内奔涌的电能。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME fire large streams of plasma from their cannons, incapacitating weaker Pokémon. Their durable shell can contain the electrical energy coursing through it.

entry: 顽皮地啃咬电线，摄取电力。甲壳脆弱，状态极不稳定，哪怕轻微受损也会爆炸。
author: Mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon will nibble on electrical lines to feed on electricity. Due to their weak carapaces, they are highly volatile and will explode if even slightly damaged.

entry: POKENAME产生的能量极不稳定，若全力引爆，威力足以媲美原子弹！
author: Phantom640
source: Due to the unstable energy it creates, If POKENAME were to ever detonate with full power, the strength of the blast would be equal to an atomic bomb!

entry: 痴迷于收集损坏、被丢弃的精灵球，住处一次就能塞进300多个。
author: .izik
source: It obsessively collects broken and discarded Poké Balls, filling its shelter with over 300 at a time.

entry: POKENAME用巨舌放出多余电力，以免身体肿胀、生病。有些医院甚至会请它充当活体除颤器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its massive tongue to discharge excess electricity to avoid becoming bloated and ill. Some hospitals have even used them as living defibrillators.

entry: POKENAME每天产生的炸弹，能毁掉周围半径二十英尺内的一切。它真正的蛋与炸弹根本分不出来。
author: bee4082
source: The bomb an POKENAME produces every day can destroy anything within a twenty-foot radius. Their actual eggs are indistinguishable from these bombs.

entry: POKENAME并没有想象中那么依恋孩子。自己遇到生命危险，就会将孩子扔向敌人引爆。育儿袋一夜之间又会形成新的孩子。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME is not as attached to its child as one might think. If its own life is in danger, it will throw the child at its enemies to cause an explosion. A new child is formed from its pouch overnight.

entry: 每挥一拳，拳头都会引发小型电爆。这种富有爆发力的打法，以冲击波压制敌人。
author: .izik
source: When attacking, its fists create small electrical explosions with each punch. This dynamic combat style overwhelms its foes with shockwaves.

entry: 身体由极不稳定的黏液构成，会对自身负面情绪产生剧烈反应。严重时，会不受控制地爆炸。
author: .izik
source: Its body is made of a highly unstable goo that reacts violently to its own negative emotions. In extreme cases, it may explode uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME每一节身体都能猛烈爆炸。引爆一节，便会让其余部分接连引爆，造成毁灭性的连锁反应。
author: sk372
source: Each segment of POKENAME's body is capable of exploding with tremendous force. Triggering one sets off the rest in a devastating chain reaction.

entry: POKENAME全身各处都能放电，常见于发电厂附近。被它咬一口，可真会“电”得大吃一惊！
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME is known to emit electricity from everywhere on its body. Commonly found near powerplants, getting bitten by one is a shocking surprise!

entry: 尾巴由半透明塑料构成，能看见电流在内部流动。若亮起纯白光，就说明快要爆炸。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is made of translucent plastic, showing electricity flowing inside. If the tail glows pure white, an explosion is imminent.

entry: 尾尖能放出强劲雷电。会将尾巴探进水中，精准电晕并捕获猎物。
author: .izik
source: The tip of its tail releases powerful bolts of electricity. It dips its tail in water to stun and catch its prey with precision.

entry: 叶片与花由导电金属构成。好奇的虫或飞行属性宝可梦只要停在上面，瞬间就会触电。
author: Staghorn
source: Its leaves and flower are comprised of conductive metals. Any curious Bug- or Flying-type Pokémon that land on it are electrocuted in a flash.

entry: POKENAME的球状嘴越大，储能越多，也越不稳定。面对更大的对手时，会先咬紧敌人，再引爆。
author: Mistymagius
source: The larger POKENAME's orb-like mouth grows, the more energy it stores and the more volatile it becomes. When face to face with larger opponents, it will chomp down on its foe before detonating.

entry: 遇到POKENAME时，若见导火索正燃着，就该快跑——那代表它快要自爆了。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: If one comes across a POKENAME and its fuse is burning, they should run. This signifies it is about to self-destruct.

entry: 凝望月亮时，双翼电光噼啪。常住在太阳能发电厂的屋顶，吸收能量。
author: .izik
source: Its wings crackle with electricity as it gazes at the moon. It often resides on the rooftops of solar power plants to absorb energy.

entry: 靠电磁力悬浮，用电击器般的爪子释放强烈电击。走投无路时还能自爆，四处射出尖锐弹片，但也会筋疲力尽。
author: Phantom640
source: It floats using electromagnetism and delivers powerful shocks with its taser-like claws. As a last resort, it can detonate, firing spiked shrapnel everywhere, though this leaves it exhausted.

entry: POKENAME能蜷成精灵球模样躲藏。还能将自身电能塑成极复杂的图案，用于威吓和交流。
author: El Fail
source: POKENAME are able to curl up to hide in such a way that they resemble a Poké Ball. They are also able to manipulate their innate electrical energy into extremely elaborate patterns as a means of both intimidation and communication.

entry: 一唱就是数小时，乐在其中。若唱到一半被打断，就会大发脾气，常常闹到爆炸。
author: .izik
source: It sings for hours without stopping, enjoying its melodic rituals. If interrupted mid-verse, it throws a tantrum that often results in an explosive reaction.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找最强的精灵球。即使拿着高级球，仍不肯停，仿佛还有更强的球存在。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME searches for the strongest Poké Ball they can find. Even if it holds an Ultra Ball, it keeps looking, suggesting a more powerful ball exists.

entry: 能将电流导入拳头。笑容越大，存下的电量就越多。
author: LGreat
source: This Pokémon can channel electrical currents into its fists. The bigger the smile, the more electricity is stored.

entry: 身上的蘑菇形似精灵球。受惊时会喷出一团孢子，接触后会造成轻微电灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on its body resembles a Poké Ball. When startled, it releases a cloud of spores that cause mild electrical burns upon contact.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖中储存的巨大能量引发猛烈爆炸。会带着令人胆寒的喜悦，炸毁找到的一切。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the large amount of energy stored in its wand to summon massive explosions. It will blow up anything it can find with terrifying glee.

entry: 训练家常把睡着的POKENAME错当成精灵球。若突然触碰，它常会毫无预兆地爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Trainers often mistake sleeping POKENAME for Poké Balls. If it is suddenly touched, it often explodes without warning.

entry: 训练家常把睡着的POKENAME错当成精灵球。若突然触碰，它常会毫无预兆地爆炸。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Trainers often mistake sleeping POKENAME for Poké Balls. If it is suddenly touched, it often explodes without warning.

entry: 逆时针甩动尾巴发电。常以爆炸分散注意，让同伴趁机偷走毫无防备的猎物身上的东西。
author: .izik
source: It swings its tail in a counter-clockwise motion to generate electricity. It often explodes as a diversion while an ally steals from unsuspecting prey.

entry: 充电的球体像一枚被丢弃的精灵球。长时间充电后，再掷向敌人，施以电击。
author: .izik
source: The orb it charges with electricity resembles a discarded Poké Ball. It hurls the orb at enemies after charging it over an extended period to shock them.

entry: 以念力托着三颗带电球体，战斗时掷向敌人。一经撞击，便爆出耀眼火花。
author: .izik
source: It psychically carries three orbs charged with electricity, lobbing them at enemies during battle. These orbs explode in dazzling sparks upon impact.

entry: 为了让围观者赞叹，会先给身体充电再举重物。若用力过猛，就会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: To impress onlookers, its body charges with electricity before lifting heavy objects. If overexerted, it will explode.

entry: 爆炸后，要花数天重新充满电。许多地下隧道与洞窟都被认为是它炸出来的。
author: .izik
source: If it explodes, it takes several days to recharge its body. Many underground tunnels and caverns are attributed to its detonation habits.

entry: POKENAME自给自足，靠自己产生的电能生存。输出过多时，就容易爆炸。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME is self-sufficient, feeding off the electric energy it produces. If it outputs too much, it is prone to explosion.

entry: POKENAME中间的头集中了全身的电力和怒气。另两颗头因此格外小心，生怕以任何方式惹爆它。
author: sk372
source: The central head of POKENAME contains all of the electricity in its body, as well as all the aggression. This leaves the other two heads very wary of setting it off in any way.

entry: 钳子长得像精灵球。据推测，会用来吸引冲浪中的训练家和宝可梦，再电击对方。
author: MaNandesz
source: Their pincers resemble Poké Balls. It's theorized that it uses them to draw in surfing Trainers and Pokémon to shock them.

entry: 用精灵球般的钳子，将宝可梦从训练家身边引开。再用强烈电击制服猎物，迅速拖入水中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Poké Ball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: 用精灵球般的钳子，将宝可梦从训练家身边引开。再用强烈电击制服猎物，迅速拖入水中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Poké Ball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: 用精灵球般的钳子，将宝可梦从训练家身边引开。再用强烈电击制服猎物，迅速拖入水中。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It lures Pokémon from Trainers with its Poké Ball-like claws. It shocks its prey with strong electric shocks and quickly pulls them into the water.

entry: 看似舌头，其实是POKENAME形状不定的内部组织。能随意伸长、缩小、变形，派上各种用途。
author: sk372
source: What looks like a tongue is actually part of the amorphous insides of POKENAME. It can grow, shrink, and reshape this appendage for a variety of purposes.

entry: 身体是一个巨大的柔韧蛋壳。POKENAME越健康，蛋壳就越坚固。
author: holgast
source: Its body is a single giant, flexible eggshell. The shell is stronger if a POKENAME is in good health.

entry: 蛋形核心外裹着蛋黄般的黏液。无论变成什么，核心总会在某处隐约显露。
author: sk372
source: A yolk-like ooze surrounds the egg-shaped core of the body. Whenever it morphs, this core is always faintly visible somewhere in its transformed form.

entry: POKENAME飞起来很吃力，却从不气馁。无论怎样，都保持阳光般的心态。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME struggles to fly, but that doesn't deter it. It'll keep up its sunny-side mindset no matter what.

entry: 能用超能力制造人类服装的幻象，模仿人们的穿着打扮。主要见于住在研究设施的POKENAME。
author: .izik
source: By using its psychic abilities it can create illusions of clothing that it sees on humans in an attempt to mimic their fashion. This is primarily seen with POKENAME that live in research facilities.

entry: 从里面开心的样子看来，破壳似乎替这群蛋蛋释放了不少压力。据说味道很好。
author: token08
source: Being cracked open seems to relieve a lot of stress from a cluster of Exeggcute, as it has a happy interior. It is supposedly delicious.

entry: POKENAME会充当蛋蛋的首领与守护者，保护它们等待进化。可它自己，其实也十分脆弱。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: An POKENAME will act as the leader and protector for Exeggute while they prepare for Evolution. However, it is very fragile itself.

entry: 百代市一家知名餐厅，会用它辛辣的藤蔓制作招牌卡邦尼意面。风味独特，备受追捧。
author: .izik
source: A renowned restaurant in Eterna City uses this Pokémon's spicy vines to make a signature carbonara dish. The flavor is both unique and highly sought after.

entry: POKENAME进化前，通常会与几只同类共同筑巢。偏爱青草与花朵，也倾向避免冲突。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically nest together with several other POKENAME until they evolve. They prefer a diet of grass and flowers and tend to avoid conflict.

entry: POKENAME将蛋状的嘴放进其他宝可梦的巢中作陷阱，想吃掉前来偷蛋的宝可梦。对巢主与新孵出的幼崽，却十分友善。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME place their egg-like mouths in other Pokémon's nests as traps, attempting to eat any Pokémon that tries to steal them. Despite this, they are friendly to the parents and newly hatched babies.

entry: 许多厨师会带一只POKENAME在身边。它能轻松判断菜肴是否欠缺火候或风味。
author: .ssunday.
source: Many chefs keep a POKENAME by their sides. It can easily predict if a meal is missing heat or flavor.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会把育儿袋中的一只幼年蛋蛋扔向攻击者。虽然危险，蛋蛋们却很喜欢被这样抛来抛去。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When startled, POKENAME will throw one of the baby Exeggcute in its pouches at the aggressor. The Exeggcute love being thrown around, even if it is dangerous for them.

entry: 胸部的脸是否有意识，仍不清楚。但一位学者坚称曾见它向自己眨眼，随后便引发争论。
author: Dusknoir64
source: It is unknown if the face on the thorax is sentient, however, it has become a subject of debate after one scholar swore the face winked at him.

entry: 会长出椰子般的头，像火箭筒一样射出。无论单发还是连射，都轻而易举。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It grows coconut heads and shoots them out like a bazooka. It can easily fire individually or in spurts.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: 根已长成强健的腿，能支撑它长途奔行。背上的一个突起向上弯起，用来承载幼崽。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Its roots have grown into legs strong enough to propel it across vast distances. One growth on it s back bends upwards to carry its young.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: 爆炸时，尖锐骨片会飞向四面八方，既是武器，也是对潜在威胁的警告。
author: .izik
source: If it explodes, it sends sharp bone shards flying in all directions. These fragments serve as both a weapon and a warning to potential threats.

entry: 随身骨头上布满无数争斗留下的咬痕。它将这件磨损的遗物视为珍宝，奋力守护。
author: .izik
source: The bone it carries is full of bite marks from countless skirmishes. It guards this worn relic fiercely, viewing it as a prized possession.

entry: 听见鼓点，POKENAME就会在空中不由自主地舞动，吸引好奇者围观。突然起舞，也能平复自己的负面情绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body moves uncontrollably in the air when it hears the beat of drums. This phenomenon often attracts curious onlookers as its sudden dancing soothes its own negative emotions.

entry: 靠近它的沼泽就会产生幻觉。这些幻象常让闯入者迷路，保住家园的清静。
author: .izik
source: It causes hallucinations in anyone who ventures too close to its swamp. These visions often lead intruders astray, ensuring its home remains undisturbed.

entry: 看到POKENAME用棒子敲自己的头骨，可别误以为它很抑郁。它其实是在敲裂外壳，让愈合后的壳更加牢固。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Contrary to popular belief, if a POKENAME is seen hitting its skull with its club, it is not in a depressive state. It is actually cracking its shell so that when it heals, it becomes more durable.

entry: POKENAME与逝去嘎啦嘎啦的灵魂有心灵联系。会与彼岸的它们沟通，试着安抚亡魂，令其安息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a psychic connection with the souls of deceased Marowak. It communes with them in the afterlife, attempting to grant their spirits some measure of peace, so they may rest.

entry: 只有极度快乐或悲伤时，本体才会从头骨中显露。短暂现身的模样，带着超脱尘世的气息。
author: .izik
source: Its main body only emerges from the skull when it experiences intense happiness or sadness. This fleeting appearance gives it an otherworldly presence.

entry: POKENAME钻进洞壁，伪装成化石。会让假头骨的颚喀喀作响，吓退闯入者。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow into the walls of caves to disguise as fossils, rattling the jaw of their false skull to scare off intruders.

entry: 头骨坚固得能将黑曜石击成细粉，因此在战斗中十分可怕。
author: .izik
source: Its skull is so durable that it can break obsidian into fine powder. This strength makes it a fearsome opponent in battle.

entry: 戴着的头骨坚韧得能偏转雷电。即使最猛烈的风暴中，这层天然护甲也能保护它。
author: .izik
source: The skull it wears is so resilient it can deflect lightning bolts. This natural armor keeps it safe even during the fiercest storms.

entry: POKENAME是曾被认为灭绝的古老宝可梦，后来在沙漠深处被发现，那里鲜有其他草属性宝可梦。坚固的壳与头骨让它抵御恶劣天气。
author: Katie
source: An ancient Pokémon thought extinct for some time, POKENAME has been discovered living deep in deserts with few other Grass-types around. POKENAME has a hardy shell and skull to protect itself from the harsh weather of its environment.

entry: 骨内嵌着磁铁，具有奇异的磁性，能轻松吸引并操纵金属物体。
author: .izik
source: Magnets are embedded within its bones, giving them strange magnetic properties. This allows it to attract and manipulate metallic objects with ease.

entry: 老学者说，这把骨匕首由孤独野兽的遗骸制成，还被它的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This bone dagger is said by old scholars to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.

entry: 学会了附身采矿设备，用工具挖取珍贵矿物。对机械的恶作剧常让矿工摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: It has learned to possess mining equipment, using tools to extract valuable minerals. Its mechanical mischief often leaves miners baffled.

entry: 身体形似墓碑，会制造幻象，让敌人措手不及。这些诡异手段让它在战斗中占优。
author: .izik
source: Its body resembles a gravestone, and it projects illusions to catch opponents off-guard. These eerie tricks give it an edge in battle.

entry: 母亲离去后，POKENAME只能独自生存，成长中始终思念母亲的温暖。这份磨炼让它坚韧，能应对危险的海洋生活。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME grow up missing the warmth of their mothers, who leave them to survive alone. This hardship prepares them for dangerous sea life, ensuring their resilience.

entry: 传说它是孩子的灵魂。即使POKENAME自己死去，也不肯放下母亲的头骨。
author: welliss
source: This Pokémon is rumored to be the spirit of a child. Stories tell that it refused to part with its mother's skull, even after POKENAME passed.

entry: 用头骨猛撞敌人，以突然而强劲的冲击威吓对方，是凶悍的领地守护者。
author: .izik
source: It rams its skull into enemies, frightening them with sudden, forceful impacts. This aggressive tactic makes it a fearsome protector of its territory.

entry: 古时被用来守护城堡地牢，阻止闯入者。坚定的忠诚，使它成为可畏的哨兵。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, it was used to guard castle dungeons, keeping intruders at bay. Its unwavering loyalty made it a formidable sentinel.

entry: 稍不如意，就会像婴儿般哭闹，引来注意。这样的性子，让训练家很难管教。
author: .izik
source: It cries like a baby whenever it doesn't get its way, drawing attention to itself. This behavior makes it difficult for Trainers to manage.

entry: 钻石般的眼睛在最黑暗的环境中也能看清一切，让它十分擅长探索地下隧道。
author: .izik
source: Its diamond-like eyes grant it perfect vision in the darkest environments. This ability makes it a formidable explorer of underground tunnels.

entry: 靠天生的方向感，将失踪旅人的遗骨送回故乡，因此有了游魂守护者的传说。
author: .izik
source: It brings the bones of lost travelers back to their hometowns, guided by an innate sense of direction. This behavior has led to legends of it being a guardian of wandering souls.

entry: 会花时间仔细清扫墓地，尊重逝者。这个不寻常的习惯赢得了大家的敬意。
author: .izik
source: It takes time to carefully clean cemeteries, showing respect for the departed. This unusual habit earns it admiration from others.

entry: 雷暴时会挥舞骨头，将电荷吸入体内，增强力量，变得更为强悍。
author: .izik
source: It waves its bone at lightning storms, absorbing the electric charge into its body. This energy boosts its strength, making it even more formidable.

entry: 将全部悲伤化为重拳，每次出击都释放着哀痛。靠这种方式排解情绪，战斗时便不肯停歇。
author: .izik
source: It channels all its grief into powerful punches, unleashing its sorrow with each strike. This coping mechanism makes it a relentless fighter.

entry: 挥舞骨头时，会发出令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫，令闻者心生恐惧。
author: .izik
source: When it swings its bone, it lets out a blood-curdling howl. This chilling sound strikes fear into anyone who hears it.

entry: 心中愤怒又孤寂，却已想不起原因。在呆呆兽与卡拉卡拉一家身旁时，能找到一点安宁。
author: sk372
source: It feels angry and forlorn, though it cannot remember the reason why.  It finds some tranquility when in the presence of Slowpoke and Cubone families.

entry: 一哭就会迸出阵阵电流，电到周围的对象。突发的哭闹让它难以预测，也十分危险。
author: .izik
source: When it starts to cry, it unleashes bursts of electricity that shock those nearby. These fits make it unpredictable and dangerous.

entry: 向敌人吐沙，扰乱其方向与判断。这种狡猾手段常让它在战斗中占上风。
author: .izik
source: It spits sand at foes to disorient and confuse them. This sneaky tactic often gives it the upper hand in combat.

entry: 经常弄掉头骨，先放声大笑，再失控痛哭。奇怪的举动让敌我双方都很困惑。
author: .izik
source: It frequently drops its skull, bursting into laughter before sobbing uncontrollably. This strange behavior confuses both allies and foes.

entry: 传闻会从墓地偷走骨头，添进自己的收藏。诡异的行为让人类与宝可梦都不安。
author: .izik
source: Rumors say it steals bones from graveyards, adding them to its collection. This eerie behavior unsettles both humans and Pokémon alike.

entry: 全身覆盖着骨头般的岩石。考古学家曾将沉睡的POKENAME误当成巨型化石挖出来。
author: Frokachu
source: Its entire body is coated in a bone-like rock. Archaeologists once unearthed a slumbering POKENAME by mistake, believing it to be a large fossil.

entry: 用超能力改变飞出骨头的方向，确保精准命中，让这件武器变得难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It uses psychic power to redirect its bone mid-flight, ensuring precision strikes. This skill makes its bone an unpredictable weapon.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能与逝去的嘎啦嘎啦交流。凡是遇上的卡拉卡拉，它都会主动照料，好安慰与自己相通的母亲亡灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to communicate with the souls of fallen Marowak. It takes it upon itself to care for any and all Cubone it comes across, to soothe the matron spirit it communes with.

entry: POKENAME虽然已有坚硬的外骨骼，仍会把战败敌人的头骨与骨骼制成盔甲，加强防护。它锋利的双镰能轻松切开对手，是战场上可怕的存在。
author: Rakunk
source: Despite its already tough exoskeleton, POKENAME has adapted the skulls and bones of its fallen foes into armor for added protection. Its razor-sharp scythes effortlessly slice through opponents, making it a formidable force in battle.

entry: POKENAME骨质般的护甲，曾是母亲的遗骸。跨过丧母之痛后，坚定不移的勇气驱使它为生存而战。钢铁巨钳能碾碎一切。
author: Beatdoof
source: The bone-like armor POKENAME possesses was once its mother's remains. Overcoming the sorrow of its mother's death, POKENAME's unshakeable bravery is what drives it to fight for survival. Its steely pincers are strong enough to crush anything.

entry: POKENAME为纪念心中亲近的逝者，会将其骨头烧成灰，再用双翼撒向世界各地。
author: Milchik
source: Wishing to honor the memories of those close to its heart after their death, POKENAME burns their bones down to ashes and scatters them across the world with its wings.

entry: POKENAME独居洞穴，避开一切交往，尤其不愿接触人类。传说背上的头骨中有个痛苦的灵魂守护着它。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME isolate themselves in caves, avoiding all social interaction, especially with humans. Legends claim the skull on their back holds a distressed spirit that watches over them.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: Katie
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: Katie
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: 融合的副作用让POKENAME的双翼枯萎，只剩骨头。它为此悲伤不已，常因沮丧而乱发脾气。
author: Phantom640
source: A side-effect of POKENAME's fusion causes its wings to wither down to bone. It grieves endlessly about this and often lashes out in frustration.

entry: POKENAME的骨棒散发微弱灵光，能温柔地让人安稳入睡。它守在睡者身边，攻击者一靠近，骨棒又是有力的防御武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bone club emits a faint aura that lets it gently put people into a restful slumber. It stays near the sleeper, using the club just as effectively for defense should an attacker draw close to them.

entry: 据说POKENAME由沙丘娃与落入陷阱的卡拉卡拉共生而成。这份联系让双方都完成进化，成为会向新猎物投掷骨片的顶级捕食者。
author: DoodleDoo
source: POKENAME is thought to be the result of a Sandygast forming a symbiotic bond with a Cubone that fell into its trap. This bond has allowed them both to reach their evolutions, turning them into an apex predator that throws bone shards at new victims.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟中爬行，伪装成空头骨躲避捕食者。细听之下，据说能听见头骨状突起内回荡着嘎啦嘎啦微弱而阴森的哭声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scuttles around caverns, pretending to be a hollow skull to avoid predators. It is said that if one listens closely, the faint and eerie cry of a Marowak can be heard echoing within the skull-like growth.

entry: 野生POKENAME看似捕食者，实际是伺机取食的食腐者。会在安全距离外徘徊，等其他捕食者吃完猎物。
author: kingd8
source: While they may look like predators, wild POKENAME are actually opportune scavengers, circling from a safe distance while other predators finish their prey.

entry: POKENAME游荡在沙漠，将其他食腐者早已丢弃的骨头上的腐肉啃净。胃已适应到连鲜肉都无法消化。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME roam the deserts, picking the rotting meat clean from bones long-abandoned by other scavengers. Their stomachs have adapted to the point where they can no longer even digest fresh meat.

entry: 据说骨面具带着可怕诅咒。心怀不纯念头者戴上后，肺部机能就会受到严重限制。
author: .izik
source: Its bone mask is said to hold a horrible curse. Legends say if the mask is worn by someone with impure thoughts, it heavily restricts lung function.

entry: 每颗头上的头骨都极其坚固，据说没有谁能在三头联手撞击后活下来。POKENAME夜间奔驰于干旱土地，跃起时发出尖啸。
author: sk372
source: The skulls on each head are so solidly built that it's often said nothing can survive being hit by all three in tandem. POKENAME dashes across arid dry lands at night, leaping through the air with a piercing cry.

entry: 四肢能伸得很长，加上沉重体形，让敌人不敢大意。因为它随时可能不只踢一脚，而是将全身弹向对方。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has limbs that can stretch long distances, so it combines that with its hefty weight to keep its opponent on guard; there is always the possibility it will suddenly spring its body directly into the foe instead of merely throwing a kick.

entry: POKENAME喜欢让年幼格斗属性宝可梦以圆鼓鼓的头当沙袋，试试力气。厚实的皮肤让它几乎感觉不到痛。
author: regula
source: POKENAME enjoys letting young Fighting-type Pokémon test their strength by using its bulbous head as a punching bag. Its thick leathery skin ensures that it feels little to no pain from this.

entry: POKENAME双腿弹性十足，最多能伸长30英尺。耐性与韧性极强，能在严酷沙漠中静候对手。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs are incredibly stretchy and can reach up to 30 feet. It is incredibly resilient, patiently waiting for an opponent in the harsh desert.

entry: 进一步研究前，POKENAME曾被当成未知的原野水母变体。腿状触手比看起来强得多，每次踢击都能注入强力毒液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was thought to be an undiscovered variant of Toedscool until further research was performed. Its leg-like tentacles are deceptively strong, and deliver a potent dose of poison with every kick.

entry: 用钳子抓住对手，同时接连踢出强劲的腿击。POKENAME会侧身小跳着前进。
author: epping_forest
source: Its technique consists on grabbing the opponent with its claws while throwing a barrage of powerful kicks. POKENAME walks sideways, doing little jumps.

entry: POKENAME不再用腿踢敌人，却爱摆出踢击姿势。实际会蹬地增强重钳的攻击，并凭强劲抓握施展摔跤抱摔。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME no longer uses its legs to kick its opponents, but it loves posing as if it did. What it actually does is kick the ground to power up the blows of its heavy claw and perform wrestling shots thanks to its strong grip.

entry: POKENAME用能伸缩的弹性双腿维持平衡，俯身闪避敌人的攻击。还能摆出特殊姿势，从出人意料的角度挥拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its retractable and stretchy legs to maintain balance while ducking and weaving from an opponent's blows. They also allow it to take positions that let it punch from unorthodox angles.

entry: POKENAME天生的体形与力量足以让相扑选手羡慕，却偏爱拳击。速度比快拳郎慢，让它有时训练不顺，十分沮丧。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME features natural bulk and strength that would make sumo wrestlers jealous, but it prefers boxing. Being slower than Hitmonchan, it sometimes has trouble effectively training for the sport and gets frustrated.

entry: 它用六条腿接连刺出快拳，猛击猎物。尤其要提防，它的左钩拳。
author: missingmilkman
source: It strikes rapidly at its prey with rapid jabs from all six of its legs. One should watch out for its left hooks.

entry: POKENAME会互相对练，磨炼出奇有力的拳头。可手臂太短，常难以打中对手。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other to train their surprisingly powerful punches. They struggle to hit their opponents due to their short arms.

entry: POKENAME用粗重尾巴砸击树木与岩石，锻炼力量。实际比看起来强得多，一击足以将钢梁打凹。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hone their strength by smashing their hefty tails into trees and rocks. They are deceptively strong, striking with enough force to dent a steel beam.

entry: 头发像沙袋，POKENAME一天大部分时间都在用它练拳。战斗不顺时，会狂甩头发，想以蛮力击退对手。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its hair acts like a punching bag which POKENAME uses to train its punches for most of the day. If it is struggling in a fight, it will swing its hair wildly trying to knock away its opponent with extreme force.

entry: 冰冻的拳头让周围空气冷却，每挥一拳便会结冰。据说即使最炽热的火属性宝可梦，挨上一记刺拳也会被冻实。
author: sk372
source: Its frozen fists chill the air around it, forming ice whenever it throws a punch. It is said that even the hottest of Fire-Type Pokémon will be frozen solid from getting hit by even a single jab.

entry: POKENAME外表毛绒绒，内部却致密如沙袋。即使最猛烈的冲击，也能安然吸收。
author: mx_wellman
source: Despite its plush appearance, a POKENAME's insides are dense and sandbag-like, capable of absorbing even the most devastating impacts without a hitch.

entry: POKENAME能将两个拳状部件射出，远距离出拳。附带的磁铁会使其迅速返回，准备再次发射。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire two of its fist-like components outward as long-distance punching attacks. Attached magnets ensure they quickly return, ready to be launched again.

entry: 会快速捶打地面，推动身体前进。力道足以让它短暂飞起，不过几秒后通常就会脸朝下落地，结束这趟小旅行。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon moves forward by rapidly punching the ground. It does so with enough force to temporarily gain the ability of flight. Its little journey usually ends within a few seconds when it hits the floor face first.

entry: POKENAME总是闭壳休息，硬壳与利刺能吓退大多捕食者。谁若强行撬壳，它就会突然打开，从里面打出毁灭性的一拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are constantly seen closed and at rest, their tough shell and sharp spikes deterring most predators. Those who attempt to forcefully pry open the shell will see it open suddenly to launch a devastating punch from within.

entry: POKENAME握力很强，却觉得使用它像作弊。但手臂实在无力，最终还是借这股力道加强拳击。
author: epping_forest
source: Despite its powerful grip, POKENAME feels like it would be cheating to use it. Anyway, because of how weak their arms are, they end up using that strength to power up its punches.

entry: POKENAME猛合巨钳，产生震耳欲聋的冲击波。通常一拳都不用出，就能让对手昏倒。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME creates deafening shockwaves by snapping its powerful claws. By doing this they usually make their opponents faint without landing a single punch.

entry: 舌头超过体长两倍，主要用来探知周围。鸟宝可梦若想吃它，就会被黏唾液糊住双翼，难以飞行。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its tongue is over twice its body length, so it mainly uses it to determine its surroundings. If any bird Pokémon tries to eat it, it will coat their wings in its sticky saliva, making it difficult for them to fly.

entry: POKENAME古怪的体形让它只能靠舌头蹦跳，可那样很痛，只好不动。靠舔电属性宝可梦获取能量维生。
author: matpal6
source: POKENAME's awkward body forces it to hop on its tongue, causing pain that keeps it stationary. It sustains itself by licking Electric-Type Pokémon for energy.

entry: 拥有共同意识，任何一个蛋的舌头尝到味道，其他蛋也能尝到。发现特别美味的东西时，整群都会涌上去，从各个方向猛舔。
author: sk372
source: Thanks to a hive mind, any flavor one egg's tongue comes across, the others will taste as well. Should one of the clutch find something particularly delicious, the entire group will swarm and lick it intensely from all sides.

entry: 有东西引起兴趣，就会冲过去，非要舔个遍。谁倒霉挡在它与目标之间，都会被撞翻。
author: sk372
source: If something piques its interest, it will charge towards it, intent on licking it thoroughly. It will bowl over anything unfortunate enough to get between it and its target.

entry: POKENAME的舌头与藤蔓一样，切断后24小时内就能再生。断舌还会跳动扭曲数秒，让许多人感到不安。
author: sk372
source: Like its vines, POKENAME's tongue will be replaced by a new one within 24 hours if severed. A severed tongue flops and wriggles for several seconds afterward, a sight many consider unnerving.

entry: POKENAME的巨舌一下就能卷来大量食物，喂给孩子。幼崽食量惊人，少了可不够。
author: sk372
source: With its huge tongue, POKENAME can gather up large amounts of food in a single motion, gathering it for its child. These large portions are necessary, as POKENAME young have a prodigious appetite.

entry: 靠宽大黏稠的舌头吞食花粉。POKENAME吃下的花粉会从翅膀分泌，再随着飞舞散播。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It gulps down pollen with its broad, sticky tongue. The pollen POKENAME eats is secreted through its wings and scattered while it flutters about.

entry: POKENAME会在风中挥动舌头，预测天气。察觉风暴将至，就会赶走附近伙伴，保护它们。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME waves its tongue in the wind to predict the weather. If it senses an incoming storm, it will drive allies away from the area in order to protect them.

entry: 身体太重飞不起来，于是用强健柔韧的下半身将自己弹上数米高空，再靠翅膀控制方向。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: As it is too heavy to fly, it instead catapaults itself many meters into the air off the ground using its strong and flexible lower body and steers with its wings.

entry: POKENAME头上垂着的“舌头”，其实是巧妙藏起的巨颚。嘴对疼痛很敏感，谁打得太重就会被反击。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its tongue is actually a cleverly hidden set of jaws that drapes over POKENAME's head. The mouth is very sensitive to pain, and it will attack anything that hits it too hard.

entry: POKENAME极为懒惰，会躺着示意路人喂食。不肯照做，就会被长舌抓住，再挨上一顿重拳。
author: sk372
source: Extremely lazy, a lounging POKENAME will gesture at passersby to feed it. Those that do not comply will be seized by its lengthy tongue, then pummeled by its powerful fists for their refusal.

entry: POKENAME的舌头与尾巴覆着辛辣化学物质，能增强火焰攻击。虽然不会损伤皮肤，却会带来强烈灼痛。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tongue and tail are coated in a spicy chemical that makes its fire attacks stronger. The chemical will cause an intense burning sensation even though it doesn't damage the skin.

entry: POKENAME忠诚却贪吃。看见能吃的，就会把职责忘光，一心追食，专注得经常迷路。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is very loyal, but also very gluttonous. When it sees something edible, it likes to forget its duties and chase after its food. It is so focused that it is not uncommon for it to get lost.

entry: 体形虽大，却爱玩又亲人，食量也极大。传闻POKENAME曾在玩耍时不慎吞掉训练家，至今尚未证实。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its size, it is playful and cuddly, but also extremely voracious. Rumors that a POKENAME accidentally devoured its Trainer while playing have not yet been confirmed.

entry: POKENAME触角不断散发可怕恶臭，防止捕食者吞食。每只气味略有不同，能借此辨认同伴。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's antennae constantly emits a horrific stench to prevent any predators from eating it. Every POKENAME has a slightly different smell which they use to identify one another.

entry: POKENAME不太聪明，常吃正常生物不会碰的东西，导致一直腹胀。毒性因此增强，身体却更臃肿，几乎无法飞行。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME isn't known for its intellect. It often eats things that no reasonable being should eat, causing it to be bloated constantly. While this boosts the potency of its poison, it makes its physique even bulkier and flying nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME羊毛制成的衣服，洗100次也有独特气味。不过，闻着像异国奶酪，让许多富人仍视其为珍品。
author: reese1017600
source: Clothes made from POKENAME wool will always have a distinctive odor, even when washed 100 times. However, the wool is still considered highly valuable to many rich folk due to smelling like exotic cheese.

entry: POKENAME聚在污染地区，吃空气中的毒素。科学家常靠数量判断当地的毒性程度。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME swarm in polluted areas, feeding off of the toxins in the air. Scientists often use the number of POKENAME in an area to determine its toxicity.

entry: POKENAME头上的嘴不断喷出毒烟，吸入者会失去行动能力。吃得越多，毒气越浓。
author: Mistymagius
source: The mouth on POKENAME's head constantly belches toxic fumes to incapacitate anyone that breathes the gas in. The more food POKENAME has eaten, the more concentrated the gas becomes.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的花纹警告捕食者，它身怀剧毒。若靠近，就要准备迎接一股毒气。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's vivid markings indicate to predators that it is intensely toxic. If you approach one, prepare to be blasted with noxious gas.

entry: POKENAME的拳头由毒气构成，对有嗅觉的敌人尤其有力。体内硫、甲烷与氦的混合物让它浮在地面上方。
author: Krune
source: With fists made of noxious gas, POKENAME's attacks will land a hefty blow to any foe with a sense of smell. A mixture of sulfur, methane and helium in its body keeps it floating above ground.

entry: 两只铁甲蛹融合后，外壳会硬得如同钻石。为进化积蓄的能量，还让身体密度升到几乎堪比恒星的程度。
author: Mistymagius
source: Fusing two Metapods together makes their carapace as hard as diamond. The energy generated for evolution increases their density to almost star-like levels.

entry: POKENAME休息时大多在储存能量，为接下来的发育做准备，因此不太活跃。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: While resting, POKENAME stores most of its energy for its upcoming development and is not particularly active.

entry: POKENAME将自己包在坚硬的念力外壳中，准备进化。超能力越强，壳就越厚。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME cocoons itself in a hard telekinetic shell to prepare for evolution. The stronger its psychic ability, the thicker its shell will be.

entry: POKENAME在磨难与战斗中很少移动，身体逐渐僵硬，几乎无法行动。如今只能强化防御、准备反击，同时节省能量。
author: SonTyp
source: Rarely moving through hardships and battles has made POKENAME's body rigid and largely immobile. All it can do now is harden its defenses and prepare for a counterstrike while conserving energy.

entry: POKENAME悬在树枝上摇荡，坚硬多刺的身体像拆墙球。更强的宝可梦会抓住树枝，将它当连枷使用。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME swings from tree branches, its tough, spiky body acting as a wrecking ball. Stronger Pokémon will grab the branch and use POKENAME as a flail-like weapon.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时，会缩进壳内。平时多处于休眠，用触手自卫。
author: PixlHoopa
source: While POKENAME prepares for evolution, its body retracts into its shell. Known for being dormant, it uses tentacles for self-defense.

entry: 食虫宝可梦常被POKENAME锐边划伤，或咬不穿硬壳，只好放弃。只有握住丝质剑穗，才能安全拿起它。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Bug-eating Pokémon often give up on eating POKENAME after scratching themselves on its sharp edge or failing to pierce its hardy shell. It can only be safely handled by its silken tassel.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会鲁莽地迎头冲撞。外壳硬如钢铁，即使撞空也不会受伤。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When battling, POKENAME will recklessly charge at the opponent headfirst. Their steel-hard shell ensures no damage is done to them when they miss.

entry: 头骨周围长出硬壳，能抵挡重击。可硬壳让眼睛无法完全闭合，始终保持警觉。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon has developed a hard shell around its skull to protect it from hard blows. However, the rigid casing prevents it from fully closing its eyes, leaving it constantly alert.

entry: 在炎热的午后缓缓踱步，精确摆好双翼，再原地振翅。吸收的太阳热量能加快进化。
author: sk372
source: It struts slowly in the afternoon heat, precisely positioning its wings before flapping in place. The warmth it gathers from the sunlight expedites its evolution process.

entry: 翼尖的刚毛能收集空气中的静电。POKENAME受威胁时，会给壳通电威吓对方，但通电期间进化也会暂停。
author: sk372
source: It gathers ambient static from the air with the bristles at the end of its wings. When threatened, POKENAME electrifies its shell as a deterrent. Its evolution process is halted while the shell is electrified.

entry: 在有风的地方等待进化，微风能激发超能力。若风太强，只好用念力稳住身体，却也会拖慢进化。
author: sk372
source: It rests in windy areas to await its evolution, where the breeze stimulates its psychic energy. If the winds grow too forceful, it uses telekinesis to hold steady, hampering its evolution speed.

entry: POKENAME以蛹的尖端站立保持平衡，倒下后就无法自己起身。若遇到倒地的它，请好心扶正。
author: soupalicious
source: POKENAME balances on the tip of its chrysalis, but if it falls over, it can't right itself again. If you see one fallen over, be kind and stand it up again.

entry: 护甲太致密，让它难以移动，常被自身重量压倒。它会趁机晒太阳储能，等待终于能蜕下重壳的那一刻。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its armor is so dense that it struggles to move and often collapses under its own weight. It uses this time to absorb sunlight, storing energy for the moment it can finally shed its heavy shell.

entry: POKENAME性格内向，喜欢保持不动，储存进化所需的能量。它们偶尔会从茧状的身体中喷出火焰，散发热量。古时，有人把POKENAME当作家中的热源。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses a withdrawn personality, preferring to stay idle and preserve energy needed for evolution. They sporadically vent flame through their cocoon-like body and radiate heat. Some POKENAME were a source of heat at home in ancient times.

entry: 额外的头发育不全，状态不稳定。虽不再容易爆炸，轻轻一碰仍会从孔洞喷出大量臭气。
author: sk372
source: The extra head has not grown properly, leaving it unstable. Though no longer prone to exploding, a single touch can cause it to release large amounts of foul gas from its pores.

entry: 这是早期利用有缺陷的基因，尝试复原史前飞行掠食者时产生的宝可梦。它的翅膀无法支撑飞行，但体内的轻质气体能让它漂浮。
author: SonTyp
source: A product of early attempts to restore an aerial predator from a pre-historic period using faulty DNA. While its wings cannot support flight, buoyant gases allow it to levitate.

entry: 充当POKENAME外壳的头，会不时吐出刺鼻烟雾。有人试着解读烟的形状，猜测它此刻的需求或心情。
author: sk372
source: The head functioning as a POKENAME's shell regularly puffs out pungent clouds of smoke.  Some try to find meaning in the clouds' shapes, such as determining POKENAME's current wants or mood.

entry: 医院隔离病区的走廊，常能看见POKENAME。别看模样阴森，它们还能帮医生检查病人。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME can be found strolling the halls of the isolation wing in hospitals. Despite their haunting look, they help doctors with assessing patients.

entry: POKENAME不断产生轻盈而剧毒的气体，长期接触会引发严重突变，因此它自己也几乎浑身长满肿瘤。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly produces a lightweight gas that is both incredibly poisonous and capable of causing severe mutations with prolonged exposure. As a result, its body is almost entirely covered in tumors.

entry: POKENAME戴帽子的模样看似古朴可爱，却会开心地与路人“分享”毒气。幸好，拖出的黄烟足以警告保持清醒的人。
author: Wormspawn
source: Though its be-hatted appearance is deceptively quaint, POKENAME will gleefully share its toxic gasses with any passer-by. Thankfully, the trail of yellow clouds serves as ample warning to those who keep their heads about them.

entry: POKENAME的烟乍看有毒，其实无害，还带着土壤气息，源于长期吃石头。这独特气味在深灰市很受欢迎，常用作香水。
author: sk372
source: Though appearing toxic at first glance, the fumes from POKENAME are harmless and have an earthy scent, a result of its constant diet of rock and stone. This unique scent is popular as a perfume in Pewter City.

entry: POKENAME长期接触有害烟雾，背部长出肿瘤。日久之后，肿瘤竟有了自己的生命。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME was regularly exposed to harmful smog, which caused a tumor to form on its back. Over time, this tumor developed a life of its own.

entry: 近来，影视作品常借POKENAME警示污染的危害。最有名的一部，讲的是英雄班基拉斯打败一只造成严重污染的巨型POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been used recently in media to provide testament to the dangers of pollution. Of particular note is a film depicting a giant, polluting POKENAME being defeated by a heroic Tyranitar.

entry: POKENAME的气体臭得能赶跑几乎所有宝可梦。一位知名博士将气体稀释，研发了“驱赶球”，用来赶走不受欢迎的宝可梦。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The gases emitted by POKENAME are so foul that it can repel almost any Pokémon. A renowned Pokémon professor has used a watered down version of this gas to develop the Pester Ball, a device used to chase off unwanted Pokémon.

entry: 角坚固锋利，可短腿无法提供多少冲力。POKENAME便躲在树上，头朝下扑向闯进领地的野生宝可梦。
author: leonian1586
source: Its horn is sturdy and sharp, but its little legs can't give it much power. Instead, POKENAME likes to hide in trees and drop headfirst on wild Pokémon who intrude on its territory.

entry: POKENAME头上覆着厚厚的岩石般皮肤，用来与同类对练。聪明的捕食者却会趁它分心，瞄准未受保护的尾巴。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's head is covered with a thick, rock-like hide used for sparring with others. Clever predators, however, target its unprotected tail when it's distracted.

entry: POKENAME的甲片牢固程度是普通独角犀牛的两倍。总举角埋头猛冲，直到彻底摧毁所有障碍。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body plates are twice as sturdy as those of a normal Rhyhorn. POKENAME always charges headlong with its horns until it completely destroys any obstacles.

entry: 石鳞经海浪细细打磨、冲洗。许多纪念品店会依照POKENAME的外形，制作华丽的笛子。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It has scales made from meticulously polished stone, washed from the waves of the ocean. Many souvenir shops like to make ornate flutes in POKENAME's image.

entry: 遗迹墙上散落的神秘符号，困扰研究者多年。后来才发现，只是POKENAME四处冲撞，将自身轮廓撞印在墙上。
author: sk372
source: Mysterious symbols scattered among ruin walls confounded researchers for years, until it was discovered they were simply the results of POKENAME charging around, hitting the walls and leaving impact silhouettes of its shape.

entry: 矿工常在洞口附近的石缝发现POKENAME。它们会用奇形怪状的石头，在洞窟深处筑大巢。
author: Schwaus
source: Miners often find POKENAME in between rocks near cave entrances. They create large nests with oddly shaped stones deep within their caves.

entry: 最常见于稀树草原。不过，深深的洞穴中也发现了适应弱光的亚种。
author: CapWolfBane
source: This Pokémon is most frequently found in savannas. Subspecies, however, have been found even in deep caves, adapted to the low light environment.

entry: 性情冲动，极力保护训练家。察觉威胁就鲁莽冲过去，全忘了用念力效果也许更好。
author: sk372
