source: It is impulsive and staunchly protective of its Trainer. It charges at perceived threats recklessly, forgetting that it could use telekinesis to better effect.

entry: 坚韧的皮肤与伪装能力，让它成为强大的伏击猎手。会融入周围环境，再猛烈冲锋，打敌人个措手不及。
author: RC2K
source: This Pokémon's sturdy hide and camouflaging abilities make it a formidable ambush predator. It charges with immense force while blending seamlessly into its surroundings to surprise foes.

entry: POKENAME巨颚咬合力惊人，却更喜欢甩头砸碎沿途一切。身体硬如石头，不怕任何撞击。
author: Mistyamgius
source: Despite its jaws' massive bite force, POKENAME prefers flailing its head around, smashing everything in its path. With a body as tough as stone, it doesn't fear any physical impacts.

entry: POKENAME外表毛绒绒，吃下的沉重矿物却聚在体内核心，增强鲁莽冲锋的惯性。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME's exterior is plush, the heavy minerals that it consumes gather in its core, lending momentum to its reckless charges.

entry: POKENAME没耐心，脾气火爆，稍疑是敌人便会攻击。以火山喷出的滚烫岩石为食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possess little patience and display a fiery temperament, being quick to attack Pokémon they suspect are foes. They eat a diet of scalding rocks that come from volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛会积蓄电荷，轻碰就会挨一记强烈电击。有时甚至遭雷劈，它却似乎毫不在意。
author: bobosmith01
source: Electrical charges build up into the wool of a POKENAME. Simply touching one will result in receiving a powerful zap. Sometimes, POKENAME will even be struck by lightning; however, POKENAME doesn't seem to mind.

entry: 高贵而骄傲，立誓保护弱小宝可梦。矛尖由某位祖先留下的角制成。
author: Launch4527
source: Noble and proud, it swears an oath to protect smaller and weaker Pokémon. The tip of its spear is made from a horn belonging to one of its ancestors.

entry: POKENAME花大部分能量，制造蛋状小颗粒喂养群体。为维持生存，每天要吃100多磅植物。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME expends most of its energy producing tiny egg-like pellets to feed its colony. To sustain itself, it consumes over 100 pounds of plant matter daily.

entry: POKENAME持续发出低沉嗡鸣，安抚附近宝可梦，缓解紧张。能维持和平氛围，是压力之下可靠的伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly emits a low buzzing sound, soothing nearby Pokémon and easing tension. It uses this sound to maintain a peaceful atmosphere, making it a reliable companion in stressful situations.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋进土里吸收养分，增强治愈能力。分享从泥土中汲取的能量，就能让别人恢复活力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients, enhancing its healing properties. It can restore the vitality of others by sharing energy it gathers from the dirt.

entry: POKENAME收集祖母绿，相信它们能增强自己的治愈能力。会将宝石赠人，盼着带来健康与好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects emeralds that it believes enhance its healing abilities. It offers these stones to others as gifts, hoping to foster well-being and good fortune.

entry: 唾液药效很强，一接触就能治好轻伤。受伤的野生宝可梦常来找它，信赖这份天然疗法。
author: .izik
source: Its saliva possesses potent medicinal properties, healing minor wounds upon contact. Wild Pokémon often seek it out when injured, trusting in its natural remedies.

entry: 古时曾协助巡回医疗队，载着病人穿越险恶地形。结实的身体让艰苦旅程也能平安。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, it served hospital caravans, transporting the sick across harsh terrains. Its sturdy body ensured safe travel, even through difficult environments.

entry: 强力的钻头能打穿崩落的土石，营救山崩中的受困者。它用力十分小心，不让伤者再受伤。
author: .izik
source: Its powerful drill allows it to rescue landslide victims by tunneling through debris. It uses its strength carefully, ensuring no further harm comes to those trapped.

entry: 在空中飞舞，释放让接触者放松的粉末，帮助宝可梦休息、恢复。
author: .izik
source: It flutters through the air, releasing powder that relaxes anyone it touches. This soothing effect allows Pokémon to rest and recover.

entry: 用利刃吓退捕食者，保护弱小的宝可梦。动作迅捷，是可靠的守护者。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp blades to scare away predators, protecting weak Pokémon from harm. Its swift movements make it a formidable guardian.

entry: POKENAME将药草存放在育儿袋的蛋下方。其他宝可梦受伤时，会细心用药草治疗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores medicinal herbs in its pouch beneath its egg. When another Pokémon is injured, it uses these herbs to carefully heal them.

entry: 会变成孩子父母的模样，安抚孩子直到平静。情况稳定后，再变回原形，悄悄溜走。
author: .izik
source: It transforms into a child's parent, providing comfort until the child calms. Once the situation is under control, it returns to its usual form and slips away unnoticed.

entry: 恶劣天气将至时，会用温和气息平复天空。风暴中见到它，总能为受灾者带来希望。
author: .izik
source: When bad weather threatens to strike, it calms the skies with a gentle aura. Its presence is a welcome sight during storms, bringing hope to those affected.

entry: POKENAME用火烹熟蛋，让其营养极为丰富。可烹饪耗能很大，因此只将蛋送给重伤者。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME cooks its eggs with its flames which makes them incredibly nutritious. It uses a lot of energy to cook them, so POKENAME only gives its eggs to the critically injured.

entry: POKENAME能精确控制电力，用电击恢复人类或宝可梦的心跳，因此很受医疗领域的训练家欢迎。
author: CartoonHostage
source: POKENAME has precise control over its electric power, capable of delivering shocks to restart the hearts of humans and Pokémon. It's a popular partner for Trainers in the medical field.

entry: 只为明显生病的对象行动，在最需要时提供帮助。它的出现象征着关怀与保护。
author: .izik
source: It only moves for those who are visibly sick, offering help when needed most. Its presence is seen as a sign of care and protection.

entry: 厚壳覆盖全身，带来无可比拟的防护，连最恶劣的环境也能承受。
author: .izik
source: A thick shell covers its body, offering unparalleled protection. This durable layer allows it to endure even the harshest conditions.

entry: 在山中钻出隧道，帮助旅人迁移。原本险恶难行的地区，因此有了安全通路。
author: .izik
source: It burrows through mountains, creating tunnels that help travelers relocate. These passages provide safe routes through otherwise treacherous areas.

entry: 在壳中混合树果汁，制成强效疗伤药水。恢复效果出众，备受追捧。
author: .izik
source: By mixing berry juices in its shell, it creates potent healing draughts. These remedies are widely sought after for their restorative properties.

entry: 龙卷风过后，会帮助灾民重建，走出失去家园的伤痛。既以力量出工，也以关怀安抚心灵。
author: .izik
source: After tornadoes, it helps victims rebuild and recover from their losses. Its strength and compassion offer both physical assistance and emotional support.

entry: 看见谁遇险，就会惊慌大叫，提醒其他人发生危机，让援助迅速赶到。
author: .izik
source: When it sees someone in danger, it panics, letting out a loud cry. This call alerts others to the crisis, ensuring help arrives quickly.

entry: POKENAME天生稀少，却乐观又友善。曾有记录显示，它强力的电击将昏迷者从生死边缘救回。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possess an upbeat and friendly personality that belies their natural rarity. Their powerful shocks have been recorded to bring the unconscious back from the brink.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓中的成分可制成烧伤膏，缓解疼痛。医者常来寻找这份珍贵的植物药材。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon's vines contain compounds used in burn salves, bringing relief to those in pain. Healers often seek out POKENAME for its valuable, plant-based remedies.

entry: POKENAME用舒缓的声音减轻疼痛。能感受到周围对象的痛苦，试着以歌声治愈。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME alleviate pain with their soothing voices. They can sense the pain others around them feel and will try to heal it with their songs.

entry: 动作优雅的舞蹈让同伴放松、重振士气。观看表演后，伙伴都会感到安宁，恢复精神。
author: .izik
source: With graceful movements, it performs a dance that relaxes allies and restores morale. Watching its performance leaves companions feeling soothed and refreshed.

entry: POKENAME用体内储存的天然成分制作解毒剂。遇到中毒的野生宝可梦，会本能地分享药物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces antidotes from natural compounds it stores within its body. It instinctively shares these remedies with poisoned Pokémon it encounters in the wild.

entry: 从森林采集药草，调配有效的药剂。精心挑选材料，让每份药都发挥最佳疗效。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon gathers medicinal herbs from forests, blending them into effective remedies. Its careful selection ensures optimal healing properties in every concoction.

entry: 无声飘过洪水灾区，寻找幸存者施救。灵活的身手让它在水难救援中十分关键。
author: .izik
source: It floats silently through flooded areas, scanning for survivors to rescue. Its agility makes it a vital asset during water-based emergencies.

entry: 巡视易发森林火灾的地区。危险发生时，以惊人速度带领人类和宝可梦离开火场，前往安全处。
author: .izik
source: It patrols areas prone to forest fires, guiding others to safety when danger arises. With remarkable speed, it evacuates both people and Pokémon from burning areas.

entry: 这只宝可梦能把日光化为能量，让花苞里长出蛋来。据说，这些蛋营养极为丰富。
author: lemage22
source: Converting sunlight into energy, this Pokémon grows eggs from its bulb which are said to be of excellent nutritional value.

entry: 照料遭遗弃的宝可梦蛋，直到孵化。大家完全信任它，知道蛋会平安无事。
author: .izik
source: It takes abandoned Pokémon eggs under its care, nurturing them until they hatch. Others trust it completely, knowing the eggs are safe.

entry: 极度害羞，只有察觉谁受伤时才肯靠近。紧急时刻却不再胆怯，迅速提供照料。
author: .izik
source: Extremely shy, it only approaches when it senses someone is hurt. Its timidity disappears in emergencies, when it provides swift care.

entry: POKENAME能在几分钟内治好任何宝可梦，作为移动宝可梦中心越来越受欢迎。可这极其耗能，自己也需要持续照料。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have grown in popularity as portable Pokémon Centers, able to heal any Pokémon within minutes. Due to the massive energy required, they need constant care.

entry: POKENAME天性爱护其他宝可梦与蛋。许多训练家和宝可梦中心会将精灵球交给它，藏在几乎无法攻破的假嘴中保管。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a protective nature, nurturing Pokémon and their eggs alike. Many Trainers and Pokémon Centers rely on them to safeguard Poké Balls in their near-impenetrable false mouth.

entry: 能感知地层变动，提前预知地震。当地人信任它的警告，只要它现身就会做好准备。
author: .izik
source: It senses shifts in the earth, predicting earthquakes before they occur. Locals trust its warnings and prepare whenever it appears.

entry: POKENAME温柔细心地清洁擦伤，再用柔软舒适的材料包扎，避免进一步刺激伤口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME treats abrasions by cleaning wounds with gentle care. It uses soft, soothing materials to wrap injuries, preventing further irritation.

entry: 体内流着两种不同液体，一种是自卫毒液，一种是疗伤膏。会按需要使用，既能救治，也能守护。
author: .izik
source: Two distinct liquids flow within its body: venom for defense and a healing ointment. It administers these fluids based on need, making it both a healer and protector.

entry: 遇到危险，会释放镇静孢子，安抚敌我双方。宁静的氛围能化解紧张。
author: .izik
source: When danger arises, it releases calming spores to pacify both friends and foes. The spores create a serene atmosphere, defusing tense situations.

entry: 夜空下，有时能看见POKENAME向月亮祈愿，盼望他人平安。若祈愿成真，朋友的伤便会迅速痊愈。
author: .izik
source: Under the night sky, one may see a POKENAME offering a Wish to the moon for the safety of others. Should the Wish come true, injuries of its friends will heal rapidly.

entry: 复杂的根系将POKENAME的药用蛋黄输送到藤蔓触须。众多带刺附肢能同时为多只宝可梦送入恢复活力的物质，施以治疗。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Intricate root systems pump POKENAME's medicinal yolk through to its viny tendrils. It can treat multiple Pokémon at once with its numerous spiked appendages, administering the rejuvenating substance it produces.

entry: 巡视古墓，寻找迷路受伤的探险者。找到后便给予帮助，带领对方回到安全处。
author: .izik
source: It patrols ancient tombs, searching for injured explorers who have lost their way. Once they are found, it provides aid and guides them back to safety.

entry: 发现脱水者，立刻领向水源。POKENAME迅速的行动在荒凉地区救下无数生命。两个头都能搜寻受难者，很少遗漏需要帮助的对象。
author: .izik
source: When this Pokémon finds those suffering from dehydration, it leads them to water without delay. POKENAME's quick actions have saved countless lives in desolate climates. Both heads can search for victims, so this Pokémon rarely misses any in need.

entry: 为虚弱的宝可梦收集足够食物，帮助恢复。孜孜不倦的努力，让它深受宝可梦群体喜爱。
author: .izik
source: It gathers food for weak Pokémon, ensuring they have enough to recover. Its tireless efforts make it a beloved member of the Pokémon community.

entry: 不知疲倦地寻找雪崩受困者，以力量施救，在雪地救援中十分关键。
author: .izik
source: It searches tirelessly for avalanche victims, using its strength to provide aid. This Pokémon plays a crucial role in rescue efforts in snowy regions.

entry: 在旅人帐篷旁睡觉，同时留意周围，保护安全。安静的陪伴，让星空下休息的人感到安心。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps near travelers' tents, keeping watch to ensure their safety. Its quiet presence offers comfort to those resting under the stars.

entry: 柔声歌唱，安慰难过的孩子，让他们重展笑容。摇篮曲连最躁动的心都能安抚。
author: .izik
source: It sings softly to calm sad children, bringing smiles back to their faces. Its lullabies are known to soothe even the most restless hearts.

entry: 泥石流中，会以无比坚定的意志营救受困者。能轻松穿越不稳地形，总能找到安全的路。
author: .izik
source: During mudslides, it rescues trapped people with unmatched determination. It navigates unstable terrain with ease, always finding a way to safety.

entry: POKENAME的双翼在月光下如紫水晶闪耀，光彩夺目。无声滑过夜空，将安宁带到各处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings shimmer like amethyst in the moonlight, creating a dazzling display. It glides silently through the night, spreading calm wherever it goes.

entry: 毒液熬煮后能用于治疗恶心，是意想不到的药材。精心处理，便能成为救命的药物。
author: .izik
source: Its venom can be boiled down and used to cure nausea, making it an unexpected ally in medicine. Careful preparation ensures the venom becomes a life-saving remedy.

entry: 分泌的黏液能制成抗真菌药膏，已被证实有效治疗感染。宝可梦医者十分喜爱这份天然药材。
author: .izik
source: The slime it secretes is used in anti-fungal ointments, which has proved effective in treating infections. This natural remedy is a favorite among Pokémon healers.

entry: 不断寻找迷路的孩子，将他们稳稳抱在怀里。再恶劣的环境，也挡不住它施救。
author: .izik
source: It searches tirelessly for lost children, cradling them safely in its arms. Even the wildest environments cannot deter it from its rescue efforts.

entry: 释放缓解疲劳的孢子，让周围的对象恢复精神。这种天然提神剂，在疲惫时很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: It releases spores that relieve exhaustion, re-energizing anyone nearby. The spores are a natural pick-me-up, sought after in times of fatigue.

entry: POKENAME会爬上哭泣婴儿的窗边，守望孩子是否平安。父母将它视为祝福，在难熬的夜里也能安心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs up to windows of crying infants, watching to ensure they are safe. Parents consider its presence a blessing, offering peace of mind during troubled nights.

entry: POKENAME毛发中的成分，经长时间接触能缓解压力与疲劳。织工常用脱毛制作安抚毯。
author: sk372
source: The hairs on POKENAME's body carry a compound that reduces stress and fatigue with prolonged contact. Shed fur is often used by garment weavers to make comfort blankets.

entry: POKENAME育儿袋中的神秘蛋，能增强花粉的治愈效果，守护栖息地的健康。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME carries a mystical egg in its pouch that enhances the healing properties of its pollen, ensuring the well-being of its habitat.

entry: 会溜进诊所偷药，治疗受伤的野生宝可梦。虽是小偷，却备受受助者尊敬。
author: .izik
source: It sneaks into doctors' offices, stealing medicine to treat injured wild Pokémon. Though a thief, it is revered by those it helps.

entry: POKENAME的蛋能对付许多小病。可讽刺的是，它自己总在头痛，蛋却对此毫无效果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eggs are excellent for combating a lot of minor ailments. Ironically, they are ineffective at fighting headaches, which POKENAME constantly suffers from.

entry: POKENAME释放温柔的超能力波动，缓解恶心与其他不适。能察觉身体痛苦，是宝可梦中心珍贵的伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases gentle waves of psychic energy that soothe nausea and other discomforts. Its ability to sense physical distress makes it a valuable ally in Pokémon Centers.

entry: 会进入梦境，温柔地疗愈困扰的心。得到它帮助的睡者，会感到精神清爽、平静安宁。
author: .izik
source: By entering dreams, it provides gentle therapy, easing troubled minds. Its presence leaves sleepers feeling refreshed and at peace.

entry: 用巨大力量建造宝可梦中心与医院，让社区有地方治疗。尽心尽力，是施工队不可或缺的一员。
author: .izik
source: It uses its immense strength to build Pokémon Centers and hospitals, ensuring communities have places to heal. Its dedication makes it an essential part of any construction team.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的外表夹着琥珀碎片，用来储能。察觉受伤的宝可梦，便会动用储备立刻施救。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rocky exterior is laced with amber fragments, which it uses to store energy. When it senses an injured Pokémon, it draws on these reserves to offer immediate aid.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都有分工。一颗头仔细警戒，其他头则负责照顾蛋。
author: .ssunday.
source: Each of POKENAME's heads have a job. One head carefully keeps watch and the others take care of its eggs.

entry: 与吉利蛋或幸福蛋的蛋不同，POKENAME的蛋难吃，还略带毒性。不过，有些毒属性宝可梦很喜欢。
author: kittyluv090
source: Unlike Chansey or Blissey's, POKENAME's eggs taste horrible and are somewhat toxic. However, some Poison-Type Pokémon really like them.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓般的毛十分坚韧，能挡住比比鸟啄击。遇险时，也能靠藤蔓在树间荡行逃脱。
author: Mistymagius
source: The vine-like hairs that coat POKENAME are actually quite tough and are able to resist the pecks of a Pidgeotto. It will also use the vines to swing from tree to tree if it needs to escape from danger.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓触感各异，有的暖、有的凉，有的粗、有的软。据说越多藤蔓触感相似，就代表进化将近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vines vary in texture, feeling warm, cold, rough, or soft. It's said that when more vines feel alike, it signals that evolution is near.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用藤蔓勒住敌人，直到对方屈服。研究者很难靠得足够近，因此无法深入了解它。
author: darkdrophaxu
source: POKENAME likes to use its vines to strangle opponents to the point of submission. Researchers can't get close enough to find out more about this Pokémon.

entry: 藤蔓会随周围的情绪以不同方式扭动、摇摆。若两个人的情绪互相冲突，藤蔓就会缠作一团、打起结。
author: Staghorn
source: Its vines twist and sway in different ways depending on the emotions of those around it. If it's near two people with conflicting emotions, its vines will become knotted and tangled.

entry: POKENAME独处时通常胆小，常藏在灌木或高草中避免冲突。更强的宝可梦靠近时，藤蔓便会分泌稀薄毒液。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is usually timid when alone, so it tends to hide in bushes or tall grass to avoid confrontations. Their vines can secrete a thin toxin whenever any stronger Pokémon approach them.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME本体的样子，只能瞥见黑暗里的一只眼。胆敢靠近者，都会被食肉藤蔓无情吞噬。
author: Mistymagius
source: No one knows what POKENAME's real body looks like, only glimpsing a single eye encased in darkness. Anyone who dares approach is mercilessly devoured by its carnivorous vines.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵由灵敏藤蔓构成，听觉极佳。更强的宝可梦靠近时，藤蔓便会分泌稀薄毒液。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME has exceptional hearing due to the ears made of their sensitive vines. These vines can secrete a thin toxin whenever any stronger Pokémon approach them.

entry: POKENAME全身藤蔓都锋利如剃刀，连柄上也一样。多数战士无法顺手持用，它只好独自作战。
author: Patch
source: The vines all along POKENAME's body are razor sharp. Since this includes the hilt, most warriors cannot wield it efficiently, forcing it to battle on its own.

entry: 越愤怒，藤蔓甩得越快。暴怒的POKENAME甚至会把自己的藤蔓甩断。
author: Andoman63
source: The angrier it gets, the faster its vines whip around. A furious POKENAME might even break off its own vines in its rage.

entry: 行动缓慢，却出奇安静隐秘。露营者常惊讶地发现，POKENAME已悄悄靠近，正好奇地翻找帐篷。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are slow-moving but surprisingly quiet and stealthy. Campers are surprised to see that POKENAME have snuck up on them and are rooting through their tents out of curiosity.

entry: 用黏长的舌头清洁幼崽，也抵御威胁。危险靠近时，会将孩子吞进第二个胃里，安全护到危机过去。
author: amiel997
source: It uses its long, sticky tongue to keep its child clean and to defend against threats. When danger is near, it swallows the child, keeping it safe inside a second stomach until the threat passes.

entry: POKENAME的一部分分裂成了幼崽。孩子起初只能改变面部，亲代便教它变形，直到能完美模仿。
author: sk372
source: Part of POKENAME divided and became its young. The child can only transform its face at first, so the parent tutors it in the ways of shapeshifting until its mimicry can become perfect.

entry: 与幼崽合作，在森林寻找甜果和花蜜。找到好食物后，先让孩子吃饱，自己再吃剩下的。
author: sk372
source: It works in tandem with its young to search for sweet fruits and nectar in forests. Once they have found a good source of food, the child will be allowed to gorge itself first before the parent eats what is left.

entry: 会凶悍地守护领地，带着幼崽时尤其如此。POKENAME甚至能攀上垂直岩壁，保护孩子。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon will aggressively protect its territory, especially when it has a joey. POKENAME can even scale vertical surfaces to defend its young.

entry: 若遇到落单的幼崽，请格外小心，母亲就在附近。POKENAME母亲会不惜一切代价保护孩子。
author: ziggaway
source: Use extreme caution if you encounter a joey by itself, as its mother will be nearby. A POKENAME mother will protect its young at all costs.

entry: 性情温和，喜避争斗，也希望孩子学会这样的处世方式。不过若被迫作战，为了孩子就会毫不留情。
author: sk372
source: It has a gentle disposition and prefers to avoid conflict, a demeanor it hopes to pass onto its young. If forced to fight however, it is utterly merciless for the sake of its children.

entry: POKENAME用伸缩长舌捉昆虫、采小果，与育儿袋中的孩子分享。幼崽好奇，也常伸舌舔舐，探索周围。
author: sk372
source: With its extendable tongue, POKENAME catches insects and small fruits to share with the young it carries within its pouch. The joey is a curious sort and is often using its own tongue to lick and explore its surroundings.

entry: 与孩子失散的POKENAME，会在悲痛中掀起沙暴。小生物若迷失在风暴里、走到它面前，迎来的却是收养，而非被吃掉。
author: Wormspawn
source: A POKENAME separated from its baby will stir up a sandstorm in grief. Smaller creatures who become disoriented by these storms and stumble across a POKENAME's path find themselves not eaten, but adopted.

entry: 幼崽不会飞，亲代狩猎时便待在它头上。POKENAME速度快、转向灵活，若孩子飞行中失足，始终能及时接住。
author: sk372
source: Its young cannot fly, so it remains perched on the parent's head while it hunts. Due to its speed and maneuverability, POKENAME is always able to catch its child should it lose its grip and fall during flight.

entry: 人们对操纵POKENAME机械躯体的生物知之甚少，一想靠近研究，机体便以武力反击。但驾驶者传出的叫喊声，让人怀疑反击其实出自自动程序。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Not much is known about the creature that pilots the mechanical body of POKENAME, as any attempts to investigate will be met with force by the mech. However, the cries coming from the pilot lead people to believe this is an automated response.

entry: POKENAME护子心切到近乎过度，会用尾巴与蛮力护住孩子、碾碎闯入者。巢边以焦叶标记，看到最好远离。
author: CpnQuacken
source: POKENAME is an extremely overprotective parent, using its tails and brute strength to both protect its children and crush trespassers. It marks its den with burnt foliage, so stay away if you spot it.

entry: 最近，科学家发现POKENAME的机械外壳，能提供热量与照明。他们因此推测，这副装甲，原本是为里面的生物设计的育成舱。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It has recently been discovered that the mechanical exterior of a POKENAME is designed to provide heat and light, leading scientists to believe that the armor was designed as a sort of incubator for the creature within.

entry: POKENAME、孩子与背上的蘑菇和睦共生。蘑菇为亲子遮挡恶劣天气，还能用孢子抵御敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME, its child, and the mushroom that grows on its back all live together in harmony. POKENAME and its child are sheltered from harsh weather and can defend themselves from foes using the mushroom's spores.

entry: POKENAME悉心教幼崽逃离或威吓敌人，避开危险。若非打不可，就用阴招与凶狠攻击尽快结束战斗。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME are caring parents, teaching their young how to avoid dangers by outrunning or intimidating aggressors. If they have to resort to fighting, POKENAME try to end fights as quickly as possible, using dirty tricks and brutal attacks.

entry: POKENAME全身许多孔洞既能喷水，也能喷烟，在水中与空中都能生存。大量聚集往往意味着附近工厂污染过重。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can emit both water and smoke from the many orifices covering its body. They are able to live in both water and air. Groups of many POKENAME are thought to be a sign of a nearby factory causing too much pollution.

entry: POKENAME十分弱小，却能从嘴里喷射液体，在水中迅速移动。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is fairly weak, but it can move quickly in water by shooting a jet of liquid from its mouth.

entry: 身体能吸存海水，数周不漏。危急时，POKENAME会以音速射出浑浊气泡，阻止捕食者。
author: Schwaus
source: Its body can absorb and hold ocean water for weeks without leaking. When in a pinch POKENAME can shoot muddy bubbles at sonic speeds to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME将头鳍缠在海草上，防止被强流冲走。据说见到两只头鳍相缠的个体，会带来永恒幸福。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its head fin around sea grass to prevent being swept away by strong currents. Seeing two POKENAME with their fins intertwined is said to bring eternal happiness.

entry: 会从吻部喷出墨黑气泡，爆开后在附近形成烟幕。野生POKENAME只在危急时用钳子，平时更喜欢悠闲地吃水草。
author: bobosmith01
source: They can spray inky-black bubbles from their snout that explode and smokescreen the general vicinity. Wild POKENAME only use their pincers in emergencies, and prefer an idyllic life of eating underwater plant life.

entry: POKENAME的两张嘴像炮管，能喷出足以贯穿钢铁的高压墨汁。常对峙较量，看谁出手更快。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME shoots pressurized ink from its two cannon-like mouths with enough force to pierce steel. They often compete in standoffs to determine the quicker shot.

entry: POKENAME全身的尖刺触之有毒。生活在水下洞穴，吸取周围岩石中的矿物。
author: robbery_666
source: The spikes all over POKENAME's body are poisonous to the touch. They live in underwater caves, draining minerals from rocks around them.

entry: POKENAME远攻时喷射高压水流。敌人靠近，就挥动自己覆盖着的船锚攻击。身体覆着毒膜，触碰可能感染。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME fires water at high pressure to hit foes from a distance. If a foe manages to get close, it instead swings the anchor it covers at them. Touching a POKENAME can result in infection due to the poisonous film that covers its body.

entry: POKENAME在水上或水下，都能从一英里以外喷出危险的高速水柱。可一旦近战，就只好缩进壳里。
author: Alumed
source: POKENAME can fire dangerous, high velocity jets of water from over a mile away both above and below water, but in close combat POKENAME is forced to retreat into its shell.

entry: 进化成POKENAME后，会放下原本平静的生活，守护附近的海洋宝可梦。钳子带着麻痹心智的毒，很少有个体再继续进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: Once evolved into POKENAME, it will shed its more peaceful lifestyle and act as a guard for nearby marine Pokémon. Its pincers are laced with a mind-numbing poison. Very few POKENAME evolve further than this state.

entry: POKENAME十分弱小，是许多水生宝可梦的常见食物。虽成千上万结成鱼群自保，效果却不太好。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very weak and are a common food source for many aquatic Pokémon. POKENAME swim in schools with numbers in the thousands trying to defend themselves but it's not very effective.

entry: POKENAME生长潜力极大，让战斗中被撕伤的长鳍也能迅速愈合。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME carries enormous potential for growth. This helps its long fins quickly heal from the tears it accumulates while fighting.

entry: POKENAME守望角金鱼群，维持秩序与安全。捕食者靠近时，便迅速摆鳍，眼中放光将其吓退。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME watch over schools of Goldeen to ensure they stay organized and safe. If a predator approaches, POKENAME will rapidly sway its fins and shine a light from its eye to scare them off.

entry: 许多海上商人会训练POKENAME守护航船。敏锐的感官让它能察觉远处的威胁。
author: .izik
source: Many sea-based merchants train POKENAME to guard their vessels during voyages. Its keen senses help it detect threats from afar.

entry: POKENAME随着成长蜕皮，鳞片也越来越美。在河湖中游泳时，双鳍如梦幻般舞动。
author: Gloomymort
source: As POKENAME grow and shed their skin, their scales become more beautiful. Their fins dance dreamily as they swim the rivers and lakes they live in.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间打磨球体与鳞片，希望更加迷人。只有在阳光下闪闪发亮，才会满足。
author: Gloomymort
source: POKENAME spend a lot of time polishing their orbs and scales in an effort to make themselves more enchanting. They will only be satisfied when they glitter in the sunlight.

entry: 受到良好照料的POKENAME，颈圈花纹华美。照料不足，花瓣便会枯萎。它们需要睡足美容觉。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME who are well-cared for boast a gorgeously patterned collar. Those who are not will see their petals wilted. They need lots of beauty sleep.

entry: POKENAME用角凿刻冰山没入水中的部分，留下复杂雕纹，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to chip away at submerged parts of icebergs. It creates intricate carvings to mark its territory.

entry: 雷雨来前，尾巴般的胡须会剧烈颤动。它便冲向空地，盼着雷电击中角，让自己精神振奋。
author: .izik
source: Before thunderstorms, its tail-like whiskers quiver intensely. It dashes to open fields, hoping a lightning strike hits its horn to invigorate it.

entry: POKENAME以美貌为傲，会收集黏土制成陶瓮，绘上自己鳞片的色彩与花纹。冲上岸的瓮片很适合制作首饰，也引来人们将海蚀玻璃上色售假。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very proud of their beauty, gathering clay to build urns depicting the colors and patterns of their scales. Washed-up fragments of these urns make for popular jewelry, leading people to paint seaglass to sell as counterfeit imitations.

entry: 生活着POKENAME的河流中的水，需要送入专门的处理厂去除毒素。不幸的是，POKENAME喜欢用通风口打磨自己的角，既堵塞水流，又释放更多毒素，拖慢了整个处理过程。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Water from rivers containing PKOENAME is sent through specialized treatment plants to clear the poison. Unfortunately, POKENAME enjoy using the vents to polish their horns, blocking the flow and releasing excess toxins, delaying the whole process.

entry: POKENAME在海底寻找最美的贝壳。一找到更好的，就丢掉旧的，把美丽看得比什么都重要。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches the seafloor for the most beautiful shells, discarding any once it finds a better one. It values beauty above all else.

entry: POKENAME住在沉船内，用遗失的宝藏掩藏亮角与彩色褶边。若被潜水者发现，就会送上宝物，换取清静。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME will make its home within a shipwreck, using lost treasure to disguise its shiny horns and colorful frills. If it's spotted by a diver, it will offer them treasure in exchange for being left alone.

entry: 春天，能看见成群POKENAME溯河攀瀑。每隔几年会脱鳞，再长出柔韧的新鳞。
author: fuzzythelion
source: In the spring, schools of POKENAME can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. Every several years it sheds its scales, and new, supple ones grow back.

entry: POKENAME用华美飘逸的鳞片与迷人歌声吸引水手。可谁傻到靠近，头上毛发般的巨颚就会咬住对方。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME lure sailors with their gorgeous, flowing scales and enchanting singing voice. However, the hair-like jaws on their head bite anyone foolish enough to approach.

entry: 圆滚滚的身体让POKENAME能在陆上短距离滚动。遇到障碍，强角轻轻松松就能击碎。
author: .izik
source: With its round body, POKENAME can roll across land for short distances. If it encounters an obstacle, it shatters it effortlessly with its powerful horn.

entry: 太阳一落，成群POKENAME就从海中洞穴游出。白天则躲藏起来，避开捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Schools of POKENAME emerge from ocean caves as soon as the sun sets. They remain hidden during the day to avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME身体密度与水不同，能轻松沿河岸移动。酷热时，可见它们挤在石头和睡莲的阴影下。
author: Rooboid
source: The density of POKENAME's body differs from water, allowing it to navigate riverbanks with ease. On particularly hot days, groups of POKENAME can be found compacted together in the shade of stones and water lilies.

entry: 每只POKENAME都曾是被关在狭小空间里的角金鱼。死后化成如今的模样，手持鱼缸，铭记过去。
author: .realthree
source: Each POKENAME was once a Goldeen held in cramped living conditions. When it died, it took this form. It holds a fishbowl as a reminder of its past.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴，用生锈的沉船零件与溺亡水手装饰家园。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME lives in underwater caves. It decorates its home with rusted shipwreck parts and drowned sailors.

entry: POKENAME的毒素有浓烈醋味。煮过后，能改用作效果很好的卸甲液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's toxin smells strongly of vinegar. If boiled, it can be repurposed as an effective nail polish remover.

entry: POKENAME咬走鱼线上的饵，留作己用。返回海底时，身上会挂满小饰物与拟饵，吸引自己的猎物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bite off bait from fishing lines, stealing it to use for themselves. They return to the ocean floor decorated in trinkets and lures to entice their prey.

entry: POKENAME埋伏其他鱼类。目标一靠近，就眨眼展示“独特”的美，把对方晃晕。再趁机损坏其鳞片，让它也变得和自己一样“漂亮”。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME lies in wait for other fish. Once a suitable target is within range, it shows its “unique” beauty by winking to stun them. While they are dazzled, it sabotages their scales so that they look just as “pretty” as POKENAME does.

entry: 养在水族箱里时，POKENAME会定期清理底床。既好看又实用，很受水族爱好者欢迎。
author: pokebio
source: When in an aquarium, POKENAME routinely cleans the substrate. This makes it popular among aquarists for its utility, as well as its looks.

entry: POKENAME试着用心灵感应交流游泳路线，却几乎总会引发剧烈头痛。因此，游起来远没有外表看着那么协调。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME attempt to communicate swimming patterns telepathically, but it almost always results in them getting intense headaches. As a result, their swimming tends to be a lot less coordinated than their appearance would suggest.

entry: POKENAME成大群游泳，与蚊香蝌蚪和角金鱼不和，双方争斗并不少见。
author: bobosmith01
source: They swim together in large groups. POKENAME do not get along with Poliwag or Goldeen, and battles between them are not unheard of.

entry: POKENAME先以触手麻痹敌人，再用角钻刺。迅猛的连招瞬间就能让对方失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME paralyzes foes with its tentacles before drilling into them with its horn. This swift combination leaves its enemies incapacitated in moments.

entry: 触须渗出酸液，将浮木溶解为养分。块头太大，就先用利角切碎再吃。
author: .izik
source: Acid seeps from its tendrils to dissolve driftwood for nourishment. For larger pieces, it uses its sharp horn to break them apart before feeding.

entry: POKENAME游动时会散落鳞片，留下闪亮的踪迹。鳞片漂流中吸附海水，很受制作香薰蜡烛的人欢迎。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter scales as they swim, creating a shimmering trail behind them. Their scales collect seawater as they drift, causing them to be popular material for scented candles.

entry: POKENAME严密监视水下抽油泵，一有泄漏就迅速通知人类。极力守护自己洁净的领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME closely monitors underwater oil pumps, quickly alerting humans to any leaks. It is fiercely protective of its clean territory.

entry: 最强的POKENAME在鱼群中威望很高，担任首领。但实际并没强太多，反而常最先成为猎物。随着年龄增长，鳍上的黑点也会增加。
author: Mistymagius
source: The strongest POKENAME lead their school with high prestige, but they are not much stronger and are often picked off first. As they age, more black spots appear on their fins.

entry: POKENAME的泳姿独特，看起来像在爬无形的梯子。还能造出隐形屏障，把大型捕食者困得像鱼缸里的鱼，以此取乐。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's rather unique swimming style makes it look like it's climbing an imaginary ladder. It can also create invisible barriers, and has fun using them to imprison big predators as if they're in a fish tank.

entry: 常见的融合体，几乎任何水域都能繁殖。科学家发现它们似乎比鲤鱼王聪明，许多连挂着优质鱼饵的普通鱼钩也会避开。
author: bobosmith01
source: A common fusion that breeds in nearly any kind of water. Scientists have noted that they appear more intelligent compared to Magikarp: many avoid common fishing hooks, even ones with quality bait.

entry: POKENAME以美丽的花纹与角闻名。角最长、花纹最繁复的个体，很受收藏家追捧。
author: Astral1447
source: POKENAME are well known for their beautiful patterns and horns, and the ones with the longest horns and most intricate patterns are sought out by collectors.

entry: 诱饵长得像两条角金鱼。捕食者以为能轻松得手而靠近时，POKENAME就放电将其击昏。
author: CartoonHostage
source: Its lures resemble a pair of Goldeen. When predators approach in hopes of easy prey, POKENAME delivers an electric shock that knocks them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME原本美味的皮肤，进化后变酸，用来防备偷猎者和钓鱼人。它并不善游。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME's once-delicious skin becomes sour as it evolves; this is a defense mechanism to ward off poachers and anglers alike. It is a weak swimmer.

entry: 古代文明靠POKENAME的鳞色判断夏秋交替。原本无色的身体先泛起鲜红，再变换其他色彩。水光映照时，宛如一片坠落的彩虹。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Ancient civilizations judged the shift from summer to autumn by the color of POKENAME's scales, its colorless body glowing into a vibrant red before making way for other colors. When water catches the light, it looks like a fallen piece of a rainbow.

entry: 两只POKENAME难得相逢，跳起的求偶之舞，美得令人屏息。可至今竟无一份亲历者的描绘——看过的人都说，再好的描写，也难及那景象分毫。
author: .fedoraman
source: On the rare occasion that two POKENAME meet, their courtship dance is a sight to behold. No firsthand depictions of the event exist, for all who witness it claim they could not do the spectacle justice.

entry: 会在溪床巨石上打洞。每隔几年，POKENAME会脱鳞，再长出柔韧的新鳞。
author: fuzzythelion
source: It punches holes in boulders on streambeds. Every several years, POKENAME sheds their scales and new, supple ones grow back in their place.

entry: POKENAME华丽的鳞片让许多高档时装设计师获得灵感。它们独自漂在外海，等头上的嘴吞下经过的鱼宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's luxurious scales have been the inspiration for many high-end fashion designers. They float alone in the open ocean waiting for the mouth on its head to gobble up passing fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME长得太大，再也离不开鱼缸。不过，对训练家的爱让它具现出了双臂。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has grown to the point that it can no longer leave its tank. However, the force of its love for its Trainer has allowed it to manifest arms.

entry: 被悉心照料的POKENAME，金色面具最为夺目。传闻虽说它健忘，实际记忆力却极好。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that are treated with care exhibit the most strikingly golden masks. Despite what rumors claim, its memory is excellent.

entry: 许多代以来，POKENAME都因外貌丑陋，在宝可梦华丽大赛中备受冷落。近年却有人发现其魅力，组建了饲养俱乐部。
author: Rakunk
source: For many generations, POKENAME was cast aside in Pokémon contests due to its ugly appearance. However, in recent years others have started to find POKENAME charming and built clubs around raising them.

entry: 水下的歌声音准完美，仿佛轻抚灵魂，整片海洋都能感受。可到了水面，听起来却像湿气球正在泄气。
author: epping_forest
source: Its chant is heard underwater as a perfectly tuned caress to the soul that a whole ocean can feel. However, on the surface, it sounds like a wet balloon being deflated.

entry: 水下的旋舞、跳跃与杂技华美动人。可到了水面，受重力与沉重双鳍拖累，再做同样动作就显得傻乎乎。
author: epping_forest
source: Its pirouettes, jumps and acrobatics look gorgeous to see underwater. However, it tends to look dumb when trying that on the surface, due to the gravity and how heavy its fins become.

entry: POKENAME学会了把大葱当作钓竿捕鱼。只要有宝可梦咬钩，就会立刻被拉出水面，展开战斗。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME developed the ability to catch fish, using its leek as a rod. If a Pokémon bites, it is sure to be pulled out of the water and battled immediately.

entry: POKENAME虽对人类友善，却是凶猛的北极捕食者，凡比它小的都吃。会用利角破开厚冰。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite being friendly towards humans, POKENAME is a vicious arctic predator and will prey on anything smaller than it. It uses its sharp horn to break through thick ice.

entry: 钳子色彩与花纹各异。渔夫喜欢收集POKENAME，就为看看每次捕获又有什么新花纹。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their claws can come in a variety of colors and patterns. Fishermen love collecting POKENAME solely to see what new patterns they will see with each catch.

entry: POKENAME熟练乘着气流，沿崖壁优雅滑翔。在突出的岩石间筑巢，险峻地形让它免受大多捕食者侵扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides gracefully along cliffs, skillfully riding air currents. It nests in rocky outcroppings, safe from most predators due to the perilous terrain.

entry: 不怕大多数植物毒素，爱吃多少花都可以。锋利的肢体几分钟就能割倒整片花田。
author: .izik
source: It is unaffected by most plant-based toxins, allowing it to eat as many flowers as it likes. By using its sharp limbs, it is able to cut down entire fields of flowers in minutes.

entry: 最爱腰木果树的辛辣树汁。吸食时十分小心，不会吸走太多，以免永久伤害树木。
author: .izik
source: It prefers the sap of Shuca Berry trees above all others due to its spicy taste. It is very careful not to drain too much of the liquid so that it does not permanently damage the tree.

entry: POKENAME乘着兽群奔腾时掀起的风，跟上冲锋的势头。它常与兽群同行，借奔跑带起的气流，飞越很长的距离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rides on the winds created by a stampede, matching the energy of charging Pokémon. It often joins herds, using their momentum to travel great distances.

entry: 靠鼻子就能在一片漆黑中辨路。嗅觉极敏锐，最远能闻见两英里外成熟树果的气味。
author: .izik
source: It can reliably travel in complete darkness by using its nose to navigate. Its sensitive nose can smell a ripened Berry from up to two miles away.

entry: 由于小小的翅膀无法支撑飞行，POKENAME常常连翅膀被扯掉都没有察觉。它一天会吃掉200多片叶子和花朵。
author: kittyluv090
source: Since it cannot fly with its tiny wings, POKENAME often doesn't notice if they get torn off. It eats over 200 leaves and flowers in a day.

entry: 毒刺一次最多能储存两加仑毒液。巢穴受威胁时，会疯狂刺击，直到对手失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: Its stingers can hold up to two gallons of venom at a time. If its nest is threatened, it will jab wildly until its opponent is incapacitated.

entry: POKENAME能注入使人困倦的特殊毒液，连大型宝可梦也会动弹不得。只需一刺，瞬间就让对手无力抵抗。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME can inject a special venom that causes drowsiness, capable of immobilizing even large Pokémon. A single sting can render opponents helpless in moments.

entry: POKENAME在污染较少的地方采蜜更快。若完全没有污染，还会产生能帮助疗伤的发光物质。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are seen to gather honey more swiftly in areas with less pollution. If there's no pollution at all, it produces a glowing substance known to help treat injuries.

entry: 总想为周围草木授粉。富裕贵族曾请POKENAME照料庄园里的花卉。
author: .izik
source: It has a constant urge to pollinate the flora in its surroundings. Rich aristocrats once used POKENAME to take care of the flowers on their estates.

entry: POKENAME优雅飞舞，洒出蕴含超能力的粉尘，让敌人无法行动。阳光下，翅膀闪耀，超能力也会增强。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME flutters gracefully as it scatters psychic dust to incapacitate foes. Its wings shimmer in sunlight, amplifying its psychic abilities.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME有一半身体没能进化。科学家仍在研究。
author: .ssunday.
source: For some reason, half of POKENAME was not able to go through evolution. Scientists are still studying this phenomenon.

entry: 会用尾巴吸引捕食者，再以超能力赶走，保护领地内的绿毛虫。
author: Staghorn
source: It protects its territory's Caterpie by using its tail to attract their predators. It then uses its psychic abilities to drive these predators away.

entry: 吃花粉时若被打扰，就会惊得爆炸，轻易毁掉栖息草地的一部分。
author: .izik
source: If it is disturbed while consuming pollen it will explode in surprise. This will easily destroy portions of the meadow it lives in.

entry: POKENAME在树干内筑巢，吸食树汁，尤其喜欢繁花盛开的树。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes their nests inside tree trunks, feeding on the sap inside. It especially loves trees with large amounts of flowers.

entry: POKENAME翅膀看似纤弱，身体骨架却极为坚固。能安然抵御风暴，还会用翅膀为小型宝可梦遮风挡雨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings appear delicate, but its frame is remarkably sturdy. It weathers storms without damage, sheltering smaller Pokémon beneath its wings.

entry: POKENAME的翼纹有催眠效果，看久了就会入迷。它优雅振翅，借此分散捕食者的注意，毫发无伤地逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wing patterns are hypnotic, entrancing those who watch too long. It flutters gracefully, using this effect to distract predators and escape unharmed.

entry: 传说POKENAME翅膀落下的鳞粉，曾用于制作爱情药剂。据说只喝一口，就会立刻坠入爱河。
author: .izik
source: There are stories that the flakes that fall off of a POKENAME's wings were once used in love potions. A single sip was said to cause instant infatuation.

entry: 主要吃树皮，用强尾从树上扯下。若吃饱了，就会挖洞埋好，留待以后。
author: .izik
source: Its main food source is bark that it pulls from trees with its strong tails. Should it grow full while eating, it will dig a hole and bury the bark for later.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟深处筑巢，用翅膀将凉风扇过隧道，为黑暗寂静的空间带来奇异的安宁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests deep within caverns, using its wings to fan cool air through the tunnels. Its presence brings a strange tranquility to these dark, quiet spaces.

entry: POKENAME把采来的花蜜滴在尖牙上，引诱其他虫宝可梦靠近，再将其吃掉。蜜香怡人，用来防治虫害格外受欢迎。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures in other bug Pokémon to eat by dripping the nectar it has collected onto its fangs. It is very popular for pest control since the nectar has a very pleasant aroma.

entry: POKENAME翅膀洒出的鳞片会发光，不知为何隔着实体物也能看见。会把鳞片撒满猎物，方便追踪。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings spread luminescent scales that can somehow be seen through solid objects. It will coat its prey in these scales in order to track them down.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太轻，因此很少飞。会细心保养双翼，厚涂蜂蜜作保护层。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Because of how light their wings are, POKENAME rarely flies. They tend to their wings with care, slathering them with honey as a protective encasing.

entry: POKENAME散发花香，吸引附近宝可梦。气味随造访的花朵变化，很受园丁欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exudes a floral fragrance that attracts Pokémon to its vicinity. The scent varies based on the flowers it visits, making it a sought-after companion for gardeners.

entry: POKENAME翅膀分泌黏胶，用于困住猎物或修巢。接触空气后会变得更牢固，经久耐用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a sticky adhesive from its wings, using it to trap prey or repair nests. This substance becomes stronger when exposed to air, providing long-lasting utility.

entry: POKENAME在火山附近生活得很好，能借上升气流轻松滑翔。双翼耐高温，让它能穿行险境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives near volcanoes, where the updrafts allow it to glide effortlessly. Its wings withstand intense heat, enabling it to navigate dangerous environments.

entry: POKENAME从双翼发出安抚的波动，缓解附近宝可梦的紧张，能慰藉受压力与焦虑困扰的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits calming waves from its wings, easing the nerves of nearby Pokémon. Its presence is known to bring comfort to those experiencing stress or anxiety.

entry: 毛发极为坚韧，玉虹市一家店会用它制作红线。这些特殊物品会随携带的宝可梦改变颜色。
author: .izik
source: The fur on its body is extremely sturdy and is used in the creation of Destiny Knots by a shop in Celadon City. These specialty items can change color based on the Pokémon holding it.

entry: 飞行吃力，大多时候都在滑翔。性情温柔善良，经常帮助其他虫属性宝可梦。
author: imagine1.
source: It struggles to fly and is seen gliding most of the time. It is sweet and kind, and it often tries to help fellow Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在花园中快乐吸蜜。成群的它们常会协助大针蜂，换得一些蜂蜜。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in flower gardens, cheerfully feeding on nectar. Flocks of POKENAME will often help Beedrill for a share of their honey.

entry: POKENAME双翼带着毒孢子，接触者便会麻痹。会成股释放孢子，在领地周围筑起防护屏障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings carry toxic spores, capable of paralyzing anything that touches them. It spreads these spores in bursts, creating protective barriers around its territory.

entry: POKENAME从双翼分泌酸雾，溶解沿途障碍，也能阻止捕食者，让它在险恶环境中自由移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes an acidic mist from its wings, dissolving obstacles in its path. The mist also discourages predators, allowing it to move freely through hostile environments.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会抖落羽毛上的孢子。音乐越有活力，孢子的效果越强。
author: welliss
source: As it dances, POKENAME shakes spores from its feathers. The more energetic the music, the more effective the spores.

entry: 抖动身体时，会扬起团团紫色粉末，甜香数日不散。
author: .izik
source: As it shakes its body, plumes of purple powder are released into the air. The powder has a sweet smell that lasts for days.

entry: POKENAME展示最漂亮的裙装来争取伴侣。走秀模特与时尚达人也会从中获得灵感，设计服饰。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME compete for a mate by showing off the prettiest dress. Runway models and fashionistas have made outfits inspired by it.

entry: POKENAME在丘顶热烈起舞，邀请大家加入，再用超能力吸取附近舞者的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs energetic dances on hilltops, encouraging others to join it. It psychically drains the energy from anyone who dances nearby.

entry: 会在月光下的神社与墓地起舞。传说未经许可偷看POKENAME跳舞，整个家族都会受到诅咒。
author: .izik
source: It dances in the moonlight at shrines and graveyards. Legends say that if you watch a POKENAME dance without permission, your family line will be cursed.

entry: 住在垃圾场，以垃圾维持双翼的硕大美丽。冬季会成群飞往阿罗拉取暖。
author: TheHeroicT
source: It lives in garbage dumps, feeding on the trash within to keep its wings large and beautiful. During the winter they fly in packs to Alola for warmth.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会洒下种子，让新植物遍布飞过之处。种子迅速扎根，将荒地变成繁茂花园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters seeds with every flap of its wings, spreading new plant life wherever it flies. These seeds quickly take root, transforming barren areas into lush gardens.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着细花粉，每次振翅都会散播。会收集花粉制成舒缓药膏，治愈自己与别人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are coated in fine pollen that spreads with every flap. It collects this pollen to create soothing balms, used to heal both itself and others.

entry: 飞到树的最高处落下，再洒出数百万孢子，形成一团紫雾。
author: .izik
source: It uses its wings to fly to the highest part of a tree. Once it lands, it will let loose millions of spores in a purple cloud.

entry: 身上抖落的粉末带着酸爽余味。常青市有家店做佛柑果冰淇淋，会撒上这种粉末作点缀。
author: .izik
source: The powder that shakes loose from its furry body has a tangy aftertaste. There is a shop in Viridian City that makes Kasib Berry ice cream and uses this powder as a garnish.

entry: 飞行时释放团团毒气，既让猎物失去行动能力，也能刺激森林植物生长。
author: .izik
source: It releases clouds of poisonous gas as it flies. This gas both incapacitates prey and acts as a stimulant for plants growing in the forest.

entry: 悠闲待在池塘与溪流中，吃睡莲的花。吃饱后，就睡在水边泥地里。
author: .izik
source: It lounges in ponds and creeks, eating the flowers off of lily pads. After consuming its fill, it will sleep in the mud on the water's edge.

entry: 据说POKENAME是外星幼虫，身体的红色球体让它能360度观察。满月时，成群的它们似乎最为活跃。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to be an alien larva, POKENAME can see in 360 degrees thanks to the red orbs on its body. Swarms of POKENAME seem most active during a full moon.

entry: 为免被猎杀，游在海洋最黑暗的深处，以宝石照明。繁星之夜会浮出水面，向往地凝望星空。
author: Phantom640
source: It swims at the darkest depths of the ocean to avoid being hunted, using its gem as a light to see. On starry nights, it surfaces and gazes longingly at the stars.

entry: 晴朗星夜，POKENAME会来到海面，安静地看一整夜星星。谁若打扰，它就会暴怒直到翌晨。
author: Phantom640
source: On clear starry nights, POKENAME comes to the ocean surface to peacefully gaze at the stars all night long. Should one disturb its rest, POKENAME will fly into a furious rage until the next morning.

entry: 据说额头宝石能感知雨天，因为POKENAME似乎只在雨中现身起舞。会用伞状大嘴抓住小型宝可梦，留在其中消化。
author: Mistymagius
source: The gem on its forehead is said to be able to sense rainy weather since POKENAME seems to only appear dancing in the rain. It catches small Pokémon in its umbrella-like mouth where they are left to be digested.

entry: 星夜高飞时，众多核心都泛着红光。有人怀疑，所谓夜间的“不明飞行物灯光”，其实只是瞥见了POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: It flies high in the skies during starlit nights, a red glow shining in each of its many cores. It's suspected that supposed sightings of "UFO lights" at night were people catching glimpses of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME厚重的外骨骼适合珊瑚礁生活。即使掉下一块，经过足够时间，也能再生成一只全新的POKENAME。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME have bulky exoskeletons that leave them well-suited to life in coral reefs. Even if a piece breaks off, with enough time it will regenerate into a brand new POKENAME.

entry: 气温下降时，POKENAME的玻璃身体会明亮发光。晶体身体若碎裂，可能需数月才能重新长好。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's glass body shines brightly when the temperature drops. If its crystalline body shatters, it can take months to regrow.

entry: POKENAME的巨大宝石能放出强光，让它在最深的海底也能畅游。被捕食者追赶时，便闪光晃花对方的眼睛，趁机游走。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME's massive gem can shine a powerful light, allowing them to swim in the deepest depths without any trouble. If a predator gives chase, POKENAME will flash its pursuer with a blinding light before swimming away.

entry: 住在海洋最深处。POKENAME发现猎物或闯入者后，会先用宝石闪光使其目盲，再猛烈攻击，拖回巢里吃掉。
author: Phantom640
source: It lives at the deepest point of the ocean. When POKENAME spots prey or intruders, it blinds them using its gem before violently attacking them. Once done, POKENAME drags its victims back down to its lair to feed.

entry: 狩猎方式复杂过头：先制作美味果汁，让喝下的对象长出巨大肾结石，变成容易捕获的猎物。而这些肾结石，在珠宝业很有价值。
author: epping_forest
source: Their overly complicated method of hunting consists of creating delicious juices that give giant kidney stones to those who drink them, so they become easier prey. These kidney stones are highly valued in jewelry.

entry: POKENAME总将大宝石擦得干净闪亮。明明没有可见的眼睛，却仍看得见，因此有人认为宝石就是它的眼。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME always keeps the large gem on its body clean and shiny. Despite having no visible eyes, it can still see, leading some to believe this gem is actually the Pokémon's eye.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏进黄金堆，捉弄寻宝者。不必害怕，恶作剧并不会伤人。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME love to hide in gold piles, and play pranks on treasure raiders. Fear not, as these pranks aren't harmful.

entry: 靠控电能力善于飞行。有理论认为，最早的不明飞行物目击，其实就是POKENAME飞过夜空。
author: Staghorn
source: It is a capable flyer thanks to its electrokinesis. It's theorized that the first sightings of UFOs were POKENAME flying through the night sky.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁，沿珊瑚爬行觅食。背上众多宝石能吸收阳光，再释放能量脉冲击晕猎物。
author: Katie
source: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁，沿珊瑚爬行觅食。背上众多宝石能吸收阳光，再释放能量脉冲击晕猎物。
author: Katie
source: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME的珍贵核心令寻宝者趋之若鹜。谁敢触碰，就会遭使人发疯的诅咒，唯独训练家能幸免。
author: tuneless.towa
source: Sought out by treasure hunters for its valuable core, POKENAME places a maddening curse on whoever dares touch it. Only its Trainer is spared.

entry: POKENAME尾端的手状附肢能集中超能力，用来摘取离地数英尺的树果。似乎很喜欢将树果抛接着玩。
author: Mistymagius
source: The hand-like appendage on POKENAME's tail concentrates its psychic powers. It will use this hand to grab berries from trees a few feet off the ground. It seems to enjoy juggling these berries for fun.

entry: POKENAME用假墙把猎物困在水下，继而使出2万亿磅的力量，将其牢牢夹住。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME uses it's fake walls to trap prey under the water before clamping down on them with 2 trillion pounds of force.

entry: POKENAME额外的手臂能帮助它操纵超能力球，表演戏法。参与演出，也有助于彼此培养感情。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's additional arms aid them in performing tricks with the psychic orbs they produce. Taking part in their performances helps with bonding.

entry: POKENAME画出的图案能活过来助战。虽然大多无害，却能搅乱敌人，让它趁乱进攻。
author: wpb71809
source: In battle, this POKENAME's drawings can come to life to assist it in battle. Though mostly harmless, the animated drawings can disorient and overwhelm POKENAME's foes, allowing it to attack in the madness.

entry: POKENAME能奏出迷人的曲调，据说连饭匙蛇与阿柏怪都能迷住。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Able to play a mesmerizing tune, POKENAME is said to even be able to enchant the likes of Seviper and Arbok.

entry: 背上的花是人造的。POKENAME喜欢从花里喷水捉弄大家，却不知道这种液体会让人刺痛。
author: roscoepcoleslaw
source: The flower on its back is synthetic. It likes to playfully squirt a fluid from the flower at others, but unbeknownst to POKENAME, this fluid rather stings.

entry: POKENAME虽外貌可怖，却尽量不用巨颚伤人。会用杂技身手逃离危险，或靠马戏般的动作分散敌人注意。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its monstrous appearance, POKENAME tries not to harm others with its jaws. Instead, it uses acrobatic skills to flee danger or distract foes with circus-like routines.

entry: 会尽力逗病人开心。可外貌太吓人，人们通常没法安心欣赏表演。
author: treeman4
source: Pokémon tries their best to cheer up the sick. However, people tend to be too afraid of its appearance to enjoy the show.

entry: 这位神灵精通喜剧与娱乐，偶尔会悄悄降临喜剧演员身边，品评笑话，给些实用的建议。
author: planatical
source: This deity specializes in comedy and entertainment. It occasionally descends in secret to comedians to evaluate their jokes and offer useful advice.

entry: POKENAME演出被打断，就会动粗。战斗时交替使出猛烈刺拳与超能力屏障，屏障上还覆着强效的虚弱孢子。
author: @enemyphase
source: POKENAME get violent when their performances are interrupted. Their fighting style alternates between destructive jabs and psychic barriers that are coated in a potent layer of debilitating spores.

entry: POKENAME常在工业建筑里筑巢。狩猎时会发出超声波，扰乱猎物的方向感。
author: Inksans201x
source: Common to industrial buildings, POKENAME can be found making its nest. When hunting, it creates an ultrasonic frequency to disorient prey.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会伴着轻微“砰”声喷出彩纸，吓攻击者一跳。在生日派对和其他庆典很受欢迎。
author: Mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is scared, it will shoot out a burst of confetti alongside a small popping sound, startling its attacker. POKENAME is quite popular at birthday parties and other celebrations.

entry: POKENAME沿海滩排开，吐出内脏假装受伤，再偷走靠近者身上的闪亮物品。
author: theradrad
source: POKENAME lines the beaches feigning injury by vomiting up its organs. It then takes shiny objects from those who approach it.

entry: POKENAME曾是很受欢迎的表演宝可梦。如今，小孩子一看到它却常常哭起来。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME were once popular entertainment Pokémon. Today, the sight of one often causes young children to cry.

entry: POKENAME很爱与遇见的对象亲昵相抱。不过，它不怎么聪明。
author: Inksans201x
source: POKENAME is very cuddly towards those it meets. However, it is not very bright.

entry: POKENAME始终用超能力墙围住自己。原先人们以为是自卫，后来发现其实是在保护旁观者，免受致命孢子伤害。
author: @enemyphase
source: POKENAME maintain psychic walls around them at all times. At first this was thought to be a defense mechanism, but researchers found they're actually in place to protect bystanders from their lethal spores.

entry: POKENAME常坐在玩具店货架上，等人带它回家。若真的带回一只，可得当心那火爆脾气。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME often sits on the shelves of toy stores, waiting for someone to take it home. Be very careful if you end up with one, because they have a boiling-hot temper.

entry: POKENAME因外形被称为“格斗小丑”。会用难以预测的动作和扰乱注意的手势，竭力让对手出丑。对方越严肃，它就越起劲。
author: sk372
source: Nicknamed "The Fighting Clown" due to its appearance, POKENAME does its best to make a fool of its opponents with unpredictable movements and distracting gestures. The more serious the opponent, the harder it tries to make them look foolish.

entry: 关于POKENAME的都市传闻很多，损害了它的名声，让训练家不愿选择。令人发冷的笑容，也很容易吓跑其他宝可梦。
author: the_smirker
source: Numerous urban rumours circulate about POKENAME, damaging its reputation and making it an unpopular choice among Trainers. Its chilling smile easily scares away other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在嘉年华很受欢迎，乐于载着孩子绕彩色帐篷游玩。能完全控制火焰，信赖的对象碰了也无妨。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular at carnivals, happily giving rides to children around colorful tents. It has full control over its flames, allowing for anyone its trusts to touch them.

entry: POKENAME低飞寻找树上的虫巢，再用头上的镰刀将树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies low, searching for insect nests in trees. It uses the scythe on its head to slice the tree cleanly in half.

entry: POKENAME用有力的嘴唇吸住树木，再脱下毛发作诱饵，让捕食者抓去，自己安然无恙。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its strong lips to stick to trees. It sheds its hair as a decoy, tricking predators into grabbing it without causing harm.

entry: 沉迷于严格的固定作息，谁想打破规矩就会被攻击。有些野生个体甚至产生了财产意识，还将其他宝可梦当宠物照顾。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion becomes addicted to having a very strict routine, and they'll become violent at anything that attempts to break it. Some of them in the wild have been found to develop a sense of property, and even take care of other Pokémon as pets.

entry: POKENAME喜欢边吃边跳，拿着不同食物时，跳的舞也各不相同。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME enjoys dancing while eating food. It has a variety of dances that vary depending on the type of food it is holding.

entry: 飞行与歌声都是迷人的表演。不过，若你是它的猎物，这也许就是最后看到的景象。
author: garret95
source: Its flight and singing are a mesmerizing display. Yet, depending on whether you're its prey, it might be the last thing you ever witness.

entry: 据说POKENAME会与深海居民订契约，操纵其他宝可梦自行陷入危险，免得亲自与之战斗。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to make contracts with the denizens of the deep, manipulating other Pokémon to put themselves in danger so it doesn't have to fight them itself.

entry: POKENAME喷出的冰块虽然与普通冰由相同的水组成，熔化焓却更高。科学家仍对此困惑不解，调酒师则已用它们制作高级鸡尾酒。
author: epping_forest
source: The ice shards that POKENAME blasts have a higher enthalpy of fusion than normal ice, though they're composed of the exact same water. Scientists are still confused, while bartenders use them for luxury cocktails.

entry: POKENAME的长毛若不打理，就会频频绊倒自己，已成为野生个体生存的一大威胁。
author: ohok3441
source: If unmanaged, POKENAME's long fur tends to cause them to trip constantly. For wild POKENAME, it has become a hazard to their survival.

entry: POKENAME说着难懂的语言，听久可能令人发疯。它的吻带来充满怪诞梦境的不安睡眠，自己则一眨不眨地盯着猎物。
author: EmpathNaga
source: POKENAME speaks in an incomprehensible tongue that can drive listeners to madness. Its kiss brings a fitful sleep filled with surreal dreams as its unblinking eyes watch its prey.

entry: 冰冷的花朵不断喷出闪亮花粉，被称作“钻石尘”。清晨阳光一照，POKENAME与周围便闪出万千色彩。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Glittering pollen called “diamond dust” spouts endlessly from its frigid blossom. When the sun shines on it in the early morning, POKENAME and its surroundings shimmer in a million hues.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会用有力的嘴唇吸在冰洞侧壁上。据说被它亲吻后，身体的热量就会被慢慢抽走。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will use its powerful lips to attach itself to the side of ice caves while they sleep. It is said if you are ever kissed by one, you will slowly be drained of your body heat.

entry: 都市传说称，POKENAME若想用头上的嘴唇亲你，最好答应。否则，腹部的嘴就会吞掉你的灵魂。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: Urban legends say that if a POKENAME attempts to kiss you with its the lips on its head, you should allow it. Otherwise, it will devour your soul with the mouth on its stomach.

entry: 住在高山，外表似乎柔软温暖。可别上当，那些看似蓬松的羊毛，其实是锋利、坚硬如石的晶体。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Living in high mountains, it appears deceptively soft and warm. Don't be fooled; what seems to be fluffy wool is actually sharp, rock-hard crystal.

entry: 无论为训练家作战还是争夺领地，艰苦的对决从不逃避。不过，POKENAME最爱的还是恐吓弱小对手取乐，再亲吻催眠。
author: epping_forest
source: It never runs away from difficult duels, like battling for its Trainer or fighting over territory. However, what POKENAME really enjoys is to terrorize smaller and weaker opponents, just to play around, before kissing and putting them to sleep.

entry: 虽然亲人，却极为害羞，也很有保护欲。生气时朝敌人尖叫，高兴时则吹口哨。
author: Rockageddon
source: While affectionate, these Pokémon are incredibly shy and protective. When angry they will scream at opponents, but when they are happy they will whistle instead.

entry: POKENAME好斗，总找更强的对手打架。落败后身心俱痛，又会去亲吻、击败弱小宝可梦，挽回自尊。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's aggressive demeanor leads it to pick fights against stronger opponents. After the physically and emotionally painful defeat, it seeks to relieve its ego by kissing and defeating weaker Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME耳朵能发出奇异声波，扰乱敌我双方的方向感。偶尔听者会陷入催眠，清醒后只记得一首听不懂的歌。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can project unusual frequencies from its ears that disorients friends and foes alike. Rarely, those who listen to it fall into a trance. Once alert, the victim only recalls hearing an unintelligible song.

entry: 皮肤很快就会干燥，因此不停找水保湿。还会冻起一些水，留作往后涂抹滋润。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its skin dries out quickly, which is why it is constantly looking for water to moisturize itself. It also freezes some to apply it later as lotion.

entry: POKENAME能将冰刺长至数米，贯穿对手。危急时，还能取下冰帽当盾牌。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can grow its ice spikes to a length of several meters to impale its opponents. It can use its detachable ice hat as a shield in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME头痛加剧时，周围涌出的超能力会迫使受影响者跳上几分钟的舞。它自己却总是一脸困惑。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME's headache intensify, the psychic surge around it compels all affected to begin dancing for several minutes. POKENAME always seems confused by this development.

entry: 跳舞时，额头宝石闪闪发光。看得太入神，就会被节奏卷入，被迫模仿动作，直到POKENAME停舞。
author: sk372
source: The jewel on its forehead gleams and shines as it dances. Should one stare too deeply at it, they will be caught in the rhythm, forced to copy the movements until POKENAME has finished its dance.

entry: 融合似乎大幅削弱了胡地的智力，让它能对着镜子般的勺子呆看数小时。
author: scotsman
source: It seems this fusion has eroded Alakazam's intelligence to the point that it stares vapidly into its mirror-like spoon for hours on end.

entry: POKENAME成功捕鱼后，常会跳舞庆祝有饭吃。不过偶尔舞跳完了，却把吃鱼这回事忘了。
author: sk372
source: It is a common ritual for POKENAME, after successfully catching a fish, to dance in celebration of securing a meal. On occasion, it may forget to actually eat the fish after the dance concludes.

entry: POKENAME能冻结脚下水面，在水上奔跑。可冰上刹不住，因此只肯跑直线。
author: Rockageddon
source: POKENAME is capable of running over bodies of water by freezing the area underneath its feet. As a result of being unable to brake on ice, POKENAME will only run in straight lines.

entry: 走路时伴着狂乱而有节奏的动作，看着十分不安。连最熟练的舞者尝试模仿，都曾因此受伤。
author: epping_forest
source: They walk doing frenetic rhythmic movements that are very unnerving to see. Even the most skilled dancers have gotten injured trying to imitate them.

entry: POKENAME一手火焰、一手雷电，确实是可怕的对手。有些训练家说，从两手各偏用哪种元素，就能看出它的性格。
author: sk372
source: With fire in one hand and electricity in the other, POKENAME make formidable opponents indeed. Some Trainers say you can tell what kind of personality it has by which hand favors which element.

entry: POKENAME迅捷如电，还能操纵雷霆。敌人常未察觉它就在附近，便已失去意识。也能射出高压电流。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to its swift speed and ability to command lightning, any foe of POKENAME often finds itself unconscious before even knowing POKENAME was around. It has the ability to fire off high-voltage currents.

entry: 栖息在雷暴频繁地区的高处，以喙为避雷针补充电力。狂热的训练家常将它错当成野生闪电鸟。
author: sk372
source: It perches high up within areas where thunderstorms are common, using its beak as a lightning rod to recharge its internal electricity. Overzealous Trainers often mistake it for being a wild Zapdos.

entry: POKENAME聚居在避雷针周围，汲取自然电力。彼此连接巨颚可增强电能，十只以上的群体，能为大城供电一周。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in groups around lightning rods to gain natural power. They link their jaws together to amplify their electrical power. A group of ten or more POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a large city for a week.

entry: POKENAME身体上的黑色橡胶环限制放电量。没有这些限制器，就可能让全镇停电。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The black, rubbery bands on POKENAME's body limit the amount of electricity it can release. Without these limiters, a POKENAME could cause town-wide blackouts.

entry: POKENAME挥拳快如闪电，却不容易打到身后。敌人会抓住敏感的尾巴，以免挨揍。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME has lightning-fast punches, but cannot easily hit opponents behind it. Enemies grab its sensitive tail to avoid getting pummeled.

entry: 一家电力公司开发了专用沙袋，能让POKENAME边出拳边发电。他们声称，只要训练足够，它就能为整座镇子供电。
author: TeatedTiten
source: An electric company developed special punching bags which POKENAME can punch to generate electricity. They claim that with enough training, POKENAME could power a town with its energy.

entry: 虽然不会飞，POKENAME却能制造冰做的落脚点，登上任何悬崖或树顶。它最喜欢占据能找到的最高处，用三重攻击狙击敌人。
author: Rockageddon
source: While flightless, POKENAME can reach the top of any cliff or tree by creating a foothold made of ice. Its favorite strategy is to perch on the highest point it can find and snipe enemies with Tri-Attack.

entry: POKENAME先喷小火，将食物烧成灰再吃。角的燃烧温度达1500度，刺鼻烟雾先警告捕食者，随后便会将其点燃。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews small flames to burn food to ashes before eating. Its horns burn at 1500 degrees, emitting pungent smoke that warns predators before igniting them.

entry: 体内积蓄着巨大热量。栖息的森林烧毁后，往往更容易进化。
author: Markusknight
source: Immense heat accumulates in its body. They tend to evolve easier after a forest they live in has burned.

entry: POKENAME每天至少会发怒3次。它暴躁的脾气经常引发山火，因此有关部门请求经验丰富的训练家捕捉遇到的所有POKENAME。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to get angry at least 3 times a day. Officials request seasoned Trainers to catch any POKENAME they come across, as their short tempers often result in wildfires.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着易燃油，点燃后能威慑敌人。咬伤会造成几乎深达骨头的三度烧伤。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in flammable oil that ignites to deter foes. Its bites can cause third-degree burns that nearly reach the bone.

entry: POKENAME对地壳深处岩浆的变动极为敏感，会前往可能喷发的火山附近，因此被视为灾难将至的预兆。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME is incredibly sensitive to the shifting of magma deep beneath the world's crust. They seek out locations where volcanic eruptions are likely to happen, earning them a reputation for imminent disaster.

entry: POKENAME浓密蓬松的云翼能喷出炽热烟流。寒夜里，一群便能为整座村庄供暖，不过需小心别让火焰失控。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can spread hot blasts of smoke from its dense, fluffy cloud wings. A flock of POKENAME can heat an entire village on a cold night, though care is needed to keep the flames from burning out of control.

entry: 泡进熔岩就能获取能量，不需要吃喝。若见野生POKENAME从火山边飞奔离去，就说明火山即将喷发。
author: Staghorn
source: It gets its energy by immersing itself in lava, so it doesn't need to eat or drink. If you see a wild POKENAME galloping away from a volcano, it is a sure sign that the volcano is going to erupt soon.

entry: 体形变大后，POKENAME会选择更危险的猎场扎根。故意摆出古怪吓人的伪装，引来大小猎物查看，再猛然以巨颚咬碎。
author: Arcul
source: With POKENAME now in a larger form, it may choose to plant itself in more dangerous hunting grounds. Intentionally off-putting mimicry draws prey, large and small, in closer to investigate, where it then lunges with powerful, crushing jaws.

entry: POKENAME结合融合原型的假哭与自身的拟态，吸引好奇猎物。等对方进入范围，再以强劲巨颚碾碎撕裂。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME utilizes its progenitor's faux tears in tandem with its innate mimicry to lure curious prey in close. When the prey enters striking range, it uses powerful jaws to crush and tear.

entry: 脚上的微钩与手爪，让它能攀上各种表面，连垂直墙面也不例外。不过巨钳太大，休息时必须找平地。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to climb all sorts of surfaces, even vertical ones, thanks to the microscopic hooks on its feet and the claws on its hands. It must rest somewhere flat, however, thanks to the large pair of pincers it carries.

entry: POKENAME的钳子有5,000磅的压力，夹住什么都能碾碎。会毁掉一圈树木，标出领地边界。
author: Mistymagius
source: The claw on POKENAME can crush anything it grabs with 5,000 pounds of pressure. It creates a border of decimated trees to outline its territory.

entry: POKENAME好斗，会头槌一切会动的东西。可甲壳承受不住这样的猛烈撞击，身上总是青一块紫一块。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very aggressive and will headbutt anything that moves. However, their carapace isn't tough enough to resist the sheer amount of blunt force, so POKENAME is constantly covered in bruises.

entry: 独角犀牛与肯泰罗融合后长出巨角，冲撞更有力。可它经常把角深深撞进物体里，将自己卡住。
author: sk372
source: The fusion of Rhyhorn and Tauros has given it a massive horn to better charge at foes with. However, it often charges into things and gets itself stuck, the new horn lodged deep within the object it crashed into.

entry: POKENAME凶猛且领地意识极强，常守护大奶罐群。可它也会保护家养大奶罐，转而袭击农民，想赶走十分费劲。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an extremely aggressive and territorial fusion that often protect herds of Miltank. Unfortunately, they may become protective of domesticated Miltank and rampage against farmers; removing these POKENAME can be quite the ordeal.

entry: POKENAME冲向敌人时，粗鬃会积起静电，常出没于荒地。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME charges at its opponent, its coarse mane builds up static electricity. This Pokémon is commonly found in badlands.

entry: 两颗头的大脑一样大，也同样想冲撞闯入者。争夺控制权时，常见POKENAME一会儿向前冲，一会儿又向后冲。
author: sk372
source: Both heads have the same size brain and the same urge to charge at intruders. It's not unheard of to see a POKENAME rapidly charging forward and backward as both heads struggle for control.

entry: POKENAME尾端的包裹，其实能当斗篷，挥向敌人。可偶尔它自己瞥见，也会追着尾巴跑。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's tail bundle actually functions as a cape that it brandishes at its enemies. Sometimes it will catch a glimpse of it and chase its own tail.

entry: POKENAME身体温顺，头上的嘴却总烦躁地啃咬沿途一切。常因坚韧的深棕毛发而被人驯养。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its body being docile, the mouth on POKENAME's head is always agitated and tries to gnaw anything in its path. POKENAME is often domesticated for its tough dark-brown hair.

entry: POKENAME虽然以凶悍出名，却更爱吃树果和水果。野外，它们以5至10只为一群四处游荡，对同伴的保护欲极强。
author: Azalde
source: Despite their reputation for aggression, POKENAME prefer eating berries and fruits. They roam in groups of 5-10 in the wild and are fiercely protective of their herd.

entry: POKENAME平时吃草就满足，却格外偏爱树汁。大吃特吃时，锯齿剑刃连最粗树干也能锯穿。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though it is mostly content to feed on grass, POKENAME is partial to tree sap. Its serrated blade can saw through the trunks of even the thickest trees when it decides to enter a feeding frenzy.

entry: POKENAME从角上的孔洞释放孢子，越愤怒就越有害。蹄子与角都比铁坚韧。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can release spores from openings on their horns. The angrier a POKENAME, the more noxious the spores. Their hooves and horns are tougher than iron.

entry: POKENAME弱得可怜，战斗中毫无用处，却是值钱的鱼饵。因此还形成了成万繁育的产业。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are pitifully weak and worthless in battle, but they are valuable as fishing bait. An entire industry exists for breeding tens of thousands of them.

entry: POKENAME平和弱小，漫无目的地走过平原与农田，无忧无虑地吃草。可一碰胡须，就会暴怒乱撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are a placid and weak species that tend to wander aimlessly across plains and farmland, grazing without thought or care. Touching its whiskers will send it into a thrashing rage.

entry: POKENAME常被渔夫错当成异色暴鲤龙。据说遇见它，既是好运也是坏运的征兆。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for shiny Gyarados by fishermen. Encountering one is said to be a sign of both good and bad luck.

entry: 骗子常谎称它是稀有红色暴鲤龙，拿去出售。但没有牙齿、长着橙色鳍，便能识破真身。
author: astral_1447
source: This Pokémon is often sold by con artists under the guise that it is a rare red Gyarados. Its true identity can be revealed by its lack of teeth and its orange fins.

entry: 肌肉很弱，身体却十分坚韧。离水后会剧烈翻腾扑打，却不会受伤。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon has very weak musculature, but a very hardy body. It will violently flop around and thrash while out of water, but it will not be harmed.

entry: POKENAME的肉不能吃，又繁殖迅速、耐受恶劣环境，成了生态威胁。水域中过度繁殖会引发严重富营养化，让大多宝可梦无法生存。
author: amiel997
source: Its meat is inedible, and due to its rapid reproduction and adaptability to harsh conditions, POKENAME is an ecological threat. Its overpopulation of water bodies leads to severe eutrophication, making the environment uninhabitable for most Pokémon.

entry: 虽然弱小，嗅觉却极敏锐。钻进河泥，捕取更小的猎物维生。
author: Metalocif
source: This weak Pokémon has a remarkable sense of smell. It survives by digging into river mud and gathering smaller prey for sustenance.

entry: 毛发状突起模仿鲤鱼王，让敌人误以为它弱得无法还手。不过，这招给POKENAME带来的麻烦往往比好处多。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its hair-like protrusion mimics a Magikarp, tricking opponents into thinking it's too weak to fight back. However, this often causes more problems for POKENAME than anything else.

entry: POKENAME背上的玻璃球里，常住着幼小的鲤鱼王。传说球中的水能赐予永生，因为从没人见过有鲤鱼王死在里面。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The glass bulb on POKENAME's back usually has baby Magikarp residing in them. Legends say the water can grant eternal life as no one has ever seen a Magikarp die in the bulb.

entry: POKENAME常在海鲜餐厅工作，尤其是供应鲤鱼王料理的店。精湛刀工能将每一餐切分得恰到好处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are often employed at seafood restaurants, particularly those that serve Magikarp cuisine. Their skill with the blade means that every meal is perfectly cut and portioned.

entry: POKENAME调皮，据说会偷钥匙。可它带着的钥匙，似乎从没成功开过任何锁。
author: Brienie
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon said to steal keys. It is believed that the keys it carries have never successfully opened any lock.

entry: 翅膀无力，无法长久飞行。一阵微风，就能把POKENAME吹得偏离路线数英里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Its weak wings cannot maintain flight for long periods of time. A gentle breeze is enough to send POKENAME flying off course for miles.

entry: 进化后，翅膀更有力了。如今微风只能将它吹偏几码，不再是几英里。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: With its evolution, its wing power has increased. Now instead of being flung off for miles by the breeze, it is only yards.

entry: POKENAME生活在干涸湖床的泥中，无论实力还是外貌，都被视为最可怜的宝可梦之一。就算当食物，充其量也只是淡而黏口。
author: sk372
source: Found in the mud of drained lakebeds, POKENAME is considered one of the most pitiful Pokémon in terms of both strength and appearance. Even as food, they are considered bland and tacky at best.

entry: POKENAME虽凶悍好斗，小牙却连皮肤都咬不穿。无法好好捕猎，只能怨愤地改当海底食腐者。
author: sk372
source: Though it has ferocious, aggressive tendencies, POKENAME's small teeth are incapable of piercing skin. Unable to properly hunt as a result, it bitterly resorts to being an undersea scavenger instead.

entry: POKENAME体形小，住在暴鲤鸟嘴里，躲避外面的敌人。
author: jreposo
source: POKENAME is a small Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Gyaralu to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

entry: 弱到连云朵都能将它托起带走。不过水中的捕食者太多，对POKENAME而言反而是好事。
author: jreposo
source: It is so weak that even clouds lift and carry it away. However, due to its many water predators, this is actually beneficial for POKENAME.

entry: 有幸在云间看见异色POKENAME，会见到美丽的景象。不过，它与普通个体一样弱。
author: jreposo
source: Shiny POKENAME offers a beautiful sight to those lucky enough to spot it between the clouds. Nevertheless, it is just as weak as regular POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能收存或提供各种钓具，很受钓鱼爱好者追捧。会在岸边伸出诱饵，捕捉猎物，吸取生命力。
author: Raza
source: POKENAME are said to be the most sought after fusions for fishing enthusiasts, as they can help store or provide a wide variety of equipment. POKENAME rest on shorelines and extend lures out into the water to catch prey and drain their life force.

entry: 鲤鱼王多变的鳞纹，配上岩狗狗的性情与易训练的特点，让POKENAME成了出人意料地受欢迎的观赏宝可梦。
author: bee4082
source: The diverse scale patterns of a Magikarp mixed with the temperament and trainability of a Rockruff make POKENAME a surprisingly popular show Pokémon.

entry: 战斗时会扯胡须，增强原本微弱的超能力波动。不过，事后便会头痛欲裂。
author: sk372
source: It will tug its whiskers during battle in order to enhance the normally weak psychic emanations it produces for its attacks. This leaves it with a splitting headache afterward, however.

entry: 游泳很弱，刺毒也极轻，根本无法自卫。POKENAME常被冲上岸，可怜地望着路人。
author: sk372
source: It has weak swimming capabilities, and even the poison of its stingers is incredibly mild, useless for defense. POKENAME often ends up washed up on shore, staring pathetically at passersby.

entry: 休息时会玩脸上的胡须取乐。曾有人见POKENAME想吃掉或扯下胡须，因此推测它不知道那是自己的一部分。
author: sk372
source: When at rest, it plays with the whiskers on its face for amusement. Based on reports of POKENAME trying to consume or pull off these whiskers, it's thought that POKENAME does not realize they are a part of its body.

entry: POKENAME走动时有种滑稽的优雅，两颗头总在争论往哪游、往哪跑。虽然笨拙，却能突然高高跃起，所到之处水花四溅。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME tends to roam about with a comical grace, its two heads arguing over which direction to swim or run. Despite its clumsy appearance, it can surprisingly launch itself high into the air, creating a splash wherever it goes.

entry: 游久了肌肉就会无力疲惫，因此会上岸休息。累得可怜兮兮地喘气的模样，让观察者觉得颇可爱。
author: sk372
source: It comes onto land to rest, as swimming for too long leaves its muscles weak and exhausted. Observers find its tired and pitiful panting on land rather endearing.

entry: 离开高压深海的家后，外形便变得软塌塌、不成形。奇怪的是，这对整体健康却没什么影响。
author: Staghorn
source: Its blobby, formless appearance is the result of being removed from the pressurized depths it calls home. Surprisingly, this has little effect on its overall well-being.

entry: POKENAME像大舌贝一样咬住呆呆兽尾巴，却不会引发进化。因为自己不善游泳，只是借宿主迁往新的水域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME latches onto Slowpoke tails like Shellder, though no evolution takes place. Instead, POKENAME uses its host as a way of migrating to a new body of water to reside in, as its own swimming capability is quite weak.

entry: 整体虽弱，钳子的抓握力却很强。会抓住大型宝可梦搭便车，等对方猎食后，再吃剩下的碎屑。
author: sk372
source: Though overall weak, its claws have a strong gripping power. It often uses them to hitch a ride on larger Pokémon while they hunt, grabbing and eating whatever scraps remain afterward.

entry: POKENAME将独角虫当作武器甩来甩去，不太在意其安全。自己厚实的甲壳能挡住独角虫蜇刺。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME wield Weedle as weaponry, flailing them around with little regard for their safety. Its thick carapace protects it's from the Weedle's sting.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密海带丛，动作慢，只有微毒的刺防御。主要靠灰暗伪装、不突然乱动，避开捕食者注意。
author: Katie
source: Slow-moving and defended only by mildly toxic stingers, POKENAME live in dense kelp growths. They rely heavily on their drab camouflage and lack of sudden movements to avoid drawing attention from predators.

entry: 深海没有叶片可吃，POKENAME便改吃海藻与苔藓。受攻击时，要么用角刺向敌人，要么摆鳍游走。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Since the deep sea lacks leaves for it to eat, POKENAME has turned to a diet of seaweed and moss instead. If attacked, it has the option of either jabbing the assailant with its horn or using its fin to swim away.

entry: 它的身体依然脆弱，却长出了更多毒刺，分泌细密的毒液涂在翅膀上，吓退捕食者。像结茧一样用翅膀裹住自己，是它惯用的防御动作。
author: sk372
source: Still physically frail, it evolved extra stingers that secrete and coat the wings with a fine poison to deter predators who would hunt it. Wrapping itself in its wings akin to a cocoon is a typical defensive maneuver.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极敏锐，光凭味道就能分辨最爱的叶子。可每颗头爱吃的都不同，吃饭时常起争执。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME's noses are so sensitive that it can distinguish its favorite leaves by smell alone. However, each head prefers a different kind of leaf, which often causes conflict during mealtimes.

entry: 只有头能动，谁想抓它就会被刺。研究表明，POKENAME仅靠气味就能记住碰过自己的人，进化后仍不会忘。
author: sautomagically
source: The only part of its body that moves is its head, which will poke anyone who tries to grab it. Research suggests POKENAME can remember anyone who touched it by smell alone, even after it evolves.

entry: POKENAME蜇一下只会肿胀，若连蜇多次却十分危险。听见翅膀特有的嗡鸣声时，训练家最好避开。
author: sautomagically
source: Although a single POKENAME sting will just cause swelling, multiple stings can be very dangerous. Trainers should avoid areas where they hear the characteristic buzzing sound made by its wings.

entry: POKENAME觅叶时，用蕴含超能力的角感知危险。害怕其他宝可梦，待在它们身旁时常会哭。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses its psychic horn to sense danger while foraging for leaves. It is afraid of other Pokémon and often cries when around them.

entry: POKENAME胆小害羞，很少攻击人类。可受威胁时，会用角和尾刺带来灼痛，因此仍须小心。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME is a very timid and shy creature. It rarely attacks humans, but if threatened, it will use its horn and tail-spike to inject a searing pain, so caution is adviced.

entry: 在树间悄悄穿行，吃叶片与鸟蛋。角和尾巴虽有毒，蜇刺却主要让人难受，实际伤害不大。
author: sautomagically
source: It slinks from tree to tree, eating leaves and bird eggs. Although its horn and tail both contain poison, its sting is more irritating than actually harmful.

entry: 身体虽大，嘴却只够吃鸟蛋与叶子。每天得吃大量食物维持体形，因此是破坏力惊人的入侵物种。
author: sautomagically
