source: Although its body is large, its mouth is only big enough to eat bird eggs and leaves. As a result, it must eat massive amounts of food each day to maintain its size, making it a devastating invasive species.

entry: POKENAME身上的倒刺，本是怪异头部向内生长的牙齿。接触就会注入毒液，但只有狠狠咬下才会达到危险剂量。
author: Mistymagius
source: The barbs on POKENAME's body are actually ingrown teeth from its monstrous head. These teeth inject poison on contact, but only full bites deliver a dangerous dose.

entry: POKENAME沿树枝缓缓爬行，常用带角的尾巴在树皮刻小痕。身体微微发热，让小型捕食者不敢靠近。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME crawls slowly along tree branches and commonly uses its horned-tail to carve small notches in the bark. Its body gives off faint warmth, which deters smaller predators from approaching.

entry: 将静电存进毒刺，准备突袭毫无防备的受害者。不过电击极轻，通常只让人短暂烦恼一下。
author: sk372
source: It stores static electricity in its stinger until it's ready to make a surprise strike on an unsuspecting victim. The jolt is still incredibly minor and rarely regarded as anything more than a momentary nuisance.

entry: 蘑菇不再危害宿主生命，吃下去却很毒。似乎也产生了奇特副作用，让POKENAME的角无法再分泌毒液。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms are no longer deadly to the host, but are now quite poisonous if consumed. This seems to have had the interesting side-effect of making POKENAME no longer able to secrete poison from its horn.

entry: POKENAME毛发中的毒，足以杀死三名训练家。若曾接触，必须立即联系当地医院。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's hair holds enough poison to kill three Trainers. If you've come in contact with it, you must contact your local hospital immediately.

entry: 伏平身体时，分节的躯体能爬得出奇快。尾刺一击便能让目标立刻动弹不得，伤口也会被烧灼封住。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When laid flat, its segmented body can skitter surprisingly fast. Anyone struck with the stinger on its tail is instantly immobilized and their wound cauterized.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉灵敏，几乎不可能在它瞬间移动逃走前悄悄靠近。不过性情温顺，拿最爱的叶子就能引来。
author: sk372
source: Due to its strong sense of smell, sneaking up on POKENAME before it teleports away is near impossible. It is docile enough to be lured close with its favorite type of leaf, however.

entry: POKENAME脚太短，够不到地面，融合后必须学会新的移动方式。
author: pokebio
source: Because its feet are too short to reach the ground, POKENAME must learn new ways to ambulate after fusion.

entry: POKENAME能吞下嘴里装得下的任何东西。每天若吃不足自身体重的食物，就会暴怒翻腾，直到筋疲力尽。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will swallow anything that can fit in its mouth. If it doesn't eat its own body weight in food daily, it flies into a fury and thrashes until exhausted.

entry: POKENAME的毒会引发强烈攻击性、躁狂与幻觉。连最凶悍、最饥饿的宝可梦，也觉得吃它太危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: The poison POKENAME creates induces intense aggression, mania, and hallucinations. As a result, it is considered too dangerous to consume even by the most hostile and famished Pokémon.

entry: 对遇到的一切都凶狠记仇，却除了狠狠咬上一口，没什么出众本领。待在鲤鱼王身旁时，会收敛些。
author: sk372
source: It has a ferocious and vindictive attitude towards all it comes across, but aside from a nasty bite, it is largely unremarkable and ineffective. It tends to act more passively in the presence of Magikarp.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，无论如何都要决斗至死。人们认为，攻击性与独立本能太强，让它们想成为世上最后也是唯一的同类。
author: sk372
source: If two POKENAME meet, they will fight to the death, no matter what. It's thought that their aggressive and independent instincts are so great that POKENAME actively seek to be the last, and only, of their kind.

entry: 老水手传说中，有种凶兽一甩尾就能劈开船首，一口足以撕碎十二名水手。人们认为，那还只是年幼的POKENAME。
author: kingd8
source: Old sailors' tales speak of a ferocious Pokémon able to cleave through the bow of a vessel with just a lash of its tail, its fangs large enough to rend a dozen sailors in a single bite. This Pokémon is believed to be a juvenile POKENAME.

entry: 这些巨兽守在河湖旁，收取过路费。付过后，便展开颈部泡沫，形成平台，载对方渡水。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: Though its size may be huge, these giants are found near rivers and lakes where they guard sections and demand tolls to pass. Once the toll is paid they expand the foam around their neck to create a platform for others to climb on and ride across.

entry: 水手间流传着许多POKENAME的故事。哪艘船若招惹它，便会被追过整片海洋，直到沉入咸涩深海才罢休。
author: sk372
source: Many a tale has been passed down amongst sailors about POKENAME. Should a ship run afoul of it, it will chase it down across entire oceans, not resting until it sends the boat sinking to the briny deep.

entry: 靠强尾溯河攀瀑。遇见任何人造物都会砸毁，船只、桥梁，连混凝土大坝也不例外。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its strong tail to swim up rivers and waterfalls. It will smash any man-made object it encounters; boats, bridges, and even concrete dams.

entry: 挖出错综复杂的水下隧道网。被拖入的猎物再无踪影，永远消失在深处。
author: amiel997
source: It digs complex underwater tunnels, creating an elaborate network. Prey dragged into these tunnels are never seen again, lost in the depths forever.

entry: POKENAME从不攻击自认比自己弱的宝可梦。可愤怒一旦到达极限，就会疯狂攻击眼前一切，直到什么也不剩。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will never attack Pokémon it considers weaker than it. However, if its anger reaches a critical point, it will violently attack anything within its line of sight until nothing remains.

entry: 哪怕只受一点冒犯，也会凶暴地大肆破坏。速度与力量足以让整艘船在几秒内被撕成碎片。
author: sk372
source: It has a most vicious, destructive nature towards anything that catches its ire, even slightly. With its speed and strength, it has torn entire ships to shreds in seconds.

entry: 几乎不动，任凭云朵带着漂流。想捕食嘴里鲤鱼鸟的宝可梦一旦钻进来，就会反被它吃掉。
author: jreposo
source: It barely moves, mostly floating wherever the clouds carry it. It feeds on Pokémon that enter its mouth attempting to prey on the Magilu living there.

entry: 这只宝可梦嘴馋，却不善于找食物，因此会与鲤鱼鸟结伴，合作捕猎。
author: jreposo
source: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Magilu to catch prey.

entry: 持续头痛让POKENAME总是愤怒凶暴。越痛，暴走就越猛烈，剧烈偏头痛甚至会引出威力巨大的破坏光线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is perpetually angry and violent due to the pain of its constant headaches. The stronger the headache, the more intense its rampage; a strong enough migraine can even make it release a massive Hyper Beam.

entry: 民间传说称POKENAME是海之子。能以超能力感知遇险船只与水手，赶去援助。但谁敢惹怒它，危险的一面便会立刻显露。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Old wives' tales say POKENAME is a scion of the seas. Using its psychic powers, it can sense ships and sailors who are in distress and go to their aid. However, it has a very dangerous side that is revealed quickly if any dare to anger this Pokémon.

entry: 古代传说中，POKENAME被称为“吞噬者”。看似触手的其实是多条舌头，先注入麻痹毒液，再将猎物拖进贪食的巨口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is referred to as "The Devouring One" in some ancient legends. What appear to be tentacles are actually multiple tongues, which deliver paralyzing venom before dragging prey into its hungry maw.

entry: POKENAME有时会莫名其妙地大发脾气，狂甩尾巴、咬牙切齿。随后又忘了为何生气，长睡一觉，补回浪费的能量。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes, POKENAME will throw a tantrum, thrashing its tail and gnashing its teeth wildly for little reason.  It then forgets why it was angry, and begins a lengthy nap to recover the wasted energy.

entry: 三颗怒吼的头与敏捷的身体，让POKENAME令人畏惧。性情极凶，能高高跃起，每颗头都喷出水流。雨天会在平原疾奔觅食。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: With three roaring heads and an agile body, POKENAME is a terrifying presence to all. It is extremely violent and is able to jump high in the air and shoot water from each head. During the rain, it runs across plains at high speeds looking for prey.

entry: POKENAME虽然体形庞大圆滚，仍能靠尾巴迅速游动。大炮则用来威吓其他宝可梦。
author: v0rtre
source: POKENAME's tail allows for it to swim swiftly through water, despite its size and round shape. Its cannons are used to intimidate other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME贪食凶猛，几乎什么都吞。古人认为，漩涡就是饥饿的它们试图吞下整片海洋造成的。
author: sk372 & Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are ravenous and ferocious creatures that are able to devour nearly anything. In ancient times, it was believed that whirlpools were caused by famished POKENAME attempting to swallow the ocean itself.

entry: 巨颚碾压力极强，性情又凶暴顽固。咬住的东西，非要压碎才肯松口。
author: sk372
source: Its jaws possess a powerful crushing strength. It has an extremely violent, stubborn nature, so anything it latches onto with its jaws will not be released until it has shattered beneath its strength.

entry: POKENAME善良体贴，十分自豪于背上的小苗。可谁想靠近它悉心照料的幼苗，就会遭到不分对象的猛烈攻击。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is a very kind and caring Pokémon and is very proud of the small seedling on its back. However, if anyone tries to get near the seedling that POKENAME cares for, it will attack indiscriminately and aggressively.

entry: 温顺的POKENAME几乎被猎杀殆尽。即使如此，野生个体仍常自愿用巨大的腹袋，载人渡过水域。
author: SonTyp
source: Their docile nature has resulted in POKENAME being hunted almost to the point of extinction. Regardless, wild POKENAME can often be observed carrying people across bodies of water in their giant belly pouches out of their own volition.

entry: POKENAME游得快又灵活，住在海洋深处，鲜在水面现身。喜爱深潜者作伴，会好奇地跟随，保护对方。
author: sk372
source: Fast and agile swimmers, POKENAME inhabit the deeper depths of the oceans, rarely being seen near the surface. They enjoy the company of deep-sea divers, following them curiously and protecting them from harm.

entry: 西尔佛公司将POKENAME开发为智能浏览器，帮助使用者安全网上冲浪，避开各种恶意软件。
author: Napstabl0ok
source: Developed by Silph Co. to work as a smart browser, POKENAME helps users surf the web safely, avoiding different kinds of malware.

entry: POKENAME比拉普拉斯更凶，也更适应暖地，常出现在新岛形成之处。亲族不信任人类，会极力保护它们。
author: leofric1814
source: More aggressive and used to warmer climates than Lapras, POKENAME appear where islands begin to form. They are protected fiercely by their families due to distrust of humans.

entry: 泳速极快，沿途留下明显的气泡踪迹。POKENAME会用背上的蒸汽与熔岩阻止偷猎者。
author: leofric1814
source: These extremely fast swimmers leave telltale trails of bubbles wherever they go. POKENAME use steam and lava from their backs to deter poachers.

entry: POKENAME用蒸汽笼罩领地，保护幼崽。发怒时，喷发甚至能造出小岛。
author: leofric1814
source: POKENAME shroud their territory in steam to protect their young. When angered, they can produce small islands with their eruptions.

entry: 不断寻找对手，战吼传到极远的地方。谁被视为威胁拉普拉斯族群，它就会攻击。
author: cheroace
source: Its war cry can be heard from even the most remote locations as it continues to seek opponents. It will attack anyone it sees as a threat to the Lapras population.

entry: POKENAME刻苦锻炼泳技与水中战斗力。速度、力量加上波导感知能力，让它很受救生员与水手欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME train themselves vigorously to be powerful swimmers and aquatic battlers. Their swimming speed, strength and ability to sense aura make them popular as assistants to lifeguards and sailors.

entry: POKENAME害羞，只会在海上现身帮助心善而有需要的训练家。受威胁时，水状附肢会变得锋利，能切开岩石。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite shy and will only appear to kind-hearted Trainers in need while at sea. When threatened, it sharpens its water-like appendage to cut through stone.

entry: 伪装成平静池塘，吸引口渴的宝可梦。可壳内的“水”其实是毒液，能削弱猎物，让POKENAME轻松吃下。
author: amiel997
source: It disguises itself as a calm pond, luring in thirsty Pokémon. However, the water inside its shell is actually a poisonous fluid that weakens its prey, allowing POKENAME to easily feed on them.

entry: POKENAME极力守护人类。同类间会竞争较量，看谁更适合守护领地中的人们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of humanity. Rivalries develop amongst its own kind as different POKENAME battle to see which of them is more fit to be guardian to humans in their territory.

entry: 聪明非凡，听得懂人话，也识字。若非如此稀少，POKENAME的文书本领一定大受重视。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has remarkable intelligence and understands human speech and writing. If it were not for its rarity, POKENAME's clerical abilities would be highly valued.

entry: POKENAME能长途穿越陆海，是最令人向往的代步宝可梦之一。历代游牧文化都将它看得比其他宝可梦珍贵。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is considered onbe of the most coveted transport Pokémon, capable of traveling great distances over land and sea.  Nomadic cultures throughout history have valued this Pokémon above all others.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳由形状不定的物质构成，能模仿任何宝可梦，但仅限花纹。睡觉时会伪装成叶子。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace is made of an amorphous substance that lets it mimic any Pokémon. However, they can only mimic things by pattern and camouflage as a leaf while sleeping.

entry: 体内旋动的色彩随食物变化，缤纷效果让它成为引人入胜的研究对象。
author: .izik
source: The swirling colors within its body change based on what it consumes. This vibrant effect makes it a fascinating creature to study.

entry: 吐出的黄色液体一碰就会引发剧烈头痛，让好奇的捕食者不敢打扰。
author: .izik
source: It spits a yellow liquid that causes intense headaches upon touch. This painful secretion ensures it stays undisturbed by curious predators.

entry: 向敌人甩出舌头上的黏液，制成黏陷阱。严重妨碍对方移动，让自己占得优势。
author: .izik
source: It flings the ooze from its tongue at enemies, creating a sticky trap. This adhesive substance severely hinders movement, giving it an advantage.

entry: 一冲锋就非撞墙不止。撞击让POKENAME柔软的胶状身体扭曲，短暂变形，晕头转向。
author: sk372
source: When it charges, it won't stop until it hits a wall. The impact causes its malleable gelatinous body to distort, leaving POKENAME misshapen and disoriented for a few moments.

entry: POKENAME看似亲切可爱的拉普拉斯，实际却是狡猾的伏击者。被外表引来，就可能困在黏软的身体里。
author: sivanandi
source: While it may look like the kind and beloved Lapras, POKENAME is a tricky ambush predator. Anything lured in by its friendly appearance risks being trapped by its gooey body.

entry: POKENAME变成弱小宝可梦引诱猎物。将要被击中的瞬间，便变回原形，以镰刀将猎物干净利落地劈半吃掉。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME will transform into weak Pokémon in order to lure in prey. Right before POKENAME is struck, it'll transform back and slice the prey clean in half with its scythes for consumption.

entry: 平日胶状的尾巴一进入战斗就能硬化，让它在近战中占优。
author: .izik
source: Its tail can harden from its normally gelatinous state when it enters battle. This transformation gives it an edge in close combat.

entry: 叫声像憋住的咕噜声，听着不安，身体却完全健康。奇怪的发声常令遇见它的人困惑。
author: .izik
source: Its cries resemble stifled gurgling, though it remains perfectly healthy despite the unsettling sound. This strange vocalization often puzzles those who encounter it.

entry: 沐浴月光，便能重新生成黏液外层。每夜如此，让身体保持湿润，随时准备战斗。
author: .izik
source: It regenerates its slimy coating by bathing in moonlight. This nightly ritual keeps its body moist and ready for combat.

entry: 模仿飞行属性宝可梦的幼崽，混进巢穴，逐一猎取目标。出手之前，始终不被察觉。
author: .izik
source: It mimics the young of other Flying-Type Pokémon to infiltrate their nests. Once inside, it picks off its prey one by one, going undetected until it strikes.

entry: 眼睛极擅观察目标的动作规律，靠敏锐感知，能将模仿做到极其精准。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes are exceptionally adept at detecting movement patterns in targets. This keen perception allows it to perfect its mimicry with remarkable precision.

entry: 移动时留下一道污泥，接触就会产生强烈幻觉。许多人害怕中招，不敢跟随。
author: .izik
source: As it moves, it leaves behind a trail of sludge that induces powerful hallucinations upon contact. Many avoid following it for fear of the effects.

entry: 睡觉时，黄色的身体部位如灯泡闪烁。有节奏的光似乎是在向附近同伴传信。
author: .izik
source: When it sleeps, the yellow portions of its body flicker like lightbulbs. These rhythmic flashes seem to serve as a signal to nearby companions.

entry: 尾巴能伸长，灵巧得惊人。会借此在人群拥挤处悄悄行窃。
author: .izik
source: Its tail can extend and manipulate objects with surprising dexterity. It uses this skill to stealthily steal from people in crowded areas.

entry: POKENAME好奇心很强，会把身体变成字母和符号，与其他生物交流。据训练家说，它十分喜爱比手画脚的猜谜游戏。
author: sk372
source: A very curious Pokémon, POKENAME communicates with others by forming its body into letters and symbols. According to Trainers, it adores playing games of charades.

entry: 体内没有骨骼，能以大多数宝可梦做不到的方式伸展、扭曲，让战斗难以预测。
author: .izik
source: Its body lacks an internal skeleton, allowing it to stretch and contort in ways most Pokémon cannot. This flexibility makes it unpredictable in battle.

entry: 会从尾尖或颈部头骨状物体喷火。为何有两处出火口，仍是谜团。
author: .izik
source: It releases flames through either the tip of its tail or the skull-like object on its neck. The reason behind this dual flame output remains unknown.

entry: 真正的脸长在颈部褶边上。异常的身体结构能迷惑攻击者，让它占上风。
author: .izik
source: Its true face is located on its hood. This unusual anatomy confuses attackers and helps it gain the upper hand.

entry: 无聊时会将蛋顶在头上取乐。其他宝可梦也看得开心，有时会引来围观。
author: .izik
source: When bored, it balances an egg on its head for entertainment. This playful activity amuses other Pokémon and occasionally draws a crowd.

entry: 头部质地像橡胶，能借此弹跳来往各处，轻松避开威胁。
author: .izik
source: The consistency of its head resembles rubber, which it uses to bounce from one place to another. This mobility allows it to evade threats with ease.

entry: POKENAME通过重组细胞结构变形，常变成自己喜欢栽种的花草与树木。
author: dragonessanimations
source: A POKENAME will reorganise its cell structure to transform. It will often take the form of the flowers, plants, or trees that it enjoys growing.

entry: 调动波导时，会让覆身黏液剧烈振动。共鸣让波导运用更快、更灵活，战斗也更强。
author: .izik
source: While channeling its aura, it vibrates the ooze covering its body intensely. The resonance helps it channel its aura faster and more flexibly, making it even more powerful in battle.

entry: 覆身黏液酸性极强，碰到什么都腐蚀。这层天然防御，让靠近它十分危险。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering its body is extremely acidic, corroding anything it touches. This natural defense makes it dangerous to approach.

entry: POKENAME努力变得可爱漂亮，讨训练家喜欢。但嘴仍保持原样，只好竭力掩饰真面目。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME tries to appear cute or beautiful to gain Trainers' affection. However, its mouth remains, so it does its best to hide its true face.

entry: POKENAME头脑极简单，见到食物就盲目跟着走。受攻击时，会本能地变形抵挡。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is of an extremely simple nature, as it mindlessly follows any source of food. POKENAME reflexively changes shape to block attacks.

entry: 这种奇特融合体是鲸身体的一部分。每一团都能说话行动，战斗时却如同一体，仿佛有谁在操控。
author: glacierwing
source: This peculiar fusion is a part of a whale's body. Each individual lump can talk and act, but in combat, they act as one, almost as if something is controlling them.

entry: 据说POKENAME能变成宇宙中曾存在的任何东西。科学家认为，滴下的黏液甚至可能成为行星、星座，或新的宝可梦。
author: milchik
source: It is said POKENAME can transform into anything that has ever existed in the universe. Scientists claim the drops of slime that ooze from its body may become planets, constellations, or even new Pokémon.

entry: 滴下的黏液带着桃桃果的甜香，吸引好奇的宝可梦，常被误当成食物。
author: .izik
source: The goo that drips from its body carries the sweet scent of Pecha Berries. This scent attracts curious Pokémon, which often mistake it for food.

entry: 沐浴月光时，身体便开始微微振动，变化似乎与月相相应。
author: .izik
source: Its body begins to vibrate when bathed in the light of the moon. This subtle movement seems to change with each phase of the lunar cycle.

entry: 它的网由粗壮、黏稠的粉红色丝线编织而成，能牢牢黏住碰到的一切。这种奇特的丝线让它成为捕捉猎物的专家。
author: .izik
source: Its webs are made of thick, sticky pink strings that cling tightly to anything they touch. These unusual threads make it an expert trapper of prey.

entry: 攀在洞顶，完美模仿钟乳石。探险者从下方经过时，便落到身上，让人措手不及。
author: .izik
source: Clinging to cave ceilings, it imitates stalactites perfectly. When explorers pass beneath, it drops onto them, catching them completely off guard.

entry: 滴下的黏液像火焰闪动，在暗处泛着微光，诡异得像没有热量的燃烧。
author: .izik
source: The slime that drips from its body flickers like flames, glowing softly in the dark. This eerie effect makes it appear as if it's burning without heat.

entry: POKENAME是警员与锁匠的噩梦。黏软身体能变形伸进任何锁孔，将锁打开。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME is the nightmare of law enforcement and locksmiths everywhere. It can mold its gooey body to fit into and unlock any keyhole.

entry: 进入战斗时，尾尖会因电能发亮，既是警告，也是武器。
author: .izik
source: The tip of its tail glows with electrical energy when it enters a fight. This glowing tail serves as both a warning and a weapon.

entry: 耳尖散发甜奶油般的香气，被烘焙师视为珍贵原料，能为精致糕点增添独特风味。
author: .izik
source: The tips of its ears exude a scent reminiscent of sweet cream, which bakers prize as a rare ingredient. This aroma adds a unique touch to delicate pastries.

entry: 会吐余烬烧去林地杂物，为新生命腾出空间，让环境保持健康繁茂。
author: .izik
source: It spits embers to burn away debris on the forest floor, clearing the way for new growth. This habit ensures the environment remains healthy and flourishing.

entry: 覆身黏液比看起来烫得多，接触就会灼伤。这股意外的高热，让它在战斗中十分危险。
author: .izik
source: The ooze on its body is deceptively hot, scorching anything it touches. This unexpected heat makes it a dangerous foe in battle.

entry: 周围的触角状结构随呼吸膨胀收缩，像肺一样。这个奇特构造，让身体始终动个不停。
author: .izik
source: The antennae-like structures around its body expand and contract as it breathes, mimicking the action of lungs. This strange trait keeps it constantly in motion.

entry: 振翅时会将黏液洒满四周，阻碍陷入其中的对象移动。
author: .izik
source: When it flaps its wings, it spreads a viscous slime that coats the surrounding area. This slime hinders the movement of anything caught in its path.

entry: 花粉什么都能黏上，很难清除，既能自卫，也能标记领地。
author: .izik
source: It releases pollen that sticks to anything, making it difficult to remove. This sticky pollen serves both as a defense mechanism and a way to mark territory.

entry: 飘过天空时，会滴下模仿周围材质的奇怪粉红液体，让研究其行为的人十分困惑。
author: .izik
source: As it floats through the sky, it drips a strange pink liquid that mimics nearby materials. This bizarre secretion puzzles researchers studying its behavior.

entry: 能调整胶状身体，挤过仅三英寸宽的缝隙，因此极难捕捉。
author: .izik
source: It can manipulate its gelatinous body to squeeze through spaces as narrow as three inches. This ability makes it exceptionally hard to capture.

entry: 浮力异常，能躺在海面任浪带走，漂往遥远、奇异又偏僻的地方。
author: .izik
source: Oddly buoyant, it floats on the ocean's surface, allowing the waves to carry it vast distances. This passive drifting leads it to many strange and remote places.

entry: 形状不定的身体能施展复杂摔跤招式，缠斗中突然扭成意想不到的形态，以难以预测的动作压制对手。
author: .izik
source: It uses its amorphous body to execute complex wrestling moves, contorting into surprising forms mid-grapple. This flexibility allows it to overwhelm opponents with unpredictable maneuvers.

entry: 抖动身体，将冰冷黏液洒满地面。接触的东西都会冻结，身后留下一道滑溜的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: By shaking its body, it spreads ice-cold ooze across the ground. This frosty slime freezes anything it touches, leaving a slick trail behind.

entry: 望着月亮时会兴奋过头，让变形略微失准，露出细小却看得出的破绽。
author: .izik
source: When it looks at the moon, it becomes overly excited, causing its transformation to falter slightly. This excitement leads to subtle but noticeable imperfections.

entry: 百变怪不稳定的基因与绵绵泡芙的糖丝融合，让POKENAME通常拥有黏稠糖浆般的身体。掉下的碎块富含简单糖类，人类与宝可梦都觉得美味。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically have sticky, syrupy bodies due to Ditto's unstable genetic makeup combined with Swirlix's sugary strands. Loose bits falling from a POKENAME, dense in simple carbohydrates, are delicious to both humans and Pokémon.

entry: 靠黏软身体挤进保险柜和金库，懒洋洋躺在钱堆中。这举动让它在盗贼间声名狼藉。
author: .izik
source: It uses its slimy form to squeeze into safes and vaults, lounging among the money. This behavior makes it a notorious figure among thieves.

entry: 没能完美变形时，会沮丧地冥想数小时，重新集中精神，准备下次尝试。
author: .izik
source: After failing to transform perfectly, it meditates for hours in frustration. This habit helps it regain focus for future attempts.

entry: POKENAME虽模仿得勉强，却也吸收了胡地的超能力。用身体化成的勺子，能释放迷乱的超能力波动，迅速压制敌人。
author: cipherlingarde
source: While only a passable imitation, POKENAME has also assimilated the psychic powers of Alakazam. With spoons formed from itself, it can unleash confounding waves of psychic energy that can quickly overwhelm a foe.

entry: 攻击前，会摆出僵硬的姿势一动不动。这股不安的紧张感，让敌人摸不着头绪。
author: .izik
source: It stands perfectly still in a rigid pose before launching an attack. This behavior creates an unsettling tension that confuses opponents.

entry: 身体像嚼过的泡泡糖，黏得能沿墙向上滚。黏性还能困住沿途物件。
author: .izik
source: Its body has the consistency of chewed bubblegum, making it sticky enough to roll up walls. This adhesiveness also helps it trap objects in its path.

entry: 它滚动时，会留下一路带着大黄气味的黏液。奇特的气味迷惑着追踪者，让它得以掩藏逃走的路线。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, it leaves behind a trail of rhubarb-scented slime. This unusual scent confuses pursuers, masking its escape route.

entry: 滴下的黏液磁性极强，会吸来小金属物，也让POKENAME难免黏在金属表面。
author: .izik
source: The ooze that drips from its body is highly magnetic, attracting small metallic objects. This strange property makes it difficult for POKENAME to avoid sticking to metal surfaces.

entry: 模仿路过人类的声音，常在夜间发出阴森笑声，惊扰旅人，让听者深感不安。
author: .izik
source: It mimics the voices of passing humans, often echoing sinister laughter to unnerve travelers at night. These eerie imitations leave those who hear them deeply unsettled.

entry: 喜欢将各种化学液体吸进皮肤，身体便随吸收的物质变换颜色。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys absorbing different types of liquid chemicals into its skin. This habit causes its body to change colors depending on the substances it absorbs.

entry: POKENAME拼命想吓唬紫苑镇的人，却通常不成功。有些人虽没被吓到，也会装作害怕，帮它建立自信。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME try desperately to scare people in Lavender Town, but usually fail. Although few are intimidated, some act scared to boost their confidence.

entry: 睡觉时常化成一滩液体，藏过捕食者与窥探者的视线。
author: .izik
source: It can melt into a puddle, a state it often assumes when sleeping. This form keeps it hidden from predators and prying eyes.

entry: 传说古代女巫会用它滴下的液体制成药剂，模仿王室。喝下后，外貌与举止都能变得与当权者相同。
author: .izik
source: Legends say its drippings were once used by ancient witches to brew elixirs that let them imitate royalty. These potions granted both the appearance and behavior of those in power.

entry: 变成目标前，会用超能力了解对方的过往，让模仿准确得令人发毛。
author: .izik
source: By using its psychic powers, it learns a target's history before transforming into them. This insight ensures its mimicry is disturbingly accurate.

entry: POKENAME几乎随处可见，四处寻找理想的进化地点。身体虽小，连最恶劣的环境也能生存。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found virtually everywhere, looking for their ideal spot for evolution. Despite how small they are, POKENAME can survive in even the harshest of environments.

entry: 虽然能适应各种环境，却偏爱黑暗偏僻的洞窟。训练家站在洞口，有时能听见里面回荡的响亮悲鸣。
author: sautomagically
source: Although it has the incredible ability to adapt to any environment, it seems to prefer dark, isolated cave systems. Trainers who stand at the entrances to these caves can sometimes hear its loud, echoing cry of sorrow.

entry: 传说随身骨头也和身体一样，能依环境改变大小与形状。战斗时会娴熟地用头骨护住柔软的身体。
author: sautomagically
source: Rumors say the bone it carries can change in size or shape depending on the environment, much like its actual body. It masterfully uses the skull it wears to protect its soft body during fights.

entry: 曾有报告称，POKENAME释放的气体让其他训练家的宝可梦意外进化。报告虽已被证伪，传闻却依旧流传。
author: sivanandi
source: There are reports of POKENAME emitting gases which caused other Trainer's Pokémon to evolve unexpectedly. These reports have been proven false, but rumors still persist.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的藤蔓容易积静电，常带来轻微电击。若发觉训练家因此疼痛，就会竭力躲开雷之石，免得情况恶化。
author: sivanandi
source: Its furry vines build static electricity easily, causing frequent mild shocks. POKENAME that realize they're causing pain to their Trainers will often actively avoid Thunder Stones at all costs to avoid worsening the problem.

entry: 虽然不会飞，有力的跳跃却让四条毛绒尾巴看似振翅。POKENAME毛湿了，就跳不高。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though flightless, mighty leaps give its four fluffy tails the illusion of wings fluttering. When POKENAME'S fur is wet, it can't jump as high.

entry: POKENAME常想偷偷混进派对，纯粹因为太爱跳舞。它对音乐类型的强烈偏好，似乎也会影响进化。
author: rosemagwin
source: Often found trying to sneak into parties, POKENAME just loves to dance. Strong music genre preference seems to influence its evolution.

entry: 这只特别的伊布发生了独特突变，基因组成大幅改变，如今与所有已知进化形都十分相近。
author: zic
source: This particular Eevee has undergone a unique mutation. Its genetic makeup has changed significantly, and now closely resembles all of its known Evolutions'.

entry: POKENAME多在僻静处筑巢。若不进化，就终生与家人一起生活。蓬松羽毛深受鸟宝可梦爱好者喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically nest in reclusive areas and, if they do not evolve, stay with their family for their entire life. Their fluffy feathers are adored by bird Pokémon enthusiasts.

entry: POKENAME四肢短，走动费劲，只好滚着走。结果毛里沾了许多小杂物，自己却清不掉。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME struggles to get around with its short limbs, so it resorts to rolling. As a result, it picks up lots of small debris in its fur that it can't get out.

entry: POKENAME在矿井旁筑巢，方便自己和家人获取进化石。虽然添麻烦，可太可爱，大多矿工也愿意容忍。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME creates its nests near mines for easier access to Evolution stones for itself and its family. While they are definitely a nuisance, they are considered so cute that most miners are happy to tolerate them.

entry: POKENAME爱收集进化石，当首饰佩戴，甚至会溜进百货商店偷走库存的石头。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to collect evolution stones and will wear them as jewelry. It will even sneak into department stores to steal their collection of stones.

entry: 它们不仅遗传构成独特，尾端的包裹里还常带着各种进化道具。
author: pankiwi
source: Not only do they carry a unique genetic makeup, but they also can be found carrying various evolutionary items in their tail bundle.

entry: POKENAME看似可爱好抱，野外群体却配合默契，是高效的猎手。基因适应性极强，能进化成适合领地环境的形态。
author: thatdanguy23
source: Although this fusion might look cute and cuddly, in the wild, packs of POKENAME are effective hunters due to their incredible teamwork. Their genetic makeup is highly adaptable, and they evolve to suit whatever environment their territory is in.

entry: POKENAME的毛发极敏感，能辨识附近物体。讨厌脏东西，讨厌得不得了。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME has highly sensitive fur that it uses to identify nearby objects. It hates dirt with a passion.

entry: POKENAME喜欢各种石头，无论色彩奇异，还是被岁月磨得圆滑。每天都要挑很久，才决定育儿袋里带哪块。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to collect all kinds of stones, from those with unusual colors to those that are smoothed down by time. It takes a long time to pick out which stone it wants to carry in its pouch on a given day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢各种石头，无论色彩奇异，还是被岁月磨得圆滑。每天都要挑很久，才决定育儿袋里带哪块。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to collect all kinds of stones, from those with unusual colors to those that are smoothed down by time. It takes a long time to pick out which stone it wants to carry in its pouch on a given day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢各种石头，无论色彩奇异，还是被岁月磨得圆滑。每天都要挑很久，才决定育儿袋里带哪块。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to collect all kinds of stones, from those with unusual colors to those that are smoothed down by time. It takes a long time to pick out which stone it wants to carry in its pouch on a given day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢各种石头，无论色彩奇异，还是被岁月磨得圆滑。每天都要挑很久，才决定育儿袋里带哪块。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to collect all kinds of stones, from those with unusual colors to those that are smoothed down by time. It takes a long time to pick out which stone it wants to carry in its pouch on a given day.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，另外三颗头却不停争斗，喷出元素攻击，想证明自己的进化比本体更出色。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its cuteness and friendly nature, POKENAME's three other heads are constantly at war. They spew elemental attacks to prove their evolution is superior to the main body.

entry: POKENAME能预知自己的未来。会固执地拒绝让自己变成预言以外形态的进化石。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME can foresee its own future. It will stubbornly refuse any Evolution stone that would cause it to evolve into a form different from the one it has predicted.

entry: POKENAME背着几块进化石，随年龄增长逐渐脱落。最后只剩一块时，便会依其种类进化。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME carry several Evolution stones on their back. As they age, these stones gradually fall off. When only one stone remains, POKENAME will evolve according to the type of stone left.

entry: POKENAME能感知进化石的气息，急切寻找，想变得更强，因此极少有个体还未进化。
author: sivanandi
source: It can sense the aura of Evolution stones, and eagerly seeks them out to become stronger. Because of this, unevolved POKENAME are extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME喜欢制造幻象，展示想象中的进化模样。可真让它进化却很难，因为它总是拿不定主意。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME likes to create illusions of what it imagines it might look like when it evolves. Actually evolving it can be a challenge, though, because it's often very indecisive.

entry: 发现伊布群后，POKENAME会将自己埋进地下，只露出头上的进化石。所有石头用完，生命也就走到尽头。
author: kittyluv090
source: When it finds a pack of Eevee, POKENAME embeds itself into the ground, leaving the evolution stones on its head exposed. After all the stones are used up, its life comes to an end.

entry: POKENAME在海滩装成埋在沙里的可爱伊布，引人抚摸。接触后便控制对方，强迫其送来进化石。
author: Knilk
source: POKENAME haunts beaches, where it lures unsuspecting victims into petting it by cutely pretending to be an Eevee buried in sand. When they touch it, it takes control of them and forces them to bring it Evolution stones.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛上的石头代表想进化的形态。通常很犹豫，只有一种石头的个体十分罕见。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The stones on POKENAME's mane represent what evolution the Pokémon wants to become. They are usually indecisive, so finding one with only a single type of stone is rare.

entry: POKENAME潜力无限，却偏爱火属性招式。目前尚未发掘更强本领，只会在野外生小火取暖。气温越暖，精力越足。
author: merclipse
source: Although possessing limitless potential, POKENAME tends to lean towards Fire-Type moves. At present, it has yet to fully tap into stronger feats other than simple fires to keep itself warm in the wild. It has more energy the warmer the temperature.

entry: POKENAME以偷进化石闻名，训练家睡觉时没收好包，便常引发意外进化。据说它们是被石头散发的能量吸引。
author: thatdanguy23
source: Many accidental evolutions are caused by Trainers not securing their bags while asleep, as POKENAME are notorious for stealing evolution stones. Supposedly, this is because they are attracted to the energy these stones emit.

entry: POKENAME精通进化之力，惊人的精神力量模糊了进化与融合的界线。能变成数量惊人的形态，各有不同的天赋与本领。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Master of the powers of evolution, POKENAME can use its incredible mental strength to blur the lines between evolution and fusion. It has the ability to transform into an incredible number of forms, all with different affinities and skills.

entry: 盔甲以坚石为底，再覆上一层各种进化石。一旦开裂，它便可能进化。
author: Toxicrown
source: Its armor is crafted with a layer of various Evolution stones placed atop a layer of solid stone. If the armor cracks, this Pokémon may evolve.

entry: POKENAME的腿尚未完全适应水中生活，主要靠强尾推进。对人类十分友善，甚至专门上岸陪人玩。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs haven't quite adapted to aquatic conditions so it relies on its powerful tail to propel itself through the water. They are quite friendly to humans and will come to shore just to play with them.

entry: 看似纤细的翅膀，其实是带蹼的鳍，能推动水中游动。可鳍太重，离水后便难以飞行。
author: Mistymagius
source: This Pokémon's delicate wings are actually webbed fins that allow it to propel itself through the water. However, it struggles to fly outside of the water because of the weight of these fins.

entry: POKENAME常在海滩出现，被误认成美人鱼。舒缓的海浪旋律总能吸引它。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME is found at the beach and often gets mistaken for a mermaid. It is attracted to the soothing melody of the waves.

entry: POKENAME泡沫般的鬃毛无风也会流动，与周围波浪融为一体。覆鳞的流线身体在月光下闪烁，潜近猎物时几乎隐没水中。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has a flowing, foam-like mane that ripples even without wind and blends seamlessly with the waves around it. Its sleek, scale-covered body glimmers under moonlight, making it nearly invisible in water as it stalks its prey.

entry: 体内火囊能将产生并排出的水加热到极高温度。战斗时喷出的沸水与滚烫蒸汽，能让敌人严重灼伤。
author: sk372
source: The flame sac within its body allows it to super-heat any water it produces and expels. In battle, it can fire boiling hot water or bursts of scalding steam to leave foes badly burnt.

entry: POKENAME一入水游动，身体就会变得半透明，连尾巴里收集的贝壳与树果，都看得见。
author: pankiwi
source: When POKENAME swim in the water, their bodies become translucent and the seashells and berries they collect in their tail become visible.

entry: 指向敌人时，会射出冰冷水流。趁对方被冷得一惊，就立刻出击。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When pointed at a foe, it shoots a jolt of chilling water. While its opponent is still shocked from the cold, it takes the opportunity to strike.

entry: 在河湖附近筑巢，追捕水属性宝可梦时，最多能潜至40英尺深。
author: Staghorn
source: It builds its nests near rivers and lakes. It can dive up to 40 feet in pursuit of Water-type Pokémon.

entry: 空灵的美貌令人称奇。POKENAME在冰湖上优雅起舞，邀人加入，再将追随者引上薄冰，默默看着他们坠入冰冷深处。
author: amiel997
source: Known for its ethereal beauty, it dances gracefully over frozen lakes inviting people to join it. Those who follow it are lured to thin ice, where POKENAME silently watches as they fall through and sink into the icy depths.

entry: POKENAME本就善于控水，新获得的超能力又能将水塑成更复杂的形状，满足战斗与生活所需。还原出进化时用掉的水之石，留作成长纪念。
author: merclipse
source: It controls water skillfully, yet its new psychic power allows POKENAME to shape water into more complex forms to aid it in combat or personal needs. It was able to restore the Water Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.

entry: 在海边岩崖筑巢，既善游泳，也善飞行。会凶猛地与暴鲤龙争夺猎物。
author: bobosmith01
source: It makes nest in rocky cliffs by the shore. It is both an expert swimmer and flier. It viciously competes for prey with Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME硬毛般的体毛能收集静电，用于维生与自卫。虽腿短，充沛精力仍让时速可达30英里。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity, which it uses for sustenance and defense. Despite its small legs, it can move up to 30 miles per hour due to its high energy.

entry: POKENAME硬毛般的体毛能收集静电，用于维生与自卫。虽腿短，充沛精力仍让时速可达30英里。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity which it uses for sustenance and as a defense mechanism. Despite its small legs it can move up to 30mph thanks to its high energy.

entry: POKENAME的毛不断产生少量静电，让手中骨头带电。风暴中，雨声雷声之间也能听见它的哭声。
author: sautomagically
source: Its fur regularly generates small amounts of static electricity, which POKENAME uses to electrify the bone in its hand. During storms, its cries can be heard amongst the sound of rain and thunder.

entry: POKENAME时常举手向天，将雷电召入掌中。靠身体天生的静电，最长能将这股电力保持一个月。
author: sautomagically
source: Every so often, POKENAME holds its hand up to the sky and summons a bolt of lightning into its grasp. Using the natural static on its body, POKENAME can maintain this electricity in its hand for up to a month.

entry: POKENAME雷能澎湃，以磁力托着巨大的雷之石。光是靠近它的雷云，就可能严重麻痹。
author: moopse
source: Bursting with thunderous energy, POKENAME carry with them an extremely large thunder stone via magnetic force. Simply getting near this Pokémon's thunderclouds can cause severe paralysis.

entry: POKENAME活泼贪玩，很讨人喜爱。可兴奋时会放电，不太适合作宠物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are prized for their playful nature, but they don't make good pets because they discharge electricity when they become excited.

entry: POKENAME喜欢摇滚演唱会，总想坐得离音箱越近越好。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME is drawn to rock concerts. It loves to sit as close as possible to the speakers.

entry: POKENAME的毛如金属刺般竖立，每根都带静电。强健双腿能牢牢抓住地面，支撑闪电般的冲刺。
author: jaminmcready
source: The fur of a POKENAME stands rigid like metallic spines, each hair charged with static electricity. Its muscular legs allow it to dig into surfaces for a powerful grip during its lightning-fast sprints.

entry: POKENAME将体内电力储存在雷之石般的晶体花苞里。风暴时四处游走，等待花苞引来雷电。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores its internal electricity in its crystalline bud that resembles a thunder stone. They roam around on stormy days, waiting for lightning to be drawn to their bud.

entry: POKENAME尾端的包裹，总带着静电。稍一靠近，就会被轻轻电一下。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's tail bundle is always charged with static electricity. Getting near it will give you a light shock.

entry: POKENAME迷恋电插座。若停电时还传来轻轻的窃笑，它就是罪魁祸首。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME is fascinated by electrical sockets. When a blackout is accompanied by faint giggling, POKENAME is the culprit.

entry: 由两只强大的电属性宝可梦融合而成，POKENAME能够爆发出超过500,000伏的电流。在紧急情况下，这股巨大能量足以为整个宝可梦中心供电，是危难时刻的重要助力。
author: xyloldi
source: With the fusion of two powerful Electric-types, POKENAME can unleash electric bursts exceeding over 500,000 volts. This immense energy is capable of powering an entire Pokémon Center during emergencies, making it a vital asset in times of need.

entry: POKENAME两种相反的属性让它很苦恼：电击常被自己喷出的泥浆抵消。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's opposite types cause it some frustration: Its electric attacks are often nullified by the mud it has sprayed.

entry: POKENAME哪怕晴天也经常突然遭雷击，力量因此大增。光是触摸太久，也可能被麻痹。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is not uncommon for POKENAME to be struck by lightning out of the blue, even on sunny days. This causes its powers to be supercharged. Simply touching it for too long may cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME不停跑动，其实是在收集周围静电，储存起来用于攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME runs about constantly. It is really gathering the static electricity out of its surroundings to store for attacks.

entry: 偶然间，POKENAME学会以摩擦将热量化成电力。拖着棍子划过泥土，积起强静电对敌，摩擦甚至会留下焦痕。
author: merclipse
source: By accident, POKENAME discovered how to turn heat into electricity through friction. It drags its stick along the dirt to build up a strong, static charge that it can wield against foes. The friction from said dragging can leave behind scorch marks.

entry: POKENAME电人虽痛，却更偏向用电力筑起屏障防御。还原出进化时用掉的雷之石，留作成长纪念。
author: merclipse
source: Although a zap from POKENAME will hurt, it's actually more defensive with its power, forming barriers of electricity to protect rather than attack. It was able to restore the Thunder Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.

entry: 电能在血管中涌动，强化肌肉。战斗兴起时，尖毛会带电引雷，获取更多力量。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its veins pulse with electrical energy that help enhance its muscles. When it gets fired up in battle its quills become charged and draw in lightning strikes to gain more power.

entry: POKENAME性情好斗，会裹着火焰冲撞其他宝可梦。软毛燃烧的热度宛如篝火，因此很受露营者欢迎。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite feisty and will tackle other Pokémon while cloaked in flames. Its soft fur burns as hot as a campfire, so these Pokémon are quite popular amongst campers.

entry: POKENAME绒毛极易燃，随时能点着吓退捕食者。身体却十分耐热，连森林大火也能安然承受。
author: Mistymagius
source: The fluff on its body is highly flammable and POKENAME can easily ignite it to scare off any predators. Its body is highly resistant to heat and is able to withstand forest fires without issue.

entry: 哭泣时，戴着的头骨会冒黑烟。据说毛是世上最软的，可谁碰了都会严重灼伤。
author: sautomagically
source: When it cries, black smoke puffs out from the skull it wears. Rumors say its fur is the softest thing in the world, but anyone who touches it will end up with a nasty burn.

entry: 战斗时手中骨头会燃起烈火。依据POKENAME毛量、火势与脾气的凶猛程度，便能判断年龄。
author: sautomagically
source: During fights, the bone in its hand erupts into flames. The age of a POKENAME can be determined by the size of its fur, the strength of its fire, and the ferocity of its temper.

entry: POKENAME越接近进化，壳内散出的热量越多。毛簇燃起时，便代表进化接近完成。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME gets closer to evolving, its shell radiates more and more heat from within. The tufts of fur igniting signals the process is nearing completion.

entry: 育儿袋由体内火囊加热，让幼崽保暖。亲代用火息给孩子烹饪，也会把靠得太近的家伙烤熟。
author: sk372
source: The joey is kept warm in the pouch, which is heated by an internal flame sac. The parent uses flame breath too cook food for the child, and cook anybody who gets too close to it.

entry: 柔软的毛显得端庄。常能看见POKENAME想办法进入当地歌剧院。
author: rosemagwin
source: Its soft fur gives it a dignified look. POKENAME can often been found trying to gain access to the local opera house.

entry: 别碰POKENAME头上的石头，一碰就立刻暴怒。会披上烈焰，冲撞周围一切，直到平静。
author: sk372
source: One should never attempt to touch the stone on POKENAME's head, as doing so will send it into an immediate rage. It will coat itself in raging flame before charging into anything and everything nearby until it calms down.

entry: 它游过之处，蒸汽随之升起，掩住身形，让天敌摸不清方向。它营造的温暖水雾，也十分适合水生植物生长。
author: jaminmcready
source: Steam rises wherever this Pokémon swims, masking its movements and confusing predators. It's known for creating warm, misty environments perfect for nurturing aquatic plants.

entry: POKENAME火焰极热，铁匠常借此锻造、回火钢铁。稳定的温度，让它成为制作耐用武器与工具的珍贵伙伴。
author: jaminmcready
source: The flames of a POKENAME burn so hot that blacksmiths often use it to forge and temper steel. Its ability to maintain a consistent heat makes it an invaluable partner in crafting durable weapons and tools.

entry: POKENAME庞大温暖，性情友善。能负担惊人食量的人很爱养它，还常用它散出的热量代替壁炉取暖。
author: sk372
source: Its large size, warmth and friendly disposition make POKENAME a popular pet for those who can afford to feed its prodigious appetite. It emits enough heat from its body that many like to use it in lieu of a fireplace for warmth.

entry: 许多孩子觉得它是最温暖、最好抱的宝可梦，见了就忍不住拥抱。
author: bostroms
source: It is thought to be the warmest and cuddliest of all Pokémon by many children.  Most can't help but give it a hug when they see it.

entry: 许多孩子觉得它是最温暖、最好抱的宝可梦，见了就忍不住拥抱。
author: bostroms
source: It is thought to be the warmest and cuddliest of all Pokémon by many children.  Most can't help but give it a hug when they see it.

entry: 淡红花瓣散发强热，20英尺之外也会灼伤。愤怒时，背部毛簇如喷灯点燃，烧焦沿途一切。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its pale-red petals give off an intense heat that can cause burns from over 20 feet away. When angered, the tuft of fur on its back ignites like a blowtorch, scorching anything in its path.

entry: 据说，POKENAME带着的包裹，暖和又舒服。有时，还能发现伊布躲在里面，静静避寒。
author: pankiwi
source: The bundle POKENAME carries is said to be extremely warm and comfortable. Eevee can sometimes be found hiding inside their bundles from the cold.

entry: 寒冬时，POKENAME会溜进人家，卧在壁炉旁。发现黄金般的毛，就说明它夜里来过。
author: rosemagwin
source: On cold winter days, POKENAME sneaks into homes to lay next to the fireplace. Finding golden hair indicates a nightly visit by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME皮肤不断散热，烫得能严重灼伤人。只有颈部和尾巴的毛较凉，那是排出热量的地方。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's skin constantly radiates with heat. It is so hot that touching it can cause severe burns, with the only cool spots being the fur on its neck and tail, where it releases the heat.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛打理得格外精致，却常在想烘干时把它点着。
author: Kampfzwuggel
source: While POKENAME's mane is considered to be one of the most well-kept out there, it regularly sets it on fire while trying to dry it.

entry: POKENAME极力保护在乎的对象，一记烈焰重拳就能吓退大多威胁。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is highly protective of those it cares about. A single blazing punch dissuades most threats.

entry: 火红花瓣晃花对手的眼睛，里面还藏着许多滚烫的刺鞭。优雅而凶悍，以火与毒的演出点燃战场。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: It dazzles opponents with its fiery petals, which conceal an arsenal of scorching, thorny whips. Graceful yet fierce, it ignites the battlefield with a performance of flames and poison.

entry: 寒山旅人总欢迎POKENAME现身。它会领人回自己的住处，以蓬松的拥抱温暖对方，直到足以再次抵御严寒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a welcome sight for those traversing frigid mountainsides. It guides them to its home and warms them with its fluffy embrace until they feel ready to tackle to cold once more.

entry: 深入理解火焰后，POKENAME着重磨炼控火，能力更进一步。将火蓄在体内，再借棍子像挥魔杖般引出。
author: merclipse
source: Now focused on enhancing it's control over fire, its ability has grown more advanced after learning a deeper understanding of flames. POKENAME stores built up fire within its body and channels it out using its stick as if it was a wand.

entry: POKENAME魔力已达顶峰，能随心操纵火焰。虽可直接从爪子引火，多数仍保留魔杖约束火力，减少破坏环境的意外。
author: merclipse
source: Now achieving the apex of its magic, POKENAME manipulates fire to its whim. Although it can now channel flames through its own claws, most choose to keep their wands to limit output. This is to minimize environmental accidents.

entry: 使用超能力时，头上的毛簇如真火般跃动闪烁。将头泡水缓解头痛时，头顶会升起蒸汽。
author: sk372
source: Whenever it uses its psychic abilities, the tuft of fur on its head moves and flickers like a real flame. When it soaks its head to relieve its headaches, steam can be seen rising from its cranium.

entry: 人们认为它因使用多块火之石而如此温暖，连鼻子摸着都舒服。战斗时，却会变得炽热。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is thought the use of multiple Fire Stones on this Pokémon is the reason it is so warm to touch. Even its nose is pleasantly warm. This warmth turns red-hot when in battle.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的毛象征财富与繁荣。炮管能以各种压力喷出从暖和到滚烫的水，嘴则能喷火。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fluffy fur is a symbol of wealth and prosperity. POKENAME can shoot water that ranges from scalding hot to pleasingly warm at all different kinds of pressures from its cannons. Through its mouth, it breathes fire.

entry: 据说POKENAME原是廉价防病毒程序，能进出设备，吞食损坏的代码。一台电脑里能同时住着数百万只。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to have been created as a cheap virus protection, POKENAME can travel in and out of devices and feed on corrupted computer code. Millions of POKENAME live in a computer at a time.

entry: 脸上的眼睛数量随情绪改变。越烦躁，每一面的眼睛就越多，最多同时有十六只。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The number of eyes on its faces fluctuates based on its mood. The more aggravated it grows, the more eyes per side, up to sixteen at once.

entry: 据说与比克提尼关系密切。正如比克提尼带来胜利，它也能带来胜利，自身更是无可击败。
author: TheHeroicT
source: This Pokémon is believed to be closely related to Victini. Just as Victini brings victory, this Pokémon does as well, being unbeatable.

entry: POKENAME似乎会随机出现在社交网站，插入毫不相关的对话。看到的人通常会感到一种“失落”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crop up within social media websites seemingly at random, interjected within unrelated conversation. Those who spot it usually report feeling a sense of loss.

entry: 据说POKENAME背着通往冥界的门。可体温太高，至今无人开展研究。
author: jaminmcready
source: It is said that POKENAME carries a portal to the underworld on its back. However, no research has been conducted due to its high body temperature.

entry: POKENAME拥有自己的网络投递系统。创造它的初衷，是与互联网上的电子通信，争一争高下。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME was created as an attempt to compete with electronic messaging on the internet through its own cyber delivery system.

entry: 来自热门电脑游戏的数字武器，被带进现实。虽然棱角方正，却能轻松切割。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A digital weapon from a popular computer game, transferred into the real world. Despite its blockiness, it cuts with ease.

entry: POKENAME看似方方正正，每一条边却都极锋利，连柄也一样，因此几乎无法持用。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Despite its blocky appearance, every one of POKENAME's edges is sharp as can be - even on its hilt. As a result, it is almost impossible to wield.

entry: 漫长下载后，代码赋予了它飞行能力。可多余的代码也带来了难以约束的暴怒。
author: TheCrowArtiste
source: As a result of a long download, its code enabled its ability to fly. However, it also inherited an unruly rage from excess code.

entry: 进化成功后，POKENAME的实体与数字两种性质达到稳定平衡，成为多才多艺又强大的伙伴。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: Having successfully evolved, POKENAME are fully stable in balancing their physical and digital natures. This makes them very versatile and powerful companions.

entry: POKENAME同时处于实体与数字状态，极不稳定。进化因此十分冒险，需要格外谨慎照料。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME are rather unstable as they exist in both physical and digital states. Their nature makes evolution a risky process for them, so caution and care are advised.

entry: 程序将POKENAME设定得比铁更硬，主要用头冠撞击。可冠太重，也让它无法飞行。
author: TheCrowArtiste
source: Coded to be harder than iron, POKENAME utilizes its crest mainly to headbutt. The crest on its head is heavy and renders it unable to fly.

entry: 这只人造宝可梦的最初版本，经过多次更新，核心系统更加偏重多边兽资料。模仿的精细程度虽高了许多，仍显得诡异，始终学不像一只自然生动的索罗亚。
author: El Fail
source: The first version of this artificial Pokémon was designed with various updates and a greater emphasis on Porygon data as its core system. As a result, it has far higher fidelity but is very uncanny and not quite able to imitate a Zorua organically.

entry: POKENAME形似旧时的街机游戏。那份怀旧感，让某些训练家格外喜爱。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME resembles an old game found in arcades. It's favored by certain Trainers for the nostalgia it brings.

entry: POKENAME会模仿任天堂64游戏机的外形与声音，喜欢用复古的表演，唤起人们怀旧的记忆。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME mimics the looks and sounds of a classic Nintendo 64 console. It loves to recreate nostalgic memories through its retro-style performances.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME从哪里来，却常在家人或情侣的欢聚场合附近出现。据说见到它的人都会获得好运。
author: lemage22
source: Nobody knows where POKENAME come from, but they are often seen near joyous gatherings of families or couples. They are said to bring good fortune to those they appear before.

entry: 远古时，POKENAME会攻击一切触手够得着的东西，完全不在意甲壳是否损坏。
author: mystora
source: In ancient times, POKENAME attacked anything they could get their tentacles on, with no care for if their shell armor became damaged.

entry: POKENAME硬壳虽只护住头颈，却无关紧要，因为其余部位失去后都能再生。
author: .realthree
source: It doesn't matter that POKENAME's hard shell only protects its head and neck. Everything else can regrow if lost.

entry: 远古时，成群POKENAME曾游荡在宽广海滩附近。冲上岸的东西，几乎什么都吃。
author: kittyluv090
source: Groups of POKENAME roamed near vast beaches in ancient times. They eat nearly anything that washes up on shore.

entry: POKENAME藏在高草中，等待猎物靠近，再以闪电般的速度伸出触手，将其缠住。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME's hunting strategy involves hiding in tall grass, waiting for something to wander near, then using its tentacles to ensnare its prey at lightning speeds.

entry: 身材虽小，却连最强的龙属性宝可梦也能击败。
author: WeirdIsNormal
source: Despite its small stature, this Pokémon is capable of defeating even the strongest of Dragon-types.

entry: 双镰是它保护茧状身体的最后手段。双镰虽然锋利，却十分脆弱，挥动得过猛就可能整根折断，让它失去防护。
author: sk372
source: Its scythes are a last resort to defend its cocooned body. Though sharp, they are rather delicate; if swung too forcefully they may snap off the body completely, leaving it vulnerable.

entry: 鲜艳体色警告捕食者远离。刺中的毒会留下恼人瘙痒，持续数天。
author: sautomagically
source: Its bright colors warn predators to stay away. The poison in its barbs leaves an annoying itch that lasts for days.

entry: 完全无法移动，身体却比钢铁还硬，连锤子也敲不出凹痕。
author: sautomagically
source: Although this fusion is incapable of all movement, its body is harder than steel. Not even a hammer could dent its shell.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在海中浅滩，互相抵御潮汐与捕食者。会如此挤在一起等上最多六个月，进化后才离海寻找大量食物。
author: lunacharlotte
source: POKENAME gather in large groups on ocean shoals to protect each other from the tides and predators. They will huddle in these patterns for up to six months waiting to evolve, at which point they will emerge from the sea and seek vast amounts of food.

entry: POKENAME翅膀撑不起沉重身体，只能慢慢爬树移动。毒性变强，也更加危险。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME's wings cannot carry its heavy body, so it slowly climbs trees to move around. Its poison has become more potent and thus more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME静止不动，集中超能力准备进化。外壳极坚韧，能弹开大多身体攻击。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME remains motionless, concentrating its psychic energy for evolution. Its shell is incredibly tough, deflecting most physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME缠在树干上一动不动，准备进化。谁想把它取下，都会因坚硬皮肤而起疹。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME wraps itself around a tree trunk and remains completely still as it prepares to evolve. Its hardened skin causes a rash to anyone who tries to remove it.

entry: POKENAME越久不动，皮肤就越硬，也越接近进化。若受威胁，却会逃往新地点，重新开始结茧。
author: sautomagically
source: The longer POKENAME stays still, the harder its skin becomes and the closer it comes to evolving. However, if threatened, it will flee to a new location and restart its cocooning process.

entry: POKENAME的硬蛹壳既能防身，也能作武器。头顶尤其厚，因此更爱迎头冲撞。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME use their hardened chrysalises both to protect themselves and as weapons. The shells of their chrysalises are especially thick at the tops of their skulls, leading them to prefer ramming head-first as an attack.

entry: POKENAME硬壳覆盖全身，背上的灌木会引来虫属性宝可梦。它经常打盹，为进化节省能量。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME's tough shell covers its whole body. The shrubbery on its back attracts Bug-type Pokémon, so it naps often to save energy for evolution.

entry: 硬壳因内热微微发亮，暗示内部正在变化。越近进化，甲壳细缝就越会喷出热气。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its hardened shell glows faintly with inner heat, hinting at a transformation within. Tiny cracks in its armor release puffs of hot air as it nears evolution.

entry: 结茧的身体无法攻击，只能飞离危险自保。可带着沉重身体飞行的消耗，也会延缓进化。
author: sk372
source: Since its cocooned body has no means of attack, its only defense is to fly away from danger. The exertion from flying its heavier body around delays its evolution process.

entry: POKENAME四处找遗落硬币吃。大量吃硬币似乎能稍加快进化，原因科学界仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scrounges around for discarded coins to consume. Science isn't yet sure how, but eating large amounts of coins seems to expedite its evolution process slightly.

entry: POKENAME甲壳没有痛觉受器，常察觉不到自己挨打。代谢极慢，一天只吃一颗树果。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace has no pain receptors, so it will often not notice that it is being attacked. Their metabolism is very slow, only having to eat a single berry a day.

entry: POKENAME最初被认为是生活在3亿年前的太阳珊瑚祖先。然而，最近的重新研究表明，POKENAME是一种寄生宝可梦，会住进由太阳珊瑚脱落的外壳拼成的壳中。
author: lunacharlotte
source: POKENAME was originally believed to be an ancient ancestor of Corsola dating back 300 million years. However, recent re-evaluation suggests that POKENAME was a parasitic species that would live inside shells constructed from discarded Corsola shells.

entry: POKENAME行动尴尬：巨镰拖累飞行，轻翼又怕沾水。于是贴水跳跃，用双臂划水，同时保持翅膀干燥以便起飞。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME is awkward; its heavy scythes hinder flight, and its airy wings clog in water. It adapts by skimming the surface in hops, swimming with its arms while keeping its wings dry to fly.

entry: POKENAME或训练家受袭时，会先以念力定住攻击者，再用利刃扫过警告，之后才放开。很少有敌人敢无视这份威胁。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME or its Trainer is attacked, it immobilizes the assailant with telekinesis before raking its sharp blades across them as a warning before it releases them. Very few aggressors choose to ignore this threat.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的毒镰了结猎物。高速滚动时会收起刀刃，只在狩猎或战斗时展开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has sharp, poison-soaked scythes that it uses to finish off its prey. When it rolls at high speeds it gathers its blades, and it only draws them out when hunting or battling other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，领地意识极强，用坚石般的镰刀毒伤敌人。由山路上找到的化石复活而来。
author: fiordaliso
source: This Pokémon has a very aggressive temperament and is extremely territorial. It uses its stone-hard scythes to poison and attack its enemies. POKENAME was revived from a fossil recovered on a mountain path.

entry: 庞大的身体拥有许多猎食武器：巨颚能咬碎岩石，双臂则是剃刀般的镰刀，使它成为远古最可怕的宝可梦之一。
author: fiordaliso
source: This gigantic Pokémon has many weapons at its disposal for hunting. It has huge jaws capable of shattering even rock, and it has razor-sharp scythes in place of arms, which have made it one of the most fearsome Pokémon in ancient times.

entry: POKENAME嘴部末端柔软灵敏，用来探知身边。一瞬间就能从壳中展开，狠狠咬住察觉到的威胁。
author: bobosmith01
source: The tips of its mouth are soft and sensitive, and they are used to feel POKENAME's immediate area. They can uncurl from their shell and chomp down on any perceived threat in a fraction of a second.

entry: 手中的琥珀块蕴含远古能量。紧紧握住，便会释放巨大磁力。
author: .izik
source: The chunks of amber that it holds are filled with an ancient energy. When gripping them tightly, it lets loose huge amounts of magnetic force.

entry: POKENAME力量与体形惊人，能轻松吓住猎物并吞下。若它远古就存在，真不知还有什么宝可梦能与之共存。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's terrifying strength and size allows it to easily intimidate prey and gobble them up. If this fusion existed in the past, it is not known what other Pokémon could have coexisted alongside it.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，飞行速度却能媲美如今的烈咬陆鲨。加上出众的狩猎能力，被称为“空中歼灭者”。
author: Patch
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME could fly at speeds that could rival modern Garchomp. This, coupled with its impressive hunting abilities, has earned it the nickname 'The Aerial Annihilator'.

entry: POKENAME静坐如雕像，等猎物靠近，从不追赶。闲暇时喜欢玩自己觉得漂亮的石头。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME sit perfectly still like statues, letting their prey get close to them instead of pursuing them. In their idle time they like to play with rocks they find pretty.

entry: POKENAME会定下明确目标与奖励，提升训练效果。比如将五十块巨石干净劈半后，才准自己吃一大份营养树果点心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sets distinct goals and rewards for itself to maximize training. For instance, it will grant itself a large snack full of nutritious Berries only once it has broken fifty boulders clean in two.

entry: POKENAME似乎懂得吃好、练足、睡饱才能健康，天生就会规律做到这三件事，因此深受职业运动员喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME seems to already know that eating a good meal, doing vigorous exercise and sleeping well will lead to a healthy body, and will do all three naturally in a steady routine. For that reason, it is beloved by pro athletes.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在睡觉，以身体不断涌出的毒气当作床铺。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME spends the majority of its time sleeping; it uses the constant stream of poisonous gas emitted from its body as a resting place.

entry: POKENAME单纯温和，平时只顾吃草睡觉。可谁吵醒它，就会带着起床气愤怒冲向对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simple and placid personality, spending most of its time grazing and sleeping. Waking it up from a nap, however, will make it charge at the culprit in a grumpy rage.

entry: POKENAME堪称肉食烹饪的美食家，能用火息将肉烤得恰到好处。火候若不对，就会气愤暴怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a gourmand when it comes to cooking meats, using flame-breath to roast meals to perfection. Improperly heating a meal will send it into an indignant rage.

entry: POKENAME平和嗜睡，温暖舒适的身体能安抚周围。受威胁时，会放出阵阵热浪自卫。
author: habibiluigi
source: POKENAME has a calm, sleepy demeanor and a warm, comfy body that soothes those nearby. When threatened, it releases bursts of heat to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME平日总以圆滚滚的身材为傲，可每隔七天，却会把自己压得扁扁的，演一出它独爱的冷笑话。
author: _sadfroggy
source: POKENAME usually prides itself on its roundness. Once every seven days, however, it flattens itself in a display of a particular kind of humor it enjoys.

entry: 任何东西一靠近就舔，连睡觉时也不例外。研究发现，它的梦里全是食物。
author: Staghorn
source: It licks anything that comes close to it, even when asleep. Studies have found that it dreams exclusively about food.

entry: 看似懒惰，却受家人尊敬。孩子遇险时，会展现出两种融合原型都从未有过的凶悍。
author: MieCreates
source: It appears lazy but is respected by its family. When its children are endangered, it displays levels of aggression never reached by its components.

entry: 据说亡者前往来世前，POKENAME会载其去不知名之处，共享最后的盛宴。吃完一切后，再引往永恒的归宿。
author: Beatdoof
source: It is said that before one departs to the afterlife, POKENAME will carry the deceased to an unknown place where they will share their final feast. POKENAME will then guide them to their eternal home after they've eaten everything.

entry: 若肯出手，攻击也总漫不经心、毫无章法。可弯折的剑刃威力凶狠，只需命中一次就够了。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its attacks, if it bothers to fight at all, are careless and sloppy. One successful hit is all it needs, though, as its zigzagging blade delivers a nasty blow.

entry: 隔着物体也能发现食物，零食根本藏不住。训练家得费心清理它鬃毛中的食物碎屑。
author: nelluc27
source: It's able to spot anything edible behind objects, making it hard to hide snacks from it. Trainers must work to help keep its mane clean of food debris.

entry: 与卡拉多激战后筋疲力尽，POKENAME在深海休息，背上成了其他宝可梦的床铺。
author: slowforest
source: Exhausted from epic battles with Snordon, POKENAME rests in the ocean depths, providing a bed for other Pokémon on its back.

entry: 找到什么都吃，不知为何一顿能吃下自身体重许多倍。POKENAME若被打断，反击的力量足以推倒树木。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It feasts on any food it finds, somehow consuming many times its body weight in a single sitting. If interrupted, POKENAME lashes out with enough power to topple trees.

entry: 只有惊人的力量能与食欲匹敌。沿途吃光一切留下的破坏痕迹，便是追踪POKENAME的线索。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Its voracious appetite is matched only by its awe-inspiring strength. POKENAME can be tracked by the trail of destruction it leaves as it eats everything in its path.

entry: 由于蘑菇不断吸取能量，POKENAME吃得比普通卡比兽还多。POKENAME以文柚果为食，连蘑菇的外形也逐渐变得像文柚果。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Thanks to the mushroom draining its energy, POKENAME eats even more than a regular Snorlax. Because of POKENAME's diet of Sitrus Berries, the mushroom has changed to resemble one.

entry: POKENAME每天睡18小时，醒来便全力找吃的，满足巨胃。强大超能力催动代谢，让它吃再多也不会胖。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day, but when it is awake, all efforts focuse on finding food for its huge appetite. Due to the abundant psychic powers supercharging its metabolism, this Pokémon can eat as much food as it wants and never gain weight.

entry: POKENAME两个头轮流睡，却常双双睡过头，错过大半天。醒来又晚又饿，只好奔走寻找树果与昆虫。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME have two heads that take turns sleeping, but they both oversleep and end up missing most of the day. They often wake up late and starving, and will then run about foraging for berries and insects.

entry: POKENAME施展超能力时，宝石般的核心会放出壮丽极光，能随心控冰。曾保护北极海域的水手，因此被称为“北极星宝石”或“北极星之珠”。
author: Alkazamis
source: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, a magnificent aurora emanates from its gemlike core. It controls ice at will. It has been known to protect sailors in arctic waters, so it is sometimes called the 'North Star Gem' or the 'Jewel of Polaris'.

entry: POKENAME罕见，遇到的人常感到恐惧。向别人描述时，会说它是“美丽的野兽”，长尾摆个不停。
author: 1bridgeyboo
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "beautiful beast," with a long tail that never stops waving.

entry: POKENAME罕见，遇到的人常感到恐惧。向别人描述时，会说它是“令人失望却很漂亮的野兽”，尾巴短得出奇。
author: 1bridgeyboo
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "disappointing but pretty beast," with a surprisingly short tail.

entry: POKENAME羽毛储电多得难以想象。身体轻轻擦过，连最强健的宝可梦也会麻痹。
author: Ayner
source: The feathers of POKENAME can store an unfathomable amounts of electricity. A simple graze of their body can paralyze even the sturdiest of Pokémon.

entry: 据说POKENAME会迎头冲进插座，融入电流，迅速穿过城市，便于伏击对手。
author: DoodleDoo
source: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.

entry: 据说POKENAME是传说中的战士，伴着猛烈雷暴现身。炽烈电流流遍身体，以电光般速度出击，让敌人灼伤、麻痹。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: A Pokémon said to be a legendary warrior, appearing alongside raging thunderstorms. POKENAME channels fiery electricity through its body, unleashing electrified blows at blazing speed. Its strikes leave foes scorched and paralyzed.

entry: 据说这种传说宝可梦会在雷云中优雅起舞，再伴着雷电猛扑而下。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: This legendary Pokémon is said to dance elegantly amongst thunderclouds, with the ability to pounce down among bolts of lightning.

entry: 训练家将POKENAME抛向星夜，它便如流星般飞行。抛得越远，就越听训练家的话。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If POKENAME's trainer throws it into a starry night sky, POKENAME will fly similar to a shooting star. The further POKENAME is thrown, the more POKENAME will listen to its trainer.

entry: POKENAME无论何处都能生火，连水下也不例外。偏爱栖息在人迹罕至的高处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME produces flames anywhere, even underwater. It prefers to perch high in reclusive places, untouched from human life.

entry: POKENAME周身的强大元素能量，让它永远燃烧。高热又会释放有毒物质。
author: .realthree
source: The sheer elemental energy that pervades POKENAME causes it to combust eternally. The intense heat releases toxic compounds.

entry: 用尾巴紧卷沉没的宝物，据为己有，藏在水下巢穴里。
author: .izik
source: It curls its tail tightly around sunken treasures, claiming them as its own. These treasures often remain hidden in its underwater lair.

entry: 用角吸收雷电，身体便在深水中明亮发光，帮助辨路，也能吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs lightning through its horn, making its body glow brilliantly in deep waters. This luminous effect helps it navigate and ward off predators.

entry: 鼻内有浮力气体，让它睡时浮在水面。鼻子露在外，即使休息，也能嗅出空中捕食者正靠近。
author: .izik
source: Its nose contains a buoyant gas, causing it to float above the water while it sleeps. With its nose exposed it can smell airborne predators approaching even while resting.

entry: 许多文化认为，一生能见到POKENAME就是神赐的祝福，往后会有好运。两颗头总协调行动，绝不朝相反方向走。
author: FaeFlame
source: Many cultures believe that to see a POKENAME in one's lifetime is a divine blessing and will lead to good fortune. The two heads tend to move in harmony with each other, never moving in opposing directions.

entry: POKENAME毛质极为奢华，深受上流训练家追捧，却也因此几乎被猎杀殆尽。
author: Mistymagius
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon by high-class Trainers, POKENAME's fur is among the most luxurious. However, this has led to it being hunted to near extinction.

entry: 咬敌人时有时会掉牙。猎人曾用这些牙齿制箭，因为它们锋利又极为耐用。
author: .izik
source: Its teeth sometimes fall out when biting an opponent, and these were once used by hunters to craft arrows. The teeth are sharp and incredibly durable.

entry: 长寿的POKENAME不断脱毛、蜕鳞。据说制成首饰后，能让人免遭厄运。
author: bee4082
source: The long-lived POKENAME is constantly shedding both fur and scales. When made into jewelry, these sheddings are said to provide protection from bad luck.

entry: 吸收的月光越多，毛色越淡，闪烁得也越美。晴朗月夜里，这种变化尤其明显。
author: .izik
source: The more moonlight it absorbs, the paler its fur becomes, shimmering beautifully. This transformation is especially visible on clear, moonlit nights.

entry: 头两侧的褶边能隔空控沙，将敌人困在地里，先取得优势再攻击。
author: .izik
source: The frills on either side of its head can remotely manipulate sand. This ability traps foes in the ground, giving it the advantage before striking.

entry: POKENAME鼻子容易变热、变干，偶尔会浸进水里降温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose is prone to becoming warm and dry. To cool down, it occasionally dips its nose into water.

entry: POKENAME会定期蜕皮，保持外表光亮。研究人员发现，它们一年约蜕皮200次，让皮肤始终光滑、健康。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME shed their skin regularly to maintain a glossy appearance. Researchers discovered they shed about 200 times a year, ensuring their skin stays smooth and healthy.

entry: POKENAME头顶珍珠在风暴前会明亮闪烁，预告天气变化。古代水手将它视为天然气压计，保障航行安全。
author: .izik
source: The pearl on POKENAME's head shimmers brightly before storms, warning of incoming weather changes. Ancient sailors used it as a natural barometer for safe navigation.

entry: 住在人迹未扰的荒野湖底，梦想长出翅膀，飞上水面。
author: cait_sith
source: It lives on the bottom of lakes in untouched wilderness. It dreams of gaining wings and soaring above the water's surface.

entry: 振翅时，尾巴会有节奏地摆动。闻见喜欢的东西，鼻子就明显泛粉红。
author: .izik
source: As it flaps its wings, its tail waves back and forth rhythmically. When it smells something it likes, its nose turns a noticeable shade of pink.

entry: 双翼收在身下，便能优雅漂在水上。平静湖面的安详姿态，让人心绪平和。
author: .izik
source: It tucks its wings beneath its body, allowing it to float gracefully on the water. This serene position makes it a peaceful sight on calm lakes.

entry: POKENAME分泌的液体可制成多种麻醉剂。它们顽皮爱闹，喜欢用黏液痕迹作画。受惊时，能迅速化成一滩黏液。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME secrete a fluid that is used for various anesthetics. They are playful and cheeky creatures and enjoy making art with their slime trails. If spooked they can quickly turn into a puddle of goo.

entry: 宁静的心灵散出安抚的气息。常现身孤独、需要朋友的人面前，给对方希望。
author: Krune
source: Its serene mind eminates a calming aura. It often shows itself to lonely people in need of a friend to give them hope.

entry: POKENAME大部分岁月都在地下度过，直到强壮得足以进化。若被发现，轻轻松松就能迅速钻走。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives underground until they get strong enough to evolve. If it is seen, it can quickly and effortlessly burrow away.

entry: 头痛加剧时，后脑的鳍会涌动超能力，在空气中荡起涟漪，显露愈发难忍的痛苦。
author: .izik
source: When its headache worsens, the fin on the back of its head pulses with psychic energy. This creates ripples in the air, signaling its growing distress.

entry: 用尾巴收集湖底杂草，整理环境。草常被拿来筑成水下巢穴的一部分。
author: .izik
source: It uses its tail to gather weeds from the lake floor, tidying its environment. These weeds often become a part of its underwater nest.

entry: POKENAME轻松就能解出复杂数学方程。古代账房曾依靠它们，确保账目准确。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can perform complex mathematical equations effortlessly. Ancient bookkeepers once relied on them to ensure their tallies were accurate.

entry: 尾端滴下的液体甜得惊人，渔夫常用来引诱水生宝可梦。只需几滴，就能引起注意。
author: .izik
source: The fluid dripping from its tail is incredibly sweet, often used by fishermen to lure aquatic Pokémon. Just a few drops are enough to attract attention.

entry: 仍在幼体阶段，龙之能量却已爆发，催生罕见形态。身体太弱，承受不了自己的力量。
author: Dusknoir64
source: While still in a larval state, it's draconic energy has flared up, causing a rare form to emerge. It's body is too weak to handle it's own power.

entry: 占卜师珍视腹部的宝石，声称能看出一整年的天气。许多人相信，宝石光芒会随预示的季节变化。
author: .izik
source: The gem on its belly is prized by fortune tellers, who claim it can reveal an entire year's weather patterns. Many believe its glow changes with seasonal forecasts.

entry: POKENAME游动时能制造巨大漩涡，困住猎物或阻止捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates massive whirlpools while swimming. These swirling maelstroms are used to trap prey or deter predators.

entry: POKENAME轻松攀过险峻瀑布，优美跳跃既令人入迷，也彰显力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ascends dangerous waterfalls with ease. Its graceful leaps mesmerize onlookers and demonstrate its strength.

entry: 能短途飞行，便于攀越瀑布或寻找新水源。这份罕见本领，让它十分善于旅行。
author: .izik
source: It can fly short distances, which is helpful for scaling waterfalls or finding new water sources. This rare ability makes it a powerful traveler.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴中，清静休息。闪耀的身体能照亮最黑暗的深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in underwater caves, where it rests undisturbed. Its shimmering presence illuminates the darkest depths.

entry: 暴风雪将至时，鼻子就会变得冰冷，为附近的对象提供可靠警告。
author: .izik
source: Its nose turns ice cold whenever a blizzard is approaching. This change provides a reliable warning to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME优雅的动作能引发巨大龙卷风。强烈风暴一旦释放，足以夷平整片森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates massive twisters with its elegant movements. These powerful storms can level entire forests when unleashed.

entry: 小群POKENAME藏在远离人类的云间。受惊时，白毛转灰，再以强雷电击周围一切。
author: Mistymagius
source: Small groups of POKENAME hide amongst the clouds far from human contact. If startled, their white wool turns grey, and they shock everything nearby with a powerful thunderbolt.

entry: 光滑的晶体体节据说蕴含强大魔力。人们由此推测，POKENAME虽身大体重、翅膀小，仍能飞行。
author: sk372
source: The smooth crystal segments are said to contain a potent magical force. This is theorized to explain how POKENAME can fly through the air despite the size and weight of its body compared to its wings.

entry: 蜕皮常被用作住宅保温材料，既耐用，又能节省能源。
author: .izik
source: The skin it sheds is often used as an ingredient in home insulation. This repurposed material is both durable and energy-efficient.

entry: 先用巨臂紧紧抓住敌人，再释放猛烈的破坏光线。威力毁灭性，几乎没有逃脱机会。
author: .izik
source: It tightly grips an enemy with its large arms before unleashing a fierce Hyper Beam. This move is devastating and leaves little chance for escape.

entry: 巨大飓风将至时，角会发出深蓝光，向懂得这信号的对象预告危险。
author: .izik
source: Its horn glows a dark blue when a large hurricane is nearing. This eerie light signals impending danger to those who understand it.

entry: 以温柔的拥抱环绕世界，让每片土地都有最适宜的天气。在许多地区，孩子们常拥抱POKENAME的巨大鳞片，而每一份爱意它都感受得到。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: This Pokémon wraps around the world in a comforting hug, ensuring that every stretch of land has weather that suits its needs perfectly. It's a common sight in most regions for children to hug POKENAME's huge scales, and it feels every act of love.

entry: POKENAME战斗时交替用尾巴和伸缩手臂，让敌人难以防备。难取胜时，还会踢腿、头槌，全身都成了危险武器。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME likes to switch between using its tail and retractable arms when fighting enemies, to throw them off guard. If it has a hard time winning, it will also try kicking and headbutting, making its entire body dangerous.

entry: 体内蕴含可怕能量，必须每天保持平静，以免灾难性爆炸。严于律己的性情让力量得到控制。
author: .izik
source: Terrible energy resides within its body, so it must remain calm each day to avoid catastrophic explosions. Its disciplined nature keeps this power under control.

entry: 沿脊背排列的宝石，会随着所用招式的属性，亮起不同颜色。绚丽的光彩，既美丽，也令人畏惧。
author: .izik
source: The gems along its spine glow in different colors, changing based on the type of attack it uses. This vibrant display is both beautiful and intimidating.

entry: POKENAME比外表看着快得多。多年来，许多邮政机构都请它跨地区送信。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME is a very fast Pokémon. Throughout the years, POKENAME have been used by many postal systems to deliver letters across regions.

entry: 雷雨将近时，头上的小翼就会发抖。对风暴的敏感，帮助它及时找到庇护处。
author: .izik
source: The small wings on its head begin to shudder when a thunderstorm is on the way. This sensitivity to storms helps it find shelter in time.

entry: 腹部蓝水晶能射出强劲能量光束，既耀眼又危险。
author: .izik
source: The blue crystal on its belly can emit powerful energy beams. These bursts of energy are both dazzling and dangerous to behold.

entry: 头痛严重时，会不自觉召来暴雨。这往往能冷却头脑，缓解痛苦。
author: .izik
source: When its headache becomes severe, it unintentionally summons a rainstorm. This phenomenon often cools its mind, bringing relief.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾守望远古沼泽，以神秘烟雾围住珍视的一切。平时温和，可谁未经邀请闯入烟雾，就会被毒素淹没。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have kept watch over an ancient swamp, POKENAME protects anything precious to it by surrounding it in enigmatic smog. While POKENAME is normally peaceful, anyone that tries to enter the smog uninvited will find themselves flooded with toxins.

entry: POKENAME特殊的鳍让它几秒便能游过5000多米。会用这速度追捕猎物、赶走竞争者。
author: KitArchen
source: Using specialized fins, POKENAME are able to swim over 5000 meters in mere seconds. They use this speed to hunt down prey and chase off competitors.

entry: 力量无可匹敌，能轻松溯溪。还会鼓励同伴训练，直到也能做到。
author: cheroace
source: It can effortlessly swim up streams with peerless strength. It encourages its brethren to train until they can do the same.

entry: POKENAME只需16小时就能绕海洋一圈。跃出水面的速度极快，看起来像在飞。
author: Ced Lasso
source: POKENAME can circle the oceans in just 16 hours. It is capable of launching out of the water at such speeds that it appears to fly.

entry: POKENAME水下速度极快，传说颈部球体能操纵洋流。古时渔夫会向海献礼，盼它平复波涛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves so fast underwater that, in legends, the orb on its neck was able to control the currents. In the past, fishers would give an offering to the sea, in hopes of POKENAME calming the waters.

entry: POKENAME天生想助人，却又胆怯，常常内心挣扎。不过真有人需要帮助时，它一定会竭尽所能。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME constantly struggle with their innate desire to help others and their timid nature. However, when someone truly is in need of assistance, POKENAME will be there to do anything they can.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的花纹描绘着一条绿色蛇形龙。龙所做的事似乎每天都变，谁也不知道原理。
author: SonTyp
source: The skin of POKENAME shows markings depicting a green, serpentine dragon. What that dragon does seems to change daily, but nobody knows how this happens.

entry: POKENAME是全球货运与送信的重要伙伴。尾巴最多能承载自身体重的一半，几小时便能飞过不同地区。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are essential for shipping goods and delivering letters worldwide. They can carry up to half their body weight in their tails and fly between regions within a few hours.

entry: POKENAME的超能力凝成了颈间水晶，它会借水晶强化龙类本能。
author: PhoenixFTW
source: POKENAME's psychic powers have manifested into the form of the crystal it wears around its neck, which POKENAME uses to amplify its draconic impulses.

entry: POKENAME守护神社与寺庙，赶走自认不配进入的对象。传说若得到它认可，就会获得力量与繁荣。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects shrines and temples and will chase anyone it deems unworthy. Stories say that if it does deem you worthy, it will bring you strength and prosperity.

entry: 据说POKENAME由奉快龙为守护神的文明创造。手臂射出毁灭性的破坏光线时，还能听见龙吼。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME was created by a civilization that worshiped Dragonite as protector gods. When it fires a destructive Hyper Beam from its arm, the dragon's roar can be heard.

entry: 这种宝可梦睿智又善良，僧侣常来求问生命的意义。曾被目击保护孩子与弱者。
author: Krune
source: This very wise and very kind Pokémon is often visited by monks in search of the meaning of life. It has been seen defending children and the weak.

entry: 为无法自卫的对象而战。无论敌人是谁，只要尾焰未熄，就绝不放弃。
author: WeirdIsNormal
source: This Pokémon fights for those that cannot defend themselves. No matter the opponent, it will never give up until the flame on its tail dies out.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，常躲在树后避开训练家。不过，手上的毒刺依旧危险。
author: Schierke
source: POKENAME is a very shy fusion; it tends to hide behind trees to avoid Trainers. The stingers on its hands pose a dangerous threat.

entry: 它酿出的蜜，被用在丰缘的许多甜点里。圣花号邮轮上的一家餐厅，也会把它加进樱子果纸杯蛋糕。
author: .izik
source: The honey that it cultivates is used in many different desserts within the Hoenn region. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower uses it in their Cheri Berry Cupcakes.

entry: 生气时，眼睛泛出深红光。POKENAME追逐猎物时，嘴里会发出巨大的嗡鸣。
author: .izik
source: When angered, its eyes will glow a deep red. POKENAME makes a loud buzzing noise from its mouth as it chases down its prey.

entry: POKENAME的舌头化为毒刺，挡住大部分嘴巴。缝隙只够让水流出，若两周内还没进化，就会饿死。
author: Walter Teigan
source: POKENAME's tongue has become a stinger, blocking most of its mouth. There is sufficient space for water to escape, but if POKENAME has not evolved within two weeks, it will starve to death.

entry: POKENAME兼具大针蜂的领地意识与龙属性的凶猛，十分可怕。敢偷走它一朵花的傻瓜，很少能活着回来。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME combines the territorial behavior of a Beedrill and the ferocity of a Dragon-type into one terrifying entity. Fools that dare steal a flower from POKENAME rarely live to tell the tale.

entry: POKENAME会不惜一切守住空树干里的蜂巢。毒素极为猛烈，若被五根毒刺全部刺中又未治疗，几乎必死。
author: sautomagically
