source: POKENAME will defend its hive, which is built in hollowed out trees, at all costs. Its stingers contain a devastating poison; being stung by all five is almost certainly lethal if not treated.

entry: 远看似乎甜美无害，可别靠近。POKENAME一动不动，任花瓣滴下的蜜引来野生宝可梦，等猎物发现蜜到底有多黏。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: This giant may look sweet and innocent from a distant but don't get to close. The leaking honey from its petals attracts wild Pokémon to POKENAME as it stands perfectly still, waiting for its prey to learn how sticky the honey really is.

entry: POKENAME能从肩膀放出并操纵滚烫蜂蜜。先用前腿与背部触须制服猎物，再以热蜜灼烧。
author: Walter Teigan
source: POKENAME can release scalding honey from its shoulders and control it. It subdues prey with its front legs and the tendrils emerging from its back before burning the prey with said honey.

entry: 深夜在城都林中听见嗡鸣，别靠近，那可能是守巢的POKENAME。白天吵醒它，同样不是好主意。
author: bobosmith01
source: Do not approach the sound of buzzing in Johtonian woods in the dead of night. It may be POKENAME, guarding their nest. Disturbing one in its sleep during the daytime is also a poor idea.

entry: POKENAME微光下也看得清，飞得快又无声，是完美的夜间猎手。谁靠近领地，就会迅速被围攻，挨上毒针。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Not only can POKENAME see well with minimal light, but it also flies both quickly and silently, making it the perfect nighttime hunter. Anyone who approaches POKENAME's territory will be quickly swarmed and jabbed with poison needles.

entry: 会用毒刺在地上戳洞，标记领地。放出的少量恶臭毒液，每只POKENAME气味都不同。
author: .izik
source: It pokes holes in the ground with its stingers to mark its territory. It expels small amounts of horrible smelling poison that is unique to each POKENAME.

entry: 腿上覆着厚厚的黑毒液，奔跑时一路滴落，毒死附近草木。
author: .izik
source: Its legs are coated in a thick black poison. As it runs it drips poison on the ground behind it, killing any nearby vegetation.

entry: POKENAME身体形似蜂巢，纤细触角能感知空气中的细微变化，预测天气。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's body resembles a honeycomb structure, with delicate antennae sensing the environment. Its antennae pick up on subtle shifts in the air, allowing it to predict the weather.

entry: 靠细细的蜜丝悬挂在树上。蜂蜜带有极轻微的毒性，却不影响人类。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon hangs from trees using thin strands of honey. The honey itself contains a very mild toxin, but it does not affect humans.

entry: POKENAME主要靠手上的毒刺，迎击、毒倒敌人，也会拿来凿开蜂巢，让幼崽进出。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME primarily use the stingers on their hands to attack and poison their enemies, but also to dig out openings in their hive for their young.

entry: 看见一只POKENAME，就代表附近一定还有数十只。必要时，会为整个蜂群牺牲自己。
author: sautomagically
source: Be warned: when one POKENAME is spotted, dozens more are certainly nearby. If needed, it will sacrifice itself for the sake of its swarm.

entry: 比起其他植物，更偏爱玫瑰与雏菊。毒刺中的强毒会导致视线模糊与高烧。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to eat roses and daisies over all other plants. Its stinger holds a powerful toxin that causes blurred vision and high fevers.

entry: 先以腹部花纹定住猎物的注意，再用刺中毒液将其彻底麻痹。毒虽有害，蜕皮却有许多珍贵药效。
author: sautomagically
source: It transfixes prey with its patterned belly before fully paralyzing its victim with the venom in its barbs. Although its poison is harmful, its shed skin has many valuable medicinal properties.

entry: 刺尾上的花以甜香引来猎物。花若枯萎或变臭，就意味着生病或重伤。
author: kittyluv090
source: It beckons prey with the sweet aroma from the flowers on its spiky tail. If the flowers wilt or have a more repulsive smell, it's a sign of illness or severe injury.

entry: POKENAME是蜂群首领，危急到最后才会出手护群。超能力化出的毒刺能远攻，注入摧毁心智的毒素，不到15秒就让敌人倒下。
author: Walter Teigan
source: The leader of its hive, POKENAME comes to the defense of the group as a last resort. Its psychically-conjured stingers attack at a range and inject a psyche-destroying toxin. The foe collapses in less than 15 seconds.

entry: 双翼从不扇动，静贴背上。靠未知力量浮空，让周围空气泛起涟漪。
author: .izik
source: Its wings never flap and stay on its back, unmoving. It uses an unknown power to float in the air, causing the air around it to ripple.

entry: POKENAME配合得天衣无缝，将蜂巢与废金属编成大巢。毒液会奇异地影响受害者心智，引发轻微幻觉。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME work in prefect sync with each other, weaving honeycomb and scrap metal into their large hive. Their venom as an odd effect on the victims' mind, causing mild hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME一认定蜂巢受威胁，就会以快得看不清的毒刺压制敌人。头顶分泌的蜜却美味健康——前提是采蜜后还能活下来。
author: Frink202
source: Once a POKENAME considers its hive under threat, it overwhelms its opponent with blindingly fast poison stabs. However, the honey POKENAME excretes out of its head is a delicacy and very healthy - should one survive harvesting it.

entry: POKENAME在森林里搜集蜂巢，拿蜂蜜泡澡。常引来蜂宝可梦报复，但对方通常又被它的巨大体形吓走。
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest, gathering beehives in order to bathe in their honey. It often gets attacked by bee Pokémon in retaliation, but they usually flee due to POKENAME's enormous size.

entry: POKENAME背部绒毛浸满甜蜜花浆。小型宝可梦不慎黏住，它却可能完全没察觉。
author: Mistymagius
source: The fluff on POKENAME's back is soaked in sweet nectar. Smaller Pokémon can accidentally get stuck in the fluff without POKENAME noticing.

entry: 产出的蜂蜜蛋白质极高，健美选手会将其加入补剂，增加肌肉。
author: .izik
source: It cultivates honey that is extremely high in protein. Bodybuilders use this ingredient in supplements to increase their muscle mass.

entry: 先用火息烤树果，再用利刺串起。最爱吃从精心守护的蜂巢中采来的蜜汁水果。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon roasts berries with its fiery breath before skewering them on its sharp stingers. Its favorite treat is honey-glazed fruit, which it gathers from hives it carefully guards.

entry: 毒刺沉重，久飞很不舒服。会翻身露背，向蜂群首领表示敬意。
author: .izik
source: Its stinger is extremely heavy, making it uncomfortable to fly for long periods. It will roll on its back to show respect to the leader of its swarm.

entry: 成群POKENAME会用身体搭成巢。捕食者一靠近，整巢便一同滚走。
author: .izik
source: A swarm of POKENAME will gather to form a nest out of their own bodies. Should the nest be approached by a predator, they will roll away in unison.

entry: POKENAME极力保护蜂巢，用坚硬的球状身体，在巢外组成六角形墙。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its hive, using its hard, spherical body to form hexagonal walls around the hive.

entry: POKENAME乐于站在蜂巢顶端欢呼数小时。若边欢呼边旋转，羽毛就会撒下少量结晶蜂蜜。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon will gladly cheer atop its hive for hours. Should POKENAME spin during the cheer, small amounts of crystallized honey will be scattered from its feathers.

entry: 起舞时，毒刺沿圆圈挥动，头冠则散发蜂蜜般的香气。
author: .izik
source: It swings its stingers in circular patterns while dancing. It emits a fragrance that smells like honey from its crown.

entry: POKENAME以蜜特别美味而闻名。可照顾不当，蜂蜜就会变成剧毒。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME are best known for producing exceptionally delicious honey. If they receive improper care, however, their honey will become highly toxic.

entry: POKENAME原本中空的身体，如今成了群聚大针蜂的巢。虽然重达好几吨，翅膀仍能让它飞行。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME's once hollow body is now a hive of swarming Beedrill. Despite weighing over several tons, it's wings still allow it to fly.

entry: 毛绒身体内装满高压蜂蜜，蜜从脚掌渗出，走过便留下痕迹。
author: .izik
source: Its furry body is filled with highly-pressurized honey. The honey leaks from its paws, leaving a trail while it walks.

entry: 身上的蘑菇带着蜜香，煮成茶能缓解胃部反酸不适。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms that grow on its body smell like honey. If boiled, they can create a tea that can help eliminate a sour stomach.

entry: POKENAME袭击其他虫属性宝可梦的巢，夺去首领之位。随后自己睡觉，强迫新手下采蜜。
author: mourge40k
source: POKENAME attacks the hives of other Bug-type Pokémon and usurps their leaders. After taking over a hive, it forces its new underlings to gather honey while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳嗓音号令其他蜂类。它们平时住在它如蜂巢般的毛里，等待召唤。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳嗓音号令其他蜂类。它们平时住在它如蜂巢般的毛里，等待召唤。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳嗓音号令其他蜂类。它们平时住在它如蜂巢般的毛里，等待召唤。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.

entry: POKENAME用灵敏触角发现弱小虫属性宝可梦，再以头顶泡沫胶冻的香气引来。也靠触角察觉捕食者，避免把它们吸引来。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME use their sensitive antennae to detect weaker Bug-types, luring them with the scents from the foamy jelly on the head. POKENAME also use these antennae to detect predators and avoid attracting them.

entry: 融合让POKENAME能承受背上蘑菇的影响，双方如今共生。蘑菇提供额外储物空间，收取一小份花蜜作为回报。
author: Walter Teigan
source: Fusion has given POKENAME the ability to survive the effects of the mushroom on its back, and the two organisms now engage in symbiosis. The mushroom provides additonal storage space, but will consume a small portion of the nectar in exchange.

entry: 这只宝可梦用毒针钻凿山壁。利亚多村有一家面包店，会用它的蜜制作美味的沙鳞果挞。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon uses its stingers to drill into mountain walls. This Pokémon's honey is used by a bakery in Riyado Town that creates delicious Salac Berry Tarts  .

entry: POKENAME猛烈攻击领地内的一切，用强大毒刺贯穿敌人，再吃得不留痕迹。
author: Canada
source: Highly aggressive towards anyone within its territory, POKENAME uses its powerful stinger to pierce foes. It then consumes them, leaving no trace behind.

entry: POKENAME最早在红莲岛被发现。有理论认为，它是制造超梦时失败的克隆遗留物。身体不完整，只能部分模仿原本该有的形态。
author: sk372
source: First discovered on Cinnabar Island, POKENAME is theorized to be left over from failed cloning attempts during Mewtwo's creation. Being incomplete, it can only partially mimic the form of the being it was supposed to be.

entry: 传闻POKENAME是超梦复制失败的产物，但证据不足。碰到身体，似乎还会被吸走智力。
author: Mistymagius
source: There have been many rumors about POKENAME being a failed replication of Mewtwo but there is not enough evidence to prove this theory. Touching its body seems to drain its victims of their intelligence.

entry: POKENAME经设计与基因改造，以成为完美宝可梦为目标。手臂能化成炮，贯穿最坚硬的钢铁。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME was engineered and genetically altered to create the perfect Pokémon. It can turn its arm into a cannon able to penetrate the hardest steel.

entry: 一群不受约束的遗传学家，将克雷色利亚羽毛样本与制造超梦的实验室研究结合，造出POKENAME。可它强大过头，连疯狂的创造者也控制不了。
author: entomoxie
source: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.

entry: 一群不受约束的遗传学家，将克雷色利亚羽毛样本与制造超梦的实验室研究结合，造出POKENAME。可它强大过头，连疯狂的创造者也控制不了。
author: entomoxie
source: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.

entry: 观察者称POKENAME异常残忍，常欺凌弱小。控水本领少有敌手，轻松就能抬起整条河。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME has been described as unusually cruel by observers, seen bullying weaker Pokémon. POKENAME's hydrokinetic powers are matched by few, able to lift entire rivers with ease.

entry: POKENAME看着像呆呆兽，心智却截然相反，聪明又狡猾。会靠智慧与不起眼的外表，操纵其他宝可梦听命行事。
author: sk372
source: Visually very similar to Slowpoke, mentally POKENAME is its complete opposite, intelligent and scheming. It uses this intellect and unassuming form to take advantage and manipulate other Pokémon to do its bidding.

entry: 梦幻常突然抓住POKENAME的尾巴啃咬，捉弄它。POKENAME一生气，愚钝温和的伪装就露了馅，梦幻正借此教训它。
author: sk372
source: Mew often pranks POKENAME by grabbing and nibbling its tail suddenly. POKENAME's angry reaction ruins its ruse as a dim, placid Pokémon, which Mew uses to teach POKENAME a lesson.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME的耳朵和脚都变大了。藤蔓也化成多余的尾巴，可它既不需要，也不用。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon's ears and feet have grown larger after fusion. POKENAME's vines have also morphed into additional tails, which it doesn't need or use.

entry: 梦幻独特的基因让POKENAME在战斗中能将身体的任意部位变成其他宝可梦的相应部位。借助这些奇妙的组合，它能创造出几乎无懈可击的攻防形态。
author: sk372
source: Mew's unique DNA allows POKENAME to change any part of its body into that of any other Pokémon while in combat. These chimeric combinations allow it to create nearly unbeatable offensive and defensive forms.

entry: 它的水晶核心中含有所有已知宝可梦的基因。遗传学家推测，凭借强大的基因操控能力，它能把触碰到的宝可梦变成其他形态。
author: sk372
source: Its crystal core contains the DNA of every known Pokémon. Geneticists theorize that it can transform any Pokémon it touches into any other form, using its vast DNA manipulation skill.

entry: 当这只融合宝可梦以特定方式绷紧下颌与肌肉时，平时柔软的皮肤会变得比碳化钨还硬。许多孩子都喜欢模仿它那独特的表情。
author: epping_forest
source: When this fusion tenses its jaws and muscles in a very specific way, its usually soft skin becomes harder than tungsten carbide. Lots of kids have fun imitating its particular expression.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，每500年才落到地表一次。喜爱玩小石子与陨石碎片。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely rare sights and only fall to the surface every 500 years. They love to play with small stones and meteorite fragments.

entry: 梦幻与大钳蟹融合成POKENAME后，基因组分析表明，它的遗传物质比许多融合宝可梦更加稳定。少数科学家因此推测，万物最终或许都会进化成螃蟹。
author: epping_forest
source: When Mew and Krabby fused to form POKENAME, analysis of its genome suggested its DNA was more stable than many other fusions. This conclusion led a few scientists to theorize that everything may eventually evolve into a crab.

entry: POKENAME转动大叶片当螺旋桨，帮助悬浮。向下的风也会把臭气吹向植物，为其施肥。
author: reese1017600
source: POKENAME spins its big leaf as a propeller helping it levitate. The downward wind blows its foul-smelling gas down to fertilize plants.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地在海草间漂流，却显得分外满足。遇到需要帮助的宝可梦，便尽己所能相助。
author: leonian1586
source: Drifting aimlessly among seaweed, POKENAME seems strangely content. It does what little it can to help any Pokémon in need it encounters.

entry: POKENAME爱晒太阳，性情又出奇温柔。待在它身旁，心情便会安定下来，不少人找它作伴解压，也能安安稳稳睡个午觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.

entry: POKENAME爱晒太阳，性情又出奇温柔。待在它身旁，心情便会安定下来，不少人找它作伴解压，也能安安稳稳睡个午觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.

entry: POKENAME爱晒太阳，性情又出奇温柔。待在它身旁，心情便会安定下来，不少人找它作伴解压，也能安安稳稳睡个午觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.

entry: 尾叶储存着所需的全部油脂与油溶性养分。身体吸水，浮叶则吸收阳光。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon stores all of the oils and oil-based nutrients it needs in its tail leaf. Its body absorbs water, while the floating leaf absorbs light.

entry: 释放淡淡香气使别人入睡，再放心偷窃。效果到早晨便会消退，不留痕迹，受害者也想不起经过。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon releases a subtle scent that puts others to sleep, allowing it to steal from them undisturbed. The effect wears off by morning, leaving no trace, and no memory of what occurred.

entry: 散发的香气会让附近对象恐慌。气味久久留在空气中，人类与宝可梦都感到不安。
author: .izik
source: It releases an aroma that triggers a sense of panic in those nearby. The scent lingers in the air, unsettling both Pokémon and people alike.

entry: POKENAME在雷雨中伸出藤蔓，吸收电力储进体内。即使长期无光，也能保持活跃警觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its vines during lightning storms, absorbing electricity to store in its body. This energy keeps it active and alert even during extended periods of darkness.

entry: POKENAME用头上的叶子探索周围。叶子被抓住或捏紧，就会烦躁。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to interact with its surroundings. It becomes agitated if the leaf is grabbed or pinched.

entry: POKENAME常出没于乡村。共感能力让它对农田与荒野都同样悉心照料。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are often found around rural communities. Their empathic powers lead them to tend to farmland and wilderness alike with equal care.

entry: POKENAME带着烤面包般的香气，吸引人类与宝可梦，在森林与田野中令人倍感安心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gives off a scent reminiscent of baked bread, attracting both humans and Pokémon. This aroma makes it a comforting presence in forests and fields.

entry: 吞食腐烂草木，滋养背上的植物。回收腐殖的能力，让它成为生态中重要的一环。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon consumes rotten vegetation, using it to nourish the plants on its back. Its ability to recycle decay makes it a vital part of the ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓末端的刺散发宜人香气，来自阳光与吃下的泥土提供的养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: A pleasant aroma wafts from the barbs on the end of POKENAME's vines. The aroma is a byproduct of the nutrients POKENAME gets from both the sun and the dirt it eats.

entry: POKENAME睡在熔岩池旁，借热量暖身。即使最寒冷的环境，也能保持活跃。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon sleeps near pools of lava, using the heat to keep its body warm. This habit ensures POKENAME stays active even in the coldest environments.

entry: 大人觉得臭，孩子却说像花园的香气，想跟它玩。破布下，油亮的根悄悄挪动。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It stinks to adults, but children describe its aroma as a flower garden that makes them want to play with it. Oily roots shift just beneath its rag.

entry: POKENAME头顶花苞调节体内气压。叶片收紧便能胀成气球，空气也可从花苞排出，带着甜香散开。
author: .realthree
source: The bud on POKENAME's head helps modulate the air pressure inside its body. The leaves can tighten to help POKENAME swell like a balloon, or the air can exit through the bud, carrying a sweet smell as it leaves.

entry: POKENAME虽小，只需得到一点力量就能构成威胁。黑暗处常回荡着它的笑声。
author: Inksans201x
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME can become a threat if given an ounce of power. Its laughter can be heard echoing in dark places.

entry: POKENAME边舞边哼唱有节奏的曲调，吸住观众目光。跳得越久，旁观者越难移开视线。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, this Pokémon hums a rhythmic cadence that captivates any onlookers. The longer POKENAME dances, the more difficult it becomes for those watching to look away.

entry: POKENAME叶片的基因与植物化石相符。科学家推测，叶片温和的香气，比人类历史还古老。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Genetic testing of POKENAME's leaves has revealed matches with fossilized plants. Scientists theorize that the gentle scent released by the leaves is older than human history.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢周围的对象生气，会从叶子释放成分类似薰衣草的香气，让大家平静。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME dislikes when those around it are angry. It releases an aroma from its leaves, similar to the composition of lavender, in order to calm others down.

entry: 喷出的翠绿粉末一接触就让敌人麻痹，容易随空气飘散，是抵御捕食者的天然防线。
author: .izik
source: It expels a verdant powder that paralyzes foes on contact. The powder spreads easily through the air, creating a natural defense against predators.

entry: 据说用POKENAME干叶制成的特殊调料，能让任何一餐都变美味，因此深受名厨追捧。
author: kittyluv090
source: A special seasoning made with dried POKENAME leaves is said to make any meal taste delicious, so it is highly sought after by master chefs.

entry: POKENAME的气味究竟让人安逸还是振奋，训练家看法不一。有人猜测，取决于它的实力强弱。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: Trainers are split on whether POKENAME's scent makes them feel cozy or peppy. Some speculate it depends on how strong the POKENAME is.

entry: POKENAME在花园旋舞，以此冥想。若成群一起跳，花朵就会长得更大、更鲜艳。
author: kittyluv090
source: It twirls and dances around flower gardens as a form of meditation. When groups of POKENAME dance together, the flowers grow bigger and more vibrant.

entry: 盛夏最常见。POKENAME在温暖夜晚起舞，沿途草木繁盛、鲜花开放。据说见它经过，便预示好运。
author: Katie
source: Most commonly encountered at the height of Summer, plants flourish and flowers bloom in the path left behind as POKENAME dances through the warm evenings. Seeing a POKENAME pass by is said to be a portent of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME常被视为夏日使者，振奋的气息让草木与宝可梦都焕发生机。贵族训练家也很珍视它，优雅的外貌能为夏日舞会增添庄重。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are often viewed as heralds of summer, their invigorating auras breathing life into plants and Pokémon alike. They are also highly prized by aristocratic Trainers, their elegant appearances lending a dignified air to summer balls.

entry: POKENAME颈部花苞的辛香能让人振奋，因此常参与山崩救援。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The buds around its neck emit a spicy aroma that acts as a stimulant for humans. POKENAME are often used in rescues during landslides.

entry: POKENAME兼有月桂叶的繁茂绿意与好坏星的水中适应力。住在海岸，用叶状触手捉猎物、吸收阳光获取养分。
author: NightwingJay
source: POKENAME combines the lush greenery of Bayleef with the aquatic adaptability of Mareanie. It dwells in coastal regions, where it uses its leafy tentacles to ensnare prey and absorb sunlight for nourishment.

entry: POKENAME颈叶的辛香能提振精神。为免大家不停凑近闻，它会先缩进壳里，再甩藤蔓、喷水驱赶。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: The spicy aroma of the leaves around POKENAME's neck boosts energy. To avoid being constantly sniffed, POKENAME withdraws into its shell before lashing out with vines and jets of water.

entry: 吃花后转化成甜香气体，让敌人放松，也能让植物以惊人速度生长。
author: Mistymagius
source: It consumes flowers to convert them into a sweet-smelling gas that makes its opponents feel at ease. The gas also helps plants grow at record speed.

entry: POKENAME常独居荒地，吃硬石与矿物时翻动土地，使其适合草木生长。等大地全绿，又会迁往下一片荒地。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.

entry: POKENAME的群体常混着许多其他宝可梦。体大温顺，便于弱小者藏身，花瓣的舒缓香气更让身旁成了最安全的地方。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: POKENAME live in herds that tend to be a large mix of other Pokémon. Their large size but docile nature make them perfect to hide around, and the calming aroma coming from their petals ensures the area around them is the safest place to be.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: Katie
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: Katie
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME若与你共撑一伞，就代表真诚信任。背叛它的人，永远不会得到原谅。
author: kittyluv090
source: If a POKENAME shares its umbrella with you, it's a sign of sincere and genuine trust. It will never forgive those who betray it.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: Katie
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: Katie
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓末端开着绚丽花朵，藤蔓本身却并非全是生物组织。金属在其中盘绕，结构像电线，因此格外坚固。
author: bobosmith01
source: Flowers bloom brilliantly at the end of POKENAME's vines. The vines themselves, however, are only partially organic: metal coils through each of them, their structure akin to wires. This makes the vines surprisingly sturdy.

entry: POKENAME燃烧游魂，以它们的生命力养育背上的花。等花瓣全部落尽，自己才终于能前往来世。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME burns wandering souls using their life force to feed the flower on its back. Once all of the flower petals fall off, POKENAME can finally move on to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME近来作为疗愈宝可梦很受欢迎。淡香、轻柔歌声与温和举止，带来让人安宁的感官体验。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME have recently gained popularity as therapy Pokémon. They provide a calming sensory experience through their light scent, their soft singing, and their gentle demeanor.

entry: POKENAME现身热爱自然的人面前，洒下让植物长得高大强壮的花粉。可花粉症患者却认为它严重危害健康。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in front of nature-lovers, spreading its pollen that allows for plants to grow big and strong. However, people with hay fever consider this Pokémon to be a serious health hazard.

entry: POKENAME花心的甜香诱人，让感官迟钝、脑中一片空白。等察觉不对时已来不及，藤蔓早已开始生长。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: The scent coming from the center of POKENAME's flower is sweet and alluring, dulling the senses, emptying the mind. By the time one realizes what is happening, it is already to late and the vines have already begun to grow.

entry: 被冰冷吐息碰到的枯死植物会复生，却常变化极大。形态与古化石相符，令人推测它们恢复成了史前祖先的样子。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Any dead plants touched by its freezing breath return to life, though often with dramatic changes. Matches with ancient fossils have led to theories that the plants are revived in the form of their prehistoric ancestors.

entry: 宝可梦被POKENAME亲吻后，要么百病痊愈，要么生命力被吸尽，全看它的心情。
author: peachnanas_3435
source: If a Pokémon is kissed by POKENAME, it will be cured of any sickness or have all its vitality drained, depending on POKENAME's mood.

entry: POKENAME花瓣鬃毛锋利如刀，猛烈甩动时，会将花粉洒向周围森林。
author: Mistymagius
source: The petals that make up POKENAME's mane are as sharp as knives. They thrash around violently, spreading around its pollen to the surrounding forest.

entry: 这名树果贼能凭花瓣感知空气振动，提前察觉危险，几乎无法偷袭。每只都有偏爱的树果，不到手绝不罢休。
author: DoxtorDaemon
source: Near impossible to catch by surprise, this berry thief can tell when danger is near by feeling the vibrations in the air through its petals. Each has their preferred berry and will stop at nothing to acquire it.

entry: POKENAME象征长寿，遇到枯死珊瑚便会令其复生。人们认为，这正是太阳珊瑚没有彻底灭绝的重要原因。
author: TeatedTiten
source: A symbol of longevity, POKENAME revives any deceased coral it stumbles upon. It is thought to be a major reason why Corsola have not gone fully extinct.

entry: 古时因壳上发光花纹而被奉为全能守护神。POKENAME在空地睡下，周围就会长出繁盛花园。
author: TeatedTiten
source: In ancient times, this Pokémon was deified as an almighty protector because of the illuminated markings on its shell.  When POKENAME sleeps in empty fields, vibrant gardens grow around it.

entry: POKENAME会在森林火灾后吃掉遗留种子。喷火时又将种子散开，让它们重新生长。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found at the sites of forest fires, eating the leftover seeds. When it expels flames, it scatters the seeds to grow again.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，却用咬表达亲近。快乐充沛时火焰不断蹿起，让大多数训练家很难招架。
author: sk372
source: Despite their cute appearance and friendly nature, POKENAME bite to signify affection. Their flames flare constantly due to their joyful energy, making them a handful for most Trainers.

entry: 振翅会掀起热风，扰乱敌人的方向感。阵阵热浪也让它在空战中占优。
author: .izik
source: When it flaps its wings, it releases bursts of hot air, creating gusts that disorient foes. These waves of heat also give it an advantage in aerial battles.

entry: POKENAME火力不足以支持飞行，只好用火焰翅膀防御。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME does not produce enough flame to fly. Instead, it uses its fiery wings for defense.

entry: POKENAME为遇见它的对象带来暖光。据说能在任何人身上发现爱的人，会看见它闪耀缤纷色彩。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME brings a warming glow to those that encounter it. It is said that POKENAME shimmers in vivid colors before those able to find love in anyone.

entry: 滚动时留下燃烧的路线，灼焦所触一切。这条火路让它在战斗中十分可怕。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, it leaves a burning path in its wake, scorching anything it touches. This blazing trail makes it a formidable foe during battles.

entry: 一哭，火焰便猛烈燃烧，令人难以安慰。这种情绪爆发常让大家不得不远离。
author: .izik
source: Its flames blaze intensely whenever it cries, making it difficult to comfort. This emotional outburst often forces others to keep their distance.

entry: 巢外环绕着旋转火涡，阻挡闯入者。只有最勇敢的宝可梦才敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: A swirling vortex of flames surrounds its den, deterring would-be intruders. Only the bravest Pokémon dare approach its blazing lair.

entry: 浸进池塘就会让水瞬间沸腾，因此在水边与它相伴十分危险。
author: .izik
source: If submerged in a pond, it causes the water to boil instantly. This strange ability makes it a dangerous companion around water.

entry: 住在冷却岩浆形成的岛上，从火山岩获取温暖。无论天气怎样变，都能安然舒适。
author: .izik
source: It resides on islands made of cooled magma, finding warmth in the volcanic rock. This environment ensures it stays comfortable despite any changes in weather.

entry: 吃下辣椒后，它的速度会显著提高。这些火辣的食物，既能助长火焰，也能提升敏捷性。
author: .izik
source: Its speed increases significantly when it consumes spicy peppers. These fiery treats fuel both its flame and its agility.

entry: 将火星注入拳头，打出烈焰重击，每一下都会在目标上留下余火闷燃的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: It channels embers into its punches, delivering fiery blows to opponents. Each strike leaves a smoldering mark on whatever it hits.

entry: POKENAME战斗、兴奋，或打喷嚏时都会冒火，因此不适合骑乘。
author: bobosmith01
source: The flames on POKENAME come out when it is battling, when it is excited, or whenever it sneezes. As a result, it is not considered suitable for riding.

entry: 用超能力精确塑造火焰形状，让火焰攻击难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It controls its flames with psychic powers, shaping them into precise forms. This unique skill makes its fire-based attacks highly unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME主要在夜间活动，食物多样，实物与梦境都吃。狩猎、拾荒时不点火，可幼年个体开心吃饱时，常控制不住火星。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are mainly nocturnal and possess a wide, varied diet of both physical matter and dreams. They hunt and scavenge with their flames unlit, but young POKENAME have trouble controlling their embers when happy and full.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，火翼让身手格外敏捷。会一边尝试短飞，一边继续磨炼火焰。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's powerful legs and flaming wings make it uncommonly nimble. It attempts short flights while further honing its flames.

entry: POKENAME也许仍有实体翅膀，但火焰太热，无法确认。靠猛烈喷火推动自己飞行。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME may still have physical wings, but the heat of their flames makes it impossible to check. They propel themselves with great jets of fire.

entry: POKENAME在石头与树木上磨炼火刃，会留下细窄的焦黑斩痕，这是它在附近活动的明确信号。
author: bee4082
source: A telltale sign of the presence of POKENAME in an area are the thin, burnt slice marks it leaves when training its flaming blades on rocks and trees.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，发怒却极为凶烈。毛中爆发巨焰，焚烧周围，同时以龙类气息掩藏身形。
author: Beatdoof
source: While POKENAME is naturally docile, it has a fierce temper. When its rage is set off, it creates a huge explosive blast from its fur, burning everything around it while camouflaging itself with a draconic aura.

entry: POKENAME来自远古，体内寄宿着一只忠诚宝可梦的亡魂。它曾属于崇拜火焰的古人。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME hails from an ancient time. It contains the ghost of a loyal Pokémon who once belonged to ancient people that worshipped fire.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的眼睛能射出熔穿岩石的热束。体内巨大热量，则通过背焰排出。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its gem-like eyes to create beams of heat hot enough to melt through rock. It vents the intense amount of heat in its body through the flames on its back.

entry: POKENAME偏爱火山与灰烬地带。身体火焰随火山休眠状态闪动，若突然暴起，就代表喷发将至。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers volcanic and ashy areas to call home. The flames that emit from its body flicker in accordance to the volcano's dormancy. Should they blaze up suddenly, an eruption is imminent.

entry: POKENAME不断从体内喷出烈焰，身体摸起来却冰冷。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly spews intense flames from inside its body. Despite this, its body is cold to the touch.

entry: 火焰极亮，100多英里外也能看见。会引领山中迷途的登山者回到安全处。
author: typhloquil
source: Its flames are so bright, it can be spotted from over 100 miles away. It'll guide hikers lost in the mountains back to safety.

entry: POKENAME用口中喷出的强水流，将身体推上高处。能在陆地与水中生活，常开心地四处跳舞。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME propel themselves to higher areas using strong blasts of water from their mouths. They can live in water or on land. They are often found dancing around gleefully.

entry: 贪玩好胜得让大多训练家疲于应付。不过，咬合力却出奇地弱。
author: Staghorn
source: It is playful and competitive to a degree that most Trainers find exhausting. Surprisingly, its bite force is relatively weak.

entry: POKENAME的身体就像一条移动、冒泡、蒸汽腾腾的小溪。会在颚中聚集大量热水，咬住敌人将其烫伤。
author: totodile.
source: A POKENAME's body is essentially a mobile, steaming, bubbling brook. It concentrates lots of hot water in its jaw and bites foes, scalding them.

entry: POKENAME跟在训练家身旁，护主心让它警惕靠近的陌生人。即使训练家认得，只要它自己不够熟，也可能咬上一口。
author: sk372
source: It tags alongside its Trainer, its protective nature making it wary of any strangers drawing near. Even faces familiar to the Trainer must be wary; if they aren't familiar enough to POKENAME, they risk getting bitten.

entry: POKENAME生活在污染沼泽，用咬来交流：朋友得到温柔轻啃，敌人则挨上凶狠重咬！
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in polluted swamps. This Pokémon communicates through biting: gentle affectionate nibbles for friends, and harsh chomps for foes!

entry: POKENAME想伪装成普通花朵，引来猎物困进巨颚。可惜，很少有谁会上当。
author: bostroms
source: It tries to disguise itself as a regular flower to lure in its prey and entrap them in its massive jaws.  Unfortunately for POKENAME,  few are fooled.

entry: POKENAME记得所有去过的地方，躲在硬壳里的日子，便用来完善脑中的地图。
author: bee4082
source: A POKENAME can remember everywhere it's ever been. It uses its time in its hard shell to perfect its mental cartography.

entry: 游泳肌肉强健，能轻松逆着大多水流前进。会上岸吃河边的蠕虫与小虫。
author: sk372
source: It has strong swimming muscles, allowing it to swim against most currents easily. It goes on land to feed, eating the worms and small bugs that inhabit the riverside.

entry: POKENAME是极小的鸟宝可梦，随风漂向想去的地方。有人靠近时，还能瞬间移动。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very tiny bird Pokémon that lets itself float on the wind wherever it may want to go. It has the power to teleport if anyone comes near.

entry: POKENAME是极小的金色鸟宝可梦，随风漂向想去的地方。若感到危险，便会瞬间移动逃走。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very tiny golden bird Pokémon that lets itself float on the wind wherever it may want to go. It will teleport away if it feels endangered.

entry: POKENAME眼旁的深色花纹能减少朝太阳看时的眩光。警觉性极高，很难让它措手不及。
author: .realthree
source: The dark markings by POKENAME's eyes reduce the glare it encounters when it stares in the direction of the sun. It is difficult to surprise due to its awareness.

entry: 飞行路线错综复杂，有人认为藏着讯息。这种神秘行为已让几代研究者困惑。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon flutters around creating intricate flight patterns that some believe carry hidden messages. Its mysterious behavior has puzzled researchers for generations.

entry: 先留下一滩黏树果汁，再藏在附近。等虫子黏得够多，就去享用果汁配虫的大餐。
author: sk372
source: It leaves behind puddles of sticky berry juice, then hides nearby. Once enough insects are stuck, it goes to feast on the mixture of tasty juice and bugs.

entry: POKENAME虽覆着大量羽毛，本体却很小，依旧轻盈。羽毛保温极好，常被用来填枕头。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite it being covered in a massive number of feathers, POKENAME is pretty lightweight due to how small their actual body is. The feathers are great heat insulators and are commonly in pillows.

entry: 用坚硬头骨撞树，震下果实、坚果与虫子吃。POKENAME若太起劲，有时会把整棵树撞倒。
author: sk372
source: It uses its rock-solid skull to headbutt trees, dislodging fruits, nuts and bugs for it to eat. Overzealous POKENAME occasionally end up knocking the entire tree down.

entry: 身体沉重，骨骼由铁构成，翅膀根本托不起来。可天生磁力让它依然能灵活飞行。
author: Staghorn
source: Its heavy body and iron bones mean that its wings are completely incapable of lifting its weight. Despite this, it is an agile flier thanks to its innate magnetism.

entry: POKENAME常见于郊区，从喂鸟器收集种子存进体内，却也因此被小拉达盯上。
author: .realthree
source: Commonly found in suburbia, POKENAME gathers seeds from birdfeeders and stores it within itself. However, this causes it to be targeted by Rattata.

entry: 晴天，尾焰烧得最亮。下雨时会钻进地下，护住火苗。
author: Ozydamians
source: The fire on its tail burns brightest on days with clear weather. It hides underground from rain to protect its flame.

entry: 天色平静时，会栖在高处眺望远方。据说捡到POKENAME的蓝羽毛十分幸运。
author: Ozydamians
source: When the skies are calm, it roosts up high to scan the horizon. To find a blue POKENAME feather is considered very lucky.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却只吃坚果与树果。喜欢烤过再吃，可常忘记火有多强，最后只剩一堆灰，气得大发脾气。
author: Ozydamians
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME only eats nuts and berries. It prefers to toast its meal, but often forgets the intensity of its flames. It throws a tantrum when it's left with nothing but a pile of ash afterwards.

entry: 不靠振翅起飞，而是瞬间移动到空中。每天虽睡15小时，醒着时却颇有效率。
author: frokachu
source: Instead of taking flight, it teleports into the air instead. Though it sleeps for 15 hours a day, it is fairly productive while awake.

entry: POKENAME体能潜力极强，因此常自大自恋。比起真正训练，花在梳理羽毛的时间更多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has powerful physical potential, which often gives it a cocky, narcissistic demeanor. It spends more time preening its feathers than it does actually training.

entry: POKENAME凶猛无休，挡路的东西一概摧毁。有理论认为，整个生态都曾因它的存在而改变。
author: Rotcivosk
source: Known for its relentless and aggressive nature, POKENAME will destroy anything that stands in its path. It is theorized that entire ecosystems have been altered due to its presence.

entry: POKENAME常浮在河湖水面睡觉，随水流一觉漂过数百英里。
author: regula
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, floating on the surface of rivers and lakes. It often travels hundreds of miles as it naps, drifting on the current.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME是史前形态的大力鳄，融合似乎让远古祖先重现了。
author: edeniteiron
source: POKENAME is believed to be a prehistoric form of Feraligatr. Fusion seemingly brought back this ancient ancestor.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，强壮肌肉却让速度惊人。为节省能量，偏爱以巨颚的粉碎重咬速战速决，避免久斗。
author: amiel997
source: Despite its massive size, its powerful muscles make POKENAME incredibly fast. To conserve energy, it prefers to finish opponents quickly with a crushing bite from its powerful jaws, avoiding drawn-out battles.

entry: 顶鳍最大的POKENAME被视为群体首领，却不太会控制自己的小手臂。
author: kittyluv090
source: A POKENAME with large top fins is deemed the leader of its pod. It doesn't have much control over its small arms.

entry: POKENAME尾端喷出的沸水力道惊人，发出宛如瀑布的轰鸣奔流声。
author: .realthree
source: The scalding water generated at the end of POKENAME's tail bursts forth with such enormous force that it creates a noisy rushing sound, similar to a waterfall.

entry: POKENAME只在深水出现，能高速旋转身体，制造漩涡。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME only appears in deep bodies of water. It can create whirlpools by spinning its body at incredible speeds.

entry: 继承大力鳄的遗存特征，POKENAME睡觉时一眼睁着，两侧大脑轮流休息。可即使睡着也能用超能力察觉敌人，不必看见便能瞬间移动逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: As a vestigial feature from its Feraligatr half, POKENAME sleeps with one eye open, resting one brain hemisphere at a time. However, it doesn't need to see a foe to know to teleport away; its psychic powers allow it to detect them even in sleep.

entry: POKENAME在河岸安家，捕食较小的全水生宝可梦，避开深水危险。洞穴入口众多，一退走便很难判断去了哪里。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME make their homes along riverbanks, hunting smaller fully aquatic Pokémon while avoiding the dangers of deeper water. Their burrows have multiple entrances, making it hard to determine where they've gone when they retreat.

entry: 成群POKENAME从里向外吃掉废弃电器。只要一只发现捕食者，里面的同伴便四散逃开，电器也跟着哐哐作响。
author: .fedoraman
source: Swarms of POKENAME consume discarded appliances from the inside out. If one spots a predator approaching, the inhabited appliance will rattle as all of the POKENAME within scatter.

entry: 有人相信，店门口摆夸张造型的POKENAME塑像会招财。大众作品常描绘它与索罗亚互为对手。它更喜欢伪装成家用品。
author: El Fail
source: It is believed by some that displaying an exaggerated statue of a POKENAME at the entrance to a business will invite good fortune. Popular media often depict them as rivals with a Zorua. They prefer to disguise themselves as household objects.

entry: 用突然发出的尖叫交流。这些夜行宝可梦叫起来，像小孩子在惊叫。
author: bobosmith01
source: To communicate, they screech sharply and suddenly. These nocturnal Pokémon's cries sound like the screams of young children.

entry: 施展超能力时，胡须会明显抽动，常在战斗中暴露意图。
author: .izik
source: Its mustache twitches noticeably whenever it uses a psychic ability. This behavior gives away its intentions during battles.

entry: 先摇动绒尾分散敌人注意，再迅速打出上勾拳，整个过程都笑眯眯。
author: .izik
source: It wags its fluffy tail to distract foes before delivering a swift uppercut. It keeps a cheerful smile throughout the entire attack.

entry: 在伙伴巢穴周围织细丝，建立预警网。捕食者靠近，便鸣叫提醒大家逃走。
author: .izik
source: It spins thin silk around the nests of its allies, creating an early warning system. When predators approach, it chirps to alert others to flee.

entry: 头顶花朵旋转吸气，充满体内气囊，让它能离地轻轻飘浮。
author: .izik
source: The flower on its head spins to draw in air, filling its internal gas sack. This allows it to lift off the ground and float gently.

entry: 身上的毛球其实是长毛气囊，能让它悠闲飘过花圃。
author: .izik
source: The puffballs on its body are actually furry gas sacks. It uses them to float gently through the air, drifting lazily across flowerbeds.

entry: 将毛绒长尾伸进树洞，找宝物或食物。一有收获，就坏笑着带走战利品。
author: .izik
source: It sticks its long, furry tail into tree holes to search for valuables or food. Once it finds something, it chuckles mischievously and runs off with its prize.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，再加上预知能力，任何危险都能轻松避开。
author: Glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is an agile creature. When combined with its precognitive powers, this means POKENAME can avoid any danger easily.

entry: 它在香草园附近筑巢，最偏爱罗勒和百里香。它经常收集一大捆香草，储存在自己的家里。
author: .izik
source: It nests near herb gardens, favoring basil and thyme above all others. It often collects large bunches to store in its home.

entry: 以毛茸茸的触角施展超能力，察觉附近敌人，几乎不可能被偷袭。
author: .izik
source: It uses its furry antennae to psychically detect nearby enemies. This makes it nearly impossible to sneak up on.

entry: 会挖出绵延数英里的蜿蜒地洞。石头与混凝土也挡不住，因此很不适合养作宠物。
author: Staghorn
source: Pokémon dig long snaking burrows that can stretch for miles. They can dig through stone and concrete, making them terrible pets.

entry: 遇见饥饿幼崽，会分享营养丰富的奶。喂食时，还用长而蓬松的尾巴提供温暖与安慰。
author: .izik
source: When it encounters a hungry young Pokémon, it offers them its nutritious milk. Its long, fluffy tail provides warmth and comfort while they feed.

entry: 冬夜用长绒尾裹住朋友，帮助保暖，也增进群体间的情谊。
author: .izik
source: Its long, furry tails wrap around its friends on cold winter nights. This behavior helps keep them warm and builds camaraderie in their group.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，毛的防水性越差。虽然仍在河流生活、狩猎，地洞却多建在沼泽地。
author: Katie
source: The fur of POKENAME gradually loses its waterproof qualities as they age. While they still live in and hunt within river environments, their burrow systems tend to be built in more swampy areas.

entry: 不再拥有进化前用来防水的油脂。POKENAME虽住在沼泽，却更爱在树根间挖洞，而非河岸。
author: Katie
source: It no longer contains the oils produced in earlier stages of their evolution that are needed to make it waterproof. Though they live in swampy environments, POKENAME prefer to make burrows among tree roots rather than along riverbanks.

entry: 冬天毛会变蓬松，察觉暴风雪将至时尤其浓厚，帮助抵御严寒。
author: .izik
source: Its fur grows fluffy during the winter, becoming especially thick if it senses an approaching blizzard. This natural adaptation helps it endure harsh cold.

entry: POKENAME住在耳机线等细长电线里，最爱沿弯弯绕绕的路线疾驰。还会故意把家打成结，让线的主人懊恼不已。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME make their homes in long thin electrical cords such as headphone wires in which they can have fun zooming through their twists and turns. To this end, they will bend their homes into knots, much to the chagrin of the cords' owners.

entry: 毛湿后会变得油滑，捕食者极难抓住。
author: .izik
source: When its fur gets wet, it becomes greasy and slippery. This makes it incredibly difficult for predators to grab hold of it.

entry: POKENAME能在密丛中游走，靠花状肢体融入环境。不怕其中的各种毒草，还很喜欢独特的香气。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can wander through dense overgrowths, using the flower-like limbs to blend in. They are resistant to the various poisonous plants in these overgrowths, enjoying their unique aromas.

entry: 在向日葵田旁安家，每天摘种子。会带回安全的窝里，用柔火加热，清静享用。
author: .izik
source: It builds its den near sunflower patches, plucking seeds daily for its meals. It retreats to the safety of its home to enjoy its food without interruption, heating it with gentle flames.

entry: 友善的脸让敌人放松警惕，随后一口酸液，就能打对方措手不及。
author: .izik
source: Its friendly face lulls foes into a false sense of security. However, it can spit acid from its mouth, catching them off guard.

entry: 外表看似毛发，身体其实由近似桦木的活木构成，因此质感与模样都很独特。
author: .izik
source: Although it looks like fur, its body is actually made of living birch-like wood. This gives it a unique texture and appearance.

entry: POKENAME刚被收服时常害羞，亲近训练家后就会永远黏在一起。是真的黏——黏液就像胶水！
author: Zeeroooo
source: POKENAME is often shy when first caught, but when it bonds with its Trainer it will stick with them forever. Quite literally; its slime is like glue!

entry: POKENAME四肢强健，速度很快，本可造成大量伤害，可天性温顺，通常不会这样做。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's limbs are very strong. It is a fast creature capable of dealing out lots of damage, but it usually won't due to its docile nature.

entry: 本体出奇纤细，90%的体积都是蓬松毛发。冬季毛更厚，显得比实际大许多。
author: .izik
source: Its actual body is remarkably thin, with 90% of its bulk being fluffy fur. In winter, its coat becomes even thicker, making it look much larger than it is.

entry: POKENAME常甩尾，用叶片切东西。日久，尾巴会逐渐吞没本体，直到只剩下头部。
author: crusaderzakk
source: POKENAME is often seen swinging its tail around to cut things with its leaves. Over time, the tail slowly engulfs the main body until only the head remains.

entry: POKENAME无法在陆地行走，只好用伸缩触手在树间荡行。柔软防水的毛，常被用于现代服装。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk on land, so it will use its stretchy tentacles to swing from trees. Its soft fur is waterproof and is often used in modern clothing.

entry: 以大葱作长矛，出其不意地重刺敌人，力道足以打裂混凝土。
author: .izik
source: It wields its leek like a lance, jabbing at foes with surprising strength. The force of its strikes is powerful enough to crack concrete.

entry: POKENAME夜间在枝头警戒。发现威胁便俯冲毒伤、扰乱敌人，同时鸣叫示警。还会在树枝间吐丝，缀上石子，奏出有节奏的风铃般旋律。
author: Greensnake01
source: POKENAME watch diligently from branches at night. On seeing a threat, they swoop down to poison and confuse the aggressor, hooting to warn forest denizens. They spin string from branches and cover it in rocks, producing a rhythmic chime-like melody.

entry: POKENAME轻快活泼，满月时会与同类一同踩着节奏起舞。舒缓神秘的歌声能催人入眠。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a spritely Pokémon known for dancing in a rhythm with other POKENAME during the full moon. It can sing a soothing, enigmatic melody that lulls others to sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会为迷途旅人穿过暗林引路。看似帮忙，实际却越领越偏，直到旅人彻底迷失。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are said to appear before lost travelers, guiding them through dark forests. Though they may seem helpful, they are in fact leading these travellers astray until they are hopelessly lost.

entry: 计时精确到微秒。传闻一些现代时钟以它为原型，却无人知道真假。
author: donutsbg
source: It measures time to the microsecond. There's a rumor that some modern clocks are based on this Pokémon, but nobody knows if it's true.

entry: POKENAME体内器官能精确计时，每晚恰睡一小时。生活节奏必须十分规律，否则就会紧张好斗。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME has an internal organ that allows it to keep perfect track of time. It sleeps exactly one hour every night and needs a very orderly daily rhythm, otherwise it becomes stressed and aggressive.

entry: POKENAME背上铭文称，正面时钟指向正确时刻，真正力量就会显现。可惜钟已经坏得修不好了。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME bears an inscription on its back that claims its true powers will be revealed when the clock on its front strikes the right time. Unfortunately, the clock is broken beyond repair.

entry: POKENAME忠诚贪玩，极爱夜间散步，是失眠者很好的伙伴。
author: Katie
source: Loyal and playful, POKENAME have a great love of nighttime walks. They make great companions for those who suffer from insomnia.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳着刺击敌人，可招式重复，容易预测。聪明些的宝可梦很容易智取。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME bounces around jabbing at its foes, but its attacks are fairly repetitive and predictable. Because of this, smarter Pokémon can easily outwit it.

entry: POKENAME双翼映月闪烁，无声滑过夜空。能用迷人花纹催眠、制造幻象，逃离危险。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME glides silently through the night, its wings shimmering under the moonlight. With the ability to hypnotize foes, it uses its mesmerizing patterns to create illusions and escape danger.

entry: 人们普遍相信，这种POKENAME曾遭诅咒。为何只有一臂仍不清楚，但似乎并不受影响。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: This variety of POKENAME is widely believed to have been cursed once upon a time. Nobody knows why it has only one arm, but it does not seem to be held back by its lack of said appendage.

entry: 巨大的黄羽能在暗处变色，夜猎时不惊动猎物。最先盯上的，是迷失又绝望的对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their large yellow feathers can alter their color in darkness so it does not alert prey while it hunts during the night. It first targets prey that are lost and in despair.

entry: 索罗亚克与猫头夜鹰的可怕融合体，以凶猛好斗的捕食者闻名，绝不可轻视。名声并非空穴来风，因为它们极力护幼。
author: El Fail
source: This intimidating fusion of Zoroark and Noctowl has a fierce reputation as a ferocious and aggressive predator which should not be taken lightly. There is some truth to this as they are very protective of their young.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却凶悍得惊人，体形大数倍的对手也不退让。潜行也极出色，能无声穿过最密的枝叶追踪猎物。
author: El Fail
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME are surprisingly ferocious and will not shy away from opponents many times their size. They are astonishingly stealthy as well, able to stalk prey through even the thickest foliage in silence.

entry: POKENAME自首次融合以来，身体就让研究者费解。组成身体的木质状材料，带有毒性。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body has baffled researchers since they were first fused. The wood-like material that composes their body is toxic.

entry: POKENAME身体庞大，十分笨拙，常跌跌撞撞，飞着又会撞上窗户。
author: ohok3441
source: Thanks to their large bodies, POKENAME are clumsy. They have a tendency to stumble around and fly into windows.

entry: 站得笔直僵硬，双眼却迅速扫视，将周围看得清清楚楚。一旦找到狩猎机会，便以精准动作出击，让猎物无声消失在森林中。
author: sk372
source: Though it stands perfectly rigid, its eyes dart around, taking in its surroundings with perfect clarity. Once it sees the opportunity to hunt, it moves with calculated perfection, its prey disappearing from the forest in total silence.

entry: 古传说视POKENAME为月夜的不祥之兆，预示厄运与恶意。其实它对人类没什么兴趣，连训练家也常被冷淡以待。
author: Katie
source: Ancient legends speak of POKENAME as bad omens, harbingers of misfortune and malice on moonlit nights. In truth, POKENAME have little interest in people and are often aloof and disinterested, even toward their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME夜间从树梢追踪猎物。出众视力与敏捷身手，让它成为可畏的猎手。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME stalk their prey from the treetops at night. Their exceptional eyesight and agility make them formidable hunters.

entry: POKENAME许多方面像摔角鹰人，却更聪明些，脾气也更喜怒无常。适应性强，容易学会格斗与飞行属性攻击。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME are similar to Hawlucha in many ways, but are a bit smarter and more temperamental. They are adaptable and can learn Fighting and Flying-type attacks easily.

entry: 忠诚聪明，很受想找伙伴的人追捧。不过只允许选中的人骑背飞行，接近时仍须谨慎。
author: bostroms
source: It is highly sought after as a companion due to its loyalty and intelligence. Approach with caution, as it will only allow select humans to fly on its back.

entry: 偶有目击称，野生POKENAME会在深夜与各类宝可梦对练。虽是夜行性，天性却骄傲又爱出风头。
author: theartemis1
source: Rare eyewitness accounts have spotted wild POKENAME participating in late-night bouts of sparring against various Pokémon. Though nocturnal, it is known to be proud and showy by nature.

entry: POKENAME能产生危险电力，可外貌可爱、性情友善，其他宝可梦不会攻击。连讨厌虫的人也不把它当害虫，收服后常视为家人。
author: Lutrax
source: POKENAME generates dangerous electricity. Due to its cute appearance and friendly nature, other Pokémon do not attack it, and even humans who dislike bugs do not consider this creature a pest. Once captured, it is often considered a family member.

entry: POKENAME以战技守护居住的城市，打击犯罪。事迹如此有名，甚至有一只担纲了以卡洛斯密阿雷市为背景的热门节目主角。
author: neo_technomon_8392
source: POKENAME regularly uses its skill in combat to protect the cities in which it resides from crime. Its work is so renowned that one stars in a popular TV show based in Lumiose City from the Kalos Region.

entry: 野外只有晨光初现、太阳尚未完全升起时才能找到它。被发现后，会发出凶险的高声尖啸，很快又变得胆怯。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is only found in the wild just as light starts to fill the sky, but before the sun is fully over the horizon. It lets out baneful, high-pitched screeches if discovered and quickly becomes timid.

entry: 用角牢牢夹住敌人，接连打上勾拳，直到对方昏倒。十分珍惜终于会飞的本领，喜欢飞上高空再自由落下，反复玩耍。
author: epping_forest
source: Its fighting style consists of strongly gripping its opponents with its horns, while throwing uppercuts until they faint. It cherishes finally being able to fly, and loves to reach high altitudes just to free fall and repeat.

entry: POKENAME一仰面倒下，就无法自己起身。露出软肚，只好乱挥六条短肢，吓退可能的攻击者。
author: SonTyp
source: When it falls on its back, it's impossible for a POKENAME to get back up on its own. With its soft belly exposed, it flails its six short limbs around to avert potential aggressors.

entry: POKENAME靠热感视觉观察世界。熔融的身体上散布着虫甲般的碎片，增强防御。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME sees the world through heat vision. Its molten body is dotted with bits of bug-like exoskeleton, boosting its defensive capabilities.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着巨颚般的甲壳，硬如岩石，能夹住攻击者。野外个体害羞避人，拿闪亮物品却可能引它靠近。
author: SonTyp
source: Its wings are covered by a huge, jaw-like carapace that's hard as rock and can clamp down on attackers. In the wild, POKENAME are shy and hide from humans, but might be lured closer by presenting shiny or glittering objects.

entry: POKENAME有的部位覆外骨骼，有的长鱼鳞。甩尾太快时，会发出虫鸣般的嗡嗡声。
author: leonian1586
source: Some parts of POKENAME's body are covered in an exoskeleton, while others have fish-like scales. It swings its tail so quickly it produces a bug-like buzzing sound.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME双翼已无法飞行，转而配合胡须，感知附近人类与宝可梦的动作。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's wings have become incapable of flight after fusion. Instead, it uses them alongside its whiskers to sense the movements of nearby people and Pokémon.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME学会坐着睡，将蛋形石头收在袋内防盗。据说也会用石头作武器。
author: lucasdesouza7
source: After evolution, POKENAME has learned to sleep sitting down with the egg-shaped rock in its pouch in order to prevent theft. Some say it also uses the rock as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME是城都林中常见的夜行融合体。腹部花纹隐约像张鬼脸，据说用来吓退捕食者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are a common nocturnal fusion found in the woodlands of Johto. The pattern on their stomach looks vaguely like a grimacing face, which is thought to scare off potential predators.

entry: POKENAME虽然外貌吓人，却体贴亲人。睡觉时会用蛛网裹住蛋形石头，细心保护。
author: lucasdesouza7
source: Despite its creepy appearance, POKENAME is caring and affectionate. It covers the egg-shaped rock in webs when it sleeps in order to protect it.

entry: 头部花纹用来吓退捕食者，掩饰POKENAME极度胆小的本性。曾见一对手足不小心互相吓着，同时逃走。
author: sk372
source: The markings on its head are meant to deter predators, and hide the fact that POKENAME is in fact incredibly timid. Sibling pairs have been seen accidentally frightening each other and running away simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林，能射出强韧蛛网，在树间荡行。随着成长进化，身手只会更加敏捷。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in jungles, able to swing from tree to tree by shooting powerful webs. It only gets more agile as it grows older and evolves.

entry: 迷人的蘑菇深受人类与宝可梦追捧。它却喜欢独居，藏在枯叶下，以黏丝捕捉小猎物。
author: Frokachu
source: Its mesmerizing mushrooms are sought after by many people and Pokémon alike. It likes to live in seclusion, hiding under dead leaves and trapping smaller prey with its sticky silk.

entry: POKENAME会为领地里的其他对象烤点心，也常被发现囤钱、偷训练家的财物。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME bakes pastries for others in its domain. It can often be found hoarding money and stealing from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME攀在网上等待猎物，一发现合适目标就跳下。角、牙、拳、脚，甚至尾巴全用上，以无休怒火打到对方屈服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to a web until it spots suitable prey, then leaps from its perch, using horns and fangs, fists and feet, and even its tail to pummel its target into submission with relentless anger.

entry: POKENAME疑心很重，织网察觉闯入者，再瞬间移动逃走。觅食时，也靠瞬间移动来回附近的树果灌木。
author: Frokachu
source: Due to its paranoid nature, POKENAME will construct webs to detect and teleport away from intruders. It will forage berries by teleporting to and from nearby bushes.

entry: 这个罕见POKENAME变体失去了翅膀与毒针，却长出牢固抓握能力，能持用针状武器。会借丝线疾冲、延伸针击。聪明善思，仍有强烈领地意识。
author: Lutrax
source: This rare variant of POKENAME lost its wings and needles but developed a firm grasp to use needle-like weapons. Its silk is now used to dash and extend its needle. It is highly intelligent and capable of deep thoughts, but still territorial.

entry: POKENAME生活在最幽暗的密林。猎物走近，诱饵便泛出微光。想循光逃离黑暗的对象，很快就会落进蛛网。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives deep within the darkest of forests, emitting a faint glow from its lure when prey stumbles near. Those who follow seeking escape from the dark will find themselves soon ensnared in its webs.

entry: POKENAME用蛛丝裹住蛋形石头，再甩向猎物头部，造成疼痛的脑震荡。随后用角刺补上最后一击。
author: lucasdesouza7
source: POKENAME covers the egg-shaped rock in webs, then slings it at the prey's head, causing a painful concussion. After that, it finishes the foe with a horn stab.

entry: POKENAME是攀爬高手，能轻松在树间跳跃。爪上覆毒，能迅速让猎物失去行动能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert climbers, jumping from tree-to-tree with little effort. Its claws are coated in poison, which it uses to quickly incapacitate its prey.

entry: 吃树根与草本叶片。闻见地下的根，就用利爪与獠牙迅速掘土。
author: .izik
source: Its diet consists of tree roots and leafy herbs. Should it smell a root underground, it will use its sharp claws and fangs to rapidly dig into the soil.

entry: 织出复杂的蛛网迷宫。困在网上的宝可梦会被吃掉，走到尽头的则会遇见POKENAME——然后也被吃掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: It weaves a complex maze of webs. Pokémon caught in the webs are devoured. Those who reach the end of the maze will meet POKENAME. They, too, are devoured.

entry: 它在角中储存加压的毒液，能将其高速射出，击中最远1英里外的静止目标。
author: .izik
source: It stores pressurized venom in its horn and can fire it at high speeds. It can hit a stationary target from up to 1 mile away.

entry: 战斗时在树间疾驰，吐黏丝设下陷阱。瞅准机会便跳下，痛击敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, it darts from tree to tree, spitting sticky threads and setting up traps for foes to get stuck in. When it sees an opportunity, it leaps down and pummels the foe.

entry: 战斗时在树间疾驰，吐黏丝设下陷阱。瞅准机会便跳下，痛击敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, it darts from tree to tree, spitting sticky threads and setting up traps for foes to get stuck in. When it sees an opportunity, it leaps down and pummels the foe.

entry: POKENAME虽外形可怕，实际却能让人平静。角储存宁静之力，缎带则如天线。
author: ziggaway
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, this Pokémon actually imparts calmness. POKENAME stores tranquility in its horn, with its ribbons acting as antennae.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吐网，在枝头之间荡行，也能借此制服猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME swings from branch to branch with the webs shooting out of its mouth. It can also neutralize prey with this ability.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会用网捕捉小虫，捆在身上。再积攒大量虫子，与其他宝可梦换更大的一餐。
author: Mistymagius
source: This clever Pokémon collects smaller bugs in its webs and then keeps them tied up on its body. POKENAME then trades large amounts of them with other Pokémon for larger meals.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝质地如银。藻玉镇的工匠会将其熔化，制成高脚杯。
author: .izik
source: The silk that comes from a POKENAME's mouth has the same consistency as silver. Artisans in Wisteria Town melt it down and craft goblets from it.

entry: 身体织出的网触感冰冷。温度越低，网就越强韧。
author: .izik
source: The webs that come from this Pokémon's body are cold to the touch. The lower the temperature of the web, the higher its strength.

entry: 体内充满白色黏毒液。看见想吃的东西，就会快速振动，口水直流。
author: .izik
source: Its body is filled with a white viscous venom. When it sees something it wants to eat, it vibrates rapidly while drooling.

entry: 掌上黏毛能轻松攀上高墙。主要在夜间活动，在高楼中寻找猎物。
author: .izik
source: There are sticky hairs on its palms that allow it to scale large walls with ease. It is active mainly at night, where it searches tall buildings for prey.

entry: POKENAME较少见的体色变体，却不算“异色”。孢子长出的蘑菇，会用坚韧丝线固定在地上。
author: Frokachu
source: A less common color variant of POKENAME, but not classified as 'Shiny'. Its spores grow into mushrooms that stay anchored to the earth with sturdy silk strands.

entry: 一些荒凉地方称它们为“死亡之铃”，实际却不伤大型生物，只捕食昆虫。
author: Frokachu
source: Some desolate places call these Pokémon "bells of death," but they are harmless to larger creatures and prey only on insects.

entry: POKENAME虽长得可怕，却深爱训练家。夜里会在床上方的天花板静坐数小时，等对方醒来一起玩，始终不出声，免得打扰。
author: soupalicious
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME loves its Trainer and will spend the night sitting on the ceiling above their bed waiting for them to wake up and play. It will sit for hours in complete silence so as not to disturb them.

entry: 快速旋转，以双翼为刃切开障碍。旋转飞行还会掀起旋风，扰乱敌人。
author: .izik
source: It spins rapidly, using its wings as blades to slash through obstacles. This spinning flight creates a whirlwind that disorients opponents.

entry: 双翼掀起强风，将水泼向敌人，阻止对方靠近，再趁机重新起飞。
author: .izik
source: Its wings generate powerful air currents that splash water toward enemies. This tactic keeps opponents at bay while it takes flight again.

entry: 变形前，会用声呐充分了解敌人的能力，确保模仿得准确又有效。
author: .izik
source: Before transforming, it uses sonar to fully assess the abilities of its opponent. This careful observation ensures it becomes an exact and effective copy.

entry: POKENAME似乎不情不愿地接受了新获得的视力。常躲在暗处生闷气，怒瞪每一缕透入的光。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME seem to have accepted their newfound vision, however begrudgingly. They can often be found sulking in dark places, glaring at any light that creeps through.

entry: 强牙能轻易咬碎缟玛瑙。这份无可比拟的咬合力，让它成为可怕的猎手。
author: .izik
source: Its powerful teeth can crush through onyx with ease. This unmatched biting force makes it a formidable hunter.

entry: 倒着飞时，能极精准地钻进地里，挖出隧道，逃离威胁。
author: .izik
source: Flying backwards, it drills into the ground with unmatched precision. This tactic allows it to carve tunnels and escape from threats.

entry: 会用爪子在巢边刻出精细石像，既作装饰，也标记领地。
author: .izik
source: Using its claws, it carves stone to create intricate statues near its den. These sculptures serve as both decoration and territory markers.

entry: 向敌人泼出壳内的酸汁，使对方晕眩，既能防身，也能威慑。
author: .izik
source: Acidic juice from its shell is splashed at enemies, leaving them stunned. This juice doubles as a defensive mechanism and deterrent.

entry: 能扛着整棵树飞行最远10英里。惊人的力量让它能在偏远高处筑巢。
author: .izik
source: It can carry entire trees through the air for up to 10 miles. This incredible strength allows it to build nests in remote areas high above the ground.

entry: 振翅掀起强风，击倒障碍，连最强悍的对手也能吹翻。
author: .izik
source: By flapping its wings, it generates powerful wind blasts that knock down obstacles. These gusts are strong enough to topple even the toughest opponents.

entry: 用鳍调节磁场，极精确地控制自己的位置与速度。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its fins to modulate its magnetic field, giving it extremely precise control over its position and speed.

entry: 背刺能像导弹般射向远方。密集锋锐的攻击，让敌人难以躲避。
author: .izik
source: It can fire the spines on its back like missiles, launching them at distant targets. This attack leaves opponents struggling to avoid the sharp barrage.

entry: 从高处台地优雅跃下，轻松滑翔。精准飞行让它能准确打中目标。
author: .izik
source: It leaps from tall plateaus with grace, gliding through the air effortlessly. Its precision in flight allows it to strike targets with pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: Soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: Soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: 发出猛烈噪音，迷惑敌人、扰乱方向。声波攻势强劲，让对方难以反击。
author: .izik
source: It unleashes powerful bursts of noise that confuse and disorient its foes. The intensity of these sonic attacks makes it hard to counter.

entry: 像狙击手般精准喷酸，远处目标也能命中。腐蚀性的攻击让它十分危险。
author: .izik
source: It spits acid with sniper-like precision, hitting targets from impressive distances. This corrosive attack makes it a dangerous foe in battle.

entry: 喜欢偷墓碑恶作剧，再随意丢在各处，令守墓人十分困惑。
author: .izik
source: It steals gravestones as a mischievous prank, scattering them in random places. This strange behavior leaves graveyard keepers puzzled.

entry: 在峡谷深处筑巢，地形的回声增强了回声定位。偏远位置既安全，也方便狩猎。
author: .izik
source: It nests deep within gorges, where the acoustics amplify its echolocation. These isolated locations provide it with both safety and hunting grounds.

entry: 藏在暴风云里，耐心等最佳时机突袭。猎物面对突然伏击，毫无反应机会。
author: .izik
source: It hides within storm clouds, waiting patiently to strike at the perfect moment. Its sudden ambush leaves prey with no chance to react.

entry: POKENAME扇动头上翼状触角，感受洞穴气流。皮肤一干，就会迷失方向。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME flutters the wing-like antennae on its head to feel the air currents in the caves in inhabits. If its skin dries, it loses its way.

entry: 太阳刚开始落山，POKENAME便会出洞。可外面若不够潮湿，很快又会回家。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME ventures from its cave as soon as the sun begins to set. However, if it's not humid enough outside, it soon returns to its home.

entry: POKENAME吸收光线，制造并储存大量危险毒素，再用身体的尖刺注入对手。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME houses a host of dangerous toxins that it produces through absorbing light. It uses the spiked portions of its body to inject venom into combatants.

entry: 它靠吃苔藓来保养毛皮，使毛皮保持光泽。这种独特的饮食也让它身手敏捷，随时都能起飞。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on moss to keep its fur glossy and well-maintained. This unique diet also keeps it nimble and ready for flight.

entry: 快速振翅，便能精准地震落树上的球果，方便取食，也能存起来备用。
author: .izik
source: Using swift wingbeats, it knocks Apricorns off trees with remarkable accuracy. This behavior helps it access food and store it for later use.

entry: 动作灵巧、身体柔韧，洞壁极浅的凹处也能轻松跃上停歇。守望采矿点，随时俯冲抢走发现的闪亮宝石。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is both impressively agile and flexible: it is able to effortlessly bound and rest its body on the slightest indent of rocky cavern walls. It watches over mining spots, waiting to dart downwards and snatch any glittering jewels that may be found.

entry: 训练家请POKENAME在葡萄园压树果酿酒，发泄怒气。客人看见它舔拳上的红汁，常吓得以为在喝受害者的血。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Trainers employ POKENAME at vineyards, encouraging them to work out their anger by squishing berries for wine. Many guests get intimidated when they see POKENAME licking red juice from their fists, afraid they're drinking blood from their victims.

entry: POKENAME虽有强毒与凶悍战技，却出奇仁慈。击败其他宝可梦后，只吸些血便放过对方。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its powerful poison and brutal fighting abilities, POKENAME is surprisingly merciful. After it defeats other Pokémon, it merely sucks some of their blood and leaves them be.

entry: 以坚硬身体猛烈俯冲，空袭让敌人伤痕累累、失去平衡。
author: .izik
source: With its hard body, it dives into enemies with tremendous force. This aerial assault leaves its opponents battered and off-balance.

entry: 野生POKENAME出没的洞穴十分危险。它能倒挂在昏暗洞顶伪装，再突然松开，重重砸向闯入者头顶。
author: bobosmith01
source: Caves that have wild POKENAME are considered dangerous due to POKENAME's ability to camouflage itself against dim ceilings while perched upside-down. It will let go and purposely fall onto a trespasser's head at crushing speeds.

entry: 只能靠超能力托起沉重身体飞行。这种奇特方式，却让滑翔快得惊人。
author: .izik
source: It can only fly with the assistance of psychic powers, which lift its heavy body into the air. This strange method allows it to glide at surprising speeds.

entry: 用削尖的大葱近身刺击敌人。出人意料的武器，让攻势难测又危险。
author: .izik
source: It strikes with a sharpened leek, jabbing at enemies in close combat. This unconventional weapon makes it both unpredictable and dangerous.

entry: 无需进屋，隔着孩子的窗户就能食梦，让沉睡者完全察觉不到它。
author: .izik
source: From outside a child's window, it feeds on dreams without needing to enter the room. This eerie ability leaves its presence unnoticed by those asleep.

entry: 双翼锋利，能将大理石干净切开。精准的斩击让它在空中十分可怕。
author: .izik
source: Its wings are so sharp they can slice cleanly through marble. This precision makes it a terrifying opponent in flight.

entry: 起飞前，POKENAME会扇动翅膀，帮助自己在地面蹦跳。它们捡来细枝，在背上的种子周围筑起保护巢，可巢一飞就散，常把它们气得不轻。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their wings to aid in leaping around the ground before they take flight. They gather twigs to build protective nests around the bulbs on their backs, but grow frustrated when they fall apart during flight.

entry: POKENAME头上的翅膀让它轻松翱翔。据说它会现身在梦想飞行的人类与宝可梦面前。
author: Mistymagius
source: The wings on POKENAME's head allow it soar effortlessly across the sky. It is said that POKENAME will appear in front of people and Pokémon who dream of flight.

entry: POKENAME是小小的鸟宝可梦，随风飘向想去的地方。平凡外表下，却藏着尚未显露的力量。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Its bland appearance belies a hidden power that hasn't been seen yet.

entry: POKENAME是小小的鸟宝可梦，随风飘向想去的地方。金色尾羽似乎藏着远古力量。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Its golden tail feathers seem to hold an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME是小小的鸟宝可梦，随风飘向想去的地方。外形虽平凡，却闪耀得比太阳更亮。
author: Smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Even though its look is bland, it sparkles brighter than the sun.

entry: POKENAME的金色羽毛备受追捧，据说藏着尚未唤醒的力量。它比同伴更鲁莽，总把自己置于险境。
author: Mistymagius
source: The golden plumage of POKENAME is highly sought after, as it is said to contain latent power. POKENAME is more reckless than its flock, constantly putting itself in danger.

entry: 敏锐双眼观察四周，周身散着奇异气息。荒诞传闻称，这份神秘的存在感能影响别人的思想。
author: jaminmcready
source: It uses its keen eyesight to observe its surroundings while exuding a strange aura. Wild tales suggest it can influence others' thoughts with its cryptic presence.

entry: 大多数POKENAME住在城市，栖在办公楼边，对路人嘀嘀鸣叫。
author: .realthree
source: Most POKENAME live in cities. They perch along office buildings, beeping and chirping at passersby.

entry: 身体大，食量小，心思却很巧。会斩下整根树枝，再以独一只翅膀扫开叶子，寻找藏着的虫宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Large in size but meager in appetite, it is nonetheless crafty. It slashes whole branches off trees, then sweeps away the leaves with its singular wing to find the bug Pokémon hidden within.

entry: POKENAME化石常被错当成始祖小鸟。如今，它是陆地与天空中最凶猛的捕食者之一。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME fossils are often mistaken for Archen. In the modern day, POKENAME is one of the most ferocious predators on land and in the sky.

entry: POKENAME从高空巡视辽阔领地。雨后会聚在茂密森林，大口吃土。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME patrols its vast territory from the sky. They gather in lush forests after it rains to feast on soil.

entry: 常忘了自己不会飞，竟从树上跳下尝试起飞。羽毛极锋利，会与其他POKENAME较量谁的羽毛更利。
author: Mistymagius
source: It tends to forget that it cannot fly so it will sometimes throw itself out of trees in an attempt to take off. Its feathers are incredibly sharp, and it will fight with other POKENAME to see whose feathers are sharper.

entry: 科学家争论POKENAME究竟是鸟、爬行动物、龙，还是恐龙。可致命的手爪、喙、牙齿与脚爪，比钢铁更锋利，毫无疑问。
author: Ozydamians
source: Scientists debate if POKENAME is a bird, reptile, dragon, or dinosaur. There is no question, however, that its deadly claws, beak, teeth, and talons are all sharper than steel.

entry: POKENAME的聪明才智与庞大体形同样惊人。曾被观察到从高空投下尖石捕猎，再生火烤肉。
author: Ozydamians
source: Its impressive size is matched only by its cleverness. POKENAME has been observed to drop sharpened stones on prey from above and roast the meat over a fire.

entry: POKENAME头上众多触角同时发光、释放超能力，引来训练家与宝可梦。并没别的目的，只是喜欢作伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The many antennae sprouting from POKENAME's head simultaneously emit light and psychic energy. This is meant to lure in Pokémon and trainers alike for no other reason than it enjoys company.

entry: 耀眼光芒能迷住敌友双方，既用于自卫，也吸引猎物。
author: .izik
source: Its dazzling lights captivate both friends and foes, mesmerizing those who watch. This light show serves as both a defense and a way to attract prey.

entry: POKENAME每条触手的末端都能发光。聚在一起时，会按特定方式旋转、亮灯，跳着仪式般的舞，目的仍不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each end of their tentacles can light up. When several POKENAME gather together, they perform some kind of ritualistic dance, twirling and lighting up their tentacles in a very particular fashion. Scientists are unsure of its purpose.

entry: POKENAME随洋流漂荡，五条带电手臂向四周伸展，寻找猎物麻痹捕捉。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME drifts through the currents, its five electrified arms floating in every direction in search of prey to paralyze and capture.

entry: POKENAME毛间的发光球既能散热，又会放出温暖柔和的光，而且长得很快。人们常把它们剪下来，制作彩灯与冬季节庆的装饰。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's fur bulbs produce heat and a warm, comforting light. They also regrow fast, so they're often shorn off to make fairy lights and winter holiday decorations.

entry: POKENAME水下遇险，会将尾巴当临时拳头。可尾巴太软，打到敌人后通常又弹了回来。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When threatened underwater, POKENAME will use their tails as makeshift fists. Their tails however are squishy, so it commonly bounces off of the opponent.

entry: POKENAME信任其他宝可梦与训练家，会亲昵蹭鼻问候。水下探险队常与它们交友，请它们照亮深海。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME are very trusting with other Pokémon and Trainers, nuzzling with them as a greeting. Underwater exploration teams befriend these Pokémon to offer light in the deep ocean.

entry: 众多电诱饵在暗中闪耀，吸引看见亮光的深海宝可梦。再用发亮触须缠住猎物，以强电流将其麻痹。
author: CartoonHostage
source: Its many dazzling, electric lures attract any deep sea Pokémon that sees it shining in the darkness. It wraps its prey in its gleaming tendrils, paralyzing them with powerful electric charges.

entry: 喜欢让光穿透浓雾，照亮前路。水手常靠它引领，穿过雾气弥漫的水域。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon loves shining its light through thick fog, illuminating the path ahead. Sailors often rely on its glow to guide them through misty waters.

entry: POKENAME由高导电矿物构成，能感知大地磁场，在深海洞窟辨路。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is made of highly conductive minerals. It finds its way through deep underwater caves by detecting the magnetic fields of the world.

entry: 喷出发光泡沫，形成耀眼屏障，阻挡攻击者。泡沫碰到什么都黏住，让对方难以脱身。
author: .izik
source: It expels glowing foam to ward off attackers, creating a dazzling barrier. The foam sticks to anything it touches, making escape difficult.

entry: POKENAME互相闪耀胸前光纹较量，直到一方受不了强光，捂眼认输。
author: kiwikelly
source: Rival POKENAME fight by flashing the glowing patterns on their torsos at each other until one of them is forced to cover its eyes from the blinding light and admit defeat.

entry: 吃发光藻类，保持灯光明亮。健康的珊瑚礁依靠它维持生机勃勃的水下生态。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon consumes glowing algae to keep its lights bright. Healthy reefs rely on it to maintain their vibrant underwater ecosystems.

entry: 近处电击猎物，远处喷射水柱。熟练的POKENAME甚至能让水弹也带电。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It can electrocute prey at short range or shoot jets of water at them at long range. A skilled POKENAME can even electrify its own water projectile.

entry: 生病时，光会变弱，提醒其他宝可梦前来帮助。这细微的信号，让它在困境中也不孤单。
author: .izik
source: It glows dimly when sick, signaling to other Pokémon that it needs help. This subtle glow ensures it is never left alone during difficult times.

entry: 夜间，成群POKENAME滑过海面，远看如闪烁星河。水手认为，见到它们就会有好运。
author: kiwikelly
source: Pods of POKENAME glide over the sea at night and look like twinkling galaxies from afar. Seeing them is said to be a sign of good luck for sailors.

entry: POKENAME擅长捕捉小兽与鱼，很受渔夫和猎人欢迎。双尾如鱼叉迅速射出，猎物还未察觉它靠近，就被电倒。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are often kept by fishermen and hunters, as they excel at catching small game and fish. They can quickly launch their twin tails like harpoons, tasering prey before they even know POKENAME is upon them.

entry: 许多橡胶洗澡玩具都仿照POKENAME制作。真正的它却属于数字生命，泡水反而容易出故障。
author: kiwikelly
source: Many rubber bath toys have been fashioned in the image of POKENAME. Real POKENAME, however, are digital in nature and tend to glitch out when submerged in water.

entry: POKENAME携带的蛋电能巨大，本可为小镇供电数周，可惜它守护得太凶。
author: kiwikelly
source: The egg that POKENAME carries is full of so much electric energy that it could power a small town for several weeks, if POKENAME didn't defend it so fiercely.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身迷失在水下洞穴的潜水者面前，分享气泡里的空气。幸存者说，它还会领人回安全处。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME is said to appear in front of divers lost in the depths of underwater caves and share its air bubbles with them. Survivors say this Pokémon even guided them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME将幼崽护在体内充水的空腔里。亲子联手，能以最高15,000伏电力攻击猎物。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps its babies safe inside the water-filled cavity in its body. Together, they attack prey with up to 15,000 volts of electricity.

entry: 光芒如灯塔，为迷途水手指引安全方向。它不停游动，让远方始终看得见亮光。
author: .izik
source: Its lights serve as a beacon for lost sailors, guiding them to safety. It swims tirelessly, ensuring its glow is always visible from afar.

entry: 天生夜行，在黑暗中泛出柔光。森林浓密的地方最为活跃。
author: .izik
source: Nocturnal by nature, it glows gently in the darkness, providing faint illumination. It is most active in heavily forested areas.

entry: POKENAME不断优美摆尾，模仿火焰跃动。细心的训练家能从诱饵摆动快慢，判断它的心情。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME always waves its tails in beautiful patterns that mimic the movement of flames. Astute Trainers can easily tell POKENAME's mood from the speed at which its lures oscillate.

entry: 开心地随浪起伏，发光身体照亮周围水面。贪玩的模样很受海滩游客喜爱。
author: .izik
source: It bobs happily on waves, its glowing body lighting up the water around it. Its playful nature makes it a popular sight among beachgoers.

entry: 咬下时牙齿会发光，在猎物身上留下亮痕。独特的特征让它发动攻击后很容易被追踪。
author: .izik
source: Its teeth glow when it bites, leaving glowing marks on its prey. This unusual trait makes it easy to track once it has attacked.

entry: 毒液发出鲜黄光，警告周围远离。感到威胁时，光就更强。
author: .izik
source: Its venom glows a bright yellow, warning others to stay away. The glow becomes more intense when it feels threatened.

entry: 很久以前，毒液曾用于制作治疗晕船的药水。可古老配方如今早已失传。
author: .izik
source: Long ago, its venom was used to brew a potion that cured seasickness. The recipe for this ancient remedy has since been lost to time.

entry: 住在浑浊深水中，以自身发光辨路。在阴暗水域里，能轻松融进周围环境。
author: .izik
source: It dwells in the murky depths where it uses bioluminescence to find its way. In these shadowy waters, it blends in effortlessly with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下看不清，飞行路线杂乱，常撞上船与岸。烦恼时便潜入深水，那里视野更好。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME erratically fly around, often bumping into boats and shorelines due to its poor vision in sunlight. When frustrated, they dive deep underwater where they can see better.

entry: 会偷走小船的桨，搅乱水手们的工作。偷来的桨常被发现藏在水下洞窟。
author: .izik
source: It steals oars from rowboats, causing confusion among sailors. The stolen oars are often found stashed in underwater caves.

entry: 风暴中，尝试与雷击同步闪光。研究者十分着迷，却仍不知目的。
author: .izik
source: During storms, it tries to flash its lights in sync with lightning strikes. This habit fascinates researchers, though its purpose remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME尾上的大舌贝是寄生者，吸收神经信号来驱动电力。因此本体几乎毫无反应，只能靠大舌贝防身。
author: kiwikelly
source: The Shellder on POKENAME's tail is a parasite that absorbs POKENAME's neurological signal to power its electric abilities. POKENAME thus rarely ever reacts to anything and relies on its Shellder to defend itself.

entry: 三只宝可梦结伴分享电力，让整体更强。POKENAME向敌人喷带电水流，使其麻痹。
author: CartoonHostage
source: Three Pokémon have formed a bond to share electricity with one another, making the whole more powerful. POKENAME sprays streams of electrified water at enemies to paralyze them.

entry: 睡觉时，灯光有节奏地闪烁。柔和亮光引来小型宝可梦，在它身旁休息。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, it blinks its lights in a rhythmic pattern. This gentle glow attracts smaller Pokémon, which rest beside it.

entry: 会从口中吐出闪亮珍珠，散落海底，深受收藏家追捧。
author: .izik
source: It dispenses shining pearls from its mouth, leaving them scattered across the ocean floor. These pearls are highly sought after by collectors.

entry: 身体突然迸出刺眼闪光，扰乱敌人。借此迷惑捕食者，再迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: Blinding flashes of light erupt from its body, disorienting enemies. It uses these bursts to confuse predators and make a swift escape.

entry: POKENAME在水下洞穴挖隧道，沿途什么都吃。吃下的晶体让磁性变得极强。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME digs tunnels in underwater caves, eating everything in its path. The crystals it consumes make POKENAME strongly magnetic.

entry: 讨厌久晒，白天躲进阴凉水域。在安全的黑暗中，灯光会更明亮。
author: .izik
source: It hates prolonged exposure to sunlight and retreats to shady waters during the day. Its lights glow brighter in the safety of darkness.

entry: POKENAME能承受海洋深渊区的水压，靠自身发光观察深海。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME can withstand the pressure of the abyssal zone of the ocean. It uses its bioluminescence to see in the deep ocean.

entry: 关于POKENAME救出洞穴迷途训练家的故事很多。头顶球体照亮前路，载人到最近出口后，便在强光中离去。
author: sk372
source: There have been many a story of Trainers lost in caverns being rescued by POKENAME. Illuminating a path with the orb on its head, it carries them safely to the nearest exit, before leaving in a bright flash of light.

entry: POKENAME在最黑暗的水中用诱饵吸引宝可梦。对方一分心，就以反应不及的速度猛然咬住。
author: Elite01
