source: POKENAME uses its lure to attract unsuspecting Pokémon in the darkest waters. Once they are distracted, it latches on with its jaws faster than they can react.

entry: 若在漆黑深海看见两点微光，就赶紧游回水面，免得成为POKENAME的下一餐！
author: Phantom640
source: If you see two faint lights in the darkest depths of the ocean, swim as fast as you can back to the surface before you become POKENAME's next meal!

entry: POKENAME的发光诱饵形似猎物，能引来远比自己大的宝可梦。利牙连暴鲤龙的硬鳞也能刺穿。
author: Cartoon Hostage
source: Its glowing lures resemble prey, enticing Pokémon much larger than POKENAME. With its sharp teeth, it can even pierce the tough scales of Gyarados.

entry: 夜间，成群POKENAME常安静漂在小湖上。对阳光敏感，因此白天很少见。
author: kittyluv090
source: Groups of POKENAME can be found calmly floating atop small lakes at night. They are sensitive to sunlight, so they are rarely seen during the day.

entry: 传说，人们曾看见水下成群的POKENAME发出灿烂光芒，便将它们与岸边的神异现象联系起来，开始加以崇敬。它们其实十分爱玩，也很容易亲近同伴或训练家。
author: Markusknight
source: According to legends, people started revering underwater herds of POKENAME, seeing their bright lights and connecting them to supernatural incidents on shores. They are very playful and bond quickly to either their herd, or Trainer.

entry: 这头深水巨兽常被称为“海沟灯塔”。发光球体为海洋宝可梦引路，照亮深处。
author: lemage22
source: Often called the 'Lighthouse of the Trenches,' this behemoth Pokémon lives in deep waters. Its glowing orbs guide sea Pokémon and illuminate the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME用自发光的球体在深海引诱其他宝可梦。尖刺钩住猎物时，还会发出更强的光。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME use their bioluminescent orbs to lure other Pokémon in dark ocean depths. Their thorns can latch on to their prey, glowing brighter in the process.

entry: POKENAME身上的球体随情绪变化而亮起闪烁。触手上的球体则用来迷惑猎物与敌人。
author: ziggaway
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body will glow and flash with its change in mood. The orbs on the tentacles are lit up to confuse prey and enemies alike.

entry: POKENAME滚动时不断发电、积电。可控制不佳，常不慎放电，把自己也吓一跳。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME generates electricity as it rolls, building a charge with each movement. However, its poor control often causes accidental discharges, startling itself in the process.

entry: 电力很强，身体却承受不住，早已碎裂。碎块松松连在电力核心周围，遮盖核心，还不断喷出小团雷云。
author: sk372
source: Its electrical capability is strong, but its body lacks the strength to properly contain it. As such, its body has shattered, loosely connected to and covering its electrical core while puffing out small storm clouds.

entry: POKENAME体内的微电流会响应敏锐嗅觉。受威胁时能放电、放毒，可控制自己的本领不太好。
author: moga6
source: The small electric currents in POKENAME react to its strong sense of smell. When threatened, it can release both electricity and poison, though it struggles with self-control.

entry: POKENAME适应性强，战斗中难以预测。每次小小放电都能加深与训练家的羁绊，帮助控能，塑造未来的进化方向。
author: moga6
source: It is adaptable, making it unpredictable in battle. Every small bolt of electricity released strengthens its bond with its Trainer, helping POKENAME control its energy and shape its future evolution.

entry: 静止不动，储存电能。时间越久，能量越强，硬壳便泛着微弱电光，可能主动或意外放出。
author: moga6
source: It stays motionless, storing electrical energy within its body. Over time, the energy intensifies, causing its shell to glow with a faint electric charge, which can be released accidentally or intentionally.

entry: POKENAME吃饭时可能不慎放电。休息时也会漏电把自己吓醒，因此有时睡不安稳。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME may accidentally release a jolt of electricity while eating. It may have trouble sleeping sometimes, as POKENAME might leak electricity while resting, waking itself up startled.

entry: POKENAME的静电让分泌液也带上轻微电击。借此交流，却可能不小心电到朋友。
author: moga6
source: The static electricity in POKENAME charges the fluid it secretes, making it mildly shocking. It uses this to communicate but may accidentally shock its friends.

entry: POKENAME弹性十足的身体能储电。靠不断唱歌帮助控制能量，唱得越多，身体越亮。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME's bouncy body stores electricity. It sings continuously to help control its energy, and the more it sings, the brighter its body becomes.

entry: POKENAME体内火与电尚不稳定。经过训练，却能成为直觉敏锐、配合出色的忠诚伙伴。
author: moga6
source: The fire and electric energy of POKENAME are unstable, but with training, it grows into a loyal companion with sharp instincts and impressive teamwork.

entry: POKENAME靠艰苦训练疏导电能。一天不练，火花就会紊乱，甚至不受控制地放电。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME channels its electric energy during intense training. If it skips a day, its sparks grow erratic and it may discharge electricity uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，却存不住电，常不慎释放。发生后会快速转动手臂，稳住状态，补回失去的能量。
author: moga6
source: This energetic Pokémon struggles to store electricity, often releasing it by accident. When this happens, POKENAME spins its arms rapidly to stabilize and recharge its lost energy.

entry: POKENAME一边模仿别人的动作，一边积蓄静电。表演中受惊，就会突然冒出电火花，吓观众一跳。
author: moga6
source: It mimics the movements of others while building up static energy in its body. If startled during its act, POKENAME releases a sudden electric spark that surprises its audience.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在随身圆石里，集中电荷。可一兴奋，还是经常误放电。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME stores electricity in the round pebble it carries, which helps focus its charge. Accidental shocks are still common when it gets excited.

entry: POKENAME六条尾巴闪着电火花，散出舒适暖意。专注时能造出浮空火球与电球，可它们难以预测，常让自己也吃惊。
author: moga6
source: The six tails of POKENAME spark with electricity and give off comforting heat. When focused, it creates floating fire and electric orbs, though their unpredictability often surprises it.

entry: POKENAME小又没经验，很难镇定。受惊会弹出内脏，碰到就会挨猛烈电击。
author: Glacierwing
source: Due to its small size and inexperience, POKENAME struggles to maintain its composure. When startled, it ejects its inner organs, which delivers a nasty shock if touched.

entry: 谜拟Ｑ附身皮丘，形成了POKENAME。皮丘似乎不太舒服，但附身实际上帮助它控制电力。
author: Adoster
source: POKENAME is the result of a Mimikyu possessing a Pichu. While it seems unpleasant to Pichu, being possesed actually helps it control its electricity.

entry: POKENAME的电力与波导相连，能向外传递情绪。痛苦时，波导暴涨，释放不稳能量，电到周围的对象。
author: moga6
source: Its electricity connects to its aura, which allows POKENAME to share its emotions. In moments of distress, the aura flares, releasing unstable energy that can shock those nearby.

entry: POKENAME转动身体部件发电，储能驱动动作，不过有时受惊就会放出。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME generates electricity by spinning its body parts. It stores the energy to power its movements, but sometimes releases it when startled.

entry: 靠幻象模仿人类或宝可梦自保。可控制不足，过于兴奋或受惊时，会让幻象失准，也会不慎放电。
author: moga6
source: It hides behind illusions, mimicking people or Pokémon to protect itself. However, its lack of control can cause its illusions to falter and lead to accidental discharges when it becomes too excited or startled.

entry: POKENAME边表演边给羽毛充电，准备攻击。一步踏错，就可能误将电击放向四面八方。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME charges its feathers with electricity as it performs to prepare its attack. A misstep can send an accidental shock flying in every direction.

entry: POKENAME梦幻般的舞蹈让周围空气充满静电。据说凑得太近观看，就会感到轻微电击。
author: moga6
source: The dreamy dance of POKENAME charges the air around it with static electricity. It is said that those who watch its performance too closely may feel a faint, shocking touch.

entry: POKENAME生于废弃电子器件与垃圾，不断漏出轻微电击。垃圾般的身体带着淡淡异味，但不受挑衅便不会伤人。
author: moga6
source: Born from discarded electronics and waste, POKENAME constantly leaks small electric shocks. Its trash-like body emits a faint smell, though it does no harm unless provoked.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嬉戏对打，却常兴奋过头，麻痹较弱的玩伴。若对手更强，反倒可能把自己麻痹。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME enjoy play fighting but often get too excited and paralyze weaker Pokémon. Against tougher playmates, POKENAME may end up paralyzing itself.

entry: POKENAME常忘记为何开始冒火花，发呆时便不慎放电。性情悠闲，容易亲近，可突发电击又让人措手不及。
author: moga6
source: It often forgets why it started sparking, accidentally releasing electricity while daydreaming. Its relaxed nature makes POKENAME approachable, but its sudden shocks can catch others off guard.

entry: POKENAME存不住电，意外释放的电力会给磁性身体充电。电荷越强，吸来的金属越多，常黏满身体两侧。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME struggles to retain its electricity, causing accidental bursts of power that charge its magnetic body. The stronger the charge, the more metallic objects it attracts, often becoming stuck to its sides.

entry: POKENAME球状身体的内部，竟违背几何常理：从里面看，比从外面看还要大。
author: .realthree
source: The interior of POKENAME's sphere defies geometric principles: It's larger on the inside than it is on the outside.

entry: 吃砂砾帮助消化，在坚韧体内磨碎。这份饮食也让岩石般的外层更加坚硬。
author: .izik
source: It consumes gravel to aid in digestion, grinding it down within its tough body. This diet also contributes to the hardening of its rocky exterior.

entry: POKENAME的双翼映着收集的星光，闪闪发亮。有人相信它来自太空，以亮翼作伪装。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's wings glitter with the captured light of stars. Some believe that POKENAME came from space, its sparkling wings acting as camouflage.

entry: 地方传闻称，POKENAME常出现在月球碎片落下之处。谁吵醒它，便会被毫不犹豫地咬住。
author: ._term.
source: According to local rumors, POKENAME are often seen in places where some moon pieces have fallen. It won't hesitate to bite anything that awakens it.

entry: 偷走旅人的帽子垫巢。帽子越精巧，在它不断增加的收藏中就越珍贵。
author: .izik
source: It steals hats from passing travelers to line its nest. The more elaborate the hat, the greater its value in this Pokémon's growing collection.

entry: 趁旅人熟睡，偷偷咬断鞋带，偷去筑巢，常让人醒来摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: While travelers sleep, it sneaks in to gnaw off and steal their shoelaces to build its nest. This peculiar habit leaves many waking up in confusion.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在月光下玩，可几分钟就累。若找到月之石，就会向大家炫耀，抛来抛去。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME love playing in the moonlight, but tend to get tired after a few minutes. If one finds a Moon Stone, it will show it off to others and toss it around.

entry: 沿螺旋挖出复杂地洞。蜿蜒道路既是家，也能迷惑闯入者，作为防御。
author: .izik
source: It digs in spiral patterns, creating intricate burrows beneath the earth. These twisting paths serve as both a home and a defense, confusing potential intruders.

entry: 撕碎树皮，铺成柔软舒适的巢。无论走到哪里，都能有个舒服的休息处。
author: .izik
source: It shreds tree bark to build comfortable bedding, creating soft nests. This habit ensures it always has a cozy place to rest, no matter where it travels.

entry: POKENAME在强月光下泛粉红光，速度也稍快。只在晴夜的火山附近活动，因此难得一见。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME glow pink in strong moonlight, and will move a bit faster than normal. Due to only being active near volcanoes on clear nights, this Pokémon is not often seen.

entry: 不喜欢浓烈气味，会避开鲜花与香食物。偏爱气味平淡的地方，对环境十分挑剔。
author: .izik
source: Strong scents bother it, causing it to avoid flowers or fragrant foods. It prefers areas with neutral smells, making it quite particular about its environment.

entry: 蜷在空树干内睡觉，寻求温暖安全。身体小，能挤进其他宝可梦避开的缝隙。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps curled up inside hollow tree trunks, seeking warmth and safety. Its small size allows it to squeeze into spaces other Pokémon avoid.

entry: 用小拳头从洞壁敲下化石，收集起来，骄傲地展示在巢里，证明力量。
author: .izik
source: It collects fossils, breaking them free from cave walls with its small fists. These treasures are proudly displayed in its nest as a sign of strength.

entry: POKENAME不停梳理头顶粉色毛团。哪怕一根没摆好，也不肯出巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly grooms the pink puff of fur on its head. It refuses to leave its nest if even a single strand is out of place.

entry: POKENAME在满月下聚集，周围便电花飞舞。每只火花颜色不同，场面既迷人又危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: When groups of POKENAME gather under the full moon's light, sparks fly in the vicinity. The color of each spark varies from POKENAME to POKENAME, so their displays can be just as mesmerizing as they are dangerous.

entry: 吃落叶助燃腹中火焰，暖着身体。找到的叶子越多，火焰就越热。
author: .izik
source: It consumes fallen leaves to fuel the flame within its belly, keeping it warm. The more leaves it finds, the hotter its flame becomes.

entry: 夜间呆望天空，数星星数到睡着。安宁的习惯，让它总能平静入眠。
author: .izik
source: At night, it stares blankly at the sky, counting stars until it falls asleep. This calming routine ensures it always drifts off peacefully.

entry: 学着植物一动不动，避开威胁。怕雨，乌云一聚就赶紧躲藏。
author: .izik
source: It mimics the behavior of plants, standing still to avoid threats. Rain frightens it, and it seeks cover whenever storm clouds gather.

entry: 会偷工地工具恶作剧，搅得工人一团乱，让施工队困惑不已。
author: .izik
source: As a prank, it steals tools from construction sites, causing chaos among workers. These antics often leave construction crews baffled.

entry: 吃毒草强化体内毒囊。日久毒性越来越强，自己也越发危险。
author: .izik
source: By eating poisonous plants, it strengthens the poison sacs within its body. This diet makes it more dangerous over time, with its toxins becoming increasingly potent.

entry: 以可爱魅力让敌人放松戒心，再突然出击。狡猾的性子，让它很难被智取。
author: .izik
source: Its charm lulls enemies into a false sense of security before it strikes unexpectedly. This deceptive nature makes it a tricky opponent to outwit.

entry: 吃洞中苔藓，尤其喜欢有淡淡甜味的发光种类。独特食物让尖刺在暗处也泛微光。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on cave moss, preferring the glowing variety for its subtle sweetness. This unique diet make its spikes glow faintly in dark environments.

entry: 持续摄取金属矿石，强化体内金属骨骼。身体更耐打，日久还会隐隐发亮。
author: .izik
source: It consumes metal ore to strengthen the metallic skeleton within its body. This steady intake ensures its durability and gives it a slight shimmer over time.

entry: 虽然向月亮许愿，面对敌人却满怀恶意。许多人相信，满月下与它相遇便会有厄运。
author: .izik
source: Though it makes wishes to the moon, its intentions toward enemies are filled with malice. Many believe that misfortune befalls those who cross its path under a full moon.

entry: 粉红金属身体在月下闪耀，晴夜里格外美丽。闪亮的外层也能保护它，抵御夜间捕食者。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon's pink metallic body gleams in the moonlight, making it a beautiful sight under clear skies. Its shimmering exterior offers protection from predators during the night.

entry: 爱吃油脂，借此让体内火焰明亮燃烧。若不按时补充，火会变暗，自己也迟钝发冷。
author: .izik
source: It consumes oil with delight, using it as fuel to keep its internal flame burning brightly. Without regular intake, its fire dims, making it sluggish and cold.

entry: 偏爱沙暴中出行，借旋风掩护，悄悄移动，避开威胁。
author: .izik
source: It prefers traveling during sandstorms, using the swirling winds as cover. This behavior allows it to move unseen and avoid potential threats.

entry: 在沼泽间忽上忽下地飞，用难测动作迷惑捕食者。身手敏捷，浓雾也难不倒它。
author: .izik
source: It flies erratically through marshlands, using its unpredictable movements to confuse predators. Navigating through dense fog is no challenge for this agile Pokémon.

entry: 偷粗心旅人的珠宝，藏进秘密洞穴。日积月累，收藏往往能与寻宝者相比。
author: .izik
source: It steals jewelry from careless travelers, stashing it away in secret caves. Its hoard grows over time, often rivaling that of treasure hunters.

entry: 喜欢冷冻食物的脆口，吃前一定先冻好。其他宝可梦常惊讶地看着它享用冰冻点心。
author: .izik
source: It freezes its food before eating, preferring the crisp texture of frozen meals. Other Pokémon often watch in amazement as it enjoys frozen treats.

entry: 月光下容易兴奋，像螃蟹般四处爬动。奇怪的是，背上蘑菇日久有时会钙化成月之石。
author: Frokachu
source: It gets excitable in moonlight, and scuttles around like a crab. Curiously, its back mushrooms sometimes calcify and become Moon Stones after long periods of time.

entry: 鼻子极灵，天气未变就能察觉，是预测风暴的可靠伙伴。
author: .izik
source: Its nose is so sensitive it can detect changes in the weather before they happen. This ability makes it a reliable companion for predicting storms.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME常在山间寻找亮石，装饰毛发。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME can be found along mountains searching for shiny rocks to decorate their fur.

entry: 偷走毫无防备者的钱币，藏进隐秘洞穴。收藏常大到足以引来寻宝者。
author: .izik
source: It steals coins from unsuspecting victims, stashing them in hidden caves. This hoard often grows large enough to attract treasure hunters.

entry: 住在地下湖，能轻松穿行黑暗水域。隐秘家园让它免受捕食者侵扰。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in underground lakes, swimming through the dark waters with ease. These hidden habitats provide it with safety from predators.

entry: 一把把嚼宝石，享受脆口。珠宝商常为这份食量叫苦，店里被吃得一团乱。
author: .izik
source: It munches on gems by the handful, savoring their crunch. Jewelers often lament its appetite, as it leaves their stores in disarray.

entry: 突然出现吓住店主，再偷糖果溜走。顽皮的举动让它既添麻烦，又莫名讨喜。
author: .izik
source: By scaring shopkeepers with sudden appearances, it sneaks away with candy. These mischievous antics make it both troublesome and oddly endearing.

entry: 一饿就暴躁难管，常躲到地下深处。训练家很快就学会随身带点心，免得它闹脾气。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, it becomes cranky and difficult to manage, often retreating deep underground. Trainers quickly learn to carry snacks to avoid its tantrums.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又有耐心，很受孩子们欢迎。科学家认为，背上的奇特突起可能是成长关键。
author: Kianjp2013
source: POKENAME is a popular companion among children due to its playful and patient nature. Scientists believe the peculiar protrusion on its back may be the key to its growth.

entry: 用鳍将自己弹离地面。蹦得越久，积蓄的电能就越多。
author: Cartoon Hostage
source: This Pokémon uses its fins to propel itself off the ground. The longer it bounces, the more electric energy it accumulates.

entry: POKENAME摸着软而有弹性，核心却硬如岩石，让形状不易走样。难过时能一连哭数小时。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME may feel soft and pliable, but it has a rock-solid core that prevents its shape from deforming. It can cry for hours on end when upset.

entry: POKENAME原生于平柑岛，贪玩又爱挖洞。会挖浅穴，在草地和沙滩互相追逐，皮肤触感出奇有弹性。
author: Katie
source: A playful burrowing Pokémon native to Pinkan Island, POKENAME digs shallow burrows and can be found chasing one another through the grass and along beaches. Its hide is surprisingly springy to the touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME的玩偶里住着幼童灵魂。它整天陪玩，玩偶若被夺走，就会陷入绝望。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dolls are said to be inhabited by the souls of young children. It plays with them all day and falls into despair if the dolls are taken away.

entry: POKENAME靠长长的带电丝短途移动，借大地电场随风飘浮。若撞上宝可梦，丝的电荷便会将其击晕，自己趁机逃走。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: To travel short distances, it releases long strands of electrified silk. The world's electric fields give it the extra boost it needs to float on the breeze. If it bumps into a Pokémon, the silk's charge stuns them while POKENAME makes its escape.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，歌声又未发育好，难以自行觅食。只能靠可爱向人讨点心，或接受老练长辈留下的食物。
author: El Fail
source: Its soft, rubbery body and underdeveloped singing voice make it very difficult for POKENAME to forage for food. As such, it must feed itself by charming humans with its cuteness for treats or by accepting scraps from its more skilled elders.

entry: POKENAME小身子轻得能随风飘。碰到大型宝可梦，就会紧紧黏住，吸收静电。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's tiny body is light enough to float in the wind. Once it bumps into a larger Pokémon, POKENAME clings to it and absorbs static electricity.

entry: POKENAME极贪玩，会追着交到的朋友，想送出自己的红宝石。若送给你，你就会永远是它最好的朋友。
author: Mistymagius
source: Extremely playful Pokémon, POKENAME will pursue anyone they befriend trying to give them one of its red gemstones. If it gives you one, you will become its best friend for the rest of time.

entry: POKENAME住在森林高处的树冠，靠长臂在枝间荡行。若没抓稳，柔软弹性的身体也能保护它不受伤。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME lives high in the canopy of forests, swinging between branches with its elongated arms. If it does miss a branch, its soft and rubbery body prevents it from injuring itself.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: Katie
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: Katie
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: POKENAME身体极柔韧，受威胁就蜷缩着躲进蛋壳自保。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's body is extremely flexible. When threatened, it will curl up and hide in its egg shell for protection.

entry: POKENAME散发欢乐积极的气息，凭共感寻找心情相同的伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME emanates an aura of joy and positivity. POKENAME uses its empathetic nature to find others who feel similarly.

entry: POKENAME火焰色彩闪烁，通常呈红蓝色。特殊庆典很受欢迎，无论大篝火还是小蜡烛，都能帮忙点燃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME produces fire that twinkles in all different colors, usually red and blue. It's beloved at special occasions as a result, with it lighting anything from bonfires to small candles.

entry: POKENAME起初冷淡得让训练家感叹。耐心相处后会走出自己的壳，可等它放开来亮毒刺，训练家反倒怀念从前。
author: .fedoraman
source: At first, Trainers remark on how aloof a POKENAME can be. With some patience, it will come out of its shell, after which, Trainers come to miss when it would keep its poison barbs to itself.

entry: POKENAME常睡觉，为成长节省能量。可别吵醒，它会追着第一个看见的人猛冲，直到再次累倒。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME spends most of their time sleeping to conserve the energy that they need to grow. Waking a POKENAME is a very bad idea; it will run down the first person it sees until it tires itself out again.

entry: POKENAME会突然发作、施以暴力，因而饱受争议。训练家却坚称，它能读懂人心，只会对想害人的家伙出手。不过，关都与城都的法院，都不认可这种能力作为证据。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are controversial due to their violent outbursts, but their Trainers insist that POKENAME can read people's intentions, only targeting those who wish to do harm. Their alleged powers are not admissible in Kantonian nor Johtonian courts.

entry: 新孵化的POKENAME带着蛋壳碎片，多一层防护。壳虽脆，受惊时却能带来慰藉与安全感。
author: Rakunk
source: Newly hatched POKENAME carry pieces of their eggshell for added protection. Though fragile, these shells are a source of comfort and security when startled.

entry: POKENAME颈部与尾巴粘着的蛋壳硬如石头。谁对它微笑，就会向谁撒娇求爱。
author: .realthree
source: The eggshell stuck on POKENAME's neck and tail is hard as rock. It seeks affection from anyone that smiles at it.

entry: 常在高草中飘浮，为受伤宝可梦歌唱施助。据说与它同行，训练家会有好运。
author: curvingapollo
source: It can usually be found floating around in tall grass, singing to injured Pokémon in an effort to help them. It is said that traveling with this Pokémon can bring the Trainer good luck.

entry: POKENAME轻盈，能轻松滑翔，将欢乐带向世界。察觉谁需要帮助，就迅速飞去治疗。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's lightweight body lets it glide with ease, spreading joy throughout the world. It can sense when others are in need and can swiftly fly over to heal them.

entry: POKENAME靠对朋友的爱支撑战斗，能感知对手的每一份情绪。
author: foolish_weasel
source: In battle, POKENAME uses the love it has for its friends to persevere. It can feel every feeling its opponents feel.

entry: POKENAME常在美丽的地方休息。据说向它献上甜果的人，便会得到好运。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME can be found relaxing in beautiful places. They're said to bring good fortune to whomever brings them an offering of sweet fruits.

entry: POKENAME内心纯洁，正义感很强，常避开心怀欺骗或残忍的对象。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has a pure heart and a strong sense of justice, so much so that it often avoids those who hold dishonesty or cruelty in their hearts.

entry: POKENAME的彩色火焰，光是看见甚至闻到，就让人舒心喜悦。不知为何，家养个体爱看烟花，野生的却会避开巨响。
author: bobosmith01
source: The multicolored fire POKENAME produces brings a sense of relief and joy in all who see or even smell it. For some reason, domesticated POKENAME love watching fireworks, but wild ones avoid the loud sounds.

entry: POKENAME很亲训练家，却似乎没见过某些人就先记恨上了。一旦讨厌谁，就很难改变主意。
author: .fedoraman
source: Affectionate towards its Trainer, a POKENAME will seem to hold a grudge against certain people even before meeting them. Once POKENAME decides it doesn't like someone, it's very hard to change its mind.

entry: POKENAME常睡觉，为成长储能。只有信赖的人在身旁，才能安稳休息。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME spends most of their time sleeping to conserve the energy that they need to grow. They can only rest if they are in the presence of people they trust.

entry: POKENAME勇敢守护和平，坚决不与想制造纷争的对象合作。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are valiant defenders of the peace. They staunchly oppose collaborating with those who wish to cause strife instead.

entry: 蜕下脆弱蛋壳后，POKENAME比进化前更好奇外界。常与其他幼年宝可梦结伴，寻求安慰。
author: Rakunk
source: After shedding its fragile eggshell, POKENAME is much more curious of the outside world compared to its pre-evolution. It often allies with other young Pokémon for comfort.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，治疗许多受捕食者袭击的宝可梦。会高速游动，寻找需要帮助的对象。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are very kind creatures, healing many targeted by predators. It swims at high speeds, finding any Pokémon in need of help.

entry: POKENAME始终忠于心善之人。因此，恶毒的训练家可能会发现，它反过来背叛了自己。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is unfailingly loyal to those with a kind heart. As a result, spiteful Trainers may find that it betrays them.

entry: POKENAME以强烈凝视吸引路人，再表演、模仿逗大家开心。等玩腻了，便秀一招压轴戏，迅速溜走。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME's intense gaze draws the attention of passersby, when it will then begin to entertain and imitate them. When it grows bored, it performs a final grand trick before quickly fleeing.

entry: POKENAME在夜间无声飘行，小身体披着阴影。眼周花纹发光，性格又顽皮，会用超能力制造诡异幻象，捉弄旅人。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME drifts silently through the night, its small body cloaked in shadows. With glowing markings around its eyes and a mischievous nature, it plays tricks on unsuspecting travelers while using its psychic powers to create eerie illusions.

entry: POKENAME双翼尚未发育，不能用来飞行或跳舞。却仍会摇摆转身，迷住敌人，使其无法行动。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's wings are underdeveloped, so it cannot use them to dance or fly. However, it still sways and turns to fascinate its enemies into inaction.

entry: POKENAME十分善于观察，始终有一颗头留意周围。有些家养个体甚至能画出家旁地区的详细地图。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are a very observant species, making sure that one head is always taking in their surroundings. Some domesticated POKENAME can even draw detailed maps of the areas surrounding their home.

entry: 某些文化相信POKENAME创造了世界。它飞行时，身旁总伴着低沉雷鸣。
author: .realthree
source: Certain cultures believe that a POKENAME was responsible for creating the world. Deep, rumbling thunder accompanies its flight.

entry: 某些文化相信POKENAME创造了世界。它飞行时，身旁总伴着低沉雷鸣。
author: .realthree
source: Certain cultures believe that a POKENAME was responsible for creating the world. Deep, rumbling thunder accompanies its flight.

entry: POKENAME吸收太阳能量，助燃火焰。据说身后拖出的烟，是给其他宝可梦的信号。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME absorbs power from the sun and uses it to fuel its flames. It's said that the smoke that it trails is meant as a signal to other Pokémon.

entry: 能预见谁正靠近，随即瞬间移动离去。因此，曾被认为只是当地早期定居者编出的神话。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can foresee anyone approaching it, and it has the ability to teleport away in an instant. As a result, it was thought to be a myth created by early settlers of the region.

entry: POKENAME爱钻进一切找得到的狭窄角落。出了名地顽皮，却是向训练家表达亲近。
author: 1bridgeyboo
source: POKENAME are often found burrowing in any tight spot they can find. They are known for being mischievous, but this trait is a sign of affection for their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓刻着古文。语言史学者发现，文字记录了帝国兴衰：绿带讲繁荣，黄带记转折，红带则记载外敌入侵后的覆亡。
author: bollocksmen
source: POKENAME's vines are engraved with ancient text. Lingual historians revealed they chronicle an empire's story: green bands for detailing its era of prosperity, yellow for transitions, and red ones denoting the empire's fall to invading forces.

entry: POKENAME总是幸福，因为超能力只让它看见未来的喜事。可看不见悲剧，也让它常陷入危险。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is always in a blissful mood because its psychic abilities show it visions of happy events in the future. Its inability to foresee tragedy often leads it into danger.

entry: POKENAME站在峡谷高处，以羽毛感知风向，借此得知未来。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME stands at the top of canyons and uses its feathers to sense the wind's direction. It gains knowledge of the future in this way.

entry: 虽能预见所有灾难，却无力改写命运。静栖高崖，哀悼那些无法拯救的生命。
author: amiel997
source: Though it can foresee every disaster that will ever occur, it is powerless to alter fate. It perches silently on high cliffs, mourning the lives it is unable to save.

entry: POKENAME缓缓旋转的身体上，众多“眼睛”似乎只是花纹。有人因此认为，它其实靠预见未来来辨路。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: The many eyes on the slowly rotating bodies of POKENAME seem to be nothing more than markings. Some conclude that they must navigate by peering into the future instead.

entry: POKENAME如何学会古老文化中复杂的舞蹈，仍让考古学家困惑。有人认为它启发早期人类，也有人认为它模仿了部落舞蹈。
author: Rakunk
source: Archaeologists remain puzzled about how POKENAME learned the intricate dances of ancient cultures. Some debate whether POKENAME inspired early humans with its movements, while others suggest it might have mimicked tribal dances.

entry: POKENAME能看见未来，在沙漠中捕猎极少失败，因此与梦歌仙人掌是最大的竞争对手。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME have the ability to see the future. They use this ability to ensure they rarely fail at capturing prey in the deserts where they live. Because of this, Cacturne are their greatest rivals.

entry: 凭超能力，POKENAME比梦歌仙人掌更善于沙漠狩猎。后者偶尔会扮成它们嘲弄。传说装久了，竟会真以为自己就是POKENAME，甚至觉醒能力。
author: odditylad
source: Due to their psychic abilities, POKENAME are superior desert hunters compared to Cacturne. Occasionally, Cacturne will dress up as POKENAME to mock them. These Cacturne are rumoured to begin thinking they are POKENAME and develop abilities.

entry: 据说，年长的POKENAME，是沙漠中的先知。它们沐浴炽热，凝望太阳，便能知晓沙漠近日的往事与将临的未来，只是预言总说得晦涩难解。
author: entomoxie
source: An older POKENAME is said to be a desert oracle. By basking in the heat and looking into the sun, they can tell what recently happened in this desert and what is to come in the near future. These predictions are quite cryptic.

entry: POKENAME以宝石般的骨头摩擦毛发，产生静电。很多人都说，抱着它十分舒服。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME rubs its gem-like bones against its fur to create static electricity. According to many, it gives great hugs.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，能长时间不停奔跑。前角如探测棒，能感知哪里正发生雷暴。
author: Gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME are generally very energetic and can run for long periods of time without stopping. They are able to sense where thunderstorms are happening using their front horns like divining rods.

entry: 摩擦毛绒手掌，聚起大量静电，造出雷球掷向敌人。尾端球体还能释放强大超能力脉冲，将对手击晕。
author: sk372
source: It rubs its woolly palms together to gather immense amounts of static electricity, creating powerful orbs of lightning to hurl at foes. The orb on its tail can emit powerful stunning psychic pulses to further incapacitate opponents.

entry: POKENAME靠强静电悬浮，随风旅行。曾有数名训练家碰到被阵风吹偏的个体，遭到电击。
author: Alumed
source: POKENAME generate a powerful static charge that they use to hover above the land and travel using the winds. Several Trainers have been electrocuted after making contact with a POKENAME that was blown off-course by a sudden gust.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME从草甸上空飘过，让城都草原泛着微光。闪烁的亮光让它们能远距离交流。
author: tuneless.towa
source: At night, the meadows of Johto glow faintly with the lights of POKENAME drifting overhead. These flickers let them communicate over great distances.

entry: 战斗或狩猎前，会猛擦羊毛，体内积起的静电流到伸缩长舌上，电得敌人与猎物屈服。
author: sk372
source: It rubs the wool on its body vigorously before a battle or hunt. The static charge this creates internally coats its extendable tongue in electricity, allowing it to shock foes or prey into submission.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴当麦克风唱歌发电。一首歌产生的电波，就足以为智能手机充满电。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME generate energy by singing, using their tail as a microphone to amplify their voice. The resulting electric waves are strong enough to fully charge a smartphone with just one song.

entry: 情绪强烈时，外层会自行发光、带电，有时还会悬浮，因此常被误认成球状闪电或鬼火。
author: Staghorn
source: Its bioluminescent coating glows and becomes charged when it feels strong emotions. The resulting charge occasionally causes it to levitate; as a result, it is often mistaken for ball lightning or will-o-wisps.

entry: POKENAME头上的羊毛产生大量静电，充入尾珠，使其明亮发光。会引好奇路人进林子，盼着交朋友。
author: Arcul
source: The fleece on POKENAME's head generates abundant static electricity. It uses this energy to charge the orb on its tail so it can glow brightly, drawing curious passersby into the woods in hopes of making friends.

entry: POKENAME混进咩利羊群，想悄悄偷一只来吃。可有时自己反倒被捕食咩利羊的敌人盯上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME infiltrates herds of Mareep in an attempt to clandestinely steal one away to eat. However, this behavior sometimes causes it to be targeted by Mareep's predators.

entry: POKENAME借毛中的静电增强念力。群体积电发出的光，数英里外都能看见。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It builds up its psychokinetic abilities through the static electricity in its wool. A herd of POKENAME can be seen from miles away from the light they emit from their static buildup.

entry: 随身银勺如瞄准器，引导电击，精准到能命中100码外的目标。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The silver spoon it carries with it acts as a crosshair aiming its electrical attacks. It can aim its attacks so precisely it can hit a target from 100 yards away.

entry: POKENAME的华丽羽冠与宽大翅膀，能让种子免受地面上的威胁。它们大部分时间都在空中飞翔，展开双翅，让阳光照到种子上。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's plume of feathers and large wings protect their bulbs from any threats on the ground. They spend most of their time flying through the air, spreading their wings to let sunlight shine down on their bulbs.

entry: 洁净的雪日，能见华美的POKENAME飞行，蓝羽泛着美丽蓝光。俯冲捕猎时，双翼会覆上细小冰晶。
author: Mistymagius
source: These gorgeous POKENAME can be seen on pristine, snowy days, its blue feathers radiate a beautiful blue glow as it flies. As it swoops down to catch their prey, their wings become coated in small ice crystals.

entry: 它的狩猎方式与同伴截然不同：先用华美的羽毛引诱猎物，再以锋利的爪子将其撕碎。
author: cheroace
source: It sets itself apart from its flock with its unique hunting method. It lures prey in with its gorgeous feathers and tears them apart with its sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME以3马赫飞行，掀起毁灭性狂风，吹倒大片森林。头顶灿烂羽饰，令大小宝可梦都赞叹。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fly at Mach-3 speeds, causing devastating windstorms that knock down large sections of forest. The plumage on its head is admired by Pokémon of all sizes for its brilliance.

entry: 散发异界般的强大能量，扰乱周围的注意力。传说它飞过时，能让人看见蕴含古老知识的幻象。
author: jaminmcready
source: This powerful Pokémon emits an otherworldly energy that disrupts the concentration of those nearby. Legends say its flight can inspire visions of ancient knowledge.

entry: POKENAME讨厌受打扰，睡觉时尤其如此。其他宝可梦若靠得太近又太吵，蛇尾便会注入强毒。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME do not like being disturbed, especially when they sleep. When other Pokémon get too close and too loud, the serpentine tail will inject potent venom into the disturbance.

entry: 每根羽毛都带强磁，脱落后也一样。因此，它的数码影像总有一层“光晕”。
author: Staghorn
source: Each of its feathers holds a potent magnetic charge, even after being shed. Digital recordings of it consistently have a "halo" effect, as a result.

entry: POKENAME常从高空俯冲，以利爪踢出重击。猎物的同伴还没反应，目标便被抓走，只剩混乱与羽毛。
author: Frink202
source: POKENAME usually swoop down from on high before delivering devastating kicks with their talons. They abduct their prey before their peers can even react, leaving nothing but confusion and feathers behind.

entry: 以利爪与天降雷电守护领地。赢得它信任，就能获得忠诚的伙伴。
author: garret95
source: It protects its domain with sharp claws and by unleashing electric bolts from the sky. Those who win its trust are rewarded with a loyal companion.

entry: POKENAME与训练家的羁绊深得仿佛心灵感应。察觉对方遇险，就可能挣出精灵球，将威胁烧成灰烬。
author: octolinggrimm
source: POKENAME forms a bond with its Trainer so strong it could be mistaken for telepathy. If it senses that its Trainer is in danger, it is liable to break free from its ball and burn the threat to ashes.

entry: POKENAME展着雄伟双翼翱翔，通常守护古遗迹，以诡异强风吓退闯入者。
author: NightwingJay
source: POKENAME soars through the skies with its majestic wings. POKENAME typically guard ancient ruins where they will create eerie and powerful winds to scare off any intruders.

entry: 羽毛光滑闪亮，如黑曜石。枕下一根，就能暖上一整夜。
author: Ozydamians
source: Its feathers shine like sleek obsidian. A single plume under your pillow can keep you warm throughout the night.

entry: 晴天，羽毛如彩虹闪耀。据说中世纪最负盛名的手稿，便用POKENAME的羽毛笔书写。
author: Ozydamians
source: On sunny days, its feathers glow like a shimmering rainbow. In medieval times, the most illustrious manuscripts were said to be penned with POKENAME quills.

entry: 相伴最久的两位朋友融合后，首次载着训练家升空，常令人心潮飞扬。这份共享喜悦，让POKENAME尾焰在往后每场战斗都明亮燃烧。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Many a Trainer's heart has soared as the fusion of their two oldest friends carries them skyward for the first time. This shared joy keeps POKENAME's tail flame blazing brilliantly through all of the battles to come.

entry: 一位异国冠军曾用POKENAME的烈风火海，驱散5级飓风。野生个体有时会被错当成划过夜空的流星。
author: Ozydamians
source: A foreign champion once dissipated a Category 5 hurricane with a POKENAME's gale-force inferno. Wild POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for meteors streaking across the night sky.

entry: 常被错认成异色咩利羊。可羊毛厚度与放电电压，都更接近茸茸羊。
author: Staghorn
source: It's commonly mistaken for a Shiny Mareep. The thickness of its wool and the voltage of the electricity it generates, however, is much closer to that of a Flaaffy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢静电的感觉，会用毛和舌头摩擦各种表面，转移电荷。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves the feeling of static electricity, so POKENAME rubs its wool and tongue against various surfaces to transfer electrical charges.

entry: POKENAME分泌的油导电极强，既让毛发闪亮，也能增强攻击，还被用于某些电池。
author: Gamblebreaker
source: The oil that POKENAME secretes is incredibly conductive, making it not only useful for its shiny coat but also empowering its attacks. It has also been used as a component in some batteries.

entry: 头部羊毛积起的静电会刺激大脑，增强超能力。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: The static electricity it builds up in the fleece around its head stimulates its brain, amplifying its psychic abilities.

entry: 每次挥拳，双拳都明亮发光。有些经过训练，能靠连续出拳闪光，传递摩尔斯电码。
author: Staghorn
source: Its fists glow brightly whenever it throws a punch. Some have been trained to communicate in Morse code via a series of punches.

entry: POKENAME开始疾冲时，会先爆出小而明亮的闪光，几秒后才传来雷鸣般的巨响。光在数英里外也能看见。
author: Frokachu
source: When POKENAME break into a sprint, a small but bright explosion occurs, followed by a thunderous boom seconds after. The light from this event can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME靠橡胶般的皮肤与晶球，能控制水中电力，也能通过球体传信，与同伴交流。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can control their electricity in the water thanks to their rubbery skin and crystal orbs. They can communicate with others in their group by channeling signals through these orbs.

entry: 中央金色核心据说能产生巨大能量，支撑防御，也赋予控雷能力。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: The golden core at its center is said to generate immense energy, powering its defenses and granting it the ability to control lightning.

entry: 振翅越快，尾巴越亮，还会发出响亮的电流嗡鸣，干扰电器。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its tail glows brighter the faster it beats its wings. They create a loud, electrical, buzzing noise that can interfere with electronic appliances.

entry: POKENAME心地不坏，野生个体却脾气急躁。先放光晃花周围的眼睛，再凑近一抱，足以压碎肋骨。
author: Meltan808
source: Although it's good-natured, wild POKENAME tend to have a short temper. It will blind anyone nearby with its ability to produce light, then close in for a rib-crushing hug.

entry: POKENAME常聚在灯塔旁岩床，被亮光吸引，夜间模仿光束旋转。涨潮后，守塔人得检查附近，数量太多会干扰水手。
author: merclipse
source: Often found in rock beds by lighthouses, POKENAME are drawn to their light, copying the rotation of the beam at night. After a high tide, lighthouse keepers should check for any POKENAME nearby, as too many may hinder sailors.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用微电流让泳者腿麻，却不伤人。但成群个体有时太亲热，不慎把人抬走，仍须当心。
author: roxie5228
source: The wild POKENAME is known for using gentle electric shocks to cause the legs of swimmers to tingle, but not hurt them. Be careful, though, because groups of POKENAME have been known to carry away people accidentally out of affection.

entry: 精细控制电力，能操纵脑波，改变被催眠者的记忆。发光球体引来目标，再悄悄重塑其思想。
author: amiel997
source: Using its fine control of electricity, it manipulates brainwaves to alter the memories of those it hypnotizes. Its glowing orbs lures in targets before subtly reshaping their thoughts.

entry: POKENAME被植物学家誉为奇迹。孢子触及植物便化为种子，生长速度最高可达正常十倍，也更健康。
author: lucasdesouza7
source: POKENAME is hailed as a miracle by botanists. Its spores, when contacting plants, transform into seeds that grow up to ten times faster and healthier than normal.

entry: 早晨在丛林采集种子，再一边荡过树间，一边向旅人投掷。
author: .izik
source: It spends its morning gathering seeds from plants throughout the jungle. It throws these seeds at travelers while swinging from tree to tree.

entry: 情绪受压时，身上的花便停止生长。沮丧时，更会枯干变灰。
author: .izik
source: If it experiences emotional stress the flowers on its body will stop growing. When depressed, the flowers will dry out and turn grey.

entry: POKENAME孢子能在险恶火山地带繁盛。身体虽看似沸腾，实际却只微温，碰了也安全。
author: galactak
source: POKENAME's spores prosper in harsh volcanic areas. Despite appearing to be boiling, its body is actually lukewarm and can be safely touched.

entry: 每到黎明，成群POKENAME便在花田奔驰。蹄中蕴含特殊力量，能大幅加快植物生长。
author: kittyluv090
source: Groups of POKENAME can be found galloping across flower fields at dawn every morning. Their hooves are imbued with a special power that greatly speeds up plant growth.

entry: POKENAME的花蜜甘甜醇厚，美味又似乎能安抚心绪。连暴怒的火暴猴喝一口，也会放松。
author: Phantom640
source: The sweet and mellow flavor of POKENAME's nectar is not only incredibly tasty, but it also seems to have a calming effect on those who drink it. Even a furious Primeape will relax after a single sip.

entry: 早晨采种，再细心种遍丛林。尾巴渗出的花蜜，会被喷洒在种下的植物上。
author: .izik
source: It gathers seeds in the mornings and takes great care to plant them around the jungle. The nectar that leaks from its tail is sprayed on these planted crops.

entry: POKENAME以花香引来虫属性宝可梦，再张颚整只吞下。消化猎物时，花色也会加深。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME lures in Bug-type Pokémon with the scent of its flowers, then it opens its jaw to swallow them whole. The colors of its flowers deepen as it digests its prey.

entry: 这根花束手杖借助鲜花与阳光的力量，能带来拨云见日、治愈轻伤等奇妙效果。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This bouquet staff uses the powers of flowers and sunshine to generate wondrous effects like parting clouds for sunlight and healing minor injuries.

entry: 看似羽毛的部位，其实是叶子。泡成茶，能迅速治好大多呼吸道疾病。
author: .izik
source: The feather-like portions of its body are actually leaves. A tea made from these leaves can quickly cure most respiratory-based ailments.

entry: 花蜜闻着像花香混着罗子果。片栗镇有家美发店，会将这香味加入洗发水。
author: .izik
source: The nectar that comes from the flowers on its body smells like a mixture of posies and Rindo Berries. There is a salon in Arrowroot Town that uses this fragrance in their shampoo.

entry: POKENAME花瓣分泌浓稠绿液，温热时带着树果香。即使沙漠极偏远处，也能借此引来猎物。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon's petals secrete a thick, green fluid that gives off a berry-like aroma when warm. POKENAME uses this scent to attract prey in even the most remote parts of the desert.

entry: POKENAME歌声能让周围草木与动物繁盛。据说会在严重污染的地方现身。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME's songs encourage flora and fauna surrounding them to thrive. It is said to appear in highly polluted areas.

entry: POKENAME伴着尾焰，跳激烈而繁复的舞，展示体能。世界各地的表演者都研究它的编舞，精进自己。
author: tuneless.towa
source: POKENAME displays its physical prowess by engaging in fierce, intricate dances with the fire blazing from its tail tip. Performers worldwide study its choreographies to improve their own.

entry: 不去狩猎，只懒懒躺在田里晒太阳。湿度高时，身上花朵最多能长至平常两倍大。
author: .izik
source: Instead of hunting, it will lazily lounge in fields soaking in the sun's light. During days with high humidity, the flowers on its body will grow up to twice their normal size.

entry: 傍晚在岸边缓慢而有条理地起舞。舞完，就在沙里睡下。
author: .izik
source: It performs a very slow methodical dance on the shoreline during the evenings. When it finishes its dance, it will fall asleep in the sand.

entry: POKENAME一滚起来就近乎停不下，五条弹尾不断碰撞反弹。为适应长久旋转，早已进化出强健的胃。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: Once POKENAME start rolling, they enter a state of near perpetual motion, ricocheting off surfaces with their five bouncy tails. They have evolved strong stomachs to handle the constant rotation.

entry: POKENAME防水的毛与浮尾很适合河流生活。常在急流边嬉戏，顺流游下，再沿岸跑回高处，重新来过。
author: Katie
source: With its waterproof fur and buoyant tail, POKENAME is well suited to its river home. They can often be found playing with one another near rapids, swimming down the fast-flowing water and scampering back up the banks to swim down again.

entry: POKENAME沿水面滑行，轻盈又不易沾水，始终不会浸入水中。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can be found sliding along the surface of bodies of water. It is hydrophobic and lightweight, so it never immerses.

entry: POKENAME最怕毛不湿润，从不远离水域。大半天都靠浮尾漂在水面。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates it when its fur isn't constantly moist and is never seen far from a body of water. It spends most of the day floating on top of the water with its buoyant tail.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极敏捷，以弹尾为支点四处跳跃，扰乱敌人。主要只是体形太小，才没能威胁更多宝可梦。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are remarkably agile in fights, using their springy tails as launching platforms to leap around and confound their opponents. Their small statures are the main thing preventing them from posing serious threats to more Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只有与人玩时才真活跃。即使这样，也更爱自己懒着，用超能力来玩。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME are only really active when playing with others. Even then, they prefer using their psychic powers to play while they loaf around.

entry: 前后摆耳储能，积足后便能猛力推进身体，跃上瀑布。
author: .izik
source: It wiggles its ears back and forth to store energy. Once it has enough power, it will propel its body with enough force to scale a waterfall.

entry: POKENAME在水中会用体内蓄火造出火焰气泡。栖息的河湖，水温能超过华氏1,400度。
author: Beatdoof
source: Whenever POKENAME spends time in the water, it creates fire-filled bubbles from the flames stored in its body. The waters of the rivers and lakes where it lives can reach over 1,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 能将身体蜷成球，在水面弹跳。可跳太久，就会严重头晕恶心。
author: .izik
source: It has the ability to roll its body into a ball and bounce across the water's surface. If it bounces for too long, it will get severe motion sickness.

entry: 覆身黏液带薄荷味。玉虹市有种能量饮料，便以它为主要原料。
author: .izik
source: The sticky slime that covers its body smells like mint. There is an energy drink made in Celadon City that uses it as a main ingredient.

entry: 花大量时间清洁身上泥污。毛里哪怕只有一盎司脏东西，也会难以入睡。
author: .izik
source: It spends a great amount of time cleaning mud and dirt off of its body. It has trouble sleeping if even a single ounce is on its fur.

entry: POKENAME常在喷泉与池塘玩耍，用长鼻朝路人吹彩色泡泡。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME are often found playing in fountains and ponds, blowing colorful bubbles out of its trunk at passersby.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: Katie
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: Katie
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: Katie
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: POKENAME体内空气太多，很难潜在水下。一睡着，便会慢慢浮上海面。
author: .izik
source: Due to the high amount of air in its body, POKENAME has trouble staying underwater. When a POKENAME sleeps, it slowly rises to the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME将逗乐伤心的宝可梦视为自己的王者职责，常用滑稽舞蹈让大家开心。
author: regula
source: POKENAME views it as its royal duty to cheer up nearby Pokémon when they are feeling sad. It often does this by performing a silly dance.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，少有对手或弱点。可天性友善，对几乎所有对象都和气，只有万不得已才会战斗。
author: Altius
source: POKENAME's incredible power makes it a Pokémon with few rivals or weaknesses. However, it is merely a friendly creature that is kind to almost everyone, only fighting when absolutely necessary.

entry: POKENAME两颗头不太会分享食物，却从不动粗。最好仍给它们各备一个食盆。
author: BlitzyDragon
source: The two heads of POKENAME struggle when it comes to sharing food but they never get aggressive. It's still ideal to provide each head with its own food bowl.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，不是弹尾端的球，就是乱挥手。附近有宝可梦溺水，便立刻冲去相救。
author: Markusknight
source: Its hyperactive and is always found either bouncing the ball on its tail, or flailing its arms. Whenever a Pokémon nearby starts drowning, POKENAME will rush quickly to help.

entry: POKENAME的厚脂在古时曾被制成灯油。虽烧得明亮，却很快耗尽。
author: .izik
source: Blubber from POKENAME was once used to create lamp oil in times long past. While it burns brightly, it is consumed quickly by a flame.

entry: POKENAME爱玩水上游戏，靠有浮力的尾巴，轻松漂在水面。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME is known to partake in playful water games and uses its buoyant tail to effortlessly float on the water's surface.

entry: 长触角极灵敏，能辨出不同深海生物沉闷的声响，弥补低下的视力。小小的脸，又让视野更差。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Its long antennae are remarkably sensitive, allowing it to detect and identify muffled sounds made by different deep-sea creatures. This compensates for its poor vision, which is exacerbated by the small size of its face.

entry: POKENAME不像树才怪一味僵直，会模仿树木随风摇动，随季节变色。可还是难让旁观者信它是树。
author: sk372
source: Rather than remaining rigid like Sudowoodo, POKENAME mimics realistic tree motions such as swaying with the breeze and seasonal color changes. It still has trouble convincing onlookers it is a tree, however.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢的事，莫过于一头撞上什么东西。身上绿色的大圆球看似植物，实则是坚如磐石的肌肉，让训练家给这些暴脾气的家伙取了个外号：“森林炮弹”。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME love nothing more than slamming into objects. While the large green bulbs on their body might look like greenery, they are in fact orbs of rock-hard muscle, leaving Trainers to call these hot-headed Pokémon 'Cannonballs of the Forest'.

entry: 夜里若见POKENAME顺河漂来，别与它对视。它会哄你登上前往来世的船。
author: kittyluv090
source: If you see a POKENAME floating down a river at night, do not make eye contact with it, as it will try to coax you onto its boat to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME躲在被毁森林中，给滥伐的伐木工一个教训。谁想砍倒它，灵魂就会被吸走。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME hides in devestated forests to teach lessons to lumberjacks about deforestation. It absorbs the soul of anyone who tries to cut it down.

entry: POKENAME动作极慢，常坐着不动，无意间成了很好的灌木伪装。缓慢的移动，连背上的东西也几乎察觉不到。
author: Glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is very slow and often sits still, which unintentionally makes a good bush disguise. Its movements are so sluggish that anything on its back barely notices.

entry: POKENAME兴奋爱玩，喜欢抛接球体、互相滚着传递。信任的训练家若做噩梦，就会将恶梦收进球里，帮对方解脱。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very excitable by nature. They enjoy juggling and rolling their orbs back and forth to each other. If a POKENAME trusts a Trainer who is experiencing nightmares, the POKENAME will contain the bad dream within its orb to aid them.

entry: POKENAME和善亲切，摆动球体，安抚躁动的人入睡。奇怪的是，对站着的人最有效，还能帮助维持平衡、提供保护。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very pleasant and kind by nature. They swing their orbs to soothe restless people to sleep. However, this technique seems to be most effective when their targets are standing up, granting them balance and protection as well.

entry: POKENAME喜欢满身泥巴在雨里跳舞，任雨点冲刷，同时兴奋地转动强劲的钳子。
author: D_Numeritos
source: POKENAME loves to dance in the rain while covered in mud. It likes to energetically spin its powerful pincers, as the raindrops wash over it.

entry: POKENAME睡在大睡莲叶上，喜欢做滑稽表情，逗人发笑。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME sleeps on top of large lilypads. It enjoys making people laugh with its silly facial expressions.

entry: POKENAME乐观开朗，体形又大，常在训练家学校陪孩子玩。察觉危险时，触角便会摇摆。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Because of POKENAME's positive demeanor and bulk, they are commonly found in Trainer Schools playing with children. Their antennae sway when they sense danger.

entry: 雌性POKENAME用背颚收集雨水，保持蛋湿润安全。雄性看似只在玩水，其实守着巢，入侵者一来便迅速重咬。
author: amiel997
source: Female POKENAME collect rainwater in their back jaws to keep eggs moist and safe. Males always seem to be playing in the water but are actually guarding the nest, attacking any intruders with a swift, crushing bite.

entry: POKENAME虽懒，却是丛林深处池塘的王。平时不是坐着，就是浮在水里吃草。
author: tigerinnenumarmer
source: POKENAME, while lazy, are the kings of their ponds deep in the jungle. It spends its time either sitting or floating in the water and grazing.

entry: 若在神秘池塘遇见POKENAME，赠它一件物品，它便会看透内心。心地纯洁，物品就被强化；若不纯，便会烧成灰，彻底失去。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If you stumble upon a POKENAME in a mysterious pond and give it an item, it looks into your heart.  If your heart is pure, the item is strengthened. If not, the item will be incinerated and lost.

entry: 受惊时，角喷出烟幕后就急忙逃走。可腹部太沉，只走得了短途，逃跑常不太成功。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When frightened, its horn releases a smokescreen and it scurries away. Its abdomen is heavy, so it only walks short distances, making its escape not very successful.

entry: POKENAME住在偏僻沼泽的水面附近。许多轻盈宝可梦在头叶上休息，可皮肤黏液却有剧毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: It lives near the surface of seclusive swamps. Many light Pokémon rest on the leaf on POKENAME's head. However, the mucus over POKENAME's skin is highly toxic.

entry: POKENAME结成巨大鱼群自保，通常完全避开争斗。可仍是千针鱼最爱的点心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME band together in giant schools for protection and generally avoid confrontation altogether. They are a preferred snack to Qwilfish.

entry: 虽有翅膀，POKENAME却不靠振翅飞行，而是控制周围空气推进、滑翔。常引领成群毽子草。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Though having wings, it does not fly by flapping. Instead, POKENAME controls the air around them as propulsion, allowing it to glide to its destination.  POKENAME are often found leading flocks of Hoppip.

entry: 它始终散发着新鲜葛拉西蒂亚花的香气，因此十分受欢迎。人们却常把它与危险、没有气味的反向融合体混淆。
author: LordKai1
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon, as it eternally gives off the smell of a fresh Gracidea. It's often confused with its dangerous, odorless reversed counterpart.

entry: POKENAME乘暖气流升上高空。叶片满是利刺，却不知为何让身体更适合顺风飞行。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME rides on warm air currents, lifting it high into the sky. Its leaves are covered in sharp thorns that somehow make its body more aerodynamic.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖水域，吃海底植物。色彩最耀眼的一只，是鱼群首领。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in warm waters and feed on undersea plant life. The POKENAME with the most dazzling colors is the leader of its school.

entry: 花蜜格外甘甜浓郁，常被采集出售，代替糖使用。
author: kittyluv090
source: The nectar in its flowers is exceptionally sweet and flavorful, so it is often harvested and sold as a sugar substitute.

entry: 暖季常见。鹿角会投出花朵幻象，分散捕食者注意，扰乱方向。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon is commonly found during the warmer seasons. Its antlers project illusions of flowers to distract and disorient predators.

entry: POKENAME只住暖地，藏在灌木与高草中，伪装成花，引来猎物。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME only live in warm environments. Hiding in bushes and tall grass, they disguise themselves as a flower to attract prey.

entry: 看POKENAME叶状翅膀上的褐斑数量，就能判断年龄。双翼全褐后会碎裂剥落，直到再也不能飞。
author: TeatedTiten
source: You can tell how old a POKENAME is by the amount of brown spots on its leaf-like wings. When POKENAME's wings get fully brown, they crumble and flake off until it can no longer fly.

entry: 装成头顶花朵的茎。确认无人看着，才移到阳光下，保持健康。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It pretends to be the stem of the flower on its head. When it's sure no one is looking, it moves into the sunlight to ensure it remains healthy.

entry: POKENAME爱在向阳草甸玩。太多天没直接晒太阳，就会十分虚弱。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME loves to frolic in sunny meadows. If it spends too many days away from direct sunlight, it becomes very weak.

entry: 受训POKENAME吃得好、身体健康时，会长出额外身体。花苞若长得太大，便脱落成为独立个体。
author: mx_wellman
source: Trained POKENAME are known to grow extra bodies when they're well fed and healthy. If a bud grows too big, it'll pop off and continue as its own individual.

entry: POKENAME虽像凶猛的蜈蚣王近亲，天性却温柔善良。乐于载孩子玩，走过的地方留下花朵。
author: Rakunk
source: Despite a close resemblance to its more aggressive cousin, Scolipede, POKENAME is known for its gentle and kindhearted nature. It delights in allowing children to ride on its back, leaving a trail of flowers in its wake.

entry: 冰雪刚开始融化，POKENAME便会现身。身上的花纹启发了许多春季和服设计。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears as soon as the snows begin to melt. The floral pattern found on it has inspired many spring kimonos.

entry: POKENAME整日寻找阳光。鲜艳花瓣则警告大家，它身带毒素。
author: elite01
source: POKENAME spend their days in search of patches of sunlight. Its bright petals are a warning of the toxins POKENAME contains.

entry: 夏季顺风大步跳跃、翱翔，同时不断散播恶臭的毒孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the summer, they travel in the direction of the wind, leaping and soaring in great bounds; all the while they spread toxic and foul-smelling spores.

entry: POKENAME用颈部花瓣蹭信赖的训练家，表达亲近。留下的花粉带矿物般性质，很难洗掉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME shows its affection to trusted Trainers by rubbing the petals on its neck against them. The pollen deposited this way has mineral-like qualities, and it's difficult to wash off.

entry: POKENAME用附近绒毛编成浮筏，乘暖南风越过海洋，飞向异国。
author: GentleSage
source: POKENAME craft hovering rafts from nearby fluff to ride warm, southern winds across the sea, flying to foreign lands.

entry: POKENAME头角长出浓密植物纤维，用纠结的绒毛抓住猎物与树果。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME grow thick plant fibers from the horns on their head. They trap prey and berries with the tangled fluff.

entry: 它虽不像大多数朋友那样会飞，乐观的心却从不动摇。格外高兴时，棉絮孢子还会迸起静电，噼啪作响。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though it can't fly like most of its friends, its upbeat spirit never wavers. Its cotton spores crackle with static when it is especially happy.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会洒种子，帮助新的草属性宝可梦生长，也治愈受伤个体。预言称，种子能将荒地变成繁茂森林。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME scatters seeds with every flap of its wings. These seeds help grow new Grass-Types and heal those that have been wounded. These seeds are prophesied to turn wastelands into lush forests.

entry: 运动队爱请POKENAME当啦啦队员。欢乐活泼的性格，连最可爱的妖精属性宝可梦也能媲美。
author: dragonessanimations
source: Sports teams love using POKENAME as cheerleaders. Their joyful and energetic personality rivals even the cutest Fairy-types.

entry: POKENAME常在平原蹦跳。刮风时，用强健双腿稳住自己。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME can be found bouncing on plains. It uses its strong legs to stay sturdy during windy days.

entry: POKENAME随季节乘风环游世界，洒下孢子。接触会造成细小割伤，呼吸时须当心。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME scatters spores as it rides the wind across the world seasonally. Contact with these can give tiny cuts, so take caution when breathing.

entry: POKENAME本体小，附肢像乒乓球，轻得宛如塑料袋般随风飞舞。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The lightweight POKENAME flies around in the wind like a plastic bag with its tiny body and ping pong ball appendages.

entry: POKENAME胆小，藏在棉田躲避目光。只在世界沉睡的夜里出来，在黑暗的安静独处中获得慰藉。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon that hides in cotton fields to avoid the gaze of others. It only emerges at night, when the world is still sleeping, finding comfort in the quiet solitude of the dark.

entry: POKENAME密度虽高，却能优雅乘暖风遍游世界。头上射出成束的绒毛孢子，将后代散播远方。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Despite their high density, POKENAME gracefully rides warm winds across the globe. They fire beams of fluffy spores from their heads, spreading their offspring far and wide.

entry: POKENAME白天晒着太阳，散播棉絮孢子。夜里则钻进地下深处，躲开天敌。
author: GentleSage
source: POKENAME spends its day basking in the sunlight and scattering cotton spores. At night, it burrows deep into the ground to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME一旦选好定居的地方，就再也挪不走。它会吸引来大群毽子鼠，在这里寻找安全的住处。
author: GentleSage
source: Once a POKENAME decides on a place to settle, it is impossible to remove. It attracts hordes of Jumplett that are seeking a safe place.

entry: 走到哪里，祸就闯到哪里。问题严重得让科学家正研究空中捕鼠器等对策。
author: Sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon wreaks havoc everywhere they go. It's such a big problem, scientists are trying to develop countermeasures like airborne mouse traps.

entry: POKENAME以堵住繁忙道路闻名，却也最适合守护重要物件，挡住窥探的目光。
author: Inksans201x
source: While it's notorious for blocking busy pathways, POKENAME is ideal for protecting important things from wandering eyes.

entry: POKENAME好奇得很，可探索大多数东西的方法，却是用强劲巨颚咬一口。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are extremely curious. Unfortunately, they investigate most things by biting them with their incredibly powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME靠体内器官掌握捕食者的睡眠规律，找准时机再去觅食。
author: Demonic_Garbage
source: With the help of its internal organ, POKENAME can track its predators' sleeping patterns. When the time is right, POKENAME scrounges for food.

entry: POKENAME爱啃小陨石，即使会伤牙。人们便借此判断哪些石头来自天外。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a strange habit of nibbling on small meteorites, despite the damage it does to their teeth. People use POKENAME to determine what rocks are extraterrestrial.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，身后拖着淡淡能量痕。能奇异地找到值钱物品，轻松偷走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME scurries about with incredible speed, leaving behind faint trails of energy in its wake. It has an uncanny ability to locate objects of value and can steal them with ease.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，藏在水边树上滑翔觅食，专找垃圾吃。热门观光海滩常受它们困扰。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME is very cheerful. It hides in the trees near bodies of water and glides in the air, looking for trash to eat. They're pests of the most popular tourist beaches.

entry: POKENAME冲动地咬一切带电物，从电线到电线杆都不放过。要改掉这习惯，得花很多心力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME impulsively bites into anything electrical, from wires to utility poles. Great effort and care is needed to break this habit.

entry: POKENAME入夜才出来偷食维生，力气大得能把别人家整台冰箱扛走。
source: POKENAME crawls out once night falls in order to steal some food to ensure its survival. It is capable of carrying an entire fridge out of somebody's home.

entry: POKENAME夜行，出了名地害羞。被看见时，身体猛闪强光，随后逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and notoriously shy. When spotted, they emit a sudden bright light from their bodies and flee.

entry: POKENAME夜行，出了名地害羞。被看见时，身体猛闪强光，随后逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and notoriously shy. When spotted, they emit a sudden bright light from their bodies and flee.

entry: 多年前，一部以POKENAME为主角的卡通一炮而红，闻名世界。如今，那个角色已成了全球最大动画工作室之一的吉祥物。
author: .fedoraman & sk372
source: Years ago, a world-famous animation first broke out with a cartoon starring a POKENAME. Today, that character is the mascot for one of the largest animation studios in the world.

entry: 会偷溜进野餐偷食，沿途酸液毁掉许多训练家的物品。态度又傲慢，惹得一大群人专门讨厌它。
author: epping_forest
source: It sneaks into picnics and tries to steal food, leaving a trail of acid that destroys the belongings of lots of trainers. Its arrogant attitude has made it gain a whole club of haters.

entry: POKENAME是自学成才、满怀抱负的画家，在热带栖息地的石头和树上作画。颜料用完就进城，偷美术店的颜料管，却只拿红、绿、蓝。
author: Jackster
source: Aspiring, self-taught artists, POKENAME paint on rocks and trees in their tropical habitats. When they run out of paint, they travel to local towns and steal paint tubes from art supply stores, but only in reds, greens, and blues.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩。但被交代无趣的工作时，就会懒散得提不起精神。
author: jreposo
source: POKENAME are active and playful. However, if they are tasked with something they don't find amusing, they become listless and lazy.

entry: 常被说悠闲、固执，又痴迷香蕉。传闻世上可能有一座POKENAME岛。
author: jreposo
source: It is often described as laid-back, stubborn, and obssesed with bananas. There are rumours that an POKENAME Island may exist.

entry: 目前被归作POKENAME的异色形态，有人却认为这才是原貌。它与刺球鳄的竞争已延续好几代。
author: jreposo
source: Currently classified as a Shiny form of POKENAME, this is thought by some to be its original form. Its rivalry with Cacdile dates back generations.

entry: POKENAME挥舞藤蔓的手和利刃，能在森林中迅速夺走生命。幸好，它更喜欢用它们抓取、切开水果和坚果。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's vine-swinging hand and blade can make for a swift death in the forest. Thankfully it prefers grabbing and cutting fruits and nuts instead.

entry: 尾端能射出利针，全身覆着薄薄合金层，抵御攻击。
author: .izik
source: It fires sharp needles from the end of its tail. A thin metallic alloy coats its entire body, protecting it from assault.

entry: 尾巴用来维持飞行平衡。末端哪怕轻伤，愈合前都会飞得笨拙。
author: .izik
source: It uses its tail to balance its flight. Should the end of the tail be injured even slightly, it will fly clumsily until it heals.

entry: POKENAME似乎认定，没有手就自己长出来。总会顽皮又开心地抓下高处树果。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: POKENAME seems to have decided that if they didn't have hands, they would grow them instead. They grab high-hanging berries with impish glee.

entry: POKENAME飘浮时，能听见数支笛子般的声音。速度越快，声响越强烈。
author: .izik
source: The sound of multiple flutes can be heard while a POKENAME floats. The faster it moves, the more intense of a noise can be heard.

entry: 融合中和了臭臭花毒蜜的致失忆效果，POKENAME的蜜理论上能安全食用。不过，多数人说味道糟透了。
author: bee4082
source: The amnesia-inducing effects of Gloom's noxious honey have been neutralized by fusion, making POKENAME's honey theoretically safe to eat - though most say that it tastes terrible.

entry: POKENAME靠众多肢体，在海滩爬得快得吓人，有时还会突然从棕榈树上跳下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME clambers down beaches at frightening speed thanks to its many limbs. It has been known to suddenly jump from palm trees.

entry: 头脑轻松就能完成复杂数学运算。阿罗拉科学家借它研究虫洞与其他现象。
author: .izik
source: Its mind has the ability to do complex math without much effort. Scientists in Alola utilize it to research wormholes and other phenomena.

entry: POKENAME奇形怪状，常被认成未知图腾的一种形态。来自哪里、如何在野外生存，都少有人知。
author: bee4082
source: The bizarre POKENAME is often mistaken for a form of Unown. Not much is known about where it comes from or how it survives in the wild.

entry: POKENAME拿得到什么就吃什么。吃足自身体重三倍的食物后，便埋进僻静向阳草甸的泥里，等待进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME will eat anything it can get its hands on. Once it has eaten enough food to match its body weight three times over, it will bury itself in the dirt of a reclusive sunny meadow, and wait to evolve.

entry: POKENAME虽顽皮，有些不走寻常路的园丁却极信赖它的独特本领，拿来帮忙务农。它播下的种子，似乎发芽快得多。
author: Rakunk
source: Despite its mischievous personality, some unconventional gardeners swear by using POKENAME as a farmhand due to its unique talents. Seeds sown by this Pokémon appear to sprout much faster than normal.

entry: POKENAME等进化时，主要靠阳光与晨露维生。通常会随身带块光滑卵石，不过为节省能量，很少走远。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME mainly relies on sunlight and morning dew to sustain itself while it waits to evolve. POKENAME will usually find a smooth pebble and carry it wherever it goes, though it doesn't typically move far to conserve energy.

entry: 晴日尽情玩耍，阴天就挖洞躲好。有时只看见POKENAME头顶的芽露在地上。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon frolicks and plays on bright sunny days, but digs a burrow and hides on cloudy days. Sometimes, the sprout on POKENAME's head is visible above the ground.

entry: POKENAME轻柔的双翼在田野间飞行时收集空气水分。旱月便化作细雨洒下，帮助其他草属性宝可梦的种子长大。
author: Katie
source: The wispy wings of POKENAME gather moisture from the air as they fly from field to field. In drier months, the water collected in their wings is showered out as soft rain, helping the seeds of other Grass-types grow to adulthood.

entry: POKENAME不在锻炼，就在日光下合成养分，一心要变得更强。连绵的雨天或雪天，最让它不快。
author: bobosmith01
source: If it isn't getting exercise, POKENAME is basking in the sunlight, synthesizing nutrients to get even stronger. It dislikes excessively rainy or snowy days.

entry: 小拳石双臂为这次融合开启了绝佳组合。POKENAME能移到最方便饮露的位置，也更易藏进地下。烈雀若来袭，就会被拳头“说服”改主意。
author: Lutrax
source: This fusion marks the start of a great combination in the wild. With Geodude arms, POKENAME can move to the best spot for its dew-based diet, and better hide into the ground. If attacked by a Spearow, POKENAME will punch a change of mind into it.

entry: POKENAME常爬上山顶，尽量靠近太阳。也喜欢雨水渗进皮肤裂缝。体内植物长大后，便必须蜕去岩石外皮。
author: Lutrax
source: POKENAME regularly climbs to mountaintops in order to be as close as possible to the sun. This Pokémon also loves rainy days as the water drips through the cracks in its skin. As the plant system within it grows, POKENAME must shed its rocky skin.

entry: 长舌多用来舔水，并非战斗。喝足后就找开阔田野晒太阳。POKENAME越圆胖，就越健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its long tongue is usually used to lap up water, not to fight. After taking in enough water, it will find a wide-open field and bask in the sun. The chubbier the POKENAME, the healthier it is.

entry: POKENAME会用茧的上半部分吸收阳光，加快进化。一旦进化完成，新的形态就会破茧而出，爆发出明亮的阳光。
author: sk372
source: The upper part of POKENAME's cocoon absorbs sunlight to fuel and hasten the evolution process. Once complete, its evolution will burst from the cocoon in an eruption of bright sunlight.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找新鲜土壤装进育儿袋，供孩子成长。亲代吸收的太阳能会渗入土中，再被幼崽吸收。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly seeks the freshest soil to fill its pouch for the sake of its child's development. Solar energy the parent absorbs will naturally filter to said soil and then be absorbed by its young.

entry: POKENAME晒足阳光便会变色。有些甚至燃烧起来，它们却乐在其中。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME change color when exposed to lots of sunlight. Some may even burst into flames, but they enjoy this.

entry: POKENAME以相同比例吸收阳光与火焰供能，胸前花纹随之发亮。花纹与脸周花瓣都能喷火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight and fire in equal measure for energy, the mark on its torso glowing as it does so. It can fire flames from this mark, or from the petals circling its face.

entry: POKENAME将太阳能转化为超能力，却因此疼痛，容易烦躁。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME converts solar power into psychic energy. This causes it pain, making it easily irritated.

entry: POKENAME将光合作用多得的太阳能存进头顶花中。性情乐观，晴日尤其开心。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores excess solar energy from photosynthesis in the flower on its head. It is a very positive Pokémon and seems to be especially cheery on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME藏在向日花怪群中，悄悄吸走它们的能量。即使如此，对谁仍都十分友善。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst other Sunflora, slowly draining their energy while they're unaware. Despite this, they are still very friendly to everyone.

entry: POKENAME虽强，却温顺友善，整天懒在繁茂花圃。某些地区认为，获赠它脱下的一片花瓣，就预示未来富足。
author: sk372
source: Though quite powerful, POKENAME are friendly and docile, spending their days lazing among verdant flowerbeds. Being offered one of their shed petals is considered a sign of a prosperous future in some regions.

entry: 讨喜，却常闹恶作剧。即使重伤，脸上的笑容也从不消失。
author: Inksans201x
source: While quite charming, It is often prone to mischief. Even when gravely injured, the smile on its face never falters.

entry: POKENAME连战斗时都朝着太阳，不必转身，也能对付任何方向的敌人。
author: Staghorn
source: Even in combat, a POKENAME will always orient itself towards the sun. It can fight opponents in any direction without turning its body.

entry: 能量来自头顶向日葵。尾巴会定期掉下营养丰富的种子，能烤成咸香点心。
author: kittyluv090
source: It gains its energy from the sunflower on its head. It regularly sheds the nutrient-dense seeds on its tail, which can be roasted into a salty snack.

entry: POKENAME伪装向日葵，融入田野与花园。若被捕食者发现，就展开藏起的双翼，高速飞走。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a sunflower to blend seamlessly into fields and gardens. If spotted by a predator, it reveals its hidden wings and takes off at incredible speeds.

entry: POKENAME爱在跃入战斗前，让太阳映在身后，摆个夸张姿势。战前晒得越久，招式就越声势浩大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to strike poses dramatically with the sun behind it before leaping into battle. The more it is allowed to bask in the sun before a fight, the more bombastic its moves become.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“温柔巨人”。弱小宝可梦跟随它，寻求友谊和保护。所到之处会长出花田，孕育完整的生态。
author: Rakunk
source: Often nicknamed 'Gentle Giant', smaller Pokémon tend to follow POKENAME around for their friendship and protection. Wherever it travels, entire ecosystems and flower fields sprout in its place.

entry: 尽量长久待在阳光下，因为皮肤一感受不到阳光，就会立刻剧烈头痛。
author: sk372
source: It tries to remain in sunlight for as long as possible. This is because it begins suffering intense headaches the moment it no longer feels sunlight on its skin.

entry: POKENAME白天爬山顶吸收阳光，夜里挖浅穴休息。睡在里面时，粗看只像一块普通石头。
author: Lutrax
source: During the day, POKENAME climbs to the tops of mountains to absorb sunlight. At night, this Pokémon digs shallow burrows to rest, and while sleeping in said burrows, it appears to casual bystanders as just a simple rock.

entry: 晴朗午后，山顶可能聚着无数晒太阳的POKENAME。可傍晚登山要当心，成群的它们会毫无顾忌地一路滚下。
author: Lutrax
source: If you happen to be on the peak of a mountain during a sunny afternoon, you could see a myriad of POKENAME enjoying the sunlight; however, be careful when climbing in the evening, as during that time herds of POKENAME may be rolling down carefree.

entry: 白天高速奔跑，尽可能让几个头晒着太阳。只有阳光消失，才会停下休息，等待下一缕阳光。
author: sk372
source: It runs across the land at high speeds during the day, keeping its heads in the sunlight for as long as possible. Only when the sun is hidden does it finally stop moving and rest, until it detects the next ray of sunshine.

entry: POKENAME整天四处播种。据说它聚集之处，周围总有最美的花园。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME spends its day planting seeds wherever it can. The most beautiful gardens are said to be around areas where this Pokémon gathers.

entry: POKENAME整天四处播种。据说它聚集之处，周围总有最美的花园。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME spends its day planting seeds wherever it can. The most beautiful gardens are said to be around areas where this Pokémon gathers.

entry: POKENAME视野达360度，偷袭者还未靠近，它就变形自卫。变形时通常保留眼睛原样，谨慎维持视力。
author: sk372
source: With 360-degree vision, those that try to sneak up on POKENAME will find it transforming to defend itself before they even get close. It typically excludes changing its eyes during transformation, so that it may retain its vision as a precaution.

entry: POKENAME发育中的身体虽受茧束缚，仍能靠轻盈与强翼主动避险。进化完成前，双翼一刻不停。
author: sk372
source: Despite its developing body being restrained by its cocoon, POKENAME can still actively avoid danger thanks to its light weight and strong wings. Its wings never stop moving until evolution is finished.

entry: 在湖面上方之字形飞行。振翅产生的大量静电，可用于战斗。
author: Schwaus
source: It can be seen flying in a zigzag pattern all across lakes. The beats of its wings generate a plethora of static electricity, which it uses in battle.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，视听敏锐，是偷食高手。别人只移开目光片刻，它就几乎无声地夺走一餐。
author: sk372
source: Quick fliers with superb senses of sight and hearing, POKENAME are experts at stealing food. One need only look away for a moment, and it will have snatched a new meal from them with hardly a sound.

entry: POKENAME振翅时，静电噼啪作响。移动忽快忽慢，碰到又会麻痹人，因此很难捕捉。
author: bobosmith01
source: The sound of crackling static can be heard when POKENAME flutters its wings. Catching one can prove difficult, as it moves sporadically and can paralyze others on contact.

entry: 它一扇翅膀，便能电死身旁飞过的虫宝可梦。黄昏时，大群POKENAME会一同演出绚丽的灯光秀。
author: Schwaus
source: The flap of its wings can electrocute other bug Pokémon it flies by. Large groupings of POKENAME create elaborate lightshows at dusk.

entry: POKENAME飞得太快，周围时间都慢了下来。因此，寿命比其他宝可梦长约50%。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies so fast that time slows down around it. Because of this, POKENAME's lifespan is about 50 percent longer than other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头骨坚硬，飞行又没准头，能严重破坏城市。它若铁了心，连强化玻璃也挡不住。
author: currentlymuffin (w/ help from ohok3441 & ziggaway)
source: With their hard skulls and erratic flying, POKENAME can cause severe damage to cities. Even reinforced glass can't withstand a determined POKENAME.

entry: 360度视野、超声波探测与精准飞行，让猎物几乎逃不开POKENAME的追猎，捕食者也几乎无法偷袭它。
author: sk372
source: With 360 degree vision, ultrasonic waves for detection and precision flying capabilities, it is near impossible for prey to avoid POKENAME hunting them, nor for a predator to sneak up on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME摇摆穿过高草时，众多翅膀会振动，将脚步声伪装成疾风。
author: .realthree
source: As POKENAME sashays through the tall grass, its many wings vibrate to disguise its footsteps as rushing wind.

entry: POKENAME会从上方俯冲，用大葱击打目标，再撤退等待下一次机会。由于防御薄弱，这种一击即退的战术最适合它狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swoops at a target from above, smacking it with its leek before retreating to wait for another chance to strike.  As it has weak defenses, these hit-and-run tactics are its best bet for successful hunts.

entry: POKENAME出没于火山地区的热泉附近，脚步声像热水袋里的水晃来晃去。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME can be found near hydrothermal springs near volcanic areas. Their footsteps sound like hot-water bottles sloshing.

entry: 进化后，头部因储满体内热水而胀大，只好鼓起尾巴，平衡沉重的头。
author: pankiwi
source: After it evolves, their heads swell up with the hot water they store in their bodies. They inflate their tail to balance their heavy head.

entry: 友善的面孔，让它得了“亲切水鬼”的外号，可别被外表骗了。POKENAME也会在沼泽中，将野生宝可梦溺死，当作猎物。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: Its friendly face has earned the nickname "Friendly Water Ghost," but don't be fooled by its appearance. The POKENAME is also known for hunting wild Pokémon in the swamps by drowning them.

entry: POKENAME常住在人类聚落内外，跟着人走，盼着讨些吃的。看它模样可爱、性情憨厚，多数训练家都忍不住递上零食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are often seen close to or within human populations, following the people within in hopes of gaining food from them. With their cute face and simple demeanor, most Trainers can't help but give them the treats they seek.

entry: 过去住在网络空间的POKENAME，如今四处寻找现实中的训练家，想交个朋友。只要认准喜欢的人，它就再也不肯离开。永远不肯。
author: Inksans201x
source: Previously residing in cyberspace, POKENAME now actively seeks out Trainers to befriend in the real world. Once it finds a Trainer it likes, it won't leave them alone. Ever.

entry: 这只宝可梦不知道，自己的力量究竟有多大。比起撕碎猎物，它更爱拥抱；可POKENAME粗糙的皮肤，常让人类与宝可梦在它的示爱中受伤。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon is unaware of the raw power it possesses. Instead of tearing prey to pieces it prefers to cuddle. Many Pokémon and Trainers get hurt over this act of affection due to POKENAME's rough skin.

entry: POKENAME常在咸淡水交汇处生活，少动弹，以水草为食。面对危险反应虽慢，一旦受了威胁，潜藏的超能力便会觉醒。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are typically found around brackish water, where they live sedentary lives feeding on aquatic plants. They are often slow to react to danger but have latent psychic powers that activate when threatened.

entry: POKENAME感觉不到疼痛，因此受了伤，也可能浑然不觉。幸好，它的身体再生得很快。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME is incapable of feeling pain and, as a result, may be unaware of any injuries it sustains. Fortunately, its body regenerates quickly.

entry: POKENAME矮胖又迟钝，整日不是吃，就是睡。它能瞬间移动，也能变成任何宝可梦，却几乎飞不起来。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: Chunky and dim witted, POKENAME is a fusion who spend its time sleeping and eating. It can teleport and shapeshift into any Pokémon but can barely fly.

entry: 它吐出泥团、喷出水流，阻止敌人靠近，最喜欢采食平静湖泊与小河边的花蜜。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can spit clumps of mud and gushes of water to deter foes from approaching. It prefers to feast on the nectar from flowers growing by still lakes and small rivers.

entry: 据说，这种融合体是所有沼王的王。王冠越大、装饰越华美，就越受尊重。
author: ValtsuRi
source: This fusion is said to be the king of all Quagsire. The larger and more decorated the crown, the more respect it has.

entry: POKENAME天性贪玩，最爱在宽阔水域中扑腾。可若待得太久，连水都会被它烧开。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME are extremely playful in nature and adore splashing in large bodies of water. If it stays in too long, the water will boil.

entry: POKENAME沿河底慢慢跟随猎物，不断往水中释放毒液。等目标不再动弹，它便张开大嘴，将其吞下。
author: peachesparfait
source: A POKENAME slowly follows prey across river bottoms, releasing poison into the water. Their mouth opens wide to catch the meal when it stops moving.

entry: POKENAME惯用头槌进攻，可脑袋又软又空，实在打不出多少威力。
author: SandGuyThing
source: POKENAME's default offensive strategy consists of headbutting its opponents, though its head is too squishy and empty to do any significant damage.

entry: POKENAME光滑的体表，覆着保湿液，能让它穿行陆地时，也不至于干燥。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's glossy coat contains a moisturizing solution that keeps it from drying up as it crosses over land.

entry: POKENAME通常住在较小的海域。犯困时，便用双翼裹住身体，钻进海床睡去。
author: Niseria
source: POKENAME usually live in smaller seas. If POKENAME get sleepy, they cover themselves with their wings and burrow into the seabed.

entry: 与许多小碎钻融合体不同，POKENAME无法悬浮在空中。它更适合生活在淡水湖里，以微生物为食，偶尔也吃些小鱼和虫宝可梦。
author: ohok3441
source: Unlike many other Carbink fusions, POKENAME lacks the ability to float in open air. They fare better in freshwater lakes, eating microbes and occasionally small fish and bug Pokémon.

entry: 它悠哉地晃过天空，一见沼泽，便让蒸汽构成的双翼散去。POKENAME直直坠下，扑哧一声，欢欢喜喜落进泥里。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It bumbles through the sky without a care until it notices a swamp. Letting its steamy wings dissolve, POKENAME plummets downward and lands with a joyous squelch.

entry: POKENAME憨憨的，却很可爱，身躯有多庞大，童心就有多旺盛。柔云般的双翼载着它懒懒飘过天空，可哪怕一缕微风，或一件闪亮物品，都能让它分心。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME has a lovable but dim-witted personality. Its massive size is matched only by its childlike enthusiasm. With wings made of soft clouds, it soars lazily through the skies, often getting distracted by the slightest breeze or shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量储存在背上的种子中。两条尾巴其实是敏锐的藤蔓，能感知其他宝可梦的情绪。
author: Mistymagius
