source: POKENAME stores its psychic energy in the bulb on its back. Its twin-tails are actually sensitive vines that it uses to sense the emotions of other Pokémon.

entry: 一年中白昼最长的那一天，POKENAME会大群聚集。只要太阳还没落下，它们就不停跳舞。
author: rosemagwin
source: On the longest day of the year, POKENAME will gather in big groups. That day, they will dance for as long as the sun is out.

entry: 人们认为，只有与训练家的羁绊如太阳般明亮，POKENAME才会自然进化。它性情含蓄又难以捉摸，却偏偏能预见未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.

entry: 这只宝可梦是和谐与力量的化身，能以心灵感应交流，精准预判动作。高深的超能力，还让它得以窥见未来。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon is an embodiment of harmony and power, capable of communicating telepathically and anticipating movements with pinpoint accuracy. Its advanced psychic abilities allow it to glimpse into the future.

entry: POKENAME的花，只在晴天绽放，释放全部的超能力。蓝色叶片散发的香气，也能抚平心绪。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flower only blooms on sunny days, unleashing its full psychic power. Its blue leaves give off a calming scent that soothes minds.

entry: POKENAME用头顶宝石，寻找缺少食物的人。不过，若腹部的宝石亮起，就是它自己饿了。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME use the gem on their head to search for those in need of food. When its belly gem glows, it's hungry.

entry: POKENAME会被情绪激烈的生物吸引，远远看着对方发作。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME is drawn to highly emotional beings. It will watch their outbursts from afar.

entry: POKENAME按催眠般的节奏游动，让猎物以为安然无事，再用超能力将其压垮。若凝视腹部的眼睛，更会彻底受它控制。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME moves in a hypnotic pattern that lures its prey into a false sense of security before it crushes them with their psychic powers. Staring into the eyes on its belly puts you under its full control.

entry: POKENAME常从栖居的丛林吸收能量，化为超能力。力量充盈时，背上的珍珠便会发光。
author: red.89
source: A POKENAME is often seen absorbing energy from its jungle home to generate psychic power. The pearls on its back glow when at full power.

entry: POKENAME能用神秘力量读心，预知下一步行动。它聪慧过人，把缔结羁绊的训练家视作平等伙伴，也能从双手射出紫色能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.

entry: POKENAME不断练习，平衡火与超能力属性的力量，创造出从耳朵和魔杖散发的独特能量。研究人员想探个究竟，它却守口如瓶，让研究难以深入。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME practices to balance out its Fire and Psychic-Type abilities, creating a unique form of energy that radiates from its ears and wand. Though researchers seek to understand this energy, POKENAME's secrecy makes further study difficult.

entry: POKENAME的火焰与精神力量已达完美平衡。手杖上深红的圆珠，藏着神秘而炽热的能量；散发的心灵杂讯会引起偏头痛，让研究人员难以靠近。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME has achieved perfect equilibrium of its fire and psychic power. The crimson orb on its staff houses a mysterious, blazing energy. The energy radiates migraine-inducing telepathic static, hampering researchers' study.

entry: POKENAME的心灵感应格外出众，不只自己的几颗头，连其他生物也能与之交谈。可每颗头个性不同，一吵起来，往往就是好几个小时。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME possesses an extraordinary ability to communicate through telepathy, not only with its own heads but with other creatures as well. Each head has a distinct personality, and will often argue with one another for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME从月光中获取能量，满月时，背上的种子开得最盛。受到威胁时，种子会渗出毒汁，误食后会引起严重恶心。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets its energy from moonlight, with its bulb blooming most fully during the full moon. When threatened, the bulb seeps toxic sap that causes severe nausea if consumed.

entry: POKENAME无声而敏捷，藏在暗处，以强力踢击迎敌。准备出手时，环纹会亮得更盛，先扰乱对手，再迅速、精准地击中。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME moves with silent agility, striking with powerful kicks in the cover of darkness. Its glowing rings intensify when it's ready to attack, disorienting foes before delivering swift, precise blows.

entry: 满月或蚀象出现时，POKENAME会大群聚集，出神地凝望月亮，身体随节奏轻轻摆动。
author: rosemagwin
source: During full moons and eclipses, POKENAME will gather in big groups. They will move rhythmically as they are transfixed on the moon.

entry: POKENAME自觉苦练，避免炽烈火焰误伤旁人，可真到战斗时，又会毫无保留地全力以赴。据说，满月时，它的力量最为强盛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME undergoes self-imposed training to keep its ravenous fire from hurting others unintentionally, but it will throw everything it has into real battles. It is said that when the moon is full, its power peaks.

entry: POKENAME裹着幽魂般的暗雾，无声滑过夜色。那气息令人发寒，身上环纹又隐隐明灭，引来毫无戒心的猎物。
author: jaminmcready
source: Shrouded in a dark, wraith-like mist, POKENAME silently glides through the night. Its eerie presence causes chills, and its glowing rings pulse faintly to attract unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME优雅地栖在弯月之中，从夜空汲取力量。传说，满月照耀时，银色雾气能让最躁动的灵魂，也安静下来。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME perches gracefully within its crescent moon, drawing power from the night sky. Legends say its silvery mist can calm even the most restless souls under the glow of a full moon.

entry: POKENAME吸收的月光越多，背上的花便开得越大。它会用小角撞击对手，注入致命的毒液。
author: Mistymagius
source: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the bigger the blossom on its back grows. It will tackle its opponents with its small horns, injecting them with a deadly poison.

entry: 毒性随月相变化。满月时，一滴便能毒死大岩蛇；新月时，却又温和得让人把POKENAME当作美食。
author: amiel997
source: Its venom's potency shifts with the moon's phases. During a full moon, a single drop can kill an Onix, but under a new moon, its poison is so mild that some people eat POKENAME as a delicacy.

entry: 月亮最明亮时，常能看见它们静静仰望。尾巴里，也收集着月之石。
author: pankiwi
source: They can often be found gazing at the moon when it's at its brightest. It collects Moon Stones in its tail.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会爬上屋顶，一躺就是几个小时，只顾凝望月亮。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME climbs on roofs in the dead of night. It lays there for hours, just staring at the moon.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: Cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME潜行暗处，先用颈部的花纹震住猎物，再施以致命的毒咬。它最喜欢在满月之夜狩猎。
author: (XB) Furious Kaiser
source: Stalking from the shadows, POKENAME stuns its prey with the markings on its hood before striking with a deadly venomous bite. It prefers to hunt on nights with a full moon.

entry: POKENAME潜行暗处，先用颈部的花纹震住猎物，再施以致命的毒咬。它最喜欢在满月之夜狩猎。
author: (XB) Furious Kaiser
source: Stalking from the shadows, POKENAME stuns its prey with the markings on its hood before striking with a deadly venomous bite. It prefers to hunt on nights with a full moon.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，临近满月时更常见。平日性情温和，会点亮法杖、环纹与角，引导迷途旅人平安回家；战斗时，则筑起光墙自保。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: POKENAME appear only at night, and are more common near full moons. Generally passive, these Pokémon light up their staves, rings, and horns to guide wayward travelers home safely, and create defensive walls of light in combat.

entry: 这只宝可梦宛如来自远方的格斗家，能随心操纵阴影，在战斗中借此扰乱对手。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It has developed the ability to bend shadows to its will and uses them in combat as distractions.

entry: POKENAME背上的花，需要月光才能绽放、存活。因此，只有夜里才能看见它，花朵也在月色中泛着微光。
author: Patch
source: The flower on POKENAME's back requires moonlight to blossom and stay alive. Because of this, POKENAME can only be seen at night, where this flower glimmers in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME是沉默的战士，据说已掌握古代城都的格斗术。它们对训练家忠心耿耿，潜伏暗处，趁敌人最不设防时，打出决定性的一击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are silent warriors that are said to have mastered fighting techniques from ancient Johto. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainers, operating in the shadows to deliver decisive blows to their opponents when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME跃过夜空，头顶刀刃宛如弯月。它们投出金色光环惊扰目标，再从光环映出的阴影里，无声挥刃袭击。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap through the night sky, the blades on their heads resembling the crescent moon. They project rings of golden light to surprise their targets, silently striking with their blades from the shadows they cast.

entry: 它的铠甲由璀璨的月岩琢出棱面。战斗中，甲胄若泛起光芒，便是POKENAME正在引导神秘的月之力。
author: NellNast42
source: Its armor is faceted from a brilliant moon rock. When the armor glows in battle, POKENAME is channeling a mysterious lunar power.

entry: 没有月亮的夜晚，它会登上高处，点亮自身，吸引蛾类宝可梦——那是POKENAME最偏爱的猎物。
author: wigglypon
source: On moonless nights, it will find a high vantage point and shine its lights. This attracts moth Pokémon, POKENAME's most-preferred prey.

entry: POKENAME只在繁星满天、夜空澄澈的时候现身。传说，若看见它在满月下起舞，往后数年都会好运相随。
author: CpnQuacken
source: POKENAME only appear during nights when the stars are plenty and the sky is unobstructed. Steeped in legend, it is said that seeing one dancing under the full moon would bring you good fortune for years to come.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME借月下的阴影掩护伏击。能力只在夜里发挥作用，它便从天明一直睡到日落。
author: NellNast42
source: When hunting, POKENAME utilizes the moon's shadow to disguise its ambushes. Since its abilities are strictly nocturnal, it sleeps from dawn till dusk.

entry: POKENAME周身的液体吸收月光，增强超能力。它能以心灵感应交流，身体也会在黑暗中发亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: Moonlight absorbed by the liquid surrounding POKENAME's body strengthens its psychic powers. This Pokémon can communicate through telepathy, and its body can glow in the dark.

entry: 满月照在POKENAME身上，能让两颗大脑更加专注，超能力也达到顶峰。它通常温和，却常随月亮在夜空中的位置，变得喜怒不定。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its psychic powers reach their peak when the full moon illuminates POKENAME's body, increasing the concentration of its two brains. Although it is generally gentle in nature, it often has mood swings due to the position of the moon in the night sky.

entry: 夜里，它在沙地上潜行猎食。感到威胁，便让身上的金环闪光，晃花敌人的眼，吓得对方退走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It prowls the sandy lands during the night hours to hunt its prey. When it feels threatened, it flashes the golden rings on its body to blind its enemies and scare them away.

entry: POKENAME的身体，已完全适应栖息洞穴的黑暗。遇险时，它会射出尖刺，驱退敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is perfectly adapted to the darkness of the caves where it lives and thrives. It shoots out its quills when it is in danger to keep its enemies away.

entry: 若感到威胁，它便从毛发间喷出带毒的炽热火星。中招之痛，比普通灼伤还要厉害得多。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it feels threatened, it shoots toxic, fiery sparks from its fur that cause horrendous pain, much more than that experienced from a normal burn.

entry: 坚硬的黑壳护住身体，也让它能完美融入黑暗。向敌人冲锋前，甲壳上的环纹便会发亮，为进攻争得先机。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to camouflage perfectly in the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, it makes the rings on its armored carapace glow, to have an advantage against them.

entry: POKENAME在夜里疾驰，追赶猎物，得手后便用尖刺中的毒液结果对方。满月时，身上的环纹熠熠生辉，让它愈显威严可怖。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME darts at great speeds through the night to chase its prey. Once caught, it finishes them off with the poison in its quills. When there is a full moon, the circles on its body shine, giving it an even more majestic and fearsome appearance.

entry: 这种古老的宝可梦是强悍的夜间猎手，巨颚连最坚固的金属都能咬碎。夜幕下，身体发光的POKENAME会以骇人的咆哮打破寂静，声音传出数英里。
author: fiordaliso
source: This ancient Pokémon is a prodigious nocturnal predator, its colossal jaws can crush even the strongest metal. During the nights, when its body glows, POKENAME pierces the silence with terrifying roars that can be heard many miles away.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME身上的环纹会发亮，反而暴露了行踪。不过它快得惊人，猎物察觉时，往往已逃不掉了。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's rings glow under moonlight, unfortunately alerting prey to its presence. However, this Pokémon is so fast, it's often too late for them to escape.

entry: 冰中保存的化石受到月亮陨石能量的照射，令POKENAME重新苏醒。黑曜石般的漆黑鳞片让它隐入夜色；鸣叫时，夜空便会出现极光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was revived after a fossil preserved in ice was irradiated by the energy of a lunar meteorite. Its obsidian-black scales allow it to hide in the darkness. When it cries, the aurora borealis appears in the night sky.

entry: 柔和的月光让POKENAME感到安心。它以月亮为引，研究星辰占卜之术。满月时格外活跃，到了新月，却怎样也寻不到踪影。
author: merclipse
source: Finding comfort under the soft light of the moon, POKENAME studies the art of astrology, using the moon as a guide to learn divination of the stars. During a full moon, they are highly active, but during a new moon, they will never be found.

entry: POKENAME是以月亮为引的占星高手，如今只在夜间活动。它能趁夜色预知敌人的动作，十分危险。据传，日月发生蚀象时，它的力量会达到顶峰。
author: merclipse
source: A master diviner of the stars, with the moon as its guide. POKENAME are now nocturnal, and are able to predict a foe's movements under the cloak of night, making it very dangerous. Rumors say its power peaks during an eclipse.

entry: POKENAME夜里会潜入人家，偷走一切闪亮的东西。因此，它一出现在有人烟的地方，常会遭到驱赶。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME sneaks into houses at night and steals anything that shimmers. Because of this, many people shoo it away if it is found in populated areas.

entry: 哪颗头上的符号与当下月相相合，便由哪颗头掌控身体。每晚，POKENAME张开尾羽吸收月光，环纹随之泛起迷人光彩，是许多摄影师梦寐以求的画面。
author: amiel997
source: The head whose symbol matches the current moon phase gains control of the body. Every night, POKENAME spreads its tail to absorb moonlight, making its body rings glow in a mesmerizing display that many photographers dream of capturing.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在森林的阴影中，入夜后尤其活跃，借藤蔓牵引身体，在树木间穿行。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME enjoys hiding among the shadows of forests. At night, POKENAME is especially active, using its vines to pull itself and navigate through the trees.

entry: POKENAME会收集黄铁矿覆盖全身，想让训练家更喜欢自己。不识矿石的人，还会把它误当成黄金，特地前来寻找。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME hoards pyrite to cover itself in order to make itself more appealing to Trainers. Uneducated Trainers seek it out for gold.

entry: POKENAME常躲在阴影里，突然蹿出来惊吓人类与宝可梦。被吓得丢下的贵重物品、小饰件，都会落入它手中，再也找不回来。
author: Gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME often hide in shadows and wait to jump out at people and Pokémon. Any valuables or trinkets that are left behind are taken by them, never to be seen again.

entry: 它用冰雕成的小武器，恐吓宝可梦与训练家，让他们交出食物与财物。可那武器，其实全无威力。
author: pankiwi
source: It uses a small ice-carved weapon to intimidate Pokémon and Trainers into giving up their food and valuables. This weapon is entirely harmless.

entry: POKENAME有着光滑的黑羽，身边环绕着小小的火焰。它爱在夜里恶作剧，用尖喙与火星吓唬毫无防备的旅人。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon with sleek black feathers and a small aura of flames. It loves to play tricks at night, using its sharp beak and small embers to frighten unsuspecting travelers.

entry: 小卡比兽的贪吃，加上黑暗鸦的贪婪，让POKENAME偷起食物来肆无忌惮。不知多少人的野餐，都被它搅得不欢而散。
author: gottkroprinziii
source: The gluttony of Munchlax fused with the greed of Murkrow causes POKENAME to brazenly steal food. This has infamously resulted in many unhappy picnickers.

entry: POKENAME爱给闯进领地的家伙制造幻象，逼真的影像会把入侵者引入歧途。它就这样靠机巧的骗局，守护自己的家。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME enjoys creating illusions for those who venture into its territory. It can make images look real, leading intruders astray. POKENAME protects its home with tricks, making it a clever guardian.

entry: POKENAME不断扇动翅膀，想警告人们厄运将至，却从来没人当回事。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME flaps its wings around trying to warn people of ill fortune, but nobody takes it seriously.

entry: POKENAME行窃前，会用幻术扮成别人熟悉的面孔，拿走心仪之物就逃。恢复原貌后，它便乐呵呵地看着被模仿者替自己背黑锅。
author: sk372
source: To aid in thievery, POKENAME will use illusions to mask itself as a familiar face before taking the item it covets and running. It returns to normal, then watches with glee as the one it mimicked takes the blame for its crime.

entry: POKENAME靠声音辨路，穿行于暗窟与月色下。据说，那颗帽子似的头投下的阴影，会给附近的训练家带来麻烦。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME moves through dark caves and under the moon, using sound to find its way. The shadow of its hat-like head is said to cause trouble for any Trainer nearby.

entry: POKENAME十分狡猾，能借冰雪迷惑其他生物与训练家。它藏身暗处，用寒风遮掩行踪，躲过危险。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME is a sneaky Pokémon that uses ice to confuse both creatures and Trainers. It hides in the shadows, using cold winds to cover its movements and avoid danger.

entry: POKENAME贪婪又蛮横，活像个小恶霸，十分招人讨厌。看上什么闪亮东西，就猛打物主，直到对方被迫交出为止。
author: sk372
source: Considered a bit of a thug, POKENAME is disliked due to its greedy tendencies. If it spots something shiny it likes, it will take it by force, battering the owner fiercely until they're forced to give up their possessions.

entry: 雨夜常能看见POKENAME，正四处寻找捣蛋的机会：不是偷走旅人的食物，就是引得其他宝可梦整夜追着它跑。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME can usually be seen in the rain at nighttime. In these moments, POKENAME tries to spot opportunities for mischief, whether stealing food from travelers or leading other Pokémon on a chase through the night.

entry: POKENAME让袋中的幼崽戴上王冠，提升孩子的智慧。自己虽因此头脑迟钝，却从未忘记疼爱、珍惜幼崽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets the child in its pouch wear the crown, enhancing the infant's intellect. This may leave POKENAME's mind dull and sluggish, but it never forgets to love and cherish its young.

entry: 大舌贝咬住POKENAME的头后，它获得了神秘力量与近似人类的智慧。可大脑尚未适应，反应依旧慢得出奇。
author: SonTyp
source: When a Shellder bit POKENAME's head, it developed mystical powers and a human-like intelligence. Its brain can't adapt to this yet, so it is incredibly slow to react.

entry: 大舌贝咬下时注入的毒液，治好了可达鸭长年的头痛。如今，POKENAME终于能专心致志，尽情发挥超能力。
author: sk372
source: The venom in Shellder's bite has cured Psyduck of its chronic headaches. POKENAME can now focus and fully utilize its psychic powers to their full potential.

entry: POKENAME借汤匙反射的影像，凝视头顶的宝石，便能看见未来。可它始终一副悠闲无聊的样子，仿佛什么事也不会发生。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can see the future by looking at the gem of its head using the reflection of its spoons. It always seems relaxed and bored about it, as if nothing ever happens.

entry: 在某些奇异情形下，大舌贝会与呆呆兽除尾巴外的整个身体融合。POKENAME智慧极高，防御强大，却似乎再也不流露情绪。
author: sk372
source: In some bizarre circumstances, Shellder merges with every part of Slowpoke except its tail. Highly intelligent and possessing powerful defenses, POKENAME no longer seems to show signs of emotion.

entry: 聪明绝顶的POKENAME会聚在一起，讨论深奥的问题。它们无法主动停止思考，只好相互催眠，帮助彼此入睡。
author: noel5229
source: Highly intelligent, POKENAME gather to discuss complex topics. Because they can't voluntarily stop thinking, they help each other sleep with hypnosis.

entry: 为了让头顶花苞绽放，POKENAME只吃同样晒着太阳的叶片，同时从两处获取能量。临近开花时，却会散发难闻的气味。
author: Soup1900
source: To help the bud on its head bloom, POKENAME will only eat leaves that are also in the bright sunlight to gain energy from two sources at once. When its bud is about to bloom, it releases a repulsive smell.

entry: POKENAME更愿意把吸收的能量拿来养护藤蔓，让它们保持修长、健康，因此花苞迟迟才开。进化后新长出的叶子，则能帮它吸收更多阳光。
author: Frokachu
source: Its bulb takes time to bloom as POKENAME likes to use the energy it absorbs to keep its vines long and healthy. The leaves it gained from evolving help to acquire more sunlight.

entry: 它们会结成六七只的亲密群体，终生相伴。人们亲切地把这些POKENAME小群落，称作“花簇”。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: They form tight-knit groups of 6 or 7 that bond for life. These POKENAME clusters are known colloquially as "floresces."

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME背上的琥珀碎片中含有古代宝可梦的遗传物质。POKENAME发怒时，藤蔓会疯狂生长。
author: Mistymagius
source: The piece of amber on POKENAME's back is theorized to contain the DNA of ancient Pokémon. Its vines grow wildly when POKENAME is angered.

entry: POKENAME生活在草木繁茂的沼泽，用宽大的叶片托着自己漂浮，悄然藏于水面。受惊时，头顶的花便会释放毒孢子。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in marshy areas covered with flora, using its large leaves to float on the water without being seen. The flower on its head releases poisonous spores when agitated.

entry: POKENAME优雅地悬浮着，宽大的叶片吸收日光，积蓄能量。吸足光照后，便会把热量传给附近的植物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME hovers gracefully, its broad leaves capturing sunlight for energy. When it captures enough light, it radiates heat to nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME角上的叶片营养丰富。每逢争夺领地，背上的花就会盛开。
author: A Small Colony Of Termites
source: The leaves on a POKENAME's horn are highly nutritious. The flower on its back blooms whenever it fights for territory.

entry: 林间深处的湖泊旁，常能看见POKENAME，尾巴上顶着一颗大花苞。只要日照充足，花苞就会开成硕大的花。
author: fuzzythelion
source: Seen around lakes deep in the forest, POKENAME has a large bulb on its tail. With enough sunlight, this bud will bloom into a large flower.

entry: 据说，遇见POKENAME是个好兆头。不过，还是别靠得太近，它的触须能抽出令人疼痛的鞭击。
author: flickeredflame
source: Seeing a POKENAME is said to be a good omen; however, it's advised not to get too close, as its feelers can deliver painful, whipping blows to its enemies.

entry: POKENAME的壳由蜡质叶片构成，闻起来像橡胶。准备进化时若遇上天敌，它们会旋转全身，将柔韧的花苞撞向地面，借力弹到安全的地方。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: The waxy leaves that form POKENAME's shells smell like rubber. To escape predators while they prepare for evolution, they whirl their entire bodies and slam their flexible bulbs into the ground, bouncing away to safety.

entry: POKENAME外貌近似普通妙蛙草，背部与手上长出的奇异花朵，却只能在水下生长。据说，有它们栖息的池塘，几乎见不到藻类。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though similar in appearance to standard Ivysaur, the unusual flowers budding from POKENAME's back and hands thrive only within an underwater environment.  Ponds in which these Pokémon are found are said to be nearly completely free of algae.

entry: 它的电力如今全部储存在头顶的花苞里，再通过磁铁形状的藤蔓释放出去。
author: Mariod246
source: All of its electricity is now stored in the bulb at the top of its head. It uses its magnet-shaped vines to expel said electricity.

entry: 花苞中的电荷吸引来了另外两只妙蛙磁怪。三只聚在一起，电力也增至原来的三倍。
author: Mariod246
source: The charge from its bulb has attracted two other Ivytons. Together, they triple their electric power.

entry: POKENAME会啃咬地窖、食品储藏室的门框和门板。人们以为它们惦记着里面的奶酪，其实它们是在分解木质纤维，为背上的种子获取养分。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw away at the frames and doors to cellars or pantries. While it is common belief that they are after the cheese stored within, they actually break down the wood grain of the structures to gather nutrients for their bulbs.

entry: 它靠啃咬骨头磨牙，也把骨头加工成战斗用的武器与铠甲。每造出一件新武器，便将旧的传给幼崽。
author: sk372
source: It gnaws on bones to maintain its teeth, as well as to shape the bones into weapons and armor it can use in battle. When it crafts a new weapon, it passes the old one onto its young.

entry: 打结的尾巴如同第三只手，专门顺走看中的东西。遇上危险，POKENAME还能咬断尾巴，引开敌人的注意。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its knotted tails act like a third arm, mainly being used to swipe things that catch its eye. When in danger, POKENAME can chew off its tail to use as a distraction.

entry: 敏锐的本能让POKENAME很会搜寻残留食物。它沿途留下淡淡的符文状痕迹，有研究者认为，那是在警告后来者。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's sharp instincts make it a master scavenger. It leaves behind faint glyph-like marks wherever it searches, which some researchers believe serve as warnings to others.

entry: 它的后半身长成了前半身阿罗拉形态的模样，性情也随之改变。那颗头比主头贪吃得多，明明不能消化，却每顿都要抢。
author: sk372
source: The back half has taken on the appearance and disposition of the front half's Alolan variant. It is far greedier than the main head, fighting it for every meal despite not being able to digest.

entry: POKENAME顽强难缠，吃起东西破坏力惊人，有时被称为“害兽之王”。关都屋顶漏雨，头号祸首就是它啃坏了瓦片。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are sometimes called "apex vermin" due to their tenacity and destructive eating habits. POKENAME chewing through roofing tiles is the leading cause of roof leaks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME常一边飞，一边啃石头磨牙。石块也常从嘴里掉下，砸中路人脑袋的事，已经发生过许多次。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME can often be seen gnawing on rocks mid-flight to whittle down its fangs. It is not uncommon for it to drop these rocks, and there have been many occasions where the falling rocks have hit people in the head.

entry: POKENAME极其珍爱背上的奶酪拼盘。就算只是看它的眼神不对，手上也可能狠狠挨一口。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME heavily values the cheese platter on its back. Even just looking at it the wrong way can result in a nasty bite to the hand.

entry: POKENAME为找吃的和住处，游荡在大城镇的下水道。它们性情凶猛，当地帮派分子便想将其驯服。
author: ._term.
source: Seeking food and shelter, POKENAME wanders the sewers of big towns. Because of their ferocious behavior, local gangsters try to tame them.

entry: POKENAME动作敏捷得惊人，身体又格外灵活。贸然踏进POKENAME的巢，少不了受伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses fantastic agility and surprising flexibility. Walking into the nest of POKENAME is an easy way to get injured.

entry: 两颗头中，牙齿更强的那颗占主导。趁它睡着，另一颗便找东西啃咬、磨炼牙齿，盼着将来争过对方。
author: sk372
source: The head possessing a stronger set of teeth is considered the dominant of the two. When that head sleeps, the other finds something to gnaw on, strengthening its teeth so it may fight for dominance in the future.

entry: POKENAME消化不了宝石和金属，挖出的隧道里便常散落珍贵材料。可别贸然进去捡，它们护起领地来，凶狠得很。
author: .fedoraman
source: Unable to digest gems or metals, POKENAME's tunnels are often littered with precious materials. It is ill-advised to extract them though, for POKENAME are viciously territorial.

entry: 据说，戳破它的一颗泡泡，就会遭到七年的诅咒。传说归传说，这样做确实会惹恼POKENAME。
author: welliss
source: It's said that if you pop one of its bubbles, you'll be cursed for seven years. Though this is a myth, it will make POKENAME upset.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙由整块红宝石构成。菊花岛上有珠宝匠，会用这些獠牙制作婚戒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are made of solid ruby. There are jewelers on Chrysanthemum Island that use these tusks in making wedding rings.

entry: POKENAME能轻松穿过几乎一切固体，却不知为何，偏偏穿不过铁。
author: .izik
source: Its body can pass through just about any solid object with little effort. For some reason, POKENAME lacks the ability to move through iron.

entry: 这只宝可梦争强好胜，会啄、扯训练家的头发，非要证明自己才是头领。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: A highly competitive Pokémon, it will peck at and tug on the hair of its Trainer to establish itself at the top of the pecking order.

entry: POKENAME用幽火吸走昏暗处仅剩的光，吓唬过路人。四周越暗，恐惧越深，它便吃得越满足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ghostly flames to siphon the light from already dim areas, spooking those traveling through. It feeds on the increase in fear caused by the darkening surroundings.

entry: POKENAME常以小群聚居在洞穴里，发出极尖厉的叫声，赶走不速之客。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME usually live in small groups inside caves. They can scream at an incredibly high pitch to drive off unwanted visitors.

entry: POKENAME是栖息在古老森林深处的幽灵宝可梦，喜欢残忍的玩笑。它们模仿人声，诱导训练家走错方向，让人迷失深林，几乎无望归家。
author: Katie
source: A Ghost-type Pokémon found deep in ancient forests, POKENAME has a cruel sense of humor. They delight in misleading Trainers with the sounds of other people, leaving them lost and confused with little hope of getting home.

entry: 乌云低垂却迟迟不下雨的日子，高空会传来POKENAME的啜泣。据说，它携带的宝石里，藏着早逝者被遗忘的梦。
author: Ozydamians
source: On days when dark clouds hang heavy in the sky but no rain falls, the sobbing cry of POKENAME can be heard high above. The jewels it carries are said to contain the forgotten dreams of those who passed too young.

entry: 这只宝可梦轻盈、敏捷，又顽劣，总爱四处破坏。它还能跳穿墙壁，叫人防不胜防。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Light, agile, and impish, Pokémon spends its time vandalizing things. Its ability to leap through walls makes it difficult to stop.

entry: POKENAME每吃掉一个梦，摆线上就会多出一颗珠子。它借珠中蕴藏的梦之精华，驱逐邪灵。
author: noel5229
source: After POKENAME eats a dream, it forms a new bead on its pendulum string. It wards off evil spirits using the dream essence contained within its beads.

entry: POKENAME背上长着奇怪的符文。科学家研究其含义时，发现它与未知图腾的某种形态相似，却仍不明白两者的联系。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: An odd rune grows from the back of a POKENAME. Attempts to determine the meaning has led to the discovery that it resembles a form of Unown, but for now, scientists are unsure of the connection.

entry: 受威胁时，它不放臭气，而会让神秘文字的闪烁影像直接浮现在对手脑海。它似乎不进食。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Rather than releasing foul odors when threatened, it sends flashing images of mysterious characters into its opponent's head. It doesn't seem to eat.

entry: 视力不好，让人类和宝可梦都误以为POKENAME很弱。可POKENAME的眼球蕴含庞大的超能力，连汽车都能轻易压碎，想捕捉它的人，往往下场凄惨。
author: Sottiwotti
source: People and Pokémon think POKENAME is weak because of its poor eyesight, but POKENAME's eyeball contains a lot of psychic energy. It can easily crush a car with its powers, and people who try to catch it often meet a terrible fate.

entry: 独角虫的鼻子变成了一只眼睛，能异常敏锐地追踪威胁。它们常聚在一起，排出神秘的信息。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Weedle's nose has been replaced with an eye that seems to track threats exceptionally well. Its often found in groups making mysterious messages.

entry: 它像百变怪一样能变身，却有一个部位始终变不了。因此，无论化成什么模样，某处总会留着一只巨大的独眼。
author: sk372
source: It possesses shapeshifting abilities just like Ditto, but is unable to change a certain part of itself. Thus, no matter the form it takes, the result will inevitably retain a giant cycloptic eye somewhere.

entry: 无法移动的POKENAME常待在高高的树上，紧盯一切可能的危险，等待终将来临的进化。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Immobile POKENAME will often sit high in trees, staring at any potential danger as it waits for its inevitable evolution.

entry: 传说，POKENAME蜕下的皮里，还残留着它的一缕意识。蜕皮虽空，有人却坚称，曾看见一只眼睛从里面回望自己。
author: sk372
source: There are rumors that the shed skin left behind by POKENAME still contains a fraction of its mind within. Despite being hollow, some swear to have seen an eye staring back at them from within.

entry: 它的领地意识不如大针蜂强，却常会守护废弃神庙，驱赶入侵者。为什么这么做，至今无人知晓。
author: BombBoyxD
source: While less territorial than Beedrill, it will often spend its time defending ruined temples from intruders. It's not known why it does this.

entry: 它像融合前的宝可梦一样温顺。受到威胁时，就会让对手看见奇怪的幻象，或扬起沙子，趁机退走。
author: BombBoyxD
source: It is docile like its unfused counterparts. If threatened, it will send strange visions or throw sand at its opponent before retreating.

entry: POKENAME能精准辨时，分秒不差。头羽随着身边漂浮的刻度旋转，推算种种事件，随后又回到当下的时间。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to tell the time down to the second. The feathers on their head spin around along the ticks that float around them to calculate various events before returning to the present time.

entry: 没人知道这种融合体如何进食。科学家只见过它残忍地伏击猎物，再将其拖往视线之外。巢穴周围，还常留着奇怪的符号。
author: BombBoyxD
source: It's unknown how this fusion eats, but scientists have noted its cruelty when it ambushes its prey before taking them out of sight. It often leaves strange symbols around its nest.

entry: POKENAME会聚在夜空中能看见最多星辰的地方。它们的排列似乎想传递某种信息，可内容是什么，又要说给谁听，仍无人知晓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather together in places where the most stars are visible in the night sky. Their positioning suggests an attempt to relay a message of some kind, but what and to whom is still unknown.

entry: 祭司们注意到，它的外貌仿佛带着神性。它不进食，却常以2马赫的速度逼近其他宝可梦，再骤然停下，直勾勾地盯着对方。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Priests have noted its divine-looking form. While it doesn't eat, it often approaches Pokémon at Mach 2 before stopping to stare at them.

entry: POKENAME似乎从不睡觉，总用眼睛搜寻附近的材料，既拿来筑巢，也留下奇怪的标记。
author: BombBoyxD
source: It doesn't seem to sleep. Instead, POKENAME uses its eyes to find sufficient materials to make both strange markings and its nests in its vicinity.

entry: 这种POKENAME比其他同族更像人。它时不时会默默演出无人知晓的剧目，原因众说纷纭。
author: BombBoyxD
source: This variation of POKENAME seems more human-like than others of its species. Periodically, it silently acts out unknown plays; the reason is debated.

entry: 据说，POKENAME诞生于一位画家的梦中。此后，它便出现在那位画家的幅幅作品里，仿佛正向观画者招手。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME was said to have come from an artist's dreams. Since then it has been found throughout the artist's paintings, seemingly waving to the viewers.

entry: 它常沐浴在阳光下。有人认为，黑叶飘动是在尝试交流，可它想说什么，仍不清楚。
author: BombBoyxD
source: It often spends its time in the sunlight. Some interpret the fluttering of its black leaf as an attempt to communicate, but its meaning is unknown.

entry: POKENAME硕大的眼睛让许多人望而生畏。它明明没有牙齿，却仍本能地啃咬东西，常把自己的眼睛弄伤。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Many are put off by POKENAME's large eye. While it has no teeth, its natural instinct to gnaw often leaves it with ocular injuries.

entry: 一群未知图腾似乎特地聚在一起，想与人类交流。可惜，它们想表达什么，依然无人知晓。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of Unown appear to have gathered together in an attempt to communicate with humans. Unfortunately, what they are trying to say remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME巢穴四周，散落着被它猎杀的生物遗骸，每一具旁边都环绕着神秘符号。奇怪的是，遗骸似乎全都未被吃过。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Around the nests of POKENAME are the remains of the prey it has hunted and defeated, each surrounded by mysterious symbols. Strangely, none appear to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME会从森林飞往附近遗迹，四处游荡，把角悬在感兴趣的物件上方，随后默默飞回家。它究竟在探查什么，仍是谜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will fly from forests to nearby ruins, wander about while hovering their horn above objects of interest before flying back home in silence. What they are apparently scanning for is still unknown.

entry: 谁在世上何处入睡，它的眼睛都看得见；谁醒着，超能力也能感知。POKENAME凭这两项本领，判断人们的善恶。
author: Griddle
source: Its eye can see when anyone in the world is sleeping. Its psychic power lets it know when someone is awake. POKENAME uses both to judge people's morality.

entry: POKENAME从杂志、玩具和各种物品上收集字母，拼成奇怪的词句。啼声听起来像孩子咯咯发笑。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME collect assorted letters from magazines, toys, and objects that spell out odd words and phrases. Their chirps sound like giggling children.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛便于在栖息的草原上搜寻食物，可它却常显得营养不良。
author: BombBoyxD
source: POKENAME's large eye allows it to effectively search the grasslands of its habitat for food. However, it is often seen to be physically malnourished.

entry: 它放弃鲜艳的颜料，改用醒目的黑墨。书法间会跃出未知图腾，借力量让POKENAME写下的字句化为现实。
author: Griddle
source: It has traded its vibrant colour palette for striking black ink. Unown spring from its calligraphy, bringing POKENAME's words to life with their power.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦极为凶暴。奇怪的是，颈部皮膜上的眼睛真的看得见；POKENAME受到威胁，它们便一齐怒视敌人。
author: BombBoyxD
source: This fusion is brutally vicious. Strangely, the eyes of its neck flap are functional, and if POKENAME is threatened, they will glare at the foe.

entry: 它栖身在常有雷暴的遗迹中。从它传出的心灵讯息判断，它对闪电近乎狂热地崇拜。
author: BombBoyxD
source: It spends its time in ruins that are regularly near thunderstorms. The psychic messages it sends shows that it holds lightning in a fanatical regard.

entry: 未知丘遭极其猛烈的雷击，便会变成POKENAME。电力充足时，瞳孔会泛起刺眼的黄光。
author: BombBoyxD
source: POKENAME is created when an Unchu is struck by incredibly strong lightning. If fully charged, the pupils on its eyes glow a harsh yellow.

entry: POKENAME挖的洞和穿山鼠一样深。不过，洞壁上还刻着奇怪的标记，谁也读不懂。
author: BombBoyxD
source: POKENAME's burrows are as deep as Sandshrew's are, but it was discovered that the walls of these burrows contain strange, unreadable markings.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺并非皮肤组织，似乎与洞中的标记有所关联，看起来简直像一则信息。
author: BombBoyxD
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back aren't hide, though they appear to be connected to the markings in their burrows. They almost seem to be a message.

entry: 它起舞时，会摆出与字母形状相似的姿势。可其中传达的信息，至今未被破译。
author: sk372
source: As it dances, it strikes poses that seem to correspond to letters of the alphabet. Whatever sort of message it is trying to convey has yet to be deciphered.

entry: 它用高超的超能力感知周围，同时守望训练家。头能旋转360度，无论如何转动，目光始终不离训练家。
author: sk372
source: It uses advanced psychic powers to keep aware of its surroundings while watching over its Trainer. It can rotate its head 360 degrees; it will always keep its eye on its Trainer.

entry: 这种POKENAME比同族更具金属质感。背后的黑色附肢能伸出去，把倒霉的家伙刺穿，钉在坚硬的背上。
author: BombBoyxD
source: This POKENAME is more metallic than others of its species. The black limbs on its rear can reach to impale unlucky others onto its hard back.

entry: POKENAME的角被眼睛取代，失去了原本御敌的主要武器。作为补偿，感知能力似乎敏锐得惊人。
author: BombBoyxD
source: POKENAME's horn has been displaced by its eye, depriving it of its main defence against aggressors. In return, it seems to have incredible senses.

entry: 科学家发现，POKENAME在日光下休息时，黑色字符便会传递一则信息。究竟是什么意思，依然是谜。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Scientists have noted that POKENAME's black characters convey a message when it relaxes in the sun. What it means remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME头形奇特，却意外地不妨碍日常生活。整个身体仿佛组成了一个古怪的符号。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Surprisingly, the unique shape of POKENAME's head does not appear to affect its daily life. Its body seems to resemble an odd symbol.

entry: POKENAME硕大的独眼始终紧闭，生活却一切如常。一些持异说的人相信，POKENAME一旦睁眼，便预示着灭顶之灾。
author: sk372
source: Its large singular eye remains eternally closed, though POKENAME still functions normally in spite of this. Some fringe theorists believe that should POKENAME open its eye, it is a harbinger of great doom.

entry: 它们借飞行的方向与动作交流。发现不喜欢的东西，两副身体便交叉成X形，用超能力将其驱退。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The direction and motion of how their bodies fly aid in their communication. If they see something they don't like, the two bodies will cross into an X-shaped formation and repel it with their psychic powers.

entry: 古代，POKENAME曾守护重要文书。发现窃贼时，便以强大超能力施展心灵感应，向君主示警。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME were ancient guards, protecting important pieces of writing. They would use their strong psychic powers to telepathically alert the monarch if a thief was caught.

entry: 身体的每一节都像一个字母。飞行时，似乎能拼出什么词句，可奇怪的是，每个目击者说出的字母组合都不一样。
author: sk372
source: Each segment of its body appears to be shaped like a letter from the alphabet. The body appears to spell something as it flies, but strangely, those who witness it each report a completely different set of letters.

entry: 遍布身体的眼睛，似乎分别跨越空间，凝望不同维度。若与某只眼睛对视，自己或许也能窥见那些未知世界。
author: sk372
source: Each of the eyes spread across its body are thought to stare across space into different dimensions. Should one meet an eye's gaze, they too may catch a glimpse of these unknown worlds.

entry: POKENAME极其厌恶被看见，甚至会撕开空间躲藏，直到众多眼睛都看不见旁人，因而成了最难寻觅的宝可梦之一。多亏一只勇敢的变隐龙，人们才留下它的记录。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: POKENAME is considered one of the most elusive Pokémon due to its aversion to being seen, going as far as tearing space to hide until its many eyes cannot see anyone in its surroundings. It was only recorded with the help of a very brave Kecleon.

entry: POKENAME坚信，自己有力量满足全人类的一切愿望，对自身本领自信得不可思议。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is convinced that it possesses the power to fulfil all of humanity's desires, and it shows unbelievable confidence in its abilities.

entry: POKENAME一度被视为神话中的君王，实际担任着墓地的守护者，对闯入者很不友善。
author: Inksans201x
source: Once thought to be a mythical ruler, POKENAME acts as a guardian of cemeteries. It is not very fond of trespassers.

entry: 即使眼睛直接遭受攻击，它的独眼也绝不眨动。那近乎疯狂的凝视，仿佛穿透帷幕，直视可见现实之外的存在。
author: sk372
source: Its singular eye will never blink, even when attacked directly. It stares with deranged intensity, gazing beyond the veil into something past visible reality.

entry: 这些宝可梦虽外貌骇人，通常却无意伤人。POKENAME只是喜欢吓唬其他宝可梦，找些乐子。
author: the_smirker
source: Despite their unnerving appearance, these Pokémon do not usually mean harm. POKENAME enjoy scaring other Pokémon for fun.

entry: 两只眼睛会互相对视，仿佛是两个独立的生命，可研究却找不到第二颗大脑。被深雪埋住身体时，它会用上方的眼睛望过雪堆。
author: sk372
source: The two eyes look to each other as if they are separate beings, though science shows no sign of anything like a second brain. In deep snow, it uses the upper eye to see above the snowbank covering its body.

entry: 它化作一本废弃的书，盼好奇的人将它带回家。书里明明全是胡言乱语，读者却依然看得入迷。
author: sk372
source: It takes the form of a discarded book in the hopes curious onlookers might take it home. The contents of the book are pure nonsense, but those who read it are entranced nonetheless.

entry: 身上的每只眼睛，都能发射强力冰冻光束，冻住敌人。可与POKENAME对视过的人说，那股沿脊背爬起的寒意，与冰之力量毫无关系。
author: sk372
source: Each of the eyes on its body can launch powerful Ice Beams to freeze opponents. Those who have met POKENAME's gaze report feeling a chill run up their spine, unrelated to its ice powers.

entry: 虽然它以攻击性强而闻名，研究却发现，它平时会花时间在崖壁上书写奇怪的字符。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Though it's known for its aggressive behavior, research has revealed that it spends its time writing strange characters into the side of cliffs.

entry: 它身上的眼睛，能看见一切踏入领地的生物。为了保护未知恐龙刻下的图案，它会近乎狂热地喷出黑色火焰。
author: BombBoyxD
source: The eyes on its body see all that enters its territory. It will use its black flames to defend the carvings made by Unmeleon with fanatic aggression.

entry: 它会在别人脑海中呈现漂浮的符号，用来交流。它喜欢安静、独处，好专心磨炼自己的超能力。
author: sk372
source: It produces the image of floating symbols within the minds of others to communicate. It values peace and solitude so that it can focus and hone its psychic powers.

entry: 这种融合体虽连颜色也变了，最引人注目的却是壳上的字符，仿佛暗示着尚未揭开的奥秘。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Despite the colour change of this fusion, the most striking change is the characters on its shell that seem to hint at mysteries untold.

entry: 它在田野嬉戏，背上的焦烟随之弥漫。消防员常误以为起火，赶来却只见无害的POKENAME，因此对它颇为头疼。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The charred smoke on its back permeates the air as it frolics in fields. Firefighters are annoyed by this Pokémon as they falsely assume there is a fire when it's simply a harmless POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME鲜有记录，更从没人见过它们伸出头来。未知图腾在旁嬉戏飞舞，仿佛是POKENAME梦中浮现的景象。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Few POKENAME have been observed in the wild, and none with their head out. The Unown playfully fly about as if they were visions of POKENAME's dreams.

entry: 尾巴依然是长寿的象征，可上面的眼睛让它少了几分美感。胸前的符号，也变得越来越多。
author: BombBoyxD
source: Its tail is still seen as a sign of longevity, though the eyes have removed much of its appeal. The symbols on its chest have become more numerous.

entry: 一窝蛋中，那颗黑色的蛋始终受其他成员保护。谁敢对它露出敌意，整群便会蜂拥而上，猛烈反击。
author: sk372
source: The dark egg in the clutch is protected at all times by the rest of the group. Should anything make an aggressive move towards it, the entire group will pile onto the aggressor in a vigorous counterattack.

entry: POKENAME身体像只小沙包，却仍能短暂飞行。就算摔下来，也几乎不会受伤。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite their footbag-like body, POKENAME can fly for short periods of time. They take very little damage when falling.

entry: 据说，皮卡丘不停做鬼脸，直到表情定住，就变成了POKENAME。它自己倒似乎毫不在意。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME is said to be the result of a Pikachu that wouldn't stop making silly faces until its expression froze. It doesn't seem to mind.

entry: 洞穴里看见的音波龙身影、听见的叫声，有时只是POKENAME的模仿。攻击它，便会被加倍反弹，几乎无路可逃。
author: Wormspawn
source: Sometimes, the sound and shape of a cave-dwelling Noivern may merely be the mimicry of a POKENAME. Attacks against it are reflected back with amplified force, making escape nearly impossible.

entry: 据说，有研究者曾想取出POKENAME袋中的蛋，仔细研究。不料，那颗蛋突然张开大颚，朝他咬去，吓了他一大跳。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: It is said that a researcher once tried to remove the egg from POKENAME's pouch for closer examination. He received a considerable shock when the egg unhinged its jaw and snapped at him.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓不断生长，最终遮住眼睛。它便改靠尾巴观察周围。
author: JackSkipper
source: POKENAME's vines grow constantly, eventually covering its eyes. It relies on its tail to see.

entry: 后方的头有自己的小脑，也有喷火用的火囊。谁想从背后偷袭，免不了被狠狠烧伤。
author: sk372
source: Its rear head possesses its own tiny brain as well as its own flame sac for producing fire breath. Anybody that tries to sneak up from behind is in for a nasty burn.

entry: POKENAME性情复杂，难以捉摸。今天还保护弱小、主持正义，明天却可能为抢食物，反过来攻击同一群宝可梦。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME is a complex and unpredictable species. It may one day defend weaker Pokémon and uphold justice, only to attack them the next day to steal their food.

entry: POKENAME操纵尾上的头，精确得惊人，却很少动用双臂。因此，有研究者猜测，尾巴上的才是真正的主头。
author: slaphappygrandpa
source: POKENAME controls the head on its tail with surprising precision, but uses its arms sparingly. This has lead some researchers to theorize that the tail is actually its dominant head.

entry: POKENAME借天生可爱的模样，装得小巧又无助，等猎物靠近才出击。体内的毒液，足以让一个小孩麻痹。
author: Rakunk
source: Using its naturally adorable appearance, POKENAME pretends to be small and defenseless - luring prey closer before striking. It has enough poison to paralyze a small child.

entry: POKENAME前面的头吃树果，后面的头吃草。食物在壳中混合，酿成备受追捧的甜茶。
author: bee4082
source: A POKENAME's front head eats berries, and its rear head eats grasses. The foods it eats mix in its shell to make a highly sought-after sweet tea.

entry: POKENAME本是杂食，通常却由后头作主，决定吃什么。少数个体两颗头势均力敌，才会荤素兼食。
author: Krune
source: Although technically an omnivore, POKENAME's rear head is usually dominant and decides the diet. On rare occasions, the heads are equally dominant, leading to a mixed diet of meat and plants.

entry: POKENAME在林中奔跑时，后方的头会欢快地点动。格外高兴时，还会发出轻快的叽喳声。
author: .izik
source: While running through the forest, POKENAME's rear head bobs in delight. If it feels very happy, it emits a cheerful chittering sound.

entry: POKENAME常藏在田野附近的地道中，静候闯入者。其他宝可梦踏进领地，它便挥尾出击，狠狠咬上一口，注入毒液。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME often hides within tunnels near fields, waiting for intruders. When other Pokémon venture into its territory, it strikes with its tail, delivering a venomous bite.

entry: 看似长着嘴的尾巴，其实是POKENAME产奶的器官。饲养它的农场主大多承认，那产奶的模样，看着多少有些不安。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be a tail with a mouth is actually the organ with which POKENAME produces milk. Most farmers who have POKENAME confess the sight of its milk production can be a little unsettling.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME更加依赖多出的头，几乎不再用上半身做任何事。
author: slaphappygrandpa
source: After evolving, POKENAME relies even more on its additional heads. It hardly uses its upper body for anything.

entry: 许多地方都流传着POKENAME潜入孩子卧房、吸干鲜血的故事。但实际观察中，它们只用毒液制服比自己小得多的猎物。
author: Rakunk
source: Various cultures have spun tales of POKENAME sneaking into children's bedrooms to drain their blood. However, despite these myths, POKENAME have only been observed using venom to subdue much smaller prey.

entry: 古代金匠曾借POKENAME的火焰熔炼贵金属。炽烈的高温，让细致精巧的加工成为可能。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, goldsmiths used POKENAME's flames to melt precious metals. The intense heat allowed for intricate craftsmanship.

entry: POKENAME又跳又喊，为同伴加油。可主体每说一句鼓励的话，双手末端的脑袋，就会回以嘲笑与尖刻的讥讽。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME dance and shout, cheering for their allies. Every word of encouragement from the main body of POKENAME is met with jeers and scathing remarks from the heads on the ends of its hands.

entry: POKENAME上方多出的头，既能警戒天敌，咬下时还会分泌黏稠毒液。它们也会咬住藤蔓，把身体拉上树，躲到安全处。
author: Holgast
source: The extra heads atop POKENAME alert them to predators and secrete a sticky, toxic goo upon biting. The heads also grab onto vines and pull the body up into trees for safety.

entry: POKENAME发射的尖针，准得致命。念力还能让针在半空转向，打敌人一个措手不及。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME launches its sharp needles with deadly accuracy. Its telekinetic powers allow it to redirect these projectiles mid-air for a surprise attack.

entry: POKENAME前后两半身体，能各自制造火焰。前半用火进攻，后半则用火防守。
author: sk372
source: The two halves of POKENAME produce flames independent of each other. The front half uses its fire offensively, while the back half applies it for defensive maneuvers.

entry: 第二颗头见什么靠得太近，便想啃上一口。可它脑容量小，偶尔竟忘记与另一颗头共用身体，连同伴也照咬不误。
author: sk372
source: Its second head will regularly nibble and gnaw on anything that gets too close. Due to its smaller brain, it will occasionally bite the other head, forgetting they share a body.

entry: POKENAME在平原找食物耗去的能量，几乎抵得上进食所得。因此，就算主体睡了，尾上的头也得继续寻找下一餐。
author: spaghettimoe
source: POKENAME uses as much energy scouring the plains for food as it gains eating. Thus, even while sleeping, its tail-heads must search for its next meal.

entry: 这只宝可梦的身体柔软，像海绵一样，还会分泌黏液。黏液裹住树皮碎片硬化后，POKENAME就能帮忙擦洗物品表面。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon has a soft, spongy body that secretes sticky fluid. When the fluid hardens around bark pieces, POKENAME can be used to scrub surfaces.

entry: POKENAME从松果状外壳渗出甜香的汁液，引其他宝可梦靠近，再发动袭击。黑色的身体，既柔韧，又结实。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may leak out a sweet-smelling sap from its pinecone-shaped shell to lure other Pokémon closer before it attacks. The black body is both flexible and durable.

entry: 中央的头用念力指挥其余头部，精准协调进攻。炮管般的嘴，能打出破坏力惊人的种子机关枪弹幕。
author: .izik
source: The central head psychically commands the others, coordinating attacks with precision. Its cannon-like mouths unleash devastating Bullet Seed barrages.

entry: 舌尖滴下的唾液，只要碰到敌人，就能令其麻痹。与它近身交手，格外危险。
author: .izik
source: The saliva dripping from its tongue can paralyze foes on contact. This makes close combat with it particularly dangerous.

entry: 它能用臂炮快速而精准地射出石块，轻松击碎挡路的障碍。
author: .izik
source: It fires stones from its arm cannons with rapid precision. These rocky projectiles can easily shatter obstacles.

entry: 它从双臂炮管射出黏泥，拖慢敌人的行动。遇上危险，就能趁机轻松脱身。
author: .izik
source: It fires sticky mud through the cannons on its arms to slow down foes. This allows it to escape easily when threatened.

entry: 头上的角就是一门强力炮，积蓄电磁炮的能量时，会泛起粉红光芒。猛烈的炮击，连大块头也能掀倒。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its head functions as a powerful cannon, glowing pink while charging a Zap Cannon. Its aggressive blasts can topple even large foes.

entry: 它从胸口炮管一次喷出数加仑蜜状黏液。为何能产生这么多甜味分泌物，科学家仍百思不解。
author: .izik
source: It fires gallons of sticky, honey-like goo from the cannon on its chest. Scientists are still baffled by the mechanism behind its sweet secretion.

entry: 富有弹性的身体，让它行动格外自如。大多数攻击打在橡胶般的皮肤上，都只会无害地弹开。
author: .izik
source: Its elastic body allows for exceptional freedom of movement. Most attacks bounce harmlessly off its rubbery skin.

entry: POKENAME交配前，会挑选最好的结实原木，挖空内部，留待日后养育幼崽。
author: .ssunday.
source: Before mating with others, POKENAME will find the finest and strongest log and hallow it out. It will then raise its young there.

entry: 悬浮的尖刺如同双手，能将触感传回POKENAME。它爱在孩子面前跳舞，用尖刺摆出各种形状，逗他们开心。
author: darxer_
source: Its floating spikes act like hands, and will transmit any sensations to POKENAME. It likes to dance and create shapes with its spikes in front of children for their entertainment.

entry: 它专找富含铁的材料吃，强化坚固的头盔。久而久之，物理攻击几乎奈何不了它。
author: .izik
source: It seeks out iron-rich materials to eat, reinforcing its durable helmet. This habit makes it nearly impervious to physical attacks.

entry: 橡胶般的长臂能伸出15英尺，精准射出撒菱。攻击距离如此之远，使它在战斗中格外危险。
author: .izik
source: Its long, rubbery arms can extend up to 15 feet to fire Spikes with pinpoint accuracy. This extended range makes it highly dangerous in combat.

entry: POKENAME始终警戒着自己照管的森林。一有入侵者，便从指尖射出脱落的金属甲片。
author: SandGuyThing
source: Ever vigilant of the forests they tend, POKENAME will fire off discarded fragments of their metallic armor from their fingertips at intruders.

entry: POKENAME平时尽量避免与别人接触。可被逼急了，也会抡起沉重的金属身体，奋力还击。
author: bukie
source: POKENAME avoids physical contact with others when able. In a pinch, however, it swings its metallic body with great force.

entry: 战斗时，腹部会裂开，释放毒粉。毒云将敌人笼罩，令其失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: Its abdomen splits open during battle to release Poison Powder. The toxic cloud envelops foes, leaving them incapacitated.

entry: POKENAME坚固的壳，既能让它浮在水中，也能抵挡危险水生猎手的袭击。货船会小心避开漂浮海面的POKENAME群。
author: CaldonB
source: POKENAME's impressive shell is capable of keeping it buoyant, as well as withstanding attacks from dangerous aquatic predators. Cargo ships take care to avoid groups of POKENAME floating on the ocean's surface.

entry: 它会向前冲锋，用脸上的钻头刺击敌人。POKENAME太重，早已退化的翅膀根本飞不起来，休息时就钻进深土。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can charge and stab foes with the drill on its face. POKENAME's wings are purely vestigial: it cannot fly, for it is too heavy. They burrow deep in the dirt to rest.

entry: 野生POKENAME多半靠尾巴掘土，找到进化石后进化。甚至有个体会钻穿商店墙壁、玻璃展柜，就为弄到那些石头。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME most often evolves in the wild by finding evolutionary stones while using its tail to dig through the earth. There are even instances of it drilling through walls and glass displays in stores to get to these stones.

entry: POKENAME为何能在洞中穿行得又快又准，研究者仍在探究。它们还会替家族钻出结构精巧的地道。
author: Schwaus
source: Researchers are still trying to determine how POKENAME navigate caves with such speed and precision. They have been known to drill elaborate burrows for their families.

entry: 野生POKENAME常坐在洞口，凝望外面的天空，若有所思。它在一部儿童电视节目中，被描绘成智慧却心不在焉的角色，因而广受喜爱。
author: sivanandi
source: In the wild, POKENAME is usually found at the mouths of caves gazing contemplatively at the sky outside. It has become popular as a wise but absent-minded character in a children's television show.

entry: 它随洋流漂荡，遇到安全处，就用钻头状尾巴扎住海底。性情温顺，又不善游泳，全靠一身剧毒保命。
author: amiel997
source: It drifts along sea currents, anchoring itself to the ocean floor with its drill-shaped tail when it finds a safe spot. With its docile nature and poor swimming skills, it relies entirely on its toxic body for survival.

entry: 所有钻头同步旋转时，据说会涌现神秘力量。若它与训练家心意相通、信念足够坚定，钻头便能穿透挡路的一切。
author: El Fail
source: When all of its drills spin in sync, a mysterious power supposedly manifests. It is said that if it and its Trainer put their minds towards a unified purpose with enough determination, its drills can pierce through any obstacle in the way.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转钻头，让尾巴升温，便于钻穿厚土。炎热的日子，也常见它懒懒地晒太阳，保持身体温暖。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME heats up its tail by spinning its drill at high speeds, helping it tunnel through thick soil. It can be seen lazing in the sun on hot days to keep itself warm.

entry: 它用尖尾钻进洞壁或洞顶。受了打扰，便迅速飞往别处，再钻个洞藏身。
author: Schwaus
source: It uses its pointy tail to burrow into the walls and tops of caves. When it gets disturbed it quickly flies to a new location to burrow.

entry: 这种融合体钻洞快得惊人，数英里厚的坚硬基岩也能穿透。因此，矿工颇爱骑在它背上，指挥它一路开掘。
author: El Fail
source: This fusion is capable of drilling tunnels at incredible speeds, even through miles of solid bedrock. For this reason it became moderately popular among miners, who ride atop it and order it where to dig while it burrows away.

entry: 它以强烈的尖叫辨认洞中道路。受到威胁，就用尾巴钻向敌人。
author: Schwaus
source: It navigates through caves with high-powered screeches. When threatened, it will drill into opponents with its tail.

entry: POKENAME看着不起眼，却以突然发狂、袭击无辜训练家而臭名昭著。看见一只，附近往往就藏着一整群。
author: SinisterSama
source: Though unassuming, POKENAME are notorious for suddenly getting violent and attacking innocent Trainers. If you see one, a school of them is nearby.

entry: POKENAME的钻头尾很适合挖土，可它经常钻到半途，就忘了为何要钻，停在地下。最后还得请人，把它从自己挖的洞里拉出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's drill-tail is an effective tool for burrowing through dirt, but it often forgets why it burrows and stops halfway within the ground.  It will often need help being pulled out of holes it dug for itself.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在险峻崖壁筑巢。谁敢靠近，就会立即遭到密集袭击，闪亮的贵重物品也被抢走。
author: bobosmith01
source: A group of POKENAME nests in the sides of craggy cliffs. Anyone who approaches is swiftly bombarded and has their shiny valuables stolen.

entry: 它用小翅膀迎风，飘在地面上方。夜间，为免飘走，便将尾巴扎进树皮柔软的树干。
author: darxer_
source: It floats above the ground, using its small wings to catch the wind. To keep itself tethered at night, it will stab its tail into a soft-barked tree.

entry: POKENAME的钳子连石头也能夹碎。想让它松开，唯一的办法，就是挠挠耳根。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pincers are strong enough to crush stone. The only way to make it release its grip is to tickle the base of its ears.

entry: POKENAME原本被培育为爬高手与猎手，如今却常被当成新奇宠物。天生适于户外工作的它们，精力旺盛得让多数主人招架不住，遭遗弃的事因而屡见不鲜。
author: .fedoraman
source: Initially bred as adept climbers and hunters, POKENAME are now kept as novelty pets. As Pokémon made to work outside, their boundless energy is too much for most owners, ending in their all-too-common abandonment.

entry: 身体由极为坚韧的钢构成，能让它引爆电能，掀起剧烈爆炸，自己却依然毫发无损。
author: sk372
source: Its body is composed of highly durable steel. This resilient form allows it to burst with an explosion of electrical energy, while leaving its body intact and undamaged.

entry: POKENAME多住在积水隧道与水下洞窟。它们被发现前，那哀婉而带金属声的鸣叫，催生了许多海上鬼故事，也曾警示过往船只。
author: sk372
source: Mainly inhabiting watery tunnels and underwater caverns, before their discovery, the wailing and metallic cry of wild POKENAME was the fuel for many a seafaring ghost story and a warning for sailing ships.

entry: 世界上一些最深的洞穴，就是POKENAME用钻尾挖出来的。它们的遗传物质不稳定，据说能在体表生成各种矿物。
author: Markusknight
source: Some of the deepest caverns in the world are known to be dug by POKENAME's drilling tail. Their genetic material is unstable and is said to produce various minerals on the surface of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME体内压力极高，必须释放猛烈火焰降温。背上奇异的晶体，即使不直接碰到火，也能升至700度。
author: Mistymagius
source: The extreme internal pressure acting on POKENAME's body causes it to release intense flames to cool off. The unique crystals on its back can reach 700 degrees without direct contact with the flames.

entry: 白天是钢铁雕像，夜里却飞行迅捷，这只宝可梦让人费解不已。重达400公斤，究竟怎样飞起来，至今无人知晓。
author: Fr34kuenCy
source: A steel statue at daytime, a swift flier at night, this Pokémon has confused many a person. Weighing 400 kg, it is unknown how it is able to fly.

entry: POKENAME的门牙长个不停。野外，它们经常钻凿岩石隧道，借此把牙磨得短而锋利。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's front teeth constantly grow. In the wild, they keep them short and sharp through frequent use as they dig tunnels through stone.

entry: POKENAME体内的金属能制作上等不锈钢平底锅，因此需求极高。幸好不必伤害它们，经常脱落的甲壳就足够用了。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME are in high demand for the metals inside their bodies, which allow for the production of first-rate stainless steel frying pans. Fortunately they do not need to be harmed in the process, as their frequently shed carapace is sufficient.

entry: 它的晶体，成分近似未经提炼的超级石。人们因此推测，它始终处于一种类似超级进化的状态。
author: Staghorn
source: Its crystals have a similar composition to unrefined Mega Stones. It is theorized to be in a constant state of something similar to Mega Evolution as a result.

entry: 大地磨亮了POKENAME的金属外壳与水晶尾巴。据说，POKENAME尾尖由最纯粹的能量构成，历经无数岁月，才淬炼而成。
author: Swagouille
source: The earth has polished POKENAME's metallic exterior and crystalline tail. The tip of POKENAME's tail is said to be formed from the purest energy, honed over countless years.

entry: POKENAME背上能长出美丽又坚韧的水晶刺，战斗时将其射出。沉重的尾巴也挥得异常灵巧，转眼便能击退敌人或窃贼。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to create beautiful yet durable crystal spines along their back and launch them out during battle. POKENAME wield their heavy tails with surprising dexterity, smacking away any foes or thieves in an instant.

entry: POKENAME身上的晶体呈棱柱状，战斗时会折射缤纷光彩。可它们十分脆弱，常常折断，在洞穴地上留下碎片。
author: kingd8
source: The crystals adorning POKENAME's body are prismatic, refracting colorfully as POKENAME fights. These crystals, however, are very fragile and break often, leaving shards along cave floors.

entry: POKENAME住在海床深处。某一带若聚集了足够多个体，它们的活动便能引发海底地震与海啸。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME live deep beneath the ocean floor. The movements of enough POKENAME in any given area can cause underwater earthquakes and tsunamis.

entry: POKENAME的身体坚不可摧，连地心的酷热也能承受。动作虽慢，冲锋的力量却足以撞碎巨石。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME's body is impenetrable and can withstand the heat of the planet's core. Although slow, it can charge with enough power to break boulders.

entry: 它主要吃各种宝石与金属。有人曾看见成群的POKENAME，在废品场里大嚼废金属。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its diet mainly consists of various types of gemstones and metals. Groups of POKENAME have been sighted devouring scrap metal in junk yards.

entry: 人们只在夜里见过这只宝可梦飞行。白天，它或许藏在地底深处，躲避阳光。
author: cheroace
source: This Pokémon has only been sighted flying at night. During the day, it is thought to be deep underground to avoid sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用巨爪把大块岩石从岩壁中拔出，再以惊人的力气投向对手，砸个粉碎。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses its massive claws to pull huge boulders out of the wall. It throws these with enormous strength to crush its opponents.

entry: 铁牙与巨颚让POKENAME能挖穿各种岩石，开凿自己的洞穴。它极护领地，洞内遇见任何宝可梦，都要打上一场。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME uses its iron tusks and jaws to dig through any kind of rock, allowing it to carve out its own caves. It is territorial and will fight any Pokémon it finds in its caves.

entry: 铁牙与巨颚让POKENAME能挖穿各种岩石，开凿自己的洞穴。它极护领地，洞内遇见任何宝可梦，都要打上一场。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME uses its iron tusks and jaws to dig through any kind of rock, allowing it to carve out its own caves. It is territorial and will fight any Pokémon it finds in its caves.

entry: 脑中的磁铁，能帮POKENAME找到最优质的矿物。吃下后，合金钢身体便更加强壮。它不是睡觉、吃饭，就是在训练。
author: bobosmith01
source: The magnet in POKENAME's brain allows them to locate the highest quality minerals, which it then devours to further strengthen its powerful body made of alloy steel. If it is not sleeping or eating, it is likely training.

entry: 只有在各类地形上，经历多种格斗训练，宝可梦才能进化成POKENAME。双臂能击碎钢铁，身体则能崩断几乎任何武器。
author: bobosmith01
source: Only with a wide variety of martial training in various terrains can a Pokémon evolve into POKENAME. It has arms that can shatter steel and a body that can break nearly any weapon.

entry: POKENAME的根系朝地心深扎，令它无法逃走。它从地下深处吸收水分与金属微粒，把头部锤炼得连钻石也划不伤。
author: takopus
source: POKENAME's roots dig towards the world's core, making it unable to flee. It absorbs water and metal particles from the depths, hardening its head that even diamond can't scratch.

entry: POKENAME每年都会蜕去最外层金属，很快再长出更坚固的一层。据说，活满百年的个体，皮肤便会变得无物可破。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shed their outermost layer of metal yearly, growing a stronger one shortly afterward. It's said that those reaching one hundred years develop impenetrable skin.

entry: 看着头重脚轻，双腿却仍与嘟嘟利没什么分别，竟能驮着三颗巨大的大钢蛇头，跑速也只略微下降。科学家至今不明白其中道理。
author: sk372
source: Despite the lopsided appearance, legs that look unchanged from Dodrio carry the three massive Steelix heads with only a marginal decrease in top speed. Scientists are still baffled by this.

entry: 与布鲁不同，POKENAME会模仿怒犬四处跑，专门吓唬小型宝可梦与孩子。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Unlike a Snubbull, POKENAME runs around mimicking an angry dog, scaring small Pokémon and children.

entry: 它背上的蘑菇甜得像糖果，十分珍贵。可POKENAME咬起人来极凶，采摘它们，并不容易。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms on its back are prized for their sweet, candy-like flavor, but gathering them is dangerous, as POKENAME has a vicious bite.

entry: POKENAME极其自私，看见甜食，就毫不犹豫地偷走。若没拿到自己认为应得的那份，还会大发脾气。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an extremely selfish Pokémon who will steal any sweet treat it can find without hesitation. It will throw a tantrum if it doesn't get the sweets it thinks it deserves.

entry: POKENAME争强好斗，常蓬起羽毛、张开翅膀，想显得更吓人。它们争抢树梢向阳的位置，败者只好待在下层枝头。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are rather argumentative, puffing up their feathers and spreading their wings to try and appear more intimidating. They fight over sunny spots in the treetops, leaving those that lose the fights to stay on the lower branches.

entry: POKENAME在树缝中筑巢，会啄向伸手想摸它的人。不过奇怪的是，它通常不攻击体型更小的虫宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME nest in small crevices in trees. It will peck at humans who try to touch it, but, strangely, it does not usually attack smaller Bug-types.

entry: POKENAME潜行于高草丛，用喙刺中虫宝可梦，充作食物。它的喙与双翅，都由干枯硬化的叶片构成。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME prowls around tall grass, spearing bug Pokémon with its beak for meals. Its beak and wings are made of dried hardened leaves.

entry: 它能发出刺耳的鸣叫，把烈拉达召到身旁。它贪吃又杂食，飞行还要耗去大量能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can let out a piercing cry that rallies Speartata to its location. It has an gluttonous omnivorous diet, and uses much of its energy in order to fly.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，吵吵闹闹，常毫无规律地四处飞窜。据说，叫声中藏着隐晦的信息，让训练家与研究者都摸不着头脑。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is a spirited and noisy creature, often found darting about in chaotic patterns. Its cries are said to contain cryptic meanings, baffling Trainers and researchers alike.

entry: POKENAME自以为高同伴一等，总爱欺负同群成员，甚至威逼它们交出食物，任其挨饿。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will constantly bully other members of its flock, thinking itself superior. It will even threaten its flock members into giving up their food, leaving them to starve.

entry: POKENAME没长出大嘴雀同族那样的长喙，只好仗势欺负成群烈雀，把它们赶开，抢吃的果腹。
author: sk372
source: Having not evolved the long beak of its Fearow kin, POKENAME often has to resort to bullying flocks of Spearow away from food in order to gain sustenance of its own.

entry: 它会混进烈雀群中，趁对方不注意，偷走食物。POKENAME一生中，只长得出少数几根钢羽。
author: Mistymagius
source: It will disguise itself amongst flocks of Spearow, planning on taking their food while their unaware. POKENAME only produce a couple of steel feathers in their lifetime.

entry: POKENAME靠磁力，勉强做出近似飞行的动作，维持起来却十分耗能。旅人可要当心，树上随时可能掉下一只累瘫的POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to achieve something vaguely resembling flight. This takes a lot of energy to maintain, so travelers should be wary to watch for exhausted POKENAME falling out of the trees.

entry: 不捕鱼时，POKENAME大多待在僻静岸边，把羽毛梳理得干干净净。即使遇上汹涌急流，它也能熟练穿行。
author: bobosmith01
source: When not hunting for fish, POKENAME spends much of its free time on secluded shores to preen its feathers to pristine condition. It shows remarkable ability to navigate through even extreme currents.

entry: 受到细心照料的POKENAME，对训练家忠诚无比。它常凭顽强意志，撑着战斗到最后一刻。
author: Inksans201x
source: When raised with care, POKENAME is fiercely loyal to it's Trainer, oftentimes willing itself to keep fighting until the very end.

entry: POKENAME的嘴虽然巨大，含东西时却柔软又轻柔，连蛋放进去也不会破。它们常这样叼着自己的蛋，护着运走。
author: SonTyp
source: Its huge mouth is actually so soft and gentle that a POKENAME can keep an egg in it without it being damaged. This goes so far that POKENAME often transport their eggs this way to guard them.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙极重，任其长得太长，连头都会歪向一边。因此，它会拿树干磨牙。
author: dragonessanimations
source: POKENAME has very heavy fangs that cause its head to tilt to one side if left to grow too much. Therefore, it will file its fangs down on trees.

entry: 这是颚部最发达的宝可梦之一。咬合的力量，几乎能一口咬碎任何东西。
author: Pof.Whitebeam
source: This is one of the Pokémon with the most-developed jaws. It has a strength that allows it to break almost anything with an single bite.

entry: 别被它不高兴的脸骗了。若不是总朝靠近主人的陌生人吠叫，它几乎就是孩子最理想的伙伴。甚至有人觉得，POKENAME实在太亲人了。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: Do not be fooled by its grumpy appearance. It would almost be the perfect Pokémon for children if it didn't have the tendency to bark at strangers coming too close to its owner. Some think POKENAME is, in fact, too approachable.

entry: POKENAME全身长满锋利的毒羽。训练家常见它将羽毛射向靠得太近的宝可梦。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME grows sharp toxic feathers all across its body. Trainers often see POKENAME launching its feathers at Pokémon that get too close.

entry: 靠近野生POKENAME，身上就会突然传来尖锐的刺痛。因此，有人把它们视为不祥之兆。
author: JackSkipper
source: A sharp sting will hit your body when you are near a wild POKENAME. Because of these harmful interactions, they are considered bad omens by some.

entry: 它借体内强大的水压，从头冠的孔中高速射出尖刺，再用超能力引导每一根，几乎百发百中。
author: amiel997
source: It uses the immense water pressure in its body to launch spikes from the hole in its crown at incredible speeds. With its psychic powers guiding each spike, it almost never misses its mark.

entry: POKENAME能拔下毒刺，叼在嘴里，再借水柱将其射向猎物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can detach its poisonous quills, hold one in its mouth, and launch it at prey with a jet of water.

entry: POKENAME恶意十足，会故意让自己讨厌的家伙，承受难忍的剧烈刺痛。
author: JackSkipper
source: POKENAME are nothing short of malicious. They will purposefully affect those they dislike with a horrible stinging feeling.

entry: 它把身体灌满水，既能熬过长久干旱，也显得更加庞大吓人。再配上长而锋利的尖刺，很少有宝可梦敢挑战它，或拿它当猎物。
author: amiel997
source: By filling its body with water, it can survive for long periods of drought and appear more imposing to foes. With its bulky appearance and long, menacing spikes, few Pokémon dare to challenge or prey on it.

entry: POKENAME以千针鱼为食，嘴巴连毒刺也扎不穿。可它常把水雷误当猎物，花上几个小时，想把水雷嚼烂。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME prey on Qwilfish. Their mouths cannot be punctured by the Qwilfish's poisonous quills. They often mistake sea mines for their prey, spending hours trying to chew them apart.

entry: POKENAME会比“拔河”，看哪一边的钩能把另一边拉得更远，以此决出主导。这种较量，也让钩始终锋利。
author: gordogamr
source: POKENAME determine which hook is dominant through duels of "Tug of War," seeing which can pull the other further. These duels also prevent their hooks from dulling.

entry: POKENAME借体内储水产生的高压，向敌人打出快拳。遍布全身的刺状结构其实是腺体，一挨打，就会释放毒孢子，让人不敢贸然进攻。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME uses the high pressure from its water-filled body to launch rapid punches at its enemies. The spike-like structures covering its body are actually glands that release poisonous spores when it's struck, making it dangerous to attack.

entry: POKENAME的性格和身体一样扎人，又挑剔得很。主人得费尽心思，赢得足够信任与喜爱，它才肯收起毒刺，让人摸一摸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a personality as prickly as its body. Finicky to the extreme, owners must work hard to earn enough of its trust and affection for it to retract its poisonous spines and allow itself to be pet.

entry: 一被激怒，它就鼓起头上的两个囊，借此紧紧附在敌人身上，再从尖刺注入毒素。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it is angered, it inflates the two sacs on its head, allowing it to latch onto enemies. It then releases toxins through its spikes.

entry: 它会把头上的小千针鱼射向敌人，保卫领地。千针鱼究竟介不介意，尚不清楚。
author: kittyluv090
source: It defends its territory by launching the small Qwilfish on its head towards foes. It is unknown if the Qwilfish are bothered by this.

entry: 它动作迟缓，尾巴上带刺的生物却有自己的大脑，谁靠得太近，就会被注入剧毒。危险时，POKENAME会摆出怒脸，想靠威吓免去争斗。
author: amiel997
source: Though it moves sluggishly, the spiky creature on its tail has its own brain and will inject potent toxins into anything that gets too close. When in danger, POKENAME will try to avoid combat by making a angry face to intimidade the adversary.

entry: 这只宝可梦的模样，像来自遥远国度的战士。POKENAME奔跑时，红尘随身飞舞，宛如风中飘落的花瓣。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. A red dust follows POKENAME as it runs, resembling flower petals blowing in the wind.

entry: 这只宝可梦的模样，像来自遥远国度的战士。POKENAME奔跑时，红尘随身飞舞，宛如风中飘落的花瓣。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. A red dust follows POKENAME as it runs, resembling flower petals blowing in the wind.

entry: POKENAME的钳子能夹碎、折弯钢铁，再硬的金属碎料，也能被它加工成摆锤。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME can crush and bend steel with its pincers. It crafts pendulums from even the toughest scraps of metal.

entry: POKENAME在繁茂的丛林中，用蘑菇伪装自己。平日几乎一动不动，偶尔才吃点树果。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME camouflages itself with mushrooms in lush jungles. It usually stays motionless, occasionally eating berries.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成椒盐卷饼，引来灰尘山、小拉达等宝可梦捕食。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are often preyed upon by Pokémon such as Garbodor and Rattata, as it is commonly mistaken for a pretzel.

entry: 初见POKENAME时，人们以为终于发现了无壳的壶壶。后来虽证实并非如此，仍有人提出偏门猜想，认为两者可能同源。
author: sk372
source: When initially observed, POKENAME was thought to be the first sighting of a shell-less Shuckle. Though debunked, it has invited fringe theories about a possible shared lineage.

entry: POKENAME用包袱装着训练家丢弃的树果，身后常会留下一路果汁。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME uses its bundle to carry berries discarded by Trainers. It tends to leave a trail of berry juice in its wake.

entry: POKENAME收集许多树果，也会分一些给境况不佳的宝可梦。可贪心的家伙若想多拿，便很可能被POKENAME咬上一口。
author: Sprach Zarathustra
source: As it collects many berries, POKENAME will share some with less fortunate Pokémon. Greedy Pokémon who try to take more than their fair share are likely to get bitten by POKENAME.

entry: 它一边吃树果，一边在壳状头骨内酿出混合果汁。偏头痛剧烈发作时，果汁可能从头顶小孔喷出，宛如间歇泉。
author: sk372
source: As it eats berries, it creates a mixture of berry juices within its shell-like cranium. If a painful migraine flares up, this juice may erupt from the hole on top like a geyser.

entry: 它真正的身体，是壳内霉菌般的团块。它以巨钳蟹为食，用强烈的消化液溶掉内脏，再把空壳占作新家。
author: amiel997
source: Its true body is the mold-like mass inside its shell. It preys on Kingler by dissolving their insides with potent digestive juices and taking over the empty shell as its new home.

entry: 深色的身体让POKENAME藏进林中阴影。强壮的舌头伸出快得惊人，转眼便能缠住猎物。
author: sivanandi
source: Its dark coloration helps POKENAME hide in shady areas of forests. Its powerful tongue lashes out at startling speeds to grapple its prey.

entry: POKENAME馋着林木的甜汁。为了更容易吸到树皮里的汁液，它连整棵树都敢一头撞倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to consume the sweet sap from forest trees. It won't hesitate to knock over the trees with its charge, just to more easily suck the sap from their bark.

entry: 它温柔地照顾着袋中珍贵的花苞。谁敢靠近，就会遭到它用强壮的角发起的猛烈反击。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: It tenderly cares for the precious bulb in its pouch, defending it fiercely with its powerful horn from any who dare to approach.

entry: 它在树上凿出深洞，让幼崽爬进去，大享甜蜜树汁。此时，谁敢靠近，都会被POKENAME强有力的角掀到一旁。
author: sk372
source: It tears deep holes in trees so that its young can crawl inside and feast on the sweet sap within. Any interlopers that venture too close during this time will be tossed aside by POKENAME's powerful horn.

entry: POKENAME虽披着坚硬笨重的外骨骼，飞得却快得惊人。翅膀响起嗡鸣，便是猎物该赶紧逃命的信号。
author: sivanandi
source: Despite its hard and bulky exoskeleton, POKENAME can fly surprisingly fast. The loud buzzing of its wings is a signal for its prey to run for their lives.

entry: POKENAME有三只角，中央那只尤其雄伟。角与坚韧的外骨骼，由同一种材料构成。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME has three horns, with the middle horn being the most impressive one. The horns are made of the same material as its tough exoskeleton.

entry: 彻底结茧前，POKENAME先把角深深扎进树中，让黏甜的树汁慢慢滴在身上。外壳吸收汁液，便为进化添了养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will embed its horn deep into trees before fully cocooning itself, so that sticky sweet sap trickles onto it. It absorbs the sap into the shell, which helps fuel the evolution process.

entry: POKENAME找到甜树汁，就从关节分泌液体，通知同伴。靠这种合作，它们能共享难得的食物。
author: lemage22
source: When POKENAME finds sweet sap, it secretes a fluid from its joints to alert others. This cooperative behavior allows groups to share valuable food sources.

entry: POKENAME聚在深林里，吸食树汁与花蜜，用角集中超能力。大群一同施力，便能让林地扭转成离奇梦境，再用怪异现象与幻术，守住这片天地。
author: Alkazamis
source: POKENAME gather deep in forests to sip sweet sap and nectar. They focus their psychic powers using their horns. Swarms of them warp their woodland realms into surreal dreamscapes, which they protect with freaky phenomena and bizarre illusions.

entry: 只有吃得饱饱的POKENAME，身上缠绕的金藤才会隐约带着蜜味。想来啃甜藤的害虫，都得先过它强壮身体这一关。
author: bobosmith01
source: The golden vines laced around its body taste vaguely of honey, but only when POKENAME is well-fed. It uses its powerful body to defend itself against pests wanting to nibble on its sweet vines.

entry: POKENAME的背又宽又平，成了绝佳擂台。常在那里开打的，便是怒气冲冲的赫拉克罗斯与凯罗斯。
author: Incognito1234
source: Possessing a large, flat back, POKENAME have become perfect places for fights. Usually, this is between angry Heracross and Pinsir.

entry: POKENAME用引以为傲的角，掀翻披着重甲的宝可梦，再以强颚咬破柔软的腹部。
author: GentleSage
source: POKENAME uses its prized horn to flip over heavily-armored Pokémon. It then uses its powerful jaws to break though the softer underbelly.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，常低估自己的速度，来不及刹住，一头撞上障碍。挡路的东西粉碎，它却毫发无伤，继续四处疾跑。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: While running, POKENAME often underestimates its speed, causing it to slam into obstacles as it cannot stop in time. Whatever it collided with ends up demolished while the Pokémon remains unharmed and continues to race around.

entry: POKENAME借包裹身体的液体，吸收找到的蜂蜜充饥。吃得太多，身体也会鼓胀起来。
author: Incognito1234
source: Using the liquid surrounding its body, POKENAME absorbs any honey it finds as food. This can cause it to swell when it obtains too much.

entry: POKENAME找到大量蜂蜜，就紧紧附在上面，用满身尖刺驱赶天敌。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME locates large honey sources and then sticks to them, warding off predators with its many spikes.

entry: POKENAME爱喝树中的蜜汁。谁想染指它占下的那棵树，就会遭到角与利爪的猛烈袭击。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME loves to drink tree nectar. If anything tries to take from a tree it has claimed, POKENAME attacks it viciously with its horn and claws.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会用双臂探索世界。两条手臂还像灵活的眉毛，随时把它的心情表现出来。
author: entomoxie
source: As a young fusion, a typical POKENAME uses both arms to explore the world. These arms naturally express how a POKENAME feels at any given moment, serving as flexible eyebrows.

entry: POKENAME的双臂既能攻击，也能装作额外的头，或组成主头的眉毛。丰富的表情让它们易于交流，必要时，也能威吓其他宝可梦。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can use their arms to attack, but they can also be used to emulate extra heads while forming the eyebrows on the main head. This expressiveness allows them to communicate clearly while intimidating other Pokémon as needed.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知水流，辨认环境与其他宝可梦。看触角的大小，还能判断POKENAME的年龄与性别。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME use their antennae to feel the current in the water, in order to discern their surroundings and sense other Pokémon. The size of the antennae determine the age and gender of a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME清早去附近树林采蜜，下午和朋友切磋，战后再分蜜给大家，当作点心。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME rises early to collect honey from nearby woods. In the afternoon, it spars with friends and shares honey with them as a post-battle treat.

entry: 母亲去世后，POKENAME变得冷漠而怨恨。它从巢中偷走蛋，想让别人也尝尝同样的痛。
author: welliss
source: POKENAME is cold and bitter after the death of its mother. It steals eggs from nests to make others experience the same pain.

entry: 它们寻找其他宝可梦的巢，合力打败亲代，再把双亲连同蛋，一并吃下。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: They seek out the nests of Pokémon and work together to defeat the parents. Once their prey is defeated, they eat both the parents and their eggs.

entry: POKENAME将毛发冻结，形成用来爬树的利爪与尖刺。它会藏在积雪的掩护下。
author: Ced Lasso
source: A POKENAME freezes its fur to make claws and spikes for climbing trees. It hides under the cover of snow.

entry: POKENAME有锋利的爪子，能在坚冰上疾奔。它本可以是出色的雪橇宝可梦，却坚决不肯套上挽具。
author: Danarchist
source: POKENAME have sharp claws that allow them to sprint on solid ice. They would make excellent sled Pokémon, but they will not tolerate being harnessed.

entry: POKENAME十分虚荣，尤其迷恋珠宝。若想让POKENAME听话，训练家就得经常送上手镯、项链，讨好它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a vain sort, obsessed with jewelry in particular.  Trainers should expect to regularly gift and bribe it with bracelets and necklaces if they ever hope to have POKENAME obey.

entry: POKENAME热爱犯罪，梦想着帮训练家逃脱法网。要把这种融合宝可梦教得正直善良，非得有最坚定的意志、最纯净的心。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME adores crime, as it cherishes the dream of helping its Trainer get away from the forces of law. It will take the strongest of wills and purest of hearts to raise this fusion in the ways of justice and goodhearted actions.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进三蜜蜂的巢夺蜜，其实是拿蜜把丝线与细枝粘在一起，搭自己的巢。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid Combee nests for their honey. They actually use the honey to stick silk and twigs together to make their nests.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME会随流星雨落到地面。即使白天，眼中也闪着星光。
author: missingmilkman
source: It is thought that POKENAME fall to ground during meteor showers. Its eye twinkles with starlight, even during the day.

entry: POKENAME住在火山洞窟，很少独自外出。出来时，会采集附近的花粉与树果，用体热烹熟，却从不为觅食离巢太远。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME live in volcanic caverns and rarely leave alone. When they do, they can harvest any pollen and berries in the area, cooking them with their own body heat. However, they never stray far from their dens for food.

entry: POKENAME跃上半空，双翼便沿途滴落蜂蜜，因此行踪很好追寻。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME leaps into the air, it trails honey from its wings. As a result, it is very easy to follow.

entry: POKENAME住在高山的森林中，靠敏锐嗅觉寻找满是蜜的蜂巢。找到后，便一再撞树，直到蜂巢掉到林地上。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains amongst alpine forests. Using its keen sense of smell it tracks down hives filled with Honey and will ram into the trees until the hive drops to the forest floor.

entry: 酿蜜的虫宝可梦夜里睡熟，POKENAME便趁机远行，寻找最爱的食物。遇上筑着蜂巢的树，它会凭巨力将其推倒。
author: Katie
source: Preferring to navigate at night when the Bug types that produce Honey are asleep, POKENAME will travel great distances in search of its favourite food. When it finds a tree housing a nest, it uses its immense strength to topple it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是尚未壮盛便遭砍伐的树木亡魂。平时藏在空心木中，新月一到，便异常活跃，大口吸食附近植物的甜汁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are said to be the spirits of trees cut down before their prime. They hide inside hollow logs until the new moon, when they become extremely active, devouring sweet sap from nearby flora.

entry: POKENAME对人友善，是果园与蜂场的好帮手。帮忙采收后，它只求分到一些蜂蜜，作为报酬。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME are very friendly to humans and are great helpers in orchards and apiaries. In exchange for help with harvesting, POKENAME asks for portions of honey as payment.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是孤儿熊宝宝死后的亡魂。它飘过森林，幽怨的哀鸣让熊宝宝哭泣，也让圈圈熊悲愤得发狂。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME is the spirit of deceased orphan Teddiursa. It floats through forests, its haunting wail causing Teddiursa to cry and Ursaring to go into grief-stricken rages.

entry: 千万别靠近落单的POKENAME幼崽，否则，它的母亲可能会缠上你，往后几年都紧追不舍。
author: kingd8
