source: Trainers should never approach an unattended POKENAME cub, or they risk being relentlessly stalked by its mother for years to come.

entry: POKENAME看着凶，却很认真地琢磨滑稽表演，想逗大家开心。最常演的桥段，就是上面一双手臂与下面一双手臂，默默吵个不停。
author: sk372
source: Though it looks aggressive, POKENAME takes its antics and attempts to entertain very seriously. Its usual act involves the upper arms arguing with the lower arms during their miming.

entry: POKENAME脖子上的花楸果，很受熊宝可梦喜爱。它们常站在湍急河畔，伸长脖子，从水中捉起鱼宝可梦。
author: moopse
source: The rowan berries that grow on POKENAME's neck are beloved by all bear Pokémon. These Pokémon can be found standing at the edge of swift rivers, grabbing fish Pokémon out of the water with their long necks.

entry: 为了追上最爱的猎物鲤鱼王，POKENAME会奋勇跃上汹涌的河流。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME aggressively leaps up raging rivers to follow its favorite prey, Magikarp.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME是废弃机器人拼合而成的集合体。可它真正从何而来，仍深藏谜团。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is rumoured to be an amalgamation composed of scrap robots. However, its true origins are shrouded in mystery.

entry: POKENAME平时大多安然躺着，可一旦发力，威势足以改变地貌。它们尤其喜欢蜜源丰富的地方，护起领地来毫不留情。
author: helix2b
source: While they spend most of their time lounging peacefully, POKENAME's bursts of energy are fearsome, capable of reshaping the land. They fiercely guard their territory, drawn especially to areas rich in honey.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，先装作四足行走，再突然直立、飘起来，吓唬猎人和登山者。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME is quite the playful creature. It pretends to walk on all fours and then float while on its hind legs to scare hunters and hikers.

entry: POKENAME一拳能劈开原木、巨石，其他藏身处更不在话下。若它正追着你跑，找掩护可救不了你。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can split logs and boulders with a single punch and otherwise totally shatter any hiding spot. If POKENAME is chasing you down, trying to protect yourself is not an option.

entry: 它生活在火山地带，散发辛辣的香气。敌人哪怕只闻到一丝，也会呛得眼泪直流。
author: _jix
source: It lives in volcanic areas. It releases a spicy aroma that can make a foe's eyes water with even the faintest of scents.

entry: 只有幼崽热得足以熔穿蛋壳，POKENAME的蛋才会孵化。它爱依偎着其他火宝可梦，将温暖分给伙伴。
author: Katie
source: A POKENAME egg only hatches once the baby within has reached a sufficient temperature to melt through its shell. It loves to cuddle up to other Fire-types, sharing its warmth with its fellow Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱跟着火舞表演者，模仿他们的动作。可它行动太慢，总演不好，却依然尽心尽力。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to follow fire dancers around and mimic their performances, however its movements are too sluggish for it to perform effectively. It tries its best nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上覆盖着岩浆般的黏液，让它能随意点燃全身。这种适应既有利战斗，也能让它飞行时不被自身火焰灼伤。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME's feathers are covered in a magma-like slime that allows it to ignite itself at will. This unique adaptation not only aids in battling but also protects it from burns during flight.

entry: POKENAME会俯冲向落叶，在飞行中将其点燃，练习捕猎。火焰虽小，每成功扑击一次，就亮上几分，渐露未来空中猎手的潜力。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME practices hunting by diving at fallen leaves, igniting them mid-flight. Though its flames are small, they grow brighter with every successful strike, showcasing its potential as a future aerial predator.

entry: POKENAME会在活火山里筑巢，借高温孵蛋、养育幼崽。科学家把这样一群火热的宝可梦，称为“一阵热潮”。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for nesting inside active volcanoes, using the intense heat to incubate its eggs and raise young. Scientists refer to a group of these fiery Pokémon as a 'Hot Flash'.

entry: 熔岩在POKENAME体内流动，一接触外界便汩汩冒泡。离开栖息地后，POKENAME会凝成密实的外壳，模样近似另一地区的泥巴鱼。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME's lava courses through its system, bubbling up when exposed to the elements. When out of its habitat, POKENAME hardens into a dense shell similar to a Stunfisk of another region.

entry: POKENAME追随活火山的光，吃新涌出的熔岩。飞行时，滚烫的岩浆沿途滴落，身体便逐渐缩小，直到它再次进食。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are drawn to the light of active volcanoes to feed on the fresh lava they produce. Droplets of hot lava drip off this Pokémon as it flies, slowly reducing their body size until they can feed again.

entry: 极少数活火山地带，也会诞生植物生命，化作POKENAME。强烈的求生本能让它比普通植物坚韧得多，可一碰水，仍会迅速萎蔫。
author: sk372
source: Rarely, plant life will form even in active volcanic areas, becoming POKENAME.  Though hardier than most plants due to their intense survival instinct, water will make it wilt rapidly.

entry: POKENAME消耗生物质，合成高辛烷值的碳氢化合物。能否利用这种本领替代化石燃料，正引发激烈争论。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME consumes biomass to synthesize high octane hydrocarbons. The possibility of exploiting this quality to replace fossil fuels is hotly debated.

entry: 摆锤会慢慢熔掉，POKENAME只得不停寻找新的。不过这倒适合它，四处活动，也让身体不易凝固。
author: noel5229
source: Because its pendulum melts over time, POKENAME constantly has to search for new ones. This suits it, however, as moving prevents it from hardening.

entry: POKENAME踢出能熔化金属的火焰踢时，熔融的身体会不断滴落，发出嘶嘶声。它热爱训练，总想踢得更快，因此训练过的地方常留下焦痕。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME's molten body drips and sizzles as it delivers flaming kicks that can melt metal. It loves to train, trying to increase the speed of its kicks, often leaving scorch marks wherever it trains.

entry: POKENAME常附在火山口内壁，藏于岩浆表面之下。离开熔岩后，就得不断转动背上的火焰手臂，免得身体凝固。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME are typically found stuck to the walls of volcano craters, just below the magma's surface. When out of lava, they must constantly spin the flaming arms on their backs to prevent themselves from hardening.

entry: POKENAME踏过熔岩池，从中汲取温暖。若待在寒冷之地，很快就会死去。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME stride through lava pools, which provide them with warmth. If they're in cold environments, they will soon perish.

entry: POKENAME的岩浆身体，能完全缩回石壳，保护自己；也借此避免伤及周围。
author: lunacharlotte
source: POKENAME's magma body can fully retreat into its stony shell for protection. It also does so to avoid harming its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME是火山地带的熔岩鸟，吃岩石、宝石与矿物。它在高空飞行时，身体可能滴落岩浆，登山者可得留神。
author: Alexandre_vulgo_Xande
source: POKENAME is a lava-like bird native to volcanic areas; its diet includes rocks, gems, and minerals. Hikers should be careful since it can drop lava from its body when flying high in the sky.

entry: 它很亲人，爱像围巾一样，缠住训练家的脖子。可皮肤烫得厉害，这份亲热，只会让人受伤。
author: bostroms
source: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.

entry: 它很亲人，爱像围巾一样，缠住训练家的脖子。可皮肤烫得厉害，这份亲热，只会让人受伤。
author: bostroms
source: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.

entry: POKENAME在熔岩池旁筑巢，也常潜入其中觅食，因此身体始终温热。可体温足以瞬间熔化岩石，训练家想摸它，可得小心。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: POKENAME is known to make nests close to lava pools and often dives into them in search of food. As a result, it is always warm. Its body temperature can melt rocks with one touch, so trainers are advised to be careful while petting it.

entry: 它往岩石手臂里灌入热气，让身体升空。若一只手臂坏了，便吐上热熔岩，耐心等它冷却成石，修补如初。
author: Mistymagius
source: It fills its rocky arms with hot air, allowing it to lift off the ground. If one of its arms is damaged, it will spit hot lava on it, then patiently wait for it to cool back into rock.

entry: 岩石外骨骼让POKENAME能藏进岩浆，伪装自己。时机一到，便猛跃而出，用角攻击猎物。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton enables it to camouflage itself in magma. At the right time, it jumps out and attacks prey with its horn.

entry: POKENAME比同类更早长出凝固岩浆形成的小壳。幼小身体背上了重量，越发难以持续活动，也更难阻止皮肤冷却、硬化。
author: sk372
source: A small shell of hardened magma has formed on POKENAME earlier than usual. The weight added to its small form makes it more difficult to stay moving and to resist its skin cooling and hardening.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，却笨手笨脚，好意常被误当成恶作剧。它们真心觉得，节日送煤块给乖孩子，是个让人开心的好主意。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME has a good heart, but it's very clumsy, so many mistake its goodhearted actions for bad jokes. They genuinely think that giving coal as a gift to nice children on holidays is a good idea and something that will make them happy.

entry: POKENAME吃猎物的眼睛，随着自身年岁渐长，将一颗颗眼睛融入身体。眼中最后映入的日光，化作燃烧的光彩，让它穿行森林时，在黑暗中泛起诡光。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME feeds on the eyes of its prey, incorporating each eye into its body as it ages. The last glimpse of sunlight in each eye fuels its fiery glow, casting an eerie light in the dark as it slithers through the forest.

entry: 岩块与岩浆不断绕着POKENAME的核心石旋转。若它们全缩回石中，便意味着世界某处的火山，即将喷发。
author: sk372
source: Chunks of stone and magma swirl endlessly above POKENAME's core stone. Should these components retract into the stone, it means somewhere in the world a volcano is about to erupt.

entry: POKENAME喷出高达10000度的火焰，将吞下的东西烧尽。待在它身旁虽危险，处理垃圾时，它却是个好帮手。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews flames up to 10,000 degrees, incinerating anything it consumes. Despite how dangerous they are to be around, POKENAME are quite helpful in garbage disposal.

entry: 有人把POKENAME视为火山暴怒的化身，在岛屿神话中，它象征毁灭。传说，壳内岩浆的温度高得不可思议，根本无法估算。
author: sk372
source: Said by some to be the epitome of volcanic fury, POKENAME is a figure of destruction in island mythology. The magma within its shell is believed to reach incalculable, impossible temperatures.

entry: POKENAME俯冲快得惊人，借炽热的利爪烧灼猎物。动作精准又迅猛，猎物几乎来不及感到疼痛，是令人畏惧的高效空中猎手。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME dives at incredible speeds, searing its prey at intense temperatures through its claws. Its precision and velocity ensure the process is almost painless for its victim, making it a feared but efficient hunter in the skies.

entry: POKENAME住在火山口附近，狂躁地四处寻找火焰，补充能量，看上去却仿佛十分痛苦。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME lives near the craters of volcanoes. It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of fire, which serves as its energy source.

entry: POKENAME在地底沉睡了数千年，历经骇人的高压与高温，大部分身体熔成岩浆。这副熔融身躯，也赋予它独特的控热本领。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME slept deep underground for so many millennia while experiencing astounding pressures and temperatures that much of their bodies have melted into magma. These molten forms grant them unique abilities to manipulate heat.

entry: 它自认肌肉已臻完美的部位，便会长出外壳。至今，还没见过全身覆壳的POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: A shell forms over the parts of its body it considers honed to muscular perfection. There has yet to be a sighting of a POKENAME with shelling that covers its entirety.

entry: 汤状的身体营养丰富，却滚烫无比。POKENAME的汤，得一次只吃一点，才不会受伤。
author: admiralvermin
source: The contents of its soupy body are highly nutritious, but piping hot. Small amounts of POKENAME's soup can be eaten at a time without causing harm.

entry: POKENAME用长喙摘取树梢的树果，也常以喙相击，彼此决斗。不过打得再激烈，它们也始终恪守同一条规矩：绝不攻击对方的种子。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long beaks to grab berries out of treetops. They often get into duels with each other, clashing their beaks into each other. No matter how intense the fights get, POKENAME always stick to a code of honor to not attack their bulbs.

entry: 球形身体上的羽毛，蓄着大量静电。它一飞过发廊，四散的电流便能毁掉发型，惹出一片混乱。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on its orb-like body are filled with static electricity. When it flies near hair salons, it causes chaos by ruining hairstyles with stray shocks.

entry: 看似光滑的岩石身体，其实覆盖着细小硬羽。羽毛让它行动敏捷，战斗中很难瞄准。
author: .izik
source: While its body resembles smooth stone, it is covered in tiny, hard feathers. These feathers enhance its agility, making it difficult to target in battle.

entry: POKENAME出了名不会筑巢，便仗着庞大体格，把别的宝可梦赶出家门。做法虽不客气，倒总能有个舒服的地方睡。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously bad at building its own nests. Instead, it uses its impressive size to push out other Pokémon from their homes. Though not the most polite approach, this tactic ensures it always has a comfortable place to sleep.

entry: 它懒洋洋地漂过草地，享受微风。若被障碍挂住，就能用尖喙轻松挣脱。
author: .izik
source: It floats lazily through meadows, enjoying the breeze. If it gets stuck on an obstacle, it uses its sharp beak to free itself with ease.

entry: 闻到屋里有奶酪，它便用喙钻穿屋顶，闯进去搜寻。凭着这股锲而不舍的劲头，它总能找到些吃的。
author: .izik
source: If it detects the scent of cheese in a home, it drills its beak into the roof to gain entry. This behavior makes it a persistent scavenger.

entry: 喙里藏着坚硬的牙齿状结构，能牢牢扣住敌人。一旦咬下，几个小时都不肯松口。
author: .izik
source: Its beak conceals rigid, tooth-like structures that latch onto foes. Once it bites down, it refuses to let go for hours.

entry: POKENAME疾速翱翔，沿途留下闪亮光迹。据说，独眼能看穿一切骗局，也常紧盯别人忽视的事物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME soars at incredible speeds, leaving shimmering trails in the air. Its single eye is said to pierce through any deception, and it often fixes its gaze on things others overlook.

entry: 它会在远处盯紧敌人，仔细观察动向，寻找危险的征兆。一旦察觉威胁，就发出响亮的鸣叫，提醒同伴。
author: .izik
source: It monitors foes from afar, carefully observing their movements for signs of danger. If it detects a threat, it lets out a loud caw to alert its flock.

entry: 身体上冒泡的物质，摸起来如同泥浆。可它一活动，就会变得极热，甚至足以熔化钢铁。
author: .izik
source: The bubbling material on its body is mud-like in texture but grows intensely hot when it moves. The heat can reach temperatures capable of melting steel.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，却快得出奇。肌肉，尤其尾部，能盘紧成弹簧，紧要时将它弹向高空，再一头钻入地面，捕捉猎物。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast despite having no limbs. Their muscles, especially near the tail, can coil up and act like a spring in a pinch letting POKENAME soar to great heights before tunneling down into the ground to capture their prey.

entry: 它挥翅掀起狂风，吹走领地内的闯入者。若吹不走，或对方不听警告再来，就可能遭它猛冲，甚至刺穿身体。
author: sk372
source: It uses its wings to kick up strong gusts of wind to blow away trespassers in its territory. Those unable to be pushed away or those who return after ignoring this warning risk getting charged at and potentially skewered.

entry: 尾巴滴下油漆般的红色液体，散发苦涩气味。它便用这液体，在岩石与树上绘出繁复图样。
author: .izik
source: The red, paint-like fluid dripping from its tail emits a bitter scent. It uses this liquid to create intricate designs on rocks and trees.

entry: 它盘在高树上栖息，再张翅远远滑翔，捕猎毫无防备的生物。据说，冒险时若有POKENAME掠过头顶，是个不祥之兆。
author: sk372
source: It perches coiled around tall trees, before using its wings to glide far distances and hunt unsuspecting prey. Having POKENAME glide over you while adventuring is said to be an unlucky omen.

entry: POKENAME用长喙深入泥土，既能辨认道路，也便于捉出猎物。它尤其偏爱大颚蚁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's long beak is used to dig deep into the dirt, helping not only with navigation, but also with snatching up prey. Its favored target is Trapinch.

entry: POKENAME用长喙深入泥土，既能辨认道路，也便于捉出猎物。它尤其偏爱大颚蚁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's long beak is used to dig deep into the dirt, helping not only with navigation, but also with snatching up prey. Its favored target is Trapinch.

entry: POKENAME疯狂振翅，靠摩擦产生它标志性的红色闪电。作为珍奇宠物，它很受追捧，可繁殖太快，也极易成为入侵物种。
author: octolinggrimm
source: The friction from POKENAME's frantically beating wings generates the distinctive red lightning it is known for. They are highly sought after as exotic pets, but breed rapidly and can easily become an invasive species.

entry: 头上的角像尖喙，中空的内部灌满剧毒。战斗时，它能精准刺中敌人，注入毒液，让对方失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its head resembles a sharp beak, hollow inside and filled with potent poison. It injects this toxin into foes with precision during battle, leaving them incapacitated.

entry: 它虽在夜间活动，每到清晨，睡梦中却会用双翼发出高频轻鸣，向同伴报个平安。
author: .izik
source: Though nocturnal, it emits a high-frequency chirp through its wings each morning while sleeping. This signal assures its allies of its safety.

entry: 它挥动羽臂，散出怡人的香气。可气味太过醉人，附近的生物吸得久了，竟会晕倒。
author: .izik
source: It waves its feathered arms to spread a delightful aroma. However, the scent is so enchanting it can cause those nearby to faint if inhaled for too long.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独自狩猎。若有另一只POKENAME闯进领地，双方便会用尖喙互相戳刺，想把对方戳破。身体虽轻，却能搬起摩托车般沉重的物件。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefer to hunt alone and will try to pop each other with their sharp beaks if another POKENAME enter their territory. Despite being lightweight, it is able to carry items as heavy as a motorcycle.

entry: 它在年长的人面前格外腼腆，盼着温柔的抚摸与关爱。被抱起来时，会轻轻咕鸣，表达喜悦。
author: .izik
source: Exceptionally coy around older humans, it seeks gentle pets and affection. When held, it coos softly to express its happiness.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头能高速旋转，用长喙钻穿地面。可脖子究竟从哪儿开始，又在哪儿结束，谁也说不清。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's three heads can rapidly spin to drill through the ground with their long beaks. Nobody is sure where their necks begin or end.

entry: 头痛难忍时，它便将超能力引向头羽。逸散的力量，能在附近水域卷起巨大的漩涡。
author: .izik
source: When its headaches become unbearable, it channels psychic energy through the feathers on its head. This energy can create massive whirlpools in nearby waters.

entry: 一不顺心，它就怒不可遏。怒气凝成力量，攻击便强得足以打断骨头。
author: .izik
source: When it doesn't get its way, it becomes uncontrollably enraged. By focusing its anger, its attacks gain enough strength to break bones.

entry: 它扇动翅膀，燃烧的火星如羽毛般，轻轻飘向地面。耀眼的火光，既让敌人目眩，也令其胆寒。
author: .izik
source: When it flaps its wings, it releases flaming embers that drift gently to the ground like feathers. This fiery display both dazzles and intimidates its enemies.

entry: 远看几乎与小山猪无异，可POKENAME移动时，急促爬动的姿态便露了馅。锐利的蓝色目光，让人背脊发凉。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Almost indistinguishable from a Swinub from afar, the telltale sign that this is a POKENAME is from its skittering motions it makes when it moves around. Its piercing blue gaze sends chills up people's spines.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是毛皮与黏土的奇妙混合。它先用灵敏的鼻子嗅出食物，再挥动永远覆着冰的双臂，向地下挖去。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's body is a curious mix of fur and clay. It uses its sensitive nose to sniff out food before digging into the ground with arms permanently covered in ice.

entry: 它用火焰寻找埋在雪下的树果。雪乡的训练家常与POKENAME结伴出行，借它取暖。
author: Schwaus
source: It uses its flames to look for berries under the snow. Trainers from snowy towns will often travel with POKENAME to keep warm.

entry: 爪子与外壳都由冰构成，壳下却覆着一层脂肪与毛皮。
author: ShadowPanther
source: Its claws and shell are made of ice. It has a layer of fat and fur underneath its shell.

entry: 它背上的种子很小，因此会用雪包起来，小心保护。训练家帮忙装饰这个雪球，也能与POKENAME增进感情。
author: AdmiralVermin
source: The bulb on its back is small, so it covers it with snow to keep it safe. Trainers will bond with their POKENAME by helping to decorate its snowball.

entry: POKENAME把身上不断长出的植物纤维，编成粗绳，缠遍全身。若人类不定期收取一些，绳子越长越多，连它自己也会被困住。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME are covered in thick ropes they braid from plant fibers that grow from their bodies. This growth never stops, so if humans don't harvest parts of these ropes intermittently, a POKENAME can become entangled in them itself.

entry: 温暖的皮毛，加上耐心的性情，让POKENAME成为理想的看护者。它常在托育中心帮忙，让幼小宝可梦睡得更舒服。
author: noel5229
source: Warm fur and a patient temperament makes POKENAME a perfect caregiver. It often works at daycare centers to help baby Pokémon sleep more comfortably.

entry: 它睡在棕榈树顶，享受暖阳，也从高处留意下方的珊瑚礁，随时准备出手保护。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps atop palm trees, enjoying the warmth of the sun. From these heights, it keeps an eye on the reefs below, ready to protect them if needed.

entry: 水中的污染物，经珊瑚枝过滤，大海便更干净。想维持健康的海洋生态，它的存在至关重要。
author: .izik
source: Pollutants in the water are filtered through its coral branches, leaving the sea cleaner. Its presence is vital to maintaining healthy marine ecosystems.

entry: 它在废弃的水雷区附近安家，活跃于被遗忘的残骸间。环境如此危险，大多数天敌都不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near abandoned aquatic minefields, where it thrives among forgotten debris. The danger of its environment keeps most predators at bay.

entry: 流星雨来临时，它映着头顶星光，亮得更加耀眼。许多人相信，这光彩象征着宇宙的和谐。
author: .izik
source: It glows more brightly during meteor showers, reflecting the starlight above. Many believe this luminous display is a sign of cosmic harmony.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁及周边，似乎会吸收来自宇宙的未知能量，再借此让海洋生命恢复活力。
author: Fenragon
source: POKENAME live on and around coral reefs. They seem to soak up a strange, unknown energy from space to and use it to help revitalize ocean life.

entry: 它们藏在缤纷的水生植物间，平时避免争斗。因此，野外很少有POKENAME能够进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They hide among colorful underwater plant life and generally avoid combat. As a result, very few POKENAME evolve in the wild.

entry: POKENAME把礁区里的太阳珊瑚，全当作蜂巢成员，凶猛驱退来犯的捕食者，对好坏星尤其毫不留情。太阳珊瑚感激这份保护，乐意为它提供住处。
author: Walter Teigan
source: POKENAME considers all Corsola within its reef to be part of its hive and viciously repulses any would-be predators; Mareanie are treated particularly harshly. Corsola appreciate the protection and happily offer it shelter.

entry: 它以废弃电器为食，借其中的材料与残存电力，强化珊瑚身体。这种奇特饮食，也让体表泛起淡淡的静电光。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on discarded electrical equipment, using the materials and latent power to enhance its coral body. This peculiar diet gives it a faint, static glow.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖的珊瑚礁，用伪装花纹藏起自己。一旦海水污染，健康便会恶化。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME lives in warm coral reefs, hiding itself with its camouflage patterns. Should the sea become polluted, its health will diminish.

entry: 它随海风轻轻飘在珊瑚礁上空，悠然自在的身影，也为下方生机盎然的礁区，添了几分美丽。
author: .izik
source: It floats gently in the sky above coral reefs, carried by ocean breezes. Its carefree drifting adds an extra touch of beauty to the vibrant reefs below.

entry: 它依偎在海带丛里入睡，随洋流轻轻摇晃。飘动的植物既舒适，也为它遮掩身影。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps nestled in kelp beds, swaying gently with the ocean currents. The flowing plants provide it with both comfort and camouflage.

entry: 它一边漂在水面，一边啃食睡莲叶。这种饮食，也使它的性情出奇平和。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on lily pads, often munching on them as it floats along the water's surface. This diet gives it a surprisingly peaceful demeanor.

entry: 它分泌的毒液，会让中招者恶心难忍。即使少量，也足以令敌人失去行动能力，是强有力的自保手段。
author: .izik
source: The venom it secretes causes intense nausea in anyone affected. Even a small amount can incapacitate a foe, making it a powerful defense mechanism.

entry: 有人推测，魔灵珊瑚若仍活着，或许就是POKENAME的模样。不过，不靠融合能量，还没找到实现的方法。
author: galactak
source: If a Cursola were to stay alive, it's speculated it would resemble POKENAME. However, no way to make this happen without fusion energy has been found.

entry: 它向猎物喷墨，遮住视线，为POKENAME争取进攻或逃跑的时间。漆黑墨云久久不散，也迷惑着附近的敌人。
author: .izik
source: It spits ink at prey to blind them, giving POKENAME time to strike or escape. The dark cloud it creates lingers in the water, confusing any nearby threats.

entry: POKENAME会寻找枝条折损的太阳珊瑚，赠送装饰精美的替代枝条。
author: pankiwi
source: Individual POKENAME seek out damaged Corsola that have lost their branches and gift them decorated replacements.

entry: 受威胁时，它朝天敌喷泥，趁对方摸不清方向，赶紧逃走。靠这招机巧，即使在险恶水域，也能保住性命。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, it spits mud at predators to confuse them and make its escape. This clever tactic ensures it remains safe in even the most perilous waters.

entry: 高兴时，珊瑚会亮起缤纷光彩，灿烂夺目。这光也是信标，为栖身在它身上的伙伴指路。
author: .izik
source: When happy, its coral glows in a spectrum of colors, creating a dazzling display. This vibrant glow serves as a beacon for its companions that take shelter along its body.

entry: 最近，人们发现POKENAME的金属外部，并非身体，而是包容珊瑚本体的壳。气候变化后，它们开始住进废弃潜水服，躲避有害的海洋环境。
author: Rakunk
source: Recent discoveries reveal that POKENAME's metal exterior is not part of its body but a shell housing its coral form. Due to climate change, it began living in abandoned diving suits to shield itself from harmful ocean conditions.

entry: 渔民把POKENAME视为好运的象征。常能看见它漂在水面附近，假装是一枚浮标。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME is considered to be a symbol of good luck by fishers. It is often spotted floating near the water's surface and pretending to be a buoy.

entry: 成群POKENAME被沉船吸引，聚在那里寻求庇护。若被浪中的碎片划伤，也能施展自我再生，短短几分钟便恢复。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of POKENAME gather around sunken ships, drawn to the shelter they provide. If injured by debris in the waves, they can Recover and heal within minutes.

entry: 坚硬如潜艇的外壳，让它潜得比大多数人类与宝可梦更深。一次次深海探险，也让它发现海底隐藏的奇观。
author: .izik
source: It can dive deeper than most humans and Pokémon thanks to its hard, submarine-like shell. These deep-sea explorations help it discover hidden wonders of the ocean floor.

entry: 鲜艳的配色，让POKENAME在浑暗水中格外显眼，难以悄悄接近猎物。可到了浅水珊瑚礁，它却是出色的伏击猎手。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME's bright coloring makes it stand out in murkier waters, making it struggle to sneak up on prey in dark areas. In shallow coral reefs, however, it's the perfect ambush predator.

entry: 它攀附漂流的冰山，越过寒冷水域，远赴其他海洋，再在那里建立新的珊瑚礁。
author: .izik
source: It attaches itself to drifting icebergs, floating across frigid waters. This journey takes it to distant oceans where it establishes new reefs.

entry: 许多POKENAME聚在一起，伪装成珊瑚礁。想躲进礁区的宝可梦，最终都会被它们吃掉。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Many POKENAME come together in order to mimic coral reefs. Any Pokémon that seek to hide in their reefs are consumed.

entry: 生活在沙漠中的POKENAME，能在坚硬的身体里高效储水。年深日久，尖刺不再那么锋利，却变得如岩石般坚实。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME that live in the desert store water efficiently in their hardened bodies. Their spines have become less sharp and taken on a rock-like sturdiness over time.

entry: 它在码头附近安家，穿行于藤壶与桩柱间。精心维持的缤纷礁群，吸引着游客与宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near piers, weaving through barnacles and pilings. The colorful reefs it maintains attract both tourists and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME在热带水域生活得很好。白天，它会把触手抬出水面，吸收充足的日光，让珊瑚长得更加结实。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in tropical waters, basking in the sun by raising its tentacles above the surface during the day. This behavior helps it absorb vital sunlight for its coral to grow strong.

entry: 触手会分泌强酸，不幸碰上的东西，都可能被溶解。这份护身本领，让它在海中令人畏惧。
author: .izik
source: Its tentacles secrete acid, dissolving anything unfortunate enough to touch them. This defensive trait makes it a formidable presence in the ocean.

entry: 只要身体太干，它就用超能力往自己身上泼水。这个奇特习惯，让它即使远离海岸，也能保持湿润、精神焕发。
author: .izik
source: Using its psychic powers, it splashes itself with water whenever it gets too dry. This curious habit keeps it refreshed even far from the shore.

entry: 它主要吃腐烂的沉船，日积月累地分解残骸。靠这习性，海底也少了许多腐败的杂物。
author: .izik
source: Rotting shipwrecks are its primary food source, as it breaks down the debris over time. This habit ensures the ocean floor stays clear of decaying material.

entry: POKENAME能产出美丽的蓝珍珠，独特的哑光表面，很受珠宝匠珍爱，常被加工成优雅的耳饰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces stunning blue pearls prized by jewelers for their unique matte finish. These pearls are often crafted into elegant earrings.

entry: 它仔细筛过沙子，挑出藏在浅层下面的食物。这样的觅食习惯，也有助于维持岸边生命的平衡。
author: .izik
source: It sifts through sand, meticulously picking out food hidden beneath the surface. This habit helps maintain the balance of life along the shoreline.

entry: 它把船身视为领地中的障碍，轻易便能砸碎。这种破坏行径，让水手们闻之色变。
author: .izik
source: It crushes boat hulls with ease, viewing them as obstacles to its territory. This destructive behavior has earned it a fearsome reputation among sailors.

entry: POKENAME虽然不善于在陆地行动，却十分热爱陆上探险。背上的种子储着水，供它的小小旅程使用。
author: jreposo
source: Despite its limited terrestrial locomotion, POKENAME loves to explore the land. It stores water for its little adventures in the bulb on its back.

entry: 背上渐渐绽放的花苞如今能自行造水，再加上新长出的一双腿，让它比进化前能深入内陆更远的地方。
author: jreposo
source: It can venture inland much farther than its pre-evolved form since the blooming bulb on its back now creates water. Its new pair of legs also helps.

entry: 这种融合体在野外争不过原有的铁炮鱼与太阳珊瑚，难以维持稳定种群。城都海军曾将它捕来培育，用以对抗入侵船只，可它们总记不住命令。
author: .fedoraman
source: This fusion cannot outcompete preexisting Remoraid and Corsola in the wild, failing to maintain a stable population. Once, they were captured and bred by the Johtonian Navy for use against invading vessels, but they could never remember their orders.

entry: POKENAME主要靠射出压实的泥球进攻。偶尔会成群来到海滩，搜集、吃下湿沙，在岸边留下一道长沟。
author: Glacierwing
source: A POKENAME's main form of offense is shooting compacted mud balls. Sometimes, hordes of them will gather on beaches to collect and eat wet sand, leaving a long trench on the shoreline.

entry: 成年POKENAME常伏在河岸，照看幼小的POKENAME，免得走散。它们不爱主动攻击，保护后代时却十分坚决。
author: jreposo
source: Adult POKENAME can be found lying along river banks ensuring younger POKENAME don't stray. They aren't aggressive, but they are extremely protective.

entry: 传说，POKENAME能听见葬身海中者最后的心愿。可无止境的呼救，似乎已让它渐渐麻木。
author: jreposo
source: Legends have it that POKENAME perceives the last wishes of those who drown at sea. It seems to have grown numb to the unceasing calls for help.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，白天得不停活动，才能在入夜前把能量耗掉。它还会主动迎敌，从口中喷出强劲水柱，轻易压倒对手，再多耗些精力。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME has copious amounts of energy, needing to be constantly moving throughout the day to burn it off before nightfall. It takes on foes to further burn off energy, often easily outmatching them with powerful jets of water shot from its mouth.

entry: 它既会游泳，也能飞行，可大部分时候，是奋力跃出水面，再贴着水面滑翔。
author: jreposo
source: It is capable of both swimming and flying. Yet, it spends most of its time gliding above the water's surface after making powerful leaps out of it.

entry: 人们常以为POKENAME吸血为生，研究却证实，它的小尖牙，根本伤不了别人。
author: jreposo
source: Despite the popular assumption that POKENAME feeds on blood, research has proven it is incapable of harming others with its small fangs.

entry: 身体深藏壳中，让POKENAME的视野十分有限。不过，这反而有利于POKENAME：一盯住目标，便不再分心。
author: .fedoraman
source: With the body of this Pokémon being deep inside its shell, POKENAME have a limited field of view. This works to POKENAME's benefit as once it has its sights on a target, it cannot get distracted.

entry: POKENAME出于谨慎，常跟在大船后。万一遭逢灾难，就用庞大身体与众多触手，尽可能多地托住幸存者，送往安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tend to follow large ships out of a sense of precaution. Should disaster strike, they use their large body and many tentacles to hold and carry as many survivors to safety as they possibly can.

entry: 有些章鱼桶会骑上呆呆王头顶，取代它的王冠。呆呆王的智慧因此下降，但仍足以与这位新乘客配合行动。
author: sk372
source: Some Octillery will hitch rides on top of Slowking, replacing its crown. Its intelligence diminishes as a result, but it retains enough to function in tandem with its new passenger.

entry: 它先在沙中撑稳身体，或用吸盘抓紧岩石，再射出威力如大炮的水柱。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It braces itself in the sand or holds onto rocks with its suction cups before firing a jet of water with the power of a cannon.

entry: POKENAME借喷墨的嘴操纵周围水流，灵活游动。墨汁还能用来标记野生宝可梦，甚至在自己身上绘出花纹。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can use their ink-jet mouths to control water around them and swim efficiently. They also use that ink to mark other Pokémon in the wild and even decorate patterns on their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着数十条触手。战斗时，先以重踢打倒敌人，再接一记迅捷的触手鞭击，结束战斗。
author: typhloquil
source: Coated over POKENAME's body is dozens of tentacles. It fights by first delivering powerful kicks to knock their opponent down, then finishing the battle with a swift tentacle whip.

entry: POKENAME能储下、喷出惊人的墨潮自保。一只POKENAME就能灌满好几个泳池，存墨却连一半都没用掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can store and expel absolutely massive torrents of ink for defense. A single POKENAME could fill multiple swimming pools with ink and still not have depleted half of its stored contents.

entry: POKENAME无法移动，总怕天敌来袭。可实际上，满身尖刺让捕食者都不愿下口，根本没有谁会吃它。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME can't move, which is why they are in constant fear of predators. However, nothing actually preys on POKENAME because of their spikes.

entry: POKENAME能把触手相互绞紧，积蓄弹力。猛然松开时，反冲的力量，便能让它迅速跃过很远的距离。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into each other and build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the resulting force.

entry: 天敌若想撬开POKENAME的壳，迎面就会撞上一股墨汁与水的激流，而POKENAME则借反冲，射向远处。
author: .fedoraman
source: If a predator attempts to pry open a POKENAME shell, it will be met with a torrent of ink and water, launching POKENAME far into the distance.

entry: 章鱼桶虽然爱住空壳，这种情况却并非如此。POKENAME能灵巧地拔下尖刺，再将其投掷出去。
author: .fedoraman
source: While Octillery loves occupying abandoned shells, this is not one such case. POKENAME can remove its spike and throw it with great dexterity.

entry: 一看见雪，它便能连唱几个小时的颂歌，虽没歌词，还常跑调。热情如此不减，有人觉得可爱，有人却被吵得头疼。
author: .izik
source: The moment it sees snow, it sings carols for hours, despite the songs being off-key and wordless. Its relentless enthusiasm can either charm or annoy listeners.

entry: 它把小冰雕藏在尾巴里，拿来送礼。每一件都独一无二，细节与用心，令人惊叹。
author: .izik
source: It keeps small ice sculptures hidden in its tail, offering them as gifts. Each sculpture is unique, crafted with surprising detail and care.

entry: POKENAME飞翔于冰雪群山间，看见迷路的人，就载其飞往安全处，再分些食物。它的羽毛，柔软又温暖得出奇。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: POKENAME flies around icy mountains. If it sees someone lost, it will fly them to safety and give them some food. Its feathers are surprisingly soft and warm.

entry: 猛烈暴风雪中，POKENAME会现身，吞下风雪，储进嗉囊。随后再带回巢里，让家园终年冰封。
author: Rockageddon
source: POKENAME appears during terrible snowstorms to eat and store the violent weather in their crop. Later it will deliver the weather to its nest to keep its home covered in permafrost.

entry: POKENAME乐呵呵的性情，给遇见它的人带来冬日的欢欣。头上的拐杖有时会卡在树上。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's jolly disposition brings a sense of wintry joy to all who meet them. The cane on their head sometimes gets stuck on trees.

entry: 它爱在积雪的林地上欢快蹦跳，兴高采烈地晃着头。头上的植物会在空气中留下松香。
author: pankiwi
source: It enjoys prancing around snowy forest floors, waving its head around with a jolly glee. The plant on its head leaves a fragrance of pine in the air.

entry: POKENAME满心欢喜时，颈间的花苞便会发光。它用头上的植物吸引伴侣。
author: pankiwi
source: The buds surrounding its neck will glow when POKENAME is filled with joy. It uses the plant on its head to attract potential mates.

entry: 颈间的褶边带有雪花图案。据说散发的香气，会让人想起与家人相处的欢乐时光。
author: pankiwi
source: The ruffles around its neck depict a snowflake pattern. The aroma it gives off is said to remind people of joyful times with family.

entry: POKENAME是干劲十足的送货鸟，常替人把小包裹送往严寒地区。若不拦着，凡是举得动的，它们都想送。
author: Rockageddon
source: POKENAME are ambitious delivery birds used to send small packets to the coldest of regions. POKENAME will try to deliver anything they can lift if they are not stopped.

entry: 训练家得留意管住POKENAME。它急着打破送货纪录，常一冲就冲过了头，反而白白浪费时间。
author: Rockageddon
source: Trainers must take care to rein in their POKENAME. Eager to break its delivery record, they will overshoot their delivery, losing time instead of saving it.

entry: 它住在松树上，据说一眼就能看出，谁是乖孩子，谁爱调皮。因此，在当地民间故事里，颇具神秘色彩。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in pine trees and is said to tell whether someone is "naughty or nice" with a single glance. This ability makes it a fascinating figure in local folklore.

entry: 它驾驭冰风，跨越遥远的距离，在茫茫雪地上穿行，丝毫不费力。
author: .izik
source: It manipulates icy winds to carry itself across long distances. This ability allows it to travel effortlessly through snowy landscapes.

entry: 一玩得太起劲，它就可能意外掀起暴风雪。这样无心闯出的祸，让它既惹人爱，又让人头疼。
author: .izik
source: If it plays too much, it can accidentally create snowstorms. These unintentional blizzards make it both endearing and troublesome.

entry: POKENAME背上长着冬青，用来保护袋中种子，免遭掠食。据说冬青结的果子有毒。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME has a holly plant on its back in order to protect its seeds it carries in its bag from predators. The berries are said to be toxic.

entry: 它用细枝做玩具，赠给别人。手工小玩意，人类与宝可梦都十分珍爱。
author: .izik
source: It crafts toys from twigs and gives them to others as gifts. These handmade toys are cherished by both Pokémon and people.

entry: 它能改变雪的方向，将雪花磨成剃刀般的利刃。凭这本领，它既是守护者，也是可怕的对手。
author: .izik
source: It can redirect snow and sharpen the flakes into razor-like edges. This ability makes it both a guardian and a fearsome opponent.

entry: 送达包裹，对POKENAME是神圣之事。谁敢偷货，就会遭到数周的猛烈攻击。它永远记得那张脸，包裹贼别想安心。
author: Rockageddon
source: Deliveries are sacred to POKENAME. Anyone that tries to steal deliveries will be mercilessly attacked for weeks. Package thieves are never safe, as POKENAME never forgets a face.

entry: 这只宝可梦对肉桂爱得不得了，走到哪儿，都要找一找。知道人类会储备这种香料，它便常往聚落跑。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon has an insatiable love for cinnamon, seeking it out wherever it goes. It is aware that humans keep this spice, which often leads it to human settlements.

entry: 它死死护着自己的礼物，任何情况下都不肯撒手。想从它那儿偷走，可不容易。
author: .izik
source: It fiercely guards its present, refusing to part with it under any circumstances. This defensive nature makes it difficult to steal from.

entry: 它用锋利的翅膀，雕出自己珍爱者的冰像。感到孤单时，就让冰像陪着自己。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp wings to carve ice sculptures of those it cares about. These creations keep it company when it feels lonely.

entry: 野生POKENAME常摇摇摆摆地找上许久，只为挑个理想巢址。研究者认为，它偏爱临水、凉爽、微湿又清静的地方，洞穴最好。
author: leonian1586
source: A wild POKENAME will spend large amounts of time waddling around looking for the perfect place to nest. Researchers believe it prefers cool, slightly damp, and quiet spots near water, preferably in caves.

entry: 它欢欢喜喜地采集树果与水果，送给大家。贴心的小礼物，让人类与宝可梦都很喜欢它。
author: .izik
source: It delights in gathering berries and other fruits to give as presents. These thoughtful offerings make it beloved among both Pokémon and people.

entry: 没人见过它尾巴里装着什么，让它更加神秘。有人相信里面是稀世珍宝，却谁也没法证实。
author: .izik
source: No one has ever seen what it carries in its tail, adding to its mysterious reputation. Some believe it holds a rare treasure, but none can confirm it.

entry: 随身携带的种子，如今已长成节日点心。它会送给森林中较小的宝可梦，周围萦绕着冬青的香气。
author: pankiwi
source: The seeds it carries have now grown into festive snacks which it gives away to smaller Pokémon in the forest. The scent of holly surrounds them.

entry: 肉豆蔻是它最爱的食物，找到多少，就囤多少。这种香料，似乎还让它本就喜庆的性情，更添几分欢乐。
author: .izik
source: Nutmeg is its favorite food, and it hoards as much of it as it can find. The spice seems to enhance its already festive nature.

entry: POKENAME大多随风自在飞行，任狂风决定去向。它常飞着飞着就睡着，最后挂在树上。
author: Rockageddon
source: Most of the time POKENAME will let wild winds choose where they fly. This carefree Pokémon is most often found stuck in trees when it has fallen asleep mid-flight.

entry: 它在冰山上安家，漂过寒冷的大海。浮动的冰岛，既是住处，也是它的游乐场。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home on icebergs, drifting across frigid seas. These floating islands serve as both a shelter and playground for it.

entry: 训练家若没看紧POKENAME，就会发现附近的玩具纷纷不见。专家也不确定，它是想偷来惹孩子哭，还是有偷窃癖。
author: Rockageddon
source: Trainers that don't pay attention to POKENAME will discover that toys tend to disappear around this Pokémon. Experts are not sure if the Pokémon likes to steal to make children cry or if it is a case of kleptomania.

entry: 每年一次，POKENAME会探访附近的孩子，送上礼物。乖巧纯真的孩子得到闪亮宝石；调皮的，只有煤块，特别不乖的，甚至会拿到硫黄。
author: epping_forest
source: Once a year, POKENAME looks for children nearby to visit and bring gifts. Well-behaved and pure-hearted kids get glistening gems, while naughty children get coal and, in extreme cases, brimstone.

entry: 民间传说，惹恼它，便可能招来雪崩。有这层威胁，人们总对它敬重又谨慎。
author: .izik
source: Folklore warns that upsetting this Pokémon may result in an avalanche. The threat ensures it is treated with respect and caution.

entry: 它摇动角，松脂的宜人香气便弥漫开来。闻到这香味，同伴与敌人都能平静下来。
author: .izik
source: When it shakes its horns, a pleasant scent of pine sap fills the air. This fragrant aroma calms both allies and opponents alike.

entry: 它闭上眼睛，伸出袋子，盼有人送自己一份礼物。若真收到了，便抱着礼物，欢天喜地地跑开。
author: .izik
source: It holds out its bag with closed eyes, hoping someone will offer it a gift. If it receives one, it runs away delighted, carrying the present with joy.

entry: 角上的饰球能有节奏地摆动，催眠敌人。一旦对方入迷，它便能轻易占得先机。
author: .izik
source: The bauble on its horn can hypnotize foes with rhythmic movements. Once mesmerized, enemies are easy to outmaneuver.

entry: 人称“生日鸟”的它，爱送出彩纸礼物，给人类和宝可梦带来惊喜。见到派对，还总想偷偷拿一块蛋糕。
author: Rockageddon
source: Commonly known as the Birthday Bird, this Pokémon loves to surprise people and Pokémon with confetti presents. If it spots a party, it will always try to sneak away with a piece of cake.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME会掰下身上的黑石，送给调皮的孩子。究竟想借此告诉他们什么，却没人明白。
author: Iaobug
source: Urban legend says POKENAME will break off the black stones on its body and gift them to naughty children. The message this conveys to them is unclear.

entry: 它能吐出冰冷雾气，碰到什么，就冻住什么。在寒冷之地，是位难缠的对手。
author: .izik
source: It can spit out an icy mist capable of freezing anything it touches. This frosty breath makes it a formidable opponent in cold environments.

entry: 它有个怪习惯：从一个镇偷来东西，再送给另一个镇。弄得两边都摸不着头脑，偏又莫名心怀感激。
author: .izik
source: It has a curious habit of stealing items from one town only to gift them to another. This behavior leaves both towns confused, yet strangely grateful.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火焰已冻得坚实，走过的地面会留下雪花状足印。胡子则由压实的积雪构成。
author: pankiwi
source: The fiery tip of POKENAME's tail is frozen solid and it leaves snowflake-shaped prints on the ground where it walks. Its beard is made of packed snow.

entry: 尾巴里装满拐杖糖，战斗时，它能一根根精准掷出。这些甜甜的弹丸，喜庆又出奇地好用。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is packed with candy canes, which it throws with precision in battle. These sweet projectiles are both festive and surprisingly effective.

entry: 包袱其实能从尾巴上拆下。它们会用真正的尾巴高速游泳，还喜欢收集贝壳和石头。
author: pankiwi
source: Their bundles are actually detachable from their tails, as they use their actual tails for swimming at high speeds. They collect seashells and rocks.

entry: 尾尖沉重无比，挥动起来宛如大锤。真需要动手时，它的战力，也强得出人意料。
author: .izik
source: The tip of its tail is extremely heavy, and it swings it like a maul. This makes it a surprisingly formidable fighter when needed.

entry: 厨师很珍爱它的角，据说烹调得当，便有胡椒薄荷的滋味。这难得的食材，能为佳肴增添一抹清凉。
author: .izik
source: Chefs prize its horn, which is said to taste like peppermint when properly prepared. This rare ingredient adds a refreshing twist to culinary dishes.

entry: 体表的黏液甜得惊人，舔上一口，连舌头都会疼。再甜，也少有人敢尝第二次。
author: .izik
source: The slime coating its body is intensely sweet, so much so that licking it can cause tongue pain. Despite its sweetness, few dare to try it twice.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会射出小礼物与彩纸，让小宝可梦开心。壳上的花纹描绘着各式节庆场面。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's blasters shoot out small gifts and confetti for small Pokémon to enjoy. The patterns on its shell depict various festive scenes.

entry: POKENAME会结成上百只的大群游动，头顶藻类高速旋转，还能让它们掠过海面，滑翔前进。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME swim as schools of hundreds. They use the algae growing on their head to glide over the sea by rotating them at high speed.

entry: 阿罗拉近海常能见到POKENAME，和同类、巨翅飞鱼一起冲浪游玩。水上花样最多的那只，便是小队的头领。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Commonly found off the Alolan coast, POKENAME surf with other POKENAME and Mantine for sport. The one who performs the most tricks on the waters is deemed the leader of their squadron.

entry: POKENAME改变尾上叶片的姿态，就能调节游速。它们对过路训练家很友善，常主动帮忙，载人渡海。
author: TeatedTiten
source: By changing the leaves on their tails, POKENAME adjust their speed when swimming. POKENAME are very friendly to passing Trainers, frequently offering them help across the seas.

entry: 据说，能看见POKENAME跃出水面，是一生难遇的奇事，还预示着往后一个月，都有好运。
author: bobosmith01
source: Witnessing a POKENAME leap from the water is said to be a once-in-a-lifetime occurrence that signifies good luck for one month.

entry: 与游走沙中的烈咬陆鲨不同，POKENAME更喜欢水中狩猎。再猛烈的激流也能穿透，游得快若离弦。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME prefers to hunt in the water as opposed to sand-swimming Garchomp. Cutting through the strongest currents, it can swim at break-neck speeds.

entry: 这只宝可梦梦想着，有朝一日成为坚定、英勇的海洋守护者。它还披上时髦斗篷，让自己更接近那个理想。
author: regula
source: This Pokémon dreams of one day becoming a stalwart and heroic protector of the ocean. It dons a stylish cape to better embody this ideal.

entry: POKENAME先在壳内蓄电，再放出一串带电气泡。有时，也会从鳍释放能量，贴着海面飞掠。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME accumulate electricity in their shells before releasing strings of shocking bubbles. Sometimes, they discharge the energy through their fins to skim across the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME让成群铁炮鱼攀住自己的链条，载它们横渡海洋。可这样一来，也更容易成为大型猎手的目标。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME allows schools of Remoraid to cling to its chain as they transport them across the ocean. However, this makes them favored targets for larger predators.

entry: POKENAME能跃出水面，短暂滑翔，捕捉猎物。它们也会陪泳者玩耍，或攀住船只，搭上长长一程。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME can glide out of the water for short distances to catch prey. They are also known to play with swimmers and latch onto boats for long rides.

entry: 野生POKENAME会掠过积雪的树梢，身后卷起纷飞雪花。却很少有人见过它们带着幼崽。
author: pankiwi
source: Wild POKENAME can be seen soaring above snowy trees with a flurry of snowflakes behind them. Rarely are they seen carrying their young.

entry: POKENAME闪动灯光，与家族成员交流。科学家发现，每只POKENAME竟都有自己的名字。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME communicates with members of its family by blinking its lights. Scientists have found that each POKENAME has its own name.

entry: 双方付出许多努力与耐心后，语言学家终于破译了POKENAME的灯光语言。原来，许多个体都想与人类一起玩水球。
author: .fedoraman
source: After much effort and patience from both parties, linguists have decoded how POKENAME use their lights to communicate. It turns out that many wish to join humans in games of water polo.

entry: 这种奇特融合，一次结合了四种宝可梦。铁炮鱼与大舌贝也融入其中，分享POKENAME多余的能量，替它驱赶看不见的害虫，是互利共生的一例。
author: bobosmith01
source: This unique fusion has combined four species at once. A Remoraid and Shellder have fused to feed off of POKENAME's excess energy while they drive off pests POKENAME can't see coming in an example of mutualism.

entry: POKENAME十分疼爱自己收养的铁炮鱼。铁炮鱼玩摆锤时，有时竟会无意中，把别的宝可梦催眠。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME cares very deeply for its adopted Remoraid. The Remoraid sometimes hypnotize other Pokémon by accident when playing with its pendulum.

entry: POKENAME爱待在邮局附近，忠心守卫。难开的箱子，也能借它的利刃，轻松划开。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME like to hang around post offices and act as loyal guards. Their blades also act as box cutters for hard-to-open boxes.

entry: 身体由轻盈而坚韧的金属构成。高速滚动时，便用翅膀状耳朵，控制行进方向。
author: Staghorn
source: Its body is made of a lightweight yet durable metal. When rolling at high speeds, it uses its winglike ears to control its trajectory.

entry: 翼刃锋利无比，飞过便能削倒树木。因此，POKENAME栖息的丛林，树永远长不过某个高度。
author: dragonessanimations
source: Its wing blades are so sharp that it fells trees as it flies. The jungles POKENAME live in never grow beyond a certain height as a result.

entry: POKENAME擅长优雅的战斗，腾空踢击，仿佛在空中起舞。不打架时，它们似乎最爱打磨钢羽，越磨越锋亮。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are masters of graceful combat, effortlessly dancing through the air with high-flying kicks. They seem to enjoy sharpening and polishing their steely feathers when not fighting.

entry: POKENAME是被哭哭面具附身的死去盔甲鸟，早已不能飞。金属身体刮擦地面的声响，老远就能听见它来了。
author: Sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is a dead Skarmory possessed by a Yamask. It can't fly, which is why you can hear POKENAME coming from a distance by the metal scraping against the floor.

entry: POKENAME用锋利钢羽威吓旅人。若发现对方没带宝石，便失望离开，什么也不偷。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME threatens travelers with its sharp steel feather. If they don't carry gems with them, they just leave disappointed without stealing anything.

entry: POKENAME在深山修行，擅长近身战。强臂擒抱，利翼劈斩，尖喙啄击，样样拿手。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME specializes in close-quarter combat, grappling with its powerful arms, slashing with its sharp wings, and pecking with its beak. It trains deep in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME的身体由坚韧、防水又永不生锈的金属构成。也因此，它们几乎被猎杀至灭绝。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's body consists of a durable, waterproof metal that never rusts. Because of this, they have been nearly hunted to extinction.

entry: 轻质钢铁组成的身体，让POKENAME能轻松飞行。它打理金属身躯，就像擦亮摆锤一样，一丝不苟。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's body is made up of lightweight steel that allows it to fly with ease. It polishes its metal body as diligently as it polishes its pendulum.

entry: POKENAME举止可爱，咬下时却带着极强毒性，当地人都十分畏惧。受威胁时，它会先吠叫，警告人类赶快逃。
author: Krune
source: Despite its cute demeanor, POKENAME has a very potently venomous bite, which is feared in the areas in which POKENAME lives. It barks when threatened, giving humans a warning to run before it bites.

entry: POKENAME漫游草原，寻找同族结伴。臀部的头常因饥饿而死；若那颗头还活着，它便明显快乐些，也更不爱独处。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME roam the savannas, searching for others of their kind to ally with. The head on their rump is usually deceased from starvation, but when alive, they are noticeably happier and less solitary.

entry: POKENAME大多成大群行动，偶尔也有个体离群与旅人交朋友。叫声粗哑，啾啾作响。
author: pankiwi
source: While POKENAME typically stick together in large packs, some can be seen splitting from the pack to befriend travelers. They speak in rough chirps.

entry: POKENAME成群训练，经常更换切磋对象。它们盼着将来各自进化成不同模样，好有更多样的伙伴，一起练习。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains together in packs, swapping sparring partners often. Pack members hope for differing evolution, as it will allow a better variety in training partners when the time comes.

entry: POKENAME天性闹腾又叛逆，虽群居，地位却总在变化。它们常相互交战，争夺领袖与高位。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are rambunctious and rebellious by nature. Though they function in a pack, the hierarchy shifts constantly as they regularly battle amongst each other for dominance and standing.

entry: POKENAME出了名爱唱反调，偏要让人怎么不方便，怎么来。它的毒液造成的灼痛，还能持续数周。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are notoriously contrarian and enjoy being as inconvenient as possible. Their toxin causes a burning sensation that can last for weeks.

entry: 若坏运气接连不断，或许就是受了POKENAME的诅咒。它正义感强烈，会把不幸带给自己认定的恶人。
author: Sajochi
source: If you are having a string of bad luck, a POKENAME may have cursed you. This Pokémon has a strong sense of justice and will bring misfortune to those it deems evil.

entry: POKENAME会靠近孩子，装成小狗，盼有人收养自己。独自待着，就会心情低落。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME approaches children and acts like a puppy to try to get adopted. When alone, it gets depressed.

entry: POKENAME用各种叫声互通消息，将猎物逼入绝境。年长的POKENAME，皮毛会泛起黑曜石般的光泽。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME communicate with each other using a variety of cries in order to corner their prey. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like obsidian.

entry: 这种POKENAME逐渐适应了与人类共处，喜欢放牧咩利羊等家畜宝可梦。不过，它也常只是作为宠物饲养。
author: Krune
source: This POKENAME has evolved to be more integrated with humans. It likes herding Mareep and other creatures common in husbandry. It is often kept as just a pet.

entry: POKENAME周身的毛发保暖极佳。上方头骨的眼睛越亮，性情便越凶猛。好好照料它的训练家，仍能赢得POKENAME的忠诚。
author: entomoxie
source: The fur surrounding a POKENAME is great at insulating its body heat. The brighter the eye on the top skull glows, the more aggressive and ferocious. POKENAME are loyal to Trainers who properly care for them.

entry: POKENAME散发刺鼻的硫黄味，又常成小群生活，气味便更加浓烈。它爱先喷火烧过垃圾，再吞下肚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been described as having a pungent sulfuric scent, intensified by its tendency to live in small groups. It likes to burn garbage with fire breath before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME会释放易燃粉末，激动或狩猎时，将其点着。猎物的肉与骨，它们都会吃掉。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME give off a flammable powder that they ignite when agitated or hunting. These Pokémon eat both the meat and bones of their prey.

entry: 游戏城已提醒顾客，提防成群的POKENAME。它们学会守在出口，纠缠离去的客人，伺机抢走闪亮的硬币。
author: sk372
source: Game Corners have put out warnings to patrons about POKENAME packs, as they have learned to loiter in wait for exiting customers so they can harass them and try to steal their shiny coins.

entry: 头痛让它们难以协作，群体狩猎也乱了套。哪只头痛时激起的超能力脉冲最强，便被认作首领。
author: sk372
source: Due to the headaches they suffer from, their coordination as a pack has suffered, their hunting methods disorganized. The one whose headaches create the strongest psychic pulse is considered the leader.

entry: POKENAME爱群起围猎，彼此忠心，同甘共苦。它们能嗅见恐惧，选定攻击目标时，还会细细享受那气味。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME prefer to fight in packs to gang up on their prey. Each POKENAME is loyal through thick and thin. They can smell fear, enjoying this aroma as they decide which targets to strike.

entry: POKENAME忠诚可爱，是受欢迎的宠物，却很难训练。并非行为顽劣，而是教会的把戏，过不了一周就忘光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are popular for being loyal and adorable pets, though they are considered difficult to train. This is not because of any behavioral problems, but that taught tricks will be forgotten within a week.

entry: POKENAME吃火，也吃噩梦。据说，在窗边点一支蜡烛，它便会来，把睡者的噩梦吃掉。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME devours fire and bad dreams. It's said that those who light a candle by their window will have their nightmares eaten by this Pokémon.

entry: 等待进化的POKENAME几乎不动。一旦受了打扰，POKENAME便发出吠叫，声音足以让人做噩梦。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME barely move while waiting to evolve. If POKENAME is disturbed, it will bark with a sound that can give humans nightmares.

entry: 终于破茧而出后，POKENAME会找到同类，结伴觅食。小虫、其他虫宝可梦，甚至蜂蜜，都是它们搜寻的目标。
author: Krune
source: Having finally emerged from its cocoon, POKENAME find packs of other POKENAME and hunt prey together. They hunt and scavenge everything ranging from small insects, other bug-Pokémon, and even honey.

entry: 它们在首领带领下成群漫游，搜寻广阔草场。吃过之处，草地尽成焦土，再不长出任何草木。
author: amiel997
source: Roaming in herds led by an alpha, they scour the land in search of vast pastures. The grasslands they feed on are left scorched and barren, with nothing ever growing back.

entry: 深夜听见诡异嚎叫，或许是POKENAME正在觅食。受惊时，它会边逃边喷出热焰与浓烟，随后变成另一只宝可梦。
author: Sajochi
source: If you hear an eerie howl in the dead of night, it may be a POKENAME looking for food. When frightened, it will attempt to flee while belching hot flames and thick smog before transforming into another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看着可爱友善，实际却十分危险。小小的身体容不住那些能造成持久灼痛的毒素，哪怕无意碰一下，也可能痛不欲生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered quite dangerous despite its cute and friendly appearance. Its small body cannot properly contain the toxins that cause lingering burns, so an errant touch could have excruciating results.

entry: POKENAME把外来的火吸入背上头骨，助长自身火焰。这样做时，骨中会传出尖叫般的声音。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME absorbs flames into the skull on its back to fuel its own fire. Scream-like sounds emanate from it when it does this.

entry: 成群的POKENAME通常不自己觅食，而是找只小宝可梦，用角欺负它，非逼它带路找吃的不可。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME packs typically do not search for food on their own. Instead, they find a smaller Pokémon and bully it with their horns until it leads them to food.

entry: 野外所见的POKENAME，大多是一群中的首领。它们携带热石，为幼崽与寒中迷路的旅人取暖。
author: pankiwi
source: Most POKENAME seen in the wild are the leaders of their pack. They carry heated rocks to aid their young as well as travelers lost in the cold.

entry: POKENAME体内生出太多火焰，根本容不下。从手臂喷出的烈火，几分钟就能熔掉一座山。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates so much fire within its body, it cannot fully contain it. It shoots flames from its arms hot enough to melt a mountain in minutes.

entry: POKENAME擅长挖掘，会把受害者埋起来，直到只剩下白骨。随后，它会挖出骨骸，拿来玩耍。
author: D_Numeritos
source: POKENAME excels at digging, burying victims until only bones remain. It then unearths them to play with their skeletal remains.

entry: 传说，这些宝可梦守着通往灵界的大门。风吹过牙齿间隙，便传出仿佛有人痛苦呜咽的声音。
author: Wormspawn
source: Legends say these Pokémon guard the gates to the spirit world. When the wind passes through their teeth, they make sounds like someone whimpering in pain.

entry: 古代遗迹中，有过类似POKENAME的零碎记载：一位神灵召出1000条手臂，将恶人拖走，用净化之火，把灵魂中的罪恶焚成灰烬。
author: sk372
source: Fragmented records of a being similar to POKENAME have been discovered in ancient ruins. They illustrate a deity that drags away the wicked with 1000 summoned arms to burn the evil in their souls to ash with cleansing flame.

entry: 别看POKENAME的模样，它们其实顽皮爱捣蛋，喜欢点燃物件，四处吓人。东西倒不会烧坏，却要留下好几天的硫黄味。
author: Sajochi
source: Despite its looks, POKENAME are mischievous tricksters who enjoy setting objects aflame to scare anyone it can. The items it ignites are unharmed but will have a lingering smell of sulfur on them for a few days.

entry: 看见POKENAME，被视为死亡的预兆，因为它似乎只在人将逝去前现身。人们相信，它会吃掉亡者灵魂，再将邪恶的魂送往冥界。
author: Sajochi
source: The sight of a POKENAME is considered an omen of death, as it only seems to appear shortly before a person passes on. People believe this Pokémon consumes the souls of the departed, and sends wicked souls to the underworld.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是冥界守门者，为亡魂开路，等它们走过，再锁上身后的门。它们全身滚烫，仿佛刚从烤炉中出来。
author: Knilk
source: Folklore speaks of POKENAME as the gatekeeper of the underworld, opening the way for the souls of the departed and locking the gates behind them. Their bodies are always burning hot, as if they had been left in an oven.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，便传出不安、近乎超自然的声响。小齿轮能离开身体自由行动，却必须在破晓前回来，否则可能丧命。
author: Sajochi
source: An unsettling, almost supernatural sound is emitted when a POKENAME spins its gears. The minigear can move freely from the body, but must return before daybreak or else it may perish.

entry: 它无目的地飘过墓地与古战场，颈间项链咔嗒作响，让人听得寒毛直竖。
author: Krune
source: It floats aimlessly around graveyards and places where wars have been fought. Its necklace rattles with a chilling sound that sends shivers down one's spine.

entry: POKENAME腿虽短，逃命、觅食时，却能跑得飞快。最初或许难驯，肯好好照料它的训练家，仍能赢得它的忠心。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite the apparently short legs, POKENAME can scuttle quickly when escaping danger or looking for food. They may be hard to tame initially, but they can be quite loyal to Trainers who properly care for them all the same.

entry: POKENAME腿虽短，逃命、觅食时，却能跑得飞快。最初或许难驯，肯好好照料它的训练家，仍能赢得它的忠心。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite the apparently short legs, POKENAME can scuttle quickly when escaping danger or looking for food. They may be hard to tame initially, but they can be quite loyal to Trainers who properly care for them all the same.

entry: POKENAME爱用咬东西、咬人的方式玩耍，咬伤却会刺痛好几天。最好备个皮皮玩偶，让POKENAME咬着玩。
author: Sajochi
source: POKENAME loves to play by biting anything and anyone. It is recommended to keep a Poké Doll around for POKENAME to play with, as this Pokémon's bite will cause a stinging pain for a few days.

entry: 现代的POKENAME，不过是扰人安宁的盗墓贼。可传说在远古，数百万根骨骼曾聚成巨型POKENAME，给世界带来浩劫。
author: octolinggrimm
source: Though POKENAME are not much more than grave-robbing nuisances in the modern day, legends tell of a gargantuan POKENAME forming from millions of bones and wreaking havoc on the world long ago.

entry: 现代的POKENAME，不过是扰人安宁的盗墓贼。可传说在远古，数百万根骨骼曾聚成巨型POKENAME，给世界带来浩劫。
author: octolinggrimm
source: Though POKENAME are not much more than grave-robbing nuisances in the modern day, legends tell of a gargantuan POKENAME forming from millions of bones and wreaking havoc on the world long ago.

entry: 有些传说里，它们潜伏冥界，焚烧恶魂。四处游荡时，硫黄味也如影随形。
author: Skymaster426
source: In some legends, it is said that these Pokémon lurk in the underworld, burning evil souls. When they wander, the smell of sulphur follows.

entry: 往昔，POKENAME一声夜嚎，便足以引发恐慌。被它袭击的村庄，等到日出，就已不复存在。
author: Skymaster426
source: In the past, a POKENAME's howl in the night would be enough to cause a panic. A village it attacked would no longer exist by the time the sun rose.

entry: POKENAME最爱用超能力折磨人。变出的汤匙一旦弯曲，毫无防备的受害者，心智也会随之扭曲。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME aims above all else to torment humans with its psychic prowess. As one of its conjured spoons bends, so too bends the mind of an unwitting victim.

entry: 古老预言中，四只POKENAME会在世界末日疾驰而过。因此，它们走到哪里，便把恐惧带到哪里。
author: NellNast42
source: Ancient prophecies describe four POKENAME riding at the end of the world. As such, these Pokémon bring fear wherever they go.

entry: 构成身体的焦油状物质，腐蚀性强得可怖，足以致命。POKENAME体内可见的骨头，便是被它吞噬、消化后的猎物遗骸。
author: sk372
source: The tar-like substance that comprises its body is horrifically acidic and deadly. The bones seen within POKENAME's body are all that remains of prey it has engulfed and consumed.

entry: 它有一条不时吞吐的舌头，却没人看清它究竟有没有嘴。受威胁时，便抖响尾巴，迸出电火花。
author: sk372
source: It possesses a flicking tongue, yet none have seen for sure if it actually has a mouth.  When threatened, it will rattle its tail, producing electric sparks.

entry: 一窝POKENAME尚在蛋壳里，就能以心灵感应互相交流。先孵出的幼崽，会担任哨兵，留意危险。
author: serversizeme
source: A clutch of POKENAME eggs can all communicate to each other telepathically from inside their shells. One hatchling acts as a sentry to watch for danger.

entry: 它摇响手中的尾巴，威吓天敌。若对方不肯退缩，便会发现，这在POKENAME手里，也是一件好用的武器。
author: sk372
source: It shakes and rattles the tail in its hand as an intimidation tactic against predators.  Those that are not dissuaded by the act will find it is still an effective weapon in POKENAME's hands.

entry: 大颚上覆着的毒黏液，连卡比兽也能放倒。POKENAME密集的沼泽，常会禁止新手训练家进入。
author: Schwaus
source: It covers its jaws with a venomous mucus that can knock out a Snorlax. Swamps with high populations of POKENAME are often closed off from novice Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动地潜在水下，盯着猎物好几个小时。一旦落入巨颚，便很难逃脱。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME can lie still and stalk its prey from under the water for hours. Once prey gets caught in its jaws, they rarely escape.

entry: POKENAME从空中袭击，又快又无声，可得手后，反而最为脆弱。它的翅膀，托不起身体加上一整顿猎物的重量。
author: sk372
source: Though effective at quickly and quietly attacking prey from above, POKENAME is most vulnerable after a successful hunt. Its wings are not strong enough to lift both itself and its latest meal.

entry: POKENAME模仿阿柏蛇的样子，吓退天敌。咬下虽有毒，毒性却不强，不会造成明显症状。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's mimic an Ekans to intimidate would-be predators. While its bite is venomous, they venom is not strong enough to have noticeable side effects.

entry: POKENAME无声滑行，常盘绕古代遗迹。身体泛起微弱脉动，仿佛正引导着某种力量，与往昔的秘密相连。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME slithers silently, often coiled around ancient ruins. Its body pulses faintly, almost as if it is channeling an unseen force tied to the mysteries of the past.

entry: 利爪虽带剧毒，平日却主要用来挖土。战斗时，POKENAME更爱盘起身体，抖响尾巴，让来犯者知难而退。
author: Frokachu
source: Though its claws carry potent poisons, they are mostly used for digging. In battle POKENAME prefer to coil up and rattle their tail to discourage attackers.

entry: POKENAME用头上舌状的附肢感知气流变化，寻找猎物。尾尖发出的声响，则用来御敌，连最强悍的生物，也会吓退。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME use their tongue-like appendages on their heads to sense changes in the air currents, helping them locate prey. Their tail-tips are used to ward off attackers, producing a sound that scares even the toughest creatures.

entry: 刀尖的剧毒汩汩冒泡。砷含量高得异常，碰到皮肤，就会造成强烈刺激。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: A potent poison bubbles at the tip of its blade. This poison severely irritates the skin on contact due to its unusually high arsenic content.

entry: 索罗亚与阿柏蛇的融合，原本被寄望成为更好的除虫帮手。可喵喵依旧远更受欢迎，喜欢这种融合体的人，也就少得多。
author: El Fail
source: This fusion, which combines Zorua with Ekans, was originally proposed as a possible means of better pest control. Unfortunately Meowth continued to be widely more popular, relegating this fusion to a much smaller following.

entry: POKENAME会把毒牙扎入猎物或敌人身体，却一听见突如其来的巨响，就转身逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sink their venomous fangs into prey and enemies alike, but flee at the sight of sudden loud noises.

entry: 它摇动头上的尾巴，像拨浪鼓般发出怪声，吓退天敌。声音令人不安，30英尺外都听得到。
author: .izik
source: It wiggles the tail on its head like a rattle to scare off predators. The sound is unnerving and can be heard from 30 feet away.

entry: 毒液储存在头顶帆状器官中，需用时流入舌头。它冷得能冻伤皮肤，也常被用来制作解毒药与灼伤药。
author: Krune
source: Its poison is stored in sails on its head, and it flows into its tongue when needed. The poison gives a chilling effect that can freeze skin, so its poison is often used for making both Antidotes and Burn Heals.

entry: 细长灵活的身体，让它能轻松钻过其他宝可梦的洞穴。它最喜欢的猎物，是尼多朗。
author: Staghorn
source: Its elongated, flexible body allows it to snake through Pokémon burrows with ease. Its favorite prey is Nidoran.

entry: 住在湿地的训练家很爱POKENAME，它们涉水穿行，轻松自如。敏锐察觉附近动静后，POKENAME便抬起爪，用吻部指出方向，提醒训练家。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME are loved by Trainers living in swampy or marshy areas, as they are able to easily traverse the watery landscapes. With their keen senses, POKENAME alert their Trainers about nearby activity by lifting a paw and pointing with their snout.

entry: POKENAME吃深海的金属矿床。若一群同时疯狂进食，掀起的力量便会形成巨型漩涡，扰乱当地渔民与宝可梦。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME feeds on metal deposits deep in the ocean. If a group of POKENAME are in a feeding frenzy, the force will create massive whirlpools, disrupting the local fisherman and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用螺旋身体搅动水流，卷起巨大漩涡，自己却只坐在海底，等漩涡把猎物送上门。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its spiral body to churn the waters around it enough to create large whirlpools. However, these Pokémon just sit on the ocean floor waiting for their whirlpools to bring them their prey.

entry: 它每天大多在睡觉或找食物，温和的POKENAME很受孩子欢迎。可父母仍会因它的利爪，告诫孩子不要靠近。
author: Krune
source: It spends most of its days sleeping or foraging for food. POKENAME's mild demeanor makes it popular among children, although parents warn them to not approach it due to its claws.

entry: 遇上其他宝可梦，若既无法悄悄靠近，又来不及逃，POKENAME便反复用头与上半身猛撞地面，想吓得对方绕道。
author: bobosmith01
source: When it cannot sneak up on or flee from an approaching Pokémon, POKENAME will repeatedly slam its head and upper body into the ground in an attempt to intimidate the Pokémon to make it steer clear.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，深受喜爱，却在许多地方被禁作宠物。体型庞大、力气惊人，还贪玩得过头，太容易无意间大肆破坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are adored for their cute appearance, but are banned in many places as pets. Their massive size combined with their strength and overly-playful nature is too prone to accidental destruction.

entry: POKENAME能感知家乡雪山的地下震动，预知雪崩。它们毕生用惊人的速度与力量，营救灾难路径上的探险者。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME can detect underground vibrations in the snowy mountains they call home and can predict avalanches before they occur. They dedicate their lives to rescuing explorers who are in the path using their super speed and strength.

entry: 有些POKENAME明明不怕冷，却仍长出浓密毛皮。有没有进化上的好处，尚不清楚，不过骑在这些个体背上，确实舒服些。
author: odditylad
source: Despite not feeling the effects of the cold temperatures some POKENAME still develop a dense fur coat. It is not known whether they have an evolutionary advantage however these variants are more comfortable to ride.

entry: 无论走到哪里，它都用象鼻卷着一株树苗。万一弄丢，便放下手头的一切，去寻找新的。
author: Staghorn
source: It carries the sapling in its trunk wherever it goes. If the sapling is lost, it will drop whatever it's doing to find a new one.

entry: POKENAME双手虽是利刃，性情却善良温和。它勤练静心与冥想，免得失去冷静，伤到别的宝可梦或训练家。
author: odditylad
source: Despite having blades for hands POKENAME is kind and gentle. It practices mindfulness and meditation to ensure it never loses its temper and hurts another Pokémon or Trainer.

entry: POKENAME是被艺术家亡魂附身的树桩，木质鼻子会发出诡异声响，吓跑来找清静作画的画家。留下的画具，就被POKENAME拿来装点自己与森林。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME are stumps possessed by the spirits of artists. Their wooden trunks produce haunting sounds that they use to scare painters looking for a quiet place to work. POKENAME then decorate themselves and their forest with any dropped supplies.

entry: POKENAME体内储着大量沙子，受威胁便从象鼻喷出。腿太短，它常不走路，而是一跳一跳地前进。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of sand inside their bodies and will shoot it out of its trunk if it feels threatened. Due to their short legs, it tends to hop around instead of walking.

entry: POKENAME看着像昆虫，其实彻头彻尾是哺乳动物。体温让象耳状的真菌，得以在身上生长。
author: .realthree
source: Despite its insectoid appearance, POKENAME is completely mammalian. Its body heat allows the elephant ear fungus to grow on it.

entry: POKENAME把有力的象鼻当铲子，轻松掘土。受威胁时，还能以惊人力道，把泥块掷向敌人。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME uses its strong trunk as a shovel to dig through the dirt with ease. When threatened, it can launch dirt at potential foes with alarming force.

entry: 它贪玩，又很快能听懂指令，很受表演者与训练家欢迎。可得定期滚泥或泡水降温，太热时，它什么也不肯做。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has a playful nature and responds quickly to cues, making it popular with performers and Trainers alike. It needs to periodically roll in the mud or dive in water to cool down, as it will refuse to do anything if it's too hot.

entry: POKENAME一天大多在使出滚动。休息时，又像玩溜溜球一样，转着摆锤自娱。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME spends most of its day using the move Rollout. In its periods of rest, it spins its pendulum like a yo-yo to entertain itself.

entry: POKENAME保留着魔墙人偶制造隐形物体的能力，却特别爱造车辆之类，人造而非自然生成的东西，因此很受某些骑手团体喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: Mr. Mime's ability to create invisible objects remains within POKENAME. Interestingly, it likes to create human objects not otherwise found in nature, such as vehicles. This Pokémon is popular among a certain group of bikers.

entry: POKENAME能用象鼻与火焰，把地形改成自己喜欢的模样。若遇上奇怪的火山地带，很可能已在它的巢附近。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME is able to terraform the land to its liking using its trunk and fire. If you ever find an odd volcanic area, you're probably near one's den.

entry: 它将长长的蛇形身体紧紧盘起，卷成轮胎模样，再以全速滚走，或直撞敌人。带孩子的POKENAME，尤其护地盘，也格外危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can curl its long serpentine body into a tight, tire-like coil. POKENAME will then roll either away or directly into foes at top speeds. A mother POKENAME is particularly territorial and dangerous.

entry: 每只POKENAME的鬃毛，都不相同。色彩越明亮，力量便越强。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: No two POKENAME have the same mane. The brighter their mane is, the stronger they are.

entry: POKENAME的颈部与腹肌格外强壮，既灵活，又有力。它们喜欢结成小群，共同生活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has particularly strong neck and abdominal muscles, which give it both flexibility and strength. POKENAME tend to live together in small groups.

entry: POKENAME是安装在高分子材料机器人身体里的多边兽Ⅱ程序。它投射的全息火焰，也能和真正的火焰一样炽热。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME is a Porygon2 program installed into a polymeric robotic body. Its holographic flames can be just as hot as real fire.

entry: POKENAME天天怒气冲冲。虽不会飞，却能把藤蔓当弹弓，将自己猛然弹出去。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is constantly angry, no matter the day. Though it can not fly, it flings itself using vines like a slingshot.

entry: 它们经过升级，电子邮件的投递速度更快了。给训练家送信时，会发出8位音效般的啾鸣。
author: pankiwi
source: They were given an upgrade to improve the speed of electronic mail delivery. They chirp in 8-bit tones when they deliver mail to Trainers.

entry: 腹部的符号，显示着它吃下了多少电力。吃饱后，便向附近设备输电，令其拥有人工智能。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The symbol on this Pokémon's stomach represents how much electricity it has eaten. When it gets full, it will transfer the electricity into nearby devices, which fills it with artificial intelligence.

entry: 人们利用存放在宝可梦寄放系统里的皮卡丘数据，创造出这种全新形态的多边兽Ⅱ——POKENAME。不过，它很快就开始自行复制，如今数量已经泛滥。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME was created as a new form of Porygon2 using the data of a Pikachu that was placed into the Pokémon Storage System. However, it quickly duplicated itself and is now overabundant.

entry: 这种宝可梦最早是给多边兽Ｚ使用杀毒程序后产生的。它既有多边兽Ｚ的力量，也有多边兽Ⅱ的情感。
author: ValtsuRi
source: The first version of this Pokémon was the result of using an antivirus on a Porygon-Z. It has the powers of Porygon-Z with the emotions of a Porygon2.

entry: POKENAME靠无机物维生，尤其爱漂在泳池里，吸饮其中的氯。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME consumes inorganic material to live. It prefers to float in pools to drink the chlorine there.

entry: 升级后，数据压缩能力高得惊人。可批评者认为，资料压得太密，想取出其中任何一条，都几乎办不到。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: It has been upgraded to increase its data compression capabilities to astounding levels. Critics have argued that it is so densely packed that retrieving any one piece of information is effectively impossible.

entry: 常能见到其他宝可梦，欣赏它绘出的超级英雄故事。能把自己的故事分享给大家，让它十分自豪。
author: Skymaster426
source: Pokémon can be found enjoying illustrations it has created, usually depicting superhero stories. It takes great pride sharing its stories with others.

entry: POKENAME的毒针与鹿角虽小，却能精准地把灵力引向任何目标。群体一旦发怒，身心两方面的压迫，都能令对手不敌。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME's stingers and antlers may be minuscule, but they can precisely channel spiritual energy to any target. Angry swarms of POKENAME can overwhelm opponents physically and psychically.

entry: POKENAME的包袱里装着各种节日点心，最爱的还是拐杖糖。常吃拐杖糖，或许也影响了鹿角的模样。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME carry several holiday snacks in its bundle, but love candy canes. Their diet of candy canes may have had an effect on their antlers.

entry: POKENAME靠微弱的超能力，不用动身，就能混合不同食物。可这点力量，却派不上战斗的用场。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME uses its weak psychic abilities to mix different foods together without having to move. However, it can't use these abilities for combat.

entry: POKENAME头上的枝条像真鹿角，随季节生长、脱落。若在一处待得太久，落枝堆多了，便可能引发火灾。
author: Holgast
source: The antler-like sticks on POKENAME's head grow out and fall off through the seasons, like real antlers. As a result, if POKENAME stay in one area for too long, their dropped twigs can cause a fire hazard.

entry: POKENAME喜欢僻静森林。闯入者会被神秘力量催眠，醒来已在林外，连遇见过POKENAME也不记得。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefer to live in reclusive forests. Trespassers are hypnotized by their mysterious powers, and wake up outside of the woods with no memory that they encountered POKENAME.

entry: 凡凝视鹿角的人，都会被POKENAME引入迷梦。它先审视被催眠者的内心，再决定如何处置。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME pulls all who gaze at its antlers into a trance. It judges the hearts of those it hypnotizes before deciding what action it will take.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤由自己脱落的角制成，因此只只不同。摆锤仍留着一部分，POKENAME天生便有的催眠力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: The pendulum POKENAME carries varies from one individual to the next, due to it actually being created from the individual's shed antlers. The pendulum still carries a portion of the hypnotic properties POKENAME can naturally create.

entry: 一见精巧的艺术品，POKENAME便立在原地，仔细分析。通常只停几分钟，可有时一想，就能纹丝不动地想上几天。
author: ohok3441
source: When seeing an elaborate art piece, POKENAME freeze in place to analyze it. They normally stay still for a few minutes but can remain frozen in thought for days on end.

entry: POKENAME把倒下的树木做成画布，尽情作画。不满意的作品，则拿去当战斗中的盾牌。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME spend their time turning fallen trees into canvases they paint onto. They'll use paintings they're unsatisfied with as shields in battle.

entry: 它用黏土塑出诱饵，再以尾巴上色，借此研究附近猎手的攻击方式与捕猎习惯。
author: Staghorn
source: It creates decoys out of clay that it paints with its tail. It uses them to study the attacks and hunting patterns of the area's predators.

entry: 据说，POKENAME画出的肖像，能替画中人承受岁月的侵蚀，让本人永葆美丽。代价是，画里的身影越来越老。
author: kandyman
source: It is believed a portrait painted by POKENAME can absorb the effects of age on a subject, leaving them beautiful forever. However, the portrait becomes increasingly old.

entry: POKENAME若预见灾难，就画出壁画，警告大家。许多遗迹里，都留着这类旧日壁画的痕迹。
author: miss_moo
source: When POKENAME sees a vision of disaster, it paints a mural in warning. Many ruins have evidence of past murals.

entry: POKENAME爱把荒漠的沙子染成各色，铺成沙画。某些基金会，还会专门保护POKENAME的作品。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to create sand paintings by dyeing the desert sand different colors. Art pieces made by POKENAME are consider protected by certain foundations.

entry: 两种颜色，分别由POKENAME的两个半脑控制。双方若能合作，薄膜般的身体便转为深紫，超能力也随之增强。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The two colors are controlled by POKENAME's two halves of its brain.  If its two halves can cooperate, its membrane-like body turns into a deep purple, heightening its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME用背上的笔尖绘画，尖端渗出的液体，就是很好的颜料。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME uses the brush tips on its back to create marks. The fluid leaking from them makes a good paint.

entry: POKENAME用炮管，在领地四处绘出复杂壁画，速度快得令人难解。有人推测，它靠背部一组复杂肌肉，边喷射，边调色、变换图样。
author: CaldonB
source: POKENAME uses its cannons to paint intricate murals across its territory at confounding speeds. It is theorized that POKENAME flexes a complex set of muscles in its back to mix colors and create patterns while firing.

entry: 吸入POKENAME喷出的气体，就会精神大振，仿佛无所不能。不过，竞技运动通常禁止使用这种气体。
author: Mistymagius
source: The gas POKENAME expels invigorates anyone who inhales it, making them feel like they can take on anything. However, using the gas in competitive sports is usually banned.

entry: POKENAME常先用翅膀扬起沙尘，遮住对手视线，再扑近身，以连踢与翼击猛攻。
author: sk372
source: A common fighting tactic for POKENAME is to kick up dust or sand with its wings, blinding an opponent before swooping in close to fight with a flurry of kicks and wing strikes.

entry: POKENAME常向体型有自己十倍大的宝可梦挑战。打赢后，最爱舔舔刚刚击败对手的前爪，乐在其中。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME is regularly known to challenge Pokémon that are ten times its size. It always takes delight in licking the same forepaws it used to defeat its opponents.

entry: POKENAME把战斗风格当作艺术，花上许久磨炼动作。可它重好看、轻实效，实战中常因此吃亏。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME considers its fighting style an art form, and spends hours perfecting its moves. It cares much more about looks than function, however, which often holds it back in battle.

entry: 它从不放过磨炼本领的机会，何时都可能在训练，只在吃沙子、砾石时，才停一停。
author: Schwaus
source: It never backs down from an opportunity to hone its skills. It can be found training at any hour, only stopping to eat sand and gravel.

entry: 它不停模仿格斗宝可梦，盼着有朝一日，学遍所有技艺，再创出只属于自己的一招。
author: sk372
source: It mimics fighting type Pokémon constantly, hoping to one day be able to master all techniques, and then craft a new one just for itself.

entry: POKENAME不吃东西时，多半就在观察别的宝可梦战斗，学习技巧。野生个体若没这份上进心，便会被同族抛下，只能独自谋生。
author: bobosmith01
source: Usually, when POKENAME are not eating, they are studying other battling Pokémon to learn their techniques. Wild POKENAME that lack this drive to improve are abandoned by their kind and left to fend on their own.

entry: POKENAME会在冰封的山上冥想数月，锻炼耐力。完成训练后，它能在没有食物和水的情况下坚持2周。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends months mediating on icy mountains to train their endurance. When fully trained, it can last up to 2 weeks without any food or water.

entry: 训练时，它会随意吹出数量、排列各不相同的泡泡，再看自己能多快、多利落地用拳脚，将它们全部打破。
author: sk372
source: As training, it will blow bubbles in a random amount and pattern around itself. It then sees how quickly and efficiently it can pop all of them with its punches and kicks.

entry: 气态身体本无手脚，可POKENAME战斗时，会短暂浮现肢体般的气缕。它不断强化这些幻肢，为日后进化出真正的手脚作准备。
author: sk372
source: Though its gaseous body has no arms or legs, wisps imitating them can briefly be seen as POKENAME fights. It strengthens these phantom limbs, preparing for the day it evolves actual physical limbs.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力，感知谁最愿意训练，立刻赶去找对方。它从不荒废任何一天的修行。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses its psychic ability to sense who is most willing to train and immediately seeks them out. It never misses a day of training.

entry: POKENAME的独特战法，融合嘻哈与霹雳舞，招式难以预料，因此很受街头艺人欢迎。
author: Mistymagius
source: A popular Pokémon among street performers, POKENAME uses a unique fighting style mimicking a mix of hip-hop and breakdancing, making it unpredictable in combat.

entry: POKENAME能一直旋转，永不头晕。据说，令人眼花缭乱的转动，还能将人催眠。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME can spin indefinitely without ever getting dizzy. Its dazzling spins are said to have hypnotic properties.

entry: POKENAME第一次被撞翻，会以为自己再也起不来，急得绝望。可过了几分钟，却突然发现，自己竟天生会倒立旋转。
author: epping_forest
source: The first time that a POKENAME is knocked over, it gets desperate, thinking it won't be able to get up. After a couple of minutes, it suddenly discovers its natural talent of spinning over its head.

entry: 起初，一只钳比另一只重，让POKENAME十分苦恼，后来却摸出了诀窍。先把重钳收至腹前，越转越快，再猛然放开，借钳重与转动惯量出击。
author: epping_forest
source: Having one claw heavier than the other really bothered POKENAME at first, but then it adapted. It puts the heavy claw over its abdomen to gain rotation speed, then releases it, combining the weight of the claw and the moment of inertia generated.

entry: POKENAME会花好几个小时把毛皮梳理整齐。它们逃避战斗，只为不把皮毛弄坏。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME spend hours keeping their fur neat. They run from battle to avoid ruining their coats.

entry: POKENAME华美的毛发，一暖和就容易断裂。幸好，唇间散发的寒气极强，让头发免遭损伤。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's luxurious hair is prone to breakage if it gets too warm. Luckily, the intense cold radiating from its lips prevents that from happening.

entry: POKENAME待人友善，遇见它却不是好兆头。据说，它只会出现在，注定永远寻不到爱情的训练家面前。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its kindness towards humans, seeing a POKENAME is not a good sign. It is said it will only appear before trainers that are destined to never find love.

entry: 它们毫无自主意识，慢慢走过遗迹，执行迷唇魔灵的心愿。每只迷唇魔灵，往往控制着好几只POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: They trudge slowly and willlessly through ruins and fulfill the wishes of Jynoirs, who often have several POKENAME's under their control.

entry: 冰凉的手臂，可放入饮料里浸泡几分钟，代替冰块，因此颇受欢迎。POKENAME自己也喜欢饮料，倒是两相情愿。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its ice-cold arms are popular ice cube alternatives, as they can be dipped in drinks for several minutes and POKENAME enjoys the liquid in return.

entry: 冰帽用来反射炙热阳光，意外地结实。凭冰之力量，它还能不断将帽子修复、更新。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Its icy hat, which it uses to reflect the sun's hot rays, is surprisingly robust. Thanks to its ice powers, it can constantly renew its hat.

entry: POKENAME敏锐的鼻子，记得喜欢与讨厌的气味。来到新地方，就到处嗅嗅，想找些熟悉的味道。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's sensitive nose can remember what it likes and dislikes. When entering a new area, it will sniff around to try and find familiar smells.

entry: POKENAME幼小时，能用头顶突起抽取设备的能量。可长大以后，这本领便消失了。
author: .realthree
source: While POKENAME are still small and young, they can use the protrusion on their head to siphon energy from devices. They lose this ability as they grow.

entry: POKENAME诞生于电力被发现之前。它身上的符号，竟仿佛预示了现代的电气标记。
author: abstrusePaladin
