source: POKENAME originates from a time before electricity was discovered. Its symbology seems to have been a prediction of modern electrical symbols.

entry: POKENAME的衣物拖过地面，摩擦出静电，储进头盔。随后，以奇异而迷人的能量迸发，将电力打向对手。
author: NightwingJay
source: POKENAME harnesses static electricity from its clothes as they drag along the ground, storing the energy in its helmet. It then releases this energy through enchanting, mystical bursts that shock its opponents.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体，始终嗡嗡带电。施展猛烈的刃击时，电力便一同倾泻出去。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's metal body is always buzzing with electricity. It discharges this electricity in devastating blade attacks.

entry: 尾巴仿佛插在插座里的插头，电火花噼啪作响。它会胡乱挥动，放出阵阵电流自保。
author: .izik
source: Its tail resembles a plug inside an outlet, sparking with power. It swings it wildly, sending out bursts of electricity to protect itself.

entry: 凡是找到的废电线、坏电器，它都往身体里塞。放电时，还会冒出一团团恶臭烟雾。
author: Staghorn
source: It fills itself with any discarded wires and broken electronics it can find. When it discharges its electricity, it emits clouds of putrid smoke.

entry: 若看见一块凹得分外明显的金属，可能就是POKENAME干的。雷雨天，它们会敲击金属表面，储电留着以后吃。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If you find a conspicuous piece of dented metal it may have been caused by a POKENAME. During thunderstorms, they punch metal surfaces to store electricity for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在雷云状尾巴里，啪地拍向地面，便雷声轰鸣，既威吓敌人，也鼓舞自己的斗志。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores up electrical reserves in its tail, which has the appearance of a thundercloud. To intimidate foes and amplify its fighting spirit, it slaps the charged tail against the ground, which creates booming thunder.

entry: POKENAME不善于维持形态，心思又大多花在变身上，结果花纹看着古怪费解，反倒吓不住敌人。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME cannot maintain its shape well. Its cognitive processes are primarily for transforming, so its markings end up perplexing, not intimidating.

entry: 它装成丢在小巷旁的钱包，引孩子靠近。等凑到跟前，便张开尖牙，猛地咬下。
author: .izik
source: It pretends to be wallets on the side of alleyways to trick kids into getting close. Once they get close, it will bite down on them with sharp fangs.

entry: 盯着那眼状花纹太久，全身便会灼痛难忍。它喷出的烈焰，几分钟就能把岩石汽化。
author: Mistymagius
source: Staring into its eye-pattern too long causes an insufferable burning sensation in your entire body. It produces flames hot enough to vaporize rock within a matter of minutes.

entry: 它潜伏沼底，追踪毫无防备的宝可梦。针对不同猎物，还能使用各不相同的专用毒液。
author: Schwaus
source: It stalks the bottom of swamps for unsuspecting Pokémon. It can use various venoms specialized for different forms of prey.

entry: 它的巨颚一合，整只轮胎也能咬碎。腹部花纹骇人，小宝可梦一看见，便吓得僵在原地。
author: Schwaus
source: Its jaws are strong enough to crush whole tires in a single chomp. The patterns on its stomach are so intimidating it can freeze small Pokémon in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME是令人畏惧的猎手，仿佛有着摄人心魄的气势。据说，胸前发光的印记，藏着古代知识，被它凶狠守护着。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is an intimidating predator with a mesmerizing presence. The glowing mark on its chest is believed to contain ancient knowledge, which it guards fiercely.

entry: 这是活动范围内的顶级猎手，即使比它更大的宝可梦，也难保安全。中毒后，全身仿佛都在燃烧。
author: zerocipher
source: This Pokémon is an apex predator across its range; even larger Pokémon are not safe. Their venom makes you feel as if your whole body is burning.

entry: 千万别喝POKENAME的奶。它能滋养自己的幼崽，人类喝下，却会立刻中毒。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: It is ill-advised to drink POKENAME's milk. While can provide vital nutrients to its young, it causes immediate poisoning to humans who drink it.

entry: 出汗时，它会向周围散发有毒香气。吸入过多，便可能偏头痛、视线模糊。
author: .izik
source: When it sweats it releases a toxic fragrance into the area. Breathing too much of this can cause migraines and blurred vision.

entry: 舌尖滴下的唾液，毒性极强。一碰到裸露皮肤，便会引发逼真的幻觉，有时甚至麻痹全身。
author: .izik
source: The saliva that drips from its tongue is extremely poisonous. If it comes in contact with exposed skin, it can cause vivid hallucinations and sometimes paralysis.

entry: 四副巨大的蛇形身体，能从POKENAME的头骨中伸出。每一条都能轻易缠住、绞碎好几个敌人，令人胆寒。
author: sk372
source: Four massive serpentine bodies can extend out from within POKENAME's skull. Each of these limbs can coil around and crush multiple foes with frightening ease.

entry: 奇异的弯曲形状，让它能探入树木缝隙，将毒液注入树干。住在被POKENAME毒害的树上的宝可梦，便会逐渐衰弱，更容易下手捕猎。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its unusually curved shape lets it dig into the recesses of trees and inject its poison into their trunks. Pokémon that live in trees poisoned by POKENAME become weakened, making for easier prey.

entry: 吹对笛子的旋律，POKENAME就会替你实现一个愿望。可措辞若不够严谨，它便故意曲解字句，拿人寻开心。
author: .realthree
source: Play the right flute music, and POKENAME will grant you a wish. If the wish's wording isn't exact, it will twist the words for its own amusement.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的眼状花纹，能吓退天敌。捕猎时，它既用毒，也借翅膀振出的刺耳声响御敌。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME's wings contain patterns resembling eyes, which are known to frighten predators. Along with its venom, it also uses the ear-piercing vibrations from the wings to hunt its prey.

entry: POKENAME高举双翼，放大尖鸣，显得比本来更加庞大，让敌人吓得动弹不得。再用尾巴卷住晕头转向的猎物，载向远处，从此再无踪影。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise their wings and amplify their piercing cries to appear even larger than they already are, paralyzing foes with fear. They coil their tails around their disoriented prey and lift them off, never to be seen again.

entry: 火山岩石基部，常能看见POKENAME喷火。看它火焰的颜色，还能预知即将到来的喷发。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME are most commonly found on the rocky base of volcanoes spitting fire. The color of the flame can be used to predict an approaching eruption.

entry: POKENAME温暖又轻巧，朋友围成圈，轻轻抛接，便成了受欢迎的聚会游戏。不过，若玩得太粗鲁，也可能被严重灼伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's warmth and light weight make it popular to gently toss from friend to friend in a circle as a party game. Being too rough while playing with POKENAME, however, may result in serious burns.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: 这只宝可梦一动，就会喷出滚烫的蒸汽。它喜欢炎热、潮湿的地方，常在温泉中泡着；温泉老板也会训练POKENAME，帮忙维持桑拿房的温度。
author: khane048
source: This Pokémon releases scalding steam with every movement. Preferring hot, humid environments, it can often be found basking in hot springs. Hot spring owners sometimes train POKENAME to help maintain the perfect temperature in their saunas.

entry: 夏季，成大群的POKENAME会迁往寒冷地区。若留在暑热中，脆弱的翅膀就会熔化。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Enormous swathes of POKENAME can be seen migrating to colder climates in the summer. If left behind in the heat, their fragile wings would melt.

entry: 它的奶虽不算营养，味道却很不错。有趣的是，POKENAME的奶，常被用来制作它最爱吃的那牌奶酪，绕来绕去，又吃回自己肚里。
author: sk372
source: The milk it produces is flavorful, if not very nutritional.  In an amusing loop of events, POKENAME milk is often used for the creation of its favorite brand of cheese to snack on.

entry: POKENAME后半身看似液体，其实只是奶没挤够，积满了黏稠乳汁。洗掉那层黏液，尾上的头，便会显得格外亲人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back half appears liquid, yet is actually simply just coated with viscous milk from not being milked enough. The tail proves very affectionate if cleansed of its gooey layer of coating.

entry: 它高速旋转，释放体内储存的奶，一次最多能装90加仑。
author: Seggule
source: It releases the milk stored within its body by spinning at a high pace. It is capable of storing up to 90 gallons at a time.

entry: 乍看之下，它似乎不产奶。细看才发现，每根羽毛末端，都有极缓慢的细流，供它长途飞行、辛苦跋涉后补充水分。
author: sk372
source: At first glance, it appears to lack milk. Close inspection reveals an extremely slow trickle at the end of each feather, allowing it to hydrate itself after long or arduous flights.

entry: 它们常抱着一大罐奶四处跑，在面包店和杂货店寻找最适合配奶的饼干。
author: pankiwi
source: They're usually seen running around with a large jar of milk, searching bakeries and grocery stores for the perfect cookie for their milk.

entry: POKENAME温顺友善，农场里常与大奶罐同族一同饲养。产出的奶，甜味较淡，也比普通奶更不易让人发胖。
author: sk372
source: Docile and friendly, POKENAME are a common sight on farms alongside their Miltank brethren. The milk it produces is a less sweet and less fattening alternative to the usual fare.

entry: 个头矮、四肢软，拳头总没它想象得有力。为了弥补，便学着在训练与战斗中，连角和尾巴也一起使上。
author: sk372
source: With a short stature and soft limbs, it does not pack as much of a punch as it would like to. To compensate, it learned to incorporate its horn and tail into its training and fighting style.

entry: 它会寻找内心受伤的人，温柔安慰。产出的热奶，还是帮助入眠的好东西。
author: Seggule
source: It seeks out people who are suffering emotionally and comforts them. The warm milk it produces is a great sleep remedy.

entry: 变色本领还在，如今却不随情绪或伪装而变，而是显示奶储得多少。急需挤奶的POKENAME，会红得惊人。
author: sk372
source: Its color-changing ability remains intact, but instead of changing with its emotions or for camouflage, it represents its milk levels. POKENAME in desperate need of milking turn a violent shade of red.

entry: 它不断从双臂喷奶，借反冲向后飞。一旦奶用尽，便摔落地面，只得再补充。
author: Seggule
source: It propels itself backwards by constantly blasting milk from its arms. Once it runs out of milk, it crashes to the ground and has to recharge.

entry: 传说，它深夜潜入卧房，用奶带来噩梦。乳糖不耐受的人，尤其是它优先挑选的目标。
author: Seggule
source: Legends say that it enters bedrooms late at night to give people milk-induced nightmares. Lactose intolerant people are considered high priority targets.

entry: 每小时产奶5加仑，尾巴最多能储900加仑。每周一次，它把奶倒进地上的洞里，积成一片奶湖。
author: Seggule
source: It produces 5 gallons of milk an hour and can store up to 900 gallons in its tail. Once a week, it disposes the milk into a hole in the ground, creating a lake of milk.

entry: 棺内之物，都浸在发酵乳中保存。曾有一伙行迹可疑的家伙，从通风口潜入博物馆，偷走一具空的POKENAME棺材。
author: Seggule
source: The contents within its coffin are preserved in fermented milk. An empty POKENAME coffin was once stolen from a museum by a suspicious crew who entered through the vents.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME朝来犯者喷出滚烫的奶，造成严重灼伤。加热速度如此快，POKENAME在厨房里，也很能帮忙。
author: Mistymagius
source: When in danger, POKENAME sprays scalding-hot milk on its attackers, causing severe burns. Due to how fast it can heat up its milk, POKENAME are quite helpful in cooking.

entry: POKENAME甲壳下有许多乳腺，能借尖刺把奶喷向敌人。随着POKENAME不断滚动，奶也渐渐搅成浓厚奶油。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME has multiple milk glands underneath its carapace which it will spray at its attacker through its spines. As POKENAME rolls around, the milk eventually turns into a rich cream.

entry: 遥远地区，许多畅销乳制品都用POKENAME作吉祥物。广告里，它总从贪心的拉达坏蛋手中夺回乳品，再分给饥饿的孩子。
author: sk372
source: In a distant region, POKENAME is used as the mascot for a number of popular dairy products. Commercials tend to depict it liberating the products from a greedy Raticate villain before sharing it with hungry children.

entry: 喝下POKENAME的奶，就会病态地想堆沙堡。受害者会一直堆下去，直到死亡。
author: theradrad
source: When someone drinks POKENAME's milk, they gain an unhealthy urge to build a sand castle. The victim will continue to build sand castles until death.

entry: 它每天产下惊人的奶量，再排去大部分水分，封存在体内。储下的数吨炼乳，能保存数千年。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: It produces incredible quantities of milk each day, which it then preserves inside its body by expelling most of its water. The tons of condensed milk it stores can last for thousands of years.

entry: POKENAME产的奶酪十分美味，滋味却深受它的心情影响。哪家农场的奶酪格外好吃，饲养者的本领，也格外受人敬重。
author: howlingstarr
source: POKENAME are known for producing delicious cheese, the flavor of which is heavily affected by the fusion's happiness. Farmers selling particularly delectable cheeses are held in high regard for their practice.

entry: POKENAME是最早期的融合尝试之一。科学家想让大奶罐学会挖洞，结果却出了可怕的差错。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME was one of the earliest attempts of fusion. Scientists tried to give Miltank the ability to dig, but it went horribly wrong.

entry: 它每天能产超过五加仑奶。可奶是一瞬间全涌出来的，根本来不及躲开。
author: Wormspawn
source: It provides over five gallons of milk a day. However, since this deluge happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

entry: POKENAME每天喝五加仑奶，身体越来越强、速度越来越快，智力却跟着下降。
author: Sonic3&Knuckles
source: POKENAME drinks five gallons of milk daily. While this makes them grow stronger and faster, their intelligence suffers.

entry: 磁铁明明变成了乳房，小磁怪的大半本领竟仍保留着，科学家困惑不已。后来才发现，奶本身，就有极强磁性。
author: sk372
source: With its magnets now replaced with udders, science was baffled as to how it retained much of its Magnemite capabilities, until it was discovered the milk itself was very highly magnetic.

entry: 第二颗头看着像乳房，里面却有一颗正常运作的大脑。它老逼另一颗头来喝奶，执拗得让对方十分不自在。
author: sk372
source: Its second head appears to be an udder, but a functioning brain resides within. It pressures the other head to drink from it, which tends to make it uncomfortable with its insistence.

entry: 奇形怪状的石节，似乎既能产奶，也能引其他宝可梦来喝。可谁若想从乳房以外的位置尝一口，它就会发怒。
author: sk372
source: The oddly-shaped stone segments seem to be where milk is produced and a lure to attract other Pokémon to drink.  However, it turns aggressive should any try to sample from anywhere other than its udders.

entry: POKENAME特别热心，想帮助悲伤或生病的人。可急着赶去，常把旁人、物件撞翻，好心却无意惹出更多祸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely eager to help the sad or sick. In its haste to rush to someone in need, it may bowl over other people or objects, inadvertently causing more harm.

entry: POKENAME痴迷镜子，见什么就模仿什么。玩得开心，却常让旁人分不清，自己究竟在对着本尊，还是倒影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fascination with mirrors leads it to imitate whatever it sees. This playful behavior often confuses others, leaving them unsure whether they are interacting with the original or a reflection.

entry: 身体散发温暖的治愈之光，让身边的人安心。既能照亮，又能感知遇险者，它在搜救中，实在不可或缺。
author: amiel997
source: Its body radiates a warm, healing light that comforts anyone in its presence. Its radiant light and ability to sense those in distress make it invaluable in search and rescue operations.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦中心管理、维护重要设备，让用具始终洁净、好用。性情又温柔，既可靠，合作起来也令人愉快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manages and maintains essential equipment in Pokémon Centers, ensuring all tools are clean and functional. Its gentle nature makes it both a reliable helper and a joy to work with.

entry: 野生POKENAME会收留找到的弃蛋，照料到孵化。若新生的宝可梦愿意，POKENAME便将其当作亲生孩子养大。
author: Hello_I_Exist
source: Wild POKENAME has a tendency to adopt abandoned eggs it finds in the wild until they hatch. If the newly hatched Pokémon is willing, POKENAME will raise it as its own.

entry: POKENAME天生爱捉弄人，先送上营养丰富的蛋，随即一记重踢，把对方溅得满身蛋清、蛋黄。它能为这事笑上几周，再找下一个人重演。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME is a natural prankster, as it will gift its nutritious egg to someone, only to smash it with a powerful kick and cover the victim in white and yolk. It will laugh for weeks about that prank, then repeat it on someone else.

entry: 雪崩发生后，POKENAME能用波导找到被埋的宝可梦，带往安全处。始终不改的善心，让它成了严冬中的希望之光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plays a vital role during avalanches, using its aura to locate buried Pokémon and lead them to safety. Its unwavering kindness makes it a beacon of hope in harsh winter conditions.

entry: 除了幼崽，POKENAME也把受伤的小宝可梦安置在背上，保护、照料，直到恢复健康。这份无私，让它在栖息地备受喜爱。
author: lemage22
source: Alongside the young, POKENAME also takes in small injured Pokémon onto its back, often protecting and nurturing them back to health. These selfless acts make it a beloved figure in its habitat.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的蛋既营养丰富，又蕴含使人焕发活力的灵力。头顶的触角，让它能同时听见现世与灵界传来的警讯。
author: VoidDx01
source: POKENAME's eggs are said to contain both extraordinary amounts of nutrients and rejuvenating spiritual energy. The antenna on its head allows it to hear alerts from both the physical world and the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME孵育的宝可梦，都被教得坚强、友善，愿意保护他人。若有野生宝可梦还不认识你，就跟在身边护你安全，它很可能是由POKENAME养大。
author: sk372
source: Pokémon hatched by POKENAME are taught to be strong, friendly and protective. If a wild Pokémon follows you and shields you from danger before even meeting you, chances are it was raised by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的褶边、卷纹、颜色，个体各异。身上长出的真菌，能治疗多种病症，也能舒缓疼痛。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME can have varying frills, swirls and colors. Fungus grown from POKENAME can cure a variety of ills and soothe pain.

entry: POKENAME的蛋形真菌，具有抗菌作用，也能缓解疾病与疼痛。POKENAME则吸收土中的污染物等有害物质，作为食物。
author: totodile.
source: Egg-shaped fungi from POKENAME has antibacterial properties and can also be used to help with illness and pain. POKENAME feeds by taking harmful things, such as pollution, out of soil.

entry: 许多宝可梦中心，都请POKENAME帮忙，把药水等治疗用品，迅速送到训练家手中。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME are used in many Pokémon Centers to quickly ship potions and other healing items to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME用育儿袋，偷走毫无防备的宝可梦的蛋，再把蛋存成日后的点心。
author: Celio_0230
source: POKENAME use their pouches to snatch eggs from unsuspecting Pokémon. They then proceed to store the egg as a snack for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME无声游过水中，引领迷路的宝可梦抵达安全处，协助救援。发光的核心散出暖意，即使在最漆黑的深水，也令人安心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently through the water, aiding rescue efforts by guiding lost Pokémon to safety. Its glowing core radiates warmth, providing comfort even in the darkest depths.

entry: POKENAME的巨蛋要经历漫长岁月才会孵化，它便用宝石与精巧花纹，悉心装饰。可惜，许多个体遭到捕猎，被卖给王室，用来存放华丽的小饰物。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME decorates its large eggs with breathtaking jewels and patterns as they wait for the many eons needed before hatching. Unfortunately, many have been hunted and sold to royalty for storing gaudy trinkets.

entry: POKENAME待在身旁，就能让人安心，舒缓头痛，让人类与宝可梦平静下来。善良又会疗伤，是心事重重者的好伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its soothing presence to alleviate headaches, calming both Pokémon and Trainers. Its kind demeanor and healing abilities make it a welcome companion for those weighed down by cares.

entry: 覆盖全身的外壳，比大理石还硬。放入水中煮，便能释放大量养分，还可入药。
author: .izik
source: The shell that covers its body is harder than marble. When boiled, the shell releases huge amounts of nutrients and can be used as medicine.

entry: 养育幼崽时，POKENAME一颗头想严厉管教，另外两颗却忍不住宠爱纵容。POKENAME努力调和严慈，盼孩子好好长大。
author: sk372
source: When raising young, one of POKENAME's heads tries to be stern, but the other two cannot resist coddling and spoiling the child. POKENAME tries its best to strike a healthy balance to raise its young correctly.

entry: POKENAME轻柔的触碰与细微超能力波动，能舒缓偏头痛。神色宁静，藏着的精神力量却深不可测，而它只拿来帮助别人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to soothe migraines through calming touch and subtle psychic waves. Its serene expression belies the depth of its mental powers, which it uses solely to help others.

entry: POKENAME很少现身，只在猛烈雷暴时出没森林。触角吸收空气中的静电，让它长得更快，跑得也更快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, only appearing in forests during intense thunderstorms. It absorbs static in the air with its antennae, which hastens its growth as well as its speed.

entry: 它会做一柄小锤，灌入电力，敲击敌人。锤子竟沉重得连怪力、请假王也搬得吃力，POKENAME却挥得轻轻松松。
author: sk372
source: It fashions a small hammer to bludgeon foes and charge with electricity. The hammer is surprisingly heavy; even Pokémon like Machamp and Slaking strain to move it, yet POKENAME wields it with ease.

entry: POKENAME使锤出神入化，必要时还能将其掷出。据说，唯有被选中者才能举起它，因为除了POKENAME，至今没人或宝可梦能挪动分毫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields its hammer flawlessly, even throwing it as a projectile when needed. It's said only the chosen may lift the hammer, as no one human or Pokémon has been seen able to budge it aside from POKENAME.

entry: 它向天空射出雷球，爆开几秒后，便掀起狂暴雷雨。POKENAME操纵自己唤来的乌云闪电，毫不留情地电击对手。
author: sk372
source: It fires a lightning orb into the sky, which creates a furious thunderstorm in seconds after bursting. POKENAME controls the lightning within the dark clouds it creates, mercilessly frying its opponents.

entry: 体内酿出的树果汁，常被形容为有股“带电”的滋味，喝后肌肉会微微发麻。如今，已有公司拿POKENAME的果汁，调制能量饮料。
author: sk372
source: The berry juice created within is often described as having an "electrifying" taste to it, making a drinker's muscles tingle slightly afterward. Companies now sell energy drinks with POKENAME juice as an ingredient.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能召来持续一个多月的巨大雷暴。每拍一次翅膀，雷鸣的威力就足以夷平房屋。
author: Mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, it summons massive thunderstorms that can last for over a month. Every flap of its wings causes thunderclaps strong enough to flatten houses.

entry: POKENAME专攻出其不意，常从对手背后，突然施以电击。
author: Gayschlatt
source: POKENAME relies on the element of surprise to shock its opponents from behind.

entry: POKENAME的一记十万伏特，便能将高树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: Gayschlatt
source: A Thunderbolt from POKENAME can split a tall tree clean in two.

entry: 背上的尖刺发电，再将电力导向利爪。它先摩擦双爪，擦出火星示威，谁不听警告，就得迎上致命的闪电。
author: sk372
source: The spines on its back generate electricity it can draw onto its claws. It scrapes its claws together to make sparks as a threat display, before firing deadly bolts of lightning at those that don't heed the warning.

entry: 超能力脉冲在周围激起强烈冲击波，响若滚雷。随后，它会揉着疼痛的脑袋，头上又迸出几缕短促的电光。
author: sk372
source: Its psychic pulses create a powerful shockwave around it that sounds like booming thunder. It rubs its pained head afterward, emitting short crackles of lightning from it as it does so.

entry: POKENAME只在火山将喷发前出现，因此，遇见它总令人害怕。若遭到攻击，便喷出大量炽热火山灰，几分钟就能让人窒息。
author: Mistymagius
source: Sightings of POKENAME are always feared since they only appear right before a volcanic eruption. If they are attacked, they spew tons of hot ash that can suffocate anyone in minutes.

entry: 最初的POKENAME，铸成于岩浆之中。据说，它附着火山的灵魂；剑一出鞘，另一座火山便会喷发。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The first POKENAME was forged in magma. It is said that it's possessed by the spirit of a volcano, and when it unsheathes, another volcano erupts.

entry: 这只美得惊人的宝可梦，仿佛热情的化身，常出现在火山温泉旁。传说有位造物之神，守护着水火交会的温泉，有人便认为，POKENAME是祂的化身。
author: Alkazamis
source: This stunningly beautiful Pokémon embodies passion. It is typically found near volcanic hot springs. Legends tell of a creator deity that is a patron of hot springs, where fire and water meet, and some people believe POKENAME is that deity's avatar.

entry: POKENAME吃熔岩，让身体保持液态。体温一低，便黏稠得动弹不得。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on lava to keep its body in a liquid state. If its body temperature gets too low, its body becomes so viscous that it can no longer move.

entry: 曾困死于烈焰中的宝可梦，其灵魂如今仍徘徊在殒命的塔内，永远受那不息的火束缚。
author: slowforest
source: A Pokémon's spirit, once ensnared in flames, now lingers within the tower where it met its fate, forever bound to the relentless blaze.

entry: 这只宝可梦诞生于火山泥浆池。POKENAME一施展火焰攻击，体温便升高，有毒的恶臭也越发难忍。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon is born from volcanic mudpots. When using flame attacks, POKENAME's body temperature increases, and its toxic stench becomes unbearable.

entry: POKENAME守护广阔水域，不容任何污染。它平时沉静，一旦水受到玷污，POKENAME便会狂怒。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects large bodies of water from any form of pollution. Despite usually being a calm Pokémon, POKENAME will fly into a frenzy if its water becomes tainted.

entry: POKENAME非常珍爱自己的神秘手杖。一旦手杖丢失或损坏，POKENAME便会发出刺耳的悲鸣。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME cares very deeply about its mystical staff. If it were to get lost or broken, POKENAME would let out a piercing cry.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会给湖边村落带来雨水。若有人辜负信任，污染湖泊，它就唤来巨型暴雨，将整片地方淹没。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to bring rain to villages that surround its lake. If anyone betrays its trust by ruining its lakes, it will summon massive rainstorms to completely flood the area.

entry: 若有谁扰乱POKENAME栖息的湖，它便收起沉静姿态，召来溺亡者的灵魂，诅咒闯入者。
author: Glacierwing
source: If anything disturbs the lake where POKENAME lives, it will drop its calm demeanor and call on the spirits of the drowned to curse the trespasser.

entry: 它藏在幽暗深水里，一察觉污染，便跃出水面，袭向罪魁祸首，将其拖向毁灭。
author: Skymaster426
source: It hides in the dark depths of the water. If it senses that the water is polluted, it leaps out and attacks the culprit, dragging them to their fate.

entry: POKENAME深入地底，寻找优质泥土来吃。地鼠的隧道里，往往有最美味的土，因此双方常闹冲突。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs deep into the ground in order to consume high-quality soil. It often runs afoul of Diglett, whose tunnels tend to make the most delectable of dirt.

entry: 头上的班基拉斯头骨，让它觉得自己既强大，又有底气。POKENAME会扔出棍棒挑衅，连大自己几倍的宝可梦，也不放过。
author: sk372
source: The Tyranitar skull on its head makes it feel more confident and powerful. POKENAME will throw its club at others to pick fights, even with Pokémon several times its size.

entry: POKENAME定期掘洞，埋下自己生出的蛋。蛋本身虽不孵出什么，往后几个月，附近的泥土与草木，却会变得养分充盈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs holes periodically to bury the eggs it creates. Though nothing grows from the egg itself, plant life and soil surrounding it will become much more nutrient-rich in the coming months.

entry: POKENAME休息时埋进泥里，冰冷身体冻得四周寒彻。若某地一夜间突然结成冻土，几乎就能肯定，POKENAME正睡在下面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the dirt when at rest, its cold body chilling the surrounding areas. If an area develops a sudden overnight permafrost, POKENAME is almost certainly sleeping somewhere beneath.

entry: POKENAME的毒针是好用的钻头，可磨损得快，只能短时间使用。
author: AlexanderC321
source: A POKENAME stinger can be used as an effective drill, though it wears down quick, and therefore, can only be used for short amounts of time.

entry: POKENAME太重，唯有最猛烈的风暴，才能将它们吹得很远。平日所谓“飞行”，不过从沙丘顶滑翔一小段。它们的到来，被视为沙暴将至的不祥预兆。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are too heavy to be carried long distances by any but the strongest of storms, limiting their 'flights' to short glides from the top of dunes. Their arrival in a region is treated as an ill-omen as heralds of sandstorms.

entry: 它跺着脚四处走，大声叫嚷，想吓住别人。常常梦想着，等完全进化，就终于能高大又强壮。
author: sk372
source: It stomps around and makes loud cries attempting intimidation. It dreams often of the day it will evolve fully, so that it may finally be tall and powerful.

entry: 它吃亡者遗体周围的泥土。吃饱后，POKENAME便诡异地悬浮不动，直到再次饥饿。
author: bobosmith01
source: It consumes the dirt that surrounds creatures that have passed away. Once full, POKENAME floats eerily still until it is hungry once more.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的伏击猎手，几乎整天埋在沙下，或钻行岩间，通常只露出背刺。粗心的训练家踩上去，就会遭到袭击。
author: Katie
source: An ambush predator in desert environments, POKENAME spends almost all of its time buried in sand and burrowing through rock. It can usually only be spotted by its back spines, often leading to unwary Trainers being attacked for stepping on them.

entry: POKENAME是干旱之地独来独往的猎手，四处迁徙。为了找猎物、守领地，它用后腿站立行走，比四足时看得更远。
author: Katie
source: A nomadic hunter, POKENAME lives a solitary life in arid environments. To help them find prey and to guard their territory, they move about on their hind legs, granting a better view of their surroundings than if they were quadrupedal.

entry: 它把捡来的闪亮硬币，藏进特地挖好的地下秘藏。谁靠近宝藏，就会遭到又咬又抓。
author: sk372
source: It buries the shiny coins it collects in special underground stashes it digs. It will bite and scratch at anything it sees standing too close to its treasure spots.

entry: POKENAME浑身披着坚硬石刺，却只在与同族争夺领地时，用来保卫自己。荒原上，它们的咆哮能传出几英里。
author: Katie
source: Covered in hard stone spines, POKENAME uses these spines solely to defend itself in territorial conflicts with other members of its own species. Their roar can travel for miles through the wastelands in which they live.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: Katie
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: Katie
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: 只要时间足够，POKENAME连最硬的基岩也能钻穿。洞穴深入之处，早已超过其他宝可梦能够生存的范围。
author: Staghorn
source: Given enough time, a POKENAME can dig through even the hardest of bedrock. Its burrows stretch past the point where any other Pokémon can survive.

entry: 体内的毒液，唯有它坚不可摧的鳞片，才抵挡得住。一旦透过皮肤渗出，连坚石也能轻易蚀穿。
author: useless
source: Its impenetrable scales are the only material known to resist the toxins that reside within. When it exudes its venom through its skin it can easily cut through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME用钻石般的利爪攀爬，沿峡谷岩壁开凿洞穴。飘扬的长毛却粗硬锐利，如同玻璃纤维。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME use their diamond-like talons to climb and dig burrows in the sides of canyon walls. Their long, flowing hair is incredibly coarse and sharp, similar to fiberglass.

entry: POKENAME栖身于高峻山岭上的古代遗迹。神话里，它曾守护财宝，也曾劫走公主。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME resides in ancient ruins on high, steep mountains. According to myth, it used to protect treasures and kidnap princesses.

entry: POKENAME是荒原顶级强者，巡行家园，确信无人敢与自己为敌。它会凶猛追逐领地中的一切，研究行为的学者，可得格外谨慎。
author: Katie
source: An apex Pokémon, POKENAME stalks its wasteland home in the certainty that there is nothing that can challenge it. Pokémon researchers trying to learn its behaviors need to remain wary as it aggressively chases down anything in its territory.

entry: 翅膀上坚韧的厚皮，让POKENAME几乎无论什么环境，都能飞行。它们常在山巅凿洞筑巢，再凶狠地守住。
author: entomoxie
source: With the tough hide on their wings, POKENAME can fly in nearly any environment. They usually make their nests in mountaintops, carving a cave just for them and guarding it fiercely.

entry: POKENAME由一层层松散的粗皮组成。究竟如何维持身体不散，尚无人知晓。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is made up of loose layers of rough skin. How it holds itself together is unknown.

entry: POKENAME体内填满了附近的沙。若周围没有沙，就会撕碎身边物体，自己造些出来。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body is filled with sand from the environment. If there is none nearby, it'll tear up the matter around it to make some.

entry: POKENAME护领地护得厉害，常在巨石上磨爪，留下记号警告闯入者。登山者最好留意爪痕，免得无意撞见它。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. They often sharpen their claws on large boulders to mark its domain to intruders. Hikers are warned to keep an eye out for scratched boulders to avoid unintended encounters with this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能掀起倾盆暴雨与毁灭性的漩涡。可脑袋太小，这份潜能，始终没法充分发挥。
author: princess_lucina
source: POKENAME has the power to create torrential storms and devastating whirlpools. However, its small brain prevents this Pokémon from reaching its full potential.

entry: 进化完全后，POKENAME终于能尽情施展力量。可失控的怒火也充满全身，让训练家很难在战斗中，将它驾驭。
author: princess_lucina
source: Now fully evolved, POKENAME can use its powers to its fullest extent. However, now the Pokémon is filled with uncontrollable rage, making it hard for Trainers to rein it in and fully control it in battle.

entry: 这种宝可梦色彩绚丽，谁敲得响它最爱的玩具鼓，它便热切靠近。赢得信任与尊重后，它还会载你飞翔，环游世界。
author: Jackster
source: A brilliantly-colored Pokémon which will eagerly approach any Trainer that manages to play its favorite toy drum. This magnificent creature will carry you around as it flies across the globe, but only once you earn its trust and respect.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME，只能掀起时速12英里的风。它很容易受影响，有时还会用超能力，重复听来的人类话语。
author: princess_lucina
source: As a youngling, POKENAME is only capable of blowing gusts of wind at 12 mph. It is very impressionable, and it sometimes uses its psychic powers to repeat words it hears from humans.

entry: POKENAME只在远海的毁灭性风暴中现身。有人相信，看见它，就意味着附近的水手将遭大难。
author: Marvin the Marrow Muncher
source: Only seen during devastating storms on the open seas, some believe a sighting of POKENAME to mean doom for nearby sailors.

entry: POKENAME常沉稳又慈爱，喜欢照顾、庇护别人。若受照料的孩子开始胡闹，POKENAME便会严肃告诫，及时纠正。
author: MileySakiko
source: POKENAME are often stoic and matronly, known for their tendency to take others under their wing. If their charge begins to act out, POKENAME are swift to correct this poor behavior with a stern warning.

entry: 它封闭了心灵，受威胁便放出黑暗风暴。融合强化了POKENAME的伪装本领，让它常能趁自己唤来的恐怖风暴，悄然出击。
author: princess_lucina
source: Its heart has been closed shut, and it unleashes dark storms whenever threatened. POKENAME's ability to camouflage itself has been heightened by fusing, as it often strikes during the terrible storms it creates.

entry: 体形与外貌，让它常被误认成毛绒玩具。拥有掀起风暴的能力，POKENAME便用伪装，躲着人类。
author: princess_lucina
source: It's often mistaken for a plush toy, given its size and appearance. Because of the storm-causing powers it is capable of, POKENAME tries to hide from humans through the use of camouflage.

entry: POKENAME的第二颗头，能喷出破坏力惊人的飓风，却也自有主见，让主体时刻费力，才能将它管住。
author: princess_lucina
source: POKENAME's second head is capable of spewing destructive, hurricane force winds. It also has a mind of its own, so the main body is constantly struggling to keep the second head in check.

entry: 身体与超能力气泡，都已发育完全。身体没大多少，气泡却膨胀得惊人。如今苏醒的POKENAME，能同时凭力量与智慧，击倒敌人。
author: princess_lucina
source: This Pokémon and its psychic bubble have fully developed, and while its body hasn't grown much bigger, the bubble has grown dramatically. Now that POKENAME is awake, it can strike down its foes with both physical and intellectual might.

entry: POKENAME仍像个婴儿，安睡在纯超能力形成的气泡中。谁若惊扰它的梦，迎来的便是难以估量的毁灭之力。
author: princess_lucina
source: POKENAME rests in an infantile state within its bubble made of pure psychic energy. Should this Pokémon be disturbed from its slumber, untold destructive power awaits to strike down the victim.

entry: POKENAME不断成长，力量也随之增强。用来自卫的超能力气泡，渐渐长出翼状附肢，向内收拢，仿佛母亲怀抱孩子。
author: princess_lucina
source: As POKENAME develops, so too does its powers. The psychic bubble the Pokémon created to defend itself has grown wing-like appendages and has folded against it like a mother cradling her child.

entry: 狂风与雷云裹住身体，双翼一拍，便一同翻涌。至今，无人能穿透这片暴风，看清里面真正的模样。
author: sk372
source: Its body is wrapped by violent winds and crackling storm clouds, surging with every flap of its wings. None yet have managed to pierce the maelstrom and see what its body truly looks like beneath.

entry: 这只宝可梦把电力收集在背上的种子里，充电时便会微微发亮。它用尾巴播下的种子，在雷雨中反而长得更旺。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon gathers electricity in the bulb on its back, which glows faintly when charged. It uses its tail to sow seeds that grow more fertile under thunderstorms.

entry: 能量不停积在脸颊，越积越不稳定。哪怕轻轻一震，也可能引发猛烈爆炸，靠近POKENAME，实在危险。
author: moga6
source: It constantly stores energy in its cheeks, and the more it stores, the more volatile it becomes. A simple shock can trigger a violent explosion, making POKENAME dangerous to approach.

entry: POKENAME体内蓄着大量电力，玩闹时会掀起电涌。有时放出多余能量，连附近城市都被弄得停电。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME stores a lot of electricity in its body. Its playful behavior can cause power surges, sometimes leading to blackouts in nearby cities when it releases extra energy.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞驰，沿途撒下带电花粉，让植物与宝可梦精神一振。POKENAME双翼迸出的电火花，也能拿来御敌。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME can be seen zipping through the air, leaving trails of electrified pollen that energize plants and Pokémon. POKENAME's wings spark with electric currents, which can be used for self-defense.

entry: POKENAME的电力很强，会轻微扰乱附近的供电。暴风雨中，它还会吸收多余电能，免得雷电伤人。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME's electricity is strong enough to cause small electrical disruptions around it. During storms, it often collects extra energy to prevent dangerous lightning from causing harm.

entry: 等待进化时，POKENAME把电力积在体内。外表虽静，内部能量却让细小火花，不时闪动。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its body while it waits to evolve. Its stillness may seem calm, but the energy inside causes small electric sparks to flicker.

entry: POKENAME振翅飞行，电流在翼间嗡鸣。它用毒针护巢，再施电击，赶走靠得太近的家伙。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME flies with electricity buzzing in its wings. It uses its venomous stingers to protect its nest and sends electric shocks to scare off anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶片散着安神香气，又像太阳能板，吸收日光。POKENAME借此为自己充电，想玩时，还会迸出小火花。
author: moga6
source: The leaf on POKENAME's back gives off a calming scent and absorbs sunlight like a solar panel. POKENAME uses this energy to charge itself, often creating small electric sparks when it's feeling playful.

entry: POKENAME在星空下飞行，吸收星光，转化为电力，再用来施展强劲的电击。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME flies under the stars, using the light to store energy. It absorbs starlight to generate electricity, which it then uses for its strong electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME以角吸引、储存电力，也靠角引导电流。
author: CodeWolfie
source: POKENAME use their horn to attract, store, and channel electricity.

entry: POKENAME跳来跳去，每一跳，都把能量蓄进尾巴。在水边玩耍时，尾巴闪得明亮；POKENAME最爱炫耀这些光，逗朋友开心。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME bounces around, storing energy in its tail with every jump. When it plays near water, its tail flashes brightly. POKENAME loves to entertain its friends by showing off these sparkling lights.

entry: 它挥舞的藤蔓带着电，能帮园丁清除顽固的杂草，因此十分受欢迎。会发光的花苞，也常为迷路的旅人引路。
author: jaminmcready
source: The vines it wields are electrically charged, making it a favorite helper for gardeners clearing stubborn weeds. Its glowing bulb is often used to guide lost hikers.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的储电脸颊，会泛起奇异的暗光花纹。有人认为，它是在模仿星座。可试着弄懂自身力量时，它也常把自己电着。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's electrical cheeks glow faintly with odd patterns at night, which some believe are attempts to mimic constellations. It often shocks itself while trying to understand its own power.

entry: POKENAME静静待在树上进食，把电力存入脸颊。若遭打扰，便落向地面，爆出猛烈电击，自卫御敌。
author: moga6
source: While feeding in the trees, POKENAME stays calm, storing energy in its cheeks. If disturbed, it falls to the ground and discharges a powerful electric blast as a defense mechanism.

entry: 它把电囊蓄满，再摆出凶脸，赶走别人。可一见朋友，POKENAME就立刻温柔下来；兴奋或紧张时，脸颊便电光闪烁。
author: moga6
source: It charges its electric sacs and displays a menacing face to drive others away, but POKENAME quickly softens when it finds a friend. Its cheeks spark when it's excited or nervous.

entry: POKENAME飞行时用翅膀发电，危险临近，便尖叫着提醒其他宝可梦。单只虽胆小，成群的POKENAME，却危险得很。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME uses its wings during flight to generate electricity and its sharp cry to warn other Pokémons whenever danger is near. Alone, it is cowardly, but beware of a flock of POKENAME as they are dangerous.

entry: 像皮卡丘用脸颊存电一样，POKENAME用尾巴储存电力。尾巴里还装着带电树果，供它食用。
author: pankiwi
source: It stores electricity in its tail, similarly to how Pikachu uses its cheeks. Their tails also hold electrically charged berries that POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，技巧高超。战斗中，善于与同伴配合，靠速度与火焰攻击，接连快打，压倒敌人。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME is a fast and skilled Pokémon. It works well with others in battle, using its speed and fiery attacks to overwhelm opponents with quick strikes.

entry: POKENAME雄伟的鹿角，如同避雷针，把吸来的能量传入脸颊。一受惊便猛然放电，让误认它是惊角鹿的人，吓一大跳。
author: moga6
source: The majestic antlers of POKENAME act as a lightning rod, sending absorbed energy to its cheeks. When startled, it releases this power, surprising those who mistake it for Stantler.

entry: POKENAME以尾巴挥出电火花，边走边画出独特图样。光痕留在身后，每一道，都展现着力量与巧思。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME uses its tail to paint with sparks, creating unique patterns as it moves. Its electric art leaves behind glowing marks, each one a masterpiece of power and creativity.

entry: 它贪吃得很，总花许多时间找食物。POKENAME不吃时，就把能量蓄在脸颊；饱餐后再猛烈放电，电到附近的一切。
author: moga6
source: It loves eating and spends a lot of time looking for food. When POKENAME is not eating, it stores energy in its cheeks. After a big meal, it releases electrical bursts that can shock anything nearby.

entry: 它先电击敌人，拖慢行动，再用毒角刺下。POKENAME虽尽量避免争斗，受威胁时，却也有力自保。
author: moga6
source: It zaps enemies to slow them down before delivering a toxic sting with its horn. POKENAME avoids fights when possible but can defend itself effectively when threatened.

entry: 农民借它花朵中储存的电力，驱动偏远地区的机器。据说，它施加的电刺激，还能提高作物收成。
author: jaminmcready
source: The electricity stored in its flower is harnessed by farmers to power machinery in remote areas. Its presence is said to boost crop yields through electrical stimulation.

entry: POKENAME警觉得很，连最细小的声音都听得见。它默默蓄电，随时准备应对危险。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME is very alert and can hear even the smallest sounds. It quietly stores electricity, ready to react to any danger that comes its way.

entry: 和皮卡丘不同，POKENAME即使被摸到尾巴，也不慌不忙。体形更大、力量更强，让POKENAME不再把这种接触，当作威胁。
author: @over9001
source: Unlike Pikachu, POKENAME remains undisturbed even when its tail is touched. This is because POKENAME doesn't see this action as a threat anymore, due to its increased size and power.

entry: 脸颊中的能量积得太多，六条尾巴便愈发灼热。POKENAME蓄势待发，接下来的一招，不是电击，就是大字爆炎。
author: moga6
source: It stores energy in its cheeks, and when it builds up too much, the heat in its six tails increases. POKENAME then becomes ready to strike, with its next attack being either an electric shock or a Fire Blast.

entry: 在妖精之力的帮助下，皮丘学会控制电力，也与附在自己身上的谜拟Ｑ成了朋友。这份新结下的羁绊，促使它进化成POKENAME。
author: Adoster
source: After using its fairy powers to help control its electricity, Pichu becomes friends with the Mimikyu possessing it. This newfound bond causes it to evolve into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME既能在脸颊蓄电，也能从双拳打出强劲的能量。恐惧或悲伤时，波导变得更强，向附近宝可梦发出警讯。
author: moga6
source: While electricity is stored in its cheeks, POKENAME can also unleash powerful bursts from its fists. Its aura grows stronger when it feels fear or sadness, acting as a warning to nearby Pokémon.

entry: 它用幻术扮成其他宝可梦，就算站在人前，也能藏起自己。受威胁时，POKENAME才露出真身，从脸颊放出电击。
author: moga6
source: It hides in plain sight by cloaking itself in illusions of other Pokémon. When threatened, POKENAME reveals its true form and unleashes electric attacks from its cheeks.

entry: POKENAME用一阵阵超声波，在黑暗中辨路，轻易找出障碍。受威胁时，便释放红颊蓄着的能量，迸出夺目电光。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME navigates through darkness using bursts of ultrasonic waves, easily detecting obstacles. When threatened, it releases a blinding electric flash from the energy stored in its red cheeks.

entry: 电流贯穿POKENAME的铠甲身体，每一节都带着电。高速旋转，既能护身，也会产生静电场。
author: moga6
source: Electricity courses through POKENAME's armored body, making each segment a live wire. Its rapid rotations not only protect it but also generate a static field.

entry: 它埋进土中，只露出叶子，既躲过天敌，也让电流导入地面。如此一来，安然休息时，电力便不至于危险地积聚。
author: moga6
source: It hides underground with only its leaves visible to ground itself and stay hidden from predators. This tactic prevents dangerous electricity buildup while it rests peacefully.

entry: POKENAME脸颊蓄着电，以优雅舞步作战。节奏分明的踏步，迸出强力，先震住敌人，再以火焰出击。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks and uses elegant dances to attack. Its rhythmic steps unleash powerful attacks, stunning opponents before striking them with flames.

entry: POKENAME的花释放毒香，让人头晕、迷乱。电击能麻痹猎物，香气则搅乱它们的记忆与思绪。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME releases a toxic scent from its flower that causes dizziness and confusion. Its electric shocks can paralyze prey, and the scent leaves them with blurry memories and disoriented thoughts.

entry: POKENAME的电力，能让设备短路，也能让物品发亮。它爱出风头，常电一下身边物件，吸引训练家注意，炫耀本领。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME uses its electric powers to short-circuit devices or make things glow. It loves attention and will often zap objects to get the notice of nearby Trainers, showing off its skills.

entry: 它大多一脸迷糊，想不起自己会用电。可一遇险，POKENAME便下意识地从脸颊放电，保护自己。
author: moga6
source: It looks confused most of the time, unable to remember its electrical abilities. However, when in danger, POKENAME unknowingly discharges electricity from its cheeks to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME毛发带电，还燃着小小火苗。它能凭气味辨别情绪，爆出能量，保护朋友、迎击威胁。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME's fur is charged with electricity and emits small flames. It can sense emotions through smell, reacting with bursts of energy to protect friends or face threats.

entry: 滑溜的皮肤，让它在水中与陆地都能顺畅滑行。POKENAME把电力存于脸颊，迅疾爆发，击倒靠得太近的敌人。
author: moga6
source: It can glide easily through water and land with its slippery skin. POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks, releasing quick, powerful bursts to defeat enemies that get too close.

entry: POKENAME把电能与格斗技巧结合，威力惊人。强壮四肢配上电力，能做出难以置信的壮举，战斗时尤其常用闪电加持的重拳。
author: moga6
source: Combining electrical energy with fighting skills, POKENAME is a powerhouse. Its strong limbs and electric charges allow it to perform stunning feats of strength, often using lightning-boosted punches in battle.

entry: POKENAME借电力强化攻击，口中还渗出能溶解铁的毒液。谁靠得太近，它也会放电阻住，不让逃跑。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME uses electricity to power its attacks and leaks a poisonous fluid from its mouth that can melt iron. It also sends out electric shocks to stop anything that gets too close from escaping.

entry: POKENAME生出强磁场，远远吸来金属。它也用电力给附近物件充能，让物件带着静电，嗡嗡作响。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME creates strong magnetic fields to pull metal objects from afar. It uses its electric energy to charge nearby items, making them hum with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME释放高频电波，改变周围温度。储电囊供给能量，让它既能维持强磁场，又能同时升温。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME generates high-frequency radio waves that alter the temperature around it. Its electricity-storing sacs provide energy, allowing it to maintain a strong magnetic field and increase the temperature at the same time.

entry: POKENAME躲在插座里，拿电击捉弄靠近的人。电若不设法放掉，积得太多，就会失控。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide inside electrical sockets, playfully shocking anyone that comes near. Its electricity will grow out of control if it doesn't discharge it somehow.

entry: POKENAME每挥一次刃臂，身后便留下一道彩虹。激战过后，那片绚烂色彩，据说美得令人屏息。
author: sk372
source: With every swing of its bladed arms, POKENAME leaves a rainbow trail behind. The aftermath of especially intense battles is said to be a truly breathtaking marvel of color.

entry: POKENAME看似幼小，几乎不动，体内却蕴着庞大力量。它极少释放，偶尔一现，反倒更加惊人。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite seeming small and immobile, a typical POKENAME contains a large amount of power within. It rarely releases that power, but that just makes the rare displays more astounding when they do occur.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“太阳公主”。传说，一株风滚草，在它手中，便能长成沙漠里的绿洲。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is often referred to as "The Princess of the Sun". Legends say that it can grow a desert oasis from a single tumbleweed.

entry: POKENAME从不真正死去，会忠诚侍奉主人，直到最后。可即使殒命后能够重生，它依然是濒危物种。
author: TheNebulaMage
source: POKENAME never truly dies and will loyally serve its master until the end. It remains an endangered species despite its ability to be reborn upon demise.

entry: POKENAME总在雨后现身，伴着彩虹而来。能遇见它们，便是好运的征兆。
author: Pokebio
source: POKENAME always come out after the rain. They bring rainbows along with them and seeing them is a sign of good fortune.

entry: 传说，POKENAME一醒来，某处便会燃起火。战斗中，它会焚烧虹色之羽，吸取其中的力量。
author: donutsbg
source: According to legend, if POKENAME awakens, a fire will light somewhere. In battle, it burns a Rainbow Wing to absorb its power.

entry: 它穿梭时间，仿佛鱼儿游水，只在无人能看见的时刻停留，是历来最难找的宝可梦之一。
author: Ozydamians
source: It flits through time like a fish swims through water. It pauses in moments where nobody is around to see it, making it one of the hardest to find Pokémon in history.

entry: POKENAME本身，就是一个自成一体的悖论。头顶绽放的花中，满溢着凝聚的时间能量。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a self-contained paradox. The blooming flower on its head is overflowing with concentrated temporal energy.

entry: 紧张时，它便变不好身。通常是耳朵仍留着原样，偶尔连蓝色的身体，也变不掉。
author: .izik
source: When it gets anxious, it is unable to transform properly. In most cases its ears will stay the same, but on rare occasions it will also stay blue.

entry: 一点小不顺心，都能让它哭起来。POKENAME的泪水释放毒素，飘入空气，闻到的人也会泪流不止。
author: .izik
source: It will begin to cry at even the slightest inconvenience. POKENAME's tears release a toxin into the air that will cause a person to weep uncontrollably.

entry: 肚子饿时，它一次将最多十颗树果放进水洼。攒得够多，再一起捣碎，拌成可口的糊。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, this Pokémon will place up to ten berries into a puddle at a time. Once it has enough berries, it will smash them within the puddle to create a delicious paste.

entry: POKENAME靠尾巴推动，像直升机一样飞行。它不停旋转、拐弯，眼中的世界总倒着，却玩得不亦乐乎。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME helicopters through the air, propelled by its tail. It is constantly spinning or swerving and views the whole world upside down; while it does this it is having the time of its life.

entry: POKENAME吃下各种植物，在胃里调出色素。口中喷出的水，便随吃过的植物，变换颜色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats a variety of different plants in order to create pigments within its stomach. Should it shoot water from its mouth, it will alter the color based on what it has consumed.

entry: 尾球弹性极好，让它不费力就能跳得老高。有报告称，有些POKENAME一跃，竟能上到一英里多高的空中。
author: .izik
source: It can leap high with little effort due to the elasticity of the ball on its tail. There are reports of some POKENAME going over a mile into the air.

entry: 人称“爱哭鬼”的POKENAME，连走路也会难过，泪水却能作肥料。心里越受压，背上的泡状突起就越多。
author: leonian1586
source: Often called a crybaby, POKENAME's steps upset it, producing tears that act as fertilizer. The more stress it feels, the more bubbles grow on its back.

entry: 头上伸出卷曲而富弹性的尾藤，让POKENAME既能在陆上弹跳，也能灵活游泳。尖刺虽已磨平，皮肤大多时候仍十分坚韧。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can bounce on land and swim well due to the bouncy coiled tail vines coming from the head. Even though the thorns are smoothed away, their skin remains tough in most situations.

entry: 抱得太紧，皮毛便会迸出一阵火星。多余静电虽无害，却能让人的头发根根竖起。
author: .izik
source: If hugged too tightly, this Pokémon's fur will let loose a flurry of sparks. While harmless, this excess static can cause a person's hair to stand on end.

entry: POKENAME双目全盲，栖息地底洞穴，靠回声定位认路。它们常分不清洞底与水面，因此长着巨大的浮尾，万一坠水，也不至于沉下。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are completely blind and roost in underground caves, using their echolocation to navigate. They often struggle to differentiate water from cave floors, so they have large tail floats to prevent sinking if they crash.

entry: POKENAME还不太会飞，便用弹尾，把自己送离地面。遇上心怀恶意的人或宝可梦，它常会吓得僵住。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME is not very good at flying yet, so it uses its bouncy tail to get off the ground. It tends to freeze up around malicious people and Pokémon.

entry: 它会装成被自己的尾巴扎伤，好让敌人轻视。可真不小心扎到自己时，也一样哭得伤心。
author: Staghorn
source: It pretends to be harmed by its own tail so that its foes underestimate it. It cries just as hard when it pricks itself on accident.

entry: 起飞前，它总欢快地用尾巴弹三下。没别的用处，纯粹给自己打打气。
author: .izik
source: It happily bounces on its tail three times before taking flight. This behavior serves no purpose other than as a morale boost for itself.

entry: 它靠弹尾蹦跳，能跃上高空，可真要飞远，仍很吃力。
author: archserpent
source: It hops on its bouncy tail, launching itself high into the air. Despite this, it struggles to fly very far.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在乱石间，偷袭毫无防备的训练家。可鲜艳的颜色与低低窃笑，往往早就暴露了它。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME enjoy hiding amongst rocks and attacking unsuspecting Trainers. However, their bright coloration and quiet snickering tend to give them away beforehand.

entry: 看似POKENAME尾羽的东西，其实是灵巧的附肢，能极精准地摆弄物件。
author: bee4082.
source: What look like POKENAME's tail feathers are actually dextrous appendages. It uses these to manipulate objects with incredible precision.

entry: POKENAME总咧嘴笑着，捉弄高山上的旅人。可这些玩笑，有时足以酿成惨祸。POKENAME自己是否明白，尚不清楚。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME play pranks on hikers at high altitudes with a grin. Unfortunately, these pranks can spell disaster. Whether POKENAME are aware of this is unclear.

entry: 若在森林里，财物突然不见了，可能就是POKENAME干的。不过，若有幸当场抓住，它们倒会彬彬有礼地，将赃物奉还。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If you suddenly lose your belongings in a forest, a POKENAME could be to blame. If you are lucky enough to catch them in the act though, they will politely return the stolen goods back to you.

entry: POKENAME住在大树根间。有宝可梦经过，POKENAME便伸出长长的肢体，将对方拖入地下。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME can be found residing in the roots of large trees.  When Pokémon come by, POKENAME use their lengthy limbs to pull them underground.

entry: 它体内分泌的毒液，闻起来像蕉香果与黄色球果混合的气味。误食这种液体会导致麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The poison that it secretes from its body smells like a mixture of Nanab Berries and Yellow Apricorns. The fluid can cause paralysis if consumed.

entry: 带刺的触手，其实灵巧得很，抓握、推动物件，都能胜任。POKENAME就生活在丛林附近的海岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its barbed tentacles are actually quite dexterous and can be used to grip and push objects. POKENAME lives on shorelines near jungles.

entry: 它使起铲子，宛如训练有素的骑士挥舞长剑。对敌人抡下武器时，口中还会狂笑不止。
author: .izik
source: It wields its shovel like a trained knight wields a longsword. It laughs maniacally as it swings its weapon at its foe.

entry: POKENAME用其他宝可梦的骨头，调制药液。有时，也会把有益的药水，分给训练家。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME mixes brews with the bones of other Pokémon. They sometimes share beneficial potions with their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的毛看着蓬松，令人想摸。可若未经POKENAME同意就伸手，它燃起的火焰，足以将人严重烧伤。
author: Alumed
source: While the fur of POKENAME may appear fluffy and inviting, touching a POKENAME against its will may cause intense burns due to the flames it generates.

entry: POKENAME吞下迷失的亡魂，再压成绚丽的紫水晶。晶体似乎仍能与其他灵魂，产生共鸣。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes lost spirits and then compresses them into gorgeous amethyst crystals. The crystals seem to be able to resonate with other spirits.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱在林间潜行，夜里向旅人扔糖果。糖果再陈旧也无所谓，它只是喜欢扔东西。
author: pankiwi
source: Wild POKENAME like sneaking around forests, tossing candy to travelers at night. It doesn't care how stale the candy is; it just likes throwing it.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，预示着灾祸。可被收服后，POKENAME又能用敏锐的感官，保护训练家远离危险。
author: SandGuyThing
source: Encountering a POKENAME in the wild forebodes certain calamity. Captured POKENAME utilize their senses to keep their Trainer out of harm's way.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的汤，能溶掉扔进去的一切肉食。若配料得当，还能召出幽魂，替它办事。
author: DoodleDoo
source: It is said that the stew POKENAME carries on its back is able to dissolve all meat that's thrown into it. With the right ingredients, it's able to conjure ghostly apparitions that carry out its deeds.

entry: 盾牌般的脸，护住它诵念咒语、折磨来犯者。可后方防守薄弱，最终导致它灭绝。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Its shield-like face protects it while it chants incantations to torment its attacker. A weakness to attacks from behind lead to its extinction.

entry: 墓地附近，常能听见POKENAME哀哀歌唱。据说，听过的人，往后几天都会恶心、头痛，眼前幻象不断。
author: thetapemaster
source: Often found near grave sites and burial grounds, POKENAME can often be heard singing sorrowfully. It is rumored that those who have listened experience nausea, headaches, and hallucinations for days afterward.

entry: POKENAME来往于现世与来世。叫声宛如咒语，据说，听见的人便会失去灵魂。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME comes and goes between this world and the afterlife. Its cries sound like incantations, and those who hear them are said to lose their souls.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会来到醉心黑魔法的人面前。它们骗来的灵魂，被酿成神秘药液，供火焰燃烧。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME appear late at night in front of those interested in dark magic. Their flames are powered by a mystical brew of the souls they've deceived.

entry: 初学灵异之术的灵异迷，有个忠诚伙伴，就是POKENAME。它爱帮忙寻觅大锅药液的配料，自己施起法，也毫不逊色。
author: NellNast42
source: A loyal Pokémon from budding Hex Maniacs. POKENAME loves to fetch ingredients for a cauldron's brew, but is more than capable of spellcasting for itself.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会射出小礼物与彩纸，让小宝可梦开心。壳上的花纹描绘着各式节庆场面。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's blasters shoot out small gifts and confetti for small Pokémon to enjoy. The patterns on its shell depict various festive scenes.

entry: POKENAME常游荡在曾发生重大惨剧的老建筑中。若遭打扰，便手持骨制刺剑，攻击闯入者。
author: Inksans201x
source: POKENAME is said to often roam old buildings with a history of great tragedy. When disturbed, it attacks trespassers with bone rapiers.

entry: 黑暗鸟手下若没收集到足够多的闪亮物品，就会遭POKENAME殴打。它们偷来的食物，则会分给幼鸟。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME will attack its Murbird goons if they fail to gather enough shiny objects. They distribute their stolen food to their young.

entry: POKENAME披着暗羽，周身火焰摇曳，模样骇人。它支配黑夜，强劲双翼掀起火热疾风，灼烧敌人，震慑对手。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a menacing figure cloaked in dark feathers and surrounded by flickering flames. This fierce Pokémon commands the night, using its powerful wings to unleash fiery gusts that scorch foes and intimidate rivals.

entry: 在传说受诅咒的夜晚，POKENAME会率领黑暗剑鞘大军，诅咒整座城镇。慢慢吞尽居民的生命力，便再转往下一处。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: On nights said to be cursed, POKENAME leads an army of Muredge to curse an entire town. They slowly consume their life force and eventually move onto the next.

entry: POKENAME竭力装得可爱亲人，诱人靠近。不过，这只是狡计：不付出什么，就换来食物、住处与悉心照料。养熟后，它便懒散又固执。
author: SonTyp
source: A POKENAME does its best to appear cute and approachable to lure humans closer. This is, however, just a devious scheme to gain food, shelter and attentive care for little return.  Once domesticated, this Pokémon becomes lazy and stubborn.

entry: POKENAME对谁都凶，连同族也不放过。自己却大多偷懒，让手下替它干尽坏事。
author: galactak
source: POKENAME is extremely agressive towards everyone, even inside its own clan. It slacks off most of the time, letting its mob do its malicious bidding.

entry: POKENAME用单脚摇摆，每秒都变换方向，平衡却丝毫不乱，边动还边发出咔嗒声。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME swings on one foot, changing direction every second, never losing its balance. It makes clicking noises as it does so.

entry: 岩石般的沉重身体，让它飞不了太久。若淋了雨，石质外表便会覆上一层薄泥。
author: .izik
source: Due to its heavy rock-like body, it cannot fly for long periods of time. If caught in the rain, a thin film of mud will cover its stony outer layer.

entry: POKENAME移动时，树皮状的外表会剥落细小石片。碎片锋利，让天敌望而却步，也让它在栖息地安然度日。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds tiny stone splinters from its bark-like exterior as it moves. These sharp fragments often discourage predators, ensuring it remains undisturbed in its habitat.

entry: POKENAME贴在崖壁，靠小巧身形躲避天敌。它会凿出缝隙，安心歇息，让大宝可梦够不着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to cliffsides, using its small size to hide from predators. It is known to carve out crevices where it can rest safely away from the reach of larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME采来大量甜果，带回巢里吃。若有野生宝可梦靠近，就赶紧扔下大半，只留一两个果子，站着不动，装成树。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME collect tons of sweet fruit and bring them back to their den to eat. However, if they are approached by a wild Pokémon, they will drop what they are holding except one or two pieces of fruit and try to imitate a tree, standing still.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体外，有层薄炭粉，能帮它在寒地保暖。受威胁时，还能喷出小团烟灰，遮掩着逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rocky body is coated in a thin layer of charcoal dust, which it uses to stay warm in colder environments. When threatened, it releases small puffs of soot to create cover and escape.

entry: POKENAME活跃在苔原，钻进雪堆下躲寒。岩石身体里蓄着热，即使天寒地冻，也能自在活动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in the tundra, where it burrows beneath snowdrifts to avoid the cold. It stores warmth in its rocky frame, allowing it to remain active even in freezing temperatures.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把秋海棠摆在巢边，标记领地，还用心照料这些花，常随心情，重新排列花瓣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys arranging begonias around its nest, using the flowers to mark its territory. It takes great care in maintaining these displays, often rearranging petals to suit its mood.

entry: 心烦时，它会经石质鹿角引导力量，放出一阵阵超能力波。
author: .izik
source: When it gets upset it will unleash waves of psychic energy. It channels its power through its stone antlers.

entry: 战斗中，野生POKENAME常一动不动，试着模仿从父母身上学来的本领。可要把能量反送给敌人，它们还不熟练。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, wild POKENAME often stay still, trying to mimic what they have learned from their parents. They are not yet skilled at channeling energy back at the foe, however.

entry: 在茂密丛林里，POKENAME装成植物，躲避危险。只要看见天敌，几个小时都能纹丝不动。
author: .izik
source: In dense jungles, POKENAME mimics plants to avoid danger. It will stay motionless for hours if it sees a predator.

entry: 这只宝可梦喜欢独处，在沼泽伪装成草木。为了不被发现，好几天都能不动一下。
author: leonian1586
source: This Pokémon prefers solitude, disguising itself as greenery in swampy terrain. It remains motionless for days to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME游荡峡谷，捡些小石，装饰身体。贪玩的它，常让走在蜿蜒山路上的旅人，遇上意外的惊喜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders through canyons, gathering small stones to decorate its body. Its playful nature often leads to surprise encounters with travelers exploring the winding paths.

entry: 它长久躺在山巅，吸足太阳的热，再将暖意化为火焰，发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: It lounges on mountaintops for long periods to absorb the sun's heat. It will channel this warmth into its fire-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME在多岩的群山生活，吸收矿物，强化身体。它伪装在巨石之间，除非受扰，否则一动不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in rocky mountains, where it absorbs minerals to harden its body. It camouflages itself among boulders, remaining motionless until disturbed.

entry: POKENAME的唾液含着矿物，能强化身体，抵御恶劣天气。它常舔遍全身，让外皮始终坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva contains minerals that strengthen its body, making it resilient against harsh weather. It frequently licks its own body, ensuring that it remains tough and durable.

entry: 身体伸出的肢体，看着像树枝，其实是感应器，能察觉热量，也能预测附近的天气变化。
author: .izik
source: Despite looking like branches, the limbs coming off of its body act as antennae. The limbs can sense heat and predict weather patterns in its immediate area.

entry: POKENAME吃富饶的矿石，慢慢融入岩质外壳。年深日久，身体便变得致密而闪亮，映出所吃矿物的特征。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on rich ore deposits, slowly incorporating these minerals into its rocky exterior. Over time, its body becomes a dense, glittering structure that reflects the materials it consumes.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，借圆珠施展超能力，让路过的人与宝可梦注意不到自己。唯有深夜才活动，将人的梦存进圆珠，留待日后享用。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand perfectly still, channeling their psychic powers through their orbs to prevent passing people or Pokémon from noticing them. They only move late at night, storing people's dreams in their orbs to feast on later.

entry: POKENAME在干燥处静坐，心无杂念。遇上误认它是植物的宝可梦，也会交朋友，以熏香安抚对方。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME sits still in dry environments with a clear mind. It befriends Pokémon that mistake it for plant life and soothes them with its incense.

entry: POKENAME爪上的玩偶，常被用来威吓敌人。研究者仍不敢肯定，POKENAME释放的超能力，究竟有没有让玩偶也生出意识。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: The puppets on the claws of POKENAME are often used in an intimidation tactic. Researchers are still not entirely sure that the psychic energy POKENAME emits hasn't given them consciousness.

entry: POKENAME爱炫耀抛接杂耍。看似武艺精湛，其实多半只在模仿其他宝可梦的战斗招式。
author: mahrtist
source: POKENAME loves showing off its juggling abilities. While it seems skilled in martial arts, it mostly mimics other Pokémon's fighting styles.

entry: POKENAME在夜里活动、捕猎，因为颈部皮膜带着微光，也因为它真正的脸，总藏不住兴奋。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and does most of its hunting at night. This is due to its slightly fluorescent frill pattern, and due to the fact that it struggles to keep excitement from its true face.

entry: POKENAME精通抛接杂耍，靠超能力与磁力，能让球一直悬空。训练家有时也见过，野生POKENAME认真练习整套动作。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME has mastered its juggling abilities and can use its psychic and magnetic abilities to keep the balls it has floating indefinitely. On occasion, Trainers have seen wild POKENAME practicing juggling routines.

entry: POKENAME模样亲切，常在托育中心，为孩子与幼小宝可梦表演。
author: Inksans201x
source: Thanks to its friendly appearance, POKENAME are often found in daycares performing for young children and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME被誉为舞台上的悲剧化身，演起幽暗、心碎的场景，总能直抵人心。可它们挑角色很严，只接真正感兴趣的主角。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME are described as embodiments of tragedy in the performing arts, never failing to convey the dark and heart-wrenching scenes of their portrayals. They have high standards when accepting roles, only taking lead parts that peak their interest.

entry: POKENAME被誉为舞台上的喜剧化身，每次都全情投入，逗得观众开怀。角色大多不挑，却更愿避开讽刺喜剧。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME are described as embodiments of comedy in the performing arts, never failing to make the audience laugh with their wholehearted efforts. They mostly aren't fussy about what roles they're cast in, but they prefer to avoid satirical comedies.

entry: POKENAME被誉为舞台上的喜剧化身，每次都全情投入，逗得观众开怀。角色大多不挑，却更愿避开讽刺喜剧。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME are described as embodiments of comedy in the performing arts, never failing to make the audience laugh with their wholehearted efforts. They mostly aren't fussy about what roles they're cast in, but they prefer to avoid satirical comedies.

entry: POKENAME靠敏锐听力，寻找模仿对象。一旦听见你的动静，便几乎躲不过它的模仿。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME uses its powerful ears to find targets to mime. Once it hears you, it is nearly impossible to avoid being mimicked.

entry: 与其他双首暴龙融合体不同，POKENAME的两颗头大多能和睦相处，而且十分爱同台表演。它们会配合超能力，把不同的物品抛接得眼花缭乱。
author: Mistymagius
source: Unlike other Zwelious fusions, POKENAME's two heads mostly co-operate with each other and love to perform together. They work in tandem to juggle different objects with their psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME虽没什么肢体，仍尽心模仿别人。最好多鼓励它，因为POKENAME一难过，便会不由自主地放出毒孢子。
author: @enemyphase
source: POKENAME do their best to mimic others, despite their lack of appendages. It's best to encourage this behavior, as when POKENAME get upset they can't help but release toxic spores.

entry: POKENAME用超能力与磁场，托住抛接的球。可力量并不强，年幼POKENAME尤其如此，球常常掉下来。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: POKENAME uses both its psychic energy and the magnetic field from its magnets to keep its juggling balls in the air. However, these powers can be quite weak, especially in younger POKENAME, so it often will drop balls.

entry: 进化后，多颗头带来额外磁力，让POKENAME能更好地控制杂耍。常能看见POKENAME身旁，漂着各式金属物件。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: Upon its evolution, the extra magnetic power that POKENAME gets from its multiple heads allows for more control over its juggling. It isn't uncommon to see POKENAME floating miscellaneous metallic items around itself.

entry: POKENAME爱用表演传递快乐。遇上悲伤的人，便一直跳舞，直到对方好起来。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME loves to spread joy through performance. It will dance for those who are sad until they feel better.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子里，藏着一块蛋形的石头。若它十分喜欢一个人，就会打开种子，让对方把石头取走。
author: lemage22
source: On POKENAME's back holds a bulb containing an egg-shaped stone. When POKENAME likes a person enough, it opens up said bulb and lets them take the stone.

entry: POKENAME爱收集石块，搭个窝睡觉。据说，石头的种类、形状，暗示着它将来的进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a habit of collecting stones and making nests out of them to sleep in. It's said that the type and shape of the stones hints what its future evolution will be.

entry: POKENAME散发令人安心的香气，帮助心爱的蛋成长；遇上偷蛋者，也用这香，安抚对方。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME gives off pleasant, calming scents to help its beloved egg grow. It also uses these scents to pacify those who try to steal its egg.

entry: 它先给随身石块充入少许电，再替疲惫的人与宝可梦摩擦身体。电流按摩，能舒缓、刺激酸痛的肌肉。
author: sk372
source: It charges the stone it carries with small amounts of electricity before rubbing the stone against weary people and Pokémon. This electric massage helps to soothe and stimulate sore muscles.

entry: POKENAME爱玩模仿吉利蛋、胖丁的游戏，送健康的宝可梦一块光滑蛋形石，假装“治病”，再唱摇篮曲哄睡。不过，那股香气，倒真的能让人放松。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to mimic Chansey and Jigglypuff by playing pretend: it will give perfectly healthy Pokémon smooth, egg-like stones to 'heal' them, and will sing lullabies to help them rest. It does, however, possess a genuinely relaxing aroma.

entry: POKENAME爱玩模仿吉利蛋、胖丁的游戏，送健康的宝可梦一块光滑蛋形石，假装“治病”，再唱摇篮曲哄睡。不过，那股香气，倒真的能让人放松。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to mimic Chansey and Jigglypuff by playing pretend: it will give perfectly healthy Pokémon smooth, egg-like stones to 'heal' them, and will sing lullabies to help them rest. It does, however, possess a genuinely relaxing aroma.

entry: 它们精力旺盛又调皮，什么都想拿蛋砸，见谁也想扔。因此，许多地方都不许它们进入。
author: Sottiwotti
source: They are very energetic and mischievous Pokémon. They like to throw eggs at anything and everyone, which is why they are banned from many places.

entry: 飞行时，高速拍动的双翼，发出低沉嗡鸣。身旁的人听着，便能静下心，舒缓身心的紧绷。
author: sk372
source: When it flies, the rapid flapping of its wings emits a low-frequency hum. It has a calming, soothing effect on those nearby, helping to relieve tension in mind and body.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知其他宝可梦的情绪，连一丝负面感受也十分敏感。情绪承受不住时，便尖叫起来，常把附近育幼所的小宝可梦吓一跳。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME uses its antennae to sense the emotions of other Pokémon, becoming highly sensitive to even the slightest negative feelings. When overwhelmed, it lets out a loud screech, often startling other baby Pokémon in nearby nurseries.

entry: 它收集蛋形石块，搬来搭建简易的巢。巢总在遗迹附近，选址似乎另有用意。
author: sk372
source: It gathers egg-shaped stones and carries them away to create makeshift nests. These nests are always in the vicinity of ruins, suggesting a significance to their placement.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME背着蛋形石块，据说能帮它吸收更多阳光，获得赖以生存的温暖。寒冷夜里，这些石头也是重要的能量来源。
author: lemage22
source: This young POKENAME carries egg-like stones on its back, which are said to assist the Pokémon with capturing more sunlight and provide more warmth for its survival. These stones are also a key source of energy during cold nights.

entry: POKENAME能把一缕温和的波导注入随身石块。将它赠人后，收礼者只要带在身边，便会心情安定、平和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can imbue some of its gentle aura into the stone it carries. When shared with others, those gifted the stone will feel more calm and peaceful while carrying it.

entry: POKENAME最爱钻进不同宝可梦的巢里休息，可满身尖刺，往往连蛋带屁股都扎伤。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME greatly enjoys resting in the nests of different Pokémon, but its spikes are prone to harm eggs and butts alike.

entry: POKENAME的蛋富含蛋白质。它会送给弱小的宝可梦，鼓励它们长成最出色的自己。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's eggs are packed with high amounts of protein. It will give out its eggs to weaker Pokémon to encourage them to become the best version of themselves.

entry: 它十分依恋随身的蛋形石。抱着石头就缩不进壳里，因此，为了护住心爱之物，常常弄得自己受伤。
author: sk372
source: It becomes very emotionally attached to the egg-shaped stone it carries. It cannot retreat into its shell while holding it, so it often gets hurt protecting its precious cargo.

entry: 这只宝可梦贪玩又调皮，常用静电电一下毫无防备的训练家。背上的种子储存着能量，供它尽情嬉闹、恶作剧。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon is playful and mischievous, often using static electricity to zap unsuspecting Trainers. Its bulb stores energy, which it uses to power its pranks and playful antics.

entry: POKENAME用弹性十足的肢体爬上高树，坐着等雷电劈中尾巴。有人推测，它是在保护森林。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME uses its springy limbs to climb high trees, where it sits and waits for lightning to strike its tail. Some theorize it is trying to protect the forests.

entry: 乍看不过是只大号雷丘。就算脚的模样没让人看出卡比兽血统，那份食量也瞒不过去。
author: Faelocke
source: It appears to simply be a very large Raichu at first glance. If its feet don't give away that it's part Snorlax, its appetite will.

entry: 卡比兽的性情，让POKENAME即使电囊蓄得满满，也不爱攻击。电力不足时，POKENAME便会疲倦，靠睡觉重新积蓄。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME's behavior isn't aggressive even when it has stored a lot of electricity in its pouches due to being part Snorlax. If its pouches are low on electricity, POKENAME will feel tired and might fall asleep to regather electricity.

entry: 它的毒针攻击带着11000伏电压。收服后，人们常给毒针套上橡胶帽，免遭电击。
author: SupersonicLoki
source: Its stingers are known to pack a punch of 11,000 volts when used to attack. When captured, many use rubber caps to prevent shocking.

entry: 带电的藤蔓常在工地帮忙，举起、搬动金属梁柱。它安神的嗡鸣，也让工人在压力之下，仍能专注。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon's electrified vines are employed in construction to lift and manipulate metal beams. Its calming hum helps workers stay focused in high-stress environments.

entry: 尾巴吸引着环境中奇异的信号，负荷过重便火花四溅。留下的焦痕，宛如失传文字的片段。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its tail attracts strange signals from the environment, causing it to spark violently when overloaded. These sparks leave marks that look like fragments of a forgotten writing.

entry: POKENAME特别热衷节庆，而且对这事很认真。它会向其他宝可梦派礼物，谁若调皮，就电谁一下。
author: pankiwi
source: They have a very festive nature that they take very seriously. POKENAME give out gifts to other Pokémon, but will shock anyone being naughty.

entry: 这只顽皮宝可梦在阴影中穿行，电光噼啪，满是捣蛋心思。尾巴一甩，便唤出幽魂般的幻象，迷惑敌人，再迅疾灵巧地出击。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: This playful Pokémon weaves through shadows, crackling with electric energy and mischief. With a flick of its tail, it conjures ghostly illusions to confuse opponents, striking with surprising speed and agility.

entry: 研究人员推测，在关都遥远的过去，雷丘或许曾自然呈现这种形态。为何如今再也无法自然变成这样，至今仍未查明。
author: sk372
source: Researchers theorize this form may be one Raichu took naturally in a distant past of Kanto history. It has yet to be determined why Raichu can no longer naturally take this form.

entry: 背上的花蓄满电力，嗡嗡作响，常帮乡间停转的发电机重新启动。它好心却笨拙，想帮忙时，反而总把自己电着。
author: jaminmcready
source: The flower on its back hums with stored electricity, often used to jump-start dead generators in rural areas. Its well-meaning nature is offset by its clumsiness, as it frequently zaps itself while trying to assist.

entry: POKENAME因两种不同进化石而诞生，难得一见。它在山中凿洞，让电流涌满其中，也给小型电宝可梦与地面宝可梦提供庇护。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: A result of two different evolution stones, POKENAME are spotted only on rare occasions. It burrows its caves into mountains, filling it with surges of electrical energy. This also provides shelter for smaller electric and ground Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME血脉中能流过300万伏电压，是雷丘放电电压的30倍。科学家认为，这是借了固拉多维持庞大力量的本领。
author: @over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through its veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: 几只POKENAME住在同一间屋里，往往因耗电太多而频频停电。若体内蓄得过量，臂上的灯泡就会炸裂，引起难以控制的火灾。
author: thatdanguy23
source: A house inhabited by multiple POKENAME will frequently suffer from power outages due to their heavy consumption of electricity. If it stores too much, the lightbulbs on its arms will shatter, causing uncontrollable fires.

entry: POKENAME体内能储下超过10000伏电力，因此容易带上静电。它又偏偏爱拥抱善良的训练家。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is able to store over 10,000 volts of electricity in its body, making it prone to static electricity. It also loves to hug kind Trainers.

entry: POKENAME以尾巴作避雷针，吸收电力，再奋力扑向对手，施以猛烈电击。
author: gamertag1001.
source: POKENAME uses its tail as a lightning rod to absorb electricity. It then flings itself at opponents to violently electrocute them.

entry: 别因没有臭味，就轻信它无害。身体会释放大量汞、铅与电池硫酸盐，对环境毒害极深。
author: epping_forest
source: One should not get deceived by the fact that it doesn't smell bad. Its body releases high amounts of mercury, lead, and battery sulfate, highly toxic to the environment.

entry: 鬃毛与尾巴由炽热的等离子体构成，一碰便能让对方全身严重灼伤。体内的电力，还让POKENAME跑出时速80英里。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its mane and tail are made of a hot plasma that on contact, will cause nasty burns all over the victim's body. Its internal electricity allows for POKENAME to run up to 80 mph.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏滑物质构成，性情始终开朗。只要人类与宝可梦开心，POKENAME自己也跟着快乐。
author: kingnekogamingvt
source: POKENAME is always cheerful and gets joy out of making people and Pokémon happy. POKENAME are made of a slimy substance.

entry: 早期研究以为，POKENAME会同类相食。深入观察才发现，它只是每次蜕皮后，立即吃掉自己的旧皮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was initially thought to be cannibalistic in early scientific reports, until further research revealed that it simply devours its own shed skin immediately after molting.

entry: POKENAME爱偷偷进城，洗劫糖果店，把赃物藏在巨喙里。训练家常在巢中找到来路不明的糖纸，便是它捣蛋的证据。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME has a habit of sneaking into towns and raiding candy shops, storing its loot inside its oversized beak. Trainers often find mysterious candy wrappers in its nest as evidence of its mischief.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，一生90%的时间几乎纹丝不动。它们躺在空地或人烟附近，朝过路者张着嘴，盼人分点吃的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are so indolent as to be almost immobile for 90 percent of their life. They lay around in clearings or near civilization, opening their mouth at passersby in the hopes of food being shared with them.

entry: POKENAME明明吃一点就能活，却见什么吃什么。谁想夺它的食物，就会挨上带刺双臂的重击。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite being able to survive with little food, POKENAME will consume anything it can find. If someone tries to take its food, it will bash them with its thorny arms.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，长得像美味食物，尝着也可口，借此让孢子传入其他生物体内。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom inhabiting POKENAME grows to appear as and taste like delicious food to help the spores spread to other organisms.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，长得像美味食物，尝着也可口，借此让孢子传入其他生物体内。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom inhabiting POKENAME grows to appear as and taste like delicious food to help the spores spread to other organisms.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，长得像美味食物，尝着也可口，借此让孢子传入其他生物体内。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom inhabiting POKENAME grows to appear as and taste like delicious food to help the spores spread to other organisms.

entry: POKENAME身手意外敏捷，能从一棵树荡向另一棵。谁不肯给吃的，它就攻击谁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME swings from tree to tree with surprising agility. It will attack anyone that refuses to give it food.

entry: 它食量惊人，部分正是为了负担严苛训练的消耗。吃与练分不开，连锻炼时，也常满嘴塞着食物。
author: sk372
source: Its massive appetite is due in part to the calories needed to maintain its strict training regimen. Eating and training are so intertwined it will often be seen with a full mouth even while exercising.

entry: POKENAME极少来到地表，贪吃的它一路啃过地下，寻找矿物。留下的隧道，常被满怀希望的勘探者利用，追寻稀有金属。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME is rarely seen at the surface, its voracious appetite leading it to eat its way through the ground in search of minerals. The tunnels left behind in its wake are often used by hopeful prospectors hunting for rare metals.

entry: POKENAME贪玩得很，爱在水中跃进跃出，给游客惊喜。水族馆与海洋公园里，它是很受孩子欢迎的明星。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very playful Pokémon and love to jump in and out of the water to surprise tourists. They are very popular in aquariums and marine parks as kid-friendly attractions.

entry: POKENAME能走路，也会涉水上岸找食物。它把大口沙子铲进嘴里，吃掉其中的小生物。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME's ambulatory nature allows it to wade onto land for food, shoveling large amounts of sand into its mouth to eat the tiny creatures within.

entry: POKENAME在水中飞快穿行，成群时被称作“小队”。可它们太爱追着船竞速，水手往往视其为麻烦。
author: chiari_queen
source: Zipping through the water, POKENAME move in groups called squads. Sailors often regard these Pokémon as pests due to their tendency to race boats.

entry: 它友善又合群，尤其亲近航海的人，却似乎不知道，庞大体型会给小玩伴带来危险。
author: Staghorn
source: It is extremely friendly and sociable, especially with seafaring humans. It seems unaware that its large size makes it a danger to its smaller playmates.

entry: 这只顽皮的宝可梦，总爱从炮管般的双臂射出泡泡，捉弄没防备的海滩游客，自得其乐。
author: regula
source: This mischievous Pokémon entertains itself by playfully firing bubbles at unsuspecting beach-goers out of its cannon-like arms.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺藏着大量毒液，性情却友善，很少伤人。有些POKENAME甚至想上岸陪人玩，尽管身体到了陆上，很快就会干掉。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Although POKENAME's stingers contain large amounts of venom, it is so friendly that it will rarely harm humans. Some POKENAME will even try and come ashore to play with people, even though it quickly dries out on land.

entry: POKENAME一家一小群地漂过海中，用黏触手收集浮游生物，再舔着吃干净。幼年个体很爱玩，常相互追逐。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME floats through the ocean in small families using their sticky tentacles to collect plankton before licking them clean. Adolescents enjoy playing games, often found chasing each other around.

entry: POKENAME痴迷金币，偶尔连寒冷的惯常领地也顾不上，专程出去捕猎野生喵喵。对人类而言，除了喙与爪，锋利如刃的翼羽也同样危险。
author: SonTyp
source: A POKENAME covets golden coins to the point of occasionally leaving its regular frigid territory to hunt for wild Meowth. Its beak and claws aren't the only danger to humans, as it often attacks with its razor sharp wing feathers.

entry: POKENAME会在结着美味树果的树上留下爪痕。谁敢偷它的果子，便会遭群体包围，吃进肚里。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME leaves scratches on trees with delicious berries. Any Pokémon who steals POKENAME's berries will be surrounded by their pack and consumed.

entry: POKENAME中，獠牙最长、最大的那只带队狩猎。它们靠翻滚与猛撞，把猎物击倒。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME with the longest and biggest tusks lead their hunting parties. They bring down prey by rolling and slamming into them.

entry: POKENAME看似雍容，性情却十分凶暴。它喜欢晒着太阳，把战斗交给玛瓢虫随从；可真遭到挑衅，也会用利爪般的鳍，把敌人撕碎。
author: scrapsorra
source: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are quite brutal. They prefer to bask in the sun and let their Weavbas entourage fight, but they will still use their sharp, clawed fins to shred in defiance.

entry: 违法作业的工厂里，常能见到POKENAME。它用磁场困住有毒废气，再由体内系统过滤，净化出的清新湿润气息，还常被拿来调制古龙水。
author: Beatdoof
source: Often seen in factories with illegal working conditions, POKENAME's magnetic field is used to trap toxic gas wastes from these factories, then filter it with its internal filtering system. The clear, dewy air it creates is often turned into cologne.

entry: POKENAME张嘴时会露出极为敏感的内核。若去触碰，可能引发当量高达10,000吉吨的爆炸。因此，很少有训练家会把自爆瓦斯继续进化成这种形态。
author: silvertotodile
source: POKENAME's mouth exposes its inner core, a very sensitive area. If messed with, it could possibly explode with a yield of 10,000 gigatons. As such, very few evolve their Magnezing further to this form.

entry: 它用触角操纵电力，在战斗中控制磁铁。身旁始终跟着一对无人机般的个体，既能助战，也会侦察适合进食的地方。
author: sk372
source: Using electricity manipulated via its antennae, it can control magnets in battle.  A pair of drone-like entities follow it at all times, aiding in battle as well as scouting for good feeding spots.

entry: 身体只负责吃喝，大脑及其余机能，全在头顶的壳内。POKENAME拥有极强的电磁力量。
author: bobosmith01
