source: The body is only used to eat and drink, and the brain and all of the other functionality is within the shell atop this Pokémon's head. POKENAME has intense electromagnetic powers.

entry: 这是一台古代文明造出的强大超级计算机。据说，它能实现愿望，也能随心扭转时空。
author: hypernovahusky
source: A powerful supercomputer built by an ancient civilization long ago. Some say it has the power to grant wishes, as well as bend space and time at will.

entry: 这是一台古代文明造出的强大超级计算机。据说，它能实现愿望，也能随心扭转时空。
author: hypernovahusky
source: A powerful supercomputer built by an ancient civilization long ago. Some say it has the power to grant wishes, as well as bend space and time at will.

entry: 改进自爆磁怪多年无果后，一名科学家干脆试着融合两只。新生的宝可梦，竟能指挥大群小磁怪与三合一磁怪，替自己达成目的，目的究竟是什么，却仍无人知晓。
author: .fedoraman
source: After years of failure trying to improve Magnezone, a scientist had the idea to simply fuse two Magnezone together. The resulting Pokémon has the strange ability to mobilize a swarm of Magnemite and Magneton to its own ends, which remain unknown.

entry: 双手的磁铁能产生电力与磁力。它惯常先操纵附近金属，掷向目标，再接近展开格斗。
author: VoidDx01
source: The magnets it has for hands can be used to generate electricity and magnetism. Its main battle tactic is to control nearby metal and then hurl it at targets before engaging in close-quarters combat.

entry: POKENAME把体内磁铁当指南针，随时调整方向。充入电力后，磁铁又能牵引游动，让它逆着潮水，也滑得轻松。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME uses the magnets in its body as a compass, helping it steer in different directions. It charges these magnets to help pull it as it swims, allowing it to glide effortlessly against the tides.

entry: 工厂或垃圾场附近，常聚着成群POKENAME，见到废金属就吃。中央的花还能发送信号，与其他POKENAME交流。
author: imagine1.
source: Herds of POKENAME are commonly spotted near factories or garbage dumps, consuming any scrap metal they find. Its main flower acts as a means of communication, sending signals to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由各式废金属借强磁场拼合而成。它会用磁场为金属充电，谁一碰，就挨上厉害的电击。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of various pieces of scrap metal held together by a strong magnetic field. It will use this field to imbue the metal with an electric charge that will produce a nasty shock on contact.

entry: 这只宝可梦的触手由极为坚韧的金属构成，触角还会持续放电，为它们提供保护。也曾有训练家被它意外电伤，送进医院。
author: VoidDx01
source: The tentacles of this Pokémon are made of an extremely durable metal and are protected by a constant stream of electricity emitted from its antenna. There are incidents of this Pokémon accidentally electrocuting and hospitalizing their Trainers.

entry: 小磁怪想合成三合一磁怪，若聚得过多，有时竟会意外塌缩成一副身体。所有大脑汇成一个，让POKENAME比从前更加高效、专注。
author: .fedoraman & wildheartrazorfangs
source: If an excess of Magnemite gather while trying to form Magneton, they may accidentally collapse into one body. With all of their brains combined into one, POKENAME is far more efficient and focused than it was previously.

entry: 极少数情况下，数只小磁怪同时结合、进化，便会诞生这种宝可梦。真正的眼睛环绕身体运行，扫描周围，收集信息。
author: .fedoraman
source: In the rare event of several Magnemite conjoining and evolving at once, this Pokémon can evolve. Its true eyes orbit around it, scanning the environment for information.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩与岸边，搜寻一切金属。城市工厂太多，常将它们不知不觉引进城里，每来一次，就闹得人仰马翻。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME are found among beaches and shores, searching for anything metallic. Most POKENAME tend to accidentally wander into large cities because of the abundance of factories, causing a ruckus everytime they do so.

entry: POKENAME的味觉，是世间最讲究的几种之一。若训练家端出合它口味的菜，便会受赐福，今后所尝的每一道菜，都美妙无比。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME has one of the most distinguished taste of all beings. If a Trainer creates a dish which pleases its tongue, they will be blessed in having every dish taste spectacular.

entry: 两只POKENAME相斗，会把长舌当鞭，舌尖甩得超过音速。看似骇人的獠牙，倒不是用来打架，而是砍树，好够着高枝上的食物。
author: Katie
source: When two POKENAME fight, they use their immensely long tongues as whips, moving the tips at supersonic speeds. Their formidable-looking tusks are used to cut down trees rather than for fighting, letting them access food high in the branches.

entry: POKENAME的舌头太大，身体根本装不下。它便埋进土里，免得舌头干掉。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's tongue is too large to fit in its body. It buries itself in dirt to keep it from drying out.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙掘开虫宝可梦的群居巢穴，伸长黏舌吸蜜。可皮肤柔软，挨不住怒虫反击，每处都待不了太久。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig into Bug-type Pokémon colonies, feeding on the honey within with its long sticky tongue. It usually can't stay long at any colony as its hide is soft, leaving it vulnerable to retaliation from the angry bugs.

entry: POKENAME用强壮獠牙迎战对手，再伸长舌，缠住对方的牙，免遭反击。双方打起来，常搅得乱七八糟。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tusks to fight with rivals, its long tongue used to try and grapple the tusks of its opponents and prevent a counter-attack. Fights between the Pokémon are often messy as a result.

entry: POKENAME见什么都爱舔一舔，表示亲近。它们似乎只需尝尝周围，就能追踪任何目标。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to lick whatever they find as a show of affection. They seem to be able to track anything just by tasting its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME忠诚尽责，却必须按时喂饱。一旦饿着，POKENAME那条强有力的舌头，便能闹得一片狼藉。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is incredibly loyal and dutiful, but needs to be fed regularly. If it goes hungry, POKENAME can make a big mess with its strong tongue.

entry: POKENAME看着单纯无害，可几米大的物件或生物，也能被它用舌卷住，轻松吞下。因此，有些组织会请它守卫。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME may appear harmless and simple, but it can easily grasp and devour things and creatures several meters in size with its tongue. For this reason, some organizations use it as a guard.

entry: POKENAME把奇长的舌头垂在水边，等没防备的宝可梦咬住，再卷回来吃。可它反应实在太慢，食物常常溜走。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME feeds by using its extraordinarily long tongue as a lure at the water's edge, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to bite it so it can reel the food in. Unfortunately, it has incredibly slow reaction times and often lets its food get away.

entry: 它会把留在地面与敌人身上的毒膜，一一舔回。什么都吃的POKENAME，臭味也随吃下的东西变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: It laps up the toxic film it leaves on the ground and its foes. This Pokémon will eat anything; the stench of POKENAME changes based on what it eats.

entry: POKENAME钻进软沙休息，只露舌头在外。钳中的肉，有股明显的咸味。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME digs into soft sand to rest, leaving only its tongue visible. The meat in its claws has a noticeably salty flavor.

entry: 融合唤醒了POKENAME体内超级大针蜂的力量，又结合了超甲狂犀惊人的威力与韧性。铠甲虽格外沉重，只要条件合适，便没有对手能击败它。
author: Walter Teigan
source: Fusion has awakened the strength of Mega Beedrill within POKENAME and incorporated the monstrous power and durability of Rhyperior. While its armor plating is considerably heavy, under the right conditions, no opponent can defeat it.

entry: POKENAME能抵挡任何剑刃，也能钻穿钻石，盾牌与铠甲，更不在话下。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can withstand any sword and is able to drill through diamond, let alone any shield or armor.

entry: POKENAME常聚在工地，充当拆楼用的重锤。石甲看着像个人防护装备，也映出它对安全的重视。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME often gathers at construction sites, acting as a wrecking ball for demolitions. Its stone armor resembles personal protective equipment, reflecting its dedication to safety.

entry: POKENAME多数藤蔓柔软灵活，唯独角状藤坚硬如花岗岩。软藤先缠住敌人，硬角便趁机刺下。
author: entomoxie
source: While most vines on a POKENAME are soft and flexible, the horn vine is as tough as granite. The softer vines can restrict and ensnare opponents while the horn strikes them.

entry: 这只宝可梦是故乡丛林里的猎手，沐浴日光，便生机勃勃。它先跟踪猎物数小时，等到时机，一甩头上藤蔓，力道足以切开几乎一切。
author: SonTyp
source: This Pokémon is a predator in its native jungle environment and thrives in sunlight. To hunt, it first stalks its prey for hours, until at an opportune moment it hurls the vines on its head with such force that they can cut through almost anything.

entry: POKENAME怒极会喷毒气。平时作战，则常放出类似惰性气体保护焊所用的气体，让电击变得更准、更强。
author: epping_forest
source: If POKENAME gets angry enough, it will expel poisonous gas. Most of the time, in battles, it will try to fill the air with a gas similar to the one used in metal inert gas welding, so its electric attacks become more accurate and powerful.

entry: POKENAME在双尾之间，放出频率不同的电弧，便能奏出电子乐般的声音。预算买不起音响的派对、夜总会，尤其需要它。
author: epping_forest
source: By creating electric arcs at different frequencies between its two tails, POKENAME can emit sounds similar to electronic music. It's a very valuable asset for parties and nightclubs that don't have enough budget for loudspeakers.

entry: 它飞过哪里，哪里便起山火、闹停电。虽有这般破坏力，训练家却说，它其实友善极了。
author: Schwaus
source: It flies through the region causing wildfires and power outages. Despite its destructive tendencies, Trainers report it is extremely friendly.

entry: POKENAME通过光合作用产生大量电力，再用电线般的藤蔓电击捕食者。电击的威力足以让小型虫宝可梦麻痹。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME generates large amounts of electricity through photosynthesis and will zap predators with its wire-like vines. The shock is strong enough to paralyze small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME长久晒太阳，以独特的光合作用，把日光转成电力。既能靠电维生，也能放电驱赶天敌。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME spend lots of time in the sun, undergoing a unique form of photosynthesis to turn sunlight into electricity. They can feed off of this electricity or discharge it to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME能尽情驾驭交流电与直流电。如此巨量的能量，偏握在一个暴烈成性的家伙手里，附近人类与宝可梦，都难言安全。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can fully harness both the power of alternating current and direct current. Such a sheer amount of energy, in the hands of such an ardently violent creature, is a serious hazard to the security of all Trainers and Pokémon nearby.

entry: 四颗强大的脑协同运作，产出的电量，是电击魔兽的四倍。只需一只POKENAME，便能轻松为整座城市供能。
author: amiel997
source: With its four powerful brains working in unison, it generates four times more electricity than an Electivire. A single POKENAME can produce enough energy to power an entire city with ease.

entry: POKENAME用六根电线释放超过20000伏的电击时，战场上便电弧交错、火花如雨。许多人相信，它是闪电的化身。
author: takopus
source: A shower of sparks arcs over the site of its battles when POKENAME uses its six wires to attack foes with over 20,000 volts of electricity. Many believe it is an incarnation of lightning.

entry: POKENAME一夜就能吸干整座城的电力。电击中蕴含的力量，甚至足以引发突变。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can drain an entire city of its electricity in a single night. Its electrical attacks contain enough power to cause mutations.

entry: POKENAME看似一动不动，其实出拳快得肉眼难辨。盯得太久，拳边激起的静电，还会让眼睛永久失明。
author: TeatedTiten
source: It might seem to be standing still, but in reality POKENAME punches faster than the eye can see. Stare at it for too long, and the ambient static of its punches can cause permanent blindness.

entry: 它把家安在狭窄的火山喷气孔内。一遭打扰，便从尾巴射出火球。
author: Busilisk
source: It finds its home within narrow volcanic vents. If disturbed, it will launch fireballs from its tail.

entry: POKENAME用炮管般的手抓起小石，裹上棉絮，点燃后射出。动画片看得太多，竟可能让这种融合体鲁莽嗜虐，令人担忧。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME grabs pebbles with its cannon-hands, covers them in cotton and launches them that are set on fire. Watching too many cartoons may cause this fusion to become worryingly temerarious and sadistic.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的小恶徒，游荡沙漠，抢劫旅人的财物。双臂还能射出会爆炸的种子。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的小恶徒，游荡沙漠，抢劫旅人的财物。双臂还能射出会爆炸的种子。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.

entry: POKENAME常去发生纷争的地方，让人们相信，有位看不见的神明，正庇佑着自己。
author: GentleSage
source: POKENAME regularly seeks out areas where there is strife. It can convince others that an unseeable deity is watching over them.

entry: POKENAME千方百计地避免激烈纷争，亲近它认为心地纯净的人，寻求彼此的快乐与安慰。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME avoids intense strife at all costs. It gravitates to those whom it deems pure of heart, seeking mutual joy and comfort.

entry: 不断蜕皮，让POKENAME在最终进化时，获得完美、坚实的外骨骼。为了负担额外重量，翅膀也变得更强，飞行依旧平稳。
author: richardcareylol
source: POKENAME's final evolved state marks it perfecting its exoskeleton through endlessly shedding. The result is a pristine, solid exterior. To compensate for the extra weight of its shell, it has developed much stronger wings in order to fly smoothly.

entry: 寓言中说，战争时期，这只宝可梦会出现，警告各个文明缔结和平。还有人说，如果和平无法实现，它就会释放超过200,000伏的电流，摧毁被它判定为不配存续的文明。
author: Beatdoof
source: Fables state that in war times, this Pokémon appears as a warning for civilizations to make peace. Some say if no peace can be achieved, it will discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 200,000 volts, destroying civilizations it deems unworthy.

entry: POKENAME身为幽灵，生命与曾孵化自己的蛋紧密相连。传说体内108个灵魂，全来自那些过早离世的善人。
author: Hello_I_Exist
source: Due to the spectral nature of POKENAME, its life-force is tied to the egg it once hatched from. Legends say this Pokémon contains 108 spirits within, all of which are from virtuous individuals who perished before their time.

entry: POKENAME振翅疾飞，穿越各个地区，守望人类与宝可梦，必要时便出手相护。有些地方称它为“和平守护者”。
author: tserii#6882
source: POKENAME can use its wings to travel at incredible speeds across different regions. It watches over people and Pokémon and protects them if needed. It is referred to as the 'Protector of Peace' in certain regions.

entry: 晴朗夜空中，常能见到它飞行。人们认为，神话里的“太空鲸”，灵感正是来自它。
author: bostroms
source: It is often seen flying through clear skies at night.  It is thought to be the inspiration for the mythical “space whale”.

entry: 晴朗夜空中，常能见到它飞行。人们认为，神话里的“太空鲸”，灵感正是来自它。
author: bostroms
source: It is often seen flying through clear skies at night.  It is thought to be the inspiration for the mythical “space whale”.

entry: POKENAME常亲近善良的人。谁好谁坏，POKENAME用鼻子就能辨别。
author: snivi
source: POKENAME usually seen near kind people. POKENAME uses its nose to determine whether a person is good or bad.

entry: POKENAME眼周的薄膜，会洒出一圈闪光，照亮需要祝福者。可恶人若闯入它们的巢，便会被蜂拥围住，在爱与接纳的温暖中，窒闷到再也支撑不住。
author: Wormspawn
source: The membrane around POKENAME's eyes illuminates those in need of blessings in a ring of sparkles. Malefactors who intrude upon a den of POKENAME will be swarmed en masse and smothered in the warmth of love and acceptance until they succumb.

entry: POKENAME的正义感坚定不移。若训练家舍和平而挑纷争，尽管放心，自己的POKENAME一定会找他算账。
author: .fedoraman
source: A POKENAME has a staunch sense of righteousness. If its Trainer chooses strife over peace, they can rest assured that their POKENAME will hold them accountable.

entry: POKENAME一察觉谁想挑起纷争，便毫不犹豫地一头滚撞过去。看人品的眼光，准得不可思议。
author: .fedoraman
source: When a POKENAME senses that someone intends to cause strife, it does not hesitate to roll headlong into them. Its judge of character is uncanny.

entry: 训练家若抛弃道义，POKENAME便抛弃训练家。离去后，从未有谁再将它收服，它却仍在世界各处，守护和平。
author: .fedoraman
source: If its Trainer abandons their moral principles, a POKENAME will abandon its Trainer. A stray POKENAME has never been recaptured, but continues its mission to protect peace around the world.

entry: POKENAME会把幼小宝可梦，拥在宽大双翼下。它能感知悲伤，谁需要安慰与支持，就留在谁身旁。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME are known for huddling baby Pokémon underneath their large wings. They have a unique ability to sense sadness and will stay close to anyone in need, offering comfort and support.

entry: POKENAME常陪孩子和小宝可梦玩，力量不用来吓人，而是用来保护、扶持。据说，它能为大地带来和睦，也从不让任何伙伴掉队。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME often plays with children and smaller Pokémon, using its strength not to intimidate, but to protect and support. It is said that its presence brings harmony to the land, always ensuring that no one is left behind.

entry: 它乐意把铲子借给想玩的人，也常找来吵架的孩子，鼓励他们一起堆座沙堡。
author: cheroace
source: It does not mind lending out its shovels to those who wish to play. It will often seek out bickering children and encourage them to work together to build a sand castle.

entry: POKENAME唱着欢乐的歌，夜里漫游城镇，为时令庆典送上祝福，人称“欢庆之灵”。
author: Alkazamis
source: Singing joyfully, POKENAME wanders through towns at night, blessing seasonal festivals. It is known as the Spirit of Jubilation.

entry: POKENAME只住在毫无纷争的和平地区海岸。可触手众多，又带剧毒，所以它们出现时，反而很少受欢迎。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME can only be found on the coasts of peaceful regions that are devoid of strife. Unfortunately, their many tentacles are extremely venomous, and so their appearance is rarely welcomed.

entry: 对受它守护者而言，它象征希望与喜悦。炮管既能射出强劲水柱，也能打出纯粹的能量。
author: VoidDx01
source: This Pokémon serves as a symbol of hope and joy to those it protects. Its cannons can fire either powerful blasts of water or pure energy.

entry: 壳上的纹样如同指纹，绝无两只相同。特殊外壳还能感知大地震动，让POKENAME预知危险。
author: jaminmcready
source: The patterns on its shell are always unique, like fingerprints, and no two are ever the same. Its special shell has the ability to feel vibrations in the ground, allowing POKENAME to anticipate danger.

entry: POKENAME的尾部包裹，和外壳一样坚韧。哪怕一声突响，或地面稍有震动，它就爱蜷成一团。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME's tail bundle is just as tough as its shell. It likes to curl up in a ball at the slightest loud noise or rumble in the ground.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，摇响尾部的响器，吓退大型天敌。毒液虽不致命，却能令四肢麻痹长达一小时。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the sand, using the rattle on its tail to ward off larger predators. Its venom isn't fatal but will cause limb paralysis for up to an hour.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，迅速钻过缝隙逃走。敌人若追得太近，便用让人疼痛的电光还击。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can curl up and quickly escape from enemies through gaps. However, should one get too close, it shocks them with painful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME卷成球，滚下山坡时，常被误认作巨石。它还会用尾巴拍地，把沙扬进敌人眼中。
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, it can be mistaken as a large boulder rolling down a hill. It slaps its tail on the ground to whip up sand in its opponent's eyes.

entry: 这些小POKENAME毫无害处，也喜欢被抱起来。可别不装进精灵球，就带回家，因为它走到哪儿，都会把沙子带得满地都是。
author: roxie5228
source: These small POKENAME are harmless and enjoy being picked up. Don't try to take it home without a Poké Ball, though, as they are known to track sand everywhere, no matter what.

entry: 受惊或疲惫时，POKENAME会钻进沙下，暂歇片刻。可沙常跑进耳朵，扰乱它们的回声定位。
author: Frokachu
source: When spooked or tired, POKENAME will burrow under sand to rest temporarily. Sand often gets in their ears, disrupting their echolocation.

entry: 与穿山鼠不同，POKENAME更靠近海岸，偏爱灼热沙滩。游客踩到锋利铁刺，脚常伤得厉害，因此，它也很不招人待见。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Unlike Sandshrew, POKENAME migrate closer to coastal regions, preferring to take residence along hot sandy beaches. It often is seen as a nuisance since beach-goers stepping on its sharp iron barbs will leave their foot seriously injured.

entry: 球体里装满细沙。发怒时，它将双球猛然相撞，把沙喷向敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its spheres are packed with very fine sand. If it is agitated, it smashes the two spheres together, blasting sand towards its foes.

entry: POKENAME似乎讨厌大片水域，喜欢晒太阳，在松土中打滚，保持身体干燥。有人见过年幼的POKENAME在暴风雨中冲着雨水呜叫、吠叫。
author: bobosmith01
source: Because POKENAME seems to dislike large bodies of water, it likes to lay in the sun and roll around in loose dirt to keep dry. Young POKENAME have been recorded yipping and barking at the rain during storms.

entry: POKENAME体内酷热，让沙质鬃毛熔成玻璃。玻璃依然滚烫，碰到草木，便会将其引燃。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME intense internal heat causes its sandy mane to turn to glass. The glass is still incredibly hot, hot enough to ignite any flora on contact.

entry: POKENAME胆子小，总藏在周身的沙尘暴中。喜欢可爱宝可梦的训练家里，倒有许多是它的粉丝。
author: soupalicious
source: POKENAME is timid, and hides in the sandstorm that surrounds its body. It has a lot of fans in Trainers that favor cute Pokémon.

entry: 它一天便能横跨整个地区。它们聚在发电厂，收集足够的电力，保护幼崽。
author: Schwaus
source: It can travel across whole regions in a single day. They congregate at power plants to collect enough electricity to protect their young.

entry: 它为蜻蜻蜓提供庇护、协调行动，让族群繁盛。背上信标发出的复杂信号，唯有蜻蜻蜓能看见。
author: Staghorn
source: It acts as a shelter and coordinator for Yanma, allowing their populations to flourish. The beacon on its back displays complex signals that only Yanma can see.

entry: 它能用触须操纵猎物的情绪，再拍动翅膀，激起冲击波，从体内摧垮对方，即使体型远大于它的敌人，也能击倒。
author: cheroace
source: It can take down foes much larger than it by manipulating their emotions with its feelers and destroying them from the inside using the shockwaves created by the flap of its wings.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度掠过沼泽上空，用三颗头、八片翅膀，抓取空中的猎物。三颗头各有近360度视野，想偷袭它，被认为根本不可能。
author: moopse
source: Zipping through swamp skies at unbelievable speeds, POKENAME nab their prey out of the air using their three heads and eight wings. With all three heads having near-360-degree vision, it is considered impossible to surprise.

entry: POKENAME虽不大能好好飞，强劲双翼却仍让它速度惊人。又快又强，对捕虫者而言，实在是个难关。
author: merclipse
source: Though unable to fly properly, POKENAME can reach incredible speeds using its powerful wings. Its speed and strength make it a daunting challenge for bug catchers.

entry: 它悬浮在平静水面上，用大钳捞起水中猎物。一旦抓住，钳口一合，便夹个粉碎。
author: bobosmith01
source: It hovers over the surface of calm waters and scoops up aquatic prey in its large pincer. When it catches something, it crushes them in a single snap.

entry: 天性害羞，让POKENAME难得一见。风铃舒缓的旋律，却能将它们吸引过来。
author: rosemagwin
source: Naturally shy, it is a rare sight to see a POKENAME. They are drawn to the soothing melody of wind chimes.

entry: 人们认为，伊布在野外住进潮湿沼泽或丛林，便可能变成这种模样。河流与溪涧间的植物丛，就是它们的家。
author: bobosmith01
source: Eevee are thought to take on this form in the wild when they live in humid swamps or jungles. They make their home in plant life amongst rivers and streams.

entry: 古画中有近似POKENAME的形象，让人猜测，镰刀盔存活的年代，比原先想的更晚。可缺乏化石佐证，考古学家认为，那只是艺术化描绘的叶嘎啦，手持两片叶刃。
author: .fedoraman
source: Ancient art resembling POKENAME leads some to speculate that Kabutops lived much more recently than previously thought. Without fossil evidence, archaeologists instead conclude that the art depicts a stylized Leafwak holding two leaf blades.

entry: POKENAME深居林中，在树木间迅疾穿行，守护自己的王国。每到落脚之处，周围草木便重焕生机。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME dwells deep in the woods, swiftly rushing between trees to guard its kingdom. Where they land, the surrounding plants are reinvigorated.

entry: POKENAME长出的叶片，一受撞击，就会爆开。可滋味辛辣，倒成了莎莎酱里很受欢迎的配料。
author: .realthree
source: The leaves that POKENAME grow explode if struck with any force. They're a popular ingredient in salsas due to their spiciness.

entry: 它挥舞成簇的利叶，保护花苞。POKENAME能连着几小时站在原地，吸收土中养分。
author: Mistymagius
source: It protects its flower bud by swinging around its cluster of sharp leaves. POKENAME stands it the same spot for hours on end, absorbing nutrients from the soil.

entry: POKENAME照料森林与植物，播撒种子，让遭森林大火摧毁的地方重新长出绿意。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME are caretakers of forests and plant life, spreading seeds to help regrow plants in places lost to forest fires.

entry: POKENAME藏在住家附近的树篱里。找到遗落的玩具，便送回那户人家的门前。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME hides in hedges near family homes. When it finds lost toys, it will return them to the family's doorstep.

entry: POKENAME虽身强体壮，却满足于整日歇在泥中，吸收周围植物多余的能量，很少捕猎水宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite having a sturdy, powerful body, POKENAME is content to live its days resting in the mud, absorbing excess energy from the plant life that grows around it. It rarely hunts for Water-type Pokémon.

entry: 这种大嘴娃亚种住在丛林深处，大半天把身体塞进小角落或缝隙里酣睡。捕蝇草般的第二张嘴，却始终张开，等着猎物。
author: ModeusTheUnbound
source: This subspecies of Mawile lives in the deepest jungles. They spend most of the day with their body wedged into a small nook or crevice, sleeping soundly, while their flytrap-like second mouth lies open and waiting.

entry: POKENAME用双叶缠住草木的茎干，吸取生命能量。实在找不到食物时，也能扎进地下，从根系中吸收养分。
author: bee4082
source: The twin leaves of POKENAME wrap around the stems and trunks of plants and trees, draining them of their life energy to feed itself. In a dire situation, it can stick into the ground to absorb nutrients from roots.

entry: POKENAME的叶状火焰泛起迷人光彩，虽常栖身幽暗森林，却不断寻找明亮空地，进行光合作用。知道这习性的迷路旅人，便跟着POKENAME走向安全处。
author: NightwingJay
source: POKENAME radiates a mesmerizing glow from its leafy flames. Typically found in dark forests, POKENAME will constantly search for bright open areas to photosynthesize. Lost travelers, with this knowledge, will follow POKENAME to safety.

entry: POKENAME不再亲近火焰，而是安居林间，用采来的种子培育花园。它还复原了进化时用掉的叶之石，留作成长的纪念。
author: merclipse
source: No longer having an affinity for Fire, POKENAME resides peacefully within forests. They tend to a garden they raise with seeds found from foraging. It was able to restore the Leaf Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.

entry: POKENAME以念力操纵寒风，把闯入者逐出洞穴。它珍爱独处，不愿受扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME psychically controls cold winds to expel intruders from its cave. It values its solitude and dislikes being disturbed.

entry: POKENAME是天生的艺术家，会雕出各种芭蕾舞姿的冰像。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME is a natural artist. It will create ice sculptures displaying various ballet poses.

entry: 暴风雪中，POKENAME身上的圆珠明亮发光，为迷路旅人指路。不过，它无法取暖或遮风，便常与其他宝可梦合作救援。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's orbs glow brightly during blizzards, acting as a guide for lost travelers. It can't provide warmth or shelter, though, so it often teams up with other Pokémon.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，成群POKENAME最为活跃。它们藏进暗影，突然吐出寒气，瞬间冻得敌人无法动弹。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: Groups of POKENAME tend to be most active on cold winter nights. They use the shadows to blend in, launching surprise attacks with freezing breath that can immobilize foes in an instant.

entry: POKENAME的花苞产生冰孢子，一碰到东西，便将其冻住。据说，花朵即将绽放时，暴风雪也随之形成。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME flower bud produces icy spores that will freeze anything they touch instantly. It is said that blizzards form once its flower is ready to bloom.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙掘出灌木的根。这些根营养丰富，是它最爱的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig up the roots of bushes. These nutrient-rich roots are its favorite food source.

entry: 耳朵帮助它们调节体温。包袱里存着的树果，还能制成冰棒。
author: pankiwi
source: Their ears help them regulate their body temperature. The berries they keep in their bundle can be made into ice pops.

entry: POKENAME会偷偷混进雪球大战。到了夏天，又给遇见的每个人，做上一份刨冰。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME sneakily joins snowball fights. In summer, it makes snowcones for anyone it meets.

entry: 它能精准射出尾上长成的冰柱。背上的树果，终年缤纷、似乎格外甜，可POKENAME只愿分给自己的幼崽。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can fire the icicles that grow on its tail with precise accuracy. The berries that grow on its back are colorful year round and are apparently quite sweet, but POKENAME only shares them willingly with its young.

entry: POKENAME带着男孩子般的淘气，脑袋又傻得可爱，因此很得训练家疼爱。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are often beloved by their Trainers due to their boyish personalities and charming lack of intelligence.

entry: POKENAME虽仪态高贵，护起领地却极凶，以冰风与念力，击退一切可能的对手。残酷又美丽的它们，被雪乡训练家称为“寒冰女王”。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are extremely territorial, fighting off any potential rivals with freezing winds and psychic force. Their cruelty and beauty have led to Trainers in snowy regions referring to them as 'Chiller Queens'.

entry: 这只宝可梦像位异国战士，操控冰与其他元素，宛如施展魔法。据传，强大的POKENAME，还能召出战败者的冰雪幽魂。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.

entry: 这只宝可梦像位异国战士，操控冰与其他元素，宛如施展魔法。据传，强大的POKENAME，还能召出战败者的冰雪幽魂。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.

entry: POKENAME把池塘冻出光滑冰面，纯为痛快滑一滑，也常邀请别人同玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes ponds to create smooth surfaces for sliding. It does this purely for fun and often invites others to join.

entry: 它极其罕见，只在看得见月亮的冬夜现身。脚下的水一踩便冻，能让它一路跳过湖面。
author: bostroms
source: It is a very rare sight, only appearing on winter nights when the moon is visible.  It can hop across lakes by freezing the water beneath its feet.

entry: POKENAME无声漂在雪山间，观察登山客。人一转弯，突然看见它，常会心头发毛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME silently floats in snowy mountains, observing hikers. This behavior can be unnerving when hikers suddenly spot it around a corner.

entry: 风雪中，隐约能听见POKENAME唱起哀乐交织的旋律。究竟是它一跳舞便下雪，还是只逢雪起舞，没人知道。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME can be faintly heard singing bittersweet melodies during snowstorms. It is unknown whether its dancing causes it to snow, or if it only dances when it snows.

entry: POKENAME是适应力很强的泳者，热带与严寒都能生存。耳朵感知温度变化，连附近宝可梦的体热，也逃不过。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are highly adaptive swimmers, surviving in both tropical and freezing temperatures. Their ears can detect fluctuation in temperature, including the body heat from nearby Pokémon.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在满月的冬夜现身，为训练家带来安宁的梦。
author: fluttershy0471
source: It is said that POKENAME appears on winter nights during the full moon, granting Trainers peaceful dreams.

entry: 迁入雪山后，POKENAME的毛发渐能抵御寒冷。虽然已得到冰属性，却仍在学习驾驭，暂时还得靠火之力量取暖。
author: merclipse
source: Moving to snow-capped mountains, POKENAME's fur has adapted to help resist the chilling environment. It still needs to use its Fire-Type abilities to keep itself warm despite now gaining the Ice-Type, of which it's still learning to control.

entry: POKENAME已不必靠火之力量抵御山中严寒。它复原了进化时用掉的冰之石，作为成长纪念，还裹进厚厚的坚冰茧里，格外珍惜。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME no longer needs its Fire-Type abilities to withstand the biting cold of the mountains. It was able to restore the Ice Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth, keeping it extra protected in a thick cocoon of solid ice.

entry: POKENAME进化后，四肢末端化成坚冰。碰到什么，什么便迅速覆上一层霜。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME's extremities turned into solid ice after evolving. As a result, anything it touches quickly becomes enveloped in a layer of frost.

entry: 爪间的蹼膜不断造冰。它把冰揉在双手间，压成极坚硬的球，掷向擅闯领地的家伙。
author: sk372
source: From the webbing between its claws, it produces ice constantly.  It can pack this ice between its hands into extremely solid ice balls it will use to pelt unwelcome intruders in its territory.

entry: 它住在岩山洞窟，除了捕猎，很少露面。许多故事都说，它专吃不听话的孩子。
author: bostroms
source: It dwells in rocky mountain caves, rarely emerging except to hunt.  It is the subject of many stories where it is said to prey on disobedient children.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛华美耀眼，像永远燃烧的火焰，让收藏家十分追捧。可谁若虐待、轻慢它，就会被活活冻住，永远封在冰里。
author: Beatdoof
source: Because of its magnificent and dazzling mane, akin to an eternally blazing flame, POKENAME is quite popular among Pokémon collectors. Those who treat it with abuse and disrespect, however, will be frozen alive, eternally encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME用念力减慢分子振动，借此控制四周温度，为自己营造最适合睡觉的环境。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its psychic power to slow the vibrations of molecules. In this way, it controls the ambient temperature around it to provide the perfect environment for sleeping.

entry: POKENAME漂在北极水域，伪装小冰块。一碰双触手便立即冻伤，伤口也极易感染它体表的细菌。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in arctic waters, mimicking small ice chunks. Contact with its twin tentacles causes instant frostbite, which can easily become infected with bacteria on its body.

entry: 它泳姿如天使般优雅，连低于零下150摄氏度，也能承受。上岸睡觉时，头部附肢铺在冰上，感知震动。
author: darxer_
source: It swims through the water with angelic grace and can withstand temperatures below -150 degrees Celsius. On land, it splays its head appendages on ice to detect vibrations while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME舔过什么，什么便立刻结冰。凭这本领，食物也能冻存起来，留待日后吃。
author: .izik
source: Anything POKENAME licks freezes instantly. This freezing touch allows it to preserve food for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME心情好时，种子会散发青草般的甜香。常能看见它们在日光下酣睡，沐浴阳光，补充养分。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its bulb gives off the sweet scent of fresh grass when POKENAME is happy. They can be seen sleeping in the sun, absorbing light as nutrients.

entry: POKENAME虽长得阴森，人们却相信，它是古城的守护者，能够驱逐恶灵。
author: howlingstarr
source: Despite POKENAME's sinister appearance, they are thought to be guardians of ancient cities. Legend has it that this fusion's presence wards off malevolent spirits.

entry: 它自演一对喜剧搭档，让尾巴充当一本正经、接话拆台的那位。POKENAME施展心灵感应，听来仿佛尾巴也能说话。
author: cait_sith
source: It puts on comedy acts as a duo, using its tail to act as the “straight man”. POKENAME uses telepathy to make it seem like the tail can speak.

entry: POKENAME吃毒虫与树果，酿出的果汁也有毒。古代神奥的刺客，曾拿这毒汁作为暗杀手段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists of poisonous bugs and berries, making the juice it creates toxic as well.  This poison juice was a known elimination tactic used by assassins in ancient Sinnoh times.

entry: POKENAME用强爪掘开铜矿，吃下金属，强化飞行用的翅膀。
author: .izik
source: With its powerful claws, POKENAME breaks into copper deposits. It consumes the metal to fortify its wings for flight.

entry: POKENAME指挥周身的蝙蝠状暗影，让自己融入夜色。咬开树果吸汁后，萃取的养分还能经尾巴注入伤者体内，治愈人类与宝可梦。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME command swarms of bat-shaped shadows that surround their bodies to help them blend into the night. They bite into berries to drink from them, extracting nutrients that can be injected with their tails to help heal people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱在高高的夜空滑翔，也不断训练，磨炼使刃的技巧。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME likes to glide high in the night sky. POKENAME trains to hone its skill with its blades.

entry: POKENAME在长满苔藓的洞穴中狩猎。猎物靠近时，它会伸长灵活的脖子，从对方视线的死角出击，再用多根毒刺刺入猎物。
author: Ayner
source: POKENAME hunt in mossy caves. When their prey is near, they extend their flexible neck to hit their blind spot, and stab them with their multiple stingers.

entry: POKENAME滑过黑夜，四处求战。它们先用盾牌般坚实的爪挡住攻击，再一击制胜，随着披风飘动，隐去身影。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide through the night in search of duels. They use their sturdy shield-like claws to block attacks before delivering decisive blows, disappearing with the flutter of their capes.

entry: 这只狡猾宝可梦，喜欢密林等幽暗地方，很会隐匿身影。巨爪配上锋锐翼刃，再以眼花缭乱的速度与凶猛劲势，制服猎物。
author: El Fail
source: Preferring to live in dark places like dense forests and jungles, this sly Pokémon is well adapted to hiding in shadows. It combines its large claws and razor sharp wing blades with blinding ferocity and speed to subdue prey.

entry: POKENAME身上的飘带状附肢，覆着微小倒刺，释放的剧毒，甚至能让来犯者失明。
author: .izik
source: The ribbon-like appendages on POKENAME's body are covered in microscopic barbs. These release a potent toxin capable of blinding attackers.

entry: POKENAME勇敢忠诚，同伴一有需要，便从翻飞的玫瑰花瓣中现身。跃入战阵时，还会沿途撒刺，击退对手，布置战场。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are valiant and loyal, appearing out of a flurry of rose petals when their allies are in need. They leap into battle while scattering thorns below them, repelling opponents and setting the stage for their fight.

entry: 据说，POKENAME出没于古代吸血鬼的破败城堡，装成棺材，吸干不受欢迎的入侵者的生命。
author: SpicyBunbun
source: Legends speak of POKENAME haunting decayed castles said to belong to ancient vampires. Myths claim they disguise themselves as coffins and drain the lifeforce of unwelcome intruders.

entry: 它倒挂在废屋椽下，观察猎物，再扑向同样在屋中游荡的昆虫与虫宝可梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It observes its prey while hanging from the rafters of abandoned buildings. It pounces on insects and Bug-type Pokémon that also roam there.

entry: POKENAME的三条利尾，能各自伸展、活动，攻击灵活又够得远。中间的尾巴还有自己的眼睛，让它几乎不留死角。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: With the ability to stretch and move independently of its three sharp tails, POKENAME can attack flexibly with a wide reach. The middle tail possesses its own eyesight, helping this Pokémon have almost no blind spots.

entry: POKENAME轻轻摇摆，唱出低沉浑厚的歌，用尾巴稳住身体，免得表演时摔倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings in deep, resonant tones while wobbling slightly. It uses its tail for balance to avoid toppling during its performances.

entry: POKENAME用钳状尾巴，抓住敌人拖进地下，动作精准，不留逃脱的机会。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its pincer-like tail to grab foes and drag them underground. It strikes with precision, leaving enemies no chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME以坚爪凿下洞壁的黄水晶，当作珍贵点心，迫不及待地吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sturdy claws to chip citrine from cave walls. It eagerly consumes the gems as a prized snack.

entry: POKENAME大多倒挂在洞中睡觉。超能力一感知有人靠近，便瞬间移动离开。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping upside-down inside caves. Using their psychic powers, they can detect anyone approaching and teleport away.

entry: POKENAME在明亮处很难看清，因此常闭着眼，靠超能力辨识方向。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能找到优质矿物，制成勺子。借这些勺子，POKENAME便能以惊人速度挖出新洞穴。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.

entry: 强壮的双臂，让它即使正与其他宝可梦交战，也能以时速220公里轻松飞行。
author: Prof.Whitebeam
source: Due to its powerful arms, it can fly at 220 km/h without any problem while fighting against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴给自己泼水，保持皮肤湿润。晴天，它最爱躺在池塘边休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes water onto itself using its tail to keep its skin hydrated. It enjoys lounging near ponds on sunny days.

entry: 尾钳明明很适合抓猎物，它却用不好，只能守在树旁，等猎物自己落进钳口。
author: cheroace
source: Despite the pincer on its tail being perfect for catching prey, it cannot use it effectively. It must wait around trees for prey to fall into its grip.

entry: 它用爪子藏着一颗奇怪圆珠。据说凝视太久的人，就会成为POKENAME的猎物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Hiding a strange orb with its claw, it's said anyone that gazes into the orb for too long will become a POKENAME's prey.

entry: POKENAME挥动的剧毒宝珠，会吸来一公里半径内的所有毒素，让它既大享毒食，也为周围生物解毒。
author: noel5229
source: The Toxic Orb that POKENAME swings draws in all poison within a one kilometer radius. This allows it to feast on poison while healing those around it.

entry: 它脾气暴躁，先用长牙挑起敌人，抛上半空，再以重踢，将其砸回地面。
author: kittyluv090
source: It uses its long tusks to throw enemies into the air, then strikes them back down with powerful kicks. It is quite short-tempered in nature.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过雪山，用变化后的獠牙拨开积雪。登山客很乐意沿它们开出的路走，对它赞不绝口。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME slowly roam snowy mountains, using their modified tusks to move the snow aside. They are praised by hikers, who willingly use their trails.

entry: 这也许是最早发现的融合体之一。POKENAME的獠牙与利爪，虽覆着厚冰，却炽热得能刺穿岩石，甚至某些金属。它独来独往，陆上、空中，都凶悍善战。
author: merclipse
source: Perhaps one of the oldest Fusion discoveries. Although POKENAME's tusks and talons are coated in thick ice, they burn hot enough to puncture stone, even some metals. It's a fierce fighter both on land and airborne and lives in isolation.

entry: 这种驯化后的POKENAME，很受寒地居民欢迎，在暴风雪中，也睡得安安稳稳。
author: char_latte3412
source: This domesticated POKENAME variant is a popular partner for those in cold climates. It sleeps comfortably in blizzards.

entry: POKENAME容易动怒，心思又变幻莫测。唯有耐心、熟练的训练家与牧场主，才能驯服这古怪性情。
author: Trismon55555
source: POKENAME is both quick to anger and mentally unpredictable. Only patient and skilled Trainers and ranchers are able to tame their bizarre nature.

entry: 许多人相信，与POKENAME对视就会被控制心智，其实不然，那只是让你犯困罢了。
author: jaminmcready
source: Many believe that POKENAME has the ability to mind control anyone who looks into its eye. This is false, however; doing so only makes you feel sleepy.

entry: 红莲岛居民自古就流传着POKENAME的目击故事。描述虽各不相同，可亲见者都坚称，那是某种根本不该存在的东西。
author: sk372
source: For ages past, tales of POKENAME sightings have existed among the residents of Cinnabar Island. Accounts vary, but all who claimed to witness it agree it is something that simply should not be.

entry: 分离的肢体，平时随意绕着身体转，战斗时却能协同，从各面守护。连炮口也能脱离头部，从意想不到的角度开火。
author: sk372
source: Its detached limbs rotate around it randomly, but can synchronize in battle to defend itself from all sides. Even its cannon mouth can detach from its head to fire at foes from unorthodox angles.

entry: 一次异常的软件更新开始流传。下载后，POKENAME就开始给毫无戒心的训练家发送暗藏恶意软件的消息。
author: pankiwi
source: An unusual software update began circulating. Upon downloading it, POKENAME began delivering messages with hidden malware to unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME极其依恋训练家。为了不被放生，便把自己附在重要文件上。
author: zic
source: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their Trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.

entry: 这只数字鸟爱打听隐私，总装作什么也不懂，让人放心说出秘密。谁也不知道，这些秘密最终会被它说给谁。
author: SonTyp
source: This digital bird Pokémon is nosy and always looking to learn a person‘s secrets, feigning ignorance to lure them into a false sense of security. Nobody knows who it might share those secrets with.

entry: POKENAME尾尖都有奇怪的红色标记，似乎与人们对皮卡丘的一种普遍集体误记有关。
author: ohok3441
source: The odd red marking on the end of POKENAME's tail is common for the species. It appears to be related to a common false collective memory regarding Pikachu.

entry: POKENAME的叫声粗糙刺耳。训练家形容，像是位深压缩后的失真音。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's cry is scratchy and hard to listen to. Trainers have described it as "bit crushed".

entry: 体内数据太多，还被强迫进化，让POKENAME向外迸裂。宝可梦研究者正辉检查后说，它的重要代码里“缺了些数字”。
author: qecci
source: POKENAME was forced to evolve with too much data stored in its body, causing it to burst outwards. Pokémon Researcher Bill described it as "missing numbers" in vital parts of its code after examination.

entry: POKENAME会攻击一切靠近训练家的家伙，仿佛想把训练家，独占在自己身边。
author: mercury_sc
source: POKENAME attacks whoever approaches its Trainer. It's almost as if it wants its Trainer for only for itself.

entry: 它的刀刃不稳定，变幻无常。看似擦身而过的一击，可能恶化成各种怪伤；真切的利落刀伤，却又可能消失，仿佛从未发生。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its blade is unstable and erratic in nature. What may appear at first as a near miss from its edge can fester into all sorts of odd injuries, and a clean cut can simply vanish like it never happened.

entry: 为免POKENAME走到哪儿都掀起猛烈沙暴，人们改了程序。可一次失误，让它如今像吸尘器，没完没了地吸进沙子与碎屑。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME's programming was modified to stop them from whipping up powerful sandstorms wherever they went. Due to an error, they now incessantly suck in sand and debris like a vacuum.

entry: 光标状利爪，能剥光整棵树的皮。即使沙尘暴漆黑一片，POKENAME面罩般的眼，也能找出猎物。
author: Trismon55555
source: The cursor-like claws of POKENAME can tear the bark off an entire tree. Their visor-like eyes can detect prey even in pitch-black sandstorms.

entry: 恶意程序员原想造它服从命令，可POKENAME如今漫游网络，反倒帮助一切需要帮助的人。
author: thereversedguy
source: Designed by malicious programmers to obey their commands. However, POKENAME now surfs the cyberspace to aid anyone in need.

entry: 一次交易弄砸后，它进化成了POKENAME。身上的丝线，承载着过去失败的重量；据说，那也正是POKENAME防御力高得出名的原因。
author: ImaginaryNeon
source: Evolving after a deal gone wrong, POKENAME's strings bear the weight of their past failures. It is said that those strings are the source of POKENAME's infamously high defenses.

entry: POKENAME顽强异常，病毒横行的数据流里，也能生存。可外表粗糙古怪，似乎很少有训练家愿意靠近。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: POKENAME are extremely hardy and can live in data streams that are heavily infested with viruses. Because of its sketchy appearance, it seems as if few Trainers approach it.

entry: 与弱小的丑丑鱼融合，迫使多边兽Ｚ的图形处理器降到最低性能。因此，POKENAME才显得如此简陋。
author: mystora
source: Fusing with a weak Feebas forced Porygon-Z's GPU down to the minimum, which is why POKENAME looks so simple.

entry: 它吸来电子设备，强行抽走数据。吃下的字节越多，身体便越大。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: It attracts electronics to itself, ripping data from them and growing larger as it consumes more bytes.

entry: POKENAME总夹在现实与数字世界之间。闯进我们的世界时，常能见到它们，偷走烧坏的机械碎片。
author: dystopiancontrol
source: POKENAME are constantly caught between the real and digital world. When they breach into our world, they can be seen stealing bits of burnt machinery.

entry: 天敌靠近，它便亮出红腹，吓对方一跳。趁对方分心，再用弹簧般的尾巴，将自己弹出去逃走。
author: Staghorn
source: When a predator approaches, it flashes its red belly to startle them. Once the predator is distracted, it uses its spring-like tail to launch itself and make a getaway.

entry: POKENAME藏在林地，与繁茂植物融为一体，躲避天敌。万一被发现，也能飞快奔逃，钻进更深的丛林。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hide themselves on the forest floor, blending in with the lush plants to hide from predators. If spotted, it can quickly sprint away, deeper into the jungle.

entry: POKENAME深居最茂密的丛林。据说，触碰叶尾的人，会遭到诅咒，再被它掳走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives deep in the thickest jungles. It is said that those who touch its leafy tails will be cursed and stolen away.

entry: 身体明明不断长出叶片，里面却似乎空无一物。POKENAME让科学家困惑多年，仍未解开。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME has been puzzling scientists for years. While leaves keep growing out of it's body, POKENAME seems to be hollow.

entry: POKENAME的利刃由坚韧叶片构成，头盔则是层层叠起的植物茎。砍树的人，曾报告遭到它的攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's blades are made of sturdy leaves and the helmet it wears is made of layered plant stems. Those who fell trees have reported being attacked by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是丛林里脾气火爆的野生宝可梦，四处找对手打架。找不到，就改打粗壮的树。
author: dragonessanimations
source: POKENAME is a hot tempered wild Pokémon of the jungle. It searches for opponents to fight, and will instead attack thick trees if it cannot find one.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光，让力量增长。颈上与尾上的叶片，还能调节体温。
author: Escollari
source: A POKENAME absorbs sunlight to become stronger. The leaves on its neck and tail help regulate its body temperature.

entry: 背上原本繁茂的灌木，渐渐烧了起来。枝条永燃不熄，让它得格外小心，免得毁掉丛林家园。
author: dragonessanimations
source: What was once a lush bush on its back soon began burning. The sticks on its back burn forever; it has to be careful not to burn down its jungle home.

entry: 它从丛林细心采来珍稀树果，调成可口果汁。咖啡馆里，常能看见它们制作这杯饮料。
author: dragonessanimations
source: It carefully harvests rare berries from the jungle, using them to create a delightfully tasty juice. They are often found in cafés making this drink.

entry: POKENAME是无声的猎手，尾部的响声，与风拂树叶的沙沙声混在一起。它们熟练穿行灌木，直到扑中猎物，才会显露身影。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are silent hunters, the rattle of their tails blending in with the sound of leaves rustling in the wind. They expertly navigate the underbrush, only being seen when they strike their prey.

entry: POKENAME深夜疾驰于密林，快得惊人，却又悄然无声。能亲眼见到已难得，见它停下那永不停歇的荒野之行，更是难上加难。
author: HummusIsHome
source: POKENAME sprint through dense forests in the dead of night. The only thing rarer than seeing them in person is seeing them stop their relentless trek through the wilderness. Despite their unreal speed, they travel while staying perfectly silent.

entry: POKENAME过于沉重，途经森林或丛林时，往往不小心将其踩平。木哑铃会随后赶来，在遭到践踏的土地上重新播种。
author: dragonessanimations
source: Its immense weight means POKENAME accidentally tramples the forests and jungles it travels through. Treedums come along to reseed the trampled lands.

entry: 背上的种荚，终生不断长大。死后，种荚便爆开，在原地孕育出一片无比茂盛的草木。
author: dragonessanimations
source: The seed pod on its back grows throughout its life. Upon death, the seed pod will burst, creating an incredibly lush area of flora.

entry: 海面以下数英里，POKENAME播下茂盛的海底草木。住处位于深水森林中央，林子广袤得除了它，谁也穿不过。
author: sk372
source: Miles below the ocean surface, POKENAME seeds lush undersea vegetation. Its home is the center of a deep-water forest so vast that none but it have managed to navigate through.

entry: POKENAME能高速吐出锋利的内部结构，击中什么，就刺穿什么。不幸中招的宝可梦，随后便被它吃掉。
author: dragonessanimations
source: POKENAME can spit out its sharp insides with great speed, impaling anything it hits. Unfortunate Pokémon hit by this will then be consumed.

entry: 看尾巴，就能判断POKENAME的年纪。尾焰像蜡烛一样渐渐烧尽，彻底熄灭时，它也随之逝去。
author: dragonessanimations
source: A POKENAME's age can be determined by its tail. The flame will gradually burn down like a candle, the Pokémon passing once it's completely gone.

entry: POKENAME每周都爬上树冠，挑最锋利、能叼住的叶片，捕猎弱小生物。遇天敌逃跑时，POKENAME也会挥动厚尾，抵御追击。
author: Aurange
source: POKENAME climbs up to tree canopies every week to find the sharpest leaves it can hold in its mouth, which it uses to hunt weaker prey. POKENAME is also known to use its bulky tail to defend itself from predators while fleeing.

entry: POKENAME亲人，身体温暖，配色又鲜艳，很受年轻女性欢迎。进化后，战法会随抚养者与养育方式不同，发生巨大变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is popular with young women due to its affectionate nature, warm body, and bright colors. When it evolves, its fighting style changes dramatically depending on who raised it and how they raised it.

entry: 它一兴奋，金属铠甲就会升温，最高超过华氏500度。为免误燃草木，便住在没有植被的荒地。
author: Staghorn
source: Its metallic armor heats up whenever it gets excited, reaching a maximum temperature of over 500 degrees Fahrenheit. Because of this, it lives in badlands without plant matter that it could accidentally ignite.

entry: 火焰炽热无比，可POKENAME喷得不够快，只好先盘住对手，再近距离集中喷火，将其焚烧。
author: Glacierwing
source: The fire it makes is blazingly hot. POKENAME has trouble expelling it with enough speed, however, so it will wrap opponents in its coils before torching them with a concentrated blast.

entry: 融合时过剩的能量，烧光了大半羽毛。可留下的三根，如今却燃得和工业喷灯一样炽热。
author: Mistymagius
source: The excessive energy from fusion has burned off most of its feathers. However, its three remaining feathers now burn as hot as an industrial blowtorch.

entry: POKENAME亲切又好奇，温暖的性情，让它成为寒地的理想伙伴。小小身体散出的热，驱走冷意，也让周围安心舒适。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are affectionate and curious, their warm personalities making them ideal companions in cold climates. The heat radiating from their small bodies helps ward off the chill, bringing comfort to those around them.

entry: POKENAME盛满水的花中，放着一块蛋似的石头，原因不明。若把石头换成真蛋，短短几秒，便煮得全熟。
author: SonTyp
source: What looks like an egg is really a rock POKENAME carries within its water-filled blossom for unknown reasons. If you replace the rock with an egg, it's hard boiled within seconds.

entry: 背上的壳，就是它孵化时的旧壳，被热腹熔在背上。POKENAME热得能熔掉大多数接触之物，再借这些熔融材料，加固外壳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The shell on its back is actually the one it hatched from, melted onto its back from the heat of its warm belly. POKENAME emits enough heat to make most things it touches melt. It uses this molten material to strengthen its shell.

entry: 棍棒看着像美味烤肉，其实却是坚硬的锈块。它用免费大餐引诱贪吃宝可梦，再一棍打晕。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its club may look like delicious roast meat, but it is actually a tough lump of rust. It tempts gluttonous Pokémon with the prospect of a free meal, then knocks them out cold.

entry: 炎热夏夜，POKENAME会走进人的梦。可它究竟是梦中的英雄，还是恶棍，见过的人，说法从来不一。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears in people's dreams on hot summer nights. Witnesses cannot agree as to whether it acts as a villain or a hero in their dreams.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，便靠尾巴代劳。打赢一场战斗后，POKENAME还会用尾巴，与训练家击掌庆祝。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME relies on its tail as a substitute for its lack of arms. After achieving victory in battle, POKENAME will slap its Trainer's hand with its tail in celebration.

entry: 冬天，它不怎么活动，爱埋在土里。POKENAME供给附近植物的热与能量，竟让它们在严寒中，也长得欣欣向荣。
author: bobosmith01
source: It becomes inactive during winter, preferring to stay buried in the dirt. The heat and energy POKENAME provides to nearby plants makes sure they can unexpectedly flourish even in the cold.

entry: POKENAME会持续攻击靠近农场的掠食者，因此常被饲养在农场里。不过，它凶暴的性情也经常让农民头疼。
author: .realthree
source: POKEMAME is commonly kept on farms because it persistently attacks predators that approach the barnyard. However, its aggressive demeanor often leads it to be a nuisance to the farmers.

entry: 掘土时，利爪会共振出低低嗡鸣，吸引野生宝可梦。究竟是在传信，还是挖洞自然产生的现象，没人知道。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its claws resonate a low hum when digging through the ground. The frequency attracts wild Pokémon, though no one knows if it is a signal or a natural side effect of its burrowing.

entry: POKENAME搬起超过体重五倍的巨石，炫耀力气。重拳的威力，更足以夷平摩天大楼。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME show off their immense strength by carrying boulders over five times its weight. Their punches have enough force to level a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME能将强电流导向背刺。谁靠得太近，它便转身背对，射出尖刺。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can channel a strong electrical current through the spikes on its back. If someone gets too close, it turns its back on them and shoots its spikes.

entry: 人们曾以为，它是史前坠落地球的外星寄生物。传说还能控制时间，却从未有人亲见。
author: bostroms
source: It was once thought to be an alien parasite that fell to earth in prehistoric times.  Legend says it has the power to control time, but this has never been observed.

entry: 握在训练家手中时，POKENAME能挥出如刀般锋利的沙斩。可这一招，耗去的不只训练家体力，还有一部分生命力。
author: lemage22
source: When wielded by a Trainer, POKENAME can create slashes of sand with sharpness akin to its blades. However, using such a technique drains the Trainer's stamina and even some of their lifeforce.

entry: 它擅长从头到尾一起作战，前有利爪劈斩，后有刺尾重击。POKENAME也极会挖洞，转眼便能开出地道。
source: This Pokémon specializes in head to tail combat, in which it slashes enemies with its sharp claws and whacks them with its spiky tail. POKENAME is also a very efficient tunneler and can dig at rapid speeds.

entry: 有时，POKENAME用尖刺攀上棕榈，装成椰子。附近宝可梦一用头撞树，它便轰然坠下，发动伏击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sometimes POKENAME will roll up palm trees using its spikes and camouflages itself as a coconut. When a nearby Pokémon headbutts the tree, it comes crashing down as part of an ambush.

entry: 觅食辛劳一整天后，POKENAME最爱泡水休息，喷点火，就把池水变成临时温泉。背上的秋色“叶片”，也常让人误认，其实那是POKENAME的羽毛。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to soak after a long day of foraging. It breathes fire into the water to create an impromptu hot spring for relaxation. Many mistake its back to be covered in autumn-tinged leaves, but it is actually POKENAME's plumage.

entry: POKENAME使劲摇动尾巴，调节体热与血流。多余热量则化作火焰，从头上的囊喷出。
author: TeatedTiten
source: To regulate heat and blood flow, POKENAME vigorously shakes its tail.  Excess body heat is transferred into flares that spew out from the sac on its head.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跑到田野、山间，用走路草的身体，练习适合自己的踢技。即使没了双臂，也拦不住它。
author: Cascadeguy
source: At nighttime, POKENAME runs off to fields and mountains, spending its time adapting its kicking mastery in the body of an Oddish. The removal of its arms will not deter it at all.

entry: 有时融合后，POKENAME会保留力壮鸡的双臂。可比起手上功夫，它还是更愿磨炼踢技。
author: Cascadeguy
source: Sometimes during the fusion process, POKENAME keeps Combusken's arms instead of removing them. It would much rather continue mastering its kicking skills, though.

entry: 这只宝可梦宛如异国战士，一拳便能击碎混凝土柱。脾气又急，动不动就开打。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. Its punches can shatter concrete pillars in an instant. It has a short temper and is quick to battle.

entry: 这只宝可梦宛如异国战士，一拳便能击碎混凝土柱。脾气又急，动不动就开打。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. Its punches can shatter concrete pillars in an instant. It has a short temper and is quick to battle.

entry: POKENAME是行走的灾厄，雷与火交织的咆哮，传出数公里。它从一棵树跃向另一棵，身后便燃起山火。
author: Scapz
source: A roving calamity, POKENAME's roar of thunder and flame can be heard from kilometers away. As it leaps from tree to tree, forest fires ignite in its wake.

entry: POKENAME极力保护巨壳顶上巢中的蛋。双腿跺出的地震，威力足以震倒30层高楼。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective over the eggs within the nest atop its massive shell. Its legs are powerful enough to cause earthquakes that can topple 30-story buildings.

entry: 它们在寒冷群山高处筑起暖巢，以热气引来寻暖的猎物。猎物才落入网中不久，就成了POKENAME嘴里的微焦点心。
author: bobosmith01
source: They create warm nests high within cold mountain ranges, where their domain's ambient heat lures in unsuspecting prey seeking warmth. Shortly after being caught within its webs, POKENAME will devour their new lightly-charred snack.

entry: 羽毛极难燃烧，因此商店里，常能买到POKENAME羽毛制的枕头与被褥。
author: .realthree
source: Its feathers are very fire retardant, so it's common to see POKENAME-feather pillows and POKENAME-feather comforters for sale in stores.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半是液体，重塑形状便能变身。它爱住泥泞池塘，装成一堆土。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME transforms by reforming its mostly liquid body. It likes to reside in muddy ponds, and will disguise itself as mounds of dirt.

entry: POKENAME常藏在暖泥边，射出火星捕猎，再用水灭火，才把猎物吃掉。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME is often seen hiding around warm mud. It shoots embers to hunt prey and then uses water to extinguish the flames before eating.

entry: 它住在沼泽、河床附近幽暗湿泥中，既会游泳，也善挖洞，因此洞穴淹水，它也不在乎。
author: Staghorn
source: It lives in dark, muddy soil in swamps and around riverbeds. It's adept at both swimming and digging, so it doesn't mind when its burrows get flooded.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于丰缘近海的沉没遗迹，常聚在被大海淹没的失落古城。它们是在古城兴盛时就已效力，还是毁灭后才到来，研究者仍争论不休。
author: Katie
source: First found in sunken ruins off the Hoenn coast, POKENAME congregate in long-lost cities drowned by the ocean. Researchers debate if they served in these cities during their prime or arrived after their destruction.

entry: POKENAME待在沼泽，隐没泥中。游泳前，会尽可能多喝水，让身体能够浮起。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs around swampy areas, hiding amongst the mud. It will swallow as much water as it can to allow it to float while swimming.

entry: 浅溪岸边，布着POKENAME的地洞。它挖出深坑，排走漫溢的水，也让洪灾不易发生。
author: Ozydamians
source: The shores of shallow streams are spotted with the burrows of POKENAME. It prevents floods by digging deep holes to drain the overflowing water.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会用鼻子吹出催眠泡泡，让目标沉睡。之后如何，却始终是谜，因为中招者，再也没有出现。
author: Rakunk
source: Legends say POKENAME uses its trunk to blow hypnotic bubbles that lull its targets into a deep sleep. What happens afterward remains a mystery, as no one who has fallen victim to its spell has ever been seen again.

entry: POKENAME爱在浅水里泼水嬉戏，也常待在泳池，用自己的浮圈，帮助大家安全玩水。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME loves to splash around in shallow bodies of water. It is often found at pools, where it helps others stay safe using its flotation ring.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME用六片尾鳍，猛拍泥地。溅起的泥浆，往往烫得危险。
author: .realthree
source: If startled, POKENAME slaps its six tailfins against the mud. The slurry it splashes this way is often dangerously hot.

entry: POKENAME既擅游泳，也会飞行，本领全面，因此，常被派往世界各地执行搜索任务。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME is both an adept swimmer and an amazing flier. It is often used for search missions all over the world because of its versatility.

entry: 强壮的双臂与鳍，让POKENAME成为游泳好手。作战时，既有行云流水的连击，也有猛浪般的撞击。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert swimmers due to their strong arms and fins. Its combat style seems to be a mix of flowing strikes and crashing impacts.

entry: POKENAME尾端盛着的水，总混着当地土中的矿物。战斗时，四肢的发热部位，便映出体内火光。
author: .realthree
source: The water held at the end of POKENAME's tail is always sullied by minerals from the local soil. When battling, the heating elements on its arms and legs glow with internal fire.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，不摆鳍，而靠念力游动，水面上极其少见。据说，能看见它，便会交好运。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to bring good luck to anyone who sees it, POKENAME is a rare sight on the surface. It lives in the deep ocean, using its psychic powers to swim instead of its fins.

entry: 头角能感知思想与情绪。一察觉周围一定范围内，有谁心怀敌意，它就先爆炸自卫，再瞬间移动离开。
author: Celio_0230
source: The horn on its head senses thoughts and emotions. If it senses a hostile thought from within a certain radius around it, it explodes in self-defense before teleporting away.

entry: 它感知波导，连最微弱的负面情绪，也能察觉。想以心灵感应分享这种感受，却常被误以为在施展超能力攻击。
author: Staghorn
source: Its aura-reading abilities can identify even the tiniest hints of negative emotion. Its attempts to telepathically share these experiences are often mistaken for psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME的超能力，借与波导的联系显现出来。可身体太小，还不太控制得住。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities manifest through its connection to aura. Due to its small body, it has difficulty controlling these powers.

entry: 它钱币状的角会扰乱附近的数据存储与测量设备，恶名远扬。许多图鉴资料因此不得不重写，熔岩蜗牛的体温就是一例。
author: epping_forest
source: Its coin-shaped horn is infamously known to scramble data storage and measuring devices around it. Many dex entries had to be rewritten due to incorrect measurements caused by it, such as Magcargo's body temperature.

entry: 危险的登山道上，常能遇见POKENAME。凭着力气与感知情绪的能力，它们会寻找、营救受伤的登山者。
author: TheTapeMaster
source: POKENAME are commonly found residing on dangerous hiking trails. With their strength and empathic abilities, they are known to find and rescue injured hikers.

entry: POKENAME一高兴，便旋转、雀跃，体内也随之发电。跳起舞来，火花四散，噼啪作响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins and prances about when in high spirits. This twirling generates electricity within its body, so sparks and small crackles of electricity emanate from it as it dances.

entry: 古人留下的记录说，POKENAME曾向他们展示图像，模样竟与现代人类文明，分毫相合。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Ancient peoples' recorded interactions with this Pokémon tell of POKENAME showing them images that accurately resemble modern human civilization.

entry: 很久以前，人们常把POKENAME送给刚为人父母的夫妇。据说，构成身体的布料，比风妖精的棉絮还软。
author: inksans201x
source: Many years ago, POKENAME was often gifted to new parents. The fabric of its body is said to be softer than Whimsicott cotton.

entry: 这只宝可梦极弱，遇袭不逃，反想拿毛发般的布料遮护自己，可大多也挡不住。
author: mystora
source: This Pokémon is extremely weak. Instead of running, it tries to uses its hair-like cloth to protect itself from attacks, usually unsuccessfully.

entry: POKENAME用念力呈现温暖、安全的幻象，引诱猎物靠近。等距离够了，毒刺便猛然扎下，猎物再看穿骗局，也已太迟。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME lure prey by projecting images of safety and warmth with their psychic powers, tricking targets into approaching. Once close enough, they strike with toxic stingers, revealing the ruse too late for their victims.

entry: POKENAME跃过敌人头顶，撒下令人衰弱的孢子。它们的舞步，也繁复而精巧。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME leap over opponents, scattering debilitating spores from above. They perform intricate dances.

entry: 对POKENAME而言，训练家也是家人，和亲生孩子一样重要。它百般疼宠、纵容，甚至想把人也装进育儿袋。
author: sk372
source: To POKENAME, its Trainer is its family and as important as its own child. It will dote on them, spoil them, and even try to carry them in its pouch.

entry: 它用利刃狩猎，也用来保护途经领地的船。因POKENAME出手相助，许多船只才躲过狂暴宝可梦的袭击。
author: sk372
source: It uses its blades for hunting, but also for defending boats that pass through its territory. Many ships have been saved from rampaging Pokémon due to POKENAME's intervention.

entry: 融合令食欲大增，每天要吃数百磅食物。这些养分，正供给它无可比拟的超能力。
author: Skymaster426
source: Its appetite grows when it is fused, motivating it to eat several hundreds of pounds of food each day. This food fuels its unmatched psychic powers.

entry: 不论有风无风，围巾始终飘扬。与POKENAME结成深厚情谊，需要漫长时间，可据说，做到的训练家，一生都能蒙受好运。
author: darxer_
source: Its scarf will always wave, regardless of the breeze. It takes a long time to forge a strong bond with POKENAME, but when Trainers do, their life is said to have good fortune.

entry: 它像陀螺般疾转，超能力还会继续加速，光影耀目，看得敌人晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: It spins like a top at incredible speeds. Its psychic abilities amplify the rotation, creating a dazzling yet disorienting display.

entry: 它凭超能力与天生感应雷电的本领，找出世界各地雷暴中迷路的人，随即瞬移到身旁，送往安全处。
author: sk372
source: It uses psychic powers in conjunction with an innate connection to lightning to sense those lost within raging thunderstorms across the world. It teleports to their side instantly in order to take them to safety.

entry: 传说，海船将遇大风暴，海面却骤然平静，得以安然通过。船上方的POKENAME，正以念力安抚怒海，保护船中的人。
author: sk372
source: Legends speak of ships about to meet extreme storms, before the oceans stilled suddenly, allowing safe passage. Above the ships, POKENAME could be seen, calming the sea with its psychic powers to protect the humans aboard.

entry: 刺耳的尖啸，先让敌人动弹不得。随后注入的毒液，便锁紧关节，令皮肤冰冷、苍白。
author: VaporVenator
source: Its piercing screech renders foes unable to move. It then delivers a venom that locks up their joints and leaves them with cold, pale skin.

entry: POKENAME能精准控制双尾的电压，许多医院都请它协助除颤。它聪慧又仁慈，施多大强度，始终恰到好处。
author: sk372
source: Able to perfectly control the voltage from its twin tails, many hospitals employ POKENAME to help with defibrillation. Highly intelligent and compassionate, it always knows precisely the right amount of intensity to apply.

entry: 剑术举世无双，忠心至死不改，让它成为不容小觑的战士。为保护所爱，即使强敌当前，也毫不畏惧。
author: cheroace
source: Its peerless swordsmanship and undying loyalty make it a force to be reckoned with. It will fearlessly stand against any foe if it means protecting those it loves.

entry: POKENAME有强大的超能力，却不拿来争斗。遇险时，便靠它悬浮、瞬移，远离威胁。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have powerful psychic abilities. They use them to float and to teleport away from threats rather than battle.

entry: 据说，若人类遭遇来自群星之外的灾祸，POKENAME便会降临，以生命为燃料制造强大黑洞，击退入侵者。
author: sk372
source: It is said that, were humanity to face disaster from beyond the stars, POKENAME will descend from on high to protect it, repelling the invaders with powerful black holes fueled by its very life force.

entry: POKENAME高悬在训练家上空，借敏锐目力与念力侦察远方。前方一有危险，就迅速落下，托起训练家，带到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats high above its Trainer, scouting the distances with its strong eyesight and psychic powers. Should it sense anything dangerous ahead, it will quickly descend to its Trainer and lift them away to safety.

entry: POKENAME爱把心爱的人、物包进网里，留在近旁，妥善保护。可察觉对方想走，即使POKENAME难过，也仍会放开。
author: Hello_I_Exist
source: POKENAME has a tendency to wrap people and things its fond of in webs to keep them close and safe. However, it will let them go if they sense they wish to be freed, even if it saddens POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会寻找拉鲁拉丝，保护它们，再带到食物充足、遮蔽完善的安全地方。
author: zic
source: POKENAME seeks out Ralts to protect them from harm. It then takes them to a safe place with plenty of shelter and food.

entry: POKENAME以可爱温柔的外貌亲近人类，好就近保护。据说，防御的最后手段，是将来犯者吸进布下藏着的黑洞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a cute and gentle appearance to endear itself to humans so it may protect them. It's said that as a defensive last resort, it will suck attackers into a black hole nestled beneath its cloth.

entry: 据说，POKENAME腹上的眼，能看见内心最深的愿望。愿望纯净，便会实现；若心怀邪念，便将你永远封进水晶。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME is said to be able to see your deepest wish with the eye on its stomach. If your wish is pure, it will be granted, but if your wish is wicked, it will trap you in crystal forever.

entry: 化石表明，POKENAME曾与人类远祖近邻而居。有人推测，它曾保护祖先，抵御天敌；若没它出力，也许就不会有今天的人类。
author: sk372
source: Fossil records indicate POKENAME lived in close proximity to humanity's ancient ancestors. Some speculate it guarded them from predators, and that humanity might not exist if not for its efforts.

entry: 它从林地捡来橡实，集中念力。若没这些橡实，力量就会变得飘忽，难以掌控。
author: .izik
source: It gathers acorns from the forest floor, which it uses to focus its telekinetic powers. Without these, its abilities become erratic and less controlled.

entry: POKENAME调节共情之角的灵敏度，感知整座城的情绪，再用耳朵播出含着潜意识讯息的高振幅超声波，改善人们的心情。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME adjusts the sensitivity of its empathic horn to assess the feelings of entire cities. It helps improving the mood of the people using its ears to broadcast high amplitude ultrasounds that contain subliminal messages.

entry: 它鳞片落下的粉末，在古代十分珍贵。提炼之后，便能制成效力强劲、效果可靠的安眠药。
author: .izik
source: The powder falling from its scales was prized in ancient times. When refined, it served as a powerful and reliable sleep aid.

entry: POKENAME训练举重时，会用念力增加负荷。紧要关头，又减轻自身所受重力，让速度成倍提升。
author: Rotcivosk
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to increase the weight it lifts when training. When in a pinch, POKENAME will decrease the force of gravity on itself to become exponentially faster.

entry: POKENAME的大脑包在引力奇点里，宛如黑洞。它本能地用超能力减轻引力，免得吞掉周围一切，形成事件视界。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's brain is encapsuled within a gravitational singularity, like a Black Hole. It unconsciously uses its psychic powers to lighten its own gravity pull, so it doesn't swallow everything around it and create an event horizon.

entry: POKENAME的大脑封在奇点中，仿佛一颗小黑洞。它下意识地用念力降低引力，阻止自身形成事件视界。
author: epping_forest
source: A POKENAME's brain is capsuled within a singularity, resembling a miniature black hole. It subconsciously uses its psychic powers to lessen its gravitational pull, preventing itself from creating an event horizon.

entry: 战斗时，它挥舞宽大扁平的羽毛，宛如锋利手斧。每一击都精准，破坏力也惊人。
author: .izik
source: It wields its large, flat feathers like sharpened hatchets during combat. Each strike is both precise and devastating.

entry: 双臂极适合划水，让它轻轻松松，就能制造漩涡、高速游动。
author: Staghorn
source: Its arms are extremely hydrodynamic, allowing it to create whirlpools and swim at high speeds with little effort.

entry: 身体虽圆胖，出击却快得让敌人猝不及防，想找机会反击，也十分困难。
author: .izik
source: Despite its rotund body, it surprises foes with incredible speed when launching an attack. Its swiftness makes it a difficult target to counter.

entry: POKENAME以回收金属造出机甲，自己驾驶，智慧非凡。它用触手操纵装置，还不断改造，因此每只POKENAME的机甲，都独一无二。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME pilots a mech suit it built from salvaged metal, showcasing its extraordinary intelligence. Using its tentacles to operate the controls, it constantly upgrades its creation, making every POKENAME's mech unique.

entry: 它用锋利的双刃，守护作为家园的森林。谁想伤害林间生命，便会遭它毫不留情地斩下。
author: cheroace
source: It strives to protect the forest it calls home using its sharp blades. It will mercilessly cut down anyone trying to bring harm to the wildlife.

entry: 它振动大翅膀，向空中撒出迷幻粉末，操控敌人心智，让其晕头转向、破绽百出。
author: .izik
source: It uses its large wings to disperse a psychedelic powder into the air. The substance manipulates the minds of foes, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable.

entry: 它曾无休止地训练、战斗，直到身体再也承受不住。如今平日虽一动不动，迎敌时仍迅捷、精准，仿佛灵魂还在驱使身体，不断变强。
author: sk372
source: It trained and fought endlessly until its body simply couldn't take any more. Though normally motionless, it can still fight opponents with swift and precise movements, as if its spirit still guides the body to grow ever stronger.

entry: POKENAME人称“森林死神”，会跟随将走到生命尽头的虫宝可梦。若在POKENAME身边死去，会发生什么，却无人知晓。
author: Frokachu
source: Known as the 'Reaper of the Forest", POKENAME follow bug Pokémon around that are near the end of their life. It is unknown what happens when they pass in the presence of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，寻找迷路的训练家，慢慢吸走能量，直到人站不起来。成对的铃铛响，会跟在POKENAME身旁，护它周全。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME silently glide during the night, looking for lost Trainers to slowly drain their energy until they can no longer stand. Pairs of Chingling follow POKENAME to protect them from danger.

entry: POKENAME能收回流失的熵，以焦耳每开尔文计，化作攻击，让熵归零。这力量或能成为无尽能源，可从没有POKENAME，肯为此配合。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can revert entropy to zero, for it invokes lost joules/kelvin to cast attacks. This power means the potential of an infinite energy source, but no POKENAME has ever cooperated to this purpose.

entry: POKENAME空有这副体格，一生却大多静止不动。任何东西钻进背上的孔，便再也不见踪影。
author: bee4082
source: Despite its size, POKENAME remains mostly motionless throughout the course of its life. Anything that enters the hole on its back is never seen again.

entry: 若听见头顶POKENAME不祥的嗡鸣，千万别抬头。谁看进它中空的腹底，就会被吸入内里的深渊，再也不会回来。
author: sk372
source: Should one hear the ominous hum of a POKENAME hovering above, they must avoid looking up at all costs. Those who gaze into its hollow underside will be sucked into the abyss within, never to be seen again.

entry: 古籍中，POKENAME现身预示着万物终焉。传说终有一日，所有生命都会被拉入空壳，化为燃料，让宇宙重新轮回。
author: sk372
source: Certain ancient records state the sight of POKENAME is a harbinger of the end of existence. The stories say all life will one day be pulled into its hollow shell and used as fuel to reincarnate the universe anew.

entry: 脱壳忍者聚在POKENAME附近，有些还在看似空心的壳内进出。有人相信，钻进去的脱壳忍者，是在存放窃来的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: Shedinja congregate near POKENAME, some venturing in and out of its seemingly hollow shell. Some believe those that Shedinja entering POKENAME's body are storing the spirits they've stolen within its confines.

entry: POKENAME动作快、踢力重，空心体内还会散出孢子。有些迷信的研究者说，在显微镜下看某颗孢子太久，它就会偷走你的灵魂。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME moves swiftly, kicks hard and releases spores from its hollow insides. Some superstitious researchers believe that each spore can steal your soul if you look at them for too long in the microscope.

entry: 两颗头都不争主导，因此能配合得分毫不差。望见POKENAME的人，却会莫名悲伤，仿佛失去了一位素未谋面的挚爱。
author: Ozydamians
source: Neither head takes the lead, allowing them to move with perfect synchronization. Those who look upon POKENAME feel as though they grieve the loss of a beloved partner they never met.

entry: POKENAME是一种罕见的土居忍士，在蜕壳中途死去。据说，往它背上的裂缝里看，便会被夺去灵魂。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME is a rare form of Nincada which died in the middle of removing its shell. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

entry: 传闻，尾焰就是这副空心身躯，灵魂最后的余火。若有人将它浇灭，它便会吸走那人的灵魂，重新燃起火来。
author: sk372
source: The flame on its tail is rumored to be the last embers of the hollow body's soul. Superstitions say dousing the flame will cause it to suck out the soul of the perpetrator to replenish the fire anew.

entry: 许多训练家说，POKENAME中空身体的漆黑深处，仿佛有眼睛凝望。可凑近查看，又什么也没有。活着的人里，没人知道它究竟怎样移动、行走。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Many Trainers claim to feel eyes staring out from the inky abyss of POKENAME's hollowed out body. However, upon closer examination there is nothing inside. No one alive knows how it moves or walks.

entry: 成群POKENAME常游荡沉船，挑战一切敢靠近的家伙。灰色藻丝能感知极细微的水中振动，既是警报，也为它们指引深海之路。
author: matpal6
source: Groups of POKENAME often roam shipwrecks, challenging all who dare to approach. Its grey algae, able to sense the slightest vibrations in the water, serves as both a warning system and a guide through the depths.

entry: 没人看过POKENAME庇身处的内部。谁想撬开或打破，都会被拉进去，再也不见踪影。
author: kittyluv090
source: Nobody has ever seen what is within POKENAME's shelter. Those who attempt to pry or break it open get pulled in, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME的宝石全被挖走，只剩空空躯体。曾冠在头顶的那颗，如今碎片永远悬浮，仿佛凝在被取出的瞬间。
author: Wormspawn
source: All POKENAME's gems have been mined away, leaving only a hollow body. The gem that crowned its head now forever hovers in pieces, frozen in the moment of extraction.

entry: 它看似空心，纹丝不动，内部却传出微弱超能力波动。若盯着背洞太久，便会偏头痛得难以行动。
author: sk372
source: It appears hollow and immobile, but faint psychic waves can be sensed from within. Those that stare too long into the hole in its back will develop a crippling migraine.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是一只宝可梦斗志的化身。至于究竟是哪一只，可就难以查证了。
author: Dusknoir64
source: Legends say that POKENAME is a manifestation of the fighting spirit of a Pokémon. Proving which Pokémon has been difficult, though.

entry: 黄昏，它微微发光的身体现身，让人注意到角上的符文。研究者仍不明白，这些符号有什么用。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its faintly glowing body appears during twilight, drawing attention to the runic markings on its horn. Researchers have yet to understand their purpose.

entry: POKENAME虽相当常见，野外却难找到。它们不爱动，又与环境融得天衣无缝，训练家每天，可能就与数百只POKENAME擦肩而过。
author: RaginCajunNacho
source: Despite being quite common, it can be very difficult to find POKENAME in the wild. Between their lack of movement and ability to camouflage perfectly with their environment, Trainers walk past hundreds of POKENAME daily.

entry: 它生出的蛋，颜色各异，分别治疗不同症状，疲倦、恶心、失眠等等，都有专门的一种。
author: sk372
source: The eggs it creates come in a variety of colors. Each color signifies a different ailment the egg is specially made for treating, such as fatigue, nausea, insomnia, and so forth.

entry: POKENAME遇险不变色，反倒瘫软下来，装成毛绒玩具。演得太像，孩子常把它们当真玩偶，抱回家去。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Instead of changing color, POKENAME will go limp when it senses danger, acting like a plushie.  They play the role so well that often children mistake them as actual stuffed toys and take them home.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能用长象鼻，够到高处的叶与果。POKENAME还把点心分给更小的宝可梦，是大家的好朋友。
author: odditylad
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME uses its long trunk to reach leaves and fruits at great heights. POKENAME shares these snacks with smaller Pokémon and is known as a friend to all.

entry: 腹部孔洞中，会伸出四条蛇样的长舌。被好奇的POKENAME舔上，谁都难免觉得难受、不自在。
author: Staghorn
source: Its four serpentine tongues emerge through holes in its abdomen. Being licked by an inquisitive POKENAME is a universally distressing and unpleasant experience.

entry: POKENAME用舌状触须，抓取远处猎物。身体寒冷无比，一碰，便能像胶一样冻黏在一起。
author: tuneless.towa
source: POKENAME catches its prey from a distance with its tongue-like tendrils. The extreme cold of its body makes them stick like glue.

entry: POKENAME变成沙地的颜色，伏着等猎物靠近。有时太过入戏，什么都忘了，竟会连着几周，都以为自己真是沙子。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME changes its color to match the sand it's lying on, waiting for its prey to get close enough. Sometimes, it gets so much in character that it forgets everything and spends weeks thinking it's made of sand.

entry: 它筑巢毫不隐蔽，就选在大丛树果旁，囤起、吃掉大半，只留少许繁衍新株。不吃时，便懒懒躺着，常常睡去。
author: bobosmith01
source: It makes its nest in an unsubtle place: directly next to large bushes of Berries, where it hoards and eats nearly all of them, leaving only a few so that they can regrow into new plants. When it is not eating, it lazes about, often sleeping.

entry: POKENAME虽会伪装，可往往只要动得比肉眼更快，谁也看不见它。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Though POKENAME are adept at camouflage, they can often remain unseen simply by moving faster than can be detected by the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME饮食简单，性情单纯，是颇容易照料的宠物。尾焰会随心情变色，开不开心，一眼便知。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a relatively easy pet to care for, with a simple diet and disposition. In addition, the flame on its tail changes color based on its mood, making it easy to tell when it is content or not.

entry: 夜里的POKENAME，是最危险的猎手。伪装本领高超得很，连铁丝网的花纹，也能模仿出来。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: At night, POKENAME are the most dangerous predators. Their camouflage ability is so advanced they can mimic the pattern of a chain-linked fence.

entry: 它能够完美伪装成70,000多种树木。人们推测它是伏击型的捕食者，但至今所有观察它进食的尝试都失败了。
author: Staghorn
source: It can perfectly disguise itself as over 70,000 different species of tree. It's theorized to be an ambush predator, but all attempts to observe it while feeding have failed.

entry: 身体的颜色能随意改变，可皮下露出的宝石，光彩太迷人，反而使它很难藏好。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: It is capable of changing the color of its body at will. However, the glimmering gems that peek through its skin are so mesmerizing that it struggles to successfully disguise itself.

entry: POKENAME改变双翼的颜色、花纹，吓退天敌。盯着翅膀太久，眼前的景象，也可能跟着扭曲。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME changes the colors and patterns on its wings to ward off predators. If you stare at its wings for too long, your vision may become distorted.

entry: POKENAME能随意改变两颗头的颜色，甚至各用一种。身体自动染成两色的混合色，唯独条纹，始终鲜红。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the color of their heads at will, even to two different colors if they so wish. Their bodies automatically change to the mixed color of the two heads, but their stripes will always remain red.

entry: POKENAME借粉红条纹融入珊瑚礁，也会藏进沙地，靠尾巴随时调整方向、抓取物件。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the pink stripes along their body to help blend in with coral reefs. They camouflage into the sand, using their tails to redirect and grasp things at a moment's notice.

entry: 调查中，人们发现有些构造简单的古怪岩群，竟会移动。最近才知，那其实是POKENAME，借岩石的颜色、纹理，藏住自己的条纹。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Odd rock formations with fairly simple compositions have been reported to shift during investigations. These formations have recently been discovered to be POKENAME, using the colors and textures of rocks to hide their stripes.

entry: POKENAME不靠滚动赶路，而是短暂悬浮半空，转动身体，用独眼打量四周。它展现过惊人的智慧。
author: bobosmith01
source: Instead of rolling to travel around, POKENAME tends to levitate for short periods of time and spins around, surveying its surroundings with its single eye. POKENAME has been shown to be remarkably intelligent.

entry: 这种融合体酷似超级球，却没有收服的功能。有人借POKENAME，论证霹雳电球与精灵球的起源，可能有关联。
author: bobosmith01
source: This fusion resembles a Great Ball, but it lacks any corresponding functionality. Theorists use POKENAME as evidence to support a link between Voltorb and the creation of the Poké Ball.

entry: POKENAME主要生活在水里，铁质皮肤却从不生锈。蜕下的金属皮，也因这份稳定耐蚀，十分抢手。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's iron skin does not rust, despite it primarily living in water. Once shed, the metallic skin is coveted for these inert properties.

entry: POKENAME振翅发出嗡鸣，借此产生磁力。声音越响，磁力越强。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME buzzes with its wings to generate magnetic force. The louder the noise, the more powerful the magnetism.

entry: POKENAME的铁躯里，封着发育完全的大脑。每个细胞都在一同成长、变强，齐心让它更加强大。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has a fully-developed brain trapped in its iron body. Every cell is growing stronger, working as one so this Pokémon can be powerful.

entry: 没有嘴，它如今只能用铁身撞击猎物。幸好，POKENAME再笨拙，也不会把自己撞伤了。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon now rams prey with its iron body since it does not have a mouth. Fortunately, POKENAMES's clumsiness no longer causes itself harm.

entry: 收服后的POKENAME，常帮人深挖矿藏。巨眼扫描泥土，比人造机器都快，耳状附肢挖起来，也快得惊人。
author: TheHeroicT
source: Captured POKENAME are used to dig deep for valuable ores. Their large eye can scan through dirt faster than any machine made by humans, and their ear-like appendages can dig extremely fast too.

entry: 它虽看不大清周围，行动却十分灵活。撞上物体时，铁甲也能护住身体。
author: ziggaway
