source: Even though it can't see its surroundings very well, this Pokémon is very mobile. Its iron armor protects its body when smashing into objects.

entry: 与嘴相比，身体小得不可思议。它用嘴里的眼睛探查，等着金属猎物到来。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon's body is incredibly small compared to its mouth. It waits for metallic prey that it detects using the eye inside its mouth.

entry: 这只宝可梦爱用铁头，撞遍身边的一切。不过，POKENAME仍在努力学习，怎样用磁力悬浮。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon headbutts everything around it with its iron head. POKENAME is still working on levitating with its magnetic capabilities, however.

entry: POKENAME表面越亮、越光滑，身体就越健康。POKENAME金属身躯坚韧，机械外貌利落，在先进城区很受欢迎，还能接入密集地区的电网，补充能量。
author: entomoxie
source: The shinier and smoother the surface of a POKENAME, the healthier. POKENAME are popular in futuristic areas due to their durable metal bodies and clean mechanical looks. They can connect to electrical grids for energy in high-density areas.

entry: POKENAME的火，连最坚固的金属也能熔掉。最初，人们在金黄市附近发现它。
author: Ayutac
source: POKENAME's flame is hot enough to melt even the strongest metals. It was first seen around Saffron City.

entry: 爪钩般的结构，组成它的獠牙。它定期磨利牙尖，让磁力讯息，传得更加精准。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon has tusks made from claw-like hooks. It regularly sharpens these tusks, helping them transmit its magnetic communications more precisely.

entry: 找猎物时，它从眼睛射出红色探照光。一见目标，便迅速闪动，晃得猎物辨不清方向。
author: .izik
source: When searching for prey, it will shine a red spotlight from its eye. When it sees a victim, the light will flash rapidly to disorient the target.

entry: 体内伸出的棉絮状物质，像翅膀一样摆动。虽然飞不快，却能一次留在空中，好几天不落下。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance that comes out of its body moves like wings. While it cannot fly at high speeds, it can stay airborne for days at a time.

entry: POKENAME虽是金属身体，却十分脆弱。全部能量，都只用来维持磁力，免得身体散开。
author: ziggaway
source: Despite being made of metal, POKENAME is incredibly vulnerable. All of its energy is focused on using its magnetic powers to hold its body together.

entry: 它的爪子比铁火龙更尖，可力气不足。不过，攻击上欠缺的，防御却补得回来。
author: Ayutac
source: It has sharper claws than Belmander, but they are lacking in strength. What it is missing in offense, though, it makes up in defense.

entry: 这只宝可梦由三只铁哑铃，以磁力连接而成。若金属物品被吸向地面，说明地下，就有一只POKENAME。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon consists of three Beldum held together with magnetism. When metallic objects are pulled toward the dirt, there's a POKENAME underground.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，比任何科学造出的镜片都强。修习神秘之术的人，常借POKENAME窥看遥远之处。
author: Ozydamians
source: A POKENAME's eye is more powerful than any lens produced by science. Occult practitioners use POKENAME to spy across vast distances.

entry: 有人发现，一位天文学家曾借POKENAME，窥见遥远行星，随即引起争论。POKENAME眼中的每个世界，都是漆黑、扭曲的噩梦。
author: ozydamians
source: Controversy arose when it was discovered an astronomer used POKENAME to glimpse visions of distant planets. Every world seen by POKENAME was a dark and twisted nightmare.

entry: 直视POKENAME的眼，除非意志最坚定，否则便会僵直失神。神秘学者声称，它能看尽凝视之物的一切，过去、当下、未来，无一遗漏。
author: Ozydamians
source: To behold the eye of POKENAME renders all but the strongest of wills catatonic. Mystics claim that it can see every aspect of what it turns its gaze to, past, present, and future.

entry: POKENAME身形庞大，蛇状身体由坚韧金属构成。它钻入地下深处，蓄力突袭毫无防备的敌人。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a large Pokémon with a serpentine body crafted from a tough, metallic material. It can burrow deep into the ground, using its strength to launch surprise attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME把铁哑铃带在躯干的凹槽内，护它安全。POKENAME还会寻找同类，好让自己的铁哑铃，遇上另一只，融合成金属怪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries Beldum around in a hollow slot in its torso, protecting it from harm. POKENAME seeks out others of its kind so its Beldum can meet another and merge into Metang.

entry: POKENAME智慧卓越，不会被怒火夺去理智。它们悬浮海上，仔细寻找符合严苛标准的猎物。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME's superior intellect prevents them from losing control to anger. They hover over oceans, scanning for prey that meets their high standards.

entry: 头重脚轻得厉害，让它不大站得稳。POKENAME却会向其他电宝可梦射出火花，证明自己有胆量。
author: leonian1586
source: It's incredibly top-heavy, so it has trouble staying upright. POKENAME shoots sparks at other Electric-type Pokémon to prove its bravery.

entry: 身体变得无比坚硬后，这只宝可梦又长出了一颗大脑。可POKENAME几乎动弹不得，反而更加渴望力量与自由。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon's body grew incredibly hard and developed another brain. However, POKENAME can barely move, and yearns even more for power and freedom.

entry: POKENAME极其稀少，也难得寻见，既能轻松拳穿金属墙，也听得懂人话。进化之后，它只会更聪明。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare and elusive Pokémon, possessing both the strength to effortlessly punch through metal walls and the intelligence to understand human speech. It only grows more intelligent with evolution.

entry: 炽烈火焰配上强劲双臂，任何路障也挡不住。传闻，西尔佛公司还想给它添双翅膀，让它真正势不可挡。
author: Ayutac
source: With its intense flame and powerful arms, it can break through any barricade. It is rumored Silph Co. is trying to give it wings to make it truly unstoppable.

entry: 西尔佛公司的秘密成果，如今终于会飞，可也失去了一些热量与力气。公司仍在设法改进。
author: Ayutac
source: Silph Co.'s secret project can now fly, but in exchange for that, it lost some of its heat and strength. Silph Co. is working on an improvement.

entry: 四颗大脑住在体内，每天耗去大量能量。需要认真思考时，它便滚进发电厂，吸电为大脑加把劲。
author: Celio_0230
source: It hosts four brains within its body, which uses up a lot of energy over the course of a day. When it needs to think hard, this Pokémon rolls into power plants, absorbing electricity to supercharge their brains.

entry: POKENAME的四颗脑，带来完美记忆，见过什么，就能变成什么。它们也是全身唯一的固体部分。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's four brains give it a perfect memory, letting it transform into anything it's seen before. These brains are the only solid part of its body.

entry: POKENAME悬浮的双臂，能储下多余电力，再以微小电击释放。插进任何插座，还能充当充电器。
author: germs2128
source: POKENAME's floating arms store excess electricity and shoot it out in small shocks. They can plug into any outlet, and they can be used as a charger.

entry: POKENAME的钢壳，几乎坚不可摧，护住内部正在进化的身体。任何想惊扰进化的家伙，都会被四只巨爪撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's steel shell is near impervious, protecting its evolving body within. Its massive four claws will rend apart anything that attempts to disturb its evolution process.

entry: 速度、力量、智慧，无可比拟，让POKENAME成了史前两栖顶级猎手。化石记录表明，连怪颚龙，也常落入它口中。
author: sk372
source: With unmatched speed, strength and intelligence, POKENAME was an amphibious apex predator of prehistory. Fossil records indicate even hunting Tyrantrum as prey was not uncommon.

entry: 有研究认为，POKENAME没有灵魂。这结果是否可信，又意味着什么，常引起学界讨论。
author: ImaginaryNeon
source: Research has been done on POKENAME that suggests they do not have souls. The validity and implications of these results are often brought up in scientific discussions.

entry: 骇人坚固的金属身躯，四颗智慧超群的大脑，加上压倒性的力量，让POKENAME成为活的灾难。力气可怕，头脑更得小心。
author: ziggaway
source: A terribly strong metal body, four hyper-intelligent brains, and overwhelming power make POKENAME a living catastrophe. Beware its brains and brawn!

entry: 凭着高超智慧，它一眼便能看清，任何东西最薄弱的地方。精算之后，用金属头骨一撞，敌人失去行动能力，建筑也顷刻粉碎。
author: sk372
source: With its high intelligence, it can quickly ascertain the weakest spot on anything it spies. This makes it easily capable of incapacitating foes or shattering structures with a single calculated strike of its metallic skull.

entry: POKENAME的耳能感知磁波，便于更快找出惯常猎物：小磁怪与朝北鼻。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME's ears are used for sensing magnetic waves. This allows them to find their usual prey, Magnemite and Nosepass, more efficiently.

entry: POKENAME身体太弱，只得靠金属附肢四处爬动。它偏爱独居，谁敢入侵，便猛扑过去。
author: darxer_
source: Because POKENAME's body is so weak, it uses metal appendages to skitter around. It prefers to live in solitude and will launch itself at any intruders.

entry: 两只聪明绝顶的宝可梦融合，让POKENAME智力无双。可它得不停施展念力，免得自己的凝胶，腐蚀支撑身体的金属腿。
author: VoidDx01
source: As the fusion of two very intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME is unrivaled in intelligence. However, it has to constantly use its psychic powers to prevent its gel from damaging the metal legs supporting it.

entry: 四肢上的“利爪”，其实是额外的尖牙，能咬住、吸血。POKENAME只要任意一点尖端，刺中对手，就能饱餐一顿。
author: sk372
source: What appear to be claws on each limb are actually additional fangs, capable of biting and absorbing blood. As long as even one of POKENAME's points punctures a foe, it can feast on them.

entry: 想在激烈竞争中立足，像样的珠宝店都会聘用POKENAME。可它们鉴得太细，倒霉的小碎钻，也常被摆上估价台。
author: backgroundnoisegalore/.fedoraman/Merc
source: All jewelry stores worth their salt employ POKENAME to keep up with the competitive market. Due to their meticulous nature, however, an unfortunate Carbink finds its way onto an appraiser's table far too often.

entry: POKENAME活泼热心，尤其护着人类孩子，甚至有些保护过头。人们都认为，它既有智慧，又忠诚。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: Vibrant and helpful, POKENAME stands out for its overprotective nature towards human children. It is considered to be wise and loyal.

entry: POKENAME入迷地看着静水中的自己，每个动作都想模仿。它也能把其他宝可梦学得惟妙惟肖，常让对方摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes fascinated with its own reflection in still water, trying to mimic every movement it sees. It often confuses other Pokémon by perfectly copying their behaviors as well.

entry: POKENAME偏爱开满郁金香的田野，把花编成简巢，再收集花瓣，垫得舒舒服服，歇在缤纷花丛下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers fields full of tulips, weaving the flowers into makeshift nests. It gathers petals for comfort, creating cozy places to rest beneath the colorful blooms.

entry: POKENAME分泌天然黏胶，加固水坝，粘牢巢穴。造出的建筑，连恶劣天气也能承受。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes a sticky adhesive, which it uses to strengthen its dams and hold together nests. This natural glue makes its structures sturdy, withstanding even harsh weather.

entry: 它高速扇翼，掀起风刃，将树木切碎，用来搭巢。
author: .izik
source: It can flap its wings at high enough speeds to create blades of wind. These air currents are used to chop up trees for its den.

entry: 啃咬木头时，动作摩擦让毛中静电渐强。此时碰到身体，可能会被轻微电灼伤。
author: .izik
source: While it chews on wood, the static in its fur grows due to the movement. Contact with its body while it eats can cause a mild electrical burn.

entry: POKENAME在河边安家。到了秋天，会啃开岩石，挖出大洞居住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME make their homes by the river's edge. During the autumn months, it will gnaw large holes in rocks for shelter.

entry: 一棵树里，能住一大群POKENAME。只要其中一只受扰，便可能接连引发小爆炸。
author: .izik
source: Large clusters of POKENAME will live in a single tree. Should one be disturbed, it can set off a chain of small explosions.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴拖过颜料与泥水，所到之处皆是污痕。可每一笔又仿佛有意，像在用画，讲述一个故事。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves stains wherever it goes, dragging its tail through paint and mud. Each mark it creates seems intentional, almost as if it is trying to tell a story through art.

entry: POKENAME爱在浅溪泼水玩耍，热天借流水降温。它还在附近筑小坝，让部分溪段，变成平静的池塘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys splashing in shallow creeks, using the flowing water to cool off during hot days. It builds small dams nearby, turning parts of the creek into peaceful pools.

entry: POKENAME在毛里夹着薄荷叶，沿途散出清香。其他宝可梦爱来相伴，闻着气味，便心静神清。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carries mint leaves in its fur, spreading a refreshing scent wherever it goes. Other Pokémon seek its company, drawing calm and clarity from the aroma.

entry: POKENAME总知道，最近的树在什么方向、离多远。它认真啃咬草木，让植物不至于过度蔓长。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME always knows the direction and distance of the nearest tree. It dutifully gnaws on trees and plants to prevent overgrowth.

entry: POKENAME敲木、敲石，勤勤恳恳地筑巢；敲地，吓退来犯者；再敲水宝可梦，打来当食物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME diligently pounds wood and stone to make its nest. It also pounds the ground to scare off invaders, and pounds aquatic Pokémon as their predator.

entry: POKENAME采来欧芹铺巢，以草香驱虫。善于利用身边之物，让它到什么地方，都能做个好帮手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects parsley to line its den, using the herb's scent to ward off pests. Its resourcefulness makes it a helpful companion in any environment.

entry: POKENAME住在高高的向日葵间，既遮风，也当食物。开朗的模样映着灿烂花朵，过路训练家看了，也很喜欢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests among tall sunflowers, using the plants as both shelter and food. Its bright demeanor matches the cheery flowers, making it a beloved sight for passing Trainers.

entry: 它会趁工地无人，偷运木材搭巢。牙硬得如钻石，连实心钢铁也能切断。
author: .izik
source: It will steal lumber from unoccupied construction sites to build its den. Its teeth are as hard as diamonds and can cut through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME的毛留得住水，热天也能凉爽。它喜欢在河边歇息，借毛中的湿气，调节体温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur retains moisture, keeping it cool during hot days. It enjoys resting near rivers, where the dampness in its coat helps regulate its body temperature.

entry: 有人报告，POKENAME会成群围着城镇，啃咬路灯。咬断灯杆底后，竟将整根杆抱起来，飞回巢里。
author: .izik
source: There are reports of POKENAME swarming around towns and gnawing at streetlights. Once it severs the base of the pole, it will fly the entire post back to its nest.

entry: 它用拳头打树，测试力气。树一倒，便靠锋利的牙齿，花几天慢慢吃掉。
author: .izik
source: It punches trees to test its strength. Once the tree falls, it will use its sharp fangs to consume it over the course of days.

entry: 六颗蛋的灵魂，汇成了这只宝可梦。亡魂仍受缚于各自破裂的蛋壳。
author: fuzzythelion
source: A Pokémon that was formed by the spirits of six eggs. The spirits are bound to their cracked shells.

entry: POKENAME会利用先辈的遗骨，强行召来它们的亡灵助战，丝毫不顾先辈是否愿意。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME uses the bones of its predecessors to call upon their spiritual aid in battle, though it's against their will.

entry: 训练家若毫无防备地靠近楔石，POKENAME便现身，以隐形屏障困住。灵魂被吸走前，最后听见的，据说只有一阵阴森笑声。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When unsuspecting Trainers get too close to the Odd Keystone, POKENAME emerges, trapping them with invisible barriers. Supposedly the last thing they hear is a dark, haunting laugh as their soul becomes absorbed.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋，便循着扭曲、混乱的路线乱窜。把楔石牢牢收住，就能阻止它作乱。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tends to zip around in twisted, confusing patterns when excited. Capturing its keystone will keep it from wreaking havoc.

entry: 森林里遇见POKENAME，千万别跟着走。它会把跟随者送回过去，再也找不到回到当下的路。
author: pokechampkevin
source: If you see POKENAME in the forest, do not follow it. When followed, it will send you into the past, with no way to get back to the present.

entry: 买火稚鸡雕像，可得小心。有些里面藏着POKENAME，会破开脆壳，用那些曾被人类吃掉、如今遭囚禁的宝可梦亡魂，向你袭来。
author: .realthree
source: Be careful if you buy a statue of a Torchic. Some instances contain a POKENAME, which will break through the fragile exterior to attack you with the imprisoned spirits of Pokémon that have been consumed by humans.

entry: 野生POKENAME收割幽灵宝可梦的灵魂，想挣脱胸口嵌着的楔石。有些人推测，若与强大训练家结下羁绊，也会开始吸取对方的生命。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: A wild POKENAME harvests the souls of Ghost-types in hopes of breaking free of the Odd Keystone embedded in its chest. If it bonds with a strong Trainer, some theorize it will begin to feed off of their life force as well.

entry: POKENAME全心驾驭幻术，舍弃身体，只留一具空壳，拴住自己与现实的联系。它以万物的恐惧为食，究竟为何，研究者却害怕得不敢追查。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME embraces its power over illusions fully, forsaking its body into nothing but a husk that tethers it to reality. It feeds off the fear of all beings for a purpose researchers are too frightened to find out.

entry: POKENAME伪装成钟乳石，躲避天敌。一处洞穴，可能藏着数百只POKENAME，各自感知周围最细小的动静。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as stalactites in order to better hide itself from predators. A cave may hold hundreds of POKENAME at a time, each of them detecting subtle movements in their environment.

entry: 花岩怪的108个亡魂，占据了勾魂眼的身体，形成POKENAME。为护住楔石，它还在外面，长出宝石般的护罩。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: The 108 souls of Spiritomb have taken over the body of a Sableye to form POKENAME. In order to keep its keystone safe, it has formed a protective gem-like cover around it.

entry: 埋在地下的楔石，若封住太多亡魂，便会破封，一同涌出地面。可每颗头都厌恶其他头，彼此不停拉扯，最终谁也逃不走。
author: @imademyselfdothis
source: If too many spirits are sealed within a buried keystone, they break free and erupt from the earth as one. Each head despises the others, and so they endlessly strain against each other at the surface, never escaping.

entry: 它只爱丰缘极为罕见的青豌果，其他树果一概不吃。只要拿到一颗，就会欣喜若狂地扭来扭去。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It adores the fleetingly rare Strib Berries that grow in Hoenn; no other Berry will do. It wiggles about in ecstasy when it gets a hold of one.

entry: 据说，这是一座住着多个恶魂的杰尼龟雕像，会朝毫无防备的人类与宝可梦，射出水流。
author: Schwaus
source: It is said to be a statue of a Squirtle inhabited by multiple malicious spirits. They will shoot water at unsuspecting Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME吸收被自己打败的宝可梦的灵魂。在遭击败前，总会尽可能大闹一番。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME absorbs the spirits of Pokémon it defeats in battles. It will often cause as much mayhem as possible before it is defeated.

entry: 它聚集数百个亡魂，强化自己。为了更多力量，连整个生态系统，也会肆意毁坏。
author: Schwaus
source: It has gathered hundreds of souls to empower itself. It will ravage entire ecosystems in the pursuit of more power.

entry: POKENAME精通波导与电力，借此制服敌人。脚步之快，连人眼也跟不上。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME uses its mastery of aura and electricity to subdue its opponents. This Pokémon is quick on its feet and is able to move faster than the human eye can follow.

entry: 即使睡着，POKENAME也能感知万物波导。遇上饿肚子的宝可梦，POKENAME便替它找出，会做美味食物的人。
author: mbavenger64
source: POKENAME can sense the auras of everything, even while it is sleeping. POKENAME assists hungry Pokémon by aura-sensing people who prepare delicious food.

entry: 电力储在背毛中，POKENAME稍作蓄能，便能将其释放。在这期间，一旦挨上攻击，就会受到猛烈电击。
author: omegacyclops
source: This Pokémon retains electricity within the fur on its back. POKENAME later releases this by charging itself up for a brief period of time. During this time, any and all attacks will cause a devastating shock to it.

entry: POKENAME是束缚在随身器物里的灵魂，赐予持有者力量，同时，也影响、控制对方的心智。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: POKENAME are spirits bound to held items. They influence their wielder's mind and control them in exchange of granting them power.

entry: POKENAME随身带的棉絮，是舒服的枕头。可心怀不轨者若来触碰，便会被灼伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: The cotton that POKENAME carries makes a comfortable pillow. However, if one with impure intent tries to touch it, they will be burned.

entry: POKENAME借手中的金面具，引导波导。它们很护训练家，对偷盗者，尤其绝不宽容。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME channel auras through the golden masks they carry. They tend to become protective of their Trainers and will be especially unforgiving to thieves.

entry: POKENAME天性亲善，到了和平的地方，总用礼物与拥抱，带来欢乐。有时，友好被误认作软弱，可真要打，它们也是出色的战士。
author: Gloomymort
source: POKENAME are incredibly friendly by nature. They bring happiness in the form of gifts and hugs when visiting peaceful places. Occasionally, their friendly disposition is mistaken for weakness when, in reality, they are very capable combatants.

entry: POKENAME看着不过一朵普通蘑菇，等猎物靠近，便亮出武艺，突然袭击。
author: Prof.Whitebeam
source: POKENAME seems like a normal mushroom, but when its prey approaches, it shows its martial skills and attacks.

entry: 感知之敏锐，让它能察觉极远之处的生命波导，也能凝出纯粹能量的大型手里剑，投向敌人。
author: garret95
source: Its sensitivity is so keen that it can sense the aura of creatures from very far away. It can launch enormous shurikens of pure, concentrated energy.

entry: 同一位训练家促成两次超级进化，极其罕见，POKENAME便是一例。可庞大的能量消耗，也让POKENAME承受着巨大痛苦。
author: Patch_Bros
source: This is one of the very few cases of two Mega Evolutions from one Trainer. Due to the massive energy usage, POKENAME is in immense pain.

entry: POKENAME在地下凿出蜿蜒隧道，蜕皮释放充沛的生命能量。因此，POKENAME洞里的土，也常被取来作肥料。
author: slaphappygrandpa
source: POKENAME carves winding tunnels underground, where it molts to release its overflowing life energy. Dirt taken from POKENAME tunnels is often used as fertilizer.

entry: POKENAME通常睡上一整天，谁打扰，就追谁，直到对方精疲力竭。据说，黏滑的体表，尝起来像果酱。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day, but anyone who disturbs their slumber will be chased until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: POKENAME眼上覆着特殊黏液，挡住风沙，便能轻松走过严酷沙漠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes are coated with a special mucus that protects them from sandstorms. This adaptation allows it to traverse harsh deserts with ease.

entry: 它在错综复杂的洞网中筑巢，用超能力脑波引导猎物，走进死路，再将其堵住。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: This Pokémon nests in intricate cave networks. It uses psychic brain waves to lure prey to dead ends, where it corners them.

entry: 巨颚能一口咬断铁条。想教会它不咬人，或少些凶性，根本办不到。
author: Staghorn
source: Its jaws are powerful enough to snap an iron bar in two. Training it to not bite or to be less aggressive is an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME在陆地摇摆着走，也能像游水一样滑过泥土。它们不停训练，想更快一些，盼有朝一日，也能飞起来。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Waddling about on land, POKENAME are able to glide through the ground as if it was water. They constantly train to get faster, hoping they will be able fly some day.

entry: POKENAME平常整天睡觉，可谁打扰休息，就会被追到筋疲力竭。传闻，体表的黏液，滋味像果酱。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day but will chase anyone who disturbs their rest until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: POKENAME头上有锋锐利刃，早早就与同类相斗，分出首领。可脑袋甩得太猛，自己往往先晕了。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME possesses a very sharp blade on its head with which it fights other POKENAME in order to determine an alpha early on. Wildly swinging its head around makes it dizzy most of the time.

entry: POKENAME沿途的黏液，会慢慢溶解有机物。它借此先让植物衰弱，再将其吃掉。
author: .izik
source: The mucus trail left by POKENAME slowly dissolves organic materials. It uses this to weaken plants before feeding on them.

entry: POKENAME轻松钻过南瓜田，啃食地下的根。农民常把它当作烦人的害兽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME effortlessly tunnels through pumpkin fields, devouring the roots beneath. Farmers often consider it a troublesome pest.

entry: POKENAME常钻进洞壁，让尾巴垂在外面，引来猎物。可脑袋不太灵光，有时，连自己的尾巴也扑。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME can often be found burrowed into cave walls, dangling its tail above the surface as a lure for prey. Occasionally, however, its less-than-intelligent mind may cause it to lunge at its own tail.

entry: 它住在深洞与地道里，模样虽凶，性情却胆小，总避开训练家。若还靠近，便摇尾引导龙之能量，发出强劲反击。
author: _kuke_
source: This Pokémon dwells in deep caves or tunnels. Despite its fierce appearance, it's timid and avoids Trainers, but if approached, it shakes its tail to channel draconic energy for a powerful attack.

entry: 它有种特别的本领，能察觉谁疼痛、谁生病。可不但不帮忙，反而像拿苦难取乐，笑得格外大声。
author: .izik
source: It has a peculiar knack for sensing those who are in pain or sick. Rather than helping, it seems to take amusement in their misery, laughing loudly.

entry: 一见晴空，它便举起尾上的圆珠，想召来风暴。唤来的天气，却据说总是狂乱、难以预料。
author: .izik
source: When it spots a clear sky, it raises the orbs on its tail in an attempt to summon storms. The resulting weather is said to be unpredictable and wild.

entry: 它大口咬向金属，在工地肆意破坏。工人隔夜回来，常发现车辆与材料，都已面目全非。
author: .izik
source: It takes enormous bites out of metal objects, wreaking havoc at construction sites. Workers often return to find their vehicles and materials mangled overnight.

entry: 它吃富含钴的矿物，强化铠甲般的鳞片。每饱餐一次，金属身体便更添光泽。
author: .izik
source: It consumes cobalt-rich minerals to enhance the strength of its armor-like scales. Its metallic body gleams brighter after every feast.

entry: POKENAME头顶长出头盔般的甲片，保护自己。它们钻进地面，再高速弹向天空，拼命想飞得好些。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have developed a helmet-like plating at the top of their heads to protect themselves. They burrow into the ground, then launch into the air at high speeds, trying to fly as best as they can.

entry: 护壳偶尔会掉下碎片。碎片十分珍贵，能制成药力强劲的外敷药膏。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally, fragments of its protective shell fall off. These pieces are highly valued and are used to create potent healing poultices.

entry: 这位猎手平日总在休息，谁惊扰睡梦，就追谁不放。凝胶据说尝起来像苦果酱，让研究者颇感好奇，想一探究竟。
author: Krune
source: Often found resting, this predator will chase down anyone who disturbs its slumber. Its gel is said to taste like bitter jam, making it a rare curiosity among researchers.

entry: 它用獠牙擦过矿道岩壁，刻下深沟标记领地。对当地工作的矿工而言，这常是危险的警告。
author: .izik
source: It drags its tusks across the walls of mining tunnels, leaving deep grooves to mark its territory. This behavior is often a warning sign for miners working in the area.

entry: 它爱在采石场安家，朝岩壁尖叫，听回声作乐，却常令附近的人心神不宁。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys making its home in rocky quarries, where it shrieks at the walls to create echoes. This pastime often unnerves anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却十分凶悍。毒刺会引起感染，痒得难受。
author: ohok3441
source: Even with their small stature, POKENAME are very hostile. Their toxic spikes cause itchy infections.

entry: POKENAME嗜爱珠宝，非囤不可。幸好，它分不清真宝石与塑料仿品，倒替训练家的钱包省了不少。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME loves jewels and hoards them compulsively. Luckily for Trainers' wallets, it can't tell the difference between real gems and plastic gems.

entry: POKENAME高唱朋克摇滚，随节奏猛摇脑袋，刀刃般的头发四处甩动。谁想伸手摸，它会突然转头，割伤靠得太近的家伙。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME belts out punk rock melodies while rocking its head to the beat, causing its razor-sharp hair to whip about. If someone tries to touch its hair, it will quickly turn away, slashing anyone that got too close.

entry: 月光越充足，POKENAME跑得越快。晴朗的满月夜，它能跑到1马赫。
author: Race9000
source: A POKENAME moves faster the more moonlight it receives. On a clear night with a full moon, it can run at Mach 1.

entry: POKENAME常向飞机发起竞速挑战，还往往获胜。难得输一次，就会暴怒，烧光眼前的一切。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME is commonly seen challenging aircraft to races, which it often wins. On the rare occasion it loses, POKENAME will break out into a fit of rage, burning everything in sight.

entry: POKENAME是仿照龙设计的人造宝可梦，靠强力大炮与人工智能辅助战斗，实力超群。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: An artificial Pokémon designed after a dragon, POKENAME stands above the rest with its powerful cannon and AI-assisted fighting skill.

entry: 它长得像某位宝可梦冠军。究竟是想讨更多人喜欢，还是用来吓退训练家，至今不明。
author: JackytheWannabe
source: It resembles a certain Pokémon champion. It's unknown if this was so more people would like it, or if it was to serve as a way to scare off Trainers.

entry: POKENAME周身裹着红色黏液，据说味如草莓酱。可它攻击性极强，只有交上朋友的训练家，才能安全采集。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME are encased in a red slime said to taste like strawberry jam. Only Trainers who befriend them can safely harvest it, as POKENAME are highly aggressive.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片顺着摸极为细滑，水里水外都能减小阻力。可每片带着微小倒刺，逆着摸，就会疼得厉害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's scales have the peculiar quality of being extremely fine in one direction, reducing drag both in and out of the water. However, each scale has microscopic barbs that make it painful to stroke it the other way.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片顺着摸极为细滑，水里水外都能减小阻力。可每片带着微小倒刺，逆着摸，就会疼得厉害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's scales have the peculiar quality of being extremely fine in one direction, reducing drag both in and out of the water. However, each scale has microscopic barbs that make it painful to stroke it the other way.

entry: 植物盛开时，POKENAME的藤蔓卷曲成亮绿色，抽击强劲。即使损伤，只需晒一小时太阳，便能重新长好。
author: Frokachu
source: When its plants are in full bloom, POKENAME's vines coil up and turn a bright green. It can unleash powerful whips with them and they even grow back with just an hour of sunlight.

entry: 它只寻找其他POKENAME，却彻底避开人类及其余宝可梦，遇险便喷出极浓密的花粉云自卫。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Despite seeking only other POKENAME, it avoids humans and all other Pokémon entirely. It sprays an ultra-dense cloud of pollen to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME曾被用于早期的3维游戏中，铺设草地贴图。不幸的是，代码中的错误让它也传播起了病毒。
author: Rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME was utilized in early 3D games to propagate grass textures. Unfortunately, an error in its coding made it spread viruses too.

entry: 化石显示，POKENAME生前是雨林中的顶级猎手，捕猎技巧高超。粗壮的尾巴能勾住树木荡行，让速度更快。
author: Mistymagius
source: Fossil records show that POKENAME were apex predators when they were alive, expertly hunting through the lush rainforest where it lives. Its thick tail allows it to swing from trees to increase its speed.

entry: POKENAME背上的烈焰，始终烧不着头顶叶片，原因无人知晓。研究者一直想弄清，POKENAME的基因能否成为培育耐火作物的关键。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: It is unknown why the blazing fire on POKENAME's backs never ignites the leaves on their heads. It's long been wondered if POKENAME's genetics could hold the key to developing more fire-resistant crops.

entry: 它常附在树侧或砖墙上休息。若要把它弄下来，建议找一把撬棍。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon is often seen resting on the sides of trees or brick walls. To remove these Pokémon from their spots, it is recommended to use a crowbar.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为只存在于史前，如今却占据大片湿地。传闻，吸入它周围浓满孢子的空气，便会终身失声。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Once believed to have existed only in prehistory, POKENAME dominate the marshlands in swathes. Urban legend warns that inhaling the spore-thick air around one will leave you permanently mute.

entry: POKENAME一生大多潜在深泥中，静待没防备的宝可梦靠近。背上的共生植物，让它们缺食时，也能靠光合作用维生。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives submerged in deep mud, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to draw too close. The symbiotic plants on their backs allow them to photosynthesize when no food is available.

entry: 它藏在丛林藤蔓里，耐心等待。猎物毫无戒心地经过，便会被四只利爪撕碎。
author: Busilisk
source: It camouflages itself in vines to remain hidden in jungle environments, where it waits patiently. Unsuspecting prey is torn apart by its four clawed limbs.

entry: POKENAME是草木繁茂之地的高明猎手。背上的植物让它融入绿意，冷不防扑向猎物。
author: ackshewally
source: POKENAME are very adept and proficient hunters in lush environments. The vegetation growing on this Pokémon's back allows it to camouflage among greenery and surprise their prey.

entry: 尾花散出甜香，引来猎物，再让藤蔓破土而出，缠住选中的一餐。
author: flickeredflame
source: The flower on its tail emits a sweet smell that is used to draw in its prey. It then causes vines to erupt from the ground, entangling its chosen meal.

entry: POKENAME通过感知荒林根系的振动，察觉森林中每一个生命与动作。
source: POKENAME can feel every organism and motion in its forest. It does so by feeling the vibrations of the roots within the wilderness.

entry: POKENAME飞在云上，用头顶的花吸收日光。若被迫降落，便以强劲的日光束，摧垮敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies above the clouds, gathering sunlight with the flower on its head. If it is forced to descend from the skies, it devastates opposition with an intense Solar Beam.

entry: 它取暖、吸收日光时，火焰会散出怡人香气，令交战的双方渐渐平静。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: As it warms itself and absorbs sunlight, its flame releases a pleasant fragrance. The fragrance becalms those engaged in battle.

entry: POKENAME性情害羞，靠阳光维持花朵生机。入夜便休眠，只留尾焰微光，滋养花朵。
author: ImaginaryNeon
source: POKENAME is a shy Pokémon that relies on sunlight to keep its flower alive. When night falls, it becomes dormant, sustaining its flower with the dim light from its flame.

entry: POKENAME用蓄满日光能量的尾藤，点燃衰亡森林，再将新种子撒向灰烬。有些热带地区，便将它奉作重生之灵。
author: brainiax
source: POKENAME uses the sun-enriched vines from its tail to spark wildfires in dying forests, scattering fresh seeds among the ashes. It is worshipped as a spirit of rebirth in some tropical regions.

entry: 若有人胆敢拥抱POKENAME，它就会在对方背上种下一颗受诅咒的种子。每起一个私念，种子便长大一分；待到花开，宿主原先站立的地方，只剩一丛扭动的荆棘。
author: seaslux
source: If a human dares to embrace POKENAME, it will plant a cursed bulb upon their back. With every selfish thought, the bulb will grow, and when it blossoms, a writhing thicket will erupt from where its host once stood.

entry: POKENAME深居浓密热带森林，常开不凋的花，也很少被注意。可千万当心，那致命的花粉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in dense, tropical forests, where its unwithering blooms go unnoticed. Beware its deadly pollen.

entry: 它悉心照顾背上的花。花虽恶臭，若POKENAME足够信任，愿让人闻一闻，据说那人往后便会鸿运当头。
author: squawkabairdy
source: This Pokémon takes delicate care of the flower on its back. Despite the foul stench, a POKENAME trusting someone enough to let them smell the flower is said to bring great fortune their way.

entry: 很久以前，它迁入地底深处，承受巨大压力，融合出护身的岩层。再回到地表时，身体已能长得比从前更大。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Long ago, it migrated deep underground and endured pressures so intense that it fused with a protective coating of rock. When it returned to the surface, it could grow larger than before.

entry: 它的祖先原本栖居海岸，后来沿热带河流迁入内陆。如今，它们把气味刺鼻的钳子伸出水面，引饥饿的虫属性宝可梦靠近，再趁猎物分心猛地拖进水下。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: This Pokémon's coastal ancestors migrated inland through tropical rivers. They extend their pungent pincers above the water's surface to lure hungry Bug-type Pokémon close before suddenly dragging the distracted prey under.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，尾巴发亮，放出电磁波。来犯者及周围的人，都会被激起剧烈偏头痛。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When POKENAME are threatened, their tail shines, releasing electromagnetic waves. This causes intense migraines in the aggressor as well as anyone in its proximity.

entry: 它察觉附近危险，耳朵便抖成锯齿状，形似古代遗迹的刻纹，可含义依然不明。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its ears twitch to form jagged shapes when it senses danger nearby. The shapes resemble carvings found in ancient ruins, but their meaning remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME在海边岩崖筑巢，潜海捕食鱼宝可梦。吃足相当于体重一半的食物，才肯上岸，攀回岩间。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME nests in rocky cliffs by the sea. It dives into the ocean and hunts fish Pokémon, only returning to scale the stones once it has consumed up enough to equal half its body weight.

entry: 它借飘带在树间荡行，微小的毒倒刺排列其上，也能用来制服猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: It swings across trees with its ribbons, which are lined with tiny poisonous barbs. It also uses these ribbons to neutralize prey.

entry: POKENAME就爱被关注，甚至会向其他宝可梦调情，只为博点注意。它的爪子带毒，足以让小型宝可梦昏倒。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love any attention that can get and will even flirt with other Pokémon just for the attention. Its claws are venomous and can cause fainting in small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME收集吃剩的猎物骨骼，既当狩猎武器，也用来剔牙。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME collects the bones of its consumed prey to hunt with as weapons or pick its teeth.

entry: 虽然它的许多张嘴共用同一个身体，但每张嘴都有自己的食欲。因此，它总是饥肠辘辘，不停地寻找食物，塞进一张张饥饿的大口里。
author: sk372
source: Though they all share the same body, each of its many mouths has its own appetite. As such, it is always hungry, and always searching for the next meal to shove into its starving maws.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，也十分亲人，可摸它却危险得很：鲜花与裙摆之下，都藏着一排排锋利的牙齿。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME is known for its cuteness, and is very affectionate. However, it is extremely dangerous to touch, as its flowers and dress both contain hidden rows of razor-sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚其实是金属角，长大后，足以护住全身。不缩进角壳休息时，POKENAME就在地下挖掘可口的矿物与真菌。
author: entomoxie
source: The giant jaws on a POKENAME are metal horns that grow large enough to protect the whole body. When not resting in their horn shells, POKENAME dig to find tasty minerals and fungi underground.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进调皮孩子的家，吃掉所有礼物，还会趁家长没发现，偷偷捉弄孩子。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid the homes of naughty children and eat all of their presents. They will even play tricks on the children without their parents noticing.

entry: POKENAME的豆大眼睛不太管用，便靠长舌四处摸索。找到什么，就飞快卷回张着的大嘴。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: POKENAME get very little use out of their small, beady eyes. They feed instead by feeling around with their long tongues, quickly yanking anything they find back into their waiting maws.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚合起，宛如一条飘带，缓缓起伏，让猎物看得入迷，也生出安心懈怠的感觉。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's huge jaws appear ribbonlike when closed. While closed, they can undulate to mesmerize prey while releasing a sensation of complacency.

entry: 双颚其实由耳朵变化而成。它诱使捕食者追进洞中，等对方明白自己才是猎物，一切已太迟。
author: wigglypon
source: Its twin jaws are ears that transformed. It lures predatory Pokémon to chase it into its burrow, where they realize too late that they are the prey.

entry: POKENAME在森林里装作树桩，纹丝不动。小宝可梦靠近，就一口吞下。
author: KLGB76
source: In the forest, POKENAME stays as still as a tree stump, patiently waiting for small Pokémon to approach before eating them whole.

entry: 巨大的颚状颈部锥体，让多数人觉得POKENAME丑又可怕。它其实十分友善，那锥体也不伤人，只负责防御天敌。
author: KLGB76
source: Despite being considered ugly and scary by most because of its huge, jaw-like neck cone, POKENAME is actually a very friendly Pokémon. The neck cone is inoffensive and only serves as protection from the predators.

entry: 可信赖的大嘴娃与它结下羁绊，压住了POKENAME的狂性。战斗中，它化作镰刀，吞噬邪恶宝可梦的灵魂，越战越强，直到足以比肩死神。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their madness kept in check thanks to their bond with a trusted Mawile, POKENAME take the form of a scythe in battle. They eat the souls of evil Pokémon, gaining strength after every battle until they can rival the Grim Reaper.

entry: POKENAME能将身上的宝石，凝成镰刀般的利刃。虽能完全化作一把镰刀，却只会交给身边可信赖的大嘴娃使用。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to condense the gems along their body into scythe-like blades. While they are capable of fully transforming into a scythe, they only do so when there is a trusted Mawile nearby to wield them.

entry: 它埋进岩中，只让一小节尾巴露在地上。谁碰到那块石头，POKENAME就从地道跃出，将其吞下，再潜回地下。
author: sk372
source: It buries itself in stone, leaving only a single part of its tail exposed above ground. When something touches this stone, POKENAME leaps from its tunnel and devours the unfortunate victim before diving back underground.

entry: POKENAME颚状的大钳，似乎自有意识。幸好，多数时候，它愿意与POKENAME合作。
author: Patch_Bros
source: POKENAME's jaw-like claw appears to have a mind of its own. Thankfully, it chooses to cooperate with POKENAME most of the time.

entry: POKENAME用黏触手攀住大宝可梦，搭个便车。身体轻得很，大个子往往连察觉也没有。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME uses its sticky tentacles to latch onto larger Pokémon who will carry it along. It weighs so little, the larger Pokémon often don't even notice.

entry: POKENAME借触手增强超能力。集中精神时，触手就会轻轻摇动。
author: Elite01
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to amplify its psychic powers. If it's concentrating, its tentacles will begin to sway.

entry: 有人认为，今日的小球飞鱼，正是POKENAME的后裔。它靠回声定位，在浑水中辨路。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some believe that today's Mantyke descended from POKENAME. It uses echolocation to navigate through murky waters.

entry: POKENAME进化出的眼斑，连最无畏的天敌也能吓住。那副假笑，其实是一排羽状刚毛，用来捕捉、电击浮游生物。
author: @imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME evolved to intimidate even the most fearless of predators with its eyespots. The false grin is actually an array of feathery bristles that it uses to catch and shock plankton.

entry: 身体是滚烫液体，外有厚膜隔开海水。它从触手渗出一些液体，溶解猎物。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Its body is composed of a scalding fluid protected against seawater by a thick membrane. It releases some of this liquid through its tentacles to dissolve prey.

entry: POKENAME双脚早已退化，如今靠黏性附肢移动。据说，它一旦抓牢什么，只要POKENAME不想放，就什么也扯不下来。
author: Ayner
source: The feet of POKENAME are vestigial; it now uses its sticky appendages to move itself. It is said that once this Pokémon grabs something, nothing can unstick it if POKENAME doesn't want it removed.

entry: POKENAME是伏击型的捕食者，会用黏性的触须吊在粗壮树枝上。它留下的分泌物，会让树枝长出苔藓。
author: dragonessanimations
source: As an ambush predator, POKENAME will hang from thick branches using its sticky tendrils. The residue it leaves behind will grow moss on the branches.

entry: 它装成史前海洋生物，偷溜进博物馆，想讨考古学家喜欢。可那股独特的臭味，让它始终交不到朋友。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: It disguises itself as a prehistoric sea creature and sneaks into museums, hoping to endear itself to archaeologists. However, its distinctive odor keeps it from making any friends.

entry: POKENAME摆动长臂，在海底上方优雅飘行，再落到猎物身上，将其困住、溶解，大享一顿流质餐。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME flutter elegantly above the sea floor by oscillating their long arms. They drift down on top of their prey, trapping their victims before dissolving them for a liquid meal.

entry: POKENAME裙摆里有八片翼，用来游过海洋。有人见过它，救起潜得太深的潜水员。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's dress contains eight wings that it uses to swim through the ocean. It's been seen rescuing divers that have swum too deep.

entry: 人们早以为POKENAME已经灭绝，古生物学家却惊讶地发现，海底仍有小群落存活。它们行动缓慢、性情温和，背上竟承载着微小而繁盛的远古生态。
author: gerbopotato
source: Long thought extinct, paleontologists were stunned to discover POKENAME still living in small colonies on the ocean floor. With their slow and gentle habits, they can support tiny but thriving ancient ecosystems on their backs.

entry: 它像机器人或无人机，靠覆着鳞片的轮子滚行，臂炮既能喷沸水，也能射冰水。
author: spencerrdevv
source: Resembling a robot or drone-like creature, it rolls around on a scaly wheel and can shoot boiling or freezing water from its arm-cannons.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，一见猎物便摇尾扬沙。频繁而猛烈地摇动，甚至能卷出漩涡。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor. When it sees prey, it shakes its tail to kick up sand. If this happens often and viciously enough, it can create whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME用硬头敲开贝类与软体动物，吸进嘴里。若另一只POKENAME来挑战，双方就对撞脑袋，直到一方认输。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME use their hard heads to crack open and slurp down shellfish and mollusks. If challenged by another POKENAME, they will butt heads until one concedes.

entry: POKENAME的头骨由极坚硬的宝石构成，幽灵能量就储在里面。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's skull is made of a very tough gemstone. Its ghostly energy is stored within.

entry: 它撞开洞中岩壁，开出通路，让复杂的洞穴系统，也变得容易探索。
author: .izik
source: It breaks walls inside caves to create paths, making exploration easier. This behavior often transforms complex cave systems into navigable trails.

entry: 古人曾用它身上掉下的石块制作铠甲。留下的遗物，至今仍受收藏家与历史学家追捧。
author: .izik
source: The stones that fall off its body were once used in ancient times to craft armor. These relics remain highly sought-after by collectors and historians.

entry: 传说，深灰市附近有座地下古墓，成群的这种宝可梦驻守其中，严密防范，不让入侵者踏进厅堂。
author: .izik
source: Legends speak of an underground tomb near Pewter City where groups of this Pokémon stand as guardians. Their watchful presence ensures no intruders enter these halls.

entry: 它把石笋当零食，日久便将其磨平。吃得矿物充足，头槌的威力也更强。
author: .izik
source: It snacks on stalagmites, wearing down the formations over time. The mineral-rich diet also makes its headbutts even more powerful.

entry: 它爱吃富铁食物，让本就坚固的头骨更加结实，撞头较量时，自然占尽优势。
author: .izik
source: It prefers foods high in iron, which help strengthen its already robust skull. This diet gives it an edge in headbutt battles.

entry: 它看护游乐场，发现谁欺负人，就出面干预。这份保护欲，也赢得孩子们信任。
author: .izik
source: It watches over playgrounds, intervening when it spots bullies. Its protective nature has earned it the trust of children.

entry: 它敲开巨石，吃掉藏在里面的水晶，从矿物中获取能量，维持强劲体力。
author: .izik
source: It cracks open boulders to eat the crystals hidden inside. These minerals give it the energy it needs to maintain its strength.

entry: POKENAME发现领地有入侵者，便飞到上方，头朝下猛撞。可它们经常扑空，地面留下的大量深坑，让领地格外好认。
author: Alumed
source: When POKENAME see an intruder in their territory they will fly above it and drop head-first into the target. Because they frequently miss, their territory can be easily identified thanks to the large number of craters.

entry: 外形太独特，让它们模仿什么都不像。伪装一旦露馅，便干脆用头猛烈撞击。
author: Frokachu
source: Due to their rather unique profile, they fail to imitate much of anything. When their disguise inevitably fails, they resort to violently headbutting instead.

entry: 它游得飞快，以鲤鱼王等水生猎物为食。头骨虽硬，身体却软得很。
author: imagine1.
source: It swims at high speeds, feasting on Magikarp and other aquatic prey. Despite its hard skull, its body is very squishy.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，直撞挡路的一切。岩石甲壳护住身体，让它不怕这些猛烈冲击。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies at extremely high speeds, ramming into anything in its path. Its rocky carapace protects its body from these high-speed impacts.

entry: POKENAME朝敌人冲锋，身上的钥匙也叮当作响。这一撞，威力比看起来更厉害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME charges into its foes, the keys jingling along with it. This tackle is more effective than one might first believe.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉坚如钢铁，两吨重的盾也举得轻松。这些勇士护着无辜宝可梦，迎战体型超过自己十倍的威胁。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's muscles are as tough as steel, allowing it to carry its two-ton shield effortlessly. They are valiant warriors who protect innocent Pokémon from threats over ten times their size.

entry: 头披重甲与尖刺，尾巴粗重，双腿肌肉结实，这只宝可梦显然既快、又凶，破坏力惊人。
author: ziggaway
source: Between a heavily-armored, spiked head, its large, heavy tail, and its thick, muscled legs, this Pokémon is clearly fast, destructive, and dangerous.

entry: 古代文明以POKENAME为原型，设计城堡与祭祀神庙。它始终正对北方，像某些著名金字塔，巧合得令人发毛。
author: ziggaway
source: Ancient civilizations based castles and sacrificial temples on POKENAME. This Pokémon always faces exactly north, eerily like certain famous pyramids.

entry: POKENAME头上、背上、尾巴上的华丽装饰，看似笨重又不实用，其实既能护身，也是求偶时的利器。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's highly ornate head, back, and tail seem cumbersome and impractical. However, they actually provide protection and are used for courting.

entry: POKENAME大多懒懒躺着，却能随环境伪装，伏击猎物，或偷巢里的东西。惹上麻烦，惊人的力气也足以自保。
author: bobosmith01
source: Though it spends most of its time lazing about, POKENAME uses its ability to camouflage into any surroundings to ambush prey or steal from nests. If it gets in trouble, it can use its incredible strength to defend itself.

entry: 它知道该击中何处，才能造成最大的伤害。许多训练家对它畏惧至极，连名字也不敢提。
author: weedspagon_real
source: It knows precisely where to strike to cause maximum damage. Fearing it, many Trainers dare not speak its name.

entry: 它拿没有手臂作借口，整天偷懒。POKENAME也会换地方，地面、水下都去，却只为试试，更稀奇的躺法。
author: epping_forest
source: It uses its lack of arms as an excuse to laze about. POKENAME will move to different locations, both on the surface and underwater, but only to try more exotic ways of lazing around.

entry: 身体末端的巨臂，在石土上刻出复杂符号，似乎用来警告闯入者。可也有人怀疑，里面藏着与古代知识有关的深意。
author: jaminmcready
source: The massive arm at the end of its body carves intricate symbols into rock or soil. These markings seem to serve as territorial warnings, though some suspect they hold deeper meanings tied to ancient knowledge.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在躺着，厚皮让它几乎伤不着。可明明整日无所事事，仍觉得自己比谁都高明。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME lazes around for most of the day. Its thick hide protects it from any real damage. Despite doing almost nothing all day, it thinks itself superior to everyone.

entry: 成群POKENAME带着幼崽，巡行风暴肆虐的荒地。它们吸收空气中的臭氧，补充捕猎时耗去的毒液。
author: .realthree
source: Packs of POKENAME patrol storm-tossed badlands with their young. They absorb the ambient ozone in the air and use it to help replenish the venom they spend on hunting.

entry: 这只宝可梦鳞甲坚实，拳力惊人。POKENAME手脚的爪甲长得极快，能刺穿敌人，注入毒素。
source: This Pokémon is known for its robust scales and impactful punches. POKENAME's nails grow at a rapid rate on its hands and feet. It uses them to inject its target with poison by piercing them.

entry: POKENAME练习多种格斗技巧，准备迎战各类敌人。战斗时，只要POKENAME抓牢对手，便会向体内注入强毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME practices a variety of fighting styles that prepare it to take on all kinds of foes. If a POKENAME grabs ahold of an enemy while in combat, it will inject a powerful toxin into them.

entry: POKENAME静坐水底，毛发随流摇曳，便能伪装成一丛海草。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME sits motionless at the bottom of the water, its fur waving with the current disguises it as seagrass.

entry: 翅膀掉下的闪亮鳞粉，可以制成救命药，治疗某些尚无其他疗法的罕见疾病。
author: kiwikelly
source: The shimmery scales shed from Pokémon's wings can be made into life-saving medicine for certain rare illnesses with no other known cures.

entry: 察觉天灾将至，它便绕着当地飞行，发出寒彻骨髓的尖叫。许多人以为POKENAME在诅咒土地，其实，它只是想提醒危险。
author: amiel997
source: When it senses an impending disaster, it flies around the area, releasing a bone-chilling scream. Though many believe that it is cursing the land, POKENAME is actually warning people of the danger ahead.

entry: 若察觉有人霉运缠身，它便到那人家上空盘旋，让不祥之兆显现。它更偏爱顺时针绕飞。
author: .izik
source: Should it sense someone with terrible luck, it will fly in circles over their home to release any bad omens. It prefers to fly in a clockwise motion.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能感知死期将近之人。若停在屋顶，唱起诡异的歌，那户人家恰好三天后，就会有人离世。
author: amiel997
source: It is believed that POKENAME can sense when someone's death is near. When it perches on a rooftop and sings its eerie song, someone in the household will die exactly three days later.

entry: 鼻子不知靠什么本领，竟能在地震前闻出征兆。一察觉危险，它就把头埋进土里。
author: .izik
source: Its nose can somehow smell earthquakes before they occur. It will bury its head in the dirt if it senses danger.

entry: 有人说，受POKENAME诅咒，便无论怎么躲，都逃不过死亡。刚遭天灾的城市，常能见到它们游荡。
author: Mistymagius
source: Some say that if you are cursed by a POKENAME, you are destined to meet your end no matter how hard you try to avoid it. They can be seen wandering around cities recently hit by natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME人称“凶兆之拳”，预知对手尚未使出的招数，借此取胜。若明知赢不了，便不顾一切，也要与敌人同归于尽。
author: MileySakiko
source: Known as "The Fist of Ill Omen", an POKENAME wins fights by knowing its opponent's moves before they ever make them. If it knows it cannot win, it will recklessly attempt to take its foe down with it.

entry: 预知天灾的本领增强后，POKENAME不只示警，还会亲自动爪，保护生命。誓要守护的生命越多，镰刃便越锋利，杀伤力也越惊人。
author: merclipse
source: With its capability to sense disasters enhanced, POKENAME now strives to both warn those of danger, but take matters into its own claws to protect lives. Its scythe grows sharper the more lives it vows to defend, making it incredibly deadly.

entry: POKENAME夜里捕食林中宝可梦，却不绕树穿行，而是用剃刀般的附肢，一路砍倒挡路的树。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that feasts on forest-dwelling Pokémon. Rather than navigating through the forest, it uses its razor-sharp appendages to slice down the trees.

entry: POKENAME透过众多眼睛，能看见过去、现在、未来，甚至其他维度，遭遇的种种灾祸。
author: alierael
source: Through its many eyes, POKENAME sees the disasters that plague the past, present, future, and even other dimensions.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是命运的使者。它们结成小队，有时阻止小灾祸，有时却亲手将灾祸带来。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are said to be agents of fate, as they work together in small groups to prevent small-scale disasters, or cause them to come about.

entry: 夜里，它躺在沙漠，吸取月光中的养分。等太阳升起，又把全身覆上一层沙。
author: .izik
source: It lays in the desert during the night to absorb nutrients from the moon's light. After the sun rises, it covers its body in a layer of sand.

entry: 它缓缓飘过沼泽，叮当作响。据说，听见这声音，往后多年，情路都会坎坷。
author: .izik
source: It floats slowly through swamps making jingling noises. It is said that if one hears this noise, they will face bad luck with love for many years.

entry: POKENAME会扮成阿勃梭鲁，四处行善，想改善它在人们心中的形象。随着声誉好转，它也渐渐赢得阿勃梭鲁与人类的友谊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to improve the poor image of Absol, by doing good deeds while disguised to resemble it. This slowly garners it the friendship of Absol and humans alike as the damaged reputation is repaired.

entry: 人们会带珍稀宝石给POKENAME，换取天灾将至的提醒。可它深居洞窟，并不好找。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: People will bring POKENAME rare gemstones in exchange for being warned of upcoming disasters. It lives deep in caves, so it's a bit tricky to find.

entry: 据说，碰到POKENAME，短时间内便会倒霉。可后来证实，那不过是POKENAME的黏液太滑惹的祸。
author: Mistymagius
source: It has been said that coming in contact with POKENAME's body causes short-lasting misfortune. However, it has been proven that the misfortune is due to how slippery POKENAME's slime is.

entry: POKENAME夜里溜进村庄，尽情嚎叫，想叫大家陪它玩。可嚎声宛如惨叫，吓得村民纷纷醒来，以为大祸突然临头。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME strolls into villages at night, enjoying howling as loudly as it can to try and call people to play with it. Unfortunately, its howls sound like shrieks, causing all of the villagers to wake up in fear of a sudden disaster happening.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，便赶进村庄示警，想尽可能救人。可进化前的模样太会闯祸，坏名声也一直跟着它们。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rush into villages when they sense an incoming disaster, trying to protect as many people as possible with their warnings. They have earned a negative reputation due to their pre-evolutions causing havoc.

entry: POKENAME能感知坏事即将发生，可偏要等事情发生后，才感知得到。它整天摸不着头脑，不明白为何总差那么一点时机。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME can sense when something bad will happen, but only after it's already happened. It spends most of its time confused, wondering why it never gets the timing quite right.

entry: 城市即将遭遇环境灾难前，总能看见成群的POKENAME，赶往灾难将发生的地方。可即使预警在先，人们也从没成功阻止灾难。
author: .realthree
source: Just before urban environmental disasters take place, hordes of POKENAME can be spotted traveling to the site of the future accident. Despite the advance warning, the disasters have never been prevented from happening.

entry: 它常被叫作“喋喋不休的树桩”，寿终以后，也仍模仿树木。研究者至今无法确定，POKENAME的身体究竟是石头、腐木，还是骨骼。
author: merclipse
source: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.

entry: 它常被叫作“喋喋不休的树桩”，寿终以后，也仍模仿树木。研究者至今无法确定，POKENAME的身体究竟是石头、腐木，还是骨骼。
author: merclipse
source: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.

entry: 它常被叫作“喋喋不休的树桩”，寿终以后，也仍模仿树木。研究者至今无法确定，POKENAME的身体究竟是石头、腐木，还是骨骼。
author: merclipse
source: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.

entry: 墓地下起雨，附近便一定有POKENAME。它走到哪儿，都带来哀愁的雨，还常到葬礼上，向逝者致意。
author: Daemonkill22
source: When it rains in a graveyard, one can be certain that a POKENAME is nearby. It brings a melancholy rain wherever it travels, frequenting funerals to pay respects to the dead.

entry: 猩红双眼连最浓的雾也能看穿。POKENAME常尾随领地里衰弱的训练家或宝可梦，耐心等待其死亡。
author: _kuke_
source: The scarlet eyes of POKENAME can see through the densest fog. It often stalks weakened Trainers or Pokémon in its territory, patiently waiting for their demise.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，怯怯躲在训练家身后。可那只独眼的凝视，却连最沉着的旅人，也难以招架。
author: Katunei
source: POKENAME floats inches from the ground and cautiously hides behind its Trainer. Though it hides, its single eye burns through even the most stoic of travelers.

entry: 猛踢与斩击已足够危险，POKENAME为了赢，还会不顾自身地猛攻。不知为何，双臂却一直紧紧绑着。
author: Katunei
source: Its ferocious kicks and slashes are enough to demand caution, but POKENAME fights recklessly to achieve victory. For some strange reason, it keeps its arms tightly bound.

entry: 据说，这只神秘宝可梦能号令亡魂，常为不明目的聚集坟旁。有人却认为，POKENAME并非恶意驱使，而是在引领迷魂，走向安息。
author: Rakunk
source: This mysterious Pokémon is said to command the spirits of the dead, often gathering near graves for mysterious purposes. Some have argued POKENAME uses its powers not from malice but rather as a guide for lost souls to their final rest.

entry: 它天性顽劣，爱突然从所附的头骨里蹿出，吓别人一跳。头骨不像任何已知宝可梦，却近似夜巡灵脸上的纹样。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has a mischievous nature, and will suddenly pop out of the skull it is bound to in order to scare others. The skull does not appear to perfectly match any known Pokémon, but it does resemble the pattern on Duskull's face.

entry: 别的宝可梦难以生存的险恶湖河里，却有大群POKENAME。没有天敌，一个POKENAME群体，甚至能铺满足球场那么大的水面。
author: Mistymagius
source: Large schools of POKENAME can be found in lakes and rivers too dangerous for other Pokémon to survive. Due to a lack of predators, POKENAME schools can be as large as a football field.

entry: 中世纪，人们把POKENAME视为疫病使者，吸过周身黑烟的人，几天内便会死去。后来研究却发现，那烟是在缓缓吸走生命力。
author: Mistymagius
source: In medieval times, POKENAME was seen as a bringer of disease, as anyone who has inhaled the dark smoke that surrounds it dies within a few days. However, studies show that the smoke slowly drains the life force of its victims.

entry: 困在夜泥中的迷失亡魂，若始终无法安息，便会怨怒，化作POKENAME。
author: Sottiwotti
source: When the lost souls trapped in Dusmer are unable to move on, they become enraged and turn into POKENAME.

entry: 进入精神恍惚状态时，束缚带末端的钉子能将它固定住。移动时，它会集中精神操纵钉子，像蜘蛛一样精准地行走。
author: .izik
source: The nails at the ends of its bindings anchor it when entering a psychic trance. To relocate, it focuses its mind to move the nails, resembling a spider walking with precision.

entry: 风吹过体表木质的覆盖物，便发出令人不安的哀号。它偏爱沼泽那诡异的寂静。
author: .izik
source: The wood-like covering on its body produces a highly unsettling wail when the wind blows over it. It prefers to live in the eerie silence of swamps.

entry: 新月夜，它从洞里出来，到村庄捕食。传说，门外放一罐蜂蜜，便能保平安。
author: .izik
source: On nights of a new moon, it emerges from its cave to prey on villages. Folklore claims leaving a pot of honey outside will ensure your safety.

entry: 飞行时一见猎物，它就俯冲，用巨手抓起，带到僻静处，再行进食。
author: .izik
source: When it spots prey while flying, it swoops down and grabs them with its massive hands. It carries its victims away to secluded places for feeding.

entry: 它的电击十分特别：竟把对手的电流吸向自己，让电子沉进不可解的虚空。可POKENAME每次电属性攻击的效果，却又和其他宝可梦一样。
author: epping_forest
source: Its electrical attacks are rather unique, for it draws electrical current from its opponents toward it, making electrons sink inside its indecipherable void. However, every Electric-type attack from POKENAME has the same effect as other Pokémon's.

entry: 它用锋利而薄如刀刃的尾巴，把枝头的杏仔果切下来。这种娴熟的动作让它能够精确地采集食物。
author: .izik
source: It uses its tail, as sharp and thin as a blade, to slice Apicot Berries from trees. This skillful motion allows it to harvest food with precision.

entry: 它在废厂细细整理机械零件，发明家因而称它为“幽灵机械师”。
author: .izik
source: It meticulously organizes machinery parts in abandoned factories. This behavior has earned it the title of the "ghostly machinist" by inventors.

entry: 巨颚轻易便能咬碎铁块。凡是需要蛮力的交锋，它都能稳占上风。
author: .izik
source: Its massive jaws can crush iron with ease. This strength ensures that it dominates any encounter where brute force is required.

entry: 它能从巨大的红眼中，射出强劲闪电。就算离得很远，也依然是可怕的威胁。
author: .izik
source: It can fire powerful bolts of lightning through its massive red eye. This ability makes it a formidable threat even at long range.

entry: 藏在嘴里的眼睛，能看见并读懂情绪。凭这份力量，它能感知周围的恐惧与悲伤。
author: .izik
source: The eye inside its mouth can see and interpret emotions. It uses this power to detect fear and sadness in its surroundings.

entry: 峡谷中遇见迷路的人，头顶的火便亮起来。那光既引人靠近，也照亮幽暗的路。
author: .izik
source: When it encounters a lost person in a canyon, the flame on its head brightens. This light serves as both a lure and a guide through the darkness.

entry: 只要它在附近，不知从何而来的阴风，便会有规律地吹起。有人相信，风里带着亡者的低语。
author: .izik
source: Its presence causes an eerie wind to blow methodically from an unknown source. Some believe this wind carries whispers from the departed.

entry: 眼睛能离体飘向远处，观察四周。夜里，它又将眼睛收进嘴里，安稳放好。
author: .izik
source: Its eye can levitate away from its body to observe distant areas. At night, it rests its detached eye safely in its mouth.

entry: 头上的眼睛像红宝石般灿亮。据说，盯着这迷人光彩太久，就会遭到催眠。
author: .izik
source: The eye on its head sparkles like a brilliant ruby. This captivating gleam is said to hypnotize anyone who stares at it for too long.

entry: POKENAME脚步悄无声息，慢慢逼近闯入者，夺走对方灵魂。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's footsteps are very quiet. It slowly approaches intruders to whisk away their soul.

entry: 一只黑夜魔灵怜悯死去的卡拉卡拉，见它尚未替母复仇，便分出一点力量，让骸骨再次行走，去完成未竟之事。
author: sk372
source: A Dusknoir has taken pity on the soul of a dead Cubone yet to avenge its mother. The skeleton walks again, granted a fraction of Dusknoir's power with which to finish its business.

entry: 漆黑之中，POKENAME也看得清清楚楚。传言说，黑暗时，灵界会低声向它们诉说周围的景象。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are able to see perfectly, in even pitch-black environments. Rumors say that the spirit world whispers to them about their surroundings when they're in the dark.

entry: POKENAME大多无害，可抽动、漂浮的器官，仍让多数人看了害怕。根与藤蔓不停蠕动，寻找月光与黑暗能量来吸收。
author: Ozydamians
source: While mostly harmless, the twitching and floating organs of POKENAME frighten most who look upon it. The roots and vines wriggle about searching for moonlight and dark energy to absorb.

entry: 据说，POKENAME从地底深处出现，对残酷的训练家施下死亡审判。仅轻轻一触，便能收走灵魂。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME is said to have emerged from the depths to deliver a fatal judgment to cruel Trainers. It can claim a soul with just a touch.

entry: 传说，POKENAME奉灵界之命，护送葬身幽暗水域的亡魂。可每到一处亡者未能抵达的海滩，它都会驻足，为他们细心垒起坚固的坟墓。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Fables say that POKENAME escorts souls that lost their lives to the dark waters at the behest of the spirit world, yet it takes the time to carefully assemble a sturdy grave for each soul on the beaches they failed to reach.

entry: 它漫无目的地游荡废矿井。有人相信，它原本是遭巨石压死的一队矿工。
author: kittyluv090
source: It wanders aimlessly in abandoned mineshafts. Some believe that it was once a crew of miners who were crushed by boulders.

entry: POKENAME像个探路者，寻找需要引往彼岸的宝可梦。找到后，POKENAME便带它们去见黑夜魔灵，送往未知世界。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME acts as a scout, finding Pokémon in need of shepherding to the beyond. Once it finds them, POKENAME guides them to a Dusknoir to take them to worlds unknown.

entry: POKENAME负责接引宝可梦亡魂，尤其那些远离冥界入口、尚未安息的灵魂。亡魂意志越强，就需要越多POKENAME，才运得动。
author: Arcul
source: POKENAME are tasked with transporting Pokémon's spirits to the beyond, specifically those that rest far from underworld entry-points. The stronger the Pokémon's force of will, the more POKENAME needed to transport it.

entry: POKENAME能憋气数小时，深入海底。背鳍发出的生物光，让深海也亮得如同晴天的水面。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can go several hours without air, allowing them to reach the ocean depths. Their bioluminescent dorsal fin makes these depths as bright as the surface in bright daylight.

entry: POKENAME喷出强劲水流，逆什么激流都轻而易举。越接近进化，凶悍的性情便越显露。
author: Rooboid
source: POKENAME breaches any current with ease, propelling itself forth with powerful jets of water. Its aggressive nature begins to show as it draws closer and closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME体内满是沸水，飞行时喷出蒸汽，在天空描出彩虹。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is filled with boiling hot water. While flying, it spews out steam that paints rainbows in the sky.

entry: 三条浮臂漂在水面，让身体仍潜在水下，也能呼吸。POKENAME的脂肪层坚韧如油轮外壳，还能庇护小鱼宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its three buoyant arms float on the surface, allowing it to breathe while its body remains submerged. POKENAME's blubber, as tough as a tanker hull, provides protection for smaller fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半由水组成，能浮在海面。受惊时，POKENAME喷出的巨型水柱，连坦克也能掀翻。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is mostly water, allowing for it to float on the surface of the ocean. When startled, POKENAME shoots massive geysers of water powerful enough to topple a tank.

entry: 传说，每颗蛋都藏着存在的本质：时间与空间、心智与肉体、灵魂、物质与反物质。古籍说，“创造”居于中央，始终受同窝其他蛋守护。
author: sk372
source: Tales state that each egg is supposed to contain an essence of existence itself: time and space, mind, body and soul, matter and antimatter. Old tomes state that creation rests in the center, protected always by the others in the clutch.

entry: POKENAME视幼崽为神圣，为凡人无法理解的使命而养育。若未经亲代同意便靠近，POKENAME就会试着将来者，从世间彻底抹去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers its young sacred, raising them for a divine purpose beyond mortal keen. If one approaches without the parent's approval, POKENAME will attempt to erase them from existence.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的歌声，让听者僵在原地。它们还能召来，持续一周以上的暴风雪。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's songs are said to freeze anyone who hears them in their tracks. They can summon blizzards that last for over a week.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是创世时剩下的余物，散落宇宙各处。至今仍在无尽星海漂游，寻找、填补现实物质的缺口。
author: milchik
source: It is said POKENAME are leftovers after the world's creation. They supposedly got scattered across the entire universe and still roam the endless cosmos, trying to find and fill the gaps in the matter of reality.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是创世时剩下的余物，散落宇宙各处。至今仍在无尽星海漂游，寻找、填补现实物质的缺口。
author: milchik
source: It is said POKENAME are leftovers after the world's creation. They supposedly got scattered across the entire universe and still roam the endless cosmos, trying to find and fill the gaps in the matter of reality.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以美丽歌声控制潮汐。它拨动里拉琴时，听者心中，也会静若止水。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to control the tides with its beautiful singing voice. As it plays its lyre, people who hear it are said to feel as calm as water.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是最初的龙宝可梦，龙焰的威力足以烧遍世界。可它们仍仁慈地守护着，一切活着的生命。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to be the first dragon Pokémon, POKENAME are powerful enough to scorch the whole world with draconic fire. Despite this, they are benevolent protectors of all living things.

entry: POKENAME踏过的土壤，都会长出植物。长成什么，又随它携带的属性石板而改变。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME grow plants on any soil they step on. The plants that grow change depending on the elemental plate they hold.

entry: POKENAME致密的皮甲连黑洞的引力也能抵挡。它将铁质核心压得极紧，几乎就要引发核聚变。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dense hide is strong enough to resist the force of a black hole. It compresses its iron core so hard the core is on the verge of nuclear fusion.

entry: POKENAME傲慢得出了名，越是自负，力量便越强。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is notoriously known for being massively arrogant. It grows stronger as it becomes more prideful.

entry: 它与洗翠传说中的某个邪恶身影，奇异地相似，性情却大多仁善。又因格外害羞，总主动避开寻它的人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It oddly resembles a sinister figure in Hisuian legend, but it is largely benevolent. It is also immensely shy, actively avoiding those who seek it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME天使般的利刃曾像雕刻家一样，雕出了宇宙的形状。它长着鳍的尾巴常会重重拍击地面，掀起拥有1,000种色彩的冲击波。
author: teczop
source: It is said the angelic blades of POKENAME carved the shape of the universe like a sculptor. It's finned tail often slams into the ground with immense force, creating a shockwave of a 1,000 colors.

entry: POKENAME射出满含苍翠能量的强箭，箭落何处，草木便繁茂生长。短短几分钟，就能造出整片森林的生机。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires off powerful arrows full of verdant energy, growing lush flora wherever the arrows land. It can grow entire forests' worth of plant life within a few minutes.

entry: 这只宝可梦极少现身，也从不久留。历史大事发生时，常见它在旁沉思；与它交谈，便会听到久远岁月，与早已湮没的战事。
author: octolinggrimm
source: This Pokémon is rarely seen, and never stays in one place for long. During historic events, it can be seen contemplating nearby. Those who speak to it are often regaled with tales of a time long past and a war long lost.

entry: 传说，阿尔宙斯把人送往过去的神奥后，便会赠予这只宝可梦。POKENAME像部手机，却能当地图使用。
author: gamelord64
source: Legends say this Pokémon is given by Arceus after sending someone the Sinnoh region's past. POKENAME looks like a phone but can be used as a map.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只在世界处于创造与毁灭的临界时现身，在两个极端之间，维系现实不坠。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME are said to appear only when the world is on the brink between creation and destruction. They hold reality in place between those extremes.

entry: POKENAME目光警醒，统御海洋。谁愚蠢地受金色珍珠引诱，就会被吃进肚里。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME rule the seas with watchful eyes. Anyone foolish enough to be lured by their golden pearls gets eaten.

entry: 它们看着无忧无虑，在晴朗森林里跳上一整天，或跑去附近河边饮水嬉游。可遇上不受欢迎的闯入者，又会造出隐形屏障、操纵树根，将其绊倒。
author: bobosmith01
source: They have an outwardly carefree disposition, and spend their days dancing away in sunlit forests or gallivanting to a nearby river to drink water. They craft invisible barriers and control roots to make unwanted encroachers trip.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME挤作一团睡觉，把覆土的背朝外，装成土堆。总有一只POKENAME不睡，守望四周。
author: bee4082
source: At night, groups of POKENAME sleep huddled together, disguising themselves as a pile of dirt with their soil-covered backs faced towards the outside. One POKENAME stays awake to keep an eye on their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的植物脑袋，顶在流畅的外星身躯上，能量澎湃。它已能控制自然力与超能力，草属性本领，却还未发育成熟。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME has a round, plant-like head atop a sleek, alien body radiating vibrant energy. It controls the forces of nature and psychic powers. It has yet to properly develop its Grass-type powers.

entry: 包裹POKENAME身体的物质，混合着泥土、水与胶质，对园艺有许多益处。
author: dodoowner_
source: The substance encasing POKENAME's body is a mixture of dirt, water, and gelatin. It has many beneficial properties for gardening.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在浓密灌丛，和草木融得难分彼此。夜里才出来活动，借着黑暗，更是难以发现。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically sleeps in dense thickets during the day, blending in perfectly with trees and bushes. It is active at night, when the darkness makes it nearly impossible to see.

entry: POKENAME推动减少垃圾、回收利用等公益，也让人想动手种花、种树，栽培本地草木。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is seen promoting many causes, such as reducing the amount of litter and recycling. It makes people want to plant flowers, trees, and other local fauna.

entry: POKENAME的腰身由多种土壤构成。POKENAME力气大得能顷刻压碎树干，再把木屑补进去，加固这副另类铠甲。
author: entomoxie
source: The mid-section of a POKENAME is made of various kinds of soil. POKENAME is strong enough to crush a tree trunk instantly, using the bits and pieces to reinforce this armor of sorts.

entry: 关都园丁很爱POKENAME。它传给植物温和电能，让其长得更快，外壳还能护住自己，抵挡空中袭击。
author: leonian1586
source: Gardeners in the Kanto region love POKENAME because it can transfer mild electric energy to plants, helping them grow faster. Its shell helps protect it from aerial attacks.

entry: 树林奇希斯充满旺盛的能量，能驾驭自然与宇宙的力量。它喜欢漫游森林，尝试掌控自身能力；随着成长，还会不断适应、进化，磨炼技巧。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: Grotxys radiates vibrant energy and harnesses the power of nature along with cosmic forces. It enjoys roaming forests, trying to harness its powers. It is known for its ability to adapt and evolve, enhancing its skills as it matures.

entry: 细看之下，POKENAME身上仿佛有完整的生态系统。它爱边漂边转，却又不许别人随便碰触体表。
author: leonian1586
source: Upon close inspection, POKENAME seems to harbor an entire ecosystem on its body. It seems to enjoy rotating while it floats, and it tries to prevent others from touching its surface.

entry: POKENAME能徒手造山。有人推测，远古成群的POKENAME，曾帮助雷吉奇卡斯，创造、塑成世界的大陆。
author: Doodledoo
source: POKENAME is able to create mountains with its bare hands. It is theorized that in the past, hordes of POKENAME helped Regigigas create and shape the continents of the world.

entry: 翅膀终生不断生长，即使年老的POKENAME，背着如此庞大沉重的翅膀，也能轻松浮起。
author: Busilisk
source: This Pokémon's wings will grow continuously throughout its lifetime. Despite their size and weight, even old POKENAME can still float effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME的菌盖上，发展出自己的生态系统，重得让它弓身弯背。它们用柔韧长臂，赶走入侵物种。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME's caps develop their own ecosystems, causing them to slouch under the resulting weight. They use their flexible, stretchy arms to shoo away any invasive species.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，能量强大，终于完全掌握草属性本领。它从大地与宇宙取力，操纵周围环境，发出猛烈攻击。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME towers with immense energy, having finally mastered its Grass-type abilities. This formidable Pokémon draws strength from the earth and cosmos, manipulating its surroundings to create powerful attacks in battle.

entry: POKENAME常用身体撞击物件，标记领地。因此，小宝可梦都不愿在它们背上筑巢。
author: zic
source: POKENAME often bash their bodies against objects to mark their territory. Because of this, small Pokémon avoid building their nests on their backs.

entry: POKENAME饿了，就在灌丛横冲直撞，草木、泥土一并扒进大口，直到再也塞不下。只有吃饱又睡着时，嘴才会闭上。
author: .fedoraman
source: When a POKENAME is hungry, it will rampage through underbrush, scooping foliage and soil alike into its maw until it can fit no more. Its jaw only closes when it is asleep and well-fed.

entry: POKENAME享受在湿地静心冥想。若危险来临，便会无惧地起身，保护家园中的生命。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME enjoys a tranquil existence meditating in swampy areas. If danger arises, it will rise fearlessly to protect the creatures in its home.

entry: POKENAME背上的树不断长大，重得无法行动后，就用壳内火焰把树烧掉，也借此获取养分。可有时，不小心便引发了山火。
author: Aurange
source: The tree on POKENAME's back grows until it is too heavy for it to move, then it uses the flames from within its shell to burn down the tree. This process is also how POKENAME nourishes itself. It sometimes unintentionally starts forest fires.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME诞生于月见山顶的细小陨石。奔跑时，背上的火沿途留光，宛如流星。
author: milchik
source: Some people believe that POKENAME are born from the tiny bits of meteorite that can be found on top of Mt. Moon. When this Pokémon runs, the fire on its back leaves a trail of light behind, making it look like a shooting star.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，又格外吵闹，常在险峻山间出没。一走丢，就用悦耳的鸣声，呼唤双亲。
author: Gwello
source: POKENAME are hyperactive and loud. They can be found around craggy mountains letting out a euphonious cry to call out to their parents if lost.

entry: 它把木炭当作最爱的点心，嚼得喀嚓响。POKENAME吃得越多，体内火焰便越亮、越热。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon loves eating charcoal, crunching through pieces like a beloved snack. The more POKENAME consumes, the brighter and hotter its inner flame burns.

entry: POKENAME晒起太阳，一躺就是几小时，把热量存作后用。即使最冷的夜里，这份温暖也让它行动活跃、力量充足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays in the sun for hours, absorbing heat to store for future use. This stored warmth keeps it active and powerful on even the coldest nights.

entry: 它虽十分好动，却也留意四周。一靠近引火物，就会熄掉身上的火焰利刃。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon is highly active, but it is also alert to its surroundings. It extinguishes the flaming blades on its body whenever it is near kindling.

entry: 它照亮丛林边缘隐秘墓地的入口，为迷路的人与灵魂指路。摇曳的火，既带来温暖，也让人不安。
author: .izik
source: It lights the entrances of cemeteries hidden at the edges of jungles, guiding lost souls and travelers alike. The flickering flame it carries provides both warmth and unease to those passing by.

entry: POKENAME跳起俏皮的舞，叮当作响，让周围的人心情振奋。再阴沉的脸，也常被它逗出笑意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs playful, jingling dances to lift the spirits of those around it. Its joyful antics often bring smiles to the most somber faces around it.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME吃了奇异果实，身体才变得柔韧、弹性十足。POKENAME格外珍惜头上的蘑菇帽，因为那是长者传下、象征志向之物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is believed the flexible and elastic body of a POKENAME is a result of their diet of odd fruit. POKENAME is always very protective of the mushroom cap it wears, as it is passed down to them from their elder and serves as a sign of their ambition.

entry: POKENAME颚力惊人，也会喷火。遇上顽强敌人，便先困在口中，再以烈火招呼。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has an incredibly strong jaw, but it can also breathe fire. It can use this against resilient enemies while they are trapped in its maw.

entry: POKENAME的身体保暖极佳，正适合生活在陡峭的高山上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's body is very well insulated. This is essential for living on the steep mountains where it makes its home.

entry: POKENAME最爱攀爬，凡抓得住，就想爬。因此，待在屋里，也总安分不了。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is known for its propensity for climbing. It will scale anything it can get a grip on, so it has a hard time behaving itself indoors.

entry: POKENAME头叶上，覆着微小毒针，碰到便一阵刺痛。可去掉针，叶片又能用来烹制异国佳肴。
author: Mistymagius
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head is coated in microscopic needles that cause a stinging pain when touched. However, once the needles are removed, the leaf can be used in exotic dishes.

entry: 箭形的耳朵，能把声音与能量汇成定向冲击。身体像雄性的符号，据说是为了迷惑天敌的防御姿态。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its arrow-shaped ear can channel sound waves and energy into focused bursts. Its body resembles the male symbol, which is thought to be a defensive display to confuse predators.

entry: 有人认为，如今的尼多朗源自POKENAME，那时它们尚未出现性别差异。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some believe that today's Nidoran descended from POKENAME before they developed their gender differences.

entry: 幼年的POKENAME剑刃短钝，临近进化时才渐渐长长。每只流苏上的斑纹都不相同，有些收藏家会专门培育斑点形状独特的个体。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Juvenile POKENAME have stubby blades that grow longer as they near evolution. Each one bears a unique pattern of spots on its tassel; some collectors are known to breed them for spots with distinct shapes.

entry: 民间传说，灯火幽灵曾囚禁宝可梦的灵魂作为火焰的燃料。POKENAME的存在被视为这一骇人传闻的佐证。
author: leonian1586
source: Folktales claim Lampent once trapped Pokémon souls to fuel their flames. The existence of POKENAME is believed to support this unsettling rumor.

entry: POKENAME一生都喜欢与大群同类共同生活。唯有完成进化的个体，才会远离族群。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefer to live in large communal packs for their entire life. Only those that evolve will stray far from the pack.

entry: POKENAME远比外表看起来淘气。入夜后，它们喜欢趁毫无防备的露营者与登山者熟睡时偷走补给。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME are much more mischievous than they initially seem. They enjoy stealing supplies from the unsuspecting campers and climbers when they fall asleep during the night.

entry: 它看似一动不动，其实一直留意着周围。POKENAME会让尾焰燃烧得更加明亮来威吓敌人，也能迅速发动攻击。
author: HoundRyS
source: Its inactivity is deceitful, as it's aware of its surroundings. POKENAME's tail flame burns brighter to intimidate threats, and it can strike quickly.

entry: 即使玩耍时不慎从栖息山地的陡崖跌落，POKENAME柔软的身体也能缓冲冲击，丝毫不觉疼痛。
author: .realthree
source: If POKENAME accidentally topples off of the steep cliffs of its mountain home while playing, its squishy body will absorb the impact painlessly.

entry: 有POKENAME定居的山上，难免发生落石。它每天都会捶打坚硬的地面锻炼自己。
author: .realthree
source: If a POKENAME takes up residence on a mountain, expect some rockslides. It trains every day by punching the stony ground.

entry: 它常攀附在墙壁或天花板上，精准喷出火焰，借反作用力发动迅猛的突袭。被POKENAME夹住，会同时尝到灼热与冰寒的极致痛楚。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It often latches itself onto walls or ceilings, then launches itself in an explosive assault with a precise expulsion of its fire. Being clamped by a POKENAME is simultaneously the hottest and coldest pain a person can feel.

entry: POKENAME喜欢成群仰望星空，盼望有朝一日能加入夜空中的流星。在流星雨之夜，它们的火焰格外明亮。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME love stargazing in groups, wishing to join the shooting stars high up in the night sky one day. Their fires burn brighter during meteor showers.

entry: 每逢秋日节庆，POKENAME便会装点门廊，惊吓路过的孩子。它天性开朗，却只能以尖叫与呼喊为食。
author: Ozydamians
source: On autumn festivals, POKENAME decorate porches and scare passing children. It has a naturally sunny disposition, but can only feed on screams and shouts.

entry: POKENAME仗着庞大的身躯与力气冲撞对手，展开激烈的推挤较量。一旦落了下风，便直接朝对手脸上喷火。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME use their immense size and strength to their advantage, ramming opponents and entering intense pushing matches. When at a disadvantage, they spew flames directly in their opponent's face.

entry: 很久以前，人们会观赏POKENAME用燃烧的四肢起舞。训练家醉心于它们的舞技，模仿这些动作创造了火舞。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Long ago, POKENAME were used for entertainment as they danced with their fire-engulfed limbs.  Trainers, being invested in their techniques, mimicked them to create fire dancing.

entry: 獠牙折断后，POKENAME会用火将其焊回原处。虽然过程痛苦，修复的獠牙却极少再度折断。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If its tusks break off, POKENAME will use its fire to weld them back on. Though this process is painful, these tusks rarely ever break again.

entry: 比起实用，它战斗时更看重招式是否华丽。绝活是翻滚跃起后接擒抱或背摔，还偏爱体型更大的对手，好让动作更有看头。
author: sk372
source: It prefers using flashy moves in battle over more practical ones. Its signature move is a rolling leap into a grapple or suplex, preferably on larger opponents to maximize flair.

entry: 这只宝可梦始终怒火中烧，只能靠冥想压制，因此总闭着眼睛。据说，它一旦睁眼，整片森林都会化为灰烬。
author: amiel997
source: This Pokémon lives in constant anger and resorts to meditation to keep it under control, which is why its eyes are always closed. It is said that when it opens them, entire forests are reduced to ashes.

entry: POKENAME在冠军之路险峻的山中顶着严寒修行。它凭借武艺和能分散注意力的泡泡出奇制胜。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME trains in Victory Road's harsh mountains, enduring extreme cold. Its martial arts and distracting bubbles allow it to outwit opponents.

entry: 它有着成年个体的身躯，心智却仍像刚孵化的幼体。成熟之前，可能会危及自身及周围的生命。
author: Krune
source: With the mind of a hatchling but body of an adult, this creature can be a danger to itself and others until it matures.

entry: POKENAME会朝周围喷水，让地面映出星光，为自己的攻击提供力量。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME sprays water over its surroundings so the ground can reflect the starlight that powers its attacks.

entry: 这是古代文明制造的机关人偶，据推测是为了探索极地、研究那里的环境与生物。POKENAME伪装成波加曼，得以混入野生波加曼之中。
author: Arcul
source: An automaton made by an ancient civilization, it is speculated its purpose was to explore and study arctic landscapes and its inhabitants. POKENAME's disguise as a Piplup allows it to blend in with wild Piplup.

entry: 看似脸的部分，其实是盖住真正头部的一层皮。POKENAME脾气暴躁，发怒时准头极佳，会精准地将致命毒液射向惹怒自己的对象。
author: galactak
source: What appears to be a face is actually a hide covering its true head. POKENAME is known for its short temper and good aim when angered; it will expertly shoot deadly venom onto what angered it.

entry: POKENAME摆动布匹般的鳍，沿海底缓缓游动。凡是落到它刀刃前的东西，转眼就会被切碎吞下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waves its cloth-like fins to slowly swim along the ocean's floor. Anything that falls in front of its blades is chopped up and consumed in short order.

entry: 自尊心太强，让POKENAME很难结交朋友或找到伴侣。但只要建立了情谊，它就会以性命守护对方。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME's pride can cause it to struggle with finding friends or partners, but once it does, it will bond with them and defend them with its life.

entry: 住在海边的人，可能会在降温时于森林中见到野生POKENAME。这些高傲的宝可梦喜欢潮湿的地方，所以会出来在雪中嬉戏。
author: .realthree
source: If you live near the coast, you may see wild POKENAME in the forests when the temperature dips. These proud Pokémon prefer damp places, so they come out to play in the snow.

entry: 它生性凶悍。两只POKENAME争夺地盘时，可能在周围引发雪崩与地震。
author: kittyluv090
source: It has a very hostile demeanor. When two POKENAME fight for territory, they may create avalanches and earthquakes around them.

entry: 据说POKENAME由葬身海中的水手化成，如今仍在大海上游荡。它会从沉船中救出遇难者，引导他们平安浮上水面。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to have been born from a fallen sailor lost at sea, POKENAME wanders the open ocean. It is known to rescue people from sinking ships, guiding them safely to the surface.
