entry: POKENAME大多面朝北方，也一路向北，仿佛踏上了漫长的朝圣之路。人们认为，它是在寻找失散的家人。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Facing and heading north most of the time, POKENAME appears to be on a long pilgrimage. It is thought to be in search for the rest of its family.

entry: 带有磁性的身体会吸来海底的铁粒，凝成保护身体的外壳。但沉重僵硬的躯体也让它游得极其缓慢。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: Its magnetic body draws in granules of iron from the sea floor, which meld together to form its protective outer shell. As a result of its weight and rigidity, however, it swims at a near glacial pace.

entry: 虽然有着类似指南针的性质，它们却不朝北。科学家推测，它们指向的其实是月球的磁场。
author: Staghorn
source: Although they have compass-like properties, they do not point north. Scientists theorize that they are aligned with a magnetic field on the moon.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子又重又有磁性，总指着北方，行动起来十分不便。因此，POKENAME只得把大鼻子举到头顶上。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: POKENAME's nose is heavy and magnetic. It always faces north, which makes moving around rather difficult, as POKENAME must resort to carrying its large nose atop its head.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动地装上几个小时的石头，纯粹是为了自娱自乐。若被识破，便会摩擦双臂，发出刺耳的尖啸。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME will stand still for hours and pretend to be a rock, purely for its own amusement. If discovered, it rubs its arms together to produce an irritating screech.

entry: 它的假嘴里传出低沉轰鸣的呼吸声，看似鼻子的部位不时冒出蒸汽。不知为何，它睡觉时一定要让这张嘴朝北。
author: sk372
source: Deep rumbling breaths can be heard from its false mouth, puffs of steam emitting from what appears to be a nose. When sleeping, it always makes sure this mouth is pointed north, for unknown reasons.

entry: 据说，向北延伸的洞穴其实是POKENAME锻炼时挖出的隧道。挖掘产生的铁质碎屑都会吸附到它带磁性的尾尖上。
author: @enemyphase
source: It is said caves leading north are actually the tunnels created by POKENAME training. Any iron rubble created in this process clings to the magnetic tip of their tail.

entry: 鼻子总朝北，迫使POKENAME练就了极其敏锐的反应。几乎不可能悄悄靠近它，否则就会触发它的战斗本能，使它陷入狂暴。
author: @enemyphase
source: Due to its north-facing snout, POKENAME have had to develop impeccable reflexes. It is nearly impossible to sneak up on one without activating its fighting instinct and sending it into a frenzy.

entry: 鼻子伸出保护身体的凝胶之外，让它能闻到食物与同伴的气味。鼻孔会排出多余的凝胶，这些凝胶也带有磁性。
author: Krune
source: Its nose protrudes beyond its protective gel, allowing it to smell food and allies. The nostrils release excess gel, which has magnetic properties.

entry: 据说POKENAME是迷途旅人的灵魂所化，如今会为同样迷路的人指引方向。它手中的石头始终指向北方。
author: Atlas333
source: Said to be the spirits of a lost traveler, POKENAME now seek to guide others who have lost their way. The stone it holds is always pointing north.

entry: POKENAME总面向太阳，不断调整位置，让自己正对着它。到了正午，POKENAME便仰面躺下，鼻子直指上方。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME always faces the sun, constantly shifting its position to line itself up perfectly. Once it hits midday, POKENAME will lie on its back, pointing its nose straight up.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的每个头都各不相同，如同指纹般独一无二。一个头打起喷嚏，其他头也会接着打，产生的震动足以引发毁灭性的地震。
author: SonTyp
source: It‘s said that no two heads of any POKENAME are the same, making them as unique as fingerprints. When one head sneezes, the others follow suit, the vibrations of which can cause devastating earthquakes.

entry: 据说，在POKENAME暴走时按下鼻子，它就会立刻平静下来。但它发怒时实在太凶猛，至今还无人能以科学方法证实。
author: sk372
source: It has been said that pressing the nose of a POKENAME during its rampage will calm it down instantly. Due to the ferocity of its raging, this has yet to be scientifically verified.

entry: POKENAME十分自恋，会打磨雕凿石头身躯，塑成自己心目中的完美体形。只有硕大的鼻子不肯改动，因为它觉得那里已经无可挑剔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather vain about its physical appearance, polishing and chiseling its stone form into the build it finds perfect. The only part it refuses to adjust is its massive nose, thinking it already flawless.

entry: 它会在山壁上绘制色彩斑斓的巨幅壁画。身边总跟着一只迷你鼻，随时抹去它不满意的笔画。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It paints enormous, colorful murals on mountainsides. It is followed everywhere by a mini-nose that can undo any unsatisfactory brushstroke it makes.

entry: POKENAME背上的水晶能产生强大的磁场。朝北鼻和三合一磁怪等宝可梦会聚集在它身旁，盼望借此进化。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a strong magnetic field from the crystals on its back. Certain Pokémon like Nosepass and Magneton hang around POKENAME in hopes to evolve.

entry: POKENAME用拳头击碎巨石锻炼身体，磁性胡须则吸附碎屑，增强防御。因此，胡须越长的POKENAME就越强。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME train by crushing boulders beneath their knuckles, while their magnetic whiskers collect the debris to strengthen their defenses. Due to this, a POKENAME's beard length directly indicates their strength.

entry: 它将四肢摆成奇怪的角度，借此精细调整自身磁场的作用。一旦察觉威胁，便用成千上万根带磁性的针发动攻击。
author: Staghorn
source: It poses with its limbs at strange angles, which allows it to fine-tune the effects of its natural magnetic field. If it senses a threat, it will attack using thousands of magnetized needles.

entry: POKENAME辨别方向的本领极高，可惜模样古怪，不太受训练家青睐。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have highly sophisticated directional skills. Unfortunately, their bizarre appearance makes them unappealing to Trainers.

entry: 很久以前，四只POKENAME与人类共同生活，守护着他们的城市。如今，人们每年都会在节庆上唱起一首古老的歌，向它们致敬。
author: Doodledoo
source: A long time ago, four POKENAME lived with humanity and protected their cities. Nowadays, once a year during a festival, an ancient song is used as tribute to them.

entry: POKENAME的钢牙能迅速吸干猎物的生命。背上的囊袋被认为装着尚未吃完的食物。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's steel fangs quickly drain the life from its victims. The sack on its back is thought to hold its unfinished food.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的火焰锻造出剑，再以此迎敌。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can forge swords from the flames on its back, which it then uses to fight with.

entry: POKENAME的喙锋利如刃。它会刺穿水果和树果，吸尽里面的汁液，再将果皮抛到一旁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's beak is as sharp as a blade. It uses it to stab through fruits and berries and drink their juices from within, tossing the husk aside when it's finished.

entry: 它靠布片般的翅膀在城镇间飘游蹦跳。战斗时会尽可能升到高处，再挥刃攻击。
author: Schwaus
source: It uses its cloth wings to float and bounce across towns. During battles it gains as much height as possible before attacking with its blade.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME的出现会招来纷争。可若在开战前看见它，又被视为己方必胜的征兆。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The presence of a POKENAME is thought to bring about strife. Seeing one before battle is thought to be a sure sign of victory for your side.

entry: POKENAME在战场上搜寻甲胄碎片，焊在自己身上。它也会伏击其他拾荒者。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME scavenges battlefields for pieces of armor to weld to itself. It ambushes other scavengers.

entry: POKENAME吵闹好斗，但只要握着柄把它提起来，就会立刻安静下来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is rowdy and acts aggressively, but quickly calms down when picked up by its handle.

entry: 传说，第一只POKENAME由受封骑士的戴鲁比进化而来，促成进化的正是它心中无比的自豪。它一直为王国效力，直至王国覆灭。有人说，它的灵魂至今仍守在昔日的王座厅。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: Legends say that the first POKENAME was born when a Houndour was knighted. The great pride it felt caused it to evolve into this form. It continued to serve its kingdom until it was destroyed. Some say its spirit still guards the former throne room.

entry: POKENAME巍然伫立在海边，守护陆地免遭海兽侵袭。只需一挥剑刃，就能将海水劈开，直露海底。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stand tall at the edges of the ocean, watching over and protecting the land from the sea's beasts. A single swing of their blade is enough to split water down to the seabed.

entry: 它的草叶利刃一挥就能斩倒树木。身上长出的厚重金属铠甲能抵挡其他POKENAME的攻击。
author: Schwaus
source: Its blade of grass can cut down trees with a single stroke. It grows a thick metallic armor to protect itself from other POKENAME.

entry: 尽管身披金属铠甲，仍常能见到它飞快地纵跃于林间。POKENAME在森林中相遇，便会交战，直到剑刃崩出缺口。
author: Schwaus
source: Despite its metal armor, it is often seen leaping through forests at breakneck speeds. When POKENAME find each other in forests they fight until their blades chip.

entry: 这只POKENAME的剑身已经长长，作战时也改用长剑技法，不再沿用短剑的招式。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword combat techniques.

entry: POKENAME由两个争夺同一宿主控制权的灵魂构成。谁都不会想被卷进它们的争斗。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME consists of two spirits fighting for control of a single host. You wouldn't want to be caught in the crossfire of their skirmish.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME顶端的利刃切割力出众，却很脆，也很怕热。眼睛由玻璃般的有机物质构成，视力极佳，却比剑刃更怕热。
author: entomoxie
source: While the sharp blade on the top of a POKENAME can slice well, it is also brittle and heat-sensitive. The eye is made of an organic glass-like substance that grants superior eyesight while being more heat-sensitive than the blade.

entry: 它在古代遗迹间游荡，会毫无预兆地袭击考古学家。好在大多只是虚张声势，只要对方不退缩，它反而会退走。
author: sivanandi
source: This Pokémon roams ancient ruins, attacking archaeologists without warning. Luckily, it is mostly posturing, and will retreat if whoever it challenges does not back down.

entry: 这种奇特的宝可梦最初被发现潜伏在村中铁匠的住处附近，以锻造武器时产生的金属边角料等废料为食。
author: sk372
source: These strange Pokémon were first sighted lurking around the homes of village blacksmiths. They feast on scrap metal and other discarded materials during the process of forging weapons.

entry: POKENAME天生精通击剑，剑术出众，却不够谦逊，常向周围的人夸耀自己的高超技艺。尽管如此，它决斗时始终堂堂正正。
author: merclipse
source: Naturally gifted duelists in the art of fencing, POKENAME are worthy of praise but aren't the most humble. They often boast about their superior swordplay to those around them. Despite this flaw, they always duel clean and fair.

entry: 这只披甲的宝可梦会在夜里持剑狩猎小型猎物，极其敏锐的双眼为它提供帮助。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This armored Pokémon hunts small prey at night with sword in hand, assisted by its hypersensitive eyes.

entry: POKENAME挥剑自卫，却因持续头痛而难以集中精神。它只能胡乱挥砍，盼着总有一下能击中敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a blade in self-defense, but its constant headaches hamper its focus in battle. As such, it makes wild, inaccurate swings in hope that one will connect with the foe.

entry: POKENAME是仍在修行的年轻剑士。它仰慕前辈，希望有朝一日能拥有同等的力量与本领。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is a young swordfighter in training. It looks up to its superiors so it may one day match their strength and prowess.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是一名已故骑士侍从的坐骑。如今它仍握着对方的剑，等待重逢。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the mount of a departed squire, holding their sword as it awaits their reunion.

entry: 壳上的刃尖对周围的动静极其敏感。若有生物靠得太近，它就会甩出流苏般的舌头将其捉住，吸尽生命力。
author: sk372
source: The bladed points on its shell are extremely sensitive to its surroundings. Should something venture too close, its tassel-like tongue lashes out to grab them and drain their life force.

entry: POKENAME会先让猎物入睡，再杀死对方在梦中的化身，以此进食。受害者从此再也无法做清醒梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME puts its victims to sleep and feeds by slaying their dream self. Victims are unable to have lucid dreams ever again.

entry: POKENAME甲壳上长出的利刃能当作飞刀投出。它丢弃的刀刃还被人用来装饰海鲜菜肴的摆盘。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME grows blades from its carapace which it uses like throwing knives. Discarded knives have been used as props to present seafood dishes.

entry: POKENAME的双臂利刃让它在近战中十分难缠。若敌人试图拉开距离，POKENAME便向双剑灌注电力，射出道道电弧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bladed arms make it a formidable close-range opponent. Should a foe try to keep their distance, POKENAME charges its swords up with electricity and fires arcs of lightning.

entry: POKENAME是守护陆上居民的精锐卫士。它手持双刃，掀起狂暴的漩涡，足以劈开陆地与海洋，降伏最凶恶的深海巨兽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are the elite guardians of those who dwell outside the ocean.  With twin blades in hand, they can carve land and sea apart in a furious maelstrom meant to subdue the foulest of deep-sea beasts.

entry: POKENAME不像天蝎王那样注重隐蔽，常毫无遮掩地飞行。遇见值得一战的敌手，就会将双刃猛然相击，发起挑战。
author: sivanandi
source: Unlike Gliscor, POKENAME cares little for stealth and flies in plain sight. When it finds a foe it believes to be a worthy opponent, it will slam its blades together as a challenge.

entry: 两片草叶利刃只需几秒就能斩倒最粗壮的树木。与其他POKENAME切磋前，它总要花上几小时磨剑。
author: Schwaus
source: With its two blades of grass, even the thickest trees are felled within seconds. It spends hours sharpening its blades before sparring with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会翻滚着突袭敌人。突破对方防御后，便用两只利刃般的手臂迅速将其制服。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME ambushes its enemies by rolling toward them, swiftly incapacitating them with its two bladed arms once their defenses are broken.

entry: POKENAME是战事将至的预兆，会为城市预警敌袭。许多城市却误以为它招来了战乱，这也成了它们最后犯下的错误。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The harbinger of battle, POKENAME warns cities of raids. Misunderstanding it as the bringer of conflict has been many cities' last mistake.

entry: POKENAME攻守兼备。面对三把旋转利刃的围攻，任凭再强的对手，想找准机会重击它也得伤透脑筋。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME is a master of both defense and offense. Trying to land a good hit on it while being swarmed by three whirling blades would frustrate even the strongest opponents.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的祸患，会突然从沙丘里钻出，伏击人类商队。若运气好，损失的还只是粮食。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME are a menace of the desert, emerging from the dunes just to ambush human caravans for their food, if the humans are lucky.

entry: POKENAME在森林中游荡，仿佛凭着本能，用牙齿与利刃不加分辨地砍向树木和草属性宝可梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest slicing trees and Grass-type Pokémon with its teeth and blades indiscriminately, as if by instinct.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: Katie
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME是高草丛的克星，带着锋利的刀刃随意走动，就能割倒身旁大半植物。据说一夜便能清出1000平方英尺，偶尔还会与切割洛托姆比赛割草。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The bane of tall grass everywhere, POKENAME cuts down most plants nearby simply by wandering around with its sharpened blades. There have been reports that it can clear 1000 square feet in a single night. Sometimes it races Mow Rotom for sport.

entry: POKENAME玻璃般的眼睛从不眨动，因此常被用来看家护院。虽然看起来全神贯注，却很难说它是否真的整夜醒着。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's glassy eye never blinks, so it's commonly used as a guard in households. Though it appears focused, it's doubtful that POKENAME actually remains awake through the night.

entry: 蜂群会竭力搜寻暗之石，甚至不惜抢夺训练家的财物，以培育这种重装突击战力。每个蜂群通常只有三到四只POKENAME，遇上入侵的卡比兽或圈圈熊时便一同出动。
author: Walter Teigan
source: The hive eagerly seeks out Dusk Stones - even robbing Trainers - to create these heavy shock troops. Each hive usually only has three to four POKENAME; they are deployed as a group against encroaching Snorlax or Ursaring.

entry: 发现具有天生领导才能的人后，POKENAME便会开始一丝不苟地服从其命令，全然不顾行动的后果。
author: NexKode
source: When a POKENAME finds someone who has innate leadership, it will begin following their orders to the letter, regardless of the effects of its actions.

entry: POKENAME默默游历四方，寻找能奉为主人的训练家。一旦认可对方，就会忠心不二地效力。收服后，最好尽早为它准备剑鞘或头盔。
author: ModeusTheUnbound
source: POKENAME silently roams the world, looking for a Trainer to call its master. It is highly loyal and devoted to those it deems worthy. Be sure to buy a sheath or helmet for it at your earliest convenience.

entry: 头饰上镶着华丽的盾牌。POKENAME常将盾牌撞向树桩，敲出富有节奏的鼓点。
author: Schwaus
source: Its headdress is adorned with an ornate shield. POKENAME often slam these shields into tree stumps to create rhythmic beats.

entry: 传说，这只宝可梦一击便能横扫千军。铁匠们研究POKENAME，希望造出更精良的武器与铠甲。
author: Schwaus
source: Legends say that this Pokémon was able to defeat whole armies in a single sweep. Blacksmiths research POKENAME to create better weapons and armor.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却能作出最公正的裁决。自诞生以来，它便被“宝可梦正义律师”用作象征。
author: GalactaKiller
source: Although POKENAME is blind, it delivers the most righteous judgements. Since its creation, it has been used as a symbol of Pokémon Justice Attorneys.

entry: POKENAME出现在许多传说中。相传只有最伟大的英雄才能突破它的防御，从它身上拔出剑刃。但古往今来，从未有过成功的记载。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears in many tales where ancient legends say only the greatest of heroes can brave its defenses and pull the blade from its body. No records, past or present, exist of anyone successfully doing so.

entry: 钢铁厂常借助POKENAME进行精密切割，无需动用机器。
author: w1ndowsxp
source: POKENAME is often used in steel mills to make precision cuts without the use of machines.

entry: 古文献记载，POKENAME是自天而降的神圣守护者。与之为敌的人只要凝视它空洞的双眼，就会感到深深的恐惧。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are noted in ancient texts as divine guardians sent from the heavens. Staring into their hollow eyes instills a profound dread in any who oppose them.

entry: POKENAME是高洁的卫士，守护着自己的领地与训练家。它用头上的刀刃防御，同时挥剑迎战前来挑战的对手。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME are noble defenders, protecting their territory and their Trainers. It uses the blades on its head for defense while wielding its sword to fight those who try to challenge them.

entry: 身上的盾牌会随着年龄增长而愈发坚硬。古时，军队会在大规模战役中使用这些盾牌。
author: .izik
source: The shields on its body grow harder as it gets older. In ancient times, armies would use these shields during large battles.

entry: POKENAME的大脑藏在剑中，其余身体只是没有意识的傀儡。它渴望统治世界，认为能选出国王的自己才更有资格坐上王座。
author: dzygomer
source: POKENAME's brain is in its swords; the rest is a mindless puppet. It wishes to rule the world, believing that those capable of choosing the king are themselves actually more deserving of the throne.

entry: 起初，这些宝可梦被当作逗人取乐的小丑。后来，一个未知物种的介入使POKENAME发生了变化。
author: the_smirker
source: At first, these Pokémon were seen as jesters, amusing people. However, intervention from an unknown species caused POKENAME to change.

entry: POKENAME用利剑般的牙齿啃穿地壳。遇到强敌时，它会将整个身体当作长鞭挥动，招架对方的攻击。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME chew through the crust of the earth with teeth as sharp as swords. They can parry the attacks of powerful enemies by swinging its entire body like a large whip.

entry: 无论环境多么恶劣，甚至城市近郊，也常能见到POKENAME。家长总会叮嘱孩子别靠得太近，以免被它背上的毒刺扎伤。
author: tigerinnenumarmer
source: POKENAME are often seen even in harsh environments and near cities. Parents often tell their children not to get too close and get stung by the poisonous stings on their backs.

entry: POKENAME能通过角迅速注出储存在蛋壳内的毒液。蛋若没有直立放好，毒液就可能从裂缝中漏出。
author: ziggaway
source: The horns on POKENAME can inject the venom stored within the eggshells rapidly. The poison can leak out cracks if the eggs aren't upright.

entry: POKENAME将半个身子埋入地下，静候猎物撞上毒刺。这样既能狩猎，又能节省体力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lies still, half-buried in the ground, waiting for prey to run into its poisonous spikes. This way, it preserves energy while hunting.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，中央的眼睛会发出微光，仿佛正引动某种被遗忘的力量。研究者推测，它或许能传递只有特定宝可梦才能解读的神秘讯息。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME battles, its central eye glows faintly, as if channeling some forgotten power. Researchers speculate it might be a conduit for cryptic messages that only certain Pokémon can interpret.

entry: POKENAME生性好斗，领地意识极强。但若向体型比自己大的对手挑衅，往往落不到好下场。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME are aggressive by nature and incredibly territorial. However, their attempts at fighting anything larger than themselves tend to end poorly.

entry: 被POKENAME的角刺中后，会有轻微的灼痛感持续数日。它嬉闹起来十分莽撞，容易误伤人，因此很少有人将它当作宠物饲养。
author: Frokachu
source: Those stung by POKENAME's horn will feel a mild burn for a few days. It isn't seen as a pet too often due to its aggressively playful nature, and risk of getting stung by mistake.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺分泌的毒液调配出各具奇效的药剂。毒液呈美丽的绿色，过去曾被用于颜料，后来才遭到禁用。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the venom that is secreted from its spines to create unique elixirs with a plethora of effects. The venom is a beautiful shade of green and was used in paint before it was banned.

entry: 尽管身披坚韧的钢鳞，POKENAME却毫无主见，只会服从更强大的宝可梦。首领与敌对宝可梦交战后，常能见到整群POKENAME倒地。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite their durable steel scales, POKENAME will always follow orders underneath stronger Pokémon, having no will of their own. Entire schools of fallen POKENAME can be seen after their leaders fight with rival Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的爪由坚固而轻盈的钢构成。狩猎时，胸腔上的利刃会锁定目标，刺入猎物，使其逐渐虚弱。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's talons are made of a strong, lightweight steel. When they hunt, the blades on their ribcage lock onto the target, piercing and weakening them.

entry: POKENAME的历史极其久远，有人推测人类正是受它启发才发明了斧头。有些个体甚至愿意让训练家握着自己使用。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is so ancient, it is theorized to have inspired the creation of the axe. Some even allow their Trainer to wield them.

entry: 与钥圈儿不同，POKENAME的钥匙末端全都尖锐。虽然太小，难以在战斗中造成永久伤害，训练家接触它时仍得小心。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Klefki, POKENAME's keys all end in sharp points. However, they are too small to cause any permanent harm in battle. Still, Trainers are advised to be careful when handling this Pokémon.

entry: 这只宝可梦喜欢与同族赛跑。POKENAME对闯入者颇有敌意，尤其不欢迎百变丁。
author: galactak
source: A Pokémon that loves racing with its kin. POKENAME is somewhat aggressive towards any intruders, especially towards Ditpuff.

entry: POKENAME梦想着打垮敌人，却没有足够的力气。它只好观看战斗，幻想自己也是其中一员。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME dreams of demolishing its enemies, but lacks the physical strength to do so. Instead, it watches battles and daydreams about being one of the participants.

entry: POKENAME全身披着钢甲，双臂上的刀刃锋利无比，连最坚韧的橡树也能斩断。
author: Jona_hehe
source: POKENAME is covered from head to toe in steel armor. The blades on POKENAME's arms are sharp enough to cut even the strongest of oak trees.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME因袭击村庄、索取黄金贡品而恶名远扬。如今在某些乡间，仍能找到它们堆满黄金的巢穴。
author: NellNast42
source: Long ago, POKENAME were infamous for raiding villages for tributes of gold. Their gold-stuffed lairs can still be discovered in certain countrysides.

entry: 它极其胆小，却仍选择挺身作战，保护他人。决心越坚定，外壳就越坚固。
author: ker.0
source: It is extremely fearful but still chooses to fight to protect others. The more resolute they are, the sturdier their shell becomes.

entry: 它用一对灌注了精神力量的短刀作战。只有打算一击结束战斗时，它的气场才会显现出来。
author: Staghorn
source: It fights with a pair of psionically-charged knives. Its aura is only visible when it intends to end the battle with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME能为人取暖，在寒冷地区深受喜爱。它喜欢依偎着训练家，也喜欢对方替自己梳去毛发上的静电。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME is well-loved in cold regions for its use as a heater. It enjoys cuddling with its Trainer and getting the static brushed from its fur.

entry: 偏离常走路线太远的训练家，可能不幸误入POKENAME的巢穴。它们领地意识极强，双眼甚至能看透实体障碍，靠得太近的人免不了吃尽苦头。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Unfortunate Trainers that wander too far off the beaten path risk the possibility of encountering a POKENAME nest. Their territorial instincts and eyes that see through even solid surfaces ensure a world of pain for those that creep too close.

entry: 电流穿过双眼，让它能看清栖息的幽暗水域。被它瞪视的宝可梦可能吓得动弹不得。
author: currentlymuffin
source: Electricity runs through their eyes, allowing them to see through the dark waters where they live. Its glare can cause other Pokémon to freeze.

entry: POKENAME虽然总板着脸，却深爱自己的训练家。它会用透视能力时时刻刻注视着对方。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its permanent scowl, POKENAME deeply loves its Trainer. It will use its x-ray vision to watch its Trainer at all moments of the day.

entry: 它会扑向猎物，用带电的爪子与角将其麻痹。见什么都爱打上一架，兴奋不起来时，甚至会电自己一下。
author: Frokachu
source: It pounces on prey, paralyzing them with electric claws and horns. They like picking fights with almost anything, and will even shock itself to get excited.

entry: POKENAME被激怒时，外壳便会飞速旋转，迸出火花。这表示它即将释放猛烈的电击。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's shell will spin and spark rapidly when it's angered. This signifies that it's about to unleash a huge blast of electricity.

entry: 唯有凝视饱受折磨的灵魂，才能让它感到快乐。有人认为，POKENAME会模仿故事中的某些角色，从中汲取力量。
author: Degla
source: It only feels joy when staring deep into a suffering soul. Some believe POKENAME draws power by mimicking certain characters in stories.

entry: 一旦被POKENAME盯上，就难逃它残酷的袭击。它能以音速在空中飞驰，双眼还能看穿墙壁，多数猎物转瞬便被吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME decides on its prey, a brutal attack is inevitable. It jets through the air at sonic speed, and it possess powerful vision that allows it to see through walls. Most prey is gobbled up in an instant.

entry: POKENAME像家族中的成体一样自信又好斗，因此常向自己打不赢的对手挑衅。不过，它冲撞敌人时仍能释放出威力不俗的电击。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to have the confidence and eagerness of the adults in its family, and because of this it picks fights it can't win. It can still pack a decent shock when charging into something though.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐的目光发现沙下的猎物，再将其困入深坑，以猛烈的电流断绝逃路。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME uses its sharp eyesight to detect prey beneath the sand. It traps them in a pit, where a surge of electricity ensures they cannot escape.

entry: POKENAME既能分泌致命毒素，也能储存电能。攻击时，它通过尖刺与尾巴将毒液和电火花一并释放，足以摧毁敌人的神经系统。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is capable of both secreting lethal toxins and storing electrical energy. When it attacks, it fuses venom with sparks through its spines and tails to unleash deadly attacks capable of destroying the nervous systems of its enemies.

entry: POKENAME会整夜尾随猎物，直到对方筋疲力尽。随后猛扑而上，用尖刺产生的电流发动攻击。
author: Riverbandage
source: POKENAME stalks its prey throughout the night until it is exhausted. When it pounces, it attacks using electricity produced by its thorns.

entry: 出于对音乐的热爱，POKENAME不断苦练，将天赋磨炼得炉火纯青。它的歌唱技艺已臻化境，出众的嗓音令世界各地无数人倾倒。
author: Voxary
source: POKENAME's innate musical talent was honed and perfected through its non-stop training and love for music. It has become an apex of singing talent, and many worldwide admire POKENAME's dazzling voice.

entry: 人们推测，POKENAME能看透物质与心灵。它能用纯光创造物品，自如地操纵；据说凝视它的手杖，还能看穿实体。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are theorized to see anything physically and mentally. It can create objects out of pure light that it controls freely. Staring into its staff is said to allow you to see through physical matter.

entry: POKENAME是强大的猎手，目光几乎能穿透一切，找到目标后便以电击捕猎。它若在水中狩猎，甚至能摧毁整个生态系统。
author: astral_1447
source: A potent hunter, POKENAME can see through nearly anything, using its vision to spot targets and electrocute them. In water, a hunting POKENAME can knock out entire ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME能喷出细化至原子级的铁粉，飘散起来几乎如同气体。它深知这种攻击会让生物痛苦而死，因此只肯用来对付班基拉斯。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can expel atomically fractured iron powder that practically behaves like a gas. Because it knows how cruel it is to submit any living creature to this painful and deadly attack, POKENAME will only use it against a Tyranitar.

entry: POKENAME的领地意识极强。坚固的头骨能轻易击碎金属，全身铠甲更比钢铁坚韧。一旦发起冲锋，沿途没有什么能幸免。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. Its reinforced skull can shatter metal with ease, and its body is clad in armor tougher than steel. When it charges, nothing in its path stands a chance.

entry: 这位远洋巨兽的霸主有时被称为“移动堡垒鲸”。古老传说中，一位术士曾与它立下誓约，在它背上建造城堡。训练家会乘着它，平安探索茫茫大海。
author: Alkazamis
source: This titanic lord of the pelagic ocean is sometimes known as the Mobile Fortress Whale, recalling an old legend in which a mystic made an oath with one and built a castle on its back. Trainers use them to explore the whale roads in safety.

entry: POKENAME极其重视领地，会向入侵者投掷巨石。曾有一只POKENAME引发山崩，摧毁了整个村庄。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are fiercely territorial, hurling boulders at trespassers. One POKENAME caused a rockslide that destroyed an entire village.

entry: 两个头不断互相撞击，想比出谁的铠甲更坚硬。可惜铠甲太重，它们的行动相当受限。
author: Mistymagius
source: The two heads constantly bash each other to see whose armor is stronger. However, their armor is so heavy that their movement is pretty limited.

entry: 它在海底沉眠，察觉异常便会苏醒，迎战狂暴的宝可梦，随后再回到深海。它们能与训练家达到完美同步。
author: ker.0
source: It lies dormant at seabeds. Should it sense a disturbance it will awaken to fight rampaging Pokémon, before returning to the depths. They can achieve perfect synchronization with their Trainers.

entry: 寄生在POKENAME体内的真菌迫使它吞食大量铁，用吃下的金属供自己生长。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus that inhabits POKENAME compels it to eat massive amounts of iron. The consumed metal supports the fungus' growth.

entry: POKENAME嗡嗡地穿行于沙暴，帮迷路的旅人找到附近的绿洲。它会高速振动翅膀，抖去种子上的沙尘。
author: Ozydamians
source: Buzzing through sandstorms, POKENAME will help guide lost travelers to an oasis near them. It rapidly vibrates its wings to clean the dust from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME擅长追踪。覆盖双眼的护目镜状薄膜，让它在最猛烈的沙暴中也能看清事物。这种忠诚的宝可梦会救助在沙漠里迷路的训练家。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are excellent trackers, with the visor-like film over its eyes allowing it to see clearly through the harshest sandstorms. These loyal Pokémon will rescue Trainers it finds lost in the desert.

entry: POKENAME在地下穿行，背上长满会散播毒孢子的花。它伏击毫无防备的猎物，用强劲的藤鞭从下方突袭。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME burrows through the ground, its back covered in toxic flowers that release poisonous spores. It ambushes unsuspecting prey, using its powerful vine whips to strike from below.

entry: POKENAME只有在需要掀起沙暴驱敌时才会飞行。它沉稳坚毅，又富有守护之心，颇具王者风范，因此在流行文化中有时会被描绘成王族。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME only fly to kick up sandstorms to ward off enemies. Their protective and stoic nature give it a feel of royalty, so it is sometimes depicted as such in popular culture.

entry: POKENAME用身体发出的绿光引来虫属性宝可梦，再以火焰烧死它们。它似乎也很喜欢熔化沙粒，塑成玻璃雕像。
author: Mistymagius
source: The green light from POKENAME's body draws in bug Pokémon before incinerating them with its flames. It seems to enjoy making glass sculptures by melting and shaping sand.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴扬起沙尘，制造沙暴。它不轻易原谅他人，会永远记得谁曾苛待自己。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME flings sand with its tails to create sandstorms. It is not very forgiving and will always remember those who treat it poorly.

entry: POKENAME轻轻振翅，发出舒缓的振动。感受过的人说，那就像一首轻柔抚慰心灵的摇篮曲。
author: noel5229
source: By subtly flapping its wings, POKENAME emits soothing vibrations. Those who have experienced this sensation have described it as a caressing lullaby.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，凡是遇见它的人却无不心生敬意。它最常出现在睡莲叶间。
author: flickeredflame
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is revered by all those who come across it. It can be found most commonly among lily pads.

entry: 羽毛美丽又锋利如刀，许多人渴望将其用作武器。但它十分高傲，不许任何人触碰。
author: bostroms
source: Its feathers are coveted as weapons both for their beauty and their razor sharpness.  However, because it is so proud, it won't allow anyone to touch them.

entry: POKENAME能随意调整背部鳞片的颜色与反光程度。在水中时，鳞片反射光线，让从上方观察的捕食者几乎看不见POKENAME。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME can adjust the color and reflectivity of its back scales at will. When viewed in water from above, the scales catch the light and render the POKENAME nearly invisible to predators.

entry: 它被称为沼泽的守护者，只要现身便足以平息纷争。背上的花能反映栖息地的生态是否健康。
author: flickeredflame
source: Known as the guardian of swamps, its mere presence is able to stop conflicts. The flower on its back is a good indicator of the health of the area it lives in.

entry: 据说，剑鞘上流光溢彩的鳞片能平复狂躁的心。POKENAME正好借此安抚猎物，再出手袭击。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts; perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.

entry: 特殊的鳞片让POKENAME无论潜入水中还是跃出水面，都丝毫不减速度。出色的飞行与游泳本领使它成为优秀的猎手。
author: Phantom640
source: Thanks to its scales, POKENAME can dive in and out of the water without losing any speed. Its excellent flying and swimming make it a great hunter.

entry: 腹部会分泌一种肥皂般的液体，遇水后在周围覆上一层滑溜溜的泡沫。在这样的地面上，它的行动不但不受阻，反而更加敏捷。
author: omegacyclops
source: A special soap-like fluid is secreted from its underbelly, which when combined with water becomes a slippery, bubble-like coat to its surroundings. Its movement is not impaired, but instead enhanced in this terrain.

entry: 有人想让丑丑鱼更像进化后的模样，以此将其“美化”，POKENAME便因此诞生。丑丑鱼爱好者对此褒贬不一。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME is the result of attempts to "beautify" Feebas by making them resemble their evolution. Opinions of POKENAME among Feebas fans are mixed.

entry: 它们成群聚集在珊瑚礁附近，保护小型鱼类宝可梦。但若有船只靠近，便会猛烈攻击，直到将船彻底摧毁。
author: Mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon hang around coral reefs and provide protection for smaller fish Pokémon. However, if any boats come near their reef, they will violently attack it until there is nothing left.

entry: 相传，它诞生于火与水之中，兼具美丽与威严。POKENAME若察觉领地附近有危险，便会飞快振动尾鳞生热，将水烧得滚烫，射向入侵者。
author: merclipse
source: Fabled to be born of fire and water, which exudes both beauty and authority. When POKENAME senses danger near its territory, the scales on its tail vibrate rapidly, generating heat, boiling water to scalding temperatures to fire upon intruders.

entry: 它性情温和，喜欢与人相处。即使野生丑丑鱼咬住尾巴也不在意，因为覆满鳞片的身体与再生能力能免去疼痛，也不会留下长久的伤害。
author: SonTyp
source: Feral Feebas biting its tail isn't a big concern for this sociable and patient creature, as its scale-covered body and regenerative powers prevent pain and lasting damage.

entry: 背上水炮的威力足有水箭龟的三倍。尽管实力强大，POKENAME仍宁愿避开争斗。
author: admiralvermin
source: The cannon on its back is three times as powerful as a Blastoise's. Despite its strength, POKENAME prefers to avoid conflict.

entry: 严格说来，POKENAME只能滑翔，还算不上真正会飞，但它仍为长出的翅膀欢喜不已。它对此十分自豪，即使变身成别的模样，也会特意保留双翼。
author: sk372
source: Though technically only able to glide rather than achieving true flight, POKENAME still delights in the wings it grew. It's so proud, that whenever it transforms it purposely retains them while in its new shape.

entry: POKENAME总被七个一组的事物吸引，因为七似乎是它唯一能数清并理解的数字。许多古代文化都将这种小生物称为“月之子”。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME always feels attracted to anything that comes in groups of seven, for it seems to be the only number that can count and comprehend. In many ancient cultures, this little creature was known as "The Moonchild".

entry: POKENAME全身的尖刺长得快得惊人，攻击时又常会脱落。一次猛扑就能射出多达一百根尖刺，通常直冲对手而去。
author: omegacyclops
source: The spikes that cover its entire body grow alarmingly fast, and POKENAME tends to shed them during any attack. A single lunge can create up to a hundred of these projectiles, often towards its opponents.

entry: 这种宝可梦极其罕见，又称“新月骑士”。它会用利爪撕碎一切活动的东西。据说，它们是受新月光芒影响而变化的特殊艾路雷朵。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: Also known as 'Cresent Knight', these Pokémon are very rare. They use their sharp claws to tear apart anything that moves. It is said that these are special Gallades transformed by the influence of the crescent moon's light.

entry: POKENAME的躯干始终保持蓝白两色，以便融入云中，翅膀与褶边却可随心变色。它们欢快地在空中竞速，留下宛如奇异彩虹的彩色尾迹。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME always keep their torsos blue and white to blend in among the clouds, but change the color of their wings and frills freely. They joyfully race with each other across the sky, creating colored contrails that resemble odd rainbows.

entry: 它用超能力将自己弹射出去，在空中如巨大的手里剑般旋转，甚至能超过超音速战斗机。
author: Staghorn
source: It launches itself using its psychic abilities, spinning like a gigantic shuriken as it flies. It can outpace even supersonic fighter jets.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME几乎势不可挡。铁甲般的头颅撞不毁的东西，它便用烈焰吐息熔化，所到之处尽成废墟。
author: Spartan_CT
source: An enraged POKENAME is incredibly difficult to stop. What it fails to destroy with its ironclad head, it melts with fiery breath, leaving only ruin in its wake.

entry: POKENAME以难以想象的速度翱翔，只需几分钟就能轻松绕地球一周。能量输出达到极限时，它的推进力可达到平时的四倍。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME soars at unimaginable speeds, easily circling the earth world in minutes. When it maximizes its energy output, its propulsive power quadruples.

entry: 它几乎总待在自己收集的大堆宝石上，常常苦恼着究竟该将它们吃掉，还是留下珍藏。
author: Dusknoir64
source: This Pokémon can almost always be found on the vast pile of gems it has collected. It often agonizes over whether to eat them or to keep them.

entry: 寄生者吸走了大半生命力，让POKENAME再也无法飞翔。宿主虽被视为只剩空壳，却仍因飞行之梦被夺而心怀怒火，偶尔会不分对象地大肆暴走。
author: sk372
source: The parasite having absorbed most of its life essence, POKENAME can no longer fly. Though supposedly a husk, the host's lingering rage at being denied its dream causes it to occasionally rampage indiscriminately.

entry: 平时，POKENAME会用齿轮拧紧体内的发条。进入战斗后，便释放发条中储存的能量，发动威力惊人的攻击。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: When POKENAME is not battling, it uses its gears to wind a spring inside its body. When it enters battle, it uses the energy stored within the spring to attack with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME在机体内燃烧大量煤炭及其他燃料。它能转动履带，射出炽热的金属板，甚至用锋利的前端劈开厚重的金属墙。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It burns masses of coal and other fuel sources in its hull. POKENAME has the ability to spin its treads, shoot out hot slabs of metal, and even split thick metal walls with its sharp-edged front.

entry: 为驱动火车而制造的人造宝可梦系列中的第三种。它的身体已能将燃料利用效率发挥到极致。
author: Gayschlatt
source: The third in a line of man-made Pokémon made for train engines. Its body has managed to maximize fuel efficency.

entry: POKENAME有时被称为“机械女王”，能影响所有机械宝可梦。手杖上的圆珠，足以开启或关闭任何科技设备，而这份力量只有POKENAME自己能唤醒。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes referred to as "The Machine Queen," POKENAME has influence over all mechanical Pokémon. The orb on its staff is able to power-up or power-down any technology, a power only POKENAME can activate.

entry: 这头发条机械巨兽十分适合迎战传说中的海中巨兽。源源不绝的水热能为它提供动力，但一遇干旱就会失控。
author: sk372
source: This clockwork monstrosity is well-suited to battle against legendary leviathans. Its powered by a bottomless well of hydrothermal energy that goes haywire during droughts.

entry: 这头机械生物十分适合迎战传说中的巨神。为引擎供能的人造太阳一旦遭遇暴雨，就会出现故障。
author: sk372
source: This mechanical creature is well-suited to battle against legendary titans. The artificial sun powering its engine glitches out when confronted by heavy rains.

entry: POKENAME极其贪食金属，会疯狂袭击工厂里的机器，大快朵颐。由于成群出现时破坏严重，人们将它视为祸害。
author: Daemonkill22
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for metal, attacking factory machinery in a feeding frenzy. It is considered a pest because of the damage it causes in large swarms.

entry: POKENAME四处奔走，寻找珍贵的宝石，制成华贵的装饰齿轮。这样做究竟有何用处，至今无人知晓。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME scampers about searching for precious gems that it can make into valuable decorative gears. What purpose this behaviour serves is unknown.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其危险，会制造幻象分散对方的注意，再从背后突袭。
author: Prof.Whitebeam
source: Wild POKENAME are highly dangerous because of their ability to create an illusion as a distraction while it strikes from behind.

entry: 它既能操纵幻象，身体又极易变形，只要体量足够，几乎能变成任何想要的模样。但若突然受惊，就会恢复原形。
author: El Fail
source: Its power over illusions and ability to shapeshift its incredibly malleable body means that it can take on nearly any appearance it desires, as long as it has the body mass for it. If it is suddenly surprised, it will revert to its original form.

entry: 遇上捕食者时，POKENAME会制造火焰的幻象，试图将其吓退。它平时很戒备训练家，只有获得它信任的人才知道，它的毛发柔软无比。
author: Tmotime
source: Whenever it encounters predators, POKENAME creates illusionary flames in an attempt to scare them away. While it's normally wary of Trainers, those it trusts find its fur to be incredibly soft.

entry: 这种宝可梦常被视为智慧与狡黠的象征。它精通幻术，能让自己看似同时出现在多处，欺骗猎物和捕食者。更可怕的是，它甚至能让森林仿佛永无尽头。
author: El Fail
source: A Pokémon often associated with vast wisdom and cunning. Its mastery over illusions allows it to appear in many places at once, deceiving both prey and those who hunt it. Even more frighteningly, its illusions can make forests appear endless.

entry: POKENAME在深海投射全息影像，引诱猎物、吓退天敌。感到寂寞时，它也会用这种力量创造想象中的朋友。
author: epping_forest
source: It projects holograms in the deep sea to lure prey and scare predators. When it feels lonely, POKENAME uses that power to create imaginary friends.

entry: 据说，数咩利羊能让人安稳入眠。但若数的是POKENAME，就会坠入无尽的噩梦。
author: fraggleBattySprite
source: Counting Mareep is said to lull any person into a restful night's sleep. Counting POKENAME however, is said to damn the person into an endless nightmare.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，会制造幻象迷惑潜在的敌人，或掩护自己逃走。它体型大、模样讨人喜欢，又不具攻击性，是很受欢迎的幼儿伴侣。
author: El Fail
source: This incredibly shy Pokémon can conjure illusions to mislead potential enemies or cover its escape. Due to its large size, cuddly appearance, and lack of aggression, POKENAME are prized highly as pets for young children.

entry: 这种高贵的宝可梦能编织极其精妙的幻象，将人类引离家园。若付出一部分生命力，甚至能让幻影生物化为实体。
author: cheroace
source: This noble Pokémon can create the most elaborate illusions to lure humans away from its home. It can even make illusory creatures tangible if it sacrifices some of its life force.

entry: POKENAME用幻术对自己眼中的弱小训练家与宝可梦隐去身形。唯有遇到值得一战的强敌，才会现身挑战。
author: Hello_I_Exist
source: POKENAME uses its illusions to hide itself from Trainers and Pokémon it considers to be weak. It will only reveal itself to worthy opponents in order to challenge them to a fight.

entry: 为守护巢穴，POKENAME会合力迷惑被视为威胁的对象，随即迅速出击。它的速度与灵活程度无可比拟。
author: DaHappycute
source: To protect their lair, POKENAME work together to trick and swiftly attack at those they deem to be a threat. It has speed and agility like no other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME精通战斗与诡计，却往往回避交锋，而是用电气幻象藏起幼崽，保护它们。它们也喜欢制造虚假的雷暴，赶走竞争者与好奇的人。
author: CpnQuacken
source: A master of both battle and trickery, POKENAME tend to shy away from combat, instead creating electrical mirages to hide their children from danger. They love to create illusionary thunderstorms to drive away competitors and curious people.

entry: POKENAME是顶尖的夜间猎手，会制造停电，让猎物陷入恐惧。它既能透视，又能操纵幻象，是难以蒙蔽视线的可怕敌手。
author: merclipse
source: The ultimate nocturnal hunter, POKENAME causes blackouts to terrify its prey. Its X-ray vision and illusion manipulation make it a fearsome foe whose eyes cannot be blinded.

entry: POKENAME力量极强，领地意识也极其强烈。巡护员会密切留意它们的栖息地，避免它们游荡到人类住处附近。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are both incredibly territorial and incredibly strong. Rangers keep a close eye on their habitat to ensure they don't roam too close to where people live.

entry: POKENAME穿梭于阴影中，九条缥缈的尾巴如轻烟般闪动。它精于欺瞒，会先以幻象迷惑对手，再用迅疾的火焰攻击。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME weaves through the shadows, its nine ethereal tails flickering like wisps of smoke. A master of deception, it creates illusions that confuse foes, striking with swift, fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: El Fail
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: El Fail
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: 野生POKENAME行踪隐秘，袭人事件虽少，却十分凶残。受害者说，挨上一轮又一轮痛打时，眼前还会浮现各种怪异的景象。
author: bobosmith01
source: As they are elusive, attacks from wild POKENAME are rare but brutal. Victims report seeing all kinds of strange sights while they were pummeled over and over.

entry: 只要有游行，就能在花车上见到POKENAME。活动不结束，它们的舞步便不会停。
author: rosemagwin
source: Whenever a parade is around, POKENAME can be found on its floats. For as long as the event lasts, they will be dancing.

entry: 它是为陪伴患有抑郁症的训练家而试制的伙伴。身体虽棱角分明，触感却相当柔软，很受女性欢迎。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: It's an experimental companion intended to help Trainers with depression. Its angular body is actually quite soft, and it's very popular with women.

entry: 这只宝可梦仍在努力塑造理想中的身体。请耐心等待，直到它准备好破壳而出。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: A Pokèmon that is still working on its ideal body. Please wait patiently until it's ready to come out of its shell.

entry: 它是强大又自信的蜂巢统治者。毒针能注入大量抗雄激素，降低袭击者的攻击性。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: The strong, confident ruler of a hive. Its stinger injects a large amount of anti-androgens, reducing the aggression of attackers.

entry: 它散发着宁静的气息，能凭令人敬畏的超能力平息争端，也能与任何种类的宝可梦交朋友。
author: rigelpogi08
source: With its radiating tranquility, it resolves conflicts with awe-inspiring psychic prowess. It can befriend any type of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME开朗亲人，香气怡人。每当春日第一朵花绽放，它便会现身野外。人们认为它冬季会迁往远方，却从无人亲眼见过。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a cheerful and affectionate Pokémon known for its brilliant aroma and for appearing in the wild as soon as the first flower blooms in the spring. It is thought to migrate far away in winter, but none have seen this firsthand.

entry: 它们常亲手制作礼物送给训练家，表达自己的喜爱。
author: pankiwi
source: As a sign of affection for their Trainers, they will frequently make them gifts to show how much they love them.

entry: 情感更加丰富，还内置投影屏幕，POKENAME将笔记本电脑与朋友完美结合。它是西尔佛公司引以为傲的最新成果。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: With upgraded emotional range and built-in projector screen, POKENAME is the perfect fusion of laptop and friend. It's the latest pride of Silph Co.

entry: POKENAME喜欢参加游行。它的快乐与乐观极富感染力。
author: rosemagwin
source: POKENAME loves joining parades. Its happiness and positivity is highly contagious.

entry: POKENAME能将训练家给予的欢乐与关爱放大，化作魔力。彼此的羁绊越深，POKENAME就越强大。
author: MileySakiko
source: POKENAME have been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into magical power. The greater the bond they share, the stronger POKENAME will become.

entry: 遭遇强敌时，翅膀般的尾巴便会轻轻飘动，散发祥和的气息，令对手心生敬畏，恍然出神。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When confronted by a powerful foe, its wing-like tail flutters, exuding a peaceful aura that leaves its opponents in a majestic trance.

entry: POKENAME闪电形的触角噼啪作响，滑翔时迸出无害的电火花。它喜欢钻进电子设备，凭着讨人喜欢的天性惹出些欢快的小乱子，逗得人们展露笑颜。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME's bolt-shaped feelers crackle with playful electric energy, sparking harmlessly as it glides around. It enjoys sneaking into electronics, using its charm to cause cheerful and playful chaos. It enjoys bringing smiles to faces.

entry: 休息时，它习惯把训练家拉进周身液体中的一处空腔。里面温暖舒适，也不会让人受伤。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: It has a habit of pulling its Trainer into a pocket of its surrounding fluid when at rest. This feels warm and comfy, not posing any risk of injury.

entry: 这只宝可梦造型流畅时尚，只需待在口袋或手提包里，就能替你守护重要物品，也照顾你的心情。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: With its sleek, chic design, this Pocket Monster can protect your Key Items and emotional well-being all from inside a pocket or purse.

entry: POKENAME迁徙的足迹遍及世界各地，因此被广泛视为太平与好日子的象征。掉落的贵重鳞片，常被身陷困境的人拾到，给他们一个改善生活的机会。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: POKENAME is widely regarded as a sign of good times and peace, due to their migration pattern that leads it across all regions in the world. Their valuable scales are typically found by those in bad situations, allowing them a chance at better lives.

entry: 这种融合体拥有惊人的超能力，却也产生了令人忧心的狂妄念头：要将和平与爱强加给整个银河，并消灭一切反抗者。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion gains an incredible amount of psychic strength. It also develops a worrying megalomaniac instinct to impose peace and love across the galaxy, annihilating anyone who resists.

entry: POKENAME常与同类聚集，用小丝带轻敲液态的身体，交流感情、加深情谊。
author: zic
source: POKENAME will often gather with others of its kind to communicate and bond. They do this by tapping their small ribbons against their liquid bodies.

entry: POKENAME的细胞质发育得更加结实，终于可以亲热地拥抱训练家，而不至于把自己的身体弄散。
author: zic
source: With its cytoplasm becoming more developed and sturdy, POKENAME are able to hug their Trainers affectionately without their bodies breaking apart.

entry: 拥抱POKENAME时请多加小心。这个惹人喜爱的小家伙在感到快乐或爱意时，体温可能会超过20,000度。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: Please exercise caution when hugging POKENAME. This little love bug's body temperature can exceed 20,000 degrees when it feels joy or affection.

entry: 这是一只可怕的海洋宝可梦。长长的触须会把猎物拖进利齿密布的大口中。奇怪的是，POKENAME近几年却颇受女性欢迎。
author: Momoiro Akane
source: A terrifying sea Pokémon, its long tendrils draw prey into its razor-sharp maw. Bizarrely, POKENAME has become popular with women in recent years.

entry: POKENAME热心又有活力，所到之处都充满欢笑。公司常请它来鼓舞员工的士气。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Being warm-hearted and energetic, POKENAME brings a sense of joyfulness to wherever it goes. Companies frequently use this Pokémon to raise the morale of their employees.

entry: POKENAME仅凭体温就能感知任何生物的情绪。它手中的枝条点燃后，顶端会燃起柔和的粉红火焰，散发无害而怡人的香气，每个人闻到的味道都不相同。
author: merclipse
source: A POKENAME can sense the emotions of any living being from body heat alone. When lit, the stick this Pokémon wields burns a soft pink flame at the tip, giving off a harmless, pleasant aroma with a scent that differs for each individual smelling it.

entry: 儿童童话里，它常是守护纯洁善良之人的魔法使者。现实中的POKENAME会用魔杖的香气迅速平息争端：大多数人就此冷静下来，怒不可遏的人则会直接昏倒。
author: merclipse
source: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.

entry: 儿童童话里，它常是守护纯洁善良之人的魔法使者。现实中的POKENAME会用魔杖的香气迅速平息争端：大多数人就此冷静下来，怒不可遏的人则会直接昏倒。
author: merclipse
source: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.

entry: POKENAME是凶狠的猎手，会俯冲施以毒击，再飞回高空，等待猎物毒发倒下。因此，在它附近必须格外小心。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are vicious predators, swooping down to deliver a poisonous blow then retreating back into the sky until its prey succumbs. It's recommended to exercise extreme caution around them for this reason.

entry: POKENAME无法用回声定位，只能靠翼状的大耳倾听风声，辨别前进方向。这虽很管用，却也让它对其他声音过度敏感。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME lacks the ability to use echolocation, so it uses its wing-like ears to listen to the wind in order to get around. While helpful, this makes it hyper-sensitive to other sounds.

entry: 它冲锋时会震动大地，在地上留下地图般错综复杂的裂痕。这些裂痕却会在几小时内消失，令研究者大感兴趣。
author: jaminmcready
source: The ground trembles when it charges, leaving intricate fissures resembling maps etched into the ground. These formations vanish within hours, intriguing researchers.

entry: 背后的尾巴增强了旋转时的破坏力。只要不断旋转，甚至能将整条街道摧毁。
author: Soup1900
source: The tail on its back adds to the destructive force of its spin. As long as it's spinning, it can even destroy entire streets.

entry: 人们曾以为POKENAME的剑刃是牙齿变异而来。其实，围绕剑刃形成的头部，才是剑柄剧烈蜕变的结果。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It was once believed that POKENAME's blade was a tooth that mutated. In truth, the head that has formed around it is a result of drastic metamorphosis of its hilt.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，是威力惊人的穿刺钻。据说，头上与背上的尖刺之所以如此坚韧，全凭它纯粹的斗志与骄傲。
source: POKENAME uses its tail as an immensely powerful piercing drill. It's said that the intense durability of the spikes on its head and its back is due to POKENAME's sheer battle spirit and pride.

entry: 野生POKENAME自私又难相处。在暴风雪中，它能从肉眼可见的范围消失，再突然现身，用带毒的身体撞向敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME feature a selfish and disagreeable personality. In blizzards, it can disappear from the naked eye and reappear to suddenly ram foes with its poisonous body.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却极其危险。为保护训练家，它会彻底陷入狂怒，不断破坏周围的地形，直到消灭所有威胁。
author: Celio_0230
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is incredibly dangerous. It will go into a blind rage to protect its Trainer, destroying the surrounding terrain until every threat is defeated.

entry: POKENAME的爪力足以推倒输电铁塔。它会将鬃毛上的毒涂在爪上，使猎物麻痹。
author: Celio_0230
source: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to topple a transmission tower. The poison it applies to its claws from its mane paralyzes its prey.

entry: POKENAME的毒素全都集中在尾巴里。战斗时，它会用尾巴作钝器，接连猛击敌人，不断削弱对方的体力。
author: Celio_0230
source: POKENAME's poison is concentrated entirely in its tail. In a fight, it will use the tail as a bludgeoning tool, sapping their foe's strength as it pummels them relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME与尼多王互不相让，争着证明，领导尼多一族，究竟靠智慧还是靠力量更有效。科学家观察至今，仍未分出高下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME and Nidoking have a strong rivalry, competing to see if brains or brawn is more effective at leading Nidoran families. Scientific observation thus far has yet to indicate which is the superior outcome.

entry: POKENAME统领着由白海狮融合体组成的族群，命令不容违抗。不听从的成员会被POKENAME逐出群体。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME is the leader of packs of Dewgong fusions, and its command is absolute. Disobedient members will be banished from their pack by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME外表虽小，却因无法完全控制自身力量，常会爆发出惊人的威力。据说它会出现在遭受干旱的地区。
author: moga6
source: Despite a small appearance, POKENAME's powers can be overwhelming due to a lack of full control. POKENAME is said to appear in areas suffering from drought.

entry: POKENAME在深海静静漂流，外壳足以承受极大的水压。它的存在会微妙地影响洋流，因此周围的海水总是异常平静。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.

entry: POKENAME在深海静静漂流，外壳足以承受极大的水压。它的存在会微妙地影响洋流，因此周围的海水总是异常平静。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.

entry: 据说POKENAME飞到哪里，就会为哪里带来雨水。它振翅洒水，令土地重获生机。虽有强大力量，POKENAME却更愿滋养环境，无意投入无谓的战斗。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME is said to bring rain wherever it flutters, using its wings to scatter water that revitalizes any soil. Despite its immense strength, POKENAME focuses on nurturing its environment rather than engaging in pointless battles.

entry: 它们栖息在偏僻海岸外的巨石间。POKENAME本是一片好意，发出的亮光却曾让许多水手迷失航向。
author: currentlymuffin
source: They live among large rocks off of isolated shorelines. Many sailors have been led astray by the bright light from a well-meaning POKENAME.

entry: 充盈POKENAME体内的原始能量，让齿轮始终转动。据说，唯有所有海洋都干涸时，它才会停下来。
author: .realthree
source: The primal energy that fills POKENAME keeps its gears spinning. It is said it will only become still if all the oceans dry up.

entry: 固拉多与盖欧卡争斗了数千年。直到融合为POKENAME，双方的宿怨才告终，如今它们共同君临一切。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: Groudon and Kyogre quarreled for millennia. But after fusing together and forming POKENAME, their rivalry ended, and they now reign supreme.

entry: 史料将POKENAME的现身与异常天气联系在一起。彼此冲撞的飓风、火山雷电、被洪水淹没的沙漠，都被归因于它的到来。
author: kingd8
source: Historical accounts associate strange weather with sightings of POKENAME. Clashing hurricanes, volcanic lightning, and flooded deserts are attributed to its presence.

entry: 将盖欧卡的基因注入盖诺赛克特后，就会产生POKENAME。它是终极猎手，凭借强大的力量统御天空、陆地与海洋。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi (spookyscaryoverlord)
source: When Genesect are infused with the DNA of Kyogre, a POKENAME is made. It is the ultimate hunter and dominates air, land, and sea with immense power.

entry: 历史上，神秘的POKENAME仅被目击过寥寥数次。海中偶尔闪烁的神秘光点，有时也被认为与它有关。
author: bee4082
source: The mysterious POKENAME has only been seen a handful of times throughout history. Mysterious blinking lights in the sea are sometimes attributed to this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME软乎乎的，看起来毫不吓人。可一旦被激怒，就能从体内喷出数千加仑的水。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME is very squishy and not at all intimidating, but if provoked, it can expel thousands of gallons of water from its body.

entry: 它们在海沟中游荡，寻找矿石充饥。身体各处孔洞喷出的气泡劲力惊人，甚至能贯穿钢铁。
author: Schwaus
source: They wander in trenches looking for ore to eat. The bubbles that blow from the holes around its body come out with enough force to pierce through steel.

entry: POKENAME时而睡在水里，时而睡在冰上。无论身在何处，红色纹路都清晰地发着光。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME alternates between sleeping in water and on ice. No matter where it goes, its red markings still glow clearly.

entry: POKENAME受怒火驱使，遇到危险时，背上的小火山便会喷发。
source: POKENAME is driven by its rage. The small volcano on its back erupts when it is confronted with danger.

entry: 在融合成POKENAME之前，它还得散发难闻的气味来吓退鸟宝可梦。如今凭着威武的外表，POKENAME已受到森林中所有宝可梦的敬重。
source: Before being fused into POKENAME, this Pokémon had to release an uncomfortable odor to scare away bird Pokémon. Now, POKENAME is respected by every Pokémon in the forest due to its mighty appearance.

entry: 它对胜利的渴望如火山般炽烈，挥出的怒拳无可比拟。拳上燃起的烈焰，让挨打的感觉宛如遭到陨星撞击。
author: sk372
source: This Pokémon fights with fists of fury like no other, burning with volcanic desire for victory. It ignites its fists, and its punches have been compared to being struck by a falling meteor.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋入沙中，让柔软的内部组织为进化做好准备。固拉多的鳞片使它的外壳坚固无比，无法破开。
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand in order to prepare its soft innards for evolution. Its shell is incredibly robust and impossible to break open due to Groudon's scales.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀承重力惊人，还能收拢起来，让它从空中飞行迅速切换为掘地穿行。因此无论地下还是地上，POKENAME都是危险的猎手。
source: POKENAME's wings can carry an incredible amount of weight and are capable of contracting themselves in order to freely switch from flying into quickly tunneling through the earth. This makes POKENAME a dangerous predator beneath and above ground.

entry: 它在进化前始终保持着温暖，也受到外壳的保护。外壳的温度最高可达华氏3,000度。
source: This Pokémon keeps itself warm and protected until it is able to evolve. Its outer shell reaches up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 它在茧内制造岩浆，促进自身进化，因此会散发出强烈的热量。进化接近完成时，熔融的液体会从裂缝中渗出。
author: sk372
source: It radiates intense heat from within the cocoon as it creates magma inside that helps induce its evolution. The molten liquid seeps through cracks as the process nears completion.

entry: POKENAME在地下筑巢。若有敌人靠近，POKENAME便会升空蓄势，再用锥形的双手刺击对方，守护巢穴。
source: POKENAME builds their nest underground. If someone were to approach it, POKENAME would defend it by stinging or piercing the enemy with its cone-shaped hands after building up momentum in the sky.

entry: POKENAME会振翅向其他鸟宝可梦展示威势。羽毛上的鳞片让它即使身处猛烈的沙暴，也能以惊人的速度飞行。
source: POKENAME flaps its wings in order to show its dominance over other bird Pokémon. It can fly at incredible speeds through rough sandstorms due to the scales on its feathers.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎。由于外貌酷似固拉多，它担心其他小拉达会一拥而上，抢走自己的食物。它打起架来凶猛无比，决不让这种事发生。
source: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎。由于外貌酷似固拉多，它担心其他小拉达会一拥而上，抢走自己的食物。它打起架来凶猛无比，决不让这种事发生。
source: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.

entry: 所有小拉达都惧怕POKENAME，认为它十分凶暴。锋利如刀的獠牙不断生长，连坚硬的地面都能咬穿。
source: POKENAME is feared by all Rattata and is seen as a violent Pokémon. It has razor-sharp fangs that grow at a steady rate. It can even chew through solid ground.

entry: POKENAME的喙坚硬锋利，能刺穿猎物。它常在火山生态区附近休息。
source: POKENAME is known for its sharp and sturdy beak that it uses to impale its prey. It can be found resting near volcanic ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME腹部的纹路灼热无比，在黑暗中也十分醒目。它在地下蜿蜒穿行，再突然破土而出，将对手紧紧缠住。
source: The pattern on POKENAME's belly is scorching hot and can be easiliy spotted in the dark. It slithers through the ground and lunges out of it to wrap around an opponent.

entry: POKENAME会将尾巴插入地下，向地面释放电流，让来袭的敌人动弹不得。
source: POKENAME immobilizes incoming threats by plugging its tail into the ground, charging the ground with electricity.

entry: POKENAME的血管内能承受300万伏的电压，是雷丘身体所能释放的30倍。科学家认为，这源于固拉多维持庞大能量的能力。
author: @over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through it's veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: 它举止十分文雅。附近若有两只穿山鼠打架，它就会站到双方中间，让它们望着自己令人不安的双眼，就此停手。
source: This Pokémon is very well mannered. When two Sandshrew are fighting nearby, it will step between them and make them stop by making them look into its unsettling eyes.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺锋利如针。它会蜷成刺球滚向敌人，用尖刺将对方贯穿。
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back are as sharp as needles. When it curls up into a spiky ball, it rolls at its enemies, piercing into them as a result.

entry: POKENAME在活火山口安家。它们的双镰由熔融的岩土形成，温度高得足以轻易切开铅块。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their homes in active volcanic craters. Their scythes are made of molten earth and are hot enough to easily cleave through lead.

entry: POKENAME背上有一套火山生态系统。科学家发现，流经它体内的熔岩是灯火山岩石与岩浆混合而成的。
source: POKENAME has a volcanic ecosystem on its back. Scientists found out that the lava flowing through its body is a mixture of rocks from Mt. Ember and magma.

entry: POKENAME极其危险，会潜行于地下，只露出白色的角。接近敌人后便破土跃起，张开大口，用强劲的颚咬住对方并注入毒液。
source: POKENAME is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon. It dives through the ground with only its white horn sticking out. Once it reaches its foe, it jumps at them with its mouth wide open to bite them with its strong jaw, injecting them with poison.

entry: POKENAME让许多登山者闻风丧胆，会用尾巴将巨石抛过山谷。它的颚力极强，能咬穿坚硬的山岩，开辟自己的隧道网。
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon feared by many mountain climbers. It uses its tail to chuck huge boulders across the valley. Its jaw is so powerful that it is capable of biting through sturdy mountain rocks, creating its own tunnel systems.

entry: POKENAME一拳便能激起绕行全球的地震波。暴怒时射出的雷电，甚至足以在地上劈出巨大的裂缝。
author: Mistymagius
source: A single punch from POKENAME can send seismic shockwaves circling the globe. When enraged, it fires out thunderbolts powerful enough to create large fissures in the ground.

entry: POKENAME行动十分敏捷，全身和每条尾巴都覆着保护性的鳞片。它留下的脚印常见于火山地区。
source: POKENAME is a very agile Pokémon that wears protective scales on each of its tails and its body. It leaves footprints in the ground that can be commonly found around volcanic regions.

entry: 它用低沉的嗓音唱出神秘而舒缓的旋律，同时震动地面，为歌声打出节拍。
source: This Pokémon sings a mysterious soothing melody with its deep voice. It generates a beat by making the ground vibrate.

entry: POKENAME借着沉重的体重与带沟槽的身体沉入沙丘底部，大口吞食沙下的矿藏。
author: Schwaus
source: POKENAME uses its heavy weight and grooved body to sink to the bottom of dunes. They feast on ore deposits found beneath the sands.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: POKENAME是体内充满电力的庞大巨兽。它漫步大地，步步撼动地面，沿途留下一道噼啪作响的能量轨迹。
author: anarchaz
source: A colossal titan charged with electricity, POKENAME roams the land with ground-shaking steps. It leaves behind a trail of crackling energy in its wake.

entry: POKENAME沉重的触手会使脚下的大地震动。据说，任何攻击都无法撼动这些宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: NAME's hefty tentacles cause the ground to quake below it. It is said that these Pokémon cannot be moved be any sort of attack.

entry: POKENAME能利用地下的菌丝网络，随心所欲地撕裂地幔。千万不要惹怒这只宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the network of mycelium in the ground to tear the mantle apart as it pleases. Avoid angering this Pokémon.

entry: 它在火山洞穴中爬行，用爪挖出隧道，寻找小虫充饥。
source: This Pokémon can be found crawling inside volcanic caves. Its claws allow it to excavate tunnels in order to find small bugs to feed on.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: POKENAME每走一步都带起轻微的震动，却常常一脸困惑，甚至反被吓到。持续的头痛偶尔还会意外引发小型地震，连它自己都吃惊不已。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME's steps leave tiny tremors in its wake, though it often looks confused and even is spooked by the shaking. Its constant headaches sometimes lead to accidental mini earthquakes, much to its own surprise.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: POKENAME的外壳坚韧耐热，让它能在熔岩中高速游动。感到受威胁时，会喷出灼热的蒸汽。
source: POKENAME's shell is very resilient and heatproof, which makes it able to swim through lava at high speeds. It emits hot steam when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由一种独特的火焰构成。虽然不是火属性宝可梦，POKENAME仍能维持尾焰不灭。研究者认为，体内的沸水让它保持活力与健康。
source: POKENAME's tail is made out of a fairly distinct flame. Even though POKENAME is not a Fire-type Pokémon, it is still capable of maintaining the flame on its tail. Researchers believe the boiling water inside its body is keeping it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME体内盛满沸水。一旦被激怒，就会朝对手喷射滚烫的液体。皮肤的颜色可能与体内储存的蒸汽有关。
source: POKENAME's body is filled with boiling water. Once it is aggravated, it will spray its opponent with scorching hot liquid. The pigmented color of its skin is likely due to the steam stored in its body.

entry: POKENAME是远古遗物。据说，只要集齐七颗特殊的石头，POKENAME就会复苏，最多实现三个愿望。
author: ETheWriter
source: POKENAME is an artifact from ancient times. It's said if you collect seven special stones, POKENAME will come back to life and grant up to three wishes.

entry: 传闻POKENAME毒针中的一滴毒液，就能放倒最强大的龙。虽无实证，龙属性宝可梦在它面前却确实格外警惕。
author: sk372
source: Stories say a single drop of the poison in POKENAME's stinger is enough to fell the mightiest of dragons. Though unsubstantiated, Dragon-type Pokémon are noticeably wary in its presence.

entry: POKENAME憎恶龙宝可梦。通过与敌人交战，它将龙属性及招式化为己用，以增加战胜宿敌的机会。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME despises dragon Pokémon. It has adapted the Dragon typing and moves from its foes' battles into itself to improve its chances against its sworn enemy.

entry: POKENAME极少从天空降临，唯有察觉足以挑战自身力量的敌人时才会现身。战斗中，双拳被烈焰包裹，据说其炽烈程度可比太阳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME descends from the skies extremely rarely, appearing only when it senses a foe worthy enough to challenge its might. In combat, it wraps its fists in flames that are said to burn with the intensity of the sun.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的战士，力量惊人，斗志不竭。每一记重击都能压制全场，让对手胆寒。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a formidable fighter, known for its incredible strength and relentless spirit. With each powerful strike, it dominates the battlefield, leaving opponents trembling in its wake.

entry: 饥饿时，POKENAME会激发潜藏的能量，将自己推进到山巅。它最爱吃那里的矿石。
author: Schwaus
source: When POKENAME is hungry, it uses latent energy to propel itself to mountaintops. It loves to eat ore found at the peak of these mountains.

entry: POKENAME振翅便能掀起猛烈的沙暴，也能在转瞬间将其平息。
author: Busilisk
source: The beating of POKENAME's wings is strong enough to induce violent sandstorms. However, it can also quell them at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME的外形与俗称“天气三神”的宝可梦有几分相似。最高的那个常得强迫另两个停止争吵，合力行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a superficial resemblance to the Pokémon colloquially known as the Weather Trio. The tallest often has to force the other two members to cooperate instead of quarrel.

entry: 据说POKENAME会施展操纵时间的魔法，帮助有需要的人。尤其有许多故事提到，POKENAME曾加快龙属性宝可梦的进化。
author: sk372
source: It is said that when POKENAME appears, it will use a type of time magic to assist those in need. Many stories tell of POKENAME hastening the evolution of Dragon-type Pokémon in particular.

entry: 它操纵时间的力量已经扭曲，变得难以预测。附近的科技产物可能毫无预兆地被替换成过去或未来的同类事物。
author: sk372
source: Its control over time has distorted and become unpredictable. Without warning, technology in its vicinity may end up being replaced with its past or future equivalent.

entry: 历代记载中，POKENAME现身时总伴着神秘的药师。各个故事里的形象虽不相同，却都讲述着扶危济困的事迹。
author: sk372
source: Throughout history, POKENAME have appeared accompanied by mysterious apothecaries. Its appearance differs across different tales, but all stories share a common theme of helping those in need.

entry: POKENAME的爪子能撕开时间，制造通往过去或未来的虫洞。有时，它还会与时拉比玩一场跨越时空的追逐游戏。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Using its claws, POKENAME can rip through the fabric of time to create wormholes to the past and future. Occasionally, POKENAME partake in an interdimensional game of Tag with Celebi.

entry: 听见POKENAME的歌声，人便会沉沉睡去，梦到往昔的生活。有人认为，凭借POKENAME操纵时间的力量，他们其实是在重历前世。
author: sk372
source: Those who hear POKENAME's song fall into a deep sleep, dreaming of life in olden times. Some believe they are actually reliving moments of past lives thanks to POKENAME's time powers.

entry: POKENAME的嚎叫能操纵时间流动。成群聚集时，甚至能扰乱远至一英里外的人对时间的感知。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's howl can control the flow of time. When they gather into packs, they can distort people's perceptions of time from up to a mile away.

entry: 靠得太近，POKENAME就可能释放毒孢子。这些孢子会引发谵妄、恐惧、性格变化，甚至死亡。
author: wbmznrxo
source: Getting too close to POKENAME can cause it to release toxic spores. These spores can cause delirium, fear, personality shifts, and death.

entry: POKENAME奔跑得很快时，有时会凭空消失，过一会儿才重新出现。其实，那是它跃进了未来的时间。
author: Ayutac
source: When POKENAME runs quickly, it sometimes vanishes into thin air, only to reappear later. This is because it actually jumps forward in time.

entry: 历史学家发现的经文将POKENAME记作一位次等时间之神。相传，它会在危急时刻放慢时间，救助遇险的人类。
author: sk372
source: Historians have found scriptures which speak of POKENAME as a minor time deity. Stories say it slows time in moments of crisis, so it can save humans in need.

entry: 为了遥远的未来，它高速穿梭于时间之中。有人认为，每件重大历史事件背后都有它的身影，不断沿着时间线修正人类的道路。
author: sk372
source: For the sake of a distant future, it races through time at high speeds. Some believe it is behind every major historical event, correcting humanity's path across the timeline.

entry: 传说中的巨神，守护着时间长河，阻止一切破坏者。据说，它水炮的一击便能将目标轰入时间洪流，一直冲到永恒的尽头。
author: sk372
source: A titan of legend, said to guard the time-stream from those who would disrupt it. A single blast from the water launched from its cannon is said to blast the target through the flow of time until they crash against the end of eternity.

entry: 进入它轨道的一切都会被吸收。据说，它的灵魂来自一只与空间相连的原始宝可梦。
author: capry.700
source: This Pokémon absorbs everything that enters its orbit. It is said that its soul is that of a primal Pokémon connected to space.

entry: 有传说称，阿尔宙斯正是用这些利刃，将空间裁成完美的形状。POKENAME的刃缘确实能在现实中划开小小的裂隙，让传说多了几分可信。
author: octolinggrimm
source: Some legends say Arceus cut the fabric of space into the perfect shape with these very blades. The edges of POKENAME are able to cut small rifts in reality, lending some credence to these tales.

entry: 这只狡猾的宝可梦，借助操纵空间的能力行窃，手法之高超，让训练家都闻所未闻。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: This devious Pokémon uses its authority over space to pickpocket to degrees never seen by Trainers before.

entry: 古老的传说称，这只宝可梦乐于在寒冷寂寥的太空中构筑一个个恒星系。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Legends of old say that this Pokémon finds joy in assembling solar systems in the cold solitude of space.

entry: 它射出的箭会留下星尘的尾迹，偶尔燃起火焰，化作转瞬即逝的星座。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Arrows released by this Pokémon leave behind them trails of stardust that sometimes burst into flame, creating short-lived constellations.

entry: 有幸研究过它的科学家发现，它的嘴通往无穷无尽的空间。不同的坠入者会见到不同的景象，唯有POKENAME嘲弄的笑声始终不变。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Scientists who had the privilege of analyzing this Pokémon discovered that its mouth leads to a never-ending space within. Its contents are different to whoever falls in, except for one constant: POKENAME's mocking laugh.

entry: 据说POKENAME守着通往扭曲世界的入口。它平时和善，若有人强闯，便会从门内拉出自己的幽影，以精神之线操纵，迎击对方。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME stand guard over portals to a distorted world. Normally amiable, those who attempt forceful entry will meet with its spectral shadow, which it pulls out from within the portal and controls with psychic strings.

entry: POKENAME是被骑拉帝纳附身的无畏小子。无法容纳的扭曲能量不断从体内迸出。
author: thybrodiebyronbrown
source: POKENAME is a Tyrogue possessed by Giratina. Distorted energy bursts out of the Pokémon, unable to be contained.

entry: POKENAME诞生于一款受诅咒的游戏，如今游荡在我们的世界。它飞驰于高草丛中，追猎狐狸宝可梦及其训练家。
author: ETheWriter
source: Born from a cursed game, POKENAME now haunts our world. It speeds around tall grass, hunting down fox Pokémon and their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME由空间的虚无构成，据说曾在数千年前创造世界。如今，它却栖身于另一个次元。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: Made from the void of space, POKENAME is said to have created the world thousands of years ago. However, it now inhabits a separate dimension.

entry: POKENAME甲壳的背部容纳着毁坏的世界的一部分。战斗时，它会借用这个平行次元的力量。
author: NellNast42
source: The back of POKENAME's shell contains a piece of the Distortion World. It calls upon the powers of this parallel dimension in battle.

entry: 它既顽皮优雅，又恶毒残暴。目击者说，POKENAME的战斗方式违背物理常理，虚幻得令人着迷。
author: Frink202
source: It is playful, graceful, spiteful, and brutal in equal measure. Witnesses have described POKENAME's fighting style as both unreal and captivating in its physical impossibility.

entry: POKENAME以其他宝可梦的混乱与不安为食，常在人口密集处现身，惊吓当地居民，引发大规模的踩踏。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME feeds on the chaos and unrest of other Pokémon. It often appears in densely-populated areas and scares the denizens there, causing enormous stampedes.

entry: POKENAME心怀深重的恶意，凭借背上威力强大的炮，能发动势不可挡的攻击。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: POKENAME possesses immense malice and is capable of attacking with overwhelming force thanks to the powerful cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME掠过平静的水面时，会将其化作一面暗镜，映出反转世界。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME skips over smooth water, it transforms it into a dark mirror that shows the Reverse World.

entry: 泥偶巨人破损的甲壳，如今成了骑拉帝纳灵魂的容器。它会先用尖锐的触须刺入猎物，再将其杀死。
author: Sand_Coffin
source: What was once the broken armor of a Golurk now houses the soul of Giratina. It uses its sharp tendrils to stab into prey before finishing them off.

entry: 它来到我们的世界时，会张开深渊般的双翼，用幽异的鳞片侵染一切光线。四周色彩尽数扭曲，唯有它的红眼仍如常。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: When this Pokémon makes its way through to our world, it flares its abyssal wings and contaminates all light with its ghostly scales, distorting color from its surroundings until the only normal sight left are its red eyes.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧惊吓他人，以产生的恐惧为食。它们因闹得太过火而遭放逐，却仍有一些偷偷溜回了这个世界。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME play tricks to startle others so they can consume the resulting fear. They were banished after taking their tricks too far, but some have snuck back into this world.

entry: POKENAME阴森的模样连最凶猛的宝可梦也能吓得瑟缩。进入我们的世界时，它会从地下缓缓升起。
author: giggity._.
source: POKENAME's eerie appearance causes even the fiercest of Pokémon to cower in fear. It slowly ascends from the ground when entering our world.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME由火山硫磺凝成。它忠诚地侍奉着一位神秘莫测的主人。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is believed to have been formed from brimstone of volcanic origin. It is dedicated to a mysterious and enigmatic master.

entry: 传说，POKENAME坚不可摧的壳内藏着直通冥界的入口。据称，少数不幸与它近距离接触的人曾感到酷热，还听见了已故亲友的低语。
author: mbo1064.
source: Legends claim that POKENAME's impenetrable shell contains a portal directly to the underworld. The unlucky few who have had a close encounter with this Pokémon reportedly felt extreme heat and heard whispers of lost loved ones.

entry: 每有一座新的火山岛浮出海面，就会诞生一只POKENAME。随着岛屿长大，它背上的灌木也会愈发茂盛。
author: ziggaway
source: A POKENAME is born every time a new volcanic island surfaces from the ocean. The shrub on its back gets larger and healthier as the island grows.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的丝网将群岛维系在一起。它富有创造力，会用蛛丝编织灵活多变的构造。
author: Mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME's webs hold island groups together. It is a creative Pokémon, making dynamic structures out of their webbing.

entry: POKENAME的模样与遗迹中的纹样相似。人们尝试破译那些纹样，得到的却尽是毫无意义的文字。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME resembles markings found in ruins. People have tried to decipher these markings, but only found gibbberish.

entry: POKENAME属于寄生融合体，行动飘忽不定。不过与外表给人的印象不同，组成它的两只宝可梦似乎各掌握着一半控制权。
author: mitcharlotte
source: As a parasitic fusion, POKENAME exhibits erratic movement. The two Pokémon that this fusion is composed of seem to be at equal control despite its look.

entry: 赢得身体控制权后，这只寄生宝可梦会蜕变成蛋形菌盖。长到足够大，菌盖便自行裂开，喷涌出科学家所谓的“雷吉孢子”。
author: mitcharlotte
source: Having won the battle for control, this parasitic Pokémon molts into an egg-like cap. Once it has grown enough, the cap will tear itself apart, bursting with what scientists call 'Regispores'.

entry: 即使沉眠，POKENAME体内仍涌动着近乎无穷的怒火与力量。神话研究者认为，一旦它苏醒并释放力量，一拳就足以击碎星球。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME lies dormant, it pulses with near-infinite rage and strength. Mythological researchers say that should it awaken and unleash its power, a single punch could shatter the planet.

entry: 无月的夜晚，POKENAME会潜伏在村庄附近，让人做出被烈焰吞没的噩梦。
author: @over9001
source: On a moonless night, POKENAME can be found lurking near villages. It is known for making people experience nightmares in which they are engulfed in flames.

entry: 新月之夜，它们会收集人们的美梦，再将其变成噩梦。
author: pankiwi
source: On new moons, they're known for collecting people's pleasant dreams and turning them into bad ones.

entry: POKENAME多在夜里现身于心术不正的人面前，用天真的外表使其放下戒心，再施以可怕的噩梦。它以恐惧与苦痛为食，直到黎明才消失，下个新月之夜再度出现。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: POKENAME primarily shows itself at night to those with impure hearts, lulling them in with its innocent appearance before inflicting awful nightmares on them. It feeds off of their fear and anguish until dawn, then disappears until the next new moon.

entry: 旅行的训练家只敢低声谈起POKENAME。这只传说中的宝可梦会让远离人烟庇护的旅人陷入无尽的噩梦。古籍记载，唯有满月之光能唤醒被它恶意困住的人。
author: Katie
source: Traveling Pokémon trainers speak in hushed whispers of POKENAME, a legendary Pokémon that visits unending nightmares on those far from the comforts of civilization. Tomes say that only the light of the full moon can wake those trapped by its malice.

entry: 极其罕见的POKENAME会让人连做数日噩梦，吃尽这些恶梦后再离开。人们尚不清楚，这种为害人的宝可梦究竟只有一只，还是另有同类。
author: bee4082
source: The exceedingly rare pest POKENAME incites nightmares in people for days on end before eating the generated bad dreams and moving on. It is unknown if there is only one or many.

entry: 冲锋时若撞上墙，它可能卡住，或一时难以转身。这时，POKENAME就会开动背炮，借后坐力脱身或调整朝向。
author: sk372
source: If it hits a wall during a charge, it may wind up stuck or unable to turn around quickly. In these cases, POKENAME uses the recoil from firing the cannon on its back to dislodge or reorient itself.

entry: 珍爱的人遭遇危险时，POKENAME会不惜一切挺身守护，即使为此付出生命。
author: Inksans201x
source: When those it loves are in danger, POKENAME will stop at nothing to defend them, even if it costs them their life.

entry: 躯干上的纹路其实是传感器，能扫描敌人的生命体征，判断弱点。分析结束后，它会调整尾炮，发射最能克制目标的能量。
author: sk372
source: The markings on its torso are actually sensors, which scan foes to read their bio-signs and determine weaknesses. Once analyzed, it calibrates the cannon on its tail to fire energy tuned to be most effective on the target.

entry: 有人声称，POKENAME背上的炮只需一发就能创造完整的星系。战斗时，还能切换为元素武器使用。
author: Patch
source: Some claim the cannon attached to POKENAME's back can create entire galaxies with a single shot. In battle, it can be switched in order to function as an elemental weapon.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: Soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: Soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: 它炮管般的尾巴，能喷出短促而强劲的火焰，还会按对手的情况改变火焰种类，让攻击更有效。
author: sk372
