source: Its cannon-like tail can emit short yet potent bursts of flame. The type of fire it emits can be adjusted to allow it to be more effective against an opponent.

entry: 它的三个头脑本该协力分析周围环境，提高运作效率与力量。结果却常为数据上的细微差异争吵不休，反而耽误了命令的执行。
author: sk372
source: Its three minds are meant to analyze surroundings in tandem to hasten its functions and increase its strength. Instead, the heads argue over minor discrepancies in their data, delaying the execution of its orders.

entry: POKENAME原本用于自动寻找代码中的条件语句，并检验其真假。但现实世界可探寻的真理远比虚拟空间更多，于是它们逃离了人造环境。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME was created to automatically search for and test truth conditionals in code. However, because there were more truths to find in the real world than in virtual space, the species escaped its artificial environment.

entry: 向敌人冲锋时，POKENAME尾部会喷起火焰，增强推进力。它看似沉重，却也能够飞行。
author: Rishi Dash
source: When charging at an enemy, POKENAME's tail flares, giving it a propulsion boost. Despite looking quite heavy, it is capable of flight.

entry: 据说POKENAME会从星空降临，拜访追寻真理的人，以星火为其赐福，护其免受伤害。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is said to descend from the stars to meet those who seek truth. It anoints them with starry fire that protects them from harm.

entry: 相传POKENAME的火焰无法熄灭，已经燃烧了超过10,000年。它只会现身于探寻生命意义、追求真理的人面前。
author: Mistymagius
source: Fables say POKENAME's flame is impossible to extinguish and to have stayed burning for over 10,000 years. It is said to only appear in front of people who seek the truth in the meaning of life.

entry: 据说POKENAME源于天外，早在时间尚未被命名的年代便已存在。它用尾巴唤出火焰，再振翅鼓旺。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: It's said that POKENAME's celestial origin dates back far before time had a name. It uses its tails to conjure flames and fans them with its wings.

entry: POKENAME以人们渴求真理的情感为食。若这类情感过于充沛，它便释放炽热的高温，消耗多余能量。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME feeds off of the feelings of those who yearn for truth. When there is an overabundance of these feelings, it burns the excess energy with its blazing heat.

entry: 第一只POKENAME是在一片苍白沙海中发现的。它们对古文明遗留的建筑废墟有着奇特的亲近感，而那个文明曾将追求真理视为至高之事。
author: .realthree
source: The first POKENAME was found inhabiting a vast desert filled with pale sand. These Pokémon hold a strange affinity for ruined buildings made by an ancient civilization that once sought truth above all else.

entry: 它同时处于冻结与燃烧的矛盾状态，对说谎者和江湖骗子深为不齿。
author: Busilisk
source: This Pokémon exists in a paradoxical state of freezing and burning. It holds a fierce contempt for liars and charlatans.

entry: 为真理而战的人，有时会忽然发现身边多了一只POKENAME陪伴。可惜，它看起来实在没什么气势。
author: .realthree
source: Those who fight for truth may suddenly find themselves accompanied by a POKENAME. Unfortunately, it has a rather underwhelming presence.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方喷射炽热的等离子体，将沿途一切烧尽。有人推测，它是外星文明制造的超级兵器，用于灭绝整个星球上的生命。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires hot plasma in all directions, incinerating anything its path. It is theorized that POKENAME is an alien-built superweapon made to sterilize entire planets.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的皮毛能隔绝体内产生的高温。若没有这层毛，脚下的地面就会燃起大火。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur insulates the intense heat its body generates. Without it, the ground would burst into flames beneath it.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动时，尾部会腾起烈焰，将原地烧出一片焦痕。它时常瞬移，连睡觉时也不例外，察觉危险逼近时尤其如此。
author: GoldeGummyBear
source: When POKENAME teleports, its tail flares and leaves a scorched patch of ground where it once was. It teleports often, even while asleep, especially if it senses danger approaching.

entry: POKENAME不知用什么方法，能将头与四肢缩回栖身的光明石内，却不留下任何可见的孔洞。据说，真理消亡之日，它便会永远退回光明石中，不再现身。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can somehow retract its head and limbs into the Light Stone that it occupies without leaving any discernible holes behind. It is said that on the day that truth dies, it will withdraw into its Light Stone permanently, never to emerge.

entry: POKENAME的假头既能挡下瞄准真头的攻击，也能积蓄热量，供出招时使用。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's faux head serves a dual purpose: It blocks attacks aimed at the real head, and it charges heat for attacks.

entry: 坚韧的皮层几乎能抵挡所有物理攻击，让它轻松守护自己的家园。
author: .izik
source: Its tough hide makes it nearly impervious to physical attacks. This resilience allows it to defend its home with ease.

entry: 月光下，毛发泛起蓝白色的光辉。POKENAME摆动双臂和手指时，会使出平常本领之外的神秘力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their fur takes on a bluish-white glow in the moonlight. When POKENAME waggles both their arms and fingers around, they display mysterious powers inconsistent with their typical abilities.

entry: 满月之夜，常能见到成群的POKENAME在空中欢快腾跃，一直持续整晚，通常等到日出才回到山中。
author: lemage22
source: Under the full moon's light, a herd of POKENAME can be seen prancing about in the skies. Their prances last through the night, often returning to the mountains when the sun rises.

entry: 它喜欢依偎着体型更大的宝可梦，希望获得庇护。这种举动让性情温柔的大个子们都十分喜爱它。
author: .izik
source: It cuddles up to larger Pokémon, hoping they will defend it from danger. This behavior makes it a beloved companion among gentle giants.

entry: 据说POKENAME沐浴月光越久，尾尖的灯泡就越明亮。在乡间，POKENAME有时会被当作灯笼照明。
author: astral_1447
source: It is rumored that the more time POKENAME spends under the moonlight, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows. In rural areas, POKENAME are sometimes used as lanterns.

entry: 它奔走迅捷无声，靠隐匿行踪躲避捕食者。即使被逼入绝境，也能凭速度与灵活的身手脱身。
author: .izik
source: It scurries swiftly and quietly, using stealth to avoid predators. When cornered, it relies on speed and agility to escape.

entry: 据说，它借着夜色无声漂游，留下淡淡的星光。古文献将它环状的形态视为神秘的象征，研究者则认为这与宇宙现象有关。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon is said to drift silently under the cover of night, leaving behind trails of faint starlight. Ancient texts describe its looping form as a symbol of mystery which researchers have linked to cosmic phenomena.

entry: 它在峭壁上掘出小洞栖身。这些崖边巢穴既安全，又能让它清楚观察周围。
author: .izik
source: It digs into cliff walls, creating small burrows for shelter. These cliffside dens provide it with safety and an excellent view of its surroundings.

entry: 它喜欢钻进雪堆，即使严冬也能保持温暖。积雪还为它提供了躲避捕食者的绝佳藏身处。
author: .izik
source: It loves burrowing into snowdrifts, where it stays warm even in harsh winters. The snow also provides it with a perfect hiding spot from predators.

entry: 它模仿无畏小子的招式练习武艺。看似玩闹的模仿，却常能展现令人吃惊的力量。
author: .izik
source: It practices martial moves, imitating Tyrogue to hone its skills. This playful mimicry often leads to surprising displays of strength.

entry: POKENAME会彼此配合，一同起舞，原因至今不明。头上的卷毛还能充当插头，吸收电力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME perform coordinated dances with each another for reasons that are not yet understood. The curls on their head can act like plugs and take in electrical energy.

entry: 它的活动似乎与月相有关，满月时格外精神。这样的夜里，它会在星空下开心蹦跳，给周围的人带去欢乐。
author: .izik
source: Its behavior seems tied to the lunar cycle, becoming more energetic during full moons. During these phases, it bounces happily under the night sky, spreading joy to those around it.

entry: 它怕雨，总躲在浓密的枝叶或凸出的岩壁下。由于不喜欢水，暴风雨时很难见到它。
author: .izik
source: Fearful of rain, it hides under dense foliage or rock overhangs. Its aversion to water makes it a rare sight during storms.

entry: POKENAME体侧的毛发有月亮形的花纹，有人认为这是皮皮来自外太空的证据。准备攻击敌人时，POKENAME全身会闪烁起柔光。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur shows a pattern of the moon on the sides. Some believe this is proof Clefairy hails from outer space. When POKENAME prepares to attack a foe, its body will twinkle and produce a soft light.

entry: 它在月下起舞时，双眼将整片夜空清晰映出。秋叶镇的夏季华丽大赛特意把庆典安排在夜间户外举行，好让众多POKENAME表演。
author: char_latte3412
source: The night sky is perfectly reflected in its eyes as it dances under the moon.  During Fallarbor Town's Summer Contest, festivities are held outdoors at night specifically to accommodate for the many POKENAME performances.

entry: 它用锋利的颚发起伏击，让敌人猝不及防。虽个头不大，却是难缠的对手。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp jaws to launch ambush attacks, catching foes off guard. Despite its small stature, it is a formidable opponent.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沐浴月光，也喜欢用尾巴在地面塑出新月形的痕迹。科学家认为，这纯粹是它开心时的举动。
source: POKENAME likes to bask in the moonlight and create crescent moons in the ground by shaping them with its tail. Scientists believe it does this out of pure joy.

entry: 月光下，它的身体闪烁着绚丽的光辉，因此深受收藏家与爱好者追捧。
author: .izik
source: Its body shimmers in the moonlight, reflecting a vibrant glow. This trait makes it highly sought-after by collectors and admirers alike.

entry: 它偷来闪亮的物件，藏进隐蔽的山洞。那些闪闪发光的珍藏，也透着它淘气的性情。
author: .izik
source: It steals shiny objects, hoarding them in hidden caves. The glimmer of its treasures reflects its mischievous personality.

entry: 它喜欢与岩狗狗作伴，一同玩些看似粗鲁却十分友好的游戏。两种宝可梦结下的深厚情谊能延续一生。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys the company of Rockruff, playing rough but friendly games. The two Pokémon form close bonds that last a lifetime.

entry: POKENAME大多在夜里仰望星空，尤其爱凝视月亮。这样做时，它的头痛似乎会减轻一些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most evenings stargazing, staring at the moon in particular. It seems less afflicted by its painful headaches while it does this.

entry: POKENAME吐出的泡泡含有独特的治愈因子，能让人恢复精神。但若使用过量，就可能产生依赖。
author: Mistymagius
source: The bubbles that POKENAME produces have a unique healing factor that makes people feel rejuvenated.  However, the substance can be addictive if too much is applied.

entry: 它将巨石滚到家园四周，筑成屏障。这些天然的防御工事能挡住大多数入侵者。
author: .izik
source: It rolls boulders to create barriers around its home, ensuring its safety. These natural fortifications deter most intruders.

entry: 它会放出阴森的雾气，连最勇敢的敌手也会心神不宁。人们往往还没看见它，就早已从迷雾察觉它的到来。
author: .izik
source: It generates an eerie mist that unnerves even the bravest opponents. The mist often signals its presence long before it is seen.

entry: 它挖掘深深的隧道，悄无声息地往来，只有必要时才会现身。这些地下通路也能用于逃生。
author: .izik
source: It digs deep tunnels to travel undetected, emerging only when necessary. These underground paths also serve as escape routes.

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: Leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: Leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: Leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME体型虽小，却十分凶悍。它将体内储存的大量能量化作电力与惊人的速度，战斗时迅如闪电，令对手遭受电击，来不及反应。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is small yet fierce. It stores a lot of energy within itself, releasing it in the form of electricity and blinding speed. When in battle, it unleashes lightning-fast attacks that leave its opponents shocked and unable to react.

entry: POKENAME宁愿守着冰冷的山洞，不理会外界纷争。旅人说它十分友善，虽是冰属性，却喜欢给人温暖的拥抱。庞大的身躯也能让它免遭威胁。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME prefers to be unfazed by the squabbles of the world outside its icy mountain cave. Travelers report that it has a friendly nature and, despite being an Ice-type, enjoys giving warm hugs. Its large size also protects it against threats.

entry: POKENAME奔过大地时，会留下转瞬即逝的冰冷光带，宛如极光。据说，它能折射光线，让身体变成任何颜色。
author: Frokachu
source: When POKENAME run across the land, they leave behind a chilling, temporary stream of light that looks like an aurora. It is said its body can change to any color by refracting light.

entry: POKENAME留下的隧道极其巨大，露出的头只占真实体型的一小部分。科学家至今未能完整研究野生POKENAME全身活动的样子。
author: bobosmith01
source: The tunnels left in POKENAME's wake are huge. Its visible head is merely a small fraction of its actual size. Scientists have been unable to properly study wild POKENAME's full body in motion.

entry: POKENAME能通过梦境洞察训练家的内心。只要对方坚定地追求崇高的真实或理想，它便愿与之并肩作战。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME can analyze a Trainer's heart from their dreams. It will battle alongside any Trainer who possesses conviction for noble truths or ideals.

entry: POKENAME的根与花瓣都有致幻作用，能扰乱对手。花瓣经过蒸馏后，却能制成药物或令人放松的茶饮。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roots and petals have psychedelic properties that it uses to disorient its opponents. However, the petals can be distilled to create medicine or a relaxing tea.

entry: POKENAME的花在水中也会散发怡人香气。其他宝可梦游近探看时，它便甩出尾中藏着的长鞭袭击。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's flowers emit a pleasing scent underwater. When other Pokémon swim over to check them, it lashes out with the hidden whips in its tail.

entry: 它乐于用镰刀击败无礼傲慢的对手。伤口虽然很快愈合，但只要受害者闻到POKENAME的玫瑰花香，就会再度裂开。
author: epping_forest
source: It loves defeating disrespectful and arrogant opponents, slashing them with its scythes. Though the wounds heal quickly, it will reopen when the victim smells the scent of POKENAME's roses.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME双手小玫瑰外层的厚花瓣其实是肌肉，能帮助它高压射出花粉弹。被直接击中的人很可能从此对这种花粉过敏。
author: epping_forest
source: The thick petals that cover the small roses of its hands are actually muscles that help POKENAME blast high-pressure pollen bullets. A direct hit from these projectiles has a high chance of making anyone allergic to this pollen.

entry: 它用尾刺串起树果，再通电烤熟。尾巴既能作武器，也能当盾牌。
author: kittyluv090
source: It skewers berries with the thorns on its tail then roasts them with electricity. It can use its tail as both a weapon and a shield.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: 网络上曾流行让新郎培育一只POKENAME，请它参加婚礼，据说能为婚姻带来好运。可它跳起舞来总会砸坏东西，这股风潮也就消退了。
author: xxrizahawkeyefanxx
source: There was a popular trend on the internet where men would train a POKENAME and bring it to their wedding as a guest, as it was thought this would bring good luck to the marriage. The trend stopped as POKENAME would break things when dancing.

entry: 椅子般的身体会吸引疲惫的猎物坐下。对方一落座，POKENAME便用荆棘与齿轮将其包围，发动攻击。
author: ferdirenz
source: Its chair-like structure attracts tired prey. When it sits, POKENAME attacks by enveloping it with thorns and gears.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的光合作用极强，甚至能借太阳之力释放火焰。此时，它还会散发出异常浓烈的气味。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can photosynthesize through its tail to such an extent that it can harness the power of the sun and unleash fire. In doing so, it emits an unusually intense scent.

entry: 晴朗的日子，POKENAME会在空中翱翔，歌声与花束般的双翼令人赏心悦目。可翅膀里还藏着捕捉猎物的尖刺。
author: takopus
source: POKENAME soars through the sky on sunny days, delighting observers with its singing voice and bouquet-wings, which conceal thorns used to catch prey.

entry: 攻击前，橡胶般的双臂会充满热空气而膨胀。积蓄的热量让它的攻击既强劲，又难以预测。
author: .izik
source: Its rubbery arms inflate with hot air before striking. This buildup of heat makes its attacks both powerful and unpredictable.

entry: 电力不足时，POKENAME会将自己鼓成气球，吸引雷暴中的闪电。充满电后便直落地面，用四爪安稳着陆。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When low on electricity, POKENAME will blow themselves up like balloons to attract lightning strikes from thunderstorms. When they are fully charged, they will plummet to the ground and safely land on their paws.

entry: 遇到危险时，它会将身体鼓胀到原来的两倍，释放体内的静电。电击敌人的同时，也为自己创造逃走的机会。
author: .izik
source: When in danger, it inflates its body to twice its size, releasing static electricity from within. This shocks attackers and creates a diversion for escape.

entry: 它漂浮在草甸上方，率领一群飘飘球，命令它们掳走人类与宝可梦。阴森的身影让各地都笼罩在恐惧中。
author: .izik
source: Floating over meadows, it leads a flock of Drifloon, ordering them to abduct people and Pokémon. Its eerie presence inspires fear across the land.

entry: 它吸入空气鼓起身体，再喷出阵阵热风灼烧敌人。这种炽烈的攻击，让它在战斗中十分危险。
author: .izik
source: It inflates its body with air, unleashing gusts of hot wind to scorch enemies. This fiery attack makes it a dangerous opponent in battle.

entry: 传闻POKENAME曾是一位旅途中神秘失踪的飞行员。它的气球里装满了毒气。
author: kittyluv090
source: Rumor has it POKENAME was once an aviator that mysteriously vanished while traveling. Its balloons are filled with poisonous gases.

entry: 严重灾难过后，常能见到它的身影。有人说，它承载着成千上万无辜的灵魂。
author: thereversedguy
source: It can be seen during the aftermath of severe catastrophes. Some say it carries thousands of innocent souls.

entry: POKENAME在野外通常十分谨慎，却很容易融入城市环境。罕见的异色个体在穿着打扮上更为醒目。
author: ziggaway
source: While normally very cautious in the wild, POKENAME blends into urban environments with ease. Rare shiny forms are more sartorially conspicuous.

entry: 它能分别向身体各节充气，借此漂浮、游泳，还能堵住水坝的破口，撑到修缮完成。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon can independently inflate each of its body segments with gas. It does so in order to float, swim, and patch dams until they're repaired.

entry: 它用腿缠住敌人的头，遮住对方视线，再释放超声脉冲。这套战术能有效制服敌人。
author: .izik
source: It wraps its legs around an enemy's head to blind them before releasing supersonic pulses. This tactic incapacitates foes effectively.

entry: POKENAME的叫声令人萎靡不振，听者常会不寒而栗。POKENAME还能吸气鼓起身体，最多膨胀到原来的五倍，威吓他人。
author: FaeFlame
source: The cry of the POKENAME has a withering effect on its opponents, often causing chills in those who hear it. POKENAME can also puff air into their bodies, appearing up to five times their size to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体与孢子带毒，会使人暂时麻痹。它其实很喜欢交际，便模仿花朵，让自己显得亲切，却仍背负着并不公允的邪恶名声。
author: SonTyp
source: The gases and spores POKENAME's body produces are toxic and cause temporary paralysis. Because this Pokémon is very social, it mimics the appearance of a flower to seem more approachable, but its undeservedly sinister reputation still stands.

entry: 它向体内充气，浮到地面上方，再突然落下，踢出毁灭性的一击，让敌人猝不及防。
author: .izik
source: It fills its body with air to hover above the ground before dropping a devastating kick onto its enemy. This airborne attack catches foes off guard.

entry: 它看似漫无目的地四处漂浮，常被误认成一群随风球。训练家还总会念错它的名字。
author: ziggaway
source: Often mistaken for a volery of Drifblim, this Pokémon floats around seemingly without aim. Trainers regularly mispronounce the name of this species.

entry: POKENAME靠调整体温升上天空，最喜欢在洁白蓬松的云朵间嬉戏。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME ascends into the air by adjusting its internal body temperature. It loves nothing more than to frolic among white, fluffy clouds.

entry: 卡比兽的特质让POKENAME变得慵懒，不再那么谨慎，但性情依旧温和。POKENAME个头大，毛发温暖柔软，谁都想抱一抱，它也毫不介意。
author: mbavenger64
source: Being part Snorlax makes POKENAME lazy rather than cautious, but it remains gentle. Its big, warm, and soft fur makes POKENAME very huggable for anyone, and it doesn't mind at all.

entry: 卡比兽的特质让POKENAME变得慵懒，不再那么谨慎，但性情依旧温和。POKENAME个头大，毛发温暖柔软，谁都想抱一抱，它也毫不介意。
author: mbavenger64
source: Being part Snorlax makes POKENAME lazy rather than cautious, but it remains gentle. Its big, warm, and soft fur makes POKENAME very huggable for anyone, and it doesn't mind at all.

entry: 这种身体僵硬的融合体喜欢雪天和庆典。不知为何，每到晚餐时间，它就会觉得不舒服。
author: waflare(CEO of ferrosaco)
source: This rigid fusion loves snowy days and celebrations. For some reason, it feels uncomfortable when it is time to eat in the evening.

entry: 古老民间故事里，整座镇子的人都因它的甜香而追赶它。它的速度，也出了名地快。
author: pankiwi
source: There is an old folk story that tells of this Pokémon being chased by an entire town for its sweet scent. It is known for being extremely fast.

entry: POKENAME厚实的毛发能留住体内产生的热量，再通过腕部的热气孔集中喷出，形成炽烈的冲击。
author: Phantom640
source: POKENAME's thick fur helps it trap the heat generated by its body, which it can then focus into fiery blasts using the thermal vents in its wrist.

entry: 发黑的角浓缩着一种独特的毒素。其他宝可梦长期接触后，身上也会长出类似的突起，并伴随疼痛。
author: miecreates
source: Its blackened horns are dense stores of a unique poison. Constant exposure can cause similar but painful growths on other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是欢庆节日的精灵。每逢佳节，它们的幽灵之力都会增强。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are festive spirits. Their ghostly energy is stronger during holidays.

entry: POKENAME即使战斗时也鲜少动怒。但若有人毁掉他人的快乐，便会招来它的怒火。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME rarely get angry, even in battle. However, those who destroy the joy of others will incur their wrath.

entry: POKENAME是游戏城广受欢迎的吉祥物，常担任荷官或舞台表演者，号称“彩色小丑”。它通常成对出现，代表好运，鲜艳的外表象征着福运与繁荣。
author: merclipse
source: A popular mascot for Game Corners, POKENAME often serves as a dealer or stage performer known as the 'Colorful Joker'. Typically found in pairs, it represents the Good Luck, embodying fortune and prosperity with its vibrant appearance.

entry: POKENAME是游戏城广受欢迎的吉祥物，常担任荷官或舞台表演者，号称“单色小丑”。它通常成对出现，代表厄运，阴森的外表象征着不幸，也提醒人们谨慎行事。
author: merclipse
source: A popular mascot for Game Corners, POKENAME often serves as a dealer or stage performer known as the 'Monochromatic Joker'. Typically found in pairs, it represents the Bad Luck, symbolizing misfortune and caution with its eerie appearance.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子云缓缓飘在空中，让凝视的人心神迷醉。这些云雾也能遮掩它的行踪，形成保护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates clouds of spores that float lazily through the air, mesmerizing those who gaze upon them. These clouds also serve as a protective barrier, obscuring its movements.

entry: POKENAME的菌盖会渗出汁液，在穿行森林时留下一路痕迹。这些滴液具有药效，深受医治宝可梦的人珍视。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds sap from its cap, leaving a trail as it moves through forests. These drippings are known to have medicinal properties, and are treasured by Pokémon healers.

entry: POKENAME将天然草药调成强效药膏，为受伤的宝可梦涂抹治疗。由于效果出众，这些药物广受追捧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mixes natural herbs into potent salves, applying them to heal injured Pokémon. Its remedies are widely sought after for their remarkable effectiveness.

entry: POKENAME在领地四周编结荆棘，筑起天然屏障保护幼崽。外来者几乎无法穿过这些带刺的防线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves brambles around its territory, creating natural barriers to protect its young. These thorny defenses are nearly impenetrable to outsiders.

entry: POKENAME会在巢穴附近栽种绣球花，借花丛隐蔽身形，躲避天敌。花朵也是诱饵，能将小型宝可梦引入它的领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cultivates hydrangeas near its nest, using the flowers to camouflage itself from predators. The blooms also serve as a lure, attracting smaller Pokémon to its territory.

entry: 有力的尾巴让POKENAME游起泳来格外优雅，令人意外。战斗时，它则偏爱径直冲锋，撞向敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful tails allow it to be a surprisingly graceful swimmer. Its preferred style to fight is to charge and ram right into the foe.

entry: 温暖的季节里，POKENAME会整天飞来飞去，撒下孢子。这些孢子会长成新的蘑蝠幼崽。
author: bee4082
source: In the warm months, POKENAME flies around all day scattering spores. These spores will grow into new baby Shroombat.

entry: POKENAME将黏土捏成小雕像，自豪地陈列在巢穴附近。作品常以当地宝可梦为原型，可见它从周围事物汲取的灵感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shapes clay into small sculptures, displaying them proudly near its den. These creations often resemble local Pokémon, showcasing the inspirations it draws from its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME以美丽闻名。它喜欢躺在太阳下，积蓄足够的能量，等待背上的花苞绽放。
author: flickeredflame
source: POKENAME is renowned for its beauty. It enjoys lying in the sun to gather enough energy for its bulb to bloom.

entry: 它生活慵懒，在森林中缓缓移动，沿途散播孢子。四肢最多能伸展到平时的五倍长。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has a sedentary life of spreading spores as it slowly moves across the forest. Its limbs can extend up to five times their normal length.

entry: POKENAME采集大褐菇，存进囊袋留待以后食用。这些菌类提供的能量，能让它挥出强劲的攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forages for portobello mushrooms, storing them in its pouch for later consumption. It uses the energy from these fungi to power its powerful strikes.

entry: 头上的蘑菇太重，小巧的身体已难以支撑。因此，POKENAME索性用蘑菇撑地旋转，借离心力踢击敌人，同时散播孢子。
author: SonTyp
source: The mushroom on its head became too heavy for its small body to effectively carry. Instead, POKENAME spins around on it, delivering kicks and spreading spores via centrifugal forces.

entry: POKENAME的孢子散发着牛肝菌的香气，引来各地的美食爱好者。它正是用这股香味，让毫无防备的猎物主动靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spores give off the aroma of porcini mushrooms, attracting food enthusiasts from far and wide. It uses this scent to lure unsuspecting prey closer.

entry: POKENAME用找到的牡丹装点领地，给粗犷的环境添上一分柔美。这些花既能引来好奇的宝可梦，也暗藏陷阱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME decorates its territory with peonies that it finds, adding a delicate beauty to its otherwise rugged environment. The flowers act as both a lure and a trap for curious Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME散发着疯狂的气息，连最镇定的生物也会心神不安。它性情狂野，动作却极其精准，让遇见它的人都心生恐惧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME radiates an aura of madness, unsettling even the calmest of creatures. Despite its wild nature, it moves with precision, striking fear into those who encounter it.

entry: 它随时准备迎战，双臂锋利如刃，覆着麻痹孢子，出手精准。严整的举止下藏着强烈的决心，既精通搏斗，也擅长施加异常状态。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: Always ready for a fight, it strikes with precise, blade-like arms coated in paralyzing spores. Its disciplined demeanor hides a fierce determination, making it a master of both combat and status-inflicting techniques.

entry: POKENAME将根深扎地下，便能察觉数英里外的敌人，再以音速挥拳出击。
author: slowforest
source: By extending its roots deep into the ground, POKENAME detects foes miles away and strikes with a punch at mach speed.

entry: POKENAME在茂密灌木间穿梭，身手灵活无比，借枝叶掩护行踪。它最适合草木疯长的环境，能完美融入其中，随时准备伏击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves through dense bushes with unparalleled agility, using them to conceal its movements. It thrives in overgrown areas, where it blends seamlessly into the foliage, always ready to ambush.

entry: 它喜欢住在蘑菇繁盛的阴暗潮湿处。繁殖时将孢子撒在腐烂的植物上，长出的菌体中便会诞生新的POKENAME。
author: amiel997
source: It prefers to live in dark, damp areas where mushrooms thrive. It reproduces by planting its spores on decaying plant matter, allowing new POKENAME to emerge from the fungal growth.

entry: POKENAME仿佛疲惫的化身，总在突然振作与精力耗尽之间徘徊。它的重击难以预料，也会让自己和对手都筋疲力尽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME embodies exhaustion, always teetering between bursts of energy and moments of collapse. Its powerful strikes are unpredictable, draining both itself and its opponents.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子会让对手咳嗽不止，打乱战斗节奏。它便趁机精准出击，让敌人连气都喘不过来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases spores that cause persistent coughing, disrupting foes mid-battle. It uses this distraction to strike with precision, leaving opponents struggling to recover their breath.

entry: POKENAME行动飘忽不定，常让对手摸不清下一步。它的双重性情，连经验丰富的训练家也难以揣测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often causes confusion with its erratic movements, leaving opponents uncertain of its next action. Its dual nature keeps even experienced Trainers guessing.

entry: POKENAME虽体型不小，行动却出奇地迅捷无声。若有人在它的领地虐待土居忍士，转眼就会遭到愤怒的POKENAME袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast and quiet when moving compared to their size. Should any Nincada be mistreated in their territory, the culprit will find themself beset by a furious POKENAME in the blink of an eye.

entry: 它绝对忠于训练家，执行命令又快又有效。关都与城都的历史传说中，高官曾雇用POKENAME执行秘密任务。
author: sk372
source: It has absolute loyalty to its Trainer, following its orders quickly and efficiently. Historical tales of Kanto and Johto speak of high-rank officials employing POKENAME for clandestine missions.

entry: POKENAME四处游历，寻找脱壳忍者。一旦找到，便拔剑驱魔，但两者之间久远的恩怨至今仍是谜。
author: _kuke_
source: POKENAME roam the region searching for Shedinja. Upon finding one, they draw their blade and perform an exorcism, though the ancient conflict between them remains a mystery.

entry: 它是潜行于黑夜的神秘武者。如此庞大的身形竟能不露行踪，实在不可思议，可人们察觉POKENAME时，往往早已太迟。
author: foolish_weasel
source: An elusive warrior that stalks the night, it is almost incomprehensible how its massive form can remain undetected at all, yet few ever catch sight of POKENAME until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME虽有翅膀，却似乎无法用来飞翔。即使遇到危险，翅膀也只会拖慢它的脚步。
author: pokebio
source: Though POKENAME has wings, it seems incapable of using them to fly. Even in dangerous situations, its wings only seem to slow it down.

entry: POKENAME的三只眼睛视力极佳，即使在深夜或水下也能看得清楚，其中第三眼最为敏锐。POKENAME还能在水面上飞快奔行。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME's three eyes can see exceptionally well, even during the darkest hours of the night and underwater. The third eye is the most acute. POKENAME can stride on the water's surface with exceptional speed.

entry: POKENAME总觉得其他宝可梦在轻视自己，时时留意它们的举动。一察觉可能受了冒犯，就会跟踪对方，等它落单后袭击。
author: hermit39
source: POKENAME are constantly on the lookout for perceived slights from other Pokémon. When they sense a possible transgression, they will stalk that Pokémon and attack when it is alone.

entry: POKENAME的每一道拉链都能伸出20米长的舌头，同时捆住多个猎物，再用带麻痹作用的唾液将其制服。
author: Love Equals Pain
source: Each zipper on POKENAME is capable of extending a 20-meter-long tongue. This allows it to restrain multiple victims at once and incapacitate them with its paralyzing saliva.

entry: 它主要栖息在城市。觅食时会在小巷的阴影里跳舞，等候迷路的游客。
author: .izik
source: Its primary habitat is in urban areas. While hunting for food, it will dance within the shadows of alleyways to wait for lost tourists.

entry: 它不断寻找可以试刀的东西。若遇上斩不断的物件，就会接连数周不知疲倦地磨爪。
author: .izik
source: It is constantly searching for objects to test its blades on. Should it find something it cannot slice, it will spend weeks tirelessly sharpening its claws.

entry: 许多POKENAME喜欢住在废弃的纺织厂，捡到散落的布料或线绳便吞下充饥。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME prefer to live in abandoned textile factories. It will consume any loose fabric or string that it finds in order to satiate its hunger.

entry: 它必须直接沐浴月光才容易入睡。若试着在白天睡觉，就会变得焦躁不安。
author: .izik
source: It has a hard time sleeping when it is not in direct contact with the moon's light. If it attempts to sleep during the day, it will become restless.

entry: POKENAME替所有被放生的宝可梦怨恨训练家。它藏在树上，用蛛网绊倒经过的人类，再扑上去施以毒咬。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME harbors resentment and anger towards Trainers on behalf of all the Pokémon they have released. It will hide on trees, using its webs to trip any humans so it can bite them with poison.

entry: POKENAME的丝网其实由极其紧密结实的织物构成，这种材料通常用于制作毛衣。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME's webbing is actually made from extremely tight and firm fabric, which is typically used for sweaters.

entry: 古代的邪教徒曾用它吐出的丝制作玩偶。据说，那些玩偶能够施下强大的诅咒。
author: .izik
source: The string that it produces was used by cultists to create dolls in ancient times. These dolls were said to have the power to inflict powerful curses.

entry: 它看似塞满棉花，身体却极其坚硬，密度与石英相近。睡觉时会直立着，纹丝不动。
author: .izik
source: Despite looking like it is full of cotton, its body is extremely hard and similar in density to quartz. When sleeping, it will stand upright and remain completely still.

entry: 它身体很轻，常被风吹走。若挂在树上，就会一边挣扎脱身，一边让双眼发出亮光。
author: .izik
source: Due being so lightweight, it is easily blown away by the wind. Should it be caught in a tree, its eyes will glow brightly as it wiggles free.

entry: 头上花朵的花粉带着腐肉般的气味，能用来驱赶巢穴附近的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The pollen that comes from the flower on its head gives off a smell that is reminiscent of rotting meat. It uses this to deter predators from its nest.

entry: 它喜欢潮湿的环境，好让身体保持湿润。体表渗出的汗珠，过去曾被用来调制使人产生噩梦般幻觉的毒药。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to live in humid environments, allowing its body to stay moist. The sweat that beads off of its body was once used in a poison that caused nightmarish delusions.

entry: 它偷来纱线与绳索筑巢。必须将十种不同的布料拼缝在一起，POKENAME才觉得巢穴大功告成。
author: .izik
source: It steals yarn and string to create its nest. A POKENAME only deems its nest complete once ten different fabrics are incorporated and sewn together.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在黑暗中，突然跳出惊吓训练家。若训练家下意识反击，POKENAME便会对其施加诅咒。
author: GentleSage
source: POKENAME lurks within the darkness and jumps out to frighten Trainers. If a Trainer reflexively attacks it, POKENAME will place a curse on them.

entry: 感到快乐时，外壳就会变软。因此，野生POKENAME战斗时必须回想可怕的经历，才能保持外层坚硬。
author: .izik
source: Its shell will become softer if it feels happiness. Because of this, it's important during combat for a wild POKENAME to think of horrible experiences to keep its outer layer strong.

entry: 积累的诅咒一旦达到临界点，POKENAME周身就会显现恶意的气场，进一步强化诅咒。
author: ziggaway
source: When the accumulated maledictions reach a critical mass, a spiteful aura is visible surrounding POKENAME. The aura further empowers its curses.

entry: 它整日收集枯花，带回巢穴。一顿能吃下一磅花朵。
author: .izik
source: It spends its days gathering dead flowers and bringing them back to its den. It can eat a pound of flowers for a single meal.

entry: POKENAME失去了光合作用的能力，只能依靠其他生物的能量生存。它潜伏在暗处，猎取毫无防备的宝可梦，吸走生命能量维持自身。
author: Love Equals Pain
source: Since POKENAME has lost its ability to perform photosynthesis, it has become dependent on the energy of others to survive. It lurks in the darkness, preying on unsuspecting Pokémon to drain their life energy in order to sustain itself.

entry: 长长的拉链沿着背部延伸，仿佛要将受诅咒的本质封在体内。它强迫幽灵宝可梦为自己囤积食物。谁敢偷POKENAME的东西，它就会追上门，将其拖回巢穴吸取生命力。
author: amiel997
source: A long zipper runs down its back, as if it's trying to keep its cursed essence sealed within. It forces ghost Pokémon to hoard food for it. If anyone steals from POKENAME, it hunts them down and drags them to its den to feed on their life essence.

entry: 据说，只要被POKENAME碰一下，就会终生背负诅咒。传说受害者从此再也无法爱上任何人。
author: .izik
source: A single touch from a POKENAME is said to curse a person for a lifetime. The legends say the curse causes its victim to become unable to fall in love for the rest of their life.

entry: 它专门寻找承载深厚感情的物件吞食。物主越珍爱那件东西，POKENAME就觉得越美味。
author: .izik
source: It actively seeks out objects with high sentimental value and eats them. The more love a person has for the item, the more delicious POKENAME finds it.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME数着训练家慌乱中掉落的硬币。有人说，还可以向它们借钱。
author: Tad
source: POKENAME can often be found counting coins dropped by panicking Trainers. Some say you can borrow money from them.

entry: POKENAME行动无声，从不出声，动作也毫无感情，让身边的人心神不宁。目击者坚称见过它兜帽上的眼睛眨动，但研究尚未证实。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME moves silently, never uttering a sound, which, paired with its emotionless movements, makes anyone in its presence unnerved. Eyewitness reports swear they have seen the eyes on its hood blink, but research can't confirm this yet.

entry: 它来自另一个已被黑暗吞噬的宇宙。双臂各有意识，为达自己的目的，操纵着双目失明的POKENAME。
author: bee4082
source: This Pokémon comes from another universe, one where darkness has consumed the world. The arms have a mind of their own, manipulating the blind POKENAME for their own agenda.

entry: 最近，人们在荫凉山庞大的洞穴群中，发现了一群POKENAME。它们的爪子远比看上去锋利，连坚硬的岩石也能挖穿。
author: .izik
source: A colony of POKENAME recently were found in the vast cave systems of Mt. Shady. Their claws are deceptively sharp and able to dig through solid stone.

entry: 嫉妒时，双眼会泛起深红的光。若遇上旅人，它便会出于贪欲，试图偷走对方的贵重物品。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes glow a deep crimson if it becomes jealous. If it encounters a traveler, it will attempt to steal something valuable from them out of greed.

entry: 它躲在阴影中看孩子玩耍，发出孩童般的笑声。若有孩子靠得太近，便会被它拖入阴影，让它以恐惧为食。
author: .izik
source: It laughs like a child from shadows while watching children play. Should a child get too close to the shadow, it will pull them in and feed off of their fear.

entry: 孩子遗失的玩具饱含思念与悲伤，最终获得生命，化作这只宝可梦。它不知为何特别厌恶某些超能力属性宝可梦。
author: Shocktopus1717
source: A child's lost toy, filled with longing and sorrow, came to life as this Pokémon. It has a strange aversion to certain Psychic-Type Pokémon.

entry: 它大多待在幽深的洞穴中，只在午夜出来觅食。獠牙能咬碎坚硬的大理石。
author: .izik
source: It spends most of its time in deep caves, only emerging in the middle of the night to gather food. Its fangs are able to break solid marble.

entry: 身处黑暗时，双眼会转为更深的红色，让它能察觉天敌与猎物散发的热量。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes tint to a darker color of red when it is in darkness. Doing so, it can read heat signatures from both predators and prey alike.

entry: 它的毛发轻得出奇，也很容易裁制。新芽镇有位织工，就用这种材料制作优雅的礼服。
author: .izik
source: Its fur is incredibly light-weight and easy to tailor. There is a weaver is Greenstation Town that makes elegant gowns with this material.

entry: 独处时，它会因寂寞而接连哀号数小时。叫声极其尖锐，甚至能震碎玻璃。
author: .izik
source: When it is alone, it will wail for hours due to its loneliness. The sound of its cry can get so high-pitched that it can break glass.

entry: POKENAME擅长制作玩偶，会为寂寞的人做出玩偶朋友。这些玩偶能驱退恶灵，诅咒胆敢伤害它们的人。
author: noel5229
source: A gifted doll maker, POKENAME crafts doll friends for those who feel lonely. These dolls ward off evil spirits and curse anyone who harms them.

entry: POKENAME体内的蛋虽受到悉心孵育，却始终没有破壳的迹象。尽管如此，POKENAME依然很快乐。
author: Patch_Bros
source: Even though it's very well incubated, the egg inside of a POKENAME never seems to show signs of hatching. Despite this, POKENAME remains happy.

entry: 它寄居在电动搅拌机里，保护娇弱的身体。收集树果榨成提神的果汁，能让失去战斗能力的宝可梦恢复活力。有人认为，这种果汁与伤药有关。
author: Mistymagius
source: It inhabits an electric blender to protect its delicate body. It collects berries to create an energizing juice that it uses to re-energize fainted Pokémon. Some believe its juice is related to potions.

entry: 这只热心的融合宝可梦喜欢利用三维打印而成的身体与电动机，为训练家制作刨冰。
author: pankiwi
source: This helpful fusion enjoys producing shaved ice treats for its Trainers using its 3D-printed body and electric motor.

entry: POKENAME是拥有意识、能源无穷的动力源，却因顽劣的恶作剧而被束缚在外壳之中。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A sentient, infinite energy power source, POKENAME is bound to its case for its mischief.

entry: 背上的发光纹样会显示体内还存有多少电力。训练家常将POKENAME当作随身电池。
author: Mistymagius
source: The bright patterns on its back indicate how much electricity is stored inside of its body. Trainers often keep POKENAME as portable batteries.

entry: POKENAME原本是为包办一切家务而设计的完美家电。被洛托姆附身后，如今能同时使用其所有形态的力量。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME was designed as the perfect household appliance, able to handle every task. However, after being possessed by a Rotom, it now enjoys the powers of all its forms at once.

entry: 它每周都会驶入居民区，四处收集垃圾，似乎并没有驾驶员。
author: bostroms
source: It appears around neighborhoods every week, driving about and collecting garbage.  It does not seem to have a driver.

entry: 它每周都会驶入居民区，四处收集垃圾，似乎并没有驾驶员。
author: bostroms
source: It appears around neighborhoods every week, driving about and collecting garbage.  It does not seem to have a driver.

entry: 据说POKENAME是遭雷击的树木所化的幽灵。有些人将它奉为繁荣与丰收的使者。
author: galactak
source: POKENAME is said to be the apparition of a tree that got struck by lightning. Some people worship it as a herald of prosperity and good harvest.

entry: 据说POKENAME是遭雷击的树木所化的幽灵。有些人将它奉为繁荣与丰收的使者。
author: galactak
source: POKENAME is said to be the apparition of a tree that got struck by lightning. Some people worship it as a herald of prosperity and good harvest.

entry: 抓娃娃机常暗藏机关，让玩家难以得手，POKENAME却另有一套：看似免费，真正的代价却是遭它伏击。
author: redhaering
source: While claw games are rigged against the player, POKENAME is uniquely so; free though it may seem, the cost is an ambush.

entry: 富含铁的沙子遭雷击后，就会诞生POKENAME。它喜欢收集废弃的金属小饰物，拿来玩耍。
author: odditylad
source: When sand with a high iron content is struck by lightning, POKENAME is formed. It likes to collect and play with discarded metal trinkets.

entry: 这只洛托姆附在岩狗狗机器人玩具上，这款玩具在阿罗拉很受孩子喜爱。原本无害的项圈受洛托姆影响，成了恶作剧时会电人的危险机关。
author: xyloldi
source: This Rotom has possessed a popular Rockruff robot toy beloved by children in Alola. Though the collar around its neck was designed to be harmless, Rotom's influence turns it into a shocking hazard for pranks.

entry: POKENAME凭强劲的车轮飞速疾驰，沿途不断从鬃毛中射出岩石。它虽对训练家极其忠诚，却也爱淘气，常拿最信任的人开玩笑。
author: Xyloldi
source: POKENAME races at incredible speeds using its powerful wheels, while launching rocks from its mane as it moves. Though fiercely loyal to its Trainer, it has a mischievous streak and often pulls pranks on those it trusts most.

entry: POKENAME头上的寄生蘑菇会将阳光转化为电力。偏偏宿主本身就靠阳光获取能量，因此深受其害。
author: trainerrobo
source: The parasitic mushroom atop POKENAME's head converts sunlight into electricity. This is unfortunate for the host, as it relies on sunlight for its energy.

entry: POKENAME会潜入设备，以其中的软件为食。若吞下恶意代码，健康就可能受到严重损害。
author: jreposo
source: POKENAME thrives on software it devours from within the devices it infiltrates. Consuming malicious code can lead to dire consequences for its health.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由凝胶状物质构成，战斗时不容易受损。但这样一来，脆弱的身体也就失去了遮护。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are made of a gel-like substance that makes them less likely to be damaged in combat. However, this leaves its fragile body wide open for attacks.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: Katie
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense Psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: Katie
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: 庞大的大脑让POKENAME对昆虫了如指掌。皮下金色的团块其实是储备的蜂蜜，供食物短缺时食用。
author: Iaobug
source: POKENAME's impeccable knowledge of insects stems from its immense brain. The gold globs under its skin are honey reserves for when food is scarce.

entry: 包裹身体的凝胶由纯粹的超能力构成。POKENAME借此操纵天气，唤起猛烈的风暴。里面那只幼小宝可梦究竟有多强，引来许多猜测。
author: princess_lucina
source: The gel is constructed of pure psychic power. POKENAME uses this power to manipulate the weather and conjure storms of great magnitude. Many speculate about how strong the infantile Pokémon within really is.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的花其实是大脑。体内渗出的叶绿素凝成有毒的薄膜，增强它的超能力。
author: brainiax
source: The flower sprouting from POKENAME is actually its brain. The chlorophyll inside its body has seeped out, congealing into a toxic membrane that amplifies its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME躯干内的本体用超能力操纵三个头。无论哪个头被斩断，都能在几秒内重新长出。
author: Mistymagius
source: The main body in POKENAME's torso controls the three heads with its psychic powers. If any of its heads gets cut off, they will regrow in a matter of seconds.

entry: 不难看出，POKENAME很难协调身体的两半。不过，它的力量足够强，足以弥补行动中的任何踉跄。
author: mx_wellman
source: It's not hard to notice that POKENAME have trouble coordinating both halves of their bodies. However, they've got more than enough power to compensate for any stumble.

entry: POKENAME能调整凝胶状的身体，减小飞行时的空气阻力。出色的听力与超能力，让它在任何环境中都能找到猎物。
author: leofric1814
source: POKENAME has a gelatinous form it can manipulate to enhance its body's aerodynamics. Its excellent hearing and psychic abilities allow it to locate prey in any environment.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的黏液能保护身体，强大的精神力量还能将其塑成牢不可破的超能力屏障。它虽强大，性情却温和，喜欢给人黏糊糊的大拥抱。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME's thick, protective slime shields it from harm, and its powerful mind controls this ooze to form unbreakable psychic barriers. Despite its strength, it is gentle by nature and fond of giving big, slimy hugs.

entry: 尽管身体没有固定形状，它仍能以超过每小时130英里的速度奔跑。据说，POKENAME全速奔跑时极少绊倒，但一旦摔倒翻滚，就会散成多只较小的POKENAME。
author: Staghorn
source: Despite its amorphous body, it can run at speeds of over 130 miles per hour. It is said that in the rare event that a POKENAME trips and falls while at a full gallop, the resulting tumble will cause it to break apart into multiple smaller POKENAME.

entry: 吸收过多月光后，体内会积聚不稳定的能量，最终引发爆炸。因此，晴朗的月夜里，它的存在十分危险。
author: .izik
source: Absorbing too much moonlight causes it to build up unstable energy, leading to explosive consequences. This makes it a hazardous presence on clear, moonlit nights.

entry: 它会使出光芒夺目的月亮之力，奋力守护巢穴。耀眼的攻击常能吓退最执着的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: It fiercely defends its nest with brilliant rays of Moonblast. The radiance of its attacks often deters even the most determined predators.

entry: 它的生命水滴连极重的伤势也能治好，为垂危者恢复生机。许多宝可梦遭遇大难时，都会来寻求它的救治。
author: .izik
source: Its Life Dew is known to heal even the most severe wounds, restoring life to those in critical need. Many Pokémon seek it out in times of great distress, hoping for its healing touch.

entry: 它用看我嘛吸引敌人的注意，保护同伴。这份无私让伙伴们免受伤害。
author: .izik
source: To keep allies safe, it uses Follow Me, drawing attention away from them. This selfless act ensures its companions remain unharmed.

entry: 它主要靠威力强大的岩崩抵御威胁，也会用这招封住通路，守护领地。
author: .izik
source: Powerful Rock Slides are its primary defense against threats. It uses these attacks to block pathways and protect its territory.

entry: 它用小石头做成饰物，送给旅人，祝愿他们好运。体贴的举动让长途旅行的人都很喜爱这个伙伴。
author: .izik
source: It creates trinkets from small rocks, gifting them to travelers for good luck. These thoughtful gestures make it a beloved companion among those on long journeys.

entry: POKENAME天生听觉极其敏锐，因此总难觅行踪。身体充满电力时，尾巴会卷得更紧，翅膀也开始轻振，甚至能飘浮起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have naturally incredible hearing, so they tend to be very elusive. When their body is charged with electricity, their tail curls further, their wings start to flutter, and they even begin to float.

entry: 看到自己的倒影时，它可能变得焦虑，分散注意，露出模仿的破绽。那一刻，也显出了它活泼外表下敏感的一面。
author: .izik
source: If it catches sight of its reflection, it may become anxious and lose focus, breaking its mimicry. This moment of vulnerability reveals the delicate nature beneath its playful exterior.

entry: 优雅的动作会散发细微波动，扭曲现实，让周围物体仿佛失去重量。学者认为，它的圆形轮廓象征着宇宙无尽的和谐。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its graceful movements emit subtle waves that distort reality, causing objects to appear weightless around it. Scholars say its circular shape represents infinite cosmic harmony.

entry: 满月之夜，它们常聚到山上，围成一圈，交换旅途中收集的小饰品。
author: pankiwi
source: They will typically appear on the night of a full moon, gathering in a circle on mountains to exchange trinkets they've collected on their travels.

entry: 它在森林的洞穴中安家，借周围的魔力增强自身能力。洞中宁静的能量为它和同伴提供了安全的栖身处。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in forest caves, where the ambient magic enhances its abilities. The tranquil energy of these caves provides a safe space for it and its allies.

entry: 它喜欢借小翅膀的力量在水面蹦跳，每一步都迸出彩色火花。满月之夜，常能见到整群POKENAME一起放电庆祝。
author: thatdanguy23
source: It loves to skip across bodies of water using its small wings, creating colourful sparks with each step. On nights with a full moon, whole groups of POKENAME can be seen discharging electricity in celebration.

entry: 它能一口气吃下与体重相当的蕉香果，速度丝毫不减。这种填不满的胃口，让它成了树果园的常客。
author: .izik
source: It can eat its weight in Nanab Berries without slowing down. This insatiable appetite makes it a frequent visitor to berry orchards.

entry: 它在丛林深处游荡，借藤蔓穿过浓密枝叶。遇见迷路的旅人，会轻轻牵引对方，带到安全的地方。
author: .izik
source: It wanders deep in jungles, using its vines to navigate through dense foliage. This Pokémon is known to assist lost travelers, guiding them to safety with gentle tugs.

entry: 除了电力，POKENAME还能产生一种特殊能量，让敌人晕头转向、同伴精神振奋。由于太过罕见，这种能量的潜力尚未得到充分研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: In addition to electricity, POKENAME produces an unusual type of energy that leaves foes dazed and allies invigorated. Due to its rarity, the full potential of this energy has not been well-studied.

entry: 它胆子很小，稍受惊扰就躲进剑鞘。但POKENAME见过的脸就绝不忘记，满月之夜更会一扫胆怯，追猎那些胆敢伤害它的人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: This Pokémon is cowardly and will hide in its sheath at even the slightest provocation. POKENAME never forgets a face, however, and it sheds its timidity under the full moon to hunt those who dared harm it.

entry: 据说，它将月夜的天空收进了锋利的爪与指甲之中。研究者认为，这是接触月之石后产生的变化。它能轻松跃上高空，仿佛身处月球。
source: It's said this Pokémon captured the moonlit sky in its sharp claws and nails. Researchers believe it's the result of it coming into contact with a Moon Stone. It can easily jump into the sky as if it were on the moon.

entry: POKENAME翱翔于浩瀚太空，保护世界免受各种星际威胁。它们十分贪玩，时不时便回到人类身边。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME soars throughout the vast emptiness of space, protecting the world from a number of intergalactic threats. They are very playful Pokémon and return to humanity every so often.

entry: 常能见到奇特的发光球体围着POKENAME旋转，模样宛如行星。科学家至今仍未对其成因达成共识。
author: avidclown
source: Peculiar, luminous orbs resembling planets are often observed to be revolving around POKENAME. Scientists have failed to come to a consensus on why this is, however.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，用强大的引力漩涡吸来猎物。漩涡虽强得连汽车也能卷入，POKENAME却只捕食小型宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the ground, using a strong gravitational vortex to pull in its prey. Despite the vortex being powerful enough to pull in a car, POKENAME only goes after smaller Pokémon.

entry: 身体轻盈无比，POKENAME只需每隔几分钟振动一次大翅膀，就能接连飞行数小时。
author: welliss
source: Its body is incredibly light. POKENAME can fly for hours despite only beating its large wings once every few minutes.

entry: 嵌在体内的水晶于月光下闪烁，更添神秘气息。人们认为，这些水晶能够储存能量，在激战时释放。
author: .izik
source: Crystals embedded in its body shimmer under moonlight, amplifying its mystical presence. These crystals are believed to store energy, which it releases during intense battles.

entry: POKENAME用双臂上的光球演出绚丽的灯光秀。在野外，这能迷惑捕食者；被人饲养时，它则是很受欢迎的表演者。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME uses the glowing balls on its arms to create dazzling light shows. In the wild, this serves to confuse its predators, but in domestic settings, this Pokémon is popular as a performance artist.

entry: POKENAME头上的螺旋宝石在收藏家间价格高昂。它通常喜欢躲藏，却也能从宝石射出激光，抵抗偷猎者。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: The spiral gem in POKENAME's head fetches a high price from collectors. Though it usually prefers to hide, POKENAME can fire lasers from this gem to defend itself from poachers.

entry: 它抵挡不住灯火与亮光的吸引，常来光顾营地。虽然无害，偶尔却会淘气地挡住光源。
author: .izik
source: Lamps and bright lights irresistibly attract it, making it a common visitor to campsites. While its presence is harmless, it sometimes causes mischief by blocking light sources.

entry: 伙伴受伤时，它会满怀真心使出治愈之愿，为对方恢复健康。牺牲让它耗尽体力，却也让彼此的羁绊更加深厚。
author: .izik
source: If its friend becomes injured, it will use a heartfelt Healing Wish to restore their health. This act of sacrifice leaves it drained, but its bond with its ally grows stronger.

entry: 摄影师屡次想拍下POKENAME在满月下跃动时，毛发闪烁的空灵光彩，却始终未能成功。
author: bobosmith01
source: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.

entry: 摄影师屡次想拍下POKENAME在满月下跃动时，毛发闪烁的空灵光彩，却始终未能成功。
author: bobosmith01
source: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.

entry: 摄影师屡次想拍下POKENAME在满月下跃动时，毛发闪烁的空灵光彩，却始终未能成功。
author: bobosmith01
source: Photographers have tried and failed to capture the ethereal sparkle of POKENAME's glittering coat of fur as it leaps under the full moon.

entry: POKENAME很受训练家欢迎。同伴聚到一起时，会相互梳理头顶的软绒毛，以此问候。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is very popular among Trainers. Groups of POKENAME greet each other by grooming the soft fluff on their heads.

entry: POKENAME紧密卷曲的毛发，不容易引起过敏。聚群时，额头的宝石一齐发亮；当它们乘风飘浮，整群宛如一片繁星点点的夜空。
author: Gloomymort
source: POKENAME's tight curls give their fur a hypoallergenic quality. When gathered in herds, the gems on their foreheads glow brightly. As they float on the wind, the herd looks like a starry night sky.

entry: POKENAME吸取猎物的生命力，储存在颈边的种子里。它会追寻临终之人，将对方的生命力送回自然。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME draws out the life force from its victims and stores it in the seeds on its neck. It pursues people near their end to return their life force to nature.

entry: POKENAME奔过田野，撒播棉花种子，是业余农人的热门伙伴。它们也喜欢嚼食棉枝，正好在重新播种时帮助清理田地。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run through fields to scatter cotton seeds, making them popular companions for amateur farmers. They enjoy snacking on cotton branches, which helps clear the field when it's time for new seeds to be planted.

entry: POKENAME总能选出最适合眼前人或宝可梦的发型，因此很受发型师欢迎。
author: w1ndowsxp
source: POKENAME is very popular among hair stylists due to it always knowing what style would best fit the person or Pokémon it's cutting.

entry: 人们猜测POKENAME是获得生命的堆肥堆。它乘风漂游时，会朝下撒落腐烂的植物残屑，似乎觉得这恶作剧十分有趣。
author: Wormspawn
source: Presumed to be a compost heap given life, POKENAME scatters decaying plant material beneath it as it rides the wind. It seems to think this is a funny joke.

entry: 骑在蓬松的POKENAME身上十分惬意。但战斗时可得离远些：不断再生的棉花一旦被它的火焰点燃，就会爆炸！
author: bobosmith01
source: It is wonderful to ride on a fluffy POKENAME. However, be far away during battle: the regenerative cotton will explode when ignited by its fire!

entry: POKENAME制造绿洲，藏进沙中捕猎。据传，即使是结伴穿越沙漠的大队人马，靠近这样的绿洲也会失踪。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME creates water oases and hides in sand to catch their prey. Rumors say that even big groups of people in the desert go missing when approaching such oases.

entry: 等待猎物时，POKENAME将四肢缩入伪装的藤蔓里。一有东西进入范围，就会整个身体弹射出去，用那些藤蔓将对方缠住。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME pulls its limbs into its vine camouflage as it waits for prey. As soon as something comes within range, it launches its entire body at them, ensnaring them with the very same vines.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾被一位传奇大盗使用。如今它在自己的沙漠领地伏击闯入者，令人闻之生畏。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Thought to once be wielded by a legendary bandit, POKENAME terrorizes its territory of the desert by ambushing trespassers.

entry: POKENAME故作强硬，命令幼小的宝可梦听自己使唤。可一旦对方的父母前来保护孩子，它就只会逃跑。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME put on a tough act and command baby Pokémon to do what they say. However, it will resort to fleeing if the parents come to protect the young.

entry: POKENAME不仅能忍受沙漠的酷热与干旱，还能以强烈的太阳能将其向外扩散。它的模样酷似多个古文明共同崇敬的一位远古太阳神。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME  can not only handle intense desert heat and drought, but also spread it with intense solar energy. They resemble an ancient sun deity revered by several ancient civilizations.

entry: 古时，它被奉为已故初始伙伴宝可梦的守护者，照看那些未能找到训练家的孩子。
author: ayem_live
source: In ancient times, it was revered as a guardian of deceased starter Pokémon. It watches over those who couldn't find a Trainer.

entry: 神话称，它是一条早已死去的龙的灵魂，附在生前珍藏的宝物上，重返世间。
author: themicelegion
source: Myths state this Pokémon is the spirit of a long dead dragon that has returned through possessing its treasures from its lifetime.

entry: POKENAME制造出盗墓者心中渴求之物的幻象，引诱毫无戒心的人进入领地。一旦上钩，POKENAME便用幽灵般的肢体榨尽他们的生命力。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME tempt unsuspecting tomb raiders into its domain with illusions of their desires.  Once enticed, POKENAME uses its ghostly limbs to squeeze the life force out of them.

entry: POKENAME的身体由实心黄金构成，很容易受损。伤害它或偷走它财物的人，都会遭到强烈的诅咒。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body is made of solid gold that is easily damaged. It'll lay a powerful curse on those who harm it or steal from it.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME体内，还留着鬃岩狼人的残魂——那曾是在古代被奉为神明的宝可梦。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some say that POKENAME contains remnants of the spirit of a Lycanroc that was worshipped as a deity in ancient times.

entry: 多年前，考古学家在古墓中发现了POKENAME。烈日下，它看起来只是一尊泥像。可据说到了凉爽的沙漠夜晚，就会有灵魂围着它，举行早已失传的仪式。
author: Kianjp2019
source: Archeologists discovered POKENAME in an ancient tomb many years ago. Under the blazing sun it appears to only be a clay sculpture, but during cool desert nights it's said that spirits can be found circled around it performing a long forgotten ritual.

entry: 芽甘蓝镇的一位裁缝用它的丝制作雅致的帽子。帽子戴起来轻巧舒适，在春日庆典上很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: A tailor in Brussel Town designs elegant hats with its silk. These hats are popular during spring festivals for their lightweight feel.

entry: 鲜艳的体色是在警告可能来犯的敌人。被激怒后，POKENAME能绕着对手飞行，用出奇有力的双臂接连攻击。
author: sivanandi
source: Its bright coloring is a warning to potential aggressors. If provoked, POKENAME can fly circles around its foes while using its surprisingly strong arms to strike.

entry: 它喜欢变成电源线插进插座，大口吞食电力。饲养POKENAME的训练家最好给插座加上儿童防护盖，免得它又钻空子。
author: pokebio
source: It loves turning into a power cord and plugging itself into an outlet, resulting in it consuming a lot of electricity. Trainers caring for POKENAME are advised to baby-proof their outlets to prevent this from happening.

entry: POKENAME棉絮般的毛簇带有微弱静电。这些纤维能吸附在物体表面，帮助它织出复杂的蛛网。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like tufts from POKENAME carry a faint static charge. These fibers cling to surfaces, aiding it in creating complex webs.

entry: 角尖长着能沿墙爬行的细小腿足。它会吊在天花板上，再精准抛网，伏击猎物。
author: .izik
source: The tip of its horn has tiny, wall-crawling legs. It suspends itself from ceilings before ambushing prey with an expertly aimed web.

entry: 发亮的双眼让它在黑暗中也能看得一清二楚，轻易趁夜袭入农田。一整片田的庄稼，都可能被它一夜吃光。
author: .izik
source: Its glowing eyes allow it to see perfectly in the dark, making nighttime raids on farm plots easy. It can strip an entire field of crops overnight.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME飞快绕着敌人奔转，用带电的丝将对方缠住。等敌人动弹不得，POKENAME便凶狠地拳打脚踢。
author: bobosmith01
source: To fight, POKENAME will rapidly circle around a foe, spinning electrified thread around them. When the foe is unable to move, POKENAME attacks them viciously with punches and kicks.

entry: 桩之镇的店铺用它的丝制作耐穿的裙子。这种材料结实又柔韧，十分抢手。
author: .izik
source: Shops in Camelia Town use its silk to create durable skirts. The material is highly sought after for its strength and flexibility.

entry: 它会爬上公路沿线亮着的指示牌，吸收电力。这些夜间活动常干扰附近的照明系统。
author: .izik
source: It scales lit street signs along highways to absorb electricity. These nocturnal climbs often disrupt nearby lighting systems.

entry: 它整天待在原处补充电力。入夜后便与同类成群横行，以不幸撞见的猎物为食。
author: Skymaster426
source: It spends the entire day in place charging itself up with electricity. At night, it goes on a rampage with its swarm, feeding on any unlucky prey.

entry: 彩穗蓬花镇的一位织工用它的丝制作防护背心。背心结实耐穿又舒适，深受矿工喜爱。
author: .izik
source: A weaver in Astilbe Town uses its silk to craft protective vests. These vests are prized by miners for their durability and comfort.

entry: POKENAME会附在其他生物或电器上，转眼吸干全部能量，再跳到新的宿主身上，继续如此。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME can attach itself to other living creatures or electrical devices to suck out all their energy within a very short time. It then jumps to a new host to repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在寺庙筑巢，夜里能照明，还会捕捉其他虫宝可梦，因此很受欢迎。有人甚至相信，它们的光能驱散邪灵。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME like to nest in temples, where they are well received because they generate light at night and catch other Bug Pokémon. Some even believe that they keep evil spirits away with their radiant light.

entry: 它如哨兵般守在货运码头附近，抛网拦住漂来的杂物。水手们信赖它，让航道保持畅通安全。
author: .izik
source: It stands as a sentinel near shipping docks, throwing its web to secure drifting debris. Sailors trust it to keep waterways clear and safe.

entry: 双翼摩擦产生的能量足以织出带电的蛛网。身体热到只要碰触，就会让对方燃起火来。
author: cheroace
source: The friction of its wings generates enough energy to create shocking webs. Its body becomes hot enough to engulf anyone who touches it in flames.

entry: 外表看似石头，其实是紧密编织的丝。这种丝韧性惊人，能抵挡物理攻击。
author: .izik
source: Though it appears stone-like, its exterior is composed of tightly woven silk. This silk is remarkably resilient against physical attacks.

entry: 它将电力导入钟摆。带电的摆锤发出微光，令附近的敌人神魂颠倒。
author: .izik
source: It channels its electric power through its pendulum. The charged pendulum emits a faint glow, entrancing nearby foes.

entry: POKENAME用尾端三只灵活的爪抓住猎物，再猛力甩尾，将其扎在自己背部的尖刺上。
author: .onionpug
source: POKENAME hunts by latching onto prey with the three prehensile claws on its tail. Once it gets a grip, it then uses its tail to savagely impale its victim on the sharp spines on its back.

entry: POKENAME将身体绷成Y形静候猎物。目标一出现，便头朝前弹射出去，狠狠咬下，力量足以碎骨。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME pulls itself taut in a Y shape and waits. When it sees prey, it launches itself headfirst and bites down with enough force to break bone.

entry: 水手们讨厌野生POKENAME，自有他们的道理。船只一驶入它的领地，船体几乎必定受损，甚至彻底破裂。
author: sivanandi
source: Sailors hate wild POKENAME, and for good reason. Bringing a ship within its territory nearly guarantees a damaged or even broken hull.

entry: 一些年幼的孤儿曾心脏停跳，后被救回。他们声称，曾在濒死时见过这只宝可梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Young orphans whose hearts have stopped and been revived claim to have seen this Pokémon during their near-death experience.

entry: 快速旋转时，四肢会甩出滚烫的熔蜡，灼伤目标。据说，被蜡烫伤就等于受到POKENAME的标记，无论逃到哪里，它都能找到对方，吸取生命力。
author: sk372
source: When it spins rapidly, its limbs fling hot melted wax that singe targets. Those burned by the wax are said to be marked by POKENAME, so that it can find them and drain their life force no matter where they go.

entry: POKENAME诞生于废弃多年的发电厂，吸取破旧机器与引擎的能量。负责停用拆卸设施的工程师常说，黑暗的走廊与大厅深处会出现幽异的蓝光。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME form within long-abandoned power plants, drawing energy from derelict machines and engines. Engineers decommissioning these facilities often report eerie blue lights deep in the dark corridors and halls.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一簇闪烁的紫焰，高兴、想玩时，就会亮起来。它会点出小小的火花与火焰，把快乐传给身边的伙伴。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME has a flickering purple flame atop its head that lights up whenever its happy and in a playful mood. It can ignite small sparks and flames, using its fire to spread its cheerful spirit.

entry: 进化时，蜡烛的热量受到封抑，让蜡质的身体得以凝固。
author: jpeggio
source: During evolution, the heat from its candle is contained. This allows its waxy body to solidify.

entry: 燃烧的颚自有意识，会咬向一切，吞噬猎物的灵魂。但它的本体却出奇地友善，常朝喜欢的训练家凑过去。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its fiery jaw has a mind of its own and will chomp at anything to consume its victims' souls. Despite this, the main body is oddly friendly and wanders toward Trainers it likes.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，会借拉帝欧斯的传说，引来好奇的人类与宝可梦，再装出温顺的样子，让对方不愿离去。与此同时，幽异的紫焰却不断吸走他们的生命力。
author: Arcul
source: A highly intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME uses the lore surrounding Latios to entice curious Pokémon and humans to approach. It then keeps them close by displaying a docile nature, but all the while, its eerie purple flame saps their life force.

entry: 体内的热量不断熔化新生的蜡，因此它始终承受着巨大的痛苦。
author: Display name: .jpg   Username: jpeggio
source: The heat from its body causes the newly formed wax to melt. Due to this, it is constantly in immense agony.

entry: 它在空中轻轻漂游，受负面情绪吸引。周围情绪越强烈，火焰就越大、越明亮。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon drifts gently through the air, drawn to negative feelings. Its flame grows larger and brighter the stronger the surrounding emotions are.

entry: 民间传说，游魂融入蜡烛最后的一点残焰，便诞生了POKENAME。它能重塑蜡质的身体，仿出各种蜡烛造型，几乎与寻常物件无异。
author: Rakunk
source: According to folklore, POKENAME was formed when the last flicker of a candle was imbued with a wandering spirit. Its waxy body can reshape itself to mimic various candle designs, making it nearly indistinguishable from ordinary objects.

entry: 临近死亡时，它会在草坪、街道与花园各处留下熔蜡。这些蜡如同种子，能够长出新的烛螳草。
author: dodoowner_
source: When it may die soon, this Pokémon is seen melting wax all over lawns, streets, and gardens. They do this as their wax acts as seeds to grow new Litmantis.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身于刚失去亲友的悲伤者面前，既令人宽慰，又令人不安。有人相信它能引领迷途的灵魂，也有人担心它会把对方引向悲伤的深渊。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to appear to those grieving a recent loss, offering a comforting yet unsettling presence. Some believe the Pokémon guides lost souls, while others fear it leads them into the depths of their sorrow.

entry: POKENAME精通死灵法术，能随心操纵生与死的能量。据说，与它结为朋友就能获得永生。
author: KLGB76
source: POKENAME are highly skilled necromancers, capable of bending life and death energy to their will. It is said that befriending one can grant eternal life.

entry: POKENAME头中的幽灵烛火燃得炽烈，能照亮大片区域。它天生好战，会裹挟灼热的幽焰冲向敌人，将沿途战场点燃。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME burns with a fierce glow, a spectral candle in its head that can illuminate a wide area. Known for its fighting instincts, it charges at foes with blazing ghostly attacks, igniting the battlefield in its wake.

entry: 有人声称，在亲人离世的前一夜，曾见POKENAME出现在对方身旁。但这纯属迷信。
author: jpeggio
source: Some have claimed to have seen POKENAME appear to their loved ones the night before they passed. However, this is purely superstition.

entry: 它对将死之人有着可怕的执念，会跟踪迷路的登山客，冻结并吸收这些可怜受害者的灵魂。
author: tr3bles
source: This Pokémon has a grisly attraction to humans about to pass away. It stalks lost hikers to freeze and absorb the souls of its poor victims.

entry: 奇怪的是，它只吃烧焦的东西，常躲进烤箱，享用里面焦黑的食物残渣。
author: Rockageddon
source: Curiously this Pokémon only eats things that have already been burnt to a crisp. They will hide in ovens to feast on the burnt remains of food inside.

entry: 它会模仿眼前的倒影，诡异地重现周围事物。如此奇特的复制，连最善于观察的宝可梦也会弄糊涂。
author: .izik
source: It mirrors the reflections it sees, becoming an eerie mimic of its surroundings. This strange duplication often confuses even the most observant Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吞食恶人的灵魂，却放过心地纯洁的人。据说，看见它是厄运将至的征兆。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME consumes the spirits of evil people, sparing those who are pure of heart. Seeing one is said to be a sign of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME的毒液会让咬伤周围一片灼痛。自发现POKENAME以来，医生一直在寻找有效的抗毒血清。
author: JesterSqueak
source: POKENAME's venom can cause a burning sensation all over the bite area. Doctors have been looking into finding an antivenom since POKENAME's discovery.

entry: 夜里，它以柔和的火焰照亮归途，救助迷失的灵魂。温暖的光能安慰并保护遇见它的人。
author: .izik
source: At night, it saves lost souls, lighting their way home with a gentle flame. Its warmth offers comfort and protection to those it encounters.

entry: 它全身迸着电光，喷出烈焰时也会释放雷电。火与电交织，让它的攻击难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It sparks with lightning, discharging electrical bolts alongside bursts of flame. The combination of fire and electricity makes it an unpredictable opponent.

entry: 它吞食孔雀石，储存其中的矿物，为明亮的火焰供能。这些绿色石头似乎能增强火势，让火焰燃得格外炽烈。
author: .izik
source: It devours malachite, storing the minerals to fuel its glowing flame. The green stones seem to enhance its fire, making it burn with an unusual intensity.

entry: POKENAME是披着幽焰的凶猛斗士，对战斗的热爱让它不断以灼热的幽灵攻击迎敌。POKENAME的火焰十分明亮，足以照亮整间暗室。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a fierce fighter cloaked in spectral flames. Its intense love for battle drives it to unleash scorching ghostly attacks on its opponents. The flame of a POKENAME is bright enough to fully illuminate a dark room.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME潜伏在医院周围，而后往往就有人离世。
author: jpeggio
source: POKENAME are often seen lurking around hospitals. In many cases, this is followed with someone passing away.

entry: POKENAME是当地声名显赫的斗士，发誓族群有难时绝不缺席。能与它匹敌的对手寥寥无几。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is a brawler of great renown in its habitat. It vows to always be there for its tribe in times of need. Few can match the strength it has.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME专为那些逃过死劫、活得长久的国王收魂。许多故事都以与它的决斗收尾。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the reaper of long-lived kings who have otherwise cheated death. Duels with this Pokémon mark the end of many tales.

entry: 双爪虽由坚不可摧的玻璃构成，走路却始终无声。战斗结束后，POKENAME会安静下来，为落败对手的命运祈祷。
author: epping_forest
source: Despite the unbreakable glass of its paws, it always walks silently. After a battle is over, POKENAME will settle down and pray for the fate of its defeated opponents.

entry: 它散发酷热，靠得太近就会被灼伤，连金属也能在炽热的气场中熔化。因此，它是领地中危险的守卫。
author: .izik
source: It radiates intense heat, leaving burns on anything that comes too close. Even metal melts under its fiery aura, making it a dangerous guardian of its territory.

entry: 火焰像熔融的玻璃般晶亮，折映出迷人的光纹。这些闪光会将猎物引入致命的陷阱。
author: .izik
source: Its flames glisten like molten glass, reflecting light in mesmerizing patterns. This shimmering glow attracts prey into its deadly trap.

entry: 火焰带着辛辣的香气，随着每次跃动愈发浓烈。这种奇香能驱退敌人，却也对某些宝可梦有着奇特的吸引力。
author: .izik
source: Its flame burns with a spicy scent, which grows stronger with every flicker. This unusual aroma wards off enemies, though some Pokémon find it strangely enticing.

entry: 随着衰老，火焰有时会变得暗淡，像旧灯笼般微弱闪烁。虽然光芒渐弱，它仍不知疲倦地巡逻，守护荒废的遗迹。
author: .izik
source: Its flame sometimes burns dimly as it ages, flickering weakly like an old lantern. Despite its faint light, it patrols tirelessly, watching over abandoned ruins.

entry: 小村庄常靠它照亮夜间的街道，却也惧怕那不祥的光。它既能带来福祉，也会招来灾祸，因为一旦被激怒，就会变得危险。
author: .izik
source: Small villages often rely on it to light their streets at night, though they fear its ominous glow. Its presence is both a blessing and a curse, as it can become dangerous if provoked.

entry: POKENAME常在深海中结成小群，以光芒引来小型猎物，却也会招来捕食者。
author: JesterSqueak
source: POKENAME are known for schooling in small groups in the depths of the sea. They use their glowing ability to draw in small prey, but this also attracts predators.

entry: 它飞快掠过夜空，留下一路闪烁的光迹。这些光能扰乱猎物，让捕捉变得容易。
author: .izik
source: It flies swiftly through the night, leaving trails of flickering lights in its wake. These lights disorient prey, making it easier to capture them.

entry: 它住在山洞里，用微弱的紫焰照亮幽暗通道。少有生物敢接近，洞中因而一片诡异的寂静。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in mountain caves, where it illuminates the dark passages with dim violet flames. These caves stay eerily quiet, as few dare approach it.

entry: 传说，它的火焰能以寒意灼伤灵魂。有人说，若在酷热中忽感冰冷，多半就是POKENAME正在夺走你的灵魂。
author: tr3bles
source: Fables say this Pokémon's flame freeze-burns the spirit. Some say that if you feel a chilling sensation in the heat, that is most likely a POKENAME taking your soul.

entry: 雷暴中，它会乘着狂风飞行，每闪过一道雷电，光芒就更明亮。它在混乱中如鱼得水，以风暴的能量为食。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, it rides on violent winds, glowing brighter with every flash of lightning. It thrives in the chaos, feeding off the storm's energy.

entry: 它飘过夜空，以幽异的光照亮云层。许多人相信，它守护着旅人，引导他们穿越黑暗。
author: .izik
source: It drifts through night skies, illuminating the clouds with a haunting glow. Many believe it watches over travelers, guiding them through the dark.

entry: 它会在夜里突然现身，全速冲向落单的训练家。据说，一旦被它撞中，就会被拖入冥界。
author: Staghorn
source: It appears suddenly at night, charging lone Trainers at a full sprint. It is said that if it tackles you, you will be dragged into the netherworld.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常栖身于沉没的游轮残骸，会诅咒一切看见的船只。
author: .ssunday.
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in the remains of a sunken cruise ship. It is known to put curses on any boats it spots.

entry: 据说，POKENAME体内住着无数灵魂，分别系于内部不同的房间。窗中闪烁着幽光，仔细聆听，还能听见隐约的低语。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to be inhabited by countless spirits living inside its body, each tied to a different room inside its structure. Its windows flicker with ghostly lights, and faint whispers can be heard if you listen closely.

entry: 它潜入梦境，放出诡异的光，使睡梦中的人迷醉。被光照到的人，常会看见鲜明却不似人世的幻景。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon invades dreams, casting eerie lights that mesmerize sleepers. Those touched by its glow often experience vivid, otherworldly visions.

entry: 厚重的玻璃包裹全身，将内部火焰的亮光放大。玻璃甲壳折射出炫目的光纹，虽美丽，靠近却十分危险。
author: .izik
source: Its body is encased in thick glass, magnifying the glow of its inner flame. This glassy armor reflects light in dazzling patterns, making it both beautiful and dangerous to approach.

entry: 消防员敬重它扑灭大火的本领。据说，它的火焰会反向燃烧，吸收热量，而非向外散播。
author: .izik
source: Firefighters revere this Pokémon for its ability to extinguish dangerous blazes. Its flames are said to burn in reverse, absorbing heat instead of spreading it.

entry: POKENAME目光阴森，执意让落败的对手有尊严地死去。可每当POKENAME背着这份沉重的心事离开，受害者却总能莫名其妙地活下来。
author: epping_forest
source: Glaring an ominous stare, POKENAME is adamant about bringing a dignified death to its defeated opponents. However, after POKENAME leaves with that weight on its soul, the victim always survives, somehow.

entry: POKENAME喜欢扮刽子手，会捏出泥偶，再用斧头砍掉它们的头。可真要伤害谁时，它却会难过得哭起来。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME loves playing executioner. It creates dolls out of clay and decapitates them with its axe, but cries and gets sensitive when it really has to hurt someone.

entry: 它用天生的利刃剪枝、刮去树皮，让藏在树干下的猎物无处遁形。外表虽凶，性情却温和随意。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its natural blades to clip branches and scrape bark from tree trunks, exposing prey underneath. Despite its fearsome appearance, it has a gentle and easygoing temperament.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: 大舌贝咬住尾巴时，POKENAME会痛得乱甩。尾巴挥动的力道极大，能将电线杆干净利落地劈成两半。
author: Mistymagius
source: When the Shellder bites down on POKENAME's tail, it will thrash around in pain. Its swinging tail can swing with enough force to cleave a telephone pole cleanly in half.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是某个湮没于岁月的文明留下的最后遗存。它们游历世界，渴望找到哪怕一点同族历史的痕迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are thought to be the last remnants of a civilization lost to time. They wander across the world, longing to find even a trace of their kin's history.

entry: 人们推测，古代文明创造POKENAME是为了照顾病人。它能在体内制出蛋形药用胶囊，据说可对抗任何疾病。
author: sk372
source: It is assumed POKENAME were created by an ancient civilization to serve as caretakers for the sick. It creates egg-shaped medicinal capsules from within its body that are thought to combat any disease.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是古代文明创造的守护者，能变化形态，应对任何敌人。可漫长岁月，已让它的身体与变身能力一同衰退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was thought to be an ancient civilization's attempt at making guardians able to transform to face any attacker. The eons have degraded its physical form and transformation capabilities.

entry: 有人说，古代文明创造POKENAME是为了阻挡袭击者。它们被设计成只有察觉来袭的威胁才会攻击。
author: jaminmcready
source: Some say that ancient civilizations created POKENAME to stop raiders. They were designed to only attack if they saw an incoming threat.

entry: 据说，许多POKENAME已将体内的蛋孵育了一千年，却始终不见破壳的迹象。
author: Patch
source: It is said many POKENAME have been incubating the egg in their body for a thousand years. It has never shown any signs of hatching.

entry: 歌谣称它们是来自群星之外的远古遗物。它们总在搜集奇异的古物，再用只有自己明白的方式，将知识与礼物分享给人类。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Songs are sung that claim these Pokémon are ancient relics from beyond the stars. Always gathering a collection of odd artifacts, these Pokémon share their knowledge and gifts with people in ways known only to them.

entry: POKENAME身躯庞大，出招缓慢，但只要击中，便有毁灭性的威力。据传，眼前的宝可梦只是一副铠甲，真正的POKENAME被锁在里面。
author: princess_lucina
source: Its large size renders POKENAME slow to attack, but it will hit with devastating strength if it can land a blow. It's rumored that the Pokémon is just a suit of armor, and the real POKENAME is locked away inside.

entry: POKENAME住在山中，会救助迷路的登山者。古时，人们还会比赛，看谁的POKENAME能最快登上月见山。
author: maximus10k
source: POKENAME lives up in the mountains and will help people who get lost when climbing. In older times, people would race to see whose POKENAME could climb Mt. Moon the fastest.

entry: POKENAME造型精巧，常被当作收藏品。可它煮茶的本领实在辜负了许多富人的期待：水刚倒进去就会蒸发，尝试的人还常被烫伤。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME is regarded as a collectible because of its intricate design. In spite of many rich humans' hopes this Pokémon is horrible at boiling tea. Those who try often suffer burns, as the water immediately evaporates upon being poured into it.

entry: 翅膀上的符文让POKENAME沉重的身体浮起。为了保护脆弱的核心，它们尽量避免战斗。
author: ohok3441
source: The runes on POKENAME's wings help their heavy body levitate. They avoid battling to protect their vulnerable core.

entry: POKENAME是仿照神话中的昆虫雕塑而成的古代机关。胸腔结构不稳，它艰难地压制着其中潜藏的沙之力。
author: NellNast42
source: An ancient automaton sculpted after a mythical insect, POKENAME struggles to contain the power of sand concealed inside its unstable chest cavity.

entry: POKENAME身上连着的轮子为何总在转动，如何保持转动，生物学家也摸不着头脑。试着让它认识齿轮儿一系，结果只会让可怜的钢属性宝可梦挨上一记旋转着打来的爆裂拳，正中面门。
author: sivanandi
source: Biologists are stumped about how and why the wheel POKENAME is attached to is constantly spinning. Attempts to introduce it to the Klink line have resulted in the poor Steel-types receiving a whirling Dynamic Punch to the face.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME或许完整记得自己出身的失落文明。即便如此，至今也没有一只愿意说出那些古老历史的秘密。
author: sk372
source: It is thought that POKENAME may possess perfect memory of the lost civilization it supposedly originated from. If so, none so far have chosen to communicate the secrets of these ancient histories.

entry: POKENAME好奇心旺盛，常用火焰吐息帮训练家点起篝火。火烧起来后，它便啁啾鸣唱，曲调应和着火光的跃动与噼啪声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are a curious sort, often helping Trainers ignite campfires with their flame breath. Once lit, it will chirp and sing a tune that matches the crackle and flicker of the fire.

entry: POKENAME平时害羞易惊，但若被逼入绝境，就会从三条尾巴的尖端甩出滚烫的火星，灼伤来敌，趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: Generally shy and skittish, if backed into a corner, POKENAME will fling hot sparks from the tips of its three tails in defense, singeing its would-be attacker before escaping.

entry: 蓬松的尾巴不断变出复杂的图案，宛如古奥的符号。据说，它用火焰编成谜语交流，透露过去的片段。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its fluffy tail constantly shifts into intricate patterns, resembling arcane symbols. It is said to communicate in riddles of fire, revealing fragments of the past.

entry: POKENAME的六条尾巴各有意识，大多数时候却相处融洽。受到攻击时，尾巴会朝四面八方喷出灼热的火星。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's six tails all have a mind of their own, but they all get along most of the time. When attacked, the tails spew hot embers in every direction.

entry: 只有最老练的训练家才能教好POKENAME。它脾气火爆至极，但若能驯服，就会成为忠诚的伙伴。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: Only the most skilled Trainers can properly train POKENAME. It has an incredibly fiery temper, but if one manages to tame it they are rewarded with a loyal companion.

entry: 它不断锻炼，以更好地掌控火焰与体力。经过修行，已经开始掌握以燃烧的拳脚出招的技艺。
author: sk372
source: It trains both to better control its fire powers and its physical strength.  Through this training it has begun to master the art of striking with flaming fists and feet.

entry: 它十分寂寞，会用鬼火引来孩子。只要有人靠近，愿意拿它当玩具，它就很开心。
author: lemage22
source: This lonely Pokémon creates will-o'-wisps to lure children to its side. It delights in being a plaything for any who approach.

entry: 融合赋予POKENAME惊人的潜力。火焰极其炽热，长时间接触，甚至会令人产生幻觉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has been endowed with amazing potential through fusion. Its fire is so hot, it causes hallucinations through prolonged exposure.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴不断放热，温度若过高，连自身的毛也会烧掉。POKENAME个头虽小，跑起来却相当快。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's tails give off heat. If the heat grows too strong, even their fur can be burned off. POKENAME is rather fast for its small size.

entry: 尖锐的毒针其实是消化道里钙化的废物。由于形成时混入胃酸，这些刺带有很强的毒性。
author: Frokachu
source: Its sharp stingers are actually calcified waste that formed from its digestive tract. Due to the stomach acids that make them, the stingers are quite poisonous.

entry: POKENAME本来并没有手臂或钳子。看似这些部位的东西，其实是塑成手臂形状的内脏。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME doesn't normally have arms or pincers. Instead, what appears to be them are actually its internal organs that are being shaped as arms.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME会从后部排出内脏。它们总能送出很棒的礼物，可谁也不知道礼物究竟从哪儿来。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME ejects its innards out of its rear for some strange reason. They always give great gifts, but no one knows where they come from.

entry: POKENAME用内脏抓取野生树果与食物，也会将吃过的食物反吐出来，再吃一次。
author: floweronbread
source: POKENAME uses its internal organs to grab wild Berries and food, as well as to regurgitate the eaten food to eat once more.

entry: 它在洞穴和地下河里寻找各种闪亮物件，带回巢穴珍藏。为守住宝物不惜一切，甚至会将内脏喷到企图行窃的人身上。
author: bobosmith01
source: It finds all manner of shiny objects in caves and subterranean rivers and brings it back to its nest. It will do anything to protect its hoard of treasure, including ejecting its internal organs onto would-be thieves.

entry: POKENAME扭动蛇般的身体穿行天空，顽皮地挥着双臂。它能释放强大的能量冲击，也会用巨臂近身攻击。平时藏在云中，伺机吞食飞过的猎物。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME wiggles through the sky with its serpentine body, flailing its arms playfully. It unleashes powerful energy blasts while using its giant arms for upclose attacks. It hides amongst clouds, preparing to devour flying prey.

entry: 头部由一组强劲的肌肉构成，能将内脏猛力弹出。它甚至无需挪动身体，就能击落体型比自己大数倍的大嘴雀。
author: Staghorn
source: Its head is a battery of powerful muscles designed to eject its inner organs with great force. It's capable of bringing down a Fearow many times its size without moving its body.

entry: 手臂受损后，一小时内就能重新长好。尖刺中的毒性虽轻，却会引起恶心与剧烈头痛。
author: Mistymagius
source: If its arms get damaged, it can regrow them within the hour. Its thorns contain a mildly toxic poison that is known to cause nausea and severe headaches.

entry: POKENAME喜欢热带海滨的细沙。柔软的身体能巧妙藏入罕见的黑沙滩，只有需要时才伸出铲子般的器官。
author: entomoxie
