source: POKENAME prefer fine sand right on the edge of tropical seas. Their soft bodies can blend in quite sneakily in rare black sand beaches, only having their shovel-like organs poke out when needed.

entry: POKENAME喜欢热带海滨的细沙。柔软的身体能巧妙藏入罕见的黑沙滩，只有需要时才伸出铲子般的器官。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME prefer fine sand right on the edge of tropical seas. Their soft bodies can blend in quite sneakily in rare black sand beaches, only having their shovel-like organs poke out when needed.

entry: 背上的蘑菇可以像武器般射出再收回，始终由POKENAME绳索般的内脏连着本体。
author: bee4082
source: The mushrooms on this Pokémon's back can be shot out and retracted like weapons, remaining attached to the main body via POKENAME's ropelike internal organs.

entry: POKENAME好斗爱挑衅，行动却太慢，敌人一退走就追不上。挨打时，它会靠出奇柔韧的身体反弹攻击。
author: Katie
source: A belligerent Pokémon prone to picking fights, POKENAME move too slowly to chase down opponents that disengage. When struck, they rebound blows with their surprisingly pliable bodies.

entry: POKENAME能用炮口以超过每秒160英尺的速度射出内脏。器官弹性极强，因此完全不会受伤。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME can eject its internal organs from its cannons at upwards of 160 feet per second. Its organs are so elastic that this does not hurt it whatsoever.

entry: POKENAME用钥匙碰触锁头，就能神奇地开启或封死，因此常被狱警聘用。狱警若放话要永远扔掉钥匙，那多半是有一只POKENAME在旁待命。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are staffed by prison wardens due to their mystical ability to release or seal any lock they touch with their keys. If a warden ever threatens to throw away the key, it is because they have a POKENAME on standby.

entry: 迷信认为，POKENAME角上的钥匙能打开一扇通向世界末日的门。多数人虽觉得荒唐，这些钥匙的来历与用途却依然是谜。
author: sivanandi
source: Superstitions say that the keys on the horn of POKENAME open a door that will cause the end of the world. While most agree that this is nonsense, the origin or purpose of these keys remains a mystery.

entry: 与它伪装的宝可梦不同，POKENAME毫不挑剔，什么钥匙都收集。但若把钥匙插进它的布衣，就会惹得它勃然大怒。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Unlike the Pokémon it's disguised as, POKENAME lacks discernment and collects any and all keys. Inserting a key into into its cloth angers it greatly.

entry: 它是珍贵钥匙的完美守卫，前提是你不想再拿回来！卡洛斯一则鲜为人知的童话里，英雄曾骗一只粗暴的POKENAME，让它看守解开自身枷锁的钥匙。
author: Wormspawn
source: The perfect protector for precious keys - as long as you don't want them back! An obscure Kalosian fairy tale tells of a hero who tricked a brutish POKENAME into guarding the key to its own shackles.

entry: POKENAME开锁技艺高超，无论锁匠还是小偷都珍视这位伙伴。只有找到更喜欢的钥匙，它才肯放下原来的最爱。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are skilled lockpicks, and are thus valued partner Pokémon of locksmiths and thieves, alike. It only lets go of its favorite key if it finds one it likes more.

entry: POKENAME主要吃各种金属合金，常漂在废品场里寻找最爱的点心——钥匙。
author: Ayner
source: The diet of POKENAME is primarily composed of diverse metal alloys. They roam around junkyards, floating in search of keys, their favorite snack.

entry: POKENAME爱收集稀奇的钥匙，也会将能开启的锁头据为己有。锁一旦换掉，它就会毫不留情地将其摧毁。
author: A-z
source: POKENAME love collecting unusual keys and become possessive of the locks they open. If a lock is changed, they destroy it with extreme prejudice.

entry: POKENAME啃咬废金属做成钥匙，潜入保护区或餐馆偷鱼吃。制作前会将触手探入锁孔，摸清所需的准确形状。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw at scrap metal, creating keys that help them infiltrate reserves or restaurants to steal fish for their next meal. They slip their tentacles into locks to determine the exact shapes the keys need to be.

entry: POKENAME无私勇敢，常在大都市中帮助别人。民间传说，它收集的钥匙都是受助者赠予的，寓意着“成功的钥匙”。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very altruistic and heroic, frequently doing favors for people in metropolitan areas. Folktales suggest that the keys they gather were given to them by people they've helped in the past, claiming them to be the key to their success.

entry: 它保管钥匙的本领极高，尤其喜欢大钥匙。若有人擅自拿走，POKENAME就会试着将对方打上平流层。
author: thereversedguy
source: Incredibly efficient at keeping keys, though prefers big ones. If someone attempts to take one without permission, POKENAME will attempt to strike them into the stratosphere.

entry: 比爱偷钥匙的钥圈儿更烦人的，只有狡猾的POKENAME。它一进屋，散放在外的钥匙就会立刻被磁力吸到身上。
author: sporkwizard
source: The only thing more annoying than a key-stealing Klefki is a crafty POKENAME. When it enters a room, any keys sitting out are instantly magnetized to it.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME是死去植物的灵魂。阴森的破布下，腐烂的根仍在挪动。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the spirit of a dead plant. Rotten roots shift just beneath its ghostly rag.

entry: POKENAME紧抓着枯死的花，借此随风漂游。一旦松手，就会变回毫无生命的毛绒玩具。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME holds onto its dead flower, which allows it to drift in the wind. If it were to let go, it would become a lifeless stuffed toy.

entry: POKENAME在夜间漂浮，把羽毛般轻盈的填充物当作帆。其中含有玻璃纤维，吸入十分危险。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME floats around at night, using its feather-light stuffing like a sail. The stuffing includes fiberglass, so is dangerous to inhale.

entry: 它极其珍惜身体的填充物，讨厌任何东西碰触。企图偷取填充物的偷猎者会被诅咒，余生全身瘙痒不止。
author: typhloquil
source: It is very protective of its stuffing and hates when anything touches it. Poachers who try to steal its stuffing will be cursed to have an itchy sensation over their body for the rest of their life.

entry: 据说，它紧抱的木偶能用死者的声音说话。胆敢窥看破布下面的人，则会听到自己惊恐的声音不断回响。
author: amiel997
source: The wooden figure it clutches is rumored to speak with the voices of the dead. Those who dare look under its rag are said to hear their own terrified voices echoing back.

entry: 它很想和别人玩，却总把人和宝可梦吓跑。若遇见POKENAME，最好友善地理理它。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It loves to play with others, but often scares people and Pokémon away. If spotted, it is recommended to give a POKENAME positive attention.

entry: POKENAME将本体藏成尾巴，收集各种派对用品，把自己装扮成喜气洋洋的信使鸟。若碰它的“袋子”，就会遭到攻击。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME hides itself as the tail while it gathers assorted party supplies to appear as a festive Delibird. It will attack if you touch its "bag".

entry: 它会跑向狗和犬形宝可梦，盼着加入它们的游戏，却常遭拒绝。夜里，能听见它悲伤的哀号。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It runs up to dogs and dog-like Pokémon, wanting to play amongst them, but is often rejected. It can be heard wailing sadly at night.

entry: 即使风平气静，它也像乘着微风般飞行。若其他风筝的线碰上它的线，那只风筝就再也飞不起来了。
author: Staghorn
source: It flies as if blown by a breeze, even when the air is still. If another kite's string touches its string, that kite will never fly again.

entry: 它看起来像在飞，其实本体躲在地下，用线牵着诱饵。只要有东西拉扯诱饵，它就会将猎物收回来！
author: Shocktopus1717
source: This Pokémon may appear to fly, but in reality, it hides underground, holding a decoy by a string. When something tugs on the decoy, it reels its prey in!

entry: POKENAME借一辆生锈的叉车模仿象牙猪的模样。虽然驾驶起来相当熟练，可它并没有叉车操作证。
author: SandGuyThing
source: POKENAME uses a rusty forklift to mimic the shape of a Mamoswine. Though it shows a clear proficiency in handling it, it is not forklift certified.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME视为危险的亡灵。破斗篷留着惨烈冲突的痕迹，阴森的外表还会增强它的超能力，让它制造幻象，驱退威胁、保护同伴。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: Regarded as a dangerous spirit by many, POKENAME wears a tattered cloak that shows signs of a violent encounter. Its haunting appearance enhances its psychic abilities, enabling it to create illusions that ward off threats and protect its allies.

entry: POKENAME只想得到喜爱。人们害怕它是灾祸的预兆而伤害它，于是它用碎布缝成衣服，遮住那些伤口。
author: Wormspawn and sk372
source: POKENAME just wants to be loved. It creates a costume out of fabric scraps to cover the injuries it has received by those who fear it as a harbinger of disaster.

entry: 若有鬼影请你吃果冻，千万别接受。一旦吃下，POKENAME就会诅咒你，让你也变成一盘果冻。
author: Tad
source: If a ghostly figure offers you jello, do not accept. Should you partake, the POKENAME will curse you to become a jello mold yourself.

entry: POKENAME是在旧宅中被训练家遗弃后形成的。满怀怨恨的POKENAME会追杀一切酷似皮卡丘的生物，吸走灵魂，只留下躯壳。
author: KLGB76
source: POKENAME are formed after being abandoned by Trainers in old mansions. Filled with spite and hatred, POKENAME will chase down any living being resembling a Pikachu to absorb its spirit, leaving only a body behind.

entry: POKENAME捡来失事飞机的残片，想在不吓到别人的情况下飞行。可残片拼得实在太糟，根本难以久留空中。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the scraps of wrecked planes in an attempt to fly without scaring anyone. However, it struggles to stay in the air long due to how terribly the pieces were put together.

entry: POKENAME将枯树连根拔起，用来拦河筑坝。只要听见流水声，就会发出骇人的尖啸。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME rips dead trees from their roots to dam rivers with. When it hears running water, it lets out a ghastly screech.

entry: POKENAME用家中的日用品维持伪装，拼命补好每一处破洞与裂口，免得本体露出来。
author: giggity._.
source: POKENAME uses household products to maintain its disguise, desperately trying to patch any holes or tears to keep its true body hidden.

entry: POKENAME收集黄铁矿裹住身体，希望更讨训练家喜欢。不识货的训练家却会当成黄金，特地来找它。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME hoards pyrite to cover itself in order to make itself more appealing to Trainers. Any uneducated Trainers seek them out for gold.

entry: POKENAME用毒气成批熏死昆虫与虫属性宝可梦，再将其吞食。若揭掉它的破布，可能当场丧命。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME feeds by smoking insects and Bug-type Pokémon with its poisonous gas en masse. Removing its rag can be instantly fatal.

entry: 谜拟Ｑ若吞食地鼠的尸体，就会与之融合，变成POKENAME。随后潜入地鼠群，逐个捕食。
author: TeatedTiten
source: A Mimikyu that feasts on a Diglett carcass will merge with it and become a POKENAME.  It then sneaks into labours of Diglett to pick them off one by one.

entry: 看到训练家喜爱软乎乎的毛绒玩具，POKENAME便尽量收集柔软的碎料，把自己塞得软绵绵，好让人拥抱。虽然性情亲人，它们也有武器，受到攻击时会自卫。
author: moopse
source: Inspired by Trainers' love for squishy plushies, POKENAME has gathered as much soft scrap material as possible to make itself extremely squishy and huggable. Despite their loving nature, they are armed and will defend themselves when attacked.

entry: 它用邪恶的气场探知世间的普遍真理。无论问什么，它都知道答案，却偏不如实回答，只会选出最能给世界招来混乱的答复。
author: xxrizahawkeyefanxx
source: It has an evil aura which it uses to find universal truths of the world. If you ask it a question it will always know the answer, but instead of answering truthfully, it will give you the answer that will cause the most chaos in the world.

entry: POKENAME背上的冠脊能分开，化作两片巨翼。加上出色的游泳与奔跑本领，让它无论身处何种地形都强悍无比。
author: Patch
source: The dorsal crest on POKENAME's back can split into two massive wings. This, paired with its excellent swimming and running abilities, makes it a terrain-based powerhouse.

entry: POKENAME厚重的铠甲积住体热，再由翅膀向外散发。POKENAME周围的气温约有150度。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick armor traps its own body heat, which it then disperses through its wings. The ambient air temperature around POKENAME is about 150 degrees.

entry: 火神蛾的双翼化成了坚硬的尖刺，材质与赫拉克罗斯的甲壳相同。POKENAME必要时仍能飞行，却更喜欢用坚硬的角威慑敌人。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: Volcarona's wings have now turned into tough spikes made of the same material as Heracross's shell. POKENAME can still fly when needed but prefers to use its tough horn to deter enemies.

entry: 传说，一只POKENAME曾用随身的岩浆石，为探险者保暖。展开双翼时，模样宛如节庆装饰的星星。
author: pankiwi
source: Legends tell of a POKENAME that kept some explorers warm with the magma rocks it carries. When their wings spread out, it resembles a festive star.

entry: POKENAME战力惊人，乐趣却据说在于农耕。它游历寒冷地区，借身体的特殊鳞片制造一颗颗小太阳，让作物得以生长，帮助当地人照看庄稼。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: POKENAME is a devastating combatant, however its joy is said to lie with agriculture. It roams colder regions and helps the people by maintaining the crops with special scales on its body, providing the crops with little pseudo-suns to grow under.

entry: 三千年前，POKENAME在一座神殿中被发现，随后被尊为迷途探险者的灵媒。研究表明，它将他们的灵魂存入手持的火球，那个火球也被称为第二个太阳。
author: red.89
source: When POKENAME was found in a temple three thousand years ago, it was revered as a medium for lost explorers. Research suggests it stored their souls in the fiery orb it wields, described as a second sun.

entry: 古碑记载，起初天地只是一片寒冷荒凉的雏形。直到POKENAME振翅撒鳞，将火焰与热的概念带往世界各处，生命才随之而来。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: It is said in ancient tablets that existence was nothing more than a cold and desolate template until POKENAME flapped its wings and scattered its scales, bringing flame and the concept of heat to all corners of the world, and with it, life.

entry: 神话称，它降临我们的现实之时，双翼的光芒会亮到无论身处何方都能看见。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: Myths say that when this Pokémon lowers itself into our reality, its wings will be bright enough to be seen from every point in existence.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，体内闷燃着惊人的高热。不戴合适的手套就碰它，可能会严重烫伤。
author: bee4082
source: Unbelievable heat smolders within POKENAME's body while it waits for evolution. Touching one without suitable gloves could result in a nasty burn.

entry: POKENAME沿途留下微光闪烁的火星，夜里很容易循迹找到。森林大火后，能看见它大口吞食灰烬。
author: bee4082
source: One can easily track a POKENAME in the night by the trail of glimmering embers it leaves behind as it travels. It can be seen feasting on ashes after forest fires.

entry: POKENAME分泌的酸会与空气中的氧气反应，变得滚烫。
author: .realthree
source: The acid that POKENAME can secrete undergoes a chemical reaction with the oxygen in the air and becomes scorching hot.

entry: POKENAME太重，翅膀无法支撑长时间飞行，却也并非毫无用处。振动时会撒出黏性鳞片，严重灼伤敌人。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME is too heavy to be carried by its wings for long periods, but they're not entirely useless. When flapped, they spread sticky scales that inflict severe burns on this Pokémon's enemies.

entry: 有人说，它体内的热量足以熔化整个星球。它用超能力压制这股压倒性的力量。
author: cheroace
source: It contains an amount of heat that is said by some to be able to melt entire planets. It keeps its overwhelming power in check using psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME紧闭柔软的壳时，周围空气会变得酷寒。待到壳完全张开，又会释放高热，喷出灼人的鳞片云。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: When POKENAME clamp their soft shells shut, the surrounding air grows brutally cold. When they open themselves fully, a searing heat is released with a cloud of scorching scales.

entry: 出水后，鳞片晶莹闪亮，反射耀眼的光。灿烂的模样常将伙伴与敌人都吸引过来。
author: .izik
source: After emerging from water, its scales glisten brightly, reflecting light with dazzling intensity. This radiant appearance often attracts both allies and foes.

entry: 发现合心意的水晶，它便会欢喜起舞。旁观者常弄不明白，它为何如此兴奋。
author: .izik
source: When it finds a crystal that catches its eye, it dances in delight. These joyful displays often leave others puzzled by its enthusiasm.

entry: 它精于控制悬浮，轻松避开钟乳石。动作精准又敏捷，是地下难缠的强敌。
author: .izik
source: With exceptional control over levitation, it dodges stalactites with ease. Its precision and agility make it a formidable opponent underground.

entry: 它从口中射出高度凝聚的能量球，威吓并压倒敌人。强劲的攻击落到哪里，哪里就会留下深坑。
author: .izik
source: It fires concentrated balls of energy from its mouth, using them to intimidate and overwhelm foes. This powerful attack leaves deep craters wherever it strikes.

entry: 由于看不见，只要听见不认识的声音，它就会咬过去。想不惊动它便靠近，十分困难。
author: .izik
source: Since it cannot see, it bites anything it doesn't recognize the sound of. This habit makes it a challenge to approach without alerting it.

entry: 它伴着雷声咆哮，仿佛要与风暴的狂怒较量。这种举动让它觉得，自己与自然元素的狂野力量相连。
author: .izik
source: It roars in sync with thunder, as if trying to compete with the storm's fury. This behavior makes it feel connected to the wild power of the elements.

entry: POKENAME双目失明，难以控制自己的火焰。若无人照看，可能意外烧毁整座房屋。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME are blind, making it difficult for them to control their flames. They have been known to accidentally burn down entire homes when left unattended.

entry: 它喜欢沐浴月光，让柔和的光安抚躁动的能量。每夜如此，心情与活力似乎都更好了。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys basking in moonlight, soaking in the gentle glow to calm its restless energy. These nightly rituals seem to enhance its mood and vitality.

entry: 它仔细观察对手的动作，等到最适合的时机才出手。周密的策略让它精于突袭。
author: .izik
source: It carefully studies the movements of its opponents, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. This calculated strategy makes it a master of surprise attacks.

entry: 飞行时，它会在空气中留下一丝木炭味。这道烟熏气息标记着它的行进路线，即使它离去许久，也不会散去。
author: .izik
source: While flying, it leaves behind a faint scent of charcoal in the air. This smoky trail marks its path, lingering long after it has gone.

entry: 它留下的黏液带着油一般的气味。这股怪味既让其他宝可梦退避，又令它们好奇。
author: .izik
source: The slime it leaves behind carries a scent similar to oil. This peculiar smell both repels and intrigues other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛、骨骼与味觉，耐痛力也异乎寻常，即使从极高处跌落，也不会留下长期的伤害。这个阶段，它的智力几乎没有发展的余地。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME lacks eyes, bones, sense of taste and has an abnormal pain tolerance, so it can fall from incredible heights without suffering any long-term damage. Its intelligence has almost no margin to develop during this stage.

entry: POKENAME的胃几乎什么都能消化，实在消化不了，吐出来就是。掉落的毛发摸着像金属切屑，却没有磁性。
author: epping_forest
source: Its stomach can digest almost anything, and when it doesn't, POKENAME simply spits it out. The trace of hair it leaves behind feels to the touch like metal swarf, though it's not magnetic.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠爪子触探周围来辨认方向。它会将鬃毛轻轻蹭在人身上，表达喜爱。
author: 1bridgeyboo
source: POKENAME is blind and navigates by feeling its surroundings with its claws. It shows affection by softly rubbing its mane against people.

entry: 它喜欢住在覆满灰烬或煤灰的地方，轻易就能融入环境。这样的住处既便于隐藏，也让它感到舒适。
author: .izik
source: It prefers living in areas coated with ash or soot, blending effortlessly into its surroundings. This environment provides both camouflage and comfort.

entry: 即使埋在地下，它也能极其准确地嗅出食物。视力虽差，敏锐的嗅觉仍让它成为优秀的猎手。
author: .izik
source: Even while buried underground, it can sniff out food with remarkable accuracy. This keen sense of smell makes it a successful hunter despite its poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME的几个头虽然凶猛，却都是尽责的父母，对幼崽关怀备至。它们的孩子脾气暴躁，够得着什么就扑咬什么。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite their ferocious nature, POKENAME's heads are very supportive parents and treat their offspring with the utmost care. Their offspring are temperamental and will maul anything they can reach.

entry: 长长的脖子与头部的位置，让POKENAME在空中难以保持平衡。除了用头攻击，也能用利爪与尾巴施加轻微的毒素。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have trouble balancing in the air due to the length of their necks and the placement of their heads. In addition to attacking with the heads, they can use their sharp claws and tail to deliver a mild toxin.

entry: POKENAME能深入地下，比铁更坚韧的毛发为身体提供保护。两个头能吃下地下的大多数矿物，却各有不同的口味。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can burrow deep into the ground, kept safe by their fur being tougher than iron. The two heads can eat most minerals found underground, though each head has distinct mineral preferences.

entry: POKENAME的两个头虽然常争吵，只要喂上新鲜蜂蜜，就会变得平和好商量。前提是分开两份，还得一样多。
author: bobosmith01
source: While the two heads of POKENAME have been known to argue, they both become placid and agreeable once given a helping of fresh honey - provided that each have separate and equal amounts, that is.

entry: POKENAME飞行技艺高超，一个头观察四周，另一个头搜捕下方的猎物。可若飞到一半意见不合，路程就会颠簸起来。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are experts in flight, as one head observes surroundings while the other hunts prey below. However, their flight can get rough whenever the heads disagree mid-flight.

entry: 即使长着两颗头，POKENAME也难以驾驭吸收的庞大灵力。两颗头各与古代文明中不同的亡魂交谈，唯有一个强大的灵魂，能被双方同时感知，让它们短暂专注于同一件事。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME struggles to control the immense spiritual energy it absorbs, even with two heads. Each communicates with different ghosts from an ancient civilization, but only one powerful spirit is perceptible to both heads, uniting their focus briefly.

entry: 壳小得勉强只能容下一个头，所以POKENAME总把两个头都伸在外面。只要其中一个想缩进去，另一个就会又怒又妒，出手攻击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have both heads out constantly because the shell is just barely big enough to fit a single head inside. Whenever one head tries to withdraw into the shell, the other head lashes out in anger and jealousy.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，两个头的獠牙常会互相勾住，难受至极。POKENAME通常不得不折断自己的獠牙，才不至于一直卡着。
author: Mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME's two heads often get their tusks interlocked, causing them severe discomfort. POKENAME will usually have to break their own tusks to make sure they don't get stuck.

entry: POKENAME喜欢暗洞，在那里可以依靠回声定位，不必勉强使用不佳的视力。可两个头常互相干扰，反被自己的回声定位弄得晕头转向。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME enjoy dark caves, where they can rely on echolocation and not their limited eyesight. However, the heads often conflict and thus get confused by their own echolocation.

entry: 两个头看似一样，其实聪明且占主导的那个控制身体，较笨的那个只顾着吃。它们总是打架，唯独发现有人看着时会停手。
author: epping_forest
source: Though the heads seem indistinguishable, the intelligent dominant one controls the body, while the dumber one is only concerned with eating. They always fight with each other, except when they know they're being watched.

entry: POKENAME用两个头攻击、扰乱对手，但有时配合不好，反会互相打起来。它飞不高，却能滑翔后从上方猛砸敌人。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can use both heads in battle to attack and disorient opponents, though the heads are sometimes uncoordinated and fight each other. While they cannot fly at great heights, they can glide before slamming opponents from above.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在森林的阴影里，布下种种陷阱，将猎物骗进蛛网。它常用尾巴迷惑对方，让自己显得比实际更小。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of forests, making various traps to trick and catch prey in its webs. It often uses its tail to make others think that it is smaller than it actually is.

entry: POKENAME聚集雷云，汇聚三条暗黑巨龙的能量。许多训练家慑于它的优雅，作诗致敬。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gathers storm clouds, channeling the energy of three dark dragons. In awe of its grace, many Trainers write poems in tribute to it.

entry: POKENAME臂上的头没有大脑，只负责吃与咬。有时，POKENAME会像腹语表演者一样，借它们“说话”，将内心的想法讲出来。
author: epping_forest
source: The heads on POKENAME's arms don't have brains, for their only function is eating and biting. Sometimes, POKENAME "talks" with them like a ventriloquist, making them represent its inner thoughts spoken out loud.

entry: POKENAME耳尖上的头颚力极强，能咬碎岩石。它自视甚高，常将石头雕成供自己坐的小王座。
author: JesterSqueak
source: The heads on the tips of POKENAME's ears have strong, powerful jaws that are strong enough to break rock. Due to POKENAME's ego, it normally carves stones into small thrones for itself.

entry: 野生POKENAME还得喂饱额外两张贪食的嘴，总难找到足够的食物。它与另外两个头关系不佳，常得挥手将它们拨开。能让它吃饱、又愿意愉快陪伴的训练家，会得到它的珍爱。
author: epping_forest
source: With two ravenous extra mouths to feed, wild POKENAME struggles finding enough food. It doesn't have a good relationship with the extra heads, which it often has to swat away. It cherishes a Trainer who keeps it well fed and in pleasant company.

entry: POKENAME浮行于地面上方，触须向下伸展，摧毁并吞食下方的一切。因此，人们曾以为它是恶灵附身的雷云。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME float across the ground, their tendrils reaching down to destroy and consume anything below them. For this reason, they were once believed to be storm clouds given spirits of malice.

entry: POKENAME只有要在建筑物上磨牙时才会降落。传说，曾有一只想飞上去吞掉月亮。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME only descends to sharpen its teeth on buildings. Legend says that one attempted to fly up to and eat the moon.

entry: POKENAME的身体强壮得可怕，能将威胁自己的对象紧紧缠住。不过，它更愿意温柔地拥抱心怀善意的人。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME have frighteningly strong bodies, which they can use to constrict any that threaten them. Despite this, they prefer to gently embrace those with positive emotions.

entry: 翅膀虽小得无法飞行，POKENAME仍能凭超能力欢快地翱翔天际。它在隐秘的湖泊与潟湖附近筑巢。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its wings being too small for flight, POKENAME joyfully soars across the sky using its psychic powers. It makes its nests near hidden lakes and lagoons.

entry: 据说，骑着POKENAME就像浮在云朵上。它常用蓬松的身体轻推训练家，邀请对方一起展开天空冒险。
author: Rakunk
source: Riding with POKENAME is said to feel like floating on a cloud. It often nudges Trainers with its fluffy body, inviting them to join it on an adventure through the skies.

entry: POKENAME贪玩随和。近来，还有以它的模样为灵感的服饰风潮。
author: zic
source: POKENAME has a playful and easygoing temperament. There have been recent clothing trends that are inspired by its appearance.

entry: POKENAME不爱战斗，会从蘑菇中喷出能量，借推进力飞向空中，逃离敌人。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME dislikes fighting, so it expels energy from its mushrooms to jet through the air and escape from its enemies.

entry: POKENAME栖息在地下的湖泊与河流中。它生成的珍珠稀有美丽，十分珍贵。
author: octolinggrimm
source: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes and rivers. The pearls that it forms are highly valued for their rarity and beauty.

entry: POKENAME栖息在地下的湖泊与河流中。它生成的珍珠稀有美丽，十分珍贵。
author: octolinggrimm
source: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes and rivers. The pearls that it forms are highly valued for their rarity and beauty.

entry: 每条飘逸的尾巴上都有繁复的文字，发着微光，据说藏有时间与命运的秘密。与它相遇后，训练家常会见到鲜明却不似人世的幻景。
author: jaminmcready
source: Each of its flowing tails bears an intricate script that glows faintly, thought to hold the secrets of time and destiny. Encounters with this Pokémon often leave Trainers with vivid, otherworldly visions.

entry: 传说POKENAME心口附近藏着9根幸运羽毛，能赐训练家长寿。要获得这些羽毛，据说必须成为POKENAME最好的朋友。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: Legends says that POKENAME has 9 lucky feathers hidden close to its heart that bless trainers with a long life. It is believed that to be granted those feathers, the trainer needs to be the POKENAME's best friend.

entry: 抓住POKENAME形似闪电的尾巴，会遭到100,000伏电流的轰击，失去行动能力。醒来后，你会发现自己中了诅咒，成了一根人形避雷针。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Grabbing one of POKENAME's lightning bolt shaped tails will result in you getting blasted by 100,000 volts of electricity and becoming incapacitated. Once you awake, you will find that you have been cursed to become a human lightning rod.

entry: 若地面出现九颗发光的星，就是POKENAME在引你走向安全处。古人曾祈求它庇护，相信它能抵御阿勃梭鲁带来的灾难。
author: TeatedTiten
source: If nine glowing stars appear on the ground, it is POKENAME guiding you to safety. Long ago, people prayed to it for protection, believing it could ward off disasters brought by Absol.

entry: POKENAME常现身于热气蒸腾的温泉附近，藏在水汽之中。喷出火焰时，彩色的鳞片会变得更加鲜艳。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be seen near active hot springs, concealing itself amongst the steam. As it spews flames, its colorful scales become even more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME天性残忍，常先玩弄对手，再将其烧尽。古老传说称，它们背负着99个怨灵的仇恨。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are cruel-natured, with a tendency to toy with their opponents before incinerating them. Old legends say they bear the hatred of 99 vengeful spirits.

entry: 科学家猜想，梦幻与代欧奇希斯独特的遗传物质，或许能帮助人们突破对外星生命起源的研究。他们希望通过深入研究POKENAME，在首次接触其他世界的生命方面取得重大进展。
author: sk372
source: Scientists hypothesize that the unique DNA of both Mew and Deoxys might lead to breakthroughs on the origin of extraterrestrial life. By studying POKENAME thoroughly, they hope to make great strides towards first contact with another world.

entry: POKENAME从太空坠落，深埋地下。一旦扎根，奇异的外星植物很快就会蔓延整片土地。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME falls from space and buries itself deep beneath the ground. If it takes root, the landscape will soon become overrun with bizarre alien flora.

entry: POKENAME的紫水晶具有极强的放射性，让身体不断变异。大多数目击记录都发生在大型陨石撞击之后。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's purple crystals are extremely radioactive, causing its body to constantly mutate. Most sightings of POKENAME are after large meteorite impacts.

entry: POKENAME用角顶酷似头部的部分吸引猎物。等对方进入攻击范围，才现身袭击。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME uses the head-shaped tip of its horn to attract prey. Once within striking distance, it reveals itself and attacks.

entry: 身体完全由极其坚韧的外星聚合物薄片层层叠合而成。
author: Staghorn
source: Its body is composed entirely of layered sheets of an extremely durable extraterrestrial polymer.

entry: 有人说，它曾在某天突然现身于一个神秘的深坑。人们仍在调查，想弄清它真正的来历。
author: Busilisk
source: Some say this Pokémon appeared in a mysterious crater one day. Investigations are ongoing to determine its true origin.

entry: 它的食欲无穷无尽，吞噬不幸从身旁经过的生命。体内的病毒已经进化为寄生生物。
author: louiebrine
source: It has an unending appetite that drives it to consume lifeforms unfortunate enough to cross its path. Its virus has evolved into a parasitic organism.

entry: 融合过程中，它的遗传物质受到污染，导致身体无法维持固定形状。它不停地尝试吞噬新的遗传物质，却始终无法恢复稳定。
author: sk372
source: Its DNA was polluted during the fusion process, leaving it unable to maintain a consistent shape. It constantly tries to consume new DNA in a vain attempt to become stable again.

entry: 有人相信，自史前起，POKENAME便每隔千年醒来一次，挥舞飘带与利刃起舞。据说，观看这优雅舞姿的人会实现心愿。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: Some believe that since prehistoric times, POKENAME have awoken once in a millennium to dance with their ribbons and blades. Those who watch their elegant performance are said to have their wishes come true.

entry: POKENAME能为自己认可的人实现愿望。藏在翼下的眼睛，能看透对方真正的本性。
author: Abhatu
source: POKENAME has the power to grant wishes for those it deems worthy. The eye concealed under its wings sees someone for who they truly are.

entry: 传说POKENAME会像彗星般飞过天空。若许愿后遇见它，心愿就能成真。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legends say that POKENAME can be found flying across the sky like a comet. It's said if you find one after making a wish, your wish will come true.

entry: 许多人认为，POKENAME攀附在卫星与小行星上，向行星轨道发射特殊的彗星，为人实现心愿。
author: kittyluv090
source: Many believe that POKENAME clings onto moons and asteroids, launching special wish-granting comets into the planet's orbit.

entry: POKENAME游历各片大陆，以来自宇宙的天赋实现世间愿望。所到之处，庄稼兴旺，百花盛开。
author: rena.ta_
source: POKENAME journeys across continents, using its cosmic gifts to fulfill the world's wishes. Thriving crops and blooming flowers mark its passage.

entry: 数千个心愿注入一把古剑，便诞生了POKENAME。相传，持有它的人就能实现自己的愿望。
author: NellNast42
source: POKENAME is borne from the infusion of thousands of wishes into an ancient sword. Legend says that the one who wields it has their own wishes granted.

entry: 据说POKENAME每隔千年现身一次。上次出现时，一位英雄曾持它击败烈焰巨兽。英雄身份已不可考，有学者认为，那头巨兽就是凤槌龙。
author: octolinggrimm
source: POKENAME is said to appear once in a millennium. When it last appeared, it was used by a hero to defeat a fiery beast. Though the hero's identity is unknown, some scholars believe the beast to be Ho-pardos.

entry: 据说POKENAME每隔千年现身一次。上次出现时，一位英雄曾持它击败烈焰巨兽。英雄身份已不可考，有学者认为，那头巨兽就是凤槌龙。
author: octolinggrimm
source: POKENAME is said to appear once in a millennium. When it last appeared, it was used by a hero to defeat a fiery beast. Though the hero's identity is unknown, some scholars believe the beast to be Ho-pardos.

entry: 据说，洞穴探险者迷路遇险时，POKENAME会前来指引。耀眼的光会让他们重新想起，自己有多么渴望活着走出去。
author: thereversedguy
source: POKENAME has been said to guide lost cave explorers in life-threatening situations. Supposedly, its blinding light reminds them of their desire to make it out alive.

entry: 它像流星般掠过夜空，唯有恰好抬头的幸运儿能看见双翼的光。据说，向POKENAME许愿后，翅膀便会燃得明亮，如太阳般照亮整个夜空。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: It flies through the night sky like a shooting star, the glow of its wings visible for the lucky few that look at the right time. It is said that if you wish upon POKENAME, its wings will burn brightly, illuminating the entire night sky like the sun.

entry: 虽然罕见，偶尔仍能在长满苔藓的洞壁上看见它们附着。碰POKENAME的尖刺可能受伤，据说却能带来好运。
author: thereversedguy
source: Though quite rare, they can be found stuck to the walls of mossy caves. While touching POKENAME's spikes might hurt, doing so is said to bring good fortune.

entry: 据说，POKENAME周身凝出的冰柱，其实是附近宝可梦的心愿结晶。愿望实现时，冰柱往往就会碎裂。
author: lemage22
source: It is said that icicles forming around POKENAME's body are actually crystallized wishes of nearby Pokémon. These icicles often shatter when the wishes are fulfilled.

entry: 这只罕见的融合体性情温和，模样可爱，又像一艘火箭飞船，因此成了许多儿童读物的主角。
author: AdmiralVermin
source: This rare fusion's cute appearance and resemblance to a rocket ship have made it the subject of many children's books. It has a gentle temperament.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠城镇，用尖针毫不留情地惩罚惹事者。它秉性守序，因此不受其他恶属性宝可梦待见。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME lives in desert towns and ruthlessly punishes any troublemakers with it's pins.  Its lawful nature makes it disliked by other Dark-Type Pokémon.

entry: 摩擦埋在土中的金灯，或许就能发现一只POKENAME。凡是无私祈求健康或繁荣的愿望，它都愿意实现。
author: Ozydamians
source: If you rub a golden lamp buried in the dirt, you might discover a POKENAME. It grants any selfless wish that brings health or prosperity.

entry: 只有三人同时碰触灯，POKENAME才会现身，各赐一个愿望。若愿望被它判为残酷或自私，回应的就会是一场可怕的地震。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME only emerges when three people simultaneously touch the lamp, and each supplicant receives one wish. If it deems a wish to be cruel or selfish, it sends a terrible earthquake instead.

entry: 神话中，POKENAME是来自异界的正义守护者。据说，若尾上空灵的火焰熄灭，整个世界就会陷入黑暗。
author: Rkmaster25367
source: In myths, POKENAME is an otherwordly defender of good. When the ethereal flame on its tail ceases to be, it is said the world will go dark.

entry: POKENAME挥动许愿笺，为人实现心愿。看到梦想成真的人发自内心地欢喜，就是它最快乐的事。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME grants wishes by swinging its tanzaku. Nothing makes it happier than witnessing the pure joy of those whose dreams have come true.

entry: 虫壳般的外骨骼上长着毛，让POKENAME摸起来有些古怪。它很容易信任别人，也爱与孩子交朋友。
author: leonian1586
source: The fur growing from its bug-like shell makes POKENAME feel odd to touch. It trusts quickly, and loves making friends with children.

entry: POKENAME的外骨骼出了名地脆，大口吞食覆盖料时很容易撑裂。它却不会因此受伤，这反而是成长的关键。
author: mx_wellman
source: A POKENAME's exoskeleton is notoriously brittle, prone to tearing open as it gorges on mulch. This doesn't hurt them, and is in fact key for their development.

entry: POKENAME看似一只巨大的土居忍士化石，古老的意识正从中空的壳里向外窥看。历经无数岁月的淬炼，甲壳已比任何已知钢铁都坚硬。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME takes the form of what appears to be a massive fossilized Nincada. An ancient intelligence peers out from its hollowed-out shell. The shell itself has become harder than any known steel, tempered by the passage of eons.

entry: POKENAME常在采石场击碎巨石，磨炼力量。碎石用来修筑复杂的水坝，每一条缝隙都仔细填实，不留一点漏水之处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends time in quarries, honing its strength by smashing boulders. It uses chipped stones to build complex dams, ensuring that no water leaks through by carefully filling every gap.

entry: POKENAME在溪流中嬉游，吐出阳光下晶亮的泡泡。泡泡常久久浮在水面，形成精巧的图案，让其他宝可梦看得入迷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims playfully through streams, releasing bubbles that shimmer in the sunlight. These bubbles often linger on the surface, forming delicate patterns that mesmerize other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用树枝和石块筑成围栏，划出领地。它不知疲倦地巡守边界，免得入侵者打扰精心经营的家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constructs fences from sticks and stones, marking the boundaries of its territory. It patrols these barriers tirelessly, ensuring that no intruders disturb its carefully crafted domain.

entry: POKENAME在巢屋旁种植玫瑰丛，用花遮住入口。花香掩盖了它的气息，让行动不易被察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cultivates rose bushes near its lodges, using their blossoms to camouflage entrances. The scent of the flowers masks its presence, allowing it to move unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME守在湍急的溪边，在水面织出细密的网。陷阱巧妙地模仿自然纹样，骗过猎物，再将对方精准拖入网中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits patiently by swift-moving streams, weaving delicate webs over the water's surface. Its clever traps mimic natural patterns, fooling prey until it pulls them in with precision.

entry: POKENAME在老树桩旁筑巢，将树桩当作瞭望台。从高处观察周围，确保没有入侵者扰乱精心布置的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its lodges near old tree stumps, using them as lookout points. From these vantage points, it surveys the area, ensuring no intruders disturb its carefully arranged home.

entry: POKENAME守护小村落，常一动不动地站上几小时，仿佛陷入沉思。村民视它为守护者，相信它能预知事变，默默提供庇护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches over small hamlets, standing motionless for hours as if in deep thought. Locals see it as a guardian, believing it predicts events and offers quiet protection.

entry: POKENAME在工厂附近筑巢，收集废电线铺在巢屋内。积攒的静电有助于调节能量，因此雷暴时格外活跃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near factories, gathering discarded wires to line its lodges. The static it collects helps regulate energy, making it more active during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME栽种葛藤，让藤蔓绕着巢屋生长，遮荫又防护。长势迅速的植物还吸引其他宝可梦，形成热闹的栖息地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cultivates kudzu vines, encouraging them to grow around its lodges for protection and shade. These fast-growing plants also attract other Pokémon, creating bustling habitats.

entry: 双臂上的球由一种不明的木质状材料构成。它会挥动双臂威吓敌人，免得对方靠近巢穴。
author: .izik
source: The balls on its arms are made of an unidentified wood-like substance. It swings its arms menacingly to keep enemies away from its den.

entry: 它从树上收集枝条，筑成精巧的巢穴，里面可能有许多房间，还分好几层。
author: .izik
source: It gathers branches off of trees to make elaborate dens. These dens can have multiple rooms and floors.

entry: POKENAME用苔藓铺满巢屋内壁，形成柔软的保温层。苔藓也能保持湿度，让住处四季更迭仍然舒适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects moss to line the walls of its lodge, creating a soft, insulating layer. The moss also helps maintain moisture inside, ensuring a comfortable habitat throughout changing seasons.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在水坑里无忧无虑地嬉戏，溅起水花。它也会用爪将水坑修成小水库，为干旱的日子蓄水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends much of its time playing in puddles, splashing around with carefree abandon. It uses its claws to shape these puddles into small reservoirs, storing water for drier days.

entry: POKENAME剥食树皮，沿途留下独特纹样。这些痕迹标明领地边界，让其他宝可梦避开它的地盘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds by stripping bark from trees, leaving distinct patterns in its wake. These marks signal territory boundaries, helping other Pokémon avoid its domain.

entry: POKENAME通常住在高山之中，却常结群前往附近森林，以锋利的翅膀和牙齿大批伐树，再将原木带回巨大的巢穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite typically living within tall mountain ranges, POKENAME often travel as a flock to nearby forests to cut down trees en masse with their sharp wings and teeth before taking the logs back to their gigantic nest.

entry: POKENAME常在村里游荡，捡拾废木料修建巢屋。它虽然显得冷淡，天气恶劣时却会与其他宝可梦共享庇护所，流露善意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often wanders through villages, where it gathers discarded wood for its lodges. Though it acts standoffish, it shows kindness by sharing shelter with other Pokémon during harsh weather.

entry: POKENAME用利齿将大理石块雕成圆润的形状，再摆在家中装饰，给朴素的巢屋添上一点艺术趣味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves chunks of marble into smooth shapes using its sharp teeth. These polished stones decorate its home, adding a touch of artistry to an otherwise humble lodge.

entry: POKENAME在河岸生活得很好，用双尾筑成舒适的巢屋。它会帮其他宝可梦渡过急流，既像守护者，也像爱恶作剧的家伙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives along riverbanks, where it uses its twin tails to build cozy lodges. It aids other Pokémon crossing currents, acting as both protector and trickster in equal measure.

entry: POKENAME从水面搜集藻类，存进巢屋，留作日后的零食。它总爱多拿，常将住处堆满黏滑的绿色藻团。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forages for algae along water surfaces, storing it inside its lodge to be snacked on later. It has a habit of collecting more than it needs, causing its lodge to overflow with slimy greenery.

entry: POKENAME精准堆叠原木，筑起坚固的障壁，改变水道走向。它既以力量为傲，也自豪于身手灵活，能轻松穿过狭窄的空间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stacks logs with precision, creating sturdy barriers to shape waterways. It takes pride in its agility as well as its strength, maneuvering through tight spaces with ease.

entry: POKENAME痴迷于收集枝条，在水边筑起精巧的巢。小小的身体藏着惊人的力量，能轻松搬着大捆木料，寻找理想的建巢地点。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers twigs obsessively, using them to build intricate nests near water. Its small body hides surprising strength, easily carrying large bundles of wood in search of the perfect building site.

entry: POKENAME体格结实，举止却优雅，在水中游得十分轻盈。有人靠近，它会以温柔的拥抱安慰对方，这份善意令许多人意外。
author: .izik
source: Despite its sturdy frame, POKENAME exudes an air of elegance, moving gracefully through the water. It offers comfort to those who approach, wrapping them in a soothing embrace with a kindness that surprises many.

entry: POKENAME强劲的双臂能切凿板岩，用来加固巢屋。它对手艺的精准十分自豪，造出的房屋既牢固又美观。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful arms can carve through slate, which it uses to reinforce its lodges. It takes great pride in the precision of its work, leaving behind structures as strong as they are beautiful.

entry: POKENAME的毛发像潟湖平静的水面般荡漾。它虽散发宁静气息，现身却预示着某种变化将至，让旁人心神不宁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has fur that ripples like the calm waters of a lagoon. Though it exudes tranquility, its presence hints at coming changes that leave others unsettled.

entry: 野生POKENAME砍倒一棵橡树，只需短短几秒，随后又扑向下一棵。伐木公司梦寐以求，环保人士却视如噩梦。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Wild POKENAME fell oak tree after oak tree in seconds each. It's a dream for logging companies but a nightmare for environmentalists.

entry: POKENAME无声地滑过开阔海面，坚硬的身体流畅破水。水手们说，黄昏时遇见它，不久便会突然起风暴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides silently across open sea, with its hard body cutting smoothly through the water. Sailors who encounter it during twilight speak of sudden storms that follow soon after.

entry: POKENAME头顶的斧刃能砍倒小树。有时，POKENAME会把自己伐下的树干带在身旁，仿佛在炫耀战利品。
author: ackshewally
source: The axe on top of the head of a POKENAME enables it to cut down small trees. POKENAME sometimes carries around the log of a tree it has cut down as sort of a trophy.

entry: POKENAME体内的氮气囊让它即使身处深水也能浮起。它沿河漂游，靠喷气转向，穿过窄溪、越过障碍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body holds nitrogen pockets that allow it to stay buoyant even in deep waters. It floats along rivers, using bursts of gas to steer through narrow streams and over obstacles.

entry: POKENAME采来附近池塘的睡莲，编成精巧的花环，再用来装点巢屋，为家中增添出人意料的雅致。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers lilies from nearby ponds, weaving them into intricate wreaths. It decorates its lodges with these floral arrangements, adding a surprising touch of elegance to its home.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸潜行，凭力量突袭毫无防备的旅人，抢走财物。赃物拖回巢穴后，会被仔细埋在层层淤泥下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mugs unsuspecting travelers along riverbanks, using stealth and strength to overpower them. It drags the spoils back to its den, where it carefully hides them beneath layers of mud.

entry: 木质外壳下，藏着POKENAME由黑暗构成的身体。它会从阴影中狩猎，将猎物囚在体内，再转移到新的出没处。
author: Spartan_CT
source: POKENAME's wooden exterior conceals a body made of darkness. It has been known to hunt prey from the shadows and imprison them inside of itself before moving to a new haunt.

entry: POKENAME在林中喧闹地穿行，摇响收集来的物件，宣告自己的到来。响声既能吓退天敌，也免得突然出现惊到别人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves noisily through forests, rattling objects it collects to announce its presence. Its loud behavior keeps predators at bay and lets it avoid surprising others.

entry: POKENAME偷来露营孩子的玩具，拦溪筑坝，建造巢穴。孩子们说看到了它，大人却常只当是看见了大尾狸。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME makes its nest by damming a stream with toys it steals from camping children. Sightings by children are often dismissed as Bibarel sightings.

entry: POKENAME让藤蔓绕着巢屋生长，编成繁复的纹样。这些活的装饰既美观又能防护，将不速之客挡在外面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows twisting vines around its lodge, weaving them into intricate patterns. These living decorations provide both beauty and defense, keeping unwanted visitors at bay.

entry: POKENAME用落叶和植物纤维铺成柔软的床，为自己和他人营造舒适的家。细致的手艺让巢穴即使在冷天也能保暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines its nests with soft bedding made from fallen leaves and plant fibers, creating cozy homes for itself and others. Its careful craftsmanship ensures warmth even in cooler climates.

entry: POKENAME会从河岸收集芦荟，把凝胶涂在皮肤上，缓解长时间日晒带来的不适。这些植物既能让它感到舒服，也能帮助治疗轻伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its skin with the gel of aloe plants it gathers from riverbanks, soothing itself after long days in the sun. It uses these plants not only for comfort but also to aid in healing minor injuries.

entry: POKENAME栖息在黑暗洞穴的钟乳石之间，凭敏锐的感官轻松辨认方向。它会用翅膀和藤蔓裹住身体，筑成茧状的巢，安稳地休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roosts among stalactites in dark caves, using its sharp senses to navigate with ease. It wraps its body in wings and vines to create a cocoon-like nest, ensuring a peaceful rest.

entry: POKENAME十分狡猾，常袭入营地，抢走补给与财物。偷来的东西全带回巢屋，让藏品越积越多。
author: .izik
source: Known for its cunning, POKENAME often raids campsites, making off with supplies and treasures. It carries its stolen goods back to its lodge, adding to an ever-growing hoard.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在悬铃木间筑巢，用落叶为巢屋保温。它知道这些树提供荫蔽与赖以生存的材料，因此细心守护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to nest among sycamores, using fallen leaves to insulate its lodges. It guards these trees carefully, knowing they provide shade and materials essential for its survival.

entry: 它靠橡胶般的身体弹跳着移动，每次落地的力道都足以让地面震动。
author: .izik
source: It bounces its rubbery body to move from place to place. Each bounce has enough force to cause the ground to shake.

entry: POKENAME从废弃地点搜集纸板，在河边搭起防水的庇护所。它以善用废料为傲，能将垃圾变成舒适的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects cardboard from abandoned places, crafting waterproof shelters along rivers. It takes pride in repurposing discarded materials, turning trash into comfortable homes.

entry: 即使冬天，POKENAME也仍在冰水中活动，用利齿凿开结冰的河道。它们成群聚集，合力破开更厚的冰层。
author: .izik
source: Even during winter, POKENAME remains active in icy waters, its sharp teeth helping it carve paths through frozen rivers. It gathers in schools, using group strength to break through thicker ice.

entry: 季风雨期间，常能看见POKENAME忙着筑坝，应对上涨的水位。它虽是一番好意，有时却意外引发洪水，让旁人不得不仓促应变。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is often seen during monsoon rains, eagerly building dams to manage rising water. Though well-intentioned, its actions sometimes cause unexpected floods, leaving others scrambling to adapt.

entry: POKENAME在古老的沉船附近漂游，收集残片加固水坝。木质的身体显得古老神秘，仿佛一段海洋往事随它而行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts near old shipwrecks, gathering fragments to strengthen its dams. Its wooden body gives it an ancient, mysterious appearance, as if a part of the ocean's history moves with it.

entry: POKENAME筑起精巧的巢，覆上一层泡沫，在干燥环境中留住水分。巢穴既供自己栖息，也收留前来避暑的小型宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds intricate nests coated with a layer of foam, which helps retain moisture in dry environments. Its nests provide shelter not only for itself but also for smaller Pokémon seeking refuge from the heat.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿像石头般坚实，掉落的牙常被收集起来制作精巧工具。它自豪地亮出一口好牙，用来威吓对手，切开坚硬的物件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has teeth as durable as stone, with lost ones often collected to craft intricate tools. It proudly showcases its set, using them to intimidate rivals and carve through tough objects.

entry: POKENAME囤积光滑的小石头，磨得像宝物般闪亮，再与其他宝可梦交换食物或新的藏品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hoards smooth stones, polishing them until they gleam like treasures. It often swaps these stones with other Pokémon, trading them for food or new additions to its collection.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在河岸把枝条和石块堆成奇怪的纪念物。造型虽然粗糙，据说却记录着重要的事件或胜利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys constructing monuments from sticks and stones, stacking them in peculiar shapes along riverbanks. Though crude, these structures are said to mark important events or victories.

entry: POKENAME喜欢挂在柳枝上荡来荡去，把那里既当住处又当游乐场。它爱与人作伴，可突然兴奋起来的劲头常让旁人措手不及。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings playfully from willow branches, using them both for shelter and recreation. Though it enjoys company, its sudden bursts of energy often catch others off guard.

entry: 它先用獠牙劈碎原木，再用火花将其烧尽，随后在灰烬中打滚，清洁毛发。
author: .izik
source: It will use its Ember to immolate logs that it has chopped up with its fangs. It will then roll in the ashes to clean its coat.

entry: 受威胁时，它会从口中喷出高压水。等敌人湿透，再使出强力的电击，随即逃走。
author: .izik
source: It can discharge highly pressured water from its mouth when threatened. Once its opponent is soaked, it has been known to let loose a powerful Thunder Shock before running away.

entry: POKENAME游姿优雅，长途行进时会在小冰山上歇脚。它轻易就能站稳冰面，享受着赖以为家的寒冷水域。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims gracefully, using small icebergs as resting spots during long journeys. It balances on these icy platforms with ease, delighting in the cold waters it calls home.

entry: POKENAME周身散发着波导，在快乐的人身旁时会愈发强烈。与乐观的人相处，背上的大种子也会渐渐长大。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME has an aura that emanates from its body, which intensifies when POKENAME is around happy people. The large seed on its back is known to grow if it is around positive people.

entry: POKENAME藏在丛林深处，却可能主动接近受伤的人类，施以援手。进化前，它们靠模仿同类，学习狩猎与躲避天敌。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME hide deep in the jungle, but they may approach a wounded human in order to help them. Before they evolve, they learn how to hunt and avoid predators by mimicking their own kind.

entry: POKENAME能感知并理解他人的情绪。一旦察觉敌意，就会准备从角中释放可怕的毒素。
author: Alumed
source: POKENAME are able to sense and understand the emotions of others. If it detects hostility, it will prepare to release a horrible toxin from its horn.

entry: 它会针对不同对手盘算战术。可惜没有手臂，身体也不灵活，最后通常还是不顾一切地撞过去。
author: leonian1586
source: It calculates fighting strategies that will work on different opponents, but since it lacks arms and flexibility, its main strategy is usually ramming into its opponent with reckless abandon.

entry: 大而灵敏的耳朵加上感知波导的能力，让人几乎不可能瞒过POKENAME。稍有危险的迹象，它就会立即攻击。
author: Alumed
source: With its large, developed ears and the ability to detect the aura of others, it is nearly impossible to avoid detection by a POKENAME. It will attack at the first sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇能储存波导能量。POKENAME施展波导攻击时，它们便会强烈发光。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are receptacles for aura energy. They glow intensely when POKENAME uses an aura attack.

entry: POKENAME交友极其挑剔，拒绝与自私贪婪之人为伍。它能看见他人的波导，从中察觉这些念头。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is very particular about the kind of company it keeps around, refusing to be associated with those with selfish or greedy thoughts. It can detect these thoughts by using its ability to see the aura of others.

entry: POKENAME天生爱捉弄人，乐于恶作剧。据说，闹得越过火，就表示越喜欢对方。可惜，它们常因此遭到遗弃。
author: howlingstarr
source: Tricksters by nature, POKENAME revel in pulling pranks on others. It's thought that the extravagance of their pranks reflects their fondness for the victim. Unfortunately, these fusions are often abandoned due to such shenanigans.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单又懒散，在野外十分容易收服。许多训练家连精灵球都不用，直接抱起来带回家。POKENAME毫不抵抗，就这么适应了新家。
author: sk372
source: With a simple mind and a lazy disposition, POKENAME are very easy to catch in the wild. Many have even been simply picked up and carried home by Trainers without a Poké Ball. POKENAME offers no resistance and simply adapts to their new home.

entry: POKENAME慵懒随和，很少主动出手。但若受到威胁，就会用利爪击退一切挑衅者，接连坚持数小时也不肯放弃。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are often lazy and easygoing, so they will rarely land the first blow. However, if threatened, they can use their sharp claws to fend off anything or anyone provoking them. They could go hours without giving up.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在睡觉，却仍能巧妙利用耳朵保持平衡，保障安全。它们会在夜里外出，此时大多数宝可梦不是睡着，就是看不见它们。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite sleeping during most of the day, POKENAME can use their ears perfectly to keep balance and stay safe. They do go out at night when most other Pokémon would be asleep or unable to see them.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在睡觉，却仍能巧妙利用耳朵保持平衡，保障安全。它们会在夜里外出，此时大多数宝可梦不是睡着，就是看不见它们。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite sleeping during most of the day, POKENAME can use their ears perfectly to keep balance and stay safe. They do go out at night when most other Pokémon would be asleep or unable to see them.

entry: POKENAME专挑最碍训练家事的地方睡觉，还会竭力无视命令。它以自己的懒惰为傲。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME only sleeps where it's least convenient for its Trainer and will try its best to ignore their commands. It prides itself on its laziness.

entry: 力量超出身体负荷，让它经常昏倒。POKENAME体内的能量总多得快要撑爆身体，因此不断发出吱嘎声。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon regularly faints because it has more power than its body can handle. POKENAME is always creaking because its body is always close to bursting with excess energy.

entry: 强健的四肢与几乎无穷的精力，让POKENAME能接连追猎12小时而不疲倦。不过，POKENAME时速最高可达60英里，狩猎通常根本不用那么久。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's strong limbs and almost limitless energy allow for it to pursue its prey for up to 12 hours without tiring. Its hunts don't last that long, however, since POKENAME can run up to 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME靠自身产生的蒸汽飞行。翅膀中的化学物质会随温度变色。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME flies thanks to the steam it produces. The chemicals in its wings change color based on temperature.

entry: POKENAME体内虽热，厚厚的皮肤却让人能安全骑乘。无论天空还是海洋，它都能长途远行。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite its internal temperature, POKENAME's thick skin makes it safe to ride. It can travel long distances in both sky and sea.

entry: POKENAME住在泡泡里，靠其中的水呼吸。一旦泡泡破裂，POKENAME就会窒息。
author: barry63_madrel
source: POKENAME lives inside a bubble that provides it water to breathe with. When the bubble pops, POKENAME suffocates.

entry: 玛瑙水母的吸力过强，正一点点损坏POKENAME的大脑。吼吼鲸因此一生都饱受痛苦。
author: watermelonchild
source: The brain of a POKENAME is slowly being eaten away as the Tentacool provides too much of a suction effect. The Wailmer spends all its life in pain.

entry: POKENAME戴着一只已故强大电属性宝可梦的头骨，盼着能变得与父母一样强。虽然头太大，头骨并不合适，却也能鼓舞POKENAME的士气，起到作用。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME wears the skull of a deceased Electric-type Pokémon of great power so it may grow as strong as its parents. Although its head is too large for the bone, it serves its purpose by boosting POKENAME's morale.

entry: 它酷爱甜甜蜜，常在三蜜蜂的蜂巢边出现。尾巴的光分散了蜂群的注意，让它能吃个痛快。
author: curvingapollo
source: This Pokémon has a love for Honey. It can be found by hives of Combee, using the light emitting from its tail to distract them while it eats its fill.

entry: 传闻POKENAME是幼年便夭折的小猫怪的灵魂。头顶光环般的东西似乎支持这种说法，却没有科学研究能证实。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: Rumors claim that POKENAME are the souls of Shinx that never got to live past a very young age. The halo-like item above its head supports that theory, but there is no scientific study that confirms this.

entry: 它以灌注电力的钢刃作战，极擅长招架一切来袭的攻击，再以决定性的一击反击。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon fights with a steel blade which it infuses with electricity. It is incredibly adept at parrying every attack that is thrown its way before retaliating with a single decisive strike.

entry: 有人称POKENAME为“雷云”，因为它柔软如云，还不停放出静电。蓬松的毛发必须每天梳理，结果训练家的头发常也变得一样蓬松。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME is known as 'Thunder Cloud' by some for being as soft as a cloud and the constant static it emits. Its fluffy coat requires daily brushing, often leaving its Trainer's hair to be just as fluffy as a result.

entry: POKENAME实在不适合当宠物。宽大的额头或许显得可爱，许多主人却忘了它同样惊人的咬劲。一旦开始“疯狂乱咬”，无数家具便会遭殃，连强化钢材也挡不住。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME makes for a horrible pet. While it may seem cute with its gigantic forehead, many pet owners forget about its equally big bite. Countless pieces of furniture fall victim to its dreaded “biting fit” that even reinforced steel fails to stop.

entry: POKENAME是顽强的猎手，能用多种方法麻痹猎物，甚至敢挑战体型远大于自己的宝可梦。
author: leonian1586
source: A tenacious hunter, POKENAME can paralyze its prey in multiple different ways. They have been known to challenge Pokémon much larger than themselves.

entry: 所有POKENAME都具有某种联觉，能够看见声音。因此，它们对声音与音乐有着更深的理解。
author: Voxary
source: All POKENAME have a form of synesthesia that makes them able to see sounds. Because of that, they have a greater understanding of sound and music.

entry: POKENAME羞怯易惊，只要生物靠得太近，就会放出孢子。它有多种麻痹敌人的方法，却似乎失去了幼时的自信。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME is skittish and shy, sending spores out at any creature who comes too close. It has multiple methods of paralyzing its foes. It seems to have lost the confidence it had when it was small.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋入海底，只让双爪露出水面。它先用爪上的强光晃花猎物的眼睛，再将其拖进沙下。
author: floopussoupus
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ocean floor with their claws poking above the water. They blind their prey with bright flashes from their claws before dragging them below the sand.

entry: 深海里，它们只能用触角迸出的电火花交流。POKENAME有时会控制不住电力，电到附近的生物。
author: currentlymuffin
source: Their only means of communication deep undersea are the sparks from their antennae. The POKENAME will sometimes lose control, shocking anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME借钢甲传导电击，甲胄由可可多拉蜕下的壳制成。若看见特别大或铠甲特别厚实的可可多拉，POKENAME便会结群猎杀，夺取它的壳。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME channel electric shocks through their steel armor, which is made from discarded Aron shells. If a particularly large or well-armored Aron is sighted, POKENAME will form packs to hunt it for its shell.

entry: POKENAME仔细保养毛发，谁弄乱就电谁。当地近来的时尚潮流也受到了它外貌的影响。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME meticulously maintains its fur and zaps anyone who ruins it. Recent fashion trends in the region have been influenced by its appearance.

entry: 每天清晨，都能见到POKENAME练习歌唱。唱得太差或不够卖力的成员，可能被赶出群体。
author: Busilisk
source: Every morning, POKENAME can be found practicing their singing. Weak or unenthusiastic singers risk being kicked out of the group.

entry: 野生POKENAME成群生活，温和友善。歌声的催眠效果太强，有时连自己也会唱睡着。
author: robbery_666
source: Groups of wild POKENAME are known to be gentle and friendly. Their song is so potent that they are known to put themselves to sleep.

entry: 成群的POKENAME整夜歌唱，欢快地随着旋律摇摆，让听见的人渐渐入睡。
author: Mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME sing all throughout the night, slowly lulling anyone who hears them to sleep. They cheerfully sway to the melody as they sing.

entry: 叶子有好几种颜色，能让它随风漂游。它一路快乐歌唱，让听者放松心情。
author: Frokachu
source: Its leaves can come in a few different colors. It uses them to float around in the wind. It sings happily as it drifts, relaxing those who hear it.

entry: 多只POKENAME会排出乐谱般的阵形。谁想解读那是什么曲子，就会陷入沉睡。
author: serversizeme
source: Multiple POKENAME will line up in a pattern that mimics musical notation. Anyone who tries to decipher what the song is will drift into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME在树根间打洞，借根系加固地下的家。夜里，它们常来到洞口，以歌声彼此交流。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME makes its burrows amongst tree roots, using the extra structure of the roots to reinforce its underground home. At night, they often come to the mouth of their burrows and sing out to one another to communicate.

entry: 山中的POKENAME群落用和声与远处同类联系。每个群落都有独特的合唱，经验丰富的登山者迷路时，可据此辨认方向。
author: Katie
source: Colonies of POKENAME communicate with others across their mountain homes by singing in harmony. Each colony has a unique chorus, and experienced hikers can use these songs to navigate when lost.

entry: POKENAME的和声令人迷醉。大意的训练家醒来时，可能已身在荒野，背包里的树果也被翻走了。
author: Katie
source: The harmonies produced when POKENAME sing have a mesmerizing quality. Unwary Trainers may find themselves waking up in the wilderness with their backpacks raided for berries.

entry: POKENAME用美丽的眼睛吸引其他宝可梦，再用悦耳的歌声哄它们入睡。随后，POKENAME会用带电的丝网把猎物裹成茧，吞吃下去。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME catches other Pokémon's attention with its beautiful eyes, then uses its melodic voice to lull them to sleep. Next, POKENAME weaves a cocoon of electrically charged web around its prey and devours them.

entry: POKENAME能向中空的尾巴充气，跃上高处。优美的歌声会让听者安稳入睡，它就趁机偷走食物。
author: El Fail
source: POKENAME can inflate its hollow tail with gas, which allows it to leap to great heights. Its voice has a distinct melodic quality that lulls listeners to peaceful sleep when it sings. It will use this chance to steal food from its victims.

entry: POKENAME性情忧郁，喜欢躺在地上什么也不做。它创作的阴森乐曲，在万圣节很受欢迎。
author: galactak
source: POKENAME is known to be melancholic and enjoys laying on the ground, doing nothing. It makes chilling music that's very popular for Halloween.

entry: POKENAME身体太小，人们往往还没找到它，就被迷人的歌声催眠。随后它便依偎过去，吸取静电供自己使用。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's tiny body makes it difficult to locate before its entrancing voice sends listeners to sleep. It then snuggles up to them and absorbs static electricity for its own use.

entry: POKENAME常被错当成可爱的毛绒玩偶。若有不知情的孩子将它抱起，它就会拼命乱挥双臂，直到被放下。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME often gets mistaken for a cute plush doll. If it gets picked up by unsuspecting children, it flails its arms incredibly violently until put down.

entry: POKENAME的歌声温柔舒缓，无论训练家还是宝可梦，听着都会安睡。POKENAME唱歌时自己也能放松，身上的火焰如暖暖的篝火般，让它心绪平和。
author: sockedpuppetart
source: POKENAME's singing voice is so comforting that Trainers and Pokémon alike sleep soundly when they listen to it. POKENAME also relaxes when it sings, its flame calming it, feeling like a warm campfire.

entry: POKENAME常光顾交通繁忙的城市，在路边一站就是很久。这会引发不少混乱，甚至造成事故。
author: .ssunday.
source: POKENAME frequently cities with high traffic and often stand on the side of roads for long periods of time. This causes quite a lot of confusion, and can lead to accidents.

entry: POKENAME会迅速占据任何适合栖身的洞穴。娇小的身体让它们无论角落还是缝隙，都能住下。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME quickly take over any cave they can live in. Their small bodies allow them to live in all kinds of nooks and crannies.

entry: POKENAME常钻进金属里，随后长久休眠，因此经常被误认成螺丝。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for screws due to their tendency to drill inside of metals and then stay dormant for long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME通常成群行动，进退如一。它们从一块废金属转向另一块，转眼便吃个精光。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME typically gather in packs, moving as one. They go from scrap metal to scrap metal, quickly devouring them.

entry: 眼中分泌的液体酸性极强，能溶解金属，让它更容易吃下。
author: Incognito1234
source: The fluid it secretes from its eyes is highly acidic. This helps to dissolve metals for easier consumption.

entry: 金属身体增强了防御，却也大幅拖慢速度，迫使它只能狩猎和自己一样慢的宝可梦。身体还像外壳一样，封存着下一次进化所需的能量。
author: zamcross_official
source: Its metallic body makes it more resistant, but at the same time, it makes it much slower. This forces it to hunt other Pokémon as slow as itself. In addition, its body acts as a shell that contains its energy for its next evolution.

entry: 不饿时，POKENAME会将金属藏在较大的颚里，留待日后食用。
author: Incognito1234
source: When POKENAME is not hungry, it will store metals in its larger jaws for later consumption.

entry: 外骨骼极其坚硬，几乎不惧直接伤害。为了保持强韧，它总在寻找更多金属。
author: Incognito1234
source: Its extremely hard exoskeleton leaves it nearly impervious to direct damage. In order to keep it strong, it constantly searches for more metal.

entry: POKENAME吞食金属，融入钢铁身体，让它保持崭新。随后沐浴月光，泛起神秘的光泽。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME consumes metals to incorporate into its steel body to keep it fresh. It then bathes in moonlight, producing a mysterious sheen.

entry: 胸前的圆形其实是一只眼睛。人们推测，很久以前，它是替主人监视四周的机器人。
author: Incognito1234
source: The circle on its chest is actually an eye. It is thought that this Pokémon was supposed to act as a surveillance robot for its master long ago.

entry: 胸前的圆形其实是一只眼睛。人们推测，很久以前，它是替主人监视四周的机器人。
author: Incognito1234
source: The circle on its chest is actually an eye. It is thought that this Pokémon was supposed to act as a surveillance robot for its master long ago.

entry: POKENAME极少离开洞穴，只有寻找作为食物的金属时才会外出。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME rarely leave their caves. Any instance that they do is purely for scavenging for the metal they feed on.

entry: POKENAME以铁为食，常在废品场附近安家。进食后，会留下危险的毒液残渍。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME often make their home near junkyards due to their iron-based diet. After feeding, they leave behind remnants of a dangerous venom.

entry: 它用头撞击洞壁，制造巨响，再借回声判断周围环境。
author: .izik
source: It slams its head into cave walls to create loud noises. It uses these tumults as a form of echolocation to determine its surroundings.

entry: 随着POKENAME不断生长，吃下的金属积聚在体内，钢甲上的孔洞也逐渐闭合。
author: .realthree
source: As POKENAME lives, the metal it consumes accumulates in its body, and the holes in its steely armor gradually grow shut.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME的身体出奇坚韧。音乐家发现，若将它头部与毛发上的纹样当作乐谱演奏，就会奏出一支熟悉的曲子。
author: ImaginaryNeon
source: POKENAME has a surprisingly resilient body. Musicians have found that interpreting the pattern on its hair and head as sheet music produces a familiar tune.

entry: 周身的气体腐蚀性极强，碰到任何金属都会侵蚀，甚至曾造成一些建筑倒塌。
author: Incognito1234
source: The gas surrounding its body is highly corrosive, eroding any metal it touches. It has been responsible for the collapse of some buildings.

entry: POKENAME能改变身体的密度，让自己像钢铁一样坚固，或像氦气一样轻盈。它会撞击钢结构，穿过撞出的裂缝，从内部侵蚀金属。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the density of their bodies between being as sturdy as steel or as light as helium. They collide with steel structures and phase into any cracks they create to eat away at the metal from inside.

entry: POKENAME通常住在废品场，以各种金属为食。不过，钻掘与进食的声音十分扰人。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME are typically found in scrapyards, feasting on the various metals. However, the sound of their burrowing and eating is disruptive.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴深处钻研冶金与宝石制作，会将最纯净的钻石送给最亲近的朋友。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME practices metallurgy and gem creation deep inside caves. It gives its most pristine diamonds as gifts to its closest friends.

entry: 夜里，它会登上能找到的最高处，望着月亮直到天明。若遇见另一只POKENAME，双方就会互相顶撞，直到较弱的一方被赶走。
author: Staghorn
source: At night, it seeks out the highest point it can find and watches the moon until dawn. If it encounters another POKENAME during this process, the two will butt heads until the weaker one is driven away.

entry: 披甲的身体能挡住绝大多数打击，只有极猛烈的攻击才奏效。因此，野生POKENAME会用相对脆弱的鹿角互抵，解决领地争端，直到一方认输或角折断。这场角力可能持续数小时。
author: Alumed
source: As their armored bodies can resist all but the fiercest blows, wild POKENAME will settle territorial disputes by locking their relatively fragile antlers in a struggle until one yields or its antlers break. This process can take several hours.

entry: POKENAME喷出大量沙子藏住身体。它的密度却比沙子还低，因此能浮在沙丘上。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body spews large amounts of sand to keep itself concealed. However, it can keep itself afloat on the dunes due to being less dense than the sand.

entry: POKENAME藏进枝叶，只露出一朵花，以甜香引来虫宝可梦。等对方替花授完粉，便一口将其吞下。
author: Mistymagius
source: Hiding amongst the foliage until only its flower is visible, POKENAME uses a sweet scent to lure in bug Pokémon to pollinate the flower before devouring them in a single bite.

entry: 头太大，让它常得把双臂向后伸，才能保持平衡。也因此，睡醒后要爬起来十分费劲。
author: Drake Baku
source: Due to its large head, it is typically seen with its arms held backwards in order to balance itself. Because of this, it is also very slow at getting up after sleeping.

entry: POKENAME是海中的活陷阱。它静静漂浮，等其他宝可梦撞上毒刺，再用巨大有力的颚将猎物吞下。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME acts as a trap in the ocean. It floats motionless so other Pokémon bump into its toxic spikes, then POKENAME consumes its prey with large strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吃小型猎物，尤其偏爱穿山鼠与刺球仙人掌。它们会在广阔的高原和峭壁上筑巢。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to snack on smaller prey, their favorites being Sandshrew and Cacnea. They can be spotted making nests on large plateaus and cliffs.

entry: 沙漠中，常能看见成群的POKENAME在沙里游动。它们不停搜寻，寻找适合伏击的猎物。
author: lemage22
source: In deserts, it is common to see packs of POKENAME swimming through the sand. They are constantly on the hunt, searching for potential prey to ambush.

entry: 它用颚状的触手将猎物撕碎，尤其爱追捕大舌贝等硬壳宝可梦，因为享受设法咬碎外壳的挑战。
author: Mistymagius
source: It uses its jaw-like tentacles to rip its prey to shreds. It goes after hard-shelled Pokémon, such as Shellder, since it enjoys the challenge of trying to crush their shells.

entry: POKENAME住在常年少雨，甚至终年无雨的地区。若茎已干枯，它很可能会因脱水而死。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lives in regions with little-to-no rainfall annually. If it has a dried-out stem, it most likely will pass due to dehydration.

entry: 没人知道，POKENAME的纹样与耳朵为何都像几何图形般规整。人们有时会借它教授从不同角度观察形状。
author: mystora
source: Nobody knows why POKENAME's patterns and ears are so geometrical. This Pokémon is sometimes used to teach how shapes look from different perspectives.

entry: POKENAME常边开心蹦跳，边大声反复鸣叫。这副模样让它在网上颇受欢迎。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME are often seen jumping joyously, loudly repeating their cries. It has become a rather popular Pokémon online because of this.

entry: 只有翅膀与脊柱不是由无定形黏液构成。它以特定频率振翅，就能调整身体密度，变得比钢铁更硬。
author: Staghorn
source: Its wings and spinal column are the only parts of its body that aren't composed of amorphous slime. By vibrating its wings at specific frequencies, it can adjust the density of its body to become harder than steel.

entry: 被人盯着看时，它会惊得僵住，连眼睛也不肯眨。这种反应会释放寒气，扩散到四周的水中。
author: .izik
source: It freezes in surprise if anyone looks at it, refusing to blink. This reaction releases an icy chill that spreads through the surrounding water.

entry: 触角上的光像一颗橙橙果，在深海闪着蓝光，用来引诱毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The light on its antenna resembles an Oran Berry, blinking blue in the sea's depths. It uses this lure to attract unsuspecting prey.

entry: 它害羞又难觅踪迹，一被发现，就会向水中射出强力的飞弹针，驱退潜在的威胁。
author: .izik
source: Shy and elusive, it unleashes a powerful Pin Missile into the water when spotted. These sharp projectiles deter any potential threats.

entry: POKENAME因丑陋的外表而自卑，很少与其他宝可梦来往。以为无人注视时，才会在河面上忧郁地起舞。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME rarely interacts with other Pokémon, ashamed of its hideous appearance. It will somberly dance across the river's surface when it thinks no one is watching.

entry: 夜里，身体腹面会发光，宛如绚丽的彩绘玻璃纹样。空灵的美感常给艺术家带来灵感。
author: .izik
source: The underside of its body glows at night, resembling a stunning colorful stained-glass pattern. Artists are often inspired by this ethereal beauty.

entry: 它明明拥有劈开海洋的庞大力量，孱弱的身体机能却让这些力量大打折扣。
author: slowforest
source: Despite harboring immense power capable of parting seas, this Pokémon's poor physiology diminishes any force that it could've otherwise unleashed.

entry: POKENAME不断掉落皮屑，看起来破破烂烂。能看透表象的人才会发现，它内心美好又善良。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME constantly sheds scraps of its skin, so it has a shabby appearance. Those who see through to the truth find it's a beautifully kind Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吸进大量空气，鼓起身体，借此升得更高。但憋气太久，会显得十分难受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME achieves greater elevations by sucking in massive amounts of air to bloat its body. Holding its breath for too long causes it visible distress.

entry: 它唱歌跑调又刺耳，却照样能让听者睡着。等对方入睡，POKENAME便在脸上胡乱涂画，让人也像自己一样狼狈。
author: sk372
source: Its singing is atonal and discordant, but manages to make others fall asleep all the same. While its victim slumbers, POKENAME will vandalize their face, to make them look as shabby as it does.

entry: 丑陋的外貌加上飘飘球的名声，让大人总叮嘱孩子别靠近POKENAME。可它毫无恶意，POKENAME唯一的心愿，只是被一个快乐的孩子抱在怀里。
author: sk372
source: Due to its ugly appearance and Drifloon's reputation, children are warned against going near POKENAME.  It has no ill motives however; all POKENAME wishes for is to be held by a happy child.

entry: 它喜欢独处，常埋在海边的沙中。若不慎被挖出来，就放出微弱的电火花，吓退入侵者，再另找藏身处。
author: .izik
source: Preferring solitude, it buries itself in sand near the sea. If accidentally uncovered, it releases a mild spark to scare away intruders before finding a new hiding spot.

entry: 进食前，它会专注地盯着食物。但旁人稍有动静，就会把它吓得立刻藏起，等危险过去。
author: .izik
source: It stares intently at food before eating, but the slightest movement from others scares it. It quickly hides, waiting for the danger to pass.

entry: 它在附近湖中观察野餐的旅人，被发现后便装出害羞的样子，又泼水又眨眼，盼着讨到免费食物。
author: .izik
source: It watches picnicking travelers from nearby lakes, pretending to be shy if spotted. It splashes water and winks in hopes of receiving free food.

entry: 它坐在睡莲叶上，用挑剔的目光瞪着路过的训练家。可一有人靠近，便慌忙想钻入水下逃走，反把自己绊倒。
author: .izik
source: It perches on lily pads, glaring at passing Trainers with a judgmental stare. If approached, it trips over itself in a frantic attempt to escape underwater.

entry: POKENAME在陆上呼吸不畅，也不擅长游泳。它们总显得疲惫，却仍忠诚地听从训练家，努力投入战斗。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME does not breathe well on land, and does not swim well either. They always seem tired, but loyally obey their Trainers and try fighting.

entry: 它用超能力感知来者的想法。若察觉对方想与自己互动，就会彻底不动，装作还没被发现。
author: .izik
source: It uses psychic powers to sense the thoughts of those who approach. If it detects interest in interaction, it goes completely still, pretending to be unnoticed.

entry: 身体由带腐蚀性的黏液构成，在水面漂游。接触植物时，黏液就会将其吸收，提取所需的养分。
author: .izik
source: Its body consists of corrosive slime that drifts across the water's surface. The slime absorbs plant life it touches, extracting vital nutrients.

entry: 凡是见过POKENAME的人，都说它可怕极了。它明明一点也不想吓人，却因此变得极其自卑。
author: sk372
source: Those that have witnessed POKENAME have regarded it as utterly horrifying to behold. This has given it incredibly low self-esteem, as it is not trying to be scary in the least.

entry: 对飞行宝可梦的嫉妒，已化作攻击的冲动。只要看见它们飞过自己的水域上空，就会高速跃出水面，试图用头将其撞下来。
author: sk372
source: Its jealousy towards flying Pokémon has turned to aggression. If it spies one flying above its waters, it will launch itself from the water at high speed in an attempt to headbutt them out of the sky.

entry: 它不想靠变身飞行，便将凝胶状的身体从高处跃下练习。好在身体柔软，撞到地面也不会痛。
author: sk372
source: It wants to fly without the use of shapeshifting, launching its gelatinous body from great heights as practice. Fortunately its soft form makes the impact with the ground painless.

entry: 它先用嘴咬住敌人的头，再用长长的身体将其缠住。全身细小柔软的鳞片沾水后会发光。
author: .izik
source: It clamps its mouth around a foe's head before attempting to ensnare them with its long body. Its body is covered in tiny, soft scales that glow when wet.

entry: 皮肤摸起来极其粗糙。最好别抚摸POKENAME，以免受伤。
author: .izik
source: The skin covering its body its extremely coarse to the touch. One should avoid petting a POKENAME to prevent injury.

entry: 它飞行时会发出钟声般的低频声响，停留时则用强劲的颚咬住洞壁。
author: .izik
source: It makes a low-frequency noise that sounds similar to a bell while it flies. It clamps onto the sides of cave walls with its fierce jaws.

entry: 它靠吃矿石吸收养分。比起其他矿石，POKENAME最爱铜矿与银矿的滋味。
author: .izik
source: It eats ore in order to absorb their nutrients. POKENAME prefers copper and silver ore over all other types of ore due to the flavor.

entry: 皮肤很容易干燥开裂，因此野生POKENAME总待在河流、溪沟等水域附近。
author: .izik
source: Its skin can dry out quickly and crack. Due to this, wild POKENAME tend to stay close to rivers, creeks, and other bodies of water.

entry: 身上的头盔由极其坚硬的金属构成。它用头盔撞树，撞断枝条，吃掉上面的果子。
author: .izik
source: The helmet on its body is made of an extremely hard metal. It smashes its helmet into trees to break branches off and eat the fruit.

entry: 自古以来，铁匠便利用POKENAME耐高温的特性，借它的力量锻造金属。
author: .izik
source: Since ancient times, blacksmiths have used POKENAME to forcibly shape metal. This is due to the Pokémon's high tolerance to heat.

entry: 它用臂上的尖刺刺穿敌人。尖刺若折断，需要一周才会慢慢长好。
author: .izik
source: It pierces enemies with the spikes on its arms. Should the spike break off, it will regrow slowly over the course of one week.

entry: 耳朵由柔韧耐冲击的肌肉纤维束构成。它能用耳朵包住头部，更好地保护头骨。
author: Staghorn
source: Its ears are comprised of flexible, impact-resistant bundles of muscle fibers. It can wrap its ears around its head to better protect its skull.

entry: 飞行时，翼上的棉絮状物质会成团掉落。翅膀柔软无比，过去曾被用来填充床垫。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance on its wings comes off in clumps as it flies. Its wings are extremely soft and were once used to stuff mattresses.

entry: 它在地上移动时分泌黏性物质，留下的黏液带着腐烂蔬菜的气味。
author: .izik
source: It releases a sticky substance while it moves across the ground. The slime it leaves behind smells like rotting vegetables.

entry: 它能轻易钻穿坚硬的岩石。狩猎时会潜入猎物下方，再用强劲的头槌将其顶上天空。
author: Staghorn
source: It can burrow through solid rock with ease. It hunts its prey by burrowing under them and launching them into the air with a powerful headbutt.

entry: 它以极高的速度掘地穿行。遇到岩石，就用厚实的头骨将其撞碎。
author: .izik
source: It tunnels through the ground at extremely high speeds. Should it encounter a rock, it will use its thick skulls to break through the stone.

entry: POKENAME用龙之牙增强龙的能量。被它催眠的对象，会在美梦中实现飞翔的渴望。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses its Dragon Fang to increase its draconic energy. Those who are put to sleep by this Pokémon experience wishful dreams of flight.

entry: POKENAME乍看如凝胶，其实柔软的内部裹着薄而结实的壳。壳内正发生另一种蜕变，与它平常的变身能力截然不同。
author: sk372
source: It looks gelatinous at a glance, but POKENAME is actually coated with a thin yet sturdy shell around its soft insides. A transformation unlike its shapeshifting capabilities is taking place within.

entry: 融合加快了POKENAME的生长。为了容纳迅速长大的身体，外壳已经扩张到原来的三倍。
author: phantom640
source: Because of it's accelerated growth due to fusion, POKENAME has tripled it's normal shell size to accommodate for it's quickly growing body.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚韧又富有弹性，能在各种地形上滚动。它们常从高高的山丘滚下加速，一旦滚起来，几乎就停不住。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's shell is tough but elastic, allowing it to roll on any terrain it chooses. They tend to roll down large hills to build speed; once they start rolling, they are almost impossible to stop.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转，产生庞大的电力，最终甚至引发爆炸。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME can revolve so fast and generate so much electricity that they eventually explode.

entry: POKENAME虽有钢铁外骨骼，却比赫拉克罗斯更轻。它们会用锯齿状肢体弄坏捕虫陷阱，再吃掉诱饵，在捕虫少年间恶名昭彰。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: Despite POKENAME's steel exoskeletons, they are lighter than a Heracross. They are notorious among Bug Catchers for breaking traps set for Bug-types with their jagged limbs and eating the bait.

entry: 喂它原木，它就会吐出木板，再用这些板材制作简单的手工艺品。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: When fed logs, it dispenses planks of wood which it then uses to construct simple crafts.

entry: POKENAME常躲在废弃工厂，主要以遗留的机械为食。老旧厂房里往往满是它们的身影。
author: Daemonkill22
source: POKENAME often shelters within abandoned factories, where the remaining machinery acts as its primary food source. Old industrial plants swarm with this Pokémon.

entry: 彼此咬合的身体让它能像山地自行车般，在林间飞驰。许多林间土路，都是由它开辟的。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: This Pokémon's interlocking body allows it to speed through the forest like a mountain bike. It is the source of many natural dirt trails.

entry: POKENAME的叶片营养丰富，是铁与纤维的好来源。只是味道实在不怎么样。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME leaves are surprisingly healthy, and they're a good source of iron and fiber. They don't taste all too well, though.

entry: POKENAME能自主行动，设计用途就是不断收集垃圾，装满后到最近的垃圾箱倒空，再重复这一过程。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is an autonomous Pokémon that was designed to fill itself with garbage, empty itself in the nearest dumpster, and repeat the process.

entry: 它靠翅膀旋转产生的磁力悬浮。成群的POKENAME休息时会将翅膀连在一起，一旦天敌靠近，只需一只开始旋转，整群就能一同升空。
author: Staghorn
source: It hovers using the magnetism generated by its spinning wings. Flocking POKENAME link wings when at rest; if a predator approaches, it only takes a single POKENAME spinning up for the entire flock to take flight.

entry: 训练家可从相互咬合的齿轮转速，判断POKENAME的心情。它能量近乎无穷，有些训练家甚至跟不上POKENAME爱玩的劲头。
author: Schwaus
source: Trainers with a POKENAME can determine its mood by how fast it's interlocking gears are turning. It contains a near infinite energy, some Trainers aren't able to keep up with POKENAME's playful nature.

entry: POKENAME实在不幸：齿轮必须转动，才能产生维生的能量，可每转一圈都会挤歪颅骨，引发难忍的头痛。
author: sk372
source: A very unfortunate Pokémon, POKENAME's gears must turn in order to generate the energy needed to live, but every turn of the gears distorts its cranium and causes excruciating headaches.

entry: 身体由一套齿轮系统构成，能推动它在水中高速前进。光滑的表面像金属般反光，让POKENAME游泳时在水下闪闪发亮。
author: Rakunk
source: Its body is composed of a system of gears, aiding in propelling it through water with surprising speed. Its polished surface reflects light like metal, which allows POKENAME to glimmer underneath the water while swimming.

entry: 脖子过于纤长，稍感疲倦，就会被上方齿轮的重量压弯。动作看似笨拙，攻击却出奇精准。
author: epping_forest
source: The slenderness ratio of its neck is so high that it starts buckling when it feels tired, due to the weight of the upper gear. Its movements look clumsy, but its attacks are surprisingly accurate.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀被巨型齿轮取代，像甲壳般护住背部。增加的体重让它更容易借力，掀翻比自己大得多的宝可梦。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME has replaced its wings with a gigantic gear, which it uses as a shell to protect its back. Its increased weight allows it to get enough leverage to fling Pokémon much larger than it.

entry: POKENAME背上的齿轮会排开各种矿物，保持洁净，确保能继续旋转。排不开的东西，则可经象鼻排出。
author: bobosmith01
source: The gear on POKENAME's back repels various minerals in an effort to keep it clean and able to spin. Anything it is unable to repel can be excreted through its trunk.

entry: 由于长期吞食老工厂的机械，POKENAME长出了更大的金属身体。成群飞行时会与同伴碰撞，发出齿轮相磨的声音。
author: Daemonkill22
source: Due to its diet of old factory machinery, POKENAME has developed a larger metallic body. Its body collides with others when flying in a swarm, creating the sound of grinding gears.

entry: POKENAME靠蒸汽驱动，动作十分机械。乍看之下，有人以为POKENAME根本不是宝可梦，只是一台机器人。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is powered by steam. Its movements are very robotic. At first glance, some believe POKENAME isn't a Pokémon at all and that it is just a robot.

entry: 这次融合减弱了POKENAME爱捉弄人的一面，却未影响变身能力。如今它近乎孩童般天真爱玩，将变身也当作游戏。
author: El Fail
source: This fusion has significantly dampened the mischievous streak of POKENAME without impacting its ability to transform. As a result, it has an almost childlike innocence and playfulness, treating its ability to transform like a game.

entry: POKENAME极其虚荣。它变成酷似伊布的模样，却保留部分原本的特征，因为觉得这样更好看。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME is incredibly vain. It assumes a form that is similar to Eevee but keeps some of its old features because it believes that it looks better that way.
