entry: 人们将索罗亚资料加入数据集，试制出这只虚拟宠物宝可梦。索罗亚的数据让它学会伪装成其他程序，逃到野外，不断复制自身。
author: El Fail
source: This artificial Pokémon was first engineered by including data on Zorua into its dataset to create an experimental virtual pet. The Zorua data caused it to disguise itself as other programs, allowing it to escape into the wild and replicate.

entry: 白天，它大多休息，用幻象把自己伪装成树枝。到了夜里，深色羽毛与无声的双翼让它几乎无迹可寻，唯有阴森的叫声会泄露行踪。
author: El Fail
source: During the day, this Pokémon spends most of its time resting while wreathed in an illusion that disguises it as a tree branch. During the night, its dark plumage and silent wings make it nearly undetectable outside of its haunting cry.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，常在半空就睡着。传说，它们成群飞过时，会无意间将噩梦散播到天空中。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME drift through the air on gentle winds, often falling asleep mid-flight. Legends say that bad dreams are unintentionally spread through the skies by groups of this Pokémon when they fly by.

entry: POKENAME性情安静，几乎不动，伪装成自己赖以取食的树的一部分。一棵树上能住着数百只，路过的人却毫不知情。
author: El Fail
source: A very passive Pokémon, POKENAME moves little and pretends to be a part of the tree that it feeds off of. Hundreds of them can live in a colony on a single tree without anyone passing by ever knowing they are even there.

entry: POKENAME爱打理毛发，还会用人类的饰品装扮自己。每只都有不同的审美。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tend to style their fur and adorn themselves with human accessories. Their aesthetics vary across individuals.

entry: POKENAME制造自身的幻影捉弄人，最爱假装突然冲到车前，造成交通事故。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME creates illusions of itself to mess with people. Its favorite prank is to pretend to run out in front of vehicles and cause road accidents.

entry: POKENAME有时会得到来源不明的灾难预兆。为了警告人类，它会用幻象扮作人类孩子靠近，展示自己预见的危险。
author: El Fail
source: POKENAME sometimes receives premonitions of disasters from an unknown source. In order to warn humans, it will use illusions to disguise itself as a human child to approach them and show them the nature of the danger it has foreseen.

entry: 夜里偏离小路的人，可能遇见一个戴狐狸面具的孩子，那其实是POKENAME的伪装。它或许会将迷路者带回路上，也可能引入密林，让人从此不知所终。
author: El Fail
source: If a person wanders off the path at night, they may encounter a child in a fox mask. This is actually a POKENAME in disguise. They will either attempt to lead the lost person back to the path or deeper into the woods, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME用幻象把入鞘的剑变得像已出鞘，把出鞘的剑变得像仍在鞘中。若觉得对手识破，就会随机颠倒幻象。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses illusions so its sheathed sword appears uncovered, and it makes its unsheathed sword look as if it's covered. If it feels that its opponent has figured out the trick, it reverses the illusion at random.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: 实际上只有一个齿轮。但若POKENAME无法制造第二个齿轮的幻象，它就会彻底停止转动。
author: .realthree
source: Only one gear exists, but if something should happen to keep POKENAME from producing the illusion of the second gear, it stops spinning entirely.

entry: POKENAME躲在洞穴最暗的角落，不愿被看见。遭到围堵时，就变成来犯者的模样，吓对方一跳，再飞走。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME hides in the darkest corners of caves to avoid being seen. When cornered, it transforms into the appearance of its provoker to startle them, then flies away.

entry: POKENAME能用幻象伪装成任何毛绒玩具，因此极难找出。玩具店有时也会被它的恶作剧弄得难以清点库存。
author: .realthree
source: Because POKENAME can create an illusion of itself to look like any stuffed toy, it's very difficult to find. Toy stores sometimes have a hard time taking inventory because of this Pokémon's antics.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇有强烈的致幻作用，足以吓退捕食者。因此，它想到哪儿就到哪儿，毫无畏惧。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are potently hallucinogenic, which deters predators. Because of this, it fearlessly runs wherever it wishes.

entry: POKENAME用魔法摆锤使对方陷入鲜明的白日梦，借此避开危险。它只在深深信任的对象面前现身。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME uses its magic pendulum to induce strong daydreams, which helps it avoid danger. It will only reveal itself to those it trusts deeply.

entry: POKENAME很难控制尾焰，常不慎引燃一小片灌木，不过火势很容易扑灭。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME have a hard time controlling the flame on their tail. They are known to accidentally start small bushfires, but they are easy to put out.

entry: 强壮的双腿燃着火，随便踢一下都能造成重伤。每走一步，地上都会留下焦痕。
author: Krune
source: Any kick from this Pokémon, with its powerful flaming legs, will cause some serious damage. Its footsteps leave seared marks on the ground.

entry: POKENAME体内的气体极易燃烧。受到威胁时，它就用尾焰将其点燃，引发烈焰爆炸。气体也有腐蚀性，吸入会损伤肺部。
author: Mistymagius
source: The gas inside of POKENAME's body is highly flammable, and when threatened it will ignite the gas with its tail to cause a fiery explosion. The gas is also caustic, causing lung damage if inhaled.

entry: 火焰烧灼着翅尖，撒落的灰烬覆住身体，形成保护。这过程不会伤到POKENAME，却会危及旁人。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: A flame singes the tips of its wings, scattering ashes that coat and protect it. This process is harmless to POKENAME but hazardous to others.

entry: 它本能地吊在高高的树枝上，躲避天敌。可惜，尾焰常在进化完成前烧断树枝，让它跌落林地，暴露在危险中。
author: sk372
source: It instinctively hangs from high branches in order to avoid predators. Unfortunately, the flame on the end of its tail often burns through a branch before its evolution is complete, causing it to fall to the forest floor and become vulnerable.

entry: 羽毛覆着薄薄一层灰。受惊时，它就会猛烈扑腾，扬起一团烟雾。
author: Ozydamians
source: Its feathers are coated in a thin layer of ash. It flaps around wildly when frightened, kicking up a cloud of smoke.

entry: 野生POKENAME能迅速飞到近处躲雨，因此比小火龙更容易保护尾焰，免遭雨淋。
author: oxitape.
source: Wild POKENAME are able to protect their flaming tails from rain much more easily than Charmander by quickly flying to nearby shelter.

entry: POKENAME用尾羽将温暖的火星扇向巢中的蛋。若有天敌来偷蛋，POKENAME就会扬起烟幕，挥爪胡乱抓挠。
author: Ozydamians
source: With its tail feathers, POKENAME fans warm embers over the eggs in its nest. When a predator tries to steal its eggs, POKENAME whips up a smokescreen and slashes haphazardly with its talons.

entry: 它散发的热量能让人类与宝可梦都感到暖意融融，心中宽慰，因此常成为治疗师的伙伴。
author: Staghorn
source: The heat it produces also creates a "warm and fuzzy" feeling in humans and Pokémon. For this reason, they're a common partner for therapists.

entry: POKENAME曾被误认成发胖的火焰鸟。飞行时身后拖着浓浓黑烟，军队因此会借POKENAME远距离传递暗号。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME was once mistaken to be a chubby Moltres. Dark clouds of smoke trail behind it as it flies, so the military employs POKENAME to send coded messages across long distances.

entry: POKENAME淘气得出了名，被人视为麻烦。它用尾巴拾起物件，点燃后朝路人扔去，恶作剧相当危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mischievous nature has given it a reputation as a menace. It picks up objects with its tail, igniting them before throwing them at passersby as a rather dangerous prank.

entry: POKENAME壳里榨出的树果汁滚烫，适合做成驱寒的热饮，因此近来在寒冷地区越来越受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has begun to gain popularity in colder regions, as the berry juice created within its shell is piping hot, making it excellent for creating a warm beverage to counter the cold temperatures.

entry: 它吞食树枝，让腹中的火焰持续燃烧。若没有源源不断的燃料，内火就会减弱，使它在寒冷环境中难以自保。
author: .izik
source: It consumes tree branches to keep the flame in its belly burning. Without constant fuel, its internal fire would weaken, leaving it vulnerable in colder environments.

entry: POKENAME紧紧盘成螺旋，护住自己的火焰。鳞片摩擦生热，能烧伤被它缠住的对象。
author: Baverbrugge
source: POKENAME protects its flame by curling into a tight spiral. Its scales produce heat through friction, burning anything it manages to constrict.

entry: 它喷出阵阵烈焰，融化沿途冰雪，在冻原上开辟道路，让自己和其他宝可梦能自由通行。
author: .izik
source: It carves paths through the tundra with bursts of flame, melting snow and ice in its way. These fiery trails allow it and other Pokémon to move freely through frozen landscapes.

entry: POKENAME吃辣纯粹是为了有趣，总在寻找最辣的食材。再强烈的辣劲，也只会助长它体内的火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys eating spicy food purely for fun, seeking out the hottest ingredients it can find. The intense heat only fuels the flames within this Pokémon's body.

entry: 看尾巴烧短了多少，就能判断POKENAME的年龄。尾巴足够长，能一直烧到下一次进化。
author: dragonessanimations
source: How old a POKENAME is can be determined by how far its tail has burned down. Its tail is long enough for it to last up to its next evolution.

entry: POKENAME周身的火焰宛如天然罗盘，让它感知附近物体与地点的方位。据说，见到训练家时，火光会更明亮。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in flames that act as a natural compass, allowing it to sense the direction of nearby objects or locations. It is said to shine brighter at the sight of its Trainer.

entry: 经过驯养，这只宝可梦始终没有养成同族惯有的好胜心。若在沙漠跋涉，有一群手脚灵巧、心思细密的它们作伴，便是再难得不过的帮手。
author: .fedoraman
source: Domestication has resulted in this Pokémon never developing the competitive spirit its species is otherwise known for. Its quick feet, dexterous hands, and attentive mind make a swarm of them an invaluable asset when traversing the desert.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME九条尾巴上的火焰若同时熄灭，它便会死去。此后，POKENAME的灵魂将诅咒肇事者，纠缠对方直到生命终结。
author: sk372
source: Some old tales say that if all nine of a POKENAME's tail-flames are extinguished at once, it will perish. These legends claim the POKENAME's soul will curse the one responsible, haunting them to their final days.

entry: POKENAME生性懒惰，常常活不到完全长成。即使雨水正浇灭尾焰，它们也只是气鼓鼓地继续睡。
author: Scapz
source: POKENAME often never make it to full maturity due to their slothful nature. They slumber indignantly even as the rain extinguishes their tails.

entry: POKENAME在温水中欢快嬉戏，总尽量让尾巴露在水面上。潜水时则用泡泡裹住尾巴，等里面的空气用尽后再浮回水面。
author: Markusknight
source: Cheerfully playing around in warm waters, POKENAME always tries to keep its tail above water. When diving, they surround it in a water bubble and come back after air in the bubble runs out.

entry: POKENAME夜里会掘出深深的隧道，藏住尾巴的光。为了进一步隐蔽，新陈代谢也会减慢，尾焰缩成一点微光。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME digs deep tunnels at night to hide the light emanating from its tail. To further hide itself, its metabolism slows and its flame shrinks to a faint flicker.

entry: POKENAME没什么斗志，在同族中总处于最底层。圈养时，人们又刻意培养它的温顺，让它始终没有染上同族出名的暴脾气。
author: .fedoraman
source: In a swarm of its kin, POKENAME remains at the bottom of the pecking order due to its lack of fighting spirit. When raised in captivity, this docility is cultivated and they never develop the fiery temper their species is known for.

entry: POKENAME用火熔化沙子，筑成玻璃巢穴。闪闪发亮的住处既能庇护自己，也能迷惑毫无防备的猎物，让它们落入陷阱。
author: .izik
source: By using its flames, POKENAME melts sand to create dens made of glass. These shimmering dens serve as both glittering shelters for this Pokémon and also befuddling traps for unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME天性爱恶作剧，通常会突然吓其他宝可梦一跳。若吃不到足够的宝石，尾焰就会变得微弱暗淡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Mischievous in nature, POKENAME love to play pranks on other Pokémon, usually by startling them. If it does not eat enough jewels, the fire on its tail will grow dim and weak.

entry: POKENAME常拿不准该喷火还是喷雪，不停在两者间切换。连它自己都不确定，对手也就难以预料攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently becomes confused about whether to breathe flames or snow, often switching between the two. This unpredictable nature makes it difficult for opponents to anticipate this Pokémon's attacks.

entry: 研究者发现，POKENAME在冰川家园中会四只或更多挤成一团移动。目前认为，这是为了挡住突来的阵风与暴风雪，保护尾焰，集体保暖。
author: Katie
source: Pokémon researchers have observed POKENAME moving across their glacial homes in huddled groups of four or more. The current theory is that they do so to protect their flames from abrupt gusts of wind or blizzards, letting them stay warm as a group.

entry: 尖刺散发着高热，碰到什么就灼烧什么。天敌很难靠近而不被烫伤。
author: .izik
source: Its spines radiate heat, scorching anything that touches them. These fiery spines make it difficult for predators to approach without getting burned.

entry: 胸中炽热的斗志，让它不断训练，磨炼肌肉。力量越强，尾焰也烧得越旺。
author: sk372
source: Its fiery spirit makes it train constantly to hone its muscles. As it grows in strength, the flame on its tail burns more intensely.

entry: 周身燃着火焰是它的自然状态，也能强有力地威慑天敌。浇灭火焰并不会伤害它，却会让它虚弱无力，失去防备。
author: sk372
source: Its appearance of being engulfed in fire is its natural state, the flames on its body providing a potent deterrent to predators. Dousing the flame will not harm it, but will leave it weak and defenseless.

entry: POKENAME常忘记尾焰也是自己的一部分。被自己的尾巴吓得逃跑，或不慎烧伤自己，都是常有的事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often forgets the flame on its tail is a part of itself. Running from its own tail or accidentally burning itself with it are common occurrences.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里睡觉，靠尾焰取暖。若去打扰熟睡的POKENAME，它就会从壳上的孔洞喷火。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will tuck themselves into their shell, using the flame from their tail to stay warm as they sleep. Attempting to disturb a sleeping POKENAME will cause them to release fire from the holes in their shell.

entry: POKENAME的每只螯都能喷出短促的火焰，用来烹熟猎物，也用于领地争斗。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's claws can produce short bursts of flame. It uses these flames to cook captured prey and for territorial disputes.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩友善，能跳到超过7英尺的高度。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is known for being extremely playful and friendly. It can jump to a height of over 7 feet.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢让人把自己当作枕头，靠着入睡。据说，被POKENAME抱着睡，是世上最惬意的安眠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME love nothing more than to be pillows for people to sleep against. It's said there is no more pleasant a sleep than one experienced while being cradled by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极其爱护蛋与幼小的宝可梦，能将身体鼓到大象般大，吓退袭击者。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME is highly protective of eggs and young Pokémon. It can inflate itself to the size of an elephant to ward off attackers.

entry: 它身体强壮，硬如花岗岩，却渴望亲昵的拥抱。因此会在身上堆满枕头与软布，让人更想抱一抱。
author: SonTyp
source: This strong Pokémon‘s body is hard as granite. Missing physical affection, it covers itself in pillows and soft fabrics to appear more huggable.

entry: 后面的头爱唱歌，唱得却连主头也受不了。歌声长年不断，让主头随着年龄增长，听力越来越差。
author: Mistymagius
source: The back head loves to sing, even though its singing is so bad not even the main head can stand it. Due to the constant singing, the main head's hearing gets worse as it gets older.

entry: POKENAME通常居于高山，在连绵峰顶维持大片领地。它们以响亮回荡的歌声，向胖王和敌对的POKENAME传递讯息。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME typically dwell high in the mountains, maintaining large territories across the peaks of their homes. They signal to Wigglyking and rival POKENAME with loud, echoing songs.

entry: 出众的歌声能令听众着迷，为它聚来大批死心塌地的歌迷，愿意替它做任何事。可演出一旦被打断，它发起火来，连脾气最坏的歌坛天后都比不上。
author: El Fail
source: Its incredible singing voice has the power to enthrall listeners, which allows it to amass giant crowds of loyal fans that will do anything for it. Its rage when a performance is disrupted can put even the most disgruntled diva to shame.

entry: POKENAME深吸一口气，鼓起身体，就能轻轻浮上天空。放气时则看心情，发出舒缓的声音，或极具破坏力的尖啸。
author: SonTyp
source: By inhaling deeply, POKENAME can inflate itself enough to gently float through the air. When it deflates, it creates soothing sounds or devastating screeches, depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME细密蓬松的毛发柔软无比。但POKENAME转眼就能将毛丝织成带电的网，因此鲜有人能摸到。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's fine, fluffy fur is wonderfully soft. However, since POKENAME can spin strands of the fur into an electrically charged web within moments, few ever get to touch it.

entry: 它毛发华美，歌声舒缓而催眠。讨喜的外貌引来大批观众，既满足被关注的渴望，又有更多食物可偷。
author: El Fail
source: This Pokémon possesses luxurious fur and a soothingly hypnotic voice. Its appealing appearance allows it to lure in large audiences, which gives it the attention it craves and more food to steal.

entry: POKENAME依附在人类与其他宝可梦身上，吸收静电。毛发实在柔软得让人爱不释手，许多人都梦想被POKENAME选中。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME clings to humans and other Pokémon to absorb static electricity. Since its fur is luxuriously soft, many dream of being chosen by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软极了，摸一摸就能让人开心。若发现谁情绪低落，它便不断亲昵地蹭过去，直到对方好受些。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely soft and can make anyone feel happy just by touching it. If it finds someone feeling down, it has a tendency to nuzzle them until they feel better.

entry: 准备蜕变时，POKENAME会闭合花苞，硬化外壳。临近破壳，又会重新张开花苞，吸收能量，完成最后的蜕变。
author: Holgast
source: As POKENAME prepare for metamorphosis, they close their buds and harden their shells. Just before they emerge, they open their buds again to absorb energy for the last push.

entry: POKENAME被挡住阳光就会气恼。若挡光的是植物，它便飞起来将其剪断，再看那些叶片能否拿来垫铺或当毯子，好让自己躺得舒服些。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME gets frustrated when something covers it from the sunlight. If it is another plant, it flies up and cuts it, to later see if the leaves can be used as a seam or a blanket to lie more comfortably.

entry: POKENAME的身体小巧轻盈，很容易飞起来，却不太能控制飞行的方向。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's small and light body helps them to fly. Unfortunately, they struggle to control their flight path.

entry: POKENAME喜欢阳光充足的草甸，从花朵吸收能量。它轻盈地穿梭花间，将欢乐带给周围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in sunlit meadows, where it absorbs energy from flowers. It flits between blossoms, spreading cheer with its gentle movements.

entry: POKENAME移动时会伴着细微的响动，提醒别人它正靠近。声音虽小，却能让其他野生宝可梦为它留些距离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's movements are accompanied by a soft rattle, warning others of its approach. This sound, though faint, helps it maintain its personal space among wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME仍喜爱阳光，但越接近进化，光合作用就越困难。有时它会将树果夹在螯里，花上数日慢慢消化。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME still loves sunlight, but the closer it gets to evolving, the harder it is to photosynthesize. Sometimes, it catches berries inside its claw and spends days digesting them.

entry: 通常能在沙漠绿洲里找到POKENAME。它满足地坐在水中，能泡多久就泡多久。
author: roxie5228
source: One can usually find POKENAME at an oasis in the desert, where it will sit, content, soaking in the water for as long as it can.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，总躲进阴暗的灌木或花田下。它需要阳光才能好好成长，若能勇敢些，本可长得更快。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in shady undergrowth or under flower fields. If it were braver, it could develop more quickly, as it needs sunlight to thrive.

entry: POKENAME放出的孢子会让附近的生物打喷嚏。无害的孢子随风飘散，既能自卫，也是淘气的玩笑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases spores that induce sneezing in anything nearby. These spores drift harmlessly through the air, acting as both a defense mechanism and a playful prank.

entry: POKENAME先向水中释放细小的电流，杀菌净水，再把身体浸入其中，吸收水分，帮助生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose small bolts of electricity into the water to sterilize it. After this, it dips its body into the water to absorb it and grow.

entry: 它吸收附近土壤中的金属与矿物，融入皮肤和尖刺。冬天越近，身体越沉、行动越慢，最终重得无法移动，便进入休眠。
author: Staghorn
source: It absorbs metals and minerals from nearby soil, incorporating them into its skin and spines. It becomes heavier and slower as winter approaches, eventually going dormant once it becomes too heavy to move.

entry: POKENAME散发温暖的花香，安抚周围的宝可梦。活动时香气更加浓郁，让盛放的花田充满安宁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a warm, floral scent that soothes nearby Pokémon. This fragrance intensifies as it moves, making it a beacon of tranquility in blooming fields.

entry: POKENAME模样纤巧，却散发令人不安的气息。它有节奏地摇摆，让旁观者不知该沉醉还是害怕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits an unsettling presence despite its delicate appearance. It sways rhythmically, leaving others unsure whether to be entranced or unnerved.

entry: POKENAME走过后，独特的香气仍久久不散。气味会吸引其他宝可梦，却并非谁都喜欢那股刺鼻的浓烈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a distinct aroma that lingers long after it passes by. This scent attracts other Pokémon, though not all are pleased by its pungency.

entry: POKENAME在小花苞里储存电力，用来自卫。它会攀附电源线，吸收能量。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its small buds, which it uses to defend itself. It latches onto power cords in order to absorb energy.

entry: POKENAME用玫瑰将敌人引入陷阱，再挥镰斩击。高速飞过时留下一路芳香，稍过片刻，便转瞬消散。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME lures its enemies into a trap with its roses and slashes them with its scythes. It flies at high speed and leaves a trail of fragrance that disappears in a blink after a few moments.

entry: POKENAME裹着粗厚的藤蔓，便于伪装，躲避天敌。虽然满是尖刺，刺却不锋利，可以放心触摸。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is wrapped in thick vines that help it camouflage from predators. Despite being covered in thorns, they are not very sharp and are safe to touch.

entry: POKENAME的白玫瑰象征爱与高洁，常受精英训练家饲养。它们竭力保护弱小的宝可梦，尤其是异性。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's white roses are symbols of love and nobility and are commonly owned by elite Trainers. They go out of their way to defend weaker Pokémon, especially ones of the opposite gender.

entry: POKENAME的毒爪藏在玫瑰花苞之下。常能见到它们从枝头跃下，用毒刺伏击猎物。
author: Mistymagius
source: Underneath the rose buds hide POKENAME's poisonous claws. They can frequently be seen jumping from tree branches, ambushing prey by stabbing them with their toxic thorns.

entry: 体表的叶片坚韧无比，战斗时能当作铠甲。雄性POKENAME常相互争斗，求取羽毛最美的雌性的青睐。
author: Mistymagius
source: The leaves on its body are extremely tough and act as protective armor in battle. Male POKENAME frequently engage in combat to woo the females with the prettiest plumage.

entry: 叶状的双翼锋利如钢，轻易就能斩开树木。但POKENAME十分友善，允许其他宝可梦为脚上的花授粉。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its leaf-like wings are as sharp as steel, able to slice through trees with ease. Despite this, POKENAME is very friendly and allows other Pokémon to pollinate the flowers on its feet.

entry: 它是春季很受欢迎的宝可梦。POKENAME在花田中欢快起舞，散发的香气让训练家不由自主地开心起来。
author: Mistymagius
source: A popular Pokémon during the spring season. POKENAME playfully dance around flower fields, emitting a scent that makes Trainers uncontrollably happy.

entry: POKENAME住在绿洲，藏身枝叶间。身体健康时，花朵会散发令人愉悦放松的香气。
author: estrellafruit
source: POKENAME reside in oases and hide amongst the foliage. Its flowers release a pleasant and relaxing aroma when it is healthy.

entry: 组成尾巴的玫瑰散发着诱人的香味。可得当心！一旦靠得太近，POKENAME就能从花里喷出猛烈的火焰！
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The roses that form its tail emit a tantalizing scent. But watch out! If anyone gets too close to them, POKENAME can emit devastating flames from the flowers!

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: 这种慵懒的宝可梦常在大片森林里闲躺，慢慢啃花。POKENAME颈边的花散发舒缓的香气，仿佛玫瑰与松木混在一起。
author: Mistymagius
source: These lazy Pokémon can be seen lounging around large forests, slowly gnawing on flowers. The flower on POKENAME's neck releases a relaxing scent that smells like a mixture of roses and pinewood.

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME开心时，耳上的花苞会散发怡人的香味，常被用于香水。可毛发里藏着利刺，抱起来并不舒服。
author: Mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is happy, the buds on its ears release a pleasant scent often used in perfumes. Its fur coat hides sharp thorns that make it unpleasant to hug.

entry: 它们成群附在树木与灌丛上，缓缓转动，产生能量。受威胁时，便将能量集中到玫瑰花苞中，射出强劲的激光。
author: Mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon can be seen attached to trees and bushes, slowly spinning to produce energy. When threatened, they concentrate this energy in their rose buds to unleash a powerful laser.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，沿途洒落彩色的花瓣。人们常将其收集起来，相信攒得够多，就能获得永恒的爱情。
author: Mistymagius
source: As POKENAME drifts along the breeze, it drops colorful flower petals. People often collect these petals, believing that gathering enough brings eternal love.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼会散播效力很强的花粉，帮助花朵生长。容易过敏的人，最好远离POKENAME大量聚集的地方。
author: Mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, its wings spread a strong pollen that helps flowers grow. People with allergies should stay away from areas where large groups of POKENAME can be found.

entry: 花园若疏于照料，可能就会被POKENAME占据。它的“眼睛”伪装成花朵，引诱猎物靠近。
author: Staghorn
source: If you don't take good care of your garden, it may become infested with POKENAME. Its "eyes" mimic flowers in order to lure in potential prey.

entry: POKENAME始终静止不动，以免损伤身上娇嫩的花。角上带着剧毒，触碰就可能致命。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always stationary to avoid damaging the delicate flowers on its body. Its horns are laced with a strong poison that can be deadly when touched.

entry: 晴天，常能看见成群的POKENAME一边睡觉，一边吸收太阳的能量。POKENAME越健康，花香就越甜美。
author: Mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen sleeping on sunny days to draw energy from the sun. The healthier POKENAME is, the sweeter the scent from its flowers becomes.

entry: 据说，迷失的灵魂会在心怀恶意的毒蔷薇体内扎根，最终长成POKENAME。它们惊吓迷路的林中人，为自然遭受的破坏寻求报复。
author: Altius
source: It is said that lost spirits take root within malevolent Roselia until they grow into POKENAME. These creatures scare people lost in the woods, seeking revenge for the destruction of nature.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太弱，几乎无法飞行。受威胁时便会拼命振翅，撒出花中带刺激性的花粉。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's weak wings make it almost impossible for it to fly. When threatened, it will frantically flap its wings, spreading the irritating pollen from its flowers.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺越大，毒性就越强。花园中常能见到成群的POKENAME，以小型虫属性宝可梦为食。
author: Mistymagius
source: The larger the thorns on POKENAME's head, the more powerful its poison it produces. Groups of POKENAME can be seen in flower gardens, feeding on small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME姿态美丽，常在花田中欢快奔跃。奇怪的是，身上的火焰烧不伤其他植物。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a thing of beauty and can be seen playfully galloping around flower fields. The flames on its body curiously cannot burn other plant life.

entry: 体内的空气带着淡淡的发霉罗勒味。无论它漂到哪里，这股怪味都能留下长达3小时。
author: .izik
source: The air inside its body smells faintly of moldy basil. This odd aroma lingers for up to 3 hours wherever it drifts.

entry: 尾巴充满气体后，它能浮到离地最高300英尺处，将四周尽收眼底。
author: .izik
source: Its tail fills with gas, allowing it to float up to 300 feet above the ground. This altitude gives it a wide view of its surroundings.

entry: 橡胶般的身体在山地弹跳前进，让它能轻松穿越崎岖的地形。
author: .izik
source: Its rubbery form bounces through mountainous areas as it travels. This unique motion helps it cover rough terrain with ease.

entry: POKENAME一出现在居民区附近，大人就会赶紧将孩子带进屋，因为它身上的绳索十分危险。轻轻一拉就能引发巨大爆炸，因此POKENAME常住在废弃城镇及其周边。
author: FaeFlame
source: If a POKENAME appears near a community, children are quickly ushered inside due to its dangerous cords. A single tug on these cords can cause a massive explosion, and as a result, POKENAME often reside in and around ghost towns.

entry: 飘飘球以掳走孩子闻名，POKENAME却是很好的伙伴。POKENAME常成群漂在嘉年华会场，陪一家大小玩耍。
author: odditylad
source: Unlike Drifloon that are known for stealing children away, POKENAME make great companions. POKENAME can often be found floating around carnivals in groups and playing with families.

entry: 有时POKENAME会呈现小小象的配色，而非飘飘球的颜色，原因尚不清楚。不过，这些个体往往更受孩子喜爱。
author: odditylad
source: Sometimes POKENAME take on the colouring of a Phanpy instead of a Drifloon. It is not known why, however, these variants tend to be even more popular with kids.

entry: 牵着POKENAME的沙袋，让它无法长时间漂浮，令POKENAME十分懊恼。
author: ohok3441
source: The sandbag holding POKENAME keeps it from floating for long periods of time. This causes POKENAME frustration.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵变得如幽灵般缥缈，原本猛烈的打击也柔和了许多。如今，它改用云絮般的耳朵，送出少量令人刺痛的能量。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME's ears have turned ghostly, and the once-brutal strikes it delivers have softened considerably. Instead, it uses the cloud-like wisps to deliver subtle doses of stinging energy.

entry: 它漂在空中，释放一道道小闪电。电击既能驱退天敌，也让它成为一幅电光闪耀的奇景。
author: .izik
source: While floating through the sky, it releases small bolts of lightning. These shocks deter predators and make it an electric spectacle.

entry: 它坚决守护古墓与巨石碑，不让拾荒者侵扰。任何胆敢靠近的对象，都会遭到毫不退让的抵抗。
author: .izik
source: It fiercely guards ancient tombs and monoliths from scavengers. Any who dare approach are met with its unyielding defense.

entry: POKENAME举起气球，看似在欢呼，其实是在等一阵风，好借风旅行。心形的配重并不太能把它留在原地。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME raises its balloons to cheer, it's really trying to catch a breeze for traveling. Its heart-shaped weights don't hold it in place well.

entry: 随风漂行时，它显得慢吞吞。可只要鼓起头部与翅膀，就能升上天空，快得转眼消失。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: It appears sluggish when it lets itself be carried by the wind. However, by inflating its head and wings, it can rise into the air and disappear surprisingly quickly.

entry: 它躺在海滩上晒太阳，温暖体内的空气。捕食者靠近时，就会鼓起身体，显得更大、更吓人。
author: .izik
source: Lying on beaches, it absorbs sunlight to warm the air inside its body. When predators approach, it puffs up to appear larger and more intimidating.

entry: POKENAME群体规模庞大，一旦占住某地，就几乎赶不走。借背上的球体短距离飘行，它们能轻松将食物带回群落。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME live in colonies of vast sizes, and once they have claimed an area it is nearly impossible to get them to leave. Using the orbs on their back they float short distances bringing food back to the colony with ease.

entry: 鼓起身体后，触角会变得烫手。高热既是警告，也是防御的手段。
author: .izik
source: When inflated, its antennae become incredibly hot to the touch. This heat acts as both a warning and a defense mechanism.

entry: 它虽像普通的绿色气球，剑般的大葱却坚硬危险，挥使起来还熟练得出人意料。
author: .izik
source: Despite resembling an ordinary green balloon, its sword-like leek is incredibly hard and dangerous. It uses this weapon with surprising skill.

entry: 鼻中逸出的气体会引人困倦，牙科诊所常借它安抚病人。带催眠作用的气味，让它成了奇特的帮手。
author: .izik
source: The air escaping from its nose induces drowsiness, often used in dental offices to calm patients. Its sleepy scent makes it a curious helper.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶子保护着篮子般头部中的东西。只有受它信任的训练家，才可以取走里面的彩绘蛋。
author: ohok3441
source: The leaves atop POKENAME protect the contents of its basket-like head. Only trusted Trainers are allowed to remove the painted eggs it carries.

entry: 据说，POKENAME掉下的红蛋象征新生，因此常被用作节庆的食物。
author: .realthree
source: The red eggs that POKENAME drops are said to symbolize new life. Because of that, they're eaten at many festive celebrations.

entry: POKENAME在田间跳来跳去，寻找食物。蓬松的毛发储存着静电，受惊时就会释放。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams fields in search of food, hopping from patch to patch. Its fluffy coat stores static electricity, which it discharges when startled.

entry: 漂浮时，头上的叶子散发浓香，闻起来像胡萝卜蛋糕与丁香。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on its head release a strong aroma while it floats. The smell is reminiscent of carrot cake and cloves.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，便摆出防御姿势，竖起耳朵，让自己显得更大。看似威风，性情却往往胆小。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes a defensive stance whenever it senses danger, raising its ears to appear larger. It has an imposing presence, though it is often timid in nature.

entry: 厚实的绒毛与坚固的甲壳，让POKENAME防御力出众。它们偏爱鼠曲草类植物与香蒲。
author: Frokachu
source: With a combination of thick wool and a sturdy shell, POKENAME have powerful defenses They prefer eating cottonweeds and cattail plants.

entry: POKENAME住在老橡树的树洞里，用落叶铺好巢穴。不论游荡多远，它都知道回家的路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in the hollow of an old oak, using fallen leaves to line its home. It always knows its way back, no matter how far it wanders.

entry: 想让暴怒的POKENAME平静，唯一的办法就是抚摸它。若尚未哄好便停手，POKENAME就会张臂紧抱，让训练家窒息，送上一个“永恒的拥抱”。
author: TeatedTiten
source: The only way to calm an enraged POKENAME is to pet it. If a Trainer stops petting it before it calms down, POKENAME will wrap its arms around them and suffocate them as an everlasting hug.

entry: POKENAME一路蹦跳，一路掉下细软的绒毛，留下毛茸茸的痕迹。据说，收集这些绒毛能带来好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds delicate tufts of fur as it hops, leaving fuzzy trails behind. The tufts are said to bring luck to those who collect them.

entry: POKENAME藏在山毛榉林中，以树冠作为天然屏障。动作轻盈又富有弹性，让它很难被追踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides among beech trees, using the forest canopy as a natural shield. Its light and bouncy movements make it difficult to track.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时会散播蒲公英种子，沿途留下绒絮般的孢子。种子轻轻飘在空中，借微风传播到远方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads dandelion seeds as it hops, leaving trails of fluffy spores in its wake. These seeds drift gently through the air, carried far and wide by the breeze.

entry: POKENAME适于生活在沼泽，在泥地与水洼间跳跃。它发出微弱的电脉冲，感知浑浊环境中的动静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in marshy areas, hopping between patches of mud and water. It generates faint electrical pulses, which help it detect movement in the murky environment.

entry: POKENAME不仅能以惊人的速度逃离捕食者，每团棉絮般的毛簇也都能猛然出拳，快得让人眼花。它们的毛能做成最柔软的枕头。
author: Wormspawn
source: In addition to the striking speed at which POKENAME can flee from predators, each of its cotton-like tufts can lash out with a dizzying punch. Their fur makes the softest pillows.

entry: POKENAME天性亲人，虽然模样诡异，仍竭尽全力想与训练家交朋友。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are affectionate by nature. They try their best to befriend Trainers despite their uncanny appearance.

entry: POKENAME空洞的脸让人害怕。近来，一则虚构的POKENAME闹鬼故事在网上传得沸沸扬扬，令人闻之色变。
author: ohok3441
source: People have found POKENAME's hollow face to be frightening. Recently, a fictional story about a haunted POKENAME became infamous online.

entry: POKENAME的毛发间满是极微小的冰晶，让体温保持低冷。天气炎热时，它们就会变得迟钝。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's fur is full of nearly microscopic ice crystals, keeping their temperature low. Hot weather makes them sluggish.

entry: POKENAME耳边长着小花，吸引友善的宝可梦。花朵散发甜香，让它所到之处都充满欢乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows small flowers along its ears, which it uses to attract friendly Pokémon. These blossoms release a sweet scent, spreading joy wherever it hops.

entry: 花瓣布满细小的倒钩刺。若碰到裸露的皮肤，就得请医生帮忙，才能安全取下。
author: .izik
source: The petals of the flowers on its body are filled with tiny barbed thorns. Should a petal touch bare skin, it will require a physician to be safely removed.

entry: POKENAME行动流畅，在沙漠中穿行自如，凭灵活的身手甩开天敌，轻松避开障碍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's movements are fluid, letting it weave effortlessly through desert landscapes. It uses this agility to outmaneuver predators and dodge obstacles with ease.

entry: POKENAME用海藻装点身体，融入海岸环境。它将小宝物埋进沙中，严加守护，不让好奇的宝可梦染指。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME adorns itself with seaweed to blend in along the shore. It buries small treasures in the sand, guarding them fiercely from curious Pokémon.

entry: 饿得走投无路时，POKENAME会吃掉鬃毛里长出的胡萝卜。不过，它更喜欢吃惊角鹿。
author: .realthree
source: In times of hungry desperation, POKENAME will eat the carrots growing in its mane, though it prefers to eat Stantler.

entry: 据说POKENAME拥有世上最可爱动听的嗓音。可惜生性害羞，总无法好好唱出来。
author: Hexx_Vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to have the cutest and most beautiful voice in the world. Unfortunately, its shy nature prevents it from properly singing.

entry: POKENAME借树枝发力，在白桦树间敏捷跳跃。它喜欢独处，保卫领地时却格外凶猛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps between birch trees with great agility, using branches to propel itself forward. It prefers solitude, though it will defend its territory with fierce energy.

entry: 据说，在睡梦中与POKENAME相遇，会招来噩梦。它平时喜欢藏起来，只有感到受威胁才会惹出麻烦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is said to bring nightmares to those it encounters while sleeping. It prefers to remain hidden, stirring up trouble only when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME体内的化合物能为人类与宝可梦退烧。它在林间跳跃着寻找草药，随时准备调制药物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body contains compounds that can reduce fevers in both Pokémon and humans. It hops around forests in search of herbs, always ready to prepare a remedy.

entry: POKENAME用壳保护柔软的身体。多余的毛发则能缠住纠缠不休的敌人。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's shells protect their soft bodies. Their excess fur tangles up persistent foes.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤能唤起欢乐，连暴走的肯泰罗也能安抚。友善的性情与柔软的毛发，让它广受喜爱。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME's pendulum invokes feelings of joy in others, and can calm even a rampaging Tauros. It is beloved for its friendly temperament and soft fur.

entry: POKENAME无声地在空中起舞，将孢子撒遍森林。孢子长成的真菌能迅速清除枯树。千万不要触碰这些真菌，它们能从任何表面生长，并让人产生幻觉。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME silently dances through the air, scattering spores throughout forests. The spores grow into a fungus that quickly clears dead trees. Be warned not to touch the fungus, as it can grow from any surface and cause you to hallucinate.

entry: POKENAME靠滚动前进，沿途散播孢子。一天就能沿超过10英里的路程撒下孢子。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Rolling around to travel, POKENAME will spread its spores as it goes. In a single day it can plant over 10 miles of spores.

entry: 它最早在合众地区被目击，模样酷似一位知名主播的吉祥物。攻击时会旋转身体，散播孢子。
author: hypernovahusky
source: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.

entry: 它最早在合众地区被目击，模样酷似一位知名主播的吉祥物。攻击时会旋转身体，散播孢子。
author: hypernovahusky
source: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.

entry: 它最早在合众地区被目击，模样酷似一位知名主播的吉祥物。攻击时会旋转身体，散播孢子。
author: hypernovahusky
source: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.

entry: 据说，POKENAME由一只吃了大量蘑菇的波加曼变成。日子久了，吃下的蘑菇便与身体融为一体。
author: beedev.
source: It is said that POKENAME has come from a Piplup that ate a lot of mushrooms. Over time, the mushrooms that this Piplup ate have been infused with its body.

entry: 它淘气地藏在蘑菇丛间，等待敌人靠近，再用锐利的金属肢体伏击。受威胁时，POKENAME会放出使敌人混乱或入睡的孢子，趁机逃走。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: This mischievous Pokémon hides among mushrooms, waiting to ambush foes with its sharp, metallic limbs. When threatened, POKENAME releases spores that cause confusion or puts opponents to sleep, giving it a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME从胸前的晶体器官中萌生，以堆肥土壤为食，补充念力。
author: slowforest
source: POKENAME sprouts from the crystalline organ on its chest. It feeds on composted soil to recharge its psychokinetic powers.

entry: 一群POKENAME喜欢聚在潮湿的林地上，用长满苔藓的翅膀伪装自己。只要有一只察觉危险，就会通知同伴，大家便一边逃跑，一边在身后撒下孢子。
author: potato_tub
source: Groups of POKENAME like to flock on damp forest floors, using their mossy wings as camouflage. If a member of the flock senses danger, it alerts the others, causing them to flee while scattering spores behind them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在洞穴或密林深处的湿土里打盹。在它附近睡着，会做奇幻的梦。
author: Danarchist
source: POKENAME prefer to doze in the damp soil found in caves and deep woods. Those who fall asleep near one experience fantastical dreams.

entry: 据传，POKENAME寄宿着一位艺术家的灵魂。那人生前爱把花缝进作品，它们也总眷恋着往昔，难以安于当下。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are rumored to harbor the spirit of an artist who enjoyed stitching flowers to his art. They tend to focus more on the past than living in the present for the most part.

entry: POKENAME始终陪伴训练家，同甘共苦。若训练家情绪低落，它便想尽办法逗对方微笑。
author: Inksans201x
source: POKENAME stick with their Trainers through thick and thin. If their Trainers are feeling blue, they do what they can to make them grin.

entry: 被怨影龟控制的草苗龟进化时，布质的外皮可能撑破。若能保持完整，就能顺利进化为POKENAME。
author: Hellaluyeah
source: When a Turtwig evolves while being controlled by a Shupwig, the fabric skin threatens to tear. If it stays intact, the evolution to POKENAME is complete.

entry: POKENAME像个被附身的兔形布偶。构成身体的碎布薄得不可思议，明明仍遵循通常的物理法则，放在手上却几乎感觉不到。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME resembles a possessed rabbit-shaped ragdoll. The rags that make its body are so impossibly thin, they feel like nothing on your hand, despite the fabric obeying the normal laws of physics.

entry: POKENAME吸收负面情绪与噩梦，让周围的人心神安宁。睡眠治疗师会借它治疗睡眠瘫痪。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME absorbs negative emotions and nightmares, which leaves those around it feeling at peace. Sleep therapists employ it to treat sleep paralysis.

entry: 深海生活让POKENAME的皮肤失去了所有色素。头上的光会伪装成发光水母，引诱猎物靠近。
author: Katie
source: Living in the deep sea, POKENAME have lost all pigmentation in their skin. The lights on their heads lure prey by fooling them into thinking they are bioluminescent jellyfish.

entry: POKENAME凝胶状的身体容许固体穿过，却不让水通过。幼小的铁炮鱼常躲在这黏稠液体中，安全地搭便车前往新的觅食地。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body allows solid objects, but not water, to pass through it. Young Remoraid often hitch rides to new feeding grounds in the safety of this viscous fluid.

entry: POKENAME沐浴月光，重新生成包裹身体的保护性凝胶。但此时POKENAME无法移动，只能放出超能力射线驱退天敌。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME basks in the moonlight, using it as a way to regenerate its protective gel-like fluid surrounding its body. However, this leaves POKENAME immobile, making it rely on emitting psychic rays to ward off any predators.

entry: POKENAME小巧黏软，生性贪玩，能随意伸展变形。它会借流动的身体，对毫无防备的敌人发动出其不意的小型超能力攻击。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a small, gooey Pokémon. Its playful nature allows it to stretch and reshape, using its fluid form to launch surprising small psychic attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME成群顺着河流轻松漂行。捕食者靠近时，就发出超能力振动，潜入水下。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME travel in groups, floating along effortlessly using river currents. Should a predator approach, they produce psychic vibrations to dip under the surface of the water.

entry: 柔软的凝胶身体让POKENAME容易遭到捕食。它们用黏性身体搜集贝壳，借此保护自己。
author: Katie
source: The soft and gelatinous bodies of POKENAME leave them vulnerable to predators. They scavenge sea shells using their sticky bodies, keeping themselves safe from danger.

entry: 藤蔓渗出的绿色黏液如同强力胶，一旦黏住，几乎就无法清除。
author: .izik
source: Sticky green fluid leaks from its vines, acting as an incredibly adhesive glue. This substance is almost impossible to remove once it bonds.

entry: 它能轻松穿过浓稠的泥浆。与多数黏液生物不同，身上那层糖浆并不黏，反而有助于行动。
author: .izik
source: Its body allows it to move effortlessly through thick mud. Unlike most slimes, the syrup coating it is not sticky, aiding its mobility.

entry: 它发出超能力波，让身体高速旋转，激起强劲的阵风，抵御来敌。
author: .izik
source: It emits waves of psychic energy to spin its body at incredible speeds. This rotation can create powerful gusts of wind to fend off attackers.

entry: POKENAME黏软的身体外覆着一层薄而滑的膜，能缓冲攻击。它以超能力操纵黏液进攻，优雅地滑过地面，迷惑对手。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME's gooey body is protected by a thin, slick membrane that cushions it from attacks. It uses its psychic powers to attack with its slime, confusing opponents as it slides gracefully across the ground.

entry: POKENAME能轻松复制出多个自己，却只用来为演出找伴唱，让科学家十分不解。表演虽无恶意，目的却仍是谜。
author: merclipse
source: POKENAME is able to duplicate itself multiple times with ease. However, to scientists' confusion, it only does this to create backup singers for its performances. The purpose of said performances, although not malevolent, remains a mystery.

entry: 它吐出的丝坚韧又富有弹性，深受工匠追捧。这些细丝能织成华美的布料与精致衣物。
author: .izik
source: The silk it produces is incredibly durable and elastic, causing it to be sought after by artisans. These delicate fibers are used to weave luxurious fabrics and fine garments.

entry: 它大吃大麦，直到沉得走不动，饱餐后常直接歇在田里。农人得留意它，免得庄稼遭殃。
author: .izik
source: It consumes barley until it becomes too heavy to move, often resting in fields after its feast. Farmers must keep an eye on it to protect their crops.

entry: 没有厚重阴云的日子，POKENAME会飘得更高，想尽量靠近太阳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats higher on days without a dense overcast. It does this to get as close to the sun as possible.

entry: 它潜入草药店偷取药材，存作私藏，却常用这些草药为同伴配制药物。
author: .izik
source: It sneaks into herbalists' shops to steal ingredients for its personal stash. These stolen herbs are often used to prepare remedies for its companions.

entry: 它漂浮时，风穿过细丝，吹出轻快的哨音，回荡在空中。幽异的旋律让听者既觉有趣，又有些困惑。
author: .izik
source: The wind flowing through its fine strings as it floats creates a playful whistling sound that echoes through the air. This haunting melody often amuses and confuses those who hear it.

entry: 它随身带着采来的雏菊，常扎成小花束，再从空中撒落，送给其他宝可梦，成为野外一道可爱的景致。
author: .izik
source: It gathers daisies and carries them wherever it goes, often creating little bouquets. It scatters these flowers from the sky as a gift to other Pokémon, making a charming sight in the wild.

entry: POKENAME吃康乃馨，维持柔软的棉絮状身体，更好地乘风漂游。飘行时会用角拨开挡路的树枝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes carnations to maintain its soft, cotton-like body, enhancing its ability to float on the wind. It uses its horn to knock branches aside as it drifts through the air.

entry: 它把头埋进颈间的棉絮，躲开危险。若仍感到威胁，就赶紧搭上气流飞走。
author: pankiwi
source: It will bury its head in the cotton around its neck to hide from danger. They will swiftly fly off on wind currents if they feel threatened.

entry: 飞行时，它散发苦涩的气味，久久弥漫空中，常让捕食者不愿跟得太近。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, it releases a bitter aroma that lingers in the air. This scent often deters predators from following too closely.

entry: POKENAME摇动蓬松的臀部，就会散发舒缓的气味，安抚周围，化解紧张。鹿角极其敏感，连敌人动作的细微变化也能察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy rump releases a calming scent when shaken, soothing those nearby and diffusing tense situations. Its antlers are highly sensitive, detecting even subtle shifts in a foe's movements.

entry: 它奋力守护花丛，赶走一切未经许可靠近的对象。这份坚定让它成为可靠的守卫。
author: .izik
source: It guards flower patches fiercely, chasing away anyone who approaches without permission. Its determination makes it a reliable protector.

entry: POKENAME酷爱万寿菊，常在花间一歇就是几小时。它细心收好种子，藏进蓬松的身体，妥善保管。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME adores marigolds and can often be found resting among them for hours. It carefully gathers their seeds and stores them within its fluffy body for safekeeping.

entry: 只要有机会，它不到两天就能吃光整片田的收成，留下的棉花还会占据土地。农人只好拿多余的干草捆给它当零食，盼它别再靠近。
author: .izik
source: Given the chance, it can devour an entire field's harvest in under two days, leaving behind cotton that takes over the soil. Farmers try to keep it away by offering it spare bales of hay for it to snack on.

entry: 它能随心引燃放出的花粉，掀起阵阵烈焰。爆炸般的能力让它兼具美丽与危险。
author: .izik
source: It releases pollen that can burst into flames at will, creating fiery bursts. This explosive ability makes it a unique mix of beauty and danger.

entry: 尾巴散出大量花粉，标记领地。浓密的花粉云随着移动，在空中留下道道痕迹。
author: .izik
source: Its tails expel large amounts of pollen, which it uses to mark its territory. The dense clouds of pollen often leave trails through the air as it moves.

entry: 它最爱草本植物的嫩苗，会从林地上仔细挑选，常与其他草食宝可梦争抢这些细嫩的绿叶。
author: .izik
source: Young herb seedlings are its favorite food, which it carefully selects from forest floors. It often competes with other herbivorous Pokémon for these delicate greens.

entry: 它吃着吃着就能睡着。其他宝可梦有时发现它时，嘴里还含着食物。
author: .izik
source: It can fall asleep even while eating, often dozing mid-meal. Other Pokémon sometimes find it with food still in its mouth.

entry: 它为寻找花朵充饥而踏过田野，十分喜欢嚼食那些踩碎的花的滋味与口感，却似乎没意识到自己留下了多大的破坏。
author: .izik
source: It tramples through fields as it searches for flowers to eat. While it actively appreciates the flavor and feeling of eating these crushed flowers, it doesn't seem to realize just how much destruction it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME能闻出植物是否生病，是花店珍贵的帮手。它会将植物研磨成肥料或药物，对园艺生产十分重要。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is a highly valuble asset to flower shops due to its ability to smell when plants are sick. It grinds plant matter into fertilizer or medicine, making it a key part of garden production.

entry: 花瓣虽然美丽，却能变得锋利如刀，切开一切触及的东西。这样的本领让它优雅又危险。
author: .izik
source: Though beautiful, its petals can become razor sharp, slicing through anything they touch. This trait makes it both graceful and dangerous.

entry: 它在田野中一边蹦跳，一边嚼着花苞，细品鲜嫩的滋味。其他宝可梦常跟在后面，盼着分一口这花朵盛宴。
author: .izik
source: It hops through fields while munching on flower buds, savoring their fresh taste. Other Pokémon often follow it, hoping to share in its floral feast.

entry: 身体轻盈无比，一阵微风就能托着它飘出数英里。它借此远行，寻找新的植物，为其授粉。
author: .izik
source: Extremely light, it can float for miles on gentle breezes. This ability allows it to travel vast distances in search of new plants to pollinate.

entry: POKENAME的叶片散发花生酱般的香味，引来好奇的宝可梦。它浮在草甸上散香，却也因此吸引了友善的来客与捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves emit a peanut butter-like scent, attracting curious Pokémon to its presence. It floats above meadows, spreading the aroma, though this makes it a target for both friendly and predatory Pokémon.

entry: 它守在田间，凭威严的气势驱退入侵者。农人珍视它的庇护，有它守护便能安心丰收。
author: .izik
source: Standing guard over fields, it wards off intruders with its imposing presence. Farmers value its protection, ensuring bountiful harvests.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵能辨谎，听见假话就会抽动，让其他宝可梦不敢当面欺瞒。头上的棉絮能压低杂音，它还会调整棉絮，专注听取重要的声音。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears can detect lies, twitching whenever falsehoods are spoken, causing other Pokémon to avoid deceit in its presence. The cotton-like substance on its head dampens unnecessary sounds, and it manipulates it to focus on important noises.

entry: 它偏爱苋菜，会在田间轻巧地采摘。身体很轻，觅食时也能悠悠飘着。
author: .izik
source: Amaranth is its preferred food, which it plucks delicately from the fields. Its lightweight body allows it to float gently as it forages.

entry: 它蹦来跳去，仿佛轻如羽毛。因此，一记重击往往让对手措手不及。
author: Staghorn
source: It bounces about as if it were as light as a feather. Because of this, many of its opponents are caught off-guard by its heavy blows.

entry: POKENAME在密林中寻找最爱的兰花，小心啃食，免得伤到植株。花朵似乎能助旺胃里的火焰，让绒毛摸起来滚烫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks out orchids in dense forests, as they are its preferred delicacy. It nibbles carefully to avoid harming the plant, and the flowers seem to fuel the flames in its stomach, making its fluff hot to the touch.

entry: 它收集落花中的种子为食。简单的食谱帮助它保持轻盈蓬松。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on seeds that it collects from fallen flowers. This simple diet helps maintain its light and airy body.

entry: 它喜欢睡在瀑布下，将奔流的水声当作摇篮曲。熟睡时，蓬松的身体吸收水分，帮助成长。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys sleeping under waterfalls, using the rushing water as a soothing lullaby. While it sleeps, it absorbs water with its fluffy body to help it grow.

entry: POKENAME的每个头都先顾自己安全，会扯走别的头的棉花据为己用。若太贪心，堆得过多的棉花反会挡住视线。
author: Mistymagius
source: Each of POKENAME's heads prioritize their own safety, so they will pull off each other's cotton to use for themselves. If one head gets too greedy, the cotton will start to impair its vision.

entry: POKENAME模样虽可爱，却能将大意的训练家咬成重伤。它们行动迅速，仿佛在沙里游泳，只露出鼻孔与背刺。
author: Markusknight
source: POKENAME, in spite of its cuteness, can deliver devastating bites to careless Trainers. They move very quickly, seemingly swimming in sand, with only their nostrils and backspikes visible.

entry: 这些扁平的宝可梦会沿沙漠表面滑行。有些象形文字似乎记录了人们见到它们的情景。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: These flat Pokémon can be found sliding along the surface of the desert sand. Some hieroglyphs seem to depict their sightings.

entry: POKENAME厌恶阳光，不惜一切躲避日晒。它靠带毒的藤蔓，从腐烂的植物残体中吸取养分。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hate sunlight and will stay out of the sun at all costs. It gets its nutrients from rotting plant-matter using its poisonous vines.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: Mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME凭敏锐的听觉与快速反应，轻松躲开敌人的招式。它更愿堂堂正正交手，不用带毒的咬击。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its keen sense of hearing and quick reflexes to allow it to effortlessly dodge its opponents' blows. It prefers to fight fair and not use its venomous bite.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: Mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME是被弃置的军事实验产物，靠回声定位寻找目标，一触碰就引爆。它们可被当作消耗品，破坏力又强，因此受邪恶组织青睐。
author: Kianjp2015
source: An abandoned military experiment, POKENAME uses echolocation to seek out targets and detonate upon contact. Due to their expendable and destructive nature they are popular among evil organizations.

entry: 它用超声波找到猎物，再发起冲锋。可智力有限，常直接冲过目标，一头撞上洞壁。
author: sk372
source: It uses ultrasonic waves to sense prey before charging. Due to its limited intellect, it often runs right past its target and into a cavern wall instead.

entry: POKENAME先用藤蔓束住猎物，再吸干体液。白天睡觉时，常能看见它们挂在树上。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its prey with its bundle of vines before draining them of their fluids. They can be seen hanging from trees while they sleep during the day.

entry: POKENAME听力惊人，连最善潜行的天敌也能及时避开。每只的毒液都不相同，若无现代医学，被咬伤后很难医治。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredible hearing allows POKENAME to stay away from even the most stealthy of predators. The venom it produces is unique to the individual, making bites difficult to treat without modern medicine.

entry: POKENAME听力惊人，连最善潜行的天敌也能及时避开。每只的毒液都不相同，若无现代医学，被咬伤后很难医治。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredible hearing allows POKENAME to stay away from even the most stealthy of predators. The venom it produces is unique to the individual, making bites difficult to treat without modern medicine.

entry: POKENAME听力惊人，连最善潜行的天敌也能及时避开。每只的毒液都不相同，若无现代医学，被咬伤后很难医治。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredible hearing allows POKENAME to stay away from even the most stealthy of predators. The venom it produces is unique to the individual, making bites difficult to treat without modern medicine.

entry: 它倒挂在树上或洞顶，等身体完成进化。若有小生物飞得离嘴太近，就会被吞下，用来加快蜕变。
author: sk372
source: It hangs upside down from trees or cavern ceilings while waiting for its body to finish evolution. It hastens the process by consuming any small creatures that fly too close to its mouth.

entry: 人们见过它用腹部的巨口吸食猎物的血。不过，POKENAME常为了省时间，干脆整只吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon has been observed sucking the blood from its prey using the giant maw located on its stomach. However, POKENAME will often swallow its prey whole to save time.

entry: 翅膀虽清晰可见，却几乎派不上用场，连体重也难以支撑，只能勉强滑翔。
author: mercury_sc
source: Even though it has visible wings, they are almost useless and can barely make it glide since they are unable to support its weight.

entry: 它用时钟般的滴答声发出回声，辨别方向。虽然眼睛很大，其实完全看不见。
author: AdmiralVermin
source: It navigates using echolocation by making clock-like ticking noises. This is because despite its large eyes, it is completely blind.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里出没，靠敏锐的听觉追踪猎物。獠牙与利爪都带着致命毒素，能让猎物失去行动能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, tracking its prey with its keen sense of hearing. Its fangs and talons contain a deadly poison that it uses to incapacitate its prey.

entry: POKENAME虽双目失明，却天生能感知月光。它们聚在月光从缝隙照入的洞穴里，一同舞蹈，发出奇异而惆怅的叫声。
author: sk372
source: Despite being blind, POKENAME can innately sense the presence of moonlight. They congregate in caves where moonlight seeps through the cracks, dancing together with curious, wistful cries.

entry: POKENAME既没有眼睛，也没有耳朵，常辨不清方向，战斗也不拿手。尽管诸多不便，性情却十分开朗。
author: howlingstarr
source: Lacking both eyes and ears, POKENAME often have a hard time navigating and aren't great battlers. However, they're quite cheerful by nature, despite their struggles.

entry: 它能利用回声定位，找到几英里外的水果。休息时，POKENAME会紧紧攀住自己信任的训练家的肩膀。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: Using its echolocation, it can find fruit within miles of its location. When resting, POKENAME will cling to the shoulder of its trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME吃下赖以为食的果实中的种子，积攒毒素。只有自己或训练家受到威胁、别无选择时，才会动用这些毒。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: POKENAME builds up its poison reserve by eating the seeds of the fruit it survives on. They are only known to use this poison as a last resort against potential threats to it or its Trainer.

entry: 荒废的城市里可能住着数千只POKENAME，以能找到的一切腐烂物为食。利齿连金属线也能咬断。
author: Mistymagius
source: Deserted cities can be home to thousands of POKENAME, feeding off any rotten matter they can find. Their sharp teeth are able to chew through metal wire.

entry: 它用回声定位寻找天上月亮的方位，找到后便整夜朝着月亮，进行光合作用。
author: TheHeroicT
source: It uses echolocation to find the location of the moon in the sky. Once it locates the moon, it faces toward it for the night in order to photosynthesize.

entry: 弥留之际的人，身旁会聚来大群POKENAME。待那人逝去，它们便会将遗体一点点吃尽，什么也不留下。
author: Mistymagius
source: Large flocks of POKENAME appear around people near their end. Once they perish, the flock will feed on their lifeless body until nothing remains.

entry: POKENAME颚力极强，能将钢梁碾碎。它们常栖息在下水道、暗巷等疫病滋生的地方。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME has extremely strong jaws, capable of pulverizing a steel beam. They are commonly found in disease-ridden areas like sewers and alleyways.

entry: POKENAME吊在大树上，伪装成松果。浓密毛发中藏着数百根毒针，一经碰触便会折落。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from large trees, disguising itself as a pinecone. Its thick fur contains hundreds of poisonous needles that break off on physical contact.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴在栖息的洞壁和洞顶挖出藏身孔。一察觉猎物从前方经过，就会弹出洞穴，将獠牙扎进新的受害者体内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tail to dig into the walls and ceilings of caves it inhabits. Once it senses potential prey moving in front of its hiding place, it launches out of the hole to sink its fangs into a new victim.

entry: 它用爪吊在深洞的洞顶休眠，让体内产生的毒液慢慢汇入尾针。许多洞穴探险者身上，都留着被POKENAME突袭的伤疤。
author: Kianjp2016
source: It hangs dormant by its claws on the ceilings of deep caves, slowly letting the venom produced in its body gather in its stinger. Many spelunkers bear the scars left by sudden POKENAME attacks.

entry: POKENAME爱吃街边的剩饭残渣，被城市居民视为祸害。遭到POKENAME咬伤，可能出现类似食物中毒的症状。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are considered pests in urban areas due to their habit of eating leftover food scraps along the streets. Being bitten by a POKENAME can cause symptoms similar to food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME爪上带有剧毒，能让猎物动弹不得。它夜间狩猎，从高处滑翔而下，伏击目标。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are laced with a strong poison that incapacitates its victims. It hunts at night, gliding from high places to ambush its prey.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找能弄到手的果子，尤其偏爱有毒的果实。它会将毒素存入牙中，咬击时释放。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are always on the hunt for any fruits it can get its paws on. It actually prefers poisonous fruits as they will store the toxins in its teeth for a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在洞穴与隧道里，专偷旅途训练家的除虫喷雾。若训练家没有，POKENAME就咬他们。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME lurk around caves and tunnels where they like to steal Repels from wandering Trainers. If the Trainers don't have any, POKENAME bite them.

entry: 这些笨头笨脑的宝可梦，分不清同伴与敌人，总打个不停。被它们毒牙咬过，灼痛会久久不散。
author: Mistymagius
source: These dim-witted Pokémon are constantly attacking each other, unable to tell each other from their enemies. Their toxic bite leaves a long-lasting burning sensation.

entry: 它摇动尾巴，发出声波，通知附近的POKENAME有猎物靠近。数十只POKENAME同时摇尾，声响会让猎物惊慌迷乱，更易被群体制服。
author: sk372
source: It uses the sound-waves from rattling its tail to alert other POKENAME in the vicinity of prey approaching. The sound of dozens of POKENAME rattling simultaneously will frighten and confuse prey, making them easier for the swarm to take down.

entry: POKENAME不停摆动沉重的象鼻，触探周围。翅膀虽弱，却一直怀着飞翔的梦想。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly swinging its hefty trunk around to sense its surroundings. Despite its weak wings, it has always dreamed of flight.

entry: POKENAME看不见，只能以电磁感官描出周围的景象。它只在暴风雨之夜现身，试图引雷击中自己。
author: Mistymagius
source: Due to its lack of eyesight, POKENAME uses its electromagnetic senses to get a picture of its surroundings. It can only be seen on stormy nights, trying to get struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在洞穴，用灵敏的听觉感知四周。它们成群住进洞壁狭小的裂隙里。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in caves, using its sensitive hearing to detect its surroundings. Groups of POKENAME make their dens in small crevices in the cave walls.

entry: POKENAME通过三只羽毛般的耳朵散去体热。据说，被POKENAME咬中，就像全身的血都烧起来了。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME vents its internal heat through its three feather-like ears. Getting bitten by POKENAME is said to feel like your blood in on fire.

entry: 夏夜，数百只POKENAME会出来寻偶。此时毒性达到平常的十倍，为保护幼崽做好准备。
author: Mistymagius
source: During summer nights, hundreds of POKENAME appear to find a mate. During this period, its poison becomes ten times more potent in preparation to protect its young.

entry: 口中四颗獠牙能够伸缩。它以四翼迅速俯冲，将猎物整个裹入口中，再从四面伸出獠牙刺穿，吸饮流出的血。
author: sk372
source: The four fangs within its mouth are retractable. It uses four wings to swoop quickly and engulf prey whole, before the fangs extend and pierce from all sides, skewering them and drinking the blood that flows forth.

entry: 多数洞穴都能找到POKENAME，但同一片区域似乎始终只有一只。超音蝠会聚到POKENAME身边，寻求庇护。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME can be found in most caves, but there only ever seems to be one in an area. Zubat flock to POKENAME for protection.

entry: 凭回声定位与天生敏锐的感官，POKENAME能在最幽深黑暗的洞穴找到迷路或受伤的旅人。可惜模样太吓人，常把想救的人吓得惊慌失措。
author: sk372
source: With its echolocation and naturally sharp senses, POKENAME can locate lost or injured travelers inside even the deepest, darkest caverns. Unfortunately, its frightening appearance often sends those it wishes to rescue into a panic.

entry: 繁殖季，POKENAME最多可同时拥有十二个伴侣。POKENAME的力量是雌性的两倍，轻易就能推动小岩块。
author: Mistymagius
source: During mating season, POKENAME can have up to twelve mates at once. POKENAME are twice as strong as the females, able to push small boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME栖息的洞穴通常死寂无声，稍有响动便会惊动整个群体。但到了夏末，各地的POKENAME汇集而来，发出嘈杂的吱叫与尖啸，寻找伴侣。
author: .fedoraman, ozydamians, & wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME caves are usually dead silent; the slightest noise will alert the swarm within. However, in late summer, POKENAME gather from all over the region, unleashing a cacophony of chittering screeches in the hopes of finding mates.

entry: POKENAME成群巡逻栖息的洞穴，一有入侵者就不顾一切地撞过去。它们通常守着富含稀有矿物的洞窟。
author: Mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME patrol the caves where they live, throwing themselves at intruders with reckless abandon. They usually guard caves with large amounts of rare minerals.

entry: POKENAME的爪由有毒金属构成，进入血液就可能致命。它们常彼此切磋，比比谁的铠甲更坚固。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are made of a toxic metal that can be fatal if it enters your bloodstream. They can often be seen sparring with each other, testing whose armor is strongest.

entry: POKENAME常见于月见山，在黑暗中生活得很好。它们结群收集月之石，用来装饰巢穴。
author: Mistymagius
source: Commonly found in Mt. Moon, POKENAME thrive in the darkness. Groups of POKENAME collect Moon Stones to decorate their dens.

entry: POKENAME不断发出尖锐的鸣响，驱退捕食者。若聚成大群，几乎转眼就能让听者的听力永久受损。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly emits a high-pitched ringing noise that deters predators. Large groups of POKENAME will cause permanent hearing loss almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME用强劲的牙齿咬碎石块、掘开土层，挖出自己的洞穴，喜欢在地下水源附近安家。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their own caves, using their strong teeth to crush stone and dig through the soil. They prefer making their homes near underground water sources.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡20小时，将全部精力留到夜里尝试飞行。爪上带着细菌，一旦划破皮肤就可能造成危险。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, putting all its energy into trying to fly during the night. Its claws are coated in bacteria that can be dangerous if they pierce the skin.

entry: 由于另一半身体没有翅膀，POKENAME通常留在地面。旋转时会发出独特的咔哒声，有人推测那是古老的信号。
author: Mistymagius
source: Due to the second body's lack of wings, POKENAME usually keeps to the ground. It creates a unique clicking noise as it spins, theorized to be an ancient signal.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，却总边振翅边蹦跳，散播毒孢子。吸入这些孢子可能致命。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite not being able to fly, POKENAME is constantly jumping around while flapping its wings. This spreads its poisonous spores, which can be deadly if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME用刺攀附洞壁与洞顶，也能将部分尖刺射出攻击。不过，每次射出后都得花时间重新长好。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME uses its thorns to attach itself to cave walls and ceilings. It can launch some of its thorns to attack, though it needs time to regrow them whenever it does this.

entry: 紫色触须会分泌一层毒膜，若不洗掉，可能引起严重皮疹。进化前，它会用翅膀包住身体，吊在结实的树枝下。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its purple feelers produce a toxic film that can cause severe rashes if not washed off. Before evolution, it wraps itself in its wings and hangs beneath a strong tree branch.

entry: POKENAME在超音蝠家族中虽属罕见，却在大型洞穴系统里颇常见。它总想将猎物一口吞下，哪怕对方大得根本咽不下去。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite being a rarity amongst the Zubat family, POKENAME is still quite common in larger cave systems. It will try to swallow its prey whole, even if they are too large to swallow.

entry: 它们喜欢捉弄路过的训练家，不是用长矛戳人，就是让人染上恶疾。若在住家附近看见POKENAME，不出一周，全家都会生病。
author: Mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon love to play tricks on passing Trainers, either prodding them with its spear or giving them nasty illnesses. If POKENAME is seen near your house, the entire household will fall ill within a week.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在洞壁爬行，巡守巢穴。它们不断吸取猎物的体液，直到自己胀到原来的两倍大。
author: Mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen crawling on cave walls, patrolling their nests. They drain the fluids out of their prey until they swell to twice their size.

entry: 最早记录的POKENAME，由多年前在暴风雪中遇难的三只超音蝠形成。它游荡在冰冷洞穴，寻找新的受害者，将其冻成坚冰。
author: Kianjp2018
source: The first recorded POKENAME is the product of three Zubat that met an unfortunate fate in a blizzard many years ago. It wanders frozen caves hunting for fresh victims to freeze solid.

entry: 它躲在果园里伏击大意的农人，吸饮他们的血。对地面震动极其敏感，能借此发现靠近的目标。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon hides in orchards to ambush careless farmers so that it can drink some of their blood. It is hypersensitive to seismic vibrations which it utilizes to sense approaching targets.

entry: POKENAME拼命往喉咙里塞垃圾，直到皮肤开始撑裂。它们成群在垃圾箱与垃圾桶中筑巢。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME shoves as much rubbish into its gullet as it can until its skin starts to tear. Groups of POKENAME make their nest in dumpsters and garbage cans.

entry: POKENAME口中渗出的液体，化学性质类似牛排煎熟后渗出的肌红蛋白汁液。科学家正研究它是否有医疗价值。
author: Holgast
source: The fluid oozing from POKENAME's mouths is chemically similar to myoglobin, the liquid which leaches out of a cooked steak. Scientists are studying whether it may have medical use.

entry: POKENAME的咬击带毒，单独一口并不危险。可同一个巢穴住着数百万只POKENAME，接着很可能还有至少十二只来咬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a toxic bite, which isn't dangerous by itself. However, millions of POKENAME live in the same nest, making it likely that you'll be bitten by at least a dozen more.

entry: 密封洞穴的深处，曾发现大群POKENAME。它们兼具多种独特特征，十分适应地下生活。
author: .realthree
source: Hordes of POKENAME have been found deep within sealed caves. They possess a unique combination of traits that make them perfect for subterranean life.

entry: POKENAME通常不用翅膀飞行，而是用翼上的黏膜裹住猎物，使其窒息。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME doesn't typically use its wings for flying. Instead, it uses their mucousy membranes to suffocate its prey.

entry: POKENAME藏在搁浅船只里，利用独特的轮廓融入残骸。只有伪装被识破，才会施以毒咬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides inside beached ships, using its unique silhouette to hide amongst the wreckage. It will only use its venomous bite when its disguise fails.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，无声地从一栋楼跃向另一栋楼，身手惊人。斗篷不易撕裂，能保护POKENAME免遭爪击与撕咬。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME only come out at night, impressively leaping from building to building without making a sound. Its cape is resistant to tearing, which defends POKENAME from claw and biting attacks.

entry: POKENAME靠坚硬的刺攀住洞壁。刺还能注入毒液，若被扎中不止一次，就可能昏倒。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tough thorns allow it to cling to cave walls. The thorns also inject poison which can cause fainting if stung more than once.

entry: 被POKENAME咬伤，会感染它的寄生蘑菇。接下来的一年里，蘑菇会慢慢吸尽感染者的生命力。
author: Mistymagius
source: Being bitten by a POKENAME causes the body to be infected by its parasitic mushrooms. The mushrooms will slowly drain the life force from anyone infected over the span of a year.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会发出尖锐的叫声，听得太久可能损伤听力。由于看不见，它也靠叫声进行回声定位。
author: Mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will emit a high-pitched screech that can cause hearing damage if exposed for too long. It uses its cry for echolocation due to its lack of eyesight.

entry: 浑浊的眼睛只能感光，因此夜间繁忙的城市里常有成群POKENAME。它们听力极佳，稍听到危险的声响就会逃走。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its cloudy eyes are only able to detect light, so swarms of POKENAME can be seen in busy cities during the night. They have excellent hearing, allowing them to flee at the slightest sound of danger.

entry: POKENAME精于拾荒，喜欢在栖身的洞穴囤积亮晶晶的物件。双眼极其敏感，几乎全黑也能看清。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are skilled scavengers that love to hoard shiny objects in the caves they call home. With their ultra-sensitive eyes, they can see in near-total darkness.

entry: 这些修长的宝可梦是高明的猎手，靠回声定位轻松追踪目标。毒咬能在数小时内，让猎物失去行动能力。
author: Mistymagius
source: These slender Pokémon are expert predators, using echolocation to track prey down with ease. Its toxic bite incapacitates its victims within a matter of hours.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在受污染的水边。体表覆着滑溜的毒膜，便于从天敌手下脱身。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be found near polluted waters. It covers its body in a slippery, poisonous film that allows it to escape from predators.

entry: POKENAME带着骇人的狂怒伏击猎物，用利牙撕碎小型宝可梦。若猎物侥幸逃脱，它便会爆发野兽般的怒火。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME ambushes its prey with unsettling fury, ripping small Pokémon apart with its sharp fangs. It flies into a primal rage if its prey somehow escapes.

entry: POKENAME对声音极其敏感，任何巨响都会让它接连暴走数小时。汗液中含有危险的化学物质，似乎只会增强它自身的力量。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very sensitive to sound; any loud sound will cause it to rampage for hours on end. It sweats out a dangerous chemical that only seems to enhance its own strength.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人，仅凭气味便能轻松追踪猎物。它们将吃不完的猎物囤在小型洞穴群中。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell and can track its prey effortlessly with its scent alone. Packs of POKENAME hoard their uneaten prey in small cave systems.

entry: POKENAME在浑浊的河湖中结成大群。只需约二十只POKENAME，就能吸干一名训练家全身的体液。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large schools and can be found in murky rivers and lakes. It only takes about twenty POKENAME to drain a Trainer of all of their bodily fluids.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼肌肉，直到强得足以飞翔。锻炼越多，汗液的毒性就越强。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are constantly training their muscles until they become strong enough to fly. The more this Pokémon exercises, the more toxic its sweat becomes.

entry: POKENAME虽已不善飞行，却依然一心增强力量。双翼如今成了毒刺，作为巨大蛮力之外的辅助手段。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite losing its ability to fly well, POKENAME is still just as dedicated to increasing its strength. Its wings now act as toxic spines that are just secondary to its massive strength.

entry: POKENAME有个怪习惯：攀在高高的崖壁上，再落到毫无防备的受害者身上。岩石般的颚力道惊人，连小汽车也能咬碎。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a weird habit of clinging to high cliff walls, then dropping themselves onto unsuspecting victims. Its rocky jaws have enough power to crush a small car.

entry: POKENAME的毒液带电，若不处理，可能造成麻痹。夜里，常能见到它们成群啃咬电线。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's venom is charged with electricity which can cause paralysis if untreated. Flocks of these Pokémon can be seen gnawing on powerlines during the night.

entry: POKENAME吞食的电力越多，几个头之间的磁力就越强。三个头都贪吃极了，总为猎物争执。
author: Mistymagius
source: The more electricity POKENAME consumes, the stronger the magnetic pull between the heads becomes. All three heads are extremely greedy and are constantly fighting over prey.

entry: POKENAME无法行走，飞行时会把珍贵的大葱叼在嘴里。它的毒液会渗入大葱，让大葱变成战斗中实用的武器。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk, so it holds its precious leek in its mouth while it flies. Its venom ends up poisoning the leek, making it a useful weapon in battle.

entry: POKENAME主要栖息在寒冷地区的海湾。有人见过它们用泡沫光线将飞行的猎物击落水中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME primarily live in coves in cold climates. There are reports of them using Bubblebeam to knock flying prey into the water.

entry: POKENAME找到什么都吃，哪怕无法一口吞下。翅膀虽小，仍能轻松在离地约十英尺处飞行。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes anything it can find, even if it can't swallow its food whole. Despite how small its wings are, it is able to comfortably fly about ten feet off the ground.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处挖隧道，靠回声定位穿过漆黑的通道。獠牙坚硬无比，连厚钢板也能刺穿。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME tunnel deep underground, using echolocation to navigate its pitch-black tunnels. Its rock-hard fangs are tough enough to pierce through thick steel.

entry: 毒液会让猎物昏昏欲睡，随后做起噩梦，供POKENAME吞食。因此，POKENAME的毒液被人寻来，作为制服难驯宝可梦的非致命手段。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its venom afflicts its victims with drowsiness and subsequent nightmares upon which POKENAME can feast. For this reason, POKENAME venom is sought out as a non-lethal way to incapacitate unruly Pokémon.

entry: 强健的下肢肌肉与长尾，让它们能轻易扑向猎物。利齿之下，骨头也会轻松碎裂。
author: Markusknight
source: They can leap on their prey with ease, using massive muscles of the lower body and a long tail. Bones are crushed with ease beneath their sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃像用鲨鱼牙齿制成的剑。它们会伏击猎物，肆意劈砍，因为掉落的牙齿很快就能重新长出来。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: With blades that resemble shark tooth swords, POKENAME ambush and hack at prey with abandon, as they quickly grow lost teeth back.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是古代宫殿王座厅守卫的宝可梦。直到今天，它似乎仍在执行首领的命令。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to have belonged to the guards of an ancient palace's throne room. It seems to follow its leader's orders to this day.

entry: 自古以来，人们对它既惧怕又仰慕。POKENAME兼具混混鳄的咬劲与伦琴猫的速度，栖息在炎热地区的河边，位居食物链顶端。
author: Milchik
source: Since ancient times, this Pokémon has been feared and admired in equal measure. Combining the bite force of Krokorok and speed of Luxray, POKENAME lives near rivers in hot regions where it dominates the food chain.

entry: 这种沙漠宝可梦的条纹，让POKENAME成了西部片中强盗常带的伙伴。
author: bee4082
source: The striped pattern on this desert-dwelling Pokémon makes POKENAME a popular partner for bandits in Western movies.

entry: POKENAME会向天蝎换来锐利之牙，用以保护家人。它性情虽温和，却更愿让人觉得自己不好惹。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME trades Razor Fangs with Gligar, which it uses to protect its family. It prefers to be perceived as intimidating despite its gentle nature.

entry: POKENAME会向天蝎换来锐利之牙，用以保护家人。它性情虽温和，却更愿让人觉得自己不好惹。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME trades Razor Fangs with Gligar, which it uses to protect its family. It prefers to be perceived as intimidating despite its gentle nature.

entry: 无论来到哪里，它都会与同类合作，挖土筑丘，为庞大的POKENAME群落开辟家园。
author: fivetailedfurret
source: No matter where this Pokémon finds itself, it works with others, creating mounds by burrowing into the earth, aiming to create a space for a large POKENAME colony.

entry: 某些古代文明曾为卡拉卡拉制作金面具，代替头骨佩戴。面具赋予奇异的力量，让它们变成POKENAME。
author: Staghorn
source: Some ancient cultures crafted golden masks for Cubone to wear instead of skulls. These masks granted them strange powers, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: 它极其害羞，只肯从金色外壳里露出头来。至今无人见过POKENAME的全貌。
author: leonian1586
source: It is extremely shy, so it only pokes its head out from its golden shell. No one has ever seen POKENAME's full body.

entry: POKENAME嫉妒受害者仍能活在人世，夜里在他们卧室外哀哭尖叫，以恐惧为食。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Jealous of the lives of its victims, POKENAME wails and screams outside their bedrooms at night to feed on their fear.

entry: 幽灵般的身体被自身过高的体温熔化。有人认为，这就是岩浆之灵的模样。
author: Soup1900
source: Its ghostly body melted from the sheer heat of its body temperature. Some people believe this to be the form of the spirit of magma.

entry: 它重拾盗墓的老本行，在古代遗迹里收集遗失的面具，还爱拿一袋袋沙，替换文物。
author: pankiwi
source: It has returned to its grave robbing origins and collects lost masks found in ancient ruins. They love to replace artifacts with bags of sand.

entry: 有人说，年老的妙蛙花若不愿前往来世，就会化作POKENAME。POKENAME珍藏着挚友的回忆，凭这份力量与训练家重聚，继续冒险。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Some say POKENAME forms when an elderly Venusaur refuses to travel to the afterlife. POKENAME's cherished memories of its best friend give it the strength to reunite with its Trainer and continue their adventure.

entry: 永不熄灭的火焰慢慢熔化灵魂的蜡面具，生前记忆也随之模糊，直至彻底遗忘。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: As an eternal flame melts the wax mask of this spirit, its memory of its life becomes fuzzier until it forgets it completely.

entry: POKENAME是一群幽灵，靠吸收闹鬼之物与凶地的灵力为生。入夜后，常能看见它们聚集在墓地。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME are spirits that absorb the spiritual energy of haunted objects and areas. They can be found swarming burial sites at night.

entry: 为这只幽灵铸造金身的古代文明相信，POKENAME象征着太阳周而复始的“死亡与重生”。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: According to beliefs of the ancient civilization who created the golden body for this spirit, POKENAME symbolizes the 'Death and Rebirth Cycle' of the sun.

entry: 它们曾在酷热的沙漠烈日下丧命，如今戴着仙人掌形的面具，纪念自己的死亡。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: These spirits passed under the sweltering desert sun. They wear cactus-shaped masks in memoriam of their passing.

entry: 月光之夜，有人说听见过POKENAME幽异的旋律。据说，听见它歌声的人注定会死。
author: Inksans201x
source: On moonlit nights, some people claim to hear the haunting melody of POKENAME. It's said that those who hear its song are fated to die.

entry: POKENAME看似一个自带磁场的古老电池盒，由囚禁其中的灵魂供能。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME appears to be an ancient form of a battery case with its own magnetic field, powered by a spirit trapped within.

entry: POKENAME是不得安息的灵魂，会让猎物入睡，再潜入其心中，重温做梦的感觉。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: A restless spirit, POKENAME puts to sleep and enters the mind of its victims to remember what it was like to dream.

entry: POKENAME能嗅出衣物与家用品中的静电，收进丝网袋里，留着以后当点心。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME can sniff out static within clothing and household objects. They store gathered static in their web bag to snack on later.

entry: 它用角袭击小型猎物，以特殊毒液夺取能量，储存在体内，再化作电力自卫。
author: Skymaster426
source: It attacks small prey with its horn, sapping their energy with a special poison it secretes. It then stores the energy in its body to convert into electricity for defense.

entry: POKENAME柔软蓬松的毛发储着能量，微微作响。在地面蹦跳时，静电不断积攒，让毛间噼啪迸出电火花。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in soft fluffy fur that hums with stored energy. As it jumps across the ground, static builds up, causing its fur to crackle and spark.

entry: POKENAME会附在人类或其他宝可梦身上，慢慢吸取生命能量。一旦黏住猎物，就很难再剥下POKENAME。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME attaches itself to other Pokémon or humans to slowly drain their life energy. It is difficult to detach POKENAME from the prey once attached.

entry: POKENAME藏在玻璃身体里保护自己，也把它当作发电机供能。因此能像手臂般操纵丝线，甚至拿来当腿走路。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME protects itself behind a glass body, which it also uses as a dynamo to produce electricity. Thanks to this, it can control its threads like arms and even use them as legs to move around.

entry: POKENAME常在虫类繁多的地方结网。蛛网导电性极佳，它能沿丝线放电，灼烧猎物。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found spinning webs in areas populated by bugs. Its webs are very conductive, so it can send a shock through the string to burn prey.

entry: POKENAME将特殊的肢体折成花苞状。猎物靠近，POKENAME便伸肢抓住，再用毒制服。
author: Alumed
source: POKENAME fold their specialized limbs into a form that resembles the bud of a flower. When their prey approach, POKENAME will use these limbs to grasp the target and subdue them with their poison.

entry: 它用翅膀摩擦毛茸茸的身体，积攒静电，再以耳朵引导电流，释放强劲的电磁波。
author: Staghorn
source: It builds up static electricity by brushing its wings against its furry body. It can unleash its built-up charge in a powerful Thunder Wave by directing the electrical discharge with its ears.

entry: POKENAME不停迸出细小的电火花。能源来自口中的器官，模样酷似合众地区某些岩石。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates small sparks of electricity consistently. This energy comes from the organs in its mouth, which look closely like rocks found in Unova.

entry: POKENAME通常从大型机器或电属性宝可梦身上吸取电力，储进蘑菇状的结节。结节就像电池，供需要时取用。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically leech off of large machines or Electric-types, storing energy in the mushroom-like nodes. These nodes act like batteries, providing energy in times of need.

entry: 毛间的静电让POKENAME能感知附近的其他生物。身形小巧又敏捷，很难捉住。
author: garret95
source: The static in their fur lets POKENAME sense the presence of others nearby. Their agility and small size make them a challenging target to catch.

entry: 它囤积找到的亮晶晶物件，充上静电，防止小偷下手。若你的东西被它拿走，想不挨电就取回来，只能小心协商。
author: sk372
source: It hoards shiny objects it finds, charging them with static electricity to keep thieves from stealing its collection. If it takes something from you, only careful negotiation will earn your item back without being shocked.

entry: POKENAME会寻找需要保护的幼小宝可梦，通常是小福蛋。它用结实的铁皮与尖锐倒刺，守护收养的家人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME seeks out small baby Pokémon in need of protection, usually Happiny. It uses its durable iron skin and pointy barbs to make sure no harm comes to their adopted kin.

entry: 失去蛋的吉利蛋，有时会遇见孤独的种子铁球，将其收养，从此不再产蛋。日子久了，双方建立密不可分的羁绊，变成POKENAME。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Occasionally a Chansey who loses its egg stumbles upon a lonely Ferroseed and adopts it, forgoing producing more eggs. After a while the two form an inseparable bond and become POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺嵌进树里，吸取养分。遇险时，POKENAME便会自爆，爆炸将尖刺四处抛射，可能伤到附近的宝可梦与训练家。
author: sharkboiowen
source: POKENAME will use its spikes to embed itself onto a tree, sapping nutrients from it. When in danger, POKENAME will self-destruct, which results in its spikes being flung out from its explosion, potentially hurting any nearby Pokémon or Trainers.
