source: POKENAME's calm expression belies the unpredictability of its defensive tactics. It hugs others tightly, seeming to absorb both joy and frustration, reflecting emotions with surprising intensity.

entry: 体表金属磁性极强。它得定期剧烈摇晃，甩掉走动时吸来的金属垃圾。
author: .izik
source: The metal on its body is highly magnetic. It regularly must shake furiously to loose any metallic trash that it accumulates while moving.

entry: POKENAME静卧田野，装作无害，等有生物偶然遇上。被激怒后便猛烈扭动，以出乎意料的凶猛拥抱扰乱敌人，再迅速钻入地下逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often lies still in fields, pretending to be harmless until something stumbles upon it. Once provoked, it thrashes about wildly, hugging with unexpected ferocity to disorient foes before making a swift escape underground.

entry: 柔软而结实的壳裹住POKENAME。它慢慢走动，将小物件拖入暗藏的巢穴。一旦抱住什么，就会持续数小时，难有东西能悄悄溜走。
author: .izik
source: Covered in a soft yet sturdy shell, POKENAME ambles about slowly, dragging small objects into its hidden lairs. When it embraces something, it holds on for hours, making it difficult for anything to slip away unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME角上的分泌物，是调制提神草药液的关键，功效近似解眠药。药液气味刺鼻，连最困倦的宝可梦也能瞬间清醒。
author: .izik
source: The secretions from POKENAME's horn are the key ingredient to brewing revitalizing herbal extracts akin to an Awakening. These elixirs emit a sharp scent that jolts even the drowsiest Pokémon back to full alertness.

entry: 毛茸茸的鼻口与结实体格，让POKENAME能不知疲倦地巡守森林。它亲热地抱住信赖者，体型与力气却常让人难以招架。
author: .izik
source: With a fuzzy snout and robust build, POKENAME patrols forests tirelessly. It offers affectionate hugs to those it trusts, but these can feel overwhelming due to its sheer size and strength.

entry: 爪力足以碾碎巨石。它用双爪压伤猎物，使其无法动弹。
author: .izik
source: Its talons are strong enough to crush boulders. It will utilize these talons to crush prey and render them immobile.

entry: POKENAME仗着巨力滚动冲锋，碾平沿途的森林。强壮的象鼻抱起人来却意外温柔，只是稍不留神，也会压碎抱住的东西。
author: .izik
source: With its immense strength and rolling charge, POKENAME barrels through forests, flattening everything in its path. Its powerful trunk hugs with surprising tenderness, though it can unintentionally crush anything caught in its grip.

entry: POKENAME步态优雅，鹿角随动作闪烁。相遇者会感到莫名平静，可它的拥抱，连最强壮的人也会喘不过气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strides gracefully, its antlers shimmering as it moves. Those who encounter it feel an odd sense of calm, but its embrace can leave even the strongest person gasping for air.

entry: 皮肤像棉花一样柔软。一旦淋雨，就会不受控制地吸进大量水分。
author: .izik
source: Its skin is extremely similar to cotton and very soft. If caught in the rain, its skin will unwillingly absorb copious amounts of water.

entry: 奶汁不怎么甜，也没什么滋味。但有些农场不养POKENAME，是因为别的缘故：只要一只暴走，就能毁尽周围数英里的一切。
author: bobosmith01
source: The milk it produces is not very sweet or flavorful. However, some farms will refuse to raise POKENAME for a different reason: A rampage from just one can completely destroy everything within miles of the general area.

entry: 别被可抱可亲的模样骗了。凡靠近POKENAME的对象，都会被它缠紧，力道足以碎骨。
author: cheroace
source: Do not be fooled by its cuddly appearance. All who approach POKENAME will fall victim to its bone-crushing constriction.

entry: POKENAME几乎做什么都靠强壮灵巧的尾巴。唯独拥抱时，会用纤细的手臂，免得弄伤对方。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME uses its powerful and dexterous tail for almost any task. When it gives hugs, however, it uses its spindly arms to avoid hurting anyone.

entry: POKENAME很适应叶之镇宝可梦交换大会那样的热闹集市，常来搜寻食物。虽然食欲无穷，却从不忘与人分享收获，因此很受摊贩喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in bustling markets like those of the Pokémon Swap Meet in Palmpona, where it scavenges for food. Despite its insatiable appetite, it never forgets to share its spoils, earning it the love of local vendors.

entry: 舌头最远能伸出25英尺，方便从枝头摘取球果。
author: .izik
source: It can extend its tongue up to 25 feet. It does this to more easily take Apricorns from the branches of a tree.

entry: 战斗时，甩动的尾巴覆满浓稠毒黏液。只需轻轻碰一下，就可能看见鲜明的幻象，或感到恶心。
author: .izik
source: A thick poisonous slime covers its tail as it is swung in battle. A single touch of its tail can cause vivid hallucinations or nausea.

entry: POKENAME看似笨拙又迟钝，却是游泳与奔跑的好手，横渡海洋、穿越沙漠、田野与沼泽，都快得惊人。可要小心，它赢了之后那出于好意的拥抱，每年仍会让许多人折断肋骨与脊椎。
author: epping_forest
source: As clumsy and dumb as it may seem, POKENAME is an expert swimmer and runner, capable of crossing seas, deserts, fields and swamps at incredible pace. Beware, as its innocent victory hugs still break many ribs and spines each year.

entry: POKENAME受强烈情感吸引，常飘过奥多马雷的林间小路。人们认为它能抚平心事，因此在当地庆典中象征安宁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is drawn to places of great emotion, often seen drifting through the forest paths of Alto Mare. Its presence is thought to soothe troubled hearts, making it a symbol of serenity during local celebrations.

entry: POKENAME的手已无法使用，尾巴便长得强劲，包办过去作为穿着熊时的大多数事情。原本阴森的孔洞也被缝起，不再那么骇人。
author: Glacierwing
source: No longer having usable hands, POKENAME's tail has grown strong enough to perform most tasks it did as a Bewear. Its spectral hole has been stitched over, reducing its once-daunting presence.

entry: POKENAME常成群在大湿地的边缘玩耍。当地人会收集软毛制作幸运符，但若惊扰它们，就会立即遭到反击。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME are known to play along the marshy borders of the Great Marsh. Their soft fur is often collected by locals for good luck charms, though the Pokémon are quick to retaliate if disturbed.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，毛发却比钢铁更坚韧。它只攻击作恶者，绝不伤害无辜的宝可梦。
author: Mistymagius
source: Despite its cutesy appearance, POKENAME's fur is tougher than steel. It will only attack wrongdoers and will never harm innocent Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以诡计和突袭守卫罗塔遗迹。访客得当心，它很喜欢玩弄靠得太近的人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards the ruins of Rota with deceptive tricks and sudden ambushes. Visitors are advised to be wary, as it enjoys toying with those who wander too close.

entry: POKENAME巡守野生原野区周围的密林，奋力保护幼小宝可梦。温柔的养护本能加上庞大力量，让它既是慈爱的卫士，也是可怕的强敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols the dense jungles surrounding the Safari Zone, fiercely protecting younger Pokémon. Its nurturing nature contrasts with its immense strength, making it both a loving guardian and a fearsome opponent.

entry: 防空镇有位女裁缝，用POKENAME的毛发制作保暖冬衣，价格极其高昂。
author: .izik
source: There is a seamstress in Shelter Town that utilizes a POKENAME's fur to create cold winter clothing. The clothing itself is extremely expensive.

entry: 它拼命挥手，仿佛在求救。旅人若靠得太近，它便捂住嘴，想将对方带走。
author: .izik
source: It waves its hands wildly as if calling for assistance. Should a traveler get too close, it will cover their mouth and attempt to carry them away.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的头上长着叶片，慢悠悠行走，满足地晒太阳。结实的身躯很适合拥抱，只是被抱住的人，有时仿佛被种在原地一般。
author: .izik
source: With a leaf sprouting atop its fluffy head, POKENAME ambles around slowly, content to lie under the sun. Its sturdy body makes it an excellent hugger, though those embraced sometimes feel like they are being planted in place.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦保护区的荒野寻找新玩伴。它个头虽小，却常与大宝可梦摔跤，迫不及待地展示渐长的力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can be seen exploring the wilderness of the Pokémon Reserve in search of new playmates. Despite its small size, it is known to wrestle with larger Pokémon, always eager to show off its budding strength.

entry: 无月的夜里，POKENAME默默追踪芙丽市幽暗的街道。强大的目光能感知藏匿者的情绪，让淘气的幽灵也无所遁形。
author: .izik
source: On nights when the moon is hidden, POKENAME silently stalks the darkened streets of Fleurrh City. Using its powerful gaze, it can sense the emotions of those in hiding, ensuring no mischievous spirit escapes detection.

entry: 飘带随着脚步轻摆，POKENAME散发着善意。它毫不犹豫地张开双臂与飘带抱住别人，分享温暖与喜爱。
author: .izik
source: With ribbons that sway gently as it moves, POKENAME radiates an air of kindness. It embraces others without hesitation, wrapping them in both its arms and ribbons to share warmth and affection.

entry: 有人在对战开拓区附近见过POKENAME，用强壮的手臂拔树开路。当地人渐渐怕起它的拥抱，虽是亲热，破坏力却堪比震地的重击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has been sighted near the Battle Frontier, where it uses its powerful arms to uproot trees and forge new paths. Locals have come to fear its hugs, which, while affectionate, can be as destructive as a seismic slam.

entry: 尾巴的棉絮浸满体内渗出的恶臭白液。气味极其刺鼻，吸入太久，甚至会引发惊厥。
author: .izik
source: The cotton on its tail is soaked in a foul-smelling white liquid that leaks from its body. The aroma of this fluid is extremely pungent and can cause seizures if inhaled for too long.

entry: 体表的棉絮能随心变硬。POKENAME出拳时，会硬化臂端，增强伤害。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance on its body hardens at will. Should a POKENAME throw a punch, it will harden the portion at the end of its arm to inflict extra damage.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾巴不断放热，摸起来烫烫的，让它即使遇上最猛烈的暴风雪也能安然生活。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy tails radiate warmth, making them hot to the touch. They allow it to thrive even in the harshest blizzards.

entry: POKENAME游荡在森林洋馆周围的阴森树林，融入古树的影子。当地人认为，它模仿穿着熊，是想得到喜爱，可惜鲜有人敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders the eerie woods surrounding the Old Chateau, blending into the shadows of ancient trees. Locals believe it mimics Bewear's appearance in a bid to attract affection, though few dare approach it.

entry: POKENAME颚力惊人，一口便能咬碎原木。城都的小镇常举办比赛，看谁的POKENAME能最快筑好水坝。
author: maximus10k
source: POKENAME is known for its incredibly strong jaws which can obliterate logs in one bite. Small towns in Johto often hold contests to see whose POKENAME can make a dam the fastest.

entry: POKENAME白天懒洋洋地活动，偶尔突然停下，给人一个强劲的拥抱。看似没精神，玩起来却很难叫停。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves lazily through the day, occasionally pausing to surprise others with a powerful hug. Though it may seem lethargic, once it starts playing, it is hard to make it stop.

entry: 蓬松的脸庞下，POKENAME强健的身体藏着无穷精力。它一路蹦跳，遇见什么就抱什么，别人常跟不上这不停的脚步。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy face hides boundless energy within its powerful frame. It leaps around playfully, embracing anything it encounters, making it difficult for others to keep up with its constant movement.

entry: POKENAME用可爱的模样引来猎物，紧紧抓住，再以强劲的电击制服。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME lure prey with their adorable appearance, trapping them in an inescapable grip. They then subdue their prey with powerful electric shocks.

entry: 内部身体极其柔软，因此POKENAME会在皮肤外长出厚厚的金属甲层。
author: .izik
source: Its inner body is extremely soft. Due to this, a POKENAME grows thick metallic plating on the outside of its skin.

entry: 木通镇月光下的庆典中，POKENAME飞快缝出雅致衣裳，令观众入迷。据说，看得陶醉的人会得到好运的祝福。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME captivates festival-goers with its quick creation of elegant garments during Chocovine Town's moonlit celebrations. Those enchanted by its sewing performance are said to be blessed with good fortune.

entry: 周身的泡泡像橡胶般富有弹性。天敌趁它睡觉来咬，常反被弹开。
author: .izik
source: The bubble that surrounds its body is extremely rubbery. Many predators attempt to bite at it while it rests only to be bounced away.

entry: POKENAME住进树上躲雨，尤其喜欢小腊梅树。它们用耳朵拍赶其他POKENAME，保卫领地。
author: maximus10k
source: POKENAME make their homes in trees to shield themselves from rain. Preferring small wintersweet trees, they use their ears to slap and scare away other POKENAME, defending their territory.

entry: POKENAME看似一只大宝可梦被斩下的头。它似乎不介意，却仍四处寻找身体其余的部分。
author: Atlas333
source: POKENAME appears to be the decapitated head of a larger Pokémon. It doesn't seem to mind but continues to search for the rest of its body.

entry: POKENAME翼上的毒液经蒸馏，能制成刺鼻的草药，颜色类似传统解毒药。气味虽难闻，却是野外对付毒素不可或缺的药物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wing venom is distilled into pungent herbal cures resembling traditional Antidotes in color. Though the scent is off-putting, these remedies are indispensable for combating toxins in the wild​.

entry: POKENAME在暗光中奔走，宝石纽扣闪亮，令与它对视者着迷。天性虽淘气，对交好的伙伴，拥抱却出奇温柔。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gleams in low light as it scurries, its gem-like buttons captivating all who meet its gaze. Despite its mischievous nature, it offers surprisingly gentle hugs to those it befriends.

entry: POKENAME把柔软的头缩进壳状外框，在地上飞快滚动。抓住猎物，就紧紧抱住，直到自己累了才肯松手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls swiftly across the ground, tucking its soft head safely inside its shell-like frame. When it catches prey, it hugs them tightly, not letting go until it tires from the effort.

entry: POKENAME轻松冲过茂密地带，双臂紧抱沿途的一切。玩闹般的挤压，却如遭蛇缠身，既刺激又令人难以招架。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges through dense terrain with ease, wrapping its powerful arms around anything in its path. Its playful squeezes can feel like being caught in the coils of a serpent, both thrilling and overwhelming.

entry: POKENAME高大的身躯顶着毛绒绒的头。开心时，一抱便有远古地震般的力道，震得四周都晃动。
author: .izik
source: The plush head of POKENAME contrasts with its towering frame. When it is happy, it gives hugs so powerful they feel like ancient tremors, shaking everything around it.

entry: POKENAME优雅的动作藏住巨力，引毫无防备的宝可梦投入怀抱。幽灵般的羽毛发出诡光，据说每次轻振，都能安抚不宁的灵魂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's graceful movements mask its immense strength, luring unsuspecting Pokémon into its embrace. Its spectral feathers emit an eerie glow, believed to soothe restless spirits with each delicate flap.

entry: 传说POKENAME玩闹的拥抱能让枯树重获生机，可它常忘了力气有多大。柔和空洞的双眼仿佛藏着古老悲伤，让人既喜爱又不安。
author: .izik
source: Legends say that POKENAME's playful hugs can restore life to withering trees, though it often forgets its own strength. Its soft, hollow eyes seem to conceal ancient sorrow, making it both endearing and unsettling.

entry: POKENAME的头如微风般轻摇，树皮包裹的身体却出奇坚硬。它紧抱别人不让动，还让植物围着对方生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head sways like a gentle breeze, but its surprisingly hard bark-covered body is unyielding. It wraps others in tight, constricting embraces, helping plants grow around them even as it holds them still.

entry: POKENAME住在罗塔的地下洞穴，靠声波穿行漆黑的隧道。环境虽阴森，它却出奇贪玩，常偷偷靠近冒险者，友好地抱一下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in the underground caves of Rota, where it uses sound waves to navigate the pitch-black tunnels. Despite its spooky environment, it is surprisingly playful, often sneaking up on adventurers to give a friendly squeeze.

entry: 它用大爪固定猎物，再放出高频声波，使其失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: It uses its large paws to hold its prey in place. Once the prey is within its grasp, it releases high frequency sound waves to incapacitate them.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在香草岛的峭壁间，对月长嚎，向其他宝可梦发起挑战。崖壁上深深的爪痕，是它昭告四方的领地标记。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams the cliffs of Potpourri Island, howling at the moon to challenge other Pokémon. It leaves deep claw marks along the cliffs, marking its domain for all to see.

entry: POKENAME凭双翼优雅漂游，软触角轻轻颤动。它飞近毫无防备的宝可梦，温柔抱一下便离去，留下闪亮的粉尘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft antennae twitch as it floats gracefully on its wings. It flutters close to unsuspecting Pokémon, wrapping them in a gentle hug before flying away, leaving a trail of sparkling dust behind.

entry: POKENAME好胜之心无穷无尽，碰见什么都想狠狠摔上一场。输了便独自生闷气，可一个友善的拥抱，就能让它立刻振作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wrestles fiercely with anything it encounters, driven by an endless thirst for competition. If it loses a match, it sulks in solitude, but a friendly hug can lift its spirits in an instant.

entry: 最近，人们见到一群POKENAME巡逻于澎柑岛的岩岸。它们忠诚的天性，让当地宝可梦群落和平相处，是岛上生态中不可或缺的一环。
author: .izik
source: A pack of POKENAME was recently seen patrolling the rocky shores of Tangelo Island. Their loyal nature ensures peace between the Pokémon communities there, making them essential to the island's ecosystem.

entry: 它以超能力从树上摘叶，为野外生病或受伤的宝可梦铺成卧床。
author: .izik
source: It uses its psychic powers to pull leaves off of trees. It will use these leaves to create bedding for sick or injured Pokémon in the wild.

entry: 一挥手，连职业拳击手也会被击昏。限制力量的腰带，是唯一能拦住POKENAME毁掉手中一切的东西，可这事通常还是会发生。
author: bobosmith01
source: A single one of its swings can knock out even a professional boxer. The power-save belt is the only thing preventing POKENAME from obliterating anything it grips or hits, and that typically happens anyways.

entry: 体表材料的质地与大理石相同。它经常试着往上坡滚，增强外壳的强度。
author: .izik
source: The material covering its body has the same consistency as marble. It regularly attempts to roll uphill to increase the strength of its shell.

entry: 每次战斗前，它都会高举手杖，在空中描画繁复的图案。每只POKENAME所画的图案，都各不相同。
author: .izik
source: It waves its staff high in the air in intricate patterns before each fight. Each POKENAME has a different pattern that it traces.

entry: 浪中漂泊的海藻之魂找到沉船的船壳，便诞生POKENAME。坚硬的头，正适合击碎海底岩石。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME forms when the soul of seaweed adrift in the waves finds the hull of a sunken boat. Its hard head is perfectly suited to smashing rocks on the ocean floor.

entry: 覆在身体上的海带味甜，深受糕点师青睐，是沿海料理珍贵的食材。
author: .izik
source: The kelp covering its body is sweet and highly sought after by chefs for use in cakes. This delicacy has become a prized ingredient in coastal cuisines.

entry: 它侧着身子浮游海面，看起来几乎像死了。这奇特的举动有助于躲过天敌的注意。
author: .izik
source: On the sea's surface, it swims on its side, appearing almost lifeless. This peculiar behavior helps it avoid detection from predators.

entry: 毒液如焦油般浓稠，碰到什么就黏住什么，让猎物难以逃脱。
author: .izik
source: Its toxin has a tar-like consistency, clinging to anything it touches. This sticky poison ensures its prey cannot escape.

entry: 拉普拉斯受航海者喜爱，POKENAME却被视作不祥之兆。迷信的人若在水中看见它，甚至会立刻掉头上岸。
author: sivanandi
source: While Lapras is beloved by seafarers, POKENAME is considered an ill omen. Superstitious people who spot it in the waters might even turn around and immediately go back to shore.

entry: 身体像被压扁的海带，一离水就散发可怕的刺鼻气味，令旁人不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: Its body appears to be squashed kelp, emitting a horribly pungent scent when out of water. This odor deters anyone from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME是人类制造的失败实验品，被扔进海中，盼从此遗忘。怨灵却从水中归来，寻求复仇。
author: NellNast42
source: A failed experiment of human engineering, POKENAME was cast into the sea to be forgotten. Instead, its vengeful spirit rose from the waters to seek revenge.

entry: 它不停啃咬船只引擎，直至彻底报废。许多水手因此被它的恶作剧困住。
author: .izik
source: It bites at boat motors with relentless determination, disabling them completely. Many sailors are left stranded by its mischief.

entry: POKENAME起初看似无害，却会不由自主地吸走照料者的生命力。即使POKENAME因此孤独又满怀怨怼，脸上仍带着微笑。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Though seemingly harmless at first, POKENAME will unwillingly drain the life-force of those who care for it. Even though this leads to POKENAME living lives of loneliness and resentment, they smile nonetheless.

entry: 它们是早已去世的善良灯塔看守人的化身。迷航的水手，有时会在深夜得到POKENAME指引。
author: Schwaus
source: These Pokémon are the manifestations of goodhearted lighthouse keepers that have long passed. Lost sailors are sometimes guided by POKENAME in the dead of night.

entry: POKENAME看似被链条锁在海底，其实能自由移动。以为站在攻击范围外的敌人，可要大吃苦头。
author: sivanandi
source: While it appears to be chained to the seafloor, POKENAME can actually move freely. Foes who assume that they're out of its reach are in for a nasty surprise.

entry: 它在海里翻筋斗，将海藻一层层收在身上，便于融入水下植物丛。
author: .izik
source: It performs somersaults in the sea, collecting seaweed on its body as it tumbles. This behavior helps it blend into underwater vegetation.

entry: 它放出有害烟雾，驱赶入侵者。即使本体潜入深海，浓重刺鼻的雾也久久不散。
author: .izik
source: It releases clouds of noxious smoke to drive away intruders. This thick, acrid mist lingers long after it disappears into the depths.

entry: 它喜欢拖着救生艇在水面兜圈取乐，常弄得水手一头雾水。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys toying with lifeboats, dragging them in circles across the water. These playful antics often leave sailors bewildered.

entry: 它在海上浮标间安家，在开阔的大海获得宁静。海浪轻晃，就让它十分满足。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon makes its home among sea buoys, finding peace in the open ocean. The gentle swaying of the waves keeps it content.

entry: 它将雷电导入尾巴，再浸进水中，迸出炫目的电光，驱退潜伏附近的威胁。
author: .izik
source: It channels lightning through its tail, dipping it into the water to create dazzling displays. These electric surges deter any threats lurking nearby.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME是海中牺牲的英雄尸体，被闹鬼的海藻操控。也有人说，这是大海对邪恶海盗的惩罚。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: Some believe that POKENAME are the corpses of heroes who died at sea, manipulated by haunted seaweed. Others think this is the ocean's punishment for evil pirates.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME是海中牺牲的英雄尸体，被闹鬼的海藻操控。也有人说，这是大海对邪恶海盗的惩罚。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: Some believe that POKENAME are the corpses of heroes who died at sea, manipulated by haunted seaweed. Others think this is the ocean's punishment for evil pirates.

entry: 尾锚比阔剑更锋利，轻易就能切开障碍，用来掌控领地。
author: .izik
source: The anchor on its tail is sharper than a claymore, slicing through obstacles with ease. It uses this weapon to maintain control over its territory.

entry: POKENAME是被遗忘的沉没游轮所化的怨灵，缓步行于海底，用锚钩紧可怜的受害者。
author: NellNast42
source: A vengeful specter of a forgotten, sunken cruise ship, POKENAME lumbers around the ocean floor, trapping any poor victims in its anchor's grasp.

entry: 它偷走船首像，装饰水下巢穴，将这些旧物当作战利品。
author: .izik
source: It steals ship figureheads, decorating its underwater den with them. These stolen relics serve as trophies.

entry: 它伏在海底，让丝线沿水面飘展。线捉住毫无防备的猎物，再将其拖进巢穴。
author: .izik
source: It lies on the ocean floor with silk threads trailing along the water's surface. These lines ensnare unsuspecting prey, drawing them down to its lair.

entry: 它死守沉没的护卫舰，不让任何人进入，坚定的守护让它获得失落遗物卫士的称号。
author: .izik
source: It guards sunken frigates fiercely, refusing to let anyone enter. This unwavering dedication has earned it the title of a protector of lost relics.

entry: 发怒时，它让周围的水沸腾，掀起危险的水流。灼热的波浪，使谁都难以靠近。
author: .izik
source: When angry, it boils the water around it, creating dangerous currents. These scorching waves make it difficult for anything to approach.

entry: POKENAME像挥鞭般甩锚，动作出奇灵活。攻击能掀翻小船，吓退入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its anchor like a whip, striking with surprising agility. This attack can topple small boats and scare off intruders.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓行，捡来锈蚀废金属打造铠甲。受威胁时便猛然挥锚，力道足以碎骨。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME slowly walk along the seafloor, gathering rusted scrap metal to build its armor. When threated they will swing its anchor with enough force to shatter bone.

entry: 它们在海底成簇聚集，完美融入周围植物。伪装既能躲避天敌，也便于伏击猎物。
author: .izik
source: It forms clusters on the ocean floor, blending perfectly with surrounding plants. This camouflage helps it evade predators and ambush prey.

entry: 只有一只眼，缺乏距离感，便靠声呐辨路，能在幽暗水中精准得出奇地穿行。
author: .izik
source: With only one eye, it lacks depth perception and relies on sonar to navigate. This skill allows it to maneuver with surprising precision in dark waters.

entry: 它释放阵阵电能，扰乱敌人、击退来犯者。电击常让捕食者晕头转向，退避而去。
author: .izik
source: It releases bursts of electrical energy to disorient foes and ward off attackers. These shocking discharges leave predators confused and retreating.

entry: 它在搁浅的废船上安家，潜伏残骸。这些被遗忘的船既能遮护，也是伏击的绝佳地点。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home on abandoned, beached boats, lurking among the wreckage. These forgotten vessels offer both shelter and the perfect vantage point for ambushes.

entry: 它在商船附近巡游，无声滑过浪下。往往直到出手，才被察觉。
author: .izik
source: It patrols near trade vessels, silently gliding beneath the waves. Its presence often goes unnoticed until it strikes.

entry: 它看似浑然不觉，其实警觉性不输最专注的宝可梦。敏锐的反应能避开投来的精灵球，十分难以收服。
author: TheHeroicT
source: It often seems unaware, but its awareness often rivals that of even the most attentive Pokémon. It can dodge Poké Balls thrown at it with its heightened reflexes, making it difficult to capture.

entry: POKENAME在雾夜走出海洋，能在岸边游荡数日，最后却必须潜回水下，为中空的身体灌满海水。
author: Danarchist
source: POKENAME emerge from the ocean on misty nights. They can wander the coast for days, but must eventually return beneath the waves to refill their hollow bodies with sea water.

entry: 据说POKENAME原是一艘海上失踪船只的船首像。它漂泊海洋，舵轮无目的地转着，寻找新的船员。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is rumored to be the figurehead of a ship lost at sea, its ship's wheel spinning aimlessly as it drifts the ocean, searching for a crew.

entry: 深受船员喜爱的沉船残骸获得灵魂，得以重游大海。POKENAME看似随意漂流，其实始终在寻找迷失的灵魂，加入自己的船队。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The wreckage of a sunken ship, beloved by its crew, gained a soul so that it may roam the seas once again. POKENAME appears to drift aimlessly, but it's actually on a constant search for lost souls to join its crew.

entry: POKENAME收集冰雪巨龙的头骨和旧船，好让自己看起来更大。腿冷得能瞬间冻住水，踏着冰面前行。
author: zerocipher
source: POKENAME collected a skull from an Aurorus and an old ship to look bigger. Its legs are so cold that it can freeze water in an instant and walk over it.

entry: POKENAME的角每次击中物体，都会剥下锈屑，留下尖锐碎片。水手把这些锈片视作好运的象征。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn sheds rust whenever it strikes, leaving behind jagged fragments. These rusty remnants are considered good luck by sailors.

entry: POKENAME与破破舵轮相似，是一团模仿实体的海藻。它借固定身体形状的金属，传导超能力。
author: ohok3441
source: Similar to Dhelmise, POKENAME is a collection of seaweed mimicking a solid body. It channels psychic energy through the metal holding its form together.

entry: 据说POKENAME载着渴望永世征服七海的海盗之魂。老船长们说，附近若有财宝，受诅咒的硬币就会发亮。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of pirates seeking eternal conquest across the seven seas. Tales from old captains claim its cursed coin gleams when it detects nearby treasure.

entry: POKENAME转动船桨威吓敌人，同时积蓄强大的超能力攻击，让对手迟疑着不敢接战。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its oars menacingly while building up a powerful psychic attack. This intimidating display leaves enemies hesitant to engage.

entry: 它们随意漂泊，捡来沉船残物，吊在身体下方挥动，钩捕猎物。曾有人见到挂着多达80只锚的POKENAME。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: They drift aimlessly, collecting debris from shipwrecks to swing below their bodies and snag prey. Sightings have been made of POKENAME with up to 80 anchors.

entry: POKENAME住在海底，能高速滚动。据说有个海边小村崇拜一只沉睡的POKENAME，称它为“伟大椰子”。
author: maximus10k
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of the ocean and can roll around at high speeds. There have been reports of a small coastal village worshipping a sleeping POKENAME, referring to it as 'The Great Coconut'.

entry: POKENAME虽威严美丽，水手却视其为厄运。它撞船力道极大，连最牢固的船也能撞穿。
author: lemage22
source: Despite its majestic beauty, sailors consider POKENAME a sign of bad luck. It rams vessels with immense force, capable of piercing even the sturdiest ships.

entry: 它守在救生艇旁，每隔几分钟查看一次，直到援救到来。保护的举动，让水手十分喜爱。
author: .izik
source: It stays near lifeboats, checking on them every few minutes until help arrives. This protective behavior makes it a beloved companion to sailors.

entry: 据说POKENAME出没于冰盖附近的沉船，对海上迷途之人而言，是不祥的征兆。
author: Murmarine
source: Said to haunt ship wrecks near ice sheets, POKENAME are rumored to be bad omens for those lost at sea.

entry: 日晒太久，体表污泥就会干成硬块脱落，沿途留下腐朽的碎屑。
author: .izik
source: The sludge coating its body breaks off in dry clumps if exposed to the sun for too long. This shedding leaves behind trails of decayed material.

entry: 它产生的珍珠一被抛出，就会大放光明，照亮幽暗的水路，常被用作临时灯笼。
author: .izik
source: The pearls it produces glow brightly when thrown, lighting the way through dark waters. These luminous treasures are often used as makeshift lanterns.

entry: 体表海藻冷得惊人，碰到什么都能使其冰凉。这层冰冻的外衣，既能伪装，也能护身。
author: .izik
source: The seaweed covering its body is excessively cold, chilling everything it touches. This frozen layer serves as both camouflage and armor.

entry: 船长曾用它手中的小锚，占卜贸易最赚钱的港口。许多人相信，锚至今还留着几分寻财的本领。
author: .izik
source: The small anchor it holds was once used by ship captains to divine the most lucrative ports for trade. Many believe it retains some of its fortune-seeking power.

entry: POKENAME捕猎高效，无声滑过猎物上方，伸出触手注毒。目标倒下后，POKENAME便绕回，用爪抓走。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are efficient hunters, gliding silently over their prey and extending their tentacles to inject them with venom. Once the prey is down, POKENAME will loop back around, carrying them away with its claws.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺带着致命剧毒，打斗也不择手段。开战前，还会摇晃毒囊。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME's spikes are lethally poisonous, and it fights dirty. It shakes the poison in its sack right before a fight.

entry: POKENAME靠回声定位穿行洞穴。飞过时滴落的毒唾液，常无意间伤到皮皮与派拉斯。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME use echolocation to navigate through caves. In flight, they trail poisonous saliva, often harming Clefairy and Paras unintentionally.

entry: 住在水下的POKENAME，往往比穴居的个体更浅，呈淡青色。为何如此，仍不得而知。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME that live underwater instead of in caves tend to take on a lighter cyan shade. Why this happens is unknown.

entry: POKENAME闭嘴装可爱，再突然出手。牙上的毒素酸性极强，什么都能溶穿，连钢铁也不例外。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME closes its mouth to appear cute, and then it strikes. Its fangs carry a toxin acidic enough to melt through anything, even steel.

entry: 涨潮时，POKENAME吃藻类；退潮后，便在沙滩上奔腾。扬起的沙黏在皮肤，防止晒伤。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME graze on algae during high tide, but when the water recedes, they stampede across the beach. The sand kicked up in this way sticks to their skin to protect them from sunburn.

entry: POKENAME剧毒，却相对温顺。哪怕被尖刺轻轻扎一下，也可能立刻休克。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME are highly poisonous, but are relatively docile. Getting poked by one of its thorns even slightly can immediately send someone into shock.

entry: 嘴唇能释放麻醉物，让猎物感觉不到接下来的咬击。但狡猾的POKENAME性情残忍，极少动用这本领。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its lips have the ability to release a numbing agent that prevents prey from feeling the bite that is sure to follow. However, due to its cruelty, the cunning POKENAME rarely uses this ability.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，放出的肾上腺素云能激起战意。战况越激烈，它们喝彩越响，释放的烟雾也越多。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME release clouds of adrenaline that will motivate people to fight. The more dynamic the battle, the louder they cheer and the more smog they release.

entry: 每次开战前，它先向面前劈下雷电，主要是为了场面好看。POKENAME更爱凭身体本领战斗，不喜欢远程投射。
author: sk372
source: It throws down lightning bolts in front of it before every battle. This is primarily meant for dramatic flair, as POKENAME prefers to use its physical prowess in battle over projectiles.

entry: POKENAME总是精神满满，尽力跳高，练习飞行。它们常想从上方冲撞同伴，结果却互相弹开，一起飞远。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME bounce as high as they can to try and practice flying. They often try to tackle each other from above, but only end up bouncing off each other and flying away.

entry: 它以精彩的杂技闻名，常与其他POKENAME比赛，看谁跳跃翻腾得更出彩。
author: sivanandi
source: It is known for its stunning displays of acrobatics. They often compete with other POKENAME to see which one can do the more impressive jumps and flips.

entry: 它打斗不择手段，先用泥土迷住对手的眼，再以令人虚脱的擒抱制服。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon is known as a dirty fighter. It will blind its targets with dirt before neutralizing them with a debilitating grapple.

entry: POKENAME现身节庆与游行，以活力感染众人。青少年常特地找POKENAME，让派对闹得更欢。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME appears during festivals and parades, invigorating everyone with a lively spirit. Teenagers often go hunting for POKENAME to make their parties even more wild.

entry: POKENAME是强悍的斗士，也天生爱炫耀。它们常为华丽的连招牺牲力道与速度，想博得观众赞叹，哪怕观众只是自己想象的。
author: kingd8
source: POKENAME are powerful fighters and natural showboats. They often sacrifice power and speed for flashy combos, aiming to impress onlookers real or imagined.

entry: POKENAME以采集的食物为赌注，彼此摔跤。输家往往比起挨饿，更在乎自尊受挫。
author: Cheroace
source: POKENAME will compete in wrestling matches with one another, putting the food they have gathered on the line. The losers often care more about their bruised egos than going hungry.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“擂台之王”，性情张扬，为战斗的精彩场面而活。只肯与足以带来挑战的对手交锋，因为结束太快，根本算不上战斗。
author: sk372
source: Often called "The King of the Ring," POKENAME is incredibly bombastic and lives for the spectacle of battle.  It only fights with opponents it knows will give it a challenge, as a fight that ends too fast is no fight at all.

entry: 它用燃烧的飘带为杂技添彩。可POKENAME并非火属性，鲁莽时常会反烧伤自己。
author: sivanandi
source: It is known for using fiery ribbons to add to its displays of acrobatics. Since they are not Fire type, however, reckless POKENAME often end up scorching themselves.

entry: POKENAME的两个头像争强的手足，常彼此打闹，必要时仍会合作。难以预测的攻击让敌人猝不及防。深色的头，反而比浅色的那个更耀眼。
author: entomoxie
source: The two heads on a POKENAME often fight with each other in a sibling rivalry but work together as needed. Their unpredictable attacks throw opponents off-guard. The head with darker colors shines more than the head with lighter colors.

entry: 摔角暴龙进化为POKENAME时，一颗头会夺得身体的控制权，另一颗则分裂成凶悍的手臂，能各自发动攻击。主导的头，也能随时指挥这些臂首。
author: entomoxie
source: Whenever a Hawlous evolves into POKENAME, one of the heads takes full control of the body. The other head splits, turning into fierce arms that can attack on their own. The dominant head can control the arm heads as needed.

entry: 摔角暴龙进化为POKENAME时，一颗头会夺得身体的控制权，另一颗则分裂成凶悍的手臂，能各自发动攻击。主导的头，也能随时指挥这些臂首。
author: entomoxie
source: Whenever a Hawlous evolves into POKENAME, one of the heads takes full control of the body. The other head splits, turning into fierce arms that can attack on their own. The dominant head can control the arm heads as needed.

entry: 摔角暴龙进化为POKENAME时，一颗头会夺得身体的控制权，另一颗则分裂成凶悍的手臂，能各自发动攻击。主导的头，也能随时指挥这些臂首。
author: entomoxie
source: Whenever a Hawlous evolves into POKENAME, one of the heads takes full control of the body. The other head splits, turning into fierce arms that can attack on their own. The dominant head can control the arm heads as needed.

entry: 弹射器般的后腿，让它一跃能超过身长的50倍。擒拿本领极佳，连体型大数倍的宝可梦，也能掀翻抛出。
author: Staghorn
source: It can jump over 50 times its body length thanks to its catapult-like back legs. It is an extremely capable grappler and can flip and throw Pokémon several times its size.

entry: POKENAME总想引人注目，鼓起身体，发出昂扬战吼，宣告准备决战。谁若看表演看睡着，就会挨上一阵毛绒拳。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Always seeking attention, POKENAME inflate themselves before releasing triumphant battle cries to declare they're ready for a showdown. If anyone falls asleep during a POKENAME's performance, they will be met with a flurry of plush fists.

entry: POKENAME精通场面功夫，先鼓胀浮空，再用猛烈的飞踢击倒敌人。它们对安排战斗的喜爱，几乎不亚于亲自上阵。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Masters of spectacle, POKENAME inflate themselves to lift into the air before delivering devastating drop kicks to their opponents. They enjoy organizing battles almost as much as the battles themselves.

entry: POKENAME通常是摔角鹰人群的首领，骄傲地伸展强翼，鼓起肌肉。它爱使出夸张的空中动作炫耀力量，登场也必须华丽。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is usually the leader among groups of Hawlucha, flexing its powerful wings and bulging muscles with pride. It performs dramatic aerial moves, showing off its strength while still loving a flashy entrance.

entry: POKENAME精于攀树，在树间跳跃，寻找强敌。最爱飞到树冠上方，再以背摔将对手砸向地面。
author: Mistymagius
source: Expert tree climbers, POKENAME leap from tree to tree looking for strong opponents to fight. Its favorite move is to fly high above the treetops and then suplex its opponent into the ground.

entry: 它智力惊人，能为对手的招式想出数十种破解之法。据说，战斗还未开始，POKENAME就算出了1000种结果。
author: sk372
source: With its massive intellect, it formulates dozens of counters for its opponent's moves. They say a POKENAME can calculate 1000 outcomes before the battle even begins.

entry: POKENAME凭轻盈的身体与电磁力悬空，也能借磁力高速冲向敌人，很少落空。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically stay in the air with their light bodies and electromagnetism. They can use this electromagnetism to charge at their opponents at high speed, rarely missing.

entry: 翅膀藏得几乎看不见，也太小，无法真正飞行。但配合POKENAME的助跑起跳，仍能滑翔极远。
author: sk372
source: Its wings are tucked away and barely visible, too small to achieve flight.  Combined with POKENAME's running leaps, however, it can manage to glide for exceedingly long distances.

entry: 它携带的种子容易散落，落到哪里就在那里扎根。其他宝可梦常跟在身后，盼能从迅速长出的植物中获益。
author: .izik
source: The seeds it carries scatter easily, taking root wherever they land. Other Pokémon often follow in its wake, hoping to benefit from the plants that quickly grow.

entry: POKENAME有规律地巡行沙漠，守护领地。成年POKENAME头顶会开花，肉质如水果般甜美。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME wanders the desert systematically, protecting its territory. Mature POKENAME have flowers blossoming on the top of their head. The flesh of a POKENAME is as sweet as fruit.

entry: 四肢能伸长到不可思议的程度，远远突袭敌人，再迅速收回，让人猝不及防。
author: .izik
source: Its limbs extend far beyond what seems possible, catching foes off guard. It uses this ability to surprise enemies from a distance before reeling itself back in.

entry: 它像老练的斗士，精准穿梭在攻击之间，动作流畅，每次闪避都能顺势接上反击。
author: .izik
source: It dodges with expert precision, weaving between attacks like a seasoned fighter. Its movements are fluid, with each dodge leading seamlessly into a counterattack.

entry: 它将身体埋进沙中，只露出脸，从阳光获取养分。一下雨，就张大嘴，吸进落下的水。
author: .izik
source: It buries its body in the sand and peaks its face out to absorb nutrients from the sun. Should it begin to rain, it will open its mouth wide to inhale any falling water.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让尖刺暂时脱离身体，射向敌人，再将尖刺飘回身边。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to temporarily detach spikes from its body and fire them at opponents before causing them to float back to it again.

entry: 它藏在云里，等候最佳出击时机。每次活动，双翼都会落下细沙，让伪装更难识破。
author: .izik
source: It uses clouds to mask its presence, hiding until the perfect moment to strike. With each movement, fine sand falls from its wings, camouflaging it further.

entry: 它跳起出奇优雅的嬉戏之舞，吸引同伴。规律的脚步在沙上留下轻浅的痕迹，令追随者入迷。
author: .izik
source: With a surprising grace, it performs playful dances to attract companions. Its rhythmic movements leave soft trails in the sand, enchanting those who follow.

entry: 它浮在地面上方，随微风轻飘，能轻松避开来自地面的攻击。
author: .izik
source: It hovers just above the ground, drifting gently on passing breezes. This floating ability allows it to evade ground-based attacks with ease.

entry: 它适应沼泽，尖刺能吸取湿润空气中的水分。潮湿环境让它活跃，随时准备守护领地。
author: .izik
source: It thrives in marshes, where its spines absorb moisture from the humid air. The damp environment keeps it active and ready to defend its territory.

entry: 外表虽强悍，交锋时却出奇胆小。它常故作凶狠，想靠威吓免去真正的战斗。
author: .izik
source: Despite its tough appearance, it is surprisingly wimpy in confrontations. It tends to bluff aggressively, hoping intimidation will prevent actual combat.

entry: 它绕猎物盘旋好几圈，再将携带的仙人掌掷出，击晕对方。即使最猛烈的沙暴，也能轻松飞行。
author: .izik
source: It circles its prey multiple times before stunning it by throwing the cactus it carries. It can easily fly in even the worst sandstorms.

entry: 尖刺覆着一层霜，碰到什么都能使其冰凉。冰冷的防护既能抵御敌人，也便于藏身寒冷地区。
author: .izik
source: A layer of frost covers its spines, chilling anything it touches. It uses this icy protection to fend off attackers and stay hidden in cold climates.

entry: 身体保水能力极佳，连干燥恶劣的环境也能生存。它藏进岩群，等待猎物靠近。
author: .izik
source: Its body retains moisture despite living in dry environments, helping it survive harsh conditions. It camouflages itself among rock formations, waiting for prey to approach.

entry: 会收集仙人掌及其上生长的花朵与果实。据说仙人掌汁十分解渴，却可能带来意想不到的效果。
author: pankiwi
source: They collect cacti and the flowers and fruits that grow on them. Drinking the cactus juice is said to be very quenching but can have unusual results.

entry: 它偷窃成性，会潜入营地，拿走食物与小饰物。反应迅速，很难当场抓住。
author: .izik
source: Known for acts of thievery, it sneaks into campsites to steal food and trinkets. Its quick reflexes make it difficult to catch in the act.

entry: POKENAME皮肤吸水性极强，靠沙漠稀少的雨水就能生存。攻击猎物时，身体最远能伸展15英尺。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's skin is very absorbent, allowing it to survive on the little rain the desert provides. They can stretch up to 15 feet when striking their prey.

entry: 它飞快旋转，扬起尘云，驱退天敌。同样的转法，也能收集散落沙漠的食物。
author: .izik
source: It spins rapidly to deter predators, kicking up dust clouds as it whirls. This spinning technique also helps it gather food scattered across the desert ground.

entry: 它快速滚过地面，碾平沿途一切。体表布满尖刺，让滚动既能进攻，也能防守。
author: .izik
source: It moves swiftly by rolling across the landscape, flattening anything in its path. Its spiny exterior makes this rolling technique both an attack and a defense.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然亲其他宝可梦一口。可嘴巴粗糙又带刺，多数宝可梦都宁愿离POKENAME远些。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME loves to give other Pokémon a surprise smooch. Since its mouth is rough and thorny, most Pokémon prefer to keep their distance from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙漠，靠体内储水维生。挥动手臂能让水带电，却相当耗费体力。
author: currentlymuffin
source: POKENAME live in deserts, surviving off of water stored in their body. They can swing their arms to electrify the water, however it is quite tiring.

entry: 有些登山者将吓人的POKENAME错当普通仙人掌，毫无戒备地靠近，结果严重烧伤。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Some hikers have suffered nasty burns because they mistook the frightening POKENAME for a normal cactus and approached it without caution.

entry: POKENAME外层虽有倒刺，摸起来却软得惊人。它们擅长收集储水，将水藏在锐利表皮之下，身体因此软弹。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite their barbed outer layer, POKENAME are otherwise quite soft to the touch due to their expert ability to harvest and store water. They keep this fluid behind the sharp outer layer, making them shockingly squishy.

entry: 炎热的日子，它在水洼里扑腾，享受清凉。无忧无虑的性情，也常吸引其他宝可梦一起玩。
author: .izik
source: It splashes in puddles, enjoying the cool water on hot days. Other Pokémon often join in, drawn to its carefree nature.

entry: 身体发出微弱磁场，帮它穿行沙漠，也能找到深埋地下的矿物。
author: .izik
source: Its body emits a faint magnetic field, which it uses to navigate through deserts. This ability allows it to find hidden minerals buried deep underground.

entry: POKENAME与长尾王是永远的宿敌。它残忍无情，喜怒无常，从不手软。
author: jreposo
source: POKENAME and Aiking are eternal rivals. Typically described as cruel, it is ruthless, unstable, and shows no mercy.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣含有特殊化学物质，战斗中若被咬下，会尝到辛辣味。这似乎有助排去多余热量，避免烧伤脆弱的仙人掌身体。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's petals have been noted to contain a chemical that gives them a spicy taste if bitten off in battle. The chemical appears to assist with expelling excess heat to avoid burning the more fragile cactus body.

entry: 它会分泌芦荟胶般的汁液，滋润、养护身上的尖刺。这层天然凝胶能挡住烈日，让它在干燥荒漠中，也保持健康。
author: .izik
source: Its body secretes aloe-like sap, which soothes and hydrates its spines. This natural gel protects it from harsh sunlight, keeping it healthy in dry, arid environments.

entry: 它适于酷热，吸收阳光，为活动供能。即使干旱，也会筑起复杂的水坝，靠强韧的生命力承受烈日。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon thrives in intense heat, absorbing sunlight to power its movements. It builds complex dams even in arid conditions, relying on its resilience to endure the blazing sun.

entry: POKENAME掉落的小黄绒里藏着利针，能电人并注毒。在干旱地区，常能见到POKENAME出手前全身带电颤动。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME leaves small yellow fur with a sharp needle inside that can give an electric shock and a dose of poison. In arid places, POKENAME is often seen shaking with electricity when preparing to attack.

entry: 身上的刺营养丰富，味道像番荔果，许多厨师会用来调味咖喱。
author: .izik
source: The thorns on its body are extremely nutritious and taste similar to Yache Berries. Many chefs use these thorns to flavor their curries.

entry: 阳光让它精力充沛，能在沙漠中突然加速。身影在日下闪烁，留下海市蜃楼般的反光。
author: .izik
source: Sunlight energizes it, allowing bursts of rapid movement through the desert. It glimmers under the sun, leaving mirage-like reflections as it moves.

entry: 即使静止，身体也不断放热，让周围空气灼烫。受激时，更会喷出阵阵烈焰，烧焦脚下的地面。
author: .izik
source: The air around it feels scorching, as it radiates heat even while standing still. When agitated, it can release bursts of intense fire, scorching the ground beneath it.

entry: 它身手敏捷，能跃出很远，轻松避开威胁。同伴常两两比试跳跃，磨炼速度与配合。
author: .izik
source: With incredible agility, it can jump great distances, easily evading threats. Pairs often practice leaping contests, developing both speed and coordination.

entry: 一感到危险，它就发出响彻四周的尖叫，警告别人远离。声音既能自卫，也能让它在暗处找到同类。
author: .izik
source: Screeching fills the air when it senses danger, warning others to keep their distance. It uses its voice both as a defense mechanism and a way to locate others in the dark.

entry: 无主的低语似乎随它到处游荡，让附近的人不安。怪声常把旅人引错方向，仿佛催促他们走向沙漠深处。
author: .izik
source: Disembodied whispers seem to follow wherever it goes, unsettling those nearby. These eerie sounds often lead travelers astray, as if urging them deeper into the desert.

entry: 它在沙中滚动，磨利细刺，随时防身。滑过沙丘时动作平稳，与不断变化的沙景融为一体。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon rolls in sand to sharpen its tiny spines, keeping them ready for defense. It glides smoothly across dunes, blending into the shifting landscape.

entry: 每次振翅都撒下火星，留下发亮的痕迹，既能警告来者，也能将好奇的宝可梦引入陷阱。
author: .izik
source: It scatters embers with every flap, leaving tiny sparks in its wake. These glowing trails act as both warnings and lures, attracting curious Pokémon into traps.

entry: 白色的毛发，其实是一根根纤细而极锋利的尖刺。它喷出的火，足以把沙子熔成玻璃，再用玻璃加固尖刺。
author: Staghorn
source: Its white fur is composed of thin but extremely sharp spines. The fire it produces is hot enough to melt desert sand into glass, which it uses to reinforce its spines.

entry: POKENAME住进温室，藏在盆栽间，夜深便悄悄吃掉周围植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in greenhouses, camouflaging itself among potted plants. Under the cover of night, it quietly consumes the vegetation around it.

entry: 身体深处传出阴森的哀号，让附近的人心神不宁。它缓慢穿过森林，融入古树投下的阴影。
author: .izik
source: A haunting wail echoes from deep within its body, unsettling those nearby. It moves slowly through forests, blending in with the shadows cast by ancient trees.

entry: POKENAME头上的果子本身无毒，有毒的是POKENAME的黏性汁液。因此，必须彻底去除污染，果实才能食用。
author: Mistymagius
source: The fruit on POKENAME's head isn't naturally poisonous, but POKENAME's sticky sap is. Because of this, the fruit needs to be thoroughly decontaminated before it can be eaten.

entry: 气候温暖的地区，常养POKENAME看家。它坐在主人门边的花盆里，用布满刺的强臂，抱住一切可能的入侵者。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME is often kept as a home defence system in warmer climates. It sits in a pot by its owner's front door and hugs any potential intruders with strong arms covered in spikes.

entry: 它用刺吸收阳光时，会保持同样的姿势数小时。若受惊扰，就会吓得跳起，再飞快溜走。
author: .izik
source: While absorbing sunlight with its thorns, it will hold the same pose for hours. Should it be disturbed, it will hop up in alarm and skitter away at great speeds.

entry: 它最爱在古遗迹歇息，藏在残墙之间。还会吸收旧建筑的残片，加强防护。
author: .izik
source: Ancient ruins are its preferred resting spots, where it camouflages among crumbled walls. It absorbs remnants of old structures to strengthen its defenses.

entry: POKENAME成簇歇在沙漠烈日下。吸收足够热量后，脸上就会开出黄色小花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rest in clusters under the hot desert sun. When it absorbs enough heat, it will grow a small yellow flower on its face.

entry: 它扔坚果的准头出奇高，爱瞄准毫无防备的目标，乐于恶作剧。可若对方前来算账，又会立刻逃跑。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon throws nuts with surprising accuracy, often aiming at unsuspecting targets. It takes delight in this playful mischief, though it quickly flees if confronted.

entry: 热到难以忍受时，它就会大发脾气，凶暴而危险。大热天，其他宝可梦都离得远远的，知道气温越高，它心情越差。
author: .izik
source: Its temper flares when the heat becomes unbearable, making it dangerously aggressive. During hot days, other Pokémon keep their distance, knowing its mood worsens with rising temperatures.

entry: 嵌在身体里的黄玉碎片，在阳光下晶亮夺目。这些宝石常引来寻宝者，造成争斗。
author: .izik
source: Topaz shards embedded in its body gleam under sunlight, giving it a dazzling appearance. These gemstones are known to attract treasure hunters, often leading to conflict.

entry: 它常显得疲惫，连烈日下也慢慢行走。迟钝的模样，掩盖了带刺身体里潜藏的力量。
author: .izik
source: Often appearing tired, it moves slowly even in the hottest sun. Its sluggish nature belies the power hidden within its thorny body.

entry: 磁场异常强大，能从远处吸来小物件。它借此收集废金属，存起来，目的却无人知晓。
author: .izik
source: Its magnetic field is unusually strong, allowing it to pull in small objects from a distance. It uses this ability to collect metal scraps, which it stores for unknown purposes.

entry: 全身细针既能防护，也能收集食物。一激动，它便猛烈乱甩，将细针射向四面八方。
author: .izik
source: Small pins cover its body, which it uses for defense and gathering food. When agitated, it flails wildly, sending these pins flying in every direction.

entry: 它适于生活在隐秘绿洲附近，存水应付干旱。其他沙漠生物常尾随它，盼着找到救命的避难所。
author: .izik
source: It thrives near hidden oases, where it stores water for dry spells. Other desert creatures often follow it, hoping to discover these life-saving havens.

entry: 它搜集被丢弃的汽水罐，藏进中空黏软的体内。叮当响声常使敌人迷惑，让它有时间逃脱。
author: .izik
source: It collects discarded soda cans, hoarding them inside its hollow slimy body. The rattling sounds it makes often confuse opponents, giving it time to escape.

entry: POKENAME把露水化作水汽吸进体内，再加热浮空。遇到威胁，就一口气排尽蒸汽，将尖刺射向四周。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME float by drawing dew into their bodies as water vapor and heating it. If threatened, they expel all of the steam at once, shooting spines in every direction.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠游荡歌唱，带刺的身体有节奏地摇动，为急促的歌声加上沙沙伴奏。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME roams through deserts singing. It shakes its thorny body rhythmically to add rattling noises to its rapid singing.

entry: 它像芭蕾舞者般优雅舞动，以旋转迷住观众。每一步都散出淡香，迷人而危险。
author: .izik
source: It performs graceful, ballet-like movements, mesmerizing onlookers with elegant spins. Each step releases a soft aroma, making it as captivating as it is dangerous.

entry: 动作让敌人头晕失措、破绽百出。独特的步伐节奏，连最老练的对手也会被弄糊涂。
author: .izik
source: Its movements induce dizziness in foes, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable. The unique rhythm of its steps confuses even the most experienced opponents.

entry: 它会突然怒气爆发，攻击沿途一切。不过，只要小心安抚，仍能让它平静。
author: .izik
source: It succumbs to sudden bursts of rage, attacking anything in its path. Despite its anger, it can be calmed with careful handling.

entry: 它栖在摩天楼之间，以锐目观察下方的城市。从高处能迅速出击，再回到安全之地。
author: .izik
source: It roosts among skyscrapers, watching the city below with keen eyes. From these high perches, it can strike quickly and return to safety.

entry: POKENAME学会了卖仙人掌，客人主要是花店与咖啡店老板。可也有人见过，它们居然试着把赚来的钱种下去。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME have learned how to monetize their cactus collection. Their target customers are florists and coffee-shop owners. They've been spotted trying to plant the money.

entry: 它高速旋转，用尖刺扫清障碍。同样的转法，兼能进攻与防御。
author: .izik
source: It rotates rapidly, using its spines to clear obstacles in its path. This spinning technique doubles as both an attack and a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙漠躲避酷热。小猎物一来，就跃出，用尖刺紧紧攀住。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME buries itself in the desert sand to protect itself from the heat. When small prey comes along, it hops out and clings to it with its spines.

entry: 它用灵活的双臂擒住敌人，固定在原地。一旦抓牢，几乎无法挣脱。
author: .izik
source: It grapples with opponents using its flexible arms, holding them in place. Once it has a firm grip, escape becomes nearly impossible.

entry: 严酷沙漠的生活，让身体保存了大量水分。不知为何，这似乎也会产生庞大电力，科学家至今难以解释。
author: SonTyp
source: Because it lives in harsh deserts, its body conserves large amounts of water. Somehow this seems to generate large amounts of electricity, a phenomenon scientists still struggle to find an explanation for.

entry: POKENAME的毛发像尖针。若在它感到威胁时碰触，皮肤就会挨上数千针，每一下都带着冰冷的冲击。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's fur is spiky, like needles. Touching one while they feel threatened will result in thousands of pricks to the skin, each delivering cold shocks.

entry: 它始终朝北，穿行沙漠时方向精准得奇异。即使遭遇强烈风暴，也从不改变。
author: .izik
source: Always facing north, it navigates through deserts with uncanny precision. This orientation never changes, even when it is caught in powerful storms.

entry: 它游荡深海，藏在珊瑚礁间。带刺的外表，让深处的天敌不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: It wanders the deep sea, camouflaging among coral reefs. Its thorny appearance deters predators in the abyss.

entry: 碰到尖刺，会有灼痛持续数小时。这痛苦的防御，能让捕食者不敢太过靠近。
author: .izik
source: Touching its spines causes a burning sensation that lingers for hours. It uses this painful defense to discourage predators from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME振翅一次，就能掀起猛烈沙暴。风中气温接近华氏200度，足以对付任何想袭来的沙漠天敌。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME can kick up a raging sandstorm with a single flap of its wings. The air inside these sandstorms can reach temperatures of nearly 200°F - more than enough to deal with any would-be desert predators.

entry: 颚力强大，连最硬的壳也能咬碎。它掘入地下，耐心等候猎物落进陷阱。
author: .izik
source: Its powerful bite can crush even the hardest shells. It burrows into the ground, waiting patiently for prey to stumble into its trap.

entry: POKENAME分泌的芦荟液带着腐烂洋葱般的刺鼻气味。过去，药剂师常将它作为烫伤药膏的关键原料。
author: .izik
source: The aloe POKENAME secretes emits a pungent odor reminiscent of rotten onions. Historically, pharmacists used this aloe as a key ingredient in burn ointments.

entry: 它不停挖沙，开辟复杂的隧道网。隐秘的通路既能栖身，也便于伏击猎物。
author: .izik
source: It digs tirelessly through the sand, creating complex tunnel networks. These hidden paths offer it both shelter and a way to ambush prey.

entry: 身体所到之处都散发高热。尖刺偶尔腾起火焰，点燃干草与灌丛。
author: .izik
source: Its body radiates intense heat wherever it goes. Flames sometimes flicker from its spines, setting fire to dry grass and brush.

entry: 它在空中跃动旋转，杂技绚丽，迅疾又难以预料的动作，令敌人难以反应。
author: .izik
source: It performs dazzling acrobatics, leaping and spinning through the air. Its swift, unpredictable movements leave enemies struggling to react.

entry: 它轻易就能唤来沙暴，环绕周身。风沙遮住动作，让它很难被追踪。
author: .izik
source: Sandstorms swirl around it, summoned effortlessly by its presence. These storms obscure its movements, making it a difficult target to track.

entry: 它最爱藏在古墓中，不受打扰。据说，它守着绝不该被揭开的秘密。
author: .izik
source: Ancient crypts are its preferred hiding spots, where it remains undisturbed. It is said to guard secrets that should never be uncovered.

entry: 它守在古老神殿前，默默等待入侵者。传说，尖刺是湮没于岁月的圣物残片。
author: .izik
source: It stands guard over ancient temples, waiting silently for trespassers. Legends say its spines are remnants of sacred relics lost to time.

entry: 它适于酷热，吸收滚烫地面的能量，借热量活动，天越热，行动越快。
author: .izik
source: It thrives in extreme heat, absorbing energy from the scorching ground. This heat fuels its movements, making it faster during hot days.

entry: POKENAME一见风滚草就入迷，常玩到天明。若被打扰，就会使出强力的劈开反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes entranced when it encounters a tumbleweed, often playing with it until dawn. If disturbed, it retaliates with a powerful Slash attack.

entry: 尖刺坚如砂岩，让身体十分耐打。发怒时，它攻势不歇，毫不留情。
author: .izik
source: Its spines are as hard as sandstone, giving it immense durability. When angered, it strikes with relentless force, showing no mercy.

entry: 它吸收日光，滋养身上的尖刺，让尖刺一天天变得锋利。正午最热时，它几乎纹丝不动，静静沐浴太阳的能量。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs sunlight to fuel its spines, which grow sharper with each day. In the heat of noon, it becomes nearly immovable, basking in the sun's energy.

entry: 它飞快奔过沙漠，在沙上留下痕迹。双头配合无间，轻松穿过崎岖地形。
author: .izik
source: It dashes through desert landscapes with incredible speed, leaving trails in the sand. Its twin heads coordinate perfectly, allowing seamless movement through rough terrain.

entry: 海滩上，不幸撞见POKENAME的人，都把它当作祸害。POKENAME不只跟孩子打架，还会往电子设备里塞沙。
author: odditylad
source: Anyone who is unfortunate enough to stumble upon a POKENAME at the beach refers to it as a pest. POKENAME will not only fight children but will also fill your electronics with sand.

entry: 古时，POKENAME以独特的节奏帮助人们计时。据说，身边若有人总不守时，它就会焦躁。
author: Atlas333
source: In ancient times, POKENAME helped keep track of time with its unique rhythms. It is said to become agitated when surrounded by tardiness.

entry: 这种融合体天性自私，领地意识很强。会毁掉沙堡，用夺来的沙子把自己堆得比实际更大。
author: pankiwi
source: This fusion is very selfish and territorial in nature. It will destroy sand castles and use them to make itself appear larger than it actually is.

entry: POKENAME藏在阳光明媚的海滩沙地中收集光能。谁想偷走它的铲子，它就会从沙中扑出发动攻击。
author: Mikk09
source: POKENAME hides in the sand of a sunny beach, collecting light. POKENAME will lunge out of the sand to attack anyone that tries to steal its shovels.

entry: 据说POKENAME由迷失海滩的卡蒂狗化成，会找幼童玩耍、挖洞，帮忙筑沙堡。可与POKENAME玩过的孩子，大多从此不知所终。
author: Mistymagius
source: Said to be a Growlithe that became lost on the beach, POKENAME will approach young children to play, digging holes or helping to build sandcastles. However, most children who play with a POKENAME are never seen again.

entry: 它伏在沙滩下，准备突袭宝可梦，吸取生命力。但多数时候，却因无聊而睡着，或干脆忘了自己在等猎物。
author: Staghorn
source: It lurks in the sand of beaches, ready to ambush Pokémon and drain their life force. Most of the time, however, it gets bored, falls asleep, or forgets that it was waiting for prey.

entry: 在沙滩休息时若忽感困倦，可得当心，或许是POKENAME在作祟。等目标熟睡，它就从下方陷开沙坑，将人困进沙墓。
author: Staghorn
source: If you feel yourself becoming drowsy while relaxing on a sandy beach, be careful; it may be due to a POKENAME's influence. Once its target is fast asleep, it will open a sinkhole below them and trap them in a sandy tomb.

entry: POKENAME常在复杂机器的程序里制造异常，成了所有程序员的头号敌人。
author: Dusknoir64
source: POKENAME is often found creating abnormalities in the code of complex machines. It has become enemy number one of all programmers.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇那一半，有时会想朝别的方向走。不过，这种失控只持续片刻。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's mushroom half sometimes tries to walk in a separate direction. However, this lapse of control is only momentary.

entry: 某些寄生真菌能感染电子设备，形成POKENAME。体内不同的个体始终争夺控制权，冲突不休。
author: entomoxie
source: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.

entry: 某些寄生真菌能感染电子设备，形成POKENAME。体内不同的个体始终争夺控制权，冲突不休。
author: entomoxie
source: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.

entry: 某些寄生真菌能感染电子设备，形成POKENAME。体内不同的个体始终争夺控制权，冲突不休。
author: entomoxie
source: Certain parasitic fungi can infect consumer electronics. The resulting POKENAME is in a consistent conflicting state regarding which entity is in control.

entry: POKENAME以头上的菌丝感知波导，在攻击还未发动时，就能预先察觉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME senses aura through the mycelium on its head. In this way, it can anticipate attacks before they even begin.

entry: POKENAME背上的树被茂密的蘑菇簇包围。只要礼貌地请求，POKENAME就愿意大方分享蘑菇。
author: soreile.arc
source: The tree growing on POKENAME's back has been surrounded by a dense field of mushrooms. The POKENAME will share its mushrooms freely if asked nicely.

entry: POKENAME若将孢子撒在某人身上，就能与其心灵交流。但它对别人的情绪太敏感，因此通常宁愿藏在森林。
author: .realthree
source: If POKENAME spreads its spores over someone, it can communicate telepathically with that person. It's extremely sensitive to others' emotions, though, so it typically hides in forests instead.

entry: 与齿轮儿融合后，派拉斯似乎不再受寄生蘑菇那么直接的控制。双方虽分开，蘑菇齿轮仍能嵌进虫身齿轮的槽隙，菌索也将它们连在一起。
author: entomoxie
source: When fused with a Klink, the Paras seems to be less directly influenced by the invasive mushroom. However, even with this separation, the mushroom's gears are shaped to fit with the grooves in the bug's gears, and a mycelial cord keeps them together.

entry: 与齿轮儿融合后，派拉斯似乎不再受寄生蘑菇那么直接的控制。双方虽分开，蘑菇齿轮仍能嵌进虫身齿轮的槽隙，菌索也将它们连在一起。
author: entomoxie
source: When fused with a Klink, the Paras seems to be less directly influenced by the invasive mushroom. However, even with this separation, the mushroom's gears are shaped to fit with the grooves in the bug's gears, and a mycelial cord keeps them together.

entry: 这是小火龙被冬虫夏草菌感染后的模样。作为回报，蘑菇会保护宿主，让它免受水的侵袭。
author: zedsmith64
source: The result of a Charmander being infected with the tochukaso mushroom. The mushroom, meanwhile, protects its host from water.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME是派拉斯进化前的形态，却从未有人见过它进化成派拉斯。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME is believed by many to be a pre-evolved form of Paras, it has never been observed evolving into that Pokémon.

entry: 包围POKENAME的浅色蘑菇，含有坚硬无比的合金。可它十分罕见，金属的具体配比仍是谜。
author: .realthree
source: The pale mushroom that surrounds POKENAME contains incredibly hard alloys. This Pokémon is rare, though, so the exact mixture of metals is unknown.

entry: 手中的蘑菇一摇，就散播强效催眠孢子。等目标昏沉，POKENAME便趁精神防备松懈，开始吸走对方的智力。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom it holds spreads highly soporific spores when shaken. As its target becomes drowsy, POKENAME uses this lull in mental defenses to begin siphoning intelligence from the victim's mind.

entry: POKENAME的智力已登顶峰，不再需要吸取其他生物的心智，却仍继续。因为这行为带来的刺激，已经让它沉迷，无法抗拒。
author: sk372
source: Having reached the pinnacle of intellect, POKENAME no longer needs to drain the minds of other beings. Yet it continues to do so, as the act itself has become an addictive thrill it cannot resist.

entry: POKENAME以沙塑成长颈，能将头伸到离身体极远之处，伏击毫无防备的海滩猎物，吸取生命力。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME can extend their heads incredibly far from their bodies by forming long necks out of sand. They use this technique to ambush and drain the vitality of unsuspecting beach prey.

entry: POKENAME守护孩子筑的沙堡，认为沙雕的形貌只有大海有权改变。谁敢当着POKENAME毁坏这份艺术，很快就会后悔。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME is known as the defender of sand castles made by children. It believes that only the sea has the right to claim the shape of art made of sand – those sacrilegious enough to destroy it while POKENAME is near will soon live to regret it.

entry: 它在海床挖隧道，寻找矿物。动用带超能力的角时，金属磨咬般的声响便回荡海中。
author: takopus
source: It tunnels through the seafloor in search of minerals. When it uses its psychically active horns, metallic gnashing resonates through the ocean.

entry: POKENAME花上多年筑成沙塔，会以狂怒捍卫。塔里埋着的骨头，属于那些曾想夺走它家园的人。
author: dragonessanimations
source: After spending years building its sand tower, POKENAME will protect it with immense fury. Inside the tower are the bones of those who have tried to take its home.

entry: 体内猛烈的幽焰，将POKENAME部分沙身熔成玻璃。独特的构造让POKENAME的光芒照得极远，连最深的夜色也能穿透。
author: Rakunk
source: The intense spectral flames within POKENAME's body have fused portions of its sandy form into glass. This unique body shape has allowed POKENAME to shine from across great distances, cutting through even the darkest nights.

entry: POKENAME喜欢抢走游客的沙滩用品，让大家玩不尽兴。它是海滩的王者，对粗制滥造的沙堡十分鄙夷。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME enjoys draining the fun from beach goers by taking their beach supplies. It despises poorly-made sand castles and is the king of the beach.

entry: 不论心情如何，脸上永远带着微笑。却有一群狂热者，相信皱眉的POKENAME会带来好运。
author: .izik
source: Its face is permanently smiling regardless of its emotions. There is a group of fanatics that believe a frowning POKENAME will bring good luck.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，POKENAME会在树上仰望夜空。北极光一出现，POKENAME体内潜藏的超能力便会苏醒。
author: Mistymagius
source: On cold winter nights, POKENAME can be seen in the trees staring up into the night sky. When the northern lights appear in the sky, a latent psychic power awakens within POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME成群住进结晶洞穴，巢里常堆满迁徙时收集的宝石。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME make home in crystalized caves. Their nests are regularly filled with gems that they gather during their migration.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷的苔原上快乐地生活、玩雪。对星形的叶子有着奇特的迷恋。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME live their lives happily in frigid tundras, playing in the snow. They have an odd fascination with star-shaped leaves.

entry: 它不爱太热的食物，常唤来冷风，将吃的吹凉。
author: .izik
source: It dislikes eating food that is overly warm. It frequently summons cold gusts of wind to chill its food.

entry: 有人发现POKENAME潜到600米以下。深处光线稀少，它们便靠发光的头冠，避免迷失方向。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME have been found diving at depths of over 600 meters. Because there is so little light at those depths, they use their luminescent crests to keep from getting lost.

entry: 身体一摇，就放出小团雪云。晒太阳太久，身上的金属甚至会微微融化。
author: .izik
source: It releases small clouds of snow when it swings its body. If it is in the sun too long, the metal on its body will melt slightly.

entry: 据说，北极光最亮时，POKENAME会出现在雪丘，顶着绚烂天空优雅转圈。看见它们聚集，被认为能带来好运。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME are said to appear when the northern lights shine at their brightest, twirling gracefully beneath the vibrant skies atop snowy hills. Seeing a gathering of these Pokémon is considered good luck.

entry: 天气温暖时，它反会颤抖。晃动间，冷雾环绕周身，让身体降温。
author: .izik
source: It shivers when subjected to warm weather. As it shakes, a mist of cold air surrounds it and chills its body.

entry: 熟睡时，它散发晶亮的气场，一碰就能冻住活体组织。若生病，气场的力量便会减弱。
author: .izik
source: When it sleeps, it emits a glistening aura that can freeze living tissue on contact. If it becomes sick, the aura loses potency.

entry: 它在傍晚收集树果，存到海底，再按颜色分开，极其细心地埋好。
author: .izik
source: It gathers berries during the evening and stores them at the bottom of the sea floor. It buries them with utmost care, separating them by color.

entry: 它集中精神，让双拳凝出厚冰。POKENAME一拳便能瞬间冻住整座湖。
author: .izik
source: By concentrating, it can form thick layers of ice on its fists. A punch from a POKENAME can freeze an entire lake in an instant.

entry: 五年前，一群POKENAME在美女橘岛附近安家。潜水员常去收集POKENAME舌上自然生成的宝石。
author: .izik
source: A pod of POKENAME made its home near Cleopatra Island five years ago. Divers visit regularly to gather the gems that naturally form on POKENAME's tongues.

entry: 它最近才被发现。科学家曾认为POKENAME是已灭绝的冰雪巨龙与现代大竺葵之间，遗失的进化环节。
author: Mister J
source: This Pokémon was recently discovered. Scientists once thought POKENAME to be a 'missing link' between the extinct Aurorus and modern Meganium species.

entry: 不知为何，融合后，极光头冠变得带有放射性。释放的微量辐射，与POKENAME的健康程度成正比。科学家用这种符号表示原子的衰变常数。
author: epping_forest
source: Nobody knows how it happened, but the aurora crest became radioactive after the fusion. This light amount of radiation emitted is proportional to how healthy POKENAME is. Scientists use this symbol to represent the disintegration constant of an atom.

entry: POKENAME曾在冰河时代的酷寒中繁盛，也能适应现代气候。背火呈现人眼无法尽见的色彩，释放的能量与北极光相同。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME used to thrive in the freezing temperatures of the ice age, but can adapt well to modern climates. The fire on its back produces more colors than the human eye can perceive and emits the same energies as the northern lights.

entry: 宽大美丽的双翼，让它与荧光鱼竞争“海中狩猎凤蝶”的称号。不过比起水中，人们更常见它在空中滑翔。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: Its large, beautiful wings are have caused it to rival Finneon for the title of 'Beautifly of the sea'. However, it's more often seen gliding through the air than in the water.

entry: 极寒地带的POKENAME目击记录，已有3000多年。最古老的记载称，它住在永不消失的极光中，但气象学家尚未证实这种现象。
author: merclipse
source: Sightings of POKENAME in the coldest regions of the world date back over 3000 years. The oldest records claim this Pokémon dwells within a permanent aurora, but no such phenomenon has been confirmed by meteorologists.

entry: POKENAME释放的波导，冷得足以冻水。有时光站在身旁，就会嘴唇发青。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: The aura POKENAME produces is cold enough to freeze water. Sometimes, standing directly next to it is enough to turn ones lips blue.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴握住水晶，借此吸引同伴或朋友。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME are known to hold crystals with their tails. They do this to attract companions or friends.

entry: 这种华美的生物，会载着在寒地迷路的旅人回家，事后再讨些食物作酬劳。高兴时，即使晴空白日，它也能让极光铺满天际。
author: epping_forest
source: This gorgeous creature is known to carry lost travelers from cold areas to their home, later asking for food in return. When it feels happy, it can cast aurora lights across the sky, even in a sunny day.

entry: POKENAME主要吃岩石，偶尔也吃一两颗水晶，权当甜点。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME eats mostly rocks. It will sometimes eat a crystal or two has a sweet treat.

entry: POKENAME的冰甲在月下闪耀，构成美丽的光墙自卫。冰冷目光能将小型猎物冻在原地，既迷人又危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's icy plates shimmer under moonlight, creating a beautiful Light Screen as a defense mechanism. Its cold gaze can freeze smaller prey in their tracks, making it both enchanting and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME虽比三角钢琴还重，中空身体却仍能优雅滑过天空。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Despite POKENAME weighing more than a grand piano, its hollow body glides through the air with elegance.

entry: 它飞过天空时，散出闪亮雾气。雾的温度，能降到远低于冰点。
author: .izik
source: As it flies through the sky it emits a sparkling mist. This mist can drop to temperatures that are far below freezing.

entry: 嵌在POKENAME体内的水晶，会冷却周围空气。少了它们，POKENAME就会融化。
author: ohok3441
source: The crystals embedded in POKENAME chill the air around it. Without them, POKENAME would melt.

entry: POKENAME用长脖子缠住对手，将其牢牢制伏。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME wraps its long neck around its opponents in order to pin them down properly.

entry: POKENAME比起发怒，更愿保持漂亮。可洁净皮毛一沾泥，照样大发脾气。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: Instead of getting angry, POKENAME prefers to look pretty. It still has temper tantrums whenever its pristine coat is sullied with dirt.

entry: 最初从冰中发现POKENAME时，人们估计它已被困100年。证据表明，这期间大脑仍在发育。
author: Incognito1234
source: When POKENAME was first found in ice, it was estimated to have been trapped for 100 years. Evidence shows its brain still developed during this time.

entry: 校园故事中，POKENAME会掳走在暴风雪里逗留太久的孩子。它吹出的风，能冷到远低于冰点。
author: .izik
source: There are schoolyard stories of POKENAME stealing children away that spend too much time in a blizzard. It can blow air that drops well below freezing.

entry: POKENAME族群亲密，做什么都在一起。捕猎时，幼崽以棍棒般的尾巴击打猎物，一击即退，再由成体扑上，完成猎杀。
author: .fedoraman
source: Packs of POKENAME are very close-knit, doing everything together. When hunting, the younger pups employ hit-and-run tactics, battering their prey with their club-like tails before the adults swoop in for the kill.

entry: POKENAME爱不断舔拭颈圈上的石头，把它们擦亮。有时一打哈欠，两颗巨牙太重，反而把自己坠倒。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to constantly polish the rocks on its collar by licking them. Sometimes when it yawns the weight of its two massive fangs causes it to fall over.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮里藏着许多小石子般坚硬的尖刺。尖刺带有使人麻木的毒素，战斗时，它会通过摩擦对手来下毒。
author: Celio_0230
source: POKENAME carries many hard, pebble-like quills within its fur. These quills carry a numbing toxin, which it uses in combat by rubbing up against the opponent.

entry: POKENAME勇猛地保护训练家，如同忠心的护卫犬。只要察觉威胁，全身倒刺就会齐齐竖起，准备迎敌护主。
author: Celio_0230
source: POKENAME protects its Trainer with fierce bravery, much like a loyal guard dog. If it senses a threat, all of its barbs bristle up at once as it prepares to protect its Trainer.

entry: 它忠诚，常被当作宠物。不过不宜如此，一发怒，咬击甚至能穿透骨头。
author: mystora
source: This loyal Pokémon is often kept as a pet. However, doing so is inadvisable, as its bite is strong enough to pierce bones when angered.

entry: POKENAME亲近人类，常在城镇旁的水洼游泳。它们喜欢被摸头，还会主动找陌生人讨摸。
author: TheHeroicT
source: POKENAME are friendly to humans, and are often found swimming in puddles near towns. They enjoy being pat on the head, and will often run up to strangers to beg for more pats.

entry: 若在当地发现POKENAME，通常就说明附近岩石中的矿物含有导电元素。
author: .realthree
source: If you find a POKENAME in the area, it's a good sign that the minerals in the local stone contain conductive elements.

entry: POKENAME借大头的重量，把石鬃猛甩向敌人。它对外者警惕，常先仔细判断局势，再投入战斗。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME uses the weight of its large head to slam its mane of rocks into enemies. It is wary of others and often takes its time assessing the situation before leaping into battle.

entry: 城里人视POKENAME为理想宠物，乡间居民却指责野生个体，是破坏庄稼的害兽。
author: .realthree
source: Though they're regarded as desirable pets in urban areas, those living in rural areas denounce wild POKENAME as destructive pests.

entry: POKENAME会耐心让自家幼崽从错误中学习，对族群之外却没那么宽容。穿越荒地的人知道，得多带食物，才可能获准通过它们的领地。
author: .fedoraman
source: As parents, POKENAME allow their younger pups to learn from their mistakes, but they are not so patient with non-pack members. Those who travel through badlands know to bring extra food so that they may be permitted access through POKENAME territory.

entry: POKENAME以时速50英里钻行地下，追猎地鼠与派拉斯。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME burrows underground at a speed of 50 mph. It chases after Diglett and Paras as its prey.

entry: POKENAME多住在沙漠般的环境，轻易融入沙中，扑向毫无防备的猎物，迅速饱餐。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME tends to live in desert-like environments. It can easily disguise itself in the sand and pounce on unsuspecting prey for a quick meal.

entry: POKENAME皮毛极厚，能在高空飞行时保暖。抚摸它的毛，POKENAME就能读懂你的心。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has very thick fur to keep it warm when it flies at high elevations. If you pet its fur, POKENAME can read your heart.

entry: 斑驳体色，让POKENAME藏进栖地岩石间。吃下的矿物越多，深色斑点也越多。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's mottled coloring allows it to hide among the rocks of its habitat. The more minerals that this Pokémon consumes, the more dark spots appear on it.

entry: 偏远山中的POKENAME缺少练习，幻术不如靠近人烟的POKENAME熟练。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that live in remote mountains are less skilled at illusion than the POKENAME that live near populated areas due to a lack of practice.

entry: 两只POKENAME争夺领地时，会猛烈甩头，以獠牙互击。往往两败俱伤，所以它们不太愿意开打。
author: .realthree
source: When two POKENAME battle over territory, they violently thrash their heads about to strike each other with their tusks. These battles don't usually end well, so they're hesitant to enter into one.

entry: POKENAME的毛并不像人们以为的那样保暖。毛其实由导热矿物组成，将热量导离身体，帮助施展冰寒攻击。
author: .realthree
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's fur does not keep it warm. The fur is actually comprised of conductive minerals that help power the Pokémon's icy attacks by conducting heat away from its body.

entry: POKENAME爱找附近各种宝可梦打架。数量稀少，又渴望变强，让许多训练家心向往之。
author: 1bridgeyboo
source: POKENAME are known for picking fights with any other Pokémon in the area. They are rare, and many Trainers desire them for their drive to grow strong.

entry: 不为进食而捕猎的POKENAME，会被族群排斥。这只却满足于独自飞行，突袭比自己更大的宝可梦，再以强韧抓握尾，将猎物拖下悬崖。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME who hunt without the intent to eat are ostracized from its packs. This Pokémon seems content flying alone, catching Pokémon even larger than itself by surprise and dragging them off cliffs with its strong prehensile tail.

entry: 双眼亮红时，便能看穿实物。为捕捉藏匿的猎物，它不惜伤到自己，连墙壁与巨石也会撞穿。
author: electricpenny48
source: When this Pokémon's eyes gleam red, it can see clearly through solid objects. If necessary, it will not hesitate to injure itself while on the hunt, even smashing through walls and large rocks to catch hiding prey.

entry: 传说POKENAME潜行乡野，赤鬃在月下如火。它猎捕不慎者，只留下爪痕，与幽兽出没的低语传闻。
author: ._term.
source: Legends speak of POKENAME stalking the countryside, its crimson mane blazing in the moonlight. It preys upon the unwary, leaving only claw marks and whispers of a shadowy beast haunting the land.

entry: 全身坚硬如基岩，触碰就会中毒。战斗时，坚不可破的头与沉重尾巴交替出击，攻势连绵不绝。
author: Celio_0230
source: Its entire body is as hard as bedrock, and toxic to the touch. It alternates between using its unbreakable head and its heavy tail to continuously deliver strikes when fighting.

entry: POKENAME是真正的凶兽，鲜少有谁敢争领地。深夜一声长嚎，多数宝可梦都会惊醒，逃离附近。
author: Frokachu
source: A truly savage beast that has few contenders for territory. When a POKENAME howls in the dead of night, most Pokémon will wake and flee the area.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然现身，吓训练家一跳。训练家越享受这些恶作剧，POKENAME就越尊重对方。
author: TeatedTiten
source: POKENAME likes to play pranks on its Trainer, usually with jumpscares.  The more the Trainer enjoys its pranks, the more POKENAME respects them.

entry: POKENAME拍翼奏出美妙旋律。成群POKENAME常伴着自己的音乐，欢快起舞。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a beautiful melody as it beats its wings. Swarms of POKENAME can be seen joyfully dancing to their own music.

entry: 它不停地练习音乐，试图创造出完美的旋律。由于练习时用的是宝可梦之笛，它在找到那首特别的曲子前都不会入睡，因此显得十分憔悴。
author: sk372
source: It practices music endlessly, trying to create the perfect melody. Its haggard appearance is due to using a Pokéflute to practice, ensuring it will not sleep until it finds that special song.

entry: 许多POKENAME将歌曲磨成优美摇篮曲。休息时仍不停演奏，让自己永远沉睡，也引来附近生灵一同入梦。
author: sk372
source: Many POKENAME have perfected their song in the form of a beautiful lullaby. They continue to play this music even as they rest, perpetuating their sleep endlessly and drawing those near to join them in slumber.

entry: POKENAME一度被当成战前遗物，如今却有许多崭露头角的音乐人，与它共同演出。
author: inksans201x
source: Once thought to be a pre-war relic, many up-and-coming musicians had been found performing with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME由裹满黏液的触手组成。拨动触手，便能奏出竖琴般舒缓的旋律。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of a collection of slime-coated tentacles. It will strum its tentacles to create a soothing melody similar to that of a harp.

entry: 据说POKENAME是节奏与歌曲之神。歌声创造万物，从大陆到飓风，都能造出。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME are said to be deities of rhythm and song. Their singing is capable of creating anything from continents to hurricanes.

entry: POKENAME常像偶像团体一样合唱，吸引来热爱它们音乐的忠实追随者。
author: zic
source: POKENAME often sing in groups similar to idols. Because of this, they gain devoted followers who enjoy listening to their music.

entry: POKENAME是住进旧留声机的灵体。据说POKENAME的乐曲会令人泪流不止，因此电影导演常拿来催动观众情绪。
author: odditylad
source: POKENAME is a spirit that has made its home inside an old gramophone. The music POKENAME plays is said to make anyone cry uncontrollably. Because of this, its music is popular in movies when directors want to get a reaction from the audience.

entry: POKENAME已精通歌声形态的歌舞，诸般艺术皆能熟练施展，如今甚至能演奏过去、现在与未来的旋律。
author: zic
source: Having mastered the Aria styles of song and dance, POKENAME has become fully proficient in all of its arts. It is now capable of preforming melodies from the past, present, and even the future.

entry: 同时掌握歌声形态的歌艺与舞步形态的舞艺后，美洛耶塔便能化作这种姿态，展现两种才华交融的和谐之美。
author: zic
source: Meloetta that have mastered both the Aria and Pirouette styles of dance and song can assume this form, showing a harmonious mix of their talents.

entry: 将歌唱与舞蹈融会贯通后，POKENAME便达到这一新形态，能优美地边唱边跳，丝毫不乱。
author: teamskullelitecross
source: Having mastered a fusion of both its singing and dancing, POKENAME achieved this new form. It now sings and dances beautifully in sync.

entry: 少数目击者表示，发光的电子音箱会放大它的歌声。除此之外，关于POKENAME仍所知甚少。
author: zic
source: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, its songs are amplified by its glowing electronic speakers. Little else is known about POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用镰刃奏出小提琴般的优美乐曲。艳丽绿瓣也能充当临时乐器，声音还颇为悦耳。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME plays beautiful melodies on its sickles, similar to a violin. Its gorgeous green petals can be used as makeshift instruments and even sound quite pleasant.

entry: 即使藏在地下，它也会大声歌唱。那些神秘歌声，却曾被错怪是幽灵作祟。
author: Busilisk
source: This Pokémon sings loudly, even while hidden underground. These mysterious songs have been erroneously blamed on ghosts.

entry: 每只POKENAME都创作独特曲调，成员间和声完美。可第四个成员究竟来自何处，始终无人弄清。
author: bostroms
source: Each POKENAME composes its own unique melodies, and its members sing in perfect harmony with each other.  No one has been able to figure out where its fourth member comes from.

entry: 它嚎唱时音准分毫不差，甚至边喷火，也能将同一个音稳稳唱住。
author: greystorm101
source: It howls with pitch-perfect accuracy, and can even hold a note while expelling flames from its mouth.

entry: 据说POKENAME是节奏与舞蹈之神。每个舞步，都蕴含创生的力量。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME are said to be deities of rhythm and dance. Every step they take is filled with power capable of creation.

entry: 这种美洛耶塔用美妙歌声迷住听众。歌声动人得让有幸观看演出的人，此后心中永远安宁喜悦。
author: zic
source: This variant of Meloetta uses its lovely singing voice to captivate others. Its songs are so lovely, that those fortunate enough to witness its performances are permanently filled with peace and joy.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: zic
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: zic
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: zic
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: POKENAME能向熟睡生物释放轻微电击，为对方带来甜甜美梦。
author: obstagoonalldayandnight
source: POKENAME has the ability to release small electric shocks to sleeping creatures, giving them a very sweet dream.

entry: 传说它会到受噩梦困扰的家庭门前，挥动新月形魔杖，为这一家人提供帮助。
author: pankiwi
source: Legends tell of this Pokémon aiding the houses of families suffering from nightmares by waving its crescent-moon-shaped wand over their doors.

entry: 有人说POKENAME远行数光年，只为与人和宝可梦分享自己的蛋。蛋的风味，被形容为不属尘世。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some say that POKENAME traveled several light years to share its eggs with humans and Pokémon. These eggs are noted to have an otherworldly flavor.

entry: POKENAME夜里现身，为孩子带来好梦。常受噩梦困扰的人，会养着它，借摇篮曲般的甜美叫声安睡。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in the night to bring children good dreams. People with frequent nightmares keep this Pokémon to help them sleep with their sweet lullaby-like cries.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，月牙般的肢体便会明亮发光。有些城市，还用它们来照亮夜晚。
author: TheHeroicT
source: When POKENAME sleeps, its moon-like appendages shine brightly. They are used to light up certain cities at night.

entry: 它神出鬼没，会向饱受夜间惊惧的人现身，据说此后便能护其远离噩梦。月光下，POKENAME的铠甲几乎能挡住大多数攻击，力量也能迅速恢复。
