author: EvilGammon
source: This elusive Pokémon appears to people plagued with night terrors, and is said to shield them from bad dreams thereafter. In the light of the moon, POKENAME's armor is near impervious to most attacks, and is able to recover its strength rapidly.

entry: 据说POKENAME背甲上树木的叶子，能治百病。月明之夜，人们还能看见它的影子映在月面。
author: Trietceratops Horridus
source: The leaves on the tree on POKENAME's shell are said to be able to cure all diseases. On moonlit nights, people can see its shadow cast on the surface of the moon.

entry: 研究者调查发现，约34%的训练家，曾在梦中见过POKENAME。多数人表示，那算不上好梦，却也并非噩梦。
author: kingd8
source: In a survey taken by researchers, approximately 34% of all Trainers have reportedly seen POKENAME in their dreams at some point. A majority of responders claimed that they were not pleasant dreams, but not nightmares.

entry: POKENAME能察觉遥远恒星的微弱热量，因此有些天文学家会借它的感官，校准望远镜。
author: greystorm101
source: It is able to detect faint heat from distant stars. Because of this, some astronomers calibrate their telescopes with the help of POKENAME's senses.

entry: 皮毛的宇宙花纹，像极了它出生时的夜空。月光下，毛上的星星还会闪烁。
author: greystorm101
source: The cosmic pattern in its fur resembles the night sky under which it was born. In moonlight, the stars on its coat will twinkle.

entry: POKENAME穿行一个个噩梦，救出被困其中的人，引向更幸福的梦境。
author: lemage22
source: POKENAME travels around many nightmares, rescuing those trapped in them and guiding them towards happier dreams.

entry: POKENAME搜集海上漂流物，在安静海湾筑巢。再藏进散落杂物间，耐心等待，伏击经过的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects pieces of floating flotsam, using them to build nests in quiet coves. It hides among these scattered objects, waiting patiently to surprise passing prey.

entry: POKENAME从口中喷出盐水，以盐雾裹身，迷惑来袭者。盐水攻守兼备，让它在水下作战占尽优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits brine from its mouth, surrounding itself with a salty cloud that confuses attackers. It uses the brine both offensively and defensively, maintaining its dominance in underwater battles.

entry: POKENAME游过睡莲叶间，借掩护突袭猎物。鲜艳的鳍如同花瓣，悄然融入周围水景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides among lily pads, using their cover to ambush unsuspecting prey. Its colorful fins resemble flower petals, blending seamlessly into its watery surroundings.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚间筑巢，以鲜艳身体融入礁群，再凶猛守卫，驱逐闯入栖地的家伙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests among coral, using its vibrant body to blend into reef formations. It guards these areas fiercely, keeping intruders away from its chosen habitat.

entry: POKENAME沿岸搜集杂物，凡觉得有趣的都留下。收藏既显出好奇心，也反映周围环境的状况。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scavenges for debris along shorelines, collecting anything it finds interesting. These collections often reflect both its curiosity and the state of the environment around it.

entry: POKENAME长途迁徙时乘着洋流省力，再凭迅猛加速调整方向，是开阔水域的旅行高手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rides ocean currents to conserve energy during long migrations. It uses powerful bursts of speed to control its direction, making it a master of open water travel.

entry: POKENAME有时把藤壶附在鳍上，化作天然铠甲，也借此伪装成岩石海床的一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sometimes attaches barnacles to its fins, using them as natural armor. The barnacles also serve as camouflage, making it look like part of the rocky seafloor.

entry: POKENAME搜寻沉船，吃掉遗留电脑设备。数字组件强化了内部系统，让它穿行险水时，准得近乎不可思议。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scours shipwrecked vessels, consuming computer equipment left behind. Its appetite for digital components allows it to enhance its internal systems, improving its ability to navigate treacherous waters with uncanny precision.

entry: 它曾住在史前海岸，以钻石般的牙咬穿菊石兽、化石盔等宝可梦的外壳。
author: Staghorn
source: It once lived on prehistoric coasts, using its diamond-like teeth to bite through the shells of Omanyte, Kabuto, and similar Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME收集被抛弃的漂流杂物，添入河岸精巧的巢，还爱将收藏装点成有趣摆设。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects jetsam, adding it to elaborate nests along riverbanks. It often decorates these collections, turning them into playful displays.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁，突然发光迷惑天敌，再穿过曲折礁道，把小鱼逼进窄缝捕食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides among coral reefs, using bursts of bioluminescence to confuse predators. It navigates the reef's intricate paths, hunting small fish by cornering them in tight spaces.

entry: POKENAME将海藻织成护身住所，巢穴随洋流摇摆。发光斑点如小鱼般，吸引猎物游进洞中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves seaweed into protective shelters, creating nests that sway with the ocean's currents. Its bioluminescent spots mimic small fish to attract prey into its lair.

entry: 跳舞时，花瓣彼此摩擦，发出磨牙般的声音。据说这舞蹈，是唤醒海中某种存在的仪式。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: When it dances, its petals rub together and make a sound like gnashing teeth. It's said that their dance is a ritual to awaken something in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME喜欢海滩，一边晒太阳，一边找食物。涨潮时，就钻进沙中休息，等海水退去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives on beaches, basking in the sunlight as it searches for food. It burrows into the sand during high tide, resting until the waters recede.

entry: POKENAME在平静海湾繁衍，穿行浅水觅食。常能见它快活地拍水玩，令遇见的人也跟着开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in calm bays, where it weaves through shallow waters in search of food. Its playful splashes are a common sight, bringing joy to those who encounter it.

entry: POKENAME散出腐烂草木般的臭气，吓退天敌，徘徊在鲜有宝可梦敢跟进的浑水中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exudes a foul odor, resembling rotten vegetation, to ward off predators. It lingers in murky waters, where few Pokémon dare to follow.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地漂过沼泽，以鲜艳外貌吓退天敌。钻进泥下睡觉时，路过者几乎发现不了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts lazily through swamps, using its colorful appearance to ward off predators. It burrows beneath the mud to sleep, making it nearly invisible to anything passing by.

entry: POKENAME适于台风中的混乱水域，借激流捕猎。满身尖刺，让它穿行风浪也不易受伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in the chaos of typhoons, using violent currents to hunt for food. Its spiked body helps it navigate the stormy waters without injury.

entry: POKENAME误将潜艇的金属船身当成大型水生生物，常一路跟随，对船的迷恋也将它引向深海。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is known to follow submarines, mistaking their metallic hulls for large aquatic creatures. Its fascination with these vessels often draws it to the depths of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME搜集沉船遗失的古卷，小心藏在隐秘水下洞穴。有人相信其中保存失落知识，可鲜少有人敢打扰POKENAME的巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers ancient scrolls lost in shipwrecks, storing them carefully in hidden underwater caves. Some believe these scrolls hold forgotten knowledge, though few dare disturb POKENAME's lair.

entry: POKENAME喜欢抽象艺术中鲜艳的色彩与图案。时装模特和艺术家常带着它作伴。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME are fond of the vivid colors and patterns of abstract art. They are a common companion among fashion models and artists alike.

entry: POKENAME轻松游在帆船旁，享受船尾水流。只在风平浪静时现身，因此水手视它为好运之兆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides effortlessly alongside sailboats, enjoying the wake created by the vessels. Sailors consider it a sign of good luck, as it appears only in calm seas.

entry: POKENAME巡视海岸，警戒海陆两处的威胁。金属鳞片反射阳光，光纹耀眼，既警告来者，也如信标指路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols coastlines, watching for threats from both land and sea. Its metallic scales reflect sunlight, creating dazzling patterns that serve as both a warning and a beacon.

entry: POKENAME受声响与速度吸引，和摩托艇并行竞速。它爱船只掀起的浪，还常借尾流翻腾嬉戏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races beside motorboats, drawn to the noise and speed. It delights in the waves these vessels create, often using the wake to perform playful acrobatics.

entry: POKENAME爱与潜水员接触，好奇地跟进水下洞穴。庞大体型，让深海探险者既惊叹，也面临危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is known to interact with scuba divers, curiously following them through underwater caves. Its immense size makes it both a marvel and a hazard for those exploring the depths.

entry: POKENAME即使闭眼，钥匙环上的许多嘴仍会咬向附近一切。POKENAME年纪越大，嘴也越多，新嘴总是毫无预兆地冒出。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even if POKENAME's eyes are closed, the multiple mouths on its keyring will still gnash at anything nearby. The older the POKENAME, the more mouths it will have. New mouths appear suddenly, out of the blue.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁底筑巢，会大声模仿超坏星与巨牙鲨融合体的叫声，借这捕食者的威势，赶走家旁的入侵者。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME make their nests at the base of coral reefs, loudly imitating the call of the predatory Toxedo to ward off intruders near their home.

entry: 它用头上的花状触须集中超能力，再以精神脉冲探查四周。
author: .izik
source: It uses the flower-like antennae on its head to focus its psychic powers. It uses these psychic pulses to determine its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME爱与冲浪者同行，轻松优雅地乘浪，还常顽皮地模仿冲浪板上的人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys swimming alongside surfers, riding waves with effortless grace. It has a playful demeanor, often mimicking the movements of those on boards.

entry: POKENAME以惊人身手攀上瀑布峭壁，迸发能量向上跃升。每次跳跃之间，便在浅池歇息，准备下一段攀爬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ascends waterfall-filled cliffs with surprising agility, using bursts of energy to propel itself upward. It rests in shallow pools between leaps, preparing for the next climb.

entry: 据说死后仍不肯移开自恋目光的灵魂，会在彼岸变成POKENAME。若打断它照镜子欣赏自己，就会勃然大怒。
author: Milchik
source: The spirits of the most narcissistic of people who can't tear their gazes from themselves even after death are thought to become this Pokémon in the afterlife. POKENAME will get furious if distracted from admiring itself in the mirror.

entry: POKENAME钻进泥潭，耐心埋伏。身上裹满泥浆，与沼泽几乎无法区分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into quagmires, waiting patiently to ambush prey. Its body becomes coated in mud, making it indistinguishable from the swampy environment.

entry: POKENAME守在游艇码头，捕捉被船只动静引来的猎物。锐齿能轻易咬断缆绳与钓线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks around marinas, waiting to catch unsuspecting prey drawn by the movement of boats. It uses its sharp teeth to tear through ropes and fishing lines with ease.

entry: POKENAME巡视北极水域，轻松游过冰海，以强颚咬碎冰山，替小宝可梦开路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols arctic waters, slicing through icy seas with ease. It uses its powerful jaws to shatter icebergs, carving pathways for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在季风中乘风而行，再险恶的天气也能从容穿过。鲜艳体色掠过风暴云，为暗天添上闪亮色彩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rides the winds during monsoons, navigating treacherous weather with ease. Its vibrant colors flash through storm clouds, adding bursts of brightness to dark skies.

entry: POKENAME天生善浮，特殊组织使漂浮十分省力。它安然漂过水面，轻哼曲调，安抚训练家与宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is naturally buoyant, using specialized tissues for efficient flotation. It drifts serenely across water surfaces, humming softly to soothe both Pokémon and Trainers.

entry: POKENAME游荡在水下遗迹旁，寻找深埋淤泥的小宝物。常伪装成残骸，伏击好奇靠近的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lingers near sunken ruins, where it scavenges for small treasures buried beneath layers of silt. It is often mistaken for part of the wreckage, lying in wait to ambush curious prey.

entry: POKENAME攀住浮木，用锐刺贯穿游过的猎物。注入强毒，使其麻痹，再也游不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to driftwood, using its sharp spikes to pierce passing prey. The potent toxins it injects can paralyze its target, rendering them unable to swim.

entry: 猎物一进入这只凶暴宝可梦的触手范围，就会遭超能力轰击，再挨一记重咬。若仍未制服，POKENAME才会用最后手段，注入致命毒液。
author: bobosmith01
source: Any prey unlucky enough to wander inside this aggressive Pokémon's tentacles will be bombarded with psychic power, followed up by a large bite. If this combination fails, POKENAME will inject its lethal poison into the prey as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME沿岸收集贝壳，在沙上摆出复杂图案。珍藏守得很紧，谁若靠得太近，就朝谁嘶嘶叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects shells along the shore, crafting intricate patterns in the sand. It guards its treasures jealously, often hissing at anyone who approaches too closely.

entry: POKENAME在河上筑小坝，改道水流困住猎物。干活不知疲倦，可行事反复无常，有时竟引发意外洪水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constructs small dams along rivers, diverting water to trap prey. It works tirelessly, though its erratic behavior sometimes results in unexpected floods.

entry: POKENAME用头上花状部位视物，水里水外，都不妨碍它感知他者。科学家推测，它还看得见人类可见光谱以外的色彩。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sees everything through the flower-like appendage on its head, and this ability to sense others is not impeded either in or out of water. Scientists suspect it sees colors outside of the visible spectrum that humans cannot see.

entry: POKENAME穿行在茂密的芦苇丛中，借此伏击毫无防备的猎物。它的动作流畅而优雅，在随风摇曳的植物间几乎无法被察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves through dense reeds, using them to ambush unsuspecting prey. It moves with fluid grace, making it nearly impossible to detect among the swaying plants.

entry: POKENAME躲在壳里捕猎。猎物一近，POKENAME便突然探出，鲜艳骇人的脸令对方怔住，足够POKENAME咬出粉碎性的重击。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME hunts by hiding in its shell. When prey draws near, POKENAME pops out, and its bright horrifying face stuns the target long enough for POKENAME to land a crushing bite.

entry: POKENAME的毒咬能麻痹猎物，也能麻痹天敌。皮肤还会排毒，吓阻胆敢靠近者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venomous bite can paralyze both prey and predators alike. It releases toxins through its skin, deterring anyone that dares approach.

entry: POKENAME蜇刺会引起剧痒，让目标慌乱挣扎。它便视情况趁乱逃走，或再度出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sting causes intense itching, driving victims into frantic fits. It uses this distraction to escape or strike again, depending on the situation.

entry: POKENAME懒散地漂过溪流，偶尔咬住经过的小猎物。在水下一待数小时，只有水流推来，才会移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts lazily through streams, occasionally snapping at smaller prey that pass by. It spends hours submerged, moving only when carried by the current.

entry: POKENAME天生擅长海上活动，水面深海都能轻松穿行。贪玩的性情，也让它成为长途航海的好伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME displays a natural flair for nautical activities, easily navigating both surface waters and ocean depths. Its playful nature makes it a welcome companion on long sea voyages.

entry: POKENAME潜伏污水系统，以废物和污染物为食。恶臭吓退天敌，使它在污水中颇有威慑力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks in sewage systems, feeding off waste and pollutants. It emits a foul odor to deter predators, making it a formidable presence in polluted waters.

entry: POKENAME常贴在船侧，悄悄搭船穿过深水。贝壳般的鳍融入船身，很难察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often clings to the sides of vessels, riding along unnoticed as they travel through deep waters. Its shell-like fins blend seamlessly into the ship's hull, making it difficult to spot.

entry: POKENAME藏在荒芜地带，将孢子种在死去宝可梦的骨头上。别随意捡拾那里的骨骸，通常已布满毒孢子。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME often hide in barren wastelands, planting their spores onto the bones of deceased Pokémon. Do not attempt to grab any bones you find in these wastelands, as they're usually infested with these poisonous spores.

entry: 控制派拉斯特的寄生者，为寻找更好的宿主，感染了魔墙人偶。获得超能力后，它几乎能骗过任何训练家或宝可梦，使其成为后代的下一任宿主。
author: Ogriphor
source: Attempting to find a more suitable host, the parasite controlling Parasect has infected a Mr. Mime. Now armed with psychic abilities, it can trick nearly any Trainer or Pokémon into becoming the next host to its offspring.

entry: 它的蘑菇会吸收大量水分，并用孢子污染水体。有POKENAME出没的水域污染极为严重，饮用其中的水会产生强烈幻觉。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its mushrooms absorb large amounts of water to infect it with its spores. Waters where POKENAME can be found are incredibly contaminated and consumption can cause severe hallucinations.

entry: 蘑菇的菌盖保护着虫茧，蘑菇本身则感染着茧内正在发育的宝可梦。在此过程中，虫茧会剧烈挣扎，随后彻底静止。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom cap aids in protecting the cocoon, while the mushroom itself infects the developing Pokémon within. The cocoon thrashes violently as it does so, before becoming perfectly still.

entry: 它性情友好，散出的孢子如闪粉。可爱模样之下，却藏着相当厚实的身体。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: This friendly Pokémon releases spores that look like sparkly glitter. Its cute demeanor hides a lot of bulk.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇改造了它的身体，使其只为在地下传播孢子而存在。即使某一节身体脱落，菌丝也会驱使它继续盲目爬动。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME have modified their bodies for nothing but spreading spores through the ground. Even if a segment is detached, the mycelium will make it continue to blindly scuttle about.

entry: POKENAME头上长着寄生珊瑚。临死前，会浮到水面，向水中散播孢子。
author: rhysanthemum
source: A parasitic coral grows from the heads of POKENAME. When they are close to death, they will float to the surface and spread spores across the water.

entry: POKENAME头上的菌丝和嘴唇一样敏感。虽然双目失明，它仍能靠这些部位的触觉辨认方向。
author: .realthree
source: The mycelium on POKENAME's head is just as sensitive as its lips. Though blind, it finds its way by feeling with these.

entry: 腹袋里的蘑菇操控POKENAME的宿主体，改变脑内化学状态，让它始终幸福满足、温顺听命。究竟是共生还是寄生，争议很大。
author: SonTyp
source: The mushroom in its belly pouch mentally controls POKENAME's host body, keeping it docile by inducing a constant state of happy contentment in its brain chemistry. Whether this is symbiosis or parasitism is heavily discussed.

entry: 它吸收周围静电，如电火花般散出孢子。若落雷击中POKENAME，就会爆发大量孢子，感染周围大片区域的一切生命。
author: sk372
source: As it draws energy from ambient static, it sheds spores in a manner akin to electric sparks. Should lightning strike POKENAME, a huge burst of spores will erupt and infect all life in a wide radius around it.

entry: 沙奈朵遭派拉斯特伏击，沦为空壳与寄生宿主。据说为了护主，它不惜牺牲自己，也不惜牺牲其他所有宝可梦。
author: Ogriphor
source: After Gardevoir was ambushed by a Parasect, it became a husk of its former self, becoming the host for the parasite. It is said that it would not only give its life to protect its Trainer, but also the life of any and all Pokémon.

entry: 大群POKENAME会合力冲撞大树，将树撞倒，再吃随之腐烂的植物残骸。
author: bee4082
source: Large groups of POKENAME have been known to ram into and knock over large trees, feeding on the resulting decaying plant matter.

entry: 寄生蘑菇无法压过POKENAME纯粹的骄傲，只好被迫与它共生。
author: da_cookiez
source: The parastitic mushroom's control is unable to overcome POKENAME's pure pride, so it's forced to symbiotically coexist with it.

entry: POKENAME融入阴影，头上真菌控制身体，留在黑暗中吞食无防备的猎物。锐爪，便于它悄然偷袭。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME blends into the shadows, the fungus on its head controlling it to stay in the dark and feed on unsuspecting prey. Its sharp claws allows it to strike stealthily from the darkness.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗湿穴，以遍布的孢子标记领地。孢子中提取的毒物，还能制成致命毒素。
source: POKENAME lives in dark, damp caves which it infests with spores to mark its territory. The poison extracted from its spores can be used to create a deadly toxin.

entry: POKENAME的孢子造成噩梦般幻觉，对受害者真实得可怕。夜里，它还会爬上天花板，散布恐惧。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME spores cause nightmarish hallucinations that feel incredibly real to its victims. It appears in the night, crawling on the ceiling to inflict terror.

entry: POKENAME背上柔韧的蘑菇会拍动，让它飞行。抽搐般的突兀动作令人不安，少有天敌愿意猎它。
author: .realthree
source: The flexible mushroom on POKENAME's back flaps to propel the Pokémon through the air. Few predators will hunt this Pokémon due to its unnerving, jerking movements.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞地爬来爬去，毫无意识地沿途撒下孢子。有时，它的酸性口水会滴到下方的孢子上，让孢子失去活性。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME slowly scuttle about, thoughtlessly dropping spores in its path. Sometimes its acidic drool will land on the spores below them, rendering them useless.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的孢子可能致病。好在接触不多时，症状通常能顺利缓解。
author: ohok3441
source: Inhaling the spores from POKENAME's body can lead to illness. Luckily, symptoms ease up with little issue if exposure to the spores is limited.

entry: 蘑菇迅速榨取派拉斯的身心，几乎只留空壳。虚弱的POKENAME很容易遭捕食，最终败在寄生者的贪食之下。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms have siphoned away the mind and body of Paras rapidly, leaving it almost a husk. In this weakened state, POKENAME are often easily hunted, doomed due to the parasites' hunger.

entry: 变换形态后，POKENAME迅速疯长失控。吸入孢子者也会失去自控，成为向更多受害者传播其影响的媒介。
author: ohok3441
source: Upon changing form, POKENAME rapidly grows out of control. Those who've inhaled its spores lose all control of themselves and become vessels to spread its influence to more victims.

entry: 蘑菇长得太大，几乎遮住了原本身体。蓬松白色颈圈，其实是厚厚一束菌丝。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: The mushroom on this Pokémon has grown so large that little of its original body remains visible. Its fluffy white collar is composed of a thick bundle of mycelium.

entry: 真菌与火恐龙相互共生。借真菌的干燥皮肤特性，火恐龙不再受水属性招式伤害。
author: TheHeroicT
source: A symbiotic relationship between a fungus and a Charmeleon. Thanks to the fungus' Dry Skin, the Charmeleon is protected from Water-type moves.

entry: 虽有三个头，只有新长出的蘑菇才有类似大脑或意识的东西。即便切除，也只会把一个头再变成蘑菇，另长出新假头。
author: sk372
source: Three heads exist, but only the newly-formed mushroom has something resembling a brain or consciousness. If removed, it will simply transform one head into another mushroom, and grow a new false head.

entry: POKENAME摆动摆锤，寄生孢子便飘入目标脑中，影响心智，使其听命行事。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.

entry: POKENAME摆动摆锤，寄生孢子便飘入目标脑中，影响心智，使其听命行事。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.

entry: POKENAME摆动摆锤，寄生孢子便飘入目标脑中，影响心智，使其听命行事。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.

entry: POKENAME摆动摆锤，寄生孢子便飘入目标脑中，影响心智，使其听命行事。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: When POKENAME swings its pendulum, parasitic spores float into its victim's brain, influencing their mind and causing them to obey its will.

entry: POKENAME酷似某个古老的游戏传闻。奇怪的是，研究者一看它就莫名失落，仿佛本该有什么事情发生。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME resembles an old rumor about a video game. Curiously, researchers report that looking at it gives them a feeling of disappointment, as if something was supposed to happen.

entry: 传说POKENAME双翼由纯光构成，什么都能切开。它飞过黑夜，将四周照得如同白昼。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are said to be made of pure light, allowing it to slice through anything. It flies through the night, illuminating the dark as if it was day.

entry: 头角几乎无物不斩。若真遇到斩不开的，散出的热量仍能将其熔化。
author: Incognito1234
source: The horn on its head is able to cut through just about anything. If for some reason it cannot, the heat it radiates will still melt it.

entry: 强光沐浴整片丛林，让草木茂密强壮。它独自静坐，滋养赖以栖居的森林。
author: dragonessanimations
source: Its intense light bathes the whole jungle, allowing it to grow thick and strong. It sits in solitary, feeding its home jungle.

entry: POKENAME即使交给信任的训练家，也难以管住。无论有意无意，过强能量都会造成严重破坏。
author: ohok3441
source: Even with trusted Trainers, POKENAME are hard to manage. Their overpowering energy wreaks havoc whether they intend to or not.

entry: 终于找到渴求的光，POKENAME完成蜕变。如今POKENAME较为平和，训练家也能靠近。它爱探索宇宙、搜集宝物，金棺则放射着永无尽头的光。
author: the_smirker
source: After POKENAME has finally found the light it desires, it transforms. POKENAME is now moderately peaceful and can be approached by Trainers. It enjoys exploring the universe in search of treasures to collect. Its golden coffin emits an infinite glow.

entry: 它能随意让天空明暗变化，因此有“辉光之蚀”的绰号。POKENAME一有需要，就乐于借这本领取得优势。
author: omegacyclops
source: Capable of brightening or darkening the skies at will, such behavior has earned this Pokémon the nickname "The Bright Eclipse". POKENAME willingly uses this ability to its advantage whenever necessary.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌，住在外骨骼下方，发出鲜明光芒，照亮POKENAME四周。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus infecting POKENAME lives just beneath its exoskeleton. It is vividly bioluminescent, illuminating everything around POKENAME.

entry: 挣脱棱晶牢笼后，POKENAME用歌声肆虐破坏。据说死于其歌，是世上最美的死法。
author: GalactaKiller
source: Now unleashed from its prismatic prison, POKENAME will wreak havoc through its songs. It is said to be the most beautiful death one could receive.

entry: 开战前，POKENAME用长鞭般的缎带抽地，威吓对手。训练家却说，这是祈求必胜的战前仪式，不过并未证实。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When entering a battle, POKENAME will crack its whip-like ribbons on the ground to intimidate its opponent. Its Trainers instead say this is a pre-fighting ritual to ensure victory, though this is unproven.

entry: 传说POKENAME降临，便预示安宁未来。古老习俗称，危急时敲响祭铃，与其鳞片鸣响共振，就能将它召来。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends claim that the arrival of POKENAME is a sign of a peaceful future. Ancient traditions say that ringing ritual bells will resonate with the clanging of POKENAME's scales and summon it in times of need.

entry: POKENAME蜷成车轮，高速滚行。摆尾、抖鳞调整方向，沿途金属鸣声嘈杂不绝。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to curl themselves up into a wheel to roll at incredible speeds. They rattle their scales and swing their tails to steer, creating a cacophony of clanging as they travel.

entry: POKENAME自豪又欢快，领军打仗与主持庆典，都一样热情。不同节奏的鳞片鸣响，宣告开战或庆祝的开始。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very prideful and joyful creatures, leading battles and festivals with the same passion. They will clang their scales together in different rhythms to signal the start of war or celebration.

entry: POKENAME个头大、力量强，却不爱战斗。遇威胁，宁可快速戳上一击，再撤退蓄力。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite its large size and immense power, POKENAME tends to avoid battling. It prefers to take a quick jab at threats and then retreat to store power.

entry: POKENAME是无情猎手，能瞬间刺穿比自己小的生物，连其他具甲武者融合宝可梦也会攻击。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a ruthless hunter, spearing any creature smaller than it in an instant. It'll even attack other Golisopod fusions.

entry: 据说POKENAME花瓣般的火焰会舞动，迷住观者的心。加上鲜艳体色与甜香，使它颇受户外庆典欢迎。
author: astral_rain
source: POKENAME's petal-like flames are said to dance and captivate the hearts of those that see them. This, alongside its vibrant colors and sweet scent, makes it a popular Pokémon for outdoor festivities.

entry: 它能在树间短暂滑翔，怕撞上时，还能直接穿树而过。眼睛并非宝石，可若这样告诉它，它又会伤心。
author: epping_forest
source: It can glide short distances between trees and go through them when it fears crashing. Its eyes are not made of gems, but being told so hurts its feelings.

entry: 它凶悍且破坏力强，却只吃草属性宝可梦。吞下的宝可梦的气味，会从花瓣散入空气。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Though this Pokémon is fierce and destructive, it only feasts on Grass-type Pokémon. Its petals permeate the air with scents of the Pokémon it ingests.

entry: POKENAME住在树果丛中，既得保护，又不愁食物，从出生起就很少离家。因此下半身长什么样，科学家至今仍在争论。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME lives in berry bushes for protection and a steady food source, rarely leaving its home since birth. As a result, scientists are still debating what its lower half looks like.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，吃富碳岩石，强化晶体铠甲。可甲层太厚，POKENAME又会难以行动。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves, eating the carbon-rich rock to help strengthen its crystalline armor. However, if the armor gets too thick, POKENAME starts to have difficulty moving around.

entry: POKENAME中空身体的内壁，由储光晶体构成。谁若想从POKENAME身上取下碎片，都会遭到敌意回应。
author: ohok3441
source: Within POKENAME's hollow body are walls of crystals that store light energy. Attempts to remove any shards from POKENAME have led it to react with hostility.

entry: POKENAME变换形态时，迅速长出晶体，再利用体内反射的阳光，射出一道道光束。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME rapidly produces crystals upon shifting form. It shoots beams of light from the sun rays reflecting within its body.

entry: POKENAME住在普通陆路到不了的水下洞穴。巨钳狠狠一夹，便能阻止勾魂眼靠近；面对更大的寻宝者，也绝不手软。
author: Wormspawn
source: POKENAME live in underwater caverns inaccessible by normal land routes. Firm pinches from their claws dissuade Sableye from getting too close, and they won't hesitate to do the same to larger treasure-hunters.

entry: POKENAME的蛋与毛发一样细绒柔软，营养和美味却丝毫不减。据说经常吃，对缓解过敏尤其有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eggs have a fine, fuzzy texture similar to its own hairs, though they are no less nutritious or delicious when eaten. Consuming them regularly is said to be particularly effective at combating allergies.

entry: POKENAME毛发上的毒粉影响心智，使其发狂。它会拿到什么就用什么，造出各种古怪装置。
author: Mistymagius
source: The poisonous dust from POKENAME's hair negatively affects its mind, causing it to go mad. It can be seen making odd contraptions out of anything it can get its hands on.

entry: 剑鞘酷似毛虫，鸟宝可梦常啄上去，却白忙一场。等发现不对，POKENAME早已开始抽取生命力。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its sheath looks just like a hairy bug, so bird Pokémon often peck at it fruitlessly. By the time they realize their mistake, it is too late - POKENAME has already begun draining their life force.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影里，与昆虫和虫属性宝可梦共处。进食时抛下伪装，显露骇人真形，将猎物整个吞下。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME lives in the shadows, with insects and Bug-type Pokémon. It throws off its disguise and unveils its horrendous form to eat its prey whole.

entry: POKENAME体内满是比空气重的毒气。与飘飘球不同，光是勉强浮起自己就很费劲，更别说拐走孩子。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME is filled with a poisonous gas that is heavier than air. Unlike Drifloon, it struggles to kidnap children because it can barely keep itself afloat.

entry: POKENAME藏住身体，等猎物擦过覆有黏稠甜腻毒素的叶片，便突然跳出咬住。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME hide their bodies and wait for prey to brush by their leaves, which are covered in a sticky, cloying toxin. Then, they pop out and bite.

entry: 它能从额头上带斑点的红色宝石发出奇特的招式。绒毛覆盖的身体很容易沾上灰尘、孢子、种子和泥土，因此它一天的大部分时间都在清理自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can fire off unusual moves from the speckled, red jewel on its forehead. Its fuzzy body quickly picks up dust, spores, seeds, and dirt, so it spends most of the day trying to clean itself.

entry: POKENAME卸下身上铠甲，将其打造成直接作战的武器。新钉头锤虽沉重，POKENAME却灵巧善谋，击击精准。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shed the armor from their bodies in favor of fashioning it into a weapon to use directly in battle. Despite the bulk of their new mace, POKENAME are dexterous and calculating, always landing precise blows.

entry: 遇险时，肌肉能产生大量电热能。耳间喷出的火星，还能使敌人短暂目眩。
author: anemonics
source: When in danger, its muscles function to create tremendous amounts of electrothermic energy. The puffs of embers from its ears may momentarily blind foes.

entry: POKENAME穿行火山之间，从盘旋升起的烈焰中现身。它号令周围一切火，乘风滑翔时闪耀橙金光彩。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Traveling between volcanoes, POKENAME appears within a rising spiral of flame. It commands all flames around it, shining in vibrant hues of orange and gold as it glides along the wind.

entry: POKENAME凭敏捷身手与皮肤色素，几乎隐入夜色。即使双眼难以看清，也能用敏锐舌头分析四周。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME use both their superb agility and skin pigments to appear nigh-undetectable in the darkness of night. Even when eyes can hardly see, they use the sensitive tongues to analyze their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME像流动道场，教呱呱泡蛙与妙蛙种子一系的融合体学习忍术。若里面的学员受威胁，POKENAME便急转背上水手里剑，射出刀刃般锐利的水滴。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME acts as a sort of traveling dojo for Froasaur, helping to teach them the art of ninjutsu. If anyone threatens the Froasaur inside, the POKENAME will rapidly spin the water shuriken on its back and launch razor-sharp droplets.

entry: POKENAME在空中、水面的速度都快得惊人。其中最快的POKENAME，更会故意借速度隐去身形、迷惑旁观者，让人几乎看不见。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are known for being incredibly fast both in the air and on the surface of the water. The fastest POKENAME in the world are hard to even see because they use their speed to deliberately disappear or deceive onlookers.

entry: POKENAME在山里试着用磁力吸煤。可煤不带磁性，只吸来大堆别的矿物。于是POKENAME改与矿工交换，拿矿物换煤。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME spends its time in the mountains attempting to use its magnetism to gather coal. Unfortunately, coal is not magnetic, and it ends up with loads of other minerals instead. POKENAME then trades these minerals with miners in exchange for coal.

entry: 伞盖散热保暖，也挡住空中火山灰。它神出鬼没，从自己喷出的烟幕走来，又消失在同一片烟云中。
author: sk372
source: Its umbrella radiates heat to keep it warm while shielding its body from volcanic ash in the air. It's known for being elusive, walking out from the smokescreen it billows, and vanishing into those same clouds.

entry: POKENAME温顺却强大，能制造最高摄氏650度的巨大热浪。岩石身体浸入熔岩储能，再由宝石放出亮光，据说能治愈百病。
author: Aurange
source: POKENAME is a docile, yet powerful Pokémon capable of producing vast heat waves up to 650° Celsius. They store energy by submerging their rocky bodies in lava, then expel it through their gemstones as gleaming light that is said to cure any illness.

entry: 它用巨钳慢慢烹煮猎物，一赢得战斗，就趁活吞吃。野生POKENAME能接受三分熟，训练过的则偏爱全熟。
author: epping_forest
source: It uses its giant clamp to slow-cook its prey, then eats it alive as soon as the fight is won. Wild POKENAME tolerate medium rare meat, while trained specimens prefer well done.

entry: 细看才发现，POKENAME微微浮在地面之上。研究者认为，是为了掩饰短腿行动无力、速度至多只能爬行的事实。
author: ohok3441
source: On close inspection, POKENAME appears to float just above the ground. Researchers believe it is to cover up the fact that their tiny legs lack the locomotion to get anywhere faster than a crawl.

entry: POKENAME在夜空大幅跃行，粉末四处飘散。别故意惹怒POKENAME，它们会追上目标反复冲撞，直到次日天明。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dart through the night sky in huge leaps, scattering powder all around. Intentionally angering POKENAME is a poor idea: they will chase down their target and ram them over and over until the dawn of the next day.

entry: POKENAME眼睛多，对光与太阳格外敏感。为避开光照，体型再大，也适应了地下生活。
author: Patch
source: Due to its many eyes, POKENAME is hypersensitive to light and the sun. To remedy this, it has adapted to living underground despite its massive size.

entry: 叉状刀刃一扫，就能成打刮下枝上叶片。叶子脱落后迅速枯死，因为POKENAME正在吸取其能量。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its fork-like blades let it scrape leaves clean off branches by the dozen. The leaves shrivel and die rapidly as they come detached since POKENAME is feeding off their energy.

entry: POKENAME的毒鳞只要碰到皮肤，毒就会迅速渗入大脑，使人失去知觉。幸好，它只在夜里活动。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: If any of POKENAME's poisonous scales touch your skin, the poison will quickly seep into your brain and make you unconscious. Thankfully, it is only active at night.

entry: POKENAME躯干大多覆盖着结构复杂的微小鳞片。蓄热足以冬季保暖，也能借鳞间孔隙调节体温。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME's main body segment has a complex arrangement of microscopic scales covering most of it. This segment contains enough heat to keep it warm in the winter and a way to regulate body heat through openings between the scales.

entry: POKENAME有“面包师噩梦”之称，爱在黎明偷溜进面包店，翻找新点心。若被当场发现，就往追兵眼里扬面粉。
author: merclipse
source: Known as “The Baker's Nightmare”. POKENAME are mischievous creatures that love sneaking into bakeries at dawn to rummage for new delicacies. If discovered in the act, they tend to throw handfuls of flour into the eyes of pursuers.

entry: POKENAME仿佛由融化的棉花糖组成，零碎物品一碰就黏住。身体还滚烫，若停得太久，自己就会烧起来。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its body seems to be made of melted marshmallows, with any loose items getting stuck to it. POKENAME is also extremely hot, and its own body will start to burn if stationary for too long.

entry: 绵绵泡芙与单首龙的融合体，只肯吃高糖食物，其余一律拒绝。食谱太极端，因此几乎无法在野外活下去。
author: dodoowner_
source: Swirino will only eat things containing high amounts of sugar and refuse anything else. Consequently, they can rarely survive in the wild due to this extreme diet.

entry: POKENAME像个塞满糖果、快要溢出的枕套。香气甜得令人发腻，可真吃里面的东西，就只剩恶心了。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME resembles a pillow case overflowing with candy. While its aroma is described as sickeningly sweet, attempts to consume the contents of POKENAME reveal them to be only sickening.

entry: 毛发闻着甜，尝着也甜，让爱甜食的POKENAME根本抵挡不住。POKENAME看似不停舔毛，其实只是在反复品尝自己的糖味。
author: sk372
source: Its fur is consistently sweet in both aroma and taste, and POKENAME's sweet tooth cannot resist the allure. What appears to be constant grooming is just POKENAME ceaselessly tasting its own sugary flavor.

entry: 这只宝可梦胃口大得惊人，什么都想吃。已有多起报告称，POKENAME袭击训练家，连精灵球在内的补给都吃得精光，让人无以维生。
author: Jackster
source: A gluttonous Pokémon with a massive appetite for everything. There have been numerous reports of attacks where POKENAME eat Trainers' supplies clean, including Poké Balls, leaving them with nothing to survive.

entry: POKENAME平时住森林，却会到附近城镇捕猎。藏起身体，只露尾巴，以蛋糕甜香引来小宝可梦，再猛扑过去。
author: AntiblitzYT (_antiblitzyt)
source: Though usually living in forests, POKENAME heads to nearby towns to hunt for food. Hiding all but its tail, it lures small Pokémon with the sweet, cake-like smell, then pounces on them.

entry: POKENAME身上自然长着美味甜点。被吃掉的部分，一夜就能补齐。许多面包店拿它当吉祥物，也借它提供免费试吃。
author: sk372
source: Delicious desserts naturally grow on top of POKENAME's body, replenishing any consumed portions overnight. Many bakeries use them as mascots and ways to offer free samples.

entry: POKENAME在冬季神秘现身。可香味引来各种虫属性宝可梦，让它们很难在野外久活。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME mysteriously appear during the winter season. However, they don't survive long in the wild because of all the Bug-type Pokémon attracted by its scent.

entry: 它属于古老的守护者种族。人们却总想砸开胸腔拿糖果，让它的身体日渐破败。
author: bostroms
source: A member of an ancient race of guardian entities, it has fallen into disrepair because people keep trying to break open its chest cavity to obtain the candy within.

entry: POKENAME外表诱人，令人想拆开一看。可里面的景象骇人又恶心，让许多人巴不得自己从未见过。
author: foolish_weasel
source: While it may be tempting to unwrap POKENAME's inviting exterior, doing so reveals a shocking and repulsive sight that many wish they hadn't seen.

entry: 人们普遍告诫别碰POKENAME。身体是各式黏甜点的混合体，诱惑人与宝可梦靠近；一碰上POKENAME，往往就被黏住，再也逃不掉。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is widely advised to not touch POKENAME. Its body is a hodgepodge amalgamation of sticky desserts designed to entice Pokémon and Trainers alike. Those who make contact with POKENAME often find themselves stuck and unable to escape.

entry: POKENAME常见于庆典。不过无论如何，都别拿走头上的团子，否则它会诅咒你。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME are commonly found during festivals. But if you see one, under any circumstances, do not remove the dango on its head as it will curse you.

entry: POKENAME爱吃甜食，每天得吃1公斤糖果，也因此散发浓浓甜香。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME has a sweet tooth, needing 1kg of sweets per day. Due to this diet, it has a very sweet scent.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜在溪池中漂浮休眠，看起来与周围睡莲叶几乎无异。背叶吃下有毒，可用来抵御天敌。
author: thheartemis1
source: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜在溪池中漂浮休眠，看起来与周围睡莲叶几乎无异。背叶吃下有毒，可用来抵御天敌。
author: theartemis1
source: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.

entry: POKENAME是远古人造宝可梦，受命保护人类。传说它们所做却恰恰相反，逼得最强术士将它们封进石像。
author: Eminemace
source: POKENAME are man-made Pokémon created a long time ago, ordered to protect humans. Legends state that they did the complete opposite, forcing the best sorcerers to trap them in a stone statue.

entry: POKENAME的壳每天能产200磅星星沙子。身体主体的颜色，决定沙子的颜色。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shell can produce 200 pounds of Stardust daily. The color of the main body determines the color of the dust.

entry: POKENAME用会发光的物质作画，色彩与光辉都十分美丽。这种颜料昂贵，只卖给知名艺术家。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME paint with a bioluminescent substance, which produces beautiful colors and light. This paint is very expensive and is only sold to famous artists.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始悬空，只有睡眠或受威胁时，才偶尔再钻进地下。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非被挖来的泥土盖住。
author: Krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark, unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: POKENAME双翼华丽，深受孩子喜爱，甚至有赛车游戏照着它们设计赛道。
author: pokebio
source: Due to its magnificent wings, POKENAME are loved by kids. So much so that a racing game has a track based on them.

entry: POKENAME密度越来越高，周围竟形成气态物质绕行的吸积盘。最好不要触碰。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has grown so dense that it has developed an accretion disk of orbiting gaseous matter.  It is advised not to touch it.

entry: 它以惊人速度驰骋星系，追逐彗星与流星吞食。若看见一道流星后又紧跟一道，可能就是POKENAME在追下一顿。
author: merclipse
source: It gallops across the galaxy at incredible speeds, chasing after comets and meteors of which it eats. If one happens to see a shooting star followed by a second, it may actually be a POKENAME chasing its next meal.

entry: 它睡得极沉，只有外壳破裂才会醒。若未被收服，POKENAME可能永远无法自然醒来，最终死去。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is a very deep sleeper, only awakened when its outer shell breaks. If left uncaptured, POKENAME may never awaken naturally, leading to its demise.

entry: 背上的喇叭能发出足以震碎巨石的声波。可POKENAME十分友善，常与其他宝可梦结队游行。
author: Mistymagius
source: The trumpets on its back are able to produce sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter boulders. Despite this, POKENAME are very friendly and can be seen parading around with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME难过时，会流出熔液般的泪，点燃骨棒作战。灼热的泪滴落在四周，留下深深的焦痕。
author: mbo1064.
source: When upset, POKENAME sheds molten tears to ignite its club for battle. These searing tears leave deep scars across the nearby landscape.

entry: 传说，精灵球尚未发明时，POKENAME会离开养育自己的人类，成群迁往如今已不知名的地方，只为寻找伴侣，再也不归。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to legend, before the invention of Poké Balls, POKENAME would leave the humans who raised it to migrate in flocks to parts now unknown, all in order to find a mate, never to return.

entry: POKENAME以控火能力飘到视线之外，准备恶作剧，强烈的火焰却会加热四周。若忽然热得难受，就得准备迎接捉弄了。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME prepares for its pranks by floating out of sight with pyrokinesis, but those mighty flames heat up its surroundings. Whenever one gets uncomfortably warm, they should be prepared for mischief.

entry: 小小的身体几乎容不下内心怒火。每叫一声，就喷出一道烈焰。
author: Ozydamians
source: Its small body can hardly contain the rage that burns within. It spouts jets of fire with every chirp.

entry: POKENAME将燃烧的尾巴弯到头顶，驱退天敌。它们领地意识极强，谁惹怒它，就想烧谁。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME arcs its flaming tail over its head to ward off predators. They are very territorial and will try to burn anyone that aggravates it.

entry: POKENAME烧出只有从空中才能看清的火线，标记领地。愚蠢地跨过神秘灰痕的人，可能遭到来自头顶的致命袭击。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME marks its territory by burning a fire line that can only be seen from the sky. A fool who steps across a mysterious trail of ash is likely to face death from above.

entry: 它化作蓝白火球，以超越声音的速度划过天际。等听见POKENAME尖锐的叫声，猎物早已被利爪贯穿。
author: Ozydamians
source: Faster than sound, it blazes across the sky as a blue-white ball of flame. By the time POKENAME's shrill cry is heard, its prey has already been skewered by deadly talons.

entry: 随着花苞开始绽放，POKENAME能把太阳能转化为火焰的燃料。它也能直接喷出这种有腐蚀性的燃料，攻击敌人。
author: Benevolent
source: With its bulb beginning to bloom, POKENAME can convert solar power into fuel for its flames. It can also spray this corrosive fuel to attack its foes.

entry: POKENAME泛着微弱紫光，尾焰随情绪起伏。它受强热源吸引，在阴暗处漂游。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME radiates a faint purple glow as its fiery tail pulses in sync with its emotions. It drifts through shadowy areas, drawn to intense heat sources.

entry: 尾焰消耗大量能量，迫使它不停找食物。发现可吃的东西，就会凶猛扑击，以灼热鳞片缠紧，再用毒牙咬下。
author: Baverbrugge
source: The flame on its tail consumes a lot of energy, so it is constantly searching for prey. When it spots something edible it strikes aggressively, constricting with burning scales and biting with venomous fangs.

entry: 它好斗暴躁，一心要当领地的顶级猎手。POKENAME受威胁时会昂身，颈膜如风箱鼓起，大声嘶鸣，牙间噼啪跳着刺鼻的火焰。
author: Baverbrugge
source: An aggressive and ornery Pokémon that wants to be the apex predator in its territory. When feeling threatened, POKENAME will rear up, its hood expanding like a bellows, and hiss loudly, acrid flames crackling between its fangs.

entry: POKENAME跑过地面，留下深深抓痕，沿途还会洒下火星。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME leaves deep scratches in the ground as it runs around. It scatters embers in its wake.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的猎手，新陈代谢太快，必须不断狩猎，凡比自己小的都吃。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a vicious predator, hunting constantly to compensate for its speedy metabolism. It eats anything smaller than itself.

entry: 游客喜欢到险峻山中，观看野生POKENAME修行。它们的踢击能迸出火焰，连岩石也能踢碎。
author: .realthree
source: Tourists enjoy traveling to craggy mountains to watch wild POKENAME train. Their kicks can cause even stone to break in a fiery burst.

entry: POKENAME用利爪抓牢泥泞的河岸。散入水中的热量，足以改变当地生态。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's claws help it keep its grip on muddy riverbanks. The heat it pours into the water is enough to alter the local ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME尾巴始终燃着火。奔过家园林木茂密的山地时，强风会让火势更旺。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's tail is always ablaze. When it runs through the forested mountains of its home, the strong winds strengthen its flames.

entry: 四肢利爪锐利无比，让POKENAME的武艺格外致命。动作越快，火焰越热。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's martial arts are deadly because of the wickedly sharp claws on its extremities. The faster it moves, the hotter its fires burn.

entry: POKENAME的水属性攻击中混有一种物质，能让火焰燃烧得更热。准备下一招时，胸前蓝色的冠状结构会发出嘶嘶声。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's water attacks are mixed with a substance that helps its flames burn hotter. The blue crest on its front sizzles as it prepares its next move.

entry: 初夏，POKENAME群中的新秀会追随月亮飞入夜空，交战直到最强者进化。自某年一大群被吸引到紫堇市后，当地便开始在这段时节限制光污染。
author: .fedoraman
source: In the early summer, the rising stars of a POKENAME swarm will follow the moon into the night sky and fight until the strongest evolve. After a swarm was drawn to Mauville City one year, they began limiting light pollution during this time of year.

entry: 野生POKENAME少有进化记录。但从小培养其好胜心，就能成为训练家队中顽强的一员，只是总不太肯给队友表现的机会。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are not known to commonly evolve in the wild, but by cultivating its natural competitiveness from a young age, it can become a tenacious member of a Trainer's team, though they struggle to give their teammates a chance to shine.

entry: POKENAME群看似混乱，实则等级森严。地位由战斗本领决定，最强者的尾焰泛着蓝白光。
author: .fedoraman
source: Despite the apparent chaos of a POKENAME swarm, it operates under a strict dominance hierarchy. A POKENAME's position is determined by its prowess in combat, with the strongest sporting tails that glow a bluish-white.

entry: 笼罩POKENAME的浓烟中，烈火熊熊。捕猎时，它将目标裹进烟里，等待对方窒息。
author: .realthree
source: Intense fires rage within the thick smoke that covers POKENAME's body. When it hunts, it engulfs its prey in that smoke and waits for it to suffocate.

entry: POKENAME从颈部产生熔融黏土，投向对手，尾焰则让黏土一直保持熔化状态。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces molten clay from its neck that it lobs at its opponents. It uses the flame on its tail to keep the clay in its molten state.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以壳为轴旋转，卷起利爪与火焰的旋风。POKENAME背壳的焦痕，正是历经战斗的骄傲印记。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spin themselves on their shell during battle, creating a whirlwind of claws and fire to attack. The burn marks around the back of a POKENAME's shell is a sign of pride after many battles.

entry: 它掘穿山体，沿途收集化石。丰富的珍藏，吸引各地考古学家前来。
author: .izik
source: It digs through mountains, collecting fossils along the way. Its impressive collection attracts archeologists from far and wide.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，性情却比初看温顺。只有闯入者无视警告，侵入它保护的地鼠巢区，才会变得凶暴。
author: sk372
source: Despite its towering size, POKENAME is more docile than a first glance would suggest. It only turns aggressive should trespassers ignore warnings and intrude upon the Diglett nesting areas it protects.

entry: 融合卡比兽的特质后，POKENAME身体厚实，见光也不易虚弱。白天吃过植物根，就会去洞穴等阴凉处睡觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: Thanks to being part Snorlax, POKENAME doesn't grow weak when exposed to light because of its thick body. During the daytime after eating plant roots, POKENAME searches for dark and cool places to sleep, such as caves.

entry: 融合卡比兽的特质后，POKENAME身体厚实，见光也不易虚弱。白天吃过植物根，就会去洞穴等阴凉处睡觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: Thanks to being part Snorlax, POKENAME doesn't grow weak when exposed to light because of its thick body. During the daytime after eating plant roots, POKENAME searches for dark and cool places to sleep, such as caves.

entry: 融合卡比兽的特质后，POKENAME身体厚实，见光也不易虚弱。白天吃过植物根，就会去洞穴等阴凉处睡觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: Thanks to being part Snorlax, POKENAME doesn't grow weak when exposed to light because of its thick body. During the daytime after eating plant roots, POKENAME searches for dark and cool places to sleep, such as caves.

entry: 附近一有危险，鼻子就会不受控制地抽动，提醒伙伴有隐患靠近。
author: .izik
source: Its nose twitches uncontrollably if it senses danger nearby. This warning signal alerts allies to hidden threats in the area.

entry: 它飞快甩头，将锋利的石角掷向敌人，扰乱来袭者，趁机逃脱。
author: .izik
source: It swings its head rapidly, flinging sharp stone horns at enemies. This tactic disorients attackers and provides an opening for escape.

entry: POKENAME在野外睡觉时，常被错当成一袋遭人丢弃的物品。它们的眉毛始终整洁如新。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for a discarded bag of items while they sleep out in the wild. Their eyebrows are always pristine.

entry: 它操纵沙暴，清走巢中的碎屑，因此十分擅长在干旱环境生存。
author: .izik
source: It can manipulate sandstorms, keeping its den clear of debris. This ability makes it an expert at surviving in arid environments.

entry: 丰缘的玻璃匠用它身上流下的沙子，吹制精巧的笛子。笛身晶莹通透，音色优美，十分珍贵。
author: .izik
source: The sand flowing from its body is used by glassblowers in Hoenn to create delicate flutes. These instruments are prized for their clarity and beautiful tone.

entry: 它偏爱挖硬地，觉得挖沙太无趣。这习性让它特别适合发掘古代遗迹与隐藏财宝。
author: .izik
source: It prefers digging through harder surfaces, finding sand too boring. This preference makes it well-suited for excavating ancient ruins and hidden treasures.

entry: 都市传说称，把耳朵贴向地面，就能听见POKENAME在隧道里唱歌。
author: Rakunk
source: Urban legend states that if you hold your ear towards the ground, you can hear POKENAME singing from inside its tunnels.

entry: 它钻出地面时，会收集岩石遮护敏感的身体，免遭日晒。水晶角战斗的力道太强，让人推测地下还藏着大得多的身体。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It gathers rocks as it emerges from the ground to protect its sensitive body from the sun. The strength it carries while fighting with its crystalline horns leads people to theorize it has a much larger body underground.

entry: POKENAME爱探索无人涉足的洞穴，每到一处，都取一块石头添进石质花朵。红色护目镜能挡住沙土，保护眼睛。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to go spelunking in unexplored caves and will collect a single rock from there to add to its rocky flowers. Its red-tinted visor protects its eyes from sand and dirt.

entry: 它全靠鲜红鼻子的嗅觉感知世界。敏锐的鼻子能追踪食物，发现危险。
author: .izik
source: It relies entirely on its sense of smell through its bright red nose to perceive the world. This keen olfactory sense helps it track food and detect danger.

entry: POKENAME深居地下，只有察觉到愿意实现的心愿才现身。若有人为私欲强行挖出POKENAME，就会化为水晶，深埋洞中。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwells deep within the ground, only emerging when it observes a wish it desires to grant. If someone attempts to dig up POKENAME for selfish reasons, they will be turned to crystal and entombed deep within a cavern.

entry: 双颚一开一合，便将周围沙子搅成猛烈漩涡，使谁也无法将它从沙里挖出。
author: Staghorn
source: By opening and closing its jaws, it churns the sand around it into a raging whirlpool. This makes it impossible to extract it from its surroundings.

entry: 飞行时，翼上镶嵌的扁平宝石发出亮丽的赤褐色光，既吸引猎物，也引来好奇的旁观者。
author: .izik
source: The flat gems embedded in its wings glow a bright auburn when it flies. This dazzling display attracts both prey and curious onlookers.

entry: 厚实的头骨轻易就能击碎巨石，让它毫不费力地掘过岩石地形。
author: .izik
source: Its thick skull is strong enough to break apart boulders with ease. This digging technique allows it to navigate through rocky terrain effortlessly.

entry: 科学家最近发现，POKENAME会用大眼睛看清暗道。据说，歌声能让它们在地下远距离交流。
author: Rakunk
source: Scientists have recently discovered POKENAME uses its large eyes to see inside dark tunnels. It is said they sing in order to communicate to one another from long distances underground.

entry: 据说，藏着的那部分身体长达30英尺以上，让它在捕猎与防御时都占优势。
author: .izik
source: The unseen portion of its body is said to extend over 30 feet in length. This hidden feature gives it an advantage in both hunting and defense.

entry: 在浅层泥土中追猎时，它会把角露在地面上，借此感知土中的振动，追踪目标。
author: .izik
source: When only slightly beneath the soil, it keeps its horn exposed while chasing prey. This horn's presence helps it track targets via their vibrations in the dirt.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋进地下，只露出岩石般的鳍。它们以鳍凿开石头，挤过窄缝进入洞中，想独自安静歇息。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ground with only their rocky fins exposed. They use these fins to carve through rocks, slipping into narrow cracks to get into caves to try and get some rest in private.

entry: 寒冷地区，见到POKENAME被视为好运，因为它擅长翻松冻土。农家的孩子会玩起搭小屋的游戏，吸引它来。
author: Wormspawn
source: Spotting a POKENAME is considered good luck in cold regions because it is especially equipped to till soil enveloped in permafrost. Farmers' children make a game of building small shelters to attract them.

entry: 隧道里满是带辛辣气味的红黏液，能促进植物生长。农人很喜欢它给庄稼施肥的功效。
author: .izik
source: Its tunnels are filled with a spicy-scented red goo that enhances plant growth. Farmers appreciate its fertilizing effect on crops.

entry: 地鼠控制了一具被丢弃的岩石躯体，便诞生POKENAME。它能飞快缩头、探头，闪避攻击。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME came into being after a Diglett took control of a discarded rock body. Its head will dip in and out at high speeds to dodge attacks.

entry: 双臂旋转着掘地，速度最高可达每小时40英里。若地面挖不进去，就只能慢慢摇摆着走。
author: Staghorn
source: It can dig rapidly by spinning its arms, reaching speeds of up to 40 miles per hour. If it can't dig into the terrain, it is forced to waddle slowly.

entry: 它会将帽子当武器，掷向远处敌人。帽子由喜爱的石头制成，既时髦又危险。
author: .izik
source: It can throw its hat as a weapon, using it to strike foes from a distance. This hat is crafted from its favorite stones, making it both stylish and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME全由沙子构成，成了一群地鼠的家。这究竟是共生，还是寄生，仍不清楚。
author: serversizeme
source: Due to being made completely of sand, POKENAME became the home to a colony of Diglett. It is unknown if this is a symbiotic or parasitic relationship.

entry: POKENAME住在幽深寒冷的洞中，吃挖来的宝石与矿物。虽常与勾魂眼交手，有时也会合力觅食，平分财宝。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Found in deep and cold caverns, POKENAME feast on gemstones and minerals they dig up. Though they have bouts with Sableye, they will sometimes work together to find food and split their treasures.

entry: POKENAME常在南瓜田附近挖洞，翻出肥沃土壤。农人若想摸它，就会被头上藤蔓抽打。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found near pumpkin patches, tunneling through the ground to create fertile soil. It will whip farmers with the vine on its head if they try to touch it.

entry: POKENAME常住峡谷，彼此发射泥弹，争夺地盘。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME are commonly found in canyons. There, they battle for turf by firing mud shots at each other.

entry: 这种被称作“双地鼠”的融合体，由两只地鼠共用一个身体。它们总像在接对方的话，可有时又仿佛等着第三只地鼠开口。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion, known by many as "Dugduo," consists of two Diglett sharing a body. They always emit sounds as if the two of them complement each other's speech, but sometimes it feels like they expect a third Diglett to be talking.

entry: 它在植物园下掘洞，吃植物的根。园丁得勤加防范，免得珍贵花卉被毁。
author: .izik
source: It makes tunnels beneath botanical gardens, feasting on the roots of plants. Gardeners must work diligently to prevent it from damaging prized flowers.

entry: 它常钻进农场，偷能缓解头痛的庄稼。那副可怜模样，让多数农人不忍赶走。
author: sk372
source: It often burrows up into farms to steal crops that might ease its aching head. Because of its pitiful expression as it does so, most farmers can't bring themselves to chase it off.

entry: 人们常以为看见了地鼠藏在地下的身体，其实那是POKENAME。它会掘地，将猎物拖入土中。
author: Ayutac
source: People often think that they saw the body of a Diglett, though it was, in fact, a POKENAME. This Pokémon can burrow, and it pulls its prey under the earth.

entry: POKENAME总把脚藏在地下，需要时随时钻走。有时拿的大葱太大，却会在挖洞时卡住。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME always keep their feet underground, ready to burrow when needed. Sometimes it gets stuck while digging if the leek it's holding is too big.

entry: POKENAME借异界之力，在岩间开出小窗，观察感兴趣的人，或打声招呼。奇怪的是，从另一面看，窗子却全无踪迹。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel an otherworldly power to make little windows between rocks that they use to observe or greet people they take an interest in. Strangely, these windows are completely invisible when viewed from the other side.

entry: 训练家睡不着时，POKENAME会朝其眼里撒些特制的沙，让对方昏昏入睡。
author: empty_set
source: When its Trainer cannot sleep, POKENAME will sprinkle some of its special sand into their eyes, which will cause them to doze off.

entry: POKENAME撞墙过猛时，身上的水晶就会剥落碎片。在山区，人们开始喜欢用这些脱落的碎片制作饰品。
author: sk372
source: Shards of the crystals on its body splinter away should POKENAME hit a wall too forcefully. These discarded pieces have begun to become popular material for accessories in mountainous regions.

entry: POKENAME全身的电气石能收存多余电力，如发电机般蓄能。进入战斗，它便震碎部分晶体，解除限制，全力出战。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tourmaline along POKENAME's body helps it contain any excess electricity, building up energy as a sort of generator. When it enters battle, it will shatter off fragments of crystal to remove its limiters and fight at full force.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，爱将宝石送给喜欢的对象。不过得保持距离，POKENAME抱得太有力，连岩石也能压成钻石。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very affectionate and loves to give its jewels to anyone it likes. Just keep your distance, as POKENAME's hugs are powerful enough to compress rocks into diamonds.

entry: POKENAME天性亲热，相信不断关心与送上耀眼礼物，最能让人觉得自己特别。它常花训练家的钱买礼物，还不明白主人为何生气。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME is very affectionate by nature, believing that constant attention and flashy gifts are the best way to make someone feel special. It often uses its Trainers' money to purchase these gifts, not understanding when they get upset.

entry: POKENAME表达喜爱极尽奢华，闪亮礼物与盛大举动接连不断。想隆重求婚的浪漫之人，也会从中得到灵感。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is lavish to the extreme when expressing affection, showering those it adores with shiny gifts and sweeping gestures. Its elaborate displays inspire romantics who wish to propose in a grandiose manner.

entry: POKENAME借宝石反光，将自己装成钻石，实际上宝石全是朱砂。矿工若靠得太近，POKENAME会故意打碎多余宝石，释放液态汞。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME reflect light off of their jewels in order to disguise themselves as diamonds. In reality, their gems are made of cinnabar. If a miner gets too close, POKENAME will purposefully shatter spare gems to release liquid mercury.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始离地悬浮，很少再钻回地下，除非睡觉或感到威胁。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非蒙上挖出的泥土。
author: Krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: 进化后，它们继续各司其职，磨炼技艺。工匠借新工作台改进工具，让挖掘者有更先进的铲子，猎手也得到更好的武器。
author: DoodleDoo
source: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.

entry: 进化后，它们继续各司其职，磨炼技艺。工匠借新工作台改进工具，让挖掘者有更先进的铲子，猎手也得到更好的武器。
author: DoodleDoo
source: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.

entry: POKENAME行动虽较慢，更大的身躯却能引起更危险的地震。吃植物根时，其中一个头总比另两个吃得多，因此也显得更大。
author: mbavenger64
source: While POKENAME may move slower than normal, its bigger body can cause more dangerous quakes. When eating plant roots, one of POKENAME's heads eats more than its other two heads, hence looking bigger.

entry: 它们栖息峡谷，吃枯灌木与细枝，在恶劣干旱的环境维持生存。
author: .izik
source: They live in canyons, surviving by eating dead bushes and twigs. This diet sustains them in the harsh, arid environment.

entry: 谁敢踏进领地，就会被三柄利刃固定。飘带末端宽长，能更快吸取大宝可梦的生命力，上面沾泥，也让猎物难以逃脱。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: If anyone dares to tread on its ground, it holds them in place with its three blades. The end of its sash is long and broad to more swiftly feed on the life force of larger Pokémon and is muddy to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME在地下将腿绑在一起，证明深厚的友谊。如今在土中连成一体，开心地共同前进。
author: slowforest
source: POKENAME bound their legs together in the ground as a testament to their deep friendship. Now united within the earth, they joyfully move as one.

entry: 三地鼠的成员若落单，便会因孤独而更加凶暴。猎人若以为只是地鼠，想轻易捕杀，可会遇上凶猛抵抗。
author: sk372
source: If a member of a Dugtrio is separated from its group, it becomes more aggressive in its solitude.  Hunters expecting a mere Diglett will find themselves faced with ferocious resistance if they try to pick it off.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的触手间，隐约藏着诡异神秘的头形。除此之外，触手还有个用处：顺走财宝。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME's furry tentacles partially conceal an eerie, mysterious head silhouette within. However, they also serve another purpose: nabbing treasure.

entry: POKENAME以大鼻子嗅出钱币特有的气味，在人家四周搜寻，挤进狭缝，捡走散落的零钱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sniffs out the unique scent of money with its large nose. It scrounges around most human homes, wriggling into tight spaces where loose change can be found.

entry: POKENAME善于变成贵重物件，一动不动待上数小时。轻信的买家常等到回家，才发现买来的巨大金珠竟是POKENAME。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME are known to shapeshift into valuable objects and stay motionless for hours. Gullible shoppers often find out the Big Nuggets they bought are POKENAME only after they bring them home.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，常受人追捧，却通常黏着更吓人的宝可梦，寻求保护。
author: Inksans201x
source: While it's often sought out for its cuteness, POKENAME typically sticks to more menacing Pokémon for protection.

entry: POKENAME身体虽圆，追起亮物与食物却飞快。白天打盹，为夜间寻宝蓄力。
author: mbavenger64
source: Despite its round body, POKENAME moves quickly when pursuing shiny objects or food. It naps during the day to prepare for nighttime treasure hunts.

entry: 与关都的同类不同，POKENAME只会寻找树果、宝可豆之类的食物。可谁若打扰它睡觉，就得面对这只高傲又狡黠的阿罗拉POKENAME的怒火。
author: mbavenger64
source: Unlike its Kanto counterpart, POKENAME will only hunt for food like berries and Poké Beans. Anyone who disturbs their sleep will deal with the rage of the prideful and crafty Alolan POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚，追起亮物与美食却很敏捷。POKENAME白天大多补眠，准备夜里寻宝觅食，也爱趴在亮晶晶的藏品上睡觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: Despite its rotund body, POKENAME moves swiftly when chasing shiny things and delicious food. POKENAME spends most of its daytime napping for late-night treasure or food hunting and also loves napping on top of its shiny objects.

entry: 猫的本能让POKENAME追自己的尾巴，鼠的本能却又让POKENAME逃离追来的自己。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's cat-like instincts compel it to chase its own tail. POKENAME's rat-like instincts compel it to run away from itself when it does this.

entry: 喜爱闪亮的硬币，能帮忙数钱，是银行出纳员的好伙伴——就是钱总会少一些。
author: pankiwi
source: Their love for shiny coins makes them the perfect companion for bank tellers by helping them count money, though there's always some money missing.

entry: POKENAME是高明的骗子，常在大城市用各种花招敛财。POKENAME还极善合作，经常暗中彼此配合行骗。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are known to be excellent scam artists. They are commonly found in the big cities, utilizing various tricks to gain a fortune. POKENAME are also astounding team players, often helping each other out with their practices in secrecy.

entry: 寻宝者常养POKENAME作宠物。它们对值钱的东西有第六感，一靠近昂贵物件，就会迸出一阵电火花。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME are often kept as a pet by people who hunt for treasure. They have developed a sixth sense for anything valuable and will emit a flurry of sparks if they are nearby anything that is worth a lot.

entry: POKENAME用硬币与尾巴的亮光，引来黑暗鸦等毫无防备的鸟宝可梦。对方一近，便猛扑捉住，拖回巢中充饥。
author: elite01
source: POKENAME uses the sharp glare of its coin and tail to lure unsuspecting bird Pokémon like Murkrow. Once they approach, it pounces and drags them back to its den as prey.

entry: POKENAME美丽的金玫瑰很受富人欢迎。可POKENAME自私极了，绝不许人碰自己的花。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME is popular among the wealthy due to its beautiful golden roses. However, POKENAME is a very selfish Pokémon and will never let anyone touch its roses.

entry: 有些物体反射超声波的声音十分悦耳，格外吸引POKENAME。每只POKENAME的听觉品味都不一样。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are drawn to objects that make a pleasant sound when ultrasonic waves are bounced off of them. Every POKENAME has its own unique taste in sounds.

entry: 据说，野外遇见POKENAME象征好运。可谁若得寸进尺，想碰硬币，立刻就会挨电。
author: Alumed
source: Finding a POKENAME in the wild is said to be a sign of good fortune, though it is quick to shock any that press their luck and try to touch its coin.

entry: POKENAME见到摄像机，就会跑到镜头前糟蹋披萨。什么都不肯认真对待，实在是个麻烦。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found destroying pizzas in front of any cameras it can find. It is unable to take anything seriously, making it a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME将贪财的人引入树林，偷走钱财。偶尔也在倒木或洪水冲来的残物里筑巢。
author: tenta
source: POKENAME like to lure greedy humans into the woods to steal their money. Occasionally, they nest inside of fallen trees and flood debris.

entry: POKENAME似乎能改变概率。愚蠢地用POKENAME赌博的训练家，终会因它的贪婪，连赢来的钱与好运都赔光。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME appears to have the ability to alter chance. Any Trainer foolish enough to use POKENAME to gamble will lose their fortune to its greed; both in winnings and luck.

entry: POKENAME贪财无厌。训练家若不花自己的钱满足它，它便会大闹城市，将珍贵宝石与钞票全收进宝库。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME has an insatiable greed for wealth. If not maintained with a Trainer's own money, it will wreak havoc in cities to absorb precious gems and cash into its hoard.

entry: POKENAME有这般体格，却十分爱玩。训练需要极大耐心，最后才能得到忠实的伙伴。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is very playful. A Trainer needs a lot of patience to train it, but will be rewarded with a loyal companion in the end.

entry: POKENAME通常悄悄接近猎物，用可伸缩的爪子捕猎。若长时间动用硕大的螯，就会累得筋疲力竭。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME usually sneaks up on prey with retractable claws, as using its oversized pincer leads to exhaustion during prolonged hunts.

entry: POKENAME好斗傲慢，却也有几分荣誉准则。它偏爱持武器的对手，哪怕只是为了潇洒缴械，再得意炫耀一番。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are arrogant fighters, but have something of a code of honor. They prefer to fight a weapon-wielding opponent, if only so they may dramatically disarm them in battle and gloat.

entry: 囊袋里装着巨大的蛋形宝石。POKENAME以宝石的大小与红艳程度，排定地位。
author: Staghorn
source: It carries a large egg-shaped gem in its pouch. POKENAME establish a heirarchy based on the size and redness of their gems.

entry: POKENAME狩猎技艺极高，以变身近乎完美地隐藏，等飞行宝可梦落地歇脚，再突然扑出。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME are incredibly proficient hunters, using their transformation abilities to hide almost perfectly, then pouncing on flying Pokémon when they land to rest.

entry: POKENAME看见亮物便兴奋，想也不想就拿走。有时连自己的金爪，也会看得入迷。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets extremely excited over shiny objects and will take anything shiny without a second thought. It will sometimes even get mesmerized by its own golden claws.

entry: POKENAME极其骄傲，只听老练训练家的话。可一旦认可，也愿为对方冒生命危险。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME is an extremely proud Pokémon that only obeys experienced Trainers. However, it would even risk its life for one.

entry: 能治好POKENAME头痛的，只有长在背上种子里的药草，可它自己偏偏够不到。因此，它常跟在训练家身后，盼着有人帮它缓解疼痛。
author: Rakunk
source: The only cure for POKENAME's headaches is the herbs growing on its bulb, which it is unable to reach on its own. As a result, it often follows Trainers with the hope they will help ease its pain.

entry: 它大半天待在枝间，嚼树叶充饥。若头痛突然加剧，发出的超能力脉冲可能让满树叶子同时落光。
author: sk372
source: It spends most of the day among the tree branches, snacking on the tree leaves. Should it get a surging headache, the psychic pulse may cause all the leaves on the tree to fall off at once.

entry: POKENAME产下的蛋，吃了特别能缓解头痛。偏偏自己常年偏头痛，于是POKENAME总在吃自己的蛋。
author: sk372
source: The eggs POKENAME makes are particularly effective in alleviating headaches when consumed.  Because of its constant migraines, POKENAME is constantly eating its own eggs.

entry: POKENAME常见于公园池塘，接受游客喂食。若POKENAME等着吃，你却不喂，它的力量可能让你事后头痛欲裂。
author: Staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly found in parks and ponds, where they are fed by visitors. If you don't feed a POKENAME when it expects to be fed, you may develop a splitting headache afterward due to its abilities.

entry: 吸收阳光时，它散出超能力波，让附近的人轻微头痛。POKENAME却浑然不觉，依旧开心。
author: sk372
source: As it absorbs sunlight, it emits psychic waves around it that cause mild headaches in those nearby. POKENAME remains blissfully unaware of its effect on people.

entry: 古时，萨满会用POKENAME的角举行治病仪式。磨粉兑成饮料，便是最早的头痛药之一。
author: sk372
source: In ancient times, POKENAME antlers were used by shamans for medicinal rituals. Ground into powder and mixed into a drink, it created one of the first headache curatives.

entry: POKENAME几乎时刻受偏头痛折磨。一尖叫，背上孔洞就冒出大泡泡。
author: dragonessanimations
source: POKENAME is in near constant pain with migraines. As it screams, large bubbles emerge from holes on its back.

entry: POKENAME常预见村落受灾，便赶去救助。可预知引发的头痛，反激起超能力，往往造成原本想阻止的破坏。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME often have visions of disasters striking a village and rush in to try and help. However, the headaches that come from their visions set off their psychic powers, often causing the destruction they sought to prevent.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME宇宙之力暴涨，超出心智承受的极限，无意间造出了宇宙。若再来一次，世界会如何，至今众说纷纭。
author: sk372
source: Some say that the universe was created inadvertently when a POKENAME's cosmic powers surged too strongly for its mind to contain. Many debate on what would happen to the world should another similar surge occur.

entry: 据说POKENAME能以超能力抬起整个海洋。可频繁的头痛总在它充分发挥前，就打乱了专注。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME could lift the entire ocean using its psychic power. However, it experiences frequent headaches that disrupt its focus before it can properly display its power.

entry: 鲁莽使用超能力，会让POKENAME伪装的头部裂开，漏出填充物。它便匆匆丢下手中一切，退走修补。
author: sk372
source: Using its psychic powers recklessly will cause the material of POKENAME's disguise to rupture at the head and lose stuffing. It will hastily drop whatever it was doing and retreat in order to repair the damage.

entry: POKENAME长得不平衡，常侧倒在地。等压力积到足够大，就能用念力把自己扶正。
author: aPixelPerfectionist
source: Due to its lopsided appearance, POKENAME frequently falls on its side. It is able to right itself using psychokinesis once it becomes stressed enough.

entry: 头痛让POKENAME无暇顾及别事，常一动不动待在土中，被其他宝可梦当作一丛草。叶子若被吃下，食用者就会中毒生病。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are so distracted by painful headaches that they tend to stay completely still in the dirt, to the point that other Pokémon may think they are a tuft of grass. If their leaves are devoured, the consumer will grow sick from poison.

entry: POKENAME平时好斗，领地意识强，遇到旅人就袭击。可头一痛，立刻忘掉怒火，抱头逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME normally has an aggressive and territorial temperament, lashing out at travelers it comes across. However, should a headache strike, it immediately forgets its rage, running away while clutching its head.

entry: POKENAME超能力强劲，甚至能放出高度凝聚的动能冲击敌人。但这又会引发剧烈偏头痛，反过来进一步增强力量。
author: cipherlingarde
source: POKENAME can wield significant psychic powers, even to the extent of unleashing powerful blasts of concentrated kinetic energy at foes. However, this can lead to it suffering from terrible migraines, which only serve to amplify its powers even more.

entry: POKENAME手中的棍杖，蓄着它残留的超能力。挨上一记的人，头痛可能持续长达48小时。
author: sk372
source: The stick it carries is charged up with some of POKENAME's residual psychic energies. Those hit by it will suffer painful headaches for up to 48 hours afterward.

entry: 两个头各自思考、各自行动，似乎根本没察觉自己共用一个身体。
author: kittyluv090
source: The two heads think and behave independently from each other. It seems they aren't even aware that they share a body.

entry: POKENAME身体轻软蓬松，能乘海风漂游。轻盈的羽毛间有两团绒球，顶端的则是一颗透明球体，有时能充当第三只眼。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME rides ocean breezes due to its light, fluffy body. While two of the puffballs on its airy plumage, the top one is a clear orb that sometimes functions as a third eye.

entry: POKENAME身体轻软蓬松，能乘海风漂游。轻盈的羽毛间有两团绒球，顶端的则是一颗透明球体，有时能充当第三只眼。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME rides ocean breezes due to its light, fluffy body. While two of the puffballs on its airy plumage, the top one is a clear orb that sometimes functions as a third eye.

entry: 它准头惊人，水炮能击中数百英尺外的飞行属性宝可梦。壳虽能护身，却沉得让POKENAME落水就会下沉。
author: leonian1586
source: It has incredible aim, able to hit Flying-type Pokémon from hundreds of feet away with its aqua cannon. Its shell is protective, but it's heavy enough that it causes POKENAME to sink in water.

entry: POKENAME终生住在厚重的装甲壳内，靠伸缩炮口喷水，将自己推进到各处。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME spends its entire life inside its thick armored shell. It shoots jets of water from its retractable cannons to blast itself from place to place.

entry: 鲜红的羽毛与宝石，是POKENAME的地位象征。羽毛越大越鲜艳的POKENAME，被认为越敏捷；宝石越亮的，则越被视为聪明，也越受同类尊敬。
author: entomoxie
source: The bright red feathers and gems on a POKENAME are seen as status symbols. POKENAME with larger, more vivid feathers are typically seen as more agile. POKENAME with brighter gems are seen as clever and worthy of respect from peers.

entry: 独特的羽毛让POKENAME飞游皆精。长颈与硬喙还能探进通常够不着的地方，寻找食物。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can fly and swim excellently due to its unique feathers. Its long neck and tough beak let it poke its head into otherwise hard-to-reach areas for food.

entry: POKENAME能在干地行走，却偏爱广阔湖泊及其周边。羽毛能抵御严寒，但零度以下时，为节省能量，它会减少活动。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can walk on dry land, but it prefers to stay in or near vast lakes. Its plumage keeps it warm even in the coldest environments, though it is less active in subzero areas due to a need to conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME羽毛格外厚，适于寒冷气候。坚硬的喙与獠牙能破开冰层，取得平时够不着的食物。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME thrives in colder climates due to its remarkably thick plumage. Its beak and tusks are tough enough to break through ice sheets and get otherwise hard-to-reach food.

entry: POKENAME住在世界各地的寒冷山地，做什么都与同类一起。尾巴储的食物，够自己和伙伴吃上数周。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is typically found in cold mountains all around the world, always doing everything with other POKENAME. Its tail can store enough food to keep it and its peers going for weeks.

entry: POKENAME羽毛轻盈却出奇坚韧，能长途飞行，也能冒雨飞过，游泳同样在行。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can fly great distances due to its lightweight but oddly tough plumage. Its tough feathers also allow it to fly in the rain and swim expertly.

entry: POKENAME用尾部的漆状物标记领地，纹样随栖息水域而大有不同。有些爱淡水，有些爱咸水，没有两只POKENAME会产出完全一样的漆。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME marks its territory with paint-like substances from its tail, with markings varying vastly depending on the water where it lives. Some prefer freshwater while others prefer saltwater. No two POKENAME produce the exact same paint.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半扁平，能借洋流前进，顺流时也十分灵活。它熟知住处洋流的规律。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can ride ocean currents with its mostly flat body, though it can also maneuver expertly when riding them. It is deeply familiar with the patterns of ocean currents where it lives.

entry: POKENAME头大，在陆上难以平衡。但浮力与超能力让它善泳，任何水温下，也都能保持暖意。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME struggles to balance on land due to its large head. However, its buoyancy and psychic powers make it an adept swimmer. It also keeps it warm in waters of any temperature.

entry: POKENAME能潜入水中。双眼清楚看见水上水下，双翼也演化成了极佳的鳍。
author: entomoxie & lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME are capable of submerging their bodies underwater. Their eyes allow them to see above and under the surface rather clearly, and their wings are adapted to serve perfectly as fins.

entry: POKENAME在各地海岸静候猎物，以喙迅速突袭。水陆行动都受限，因此只捕较小、较弱的目标。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME lie in wait on shores across the world. When they spot prey, they use their beaks to strike swiftly and catch them off guard. They target only smaller, weaker prey due to their limited mobility on land or in water.

entry: POKENAME通常住在广阔海洋，厚羽能够保暖。它们得靠大片水域保持湿润，在干地上便难以活动。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically stay in vast oceans and have thick plumage to keep them warm. They struggle to move on dry land, as they require large bodies of water to stay hydrated.

entry: POKENAME很善泳。POKENAME开心时，尾巴的泡泡慢慢冒出，发怒时却会猛烈喷涌。
author: Krune
source: A POKENAME is an adept swimmer. The bubbles on its tail calmly emerge when POKENAME is happy and burst out when it is enraged.

entry: 爪与头上的宝石突起，让POKENAME在最黑的洞里也能看清。喙能张得异常宽，每口都吃得很多。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can see even in the darkest of caves due to the gem-like protrusions on their claws and heads. Their beaks can open unusually wide, letting them eat large bites of food at a time.

entry: POKENAME用超能力造出厚实泡泡，既保护POKENAME，也能调节体温，甚至让POKENAME预知即将到来的天气。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME form a thick bubble with their own psychic powers. These bubbles keep POKENAME safe and let them control their body temperatures. They also allow POKENAME to predict upcoming weather events.

entry: POKENAME冻结脸周围的薄层水，形成冰面具。其中最清透鲜亮的一块，就是双眼之间的红色冰球。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME freezes a thin layer of water around its face to form a protective ice layer. The clearest and most vibrant piece of ice on this mask is the red orb between its eyes.

entry: POKENAME身体中空，轻得神秘，常在寒地漂游。它能将闯入者冻牢，隔着冰仔细观察，再决定如何处置。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME drifts around colder areas with its mysteriously light and hollow body. It can freeze any intruders solid and decide what to do with them after carefully examining them in a chunk of ice.

entry: POKENAME游得比大多数宝可梦快，连快艇也能一较高下。喙极锋利，轻松啄开岩石与冰。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can swim faster than most other Pokémon, rivaling even speedboats. Their beaks are sharp enough to pick through rocks and ice with ease.

entry: 羽形与流畅体态，让POKENAME跻身宝可梦中最快的游泳者。大嘴一张，就能吞下小型宝可梦。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are among the fastest swimmers of any Pokémon due to the shape of their feathers and smooth body plans. Their mouths can engulf smaller Pokémon in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: Wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: Wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: 羽毛轻、双翼大，让POKENAME飞游皆擅。即使黑暗中，大耳朵与超能力也能精准描出周围。
author: entomoxie
source: Due to their light feathers and vast wings, POKENAME are excellent at flight and swimming. Even in the dark, they use their large ears and psychic powers to map out their surroundings ideally.

entry: POKENAME喜欢飞过广阔清澈的大海。云翼能让它连续数周不落地，发怒时甚至从翼中降下暴雨或雷电。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME enjoy flying on top of vast, clear oceans. Their cloud-like wings keep them in the air for weeks at a time. When angered, they can even send intense rain or lightning from their wings.

entry: POKENAME平常静候，鲜红尖刺如眼睛般观察四周，几乎不可能悄悄接近POKENAME。硬要尝试，还可能挨上尖刺的烈毒。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME usually lie in wait, with their bright red thorns acting as eyes and seeing their surroundings. As such, sneaking up on a POKENAME is nearly impossible. Their thorns can deliver a powerful toxin to those who try.

entry: POKENAME喜欢气候温和的宽阔海滩。据说，体内神秘宝石能与新亡的灵魂交流。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME prefer vast beaches in moderate climates. The mysterious gems in their bodies are said to let them commune with the spirits of those who recently passed.

entry: 健康POKENAME的水晶清透、色泽明亮，暗中还会发出迷人的光。
author: entomoxie
source: The crystals on a healthy POKENAME are clear and bright in color. In the dark, they can emanate a mesmerizing glow.

entry: POKENAME借体表宝石突起感知环境，即使最暗最浑浊的水，也能精准游行。靠近的其他宝可梦想什么，它也读得懂。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can swim with perfect precision even in the darkest and murkiest of waters. They can do this by using the gem-like protrusions on their bodies to sense their environments. They can read the minds of other Pokémon approaching them.

entry: POKENAME头大，额间有神秘宝石。虽然超能力庞大，却很少控制得住，一试就常惹来剧烈头痛。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME has a large head for its body and a mysterious gem in its forehead. While it has vast psychic energy, it is rarely able to control it, often ending up with intense headaches whenever it tries.

entry: POKENAME头大，额间有神秘宝石。虽然超能力庞大，却很少控制得住，一试就常惹来剧烈头痛。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have large heads for their bodies and mysterious gems in their foreheads. While they have vast psychic energy, they are rarely able to control it, often ending up with intense headaches whenever they try.

entry: POKENAME头大，额间有神秘宝石。虽然超能力庞大，却很少控制得住，一试就常惹来剧烈头痛。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have large heads for their bodies and mysterious gems in their foreheads. While they have vast psychic energy, they are rarely able to control it, often ending up with intense headaches whenever they try.

entry: POKENAME游得出奇好，腹部的螺旋纹样会扰乱尾随者，保障高速游泳时的安全。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can swim around surprisingly well. The spiral patterns on their bellies disorient any Pokémon trying to swim after them, keeping them safe when swimming at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME也能走干地，却更爱在清澈河湖游泳。常沉思得出神，任身体漂在水上，也浑然不觉。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can move on dry land, though they much prefer swimming in clear lakes or rivers. They frequently get lost in their own thoughts, drifting on the water's surface without even realizing it.
