entry: POKENAME能在陆地或水中行动，却很少走得快、游得快。超能力让它与尾巴上的可达贝配合得天衣无缝，想打它一个措手不及，可不容易。
author: entomxoie
source: POKENAME can move on dry land or in the water, though they are rarely able to walk or swim quickly. Their psychic powers allow them to be in perfect harmony with the Psyder on the tail, so catching them off-guard is quite difficult.

entry: POKENAME对树枝各有偏好。POKENAME找到心爱的枝条，就始终带着，谁想拿走或折断，都会遭到猛烈反击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have varying preferences in branches. A POKENAME will find a branch that it likes, keeping the stick at all times and aggressively fighting those who try to take or break it.

entry: POKENAME哪里都能生存，连冰川与冰封海洋也不例外。羽毛却奇特得像一身厚毛。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can thrive anywhere, even glaciers and ice-covered oceans. Their feathers strangely resemble a thick coat of fur.

entry: POKENAME能游冷水，也能游暖水。鳍其实是覆着轻盈羽毛的薄片，羽毛虽轻，却很能留住体热。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can swim in warm or cold waters alike. Their fins are actually thin flaps covered in uniquely light feathers, though their feathers are effective at insulating body heat.

entry: POKENAME很少离壳，只伸喙进食。陆上难行，水中却是高手。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME rarely leave their shells, only poking their beaks out to eat. They struggle to move on dry land, but they are excellent swimmers.

entry: POKENAME常在沙滩享受清爽海潮与微风。双螯通常与喙同样坚韧。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are often found on sandy beaches, enjoying the refreshing ocean tides and breezes. Their pincers are typically just as tough as their bills.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸与海湾慢慢摇摆着走，借钳尖的宝石传导奇异力量，施展招式。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME waddles slowly along the banks of rivers and bays. It channels unusual powers and moves through the jewel-tipped pincers it has.

entry: 一看见谁有闪亮物件，POKENAME便妒火中烧，飞扑猛攻，非抢到不可。可一发现新的亮物，先前偷来的就忘光了。
author: sk372
source: Seeing someone possessing a sparkly item sends POKENAME into a jealous rage. It will fly at and attack the item's owner furiously until it can steal the item from them. It forgets its stolen trinket the minute it spies a new one.

entry: 它苦练控制怒气，战斗时却仍常突然暴起。有人说，狂怒中使用的招式类型，暗示着日后的进化方向。
author: sk372
source: It trains hard to control its anger, but still has regular bursts of violence in battle. Some say the types of attacks it uses while in this rage hint at what form it will take when it evolves.

entry: 它性情懒散，可谁碰了食物，就会凶暴起来。偏又贪心得很，看见的食物，全当自己的。
author: sk372
source: It has a lazy disposition, but turns violent should anyone touch its food. Because it is also incredibly greedy, it considers any food it sees as belonging to it.

entry: POKENAME被宠坏了，稍不如意就大发脾气，很少主动向训练家示好。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very spoiled Pokémon and will throw temper tantrums any time it doesn't get its way. It very rarely shows outward affection towards its Trainer.

entry: 它身躯巨大，只有满月时才会现身。据说剪断尾巴能将其赶走，可鲜有人敢试。
author: captainmodeus
source: This massive Pokémon is only seen on the full moon. It is said that cutting off its tail can cause it to flee, but few have dared to try.

entry: 越愤怒，尾焰越热越亮。POKENAME一不高兴，连信赖的训练家也难免被烧伤。
author: sautomagically
source: The angrier it is, the hotter and brighter its tail burns. Even trusted Trainers are not safe from a burn if POKENAME becomes upset.

entry: POKENAME小巧有活力，满身绒毛。它凭敏捷动作与灵敏感官突袭对手，有时还会藏进高草，施以毒击。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME is a small, energetic Pokémon covered in fuzzy fur. It uses its swift movements and keen senses to strike and surprise opponents, sometimes launching toxic strikes while hiding in tall grass.

entry: 它脾气火爆，爱找强敌打架。盛怒时，尾焰会燃成明亮的蓝色。
author: sautomagically
source: This hotheaded Pokémon loves to get into fights, especially when its opponent is tough. The flame on its tail burns bright blue during a state of outrage.

entry: 持续头痛让POKENAME性情恶劣，痛得朝周围一切发泄。头越疼，抓打得越凶。
author: sk372
source: Due to constant headaches, POKENAME is very ill-tempered, lashing out at anything nearby in a pained tantrum. The more intense the headache, the more viciously it swipes at everything around it.

entry: 力量虽不及普通火暴猴，脾气也没那么易变。它们常守护年轻猴怪群，也会管住其中更暴躁的成员。
author: sk372
source: While not as strong as normal Primeape, they are not as volatile in temper either. They often guard troops of young Mankey, as well as keeping the more aggressive ones in line.

entry: 愤怒时，它会大声跺脚、奋力振翅。成群POKENAME若爆发内斗，可能不慎烧毁整片森林。
author: sautomagically
source: During fits of fury, it loudly stomps its feet and flaps its wings. When in-fighting erupts in packs of POKENAME, they can accidentally burn down entire forests.

entry: 它一见键盘就格外兴奋，愤怒地猛砸，直到弄坏。奇怪的是，POKENAME有时竟能敲出通顺句子，只是拼写总错得离谱。
author: epping_forest
source: It gets especially excited when it sees a keyboard and angrily smashes it until it breaks. Strangely, POKENAME sometimes ends up writing coherent sentences, though they always have horrid spelling mistakes.

entry: 它们像不良少年，凭钢铁身躯与近战本领，无缘无故找麻烦。POKENAME腕上的链越长，群中地位就越高。
author: SonTyp
source: These delinquent Pokémon use their steel bodies and close-combat techniques to cause trouble with no provocation at all. The longer the chain on a POKENAME‘s wrist, the higher it stands in its group‘s hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME危险的上勾拳能将敌人打上天空。它动起手来，从不犹豫。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is known for its dangerous uppercut, which sends foes flying into the air. It never hesitates to attack.

entry: POKENAME平时比火暴猴少些攻击性，却极其爱护随身的蛋。哪怕裂出一道细纹，也会暴怒，毁尽周围。
author: sk372
source: Though less outwardly aggressive than Primeape, POKENAME is incredibly protective of the eggs it carries. Even a single crack, and it will lay waste to all its surroundings in a rage.

entry: 它怒气难控，又爱恶作剧，所到之处常一片混乱。遇到敌人，就用尾巴抓牢，再挥拳打到服。
author: amiel997
source: It's known for its uncontrollable rage and mischievous nature, often causing chaos wherever it goes. When it finds an opponent, it uses its tails to grab them and pummels them into submission with its fists.

entry: POKENAME发现谁心情低落，就会狠狠揍一顿，盼着能让对方开心。虽然打得凶，这办法居然出奇有效。
author: Mistymagius
source: If POKENAME finds someone who is feeling down, it will violently beat them in hopes they feel better. Despite the vicious attacks, this method is surprisingly effective.

entry: POKENAME怒火升温，加热体内空气，让自己飘飞。太平静便会掉下来，可这又惹怒了POKENAME，因此从不落地太久。
author: Staghorn
source: A POKENAME's red-hot temper heats up the air inside it, which provides enough lift for it to fly. It loses its ability to float if it becomes too calm; since this enrages the POKENAME, it never remains grounded for long.

entry: 别因个头低估它，它足以与成年男子正面交锋。鼻孔若冒出黑烟，就准备迎战吧。
author: sautomagically
source: Do not underestimate this Pokémon because of its size; it can go toe-to-toe with a grown man. When it puffs black smoke out of its nose, be prepared for a fight.

entry: POKENAME是太古时代创造的魔像，如今似乎已经失控，在大地上横冲直撞，攻击视线内的一切。科学家和历史学家仍在争论，它最初被创造出来究竟是为了什么。
author: sk372
source: An ancient golem created in time immemorial, POKENAME appears to have gone berserk, targeting anything in sight as it rampages across the land. Scientists and historians debate what its original purpose could have been.

entry: 战斗受伤越重，尾焰就越灼热。恶战时，相隔三十多英尺，也能感到火焰的热浪。
author: sautomagically
source: The more damage it takes in a fight, the hotter the flame on its tail becomes. During particularly tough battles, the heat from its fire can be felt from over thirty feet away.

entry: 它战斗的凶残，连最老练的训练家也害怕。POKENAME夜里飞寻强敌，明亮的尾焰在旁人眼中，就像一颗流星。
author: sautomagically
source: Its brutality in battle scares even the most seasoned Trainers. When POKENAME flies around at night, searching for powerful opponents, the bright flame on its tail looks like a shooting star to onlookers.

entry: 为了POKENAME健康，毛孔长出的绒簇必须定期清除。臭烘烘的毛团，有时会被拿去喂家养的破破袋与臭泥。
author: sk372
source: The tufts of fur growing from its pores need to be regularly removed for POKENAME's health. The repugnant-smelling hair clumps are sometimes used as a treat for domestic Trubbish and Grimer.

entry: POKENAME能把火焰吸入体内，吸收一部分。成群POKENAME协力，甚至不到一小时就能压下猛烈山火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can draw fire into its body and absorb it to some extent. Working together, a team of POKENAME could suppress a raging forest fire in less than an hour.

entry: POKENAME好奇又爱温暖，四处嗅寻热源。消防员借它闻出附近小火，在火势扩大前及时扑灭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are inquisitive creatures, seeking warmth and sniffing around for sources of heat. Firefighters use them to smell nearby small fires and snuff them out before they grow larger.

entry: POKENAME好奇得什么都要用嘴探一探，出了名地难养。训练家既要留意，也要耐心，否则无尽好奇可能惹出意外的乱子。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously difficult to raise due to its curious nature and instinct to investigate everything using its mouth. Trainers must be vigilant and patient, as its relentless curiosity can cause unintended chaos if not properly managed.

entry: 玩捡枝条时，POKENAME会兴冲冲地抛网，枝条还未落地就捉回。有时收回来后，反而将枝条扔出，等训练家也去捡。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME playing fetch will use its webbing to eagerly catch the stick from afar, often before it even hits the ground. Sometimes after reeling it back, it will throw the stick instead, expecting its trainer to fetch, too.

entry: 古人将POKENAME描绘成忠诚的伙伴。如今，谁迷失在它栖息的遗迹，它便会悄悄指引。
author: ServerSizeMe
source: POKENAME is a depiction of a loyal companion to ancient people. It will subtly guide those who end up lost in the ruins it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME在树林嗅寻适合吃草、坚果与树果的好地方。尾巴上的头虽没有嗅觉，也会跟着做出嗅闻的动作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sniffs around wooded areas looking for the best spots to graze for grass, nuts and berries. Though it has no sense of smell, the head on the tail will make sniffing motions as well.

entry: 执法机构开始训练POKENAME，加入特殊队伍与行动。嗅觉加上天生的协作能力，让它们成为高效伙伴，尤其适合搜寻队。
author: sk372
source: Law enforcement agencies have begun training POKENAME for special units and operations. Their sense of smell and natural-born teamwork skills make them efficient partners, particularly for search parties.

entry: POKENAME是猎人出色的追踪伙伴。嗅觉与细长身体让它能循味追入藏身处，只有最狭窄的缝隙才拦得住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes for an excellent tracking companion for hunters. With its sense of smell and its thin body, it can sniff out and give chase to a target into all but the tightest of hiding spots.

entry: 它们用迅疾动作威吓、迷惑敌人，等对方头晕，就喷火收尾。
author: mystora
source: These Pokémon use swift movements to intimidate and confuse the opponent. When the opponent is dazed, they spit fire as a finisher.

entry: POKENAME一被激怒，就得赶快逃。它会原地打转，向四面八方喷火。
author: mystora
source: If POKENAME gets enraged, run away as fast as possible. It will start spinning in circles whilst shooting fire in all directions.

entry: POKENAME深挖泥土，藏起珍视的物件。玩耍时，一只蜷成球，其余POKENAME便围着追逐。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dig deep into the dirt to store objects it finds valuable. For recreation, one out of a group of POKENAME will curl into a ball, while the other POKENAME chase it around.

entry: POKENAME通常很乖，突然闹事，多半是想告诉训练家什么。例如，院里突然挖出许多洞，就预示地震将至。
author: sk372
source: Normally well-behaved, a POKENAME acting out is a sign of it trying to tell its trainer something. For instance, digging many holes in the yard suddenly is a sign an earthquake is approaching.

entry: POKENAME深爱训练家，总尽量陪在身旁。它悄悄放慢时间，只想让相伴的时刻更长一些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores its Trainer and spends as much time as possible by their side. It subtly slows the flow of time, just to extend how long they can be together.

entry: 嗅觉极强，无论洞中离得多远，都能准确追踪任何生物。而新来者的气味，总最先得到注意。
author: sk372
source: Its sense of smell is so strong that it can accurately track any living thing within its cavernous home, no matter how far away. The scent of a new arrival always takes priority.

entry: POKENAME以欢迎的舞蹈与快乐吠声，迎接归家的训练家。舞动时散出热量，让从寒风中进来的人格外惬意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will greet a trainer returning home with a welcoming dance and cheerful barks. It radiates heat during the movements, so those coming in from the cold find it very refreshing.

entry: POKENAME忠诚护主，温暖又蓬松，是受欢迎的伙伴与吉祥物。它们常控制不好力道，好在软绒身体通常能免去重伤。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are fiercely loyal and protective, their warmth and fluffiness making them popular companions and mascots. They often have some trouble controlling their own strength, but their plushiness usually keeps anyone from getting too hurt.

entry: 最好趁早教POKENAME别拿旁人的东西。未经教导的POKENAME既爱闪亮钱币，又爱训练家，常偷钱币回来送礼。
author: sk372
source: It is recommended to teach a POKENAME early about respecting ownership; its affection for shiny coins and its trainer often leads untrained POKENAME to steal coins to present to its trainer as gifts.

entry: POKENAME懒散极了，整天窝在家，缠主人煮最爱的意大利面。早上尤其没精神，宁愿存着体力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are an incredibly lazy species, lazing around homes and pestering owners to cook its favorite type of pasta. It is most lethargic in the mornings, preferring to conserve its energy.

entry: POKENAME扯下藤蔓，将碎段烧成灰，再埋进土里。混合后的腐殖物是有效肥料，能帮助新植物生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will pull down vines and burn the severed pieces to ash before burying it in the dirt. The mulched mixture is an effective fertilizer for helping new plant life grow.

entry: POKENAME从双翼喷出烈焰推进，时速最高180英里，用强劲的角贯穿敌人。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME propels itself by shooting intense flames from its wings. It can fly up to 180 mph, impaling its opponents with its powerful horn.

entry: 某些文化对POKENAME崇拜极深，科学家因此长期拿不准它是否真实存在。据说，仁君诞生前，它便会到来，为土地带来和平。
author: Rakunk
source: For a long time, scientists were unsure if POKENAME actually existed due to its prominent worship in some cultures. They are said to arrive before the birth of a benevolent ruler to bring peace to the lands.

entry: 听POKENAME吟唱，可能得到好运，也可能遭逢厄运，全看它的心情。它迅速滑过战场，身后留着小片火焰。
author: Spartan_CT
source: Depending on its mood, listening to a POKENAME's chanting can bestow both good and bad luck. It glides swiftly around the battlefield, leaving small patches of fire in its wake.

entry: 成群POKENAME不止一次被错认成火山喷发。它们如火山碎屑流般冲过干地，以利爪、烈火与尘土裹住不幸的猎物。
author: Frink202
source: A pack of POKENAME has on more than one occasion been confused for a volcanic eruption. They surge across dry environments like pyroclastic flows, enveloping any unfortunate prey they find in a flurry of claws, flames and dust.

entry: 古代传说里，有位战士速度眩目、怒火炽烈。有学者认为，那是现代融合出现前，POKENAME最早的记载。
author: Phantom640
source: Ancient tales told of a legendary warrior who would fight with blinding speed and blazing fury. Some scholars believe these tales to be early records of POKENAME, long before modern-day fusion.

entry: POKENAME对训练家的忠诚无人能及。哪怕只让对方的生活好上一点，也可能倒转时间，重写历史。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's loyalty and devotion to its Trainer is peerless. It might even go back in time to rewrite history if it would even slightly improve its Trainer's life.

entry: 旧磨牙玩具曾被投入火堆，却莫名幸存。它喜欢玩抛接，被人扔来扔去。
author: greystorm101
source: This old chew toy was burned, but somehow survived the pyre. It enjoys being thrown about in games of fetch.

entry: POKENAME守在家门，尽职挡住一切入侵者，因此深受屋主喜爱。
author: AdmiralVermin
source: POKENAME will settle on the front doors of houses, and dutifully protect them from any would-be intruders. As such, they're beloved by homeowners.

entry: 一名年轻训练家曾在醒来后，变成这只宝可梦。它看着适合拥抱，激烈的情绪却能驱动火焰，击败敌人。
author: hypernovahusky
source: A young Trainer once woke up transformed into this Pokémon. While it may look cuddly, its wild emotions allow it to utilise fire to defeat its foes.

entry: 战斗时，体内火焰回应POKENAME的决心，让体温急升，出拳更猛更快。但若不控制，也可能过热。
author: Glacierwing
source: During combat, POKENAME's body temperature rises rapidly, the flame inside its body reacting to the Pokémon's determination. This raises the intensity and speed of its punches, but this can lead to overheating if not managed.

entry: POKENAME藏在火山岩间，等猎物游过，就喷火烤熟。可被老练厨师料理后，POKENAME自己也是受欢迎的佳肴，据说肉质鲜嫩多汁。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst volcanic rock, waiting for its prey to swim by before cooking them with a blast of fire. When prepared by an experienced chef POKENAME is considered a popular delicacy with their meat being described as juicy and tender.

entry: POKENAME秋末迁往热带。待附近其他地区的野花将要盛开，又会离开热带。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME begins migrating at the end of autumn to live in more tropical locations. It leaves the tropics just before wildflowers begin to bloom in other nearby regions.

entry: POKENAME会载旅人渡海，但得先在战斗中胜过它，证明自己的资格。烈焰与锐冰，会为它载着的人护航。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will ferry travelers across the oceans, but only after it has been bested in battle to prove the passengers' worth. It guards those it ferries with fierce flames and piercing shards of ice.

entry: 喷火龙与火暴兽的实力相当，但POKENAME散出的酷热，鲜有宝可梦能比拟。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: While Charizard and Typhlosion are of equal power, the immense heat emanating from a POKENAME's body can rarely be matched by other Pokémon.

entry: 它高飞在寒冷稀薄的空气中。养鸟人传说，POKENAME若在地上待得太久，羽毛就会起火。
author: Ozydamians
source: It flies high above the ground where the air is cold and thin. A birdkeeper legend says if POKENAME spends too much time on the ground, its feathers burst into flame.

entry: 目力比最强的望远镜还精准。从数英里高空，它会撒下炽热的火点，如雨般降落。
author: Ozydamians
source: Its eyes are more powerful and precise than even the strongest telescope. From miles above, it rains down superheated motes of fire.

entry: 它产生足够的热量与空气，让训练家即使身处太空边缘，也能安然无恙。从遥远下方看，POKENAME很像传说的宝可梦。
author: Ozydamians
source: It generates enough heat and air to safely insulate its Trainer even at the edge of space. From far below, you might mistake POKENAME for a legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME整日飞行，寻找强敌解闷。发现合适对手，便停下点燃全身羽毛，如小太阳耀于天际，再厉声尖啸着俯冲。
author: Baverbrugge
source: POKENAME spends its days in flight, searching for challengers to alleviate its boredom. If it spots a fitting rival, it pauses and ignites its plumage, blazing in the sky like a miniature sun, before plummeting down with a terrifying screech.

entry: POKENAME双翼泛着超能力光辉，飞过就留下光迹。火焰起伏难测，力量一涌，便迸出火星。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's wings shimmer with psychic energy, leaving a glowing trail as it flies. Its flame flares unpredictably, sparking when its power surges.

entry: 一被POKENAME缠住，就不可能逃出硫磺烈焰。
author: GasmaskBlacky
source: Once a POKENAME wraps its body around a foe, escaping its sulfuric flames becomes an impossible task.

entry: 吐息灼热得连钻石也能熔化。曾有一场森林大火，被认为是POKENAME引发。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.

entry: 吐息灼热得连钻石也能熔化。曾有一场森林大火，被认为是POKENAME引发。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.

entry: 吐息灼热得连钻石也能熔化。曾有一场森林大火，被认为是POKENAME引发。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fiery breath is hot enough to melt even diamond. There was once a massive forest fire thought to be caused by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的焰爪切油轮船壳，如切黄油般容易。目标若太远，就常朝对方投掷熔融的碎屑。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flaming claws are hot enough to slice through a tanker hull like butter. If its target is too far away however, it has a tendency to throw molten debris at its target.

entry: 它极其护主，训练家一有危险，就能以念力投出火球。POKENAME还会与队友比试，确认其他宝可梦是否有资格保护主人。
author: sk372
source: It is fiercely protective of its Trainer, able to fling psychically-controlled fireballs should they be threatened. POKENAME has been known to compete with its Trainer's team to see if other Pokémon are worthy of guarding them.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，飞不起来，便以腹部火焰条纹的快速变色，炫耀力量。
author: soreile.arc
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to fly. Instead, it shows off its strength by rapidly changing the color of the flaming stripe on its stomach.

entry: POKENAME不断交战证明强大，每胜一次，火鬃就更盛。若嫌对手太弱，便傲慢地躺下睡觉，借此嘲弄、宣示优势。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME are constantly battling one another to prove their strength, their fiery manes growing larger with each victory. If it judges an opponent as too weak, it will lie down and sleep as a mockery, displaying its dominance through sheer arrogance.

entry: 它们每年都会进行求偶飞行，只有最强者才能进化为POKENAME。胜出者结为伴侣，在沙漠产蛋，繁衍新一代。
author: .fedoraman
source: Every year, this species has a nuptial flight from which only the strongest evolve into POKENAME. The champions will form mating pairs who lay eggs in the desert sand to start a new generation.

entry: 翅膀只是摆设。受到威胁时，POKENAME可能振翅，却根本飞不起来。
author: welliss
source: This Pokémon's wings are only for show. When threatened, POKENAME may flap its wings, but will be unable to actually fly.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: 它喷出的诅咒火焰能烧穿珍珠、钻石，甚至钨。虽然火焰温度极高，遭到灼伤的宝可梦却不会直接昏厥，而是会痛苦地挣扎数小时。
author: bobosmith01
source: It spits cursed flames that burn through pearls, diamonds, and even tungsten. Despite the flame's high recorded temperatures, Pokémon afflicted by burns writhe in agony for several hours instead of merely fainting.

entry: 莱希拉姆的力量，唤醒了喷火龙潜藏的强大本领。POKENAME身体释放的热量，足以熔化雷吉艾斯，直至蒸发。
author: CrazyNaturekitty
source: The power of Reshiram has awoken a latent strength in Charizard. The amount of heat POKENAME's body can exert is enough to melt a Regice until it evaporates.

entry: 绰号“岩浆王”，能让地面沸腾。有人将它误认成丰缘的传说宝可梦。
author: PokePower
source: Nicknamed the "Magma King," it can make the ground boil. Some have mistaken it for a legendary Pokémon from the Hoenn region.

entry: 据说POKENAME精通相反的冰火之力，能同时冻伤、烧伤敌人，带来极端痛苦。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME is said to have a mastery in the contrasting elements of fire and ice. It can use its powers to freeze and burn opponents simultaneously, inflicting extreme pain upon them.

entry: POKENAME被愤怒灵魂附身，四处寻找强敌。它常使人陷入催眠般的恍惚，很难挑战。火焰则让人想到它的前世。
author: DaHappycute
source: Possessed by an enraged spirit, POKENAME wanders in search of strong opponents. It often induces hypnotic trances, making challenging it difficult. Its flame is reminiscent of its former life.

entry: POKENAME好战，总在找对手。单只的力量就大得出奇，哪怕几只相斗，也能将大片地方烧成火海。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME love to fight, and are in always in search of an opponent. A single Pokémon is deceptively strong, and even a small amount of them can set a large area completely ablaze as they battle each other.

entry: 它不愿咬弱者。若认可对手，POKENAME便饮其血，试着夺取挑战者的力量。
author: sk372
source: It refuses to sink its fangs into a weak opponent. If it deems an opponent worthy, POKENAME drinks its blood to try and siphon the power of the challenger.

entry: 每只POKENAME都护着一堆宝石。谁稍一靠近，就会被可怕的梦折磨，而梦中总莫名与火有关。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each POKENAME protects a hoard of gems. Those who even come near its hoard are plagued with horrific dreams that somehow involve fire.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，身后冰火交织，形成美丽光迹。夜里看见时，常被错认成彗星。
author: Shocktopus1717
source: As POKENAME soars through the sky, beautiful trails of fire and ice shimmer behind it. When seen at night, it is often mistaken for a comet.

entry: 它的外貌近似超级POKENAMEY。速度极快，掠过夜空时，宛如一颗流星。
author: Soup1900
source: Its appearance resembles that of Mega POKENAME Y. Its speed makes it look like a shooting star during the night.

entry: 即使休息，胸口的热量也足以把钢铁熔进自身。不过，这从来不是有意为之，往往发生在POKENAME睡梦之中。
author: omegacyclops
source: The heat in its chest, even during rest, reaches temperatures hot enough to melt steel directly into itself. This is never done on purpose, however; it usually happens while POKENAME sleeps.

entry: POKENAME尾端的毛发分叉，护着其中的火焰。常参与艰苦战斗，让壳上留着许多抓痕。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME will have split hairs on the end of its tail to house the flame it has there. It will often have many scratches on its shell due to partaking in many tough battles.

entry: 据说，一只POKENAME几天就能吃掉大量淡水植物。惊人的食欲，对池塘湖泊是巨大威胁。
author: lemage22
source: A single POKENAME is said to devour massive amounts of freshwater vegetation in days. Its voracious appetite poses a significant threat to ponds and lakes.

entry: 脆弱的脑外覆着透明薄膜，作为缓冲。可它爱用头撞敌人，仍总在头痛。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its delicate brain is covered in a transparent film that acts as padding. Due to its tendency to headbutt its opponents, it is constantly suffering from headaches.

entry: 它害羞，大多纹丝不动，倾听天敌的动静。有幸靠近POKENAME的训练家，能看见皮下的毒囊。
author: sautomagically
source: This shy Pokémon spends most of its time standing perfectly still, listening for predators. A Trainer lucky enough to get close to a POKENAME can see the poison sacs underneath its skin.

entry: POKENAME爱挑事，可稍落下风就逃。常能见到它在河中涉行，用吸盘般的嘴，刮吃石上的藻。
author: sautomagically
source: While POKENAME loves to start fights, it tends to flee the moment it begins losing. Trainers can often find it wading in rivers and eating algae off of rocks using its suction-like mouth.

entry: POKENAME藏在河岸浅水处的植物间伪装自己。头顶粉红色的球茎，能释放有毒的孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME disguises itself among plant life among shallow parts of the riverbank. The pink bulb on its head can emit poisonous spores.

entry: 巨耳能察觉5英里之外的水中震动。皮肤黏液滑又有毒，战斗中可别贸然抓住POKENAME。
author: sautomagically
source: Its massive ears can detect vibrations in water from over 5 miles away. The slime on its skin is both slippery and poisonous, making it a bad idea to grab POKENAME in a fight.

entry: POKENAME偏爱深水，躲避天敌。可若被逼入绝境，就会毫不留情反击。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME prefers to spend its time deep underwater to avoid its natural enemies. However, when cornered, it will attack without mercy.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅水下，只让眼状花纹露出，威吓捕食者。受惊扰时，便向来敌喷水，趁隙逃走。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides just below the water surface, keeping its eye patterns above the water to deter predators. If disturbed, it will shoot a small jet of water at its attacker, letting it escape.

entry: POKENAME用额外的两个头吓退天敌。研究者还不确定，那是真头，还是逼真的傀儡。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME uses its two extra heads to scare off predators. Researchers are unsure whether these heads are real, or just convincing puppets.

entry: POKENAME用额外的三个头吓退天敌。研究者还不确定，那是真头，还是逼真的傀儡。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME uses its three extra heads to scare off predators. Researchers are unsure whether these heads are real, or just convincing puppets.

entry: 闯进遗迹的盗贼，会被POKENAME要求参加游戏。没能及时逃出的，就会被催眠，乖乖交还所有财宝。
author: squawkabairdy
source: POKENAME challenge any robbers who enter the ruins in which it resides to a game. Those that can't escape in time are hypnotized into giving all the treasure back.

entry: POKENAME肌肉强劲，能攀陡峭岩坡，掘开硬地。可维生食量太大，寒季的一部分时间，只能靠冬眠度过。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful muscles allow it to climb steep rocky slopes and dig through tough terrain. Due to the raw amount of food needed for them to sustain themselves, they hibernate through parts of the cold season.

entry: POKENAME肌肉强劲，能攀陡峭岩坡，掘开硬地。可维生食量太大，寒季的一部分时间，只能靠冬眠度过。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful muscles allow it to climb steep rocky slopes and dig through tough terrain. Due to the raw amount of food needed for them to sustain themselves, they hibernate through parts of the cold season.

entry: 它渴望战斗，无人能比。闻到附近宝可梦的气味，就疯狂挥动飘带上的拳头，连自己的安危也不顾。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Its craving for battle is unmatched. When it catches the scent of a nearby Pokémon, it wildly flails the fists on its sash about without any regard towards even its own safety.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，闯入领地就会遭攻击。它也曾用强尾，砸碎不知情水手的船。
author: sautomagically
source: Highly aggressive, POKENAME will attack anyone who enters its territory. It has been known to use its powerful tail to smash the boats of unaware sailors.

entry: POKENAME爱坐在瀑布下磨炼耐力。无论战斗还是游泳，肌肉都从不疲倦。
author: elite01
source: POKENAME prefer to train their endurance by sitting beneath a waterfall. Their muscles never grow tired from fighting or swimming.

entry: 热带常能见到POKENAME。可惜它常被当成掉落的香蕉，让其他宝可梦吃掉。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is a common sight in tropical climates. Unfortunately, it is often mistaken for a fallen banana and eaten by other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME有这般体格，却很胆小，一遇威胁就逃，再瞬移到安全处。可瞬移后仍跑个不停，常突然凭空出现，一头撞上东西。
author: sk372
source: It is timid despite its size, running away from threats before teleporting to safety. Because it continues running after teleporting, POKENAME has a tendency to appear out of thin air and smash into things head-first.

entry: 变身时，还会用超能力尽量模仿目标的心智。有时，技巧高超的POKENAME反而会忘掉真我，直到变身结束。
author: sk372
source: As it transforms, it uses its psychic powers to also copy its target's mind as closely as possible. This has sometimes led particularly skilled POKENAME to forget their true self until the transformation wears out.

entry: POKENAME能看见数秒后的未来，预判敌人动作。加上闪电般的速度，POKENAME几乎什么招式都能躲开。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can see a few seconds into the future, allowing it to predict its opponent's moves. Alongside its lightning-quick speed, POKENAME is able to dodge almost any attack.

entry: POKENAME坚信，身心都得磨炼，才算真正强大。它每天苦练，只为成为最强。
author: Daemonkill22
source: POKENAME firmly believes that to be truly strong, it must train both body and mind. It trains every day to become the strongest of all.

entry: 附近一有人，就会瞬移逃走，因此野外极难见到。仅有的可靠目击记录，都是它整理或打磨光滑石头的时候。
author: bobosmith01
source: This is an extremely rare Pokémon to find in the wild due to its tendency to teleport away whenever someone else is in the area. The only confirmed sightings have been during times when it is sorting out or polishing smooth stones.

entry: POKENAME让自造的毒液悬空，练习超能力。可常常练着练着睡着，忘了自己练到哪一步。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME practice their psychic powers by levitating the poison they create. Unfortunately, they often fall asleep during their training, causing them to lose track of where they were at in their progress.

entry: 它在人家装汤匙的抽屉里安睡，主人却毫不知情。抽屉一开，就急忙瞬移到远方另一只抽屉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It sleeps soundly in unsuspecting people's spoon drawers. If the drawer it rests in is opened, it hurriedly teleports to another drawer far away.

entry: 尾端紫焰显示着超能力的潜力，使用念力时便会高涨。盯着火看太久，可能轻微头痛。
author: sk372
source: The purple flame on its tail is an indicator of its psychic potential, flaring up when it uses its telekinetic abilities. Staring at the flame too long has been known to cause mild headaches.

entry: POKENAME重攻轻守，以武艺与超能力压倒敌人，为求更强，从不停止修行。
author: Daemonkill22
source: Favoring attack over defense, POKENAME uses both its fighting and psychic abilities to overwhelm its opponent. Its training never ceases as it strives to become even stronger.

entry: POKENAME重守轻攻，在战斗中谋划，追求强大。它以超能力读懂敌人，每招都以完美的反击应对。
author: Daemonkill22
source: Favoring defense over attack, POKENAME aims to grow strong by strategizing during battle. It uses its psychic ability to read its opponents, reacting to their moves with the perfect counter.

entry: 变身本领已能完整复制目标的心智，连所有记忆也不遗漏。训练家常请POKENAME帮忙回想过去。
author: sk372
source: Its shapeshifting abilities have evolved to the point where it can copy a target's mind perfectly, including all their memories. Trainers often have POKENAME help them to remember past events.

entry: POKENAME不倦地锻炼身心。精神修行让它能用超能力掰弯汤匙，身体却依旧脆弱。
author: Daemonkill22
source: POKENAME trains tirelessly to grow its physical and mental strength. Its mental training allows it to bend spoons with psychic power, but it remains physically frail.

entry: POKENAME取得攻守的完美平衡，成为战斗高手。它能应付任何局面，也会抓住自己创造的每个机会，发动猛烈攻击。
author: Daemonkill22
source: Striking the perfect balance between offense and defense, POKENAME becomes a master of battle. It has an answer to every situation and uses every opening it creates for devastating attacks.

entry: POKENAME以庞大超能力与压倒性力量，自认已登顶峰。出手毫不留情，连踢与超能力齐发，转眼击败敌人。
author: Daemonkill22
source: With massive psychic ability and overwhelming power, POKENAME believes it has become the strongest of all. It fights without mercy, defeating its opponents in moments with a flurry of kicks and a psychic barrage.

entry: POKENAME精通战术，敌人未动便已预见。强大的超能力与体力，让每次来袭都变成自己的机会。
author: Daemonkill22
source: A master combat strategist, POKENAME reads its opponents' moves before they are made. It uses its immense psychic and physical power to turn every attack against it into an opportunity for itself.

entry: 它能以意念让自身与物件悬浮，却不常使用，反而深居海洋。偶尔出水，研究周围世界，随后再度消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to levitate itself and other things with its mind. Despite that, it tends to not use this ability and lives deep in the ocean. It occasionally rises from the water to study the world around it before vanishing once more.

entry: 心智变得庞大强劲，连变身结束，也记得每个曾化成的生命的一生。历史学家相信，POKENAME是为后世留存文化历史的关键。
author: sk372
source: Its mind has grown so vast and powerful, it remembers the lives of every being it has become, even when not transformed. Historians believe POKENAME is key to preserving cultural history for the future.

entry: POKENAME的大脑，其实藏在始终伴在身边的球体里。球若破碎，POKENAME便会沉睡，永不再醒。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's brain is actually stored in the orb it keeps close by. If this orb shatters, POKENAME will fall into a deep sleep, never to wake up again.

entry: 它以强大的超能力举起自己，四处活动。可负担实在太重，总会恶心得难受。
author: jaminmcready
source: To move around, this Pokémon will lift itself using its powerful psychic abilities. This puts a lot of strain on it though, giving it extreme nausea.

entry: 据说POKENAME背上的冰淇淋，是世上最好吃的甜点。可惜，尝过的人无一例外，都得了剧烈偏头痛。
author: Patch
source: The ice cream on POKENAME's back is said to be the best-tasting dessert in the world. Unfortunately, every person who has tasted it ends up with an intense migraine.

entry: POKENAME附身某些电器后，便能流畅交流，传达详尽而准确的信息。有科学家担心，如此运用POKENAME的智慧，是否合乎伦理。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME possesses certain electronics, it displays the ability to communicate fluently and convey detailed and accurate information. Some scientists are worried about the ethics of using POKENAME's intelligence in such a manner.

entry: 它能在尾巴的汤匙中凝成雪球。察觉攻击将至，就投向敌人，试着扰乱对方。
author: .izik
source: It can form snowballs in the spoons on its tail. If it senses an oncoming attack, it will fling them at enemies in an attempt to disorient them.

entry: 它力气很大，头脑却简单，大宝可梦也想都不想就撞过去，哪怕对方转眼就能放倒自己。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: It is very strong but largely unintelligent. It will ram into large Pokémon without thinking twice, even those that could topple it in a heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME常成群玩耍，一起练武，互相较量力气。
author: Krune
source: Often playing in packs, POKENAME can be seen practising martial arts and competing in tests of strength with each other.

entry: 进化后，奔跑快得多，拳力却没有进一步增强。尾巴较弱，只用来作诱饵。
author: Krune
source: Having evolved, it has a much higher running speed, but it has not further developed its punching strength. The tail just acts as a decoy and is relatively weak.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不停活动，自如切换多种武术。它最爱以踢腿为主的流派，尤其喜欢跆拳道。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME remains constantly in motion during battle, switching fluidly between multiple different styles of martial arts. Its preferred fighting styles are usually those focused on kicks, Taekwondo is a particular favorite.

entry: POKENAME以迅捷身手弥补个头小的劣势。快速活动还能积攒电力，用于最后一击。
author: ziggaway
source: Quick and agile, POKENAME makes up for its small stature with agility. Its quick movements also charge up electricity for a finishing attack.

entry: 它将强烈的情绪化作动力，更加刻苦地锻炼身体。与拉鲁拉丝不同，POKENAME反而受别人的敌意吸引。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It channels its strong feelings to motivate it to train harder physically. Unlike Ralts, POKENAME is drawn to hostile emotions it senses in others.

entry: 它竭尽全力学习各种舞蹈。POKENAME喜欢与其他宝可梦以舞较量。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It strives to learn all forms of dance to the best of its ability. POKENAME loves competing with other Pokémon in dance battles.

entry: 本体虽然弱，假嘴的肌肉却强得惊人。它用假嘴擒住敌人，压到对方屈服，再远远扔出领地。
author: sk372
source: Though the main body is rather weak, the muscles in the false mouth are incredibly powerful. It uses them to grapple and crush foes into submission, before flinging them far away from its territory.

entry: 它是个爱练拳的小斗士，总打着池水，自豪地绷起小鳍。POKENAME随时愿意切磋，常挑战大得多的宝可梦。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: A little fighter that loves to practice its punches by hitting the water in ponds, flexing its tiny flippers with pride. POKENAME is always ready for a spar, often trying to fight Pokémon much bigger than itself.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME被一位拳师的灵魂附身。它常在街头，找凶暴的不法之徒打架。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be possessed by the spirit of a fist fighter. It picks fights with violent outlaws on the streets.

entry: POKENAME不断磨炼技艺，尤其擅练适合体形的相扑。开战前，会拍响胸前石块鼓劲，再全力上阵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME train constantly to hone its skills, particularly the ways of sumo as befitting its shape. It smacks the stone on its chest to hype itself up before giving it all its got in the fight.

entry: POKENAME已有豪力的体格，却还未有同等力量，被视为腕力形态的顶峰。完全进化前，它们会训练年轻腕力，助其更进一步。
author: sk372
source: Having evolved the build but not the full strength of Machoke, POKENAME are considered the apex of the Machop form. Until they evolve fully, they spend their time training young Machop to new heights.

entry: 几乎一醒着，它就锻炼岩石般的双臂，练习将石头打成粉。双手猛推地面，还能将自己弹上高空，攀登山岳。
author: sk372
source: It trains its rock-hard arms almost every waking hour, punching stones into powder as practice. By pushing hard against the ground, it can launch itself to great heights and scale mountains.

entry: POKENAME举巨石练肌肉，可同类太像石头，常常举错。被举的POKENAME倒不在意，很乐意帮伙伴长力气。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME train their muscles by lifting up boulders. However, they often end up lifting others of their kind due to their close resemblance to rocks. POKENAME rarely minds though, since they're happy to help others build muscle.

entry: POKENAME看着肚大，腹内却满是肌肉。
author: Skymaster426
source: POKENAME, despite its size, is full of muscles within its large gut.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的粗皮需要护理，才能维持POKENAME的耐力与速度。可什么办法最好，训练家始终争论不休。
author: bobosmith01
source: The rough, rock-like skin of a POKENAME requires a certain level of care in order to preserve POKENAME's endurance and speed. Which method is best, however, is hotly contested among Pokémon Trainers.

entry: POKENAME整天锻炼上身。可下身太小，偶尔会失衡翻倒。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME spends all day exercising its upper body. Its small lower body sometimes causes it to tilt over.

entry: POKENAME时速最高60公里，拳力胜过最好的拳击手。人类已懂得别惹它。尾巴却不强，只是诱饵。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME can run at a top speed of 60 km/h, and its punches are stronger than those of the best boxers. Humans have learned to not anger this mighty Pokémon. The tail does not hold much strength and is simply a decoy.

entry: POKENAME爱挺着健美肌肉昂首走路，也爱在湖边砸巨石，试试力气。它骄傲自负，常在旁人面前绷紧肌肉炫耀。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME loves strutting around with a proud stance and toned muscles, it loves to test its strength by cracking boulders near lakes. It is a Pokémon with a lot of pride and ego, often seen flexing and showing off in front of others.

entry: 腰带能调节超声鸣叫。若摘掉，声量足以让方圆100英尺内的生物失聪。
author: sk372
source: The belt it wears helps regulate its ability to make ultrasonic cries. If it were removed, the decibel level of its cries would be enough to deafen any creatures within a 100 foot radius.

entry: 它严格执行训练计划，压制暴力的冲动。可战斗时仍偶尔怒气爆发，事后便失望地闷闷不乐。
author: sk372
source: It maintains a strong training regiment as a way to curb and control its more violent tendencies. Sometimes this temper still flares up in battle, leaving it disappointed and sullen afterward.

entry: POKENAME追求智慧与力量的完美平衡，同样用心磨炼身心。体能训练与冥想的时长，连一毫秒也不差。
author: sk372
source: Seeking the perfect balance of brains and brawn, POKENAME commits itself to honing both body and mind.  It perfectly schedules an equal amount of physical training and meditation, down to the millisecond.

entry: POKENAME明智聪慧，专心求强，会走遍世界，学习各种武术。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a wise, intelligent, and dedicated Pokémon that is striving for greater power. It will travel across the world to learn various martial arts.

entry: POKENAME强壮勤奋，崎岖地形也能穿过，深受矿工与登山者喜爱。它始终努力改善体魄、力量与灵活程度。
author: bobosmith01
source: Sturdy, hard-working, and able to move through a variety of rugged terrain, POKENAME is popular with miners and hikers alike. It is constantly striving to improve its health, strength, and agility.

entry: 与反向融合体相比，POKENAME更有耐心，也更善于思考，因此是格斗家们的良师。
author: bobosmith01
source: Compared to its reversed counterpart, POKENAME is more patient and reflective. As a result, it makes an excellent teacher for martial artists.

entry: POKENAME又强又难缠，是宝可梦驱害人员最怕接的活。仅一只闯进家中，就常得出动整个团队才能处理。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME problem is considered the worst job for Pokémon pest control specialists to be called for, due to their strength and tenacity. Often an entire team is needed just to take care of a single POKENAME infesting a home.

entry: POKENAME自认是有爪宝可梦中的最强者，极力捍卫头衔。不修行时，就把爪擦得光洁闪亮，好随时炫耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers itself the strongest of the clawed Pokémon, a title it defends fiercely.  When not honing itself, it cleans its claws to make sure they always have a pristine shine for it to flaunt.

entry: 四条手臂让POKENAME更易平衡巨大的上身与小小的下身。腰带大小标明地位，较大的那条属于首领。
author: Krune
source: With four arms, POKENAME can more easily balance its massive upper body against its tiny lower body. The size of its belt symbolises its place in the hierachy, with the bigger one belonging to the leader.

entry: POKENAME产的蛋蛋白质极高，是增肌训练者喜爱的伙伴。用蛋制成的蛋白奶昔，也很畅销。
author: sk372
source: The eggs POKENAME makes are especially high in protein, so it has become a popular companion for those undergoing muscle training. Protein shakes containing the eggs are also a popular market item.

entry: 拳力强得能造出小黑洞。训练家受威胁时，POKENAME最危险，会倾尽精神与身体力量保护对方，常造成毁灭性的破坏。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its punches are strong enough to form small black holes. POKENAME is at its most dangerous when there is a threat to its trainer, as it will unleash all of its mental and physical strength to protect them, often to devastating effect.

entry: 坚实强悍的身体，让POKENAME几乎任何环境都敢战斗。护幼时尤其疯狂，不惜一切，让敌人再也无法威胁孩子。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has a rugged and powerful body that gives POKENAME the courage to fight in almost any condition. It will fight wildly to protects its young, doing whatever it takes to make sure their foe never threatens them again.

entry: 它以惊人的力量与威势掌控战场，金属般的强鳍打出粉碎重击，举止间尽是王者的自信。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: This formidable warrior dominates the battlefield with its impressive strength and commanding presence. With powerful metal-like fins, it delivers crushing blows while exuding an aura of regal confidence.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找新挑战，锻炼较小的头。各部位力量与外观不平衡，似乎让它十分苦恼。
author: SonTyp
source: POKENAME is constantly looking for new challenges to strengthen its smaller heads with. Imbalances in its different body parts' strength and looks seem to distress it.

entry: 以体型而言，POKENAME臂力强得惊人，腿却相对弱，因此更爱找慢些的宝可梦对练。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME possesses incredible arm strength for its size, but its legs are relatively weak. For this reason, it prefers to train against slower Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是磨炼心智与能力的战士。野生POKENAME罕见至极，却偶尔能在深洞见到它们冥想。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are warriors striving to strengthen their mental aptitude and abilities. Wild POKENAME are unspeakably rare, but they can be seen meditating deep within caves.

entry: 它散出可怕的强大能量。完全掌握超能力与体术的POKENAME，只一根手指，就能将敌人弹飞数英里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Terrifyingly powerful energy radiates from this Pokémon. POKENAME who have completely mastered both the psychic and physical arts can flick a foe away for miles with just one finger.

entry: POKENAME的超能力拳能压垮厚钢墙，还能在攻击发生前数纳秒预见。可肾上腺素一冲，往往仍拿原本脆弱的身体硬接。
author: cipherlingarde
source: Capable of throwing psychic-powered punches able to crumple thick steel walls, POKENAME can foresee attacks nanoseconds before they occur. However, due to the adrenaline in its body, it'll often endure the attack to its otherwise frail body.

entry: 它用大舌品尝土壤，寻找最好的养分。选中适合的巢址，就深深埋进土里。
author: .izik
source: It uses its large tongue to taste the soil for optimal nutrients. Once it finds a suitable nesting spot, it will bury itself deep in the dirt.

entry: POKENAME极其怕生，厌恶陌生人，为此长出独特的适应：舍去长肢，改成可藏身的藤蔓丛。
author: ziggaway
source: POKENAME has adapted unique traits to ease its crippling shyness and aversion to strangers: it traded long limbs for a vine cluster in which it hides.

entry: POKENAME成群钻入屋墙，啃木料与保温层。它们胆小极了，哪怕只被看见一瞬，也会弃屋逃走。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME will invade the walls of a home to consume the wood and insulation. They are timid and will abandon the house if someone sees them for even a moment.

entry: 它伏在林地，用体内伸出的根吸取土中养分。吃得足够，就开始进化。
author: .izik
source: It lays on the forest floor and uses the roots coming out of its body to absorb nutrients from the soil. Once it takes in enough, it will begin to evolve.

entry: 它从附近捡来细枝、小石与藤蔓筑巢，再朝巢边地面吐酸，不让别人靠近。
author: .izik
source: It spits globs of acid on the ground near its nest to deter others from approaching. It will create its nest with twigs, pebbles and vines that it collects from the immediate area.

entry: 它们清晨四处轻飞，寻找花蜜。入夜便藏到灌木等隐蔽处，将脚埋进土中，当作根使用。
author: bobosmith01
source: They flutter around in the early morning, looking for nectar. When night comes, they rest in a secluded, hidden spot, such as bushes, and bury their feet into the ground, which act as roots.

entry: 夜里，它用周围藤蔓盖住身体保暖。若被天敌吵醒，就朝来者吐酸。
author: .izik
source: At night, it will cover itself in nearby vines to keep warm. If awoken by a predator, it will fire acid from its mouth at the offender.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时在田里扎根，吸收养分。两个头同样擅长战斗。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: When sleeping, POKENAME root themselves in fields to absorb nutrients. Both their heads are equally capable of fighting.

entry: 遇到威胁，它朝平面喷出彩酸，借此伪装躲敌。连最厉害的行家，也几乎分不清它与一幅画。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, it will spit colored acid on a flat surface to hide from foes. This camouflage is almost impossible to differentiate from a painting by even the most accomplished experts.

entry: 尾尖会产生彩色酸液，POKENAME遇险就涂满身体，借此伪装。好在酸性出奇温和，留在裸露皮肤上许多小时，才会造成灼伤。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon produces a colorful acid from the tip of its tail. When POKENAME is in danger, it will cover itself in this acid as camouflage. Fortunately, the acid is surprisingly mild and will only burn it if left on exposed skin for many hours.

entry: 雷雨中，它站在树上，向天举起根状的长尾。只要被雷劈一次，就够POKENAME数周不饿。
author: .izik
source: It will stand on trees and raise its long, root-like tail to the sky during thunderstorms. A single lightning strike can satisfy a POKENAME's hunger for weeks.

entry: POKENAME用根状尾巴捕捉虫宝可梦，抓住后，POKENAME便施以强烈电击，将其制服。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME uses its root-like tail to capture bug Pokémon. Once its prey is in its grasp, POKENAME incapacitates them with a strong electric shock.

entry: 嘴边覆着薄薄的酸液，能蚀穿球果硬皮，吸饮内部汁液。
author: .izik
source: The edges of its mouth have a thin layer of acid on them. It uses this acid to burn through the hard outer skin of an Apricorn and drink the juice inside.

entry: 身体太重，难以远行。看见食物，就伸出最长15英尺的舌头取来。
author: .izik
source: Due to its heavy body, it has trouble moving long distances. If it sees a food source, it will extend its tongue up to 15 feet to grab the meal.

entry: 被称为“护卫”的微型喇叭芽，守着它的身躯，向任何想拿起它的对象吐黏酸。它们全由死去独剑鞘的灵魂操纵，保护的正是其遗体。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Miniature Bellsprout known as "wards" guard its body, spitting slimy acid at anything that tries to pick it up. The wards are controlled wholly by the spirit of the departed Honedge whose body they protect.

entry: 每条尾巴都带着不同草药的滋味。POKENAME越年老，各条尾巴就越苦。
author: .izik
source: Each of its tails holds the flavor of a different herb. Each tail gets consistently more bitter in flavor the older the POKENAME gets.

entry: POKENAME以藤蔓般的头攀住枝条，很少活动。性情虽闲适，必要时却能爆发惊人力量。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME clings to branches with its vine-like head and rarely moves. Its relaxed nature hides its potential to unleash surprising strength when necessary.

entry: 它吹哨就能操纵藤蔓。POKENAME用藤蔓缚住猎物，再吞食。
author: .izik
source: While it whistles it can control vines. POKENAME uses these vines to immobilize prey and consume them.

entry: 花中藏着剧毒倒刺。POKENAME通常只猎小型虫属性宝可梦，却也爱用诡计引来大猎物。
author: ziggaway
source: The flowers on this Pokémon contain incredibly toxic barbs. While it normally only hunts small Bug-types, POKENAME also enjoys luring large prey through use of trickery.

entry: 腰间的绒毛，其实由数万亿根细根构成。它在溪里泡上数小时，尽可能吸足水分。
author: .izik
source: The fluff on its waist is made up of trillions of tiny roots. It will soak these roots for hours within a stream to absorb as much water as possible.

entry: 它用圆嘴吸住树侧，再以少量酸液蚀开树皮，吸取汁液。
author: .izik
source: It uses its round mouth to suction onto the sides of trees. It will utilize a small amount of acid to burn into the bark and drink the sap.

entry: 体表叶片可磨成药膏，治疗轻微擦伤与割伤。叶子一接触水，就能快速再生。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on its body can be ground into a paste to treat minor scrapes or cuts. They regrow rapidly when exposed to water.

entry: 叶子闻起来像鼠尾草混着牛至，尝起来却苦极了。若不煮熟，根本无法食用。
author: .izik
source: Its leaves smell like a mixture of sage and oregano. Their taste, however, is exceptionally bitter and they are completely inedible unless boiled.

entry: POKENAME以杂技般的身手在树间荡跃，借藤蔓发动空中突袭。隐蔽身影配合摔跤技艺，常让敌人猝不及防。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings between trees with acrobatic finesse, using its vines to perform surprise aerial attacks. Its opponents are often caught off guard by its combination of stealth and wrestling prowess.

entry: 睡觉时，叶子散发可怕的恶臭，将小偷与天敌都挡在巢外。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on its body exude a terrible stench while it sleeps. This deters thieves and predators from its nest.

entry: 它在池边一站就是数小时，纹丝不动，用脚缘细根吸收泥中水分。
author: .izik
source: It stands at the edge of ponds for hours at a time without moving. It will use the tiny roots on the edges of its feet to absorb moisture from the mud.

entry: 它毛皮中飘出的孢子营养丰富。过去，人们曾用这些孢子制作效果较弱的要害攻击。
author: .izik
source: The spores that come from its fur are highly nutritious. In the past, these spores were used to create a less-effective Dire Hit.

entry: 嘴里射出的种子热得能熔化金属。种子一多，就可能引起山火。
author: .izik
source: The seeds that it fires from its mouth are hot enough to melt metal. Large amounts of these seeds can cause forest fires.

entry: 王冠市有位草药师，用POKENAME的叶子调制手工解眠药，带着淡淡薄荷香。
author: .izik
source: There is an herbalist in Crown City that utilizes a POKENAME's leaves to create artisanal Awakenings. These Awakenings have a slightly minty scent.

entry: 夜里，身体微光能引来猎物。紫酸最远能喷出10英尺，制服将要吃下的目标。
author: .izik
source: Its body will glow slightly at night to entice prey. It will vomit a purple acid from up to 10 feet away in order to incapacitate its meal.

entry: 浅葱镇的一家餐馆，用POKENAME嘴里的大葱炖出特色料理。神奥各地的游客都慕名前来。
author: .izik
source: A restaurant in Daybreak Town utilizes the leek in a POKENAME's mouth to create a special stew. Tourists come from all around Sinnoh to enjoy it.

entry: POKENAME以死去水箭龟的骨头、头骨与龟壳碎片防身。它想装得勇敢，却总压低头骨遮脸，免得别人看见自己哭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself with the bone, skull, and shell fragment of fallen Blastoise. It tries to appear brave, lowering the skull to obscure its face so nobody can see it cry.

entry: POKENAME壳内藏着火焰囊，用来将水加热至沸腾。
author: lemage22
source: Inside the POKENAME's shell is an internal flame sac, which it uses to heat water to its boiling point.

entry: 野生POKENAME长大后，会定期寻找新头盔。常能看见它们排成队，换进比自己大一号的同类丢下的壳里。
author: Dragon_Hunter_70
source: Wild POKENAME will search for new helmets periodically as they grow. It is not unusual to see lines of POKENAME's swapping into the discarded shells of POKENAME's larger than themselves.

entry: 它比起飞行，更爱游泳，几小时就能横跨海洋。遇见船只，便一路相随，守护并引导它们通过险浪。
author: sk372
source: It prefers swimming to flying, able to swim across entire oceans in a few hours. It follows along ships it comes across, watching over them and guiding them through rough waters.

entry: POKENAME受攻击，就振翅扬沙，缩进壳里。若对方还不罢休，POKENAME便喷水反击。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: When attacked, POKENAME will flap its wings to kick up sand, then proceed to hide in its shell. If the attacker persists, POKENAME will fight back by squirting water.

entry: POKENAME一旦与同伴走散，就会立刻缩进壳里，直到重新找到同类，才肯出来。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: If a POKENAME becomes separated from its group, it will immediately withdraw into its shell and won't come out until it is reunited with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME想装得吓人，却总不成功。它往往靠无意间流露的可爱取胜，而非那副凶脸。
author: typhloquil
source: While POKENAME may act intimidating, this act always falls flat. More often than not, it wins through accidental charm rather than its fierce facade.

entry: POKENAME控制不好电力，入水时常不慎电到鱼宝可梦，随后羞愧地躲进壳里。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: Due to its poor control over its electricity, POKENAME will often accidently shock fish Pokémon whenever it enters the water. Afterwards it will hide in its shell in shame.

entry: POKENAME的壳便于快速游泳，捕食鱼宝可梦。它又不断繁衍，定居之处的鱼群往往迅速减少。
author: DarkWeavile428
source: POKENAME's shell allows it to swim quickly in the water and catch fish Pokémon. Since it continuously produces offspring, the fish Pokémon population in areas where POKENAME settles quickly decrease.

entry: POKENAME栖在小树，用壳状头盔朝附近树果喷水。可POKENAME自己又讨厌沾湿，什么水域都躲着。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME perch on small trees, firing jets of water at nearby berries with its shell-like helmet. Despite this, POKENAME hates being wet and will stay away from any body of water.

entry: POKENAME漂在水面上方，避开饥饿的捕食者。遇险时，也常造出小漩涡护身。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME drifts just above the water to avoid hungry predators. It often forms small whirlpools to protect itself when in danger.

entry: 雨季常能看见POKENAME，开心地踏水洼、在雨中跳舞。孩子般的顽皮，让它们很受小学生欢迎。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are frequently seen during the rainy season, gleefully jumping in puddles and dancing in the rain. They are popular amongst school children with their child-like whimsy.

entry: POKENAME失去了壳，却长出流线型身体，游得敏捷，攻守皆擅。为保安全，进化前很少爬上陆地。
author: sk372
source: Now lacking a shell but gaining a streamlined body, POKENAME has become adept at agile swimming, both offensively and defensively. For its own safety, it rarely slithers onto land before it evolves.

entry: POKENAME常收集冲上海岸的光滑石头与漂亮贝壳。身体轻、壳形利于行水，能轻易浮在水面。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spend much of their time collecting smooth stones and pretty shells that wash up on shorelines. Their hydrodynamic shell and light weight allows them to easily float on top of the water.

entry: POKENAME身体底部有壳，充进空气当浮具，再用尾巴划水前进。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME has a shell on the bottom of its body, which it fills with air and uses as a flotation device. It then uses its tail as a paddle to move through the water.

entry: 它朝壳喷水，便能快速转起来，甚至在池面弹跳。POKENAME觉得有趣，还会比试谁去得最远。
author: Frokachu
source: By shooting water at its shell, it can begin to spin quickly and even skip along the ponds it resides in. POKENAME do this for fun, and challenge others to see who can go the farthest.

entry: 遇险瞬移后，它会留下一个浮在空中的水泡。泡泡破裂前，还能隐约听见POKENAME的叫声从里头回荡。
author: sk372
source: When it teleports away from danger, it leaves behind a bubble of water floating in the air. One can faintly hear an echo of POKENAME's cry from within before it pops.

entry: POKENAME既没普通卡咪龟的耳朵，也没那条大尾巴，游泳常失去平衡。因此，再次进化前，训练家通常不带它去宽阔水域。
author: Soup1900
source: POKENAME often has a hard time balancing itself while swimming due to the lack of ears and the big tail a normal Wartortle would have. As such, Trainers often avoid bringing this Pokémon to large bodies of water until it evolves again.

entry: POKENAME身体臃肿，休息时得找格外结实的枝条。舌头分泌稠胶，能黏住一切食物。
author: entomoxie
source: Due to their bloated bodies, POKENAME need particularly strong branches when resting. Their tongues secrete a thick glue which they use to grab on to any food.

entry: POKENAME住在湿地与沼泽边。被激怒时，就用尾巴聚起泥浆，高速掷向敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives near marshes and swamps. If provoked, it gathers mud into its tail and flings it towards enemies at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME通常躺着不动，被当成普通植物。自身毒素不断让它们头昏、困倦。
author: Holgast
source: POKENAME are usually found lying still and often mistaken for regular plants. They are constantly disoriented and drowsy from their own toxins.

entry: POKENAME觅食时倒飞，方便捞起猎物。可猎得太久，自己也会头晕。
author: Frokachu
source: When locating prey, POKENAME fly upside down to better scoop them up. When hunting for too long, they end up getting dizzy.

entry: 两个头都会引诱猎物，却只有前头能吃。后头只替POKENAME捕些小猎物，存着，等缺少大份饱食时再用。
author: sk372
source: Though both heads use lure tactics to capture prey, only the front head can actually consume it. The rear head simply captures smaller prey for POKENAME to save for when larger, more fulfilling food is scarce.

entry: 它能整只吞下大针蜂。野外遇见POKENAME，可得格外小心。
author: kittyluv090
source: It is known to swallow Beedrill whole. Those who find a POKENAME in the wild should proceed with extreme caution.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，等下一位受害者。一旦开始吞咽，胃酸几乎无物不溶，再挣扎也逃不掉。
author: Uncookie
source: POKENAME hangs on trees, awaiting its next victim. Once it starts swallowing, its stomach acid dissolves almost anything; attempting escape is futile.

entry: POKENAME出手极准，锐利的鞭状尾巴刺向敌人弱处，从不落空。
author: EaSpordz
source: A POKENAME is extremely accurate with its strikes. With its sharp whip-like tail, it pierces any weak point of its target without fail.

entry: 双腿能伸缩，灵巧无比，最长近三米。POKENAME会在踢出的途中突然伸腿，缠住敌人，以强劲的绞力碾压。
author: sk372
source: Its legs are retractable and extremely dexterous, able to extend to lengths of almost three meters. POKENAME will extend its legs mid-kick in order to wrap around an opponent and crush it with its powerful constriction.

entry: POKENAME有两个大脑，或许还有两份意识。哪一方主导，科学家也不清楚。
author: Krune
source: POKENAME has two brains and possibly two minds. Scientists are unsure which one is the dominant mind.

entry: POKENAME有些笨拙，待在海面附近，浅潜捕猎。鼓起的头能当浮具，还能膨胀，迅速浮出水面，或吓唬来敌。
author: Katie
source: A somewhat clumsy aquatic Pokémon, POKENAME stays near the sea's surface and performs shallow dives for its prey. Its bulbous head acts as a float and can expand to rapidly surface or intimidate threats.

entry: 野生POKENAME藏在海底岩群，几乎难以察觉。它只有一对触手与弱酸，总缩在壳里，等待养分或小猎物靠近孔口。
author: Lutrax
source: A wild POKENAME is hardly noticed among rock formations under the sea. Since it only has a pair of tentacles and weak acid, it stays hidden within its shell at all times, waiting for any nutrients or smaller prey to approach its holes.

entry: 它喷出背部红腺中储藏的酸水。曾有渔船想捕捉它，结果船壳被蚀出了洞。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: It shoots jets of acidic water stored in the red gland on its back. Fishing boats that dared try to catch it have been found with holes in their hull.

entry: 满月之夜，成群POKENAME像气球般浮在水上。月光在头顶红囊折射，化作绚丽光彩。
author: sautomagically
source: On nights with a full moon, groups of POKENAME float above the water like balloons. Moonlight refracts in the red sacs on their heads to create a dazzling display of lights.

entry: POKENAME体内装的不是内脏系统，而是水。腹部宝石能放出安抚的能量，连盛怒者也能平静。
author: robbery_666
source: POKENAME's body is filled with water rather than internal systems. The gem on its belly lets it release a calming energy that can soothe even the most enraged.

entry: 它发出奇异幽沉的哼鸣，能让水手沉睡，老练海员便总带着耳塞。也难怪，一群POKENAME被叫作“合唱团”。
author: sautomagically
source: It emits strange, haunting hums that can lure sailors into a deep slumber, so experienced seafarers always carry earplugs. Fittingly, groups of POKENAME are called a choir.

entry: POKENAME在海底筑巢，能化成任何水生宝可梦的模样，因此很难找到。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME makes its den at the bottom of the ocean. It's difficult to find because it can appear as any aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME便是玛瑙水母夺取其他宝可梦心智的结果。被控制的宝可梦，会慢慢变成玛瑙水母的躯体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an example of what happens when a Tentacool takes control of a Pokémon's mind. The other Pokémon will slowly become Tentacool's body.

entry: 这只喵喵正被玛瑙水母控制心智，外形会随受控时间长短而变化。
author: Krune
source: This Meowth is being mind-controlled by a Tentacool. Its shape depends on how long the Tentacool has controlled it.

entry: POKENAME便是玛瑙水母夺取其他宝可梦心智的结果。被控制的宝可梦，会慢慢变成玛瑙水母的躯体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an example of what happens when a Tentacool takes control of a Pokémon's mind. The other Pokémon will slowly become Tentacool's body.

entry: POKENAME便是玛瑙水母夺取其他宝可梦心智的结果。被控制的宝可梦，会慢慢变成玛瑙水母的躯体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an example of what happens when a Tentacool takes control of a Pokémon's mind. The other Pokémon will slowly become Tentacool's body.

entry: POKENAME便是玛瑙水母夺取其他宝可梦心智的结果。被控制的宝可梦，会慢慢变成玛瑙水母的躯体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is an example of what happens when a Tentacool takes control of a Pokémon's mind. The other Pokémon will slowly become Tentacool's body.

entry: POKENAME鲜红的壳既能挡住天敌，也能在退潮时把水留在壳内。没有水，POKENAME就会干瘪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's brilliant red shell serves two purposes: one is to give it defense against predators, and the other is to help shut water inside the shell at lower tides. Without water, POKENAME shrivels up.

entry: POKENAME尚未掌握随意分泌毒素的本领，可能毫无明显缘由，就意外朝周围排毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have not mastered their ability to secrete poison at will, and may accidentally discharge toxins around them for no discernable reason at all.

entry: POKENAME找到复杂的海底洞穴，便占为己有。它们小心探出触手，感知猎物接近，一有机会就出击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can find intricate ocean caverns, claiming them as their own. They can carefully extend their tentacles out to sense any prey approaching them, striking as soon as they have their chance.

entry: 它掌握庞大的超能力，用以自卫。传说，只需一个念头，就能掀起巨大海啸。
author: Schwaus
source: It controls an immense amount of psychic energy, which it uses to protect itself. Legends say it can cause massive tsunamis with a single thought.

entry: POKENAME完美藏进彩色珊瑚，悄悄观察四周。猎物一近，POKENAME便从每个壳孔伸出触手，迅速捉住，以强酸溶化。
author: Lutrax
source: POKENAME perfectly camouflages itself amongst colourful corals, silently scanning its surroundings unnoticed. When prey draw near, POKENAME releases tentacles from every hole in its shell to quickly grab and melt them using a powerful acid.

entry: POKENAME有80根触手，能仔细除草、照料植物，也会攻击任何想砍树的人。
author: dragonessanimations
source: POKENAME has 80 tentacles, which it uses to carefully tend to plants by weeding them. They are also used to attack anyone who tries to fell a tree.

entry: POKENAME是从最深海渊被放逐的隐者。歌声满是骗人的许诺，被引去的人，鲜有好下场。
author: GalactaKiller
source: POKENAME is a recluse, exiled from the deepest depths. Its songs are full of deceiving promises, and getting lured by it rarely ends well.

entry: 壳内伸出的炮管能灵活抓握，攻防皆强。一根被切断，内部就会再伸出备用的替换。
author: sk372
source: The prehensile cannons extending from within its shell give it fantastic offensive and defensive capabilities. If one should be severed, a reserve from within will extend to replace it.

entry: POKENAME会私下摘去头骨，独自哀悼。年老POKENAME脸上有平滑的纹路，那是多年泪水侵蚀的痕迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME removes its skull cap in private to mourn its loss. Older POKENAME can be identified by smooth lines on their face where tears have caused erosion over time.

entry: POKENAME看似很容易发现，实际极精于伪装。毫无防备的猎物一靠近，就会遭到攻击。
author: snivi4971
source: POKENAME is very skilled at camouflage, though it seems like it would be easy to see. When an unsuspecting victim approaches it, it attacks.

entry: POKENAME只有争夺领地时才摇尾，声音如乱石相碰。平时，它无声潜伏山径，等着伏击不设防的宝可梦。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When POKENAME rattles its tail, it sounds like a clattering of rocks smacking together, though it only does this during territorial disputes. Usually, it silently lies in wait on mountain trails, ready to ambush unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: 它偏爱以石尾缠住敌人，紧紧束缚，再用拳头猛击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It prefers to constrict its enemies with its stony tail. While it has its prey immobilized in its rock-hard grip, it pummels them with its fists.

entry: POKENAME装成石头，守护家园，等入侵者没看它时，才伸出角。
author: v0rtre
source: POKENAME tend to disguise themselves as rocks to protect their homes from intruders. They stick out their horns when the intruder is not looking.

entry: 皮肤坚如岩石，少有天敌。越是年老，砖块般的纹样越粗糙模糊，最后与普通石头无异。
author: Staghorn
source: It has few predators thanks to its rock-hard hide. As it grows older, the brick-shaped pattern on its skin grows rougher and loses definition until it's indistinguishable from stone.

entry: POKENAME用强臂将猎物举上高空，再摔到地上，令其失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong arms to lift prey high into the air. It then drops them to the ground to incapacitate them.

entry: 据说，这只蜥脚类宝可梦与冰雪龙生于同一时代。岩石身体总是冰冷，因此很爱拥抱。
author: zerocipher
source: This sauropod Pokémon is believed to have lived with Amaura in the same time period. It loves cuddles because its rocky body is always cold.

entry: 大钳蟹常与POKENAME作伴，借强臂投石，赶走平时捕食自己的鸟宝可梦。事后，它还会在感激的受护者面前，得意地秀起肌肉。
author: sk372
source: Krabby often keep POKENAME in close company, as their strong arms allow them to hurl stones at flying Pokémon that would normally hunt them. Afterward, it flexes triumphantly before its grateful charges.

entry: 据说古人会把成群POKENAME推下山坡，下注比快，作为娱乐。如今，POKENAME仍以速度自豪，只有修补体裂时才慢下来。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is believed that in ancient times, people would roll groups of POKENAME down hills for entertainment, placing bets on which is faster. To this day, POKENAME pride themselves on their speed, only slowing down to mend the cracks in their bodies.

entry: POKENAME相争，胜者会夺走败者骨棒，与自己的并用。遇上持四根棒的POKENAME，可得当心，那必是强敌。
author: sk372
source: In battles between rival POKENAME, the victor will take the loser's bone club and wield it in tandem with its own. Be wary if one sees a POKENAME with four clubs; it is sure to be a powerful foe indeed.

entry: POKENAME用双臂保持平衡、调整方向，施展强踢。伸长的四肢也能助它攀崖，一脚就能碎岩。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME primarily use their arms to balance and direct themselves while performing powerful kicks. They extend their limbs to help them scale cliffs, kicking hard enough to shatter rock.

entry: POKENAME能让拳套硬得超过岩石。它们仔细击开洞壁，开辟新道，救出塌方中受困的人与宝可梦。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to harden the gloves on their fists to be harder than rock. They carefully punch out sections of cave walls to create new tunnels and free people or Pokémon from cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME舌头极敏感，甚至得包进石中保护。每只POKENAME选的石料不同，方便品尝各自喜爱的矿物。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tongues of POKENAME are very sensitive, to the point where they encase them in rocks for protection. Different POKENAME use different types of rocks in this process to enjoy their favorite minerals.

entry: POKENAME难以靠鼓胀离地，便改用吃下的岩石分解出的粉尘喷射推进，让自己悬空。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME struggle to inflate themselves enough to lift off the ground. They instead release dust broken down from the rocks they eat to act as propulsion to suspend themselves in the air.

entry: POKENAME外表虽凶，却很早就被驯养，尤其受建筑工人与商户欢迎。夜里，它们攀在楼侧，借火光守望。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their fearsome appearance, POKENAME were domesticated fairly early, especially popular among construction workers and business owners. They perch on the side of buildings to keep watch at night with the light of their flames.

entry: POKENAME大吃矿物丰富的食物，维持岩石身躯。常睡在山顶，有时梦中就滚下山去。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: POKENAME gorges on mineral-rich foods to maintain its rocky composition. It sleeps on the top of mountains, sometimes tumbling down in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME略有虚荣，为头上长鬃般的石发自豪。它常洗常磨，擦得发亮，谁弄脏，就凶狠对待谁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is slightly vain, proud of the long mane of hair-like stone on its head. It washes and polishes the rock often until it gleams, and is particularly vicious against any who would dirty it.

entry: POKENAME啃咬山洞与群山散落的石块，让大牙保持强健。可偶尔连岩石属性宝可梦也啃，让它们烦恼不已。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its large teeth healthy and strong by gnawing on the many rocks and stones strewn about mountains and caverns. It's become a nuisance to Rock-type Pokémon as it sometimes gnaws on them as well.

entry: POKENAME能化为无形，附身石头。山路上若总有落石险险擦身，也许就是POKENAME在恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can make itself incorporeal and possess stone. If one's mountain travel seems fraught with far too many near misses with falling rocks, it may be a POKENAME playing pranks.

entry: POKENAME以钩爪扎进崖壁，迅速轻松地攀山。它们滑翔在崖边，尾巴缓摇，等着挖出矿石充饥。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their claws as hooks to dig into the sides of cliffs, quickly and effortlessly scaling mountainsides. They glide around the cliffside with their tails swaying slowly, waiting to dig up ore deposits for their meals.

entry: 它既吃山边树果，也吃小石子，因此POKENAME的果汁略带颗粒口感，颇受登山者与露营者喜爱。
author: sk372
source: Because it eats small rocks as well as berries that grow near mountains, POKENAME's juice is described as having a slightly grainy texture. It's a popular beverage choice among hikers and campers.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近，用背臂收集熔岩，制成铠甲。它们生性爱玩，跳进岩浆扑腾，仿佛只是在玩水。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live near volcanoes where they use the arms on their backs to gather molten rocks to make into armor. They're rather playful by nature, leaping and splashing around lava as if it was water.

entry: POKENAME用象鼻抓起石块，互相投掷闪躲，玩得起劲。倒霉的小拳石与石丸子，有时也被拿来当球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often play with each other by using their trunks to grab rocks, throwing and dodging the stone projectiles. Unfortunate Geodude and Roggenrola sometimes get used in these games as well.

entry: POKENAME的第二对手臂，打斗与干活都有用，尤其擅长挖掘建造。
author: v0rtre
source: POKENAME's second pair of arms are useful for both combat and labor. They are excellent at digging and building.

entry: 进化到这一阶段，POKENAME开始压实身体，压得越紧，就越坚韧。
author: v0rtre
source: At this stage in its evolution, POKENAME begins to condense itself. It becomes tougher and tougher the more it condenses.

entry: 它蜷起身体滚过山地，在体内发电，喜欢攒足电力，再用雷电击碎大石。
author: sk372
source: It generates energy internally by curling up and rolling about the mountains. It enjoys charging up enough energy to shoot bolts of lightning at large rocks to shatter them to pieces.

entry: 头上的巨臂把大石砸成一口能吃的小块。接着，四臂轮番将石粒送进饥饿的大嘴。
author: sk372
source: It shatters large rocks into bite-size pebbles with the large arms on its head. Afterward, all four arms will take turns shoveling the stone morsels into its hungry mouth.

entry: 背刺长得太大，就用背部磨蹭石墙，将其磨短。古代关都出土的长矛，有些矛尖正是折下的石刺。
author: sk372
source: It rubs its back against stone walls to grind down the rocky spines on its back when they grow too large. Spears using broken-off spines as the tip have been found dating back to ancient Kanto.

entry: POKENAME静立时，多臂会无规律地摆动旋转。研究者推测，这是在调整体内磁力。
author: sk372
source: When standing still, POKENAME will swing and rotate its multiple arms with no discernible pattern. Researchers theorize these movements adjust and regulate its internal magnetism.

entry: 双臂能投巨石、投敌人，也能投自己，这正是它最爱的出行方式。可巨石做的外鞘，让落地总不太优雅。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Its arms can hurl boulders, opponents, or itself; its preferred mode of travel. The boulders it sheaths into ensure its landings are not graceful.

entry: POKENAME总给飞碟射击比赛添乱。它误把飞碟当同类，以为遇险，就飞去抢救。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME causes issues for clay target shooting competitions. It confuses the flying discs for members of its species and snatches them up because it believes they are in danger.

entry: POKENAME用大牙磨碎岩石，取出其中矿物。飞行时撒下剩余石粉，迷住敌人与领地入侵者的双眼。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large teeth to break through rocks in order to grind them into dust and gather minerals from within. They scatter the leftover dust as they fly, blinding opponents or intruders to their territory.

entry: 它以四臂掘洞，寻找珍贵的宝石原石。成功拿到，总得先欢跳庆贺，再吃下晶亮的美餐。
author: sk372
source: Using all four arms, it digs through caverns in search of raw precious gems. After successfully snatching some, it cannot resist prancing about in triumph before consuming its crystalline meal.

entry: POKENAME无论走到哪里，都会喷出恶臭的孢子和粉尘。人们不确定它是否完全出于自觉，但确实见过POKENAME故意把粉尘和孢子射进攻击者的眼睛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spews foul-smelling spores and dust wherever it goes. It is unclear if this action is entirely conscious or not, but POKENAME have been observed purposely firing dust and spores into the eyes of aggressors.

entry: POKENAME爬上巨石，吸取养分。石头渐渐中空脆弱，等POKENAME吃完，就碎成粉尘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crawls atop large boulders and siphons nutrients from them. The boulders turn hollow and brittle as a result, crumbling to dust once POKENAME has fed from them completely.

entry: 它用四臂，甚至尾巴抓石，投向入侵者。警告若被无视，就愈发暴怒，边嚎边滚向目标。
author: sk372
source: It uses all four arms and even its tail to grab stones in order to pelt them at trespassers. Should this warning be ignored, it will fly into a deeper rage and roll at its target, howling all the while.

entry: 每拳都轻松打穿岩石，令POKENAME十分难缠。曾有暴怒POKENAME，一天就将整座山峰打成粉，才肯平息。
author: sk372
source: Each fist can punch a hole in stone with ease, making POKENAME a formidable opponent. A raging POKENAME once reduced an entire mountain peak to dust in a day before it calmed down.

entry: POKENAME用搜集的矿物制作汤匙，集中超能力。主要借此比较各种矿物，探查周围洞穴的构成。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion spoons out of minerals they gather in order to focus their psychic powers. They primarily use these powers to compare various minerals and see the composition of caves around them.

entry: 岩石般的强前臂擅长进攻，另一对却像发育不全。其实它只是将那双臂紧贴躯干，护住弱点。
author: sk372
source: Its strong rocky forearms make for a potent offense. Its other set of arms seem malformed, but in actuality it keeps them tucked close to help protect weak spots on its torso.

entry: POKENAME绷肌肉不只为炫耀，每绷一次，石臂就能暂存更多能量。若放招前蓄得够，一拳甚至能震垮整片山脉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flexing isn't just for showboating; every flex temporarily stores more energy in its stony arms. If allowed to flex enough before release, a single punch could crumble an entire mountain range.

entry: POKENAME常被当成普通隆隆石，主要区别却是没有脚。新长的第二对手臂，总垂在身旁，仿佛连自己也没发现。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Commonly mistaken for regular Graveler, the main distinction of a POKENAME is its lack of feet. It almost always keeps its newly developed second pair of arms by its side, as if it doesn't even realize it has them.

entry: POKENAME进化前，会拢来石头保护身体。常犹豫该用哪对手臂，好像正在决定更喜欢哪一双。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather rocks around themselves to protect their bodies as they prepare for evolution. They often seem confused on which set of arms to use, as if trying to decide which one they prefer.

entry: 尾上的拳头把石块敲小，方便吞食。嚼碎岩石时，有时还能迸出火星。
author: sk372
source: The fist on its tail is used to smash stones into chunks small enough for it to eat. When it chews on the rocks, sparks can sometimes be seen as it crunches on the stones.

entry: 描绘古代伽勒尔与卡洛斯王室的图画中，曾出现POKENAME。高阶骑士骑着它穿越险地，速度与防御都关乎生死。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have been found in depictions of royal houses in historical Galar and Kalos. High-ranking knights would ride them across dangerous territory, where speed and defense were both paramount to survival.

entry: POKENAME虽有磁力，却更爱把磁铁当钝锤。它们高速原地转动，反复敲打敌人，还用磁力来回拉扯。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their magnetic powers, POKENAME prefer to use the magnets they carry as blunt maces. They rapidly spin in place, smacking their opponents repeatedly while pulling them back and forth with their magnets.

entry: POKENAME的三部分靠抓牢彼此相连，并非磁力。奇怪的是，这结合比磁吸还强，至今没见过谁能拉开。
author: sk372
source: The three parts of POKENAME maintain a connection via a strong grip, rather than any magnetism at work. Curiously, the bond this way is even stronger than the magnets; nothing has been seen able to pull them apart.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷的地下湖底。记录中，它曾从深处猛然冲出，攻击偷猎者，救下拉普拉斯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home at the bottom of cold underground lakes. Records indicate some Lapras have been saved from poachers by POKENAME rocketing from the depths and attacking the interlopers.

entry: POKENAME的手臂通常已退化，看不出用途。但也有人见过，一些POKENAME仍用来朝敌人掷巨石。
author: bobosmith01
source: Typically, POKENAME's arms are vestigial in nature and serve no clear function. However, some POKENAME have been witnessed using them to hurl large boulders at foes.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下洞窟底部的岩石，只为补充筑巢石料才出来。它们捏碎石头，将粉尘撒进水中，让矿物帮助生长。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Burrowing into rocks at the bottom of underground caves, POKENAME only surface to gather more rocks for their shelters. They crush rocks into dust in their grip then release the dust into the water to fill it with minerals that will help them grow.

entry: 石身坚硬、钻角强劲，攻防皆出众。POKENAME常与班基拉斯争夺山坡领地。
author: sk372
source: Its hardened stone body and powerful drill horn give it incredible offense and defense capabilities. POKENAME are known to battle Tyranitar over territorial claims for mountainsides.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: POKENAME住在洁净的地下湖。平时独来独往，若旅人想渡湖，却愿帮忙，载行时低沉的歌声回荡整座洞穴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabit pristine underground lakes. Ordinarily a creature of solitude, should travelers need to cross its lake, it will oblige them. It sings a rumbling song that echoes across the cavern as it does so.

entry: 科学家开发POKENAME，为山区施肥、收割庄稼。一些无法驯服的个体却逃了出去，如今正破坏当地生态。
author: Leviath
source: Scientists developed POKENAME for fertilizing and crop harvesting in mountainous regions. Some untamable specimens managed to set themselves free and now cause havoc in local ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME的石皮竟能长毛，每年换一次。用毛制成的地毯带天然泥土香，在某些地区很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: Fur manages to grow from POKENAME's rocky skin, forming a coat that sheds once a year. Carpeting made with its fur is popular in some regions due to emanating a natural earthy scent.

entry: 野生POKENAME遇险便紧紧盘起，在体内蓄压。待准时机，外层矿物就会炸开，尖片深深割伤近处的敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: To defend itself, a wild POKENAME will coil up tightly and build up pressure within its body. After biding its time, its outer mineral layer explodes, causing sharp shrapnel to cut deeply into any nearby foe.

entry: 火山喷发后，常能见到POKENAME，给受灾居民带来欢乐。柔软而结实的身体，能护住蛋不受伤害。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME are commonly sighted after a volcano erupts, seeking to bring joy to any affected locals. Its soft and sturdy body ensures no harm befalls its egg.

entry: POKENAME身体已完全压实，准备最终进化。它缩回双臂，尽量积蓄力量。
author: v0rtre
source: Now fully condensed, POKENAME prepares for its final evolution. It retracts its arms to give itself as much power as possible.

entry: POKENAME披着厚甲，游历各种地形，最常见于群山与火山，常住在洞穴。
author: v0rtre
source: With a heavily armored body, POKENAME roams many different landscapes. It is usually seen in mountains and volcanoes, often dwelling in a cave.

entry: POKENAME石身不断发电，若不定期释放，能量便会爆发。山中家园，曾因此整大片遭到摧毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are always producing electricity within their stony body; if not released periodically, the built-up energy will explode out of it. Entire chunks of their mountainous homes have been destroyed this way.

entry: 它披上能找到的最好岩石，如穿王者礼服。换下的石头，则会送给一个幼崽。
author: Staghorn
source: It clads itself in the highest-quality rocks it can find, wearing them like royal regalia. When it replaces a rock, it gifts the rock being replaced to one of its young.

entry: POKENAME天生能察觉岩层是否稳定。山民已懂得，若POKENAME从身边跑过，就赶紧跟上，否则可能陷入山崩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have an innate sense of how stable rock and stone in the area is. Those in the mountains have come to know that if one sees a POKENAME running past them, they should follow, or be caught in a landslide.

entry: POKENAME翻碎整山，寻找最硬的岩石，重建石质鳞片。暴走时，会如陨石般俯冲砸地。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME shred through entire mountains looking for the toughest rocks to rebuild their rock-like scales. In a rampage, they will divebomb into the ground with the force of a meteorite.

entry: POKENAME常用幻象，让石甲看起来像宝石或亮金属。据说，凝视尾端宝石，能看见理想中的自己。
author: sivanandi
source: POKENAME often use illusions to make their rocky armor look like gems or polished metal. It is said that staring into the gem on its tail will show you a vision of your ideal self.

entry: POKENAME偏爱海底火山喷口，很少接近表层。一旦现身，或许就是洪水来临的预兆。
author: KitArchen
source: It is rare to see POKENAME near the surface as they prefer to reside near underwater volcanic vents. If seen, it could be an early sign of a flood coming.
