entry: POKENAME日复一日，细心拆取、碾碎并重塑栖居的山。人们认为，它想将群山化作宏大的神殿，献给早已消逝的文明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully remove, crush and reshape parts of the mountains they reside in over time. It is thought that they are attempting to turn these mountains into vast temples for a civilization that no longer exists.

entry: POKENAME身上的尖刺，由软玉构成。它用坚实的身体凿开洞穴，吃下里面的矿物，帮助POKENAME的尖刺生长。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spines along a POKENAME's body are composed of nephrite jade. POKENAME will use their sturdy bodies to carve out spots to burrow within caves, eating the minerals inside to help grow their spines.

entry: POKENAME浮在浅水，用带电触手麻痹猎物。大风暴后，海滩上常能见到成群POKENAME被冲上岸。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in shallow waters, using its electrified tentacles to paralyze its prey. Schools of POKENAME can be seen washed up on the beach after large storms.

entry: 石质外皮让它在古代几乎无敌，占下大片领地。唯一弱点是颈部的一小块，那里的石皮最脆。
author: sk372
source: Its rocky exterior made it near invulnerable in the ancient world, helping it claim large amounts of territory for itself. Its only weak spot is a small area on the neck where its stone skin is least durable.

entry: 不顾山中宝可梦安危、贸然钻山开隧道时，据说POKENAME便会出现。它会向不尊重山中住民的人，施以可怕报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear in mountains being drilled or tunneled with no regards to the Pokémon dwelling within. It enacts a terrible vengeance on those who do not respect the mountain's inhabitants.

entry: 超能力与健壮身体，让它能接住冲击，再反送回去。非凡的记忆力，也使它成为无可匹敌的地下向导。
author: mistershaokahn
source: Its psychic abilities and robust body enable it to absorb shocks and send them back. Its massive memory makes it also an unparalleled underground guide.

entry: POKENAME被送进太空后，便会变成这副形态。POKENAME身上形成的行星，似乎可以居住。
author: Rkmaster25367
source: When POKENAME is propelled into space, it assumes this form. The planet formed on POKENAME's body appears habitable.

entry: 巨石身体与三个头虽重，POKENAME仍能快得危险。可一旦太快，就可能绊倒，挟巨大破坏力滚撞四周。
author: SonTyp
source: Despite the weight of its boulder-like body and three heads, POKENAME can become dangerously fast. Once it accumulates too much speed, however, it may stumble and roll into its surroundings with devastating force.

entry: 它们在草原挖出精巧的洞穴。干季却可能引起野火，扰乱环境。
author: Schwaus
source: They create elaborate burrows in grasslands. During dry seasons they have been known to disrupt the environment by causing wildfires.

entry: POKENAME以臂与头上的火焰自卫，在敌人眼前晃动，分散注意。
author: Glacierwing
source: POKENAME use the fire growing on their arms and head to defend themselves, flashing it into any attackers' eyes to distract them.

entry: 它喜欢绵延开阔的地带，不断往北走，直到累了。之后POKENAME才会四下觅食，吞下附近土壤与植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: It prefers to live in long stretches of terrain, moving north constantly until it tires. Only then will POKENAME wander around to devour nearby dirt and plant life.

entry: 它常被当作儿童玩具。谁握着缰绳，都能像骑真小马般骑行，但也得先与它建立感情。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Often mistaken for a kids' toy, anyone who holds its reins can ride it like a real pony, but similarly must develop a relationship with it first.

entry: 双翼全由火焰构成，每次振翅都撒下火星。可它控制自如，除非POKENAME有意，否则火星余烬都不会烧伤任何东西。
author: sk372
source: Its wings are composed entirely of flames, spreading sparks with every flap. It has complete control over these flames, so the sparks and embers will not burn anything unless POKENAME wills it.

entry: 有些训练家打起主意，想将POKENAME当驮兽，结合肯泰罗的力量与烈焰马的速度。可往往忘了，前者脾气坏，后者还带着火。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Enterprising Trainers occasionally attempt to use POKENAME as a beast of burden, hoping to combine the strength of a Tauros with the speed of a Rapidash. Unfortunately, they usually overlook Tauros's bad temper and Rapidash's flames.

entry: 循着觅食时挖出、又烧焦的蘑菇，常能追踪POKENAME。这些焦痕标明它最近探索过的地方。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME can often be tracked by the scorched mushrooms it leaves behind, dug up during its search for a meal. These burns mark the territory it has recently explored.

entry: POKENAME腿虽短，长途奔跑却出奇快。在家乡雪地，会留下一道道融雪的路。
author: garret95
source: Though its legs are short, POKENAME is surprisingly fast over long distances. It leaves behind melted paths in the snowy regions it calls home.

entry: 图图犬的本能一来，POKENAME便想用尾巴画画，却忘了尾巴已非带颜料的毛，而是烈焰。多数POKENAME因此常被烫伤。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME often attempts to paint something with its tail when its Smeargle instincts take over. Sadly it forgets that its tail is no longer made of fur and paint, but instead is a scorching hot flame. Most POKENAME suffer constant burns as a result.

entry: 它是隐居的画家，用尾焰烘干颜料。可实在笨拙，事故频频，不是烧画，就是烧自己。常在巨石上练画，含义却无人能解。
author: merclipse
source: A reclusive artist that uses its own tail to dry its paint faster. It is highly accident-prone and clumsy, however, leading it to burn either its own artwork or itself. It practices its work on boulders, yet the meaning behind them remains unclear.

entry: 烈焰旺到盖住全身，迅速熔化家园的雪地，因此它们被视为环境的威胁。
author: garret95
source: Its flames are so intense that they completely cover its body. These creatures are seen as an environmental threat, rapidly melting the snowy landscapes they call home.

entry: 偷猎美味尾巴，让POKENAME失去母亲。它如今挥着母亲的尾巴作武器，保护其他呆呆兽群，免遭同样命运。
author: sk372
source: Orphaned due to Slowpoke Tail poaching, POKENAME wields its mother's tail as a weapon to defend other Slowpoke colonies from suffering a similar fate.

entry: 体内气体会让POKENAME麻木、懒散，却也常被用作医疗程序中优良的麻醉剂。
author: Mistymagius
source: It produces a gas from inside its body that causes POKENAME to become numb and lethargic. The gas is commonly used as an excellent anesthetic for medical procedures.

entry: 任何对象一近领地，它便想冲撞。可POKENAME腿小、上身重，慢得像蜗牛。还没造成伤害就放弃，常连为何要冲也忘了。
author: sk372
source: It charges at anything approaching its territory, but with its small legs and heavy upper body, POKENAME moves at a snail's pace. It gives up long before it does any damage, and often forgets why it tried to charge in the first place.

entry: 奸商曾想靠POKENAME让美味尾巴产量变为三倍，大赚一笔。可POKENAME的尾巴苦得不能吃，算盘就此落空。
author: sk372
source: Unscrupulous sorts once thought POKENAME would be the key to profit by tripling Slowpoke Tail production. However, POKENAME tails were far too bitter to be edible, ruining the plans.

entry: POKENAME的凶脸能吓退闯入者与猎人，脑筋却和呆呆兽同类一样迟钝。游泳时，甚至可能把自己的尾巴当猎物，误伤自己。
author: sk372
source: Its frightening expression scares off intruders and hunters, but POKENAME is as dim-witted as its Slowpoke brethren. While swimming, it may mistake its own tail for prey and accidentally injure itself.

entry: 它懒得很，极少起身活动。就算想动，起身也太慢，等终于站好，早忘了为什么要走。
author: sk372
source: Its lethargic lifestyle means it rarely gets up and moves around for any reason. It takes so long to do so that by the time it is on its feet, it has forgotten the reason it wanted to move in the first place.

entry: POKENAME若能清楚思考、全神贯注，超能力便惊人得很。可清醒时刻极短极少，往往隔上几年，才能展现短短一分钟的潜力。
author: sk372
source: When able to think properly and fully concentrate, POKENAME utilizes incredible psychic power. These moments of clarity are incredibly rare and brief, often going years between minute-long displays of potential.

entry: POKENAME很少愤怒或吃惊。背上若燃火，就表示它终于起了这些难得的情绪。
author: char_latte3412
source: Rarely does one see flames burning on its back, as it signifies emotions of anger or surprise; feelings that do not come easily to POKENAME.

entry: 脸看着傻，性情却爱生气，路过什么就咬什么。毛发闻起来倒是甜甜的。
author: fouguri
source: Despite its goofy face, this fusion has indignant behavior and bites everything passing by. Its fur smells sweet.

entry: POKENAME收集海滩与河岸上被丢弃的宝物。既笨拙又健忘，常弄掉宝物，随后又重新拾到。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME collects discarded treasures on beaches and riverbanks. Clumsy and forgetful, it often drops and finds them anew.

entry: POKENAME大半生都在饱餐后休眠。毒唾液碰到什么都能伤害，借此吓退天敌。
author: Danarchist
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives in a post-meal hibernation. They deter predators by secreting a toxic drool that causes harm to anything that touches it.

entry: POKENAME懒又不聪明，曾被见到不去找食物，反吃自己尾巴。好在肢体能完全再生，不会留下长久的伤害。
author: SonTyp
source: Lazy and not terribly intelligent, POKENAME have been observed trying to eat their own tails instead of gathering food. Since their limbs regenerate fully, there is no lasting damage from this behavior.

entry: POKENAME怨念深重，却想不起怨谁、为何而怨。于是只顾快乐漂游，早把深仇大恨忘得一干二净。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME harbors a deep grudge, but it can't remember against whom or why. As a result, it just floats around happily, blissfully unaware of its forgotten vendetta.

entry: 它把多条尾巴垂进水中钓猎，常能见到POKENAME身上同时挂着好几份收获。
author: Holgast
source: It dangles its many tails into the water to catch prey. It's not uncommon to see a POKENAME with several catches hanging from it.

entry: 几年前，由于旅人岛生长着大量橙橙果，一群POKENAME在那里安了家。进食前，POKENAME会从嘴里吐出柔和的泡泡，将树果彻底洗净。
author: .izik
source: A swarm of POKENAME made its home on Wayfarer Island years ago due to the high quantity of Oran Berries growing there. POKENAME cleans the berries thoroughly with gentle bubbles from its mouth before eating them.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下，露出的毛就像海沫。最年长的记录，有893岁。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME hides underwater, its fur sticking out looks like seafoam. The oldest recorded POKENAME was 893 years old.

entry: POKENAME白鬃由超热蒸汽构成，一碰就会造成二度烫伤。精巧的耳朵，还能感知气压与湿度变化。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME white mane is made of super-hot water vapor that will cause second-degree burns on contact. Its delicate ears are able to sense differences in air pressure and humidity.

entry: 多年在壳里煮水，让蒸汽完全包住POKENAME的耳朵与尾巴。颈边也环着蒸汽，形成鬃毛般的云。
author: lemage22
source: After years of boiling water inside its shell, steam has enveloped POKENAME's ears and tails completely. The steam also surrounds the Pokémon's neck, forming a mane-like cloud.

entry: POKENAME放松时，蓬松颈边会放出热气。据说有疗愈效果，一些水疗馆便用来蒸桑拿。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME feels relaxed, it emits hot steam from its fluffy neck. The steam is said to have therapeutic effects, so some spas use it for their sauna.

entry: POKENAME虚荣得很，用利爪细细梳理光滑的毛与龟壳，常盯着水中倒影，欣赏自己好几个小时。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME is an incredibly vein Pokémon, using its razor-sharp claws to meticulously groom its sleek fur and shell. It often gazes at its reflection in water, admiring its own appearance for hours.

entry: POKENAME一怒，角中就喷出猛烈的污水。水含剧毒，哪怕只碰到皮肤也危险。
author: robbery_666
source: When angered, POKENAME's horn releases a strong torrent of tainted water. This water is horribly poisonous, and can prove dangerous even with simple contact with skin.

entry: 它用黏液团固定敌人的手脚，再挥拳踢腿，接连痛打。
author: themicelegion
source: It pins its opponent's arms and legs down with globs of adhesive fluid. It then beats them down with a barrage of punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME往壳里充气浮海，用尾巴与耳羽作帆。自己力气不够游动，便随风而行。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME floats on the ocean by filling its shell with air. It uses its tail and ear plumes as sails. It lacks enough power to swim on its own, so it follows the winds.

entry: 两个头各有坚固的壳保护。POKENAME一生气，就猛烈头槌四周，连另一个头也不放过。
author: soreile.arc
source: Each head is protected by its own sturdy shell. When a POKENAME gets mad, it violently headbutts anything nearby, including its other head.

entry: 进化后，性子认真了。仍像先前那样，能向壳喷水，在水上弹跳，却只在必要时才用。
author: Frokachu
source: It developed a more serious attitude after evolving. Like its previous form, it can skip along water by shooting water at its shell but does so only when necessary.

entry: 壳里留着大块空腔，可收进尾巴。尾巴如螺旋桨转动，就能将自己推进出去。
author: Frokachu
source: Its shell has a large empty area for its tail to go into. It can launch itself by spinning its tail like a propeller.

entry: POKENAME看着庞大威严，却是最温顺的伙伴之一，也不知道自己长什么样。野生POKENAME甚至曾被水中倒影吓到。
author: sk372
source: Though it appears large and imposing, POKENAME is one of the most docile Pokémon to own, ignorant of its own appearance. Some wild POKENAME have even been seen frightened by their own reflection on water surfaces.

entry: 尾上的大舌贝吸取宿主超能力，变得聪明，甚至超过宿主。如今，它咬住特定神经，强迫身体反应，让战斗更加难缠。
author: sk372
source: The Shellder biting its tail leeched psychic energy from the host, growing more intelligent. Now smarter than the host, it bites specific nerves to force physical responses and make it more formidable in battle.

entry: POKENAME脑活动极低，有时会不慎电到自己，也似乎没察觉耳边有生物在啃咬。
author: Leonian1586
source: POKENAME has very low brain activity, sometimes shocking itself on accident. It doesn't seem to be aware of the creature nibbling on its ear.

entry: POKENAME脑袋空空，却有着非凡的超能力。战斗时，它会把尾巴当鱼雷射出去，再用念力指引方向。
author: TeatedTiten
source: With not a thought in its mind, POKENAME still possesses remarkable psychic energy. As means of attack, POKENAME shoots their tail like a torpedo and directs it using its powers.

entry: 偶尔啃啃甜甜圈般的尾巴，却不真正吃下什么，令博士们想不通它如何获取养分。
author: TeatedTiten
source: It occasionally nibbles on its donut-like tail, though does not consume anything.  Because of this, professors are stumped as to how it gains nutrients.

entry: POKENAME若失去大舌贝，只会留下原本惊人智力的一小部分。即便如此，仍比多数宝可梦聪明得多。
author: Staghorn
source: When a POKENAME loses its Shellder, it retains only a fraction of its great intelligence. Even so, it is far smarter than most other Pokémon.

entry: 它只是好奇，够得着什么都习惯啃一啃。POKENAME连尾上的大舌贝也咬，却不该这样，因为硬壳会磨坏牙。
author: sk372
source: It habitually gnaws on objects within reach, out of nothing more than simple curiosity. POKENAME even gnaws the Shellder on their tail, though this is discouraged as the hard shell damages their teeth.

entry: 尾巴自有意识，会咬POKENAME的尾巴，指挥前进方向。它常吃角金鱼与莲叶童子。
author: Schwaus
source: Its tail has a mind of its own, biting POKENAME's tail to change its direction. It often feasts on Goldeen and Lotad.

entry: 附在下身的大舌贝，极大改善POKENAME的平衡与动作，连科学家也怀疑，究竟谁在指挥谁。游泳的POKENAME曾被误认成人鱼。
author: SonTyp
source: The Shellder attached to a POKENAME's lower body increases its balance and motor skills so drastically that scientists speculate which of the two is actually in charge. Swimming POKENAME have been mistaken for mermaids in the past.

entry: 大舌贝已经融入POKENAME的遗传物质，再也无法脱落。它的意识分散在POKENAME的爪子与尾巴之间。美食家认为，它的尾巴并不好吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shellder has ingrained itself in POKENAME's DNA and can no longer fall off. Its consciousness has split itself between POKENAME's claws and tail. The tail is not considered delicious by connoisseurs.

entry: 视力差，脑筋又不灵，让POKENAME几乎总在迷糊。它们常跌进河，成群顺流漂走。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost always confused, due to its lack of sight and underwhelming intelligence. They will often fall into rivers and groups of POKENAME can be seen floating downstream.

entry: 大舌贝一咬住剑鞘，就迅速进化，将其包围。如今偶尔还咬POKENAME的剑柄，POKENAME却似乎不在意。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When a Shellder bit down on this Pokémon's sheath, it rapidly evolved to encompass it. It now likes to occasionally bite POKENAME's hilt, but POKENAME doesn't seem to mind.

entry: POKENAME能造出水翼飞行，从高空俯冲，用尾上的大舌贝当连枷甩击。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME can generate watery wings that allow it to fly. While high in the sky, it dives and uses the Shellder attached to its tail as a flail.

entry: POKENAME尾焰自有意识，会烧本体，催它活动。本体虽然痛，却依然对战斗没多大兴趣。
author: Mistymagius
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail has a mind of its own, which will try to burn the main body to get it moving. Despite being in a lot of pain, the main body isn't that interested in combat.

entry: 融合究竟给POKENAME什么好处，实在不明。它仍慢又迟钝；即使解除融合，两个个体也看不出从彼此得到明显益处。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is unclear how being fused benefits POKENAME. It is still slow and dull-witted, and, if unfused, both individual Pokémon do not show any substantial signs of having benefited from the other, either.

entry: 巨螯自有意识，狩猎本能强烈。它以颚捉食，再为共同生存，勉强把残渣分给迟钝的宿主。
author: sk372
source: Its oversized claw has a mind of its own, with a strong hunting instinct. It snatches prey in its jaws, then begrudgingly gives the scraps to its dim-witted host, for the sake of their shared survival.

entry: POKENAME以磁铁辨方向，游荡工厂之间，寻找创造自己的设计师——它的“母亲”。
author: abstrusePaladin
source: Using its magnet to navigate, POKENAME wanders factory to factory in search for its "mother", the designer who created it.

entry: 它借身体的磁极相斥踢腿。若没踢好，四肢反会相互吸住，动弹不得。
author: Staghorn
source: It uses its polarized body to throw kicks via magnetic repulsion. If it flubs a kick, its limbs will attract to each other, leaving it helpless.

entry: POKENAME的烟竟然无毒，排出的废物全是天然化学物质。融合体靠核裂变供能，几百年不进食也能维持。
author: silvertotodile
source: POKENAME's smoke is surprisingly non-toxic, as all waste expunged is natural chemicals. Because the fusion is fueled by nuclear fission, it can last for centuries without food.

entry: POKENAME太重，非得靠磁力才飞得起来。幼年POKENAME还没练熟，有时会跌出巢，得小心送回安全处。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are too heavy to fly without magnetic powers. Sometimes, young POKENAME that haven't mastered magnetism are found fallen from their nests and should be carefully returned to safety.

entry: POKENAME靠电磁辐射维持清醒，几乎不需睡，因此常被人寻来守卫或监视。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Subsisting on electromagnetic radiation to keep itself awake, POKENAME requires little sleep. As a result, it is often keenly sought after as a guard or surveillance Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常在电线杆顶筑巢，代谢电磁辐射，瞬间爆发惊人速度。毛发纹样，会随附近电源的波长改变。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME often builds its nest on the top of telephone poles. It metabolizes electromagnetic radiation in order to perform bouts of incredible speed. The patterns on its fur change depending on the wavelength of nearby sources of electricity.

entry: POKENAME爱往城里聚，沿电线筑巢。数量一多，集中磁场就干扰电流，造成城市停电。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME are drawn to urban areas, often nesting along powerlines. Large populations can cause blackouts in cities as the concentrated magnetic fields disrupt the flow of electricity.

entry: 摇尾示警时，两个响节之间会窜起雷电。若警告无效，它便毫不犹豫地甩出闪电，电焦来敌。
author: sk372
source: The two rattles on its tail course lightning between them when it shakes them to warn threats. If its warning goes unheeded, it doesn't hesitate to fling lightning from its tail to fry its attacker.

entry: POKENAME用磁力偷走并囤积遇到的人携带的钥匙。奇怪的是，它的磁力只对钥匙有效，其他金属物品都不会吸附在它身上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses magnetism in order to steal and hoard any keys from any people it comes across. Curiously, its magnetism only affects keys, as no other metallic objects will cling to it.

entry: POKENAME以磁力悬浮，力量却不足以抵御大风，因此仍会被吹走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME levitates using the power of magnetism, but it's not strong enough to keep itself from blowing away on gusty days.

entry: POKENAME以磁爪抓住彼此。空旷田野上，常能看见环成圈的POKENAME，试着产生电力。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME clings to each other using their magnetic claws. Rings of POKENAME can be seen in open fields trying to generate electrical power.

entry: POKENAME的金属毛发收集环境静电，再通过金属触角放出，袭击猎物。
author: themasterswordmaster
source: The metallic fur covering POKENAME's body gathers static electricity from its environment. It releases this electricity through its metal antennae to attack prey.

entry: 这奇特形态的POKENAME似乎吃孩子的尖叫，有人甚至说，孩子的笑声也能养活它。
author: jreposo
source: This strange form of POKENAME appears to feed on the screams of children. Some even claim it can thrive on children's laughter.

entry: 不像许多猴怪融合体，POKENAME并不暴力。它通常只静立不动，以不眨的眼观察其他宝可梦。
author: jreposo
source: Unlike many other Mankey fusions, POKENAME isn't prone to violence. Instead, it usually stands still, observing other Pokémon with its unblinking eye.

entry: 两只小磁怪太靠近，可能会融合成一只。少了第三只居中平衡，两个伙伴几乎什么都谈不拢。
author: .fedoraman
source: When two Magnemite get too close together, they may fuse into a single Pokémon. Without a third to balance them out, this pairing struggles to agree on anything.

entry: 小磁怪聚成三合一磁怪，心智就会合一。可一旦超过三只，阵形对面的个体便无法沟通，行动乱成一团。
author: .fedoraman
source: When Magnemite come together to form a Magneton, their minds become one. With more than three Magnemite conjoining, those on opposite sides of the formation cannot communicate, leading to an uncoordinated mess.

entry: 两侧磁铁看着像实物，其实和头部一样虚幻。恶念深重的人一靠近POKENAME，据说便感到异界的牵引。
author: sk372
source: Though appearing corporeal, the magnets on each side are just as ghostly as the head. It is said that those with malevolent souls will feel an otherworldly tug while near POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在发电厂吸电，还用磁爪收集废金属，拿作剑矛等武器。
author: Mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME gather around power plants to siphon off their electricity. They use their magnetic claws to collect scrap metal to use as a form of weaponry such as swords or spears.

entry: 强烈磁脉冲能扰乱敌人、削弱戒备。它快得让对手以为，竟有三只POKENAME同时来袭。
author: sk372
source: It emanates strong magnetic pulses that can disorient foes and lower their guard. Its attacks come so quickly, opponents believe themselves to be attacked by three POKENAME at once.

entry: 与更多同类焊合后，POKENAME的发电量会增至十倍。如今的电力，足够供一座大楼使用。
author: silvertotodile
source: As POKENAME welds together with more POKENAME, the power it generates is multiplied tenfold. At its current power, it can generate enough electricity to power a large building.

entry: 无数小弹汇聚，便成POKENAME，是堪比多边兽的科学奇迹。不到一小时，就能产出整个地区一年的用电量。科学家仍苦思该如何善用。
author: silvertotodile
source: The result of countless Magnefing coalescing, POKENAME is a scientific marvel on par with Porygon. It can functionally power an entire region's yearly power supply in under an hour. Scientists struggle to figure out how to use this for good.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，建巢高效，能留更多时间育幼。可偏爱用电线做材料，数量多的城市因此大受困扰。
author: Katie
source: With three heads, POKENAME are efficient at constructing dwellings and can devote more time to raising their young. Unfortunately, their preferred building material is electrical wire, causing major issues in cities where they are abundant.

entry: POKENAME的几部分能交换位置。一部分走累，便换另一部分接替。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's multiple bodies can swap places. If one segment gets tired of walking, another will replace it.

entry: POKENAME在各部分之间放电交流。好在地面属性保护着POKENAME，不会因此受伤。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME sends electric shocks between their bodies to communicate. Luckily, POKENAME's ground typing keeps them from getting hurt.

entry: POKENAME的各部分似乎都有独立意识。一个被偏爱照顾，另两个就会不高兴。
author: ohok3441
source: All of POKENAME's bodies appear to have separate consciousnesses. If one receives more care than the others, the other two become upset.

entry: 大舌贝每根角各带正电或负电，可再强的磁铁，也拉不下POKENAME身上的大舌贝。它常茫然盯着不知什么地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each horn of the Shellder has either a positive or a negative charge, but even the strongest magnet can't get the Shellder off of POKENAME. This Pokémon is often seen staring at nothing in particular.

entry: 两只小磁怪经电缆般的尾巴连接，与POKENAME共用意识，因此能默契十足地从三路发出雷击。
author: sk372
source: Twin Magnemite units are attached to it via a cable-like tail. They and POKENAME share a mind, allowing them to make three-pronged lightning attacks in battle with great synchronicity.

entry: POKENAME就像有意识的搭电线，会夹住想充电的东西，再用尾巴从附近物体抽取电力。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: Acting as a sort of sentient jumper cable, POKENAME clamp onto things they want charged and use their tail to drain power from objects nearby.

entry: 野生POKENAME捉弄其他宝可梦的视频，因顽皮天性而在网上走红。不知为何，它们尤其爱拿电属性宝可梦开玩笑。
author: KLGB76
source: Because of their mischievous nature, videos of wild POKENAME pranking other Pokémons became very popular on the internet. For some unknown reason, it seems Electric-type Pokémons are their favourite victims.

entry: 两只倒霉小磁怪黏在磁化剑柄两端。它操纵磁怪，吸引盔甲鸟靠近，再电击、刺穿。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: An unfortunate pair of Magnemite have become stuck to either end of its magnetized hilt. It manipulates them to draw in Skarmory, which it then zaps and skewers.

entry: POKENAME以小磁怪般的拳头，与其他POKENAME比试拳击。拳头最远能伸到20英尺，射程长，很占优势。
author: TeatedTiten
source: Using their Magnemite-like fists, POKENAME engage in boxing matches with other POKENAME. Because they can reach up to 20 feet, they take advantage of their long range.

entry: 小磁性突起如传感器，寻找适合撒孢子的地方。POKENAME聚得太多，还能改变当地磁场。
author: Frokachu
source: The small magnetic protrusions act as sensors that identify good places to spread spores. A high presence of POKENAME can alter magnetic fields in the area.

entry: 它奔过地面，收集空气中的电力，存进背上的云。充足之后，云里便传出滚滚雷声。
author: sk372
source: As it dashes across the land, it gathers ambient electricity in the air to store in the clouds along its back. When fully charged, thunder can be heard rumbling from within these clouds.

entry: 命运作弄，让一个身体成了本该分开的两个三人组合的共同中心。接得不对，力量与协调性都远不如应有的水平。
author: sk372
source: A twist of fate caused one body to become the center of what should have been two trios. Due to the mismatched conjoining, it is nowhere near as strong or coordinated as it should be.

entry: 三只小磁怪合体，能干扰方圆一英里的电子设备。可六只合起，却无法齐心，反而造不成多少破坏。
author: .fedoraman
source: While a conjoining of three Magnemite can hamper electronics within a mile radius, six conjoined Magnemite cannot focus their efforts enough to cause appreciable damage.

entry: 它用磁铁辅助震晕、催眠机械宝可梦。等目标动弹不得，便以磁摆吸取能量。
author: sk372
source: Its magnet it carries is for to assist in stunning and hypnotizing mechanical Pokémon. Once they are incapacitated, it uses the magnetic pendulum to siphon power from its victim.

entry: POKENAME脖子上生长的各种芦苇，能帮助它在沼泽家园里，向其他宝可梦藏起自己珍贵的大葱尾巴。
author: .realthree
source: The various reeds that grow along POKENAME's neck help it hide its precious leek-tail from the other Pokémon in its marsh home.

entry: 它会反复用大葱拍打巢穴周围的地面，将其拍平。这种行为能精确地标出自己的领地。
author: .izik
source: It flattens the ground around its nest by repeatedly smacking it with its leek. This behavior marks its territory with precision.

entry: POKENAME成群躺地，以尾巴模仿草丛窸窣，吓跑小型天敌。
author: Holgast
source: A troop of POKENAME will lie on the ground and use their tails to simulate rustling grass, frightening away small predators.

entry: 大葱覆着黏性物质，能黏住树枝，让它藏身，躲避捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Its leek is coated with a sticky substance, allowing it to cling to tree branches. This adhesion helps it stay hidden from predators.

entry: 看似笨拙，却在沙滩上行动飞快。多出来的腿，让它灵巧避开障碍。
author: .izik
source: Despite its awkward appearance, it moves swiftly across sandy beaches. Its extra legs help it nimbly avoid obstacles.

entry: POKENAME尾巴捆里最多能携带10种植物茎秆。每根都有多种用途，它们对此收藏十分自豪。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME can carry up to 10 different plant stalks in its tail bundle. They take pride in their collection of stalks, each suited for several uses.

entry: 即使是宝可梦，也很少能用肉眼看见POKENAME。它会制造小冰柱，再从那根中空的长葱中射向猎物。
author: Shocktopus
source: POKENAME is rarely seen with the naked eye, even by Pokémon. It produces small icicles that it fires at prey from its long, hollow leek.

entry: POKENAME酷似一部被遗忘的儿童节目的主角。用爪围住眼睛，就能看得极远。
author: Shocktopus
source: POKENAME resembles the main character from a forgotten children's show. It can see great distances by cupping its paws around its eyes.

entry: 据说，在POKENAME头顶的盘子里放上一截大葱，会让它十分开心。随后牵起它的手，POKENAME就会带人找到隐藏的宝藏。
author: _kuke_
source: Placing a piece of leek on the plate atop POKENAME's head is said to provoke a joyful reaction. If one takes its hand afterward, POKENAME will lead them to hidden treasure.

entry: 想阻止POKENAME攻击，最快的方法是偷走大葱，塞进它张开的嘴里。大葱太过珍贵，它舍不得咬断，只顾着把大葱取出来，也就无暇追赶。
author: sk372
source: A quick way to foil a POKENAME attack is to steal its leek and jam it in its open mouth. The leek is too precious to break by biting, so POKENAME will be too distracted removing it to give chase.

entry: 大葱分泌毒液，可泼向敌人。毒素会引发抽搐，是危险的战斗武器。
author: .izik
source: Its leek secretes a toxic substance that it splashes onto enemies. The toxin induces convulsions, making it a dangerous weapon in battle.

entry: 它头上的大葱拥有自己的意识，控制着身体周围的沙子。一旦取走大葱，整个身体结构就会崩塌。
author: .izik
source: The leek on its head has its own sentience, controlling the sand around its body. If the leek is removed, the entire structure collapses.

entry: 它替朋友采集蔬菜，嗅出最有营养的，骄傲地奉上，作为贴心礼物。
author: .izik
source: It collects vegetables for its friends, sniffing out the most nutritious options. It proudly presents these finds as thoughtful gifts.

entry: 它摆动身上葱苗般的枝叶，同时放出催眠粉，使粉末撒得更广。
author: .izik
source: It wiggles the onion-like sprigs on its body while releasing Sleep Powder into the air. This motion spreads the powder more effectively.

entry: 它的大葱会发出暗绿色的光，像灯塔一样吸引猎物。随后，它便释放麻痹粉，让目标失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: Its leek glows a dim green, luring prey like a beacon. It then releases Stun Spore to incapacitate its targets.

entry: 它以大葱作超能力导管，将频繁的头痛送进敌人脑中，让对方晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: It channels its frequent headaches into a foe's mind by using its leek as a psychic conduit. This transfer leaves the opponent disoriented.

entry: POKENAME会用意念控制削尖的大葱进行战斗。如果大葱折断，它就会失去继续战斗的所有动力。
author: bobosmith01
source: It battles with a sharpened leek, which POKENAME controls with its mind. If the leek is broken, it loses all motivation to continue battling.

entry: POKENAME很会配合，与善待它的训练家相处融洽。还爱替人叼取东西，仿佛天生就会。
author: Frokachu
source: A very cooperative Pokémon, POKENAME get along well with good Trainers. They love fetching things for others as well, and seem to do so instinctually.

entry: 它想催眠敌人时，腹部螺旋就泛起绿光，一阵阵闪动，效果出奇好。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on its belly glows green and pulsates when it attempts to put foes to sleep. This hypnotic effect is surprisingly effective.

entry: POKENAME的鸟身与植物身，看似独立生物，实际却由群体生物操纵，共用一份意识。究竟怎么做到，仍无人明白。
author: Holgast
source: While they appear to be separate, distinct organisms, both the bird and plant body of POKENAME are one mind, controlled by a colonial organism. It is unknown precisely how they accomplish this.

entry: 像植物的部分，其实是强磁铁。POKENAME到底吃什么，没有人知道。
author: bobosmith01
source: The parts that appear to be plants are actually powerful magnets. No one knows what POKENAME's diet consists of.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的铠甲，换下了大多数大葱鸭拥有的翅膀，抵挡众多天敌。睡觉时，它会紧紧合拢外壳，护住柔软的身体与珍贵的棍杖。
author: Wormspawn
source: POKENAME have traded the wings that most Farfetch'd possess for resilient armor that stymies their many predators. They sleep with their shells clamped shut, protecting their soft bodies and precious sticks.

entry: POKENAME友好又热心，两个头合力解决难题，从未有人见过它们争吵打架。
author: Frokachu
source: Incredibly friendly and helpful, POKENAME will try to solve problems with its two heads. No one has ever seen the heads disagree or fight with one another.

entry: POKENAME的短腿擅抓不稳的枝条。它们沿树梢奔行，追捕爱吃枯死衰木的虫属性宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's short legs are good for holding onto unstable branches. They run along treetops, chasing the Bug-type Pokémon that like to feed off of dead or dying trees.

entry: POKENAME只有一个头，却有两颗心。它跑得轻松又快，以毒刺蹭伤逃跑的草属性宝可梦，再等对方倒下。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite only having one head, POKENAME has two hearts. It can easily run at high speeds, rub their poisonous spines up against Grass-type Pokémon trying to escape, and wait for them to collapse.

entry: 它混入树间，羽毛垂如枯叶。虫宝可梦一近，就用两根坚实剑柄之一，狠狠敲打。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Blending in with the trees, it dangles its feathers like dead leaves. When bug Pokémon approach, it whacks them with one of its two hardy handles.

entry: POKENAME能跳出惊人距离。两个头一起缩进壳里，便能喷出寒息，冻实整座湖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can jump surprisingly long distances. When both heads tuck into the shell, they can exhale freezing breath that can turn lakes solid.

entry: 羽毛蓬松，长大后更显丰厚。POKENAME以长喙防身狩猎，偏爱小型虫属性宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their feathers are quite fluffy, and only get more voluminous as they grow. POKENAME defend themselves and hunt prey with their long beak; they have a preferred diet of small Bug-types.

entry: 古遗迹的象形文字，描绘着酷似POKENAME的生物。已解读的部分称，它们负责将邪恶灵魂拖往死后的世界。
author: sk372
source: Hieroglyphs in ancient ruins depict creautres very reminiscent of POKENAME. What has been translated of them thus far refer to them as beings tasked with dragging wicked souls to the afterlife.

entry: 描绘POKENAME的古代图像，比基因之楔的发明还早。它能发出响亮怒吼，却更爱用小画拼成近似文字的排列，彼此交流。
author: SonTyp
source: Ancient depictions of POKENAME predate the invention of DNA splicers. It's capable of loud, angry noises, but prefers to communicate via small paintings it assembles in a way that resembles writing.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有时会缠住另两个头，让它惊慌奔跑，边跑边放电。为三个头供能的器官更大，这阵闹腾便能持续数小时。
author: thatdanguy23
source: Sometimes, the tail of a POKENAME can get entangled with the two secondary heads - this causes it to run about in a panic, discharging electricity as it goes. Because it has larger organs to sustain three heads, these outbursts can last for hours.

entry: 融合后，有些POKENAME过于不稳定，物质世界只留得下极少粒子。意识虽分裂，运作却完好。
author: entomoxie
source: Upon fusion, some POKENAME becomes too unstable for all but a few particles to remain in the physical realm. Their minds, while split, function perfectly.

entry: 大部分血流向四个头，让身体脆弱、动弹不得。可头部出击，却迅猛得可怕。
author: slowforest
source: Most of its blood flows to its four heads, leaving its body immobile and fragile. The heads strike with terrifying power and speed.

entry: 三个面具各描绘生前为人时的一面：一个是身体的脸，一个是心智的脸，最后一个是灵魂的脸。
author: sk372
source: The three masks it holds each depict an aspect of its former life as a human. One depicts the face of the body, another the face of the mind, and the last the face of the soul.

entry: 它在空中慢慢浮行。发现猎物，三颈便伸到平常近两倍长，以喙捉住。奇怪的是，接着POKENAME却用硬壳上的喙吞食。
author: bobosmith01
source: It slowly levitates in the sky. When it spots prey, its three necks stretch out to nearly double their usual length and nab prey with their beaks. Oddly, POKENAME will then use the beak on its hard shell to devour them.

entry: POKENAME与蘑菇互利共生。蘑菇分散天敌注意，换取养分。
author: .realthree
source: The symbiotic relationship between POKENAME and its mushrooms is mutualistic: The mushrooms distract predators in exchange for nutrients.

entry: 它为战斗而生，多数时候却只和自己打。若忽见它和平停战，就得治疗，可能已经命不久矣。
author: cyprexx
source: This Pokémon lives to fight, though it mostly fights itself. If seen not fighting and at peace, it requires therapy, as it may not have long to live.

entry: 有时，其他宝可梦钻进隆隆石进化后留下的壳避难，便形成POKENAME这样的融合体。
author: bee4082
source: Sometimes Pokémon will take shelter in the shells that Graveler leave behind after evolution, which results in fusions like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME同时挥舞多个摆锤，催眠力极强。可施术时偶尔也催眠了自己的几个头，结果乱成一团。
author: sk372
source: Wielding multiple pendulums simultaneously, POKENAME has massive levels of hypnotic strength. Unfortunately, during hypnosis, it can occasionally hypnotize some of its own heads, leading to chaos.

entry: POKENAME腿虽短，趴着肚子滑冰却很快。游水时浮在表面，如一座小冰山。
author: milchik
source: Despite having very short legs, POKENAME can achieve greater speed on ice by sliding on its belly. When swimming, it floats on the water surface akin to a small iceberg.

entry: 极软的羽毛，让POKENAME在极地水中也很暖。小角摸着冰冷，可用来驱退天敌。
author: Mistymagius
source: Its incredibly soft feathers keep POKENAME warm while swimming in arctic waters. Its small horn is cold to the touch, which it uses to deter predators.

entry: 它偏爱寒地。训练家可摸鼻子检查健康：若不冰凉，就该立刻送往宝可梦中心。
author: MelodyDeLune
source: It prefers colder climates. Trainers should check its health to see if its nose is cold; if not, it should be brought to a Pokémon Center immediately.

entry: POKENAME潜在海边浅水，只让眼睛露在沙上。猎物游近，就以强颚向上猛扑，试着拖进洞穴。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME lurks in the shallows of the ocean, keeping just its eyes above the sand. When prey swims close enough, they launch upward with their powerful jaws and attempt to drag it into their burrows.

entry: 平时安静，开战却会凶狠。它会飞，也善泳，POKENAME用额角劈开海浪，在水下捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: It usually has a calm nature, but when it fights it becomes aggressive. Although this Pokémon can fly, it is also a skilled swimmer. POKENAME uses the horn on its forehead to cut through the waves of the sea, and to hunt prey underwater.

entry: POKENAME体表液体留着它曾经过的每处水源的样本，科学家能据此追溯出生后的行踪。年纪渐长，水会变得滚烫，或极寒。
author: sautomagically
source: The liquid on its body contains samples of every water source a POKENAME has ever been in, allowing scientists to trace its movements since it hatched. As a POKENAME grows older, this water becomes either boiling hot or ice cold.

entry: 它懒散慢吞，爱躺在凉爽岸边。非得饿极，才有动力外出狩猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: A lazy and slow-moving Pokémon that prefers to rest on cool shorelines. It only hunts when it becomes very hungry, and thus, motivated.

entry: POKENAME既吃电，又吃肥鱼，食谱奇特，因此常聚渔镇。快乐的齐声吠叫，游客喜欢，当地居民却烦透了。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have an unusual diet of both electricity and fatty fish, so they tend to gather at fishing towns. Their chorus of joyous yelping tend to be beloved by tourists and be reviled by the local populace.

entry: 成群POKENAME攀住沉没的货轮，借残骸庇护，躲避更大的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Schools of POKENAME cling to sunken freighters, using the wrecks for shelter. These underwater havens offer protection from larger predators.

entry: 游过时，身后留下一路晶亮的冰晶，闪烁水中，吸引朋友与好奇的旁观者。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, it leaves a trail of sparkling ice crystals that shimmer in the water. This beautiful path attracts both friends and curious onlookers.

entry: 鳞片尝起来像姜黄，深受厨师欢迎。这奇特风味，让它成为罕有的佳肴。
author: .izik
source: The scales on its body taste like turmeric, making it popular among chefs. This culinary curiosity has made it a rare delicacy.

entry: 它吹出迷人曲调，骗水手驶入险水。无数船只因此迷航，许多传说都警告人们别信这歌。
author: .izik
source: It whistles an alluring tune that tricks sailors into navigating dangerous waters. Many legends warn of this song, which has led countless ships astray.

entry: 兴奋时，鳍会大放光明，照亮周围水域，引来附近宝可梦的注意。
author: .izik
source: When excited its fins glow brightly, lighting up the surrounding water. This shimmering display attracts attention from nearby Pokémon.

entry: 光滑的流线身体减小水阻，让它游得惊人地快，既难追上，也难从它手中逃走。
author: .izik
source: Its smooth body reduces water resistance, allowing it to swim at incredible speeds. This streamlined physique makes it difficult to catch or outrun.

entry: 它轻松穿过猛烈漩涡，不受吸力影响。在险急的水流里，力量无人能及。
author: .izik
source: With ease, it swims through powerful whirlpools, unaffected by their pull. Its strength in turbulent waters is unmatched.

entry: POKENAME美丽的纹样与配色，近来成了时尚界的新宠。富人间甚至流行办整场以它为主题的秀。
author: Rakunk
source: POKENAME has recently become a large icon in the fashion world for its beautiful patterns and coloring. Entire shows dedicated to this Pokémon have recently become trendy among the wealthy.

entry: POKENAME头羽冰寒，深受收藏家觊觎。颜色越深，越被视为珍贵。
author: .izik
source: The feather on POKENAME's head is cold as ice, and is coveted by collectors. The darker the feather becomes, the more valuable it is considered.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，用鳍挖进雪中，与同伴捉迷藏。
author: Rhysanthemum
source: POKENAME are incredibly playful. They can be found playing hide and seek with others by burrowing into the snow with their flippers.

entry: 浓密毛发让它承受最酷寒的环境。察觉危险，POKENAME便用大耳遮脸，装成一大堆雪。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's thick fur allows it to survive even in the coldest environments. If it senses a danger nearby, POKENAME hides by covering its face with its big ears, making itself look like a big pile of snow.

entry: 角是身体最冷的地方，连暖地也保持冰寒，碰到什么就能使其冷却。
author: .izik
source: The coldest part of its body is its horn, which remains icy even in warm climates. This frozen horn can chill anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME的歌声传遍冻原，迷惑猎物靠近。速度与力量足以压倒猎物，也能击败竞争者。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME's songs can be heard all across the tundra, enchanting its prey to move closer. Its speed and power are more than enough to overwhelm its prey, as well as its competition.

entry: 它放出恶臭雾团，扰乱敌人。气味久久不散，让追兵不愿再跟。
author: .izik
source: It expels clouds of foul-smelling fog to confuse enemies. This stench lingers, discouraging pursuers from following.

entry: 厚毛能抵挡最极端的气候。性情开朗，护主时却凶猛无比。
author: bostroms
source: Its thick fur protects it in even the most extreme climates.  It is jovial in temperament but ferocious when defending its Trainer.

entry: 厚毛下藏着纯冰铠甲。POKENAME看似柔软好捏，有这内层防护，直接打击却鲜少能伤到它。
author: typhloquil
source: Underneath its thick fur coat is armor made of pure ice. It may look soft and squishy, but direct blows to POKENAME rarely harm it thanks to its undercoat.

entry: 尾边空气始终冰冷，沿途留下霜迹。其他宝可梦很喜欢这清爽寒意。
author: .izik
source: The air around its tail is always frigid, leaving a frosty trail behind. Other Pokémon enjoy the refreshing cold it radiates.

entry: 相似的外貌，让科学家推测POKENAME与浩大鲸是远亲。它看着可爱友善，领地意识却很强，会不惜代价保护族群。
author: milchik
source: Scientists believe that POKENAME is distantly related to Cetitan due to their similarities. Despite its cute and friendly appearance, this Pokémon is very territorial and will protect its herd from invaders no matter the cost.

entry: 尾巴强壮，轻易就能推动身体穿过水流，必要时也能击退来敌。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is incredibly strong, capable of propelling it through currents effortlessly. It also uses its tail to defend against attackers when needed.

entry: 它在冰洞装成冰柱静候。猎物不知情地走过下方，POKENAME就落到对方身上。
author: kittyluv090
source: It waits in icy caverns, disguised as an icicle. When unsuspecting prey walk underneath, POKENAME drops itself on top of them.

entry: 它不肯喝温水，只选最冰冷的水源。厌热，是性情中鲜明的一面。
author: .izik
source: It refuses to drink warm water, preferring only the coldest sources. Its aversion to warmth is a defining trait of its personality.

entry: 它通常温顺，爱将大身体搁在冰凉表面休息。可受威胁时，POKENAME能跑得出奇快，巨牙刺入敌人，注进烈毒。
author: octability
source: This typically docile Pokémon loves to rest its large body on cold, icy surfaces. When threatened, POKENAME can run at deceptively fast speeds and sink its large fangs into its foe, administering a powerful venom.

entry: POKENAME在陆上行走，头鳍放出凛冽寒气，连暖地也能待得舒服。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME walks on land, the fin on its head radiates a chilling cold. This icy presence allows it to stay comfortable even in warmer climates.

entry: 阴森一声嚎叫，就能唤来猛烈冰雹。改变天气的本领，让它在冬季格外难惹。
author: .izik
source: With a haunting howl, it can summon a fierce hailstorm. This weather-changing ability makes it a force to be reckoned with during winter.

entry: 它深居水下冰洞，与外界隔绝。僻静的洞穴既能庇护，也能让它独处。
author: .izik
source: It lives deep within submerged, icy caves, hidden from the outside world. These secluded caverns provide it with both shelter and solitude.

entry: 水手从前远航前，会纹上它的形象，祈求好运。某些海边聚落，至今保留这传统。
author: .izik
source: Sailors once got tattoos of this Pokémon before embarking on long journeys, believing it would bring them good luck. This tradition persists among some maritime communities to this day.

entry: POKENAME受伤，只需让身体接触雪，便能自愈。再生本领让它很适合冰寒环境。
author: .izik
source: If injured, POKENAME can heal by exposing its body to snow. This regenerative ability makes it thrive in icy environments.

entry: 它向朋友淘气地喷冷水，以冰凉的水花示好。虽然冷，伙伴们却都玩得开心。
author: .izik
source: It playfully spits cold water at its friends, showing affection through these chilly splashes. Despite the cold, its companions enjoy these friendly interactions.

entry: 热时将热能存进体内，到酷寒地区再拿来保暖。若存得过多，POKENAME就跳起高难又迷人的舞，释放能量。
author: Hello_I_Exist
source: It stores thermal energy in its body when its hot, then uses that energy to keep itself warm in freezing-cold areas. However, if it stores too much energy, POKENAME will release it by performing difficult yet mesmerizing dances.

entry: 它将超能力导进角，再一阵阵放出。强劲的攻击让敌人震晕迷乱。
author: .izik
source: It channels psychic energy into its horn before releasing it in bursts. This powerful attack leaves foes stunned and disoriented.

entry: 头部不断散出庞大超能力。为免脑过热，它以体表静脉散热，维持温度。
author: mx_wellman
source: Its immense psychic power can be felt radiating from its head. To keep its brain from overheating, it has external veins that serve to cool off and stabilize its temperature.

entry: POKENAME周身的大鳍，其实由数万亿根半透明触手组成，精巧的结构让它在水里优雅游动。
author: .izik
source: The large fin around POKENAME's body is actually made up of trillions of translucent tentacles. These delicate structures allow it to move gracefully through the water.

entry: POKENAME尾巴肥厚香甜，入口即化。可它游泳离不开尾，长回来又比呆呆兽慢，因此禁止割取。
author: bobosmith01
source: The blubbery and sweet tail of POKENAME is a melt-in-your-mouth delicacy. However, as POKENAME needs it to swim, it takes even longer to grow back compared to Slowpoke, so cutting it off is illegal.

entry: 离群就会寂寞，因此更爱结群游泳。长途行进中，同伴能给它安慰与陪伴。
author: .izik
source: It becomes lonely when separated from its pod, preferring to swim in groups. These pods provide comfort and companionship during long journeys.

entry: POKENAME合壳的力道极强，轻易就能夹断肢体。这危险本领，让野外其他生物既敬又畏。
author: .izik
source: The clamp of POKENAME's shell is powerful enough to sever limbs with ease. This dangerous trait makes it both feared and respected in the wild.

entry: 它顺时针旋转着游，以角作钻，清掉挡路的障碍，轻易穿过冰冷水域。
author: .izik
source: It swims in a clockwise spin, using its horn as a drill to clear any obstacles in its path. This unique motion allows it to navigate icy waters with ease.

entry: 融合尚未被发现时，人们以为POKENAME是逃过臭泥吞食的霹雳电球，却从此被毒泥永久污染。
author: sk372
source: Before fusion was discovered, POKENAME were thought to be Voltorb that survived attempted consumption by Grimer, but were left permanently tainted by the poison sludge as a result.

entry: 一窝蛋中，有一颗变毒，内容物从壳里渗出。超能力让它即使流散，也仍能活动，可样子常把同窝伙伴吓乱。
author: sk372
source: One egg within a clutch has become toxic, leaking from its shell. Its psychic powers let it remain functioning despite spilling out, though its appearance causes disarray amongst its clutch-mates.

entry: 吃下的污物将舌头染了色。它舔过东西后，唾液留下的气味几乎洗不干净。
author: sk372
source: Its tongue has been colored by all the filth it devours. The smell left behind from its saliva after it licks something is almost impossible to remove completely.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: Katie
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME常被嘲笑为“比丑丑鱼还丑”，可喜欢它的人，竟比想象中多得多。人们说，这古怪的模样，自有一份奇妙的魅力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have been largely derided as being "even uglier than a Feebas," but despite those claims, a surprising number of people are endeared to it, citing it as having a strange charm to its odd appearance.

entry: 它学着百变怪的模样，想讨训练家和宝可梦欢心。可不论怎样表现、变成什么样子，POKENAME都掩不住那股令人退避三舍的恶臭。
author: sk372
source: It tries to emulate Ditto to endear itself to Trainers and Pokémon. No matter its actions or what form it takes, POKENAME can never hide the foul, repellent stench it emits.

entry: 伊布的遗传物质过于不稳定时，身体就会融化。与臭泥融合后，它可以彻底接受自己的黏稠形态，以不再受欢迎为代价，避免悲剧发生。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: An Eevee whose DNA becomes too unstable is subject to melting. Fusing with a Grimer allows it to prevent a tragedy by fully embracing its viscosity at the cost of its popularity.

entry: 饲养、接触POKENAME都得格外小心。它亲昵玩闹时咬出的伤口极易感染，哪怕只被咬一口，若不处理，轻则恶心头晕一整周。
author: sk372
source: Great care must be taken when raising and handling POKENAME. Its playful bites of affection are highly prone to infection; a single untreated bite could lead to a week of nausea and dizziness at the least.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于一片遭非法倾倒有毒废物的森林。它以枯树腐烂留下的碎屑和某些气味浓烈的真菌为食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was first discovered in a forest where illegal toxic waste dumping occurred. It feeds on detritus left behind by dead rotting trees as well as certain pungent fungi.

entry: 它黏软的身体连最细小的缝隙也能钻过，悄悄溜进人家。若屋里一夜之间泛起刺鼻气味，就说明POKENAME已经入侵。
author: sk372
source: It oozes its way into people's homes by sliding through even the tiniest of gaps. If a pungent smell starts infesting a home overnight, a POKENAME infestation has begun.

entry: POKENAME栖居肮脏的泥水，以池塘浮渣和废弃垃圾为食。它爱把心爱的臭水泼向路人，与对方“分享”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in muddy, filthy waters, nourishing itself with pond scum and discarded trash. It enjoys "sharing" its beloved stinky water by splashing those who pass by.

entry: POKENAME会和破破袋助手一起打理下水道，刷去污垢，将废物打包。城里的居民忍受它臭烘烘的礼物，换来了格外干净的管道。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME tidies up sewer systems, scrubbing grime and packaging waste with its Trubbish assistant. The residents of its home city endure its smelly gifts in exchange for exceptionally clean pipes.

entry: POKENAME会成群配合，骚扰环卫工人，偷走垃圾袋，吃掉里面腐烂的东西。有些地方甚至见过它们骚扰、捕猎破破袋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs harass garbage workers in tandem in order to steal bags of trash and eat the rotten contents. They have even been seen harassing and hunting Trubbish in some areas.

entry: 据说，一只魔尼尼掉进毒泥坑后没有死去，反而与污泥融合，变成了POKENAME。
author: robbery_666
source: It is said that POKENAME was created when a Mime Jr. fell into a pit of toxic sludge. Instead of dying, it fused with it, creating this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的有毒生物，走到哪儿都漏着黏液。大嘴让它能轻易朝猎物喷射腐蚀性酸液。
author: Shado_.w
source: POKENAME is a horrid poisonous being that leaks goop wherever it goes. Its big mouth allows it to shoot corrosive acid at prey easily.

entry: POKENAME称霸沼泽湿地，常把陆地化为沼泽，扩张领地。胸前的凹槽能嵌入属性石板。
author: iolitetigerdragon
source: POKENAME rule over swamps and bogs, often expanding their territory by turning land into marsh. They can hold an elemental plate in a slot on their chests.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时缩在钢盔里。一察觉危险，便朝它认定的威胁射出裹着毒泥的钢刺。
author: robbery_666
source: POKENAME hide in their steel helmets while they sleep. When they sense danger, they will fire steel spikes coated in toxic sludge at the perceived threat.

entry: POKENAME从垃圾污物间拾起遗失或丢弃的钥匙，寻找旧主归还。可钥匙早已沾满它的恶臭，找到的人往往不肯收下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects lost or discarded keys amongst garbage and filth and seeks out their former owners to return them. Due to its stench permeating on the keys it collects, those it finds are reluctant to take their keys back.

entry: POKENAME梦想成为深海中的美丽长蛇。可它无法在清水中存活，注定只能栖居沼泽。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME dreams of being a beautiful serpent deep in the sea. Unfortunately it is condemned to live in swamps only as it cannot survive in clean waters.

entry: POKENAME毫无恶意，只想帮忙，却成了工厂的麻烦。它钻进机械，试图替换齿轮，结果把机器弄得一团糟。
author: sk372
source: Though it means no harm and only wishes to help, POKENAME has become a problem in factories by working its way into machinery, attempting to replace cogs and mucking up machines.

entry: POKENAME体表有一层腐蚀性极强的保护膜。据说，触摸它能传递思想；可鲜有人能忍受足够久的接触，验证这个说法。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is covered in an incredibly caustic protective membrane. Interestingly, it is thought that POKENAME's membrane is capable of transmitting thoughts when touched, but few have been able to withstand contact long enough to test the theory.

entry: 它疯狂繁殖，可能短短几天就污染大片陆地或海域。多只POKENAME聚在一起时，意念会形成强大的超能力场。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It multiplies uncontrollably, threatening to pollute vast stretches of land or sea in mere days. When multiple POKENAME are together their minds create a powerful psychic field.

entry: 几片扁平的身体由浓稠毒液黏在一起。POKENAME虽看着像煎饼，可千万别吃。
author: Tad
source: Its body is composed of several flat segments joined together by a thick, toxic goo. Though POKENAME looks like pancakes, eating it is not advised.

entry: POKENAME由多种污染物构成，会像出汗一样将其排出，留得四处都是。它靠这些污物标记领地，可有些POKENAME偏偏喜欢这黏液的气味与滋味。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are comprised of multiple kinds of pollutants which they sweat out and leave everywhere. These pollutants can be used to mark territory, though some other POKENAME might like the odor and flavor of this ooze.

entry: POKENAME常出现在遭化工厂污染的海滩。据说，那里很久以前堆起的沙堡留下了孤独的灵魂，最终化作POKENAME。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME often appears in locations where beaches have been spoiled by chemical plants. Some say POKENAME is born from the lonely spirits of sandcastles made long ago on those beaches.

entry: 它爱收集垃圾堆和脏角落里的污秽硬币。若碰上光洁如新的零钱，就立刻弄脏，才肯收入收藏。
author: sk372
source: It loves to collect filthy coins scattered amongst garbage and other dirty corners. If it comes across shiny pristine change, it promptly goes about dirtying it so that it can properly join its collection.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾和污泥来缓解头痛。可一顿吃太多，头痛反而加重，身体也会散成一摊毒液，直到康复才恢复原形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes garbage and sludge to soothe its aching head. If it eats too much in one sitting, however, its headache will worsen and it will lose its solid shape, becoming a toxic puddle until it recovers.

entry: POKENAME生于毒泥与工业废水，对人类充满敌意。研究者发现，孕育它们的污泥毒性越强，它们就越快发动攻击。
author: Katie
source: Born of toxic sludge and industrial discharge, POKENAME are aggressive and hostile toward humans. Researchers have observed that the more poisonous the sludge they arise from, the quicker they are to attack.

entry: POKENAME友善忠诚，却因有害的臭气而难觅主人。垃圾场常把它收作吉祥物，也方便喂它最爱的臭垃圾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very friendly and loyal pet, but its noxious aroma makes it difficult to find an owner. Garbage dumps often adopt it as a mascot and to easily feed it its favorite meal of stinky trash.

entry: 人们投入大量POKENAME清理海上漏油。它们成群聚在泄漏处吸食油污，连其他宝可梦身上沾的油也能清除。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have been deployed in large numbers to clean oil spills at sea. They swarm the spill en masse, absorbing and consuming the oil, even removing it from other Pokémon that may have been coated by the spill.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，乐于在人类的垃圾堆间寻找食物与陪伴。它总想亲昵地依偎别人，却似乎没发现，多数对象都被恶臭熏跑了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a friendly nature, content to linger among human garbage to seek food and companionship. It seems unaware of its repugnant smell repelling most it tries to cuddle up to.

entry: POKENAME以有毒的碱性液体涂身，抵御捕食者。不过，它会避开磁性附肢，以免干扰磁性。
author: Frokachu
source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a toxic, alkaline fluid to ward off predators. They keep this fluid away from their magnetic appendages, however, so that their magnetic properties aren't disturbed.

entry: 难免排放污水的工厂很欢迎POKENAME。它对人类格外友善，也会兴冲冲地将有毒废水吃得一滴不剩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are actually a welcome sight for factories where polluted runoff is inevitable. They consume every drop of the toxic waste eagerly and are remarkably friendly to humans.

entry: 它对垃圾与污染物的胃口无穷无尽，飞快吞下，再化作阵阵气体排出。有些POKENAME甚至会试着吸回自己排出的气体，重新吃掉。
author: sk372
source: Its appetite for garbage and pollution is endless, devouring it all quickly and processing it in bursts of gas around it. Some POKENAME have even been seen attempting to inhale and consume their own gaseous expulsions.

entry: 工厂的有毒废水污染了鲤鱼王栖居的池塘，孕育出POKENAME。它们虽看似畸形多病，实际却比普通鲤鱼王更强壮、更耐折腾。
author: sk372
source: Toxic runoff from factories polluting ponds where Magikarp reside resulted in the creation of POKENAME. Though they look deformed and ill, they are actually stronger and more hardy than the average Magikarp.

entry: 重污染工厂里的拉达泛滥，催生了POKENAME。它靠形状不定的身体轻易潜入建筑，不停啃咬一切靠近那张淌着黏液的大嘴的东西。
author: sk372
source: A result of Raticate infestations within highly polluting factories, POKENAME will use its amorphous body to more easily infiltrate buildings, gnawing endlessly on anything that comes close to its oozing maw.

entry: POKENAME一边用嘴吃垃圾，一边让尾巴吞下沿途的垃圾。有时同一样东西还会吃上两遍。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME makes its tail gobble up trash they come across, while it also eats trash with its mouth. Sometimes they eat the same thing twice.

entry: 节日期间，POKENAME会巡视排污系统，检查损坏与失修之处。它用条带状黏垢堵住漏口，或以会爆炸的垃圾炸开堵塞。
author: Ozydamians
source: During the holidays, POKENAME inspects the sewage system for damage and neglect. It patches up leaks with ribbons of sticky grime, or clears blockages with explosive garbage.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温暖潮湿的环境，常化作一摊液体伏在丛林中。任何踩进去的东西都会被吞掉。
author: dragonessanimations
source: Preferring a warm and humid environment, POKENAME will sit as a puddle in the jungle. Anything that steps into this puddle will be consumed.

entry: 这只残忍的宝可梦爱把对手埋进毒泥里。相传，下半身那张嘴会低声诉说你的未来。
author: Altius
source: This cruel Pokémon likes to bury its opponents under poisonous mud. According to legend, the mouth on its lower body can whisper your future.

entry: 这种宝可梦会用超能力操纵大量污泥。不同于其他臭臭泥变种，它带着淡淡的棉花糖香；研究者至今没能弄清原因。
author: Cinnamoone_Redfield
source: This Pokémon is commonly known to manipulate large amounts of sludge using its psychic power. Unlike other variants of Muk, this Pokémon smells faintly of cotton candy; researchers have been unable to determine the reason for this.

entry: POKENAME用超能力控制裹住身体的黏液，既能使其硬化为护层，也能分出一部分，赋予生命，化作听命于自己的仆从。
author: Wormspawn
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to control the ooze that envelops its body. It can harden this ooze into a protective coating or even animate some of it into a separate minion to do its bidding.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是这颗星球对人类污染的怒火所化。它甩出的熔融污泥会裹住、侵蚀接触的一切，直至只剩冒泡的毒液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said by some to be a manifestation of the planet's rage against human pollution. The molten muck it flings from its body coats and erodes anything it touches until nothing is left but a bubbling toxic ooze.

entry: POKENAME令人作呕，以中心核的超能力驱动形状不定的身体。传闻喝下它的黏液能知晓宇宙奥秘，可试过的人无一生还。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A sickening creature, POKENAME animates its amorphous body with the psychic power of its central nucleus. There are rumors that ingesting ooze from POKENAME will reveal secrets to the universe, but any who have attempted this have simply perished.

entry: 丑丑鱼栖息地的污染，造就了这只畸形而不幸的宝可梦。POKENAME始终为自己愈发丑陋而愤怒，会攻击任何看见它扭曲外形的对象。
author: sk372
source: Pollution in areas where Feebas live has resulted in this deformed, unfortunate Pokémon. POKENAME lashes out at any who view its misshapen appearance, forever enraged at becoming more hideous.

entry: POKENAME的两张嘴似乎各自进食、消化。多喂上面的嘴，好像会变聪明；多喂下面的嘴，则似乎能变强壮。
author: sk372
source: The two mouths of POKENAME appear to feed and digest separately from each other. Feeding the top mouth more apparently makes it smarter, while feeding the bottom more seems to make it stronger.

entry: 它藏在填埋场等肮脏的污染区，在垃圾中守候。谁若踩中，就会被它抓住，遭到令人麻痹的电击。
author: sk372
source: It hides itself in grimy, filthy areas such as landfills and other polluted areas, laying in wait amongst the refuse. Should something step on it, it grabs hold and delivers paralyzing jolts of electricity.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME长出果实般的突起，引诱猎物。这些突起与黏合身体的黏液一样有毒。
author: Tad
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME develops fruit-like protrusions to attract prey. These protrusions are just as toxic as the goo holding its body together.

entry: POKENAME由冰冷污泥构成，漂浮时，最外层的毒冰不断融化滴落。若冬天积下足够多的污泥，其中就可能诞生臭童子。
author: sk372
source: Composed of icy sludge, POKENAME's outermost layer of toxic ice constantly thaws and drips as it floats around. If enough of the sludge pools during winter, Grirunt may form from within the ooze.

entry: 有人说，最初的POKENAME是一只倒霉的毒刺水母沾上化工废水后变成的。POKENAME是一团翻涌的毒素与触手，每条肢体滴下的黑泥都能在数秒内溶解最坚韧的材料。
author: sk372
source: Some say the first POKENAME was created when chemical runoff spilled onto an unlucky Tentacruel. POKENAME is an undulating mass of toxins and tentacles. The black sludge that drips from each limb can dissolve the toughest material in seconds.

entry: 许多人认为融合尚未完成，可呆呆兽实在迟钝，竟浑然不觉。它懒洋洋地待在污河旁，连自己的模样东拼西凑都不知道，倒也过得自在。
author: sk372
source: Many theorize that the fusion is incomplete, but thanks to Slowpoke's dim mind, it hasn't even noticed. It lazes near polluted rivers, living in blissful ignorance of its own mismatched form.

entry: POKENAME出现在海洋遭大规模污染泄漏的地方，吸收同时诞生的其他臭泥。论程度，唯有它对恶臭垃圾的惊人胃口，能与那股腐臭相提并论。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appeared from scenes of massive pollution spills in the ocean, absorbing other Grimer that formed at the same time. Their putrid odor is matched only by their appetite for the foulest of garbage.

entry: POKENAME嘴里的巨型水炮，靠近十分危险。可炮身太重，POKENAME也瞄不太准。
author: .realthree
source: The gigantic water cannon in POKENAME's mouth is dangerous to approach, but because of its weight, POKENAME can't aim it very well.

entry: 它其实由一只小小的水箭龟操控，靠喷射水流轰击敌人，也借此敏捷移动，身手如战斗机飞行员般娴熟。
author: PokePower
source: It is really controlled by a tiny Blastoise. Using jets of water to bombard foes and move with incredible agility, it's as skilled as a fighter pilot.

entry: 水上乐园里，常能看到POKENAME为孩子们表演。背上的袋子里，藏着各式各样的戏水花招。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME can be seen performing for children at water parks. The sack on its back is filled with all sorts of water-themed party tricks.

entry: POKENAME极力捍卫领地，一发现闯入者就猛冲过去。贴到近前，炮中的高压水流便会将目标轰向天边。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very protective of its territory, charging at any intruders it spies. Once it gets at point-blank range, high-pressure water from its cannons launches its target across the horizon.

entry: 与人们所想的不同，POKENAME喷口射出的其实是滚烫蒸汽。它常用这招烹煮惯常捕食的软体动物宝可梦，数秒就能煮透。
author: lemage22
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME actually fires clouds of boiling steam from its sprouts. It usually uses this ability to cook its usual prey, mollusk Pokémon, boiling them completely in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME将超能力注入炮管，射出受念力驱动的强劲水炮。它也能以意念控水，掀起波浪击倒对手。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its cannons, launching powerful telekinetic water blasts. It can control water with its mind, forming waves to strike down opponents.

entry: 即使高速移动，它也能从背甲上的炮管精准射出水流。军队会用它们代替攻击型无人机。
author: Soup1900
source: It can accurately fire water jets from the cannon on its shell while moving extremely fast. They are utilized in the military in place of attack drones.

entry: POKENAME的炮管在水中如催眠般摇摆，吸引游过的好奇宝可梦。等猎物靠近，便猛射强劲水柱，打个措手不及。
author: CartoonHostage
source: POKENAME's cannons sway hypnotically in the water, drawing the attention of curious Pokémon swimming by. When they get close enough, it blasts its unsuspecting prey with powerful beams of water.

entry: 口中的炮管水力惊人，可POKENAME身体太脆弱，开炮后反而被震得倒飞出去。有些POKENAME索性借此赶路。
author: ImaginaryNeon
source: The cannon in its mouth fires water at exceptional power. However, POKENAME is so frail that it flies backwards afterwards, leading to some POKENAME using it as a means of travel.

entry: POKENAME从背上的小炮管射出带电水流。不过，无论电力还是水压都太弱，只能给对手一点难受的电击。
author: richardcareylol
source: POKENAME shoots electrically charged squirts of water from the pea-shooters on its back. However, the wattage and hydrologic strength of these attacks is so weak, it does little more than give its opponents a little uncomfortable shock.

entry: POKENAME的巨炮能汇聚、发射高浓度的超能力能量。开炮的后坐力极大，常将它自己震飞到空中。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's massive cannon gathers and fires concentrated psychic energy. When fired, the recoil is so immense that it often sends this Pokémon flying through the air.

entry: POKENAME转动身体时，会踢起一道小水墙，力道足以掀倒成年人。水让地面湿滑，也使POKENAME转得更快。
author: Mistymagius
source: As POKENAME spins its body, it kicks up a small wall of water with enough force to topple a fully grown person. The water creates a slippery surface that allows for POKENAME to spin even faster.

entry: POKENAME的战斗常像牛仔对峙般一对一决斗。它时常与章鱼桶结怨。
author: TeatedTiten
source: When POKENAME battle, they usually engage in duels reminiscent of cowboy standoffs. It frequently has feuds with Octillery.

entry: POKENAME追猎时，会借背甲伸出的喷水管跃得更远。虽说动静很大，可一旦快到肉眼难辨，也就无关紧要了。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME uses the waterspouts that protrude from its shell to leap even greater distances while hunting down its prey. This makes it a very loud hunter, but that hardly matters if it reaches speed levels that are invisible to the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME的硬壳其实由干泥组成。它能敲碎壳片，当作弹片高速射出，连壶壶的壳都能打凹。
author: Shocktopus1717
source: The hard material comprising POKENAME's shell is actually dried mud. It can smash pieces of the shell into shrapnel and fire them at speeds that could dent a Shuckle's shell.

entry: POKENAME不仅能改变身体与外壳的颜色，还学会了给水变色。开心时色彩像颜料般鲜亮，紧张时则油腻浑浊。
author: sockedpuppetart
source: In addition to changing the colors of its body and shell, POKENAME has mastered changing the color of its water. When it is happy, the colors are paint-like and vibrant. When it is nervous, the colors are oily and murky.

entry: 研究显示，POKENAME睡觉时，喷口会积蓄水压。它总在打盹，因此有人推测，只要时间够长，POKENAME就能蓄出夷平山岳的威力。
author: atlasmountain
source: Research shows that the jets of POKENAME build up water pressure as they sleep. Due to the constant naps POKENAME takes, it is theorized that with enough time they could grow strong enough to level a mountain.

entry: POKENAME会朝来袭威胁开炮，射出水流和尖石。心理学家发现，它不喜欢自己的蓝色鳞片，因为那会让它想起盖欧卡。
source: POKENAME fires water as well as pointy rocks out of its cannons at incoming threats. Psychologists found out that this Pokémon doesn't like its blue colored scales, because they remind it of Kyogre.

entry: POKENAME目力极佳，炮法也精准，能从几英里高的空中居所狙击目标。据推测，全力射出的水弹，甚至能贯穿整颗星球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has perfect vision and accuracy with its cannons, able to snipe targets from its home miles up in the skies. It's thought that at max power, its water shots could pierce completely through the planet.

entry: 栖居潮湿环境的人造宝可梦。背上的炮管能以极高压力攻击，连钢铁都能轰裂。
author: Spooky Scary Kunoichi
source: An artificial Pokémon which inhabits damp environments. The cannons on its back can attack with such pressure that they crack steel.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便用自身融合的遗传物质造出一队微型船员，负责操炮、装填。POKENAME常跟随船只，保护它们免遭凶暴宝可梦袭击。
author: VibrationJaveline
source: POKENAME, lacking any limbs, creates a miniature crew from its fused genetic material to man and reload its cannons. POKENAME often follow boats, protecting them from more aggressive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME利用压强达每平方英寸200磅的喷水推进，在空中疾驰。据说，如果毫无预兆地下起雨来，就说明附近有POKENAME。
author: Rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME blasts across the sky with its 200-PSI water jets. When it starts raining without warning, it is said that a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME守护着失去亲人或遭遗弃的杰尼龟。它能感知人的内心，只许心地善良的训练家领养自己照管的孩子。
author: gerbopotato
source: POKENAME is a guardian of orphaned or abandoned Squirtle. It can sense the hearts and minds of people, and will only allow kindhearted Trainers to adopt one of its charges.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，尾巴老是把东西点着。接着便用水炮灭火，可通常又喷得太多。
author: Incognito1234
source: A clumsy Pokémon, POKENAME constantly sets fire to things with its tail. It then uses its cannons to put out the fire, usually using too much water.

entry: POKENAME凭惊人的速度与坚如岩石的头骨，连最大的海洋生物也能击倒。许多丰缘水手认为，仙人掌号的惨剧，就是一群POKENAME造成的。
author: mbo1064.
source: POKENAME uses its blistering speed and rock-hard skull to take down even the largest ocean creatures. Many Hoenn sailors believe that a school of POKENAME was responsible for the great tragedy of the S.S. Cactus.

entry: POKENAME炮管射出的水含有一种物质，提纯后能制成强效除草剂。
author: kittyluv090
source: The water from POKENAME's cannons contains a substance that can be extracted and refined to make a potent weed killer.

entry: POKENAME很容易发怒，稍受挑衅便敌意大起，朝惹恼自己的家伙喷出滚烫蒸汽。
author: Incognito1234
source: POKENAME angers easily, becoming hostile at even the slightest provocation. It will then blast the agitator with scalding steam from its cannons.

entry: POKENAME背甲上的炮管，既能喷出强劲火焰，也能射出水流。凭这份多面本领，它们深受林务员与公园巡护员欢迎。
author: theartemis1
source: The cannons on POKENAME's shell are capable of generating intense blasts of both flame and water. This versatility makes them highly popular among foresters and park rangers.

entry: 鳍太小，游不起来，它只好拖着身体沿海底移动。受威胁时，POKENAME就钻进沙里，只露出硬壳。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its fins are too small to swim, so it must drag itself along the ocean floor to move. When threatened, POKENAME will burrow into the sand, leaving only its hard shell exposed.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底，装作一枚空贝壳。猎物游过时，POKENAME那条长得出人意料的舌头便会瞬间将其捉住。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME hides in the seafloor, posing as an empty shell. When prey swims by, it is caught in the blink of an eye by POKENAME's deceptively long tongue.

entry: POKENAME能在贝壳般的花苞里孕育珍珠，每周最多5颗。它极爱护珍珠，谁敢偷，就挥动花苞朝谁打去。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can produce pearls in its shell-like bud, making up to 5 pearls a week. It is very protective of its pearls and will swing its bud at anyone that tries to steal them.

entry: 外壳是一顶轻巧又坚固的头盔。它靠舌头感知气流，在漆黑洞穴中辨路。
author: Staghorn
source: Its shell serves as a lightweight yet durable helmet. It uses its tongue to sense air currents and navigate through dark caves.

entry: 有时，潜水员伸手想取珊瑚礁上的4颗珍珠，却遭到野生POKENAME的袭击。如果经常擦拭它的珍珠，珍珠就会映出观看者最美丽的模样。
author: leonian1586
source: Sometimes divers report reaching for a cluster of 4 pearls on coral reefs, only to be attacked by a wild POKENAME. If its pearls are polished regularly, it reflects the most beautiful version of its beholder.

entry: POKENAME其实不会游泳，只能漫步海底，寻找小型软体动物吃。头上的角带毒，能让受害者浑身发抖。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME can't actually swim, so it wanders the seafloor looking for small mollusks to eat. The horns on its head contain poison, which can cause shivering in its victims.

entry: POKENAME化作有毒烟气，从废弃坟墓中冒出。谁想盗掘这些被遗忘的安息之所，就会被霉腐气息呛得窒息。
author: Ozydamians
source: POKENAME emerge as noxious fumes from abandoned graves. The musty air chokes and suffocates those who seek to pilfer these forgotten resting places.

entry: POKENAME生活在沿海沼泽。一旦翻倒，就用舌头把自己撑回原位。
author: Elite01
source: POKENAME live in swampy areas along the coastline. They use their tongue to reposition themselves if they fall over.

entry: 它用嘴咬住珊瑚，以高压水流击碎吞食。珊瑚中的养分，能让身上的尖刺更加坚固。
author: .izik
source: It latches its mouth onto coral and uses pressurized water to break it apart. The coral it eats contains nutrients it needs to strengthen the spikes on its body.

entry: 很久以前，它们成群伴着雄伟的大帆船游过浩瀚海洋。如今那些船早已不在，它们仍循着古老航线前行。
author: .izik
source: Long ago, its pods swam alongside mighty galleons, navigating vast oceans. Though those ships are gone, it continues to follow ancient sea routes.

entry: 壳太重，难以长途飞行，POKENAME转而成了凶猛的海底猎手。它用翅膀高速游动，从壳中射刺袭击鱼群，大啖被串起的猎物。
author: sk372
source: With a shell too heavy for long flights, POKENAME instead lived as a fierce undersea hunter. Its wings allowed it to swim at high speeds, firing spikes from its shell at schools of fish, feasting on the skewered victims.

entry: 它受声响与动静吸引，跟着油轮横渡海洋。水手常看见它紧贴船身搭便车，还盼着不被发现。
author: .izik
source: It follows tankers across the ocean, drawn to the noise and movement. Sailors often spot it clinging to the hull, riding along, hoping to be unnoticed.

entry: 它喜欢住在灯塔附近，沐浴灯光。水手们将它的到来视为好运的征兆。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to live near lighthouses, where it basks in the glow of the beacon. Its presence is considered a sign of good luck for sailors.

entry: 它靠高压水流倒退前进，流线形外壳让身体轻易破水而行。可惜，始终看不见自己要去的方向。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its streamlined shell allows for it to cut through the water as it propels itself backwards with a stream of pressurized water. Unfortunately, it can't ever see where it's going.

entry: 它在汹涌巨浪中如鱼得水，借强劲水流向前冲。波涛越纷乱，它越觉得自在。
author: .izik
source: It thrives in tidal waves, using the powerful currents to propel itself forward. The chaos of these waves makes it feel most at home.

entry: 它会从嘴和铠甲上的突起喷出灼热蒸汽，攻击敌人。POKENAME独来独往，性情凶暴，平时不愿受打扰，一旦被惹怒，便会战斗不休。
author: Frokachu
source: This Pokémon shoots burning hot steam at enemies from its mouth and the protrusions in its armor. Solitary but violent, POKENAME prefers to be left alone but will fight relentlessly if provoked.

entry: POKENAME靠喷水在水中推进，也会释放蓄积的电力，维持体内平衡。POKENAME排出的多余电能，会让波涛间的生灵归于沉寂。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME uses water propulsion to move among the waters. It releases stored electrical energy to maintain homeostasis. Excess energy discharged from POKENAME ensures stillness among life amid the waves.

entry: 洪水期间，它会迅速穿过淹水区域，援助受困的宝可梦。坚韧的外壳让它能轻松穿行于急流。
author: .izik
source: During floods, it moves swiftly through submerged areas, providing aid to stranded Pokémon. Its resilient shell allows it to traverse fast-moving waters with ease.

entry: 即使交给信任的训练家照顾，它仍爱索求又虚荣。若不定期擦亮那柄珠光钉头锤，它就慢慢吸取训练家的生命力，直到擦得满意为止。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Even in the hands of trusted Trainers, it is needy and vain. If its pearlescent mace isn't polished regularly, it will slowly sap its Trainer's life force until they polish it well.

entry: 它常被游艇吸引，在船旁滑行觅食。豪华船只身边有它相伴，也为宁静水面添了几分野趣。
author: .izik
source: Yachts often attract this Pokémon, where it glides alongside in search of food. Its presence near luxury vessels adds a touch of the wild to tranquil waters.

entry: POKENAME贴近海底漂游，睡着时，珍珠般的头泛着深蓝微光。若受惊扰，就放出强劲的极光束还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts close to the seafloor, its pearl-like head glowing a deep blue as it sleeps. If disturbed, it retaliates by unleashing a powerful Aurora Beam.

entry: 它捡食死去的珊瑚，用强硬的壳将其击碎。这习惯能清理礁面，让新的珊瑚长出来。
author: .izik
source: It scavenges dead coral for food, breaking it apart with its powerful shell. This habit keeps reefs clear, allowing new coral to grow in its place.

entry: 它依附海底峭壁，既当作庇护所，也当作瞭望点，在高处守望下方深水中经过的猎物。
author: .izik
source: It clings to underwater cliffs, using them as both shelter and vantage points. From these heights, it watches for prey passing through the depths below.

entry: 身体能承受部分极深海域的巨大水压，但日晒过多时会迅速灼伤。
author: .izik
source: Its body can withstand the extreme pressure of some of the deepest portions of the sea. Its body can quickly burn if exposed to too much sunlight.

entry: 壳中藏着一颗珍珠，历经多年洋流打磨，价值不菲。寻宝者虽多，真正能将它取走的却寥寥无几。
author: .izik
source: A valuable pearl lies hidden within its shell, polished by years of ocean currents. Many seek it, though few manage to claim the treasure within.

entry: 它在邮轮附近巡游，捡食丢弃的食物残渣。乘客偶尔从甲板瞥见它，总惊叹于那光滑的壳。
author: .izik
source: It patrols near cruise ships, scavenging discarded food and scraps. Passengers sometimes catch glimpses of it from the decks and marvel at its sleek shell.

entry: POKENAME将灵魂系在一枚破裂的蛋上，以力量加固，护住自身。若失去这层庇护，便可能消散。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME tethers its spirit to a broken egg, which it hardens with its powers to protect itself. Without shelter, it risks dissipating.

entry: POKENAME附身于死去已久的独角犀牛遗骸，凭威武的新身体震慑敌人。遭攻击时，石质甲片会散开避击，再重新聚合还击。
author: sk372
source: Possessing a long-deceased Rhyhorn's remains, POKENAME intimidates foes with its imposing new body. If attacked, the stone plates separate to avoid strikes, then reform to counterattack.

entry: 失去孩子的袋兽常因悲伤而死。可在POKENAME身上，亡故的孩子却凭强烈意志留了下来，支撑着母亲。
author: mattyzer0
source: Childless Kangaskhan often die of heartbreak. However, in the case of POKENAME, the deceased child persists by sheer will to support its parent.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵气体为火力添威，却也可能意外酿成危险大火。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME's ethereal gases fuel their firepower. However, they can also lead to unintended and dangerous blazes.

entry: 鬼斯原想附身肯泰罗四处破坏、恶作剧，却让肯泰罗失去了实体。过去破坏力十足的冲撞，如今再也撞不坏财物了。
author: sk372
source: Gastly possessed a Tauros in order to cause damage and mischief. However, their possession has caused the Tauros to become incorporeal, so their once-destructive charges no longer cause actual property damage.

entry: 体周气体燃烧得极为猛烈，肌肤哪怕只碰一下，也会留下严重烫伤。
author: .izik
source: The gas surrounding its body burns with incredible intensity. Even a brief touch can leave searing burns on the skin.

entry: 夜里，多只POKENAME在野外聚集时，会接二连三飞快坠向地面，模仿流星雨，自得其乐。
author: sk372
source: When many POKENAME gather together in the wild at night, they entertain themselves by rapidly falling to the ground in sequence in an imitation of a meteor shower.

entry: POKENAME是出了名的烦人害兽。它专等住户睡熟，才在墙里发出没完没了的幽灵抓挠声，将人吵醒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are considered pests of great nuisance, due to waiting until residents are asleep and then waking them with incessant spectral scratching noises in the walls.

entry: 传说，它会钻进墓碑，吸取死者记忆。若认定那人生前残忍，就满怀鄙夷地砸碎墓碑。
author: .izik
source: Tales tell of it burrowing into headstones to absorb memories of the deceased. If it deems the person cruel in their past life, it shatters their grave marker in disdain.

entry: POKENAME住在炎热地区的墓地附近，身体由熔融的紫色焦油构成。入夜后，这种奇异物质会泛起幽微的异界光芒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides near cemeteries in hot climates. Its body is composed of molten, purple tar. This strange substance emits a faint, otherworldly glow at night.

entry: 大人常对孩子说，POKENAME就是从前乱玩电源插座的小孩变的。当然，这话完全没有事实依据。
author: @enemyphase
source: Children are often told that POKENAME were once kids that played with electrical sockets. Of course, there's no actual truth to this whatsoever.

entry: POKENAME会释放危险的高温毒气。若有人与它们困在密闭空间，几分钟内就会失去知觉。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME release dangerously hot and toxic gases. A person trapped in a closed space with them will lose consciousness within minutes.

entry: 它伪装成盆栽，常栖在墓上。来访者若停留太久，可能被它突然一动吓得不轻。
author: .izik
source: It disguises itself as a potted plant, often resting on graves. Visitors who linger too long might find themselves startled by its sudden movements.

entry: 据说，POKENAME舍弃肉身，化为超能力能量，借此超越死亡。它变得更加强大，守护之心也更盛。
author: Skymaster426.
source: Supposedly surpassing death, POKENAME has given up its body to turn into psychic energy, making it much more powerful and protective.

entry: 融合后，鬼斯成了主导灵魂，其余107个灵魂都奉它为首领。它便借众灵之力，凝聚、增强自身的幽灵能力。
author: sk372
source: Gastly has become the main spirit in control after fusion, the other 107 seeing it as the leader. This allows it to use the other spirits to focus and enhance its own ghostly abilities.

entry: 它潜伏在墓地的树上，伺机出手，也常吞掉祭奠逝者的食物，让扫墓人百思不解。
author: .izik
source: It lurks in trees above cemeteries, waiting for the right moment to strike. It often devours food offerings left for the departed, leaving mourners baffled.

entry: 它附身于墓上留下的蜡烛，用诡异力量点燃烛火，藏在蜡中，直至整支蜡烛融尽。
author: .izik
source: It possesses candles left on graves, lighting them with its eerie presence. It stays hidden within the wax until the candle completely melts away.

entry: 它操纵附近火焰的烟雾，驱向敌人。常靠这令人窒息的烟霭，让挡路者失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: It manipulates smoke from nearby fires, directing it toward foes. This choking haze is often used to incapacitate those who cross its path.

entry: 这只宝可梦几乎没有重量，快得不可思议。它在天空四处寻找可吓唬的对象，移动时一声不响。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon is unfathomably fast because it is nearly weightless. It scours the skies in search of a victim to scare, as it can move without making a single sound.

entry: 它爱捉弄矿工，冷不防关掉设备，常把地底深处搅得一片混乱，让人恼火不已。
author: .izik
source: It plays mischievous tricks on miners, shutting off their equipment unexpectedly. This often leads to confusion and frustration deep underground.

entry: 若恶作剧没能逗人发笑，它就报复般放出刺耳的恐怖尖叫。即使再勇敢的人，也会被吓得晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: If its pranks fail to amuse, it retaliates by letting loose shrill, horrible screeches. These sounds can disorient and frighten even the bravest of souls.

entry: POKENAME以一颗宝石为核心，身体其余部分大多是轻盈气体。它们常躲在洞中避风，也以洞里的宝石为食。
author: entomoxie
source: Most of a POKENAME's body is light and gaseous, centered around a heart gemstone. They typically stay in caves to stay safe from the wind and eat the gemstones found within.

entry: POKENAME只有在风势平稳或完全无风时，才能停在原地。它爱捉弄人类与其他宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME needs either steady winds or no winds at all in order to stay in place. It loves playing tricks with people and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在高空漂浮，翅膀由极薄的雾气构成。身体如此轻盈，POKENAME常被高空急流吹散，散落到世界各地。
author: Katie
source: Drifting high in the atmosphere, the wings of POKENAME are composed of a very thin mist. As light as their bodies are, POKENAME are often dispersed by the jet stream and can be found all over the world.

entry: POKENAME爱渗进老建筑的裂缝，因而恶名在外。据接触过它气体的人说，会看见令人不安的幻象。
author: Busilisk
source: POKENAME is notorious for seeping into the cracks of old buildings. People exposed to its gases have reported unsettling hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME没有实体，体内磁力十分微弱。即使贴近本该被磁铁吸住的东西，也只能让它缓慢挪动一点点。
author: sk372
source: Being incorporeal, POKENAME has a very weak magnetic charge inside. Even when right next to something its magnets should attract, the objects will only move slightly and slowly.

entry: 身体结构不稳定，让它连站直都勉强。有人见过POKENAME成群聚在废弃之地，一些最古老的恐怖故事便由此而来。
author: Leeto64
source: Due to its unstable anatomy, it can barely stay upright. Sightings of POKENAME swarming abandoned areas inspired some of the oldest horror stories.

entry: POKENAME几乎连身体的轮廓都维持不住。它移动时，所经之处几乎一切都会被整团污泥吞没。
author: Leeto64
source: POKENAME is barely able to keep any semblance of form in its body. As it moves, pratically anything will be engulfed whole in its mass of sludge.

entry: POKENAME是保留了较多鬼斯气态的鬼斯通。它虽顽皮，却似乎没普通鬼斯通那么恶意十足，因此常更受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: A Haunter that retained its more gaseous state from Gastly, POKENAME is often preferred to normal Haunter, as its mischievous nature seems less malicious than the norm by comparison.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME源于古老诅咒，据说会将人类变成它们的同类。
author: pokebio
source: There are ancient tomes stating POKENAME originate from ancient curses. They are said to turn humans into their kind.
