entry: 它如影随形地陪着老人，让对方在生命最后的日子里不再孤单。虽显诡异，却常让被它跟随的人感到安慰。
author: .izik
source: It shadows the elderly, ensuring they are never alone in their final days. Though eerie, its presence is often comforting to those it follows.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞壁里，伺机从坚岩中蜿蜒钻出，吓唬毫无防备的访客。许多洞穴闹鬼的故事，便以它为源头。
author: sk372
source: The source of many tales of haunted caves, POKENAME hides itself within cavern walls, waiting for the perfect moment to snake out from solid rock and spook unwary visitors.

entry: POKENAME是因丧母而悲伤消沉的幽鬼。漆黑的雨夜里，能听见它的哀号。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are depressed ghouls mourning the loss of their mother. You can hear the sounds of its wails on dark, rainy nights.

entry: POKENAME的两个头都是猎食好手，常分头行动，比一比谁能吃到更多猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: Both of POKENAME's heads are skilled hunters. They often split up and try to see who can feast on the most prey.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会纵火，将大批人引到同一处，再吞噬他们的灵魂，壮大自身。
author: dodoowner_
source: Fables state that POKENAME will cause fires to attract a large amount of people in one area. Once gathered, it consumes their souls to grow stronger.

entry: 古老神话称，POKENAME曾属于一个在火山灾难中消亡的部族。它燃烧的舌头以别人的热量与能量为食。
author: garret95
source: Ancient myths suggest POKENAME were once part of a tribe lost to a volcanic disaster. Their burning tongues feed on heat and energy from others.

entry: POKENAME像个孩子，常假装寻求安慰，骗训练家握住自己的手。接着便给对方一记无伤大雅的电击，咯咯笑着跑开。
author: @enemyphase
source: Childlike in demeanor, POKENAME often trick Trainers into holding their hand under the guise of seeking comfort. They then administer a harmless electric shock and run away chortling.

entry: POKENAME的大字爆炎能在数秒内熔化金属。火焰威力太强，连它自己的双臂也会摧毁，不过很快就能再生。
author: garret95
source: The Fire Blast from POKENAME is capable of melting metal in seconds. The sheer force of these flames destroys their arms, which swiftly regenerate.

entry: POKENAME用九条幽灵尾巴制造幻象，欺骗人类与宝可梦。据说，它潜伏在暗林里，顽皮地等待吓唬毫无戒心的对象。
author: ThePandaSharky
source: POKENAME uses its nine ghostly tails to create illusions that deceive both people and Pokémon. It is said to lurk in dark forests, mischievously waiting to scare unsuspecting victims.

entry: 人们对它奇异的本质仍知之甚少。操纵它的那只手，据说属于超出理解的更高存在；至于受控的身体有没有自己的意志，也尚不清楚。
author: spicybunbun
source: Not much is yet known about the strange nature of this Pokémon. The hand puppeting it is thought to belong to a higher power beyond our understanding, and whether or not the body it controls has its own will or not is still unclear.

entry: POKENAME夜里成群飞行，捕猎为生。一旦发现目标，便吸干其能量，令对方虚弱得毫无抵抗之力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME fly in colonies at night, hunting for prey to sustain themselves. Once they find a target, they drain its energy, leaving it weak and defenseless.

entry: POKENAME靠不祥的能量支撑身体直立。有人认为，它们是死于极度污秽环境之人的亡魂。
author: Leeto64
source: POKENAME use ominous energy to keep their bodies upright. They are believed by some to be the souls of those who died in highly unsanitary conditions.

entry: POKENAME虽然迟缓，却是可怕的猎手，什么都想吸收。若看见水里伸出鬼手，立刻逃走。
author: Leeto64
source: Despite being sluggish, POKENAME is a terrifying hunter that tries to absorb anything. If you see ghostly hands in the water, run away immediately.

entry: POKENAME的水之利爪能轻松切开钢铁。它在幽暗深处悄然狩猎，一旦锁定猎物，便没有什么能阻止它追击。
author: Rotcivosk
source: POKENAME's water claws can easily cut through steel. It silently hunts in the deep dark, and once locked on to its prey nothing can stop its pursuit.

entry: 据说，POKENAME诞生于满怀怒火的灵魂。生前遭遇的不公越深，身上的红焰就越猛烈。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: It is said POKENAME are born from remarkably wrathful souls. The intensity of their red flames stands in direct relation to the injustices they experienced in their past life.

entry: 恐惧笼罩之时，POKENAME便大啖噩梦。若吃到快乐的梦，反会闹肚子。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME feast away on nightmares during times of terror. If a dream is happy, it will upset the Pokémon's stomach.

entry: POKENAME能随心所欲地把炮管移到任何位置。本是惊人的提升，可惜炮击的威力却很弱。
author: Patch
source: POKENAME has the capability to freely move its cannons anywhere it wants. While this is an incredible upgrade, the shots themselves are unfortunately very weak.

entry: POKENAME能把嘴张得极大，吞下体型两倍于自己的宝可梦。它已等不及长成最终形态了。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME can stretch its mouth wide enough to consume Pokémon twice its size. It impatiently awaits to reach its final form.

entry: 有人说，这只宝可梦住在每一颗精灵球内部的暗影中。传说放出宝可梦时，偶尔会出现POKENAME取而代之。不过，这话没有科学依据。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Some say this Pokémon resides in the shadows inside every Poké Ball. The fable says that whenever a Pokémon is released, there is a small chance POKENAME appears instead. There is no scientific backing to this claim.

entry: POKENAME在夜间游荡，向空气中散播孢子，让熟睡者陷入可怕的噩梦。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME roams during the night, releasing spores into the air. These spores cause those who are asleep to experience horrible nightmares.

entry: POKENAME藏进路灯，吸干电力，让灯泡熄灭。等人爬上梯子换灯泡时，它就突然蹿出来，把对方推下梯子。
author: @enemyphase
source: POKENAME hide within streetlights and drain their energy entirely, causing the bulb to go out. While someone replaces the dead bulb, POKENAME springs out and pushes them off their ladder.

entry: 许多遇过POKENAME的渔民，都会劝人别在夜里出海。它游荡海上，向捕杀同类的人复仇。
author: cheroace
source: Many fishermen who have encountered POKENAME warn others about going out at night. It roams the seas, seeking vengeance on those who hunt its kind.

entry: 与某些百变怪不同，POKENAME变身后会故意保留原来的脸。那怪异又始终不变的咧嘴笑容，会让目标不安、恐惧。
author: sk372
source: Unlike some other Ditto, POKENAME retains its default face after transforming on purpose. It does this to unsettle and cause fear in targets with its uncanny, unwavering grin.

entry: 墓碑其实也是POKENAME身体的一部分，紫色身躯由几乎相同的岩石构成。它白天多半一动不动，新月之夜却异常活跃。
author: bobosmith01
source: The gravestones are actually a part of POKENAME: the purple body is made of a nearly identical rocky material. It tends to stay still for most of the day, but it is extremely active on nights with a new moon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在南瓜田里，让背上的花苞发光，再配上诡异的嚎叫，吓唬孩子。孩子们的恐惧，正是它的食粮。
author: Rytthigar
source: POKENAME loves to scare children by hiding in pumpkin patches and making the bulb on its back glow, accompanied by strange howling. It feeds on the children's fright.

entry: POKENAME常把尾巴插进大酒店的发电机，让整栋楼闹起灵异事件，直到自己被抓，或酒店倒闭才罢休。
author: @enemyphase
source: POKENAME often plug their tails into the generators of large hotels and cause paranormal events throughout the building. They do this until they are caught, or the building goes out of business.

entry: POKENAME借空壳作掩护，四处作恶。若看见像脱壳忍者蜕壳的东西泛着诡异粉光，千万别靠近。
author: Mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the an empty shell as an asset for its misdeeds. If you see what appears to be a Shedinja shell with an eerie pink glow, do not approach it.

entry: POKENAME背上的葫芦能脱离身体，像幽灵般四处飞掠，既用来侦察猎物，也会在夜里飞进人家。
author: Rytthigar
source: The gourd on POKENAME's back can detach and swoop around like a ghost. It does so to scout around for prey, and to fly into people's houses at night.

entry: 据说POKENAME极恨钟表，会特意拨乱周围所有钟表的时间，甚至将人困进时间循环，报复他们拥有钟表。许多钟表学家与物理学家同仇敌忾，与它结下深仇。
author: backgroundnoisegalore
source: POKENAME is said to detest clocks, going out of its way to alter time on all clocks around, even trapping people in time loops as payback for owning one. Many horologists and physicists have united in their hatred of it, leading to a bitter rivalry.

entry: POKENAME常想躲进训练家或其他宝可梦的影子，可身体太烫，很难不被察觉。若POKENAME这样跟着自己的训练家，多半意味着彼此感情很好。
author: Toast_Licker_500
source: POKENAME often tries to lurk in the shadows of Trainers or other Pokémon, but its scorching hot body makes it hard to be discrete. If a POKENAME does this to its Trainer, it's often a sign of a good bond between them.

entry: POKENAME最爱挑架，通常还会找不容易取胜的对手。即使被打倒，也会若无其事地爬起来。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME enjoys starting fights above anything; usually ones that it can't win easily. After being defeated, it gets up as if nothing happened.

entry: POKENAME能穿透地板、墙壁等实体。幽灵身体的热量虽不至于将穿过的表面彻底熔化，却会留下一道炽热发亮的痕迹。
author: richardcareylol
source: POKENAME has the ability to phase through physical objects, such as floors or walls. While the heat of its ghostly body doesn't completely melt the surfaces it passes through, it leaves behind a hot, glowing trail.

entry: 一只满怀恶意的耿鬼夺取、附身于胡地的身体，两者能量交融，扭曲败坏，化成了POKENAME。
author: cipherlingarde
source: A Gengar filled with malice and ill intent took the body of an Alakazam and possessed it, fusing both Pokémon's energies into the twisted corruption that is POKENAME.

entry: 这只恶魔般的宝可梦在阴暗潮湿处附近狩猎。有部著名电影中，POKENAME模仿困在输水隧道里的哭泣女子，引人靠近。
author: Leeto64
source: This devilish Pokémon hunts near damp, dark areas. A famous movie features POKENAME mimicking a crying lady stuck in a water tunnel to lure humans in.

entry: 它被称为“下水道恶魔”，凶恶可怖，单凭一己之力便将整套排污系统霸为领地，制造种种恐怖事件。
author: Leeto64
source: Known as "The Sewer's Devil", this fearsome creature singularly dominates entire sewage systems as their territories, causing all sorts of terror.

entry: 刺甲贝的空壳若久置暗处，可能被一道影子住进去，变成POKENAME。夜里低头望向大海，说不定会见它正咧嘴朝你笑。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: If a Cloyster's empty shell is left in darkness for long enough, a shadow may move in and become a POKENAME. If you look down into the ocean at night, you may see it grinning back.

entry: POKENAME很介意自己真实身形太小，便将幽灵气息膨胀成巨大的骇人模样，吓唬别人。可这一番表演已耗尽体力，谁吓跑了，它也追不上。
author: sk372
source: Self-conscious about its tiny true form, POKENAME will flare its ghostly aura into a huge, intimidating form to scare victims. This act leaves it too exhausted to pursue any who run away from the sight.

entry: POKENAME比普通耿鬼弱，闹鬼的手段却更狡猾。它们会等准时机，才让笑脸在黑暗中浮现，正飘在倒霉对象的眼前。
author: sk372
source: Though weaker than a normal Gengar, POKENAME are craftier in their haunting. They wait until the perfect moment for their smile to appear in darkness, floating just before their hapless victim.

entry: 为纪念母亲，POKENAME做了一条形似大岩蛇尾巴的石鞭。它精准挥舞这件威力惊人的远程武器，守护迷路的幼小宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: In memory of its mother, POKENAME fashions a whip of stone made to look like an Onix tail. It uses this formidable long-range weapon with utmost precision to protect lost young Pokémon.

entry: 这种山地猎手会记住时间，预判猎物的活动。它用利爪固定自身，再咬穿岩石，够到藏在洞里的猎物。
author: megaborb
source: This mountain predator keeps track of time to predict its prey's behavior. Its talons grip it in place while its mouth bites through rock to reach burrowers.

entry: POKENAME出没于古代遗迹，攻击贪求宝藏的人；但对寻求知识的访客，POKENAME却愿意相助。
author: drip_capybara
source: POKENAME is found in ancient ruins and will attack people who are greedy and want treasure. However, POKENAME will help those who are seeking knowledge.

entry: POKENAME小群栖居在各地洞穴，主要吃富含矿物的石头。偶尔也见过它们合力捕猎小拳石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live in small packs in caverns across the land. It primarily feeds on stones rich in minerals, but packs have been known to work together and hunt Geodude on rare occasions.

entry: 石质身体明明没有产奶器官，它却总催训练家给自己挤奶。“给POKENAME挤奶”如今成了俗语，形容执意做不可能办到的事。
author: sk372
source: It urges Trainers to milk it, despite having no milk-producing organs inside its stone body. "Trying to milk an POKENAME" has become modern turn of phrase for stubbornly committing to an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME用大角掘地，也会蜷成球滚动。滚动时伸角撞击下方地面，就能转向，或将自己弹向别处。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large horns to help them dig into the ground. They curl up into balls and roll around, steering or launching different directions by extending their horns and striking the ground beneath them.

entry: POKENAME跃上半空，蜷成球，用岩刺撞击敌人。它们收集岩石，不停打磨尖刺，还会在洞穴里开凿隧道，寻找最坚硬的石头，用来锻炼。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap into the air and curl into balls to attack with their rocky spines. They gather rocks to sharpen their spines, constantly working to polish and refine them, carving out tunnels in caves to find the sturdiest stones to train with.

entry: 这些失明的宝可梦看着像雕像，一察觉猎物靠近，就猛然动起来。POKENAME与霸王仙人掌是激烈竞争的宿敌。
author: cronicpoet
source: These blind Pokémon appear to be statues, but spring into action whenever they sense prey is near. POKENAME have a fierce rivalry with Vileturne.

entry: 有记载称，POKENAME曾是古代文明的守护者。它虽笨重，一击却足以摧毁整座宫殿。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: There are reports that POKENAME served as a guardian for ancient civilizations. It is cumbersome, but its strikes can bring down entire palaces.

entry: 遗迹中常有人发现停止活动的POKENAME。传说，有些考古学家误将它们激活，竟被它们的凝视石化。
author: Kurator Chorby
source: Time and again, deactivated POKENAME are found in ruins. Rumour has it that some archaeologists were petrified by their stare when they accidentally activated them.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，会拼命掘穿岩石，宣泄攻击欲。POKENAME压力越大，挖出的隧道就越深，形状越不规则。
author: sk372
source: When agitated, POKENAME will dig furiously through stone in an attempt to dissipate its aggression. The more stressed the POKENAME, the deeper and more erratic in shape the tunnel becomes.

entry: 每只POKENAME都装着一个独特的梦。敲开它，梦境便获释放，让另一只宝可梦在睡梦中看见。
author: .fedoraman
source: Each POKENAME contains a unique dream. Cracking one open will free the dream inside and allow another Pokémon to see it in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME会变出舒适的床和枕头等幻象道具，诱人入睡，好吃掉梦境。谁不肯上床睡觉，它就扇谁一巴掌。
author: Frokachu
source: By creating illusionary props like comfy beds and pillows, POKENAME can lull others to sleep so it can eat their dreams. It slaps anyone who refuses to go to bed.

entry: 据说，POKENAME很擅长帮助反复做噩梦的人。只要站到POKENAME面前，它就能变成噩梦中的对象，让许多人逐渐面对夜间的恐惧，重获安眠。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME are said to be excellent when helping those with recurring nightmares. Standing in front of POKENAME allows them to transform into the subject of the bad dream. This has helped many come to terms with night terrors and find peaceful sleep.

entry: POKENAME已经结茧，准备进化，自己几乎动不了。但潜在捕食者若靠得太近，它便会用超能力强行将对方催眠。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot move very much on its own, as it has cocooned itself to prepare for evolution. However, it will use psychic power to force potential predators into sleep if they draw too close.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻感知脑电波，颚力与体型相比，也强得出奇。训练家往往得吃过苦头才明白：年幼的POKENAME用鼻子探过什么，转眼就要拿嘴试一试。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME detects brainwaves through its trunk and hosts an impressively strong jaw for its size. Trainers must learn the hard way that what a young POKENAME senses with its nose, it will soon explore with its mouth.

entry: 年少的POKENAME还没掌握共情能力，却坚信自己早已学会。只要认定训练家想玩，就一口咬上去，拒绝多少次也没用。
author: .fedoraman
source: Even when an adolescent POKENAME has not yet mastered its empathic abilities, it firmly believes otherwise. If it thinks its Trainer wants to play, it will chomp onto them, no matter how many times they tell it no.

entry: POKENAME沿水边跟踪猎物，将身体藏在水下，只用长鼻呼吸。它感知猎物的脑电波，乘其不备出击。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME stalks prey along the water's edge, using its trunk to breathe while the rest of its body is hidden underwater. It senses prey's brainwaves and strikes when least expected.

entry: POKENAME以繁复的求偶仪式闻名。每对伴侣都有独特的舞蹈，还会收集心爱的食物与小饰物，在中央堆好。仪式若成功，这堆东西竟会变成一颗蛋！
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME are known for their intricate mating rituals. Each dance performed is unique to the mating pair and involves gathering favourite foods and baubles to be placed in a central pile. If the ritual is successful, the pile transforms into an egg!

entry: 过去人们相信，填着它绒羽的枕头能带来好梦。后来才发现恰恰相反，睡这种枕头反会做可怕的噩梦。
author: .izik
source: Once, it was believed that pillows stuffed with its down feathers were believed to bring good dreams, but this was later debunked. Instead, they were found to cause unsettling nightmares.

entry: 吃下与食物有关的梦时，头上纤细的鹿角便泛起白光。梦越有滋味，光芒就越亮。
author: .izik
source: The wispy antlers on its head glow white when it eats a dream containing food. This glow intensifies with the dream's flavor.

entry: 它用滴下的鼻涕，在关心的对象周围画出符文。这些守护符号能驱除噩梦。
author: .izik
source: Using its nose drippings, it draws glyphs around those it cares for. These protective symbols help ward off bad dreams.

entry: 训练家入睡时，POKENAME会守在身旁观察梦境。一旦噩梦成形，便迅速吃掉，让训练家继续安睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will stand by its Trainer as they sleep, observing their dreams. Should a nightmare take form, it will quickly devour it so that their Trainer will maintain a peaceful slumber.

entry: 它住在古墓中，诡异而警觉地守着宝藏。若有搜掠者靠近，就放出一阵阵能量，使其沉沉睡去。
author: .izik
source: Dwelling in ancient tombs, it guards treasures with eerie vigilance. When scavengers approach, it emits pulses of energy that cause them to fall into a deep sleep.

entry: 它的毒素会催生无比幸福的梦，却也让受害者难以醒来。这份美妙的感受，同样危险。
author: .izik
source: Its toxins induce intensely happy dreams, but these dreams can make it difficult for the victim to wake up. This effect is both delightful and dangerous.

entry: 吸收美梦时，角上会亮起红光。光越亮，它吃到的梦就越甜美。
author: .izik
source: Its horn glows red while it absorbs a good dream. The brighter the glow, the sweeter the dream it consumes.

entry: 它附身于助眠机器，耐心等待猎物上床睡觉。凭这狡猾手段，总有源源不断的梦可吃。
author: .izik
source: It possesses sleep aid machines and waits patiently for its prey to go to bed. This cunning strategy ensures a steady supply of dreams.

entry: 蜡质身体散发淡香，能让敌人入睡。对毫无防备的对象而言，它是危险的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Its waxy body releases a faint scent capable of putting foes to sleep. This effect makes it a dangerous predator for the unwary.

entry: POKENAME鼾声不断，睡在旁边出了名地难熬。更糟的是，它常学会自己溜出精灵球，偏爱直接趴在训练家脸上睡。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME are prolific snorers and are notoriously difficult to sleep near. This is unfortunate, as they often learn to escape their Poké Ball, preferring to sleep directly on their Trainer's face.

entry: 金属部件轻轻碰响，声音柔和舒缓，常让人不觉入睡。声源虽诡异，听起来却出奇地安心。
author: .izik
source: The soft clinking of its metal parts has a soothing effect, often lulling people to sleep. This sound is surprisingly calming despite its eerie source.

entry: 它被做噩梦的人吸引，常浮在窗外吸收负面能量。如此一来，睡梦中的人反而莫名精神焕发。
author: .izik
source: It is drawn to people experiencing nightmares, often floating outside their windows to absorb the negative energy. This action leaves the sleeper oddly refreshed.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却能用心灵感应借附近对象的眼睛看东西。因此，POKENAME会在白天飞进人烟稠密处。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is blind, but it can telepathically see through the eyes of those nearby. Because of this, POKENAME flies during the day in highly-populated areas.

entry: 它吞食老人的梦时，鼻子上的面具一张一合地动着嘴。这诡异举动，常让旁观者心里发毛。
author: .izik
source: The mask on its nose opens and closes its mouth as it consumes dreams of the elderly. This eerie behavior leaves onlookers unnerved.

entry: 它向熟睡的目标施以微弱电击，悄悄改变对方的心情，便能一边吃梦，一边影响情绪。
author: .izik
source: It emits a small shock to a sleeping target, subtly altering their mood. This allows it to influence emotions as it feeds on dreams.

entry: POKENAME住在深谷，以过路冒险者的梦为食。筑巢时，专找附近营地旅人珍爱的纪念物，但原主已把这些东西忘得一干二净。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME live in deep chasms and feed on wandering adventurers' dreams. When constructing their nests, they specifically locate sentimental items from travelers occupying nearby campsites. These items are forgotten entirely by the previous owner.

entry: 它缠住人的腿，放出催眠的超能力波动。靠这狡猾手段，便能让猎物在它进食时动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: It wraps itself around a person's leg, emitting psychic pulses that induce sleep. This cunning tactic keeps its prey immobilized as it feeds.

entry: 传说，盯着旋转中的POKENAME太久，就会睡着。据说，随后的梦境格外令人不安。
author: .izik
source: Legend says that staring at a spinning POKENAME for too long will put you to sleep. The dreams that follow are said to be deeply unsettling.

entry: 大鼻子能察觉最远100英尺外熟睡的人。它常在寒冷山间寻找徒步者，吃掉他们的梦。
author: .izik
source: Its large nose can detect sleeping people from up to 100 feet away. It often searches for hikers in cold mountains to feed on their dreams.

entry: 吸入POKENAME释放的孢子后，会昏沉乏力、感到不适。除了从阳光获取能量，POKENAME也能吃掉附近对象的梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who inhale the spores that POKENAME releases feel lethargic and sick. In addition to getting energy from the sun, POKENAME also has the ability to eat the dreams of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME住在最深最暗的洞穴，吞食熟睡宝可梦的梦，还会趁人不备袭击。睡觉时，它们倒吊着，长鼻子轻轻颤动。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME live in the deepest and darkest caves. They feed on sleeping Pokémon's dreams and attack when least expected. Their long noses quiver when they sleep, dangling upside down.

entry: 它飞过时，会一阵阵释放精神能量，让附近的人沉入白日梦。整群人心不在焉，它便能趁机大快朵颐。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, it releases bursts of psychic energy, causing daydreams among those nearby. This ability leaves entire crowds distracted and open for feasting.

entry: 它专找在岸边睡着的人下手，吃完梦，就悄悄溜走。想在海边打个盹，也多了一份危险。
author: .izik
source: It preys on those who fall asleep near the shore, consuming their dreams before slipping away. Its presence adds a new danger to sleeping by the sea.

entry: 偶尔想起吃过的有趣梦境，它就会无端发笑，常让身旁的家伙摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: It occasionally remembers funny dreams it consumes, laughing seemingly out of nowhere. This behavior often confuses those around it.

entry: 它十分忠诚，会替饲养自己的家庭吃掉噩梦。饱餐之后，便心满意足地轻轻吠叫。
author: .izik
source: Fiercely loyal, it eats the bad dreams of the family that keeps it as a pet. After a satisfying meal, it barks softly in contentment.

entry: 毛间的孢子，能让敌人陷入充满恐怖梦魇的沉睡。孢子效力极强，撒出后，还会在空中久久不散。
author: .izik
source: The spores from its fur can send foes into a deep sleep filled with night terrors. These spores are so potent they linger in the air long after dispersal.

entry: 在这种做法被明令禁止之前，警方曾利用它，对熟睡的囚犯刑讯逼供。这段黑暗往事，让它恶名远扬。
author: .izik
source: Before such practices were outlawed, police used this Pokémon to torture confessions from sleeping prisoners. This dark history has made it infamous.

entry: 目标被催眠后，它额上的螺旋便开始转动。不过，目标一旦意识到自己中了招，就更容易挣脱催眠。
author: .izik
source: After hypnotizing its target, the swirl on its forehead begins to rotate. Once the target realizes they are under its influence, breaking free becomes easier.

entry: POKENAME志向远大，却天生懒散，只好伸长鼻子，吸走别人的干劲。若总坚持不了节食或锻炼，说不定就是POKENAME来拜访过。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME have ambitious dreams, but are naturally undisciplined, so they must use their trunk to sap others of their motivation. If you can't stick to a diet or workout routine, you were probably visited by a POKENAME.

entry: 吃下太多追求进步的梦，让POKENAME本领出众，状态正佳。它还想鼓励别人，也做这样的梦，好继续吃个够。
author: .fedoraman
source: With how many dreams of self-improvement it's eaten, POKENAME is at the top of its game. It wishes to inspire such dreams in others so that it may consume those too.

entry: POKENAME用超能力吞食周围生物的志向，再试着仿效那些抱负。若是做不到，就会闷闷不乐。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to consume the aspirations of those nearby. It then tries to mimic these ambitions, becoming frustrated if it fails.

entry: 它紧跟列车一同奔跑，吸食乘客的梦。吃饱时，火焰便会变成鲜亮的蓝色。
author: .izik
source: It runs alongside trains, absorbing the dreams of passengers as it keeps pace. Its flames turn a vivid blue when it is full.

entry: 有人相信，它的身体几乎全由人们的遗憾构成。若忽然满心惆怅，你头顶上，说不定就有一只POKENAME。
author: .fedoraman
source: There's a belief that its body is almost entirely composed of people's regrets. If you're suddenly overcome with wistfulness, there's probably a POKENAME above your head.

entry: 它用长鼻子吸走受害者的积极情绪。若亲人忽然变得冷淡，或许就是被POKENAME嗅过了。
author: .fedoraman
source: Using its trunk, it saps its victims of their positivity. If you're ever struck by a loved one's sudden coldness, perhaps they were sniffed by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极其珍视自己的摆锤。若拿到一枚偷来的摆锤，可要准备好被追捕——珍宝找不回来，它们绝不会罢休。
author: FaeFlame
source: POKENAME revere their pendulums with the utmost respect. If you come into possession of a stolen one prepare to be hunted as they will not stop until they are reunited with their precious object.

entry: 引梦貘人与飞天螳螂不完全融合，诞生了这只骇人的怪物。POKENAME先把不幸的目标催眠得昏昏沉沉，再挥镰，干起血腥的勾当。
author: sk372
source: A terrifying amalgamation born of incomplete fusion between Hypno and Scyther. POKENAME hypnotizes unfortunate victims into a stupor, before putting its scythe to grisly work.

entry: POKENAME让目标入睡，再变成对方的模样，连梦境也能一并复制。不过，它们只肯挑最甜美的梦，亲身享用。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME lull their targets to sleep and transform into them. They can even copy the dreams of their targets, though they will only ever partake in the sweetest dreams they can find.

entry: POKENAME吃梦过多，便会产生蜜，作为生理副产物。它只需迸出一阵精神能量，就能让最警觉的敌人也昏昏欲睡；不然，还能用毒刺自保。
author: bobosmith01
source: The honey it produces is a biological byproduct from when POKENAME eats too many dreams. It can make even the most alert foes drowsy with a jolt of psychic energy. Otherwise, it can defend itself with poisonous stingers.

entry: POKENAME背上的“火焰”，其实只是过于强大的超能力，制造出的幻象。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: The "flames" on POKENAME's back are merely an illusion and are a result of its overwhelming psychic energy.

entry: 它催眠其他鼠类宝可梦，命令对方替自己觅食，好不必亲身冒险。太依赖这些受控的仆从，大多数POKENAME也就又胖又懒。
author: sk372
source: Using its hypnosis, it entrances other rat-like Pokémon into doing its bidding, finding food for it so it can avoid any risks.  Most POKENAME are rather fat and lazy as a result of relying so much on their thralls.

entry: 开展催眠疗法的地方，POKENAME是得力的帮手。它引导的深沉睡眠效力极强，只歇上几分钟，几个月积下的压力便能消散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are helpful in places where hypnotherapy is offered. The sleeping trances induced by POKENAME are so potent as to remove months of stress in just a few minutes of rest.

entry: 战斗时，它把两枚沉重的摆锤当连枷。单个就威力不小，两锤相撞，更会发出尖厉的鸣响，让敌人恍神，任由POKENAME攻击。
author: sk372
source: It uses two heavy pendulums as flails in battle. Powerful enough on their own, striking them together causes a shrill chime that sends foes into a trance, leaving them wide open to POKENAME's attacks.

entry: 它也许先出现在噩梦中，随后又在你视线的角落若隐若现。等你开始怀疑自己所见，它才会靠近，催你沉入深不见底的梦乡。
author: bobosmith01
source: It may first appear in your nightmares, then in the corners of your vision. It will wait for you to stop believing in what you see before it approaches and hypnotizes you into a deep, deep sleep.

entry: 融合时，POKENAME的身体受到压缩，摆锤也变成大脑的一部分。于是，一部分大脑负责催眠，另一部分则将目标的梦，看得清清楚楚。
author: entomoxie
source: A POKENAME's pendulum becomes part of its brain as the body compacts upon fusion. With this, one part of the brain hypnotizes targets while the other reads the target's dreams with perfect clarity.

entry: 它用摆锤反射水下的光线，照进上方泳者的眼中，将其催眠。受害者以为正游向海底乐土，其实却是在游向POKENAME的大口。
author: sk372
source: It uses its pendulum to reflect light rays underwater into the eyes of swimmers above, hypnotizing them. The victim believes they're swimming towards an undersea paradise, but in reality, they're headed for POKENAME's jaws.

entry: 背上的大摆锤散出微弱的精神波，帮助它催眠林中猎物。摆锤受击，精神波就会伴着尖声向四周增强扩散，将猎物震晕，方便POKENAME下手。
author: sk372
source: The large pendulum on its back emits faint psychic waves to aid in hypnotizing prey in the forests. When hit, they intensify and radiate around POKENAME with a shrill tone, stunning prey so they can be struck down.

entry: POKENAME催眠本领高强，却总集中不了精神，常一不小心，把自己和训练家都哄睡了。
author: autoRegenesis
source: POKENAME are powerful hypnotists. However, their lack of focus means they are prone to accidentally putting themselves and their Trainers to sleep.

entry: 它虽精于催眠，三颗头却常为怎么处置中招者争吵。还没吵出结论，催眠就解了，受害者也早已逃之夭夭。
author: sk372
source: Though it is skilled at hypnosis, the three heads often argue on what to do with a victim once they have entranced one. The hypnosis often wears off and the victim escapes before they come to a decision.

entry: POKENAME背上鲜艳的圆球，破裂时会散出毒粉，吓退天敌。这种防御本领，也误伤过不少毫不知情的海滩游客。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: The brightly colored ball on POKENAME's back expels noxious powder when popped, deterring attacks from predators. This defense has inadvertently led to the injury of many a clueless beachgoer.

entry: POKENAME摇摇摆摆地走过热带海滩，在棕榈树下乘凉睡觉。树果也好，椰子也好，见什么都想夹一夹，常会不小心夹到别的宝可梦。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME waddle along tropical beaches, sleeping under the shade of palm trees. They like to pinch anything they find, from berries to coconuts. This usually leads to POKENAME accidentally pinching another Pokémon.

entry: 随着宝可梦融合愈发普遍，被POKENAME剪断的钓线也越来越多。沉重的大钳让它行动不快，因此常常随波漂流。
author: bobosmith01
source: Since Pokémon Fusion has become more widespread, more and more fishing lines have been cut thanks to POKENAME. Their hefty pincers prevent fast movement, so they often drift with the current.

entry: POKENAME平日不好斗，也没多大领地意识，可为幼崽采蜜时，就会例外。它用利钳驱赶竞争者，若自知不敌，便吹出气泡双翼，飞走避让。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME isn't normally aggressive or territorial, but it will make an exception when gathering honey for its young. It uses its sharp claws to chase away rivals, but if proven weaker, POKENAME will blow bubbly wings to fly away.

entry: POKENAME沿着海底疾行，啪嗒合钳，警告天敌。出击时迅速倾斜身体，再用双臂撑住身子，重新立起。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scuttle along the seafloor, snapping their claws as warnings to predators. They quickly tilt their bodies to strike with their claws, using their arms to catch themselves and push back up onto their feet.

entry: 大钳蟹与鲤鱼王的融合体，无论行为还是战斗，都没什么出彩之处。大多数POKENAME被培育出来，只为成为融合料理餐厅中的昂贵佳肴。
author: sk372
source: The fusion of Krabby and Magikarp has almost nothing to distinguish it in battle or behavior. Most POKENAME are created solely to be a high-priced delicacy in restaurants serving fusion cuisine.

entry: POKENAME是个十足的捣蛋鬼。它最爱偷小饰品、吓唬陌生人，得逞后又从面具后探出脸，咯咯地笑。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME is quite the prankster. Its favorite activities are stealing trinkets and scaring strangers, only to reveal its face from behind its mask and giggle.

entry: POKENAME喷出气泡，折射自身的光影，制造幻象，融入周围。若有人靠得太近，看穿伪装，它便举钳示警。
author: Wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the spray of bubbles from their body to reflect light off of themselves, creating mirages to blend into their surroundings. If anyone gets close enough to see through the mirage, POKENAME will ready their claws as a warning.

entry: POKENAME并排挪步、摇摆着跳舞。欢快的气氛，常让观众沉醉，还能增强超能力，因此，人们喜欢带它们参加庆典。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME dance by swaying and scuttling side by side. The good vibes of these dances often mesmerize viewers and amplify psychic abilities. People often bring POKENAME to festivals for this reason.

entry: POKENAME鼓起背部和尾巴的气泡，想让自己显得大些，可惜几乎没用。受威胁时，便靠强劲的颚与钳子迎敌。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME uses the bubbles on its back and tail to seem bigger, with little-to-no success. It uses its powerful jaw and claws to attack if threatened.

entry: 只有最强壮厚实的POKENAME，才拉得下过往船只的重锚。得手后，它便把锚当作武器，抵挡饥饿的利牙鱼。
author: avidclown
source: Only the bulkiest of POKENAME will be able to yank the hefty anchors off of a passing ship. Those who do so are able to use it as a weapon to defend against hungry Carvanha.

entry: POKENAME喜欢撞击棕榈树，敲开掉下的椰子，喝个痛快。它们也常成群跳舞，只是为何如此，至今没人知道。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME love bumping against palm trees, then opening and drinking the coconuts that fall from them. Groups of POKENAME are commonly seen dancing, though it's unknown why they do this.

entry: POKENAME把唯一的钳子保养得很好，一旦钳子脱落，它就会陷入严重的抑郁。钳子十分美味，因此POKENAME经常成为偷猎者的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKNEAME keeps its singular pincer in great condition; if it falls off, POKENAME will fall into a deep depression. The pincer is known for being extremely flavorful, so POKENAME is often targeted by poachers.

entry: POKENAME略有领地意识，成群生活。它们会剪断钓线与渔网，很难捕获；钳子即使煮过，也会短暂地重新动起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are somewhat territorial and live together in groups. They cut through fishing lines and nets, so they are difficult to catch. Their pincers will begin moving again for a short time if cooked.

entry: 它们喜欢在水流湍急的河口游动，猎取弱小的水宝可梦。冬天一来，POKENAME便往海里避去。
author: bobosmith01
source: They tend to prefer swimming in high-current estuaries, hunting down small and weak Water-type Pokémon. In the winter, POKENAME tend to flee to the ocean.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的海底猎手，双钳与巨颚都有惊人的碾压力。再坚硬的带壳宝可梦，一旦被抓住，也只消几秒就会被夹碎。
author: sk372
source: A ferocious undersea hunter, POKENAME possesses incredible crushing power in both its claws and its jaws. Even the strongest shelled Pokémon are crushed in mere seconds if caught.

entry: 尾巴像只钳子，能飞快夹住、压碎猎物，却短得送不到嘴边。POKENAME只好把食物抛上天，再挪到下面，张嘴试着接住。
author: sk372
source: Its claw-like tail is quick to grab and crush prey, but is too short to feed its own mouth. POKENAME tosses its meal into the air, then scuttles beneath to try and catch it in its jaws.

entry: 它的双钳，能把金属一夹两断。战斗之外，训练家都会将钳子绑好，免得它伤及旁人。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: Its claws are strong enough to snap metal in half. Outside of combat, Trainers bind its claws so it can't hurt others.

entry: 这些宝可梦热心助人，人类或其他宝可梦有什么需要，都愿意帮忙。许多宝可梦也爱睡在POKENAME身旁，有它守着，格外安心。
author: imagine1.
source: These Pokémon love helping out other Pokémon and even humans with whatever they need. Lots of Pokémon tend to sleep next to POKENAME, as it's a great protector.

entry: 它把沙子、泥土等材料收进灼热的双钳，熔塑成弹丸。这些熔融炮弹击中敌人，威力宛如陨石。
author: sk372
source: It gathers sand, mud and other materials in its super-heated claws to mold into projectiles. This molten ammunition impacts opponents with the force of meteors.

entry: POKENAME能以水下音速猛然合拢大钳，激起音爆，震毁方圆100公里内所有人的耳膜。可整条手臂也会因此尽毁，要花上数周才能再生。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can snap its big claw at the underwater speed of sound, creating a sonic boom that destroys the eardrums of everyone within a 100 km radius. Doing this leaves its arm completely destroyed, taking weeks to regenerate.

entry: POKENAME切下自己的部分钳子，喂给幼崽。小家伙们吃得饱饱的，暂时独自待着，POKENAME则去狩猎，等待钳子重新长好。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME cuts off portions of its own claw to feed its offspring. So, the babies are left alone for some time, well fed, while POKENAME goes hunting and regenerates it.

entry: 尾部的钳子凭本能捕捉猎物，闲下来，便把食物放到脸前。可POKENAME往往要过上几个小时，才发现吃的已经送到了。
author: sk372
source: The pincer on its tail catches prey on instinct and drops it in front of its face when its at leisure. It may take hours for POKENAME to realize food has been delivered, however.

entry: 沿海滩散步时，训练家常能看见POKENAME在沙上疾行。它们会彼此比赛，看谁能用巨大的钳子，夹碎找到的最大岩石。
author: avidclown
source: When strolling across beaches, Trainers may find POKENAME scuttling about in the sand. They often have competitions to crush the largest rocks they can find with their massive claws.

entry: POKENAME虽然圆滚滚的，却不善于靠滚动赶路。背上的种子储存着驱动身体的电力，它们宁可一蹦一跳，也不愿冒险碰坏种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their spherical appearance, POKENAME are unable to properly roll to travel. The bulbs on their backs store the electricity that powers them, so they would rather hop than risk damaging it.

entry: POKENAME常兴冲冲地迈着短腿四处奔跑，站不稳也毫不在意，摔倒了就顺势滚回站姿。不过，种子一碰到地面，就会炸开一片火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly run about on their short legs. Their lack of balance doesn't hinder them; when they fall, they simply roll back onto their feet. If their bulbs touch the ground, they release an explosion of sparks.

entry: POKENAME是同一株植物的种子组成的集群，彼此共享意识。身体分为脸部和种子：脸部负责认路、战斗，种子则负责收集能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME function as a hivemind of seeds from the same plant. Their bodies are divided into faces and bulbs, with the faces handling navigation and fighting, while the bulbs gather energy.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶片都来自同一颗种子，在体内构成了小小的生态系统。三颗头以心灵感应交谈，谁来打扰，叶片就会向外伸展，将其赶走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The leaves atop POKENAME sprout from a single bulb, creating a miniature ecosystem within its body. The three heads communicate telepathically, with its leaves extending outward to repel anyone who interrupts them.

entry: POKENAME戴着陶土做的头骨，纪念妙蛙种子祖先，还会用鲜花装饰，礼赞生命。它们把种子伸出的藤蔓当作鞭子，抽击之力足以在地面刻出深痕。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wear clay skulls to honor their Bulbasaur ancestors, decorating them with flowers to celebrate life. They wield vines from their bulbs as whips, striking hard enough to carve into the ground.

entry: POKENAME善于操纵藤蔓，能挖出隧道，或拖来倒木搭建住处。随着它们成长为战士，装饰用的头骨逐渐开裂，恰如背上的种子渐渐绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With masterful vine control, POKENAME carve tunnels or pull fallen trees to create shelter. Their decorative skulls crack as they mature, reflecting the blooming of their bulbs as they grow into warriors.

entry: POKENAME的四肢由盘卷藤蔓构成，能伸长攻击范围，也能有力跳跃。它们是骄傲的战士，可踢击较量时，双腿却经常缠在一起。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's limbs are made of coiled vines, allowing them to extend for greater reach or powerful leaps. POKENAME are proud fighters, but in kicking matches, their legs often tangle together.

entry: POKENAME拳力惊人，却更喜欢晒太阳冥想。被迫战斗时，会用藤蔓裹住拳头，减轻第一拳的力道，仅作警告。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While POKENAME possess incredible punching strength, they prefer meditating in sunlight to fighting. When forced to fight, they wrap vines around their fists to cushion the first blow as a warning shot.

entry: POKENAME用长舌卷住树果灌木，摇下所有树果。唾液含有帮助植物生长的特殊花蜜，让树果更频繁地结出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME grab berry bushes with their long tongues and shake them to gather all of the berries. Their tongues contain saliva with special nectar that helps plants grow, resulting in more frequent berry supplies.

entry: POKENAME不断产生比空气轻的孢子，让自己飞行。愤怒时放出孢子毒害敌人，自己却会无法移动，直到重新长出足够飞行的孢子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's body constantly produces spores lighter than air, allowing it to fly. When angered, POKENAME release spores to poison foes, leaving them immobile until enough spores regenerate for flight.

entry: POKENAME中央的种子宛如一座发电厂，吸收日光，制造能托起身体的轻盈孢子。遇敌时，POKENAME会将孢子混上毒液喷出去，自保御敌。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb at the center of POKENAME acts as a power plant, gathering sunlight and producing spores light enough to lift its body. POKENAME mix these spores with poison to spray as a defense.

entry: POKENAME挥舞藤蔓冲进战斗。只有敌人在正前方才会动角，先以藤蔓缠住对方，再给出最后一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charge into battle, lashing with vines. They only use their horns if their enemy is directly in front, wrapping them in vines before delivering the finishing blow.

entry: POKENAME的大种子为长途奔跑提供能量，因此它总用尾巴护着种子。长长的角则用来采摘树果，与尚未进化的同类分享。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's large bulbs provide energy for long runs, so they keep them protected with their tails. They use their long horns to pick berries and share them with pre-evolutions.

entry: POKENAME会把种子抱进特别的育儿袋，细心保护。种子通过光合作用积蓄能量，再传给POKENAME的身体，两者相依共生。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cradle and protect a bulb in their special pouches. The bulb gathers energy through photosynthesis, which transfers to the POKENAME's body, creating a symbiotic relationship.

entry: 与大多数妙蛙种子融合体不同，POKENAME没有自己的种子。它们会让流浪的妙蛙种子住进育儿袋，视如己出地照顾。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unlike most Bulbasaur fusions, POKENAME lack a bulb of their own. Instead, they offer their pouches to stray Bulbasaur, caring for them as if they were their own.

entry: POKENAME贴着水面下方游动，只把种子的尖端露出来晒太阳，以免引起天敌注意。若有人碰了种子，它们就会怒气冲冲地喷出气泡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel just below the water's surface, with the tips of their bulbs above to absorb sunlight without attracting predators. Disturbing their bulbs triggers furious bubble sprays.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺保护种子，内侧却光滑平整，让种子安稳地躺在其中。游动时，它们会从种子或吻部喷出气泡，推动身体前进。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use sharp spines to protect their bulbs, with the smooth interiors cradling them securely. They propel through water by spraying bubbles from their bulbs or snouts.

entry: POKENAME用叶状尾巴混入藻类与海草中。在向阳处休息积蓄能量，便能走得更远，寻找需要照料的珊瑚礁。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their leafy tails to blend into algae and seaweed. They rest in sunlit spots to gather energy, allowing them to travel farther as they search for coral reefs to tend.

entry: POKENAME偏爱深水，比多数妙蛙种子融合体需要的阳光更少。身上的绿斑吸收光线，产生孢子，让它藏进浑水里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Preferring deep waters, POKENAME require less sunlight than most Bulbasaur fusions. Green spots on their bodies absorb light and produce spores to disguise them in murky waters.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸漂流，吸收阳光，将能量储存在宝石中。夜间的亮光宛如散落在沙滩上的星座。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift along shores, absorbing sunlight and storing energy in their jewels. At night, the glowing jewels appear like constellations scattered along the beach.

entry: POKENAME以复杂的手势挥动双手，用超能力促进植物生长。动作虽看似随意，却总热切展示这份独特的表演。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wave their hands in intricate patterns to help plants grow with their psychic powers. Though the motions seem random, they eagerly show off their unique performances.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的手臂翻土，种下一排排种子。只有花园受到威胁时，才会挥刃战斗。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their blade-like arms to dig into soil and plant rows of seeds. They only wield their blades in combat if someone or something threatens their gardens.

entry: POKENAME从森林收集叶子，制成精致长裙。十分自豪于自己的表演，日出时会在草地上歌唱，迎接新的一天。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather leaves from the forest to fashion into elaborate gowns. They pride themselves on their performances, singing in grassy fields at sunrise to welcome the new day.

entry: POKENAME会飞快地旋转双臂发电，为种子充能。充满电后，种子会明亮发光，还能释放带电的孢子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spin their arms rapidly to generate electricity and charge their bulbs. Once fully charged, the bulbs glow brightly and can release electrified spores.

entry: POKENAME从种子中释放极易燃烧的孢子。孢子像烟雾一样翻涌，将敌人包围、削弱，随后便会燃起火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release highly flammable spores from their bulbs. These spores billow like smoke, surrounding foes to weaken them before setting them aflame.

entry: POKENAME用叶子包住角，以免照料种子时划断树木。不包住的角，眨眼就能将树切成两半。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap leaves around their horns to avoid tearing through trees as they tend to seeds. Unwrapped horns can slice trees in half in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME在农场很受欢迎，能用藤蔓尾巴帮忙拉犁。颈部的叶子让它即使在田间工作，也能吸收阳光获取能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very popular on farms, where they use their vine tails to help pull plows. The leaves around their necks help them gather sunlight for energy even while they work in the fields.

entry: 与鲤鱼王不同，POKENAME会主动跃上陆地，用叶状的鳍吸收阳光。不过，想顺利回到水里依然很费劲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unlike Magikarp, POKENAME intentionally leap onto land to absorb sunlight through their leafy fins. However, they still struggle to navigate back into the water efficiently.

entry: POKENAME带领宝可梦在森林游行，庆祝春天。沿途收集脚下的叶子、种下嫩苗，回湖泊时再为它们浇水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME lead parades of Pokémon through forests to celebrate springtime. They gather leaves underfoot, planting sprouts as they travel and watering them on their return to lakes.

entry: POKENAME会把迷路或疲惫的宝可梦轻轻安置在种子里，载着它们长途跋涉。光合作用和POKENAME的冰之力量，共同调节着里面的温度。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME transport lost or tired Pokémon great distances, gently cradling them in their bulbs. The temperature in the bulbs is regulated by photosynthesis and POKENAME's ice powers.

entry: POKENAME用胶状的身体穿行于树根间。找到僻静处后，便稍稍探出身子，让种子晒到阳光，自己则装成嫩芽，融入周围的植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their gelatinous bodies to navigate tree roots. When they find a secluded spot, they emerge slightly to let their bulbs absorb sunlight, mimicking sprouts to blend in.

entry: POKENAME适应力极强，几乎在哪里都能生存。人们认为，背上的种子会随当地气候，开出功用不同的花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly adaptable and able to thrive in nearly any environment. It is believed that the bulbs on their back sprout flowers of different functions depending on the climate they live in.

entry: POKENAME住在森林河流中，用鳍反射日光，吓退敌人。它们还会把尾巴浸入水中，从种子释放孢子，帮助净化河水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living in forest rivers, POKENAME use their fins to reflect sunlight to repel attackers. They dip their tails into rivers and release spores from their bulbs to help purify the water.

entry: 深居雨林的POKENAME靠电力而非日光，为种子积蓄能量。暴风雨中，它们奔走于树冠，宛如活的避雷针，赶在闪电劈中树木前将其引走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living deep within rainforests, POKENAME use their bulbs to store energy from electricity instead of sunlight. They run across treetops during storms, acting as lightning rods to catch stray bolts before they can strike trees.

entry: 生活在热带的POKENAME，用叶片般的尾巴与鬃毛吸收日光，将能量储存在种子里。光合作用产生的多余能量化为热量，让种子能喷出火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living in tropical climates, POKENAME use their leafy tails and manes to absorb energy from sunlight and store it in their bulbs. The excess energy from their photosynthesis runs hot, allowing them to produce flame from their bulbs.

entry: 据说POKENAME的程序原为创造数字景观而设，却会飘过田野播种。种子完全是有机的，每逢开工，它却总会哼出奇怪的五音合鸣。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have been programmed to help create digital landscapes, POKENAME float through fields to plant seeds. While the seeds are completely organic, POKENAME always seem to buzz in an odd chorus of five notes whenever they start their work.

entry: POKENAME的壳由叶绿体构成，躲在里面也能不断通过光合作用获取能量。不过，壳的额外重量让它更容易疲劳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's shell is made out of chloroplasts, allowing the body to constantly gain energy from photosynthesis even when hiding within them. The additional weight of the shell causes POKENAME to tire out more frequently.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓帮忙搬运壳，也会在光合作用时护住它。壳若破裂，就会射出带刺种子，既用于自卫，也帮助长出新壳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their vines to help carry their shells during travel or protect them during photosynthesis. If their shells ever crack, they will shoot off spiny seeds as both a defense mechanism and a way to grow a new one.

entry: 据说POKENAME是远古植物的遗存。白天爬上岸，从阳光中汲取养分；夜间回到水中，将多余的叶片洒在波浪间。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to be remnants of ancient plants, POKENAME crawl onto shore during the day to absorb nutrients from sunlight. At night, they return to the water, shedding any spare leaves along the waves.

entry: POKENAME将手臂长出的叶子塑成刀刃，争夺海滩上阳光充足的领地。刀刃有特殊弧度，游泳时便于划水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion blades out of the leaves that grow from their arms and use them to fight over sunny territories on beaches. They design the blades with specialized curves that help them catch the water as they swim.

entry: POKENAME在高空展开双翼吸收阳光，在下方投出可怕的影子。据说它们曾从树顶统治远古森林，尖啸能震落树叶。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spread their wings high in the sky to absorb sunlight, casting a fearsome shadow below them. It is believed that these Pokémon ruled ancient forests from the treetops, their piercing cries causing leaves to fall from trees.

entry: POKENAME漫步林间，尽可能多地收集树果。吃不完的就存进种子，留待下次；若还没到饭点就困了，它会先把树果分给小型宝可梦，再去睡觉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander through forests to gather as many berries as they can. Whatever they don't eat is stored in their bulbs for later. If a POKENAME gets tired before their next meal, they will share the berries with smaller Pokémon before they sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在冬季首日或末日现身，孢子既能聚雪，也能清雪。它制造的霜能护住植物过冬，让来年春天长得更强健。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to appear on the first or last day of winter, POKENAME's spores can either help collect or clear snow. The frost that POKENAME creates can preserve plants through the winter, allowing them to grow back stronger the following spring.

entry: POKENAME披着雷云飞行，用闪电为种子充能。待风雨散去，便射出灿烂的光束；凝聚的能量照到哪里，哪里的植物就加速生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flies cloaked in storm clouds, charging its bulb with lightning before producing radiant beams when the storm clears. These concentrated beams of energy will accelerate the growth of plants they touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME由误陷野火的嫩芽获得生命。会用翅膀聚拢火焰，将其引离自然环境。周身覆火后发出的光，还能帮助附近植物进行光合作用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have been brought to life from a stray sprout caught in a wildfire, POKENAME gathers fire along its wings to redirect it away from nature. Once cloaked in flame, POKENAME will emit light to aid in photosynthesis in its environment.

entry: POKENAME小心地盘绕在自己的种子周围，谁来威胁就猛然出击。不过，肯花心思好好训练它的人，会发现POKENAME既忠诚，又十分亲人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Carefully coiled around their bulbs, POKENAME will lash out at anyone that threatens them.  Those that take the time to properly train POKENAME will find them to be deeply loyal and affectionate.

entry: POKENAME把光合作用的能量储存在尾部的种子里。能量沿身体流转，使它能从颈间的圆珠喷出奇异火焰，或从角上射出耀眼的光束。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store energy from photosynthesis in the bulbs on their tails. This energy travels along the POKENAME's body, allowing them to produce mystical flames from the orbs on their necks or beams of radiant light from their horns.

entry: POKENAME虽然高大，却温顺友善。愤怒时会喷出火流，其中的神秘力量只伤害招惹它的对象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are very docile and friendly Pokémon. If angered, they will shoot a stream of flames from their mouths. These flames contain mystical powers, only harming those that have incurred a POKENAME's wrath.

entry: 据说关都的第一棵树，来自POKENAME种下的种子。它飞遍各地，照料森林与嫩苗。笑起来时，周围会绽放鲜艳的花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have planted a seed that sprouted into the first tree in Kanto, POKENAME flies throughout the region to look after the growth of forests and budding sprouts. When POKENAME laughs, flowers bloom around it in vivid colors.

entry: 与妙蛙种子融合后，芭瓢虫变得更怕冷。POKENAME大部分时间都在晒太阳积蓄能量，以度过寒冷天气。
author: darkweavile428
source: Fusing with Bulbasaur has made Ledyba even more sensitive to the cold. POKENAME spends most of its time gathering energy from the sun to survive days with cold weather.

entry: POKENAME晴天吸收阳光，阴天积蓄电力，因此总是活力充沛。
author: darkweavile428
source: On sunny days POKENAME will absorb the sun's rays and on cloudy days it will charge electricity. As a result, POKENAME is often full of energy.

entry: 阳光直射会大幅加快进化。必要时，POKENAME会用藤蔓挪动身体，走出阴影。
author: kandyman
source: Exposure to direct sunlight will dramatically speed up the evolution process. POKENAME will use its vines to move out of shadows if necessary.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在茂密海带林底部。毫无察觉地闯进领地的宝可梦，会立刻遭到巨大种子的射击。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME is often found at the bottom of dense kelp forests. Oblivious Pokémon that wander into its territory are immediately shot with massive seeds.

entry: POKENAME兴高采烈地采来树果，在携带的种子里调制药液。等药液调好，它们便把种子种下，让其长成叶色缤纷的美丽树木。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly gather berries to brew into potions within the bulbs they carry. Once their concoctions are ready, they plant the bulbs that will grow into beautiful trees with leaves of various colors.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞行，从种子中释放孢子云，让敌人中毒、逐渐虚弱。平时，它们则会降低孢子的毒性，反过来为同伴疗伤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly around their opponents, releasing clouds of spores from their bulbs to poison them and wear them down. Outside of battle, they reduce the toxicity of the spores to heal damage done to their allies instead.

entry: POKENAME平时喜欢独处，可一旦背上的种子受到威胁，就会用毒角发动攻击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME tend to keep to themselves. If it feels that the bulb on its back is threatened, however, it will attack with its poisonous horns.

entry: POKENAME头上的食肉嫩芽刚长出不久，还不聪明，要靠身体引导。若不按时喂食，就会发脾气，试着将自己从身体上撕下来。
author: mistymagius
source: The carnivorous sprout on POKENAME's head is newly developed and not very intelligent, relying on the body to guide it. If it's not fed regularly, it throws a tantrum and tries to rip itself from the body.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处、绿意盎然的隐秘洞穴里。若能偶然遇上它，人们认为，附近必有令人惊叹的景象。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME lives in hidden, greenery-filled caves deep underground. To find one naturally is considered a sign you are near an awe-inspiring sight.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵护着后脑的种子，也像太阳能板一样吸收日光，通过光合作用产生能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have large ears to protect the bulbs on the back of their heads. These ears act as solar panels, absorbing sunlight to produce energy through photosynthesis.

entry: 这只形似棍棒、被幽灵附身的宝可梦，若发现敲打没用，就会从种子般的头部，喷射植物弹丸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When bludgeoning won't do the job, this haunted, club-like Pokémon expels plant-based projectiles from its seed head.

entry: POKENAME用头上的角挪开树根，整理出睡觉的位置。睡时只露出头和种子，清晨便能通过光合作用积蓄能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the horns on their head to move roots at the bases of trees, creating a sleeping spot. They sleep with only their heads and bulbs above ground, gathering energy in the morning through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME虽然高大，却很会照料生命。会带着幼苗掘地，以大耳朵收集阳光，再通过光合作用滋养土壤，培育新树。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are very nurturing Pokémon. They burrow with sprouts, gathering sunlight in their large ears and enriching the soil through photosynthesis to grow new trees.

entry: POKENAME从背上发射种子，种出茂密森林，以此塑造大陆。随着它进化，曾种下的树木也变得更坚韧。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is known for shaping continents by launching seeds from its back that sprout into dense forests. As it evolves, the trees that it once planted become more resilient.

entry: 满月之夜，它们奇异的种子会发出光芒。据说，POKENAME的种子里藏着月之石，能引导神秘力量，让它们飞上天空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Their strange bulbs glow on nights of the full moon. It is said that a POKENAME's bulb contains Moon Stones that channel their mystical powers and allow them to fly.

entry: POKENAME的几颗种子里装着不同的孢子：左边使人中毒，右边使人麻痹，后面的则让人昏睡。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulbs are filled with different spores. The left shoots out poison, the right one stuns, and the back makes you sleep.

entry: 满月照耀的花园里，POKENAME会从种子中放出奇异而神秘的光，让花朵绽放出鲜艳的色彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Appearing in gardens under the light of the full moon, POKENAME release a strange, mystical light from their bulbs that helps flowers bloom in vivid color.

entry: POKENAME的种子里装满了易燃液体。为了不洒出一滴，它总是摇摇摆摆地慢慢走。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulb is filled to the brim with flammable liquid. It waddles slowly to avoid spilling a single drop.

entry: 常能看见它们的尾巴上开着花。随POKENAME栖息环境不同，每条尾巴还能长出不同种类的花。
author: kitarchen
source: They can often be spotted with flowers on their tails. Each tail can grow a different flower species on it depending on the POKENAME's environment.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时会左右摇摆，让花苞里的种子沙沙作响。可若有人听着歌安然睡去，POKENAME反而会生气地喷出孢子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: As POKENAME sing, they sway back and forth, rattling the seeds inside their bulb. If people fall asleep from the soothing song, POKENAME spray spores from their bulb in anger.

entry: POKENAME必须小心，免得尾巴上的火焰烧到背上的种子。万一烧坏了，种子可能要花上数周才能重新长好。
author: benevolent
source: POKENAME has to be careful not to accidentally burn its bulb with the flame on its tail. If that happens, it can take weeks for the bulb to grow back.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: POKENAME把种子鼓起来，借此飞翔。唱歌时，它们还会沿途撒播小种子，种出供人歇脚的美丽花园。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME inflate their bulbs to fly. As they sing, they scatter seeds from their bulbs, creating beautiful gardens where people can rest.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在洞穴侧壁，只让种子晒着太阳。夜里，它们收集树果，种在洞口附近，方便日后采食。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep on the sides of caves during the day, exposing only their bulbs to sunlight. At night, they gather berries and plant them near their caves for easier access.

entry: POKENAME攻击性很强，会不停袭击附近的虫宝可梦。它常在阳光下休息，让绿色的羽毛恢复健康。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME are aggressive, and relentlessly attack nearby bug Pokémon. It often rests in the sunlight, which heals its green feathers.

entry: POKENAME把尖牙扎进树干，为种子吸取养分，洞口附近因此常有枯树。不过吸得太多，种子就会重得让它们飞不起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sink their fangs into trees to absorb nutrients for their bulbs, often leaving withered trees near cave entrances. Drinking too much can make their bulbs too heavy to fly.

entry: POKENAME的下半身白天吸收阳光，夜里微微发亮。会借光引来猎物，再用毒针将其击昏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The lower body of a POKENAME absorbs energy from sunlight during the day and glows faintly at night. POKENAME draw in prey with this glow and shoot them with poisonous needles to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME的身体比背上的种子还小，住在花园里，靠人类或宝可梦照料。受到善待、身体健康的POKENAME，种子会变成更深的绿色，渐渐露出新芽。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Smaller than the bulbs they carry, POKENAME live in gardens, relying on people or Pokémon to care for them. Healthy POKENAME with a good home grow darker green bulbs with budding signs.

entry: POKENAME飞在翻涌的白云间，收集日光，让背上的种子茁壮成长。
author: deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the billowing white clouds, collecting sunlight for the seed on its back to grow.

entry: POKENAME的叶片厚实得惊人，上面常留着大块咬痕。尖刺能喷出较温和的毒液，主要用来削弱对手的体力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaves are incredibly thick and can be seen with large bite marks taken out of them. Its thorns eject a mild poison that is mainly used to physically weaken its opponents.

entry: POKENAME已经足够强壮，能稳稳托起头上的种子，也会照料自己居住的花园。它们让种子储满养分，再埋身花丛，休息时也滋养着土壤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Strong enough to support the bulbs on their head, POKENAME care for the gardens they call home. They gather nutrients in their bulbs and bury themselves among flowers, enriching the soil as they rest.

entry: POKENAME种子上长出的叶片，渐渐包住了整个身体。它们大部分时间藏在树根之间，吸取养分，让叶片继续生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The leaves from POKENAME's bulbs have grown to wrap around their main body. They spend most of their time hiding among tree roots, draining nutrients to grow their leaves.

entry: POKENAME偏爱农场，用藤蔓帮忙照料土壤。会以毒孢子麻痹打作物主意的昆虫，再带走当食物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME prefer to live on farms, where they use their vines to help tend the soil. POKENAME use their toxic spores to paralyze any insects after the crops and then take them away as their own food.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: POKENAME每天醒来，都会先打理自己的种子。种子散发的辛香气息，也让它们精神一振。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME start their day by grooming their bulbs. In doing so, the spices that they excrete perk them up.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME真正的身体是什么样子，只知道头部保护着一颗种子。种子能连接附近的树根，让POKENAME随心所欲地指挥植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the true body of a POKENAME looks like, only that it contains a bulb the head protects. The bulb can connect to nearby roots, allowing POKENAME to command plants at will.

entry: 若地面上并排冒出三株嫩芽，就说明附近藏着钻入地下的POKENAME。它们围绕种子铺开根系，长出小小的森林或花园。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of three sprouts sticking out of the ground signals a nearby burrowed POKENAME. They create root networks around their bulbs, sprouting small forests or gardens.

entry: POKENAME住在树木最高的枝头，额头硬币与叶片融为一体。早晨将头探出叶间，吸收阳光进行光合作用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live in the highest branches of trees, where the coins on their foreheads blend into the leaves. In the mornings, they poke their heads through the leaves to absorb sunlight for photosynthesis.

entry: 头顶的种子泛起绿光时，POKENAME就能与植物交谈。不过这种能力会引发剧烈头痛，因此很少见它使用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When the bulb on POKENAME's head glows green, it can speak to plants. However, this ability causes severe headaches, making it a rare sight.

entry: POKENAME能在河流中飞快游动。休息时，它们将身体完全浸入水中，只露出种子，宛如一片长着叶子的睡莲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim through rivers at incredible speeds. When resting, they submerge their bodies completely, leaving only their bulb visible like a leafy lily pad.

entry: POKENAME住在最高的树梢，以便多晒太阳。若不在树顶，就会愤怒地攻击靠近者。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME lives on the tallest treetops to better absorb the sun's rays. When it is not on the treetops, POKENAME will become enraged and attack anyone who comes near.

entry: POKENAME敏捷活泼，靠四肢周围的藤蔓在树梢荡行。生气时会甩藤蔓打向惹怒自己的对象，却常把自己缠住。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are agile and energetic, using vines around their limbs to swing through treetops. When upset, they lash their vines at the source of their anger, often tangling themselves.

entry: POKENAME的毛发更像草叶。光合作用产生的能量储存在种子中，随后便能化作口中喷出的火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's fur resembles grass or leaves more than typical fur. They store energy from photosynthesis in their bulbs, releasing it as fire from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME覆着青草般的毛，黎明站在丘顶吸收阳光。咆哮释放的强光与高热，几分钟内就能烧毁或催生一片森林。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Covered in grass-like fur, POKENAME stand atop hills at dawn to gather sunlight. Their roar generates intense heat and light, capable of burning or growing forest sections in minutes.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的勺子传递治愈之力。用勺子挖洞种下的幼苗，很快就能长成健壮美丽的植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel healing power through the spoons they carry. Any sprout planted in a hole dug by their spoon grows quickly into a sturdy and beautiful plant.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，挥拳时释放的孢子反而会让对手精神振奋。它们只借此鼓励激战，从不用来妨碍敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Playful by nature, POKENAME release spores with their punches that energize opponents. They only use their spores to encourage intense battles, never to hinder their foes.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓在森林搭起拳击擂台训练。林间空地若飘出孢子雾，就说明它们正在举办比赛。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their vines to create boxing rings in the forest to train for battle. A fog of spores drifting from a forest clearing is a sign that a group of POKENAME are hosting a tournament.

entry: POKENAME以惊人力量著称，被视为森林中的冠军新秀。进化后常不习惯第二对手臂，于是用藤蔓协调动作。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protégé champions of the forest, known for their incredible strength. They often have trouble using their second pair of arms after evolving, so they use vines to stay organized.

entry: 萌动的幼苗获得意识后，以生长中的根构成身体，形成POKENAME。会缠住树木，混入叶间吸取能量，盼着有朝一日开花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are formed when a budding sprout gains sentience and forms a body from its developing roots. POKENAME wrap their bodies around trees to blend in with the leaves and drain energy in hopes of blooming someday.

entry: POKENAME在自己萌发的植物周围，长出了一副伪装的身体。它们用大嘴一口气收集、吃下许多树果，再把养分化为能量，供给中央的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Having grown a false body around the plant they sprouted from, POKENAME use their wide mouths to collect and eat berries all at once. The nutrients are converted into energy for their central bulb.

entry: 种子已占据身体大半的POKENAME，一心收集足够的食物与能量，等待开花。它们会用藤蔓搬来倒木，在种子中溶解，吸收其中的养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their bulbs now making up most of their body, POKENAME focus on collecting enough food and energy to bloom. They use their vines to gather fallen trees, dissolving them in their bulbs for nutrients.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME钟形外壳下的内部模样。只知道它会伸出藤蔓，在水中移动，直到找到向阳处休息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the inside of a POKENAME looks like beneath their outer bell. It is only known that they sprout vines that help them navigate around the water until they find sunny spots to rest.

entry: POKENAME用众多藤蔓保护头上长出的种子。没人知道藤蔓究竟从何处伸出，只知道它们似乎转瞬就能再生，甚至越长越多。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their multitude of vines to protect the bulbs growing from their heads. It is unknown where these vines stem from, but POKENAME seem to be able to regenerate or multiply them near instantly.

entry: POKENAME睡在洞口或崖壁上，与覆满苔藓的岩石融为一体。滚动时，它们用坚固的身体和粗壮的双臂，护住背上的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep at cave entrances or on cliff walls, blending in with mossy rocks. They use their durable bodies and large arms to protect the bulbs on their backs as they roll around.

entry: POKENAME不习惯用手臂，主要靠藤蔓在山坡移动。滚下山时会沿途播种，长出新的森林。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unaccustomed to using their arms, POKENAME navigate mountain slopes primarily with their vines. As they roll down mountains, they scatter seeds to create new forests.

entry: POKENAME身边已形成完整的生态系统，原来的种子在进化后硬化成了岩石。身上的花朵既能射出去，炸出密集弹幕，也能长成藤蔓发动攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: An entire ecosystem has sprouted around POKENAME's body, with their former bulbs hardening into rocks after evolution. The flowers on their body can be launched in explosive barrages or grown into vines for attacks.

entry: POKENAME把光合作用产生的热量储存在背上的种子里。种子伸出的藤蔓燃着火焰，让它能从对手身旁飞驰而过，打出强劲的一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store heat generated from photosynthesis in the bulbs on their back. Flaming vines sprout from these bulbs, letting them deliver strong attacks while speeding past opponents.

entry: 光合作用积蓄的热量，会从POKENAME身上喷发，化为火焰鬃毛。战斗时，它们按复杂的路线奔跑，让藤蔓穿过鬃毛点燃后发动攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Heat gathered through photosynthesis erupts from POKENAME as a fiery mane. In battle, they run in complex patterns, aiming vines through the mane to ignite them for attacks.

entry: POKENAME到湖岸晒太阳，却经常拖延到日头很晚才出门。光合作用不足，能量更少，于是又陷入相同的循环。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander lake shores to bask in sunlight but often delay, going out late in the day. This incomplete photosynthesis leaves them with less energy, perpetuating the cycle.

entry: POKENAME坐在林中的湖畔，把尾部的种子泡在水里。野生宝可梦常来吸食其中的蜜，它却往往呆呆的，浑然不觉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sit by lake shores in forests, resting the bulbs on their tails in the water. Wild Pokémon often drink nectar from their bulbs, but POKENAME are usually too dazed to notice.

entry: POKENAME共有三副身体，中央大脑就藏在主身背上的种子中。释放电力时，种子会微微展开，身上的螺钉也随之发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The central brain of POKENAME's three bodies is stored in the bulb on the back of the main body. When releasing electricity, the bulb unfurls slightly, and the screws on their bodies glow.

entry: POKENAME把大葱鸭的大葱换成了从身体里长出的藤蔓。它把藤蔓当成鞭子，能从很远的地方抽出强劲的攻击。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME has traded Farfetch'd's leek for a vine that grows from its body. It uses it like a whip to deliver powerful lashes from a long distance.

entry: 与许多妙蛙种子融合体相比，POKENAME的种子更大，好让一副身体的光合作用养活两颗头。它们站在晴朗的田野，不时转动身体，让两颗头均匀晒暖。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have larger bulbs than many other Bulbasaur fusions to support two heads with the photosynthesis of one body. They stand in sunny fields, turning back and forth to heat their heads evenly.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已长成一片茂密的枝叶，让三颗头都能均匀地晒到太阳。不过，打理叶片时，三颗头常会拌嘴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back has sprouted into a leafy patch, allowing all three heads to absorb sunlight evenly. The heads often squabble as they maintain the leaves.

entry: 比起许多小海狮融合体，POKENAME更喜欢热带。它们在丛林河流中游动，让种子露出水面晒太阳，休息时则躺在浅水的岩石间，用藤蔓铺好临时的床。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Preferring more tropical climates to many Seel fusions, POKENAME swim along jungle rivers with their bulbs above the water to absorb sunlight. POKENAME will rest among rocks in shallow water, using vines to help arrange makeshift beds.

entry: POKENAME被视为热带河流的守护者，会用角清理河道里的杂物。它宽大的身躯能庇护小型宝可梦，有时还会让它们吸食种子里的蜜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protectors of tropical rivers, using their horns to clear debris. POKENAME shelter smaller Pokémon using their large bodies, even letting some drink nectar from their bulbs.

entry: 受污染植物释放的过量孢子，凝成了有意识的淤泥。淤泥守护着逐渐长大的种子，试图挽回自己曾经作为嫩芽的模样。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Excess spores from a polluted plant have condensed into a sentient sludge. The sludge protects the bulb as it grows, trying to salvage the sprout it once was.

entry: 受污染植物的孢子突变成了怪物。POKENAME战斗时洒出的污泥，会污染周围植物，甚至使其突变。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Spores from a polluted plant have mutated into a monstrous form. When POKENAME fight, they scatter sludge that can pollute or mutate nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME是一种体型庞大、以双足行走的爬行动物宝可梦。它最醒目的特征，是出生时便种在背上的那颗种子。
author: kames
source: POKENAME is a large, bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. Its most notable feature is the bulb on its back which was planted on it at birth.

entry: POKENAME壳顶含有叶绿体，帮助进行光合作用。壳里积沙后，会拿来种植物，再留在岸边。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The top of POKENAME's shell contains chloroplasts that aid in photosynthesis. When sand collects in their shells, they use it to grow plants and leave them along the shore.

entry: 藻类聚在POKENAME壳内，形成微型生态系统。它会指挥藻类如藤蔓般抓住目标，不断收集生长所需的材料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Collections of algae gather within POKENAME's shell, forming a miniature ecosystem. They command the algae to grab targets like vines, constantly gathering materials to grow.

entry: 黎明前，花园嫩芽间会冒出闪烁的奇异绿焰。那其实是POKENAME的孢子，正在照料植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Just before dawn, strange flickering green flames can be seen emanating from garden sprouts. These flames are actually POKENAME spores, tending to the plants.

entry: 据说，游魂附在初生的嫩芽上，就会形成POKENAME。它们无声地飞过夜空，吸走毫无防备的猎物的生命力，让背上的种子绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are said to form when wandering spirits possess budding sprouts. They silently fly at night, draining life force from unsuspecting prey to help their bulbs bloom.

entry: 迷失的灵魂附在萌芽的植物上，吸收周围生命的养分，直到长出完整身体。它们以POKENAME的姿态继续游荡、积蓄力量，背上的种子也慢慢绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When lost spirits possess budding plants, they absorb the nutrients of living things around them until they are able to grow a full body. These spirits wander as POKENAME to continue building their strength, the bulbs on their backs slowly blooming.

entry: 据说，靠近地表的大岩蛇长出能进行光合作用的种子后，就变成了POKENAME。种子的根系贯穿岩石身体，织成一张能伸缩自如的藤蔓网。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME formed when Onix near the surface of the ground sprouted bulbs for photosynthesis. The bulb's roots have grown through their rocky body, forming a network of extendable vines.

entry: POKENAME从种子释放孢子，让人类和宝可梦沉睡，再吸取梦中的能量。梦越甜美，种子绽放时就越灿烂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release spores from their bulbs that put people and Pokémon to sleep, absorbing energy from their dreams. The sweeter the dream, the brighter their bulbs bloom.

entry: POKENAME以共生的方式生活。种子为主体提供温暖与住处，主体则借助种子长出的藤蔓，伸展利爪，保护种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME exist in a symbiotic relationship where the bulb provides warmth and shelter for the main body. In return, the main body defends the bulb with extendable claws powered by vines sprouting from it.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩横着跑，寻找临水的地方钻洞。它们用大钳盛起海水，再借光合作用的能量将水煮沸，用蒸馏出的水汽浇灌种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run sideways along beaches in order to find spots to burrow near the water. They gather seawater in their large claws and boil it using energy from photosynthesis, using the distilled vapor to water their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME会用脚底的吸盘爬上高树，让背上的种子，得到更多阳光。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME can be seen climbing tall trees using suction cups on its feet. This helps provide sunlight for the seed on its back.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拆下树间的蛛网，用来装树果，再送给其他同类。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME likes to tear down webs connected to trees. It uses these webs to hold Berries in order to deliver them to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从头上的红色触角释放气味，标记领地，也驱走那些打扰它晒太阳的天敌。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME mark their territory by releasing an odor from the red antenna on their head. This wards off predators that disturb its sun bathing.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却很弱，因此常被飞行属性宝可梦当成量多好抓的食物。它们默默忍受袭击，极少反击。
author: sontyp
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are weak Pokémon, so Flying-Type Pokémon often hunt them as an easy source of plentiful food. POKENAME endure those attacks stoically and rarely fight back.

entry: 虽然常被人看轻，POKENAME还是整天训练，一心想要变强。它总爱向远比自己强大的对手挑战。
author: jackythewannabe
source: Considered weak by many, POKENAME spends all day training, hoping to grow stronger. It tends to pick fights against opponents far stronger than it.

entry: 春季，POKENAME背上的花会散出甜香花粉，让人类与宝可梦都感到安宁。
author: curerry
source: During the springtime, POKENAME releases a sweet smelling pollen from the flower on its back. This pollen is soothing to both humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用巨颚吞食找到的一切植物。无尽的食欲让它连远比自己大的草属性宝可梦也想吃，全然不顾危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its large jaws to devour any plant matter it can find. Its insatiable hunger drives it to attempt eating even much larger Grass Pokémon, regardless of the danger.

entry: POKENAME已重得无法住在树上。不过，它的力气也大得惊人，再不必躲躲藏藏，反能将敌人打得落荒而逃。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to live on trees. Thanks to its great physical strength, however, it no longer has to hide, but can put enemies to rout.

entry: 修长而分节的身体，让它能钻过狭窄的缝隙。只要POKENAME的头能伸进去，整副身子也就能挤过去。
author: melodydelune
source: Its long, segmented body allows it to squirm its way through narrow openings. Anything POKENAME can stick its head through, it can squirm through.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，一跃能达100英尺。似乎很爱叶菜，尤其是生菜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have extremely strong legs, allowing them to cover 100 feet in a single bound. They seem to a have a fondness for leafy vegetables, lettuce in particular.

entry: POKENAME沿着一根树枝挪动，都要花上几个小时。可附近的叶子一吃完，它便吐丝牵住另一棵树，飞快地荡过去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME takes hours to move along a branch. However, once it has eaten all the nearby leaves, it uses string to swing at high speeds to a new tree.

entry: POKENAME载着绿毛虫穿过宽阔水域，寻找食物、建立新群落。同伴会送上最大的树果作为回报。
author: mirpebble
source: POKENAME carries Caterpie across large bodies of water to find food and form new colonies. In return, the colony gives POKENAME the largest berries.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子里蓄着不稳定的电能，受到干扰就可能引发大爆炸。它用电线般的藤蔓，从植物中抽取能量。
author: mistymagius
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back contains unstable electrical energy, and disrupting it could cause a large explosion. It uses its wire-like vines to siphon energy from plant matter.

entry: 暴风雨之夜，成群POKENAME会出来，用杆状触角引雷。性情好斗，常互相电击取乐。
author: mistymagius
source: During stormy nights, swarms of POKENAME emerge to draw lightning bolts with their rod-like antennae. They are aggressive Pokémon, often shocking each other for fun.

entry: 捡到霹雳电球的外壳当头盔，如今已与头部融为一体。POKENAME还能借用其中一些力量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This Pokémon picked up the shell of a Voltorb and wore it as a helmet. It is now fused to its head, and POKENAME borrows some of its power.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛中蓄着强大电力，最好不要触碰。那些在羊毛里盘旋的电流，还能从尾巴射出去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's wool is highly energized, so it is not advisable to touch it. It can shoot the electricity swirling around in its wool via its tail.

entry: POKENAME把体内产生的电力，导入颈毛与毛簇。必要时，再由尾巴聚成一束射出。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME directs the electricity generated in its body into its ruff and tuft. If necessary, it can shoot it in a bundle via its tail.

entry: 出现爆炸的噩梦中，很可能会有POKENAME的身影。腹内的漆黑圆珠，维系着它的生命与健康。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME will likely appear in nightmares that have explosions in them. The dark orb in its stomach keeps it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME一落地就会猛烈爆炸。曾有人猜测它是战时科学家制造的武器，但这传闻已被证实不实。
author: mistymagius
source: As soon as POKENAME hit the ground, their bodies erupt in a violent explosion. Some people theorized that scientists created POKENAME as a weapon during wartime, but this rumor has been proven false.

entry: POKENAME会投掷精灵球。有人推测，它们前世曾是训练家，至今还握着生前最心爱的那一颗。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to throw Poké Balls. It's been theorized that they were Trainers in a past life, and still hold their favorite Poké Ball.

entry: POKENAME极不稳定，任何情况下都不该靠近。受刺激就会怒而爆炸，电击周围的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely volatile and should not be approached under any circumstance. If agitated, they explode with anger and electrocute anything in their vicinity.

entry: 顽皮地啃咬电线，摄取电力。甲壳脆弱，状态极不稳定，哪怕轻微受损也会爆炸。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon will nibble on electrical lines to feed on electricity. Due to their weak carapaces, they are highly volatile and will explode if even slightly damaged.

entry: POKENAME并没有想象中那么依恋孩子。自己遇到生命危险，就会将孩子扔向敌人引爆。育儿袋一夜之间又会形成新的孩子。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is not as attached to its child as one might think. If its own life is in danger, it will throw the child at its enemies to cause an explosion. A new child is formed from its pouch overnight.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: POKENAME的球状嘴越大，储能越多，也越不稳定。面对更大的对手时，会先咬紧敌人，再引爆。
author: mistymagius
source: The larger POKENAME's orb-like mouth grows, the more energy it stores and the more volatile it becomes. When face to face with larger opponents, it will chomp down on its foe before detonating.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时火焰与花瓣一同迸散。同类交锋，它便以自己的爆炸回敬对方的爆炸。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's explosions are filled with bursts of fire and petals. When fighting one another, this Pokémon counters explosions with blasts of its own.

entry: POKENAME一爆炸，火光与花瓣便会四处飞散。建议训练家带它练练，如何控制怒气。
author: xenophacilus
source: The explosions POKENAME lets out burst with fire and flower petals. Trainers are advised to put this Pokémon in anger management training.

entry: POKENAME能蜷成精灵球模样躲藏。还能将自身电能塑成极复杂的图案，用于威吓和交流。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME are able to curl up to hide in such a way that they resemble a Poké Ball. They are also able to manipulate their innate electrical energy into extremely elaborate patterns as a means of both intimidation and communication.

entry: 能将电流导入拳头。笑容越大，存下的电量就越多。
author: lgreat
source: This Pokémon can channel electrical currents into its fists. The bigger the smile, the more electricity is stored.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖中储存的巨大能量引发猛烈爆炸。会带着令人胆寒的喜悦，炸毁找到的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the large amount of energy stored in its wand to summon massive explosions. It will blow up anything it can find with terrifying glee.

entry: POKENAME背着一颗巨大的种子。过上一阵，种子便会脱落，从中长出一只妙蛙树。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hold a giant seed on their back. After some time, the seed will fall off, and a Bulbator will grow from it.

entry: POKENAME自信十足，整天跑来跑去，爬上爬下，连家具也不放过，照料起来着实费神。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME are known to be very confident. Their spend their energy running around and climbing furniture, making them a challenge to take care of.

entry: POKENAME喜欢欺负其他幼小的宝可梦。早餐常不舍得自己吃，偏要拿来砸别人，恶作剧取乐。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME enjoys bullying other baby Pokémon. Its favorite prank involves throwing food at someone instead of eating its breakfast.

entry: POKENAME会充当蛋蛋的首领与守护者，保护它们等待进化。可它自己，其实也十分脆弱。
author: serversizeme
source: An POKENAME will act as the leader and protector for Exeggute while they prepare for Evolution. However, it is very fragile itself.

entry: POKENAME将蛋状的嘴放进其他宝可梦的巢中作陷阱，想吃掉前来偷蛋的宝可梦。对巢主与新孵出的幼崽，却十分友善。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME place their egg-like mouths in other Pokémon's nests as traps, attempting to eat any Pokémon that tries to steal them. Despite this, they are friendly to the parents and newly hatched babies.

entry: POKENAME最大的一簇胡须能充当巢穴，保护同胞。它产生的磁场让大家不至于彼此散开。
author: melodydelune
source: The largest part of POKENAME's moustache acts as a nest to protect its siblings. Its magnetic field keeps them from being separated.

entry: POKENAME为何折磨同族，生物学家至今不解。最受认可的说法，是它想压制同族成长，以免自己的地位被取代。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Biologists are perplexed as to why POKENAME tortures its kin. The most popular theory is that it is stunting their growth to prevent usurpation.

entry: 蛋与剑各是独立的生命，靠心灵感应相连。即使被分开，也会彼此吸引，重新合在一起。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The egg and sword are separate entities with a telepathic bond. They attract and rejoin each other after being separated.

entry: POKENAME的同胞，会从主体上萌发而出。主体产生的蛋黄供养着它们，直到能脱离主体，独立生活。
author: melodydelune
source: Its siblings bud off the main body of POKENAME. The yolk it produces feeds its siblings until they are able to split off onto their own.

entry: POKENAME的蛋看着诱人，吃起来却极辣。蛋里本就有充足的香料与盐，早已调好了味。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME eggs seem tempting to eat, but are very spicy. The eggs are well-seasoned with spices and salts.

entry: 这只刚出生的小家伙有点害羞。壳里的宝可梦不肯彻底钻出来，蛋壳便成了它的护甲。
author: theheroict
source: A hatchling who is a bit shy. The Pokémon within refuses to hatch fully, and its shell works as armor of sorts.

entry: POKENAME身上的培根太诱人，有些训练家竟忍不住咬自己的宝可梦。结果往往是脸上挨一记喷射火焰。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME bacon is so tempting to eat that some Trainers actually bite their Pokémon. This usually results in a Flamethrower to their face.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把蛋朝目标扔过去，可大得过头的钳子，有时会先把蛋夹碎。结果既糊了满脸蛋液，又丢尽面子。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME enjoys throwing its egg at targets. Sometimes its oversized pincer breaks the egg, causing it to have literal and figurative egg on its face.

entry: POKENAME背上的椰子会产生能安抚心绪的椰奶。宝可梦只喝一口，就会睡着。
author: dodoowner_
source: The coconut on POKENAME's back produces very soothing coconut milk. It can put Pokémon to sleep with just one sip.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会把育儿袋中的一只幼年蛋蛋扔向攻击者。虽然危险，蛋蛋们却很喜欢被这样抛来抛去。
author: teatedtiten
source: When startled, POKENAME will throw one of the baby Exeggcute in its pouches at the aggressor. The Exeggcute love being thrown around, even if it is dangerous for them.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: mistymagius
