source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: POKENAME从地里长出来，平时懒洋洋的，等猎物走近，才一口吞下。夜里，旁边的几颗头负责放哨。
author: theheroict
source: Grown from the ground, POKENAME tends to laze about, waiting for prey to come near before chowing down. The heads on the side keep watch at night.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: 在筑巢材料稀少的干旱地区，POKENAME便用骨头搭巢。它不善交友，可已有的朋友，每一个都十分珍惜。
author: leshii
source: In arid places where materials are scarce, POKENAME crafts a nest out of bones. It struggles to make friends, but deeply cherishes the ones it has.

entry: POKENAME戴着挚友的头骨，可身体渐长，已经快戴不下了。它独自巡飞，守望并保护领地里的宝可梦。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME wears the skull of a treasured friend, but is outgrowing it. It flies alone, keeping watch and protecting Pokémon within its territory.

entry: 美丽的羽毛，从POKENAME头骨盔的裂缝间伸出。它能发现几英里外的天敌，无声无息，迅速出手惩戒。
author: leshii
source: Beautiful feathers spill from the cracks of POKENAME's skull helmet. It can spot a predator from miles away, dispensing swift justice without a sound.

entry: 身体由灼热的沙子构成。POKENAME会用身上的骨头，将岩石敲碎、磨成沙，再吃下去。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is made of incredibly hot sand. POKENAME uses the bones on its body to break and grind down rocks to sand for consumption.

entry: POKENAME钻进洞壁，伪装成化石。会让假头骨的颚喀喀作响，吓退闯入者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow into the walls of caves to disguise as fossils, rattling the jaw of their false skull to scare off intruders.

entry: POKENAME是曾被认为灭绝的古老宝可梦，后来在沙漠深处被发现，那里鲜有其他草属性宝可梦。坚固的壳与头骨让它抵御恶劣天气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An ancient Pokémon thought extinct for some time, POKENAME has been discovered living deep in deserts with few other Grass-types around. POKENAME has a hardy shell and skull to protect itself from the harsh weather of its environment.

entry: 老学者说，这把骨匕首由孤独野兽的遗骸制成，还被它的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This bone dagger is said by old scholars to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.

entry: 没人见过POKENAME真正的脸。人们推测，它戴的头骨，属于一位已经逝去的族群伙伴。
author: melodydelune
source: No one has seen the true face of POKENAME. The skull it wears is theorized to be that of a pack member that passed on.

entry: 母亲离去后，POKENAME只能独自生存，成长中始终思念母亲的温暖。这份磨炼让它坚韧，能应对危险的海洋生活。
author: krune
source: POKENAME grow up missing the warmth of their mothers, who leave them to survive alone. This hardship prepares them for dangerous sea life, ensuring their resilience.

entry: POKENAME以拾荒为生，通常不愿战斗。不过真躲不过时，它就会用手杖猛敲对手，直到对方昏倒。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are scavengers and tend to avoid battle. However, if one can't, it will thwack opponents with its staff until they faint.

entry: 全身覆盖着骨头般的岩石。考古学家曾将沉睡的POKENAME误当成巨型化石挖出来。
author: frokachu
source: Its entire body is coated in a bone-like rock. Archaeologists once unearthed a slumbering POKENAME by mistake, believing it to be a large fossil.

entry: POKENAME虽然已有坚硬的外骨骼，仍会把战败敌人的头骨与骨骼制成盔甲，加强防护。它锋利的双镰能轻松切开对手，是战场上可怕的存在。
author: rakunk
source: Despite its already tough exoskeleton, POKENAME has adapted the skulls and bones of its fallen foes into armor for added protection. Its razor-sharp scythes effortlessly slice through opponents, making it a formidable force in battle.

entry: POKENAME披着骨骼，自豪地展示伤疤。幼崽出生便遭遗弃，成年后也郁郁而严肃，常独自躲起来哭泣。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME dress in bones and proudly flaunt their scars. Babies are abandoned at birth; adults are broody and stern, secluding themselves to weep.

entry: POKENAME是复活史前生命的尝试中，记录最详尽的一例。虽然强壮，性情却出奇温顺，双刃也十分脆。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the best-recorded attempt at reviving prehistoric life. Though strong, it's surprisingly docile, and its blades are brittle.

entry: POKENAME虽已走出失去朋友的悲伤，仍将往日回忆珍藏心中。无论走到哪里，都会为保护幼小的宝可梦而战。
author: leshii
source: Though POKENAME has overcome the grief of a lost friend, it carries their memory in its heart. It fights to protect young Pokémon wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME常不自量力，陷入根本打不赢的战斗。它用头撞击敌人，磨炼头部的骨甲。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: A POKENAME can often be found in over its head fighting battles it can't win. It strengthens the bone armor on its head by knocking it into foes.

entry: 这只宝可梦以坚韧的骨甲为傲，任何冲突也不怕，总奋不顾身地朝敌人猛冲。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This Pokémon has pride in the toughness of its bone armor. Fearing no confrontation, it barrels towards foes with reckless abandon.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长产奶，动作却敏捷，领地意识也强。在干旱地区，它很受大奶罐牧群欢迎，是出色的守卫。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: POKENAME is not a good milk supplier; however, it is nimble and territorial, making it a popular guard for Miltank herds in arid regions.

entry: POKENAME为纪念心中亲近的逝者，会将其骨头烧成灰，再用双翼撒向世界各地。
author: milchik
source: Wishing to honor the memories of those close to its heart after their death, POKENAME burns their bones down to ashes and scatters them across the world with its wings.

entry: 树梢上常能找到POKENAME。可它爱朝毫无防备的训练家扔骨头，在多数地方，都被视为惹祸的家伙。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: You can find POKENAME on the tops of trees. However, it is considered a pest in most regions, as it hurls bones at unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME独居洞穴，避开一切交往，尤其不愿接触人类。传说背上的头骨中有个痛苦的灵魂守护着它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME isolate themselves in caves, avoiding all social interaction, especially with humans. Legends claim the skull on their back holds a distressed spirit that watches over them.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: POKENAME由久经沙场的野兽遗骸制成，其中仍留着原主的灵魂。看它战斗的身手，便知此言不虚。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME was crafted from the remains and still-present spirit a battle-hardened beast, as evident by its movements in battle.

entry: 融合的副作用让POKENAME的双翼枯萎，只剩骨头。它为此悲伤不已，常因沮丧而乱发脾气。
author: phantom640
source: A side-effect of POKENAME's fusion causes its wings to wither down to bone. It grieves endlessly about this and often lashes out in frustration.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME巡行于采石场，寻找失去母亲的卡拉卡拉。厚重的铠甲，能保护它收养的小家伙免受伤害。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME roams the quarries at night, searching for motherless Cubone. POKENAME's bulky armor protects its foundlings from harm.

entry: POKENAME身旁的乌鸦头头，多半是早已与它结伴的黑暗鸦进化而来，而非新加入的伙伴。有些身上，也会缀着骨头。
author: ohok3441
source: The Honchkrow around POKENAME are typically bonded Murkrow rather than new additions. Sometimes they will be adorned with bones too.

entry: 据说POKENAME由沙丘娃与落入陷阱的卡拉卡拉共生而成。这份联系让双方都完成进化，成为会向新猎物投掷骨片的顶级捕食者。
author: doodledoo
source: POKENAME is thought to be the result of a Sandygast forming a symbiotic bond with a Cubone that fell into its trap. This bond has allowed them both to reach their evolutions, turning them into an apex predator that throws bone shards at new victims.

entry: POKENAME双腿富有弹性，能一跃高过摩天大楼，再踢出威力惊人的飞踢，冲击宛如小陨石坠落。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's elastic legs allow it to leap over skyscrapers. It uses this to land devastating jump kicks with the impact of a small meteorite.

entry: POKENAME双腿弹性十足，最多能伸长30英尺。耐性与韧性极强，能在严酷沙漠中静候对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs are incredibly stretchy and can reach up to 30 feet. It is incredibly resilient, patiently waiting for an opponent in the harsh desert.

entry: POKENAME常与铁壳蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长出拳。每挨一拳，它就离进化更近一步。
author: cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonuna, which are better at punching. With each hit they take, they get closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME常与铁甲蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长防守。每打中一拳，它就离进化更近一步。
author: cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonpod, which are better at defending. With each hit they make, they get closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME会互相对练，磨炼出奇有力的拳头。可手臂太短，常难以打中对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other to train their surprisingly powerful punches. They struggle to hit their opponents due to their short arms.

entry: POKENAME用粗重尾巴砸击树木与岩石，锻炼力量。实际比看起来强得多，一击足以将钢梁打凹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hone their strength by smashing their hefty tails into trees and rocks. They are deceptively strong, striking with enough force to dent a steel beam.

entry: 头发像沙袋，POKENAME一天大部分时间都在用它练拳。战斗不顺时，会狂甩头发，想以蛮力击退对手。
author: mistymagius
source: Its hair acts like a punching bag which POKENAME uses to train its punches for most of the day. If it is struggling in a fight, it will swing its hair wildly trying to knock away its opponent with extreme force.

entry: 人们认为，这是一位令人生畏的武僧，生前穿过的残甲，如今又被他的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's thought to be the remains of armor once worn by a fearsome battle-monk, now possessed by their spirit.

entry: 吃到不合口味的东西，它就会勃然大怒，失去理智。每只POKENAME都有不同的心头好，喂上一口，便能让它平静。
author: staghorn
source: When it tastes something unpleasant, it flies into a blind rage. Each POKENAME has a different favorite food that will calm it down.

entry: POKENAME头上垂着的“舌头”，其实是巧妙藏起的巨颚。嘴对疼痛很敏感，谁打得太重就会被反击。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tongue is actually a cleverly hidden set of jaws that drapes over POKENAME's head. The mouth is very sensitive to pain, and it will attack anything that hits it too hard.

entry: POKENAME见到不认识的物件或生物，总爱先舔一舔，好弄个明白。可惜，这一舔，常会造成割伤与麻痹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has a habit of licking every new object and living thing it sees to learn about it. Unfortunately, its licks often cause cuts and paralysis.

entry: 这只融合宝可梦外表并不吓人，却会让身边的人做些与牙齿有关的噩梦。除此之外，它倒总是独来独往。
author: ohok3441
source: While not threatening visually, this fusion causes those around it to have teeth-based nightmares. It otherwise keeps to itself.

entry: POKENAME凭声波辨认方向，扑扇着翅膀穿行洞穴。舌头够得着的东西，只要能吃，就会被它舔走吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME orients itself using sound waves and flutters through caves. Anything edible that comes within reach of its tongue is lapped up and eaten.

entry: POKENAME的舌头与尾巴覆着辛辣化学物质，能增强火焰攻击。虽然不会损伤皮肤，却会带来强烈灼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tongue and tail are coated in a spicy chemical that makes its fire attacks stronger. The chemical will cause an intense burning sensation even though it doesn't damage the skin.

entry: 小心别把硬币掉在地上。POKENAME以舔走钱币出名，肚子里，装满别人遗失的零钱。
author: kitarchen
source: Be wary of dropping coins on the ground. POKENAME are notorious for licking up money they find and filling their stomachs with lost pocket change.

entry: POKENAME忠诚却贪吃。看见能吃的，就会把职责忘光，一心追食，专注得经常迷路。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very loyal, but also very gluttonous. When it sees something edible, it likes to forget its duties and chase after its food. It is so focused that it is not uncommon for it to get lost.

entry: 体形虽大，却爱玩又亲人，食量也极大。传闻POKENAME曾在玩耍时不慎吞掉训练家，至今尚未证实。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its size, it is playful and cuddly, but also extremely voracious. Rumors that a POKENAME accidentally devoured its Trainer while playing have not yet been confirmed.

entry: POKENAME触角不断散发可怕恶臭，防止捕食者吞食。每只气味略有不同，能借此辨认同伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's antennae constantly emits a horrific stench to prevent any predators from eating it. Every POKENAME has a slightly different smell which they use to identify one another.

entry: POKENAME聚在污染地区，吃空气中的毒素。科学家常靠数量判断当地的毒性程度。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swarm in polluted areas, feeding off of the toxins in the air. Scientists often use the number of POKENAME in an area to determine its toxicity.

entry: POKENAME调皮得很，惹完祸，常会喷出高压气体，飞快溜走，逃避追究。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME is quite mischievous and will often propel itself away from consequences at high speed with jets of pressurised gas.

entry: POKENAME头上的嘴不断喷出毒烟，吸入者会失去行动能力。吃得越多，毒气越浓。
author: mistymagius
source: The mouth on POKENAME's head constantly belches toxic fumes to incapacitate anyone that breathes the gas in. The more food POKENAME has eaten, the more concentrated the gas becomes.

entry: 给POKENAME安排特殊饮食，便能让排出的气体失去活性。它性情开朗，是不错的宠物，只是养起来颇费钱。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's emissions can be rendered inert if they are fed a specialty diet. Their cheery temperaments make them good, if expensive, pets.

entry: POKENAME的拳头由毒气构成，对有嗅觉的敌人尤其有力。体内硫、甲烷与氦的混合物让它浮在地面上方。
author: krune
source: With fists made of noxious gas, POKENAME's attacks will land a hefty blow to any foe with a sense of smell. A mixture of sulfur, methane and helium in its body keeps it floating above ground.

entry: POKENAME偏爱受污染的水域，近几年扩散得很快。它到来后，本就污浊的水，又会渐渐变得更脏。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has spread fast in recent years because it prefers polluted waters. The already dirty waters are slowly being contaminated by its presence.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，会不断排出气泡。哪怕只吸入几秒，也会让呼吸道受到严重刺激。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME dives, it regularly emits bubbles of gas. Anyone who inhales this gas for even a few seconds can expect severe respiratory irritation.

entry: POKENAME体内不断酿出极易爆炸的气体，可黏稠的身体又关不住气体，让它疼痛不堪。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME constantly brews a highly explosive gas within its body. Due to its slimy form, it cannot contain the gas well enough, causing it pain.

entry: POKENAME堪称污秽的化身，据说光是气味，就能熏走其他宝可梦。到了夏天，臭得连附近城镇，都不得不疏散。
author: symile
source: The essence of filth, a POKENAME's scent is said to repel other Pokémon. During the summer, its stench warrants evacuation of nearby towns.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与同类聚在一起，一同硬化外壳，让阳光折射成耀眼、斑驳的光影。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME enjoys gathering with other members of its kind. Together, they harden their shells, creating dashing displays of fractured sunlight.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，可要小心。它为进化储备能量时，性情格外凶暴。
author: pixlhoopa
source: When you find POKENAME in the wild, be cautious. It's known to be violent when storing its power to prep for evolution.

entry: 即使化为数字资料，POKENAME仍有严密的代码保护。外壳如同防火墙，替它隔绝危险。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Even as digital code, POKENAME is protected with secure code. The shell is akin to a firewall, securing it from danger.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地准备进化，常被误认成枝叶。它靠外壳吸收的水分，维持生命。
author: zagreus8
source: POKENAME are often mistake for foliage as they keep completely still, preparing for evolution. They subsist on moisture absorbed through their shell.

entry: POKENAME生性胆小、温顺，可进化越近，就越严防死守，不让背上的茧受伤。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME is quite timid and docile in nature. However, as it approaches evolution, it grows more defensive in protecting the cocoon on its back.

entry: POKENAME在磨难与战斗中很少移动，身体逐渐僵硬，几乎无法行动。如今只能强化防御、准备反击，同时节省能量。
author: sontyp
source: Rarely moving through hardships and battles has made POKENAME's body rigid and largely immobile. All it can do now is harden its defenses and prepare for a counterstrike while conserving energy.

entry: POKENAME悬在树枝上摇荡，坚硬多刺的身体像拆墙球。更强的宝可梦会抓住树枝，将它当连枷使用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swings from tree branches, its tough, spiky body acting as a wrecking ball. Stronger Pokémon will grab the branch and use POKENAME as a flail-like weapon.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时，会缩进壳内。平时多处于休眠，用触手自卫。
author: pixlhoopa
source: While POKENAME prepares for evolution, its body retracts into its shell. Known for being dormant, it uses tentacles for self-defense.

entry: 还是绿小子时，就耗掉了大部分能量，如今POKENAME格外倦怠。它停在低垂树枝上，只有自卫时才战斗。
author: jackythewannabe
source: With most of its energy spent as a Caterogue, POKENAME grows lethargic. It sits in low-hanging tree branches, only fighting in self defense.

entry: POKENAME躺在林地上化蛹，背上帐篷般的突起，还能收留小宝可梦，替它们遮蔽危险。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lies on the ground in forests and pupates. It shelters small Pokémon in a tent-like outgrowth on its back.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会鲁莽地迎头冲撞。外壳硬如钢铁，即使撞空也不会受伤。
author: teatedtiten
source: When battling, POKENAME will recklessly charge at the opponent headfirst. Their steel-hard shell ensures no damage is done to them when they miss.

entry: POKENAME最初的壳薄而易破。常常沐浴月光之后，才会逐渐坚韧。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The shell of a POKENAME is, at first, thin and penetrable. After regular moonbathing, its shell toughens up.

entry: POKENAME快要进化了，外壳也出现裂纹。它只能用前肢发力，缓缓拖着身体前行。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME's shell is cracked due to how close it is to evolving. It is forced to slowly drag its body using its front legs to move.

entry: POKENAME用细丝吊在树上，等待进化。有外壳妥善保护，它一天能睡上22小时。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hangs on thin threads from trees and waits for its evolution. It sleeps up to 22 hours a day, well protected by its shell.

entry: POKENAME常无缘无故，从一棵树窜向另一棵树，不知不觉间，就浪费了许多本该留给进化的能量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME scurries from tree to tree, often for no real reason. Without noticing, it wastes a lot of energy that it actually needs for evolution.

entry: 这种宝可梦入侵性很强，因此，人们鼓励当地训练家捕捉POKENAME，减少野外的数量。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is considered highly invasive. Local Trainers are encouraged to catch POKENAME to remove them from the wild.

entry: POKENAME对幼小的绿毛虫十分大方，愿意让它们暂时住进有壳的身体里。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME is known for its generosity towards young Caterpie. Within its shelled body, they are given a temporary home.

entry: 这是早期利用有缺陷的基因，尝试复原史前飞行掠食者时产生的宝可梦。它的翅膀无法支撑飞行，但体内的轻质气体能让它漂浮。
author: sontyp
source: A product of early attempts to restore an aerial predator from a pre-historic period using faulty DNA. While its wings cannot support flight, buoyant gases allow it to levitate.

entry: POKENAME不断产生轻盈而剧毒的气体，长期接触会引发严重突变，因此它自己也几乎浑身长满肿瘤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly produces a lightweight gas that is both incredibly poisonous and capable of causing severe mutations with prolonged exposure. As a result, its body is almost entirely covered in tumors.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体，浓密得能当作肢体使用。在卡洛斯，人们也常用这些气体，制作高级香水。
author: melodydelune
source: The gases produced by POKENAME are dense enough to be used as limbs. The gases are also often used in Kalos to produce high-grade perfumes.

entry: POKENAME戴帽子的模样看似古朴可爱，却会开心地与路人“分享”毒气。幸好，拖出的黄烟足以警告保持清醒的人。
author: wormspawn
source: Though its be-hatted appearance is deceptively quaint, POKENAME will gleefully share its toxic gasses with any passer-by. Thankfully, the trail of yellow clouds serves as ample warning to those who keep their heads about them.

entry: POKENAME的气体，能暂时提高人的智力。不过不宜长期使用，大量接触，更会损伤脑组织。
author: darkweavile428
source: Gases emitted by POKENAME can temporarily increase a person's IQ. Prolonged use isn't recommended however, as large amounts can damage brain tissue.

entry: POKENAME长期接触有害烟雾，背部长出肿瘤。日久之后，肿瘤竟有了自己的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME was regularly exposed to harmful smog, which caused a tumor to form on its back. Over time, this tumor developed a life of its own.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME的气体臭得能赶跑几乎所有宝可梦。一位知名博士将气体稀释，研发了“驱赶球”，用来赶走不受欢迎的宝可梦。
author: darkweavile428
source: The gases emitted by POKENAME are so foul that it can repel almost any Pokémon. A renowned Pokémon professor has used a watered down version of this gas to develop the Pester Ball, a device used to chase off unwanted Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME头上覆着厚厚的岩石般皮肤，用来与同类对练。聪明的捕食者却会趁它分心，瞄准未受保护的尾巴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's head is covered with a thick, rock-like hide used for sparring with others. Clever predators, however, target its unprotected tail when it's distracted.

entry: POKENAME冲锋起来，连坦克也能掀翻。性情虽凶，骑乘却意外容易，因此常出现在竞技骑术表演中。
author: staghorn
source: A charging POKENAME is capable of flipping a tank. They are surprisingly easy to ride despite their fierceness, making them a common sight at rodeos.

entry: 矿工常在洞口附近的石缝发现POKENAME。它们会用奇形怪状的石头，在洞窟深处筑大巢。
author: schwaus
source: Miners often find POKENAME in between rocks near cave entrances. They create large nests with oddly shaped stones deep within their caves.

entry: 最常见于稀树草原。不过，深深的洞穴中也发现了适应弱光的亚种。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is most frequently found in savannas. Subspecies, however, have been found even in deep caves, adapted to the low light environment.

entry: 坚韧的皮肤与伪装能力，让它成为强大的伏击猎手。会融入周围环境，再猛烈冲锋，打敌人个措手不及。
author: rc2k
source: This Pokémon's sturdy hide and camouflaging abilities make it a formidable ambush predator. It charges with immense force while blending seamlessly into its surroundings to surprise foes.

entry: POKENAME巨颚咬合力惊人，却更喜欢甩头砸碎沿途一切。身体硬如石头，不怕任何撞击。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its jaws' massive bite force, POKENAME prefers flailing its head around, smashing everything in its path. With a body as tough as stone, it doesn't fear any physical impacts.

entry: POKENAME虽披着岩石般坚硬的甲片，动作却敏捷惊人。它会猛撞敌人，造成脑震荡与骨折。
author: _testrun_
source: Despite the rock-hard plating, POKENAME are incredibly agile. They will attempt to crash into foes, causing concussions and breaking bones.

entry: POKENAME花大部分能量，制造蛋状小颗粒喂养群体。为维持生存，每天要吃100多磅植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME expends most of its energy producing tiny egg-like pellets to feed its colony. To sustain itself, it consumes over 100 pounds of plant matter daily.

entry: POKENAME生性体贴，会模仿治愈球，想引来需要帮助的生物。等对方靠近，POKENAME便替它疗伤。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: Guided by its caring nature, POKENAME mimics a Heal Ball in the hopes of capturing the attention of those in need. POKENAME then heals them.

entry: POKENAME用火烹熟蛋，让其营养极为丰富。可烹饪耗能很大，因此只将蛋送给重伤者。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cooks its eggs with its flames which makes them incredibly nutritious. It uses a lot of energy to cook them, so POKENAME only gives its eggs to the critically injured.

entry: POKENAME能精确控制电力，用电击恢复人类或宝可梦的心跳，因此很受医疗领域的训练家欢迎。
author: cartoonhostage
source: POKENAME has precise control over its electric power, capable of delivering shocks to restart the hearts of humans and Pokémon. It's a popular partner for Trainers in the medical field.

entry: POKENAME天生稀少，却乐观又友善。曾有记录显示，它强力的电击将昏迷者从生死边缘救回。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possess an upbeat and friendly personality that belies their natural rarity. Their powerful shocks have been recorded to bring the unconscious back from the brink.

entry: POKENAME能在几分钟内治好任何宝可梦，作为移动宝可梦中心越来越受欢迎。可这极其耗能，自己也需要持续照料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have grown in popularity as portable Pokémon Centers, able to heal any Pokémon within minutes. Due to the massive energy required, they need constant care.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外壳，来自出生时残留的蛋壳。遇到野外生病的宝可梦，它便会细心照料。
author: melodydelune
source: The harden shell of POKENAME is formed from the remnants of the egg it was hatched from. It's known to nurse sick Pokémon it finds in the wild.

entry: 刀刃轻轻划过，小伤小病就能痊愈。可贪图利益的人纷纷想抓走POKENAME，如今，它也越来越罕见。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When its blade is lightly run across a minor wound or ailment, it is healed. Attempts to kidnap POKENAME for profit has made its presence rare.

entry: POKENAME心怀怜悯，是医护人员的好伙伴。手术时，它还能用飘带，把器械递给外科医生。
author: melodydelune
source: Its compassionate nature makes POKENAME an excellent partner for medical professionals. They assist surgeons by handing them tools with their ribbons.

entry: 据说，有POKENAME照料的蛋，能孵出健康强壮的宝可梦，因此，它很受培育家的欢迎。
author: jackythewannabe
source: It is said that an egg watched over by POKENAME will hatch into a strong, healthy Pokémon. This makes them popular among breeders.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都有分工。一颗头仔细警戒，其他头则负责照顾蛋。
author: dodoowner_
source: Each of POKENAME's heads have a job. One head carefully keeps watch and the others take care of its eggs.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓般的毛十分坚韧，能挡住比比鸟啄击。遇险时，也能靠藤蔓在树间荡行逃脱。
author: mistymagius
source: The vine-like hairs that coat POKENAME are actually quite tough and are able to resist the pecks of a Pidgeotto. It will also use the vines to swing from tree to tree if it needs to escape from danger.

entry: POKENAME周身包裹的大量触手，能替它御寒。它靠獠牙与鼻子，一起探查方向。
author: melodydelune
source: The mass of tentacles that encase POKENAME's body protect it from the cold. It uses a combination of its tusks and nose to guide itself.

entry: 它常跑到人群前，想表演一番。可观众若嘲笑POKENAME，它便躲进帽子里，独自哭泣。
author: dodoowner_
source: It usually goes in front of large crowds to try and perform. If they laugh at POKENAME, it'll hide in its hat and cry.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME本体的样子，只能瞥见黑暗里的一只眼。胆敢靠近者，都会被食肉藤蔓无情吞噬。
author: mistymagius
source: No one knows what POKENAME's real body looks like, only glimpsing a single eye encased in darkness. Anyone who dares approach is mercilessly devoured by its carnivorous vines.

entry: POKENAME全身藤蔓都锋利如剃刀，连柄上也一样。多数战士无法顺手持用，它只好独自作战。
author: patch
source: The vines all along POKENAME's body are razor sharp. Since this includes the hilt, most warriors cannot wield it efficiently, forcing it to battle on its own.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。还有人加上酸奶油与葱，衬出更多滋味。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. Some add sour cream and spring onions to it to bring out more flavor.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。人们常说，吃着像土豆与洋葱。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. People often remark its flavor as being similar to potatoes and onions.

entry: 越愤怒，藤蔓甩得越快。暴怒的POKENAME甚至会把自己的藤蔓甩断。
author: andoman63
source: The angrier it gets, the faster its vines whip around. A furious POKENAME might even break off its own vines in its rage.

entry: POKENAME头上的“头发”其实是藤蔓，摸起来湿漉漉的。可惜POKENAME没有手臂，藤蔓也总是乱蓬蓬。
author: hellaluyeah
source: The hair on POKENAME's head are actually vines that are wet to the touch. Since POKENAME doesn't have arms, its vines always appear disheveled.

entry: POKENAME的头发长了，手臂也长了。既有催眠本领，又有拳击手套，让对手“睡下”，足足有两种办法。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME hair has grown and so have its arms. With its hypnotizing powers and its boxing gloves, it has two ways to put its opponents to rest.

entry: POKENAME能舒展开缠绕的身体，让自己变大。两腿间的距离随之拉开，再宽的沟壑，也能轻松跨过。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can unravel its body and thus grow in size. This increases the distance between its legs and allows it to cross large gaps with ease.

entry: 幼崽已健康、强壮地长大，如今与母亲并肩作战。只有彼此的爱，能与它们战斗时的凶猛相比。
author: griddle
source: The child has grown up healthy and strong, and now fights by its mother's side. Their ferocity is matched only by their love for each other.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽，由金属母亲养大。待母亲衰老，幼崽便会驾驶母亲的身体，保护彼此。
author: mistymagius
source: The young baby of a POKENAME is nurtured by the metal mother. Once the mother grows old, the baby will pilot it to protect the two of them.

entry: 与孩子失散的POKENAME，会在悲痛中掀起沙暴。小生物若迷失在风暴里、走到它面前，迎来的却是收养，而非被吃掉。
author: wormspawn
source: A POKENAME separated from its baby will stir up a sandstorm in grief. Smaller creatures who become disoriented by these storms and stumble across a POKENAME's path find themselves not eaten, but adopted.

entry: POKENAME用飘带包裹幼崽，宛如襁褓。若它肯让你抱小家伙，就说明，它已完全信任你。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME swaddles its young by wrapping its ribbons around them. If they let you hold their baby, it is a sign they trust you completely.

entry: 人们对操纵POKENAME机械躯体的生物知之甚少，一想靠近研究，机体便以武力反击。但驾驶者传出的叫喊声，让人怀疑反击其实出自自动程序。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Not much is known about the creature that pilots the mechanical body of POKENAME, as any attempts to investigate will be met with force by the mech. However, the cries coming from the pilot lead people to believe this is an automated response.

entry: POKENAME护子心切到近乎过度，会用尾巴与蛮力护住孩子、碾碎闯入者。巢边以焦叶标记，看到最好远离。
author: cpnquacken
source: POKENAME is an extremely overprotective parent, using its tails and brute strength to both protect its children and crush trespassers. It marks its den with burnt foliage, so stay away if you spot it.

entry: 最近，科学家发现POKENAME的机械外壳，能提供热量与照明。他们因此推测，这副装甲，原本是为里面的生物设计的育成舱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It has recently been discovered that the mechanical exterior of a POKENAME is designed to provide heat and light, leading scientists to believe that the armor was designed as a sort of incubator for the creature within.

entry: POKENAME的身体长成了摇篮，保护幼崽。有人曾在夜里，看见那树木般的身体，悄然穿过田野。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: POKENAME has grown its body into a bassinet to protect its young. Some report to have seen its treelike body move quietly across fields at night.

entry: 幼崽从POKENAME背上的蘑菇里发育而来，长大成熟后，才会从母亲身上脱落。
author: melodydelune
source: Its young develop from the mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's back. When the young reach maturity, they will fall off their mother.

entry: POKENAME悉心教幼崽逃离或威吓敌人，避开危险。若非打不可，就用阴招与凶狠攻击尽快结束战斗。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME are caring parents, teaching their young how to avoid dangers by outrunning or intimidating aggressors. If they have to resort to fighting, POKENAME try to end fights as quickly as possible, using dirty tricks and brutal attacks.

entry: POKENAME用头上的触须，感知水中的振动，赶在天敌抓住自己之前，就已退走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the feelers on its head to detect vibrations in the water. This allows it to retreat from predators before it is caught.

entry: POKENAME用头上的触须，感知水中的振动，赶在天敌抓住自己之前，就已退走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the feelers on its head to detect vibrations in the water. This allows it to retreat from predators before it is caught.

entry: POKENAME十分弱小，却能从嘴里喷射液体，在水中迅速移动。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is fairly weak, but it can move quickly in water by shooting a jet of liquid from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME常结成小群，扑扇着翅膀，飞过池塘与河面。一察觉危险，便潜入水中，把翅膀当鳍游走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME flutters over the surface of ponds and rivers, often in small groups. If it senses danger, it dives, using its wings as flippers.

entry: 身体能吸存海水，数周不漏。危急时，POKENAME会以音速射出浑浊气泡，阻止捕食者。
author: schwaus
source: Its body can absorb and hold ocean water for weeks without leaking. When in a pinch POKENAME can shoot muddy bubbles at sonic speeds to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME将头鳍缠在海草上，防止被强流冲走。据说见到两只头鳍相缠的个体，会带来永恒幸福。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its head fin around sea grass to prevent being swept away by strong currents. Seeing two POKENAME with their fins intertwined is said to bring eternal happiness.

entry: POKENAME的两张嘴像炮管，能喷出足以贯穿钢铁的高压墨汁。常对峙较量，看谁出手更快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shoots pressurized ink from its two cannon-like mouths with enough force to pierce steel. They often compete in standoffs to determine the quicker shot.

entry: POKENAME全身的尖刺触之有毒。生活在水下洞穴，吸取周围岩石中的矿物。
author: roundabout_robin
source: The spikes all over POKENAME's body are poisonous to the touch. They live in underwater caves, draining minerals from rocks around them.

entry: POKENAME在水上或水下，都能从一英里以外喷出危险的高速水柱。可一旦近战，就只好缩进壳里。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME can fire dangerous, high velocity jets of water from over a mile away both above and below water, but in close combat POKENAME is forced to retreat into its shell.

entry: POKENAME十分弱小，是许多水生宝可梦的常见食物。虽成千上万结成鱼群自保，效果却不太好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very weak and are a common food source for many aquatic Pokémon. POKENAME swim in schools with numbers in the thousands trying to defend themselves but it's not very effective.

entry: POKENAME价值连城，受各地厨师追捧。可在料理界地位再高，论起打架，它们实在弱得可怜。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are priceless, sought after by chefs all over the region. Contrary to their revered status in the culinary field, they are pathetic fighters.

entry: POKENAME守望角金鱼群，维持秩序与安全。捕食者靠近时，便迅速摆鳍，眼中放光将其吓退。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME watch over schools of Goldeen to ensure they stay organized and safe. If a predator approaches, POKENAME will rapidly sway its fins and shine a light from its eye to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME随着成长蜕皮，鳞片也越来越美。在河湖中游泳时，双鳍如梦幻般舞动。
author: gloomymort
source: As POKENAME grow and shed their skin, their scales become more beautiful. Their fins dance dreamily as they swim the rivers and lakes they live in.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间打磨球体与鳞片，希望更加迷人。只有在阳光下闪闪发亮，才会满足。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME spend a lot of time polishing their orbs and scales in an effort to make themselves more enchanting. They will only be satisfied when they glitter in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME像流星，滑过夜空。闪亮的鳞片映着月光，为迷途的船只引向岸边。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME glide through the night sky like shooting stars, guiding lost ships to shore by reflecting the moonlight in their shimmering scales.

entry: 这只小巧的宝可梦，靠秋叶与橡子添些脂肪，好安然过冬。谁敢弄乱它的头发，可就要倒霉了。
author: rooboid
source: This petite Pokémon snacks on autumn leaves and acorns to gain weight and stay warm during winter. Those who ruffle its hair will suffer a nasty fate.

entry: POKENAME爱美得很，还会竖起水墙，欣赏自己华丽的倒影。它尤其宝贝自己的头发。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are known for their persistent vanity, and create walls of water to admire their gorgeous reflection. They are protective of their hair.

entry: 受到良好照料的POKENAME，颈圈花纹华美。照料不足，花瓣便会枯萎。它们需要睡足美容觉。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME who are well-cared for boast a gorgeously patterned collar. Those who are not will see their petals wilted. They need lots of beauty sleep.

entry: POKENAME常被赠给年幼的孩子，充当最初的伙伴。毕竟，背上的气泡，比火球鼠的火星安全得多。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are often gifted as a starter Pokémon to young children, as the bubbles from its back are much safer than the fiery embers of Cyndaquil.

entry: POKENAME如今一发怒，头顶的冠便会冒出火焰。它冲向毫无防备的敌人时，华美的尾巴也随风翻卷。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME can now let off flames from its crown when enraged. Its gorgeous tail twists in the breeze as it dashes towards unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME先绊倒敌人，再打出密集的气泡，轻易取胜。愤怒时，鬃毛还会迸起火焰。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME makes light work of foes by sweeping them off their feet and barraging them with a hail of bubbles. Flames burst from its mane when enraged.

entry: 阿罗拉一位著名训练家，曾在电视上展示这只小宝可梦。如今，许多训练家也给POKENAME打扮，仿照那位训练家的宝可梦。
author: rooboid
source: A famous Trainer in the Alola region showcased this petite Pokémon on TV. Now, many Trainers dress their POKENAME to also look like that Trainer's.

entry: POKENAME以美貌为傲，会收集黏土制成陶瓮，绘上自己鳞片的色彩与花纹。冲上岸的瓮片很适合制作首饰，也引来人们将海蚀玻璃上色售假。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very proud of their beauty, gathering clay to build urns depicting the colors and patterns of their scales. Washed-up fragments of these urns make for popular jewelry, leading people to paint seaglass to sell as counterfeit imitations.

entry: POKENAME住在沉船内，用遗失的宝藏掩藏亮角与彩色褶边。若被潜水者发现，就会送上宝物，换取清静。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME will make its home within a shipwreck, using lost treasure to disguise its shiny horns and colorful frills. If it's spotted by a diver, it will offer them treasure in exchange for being left alone.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME把年幼的大嘴蛋养在育儿袋里。这些小家伙力量不大，却是出色的游泳健将，速度很快。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME can be observed raising young Golcute in its pouch. While they aren't particularly strong, they are excellent and speedy swimmers.

entry: POKENAME常与一群雄性角金鱼同行，还能操控水流，为鱼群引路。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often seen with a school of male Goldeen. They are able control the flow of the water to guide their school.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: POKENAME用华美飘逸的鳞片与迷人歌声吸引水手。可谁傻到靠近，头上毛发般的巨颚就会咬住对方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lure sailors with their gorgeous, flowing scales and enchanting singing voice. However, the hair-like jaws on their head bite anyone foolish enough to approach.

entry: 追求力量的训练家会让POKENAME进化成海战龙；追求美丽的人，则已对它华丽闪耀的身姿心满意足。
author: rooboid
source: Trainers who seek power evolve their POKENAME into Seaxorus, but Trainers who seek beauty are more than happy with this gorgeous, shimmering Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力，能在水下彻底隐形。身上的纹路，宛如波浪，流转全身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are able to become completely invisible underwater thanks to its psychic powers. The patterns on its body ripple across its body like waves.

entry: POKENAME眼睛鼓鼓，性情胆怯，常被当作游园会的奖品。于是，虽模样古怪，却成了颇常见的新手伙伴。
author: rooboid
source: Known for its bulbous eyes and cowardly nature, POKENAME are often won as carnival prizes, making it a common and rather odd-looking starter Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体密度与水不同，能轻松沿河岸移动。酷热时，可见它们挤在石头和睡莲的阴影下。
author: rooboid
source: The density of POKENAME's body differs from water, allowing it to navigate riverbanks with ease. On particularly hot days, groups of POKENAME can be found compacted together in the shade of stones and water lilies.

entry: POKENAME肉质肥美，游起水来却意外出色。许多保护人士，都致力于守护这种独特的宝可梦。
author: rooboid
source: While it is indeed delicious and fatty, POKENAME is a surprisingly good swimmer, and many activists ensure the protection of this unique Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME咬走鱼线上的饵，留作己用。返回海底时，身上会挂满小饰物与拟饵，吸引自己的猎物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bite off bait from fishing lines, stealing it to use for themselves. They return to the ocean floor decorated in trinkets and lures to entice their prey.

entry: 养在水族箱里时，POKENAME会定期清理底床。既好看又实用，很受水族爱好者欢迎。
author: pokebio
source: When in an aquarium, POKENAME routinely cleans the substrate. This makes it popular among aquarists for its utility, as well as its looks.

entry: POKENAME爱待在许愿井底，这样，人们抛进井中的硬币，就都能被它偷走。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are well known to hang out at the bottom of wishing wells. By doing so, it allows them to steal any coins that people throw in.

entry: POKENAME试着用心灵感应交流游泳路线，却几乎总会引发剧烈头痛。因此，游起来远没有外表看着那么协调。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME attempt to communicate swimming patterns telepathically, but it almost always results in them getting intense headaches. As a result, their swimming tends to be a lot less coordinated than their appearance would suggest.

entry: 春天，成群的POKENAME会迁回出生的溪流与河道。它们喷出的水，足以让猎物严重烫伤。
author: melodydelune
source: In spring, groups of POKENAME can be seen migrating to the streams and rivers of their birth. The water they spout leaves intense burns on their prey.

entry: 它在透明如玻璃的育儿袋中，养育角金鱼。看袋中角金鱼的体型与状态，就能判断POKENAME是否健康。
author: rooboid
source: This Pokémon raises Goldeen in its glassy pouch. The overall health of a POKENAME can be determined by the condition and size of its Goldeen.

entry: POKENAME体内藏着一个小型生态系统。可它太爱徒手搏斗，常会打得这个小天地，整个裂开。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME hosts a small ecosystem within its body. Its love of hand-to-hand combat often results in this ecosystem being smashed open.

entry: POKENAME游动时会散落鳞片，留下闪亮的踪迹。鳞片漂流中吸附海水，很受制作香薰蜡烛的人欢迎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter scales as they swim, creating a shimmering trail behind them. Their scales collect seawater as they drift, causing them to be popular material for scented candles.

entry: 一群角金鱼操纵着大岩蛇骇人的遗骸，以POKENAME的姿态，再度活动。它们共享思想，行动也如一个整体。
author: rooboid
source: Operated by a school of Goldeen, the ghastly remains of an Onix live again in the form of POKENAME. This Pokémon acts and thinks as a combined entity.

entry: 最强的POKENAME在鱼群中威望很高，担任首领。但实际并没强太多，反而常最先成为猎物。随着年龄增长，鳍上的黑点也会增加。
author: mistymagius
source: The strongest POKENAME lead their school with high prestige, but they are not much stronger and are often picked off first. As they age, more black spots appear on their fins.

entry: POKENAME以美丽的花纹与角闻名。角最长、花纹最繁复的个体，很受收藏家追捧。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME are well known for their beautiful patterns and horns, and the ones with the longest horns and most intricate patterns are sought out by collectors.

entry: 诱饵长得像两条角金鱼。捕食者以为能轻松得手而靠近时，POKENAME就放电将其击昏。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Its lures resemble a pair of Goldeen. When predators approach in hopes of easy prey, POKENAME delivers an electric shock that knocks them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME美味得入口即化，各地厨师都愿出高价求购。可它一受惊，就会躲进蛋里。
author: rooboid
source: Sought after for its delectable, melt-in-the-mouth texture, chefs the world over will pay handsomely for a POKENAME. It hides in its egg when scared.

entry: POKENAME原本美味的皮肤，进化后变酸，用来防备偷猎者和钓鱼人。它并不善游。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's once-delicious skin becomes sour as it evolves; this is a defense mechanism to ward off poachers and anglers alike. It is a weak swimmer.

entry: 每年，成群的POKENAME都会来到岸边求偶。雄性会亮出鲜艳的花纹，跳起舞蹈，吸引雌性。
author: melodydelune
source: Once a year, groups of POKENAME gather by the shore to perform courtship rituals. Males will attract females with vibrant patterns and dances.

entry: 据说，龙卷寿司的灵感，就来自这只宝可梦。上半身能独立于下半身活动，不过，也不能离得太远。
author: rooboid
source: This Pokémon is said to have inspired the creation of dragon rolls. Its torso moves independently from its lower body, though it cannot stray too far.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长战斗，动作灵巧程度却远超常人。野外，很少见到POKENAME。
author: rooboid
source: Though POKENAME isn't well-suited for battle, it boasts a dexterity that far surpasses the average human's. POKENAME are seldom seen in the wild.

entry: 许多代以来，POKENAME都因外貌丑陋，在宝可梦华丽大赛中备受冷落。近年却有人发现其魅力，组建了饲养俱乐部。
author: rakunk
source: For many generations, POKENAME was cast aside in Pokémon contests due to its ugly appearance. However, in recent years others have started to find POKENAME charming and built clubs around raising them.

entry: 它飞快游动，试图用坚硬如石的大角，撞中目标。
author: pokopish
source: It swims at high speeds, attempting to ram targets with its large horn that is as hard as rock.

entry: POKENAME学会了把大葱当作钓竿捕鱼。只要有宝可梦咬钩，就会立刻被拉出水面，展开战斗。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME developed the ability to catch fish, using its leek as a rod. If a Pokémon bites, it is sure to be pulled out of the water and battled immediately.

entry: POKENAME虽对人类友善，却是凶猛的北极捕食者，凡比它小的都吃。会用利角破开厚冰。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being friendly towards humans, POKENAME is a vicious arctic predator and will prey on anything smaller than it. It uses its sharp horn to break through thick ice.

entry: POKENAME常会照料迷路的铁甲蛹与绿毛虫，将它们留在身边，直到彻底恢复健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often seen taking care of lost Metapod and Caterpie. It keeps them until they are fully rehabilitated.

entry: 身体虽一动不动，POKENAME的翅膀却会飞快拍动，本能地帮它躲避天敌。
author: zagreus8
source: While the body remains immobile, POKENAME's wings flutter rapidly, acting on instinct to allow it to evade predators.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，从不争斗。有人偶尔会看见它从腕部吐丝，织成美丽的挂毯。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME is a very peaceful, conflict-free Pokémon. It has occasionally been observed shooting silk out of its wrists to make beautiful tapestries.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: POKENAME在污染较少的地方采蜜更快。若完全没有污染，还会产生能帮助疗伤的发光物质。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are seen to gather honey more swiftly in areas with less pollution. If there's no pollution at all, it produces a glowing substance known to help treat injuries.

entry: 许多巴大蝶毛绒玩具与钥匙圈，都从POKENAME的尾巴取得灵感。可要让它老实待够久，好照着制作，并不容易。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tails are big inspirations for Butterfree plushies and keychains. Though, it's hard to keep one in place long enough to replicate it.

entry: 这只宝可梦振翅撒出致幻粉末，再从幻象引起的恐惧中，吸取养分。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: This Pokémon releases a hallucinogenic powder by flapping its wings, absorbing nutrition from the fear the induced visions cause.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME有一半身体没能进化。科学家仍在研究。
author: dodoowner_
source: For some reason, half of POKENAME was not able to go through evolution. Scientists are still studying this phenomenon.

entry: 会用尾巴吸引捕食者，再以超能力赶走，保护领地内的绿毛虫。
author: staghorn
source: It protects its territory's Caterpie by using its tail to attract their predators. It then uses its psychic abilities to drive these predators away.

entry: POKENAME的壳由能挡住子弹的几丁质构成。若真有人打裂外壳，里面便会涌出团团毒气。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shell is made from a bulletproof chitin. If you somehow crack its shell, it'll release clouds of poisonous gases into the air.

entry: POKENAME在树干内筑巢，吸食树汁，尤其喜欢繁花盛开的树。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes their nests inside tree trunks, feeding on the sap inside. It especially loves trees with large amounts of flowers.

entry: POKENAME翼上的每片鳞，都是一枚细小的毒刺。身上的毒棘，也能护它免受攻击。
author: sand_coffin
source: Each scale on a POKENAME's wing is a small, toxic spike. The toxic quills on its body act as a defense mechanism, protecting it from attacks.

entry: POKENAME满脑子只想找到最甜的蜜。谁若阻拦，它就喷出麻痹气体，直到对方无法再动。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's only goal is to find the sweetest honey. If anyone tries to stop it, it'll spit paralyzing gas until they're neutralized.

entry: 它会为作物授粉，又能用毒牙赶走害虫，深受农民与花卉爱好者喜爱。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is loved by farmers and flower enthusiasts. It helps pollinate crops and protects them against pests with its poisonous fangs.

entry: 它欢欢喜喜地打着转，撒下银色粉末。POKENAME总留意着周围，却偏要装得无忧无虑。
author: xephyr
source: It twirls gleefully, releasing silver dust as it does. POKENAME is always observing its surroundings but tries to appear carefree.

entry: POKENAME把采来的花蜜滴在尖牙上，引诱其他虫宝可梦靠近，再将其吃掉。蜜香怡人，用来防治虫害格外受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures in other bug Pokémon to eat by dripping the nectar it has collected onto its fangs. It is very popular for pest control since the nectar has a very pleasant aroma.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: chorb33
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: chorb33
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: 灾难将至的地方，会聚来数百只POKENAME，试着载起人类与宝可梦，将他们送到安全处。
author: dodoowner_
source: Hundreds of POKENAME swarm around places where tragedy will strike. They try to pick up people and Pokémon and fly them to safety.

entry: 这把华美的剑，只能靠剑刃吸血进食。谁为欣赏美貌而走近，谁就落进了它的陷阱。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This majestic sword can only eat by absorbing blood through its blade. Those who approach it to observe its beauty have only fallen into its trap.

entry: 分成一对之后，它们优美的剑舞，引来了更多受害者，恰好填补了与日俱增的嗜血欲望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The duo's majestic sword-dances attract more victims than it did before it split. That helps it meet its increased thirst for blood.

entry: POKENAME翅膀洒出的鳞片会发光，不知为何隔着实体物也能看见。会把鳞片撒满猎物，方便追踪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings spread luminescent scales that can somehow be seen through solid objects. It will coat its prey in these scales in order to track them down.

entry: 它能采集大量花粉与花蜜，酿成蜂蜜。双翅撒出的粉末，还能安抚敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: It can collect massive amounts of pollen and nectar to produce honey. Its wings spread a powder that calms its enemies.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太轻，因此很少飞。会细心保养双翼，厚涂蜂蜜作保护层。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of how light their wings are, POKENAME rarely flies. They tend to their wings with care, slathering them with honey as a protective encasing.

entry: POKENAME飞起来，宛如翩翩起舞，因此得了个外号：“蝴蝶夫人”。
author: kiddivinegon
source: POKENAME flies through the air almost as if it is dancing. This has earned it the nickname 'Madame Butterfly'.

entry: POKENAME巨翼上的鳞片，带着金属气味。双翅虽比多数宝可梦还大，它却飞不起来。
author: sand_coffin
source: The scales POKENAME produces from its massive wings give off a metallic scent. Despite its wings being larger than most Pokémon, it cannot fly.

entry: POKENAME味觉细腻，要求极高。餐厅常请它把关，检查食材品质。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has exquisite taste. Due to its high standards, it is often used by restaurants for quality control of their ingredients.

entry: POKENAME在花园中快乐吸蜜。成群的它们常会协助大针蜂，换得一些蜂蜜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in flower gardens, cheerfully feeding on nectar. Flocks of POKENAME will often help Beedrill for a share of their honey.

entry: POKENAME的叶片，能给各种菜肴增添美味。不过，下锅前，必须仔细去净毒素。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME leaves are a delicious flavoring for any dish. Before cooking, you have to drain out the toxins carefully.

entry: POKENAME展示最漂亮的裙装来争取伴侣。走秀模特与时尚达人也会从中获得灵感，设计服饰。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME compete for a mate by showing off the prettiest dress. Runway models and fashionistas have made outfits inspired by it.

entry: 据说POKENAME是外星幼虫，身体的红色球体让它能360度观察。满月时，成群的它们似乎最为活跃。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be an alien larva, POKENAME can see in 360 degrees thanks to the red orbs on its body. Swarms of POKENAME seem most active during a full moon.

entry: 为免被猎杀，游在海洋最黑暗的深处，以宝石照明。繁星之夜会浮出水面，向往地凝望星空。
author: phantom640
source: It swims at the darkest depths of the ocean to avoid being hunted, using its gem as a light to see. On starry nights, it surfaces and gazes longingly at the stars.

entry: 晴朗星夜，POKENAME会来到海面，安静地看一整夜星星。谁若打扰，它就会暴怒直到翌晨。
author: phantom640
source: On clear starry nights, POKENAME comes to the ocean surface to peacefully gaze at the stars all night long. Should one disturb its rest, POKENAME will fly into a furious rage until the next morning.

entry: 它把身体埋进沙子，只露出头，伪装成海星星。想吃海星星的宝可梦，反倒成了它的猎物。
author: pokepower
source: It buries its body in the sand, leaving its head out and pretending to be Staryu. Pokémon that try to eat Staryu are it's prey.

entry: POKENAME在海中漫无目的地漂浮，直到进化。头上的宝石，能感知精神能量。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME float aimlessly through the ocean until they evolve. The gem on its head can sense psychic energy.

entry: 据说额头宝石能感知雨天，因为POKENAME似乎只在雨中现身起舞。会用伞状大嘴抓住小型宝可梦，留在其中消化。
author: mistymagius
source: The gem on its forehead is said to be able to sense rainy weather since POKENAME seems to only appear dancing in the rain. It catches small Pokémon in its umbrella-like mouth where they are left to be digested.

entry: 只要眼睛完好，POKENAME便能再生身体。星夜里，它站上海边峭壁，让眼睛朝天空发亮、凝望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As long as its eye is intact, POKENAME can regenerate its body. On starry nights, it stares and shines its eye at the sky from a seaside cliff.

entry: 美丽的花纹与色彩，让它很受水属性行家的欢迎。战斗中失去的肢体，也能重新长好。
author: melodydelune
source: Its beautiful pattern and colors make this Pokémon popular among water specialists. It can regenerate limbs that have been lost in battle.

entry: 它巡行海滩，朝跃出水面的鱼宝可梦掷出手里剑。两只POKENAME相遇，还会比赛谁抓的猎物更多。
author: kittyluv090
source: It patrols beaches, throwing shurikens at fish Pokémon that jump out of the water. When two POKENAME meet, they compete to catch the most prey.

entry: POKENAME厚重的外骨骼适合珊瑚礁生活。即使掉下一块，经过足够时间，也能再生成一只全新的POKENAME。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have bulky exoskeletons that leave them well-suited to life in coral reefs. Even if a piece breaks off, with enough time it will regenerate into a brand new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME肢体折断，还会重新长出。有人试吃过断下的部分，说味道与口感，都不怎么样。
author: ohok3441
source: If a limb breaks off of POKENAME, it'll regrow. Those who have attempted to eat the torn pieces claim the taste and texture is unappealing.

entry: POKENAME的巨大宝石能放出强光，让它在最深的海底也能畅游。被捕食者追赶时，便闪光晃花对方的眼睛，趁机游走。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's massive gem can shine a powerful light, allowing them to swim in the deepest depths without any trouble. If a predator gives chase, POKENAME will flash its pursuer with a blinding light before swimming away.

entry: 住在海洋最深处。POKENAME发现猎物或闯入者后，会先用宝石闪光使其目盲，再猛烈攻击，拖回巢里吃掉。
author: phantom640
source: It lives at the deepest point of the ocean. When POKENAME spots prey or intruders, it blinds them using its gem before violently attacking them. Once done, POKENAME drags its victims back down to its lair to feed.

entry: 夜晚，POKENAME飞过天际，从翅膀撒下宇宙尘埃。据说见到它时，就该许个愿。
author: fr34kuency
source: At night, POKENAME flies across the sky, spreading cosmic dust from its wings. It is said that you should make a wish if you see one.

entry: 水宝可梦常把POKENAME误认成大块珊瑚。可一旦被触手缠上，不论猎物多大，POKENAME都照吃不误。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.

entry: 水宝可梦常把POKENAME误认成大块珊瑚。可一旦被触手缠上，不论猎物多大，POKENAME都照吃不误。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a large coral by other Water Pokémon. Once entangled in its tentacles, POKENAME will eat it, regardless of its size.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏进黄金堆，捉弄寻宝者。不必害怕，恶作剧并不会伤人。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME love to hide in gold piles, and play pranks on treasure raiders. Fear not, as these pranks aren't harmful.

entry: POKENAME身上金黄的部分，由骨骼构成，是天然的铠甲。宝石则引导着它的超能力。
author: melodydelune
source: The golden parts of its body act as a natural armor for POKENAME, being made of bone. The gems on its body are the conduits for its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦中，是出色的占星师。可每当路过的旅人，纠正了它的错误，那份骄傲就会碎个干净。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is known to be an excellent astrologer among Pokémon. However, its pride shatters whenever passing travelers correct its mistakes.

entry: 靠控电能力善于飞行。有理论认为，最早的不明飞行物目击，其实就是POKENAME飞过夜空。
author: staghorn
source: It is a capable flyer thanks to its electrokinesis. It's theorized that the first sightings of UFOs were POKENAME flying through the night sky.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁，沿珊瑚爬行觅食。背上众多宝石能吸收阳光，再释放能量脉冲击晕猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁，沿珊瑚爬行觅食。背上众多宝石能吸收阳光，再释放能量脉冲击晕猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Found within coral reefs, POKENAME scuttle across the coral and hunt through the reef for prey. They use the many gems studded along their backs to absorb sunlight and release energy pulses to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，身后拖着流星般的光。宝石般的眼睛，据说能看见未来，难怪它总惊慌不已。
author: pokepower
source: A running POKENAME leaves lights behind it resembling shooting stars. Its gem-like eye is said to see the future, hence its state of constant panic.

entry: 它敲着钟，却听不到声响。不过研究人员已经证实：每当POKENAME鸣钟，外太空便有另一口钟，遥遥回应。
author: fenragon
source: Its bell tolls inaudibly. However, researchers have proven that whenever POKENAME tolls, another bell answers from outer space.

entry: 即使只剩一星火苗，POKENAME也能再生身体。全速奔跑时，POKENAME还可轻松踏水而行。
author: darkweavile428
source: If even a single ember of its flames remains, POKENAME can regenerate its body. When moving at top speed, POKENAME can run across water with ease.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的隐秘湖泊。从身上取下的石头，受光角度合适时，会泛起彩虹的七种颜色。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME lives in lakes hidden deep underground. Stones taken from its body glow in the seven colors of the rainbow when light hits them just right.

entry: POKENAME尾端的手状附肢能集中超能力，用来摘取离地数英尺的树果。似乎很喜欢将树果抛接着玩。
author: mistymagius
source: The hand-like appendage on POKENAME's tail concentrates its psychic powers. It will use this hand to grab berries from trees a few feet off the ground. It seems to enjoy juggling these berries for fun.

entry: POKENAME模样可怕，许多人担心被它伤害，见了就逃。可实际上，它不过想找个温暖的家，安定下来。
author: skymaster426
source: Due to its horrifying appearance, many run from POKENAME in fear of it harming them. In reality however, it only wishes to settle down in a warm home.

entry: POKENAME用假墙把猎物困在水下，继而使出2万亿磅的力量，将其牢牢夹住。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME uses it's fake walls to trap prey under the water before clamping down on them with 2 trillion pounds of force.

entry: 看不出吧，POKENAME其实更爱住在地下。有人说，独处时，它还会轻声向自己出主意。
author: gp423
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME prefers to live underground. Some people claim it whispers suggestions to them when no one else is around.

entry: POKENAME始终在身前撑着保护屏障。可危险来了，它也不肯转身，让屏障白白失了用处。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME holds a protective barrier in front of itself at all times. However, it doesn't turn to face potential dangers, making the barrier useless.

entry: POKENAME用双手造出的无形屏障，十分坚固。有些公司，乃至政府机构，都请它负责安保。
author: chorb33
source: With its hands, POKENAME can create such robust and invisible barriers that it is used by some companies and even government agencies for security.

entry: POKENAME虽外貌可怖，却尽量不用巨颚伤人。会用杂技身手逃离危险，或靠马戏般的动作分散敌人注意。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its monstrous appearance, POKENAME tries not to harm others with its jaws. Instead, it uses acrobatic skills to flee danger or distract foes with circus-like routines.

entry: 气球刀刃一爆，POKENAME便慌忙从手里抽出另一只气球，假装用打气筒充气，再扭成新刀。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: If its blade ever pops, POKENAME frantically pulls another balloon from its hand, mimes inflating it with a tire pump, and twists up a new one.

entry: 最让POKENAME开心的，就是逗人类与宝可梦乐一乐。它们尤其擅长手法魔术与抛接杂耍。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are happiest when they entertain people and Pokémon. They are excel in sleight of hand and juggling.

entry: POKENAME演出被打断，就会动粗。战斗时交替使出猛烈刺拳与超能力屏障，屏障上还覆着强效的虚弱孢子。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME get violent when their performances are interrupted. Their fighting style alternates between destructive jabs and psychic barriers that are coated in a potent layer of debilitating spores.

entry: POKENAME常在工业建筑里筑巢。狩猎时会发出超声波，扰乱猎物的方向感。
author: inksans201x
source: Common to industrial buildings, POKENAME can be found making its nest. When hunting, it creates an ultrasonic frequency to disorient prey.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会伴着轻微“砰”声喷出彩纸，吓攻击者一跳。在生日派对和其他庆典很受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is scared, it will shoot out a burst of confetti alongside a small popping sound, startling its attacker. POKENAME is quite popular at birthday parties and other celebrations.

entry: POKENAME很爱与遇见的对象亲昵相抱。不过，它不怎么聪明。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME is very cuddly towards those it meets. However, it is not very bright.

entry: POKENAME始终用超能力墙围住自己。原先人们以为是自卫，后来发现其实是在保护旁观者，免受致命孢子伤害。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME maintain psychic walls around them at all times. At first this was thought to be a defense mechanism, but researchers found they're actually in place to protect bystanders from their lethal spores.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME用大手撑起无形屏障，逼退敌人，再伸出藤蔓般的舌头，撒下毒孢子，制服猎物。
author: raza
source: POKENAME use their large hands to repel foes with invisible barriers before extending their vine-like tongue, using toxic spores to incapacitate prey.

entry: POKENAME在嘉年华很受欢迎，乐于载着孩子绕彩色帐篷游玩。能完全控制火焰，信赖的对象碰了也无妨。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular at carnivals, happily giving rides to children around colorful tents. It has full control over its flames, allowing for anyone its trusts to touch them.

entry: 野外遇上POKENAME，就快逃吧。双镰能轻松划开皮肉，硬壳又挡得住多数攻击。
author: krune
source: Should you encounter a wild POKENAME, run. Its scythes are sharp enough to cut through skin with ease, and its shell can deflect most attacks.

entry: POKENAME低飞寻找树上的虫巢，再用头上的镰刀将树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies low, searching for insect nests in trees. It uses the scythe on its head to slice the tree cleanly in half.

entry: 这把飞镰迅捷而致命，收割了许多虫宝可梦的性命，甚至让某些种类陷入生存危机。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Swift and deadly, this flying scythe has been the reaper of many bug Pokémon, endangering some species.

entry: POKENAME用有力的嘴唇吸住树木，再脱下毛发作诱饵，让捕食者抓去，自己安然无恙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its strong lips to stick to trees. It sheds its hair as a decoy, tricking predators into grabbing it without causing harm.

entry: POKENAME能让碰到的东西像炸弹一样爆炸，主要借此捕猎，例如捕捉电蛋。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME possess the ability of making everything it touches explodes like a bomb. POKENAME mainly uses it to hunt its prey, such as Galvancute.

entry: POKENAME转着圈，唱出美妙的歌。可它发出的声音，至今无人能分毫不差地模仿。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME sings a beautiful song as it spins around. Nobody has ever been able to precisely replicate the sounds it makes.

entry: 据说POKENAME会与深海居民订契约，操纵其他宝可梦自行陷入危险，免得亲自与之战斗。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to make contracts with the denizens of the deep, manipulating other Pokémon to put themselves in danger so it doesn't have to fight them itself.

entry: POKENAME说着难懂的语言，听久可能令人发疯。它的吻带来充满怪诞梦境的不安睡眠，自己则一眨不眨地盯着猎物。
author: empathnaga
source: POKENAME speaks in an incomprehensible tongue that can drive listeners to madness. Its kiss brings a fitful sleep filled with surreal dreams as its unblinking eyes watch its prey.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会用有力的嘴唇吸在冰洞侧壁上。据说被它亲吻后，身体的热量就会被慢慢抽走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will use its powerful lips to attach itself to the side of ice caves while they sleep. It is said if you are ever kissed by one, you will slowly be drained of your body heat.

entry: 严寒的冬夜，POKENAME会现身，将迷路的旅人引向歧途，再带往灵界。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME appears on particularly cold winter nights to lead lost wanderers astray and carry them off to the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME能用伴随身侧的灵火打开传送门，转眼之间，便跨越遥远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create portals with the spirit flames that accompany it, allowing it to travel long distances in a short time.

entry: POKENAME住在城堡、遗迹与废屋中，支配附近的宝可梦，让它们麻木地侍奉自己。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in castles, ruins, and abandoned houses. It controls other Pokémon in the vicinity, which serve POKENAME apathetically.

entry: 虽然亲人，却极为害羞，也很有保护欲。生气时朝敌人尖叫，高兴时则吹口哨。
author: rockageddon
source: While affectionate, these Pokémon are incredibly shy and protective. When angry they will scream at opponents, but when they are happy they will whistle instead.

entry: POKENAME能将冰刺长至数米，贯穿对手。危急时，还能取下冰帽当盾牌。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can grow its ice spikes to a length of several meters to impale its opponents. It can use its detachable ice hat as a shield in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME会在午夜起舞，磨炼利爪。它们不知怎么，竟能说一种只有自己训练家才懂的秘语。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME hone their claws by dancing during midnight. They somehow speak in a secretive language that only their Trainer can understand.

entry: POKENAME浓密秀美的金色长发，令人争相追求。它还能让发间的冷热，维持完美平衡。
author: t.i.a.
source: The luscious, golden locks of a POKENAME are highly coveted. It can perfectly keep heat and cold balanced within them.

entry: POKENAME能冻结脚下水面，在水上奔跑。可冰上刹不住，因此只肯跑直线。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME is capable of running over bodies of water by freezing the area underneath its feet. As a result of being unable to brake on ice, POKENAME will only run in straight lines.

entry: POKENAME爱在海滩偷饰品，再拿来作道具，逗其他宝可梦开心。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME love to steal accessories on beachy areas. They use these as props to entertain other Pokémon.

entry: 雷雨来时，成群的POKENAME会聚在山坡，比赛争夺让雷劈中的资格。
author: melodydelune
source: Herds of POKENAME will gather on mountainsides during thunderstorms. They compete to determine who will be allowed to get struck by lightning.

entry: 必要时，POKENAME的两颗头，都会上阵战斗。火与电招式并用，能应对多种宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's two heads both battle if necessary. They use both Fire and Electric moves to counter many Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体内始终蓄着庞大电力，移动速度可达20马赫。走投无路时，还能引发巨大的能量爆发。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME has a massive constant charge within its body, allowing it to move at Mach 20. When cornered, it can produce a giant blast of energy.

entry: POKENAME聚居在避雷针周围，汲取自然电力。彼此连接巨颚可增强电能，十只以上的群体，能为大城供电一周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in groups around lightning rods to gain natural power. They link their jaws together to amplify their electrical power. A group of ten or more POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a large city for a week.

entry: 据说，若有POKENAME开始尾随你，不久之后，你就注定会遭雷劈。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that if an POKENAME starts following you, you are doomed to be struck by lightning in the near future.

entry: 它们把触须当作电缆，吸取电力。暴风雨中，POKENAME常站上屋顶，充当避雷针。
author: melodydelune
source: They can use their feelers as cables to absorb electricity. POKENAME will often stand on rooftops and act like lightning rods during storms.

entry: POKENAME能造出小片雷云，躺在上面，歇在空中。谁敢打扰它睡觉，就会挨上猛烈的雷击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME挥拳快如闪电，却不容易打到身后。敌人会抓住敏感的尾巴，以免挨揍。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME has lightning-fast punches, but cannot easily hit opponents behind it. Enemies grab its sensitive tail to avoid getting pummeled.

entry: 一家电力公司开发了专用沙袋，能让POKENAME边出拳边发电。他们声称，只要训练足够，它就能为整座镇子供电。
author: teatedtiten
source: An electric company developed special punching bags which POKENAME can punch to generate electricity. They claim that with enough training, POKENAME could power a town with its energy.

entry: 虽然不会飞，POKENAME却能制造冰做的落脚点，登上任何悬崖或树顶。它最喜欢占据能找到的最高处，用三重攻击狙击敌人。
author: rockageddon
source: While flightless, POKENAME can reach the top of any cliff or tree by creating a foothold made of ice. Its favorite strategy is to perch on the highest point it can find and snipe enemies with Tri-Attack.

entry: POKENAME先喷小火，将食物烧成灰再吃。角的燃烧温度达1500度，刺鼻烟雾先警告捕食者，随后便会将其点燃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews small flames to burn food to ashes before eating. Its horns burn at 1500 degrees, emitting pungent smoke that warns predators before igniting them.

entry: POKENAME每天至少会发怒3次。它暴躁的脾气经常引发山火，因此有关部门请求经验丰富的训练家捕捉遇到的所有POKENAME。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to get angry at least 3 times a day. Officials request seasoned Trainers to catch any POKENAME they come across, as their short tempers often result in wildfires.

entry: 在POKENAME眼里，战斗就是舞蹈。它轻巧错步，避开攻击，还总留着一只手，等舞伴来牵。
author: leshii
source: For POKENAME, there is no difference between battle and dance. It sidesteps attacks with the greatest ease with one hand always open for a partner.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME以优雅潇洒的舞步，穿行战场。火热的心熊熊燃烧，战斗也宛如与对手共舞。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME dances about the battlefield with grace and style. With its fiery heart burning bright, it battles as though dancing with another.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着易燃油，点燃后能威慑敌人。咬伤会造成几乎深达骨头的三度烧伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in flammable oil that ignites to deter foes. Its bites can cause third-degree burns that nearly reach the bone.

entry: POKENAME对地壳深处岩浆的变动极为敏感，会前往可能喷发的火山附近，因此被视为灾难将至的预兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is incredibly sensitive to the shifting of magma deep beneath the world's crust. They seek out locations where volcanic eruptions are likely to happen, earning them a reputation for imminent disaster.

entry: 若耳朵与尾巴上的火焰低落，训练家就该给POKENAME喂些木炭。火一暗，它便会行动迟缓。
author: melodydelune
source: If the flames on its ears and tail seem low, Trainers should feed their POKENAME charcoal. It becomes sluggish when its flames are dim.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，温度高达数百度，因此，只会在石头或金属结构上筑巢。
author: chorb33
source: The threads that POKENAME spins reach temperatures of several hundred degrees. This is why it builds its nests on stones or metal structures.

entry: POKENAME能爬上墙壁与天花板。喷火前，眼睛上方的毛会先亮起，若见到这一幕，就快离开吧。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb walls and ceilings. Just before it spits fire, the fur above its eyes lights up. If you see this, get out of the area.

entry: 它点燃毛发，保护自己。身上烧着火，POKENAME毫不在意，就连意外引起森林大火，也不放在心上。
author: pokepower
source: It sets its fur alight for protection. Being ablaze doesn't bother POKENAME in the least, nor any forest fires it accidentally starts.

entry: 身体由燃烧的火成岩组成。谁让POKENAME觉得有威胁，它就喷出熔岩迎击，只是射得不远。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is made of burning igneous rock. POKENAME will spew molten rock at anyone it finds a threat, even though it can't shoot very far.

entry: 泡进熔岩就能获取能量，不需要吃喝。若见野生POKENAME从火山边飞奔离去，就说明火山即将喷发。
author: staghorn
source: It gets its energy by immersing itself in lava, so it doesn't need to eat or drink. If you see a wild POKENAME galloping away from a volcano, it is a sure sign that the volcano is going to erupt soon.

entry: 体形变大后，POKENAME会选择更危险的猎场扎根。故意摆出古怪吓人的伪装，引来大小猎物查看，再猛然以巨颚咬碎。
author: arcul
source: With POKENAME now in a larger form, it may choose to plant itself in more dangerous hunting grounds. Intentionally off-putting mimicry draws prey, large and small, in closer to investigate, where it then lunges with powerful, crushing jaws.

entry: 夹住对手，还是将其掀翻，全看它临场的战术。两只POKENAME交锋时，却总会选相反的招数。
author: staghorn
source: Whether it aims to pinch or flip its opponent varies on a tactical basis. When two POKENAME fight, they will always choose opposite tactics.

entry: 钳子从POKENAME头部穿出，遮挡了视线，害它找食物时格外费劲。
author: toxicrown
source: The pincer that protrudes through the head of POKENAME has caused it's vision to be reduced. It struggles to find food because of this.

entry: POKENAME结合融合原型的假哭与自身的拟态，吸引好奇猎物。等对方进入范围，再以强劲巨颚碾碎撕裂。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME utilizes its progenitor's faux tears in tandem with its innate mimicry to lure curious prey in close. When the prey enters striking range, it uses powerful jaws to crush and tear.

entry: POKENAME的钳子有5,000磅的压力，夹住什么都能碾碎。会毁掉一圈树木，标出领地边界。
author: mistymagius
source: The claw on POKENAME can crush anything it grabs with 5,000 pounds of pressure. It creates a border of decimated trees to outline its territory.

entry: 若不曾夺走所有持握者的四肢，POKENAME本该是伐木与拆迁的好工具。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME would be an excellent tool for logging and demolition, if it wouldn't claim the limbs of all those attempting to wield it.

entry: POKENAME好斗，会头槌一切会动的东西。可甲壳承受不住这样的猛烈撞击，身上总是青一块紫一块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very aggressive and will headbutt anything that moves. However, their carapace isn't tough enough to resist the sheer amount of blunt force, so POKENAME is constantly covered in bruises.

entry: POKENAME见什么都想撞，可身体太轻，没多少威力。头上的角，也还没长好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will try to ram themselves into anything, even though their bodies are so light they don't do much damage. Their horns are still developing.

entry: POKENAME身体温顺，头上的嘴却总烦躁地啃咬沿途一切。常因坚韧的深棕毛发而被人驯养。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its body being docile, the mouth on POKENAME's head is always agitated and tries to gnaw anything in its path. POKENAME is often domesticated for its tough dark-brown hair.

entry: POKENAME虽然以凶悍出名，却更爱吃树果和水果。野外，它们以5至10只为一群四处游荡，对同伴的保护欲极强。
author: azalde
source: Despite their reputation for aggression, POKENAME prefer eating berries and fruits. They roam in groups of 5-10 in the wild and are fiercely protective of their herd.

entry: POKENAME常成群顶角嬉闹，假打玩耍。它们耐力惊人，连跑几个小时，也不必休息。
author: melodydelune
source: Herds of POKENAME play by locking their horns in play fights. They have high stamina and can run for hours without rest.

entry: 听歌声的高低，就能知道POKENAME生没生气。真正冲锋之前，声音反而会轻得如耳语。
author: mrpeach774
source: You can tell a POKENAME is angry by the pitch of its song. Its voice drops to a whisper when it is about to charge.

entry: POKENAME弱得可怜，战斗中毫无用处，却是值钱的鱼饵。因此还形成了成万繁育的产业。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are pitifully weak and worthless in battle, but they are valuable as fishing bait. An entire industry exists for breeding tens of thousands of them.

entry: 这只传说中的海兽，经融合技术，恢复了远古的辉煌模样。可力量，还是弱得可怜。
author: brienie
source: A legendary creature of the sea, restored to its ancient glory through fusion technology. Its power, however, is still weak and pathetic.

entry: POKENAME常被渔夫错当成异色暴鲤龙。据说遇见它，既是好运也是坏运的征兆。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for shiny Gyarados by fishermen. Encountering one is said to be a sign of both good and bad luck.

entry: 将鲤鱼王与最强生命体融合的实验，的确成功了。可即便如此，也没能给鲤鱼王添上什么了不起的力量。
author: brienie
source: Experiments to fuse a Magikarp with the strongest lifeform were a success. However, it was still not enough to give Magikarp any noteworthy power.

entry: POKENAME游得飞快，还能跃出水面，滑翔好几米，再潜回深水。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an extremely fast swimmer that can jump out of the water and glide many meters before diving back into the depths.

entry: POKENAME天资聪颖，却白白浪费潜能。整天自鸣得意，钻研些无意义、无用处、毫无道理的话题。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME have gifted minds, but wasted potentials. They waste their intellect smugly pondering meaningless, useless and senseless topics all day.

entry: 高大瀑布旁，常能看见POKENAME，想用爪子爬到顶端。可每次，没爬到就先累了。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is commonly seen around tall waterfalls, using its claws to climb to the top. However, it always gets tired before it can reach its goal.

entry: 虽然弱小，嗅觉却极敏锐。钻进河泥，捕取更小的猎物维生。
author: metalocif
source: This weak Pokémon has a remarkable sense of smell. It survives by digging into river mud and gathering smaller prey for sustenance.

entry: 毛发状突起模仿鲤鱼王，让敌人误以为它弱得无法还手。不过，这招给POKENAME带来的麻烦往往比好处多。
author: mistymagius
source: Its hair-like protrusion mimics a Magikarp, tricking opponents into thinking it's too weak to fight back. However, this often causes more problems for POKENAME than anything else.

entry: POKENAME背上的玻璃球里，常住着幼小的鲤鱼王。传说球中的水能赐予永生，因为从没人见过有鲤鱼王死在里面。
author: teatedtiten
source: The glass bulb on POKENAME's back usually has baby Magikarp residing in them. Legends say the water can grant eternal life as no one has ever seen a Magikarp die in the bulb.

entry: 保卫领地时，POKENAME会乱挥双臂，想显得吓人些。可惜，通常都没什么效果。
author: brienie
source: When POKENAME defends its territory, it can be seen flailing its arms about in an attempt to be intimidating. This attempt is usually unsuccessful.

entry: 这柄古老的传说之刃，遗失于深海。据说谁握起POKENAME，都会变得前所未有地弱。
author: brienie
source: A legendary and ancient blade, lost deep in the ocean. It is said whoever wields POKENAME will become weaker than ever before.

entry: 谁想拿起POKENAME，它便拼命扑腾。可实在没力气，很快就屈服，被当地渔民拿去剖鱼。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wildly flops when someone tries to pick it up. However, it is so weak that it quickly gives in to being used by local fisherman to gut fish.

entry: POKENAME想执刃守护海洋，可年纪尚幼，还不能参加真正的战斗。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME wishes to take up a blade in defense of the sea. Still, its youth hinders it from seeing real combat.

entry: 海洋危急之时，POKENAME便会挺身守护。平日不忙护海，便总在刻苦训练。
author: brienie
source: POKENAME have been known to defend the ocean in times of peril. When they are not defending the ocean, they can be found constantly training.

entry: POKENAME调皮，据说会偷钥匙。可它带着的钥匙，似乎从没成功开过任何锁。
author: brienie
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon said to steal keys. It is believed that the keys it carries have never successfully opened any lock.

entry: 翅膀无力，无法长久飞行。一阵微风，就能把POKENAME吹得偏离路线数英里。
author: melodydelune
source: Its weak wings cannot maintain flight for long periods of time. A gentle breeze is enough to send POKENAME flying off course for miles.

entry: POKENAME能收存或提供各种钓具，很受钓鱼爱好者追捧。会在岸边伸出诱饵，捕捉猎物，吸取生命力。
author: raza
source: POKENAME are said to be the most sought after fusions for fishing enthusiasts, as they can help store or provide a wide variety of equipment. POKENAME rest on shorelines and extend lures out into the water to catch prey and drain their life force.

entry: POKENAME走动时有种滑稽的优雅，两颗头总在争论往哪游、往哪跑。虽然笨拙，却能突然高高跃起，所到之处水花四溅。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME tends to roam about with a comical grace, its two heads arguing over which direction to swim or run. Despite its clumsy appearance, it can surprisingly launch itself high into the air, creating a splash wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME只能在茂密灌丛中缓缓前进，可身上的倒刺，带着强烈的毒液。林间跋涉，可要留意。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can only move slowly through dense undergrowth. However, its barbs spread a strong venom, so hikers should be careful in the forest.

entry: POKENAME将独角虫当作武器甩来甩去，不太在意其安全。自己厚实的甲壳能挡住独角虫蜇刺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wield Weedle as weaponry, flailing them around with little regard for their safety. Its thick carapace protects it's from the Weedle's sting.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密海带丛，动作慢，只有微毒的刺防御。主要靠灰暗伪装、不突然乱动，避开捕食者注意。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Slow-moving and defended only by mildly toxic stingers, POKENAME live in dense kelp growths. They rely heavily on their drab camouflage and lack of sudden movements to avoid drawing attention from predators.

entry: 深海没有叶片可吃，POKENAME便改吃海藻与苔藓。受攻击时，要么用角刺向敌人，要么摆鳍游走。
author: darkweavile428
source: Since the deep sea lacks leaves for it to eat, POKENAME has turned to a diet of seaweed and moss instead. If attacked, it has the option of either jabbing the assailant with its horn or using its fin to swim away.

entry: POKENAME想装凶，反而只会逗人笑。这只滑稽的小虫若摔倒，爬起来还很费劲。
author: robosoup
source: When POKENAME tries to act fierce, it only makes people laugh. If this clownish bug falls over, it has trouble getting back up.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: chorb33
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME胆小害羞，很少攻击人类。可受威胁时，会用角和尾刺带来灼痛，因此仍须小心。
author: krune
source: POKENAME is a very timid and shy creature. It rarely attacks humans, but if threatened, it will use its horn and tail-spike to inject a searing pain, so caution is adviced.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: chorb33
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME身上的倒刺，本是怪异头部向内生长的牙齿。接触就会注入毒液，但只有狠狠咬下才会达到危险剂量。
author: mistymagius
source: The barbs on POKENAME's body are actually ingrown teeth from its monstrous head. These teeth inject poison on contact, but only full bites deliver a dangerous dose.

entry: POKENAME沿袭绿剑鞘的进化方式，又添上丝制的尖刺，让连枷更能吓退敌人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has built onto Cateredge's evolutionary strategy by adding silk spikes to make its flail a greater deterrent.

entry: POKENAME毛发中的毒，足以杀死三名训练家。若曾接触，必须立即联系当地医院。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's hair holds enough poison to kill three Trainers. If you've come in contact with it, you must contact your local hospital immediately.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋入地下，只露头顶的尖刺，防备天敌。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME protects itself from predators by burying itself under the ground and leaving the spike atop its head exposed.

entry: POKENAME能吞下嘴里装得下的任何东西。每天若吃不足自身体重的食物，就会暴怒翻腾，直到筋疲力尽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will swallow anything that can fit in its mouth. If it doesn't eat its own body weight in food daily, it flies into a fury and thrashes until exhausted.

entry: 这些巨兽守在河湖旁，收取过路费。付过后，便展开颈部泡沫，形成平台，载对方渡水。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Though its size may be huge, these giants are found near rivers and lakes where they guard sections and demand tolls to pass. Once the toll is paid they expand the foam around their neck to create a platform for others to climb on and ride across.

entry: 它夜里潜行河湖，静候猎物。关都发生的宝可梦袭击事件中，有很大一部分，都是POKENAME所为。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon stalks rivers and lakes at night, lying in wait for prey. POKENAME attacks make up a large percent of all Pokémon attacks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME从不攻击自认比自己弱的宝可梦。可愤怒一旦到达极限，就会疯狂攻击眼前一切，直到什么也不剩。
author: mistymagius
