source: POKENAME will never attack Pokémon it considers weaker than it. However, if its anger reaches a critical point, it will violently attack anything within its line of sight until nothing remains.

entry: POKENAME梦想有朝一日，像那些英雄一样，保护弱者。可眼下，它还忙着钓起水宝可梦，盼着大丰收。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME dreams of one day becoming like the heroes who protect the weak. Now, though, it fishes out Water-type Pokémon in hopes of a big catch.

entry: POKENAME的水炮臂，作战十分凶狠。可它依然恪守荣誉，愿意保护比自己弱小的宝可梦。
author: phantom640
source: Despite its cruelty in combat using its water cannon arm, POKENAME has been found to live by a code of honor, leading it to defend weaker Pokémon.

entry: 传说，最早的POKENAME来自一只鲤鱼伊布——它仅靠跃起水花，便逆着雄伟的瀑布游了上去。
author: melodydelune
source: Legends say the first POKENAME came from a Magiveon that swam up a mighty waterfall by only splashing.

entry: 尾巴上的火焰，即使浸入水中，也不会熄灭。POKENAME一下水，附近多数宝可梦，便都被吓跑。
author: schierke
source: The fire burning on its tail stays lit underwater. When POKENAME enters the water, it scares off most Pokémon living in that area.

entry: POKENAME藏身雾气，行踪难觅。若被激怒，就会猛然冲出迷雾，挥动强尾，抽打敌人。
author: manidrake
source: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that hides itself in clouds of mist. If enraged, it will surge from the mist, whipping foes with its mighty tail.

entry: 三颗怒吼的头与敏捷的身体，让POKENAME令人畏惧。性情极凶，能高高跃起，每颗头都喷出水流。雨天会在平原疾奔觅食。
author: thepandasharky
source: With three roaring heads and an agile body, POKENAME is a terrifying presence to all. It is extremely violent and is able to jump high in the air and shoot water from each head. During the rain, it runs across plains at high speeds looking for prey.

entry: POKENAME贪食凶猛，几乎什么都吞。古人认为，漩涡就是饥饿的它们试图吞下整片海洋造成的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are ravenous and ferocious creatures that are able to devour nearly anything. In ancient times, it was believed that whirlpools were caused by famished POKENAME attempting to swallow the ocean itself.

entry: POKENAME善良体贴，十分自豪于背上的小苗。可谁想靠近它悉心照料的幼苗，就会遭到不分对象的猛烈攻击。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is a very kind and caring Pokémon and is very proud of the small seedling on its back. However, if anyone tries to get near the seedling that POKENAME cares for, it will attack indiscriminately and aggressively.

entry: 温顺的POKENAME几乎被猎杀殆尽。即使如此，野生个体仍常自愿用巨大的腹袋，载人渡过水域。
author: sontyp
source: Their docile nature has resulted in POKENAME being hunted almost to the point of extinction. Regardless, wild POKENAME can often be observed carrying people across bodies of water in their giant belly pouches out of their own volition.

entry: 西尔佛公司将POKENAME开发为智能浏览器，帮助使用者安全网上冲浪，避开各种恶意软件。
author: napstabl0ok
source: Developed by Silph Co. to work as a smart browser, POKENAME helps users surf the web safely, avoiding different kinds of malware.

entry: POKENAME比拉普拉斯更凶，也更适应暖地，常出现在新岛形成之处。亲族不信任人类，会极力保护它们。
author: wormspawn
source: More aggressive and used to warmer climates than Lapras, POKENAME appear where islands begin to form. They are protected fiercely by their families due to distrust of humans.

entry: POKENAME能旋转身体各节，让骨状突起充当螺旋桨。足以让多数宝可梦丧命的水压，它也能承受。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can rotate its body segments, their bony protrusions acting as propellers. It tolerates water pressures most Pokémon would find lethal.

entry: 厚实而带刺的壳，保护POKENAME免遭攻击。它们聪明得很，歌也唱得动听。
author: essie
source: A thick, spiked shell protects POKENAME from enemy attacks. They are highly intelligent, and can sing beautifully.

entry: POKENAME害羞，只会在海上现身帮助心善而有需要的训练家。受威胁时，水状附肢会变得锋利，能切开岩石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite shy and will only appear to kind-hearted Trainers in need while at sea. When threatened, it sharpens its water-like appendage to cut through stone.

entry: POKENAME爱陪训练家，在开阔水域畅游。救生员也常请它帮忙，救起溺水的人与宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME love to swim in open waters with their Trainers. They are often used by lifeguards to help save drowning people and Pokémon.

entry: 拉普拉斯濒临灭绝时，人们创造这种融合体，想让它们永久留存。后来发现没有必要，POKENAME的设计便被废弃。
author: dodoowner_
source: When Lapras was on the brink of extinction, this fusion was created to keep them forever. POKENAME's design was later scrapped, as it was unneeded.

entry: POKENAME不断放出的水，看似清澈，实则暗藏凶险，里面混着自身剧毒的体液。
author: chorb33
source: The clear-looking water that POKENAME constantly releases is particularly perfidious, as it is mixed with the highly toxic juices of its body.

entry: 多长出的两条手臂，让POKENAME游得更快。双腿也结实，甚至能背着人，在陆地上赶路。
author: darkweavile428
source: The edition of two extra arms allow POKENAME to swim faster in the water. It can even ferry people across land thanks to its sturdy legs.

entry: POKENAME由有机物构成，比大岩蛇脆弱，却也浮得更稳，能载上几十名乘客。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME is more fragile than Onix due to its organic composition. However, it's much more buoyant, allowing it to ferry dozens of passengers.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳由形状不定的物质构成，能模仿任何宝可梦，但仅限花纹。睡觉时会伪装成叶子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace is made of an amorphous substance that lets it mimic any Pokémon. However, they can only mimic things by pattern and camouflage as a leaf while sleeping.

entry: POKENAME变成了吉利蛋的样子。为了装得更真，还从另一只可怜的吉利蛋那里，偷来一颗蛋。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: This POKENAME has taken the form of a Chansey. It has also stolen an egg from another poor Chansey to really sell the appearance.

entry: 它想逗孩子开心，便努力变出自己知道的各种鬼脸。可身体不稳定，变到最后，总是反而吓人。
author: skymaster426
source: It wishes to entertain children, so it attempts to craft the funniest faces it knows. However, due to its instability, it only ends up scaring.

entry: POKENAME闻起来，宛如一大束鲜花。人们常采集它的黏液，制作香气浓郁的香水。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME tends to smell like a giant bouquet of flowers. The goo from it is often harvested and used in the creation of strong scented perfumes.

entry: 据说，POKENAME乳头流出的胶状物，营养十分丰富。可那副模样，实在让人不想尝试。
author: kitarchen
source: The goo that comes out of POKENAME's udders is said to be highly nutritious. However, the appearance of it makes people unwilling to try it.

entry: POKENAME模仿当红艺人，照搬节目。可惜，本领往往学不来，评论也因此很糟。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME mimics very popular performers to rip off their shows. Unfortunately, it typically fails to mimic their skills and gets low reviews.

entry: POKENAME通过重组细胞结构变形，常变成自己喜欢栽种的花草与树木。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A POKENAME will reorganise its cell structure to transform. It will often take the form of the flowers, plants, or trees that it enjoys growing.

entry: POKENAME努力变得可爱漂亮，讨训练家喜欢。但嘴仍保持原样，只好竭力掩饰真面目。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tries to appear cute or beautiful to gain Trainers' affection. However, its mouth remains, so it does its best to hide its true face.

entry: 将要击中之前，POKENAME总爱忽然变换刀刃，随机换种材质，或变成某种勉强像武器的东西。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Right before landing a hit, POKENAME likes to change its blade's composition into that of a random material or any object vaguely resembling a weapon.

entry: 刚被发现时，科学家以为它是一只正在变成仙子伊布的百变怪。它的遗传物质极不稳定。
author: melodydelune
source: When first discovered, scientists believed this Pokémon was a Ditto mid-transformation into a Sylveon. Its DNA is extremely unstable.

entry: 科学家尝试测定来自其他世界的宝可梦的基因结构，但每一次尝试最终都产生了POKENAME。
author: tokenoracle
source: Scientists attempted to sequence the DNA structure of Pokémon from other worlds. All attempts resulted in POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME被装在一个塑料袋里。通常它的身体只有轻微毒性，但不稳定的基因能重组身体，使它产生麻痹毒素。
author: bobosmith01
source: A plastic bag contains POKENAME. Its body, by default, is only mildly poisonous. POKENAME's unstable DNA can rearrange its body to become paralytic.

entry: POKENAME拼命想吓唬紫苑镇的人，却通常不成功。有些人虽没被吓到，也会装作害怕，帮它建立自信。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME try desperately to scare people in Lavender Town, but usually fail. Although few are intimidated, some act scared to boost their confidence.

entry: POKENAME几乎随处可见，四处寻找理想的进化地点。身体虽小，连最恶劣的环境也能生存。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found virtually everywhere, looking for their ideal spot for evolution. Despite how small they are, POKENAME can survive in even the harshest of environments.

entry: 这只特别的伊布发生了独特突变，基因组成大幅改变，如今与所有已知进化形都十分相近。
author: jackjirachi
source: This particular Eevee has undergone a unique mutation. Its genetic makeup has changed significantly, and now closely resembles all of its known Evolutions'.

entry: 两只伊布融合后，不稳定的基因发生突变，造就了一只兼具所有进化形态特征的宝可梦。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: Combining an Eevee with another Eevee has resulted in its unstable genes mutating, creating a Pokémon with features of each possible evolution.

entry: POKENAME十分稀有。传说，接触不同的特殊石头，便能进化成不同姿态。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME is a rare Pokémon. Legend says it will evolve into different forms when in contact to certain stones.

entry: POKENAME好奇又容易轻信，还总分心，一不小心，就把自己置于危险。照顾它，可得时时看紧。
author: kittyluv090
source: Very curious and gullible, POKENAME needs constant supervision because it is easily distracted and can unknowingly put itself in harm's way.

entry: POKENAME爱收集进化石，当首饰佩戴，甚至会溜进百货商店偷走库存的石头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to collect evolution stones and will wear them as jewelry. It will even sneak into department stores to steal their collection of stones.

entry: POKENAME作为家养宠物，始终供不应求。遗憾的是，也因此常有土龙弟弟，遭人为融合而非法捕猎。
author: staghorn
source: Demand for POKENAME as a house pet is always extremely high. Cases of Dunsparce being illegally poached for fusion purposes are, regrettably, common.

entry: 两边原主都较为稀有，因此，这种融合体也难得一见。已有的个体，多半被当作宠物饲养。
author: faelocke
source: Due to requiring two relatively rare Pokémon as components, this fusion is rarely seen. Those that exist are often kept as pets.

entry: 伊布在间歇出现严寒的环境附近长大，才会进化为POKENAME。有些培育者认为，刻意这样促成进化，并不道德。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME only evolve from Eevee raised near severe, sporadic sources of cold. Some Eevee breeders consider deliberately evolving one to be unethical.

entry: 伊布与多边兽Ｚ融合后，遗传构成变得极不稳定。每次试图适应环境，都会出了故障。
author: jackjirachi
source: Fusing Eevee with Porygon-Z has caused its genetic makeup to become critically unstable. It glitches every time it tries to adapt to an environment.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，另外三颗头却不停争斗，喷出元素攻击，想证明自己的进化比本体更出色。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its cuteness and friendly nature, POKENAME's three other heads are constantly at war. They spew elemental attacks to prove their evolution is superior to the main body.

entry: POKENAME善于攀爬，生活在热带森林中。周围环境的种种变化，都会影响它未来的进化。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb very well and lives in tropical forests. Various environmental influences affect its future evolution.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: 这支长矛忠诚，潜力无穷。背面的凹槽里，似乎还缺一块石头。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A loyal spear full of potential. There is a slot on the back that seems to be missing a stone.

entry: 人们推测，伊布进化成仙子伊布时，若仍保留不稳定的遗传构成，就会成为POKENAME。
author: melodydelune
source: It is theorized that POKENAME is the result of an Eevee that retained its unstable genetic makeup when evolving into a Sylveon.

entry: POKENAME像谜拟Ｑ一样，披着做成伊布模样的破布，免得显得吓人。那块布，也会随环境发生古怪的反应。
author: petermars
source: Much like Mimikyu, POKENAME wears a rag fashioned into an Eevee costume to make it look less scary. This rag reacts strangely to its environment.

entry: POKENAME能完全掌控自己的遗传结构，依环境的需要，改变形态与属性。
author: ethewriter
source: POKENAME has full control over its genetic structure. It can change its form and type based on what it needs for its environment.

entry: POKENAME头上的花瓣，象征着进化潜力。某一种花瓣越多，便越接近相应的进化。
author: mistymagius
source: The petals on POKENAME's head symbolizes its evolutionary potential. The more of one type of petal is on its head, the closer it is to evolution.

entry: POKENAME在海滩装成埋在沙里的可爱伊布，引人抚摸。接触后便控制对方，强迫其送来进化石。
author: knilk
source: POKENAME haunts beaches, where it lures unsuspecting victims into petting it by cutely pretending to be an Eevee buried in sand. When they touch it, it takes control of them and forces them to bring it Evolution stones.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛上的石头代表想进化的形态。通常很犹豫，只有一种石头的个体十分罕见。
author: teatedtiten
source: The stones on POKENAME's mane represent what evolution the Pokémon wants to become. They are usually indecisive, so finding one with only a single type of stone is rare.

entry: 融合产生的副作用，让伊布部分遗传密码突变，因此，两颗头分别近似伊布的两种进化形态。
author: cascadeguy
source: The fusion process has mutated some of Eevee's genetic code as a side effect. Due to this, its heads resemble two of Eevee's evolutions.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头，偶尔会显出伊布三种进化形态的能力，可威力，就没那么出色了。
author: cascadeguy
source: The heads of POKENAME occasionally display abilities from three of Eevee's evolutions. However, the potency of these abilities is not as impressive.

entry: POKENAME身上带条纹的污泥，其实是一种伪装。有时，它只吃掉进化石放出的辐射，却不进化。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's striped sludge is actually a method of camouflage. Sometimes, it will eat the radiation from an evolution stone instead of evolving.

entry: POKENAME的腿尚未完全适应水中生活，主要靠强尾推进。对人类十分友善，甚至专门上岸陪人玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs haven't quite adapted to aquatic conditions so it relies on its powerful tail to propel itself through the water. They are quite friendly to humans and will come to shore just to play with them.

entry: 河流与小池塘中，常能发现POKENAME，也因此，常被人拿来作鱼饵。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are well known to be spotted in rivers or small ponds. This has led to them being used commonly as fishing bait.

entry: 看似纤细的翅膀，其实是带蹼的鳍，能推动水中游动。可鳍太重，离水后便难以飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon's delicate wings are actually webbed fins that allow it to propel itself through the water. However, it struggles to fly outside of the water because of the weight of these fins.

entry: POKENAME动作敏捷，协调出色，是游泳的好手。休息时，常仰着身子，漂在水面。
author: vaporvenator
source: Remarkable agility and coordination makes POKENAME an expert swimmer. They can be observed resting on their backs, floating atop the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME的触角，有时能触发进化。找不到水之石的野生水宝可梦，就能得到它的帮助。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's antennae can sometimes trigger evolution. It helps wild Water-types who can't seem to find their own Water Stones.

entry: POKENAME住在湖底最深处，用诱饵状的器官，吸引小鱼。其余身体，则轻松藏进幽暗的水里。
author: crypticanexe
source: Living in the deepest parts of lakes, POKENAME uses its esca to lure in smaller fish. It easily camouflages the rest of its body in the dark waters.

entry: POKENAME背上的花有两重用处：靠近水面时，能帮它伪装，还能通过光合作用，提供养分。
author: melodydelune
source: The flower on POKENAME's back serves two purposes: it helps it blend in when near the surface, and it provides nutrients through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME钻入水下松软的淤泥，藏身待猎。由于细胞结构特殊，身体一沾水，便半透明起来。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME will dig into loose silt underwater to hide and wait for prey. Because of its cell structure its body becomes translucent when wet.

entry: POKENAME掘地寻找地下水，带回自己的巢穴。在沙漠里，这样的活动，最终会形成滋养新生命的绿洲。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME dig in search for groundwater to bring back to their nests. In deserts, this activity ends up forming oases for new life to thrive in.

entry: POKENAME对人类活动很感兴趣，喜欢轻轻啃咬物品，探索周围世界。力道通常很轻，不会伤人。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME are intrigued by human activities. They explore the world around them by nibbling things, often too softly to cause harm to others.

entry: POKENAME钩住猎物后，便散发出安抚的气息，让对方不再挣扎。
author: melodydelune
source: When POKENAME have hooked their prey, they are filled with a soothing aura that makes it stop struggling against them.

entry: POKENAME的种子萌发后，它便会将其打开，与所有生命分享水，因此，草木鸟兽，都是它的朋友。
author: ladan
source: When a POKENAME's seed sprouts, it will open and share its water with all, making it a friend to flora and fauna alike.

entry: 黑夜里，它摇动灯火，引来猎物。蓝光奇特，见过的很少，能解释自己所见的，更少。
author: wigglypon
source: On dark nights, it waves its lights to attract prey. Its blue glow is unusual; few have witnessed it, and fewer could explain what they'd seen.

entry: POKENAME体内满是净水，平日用带刺的尾巴，小心保护。它要留着这些水，直到准备进化。
author: ladan
source: POKENAME is filled with purified water that it protects with its spiked tail. It will save this water until it's ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME既能操水，又会耕地，用来务农，再合适不过。许多人请它帮忙，轻松种植作物。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's skills in water manipulation and tilling are a great combo for farming. Many use it to grow crops effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME硬毛般的体毛能收集静电，用于维生与自卫。虽腿短，充沛精力仍让时速可达30英里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity, which it uses for sustenance and defense. Despite its small legs, it can move up to 30 miles per hour due to its high energy.

entry: POKENAME硬毛般的体毛能收集静电，用于维生与自卫。虽腿短，充沛精力仍让时速可达30英里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bristle-like hairs gather static electricity which it uses for sustenance and as a defense mechanism. Despite its small legs it can move up to 30mph thanks to its high energy.

entry: POKENAME将体内电力储存在雷之石般的晶体花苞里。风暴时四处游走，等待花苞引来雷电。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores its internal electricity in its crystalline bud that resembles a thunder stone. They roam around on stormy days, waiting for lightning to be drawn to their bud.

entry: 掷出POKENAME，击中目标的瞬间，便会迸出电流。握着它举向天空，还能召下雷电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.

entry: 掷出POKENAME，击中目标的瞬间，便会迸出电流。握着它举向天空，还能召下雷电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME releases a jolt of electricity on impact when thrown. Its wielder can also call down lightning bolts while holding POKENAME to the sky.

entry: POKENAME虽仍迟缓，身上伸出的电缆，却让它轻易就能抓住、并电击那些靠得太近的家伙。
author: ladan
source: Even though POKENAME remains slow, the cables extending from its body make it a lot easier to catch and shock anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME歌唱得糟糕，是出了名的。若发现没人理它，就会愤怒地放出电流。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are known to be terrible singers. If one realizes that it's being ignored, they are known to shoot out electricity in anger.

entry: POKENAME干劲十足，却总难把想做的事做好。它想往敌人身上扑，火花四溅，忙到最后，还是徒劳。
author: ladan
source: Though POKENAME is full of energy and motivation, it struggles to follow its aims. It fruitlessly tries to hurl itself toward foes, sparks flying.

entry: 突然袭来的雷雨，常是它们惹的祸。它们最爱在云间嬉戏，闪来闪去，躲着道道雷电。
author: hummusishome
source: These Pokémon are often to blame for sudden thunderstorms. They take delight in playing among the clouds and dodging bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME性情好斗，会裹着火焰冲撞其他宝可梦。软毛燃烧的热度宛如篝火，因此很受露营者欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite feisty and will tackle other Pokémon while cloaked in flames. Its soft fur burns as hot as a campfire, so these Pokémon are quite popular amongst campers.

entry: POKENAME绒毛极易燃，随时能点着吓退捕食者。身体却十分耐热，连森林大火也能安然承受。
author: mistymagius
source: The fluff on its body is highly flammable and POKENAME can easily ignite it to scare off any predators. Its body is highly resistant to heat and is able to withstand forest fires without issue.

entry: 这是伊布的一种特殊进化，毒汗与火焰混合，能让疼痛久久不散。漆黑的夜里，也能看见它泛起红光。
author: mistymagius
source: A unique evolution of Eevee, its poisonous sweat mixes with flames to cause lost-lasting pain. Its red glow can be seen on dark nights.

entry: POKENAME皮肤不断散热，烫得能严重灼伤人。只有颈部和尾巴的毛较凉，那是排出热量的地方。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's skin constantly radiates with heat. It is so hot that touching it can cause severe burns, with the only cool spots being the fur on its neck and tail, where it releases the heat.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛打理得格外精致，却常在想烘干时把它点着。
author: kampfzwuggel
source: While POKENAME's mane is considered to be one of the most well-kept out there, it regularly sets it on fire while trying to dry it.

entry: POKENAME把热量全存进刀刃，留待战斗时释放。持剑者，也能借助POKENAME操纵火焰。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stores all its heat in its blade to release in battle. Its wielder can control fire through POKENAME while holding it.

entry: 这只宝可梦喜欢依偎着训练家。人们常说，把POKENAME抱在腿上，暖得就像盖了电热毯。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon loves to cuddle with its Trainer. It's often said that the feeling of a POKENAME on one's lap feels as toasty as an electric blanket.

entry: 寒夜月出时，POKENAME会来到野外露营的旅人身旁。大家睡着，它便看着篝火，让火焰始终不灭。
author: fenragon
source: On cold nights, when the moon is out, POKENAME visits travelers camping outside to keep their campfires burning while they sleep.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，翼间与毛发里，会散出火星。它与古书中记载的一种宝可梦，颇为相似。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME scatters flaming embers from its wings and fur as it runs. It shares some similarities with a Pokémon found in an old book.

entry: POKENAME酷似西尔佛公司生产的火伊布毛绒玩具。明明是火属性，毛发却特别容易燃烧。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME heavily resembles a plush of Flareon produced by Silph Co. Despite being a fire type, its fur is highly combustible.

entry: 据说POKENAME原是廉价防病毒程序，能进出设备，吞食损坏的代码。一台电脑里能同时住着数百万只。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have been created as a cheap virus protection, POKENAME can travel in and out of devices and feed on corrupted computer code. Millions of POKENAME live in a computer at a time.

entry: POKENAME从网上下载秘籍与强化补丁，提升拳击本领。再打起来，便招招凶狠，对手面前绝不留情。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME downloads cheats and buffs online to boost its boxing skills. Afterwards, it throws out attacks and shows no mercy to its opponents.

entry: POKENAME充当一种程序语言，帮助网络世界运行脚本。研究人员与程序员，也用它进行模拟。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME serves as a language to help run scripts in the cyberworld. Researchers and programmers use it to run simulations.

entry: 这次融合让它的代码变得稳定，不再出现错误。然而，它也失去了所有情感，以及身为多边兽Ⅱ时学会的大部分能力。
author: soup1900
source: This fusion caused its code to become stable and error-free. However, it has lost all emotion and most capabilities it learned when it was a Porygon2.

entry: 人们试图在实验电脑中复制、粘贴数码独剑鞘，原始数据却意外损坏，变成了一只全新而诡异的宝可梦——POKENAME。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In an effort to copy and paste a digital Honedge in an experimental PC, the original instead corrupted into a new, uncanny Pokémon: a POKENAME.

entry: 漫长下载后，代码赋予了它飞行能力。可多余的代码也带来了难以约束的暴怒。
author: thecrowartiste
source: As a result of a long download, its code enabled its ability to fly. However, it also inherited an unruly rage from excess code.

entry: POKENAME是卡洛斯创造的人造宝可梦，用来验证：能否以计算机代码，复制出任何一种宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is an artificial Pokémon that was created in Kalos to test the idea that any Pokémon could be replicated through computer code.

entry: POKENAME总坚持，自己能帮训练家操作某些电脑程序。可真问起建议，POKENAME又很少给得出有用的。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME constantly insists on helping its Trainer use certain computer programs. Despite this, POKENAME rarely has any helpful advice to give.

entry: 程序将POKENAME设定得比铁更硬，主要用头冠撞击。可冠太重，也让它无法飞行。
author: thecrowartiste
source: Coded to be harder than iron, POKENAME utilizes its crest mainly to headbutt. The crest on its head is heavy and renders it unable to fly.

entry: 这只人造宝可梦的最初版本，经过多次更新，核心系统更加偏重多边兽资料。模仿的精细程度虽高了许多，仍显得诡异，始终学不像一只自然生动的索罗亚。
author: elfail0
source: The first version of this artificial Pokémon was designed with various updates and a greater emphasis on Porygon data as its core system. As a result, it has far higher fidelity but is very uncanny and not quite able to imitate a Zorua organically.

entry: POKENAME嘴里，竟能藏下100多个程序漏洞。若让POKENAME靠近设备，电脑往往就会染上一大堆病毒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can house over 100 computer bugs in its mouth. Letting a POKENAME near your device will usually infect your computer with plenty of viruses.

entry: 训练家说，它的模样，像某款电子游戏里的城堡。不过，POKENAME长成这样，纯属巧合。
author: filteredtea
source: Trainers say this Pokémon's appearance bears resemblance to a castle in a video game. POKENAME's appearance, however, is purely coincidental.

entry: 不论训练家走到哪里，它都会跟随。针叶林也好，热带草原也好，POKENAME始终陪伴身旁。
author: dodoowner_
source: This Pokémon will follow its Trainer no matter where they venture. Whether it be a taiga or a savannah, POKENAME will accompany them.

entry: POKENAME会模仿任天堂64游戏机的外形与声音，喜欢用复古的表演，唤起人们怀旧的记忆。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME mimics the looks and sounds of a classic Nintendo 64 console. It loves to recreate nostalgic memories through its retro-style performances.

entry: POKENAME把双镲一碰，便激出数字冲击波，扰乱对手。可有时候，连自己也会一起乱了神。
author: shadow
source: The cymbals that POKENAME uses can be crashed together to make digital shock waves that can confuse the target. However, it can even confuse itself!

entry: POKENAME收集大量石头，再削成立方体，用这些方块，搭起令人惊叹的建筑。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME gathers large amounts of stone, and then shapes them into cubes. It can build impressive structures with these blocks.

entry: POKENAME曾生活在如今真新镇附近的海洋。它不为幼崽筑巢，而是直接把蛋，产在自己的壳内。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME was once found in oceans near what is now Pallet Town. Instead of making a nest for its young, it lays its eggs inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME蜷进壳里，沿海底滚动赶路。遇到食物，先用触手抓住，再整个吞下。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME travels the sea by curling into its shell and rolling along the ocean floor. It first grasps food with its tentacles, then swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME不狩猎时，便藏在壳里，用飘带拖着自己，慢慢挪动。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it's not hunting, dragging itself around with its ribbon.

entry: 据说，POKENAME携带着，来自遥远史前的果实，可从来没人敢尝。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are said to carry prehistoric fruits from long ago. No one has ever dared to taste them.

entry: 拉普拉斯是POKENAME的主要食物，因此，拉普拉斯壳上常能见到它的触手。久而久之，拉普拉斯也进化出了更硬的壳。
author: zeeroooo
source: POKENAME's tentacles can commonly be found on Lapras shells, as Lapras makes up most of their diet. Since then, Lapras have evolved harder shells.

entry: POKENAME每天有18个小时以上，牢牢附在海底。受攻击时，便猛烈挥动外壳。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will spend over 18 hours a day anchored to the seafloor. When attacked it will flail its shell violently.

entry: 化蛹时，POKENAME几乎毫无自保之力。只好用粗短的腿，攀紧树枝，避开天敌。
author: chorb33
source: During its pupation, POKENAME is almost helpless. With its short stubby legs, it clings to branches to stay safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在海中浅滩，互相抵御潮汐与捕食者。会如此挤在一起等上最多六个月，进化后才离海寻找大量食物。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME gather in large groups on ocean shoals to protect each other from the tides and predators. They will huddle in these patterns for up to six months waiting to evolve, at which point they will emerge from the sea and seek vast amounts of food.

entry: POKENAME把进化所需的能量存进花苞，受了伤，也能迅速长好新皮。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stores the energy it needs for evolution in its bud. If it is injured, it can quickly renew its skin.

entry: POKENAME的硬蛹壳既能防身，也能作武器。头顶尤其厚，因此更爱迎头冲撞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their hardened chrysalises both to protect themselves and as weapons. The shells of their chrysalises are especially thick at the tops of their skulls, leading them to prefer ramming head-first as an attack.

entry: POKENAME紧贴在树上，几乎一动不动。它会用飘带引诱猎物，获取营养。
author: melodydelune
source: Being virtually immobile while clinging to a tree, POKENAME gains nutrients by luring in prey with its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME甲壳没有痛觉受器，常察觉不到自己挨打。代谢极慢，一天只吃一颗树果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace has no pain receptors, so it will often not notice that it is being attacked. Their metabolism is very slow, only having to eat a single berry a day.

entry: POKENAME常常像个小商人一样，用大葱指点图表。如果煮熟后食用，它的口感会非常奇怪。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME often acts like a tiny businessman, using its leek to point at charts. If cooked and eaten, it has a very strange texture.

entry: POKENAME最初被认为是生活在3亿年前的太阳珊瑚祖先。然而，最近的重新研究表明，POKENAME是一种寄生宝可梦，会住进由太阳珊瑚脱落的外壳拼成的壳中。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME was originally believed to be an ancient ancestor of Corsola dating back 300 million years. However, recent re-evaluation suggests that POKENAME was a parasitic species that would live inside shells constructed from discarded Corsola shells.

entry: 这对深水伙伴，似乎早在人类出现之前，就发明了剑刃。细长的那只，负责打磨圆伙伴尾端的尖刺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This deepwater pair are thought to have created a sword blade eons before humans did. The elongated partner polishes the rounded one's caudal spike.

entry: POKENAME行动尴尬：巨镰拖累飞行，轻翼又怕沾水。于是贴水跳跃，用双臂划水，同时保持翅膀干燥以便起飞。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME is awkward; its heavy scythes hinder flight, and its airy wings clog in water. It adapts by skimming the surface in hops, swimming with its arms while keeping its wings dry to fly.

entry: 镰刀般的尾巴，能轻易切开猎物。游水时，POKENAME则会将尾巴，收拢贴紧身体。
author: melodydelune
source: Its sickle-like tail allows it to cut through prey with ease. When swimming, POKENAME will tuck its tail up against its body.

entry: POKENAME是最早被发现的史前哺乳动物之一。古代洞穴壁画中，还画着它挥舞刀刃，催眠猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of the first prehistoric mammals ever discovered. Ancient cave paintings have shown it using its blades to hypnotize its prey.

entry: 每只POKENAME的镰刀，都有独特花纹。若两只的刀刃太相似，POKENAME便会打到，只剩一把镰刀为止。
author: ohok3441
source: Each POKENAME has its own scythe with its own set of patterns. If their blades are too similar, POKENAME will fight until only one scythe remains.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME背上的琥珀碎片中含有古代宝可梦的遗传物质。POKENAME发怒时，藤蔓会疯狂生长。
author: mistymagius
source: The piece of amber on POKENAME's back is theorized to contain the DNA of ancient Pokémon. Its vines grow wildly when POKENAME is angered.

entry: 勾魂眼吃下秘密琥珀，有时便会变成这只宝可梦，很快，连各种化石也都想尝一尝。
author: insanity5734
source: A Sableye that consumes Old Amber will sometimes become this Pokémon, and soon develops a taste for all fossils.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，飞行速度却能媲美如今的烈咬陆鲨。加上出众的狩猎能力，被称为“空中歼灭者”。
author: patch
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME could fly at speeds that could rival modern Garchomp. This, coupled with its impressive hunting abilities, has earned it the nickname 'The Aerial Annihilator'.

entry: POKENAME静坐如雕像，等猎物靠近，从不追赶。闲暇时喜欢玩自己觉得漂亮的石头。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME sit perfectly still like statues, letting their prey get close to them instead of pursuing them. In their idle time they like to play with rocks they find pretty.

entry: 卡比兽以堵路出名，POKENAME也不例外，只不过堵的是河床与溪流，害水宝可梦春天也无法迁徙。
author: rooboid
source: Following Snorlax's reputation of blocking walkways, POKENAME blocks riverbeds and streams, leaving aquatic Pokémon unable to migrate in the spring.

entry: POKENAME太贪吃，触角竟适应着，长成了树果。它吃自己的树果，并不会痛，通常也会重新长好。
author: dodoowner_
source: The force of POKENAME's gluttony has adapted its antennae into Berries. It eating its Berries doesn't hurt, and they usually grow back.

entry: POKENAME硕大的独眼始终紧闭，生活却一切如常。一些持异说的人相信，POKENAME一旦睁眼，便预示着灭顶之灾。
author: sk372
source: Its large singular eye remains eternally closed, though POKENAME still functions normally in spite of this. Some fringe theorists believe that should POKENAME open its eye, it is a harbinger of great doom.

entry: 醒着的POKENAME，十分难见。凡是费力的事，都不如一场长觉来得好，可睡醒发起脾气，却相当可怕。
author: rooboid
source: To see POKENAME awake is a rarity, as they will always favor a long nap over anything that requires any effort. Their post-nap tantrums can be brutal.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺，是牢靠的防护。可头槌通常只打得出几记，就又开始犯困。
author: gp423
source: The spikes on its head provide POKENAME a solid defense mechanism. However, it can usually only muster a few headbutts before it gets sleepy.

entry: 据说亡者前往来世前，POKENAME会载其去不知名之处，共享最后的盛宴。吃完一切后，再引往永恒的归宿。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that before one departs to the afterlife, POKENAME will carry the deceased to an unknown place where they will share their final feast. POKENAME will then guide them to their eternal home after they've eaten everything.

entry: 性情温顺又讨喜，让这只宝可梦常被带到养老院。一天里，能有20个小时，都在睡觉。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon is often brought to retirement homes due to its docile and sweet nature. They spend up to 20 hours a day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME常突然大闹，脾气凶得很。可这样太耗能，余下一整天，就只顾睡觉。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME often go on violent temper tantrums. These take up a lot of energy, however, and it spends the rest of the day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛不停生长，得定期修剪。剪下的毛，常被用来制作厚实的冬衣。
author: kitarchen
source: Due to their fluff constantly growing, POKENAME are regularly shaved. The fur is often used in the creation of thick winter coats.

entry: 城镇附近，常能发现打盹的POKENAME。唯有路人带着好吃的，它才肯醒。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is often found napping around towns. It only wakes up if a passer-by has a tasty treat to eat.

entry: 由于蘑菇不断吸取能量，POKENAME吃得比普通卡比兽还多。POKENAME以文柚果为食，连蘑菇的外形也逐渐变得像文柚果。
author: darkweavile428
source: Thanks to the mushroom draining its energy, POKENAME eats even more than a regular Snorlax. Because of POKENAME's diet of Sitrus Berries, the mushroom has changed to resemble one.

entry: POKENAME平日忙着往嘴里塞意面，吃够了，便蜷进床铺，一连睡上好几个小时。
author: gp423
source: When POKENAME isn't participating in its usual routine of stuffing its face with pasta, it curls up in its bed and sleeps for hours upon hours.

entry: POKENAME爱趴在训练家身上，像一床暖和又厚重的毯子，表达亲昵，因此，是十分受欢迎的宠物。
author: jordanx27
source: POKENAME love to show affection for their Trainer by laying on them like a warm, heavy blanket. This makes them a very popular pet.

entry: POKENAME两个头轮流睡，却常双双睡过头，错过大半天。醒来又晚又饿，只好奔走寻找树果与昆虫。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME have two heads that take turns sleeping, but they both oversleep and end up missing most of the day. They often wake up late and starving, and will then run about foraging for berries and insects.

entry: 它的树果，只咬一口，就会让人立刻睡着。可别贪嘴，醒来时，食物早已全被POKENAME吃光。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Anyone who takes a bite of its berries will fall asleep right away. It's advised is not to eat them, as POKENAME will deprive you of all your food.

entry: POKENAME施展超能力时，宝石般的核心会放出壮丽极光，能随心控冰。曾保护北极海域的水手，因此被称为“北极星宝石”或“北极星之珠”。
author: alkazamis
source: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, a magnificent aurora emanates from its gemlike core. It controls ice at will. It has been known to protect sailors in arctic waters, so it is sometimes called the 'North Star Gem' or the 'Jewel of Polaris'.

entry: POKENAME胸中，满是强烈而不竭的决心，已经臻于巅峰。即使生命垂危，也会战斗到最后一刻。
author: leeto64
source: Bestowed with intense, overflowing determination, POKENAME has reached its zenith. With its life on the line, it'll keep battling until the very end.

entry: 有人见过，POKENAME不小心将自己的触角冻干。即使在冰寒的环境里，它仍能游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally freeze-drying their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in ice-cold environments.

entry: 葬身暴风雪的亡魂，汇成了POKENAME。这个强大的灵体，与一块冻结的楔石，相依相连。
author: melodydelune
source: Spirits that have passed in blizzards gather to form POKENAME. This powerful spirit is bonded to a frozen keystone.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，住在冰封的高峰附近。只消挥动刀刃，就能卷起暴风雪。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around icy summits. It can generate a blizzard with a swing of its blade.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦，给触须裹上厚冰，便造出壮丽的双翼。飞到哪里，雪就下到哪里。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon can create magnificent wings by coating its feelers in a thick coat of ice. Wherever it flies, it snows.

entry: 传说，在暴风雪中迷路时，若POKENAME就在附近，它会先把你催眠，免得被看见，再送你到安全的地方。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Legends say that if you get lost in a blizzard and POKENAME is nearby, it will put you to sleep so you won't see it and take you to a safe place.

entry: 白天看见流星，或许就是POKENAME正掠过天空，赶往远方，带去雷电。
author: fenragon
source: If you see a falling star during the daytime, it could be POKENAME zipping through the sky on its way to bring lightning to faraway regions.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心电到自己的触角。即使在带电的水中，它也能游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally shocking their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in electrified waters.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺能扎穿人类皮肤，把电流直接送进体内。凡发现它们的水域，都禁止游泳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's quills are able to pierce human skin and discharge electricity directly into the body. Swimming is off limits anywhere they are spotted.

entry: POKENAME羽毛储电多得难以想象。身体轻轻擦过，连最强健的宝可梦也会麻痹。
author: ayner
source: The feathers of POKENAME can store an unfathomable amounts of electricity. A simple graze of their body can paralyze even the sturdiest of Pokémon.

entry: 据说POKENAME会迎头冲进插座，融入电流，迅速穿过城市，便于伏击对手。
author: doodledoo
source: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.

entry: 海面出现雷暴，可能就意味着附近有POKENAME。只要POKENAME重新潜入水中，风暴很快便会散去。
author: kitarchen
source: If you see a thunderstorm over the ocean, it may mean a POKENAME is near. The storm will quickly pass once POKENAME dives back down into the water.

entry: 据说POKENAME是传说中的战士，伴着猛烈雷暴现身。炽烈电流流遍身体，以电光般速度出击，让敌人灼伤、麻痹。
author: thepandasharky
source: A Pokémon said to be a legendary warrior, appearing alongside raging thunderstorms. POKENAME channels fiery electricity through its body, unleashing electrified blows at blazing speed. Its strikes leave foes scorched and paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，栖息于火山熔岩附近，也能在熔岩中再生。据说，它若出现在别处，春天也会随之到来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around and regenerates in volcanic lava. Its appearance elsewhere is said to bring about spring.

entry: 据说这种传说宝可梦会在雷云中优雅起舞，再伴着雷电猛扑而下。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon is said to dance elegantly amongst thunderclouds, with the ability to pounce down among bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME的火焰永远燃烧，无法熄灭。即使是水，也只会让火势更旺。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME's fire burns forever and cannot be extinguished. Even water only strengthens the fire.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心烧掉自己的触角。即便如此，它也能在熔岩中游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally incinerating their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in molten lava.

entry: POKENAME能操控各种火焰，也能幻化出高大的凤凰影像，替代自己娇小的身姿。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME has the power to control all kinds of fire. It is able to conjure images of a towering phoenix in place of its diminutive form.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦诞生于火山核心。据说，看见它，就是春天将至的征兆。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon was born in the heart of a volcano. It's said that seeing this Pokémon is a sign of spring coming.

entry: 这是POKENAME的稀有种，有时也被称为“海之九头蛇”。
author: toxicrown
source: A rare species of POKENAME. It is sometimes called 'The Hydra of the Seas'.

entry: 许多文化认为，一生能见到POKENAME就是神赐的祝福，往后会有好运。两颗头总协调行动，绝不朝相反方向走。
author: faeflame
source: Many cultures believe that to see a POKENAME in one's lifetime is a divine blessing and will lead to good fortune. The two heads tend to move in harmony with each other, never moving in opposing directions.

entry: POKENAME毛质极为奢华，深受上流训练家追捧，却也因此几乎被猎杀殆尽。
author: mistymagius
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon by high-class Trainers, POKENAME's fur is among the most luxurious. However, this has led to it being hunted to near extinction.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区极为罕见。它通常尽力避免冲突，真有必要，也会迎战。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME are exceedingly rare in volcanic biomes. They usually try to avoid conflict but will fight if necessary.

entry: POKENAME柔软的吻部布满神经，轻轻碰一下，也会让它痛得厉害，因此不适合给孩子作伴。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's soft snout is full of nerve endings, and even minor impacts cause it great pain. For this reason, they make poor companions for children.

entry: 随着身体慢慢长大，POKENAME会弃下旧鞘，长出更大的新鞘。这些旧剑鞘，常被王室用来象征身份。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its scabbard for a larger one it generates as it slowly grows. These scabbards are often used as status symbols for royalty.

entry: 刚出生的POKENAME生活在河床与湖底。每次蜕皮，触须也会长得更长。
author: melodydelune
source: During the beginning of POKENAME's life, it will live on the floor of rivers and lakes. As it sheds its skin, its feelers will grow longer.

entry: POKENAME虽模样凶恶，性情却平和温顺。可一到战斗，尾巴还是会兴奋地摆动起来。
author: xephyr
source: Despite a fearsome exterior, POKENAME is a calm and docile Pokémon by nature. When in battle, its tail begins swaying excitedly.

entry: POKENAME分泌的液体可制成多种麻醉剂。它们顽皮爱闹，喜欢用黏液痕迹作画。受惊时，能迅速化成一滩黏液。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME secrete a fluid that is used for various anesthetics. They are playful and cheeky creatures and enjoy making art with their slime trails. If spooked they can quickly turn into a puddle of goo.

entry: POKENAME大部分岁月都在地下度过，直到强壮得足以进化。若被发现，轻轻松松就能迅速钻走。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives underground until they get strong enough to evolve. If it is seen, it can quickly and effortlessly burrow away.

entry: 小群POKENAME藏在远离人类的云间。受惊时，白毛转灰，再以强雷电击周围一切。
author: mistymagius
source: Small groups of POKENAME hide amongst the clouds far from human contact. If startled, their white wool turns grey, and they shock everything nearby with a powerful thunderbolt.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，通常只喷出墨汁，掩护逃走。可若生命垂危，也会使出全部的龙之力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite timid and usually just spray ink on its attackers to escape. But if its life is on the line, it will use its full draconic power.

entry: 村庄常向这只威严的宝可梦供奉，盼望好天气。据说，它的鸣叫，连最猛烈的风暴也能安抚。
author: melodydelune
source: This majestic Pokémon is often given offerings by villages in hopes of good weather. It's said its cry can calm the fiercest storms.

entry: POKENAME战斗时交替用尾巴和伸缩手臂，让敌人难以防备。难取胜时，还会踢腿、头槌，全身都成了危险武器。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME likes to switch between using its tail and retractable arms when fighting enemies, to throw them off guard. If it has a hard time winning, it will also try kicking and headbutting, making its entire body dangerous.

entry: POKENAME产生的泡泡，看着像珍珠，其实只是虹彩流转的液体。遇上威胁，便喷向对方，趁机逃走。
author: ohok3441
source: While the bubbles POKENAME produces look like pearls, it's nothing more than an iridescent fluid. It spits it at any threat to make a quick escape.

entry: 为适应雪地，POKENAME长出几丛厚毛，在风雪中保护面部。可厚毛也因此，遮住了视线。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's snowy habitat has led it to adapt patches of thick fur for protecting its face during blizzards, which has restricted its eyesight.

entry: POKENAME身上的圆珠，会放出明亮的电蓝色光，晃花注视者的双眼，因此，想拍到一张好照片，并不容易。
author: mistymagius
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow with an electric blue light. They use this to blind anyone that see them, so good photos of POKENAME are rare.

entry: POKENAME比外表看着快得多。多年来，许多邮政机构都请它跨地区送信。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME is a very fast Pokémon. Throughout the years, POKENAME have been used by many postal systems to deliver letters across regions.

entry: POKENAME的预知力，在风暴中最为强大。它凝望暴雨中的云，便能清晰看见未来的景象。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's clairvoyant abilities peak during storms. It gazes at the clouds during heavy rains, viewing crystal-clear images of the future.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾守望远古沼泽，以神秘烟雾围住珍视的一切。平时温和，可谁未经邀请闯入烟雾，就会被毒素淹没。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have kept watch over an ancient swamp, POKENAME protects anything precious to it by surrounding it in enigmatic smog. While POKENAME is normally peaceful, anyone that tries to enter the smog uninvited will find themselves flooded with toxins.

entry: POKENAME特殊的鳍让它几秒便能游过5000多米。会用这速度追捕猎物、赶走竞争者。
author: kitarchen
source: Using specialized fins, POKENAME are able to swim over 5000 meters in mere seconds. They use this speed to hunt down prey and chase off competitors.

entry: POKENAME天生想助人，却又胆怯，常常内心挣扎。不过真有人需要帮助时，它一定会竭尽所能。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME constantly struggle with their innate desire to help others and their timid nature. However, when someone truly is in need of assistance, POKENAME will be there to do anything they can.

entry: POKENAME虽是一条龙，却像骑士一样，拯救困在城堡中的公主。闪亮的铠甲，也硬如黑曜石。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although a dragon, POKENAME saves princesses from castles like a knight. Its shining armor is as tough as obsidian.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的花纹描绘着一条绿色蛇形龙。龙所做的事似乎每天都变，谁也不知道原理。
author: sontyp
source: The skin of POKENAME shows markings depicting a green, serpentine dragon. What that dragon does seems to change daily, but nobody knows how this happens.

entry: POKENAME是全球货运与送信的重要伙伴。尾巴最多能承载自身体重的一半，几小时便能飞过不同地区。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are essential for shipping goods and delivering letters worldwide. They can carry up to half their body weight in their tails and fly between regions within a few hours.

entry: POKENAME的超能力凝成了颈间水晶，它会借水晶强化龙类本能。
author: phoenixftw
source: POKENAME's psychic powers have manifested into the form of the crystal it wears around its neck, which POKENAME uses to amplify its draconic impulses.

entry: POKENAME实力强大，通常连比自己大的对手，也能击倒。它又十分体贴，常照料较弱的宝可梦。
author: mossybanana
source: A strong Pokémon, POKENAME can typically take down opponents larger than itself. It is very compassionate, and will often watch over weaker Pokémon.

entry: 据说，这只剑宝可梦，曾从瓦砾与战俘营中，救出战争的受害者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword Pokémon is said to have rescued victims of war from rubble and prison camps.

entry: 故事中，沉船上的水手，本以为必死无疑，回过神来，却已被POKENAME送回陆地。
author: melodydelune
source: Stories are told of sailors on sinking ships who had thought they were doomed only to find themselves brought to land by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME守护神社与寺庙，赶走自认不配进入的对象。传说若得到它认可，就会获得力量与繁荣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects shrines and temples and will chase anyone it deems unworthy. Stories say that if it does deem you worthy, it will bring you strength and prosperity.

entry: 这种宝可梦睿智又善良，僧侣常来求问生命的意义。曾被目击保护孩子与弱者。
author: krune
source: This very wise and very kind Pokémon is often visited by monks in search of the meaning of life. It has been seen defending children and the weak.

entry: POKENAME的咆哮充满威严，奔跑起来，一周就能绕世界一圈。唯有心地纯净的人，才会见到它现身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roar is a thing of majesty. They can run fast enough to circle the globe in a week, and will only reveal themselves to the pure of heart.

entry: 为无法自卫的对象而战。无论敌人是谁，只要尾焰未熄，就绝不放弃。
author: weirdisnormal
source: This Pokémon fights for those that cannot defend themselves. No matter the opponent, it will never give up until the flame on its tail dies out.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地待在偏远岛屿的沙滩。没有天敌，也让它们对游客，格外友好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME laze around on remote island beaches. They don't have any natural predators, so they are quite friendly towards tourists.

entry: POKENAME背上的蜂巢，不停酿出蜂蜜，因此身边，总围着一群其他虫宝可梦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME continuously produces honey in the honeycomb on its back. For this reason, it is constantly accompanied by a swarm of other bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，常躲在树后避开训练家。不过，手上的毒刺依旧危险。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME is a very shy fusion; it tends to hide behind trees to avoid Trainers. The stingers on its hands pose a dangerous threat.

entry: 远看似乎甜美无害，可别靠近。POKENAME一动不动，任花瓣滴下的蜜引来野生宝可梦，等猎物发现蜜到底有多黏。
author: doxtordaemon
source: This giant may look sweet and innocent from a distant but don't get to close. The leaking honey from its petals attracts wild Pokémon to POKENAME as it stands perfectly still, waiting for its prey to learn how sticky the honey really is.

entry: POKENAME微光下也看得清，飞得快又无声，是完美的夜间猎手。谁靠近领地，就会迅速被围攻，挨上毒针。
author: darkweavile428
source: Not only can POKENAME see well with minimal light, but it also flies both quickly and silently, making it the perfect nighttime hunter. Anyone who approaches POKENAME's territory will be quickly swarmed and jabbed with poison needles.

entry: 背上的蜂巢能吸引几公里外的虫宝可梦，因此POKENAME很受捕虫少年的欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: The hive on its back attracts other bug Pokémon over several kilometers. This makes POKENAME a popular companion for bug catchers.

entry: POKENAME在地壳深处筑巢。多数地方的群落，彼此隔绝，可神奥地下的数量，却渐渐成了隐患。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME make their hives deep in the planet's crust. Normally isolated in most regions, they've become a growing concern in the Sinnoh underground.

entry: POKENAME体格厚重，性情凶猛。圆锥形的双钳，既能刺得更深，也能钳得更紧。
author: alexanderenjoyer1
source: POKENAME is known for its aggressive nature and bulky frame. Its cone-shaped pincers allow for greater piercing and gripping strength.

entry: POKENAME用腹部花纹与嗡鸣，迷惑猎物，再收紧身体，不停蜇刺，直到能安稳地将其整个吞下。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME bewilders prey with its belly pattern and buzzing. It then constricts its prey and stings it until it can be safely swallowed whole.

entry: 它专在电力旺盛的地方筑巢。多数除虫人员都认为，想清走一整群POKENAME，根本是不可能的事。
author: staghorn
source: It builds hives in places with high amounts of electricity. Most exterminators consider removing a swarm of POKENAME to be an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME配合得天衣无缝，将蜂巢与废金属编成大巢。毒液会奇异地影响受害者心智，引发轻微幻觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME work in prefect sync with each other, weaving honeycomb and scrap metal into their large hive. Their venom as an odd effect on the victims' mind, causing mild hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME把进化前的同类安置在背上的大蜂巢里，保护它们。它还能喷出蜂蜜，靠大量黏稠的蜜缠住对手，让其难以行动。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME offers its pre-evolutions protection in the large hive on its back. It can shoot honey to restrict opponents' movement with its viscous bulk.

entry: POKENAME一认定蜂巢受威胁，就会以快得看不清的毒刺压制敌人。头顶分泌的蜜却美味健康——前提是采蜜后还能活下来。
author: frink202
source: Once a POKENAME considers its hive under threat, it overwhelms its opponent with blindingly fast poison stabs. However, the honey POKENAME excretes out of its head is a delicacy and very healthy - should one survive harvesting it.

entry: 与POKENAME短兵相接，很容易丧命。若遇上一整群，恐怕更会落得面目全非。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A knife fight with a POKENAME is easily fatal. An encounter with a swarm of POKENAME is a sure way to become unrecognizable.

entry: POKENAME的盾，由专为它构筑的坚韧蜂巢制成，即使传说宝可梦的招式，也能挡住。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shield is made of a highly durable type of honeycomb made specially for it, able to withstand moves from even Legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在森林里搜集蜂巢，拿蜂蜜泡澡。常引来蜂宝可梦报复，但对方通常又被它的巨大体形吓走。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest, gathering beehives in order to bathe in their honey. It often gets attacked by bee Pokémon in retaliation, but they usually flee due to POKENAME's enormous size.

entry: 这是一种妖精般的稀有融合体，难得现身，训练家却趋之若鹜。可别随便招惹，它也会奋起自卫。
author: chocouniversa
source: A rare fusion that is akin to a fairy, rarely seen and often sought after by Trainers. However, it is unwise to provoke it for it will defend itself.

entry: POKENAME背部绒毛浸满甜蜜花浆。小型宝可梦不慎黏住，它却可能完全没察觉。
author: mistymagius
source: The fluff on POKENAME's back is soaked in sweet nectar. Smaller Pokémon can accidentally get stuck in the fluff without POKENAME noticing.

entry: POKENAME热衷于和同族交手，常钻凿山壁，惹出小规模滑坡。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME has a passion for battling with others of its kind. It is usually spotted drilling into the sides of mountains, causing small landslides.

entry: POKENAME极力保护蜂巢，用坚硬的球状身体，在巢外组成六角形墙。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its hive, using its hard, spherical body to form hexagonal walls around the hive.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳嗓音号令其他蜂类。它们平时住在它如蜂巢般的毛里，等待召唤。
author: theheroict
source: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.

entry: POKENAME猛烈攻击领地内的一切，用强大毒刺贯穿敌人，再吃得不留痕迹。
author: canada
source: Highly aggressive towards anyone within its territory, POKENAME uses its powerful stinger to pierce foes. It then consumes them, leaving no trace behind.

entry: 传闻POKENAME是超梦复制失败的产物，但证据不足。碰到身体，似乎还会被吸走智力。
author: mistymagius
source: There have been many rumors about POKENAME being a failed replication of Mewtwo but there is not enough evidence to prove this theory. Touching its body seems to drain its victims of their intelligence.

entry: 人们以基因工程创造POKENAME，想造出终极武器，可它却不肯让人握着使用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME was genetically engineered in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon, but it refuses to be wielded.

entry: 人类造POKENAME，本想让它成为终极武器，它却放下过去，走自己的路。接近它的人，往往发现自己，竟无法与它战斗。
author: melodydelune
source: Created by humans to be the ultimate weapon, POKENAME has left its past behind to forge its own path. Those who come near it find they can't fight it.

entry: POKENAME经设计与基因改造，以成为完美宝可梦为目标。手臂能化成炮，贯穿最坚硬的钢铁。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME was engineered and genetically altered to create the perfect Pokémon. It can turn its arm into a cannon able to penetrate the hardest steel.

entry: POKENAME能从手臂上的炮，射出凝聚的精神能量。可铠甲底下究竟什么模样，没人知道。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fire concentrated psychic blasts from the cannon on its arms. No one knows what this Pokémon looks like under its armor.

entry: 中间的头，以超能力支配另外两颗。若三头彻底同步，便能将整座城市，化为灰烬。
author: mistymagius
source: The middle head controls the other two with its psychic powers. However, if all three heads are in perfect sync, they can turn a whole city to ashes.

entry: 若遭激怒，它便会连对手的灵魂一并焚烧，再用超能力，将所有痕迹抹去。
author: skymaster426
source: If it is angered, then it burns its opponents to their very soul. Then, it uses its psychic powers to leave no trace behind.

entry: 观察者称POKENAME异常残忍，常欺凌弱小。控水本领少有敌手，轻松就能抬起整条河。
author: krune
source: POKENAME has been described as unusually cruel by observers, seen bullying weaker Pokémon. POKENAME's hydrokinetic powers are matched by few, able to lift entire rivers with ease.

entry: 可爱的性情，加上躯干花纹，让POKENAME备受喜爱。训练家伤心时，它也会想尽办法，让对方高兴。
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal
source: POKENAME is highly respected for its cute nature and the pattern on its torso. When its Trainer is sad, it tries everything it can to cheer them up.

entry: 圆球中的胚胎，才是真正的POKENAME。外面的大个子，不过是由超能力凝成的躯体。
author: toxicrown
source: The embryo within the orb is the true POKENAME. The larger creature is actually a psionic construct made from the Pokémon's psychic powers.

entry: 研究人员推测，这种特殊的梦幻融合体，源于罕见的遗传异常。不过，POKENAME自己，似乎一切安好。
author: jackjirachi
source: Researchers speculate that this particular Mew fusion was the result of a rare genetic disorder. POKENAME seems to be perfectly fine, however.

entry: POKENAME凭强大的超能力，造出真假难辨的幻象，仿佛连地貌也随之变化。因此，能遇见它的人，少之又少。
author: t.i.a.
source: With tremendous psychic power, POKENAME seemingly morph the very land with convincing illusions. Because of this, encountering one is extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME在美的舞台上，名气很响。许多华丽大赛的明星，都曾从它身上取得灵感。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME is very famous in the beauty scene. Many Contest superstars were inspired by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME超能力强大，能用意念移动物品。不过性情害羞，难得被人看见。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful psychic prowess that allows it to manipulate objects with its mind. It has a shy nature, so sightings are rare.

entry: 这只武器般的宝可梦，能运用超能力变形。它想学遍所有招式，成为最强的存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A psychic, shapeshifting weapon, this Pokémon aspires to become the strongest by learning every move.

entry: 它只在心地纯净的人面前现身，性情十分爱玩，似乎并不明白，自己的力量究竟有多强。
author: melodydelune
source: Appearing only to those of pure heart, it is a very playful Pokémon. It does not seem to grasp its level of power.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，每500年才落到地表一次。喜爱玩小石子与陨石碎片。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely rare sights and only fall to the surface every 500 years. They love to play with small stones and meteorite fragments.

entry: POKENAME常出没于乡村。共感能力让它对农田与荒野都同样悉心照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often found around rural communities. Their empathic powers lead them to tend to farmland and wilderness alike with equal care.

entry: POKENAME不爱打架，宁愿让刀刃的甜香，安抚对手。与钢刃不同，它的刃在阳光与水分滋养下，还能再生。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME would rather calm its opponent with its blade's sweet aroma than fight. Unlike steel, the blade regenerates in sunlight and moisture.

entry: 亲近训练家的POKENAME，会送出自己的花瓣。花瓣泡成茶，味道浓郁，还能安抚心绪。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME that have become close to their Trainers will give them their petals. These petals can be used to brew a tea that has a rich, calming flavor.

entry: POKENAME只在洁净的水域生活。阳光明媚时，常能看见它们在岸边晒太阳、打滚。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives exclusively in clean waters. When the sun is shining, they can be seen rolling around in the sun on the shore.

entry: POKENAME虽小，只需得到一点力量就能构成威胁。黑暗处常回荡着它的笑声。
author: inksans201x
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME can become a threat if given an ounce of power. Its laughter can be heard echoing in dark places.

entry: 盛夏最常见。POKENAME在温暖夜晚起舞，沿途草木繁盛、鲜花开放。据说见它经过，便预示好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Most commonly encountered at the height of Summer, plants flourish and flowers bloom in the path left behind as POKENAME dances through the warm evenings. Seeing a POKENAME pass by is said to be a portent of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME常被视为夏日使者，振奋的气息让草木与宝可梦都焕发生机。贵族训练家也很珍视它，优雅的外貌能为夏日舞会增添庄重。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often viewed as heralds of summer, their invigorating auras breathing life into plants and Pokémon alike. They are also highly prized by aristocratic Trainers, their elegant appearances lending a dignified air to summer balls.

entry: POKENAME的香气，会悄悄勾起别人的战意。它自己倒乐得如此，毕竟，最爱与人决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's scent subtly influences others to want to fight it, much to the joy to POKENAME, as it likes to duel.

entry: POKENAME颈部花苞的辛香能让人振奋，因此常参与山崩救援。
author: melodydelune
source: The buds around its neck emit a spicy aroma that acts as a stimulant for humans. POKENAME are often used in rescues during landslides.

entry: POKENAME兼有月桂叶的繁茂绿意与好坏星的水中适应力。住在海岸，用叶状触手捉猎物、吸收阳光获取养分。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME combines the lush greenery of Bayleef with the aquatic adaptability of Mareanie. It dwells in coastal regions, where it uses its leafy tentacles to ensnare prey and absorb sunlight for nourishment.

entry: POKENAME常独居荒地，吃硬石与矿物时翻动土地，使其适合草木生长。等大地全绿，又会迁往下一片荒地。
author: doxtordaemon
source: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.

entry: POKENAME的群体常混着许多其他宝可梦。体大温顺，便于弱小者藏身，花瓣的舒缓香气更让身旁成了最安全的地方。
author: doxtordaemon
source: POKENAME live in herds that tend to be a large mix of other Pokémon. Their large size but docile nature make them perfect to hide around, and the calming aroma coming from their petals ensures the area around them is the safest place to be.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: 这只融合体，自认是统御其他宝可梦的高傲君主，尤其以那对小胡子般的触角为荣。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion sees itself as a proud ruler over other Pokémon. It is particularly proud of its antennae that resemble a mustache.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃散发令人平静的气味，让对手更容易被它斩杀。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits an odor that calms opponents, making them easy victims to slay.

entry: 农民把POKENAME视为丰收的象征。据说，它巡游乡野时，便能让枯萎的庄稼与植物，重获生机。
author: melodydelune
source: Known by farmers as a symbol of the harvest, POKENAME are said to roam the countryside, reviving crops and plants that have withered.

entry: POKENAME燃烧游魂，以它们的生命力养育背上的花。等花瓣全部落尽，自己才终于能前往来世。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME burns wandering souls using their life force to feed the flower on its back. Once all of the flower petals fall off, POKENAME can finally move on to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME现身热爱自然的人面前，洒下让植物长得高大强壮的花粉。可花粉症患者却认为它严重危害健康。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in front of nature-lovers, spreading its pollen that allows for plants to grow big and strong. However, people with hay fever consider this Pokémon to be a serious health hazard.

entry: POKENAME花心的甜香诱人，让感官迟钝、脑中一片空白。等察觉不对时已来不及，藤蔓早已开始生长。
author: doxtordaemon
source: The scent coming from the center of POKENAME's flower is sweet and alluring, dulling the senses, emptying the mind. By the time one realizes what is happening, it is already to late and the vines have already begun to grow.

entry: POKENAME花瓣鬃毛锋利如刀，猛烈甩动时，会将花粉洒向周围森林。
author: mistymagius
source: The petals that make up POKENAME's mane are as sharp as knives. They thrash around violently, spreading around its pollen to the surrounding forest.

entry: 这名树果贼能凭花瓣感知空气振动，提前察觉危险，几乎无法偷袭。每只都有偏爱的树果，不到手绝不罢休。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Near impossible to catch by surprise, this berry thief can tell when danger is near by feeling the vibrations in the air through its petals. Each has their preferred berry and will stop at nothing to acquire it.

entry: POKENAME用花瓣与触手，演出绚丽的节目，在华丽大赛中十分受欢迎。可它的墨镜从何而来，仍没人知道。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME is a favorite in Contests for its ability to make dazzling displays with its petals and tentacles. The origin of its shades is unknown.

entry: POKENAME象征长寿，遇到枯死珊瑚便会令其复生。人们认为，这正是太阳珊瑚没有彻底灭绝的重要原因。
author: teatedtiten
source: A symbol of longevity, POKENAME revives any deceased coral it stumbles upon. It is thought to be a major reason why Corsola have not gone fully extinct.

entry: 古时因壳上发光花纹而被奉为全能守护神。POKENAME在空地睡下，周围就会长出繁盛花园。
author: teatedtiten
source: In ancient times, this Pokémon was deified as an almighty protector because of the illuminated markings on its shell.  When POKENAME sleeps in empty fields, vibrant gardens grow around it.

entry: POKENAME会在森林火灾后吃掉遗留种子。喷火时又将种子散开，让它们重新生长。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found at the sites of forest fires, eating the leftover seeds. When it expels flames, it scatters the seeds to grow again.

entry: 只要聚上一批POKENAME，就足够让小村庄暖和起来。抱着一只，还能治好失温症。
author: neonriser
source: An armory of POKENAME is enough to keep a small village warm. Hugging one can cure hypothermia.

entry: POKENAME为遇见它的对象带来暖光。据说能在任何人身上发现爱的人，会看见它闪耀缤纷色彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME brings a warming glow to those that encounter it. It is said that POKENAME shimmers in vivid colors before those able to find love in anyone.

entry: 刀刃上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: 护手上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its guard's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，为刀刃增添了可怕威力。战斗时，火势迸发，释放强烈的热量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable addition to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: 除了刀刃，POKENAME的火焰，也是有力的第二重防护。战斗时，火焰猛燃，放出强烈的热量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable secondary defense to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: 它在陆地上蹦跳着走，产生热量。POKENAME再用这股能量点燃尾巴，从背后袭击敌人。
author: vaporvenator
source: It moves on land by bouncing around, producing heat energy. POKENAME uses this energy to ignite its tail and attack foes from behind.

entry: 火山地带常能看见POKENAME晒太阳。它会把身体藏进熔岩，等待经过的宝可梦，伺机捕杀。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can be found basking in volcanic regions. It shrouds itself in lava and waits to hunt passerby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是一只走上了不同进化道路的火暴兽。蓝色火焰炽热无比，连站在附近的训练家，都曾被灼伤。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME is a Typhlosion that evolved a bit differently. Its blue fire is intensely hot, so hot that Trainers have gotten burns by standing near it.

entry: 它是英勇的英雄，愿为所珍视的生命，付出自己的一切。可调用的力量越多，背上十字形的火焰，就越会灼烧自己的灵魂。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A valiant hero who would give its life to save those it cares for. The cross flames on its back burn through its soul the more power it calls for.

entry: 即使没有燃着火，POKENAME灼热的刀刃，也能点着碰到的任何东西。接触的一瞬间，甚至可能引发爆炸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The heat of POKENAME's blade ignites anything it touches, even when it isn't aflame. On contact, it can even generate explosions.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，发怒却极为凶烈。毛中爆发巨焰，焚烧周围，同时以龙类气息掩藏身形。
author: beatdoof
source: While POKENAME is naturally docile, it has a fierce temper. When its rage is set off, it creates a huge explosive blast from its fur, burning everything around it while camouflaging itself with a draconic aura.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的眼睛能射出熔穿岩石的热束。体内巨大热量，则通过背焰排出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its gem-like eyes to create beams of heat hot enough to melt through rock. It vents the intense amount of heat in its body through the flames on its back.

entry: POKENAME不断从体内喷出烈焰，身体摸起来却冰冷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly spews intense flames from inside its body. Despite this, its body is cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME以火焰替代双翼，能将敌人灼伤。可火声有时，也会让它分不清方向。
author: canada
source: In place of wings, POKENAME is coated in fire, allowing it to burn foes. However, the sound of the flames sometimes cause it to get disoriented.

entry: POKENAME喜欢下雨时，在水坑里嬉戏。可一兴奋，就容易不小心放电。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME likes to play in puddles during the rain. Unfortunately, when it gets excited, it also tends to let out an electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME总忍不住，把能找到的食物都吃进去。食物紧缺时，又会找来需要帮助的宝可梦，反刍出来，与它们分享。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME can't help gorging itself on every source of food it can find. In lean times, it finds Pokémon in need and regurgitates food to share.

entry: POKENAME是极小的鸟宝可梦，随风漂向想去的地方。有人靠近时，还能瞬间移动。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very tiny bird Pokémon that lets itself float on the wind wherever it may want to go. It has the power to teleport if anyone comes near.

entry: 这是新手训练家常用的融合宝可梦。POKENAME好训练，还喜欢找来树果，与训练家分享。
author: vaporvenator
source: A fusion used commonly by beginner Trainers. POKENAME are generally easy to train and enjoy searching for Berries to share with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME虽覆着大量羽毛，本体却很小，依旧轻盈。羽毛保温极好，常被用来填枕头。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite it being covered in a massive number of feathers, POKENAME is pretty lightweight due to how small their actual body is. The feathers are great heat insulators and are commonly in pillows.

entry: POKENAME不怕高，能在枝头爬行。背上的真菌不断吸走养分，害它总得四处找吃的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not afraid of heights and crawls over branches. It is in constant search of food, as the fungi on its back slowly extract its nutrients.

entry: 天色平静时，会栖在高处眺望远方。据说捡到POKENAME的蓝羽毛十分幸运。
author: ozydamians
source: When the skies are calm, it roosts up high to scan the horizon. To find a blue POKENAME feather is considered very lucky.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却只吃坚果与树果。喜欢烤过再吃，可常忘记火有多强，最后只剩一堆灰，气得大发脾气。
author: ozydamians
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME only eats nuts and berries. It prefers to toast its meal, but often forgets the intensity of its flames. It throws a tantrum when it's left with nothing but a pile of ash afterwards.

entry: POKENAME凶猛无休，挡路的东西一概摧毁。有理论认为，整个生态都曾因它的存在而改变。
author: rotcivosk
source: Known for its relentless and aggressive nature, POKENAME will destroy anything that stands in its path. It is theorized that entire ecosystems have been altered due to its presence.

entry: POKENAME被称为天空的哨兵，常在巢穴周围巡飞，大声尖叫，吓退带来威胁的宝可梦。
author: sentretvstar
source: Often called the sentry of the sky, POKENAME often flies around the area near its nest. It shrieks loudly to scare away any threatening Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在河岸安家，捕食较小的全水生宝可梦，避开深水危险。洞穴入口众多，一退走便很难判断去了哪里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes along riverbanks, hunting smaller fully aquatic Pokémon while avoiding the dangers of deeper water. Their burrows have multiple entrances, making it hard to determine where they've gone when they retreat.

entry: 有人相信，店门口摆夸张造型的POKENAME塑像会招财。大众作品常描绘它与索罗亚互为对手。它更喜欢伪装成家用品。
author: elfail0
source: It is believed by some that displaying an exaggerated statue of a POKENAME at the entrance to a business will invite good fortune. Popular media often depict them as rivals with a Zorua. They prefer to disguise themselves as household objects.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，再加上预知能力，任何危险都能轻松避开。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is an agile creature. When combined with its precognitive powers, this means POKENAME can avoid any danger easily.

entry: POKENAME无聊时，便找毫无防备的宝可梦，用蓄着静电的尾尖，挠得对方发痒。
author: phantom640
source: If bored, POKENAME will often look for unsuspecting Pokémon and tickle them with the tip of its tail using the static electricity stored inside of it.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，毛的防水性越差。虽然仍在河流生活、狩猎，地洞却多建在沼泽地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fur of POKENAME gradually loses its waterproof qualities as they age. While they still live in and hunt within river environments, their burrow systems tend to be built in more swampy areas.

entry: 不再拥有进化前用来防水的油脂。POKENAME虽住在沼泽，却更爱在树根间挖洞，而非河岸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: It no longer contains the oils produced in earlier stages of their evolution that are needed to make it waterproof. Though they live in swampy environments, POKENAME prefer to make burrows among tree roots rather than along riverbanks.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: POKENAME摸着虽不像，其实有毛。只是分泌物把毛粘在一起，看着反倒像一团黏液。
author: endermagnet
source: Despite what it feels like, POKENAME actually does have fur. However, the substance it secretes sticks its fur together, so it resembles goo instead.

entry: POKENAME刚被收服时常害羞，亲近训练家后就会永远黏在一起。是真的黏——黏液就像胶水！
author: zeeroooo
source: POKENAME is often shy when first caught, but when it bonds with its Trainer it will stick with them forever. Quite literally; its slime is like glue!

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。聪明的家伙，会爬上POKENAME干燥的壳，躲过这些拥抱。
author: endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. Clever Pokémon can hide from these hugs on POKENAME's dry shell.

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。结果，竟有出人意料之多的小家伙，就这样被粘在POKENAME身上。
author: endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. A surprising number of these Pokémon get stuck to POKENAME.

entry: 覆在毛上的蜜，能让人恢复活力，含糖少，味道又好。研究人员也记录过，POKENAME与生病的宝可梦，分享蜂蜜。
author: endermagnet
source: The honey coating its fur is rejuvenating, low in sugar and extra tasty. Researchers have documented POKENAME sharing this honey with unwell Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME四肢强健，速度很快，本可造成大量伤害，可天性温顺，通常不会这样做。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's limbs are very strong. It is a fast creature capable of dealing out lots of damage, but it usually won't due to its docile nature.

entry: POKENAME无法在陆地行走，只好用伸缩触手在树间荡行。柔软防水的毛，常被用于现代服装。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk on land, so it will use its stretchy tentacles to swing from trees. Its soft fur is waterproof and is often used in modern clothing.

entry: 托儿所常能看见POKENAME，陪孩子们消磨时光，一起画画、游戏，还能造出彩虹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often are seen at daycares keeping children occupied. It paints, plays, and makes rainbows with them.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跳过田野与花园，不停寻找能吃的果实、种子，以及小型虫宝可梦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hops through fields and gardens at night. It is constantly on the lookout for edible fruits, seeds, or small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜间在枝头警戒。发现威胁便俯冲毒伤、扰乱敌人，同时鸣叫示警。还会在树枝间吐丝，缀上石子，奏出有节奏的风铃般旋律。
author: greensnake01
source: POKENAME watch diligently from branches at night. On seeing a threat, they swoop down to poison and confuse the aggressor, hooting to warn forest denizens. They spin string from branches and cover it in rocks, producing a rhythmic chime-like melody.

entry: POKENAME轻快活泼，满月时会与同类一同踩着节奏起舞。舒缓神秘的歌声能催人入眠。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a spritely Pokémon known for dancing in a rhythm with other POKENAME during the full moon. It can sing a soothing, enigmatic melody that lulls others to sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会为迷途旅人穿过暗林引路。看似帮忙，实际却越领越偏，直到旅人彻底迷失。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are said to appear before lost travelers, guiding them through dark forests. Though they may seem helpful, they are in fact leading these travellers astray until they are hopelessly lost.

entry: 背上时钟般的突起，始终滴答作响。POKENAME每隔十五分钟，准时咕鸣一声。
author: chorb33
source: The clock-like growth on its back is constantly ticking. POKENAME emits cooing sounds at intervals of exactly fifteen minutes.

entry: 体内时钟精准得惊人，有些训练家，便把POKENAME当作闹钟。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon has an amazing internal clock. Some Trainers use POKENAME as an alarm clock.

entry: POKENAME能记住夜里听见的每一种声音。白天再模仿出来，常把训练家吓一跳。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can remember each sound it hears at night. When it mimics them during the day, many Trainers feel spooked.

entry: POKENAME体内器官能精确计时，每晚恰睡一小时。生活节奏必须十分规律，否则就会紧张好斗。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME has an internal organ that allows it to keep perfect track of time. It sleeps exactly one hour every night and needs a very orderly daily rhythm, otherwise it becomes stressed and aggressive.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的耳朵，能自由转动，倾听危险。特殊器官还能感知星球自转，让POKENAME始终报时准确。
author: essie
source: Male POKENAME ears can move freely to listen for danger. A special organ lets POKENAME keep perfect time based on the planet's rotation.

entry: 这只锤状宝可梦多半悬在原地，只随一天中的时刻转动，让手柄像时钟的时针一样指示时间。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This mace Pokémon floats in a mostly stationary position, rotating with the time of day so its handle corresponds to an analog clock's hour hand.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳着刺击敌人，可招式重复，容易预测。聪明些的宝可梦很容易智取。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME bounces around jabbing at its foes, but its attacks are fairly repetitive and predictable. Because of this, smarter Pokémon can easily outwit it.

entry: POKENAME双翼映月闪烁，无声滑过夜空。能用迷人花纹催眠、制造幻象，逃离危险。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME glides silently through the night, its wings shimmering under the moonlight. With the ability to hypnotize foes, it uses its mesmerizing patterns to create illusions and escape danger.

entry: POKENAME的时间感能精确到秒。可这与背上时钟般的突起究竟有何联系，尚未得到充分研究。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a sense of timing to the second. The connection between this and the clock-like growth on its back has not yet been adequately studied.

entry: 人们普遍相信，这种POKENAME曾遭诅咒。为何只有一臂仍不清楚，但似乎并不受影响。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: This variety of POKENAME is widely believed to have been cursed once upon a time. Nobody knows why it has only one arm, but it does not seem to be held back by its lack of said appendage.

entry: 索罗亚克与猫头夜鹰的可怕融合体，以凶猛好斗的捕食者闻名，绝不可轻视。名声并非空穴来风，因为它们极力护幼。
author: elfail0
source: This intimidating fusion of Zoroark and Noctowl has a fierce reputation as a ferocious and aggressive predator which should not be taken lightly. There is some truth to this as they are very protective of their young.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有力，头角带毒，视力也极好。别看体型庞大，动作却敏捷得惊人。
author: essie
source: POKENAME have powerful tails, venomous horns, and superb vision. Despite their bulk, POKENAME are surprisingly agile.

entry: 这只融合体虽不是超能力属性，却颇有精神力量的天分。有人推测，它体内深处藏着某种诡异力量。
author: jaycielantern
source: Despite not being a Psychic type, this fusion shows an aptitude for psionic abilities. Some theorize some eldritch power lies deep within it.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却凶悍得惊人，体形大数倍的对手也不退让。潜行也极出色，能无声穿过最密的枝叶追踪猎物。
author: elfail0
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME are surprisingly ferocious and will not shy away from opponents many times their size. They are astonishingly stealthy as well, able to stalk prey through even the thickest foliage in silence.

entry: POKENAME自首次融合以来，身体就让研究者费解。组成身体的木质状材料，带有毒性。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body has baffled researchers since they were first fused. The wood-like material that composes their body is toxic.

entry: POKENAME身体庞大，十分笨拙，常跌跌撞撞，飞着又会撞上窗户。
author: ohok3441
source: Thanks to their large bodies, POKENAME are clumsy. They have a tendency to stumble around and fly into windows.

entry: 古传说视POKENAME为月夜的不祥之兆，预示厄运与恶意。其实它对人类没什么兴趣，连训练家也常被冷淡以待。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Ancient legends speak of POKENAME as bad omens, harbingers of misfortune and malice on moonlit nights. In truth, POKENAME have little interest in people and are often aloof and disinterested, even toward their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME许多方面像摔角鹰人，却更聪明些，脾气也更喜怒无常。适应性强，容易学会格斗与飞行属性攻击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are similar to Hawlucha in many ways, but are a bit smarter and more temperamental. They are adaptable and can learn Fighting and Flying-type attacks easily.

entry: POKENAME织的网，形似星辰。每只POKENAME的网，还有独属于自己的气味。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME spin webs that take the appearance of stars. Each web has a unique scent tied to each individual POKENAME.

entry: 野外难得看见POKENAME。它们的网由许多星形图案组成，会在繁星满天的夜晚，微微发亮。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME are a rare site in the wild. Their webs consist of a multiple star shaped patterns that glow under a starry night sky.

entry: 这种长着蓝色角的POKENAME更加罕见。据传，在同类中，蓝角个体享有最高的地位。
author: gotfyr
source: These blue horned variants of POKENAME are an even rarer find. It is rumored that those with blue horns have the most authority over other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能产生危险电力，可外貌可爱、性情友善，其他宝可梦不会攻击。连讨厌虫的人也不把它当害虫，收服后常视为家人。
author: lutrax
source: POKENAME generates dangerous electricity. Due to its cute appearance and friendly nature, other Pokémon do not attack it, and even humans who dislike bugs do not consider this creature a pest. Once captured, it is often considered a family member.

entry: 它靠眼睛分泌的芳香液体交流。健康又快乐的POKENAME，甚至会被液体整个包裹。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: It communicates using the aromatic fluid it secretes from its eyes. A happy and healthy POKENAME will be fully encompassed by this fluid.

entry: POKENAME一仰面倒下，就无法自己起身。露出软肚，只好乱挥六条短肢，吓退可能的攻击者。
author: sontyp
source: When it falls on its back, it's impossible for a POKENAME to get back up on its own. With its soft belly exposed, it flails its six short limbs around to avert potential aggressors.

entry: 进化后的POKENAME更爱独居。可一有危险，便会为了心中正义，保护自己与其他生命。
author: alliveir
source: After evolution, POKENAME prefer to live a more solitary life from eachother. If it senses danger it will protect both itself and others for justice.

entry: POKENAME正义感强烈，凡遇险的宝可梦，都愿守护。它们还能借弹力蛛网反弹，迅速赶路。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME have a strong sense of justice and will defend any Pokémon that are in danger. They bounce off their elastic webs to travel at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着巨颚般的甲壳，硬如岩石，能夹住攻击者。野外个体害羞避人，拿闪亮物品却可能引它靠近。
author: sontyp
source: Its wings are covered by a huge, jaw-like carapace that's hard as rock and can clamp down on attackers. In the wild, POKENAME are shy and hide from humans, but might be lured closer by presenting shiny or glittering objects.

entry: POKENAME挥刃、出拳，同时迎敌。月光下，刀刃闪闪发亮，挥动时还拖出一道光痕。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fights with its blade and fist simultaneously. In the moonlight, its blade sparkles and makes glowing trails with its swings.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，还不习惯自己的翅膀。狩猎时常撞上东西，管它是不是猎物，都撞个正着。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME are very clumsy Pokémon. They aren't used to their wings yet, resulting in many hunts ending with them crashing into an object, prey or not.

entry: 进化之后，POKENAME狩猎更加大胆，会高速飞行，用头顶的尖角，刺穿猎物。
author: gotfyr
source: After evolving, POKENAME are more bold in their approach to hunting. They fly at high speeds using their sharp top horns to skewer their prey.

entry: POKENAME用自己的丝网滑翔。网若破了，几秒便能修好，甚至飞在半空，也不耽搁！
author: gp423
source: POKENAME glides around on its own webbing. It can patch up any damage done to the web in a matter of seconds, even mid-glide!

entry: POKENAME在洞穴中布下丝网，感知猎物。它爬过昏暗洞顶，等猎物粘住、挣扎，再猛扑下去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME creates web network systems in caves to sense prey. It wanders the dark ceilings and plunges into them while they struggle in the sticky web.
