entry: POKENAME疑心很重，织网察觉闯入者，再瞬间移动逃走。觅食时，也靠瞬间移动来回附近的树果灌木。
author: frokachu
source: Due to its paranoid nature, POKENAME will construct webs to detect and teleport away from intruders. It will forage berries by teleporting to and from nearby bushes.

entry: 这个罕见POKENAME变体失去了翅膀与毒针，却长出牢固抓握能力，能持用针状武器。会借丝线疾冲、延伸针击。聪明善思，仍有强烈领地意识。
author: lutrax
source: This rare variant of POKENAME lost its wings and needles but developed a firm grasp to use needle-like weapons. Its silk is now used to dash and extend its needle. It is highly intelligent and capable of deep thoughts, but still territorial.

entry: 别被模样骗了，POKENAME极容易受惊发怒。许多训练家想用手捧起野生POKENAME，最后都得就医。
author: gotfyr
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME are easily agitated. Many Trainers have needed medical attention after trying to hold wild POKENAME in their hands.

entry: 每只POKENAME都自认是最强的超级反派。那些邪恶计划，让宝可梦与训练家，都大伤脑筋。
author: gotfyr
source: Each POKENAME sees itself as the ultimate super villain. Their evil schemes make them quite the nuisance to both Pokémon and Trainers alike.

entry: POKENAME是攀爬高手，能轻松在树间跳跃。爪上覆毒，能迅速让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert climbers, jumping from tree-to-tree with little effort. Its claws are coated in poison, which it uses to quickly incapacitate its prey.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会用网捕捉小虫，捆在身上。再积攒大量虫子，与其他宝可梦换更大的一餐。
author: mistymagius
source: This clever Pokémon collects smaller bugs in its webs and then keeps them tied up on its body. POKENAME then trades large amounts of them with other Pokémon for larger meals.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的洞穴，靠丝线找到回巢的路，因此，被视为洞穴探险者的理想伙伴。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are found in deep underground caves, using their threads to navigate back to their nests. They're considered ideal partners for spelunkers.

entry: POKENAME较少见的体色变体，却不算“异色”。孢子长出的蘑菇，会用坚韧丝线固定在地上。
author: frokachu
source: A less common color variant of POKENAME, but not classified as 'Shiny'. Its spores grow into mushrooms that stay anchored to the earth with sturdy silk strands.

entry: 一些荒凉地方称它们为“死亡之铃”，实际却不伤大型生物，只捕食昆虫。
author: frokachu
source: Some desolate places call these Pokémon "bells of death," but they are harmless to larger creatures and prey only on insects.

entry: POKENAME在灯具与路灯周围织网。可别站在巢下，它的粉末与丝线，都有毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their webs around lamps and streetlamps. Standing underneath these nests is unwise due to POKENAME's toxic dust and threads.

entry: POKENAME能吐出真正由黄金构成的贵重丝线，因此，多半只有十分富裕的训练家才养得起。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME produces highly valued silk that's made out of gold. Because of this, it's typically only owned by very wealthy Trainers.

entry: POKENAME用下半身装成一只受困的豪力，诱使毫无防备、想救助它的猎物上前。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME mimics a trapped Machoke with its lower body to lure in unsuspecting prey trying to free it.

entry: 它们在森林中窜行，寻找大型猎物。POKENAME会跃上强壮宝可梦的头，注入致命的神经毒素。
author: hummusishome
source: They scuttle through forests in search of large prey to devour. POKENAME jump on the heads of strong Pokémon and inject them with a lethal neurotoxin.

entry: 母亲的头骨已与它的头和翅膀融为一体，化作铠甲。双翼更结实了，也能当作利刃迎敌。
author: skymaster426
source: Its mother's skull has fused with its head and wings as armor. With its wings being given extra strength, it can use them as blades to attack.

entry: POKENAME的大头，总被其他头惹得心烦，时时惦念着从前，自己还是独立宝可梦的日子。
author: dodoowner_
source: The giant head of POKENAME is always annoyed and bothered by the other heads. It constantly dreams of when it was its own Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME全身入鞘时，飞得最快，四片翅膀都悄无声息。剑刃则靠吸血为食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME flies fastest while in its scabbard, employing four silent wings in total. Its blade consumes blood.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: 训练家请POKENAME在葡萄园压树果酿酒，发泄怒气。客人看见它舔拳上的红汁，常吓得以为在喝受害者的血。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Trainers employ POKENAME at vineyards, encouraging them to work out their anger by squishing berries for wine. Many guests get intimidated when they see POKENAME licking red juice from their fists, afraid they're drinking blood from their victims.

entry: 起飞前，POKENAME会扇动翅膀，帮助自己在地面蹦跳。它们捡来细枝，在背上的种子周围筑起保护巢，可巢一飞就散，常把它们气得不轻。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their wings to aid in leaping around the ground before they take flight. They gather twigs to build protective nests around the bulbs on their backs, but grow frustrated when they fall apart during flight.

entry: POKENAME头上的翅膀让它轻松翱翔。据说它会现身在梦想飞行的人类与宝可梦面前。
author: mistymagius
source: The wings on POKENAME's head allow it soar effortlessly across the sky. It is said that POKENAME will appear in front of people and Pokémon who dream of flight.

entry: POKENAME是强大的鸟宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比。感到受威胁，便能轻松掀起龙卷风。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong bird Pokémon, its claws are razor sharp. It will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能借风飘往任何想去的地方。蓝色羽毛里，似乎还藏着古老的超能力。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Its blue feathers seem to hold an ancient psychic power.

entry: POKENAME的金色羽毛备受追捧，据说藏着尚未唤醒的力量。它比同伴更鲁莽，总把自己置于险境。
author: mistymagius
source: The golden plumage of POKENAME is highly sought after, as it is said to contain latent power. POKENAME is more reckless than its flock, constantly putting itself in danger.

entry: 它叫得实在太吵。养着POKENAME的人，不是放归野外，就是赶紧想办法，让它进化。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its cries are obnoxiously loud. Those who own POKENAME tend to either release them into the wild or evolve them as quickly as possible.

entry: 浓密而鲜艳的头羽，是它求偶的资本。雌性POKENAME总会寻找头羽最浓密、颜色最鲜亮的雄性POKENAME。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Its thick, colorful head plumage is used for courtship rituals. Female POKENAME search out the male POKENAME with the thickest, most vibrant plumage.

entry: 它在领地上空翱翔，保护所栖森林里，那些较弱的宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: Soaring around its territory, this Pokémon acts as a defender of weaker Pokémon in the forests it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME化石常被错当成始祖小鸟。如今，它是陆地与天空中最凶猛的捕食者之一。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME fossils are often mistaken for Archen. In the modern day, POKENAME is one of the most ferocious predators on land and in the sky.

entry: 常忘了自己不会飞，竟从树上跳下尝试起飞。羽毛极锋利，会与其他POKENAME较量谁的羽毛更利。
author: mistymagius
source: It tends to forget that it cannot fly so it will sometimes throw itself out of trees in an attempt to take off. Its feathers are incredibly sharp, and it will fight with other POKENAME to see whose feathers are sharper.

entry: POKENAME行动反复无常，仿佛背上的蘑菇，正在时不时接管，身体的活动能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very capricious in its actions. It almost seems as if the mushroom on its back is temporarily gaining control of its locomotor abilities.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地爬过树枝，神情漠然，仿佛已无法掌控，自己的感官。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME crawls aimlessly through the branches of trees. It seems almost apathetic, as if it is not in control of its senses.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的鳞片，更像细小的羽毛。它主要以虫宝可梦为食，可爪子太小，实在不便抓牢猎物。
author: robosoup
source: The scales on POKENAME's wings are more like tiny feathers. It mostly eats bug Pokémon, though its claws are too small for grasping prey.

entry: 科学家争论POKENAME究竟是鸟、爬行动物、龙，还是恐龙。可致命的手爪、喙、牙齿与脚爪，比钢铁更锋利，毫无疑问。
author: ozydamians
source: Scientists debate if POKENAME is a bird, reptile, dragon, or dinosaur. There is no question, however, that its deadly claws, beak, teeth, and talons are all sharper than steel.

entry: POKENAME的聪明才智与庞大体形同样惊人。曾被观察到从高空投下尖石捕猎，再生火烤肉。
author: ozydamians
source: Its impressive size is matched only by its cleverness. POKENAME has been observed to drop sharpened stones on prey from above and roast the meat over a fire.

entry: POKENAME好奇心极强。若遇到危险，便从口中喷出，带电的墨汁。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are known to be extremely curious. If it's in danger, it'll shoot electrified ink from its mouth.

entry: 深暗之中，有潜水者错把它认成潜艇。还没发觉认错，就已被POKENAME吞下。
author: dodoowner_
source: In the dark, some scuba divers mistake it for a submarine. Before they realize their mistake, they get eaten by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME水下遇险，会将尾巴当临时拳头。可尾巴太软，打到敌人后通常又弹了回来。
author: teatedtiten
source: When threatened underwater, POKENAME will use their tails as makeshift fists. Their tails however are squishy, so it commonly bounces off of the opponent.

entry: POKENAME信任其他宝可梦与训练家，会亲昵蹭鼻问候。水下探险队常与它们交友，请它们照亮深海。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME are very trusting with other Pokémon and Trainers, nuzzling with them as a greeting. Underwater exploration teams befriend these Pokémon to offer light in the deep ocean.

entry: 近处电击猎物，远处喷射水柱。熟练的POKENAME甚至能让水弹也带电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can electrocute prey at short range or shoot jets of water at them at long range. A skilled POKENAME can even electrify its own water projectile.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险时，鹿角会亮起来，随后便会飞快奔逃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's antlers light up when it senses danger. When this happens, it gallops away with high speed.

entry: POKENAME将幼崽护在体内充水的空腔里。亲子联手，能以最高15,000伏电力攻击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps its babies safe inside the water-filled cavity in its body. Together, they attack prey with up to 15,000 volts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME用触角产生正负电能，为头部充电，也特别爱用头槌攻击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME charges its head electrically by generating positive and negative energy via its antennae. It loves to give out headbutts.

entry: POKENAME游得不快，可硬壳加上，向周围放电的本领，让它几乎不怕天敌。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not a fast swimmer. However, thanks to its hard shell and its ability to electrify its surroundings, it hardly fears predators.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常住在热带海底。遇上威胁，一颗头留下放哨，其余的，则躲进洞里。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in tropical areas at the bottom of the ocean. If threatened, one head keeps watch and the others hide in their hole.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下看不清，飞行路线杂乱，常撞上船与岸。烦恼时便潜入深水，那里视野更好。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME erratically fly around, often bumping into boats and shorelines due to its poor vision in sunlight. When frustrated, they dive deep underwater where they can see better.

entry: 三只宝可梦结伴分享电力，让整体更强。POKENAME向敌人喷带电水流，使其麻痹。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Three Pokémon have formed a bond to share electricity with one another, making the whole more powerful. POKENAME sprays streams of electrified water at enemies to paralyze them.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME的触角，发出诱人的光，吸引毫无防备的猎物。光景虽美，接下来发生的，可就骇人了。
author: mykoloth
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a captivating light that attracts unsuspecting prey. Though the light is a beautiful sight, what follows is truly horrific.

entry: POKENAME能承受海洋深渊区的水压，靠自身发光观察深海。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME can withstand the pressure of the abyssal zone of the ocean. It uses its bioluminescence to see in the deep ocean.

entry: POKENAME背上排着亮闪闪的脊棱，带电时格外明亮，让它在最黑的水中，也能看清。
author: t.i.a.
source: A POKENAME has a row of shiny dorsal ridges down its back. They glow brightly with electricity, allowing it to see even in the darkest waters.

entry: 野生POKENAME曾因壳太亮，而走向灭绝。它们睡在海中，天敌却能从一英里外，看得清清楚楚。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME went extinct because of how bright their shells are. Predators could spot them sleeping in the ocean from a mile away.

entry: POKENAME在最黑暗的水中用诱饵吸引宝可梦。对方一分心，就以反应不及的速度猛然咬住。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses its lure to attract unsuspecting Pokémon in the darkest waters. Once they are distracted, it latches on with its jaws faster than they can react.

entry: POKENAME拿水果形状的诱饵，引来猎物。对方一靠近，就会落入，腿间织好的网。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will lure in prey with its fruit-shaped lure. Once its prey is close enough, it will ensnare it with a web woven between its legs.

entry: 若在漆黑深海看见两点微光，就赶紧游回水面，免得成为POKENAME的下一餐！
author: phantom640
source: If you see two faint lights in the darkest depths of the ocean, swim as fast as you can back to the surface before you become POKENAME's next meal!

entry: POKENAME的发光诱饵形似猎物，能引来远比自己大的宝可梦。利牙连暴鲤龙的硬鳞也能刺穿。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Its glowing lures resemble prey, enticing Pokémon much larger than POKENAME. With its sharp teeth, it can even pierce the tough scales of Gyarados.

entry: 传说，人们曾看见水下成群的POKENAME发出灿烂光芒，便将它们与岸边的神异现象联系起来，开始加以崇敬。它们其实十分爱玩，也很容易亲近同伴或训练家。
author: markusknight
source: According to legends, people started revering underwater herds of POKENAME, seeing their bright lights and connecting them to supernatural incidents on shores. They are very playful and bond quickly to either their herd, or Trainer.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME的丝，可以织成渔网。渔民们喜欢把它留在身旁，免得哪天，网不够用了。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME silk can be used as net material. Fishermen love to have this Pokémon stick around, in case they run out of netting.

entry: POKENAME年纪小，还控制不好电力。大部分时候，待在能吸收零星电击的电网上，才安心。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are still young and can't control their electricity. They spend most of their time on Electrowebs that absorb their stray Thunder Shocks.

entry: POKENAME难以留住电力，游泳时常突然放出一阵电，再被周围的水，传导出去。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has difficulty retaining its electricity. While swimming, it will often release a burst of electricity that's then conducted by the water.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: POKENAME能感知人的精神状态。若发现谁没劲，就可能电他一下，好让脚步轻快些。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can sense people's energy levels. If it's low, it may give them a shock to put more pep in their step.

entry: POKENAME小又没经验，很难镇定。受惊会弹出内脏，碰到就会挨猛烈电击。
author: glacierwing
source: Due to its small size and inexperience, POKENAME struggles to maintain its composure. When startled, it ejects its inner organs, which delivers a nasty shock if touched.

entry: 谜拟Ｑ附身皮丘，形成了POKENAME。皮丘似乎不太舒服，但附身实际上帮助它控制电力。
author: adoster
source: POKENAME is the result of a Mimikyu possessing a Pichu. While it seems unpleasant to Pichu, being possesed actually helps it control its electricity.

entry: POKENAME三颗头的电都控制不好，总互相电到，也因此，吵个不停。
author: mistymagius
source: The three heads of POKENAME are always squabbling with one another since they constantly shock each other with their uncontrollable electricity.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嬉戏对打，却常兴奋过头，麻痹较弱的玩伴。若对手更强，反倒可能把自己麻痹。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME enjoy play fighting but often get too excited and paralyze weaker Pokémon. Against tougher playmates, POKENAME may end up paralyzing itself.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在月光下玩，可几分钟就累。若找到月之石，就会向大家炫耀，抛来抛去。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME love playing in the moonlight, but tend to get tired after a few minutes. If one finds a Moon Stone, it will show it off to others and toss it around.

entry: POKENAME在强月光下泛粉红光，速度也稍快。只在晴夜的火山附近活动，因此难得一见。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME glow pink in strong moonlight, and will move a bit faster than normal. Due to only being active near volcanoes on clear nights, this Pokémon is not often seen.

entry: POKENAME坐在飞碟的保护中，飞过星夜。若发现有趣的物件，就以牵引光束，将其提起。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME flies through starry nights protected by a flying saucer. If it spots an interesting object, it uses a tractor beam to pick it up.

entry: POKENAME身体娇弱，若挨上猛烈攻击，就会整个融化。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body is delicate. If hit by a strong attack, it'll melt.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又害羞，总隔着一段距离，跟在训练家与宝可梦身后。只须招招手，它就飘过来。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is playful but shy, following behind Trainers and Pokémon at a distance. It'll float over when beckoned.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME常在山间寻找亮石，装饰毛发。
author: melodydelune
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME can be found along mountains searching for shiny rocks to decorate their fur.

entry: POKENAME很受婴儿欢迎，柔软闪烁的尾巴，摸着只有微温，恰能哄他们安稳入睡。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME is popular with infants, as its soft twinkling tail helps lull them to sleep, and is only warm to the touch.

entry: POKENAME看似弱小，吸引力却很强，还能放出电磁场，阻止敌人靠近。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME seems weak, but it has strong powers of attraction and can generate electric magnetic fields to keep enemies away.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又有耐心，很受孩子们欢迎。科学家认为，背上的奇特突起可能是成长关键。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME is a popular companion among children due to its playful and patient nature. Scientists believe the peculiar protrusion on its back may be the key to its growth.

entry: POKENAME原生于平柑岛，贪玩又爱挖洞。会挖浅穴，在草地和沙滩互相追逐，皮肤触感出奇有弹性。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A playful burrowing Pokémon native to Pinkan Island, POKENAME digs shallow burrows and can be found chasing one another through the grass and along beaches. Its hide is surprisingly springy to the touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME的玩偶里住着幼童灵魂。它整天陪玩，玩偶若被夺走，就会陷入绝望。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dolls are said to be inhabited by the souls of young children. It plays with them all day and falls into despair if the dolls are taken away.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，歌声又未发育好，难以自行觅食。只能靠可爱向人讨点心，或接受老练长辈留下的食物。
author: elfail0
source: Its soft, rubbery body and underdeveloped singing voice make it very difficult for POKENAME to forage for food. As such, it must feed itself by charming humans with its cuteness for treats or by accepting scraps from its more skilled elders.

entry: POKENAME极贪玩，会追着交到的朋友，想送出自己的红宝石。若送给你，你就会永远是它最好的朋友。
author: mistymagius
source: Extremely playful Pokémon, POKENAME will pursue anyone they befriend trying to give them one of its red gemstones. If it gives you one, you will become its best friend for the rest of time.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就把头鼓到身体的三倍大，飘飞逃走。熟悉了、安心了，它又会十分亲人。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME senses danger, it blows its head up to three times its body size to fly away. Once it has gained confidence, it is very affectionate.

entry: POKENAME住在森林高处的树冠，靠长臂在枝间荡行。若没抓稳，柔软弹性的身体也能保护它不受伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives high in the canopy of forests, swinging between branches with its elongated arms. If it does miss a branch, its soft and rubbery body prevents it from injuring itself.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: katieplaysgames
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: katieplaysgames
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: 给POKENAME的蛋涂彩，是一些人庆祝复活节的传统。它虽以蛋闻名，本身也是很好的宠物。
author: dodoowner_
source: Painting POKENAME eggs is a tradition for people who celebrate Easter. Although it's mostly known for its eggs, it also just makes for a good pet.

entry: 它还不知道，自己已经破壳出生，便仍留在蛋壳里，保护自己。被喜欢的气味包围时，又会进化。
author: skymaster426
source: It doesn't know it has hatched from its egg yet, and keeps within its shell for protection. When it is surrounded by smells it enjoys, it evolves.

entry: 它会依恋第一眼看见的人。身体坚韧得很，哪怕冒雨踏雪，也要一点点挪着追去，直到重新相见。
author: skymaster426
source: It grows immensely attached to the first person it sees. It is immensely durable, and will scooch after them through rain and snow until they reunite.

entry: POKENAME散发欢乐积极的气息，凭共感寻找心情相同的伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME emanates an aura of joy and positivity. POKENAME uses its empathetic nature to find others who feel similarly.

entry: 新孵化的POKENAME带着蛋壳碎片，多一层防护。壳虽脆，受惊时却能带来慰藉与安全感。
author: rakunk
source: Newly hatched POKENAME carry pieces of their eggshell for added protection. Though fragile, these shells are a source of comfort and security when startled.

entry: 蜕下脆弱蛋壳后，POKENAME比进化前更好奇外界。常与其他幼年宝可梦结伴，寻求安慰。
author: rakunk
source: After shedding its fragile eggshell, POKENAME is much more curious of the outside world compared to its pre-evolution. It often allies with other young Pokémon for comfort.

entry: POKENAME以强烈凝视吸引路人，再表演、模仿逗大家开心。等玩腻了，便秀一招压轴戏，迅速溜走。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME's intense gaze draws the attention of passersby, when it will then begin to entertain and imitate them. When it grows bored, it performs a final grand trick before quickly fleeing.

entry: POKENAME在夜间无声飘行，小身体披着阴影。眼周花纹发光，性格又顽皮，会用超能力制造诡异幻象，捉弄旅人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME drifts silently through the night, its small body cloaked in shadows. With glowing markings around its eyes and a mischievous nature, it plays tricks on unsuspecting travelers while using its psychic powers to create eerie illusions.

entry: 白天，POKENAME一动不动地凝望太阳。夜幕一落，便飞上天空，出门寻猎。
author: darkweavile428
source: During the day, POKENAME stands perfectly still and stares at the sun, but as soon as night falls, it takes to the skies in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME能看见过去与未来。有人甚至推测，它能改变某些事情，最终的结果。
author: manandesz
source: POKENAME has the power to peer into the future and past. Some theorize it even has the power to change the outcomes of certain events.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找小型聚落，想去守护。可谜一般的力量，与让人不安的模样，往往换来人类的疏远。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME seeks out small communities to protect. However, its enigmatic power and unsettling nature often leads to humans shunning it instead.

entry: POKENAME能捕获熟睡者的噩梦，再将噩梦，化为梦雾。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are used to capture the nightmares of sleeping people. When it captures a nightmare, it turns it into Dream Mist.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，能长时间不停奔跑。前角如探测棒，能感知哪里正发生雷暴。
author: gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME are generally very energetic and can run for long periods of time without stopping. They are able to sense where thunderstorms are happening using their front horns like divining rods.

entry: POKENAME靠强静电悬浮，随风旅行。曾有数名训练家碰到被阵风吹偏的个体，遭到电击。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME generate a powerful static charge that they use to hover above the land and travel using the winds. Several Trainers have been electrocuted after making contact with a POKENAME that was blown off-course by a sudden gust.

entry: POKENAME的颚上覆着羊毛，咀嚼时，便常会把静电，释放到猎物身上。
author: mossybanana
source: Since POKENAME's jaws are covered with wool, it will often discharge static electricity on its prey whilst chewing.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的尾巴互相摩擦，产生静电，再把能量传进刀刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's woolly tail generates static electricity by rubbing against itself. This energy is transferred to its blade.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在操场与学校附近，诱使孩子触碰黄色圆球，再狠狠电上一下。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to float around playgrounds and schools. They entice children into touching their yellow spheres, violently shocking them.

entry: POKENAME头上的羊毛产生大量静电，充入尾珠，使其明亮发光。会引好奇路人进林子，盼着交朋友。
author: arcul
source: The fleece on POKENAME's head generates abundant static electricity. It uses this energy to charge the orb on its tail so it can glow brightly, drawing curious passersby into the woods in hopes of making friends.

entry: POKENAME借毛中的静电增强念力。群体积电发出的光，数英里外都能看见。
author: melodydelune
source: It builds up its psychokinetic abilities through the static electricity in its wool. A herd of POKENAME can be seen from miles away from the light they emit from their static buildup.

entry: POKENAME的华丽羽冠与宽大翅膀，能让种子免受地面上的威胁。它们大部分时间都在空中飞翔，展开双翅，让阳光照到种子上。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's plume of feathers and large wings protect their bulbs from any threats on the ground. They spend most of their time flying through the air, spreading their wings to let sunlight shine down on their bulbs.

entry: 洁净的雪日，能见华美的POKENAME飞行，蓝羽泛着美丽蓝光。俯冲捕猎时，双翼会覆上细小冰晶。
author: mistymagius
source: These gorgeous POKENAME can be seen on pristine, snowy days, its blue feathers radiate a beautiful blue glow as it flies. As it swoops down to catch their prey, their wings become coated in small ice crystals.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，感到威胁时，就会掀起龙卷风。蓝色羽毛宛如瀑布，还藏着古老的力量。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon, and it will whip up a tornado if threatened. Its blue feathers look like waterfalls and contain an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME是强大的宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比，遇上威胁，更能轻松卷起龙卷风。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon. Its claws are razor sharp, and it will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME以3马赫飞行，掀起毁灭性狂风，吹倒大片森林。头顶灿烂羽饰，令大小宝可梦都赞叹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fly at Mach-3 speeds, causing devastating windstorms that knock down large sections of forest. The plumage on its head is admired by Pokémon of all sizes for its brilliance.

entry: 把波拉达养到进化成POKENAME，就能得到十分忠诚的伙伴。羽毛也总打理得干干净净，摸着柔软。
author: vaporvenator
source: Those who keep Pidtata long enough to evolve into POKENAME are rewarded with a very loyal companion. Its feathers are well-cleaned and soft to touch.

entry: POKENAME的双翼能让它以2马赫飞行，却更多用来调节体温。爪子般的双钳，则由钢铁构成。
author: darkweavile428
source: While its wings allow it to fly at Mach 2, POKENAME mostly uses them to regulate its body temperature. Its talon-like pincers are made of steel.

entry: POKENAME讨厌受打扰，睡觉时尤其如此。其他宝可梦若靠得太近又太吵，蛇尾便会注入强毒。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME do not like being disturbed, especially when they sleep. When other Pokémon get too close and too loud, the serpentine tail will inject potent venom into the disturbance.

entry: 强翼与利爪，让POKENAME能在野外狩猎。体侧的红刺，则保护它珍爱的翅膀，不让敌人伤害。
author: therider
source: Strong wings and sharp claws allow POKENAME to hunt in the wild. The red spikes along its side prevent attackers from harming its prized wings.

entry: POKENAME常从高空俯冲，以利爪踢出重击。猎物的同伴还没反应，目标便被抓走，只剩混乱与羽毛。
author: frink202
source: POKENAME usually swoop down from on high before delivering devastating kicks with their talons. They abduct their prey before their peers can even react, leaving nothing but confusion and feathers behind.

entry: POKENAME常停在信任的训练家肩头，遇到喜欢的训练家，也会轻轻咕鸣。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME will often perch on the shoulders of Trainers it trusts. It emits a soft, cooing sound around Trainers it likes.

entry: POKENAME展着雄伟双翼翱翔，通常守护古遗迹，以诡异强风吓退闯入者。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME soars through the skies with its majestic wings. POKENAME typically guard ancient ruins where they will create eerie and powerful winds to scare off any intruders.

entry: POKENAME住在树梢，吃叶子与枯木。背上的真菌，却夺去了它感受疼痛的能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in treetops, where it feeds on leaves and dead wood. The fungus on its back robs it of any sense of pain.

entry: 晴天，羽毛如彩虹闪耀。据说中世纪最负盛名的手稿，便用POKENAME的羽毛笔书写。
author: ozydamians
source: On sunny days, its feathers glow like a shimmering rainbow. In medieval times, the most illustrious manuscripts were said to be penned with POKENAME quills.

entry: POKENAME的大半电力，来自天然棉絮产生的静电，也因此，尽可能不让自己沾湿。
author: phantom640
source: Most of POKENAME's power is generated by static electricity from its natural cotton. Because of this, it tries to avoid getting wet whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME担心羊毛变少，发不出足够电力，便常特意放电，权当锻炼。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often discharge its electricity simply as an exercise, as it is concerned about having less wool with which to generate it.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛，能产生更多电力，身体也更耐电击。靠近导电材料，就会激起电弧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's wool generates more electricity, and its body is more resistant to shocks. Electrical arcs form when it nears conductive materials.

entry: 茸茸羊柔软的羊毛，与风妖精优质的棉絮结合，成了极好的织物。这种特殊纤维，广用于靴子、背心与帽子。
author: dodoowner_
source: Flaaffy's soft wool mixed with Whimsicott's great cotton makes the ultimate fabric. This special fiber is used in many boots, vests, and hats.

entry: POKENAME分泌的油导电极强，既让毛发闪亮，也能增强攻击，还被用于某些电池。
author: gamblebreaker
source: The oil that POKENAME secretes is incredibly conductive, making it not only useful for its shiny coat but also empowering its attacks. It has also been used as a component in some batteries.

entry: POKENAME在雷雨里，破坏欲格外强。一些地区越来越担忧这种行为，连天气预报，也常提起。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME become very destructive during thunderstorms. This behavior is a rising concern in some regions, often being mentioned in weather broadcasts.

entry: POKENAME常支配其他犬类宝可梦，让它们做自己的仆人。谁不听话，脸上就得挨一记重击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often control other dog-like Pokémon and make them its servants. If they don't comply, they get a whack to the face.

entry: POKENAME开始疾冲时，会先爆出小而明亮的闪光，几秒后才传来雷鸣般的巨响。光在数英里外也能看见。
author: frokachu
source: When POKENAME break into a sprint, a small but bright explosion occurs, followed by a thunderous boom seconds after. The light from this event can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME的毛品质极佳，常被用来制作防静电衣物，因此备受珍视。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME are treasured for the quality of their fur, which is often used to make static-resistant clothes.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME灯塔般的光，会引来寻宝者与挑战者。它也正热切等着，和这些家伙一较高下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's beacon-like light attracts treasure-hunters and challengers it is eager to face.

entry: 别被POKENAME可爱的模样骗了。它的尾巴与尖刺，都能释放致命电击。
author: chorb33
source: Pokémon Trainers shouldn't be fooled by POKENAME's deceptive cuteness. It can deliver deadly electric shocks via its tail and spikes.

entry: 光芒连太空里，也能看见。天文学家会借助驯养的POKENAME，校准探测器与卫星，重新调整方位。
author: chorb33
source: Its light is visible even in space. Domesticated POKENAME are used by astronomers to calibrate or realign space probes and satellites.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME十分热心，会救助海上迷途的水手。每颗红珠的光，都亮得足以穿透浓雾。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are extremely helpful Pokémon that help lost sailors at sea. Each of their red orbs can shine brightly enough to cut through dense fog.

entry: POKENAME心地不坏，野生个体却脾气急躁。先放光晃花周围的眼睛，再凑近一抱，足以压碎肋骨。
author: meltan808
source: Although it's good-natured, wild POKENAME tend to have a short temper. It will blind anyone nearby with its ability to produce light, then close in for a rib-crushing hug.

entry: 它待在岸边，发出灯光，替船只引路。人们却不知道，POKENAME其实想让船沉没，好拿来取乐。
author: kiddivinegon
source: This Pokémon hangs out on the shore and shines lights to guide ships. What people don't know is that POKENAME is trying to sink those vessels for fun.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，就会撒出粉末，让植物长得更好，活得更长。
author: dodoowner_
source: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME spread a powder which promotes growth and longevity in plants.

entry: 它把阳光变成电力，再射出雷电。POKENAME的花越红、越深，便代表蓄电越多。
author: ecovermination
source: It turns sunlight into electricity, before firing off bolts of lightning. The darker the red POKENAME's flowers are, the more charged up it is.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴虽美，里面却可能藏着高达1000伏的电压。花朵有时，更亮得宛如太阳。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME tail, although pretty, can have up to 1000 volts of electricity hiding inside. This Pokémon's flowers sometimes shine as bright as the sun.

entry: POKENAME有时会聚在林间小路，搭成一道花拱。最明亮的花在顶端，较弱的则从下方，吸取养分。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME sometimes gather and form an arch over forest footpaths. The brightest blooms form the top, while the weakest draw nutrients from below.

entry: POKENAME的花蜜甘甜醇厚，美味又似乎能安抚心绪。连暴怒的火暴猴喝一口，也会放松。
author: phantom640
source: The sweet and mellow flavor of POKENAME's nectar is not only incredibly tasty, but it also seems to have a calming effect on those who drink it. Even a furious Primeape will relax after a single sip.

entry: POKENAME会把身上长出的花，送给伤心的人。跳舞时，身上也飘出怡人的香气。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME offers the flowers growing on its body to those who are sad. When it dances, a pleasing scent wafts from its body.

entry: POKENAME以花香引来虫属性宝可梦，再张颚整只吞下。消化猎物时，花色也会加深。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME lures in Bug-type Pokémon with the scent of its flowers, then it opens its jaw to swallow them whole. The colors of its flowers deepen as it digests its prey.

entry: 这根花束手杖借助鲜花与阳光的力量，能带来拨云见日、治愈轻伤等奇妙效果。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This bouquet staff uses the powers of flowers and sunshine to generate wondrous effects like parting clouds for sunlight and healing minor injuries.

entry: POKENAME以海滩上的欢快舞姿闻名。它一跳，周围的大家，也都神清气爽。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is known for its cheerful dance that it performs on beaches. When it dances, everyone around feels refreshed.

entry: POKENAME歌声能让周围草木与动物繁盛。据说会在严重污染的地方现身。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's songs encourage flora and fauna surrounding them to thrive. It is said to appear in highly polluted areas.

entry: POKENAME虽在某些地方受崇敬，平日却几乎什么也不做，只偶尔滚两下，进行光合作用。
author: rawthorn
source: Although revered in some regions, POKENAME have been observed to do very little. They occasionally roll around to photosynthesize.

entry: 海岸边，常能看见POKENAME比着彼此的壳。据说，那些住着的壳，原属于古代宝可梦。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME often is found along shorelines comparing their shells to other POKENAME. The shell it inhabits is said to be that of an ancient Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME防水的毛与浮尾很适合河流生活。常在急流边嬉戏，顺流游下，再沿岸跑回高处，重新来过。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With its waterproof fur and buoyant tail, POKENAME is well suited to its river home. They can often be found playing with one another near rapids, swimming down the fast-flowing water and scampering back up the banks to swim down again.

entry: POKENAME沿水面滑行，轻盈又不易沾水，始终不会浸入水中。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can be found sliding along the surface of bodies of water. It is hydrophobic and lightweight, so it never immerses.

entry: POKENAME最怕毛不湿润，从不远离水域。大半天都靠浮尾漂在水面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates it when its fur isn't constantly moist and is never seen far from a body of water. It spends most of the day floating on top of the water with its buoyant tail.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极敏捷，以弹尾为支点四处跳跃，扰乱敌人。主要只是体形太小，才没能威胁更多宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are remarkably agile in fights, using their springy tails as launching platforms to leap around and confound their opponents. Their small statures are the main thing preventing them from posing serious threats to more Pokémon.

entry: 抱得太紧，皮毛便会迸出一阵火星。多余静电虽无害，却能让人的头发根根竖起。
author: .izik
source: If hugged too tightly, this Pokémon's fur will let loose a flurry of sparks. While harmless, this excess static can cause a person's hair to stand on end.

entry: POKENAME靠水生活，吃些水生猎物。尾部的圆球，在水中能充当刹车，让它很快就能重新起飞。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME live near bodies of water, subsisting on aquatic prey. The baubles of its tails act as water brakes, allowing it to quickly take off again.

entry: POKENAME只有与人玩时才真活跃。即使这样，也更爱自己懒着，用超能力来玩。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are only really active when playing with others. Even then, they prefer using their psychic powers to play while they loaf around.

entry: POKENAME在水中会用体内蓄火造出火焰气泡。栖息的河湖，水温能超过华氏1,400度。
author: beatdoof
source: Whenever POKENAME spends time in the water, it creates fire-filled bubbles from the flames stored in its body. The waters of the rivers and lakes where it lives can reach over 1,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 沉重的外壳，让POKENAME难以在急流中游动。它索性沿着沙质河底，翻滚着前进。
author: captainzscourge
source: The shell on its body makes it hard for POKENAME to properly swim in strong currents. It has resorted to tumbling along the sandy bottoms instead.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间沙滩徘徊，享受凉爽的夜游，可常因此，吓着游客。
author: supersonicloki
source: Known to roam beaches at night, POKENAME usually frightens tourists as it enjoys a cool night swim.

entry: POKENAME是探险者的多功能宝可梦工具，既能当棍棒，又能探听声音，还能在水下提供气泡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a Pokémon multi-tool for explorers. It can be used as a club, a auditory sensor, and an underwater air bubble dispenser.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，少有对手或弱点。可天性友善，对几乎所有对象都和气，只有万不得已才会战斗。
author: altius
source: POKENAME's incredible power makes it a Pokémon with few rivals or weaknesses. However, it is merely a friendly creature that is kind to almost everyone, only fighting when absolutely necessary.

entry: POKENAME两颗头不太会分享食物，却从不动粗。最好仍给它们各备一个食盆。
author: blitzydragon
source: The two heads of POKENAME struggle when it comes to sharing food but they never get aggressive. It's still ideal to provide each head with its own food bowl.

entry: 它每到整点，分秒不差地探出身体，发出咕鸣，因此在乡间十分受欢迎。有时，也住在森林里。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion is popular in rural areas, as the body emerges every hour to the second and emits a cooing sound. Occasionally, it also lives in forests.

entry: POKENAME很受豪华家具收藏家青睐，与老派房间十分相配，又不用四处走动。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a popular fusion for collectors of luxury furniture. It perfectly complements rather old-fashioned rooms and doesn't need to move.

entry: POKENAME背上的树才怪，常动弹不得。充当遮雨物时，有时还能听见，它在哭着求救。
author: dodoowner_
source: The Sudowoodo on top of POKENAME's back is often unable to move. It is sometimes heard crying for help as it serves as protection from the rain.

entry: POKENAME不是木头，是岩石，核心还由石墨构成。它爱在墙上画树，一被看见，又把脸藏好。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is not made of wood, but rock; its core is made of graphite. It likes drawing trees on walls and hides its face when observed.

entry: 这种融合体，性情差异极大。有些守护弱者，有些却装成树，吓路人一跳，再转身逃跑。
author: ohok3441
source: This fusion tends to vary wildly in personality. Some protect the weak while others pretend to be trees and try to scare passerby before running away.

entry: POKENAME动作极慢，常坐着不动，无意间成了很好的灌木伪装。缓慢的移动，连背上的东西也几乎察觉不到。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is very slow and often sits still, which unintentionally makes a good bush disguise. Its movements are so sluggish that anything on its back barely notices.

entry: POKENAME兴奋爱玩，喜欢抛接球体、互相滚着传递。信任的训练家若做噩梦，就会将恶梦收进球里，帮对方解脱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very excitable by nature. They enjoy juggling and rolling their orbs back and forth to each other. If a POKENAME trusts a Trainer who is experiencing nightmares, the POKENAME will contain the bad dream within its orb to aid them.

entry: POKENAME和善亲切，摆动球体，安抚躁动的人入睡。奇怪的是，对站着的人最有效，还能帮助维持平衡、提供保护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very pleasant and kind by nature. They swing their orbs to soothe restless people to sleep. However, this technique seems to be most effective when their targets are standing up, granting them balance and protection as well.

entry: POKENAME喜欢满身泥巴在雨里跳舞，任雨点冲刷，同时兴奋地转动强劲的钳子。
author: d_numeritos
source: POKENAME loves to dance in the rain while covered in mud. It likes to energetically spin its powerful pincers, as the raindrops wash over it.

entry: POKENAME每天同一时刻，都会高声呱鸣。野外族群又常齐声合唱，借此驱走天敌。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME croak loudly at the same time each day. Wild populations often synchronize their croaks, which helps drive away potential predators.

entry: 呱呱鸣叫时，它们的喉咙会泛起电光。夜晚，POKENAME聚居的森林，既有悦目的光，也有动听的鸣声。
author: blitzydragon
source: Their throats glow with electricity when croaking. Forests with POKENAME flocks look and sound beautiful at night.

entry: POKENAME乐观开朗，体形又大，常在训练家学校陪孩子玩。察觉危险时，触角便会摇摆。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of POKENAME's positive demeanor and bulk, they are commonly found in Trainer Schools playing with children. Their antennae sway when they sense danger.

entry: POKENAME宽大的荷叶，是其他两栖伙伴的避难所。它走遍湿地，寻找疲惫的生命，收留它们。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME's large lily pad provides sanctuary for its fellow amphibians. It roams the wetlands, searching for weary creatures to take in.

entry: POKENAME吸收池水与雨水。天一干，就呱鸣着引来蚊香君与蚊香蝌蚪，请它们替自己淋水。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs water from ponds or rain. When the weather is dry, it croaks to attract Poliwhirl and Poliwag to shower them.

entry: POKENAME经常笨手笨脚的。有时会把训练家错认成敌对宝可梦，朝对方喷水。
author: spencerrdevv
source: POKENAME are often clumsy in nature. They will sometimes confuse Trainers for rival Pokémon and begin spraying water at them.

entry: 虽有翅膀，POKENAME却不靠振翅飞行，而是控制周围空气推进、滑翔。常引领成群毽子草。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though having wings, it does not fly by flapping. Instead, POKENAME controls the air around them as propulsion, allowing it to glide to its destination.  POKENAME are often found leading flocks of Hoppip.

entry: 它始终散发着新鲜葛拉西蒂亚花的香气，因此十分受欢迎。人们却常把它与危险、没有气味的反向融合体混淆。
author: kai____________
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon, as it eternally gives off the smell of a fresh Gracidea. It's often confused with its dangerous, odorless reversed counterpart.

entry: POKENAME随清爽夏风，悠悠漂荡。夏日里的孩子们，最爱陪POKENAME玩耍。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to drift along fresh summer breezes. Children love to play with POKENAME during the summer months.

entry: POKENAME乘暖气流升上高空。叶片满是利刺，却不知为何让身体更适合顺风飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rides on warm air currents, lifting it high into the sky. Its leaves are covered in sharp thorns that somehow make its body more aerodynamic.

entry: POKENAME跑遍田野，用长喙拔出萝卜与生菜，偷偷带走。农民们，自然很不欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME runs across fields and steals turnips and lettuce by pulling them out of the ground with its long beak. They are not popular with farmers.

entry: 野生POKENAME，能毁掉整季的收成。可有些农民，倒成功将它们驯服，训练成快速犁田的帮手。
author: chorb33
source: Wild POKENAME devastate entire harvests. However, some farmers manage to tame them and train them to rapidly plow their fields instead.

entry: 它们更常在夜里现身。发光的触角，能让随气流漂浮的它，吸引其他POKENAME靠近。
author: kitarchen
source: They are often seen at night, rather than during the day. Their glowing antennae allow them to attract other POKENAME as they float on air currents.

entry: 看POKENAME叶状翅膀上的褐斑数量，就能判断年龄。双翼全褐后会碎裂剥落，直到再也不能飞。
author: teatedtiten
source: You can tell how old a POKENAME is by the amount of brown spots on its leaf-like wings. When POKENAME's wings get fully brown, they crumble and flake off until it can no longer fly.

entry: POKENAME虽像凶猛的蜈蚣王近亲，天性却温柔善良。乐于载孩子玩，走过的地方留下花朵。
author: rakunk
source: Despite a close resemblance to its more aggressive cousin, Scolipede, POKENAME is known for its gentle and kindhearted nature. It delights in allowing children to ride on its back, leaving a trail of flowers in its wake.

entry: POKENAME整日寻找阳光。鲜艳花瓣则警告大家，它身带毒素。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME spend their days in search of patches of sunlight. Its bright petals are a warning of the toxins POKENAME contains.

entry: POKENAME让头上的扇叶，迎向强风，就能乘风而去，一路滑过几公里，抵达新的草地。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME points the fans on its head against strong winds, it is swept along. In this way, it glides several kilometers to new meadows.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，胳膊也短，可拳头打出的力道，却足以把钢铁，生生折弯。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME have a short temper and short range with their fists. However, they can deliver enough force to bend steel.

entry: POKENAME用附近绒毛编成浮筏，乘暖南风越过海洋，飞向异国。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME craft hovering rafts from nearby fluff to ride warm, southern winds across the sea, flying to foreign lands.

entry: POKENAME总是喜笑颜开，仿佛不停点头答应。可软绵绵的拳头，对多数宝可梦，都没什么威力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME always has a happy expression, like it's nodding 'yes' all the time. Its soft punches aren't very effective against most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把身上长出的棉花揉成球，挥打向敌人。“百代杂技”网球队的灵感，正来自它。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME makes balls out of the cotton that grows from its body, and whacks them at its enemies. It inspired The Eterna Acrobats tennis team.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会洒种子，帮助新的草属性宝可梦生长，也治愈受伤个体。预言称，种子能将荒地变成繁茂森林。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME scatters seeds with every flap of its wings. These seeds help grow new Grass-Types and heal those that have been wounded. These seeds are prophesied to turn wastelands into lush forests.

entry: 运动队爱请POKENAME当啦啦队员。欢乐活泼的性格，连最可爱的妖精属性宝可梦也能媲美。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Sports teams love using POKENAME as cheerleaders. Their joyful and energetic personality rivals even the cutest Fairy-types.

entry: POKENAME挥着毽子棉绒毛做的绒球，一心想当一位，热情洋溢的啦啦队员。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME wields pom-poms made of Jumpluff's fluff. It aspires to be a passionate cheerleader.

entry: POKENAME常在平原蹦跳。刮风时，用强健双腿稳住自己。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME can be found bouncing on plains. It uses its strong legs to stay sturdy during windy days.

entry: POKENAME随季节乘风环游世界，洒下孢子。接触会造成细小割伤，呼吸时须当心。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME scatters spores as it rides the wind across the world seasonally. Contact with these can give tiny cuts, so take caution when breathing.

entry: POKENAME本体小，附肢像乒乓球，轻得宛如塑料袋般随风飞舞。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The lightweight POKENAME flies around in the wind like a plastic bag with its tiny body and ping pong ball appendages.

entry: 它们用绒毛与棉絮筑屋。屋子一被吹走，POKENAME便坐在里面，前往新的土地。
author: staghorn
source: They construct lodges out of fluff and cotton. When these lodges blow away, the POKENAME ride inside them to travel to new lands.

entry: POKENAME白天晒着太阳，散播棉絮孢子。夜里则钻进地下深处，躲开天敌。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME spends its day basking in the sunlight and scattering cotton spores. At night, it burrows deep into the ground to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME一旦选好定居的地方，就再也挪不走。它会吸引来大群毽子鼠，在这里寻找安全的住处。
author: gentlesage
source: Once a POKENAME decides on a place to settle, it is impossible to remove. It attracts hordes of Jumplett that are seeking a safe place.

entry: POKENAME容易发怒，常袭击训练家。可拳头全是棉花，打起来，根本不痛。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is easily irritated and is known to attack Trainers frequently. However, due to having cotton for fists, its punches don't hurt at all.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME被攻击时，就旋转头顶的突起，扬起大量种子，挡住敌人的视线，再趁机逃走。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME is attacked, it whirls the outgrowths on its head around to block its opponent's view with lots of seeds and then runs away.

entry: 体内不断产生的毒气，让POKENAME浮了起来。它也能通过牙齿，将毒素传给对方。
author: chorb33
source: It continuously produces poisonous gases in its body that cause POKENAME to float. It can transmit these poisons via its teeth.

entry: 走到哪里，祸就闯到哪里。问题严重得让科学家正研究空中捕鼠器等对策。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon wreaks havoc everywhere they go. It's such a big problem, scientists are trying to develop countermeasures like airborne mouse traps.

entry: POKENAME以堵住繁忙道路闻名，却也最适合守护重要物件，挡住窥探的目光。
author: inksans201x
source: While it's notorious for blocking busy pathways, POKENAME is ideal for protecting important things from wandering eyes.

entry: POKENAME靠体内器官掌握捕食者的睡眠规律，找准时机再去觅食。
author: demonic_garbage
source: With the help of its internal organ, POKENAME can track its predators' sleeping patterns. When the time is right, POKENAME scrounges for food.

entry: POKENAME爱啃小陨石，即使会伤牙。人们便借此判断哪些石头来自天外。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a strange habit of nibbling on small meteorites, despite the damage it does to their teeth. People use POKENAME to determine what rocks are extraterrestrial.

entry: POKENAME常偷郊区住家的奶酪。它们聪明得狡猾，还会组织行动，尽可能多偷一些。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are commonly seen stealing cheese from suburban homes. They are devilishly clever and organize heists to steal as much cheese as they can.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，藏在水边树上滑翔觅食，专找垃圾吃。热门观光海滩常受它们困扰。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is very cheerful. It hides in the trees near bodies of water and glides in the air, looking for trash to eat. They're pests of the most popular tourist beaches.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿，由钢合金构成。想要磨短，实在是件费工夫的事。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's teeth are made of a steel alloy. This makes wearing them down a tedious experience.

entry: POKENAME在暗巷狩猎，越饿，瞄准的受害者就越大。人们只好投食，免得它向人类下手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are found in dark alleyways where they hunt. They target larger victims the hungrier they are, so are fed to deter attacks on humans.

entry: POKENAME胆子小，却爱探索周围。想吸引它的训练家，可以在附近，摆些能勾起兴趣的玩具。
author: melodydelune
source: Skittish in nature, POKENAME loves to explore its area. Trainers are advised to keep stimulating toys around if seeking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME入夜才出来偷食维生，力气大得能把别人家整台冰箱扛走。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME crawls out once night falls in order to steal some food to ensure its survival. It is capable of carrying an entire fridge out of somebody's home.

entry: POKENAME夜行，出了名地害羞。被看见时，身体猛闪强光，随后逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and notoriously shy. When spotted, they emit a sudden bright light from their bodies and flee.

entry: 多年前，一部以POKENAME为主角的卡通一炮而红，闻名世界。如今，那个角色已成了全球最大动画工作室之一的吉祥物。
author: .fedoraman
source: Years ago, a world-famous animation first broke out with a cartoon starring a POKENAME. Today, that character is the mascot for one of the largest animation studios in the world.

entry: POKENAME爱向路人挥手，飞累了，又会替自己，轻轻按按摩。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to wave to people who pass by. When it's tired in flight, it'll give itself a slight massage.

entry: POKENAME手臂般的尾巴，黏性极强。它能边飞，边从毫无防备的人与宝可梦那里，抢走食物。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME's arm-like tail is incredibly sticky. It uses it while flying to snatch food away from inattentive Pokémon and Trainers.

entry: POKENAME是自学成才、满怀抱负的画家，在热带栖息地的石头和树上作画。颜料用完就进城，偷美术店的颜料管，却只拿红、绿、蓝。
author: jackster
source: Aspiring, self-taught artists, POKENAME paint on rocks and trees in their tropical habitats. When they run out of paint, they travel to local towns and steal paint tubes from art supply stores, but only in reds, greens, and blues.

entry: POKENAME挥舞藤蔓的手和利刃，能在森林中迅速夺走生命。幸好，它更喜欢用它们抓取、切开水果和坚果。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vine-swinging hand and blade can make for a swift death in the forest. Thankfully it prefers grabbing and cutting fruits and nuts instead.

entry: POKENAME靠多只手，在树枝与藤蔓间飞快荡行，偷走毫无防备宝可梦的树果，或其他东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME use their multiple hands to quickly swing across branches and vines. They steal berries and other items from unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只用那一只手，慢慢堆起自己的身体，十分自豪。可一慌乱挥动着自卫，身体又往往散了。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME take great pride in building up their body using their singular hand. Their body usually falls apart as they flail to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME夜里会用巨大的尾状附肢，抓住毫无防备的人。它并不想伤害，只是想吓一跳。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME uses its large, tail-like appendage to latch onto unsuspecting people at night. It does not wish to do harm however, merely to frighten.

entry: POKENAME常待在近水面，很少潜得更深，好让身体吸收到，足够维生的日光。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME often stay close to the surface of water and rarely dive deeper. This is to ensure they are collecting enough sunlight to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME一拳，就能打出适合播种的洞。效率出色，也让POKENAME很受农民喜欢。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME use their punches to make perfect holes for seeds. This efficiency has made POKENAME favored by farmers.

entry: POKENAME很会分辨杂草与真菌，飞遍农场，除掉可能危害作物的植物。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are great at identifying weeds and fungi. They fly around farmsteads eliminating any plants that may threaten the farm.

entry: POKENAME虽顽皮，有些不走寻常路的园丁却极信赖它的独特本领，拿来帮忙务农。它播下的种子，似乎发芽快得多。
author: rakunk
source: Despite its mischievous personality, some unconventional gardeners swear by using POKENAME as a farmhand due to its unique talents. Seeds sown by this Pokémon appear to sprout much faster than normal.

entry: POKENAME钻进土里，只为隐藏自己。若有人不慎踩到叶子，它便喷出火焰，烧得对方疼痛。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME digs itself into the ground to hide. If someone accidentally steps on its leaf, it emits a painful flame.

entry: POKENAME轻柔的双翼在田野间飞行时收集空气水分。旱月便化作细雨洒下，帮助其他草属性宝可梦的种子长大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wispy wings of POKENAME gather moisture from the air as they fly from field to field. In drier months, the water collected in their wings is showered out as soft rain, helping the seeds of other Grass-types grow to adulthood.

entry: 它最有效的防身本领，只有喷火。可这会耗掉POKENAME大量能量，因此，通常避免作战。
author: chorb33
source: Its only effective defense is fire, which it can emit. However, this drains POKENAME of a lot of energy, so it usually avoids combat.

entry: 小拳石双臂为这次融合开启了绝佳组合。POKENAME能移到最方便饮露的位置，也更易藏进地下。烈雀若来袭，就会被拳头“说服”改主意。
author: lutrax
source: This fusion marks the start of a great combination in the wild. With Geodude arms, POKENAME can move to the best spot for its dew-based diet, and better hide into the ground. If attacked by a Spearow, POKENAME will punch a change of mind into it.

entry: POKENAME常爬上山顶，尽量靠近太阳。也喜欢雨水渗进皮肤裂缝。体内植物长大后，便必须蜕去岩石外皮。
author: lutrax
source: POKENAME regularly climbs to mountaintops in order to be as close as possible to the sun. This Pokémon also loves rainy days as the water drips through the cracks in its skin. As the plant system within it grows, POKENAME must shed its rocky skin.

entry: POKENAME晒足阳光便会变色。有些甚至燃烧起来，它们却乐在其中。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME change color when exposed to lots of sunlight. Some may even burst into flames, but they enjoy this.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，最爱晒夏日太阳。营养丰富的鳞片掉落后，还能帮助植物生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are cheery Pokémon who love to bask in the summer sun. Its nutrient-rich scales can help plants grow when they fall off.

entry: POKENAME将光合作用多得的太阳能存进头顶花中。性情乐观，晴日尤其开心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores excess solar energy from photosynthesis in the flower on its head. It is a very positive Pokémon and seems to be especially cheery on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME双臂如炮，能射出种子。它飞过农场上方，对任何可能危害庄稼的东西，都会开火。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME have the ability to fire seeds from their arms like cannons. They fly above farmsteads, firing at anything that may be a threat to the crops.

entry: POKENAME藏在向日花怪群中，悄悄吸走它们的能量。即使如此，对谁仍都十分友善。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst other Sunflora, slowly draining their energy while they're unaware. Despite this, they are still very friendly to everyone.

entry: POKENAME连战斗时都朝着太阳，不必转身，也能对付任何方向的敌人。
author: staghorn
source: Even in combat, a POKENAME will always orient itself towards the sun. It can fight opponents in any direction without turning its body.

entry: POKENAME伪装向日葵，融入田野与花园。若被捕食者发现，就展开藏起的双翼，高速飞走。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a sunflower to blend seamlessly into fields and gardens. If spotted by a predator, it reveals its hidden wings and takes off at incredible speeds.

entry: POKENAME常在草木繁茂的田野里晒太阳。虽然性情温顺，谁若打扰了它的清静，也会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME is often found in lush fields, basking in the sun. Although docile, POKENAME will viciously attack those who disturb its peace.

entry: POKENAME尾端始终燃着小火，身体却十分易燃。每逢攻击，都得小心，别把自己点着。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME always emits a small flame from its tail, its body is flammable. It is always careful not to ignite itself when attacking.

entry: POKENAME伏在大花田中，伸长尾巴，等其他宝可梦经过。授粉的生物一落上花，就成了它的盘中餐。
author: mundane_frog
source: POKENAME lies in large flower fields, its tail outstretched in wait for a Pokémon to come by. Once a pollinator lands on a flower, it secures a meal.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“温柔巨人”。弱小宝可梦跟随它，寻求友谊和保护。所到之处会长出花田，孕育完整的生态。
author: rakunk
source: Often nicknamed 'Gentle Giant', smaller Pokémon tend to follow POKENAME around for their friendship and protection. Wherever it travels, entire ecosystems and flower fields sprout in its place.

entry: POKENAME僵直地站在森林或田野，吸收阳光。敌人一走近，就喷出火焰，有时，甚至引发森林大火。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stands rigidly in forests or fields and absorbs sunlight. If an enemy approaches, it launches fire that has been known to light forest fires.

entry: POKENAME不停吸收太阳能。蓄够了，就能卷起整场火焰风暴，可也得小心，自己易燃的身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME constantly absorbs solar energy. Once it has collected enough, it can ignite entire firestorms. But it has to be wary of its flammable body.

entry: POKENAME白天爬山顶吸收阳光，夜里挖浅穴休息。睡在里面时，粗看只像一块普通石头。
author: lutrax
source: During the day, POKENAME climbs to the tops of mountains to absorb sunlight. At night, this Pokémon digs shallow burrows to rest, and while sleeping in said burrows, it appears to casual bystanders as just a simple rock.

entry: 晴朗午后，山顶可能聚着无数晒太阳的POKENAME。可傍晚登山要当心，成群的它们会毫无顾忌地一路滚下。
author: lutrax
source: If you happen to be on the peak of a mountain during a sunny afternoon, you could see a myriad of POKENAME enjoying the sunlight; however, be careful when climbing in the evening, as during that time herds of POKENAME may be rolling down carefree.

entry: POKENAME曾是受欢迎的竞速品种。可速度竟依赖太阳，实在太不可靠，最终不再被看好。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME used to be a popular Pokémon racing breed. However since its speed depended on the sun, it was deemed too unreliable.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不起来，便改用翅膀积起静电，射出电击波，作为主要攻击手段。
author: t.i.a.
source: Too heavy to fly, POKENAME use their wings to charge up static electricity and shoot shock waves as its main form of attack.

entry: 它一扇翅膀，便能电死身旁飞过的虫宝可梦。黄昏时，大群POKENAME会一同演出绚丽的灯光秀。
author: schwaus
source: The flap of its wings can electrocute other bug Pokémon it flies by. Large groupings of POKENAME create elaborate lightshows at dusk.

entry: POKENAME飞得太快，周围时间都慢了下来。因此，寿命比其他宝可梦长约50%。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies so fast that time slows down around it. Because of this, POKENAME's lifespan is about 50 percent longer than other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一心想帮助别人，潜力也巨大，却还不懂，怎样把力量发挥出来。
author: jackythewannabe
source: POKENAME is driven by a strong desire to help others. Though it has great potential, it doesn't know how to tap into this power.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖畔，嗡嗡地飞到结果的植物旁，寻找食物。双眼能察觉周围360度，逼近的威胁。
author: melodydelune
source: Living along lakes, POKENAME will buzz around fruiting plants to eat. Their eyes allow them to see approaching threats 360° around them.

entry: POKENAME头骨坚硬，飞行又没准头，能严重破坏城市。它若铁了心，连强化玻璃也挡不住。
author: currentlymuffin
source: With their hard skulls and erratic flying, POKENAME can cause severe damage to cities. Even reinforced glass can't withstand a determined POKENAME.

entry: 失去了曾经最珍重的东西，POKENAME也失去了生活的目标。
author: fuade
source: Having lost what it once valued most, POKENAME finds itself without purpose.

entry: 过去住在网络空间的POKENAME，如今四处寻找现实中的训练家，想交个朋友。只要认准喜欢的人，它就再也不肯离开。永远不肯。
author: inksans201x
source: Previously residing in cyberspace, POKENAME now actively seeks out Trainers to befriend in the real world. Once it finds a Trainer it likes, it won't leave them alone. Ever.

entry: POKENAME爱朝人泼水，想吓对方一跳。可人家究竟是吓到了，还是被逗笑了，它往往又分不清。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to spook people by splashing water on them, though most times it's confused whether that person is spooked or laughing.

entry: 世界有些地方，会在窗边挂上POKENAME模样的纸偶，用来求雨。
author: staghorn
source: In some parts of the world, paper dolls resembling POKENAME are hung in windows in order to invite rain.

entry: POKENAME常在咸淡水交汇处生活，少动弹，以水草为食。面对危险反应虽慢，一旦受了威胁，潜藏的超能力便会觉醒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically found around brackish water, where they live sedentary lives feeding on aquatic plants. They are often slow to react to danger but have latent psychic powers that activate when threatened.

entry: POKENAME久静不动。究竟是身体太湿，还是太懒，才迟迟不爆炸，科学家也无从确定。
author: duskrd
source: Scientists have been unable to determine if POKENAME is either too damp or too lazy to explode. It stays completely still for long periods of time.

entry: 它总吐着舌头，不知是在逗人，还是不得不如此。平日便在沼地与湿泽间，游来游去。
author: dodoowner_
source: It constantly sticks its tongue out, either to be funny or because it has to. It swims around in marshes and swamps.

entry: 据说，这种融合体是所有沼王的王。王冠越大、装饰越华美，就越受尊重。
author: valtsuri
source: This fusion is said to be the king of all Quagsire. The larger and more decorated the crown, the more respect it has.

entry: POKENAME是合力施法，守护森林的小妖精。虽然呆呆的、无忧无虑，却从不忘记，林间发生的事。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME are little fairies who protect the forest with their combined magics. While dopey and carefree, they never forget what happens in the forest.

entry: POKENAME惯用头槌进攻，可脑袋又软又空，实在打不出多少威力。
author: sandguything
source: POKENAME's default offensive strategy consists of headbutting its opponents, though its head is too squishy and empty to do any significant damage.

entry: POKENAME太懒，能在泥里坐到，身边的泥土全干硬了。之后便动不了，只好等着下一场雨。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is quite lazy. It can sit in the mud for so long that the earth will dry around it, leaving it immobilized until it rains again.

entry: 一下雨，POKENAME就激动地泼泥、扔泥。因此，POKENAME的领地，多半到处是干泥。
author: blitzydragon
source: Whenever it rains, POKENAME will start splashing and throwing mud violently. Territories of POKENAME are usually covered in dried mud because of this.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥池，张嘴等猎物，自己走进来。可几乎，从来没有成功过。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME lies in a pool of mud and waits for prey to wander into its open mouth. It is almost never successful.

entry: POKENAME通常住在较小的海域。犯困时，便用双翼裹住身体，钻进海床睡去。
author: niseria
source: POKENAME usually live in smaller seas. If POKENAME get sleepy, they cover themselves with their wings and burrow into the seabed.

entry: 总被拿来与大嘴王比较，让它心生自卑。它盼着身材更结实，却把嫉妒，藏在笑容后面。
author: megaban
source: It has developed an inferiority complex of sorts, being compared to Golsire. It wishes for a more well-built body, hiding its envy behind a smile.

entry: POKENAME憨憨的，却很可爱，身躯有多庞大，童心就有多旺盛。柔云般的双翼载着它懒懒飘过天空，可哪怕一缕微风，或一件闪亮物品，都能让它分心。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a lovable but dim-witted personality. Its massive size is matched only by its childlike enthusiasm. With wings made of soft clouds, it soars lazily through the skies, often getting distracted by the slightest breeze or shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量储存在背上的种子中。两条尾巴其实是敏锐的藤蔓，能感知其他宝可梦的情绪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores its psychic energy in the bulb on its back. Its twin-tails are actually sensitive vines that it uses to sense the emotions of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常成群出没，人们称其为“集合体”。遇险时，整个集合体会协力，打出庞大的精神冲击。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually found in herds known as collectives. When in a pinch, the collective will attack with a giant psychic blast.

entry: 人们认为，只有与训练家的羁绊如太阳般明亮，POKENAME才会自然进化。它性情含蓄又难以捉摸，却偏偏能预见未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.

entry: 人们认为，只有与训练家的羁绊如太阳般明亮，POKENAME才会自然进化。它性情含蓄又难以捉摸，却偏偏能预见未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.

entry: POKENAME的花，只在晴天绽放，释放全部的超能力。蓝色叶片散发的香气，也能抚平心绪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flower only blooms on sunny days, unleashing its full psychic power. Its blue leaves give off a calming scent that soothes minds.

entry: POKENAME对训练家十分忠诚，会读懂对方的心思，再设法让训练家开心。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is very loyal to its Trainer. Reading its Trainer's mind, it always tries to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME按催眠般的节奏游动，让猎物以为安然无事，再用超能力将其压垮。若凝视腹部的眼睛，更会彻底受它控制。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME moves in a hypnotic pattern that lures its prey into a false sense of security before it crushes them with their psychic powers. Staring into the eyes on its belly puts you under its full control.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，性情又友善，是受欢迎的伙伴。据说，它还会赐予为正义而战的人，神奇的力量。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME's insightful nature and friendly demeanor makes it a popular companion. They are said to grant magical powers to those fighting for justice.

entry: POKENAME能用神秘力量读心，预知下一步行动。它聪慧过人，把缔结羁绊的训练家视作平等伙伴，也能从双手射出紫色能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.

entry: 凭强大的超能力，POKENAME能随心操纵火焰，也能让火势迅速蔓延。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can control fires and spread them at will.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME长久磨炼超能力，长出的水晶也更大、更有力量，能保护自己，对抗敌人。
author: ladan
source: POKENAME spent a long time honing its psychic abilities. It grows larger and more powerful crystals to protect itself against foes.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便学会操纵自己长出的锋利水晶，抵御来犯的敌人。
author: ladan
source: Since the POKENAME lacks any limbs, it learned to manipulate the sharp crystals it grows to fend off attackers.

entry: POKENAME融合了昼行与夜行的宝可梦，因此很少睡觉。超能力，也让光合作用，更有效率。
author: vaporvenator
source: As a fusion of a nocturnal and diurnal Pokémon, POKENAME rarely sleeps. Psychic power aids in the efficiency of its photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME的心灵感应格外出众，不只自己的几颗头，连其他生物也能与之交谈。可每颗头个性不同，一吵起来，往往就是好几个小时。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME possesses an extraordinary ability to communicate through telepathy, not only with its own heads but with other creatures as well. Each head has a distinct personality, and will often argue with one another for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME从月光中获取能量，满月时，背上的种子开得最盛。受到威胁时，种子会渗出毒汁，误食后会引起严重恶心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets its energy from moonlight, with its bulb blooming most fully during the full moon. When threatened, the bulb seeps toxic sap that causes severe nausea if consumed.

entry: POKENAME无声而敏捷，藏在暗处，以强力踢击迎敌。准备出手时，环纹会亮得更盛，先扰乱对手，再迅速、精准地击中。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME moves with silent agility, striking with powerful kicks in the cover of darkness. Its glowing rings intensify when it's ready to attack, disorienting foes before delivering swift, precise blows.

entry: 这头史前猛兽，只肯夜间狩猎。偏偏饭点定得太死，能选的食物，便实在不多。
author: patch_bros
source: This prehistoric powerhouse would exclusively hunt at night. Due to this scheduled mealtime, it unfortunately didn't have too many options for food.

entry: 月光照来，光环便开始发亮、迸出火花。可有记录的POKENAME目击，竟都发生在，暴风雨的夜里。
author: deflador
source: Under the moon's light, the rings on its body start to glow and spark. The only recorded sightings of POKENAME have been during stormy nights.

entry: POKENAME有许多眼睛，能看清远近，找出隐藏之物。它原生于幽暗森林，也时常守护着，那片树林。
author: anlcorpagent
source: POKENAME possesses many eyes that can see far and wide, able to detect hidden objects. It is native to dark forests, regularly protecting them.

entry: POKENAME能放出，宛如克雷色利亚般美丽的月光。满月之夜，光芒也最强。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can emit moonlight as beautiful as a Cresselia's. Its bioluminescence is strongest on a full moon night.

entry: POKENAME吸收的月光越多，背上的花便开得越大。它会用小角撞击对手，注入致命的毒液。
author: mistymagius
source: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the bigger the blossom on its back grows. It will tackle its opponents with its small horns, injecting them with a deadly poison.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，临近满月时更常见。平日性情温和，会点亮法杖、环纹与角，引导迷途旅人平安回家；战斗时，则筑起光墙自保。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: POKENAME appear only at night, and are more common near full moons. Generally passive, these Pokémon light up their staves, rings, and horns to guide wayward travelers home safely, and create defensive walls of light in combat.

entry: POKENAME背上的花，需要月光才能绽放、存活。因此，只有夜里才能看见它，花朵也在月色中泛着微光。
author: patch
source: The flower on POKENAME's back requires moonlight to blossom and stay alive. Because of this, POKENAME can only be seen at night, where this flower glimmers in the moonlight.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: POKENAME是沉默的战士，据说已掌握古代城都的格斗术。它们对训练家忠心耿耿，潜伏暗处，趁敌人最不设防时，打出决定性的一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are silent warriors that are said to have mastered fighting techniques from ancient Johto. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainers, operating in the shadows to deliver decisive blows to their opponents when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME跃过夜空，头顶刀刃宛如弯月。它们投出金色光环惊扰目标，再从光环映出的阴影里，无声挥刃袭击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap through the night sky, the blades on their heads resembling the crescent moon. They project rings of golden light to surprise their targets, silently striking with their blades from the shadows they cast.

entry: 它的铠甲由璀璨的月岩琢出棱面。战斗中，甲胄若泛起光芒，便是POKENAME正在引导神秘的月之力。
author: nellnast42
source: Its armor is faceted from a brilliant moon rock. When the armor glows in battle, POKENAME is channeling a mysterious lunar power.

entry: 有些古代文化，将POKENAME视为神圣。至今，它仍徘徊于他们的墓地，诅咒擅闯之人。
author: cadyrocks
source: POKENAME was seen as sacred by certain ancient cultures. To this day, it haunts their tombs, placing its curse on trespassers.

entry: POKENAME只在繁星满天、夜空澄澈的时候现身。传说，若看见它在满月下起舞，往后数年都会好运相随。
author: cpnquacken
source: POKENAME only appear during nights when the stars are plenty and the sky is unobstructed. Steeped in legend, it is said that seeing one dancing under the full moon would bring you good fortune for years to come.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME借月下的阴影掩护伏击。能力只在夜里发挥作用，它便从天明一直睡到日落。
author: nellnast42
source: When hunting, POKENAME utilizes the moon's shadow to disguise its ambushes. Since its abilities are strictly nocturnal, it sleeps from dawn till dusk.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME身上的环纹会发亮，反而暴露了行踪。不过它快得惊人，猎物察觉时，往往已逃不掉了。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's rings glow under moonlight, unfortunately alerting prey to its presence. However, this Pokémon is so fast, it's often too late for them to escape.

entry: POKENAME常躲在阴影里，突然蹿出来惊吓人类与宝可梦。被吓得丢下的贵重物品、小饰件，都会落入它手中，再也找不回来。
author: gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME often hide in shadows and wait to jump out at people and Pokémon. Any valuables or trinkets that are left behind are taken by them, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME有着光滑的黑羽，身边环绕着小小的火焰。它爱在夜里恶作剧，用尖喙与火星吓唬毫无防备的旅人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon with sleek black feathers and a small aura of flames. It loves to play tricks at night, using its sharp beak and small embers to frighten unsuspecting travelers.

entry: POKENAME不断扇动翅膀，想警告人们厄运将至，却从来没人当回事。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME flaps its wings around trying to warn people of ill fortune, but nobody takes it seriously.

entry: POKENAME会欺骗其他宝可梦，也会偷走它们的树果。如果帽子被偷，它就会大闹一场，直到找回帽子为止。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is known to con other Pokémon or steal their Berries. If its hat is stolen, it goes on a rampage until it is found.

entry: 它虽骄傲又爱自夸，却被人们尊为守护者。保护训练家的强烈意愿使它颇受欢迎。
author: xephyr
source: Although proud and boastful, these Pokémon are revered as guardians. Their burning desire to defend their Trainer makes them popular.

entry: 大舌贝咬住POKENAME的头后，它获得了神秘力量与近似人类的智慧。可大脑尚未适应，反应依旧慢得出奇。
author: sontyp
source: When a Shellder bit POKENAME's head, it developed mystical powers and a human-like intelligence. Its brain can't adapt to this yet, so it is incredibly slow to react.

entry: POKENAME会死死盯着它认为有威胁的人。在野外遇见它时，应避开目光，慢慢走远。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will intensely stare at anyone that it considers a threat. If you encounter one in the wild, slowly walk away without making eye contact.

entry: POKENAME常挥动那根有生命的手杖，像个小巫师。人们以为它有神秘的法力，但也许只是装装样子。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME often waves its living staff around like a tiny wizard. People assume it has mystical powers, but it may just be an act.

entry: 为了让头顶花苞绽放，POKENAME只吃同样晒着太阳的叶片，同时从两处获取能量。临近开花时，却会散发难闻的气味。
author: soup1900
source: To help the bud on its head bloom, POKENAME will only eat leaves that are also in the bright sunlight to gain energy from two sources at once. When its bud is about to bloom, it releases a repulsive smell.

entry: POKENAME生活在草木繁茂的沼泽，用宽大的叶片托着自己漂浮，悄然藏于水面。受惊时，头顶的花便会释放毒孢子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in marshy areas covered with flora, using its large leaves to float on the water without being seen. The flower on its head releases poisonous spores when agitated.

entry: POKENAME吸收过多阳光时，会从尾端的花苞释放多余能量，使周围植物骤然生长。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME absorbs too much sunlight, it dispels this energy through the bud on its tail. This causes plants nearby to suddenly grow.

entry: 它背上的花苞还没到绽放的时候。为了让花苞长大，它耗去了大部分能量，因此行动格外迟缓。
author: soup1900
source: The bulb on its back is not fully ready to bloom yet. It is quite sluggish since it uses most of its energy to grow its bulb.

entry: POKENAME的双腿十分强健，能在树冠间跳跃。那些巨大的森林生长在它赖以栖身的古老洞穴中。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME's legs have grown strong to allow it to leap through the canopy of the massive forests that grow in the ancient caves it calls home.

entry: POKENAME虽然仍能当作棍棒使用，却更喜欢让花苞散发香气，把对手哄睡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though still a functional club, POKENAME prefers to put its opponents to sleep with the aroma emanating from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME开心时，花瓣会散发怡人的花香。经常能看到POKENAME在阳光下打盹。
author: melodydelune
source: The petals of POKENAME emit a pleasant floral scent when it is happy. POKENAME can often be found napping in the sun.

entry: 它的花同时处于绽放与未绽放的奇妙状态，因此散发着其他花朵都没有的独特香气。
author: soup1900
source: Its flower is in a special state of blooming and not blooming at the same time. This gives it a unique aroma no other flower has.

entry: 尾端的花苞越鲜艳，POKENAME就越有精神。花苞若散发出带烟熏味的香气，就表示快开花了。
author: soup1900
source: The more vibrant the bud on its tail is, the more energetic POKENAME becomes. A smoke-like aroma from the bud indicates that it's about to bloom.

entry: 它十分珍爱尾巴上的花苞。如果这株植物枯萎，POKENAME也会随之死去。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is very proud of the bulb on its tail. If the plant ever withers away, POKENAME will die with it.

entry: 尾端的花苞绽开时，会露出一小簇火焰。它有时会在战斗中故意开花，让前来攻击的对手措手不及。
author: soup1900
source: When the bud on its tail blooms, a tiny flame is revealed. It will sometimes intentionally do this in battle to surprise foes who attack it.

entry: 尾端的花苞能喷出猛烈火焰，却不会伤及身上的植物。它会烧掉枯树与灌木，为新植物腾出生长空间。
author: soup1900
source: The bud on its tail spouts an intense flame that doesn't harm its flora. It will burn down dead trees and shrubs to allow room for new ones to grow.

entry: 花苞长得太大时，它就无法再用后腿站立。人们看见这一幕，常会把POKENAME误认成树林龟。
author: dodoowner_
source: If its bulb grows too large, it'll lose the ability to stand on its hind legs. When people see this, they often mistake POKENAME for a Grotle.

entry: 它的电力如今全部储存在头顶的花苞里，再通过磁铁形状的藤蔓释放出去。
author: mariod246
source: All of its electricity is now stored in the bulb at the top of its head. It uses its magnet-shaped vines to expel said electricity.

entry: 花苞中的电荷吸引来了另外两只妙蛙磁怪。三只聚在一起，电力也增至原来的三倍。
author: mariod246
source: The charge from its bulb has attracted two other Ivytons. Together, they triple their electric power.

entry: 它吸收阳光为炮管积蓄能量。蓄满后便会射出两道强劲的日光束，足以贯穿混凝土。
author: soup1900
source: It absorbs sunlight to charge its cannons. Once it is fully charged, it'll fire two powerful Solar Beams that can tear through concrete.

entry: POKENAME会啃咬地窖、食品储藏室的门框和门板。人们以为它们惦记着里面的奶酪，其实它们是在分解木质纤维，为背上的种子获取养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw away at the frames and doors to cellars or pantries. While it is common belief that they are after the cheese stored within, they actually break down the wood grain of the structures to gather nutrients for their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME成群住在肮脏的下水道里。无论它吐出的气体还是咬伤，都可能传播多种疾病。
author: chorb33
