source: POKENAME live together in groups in dirty sewers. Both the gas it emits and its bite transmit numerous diseases.

entry: 极少数情况下，拉弹的尾巴会缠在一起，再也无法分开，最终形成POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: In rare cases, the tails of Ratfings become so entangled that they can no longer detach and form POKENAME.

entry: 多种特征让这只融合宝可梦格外适合树栖生活。它会从树上俯冲而下，抢走路人手中的食物。
author: vaporvenator
source: A combination of traits make this fusion suitable for a uniquely arboreal lifestyle. It swoops down from trees to snatch food from passersby.

entry: 打结的尾巴如同第三只手，专门顺走看中的东西。遇上危险，POKENAME还能咬断尾巴，引开敌人的注意。
author: mistymagius
source: Its knotted tails act like a third arm, mainly being used to swipe things that catch its eye. When in danger, POKENAME can chew off its tail to use as a distraction.

entry: 有报告称，POKENAME在暗中统领着数支拉达小队。这些小队彼此配合，企图控制道路。
author: the_smirker
source: Reports state POKENAME commands small legions of Raticate in secret. These legions work together to assert control over routes.

entry: 头发和门牙长得一样快。它常得自己啃掉一些丰厚秀发，才不至于太长。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The hairs on its head grow as fast as its fangs. It often has to pare down its luscious locks by chewing on them.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的门牙彼此较量。族群首领的门牙往往最大也最锋利。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME use their giant fangs to compete. The leader of a pack of POKENAME often have the largest and sharpest fangs.

entry: POKENAME顽强难缠，吃起东西破坏力惊人，有时被称为“害兽之王”。关都屋顶漏雨，头号祸首就是它啃坏了瓦片。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are sometimes called "apex vermin" due to their tenacity and destructive eating habits. POKENAME chewing through roofing tiles is the leading cause of roof leaks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME常一边飞，一边啃石头磨牙。石块也常从嘴里掉下，砸中路人脑袋的事，已经发生过许多次。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME can often be seen gnawing on rocks mid-flight to whittle down its fangs. It is not uncommon for it to drop these rocks, and there have been many occasions where the falling rocks have hit people in the head.

entry: 人们普遍认为POKENAME十分危险，却也有一小群爱好者很喜欢照顾它们。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME is generally considered a very dangerous Pokémon. There is, however, a niche community that greatly enjoys caring for them.

entry: POKENAME极其珍爱背上的奶酪拼盘。就算只是看它的眼神不对，手上也可能狠狠挨一口。
author: patch
source: POKENAME heavily values the cheese platter on its back. Even just looking at it the wrong way can result in a nasty bite to the hand.

entry: POKENAME夜里在巷中闻到餐馆的饭香后，曾持剑胁迫店员，把食物抢走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has held restaurant employees at sword-point to steal the food it smells from the alleyways at night.

entry: 这只机灵的啮齿类宝可梦以高智商闻名。会用爪子和手状缎带解开遇到的各种谜题，需要格外用心照顾。
author: melodydelune
source: Known for its high IQ, this crafty rodent Pokémon uses its paws and hand-ribbons to solve various puzzles it finds. It requires extra attention.

entry: POKENAME会收集死去的啮齿动物的灵魂。据说向它供奉奶酪，就能让家中免受鼠患。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME collects the soul of every rodent that meets its end. It is said that offering it tributes of cheese keeps one's home free from pests.

entry: 不知为何，这种融合体总有四只草苗龟相伴，每只都戴着颜色不同的头巾。见到它们围在一起吃披萨，也不是什么稀罕事。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: For some reason, this fusion is accompanied by four Turtwigs, each with a different color of headband. It's not uncommon to see them eating pizza.

entry: POKENAME收集树果、草药和其他宝可梦的粪便，投入背上的大锅，调成致命的毒药。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME collects berries, herbs, and droppings from other Pokémon to add to the cauldron on its back. The toxic mix makes a deadly poison.

entry: POKENAME用花朵般的身体作为天然伪装，既能躲避天敌，也能蒙骗猎物。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its flower-like body as natural camouflage, both to hide itself from predators and to deceive its prey.

entry: POKENAME能用颈间圆珠唤来浓雾，让月亮染红，借不祥的气氛吓退可能的威胁。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME can use the orb around its neck to summon fog and turn the moon red. It uses this foreboding atmosphere to unnerve potential threats.

entry: 据说POKENAME走到哪里，就将不幸带到哪里。浅色皮毛根根竖起时，便是在与彼岸沟通。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to carry misfortune wherever they go. If this Pokémon's light fur stands on end, it is said to be communicating with the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME在宝石与颊囊中储存魔力。多只聚在一起时，就能在辽阔的区域内制造强大的幻象。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME stores magical power in its gems and cheek pouches. When multiple gather together, they can create powerful illusions over vast areas.

entry: 胆小的POKENAME会用幽灵之力吓退入侵者。可对方若不怕幻象，它反倒马上害怕起来。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The timid POKENAME uses its spectral powers to scare off intruders, though it quickly becomes terrified of those who resist its illusions.

entry: POKENAME优雅又顽皮，只向自己认可的人现身。据说惹它不快，就会招来千年诅咒。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Elegant and impish, POKENAME only reveal themselves to those they believe are worthy. Making one displeased is said to bring a thousand-year curse.

entry: POKENAME以幽怨的叫声和阴森火焰惊吓踏入领地的人。得逞后，火焰便烧得更亮。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its haunting cries and ghastly flame to scare those who wander through its territory. Its flame brightens when it succeeds.

entry: POKENAME是栖息在古老森林深处的幽灵宝可梦，喜欢残忍的玩笑。它们模仿人声，诱导训练家走错方向，让人迷失深林，几乎无望归家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Ghost-type Pokémon found deep in ancient forests, POKENAME has a cruel sense of humor. They delight in misleading Trainers with the sounds of other people, leaving them lost and confused with little hope of getting home.

entry: 乌云低垂却迟迟不下雨的日子，高空会传来POKENAME的啜泣。据说，它携带的宝石里，藏着早逝者被遗忘的梦。
author: ozydamians
source: On days when dark clouds hang heavy in the sky but no rain falls, the sobbing cry of POKENAME can be heard high above. The jewels it carries are said to contain the forgotten dreams of those who passed too young.

entry: POKENAME爱在神社与墓园附近游荡。据说若有POKENAME偷走供品，便是不祥之兆。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around shrines and graveyards. It's believed that a POKENAME stealing an offering left there is a bad omen.

entry: 受威胁时，它不放臭气，而会让神秘文字的闪烁影像直接浮现在对手脑海。它似乎不进食。
author: bombboyxd
source: Rather than releasing foul odors when threatened, it sends flashing images of mysterious characters into its opponent's head. It doesn't seem to eat.

entry: POKENAME自认为是古代遗迹的守护者。可惜它们总爱对入侵者自爆，往往反而造成更严重的破坏。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME consider themselves protectors of ancient ruins. Tragically, their tendency to explode on intruders means they often cause greater harm.

entry: 眼睛才是本体。受威胁时会从保护壳中弹射出去，若逃不掉，就会爆炸。
author: griddle
source: The eye is its true body. When threatened, it will eject itself from its protective shell. If it can't get away, it explodes.

entry: 一种守护意识古怪的古老生物。察觉有人进入栖身之处，便会用眼睛锁定对方并发动攻击。
author: theheroict
source: An ancient being that has a strange sense of protection. When it senses someone in its home, it locks onto them with its eyes and attacks.

entry: 视力不好，让人类和宝可梦都误以为POKENAME很弱。可POKENAME的眼球蕴含庞大的超能力，连汽车都能轻易压碎，想捕捉它的人，往往下场凄惨。
author: sottiwotti
source: People and Pokémon think POKENAME is weak because of its poor eyesight, but POKENAME's eyeball contains a lot of psychic energy. It can easily crush a car with its powers, and people who try to catch it often meet a terrible fate.

entry: POKENAME吐出的烟雾里能看到数千只眼睛。没人知道它们属于谁，也没人知道它们在寻找什么。
author: griddle
source: Thousands of eyes can be seen in the smoke emitted by POKENAME. No one knows who the eyes belong to, or what they're looking for.

entry: 吸入POKENAME气体的人会看见惊人幻象。受害者总会描述一片广阔的灰色天空，其中布满多如繁星的眼睛。
author: griddle
source: Those who inhale POKENAME's gas witness startling visions. Victims of it always describe a vast grey sky, filled with as many eyes as there are stars.

entry: POKENAME的四肢柔韧得像橡胶软管。它会用这些肢体逗乐大人和孩子。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's limbs have all the flexibility of a rubber hose. It uses these limbs to entertain children and adults alike.

entry: 独角虫的鼻子变成了一只眼睛，能异常敏锐地追踪威胁。它们常聚在一起，排出神秘的信息。
author: bombboyxd
source: Weedle's nose has been replaced with an eye that seems to track threats exceptionally well. Its often found in groups making mysterious messages.

entry: 无法移动的POKENAME常待在高高的树上，紧盯一切可能的危险，等待终将来临的进化。
author: bombboyxd
source: Immobile POKENAME will often sit high in trees, staring at any potential danger as it waits for its inevitable evolution.

entry: POKENAME的眼柄不停扭动挥舞，永无止境地寻找值得捕捉的猎物，只有猎食成功后才会安静下来。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's eyestalks constantly writhe and thrash in its endless search for worthy prey; they're only at rest after a successful hunt.

entry: 它的领地意识不如大针蜂强，却常会守护废弃神庙，驱赶入侵者。为什么这么做，至今无人知晓。
author: bombboyxd
source: While less territorial than Beedrill, it will often spend its time defending ruined temples from intruders. It's not known why it does this.

entry: 它像融合前的宝可梦一样温顺。受到威胁时，就会让对手看见奇怪的幻象，或扬起沙子，趁机退走。
author: bombboyxd
source: It is docile like its unfused counterparts. If threatened, it will send strange visions or throw sand at its opponent before retreating.

entry: POKENAME能精准辨时，分秒不差。头羽随着身边漂浮的刻度旋转，推算种种事件，随后又回到当下的时间。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to tell the time down to the second. The feathers on their head spin around along the ticks that float around them to calculate various events before returning to the present time.

entry: 没人知道这种融合体如何进食。科学家只见过它残忍地伏击猎物，再将其拖往视线之外。巢穴周围，还常留着奇怪的符号。
author: bombboyxd
source: It's unknown how this fusion eats, but scientists have noted its cruelty when it ambushes its prey before taking them out of sight. It often leaves strange symbols around its nest.

entry: 祭司们注意到，它的外貌仿佛带着神性。它不进食，却常以2马赫的速度逼近其他宝可梦，再骤然停下，直勾勾地盯着对方。
author: bombboyxd
source: Priests have noted its divine-looking form. While it doesn't eat, it often approaches Pokémon at Mach 2 before stopping to stare at them.

entry: POKENAME似乎从不睡觉，总用眼睛搜寻附近的材料，既拿来筑巢，也留下奇怪的标记。
author: bombboyxd
source: It doesn't seem to sleep. Instead, POKENAME uses its eyes to find sufficient materials to make both strange markings and its nests in its vicinity.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会把未知王那些眼睛般的蛋，顶在头部的柄状突起上。科学家推测，这种行为能提高它的存活机会。
author: filteredtea
source: A young POKENAME carries the eye-like eggs of Unsire on its head stalks. Scientists theorize this behavior increases its odds of survival.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME用超能力改造湖泊池塘来筑巢。为了保护幼崽，它们会表现得极为凶狠。
author: filteredtea
source: POKENAME have been seen terraforming lakes and ponds with their psychic powers to make their nests. They defend their young with fierce hostility.

entry: 初次发现POKENAME时，人们以为它是月亮伊布的罕见变异。可研究没多久，眼睛就从它的纹饰中伸了出来。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME was thought to be a rare mutation of Umbreon upon initial discovery. After a short time studying it, eyes protruded from its markings.

entry: 这种POKENAME比其他同族更像人。它时不时会默默演出无人知晓的剧目，原因众说纷纭。
author: bombboyxd
source: This variation of POKENAME seems more human-like than others of its species. Periodically, it silently acts out unknown plays; the reason is debated.

entry: 它常沐浴在阳光下。有人认为，黑叶飘动是在尝试交流，可它想说什么，仍不清楚。
author: bombboyxd
source: It often spends its time in the sunlight. Some interpret the fluttering of its black leaf as an attempt to communicate, but its meaning is unknown.

entry: POKENAME硕大的眼睛让许多人望而生畏。它明明没有牙齿，却仍本能地啃咬东西，常把自己的眼睛弄伤。
author: bombboyxd
source: Many are put off by POKENAME's large eye. While it has no teeth, its natural instinct to gnaw often leaves it with ocular injuries.

entry: 一群未知图腾似乎特地聚在一起，想与人类交流。可惜，它们想表达什么，依然无人知晓。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of Unown appear to have gathered together in an attempt to communicate with humans. Unfortunately, what they are trying to say remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME巢穴四周，散落着被它猎杀的生物遗骸，每一具旁边都环绕着神秘符号。奇怪的是，遗骸似乎全都未被吃过。
author: bombboyxd
source: Around the nests of POKENAME are the remains of the prey it has hunted and defeated, each surrounded by mysterious symbols. Strangely, none appear to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME被视为未知图腾最强的形态之一。外貌让人想起名为“未知图腾之王”的古老传说。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is considered to be one of the strongest forms of Unown. Its appearance is reminiscent of an old legend known as "The Unown King".

entry: 谁在世上何处入睡，它的眼睛都看得见；谁醒着，超能力也能感知。POKENAME凭这两项本领，判断人们的善恶。
author: griddle
source: Its eye can see when anyone in the world is sleeping. Its psychic power lets it know when someone is awake. POKENAME uses both to judge people's morality.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛便于在栖息的草原上搜寻食物，可它却常显得营养不良。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's large eye allows it to effectively search the grasslands of its habitat for food. However, it is often seen to be physically malnourished.

entry: 它放弃鲜艳的颜料，改用醒目的黑墨。书法间会跃出未知图腾，借力量让POKENAME写下的字句化为现实。
author: griddle
source: It has traded its vibrant colour palette for striking black ink. Unown spring from its calligraphy, bringing POKENAME's words to life with their power.

entry: POKENAME会在遗迹墙上画下抽象涂鸦。人们从画中发现了一些规律，有人坚称其中藏有奇怪的密码。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME will mark ruin walls with abstract graffiti. Patterns have been discovered in its paintings, which some insist include strange codes.

entry: 放电留下的痕迹与焦印，会形成酷似文字的图案。
author: staghorn
source: The tracks and burns created by its electrical discharges form patterns that resemble text characters.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦极为凶暴。奇怪的是，颈部皮膜上的眼睛真的看得见；POKENAME受到威胁，它们便一齐怒视敌人。
author: bombboyxd
source: This fusion is brutally vicious. Strangely, the eyes of its neck flap are functional, and if POKENAME is threatened, they will glare at the foe.

entry: 曾有研究者误把这只融合宝可梦当作水君的壁画。没人真正见过POKENAME移动，因为它只在你眨眼时奔跑和攻击。
author: griddle
source: A researcher once mistook this fusion for a wall mural of Suicune. Nobody has actually seen POKENAME move; it runs and attacks only when you blink.

entry: 它栖身在常有雷暴的遗迹中。从它传出的心灵讯息判断，它对闪电近乎狂热地崇拜。
author: bombboyxd
source: It spends its time in ruins that are regularly near thunderstorms. The psychic messages it sends shows that it holds lightning in a fanatical regard.

entry: 地面上刻出的仪式圆阵，是辨认POKENAME巢穴的线索。至于这些圆阵有何用途，至今无人知晓。
author: griddle
source: One can identify an POKENAME's den by the ritual circles it carves into the ground. The purpose of these circles is a mystery to all.

entry: 它爱好谜团，常与小说家相伴。许多作家把POKENAME看作最忠实的书迷，也是最苛刻的评论家。
author: griddle
source: It loves a mystery, and can frequently be found in the company of novelists. Many writers regard POKENAME as their biggest fan and harshest critic.

entry: POKENAME常与其他幼年宝可梦待在一起。欢笑与喜悦能增强它的超能力。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME is frequently found in the company of other baby Pokémon. Its psychic powers are strengthened by laughter and joy.

entry: 未知丘遭极其猛烈的雷击，便会变成POKENAME。电力充足时，瞳孔会泛起刺眼的黄光。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME is created when an Unchu is struck by incredibly strong lightning. If fully charged, the pupils on its eyes glow a harsh yellow.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能在黑夜里看得一清二楚，却也格外容易患雪盲症，因此十分畏惧阳光。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's eye gives it flawless night vision, but makes it uniquely vulnerable to snow blindness. It lives in fear of the sun as a result.

entry: 它从炮管射出未知图腾，把攻击拼成文字。强大的POKENAME能打出整句，最强的甚至能打出押韵的诗句。
author: griddle
source: It shoots Unown from its cannons, spelling its attacks. Strong POKENAME have been known to fire sentences; the strongest will actually fire rhymes.

entry: POKENAME挖的洞和穿山鼠一样深。不过，洞壁上还刻着奇怪的标记，谁也读不懂。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's burrows are as deep as Sandshrew's are, but it was discovered that the walls of these burrows contain strange, unreadable markings.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺并非皮肤组织，似乎与洞中的标记有所关联，看起来简直像一则信息。
author: bombboyxd
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back aren't hide, though they appear to be connected to the markings in their burrows. They almost seem to be a message.

entry: 这种POKENAME比同族更具金属质感。背后的黑色附肢能伸出去，把倒霉的家伙刺穿，钉在坚硬的背上。
author: bombboyxd
source: This POKENAME is more metallic than others of its species. The black limbs on its rear can reach to impale unlucky others onto its hard back.

entry: POKENAME的角被眼睛取代，失去了原本御敌的主要武器。作为补偿，感知能力似乎敏锐得惊人。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's horn has been displaced by its eye, depriving it of its main defence against aggressors. In return, it seems to have incredible senses.

entry: 据说，一部作品发表时若恰有108处拼写错误，就会诞生POKENAME。人们常用这故事吓唬粗心的学生。
author: griddle
source: It's said POKENAME are created when a written work with exactly 108 spelling errors is published. It's commonly used to scare inattentive students.

entry: 科学家发现，POKENAME在日光下休息时，黑色字符便会传递一则信息。究竟是什么意思，依然是谜。
author: bombboyxd
source: Scientists have noted that POKENAME's black characters convey a message when it relaxes in the sun. What it means remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME头形奇特，却意外地不妨碍日常生活。整个身体仿佛组成了一个古怪的符号。
author: bombboyxd
source: Surprisingly, the unique shape of POKENAME's head does not appear to affect its daily life. Its body seems to resemble an odd symbol.

entry: 身体是个空心外壳。人们将物品交给POKENAME保管，取回时只需轻轻摇晃它。它似乎并不介意。
author: griddle
source: Its body is a hollow shell. People will give POKENAME items for safekeeping and then gently shake it to retrieve them. It doesn't seem to mind this.

entry: 它在海底散落的摇篮百合石化残骸中安家。虽然常被误解，其实它毫无恶意，只是害羞。
author: griddle
source: This fusion makes its home in the petrified remains of Cradily littering the seafloor. Contrary to popular belief, it's not malevolent; it's just shy.

entry: 它们用砸碎的未知图腾残片装饰身体，研究者把这些战利品称为“断字”。佩有最大“断字”的POKENAME便是首领。
author: griddle
source: They adorn themselves with smashed Unown parts; scientists refer to these trophies as 'text breaks'. The POKENAME with the biggest text break leads.

entry: 它是一种形似简陋长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like a rudimentary sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它是一种形似过分繁复的长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like an over-complicated sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它们借飞行的方向与动作交流。发现不喜欢的东西，两副身体便交叉成X形，用超能力将其驱退。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The direction and motion of how their bodies fly aid in their communication. If they see something they don't like, the two bodies will cross into an X-shaped formation and repel it with their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME乍看令人畏惧，一旦信任你，却会变得十分亲切。它的每只眼睛都曾属于一只未知图腾。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is an intimidating Pokémon at first, but once it trusts you, it becomes very kind. Each eye it has once belonged to an Unown.

entry: POKENAME一度被视为神话中的君王，实际担任着墓地的守护者，对闯入者很不友善。
author: inksans201x
source: Once thought to be a mythical ruler, POKENAME acts as a guardian of cemeteries. It is not very fond of trespassers.

entry: 它的视力始终完美无缺。研究者一直研究POKENAME，希望从它身上找到治愈失明的秘密。
author: griddle
source: Its vision is always perfect. Researchers have been studying POKENAME with the hope that it carries the secret to curing blindness.

entry: 虽然它以攻击性强而闻名，研究却发现，它平时会花时间在崖壁上书写奇怪的字符。
author: bombboyxd
source: Though it's known for its aggressive behavior, research has revealed that it spends its time writing strange characters into the side of cliffs.

entry: POKENAME挖出的地洞窄得根本容不下它的头，可它偏偏能在其中穿行，令所有人都百思不解。
author: griddle
source: Nobody knows how POKENAME moves underground, as the holes it makes are too narrow for its head. To the bafflement of all, it traverses them anyways.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME的根扎得有多深。最新研究发现，它的根竟能拼成整整几段文字。
author: griddle
source: No one knows how deep POKENAME's roots go. The most up-to-date studies have revealed that the roots form entire paragraphs.

entry: POKENAME凭超能力，只需对视就能看出一个人拥有多少财富。得到它的青睐，预示着好运降临。
author: griddle
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to discern the wealth of anyone it makes eye contact with. Its favor is a portent of good fortune.

entry: 只要盯住眼睛，POKENAME就会僵在原地。但它极其讨厌对视，你一眨眼或移开目光，它便立刻攻击。
author: griddle
source: It will freeze on the spot if you stare into its eye. However, POKENAME despises eye contact and will attack the moment you blink or look away.

entry: 有旅人说，戳眼睛就能摆脱凶猛的POKENAME。可千万别试，这只会让它更加愤怒。
author: griddle
source: Some travellers say that you can escape an aggressive POKENAME by poking it in the eye. Do not do this; it will only get angrier.

entry: 它身上的眼睛，能看见一切踏入领地的生物。为了保护未知恐龙刻下的图案，它会近乎狂热地喷出黑色火焰。
author: bombboyxd
source: The eyes on its body see all that enters its territory. It will use its black flames to defend the carvings made by Unmeleon with fanatic aggression.

entry: POKENAME的巨眼占体重的85%，让它拥有极佳的浮力。可它的视力却出奇地差，常常摔倒。
author: filteredtea
source: POKENAME's giant eye makes up 85% of its body weight, making it very buoyant. It often falls over due to its surprisingly poor eyesight.

entry: 这种融合体虽连颜色也变了，最引人注目的却是壳上的字符，仿佛暗示着尚未揭开的奥秘。
author: bombboyxd
source: Despite the colour change of this fusion, the most striking change is the characters on its shell that seem to hint at mysteries untold.

entry: POKENAME滚动时能看见未来。可它滚得太快，预言往往过于简略，派不上什么用场。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME has visions of the future when it rolls. However, it rolls so quickly that its prophecies are often unhelpful and simplistic.

entry: 为免感官负荷过重，POKENAME每次只会启用一只眼睛。因此，根本无法判断它正看向哪里。
author: griddle
source: In order to avoid sensory overload, only one of POKENAME's eyes is working at any given time. As a result, it's impossible to tell where it's looking.

entry: 它在田野嬉戏，背上的焦烟随之弥漫。消防员常误以为起火，赶来却只见无害的POKENAME，因此对它颇为头疼。
author: teatedtiten
source: The charred smoke on its back permeates the air as it frolics in fields. Firefighters are annoyed by this Pokémon as they falsely assume there is a fire when it's simply a harmless POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME鲜有记录，更从没人见过它们伸出头来。未知图腾在旁嬉戏飞舞，仿佛是POKENAME梦中浮现的景象。
author: bombboyxd
source: Few POKENAME have been observed in the wild, and none with their head out. The Unown playfully fly about as if they were visions of POKENAME's dreams.

entry: 尾巴依然是长寿的象征，可上面的眼睛让它少了几分美感。胸前的符号，也变得越来越多。
author: bombboyxd
source: Its tail is still seen as a sign of longevity, though the eyes have removed much of its appeal. The symbols on its chest have become more numerous.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩击剑游戏，但黑色尾巴若受伤，就会停下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME enjoys playful swordplay, but if its black tail gets injured, it will stop playing.

entry: POKENAME像根球棒，十分耐打；但若手臂受伤，就会狠狠还击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a bat that can take a beating, and if its arm is hurt, give a beating.

entry: 除了黑色尾巴，POKENAME的整个身体都是投影。凡是被它截获的电磁信号，都会受到严重干扰。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is entirely a projection save for its black tail. It causes any electromagnetic signals it intercepts to become heavily corrupted.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓不断生长，最终遮住眼睛。它便改靠尾巴观察周围。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME's vines grow constantly, eventually covering its eyes. It relies on its tail to see.

entry: POKENAME的各个头共享意识。战斗时轮流上阵，而且每个头都随时做好了准备。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME's consciousness is shared between each head. They all take turns fighting in a battle, and they're all equally ready to fight.

entry: POKENAME操纵尾上的头，精确得惊人，却很少动用双臂。因此，有研究者猜测，尾巴上的才是真正的主头。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: POKENAME controls the head on its tail with surprising precision, but uses its arms sparingly. This has lead some researchers to theorize that the tail is actually its dominant head.

entry: POKENAME借天生可爱的模样，装得小巧又无助，等猎物靠近才出击。体内的毒液，足以让一个小孩麻痹。
author: rakunk
source: Using its naturally adorable appearance, POKENAME pretends to be small and defenseless - luring prey closer before striking. It has enough poison to paralyze a small child.

entry: POKENAME本是杂食，通常却由后头作主，决定吃什么。少数个体两颗头势均力敌，才会荤素兼食。
author: krune
source: Although technically an omnivore, POKENAME's rear head is usually dominant and decides the diet. On rare occasions, the heads are equally dominant, leading to a mixed diet of meat and plants.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME更加依赖多出的头，几乎不再用上半身做任何事。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: After evolving, POKENAME relies even more on its additional heads. It hardly uses its upper body for anything.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛已完全消失，改用手中的球观察四周。将球在双手间抛来抛去，就能看清全貌。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME's eyes have completely disappeared. It instead uses its ball to look around, tossing it from hand to hand to get a full visual.

entry: 许多地方都流传着POKENAME潜入孩子卧房、吸干鲜血的故事。但实际观察中，它们只用毒液制服比自己小得多的猎物。
author: rakunk
source: Various cultures have spun tales of POKENAME sneaking into children's bedrooms to drain their blood. However, despite these myths, POKENAME have only been observed using venom to subdue much smaller prey.

entry: POKENAME的两部分看似是性格迥异的两只宝可梦，却永远无法分开。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: Despite seemingly being two separate Pokémon and having different personalities, the two parts of a POKENAME can never be separated.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃与尾巴天生敌视大多数靠近者。不过，向剑柄那一侧献上素食，就能让它平静下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade and tail are naturally hostile to most who approach it. However, vegetarian offerings to the hilt's side will calm it down.

entry: POKENAME上方多出的头，既能警戒天敌，咬下时还会分泌黏稠毒液。它们也会咬住藤蔓，把身体拉上树，躲到安全处。
author: holgast
source: The extra heads atop POKENAME alert them to predators and secrete a sticky, toxic goo upon biting. The heads also grab onto vines and pull the body up into trees for safety.

entry: POKENAME很受捕虫少年欢迎，粗硬的皮毛能在野外保护它。
author: melodydelune
source: Popular among bug catchers, POKENAME has rough fur that helps to protect it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME对人和宝可梦都慷慨友善。它们喜欢送给人类坚果、树果和水果，分享自然的喜悦。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are very generous and kind to humans and Pokémon alike. They like to give nuts, Berries, and fruit to humans to spread the joys of nature.

entry: 它会用飘带把刀刃般的树皮，粘到中央的黏性部分，迎击来犯者。走投无路时，还会炸散身体，再一点点修复。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its ribbon adds blade-like bark to its sticky center to hit attackers with. As a last resort, it explosively breaks apart and slowly repairs itself.

entry: POKENAME交配前，会挑选最好的结实原木，挖空内部，留待日后养育幼崽。
author: dodoowner_
source: Before mating with others, POKENAME will find the finest and strongest log and hallow it out. It will then raise its young there.

entry: 臂上的刀刃变成了炮管，攻击方式也更难预测。铠甲哪怕受一点损伤，它都会伤心。
author: pokopish
source: The blades on its arms have turned into cannons and its attack patterns have become more unpredictable. Any damage to its armor causes it grief.

entry: 它行动迟缓得很，炮管发射弹丸却快得惊人。只有从下方攻击才能伤到它。
author: chorb33
source: It is incredibly sluggish and slow, but it can fire projectiles surprisingly quickly from its cannons. You can only damage it from the underside.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: 它将冰冻的外壳塑形染色，以此吓退天敌。研究者发现，每个外壳的色调与形状都有细微差别。
author: pokopish
source: It shapes and dyes its frozen shell to deter predators. Researchers note the subtle differences in each shell's hue and form.

entry: POKENAME始终警戒着自己照管的森林。一有入侵者，便从指尖射出脱落的金属甲片。
author: sandguything
source: Ever vigilant of the forests they tend, POKENAME will fire off discarded fragments of their metallic armor from their fingertips at intruders.

entry: 虽然菌菇藏在壳里，POKENAME的孢子仍能感染其他生物。它也能像其他佛烈托斯一样，缩入巨大的钢壳。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although its fungus is hidden by its shell, POKENAME spores can still infect others. It can retract into its large steel shell, like other Forretress.

entry: POKENAME坚固的壳，既能让它浮在水中，也能抵挡危险水生猎手的袭击。货船会小心避开漂浮海面的POKENAME群。
author: caldonb
source: POKENAME's impressive shell is capable of keeping it buoyant, as well as withstanding attacks from dangerous aquatic predators. Cargo ships take care to avoid groups of POKENAME floating on the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME很会讲故事。训练家常到它的洞穴拜访，向它请教丰富的智慧。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME is a great storyteller. Trainers often visit this Pokémon's burrow to learn from its vast wisdom.

entry: POKENAME为何能在洞中穿行得又快又准，研究者仍在探究。它们还会替家族钻出结构精巧的地道。
author: schwaus
source: Researchers are still trying to determine how POKENAME navigate caves with such speed and precision. They have been known to drill elaborate burrows for their families.

entry: POKENAME总用尾巴钻进下水道，让城里的居民头疼不已。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME always drill into sewers with their tails, making them a nuisance for people living in the city.

entry: POKENAME将原石放入粗糙的皮囊，再徒手一点点打磨成蛋形。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME put raw stones into their rough skin pouch. They then slowly polish them into an egg shape by sanding it down with their bare hands.

entry: 遇到威胁时，长枪会笔直钻入地下助它脱身；友好比试时，则会直直钻向挑战者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its lance drills straight down into the ground to escape threats, or straight toward challengers in friendly duels.

entry: POKENAME尾部的发电机能把摄入的地下养分转为强劲电力，再引导电流流遍全身。
author: nellnast42
source: The underground nutrients POKENAME consumes are converted into strong electricity using the generator on its tail, which directs it through its body.

entry: 所有钻头同步旋转时，据说会涌现神秘力量。若它与训练家心意相通、信念足够坚定，钻头便能穿透挡路的一切。
author: elfail0
source: When all of its drills spin in sync, a mysterious power supposedly manifests. It is said that if it and its Trainer put their minds towards a unified purpose with enough determination, its drills can pierce through any obstacle in the way.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尾巴掘地，寻找金属吞食。吃下的金属会强化POKENAME铠甲般的外壳。
author: ecovermination
source: POKENAME uses its drill-shaped tail to burrow for metal to eat. The metal POKENAME consumes strengthens its armor-like shell.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转钻头，让尾巴升温，便于钻穿厚土。炎热的日子，也常见它懒懒地晒太阳，保持身体温暖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME heats up its tail by spinning its drill at high speeds, helping it tunnel through thick soil. It can be seen lazing in the sun on hot days to keep itself warm.

entry: POKENAME用头上的钻尖翻耕泥土，令土壤养分更丰富，再加以食用。
author: melodydelune
source: Using the drill tip on its head, POKENAME tills soil to make it it more nutrient rich for consumption.

entry: 它用尖尾钻进洞壁或洞顶。受了打扰，便迅速飞往别处，再钻个洞藏身。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its pointy tail to burrow into the walls and tops of caves. When it gets disturbed it quickly flies to a new location to burrow.

entry: 这种融合体钻洞快得惊人，数英里厚的坚硬基岩也能穿透。因此，矿工颇爱骑在它背上，指挥它一路开掘。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion is capable of drilling tunnels at incredible speeds, even through miles of solid bedrock. For this reason it became moderately popular among miners, who ride atop it and order it where to dig while it burrows away.

entry: 它以强烈的尖叫辨认洞中道路。受到威胁，就用尾巴钻向敌人。
author: schwaus
source: It navigates through caves with high-powered screeches. When threatened, it will drill into opponents with its tail.

entry: POKENAME看着不起眼，却以突然发狂、袭击无辜训练家而臭名昭著。看见一只，附近往往就藏着一整群。
author: sinistersama
source: Though unassuming, POKENAME are notorious for suddenly getting violent and attacking innocent Trainers. If you see one, a school of them is nearby.

entry: POKENAME在海底形成庞大的群落。整群迁移时，震动甚至可能引发地震。
author: munchyaxolotls
source: POKENAME lives in massive colonies under the sea. When these colonies migrate, the vibrations may cause earthquakes.

entry: 它用头上的巨钻破开猎物的甲壳。触手像直升机旋翼一样甩动，还能让它稍稍浮起。
author: soup1900
source: It uses the giant drill on its head to break any shell on its prey. It is able to hover a little by whipping its tentacles around like a helicopter.

entry: POKENAME很寂寞，在沙漠中四处寻找能和自己做朋友的训练家。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is lonely, so it searches the desert, looking for a Trainer who can be its friend.

entry: 这种POKENAME十分忧伤，藏在干裂的土地缝隙中。只有少数训练家拥有这种模样的POKENAME。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This POKENAME is extremely sad. Only a few Trainers have this variation of POKENAME that hides in the cracks of dry earth.

entry: POKENAME模仿别人时，身上的钻石便会发光。若不移开视线，就会无可抗拒地被它迷住。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME mimics someone, the diamonds on its body start to glow. If you don't look away, you will be inexorably drawn into its mesmerizing charm.

entry: 钻石构成的爪子，能轻易切开钢铁般坚固的金属。极其结实的外壳也为它提供保护。
author: chorb33
source: Its claws are made of diamonds, allowing it to easily cut through metals as strong as steel. It is similarly protected by an incredibly sturdy shell.

entry: 世界上一些最深的洞穴，就是POKENAME用钻尾挖出来的。它们的遗传物质不稳定，据说能在体表生成各种矿物。
author: markusknight
source: Some of the deepest caverns in the world are known to be dug by POKENAME's drilling tail. Their genetic material is unstable and is said to produce various minerals on the surface of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME体内压力极高，必须释放猛烈火焰降温。背上奇异的晶体，即使不直接碰到火，也能升至700度。
author: mistymagius
source: The extreme internal pressure acting on POKENAME's body causes it to release intense flames to cool off. The unique crystals on its back can reach 700 degrees without direct contact with the flames.

entry: 白天是钢铁雕像，夜里却飞行迅捷，这只宝可梦让人费解不已。重达400公斤，究竟怎样飞起来，至今无人知晓。
author: fr34kuency
source: A steel statue at daytime, a swift flier at night, this Pokémon has confused many a person. Weighing 400 kg, it is unknown how it is able to fly.

entry: POKENAME乘磁场滑行，以钢翼灵活急转，飞行迅疾而无声。
author: cybresamurai
source: POKENAME glides on magnetic fields, steering sharply with its steel wings in silent and swift flight.

entry: 它在地下高速钻进，身体能承受极高压力。传闻曾有城市因它而消失。
author: houndrys.
source: It drills underground at high speeds. Its body allows it to resist the highest pressures. It has been rumored to cause the disappearance of cities.

entry: 它的晶体，成分近似未经提炼的超级石。人们因此推测，它始终处于一种类似超级进化的状态。
author: staghorn
source: Its crystals have a similar composition to unrefined Mega Stones. It is theorized to be in a constant state of something similar to Mega Evolution as a result.

entry: 大地磨亮了POKENAME的金属外壳与水晶尾巴。据说，POKENAME尾尖由最纯粹的能量构成，历经无数岁月，才淬炼而成。
author: swagouille
source: The earth has polished POKENAME's metallic exterior and crystalline tail. The tip of POKENAME's tail is said to be formed from the purest energy, honed over countless years.

entry: POKENAME用爪子施加惊人压力，制造钻石粉尘，再将粉尘卷起，用来磨利身体或攻击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can exert incredible pressure with its claws. This creates diamond dust, which it whirls around to sharpen its body or to attack.

entry: POKENAME背上能长出美丽又坚韧的水晶刺，战斗时将其射出。沉重的尾巴也挥得异常灵巧，转眼便能击退敌人或窃贼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to create beautiful yet durable crystal spines along their back and launch them out during battle. POKENAME wield their heavy tails with surprising dexterity, smacking away any foes or thieves in an instant.

entry: 民间传说，艾路雷朵会深入洞穴，击败大钢蛇，再用它的遗骸锻造武器。
author: mundane_frog
source: Folklore says that a Gallade will travel deep into a cave and defeat a Steelix.  The Gallade will then forge its weapon with the remains.

entry: POKENAME有“活体无畏舰”之称，叫声如战号，连陆地上都能听见。它游动时，碰上它便会致命。
author: jokerswild
source: Nicknamed "The Living Dreadnought", POKENAME bellow a warhorn-like call that can be heard from land. Coming into contact with one swimming is deadly.

entry: POKENAME的身体坚不可摧，连地心的酷热也能承受。动作虽慢，冲锋的力量却足以撞碎巨石。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME's body is impenetrable and can withstand the heat of the planet's core. Although slow, it can charge with enough power to break boulders.

entry: POKENAME用巨爪把大块岩石从岩壁中拔出，再以惊人的力气投向对手，砸个粉碎。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses its massive claws to pull huge boulders out of the wall. It throws these with enormous strength to crush its opponents.

entry: POKENAME刚进化时会离群独居，独自锻炼、打磨身体，并拼死保护自己的鬃毛。
author: ethewriter
source: POKENAME seclude themselves away when they first evolve. They train and polish their body alone, protecting their manes with their lives.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由经过淬炼的钢构成，能承受极高温度。巨锤击中的一切，都会被点燃。
author: kduffradio
source: The tempered steel that makes up POKENAME's armor can withstand extremely high temperatures. It sets ablaze anything it strikes with its large hammer.

entry: 与布鲁不同，POKENAME会模仿怒犬四处跑，专门吓唬小型宝可梦与孩子。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike a Snubbull, POKENAME runs around mimicking an angry dog, scaring small Pokémon and children.

entry: POKENAME极其自私，看见甜食，就毫不犹豫地偷走。若没拿到自己认为应得的那份，还会大发脾气。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an extremely selfish Pokémon who will steal any sweet treat it can find without hesitation. It will throw a tantrum if it doesn't get the sweets it thinks it deserves.

entry: POKENAME虽常大喊大叫、龇牙咧嘴，却既不危险也不好斗，很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME often shouts and grimaces, it is neither dangerous nor aggressive. It is a popular Pokémon for rookie Trainers.

entry: POKENAME争强好斗，常蓬起羽毛、张开翅膀，想显得更吓人。它们争抢树梢向阳的位置，败者只好待在下层枝头。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are rather argumentative, puffing up their feathers and spreading their wings to try and appear more intimidating. They fight over sunny spots in the treetops, leaving those that lose the fights to stay on the lower branches.

entry: POKENAME是一只贪玩的小小鸟宝可梦，谁一靠近，就想拉对方玩捉迷藏。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very playful tiny bird Pokémon. It will attempt to play hide and seek with anyone coming near.

entry: POKENAME自以为高同伴一等，总爱欺负同群成员，甚至威逼它们交出食物，任其挨饿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will constantly bully other members of its flock, thinking itself superior. It will even threaten its flock members into giving up their food, leaving them to starve.

entry: 它会混进烈雀群中，趁对方不注意，偷走食物。POKENAME一生中，只长得出少数几根钢羽。
author: mistymagius
source: It will disguise itself amongst flocks of Spearow, planning on taking their food while their unaware. POKENAME only produce a couple of steel feathers in their lifetime.

entry: POKENAME重得无法飞行，却是敏捷的短跑高手。即便被天敌抓住，对方也很难突破它的甲片。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, but it is an agile sprinter. Even predators that catch it will have trouble getting through its plating.

entry: 它很容易发怒，谁若闯入领地，就会被它啄个不停。
author: melodydelune
source: Quick to aggravate, this Pokémon will incessantly peck at anyone who wanders into its territory.

entry: 翅上的羽毛入水后会拢在一起，让POKENAME当作鳍使用。短腿划水也能帮它加速。
author: chorb33
source: The feathers of its wings clump together in the water so that POKENAME can use them as fins. It can also pedal with its stubby legs to accelerate.

entry: 受到细心照料的POKENAME，对训练家忠诚无比。它常凭顽强意志，撑着战斗到最后一刻。
author: inksans201x
source: When raised with care, POKENAME is fiercely loyal to it's Trainer, oftentimes willing itself to keep fighting until the very end.

entry: POKENAME的嘴虽然巨大，含东西时却柔软又轻柔，连蛋放进去也不会破。它们常这样叼着自己的蛋，护着运走。
author: sontyp
source: Its huge mouth is actually so soft and gentle that a POKENAME can keep an egg in it without it being damaged. This goes so far that POKENAME often transport their eggs this way to guard them.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙极重，任其长得太长，连头都会歪向一边。因此，它会拿树干磨牙。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME has very heavy fangs that cause its head to tilt to one side if left to grow too much. Therefore, it will file its fangs down on trees.

entry: POKENAME常被用来看守废品场等地方。但它们性情懒散，大多只是叫得凶，却不怎么咬人。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly used as guards for junkyards and similar establishments. However, their lax personalities mean most are more bark than bite.

entry: 这是颚部最发达的宝可梦之一。咬合的力量，几乎能一口咬碎任何东西。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: This is one of the Pokémon with the most-developed jaws. It has a strength that allows it to break almost anything with an single bite.

entry: POKENAME比外貌看起来更亲人，也很容易受惊。一旦吓着，就会在恐惧中横冲直撞。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is much cuddlier than its looks might suggest. They are easily startled and, when spooked, it will take off on a fear-fueled rampage.

entry: POKENAME的小屋由极其坚固的黑曜石和火山岩筑成。发达的下颚能轻松咬碎各种岩石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's hut is made of incredibly robust obsidian and volcanic rock. With its well-developed lower jaw, it effortlessly crushes any rock.

entry: POKENAME全身长满锋利的毒羽。训练家常见它将羽毛射向靠得太近的宝可梦。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME grows sharp toxic feathers all across its body. Trainers often see POKENAME launching its feathers at Pokémon that get too close.

entry: 猎物还没游近，POKENAME便已知道它何时会来。它在海面上飞行，掌握着俯冲捕食的最佳时机。
author: dodoowner_
source: It knows when prey will come before they even swim near POKENAME. It flies above the sea, knowing the perfect time to swoop down and catch its food.

entry: POKENAME全身长满带毒的短刺。饲养POKENAME的训练家必须小心接触，以免被刺伤。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are covered in short toxic quills. Trainers that own a POKENAME must handle them with care to avoid getting pricked.

entry: 靠近野生POKENAME，身上就会突然传来尖锐的刺痛。因此，有人把它们视为不祥之兆。
author: jackskipper
source: A sharp sting will hit your body when you are near a wild POKENAME. Because of these harmful interactions, they are considered bad omens by some.

entry: POKENAME能拔下毒刺，叼在嘴里，再借水柱将其射向猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can detach its poisonous quills, hold one in its mouth, and launch it at prey with a jet of water.

entry: POKENAME的乳房里既存着奶，也存着毒液。农夫前来挤奶时，往往会被喷一脸毒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME keep both toxins and milk in their udders. If a farmer comes up to milk it, they get splatted in the face with poison.

entry: POKENAME恶意十足，会故意让自己讨厌的家伙，承受难忍的剧烈刺痛。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME are nothing short of malicious. They will purposefully affect those they dislike with a horrible stinging feeling.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁间，用捡来的珊瑚碎片伪装自己。它能用壳上的尖刺，将毒液注入捕食者体内。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live amongst coral reefs and use pieces of coral it finds as camouflage. It uses the quills on its shell to inject poison into predators.

entry: 据说POKENAME是被千针鱼毒死、痛苦身亡的渔夫之魂。它会钩住大批水生宝可梦，并使其毒发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Said to be the spirit of a fisherman painfully killed by a Qwilfish's poison, POKENAME hooks and poisons mass amounts of aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只在攻击或进食时打开外壳。外壳与甲片的颜色并不固定。
author: krune
source: POKENAME only open their shell when they are attacking or eating. The color of the shell and carapace can vary.

entry: POKENAME本领多样，既能用钳子击倒树木，也能用角撞碎巨石。
author: incognito1234
source: A highly versatile Pokémon, POKENAME is able to use its pincers to knock down trees and its horns to destroy boulders.

entry: POKENAME如同活兵器，一旦动起来便几乎势不可挡。可碰上崎岖地形，又特别容易卡住。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is a living weapon, nigh unstoppable once it starts moving. However, it's very susceptible to getting stuck on uneven terrain.

entry: POKENAME上半身的铠甲虽然不含铁，仍然十分坚硬。腹部却毫无保护。
author: faelocke
source: The armor covering POKENAME's upper body contains no iron, but is still remarkably hard. Its stomach is unprotected, however.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由昆虫几丁质天然形成，不仅极其轻盈，而且像钢铁一样坚硬。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade is naturally formed out of ultralight insect chitin that is also as hard as steel.

entry: 尾巴上的钳子攻守兼备。POKENAME控火十分娴熟，能用钳子充当火焰喷射器。
author: codewolfie
source: The pincers on its tails act as both defense and offense. POKENAME is very skilled with their fire, using its pincers as flamethrowers.

entry: POKENAME常无忧无虑地四处飘荡。有人说，那是毒素侵入了它的脑子。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is often seen floating about without a care in the world. Some say the toxins got to its brain.

entry: POKENAME在繁茂的丛林中，用蘑菇伪装自己。平日几乎一动不动，偶尔才吃点树果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME camouflages itself with mushrooms in lush jungles. It usually stays motionless, occasionally eating berries.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME体内流动的毒素严重伤害了身体。它最终可能病重得无法作战，渐渐衰亡。
author: dodoowner_
source: After evolving, toxins flowing through POKENAME's body seriously damaged it. This Pokémon may eventually get too sick to fight and wilt away.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成椒盐卷饼，引来灰尘山、小拉达等宝可梦捕食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often preyed upon by Pokémon such as Garbodor and Rattata, as it is commonly mistaken for a pretzel.

entry: POKENAME用威风凛凛的外形吓跑天敌，好安心酿造果汁。据说酿出的汁液尝起来像葡萄酒。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME takes advantage of its imposing shape to scare away predators so it can brew its juice in peace. This juice supposedly tastes akin to wine.

entry: 它不停分泌黏液，使身体不怕进水。对孩子十分友善，无论如何都会把保护他们放在首位。
author: skymaster426
source: It secretes mucus constantly, which allows it to stay waterproof. It is very friendly around children and will protect them above all else.

entry: POKENAME是杂食性宝可梦，会先用带刺的壳捶打食物，再吞下碎屑，与体液混合成咸甜的汁液。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is omnivorous and beats its food with its spiky shell. It eats what's left, mixing with its bodily fluids to create a sweet and savory juice.

entry: POKENAME既能翻耕土地，又能用吃下的树果分解后的残渣施肥，对农夫而言是难得的帮手。
author: larkus
source: POKENAME is incredibly valuable to farmers due to its ability to till land and fertilize it with the decomposed remnants of the Berries it eats.

entry: POKENAME聚在深林里，吸食树汁与花蜜，用角集中超能力。大群一同施力，便能让林地扭转成离奇梦境，再用怪异现象与幻术，守住这片天地。
author: alkazamis
source: POKENAME gather deep in forests to sip sweet sap and nectar. They focus their psychic powers using their horns. Swarms of them warp their woodland realms into surreal dreamscapes, which they protect with freaky phenomena and bizarre illusions.

entry: 野生POKENAME会聚在印记树林，吸食树干内部的汁液。它能用耳朵察觉危险。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME gather together in the Tagtree Thicket and drink the sap inside of trees. It can sense danger with its ears.

entry: POKENAME常互相争斗至筋疲力尽，借此锻炼角的坚韧程度。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME can often be seen fighting one another to exhaustion in order to increase the durability of their horns.

entry: 只有吃得饱饱的POKENAME，身上缠绕的金藤才会隐约带着蜜味。想来啃甜藤的害虫，都得先过它强壮身体这一关。
author: bobosmith01
source: The golden vines laced around its body taste vaguely of honey, but only when POKENAME is well-fed. It uses its powerful body to defend itself against pests wanting to nibble on its sweet vines.

entry: POKENAME的背又宽又平，成了绝佳擂台。常在那里开打的，便是怒气冲冲的赫拉克罗斯与凯罗斯。
author: incognito1234
source: Possessing a large, flat back, POKENAME have become perfect places for fights. Usually, this is between angry Heracross and Pinsir.

entry: POKENAME用巨力放倒树木，吸取甘甜的树液。若进食时被打扰，它也会退而求其次，吸走来袭者的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fells trees with tremendous force to absorb their sweet sap. It will settle for an attacker's life force if disturbed while eating.

entry: POKENAME有森林英雄之称，会灵巧地在树间跳跃，巡视有无危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known as heroes of the forest. They nimbly leap from tree to tree scouting for danger.

entry: POKENAME用引以为傲的角，掀翻披着重甲的宝可梦，再以强颚咬破柔软的腹部。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME uses its prized horn to flip over heavily-armored Pokémon. It then uses its powerful jaws to break though the softer underbelly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢长时间静伏不动。毫无戒心的猎物一靠近，它便弹出角状的肢体。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME prefers to lie dormant for long periods of time. When unsuspecting prey approaches, it shoots out its horn-like appendage.

entry: POKENAME借包裹身体的液体，吸收找到的蜂蜜充饥。吃得太多，身体也会鼓胀起来。
author: incognito1234
source: Using the liquid surrounding its body, POKENAME absorbs any honey it finds as food. This can cause it to swell when it obtains too much.

entry: POKENAME找到大量蜂蜜，就紧紧附在上面，用满身尖刺驱赶天敌。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME locates large honey sources and then sticks to them, warding off predators with its many spikes.

entry: POKENAME十分顽皮，爱用角戳人，随后迅速消失无踪。
author: incognito1234
source: A mischievous creature, POKENAME like to poke humans with its horn before quickly disappearing.

entry: POKENAME很固执，常试图举起比自身重好几倍的东西，结果往往失败。
author: incognito1234
source: A very stubborn Pokémon, POKENAME is usually seen trying to lift objects many times its own weight, oftentimes failing.

entry: 它崇拜赫拉克罗斯和强大的斗士。即使笨拙地模仿它们的招式，凭着扬起的毒粉，攻击仍然有效。
author: pokepower
source: It idolizes Heracross and great fighters. Even its clumsy imitations of their moves are effective, thanks to the toxic powder it kicks up.

entry: 它在海底疾行，很少露出水面。没人知道壳里究竟藏着什么。
author: krune
source: It scurries along the bottom of the sea, rarely seen above water. Nobody knows what is inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知水流，辨认环境与其他宝可梦。看触角的大小，还能判断POKENAME的年龄与性别。
author: krune
source: POKENAME use their antennae to feel the current in the water, in order to discern their surroundings and sense other Pokémon. The size of the antennae determine the age and gender of a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能发出多种类似笑声的叫声。头部带角的甲片，形状与大小各不相同。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have a variety of vocalizations they can make that sound like laughter. The horned plating on its head comes in different shapes and sizes.

entry: 它们天生甘愿当手下，会聚到附近最强的个体身边。只要能捣乱，就会勤勤恳恳地执行命令。
author: jackythewannabe
source: Natural-born underlings, they flock to the strongest individual nearby. They follow orders diligently as long as it causes mischief.

entry: 它们寻找其他宝可梦的巢，合力打败亲代，再把双亲连同蛋，一并吃下。
author: darkweavile428
source: They seek out the nests of Pokémon and work together to defeat the parents. Once their prey is defeated, they eat both the parents and their eggs.

entry: POKENAME有锋利的爪子，能在坚冰上疾奔。它本可以是出色的雪橇宝可梦，却坚决不肯套上挽具。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME have sharp claws that allow them to sprint on solid ice. They would make excellent sled Pokémon, but they will not tolerate being harnessed.

entry: POKENAME守在阴影里，用灵活伸缩的刀刃撬开无人看守的蛋，或撕开无力防备的猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: After waiting in the shadows, POKENAME uses its dexterous, retractable blades to crack open unguarded eggs or rip into vulnerable victims.

entry: POKENAME热爱犯罪，梦想着帮训练家逃脱法网。要把这种融合宝可梦教得正直善良，非得有最坚定的意志、最纯净的心。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME adores crime, as it cherishes the dream of helping its Trainer get away from the forces of law. It will take the strongest of wills and purest of hearts to raise this fusion in the ways of justice and goodhearted actions.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进三蜜蜂的巢夺蜜，其实是拿蜜把丝线与细枝粘在一起，搭自己的巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid Combee nests for their honey. They actually use the honey to stick silk and twigs together to make their nests.

entry: POKENAME住在高山的森林中，靠敏锐嗅觉寻找满是蜜的蜂巢。找到后，便一再撞树，直到蜂巢掉到林地上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains amongst alpine forests. Using its keen sense of smell it tracks down hives filled with Honey and will ram into the trees until the hive drops to the forest floor.

entry: 酿蜜的虫宝可梦夜里睡熟，POKENAME便趁机远行，寻找最爱的食物。遇上筑着蜂巢的树，它会凭巨力将其推倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Preferring to navigate at night when the Bug types that produce Honey are asleep, POKENAME will travel great distances in search of its favourite food. When it finds a tree housing a nest, it uses its immense strength to topple it.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏欲睡。它睡的枕头，连暴怒的火暴猴都能哄入梦乡。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always very sleepy. The pillow it sleeps on could send even a raging Primeape into slumber.

entry: 它在人面前十分害羞。想与它交朋友，最简单的办法就是送上蜂蜜。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is extremely shy around people. The easiest way to befriend one is to present it with honey.

entry: POKENAME常出现在蜂女王巢穴附近的田野中。它们一心寻找蜂蜜，除此之外什么都不吃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in fields near Vespiquen hives. They are always on the hunt for honey, and will not eat anything other than it.

entry: POKENAME对人友善，是果园与蜂场的好帮手。帮忙采收后，它只求分到一些蜂蜜，作为报酬。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME are very friendly to humans and are great helpers in orchards and apiaries. In exchange for help with harvesting, POKENAME asks for portions of honey as payment.

entry: POKENAME的外貌加上慢吞吞的动作，常让它被误认成巨大的儿童玩偶。
author: stabbycat
source: Because of POKENAME's appearance and slow-moving nature, it is often mistaken for a large children's toy.

entry: 它们很自豪于自己丰厚柔美的皮毛。但为了保护幼崽，哪怕弄得满身脏污也毫不犹豫。
author: quote.lass
source: They take great pride in their plush, luxurious coats, but will not hesitate to get dirty to protect their young.

entry: POKENAME是最适合拥抱的宝可梦，也是可靠的朋友，深受孩子和一些大人喜爱。
author: krune
source: The cuddliest Pokémon that exists, POKENAME is a true friend and is very popular with children and some adults.

entry: 当熔岩浇上火山周围绽放的花苞，POKENAME便会诞生。
author: theheroict
source: POKENAME is born when lava pours onto the flower buds that bloom around volcanos.

entry: 只有幼崽热得足以熔穿蛋壳，POKENAME的蛋才会孵化。它爱依偎着其他火宝可梦，将温暖分给伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A POKENAME egg only hatches once the baby within has reached a sufficient temperature to melt through its shell. It loves to cuddle up to other Fire-types, sharing its warmth with its fellow Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME十分黏人，喜欢紧靠训练家为其取暖。不知为何，它的身体在寒冷中也不会变硬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very clingy and love to keep close to their Trainer to keep them warm. Somehow their bodies never harden in the cold.

entry: POKENAME的身体由不会凝固的铁水构成。它静伏熔岩之中，只让缎带露出表面，等待挑战者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's body is made of molten iron that doesn't solidify. It lies dormant in lava with only its ribbon above the surface, waiting for a challenge.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上覆盖着岩浆般的黏液，让它能随意点燃全身。这种适应既有利战斗，也能让它飞行时不被自身火焰灼伤。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME's feathers are covered in a magma-like slime that allows it to ignite itself at will. This unique adaptation not only aids in battling but also protects it from burns during flight.

entry: 它住在火山地区，以煤与火山岩为食。急需补充能量时，还会吞下木头作为燃料。
author: melodydelune
source: Living in volcanic areas, its diet is composed of coal and volcanic rocks. If it desperately needs a recharge, it will consume wood to fuel itself.

entry: POKENAME常被自己产生的熔岩吓到。在它平静下来之前，周围的一切都会遭到焚烧。
author: mistershaokahn
source: POKENAME is often frightened by the lava it itself produces. When this happens, all its surroundings are burned until it has calmed down.

entry: POKENAME会俯冲向落叶，在飞行中将其点燃，练习捕猎。火焰虽小，每成功扑击一次，就亮上几分，渐露未来空中猎手的潜力。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME practices hunting by diving at fallen leaves, igniting them mid-flight. Though its flames are small, they grow brighter with every successful strike, showcasing its potential as a future aerial predator.

entry: POKENAME会在活火山里筑巢，借高温孵蛋、养育幼崽。科学家把这样一群火热的宝可梦，称为“一阵热潮”。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for nesting inside active volcanoes, using the intense heat to incubate its eggs and raise young. Scientists refer to a group of these fiery Pokémon as a 'Hot Flash'.

entry: 熔岩在POKENAME体内流动，一接触外界便汩汩冒泡。离开栖息地后，POKENAME会凝成密实的外壳，模样近似另一地区的泥巴鱼。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's lava courses through its system, bubbling up when exposed to the elements. When out of its habitat, POKENAME hardens into a dense shell similar to a Stunfisk of another region.

entry: 绚烂的晶体云环绕全身。碰上一颗，就会冷得仿佛被灼烧。
author: melodydelune
source: Dazzling clouds of crystals surround its body. Touching one of these crystals leaves one with a chill so cold it burns.

entry: POKENAME追随活火山的光，吃新涌出的熔岩。飞行时，滚烫的岩浆沿途滴落，身体便逐渐缩小，直到它再次进食。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are drawn to the light of active volcanoes to feed on the fresh lava they produce. Droplets of hot lava drip off this Pokémon as it flies, slowly reducing their body size until they can feed again.

entry: POKENAME体内有个巨大的气囊。包裹气囊的熔岩表层十分脆弱，容易破裂并猛烈爆炸。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME has a large air pocket inside it. The surface tension of the lava that surrounds it is fragile, and is prone to burst with explosive results.

entry: POKENAME踢出能熔化金属的火焰踢时，熔融的身体会不断滴落，发出嘶嘶声。它热爱训练，总想踢得更快，因此训练过的地方常留下焦痕。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's molten body drips and sizzles as it delivers flaming kicks that can melt metal. It loves to train, trying to increase the speed of its kicks, often leaving scorch marks wherever it trains.

entry: POKENAME踏过熔岩池，从中汲取温暖。若待在寒冷之地，很快就会死去。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stride through lava pools, which provide them with warmth. If they're in cold environments, they will soon perish.

entry: POKENAME的岩浆身体，能完全缩回石壳，保护自己；也借此避免伤及周围。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME's magma body can fully retreat into its stony shell for protection. It also does so to avoid harming its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME是火山地带的熔岩鸟，吃岩石、宝石与矿物。它在高空飞行时，身体可能滴落岩浆，登山者可得留神。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: POKENAME is a lava-like bird native to volcanic areas; its diet includes rocks, gems, and minerals. Hikers should be careful since it can drop lava from its body when flying high in the sky.

entry: 它往岩石手臂里灌入热气，让身体升空。若一只手臂坏了，便吐上热熔岩，耐心等它冷却成石，修补如初。
author: mistymagius
source: It fills its rocky arms with hot air, allowing it to lift off the ground. If one of its arms is damaged, it will spit hot lava on it, then patiently wait for it to cool back into rock.

entry: 岩石外骨骼让POKENAME能藏进岩浆，伪装自己。时机一到，便猛跃而出，用角攻击猎物。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton enables it to camouflage itself in magma. At the right time, it jumps out and attacks prey with its horn.

entry: 它原是一套广受欢迎、防护出色的防火墙。科学家将其变成宝可梦，POKENAME便诞生了。
author: dodoowner_
source: It used to be a very popular and protective firewall. Scientists turned it into a Pokémon, and POKENAME was born.

entry: POKENAME散发惊人热量，一碰就能熔化岩石。虽然外表烈焰腾腾，却仍保有路卡利欧的敏捷与战斗本领。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME emit immense heat, capable of melting rocks with a touch. Despite its fiery exterior, it maintains Lucario's agility and combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME喷出高达10000度的火焰，将吞下的东西烧尽。待在它身旁虽危险，处理垃圾时，它却是个好帮手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews flames up to 10,000 degrees, incinerating anything it consumes. Despite how dangerous they are to be around, POKENAME are quite helpful in garbage disposal.

entry: POKENAME偶尔深入地下，将体温升至华氏18,000度，再有意冷却背部，形成坚硬的鞘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME occasionally delves deeper underground to raise its temperature to 18,000 degrees F and strategically cools its back into a hard sheath.

entry: POKENAME俯冲快得惊人，借炽热的利爪烧灼猎物。动作精准又迅猛，猎物几乎来不及感到疼痛，是令人畏惧的高效空中猎手。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME dives at incredible speeds, searing its prey at intense temperatures through its claws. Its precision and velocity ensure the process is almost painless for its victim, making it a feared but efficient hunter in the skies.

entry: 它带着一大块火山岩当盾牌。盾牌变得不够坚固时，就用高温的爪子制作新的。
author: melodydelune
source: It carries around a large volcanic rock it uses as a shield. When weakened, it will make a new shield with its high-temperature claws.

entry: POKENAME常被叫作“烫手垃圾”。虽然说得没错，听了却还是会伤心。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often known as "Flaming Hot Garbage." Although true, it still hurts the Pokémon's feelings.

entry: 身体原本全是熔融状态，经急速冷却后，大部分变成黑曜石。内部却仍蓄着大量热量。
author: jaycielantern
source: Its body was once all molten, but being quickly cooled turned most of it into obsidian. Its insides still retain a large amount of heat.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在海底火山附近，触手由凝固的岩浆构成。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME often live near underwater volcanoes. Their tentacles are made of hardened magma.

entry: 因为身上有火，POKENAME常被说成“火爆脾气”，其实恰恰相反。它会为旅人照亮洞穴与森林。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is usually called hot-headed due to its fire, but it's actually quite the contrary. It lights up caves and forests for travelers.

entry: POKENAME的帽子由极其坚固的黑曜石制成，能替训练家挡下致命攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME's hat is made out of a very tough obsidian. It uses it to protect its Trainer from lethal attacks.

entry: POKENAME的模样酷似曾令它灭绝的火山，如今栖居在山地环境中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME looks like the volcanoes that once drove it to extinction. It makes its home in mountainous environments.

entry: POKENAME用长喙摘取树梢的树果，也常以喙相击，彼此决斗。不过打得再激烈，它们也始终恪守同一条规矩：绝不攻击对方的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long beaks to grab berries out of treetops. They often get into duels with each other, clashing their beaks into each other. No matter how intense the fights get, POKENAME always stick to a code of honor to not attack their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME出了名不会筑巢，便仗着庞大体格，把别的宝可梦赶出家门。做法虽不客气，倒总能有个舒服的地方睡。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously bad at building its own nests. Instead, it uses its impressive size to push out other Pokémon from their homes. Though not the most polite approach, this tactic ensures it always has a comfortable place to sleep.

entry: 它守在树梢高处等待猎物。猎物一靠近，POKENAME便飞扑而下，刺入毒液。
author: dodoowner_
source: It stays high in the trees, waiting to launch onto its prey. When it approaches, POKENAME will fly onto its food and sting it with venom.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，却快得出奇。肌肉，尤其尾部，能盘紧成弹簧，紧要时将它弹向高空，再一头钻入地面，捕捉猎物。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast despite having no limbs. Their muscles, especially near the tail, can coil up and act like a spring in a pinch letting POKENAME soar to great heights before tunneling down into the ground to capture their prey.

entry: POKENAME宽大有力的翅膀，能让它在空中长时间飞行，无需降落。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large, powerful wings allow POKENAME to remain airborne for long periods of time without needing to land.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独自狩猎。若有另一只POKENAME闯进领地，双方便会用尖喙互相戳刺，想把对方戳破。身体虽轻，却能搬起摩托车般沉重的物件。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefer to hunt alone and will try to pop each other with their sharp beaks if another POKENAME enter their territory. Despite being lightweight, it is able to carry items as heavy as a motorcycle.

entry: 长脖子便于POKENAME潜水时伸头换气。双翼发育不良，只能扑腾着飞一小段。
author: chorb33
source: Its long neck helps POKENAME to gasp for air when diving. Its wings are so stunted that it can only flap over short distances.

entry: 进食时，嘴上的尖刺会转向内侧，防止猎物逃走。只有肚子完全空着时，它才能飞行。
author: staghorn
source: When it eats, the spikes on its mouth turn inward to keep its prey from escaping. It can only fly if its stomach is completely empty.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在各种水域中，靠四肢悠闲划行。一旦受惊，就会起飞逃走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME likes to drift through all kinds of water and moves leisurely with the help of its limbs. If it gets spooked, it takes off and runs away.

entry: POKENAME虽体重不轻，却能轻松飞行。背上的炮管能射出强劲水柱，用来加速或闪避。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its weight, POKENAME can fly with ease. The cannons on its back can shoot powerful jets of water, which it can use to accelerate or dodge.

entry: POKENAME凭爪子和喙，能撬开任何贝类。它偷走其他宝可梦的猎物后，便笨拙地横行逃开，藏起来享用。
author: pokepower
source: Between its claws and beak, POKENAME can open up any shellfish. It steals prey from other Pokémon, then clumsily scuttles away to hide and eat it.

entry: POKENAME主要以毒蘑菇为食，借此释放恶臭，驱赶天敌。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME's diet primarily consists of poisonous mushrooms. These mushrooms allow it to secrete a foul odor it uses to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME将自己裹在厚厚的冰壳里，保护身体。等准备好进化时，冰壳才会融化。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME encases itself in a thick shell of ice to protect itself until it's ready to evolve, at which point the shell will melt away.

entry: POKENAME太喜欢雪球，无论到哪儿都带着三个。传闻它之所以长这样，就是因为曾吃下一颗雪球。
author: yorui3913
source: POKENAME loves snowballs so much that it carries three wherever it goes. It's rumored that its shape is the way it is because it ate a snowball once.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，身体越长。敏锐的鼻子能找到蘑菇、树果，甚至冰层下的温泉。
author: the_fireplace
source: The older POKENAME gets, the longer it grows. It has a very sensitive nose that can locate mushrooms, Berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

entry: POKENAME能投掷雪球抵御天敌，也很喜欢打雪仗。
author: yorui3913
source: POKENAME is able to throw snowballs, which it uses to defend itself from predators. It loves snowball fights.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷的高山湖泊中。POKENAME冰制的鳍会发光，为跌破冰面落水的生物指引方向。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME live in cold mountain lakes. The icy fins on POKENAME glow, acting as a guiding light to anything that may have fallen through the ice.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是毛皮与黏土的奇妙混合。它先用灵敏的鼻子嗅出食物，再挥动永远覆着冰的双臂，向地下挖去。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's body is a curious mix of fur and clay. It uses its sensitive nose to sniff out food before digging into the ground with arms permanently covered in ice.

entry: 它用火焰寻找埋在雪下的树果。雪乡的训练家常与POKENAME结伴出行，借它取暖。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its flames to look for berries under the snow. Trainers from snowy towns will often travel with POKENAME to keep warm.

entry: 爪子与外壳都由冰构成，壳下却覆着一层脂肪与毛皮。
author: shadowpanther
source: Its claws and shell are made of ice. It has a layer of fat and fur underneath its shell.

entry: 它背上的种子很小，因此会用雪包起来，小心保护。训练家帮忙装饰这个雪球，也能与POKENAME增进感情。
author: admiralvermin
source: The bulb on its back is small, so it covers it with snow to keep it safe. Trainers will bond with their POKENAME by helping to decorate its snowball.

entry: POKENAME把身上不断长出的植物纤维，编成粗绳，缠遍全身。若人类不定期收取一些，绳子越长越多，连它自己也会被困住。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME are covered in thick ropes they braid from plant fibers that grow from their bodies. This growth never stops, so if humans don't harvest parts of these ropes intermittently, a POKENAME can become entangled in them itself.

entry: POKENAME用斧头砍倒腐树，寻找其中富含养分的蘑菇。挥斧时，厚皮毛还能帮它稳住身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its axe to cut down rotten trees containing nutritious mushrooms. Its thick coat can be used to brace itself when it delivers a swing.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，通常伏在海底，静候小型鱼宝可梦游近，再将其吃掉。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME don't move very often. They usually lay on the ocean floor, silently waiting for small fish Pokémon to come closer so they can eat them.

entry: 它附着在海里的有毒废物上，吸收毒素维生，同时也将废物净化。
author: staghorn
source: It attaches itself to oceanic toxic waste. It sustains itself by absorbing the toxins, purifying the waste in the process.

entry: 一道道洁净温暖的海水从体内流出。POKENAME栖居的地方，海洋生物往往十分繁盛。
author: pizzarcato
source: Ribbons of clean, warm ocean water stream out of its body. Ocean life prospers in areas POKENAME call home.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸上，常与鸟宝可梦争斗得筋疲力尽，随后到潮池里晒太阳恢复精力。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wears itself out trying to fight bird Pokémon on the rocky shores it calls home. To recharge, it will bask in tide pools.

entry: POKENAME在浅水中寻找好坏星，试图将其击败。一旦获胜，背上的气泡便会喷得更加猛烈。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wades in shallow waters, attempting to find and defeat Mareanie. If it succeeds, the bubbles spouting from its back intensify.

entry: 水属性宝可梦要穿越陆地时，会找上POKENAME。POKENAME便用水袋装着它，将它送到目的地。
author: staghorn
source: If a Water-type Pokémon needs to travel across land, it will seek out a POKENAME. The POKENAME then carries it in its water pouch to its destination.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁及周边，似乎会吸收来自宇宙的未知能量，再借此让海洋生命恢复活力。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME live on and around coral reefs. They seem to soak up a strange, unknown energy from space to and use it to help revitalize ocean life.

entry: 它们藏在缤纷的水生植物间，平时避免争斗。因此，野外很少有POKENAME能够进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They hide among colorful underwater plant life and generally avoid combat. As a result, very few POKENAME evolve in the wild.

entry: 它从独特的臂炮射出压实的珊瑚巨石。打得兴起时，偶尔连太阳珊瑚也会不小心射出去。
author: pizzarcato
source: Compacted boulders of coral are blasted from its distinctive arm cannon. In its fervor, Corsola are occasionally launched by accident.

entry: 头部由致密的珊瑚构成。POKENAME在水下的太阳珊瑚群旁巡逻，保护它们免受天敌侵害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its head is formed out of dense coral. POKENAME patrols around underwater groups of Corsola to protect them from predators.

entry: 最近，人们发现POKENAME的金属外部，并非身体，而是包容珊瑚本体的壳。气候变化后，它们开始住进废弃潜水服，躲避有害的海洋环境。
author: rakunk
source: Recent discoveries reveal that POKENAME's metal exterior is not part of its body but a shell housing its coral form. Due to climate change, it began living in abandoned diving suits to shield itself from harmful ocean conditions.

entry: 据说POKENAME是死于海边意外的孩子所化。有人在海边听到过声音，引诱自己跳入水中。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said POKENAME are children who have died in mishaps around the ocean. People near oceans have reported a voice luring them to jump in the water.

entry: 许多POKENAME聚在一起，伪装成珊瑚礁。想躲进礁区的宝可梦，最终都会被它们吃掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: Many POKENAME come together in order to mimic coral reefs. Any Pokémon that seek to hide in their reefs are consumed.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁中，与斑斓色彩融为一体。天敌出现时，也会让海洋生物躲进自己的掩体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in reefs, blending in among the different colors. It also allows sea life to hide within its bunker if predators are around.

entry: 它想邀请所有人到巨口里的海洋中玩耍，却不知道进去的人几分钟内就会溺亡。
author: skymaster426
source: It wishes to bring everyone into the ocean within its maw to play. It doesn't realize that anyone who enters will drown within minutes.

entry: POKENAME主要靠射出压实的泥球进攻。偶尔会成群来到海滩，搜集、吃下湿沙，在岸边留下一道长沟。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME's main form of offense is shooting compacted mud balls. Sometimes, hordes of them will gather on beaches to collect and eat wet sand, leaving a long trench on the shoreline.

entry: 两群POKENAME每次相遇，都会展开长达一周的争斗，直到一方全军覆没才肯罢休。
author: falsedoll
source: Whenever two groups of POKENAME run into each other, they will engage in a week-long conflict that only ends one side is completely annihilated.

entry: POKENAME猎捕飞行猎物时，会先从口中射出水柱将其击落，再让猎物坠上刀刃般的角。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has a strategy for hunting flying prey: Striking it down with a water jet from its mouth and letting it fall onto its bladed horn.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，白天得不停活动，才能在入夜前把能量耗掉。它还会主动迎敌，从口中喷出强劲水柱，轻易压倒对手，再多耗些精力。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME has copious amounts of energy, needing to be constantly moving throughout the day to burn it off before nightfall. It takes on foes to further burn off energy, often easily outmatching them with powerful jets of water shot from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，是理想的宠物。可肉质鲜甜，也令它经常遭到捕猎。
author: sand_coffin
source: Due to POKENAME's gentle and docile nature, it makes an ideal pet. However, it is also hunted often for its fresh, sweet taste.

entry: 人们发现许多POKENAME远离原有栖息地。原来它们附着在巨翅飞鱼身上时，忘了本来要去哪里。
author: gp423
source: Many POKENAME have been found far from their natural habitat. This is because they have forgotten where they were going while attached to a Mantine.

entry: 它先在沙中撑稳身体，或用吸盘抓紧岩石，再射出威力如大炮的水柱。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It braces itself in the sand or holds onto rocks with its suction cups before firing a jet of water with the power of a cannon.

entry: POKENAME产出的不是奶而是墨汁，因此常被人工饲养。墨汁既能书写，也能用于一些料理。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is often farmed for its capability to produce ink instead of milk. The ink can be used for writing, but is also used in some recipes.

entry: 它用灵活的脖子精准瞄准，连高飞的宝可梦也能击落。铁炮鱼纷纷聚来，既为食物，也想向它学习。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its flexible neck to take perfect aim, shooting down even high-flying Pokémon. Remoraid flock to it, eager for both food and lessons.

entry: 它用美妙歌声引来对手，再以触手牢牢缠住猎物。一旦缠上，绝不松开。
author: mrpeach774
source: After luring in a foe with a beautiful song, it uses its tentacles to latch onto its prey. Once attached, it never lets go.

entry: POKENAME扭紧再松开触手，借反作用力前进，不太费力就能在水中悠闲滑行。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME twists and releases its tentacles, giving it propulsion and allowing it to glide leisurely through the water with little energy expenditure.

entry: POKENAME能将触手拧在一起蓄力。松开时，便能借这股力量迅速游过很远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into together to build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the force.

entry: POKENAME能把触手相互绞紧，积蓄弹力。猛然松开时，反冲的力量，便能让它迅速跃过很远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into each other and build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the resulting force.

entry: POKENAME将用来充饥的种子存进背上包袱。这些种子也能在它栖居的雪林中生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the bundle on its back to store seeds it uses for nutrients. These seeds are able to grow in the snowy forests where it lives.

entry: POKENAME飞翔于冰雪群山间，看见迷路的人，就载其飞往安全处，再分些食物。它的羽毛，柔软又温暖得出奇。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME flies around icy mountains. If it sees someone lost, it will fly them to safety and give them some food. Its feathers are surprisingly soft and warm.

entry: 猛烈暴风雪中，POKENAME会现身，吞下风雪，储进嗉囊。随后再带回巢里，让家园终年冰封。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME appears during terrible snowstorms to eat and store the violent weather in their crop. Later it will deliver the weather to its nest to keep its home covered in permafrost.

entry: POKENAME是干劲十足的送货鸟，常替人把小包裹送往严寒地区。若不拦着，凡是举得动的，它们都想送。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME are ambitious delivery birds used to send small packets to the coldest of regions. POKENAME will try to deliver anything they can lift if they are not stopped.

entry: 训练家得留意管住POKENAME。它急着打破送货纪录，常一冲就冲过了头，反而白白浪费时间。
author: rockageddon
source: Trainers must take care to rein in their POKENAME. Eager to break its delivery record, they will overshoot their delivery, losing time instead of saving it.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，突然落到路人面前送礼物。若对方拒收，POKENAME可能会懊恼得当场爆炸。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME hangs in trees, dropping in front of passersby to give gifts to them. If the recipient refuses the gift, POKENAME may explode in frustration.

entry: 送达包裹，对POKENAME是神圣之事。谁敢偷货，就会遭到数周的猛烈攻击。它永远记得那张脸，包裹贼别想安心。
author: rockageddon
source: Deliveries are sacred to POKENAME. Anyone that tries to steal deliveries will be mercilessly attacked for weeks. Package thieves are never safe, as POKENAME never forgets a face.

entry: 普通信使鸟天性慷慨，可两只信使鸟融合后却脾气暴躁又刻薄。礼物不送，只送煤炭。
author: valtsuri
source: Despite an unfused Delibird's generous nature, a Delibird double fusion is grumpy and mean. It only delivers coal, not gifts.

entry: 训练家若没看紧POKENAME，就会发现附近的玩具纷纷不见。专家也不确定，它是想偷来惹孩子哭，还是有偷窃癖。
author: rockageddon
source: Trainers that don't pay attention to POKENAME will discover that toys tend to disappear around this Pokémon. Experts are not sure if the Pokémon likes to steal to make children cry or if it is a case of kleptomania.

entry: 它摇动角，松脂的宜人香气便弥漫开来。闻到这香味，同伴与敌人都能平静下来。
author: .izik
source: When it shakes its horns, a pleasant scent of pine sap fills the air. This fragrant aroma calms both allies and opponents alike.

entry: 人称“生日鸟”的它，爱送出彩纸礼物，给人类和宝可梦带来惊喜。见到派对，还总想偷偷拿一块蛋糕。
author: rockageddon
source: Commonly known as the Birthday Bird, this Pokémon loves to surprise people and Pokémon with confetti presents. If it spots a party, it will always try to sneak away with a piece of cake.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME会掰下身上的黑石，送给调皮的孩子。究竟想借此告诉他们什么，却没人明白。
author: iaobug
source: Urban legend says POKENAME will break off the black stones on its body and gift them to naughty children. The message this conveys to them is unclear.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME不愿战斗，宁可坐着挨打，也不大愿意出手。它们十分喜欢宝物。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are reluctant to engage in battle and much more likely to sit and endure hits rather than dish them out. They have a fondness for treasure.

entry: POKENAME性情温雅，对宝可梦对战嗤之以鼻，倒更愿意在待客、娱乐等方面施展才华。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME possess a very genteel nature. They scoff at Pokémon battles and showcase their talents elsewhere, such as in hospitality and entertainment.

entry: POKENAME会结成上百只的大群游动，头顶藻类高速旋转，还能让它们掠过海面，滑翔前进。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME swim as schools of hundreds. They use the algae growing on their head to glide over the sea by rotating them at high speed.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: 小小的POKENAME好奇心旺盛，一半时间在水中，一半在陆地。它吃水草，吃饱后有时会吹泡泡。
author: rooboid
source: The small, curious POKENAME lives half of its life in water and half on land. It feeds on aquatic vegetation and may blow bubbles when it's well-fed.

entry: POKENAME体内住着各种小型水生宝可梦。长大后，它便会学着借体内住客的力量维生。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is home to an assortment of small, aquatic Pokémon. When it grows in size, it will learn to feed off the power of its inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME靠体内水生生态提供动力，以骇人速度破浪前行。双翼如刀，攻击凶狠毫不留情。
author: rooboid
source: Powered by an aquatic ecosystem within its body, POKENAME tears through the waves at a wicked pace. Its wings cut like blades; remorseless and fierce.

entry: 阿罗拉近海常能见到POKENAME，和同类、巨翅飞鱼一起冲浪游玩。水上花样最多的那只，便是小队的头领。
author: teatedtiten
source: Commonly found off the Alolan coast, POKENAME surf with other POKENAME and Mantine for sport. The one who performs the most tricks on the waters is deemed the leader of their squadron.

entry: POKENAME改变尾上叶片的姿态，就能调节游速。它们对过路训练家很友善，常主动帮忙，载人渡海。
author: teatedtiten
source: By changing the leaves on their tails, POKENAME adjust their speed when swimming. POKENAME are very friendly to passing Trainers, frequently offering them help across the seas.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在雨后跳水洼。每只背鳍上的花纹都独一无二。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME love to jump in puddles after a rainy day. Each one sports a unique dorsal fin pattern.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由软骨与软组织构成，硬骨很少。漫长的历史中，它的化石一直被错认成拉普拉斯。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's body consists mostly of cartilage and soft tissue, with few bones. For most of history, its fossils were mistakenly attributed to Lapras.

entry: 与巨翅拉斯一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解POKENAME吃下的食物。
author: rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: 与巨翅拉斯一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解POKENAME吃下的食物。
author: rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME将黏液涂满身体，便能在海面滑行。即使搁浅，也能把自己弹回海里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME covers itself in slime to be able to glide across the ocean surface. It is able to bounce itself back into the ocean if beached.

entry: POKENAME让成群铁炮鱼攀住自己的链条，载它们横渡海洋。可这样一来，也更容易成为大型猎手的目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME allows schools of Remoraid to cling to its chain as they transport them across the ocean. However, this makes them favored targets for larger predators.

entry: 可可多拉披着厚厚钢甲，POKENAME却由岩石构成。因此POKENAME潜入水下时，也不会生锈。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is made of rock, unlike Aron, who boasts a thick coat of steel armor. Because of this, POKENAME doesn't rust when it dives underwater.

entry: 小型水生宝可梦住在POKENAME外壳的缝隙中。长久共生之后，它会利用这种关系，获得更强的力量。
author: rooboid
source: Small, aquatic Pokémon live within the cracks of POKENAME's shell. Eventually, it will capitalise on this symbiotic relationship to gain power.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: 这种走路草融合宝可梦生活在海里。铁炮鱼喜欢躲进它的叶丛，避开天敌。
author: uncookie
source: This Oddish fusion can be found in the ocean. Species of Remoraid like to seek shelter from predators in its leaves.

entry: POKENAME发现小个子的朋友遇险时，会将对方装进气泡，保护起来。
author: uncookie
source: When POKENAME sees a smaller friend in danger, it will shield them from harm by putting them in its bubble.

entry: POKENAME通常温和体贴，用气泡保护朋友。但必要时，也会用气泡困住或震晕敌人。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME are usually passive and caring, using their bubbles to shield friends. However, if necessary, it will use its bubbles to trap or stun foes.

entry: 它模样奇特，像顶着平坦菌盖的蘑菇，常见于沿岸沼泽，以腐烂植物为食。眼神空洞无神。
author: rooboid
source: Often spotted within coastline swamps, this unusual Pokémon resembles a flat-capped mushroom and feeds on rotten plants. Its gaze is soulless.

entry: 淡水水流将POKENAME的身体打磨得圆润光滑。夏日阳光下，它的身体闪闪发亮，吸引小型水生宝可梦前来安家。
author: rooboid
source: Rounded by the flow of freshwater currents, the body of POKENAME shines in the summer sun, attracting small aquatic Pokémon to make their homes there.

entry: 它靠拆毁废弃建筑锻炼拳头。两只POKENAME相互挑战时，金属碰撞声会一直持续，直到一方倒下。
author: mistershaokahn
source: It trains its fists by destroying abandoned buildings. When one POKENAME challenges another, their metallic strikes won't stop until one is down.

entry: 虽然蛋几乎无法打碎，它还是会拼命保护。虽长着翅膀，却不会飞。
author: krune
source: It protects its egg with its life, despite the fact that the egg is nearly unbreakable. Despite having wings, it cannot fly.

entry: POKENAME生活在各地区的积雪森林。剑术足以压倒艾路雷朵，毒性也相当猛烈。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME can be found in forests in snowy areas of any region. Their swordsmanship is enough to overwhelm a Gallade and their poison is quite potent.

entry: POKENAME放出令人安宁的香气，将猎物引入洞穴，喂给自己的幼崽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tries to lure in its prey by letting out a serene smell. It then lures it to a cave to feed it to its young.

entry: 身体由轻盈而坚韧的金属构成。高速滚动时，便用翅膀状耳朵，控制行进方向。
author: staghorn
