source: Its body is made of a lightweight yet durable metal. When rolling at high speeds, it uses its winglike ears to control its trajectory.

entry: POKENAME的凶暴程度与体型不相称，满怀杀意。在野外遇见它，务必要小心。
author: krune
source: Despite its size, POKENAME have murderous intent and can be quite violent. Be very careful if you meet it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME还很年幼，不懂得像长辈那样慈爱体贴。谁惹它生气，它就把石头扔向谁。
author: krune
source: As it is very young, POKENAME does not know how to be paternal and throws its stone at others who annoy it.

entry: POKENAME最早的记录可追溯至卡洛斯战争。身上的金属甲片，是为了让人能骑着它上战场而打造的。
author: patch_bros
source: The earliest recorded cases of POKENAME date back to the Kalos War. The metal plating along its body was made so it could be ridden into battle.

entry: 翼刃锋利无比，飞过便能削倒树木。因此，POKENAME栖息的丛林，树永远长不过某个高度。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its wing blades are so sharp that it fells trees as it flies. The jungles POKENAME live in never grow beyond a certain height as a result.

entry: POKENAME扇状的钢羽刀刃能像鸟般飞翔。脱落的羽毛，很容易制成刀具。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's fan of steel feather blades can fly like a bird. Its fallen feathers are easily made into knives.

entry: POKENAME是被哭哭面具附身的死去盔甲鸟，早已不能飞。金属身体刮擦地面的声响，老远就能听见它来了。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is a dead Skarmory possessed by a Yamask. It can't fly, which is why you can hear POKENAME coming from a distance by the metal scraping against the floor.

entry: 融合让POKENAME以蛮力换来出神入化的剑术。虽然技艺高强，它却似乎不喜欢这种变化。
author: patch_bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to trade its brawn for incredibly impressive fencing skills. Despite its prowess, it does not seem to enjoy this change.

entry: 身体太过锋利，骑上去必被割伤。中世纪时，人们常用它的形象作为纹章图案。
author: staghorn
source: Its sharp body makes it impossible to ride without being cut. It was commonly used as a heraldic symbol during the Middle Ages.

entry: POKENAME举止可爱，咬下时却带着极强毒性，当地人都十分畏惧。受威胁时，它会先吠叫，警告人类赶快逃。
author: krune
source: Despite its cute demeanor, POKENAME has a very potently venomous bite, which is feared in the areas in which POKENAME lives. It barks when threatened, giving humans a warning to run before it bites.

entry: 它们会收集已故人类与宝可梦的骨骼。藏品品质越好，在同族中就越受尊重。
author: sottiwotti
source: They collect the bones of deceased Pokémon and people. The quality of their collection influences the respect they get in their flock.

entry: POKENAME漫游草原，寻找同族结伴。臀部的头常因饥饿而死；若那颗头还活着，它便明显快乐些，也更不爱独处。
author: krune
source: POKENAME roam the savannas, searching for others of their kind to ally with. The head on their rump is usually deceased from starvation, but when alive, they are noticeably happier and less solitary.

entry: 每次只能由一个头使出火焰攻击，火焰却比黑鲁加能喷出的还要炽热得多。
author: itsbrewsky
source: Only one head is able to use fire attacks at a time, but this fire is vastly hotter than anything even a Houndoom is capable of producing.

entry: POKENAME出了名爱唱反调，偏要让人怎么不方便，怎么来。它的毒液造成的灼痛，还能持续数周。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are notoriously contrarian and enjoy being as inconvenient as possible. Their toxin causes a burning sensation that can last for weeks.

entry: 若坏运气接连不断，或许就是受了POKENAME的诅咒。它正义感强烈，会把不幸带给自己认定的恶人。
author: sajochi
source: If you are having a string of bad luck, a POKENAME may have cursed you. This Pokémon has a strong sense of justice and will bring misfortune to those it deems evil.

entry: POKENAME会靠近孩子，装成小狗，盼有人收养自己。独自待着，就会心情低落。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME approaches children and acts like a puppy to try to get adopted. When alone, it gets depressed.

entry: POKENAME用各种叫声互通消息，将猎物逼入绝境。年长的POKENAME，皮毛会泛起黑曜石般的光泽。
author: krune
source: POKENAME communicate with each other using a variety of cries in order to corner their prey. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like obsidian.

entry: POKENAME一天能睡上20小时。打哈欠时有时会不小心喷火，靠近时务必小心。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours a day. When it yawns, it sometimes accidentally emits hot flames, so caution is advised when approaching it.

entry: 这种POKENAME逐渐适应了与人类共处，喜欢放牧咩利羊等家畜宝可梦。不过，它也常只是作为宠物饲养。
author: krune
source: This POKENAME has evolved to be more integrated with humans. It likes herding Mareep and other creatures common in husbandry. It is often kept as just a pet.

entry: 等待进化的POKENAME几乎不动。一旦受了打扰，POKENAME便发出吠叫，声音足以让人做噩梦。
author: krune
source: POKENAME barely move while waiting to evolve. If POKENAME is disturbed, it will bark with a sound that can give humans nightmares.

entry: 终于破茧而出后，POKENAME会找到同类，结伴觅食。小虫、其他虫宝可梦，甚至蜂蜜，都是它们搜寻的目标。
author: krune
source: Having finally emerged from its cocoon, POKENAME find packs of other POKENAME and hunt prey together. They hunt and scavenge everything ranging from small insects, other bug-Pokémon, and even honey.

entry: 深夜听见诡异嚎叫，或许是POKENAME正在觅食。受惊时，它会边逃边喷出热焰与浓烟，随后变成另一只宝可梦。
author: sajochi
source: If you hear an eerie howl in the dead of night, it may be a POKENAME looking for food. When frightened, it will attempt to flee while belching hot flames and thick smog before transforming into another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的超能力攻击造成的痛苦，只有另一只POKENAME才能治好。但它们只愿治疗自己信任的训练家。
author: darkweavile428
source: The pain from POKENAME's psychic attacks can only be cured by another POKENAME. However, they will only cure a Trainer that they trust.

entry: POKENAME把外来的火吸入背上头骨，助长自身火焰。这样做时，骨中会传出尖叫般的声音。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME absorbs flames into the skull on its back to fuel its own fire. Scream-like sounds emanate from it when it does this.

entry: 成群的POKENAME通常不自己觅食，而是找只小宝可梦，用角欺负它，非逼它带路找吃的不可。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME packs typically do not search for food on their own. Instead, they find a smaller Pokémon and bully it with their horns until it leads them to food.

entry: POKENAME擅长挖掘，会把受害者埋起来，直到只剩下白骨。随后，它会挖出骨骸，拿来玩耍。
author: d_numeritos
source: POKENAME excels at digging, burying victims until only bones remain. It then unearths them to play with their skeletal remains.

entry: 传说，这些宝可梦守着通往灵界的大门。风吹过牙齿间隙，便传出仿佛有人痛苦呜咽的声音。
author: wormspawn
source: Legends say these Pokémon guard the gates to the spirit world. When the wind passes through their teeth, they make sounds like someone whimpering in pain.

entry: POKENAME虽原始，却拥有惊人的力量。可大多时间都在懒散度日，或毫无缘由地用骨头敲打岩石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is primitive, but it has incredible powers. However, it spends most of its time lazing around or hitting rocks with its bones for no reason.

entry: 与土台龟不同，POKENAME不照顾身上生长的生命。它在废弃城市里翻找，搜罗更称心的装饰。
author: vaporvenator
source: Unlike Torterra, POKENAME does not take care of the life that grows on it. It scavenges abandoned cities in search of more preferable ornamentation.

entry: 别看POKENAME的模样，它们其实顽皮爱捣蛋，喜欢点燃物件，四处吓人。东西倒不会烧坏，却要留下好几天的硫黄味。
author: sajochi
source: Despite its looks, POKENAME are mischievous tricksters who enjoy setting objects aflame to scare anyone it can. The items it ignites are unharmed but will have a lingering smell of sulfur on them for a few days.

entry: 看见POKENAME，被视为死亡的预兆，因为它似乎只在人将逝去前现身。人们相信，它会吃掉亡者灵魂，再将邪恶的魂送往冥界。
author: sajochi
source: The sight of a POKENAME is considered an omen of death, as it only seems to appear shortly before a person passes on. People believe this Pokémon consumes the souls of the departed, and sends wicked souls to the underworld.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是冥界守门者，为亡魂开路，等它们走过，再锁上身后的门。它们全身滚烫，仿佛刚从烤炉中出来。
author: knilk
source: Folklore speaks of POKENAME as the gatekeeper of the underworld, opening the way for the souls of the departed and locking the gates behind them. Their bodies are always burning hot, as if they had been left in an oven.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，便传出不安、近乎超自然的声响。小齿轮能离开身体自由行动，却必须在破晓前回来，否则可能丧命。
author: sajochi
source: An unsettling, almost supernatural sound is emitted when a POKENAME spins its gears. The minigear can move freely from the body, but must return before daybreak or else it may perish.

entry: 它无目的地飘过墓地与古战场，颈间项链咔嗒作响，让人听得寒毛直竖。
author: krune
source: It floats aimlessly around graveyards and places where wars have been fought. Its necklace rattles with a chilling sound that sends shivers down one's spine.

entry: POKENAME爱用咬东西、咬人的方式玩耍，咬伤却会刺痛好几天。最好备个皮皮玩偶，让POKENAME咬着玩。
author: sajochi
source: POKENAME loves to play by biting anything and anyone. It is recommended to keep a Poké Doll around for POKENAME to play with, as this Pokémon's bite will cause a stinging pain for a few days.

entry: 吸入POKENAME四处散布的孢子，喉咙就会产生难以忍受的灼痛，而且永远无法完全消退。
author: fenragon
source: The spores POKENAME scatters everywhere cause unbearably painful burns in the throat when inhaled. This pain will never completely fade.

entry: 有些传说里，它们潜伏冥界，焚烧恶魂。四处游荡时，硫黄味也如影随形。
author: skymaster426
source: In some legends, it is said that these Pokémon lurk in the underworld, burning evil souls. When they wander, the smell of sulphur follows.

entry: 往昔，POKENAME一声夜嚎，便足以引发恐慌。被它袭击的村庄，等到日出，就已不复存在。
author: skymaster426
source: In the past, a POKENAME's howl in the night would be enough to cause a panic. A village it attacked would no longer exist by the time the sun rose.

entry: POKENAME最爱用超能力折磨人。变出的汤匙一旦弯曲，毫无防备的受害者，心智也会随之扭曲。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME aims above all else to torment humans with its psychic prowess. As one of its conjured spoons bends, so too bends the mind of an unwitting victim.

entry: 古老预言中，四只POKENAME会在世界末日疾驰而过。因此，它们走到哪里，便把恐惧带到哪里。
author: nellnast42
source: Ancient prophecies describe four POKENAME riding at the end of the world. As such, these Pokémon bring fear wherever they go.

entry: 大颚上覆着的毒黏液，连卡比兽也能放倒。POKENAME密集的沼泽，常会禁止新手训练家进入。
author: schwaus
source: It covers its jaws with a venomous mucus that can knock out a Snorlax. Swamps with high populations of POKENAME are often closed off from novice Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动地潜在水下，盯着猎物好几个小时。一旦落入巨颚，便很难逃脱。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME can lie still and stalk its prey from under the water for hours. Once prey gets caught in its jaws, they rarely escape.

entry: POKENAME身体太长，既难飞行，也难保持直立。不过仍有剧毒，不宜靠近。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME struggles to fly or keep an upright posture due to its excessively long body. It is still highly venomous and should not be approached.

entry: 宽大的翅膀与强健肌肉，让这副奇特身体也能飞行。它常袭击鸟宝可梦的巢，将蛋整个吞下。
author: vaporvenator
source: Large wings and strong muscles allow its peculiar body shape to fly. It will often raid the nests of bird Pokémon to swallow their eggs whole.

entry: 利爪虽带剧毒，平日却主要用来挖土。战斗时，POKENAME更爱盘起身体，抖响尾巴，让来犯者知难而退。
author: frokachu
source: Though its claws carry potent poisons, they are mostly used for digging. In battle POKENAME prefer to coil up and rattle their tail to discourage attackers.

entry: POKENAME用头上舌状的附肢感知气流变化，寻找猎物。尾尖发出的声响，则用来御敌，连最强悍的生物，也会吓退。
author: krune
source: POKENAME use their tongue-like appendages on their heads to sense changes in the air currents, helping them locate prey. Their tail-tips are used to ward off attackers, producing a sound that scares even the toughest creatures.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片由钢构成。古时，人们会把它蜕下的皮做成护臂。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's scales are made of steel. In ancient times, the shed skin was used as an armor sleeve.

entry: 传说POKENAME只消一眼，就能将活物化为石头。头上的每条阿柏蛇，都拥有自己的意识。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Legends say a mere glance from POKENAME can turn living things into stone. All of the Ekans on its head are sentient.

entry: 多出的头没有大脑，只是一张张额外的嘴。POKENAME能将它们弹出，够到身体碰不到的食物。
author: melodydelune
source: Its extra heads contain no brain, but they work as extra mouths that POKENAME can launch to reach food its body can't.

entry: 头上的火焰缓缓熔化混有毒物的蜡质身体，产生几乎难以察觉的有毒蒸气。
author: chorb33
source: The flame on its head slowly melts the wax of its body, which is mixed with noxious substances. This produces toxic, barely noticeable vapors.

entry: 虽然右臂也有意识，科学家仍一致认为，POKENAME的整个身体由头部控制。
author: chorb33
source: Although its right arm is also conscious, scientists agree that POKENAME's head is controlling the whole body.

entry: 索罗亚与阿柏蛇的融合，原本被寄望成为更好的除虫帮手。可喵喵依旧远更受欢迎，喜欢这种融合体的人，也就少得多。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion, which combines Zorua with Ekans, was originally proposed as a possible means of better pest control. Unfortunately Meowth continued to be widely more popular, relegating this fusion to a much smaller following.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在灌木丛中。若被发现，就会迈着小短腿试图逃走。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME tend to hide themselves in scrub brush. If they are discovered, they will use their tiny legs to attempt an escape.

entry: 毒液储存在头顶帆状器官中，需用时流入舌头。它冷得能冻伤皮肤，也常被用来制作解毒药与灼伤药。
author: krune
source: Its poison is stored in sails on its head, and it flows into its tongue when needed. The poison gives a chilling effect that can freeze skin, so its poison is often used for making both Antidotes and Burn Heals.

entry: POKENAME全身的许多眼睛，帮助它时刻提防天敌。碰到身上的帆，则会中毒。
author: krune
source: POKENAME have many eyes on its body to help it stay alerted to predators.  Its sail is poisonous to the touch.

entry: 身上的宝石由毒液结晶而成。虽然受到收藏家追捧，却仍具有剧毒。
author: krune
source: The gems on its body are made of crystallized venom.  These jewels are sought after by collectors, but remain highly toxic.

entry: 细长灵活的身体，让它能轻松钻过其他宝可梦的洞穴。它最喜欢的猎物，是尼多朗。
author: staghorn
source: Its elongated, flexible body allows it to snake through Pokémon burrows with ease. Its favorite prey is Nidoran.

entry: 它用使人麻痹的目光与催眠花纹，迷惑天敌和猎物。碰到无法催眠的敌人，就束手无策了。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its paralyzing gaze and hypnotic patterns to entrance both its predators and its prey. It is helpless against foes it cannot mesmerize.

entry: POKENAME摇晃植物茎秆引诱猎物，直到最后一刻才猛然施毒。
author: terastrial
source: POKENAME lures in prey by shaking its plant stalk, waiting until the last possible moment to strike with its venom.

entry: 背上的壳重得令它无法移动。它用成团的触须抓住其他宝可梦，再以嘴将其制服。
author: toxicrown
source: The shell on its back has grown too heavy to move. It uses its mass of tendrils to grab other Pokémon, before using its mouth to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME吃深海的金属矿床。若一群同时疯狂进食，掀起的力量便会形成巨型漩涡，扰乱当地渔民与宝可梦。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME feeds on metal deposits deep in the ocean. If a group of POKENAME are in a feeding frenzy, the force will create massive whirlpools, disrupting the local fisherman and Pokémon.

entry: 从海床到海面都能见到POKENAME。它旋转身体制造吞船的漩涡，借此吸取乘客的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can be found from the seafloor to the surface. It spins to create vortexes which swallow ships so it can absorb the life force of passengers.

entry: POKENAME用螺旋身体搅动水流，卷起巨大漩涡，自己却只坐在海底，等漩涡把猎物送上门。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its spiral body to churn the waters around it enough to create large whirlpools. However, these Pokémon just sit on the ocean floor waiting for their whirlpools to bring them their prey.

entry: 它每天大多在睡觉或找食物，温和的POKENAME很受孩子欢迎。可父母仍会因它的利爪，告诫孩子不要靠近。
author: krune
source: It spends most of its days sleeping or foraging for food. POKENAME's mild demeanor makes it popular among children, although parents warn them to not approach it due to its claws.

entry: 无论走到哪里，它都用象鼻卷着一株树苗。万一弄丢，便放下手头的一切，去寻找新的。
author: staghorn
source: It carries the sapling in its trunk wherever it goes. If the sapling is lost, it will drop whatever it's doing to find a new one.

entry: POKENAME会用鼻子向空中喷洒亮粉，表达对训练家的喜爱。
author: clawshdi
source: To show its affection for its Trainer, a POKENAME will blast glitter into the air using its trunk.

entry: POKENAME体内储着大量沙子，受威胁便从象鼻喷出。腿太短，它常不走路，而是一跳一跳地前进。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of sand inside their bodies and will shoot it out of its trunk if it feels threatened. Due to their short legs, it tends to hop around instead of walking.

entry: 獠牙锋利得如同盔甲鸟的利爪。可头上戴着硕大的颅骨，让它看不太清楚。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its tusks are as sharp as a Skarmory's talons. Due to the large skull on its head, it cannot see very well.

entry: POKENAME能用象鼻与火焰，把地形改成自己喜欢的模样。若遇上奇怪的火山地带，很可能已在它的巢附近。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME is able to terraform the land to its liking using its trunk and fire. If you ever find an odd volcanic area, you're probably near one's den.

entry: POKENAME的拟态十分奇特，颈部皮膜的花纹像汽车警示标志，还会随身体健康状况而改变。
author: capwolfbane
source: A bizarre example of mimicry, POKENAME's hood patterns resemble automotive warning symbols. The exact symbol changes according to its physical health.

entry: 尾巴上的多边兽Ｚ喜欢捉弄自己寄居的宝可梦。仅是它的存在，就使对方的超能力变得不稳而难以预测。
author: zeeroooo
source: The Porygon-Z on its tail enjoys bugging the Pokémon it lives on. Just its presence makes this Pokémon's psychic abilities unstable and unpredictable.

entry: 腹部的符号，显示着它吃下了多少电力。吃饱后，便向附近设备输电，令其拥有人工智能。
author: teatedtiten
source: The symbol on this Pokémon's stomach represents how much electricity it has eaten. When it gets full, it will transfer the electricity into nearby devices, which fills it with artificial intelligence.

entry: POKENAME爬行时总以精确的90度直角转弯。一家外国科技公司，还把它颈部皮膜的花纹用作标志。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME moves by slithering in perfect 90 degree angles. A foreign tech company uses the pattern on its hood as their logo.

entry: 由于程序出错，POKENAME闯入了广告业。可它推销的产品，再好也不过是些破烂货。
author: skymaster426
source: Due to a programming error, POKENAME has gotten into the advertising market. However, all of its products are shabby and broken at best.

entry: 这种宝可梦最早是给多边兽Ｚ使用杀毒程序后产生的。它既有多边兽Ｚ的力量，也有多边兽Ⅱ的情感。
author: valtsuri
source: The first version of this Pokémon was the result of using an antivirus on a Porygon-Z. It has the powers of Porygon-Z with the emotions of a Porygon2.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。不过，为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent though.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent.

entry: 常能见到其他宝可梦，欣赏它绘出的超级英雄故事。能把自己的故事分享给大家，让它十分自豪。
author: skymaster426
source: Pokémon can be found enjoying illustrations it has created, usually depicting superhero stories. It takes great pride sharing its stories with others.

entry: 振翅时，尾巴会有节奏地摆动。闻见喜欢的东西，鼻子就明显泛粉红。
author: .izik
source: As it flaps its wings, its tail waves back and forth rhythmically. When it smells something it likes, its nose turns a noticeable shade of pink.

entry: POKENAME头上的枝条像真鹿角，随季节生长、脱落。若在一处待得太久，落枝堆多了，便可能引发火灾。
author: holgast
source: The antler-like sticks on POKENAME's head grow out and fall off through the seasons, like real antlers. As a result, if POKENAME stay in one area for too long, their dropped twigs can cause a fire hazard.

entry: POKENAME华美的鹿角曾被入药，人们相信它能治好任何疾病。
author: yanlu
source: POKENAME's magnificent antlers were once used as a medicine that was believed to cure any disease.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛会散出粉末，在身后天空留下虹彩轨迹，因此常被误认成某只传说的宝可梦。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME's feathers release a powder that create a rainbow trail in the sky behind it. It is often confused with a certain legendary Pokémon.

entry: 它用黏土塑出诱饵，再以尾巴上色，借此研究附近猎手的攻击方式与捕猎习惯。
author: staghorn
source: It creates decoys out of clay that it paints with its tail. It uses them to study the attacks and hunting patterns of the area's predators.

entry: POKENAME有时会用画笔般的角蘸树液作画，而且似乎偏爱品质上乘的树液。
author: incognito1234
source: Sometimes, POKENAME uses tree sap to paint with its paintbrush-like horn. It seems to prefer higher-quality saps.

entry: 人们将POKENAME放上画布，任它四处奔跑，再把画成的作品展示给POKENAME看，它就会十分开心。
author: dodoowner_
source: People place POKENAME on a canvas and let it run around. After a while, they show the painting POKENAME has made to it, which makes it feel happy.

entry: 它能用尾巴净化水域，让其中死去的鱼复活。据说雨后出现的彩虹，也出自POKENAME之手。
author: patch_bros
source: It can use its tails to purify bodies of water, reviving any dead fish within. It is said POKENAME is responsible for rainbows seen after a rainy day.

entry: POKENAME虽很少现身野外，如今世上87%的食物画，实际上却都是它的作品。
author: rooboid
source: Despite being rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME is actually responsible for 87% of food paintings that exist today.

entry: POKENAME爱把荒漠的沙子染成各色，铺成沙画。某些基金会，还会专门保护POKENAME的作品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to create sand paintings by dyeing the desert sand different colors. Art pieces made by POKENAME are consider protected by certain foundations.

entry: 两种颜色，分别由POKENAME的两个半脑控制。双方若能合作，薄膜般的身体便转为深紫，超能力也随之增强。
author: teatedtiten
source: The two colors are controlled by POKENAME's two halves of its brain.  If its two halves can cooperate, its membrane-like body turns into a deep purple, heightening its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME用背上的笔尖绘画，尖端渗出的液体，就是很好的颜料。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME uses the brush tips on its back to create marks. The fluid leaking from them makes a good paint.

entry: POKENAME摇摇晃晃地四处走，所到之处都留下涂迹。它喜欢在难以够到的地方涂鸦，常想胜过同伴。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME toddles around, leaving marks wherever it goes. It likes to tag hard-to-reach locations, often seeking to outdo its peers.

entry: POKENAME绘制的壁画细节精妙，倾注的情感无与伦比。奇怪的是，它从不用黄色颜料。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME paints murals with outstanding detail, pouring its emotions into art like no other. Curiously, it never uses yellow paint.

entry: POKENAME用炮管，在领地四处绘出复杂壁画，速度快得令人难解。有人推测，它靠背部一组复杂肌肉，边喷射，边调色、变换图样。
author: caldonb
source: POKENAME uses its cannons to paint intricate murals across its territory at confounding speeds. It is theorized that POKENAME flexes a complex set of muscles in its back to mix colors and create patterns while firing.

entry: 吸入POKENAME喷出的气体，就会精神大振，仿佛无所不能。不过，竞技运动通常禁止使用这种气体。
author: mistymagius
source: The gas POKENAME expels invigorates anyone who inhales it, making them feel like they can take on anything. However, using the gas in competitive sports is usually banned.

entry: POKENAME每天都得用一用变硬，否则就会焦躁不安。
author: yanlu
source: POKENAME become stressed out if they do not get to use Harden every day.

entry: 它从不放过磨炼本领的机会，何时都可能在训练，只在吃沙子、砾石时，才停一停。
author: schwaus
source: It never backs down from an opportunity to hone its skills. It can be found training at any hour, only stopping to eat sand and gravel.

entry: 这只尚在修行的战士，想让训练家握着自己上阵，边看边学。POKENAME日后的进化，也取决于训练的风格。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This Pokémon fighter-in-training wishes to observe and learn by being wielded by its Trainer. POKENAME will evolve according to the style of training.

entry: POKENAME会在冰封的山上冥想数月，锻炼耐力。完成训练后，它能在没有食物和水的情况下坚持2周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends months mediating on icy mountains to train their endurance. When fully trained, it can last up to 2 weeks without any food or water.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不爱用手，更喜欢以锋利的尾巴和双腿猛烈旋转，连金属都能切开。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME dislikes using its hands in combat. It prefers to use its sharp tails and legs to unleash powerful spins capable of slicing through metal.

entry: POKENAME的独特战法，融合嘻哈与霹雳舞，招式难以预料，因此很受街头艺人欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: A popular Pokémon among street performers, POKENAME uses a unique fighting style mimicking a mix of hip-hop and breakdancing, making it unpredictable in combat.

entry: POKENAME在暴风雪中现身，缓缓接近迷路的登山客。靠得够近时，便舔舐受害者，使其无法动弹。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME appears during snowstorms and slowly approaches disoriented hikers. When it gets close enough, it licks its victim to immobilize them.

entry: 它们毫无自主意识，慢慢走过遗迹，执行迷唇魔灵的心愿。每只迷唇魔灵，往往控制着好几只POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: They trudge slowly and willlessly through ruins and fulfill the wishes of Jynoirs, who often have several POKENAME's under their control.

entry: POKENAME十分狡猾，轻易就能将别人玩弄于股掌。谁若反抗，就会见识到它强大的魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon that can easily wrap others around its finger. Any who resist it will witness its powerful magic.

entry: 冰凉的手臂，可放入饮料里浸泡几分钟，代替冰块，因此颇受欢迎。POKENAME自己也喜欢饮料，倒是两相情愿。
author: chorb33
source: Its ice-cold arms are popular ice cube alternatives, as they can be dipped in drinks for several minutes and POKENAME enjoys the liquid in return.

entry: 冰帽用来反射炙热阳光，意外地结实。凭冰之力量，它还能不断将帽子修复、更新。
author: chorb33
source: Its icy hat, which it uses to reflect the sun's hot rays, is surprisingly robust. Thanks to its ice powers, it can constantly renew its hat.

entry: 它虽然跑得笨拙，时速却可达258英里。可惜总被绊倒，很少真能跑远。暴风雪中，曾有人见它像孩子般安然打盹。
author: houndrys.
source: It is capable of clumsily running at up to 258 mph, yet rarely goes far due to tripping. During blizzards, it has been seen napping like a child.

entry: 它们对着能映出倒影的水晶整理仪容，还会向路过的登山客送飞吻。
author: jackythewannabe
source: They look into reflective crystals to touch up on their looks. They're known to blow kisses at passing hikers.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在尾巴中。遇险时便把尾巴猛砸地面，释放电流。
author: holzycookie
source: It stores electricity in its tail. If ever in danger, POKENAME will slam its tail onto the ground to let out an electrical discharge.

entry: POKENAME诞生于电力被发现之前。它身上的符号，竟仿佛预示了现代的电气标记。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME originates from a time before electricity was discovered. Its symbology seems to have been a prediction of modern electrical symbols.

entry: POKENAME能产生使人麻痹的毒液。它会吞下尾巴，再四处翻滚，为自己充电。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME produces a poison with paralyzing properties. It recharges itself by swallowing its tail and rolling around.

entry: POKENAME的衣物拖过地面，摩擦出静电，储进头盔。随后，以奇异而迷人的能量迸发，将电力打向对手。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME harnesses static electricity from its clothes as they drag along the ground, storing the energy in its helmet. It then releases this energy through enchanting, mystical bursts that shock its opponents.

entry: POKENAME把头插进电源插座获取能量。一小时内就能补足超过八小时睡眠带来的精力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME docks its head in power sockets to get energy. Within an hour, it can recharge energy worth over eight hours of sleep.

entry: POKENAME能像强力电击器一样，充当致命性较低的近战武器。它会旋转飘带充电，也会接上插座，大幅补充电力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a powerful taser, a less-lethal melee weapon. It rotates its ribbon to recharge or plugs into outlets to supercharge.

entry: 凡是找到的废电线、坏电器，它都往身体里塞。放电时，还会冒出一团团恶臭烟雾。
author: staghorn
source: It fills itself with any discarded wires and broken electronics it can find. When it discharges its electricity, it emits clouds of putrid smoke.

entry: POKENAME睡在电源附近。受到打扰就瞬移到安全处，却会在原地留下危险的电荷。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sleeps near power sources. If it is disturbed, it teleports to safety, leaving behind a dangerous electrical charge at its point of origin.

entry: 盯着那眼状花纹太久，全身便会灼痛难忍。它喷出的烈焰，几分钟就能把岩石汽化。
author: mistymagius
source: Staring into its eye-pattern too long causes an insufferable burning sensation in your entire body. It produces flames hot enough to vaporize rock within a matter of minutes.

entry: 它潜伏沼底，追踪毫无防备的宝可梦。针对不同猎物，还能使用各不相同的专用毒液。
author: schwaus
source: It stalks the bottom of swamps for unsuspecting Pokémon. It can use various venoms specialized for different forms of prey.

entry: 它的巨颚一合，整只轮胎也能咬碎。腹部花纹骇人，小宝可梦一看见，便吓得僵在原地。
author: schwaus
source: Its jaws are strong enough to crush whole tires in a single chomp. The patterns on its stomach are so intimidating it can freeze small Pokémon in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME展示鲜艳的翅膀吓退威胁，还能用利爪注入毒液，尤其适合猎捕空中的目标。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME scares away threats by displaying its brightly colored wings. It injects venom through its talons, ideal for hunting airborne targets.

entry: 经过严苛训练，POKENAME出手已如蛇般迅疾，还能将波导化为长鞭攻击敌人。
author: kiddivinegon
source: Through intense training, this Pokémon is now able to strike with the speed of a snake. The aura POKENAME wields can be used as a whip to attack foes.

entry: 蛇形身体优雅游动，散发致命波导。POKENAME以带毒的波导吓退威胁，守护领地。
author: sheogorath
source: Its serpentine body moves with grace while it exudes a lethal aura. POKENAME uses its toxic aura to deter any threats and protect its territory.

entry: 它缠绞的力量极强。若没能引来敌人，就会骑在蛇形肢体上主动追击。
author: mossybanana
source: This Pokémon has exceptional constriction power. If luring foes in does not work, it will give chase by riding its snake-like appendage.

entry: 多个头会张口咬向一切靠近之物。有些人相信，若被POKENAME直视双眼，就会化为石头。
author: chorb33
source: The various heads of this fusion snap at anything that comes near them. Some believe that POKENAME will petrify you if it looks you right in the eye.

entry: POKENAME发育不全，始终没长出颈部皮膜，于是改学剑术弥补，模样反而更令人畏惧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Stunted in its development and never growing a hood, POKENAME compensated by learning the way of the sword, an arguably more intimidating sight.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃中长出了储有致命毒液的毒囊，还会用缎带上的假脸转移对手视线，掩藏真正的眼睛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has grown deadly venom vessels in its blade. It also distracts opponents from its true eye with its fake ribbon face.

entry: 胸前鲜艳的花纹，在警告天敌它身怀剧毒。只咬一口，就能让目标无法动弹。
author: melodydelune
source: The brightly colored patterns on its chest warn predators of its highly toxic venom. A single bite can leave a target unable to move.

entry: POKENAME用两条尾巴缠住废楼的横梁或排水管。谁若从下方经过，就会被它口中的火焰烤焦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME winds its two tails around beams or drainpipes in abandoned buildings. Anyone passing underneath it is roasted by a flame from its maw.

entry: 任何看见POKENAME的人，都会心生恐惧。蛇般的尾巴仿佛各有思想，而且和本体一样记仇。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME cause feelings of dread to all who look upon it. Its snake-like tails seem to have minds of their own, all just as vindictive as the body.

entry: POKENAME高举双翼，放大尖鸣，显得比本来更加庞大，让敌人吓得动弹不得。再用尾巴卷住晕头转向的猎物，载向远处，从此再无踪影。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise their wings and amplify their piercing cries to appear even larger than they already are, paralyzing foes with fear. They coil their tails around their disoriented prey and lift them off, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME用全身各处擒住、缠绕猎物。力气足以把汽车压成直径仅几英寸的圆球。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME grapple and wrap up prey with every part of their body. They have the strength to crush a car into a sphere only a few inches in diameter.

entry: 它吐出胃酸溶解猎物，再吞下化成的浆液。食物会让酸性更强，所以它整天都在寻觅更大的一餐。
author: pokepower
source: It brings up stomach acid to dissolve prey, then consumes the sludge. Food makes the acid stronger, so it seeks bigger meals all through the day.

entry: 它用颈部发光的脸形花纹吓唬猎物，夜里尤其有效。目标若逃，定会被它追上。
author: staghorn
source: It uses the glowing face on its neck to terrify its prey, particularly at night. If its target tries to run away, it chases them down without fail.

entry: 火山岩石基部，常能看见POKENAME喷火。看它火焰的颜色，还能预知即将到来的喷发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are most commonly found on the rocky base of volcanoes spitting fire. The color of the flame can be used to predict an approaching eruption.

entry: POKENAME遇险时会从天花板落下，以柔软的头部缓冲。嘴里却会不受控制地冒出小火苗。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it drops from the ceiling and cushions the fall with its soft head, uncontrollably emitting small flames from its mouth.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: chorb33
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: chorb33
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，整天跑个不停。累了就赶紧喝一口奶，转身又继续飞奔。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME runs around all day, full of energy. Eventually, when it gets tired, it takes a quick milk drink and goes right back to dashing around.

entry: 它高速旋转，释放体内储存的奶，一次最多能装90加仑。
author: seggule
source: It releases the milk stored within its body by spinning at a high pace. It is capable of storing up to 90 gallons at a time.

entry: 它会寻找内心受伤的人，温柔安慰。产出的热奶，还是帮助入眠的好东西。
author: seggule
source: It seeks out people who are suffering emotionally and comforts them. The warm milk it produces is a great sleep remedy.

entry: 它们最擅长制酪。卡洛斯流行的许多上等奶酪，都出自品味讲究的POKENAME之手。
author: quote.lass
source: Their greatest skill is cheesemaking. Many of the gourmet varieties of cheese popular across Kalos were cultivated by discerning POKENAME.

entry: 它不断从双臂喷奶，借反冲向后飞。一旦奶用尽，便摔落地面，只得再补充。
author: seggule
source: It propels itself backwards by constantly blasting milk from its arms. Once it runs out of milk, it crashes to the ground and has to recharge.

entry: 舔一口这把凝乳之刃，美味又饱腹。可若咬下去，它就会反击；若被刀刃割伤，还会肚子痛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A lick of this solidified milk blade is delicious and filling. A bite, however, will cause retaliation, and a cut from it will cause a stomach ache.

entry: 传说，它深夜潜入卧房，用奶带来噩梦。乳糖不耐受的人，尤其是它优先挑选的目标。
author: seggule
source: Legends say that it enters bedrooms late at night to give people milk-induced nightmares. Lactose intolerant people are considered high priority targets.

entry: 每小时产奶5加仑，尾巴最多能储900加仑。每周一次，它把奶倒进地上的洞里，积成一片奶湖。
author: seggule
source: It produces 5 gallons of milk an hour and can store up to 900 gallons in its tail. Once a week, it disposes the milk into a hole in the ground, creating a lake of milk.

entry: 棺内之物，都浸在发酵乳中保存。曾有一伙行迹可疑的家伙，从通风口潜入博物馆，偷走一具空的POKENAME棺材。
author: seggule
source: The contents within its coffin are preserved in fermented milk. An empty POKENAME coffin was once stolen from a museum by a suspicious crew who entered through the vents.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME朝来犯者喷出滚烫的奶，造成严重灼伤。加热速度如此快，POKENAME在厨房里，也很能帮忙。
author: mistymagius
source: When in danger, POKENAME sprays scalding-hot milk on its attackers, causing severe burns. Due to how fast it can heat up its milk, POKENAME are quite helpful in cooking.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚勤恳的伙伴，既会收割庄稼，也会替花园除草。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are loyal and hard-working companions. They harvest crops and pull weeds from gardens.

entry: POKENAME在一些地区被视为珍馐。融合时意外发生的变异，让它产出的不是奶，而是奶酪。
author: forbiddenbread
source: It is a delicacy in some regions. Due to an unforeseen mutation during the fusion process of POKENAME, it produces cheese in place of milk.

entry: POKENAME甲壳下有许多乳腺，能借尖刺把奶喷向敌人。随着POKENAME不断滚动，奶也渐渐搅成浓厚奶油。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has multiple milk glands underneath its carapace which it will spray at its attacker through its spines. As POKENAME rolls around, the milk eventually turns into a rich cream.

entry: 与雪妖女不同，POKENAME很乐意帮助迷路的旅人。它会递上一杯热奶，再把旅人带回有人烟的地方。
author: dodoowner_
source: Unlike it's Froslass counterpart, POKENAME loves to help lost travelers. It gives them a hot glass of milk and guides them back to civilization.

entry: 构成POKENAME翅膀的云，在特定条件下会降雨。可落下的不是水，而是牛奶。
author: gp423
source: The clouds that make up POKENAME's wings will precipitate under specific conditions. Instead of water, however, these clouds will rain milk.

entry: 用POKENAME出产的原料制作的冰淇淋，被视为美味佳肴。细滑的口感，能让人暖到心里。
author: dodoowner_
source: Ice cream made with POKENAME's resources are considered delicacies. The smooth texture makes people feel warm inside.

entry: POKENAME由乳品精华凝成，不停追寻乳汁，那是它唯一的生命来源。渴求的乳汁供它行动，令它成为毫不留情的存在。
author: slowforest
source: Forged from the essence of dairy, POKENAME relentlessly hunts milk, its sole life force. It is a merciless force fueled by the very essence it craves.

entry: 它每天能产超过五加仑奶。可奶是一瞬间全涌出来的，根本来不及躲开。
author: wormspawn
source: It provides over five gallons of milk a day. However, since this deluge happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

entry: POKENAME每天喝五加仑奶，身体越来越强、速度越来越快，智力却跟着下降。
author: sonic3knuckles
source: POKENAME drinks five gallons of milk daily. While this makes them grow stronger and faster, their intelligence suffers.

entry: 大多数训练家一见它就感到不安。POKENAME的两个头，也时刻受着中央乳房的惊吓。
author: dodoowner_
source: Most Trainers feel uneasy when they see this fusion. The two heads of POKENAME are constantly terrorized by the udders in the middle.

entry: 传说喝下POKENAME的奶，就会遭受永恒诅咒。不过，没人能忍着直视它那么久，撑到把奶挤出来。
author: darkweavile428
source: Legends say that anyone who drinks POKENAME's milk will be cursed for all eternity. However, no one can stand the sight of it long enough to milk it.

entry: POKENAME总是快快乐乐，爱寻找有烦恼的孩子，用腹部心形图案发出的魔法光芒帮他们排忧解难。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always happy. It likes to seek out children with problems and help solve them through a magical light from the heart on its belly.

entry: POKENAME用宝可梦中心采集的数据完成了升级，程序使它能照料电脑盒子中存放的宝可梦蛋。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME was upgraded with data collected by Pokémon Centers. Its programming allows it to care for Pokémon eggs stored in PC boxes.

entry: POKENAME将迷路的登山客收留到洞穴，照料他们直到离开。石头般的皮毛也不易受损。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will take in lost hikers into their cave and look after them until they leave. Its stone-like fur is resistant to damage.

entry: POKENAME平时善良温和，可若有人想拿走它的蛋，就会气势汹汹地用蛋形尾巴攻击。
author: krune
source: POKENAME can be very kind and gentle creatures, but should you try to take its egg, they will get aggressive and use their egg-shaped tail to attack.

entry: 野生POKENAME会收留找到的弃蛋，照料到孵化。若新生的宝可梦愿意，POKENAME便将其当作亲生孩子养大。
author: hello_i_exist
source: Wild POKENAME has a tendency to adopt abandoned eggs it finds in the wild until they hatch. If the newly hatched Pokémon is willing, POKENAME will raise it as its own.

entry: 背上的巨蛋蕴藏太过强烈的幸福，吃下它甚至被认为十分危险。因此POKENAME总将它严密守护。
author: pizzarcato
source: The massive egg on its back contains such potent happiness that eating it is considered dangerous. As a result, POKENAME keeps it well-protected.

entry: POKENAME虽身形魁梧，却十分友善。若看见宝可梦遭到欺负，就会挺身而出，把欺负者狠狠揍一顿。
author: pepperthepirate
source: Despite its hulking stature, POKENAME is very friendly. If it sees a Pokémon getting picked on, it will step in and utterly wallop the attacker.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的蛋既营养丰富，又蕴含使人焕发活力的灵力。头顶的触角，让它能同时听见现世与灵界传来的警讯。
author: voiddx01
source: POKENAME's eggs are said to contain both extraordinary amounts of nutrients and rejuvenating spiritual energy. The antenna on its head allows it to hear alerts from both the physical world and the spirit world.

entry: 这把剑轻轻一触，既能治好伤口，也能让对手萌生停战和好的愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A gentle touch from this sword not only heals wounds, but also fills opponents with an urge to stop fighting and make up.

entry: 蛋被视为珍馐，让野生POKENAME演化出钙质凝聚的外骨骼，借此对抗偷猎者。
author: yersin1a
source: Their eggs are considered delicacies, so wild POKENAME developed calcium-condensed exoskeletons to help them fight against poachers.

entry: POKENAME发现伤者时，会一边用幻象保护，一边为其治疗。谁也拦不住它救治附近的每一个人。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.

entry: POKENAME的疗愈能力十分独特。粉红电流轻轻一击，就能帮助治愈多种伤病。
author: Trainerrobo
source: POKENAME has very unique healing properties. One zap from its pink electricity can help cure many different types of wounds and illnesses.

entry: 据说揉一揉盖上的蛋会得到幸福，弄裂却会招来可怕诅咒。古时，它曾是长寿的象征。
author: faelocke
source: The egg on its lid is said to give happiness when rubbed, but bestow horrible curses if cracked. In ancient times, it was a symbol of longevity.

entry: 许多宝可梦中心，都请POKENAME帮忙，把药水等治疗用品，迅速送到训练家手中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are used in many Pokémon Centers to quickly ship potions and other healing items to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME翅上散出的粉尘，一接触就能治愈伤者。据说见到它的人，也会获得健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's wings spread a dust which heals people on contact. If you see this Pokémon, it is said good health will be given to you.

entry: 一察觉有人悲伤，它就会离开藏身处奔向对方，分享带来幸福的蛋，不管路途有多远。
author: tomatosalad
source: When it senses sadness in a person, this Pokémon will leave hiding and race to them to share an egg of happiness, no matter how far it must travel.

entry: POKENAME的蛋散发怡人香气，却含有微量毒素。闻得太久，可能损害健康。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's egg emits a pleasant aroma. However, prolonged exposure to the smell can result in health problems, as it contains trace amounts of poison.

entry: POKENAME用育儿袋，偷走毫无防备的宝可梦的蛋，再把蛋存成日后的点心。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME use their pouches to snatch eggs from unsuspecting Pokémon. They then proceed to store the egg as a snack for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME在降雪中隐去身影，寻找冻僵的遗骸，希望用生命力填满自己的蛋。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME hide their presence during snowfall. They can be found searching for frozen remains, hoping to fill their egg with lifeforce.

entry: POKENAME喜欢携带能孵化的蛋，还常从别人那里偷来。幼崽孵出后，它会一直带着，直到大得带不下。
author: sitten1115
source: POKENAME prefer to carry fertile eggs, often stealing them from others. Once an egg hatches, the infant is carried until it grows too large.

entry: POKENAME的吼声比雷鸣更响。利爪会在领地内的树木上留下锯齿般的焦痕，满是电灼的伤迹。
author: cristata
source: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能召来持续一个多月的巨大雷暴。每拍一次翅膀，雷鸣的威力就足以夷平房屋。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, it summons massive thunderstorms that can last for over a month. Every flap of its wings causes thunderclaps strong enough to flatten houses.

entry: POKENAME专攻出其不意，常从对手背后，突然施以电击。
author: gayschlatt
source: POKENAME relies on the element of surprise to shock its opponents from behind.

entry: POKENAME的一记十万伏特，便能将高树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: gayschlatt
source: A Thunderbolt from POKENAME can split a tall tree clean in two.

entry: POKENAME是雷霆般的斗士，兼具火焰鸡的格斗技巧与雷公的力量，出招迅疾如电。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a thunderous brawler. Fusing Blaziken's fighting prowess with Raikou's power, it is capable of launching attacks at lightning speed.

entry: POKENAME乘着浮空的雷云，以闪电般的电击贯穿目标。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME pierces its victims with the electric impact of lightning. It rides on a floating storm cloud.

entry: POKENAME将庞大的电能化为速度，快得唯有闪电能够比拟，因此鲜少被人看见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has been seen very rarely since it converts astronomical amounts of electricity into a speed that is only matched by lightning.

entry: POKENAME只在火山将喷发前出现，因此，遇见它总令人害怕。若遭到攻击，便喷出大量炽热火山灰，几分钟就能让人窒息。
author: mistymagius
source: Sightings of POKENAME are always feared since they only appear right before a volcanic eruption. If they are attacked, they spew tons of hot ash that can suffocate anyone in minutes.

entry: POKENAME控火本领高强，被称为“余烬女皇”。绰号虽吓人，心地却十分善良。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME has been nicknamed "Empress of the Ember" for its pyrokinetic prowess. Even with this intimidating moniker, it is very kindhearted.

entry: POKENAME的雕像，是怀有怨恨的火神之灵的容器。仔细聆听，能从内部听见火焰的噼啪声。
author: patch_bros
source: The statue of POKENAME is a vessel for a vengeful spirit of a flame deity. If you listen closely, sounds of crackling fire can be heard from within.

entry: 最初的POKENAME，铸成于岩浆之中。据说，它附着火山的灵魂；剑一出鞘，另一座火山便会喷发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The first POKENAME was forged in magma. It is said that it's possessed by the spirit of a volcano, and when it unsheathes, another volcano erupts.

entry: 这只美得惊人的宝可梦，仿佛热情的化身，常出现在火山温泉旁。传说有位造物之神，守护着水火交会的温泉，有人便认为，POKENAME是祂的化身。
author: alkazamis
source: This stunningly beautiful Pokémon embodies passion. It is typically found near volcanic hot springs. Legends tell of a creator deity that is a patron of hot springs, where fire and water meet, and some people believe POKENAME is that deity's avatar.

entry: POKENAME吃熔岩，让身体保持液态。体温一低，便黏稠得动弹不得。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on lava to keep its body in a liquid state. If its body temperature gets too low, its body becomes so viscous that it can no longer move.

entry: 冰爪极其锋利，刃口仅3微米宽。即便如此，这些利刃仍几乎无法损坏。
author: gp423
source: Its icy claws are so sharp, the edges are a mere three micrometers wide. Despite this, these blades are virtually indestructible.

entry: POKENAME守护广阔水域，不容任何污染。它平时沉静，一旦水受到玷污，POKENAME便会狂怒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects large bodies of water from any form of pollution. Despite usually being a calm Pokémon, POKENAME will fly into a frenzy if its water becomes tainted.

entry: POKENAME耐心而沉稳。据说很久以前，它曾用强健的头冠推动冰川，横越大地，开辟新的河道。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is a patient, stoic Pokémon. It is said that long ago, it used its powerful crown to push glaciers across the land and carve new rivers.

entry: POKENAME借缎带乘北风而行，寻找蓄水之地，再将剑刃浸入其中，净化水源。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME rides the north wind with its ribbon in search of water reservoirs. It rests its blade in them to purify them.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会给湖边村落带来雨水。若有人辜负信任，污染湖泊，它就唤来巨型暴雨，将整片地方淹没。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to bring rain to villages that surround its lake. If anyone betrays its trust by ruining its lakes, it will summon massive rainstorms to completely flood the area.

entry: 若有谁扰乱POKENAME栖息的湖，它便收起沉静姿态，召来溺亡者的灵魂，诅咒闯入者。
author: glacierwing
source: If anything disturbs the lake where POKENAME lives, it will drop its calm demeanor and call on the spirits of the drowned to curse the trespasser.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀映出北极光般的美景。有时它出现在不合时宜的时刻、季节或地点，令人惊叹不已。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME's wings mimic the beauty of the Aurora Borealis. Some people are shocked to see them at unusual times of day, year, or location.

entry: 它藏在幽暗深水里，一察觉污染，便跃出水面，袭向罪魁祸首，将其拖向毁灭。
author: skymaster426
source: It hides in the dark depths of the water. If it senses that the water is polluted, it leaps out and attacks the culprit, dragging them to their fate.

entry: POKENAME的毒针是好用的钻头，可磨损得快，只能短时间使用。
author: alexanderc321
source: A POKENAME stinger can be used as an effective drill, though it wears down quick, and therefore, can only be used for short amounts of time.

entry: POKENAME太重，唯有最猛烈的风暴，才能将它们吹得很远。平日所谓“飞行”，不过从沙丘顶滑翔一小段。它们的到来，被视为沙暴将至的不祥预兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are too heavy to be carried long distances by any but the strongest of storms, limiting their 'flights' to short glides from the top of dunes. Their arrival in a region is treated as an ill-omen as heralds of sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME收在鞘中，静卧地下深处，吸收周围泥土。只有受威胁时，才会出鞘迎战。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME rests deep underground, sheathed, absorbing the soil around it. It only unsheathes to fight when it is under threat.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的伏击猎手，几乎整天埋在沙下，或钻行岩间，通常只露出背刺。粗心的训练家踩上去，就会遭到袭击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An ambush predator in desert environments, POKENAME spends almost all of its time buried in sand and burrowing through rock. It can usually only be spotted by its back spines, often leading to unwary Trainers being attacked for stepping on them.

entry: POKENAME是干旱之地独来独往的猎手，四处迁徙。为了找猎物、守领地，它用后腿站立行走，比四足时看得更远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A nomadic hunter, POKENAME lives a solitary life in arid environments. To help them find prey and to guard their territory, they move about on their hind legs, granting a better view of their surroundings than if they were quadrupedal.

entry: POKENAME浑身披着坚硬石刺，却只在与同族争夺领地时，用来保卫自己。荒原上，它们的咆哮能传出几英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Covered in hard stone spines, POKENAME uses these spines solely to defend itself in territorial conflicts with other members of its own species. Their roar can travel for miles through the wastelands in which they live.

entry: POKENAME脾气很差，发怒时会猛烈甩头。头上岩石般坚固的甲片，足以击碎防弹玻璃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very irritable and will flail their heads if angered. The tough, rocklike plates on their heads are enough to shatter bulletproof glass.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: 只要时间足够，POKENAME连最硬的基岩也能钻穿。洞穴深入之处，早已超过其他宝可梦能够生存的范围。
author: staghorn
source: Given enough time, a POKENAME can dig through even the hardest of bedrock. Its burrows stretch past the point where any other Pokémon can survive.

entry: 它用强健的角撞倒树木，划定领地。较弱的POKENAME则成群漫游，寻找更强的对手。
author: al_chimera
source: This Pokémon marks its territory by knocking down trees with its powerful horns. Weaker POKENAME roam in packs to seek stronger opponents.

entry: POKENAME用双颚从山体咬下大块岩石，开凿洞穴。入侵者会迎来它的暴怒，随后被吞食。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME uses its jaws to tear chunks of rock out of mountainous terrain to create a cave. Intruders are met with fury and rage before being devoured.

entry: POKENAME什么都不懂，只知用岩石般的头猛撞眼前一切。连整片山脉都曾败在它面前。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME knows nothing else but to smash its rocky head into anything directly in front of it. Entire mountain ranges have lost to this Pokémon.

entry: 下半身的各个孔洞不断喷出沙子。战斗时，它便将这些受诅咒的沙卷成猛烈沙暴。
author: moopse
source: Sand spews from all of the orifices on its lower body. In battle, it whips this cursed sand into a harsh sandstorm.

entry: POKENAME是荒原顶级强者，巡行家园，确信无人敢与自己为敌。它会凶猛追逐领地中的一切，研究行为的学者，可得格外谨慎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An apex Pokémon, POKENAME stalks its wasteland home in the certainty that there is nothing that can challenge it. Pokémon researchers trying to learn its behaviors need to remain wary as it aggressively chases down anything in its territory.

entry: POKENAME护领地护得厉害，常在巨石上磨爪，留下记号警告闯入者。登山者最好留意爪痕，免得无意撞见它。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. They often sharpen their claws on large boulders to mark its domain to intruders. Hikers are warned to keep an eye out for scratched boulders to avoid unintended encounters with this Pokémon.

entry: 一只POKENAME曾借沙暴掩护，以吐息将沙化为玻璃，独自挡住整支军队，因此被称为“沙之将军”。
author: therider
source: Called the "General of the Sands", a lone POKENAME once held off an army by using a sandstorm as cover and turning the sand to glass with its breath.

entry: POKENAME会闯入大钳蟹的群落，向其中的巨钳蟹挑衅。巨钳蟹一旦落败，POKENAME便开始在群落里作威作福。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are known to target colonies of Krabby to start fights with their Kinglers. If the Kinglers lose, then POKENAME begins to rule as a tyrant.

entry: 这种宝可梦色彩绚丽，谁敲得响它最爱的玩具鼓，它便热切靠近。赢得信任与尊重后，它还会载你飞翔，环游世界。
author: jackster
source: A brilliantly-colored Pokémon which will eagerly approach any Trainer that manages to play its favorite toy drum. This magnificent creature will carry you around as it flies across the globe, but only once you earn its trust and respect.

entry: 据说，帕底亚只有在漫长又凶险的洪水过后，才会出现POKENAME。也有人认为，这不过是传说。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are only spotted in Paldea after a long, dangerous flood. Others say this is only a myth, though.

entry: 据说深色身体与红眼，是接触罕见能量波的结果。此现象最早记录于欧雷地区。
author: staghorn
source: Its dark coloration and red eyes is said to be the result of exposure to rare energy waves. The phenomenon was first recorded in the Orre region.

entry: 它们优雅而令人安心，拍翼声如银铃。但若惹怒POKENAME，就会置身狂风暴雨之中。
author: quote.lass
source: They are elegant and soothing, with wings that sound like silver bells. Make POKENAME angry, however, and you'll find yourself in a tempest.

entry: POKENAME常沉稳又慈爱，喜欢照顾、庇护别人。若受照料的孩子开始胡闹，POKENAME便会严肃告诫，及时纠正。
author: mileysakiko
source: POKENAME are often stoic and matronly, known for their tendency to take others under their wing. If their charge begins to act out, POKENAME are swift to correct this poor behavior with a stern warning.

entry: POKENAME只需挥动一次利刃，就能摧毁房屋。因此，它平时会将刀刃收回鞘中，在海底休息。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With a slash of its blade, POKENAME can destroy houses. As a result, it chooses to rest sheathed in the ocean floor.

entry: 它来回扭动身体就能发电。徒手抓POKENAME这种错误，捕虫少年很少会犯第二次。
author: staghorn
source: It generates a charge by wiggling its body back and forth. Holding a POKENAME with bare hands is a mistake bug catchers rarely make twice.

entry: POKENAME能从口颚传导电流，常被警方用来让嫌疑人暂时无法动弹。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME transmits electricity through its mandibles. It is commonly used by police to temporarily immobilize suspects.

entry: POKENAME会在雷暴时升到高空，吸收闪电中的电力维生。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME floats high into the sky during thunderstorms to absorb electricity from the lightning bolts for nutrition.

entry: 长脖子与喙很适合灵巧捕食。若没能成功，迅速放一次电，就能击倒整池鱼。
author: essie
source: Its long neck and beak are designed to deftly catch prey. If that doesn't work, a quick electric burst will take out a whole pond of fish.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: 被POKENAME刺中，犹如遭雷击。POKENAME会把自己插进插座充电，经常造成停电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Being stabbed by POKENAME is comparable to being struck by lightning. POKENAME recharges by plugging itself into outlets, often causing outages.

entry: 被这把匕首划伤，感觉如同挨了电击枪。它用这种通常不致命的反击，吓阻突然伸手抓它的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A cut from this dagger is comparable to being tased, a less-than-lethal deterrent to being suddenly grabbed.

entry: POKENAME像使用搭电线一样，用缎带夹住目标注入电力。修车师傅常靠它替汽车搭电启动。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons like jumper cables to latch onto its target and fill it with electricity. It's often used by mechanics to jump-start cars.

entry: 和皮卡丘不同，POKENAME即使被摸到尾巴，也不慌不忙。体形更大、力量更强，让POKENAME不再把这种接触，当作威胁。
author: over9001
source: Unlike Pikachu, POKENAME remains undisturbed even when its tail is touched. This is because POKENAME doesn't see this action as a threat anymore, due to its increased size and power.

entry: 在妖精之力的帮助下，皮丘学会控制电力，也与附在自己身上的谜拟Ｑ成了朋友。这份新结下的羁绊，促使它进化成POKENAME。
author: adoster
source: After using its fairy powers to help control its electricity, Pichu becomes friends with the Mimikyu possessing it. This newfound bond causes it to evolve into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME是小小的发电高手，体积小、输出电压高，常由发电厂员工照料。
author: supersonicloki
source: An electrical powerhouse; POKENAME is often found in the care of power plant employees due to its small size and voltage output.

entry: 它在乐队工作，每场演出都不缺席。POKENAME其实并不演奏，而是给各件乐器供电。
author: dodoowner_
source: It works for a band and goes to every concert. Instead of playing for the band, POKENAME actually charges each instrument.

entry: POKENAME会竖起毛发积蓄电力，再在POKENAME击中对手时释放电流。
author: mossybanana
source: A POKENAME charges electricity by bristling its fur. It is then discharged when POKENAME strikes their opponents.

entry: POKENAME躲在插座里，拿电击捉弄靠近的人。电若不设法放掉，积得太多，就会失控。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide inside electrical sockets, playfully shocking anyone that comes near. Its electricity will grow out of control if it doesn't discharge it somehow.

entry: 一片大水域附近发生化学品泄漏后，POKENAME开始大量出现。它们大多开朗又富有爱心。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.

entry: 它心地仁慈，会赐福给内心纯净的训练家。据说歌声能令每位听众感到无比喜悦。
author: mistymagius
source: This benevolent Pokémon will grant blessing to Trainers that are pure of heart. Its singing voice is said to bring any listeners pure euphoria.

entry: 传说POKENAME的叶片有机会让死者复生。身体散发着彩虹般七彩的温暖光辉。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say the leaves from a POKENAME have a chance to bring back the dead. Its body gives off a warm glow in every color of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME高贵而罕见，喜欢住在塔顶与山巅。缘朱市优雅的舞者，常从它身上汲取灵感。
author: quote.lass
source: A regal and seldom-seen Pokémon that prefers to live atop towers and mountains. The elegant dancers of Ecruteak take great inspiration from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从不真正死去，会忠诚侍奉主人，直到最后。可即使殒命后能够重生，它依然是濒危物种。
author: thenebulamage
source: POKENAME never truly dies and will loyally serve its master until the end. It remains an endangered species despite its ability to be reborn upon demise.

entry: 据说POKENAME的神圣之火能净化一切。传说它正等待着某一天，遇见一个连它的火焰也伤不了的人。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that POKENAME's sacred fire can purify anything. According to legend, it waits for the day it meets a human that its flames cannot burn.

entry: 古代有个文明，曾崇拜彩虹般的存在。据说，POKENAME缤纷的火焰，正是那个文明梦想的结晶。
author: mpotter75
source: The colorful flames of POKENAME are said to be the culmination of the dreams of an ancient civilization that worshiped a rainbow being.

entry: POKENAME总在雨后现身，伴着彩虹而来。能遇见它们，便是好运的征兆。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME always come out after the rain. They bring rainbows along with them and seeing them is a sign of good fortune.

entry: 世界各地的建筑工地，都曾发现POKENAME的雕像。许多人相信，它会保护勤恳劳作的人和宝可梦。
author: leshii
source: Statues of POKENAME have been found at construction sites around the world. Many believe it grants protection to hard-working people and Pokémon.

entry: 它穿梭时间，仿佛鱼儿游水，只在无人能看见的时刻停留，是历来最难找的宝可梦之一。
author: ozydamians
source: It flits through time like a fish swims through water. It pauses in moments where nobody is around to see it, making it one of the hardest to find Pokémon in history.

entry: POKENAME是极少数在晨昏活动的咕咕变种。不知为何，它常栖在森林神社顶上。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of the very few crepuscular variants of Hoothoot. For some strange reason, it can often be found perched atop forest shrines.

entry: 这对搭档喜欢穿梭于不同时代，用力量改变关键事件，创造新的时间线。
author: jackjirachi
source: This duo loves to traverse through time periods. They alter key events with their powers, creating new timelines.

entry: 据说它守护着时间本身，为确保未来免于毁灭，不遗余力。
author: gayschlatt
source: This Pokémon is said to be the guardian of time itself. It's very passionate in making sure the future doesn't fall into ruin.

entry: 它快得足以穿越时间本身。据说消失的瞬间，周围空气都会被点燃。
author: captainzscourge
source: Due to this Pokémon's speed, it is able to pass through time itself. It is said that when it does so, the air is set ablaze as it disappears.

entry: 据说POKENAME是一次失败的时间旅行产生的异常存在。它已见尽永恒，脑海中燃烧着诡秘莫测的知识。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. Having seen all of eternity, its mind burns with eldritch knowledge.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能把全身缩进大壳里避难。缩进去后，偶尔还会被误认成一枚空壳。
author: captainzscourge
source: Thanks to its small body, POKENAME it is able to withdraw into its large shell as a shelter. Sometimes it is mistaken for a shell when it does so.

entry: POKENAME双目全盲，栖息地底洞穴，靠回声定位认路。它们常分不清洞底与水面，因此长着巨大的浮尾，万一坠水，也不至于沉下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and roost in underground caves, using their echolocation to navigate. They often struggle to differentiate water from cave floors, so they have large tail floats to prevent sinking if they crash.

entry: POKENAME还不太会飞，便用弹尾，把自己送离地面。遇上心怀恶意的人或宝可梦，它常会吓得僵住。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is not very good at flying yet, so it uses its bouncy tail to get off the ground. It tends to freeze up around malicious people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常在河床附近哭泣。住在附近的居民，总抱怨它们整夜吵闹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found crying near riverbeds. Residents who live near these Pokémon often complain about their loud noises over the night.

entry: 它会装成被自己的尾巴扎伤，好让敌人轻视。可真不小心扎到自己时，也一样哭得伤心。
author: staghorn
source: It pretends to be harmed by its own tail so that its foes underestimate it. It cries just as hard when it pricks itself on accident.

entry: POKENAME用软软的刀刃割断果梗，再以缎带将果实扔进嘴里。它还会反复弯折刀刃，让其变得更韧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME harvests fruits by cutting stems with its floppy blade and chucking them into its mouth with its ribbon. It bends its blade to toughen it.

entry: 看似POKENAME尾羽的东西，其实是灵巧的附肢，能极精准地摆弄物件。
author: bee4082
source: What look like POKENAME's tail feathers are actually dextrous appendages. It uses these to manipulate objects with incredible precision.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴会影响平衡，使转速变慢。不过甩出的力道，仍足以将相扑力士打飞。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's spins are slower due to its tails affecting its balance. However, the impact of them is powerful enough to send a sumo wrestler flying.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞奔，试图耗尽其体力。有时边跑边喝特制汽水，进一步增强本领。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME races around its opponent in order to tire it out. Sometimes, it drinks a special soda while doing so, further enhancing its abilities.

entry: POKENAME住在大树根间。有宝可梦经过，POKENAME便伸出长长的肢体，将对方拖入地下。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME can be found residing in the roots of large trees.  When Pokémon come by, POKENAME use their lengthy limbs to pull them underground.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，会用尾巴撑起身体，再将自己猛掷向敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: When POKENAME is angered, it will lift itself up using its tails and hurl itself towards enemies.

entry: POKENAME用其他宝可梦的骨头，调制药液。有时，也会把有益的药水，分给训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mixes brews with the bones of other Pokémon. They sometimes share beneficial potions with their Trainer.

entry: 人们普遍猜测，POKENAME的骨头里藏着许多咒术与诅咒。大多数人都尽量远离它。
author: dodoowner_
source: Popular conjecture theorizes that POKENAME's bones hold many curses and spells. Most people try to stay away from this Pokémon.

entry: 魔法咒语让它能用新方式操纵水，甚至使水穿墙而过。它还会往讨厌者的饮料里施下可怕诅咒。
author: vaporvenator
source: Magic spells grant it new ways to manipulate water, such as phasing it through walls. It taints the drinks of those it dislikes with terrible curses.

entry: POKENAME的毛看着蓬松，令人想摸。可若未经POKENAME同意就伸手，它燃起的火焰，足以将人严重烧伤。
author: alumed
source: While the fur of POKENAME may appear fluffy and inviting, touching a POKENAME against its will may cause intense burns due to the flames it generates.

entry: POKENAME吞下迷失的亡魂，再压成绚丽的紫水晶。晶体似乎仍能与其他灵魂，产生共鸣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes lost spirits and then compresses them into gorgeous amethyst crystals. The crystals seem to be able to resonate with other spirits.

entry: 它吟诵的咒文，可能招来突如其来的猛烈风暴。风暴一过，它便往往消失了。
author: captainzscourge
source: The incantations that this Pokémon may chant can cause sudden and violent storms. It often disappears once the storm has passed.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，预示着灾祸。可被收服后，POKENAME又能用敏锐的感官，保护训练家远离危险。
author: sandguything
source: Encountering a POKENAME in the wild forebodes certain calamity. Captured POKENAME utilize their senses to keep their Trainer out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME熟练地将黑暗魔法与体内电力结合。被逼到极限时，雷电便会黑如夜色。
author: maugre
source: POKENAME has mastered the art of combining dark magic with its body's electricity. When pushed to the limit, its thunder bolts become black as night.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的汤，能溶掉扔进去的一切肉食。若配料得当，还能召出幽魂，替它办事。
author: doodledoo
source: It is said that the stew POKENAME carries on its back is able to dissolve all meat that's thrown into it. With the right ingredients, it's able to conjure ghostly apparitions that carry out its deeds.

entry: 盾牌般的脸，护住它诵念咒语、折磨来犯者。可后方防守薄弱，最终导致它灭绝。
author: darkweavile428
source: Its shield-like face protects it while it chants incantations to torment its attacker. A weakness to attacks from behind lead to its extinction.

entry: POKENAME从学徒成长为师父，开始教导同族。各群POKENAME与各自的徒弟，会为争夺高下而较量。
author: awiralonprime
source: Having gone from student to master, POKENAME teaches its brethren. Groups of POKENAME and their apprentices compete for superiority.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会来到醉心黑魔法的人面前。它们骗来的灵魂，被酿成神秘药液，供火焰燃烧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME appear late at night in front of those interested in dark magic. Their flames are powered by a mystical brew of the souls they've deceived.

entry: 初学灵异之术的灵异迷，有个忠诚伙伴，就是POKENAME。它爱帮忙寻觅大锅药液的配料，自己施起法，也毫不逊色。
author: nellnast42
source: A loyal Pokémon from budding Hex Maniacs. POKENAME loves to fetch ingredients for a cauldron's brew, but is more than capable of spellcasting for itself.

entry: 据说POKENAME是受不幸吸引而来的灵体。虽然灾祸并非它们所致，这份恶名仍让人类不愿亲近。
author: sandguything
source: POKENAME are said to be spirits that are attracted to misfortune. While not the direct cause, that stigma makes them not very loved by humans.

entry: 梦磁怪会被严重的不幸事件吸引，聚在一起，融合成POKENAME。仍戴着帽子的那只，就是最先赶到现场的个体。
author: sandguything
source: Mismites are attracted to larger cases of misfortune, merging together to become POKENAME. The one keeping its hat was the first to the scene.

entry: POKENAME常游荡在曾发生重大惨剧的老建筑中。若遭打扰，便手持骨制刺剑，攻击闯入者。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME is said to often roam old buildings with a history of great tragedy. When disturbed, it attacks trespassers with bone rapiers.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它们举止潇洒，会偷羽毛装点外衣与帽子。外衣越大，在族群中的权势也越大。
author: mistymagius
source: These suave Pokémon will steal feathers to build out their coat and hat. The larger the coat, the more power they have over their pack.

entry: 在传说受诅咒的夜晚，POKENAME会率领黑暗剑鞘大军，诅咒整座城镇。慢慢吞尽居民的生命力，便再转往下一处。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: On nights said to be cursed, POKENAME leads an army of Muredge to curse an entire town. They slowly consume their life force and eventually move onto the next.

entry: POKENAME竭力装得可爱亲人，诱人靠近。不过，这只是狡计：不付出什么，就换来食物、住处与悉心照料。养熟后，它便懒散又固执。
author: sontyp
source: A POKENAME does its best to appear cute and approachable to lure humans closer. This is, however, just a devious scheme to gain food, shelter and attentive care for little return.  Once domesticated, this Pokémon becomes lazy and stubborn.

entry: POKENAME的几个头像天平一样，称量生灵的善恶业报，再作出裁决。它住在阴暗森林中。
author: anlcorpagent
source: POKENAME's heads operate as a scale, weighing the karma of creatures and delivering a verdict. It resides in dark forests.

entry: POKENAME用单脚摇摆，每秒都变换方向，平衡却丝毫不乱，边动还边发出咔嗒声。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME swings on one foot, changing direction every second, never losing its balance. It makes clicking noises as it does so.

entry: 战斗中，野生POKENAME常一动不动，试着模仿从父母身上学来的本领。可要把能量反送给敌人，它们还不熟练。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, wild POKENAME often stay still, trying to mimic what they have learned from their parents. They are not yet skilled at channeling energy back at the foe, however.

entry: POKENAME究竟是木头雕好后石化，还是从一开始就是石头，研究人员尚无定论。但有一点他们都赞同：里面附着灵魂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers have yet to confirm whether POKENAME was wood that petrified after it was carved or always stone, but they agree that it is possessed.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，借圆珠施展超能力，让路过的人与宝可梦注意不到自己。唯有深夜才活动，将人的梦存进圆珠，留待日后享用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand perfectly still, channeling their psychic powers through their orbs to prevent passing people or Pokémon from noticing them. They only move late at night, storing people's dreams in their orbs to feast on later.

entry: POKENAME爪上的玩偶，常被用来威吓敌人。研究者仍不敢肯定，POKENAME释放的超能力，究竟有没有让玩偶也生出意识。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The puppets on the claws of POKENAME are often used in an intimidation tactic. Researchers are still not entirely sure that the psychic energy POKENAME emits hasn't given them consciousness.

entry: POKENAME藏在异常坚固的盒子里，奏乐吸引人靠近，再捉弄对方，转眼又消失。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hides in its incredibly robust box and plays music so that it can prank approaching people and then disappear again.

entry: POKENAME没有其他熔岩虫融合宝可梦那般高温，摸上去温暖如棉花糖，常与逗孩子的艺人一同表演。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Often used by children's entertainers, POKENAME has lost the heat of other Slugma fusions. Instead, it has a warm, candy floss feel.

entry: POKENAME在夜里活动、捕猎，因为颈部皮膜带着微光，也因为它真正的脸，总藏不住兴奋。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and does most of its hunting at night. This is due to its slightly fluorescent frill pattern, and due to the fact that it struggles to keep excitement from its true face.

entry: POKENAME精通抛接杂耍，靠超能力与磁力，能让球一直悬空。训练家有时也见过，野生POKENAME认真练习整套动作。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME has mastered its juggling abilities and can use its psychic and magnetic abilities to keep the balls it has floating indefinitely. On occasion, Trainers have seen wild POKENAME practicing juggling routines.

entry: POKENAME模样亲切，常在托育中心，为孩子与幼小宝可梦表演。
author: inksans201x
source: Thanks to its friendly appearance, POKENAME are often found in daycares performing for young children and Pokémon alike.

entry: 这把剑的切割能力与普通剑相同。刀刃若爆开，POKENAME便借泄出的空气飞走，到别处重新长好。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword is as effective a cutter as a standard sword. If its blade ever pops, POKENAME uses to expelling air to fly away and regenerate elsewhere.

entry: 连续弹跳的次数越多，刀刃就越有力，POKENAME也越兴奋。它很乐意让孩子拿自己玩耍。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The more successive bounces it achieves, the more powerful the blade and the more excited the POKENAME becomes. It happily lets kids play with it.

entry: 与其他双首暴龙融合体不同，POKENAME的两颗头大多能和睦相处，而且十分爱同台表演。它们会配合超能力，把不同的物品抛接得眼花缭乱。
author: mistymagius
source: Unlike other Zwelious fusions, POKENAME's two heads mostly co-operate with each other and love to perform together. They work in tandem to juggle different objects with their psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME见谁都热情过头，尤其爱逗孩子开心。可无论大人孩子，往往都很怕它。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME acts overly friendly to all who it meets. It loves to entertain children despite both kids and adults alike often being terrified of it.

entry: POKENAME虽没什么肢体，仍尽心模仿别人。最好多鼓励它，因为POKENAME一难过，便会不由自主地放出毒孢子。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME do their best to mimic others, despite their lack of appendages. It's best to encourage this behavior, as when POKENAME get upset they can't help but release toxic spores.

entry: POKENAME翅上脱落的彩纸常被用于生日派对，因此POKENAME很受表演者欢迎。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The confetti that comes off of POKENAME's wings are often often used at birthday parties. POKENAME is popular among entertainers as a result of this.

entry: 这个默剧演员脾气十分凶暴，随时可能毫无预警地出手。训练家教导它时，必须留神。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This mime has a highly aggressive disposition. Trainers should be careful training it, as it is likely to lash out with no warning.

entry: POKENAME新觉醒的第三只眼赋予它强大超能力，常被用来辅助抛接杂耍。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's newly awakened third eye gives it strong psychic powers. It uses this power to assist its juggling.

entry: POKENAME用超能力与磁场，托住抛接的球。可力量并不强，年幼POKENAME尤其如此，球常常掉下来。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME uses both its psychic energy and the magnetic field from its magnets to keep its juggling balls in the air. However, these powers can be quite weak, especially in younger POKENAME, so it often will drop balls.

entry: 进化后，多颗头带来额外磁力，让POKENAME能更好地控制杂耍。常能看见POKENAME身旁，漂着各式金属物件。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Upon its evolution, the extra magnetic power that POKENAME gets from its multiple heads allows for more control over its juggling. It isn't uncommon to see POKENAME floating miscellaneous metallic items around itself.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: 它们精力旺盛又调皮，什么都想拿蛋砸，见谁也想扔。因此，许多地方都不许它们进入。
author: sottiwotti
source: They are very energetic and mischievous Pokémon. They like to throw eggs at anything and everyone, which is why they are banned from many places.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知其他宝可梦的情绪，连一丝负面感受也十分敏感。情绪承受不住时，便尖叫起来，常把附近育幼所的小宝可梦吓一跳。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME uses its antennae to sense the emotions of other Pokémon, becoming highly sensitive to even the slightest negative feelings. When overwhelmed, it lets out a loud screech, often startling other baby Pokémon in nearby nurseries.

entry: POKENAME将找到的白色小物件藏进秘密收藏处，再用缎带赶走入侵者，守住珍藏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stashes away small, white objects it finds in a hidden hoard. It guards it by shooing away invaders with its ribbon.

entry: POKENAME的蛋富含蛋白质。它会送给弱小的宝可梦，鼓励它们长成最出色的自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's eggs are packed with high amounts of protein. It will give out its eggs to weaker Pokémon to encourage them to become the best version of themselves.

entry: POKENAME能结出带着麻舌苦味的柑橘，是制作酸糖的人气原料。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME produce a type of citrus that has an electrifying and bitter taste. It is a popular ingredient in sour candies.

entry: 乍看不过是只大号雷丘。就算脚的模样没让人看出卡比兽血统，那份食量也瞒不过去。
author: faelocke
source: It appears to simply be a very large Raichu at first glance. If its feet don't give away that it's part Snorlax, its appetite will.

entry: 它心地善良，会在风暴中为船只引路，一边飞行，一边用身体吸收落雷。
author: melodydelune
source: This kindhearted Pokémon has been known to guide ships during storms, using its body to absorb lighting strikes as it flies.

entry: 它的毒针攻击带着11000伏电压。收服后，人们常给毒针套上橡胶帽，免遭电击。
author: supersonicloki
source: Its stingers are known to pack a punch of 11,000 volts when used to attack. When captured, many use rubber caps to prevent shocking.

entry: POKENAME已能熟练控电。POKENAME在几条尾巴间产生电能，再以扰乱性的电流释放出去。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME has mastered its control over electricity. The electricity POKENAME generates between its tails can be sent out in disruptive currents.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又容易兴奋。散步时常在训练家脚边穿来绕去，尾巴还迸着电火花。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is incredibly energetic and excitable. It will often weave around Trainers feet while on walks, with electricity sparking off its tail.

entry: 这只顽皮宝可梦在阴影中穿行，电光噼啪，满是捣蛋心思。尾巴一甩，便唤出幽魂般的幻象，迷惑敌人，再迅疾灵巧地出击。
author: thepandasharky
source: This playful Pokémon weaves through shadows, crackling with electric energy and mischief. With a flick of its tail, it conjures ghostly illusions to confuse opponents, striking with surprising speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME先在地面充电，再跃向空中，尾巴朝下猛撞地面，将自己钻入地下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME charges itself with electricity on the surface, then leaps into the air and crashes into the ground, tail first, to dig itself in.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃不停震动，稍有声音就会惊慌。它喜欢独处，可被逼到绝境时，震动也能增强攻击威力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade vibrates and it panics at the slightest sound. It prefers solitude, but when cornered, its vibrations enhance its damage.

entry: 它与其他POKENAME交流时，会将闪电形缎带连在一起，在彼此之间传递电流。
author: melodydelune
source: It communicates with other POKENAME by connecting their lighting-shaped ribbons and sending shocks between them.

entry: POKENAME因两种不同进化石而诞生，难得一见。它在山中凿洞，让电流涌满其中，也给小型电宝可梦与地面宝可梦提供庇护。
author: thepandasharky
source: A result of two different evolution stones, POKENAME are spotted only on rare occasions. It burrows its caves into mountains, filling it with surges of electrical energy. This also provides shelter for smaller electric and ground Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME血脉中能流过300万伏电压，是雷丘放电电压的30倍。科学家认为，这是借了固拉多维持庞大力量的本领。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through its veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: 蓬松毛皮里积起的静电，会被存进颊囊。静电太多时，它们就会变得格外黏人、爱撒娇。
author: faelocke
source: Their cheek pouches store static electricity that builds up in their fluffy fur. Too much of it can make them clingy and needy.

entry: POKENAME常因外貌被误当成落到地面的雨云，曾有旅人因此挨了电击。
author: supersonicloki
source: Because of its appearance, POKENAME is often mistaken for a grounded nimbus cloud. Travelers have been known to be shocked by it.

entry: POKENAME天性贪玩，常能看到它拿路灯杆和电线胡闹。
author: supersonicloki
source: Carrying through life with a playful personality, you may find a POKENAME goofing around with lampposts and power lines.

entry: 野生POKENAME会拼命保护自己的雷之石，谁想偷走就会让它们暴怒。它们还会拿石头砸野生皮卡丘，强迫其进化。
author: donutsbg
source: Wild POKENAME protect their Thunder Stones. If someone tries to steal them, they go berserk. They hit wild Pikachu with the Stones to force evolution.

entry: POKENAME存电太多时，会散出带电的花粉。这些花粉，甚至能为大型机械供电。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME has too much stored electricity, it will scatter electrically charged pollen. This pollen can be used to power large machinery.

entry: 鬃毛与尾巴由炽热的等离子体构成，一碰便能让对方全身严重灼伤。体内的电力，还让POKENAME跑出时速80英里。
author: mistymagius
source: Its mane and tail are made of a hot plasma that on contact, will cause nasty burns all over the victim's body. Its internal electricity allows for POKENAME to run up to 80 mph.

entry: POKENAME爱偷偷进城，洗劫糖果店，把赃物藏在巨喙里。训练家常在巢中找到来路不明的糖纸，便是它捣蛋的证据。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a habit of sneaking into towns and raiding candy shops, storing its loot inside its oversized beak. Trainers often find mysterious candy wrappers in its nest as evidence of its mischief.

entry: POKENAME闯进民宅、农场、餐馆和仓库大肆觅食，再通过勺子与叉状刀刃吸收食物颗粒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME ravages homes, farms, restaurants, and warehouses for their food. It absorbs food particles through its spoon and forked blade.

entry: POKENAME明明吃一点就能活，却见什么吃什么。谁想夺它的食物，就会挨上带刺双臂的重击。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being able to survive with little food, POKENAME will consume anything it can find. If someone tries to take its food, it will bash them with its thorny arms.

entry: POKENAME极少来到地表，贪吃的它一路啃过地下，寻找矿物。留下的隧道，常被满怀希望的勘探者利用，追寻稀有金属。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is rarely seen at the surface, its voracious appetite leading it to eat its way through the ground in search of minerals. The tunnels left behind in its wake are often used by hopeful prospectors hunting for rare metals.

entry: POKENAME漂在酸性水域，雷暴袭来时便能轻易吸收电力。发电厂附近也常能见到它们。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in acidic waters so if a thunderstorm hits, it can easily absorb the electricity from them. They are also common around power plants.

entry: POKENAME贪玩得很，爱在水中跃进跃出，给游客惊喜。水族馆与海洋公园里，它是很受孩子欢迎的明星。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very playful Pokémon and love to jump in and out of the water to surprise tourists. They are very popular in aquariums and marine parks as kid-friendly attractions.

entry: 它友善又合群，尤其亲近航海的人，却似乎不知道，庞大体型会给小玩伴带来危险。
author: staghorn
source: It is extremely friendly and sociable, especially with seafaring humans. It seems unaware that its large size makes it a danger to its smaller playmates.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳的声音控制流过触角间的海流，借水流大幅提升游速。
author: mrpeach774
