source: A POKENAME uses its melodic voice to control the ocean currents that flow between its antennae. It can use these currents to move much faster.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺藏着大量毒液，性情却友善，很少伤人。有些POKENAME甚至想上岸陪人玩，尽管身体到了陆上，很快就会干掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: Although POKENAME's stingers contain large amounts of venom, it is so friendly that it will rarely harm humans. Some POKENAME will even try and come ashore to play with people, even though it quickly dries out on land.

entry: POKENAME痴迷金币，偶尔连寒冷的惯常领地也顾不上，专程出去捕猎野生喵喵。对人类而言，除了喙与爪，锋利如刃的翼羽也同样危险。
author: sontyp
source: A POKENAME covets golden coins to the point of occasionally leaving its regular frigid territory to hunt for wild Meowth. Its beak and claws aren't the only danger to humans, as it often attacks with its razor sharp wing feathers.

entry: POKENAME会在结着美味树果的树上留下爪痕。谁敢偷它的果子，便会遭群体包围，吃进肚里。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME leaves scratches on trees with delicious berries. Any Pokémon who steals POKENAME's berries will be surrounded by their pack and consumed.

entry: POKENAME中，獠牙最长、最大的那只带队狩猎。它们靠翻滚与猛撞，把猎物击倒。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME with the longest and biggest tusks lead their hunting parties. They bring down prey by rolling and slamming into them.

entry: POKENAME是一群狃小子的首领，总与帮众形影不离。它整天吆喝发令，还会主动挑起与敌帮的争斗。
author: jackythewannabe
source: The leader of a pack of Snearogues, POKENAME is never seen without its gang. It barks orders all day, and initiates fights with rival gangs.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里袭敌。战斗本能虽敏锐，这个顽皮家伙却总爱挑弱小的对手下手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME only targets foes at night. While this mischievous Pokémon possesses sharp fighting instincts, it tends to only go for weaker enemies.

entry: 违法作业的工厂里，常能见到POKENAME。它用磁场困住有毒废气，再由体内系统过滤，净化出的清新湿润气息，还常被拿来调制古龙水。
author: beatdoof
source: Often seen in factories with illegal working conditions, POKENAME's magnetic field is used to trap toxic gas wastes from these factories, then filter it with its internal filtering system. The clear, dewy air it creates is often turned into cologne.

entry: POKENAME的身体释放极强磁场。传说磁场强大得连空间本身都能扭曲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body emits an incredibly strong magnetic field. Legends say this field is strong enough to warp space itself.

entry: POKENAME会偷走人们的金属物品，挑选优质材料强化机械身体。凡拿到手的，就绝不打算归还。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME steals metal items from people, seeking quality items to enhance its mechanical body. It has no intention of returning anything it takes.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由各式废金属借强磁场拼合而成。它会用磁场为金属充电，谁一碰，就挨上厉害的电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of various pieces of scrap metal held together by a strong magnetic field. It will use this field to imbue the metal with an electric charge that will produce a nasty shock on contact.

entry: 这只宝可梦的触手由极为坚韧的金属构成，触角还会持续放电，为它们提供保护。也曾有训练家被它意外电伤，送进医院。
author: voiddx01
source: The tentacles of this Pokémon are made of an extremely durable metal and are protected by a constant stream of electricity emitted from its antenna. There are incidents of this Pokémon accidentally electrocuting and hospitalizing their Trainers.

entry: 小磁怪想合成三合一磁怪，若聚得过多，有时竟会意外塌缩成一副身体。所有大脑汇成一个，让POKENAME比从前更加高效、专注。
author: .fedoraman
source: If an excess of Magnemite gather while trying to form Magneton, they may accidentally collapse into one body. With all of their brains combined into one, POKENAME is far more efficient and focused than it was previously.

entry: POKENAME向对手喷射磁性黏液。黏液几乎无法除去，让对方再也难以摆脱POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME shoots its magnetic slime at opponents. The slime is nearly impossible to get off, and leaves them unable to get away from POKENAME.

entry: 体型变小、重量变轻，让它稍微灵活了一些。唾液如今带有麻痹作用，碰到舌头还会遭到电击。
author: cascadeguy
source: It is slightly more mobile due to its reduced weight and size. Its saliva now contains a paralyzing effect, shocking anything that touches its tongue.

entry: 它在洞里快速飞行，用长舌扫舔地面，尽可能捡起食物，再把石头等杂物吐掉。
author: chorb33
source: It flies quickly through caves and licks the ground with its long tongue to pick up as much food as possible. It spits out stones and similar items.

entry: POKENAME总爱舔训练家，可一点也不像小约克那样可爱，反倒让人毛骨悚然。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lick their Trainers all the time. Instead of it being cute, like with Lillipup, it just seems creepy.

entry: 它先用唾液令猎物动弹不得，再以前方的舌头吸血。背上那对翅膀，其实也是舌头。
author: soup1900
source: It uses its saliva to immobilize its prey before slurping their blood with its front tongue. Its wings are actually the tongues that are on its back.

entry: POKENAME的味觉，是世间最讲究的几种之一。若训练家端出合它口味的菜，便会受赐福，今后所尝的每一道菜，都美妙无比。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME has one of the most distinguished taste of all beings. If a Trainer creates a dish which pleases its tongue, they will be blessed in having every dish taste spectacular.

entry: 舌刃靠的不是切割，而是分泌的腐蚀性唾液伤敌。还能缠住对手，使皮肤麻木。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its tongue blade deals damage not through cutting, but the corrosive saliva it produces. It also wraps around opponents and numbs their skin.

entry: 舌头强劲，能像弹簧一样卷起，让它弹跳前行。据说当POKENAME能将自己弹进轨道时，就会升华成更高的形态。
author: genesisparallax
source: It bounces on its powerful tongue which can coil up like a spring. It's said a POKENAME ascends to a higher form when it can launch itself into orbit.

entry: 两只POKENAME相斗，会把长舌当鞭，舌尖甩得超过音速。看似骇人的獠牙，倒不是用来打架，而是砍树，好够着高枝上的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When two POKENAME fight, they use their immensely long tongues as whips, moving the tips at supersonic speeds. Their formidable-looking tusks are used to cut down trees rather than for fighting, letting them access food high in the branches.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀对周围的一切都极其敏感。散出的粉末会引起严重瘙痒与皮疹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are very sensitive to every aspect of their surroundings The powder it spreads causes severe itching and rashes.

entry: POKENAME虽然模样不讨喜，味觉却极为敏锐，因此常成为美食家的伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their unpleasant appearance, POKENAME are known to be the partners of food connoisseurs due to their very sensitive sense of taste.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙掘开虫宝可梦的群居巢穴，伸长黏舌吸蜜。可皮肤柔软，挨不住怒虫反击，每处都待不了太久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig into Bug-type Pokémon colonies, feeding on the honey within with its long sticky tongue. It usually can't stay long at any colony as its hide is soft, leaving it vulnerable to retaliation from the angry bugs.

entry: POKENAME用强壮獠牙迎战对手，再伸长舌，缠住对方的牙，免遭反击。双方打起来，常搅得乱七八糟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tusks to fight with rivals, its long tongue used to try and grapple the tusks of its opponents and prevent a counter-attack. Fights between the Pokémon are often messy as a result.

entry: POKENAME贪吃得无可救药，靠近的东西都要吞下。传言连登山客失踪，也与它有关。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an absolute glutton that eats anything that even comes close. Rumor has it that it is even responsible for the disappearance of hikers.

entry: POKENAME被放入野外后，已成了常见害兽。它常用舌头卷住旅人的腿，将对方绊倒。
author: forbiddenbread
source: Since POKENAME's introduction to the wild, it has become a common pest. It will often grab travellers' legs with its tongue, making them fall over.

entry: POKENAME见什么都爱舔一舔，表示亲近。它们似乎只需尝尝周围，就能追踪任何目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to lick whatever they find as a show of affection. They seem to be able to track anything just by tasting its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME忠诚尽责，却必须按时喂饱。一旦饿着，POKENAME那条强有力的舌头，便能闹得一片狼藉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is incredibly loyal and dutiful, but needs to be fed regularly. If it goes hungry, POKENAME can make a big mess with its strong tongue.

entry: POKENAME看着单纯无害，可几米大的物件或生物，也能被它用舌卷住，轻松吞下。因此，有些组织会请它守卫。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME may appear harmless and simple, but it can easily grasp and devour things and creatures several meters in size with its tongue. For this reason, some organizations use it as a guard.

entry: POKENAME把奇长的舌头垂在水边，等没防备的宝可梦咬住，再卷回来吃。可它反应实在太慢，食物常常溜走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feeds by using its extraordinarily long tongue as a lure at the water's edge, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to bite it so it can reel the food in. Unfortunately, it has incredibly slow reaction times and often lets its food get away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把小个头的小鱼弹射出去，可小鱼们觉得，该拿去扔的明明是小独角鱼。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME like to catapult little Georaid at their targets, but the Georaid are of the opinion that it should be throwing little Rhyraid instead.

entry: POKENAME能抵挡任何剑刃，也能钻穿钻石，盾牌与铠甲，更不在话下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can withstand any sword and is able to drill through diamond, let alone any shield or armor.

entry: POKENAME用钻头触须挂在洞顶，捕食毫无戒心的岩石属性宝可梦，轻易就能钻破隆隆岩的硬壳。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME latch onto the tops of caverns with its drill tendrils to prey upon unaware Rock types. It can easily crack through a Golem's hard carapace.

entry: 它常被用于拆迁。不过有报告称，POKENAME进场后，曾有工人消失得无影无踪。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion is often used for demolition work. However, there have been reports of workers disappearing without a trace once POKENAME was on site.

entry: 这只宝可梦是故乡丛林里的猎手，沐浴日光，便生机勃勃。它先跟踪猎物数小时，等到时机，一甩头上藤蔓，力道足以切开几乎一切。
author: sontyp
source: This Pokémon is a predator in its native jungle environment and thrives in sunlight. To hunt, it first stalks its prey for hours, until at an opportune moment it hurls the vines on its head with such force that they can cut through almost anything.

entry: POKENAME的藤刃既能当鞭，也能设套索。容易再生，最长能超过100英尺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vine blade functions both as a whip and a snare. It easily regenerates and can grow more than 100 feet long.

entry: 它在林中挖洞避风雨。若有足够小的东西凑近探看，就会被触手抓住吞食。
author: skymaster426
source: It digs holes in forests to shelter from the elements. When something small enough inspects the hole, it grabs it with its tentacles and consumes it.

entry: POKENAME全身由会蜇人的长触手构成，碰上就疼。能忍受蜇刺的鱼宝可梦，却能借它藏身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of long stinging tentacles that are painful to touch. These Pokémon are shelter for fish Pokémon that can endure its sting.

entry: POKENAME通过光合作用产生大量电力，再用电线般的藤蔓电击捕食者。电击的威力足以让小型虫宝可梦麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME generates large amounts of electricity through photosynthesis and will zap predators with its wire-like vines. The shock is strong enough to paralyze small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常在风暴天空中飞过，身后拖着道道电光。铁炮鱼想搭它的便车，都会先犹豫再三。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are often observed drawing trails of lightning behind them across stormy skies. Remoraid think twice about hitching a ride on this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头上的电球如同发电机，还能将电力传至尾巴，进一步增强打击力。
author: chorb33
source: The electric sphere on POKENAME's head acts as a generator, which can also pass the generated electricity on to its tail to further amplify strikes.

entry: POKENAME一夜就能吸干整座城的电力。电击中蕴含的力量，甚至足以引发突变。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can drain an entire city of its electricity in a single night. Its electrical attacks contain enough power to cause mutations.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，能把强烈怒气化为攻击力。此时，它能产生数千瓦特的电力。
author: lemmymaster
source: When angered, POKENAME can channel its potent rage into increased attack power. In this state, it can produce many thousands of watts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME把两个尾尖抵在头上电击自己，刺激脑波，释放全部潜力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME holds the two tips of its tails to its head to shock itself. This procedure stimulates its brain waves and unleashes its full potential.

entry: POKENAME看似一动不动，其实出拳快得肉眼难辨。盯得太久，拳边激起的静电，还会让眼睛永久失明。
author: teatedtiten
source: It might seem to be standing still, but in reality POKENAME punches faster than the eye can see. Stare at it for too long, and the ambient static of its punches can cause permanent blindness.

entry: 离POKENAME太近，甚至会让人熔化。身上不停滴落超过7000度的火焰。
author: mistymagius
source: Being too close to a POKENAME will cause anyone to melt. Its body is constantly dripping flames of over 7000 degrees.

entry: 它把家安在狭窄的火山喷气孔内。一遭打扰，便从尾巴射出火球。
author: busilisk
source: It finds its home within narrow volcanic vents. If disturbed, it will launch fireballs from its tail.

entry: POKENAME混进弱小宝可梦的群落，靠恐吓夺取首领之位，再以尾炮保护部下。
author: pokopish
source: POKENAME will infiltrate a community of weaker Pokémon and take leadership through intimidation. It protects its underlings with its tail cannon.

entry: POKENAME每赢一场战斗，体温就会升高一些。它寻找势均力敌的对手，免得热得无人能碰。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME's body temperature rises with each won battle. It seeks a rival that can match its strength, lest it grows too hot to touch.

entry: 不败的POKENAME会用强劲炮火轰开荒地，造出熔岩竞技场，等待值得一战的挑战者。
author: leshii
source: An undefeated POKENAME will use its powerful cannons to blast apart barren land, forming a molten arena in which it will wait for a worthy challenger.

entry: 头上的巨型迫击炮能发射猛烈火球，连钻石都能熔化，温度可见超过华氏8,200度。
author: soup1900
source: The giant mortar on its head fires powerful fireballs that can melt even diamonds. This means its fire is over 8,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 铠甲能承受超过摄氏4000度的高温。POKENAME强劲的喷射火焰，曾烧焦整片地区。
author: chorb33
source: Its armor can withstand temperatures of over 4000 degrees Celsius. POKENAME has already scorched entire regions with its powerful flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的小恶徒，游荡沙漠，抢劫旅人的财物。双臂还能射出会爆炸的种子。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.

entry: POKENAME常去发生纷争的地方，让人们相信，有位看不见的神明，正庇佑着自己。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME regularly seeks out areas where there is strife. It can convince others that an unseeable deity is watching over them.

entry: POKENAME受沉重外壳拖累，飞得很慢。史前时期，它曾照料受伤的宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flies around at a slow pace, as its shell weighs it down. During prehistoric times, it acted as a caretaker for injured Pokémon.

entry: 头上的圆珠明亮发光时，附近的人都会平静下来。它的电力，足够供应整栋房屋。
author: kittyluv090
source: When the orbs on its head glow brightly, it calms anyone in its vicinity. Its electricity can power an entire house.

entry: 寓言中说，战争时期，这只宝可梦会出现，警告各个文明缔结和平。还有人说，如果和平无法实现，它就会释放超过200,000伏的电流，摧毁被它判定为不配存续的文明。
author: beatdoof
source: Fables state that in war times, this Pokémon appears as a warning for civilizations to make peace. Some say if no peace can be achieved, it will discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 200,000 volts, destroying civilizations it deems unworthy.

entry: POKENAME身为幽灵，生命与曾孵化自己的蛋紧密相连。传说体内108个灵魂，全来自那些过早离世的善人。
author: hello_i_exist
source: Due to the spectral nature of POKENAME, its life-force is tied to the egg it once hatched from. Legends say this Pokémon contains 108 spirits within, all of which are from virtuous individuals who perished before their time.

entry: POKENAME振翅疾飞，穿越各个地区，守望人类与宝可梦，必要时便出手相护。有些地方称它为“和平守护者”。
author: tserii
source: POKENAME can use its wings to travel at incredible speeds across different regions. It watches over people and Pokémon and protects them if needed. It is referred to as the 'Protector of Peace' in certain regions.

entry: POKENAME眼中光芒闪动时，就能看透人心。若被POKENAME认为心地善良，便会得到好运祝福。
author: darkweavile428
source: When a POKENAME's eyes gleam, it can see what's in a person's heart. If POKENAME deems you to be kind, it will bless you with good luck.

entry: POKENAME渴望绝对的幸福。一察觉争端，就用太阳之力射出金色光辉，哪怕造成毁灭，也要终结冲突。
author: miistical
source: POKENAME craves absolute happiness. If it senses strife, it uses the power of the sun to fire an aureate gleam to end the conflict, even ruinously.

entry: POKENAME眼周的薄膜，会洒出一圈闪光，照亮需要祝福者。可恶人若闯入它们的巢，便会被蜂拥围住，在爱与接纳的温暖中，窒闷到再也支撑不住。
author: wormspawn
source: The membrane around POKENAME's eyes illuminates those in need of blessings in a ring of sparkles. Malefactors who intrude upon a den of POKENAME will be swarmed en masse and smothered in the warmth of love and acceptance until they succumb.

entry: POKENAME会把幼小宝可梦，拥在宽大双翼下。它能感知悲伤，谁需要安慰与支持，就留在谁身旁。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME are known for huddling baby Pokémon underneath their large wings. They have a unique ability to sense sadness and will stay close to anyone in need, offering comfort and support.

entry: POKENAME常陪孩子和小宝可梦玩，力量不用来吓人，而是用来保护、扶持。据说，它能为大地带来和睦，也从不让任何伙伴掉队。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME often plays with children and smaller Pokémon, using its strength not to intimidate, but to protect and support. It is said that its presence brings harmony to the land, always ensuring that no one is left behind.

entry: POKENAME唱着欢乐的歌，夜里漫游城镇，为时令庆典送上祝福，人称“欢庆之灵”。
author: alkazamis
source: Singing joyfully, POKENAME wanders through towns at night, blessing seasonal festivals. It is known as the Spirit of Jubilation.

entry: 对受它守护者而言，它象征希望与喜悦。炮管既能射出强劲水柱，也能打出纯粹的能量。
author: voiddx01
source: This Pokémon serves as a symbol of hope and joy to those it protects. Its cannons can fire either powerful blasts of water or pure energy.

entry: 它钻进沙漠的沙中，伪装成灌木。背上的叶子极苦，令食草动物不敢下口。
author: chorb33
source: It burrows into the desert sand to disguise itself as a bush. The leaves on its back taste extremely bitter to deter potential herbivores.

entry: POKENAME扬起泥沙，射出闪电，吓退敌人。它生活在一小片相通的地下洞穴中。
author: chorb33
source: To frighten enemies, POKENAME flings dirt and sand and hurls lightning bolts. It lives in small underground cave systems.

entry: 背上的仙人掌能储水，供POKENAME饮用。吸水越多，花就开得越绚烂。
author: chorb33
source: The cactus on its back can store water and supply POKENAME with liquid. The more water it has absorbed, the more splendidly it blooms.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，摇响尾部的响器，吓退大型天敌。毒液虽不致命，却能令四肢麻痹长达一小时。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the sand, using the rattle on its tail to ward off larger predators. Its venom isn't fatal but will cause limb paralysis for up to an hour.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，迅速钻过缝隙逃走。敌人若追得太近，便用让人疼痛的电光还击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can curl up and quickly escape from enemies through gaps. However, should one get too close, it shocks them with painful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME能用尾巴在特定位置产生电压，电击对手，也能用尾巴支撑身体，帮助双爪挖掘。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can use its tail to create tension at certain points to shock opponents or as a support for its claws to dig through the ground.

entry: POKENAME从背上的仙人掌吸收、储存水分，因此最长能三年不补水而存活。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME absorbs water via the cacti on its back and stores it. This means it can survive for up to three years without new water.

entry: POKENAME虽无法将身体聚成完整刀刃，仍能以危险的力道挥出沙子。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though POKENAME fails to hold itself together as a blade, it still swings its sand around at dangerous force.

entry: POKENAME看似无害，却会铲起沙子，猛力射向想握住它的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Despite its harmless appearance, POKENAME shovels into sand and launches it with great force at anyone who attempts to hold it.

entry: POKENAME把缎带拧在一起，像钻头般旋转，就能迅速钻入地下。
author: melodydelune
source: By coiling its ribbons together and spinning them like a drill, POKENAME can burrow its way rapidly into the ground.

entry: POKENAME卷成球，滚下山坡时，常被误认作巨石。它还会用尾巴拍地，把沙扬进敌人眼中。
author: over9001
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, it can be mistaken as a large boulder rolling down a hill. It slaps its tail on the ground to whip up sand in its opponent's eyes.

entry: 受惊或疲惫时，POKENAME会钻进沙下，暂歇片刻。可沙常跑进耳朵，扰乱它们的回声定位。
author: frokachu
source: When spooked or tired, POKENAME will burrow under sand to rest temporarily. Sand often gets in their ears, disrupting their echolocation.

entry: POKENAME体内酷热，让沙质鬃毛熔成玻璃。玻璃依然滚烫，碰到草木，便会将其引燃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME intense internal heat causes its sandy mane to turn to glass. The glass is still incredibly hot, hot enough to ignite any flora on contact.

entry: POKENAME极其危险凶暴，透镜强化后的超能力，能在瞬间轻易撕裂敌人的身体。
author: soup1900
source: Extremely dangerous and violent, POKENAME is able to use its lens-boosted psychic powers to rip apart the foe's bodies instantly without difficulty.

entry: 它一天便能横跨整个地区。它们聚在发电厂，收集足够的电力，保护幼崽。
author: schwaus
source: It can travel across whole regions in a single day. They congregate at power plants to collect enough electricity to protect their young.

entry: 它为蜻蜻蜓提供庇护、协调行动，让族群繁盛。背上信标发出的复杂信号，唯有蜻蜻蜓能看见。
author: staghorn
source: It acts as a shelter and coordinator for Yanma, allowing their populations to flourish. The beacon on its back displays complex signals that only Yanma can see.

entry: POKENAME是极其古老的虫形宝可梦。在岛屿间迁徙时，沉重双翼的振动会掀起巨大风暴潮。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is an extremely ancient insectoid Pokémon. The flutter of its heavy wings create massive tidal storms as it migrates between islands.

entry: 野生POKENAME是最常遭捕食的宝可梦之一。不过，它也能轻易从对方掌握中溜出，迅速飞走。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are one of the most preyed on of Pokémon. However, it can easily zip away from a Pokémon's grasp and fly away.

entry: 大群野生POKENAME几分钟就能吃光整片农田。农夫常备大量除虫喷雾，以防虫群来袭。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Hordes of wild POKENAME will eat through entire fields in minutes. Farmers often keep plenty of repels on them to reduce the risk of a swarm.

entry: 它能像螺旋桨一样旋转翅膀，将花粉和种子洒遍大片区域。
author: staghorn
source: It can spin its wings like a propeller, allowing it to cover wide areas in its pollen and seeds.

entry: POKENAME总欢快地飞过树林，想找谁一起在叶丛里玩耍。飞行时，身后会出现彩色的树叶。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME always cheerfully flies through the woods, looking for someone to play with in the leaves. When it flies, colorful leaves appear behind it.

entry: 它挥舞成簇的利叶，保护花苞。POKENAME能连着几小时站在原地，吸收土中养分。
author: mistymagius
source: It protects its flower bud by swinging around its cluster of sharp leaves. POKENAME stands it the same spot for hours on end, absorbing nutrients from the soil.

entry: POKENAME是老练的猎手，藏在大片海草中，用高压水流狙击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert predators. They hide themselves within large amounts of seagrass and snipe their prey with pressurized water.

entry: POKENAME深居林中，在树木间迅疾穿行，守护自己的王国。每到落脚之处，周围草木便重焕生机。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME dwells deep in the woods, swiftly rushing between trees to guard its kingdom. Where they land, the surrounding plants are reinvigorated.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在密林深处，为生病的野生宝可梦配药。据说它们能理解植物的灵魂。
author: quote.lass
source: POKENAME prefer to stay deep in forests so that they might craft medicine for sick wild Pokémon. They're said to understand the souls of plants.

entry: 这种大嘴娃亚种住在丛林深处，大半天把身体塞进小角落或缝隙里酣睡。捕蝇草般的第二张嘴，却始终张开，等着猎物。
author: modeustheunbound
source: This subspecies of Mawile lives in the deepest jungles. They spend most of the day with their body wedged into a small nook or crevice, sleeping soundly, while their flytrap-like second mouth lies open and waiting.

entry: POKENAME的叶状火焰泛起迷人光彩，虽常栖身幽暗森林，却不断寻找明亮空地，进行光合作用。知道这习性的迷路旅人，便跟着POKENAME走向安全处。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME radiates a mesmerizing glow from its leafy flames. Typically found in dark forests, POKENAME will constantly search for bright open areas to photosynthesize. Lost travelers, with this knowledge, will follow POKENAME to safety.

entry: POKENAME骄傲而忠诚，会巡视森林，确保环境安全洁净。奔跑时，皮毛中的叶子还会产生清新空气。
author: mistymagius
source: A proud and loyal Pokémon. POKENAME scout the forest to make sure the area is safe and clean. The leaves in their fur produce clean air when they run.

entry: POKENAME常在花园晒太阳。心情好时，若被抚摸皮毛，就会散发类似猫薄荷的气味。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, basking in the sunlight. If in a good mood, they will smell similar to catnip when their fur is stroked.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴引来爱吃海藻的鱼。幸好，这些鱼大多正是它的猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME uses its tail to attract seaweed-favoring fish. Thankfully, most of these fish happen to be its prey.

entry: 为免过热，它会将周围空气降至冰点。结果所到之处，都会掀起巨大暴风雪。
author: soup1900
source: To keep itself from overheating, it will freeze the temperature around it. This, however, causes massive blizzards wherever it passes.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，成群POKENAME最为活跃。它们藏进暗影，突然吐出寒气，瞬间冻得敌人无法动弹。
author: thepandasharky
source: Groups of POKENAME tend to be most active on cold winter nights. They use the shadows to blend in, launching surprise attacks with freezing breath that can immobilize foes in an instant.

entry: POKENAME的花苞产生冰孢子，一碰到东西，便将其冻住。据说，花朵即将绽放时，暴风雪也随之形成。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flower bud produces icy spores that will freeze anything they touch instantly. It is said that blizzards form once its flower is ready to bloom.

entry: POKENAME有独特的战法，将冰与火运用得恰到好处。灼烧与冰冻交替出击，凶猛得难以招架。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style equally balancing fire and ice. Its brutal combination of burning and freezing strikes makes it tough to face.

entry: POKENAME带着男孩子般的淘气，脑袋又傻得可爱，因此很得训练家疼爱。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are often beloved by their Trainers due to their boyish personalities and charming lack of intelligence.

entry: POKENAME靠冻结湖泊练习能力。对寒冷的掌控十分高超，无论什么气候都能做到。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME practices its abilities by freezing lakes. Its prowess with the cold allows it to do this no matter what climate it is in.

entry: POKENAME虽仪态高贵，护起领地却极凶，以冰风与念力，击退一切可能的对手。残酷又美丽的它们，被雪乡训练家称为“寒冰女王”。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are extremely territorial, fighting off any potential rivals with freezing winds and psychic force. Their cruelty and beauty have led to Trainers in snowy regions referring to them as 'Chiller Queens'.

entry: POKENAME格外爱玩，又很护着别人。它喜欢把冰晶塑成各式形状与花纹，让人看得入迷。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME is an unusually playful yet protective Pokémon. It enjoys fascinating others by creating various shapes and patterns from ice crystals.

entry: POKENAME的本体能冻结周围空气，造出雪花、可射出的冰刺，以及自己的剑刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's main body can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow, icy spikes which can shoot off as projectiles, and its blade.

entry: POKENAME能冻结周围空气，制造雪或冰晶，射向对手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow or ice crystals it can fire at opponents.

entry: 在野外遇到POKENAME，最好别打扰。否则，这个冰冷孤僻的家伙就会将尖锐冰锥指向你。
author: ladan
source: If you find a POKENAME in the wild, it's best to leave it be, or this cold introvert will point sharp icicles in your direction.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: chorb33
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: chorb33
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛华美耀眼，像永远燃烧的火焰，让收藏家十分追捧。可谁若虐待、轻慢它，就会被活活冻住，永远封在冰里。
author: beatdoof
source: Because of its magnificent and dazzling mane, akin to an eternally blazing flame, POKENAME is quite popular among Pokémon collectors. Those who treat it with abuse and disrespect, however, will be frozen alive, eternally encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME漂在北极水域，伪装小冰块。一碰双触手便立即冻伤，伤口也极易感染它体表的细菌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in arctic waters, mimicking small ice chunks. Contact with its twin tentacles causes instant frostbite, which can easily become infected with bacteria on its body.

entry: POKENAME心情好时，种子会散发青草般的甜香。常能看见它们在日光下酣睡，沐浴阳光，补充养分。
author: mistymagius
source: Its bulb gives off the sweet scent of fresh grass when POKENAME is happy. They can be seen sleeping in the sun, absorbing light as nutrients.

entry: POKENAME将翅膀裹住身体，先快速爬行，再跃向空中，滑翔扑向目标。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will wrap their wings around themselves to slither faster before launching into the air and gliding to their target.

entry: POKENAME指挥周身的蝙蝠状暗影，让自己融入夜色。咬开树果吸汁后，萃取的养分还能经尾巴注入伤者体内，治愈人类与宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME command swarms of bat-shaped shadows that surround their bodies to help them blend into the night. They bite into berries to drink from them, extracting nutrients that can be injected with their tails to help heal people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱在高高的夜空滑翔，也不断训练，磨炼使刃的技巧。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME likes to glide high in the night sky. POKENAME trains to hone its skill with its blades.

entry: POKENAME在长满苔藓的洞穴中狩猎。猎物靠近时，它会伸长灵活的脖子，从对方视线的死角出击，再用多根毒刺刺入猎物。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME hunt in mossy caves. When their prey is near, they extend their flexible neck to hit their blind spot, and stab them with their multiple stingers.

entry: POKENAME滑过黑夜，四处求战。它们先用盾牌般坚实的爪挡住攻击，再一击制胜，随着披风飘动，隐去身影。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide through the night in search of duels. They use their sturdy shield-like claws to block attacks before delivering decisive blows, disappearing with the flutter of their capes.

entry: 这只狡猾宝可梦，喜欢密林等幽暗地方，很会隐匿身影。巨爪配上锋锐翼刃，再以眼花缭乱的速度与凶猛劲势，制服猎物。
author: elfail0
source: Preferring to live in dark places like dense forests and jungles, this sly Pokémon is well adapted to hiding in shadows. It combines its large claws and razor sharp wing blades with blinding ferocity and speed to subdue prey.

entry: POKENAME勇敢忠诚，同伴一有需要，便从翻飞的玫瑰花瓣中现身。跃入战阵时，还会沿途撒刺，击退对手，布置战场。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are valiant and loyal, appearing out of a flurry of rose petals when their allies are in need. They leap into battle while scattering thorns below them, repelling opponents and setting the stage for their fight.

entry: 据说，POKENAME出没于古代吸血鬼的破败城堡，装成棺材，吸干不受欢迎的入侵者的生命。
author: spicybunbun
source: Legends speak of POKENAME haunting decayed castles said to belong to ancient vampires. Myths claim they disguise themselves as coffins and drain the lifeforce of unwelcome intruders.

entry: 它倒挂在废屋椽下，观察猎物，再扑向同样在屋中游荡的昆虫与虫宝可梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It observes its prey while hanging from the rafters of abandoned buildings. It pounces on insects and Bug-type Pokémon that also roam there.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: carameldog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: carameldog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME会两只一组，协同狩猎。一只用爪子抓住猎物，另一只则用带刺的尾巴猛砸。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are pack hunters that work in twain. One will grab their prey with their claws, while the other bashes it with their barbed tail.

entry: POKENAME轻松穿行海空。猎物才看见巨大的阴影，便被裹住，注入毒素。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME effortlessly soars through both the skies and the sea. Prey only see its large shadow before they are enveloped and injected with toxins.

entry: POKENAME大多倒挂在洞中睡觉。超能力一感知有人靠近，便瞬间移动离开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping upside-down inside caves. Using their psychic powers, they can detect anyone approaching and teleport away.

entry: POKENAME在明亮处很难看清，因此常闭着眼，靠超能力辨识方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能找到优质矿物，制成勺子。借这些勺子，POKENAME便能以惊人速度挖出新洞穴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.

entry: 强壮的双臂，让它即使正与其他宝可梦交战，也能以时速220公里轻松飞行。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: Due to its powerful arms, it can fly at 220 km/h without any problem while fighting against other Pokémon.

entry: 在这颗星球最严寒的地方，也发现过POKENAME群。雄性拥有更大的獠牙和尖刺，守护正在孕育后代的雌性。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME herds have been recorded in the coldest places on the planet. Males sport greater tusks and spikes to defend the child-bearing mothers.

entry: 人们以为POKENAME在冰河时代已灭绝，其实它们只是在深水中沉睡了10,000年。
author: darkweavile428
source: It was thought that POKENAME went extinct during the ice age, but it turns out they were sleeping deep underwater for 10,000 years.

entry: POKENAME曾是远古冰河时代的顶级猎手，聪明得懂用其他宝可梦的残骸制作武器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME was an apex hunter during an ancient ice age. It has the intelligence to create weapons using remains of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过雪山，用变化后的獠牙拨开积雪。登山客很乐意沿它们开出的路走，对它赞不绝口。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME slowly roam snowy mountains, using their modified tusks to move the snow aside. They are praised by hikers, who willingly use their trails.

entry: POKENAME伪装成普通墨海马，骗取训练家的信任。一有机会，就接管训练家的全部设备。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME preys on Trainers' trust by disguising itself as a regular Horsea. When given the chance, it will take control of all of a Trainer's devices.

entry: POKENAME容易动怒，心思又变幻莫测。唯有耐心、熟练的训练家与牧场主，才能驯服这古怪性情。
author: trismon55555
source: POKENAME is both quick to anger and mentally unpredictable. Only patient and skilled Trainers and ranchers are able to tame their bizarre nature.

entry: 红莲岛居民自古就流传着POKENAME的目击故事。描述虽各不相同，可亲见者都坚称，那是某种根本不该存在的东西。
author: sk372
source: For ages past, tales of POKENAME sightings have existed among the residents of Cinnabar Island. Accounts vary, but all who claimed to witness it agree it is something that simply should not be.

entry: 有人试着替这只宝可梦升级，却出了差错，导致部分资料损坏。如今，它身体的两边常常自己打起来。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: An upgrade was attempted on this Pokémon, but something went wrong and it got partially corrupted. The two sides often fight with each other.

entry: 它用垃圾数据裹住身体，保护内部的真实数据。这招虽有效，却会占用寄居电脑的大量存储空间。
author: soup1900
source: It covers itself in garbage data to protect the real data inside. While this strategy is effective, it uses a lot of storage on the computer it's in.

entry: 它进入哪台电脑，就会令哪台过热。沿途的数据也会熔毁，损坏得无法再用。
author: soup1900
source: It will overheat any computer it enters. Any data it passes through will melt, corrupting it and making it unusable.

entry: POKENAME极其依恋训练家。为了不被放生，便把自己附在重要文件上。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their Trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.

entry: POKENAME现身时，软件会出现仿佛时间错位的故障。人们尝试利用这种效果，却仍未成功。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's appearance causes software to glitch in ways consistent with temporal displacement. Attempts to harness this effect have yet to bear fruit.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在绘画和游戏程序里，将软件的全部代码拿走，编进自身程序。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to hide in art and game applications. It takes all the code from the software, and incorporates it into their own.

entry: 周围变化不定的雾气，让POKENAME几乎难以辨识。直接盯着它看，就会头痛恶心。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is near impossible to comprehend thanks to the unstable haze around it. Looking at it directly causes headaches and nausea.

entry: 程序原为缩小文件体积而设计，错误却让它把比特本身切开，反倒产生更多垃圾数据。
author: soup1900
source: Its program was designed to cut down file size, but a programming error caused it to cut the bits themselves, resulting in more garbage data instead.

entry: 它是等离子队一次失败实验的产物，只懂毁灭，胡乱开炮，所过之处什么都不剩。
author: soup1900
source: An experiment by Team Plasma gone wrong. It only knows destruction, firing its cannon randomly and leaving nothing behind.

entry: 光标状利爪，能剥光整棵树的皮。即使沙尘暴漆黑一片，POKENAME面罩般的眼，也能找出猎物。
author: trismon55555
source: The cursor-like claws of POKENAME can tear the bark off an entire tree. Their visor-like eyes can detect prey even in pitch-black sandstorms.

entry: 一次交易弄砸后，它进化成了POKENAME。身上的丝线，承载着过去失败的重量；据说，那也正是POKENAME防御力高得出名的原因。
author: imaginaryneon
source: Evolving after a deal gone wrong, POKENAME's strings bear the weight of their past failures. It is said that those strings are the source of POKENAME's infamously high defenses.

entry: 它是广受欢迎的游戏破解装置，却有时会擅自往游戏里注入恶意代码，造成永久损坏。
author: t.i.a.
source: A popular device made to hack games, they are sometimes known to inject malicious code into them by themselves, resulting in permanent damage.

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 代码出错，使超声波夹杂着沙沙噪声。这种冲击破坏力极强，被许多人称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: A coding error caused it to emit static noise from its ultrasonic waves. These blasts are called static booms by many since they're very destructive.

entry: POKENAME的几个头各自独立行动。可POKENAME性情反复无常，往往会自己闹起内讧。
author: t.i.a.
source: The heads of a POKENAME act and move independently of each other. However, the erratic nature of POKENAME usually results in infighting.

entry: POKENAME破坏周围现实，构成一个并非圆形的防护壳。壳无法被感知，藏在后方的一切也同样无法察觉。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME corrupts reality around itself to form a nonround protective shell. The shell can't be perceived, yet neither can anything behind it.

entry: 天敌靠近，它便亮出红腹，吓对方一跳。趁对方分心，再用弹簧般的尾巴，将自己弹出去逃走。
author: staghorn
source: When a predator approaches, it flashes its red belly to startle them. Once the predator is distracted, it uses its spring-like tail to launch itself and make a getaway.

entry: POKENAME藏在树上，用柔韧如叶的棍棒守护领地，被认为是森林的守护者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from the trees with its flexible, leaf-like club. It is said to be a guardian of the forest.

entry: POKENAME借身上长出的叶片吸收阳光，为预知能力积蓄能量。
author: glacierwing
source: Using the leaves that grow out of their body, POKENAME gather sunlight to charge their precognitive powers.

entry: POKENAME手持叶刃，以额外叶片伪装，借灌木掩护，凶狠地保护林中树木。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With a leaf blade and additional leaves used for camouflage, POKENAME brutally protects the forest's trees with cover of the underbrush.

entry: POKENAME是丛林里脾气火爆的野生宝可梦，四处找对手打架。找不到，就改打粗壮的树。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is a hot tempered wild Pokémon of the jungle. It searches for opponents to fight, and will instead attack thick trees if it cannot find one.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光，让力量增长。颈上与尾上的叶片，还能调节体温。
author: escollari
source: A POKENAME absorbs sunlight to become stronger. The leaves on its neck and tail help regulate its body temperature.

entry: 背上原本繁茂的灌木，渐渐烧了起来。枝条永燃不熄，让它得格外小心，免得毁掉丛林家园。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: What was once a lush bush on its back soon began burning. The sticks on its back burn forever; it has to be careful not to burn down its jungle home.

entry: 它从丛林细心采来珍稀树果，调成可口果汁。咖啡馆里，常能看见它们制作这杯饮料。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: It carefully harvests rare berries from the jungle, using them to create a delightfully tasty juice. They are often found in cafés making this drink.

entry: POKENAME是无声的猎手，尾部的响声，与风拂树叶的沙沙声混在一起。它们熟练穿行灌木，直到扑中猎物，才会显露身影。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are silent hunters, the rattle of their tails blending in with the sound of leaves rustling in the wind. They expertly navigate the underbrush, only being seen when they strike their prey.

entry: POKENAME深夜疾驰于密林，快得惊人，却又悄然无声。能亲眼见到已难得，见它停下那永不停歇的荒野之行，更是难上加难。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME sprint through dense forests in the dead of night. The only thing rarer than seeing them in person is seeing them stop their relentless trek through the wilderness. Despite their unreal speed, they travel while staying perfectly silent.

entry: POKENAME过于沉重，途经森林或丛林时，往往不小心将其踩平。木哑铃会随后赶来，在遭到践踏的土地上重新播种。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its immense weight means POKENAME accidentally tramples the forests and jungles it travels through. Treedums come along to reseed the trampled lands.

entry: 背上的种荚，终生不断长大。死后，种荚便爆开，在原地孕育出一片无比茂盛的草木。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The seed pod on its back grows throughout its life. Upon death, the seed pod will burst, creating an incredibly lush area of flora.

entry: POKENAME培育种子、修剪枝叶，照顾森林植物。多出的刀刃，也让它成为凶悍的守卫。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With its ability to grow seeds and prune plants, POKENAME cares for the forest's flora. With its additional blades, it is its vicious defender.

entry: POKENAME的叶状甲片坚韧如钢，还锋利得能砍倒大树。它们借此毁树，标记自己的领地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaf-like plating is a durable as steel. They are also sharp enough to cut large trees, which they destroy to mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME快速飞过炎热沙漠觅食，眼上的特殊透镜，能保护双眼免受风沙侵袭。
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv
source: It flies swiftly over hot deserts in search of food. POKENAME have special lenses covering their eyes to protect them from sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME能高速吐出锋利的内部结构，击中什么，就刺穿什么。不幸中招的宝可梦，随后便被它吃掉。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME can spit out its sharp insides with great speed, impaling anything it hits. Unfortunate Pokémon hit by this will then be consumed.

entry: POKENAME是丛林的顶级猎手，以惊人速度掠过树冠，俯冲扑向毫无戒心的猎物。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is the apex predator of the jungle. With its astounding speed, it soars across the treetops and swoops down on unsuspecting prey.

entry: 一颗小行星坠入丛林后，POKENAME出现了。它能改变基因结构，适应恶劣气候，捕捉猎物。
author: nellnast42
source: After an asteroid landed in the jungle, POKENAME emerged. It is able to alter its genetic structure to adapt to the harsh climate and catch prey.

entry: 看尾巴，就能判断POKENAME的年纪。尾焰像蜡烛一样渐渐烧尽，彻底熄灭时，它也随之逝去。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A POKENAME's age can be determined by its tail. The flame will gradually burn down like a candle, the Pokémon passing once it's completely gone.

entry: POKENAME每周都爬上树冠，挑最锋利、能叼住的叶片，捕猎弱小生物。遇天敌逃跑时，POKENAME也会挥动厚尾，抵御追击。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME climbs up to tree canopies every week to find the sharpest leaves it can hold in its mouth, which it uses to hunt weaker prey. POKENAME is also known to use its bulky tail to defend itself from predators while fleeing.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强。即使入侵者在森林另一端，POKENAME也能凭耳朵察觉，几秒便追上对方。
author: alphamerican
source: POKENAME is a very territorial Pokémon. Using its ears, POKENAME can detect an intruder on the other side of its forest and hunt them down in seconds.

entry: 它一兴奋，金属铠甲就会升温，最高超过华氏500度。为免误燃草木，便住在没有植被的荒地。
author: staghorn
source: Its metallic armor heats up whenever it gets excited, reaching a maximum temperature of over 500 degrees Fahrenheit. Because of this, it lives in badlands without plant matter that it could accidentally ignite.

entry: 火焰炽热无比，可POKENAME喷得不够快，只好先盘住对手，再近距离集中喷火，将其焚烧。
author: glacierwing
source: The fire it makes is blazingly hot. POKENAME has trouble expelling it with enough speed, however, so it will wrap opponents in its coils before torching them with a concentrated blast.

entry: 融合时过剩的能量，烧光了大半羽毛。可留下的三根，如今却燃得和工业喷灯一样炽热。
author: mistymagius
source: The excessive energy from fusion has burned off most of its feathers. However, its three remaining feathers now burn as hot as an industrial blowtorch.

entry: POKENAME亲切又好奇，温暖的性情，让它成为寒地的理想伙伴。小小身体散出的热，驱走冷意，也让周围安心舒适。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are affectionate and curious, their warm personalities making them ideal companions in cold climates. The heat radiating from their small bodies helps ward off the chill, bringing comfort to those around them.

entry: POKENAME盛满水的花中，放着一块蛋似的石头，原因不明。若把石头换成真蛋，短短几秒，便煮得全熟。
author: sontyp
source: What looks like an egg is really a rock POKENAME carries within its water-filled blossom for unknown reasons. If you replace the rock with an egg, it's hard boiled within seconds.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，便靠尾巴代劳。打赢一场战斗后，POKENAME还会用尾巴，与训练家击掌庆祝。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME relies on its tail as a substitute for its lack of arms. After achieving victory in battle, POKENAME will slap its Trainer's hand with its tail in celebration.

entry: POKENAME背上的硬刺带有微毒。察觉危险时，就会蜷成一团，滚下沙丘。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME protects its back with hard spines that have a weak poison. If it senses danger, it curls up and rolls down the dunes.

entry: 背上的花与叶坚硬，能保护POKENAME，还能分泌使人虚弱的毒素，用来毒倒来袭者。
author: chorb33
source: The flower and its leaves on its back are hard and protect POKENAME. They allow it to secrete debilitating toxins, which it uses to poison attackers.

entry: 它住在遍布岩石的荒地，靠速度与利爪驱走威胁。即使野生的怪颚龙，也会绕开POKENAME的领地。
author: staghorn
source: It lives in rocky badlands, using its speed and claws to drive away potential threats. Even a wild Tyrantrum will avoid a POKENAME's territory.

entry: POKENAME搬起超过体重五倍的巨石，炫耀力气。重拳的威力，更足以夷平摩天大楼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME show off their immense strength by carrying boulders over five times its weight. Their punches have enough force to level a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME是圈圈熊类中少数不冬眠的宝可梦。虽然奇特，却也更容易遭到毛皮猎人的捕杀。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of very few Ursaring species to not hibernate. While interesting, this unfortunately makes it vulnerable to fur hunters.

entry: 它醒着时几乎都在晒太阳，为捕猎节省精力。出击时飞快掠过猎物身边，以背刺将其划伤。
author: pokepower
source: It spends nearly every waking hour sunbathing. It conserves its energy for taking down prey, which it slashes with its spines as it rushes past.

entry: POKENAME能将强电流导向背刺。谁靠得太近，它便转身背对，射出尖刺。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel a strong electrical current through the spikes on its back. If someone gets too close, it turns its back on them and shoots its spikes.

entry: POKENAME捏出含水量高的泥球，先充入电流，再把尾巴当球棒，将它们击向对手。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME forms clay balls with a high water-content so it can electrify, then propel them at opponents using its tail as a makeshift bat.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物十分坚硬，雨水再少也能提供足够养分，还能分泌强毒。
author: chorb33
source: The vegetation on its back is hard. It provides POKENAME with sufficient nutrients even when there is little rain and can also secrete strong poison.

entry: 沙漠神庙中游荡的POKENAME，当初究竟属于神庙守卫，还是盗墓贼，研究者仍有争论。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers disagree on whether POKENAME haunting desert temples once belonged to the temple's guards or its robbers.

entry: 受威胁时，它会蜷成球，用缎带猛抽。一昼夜内，能向地下挖掘最深10公里。
author: melodydelune
source: When threatened, this Pokémon will curl into a ball and lash out with its ribbons. It can dig up to 10 kilometers deep in a single day and night.

entry: 它擅长从头到尾一起作战，前有利爪劈斩，后有刺尾重击。POKENAME也极会挖洞，转眼便能开出地道。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon specializes in head to tail combat, in which it slashes enemies with its sharp claws and whacks them with its spiky tail. POKENAME is also a very efficient tunneler and can dig at rapid speeds.

entry: 它的利爪足以凿穿岩石，常会走过大片水域，寻找食物。
author: .flipside3
source: Its claws are strong enough to dig through rock. It will often walk across large bodies of water to find food.

entry: 野生POKENAME常互相拌嘴。一只生气了，就想掀起沙暴，让另一只也跟着生气。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME in the wild are usually found bickering with each other. If one gets mad, it tries to start a sandstorm to make the other one mad too.

entry: POKENAME没有腿，踢不了对手，简直懊恼透顶。战斗时只好依靠自己产生的火焰与爆炸。
author: cascadeguy
source: POKENAME is frustrated to no end by its lack of legs and inability to kick. It instead relies on the flames and explosions it produces in combat.

entry: POKENAME使劲摇动尾巴，调节体热与血流。多余热量则化作火焰，从头上的囊喷出。
author: teatedtiten
source: To regulate heat and blood flow, POKENAME vigorously shakes its tail.  Excess body heat is transferred into flares that spew out from the sac on its head.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跑到田野、山间，用走路草的身体，练习适合自己的踢技。即使没了双臂，也拦不住它。
author: cascadeguy
source: At nighttime, POKENAME runs off to fields and mountains, spending its time adapting its kicking mastery in the body of an Oddish. The removal of its arms will not deter it at all.

entry: 有时融合后，POKENAME会保留力壮鸡的双臂。可比起手上功夫，它还是更愿磨炼踢技。
author: cascadeguy
source: Sometimes during the fusion process, POKENAME keeps Combusken's arms instead of removing them. It would much rather continue mastering its kicking skills, though.

entry: POKENAME兼具火焰鸡的烈火与快拳郎的拳力。炽热踢击猛烈，迅疾的重拳更足以碎骨。
author: sheogorath
source: Fusing Blaziken's blaze with Hitmonchan's punch, POKENAME unleashes devastating fiery kicks alongside fast bone-crunching punches.

entry: POKENAME是行走的灾厄，雷与火交织的咆哮，传出数公里。它从一棵树跃向另一棵，身后便燃起山火。
author: scapz
source: A roving calamity, POKENAME's roar of thunder and flame can be heard from kilometers away. As it leaps from tree to tree, forest fires ignite in its wake.

entry: POKENAME是由自身炽烈意志锻成的火焰剑盾。踢击会将目标灼伤，烈焰斩击更会留下烧伤与刀口。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a blazing sword and shield, forged from its own fiery spirit. Its kicks scorch, while fiery slashes leave both burns and gashes.

entry: 金属双臂与灼热刀刃融为一体，POKENAME跳起烈焰战舞。踢击灼人，锋利挥斩则让对手既被割伤，又遭火烫。
author: sheogorath
source: Metal arms fused with searing blades, POKENAME dances a fiery war dance. Its kicks scorch, while razor-sharp swipes leave opponents sliced and singed.

entry: 四只火拳释放熊熊怒火。POKENAME的每记武术攻击都带着灼热，烈焰烧得如斗志般明亮。
author: sheogorath
source: Four fiery fists unleash a blazing fury. POKENAME's martial arts scorch with each blow, its inferno burning as bright as its fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME常在活火山边冥想，将热量吸进摆锤。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME often spends time meditating at the edge of active volcanoes, where it absorbs the heat into its pendulum.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半是液体，重塑形状便能变身。它爱住泥泞池塘，装成一堆土。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME transforms by reforming its mostly liquid body. It likes to reside in muddy ponds, and will disguise itself as mounds of dirt.

entry: 它是顶级猎手，既能在陆地与空中捕猎，独特的羽毛结构还让它能高速潜水。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is an apex predator. It can hunt on land, in the sky, and it can dive at high speeds due to the unique composition of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME常见于温泉中，喜欢用身体裹住伤处，帮助伤口愈合。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME can be found in hot springs. They like to wrap themselves around wounds to help them heal.

entry: POKENAME常藏在暖泥边，射出火星捕猎，再用水灭火，才把猎物吃掉。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is often seen hiding around warm mud. It shoots embers to hunt prey and then uses water to extinguish the flames before eating.

entry: 它住在沼泽、河床附近幽暗湿泥中，既会游泳，也善挖洞，因此洞穴淹水，它也不在乎。
author: staghorn
source: It lives in dark, muddy soil in swamps and around riverbeds. It's adept at both swimming and digging, so it doesn't mind when its burrows get flooded.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于丰缘近海的沉没遗迹，常聚在被大海淹没的失落古城。它们是在古城兴盛时就已效力，还是毁灭后才到来，研究者仍争论不休。
author: katieplaysgames
source: First found in sunken ruins off the Hoenn coast, POKENAME congregate in long-lost cities drowned by the ocean. Researchers debate if they served in these cities during their prime or arrived after their destruction.

entry: POKENAME让看见它的人心生恐惧，可它其实只想在夜里引人走出沼泽。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME strikes fear in the heart of those who see them, even though they only want to help them find a way out of swamps at night.

entry: POKENAME待在沼泽，隐没泥中。游泳前，会尽可能多喝水，让身体能够浮起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs around swampy areas, hiding amongst the mud. It will swallow as much water as it can to allow it to float while swimming.

entry: 浅溪岸边，布着POKENAME的地洞。它挖出深坑，排走漫溢的水，也让洪灾不易发生。
author: ozydamians
source: The shores of shallow streams are spotted with the burrows of POKENAME. It prevents floods by digging deep holes to drain the overflowing water.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会用鼻子吹出催眠泡泡，让目标沉睡。之后如何，却始终是谜，因为中招者，再也没有出现。
author: rakunk
source: Legends say POKENAME uses its trunk to blow hypnotic bubbles that lull its targets into a deep sleep. What happens afterward remains a mystery, as no one who has fallen victim to its spell has ever been seen again.

entry: 它靠泥浴保持皮肤光滑明亮，头上的触须能辨识泥浆的种类与状态。
author: soup1900
source: It keeps its skin smooth and shiny by bathing itself in mud. The feelers on its head are used to tell both the type and condition of the mud.

entry: 强壮的双臂与鳍，让POKENAME成为游泳好手。作战时，既有行云流水的连击，也有猛浪般的撞击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert swimmers due to their strong arms and fins. Its combat style seems to be a mix of flowing strikes and crashing impacts.

entry: 身体密实，入水便迅速下沉，能沿河床步行。想浮上水面时，单凭强健肌肉也能轻松游回。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its dense body sinks quickly underwater, allowing it to walk along river beds. It can easily swim back to the surface through sheer muscle strength.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，不摆鳍，而靠念力游动，水面上极其少见。据说，能看见它，便会交好运。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to bring good luck to anyone who sees it, POKENAME is a rare sight on the surface. It lives in the deep ocean, using its psychic powers to swim instead of its fins.

entry: POKENAME常笨手笨脚地撞上东西。虽然不会受伤，POKENAME却还是觉得很烦。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME are often seen clumsily tripping into things. While this does not hurt them, POKENAME still find it annoying.

entry: 头角能感知思想与情绪。一察觉周围一定范围内，有谁心怀敌意，它就先爆炸自卫，再瞬间移动离开。
author: celio_0230
source: The horn on its head senses thoughts and emotions. If it senses a hostile thought from within a certain radius around it, it explodes in self-defense before teleporting away.

entry: 它们讨人喜欢却缺少自信，据说拥有所有融合宝可梦中最甜美的笑容。但只会向信任的训练家展颜。
author: quote.lass
source: While they lack the confidence, these charming Pokémon are said to have the sweetest smile of any fusion. They only smile for Trainers they trust.

entry: POKENAME用护手感知敌意，总是尽力避开冲突。即使信任的人想拿它进攻，它也不愿配合。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME senses hostility with its guard and goes out of its way to avoid conflict. It even avoids being used offensively by people it trusts.

entry: 它感知波导，连最微弱的负面情绪，也能察觉。想以心灵感应分享这种感受，却常被误以为在施展超能力攻击。
author: staghorn
source: Its aura-reading abilities can identify even the tiniest hints of negative emotion. Its attempts to telepathically share these experiences are often mistaken for psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME的超能力，借与波导的联系显现出来。可身体太小，还不太控制得住。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities manifest through its connection to aura. Due to its small body, it has difficulty controlling these powers.

entry: POKENAME皮毛柔软，又能辨识情绪，因此十分受欢迎，许多人视它为理想的家庭伙伴。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME are very popular. Many people consider them an ideal Pokémon to raise around a family for their soft coat and ability to recognize emotions.

entry: 它厌恶愤怒，因为共感会让这种情绪化成身体上的痛楚。只愿接近它认为平静的人。
author: skymaster426
source: It despises anger, due to its empathy causing physical pain when it experiences said emotion. It will only approach those it sees as calm.

entry: 危险的登山道上，常能遇见POKENAME。凭着力气与感知情绪的能力，它们会寻找、营救受伤的登山者。
author: thetapemaster
source: POKENAME are commonly found residing on dangerous hiking trails. With their strength and empathic abilities, they are known to find and rescue injured hikers.

entry: 古人留下的记录说，POKENAME曾向他们展示图像，模样竟与现代人类文明，分毫相合。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Ancient peoples' recorded interactions with this Pokémon tell of POKENAME showing them images that accurately resemble modern human civilization.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃划开次元裂隙，窥见未来。持有者心情越好，它的战斗表现也越出色。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade can cut open dimensional tears to see into the future. It fights better when its wielder is in higher spirits.

entry: POKENAME用念力呈现温暖、安全的幻象，引诱猎物靠近。等距离够了，毒刺便猛然扎下，猎物再看穿骗局，也已太迟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lure prey by projecting images of safety and warmth with their psychic powers, tricking targets into approaching. Once close enough, they strike with toxic stingers, revealing the ruse too late for their victims.

entry: 融合令食欲大增，每天要吃数百磅食物。这些养分，正供给它无可比拟的超能力。
author: skymaster426
source: Its appetite grows when it is fused, motivating it to eat several hundreds of pounds of food each day. This food fuels its unmatched psychic powers.

entry: 它是建筑大师。一找到合适地点，就会吐丝织出由桥梁、巢穴和复杂陷阱组成的高效网络。
author: vaporvenator
source: A master architect. Once it finds a suitable area, it spins its webbing to build a remarkably efficient network of bridges, nests, and complex traps.

entry: 刺耳的尖啸，先让敌人动弹不得。随后注入的毒液，便锁紧关节，令皮肤冰冷、苍白。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its piercing screech renders foes unable to move. It then delivers a venom that locks up their joints and leaves them with cold, pale skin.

entry: 融合技术还未普及时，人们曾把POKENAME当作蛇发女妖。古老传说称，POKENAME的目光能将生灵石化。
author: hypersonic06
source: POKENAME were once believed to be Gorgons before fusion was commonplace. Old legends claimed that POKENAME's gaze could turn creatures to stone.

entry: POKENAME在肉搏与超能力战斗上都天赋异禀，一心寻求严苛锻炼磨练本领，许多训练家反而难以满足它。
author: phantom640
source: A prodigy in both physical and mental combat, POKENAME seeks out rigorous training to hone its skills. This can make it a challenge to train for many.

entry: POKENAME极少被人目击，曾一度被尊为神明。环绕身边的符印，检测不到生物特征信号。
author: jokerswild
source: Since sightings of POKENAME are so rare, it was once hailed as a deity. The sigils that surround it have no biometric signature.

entry: 它凭四个大脑与心脏预见危险。训练家若受威胁，就会竭尽全力保护。
author: lemgambino
source: It uses its four brains and hearts to foresee danger. If its Trainer is threatened, it will protect them with all its might.

entry: POKENAME以超能力预知未来。若看见持有者将有危险，就会挥刃劈开黑洞，保护对方。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to see into the future, and if it sees its wielder is in danger, will slice open a black hole in their defense.

entry: POKENAME用超能力幻象躲开人类。若与训练家建立深厚感情，就会不惜一切守护对方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes psychic illusions to hide itself from humans. If it becomes close to its Trainer, it will do everything its power to protect them.

entry: POKENAME用毛发监测周围的精神能量，察觉危险，因此格外在意头发是否干净。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's hair lets it monitor the surrounding psychic energy to detect danger. Because of this, it's very sensitive about keeping its hair clean.

entry: POKENAME爱把心爱的人、物包进网里，留在近旁，妥善保护。可察觉对方想走，即使POKENAME难过，也仍会放开。
author: hello_i_exist
source: POKENAME has a tendency to wrap people and things its fond of in webs to keep them close and safe. However, it will let them go if they sense they wish to be freed, even if it saddens POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会寻找拉鲁拉丝，保护它们，再带到食物充足、遮蔽完善的安全地方。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME seeks out Ralts to protect them from harm. It then takes them to a safe place with plenty of shelter and food.

entry: POKENAME训练举重时，会用念力增加负荷。紧要关头，又减轻自身所受重力，让速度成倍提升。
author: rotcivosk
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to increase the weight it lifts when training. When in a pinch, POKENAME will decrease the force of gravity on itself to become exponentially faster.

entry: 它通常生活在山区，凭超能力与速度，能轻易躲开天敌。
author: patch
source: It is usually found within mountainous regions. It can easily evade predators due to their psychic powers and speed.

entry: 双臂极适合划水，让它轻轻松松，就能制造漩涡、高速游动。
author: staghorn
source: Its arms are extremely hydrodynamic, allowing it to create whirlpools and swim at high speeds with little effort.

entry: 对正义的强烈渴望驯服了POKENAME的野性，让它成为英勇的英雄。不过，它有个坏习惯，总爱在战斗中摆出英雄姿势。
author: leshii
source: Its wild nature tamed by an overwhelming desire for justice, POKENAME is a gallant hero that has a bad habit of striking heroic poses mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME与另一个地区的特殊现象有所关联。它用强劲的肘刃和超能力，保护无辜者。
author: scigaming
source: POKENAME shares a connection to another region's local phenomenon. It uses its strong elbow-blades and psychic power to protect the innocent.

entry: POKENAME是能读懂对手想法的格斗高手。凭先知先觉的迅速行动，它会保护对手，也保护需要帮助的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An expert fighter able to read its opponent's thoughts, POKENAME protects its opponent and those in need with predictive haste.

entry: POKENAME十分强大，却从不发挥全部潜力。它懒得很，喜欢长时间打盹，可被逼入绝境时也十分危险。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is quite powerful, but never uses its full potential. It is lazy and enjoys long naps, but can become dangerous when pushed into a corner.

entry: POKENAME住在拳击手形状的外壳中。先以快如闪电的连拳进攻，再忽然停住动作休息，连半空中也不例外。
author: eggsaladologist
source: POKENAME inhabits a shell in the shape of a boxer. It uses lightning-fast flurries of punches before freezing mid-motion to rest, even in mid-air.

entry: POKENAME人称“森林死神”，会跟随将走到生命尽头的虫宝可梦。若在POKENAME身边死去，会发生什么，却无人知晓。
author: frokachu
source: Known as the 'Reaper of the Forest", POKENAME follow bug Pokémon around that are near the end of their life. It is unknown what happens when they pass in the presence of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，寻找迷路的训练家，慢慢吸走能量，直到人站不起来。成对的铃铛响，会跟在POKENAME身旁，护它周全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME silently glide during the night, looking for lost Trainers to slowly drain their energy until they can no longer stand. Pairs of Chingling follow POKENAME to protect them from danger.

entry: 据说训练家将一只表现不佳的皮卡丘遗弃森林，神秘力量随后附在它身上，便诞生了POKENAME。
author: patch_bros
source: It's said that POKENAME formed when a Trainer abandoned their underperforming Pikachu in a forest, and it became possessed by a mysterious force.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃锋利得能切开一切，却又异常易碎，实在难以使用。
author: .flipside3
source: The blades of a POKENAME are sharp enough to cut through anything. However, they are exceptionally brittle, making them hard to use.

entry: POKENAME飘过荒原，吸取四周一切的能量维生。身体完全中空，却充满电力。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME floats through wastelands, sapping energy from everything around it to fuel itself. Its body is completely hollow and full of electricity.

entry: 月食时，成群POKENAME围成圆圈，向天空挥舞魔杖，仿佛正举行某种仪式。
author: kittyluv090
source: On lunar eclipses, groups of POKENAME will assemble in a circle while waving their wands towards the sky, as if performing a ritual of some sort.

entry: 两颗头都不争主导，因此能配合得分毫不差。望见POKENAME的人，却会莫名悲伤，仿佛失去了一位素未谋面的挚爱。
author: ozydamians
source: Neither head takes the lead, allowing them to move with perfect synchronization. Those who look upon POKENAME feel as though they grieve the loss of a beloved partner they never met.

entry: POKENAME是一种罕见的土居忍士，在蜕壳中途死去。据说，往它背上的裂缝里看，便会被夺去灵魂。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME is a rare form of Nincada which died in the middle of removing its shell. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾是引魂者，以歌声送亡魂前往彼岸。如今，却以听见歌声者的灵魂为食。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Legend says POKENAME was once a guide who used songs to send spirits off to the afterlife. Now, it feeds off the souls of those who hear its song.

entry: POKENAME的宝石全被挖走，只剩空空躯体。曾冠在头顶的那颗，如今碎片永远悬浮，仿佛凝在被取出的瞬间。
author: wormspawn
source: All POKENAME's gems have been mined away, leaving only a hollow body. The gem that crowned its head now forever hovers in pieces, frozen in the moment of extraction.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是一只宝可梦斗志的化身。至于究竟是哪一只，可就难以查证了。
author: dusknoir64
source: Legends say that POKENAME is a manifestation of the fighting spirit of a Pokémon. Proving which Pokémon has been difficult, though.

entry: 极少数尼多兰进化后，仍会保留幼年特征。究竟由何种因素引起，仍然未知。
author: staghorn
source: Rarely, a female Nidoran retains its juvenile traits when it evolves. The factors that cause this to occur remain unknown.

entry: 传闻POKENAME曾是尼多兰，被一位憎恨该物种的疯狂铸剑师锻造成活剑，模样仿佛饱受折磨。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's seemingly tortured form is rumored to have once been a Nidoran, forged into a living sword by a deranged swordsmith who hated the species.

entry: 天敌来袭时，POKENAME会用缎带捆住对方，猛拉过来，撞上自己身上的毒刺。
author: melodydelune
source: If attacked by a predator, POKENAME will latch its ribbons onto its attacker and slam them into the poisonous barbs on its body.

entry: 女孩常在森林里发现POKENAME，它很快就会与她们亲近。虽极力保护饲主，却从不向她们显露真身。
author: houndrys.
source: Girls often find POKENAME in forests, and it quickly bonds with them. They are protective of their keeper, never revealing their true form to them.

entry: POKENAME虽相当常见，野外却难找到。它们不爱动，又与环境融得天衣无缝，训练家每天，可能就与数百只POKENAME擦肩而过。
author: ragincajunnacho
source: Despite being quite common, it can be very difficult to find POKENAME in the wild. Between their lack of movement and ability to camouflage perfectly with their environment, Trainers walk past hundreds of POKENAME daily.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎无法察觉。它们常藏在树上伪装，避开烈箭鹰等天敌。
author: dodoowner_
source: A wild POKENAME is almost impossible to spot. Often times, they hide up in the trees then camouflage away from predators like Talonflame.

entry: POKENAME遇险不变色，反倒瘫软下来，装成毛绒玩具。演得太像，孩子常把它们当真玩偶，抱回家去。
author: teatedtiten
source: Instead of changing color, POKENAME will go limp when it senses danger, acting like a plushie.  They play the role so well that often children mistake them as actual stuffed toys and take them home.

entry: 腹部孔洞中，会伸出四条蛇样的长舌。被好奇的POKENAME舔上，谁都难免觉得难受、不自在。
author: staghorn
source: Its four serpentine tongues emerge through holes in its abdomen. Being licked by an inquisitive POKENAME is a universally distressing and unpleasant experience.

entry: POKENAME伸出刀刃斩击对手。头部颜色，会随环境或心情改变。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade extends to slice its opponent. Its head's color adjusts to its surroundings or mood.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛能变色、带电，都可用于战斗。可也因独特皮毛常遭捕猎，如今已所剩无几。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME fur has color-shifting and electric properties that it uses in battles. Not many are left since it's frequently hunted for its unique fur.

entry: 它能够完美伪装成70,000多种树木。人们推测它是伏击型的捕食者，但至今所有观察它进食的尝试都失败了。
author: staghorn
source: It can perfectly disguise itself as over 70,000 different species of tree. It's theorized to be an ambush predator, but all attempts to observe it while feeding have failed.

entry: POKENAME能随意改变两颗头的颜色，甚至各用一种。身体自动染成两色的混合色，唯独条纹，始终鲜红。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the color of their heads at will, even to two different colors if they so wish. Their bodies automatically change to the mixed color of the two heads, but their stripes will always remain red.

entry: POKENAME借粉红条纹融入珊瑚礁，也会藏进沙地，靠尾巴随时调整方向、抓取物件。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the pink stripes along their body to help blend in with coral reefs. They camouflage into the sand, using their tails to redirect and grasp things at a moment's notice.

entry: 调查中，人们发现有些构造简单的古怪岩群，竟会移动。最近才知，那其实是POKENAME，借岩石的颜色、纹理，藏住自己的条纹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Odd rock formations with fairly simple compositions have been reported to shift during investigations. These formations have recently been discovered to be POKENAME, using the colors and textures of rocks to hide their stripes.

entry: 它隐入背景，吞食人和宝可梦的噩梦。若做了噩梦，却忘记内容，那便是被POKENAME吃掉了。
author: melodydelune
source: Blending in with the background, it eats the bad dreams of people and Pokémon. If you had a bad dream but forgot what it was, POKENAME has eaten it.

entry: POKENAME能不停歇地往返月球无数次，为人类研究月之石的形成提供宝贵线索。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME can journey from the moon and back countless times without a break. It provides humans valuable information on how moonstones are created.

entry: 科学家曾用基因之楔融合两只铁哑铃，试图人工造出金属怪。实验却彻底失败。
author: faelocke
source: Scientists attempted to artificially create a Metang by fusing two Beldum with DNA Splicers. The experiment was a resounding failure.

entry: 人们将额外一只铁哑铃与金属怪融合，想让它更强。可融合过程出了缺陷，整体实力反而下降。
author: faelocke
source: An extra Beldum was fused with Metang in an attempt to make it stronger. However, an imperfection in the fusion process made it weaker overall.

entry: 融合失误，让五个大脑无法同步，结果比普通巨金怪弱得多。
author: faelocke
source: Due to an error in the fusion process, the five brains of this fusion are out of sync. It is much weaker than a regular Metagross as a result.

entry: POKENAME成队捕猎，以磁脉冲交流。攻击时，主要靠磁力把对手拉向自己的刀刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunt in companies and communicate with magnetic pulses. They attack primarily by magnetically pulling opponents onto their blades.

entry: POKENAME的火，连最坚固的金属也能熔掉。最初，人们在金黄市附近发现它。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME's flame is hot enough to melt even the strongest metals. It was first seen around Saffron City.

entry: 它的爪子比铁火龙更尖，可力气不足。不过，攻击上欠缺的，防御却补得回来。
author: ayutac
source: It has sharper claws than Belmander, but they are lacking in strength. What it is missing in offense, though, it makes up in defense.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，比任何科学造出的镜片都强。修习神秘之术的人，常借POKENAME窥看遥远之处。
author: ozydamians
source: A POKENAME's eye is more powerful than any lens produced by science. Occult practitioners use POKENAME to spy across vast distances.

entry: 有人发现，一位天文学家曾借POKENAME，窥见遥远行星，随即引起争论。POKENAME眼中的每个世界，都是漆黑、扭曲的噩梦。
author: wormspawn
source: Controversy arose when it was discovered an astronomer used POKENAME to glimpse visions of distant planets. Every world seen by POKENAME was a dark and twisted nightmare.

entry: 直视POKENAME的眼，除非意志最坚定，否则便会僵直失神。神秘学者声称，它能看尽凝视之物的一切，过去、当下、未来，无一遗漏。
author: ozydamians
source: To behold the eye of POKENAME renders all but the strongest of wills catatonic. Mystics claim that it can see every aspect of what it turns its gaze to, past, present, and future.

entry: POKENAME身形庞大，蛇状身体由坚韧金属构成。它钻入地下深处，蓄力突袭毫无防备的敌人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a large Pokémon with a serpentine body crafted from a tough, metallic material. It can burrow deep into the ground, using its strength to launch surprise attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: 两只POKENAME的身体虽已成功融合，大脑却未能相连，因此远比“真正的”巨金怪弱。
author: faelocke
source: While the two POKENAME's bodies were successfully fused, their brains have not linked up. As a result, this is far weaker than a "true" Metagross.

entry: 多出的爪子有助捕猎，战斗时却不太听使唤。这是因为相连的大脑失去了平衡。
author: faelocke
source: The extra claws aid this fusion in hunting its prey, but tend to be unwieldy in battle. This is due to an imbalance in their linked brains.

entry: 炽烈火焰配上强劲双臂，任何路障也挡不住。传闻，西尔佛公司还想给它添双翅膀，让它真正势不可挡。
author: ayutac
source: With its intense flame and powerful arms, it can break through any barricade. It is rumored Silph Co. is trying to give it wings to make it truly unstoppable.

entry: 西尔佛公司的秘密成果，如今终于会飞，可也失去了一些热量与力气。公司仍在设法改进。
author: ayutac
source: Silph Co.'s secret project can now fly, but in exchange for that, it lost some of its heat and strength. Silph Co. is working on an improvement.

entry: 四颗大脑住在体内，每天耗去大量能量。需要认真思考时，它便滚进发电厂，吸电为大脑加把劲。
author: celio_0230
source: It hosts four brains within its body, which uses up a lot of energy over the course of a day. When it needs to think hard, this Pokémon rolls into power plants, absorbing electricity to supercharge their brains.

entry: 它借水流推进，以坦克炮弹般的速度射出手臂。手臂若被毁，POKENAME就会寻找铁哑铃替换。
author: vaporvenator
source: It uses water propulsion to fire its arms with the velocity of a tank shell. When an arm is destroyed, POKENAME searches for a Beldum to replace it.

entry: 它以机械强化的毒刺传播极其危险的瘟疫。是否仍拥有自己的意志，目前尚不清楚。
author: pepperthepirate
source: It spreads an incredibly dangerous plague with its mechanically augmented stingers. It is unclear whether or not this Pokémon has a will of its own.

entry: 有研究认为，POKENAME没有灵魂。这结果是否可信，又意味着什么，常引起学界讨论。
author: imaginaryneon
source: Research has been done on POKENAME that suggests they do not have souls. The validity and implications of these results are often brought up in scientific discussions.

entry: POKENAME放出花粉般的纳米机器，分析周围环境，借此在脑中构成三维战场地图。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME expels pollen-like nanomachines to help analyze its surroundings. This process allows it to mentally visualize a 3D map of the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME以带爪双翼翱翔高空，身后留下鲜红轨迹，因此有“赤色彗星”之称。
author: nyaarys
source: POKENAME's clawed wings leave bright red trails as it flies high in the sky. These trails have given this Pokémon its nickname, the Crimson Comet.

entry: POKENAME的耳能感知磁波，便于更快找出惯常猎物：小磁怪与朝北鼻。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's ears are used for sensing magnetic waves. This allows them to find their usual prey, Magnemite and Nosepass, more efficiently.

entry: POKENAME的四条金属手臂，出拳比高速列车还快。别与它对视，否则它会以为你在向它挑战。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can use its four metallic arms to punch faster than a bullet train. Do not make eye contact with it as it will see you as a challenge.

entry: 两只聪明绝顶的宝可梦融合，让POKENAME智力无双。可它得不停施展念力，免得自己的凝胶，腐蚀支撑身体的金属腿。
author: voiddx01
source: As the fusion of two very intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME is unrivaled in intelligence. However, it has to constantly use its psychic powers to prevent its gel from damaging the metal legs supporting it.

entry: 想在激烈竞争中立足，像样的珠宝店都会聘用POKENAME。可它们鉴得太细，倒霉的小碎钻，也常被摆上估价台。
author: merclipse
source: All jewelry stores worth their salt employ POKENAME to keep up with the competitive market. Due to their meticulous nature, however, an unfortunate Carbink finds its way onto an appraiser's table far too often.

entry: POKENAME借连接身体的锁链，猛力甩动金属腿，大幅增强穿透力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can use its connective chains to swing its metal legs with a lot of momentum, which greatly increases their penetrating power.

entry: POKENAME痴迷刻划木头与石块。凡是刻上自己印记的东西，都会凶狠地守住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME obsessively carves wood and stone. It aggressively defends anything it has marked.

entry: POKENAME敲木、敲石，勤勤恳恳地筑巢；敲地，吓退来犯者；再敲水宝可梦，打来当食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME diligently pounds wood and stone to make its nest. It also pounds the ground to scare off invaders, and pounds aquatic Pokémon as their predator.

entry: 它时不时就会发呆，此时火焰便渐渐暗下。若没人及时叫醒，火焰就会完全熄灭。
author: skymaster426
source: It has a habit of spacing out from time to time. When it does, its flame slowly dims, and if not snapped out of the trance, it will burn out entirely.

entry: POKENAME会利用先辈的遗骨，强行召来它们的亡灵助战，丝毫不顾先辈是否愿意。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses the bones of its predecessors to call upon their spiritual aid in battle, though it's against their will.

entry: POKENAME似乎变得更加油腻自恋。不过缺点归缺点，它给朋友做的披萨，味道可真不差。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME appears to have taken on a more greasy and narcissistic persona. Despite its failings, it can cook a mean pizza for those it deems friends.

entry: 训练家若毫无防备地靠近楔石，POKENAME便现身，以隐形屏障困住。灵魂被吸走前，最后听见的，据说只有一阵阴森笑声。
author: teatedtiten
source: When unsuspecting Trainers get too close to the Odd Keystone, POKENAME emerges, trapping them with invisible barriers. Supposedly the last thing they hear is a dark, haunting laugh as their soul becomes absorbed.

entry: 它常藏在海中岩缝，耐心等待伏击猎物的好时机。
author: karma
source: A Pokémon commonly spotted hiding in marine crevices. It patiently waits for the opportune moment to ambush its prey.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: chorb33
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: chorb33
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现在巷中，不停抛接发光圆球，借此催眠目标，再将其掳走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME appears in alleyways at night. It constantly juggles its glowing balls, which it uses to hypnotize its victims before abducting them.

entry: POKENAME诞生于崩溃社会的废墟，出没在曾奴役自己祖先的工厂中。
author: thropp
source: Born from the ruins of a failed society, POKENAME haunts the factories that enslaved its ancestors.

entry: 它由108种病毒与恶意程序组成。一旦释放，可能毁掉整个互联网，以及所有相连之物。
author: soup1900
source: A Pokémon made up of 108 viruses and malware programs. Releasing it could destroy the entire internet and everything connected to it.

entry: 一名疯狂科学家将两只宝可梦融合，想把花岩怪永远封在数字世界。结果却未能如愿。
author: soup1900
source: A mad scientist fused these two Pokémon, thinking he could permanently seal Spiritomb into the digital world. It didn't work as planned.

entry: 野生POKENAME收割幽灵宝可梦的灵魂，想挣脱胸口嵌着的楔石。有些人推测，若与强大训练家结下羁绊，也会开始吸取对方的生命。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: A wild POKENAME harvests the souls of Ghost-types in hopes of breaking free of the Odd Keystone embedded in its chest. If it bonds with a strong Trainer, some theorize it will begin to feed off of their life force as well.

entry: 它是音乐遗失的灵魂。未曾谱写或未曾问世的歌曲，都在它身上具现，入夜便庄重吟唱。
author: theheroict
source: The lost soul of music. Any song that has never been written or released is embodied in this Pokémon. It sings solemnly at night.

entry: POKENAME伪装成钟乳石，躲避天敌。一处洞穴，可能藏着数百只POKENAME，各自感知周围最细小的动静。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as stalactites in order to better hide itself from predators. A cave may hold hundreds of POKENAME at a time, each of them detecting subtle movements in their environment.

entry: 花岩怪的108个亡魂，占据了勾魂眼的身体，形成POKENAME。为护住楔石，它还在外面，长出宝石般的护罩。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: The 108 souls of Spiritomb have taken over the body of a Sableye to form POKENAME. In order to keep its keystone safe, it has formed a protective gem-like cover around it.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会唤起前世的仇恨与恶意。没人知道，它为何会被锁在楔石上。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME dances it summons forth its hatred and malice it had in another life. No one knows why this Pokémon was chained to the keystone.

entry: POKENAME常在古迹或黑暗森林附近安家。谁若在家旁被POKENAME抓到，就会遭它夺魂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to make its home near ancient ruins or dark forests. Anyone POKENAME catches near its home will have their spirit stolen from them.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: chorb33
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: chorb33
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 埋在地下的楔石，若封住太多亡魂，便会破封，一同涌出地面。可每颗头都厌恶其他头，彼此不停拉扯，最终谁也逃不走。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: If too many spirits are sealed within a buried keystone, they break free and erupt from the earth as one. Each head despises the others, and so they endlessly strain against each other at the surface, never escaping.

entry: 据说，这是一座住着多个恶魂的杰尼龟雕像，会朝毫无防备的人类与宝可梦，射出水流。
author: schwaus
source: It is said to be a statue of a Squirtle inhabited by multiple malicious spirits. They will shoot water at unsuspecting Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME吸收被自己打败的宝可梦的灵魂。在遭击败前，总会尽可能大闹一番。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME absorbs the spirits of Pokémon it defeats in battles. It will often cause as much mayhem as possible before it is defeated.

entry: 它聚集数百个亡魂，强化自己。为了更多力量，连整个生态系统，也会肆意毁坏。
author: schwaus
source: It has gathered hundreds of souls to empower itself. It will ravage entire ecosystems in the pursuit of more power.

entry: POKENAME出没于古迹，骨骼因注入波导而发光。忠诚勇猛，肉搏与波导战都很强，深受训练家钦佩。
author: sheogorath
source: Found in ancient ruins, POKENAME's bones glow with infused aura. Trainers admire its fierce loyalty and strength in physical and aura-based combat.

entry: POKENAME精通波导与电力，借此制服敌人。脚步之快，连人眼也跟不上。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME uses its mastery of aura and electricity to subdue its opponents. This Pokémon is quick on its feet and is able to move faster than the human eye can follow.

entry: POKENAME身上的火会燃尽接触者的生命精华。它也是精通多种流派的格斗大师。
author: houndrys.
source: The fire that POKENAME emanates burns the life essence of whatever it touches. It's a master of many fighting styles.

entry: 它们虽轻巧细小，勇气与荣誉感却无可比拟。即便毫无胜算，也常奋勇应战。
author: xephyr
source: Although tiny and light, their fearlessness and honor cannot be overstated. They often enter fights that they have no chance of winning.

entry: POKENAME天性亲善，到了和平的地方，总用礼物与拥抱，带来欢乐。有时，友好被误认作软弱，可真要打，它们也是出色的战士。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME are incredibly friendly by nature. They bring happiness in the form of gifts and hugs when visiting peaceful places. Occasionally, their friendly disposition is mistaken for weakness when, in reality, they are very capable combatants.

entry: POKENAME看着不过一朵普通蘑菇，等猎物靠近，便亮出武艺，突然袭击。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME seems like a normal mushroom, but when its prey approaches, it shows its martial skills and attacks.

entry: 它忠于训练家，相隔很远也能察觉对方是否安好。记住一股波导的气味后，就再也不会忘记。
author: houndrys.
source: Loyal to its Trainer, it can sense their wellbeing even at long distance. Once it's learned the smell of an aura, it never forgets it.

entry: POKENAME很少成群被人看见。模样酷似某个热门儿童游戏系列中的可怕敌人。
author: moginar
source: POKENAME have rarely been spotted in groups. They resemble a fearsome foe from a popular children's game series.

entry: POKENAME对波导的掌控增强，四肢也因此更加灵巧迅捷。火焰的威力，不亚于拳头。
author: houndrys.
source: Enhanced aura control allows POKENAME to move its limbs with much greater dexterity and speed. Its flames are as powerful as its fists.

entry: POKENAME由路卡利欧与怪力融合，兼具波导之力与惊人蛮力，常在山区勤奋锻炼。
author: sheogorath
