source: A fusion of Lucario and Machamp, POKENAME wields both aura powers and immense strength. It trains diligently in mountainous regions.

entry: POKENAME在地下凿出蜿蜒隧道，蜕皮释放充沛的生命能量。因此，POKENAME洞里的土，也常被取来作肥料。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: POKENAME carves winding tunnels underground, where it molts to release its overflowing life energy. Dirt taken from POKENAME tunnels is often used as fertilizer.

entry: POKENAME探索水下洞穴，寻找食物与庇护所。凭身体发出的光，越游越深。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME explore underwater caves in search of food and shelter, using their bioluminescence to guide them deeper and deeper into the depths.

entry: POKENAME通常睡上一整天，谁打扰，就追谁，直到对方精疲力竭。据说，黏滑的体表，尝起来像果酱。
author: krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day, but anyone who disturbs their slumber will be chased until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: 巨颚能一口咬断铁条。想教会它不咬人，或少些凶性，根本办不到。
author: staghorn
source: Its jaws are powerful enough to snap an iron bar in two. Training it to not bite or to be less aggressive is an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME在陆地摇摆着走，也能像游水一样滑过泥土。它们不停训练，想更快一些，盼有朝一日，也能飞起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Waddling about on land, POKENAME are able to glide through the ground as if it was water. They constantly train to get faster, hoping they will be able fly some day.

entry: POKENAME平常整天睡觉，可谁打扰休息，就会被追到筋疲力竭。传闻，体表的黏液，滋味像果酱。
author: krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day but will chase anyone who disturbs their rest until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: POKENAME一察觉震动，就会成群钻出，咬向目标。幸好一双结实靴子，就能挡住它们的小牙。
author: staghorn
source: When POKENAME detect vibrations, they emerge en masse to nip at the target. Thankfully, their tiny teeth can be blocked by a sturdy pair of boots.

entry: POKENAME常钻进洞壁，让尾巴垂在外面，引来猎物。可脑袋不太灵光，有时，连自己的尾巴也扑。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME can often be found burrowed into cave walls, dangling its tail above the surface as a lure for prey. Occasionally, however, its less-than-intelligent mind may cause it to lunge at its own tail.

entry: POKENAME头顶长出头盔般的甲片，保护自己。它们钻进地面，再高速弹向天空，拼命想飞得好些。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have developed a helmet-like plating at the top of their heads to protect themselves. They burrow into the ground, then launch into the air at high speeds, trying to fly as best as they can.

entry: 这位猎手平日总在休息，谁惊扰睡梦，就追谁不放。凝胶据说尝起来像苦果酱，让研究者颇感好奇，想一探究竟。
author: krune
source: Often found resting, this predator will chase down anyone who disturbs its slumber. Its gel is said to taste like bitter jam, making it a rare curiosity among researchers.

entry: POKENAME高唱朋克摇滚，随节奏猛摇脑袋，刀刃般的头发四处甩动。谁想伸手摸，它会突然转头，割伤靠得太近的家伙。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME belts out punk rock melodies while rocking its head to the beat, causing its razor-sharp hair to whip about. If someone tries to touch its hair, it will quickly turn away, slashing anyone that got too close.

entry: 月光越充足，POKENAME跑得越快。晴朗的满月夜，它能跑到1马赫。
author: race9000
source: A POKENAME moves faster the more moonlight it receives. On a clear night with a full moon, it can run at Mach 1.

entry: 与大嘴娃不同，POKENAME不太爱欺骗，而是自信地追猎比自己大数倍的猎物。双颚连最硬的金属都能咬碎。
author: berrivine
source: Unlike Mawile, POKENAME is much less deceptive, confidently hunting for prey many times its own size. Its jaws can crush even the toughest of metals.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME鳞片薄而坚硬，加上锋利刀刃，全身上下都是武器。
author: mistershaokahn
source: Its thin, rigid scales, combined with its sharp blades, makes POKENAME a being whose entire body is a weapon.

entry: POKENAME在山中决斗，争夺支配地位。动作快得两秒内，就能把巨石削成沙粒。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found in the mountains, dueling each other for dominance. It is fast enough to turn a boulder into sand in two seconds.

entry: 身体连睡着时也会自行吸放电力，借积存的能量察觉猎物，以闪电般的速度移动。
author: lemgambino
source: Its body passively absorbs and discharges electricity, even while asleep. It uses this stored energy to detect prey and move at lightning-fast speeds.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋就见什么咬什么。虽忠心耿耿，仍不适合由新手训练家饲养。
author: fenragon
source: When it gets excited, it bites everything it sees. For this reason, POKENAME should not be trained by fledgling Trainers, despite its loyalty.

entry: POKENAME十分合群，常与其他物种结伴。过度捕猎，却让它已濒临灭绝。
author: yoshimon
source: This Pokémon is very social and often makes groups with other species. Overhunting has caused POKENAME to be near extinct.

entry: 它长得像某位宝可梦冠军。究竟是想讨更多人喜欢，还是用来吓退训练家，至今不明。
author: jackythewannabe
source: It resembles a certain Pokémon champion. It's unknown if this was so more people would like it, or if it was to serve as a way to scare off Trainers.

entry: POKENAME周身裹着红色黏液，据说味如草莓酱。可它攻击性极强，只有交上朋友的训练家，才能安全采集。
author: krune
source: POKENAME are encased in a red slime said to taste like strawberry jam. Only Trainers who befriend them can safely harvest it, as POKENAME are highly aggressive.

entry: POKENAME出手迅疾、不讲规矩，先用踢击让敌人踉跄，再以利爪结束战斗。它们好胜得很，最讨厌输。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are quick, dirty fighters that stagger enemies with kicks before finishing them with sharp talons. They are very competitive and hate losing.

entry: 身体的其他部分都已成熟，背上的种子却毫无变化。科学家认为，它的种子可能一生都会处于休眠。
author: soup1900
source: Although the rest of its body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of its life.

entry: 它吐出的气体带有热带水果味，却依旧刺鼻。人们说，闻起来就像腐烂的菠萝与木瓜。
author: xephyr
source: The gases it expels have become tropical scented, but still remain pungent. People describe the aroma as being like rotten pineapples and papayas.

entry: 植物盛开时，POKENAME的藤蔓卷曲成亮绿色，抽击强劲。即使损伤，只需晒一小时太阳，便能重新长好。
author: frokachu
source: When its plants are in full bloom, POKENAME's vines coil up and turn a bright green. It can unleash powerful whips with them and they even grow back with just an hour of sunlight.

entry: 整条裙子，其实只是头上花冠的一片花瓣。它能与植物交谈，向它们下令。
author: houndrys.
source: Its entire dress is a single petal from the flower crown on its head. It talks to plants, giving them commands.

entry: POKENAME曾被用于早期的3维游戏中，铺设草地贴图。不幸的是，代码中的错误让它也传播起了病毒。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME was utilized in early 3D games to propagate grass textures. Unfortunately, an error in its coding made it spread viruses too.

entry: 化石显示，POKENAME生前是雨林中的顶级猎手，捕猎技巧高超。粗壮的尾巴能勾住树木荡行，让速度更快。
author: mistymagius
source: Fossil records show that POKENAME were apex predators when they were alive, expertly hunting through the lush rainforest where it lives. Its thick tail allows it to swing from trees to increase its speed.

entry: 它浮在池面吸收阳光，转化成电力。攻击前，还会从触角散出麻痹粉。
author: ariamelisma
source: It gathers sunlight as as floats on the surface of ponds, converting it into electricity. It releases Stun Spores from its antennae before attacking.

entry: 花比预期更早长大，可身体还没强壮到能承重，反而被花压得抬不起身。
author: soup1900
source: Its flower has grown a lot sooner than expected. The weight of the flower crushes it, as it is not strong enough to carry it yet.

entry: POKENAME为了在地面更好地移动，练出强壮肌肉。它以尾端花朵引来猎物，再突然出击。
author: raza
source: POKENAME have developed stronger muscles in order to better navigate on the ground. They lure prey in with the flowers on their tails before striking.

entry: 玩耍泥浆中的养分，让POKENAME颊边的花长大。为了撑住头部，后腿也变得更加硬挺。
author: shocktopus1717
source: The nutrients in the mud POKENAME plays in have enlarged its cheek flowers. Because of this, its hind legs have stiffened further to support its head.

entry: 它藏在丛林藤蔓里，耐心等待。猎物毫无戒心地经过，便会被四只利爪撕碎。
author: busilisk
source: It camouflages itself in vines to remain hidden in jungle environments, where it waits patiently. Unsuspecting prey is torn apart by its four clawed limbs.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与其体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今，它背上的树已经深深扎根于POKENAME的神经系统。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. The tree on its back is now fully rooted in POKENAME's nervous system.

entry: 如今仍活着的许多POKENAME，早在化石宝可梦所处的远古时代就已诞生。它们用极强的力量，守住隐秘洞穴。
author: veteranadventurer
source: Many POKENAME alive today were first born in the time of fossil Pokémon. They guard their hidden caves with extreme power.

entry: POKENAME的绝招，是以剑刃吸收充足阳光，再释放太阳之力，重击对手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's ultimate move is absorbing enough sunlight through its blade to release and smite its opponent with the power of the sun.

entry: 传说这根权杖曾属于巫师，能号令植物。吸足阳光后，还能射出强劲的太阳能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This legendary scepter, said to have belonged to a wizard, can command plants and with enough absorbed sunlight, release a blast of solar energy.

entry: POKENAME的花伞既能通过光合作用提供养分，也能在下雨时收集水分。
author: melodydelune
source: The floral parasol of POKENAME acts both as a source of nutrients when conducting photosynthesis and as a way to gather water during rain.

entry: POKENAME通过感知荒林根系的振动，察觉森林中每一个生命与动作。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME can feel every organism and motion in its forest. It does so by feeling the vibrations of the roots within the wilderness.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴释放大量花粉，让植物茁壮生长。POKENAME住过的地方，总覆盖着绚丽花草。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME emits large amounts of pollen from its tail that allow plants to flourish. Areas where POKENAME reside are blanketed in gorgeous flora.

entry: 它取暖、吸收日光时，火焰会散出怡人香气，令交战的双方渐渐平静。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: As it warms itself and absorbs sunlight, its flame releases a pleasant fragrance. The fragrance becalms those engaged in battle.

entry: POKENAME性情害羞，靠阳光维持花朵生机。入夜便休眠，只留尾焰微光，滋养花朵。
author: imaginaryneon
source: POKENAME is a shy Pokémon that relies on sunlight to keep its flower alive. When night falls, it becomes dormant, sustaining its flower with the dim light from its flame.

entry: POKENAME飞向高空，尽情吸收阳光。日照不足时，则改吃鸟宝可梦。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME flies high into the sky to better absorb the sun's rays. On days where the sunlight isn't as strong, it feeds on bird Pokémon instead.

entry: POKENAME用真菌般材质的双翼高速飞行，散出的孢子，还能帮它进行某种回声定位。
author: canada
source: POKENAME uses its wings, which are made from a fungus-like material, to fly at high speeds. It uses the spores it spreads in a form of echolocation.

entry: POKENAME以巨大花瓣护身，自封沼泽之王，还要求其他宝可梦进贡。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME shields its body with massive flower petals. It fancies itself king of the swamp, and demands tribute from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽友善，却不知道自己拍翼时会散出多少花粉。这些花粉，能引发严重过敏。
author: thekrt
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are unaware of the amount of pollen released as they flutter their wings. Their pollen can cause intense allergic reactions.

entry: 据说POKENAME走遍故乡的农场，以强大超能力催生庄稼，让花朵绽放。
author: cipher
source: It is said POKENAME travels to farms across its homeland, using its immense psychic energy to make crops grow and flowers blossom.

entry: POKENAME那条长满叶片的长尾，年纪越大就越美味。它在热带晒太阳，促进光合作用。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's long, leafy tail tastes better the longer the Pokémon has lived. It sunbathes in tropical areas to promote photosynthesis.

entry: 身上的植物在雨中长得更健康强壮。太阳一出来，便会射出强劲日光束，贯穿厚钢板。
author: soup1900
source: Its flora grows healthier and stronger during the rain. When the sun comes back up, it fires powerful Solar Beams that tear through thick steel.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，尾巴发亮，放出电磁波。来犯者及周围的人，都会被激起剧烈偏头痛。
author: teatedtiten
source: When POKENAME are threatened, their tail shines, releasing electromagnetic waves. This causes intense migraines in the aggressor as well as anyone in its proximity.

entry: POKENAME常独来独往。受到威胁时，便刺向来犯者，将倒刺留在对方体内。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME often keeps to itself, but when it feels threatened it pierces and releases its barbs into its aggressor.

entry: POKENAME在朋友面前很温柔，也能发出使敌人麻痹的超声波叫声。背上的毒刺，还能自由收回。
author: melodydelune
source: Known to be gentle around friends, POKENAME can emit ultrasonic cries that can paralyze enemies. It can retract the poison barbs on its back.

entry: POKENAME就爱被关注，甚至会向其他宝可梦调情，只为博点注意。它的爪子带毒，足以让小型宝可梦昏倒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love any attention that can get and will even flirt with other Pokémon just for the attention. Its claws are venomous and can cause fainting in small Pokémon.

entry: 它长着幽暗的毒刺，平时会收起，免得伤到主人。受威胁时，便以幽灵之手触碰敌人，使其毒发。
author: houndrys.
source: It grows shadowy poison barbs which it retracts as to not hurt its owner. When threatened, it touches its foe with a ghostly hand, poisoning them.

entry: 巨颚移到了背上，既能吐出种子，也能咬住敌人。
author: mossybanana
source: Its giant jaws have migrated to its back. They are capable of spitting seeds or biting foes.

entry: POKENAME收集吃剩的猎物骨骼，既当狩猎武器，也用来剔牙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME collects the bones of its consumed prey to hunt with as weapons or pick its teeth.

entry: POKENAME诱使毫无戒心的猎物欣赏美丽双翼，等对方毫无防备，再猛然咬下。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tricks unsuspecting prey to look at its beautiful wings. When they are most vulnerable, they chomp down on them.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，也十分亲人，可摸它却危险得很：鲜花与裙摆之下，都藏着一排排锋利的牙齿。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME is known for its cuteness, and is very affectionate. However, it is extremely dangerous to touch, as its flowers and dress both contain hidden rows of razor-sharp teeth.

entry: 野生POKENAME平时很怯弱，被逼急了才会反抗。POKENAME猛烈甩动嵌满尖牙的尾巴，展开攻击。
author: mossybanana
source: A wild POKENAME is very meek unless it is cornered. POKENAME fights by wildly swinging its tail, which is embedded with pointed teeth.

entry: POKENAME长大后萌出了叶子。若咬不到对手，POKENAME就会伸出藤鞭。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME has sprouted leaves due to its growth. If POKENAME cannot bite an opponent, then it will reach out with Vine Whip.

entry: 只要是找吃的，POKENAME就格外大胆，甚至常常直接从别人盘子里拿。
author: mossybanana
source: A POKENAME is very bold in its pursuit of food, often taking things directly off of someone's plate.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进调皮孩子的家，吃掉所有礼物，还会趁家长没发现，偷偷捉弄孩子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid the homes of naughty children and eat all of their presents. They will even play tricks on the children without their parents noticing.

entry: POKENAME皮肤如同锈铁，有时会伪装成雕像。其他宝可梦一靠近，就猛然咬下。
author: jokerswild
source: Because of its rust-like skin, POKENAME sometimes pretends to be a statue. When another Pokémon gets too close, it chomps down viciously.

entry: POKENAME跑不过猎物，便常先用香气安抚，再将其吃掉。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often soothe their prey with an aroma before consuming them, as they cannot outrun them.

entry: POKENAME背上的凶恶巨颚，看见什么都吞。结果POKENAME总是吃得肚子满满，懒得活动。
author: nellnast42
source: The vicious jaws on POKENAME's back devour anything and everything in sight. This leaves POKENAME constantly stuffed and lazy, though.

entry: POKENAME张着巨口缓缓漂过水中，甚至能将长达两米的宝可梦整个吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME drifts slowly through the water with its huge, mostly open mouth. It can even swallow Pokémon up to two meters in size in one piece.

entry: POKENAME的头会呼唤寻宝者拿起剑。可一进入范围，可怜的冒险者就会被巨颚咬住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's head calls out to treasure hunters to pick up the sword. Once in range, its jaws chomp down on the poor adventurer.

entry: POKENAME在森林里装作树桩，纹丝不动。小宝可梦靠近，就一口吞下。
author: klgb76
source: In the forest, POKENAME stays as still as a tree stump, patiently waiting for small Pokémon to approach before eating them whole.

entry: POKENAME沿洞顶飞掠，凶猛捕猎。尾巴上的几张嘴饥饿贪食，怎么也填不饱。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME savagely hunts by soaring across the ceilings of caves. The mouths on its tail have a ravenous, insatiable appetite.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: chorb33
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: chorb33
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: 巨大的颚状颈部锥体，让多数人觉得POKENAME丑又可怕。它其实十分友善，那锥体也不伤人，只负责防御天敌。
author: klgb76
source: Despite being considered ugly and scary by most because of its huge, jaw-like neck cone, POKENAME is actually a very friendly Pokémon. The neck cone is inoffensive and only serves as protection from the predators.

entry: 没人说得清POKENAME为何变成这样。只知道抱它一下，往往就得去医院。
author: mossybanana
source: No one quite knows how POKENAME wound up the way it did. It is, however, known that a hug will often result in a visit to the hospital.

entry: POKENAME牙间滴落的毒液，会吸引小宝可梦。它藏在花坛中，引诱猎物靠近。
author: mistymagius
source: The poison that drips from POKENAME's teeth attracts small Pokémon. It will hide in flower beds to lure in its prey.

entry: 它常住在湖里，将巨口埋入沙中。发光的尾巴吸引小宝可梦，待对方毫无防备，再发动攻击。
author: radiationv2
source: It's often found in lakes, hiding its maw under the sand. It uses its glowing tail to attract smaller Pokémon, then attacks when they are vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME能将身上的宝石，凝成镰刀般的利刃。虽能完全化作一把镰刀，却只会交给身边可信赖的大嘴娃使用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to condense the gems along their body into scythe-like blades. While they are capable of fully transforming into a scythe, they only do so when there is a trusted Mawile nearby to wield them.

entry: 可信赖的大嘴娃与它结下羁绊，压住了POKENAME的狂性。战斗中，它化作镰刀，吞噬邪恶宝可梦的灵魂，越战越强，直到足以比肩死神。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their madness kept in check thanks to their bond with a trusted Mawile, POKENAME take the form of a scythe in battle. They eat the souls of evil Pokémon, gaining strength after every battle until they can rival the Grim Reaper.

entry: POKENAME发丝般的嘴啃食垃圾，喷出恶臭烟雾。牙上满是有害细菌，让咬伤也带着毒性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's hair-like mouths munch on garbage and spew out foul-smelling fumes. Their teeth are coated in bad bacteria, causing its bite to be toxic.

entry: 没人明白POKENAME为何能飞。它就是能靠背上的巨颚飞来飞去，不停追赶猎物。
author: mossybanana
source: No one is sure why POKENAME is capable of flight. Yet it flies around on its back-mounted jaws, which it uses to chase prey relentlessly.

entry: 甲壳化成了一副巨颚。POKENAME既用来挡住攻击，也会狠狠咬向靠得太近的敌人。
author: mossybanana
source: Its shell has become a set of jaws. POKENAME will use it to not only block attacks, but also bite down viciously on opponents that get too close.

entry: POKENAME的壳状巨口十分坚固，能抵挡多次攻击。本体却相当脆弱。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's shell-maw is very sturdy, and will withstand many attacks. Its body, however, is quite frail.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑水中，以触手像船用螺旋桨一样转动前进。身体硬而坚韧，与珊瑚颇为相似。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in murky waters and moves around using its tentacles like a ship's propeller. Its body is hard and tough, not dissimilar to coral.

entry: 头上的花如螺旋桨运作。有时，大群POKENAME会从水中升起，飞过数百米。
author: chorb33
source: The blossom on its head works like a propeller. Sometimes large groups of POKENAME emerge from the water and fly many hundreds of meters.

entry: POKENAME能用花产生强劲气流，既可在水中瞬间转向，也能吹飞敌人。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can emit strong air currents via its flowers, which enables it to either change direction in the water immediately or blow enemies away.

entry: POKENAME借触手增强超能力。集中精神时，触手就会轻轻摇动。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to amplify its psychic powers. If it's concentrating, its tentacles will begin to sway.

entry: POKENAME将触手伪装成长剑，吸引寻宝的猎物。对方一进范围，就被抓住，整个吞下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises its tentacle as a sword to attract treasure-hunting prey. When they come within range, it snatches them and eats them whole.

entry: POKENAME进化出的眼斑，连最无畏的天敌也能吓住。那副假笑，其实是一排羽状刚毛，用来捕捉、电击浮游生物。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME evolved to intimidate even the most fearless of predators with its eyespots. The false grin is actually an array of feathery bristles that it uses to catch and shock plankton.

entry: POKENAME装作野生卡比兽，懒洋洋地躺着。猎物靠近，真正的身体就会一把抓住。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME pretends to be a wild Snorlax, lazing around. When its prey gets close, its real body snatches them.

entry: 它能水陆生活。水中将触手转作船用螺旋桨，空中则用作旋翼。
author: chorb33
source: It can live both in water and on land. In the water it rotates its tentacles like a ship's propeller, and in the air it uses them as a rotor.

entry: POKENAME用吸力贴在岩石上，再以触手抓住飘过的东西。不能吃的，就放掉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sticks itself onto rock formations with suction and catches things floating by with its tentacles. It releases anything that is not edible.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁里，咬住靠得太近的猎物。还能像风扇一样转动触手，卷起强劲漩涡。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hides in coral reefs and snaps at prey that gets too close. It can also rotate its tentacles like a fan to create powerful whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME双脚早已退化，如今靠黏性附肢移动。据说，它一旦抓牢什么，只要POKENAME不想放，就什么也扯不下来。
author: ayner
source: The feet of POKENAME are vestigial; it now uses its sticky appendages to move itself. It is said that once this Pokémon grabs something, nothing can unstick it if POKENAME doesn't want it removed.

entry: POKENAME是伏击型的捕食者，会用黏性的触须吊在粗壮树枝上。它留下的分泌物，会让树枝长出苔藓。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: As an ambush predator, POKENAME will hang from thick branches using its sticky tendrils. The residue it leaves behind will grow moss on the branches.

entry: 据说这只史前宝可梦住在热带水域，用扇状部位催眠猎物，吓退敌人。
author: the_smirker
source: This prehistoric Pokémon is said to have lived in tropical waters, using its fans to hypnotize prey and scare off enemies.

entry: POKENAME被认为是太古羽虫与土龙弟弟之间缺失的过渡形态。大眼睛表明，它尚未适应地下生活。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is thought to be a missing link between Anorith and Dunsparce. Its large eyes suggest that it had yet to evolve to an underground lifestyle.

entry: 这把剑放下了自己的武士之魂，与一枚已有100,000,000年历史的爪子化石中的灵魂相连，重新回忆起古老的招式。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword has dismissed its warrior spirit to connect with the one inside a 100,000,000-year-old Claw Fossil, remembering its ancient techniques.

entry: 据说古时POKENAME的皮毛是稳定的丝料来源。柔滑如丝的鬃毛，当年很受人追捧。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said POKENAME fur was a consistent source of silk in ancient times. Its mane is silky smooth and was yearned for back then.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，一见猎物便摇尾扬沙。频繁而猛烈地摇动，甚至能卷出漩涡。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor. When it sees prey, it shakes its tail to kick up sand. If this happens often and viciously enough, it can create whirlpools.

entry: 大爪让捕猎轻而易举。POKENAME背上的硬壳，则保护它休息时免遭突袭。
author: captainzscourge
source: The large claws on its paws allow for an easy hunt. The hard shells on POKENAME's back protect it from any surprise attacks while it's resting.

entry: POKENAME想起亡母时，心中痛苦难当，便会用头骨猛撞坚硬物体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME smashes its skull on hard surfaces in emotional agony when thinking of its late mother.

entry: POKENAME用硬头敲开贝类与软体动物，吸进嘴里。若另一只POKENAME来挑战，双方就对撞脑袋，直到一方认输。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME use their hard heads to crack open and slurp down shellfish and mollusks. If challenged by another POKENAME, they will butt heads until one concedes.

entry: 觅食时，它专找飞行属性宝可梦的巢。一旦发现，就会全力撞过去，将巢摧毁。
author: skymaster426
source: While it hunts for food, it seeks any nests of Flying-type Pokémon. When it finds one, it rams into it at full force, destroying the nest.

entry: POKENAME发现领地有入侵者，便飞到上方，头朝下猛撞。可它们经常扑空，地面留下的大量深坑，让领地格外好认。
author: alumed
source: When POKENAME see an intruder in their territory they will fly above it and drop head-first into the target. Because they frequently miss, their territory can be easily identified thanks to the large number of craters.

entry: 外形太独特，让它们模仿什么都不像。伪装一旦露馅，便干脆用头猛烈撞击。
author: frokachu
source: Due to their rather unique profile, they fail to imitate much of anything. When their disguise inevitably fails, they resort to violently headbutting instead.

entry: 古时，POKENAME以甜香引来猎物，再用坚如铁的头骨狠狠撞击。
author: darkweavile428
source: During ancient times, POKENAME would attract prey with a sweet aroma, then bash it with its skull, which is as hard as iron.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，直撞挡路的一切。岩石甲壳护住身体，让它不怕这些猛烈冲击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies at extremely high speeds, ramming into anything in its path. Its rocky carapace protects its body from these high-speed impacts.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，会飞向彼此，用头猛撞，争夺高下。撞击声，常被误认成雷鸣。
author: fenragon
source: When two POKENAME meet, they will fly to each other and slam their heads together in a display of dominance. This sound is often mistaken for thunder.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉坚如钢铁，两吨重的盾也举得轻松。这些勇士护着无辜宝可梦，迎战体型超过自己十倍的威胁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's muscles are as tough as steel, allowing it to carry its two-ton shield effortlessly. They are valiant warriors who protect innocent Pokémon from threats over ten times their size.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳，总像故乡的一座中世纪城堡。有时，甚至成了那座城堡样式仅存的证据。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's shell always resembles a medieval castle of its home region. In some cases, they are the only surviving evidence of the castle's design.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME硕大的头有90%由骨骼构成，比钢铁还硬。头骨太厚，大脑反倒小得可怜。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME's oversized head is 90% bone, which makes it harder than steel. Since its skull is so thick, its brain is very tiny.

entry: POKENAME虽有推动大陆的力量，却从不认真战斗。训练家养上一周，往往就受不了，解除了融合。
author: faelocke
source: While powerful enough to move continents, it never takes battling seriously. Trainers of POKENAME often unfuse it out of frustration after a week.

entry: POKENAME的体能无与伦比。然而，过于强大的力量反而让它变得懒散而傲慢。
author: griddle
source: The physical prowess of POKENAME is unmatched. However, its strength has made it sedentary and arrogant.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，挖出巨大隧道。有些已发现的隧道，深入地下超过0.6英里。
author: krune
source: POKENAME dig through the ground, creating huge tunnels. Some are found to reach a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在躺着，厚皮让它几乎伤不着。可明明整日无所事事，仍觉得自己比谁都高明。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lazes around for most of the day. Its thick hide protects it from any real damage. Despite doing almost nothing all day, it thinks itself superior to everyone.

entry: POKENAME寻找尼多一族的其他融合宝可梦，将它们视作家人，尽心战斗、守护。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME seeks other Nidoran-related fusions in order to fight for and protect them diligently as family.

entry: 它对在乎的对象极为护短，会拼上性命，确保幼崽与训练家安全。
author: melodydelune
source: Extremely protective of those it cares about, this Pokémon will stake its life to ensure the safety of its young and Trainer.

entry: 这只宝可梦鳞甲坚实，拳力惊人。POKENAME手脚的爪甲长得极快，能刺穿敌人，注入毒素。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon is known for its robust scales and impactful punches. POKENAME's nails grow at a rapid rate on its hands and feet. It uses them to inject its target with poison by piercing them.

entry: 它性情神秘，只与主人交流。真身藏在鳞片躯壳之内，攻击时便伸出幽暗针刺。
author: houndrys.
source: It communicates only with its owner, being very secretive. It keeps its form hidden in its scaly body, and attacks by extending shadowy needles.

entry: POKENAME随时准备迎战。挥出的拳头，对小型生物甚至可能致命。
author: supersonicloki
source: POKENAME is ready for anything. Its punch has been known to be fatal to smaller creatures.

entry: 只有肌肉拉伤时，人们才见过它畏缩。它总在寻找其他豪力融合宝可梦，发起挑战。
author: supersonicloki
source: This Pokémon is only known to flinch when it pulls a muscle. It seeks out and challenges other Machoke fusions.

entry: POKENAME走到哪间健身房，都满嘴“积极向上”，逼得人喘不过气。可想突破自我极限的强大训练家，偏偏就爱找它一起练。
author: supersonicloki
source: A toxic positivity personality at any gym; strong Trainers seek POKENAME out when they want to push their limits as a Trainer and as a human.

entry: 一察觉灾难，它就急忙四处分发自己的蛋，想帮上忙。POKENAME明明仁慈，许多人却仍以为灾祸是它引起的。
author: fountainihili
source: If it senses a disaster, it will begin frantically giving out its eggs to help. Despite its kindness, many still believe POKENAME caused the disaster.

entry: POKENAME如今有了强劲双翼带来的速度，便会远行各地，警告人们即将到来的危险。
author: sejha
source: POKENAME, now blessed with the speed afforded to it by its powerful wings, travels great distances to warn people of coming danger.

entry: 分叉尾巴颤动时，POKENAME就能预见灾难。不过只会告诉自己认可的训练家。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME has the power to predict disasters when its forked tail quivers. However, it will only share its knowledge with a Trainer it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME人称“凶兆之拳”，预知对手尚未使出的招数，借此取胜。若明知赢不了，便不顾一切，也要与敌人同归于尽。
author: mileysakiko
source: Known as "The Fist of Ill Omen", an POKENAME wins fights by knowing its opponent's moves before they ever make them. If it knows it cannot win, it will recklessly attempt to take its foe down with it.

entry: POKENAME夜里捕食林中宝可梦，却不绕树穿行，而是用剃刀般的附肢，一路砍倒挡路的树。
author: patch
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that feasts on forest-dwelling Pokémon. Rather than navigating through the forest, it uses its razor-sharp appendages to slice down the trees.

entry: POKENAME常在生态灾区边缘现身，警告闯入者远离，同时吸收其中污染，让当地复原。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME is often found at the edges of ecological disaster zones, warning away trespassers and absorbing the pollution within to heal the area.

entry: 自然灾难将至之处，常会聚集许多POKENAME，准备将未能生还者的灵魂引往彼岸。
author: darkweavile428
source: Many POKENAME will gather in an area where a natural disaster is soon to occur, ready to take the spirts of all who do not survive to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: POKENAME能感知灾难，并主动示警。对那些不听劝的人，它却乐于看着他们自食后果。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME can sense disasters, and actively warns people of them. It enjoys witnessing the aftermath of those who don't listen.

entry: 人们会带珍稀宝石给POKENAME，换取天灾将至的提醒。可它深居洞窟，并不好找。
author: darkweavile428
source: People will bring POKENAME rare gemstones in exchange for being warned of upcoming disasters. It lives deep in caves, so it's a bit tricky to find.

entry: 据说，碰到POKENAME，短时间内便会倒霉。可后来证实，那不过是POKENAME的黏液太滑惹的祸。
author: mistymagius
source: It has been said that coming in contact with POKENAME's body causes short-lasting misfortune. However, it has been proven that the misfortune is due to how slippery POKENAME's slime is.

entry: 它会强行把人拖离险境，甚至提前好几个小时。可力气太大，拖人时往往反而弄伤对方。
author: pokepower
source: It will forcibly drag people away from danger, even hours ahead of time. Its immense strength usually harms those people in the process.

entry: 它若察觉巨浪将至，就用角戳赶人和宝可梦，把大家送到安全处。明亮的白沙，也颇受收藏家喜爱。
author: pokepower
source: If it senses a tidal wave coming, it will jab people and Pokémon with its horn to drive them to safety. Collectors love its brilliant white sand.

entry: POKENAME夜里溜进村庄，尽情嚎叫，想叫大家陪它玩。可嚎声宛如惨叫，吓得村民纷纷醒来，以为大祸突然临头。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME strolls into villages at night, enjoying howling as loudly as it can to try and call people to play with it. Unfortunately, its howls sound like shrieks, causing all of the villagers to wake up in fear of a sudden disaster happening.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，便赶进村庄示警，想尽可能救人。可进化前的模样太会闯祸，坏名声也一直跟着它们。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rush into villages when they sense an incoming disaster, trying to protect as many people as possible with their warnings. They have earned a negative reputation due to their pre-evolutions causing havoc.

entry: POKENAME能够察觉灾难。可往往还没来得及告诉谁，就把事情忘了。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME have the ability to detect disasters. However, they usually forget about them before they can warn anyone.

entry: POKENAME诞生于死去的绿毛虫。受威胁时，会散出阴冷雾气，趁机脱身。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are born from deceased Caterpie. When threatened, they emit a chilling mist to secure an escape.

entry: POKENAME的目光轻易就能麻痹打算吞食的猎物。它是来自远古的凶悍猎手。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's glare from its eyes can easily paralyze prey it plans on eating. This Pokémon is a fierce predator from long ago.

entry: POKENAME极度胆怯，总避开镜子与水面，免得看见自己可怕的倒影。
author: kandyman
source: An extremely nervous creature, POKENAME tends to avoid mirrors and water, lest it sees its own terrifying reflection.

entry: 墓地下起雨，附近便一定有POKENAME。它走到哪儿，都带来哀愁的雨，还常到葬礼上，向逝者致意。
author: daemonkill22
source: When it rains in a graveyard, one can be certain that a POKENAME is nearby. It brings a melancholy rain wherever it travels, frequenting funerals to pay respects to the dead.

entry: POKENAME更容易在生日会后现身。民间传说，它会夺走小寿星的灵魂，占据其身体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are more likely to appear after birthday parties. Folktales say it snatches the soul of the child who is celebrating, and possesses the body.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，不顾四周，一把抓住所有有机之物。似乎尤其喜欢腐烂的东西。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME have voracious appetites, grabbing anything organic while ignoring their surroundings. They seems to prefer rotten things.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，怯怯躲在训练家身后。可那只独眼的凝视，却连最沉着的旅人，也难以招架。
author: katunei
source: POKENAME floats inches from the ground and cautiously hides behind its Trainer. Though it hides, its single eye burns through even the most stoic of travelers.

entry: 猛踢与斩击已足够危险，POKENAME为了赢，还会不顾自身地猛攻。不知为何，双臂却一直紧紧绑着。
author: katunei
source: Its ferocious kicks and slashes are enough to demand caution, but POKENAME fights recklessly to achieve victory. For some strange reason, it keeps its arms tightly bound.

entry: 据说，这只神秘宝可梦能号令亡魂，常为不明目的聚集坟旁。有人却认为，POKENAME并非恶意驱使，而是在引领迷魂，走向安息。
author: rakunk
source: This mysterious Pokémon is said to command the spirits of the dead, often gathering near graves for mysterious purposes. Some have argued POKENAME uses its powers not from malice but rather as a guide for lost souls to their final rest.

entry: POKENAME脸上的骷髅面具用来吓退天敌。面具边缘的锯齿，还能帮助进食。
author: melodydelune
source: The skull mask on the face of POKENAME is used to ward off predators. The jagged edges of the mask assist it when eating.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME象征着谦逊而缺乏自信的波加曼。独眼让步态笨拙，却仍深得训练家喜爱。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME, thought to represent humble Piplup lacking confidence, charm Trainers despite their clumsy gait from their single eye.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: 别的宝可梦难以生存的险恶湖河里，却有大群POKENAME。没有天敌，一个POKENAME群体，甚至能铺满足球场那么大的水面。
author: mistymagius
source: Large schools of POKENAME can be found in lakes and rivers too dangerous for other Pokémon to survive. Due to a lack of predators, POKENAME schools can be as large as a football field.

entry: POKENAME能穿墙、变形，却只拿这些本领来偷训练家包里的零食。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME have the ability to pass through walls and shapeshift, yet they only ever use this power to steal treats from their Trainer's bag.

entry: 中世纪，人们把POKENAME视为疫病使者，吸过周身黑烟的人，几天内便会死去。后来研究却发现，那烟是在缓缓吸走生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: In medieval times, POKENAME was seen as a bringer of disease, as anyone who has inhaled the dark smoke that surrounds it dies within a few days. However, studies show that the smoke slowly drains the life force of its victims.

entry: 据说伙伴宝可梦离去后，POKENAME便会探访训练家，顽皮地逗对方振作。
author: fenragon
source: It is said POKENAME will visit a Trainer after their partner Pokémon has departed. It will playfully try to cheer the Trainer up.

entry: 骨骼坚硬如石，外衣却没有实体，让POKENAME转瞬之间就能消失。
author: chorb33
source: Its bones are as hard as stone. Its coat, on the other hand, is immaterial and allows POKENAME to disappear in a fraction of a second.

entry: 死去宝可梦的骨骼与巨石结合，诞生了POKENAME。它很少活动，藏在岩缝或洞穴中。
author: chorb33
source: Bones of deceased Pokémon combined with boulders to create POKENAME. It is very inactive and hides in crevices or caves.

entry: POKENAME裹着来历不明的阴暗破布。它能把骨骼缩入其中，喷出尘雾，再消失不见。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is wrapped in gloomy rags whose origin is unknown. It can withdraw its bones inside and emit dust before disappearing.

entry: 困在夜泥中的迷失亡魂，若始终无法安息，便会怨怒，化作POKENAME。
author: sottiwotti
source: When the lost souls trapped in Dusmer are unable to move on, they become enraged and turn into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常在遗迹附近，喜欢吓唬探险者，甚至常令对方心脏病发，丢了性命。
author: sottiwotti
source: They are often found near ruins. POKENAME likes to scare adventurers exploring the ruins, often giving them a fatal heart attack.

entry: POKENAME是一颗巨大浮空眼球。没人知道POKENAME的来历，只知它入夜苏醒，四处觅食。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME has the appearance of a giant floating eyeball. No one knows the origins of POKENAME. It awakens in the night to seek prey.

entry: POKENAME大多无害，可抽动、漂浮的器官，仍让多数人看了害怕。根与藤蔓不停蠕动，寻找月光与黑暗能量来吸收。
author: ozydamians
source: While mostly harmless, the twitching and floating organs of POKENAME frighten most who look upon it. The roots and vines wriggle about searching for moonlight and dark energy to absorb.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: 传说POKENAME偶尔会吸干人的生命，那些人便再不见踪影。有人担心它再次现身，因而惶恐不安。
author: dodoowner_
source: Legends say POKENAME has rarely sucked the life out of humans, who are never seen again. Some people think it'll come out again, causing terror.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: 缠满绷带的身体看似中空，却灌满黑暗魔法。POKENAME能从腹部的骷髅，将魔法释放出来。
author: chorb33
source: Its bandaged body appears hollow, but it is imbued with a dark magic that POKENAME can emit via the skull on its stomach.

entry: 古老神话称，POKENAME是遭渔人捕杀的巨牙鲨化成的怨灵，永远寻找杀死自己的渔夫。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: An ancient myth states that POKENAME are the vengeful spirits of fished-up Sharpedo, forever searching for the fishermen that killed them.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡视河岸。靠近POKENAME的人，却常莫名昏迷，被冲到下游才让人发现。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME are found patrolling the banks of rivers at night. Those who have approached POKENAME are mysteriously found unconsious, washed up downriver.

entry: POKENAME一看见谁，就会盯住，缓慢而坚定地跟上。曾受其害的人说，连噩梦里，它也在一直注视。
author: chorb33
source: As soon as POKENAME sees someone, it stares at them and follows them slowly but purposefully. Past victims report nightmares in which it watched them.

entry: POKENAME展示巨大爪子，威吓其他宝可梦。有人认为，腹部的嘴会吞食猎物的灵魂。
author: pepperthepirate
source: POKENAME shows off its massive claws to intimidate other Pokémon. Some believe it uses the mouth on its stomach to consume the souls of its prey.

entry: 据说，它听从亡者的吩咐，斩杀曾伤害亡者的人，再将其径直送往灵界最黑暗的角落。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said to do the bidding of the dead, slaying those who have wronged them and delivering them straight to the darkest corner of the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME分节身体的每一部分，都能咬住对手。战斗时迅疾扭转翻滚，撕碎掌握中的一切。
author: leshii
source: Each part of POKENAME's segmented body can bite down on a rival. In battle, it twists and rolls at dizzying speeds, shredding everything in its grasp.

entry: POKENAME用头顶天线发出无线电波，与附近所有幽灵属性宝可梦交流，向它们发号施令。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits radio waves via the antenna on its head, allowing it to communicate with all Ghost Pokémon in the vicinity and give them commands.

entry: POKENAME负责接引宝可梦亡魂，尤其那些远离冥界入口、尚未安息的灵魂。亡魂意志越强，就需要越多POKENAME，才运得动。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME are tasked with transporting Pokémon's spirits to the beyond, specifically those that rest far from underworld entry-points. The stronger the Pokémon's force of will, the more POKENAME needed to transport it.

entry: POKENAME夜里守着河岸，行动慢却十分凶猛。被POKENAME袭击的人，通常毫发无伤，却什么都不记得。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME are slow yet aggressive defenders of river banks at night. Those who POKENAME attack are usually unharmed, yet remember nothing.

entry: POKENAME能感知来自灵界的电波。它穿行于墓地，走过之处，彷徨的灵魂也随之离去。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is able to sense radio waves from the spirit realm. It it seen moving through graveyards, and as it passes, it takes the spirits with it.

entry: 据说POKENAME注视谁，就是在审判谁的灵魂。平日爱好和平，受威胁时却会变得极其凶猛。
author: elionagashi
source: It's said that when a POKENAME looks at someone, it judges their soul. They usually are pacifistic, but become highly aggressive when threatened.

entry: 因为没有脸，人们反而会盯着摆锤般的眼睛。凡落入其掌控者，之后命运如何，无人知晓。
author: houndrys.
source: Its lack of a face leads people to instead watch its pendulum eye. The fate of any who fall under its control is unknown.

entry: POKENAME的脖子能伸长许多米，让头部成为有效的打击武器。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can stretch its neck for many meters, allowing it to use its head as an effective striking weapon.

entry: POKENAME大多待在海中，偶尔也会在小海湾与沙滩边游荡。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in the ocean. They are sometimes seen wandering around coves and beaches.

entry: POKENAME住在造船厂附近，爱逛水手常去的地方，以惊人怪力和爱吃菠菜闻名。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME live near shipyards and loiter where sailors usually would. They are known for their wicked strength and their penchant for eating spinach.

entry: POKENAME是为战斗而生的魁梧巨兽，食量大得荒唐，常被养在专为填饱它们而建的牧场。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are hulking behemoths built for battle. They eat absurd amounts of food and are often raised on ranches purpose-built to sate their appetite.

entry: POKENAME喷出强劲水流，逆什么激流都轻而易举。越接近进化，凶悍的性情便越显露。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME breaches any current with ease, propelling itself forth with powerful jets of water. Its aggressive nature begins to show as it draws closer and closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME罕见又刚被发现，却成了伪科学爱好者的宠儿，还常被误称为“最早在陆地生活的宝可梦”。
author: leeto64
source: Despite being a rare, recent discovery, it's a favorite in pseudoscience. POKENAME is commonly incorrectly called 'The First Land-Living Pokémon'.

entry: POKENAME重200公斤，一击便能压扁车辆或整群鱼，吞尽其中生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Weighing in at 200kg, POKENAME can flatten vehicles or entire schools of fish to consume all their life force in one blow.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为体色更浓的吼吼鲸。也有人觉得，不过是嘴巴更大一点的吼吼鲸。
author: dodoowner_
source: People mistake POKENAME for a more saturated Wailmer. However, some people consider this to be a Wailmer with a bigger mouth.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的般地游海，很少受打扰。可一发现猎物，就会以惊人速度猛冲过去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is rarely disturbed as it roams the sea seemingly without aim. However, it will shoot forward at considerable speed if it spots prey.

entry: POKENAME半埋在海床沙中，一动不动等待猎物。目标一出现，便扑出将其整个吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the seabed, half-buried in the sand, where it lies motionless in wait for prey. If it spots any, it lunges and devours them whole.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半由水组成，能浮在海面。受惊时，POKENAME喷出的巨型水柱，连坦克也能掀翻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is mostly water, allowing for it to float on the surface of the ocean. When startled, POKENAME shoots massive geysers of water powerful enough to topple a tank.

entry: 它比其他虫宝可梦长得快得多。据传，中了它毒针的毒，就再也无法治好。
author: .flipside3
source: It grows much faster than other bug Pokémon. The poison applied by its stinger is rumored to be incurable.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的歌声，让听者僵在原地。它们还能召来，持续一周以上的暴风雪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's songs are said to freeze anyone who hears them in their tracks. They can summon blizzards that last for over a week.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以美丽歌声控制潮汐。它拨动里拉琴时，听者心中，也会静若止水。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to control the tides with its beautiful singing voice. As it plays its lyre, people who hear it are said to feel as calm as water.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是最初的龙宝可梦，龙焰的威力足以烧遍世界。可它们仍仁慈地守护着，一切活着的生命。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be the first dragon Pokémon, POKENAME are powerful enough to scorch the whole world with draconic fire. Despite this, they are benevolent protectors of all living things.

entry: POKENAME守护着升华的小陨星。据说它与星辰本身为友，可无人知道是真事，还是传说。
author: charmingloopy
source: POKENAME is the guardian of ascended Minior. It is said to be friends with the stars themselves, but no one knows if that is true or just a legend.

entry: POKENAME致密的皮甲连黑洞的引力也能抵挡。它将铁质核心压得极紧，几乎就要引发核聚变。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dense hide is strong enough to resist the force of a black hole. It compresses its iron core so hard the core is on the verge of nuclear fusion.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME有“神之子”的称号，人们因此像崇拜阿尔宙斯本尊一样敬奉它。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is given the title of God's Child. Because of this, people worship POKENAME as if it was Arceus itself.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME狂妄自大，总吹嘘自己凌驾众生。还有个古怪爱好：追逐野生六尾。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME is a creature of great hubris, often bragging about its superiority to all creatures. It has a strange hobby of chasing wild Vulpix.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME射出满含苍翠能量的强箭，箭落何处，草木便繁茂生长。短短几分钟，就能造出整片森林的生机。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires off powerful arrows full of verdant energy, growing lush flora wherever the arrows land. It can grow entire forests' worth of plant life within a few minutes.

entry: 它拥有宇宙中每种元素的力量。传说认为，这才是POKENAME真正力量的展现。
author: zerpus
source: It has the powers of each and every element of the universe. Legends claim this is POKENAME tapping into its true power.

entry: POKENAME蕴含阿尔宙斯的伟力，据说能摧毁宇宙，与阿尔宙斯的创造之力维持平衡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Imbued with the might of Arceus, POKENAME is said to have the power to destroy the universe to balance Arceus' creation.

entry: 传说末日之时，POKENAME会伴着刺目光芒自天而降。人们每年献上供物，盼其息怒。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that, in the end times, POKENAME will descend from the skies with a piercing light. Tributes are made each year to appease it.

entry: POKENAME的涡轮尾巴产生原初宇宙能量，使它能够动用创世之力。
author: junohnebula
source: POKENAME's turbine tail generates a primal cosmic energy, allowing this fusion to tap into powers of creation.

entry: POKENAME会在梦中化作明光现身。凡目睹它的人，醒来后都会神情恍惚。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found within people's dreams, appearing as a bright light. Anyone who witnesses it can be found in a trance after waking.

entry: 据说POKENAME的脑海装着整个宇宙。里面发生的一切，它都听得见，因此头痛得厉害。
author: cybresamurai
source: It's said that POKENAME's mind contains an entire universe. It hears everything that happens within, so it gets terrible headaches.

entry: 金色鬃毛的火焰璀璨闪耀，仿佛不属尘世。若不慎吸入灰烬，可能会在超凡的震撼中僵住。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The flames of its brilliant, golden mane glitter like nothing in this world. Mistakenly inhaling its ashes could leave you frozen in unearthly shock.

entry: 它从土里萌生，身体由叶片构成，尾巴则是泥土。温暖湿润的尾巴里，带着可供繁殖的芽苗。
author: houndrys.
source: It sprouts out of the ground. Its body is made of leaves and its tail of dirt. It carries reproductive sprouts in its tail, which is warm and moist.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的植物脑袋，顶在流畅的外星身躯上，能量澎湃。它已能控制自然力与超能力，草属性本领，却还未发育成熟。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME has a round, plant-like head atop a sleek, alien body radiating vibrant energy. It controls the forces of nature and psychic powers. It has yet to properly develop its Grass-type powers.

entry: POKENAME栖居沼泽，藏在水下，用酷似植物的尾巴伪装。
author: supersonicloki
source: Found in marshes, POKENAME is known to hide underwater and disguise itself using its tail's plantlike resemblance.

entry: POKENAME大多出现在红树林生长健康的沼泽，因令人安心的气息而受欢迎。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are mostly found in swamps where the mangroves are healthy. It's popular for its soothing aura.

entry: POKENAME能徒手造山。有人推测，远古成群的POKENAME，曾帮助雷吉奇卡斯，创造、塑成世界的大陆。
author: doodledoo
source: POKENAME is able to create mountains with its bare hands. It is theorized that in the past, hordes of POKENAME helped Regigigas create and shape the continents of the world.

entry: 背上的树大得足以让小宝可梦栖居。POKENAME动作太慢，住客几乎不会被摇下来。
author: pepperthepirate
source: The trees on its back are large enough for smaller Pokémon to live in. Since POKENAME is so sluggish, the inhabitants are rarely shaken out.

entry: 翅膀终生不断生长，即使年老的POKENAME，背着如此庞大沉重的翅膀，也能轻松浮起。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon's wings will grow continuously throughout its lifetime. Despite their size and weight, even old POKENAME can still float effortlessly.

entry: 最大的POKENAME已成了动植物的浮空乐土。它会落地熟睡，让小宝可梦爬上身。
author: mistymagius
source: The largest of POKENAME have become floating havens of flora and fauna. It sleeps soundly on the ground, allowing small Pokémon to climb on.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，能量强大，终于完全掌握草属性本领。它从大地与宇宙取力，操纵周围环境，发出猛烈攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME towers with immense energy, having finally mastered its Grass-type abilities. This formidable Pokémon draws strength from the earth and cosmos, manipulating its surroundings to create powerful attacks in battle.

entry: POKENAME常用身体撞击物件，标记领地。因此，小宝可梦都不愿在它们背上筑巢。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME often bash their bodies against objects to mark their territory. Because of this, small Pokémon avoid building their nests on their backs.

entry: POKENAME拔起树苗，栽进背部进行光合作用。树长得太大，就再换一棵新的。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME pull saplings from the ground and integrate them into their back for photosynthesis. Once it grows too big, they replace it with a new one.

entry: POKENAME背上的树不断长大，重得无法行动后，就用壳内火焰把树烧掉，也借此获取养分。可有时，不小心便引发了山火。
author: aurange
source: The tree on POKENAME's back grows until it is too heavy for it to move, then it uses the flames from within its shell to burn down the tree. This process is also how POKENAME nourishes itself. It sometimes unintentionally starts forest fires.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，又格外吵闹，常在险峻山间出没。一走丢，就用悦耳的鸣声，呼唤双亲。
author: gwello
source: POKENAME are hyperactive and loud. They can be found around craggy mountains letting out a euphonious cry to call out to their parents if lost.

entry: POKENAME会在崎岖山巅成群玩耍，有时持剑对决，有时翩翩起舞，留下道道火迹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been seen playing in groups atop craggy mountains. Sometimes they sword duel, and sometimes they dance, leaving behind trails of flames.

entry: POKENAME一天睡上20小时，战斗时却从不疲倦。以三片叶子为食，便能维持体内余火。
author: houndrys.
source: This POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours daily, yet never tires when fighting. Its three-leaf diet keeps its embers alive.

entry: POKENAME凭大耳朵听见数英里外的威胁，却胆小得连毒也不敢用。威胁若靠近，就赶快逃跑。
author: canada
source: POKENAME uses its large ears to hear threats from miles away. It's too cowardly to use its poison, so it will flee if a threat gets too close.

entry: POKENAME头叶上，覆着微小毒针，碰到便一阵刺痛。可去掉针，叶片又能用来烹制异国佳肴。
author: mistymagius
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head is coated in microscopic needles that cause a stinging pain when touched. However, once the needles are removed, the leaf can be used in exotic dishes.

entry: 大耳朵能听见远处威胁。毒性越强，身上的毒刺也越大。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large ears allows it to hear threats coming from far away. Its poison barbs grow larger the more poisonous it is.

entry: 它看似一动不动，其实一直留意着周围。POKENAME会让尾焰燃烧得更加明亮来威吓敌人，也能迅速发动攻击。
author: houndrys.
source: Its inactivity is deceitful, as it's aware of its surroundings. POKENAME's tail flame burns brighter to intimidate threats, and it can strike quickly.

entry: 每到冬天，POKENAME就格外抢手。它的火焰温暖又舒适，能让食物瞬间解冻，用来烤棉花糖饼干也再合适不过。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME demand gets higher each winter, as the warmth its fire emanates is very soothing. It can thaw food in an instant and is great for s'mores.

entry: POKENAME很容易被激怒，转而攻击。这头烈焰公牛全速冲锋时，会点燃沿途一切。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME tend to be very easily enraged into attacking. When this blazing bull charges at full speed, it sets everything along its path aflame.

entry: POKENAME对实力极有信心，连战斗都保持侧卧。技艺高超得连果子会落在哪里，也能预知。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME is so confident in its power that it remains lying on its side, even in battles. It's so skilled, it can predict where fruit will fall.

entry: 血液燃烧，斗志也熊熊而起。两只交战时，能听到急促轰鸣；等响起大大的哈欠，才算打完。
author: houndrys.
source: As their blood burns, so does their fighting spirit. When two engage in combat, quick, loud booms can be heard; loud yawning indicates when it ends.

entry: 熟睡时虽安宁，醒来后血流便会升温，使它们狂暴肆虐，所过之处只剩灰烬。
author: houndrys.
source: Though peaceful while slumbering, when woken up, their blood flow will heat up, causing them to rampage, leaving only cinders behind.

entry: POKENAME能随心操纵身体，直抵天际。据说心跳听起来，如同鼓声。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate its body at will to reach the heavens. It is said that you can hear the sound of drums coming from its heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME身上的“火焰”其实不是火，仍是棉絮，只是借火焰的幻象吓退天敌。
author: patch_bros
source: The flames on POKENAME are actually not flames at all. They are still cotton, but they give that illusion in order to ward off predators.

entry: 很久以前，人们会观赏POKENAME用燃烧的四肢起舞。训练家醉心于它们的舞技，模仿这些动作创造了火舞。
author: teatedtiten
source: Long ago, POKENAME were used for entertainment as they danced with their fire-engulfed limbs.  Trainers, being invested in their techniques, mimicked them to create fire dancing.

entry: POKENAME整天不知疲倦地锻炼、进食、战斗。练成新武艺时，热血燃得更烈，却始终不肯满足。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME tirelessly train, eat, and fight all day. Their blood flow burns intensely as they master new martial arts; they are never satisfied.

entry: 獠牙折断后，POKENAME会用火将其焊回原处。虽然过程痛苦，修复的獠牙却极少再度折断。
author: teatedtiten
source: If its tusks break off, POKENAME will use its fire to weld them back on. Though this process is painful, these tusks rarely ever break again.

entry: POKENAME平时不太留意四周。野生个体虽讨厌接受训练家投喂，却必须靠这些赠食才能活下去。
author: dodoowner_
source: This Pokémon is usually oblivious to its surroundings. Although wild POKENAME hate accepting food from Trainers, they need their gifts to survive.

entry: 它有着成年个体的身躯，心智却仍像刚孵化的幼体。成熟之前，可能会危及自身及周围的生命。
author: krune
source: With the mind of a hatchling but body of an adult, this creature can be a danger to itself and others until it matures.

entry: POKENAME平时温和，只捕小鱼。可一受善待，就觉得对方在挑战自己的本领，随即发起攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is usually passive, hunting only small fish. However, when shown any kindness, it takes it as a challenge of its abilities and attacks.

entry: 这是古代文明制造的机关人偶，据推测是为了探索极地、研究那里的环境与生物。POKENAME伪装成波加曼，得以混入野生波加曼之中。
author: arcul
source: An automaton made by an ancient civilization, it is speculated its purpose was to explore and study arctic landscapes and its inhabitants. POKENAME's disguise as a Piplup allows it to blend in with wild Piplup.

entry: POKENAME虽是植物，却能在最寒冷的环境存活，也是生态巨蛋中炎兔儿喜爱的零食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME, although a plant, can survive the coldest environments. It's a popular snack for Scorbunny living in the Terarium.

entry: 自尊心太强，让POKENAME很难结交朋友或找到伴侣。但只要建立了情谊，它就会以性命守护对方。
author: krune
source: POKENAME's pride can cause it to struggle with finding friends or partners, but once it does, it will bond with them and defend them with its life.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着曾被偷猎的帝王拿波的灵魂。为了复仇，它会劈开一整队偷猎船。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Said to be imbued with the spirit of the Empoleon it was poached from, POKENAME cleaves fleets of poaching ships in revenge.

entry: POKENAME从冰山顶守住领地，凭武艺将浮冰劈成两半，震慑来犯者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from atop icebergs, intimidating invaders with its martial prowess by cleaving ice floes in half.

entry: 据说POKENAME由葬身海中的水手化成，如今仍在大海上游荡。它会从沉船中救出遇难者，引导他们平安浮上水面。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have been born from a fallen sailor lost at sea, POKENAME wanders the open ocean. It is known to rescue people from sinking ships, guiding them safely to the surface.

entry: POKENAME是冰河时代的王者。在精灵球被发明之前，它曾捕食早期人类。宝可梦融合技术使它再次苏醒。
author: creep0202
source: The king of the ice age, POKENAME was a predator to early humans before the invention of Poké Balls and have been revived due to Pokémon fusion.

entry: POKENAME大多面朝北方，也一路向北，仿佛踏上了漫长的朝圣之路。人们认为，它是在寻找失散的家人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Facing and heading north most of the time, POKENAME appears to be on a long pilgrimage. It is thought to be in search for the rest of its family.

entry: 它用鼻子辨别所居海域的水流方向，岩石般的硬身体则能抵御天敌。
author: melodydelune
source: Its nose is used to navigate the currents of the seas it inhabits. Its rock-hard body defends it from predators.

entry: 虽然有着类似指南针的性质，它们却不朝北。科学家推测，它们指向的其实是月球的磁场。
author: staghorn
source: Although they have compass-like properties, they do not point north. Scientists theorize that they are aligned with a magnetic field on the moon.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子又重又有磁性，总指着北方，行动起来十分不便。因此，POKENAME只得把大鼻子举到头顶上。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME's nose is heavy and magnetic. It always faces north, which makes moving around rather difficult, as POKENAME must resort to carrying its large nose atop its head.

entry: 据说，向北延伸的洞穴其实是POKENAME锻炼时挖出的隧道。挖掘产生的铁质碎屑都会吸附到它带磁性的尾尖上。
author: enemyphase
source: It is said caves leading north are actually the tunnels created by POKENAME training. Any iron rubble created in this process clings to the magnetic tip of their tail.

entry: 鼻子总朝北，迫使POKENAME练就了极其敏锐的反应。几乎不可能悄悄靠近它，否则就会触发它的战斗本能，使它陷入狂暴。
author: enemyphase
source: Due to its north-facing snout, POKENAME have had to develop impeccable reflexes. It is nearly impossible to sneak up on one without activating its fighting instinct and sending it into a frenzy.

entry: POKENAME常被各大社交平台拿来当表情包。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME is commonly used as a reaction image on many social media platforms.

entry: 环绕POKENAME的电气场，总有一部分被拉向北方，成为许多探险者可靠的指路标。
author: phantom640
source: A part of the electric aura surrounding POKENAME will always be pulled north, making it a reliable source of navigation for many explorers.

entry: 鼻子伸出保护身体的凝胶之外，让它能闻到食物与同伴的气味。鼻孔会排出多余的凝胶，这些凝胶也带有磁性。
author: krune
source: Its nose protrudes beyond its protective gel, allowing it to smell food and allies. The nostrils release excess gel, which has magnetic properties.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却有辨认方向的第六感。飞机上的卫星导航失灵或断线时，就会请它充当指南针。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although blind, POKENAME can use its sixth sense of direction to guide it. Planes use it as a compass if the GPS breaks or loses connection.

entry: POKENAME最爱金属含量高的石头。吃完一颗，便会转向下一颗磁石所在的方向。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME always prefers stones with the highest metal content. Once it has eaten one, it turns in the direction of the next magnetic stone.

entry: 角能释放强磁场，吸来富铁岩石，再反转磁极，将岩石作为危险弹丸射出。
author: chorb33
source: Its horn can emit a strong magnetic field, attracting iron-rich stones. It then reverses the field's polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: 它用角释放强磁力，吸来金属含量高的岩石，再改变磁极，将它们作为危险弹丸射出。
author: chorb33
source: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: POKENAME总面向太阳，不断调整位置，让自己正对着它。到了正午，POKENAME便仰面躺下，鼻子直指上方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME always faces the sun, constantly shifting its position to line itself up perfectly. Once it hits midday, POKENAME will lie on its back, pointing its nose straight up.

entry: POKENAME背上的水晶能产生强大的磁场。朝北鼻和三合一磁怪等宝可梦会聚集在它身旁，盼望借此进化。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a strong magnetic field from the crystals on its back. Certain Pokémon like Nosepass and Magneton hang around POKENAME in hopes to evolve.

entry: POKENAME能从头部电磁铁释放强大电磁脉冲，让附近所有电子设备停摆。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can emit a powerful EMP via the electromagnet in its head, deactivating everything electronic in its vicinity.

entry: 幽灵能量，让金属聚集在双臂的头部周围。人们认为，它会将亡魂引往彼岸。
author: moopse
source: Ghostly energy causes metal to collect around the heads on its arms. It's thought to direct souls to the afterlife.

entry: 它将四肢摆成奇怪的角度，借此精细调整自身磁场的作用。一旦察觉威胁，便用成千上万根带磁性的针发动攻击。
author: staghorn
source: It poses with its limbs at strange angles, which allows it to fine-tune the effects of its natural magnetic field. If it senses a threat, it will attack using thousands of magnetized needles.

entry: 它用强磁场让皮毛覆满金属，化作护身铠甲。出拳的威力，犹如掷出巨石。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its strong magnetic field, it coats its fur in metal to act as armor for its body. Its punches are equivalent to boulders being thrown.

entry: 很久以前，四只POKENAME与人类共同生活，守护着他们的城市。如今，人们每年都会在节庆上唱起一首古老的歌，向它们致敬。
author: doodledoo
source: A long time ago, four POKENAME lived with humanity and protected their cities. Nowadays, once a year during a festival, an ancient song is used as tribute to them.

entry: POKENAME的钢牙能迅速吸干猎物的生命。背上的囊袋被认为装着尚未吃完的食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's steel fangs quickly drain the life from its victims. The sack on its back is thought to hold its unfinished food.

entry: POKENAME挥动布带，似乎能迷住目标，随后POKENAME便冲上去，狠狠咬住对方。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's cloth seems to enchant its victims when waved around before POKENAME charges and bites down on them.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的火焰锻造出剑，再以此迎敌。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can forge swords from the flames on its back, which it then uses to fight with.

entry: 它靠布片般的翅膀在城镇间飘游蹦跳。战斗时会尽可能升到高处，再挥刃攻击。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its cloth wings to float and bounce across towns. During battles it gains as much height as possible before attacking with its blade.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME的出现会招来纷争。可若在开战前看见它，又被视为己方必胜的征兆。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The presence of a POKENAME is thought to bring about strife. Seeing one before battle is thought to be a sure sign of victory for your side.

entry: POKENAME在战场上搜寻甲胄碎片，焊在自己身上。它也会伏击其他拾荒者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME scavenges battlefields for pieces of armor to weld to itself. It ambushes other scavengers.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的尾巴铲土。领地争斗时，也会拿尾巴互相冲刺交锋。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME use their blade-like tails to move dirt, akin to a spade, but also use them to joust with one another during territorial conflict.

entry: POKENAME吵闹好斗，但只要握着柄把它提起来，就会立刻安静下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is rowdy and acts aggressively, but quickly calms down when picked up by its handle.

entry: 它的草叶利刃一挥就能斩倒树木。身上长出的厚重金属铠甲能抵挡其他POKENAME的攻击。
author: schwaus
source: Its blade of grass can cut down trees with a single stroke. It grows a thick metallic armor to protect itself from other POKENAME.

entry: 尽管身披金属铠甲，仍常能见到它飞快地纵跃于林间。POKENAME在森林中相遇，便会交战，直到剑刃崩出缺口。
author: schwaus
source: Despite its metal armor, it is often seen leaping through forests at breakneck speeds. When POKENAME find each other in forests they fight until their blades chip.

entry: POKENAME凭顽强意志，撑过本该致命的伤口。不过插在颈间的剑，仍会影响它的身体。
author: ayner
source: The sheer determination of POKENAME has made it able to withstand its normally fatal wound. The sword in its neck can influence the body nonetheless.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: 这只POKENAME正在分裂，尝试新的战术。两条缎带，也让动作更加灵巧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME is in the process of splitting. It is attempting new tactics and its two ribbons give it more dexterity.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: 这只POKENAME的剑身已经长长，作战时也改用长剑技法，不再沿用短剑的招式。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword combat techniques.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME成群聚集，用月之石碎片铸剑，再始终带在身边。
author: melodydelune
source: During a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather to forge their swords out of Moon Stone fragments. They will carry these swords with them at all times.

entry: POKENAME由两个争夺同一宿主控制权的灵魂构成。谁都不会想被卷进它们的争斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consists of two spirits fighting for control of a single host. You wouldn't want to be caught in the crossfire of their skirmish.

entry: 体内寄居着亡者的灵魂。它不知疲倦地四处奔走，只为完成那个灵魂的遗愿。
author: .flipside3
source: A departed soul rests inside this Pokémon. It tirelessly seeks to fulfill that soul's dying wish.

entry: 据说独剑鞘曾怜惜一只孤独的小火龙，任它握起自己。如今，两者英勇冒险，铲除邪恶。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that a Honedge once took pity on a lonely Charmander, allowing itself to be wielded. Now, the two adventure valiantly to vanquish all evil.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: 几只酷似独剑鞘的宝可梦寄居在灰尘山的空壳内。每把穿出皮肤的刀刃，都属于藏在里面的不同个体。
author: duskrd
source: Several Pokémon resembling Honedge have infested the husk of a Garbodor. Every blade piercing its skin belongs to a unique member hiding inside.

entry: POKENAME花瓣中卡着的刀刃根本无法挪动。它已夺走霸王花的灵魂，如今控制着空壳。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The blade trapped within POKENAME's petals is impossible to move. This is because it has taken the soul of the Vileplume, and now controls its husk.

entry: 这只披甲的宝可梦会在夜里持剑狩猎小型猎物，极其敏锐的双眼为它提供帮助。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This armored Pokémon hunts small prey at night with sword in hand, assisted by its hypersensitive eyes.

entry: 独剑鞘已接管火恐龙部分身体。不过战斗动作反而更灵活，因此火恐龙并不反对。
author: nellnast42
source: Honedge has now taken over part of Charmeleon's body. However, this improves their movement in battle, so the Charmeleon does not object.

entry: 意识分在剑与本体之间。若换给它一把没有意识的剑，就会发现它的剑术其实很差。
author: staghorn
source: Its consciousness is split between its sword and its main body. When given a nonsentient blade, its swordsmanship is revealed to be poor.

entry: 喷火龙与独剑鞘如今配合得天衣无缝。在战场上，POKENAME的剑刃与烈焰都不可轻视。
author: nellnast42
source: Charizard and Honedge are now in perfect sync with one another. Both POKENAME's blade and flames are not to taken lightly on the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME是仍在修行的年轻剑士。它仰慕前辈，希望有朝一日能拥有同等的力量与本领。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a young swordfighter in training. It looks up to its superiors so it may one day match their strength and prowess.

entry: 隆隆石的身体被独剑鞘之灵附身，成了既善格斗又力大无比的战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The body of the Graveler possessed by the spirit of a Honedge makes it a formidable martial fighter and brute.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是一名已故骑士侍从的坐骑。如今它仍握着对方的剑，等待重逢。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the mount of a departed squire, holding their sword as it awaits their reunion.

entry: POKENAME会先让猎物入睡，再杀死对方在梦中的化身，以此进食。受害者从此再也无法做清醒梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME puts its victims to sleep and feeds by slaying their dream self. Victims are unable to have lucid dreams ever again.

entry: POKENAME甲壳上长出的利刃能当作飞刀投出。它丢弃的刀刃还被人用来装饰海鲜菜肴的摆盘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME grows blades from its carapace which it uses like throwing knives. Discarded knives have been used as props to present seafood dishes.

entry: 布制翅膀的浮空效果，竟意外出色。它俯冲斩击敌人，再以粉末扰乱目标。
author: xephyr
source: The cloth that comprises its wings is surprisingly effective at keeping it airborne. It dives and slashes at foes, using powders to disorient targets.

entry: POKENAME游在古战场附近的海岸，会收集找到的阵亡武士兵器，添入自己的武库。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME swims near the shores of ancient battle sites. It will add the weapons of fallen warriors it finds to its arsenal.

entry: 胸前的眼睛时刻留意危险。头上刀刃却太钝，不能用来战斗。
author: .flipside3
source: The eye on its chest is always on the lookout for danger. The blades on its head are too dull to use for combat.

entry: 两片草叶利刃只需几秒就能斩倒最粗壮的树木。与其他POKENAME切磋前，它总要花上几小时磨剑。
author: schwaus
source: With its two blades of grass, even the thickest trees are felled within seconds. It spends hours sharpening its blades before sparring with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME另有一个幽灵形态的心智。幽灵在旁预警，它则优雅地挥舞双剑。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME have a second mind in the form of a specter. The specter warns of danger as they elegantly slash with their two swords.

entry: 模样酷似古代英雄。人们会请它充当守卫，保护贵重物品。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon resembles a hero from ancient times. They are used as guardians to protect valuable items.

entry: POKENAME摆动布匹般的鳍，沿海底缓缓游动。凡是落到它刀刃前的东西，转眼就会被切碎吞下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waves its cloth-like fins to slowly swim along the ocean's floor. Anything that falls in front of its blades is chopped up and consumed in short order.

entry: POKENAME是战事将至的预兆，会为城市预警敌袭。许多城市却误以为它招来了战乱，这也成了它们最后犯下的错误。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The harbinger of battle, POKENAME warns cities of raids. Misunderstanding it as the bringer of conflict has been many cities' last mistake.

entry: POKENAME已部分分裂，主要边旋转边前进攻击，攻势令大多数斗士难以招架。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has partially split, and attacks primarily by spinning and advancing. Its movements are overwhelming to most fighters.

entry: 三剑攻势复杂莫测，连剑术造诣极高的对手也挡不住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The complex attack patterns of its three swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

entry: 这只POKENAME暂时认定，还是用单一形态容纳新力量最合适。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME has decided its newfound abilities are best contained in its single form, for now.

entry: 它好奇心旺盛，常用臂上刀刃切开东西，只为看看里面长什么样。
author: .flipside3
source: It has an incredibly curious nature. It will often cut through things using the blades on its arms to see what they look like on the inside.

entry: 它能感知附近人的情绪。据传，还会盯着心藏秘密的人不放。
author: .flipside3
source: It is able to sense the emotions of nearby people. It is rumored to stare at people who are hiding secrets.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的祸患，会突然从沙丘里钻出，伏击人类商队。若运气好，损失的还只是粮食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are a menace of the desert, emerging from the dunes just to ambush human caravans for their food, if the humans are lucky.

entry: 传闻它不死不灭。也有人说，若主人曾善待它，它就会替训练家完成遗愿。
author: .flipside3
source: It is rumored to be immortal. It is also rumored to carry out the dying wish of its Trainer if it was treated well.

entry: POKENAME在森林中游荡，仿佛凭着本能，用牙齿与利刃不加分辨地砍向树木和草属性宝可梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest slicing trees and Grass-type Pokémon with its teeth and blades indiscriminately, as if by instinct.

entry: 它十分害羞。有人靠近，就用两侧缎带遮住眼睛。
author: .flipside3
source: It is an exceptionally shy Pokémon. If approached, it covers its eye using the ribbons at its sides.

entry: 身上刀刃锋利得能切开钢铁。可动作不够灵巧，无法有效运用。
author: .flipside3
source: The blades on its body are sharp enough to cut through steel. It lacks the dexterity to use them effectively, however.

entry: 随着成长，体表液体慢慢覆上刀刃。成熟后，对刀刃的控制也更加自如。
author: .flipside3
source: As it grows, the liquid enveloping its body slowly covers the blades. This gives it more control over them as it matures.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: 进化后，群体内的成员数量翻倍。害怕被盯着看或害怕尖锐物品的训练家，不适合训练它。
author: duskrd
source: The number of members in the colony has doubled during its evolution. Trainers with scopophobia or aichmophobia should not train this Pokémon.

entry: 它爱在废弃城堡筑巢，歌声如同小号吹响迎宾号曲。
author: .flipside3
source: It likes to build nests in abandoned castles. Its song resembles a trumpet's fanfare.

entry: 它从不背后袭敌。双翼既可当铠甲，也能用来飞行。
author: .flipside3
source: It never attacks an opponent from behind. Its wings are used for armor as well as flight.

entry: 野生POKENAME常把树果串在头上刀刃，留着以后吃。若在寒地长大，围巾也会变长。
author: .flipside3
source: Wild POKENAME will often skewer Berries on the blades on their heads to be eaten later. If raised in colder weather, its scarf will grow longer.

entry: 身体各处的眼睛，留意每个方向的危险。围巾末端十分灵巧，甚至能从树上摘果。
author: .flipside3
source: It watches for danger from any direction using the eyes on its body. The ends of its scarf are dexterous enough to pluck Berries from trees.

entry: POKENAME背上的刀刃蕴含庞大幽灵之力。可喷火龙每次使用，都会被双剑鞘抽取生命力。
author: nellnast42
source: The blades on POKENAME's back hold immense spectral power. However, each time Charizard uses them, Doublade drains its life force.

entry: 据说，每只POKENAME都寄宿着王族的灵魂。它的意志与铠甲一样坚不可摧，即使败局已定，也绝不低头。
author: xillo
source: It is said that each POKENAME possesses the soul of royalty. Indomitable in both spirit and armor, this Pokémon never yields, even in assured defeat.

entry: 融合能量染上了花朵。胸前宝石是有自身意识，还是仅在辅助能力，仍有争论。
author: noilaedi
source: The energy from fusion has tinted its flowers. It's debated if the jewel on its chest is sentient or assisting in its abilities.

entry: POKENAME始终勇敢重诺，据说是从异世界穿越时间而来的骑士。
author: adoster
source: Always displaying courage and honor, POKENAME are rumored to be time-traveling knights from another world.

entry: POKENAME默默游历四方，寻找能奉为主人的训练家。一旦认可对方，就会忠心不二地效力。收服后，最好尽早为它准备剑鞘或头盔。
author: modeustheunbound
source: POKENAME silently roams the world, looking for a Trainer to call its master. It is highly loyal and devoted to those it deems worthy. Be sure to buy a sheath or helmet for it at your earliest convenience.

entry: 头饰上镶着华丽的盾牌。POKENAME常将盾牌撞向树桩，敲出富有节奏的鼓点。
author: schwaus
source: Its headdress is adorned with an ornate shield. POKENAME often slam these shields into tree stumps to create rhythmic beats.

entry: 传说，这只宝可梦一击便能横扫千军。铁匠们研究POKENAME，希望造出更精良的武器与铠甲。
author: schwaus
source: Legends say that this Pokémon was able to defeat whole armies in a single sweep. Blacksmiths research POKENAME to create better weapons and armor.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却能作出最公正的裁决。自诞生以来，它便被“宝可梦正义律师”用作象征。
author: galactakiller
source: Although POKENAME is blind, it delivers the most righteous judgements. Since its creation, it has been used as a symbol of Pokémon Justice Attorneys.

entry: 各地都知道，POKENAME会在英雄危急时刻现身，给他们武装，迎战强敌。
author: tomatosalad
source: POKENAME is known throughout the lands to appear to heroes in their time of need, arming them to fight great foes.

entry: 它似乎能看出与生俱来的领袖资质。传说获其认可者，注定会成为领主。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become a lord.

entry: POKENAME凭钢刃的力道与重量，能劈开任何对手。可它的另一半，却已被夺走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade, but it was robbed of its other half.

entry: POKENAME能从头部与双臂长出武士刀，施展迅疾拔刀术。它对劈斩拉多怀有宿怨。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is capable of sprouting katanas out of its head and arms, which it uses to perform a quick draw. It holds a vendetta against Bidon.

entry: 它是剑艺超群、手段却不光彩的剑士。先以幻象误导敌人，再挥出可怕一斩。
author: nellnast42
source: An extremely talented but underhanded swordfighter. It uses its illusions to misdirect its foes before unleashing a terrifying slash.

entry: POKENAME像守护王族一样保护训练家。它用强劲双腿猛然前冲，挥出破坏力惊人的一斩。
author: pikachu_2434
source: POKENAME will protect Trainers as if they were royalty. It lunges forward using impressive legs and delivers a devastating slash.

entry: POKENAME是高洁的卫士，守护着自己的领地与训练家。它用头上的刀刃防御，同时挥剑迎战前来挑战的对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME are noble defenders, protecting their territory and their Trainers. It uses the blades on its head for defense while wielding its sword to fight those who try to challenge them.

entry: 古文献暗示，POKENAME早在融合技术出现之前就已被创造，是打造它们的王室的贴身侍卫。
author: phantom640
source: Ancient texts hint that POKENAME was actually first created long ago before fusion, and were the personal guards to the royal houses that built them.

entry: 过去，人们在战场立起巨像纪念阵亡者。士兵亡魂附入其中，便化成POKENAME。
author: skymaster426
source: In the past, giant golems were created at the sites of wars to honor the fallen. The souls of dead soldiers possessed them, becoming POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的防御经过优化，无论太空的冰冷真空，还是重返大气时的酷热，都能承受，几乎毫发无损。
author: char_latte3412
source: With its optimized defenses, POKENAME can endure both the cold vacuum of space and superheated atmospheric entry with hardly a scratch.

entry: 中世纪，人们常佩戴绘有POKENAME的徽章。采用这一纹章的王国，都以精锐军队和坚固防御自豪。
author: char_latte3412
source: A depiction of POKENAME was a common badge worn in medieval times. Kingdoms that bore it prided themselves on their superb armies and defenses.

entry: 亡魂如浓雾般围绕POKENAME。传说它会替这些灵魂实现最后的心愿。
author: .flipside3
source: The souls of the departed flock around POKENAME like a heavy mist. It is said to grant the last wishes of these souls.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的剑士，常独自锻炼。面具若破损或被摘下，就会立刻逃走。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: As a proud swordsman, POKENAME is often seen training alone. If its mask breaks or is removed, it will flee immediately.

entry: 小火龙的勇气赢得坚盾剑怪认可。如今两者并肩作战，坚盾剑怪还能让它的尾火永不熄灭。
author: nellnast42
source: Charmander's courage deemed it worthy in Aegislash's eyes. The two fight now together, as Aegislash can keep its tail burning forever.

entry: 有人靠近，它就把脸藏在盾后。据说面对天生有领袖资质的人，会少些害羞。
author: .flipside3
source: It hides its face behind its shield if approached. It is rumored to be less shy around those with innate leadership qualities.

entry: POKENAME遍身珠宝，生活奢华，囤积从其他宝可梦与训练家处掠来的财物。POKENAME会拼命守住这些战利品。
author: j1miin
source: POKENAME lives in luxury, covered in riches. It will hoard its loot from other Pokémon and Trainers. POKENAME will defend the loot with its life.

entry: POKENAME由古老铠甲与布料组成。只有用对招式，背上的剑才会出鞘。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is made up of ancient armor and cloth. The sword on its back will only be unsheathed when the right move is used.

entry: POKENAME曾是骑士贵族的常见伙伴。它极善用剑，而剑往往由主人赐予。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was once a common partner for knightly nobility. It is extremely adept with a blade, which it often receives from its masters.

entry: 据说，野生POKENAME会像训练家对战一样，向其他野生宝可梦发起挑战。还有传闻称，剑中封着所有败于它手下的灵魂。
author: jokerswild
source: Wild POKENAME reportedly challenge other wild Pokémon like a Trainer Battle. An urban legend says its sword houses the souls of those it has bested.

entry: POKENAME自认是将要继承王国的王子。勇武故事渐渐传开，也聚起了一小群追随者。
