author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME views itself as the prince of a kingdom it will soon inherit. Tales of its bravery have spread, and it has amassed a small following.

entry: 这对刀刃不停铲土钻地，身边常有一面盾。那面盾，恰好就是它们的首领。
author: neonriser
source: A pair of blades that constantly shovel themselves to the ground. They are often accompanied by a shield, who happens to be their leader.

entry: 可怕的幽灵烈焰，加上精湛的剑盾技艺，让POKENAME仿佛注定会成为强大、却也可能专横的君王。
author: nellnast42
source: With its terrifying spectral flames and mastery of sword and shield, POKENAME appears destined rule as a mighty, yet perhaps despotic, king.

entry: 它远行各地寻找最强兵刃。传说曾有一只POKENAME，手中之剑连次元也能斩开。
author: rakanadyo
source: This Pokémon wanders far and wide in search of the strongest blades. There are legends of an POKENAME whose sword could cut through dimensions.

entry: POKENAME用利剑般的牙齿啃穿地壳。遇到强敌时，它会将整个身体当作长鞭挥动，招架对方的攻击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME chew through the crust of the earth with teeth as sharp as swords. They can parry the attacks of powerful enemies by swinging its entire body like a large whip.

entry: 它体型虽庞大，却不用炮，而施展灵巧剑术。拼命保护麾下的杰尼龟与卡咪龟，连来犯水箭龟也能击退。
author: pokepower
source: Despite its bulk, it uses deft swordplay instead of cannons. It fiercely defends the Squirtle and Wartortle it leads, repelling even rival Blastoise.

entry: POKENAME生性好斗，领地意识极强。但若向体型比自己大的对手挑衅，往往落不到好下场。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME are aggressive by nature and incredibly territorial. However, their attempts at fighting anything larger than themselves tend to end poorly.

entry: 它们容易动怒，会用缎带缠住一切被视为威胁的东西，再以毒角猛刺。
author: melodydelune
source: Quick to anger, these Pokémon will latch onto anything it perceives as a threat with its ribbons and jab it with its poisonous horn.

entry: 被POKENAME的角刺中后，会有轻微的灼痛感持续数日。它嬉闹起来十分莽撞，容易误伤人，因此很少有人将它当作宠物饲养。
author: frokachu
source: Those stung by POKENAME's horn will feel a mild burn for a few days. It isn't seen as a pet too often due to its aggressively playful nature, and risk of getting stung by mistake.

entry: POKENAME的历史极其久远，有人推测人类正是受它启发才发明了斧头。有些个体甚至愿意让训练家握着自己使用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is so ancient, it is theorized to have inspired the creation of the axe. Some even allow their Trainer to wield them.

entry: POKENAME用水中垃圾制成锐利兵器，与其他POKENAME并肩作战，抵御外来物种，保护家园。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME uses trash in the water to create sharp weapons. It defends its home from invasive species, fighting alongside other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME成群猎杀目标。捕猎成功后，便在河边石上磨利身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME slaughter their victims in groups. After a successful hunt, they sharpen themselves on stones by a river.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又鲁莽，常把刀刃卡进各种东西。可群体配合，却十分默契。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are recklessly energetic, and are often found with their blades stuck in various surfaces. However, they are well coordinated in groups.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又能预知，是可怕的军师与首领，还能用超能力更好地操控巨大尾刃。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's cunning and clairvoyance make them formidable strategists and leaders. They use psychic power to better control their large tail blade.

entry: POKENAME极为聪明。指挥驹刀桶大军时，谋划的战术往往极其有效。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are extremely intelligent. When commanding an army of Pawnllery, its battle strategies prove to be extremely effective.

entry: 四肢都附着锐利刀刃。POKENAME以头撑地旋转时，碰到什么都能切开。
author: blazerxz
source: It has sharp blades attached to all four of its limbs. When POKENAME starts spinning on its head, it can cut anything it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME全身披着钢甲，双臂上的刀刃锋利无比，连最坚韧的橡树也能斩断。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME is covered from head to toe in steel armor. The blades on POKENAME's arms are sharp enough to cut even the strongest of oak trees.

entry: POKENAME是个空壳，漫游世界，收集死去宝可梦的灵魂。平时温顺，受攻击后却战得毫不留情。
author: radiationv2
source: POKENAME is an empty husk which wanders the world in search of deceased Pokémon souls to gather. It is docile unless attacked, but ruthless in combat.

entry: 融合使POKENAME的双臂与头部长出电锯。如今，脑海里塞满了自私欲望。
author: nellnast42
source: With Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME sprouted chainsaws from its arms and head. Its head is now flooded with selfish desire.

entry: POKENAME常成群弹奏舒缓吉他，吸引伴侣，博取青睐。带刃尾巴则用于捕猎。
author: acidicjesse
source: POKENAME plays soothing guitar music to attract and impress potential mates, usually in groups. It uses its bladed tail for hunting prey.

entry: 它精通手里剑技艺。双打对战时，会将自己掷向敌人，替伙伴分散注意。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon has mastered the art of the shuriken. In double battles, it will throw itself at its enemies to distract them from its partner.

entry: 它用一对灌注了精神力量的短刀作战。只有打算一击结束战斗时，它的气场才会显现出来。
author: staghorn
source: It fights with a pair of psionically-charged knives. Its aura is only visible when it intends to end the battle with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME虽然总板着脸，却深爱自己的训练家。它会用透视能力时时刻刻注视着对方。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its permanent scowl, POKENAME deeply loves its Trainer. It will use its x-ray vision to watch its Trainer at all moments of the day.

entry: 它会扑向猎物，用带电的爪子与角将其麻痹。见什么都爱打上一架，兴奋不起来时，甚至会电自己一下。
author: frokachu
source: It pounces on prey, paralyzing them with electric claws and horns. They like picking fights with almost anything, and will even shock itself to get excited.

entry: 唯有凝视饱受折磨的灵魂，才能让它感到快乐。有人认为，POKENAME会模仿故事中的某些角色，从中汲取力量。
author: degla
source: It only feels joy when staring deep into a suffering soul. Some believe POKENAME draws power by mimicking certain characters in stories.

entry: POKENAME追逐目标时，刀刃一闪，便能感知对方的灵魂。连隔着墙的灵魂，也逃不过感应。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When POKENAME's blade glimmers whilst pursuing a victim, it can sense their spirit. It can even sense spirits through walls.

entry: POKENAME像家族中的成体一样自信又好斗，因此常向自己打不赢的对手挑衅。不过，它冲撞敌人时仍能释放出威力不俗的电击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to have the confidence and eagerness of the adults in its family, and because of this it picks fights it can't win. It can still pack a decent shock when charging into something though.

entry: POKENAME会整夜尾随猎物，直到对方筋疲力尽。随后猛扑而上，用尖刺产生的电流发动攻击。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME stalks its prey throughout the night until it is exhausted. When it pounces, it attacks using electricity produced by its thorns.

entry: 出于对音乐的热爱，POKENAME不断苦练，将天赋磨炼得炉火纯青。它的歌唱技艺已臻化境，出众的嗓音令世界各地无数人倾倒。
author: voxary
source: POKENAME's innate musical talent was honed and perfected through its non-stop training and love for music. It has become an apex of singing talent, and many worldwide admire POKENAME's dazzling voice.

entry: 人们推测，POKENAME能看透物质与心灵。它能用纯光创造物品，自如地操纵；据说凝视它的手杖，还能看穿实体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are theorized to see anything physically and mentally. It can create objects out of pure light that it controls freely. Staring into its staff is said to allow you to see through physical matter.

entry: POKENAME的铁甲虽笨重，却十分适于水下行动。额前的角，则用来刺穿毫无戒心的猎物。
author: nellnast42
source: Although clunky, POKENAME's iron plating is specially suited for underwater travel. Its frontal horn is used to skewer unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME被激怒时，厚甲会亮起黄澄澄的电光。带电后，沉重身体也变得异常灵活。
author: nellnast42
source: When irritated, POKENAME's heavy armor glows bright yellow with electricity. This charge makes it extremely nimble for its weight.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，铠甲会烧得像熔炉。随后便鲁莽地四处冲撞，为自己降温。
author: nellnast42
source: When in battle, POKENAME's armor heats up like a furnace. It then smashes into its surroundings recklessly to cool off.

entry: POKENAME能借铠甲传导庞大超能力，尾巴也能发射强劲光束。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is able to channel its immense psychic powers through its armor. Its tail is capable of launching off a powerful beam.

entry: 它住在深海床。哪怕轻擦一下锐刺，也会令它猛烈爆炸，留下剧毒。
author: kittyluv090
source: It lives on the floor of deep oceans. Even just slightly grazing its sharp spikes causes it to violently explode, leaving potent toxins in its wake.

entry: 它照料的蛋几乎无法破坏，却也永不孵化。因此也没法吃，尽管有传闻称它们能大益健康。
author: pokepower
source: Eggs it cares for become nigh-indestructible, but never hatch. This also means they are inedible, despite rumors of wondrous health benefits.

entry: 它不断散失静电，因此总在寻求补电。会接下落雷，也用尾巴剖开电子设备和电池取电。
author: pokepower
source: It's always seeking a charge, as it constantly sheds static. It relies on lighting strikes and slicing open electronics and batteries with its tail.

entry: 这位远洋巨兽的霸主有时被称为“移动堡垒鲸”。古老传说中，一位术士曾与它立下誓约，在它背上建造城堡。训练家会乘着它，平安探索茫茫大海。
author: alkazamis
source: This titanic lord of the pelagic ocean is sometimes known as the Mobile Fortress Whale, recalling an old legend in which a mystic made an oath with one and built a castle on its back. Trainers use them to explore the whale roads in safety.

entry: POKENAME将整座山划为领地，时刻警惕地守护。刀刃上的缺口，也被视作值得骄傲的战斗纪念。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, which it vigilantly maintains. Chips in its blade are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

entry: POKENAME凭强大铠甲自由往来各界。凡被它视为闯入领地者，都会遭到可怕的暴力袭击。
author: tomatosalad
source: Utilizing its powerful armor, POKENAME can travel freely between realms, unleashing terrible violence on any it deems trespassers of its territory.

entry: 两个头不断互相撞击，想比出谁的铠甲更坚硬。可惜铠甲太重，它们的行动相当受限。
author: mistymagius
source: The two heads constantly bash each other to see whose armor is stronger. However, their armor is so heavy that their movement is pretty limited.

entry: 多年前，人们曾在卡洛斯战争的险恶战场见过POKENAME。它用铁矛吓退对手。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME was observed fighting on the dangerous battlefields of the Kalos war many years ago. It uses its iron spear to scare off opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，其中金属充足，足够构筑铠甲。金属善于反射声音，还能增强声波能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves with enough metal to build its armor. The metal is great at reflecting sound, which enhances its sonic abilities.

entry: 寄生在POKENAME体内的真菌迫使它吞食大量铁，用吃下的金属供自己生长。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus that inhabits POKENAME compels it to eat massive amounts of iron. The consumed metal supports the fungus' growth.

entry: POKENAME嗡嗡地穿行于沙暴，帮迷路的旅人找到附近的绿洲。它会高速振动翅膀，抖去种子上的沙尘。
author: ozydamians
source: Buzzing through sandstorms, POKENAME will help guide lost travelers to an oasis near them. It rapidly vibrates its wings to clean the dust from its bulb.

entry: 它高飞避敌，个头又小，让天敌很难抓住。入夜才飞下来，到池塘喝水。
author: skymaster426
source: It keeps high in the skies to avoid predators, which struggle to grab it due to its small size. During the night, it flies down to drink from ponds.

entry: POKENAME擅长追踪。覆盖双眼的护目镜状薄膜，让它在最猛烈的沙暴中也能看清事物。这种忠诚的宝可梦会救助在沙漠里迷路的训练家。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are excellent trackers, with the visor-like film over its eyes allowing it to see clearly through the harshest sandstorms. These loyal Pokémon will rescue Trainers it finds lost in the desert.

entry: 沙暴中，POKENAME拍翼扩展波导，寻找其他生物。它会保护领地内弱小宝可梦，抵御猎人与偷猎者。
author: therider
source: During sandstorms, POKENAME flap their wings to extend their aura and find others. It defends weak Pokémon in its territory from poachers and hunters.

entry: POKENAME力量虽大，却很少构成威胁。它们更爱拍翼扬沙，挖出凹坑躺着。
author: jokerswild
source: Despite their immense strength, POKENAME are very seldom dangerous. They prefer to kick up sand with their wings to create divots they can lay in.

entry: POKENAME只有在需要掀起沙暴驱敌时才会飞行。它沉稳坚毅，又富有守护之心，颇具王者风范，因此在流行文化中有时会被描绘成王族。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME only fly to kick up sandstorms to ward off enemies. Their protective and stoic nature give it a feel of royalty, so it is sometimes depicted as such in popular culture.

entry: 剑刃与拍动的双翼，奏出迷人的金属乐曲。POKENAME再用缎带卷起沙尘暴，困住目标。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade and flapping wings create an enthralling, metallic song. POKENAME then spins up a dust storm with its ribbon to trap its victims.

entry: POKENAME用身体发出的绿光引来虫属性宝可梦，再以火焰烧死它们。它似乎也很喜欢熔化沙粒，塑成玻璃雕像。
author: mistymagius
source: The green light from POKENAME's body draws in bug Pokémon before incinerating them with its flames. It seems to enjoy making glass sculptures by melting and shaping sand.

entry: 它在花田筑巢。受威胁时，就用带毒旋风迎敌。
author: lemgambino
source: It makes its nest amongst fields of flowers. When threatened, it attacks enemies with a poisonous whirlwind.

entry: POKENAME的腿原本太脆弱，终于长出了护腿。它崇拜狂欢浪舞鸭，也想学会流水旋舞。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME eventually got leggings, as its legs were very vulnerable before. It admires Quaquaval and wants to learn Aqua Step.

entry: 一点污垢就会令它恼火。美丽外貌加上流畅迅捷的泳姿，让它在华丽大赛中备受赞赏。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is irritated by the slightest grime. It is prized in contests for its beauty and swift and fluid swimming.

entry: 它真正的美貌，常让人类和其他宝可梦为之倾倒。为了躲开不想要的关注，它经常藏进身上坚韧的海带丛后。
author: mundane_frog
source: Its true beauty often bewitches people and other Pokémon. It regularly hides behind its sturdy kelp growths to avoid unwanted attention.

entry: POKENAME能随意调整背部鳞片的颜色与反光程度。在水中时，鳞片反射光线，让从上方观察的捕食者几乎看不见POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME can adjust the color and reflectivity of its back scales at will. When viewed in water from above, the scales catch the light and render the POKENAME nearly invisible to predators.

entry: 据说，剑鞘上流光溢彩的鳞片能平复狂躁的心。POKENAME正好借此安抚猎物，再出手袭击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts; perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.

entry: 特殊的鳞片让POKENAME无论潜入水中还是跃出水面，都丝毫不减速度。出色的飞行与游泳本领使它成为优秀的猎手。
author: phantom640
source: Thanks to its scales, POKENAME can dive in and out of the water without losing any speed. Its excellent flying and swimming make it a great hunter.

entry: 它住在海中，悦耳歌声便是靠近的信号。人们认为，人鱼传说正源于它。
author: melodydelune
source: Living in the seas, you will know it is near by its harmonious singing. It is thought this Pokémon is the origin of the myth of mermaids.

entry: POKENAME只吃最美味的鱼宝可梦。离水后，就用爪子反反复复梳理长发。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME eat only the tastiest fish Pokémon. When they get out of the water, they brush their hair with their claws over and over.

entry: 有人想让丑丑鱼更像进化后的模样，以此将其“美化”，POKENAME便因此诞生。丑丑鱼爱好者对此褒贬不一。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is the result of attempts to "beautify" Feebas by making them resemble their evolution. Opinions of POKENAME among Feebas fans are mixed.

entry: 古时，人们敬重POKENAME的绝美姿容。直到如今，牙与爪的化石仍是珍贵奢侈品。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was revered in ancient times for its great beauty. Fossils of its teeth and claws are still valued as luxury items.

entry: 它们成群聚集在珊瑚礁附近，保护小型鱼类宝可梦。但若有船只靠近，便会猛烈攻击，直到将船彻底摧毁。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon hang around coral reefs and provide protection for smaller fish Pokémon. However, if any boats come near their reef, they will violently attack it until there is nothing left.

entry: 它性情温和，喜欢与人相处。即使野生丑丑鱼咬住尾巴也不在意，因为覆满鳞片的身体与再生能力能免去疼痛，也不会留下长久的伤害。
author: sontyp
source: Feral Feebas biting its tail isn't a big concern for this sociable and patient creature, as its scale-covered body and regenerative powers prevent pain and lasting damage.

entry: POKENAME华丽的鳞片让许多高档时装设计师获得灵感。它们独自漂在外海，等头上的嘴吞下经过的鱼宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's luxurious scales have been the inspiration for many high-end fashion designers. They float alone in the open ocean waiting for the mouth on its head to gobble up passing fish Pokémon.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞状外壳。明明没有翅膀，却依然能飞，原理无人明白。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard, scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it since it has no wings.

entry: POKENAME双翼极其锋利，性情又凶暴，常把敌人斩成碎片。它们大多住在洞穴或山中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's extremely sharp wings and viscous temperament leads to its opponent being slashed to pieces. They tend to live in caves or mountains.

entry: POKENAME的躯干始终保持蓝白两色，以便融入云中，翅膀与褶边却可随心变色。它们欢快地在空中竞速，留下宛如奇异彩虹的彩色尾迹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME always keep their torsos blue and white to blend in among the clouds, but change the color of their wings and frills freely. They joyfully race with each other across the sky, creating colored contrails that resemble odd rainbows.

entry: 它用超能力将自己弹射出去，在空中如巨大的手里剑般旋转，甚至能超过超音速战斗机。
author: staghorn
source: It launches itself using its psychic abilities, spinning like a gigantic shuriken as it flies. It can outpace even supersonic fighter jets.

entry: POKENAME虽失去双翼，仍快得目不暇接。再加上惊人跳跃高度，依旧是强悍的空中猎手。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its loss of wings, POKENAME is still blindingly fast. It can jump at incredibly high as well, making it still a formidable aerial predator.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME几乎势不可挡。铁甲般的头颅撞不毁的东西，它便用烈焰吐息熔化，所到之处尽成废墟。
author: spartan_ct
source: An enraged POKENAME is incredibly difficult to stop. What it fails to destroy with its ironclad head, it melts with fiery breath, leaving only ruin in its wake.

entry: POKENAME以难以想象的速度翱翔，只需几分钟就能轻松绕地球一周。能量输出达到极限时，它的推进力可达到平时的四倍。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME soars at unimaginable speeds, easily circling the earth world in minutes. When it maximizes its energy output, its propulsive power quadruples.

entry: 它几乎总待在自己收集的大堆宝石上，常常苦恼着究竟该将它们吃掉，还是留下珍藏。
author: dusknoir64
source: This Pokémon can almost always be found on the vast pile of gems it has collected. It often agonizes over whether to eat them or to keep them.

entry: 平时，POKENAME会用齿轮拧紧体内的发条。进入战斗后，便释放发条中储存的能量，发动威力惊人的攻击。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: When POKENAME is not battling, it uses its gears to wind a spring inside its body. When it enters battle, it uses the energy stored within the spring to attack with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能犁过积雪、沥青与松软地面，再释放大量蒸汽降温。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME plough through snow, asphalt and loose ground with ease. They cool themselves down by releasing lots of steam.

entry: POKENAME在机体内燃烧大量煤炭及其他燃料。它能转动履带，射出炽热的金属板，甚至用锋利的前端劈开厚重的金属墙。
author: chorb33
source: It burns masses of coal and other fuel sources in its hull. POKENAME has the ability to spin its treads, shoot out hot slabs of metal, and even split thick metal walls with its sharp-edged front.

entry: 为驱动火车而制造的人造宝可梦系列中的第三种。它的身体已能将燃料利用效率发挥到极致。
author: gayschlatt
source: The third in a line of man-made Pokémon made for train engines. Its body has managed to maximize fuel efficency.

entry: POKENAME是审判级巨兽，铠甲坚不可破，力量出众。虽冷淡疏离，却很体贴，愿守护信任的对象。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME is a judgement-class beast, with impervious armor and superb power. While cold and aloof, it's very caring and will protect those it trusts.

entry: 最早记录它的，是一本名声不佳的八卦杂志，因此人们一度以为它只是骗局。
author: griddle
source: This Pokémon was originally thought to have been a hoax, having been first documented in an disreputable gossip magazine.

entry: POKENAME是古代自动机械，部件却古怪地十分现代。据说若组成军队，力量甚至足以征服世界。
author: blazerxz
source: An ancient automaton, POKENAME is curiously made with modern mechanical parts. Allegedly, an army of them could be strong enough to conquer the world.

entry: POKENAME极其贪食金属，会疯狂袭击工厂里的机器，大快朵颐。由于成群出现时破坏严重，人们将它视为祸害。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for metal, attacking factory machinery in a feeding frenzy. It is considered a pest because of the damage it causes in large swarms.

entry: POKENAME四处奔走，寻找珍贵的宝石，制成华贵的装饰齿轮。这样做究竟有何用处，至今无人知晓。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME scampers about searching for precious gems that it can make into valuable decorative gears. What purpose this behaviour serves is unknown.

entry: 有些阴谋论者相信，POKENAME是政府秘密计划的产物，专从水下袭击敌舰。
author: chorb33
source: Some conspiracy theorists believe that POKENAME is a secret government project designed to attack enemy ships from below.

entry: 表盘上的时间从不准确。民间传说认为，POKENAME显示的其实是观看者的死期。
author: chorb33
source: The time on its dial never matches the actual time. Folk tales believe that POKENAME actually shows the date of death of the person who sees it.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: chorb33
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: chorb33
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: POKENAME常在大型锻造厂运送炽热金属。它们不怕高温，甚至能踏过熔融材料。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME are often used in large industrial forges to transport hot metal, as they do not mind high heat and can trudge through molten material.

entry: POKENAME吞煤，供给体内熔炉燃烧。极热火焰，则从身体各处开口喷出。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME eats coal to fuel the furnace in its body. It ejects the incredibly hot flames from the combustion process through various openings.

entry: POKENAME不停旋转，再用自身产生的磁力加速，快得迸出火花。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME rotates continuously, using self-generated magnetism to accelerate in such a way that it sparks.

entry: POKENAME能产生庞大能量，也会释放强大磁波，让附近大多数电器停摆。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can generate an incredible amount of energy, but it also emits powerful magnetic waves that disable most electrical devices in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME转动几个头，不断产生能量与热，存进外环，也能从环中释放。
author: chorb33
source: By rotating its heads, POKENAME can constantly generate energy and heat, which it can store in its outer ring. It can also use this to release it.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断转动，各个头也轮流换位。位于最高处的，暂时担任指挥。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's body rotates continuously, causing its individual heads to change position regularly. The one at the top is in temporary command.

entry: 齿轮怪熔化后与臭臭泥融合，因此POKENAME常见于烧毁的工厂。早在基因之楔问世前，就已发现这种融合。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in burnt factories, as the Klinklang melts and fuses with the Muk. This is a fusion that was found even before DNA Splicers.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其危险，会制造幻象分散对方的注意，再从背后突袭。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: Wild POKENAME are highly dangerous because of their ability to create an illusion as a distraction while it strikes from behind.

entry: 它既能操纵幻象，身体又极易变形，只要体量足够，几乎能变成任何想要的模样。但若突然受惊，就会恢复原形。
author: elfail0
source: Its power over illusions and ability to shapeshift its incredibly malleable body means that it can take on nearly any appearance it desires, as long as it has the body mass for it. If it is suddenly surprised, it will revert to its original form.

entry: 遇上捕食者时，POKENAME会制造火焰的幻象，试图将其吓退。它平时很戒备训练家，只有获得它信任的人才知道，它的毛发柔软无比。
author: tmotime
source: Whenever it encounters predators, POKENAME creates illusionary flames in an attempt to scare them away. While it's normally wary of Trainers, those it trusts find its fur to be incredibly soft.

entry: POKENAME的火焰制造热浪蜃景，将敌人困入其中。一旦被幻象捕获，就再也逃不掉。
author: jordanx27
source: Their flames allow POKENAME to ensnare their opponents in a mirage formed by the heat haze. Once trapped by the illusion, there is no escape.

entry: 这种宝可梦常被视为智慧与狡黠的象征。它精通幻术，能让自己看似同时出现在多处，欺骗猎物和捕食者。更可怕的是，它甚至能让森林仿佛永无尽头。
author: elfail0
source: A Pokémon often associated with vast wisdom and cunning. Its mastery over illusions allows it to appear in many places at once, deceiving both prey and those who hunt it. Even more frighteningly, its illusions can make forests appear endless.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，会制造幻象迷惑潜在的敌人，或掩护自己逃走。它体型大、模样讨人喜欢，又不具攻击性，是很受欢迎的幼儿伴侣。
author: elfail0
source: This incredibly shy Pokémon can conjure illusions to mislead potential enemies or cover its escape. Due to its large size, cuddly appearance, and lack of aggression, POKENAME are prized highly as pets for young children.

entry: POKENAME披着暗影，借波导发力，以幻象迷惑敌人，再用钢爪攻击。每次欺骗得逞，力量便更强。
author: sheogorath
source: Cloaked in shadows and powered by aura, POKENAME confounds foes with illusions while striking with steel claws. Its power surges with each deception.

entry: POKENAME用幻术对自己眼中的弱小训练家与宝可梦隐去身形。唯有遇到值得一战的强敌，才会现身挑战。
author: hello_i_exist
source: POKENAME uses its illusions to hide itself from Trainers and Pokémon it considers to be weak. It will only reveal itself to worthy opponents in order to challenge them to a fight.

entry: 为守护巢穴，POKENAME会合力迷惑被视为威胁的对象，随即迅速出击。它的速度与灵活程度无可比拟。
author: dahappycute
source: To protect their lair, POKENAME work together to trick and swiftly attack at those they deem to be a threat. It has speed and agility like no other Pokémon.

entry: 据说六只耳朵能听见方圆一千英里内的任何秘密。POKENAME还能完美扮作任何生物，为自己谋利。
author: milchik
source: Its six ears are said to hear any secret within a thousand miles radius. POKENAME can perfectly impersonate any creature it wants for its own benefit.

entry: POKENAME同时将多个目标困在幻象中，留待日后饥饿，再吸取它们的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME traps multiple victims in illusions at once, storing them for later, when it'll be hungry for their life force.

entry: POKENAME精通战斗与诡计，却往往回避交锋，而是用电气幻象藏起幼崽，保护它们。它们也喜欢制造虚假的雷暴，赶走竞争者与好奇的人。
author: cpnquacken
source: A master of both battle and trickery, POKENAME tend to shy away from combat, instead creating electrical mirages to hide their children from danger. They love to create illusionary thunderstorms to drive away competitors and curious people.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: jokerswild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: jokerswild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: POKENAME穿梭于阴影中，九条缥缈的尾巴如轻烟般闪动。它精于欺瞒，会先以幻象迷惑对手，再用迅疾的火焰攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME weaves through the shadows, its nine ethereal tails flickering like wisps of smoke. A master of deception, it creates illusions that confuse foes, striking with swift, fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: elfail0
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: elfail0
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: POKENAME是诡计的顶尖大师，以勺子传导幻术魔法，制造逼真的蜃景。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is the ultimate master of trickery. It channels its illusory magic through its spoons, enabling it to conjure realistic mirages.

entry: POKENAME很不受人喜爱，便用黏性缎带捉住人类，想强迫对方爱上自己。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is a very unloved Pokémon. Due to this, it uses its sticky ribbons to catch humans in an effort to force them to love it.

entry: POKENAME能将训练家给予的欢乐与关爱放大，化作魔力。彼此的羁绊越深，POKENAME就越强大。
author: mileysakiko
source: POKENAME have been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into magical power. The greater the bond they share, the stronger POKENAME will become.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: 这是为收集妖精属性能量而设计的POKENAME原型。可惜“月之驱动”装置有缺陷，最终被废弃。
author: t.i.a.
source: A prototype of POKENAME that was designed to collect Fairy-type energy. However, the Moon Drive was faulty, so it was scrapped.

entry: POKENAME闪电形的触角噼啪作响，滑翔时迸出无害的电火花。它喜欢钻进电子设备，凭着讨人喜欢的天性惹出些欢快的小乱子，逗得人们展露笑颜。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's bolt-shaped feelers crackle with playful electric energy, sparking harmlessly as it glides around. It enjoys sneaking into electronics, using its charm to cause cheerful and playful chaos. It enjoys bringing smiles to faces.

entry: POKENAME是最优雅的宝可梦之一，会以缎带迅速击打目标。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is known as one of the most elegant Pokémon out there. It rapidly strikes targets with its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME常与同类聚集，用小丝带轻敲液态的身体，交流感情、加深情谊。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME will often gather with others of its kind to communicate and bond. They do this by tapping their small ribbons against their liquid bodies.

entry: POKENAME的细胞质发育得更加结实，终于可以亲热地拥抱训练家，而不至于把自己的身体弄散。
author: jackjirachi
source: With its cytoplasm becoming more developed and sturdy, POKENAME are able to hug their Trainers affectionately without their bodies breaking apart.

entry: 它以和平守卫之名为人所知，散发使人平静的气息。可领地受威胁时，也会凶猛抵抗。
author: lyman
source: It is known to be a guardian of peace, sending out a tranquilizing aura. It is known to aggressively defend its territory if threatened.

entry: POKENAME热心又有活力，所到之处都充满欢笑。公司常请它来鼓舞员工的士气。
author: teatedtiten
source: Being warm-hearted and energetic, POKENAME brings a sense of joyfulness to wherever it goes. Companies frequently use this Pokémon to raise the morale of their employees.

entry: POKENAME无法用回声定位，只能靠翼状的大耳倾听风声，辨别前进方向。这虽很管用，却也让它对其他声音过度敏感。
author: patch
source: POKENAME lacks the ability to use echolocation, so it uses its wing-like ears to listen to the wind in order to get around. While helpful, this makes it hyper-sensitive to other sounds.

entry: POKENAME能从全身每个孔洞射出毒镖。激动时射得飞快，肉眼根本看不清。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME can fire poison-tipped darts from every hole in its body. When agitated, it fires these darts faster than the naked eye can comprehend.

entry: 背后的尾巴增强了旋转时的破坏力。只要不断旋转，甚至能将整条街道摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: The tail on its back adds to the destructive force of its spin. As long as it's spinning, it can even destroy entire streets.

entry: POKENAME的骨骼由极耐用的金属构成。它们常召集弱小宝可梦，命其突袭城镇，抢夺食物。
author: vaporvenator
source: The skeleton of POKENAME is composed of a highly durable metal. They often rally up lesser Pokémon and command them to raid towns for food.

entry: 岩石般的厚皮保护着它，让它能抵御威胁、守住地洞。对训练家，则像待自己的孩子一样。
author: melodydelune
source: Its rock-hard hide helps protect it as it defends its burrows from threats. It is known to treat its Trainers as if they were its children.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，是威力惊人的穿刺钻。据说，头上与背上的尖刺之所以如此坚韧，全凭它纯粹的斗志与骄傲。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME uses its tail as an immensely powerful piercing drill. It's said that the intense durability of the spikes on its head and its back is due to POKENAME's sheer battle spirit and pride.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却极其危险。为保护训练家，它会彻底陷入狂怒，不断破坏周围的地形，直到消灭所有威胁。
author: celio_0230
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is incredibly dangerous. It will go into a blind rage to protect its Trainer, destroying the surrounding terrain until every threat is defeated.

entry: POKENAME的爪力足以推倒输电铁塔。它会将鬃毛上的毒涂在爪上，使猎物麻痹。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to topple a transmission tower. The poison it applies to its claws from its mane paralyzes its prey.

entry: POKENAME的毒素全都集中在尾巴里。战斗时，它会用尾巴作钝器，接连猛击敌人，不断削弱对方的体力。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME's poison is concentrated entirely in its tail. In a fight, it will use the tail as a bludgeoning tool, sapping their foe's strength as it pummels them relentlessly.

entry: 它打盹之处，细雨永不停歇。POKENAME若被激怒，便会骤变成毁灭性的风暴。
author: vaporvenator
source: An everlasting drizzle of rain occurs where it dozes off. This light shower escalates into a devastating storm when POKENAME is provoked.

entry: 将盖欧卡的基因注入盖诺赛克特后，就会产生POKENAME。它是终极猎手，凭借强大的力量统御天空、陆地与海洋。
author: spookyscaryoverlord
source: When Genesect are infused with the DNA of Kyogre, a POKENAME is made. It is the ultimate hunter and dominates air, land, and sea with immense power.

entry: POKENAME软乎乎的，看起来毫不吓人。可一旦被激怒，就能从体内喷出数千加仑的水。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME is very squishy and not at all intimidating, but if provoked, it can expel thousands of gallons of water from its body.

entry: 它们在海沟中游荡，寻找矿石充饥。身体各处孔洞喷出的气泡劲力惊人，甚至能贯穿钢铁。
author: schwaus
source: They wander in trenches looking for ore to eat. The bubbles that blow from the holes around its body come out with enough force to pierce through steel.

entry: POKENAME轻哼的曲调响彻海洋。它想让世界沉入大海，好让所有人都听见自己的声音。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: The gentle tune POKENAME hums resonates throughout the ocean. It wishes for everyone to hear its voice by drowning the world in the sea.

entry: POKENAME时而睡在水里，时而睡在冰上。无论身在何处，红色纹路都清晰地发着光。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME alternates between sleeping in water and on ice. No matter where it goes, its red markings still glow clearly.

entry: POKENAME受怒火驱使，遇到危险时，背上的小火山便会喷发。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is driven by its rage. The small volcano on its back erupts when it is confronted with danger.

entry: 在融合成POKENAME之前，它还得散发难闻的气味来吓退鸟宝可梦。如今凭着威武的外表，POKENAME已受到森林中所有宝可梦的敬重。
author: over9001
source: Before being fused into POKENAME, this Pokémon had to release an uncomfortable odor to scare away bird Pokémon. Now, POKENAME is respected by every Pokémon in the forest due to its mighty appearance.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋入沙中，让柔软的内部组织为进化做好准备。固拉多的鳞片使它的外壳坚固无比，无法破开。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand in order to prepare its soft innards for evolution. Its shell is incredibly robust and impossible to break open due to Groudon's scales.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀承重力惊人，还能收拢起来，让它从空中飞行迅速切换为掘地穿行。因此无论地下还是地上，POKENAME都是危险的猎手。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can carry an incredible amount of weight and are capable of contracting themselves in order to freely switch from flying into quickly tunneling through the earth. This makes POKENAME a dangerous predator beneath and above ground.

entry: 它在进化前始终保持着温暖，也受到外壳的保护。外壳的温度最高可达华氏3,000度。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon keeps itself warm and protected until it is able to evolve. Its outer shell reaches up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME在地下筑巢。若有敌人靠近，POKENAME便会升空蓄势，再用锥形的双手刺击对方，守护巢穴。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME builds their nest underground. If someone were to approach it, POKENAME would defend it by stinging or piercing the enemy with its cone-shaped hands after building up momentum in the sky.

entry: POKENAME会振翅向其他鸟宝可梦展示威势。羽毛上的鳞片让它即使身处猛烈的沙暴，也能以惊人的速度飞行。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME flaps its wings in order to show its dominance over other bird Pokémon. It can fly at incredible speeds through rough sandstorms due to the scales on its feathers.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎。由于外貌酷似固拉多，它担心其他小拉达会一拥而上，抢走自己的食物。它打起架来凶猛无比，决不让这种事发生。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.

entry: 所有小拉达都惧怕POKENAME，认为它十分凶暴。锋利如刀的獠牙不断生长，连坚硬的地面都能咬穿。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is feared by all Rattata and is seen as a violent Pokémon. It has razor-sharp fangs that grow at a steady rate. It can even chew through solid ground.

entry: POKENAME的喙坚硬锋利，能刺穿猎物。它常在火山生态区附近休息。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is known for its sharp and sturdy beak that it uses to impale its prey. It can be found resting near volcanic ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME腹部的纹路灼热无比，在黑暗中也十分醒目。它在地下蜿蜒穿行，再突然破土而出，将对手紧紧缠住。
author: over9001
source: The pattern on POKENAME's belly is scorching hot and can be easiliy spotted in the dark. It slithers through the ground and lunges out of it to wrap around an opponent.

entry: POKENAME会将尾巴插入地下，向地面释放电流，让来袭的敌人动弹不得。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME immobilizes incoming threats by plugging its tail into the ground, charging the ground with electricity.

entry: POKENAME的血管内能承受300万伏的电压，是雷丘身体所能释放的30倍。科学家认为，这源于固拉多维持庞大能量的能力。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through it's veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: 它举止十分文雅。附近若有两只穿山鼠打架，它就会站到双方中间，让它们望着自己令人不安的双眼，就此停手。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon is very well mannered. When two Sandshrew are fighting nearby, it will step between them and make them stop by making them look into its unsettling eyes.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺锋利如针。它会蜷成刺球滚向敌人，用尖刺将对方贯穿。
author: over9001
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back are as sharp as needles. When it curls up into a spiky ball, it rolls at its enemies, piercing into them as a result.

entry: POKENAME在活火山口安家。它们的双镰由熔融的岩土形成，温度高得足以轻易切开铅块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their homes in active volcanic craters. Their scythes are made of molten earth and are hot enough to easily cleave through lead.

entry: POKENAME背上有一套火山生态系统。科学家发现，流经它体内的熔岩是灯火山岩石与岩浆混合而成的。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME has a volcanic ecosystem on its back. Scientists found out that the lava flowing through its body is a mixture of rocks from Mt. Ember and magma.

entry: POKENAME极其危险，会潜行于地下，只露出白色的角。接近敌人后便破土跃起，张开大口，用强劲的颚咬住对方并注入毒液。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon. It dives through the ground with only its white horn sticking out. Once it reaches its foe, it jumps at them with its mouth wide open to bite them with its strong jaw, injecting them with poison.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾将大地劈成大陆与岛屿。岁月流转，它还会再做一次。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to legend, POKENAME is said to have cleaved the land into continents and islands, and will again as the ages pass.

entry: POKENAME让许多登山者闻风丧胆，会用尾巴将巨石抛过山谷。它的颚力极强，能咬穿坚硬的山岩，开辟自己的隧道网。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon feared by many mountain climbers. It uses its tail to chuck huge boulders across the valley. Its jaw is so powerful that it is capable of biting through sturdy mountain rocks, creating its own tunnel systems.

entry: POKENAME一拳便能激起绕行全球的地震波。暴怒时射出的雷电，甚至足以在地上劈出巨大的裂缝。
author: mistymagius
source: A single punch from POKENAME can send seismic shockwaves circling the globe. When enraged, it fires out thunderbolts powerful enough to create large fissures in the ground.

entry: POKENAME行动十分敏捷，全身和每条尾巴都覆着保护性的鳞片。它留下的脚印常见于火山地区。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a very agile Pokémon that wears protective scales on each of its tails and its body. It leaves footprints in the ground that can be commonly found around volcanic regions.

entry: 它用低沉的嗓音唱出神秘而舒缓的旋律，同时震动地面，为歌声打出节拍。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon sings a mysterious soothing melody with its deep voice. It generates a beat by making the ground vibrate.

entry: POKENAME借着沉重的体重与带沟槽的身体沉入沙丘底部，大口吞食沙下的矿藏。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME uses its heavy weight and grooved body to sink to the bottom of dunes. They feast on ore deposits found beneath the sands.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: POKENAME歌声低沉，每段旋律都塑造大地，回荡的曲调甚至能形成绵延山脉。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME sings with a deep voice, shaping the land with each spoken melody. It forms mountain ranges through its reverberate song.

entry: 它在火山洞穴中爬行，用爪挖出隧道，寻找小虫充饥。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon can be found crawling inside volcanic caves. Its claws allow it to excavate tunnels in order to find small bugs to feed on.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: POKENAME每走一步都带起轻微的震动，却常常一脸困惑，甚至反被吓到。持续的头痛偶尔还会意外引发小型地震，连它自己都吃惊不已。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's steps leave tiny tremors in its wake, though it often looks confused and even is spooked by the shaking. Its constant headaches sometimes lead to accidental mini earthquakes, much to its own surprise.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: POKENAME的外壳坚韧耐热，让它能在熔岩中高速游动。感到受威胁时，会喷出灼热的蒸汽。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's shell is very resilient and heatproof, which makes it able to swim through lava at high speeds. It emits hot steam when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由一种独特的火焰构成。虽然不是火属性宝可梦，POKENAME仍能维持尾焰不灭。研究者认为，体内的沸水让它保持活力与健康。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is made out of a fairly distinct flame. Even though POKENAME is not a Fire-type Pokémon, it is still capable of maintaining the flame on its tail. Researchers believe the boiling water inside its body is keeping it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME体内盛满沸水。一旦被激怒，就会朝对手喷射滚烫的液体。皮肤的颜色可能与体内储存的蒸汽有关。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's body is filled with boiling water. Once it is aggravated, it will spray its opponent with scorching hot liquid. The pigmented color of its skin is likely due to the steam stored in its body.

entry: POKENAME是远古遗物。据说，只要集齐七颗特殊的石头，POKENAME就会复苏，最多实现三个愿望。
author: ethewriter
source: POKENAME is an artifact from ancient times. It's said if you collect seven special stones, POKENAME will come back to life and grant up to three wishes.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在看顾两个不省心的孩子。稍不留神，它们就会打起来。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME spends most of its time watching over its rather troublesome children. The two often fight one another if left unmonitored.

entry: POKENAME待在臭氧层上方，极少被目击。位于大气之上，也让冰之能力大幅增强。
author: unknown
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it stays above the ozone layer. By staying above the atmosphere, its abilities of ice have powered up immensely.

entry: POKENAME憎恶龙宝可梦。通过与敌人交战，它将龙属性及招式化为己用，以增加战胜宿敌的机会。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME despises dragon Pokémon. It has adapted the Dragon typing and moves from its foes' battles into itself to improve its chances against its sworn enemy.

entry: POKENAME是最聪明、最令人生畏的宝可梦之一。它永不停飞，一发现猎物，就全速撞上。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are known as one of the smartest and most intimidating Pokémon. It flies endlessly, and when it finds prey, smashes into them at full speed.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的战士，力量惊人，斗志不竭。每一记重击都能压制全场，让对手胆寒。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a formidable fighter, known for its incredible strength and relentless spirit. With each powerful strike, it dominates the battlefield, leaving opponents trembling in its wake.

entry: 饥饿时，POKENAME会激发潜藏的能量，将自己推进到山巅。它最爱吃那里的矿石。
author: schwaus
source: When POKENAME is hungry, it uses latent energy to propel itself to mountaintops. It loves to eat ore found at the peak of these mountains.

entry: POKENAME振翅便能掀起猛烈的沙暴，也能在转瞬间将其平息。
author: busilisk
source: The beating of POKENAME's wings is strong enough to induce violent sandstorms. However, it can also quell them at a moment's notice.

entry: 靠近POKENAME时，会先听见咕咕钟响，随后它便消失。有人相信，它穿越时间逃走了。
author: chorb33
source: When you approach POKENAME, you hear the sound of a cuckoo clock before it disappears. Some believe that it travels through time to escape.

entry: POKENAME随意改变表盘时间，就能穿梭时空。也有人猜测，它不会死亡。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can change the time on the dial of its watch at will, allowing it to travel through time. There are speculations that it is immortal.

entry: 见过POKENAME的人，总说它演奏着同一首歌。曲调听来熟悉，又令人怀念。
author: jokerswild
source: Those who have reported seeing POKENAME always describe it playing the same song. They also claim the song sounds nostalgically familiar.

entry: POKENAME是穿越时间寻找强敌的战士。可至今，也没找到足够强的对手。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is a warrior that uses its time travelling abilities to search for a worthy opponent. It has yet to find a strong enough opponent.

entry: POKENAME能操纵全部时空。有人相信它才是真正的创世宝可梦，也有人称它为存在本身的扭曲。
author: scigaming
source: POKENAME can control the entirety of space-time. Some believe it to be the true Creator Pokémon, whilst others call it a corruption of existence.

entry: 许多人视它为掌控一切时空的神奥大尊。力量之强，唯有阿尔宙斯本尊能比拟。
author: toxicrown
source: It's believed by many to be the Almighty Sinnoh and controller of all spacetime. Its power is rivalled only by Arceus itself.

entry: POKENAME的爪子能撕开时间，制造通往过去或未来的虫洞。有时，它还会与时拉比玩一场跨越时空的追逐游戏。
author: teatedtiten
source: Using its claws, POKENAME can rip through the fabric of time to create wormholes to the past and future. Occasionally, POKENAME partake in an interdimensional game of Tag with Celebi.

entry: POKENAME喜爱寒冷，能活数千年。环境若过热，就将自身冻结在时间中，重新现身过去。
author: 7magic7mike7
source: POKENAME loves the cold and can live for thousands of years. If its environment gets too hot, it freezes itself in time to reappear in the past.

entry: POKENAME奔跑得很快时，有时会凭空消失，过一会儿才重新出现。其实，那是它跃进了未来的时间。
author: ayutac
source: When POKENAME runs quickly, it sometimes vanishes into thin air, only to reappear later. This is because it actually jumps forward in time.

entry: POKENAME转动身体，制造重力裂隙。据说中央宝石，是望向整个宇宙的窗口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can spin its body to create gravitational rifts. It is said that the gem at its center is a window to the entire cosmos.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它十分贪玩，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A playful Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: POKENAME腹中有一个完整宇宙。许多人相信，我们的宇宙或许也在同样的巨兽体内。
author: jokerswild
source: A whole universe exists inside POKENAME's belly. Many believe that our universe could be inside a beast just like it.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又擅长操纵别人，梦想统治世界。POKENAME还对胖丁怀着莫名怨恨。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is described as cunning and manipulative. It dreams about taking over the world. POKENAME has an unexplainable grudge against Jigglypuff.

entry: POKENAME有“恶魔蛇”的绰号。只要落入它的视线，就没有生还的可能。
author: mistymagius
source: Known by the nickname of "Demon Serpent": If you are in POKENAME's line of sight, your chances of survival are zero.

entry: 据说POKENAME与毁坏的世界建立精神联系，能在残酷战斗中，运用那个次元的扭曲阴影。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is said to have forged a psychic link with the Distortion World, enabling it to use the dimension's twisted shadows in gruesome combat.

entry: 传说POKENAME潜伏海底最深、最黑的洞穴，耐心等待猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legend says that within the deepest and darkest caves in the ocean, POKENAME lurks, waiting patiently for its prey.

entry: POKENAME守着生者世界与虚空的边界。嚎声回荡，带着令人不安的悲伤。
author: xoriey
source: POKENAME guards the border between the living world and the void. Its howls echo with an unsettling sadness.

entry: POKENAME诞生于一款受诅咒的游戏，如今游荡在我们的世界。它飞驰于高草丛中，追猎狐狸宝可梦及其训练家。
author: ethewriter
source: Born from a cursed game, POKENAME now haunts our world. It speeds around tall grass, hunting down fox Pokémon and their Trainers.

entry: 它既顽皮优雅，又恶毒残暴。目击者说，POKENAME的战斗方式违背物理常理，虚幻得令人着迷。
author: frink202
source: It is playful, graceful, spiteful, and brutal in equal measure. Witnesses have described POKENAME's fighting style as both unreal and captivating in its physical impossibility.

entry: 它是来自异次元的凶残猎手，扭曲现实本身的构造，制造难辨的幻象。
author: nellnast42
source: A savage hunter hailing from a different dimension. It creates tricky illusions by distorting the very fabric of this reality.

entry: 它可怕得很，拥有深不可测的力量。一旦发怒，顷刻便可能毁灭整片大陆。
author: pepperthepirate
source: A terror blessed with unfathomable power. Were it to lose its temper, it could annihilate an entire continent in moments.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: 泥偶巨人破损的甲壳，如今成了骑拉帝纳灵魂的容器。它会先用尖锐的触须刺入猎物，再将其杀死。
author: sand_coffin
source: What was once the broken armor of a Golurk now houses the soul of Giratina. It uses its sharp tendrils to stab into prey before finishing them off.

entry: 它只是毁坏的世界的拙劣仿品。夜里靠近游荡的人会消失，再不见踪影……
author: rkmaster25367
source: A pale imitation of the Distortion Realm. Those who wander near at night will disappear, never to be seen again...

entry: POKENAME是来自毁坏的世界的巨兽。异次元的土地碎块嵌在体内，对我们的现实构成威胁。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is a beast hailing from the Distortion World. Chunks of that dimension's earth are embedded into its body, and pose a threat to our reality.

entry: POKENAME小巧却强大，能从现实的褶隙中创造想要的一切。可造完之后，往往就丢着不管。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a small but powerful Pokémon, creating anything it pleases from folds of reality. It tends to abandon its own creations.

entry: POKENAME外壳是金属，身体则有磁性。体型庞大又带磁，让它常吸附在大型金属物上。
author: sand_coffin
source: Its outer shell is metallic, while its body is magnetic. Due to its enormous size and magnetic body, POKENAME often clings to large metal objects.

entry: 传说古时，它保护世界免遭海啸与飓风。后来试图拦住巨大小行星，却因此丧命。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that this Pokémon protected the world against tsunamis and hurricanes during ancient times. It died while trying to stop a giant asteroid.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的丝网将群岛维系在一起。它富有创造力，会用蛛丝编织灵活多变的构造。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME's webs hold island groups together. It is a creative Pokémon, making dynamic structures out of their webbing.

entry: 它用山洪与滔天海啸的噩梦，折磨污染水域的人。受害者醒来时，往往已严重脱水。
author: vaporvenator
source: It torments those that pollute its waters with nightmares of flash floods and towering tsunamis. Victims often wake up critically dehydrated.

entry: 无月的夜晚，POKENAME会潜伏在村庄附近，让人做出被烈焰吞没的噩梦。
author: over9001
source: On a moonless night, POKENAME can be found lurking near villages. It is known for making people experience nightmares in which they are engulfed in flames.

entry: POKENAME锐利的目光，能令人与宝可梦立刻沉睡。随后，便拨弄那些中招者的梦。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME's piercing gaze can instantly put any human or Pokémon into a deep sleep. It plucks at the dreams of those who fell victim to its gaze.

entry: POKENAME在林中蹿行，守护领地免遭入侵。若被发现，就让对方短暂睡去，自己趁机逃走。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME scurries around forests, guarding its territory from intruders. If found, it can put others to sleep for a short time as it runs away.

entry: POKENAME融入幽暗森林，隐去身影。猎物在林中迷路时，便会被它催入深睡。
author: thepandasharky
source: It hides in dark forests, blending into the surroundings. POKENAME hunts by putting others into a deep sleep as they get lost in the forest.

entry: 它能哄人和宝可梦入睡。趁对方做梦，便用藤蔓缠紧，抽取能量。
author: thepandasharky
source: It can lull people and other Pokémon to sleep. As they dream, it wraps vines around the sleeping target, draining them of their energy.

entry: 超能力增强了它制造噩梦的本领。即使相隔遥远，也能在梦魇中护住训练家的性命。
author: thunderjimmy
source: This Pokémon's ability to induce nightmares has been amplified by its psychic power. It can safeguard its Trainer's life in nightmares from afar.

entry: POKENAME多在夜里现身于心术不正的人面前，用天真的外表使其放下戒心，再施以可怕的噩梦。它以恐惧与苦痛为食，直到黎明才消失，下个新月之夜再度出现。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: POKENAME primarily shows itself at night to those with impure hearts, lulling them in with its innocent appearance before inflicting awful nightmares on them. It feeds off of their fear and anguish until dawn, then disappears until the next new moon.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: POKENAME深夜捕猎，专盯野外疲倦的人。即使以为甩掉它，也仍不安全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunt in the dead of night and will target tired people out in the wild. Even if you think you have lost it, you are not safe.

entry: 据说它来自太空，潜伏在人的梦里。一旦被发现，便以异世界的噩梦折磨梦中人。
author: alexanderenjoyer1
source: This Pokémon, said to originate from space, lurks in people's dreams. If found, it torments them with nightmares of other worlds.

entry: POKENAME很久以前便被封入永眠。古籍告诫绝不可唤醒，否则将带来无穷噩梦。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME was locked away in an eternal slumber long ago. Ancient texts say never to wake it and warn of the endless nightmares it would inflict.

entry: POKENAME的花粉能催人入睡、引起噩梦，因此常被用于梦境研究。
author: kiva
source: POKENAME is known for its soporific pollen that causes nightmares. Because of this, it is often used in oneirological studies.

entry: 它背上的大炮会直接抽取种子中的能量。种子又被金属完全包住，导致POKENAME发育不良。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back extracts energy directly from its bulb, which is entirely encased in metal. This causes growth deficiency for POKENAME.

entry: 它由等离子队创造，是盖诺赛克特的原型机之一，尚缺最终设计中后来加上的强化。
author: jackjirachi
source: Created by Team Plasma, it was one of the prototypes of Genesect. It lacked the enhancements that were later incorporated into the final design.

entry: 珍爱的人遭遇危险时，POKENAME会不惜一切挺身守护，即使为此付出生命。
author: inksans201x
source: When those it loves are in danger, POKENAME will stop at nothing to defend them, even if it costs them their life.

entry: 有人声称，POKENAME背上的炮只需一发就能创造完整的星系。战斗时，还能切换为元素武器使用。
author: patch
source: Some claim the cannon attached to POKENAME's back can create entire galaxies with a single shot. In battle, it can be switched in order to function as an elemental weapon.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: POKENAME背炮发射高压水流。与POKENAME发生冲突的船只，往往会被发现船身已遭击穿。
author: blazerxz
source: The cannon on POKENAME's back fires highly pressurized water. Ships that run afoul of POKENAME are often found with holes punched through their hull.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温泉，能用尾巴加热周围的水。尾巴也能在水下喷射推进，帮助游泳。
author: final_courtesy
source: POKENAME can warm surrounding water with its tail and favors hot springs. Its tail can also assist it while swimming via underwater propulsion.

entry: 骗子与阴谋家永远无法和它交朋友。最好远远避开，免遭烈火惩罚。
author: final_courtesy
source: Liars and schemers will never befriend this Pokémon. In fact, they should avoid it at all costs, lest they suffer the fiery consequences.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃燃着太阳般的高热，还会影响天气。它倾向选择更明辨真理的持有者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade burns with the heat of the sun and affects the weather. It gravitates towards wielders with a superior sense of truth.

entry: 渡海求索真理的人，或许能瞥见这只传说宝可梦。鳍上的火欧泊，能改变全球天气。
author: .realthree
source: Those who cross the seas seeking truth may catch a glimpse of this legendary Pokémon. The fiery opals on its fins can alter the world's weather.

entry: 它是真实与理想之龙，因训练家心中的力量而合一，应着铃声被唤来。
author: caffinateddragon
source: The Dragon of Truth and Ideals, merged by the strength of its Trainer's heart. It was called forth by the sound of a bell.

entry: 人们让莱希拉姆与捷克罗姆融合，试图复原最初之龙。可没有酋雷姆，这种融合极不稳定。
author: faelocke
source: Reshiram and Zekrom were fused in an attempt to revive the original dragon. But without Kyurem, this fusion is highly unstable.

entry: 相传POKENAME的火焰无法熄灭，已经燃烧了超过10,000年。它只会现身于探寻生命意义、追求真理的人面前。
author: mistymagius
source: Fables say POKENAME's flame is impossible to extinguish and to have stayed burning for over 10,000 years. It is said to only appear in front of people who seek the truth in the meaning of life.

entry: POKENAME拍动双翼，控制喷出的火焰，再借毛发引导，将火集中到尾巴。
author: vicho9761
source: POKENAME can control the fire that it expels by flapping its wings. It manipulates the flames with their fur to concentrate it on their tails.

entry: POKENAME排出的毒烟不断刺激自己，令它陷入狂暴。它以猛焰裹身，撞向所有挡路之物。
author: mistymagius
source: The toxic fumes POKENAME's body emits constantly agitate it into a rampage. It coats its body in harsh flames and rams into anything in its way.

entry: 它同时处于冻结与燃烧的矛盾状态，对说谎者和江湖骗子深为不齿。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon exists in a paradoxical state of freezing and burning. It holds a fierce contempt for liars and charlatans.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方喷射炽热的等离子体，将沿途一切烧尽。有人推测，它是外星文明制造的超级兵器，用于灭绝整个星球上的生命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires hot plasma in all directions, incinerating anything its path. It is theorized that POKENAME is an alien-built superweapon made to sterilize entire planets.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动时，尾部会腾起烈焰，将原地烧出一片焦痕。它时常瞬移，连睡觉时也不例外，察觉危险逼近时尤其如此。
author: goldegummybear
source: When POKENAME teleports, its tail flares and leaves a scorched patch of ground where it once was. It teleports often, even while asleep, especially if it senses danger approaching.

entry: POKENAME驰骋世界追寻真理。据说会向那些探索自身真实的人现身。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME gallops across the world in pursuit of truth. It is said that it tends to appear before those who search for their own truth.

entry: POKENAME颈间的项链似乎由月之石组成。它用幻术，对人施些孩子气的恶作剧。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The necklace around POKENAME's neck seems to be made of Moon Stones. It uses its illusory powers to play childish pranks on people.

entry: 它在满月之夜，用天线吸收月之能量，驱动飞碟。天线也能释放磁波。
author: chorb33
source: It powers its flying disc with lunar energy, which it absorbs via its antenna on full-moon nights. It also uses the antenna to emit magnetic waves.

entry: 野外只在满月时能见到POKENAME。它凝望月亮，挥动缎带，跳着孤独的舞。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Spotted in the wild only during a full moon, POKENAME stares at the moon and swings its ribbon in a lonely dance.

entry: 可爱的模样与爱玩的性情，让这只宝可梦拥趸无数。它是出色的宠物，可惜实在罕见。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon has an immense amount of admirers due to its cute looks and playful spirit. It makes an excellent pet, though it is extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沐浴月光，也喜欢用尾巴在地面塑出新月形的痕迹。科学家认为，这纯粹是它开心时的举动。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME likes to bask in the moonlight and create crescent moons in the ground by shaping them with its tail. Scientists believe it does this out of pure joy.

entry: POKENAME爱与其他发光宝可梦相伴。有人见过它们成群在黑暗中起舞。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME enjoys the company of other glowing Pokémon. Groups of them have been seen dancing in the dark.

entry: POKENAME脱落的星尘，一碰到活物似乎就会消失。好在并无害处。
author: ohok3441
source: The stardust that flakes off of POKENAME seems to disappear when touching living material. Luckily, it's harmless.

entry: POKENAME火焰里的星星缓慢旋转。兴奋或战斗时，转速便会加快。
author: ohok3441
source: The stars within POKENAME's fires spin slowly. When excited or in battle, their speed increases.

entry: POKENAME吐出的火焰闪烁不定，光谱特征竟与星光相同。
author: robosoup
source: The flames breathed out by POKENAME have a twinkling quality to them. These have the same spectrographic signature as starlight.

entry: POKENAME吐出的泡泡含有独特的治愈因子，能让人恢复精神。但若使用过量，就可能产生依赖。
author: mistymagius
source: The bubbles that POKENAME produces have a unique healing factor that makes people feel rejuvenated.  However, the substance can be addictive if too much is applied.

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: 据说火山喷发遇上风暴，便诞生了它。掌控烈焰与雷电的本领，无可比拟。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is believed to have been birthed when a volcano erupted into a storm. It's control over fire and lightning is unrivalled.

entry: 蓄力时，背上亮起蓝光，传出独特嗡鸣。蓄满后，一击便能轰毁整座城市。
author: dragonzzilla
source: As it gathers energy to attack, its back glows blue and a distinct thrum can be heard. At full charge, it can destroy a whole city in a single blast.

entry: POKENAME从深处现身，迎战破坏自然平衡的宝可梦。背上噼啪迸发着惊人能量。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃迸出雷霆般的电光，引来雷暴。它偏爱信念格外坚定的持有者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade sparks with the intensity of lighting and and brings about thunderstorms. It gravitates towards wielders with superior conviction.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会在颈间聚起闪电，吸引伴侣，也威吓情敌。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. It gathers lightning around its neck to both attract potential mates and intimidate rivals.

entry: 它是活体发电机，能凭空产生能量。已知存世不到20只，因此备受追寻。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is a living generator, able to make energy from nothing. It is highly sought after, as less than 20 are known to exist.

entry: POKENAME体型虽小，却十分凶悍。它将体内储存的大量能量化作电力与惊人的速度，战斗时迅如闪电，令对手遭受电击，来不及反应。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is small yet fierce. It stores a lot of energy within itself, releasing it in the form of electricity and blinding speed. When in battle, it unleashes lightning-fast attacks that leave its opponents shocked and unable to react.

entry: POKENAME奔过大地时，会留下转瞬即逝的冰冷光带，宛如极光。据说，它能折射光线，让身体变成任何颜色。
author: frokachu
source: When POKENAME run across the land, they leave behind a chilling, temporary stream of light that looks like an aurora. It is said its body can change to any color by refracting light.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自宇宙最寒冷的深处，会寻找强敌，汲取对方的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon is said to come from the coldest depths of space. POKENAME seek powerful opponents to leech off their strength.

entry: POKENAME的根与花瓣都有致幻作用，能扰乱对手。花瓣经过蒸馏后，却能制成药物或令人放松的茶饮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roots and petals have psychedelic properties that it uses to disorient its opponents. However, the petals can be distilled to create medicine or a relaxing tea.

entry: POKENAME的花在水中也会散发怡人香气。其他宝可梦游近探看时，它便甩出尾中藏着的长鞭袭击。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's flowers emit a pleasing scent underwater. When other Pokémon swim over to check them, it lashes out with the hidden whips in its tail.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME用尾上花朵结出的果实调制颜料，既能作画，也用来标记领地。
author: melodydelune
source: Using the fruit produced by the flower on its tail, POKENAME will produce the ink it uses to paint. It marks its territory with this paint.

entry: 有的POKENAME尾花是蓝色，有的是红色。花色相同的个体，往往更能相处融洽。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some POKENAME have blue flowers on their tail, while others have red. Individuals with the same color flowers are more likely to get along.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的光合作用极强，甚至能借太阳之力释放火焰。此时，它还会散发出异常浓烈的气味。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can photosynthesize through its tail to such an extent that it can harness the power of the sun and unleash fire. In doing so, it emits an unusually intense scent.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，低飞掠过海洋，从不沾水。虽然已无法游泳，却始终依恋水边。
author: sand_coffin
source: Small groups of POKENAME fly low over the ocean, never touching the water. Though it can no longer swim, it always stays near water.

entry: POKENAME常在夜海、尤其离岸流中出现。它随流漂荡，将困在其中的孩子带向外海。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is often seen at night in the ocean, usually during riptides. It floats within the currents and takes children caught within them out to sea.

entry: 电力不足时，POKENAME会将自己鼓成气球，吸引雷暴中的闪电。充满电后便直落地面，用四爪安稳着陆。
author: teatedtiten
source: When low on electricity, POKENAME will blow themselves up like balloons to attract lightning strikes from thunderstorms. When they are fully charged, they will plummet to the ground and safely land on their paws.

entry: 夜里风太强，POKENAME就常不小心飘入月色深处。它几乎控制不了自己的身体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often accidently drifts off into the moonlight if the winds are too strong during the night. It barely has control of its body.

entry: POKENAME的头富有弹性，能把对手弹出数公里，也能变硬，造成巨大破坏。
author: chorb33
source: With its flexible head, POKENAME can bounce opponents back several kilometers, but it can also harden its head to cause enormous destruction.

entry: POKENAME的叫声令人萎靡不振，听者常会不寒而栗。POKENAME还能吸气鼓起身体，最多膨胀到原来的五倍，威吓他人。
author: faeflame
source: The cry of the POKENAME has a withering effect on its opponents, often causing chills in those who hear it. POKENAME can also puff air into their bodies, appearing up to five times their size to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体与孢子带毒，会使人暂时麻痹。它其实很喜欢交际，便模仿花朵，让自己显得亲切，却仍背负着并不公允的邪恶名声。
author: sontyp
source: The gases and spores POKENAME's body produces are toxic and cause temporary paralysis. Because this Pokémon is very social, it mimics the appearance of a flower to seem more approachable, but its undeservedly sinister reputation still stands.

entry: 这种身体僵硬的融合体喜欢雪天和庆典。不知为何，每到晚餐时间，它就会觉得不舒服。
author: houndrys.
source: This rigid fusion loves snowy days and celebrations. For some reason, it feels uncomfortable when it is time to eat in the evening.

entry: POKENAME厚实的毛发能留住体内产生的热量，再通过腕部的热气孔集中喷出，形成炽烈的冲击。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's thick fur helps it trap the heat generated by its body, which it can then focus into fiery blasts using the thermal vents in its wrist.

entry: 它们精力十足，常出现在健身影片中，鼓励观众跳舞，直到累倒。
author: quote.lass
source: These energetic Pokémon make frequent appearances in exercise videos, encouraging viewers to dance until they drop.

entry: 受到妥善关爱与照料，POKENAME便会茁壮成长，比进化前更有自信。不过，对不信任的陌生人，它仍很少开口歌唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: With proper love and care, POKENAME will grow and have more confidence than its pre-evolution. However, it seldom sings to strangers it doesn't trust.

entry: POKENAME振翅攻击时，能随机引发一种异常状态。甜香却有毒的花粉团，也能帮它引诱猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to attack and cause a random status condition. It can lure prey with its sweet-yet-poisonous pollen puffs.

entry: 头上的蘑菇太重，小巧的身体已难以支撑。因此，POKENAME索性用蘑菇撑地旋转，借离心力踢击敌人，同时散播孢子。
author: sontyp
source: The mushroom on its head became too heavy for its small body to effectively carry. Instead, POKENAME spins around on it, delivering kicks and spreading spores via centrifugal forces.

entry: 它随时准备迎战，双臂锋利如刃，覆着麻痹孢子，出手精准。严整的举止下藏着强烈的决心，既精通搏斗，也擅长施加异常状态。
author: thepandasharky
source: Always ready for a fight, it strikes with precise, blade-like arms coated in paralyzing spores. Its disciplined demeanor hides a fierce determination, making it a master of both combat and status-inflicting techniques.

entry: POKENAME常住在草木丛生、孢子弥漫的洞穴中，用壳上鱼叉般的尖刺，牢牢钩住洞壁。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME are often found in overgrown caves full of their spores. They hold onto cave walls with the harpoon-like spikes protruding from its shell.

entry: POKENAME在散发着潮湿气味的森林中挪动，想要融入菌丝与苔藓之间。它的孢子具有强烈的催眠效果，令人畏惧。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME shuffle around in musky forests, hoping to blend in with the mycelium and moss. Their spores are feared for their drowsy potency.

entry: POKENAME出鞘之快，声响震耳欲聋。可受害者听见时，早已被利刃划伤。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The speed in which POKENAME unsheathes is deafening. By the time its victim hears it, however, they are already wounded by its blade.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，又能感知磁场，难以捕捉。因此，人们至今对它知之甚少。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME's speed and ability to detect magnetic fields make it very difficult to catch. As a result, not much is known about this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME替所有被放生的宝可梦怨恨训练家。它藏在树上，用蛛网绊倒经过的人类，再扑上去施以毒咬。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME harbors resentment and anger towards Trainers on behalf of all the Pokémon they have released. It will hide on trees, using its webs to trip any humans so it can bite them with poison.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在黑暗中，突然跳出惊吓训练家。若训练家下意识反击，POKENAME便会对其施加诅咒。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME lurks within the darkness and jumps out to frighten Trainers. If a Trainer reflexively attacks it, POKENAME will place a curse on them.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME数着训练家慌乱中掉落的硬币。有人说，还可以向它们借钱。
author: tad
source: POKENAME can often be found counting coins dropped by panicking Trainers. Some say you can borrow money from them.

entry: 不愿离开训练家的宝可梦灵魂，会化作POKENAME。只要与训练家重逢，它们便能恢复原来的模样。
author: skymaster426
source: Pokémon souls unwilling to part with their Trainer are turned into POKENAME. Meeting their Trainer allows them to turn back to their normal form.

entry: 孩子遗失的玩具饱含思念与悲伤，最终获得生命，化作这只宝可梦。它不知为何特别厌恶某些超能力属性宝可梦。
author: shocktopus1717
source: A child's lost toy, filled with longing and sorrow, came to life as this Pokémon. It has a strange aversion to certain Psychic-Type Pokémon.

entry: 虽然已融合，体内的诅咒娃娃仍能短暂离开装甲。它回来之前，空壳便一动不动。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite being a fusion, the Banette within can leave the armor for short periods of time. The hollow shell will be inactive until it returns.

entry: 主人对音乐的热爱，让POKENAME获得了生命。它幽幽而舒缓的歌声，还能让别的玩偶活过来，组成偶像团体。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Its owner's love for music brought POKENAME to life. Its haunting yet soothing voice can reanimate other dolls to be used as an idol group.

entry: 它体内中空。拉链打开，水便被吸进胸口，随后就能在战斗中，借神秘力量操纵这些水。
author: houndrys.
source: It is hollow. Water is sucked into its chest when the zipper opens; it later uses that water in battle, manipulating it with its paranormal powers.

entry: 洛托姆本想附进熟睡的卡拉卡拉所戴的头骨里，却与卡拉卡拉结下了牵绊。如今，它们结伴旅行。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Trying to merge with the skull on a sleeping Cubone's head, Rotom became attached to the Cubone. They now travel together.

entry: POKENAME体内的蛋虽受到悉心孵育，却始终没有破壳的迹象。尽管如此，POKENAME依然很快乐。
author: patch_bros
source: Even though it's very well incubated, the egg inside of a POKENAME never seems to show signs of hatching. Despite this, POKENAME remains happy.

entry: 雷暴中，POKENAME从一台街机诞生。如今，它执着地吞食现实中的树果，一心想长得更大。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Spawned from an arcade cabinet during a lightning storm, POKENAME now obsessively consumes berries in the real world to increase in size.

entry: POKENAME常打开背上的保温箱，为海滩游客送上饮品。可饮料究竟打哪儿来，谁也说不清。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME will often provide refreshments to beachgoers using the cooler on its back. Where these drinks come from, nobody quite knows.

entry: 这只洛托姆附在自动贩卖机里。战斗时，它会借助强大的电击，将饮料射出去。
author: jackjirachi
source: This Rotom has possessed a vending machine. When in battle, it shoots out the refreshments using powerful electric shocks.

entry: 它的头与尾各有独立的意识，平时互不相通，唯有战斗时，两颗心才能真正同步。
author: staghorn
source: The consciousnesses in its head and tail are completely separate. Only in battle do its two minds properly synchronize.

entry: 它寄居在电动搅拌机里，保护娇弱的身体。收集树果榨成提神的果汁，能让失去战斗能力的宝可梦恢复活力。有人认为，这种果汁与伤药有关。
author: mistymagius
source: It inhabits an electric blender to protect its delicate body. It collects berries to create an energizing juice that it uses to re-energize fainted Pokémon. Some believe its juice is related to potions.

entry: 曾有记录称，POKENAME以时速88英里穿行，时而遁入时间，时而重返现世。
author: supersonicloki
source: There have been records of POKENAME being seen drifting in and out of time at a speed of 88 mph.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，头部与双臂上的电锯，却能轻松切开金属。许多训练家觉得，它很像某个虚构角色。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is a loyal fusion. The chainsaws on its arms and head can easily cut through metal. Many Trainers think it resembles a fictional character.

entry: 背上的发光纹样会显示体内还存有多少电力。训练家常将POKENAME当作随身电池。
author: mistymagius
source: The bright patterns on its back indicate how much electricity is stored inside of its body. Trainers often keep POKENAME as portable batteries.

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: POKENAME是一把威力惊人的能量剑。人们相信，它来自一个遥远、遥远的地方……
author: rkmaster25367
source: As an energy sword of vast power, POKENAME is believed to hail from a land far, far away....

entry: POKENAME的身体是一只有缺陷的电源分配器。据推测，若把所有插头都接上插座，就会引发惊人的大爆炸。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's body is made from a defective power hub. It is theorized that plugging all of its plugs into outlets would cause a tremendous explosion.

entry: 旋入普通灯座后，POKENAME便会吸走在它灯光下休息的人的生命能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: After screwing into ordinary sockets, POKENAME absorbs the life energy of those who rest in its light.

entry: POKENAME能投射出无害宝可梦的影像，吸引目光，再把猎物引进带电的陷阱，牢牢捕住。
author: mistershaokahn
source: To lure and capture its prey via its electrified traps, POKENAME is able to project images of harmless Pokémon that catch anyone's eye.

entry: POKENAME凭强劲的车轮飞速疾驰，沿途不断从鬃毛中射出岩石。它虽对训练家极其忠诚，却也爱淘气，常拿最信任的人开玩笑。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME races at incredible speeds using its powerful wheels, while launching rocks from its mane as it moves. Though fiercely loyal to its Trainer, it has a mischievous streak and often pulls pranks on those it trusts most.

entry: POKENAME头上的寄生蘑菇会将阳光转化为电力。偏偏宿主本身就靠阳光获取能量，因此深受其害。
author: Trainerrobo
source: The parasitic mushroom atop POKENAME's head converts sunlight into electricity. This is unfortunate for the host, as it relies on sunlight for its energy.

entry: 它不断再生细胞，分离出胶状的身体组织。这些组织都带着病原体，千万不要触碰。
author: chorb33
source: It constantly regenerates its cells and splits off its jelly-like body parts. They are infected with pathogens, which is why contact must be avoided.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由凝胶状物质构成，战斗时不容易受损。但这样一来，脆弱的身体也就失去了遮护。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are made of a gel-like substance that makes them less likely to be damaged in combat. However, this leaves its fragile body wide open for attacks.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense Psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: 庞大的大脑让POKENAME对昆虫了如指掌。皮下金色的团块其实是储备的蜂蜜，供食物短缺时食用。
author: iaobug
source: POKENAME's impeccable knowledge of insects stems from its immense brain. The gold globs under its skin are honey reserves for when food is scarce.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: POKENAME躯干内的本体用超能力操纵三个头。无论哪个头被斩断，都能在几秒内重新长出。
author: mistymagius
source: The main body in POKENAME's torso controls the three heads with its psychic powers. If any of its heads gets cut off, they will regrow in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的黏液能保护身体，强大的精神力量还能将其塑成牢不可破的超能力屏障。它虽强大，性情却温和，喜欢给人黏糊糊的大拥抱。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's thick, protective slime shields it from harm, and its powerful mind controls this ooze to form unbreakable psychic barriers. Despite its strength, it is gentle by nature and fond of giving big, slimy hugs.

entry: 背上的特殊液体，控制着POKENAME的行动。它力气极大，单用一只手，就能捏碎树干。
author: pizzarcato
source: A special liquid on its back controls POKENAME. Just one of its powerful hands can crush a tree trunk.

entry: 尽管身体没有固定形状，它仍能以超过每小时130英里的速度奔跑。据说，POKENAME全速奔跑时极少绊倒，但一旦摔倒翻滚，就会散成多只较小的POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Despite its amorphous body, it can run at speeds of over 130 miles per hour. It is said that in the rare event that a POKENAME trips and falls while at a full gallop, the resulting tumble will cause it to break apart into multiple smaller POKENAME.

entry: 传说POKENAME思乡心切，才让背上长出了月亮。有时会让旅人梦见月上的景象。
author: zombieshinx_
source: Legend says POKENAME's desperate desire to go home caused the growth of the moon on its back. It sometimes gives dreams of the moon to travelers.

entry: POKENAME载着孩子，遨游奇幻夜空的故事，流传甚广。可真正得到证实的目击，却寥寥无几。
author: staghorn
source: Stories of POKENAME giving small children wondrous and magical rides through the night sky are common. Confirmed sightings, however, are rare.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现于人前。若有幸寻到，它就会让来者看见浩瀚深空的美丽幻象。
