author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME are rarely seen by human eyes. Those who are lucky enough to find one are shown beautiful visions of deep space.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: 训练家夜里难以入睡时，POKENAME就会围着对方优雅起舞，唱起轻柔的摇篮曲。
author: kittyluv090
source: If its Trainer is having trouble falling asleep at night, POKENAME will dance around them beautifully while singing a soothing lullaby.

entry: POKENAME对人类十分戒备。两只大耳朵始终留意四周，探察潜在的威胁。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are wary of humans. Their large ears are constantly monitoring the environment of possible threats.

entry: 据说，它将月夜的天空收进了锋利的爪与指甲之中。研究者认为，这是接触月之石后产生的变化。它能轻松跃上高空，仿佛身处月球。
author: over9001
source: It's said this Pokémon captured the moonlit sky in its sharp claws and nails. Researchers believe it's the result of it coming into contact with a Moon Stone. It can easily jump into the sky as if it were on the moon.

entry: POKENAME翱翔于浩瀚太空，保护世界免受各种星际威胁。它们十分贪玩，时不时便回到人类身边。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME soars throughout the vast emptiness of space, protecting the world from a number of intergalactic threats. They are very playful Pokémon and return to humanity every so often.

entry: 头顶的星星，蓄满了宇宙能量。有人相信，若能摸到它而不被烫伤，就能实现一个愿望。
author: ohok3441
source: The star atop this fusion's head is filled with cosmic energy. Some believe that if you touch it without getting burnt, you'll be granted a wish.

entry: 它头上月牙状的饰物，根本拿不下来。谁若伸手想扯，往往只落得一手烫伤。
author: ohok3441
source: The moon-shaped headpiece cannot be removed from this fusion. Individuals who try to grab at it often find themselves earning a burn instead.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰，以宇宙力量与积极的情绪为燃料。心情越好，火便烧得越亮。
author: ohok3441
source: The fire on POKENAME's head is fueled by both cosmic power and positivity. It'll burn brighter when it's happy.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，用强大的引力漩涡吸来猎物。漩涡虽强得连汽车也能卷入，POKENAME却只捕食小型宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the ground, using a strong gravitational vortex to pull in its prey. Despite the vortex being powerful enough to pull in a car, POKENAME only goes after smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱与皮皮共舞，用低沉浑厚的嗓音，在月光下歌唱。到了新月之夜，其他妖精宝可梦，也会围着它起舞。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME loves to dance with Clefairy and sing in the moonlight with its deep, rumbling voice. Other fairy types dance around it on new-moon nights.

entry: 满月之夜，成群的POKENAME会四处列队行进。它们对旗帜有着奇特的痴迷，因此也常参加游行。
author: sottiwotti
source: Groups of POKENAME march around on full moon nights. Because of their weird obsession with flags, they are often used in parades.

entry: POKENAME头上的螺旋宝石在收藏家间价格高昂。它通常喜欢躲藏，却也能从宝石射出激光，抵抗偷猎者。
author: darkweavile428
source: The spiral gem in POKENAME's head fetches a high price from collectors. Though it usually prefers to hide, POKENAME can fire lasers from this gem to defend itself from poachers.

entry: POKENAME物理攻击强劲，是不折不扣的大力士。可在野外，它几乎不肯动用蛮力，因为一伤害别人，自己便难过。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's physical attack is truly great, making it a powerhouse. However, it barely uses its strength in the wild, as it feels bad when it attacks.

entry: 满月之夜，若有好几只POKENAME聚在一起，就可能彼此黏合，发生进化。
author: chorb33
source: If several POKENAME come together on the night of a full moon, they may stick together and evolve.

entry: 每逢月圆，许多POKENAME便聚上高原或山峰，尽可能吸收月光，加快进化。
author: chorb33
source: On full-moon nights, many POKENAME gather on plateaus or mountains to absorb as much moonlight as possible in order to accelerate their evolution.

entry: POKENAME紧密卷曲的毛发，不容易引起过敏。聚群时，额头的宝石一齐发亮；当它们乘风飘浮，整群宛如一片繁星点点的夜空。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME's tight curls give their fur a hypoallergenic quality. When gathered in herds, the gems on their foreheads glow brightly. As they float on the wind, the herd looks like a starry night sky.

entry: POKENAME吸取猎物的生命力，储存在颈边的种子里。它会追寻临终之人，将对方的生命力送回自然。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME draws out the life force from its victims and stores it in the seeds on its neck. It pursues people near their end to return their life force to nature.

entry: POKENAME奔过田野，撒播棉花种子，是业余农人的热门伙伴。它们也喜欢嚼食棉枝，正好在重新播种时帮助清理田地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run through fields to scatter cotton seeds, making them popular companions for amateur farmers. They enjoy snacking on cotton branches, which helps clear the field when it's time for new seeds to be planted.

entry: 每当想要飞行，它就先把棉絮聚在下半身，再撑着手杖纵身一跃，乘风向西而去。
author: skymaster426
source: Whenever it wishes to fly, it gathers cotton around its lower body before using its staff to make a big leap. Then it rides the wind, going west.

entry: POKENAME身轻如风，会偷偷钻进房屋的缝隙，吸走家中小宠物的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As agile as the wind, POKENAME sneaks into the cracks of buildings to steal the life force of small household pets.

entry: 这只狡猾的宝可梦，会藏在棉田里伪装自己。等到时机合适，就突然跳出来袭击。
author: holzycookie
source: This sneaky Pokémon is known to disguise itself in fields of cotton. When the time is right, it jumps out and strikes.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮软得连自己也抵挡不住，总想躺上去睡一觉。据说，收集POKENAME的棉花，是件轻松差事。
author: xenophacilus
source: The cotton from POKENAME is so soft that even it can't resist sleeping on its own fluff. Harvesting POKENAME's cotton is said to be an easy job.

entry: POKENAME能纺出品质绝佳的棉絮。工业时代，棉纺工厂曾十分依赖它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spins cotton of incredible quality. Cotton factories of the industrial era were heavily reliant of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄其他宝可梦，常装成一团棉花，在田野间蹦跳嬉戏。
author: holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to play tricks on other Pokémon. It often frolics around fields pretending to be a ball of cotton.

entry: 人们猜测POKENAME是获得生命的堆肥堆。它乘风漂游时，会朝下撒落腐烂的植物残屑，似乎觉得这恶作剧十分有趣。
author: wormspawn
source: Presumed to be a compost heap given life, POKENAME scatters decaying plant material beneath it as it rides the wind. It seems to think this is a funny joke.

entry: POKENAME曾在寺庙中沉睡多年，无人发觉。毛发长得太长，终于被收服后，还得先剪个发。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME slept undiscovered in a temple for many years. Its hair grew so long that it had to have a haircut after it was finally caught.

entry: 夜里遇见疲惫的训练家，POKENAME就会热心帮忙：先用棉絮铺好软床，再施以催眠，让人安然入睡。
author: holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to help any weary Trainers it finds throughout the night. It makes soft beds out of cotton, and hypnotises Trainers to help them sleep.

entry: POKENAME制造绿洲，藏进沙中捕猎。据传，即使是结伴穿越沙漠的大队人马，靠近这样的绿洲也会失踪。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME creates water oases and hides in sand to catch their prey. Rumors say that even big groups of people in the desert go missing when approaching such oases.

entry: 这种宝可梦以暴躁易怒、破坏力强而出名。虽行事鲁莽，却是维系当地生态的重要一员。
author: rawthorn
source: A Pokémon known for its quick temper and destructive capabilities. Although they are rash, they are vital in protecting their surrounding ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME带领黑眼鸦与混混鸦成群觅食，身上分泌的特殊液体，能防止沙粒钻入羽毛。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME leads packs of Sandikrow and Krokokrow to hunt for food. It secretes a special fluid that keeps sand out of its feathers.

entry: 即使猎物在30多英里外，POKENAME也能发现，随即俯冲而下，用强健的大颚将其咬碎。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swoops down on them and crushes them with its powerful jaws.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾被一位传奇大盗使用。如今它在自己的沙漠领地伏击闯入者，令人闻之生畏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Thought to once be wielded by a legendary bandit, POKENAME terrorizes its territory of the desert by ambushing trespassers.

entry: POKENAME故作强硬，命令幼小的宝可梦听自己使唤。可一旦对方的父母前来保护孩子，它就只会逃跑。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME put on a tough act and command baby Pokémon to do what they say. However, it will resort to fleeing if the parents come to protect the young.

entry: 据说，POKENAME顽强得不可思议。无论敌人有多强、处境多不利，只要它决定挑战，就能闯过去。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME is said to be extremely tenacious. No matter the enemy or odds, if it challenges something, it can overcome it.

entry: POKENAME行动不够灵活，狩猎时便将自己埋入沙中，再用水炮让猎物脚下喷起间歇泉。
author: iamjocheena
source: Due to their lack of agility, POKENAME hunt by burying themselves in sand and using their water cannons to create geysers under their prey.

entry: 这个孤独的幽灵，仍在哀悼自己的死去。据说，它曾是一位早已被世人遗忘的法老的宠物。
author: theheroict
source: A lonesome spirit that mourns its death. It is supposedly the pet of a long-forgotten pharaoh.

entry: 它潜居古老的金字塔，将盗墓者拖入墓中，作为惩罚，让他们永世不得离开。
author: theheroict
source: A vicious creature that punishes grave robbers by dragging them into a tomb to lay for eternity. It's found inside ancient pyramids.

entry: POKENAME伪装成镀金的弯头权杖，捕捉意图盗墓的人。它会勾住对方的脖子，吸尽生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises as a gold-plated crook to catch would-be grave robbers. It hooks them by the neck and drains them of their life force.

entry: 残暴法老的灵魂重返旧日躯体，便形成了POKENAME。战斗时，它用暗影幻象迷惑敌人，再将其制服。
author: yoshimon
source: A cruel pharaoh's spirit possessed its old body, creating POKENAME. It utilizes shadow illusions in combat to confuse and conquer.

entry: POKENAME制造出盗墓者心中渴求之物的幻象，引诱毫无戒心的人进入领地。一旦上钩，POKENAME便用幽灵般的肢体榨尽他们的生命力。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME tempt unsuspecting tomb raiders into its domain with illusions of their desires.  Once enticed, POKENAME uses its ghostly limbs to squeeze the life force out of them.

entry: 据说，它是疑心极重的法老们制造的古代巡逻机关。一发现闯入者，便先发出高频尖声，再展开攻击。
author: theheroict
source: Supposedly, it's an ancient security drone created by paranoid pharaohs. It emits high pitched frequencies when it spots an intruder before attacking.

entry: POKENAME为富可敌国的人家作舞者。若喂它金珠，舞姿便会美得令人出神。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME live as dancers for exceptionally rich citizens. When fed gold nuggets, their dance will become mesmerizing.

entry: POKENAME审判亡者的灵魂。纯净的，便引往来世；污浊的，则会化作黄沙。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME judge the souls of those who have died. If they are pure, then they are guided to the afterlife. If they are corrupt, the souls become sand.

entry: 人们在沙漠中发现了它，相信里面寄宿着远古统治者的灵魂。它会命令某些宝可梦替自己筑起身躯。
author: houndrys.
source: Found in deserts, it is believed it contains the soul of a ruler from ancient times. It commands certain Pokémon to build its body.

entry: 多年前，考古学家在古墓中发现了POKENAME。烈日下，它看起来只是一尊泥像。可据说到了凉爽的沙漠夜晚，就会有灵魂围着它，举行早已失传的仪式。
author: kianjp2008
source: Archeologists discovered POKENAME in an ancient tomb many years ago. Under the blazing sun it appears to only be a clay sculpture, but during cool desert nights it's said that spirits can be found circled around it performing a long forgotten ritual.

entry: POKENAME会伏击盗墓贼，让他们中毒；对规矩守礼的训练家，却会慷慨赠送宝物，有些价值数百万。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME ambushes and poisons grave robbers. It rewards behaving Trainers with riches. Some of these riches are worth millions.

entry: 它整天待在原处补充电力。入夜后便与同类成群横行，以不幸撞见的猎物为食。
author: skymaster426
source: It spends the entire day in place charging itself up with electricity. At night, it goes on a rampage with its swarm, feeding on any unlucky prey.

entry: POKENAME会附在其他生物或电器上，转眼吸干全部能量，再跳到新的宿主身上，继续如此。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can attach itself to other living creatures or electrical devices to suck out all their energy within a very short time. It then jumps to a new host to repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在寺庙筑巢，夜里能照明，还会捕捉其他虫宝可梦，因此很受欢迎。有人甚至相信，它们的光能驱散邪灵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME like to nest in temples, where they are well received because they generate light at night and catch other Bug Pokémon. Some even believe that they keep evil spirits away with their radiant light.

entry: POKENAME埋伏着，等待猎物落入带电的丝网。它听觉敏锐，能准确抓住俯冲下去、了结猎物的时机。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME lies in wait for prey to stumble into its electrified webs. It is perceptive, and hears exactly when it must swoop down and finish the job.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的花苞，平时紧紧闭合。到了春天，便绽成美丽的黄花。
author: ohok3441
source: The ends of POKENAME's tails are closed buds. In spring, they bloom into beautiful yellow flowers.

entry: POKENAME用狼牙棒般的尾巴重砸敌人，接着便疯狂挥砍，直到对方再也不动。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME uses its mace-like tail to ferociously crush foes. It follows up a blow from its tail with furious slashing until the foe stops moving.

entry: POKENAME附在阴暗洞顶生活。粗心的访客一踏入领地，它就突然落下，将人掳走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in gloomy caves, attached to the ceiling. If a careless visitor enters its territory, it suddenly drops down and abducts them.

entry: POKENAME一受惊，就用藤蔓缠住敌人，再以燃烧的四肢将其烧毁。它的钢壳，过去曾被用来做炊具。
author: staghorn
source: If startled, a POKENAME will wrap its vines around its foe and torch them with its flaming limbs. Its steel shell was once used to make cookware.

entry: POKENAME用收集来的金属与自身尖刺，做成一只巨大的刺轮，既可远攻，也能格挡来袭的招式。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Using the metal it gathers and its own spines, POKENAME creates a giant spiked wheel. It uses said wheel to fight from afar or block attacks.

entry: 这只宝可梦用众多带刺的触须，攀过墙面、地板与洞顶。占好位置，便会突然出击。
author: houndrys.
source: This Pokémon uses its many spiky tendrils to clamber across walls, floors, and ceilings. When it's in the right place, it strikes.

entry: 腹中燃着不灭的火焰，POKENAME总感到饥饿。即使一连吃上好几天，还是觉得饿得慌。
author: blitzydragon
source: Because of the perpetual flame in its stomach, POKENAME are always hungry. They can eat for days on end and still feel like they're starving.

entry: POKENAME白天睡觉，吸收阳光，为超能力火焰储备燃料。盯着那火看得太久，就会受它控制。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleep during the day to gather sunlight to fuel their psychic flames. Staring at the flame for too long will put you under its control.

entry: POKENAME诞生于废弃多年的发电厂，吸取破旧机器与引擎的能量。负责停用拆卸设施的工程师常说，黑暗的走廊与大厅深处会出现幽异的蓝光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form within long-abandoned power plants, drawing energy from derelict machines and engines. Engineers decommissioning these facilities often report eerie blue lights deep in the dark corridors and halls.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一簇闪烁的紫焰，高兴、想玩时，就会亮起来。它会点出小小的火花与火焰，把快乐传给身边的伙伴。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME has a flickering purple flame atop its head that lights up whenever its happy and in a playful mood. It can ignite small sparks and flames, using its fire to spread its cheerful spirit.

entry: 燃烧的颚自有意识，会咬向一切，吞噬猎物的灵魂。但它的本体却出奇地友善，常朝喜欢的训练家凑过去。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fiery jaw has a mind of its own and will chomp at anything to consume its victims' souls. Despite this, the main body is oddly friendly and wanders toward Trainers it likes.

entry: 据说，吃下用POKENAME的火烹煮的食物，会鲜明地梦见史前的远古海洋。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that eating food cooked over a POKENAME's flame will cause you to have vivid dreams of ancient, prehistoric oceans.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，会借拉帝欧斯的传说，引来好奇的人类与宝可梦，再装出温顺的样子，让对方不愿离去。与此同时，幽异的紫焰却不断吸走他们的生命力。
author: arcul
source: A highly intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME uses the lore surrounding Latios to entice curious Pokémon and humans to approach. It then keeps them close by displaying a docile nature, but all the while, its eerie purple flame saps their life force.

entry: 体内的热量不断熔化新生的蜡，因此它始终承受着巨大的痛苦。
author: jpeggio
source: The heat from its body causes the newly formed wax to melt. Due to this, it is constantly in immense agony.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，仿佛孩童，会引领葬身海中的亡魂前往来世。紫色鳞片在夜里闪闪发光。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are playful, almost childlike Pokémon that help guide those who lost their lives at sea to the afterlife. Their purple scales shine at night.

entry: 它用头上的火焰诱来毫无戒心的猎物，同时吸取能量。待对方虚弱得足够厉害，便整个吞下。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Using the flames on its head, it lures unsuspecting prey in whilst draining its energy. Once a victim is weak enough, it swallows them whole.

entry: 它为宝可梦引路穿过海洋，一路却都在吸走生命力。等宝可梦死去，POKENAME便吃掉遗体。
author: darkweavile428
source: It guides Pokémon though the ocean, draining their life force all the while. When the Pokémon passes away, POKENAME consumes their corpse.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，唱着和谐的旋律。歌声引来其他宝可梦，它便吸取对方的生命力。
author: deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the skies singing a harmonious melody. Its song draws other Pokémon in, and it absorbs the life force out of them.

entry: 民间传说，游魂融入蜡烛最后的一点残焰，便诞生了POKENAME。它能重塑蜡质的身体，仿出各种蜡烛造型，几乎与寻常物件无异。
author: rakunk
source: According to folklore, POKENAME was formed when the last flicker of a candle was imbued with a wandering spirit. Its waxy body can reshape itself to mimic various candle designs, making it nearly indistinguishable from ordinary objects.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身于刚失去亲友的悲伤者面前，既令人宽慰，又令人不安。有人相信它能引领迷途的灵魂，也有人担心它会把对方引向悲伤的深渊。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to appear to those grieving a recent loss, offering a comforting yet unsettling presence. Some believe the Pokémon guides lost souls, while others fear it leads them into the depths of their sorrow.

entry: 它体内不断燃起紫焰，发出苍白的光。POKENAME借头顶的灯罩，让光均匀地散向四周。
author: chorb33
source: It constantly creates purple flames in its body. These cause a pale light, which POKENAME can radiate evenly using the lampshade on its head.

entry: POKENAME精通死灵法术，能随心操纵生与死的能量。据说，与它结为朋友就能获得永生。
author: klgb76
source: POKENAME are highly skilled necromancers, capable of bending life and death energy to their will. It is said that befriending one can grant eternal life.

entry: POKENAME头中的幽灵烛火燃得炽烈，能照亮大片区域。它天生好战，会裹挟灼热的幽焰冲向敌人，将沿途战场点燃。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME burns with a fierce glow, a spectral candle in its head that can illuminate a wide area. Known for its fighting instincts, it charges at foes with blazing ghostly attacks, igniting the battlefield in its wake.

entry: 战斗结束后，POKENAME便出现在战场，收集阵亡士兵的灵魂。战争期间，它们的光格外耀眼。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME appears at the sites of concluded battles to collect the spirits of fallen soldiers. They shine brilliantly during wartime.

entry: 几只POKENAME会排成一路，将迷路旅人引往沙漠深处，再等对方死去，吸收灵魂。
author: duskrd
source: Several POKENAME will form a trail to lead lost travellers further into the desert. They then wait for the victim to pass on to absorb their spirit.

entry: 它会出现在夜间迷路的人面前，招手邀人同往来世。若对方不肯，POKENAME便会强行带走。
author: hummusishome
source: It appears to those who get lost at night, beckoning them to follow it to the afterlife. POKENAME will take them there by force if they decline.

entry: 身体发出的光，吸引来大群夜行昆虫。一旦靠近，生命力就会被POKENAME迅速吸走。
author: staghorn
source: Its body glows with a light that attracts large swarms of nocturnal insects. Those that approach have their vitality rapidly drained by the POKENAME.

entry: 奇怪的是，它只吃烧焦的东西，常躲进烤箱，享用里面焦黑的食物残渣。
author: rockageddon
source: Curiously this Pokémon only eats things that have already been burnt to a crisp. They will hide in ovens to feast on the burnt remains of food inside.

entry: POKENAME头上的甲片，能当作冲撞的重锤。背上的紫焰既为POKENAME保暖，也让它能借高温进攻。
author: shado_.w
source: The plating on POKENAME's head is used as a ram. In addition, the purple flame on its back warms POKENAME up and allows it to attack with heat.

entry: POKENAME的灼焰能斩断一切，连灵魂也不例外，原地只会留下躯体。
author: symile
source: A POKENAME is able to cut through anything with its searing flames. Only the body is left behind, as it even cleaves the spirit.

entry: 它电死猎物后，尸身的灰烬便供幽焰燃烧，残留的灵魂则被用来产生恐怖的电力。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly flames are fueled by the ashes of the bodies its electrocuted. It uses the remaining spirit to generate its terrifying electricity.

entry: POKENAME带着一座最多插有9根蜡烛的烛台。据说，猜中哪支蜡烛最后烧完的人，可能会得到礼物。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME carries a candelabra with up to 9 candles on it. It's said that people who guess which candle will last the longest may receive a gift.

entry: POKENAME的毒液会让咬伤周围一片灼痛。自发现POKENAME以来，医生一直在寻找有效的抗毒血清。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME's venom can cause a burning sensation all over the bite area. Doctors have been looking into finding an antivenom since POKENAME's discovery.

entry: POKENAME释放灵火时，透明的上半身会泛起紫光。谁若被火击中，便会身中诅咒，注定走向死亡。
author: chorb33
source: Its transparent upper body glows purple when POKENAME emits its spirit flames. Anyone hit by them is cursed and doomed to death.

entry: POKENAME是披着幽焰的凶猛斗士，对战斗的热爱让它不断以灼热的幽灵攻击迎敌。POKENAME的火焰十分明亮，足以照亮整间暗室。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a fierce fighter cloaked in spectral flames. Its intense love for battle drives it to unleash scorching ghostly attacks on its opponents. The flame of a POKENAME is bright enough to fully illuminate a dark room.

entry: 据说，谁若在POKENAME的纸上写下名字，灵魂便会被夺走。
author: inksans201x
source: Those that write their names on POKENAME's papers are said to have their souls taken away.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，会为每位受害者映出独有的幻象，例如已故亲人的面容，随后再吞噬灵魂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flame creates illusory images unique to each of its victims, such as the face of a deceased loved one, before it consumes their spirit.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME专为那些逃过死劫、活得长久的国王收魂。许多故事都以与它的决斗收尾。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the reaper of long-lived kings who have otherwise cheated death. Duels with this Pokémon mark the end of many tales.

entry: POKENAME会指挥成群的烛小兵，吸干猎物的生命能量。随后，它把猎物的灵魂烧掉，只留下躯体。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME commands groups of Litiard to drain the life energy from its prey. POKENAME then burns the prey's sprit, leaving the body behind.

entry: 据说，接触POKENAME的火焰，便能看见来世。可那些景象，不过是它制造的幻象。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that exposure to POKENAME's flames will cause one to experience visions of the afterlife. These are just its illusions, however.

entry: POKENAME吸收并储存周围空气中的静电。蓄满时，便能放出强烈耀眼的光芒。
author: Trainerrobo
source: POKENAME absorbs and stores static electricity from the air around it. It is able to produce an intensely bright light when at full capacity.

entry: POKENAME常在深海中结成小群，以光芒引来小型猎物，却也会招来捕食者。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME are known for schooling in small groups in the depths of the sea. They use their glowing ability to draw in small prey, but this also attracts predators.

entry: POKENAME等在医院外，守候亡魂经过。有时还会吸走医院的电力，加快这个过程。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME waits outside of hospitals for spirits to pass. Sometimes POKENAME will sap the hospital's power to speed up the process.

entry: 它会在夜里突然现身，全速冲向落单的训练家。据说，一旦被它撞中，就会被拖入冥界。
author: staghorn
source: It appears suddenly at night, charging lone Trainers at a full sprint. It is said that if it tackles you, you will be dragged into the netherworld.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常栖身于沉没的游轮残骸，会诅咒一切看见的船只。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in the remains of a sunken cruise ship. It is known to put curses on any boats it spots.

entry: 据说，POKENAME体内住着无数灵魂，分别系于内部不同的房间。窗中闪烁着幽光，仔细聆听，还能听见隐约的低语。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to be inhabited by countless spirits living inside its body, each tied to a different room inside its structure. Its windows flicker with ghostly lights, and faint whispers can be heard if you listen closely.

entry: 它用天生的利刃剪枝、刮去树皮，让藏在树干下的猎物无处遁形。外表虽凶，性情却温和随意。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its natural blades to clip branches and scrape bark from tree trunks, exposing prey underneath. Despite its fearsome appearance, it has a gentle and easygoing temperament.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: 只要不在战斗，它就不停磨砺刀刃。过去曾有一只POKENAME仅挥动一下身体，就劈开了整座山。
author: skymaster426
source: It constantly sharpens its blades whenever not fighting. In the past, one POKENAME split an entire mountain with a single swing of its body.

entry: POKENAME虽模样古老得仿佛来自史前，如今却仍活得好好的。凭借速度与尾刃，森林和猎物都能被它轻松劈开。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its prehistoric appearance, POKENAME is still very much alive today. It uses its speed and tail to effortlessly cut through forests and prey.

entry: POKENAME通常住在洞穴深处，保护着大群牙蜈蚣幼虫。若受到威胁，就会变得极为凶暴。
author: cutiepierate
source: POKENAME are usually found deep within caves, protecting large amounts of Axepede larvae.  They can be highly aggressive if threatened.

entry: 大舌贝咬住尾巴时，POKENAME会痛得乱甩。尾巴挥动的力道极大，能将电线杆干净利落地劈成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: When the Shellder bites down on POKENAME's tail, it will thrash around in pain. Its swinging tail can swing with enough force to cleave a telephone pole cleanly in half.

entry: 据推测，POKENAME是一种失传已久的自动机关，古人用它们作警觉的卫士，守护君王。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is speculated to be a species of long-lost automaton used by ancient people as vigilant guards for the king they serve.

entry: 据说，许多POKENAME已将体内的蛋孵育了一千年，却始终不见破壳的迹象。
author: patch
source: It is said many POKENAME have been incubating the egg in their body for a thousand years. It has never shown any signs of hatching.

entry: 歌谣称它们是来自群星之外的远古遗物。它们总在搜集奇异的古物，再用只有自己明白的方式，将知识与礼物分享给人类。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Songs are sung that claim these Pokémon are ancient relics from beyond the stars. Always gathering a collection of odd artifacts, these Pokémon share their knowledge and gifts with people in ways known only to them.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于古代文明的遗迹，可它的剑与盾，至今仍闪着神秘能量。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME was first discovered the ruins of an ancient civilization. Despite this, its sword and shield still glows with a mysterious energy.

entry: 据推测，数千年前，一个失落的文明造出了POKENAME，既让它们充当守护者，也作为献给神明的敬礼。
author: cristata
source: It's theorized that POKENAME were built millennia ago by a long lost civilization, both as guardian protectors and as tributes to their deity.

entry: 这只宝可梦体内，不断泄出一阵阵炽热气流。它几乎控制不住自身的破坏力，十分危险。
author: sonicdestroyer12
source: Bursts of superheated air constantly leak from this Pokémon's body. It has dangerously little control over its own destructive power.

entry: POKENAME是仿照神话中的昆虫雕塑而成的古代机关。胸腔结构不稳，它艰难地压制着其中潜藏的沙之力。
author: nellnast42
source: An ancient automaton sculpted after a mythical insect, POKENAME struggles to contain the power of sand concealed inside its unstable chest cavity.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是火暴猴为追求更强力量，改变自身而成。即使战至粉身碎骨，它也不肯停下。
author: staghorn
source: Some think POKENAME is a Primeape that transformed itself in order to grow stronger. It will keep fighting even if it crumbles to dust in the process.

entry: 古老的机关，让它能升到几米高的空中。有些考古学家因此认为，创造者曾把POKENAME当作升降台。
author: chorb33
source: An ancient mechanism allows it to fly several meters into the air. Some archaeologists believe that POKENAME was used as an elevator by its creators.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: 覆盖全身的巨石，为POKENAME提供了极佳防护。可多出的重量，也让每个动作都变得艰难。
author: chorb33
source: The huge boulders that cover POKENAME provide it with excellent protection. At the same time, the added weight makes every move difficult.

entry: POKENAME的六条尾巴各有意识，大多数时候却相处融洽。受到攻击时，尾巴会朝四面八方喷出灼热的火星。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's six tails all have a mind of their own, but they all get along most of the time. When attacked, the tails spew hot embers in every direction.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，能用尾巴感知他人的情绪，是安慰人心的好伙伴。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are gentle-natured. They are able to sense the feelings of others by their tails, making them great comfort Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，会用火焰带来舒适暖意，缓解受其照料者的疼痛与不适。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME has a kindhearted demeanor. It uses its flames to create a soothing warmth, easing the pain and discomfort of those it cares for.

entry: 传说一位巫女经过神秘转变，成了POKENAME。如今继续指引别人，让他们守住纯净之心。
author: jackjirachi
source: It is rumored that a shrine maiden became POKENAME through a mystical transformation. It now guides others, ensuring that they remain pure.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃能放出受它操控的火焰。战斗经验越丰富，新尾巴也会渐渐长出来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits flames which it can control. New tails grow with its experience in battle.

entry: POKENAME出生时只有一条尾巴，长大后才不断分叉。每条尾巴都能像额外的手脚一样运用。
author: melodydelune
source: When POKENAME is born, it only has one tail, but as it ages, its tails split into more. It can use each of its tails as an additional limb.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片摸着温暖，却很容易烧焦，变成难看的褐色。六片尾巴状的鳍，让它游得很快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales are warm to the touch, but they burn quite easily, causing them to turn an ugly brown. Its six tail-like fins help it swim quickly.

entry: 尖锐的毒针其实是消化道里钙化的废物。由于形成时混入胃酸，这些刺带有很强的毒性。
author: frokachu
source: Its sharp stingers are actually calcified waste that formed from its digestive tract. Due to the stomach acids that make them, the stingers are quite poisonous.

entry: POKENAME不爱站着，便把自己的内脏当坐垫。不拿来垫着时，就用它捕捉宝可梦，吞食下肚。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME uses its own guts to sit on, as it doesn't like standing. If a POKENAME isn't using its guts to sit, it's using it to catch Pokémon to eat.

entry: 它拥有神明般的力量，足以毁灭先出手攻击自己的敌人。但若觉得来者值得相交，也会主动伸出手。
author: skymaster426
source: Godlike power allows it to unleash devastating attacks at those who strike it first. However, it offers its hand to those it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME主要靠吐出利刃，刺穿猎物来攻击。它能贴在墙上，明明就在眼前，却让人难以察觉。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spits out its blade as its main form of attack, piercing prey. It can stick to walls to do so hidden in plain sight.

entry: POKENAME扭动蛇般的身体穿行天空，顽皮地挥着双臂。它能释放强大的能量冲击，也会用巨臂近身攻击。平时藏在云中，伺机吞食飞过的猎物。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME wiggles through the sky with its serpentine body, flailing its arms playfully. It unleashes powerful energy blasts while using its giant arms for upclose attacks. It hides amongst clouds, preparing to devour flying prey.

entry: 别看POKENAME的双臂这副模样，其实十分柔软，却蕴藏惊人力量。它们既用来捕鱼，也用来战斗。
author: ayner
source: Despite appearances, the arms of POKENAME are squishy appendages that hide tremendous strength. They use them to catch marine fish Pokémon and fight.

entry: POKENAME将旧内脏裹在身上，既能保暖，也能承受高处坠落的冲击。进化时，这层包裹便会脱落。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME wraps its old guts around its body to keep itself warm and survive long falls. It sheds them when it evolves.

entry: 头部由一组强劲的肌肉构成，能将内脏猛力弹出。它甚至无需挪动身体，就能击落体型比自己大数倍的大嘴雀。
author: staghorn
source: Its head is a battery of powerful muscles designed to eject its inner organs with great force. It's capable of bringing down a Fearow many times its size without moving its body.

entry: 手臂受损后，一小时内就能重新长好。尖刺中的毒性虽轻，却会引起恶心与剧烈头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: If its arms get damaged, it can regrow them within the hour. Its thorns contain a mildly toxic poison that is known to cause nausea and severe headaches.

entry: POKENAME好斗爱挑衅，行动却太慢，敌人一退走就追不上。挨打时，它会靠出奇柔韧的身体反弹攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A belligerent Pokémon prone to picking fights, POKENAME move too slowly to chase down opponents that disengage. When struck, they rebound blows with their surprisingly pliable bodies.

entry: 它把内脏抛进水中，等猎物咬钩。无论嘴里还是尾尖，都能将内脏放出去。
author: staghorn
source: It catches prey by casting its innards into the water and waiting for a bite. It can expel its guts both from its mouth and the tip of its tail.

entry: POKENAME能用炮口以超过每秒160英尺的速度射出内脏。器官弹性极强，因此完全不会受伤。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME can eject its internal organs from its cannons at upwards of 160 feet per second. Its organs are so elastic that this does not hurt it whatsoever.

entry: 钥匙状的尾巴让POKENAME更善于控制电力。它能汇聚等离子体般的雷霆，将敌人劈开。
author: thunderjimmy
source: POKENAME has greater control over electricity because of its key-shaped tail; POKENAME can channel plasma-like thunder to cleave its enemies asunder.

entry: POKENAME用钥匙碰触锁头，就能神奇地开启或封死，因此常被狱警聘用。狱警若放话要永远扔掉钥匙，那多半是有一只POKENAME在旁待命。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are staffed by prison wardens due to their mystical ability to release or seal any lock they touch with their keys. If a warden ever threatens to throw away the key, it is because they have a POKENAME on standby.

entry: POKENAME把刀刃变作钥匙，潜入屋内，再变回利刃，夺取住户的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME morphs its blade into a key to break into buildings and back into a blade to claim the life force of its dwellers.

entry: 与它伪装的宝可梦不同，POKENAME毫不挑剔，什么钥匙都收集。但若把钥匙插进它的布衣，就会惹得它勃然大怒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike the Pokémon it's disguised as, POKENAME lacks discernment and collects any and all keys. Inserting a key into into its cloth angers it greatly.

entry: 它是珍贵钥匙的完美守卫，前提是你不想再拿回来！卡洛斯一则鲜为人知的童话里，英雄曾骗一只粗暴的POKENAME，让它看守解开自身枷锁的钥匙。
author: wormspawn
source: The perfect protector for precious keys - as long as you don't want them back! An obscure Kalosian fairy tale tells of a hero who tricked a brutish POKENAME into guarding the key to its own shackles.

entry: POKENAME主要吃各种金属合金，常漂在废品场里寻找最爱的点心——钥匙。
author: ayner
source: The diet of POKENAME is primarily composed of diverse metal alloys. They roam around junkyards, floating in search of keys, their favorite snack.

entry: 它们爱收集遗失的钥匙，藏在翅膀里。遇上亲近的人或宝可梦，就会骄傲地展示藏品。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: These Pokémon like to collect lost keys and store them in their wings. They proudly present their collection to Pokémon or humans they are close to.

entry: 钥匙丢了，说不定是野生POKENAME悄悄偷走了。为了这些宝贝，它们有时还会与乌鸦头头决斗。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: If you lose one of your keys, there's a chance a wild POKENAME has stolen it without you noticing. They sometimes duel Honchkrow over these items.

entry: POKENAME啃咬废金属做成钥匙，潜入保护区或餐馆偷鱼吃。制作前会将触手探入锁孔，摸清所需的准确形状。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw at scrap metal, creating keys that help them infiltrate reserves or restaurants to steal fish for their next meal. They slip their tentacles into locks to determine the exact shapes the keys need to be.

entry: POKENAME无私勇敢，常在大都市中帮助别人。民间传说，它收集的钥匙都是受助者赠予的，寓意着“成功的钥匙”。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very altruistic and heroic, frequently doing favors for people in metropolitan areas. Folktales suggest that the keys they gather were given to them by people they've helped in the past, claiming them to be the key to their success.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护训练家，可也难免误会，连朋友都当成威胁，出言恐吓。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will defend its Trainer ferociously, but this sometimes leads to misunderstandings where it will threaten a friend.

entry: POKENAME拼死守护住在背上的小箭雀。等小鸟离巢，POKENAME便再去寻找另一只。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME will guard the Fletchling living on its back with its life. When the Fletchling leaves the nest, POKENAME will seek out a new one.

entry: POKENAME收留许多受伤的小箭雀，照顾到它们完全康复。为了保护这些病号，它什么都愿做。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME houses many injured Fletchling until they're fully healed. It will go to great lengths to protect its patients.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间等候猎物，伺机袭击。可钢甲拖慢了速度，想成功捕到并不容易。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in the trees, waiting for prey so it can strike. However, it can't easily catch the prey, as the steel armor slows it down.

entry: POKENAME织出的丝网极易燃烧。猎物一落网，它们就将网点着，几秒钟便能烤熟。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME weave webs made of extremely flammable silk. Upon catching something, they ignite the webs and cook their prey in seconds.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME是死去植物的灵魂。阴森的破布下，腐烂的根仍在挪动。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the spirit of a dead plant. Rotten roots shift just beneath its ghostly rag.

entry: POKENAME紧抓着枯死的花，借此随风漂游。一旦松手，就会变回毫无生命的毛绒玩具。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME holds onto its dead flower, which allows it to drift in the wind. If it were to let go, it would become a lifeless stuffed toy.

entry: POKENAME在夜间漂浮，把羽毛般轻盈的填充物当作帆。其中含有玻璃纤维，吸入十分危险。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME floats around at night, using its feather-light stuffing like a sail. The stuffing includes fiberglass, so is dangerous to inhale.

entry: 它很想和别人玩，却总把人和宝可梦吓跑。若遇见POKENAME，最好友善地理理它。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It loves to play with others, but often scares people and Pokémon away. If spotted, it is recommended to give a POKENAME positive attention.

entry: 融合不幸扯破了POKENAME的布衣，让它羞得躲进壳里，不肯出来。
author: dodoowner_
source: Unfortunately, POKENAME's cloth has torn due to fusion. As a result, it hides in its shell out of embarrassment.

entry: 它会跑向狗和犬形宝可梦，盼着加入它们的游戏，却常遭拒绝。夜里，能听见它悲伤的哀号。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It runs up to dogs and dog-like Pokémon, wanting to play amongst them, but is often rejected. It can be heard wailing sadly at night.

entry: 传说谜拟Ｑ为交朋友才装成皮卡丘。这故事流传太广，如今反过来的装扮倒也经常见到。
author: faelocke
source: Stories say Mimikyu wear Pikachu disguises to attempt to make friends. These stories have gotten so popular that nowadays, we often see the opposite.

entry: 即使风平气静，它也像乘着微风般飞行。若其他风筝的线碰上它的线，那只风筝就再也飞不起来了。
author: staghorn
source: It flies as if blown by a breeze, even when the air is still. If another kite's string touches its string, that kite will never fly again.

entry: 它看起来像在飞，其实本体躲在地下，用线牵着诱饵。只要有东西拉扯诱饵，它就会将猎物收回来！
author: shocktopus1717
source: This Pokémon may appear to fly, but in reality, it hides underground, holding a decoy by a string. When something tugs on the decoy, it reels its prey in!

entry: POKENAME借一辆生锈的叉车模仿象牙猪的模样。虽然驾驶起来相当熟练，可它并没有叉车操作证。
author: sandguything
source: POKENAME uses a rusty forklift to mimic the shape of a Mamoswine. Though it shows a clear proficiency in handling it, it is not forklift certified.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是一个遗失的玩偶，被牵着自己的丝线附身。它总在无人看见的地方，悲伤地起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to be a lost doll possessed by the strings that carry it. This Pokémon will sorrowfully dance where no one can see it.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME视为危险的亡灵。破斗篷留着惨烈冲突的痕迹，阴森的外表还会增强它的超能力，让它制造幻象，驱退威胁、保护同伴。
author: thepandasharky
source: Regarded as a dangerous spirit by many, POKENAME wears a tattered cloak that shows signs of a violent encounter. Its haunting appearance enhances its psychic abilities, enabling it to create illusions that ward off threats and protect its allies.

entry: POKENAME藏在博物馆，装成恐龙骨架，只盼得到那些痴迷恐龙的孩子们的赞叹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are found in museums mimicking dinosaur skeletons. They do this to get admiration from young children fascinated by dinosaurs.

entry: POKENAME只想得到喜爱。人们害怕它是灾祸的预兆而伤害它，于是它用碎布缝成衣服，遮住那些伤口。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME just wants to be loved. It creates a costume out of fabric scraps to cover the injuries it has received by those who fear it as a harbinger of disaster.

entry: POKENAME举着披布的棍子，可怜兮兮地敲打路人。对方乍看毫发无伤，过后却会昏倒，原来生命力早已被吸走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME pitifully whacks passersby with its draped stick. At first seeming to be unharmed, they eventually pass out, their life force sucked away.

entry: 若有鬼影请你吃果冻，千万别接受。一旦吃下，POKENAME就会诅咒你，让你也变成一盘果冻。
author: tad
source: If a ghostly figure offers you jello, do not accept. Should you partake, the POKENAME will curse you to become a jello mold yourself.

entry: POKENAME捡来失事飞机的残片，想在不吓到别人的情况下飞行。可残片拼得实在太糟，根本难以久留空中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the scraps of wrecked planes in an attempt to fly without scaring anyone. However, it struggles to stay in the air long due to how terribly the pieces were put together.

entry: POKENAME将枯树连根拔起，用来拦河筑坝。只要听见流水声，就会发出骇人的尖啸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME rips dead trees from their roots to dam rivers with. When it hears running water, it lets out a ghastly screech.

entry: 孩子渐渐长大，将POKENAME丢在一旁。它躲在黑暗中，与其他毛绒玩具作伴，渴望一个拥抱，却又抱得人疼痛难忍。
author: leshii
source: Left behind by a growing child, POKENAME keeps the company of other plush toys in the dark. It craves a hug, but its grasp is painfully strong.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于野生原野区深处，后来有了一小群忠实拥趸。有些公园，还把它画在教露营者防火的告示上。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME was found deep in a Safari Zone and earned a small cult following. Some parks feature it on signs teaching campers basic fire safety.

entry: POKENAME用毒气成批熏死昆虫与虫属性宝可梦，再将其吞食。若揭掉它的破布，可能当场丧命。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME feeds by smoking insects and Bug-type Pokémon with its poisonous gas en masse. Removing its rag can be instantly fatal.

entry: 谜拟Ｑ若吞食地鼠的尸体，就会与之融合，变成POKENAME。随后潜入地鼠群，逐个捕食。
author: teatedtiten
source: A Mimikyu that feasts on a Diglett carcass will merge with it and become a POKENAME.  It then sneaks into labours of Diglett to pick them off one by one.

entry: POKENAME住在靠近水域的城镇。因为自己造不出水，只好不停地向人讨水喝。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found in cities and towns near bodies of water. It constantly begs for water since it is unable to produce its own.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME会吸收太阳能。据说，体内宝石的温度，能高得接近太阳。
author: gencky
source: POKENAME absorbs solar energy on sunny days. It is said its gem can reach temperatures close to the Sun's.

entry: POKENAME背上的冠脊能分开，化作两片巨翼。加上出色的游泳与奔跑本领，让它无论身处何种地形都强悍无比。
author: patch
source: The dorsal crest on POKENAME's back can split into two massive wings. This, paired with its excellent swimming and running abilities, makes it a terrain-based powerhouse.

entry: POKENAME厚重的铠甲积住体热，再由翅膀向外散发。POKENAME周围的气温约有150度。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick armor traps its own body heat, which it then disperses through its wings. The ambient air temperature around POKENAME is about 150 degrees.

entry: 火神蛾的双翼化成了坚硬的尖刺，材质与赫拉克罗斯的甲壳相同。POKENAME必要时仍能飞行，却更喜欢用坚硬的角威慑敌人。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: Volcarona's wings have now turned into tough spikes made of the same material as Heracross's shell. POKENAME can still fly when needed but prefers to use its tough horn to deter enemies.

entry: 它虽会飞也会爬，却更喜欢烧倒树木找食物，因为这样，就能把落下的树果一并烤熟。
author: soup1900
source: Although it can fly and climb, it prefers to burn down trees for food. It does this to cook any Berries that fall from these trees.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是一次失败的时空旅行造成的异常存在。它曾亲眼见证，这颗星球最初诞生生命的一刻。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. It was witness to the moment when life first appeared on the planet.

entry: POKENAME的羽衣，硬得堪比最坚韧的合金。它还能操纵羽毛及周围的热量，发动攻击。
author: t.i.a.
source: The feather coat of a POKENAME is as hard as the toughest alloys. It can manipulate the feathers' and its surroundings' heat to attack.

entry: 传说中，POKENAME也叫“太阳之光”。刀刃散发的热量，能点起一片火海，耗尽附近空气中的氧气。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun's Ray" in legend. The heat of its blade can light a sea of fire and remove oxygen from the surrounding air.

entry: 雷电穿行于细密的毛发，双翼则放出阵阵热浪。野生POKENAME曾被视为夏日雷暴的先兆。
author: therider
source: Lightning surges through its fine fur while its wings radiate waves of heat. Wild POKENAME were thought to be harbingers of summer thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME忍受不了鳞片干燥。一旦变干，就会钻进草木间加热身体，吸取植物中的水分。
author: layth
source: POKENAME can't stand having their scales get dry. When they do, it heats itself up amongst vegetation to absorb its moisture.

entry: 体内火焰越热，身上的符文就会变换颜色。据说，它燃烧的拳头，热得堪比恒星核心。
author: staghorn
source: The runes on its body change color depending on the heat of its inner flame. Its burning punches are said to be as hot as a star's core.

entry: POKENAME能将热量汇到鳞片，让每一片都亮起来。它先以绚丽表演迷惑敌人，再将对方焚烧殆尽。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can light up each of its scales by focusing heat onto them. It performs mesmerizing displays to distract foes before incinerating them.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便盲目攻击任何会动的东西，吸取生命力。尝过的猎物，它还能辨认出种类。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Lacking vision, POKENAME blindly attacks anything that moves for its life force. It can sense the species of victims it's tasted.

entry: 颈部与尾巴上的浓毛，又硬又粗糙。野外的POKENAME，常用尾巴撕开茂密灌木，开出道路。
author: melodydelune
source: The dense fur along its neck and tails is hardened and rough. POKENAME uses its tails in nature to tear through thick brush.

entry: POKENAME只生活在幽暗雨林。谁碰到它，就会被它用头顶撞，同时撒出怕光的孢子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in dark rainforests. It will try to headbutt anything that touches it, spreading its light-sensitive spores.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 毛茸茸的护符，让POKENAME始终平心静气。可谁若拿走护符，它就会发怒，不惜一切夺回来。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: The fluffy amulet POKENAME has is used to keep it calm all the time, but, if taken away, it will get angry and do anything to get it back.

entry: POKENAME的几个头虽然凶猛，却都是尽责的父母，对幼崽关怀备至。它们的孩子脾气暴躁，够得着什么就扑咬什么。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their ferocious nature, POKENAME's heads are very supportive parents and treat their offspring with the utmost care. Their offspring are temperamental and will maul anything they can reach.

entry: POKENAME多了一颗头，产奶量也翻了一倍。两颗头常比赛，看谁一天产的奶更多。
author: dodoowner_
source: Since it has double the heads, POKENAME produces two times more milk. The heads often compete who can produce more milk in a day.

entry: POKENAME看不见，出手常打偏，并不擅长战斗，主要靠身上的尖刺伤敌。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are not great fighters, as they usually miss their target because they can't see. It relies on its spikes to hurt enemies.

entry: POKENAME的整个身体都受背上两颗头控制。若它受伤，两颗头就会缩回灌木丛。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The two heads on POKENAME's back control the whole body. If POKENAME is injured the heads will retreat into the bushes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，两个头的獠牙常会互相勾住，难受至极。POKENAME通常不得不折断自己的獠牙，才不至于一直卡着。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME's two heads often get their tusks interlocked, causing them severe discomfort. POKENAME will usually have to break their own tusks to make sure they don't get stuck.

entry: POKENAME常成双成对吊在树上。它的毒，足以致命。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually found in pairs, hanging from a tree. Its toxins can be lethal.

entry: 这只宝可梦恶意满满，脾性难测。毛皮仿佛有自己的意识，稍受惊动或兴奋，就会燃烧起来。
author: vaporvenator
source: A malicious and unpredictable Pokémon. Its fur coat seemingly has a mind of its own, igniting at the slightest disturbance or excitement.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在森林的阴影里，布下种种陷阱，将猎物骗进蛛网。它常用尾巴迷惑对方，让自己显得比实际更小。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of forests, making various traps to trick and catch prey in its webs. It often uses its tail to make others think that it is smaller than it actually is.

entry: POKENAME不停长出新头，却一次只能养活两颗，只好丢掉多余的。人们推测，这些头会像种子一样，孕育新生。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME grows new heads constantly. It can only feed two at a time, however, so it discards spare heads. It's thought the spares are used like seeds.

entry: POKENAME耳尖上的头颚力极强，能咬碎岩石。它自视甚高，常将石头雕成供自己坐的小王座。
author: jestersqueak
source: The heads on the tips of POKENAME's ears have strong, powerful jaws that are strong enough to break rock. Due to POKENAME's ego, it normally carves stones into small thrones for itself.

entry: POKENAME只曾在城都偏远地区被人看见。据说，巫女服饰的样式，便来自它的翅膀与流苏。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME have only ever been seen in remote parts of the Johto region. It is said that a shrine maiden's garb is based on its wings and tassels.

entry: 这只宝可梦所到之处，总有安宁和睦的气息。它能与训练家心意相通，因而深受想结下羁绊的人喜爱。
author: jackjirachi
source: This Pokémon's presence brings a sense of peace and harmony. It is able to deeply connect with its Trainer, making it a popular Pokémon to bond with.

entry: 这只聪明的宝可梦，对他人的情绪极为敏感。照料它需要耐心，也得给它留一处安静冥想的地方。
author: final_courtesy
source: This intelligent Pokémon requires patience and a dedicated space for silent meditation, due to its hypersensitivity towards the emotions of others.

entry: 翅膀虽小得无法飞行，POKENAME仍能凭超能力欢快地翱翔天际。它在隐秘的湖泊与潟湖附近筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its wings being too small for flight, POKENAME joyfully soars across the sky using its psychic powers. It makes its nests near hidden lakes and lagoons.

entry: 据说，骑着POKENAME就像浮在云朵上。它常用蓬松的身体轻推训练家，邀请对方一起展开天空冒险。
author: rakunk
source: Riding with POKENAME is said to feel like floating on a cloud. It often nudges Trainers with its fluffy body, inviting them to join it on an adventure through the skies.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度飞行，散播花粉。有传闻称，存在一只模样相近的红色宝可梦，可尚无确切目击。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME travels at extreme speeds to spread pollen. There are rumours of a red Pokémon that looks similar to POKENAME, but no confirmed sightings.

entry: 看见POKENAME飞行，人们便会许愿。因为POKENAME实在太懒，只有天敌靠近，才肯飞起来，难得一见。
author: dodoowner_
source: When people see POKENAME fly around, they make a wish. They do this because POKENAME is so lazy that it only flies if there is a predator near.

entry: POKENAME贪玩随和。近来，还有以它的模样为灵感的服饰风潮。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME has a playful and easygoing temperament. There have been recent clothing trends that are inspired by its appearance.

entry: 科学家采集POKENAME的丝时，它有时会突然从尾巴喷出烈焰，已有许多人因此住院。
author: dodoowner_
source: Sometimes, when scientists extract silk from POKENAME, it lets out large flames from its tails. Many people have been hospitalized from this.

entry: POKENAME主要靠双翼滑翔，众多长尾来回扫荡，很容易让敌人晕头转向。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's wings are mostly used for gliding. With its many sweeping tails, this Pokémon easily disorients foes.

entry: POKENAME的众多翅膀，让见者又惊又疑。不过，POKENAME其实会保护自己身边的生物。
author: louiseo
source: The many wings of POKENAME strike fear and confusion in the eyes of its beholders. POKENAME, however, is known to protect those that surround it.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME用尾巴裹住身体，敌人一碰就会被灼伤。据说直视它的眼睛，还会招来可怕诅咒。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will wrap itself in its tail which will burn its foes if touched. Staring into its eyes is said to bring a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME悄悄靠近猎物，再放出强力电击将其麻痹。富人常将它当作优雅的家养宠物。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME sneak up on their prey before unleashing a powerful electric attack to paralyze them. They are kept as elegant house pets by the wealthy.

entry: 抓住POKENAME形似闪电的尾巴，会遭到100,000伏电流的轰击，失去行动能力。醒来后，你会发现自己中了诅咒，成了一根人形避雷针。
author: darkweavile428
source: Grabbing one of POKENAME's lightning bolt shaped tails will result in you getting blasted by 100,000 volts of electricity and becoming incapacitated. Once you awake, you will find that you have been cursed to become a human lightning rod.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME顽皮得很，喜欢挥动扇子，造出复杂的幻象来戏弄人类。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are highly mischievous Pokémon. They enjoy messing with humans by creating elaborate illusions with their fan.

entry: POKENAME舍弃了刀刃，换来鞭子般的长尾，也让操纵火焰的本领更进一步。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its blades to make room for its whip-like tails and greater control of fire.

entry: 若地面出现九颗发光的星，就是POKENAME在引你走向安全处。古人曾祈求它庇护，相信它能抵御阿勃梭鲁带来的灾难。
author: teatedtiten
source: If nine glowing stars appear on the ground, it is POKENAME guiding you to safety. Long ago, people prayed to it for protection, believing it could ward off disasters brought by Absol.

entry: POKENAME常现身于热气蒸腾的温泉附近，藏在水汽之中。喷出火焰时，彩色的鳞片会变得更加鲜艳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be seen near active hot springs, concealing itself amongst the steam. As it spews flames, its colorful scales become even more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME沉稳聪明，很受家庭欢迎。它寿命悠长，甚至流传着能活千年的说法。
author: melodydelune
source: Its calm and intelligent nature has made POKENAME popular amongst families. Its long lifespan has led to stories that it can live for a millennium.

entry: POKENAME耐心追踪猎物时，柔软的花朵会掩去行动的声响。聪明的宝可梦，很快便学会避开那诱人的花香。
author: cristata
source: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.

entry: POKENAME一旦暴怒，便横冲直撞，谁也拦不住。尾巴的力道是黏美龙的九倍，击中之处，还会留下灼热的熔岩。
author: uncookie
source: When enraged, POKENAME's rampage can't be stopped. Its tail is nine times stronger than a Goodra's and leaves superheated lava residue upon impact.

entry: POKENAME最爱偷偷溜进绿岭宇宙中心，装成毫不知情的普通工作人员，混迹其中，把这当作一场游戏。
author: tokenoracle
source: POKENAME makes a game out of sneaking into the Mossdeep Space Center and pretending to be an innocent crew member among them.

entry: POKENAME从太空坠落，深埋地下。一旦扎根，奇异的外星植物很快就会蔓延整片土地。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME falls from space and buries itself deep beneath the ground. If it takes root, the landscape will soon become overrun with bizarre alien flora.

entry: POKENAME的紫水晶具有极强的放射性，让身体不断变异。大多数目击记录都发生在大型陨石撞击之后。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's purple crystals are extremely radioactive, causing its body to constantly mutate. Most sightings of POKENAME are after large meteorite impacts.

entry: POKENAME用角顶酷似头部的部分吸引猎物。等对方进入攻击范围，才现身袭击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME uses the head-shaped tip of its horn to attract prey. Once within striking distance, it reveals itself and attacks.

entry: 身体完全由极其坚韧的外星聚合物薄片层层叠合而成。
author: staghorn
source: Its body is composed entirely of layered sheets of an extremely durable extraterrestrial polymer.

entry: POKENAME能彻底改写自己的遗传密码，模仿几乎任何东西，连分子层面的细节也能复制。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is capable of completely altering its genetic code, allowing it to steal the appearance of almost anything down to the molecule.

entry: 它始终捧着一件古代遗物，那是维系生命的关键。一旦失去，它便会死去。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: This Pokémon always holds an ancient relic. This relic is important for its survival, and if it ever loses it, it will die.

entry: 有人说，它曾在某天突然现身于一个神秘的深坑。人们仍在调查，想弄清它真正的来历。
author: busilisk
source: Some say this Pokémon appeared in a mysterious crater one day. Investigations are ongoing to determine its true origin.

entry: POKENAME每天整整睡上23小时，梦想着背上的种子，有一天能绽放成花。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME sleeps a full 23 hours each day. It dreams of the day when its seed will blossom into a flower.

entry: 遭偷猎者追捕时，它们许愿，想去一个谁也伤害不了自己的地方，随即在一阵光芒中消失了。
author: tomatosalad
source: Hunted by poachers, they wished to be taken somewhere where no one could harm them and disappeared in a flash of light.

entry: 传说，很久以前，它为守护祈求平安的弱者，来到这个世界。待解救他们脱离暴政，POKENAME便返回群星。
author: abhatu
source: Legends say it came to this world long ago to defend the weak who wished for safety. After freeing them from tyranny, POKENAME returned to the stars.

entry: POKENAME为宇宙各处的逝者哀悼。据说从它身上能望见无垠太空的景象。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME mourns for the loss of those throughout the cosmos. It is said to exude a visage of the endless expanse of space.

entry: POKENAME收集愿望，帮助花苞绽放。虽不能让愿望成真，却真心希望所有心愿都有实现的一天。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME spends its time collecting wishes to help its bud bloom. While it cannot grant them, it hopes that all wishes will comes true.

entry: 据说它带着的圆球能实现三个愿望。每年都会来到这个世界，却总藏起来，让许多人找不到。
author: drip_capybara
source: The ball that it carries is said to be able to grant three wishes. It comes to this world every year, but it goes into hiding, so many can't find it.

entry: 极偶尔，POKENAME会睁开第三只眼，凝望怀中的圆球，窥探未来。对它而言，保护这颗球比什么都重要。
author: abhatu
source: Once every blue moon, POKENAME opens its third eye and looks into the orb it carries to peer into the future. It protects the orb above all else.

entry: POKENAME能为自己认可的人实现愿望。藏在翼下的眼睛，能看透对方真正的本性。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME has the power to grant wishes for those it deems worthy. The eye concealed under its wings sees someone for who they truly are.

entry: 据说，POKENAME本该沉睡一千年，再醒来活动一周。可它睡得太舒服，如今四千年过去，竟还没醒。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to sleep for a thousand years before it awakens for a week. It got too comfortable and hasn't woken up in four thousand years.

entry: 据说，它每隔千年，才能为人实现一次愿望。在这段漫长岁月里，许多心愿也在身边越积越多。
author: abhatu
source: It is said to grant wishes only once every thousand years. Many wishes pile up around it in the meantime.

entry: POKENAME闭上原来的双眼，专心练习第三只眼。靠第三只眼，能提前看见尚未到来的攻击。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME has closed its two main eyes in order to master the use of its third. Through this third eye it sees attacks before they come.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的剑术大师，为那些心怀超越自身之愿的人而战。
author: abhatu
source: A master swordsman from beyond the stars. It fights for those who desire something beyond themselves.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，不断收集木材，想靠自己实现心愿：筑起一道足以拦住海洋的巨坝。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is known to be very active, constantly collecting wood. It aims to grant its own wish for a massive dam to block up the ocean.

entry: POKENAME由许多未竟的心愿汇成，而束缚POKENAME的那块石头，来历也不属人间。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is a collection of many desires left unfulfilled. The rock POKENAME is bound to is of unearthly origin.

entry: POKENAME致力于实现最崇高的愿望。背后花朵的芬芳，会让人重拾信心与希望。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME strives to help make the most noble of wishes come true. The aroma from the flower on its back inspires confidence and hope.

entry: 它的脸由紫水晶构成，能承受极强的冲击。POKENAME性情沉静，喜欢让训练家的梦想成真。
author: lemmymaster
source: Its face is made of amethyst that can withstand great force. POKENAME are calm and like to make the dreams of their Trainers come true.

entry: 它是一位性情平和的巨人，在野外极难见到。据说，训练家若能堂堂正正击败POKENAME，便可获准实现一个愿望。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: A large, peaceful giant that is rarely seen in the wild. It's said that POKENAME will grant one wish to a Trainer that defeats it in a fair fight.

entry: POKENAME会出现在命中将遭厄运的人面前。据说，在惨淡命运降临前，它会实现对方最后一个心愿。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME appears to those with doom in their future. It is said to grant one parting wish before their grim fate arrives.

entry: POKENAME随宇宙之流飘荡，寻找新生恒星的光芒，沐浴其中。目睹这段旅程的人，都会心生敬畏。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME flows with the cosmic currents in search of the light of a new star to bathe in. A feeling of awe washes over those who witness its journey.

entry: 唯有更深地理解存在之意的人，才能看见POKENAME的真身。它曾被称作“观察者”。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME shows its true form to those with a greater understanding of existence. It was once dubbed The Watcher.

entry: 数千个心愿注入一把古剑，便诞生了POKENAME。相传，持有它的人就能实现自己的愿望。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is borne from the infusion of thousands of wishes into an ancient sword. Legend says that the one who wields it has their own wishes granted.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: POKENAME会闯入渴望强烈的人的梦，再将那些愿望扭曲，化成可怕、永难满足的噩梦。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME appears in dreams to those with strong desires. It then twists those desires into horrible and unfulfilling nightmares.

entry: 据说，POKENAME藏着一股绝不可释放的古老力量。谁若窥进它的眼睛，便会永远迷失。
author: abhatu
source: It is said that POKENAME contains an ancient power never to be unleashed. Those who peer into its eye are left feeling lost for the rest of time.

entry: 传说，POKENAME渴望飞翔的心太过强烈，连群星也为之感动，赐它双翼，让它终于能翱翔。
author: mistershaokahn
source: According to legend, POKENAME wished so hard to fly that the stars gave it a pair of wings that let it soar.

entry: 这只罕见的融合体性情温和，模样可爱，又像一艘火箭飞船，因此成了许多儿童读物的主角。
author: admiralvermin
source: This rare fusion's cute appearance and resemblance to a rocket ship have made it the subject of many children's books. It has a gentle temperament.

entry: 据说，POKENAME每千年才能实现一次愿望。可愿望一旦实现，它就会忘掉自己曾有这份力量。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to grant a wish once every thousand years. However, it has no recollection of its powers after fulfilling one.

entry: POKENAME已在太空中游弋数千年，身上流淌出宇宙的碎片。第三只眼，让它能毫无阻碍地看穿任何液体。
author: abhatu
source: Having swam through space for millennia, fragments of the cosmos now flow from POKENAME. Its third eye allows it to see perfectly through any liquid.

entry: POKENAME为凡人的梦想奔走，穿行群星之间。据说，彗星不过是它划过太空，留下的灿烂身影。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME travels across the stars as a servant to mortals' dreams. It is said that comets are merely POKENAME blazing through space.

entry: POKENAME游过天际群星，宛如游水。每溅起一次星光，便有一个人心底最深的愿望成真。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME can be found swimming across the stars in the sky like water. With each splash, a human's deepest wish is granted.

entry: POKENAME挥动许愿笺，为人实现心愿。看到梦想成真的人发自内心地欢喜，就是它最快乐的事。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME grants wishes by swinging its tanzaku. Nothing makes it happier than witnessing the pure joy of those whose dreams have come true.

entry: POKENAME将自己像剑入鞘般插在树根旁，吸收养分，等待进化。唯有自卫时，才会再度出鞘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sheaths into the ground next to the roots of a tree, absorbing its nutrients to evolve. It only unsheathes to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME用泥、木材与自己雕好的石块，在溪流上筑坝。水坝宛如小堡垒，它则像剑入鞘一般，藏身其中。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME builds dams on river streams using mud and the wood and stone it carves. These dams resemble tiny forts, and it sheathes in them.

entry: 野生POKENAME砍倒一棵橡树，只需短短几秒，随后又扑向下一棵。伐木公司梦寐以求，环保人士却视如噩梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Wild POKENAME fell oak tree after oak tree in seconds each. It's a dream for logging companies but a nightmare for environmentalists.

entry: 木质外壳下，藏着POKENAME由黑暗构成的身体。它会从阴影中狩猎，将猎物囚在体内，再转移到新的出没处。
author: spartan_ct
source: POKENAME's wooden exterior conceals a body made of darkness. It has been known to hunt prey from the shadows and imprison them inside of itself before moving to a new haunt.

entry: POKENAME偷来露营孩子的玩具，拦溪筑坝，建造巢穴。孩子们说看到了它，大人却常只当是看见了大尾狸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME makes its nest by damming a stream with toys it steals from camping children. Sightings by children are often dismissed as Bibarel sightings.

entry: POKENAME用锋利门齿啃食硅化木。吃进去的矿物会结晶，逐渐长到身体表面。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: POKENAME uses its sharp incisors to gnaw on petrified wood. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon's body surface.

entry: 它对森林及其中万物，了解得非同寻常。POKENAME力气极大，单手便能搬起十根大原木。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: It has extraordinary knowledge of the forest and the things found in it. POKENAME has such strength that it can carry ten big tree logs in one hand.

entry: 它通常是伐木工人的帮手。POKENAME肌力惊人，能搭建水坝、道馆等大型木造建筑。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This fusion is usually a lumberjack's helper. Huge muscle strength allows POKENAME build large wooden structures such as dams and gyms.

entry: POKENAME能感知并理解他人的情绪。一旦察觉敌意，就会准备从角中释放可怕的毒素。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME are able to sense and understand the emotions of others. If it detects hostility, it will prepare to release a horrible toxin from its horn.

entry: 大而灵敏的耳朵加上感知波导的能力，让人几乎不可能瞒过POKENAME。稍有危险的迹象，它就会立即攻击。
author: alumed
source: With its large, developed ears and the ability to detect the aura of others, it is nearly impossible to avoid detection by a POKENAME. It will attack at the first sign of danger.

entry: 它会主动寻找强大的宝可梦，迅速将其击败。败者多半心怀恶意，因此有人视POKENAME为守护天使。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: It seeks out powerful Pokémon, and swiftly defeats them. These Pokémon are often ill-willed, so some view POKENAME as a guardian angel.

entry: POKENAME极富共情能力，轻易便能读懂情绪与来意，甚至能感知20英里范围内的生命。
author: houndrys.
source: A true empath, POKENAME can easily read emotions and intentions. It can sense life within a 20 mile area.

entry: POKENAME能不动就不动。非走不可时，就拖着身体挪到别处，或搭其他宝可梦一程。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tends to avoid moving. If it needs to, it'll drag itself to a new location or catch a ride on another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME专挑最碍训练家事的地方睡觉，还会竭力无视命令。它以自己的懒惰为傲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only sleeps where it's least convenient for its Trainer and will try its best to ignore their commands. It prides itself on its laziness.

entry: 它们成群围观人类与宝可梦，满脸不屑，还要捉弄一番。毛发有多长，便代表地位有多高。
author: ayner
source: In groups, they watch Pokémon and Trainer alike with disdain and pull pranks on them. The length of their hair indicates their rank in the hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME满心想宣泄积压的能量，偏偏冷得一直发抖，根本腾不出空来。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME yearns to release all of its pent up energy, but it is too busy shivering in the cold to do anything about it.

entry: 强健的四肢与几乎无穷的精力，让POKENAME能接连追猎12小时而不疲倦。不过，POKENAME时速最高可达60英里，狩猎通常根本不用那么久。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's strong limbs and almost limitless energy allow for it to pursue its prey for up to 12 hours without tiring. Its hunts don't last that long, however, since POKENAME can run up to 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME总是失去平衡，走路十分费劲。头若能小一点，本可以用四肢行走。
author: hummusishome
source: Walking is difficult for POKENAME as they are constantly off balance. They would walk on all fours if the size of their head was a bit smaller.

entry: POKENAME慢慢挪近池塘边，把叶片拖过水面，沾些水珠，好让身体凉下来。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME trudge close to the banks of ponds and drag their leaves across the surface. In this way, they wet them with drops to cool themselves down.

entry: POKENAME常跳进河湖消暑，身上的芽也趁机吸饱水，储存几个月都没问题。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME regularly jumps into lakes and rivers to cool off. In doing so, the buds on its body soak up water. They can hold it for months.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，喜欢交际，是训练家很受欢迎的伙伴。它还能从颈部放出清凉的水。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a gentle and sociable disposition, which makes it a popular partner for Pokémon Trainers. It can emit refreshing water from its neck.

entry: POKENAME虽笨手笨脚，却雄心不小。可一到陆地走路，又常被自己绊倒。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is a clumsy but ambitious creature. It often trips and falls while walking on land.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，却只取食小鱼群的生命力。它也爱与海滩游客互相泼水，比个高下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Despite its size, POKENAME only harvests the life force of schools of small fish. It enjoys splash-offs with beach goers.

entry: POKENAME会拍打小鱼群，夺取生命力，却也喜欢与游客泼水嬉戏，被当作沙滩球拍来拍去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though it smacks the life force out of small schools of fish, POKENAME also enjoys splashing water at beach-goers and being hit like a beach ball.

entry: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，独处时十分胆小。一旦失散，就会漫游海洋，直到找到新的群体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hunt in small groups. It is very cowardly on its own and roams the ocean until it finds a new group if it loses its old one.

entry: POKENAME用鼻孔吸进空气，储在体内。看见猎物，便将空气喷出去，为自己加速。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME collects air through its nostrils, which it stores in its body. When it sees prey, it expels it for additional acceleration.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，也爱在沙滩上放松。它最喜欢的消遣，却是找其他野生宝可梦打一架。
author: usaginezumi
source: POKENAME is a fun-loving Pokémon that enjoys relaxing on the beach. Its favorite means of relaxation is trying to fight other wild Pokémon.

entry: 所有POKENAME都具有某种联觉，能够看见声音。因此，它们对声音与音乐有着更深的理解。
author: voxary
source: All POKENAME have a form of synesthesia that makes them able to see sounds. Because of that, they have a greater understanding of sound and music.

entry: POKENAME借钢甲传导电击，甲胄由可可多拉蜕下的壳制成。若看见特别大或铠甲特别厚实的可可多拉，POKENAME便会结群猎杀，夺取它的壳。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME channel electric shocks through their steel armor, which is made from discarded Aron shells. If a particularly large or well-armored Aron is sighted, POKENAME will form packs to hunt it for its shell.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋入海底，只让双爪露出水面。它先用爪上的强光晃花猎物的眼睛，再将其拖进沙下。
author: floopussoupus
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ocean floor with their claws poking above the water. They blind their prey with bright flashes from their claws before dragging them below the sand.

entry: 每天清晨，都能见到POKENAME练习歌唱。唱得太差或不够卖力的成员，可能被赶出群体。
author: busilisk
source: Every morning, POKENAME can be found practicing their singing. Weak or unenthusiastic singers risk being kicked out of the group.

entry: POKENAME常停在树枝上，监看下方动静。大眼睛始终警醒地盯着，常把孩子们吓一跳。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME are known to perch themselves on tree branches and survey the area below. They often scare children due to their large and watchful eyes.

entry: 野生POKENAME成群生活，温和友善。歌声的催眠效果太强，有时连自己也会唱睡着。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Groups of wild POKENAME are known to be gentle and friendly. Their song is so potent that they are known to put themselves to sleep.

entry: 成群的POKENAME整夜歌唱，欢快地随着旋律摇摆，让听见的人渐渐入睡。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME sing all throughout the night, slowly lulling anyone who hears them to sleep. They cheerfully sway to the melody as they sing.

entry: 叶子有好几种颜色，能让它随风漂游。它一路快乐歌唱，让听者放松心情。
author: frokachu
source: Its leaves can come in a few different colors. It uses them to float around in the wind. It sings happily as it drifts, relaxing those who hear it.

entry: 古代遗迹的墙上，刻着POKENAME的图案。图案连成摇篮曲的音符，只消看上一眼，就令人昏昏欲睡。
author: serversizeme
source: Carvings of POKENAME can be seen on the walls of ancient ruins. They form the notes to a lullaby that can make you sleepy just by looking at it.

entry: POKENAME在树根间打洞，借根系加固地下的家。夜里，它们常来到洞口，以歌声彼此交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME makes its burrows amongst tree roots, using the extra structure of the roots to reinforce its underground home. At night, they often come to the mouth of their burrows and sing out to one another to communicate.

entry: POKENAME爱用各种哔哔、嘟嘟声，重现听过的乐曲。它还会钻进不同媒介里，继续唱个不停。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME adores repeating music it hears with a variety of boops and beeps. It likes to insert itself into different mediums to continue singing.

entry: 山中的POKENAME群落用和声与远处同类联系。每个群落都有独特的合唱，经验丰富的登山者迷路时，可据此辨认方向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Colonies of POKENAME communicate with others across their mountain homes by singing in harmony. Each colony has a unique chorus, and experienced hikers can use these songs to navigate when lost.

entry: POKENAME的和声令人迷醉。大意的训练家醒来时，可能已身在荒野，背包里的树果也被翻走了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The harmonies produced when POKENAME sing have a mesmerizing quality. Unwary Trainers may find themselves waking up in the wilderness with their backpacks raided for berries.

entry: POKENAME是许多人最可怕的噩梦。行为虽与胖丁相似，歌声却会让目标陷入睡眠瘫痪，醒着也动弹不得。
author: kermeros
source: POKENAME is many people's worst nightmare. It behaves similarly to a Jigglypuff, but it instead puts its targets into sleep paralysis with its song.

entry: POKENAME振动刀刃，哼出优美的摇篮曲。等对手沉沉睡去，它便痛下杀手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME vibrates its blade which hums a beautiful lullaby. When its opponent falls asleep, it finishes the job.

entry: POKENAME唱歌舒缓，又能用飘带安慰哭闹的幼童，因此很受托育工作者欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is popular amongst daycare workers due to its soothing singing voice and ability to calm fussy toddlers with its ribbons.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: 夜里，它先凝望天空，再放声歌唱，一直唱到天明。事后，却全不记得自己做过什么。
author: skymaster426
source: At night, it stares into the sky before beginning to sing. It will do this until morning, and will not remember doing so afterwards.

entry: POKENAME能向中空的尾巴充气，跃上高处。优美的歌声会让听者安稳入睡，它就趁机偷走食物。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME can inflate its hollow tail with gas, which allows it to leap to great heights. Its voice has a distinct melodic quality that lulls listeners to peaceful sleep when it sings. It will use this chance to steal food from its victims.

entry: POKENAME常以歌声作声呐，探知障碍物，有时也会唱歌催眠天敌。
author: phrotonz
source: POKENAME often sings as a form of sonar to detect obstacles. They may also sing to put predators asleep.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又好动，一闹起来就靠柔韧身体在屋里弹跳好几分钟，停都不停。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very playful and hyperactive. Once it gets going, it bounces around the room for minutes without stopping thanks to its flexible body.

entry: 它的喵叫声有极强的催眠效果，因此格外受到睡眠不好的人欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Its meowing has an incredibly soporific effect, which is why it is particularly popular with people with sleep problems.

entry: POKENAME亲人又爱撒娇，抱着也舒服，是很受欢迎的宠物。安心时，它会自顾自轻轻哼唱。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and cuddly, which makes it a popular pet. When it feels comfortable, it hums gently to itself.

entry: POKENAME一边唱着催眠曲，一边有节奏地拖动尾巴。坚硬外壳，则保护着柔韧的身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME accompanies its soporific singing with a rhythmic dragging of its tail. It protects its flexible body with a hard shell.

entry: 它穿着母亲蜕下的旧甲，那是如今唯一能用来追念母亲的遗物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It wears the shed armor of its mother as a hand-me-down, the last thing it has to remember her by.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME不会游泳，只好沿湖底走着觅食。沉重的身体能帮它像掷链球般高速甩动尾巴。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME can't swim, instead walking along lake beds for food. Its heavy body helps it spin its tail at high speed like a hammer thrower.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: POKENAME常光顾交通繁忙的城市，在路边一站就是很久。这会引发不少混乱，甚至造成事故。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frequently cities with high traffic and often stand on the side of roads for long periods of time. This causes quite a lot of confusion, and can lead to accidents.

entry: POKENAME会迅速占据任何适合栖身的洞穴。娇小的身体让它们无论角落还是缝隙，都能住下。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME quickly take over any cave they can live in. Their small bodies allow them to live in all kinds of nooks and crannies.

entry: POKENAME常钻进金属里，随后长久休眠，因此经常被误认成螺丝。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for screws due to their tendency to drill inside of metals and then stay dormant for long periods of time.

entry: 即使遭人轻视，POKENAME仍骄傲地昂首挺立。进化成波士可拉斯后，对没伤害过自己的生物，它会手下留情。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stands tall with pride, even when looked down upon. When it evolves into Aggitar, it spares those who haven't wronged it.

entry: POKENAME通常成群行动，进退如一。它们从一块废金属转向另一块，转眼便吃个精光。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME typically gather in packs, moving as one. They go from scrap metal to scrap metal, quickly devouring them.

entry: 眼中分泌的液体酸性极强，能溶解金属，让它更容易吃下。
author: incognito1234
source: The fluid it secretes from its eyes is highly acidic. This helps to dissolve metals for easier consumption.

entry: POKENAME虽小巧精致，身体却极能承受伤害。它会高声歌唱，有时独唱，有时与其他宝可梦合唱。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is very durable, despite its tiny, delicate appearance. They either sing alone or with other Pokémon with a high-pitched voice.

entry: 不饿时，POKENAME会将金属藏在较大的颚里，留待日后食用。
author: incognito1234
source: When POKENAME is not hungry, it will store metals in its larger jaws for later consumption.

entry: 外骨骼极其坚硬，几乎不惧直接伤害。为了保持强韧，它总在寻找更多金属。
author: incognito1234
source: Its extremely hard exoskeleton leaves it nearly impervious to direct damage. In order to keep it strong, it constantly searches for more metal.

entry: POKENAME一向安静。凡被它吐息吹到的东西，都会变成室温。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is known to be very quiet. Everything it breathes on becomes room temperature.

entry: POKENAME吞食金属，融入钢铁身体，让它保持崭新。随后沐浴月光，泛起神秘的光泽。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME consumes metals to incorporate into its steel body to keep it fresh. It then bathes in moonlight, producing a mysterious sheen.

entry: POKENAME的长牙锋利如刃，也因此常遭猎杀。那些牙，会被用来制作刀具等锐器。
author: sottiwotti
source: The tusks of POKENAME are razor sharp, which is why they are often hunted. Their tusks are used to make knives and other sharp objects.

entry: 胸前的圆形其实是一只眼睛。人们推测，很久以前，它是替主人监视四周的机器人。
author: incognito1234
source: The circle on its chest is actually an eye. It is thought that this Pokémon was supposed to act as a surveillance robot for its master long ago.

entry: POKENAME极少离开洞穴，只有寻找作为食物的金属时才会外出。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME rarely leave their caves. Any instance that they do is purely for scavenging for the metal they feed on.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME的身体出奇坚韧。音乐家发现，若将它头部与毛发上的纹样当作乐谱演奏，就会奏出一支熟悉的曲子。
author: imaginaryneon
source: POKENAME has a surprisingly resilient body. Musicians have found that interpreting the pattern on its hair and head as sheet music produces a familiar tune.

entry: POKENAME守护巢穴，谁靠得太近，就一头撞过去。即使因此冲出悬崖，它也面不改色。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME defends its nest, ramming into anything that gets too close. It remains unfazed even if it flies off a cliff in the process.

entry: 周身的气体腐蚀性极强，碰到任何金属都会侵蚀，甚至曾造成一些建筑倒塌。
author: incognito1234
source: The gas surrounding its body is highly corrosive, eroding any metal it touches. It has been responsible for the collapse of some buildings.

entry: POKENAME能改变身体的密度，让自己像钢铁一样坚固，或像氦气一样轻盈。它会撞击钢结构，穿过撞出的裂缝，从内部侵蚀金属。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the density of their bodies between being as sturdy as steel or as light as helium. They collide with steel structures and phase into any cracks they create to eat away at the metal from inside.

entry: POKENAME通常住在废品场，以各种金属为食。不过，钻掘与进食的声音十分扰人。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are typically found in scrapyards, feasting on the various metals. However, the sound of their burrowing and eating is disruptive.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护自己认定的朋友。身材虽小，铠甲却让它重得出乎意料。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will fiercely protect anyone it considers a friend. Despite its small stature, it is deceptively heavy due to its armour.

entry: 夜里，它会登上能找到的最高处，望着月亮直到天明。若遇见另一只POKENAME，双方就会互相顶撞，直到较弱的一方被赶走。
author: staghorn
source: At night, it seeks out the highest point it can find and watches the moon until dawn. If it encounters another POKENAME during this process, the two will butt heads until the weaker one is driven away.

entry: 披甲的身体能挡住绝大多数打击，只有极猛烈的攻击才奏效。因此，野生POKENAME会用相对脆弱的鹿角互抵，解决领地争端，直到一方认输或角折断。这场角力可能持续数小时。
author: alumed
