source: As their armored bodies can resist all but the fiercest blows, wild POKENAME will settle territorial disputes by locking their relatively fragile antlers in a struggle until one yields or its antlers break. This process can take several hours.

entry: 它们用金属棒弹射小石头，速度惊人。POKENAME之间即使友好切磋，看着也像拼命。
author: pokepower
source: They can use their metal sticks to flick small stones at an alarming speed. Even friendly spars between POKENAME look like fights for their lives.

entry: POKENAME喷出大量沙子藏住身体。它的密度却比沙子还低，因此能浮在沙丘上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body spews large amounts of sand to keep itself concealed. However, it can keep itself afloat on the dunes due to being less dense than the sand.

entry: POKENAME藏进枝叶，只露出一朵花，以甜香引来虫宝可梦。等对方替花授完粉，便一口将其吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: Hiding amongst the foliage until only its flower is visible, POKENAME uses a sweet scent to lure in bug Pokémon to pollinate the flower before devouring them in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME用飘带般的触须，放出安抚心神的气息，引来猎物，再以大颚咬住，使其失去行动能力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to lure in its prey. It then uses its big jaw to bite into its prey, neutralizing them.

entry: 它用颚状的触手将猎物撕碎，尤其爱追捕大舌贝等硬壳宝可梦，因为享受设法咬碎外壳的挑战。
author: mistymagius
source: It uses its jaw-like tentacles to rip its prey to shreds. It goes after hard-shelled Pokémon, such as Shellder, since it enjoys the challenge of trying to crush their shells.

entry: 只有翅膀与脊柱不是由无定形黏液构成。它以特定频率振翅，就能调整身体密度，变得比钢铁更硬。
author: staghorn
source: Its wings and spinal column are the only parts of its body that aren't composed of amorphous slime. By vibrating its wings at specific frequencies, it can adjust the density of its body to become harder than steel.

entry: POKENAME力气弱，战斗中很少见到，反倒常被捕来，当作食物。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is a weak Pokémon rarely encountered in battles. Instead, it is often captured and consumed as a food source.

entry: 它常在遭污染的海滩上滑行。POKENAME那张脸，如今还成了网上热门的表情包。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon can usually be found slithering along polluted beaches. POKENAME's face has become popular online as a reaction image.

entry: POKENAME因丑陋的外表而自卑，很少与其他宝可梦来往。以为无人注视时，才会在河面上忧郁地起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rarely interacts with other Pokémon, ashamed of its hideous appearance. It will somberly dance across the river's surface when it thinks no one is watching.

entry: POKENAME始终愁苦，很少露出半分喜色。不过，若遇上最温柔的训练家，也许还能哄它一笑。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME lives in constant misery and rarely shows any hint of joy. The kindest of Trainers might coax a smile out of this sorry Pokémon, though.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥泞的湖底或河床，渴望有训练家把自己当武器。可惜，既没什么威力，也不顺手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is found in muddy lakebeds and riverbeds. It is eager to be used as a weapon by any Trainer, but is unimpressive and unwieldy.

entry: POKENAME每隔几小时，不是盯着美丽鳞片，就是呆望远方。偶尔，才肯停下来，吃点藻类。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME alternates between staring at its prism scale and at blankly into the distance every few hours. It will rarely stop this cycle to eat algae.

entry: POKENAME在陆上呼吸不畅，也不擅长游泳。它们总显得疲惫，却仍忠诚地听从训练家，努力投入战斗。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME does not breathe well on land, and does not swim well either. They always seem tired, but loyally obey their Trainers and try fighting.

entry: POKENAME重得再也离不开地面，只能整天靠吃排解悲伤，望着心中辽阔的天空，默默流泪。
author: kecleonfan352
source: Having grown far too heavy to get off the ground, POKENAME spends its days eating its feelings away, dreaming about the open sky and weeping silently.

entry: 耳朵由柔韧耐冲击的肌肉纤维束构成。它能用耳朵包住头部，更好地保护头骨。
author: staghorn
source: Its ears are comprised of flexible, impact-resistant bundles of muscle fibers. It can wrap its ears around its head to better protect its skull.

entry: 它能轻易钻穿坚硬的岩石。狩猎时会潜入猎物下方，再用强劲的头槌将其顶上天空。
author: staghorn
source: It can burrow through solid rock with ease. It hunts its prey by burrowing under them and launching them into the air with a powerful headbutt.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞甲外壳。可明明没翅膀，这种融合体究竟怎么飞，谁也解释不清。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it does not have any wings.

entry: POKENAME的长腿，比看上去有力得多，一脚便能把巨金怪这样沉重的宝可梦踢飞。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME's long legs are deceptively strong, able to send heavy Pokémon like Metagross flying with a single kick.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚韧又富有弹性，能在各种地形上滚动。它们常从高高的山丘滚下加速，一旦滚起来，几乎就停不住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's shell is tough but elastic, allowing it to roll on any terrain it chooses. They tend to roll down large hills to build speed; once they start rolling, they are almost impossible to stop.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转，产生庞大的电力，最终甚至引发爆炸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can revolve so fast and generate so much electricity that they eventually explode.

entry: POKENAME虽有钢铁外骨骼，却比赫拉克罗斯更轻。它们会用锯齿状肢体弄坏捕虫陷阱，再吃掉诱饵，在捕虫少年间恶名昭彰。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: Despite POKENAME's steel exoskeletons, they are lighter than a Heracross. They are notorious among Bug Catchers for breaking traps set for Bug-types with their jagged limbs and eating the bait.

entry: POKENAME不停吃煤炭或泥土，再在体内燃烧，驱动自己，时速最高可达35英里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME constantly eats coal or soil, which it burns in its body to power itself. It can reach speeds of up to 35 mph.

entry: 一个个齿轮旋转生能，再经头顶天线，将能量转化为磁波。
author: chorb33
source: The individual gears rotate and generate energy, which is converted into magnetic waves via the antenna on the head.

entry: 喂它原木，它就会吐出木板，再用这些板材制作简单的手工艺品。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When fed logs, it dispenses planks of wood which it then uses to construct simple crafts.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮，能让剑刃不断振动，切入受害者体内。夺来的生命力，则为它持续供能。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's gears cause its blade to vibrate, cutting into the body of its victims. It is continuously powered by the life force it harvests.

entry: POKENAME常躲在废弃工厂，主要以遗留的机械为食。老旧厂房里往往满是它们的身影。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME often shelters within abandoned factories, where the remaining machinery acts as its primary food source. Old industrial plants swarm with this Pokémon.

entry: 彼此咬合的身体让它能像山地自行车般，在林间飞驰。许多林间土路，都是由它开辟的。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This Pokémon's interlocking body allows it to speed through the forest like a mountain bike. It is the source of many natural dirt trails.

entry: POKENAME能自主行动，设计用途就是不断收集垃圾，装满后到最近的垃圾箱倒空，再重复这一过程。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is an autonomous Pokémon that was designed to fill itself with garbage, empty itself in the nearest dumpster, and repeat the process.

entry: 齿轮就像发条马达，POKENAME转得越久，随后朝前疾冲的速度便越快。
author: chorb33
source: Its gears work like a wind-up motor. The longer POKENAME rotates it, the faster it can whizz off in one direction.

entry: 它靠翅膀旋转产生的磁力悬浮。成群的POKENAME休息时会将翅膀连在一起，一旦天敌靠近，只需一只开始旋转，整群就能一同升空。
author: staghorn
source: It hovers using the magnetism generated by its spinning wings. Flocking POKENAME link wings when at rest; if a predator approaches, it only takes a single POKENAME spinning up for the entire flock to take flight.

entry: 训练家可从相互咬合的齿轮转速，判断POKENAME的心情。它能量近乎无穷，有些训练家甚至跟不上POKENAME爱玩的劲头。
author: schwaus
source: Trainers with a POKENAME can determine its mood by how fast it's interlocking gears are turning. It contains a near infinite energy, some Trainers aren't able to keep up with POKENAME's playful nature.

entry: POKENAME很受马戏团欢迎。吞火艺人与杂技演员骑在它身上，借失控的火焰表演惊险特技。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is popular in circus performances, where fire eaters or acrobats ride on it and perform dangerous stunts featuring its uncontrolled fire.

entry: 身体由一套齿轮系统构成，能推动它在水中高速前进。光滑的表面像金属般反光，让POKENAME游泳时在水下闪闪发亮。
author: rakunk
source: Its body is composed of a system of gears, aiding in propelling it through water with surprising speed. Its polished surface reflects light like metal, which allows POKENAME to glimmer underneath the water while swimming.

entry: 研究人员已经证实，POKENAME不断让一个无形磁场，绕自身轴线旋转，借此保护自己。
author: chorb33
source: Researchers were able to prove that POKENAME constantly rotates an invisible magnetic field around its own axis, which it uses to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME用下方的齿轮，激发自身产生的磁场。即使一片漆黑，也能准确辨认方向。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the gear on its underside to stimulate its self-generated magnetic field, with which it can orient itself even in absolute darkness.

entry: POKENAME能将几颗头嵌在一起，飞快旋转。这本是护身的办法，有些人却借此发电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can interlock its heads and then make them rotate rapidly. This protective mechanism is exploited by some to generate energy.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀被巨型齿轮取代，像甲壳般护住背部。增加的体重让它更容易借力，掀翻比自己大得多的宝可梦。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME has replaced its wings with a gigantic gear, which it uses as a shell to protect its back. Its increased weight allows it to get enough leverage to fling Pokémon much larger than it.

entry: POKENAME用赖以运转的油液，在地面上滑行。可人类改用可再生能源后，它们的数量也日益减少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the oil it runs on to slide along the ground. However, because of the shift to renewable energy, their numbers have dwindled.

entry: 坚硬的玻璃，保护着内部马达。POKENAME借马达不断产生能量，再将其转化为磁波。
author: chorb33
source: The motor on the inside is protected by hard glass. POKENAME constantly generates energy via this motor, which it can convert into magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME觉得自己陷在不断昏厥、苏醒的循环里，永无尽头。它会把附近的齿轮雷朵，当作训练家般保护。
author: tokenoracle
source: POKENAME considers itself trapped in a never-ending spiral of faints and revives. It chooses to protect any nearby Klalade as if they were a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME既是振动利刃，也是战斗电锯，能高效取走受害者体内的铁与生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions both as a vibrating blade and combat chainsaw. It effectively harvests iron and life force from its victims.

entry: 由于长期吞食老工厂的机械，POKENAME长出了更大的金属身体。成群飞行时会与同伴碰撞，发出齿轮相磨的声音。
author: daemonkill22
source: Due to its diet of old factory machinery, POKENAME has developed a larger metallic body. Its body collides with others when flying in a swarm, creating the sound of grinding gears.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: POKENAME疾驰时，喷出滚烫蒸汽，点燃身后的大地。蒸汽声与踏地的回响，听来宛如火车头。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME gallops, it emits boiling steam that ignites the landscape behind it. This and the echoing of its steps sound like a locomotive.

entry: 这次融合减弱了POKENAME爱捉弄人的一面，却未影响变身能力。如今它近乎孩童般天真爱玩，将变身也当作游戏。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion has significantly dampened the mischievous streak of POKENAME without impacting its ability to transform. As a result, it has an almost childlike innocence and playfulness, treating its ability to transform like a game.

entry: 白天，它大多休息，用幻象把自己伪装成树枝。到了夜里，深色羽毛与无声的双翼让它几乎无迹可寻，唯有阴森的叫声会泄露行踪。
author: elfail0
source: During the day, this Pokémon spends most of its time resting while wreathed in an illusion that disguises it as a tree branch. During the night, its dark plumage and silent wings make it nearly undetectable outside of its haunting cry.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，常在半空就睡着。传说，它们成群飞过时，会无意间将噩梦散播到天空中。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME drift through the air on gentle winds, often falling asleep mid-flight. Legends say that bad dreams are unintentionally spread through the skies by groups of this Pokémon when they fly by.

entry: POKENAME性情安静，几乎不动，伪装成自己赖以取食的树的一部分。一棵树上能住着数百只，路过的人却毫不知情。
author: elfail0
source: A very passive Pokémon, POKENAME moves little and pretends to be a part of the tree that it feeds off of. Hundreds of them can live in a colony on a single tree without anyone passing by ever knowing they are even there.

entry: POKENAME制造自身的幻影捉弄人，最爱假装突然冲到车前，造成交通事故。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME creates illusions of itself to mess with people. Its favorite prank is to pretend to run out in front of vehicles and cause road accidents.

entry: POKENAME有时会得到来源不明的灾难预兆。为了警告人类，它会用幻象扮作人类孩子靠近，展示自己预见的危险。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME sometimes receives premonitions of disasters from an unknown source. In order to warn humans, it will use illusions to disguise itself as a human child to approach them and show them the nature of the danger it has foreseen.

entry: 夜里偏离小路的人，可能遇见一个戴狐狸面具的孩子，那其实是POKENAME的伪装。它或许会将迷路者带回路上，也可能引入密林，让人从此不知所终。
author: elfail0
source: If a person wanders off the path at night, they may encounter a child in a fox mask. This is actually a POKENAME in disguise. They will either attempt to lead the lost person back to the path or deeper into the woods, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME为躲避冲突，常伪装成普通物品。只有脆弱的猎物落单时，才会出手伏击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises itself as ordinary objects to avoid conflict. It only ambushes vulnerable prey when they are alone.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: POKENAME躲在洞穴最暗的角落，不愿被看见。遭到围堵时，就变成来犯者的模样，吓对方一跳，再飞走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hides in the darkest corners of caves to avoid being seen. When cornered, it transforms into the appearance of its provoker to startle them, then flies away.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，含有易燃毒液。POKENAME既能从尖刺放毒自保，也能点燃毒液进攻。
author: raza
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back contains a flammable toxin. POKENAME can release the toxin from the spikes for defense or ignite it for attacks.

entry: POKENAME的种子能分泌溶解金属的强烈腐蚀性酸液。这种酸液，也是尾焰燃烧的燃料。
author: benevolent
source: The bulb of a POKENAME is capable of producing a corrosive acid that can dissolve metal. This acid is the fuel for the flame on its tail.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，能抵御火焰。许多厨师烹饪时，都会穿上这种丝做的围裙。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME produce a flame-resistant silk. Many chefs wear aprons made from this material when cooking.

entry: 强壮的双腿燃着火，随便踢一下都能造成重伤。每走一步，地上都会留下焦痕。
author: krune
source: Any kick from this Pokémon, with its powerful flaming legs, will cause some serious damage. Its footsteps leave seared marks on the ground.

entry: POKENAME体内的气体极易燃烧。受到威胁时，它就用尾焰将其点燃，引发烈焰爆炸。气体也有腐蚀性，吸入会损伤肺部。
author: mistymagius
source: The gas inside of POKENAME's body is highly flammable, and when threatened it will ignite the gas with its tail to cause a fiery explosion. The gas is also caustic, causing lung damage if inhaled.

entry: 古时候，人们将POKENAME当作活灯笼。历史上许多火灾，据说都与遭受虐待的POKENAME有关。
author: staghorn
source: In ancient times, humans used POKENAME as living lanterns. Many historical fires are thought to be caused by mistreated POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的耐心，比牙签还短。再加上强壮的体格，至今没有斗牛士能赢过它。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME's temper is about as short as a toothpick. Because of this, in addition to its physique, no matador has ever bested it.

entry: POKENAME的叶片从叶尖一直烧到根部时，就说明它要进化了。脖子上的花苞，会散发出干花香料般的怡人香气。
author: volvonovic
source: When a POKENAME's leaf burns down to its root, it is ready to evolve. The bulbs on its neck emit a pleasant aroma reminiscent of potpourri.

entry: 羽毛覆着薄薄一层灰。受惊时，它就会猛烈扑腾，扬起一团烟雾。
author: ozydamians
source: Its feathers are coated in a thin layer of ash. It flaps around wildly when frightened, kicking up a cloud of smoke.

entry: POKENAME用尾羽将温暖的火星扇向巢中的蛋。若有天敌来偷蛋，POKENAME就会扬起烟幕，挥爪胡乱抓挠。
author: ozydamians
source: With its tail feathers, POKENAME fans warm embers over the eggs in its nest. When a predator tries to steal its eggs, POKENAME whips up a smokescreen and slashes haphazardly with its talons.

entry: 它散发的热量能让人类与宝可梦都感到暖意融融，心中宽慰，因此常成为治疗师的伙伴。
author: staghorn
source: The heat it produces also creates a "warm and fuzzy" feeling in humans and Pokémon. For this reason, they're a common partner for therapists.

entry: POKENAME曾被误认成发胖的火焰鸟。飞行时身后拖着浓浓黑烟，军队因此会借POKENAME远距离传递暗号。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME was once mistaken to be a chubby Moltres. Dark clouds of smoke trail behind it as it flies, so the military employs POKENAME to send coded messages across long distances.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: POKENAME紧紧盘成螺旋，护住自己的火焰。鳞片摩擦生热，能烧伤被它缠住的对象。
author: baverbrugge
source: POKENAME protects its flame by curling into a tight spiral. Its scales produce heat through friction, burning anything it manages to constrict.

entry: POKENAME在一英里外，就能听见肚子咕咕叫。厨艺虽然才起步，每一餐却都满怀心意。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME can hear a rumbling stomach from a mile away. It's only just learning to cook, but every meal is made with love.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME通常爱吵爱闹，玩起来没轻没重，一不留神，帽子就会点着周围的东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually rowdy when they're younger. They often play without care, and when that happens, their hat can set things on fire.

entry: 看尾巴烧短了多少，就能判断POKENAME的年龄。尾巴足够长，能一直烧到下一次进化。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: How old a POKENAME is can be determined by how far its tail has burned down. Its tail is long enough for it to last up to its next evolution.

entry: POKENAME周身的火焰宛如天然罗盘，让它感知附近物体与地点的方位。据说，见到训练家时，火光会更明亮。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in flames that act as a natural compass, allowing it to sense the direction of nearby objects or locations. It is said to shine brighter at the sight of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能从热量中汲取大量能量，却又怕身体干掉，便爱在温泉边的泥里玩耍，保持湿润。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME gets lots of energy from heat, but must be careful not to dry out. To deal with this, it plays in the mud near hot springs.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: 尾尖的火焰，为背上的花提供了光源。可光照太多，叶片反而已经泛黄。
author: soup1900
source: The flame that's on the tip of its tail gives it its own source of light for its flower. Its leaves have yellowed due to too much exposure to light.

entry: POKENAME常把树果和肉烤过再吃。若火焰颜色古怪，多半与它吃了什么有关。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often roast Berries and meat before eating them. If their flames are an odd color, it is most likely due to their diet.

entry: POKENAME借尾焰调节体温。潜水时，会用气泡包住火焰，免得熄灭。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the flame on its tail to regulate its body temperature. During dives, it envelops it in an air bubble to prevent it from going out.

entry: 不论外界多冷，它都能把绒羽加热到140度以上。滑过雪地时，身后便留下一道冒着蒸汽的痕迹。
author: chorb33
source: It can heat its down to over 140 degrees, regardless of outside temperatures. As it glides over the snow, it leaves a steaming trail in its wake.

entry: 这把附有幽灵的镐，击中金属或血肉，便能将其瞬间烧至赤热。它游荡矿中，只有采掘时遭到打扰，才会发动攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: On impact, this haunted pick instantly turns metal or flesh red hot. It wanders mines and only attacks if disturbed while mining.

entry: 这个顽皮伙伴，走到哪里都留下焦痕。POKENAME既宝贝自己的尾焰，也会拼命保护同伴。
author: supersonicloki
source: A playful companion that leaves burn marks wherever it goes. POKENAME is very protective of its companions and the flame on its tail.

entry: 心情越好，这只宝可梦摸起来就越温暖。它常想扑进信任的训练家怀里，亲昵一会儿。
author: melodydelune
source: The happier this Pokémon is, the warmer its body feels to the touch. It often seeks to cuddle with a trusted Trainer.

entry: 它走到哪里，哪里便落满极易燃烧的毛发。饲养这只宝可梦的训练家，必须先上消防安全课。
author: capwolfbane
source: It sheds incredibly flammable fur on just about any surface. Trainers of this Pokémon are required to take a fire safety course.

entry: POKENAME生性懒惰，常常活不到完全长成。即使雨水正浇灭尾焰，它们也只是气鼓鼓地继续睡。
author: scapz
source: POKENAME often never make it to full maturity due to their slothful nature. They slumber indignantly even as the rain extinguishes their tails.

entry: POKENAME在温水中欢快嬉戏，总尽量让尾巴露在水面上。潜水时则用泡泡裹住尾巴，等里面的空气用尽后再浮回水面。
author: markusknight
source: Cheerfully playing around in warm waters, POKENAME always tries to keep its tail above water. When diving, they surround it in a water bubble and come back after air in the bubble runs out.

entry: 在关都，人们常让孩子通过照顾POKENAME，学习饲养宝可梦的基础。不过，为安全起见，最好让它离地毯远点。
author: supersonicloki
source: In Kanto, POKENAME is mostly used to teach young children the ropes of Pokémon care. Keep it away from carpets for your own safety.

entry: 它们常成群嬉戏，诙谐又爱闹，总喜欢捉弄路过的旅人。
author: supersonicloki
source: Often found playing in packs, these humorous creatures have been known to prank travelers passing by.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合后，原本隐性的龙类等位基因，便会转为显性。它性情凶悍，尾焰也极难扑灭。
author: atomicdiamond
source: Recessive, dragon-like alleles become dominant when two POKENAME are fused. It tends to have a fierce nature, and its tail is difficult to extinguish.

entry: 研究者发现，POKENAME在冰川家园中会四只或更多挤成一团移动。目前认为，这是为了挡住突来的阵风与暴风雪，保护尾焰，集体保暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon researchers have observed POKENAME moving across their glacial homes in huddled groups of four or more. The current theory is that they do so to protect their flames from abrupt gusts of wind or blizzards, letting them stay warm as a group.

entry: 如今火焰已变得炽热无比，尾巴上的火无论泼多少水也无法熄灭。
author: soup1900
source: Its flames have now become ultra hot. No amount of water can put out the flame on its tail.

entry: 它的外表变得更加暗沉，口中也冒出火焰。卡洛斯的专家认为，它与超级喷火龙X有相似之处。
author: soup1900
source: It has taken on a darker appearance, and flames come out of its mouth. Kalos experts claim it has similarities with Mega Charizard X.

entry: 它性情相当平和，除非迫不得已，不会凶狠地进攻。面对强敌时，反而会有点害怕。
author: soup1900
source: It is a pretty calm Pokémon and won't viciously attack unless absolutely necessary. It becomes slightly afraid when facing tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里睡觉，靠尾焰取暖。若去打扰熟睡的POKENAME，它就会从壳上的孔洞喷火。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will tuck themselves into their shell, using the flame from their tail to stay warm as they sleep. Attempting to disturb a sleeping POKENAME will cause them to release fire from the holes in their shell.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上的炮管喷火，射出的小火球，会飞出10英尺才炸开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME expels flames from the cannons on its shell. It can shoot small fireballs that travel for a distance of 10 feet before they explode.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会喷出蒸汽，可烫伤人的威力不强，顶多只会刺痛一阵。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME shoots steam from its cannons. However, the steam doesn't burn much, and at most it'll sting for a while.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会发出呻吟，仿佛一位正受痛苦折磨的老妇人。若有人上前相助，就会被它吃掉，化为进化的能量。
author: .izik
source: Late at night, a POKENAME groans as if it is an elderly woman in pain. Should a person assist, it will consume them, storing energy for evolution.

entry: 华美的外貌，让它常被请去唱歌、跳舞，可至今竟没留下表演评价。失眠的人，倒很喜欢它。
author: houndrys.
source: Due to its luxurious look, it's often employed as a singer and dancer, but no reviews exist of its performance. It's popular among insomniacs.

entry: 关都的一些商店照着POKENAME的模样制作甜点，想与名气响亮的飞云冰淇淋竞争，效果却不怎么好。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Some stores in Kanto have made confections based on POKENAME to try to compete with the vaunted Casteliacone, to little success.

entry: POKENAME用凝视赶走天敌。若不眨眼、不退缩的表情还不够，就突然尖叫一声，刺得对方耳朵生疼。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME drive off predators by staring. If its unblinking, unflinching expression isn't enough, a sudden ear-piercing screech does the job.

entry: 后面的头爱唱歌，唱得却连主头也受不了。歌声长年不断，让主头随着年龄增长，听力越来越差。
author: mistymagius
source: The back head loves to sing, even though its singing is so bad not even the main head can stand it. Due to the constant singing, the main head's hearing gets worse as it gets older.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME通常居于高山，在连绵峰顶维持大片领地。它们以响亮回荡的歌声，向胖王和敌对的POKENAME传递讯息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME typically dwell high in the mountains, maintaining large territories across the peaks of their homes. They signal to Wigglyking and rival POKENAME with loud, echoing songs.

entry: POKENAME只用飘带上柔软的毛轻轻拂过，便能安抚人类与宝可梦。它还能把刀刃鼓得奇大无比。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can calm people and Pokémon just by brushing them with their ribbon's soft fur. It can also inflate their blade to a ridiculous size.

entry: 出众的歌声能令听众着迷，为它聚来大批死心塌地的歌迷，愿意替它做任何事。可演出一旦被打断，它发起火来，连脾气最坏的歌坛天后都比不上。
author: elfail0
source: Its incredible singing voice has the power to enthrall listeners, which allows it to amass giant crowds of loyal fans that will do anything for it. Its rage when a performance is disrupted can put even the most disgruntled diva to shame.

entry: 毛发丰厚蓬松，手感好得让人忍不住想摸。抱着POKENAME，也被用来帮助失眠的人入睡。
author: melodydelune
source: Its rich, fluffy fur feels so good to touch that people find it difficult not to touch it. Cuddling POKENAME is used to help insomnia patients.

entry: POKENAME深吸一口气，鼓起身体，就能轻轻浮上天空。放气时则看心情，发出舒缓的声音，或极具破坏力的尖啸。
author: sontyp
source: By inhaling deeply, POKENAME can inflate itself enough to gently float through the air. When it deflates, it creates soothing sounds or devastating screeches, depending on its mood.

entry: 它毛发华美，歌声舒缓而催眠。讨喜的外貌引来大批观众，既满足被关注的渴望，又有更多食物可偷。
author: elfail0
source: This Pokémon possesses luxurious fur and a soothingly hypnotic voice. Its appealing appearance allows it to lure in large audiences, which gives it the attention it craves and more food to steal.

entry: 舞姿道馆的对战中，常能看见POKENAME。它们花样繁多，又很爱炫耀。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in Gym battles at the Ballonlea gym. They know numerous tricks and like to show off.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软极了，摸一摸就能让人开心。若发现谁情绪低落，它便不断亲昵地蹭过去，直到对方好受些。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely soft and can make anyone feel happy just by touching it. If it finds someone feeling down, it has a tendency to nuzzle them until they feel better.

entry: 它的喵叫声各有特色。每只POKENAME的音调、音高与长短，都不尽相同，有时差别还大得惊人。
author: chorb33
source: Its meowing sounds are unique. This is because each POKENAME has its own pitch, height and tone length, which can vary greatly in some cases.

entry: POKENAME能把身体各部位鼓到平常的许多倍。马戏团很欢迎它，孩子们尤其喜欢。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can puff up each of its body parts to many times their normal size. It is a popular circus attraction and especially popular with children.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: 准备蜕变时，POKENAME会闭合花苞，硬化外壳。临近破壳，又会重新张开花苞，吸收能量，完成最后的蜕变。
author: holgast
source: As POKENAME prepare for metamorphosis, they close their buds and harden their shells. Just before they emerge, they open their buds again to absorb energy for the last push.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，总躲进阴暗的灌木或花田下。它需要阳光才能好好成长，若能勇敢些，本可长得更快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in shady undergrowth or under flower fields. If it were braver, it could develop more quickly, as it needs sunlight to thrive.

entry: 它吸收附近土壤中的金属与矿物，融入皮肤和尖刺。冬天越近，身体越沉、行动越慢，最终重得无法移动，便进入休眠。
author: staghorn
source: It absorbs metals and minerals from nearby soil, incorporating them into its skin and spines. It becomes heavier and slower as winter approaches, eventually going dormant once it becomes too heavy to move.

entry: POKENAME用熏香安抚其他宝可梦。待对方平静，就打开花苞，把愉快的情绪吸进去。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME uses the aroma of their incense to calm other Pokémon. Once this is done, they open their bud and absorb their positive emotions with it.

entry: 它从翅膀撒出花粉，干扰敌人。受到善良训练家照料的POKENAME，双翼色彩更鲜艳，香气也更芬芳。
author: kittyluv090
source: It distracts enemies by scattering pollen from its wings. The wings of POKENAME who are raised by kind Trainers are more vibrant and aromatic.

entry: POKENAME裹着粗厚的藤蔓，便于伪装，躲避天敌。虽然满是尖刺，刺却不锋利，可以放心触摸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is wrapped in thick vines that help it camouflage from predators. Despite being covered in thorns, they are not very sharp and are safe to touch.

entry: POKENAME的白玫瑰象征爱与高洁，常受精英训练家饲养。它们竭力保护弱小的宝可梦，尤其是异性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's white roses are symbols of love and nobility and are commonly owned by elite Trainers. They go out of their way to defend weaker Pokémon, especially ones of the opposite gender.

entry: POKENAME的毒爪藏在玫瑰花苞之下。常能见到它们从枝头跃下，用毒刺伏击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: Underneath the rose buds hide POKENAME's poisonous claws. They can frequently be seen jumping from tree branches, ambushing prey by stabbing them with their toxic thorns.

entry: 体表的叶片坚韧无比，战斗时能当作铠甲。雄性POKENAME常相互争斗，求取羽毛最美的雌性的青睐。
author: mistymagius
source: The leaves on its body are extremely tough and act as protective armor in battle. Male POKENAME frequently engage in combat to woo the females with the prettiest plumage.

entry: 叶状的双翼锋利如钢，轻易就能斩开树木。但POKENAME十分友善，允许其他宝可梦为脚上的花授粉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its leaf-like wings are as sharp as steel, able to slice through trees with ease. Despite this, POKENAME is very friendly and allows other Pokémon to pollinate the flowers on its feet.

entry: 它是春季很受欢迎的宝可梦。POKENAME在花田中欢快起舞，散发的香气让训练家不由自主地开心起来。
author: mistymagius
source: A popular Pokémon during the spring season. POKENAME playfully dance around flower fields, emitting a scent that makes Trainers uncontrollably happy.

entry: POKENAME深受舞台魔术师喜爱，能从任意物件中突然钻出，让观众惊叹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are favored by stage magicians. It can pop out through any object and audience members are amazed.

entry: 组成尾巴的玫瑰散发着诱人的香味。可得当心！一旦靠得太近，POKENAME就能从花里喷出猛烈的火焰！
author: chorb33
source: The roses that form its tail emit a tantalizing scent. But watch out! If anyone gets too close to them, POKENAME can emit devastating flames from the flowers!

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: chorb33
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: 这种慵懒的宝可梦常在大片森林里闲躺，慢慢啃花。POKENAME颈边的花散发舒缓的香气，仿佛玫瑰与松木混在一起。
author: mistymagius
source: These lazy Pokémon can be seen lounging around large forests, slowly gnawing on flowers. The flower on POKENAME's neck releases a relaxing scent that smells like a mixture of roses and pinewood.

entry: 谁碰到POKENAME撒出的花粉，它就能感知谁的情绪，即使远在几英里之外，也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: chorb33
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME开心时，耳上的花苞会散发怡人的香味，常被用于香水。可毛发里藏着利刺，抱起来并不舒服。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is happy, the buds on its ears release a pleasant scent often used in perfumes. Its fur coat hides sharp thorns that make it unpleasant to hug.

entry: 它们成群附在树木与灌丛上，缓缓转动，产生能量。受威胁时，便将能量集中到玫瑰花苞中，射出强劲的激光。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon can be seen attached to trees and bushes, slowly spinning to produce energy. When threatened, they concentrate this energy in their rose buds to unleash a powerful laser.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，沿途洒落彩色的花瓣。人们常将其收集起来，相信攒得够多，就能获得永恒的爱情。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME drifts along the breeze, it drops colorful flower petals. People often collect these petals, believing that gathering enough brings eternal love.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼会散播效力很强的花粉，帮助花朵生长。容易过敏的人，最好远离POKENAME大量聚集的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, its wings spread a strong pollen that helps flowers grow. People with allergies should stay away from areas where large groups of POKENAME can be found.

entry: 花园若疏于照料，可能就会被POKENAME占据。它的“眼睛”伪装成花朵，引诱猎物靠近。
author: staghorn
source: If you don't take good care of your garden, it may become infested with POKENAME. Its "eyes" mimic flowers in order to lure in potential prey.

entry: POKENAME始终静止不动，以免损伤身上娇嫩的花。角上带着剧毒，触碰就可能致命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always stationary to avoid damaging the delicate flowers on its body. Its horns are laced with a strong poison that can be deadly when touched.

entry: 晴天，常能看见成群的POKENAME一边睡觉，一边吸收太阳的能量。POKENAME越健康，花香就越甜美。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen sleeping on sunny days to draw energy from the sun. The healthier POKENAME is, the sweeter the scent from its flowers becomes.

entry: 据说，迷失的灵魂会在心怀恶意的毒蔷薇体内扎根，最终长成POKENAME。它们惊吓迷路的林中人，为自然遭受的破坏寻求报复。
author: altius
source: It is said that lost spirits take root within malevolent Roselia until they grow into POKENAME. These creatures scare people lost in the woods, seeking revenge for the destruction of nature.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太弱，几乎无法飞行。受威胁时便会拼命振翅，撒出花中带刺激性的花粉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's weak wings make it almost impossible for it to fly. When threatened, it will frantically flap its wings, spreading the irritating pollen from its flowers.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺越大，毒性就越强。花园中常能见到成群的POKENAME，以小型虫属性宝可梦为食。
author: mistymagius
source: The larger the thorns on POKENAME's head, the more powerful its poison it produces. Groups of POKENAME can be seen in flower gardens, feeding on small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME姿态美丽，常在花田中欢快奔跃。奇怪的是，身上的火焰烧不伤其他植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a thing of beauty and can be seen playfully galloping around flower fields. The flames on its body curiously cannot burn other plant life.

entry: POKENAME像飘飘球一样，爱把孩子带走。可它是带孩子去儿童免餐费的餐厅，骗来免费的饭，喂饱自己。
author: llamawiz34
source: Just like Drifloon, POKENAME likes to take children away. It carries them to kids-eat-free restaurants to trick them into giving it free food.

entry: POKENAME一出现在居民区附近，大人就会赶紧将孩子带进屋，因为它身上的绳索十分危险。轻轻一拉就能引发巨大爆炸，因此POKENAME常住在废弃城镇及其周边。
author: faeflame
source: If a POKENAME appears near a community, children are quickly ushered inside due to its dangerous cords. A single tug on these cords can cause a massive explosion, and as a result, POKENAME often reside in and around ghost towns.

entry: 身体慢慢石化，变得越来越沉。想飞起来，就得耗去极大的能量。
author: chorb33
source: Its body slowly petrifies, making it progressively heavier and only able to fly by expending a great deal of energy.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵变得如幽灵般缥缈，原本猛烈的打击也柔和了许多。如今，它改用云絮般的耳朵，送出少量令人刺痛的能量。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's ears have turned ghostly, and the once-brutal strikes it delivers have softened considerably. Instead, it uses the cloud-like wisps to deliver subtle doses of stinging energy.

entry: POKENAME好奇、友善，通常也没什么危险。可它真正从何而来，却流传着许多骇人的都市传说。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are curious, friendly, and often harmless. Despite this, there are many grisly urban legends surrounding its true origins.

entry: 随风漂行时，它显得慢吞吞。可只要鼓起头部与翅膀，就能升上天空，快得转眼消失。
author: chorb33
source: It appears sluggish when it lets itself be carried by the wind. However, by inflating its head and wings, it can rise into the air and disappear surprisingly quickly.

entry: POKENAME群体规模庞大，一旦占住某地，就几乎赶不走。借背上的球体短距离飘行，它们能轻松将食物带回群落。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in colonies of vast sizes, and once they have claimed an area it is nearly impossible to get them to leave. Using the orbs on their back they float short distances bringing food back to the colony with ease.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就竖起耳朵。觅食时，会搜遍广大的区域。
author: the_fireplace
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it perks up its ears. It searches wide areas for food.

entry: 厚实的绒毛与坚固的甲壳，让POKENAME防御力出众。它们偏爱鼠曲草类植物与香蒲。
author: frokachu
source: With a combination of thick wool and a sturdy shell, POKENAME have powerful defenses They prefer eating cottonweeds and cattail plants.

entry: 想让暴怒的POKENAME平静，唯一的办法就是抚摸它。若尚未哄好便停手，POKENAME就会张臂紧抱，让训练家窒息，送上一个“永恒的拥抱”。
author: teatedtiten
source: The only way to calm an enraged POKENAME is to pet it. If a Trainer stops petting it before it calms down, POKENAME will wrap its arms around them and suffocate them as an everlasting hug.

entry: POKENAME不仅能以惊人的速度逃离捕食者，每团棉絮般的毛簇也都能猛然出拳，快得让人眼花。它们的毛能做成最柔软的枕头。
author: wormspawn
source: In addition to the striking speed at which POKENAME can flee from predators, each of its cotton-like tufts can lash out with a dizzying punch. Their fur makes the softest pillows.

entry: 据说POKENAME拥有世上最可爱动听的嗓音。可惜生性害羞，总无法好好唱出来。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to have the cutest and most beautiful voice in the world. Unfortunately, its shy nature prevents it from properly singing.

entry: POKENAME将孢子撒遍河流与沼泽，因此，它栖息的地方，附近很少有其他宝可梦生活。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME scatters spores all over rivers and swamps. As a result, not many Pokémon live near its habitat.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，享用湿润的腐殖土。丰富养分，让背上的地星菌长得硕大、健康。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.

entry: POKENAME靠滚动前进，沿途散播孢子。一天就能沿超过10英里的路程撒下孢子。
author: melodydelune
source: Rolling around to travel, POKENAME will spread its spores as it goes. In a single day it can plant over 10 miles of spores.

entry: 身上的蘑菇长得飞快。一旦长得太长，就会进化成斗笠种子，蘑菇也随之截断。
author: dodoowner_
source: Its mushroom grows at a rapid rate. Once the mushroom grows too long, it evolves into Bresaur and the mushroom gets cut.

entry: 它淘气地藏在蘑菇丛间，等待敌人靠近，再用锐利的金属肢体伏击。受威胁时，POKENAME会放出使敌人混乱或入睡的孢子，趁机逃走。
author: thepandasharky
source: This mischievous Pokémon hides among mushrooms, waiting to ambush foes with its sharp, metallic limbs. When threatened, POKENAME releases spores that cause confusion or puts opponents to sleep, giving it a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在洞穴或密林深处的湿土里打盹。在它附近睡着，会做奇幻的梦。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME prefer to doze in the damp soil found in caves and deep woods. Those who fall asleep near one experience fantastical dreams.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇，可不像引梦貘人的摆锤。让人昏昏欲睡的，其实是蘑菇摇动时撒出的孢子。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME's mushroom does not function in the same manner as Hypno's pendulum. Instead, the spores it emits when swung induce sleepiness.

entry: POKENAME始终陪伴训练家，同甘共苦。若训练家情绪低落，它便想尽办法逗对方微笑。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME stick with their Trainers through thick and thin. If their Trainers are feeling blue, they do what they can to make them grin.

entry: 被怨影龟控制的草苗龟进化时，布质的外皮可能撑破。若能保持完整，就能顺利进化为POKENAME。
author: hellaluyeah
source: When a Turtwig evolves while being controlled by a Shupwig, the fabric skin threatens to tear. If it stays intact, the evolution to POKENAME is complete.

entry: POKENAME以针对某个人的复仇之情为食。吃饱之后，便找到那个人，真正付诸报复。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME feeds on feelings of vengeance against specific people. When it is full, it finds and acts out that revenge on that person.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: POKENAME周围的细胞团，再生得快得惊人。即使待在放射性污染地区，也能安然生存。
author: chorb33
source: The cell mass surrounding POKENAME regenerates incredibly quickly. It can even survive in areas contaminated by radioactivity without any problems.

entry: POKENAME在有丝分裂时发电，不断迸出火花。有些家庭，便让它帮忙提供可再生电力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sparks continuously as it generates electricity during mitosis. It is therefore used in some households to generate renewable electricity.

entry: 深海生活让POKENAME的皮肤失去了所有色素。头上的光会伪装成发光水母，引诱猎物靠近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Living in the deep sea, POKENAME have lost all pigmentation in their skin. The lights on their heads lure prey by fooling them into thinking they are bioluminescent jellyfish.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大超能力，性情却胆小。一遇危险，便靠柔软身体挤进窄缝，转眼不见。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its strong psychic powers, POKENAME is cowardly and disappears into narrow cracks through which it can squeeze thanks to its flexible body.

entry: 不停再生的细胞团，护着POKENAME真正的身体。个头虽大，却很柔软，钻进小洞就能消失无踪。
author: chorb33
source: Constantly regenerating cell mass protects the actual body of POKENAME. Despite its size, it is very flexible and can disappear through narrow holes.

entry: POKENAME的脸乍看柔软，却因质地致密，有着钢铁般的强度。可身体其他地方，仍十分娇弱。
author: forbiddenbread
source: While it may look soft, POKENAME's face retains the strength of steel due to its density. However, the remainder of its body is still very fragile.

entry: POKENAME小巧黏软，生性贪玩，能随意伸展变形。它会借流动的身体，对毫无防备的敌人发动出其不意的小型超能力攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a small, gooey Pokémon. Its playful nature allows it to stretch and reshape, using its fluid form to launch surprising small psychic attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME成群顺着河流轻松漂行。捕食者靠近时，就发出超能力振动，潜入水下。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME travel in groups, floating along effortlessly using river currents. Should a predator approach, they produce psychic vibrations to dip under the surface of the water.

entry: 柔软的凝胶身体让POKENAME容易遭到捕食。它们用黏性身体搜集贝壳，借此保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The soft and gelatinous bodies of POKENAME leave them vulnerable to predators. They scavenge sea shells using their sticky bodies, keeping themselves safe from danger.

entry: POKENAME表面的胶质，是它不断进行有丝分裂时排出的多余细胞，里面还感染着病原体。
author: chorb33
source: The jelly that coats POKENAME are surplus cells that it secretes during its constant mitosis. These are infected with pathogens.

entry: 它把使自己进化的雷之石，包在特殊液体里。借这块石头，便能释放10000伏的电击。
author: duskrd
source: It keeps the Thunder Stone that evolved it enveloped in a special liquid. It can use the Thunder Stone to unleash electrical shocks of 10,000 volts.

entry: POKENAME黏软的身体外覆着一层薄而滑的膜，能缓冲攻击。它以超能力操纵黏液进攻，优雅地滑过地面，迷惑对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's gooey body is protected by a thin, slick membrane that cushions it from attacks. It uses its psychic powers to attack with its slime, confusing opponents as it slides gracefully across the ground.

entry: 它从炮管中射出棉花，想吓走天敌。可毕竟只是棉花，这招常不管用，照样挨打。
author: soup1900
source: It shoots cotton out of its cannons to scare predators away. This defense is often ineffective since it's just cotton, and it gets attacked anyways.

entry: POKENAME先把棉花射向对手眼睛，再发动攻击。身轻固然灵巧，却也容易被人推开。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME shoots cotton into its opponent's eyes before attacking. Its light weight makes it nimble yet easy to push around.

entry: POKENAME用练习棍般的武器，将来犯者推远。若看来要输，就朝敌人射出棉絮，趁机逃跑。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its pugil stick-like weapon to push away would be attackers. If the battle seems lost, it shoots its cotton at its foe to escape.

entry: 它蹦来跳去，仿佛轻如羽毛。因此，一记重击往往让对手措手不及。
author: staghorn
source: It bounces about as if it were as light as a feather. Because of this, many of its opponents are caught off-guard by its heavy blows.

entry: POKENAME的每个头都先顾自己安全，会扯走别的头的棉花据为己用。若太贪心，堆得过多的棉花反会挡住视线。
author: mistymagius
source: Each of POKENAME's heads prioritize their own safety, so they will pull off each other's cotton to use for themselves. If one head gets too greedy, the cotton will start to impair its vision.

entry: POKENAME模样虽可爱，却能将大意的训练家咬成重伤。它们行动迅速，仿佛在沙里游泳，只露出鼻孔与背刺。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME, in spite of its cuteness, can deliver devastating bites to careless Trainers. They move very quickly, seemingly swimming in sand, with only their nostrils and backspikes visible.

entry: 这些扁平的宝可梦会沿沙漠表面滑行。有些象形文字似乎记录了人们见到它们的情景。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These flat Pokémon can be found sliding along the surface of the desert sand. Some hieroglyphs seem to depict their sightings.

entry: 它伏在浅浅的沙下，挥刃划向路人的腿。受害者若逃走，POKENAME便凶猛地追上去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It lies just below the surface of the desert to slice at the legs of passersby. When victims get away, POKENAME aggressively pursues them.

entry: 这种POKENAME是专为宠物培育的。与主人感情深了，还会亲昵地轻咬一口。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This form of POKENAME was specifically bred as a pet. It will nibble its owner affectionately if they share a close bond.

entry: POKENAME厌恶阳光，不惜一切躲避日晒。它靠带毒的藤蔓，从腐烂的植物残体中吸取养分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hate sunlight and will stay out of the sun at all costs. It gets its nutrients from rotting plant-matter using its poisonous vines.

entry: POKENAME发出超声波，在洞中认路，再以爆发的电力袭击猎物。猛烈的放电，甚至能让供电中断，自己也跟着昏过去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME emits ultrasonic waves to navigate caves and blasts to shock prey. It can emit a blast strong enough to knock out power as well as itself.

entry: POKENAME戴着被自己吸干鲜血的猎物的头骨。因为看不见，狩猎时只能朝声音传来的方向俯冲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of the prey it has sucked all the blood from. Since it is blind, it just dives in the direction of prey it hears.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME凭敏锐的听觉与快速反应，轻松躲开敌人的招式。它更愿堂堂正正交手，不用带毒的咬击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its keen sense of hearing and quick reflexes to allow it to effortlessly dodge its opponents' blows. It prefers to fight fair and not use its venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却靠长舌与敏锐的耳朵，准确感知周围。
author: chorb33
source: With the help of its long tongue and sensitive ears, the otherwise blind POKENAME can accurately scan its surroundings.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME是被弃置的军事实验产物，靠回声定位寻找目标，一触碰就引爆。它们可被当作消耗品，破坏力又强，因此受邪恶组织青睐。
author: kianjp2008
source: An abandoned military experiment, POKENAME uses echolocation to seek out targets and detonate upon contact. Due to their expendable and destructive nature they are popular among evil organizations.

entry: POKENAME先用藤蔓束住猎物，再吸干体液。白天睡觉时，常能看见它们挂在树上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its prey with its bundle of vines before draining them of their fluids. They can be seen hanging from trees while they sleep during the day.

entry: 由于没有视力，耳朵逐渐变成大颚般的器官，用来夹捕猎物。
author: melodydelune
source: Its ears have adapted, due to its lack of eyesight, to act as a set of mandibles to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME附在受害者身上，慢慢吸尽鲜血。它们生命力顽强，主要住在阴暗潮湿之处。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sucks on its victims and gradually drains their blood. They are hardy and live mainly in dark and damp places.

entry: 它用时钟般的滴答声发出回声，辨别方向。虽然眼睛很大，其实完全看不见。
author: admiralvermin
source: It navigates using echolocation by making clock-like ticking noises. This is because despite its large eyes, it is completely blind.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里出没，靠敏锐的听觉追踪猎物。獠牙与利爪都带着致命毒素，能让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, tracking its prey with its keen sense of hearing. Its fangs and talons contain a deadly poison that it uses to incapacitate its prey.

entry: 它能利用回声定位，找到几英里外的水果。休息时，POKENAME会紧紧攀住自己信任的训练家的肩膀。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its echolocation, it can find fruit within miles of its location. When resting, POKENAME will cling to the shoulder of its trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME吃下赖以为食的果实中的种子，积攒毒素。只有自己或训练家受到威胁、别无选择时，才会动用这些毒。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME builds up its poison reserve by eating the seeds of the fruit it survives on. They are only known to use this poison as a last resort against potential threats to it or its Trainer.

entry: 荒废的城市里可能住着数千只POKENAME，以能找到的一切腐烂物为食。利齿连金属线也能咬断。
author: mistymagius
source: Deserted cities can be home to thousands of POKENAME, feeding off any rotten matter they can find. Their sharp teeth are able to chew through metal wire.

entry: POKENAME是没有眼睛的猎手，靠振翅感受从洞壁弹回的气流，辨认方向。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An eyeless hunter, POKENAME flaps its wings and feels the air bouncing off cave walls in order to navigate.

entry: 弥留之际的人，身旁会聚来大群POKENAME。待那人逝去，它们便会将遗体一点点吃尽，什么也不留下。
author: mistymagius
source: Large flocks of POKENAME appear around people near their end. Once they perish, the flock will feed on their lifeless body until nothing remains.

entry: POKENAME颚力极强，能将钢梁碾碎。它们常栖息在下水道、暗巷等疫病滋生的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has extremely strong jaws, capable of pulverizing a steel beam. They are commonly found in disease-ridden areas like sewers and alleyways.

entry: POKENAME住在洞中，朝猎物所在的方向乱挥身体狩猎。它会躲开其他捕食者，除非对方先击中它的尾巴。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME lives in caves and hunts by blindly flailing its body in the direction of prey. It avoids other predators unless they strike its tail first.

entry: POKENAME吊在大树上，伪装成松果。浓密毛发中藏着数百根毒针，一经碰触便会折落。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from large trees, disguising itself as a pinecone. Its thick fur contains hundreds of poisonous needles that break off on physical contact.

entry: 它用爪吊在深洞的洞顶休眠，让体内产生的毒液慢慢汇入尾针。许多洞穴探险者身上，都留着被POKENAME突袭的伤疤。
author: kianjp2008
source: It hangs dormant by its claws on the ceilings of deep caves, slowly letting the venom produced in its body gather in its stinger. Many spelunkers bear the scars left by sudden POKENAME attacks.

entry: POKENAME爱吃街边的剩饭残渣，被城市居民视为祸害。遭到POKENAME咬伤，可能出现类似食物中毒的症状。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are considered pests in urban areas due to their habit of eating leftover food scraps along the streets. Being bitten by a POKENAME can cause symptoms similar to food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME爪上带有剧毒，能让猎物动弹不得。它夜间狩猎，从高处滑翔而下，伏击目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are laced with a strong poison that incapacitates its victims. It hunts at night, gliding from high places to ambush its prey.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找能弄到手的果子，尤其偏爱有毒的果实。它会将毒素存入牙中，咬击时释放。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are always on the hunt for any fruits it can get its paws on. It actually prefers poisonous fruits as they will store the toxins in its teeth for a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME不需要眼睛，因此嘴巴最终长大到覆盖了整个身体。它一顿就能吞下300颗以上的树果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME 's mouth eventually covered it's whole body, as it didn't need eyes. It can gobble up over 300 Berries in one sitting.

entry: 这些笨头笨脑的宝可梦，分不清同伴与敌人，总打个不停。被它们毒牙咬过，灼痛会久久不散。
author: mistymagius
source: These dim-witted Pokémon are constantly attacking each other, unable to tell each other from their enemies. Their toxic bite leaves a long-lasting burning sensation.

entry: POKENAME不停摆动沉重的象鼻，触探周围。翅膀虽弱，却一直怀着飞翔的梦想。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly swinging its hefty trunk around to sense its surroundings. Despite its weak wings, it has always dreamed of flight.

entry: POKENAME看不见，只能以电磁感官描出周围的景象。它只在暴风雨之夜现身，试图引雷击中自己。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to its lack of eyesight, POKENAME uses its electromagnetic senses to get a picture of its surroundings. It can only be seen on stormy nights, trying to get struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在洞穴，用灵敏的听觉感知四周。它们成群住进洞壁狭小的裂隙里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in caves, using its sensitive hearing to detect its surroundings. Groups of POKENAME make their dens in small crevices in the cave walls.

entry: POKENAME通过三只羽毛般的耳朵散去体热。据说，被POKENAME咬中，就像全身的血都烧起来了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME vents its internal heat through its three feather-like ears. Getting bitten by POKENAME is said to feel like your blood in on fire.

entry: 夏夜，数百只POKENAME会出来寻偶。此时毒性达到平常的十倍，为保护幼崽做好准备。
author: mistymagius
source: During summer nights, hundreds of POKENAME appear to find a mate. During this period, its poison becomes ten times more potent in preparation to protect its young.

entry: 繁殖季，POKENAME最多可同时拥有十二个伴侣。POKENAME的力量是雌性的两倍，轻易就能推动小岩块。
author: mistymagius
source: During mating season, POKENAME can have up to twelve mates at once. POKENAME are twice as strong as the females, able to push small boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME栖息的洞穴通常死寂无声，稍有响动便会惊动整个群体。但到了夏末，各地的POKENAME汇集而来，发出嘈杂的吱叫与尖啸，寻找伴侣。
author: jacobtmm
source: POKENAME caves are usually dead silent; the slightest noise will alert the swarm within. However, in late summer, POKENAME gather from all over the region, unleashing a cacophony of chittering screeches in the hopes of finding mates.

entry: POKENAME成群巡逻栖息的洞穴，一有入侵者就不顾一切地撞过去。它们通常守着富含稀有矿物的洞窟。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME patrol the caves where they live, throwing themselves at intruders with reckless abandon. They usually guard caves with large amounts of rare minerals.

entry: POKENAME的爪由有毒金属构成，进入血液就可能致命。它们常彼此切磋，比比谁的铠甲更坚固。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are made of a toxic metal that can be fatal if it enters your bloodstream. They can often be seen sparring with each other, testing whose armor is strongest.

entry: POKENAME天生失明，靠回声定位与飘带感受周围。若遇上不认识的东西，就会试着轻咬一下。
author: melodydelune
source: Being born blind, POKENAME uses echolocation and its ribbons to feel its surroundings. When around something it doesn't recognize, it will nibble it.

entry: 这只宝可梦双目失明，却有着不可思议的本领，能感知周围生物的情绪。
author: supersonicloki
source: This Pokémon is blind as a bat. However, it has an incredible ability to sense the emotions of beings around it.

entry: POKENAME常见于月见山，在黑暗中生活得很好。它们结群收集月之石，用来装饰巢穴。
author: mistymagius
source: Commonly found in Mt. Moon, POKENAME thrive in the darkness. Groups of POKENAME collect Moon Stones to decorate their dens.

entry: POKENAME不断发出尖锐的鸣响，驱退捕食者。若聚成大群，几乎转眼就能让听者的听力永久受损。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly emits a high-pitched ringing noise that deters predators. Large groups of POKENAME will cause permanent hearing loss almost instantly.

entry: 失明的POKENAME，在洞中发出超声波尖叫，靠回声定位狩猎。年岁渐长，尾巴越多，动作也越灵活。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The blind POKENAME uses ultrasonic screams and echolocation to hunt in caves. As it gets older, it grows more tails and in turn becomes more agile.

entry: POKENAME用强劲的牙齿咬碎石块、掘开土层，挖出自己的洞穴，喜欢在地下水源附近安家。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their own caves, using their strong teeth to crush stone and dig through the soil. They prefer making their homes near underground water sources.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡20小时，将全部精力留到夜里尝试飞行。爪上带着细菌，一旦划破皮肤就可能造成危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, putting all its energy into trying to fly during the night. Its claws are coated in bacteria that can be dangerous if they pierce the skin.

entry: 由于另一半身体没有翅膀，POKENAME通常留在地面。旋转时会发出独特的咔哒声，有人推测那是古老的信号。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to the second body's lack of wings, POKENAME usually keeps to the ground. It creates a unique clicking noise as it spins, theorized to be an ancient signal.

entry: POKENAME胆小又看不见，躲在黑暗洞穴，用回声定位感知周围。它会变成天敌的模样，吓退、欺骗对方，可即使变了，仍然失明。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A shy, blind Pokémon, POKENAME hides in dark caves and uses echolocation. It scares and tricks predators by transforming into them, but remains blind.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，却总边振翅边蹦跳，散播毒孢子。吸入这些孢子可能致命。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite not being able to fly, POKENAME is constantly jumping around while flapping its wings. This spreads its poisonous spores, which can be deadly if inhaled.

entry: 紫色触须会分泌一层毒膜，若不洗掉，可能引起严重皮疹。进化前，它会用翅膀包住身体，吊在结实的树枝下。
author: mistymagius
source: Its purple feelers produce a toxic film that can cause severe rashes if not washed off. Before evolution, it wraps itself in its wings and hangs beneath a strong tree branch.

entry: POKENAME在超音蝠家族中虽属罕见，却在大型洞穴系统里颇常见。它总想将猎物一口吞下，哪怕对方大得根本咽不下去。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being a rarity amongst the Zubat family, POKENAME is still quite common in larger cave systems. It will try to swallow its prey whole, even if they are too large to swallow.

entry: 它们喜欢捉弄路过的训练家，不是用长矛戳人，就是让人染上恶疾。若在住家附近看见POKENAME，不出一周，全家都会生病。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon love to play tricks on passing Trainers, either prodding them with its spear or giving them nasty illnesses. If POKENAME is seen near your house, the entire household will fall ill within a week.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在洞壁爬行，巡守巢穴。它们不断吸取猎物的体液，直到自己胀到原来的两倍大。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen crawling on cave walls, patrolling their nests. They drain the fluids out of their prey until they swell to twice their size.

entry: POKENAME拼命往喉咙里塞垃圾，直到皮肤开始撑裂。它们成群在垃圾箱与垃圾桶中筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shoves as much rubbish into its gullet as it can until its skin starts to tear. Groups of POKENAME make their nest in dumpsters and garbage cans.

entry: POKENAME口中渗出的液体，化学性质类似牛排煎熟后渗出的肌红蛋白汁液。科学家正研究它是否有医疗价值。
author: holgast
source: The fluid oozing from POKENAME's mouths is chemically similar to myoglobin, the liquid which leaches out of a cooked steak. Scientists are studying whether it may have medical use.

entry: POKENAME的咬击带毒，单独一口并不危险。可同一个巢穴住着数百万只POKENAME，接着很可能还有至少十二只来咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a toxic bite, which isn't dangerous by itself. However, millions of POKENAME live in the same nest, making it likely that you'll be bitten by at least a dozen more.

entry: POKENAME藏在搁浅船只里，利用独特的轮廓融入残骸。只有伪装被识破，才会施以毒咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides inside beached ships, using its unique silhouette to hide amongst the wreckage. It will only use its venomous bite when its disguise fails.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，无声地从一栋楼跃向另一栋楼，身手惊人。斗篷不易撕裂，能保护POKENAME免遭爪击与撕咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only come out at night, impressively leaping from building to building without making a sound. Its cape is resistant to tearing, which defends POKENAME from claw and biting attacks.

entry: POKENAME靠坚硬的刺攀住洞壁。刺还能注入毒液，若被扎中不止一次，就可能昏倒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tough thorns allow it to cling to cave walls. The thorns also inject poison which can cause fainting if stung more than once.

entry: 被POKENAME咬伤，会感染它的寄生蘑菇。接下来的一年里，蘑菇会慢慢吸尽感染者的生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: Being bitten by a POKENAME causes the body to be infected by its parasitic mushrooms. The mushrooms will slowly drain the life force from anyone infected over the span of a year.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会发出尖锐的叫声，听得太久可能损伤听力。由于看不见，它也靠叫声进行回声定位。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will emit a high-pitched screech that can cause hearing damage if exposed for too long. It uses its cry for echolocation due to its lack of eyesight.

entry: 浑浊的眼睛只能感光，因此夜间繁忙的城市里常有成群POKENAME。它们听力极佳，稍听到危险的声响就会逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: Its cloudy eyes are only able to detect light, so swarms of POKENAME can be seen in busy cities during the night. They have excellent hearing, allowing them to flee at the slightest sound of danger.

entry: 这些修长的宝可梦是高明的猎手，靠回声定位轻松追踪目标。毒咬能在数小时内，让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: These slender Pokémon are expert predators, using echolocation to track prey down with ease. Its toxic bite incapacitates its victims within a matter of hours.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在受污染的水边。体表覆着滑溜的毒膜，便于从天敌手下脱身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be found near polluted waters. It covers its body in a slippery, poisonous film that allows it to escape from predators.

entry: POKENAME带着骇人的狂怒伏击猎物，用利牙撕碎小型宝可梦。若猎物侥幸逃脱，它便会爆发野兽般的怒火。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME ambushes its prey with unsettling fury, ripping small Pokémon apart with its sharp fangs. It flies into a primal rage if its prey somehow escapes.

entry: POKENAME对声音极其敏感，任何巨响都会让它接连暴走数小时。汗液中含有危险的化学物质，似乎只会增强它自身的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very sensitive to sound; any loud sound will cause it to rampage for hours on end. It sweats out a dangerous chemical that only seems to enhance its own strength.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人，仅凭气味便能轻松追踪猎物。它们将吃不完的猎物囤在小型洞穴群中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell and can track its prey effortlessly with its scent alone. Packs of POKENAME hoard their uneaten prey in small cave systems.

entry: POKENAME在浑浊的河湖中结成大群。只需约二十只POKENAME，就能吸干一名训练家全身的体液。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large schools and can be found in murky rivers and lakes. It only takes about twenty POKENAME to drain a Trainer of all of their bodily fluids.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼肌肉，直到强得足以飞翔。锻炼越多，汗液的毒性就越强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are constantly training their muscles until they become strong enough to fly. The more this Pokémon exercises, the more toxic its sweat becomes.

entry: POKENAME虽已不善飞行，却依然一心增强力量。双翼如今成了毒刺，作为巨大蛮力之外的辅助手段。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite losing its ability to fly well, POKENAME is still just as dedicated to increasing its strength. Its wings now act as toxic spines that are just secondary to its massive strength.

entry: POKENAME常吊在洞中植物上，吸收养分，张着嘴捕虫；也会突然俯冲，一口口吞食小虫。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME often hangs onto cave plants, absorbing their nutrients and catching bugs with its open mouth. It also swoops down to eat bugs in mouthfuls.

entry: 它们飞过漆黑洞穴，凭坚固身体横冲直撞，撞碎障碍。被它撞一下，可比挨一口咬更伤。
author: staghorn
source: They fly through pitch-black caves, plowing through obstacles with their durable bodies. Being struck by one is more injurious than being bitten.

entry: POKENAME有个怪习惯：攀在高高的崖壁上，再落到毫无防备的受害者身上。岩石般的颚力道惊人，连小汽车也能咬碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a weird habit of clinging to high cliff walls, then dropping themselves onto unsuspecting victims. Its rocky jaws have enough power to crush a small car.

entry: 它发出低沉音调，感知周围。这声音令人不安，也被恐怖电影用来烘托惊悚气氛。
author: .izik
source: It makes a low tone to view its surroundings. This tone is unsettling and has been used in horror movies to cause unease.

entry: POKENAME的毒液带电，若不处理，可能造成麻痹。夜里，常能见到它们成群啃咬电线。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's venom is charged with electricity which can cause paralysis if untreated. Flocks of these Pokémon can be seen gnawing on powerlines during the night.

entry: POKENAME吞食的电力越多，几个头之间的磁力就越强。三个头都贪吃极了，总为猎物争执。
author: mistymagius
source: The more electricity POKENAME consumes, the stronger the magnetic pull between the heads becomes. All three heads are extremely greedy and are constantly fighting over prey.

entry: POKENAME无法行走，飞行时会把珍贵的大葱叼在嘴里。它的毒液会渗入大葱，让大葱变成战斗中实用的武器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk, so it holds its precious leek in its mouth while it flies. Its venom ends up poisoning the leek, making it a useful weapon in battle.

entry: POKENAME找到什么都吃，哪怕无法一口吞下。翅膀虽小，仍能轻松在离地约十英尺处飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes anything it can find, even if it can't swallow its food whole. Despite how small its wings are, it is able to comfortably fly about ten feet off the ground.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处挖隧道，靠回声定位穿过漆黑的通道。獠牙坚硬无比，连厚钢板也能刺穿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tunnel deep underground, using echolocation to navigate its pitch-black tunnels. Its rock-hard fangs are tough enough to pierce through thick steel.

entry: 强健的下肢肌肉与长尾，让它们能轻易扑向猎物。利齿之下，骨头也会轻松碎裂。
author: markusknight
source: They can leap on their prey with ease, using massive muscles of the lower body and a long tail. Bones are crushed with ease beneath their sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃像用鲨鱼牙齿制成的剑。它们会伏击猎物，肆意劈砍，因为掉落的牙齿很快就能重新长出来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With blades that resemble shark tooth swords, POKENAME ambush and hack at prey with abandon, as they quickly grow lost teeth back.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是古代宫殿王座厅守卫的宝可梦。直到今天，它似乎仍在执行首领的命令。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to have belonged to the guards of an ancient palace's throne room. It seems to follow its leader's orders to this day.

entry: 自古以来，人们对它既惧怕又仰慕。POKENAME兼具混混鳄的咬劲与伦琴猫的速度，栖息在炎热地区的河边，位居食物链顶端。
author: milchik
source: Since ancient times, this Pokémon has been feared and admired in equal measure. Combining the bite force of Krokorok and speed of Luxray, POKENAME lives near rivers in hot regions where it dominates the food chain.

entry: 某些古代文明曾为卡拉卡拉制作金面具，代替头骨佩戴。面具赋予奇异的力量，让它们变成POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Some ancient cultures crafted golden masks for Cubone to wear instead of skulls. These masks granted them strange powers, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: 这个幽灵徘徊于自己的墓地，哀悼着逝去的生命。脸上的葬面具，是仅存的身份印记。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This spirit wanders its burial site, mourning its passing. Its burial mask is all that remains of its identity.

entry: POKENAME戴着面具，藏起生前的身份。驯服后，它们便是强悍的信使，能跨越长途，将信送达。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME wear masks to hide who they were in life. Once tamed, they are fierce messengers, able to traverse long distances to deliver a letter.

entry: POKENAME被幽冥之水吸引，夜里会举行神秘仪式。据说，目睹者将遭遇不幸。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is drawn to spectral waters, performing mysterious rituals at night. Those who witness these rituals are said to encounter misfortune.

entry: POKENAME嫉妒受害者仍能活在人世，夜里在他们卧室外哀哭尖叫，以恐惧为食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Jealous of the lives of its victims, POKENAME wails and screams outside their bedrooms at night to feed on their fear.

entry: 幽灵般的身体被自身过高的体温熔化。有人认为，这就是岩浆之灵的模样。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly body melted from the sheer heat of its body temperature. Some people believe this to be the form of the spirit of magma.

entry: 据说，武士的灵魂附在自己的葬面具与生前佩剑上，至今仍为战败，深感绝望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior possesses its funeral mask and sword it wielded while it was alive. It still despairs that it lost the war.

entry: 据说，武士的亡魂仍带着生前的剑，悲悼自己为之奋战的王国，早已不复存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior carries the sword that it wielded in life. It mourns that the kingdom it fought for no longer exists.

entry: 这把仪式用剑，被幽灵附身，徘徊地下墓穴，寻找更多祭品，尤其喜欢盯上盗墓者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A ceremonial blade haunted by a spirit. It wanders catacombs in search of more victims to sacrifice, especially grave robbers.

entry: 没人敢看POKENAME铠甲里面，就连它自己的训练家，也不敢。
author: tomatosalad
source: Nobody dares look within POKENAME's armor. Not even its own Trainers.

entry: 永不熄灭的火焰慢慢熔化灵魂的蜡面具，生前记忆也随之模糊，直至彻底遗忘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As an eternal flame melts the wax mask of this spirit, its memory of its life becomes fuzzier until it forgets it completely.

entry: 据说，好几只哭哭面具的灵魂合在一起，成了POKENAME。它再也弄不清自己是谁，那些带着的面具，只能徒增痛苦。
author: ethewriter
source: It's said the souls of multiple Yamask combined, creating POKENAME. Its identity is compromised, so the masks it carries only cause them anguish.

entry: 古代人会照着逝去亲人的面容，为POKENAME制作面具。面具属于谁，这只宝可梦便会守护谁的墓。
author: melodydelune
source: Ancient civilizations would craft masks of departed loved ones for POKENAME. This Pokémon will guard the burial site of the person their mask matches.

entry: 身体没有固定形态，让POKENAME能接上各种古老机关，也因此很受盗墓者欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its amorphous shape, POKENAME can connect with all kinds of ancient mechanisms. For this reason, it is very popular with grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME是一群幽灵，靠吸收闹鬼之物与凶地的灵力为生。入夜后，常能看见它们聚集在墓地。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are spirits that absorb the spiritual energy of haunted objects and areas. They can be found swarming burial sites at night.

entry: 为这只幽灵铸造金身的古代文明相信，POKENAME象征着太阳周而复始的“死亡与重生”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to beliefs of the ancient civilization who created the golden body for this spirit, POKENAME symbolizes the 'Death and Rebirth Cycle' of the sun.

entry: 金色王冠在阳光下闪耀，诱着毫无戒心的人深入沼泽。面具上，则戴着那些迷失者的脸。
author: zagreus8
source: Its golden crown glitters in the sun, luring unsuspecting people deeper into swamps. It wears the faces of those lost on its mask.

entry: 它们曾在酷热的沙漠烈日下丧命，如今戴着仙人掌形的面具，纪念自己的死亡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These spirits passed under the sweltering desert sun. They wear cactus-shaped masks in memoriam of their passing.

entry: 月光之夜，有人说听见过POKENAME幽异的旋律。据说，听见它歌声的人注定会死。
author: inksans201x
source: On moonlit nights, some people claim to hear the haunting melody of POKENAME. It's said that those who hear its song are fated to die.

entry: POKENAME看似一个自带磁场的古老电池盒，由囚禁其中的灵魂供能。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME appears to be an ancient form of a battery case with its own magnetic field, powered by a spirit trapped within.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: lyman
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: oxitape.
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.

entry: POKENAME是不得安息的灵魂，会让猎物入睡，再潜入其心中，重温做梦的感觉。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A restless spirit, POKENAME puts to sleep and enters the mind of its victims to remember what it was like to dream.

entry: 它用角袭击小型猎物，以特殊毒液夺取能量，储存在体内，再化作电力自卫。
author: skymaster426
source: It attacks small prey with its horn, sapping their energy with a special poison it secretes. It then stores the energy in its body to convert into electricity for defense.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME柔软蓬松的毛发储着能量，微微作响。在地面蹦跳时，静电不断积攒，让毛间噼啪迸出电火花。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in soft fluffy fur that hums with stored energy. As it jumps across the ground, static builds up, causing its fur to crackle and spark.

entry: POKENAME会附在人类或其他宝可梦身上，慢慢吸取生命能量。一旦黏住猎物，就很难再剥下POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME attaches itself to other Pokémon or humans to slowly drain their life energy. It is difficult to detach POKENAME from the prey once attached.

entry: POKENAME藏在玻璃身体里保护自己，也把它当作发电机供能。因此能像手臂般操纵丝线，甚至拿来当腿走路。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME protects itself behind a glass body, which it also uses as a dynamo to produce electricity. Thanks to this, it can control its threads like arms and even use them as legs to move around.

entry: POKENAME常在虫类繁多的地方结网。蛛网导电性极佳，它能沿丝线放电，灼烧猎物。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found spinning webs in areas populated by bugs. Its webs are very conductive, so it can send a shock through the string to burn prey.

entry: POKENAME将特殊的肢体折成花苞状。猎物靠近，POKENAME便伸肢抓住，再用毒制服。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME fold their specialized limbs into a form that resembles the bud of a flower. When their prey approach, POKENAME will use these limbs to grasp the target and subdue them with their poison.

entry: 吸收了电气石洞穴一块水晶的能量后，POKENAME长得庞大无比，却仍带着那块水晶，走到哪里也不放下。
author: nellnast42
source: After absorbing energy from a crystal from Chargestone Cave, POKENAME has grown to enormous sizes. It still carries around this crystal, though.

entry: 它用翅膀摩擦毛茸茸的身体，积攒静电，再以耳朵引导电流，释放强劲的电磁波。
author: staghorn
source: It builds up static electricity by brushing its wings against its furry body. It can unleash its built-up charge in a powerful Thunder Wave by directing the electrical discharge with its ears.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，用满是尖刺的身躯与锋利尾巴保卫家园。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are quite territorial. They use their spiky bodies and sharp tails to defend their home.

entry: POKENAME既会重击受害者，也能发射尖刺。它最擅长对付披甲的敌人，吸收对方身上的金属。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fires off spikes in addition to bludgeoning its victims. It excels against armored opponents and absorbs their metal.

entry: POKENAME藏在带刺的金属铠甲中。有些民间传说认为，甲壳下面，是一个怀恨的亡魂。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is encased in thorny metal armor that covers its interior. Some folk tales suspect a vengeful spirit lies beneath the armor.

entry: 为保护钥匙，POKENAME会以带刺的身体冲撞来犯的窃贼。最爱的钥匙往往来自废弃花园小屋。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME protect their keys from robbers by charging them with their thorny bodies. Their favorite keys often come from abandoned garden shacks.

entry: POKENAME不爱与其他宝可梦贴得太近，便让全身长满倒刺。若侧耳细听，还能听见面具里传来轻轻的哼唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME covers itself with barbs as it hates being too close to other Pokémon. If you listen closely, you can hear soft humming coming from its mask.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，想靠尖刺，让周围土地萌发生机。可它离开后留下的土，却往往粗硬不平。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground in hopes of germinating the surrounding area with its spikes. Often, the soil it leaves behind is coarse and tough.

entry: 獠牙与剃刀般的尖齿，让它咬劲极强。偏又喜欢咬着玩，害许多训练家受过伤。
author: melodydelune
source: Its combination of tusks and razor-sharp teeth gives this Pokémon an intense bite force. It plays by nibbling, causing many injuries to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME会在树上刻下独有的记号，标示领地。刀刃虽会崩口，重新长好后，却更加强韧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME marks its territory by etching its unique signature in trees. Its blade chips but grows back stronger.

entry: 它们用獠牙在树上划出深痕，标记领地。也有人见过POKENAME在石头上磨利尾巴的某些部位。
author: elite01.
source: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. POKENAME have also been spotted sharpening parts of their tails on rocks.

entry: POKENAME用利爪爬上树，平日多在林冠间滑翔。坚硬的獠牙，则用来威吓敌人。
author: nyandogegaming
source: Using its clawed hands to climb trees, POKENAME are usually found gliding around the canopies in forests. Its hard tusks are used to deter foes.

entry: 头冠、獠牙与背甲由极其坚硬耐用的金属构成。沿洞壁留下的划痕，就能看出POKENAME曾走过哪里。
author: holgast
source: Its crest, tusks and back plates are composed of an extremely durable and hard metal. One can see where a POKENAME has been by the scratches it leaves along cave walls.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头彼此厌恶，总打个不停。若能把它们教得齐心协力，便足以证明训练家精于培育龙宝可梦。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's two heads hate each other and fight constantly. Owning a POKENAME whose heads cooperate is a mark of a skilled Dragon-type Trainer.

entry: POKENAME凶猛不屈，因此被某些文化融入传统。战时，人们会陈列这种宝可梦的石像。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for a fierce and unyielding nature, earning it a place in the traditions of some cultures. Stone statues of this Pokémon are displayed during times of war.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是失落地下文明中走失的孩子。研究者远远跟随，盼它能带领他们找到它的故乡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be a lost child of a lost underground civilization. Researchers follow it from afar in hopes it will lead them to its home.

entry: 古时，POKENAME被奉为圣殿的守护者，站在刻有复杂谜题的石板旁，只为考验旅人而醒来。唯有最聪慧的人，才能解谜获准入内。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME were revered as guardians of sacred temples in ancient times. They would stand near tablets inscribed with intricate riddles, awakening only to challenge travelers. Only the most intelligent could solve their puzzles and gain entry.

entry: 材料虽极其致密，它仍保有天然雀出色的跳跃本领。POKENAME能长久纹丝不动，看起来只是一尊普通石像，直到危险来临才会行动。
author: elfail0
source: It still retains the great hopping capabilities of a Natu, despite being made of incredibly dense materials. POKENAME can stay incredibly still for long periods of time, appearing as nothing more than a simple stone idol until danger approaches.

entry: POKENAME靠来源不明的能源运转。大尾巴充当导管，窃取小型电子设备的电力，再将损坏的东西藏进高高的树枝间。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: POKENAME runs off an energy source of unknown origin. It uses its large tail as a conduit to steal power from small electronics, then stashes the broken items in tree branches high off the ground.

entry: 栖息遗迹中的考古资料显示，POKENAME自诞生之初便与孩子结伴，充当守护者。如今常见它们搜寻各处壁龛与隐蔽角落，寻找失散的伙伴。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: Archeological data gathered from ruins that were home to POKENAME suggest they were bonded to a child from birth, serving as a guardian and protector. They are often seen searching various alcoves and hidden spots, trying to find their lost partners.

entry: 栖息遗迹中的考古资料显示，POKENAME自诞生之初便与孩子结伴，充当守护者。如今常见它们搜寻各处壁龛与隐蔽角落，寻找失散的伙伴。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: Archeological data gathered from ruins that were home to POKENAME suggest they were bonded to a child from birth, serving as a guardian and protector. They are often seen searching various alcoves and hidden spots, trying to find their lost partners.

entry: POKENAME发达的双臂能挥出毁灭性的拳击，位置却长得不合适，常在打斗时把自己绊倒。随着长大，体重分布改变，这个问题才渐渐缓解。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: While POKENAME are capable of delivering devastating punches with their highly developed arms, the unfortunate placement of these appendages often trips them up mid-fight. As they age, their weight distribution changes to help counteract this issue.

entry: 这种融合体酷似许多遗迹中的雕像，相似得令人发毛。一旦接到命令，就会不眠不休地执行，永不疲倦，还能借幻术隐秘行事。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion is eerily close in appearance to carved idols found in a number of ruins. When given an order, it will carry it out relentlessly, never resting or tiring. Its power over illusions allows it to do this work very discreetly.

entry: POKENAME从脚底喷出能量，瞬间加速。可身体太重，POKENAME在半空无法转向，常以惊人的冲击力撞上东西。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: POKENAME are able to channel energy from the soles of their feet into explosive bursts of speed. However, due to their weight, POKENAME lack the ability to change direction mid-flight, often causing them to slam into things with very alarming force.

entry: 尾巴既擅长挖掘，也擅长游泳。它们热心帮助人类，启发古代文明发明了铲子与船桨。
author: markusknight
source: Their tails are equally good at digging and swimming. They eagerly helped people and inspired the creation of shovels and oars in ancient civilizations.

entry: 人们先在古代壁画上发现了POKENAME的形象，很久之后才见到活体。腹部催眠般的纹样也曾被画作装饰。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME was first discovered on ancient wall paintings, with the living species being discovered much later. The hypnotic pattern on their abdomen has been depicted as ornaments.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，能长久游泳，关节间放出亮光。休息时，便会停机，沉眠于河床与湖底。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is full of energy. They swim for prolonged periods of time, shining bright from its joints. When the time comes to rest, they shut down and hibernate on the river and lake beds.

entry: POKENAME生活在某些古代遗址。它的形状与墙上的孔洞相合，因此可能是开启特定机关的钥匙。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in certain ancient sites. Due to its shape and matching holes on the walls, it could have been used as a key for specific mechanisms.

entry: POKENAME稳稳滚过古迹长廊。若碰撞受损，就会搜集新材料，修补自己。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME rolls steadily through the corridors of ancient ruins. If it suffers damage due to collisions, it can collect new material for repairs.

entry: POKENAME的外壳模仿小箭雀，避免遭其他鸟宝可梦攻击。临近进化时，身体摸起来会暖暖的。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's outer shell mimics a Fletchling to dissuade other bird Pokémon from attacking it. Its body will become warm to the touch when it is ready for evolution.

entry: 这只小宝可梦虽有翅膀，却更爱在地上走。它很容易与其他小宝可梦交朋友，还愿分享食物。
author: holzycookie
