source: Despite having wings, this little Pokémon likes to walk around on the ground. It easily befriends other small Pokémon, sharing its food with them.

entry: POKENAME背上的蛋用来引诱猎物。POKENAME通过蛋分泌麻痹毒素，等猎物动弹不得，再用燃烧的藤蔓烤熟。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The egg on the back of POKENAME is used as a lure for its prey. POKENAME secretes a paralysing poison through the egg, and while its prey is immobilised, it will cook them with its fiery vines.

entry: POKENAME看着像海中植物，其实是靠拟态引诱猎物的虫宝可梦。碰一下，便会严重灼伤。
author: hellaluyeah
source: While POKENAME looks like a marine plant, it is actually a Bug-type Pokémon drawing in prey with mimicry. It causes serious burns on contact.

entry: 当地人也把POKENAME称作“太阳之滴”。它能从刀刃喷出火焰，温度高达华氏5500度。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun Drop" by locals. It expels flames from its blade up to 5,500 degrees F.

entry: POKENAME是一只庞大的幼虫，梦想有朝一日，进化成威风的巨龙。身上的尖刺，则由永不融化的冰构成。
author: voxposs
source: A humongous larva, POKENAME dreams about evolving into a mighty dragon someday. Its spikes are made of ice that never melts.

entry: POKENAME通过头上的红刺散发体热，也能将烫刺射向敌人，造成剧烈的疼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME radiates its internal body heat through the red thorns on its head. It can fire its hot thorns at its opponents, causing excruciating pain.

entry: 它用沉重的炮管射出水流，将敌人推得远远的。这也是POKENAME保护柔软肚皮的唯一办法。
author: voxposs
source: This larva uses heavy cannons to shoot water streams and push enemies far away. That's the only way POKENAME can protect their soft belly.

entry: POKENAME用长舌缠住洞中的岩台，在石块之间荡来荡去，再凭声波，寻找黑暗中的下一个落点。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to wrap around ledges in caves and swing from stone to stone. It uses sound waves to locate its next target in the darkness.

entry: 身躯太庞大，POKENAME飞得并不好，却仍会跳下悬崖，盼着展翅翱翔，最后只能一路摔到崖底。
author: capwolfbane
source: Given its bulk, it cannot fly well. Despite this, POKENAME jump off cliffs hoping to soar, only to tumble to the bottom.

entry: POKENAME从不闭嘴，能塞进嘴的东西全吃。也因此，翅膀失去了作用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME never closes its mouth and consumes anything that fits inside. Its wings are nonfunctional as a consequence.

entry: POKENAME在新月之夜最活跃，飞行无声。獠牙太钝，咬不进猎物的身体，只好留些红色树果咬着，装出凶狠吓人的样子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Most active on nights with a new moon, POKENAME fly without making a sound. Their fangs are too dull to properly bite into prey, so they instead keep around red berries to bite into, trying to play tough and appear intimidating.

entry: 它们协力捕倒猎物，再吸食鲜血。每只POKENAME都要吸干100个受害者，才肯心满意足。
author: darkweavile428
source: They work together to bring down prey and feed on their blood. Each POKENAME is not satisfied until it has completely drained 100 victims.

entry: POKENAME虽然弱小，尖叫却能令人毛骨悚然，连最强的敌人也会被吓退。它常住在有水的洞穴里。
author: canada
source: Although it is weak, POKENAME can produce a bloodcurdling scream that scares away the toughest of foes. It is often found in aquatic caves.

entry: POKENAME用发达的声带模仿其他宝可梦的叫声，再以幻象遮身，诱来猎物。等毫无防备的目标近到看见幻象消散，已经太迟。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their expanded vocal chords to mimic the cries of other Pokémon, cloaking themselves in an illusion and crying out to lure in prey. By the time the unsuspecting prey get close enough to see the illusion fade, it is too late.

entry: 它每次进食，最多能喝下10盎司鲜血。咬下之前，飘带能帮忙，把猎物牢牢缠住。
author: melodydelune
source: It drinks up to 10 ounces of blood during any feeding. Its ribbons makes it easier to hold its prey before it bites.

entry: POKENAME口腔极大，双翼也巨大无比，能掀起强风自卫。超音蝠会躲进它嘴里，避开想收服自己的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME has an incredibly large oral cavity and a huge pair of wings which it can use to generate strong winds to protect itself. Zubat seek shelter in its mouth to hide from Trainers that try to capture them.

entry: POKENAME攀在洞顶耐心等候，从上方扑向猎物，再用腹部的嘴将其吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME clings to the ceiling of caves, patiently waiting for prey. It pounces on its prey from above, devouring them with the mouth on its belly.

entry: POKENAME嘴的两侧各有大脑，常为要吃什么争斗。双方打架时夹进嘴里的东西，反而成了大部分养分的来源。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two sides of a POKENAME's mouth each have their own brain, which often leads to them fighting over what they want to eat. Most of their nourishment comes from anything caught between the two sides while they are fighting each other.

entry: POKENAME先高速滚动，再奋力振翅，将自己弹向空中。它们从上方张大嘴捉住毫无防备的猎物，咬紧牙，再一路滚走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME roll at incredible speeds before flapping their wings hard enough to launch themselves into the air. They open their mouths as wide as they can to capture unsuspecting prey from above, sinking their teeth into them and rolling away.

entry: 它常住洞穴深处。对老练矿工来说，发现POKENAME，就意味着附近很可能有矿。
author: supersonicloki
source: It is often found deep in caves. Finding a POKENAME is a sign of nearby ore deposits to veteran miners.

entry: 它喜欢用关节技制住对手。待猎物虚弱下来，再吸干鲜血，作最后一击。
author: chazzwozzer32
source: This Pokémon likes to put its opponents in submission holds. When its prey is weakened, it will finish it off by draining its blood.

entry: POKENAME摇摇摆摆地走着，徒劳拍打叶片，想要飞起来。平衡虽差，速度却出奇地快，常趁猎物不备，突然咬下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME awkwardly waddle about while flapping their leaves in futile attempts to fly. Despite their lack of traditional balance, they still possess a surprising level of speed, managing to sink their teeth into prey when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME住在海蚀洞里，躲进暗角，等待猎物游过，再将其拖回洞中，吸上好几个小时的血。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME live in sea caves, hiding in dark corners and waiting for prey to swim by. It drags its prey into its cave and sucks its blood for hours.

entry: POKENAME有时会陷入存在的迷惘。严重时，就四肢摊开、仰面躺下，低低嘀咕一声：“唉……”
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is prone to periods of existential crisis. When this problem worsens, it lies down flat on its back and a faint sound mutters out: "Man".

entry: 它通过活动身体发电，因此十分活跃。等电力释放完，又会变得懒洋洋，直到重新充足。
author: staghorn
source: It generates electricity by moving its body and is quite active as a result. Once it unleashes its charge, it is lethargic until it recharges.

entry: POKENAME扁得几乎难用肉眼看见。科学家发现，它甚至比纸和人的发丝还薄。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is so flat that it is barely visible to the human eye. Scientists have found that it is thinner than paper and human hair.

entry: 铠甲比已知的任何金属都坚韧，让人怀疑，它根本来自另一个世界。挖掘宝石时，动作又几乎如机械一般。
author: pepperthepirate
source: Its armor is tougher than any known metal, making some believe it came from another world entirely. It digs for gems in an almost mechanical fashion.

entry: POKENAME栖息在不见天日的深洞，双眼却极其敏锐。全身晶体发出微光，让它能在居住的地下水池里觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Living in deep caves far from any sunlight, POKENAME has nevertheless developed extremely sensitive eyes. The crystal growths across its body produce a dim light that allows it to find food in the underground pools it lives in.

entry: POKENAME用楔石上宝石般的外层，欺骗毫无防备的宝可梦。只要靠得太近，POKENAME就会从宝石里跳出来吓对方。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME uses the gem-like coating over its keystone as a way to trick unsuspecting Pokémon. If a Pokémon gets too close, POKENAME will pop out of the gem to frighten it.

entry: 信赖的勾魂眼化作镰刀，伴POKENAME四处寻找腐化的灵魂。据说，击败幽灵属性宝可梦后，它们会更强，仿佛镰刀以死亡本身为动力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their trusted Sableye having taken the form of their scythe, POKENAME wander in search of corrupted souls. It is said they grow stronger after defeating Ghost-Types, as if their scythe is powered by death itself.

entry: 贪婪的POKENAME藏在洞穴深处，埋身财宝堆。人类或宝可梦只要靠得太近，宝物便会被它夺走。
author: pizzarcato
source: The covetous POKENAME lurks in the depths of caves, buried in a pile of riches. It collects the treasures of people and Pokémon who come too close.

entry: POKENAME脸上的宝石状甲片，由特殊分泌物结晶而成。必须蜕下，POKENAME才能继续生长，掉落的甲片深受收藏家追捧。
author: alumed
source: The gem-like plate on the face of POKENAME is formed by the crystalization of specialized secretions and must be shed to allow POKENAME to grow. Shed plates are highly sought-after by collectors.

entry: POKENAME外表虽凶，内心却温柔无私。POKENAME会用坚硬无比的宝石甲片堵住隧道，保护小型宝可梦免遭捕食。
author: alumed
source: Despite their fearsome appearance, POKENAME are selfless, gentle creatures. POKENAME will block tunnel entrances using their incredibly hard gem-like plate to protect smaller Pokémon from predators.

entry: POKENAME疯狂挖掘地下隧道，寻找可吸收的宝石，也会袭击矿工，抢走他们采得的宝物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME feverishly mines underground tunnels in search for gemstones to absorb. It also assaults miners for the gems they've found.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: 传说，有头巨兽游荡在最幽暗的洞穴，遇见它的人从此不知所终。有人相信，它会将猎物的灵魂变成宝石，再吞下。
author: ravendragons
source: Legends speak of a beast who wanders the darkest caverns, and those who encounter it are never seen again. Some believe that it turns the souls of its prey into gemstones and eats them.

entry: POKENAME常守在古墓，喜爱囤积古代君王的陪葬财宝。它会以浓重的沙暴掩住墓穴，不让人发现所在。
author: mistymagius
source: Usually found guarding ancient tombs, POKENAME loves hoarding the buried loot once held by ancient kings. It will conceal the tomb in a thick sandstorm to hide its location.

entry: POKENAME常藏在深洞，囤积宝物，再用这堆财宝作诱饵，把猎物引回巢。
author: scapz
source: POKENAME is often found in deep caves, hoarding its treasure. It uses its hoard to lure prey into its lair.

entry: POKENAME将最大的宝石制成特殊的环，装在最先进的无人机上，用来搜寻大批宝藏。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME fashions a special ring with its biggest gem and mounts it onto its most advanced drone, which it uses to locate massive amounts of treasure.

entry: 宝石太大，吞不进体内，POKENAME就背在身上。若受威胁，便吐出钱币与宝石迎击。
author: neonriser
source: If a gemstone is too big to store inside its body, POKENAME carries it on its back instead. It spits out coins and gems to whatever threatens it.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全由水晶构成。为了躲避觊觎水晶的人类猎杀，POKENAME开始迁入水下洞穴的深处。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME's body is almost entirely made up of crystal. POKENAME have started to live deep in underwater caves to avoid being hunted for its crystals by humans.

entry: POKENAME用各种金属与最珍贵的宝石，打造闪亮的无人机，帮助寻找更多宝石，也能协助战斗。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME fashions its most precious gems into glittering drones using various metals. These drones then help it find more gems, or aid it in battle.

entry: POKENAME喜欢给无人机试配不同的宝石组合。最受宠的那一台，往往会被升级得远胜其他。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME loves to experiment with different gem combinations with its drones. The one it likes the most is often upgraded far beyond the others.

entry: 据说，古时有只贪心的勾魂眼想偷哭哭面具的面具，结果受到惩罚，变成了POKENAME。
author: eminemace
source: It's said that long ago, a greedy Sableye tried to steal the mask of a Yamask. This incident caused it to be turned into POKENAME as a punishment.

entry: POKENAME只住在最晶亮、财宝与宝石最多的洞穴。它在其中伪装身形，等待毫无防备的寻宝者。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is only found in the shiniest caves with the most treasures and gemstones. In those caves, it camouflages itself to wait for unsuspecting treasure hunters.

entry: POKENAME四处搜寻贵重物件，藏在嘴里。可若吞得太多，就会接连数周飞不起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts for all sorts of valuable items to store in its mouth. If it consumes too much however, it will become grounded for weeks on end.

entry: 流传甚广的一种说法认为，这种融合体，是很久以前统治丰缘的邪恶君王，转世而来。
author: 8xviktor
source: A popular theory has been floating around that suggests this fusion is the reincarnation of an evil king that ruled Hoenn long ago.

entry: 有人推测，勾魂眼会收集珍贵宝石，搭建一个魔像。等它们外出找更多宝石，魔像便负责守住财宝。
author: tokenoracle
source: Theory suggests Sableye will gather precious gemstones to construct a golem.  It's tasked with protecting the hoard when they go and gather more gems.

entry: POKENAME用水晶，把地质学家引入洞中，再将他们困进地下洞窟。大多数人，终生都没能逃出。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lure geologists into caves with crystals. It then captures the humans and traps them in a underground cavern from which most never escape.

entry: POKENAME常与进化前的勾魂星合作，引诱、捕捉地质学家。POKENAME盯紧这些人，谁想逃跑，便受到惩罚。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often lures and captures geologists with its pre-evolution, Sableanie. POKENAME keeps track of the humans, punishing those who try to escape.

entry: 双拳覆着一层钻石，出拳威力惊人。它渴求珍贵的宝石，为了寻找它们，甚至会摧毁整座山。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fists are coated in a layer of diamonds, which makes its punches absolutely devastating. It desires precious gemstones and will destroy entire mountains in search of them.

entry: POKENAME痴迷敛财，见多少囤多少。哪怕只丢了一枚钱币，也会横冲直撞，直到那枚硬币物归原主。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME obsessively hoards as much wealth as it can find. If even a single coin is stolen, it will rampage across the land until it is returned.

entry: POKENAME的宝石外壳被走私者视若珍宝，却从无人能在上面留下一道划痕。那也是POKENAME唯一会奋力守护的东西。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's gemstone shell is highly valued by traffickers, but nobody was able to even scratch it. It's the only thing POKENAME will fiercely fight for.

entry: POKENAME笼罩在宝石粉末形成的闪亮云雾里。据说，只需一眼，就能控制贪婪之人的心智。
author: staghorn
source: The bodies of POKENAME are shrouded in glittering clouds made of pulverized gemstones. It is said that they can dominate the minds of greedy people with a single look.

entry: 这种融合体很聪明，先把岩石宝可梦催眠，再将其吃掉。颈部的毛，竟由纯粹坚硬的钻石构成。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This is an intelligent fusion that uses hypnosis to put Rock-type Pokémon to sleep, then eats them. Its neck fur is made of pure, hard diamond.

entry: POKENAME头上的大触角，能感知近处的振动。再毒的植物，它也照吃不误。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a large antenna on its head with which it can locate vibrations in its immediate vicinity. It can eat even the most poisonous plants.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在毒草上，吸收毒性。到了夜晚，再借这些毒，展开凶猛狩猎。
author: chorb33
source: During the day, POKENAME sleeps on poisonous plants to absorb their toxicity. It uses this at night to go on a fierce hunt.

entry: POKENAME身上连着巨大的毒囊，受到威胁便会释放烈毒。被逼入绝境时，还会紧抓尾巴，摆出威吓的姿势，赶走来敌。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a large poison sac attached to its body, which it uses to deliver potent venom when threatened. When feeling cornered, it grips its tail tightly, using it as an intimidation tactic to ward off potential threats.

entry: POKENAME能抵御恶劣环境，在世界各地生活。沙漠中的POKENAME吃仙人掌，沼泽中的则靠啃蕨类与荨麻维生。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's resilience to the elements allows it to thrive in many corners of the world. Desert POKENAME enjoy a diet of cacti, while marshland POKENAME nibble away at ferns and nettles to survive.

entry: 这是长着两颗头的百足蜈蚣。由于大多个体活不长，极其难得一见。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: A two-headed form of Venipede. They are exceptionally rare to find, as most don't live for very long.

entry: POKENAME不算好斗，毛发却会分泌剧毒。它也有些微弱的超能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not particularly aggressive, but its fur produces a highly poisonous secretion. It also has weak psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着毒膜，碰触会刺激皮肤。若腹部花纹所在的位置被攻击刺破，就会分泌更猛烈的毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is covered in a toxic film which is irritating to the touch. If the pattern on its belly is punctured by an attack, it will secrete a more potent poison.

entry: POKENAME能凭空变出隐形物体，只有腹部的眼睛看得见。POKENAME很喜欢圆形的东西，尤其着迷于旋转的动作。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME are able to conjure invisible objects out of thin air that only the eye on their stomach can see. POKENAME are very fond of circular objects; they are especially interested in spinning motions.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: chorb33
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: chorb33
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: POKENAME以恶作剧出名。它会躲在阴影中纠缠受害者，等待最佳的出手时机。项链上旋转的珠子拥有强大的催眠能力，能让受害者沉睡长达2周。
author: kianjp2008
source: Known for its mischievous pranks, POKENAME haunts victims from the shadows before it finds the perfect opportunity to strike. The spinning beads on its necklace have powerful hypnotic powers, able to put victims to sleep for up to 2 weeks.

entry: POKENAME平时不动，进攻时却会蜷成球撞向敌人，接触的瞬间喷火，烧得地面焦黑，余火闷燃。
author: kriznick
source: While usually motionless, POKENAME form a ball to crash into opponents, spewing fire on impact. The resulting blaze leaves the ground scorched and smoldering.

entry: POKENAME常在湖岸歇息，与环境浑然一体，被误认成石头。口渴时才滚到水边，吓旁观者一跳。
author: kriznick
source: Often mistaken for stones, POKENAME rest by lakeshores, blending seamlessly with their surroundings. When thirsty, they roll to the water's edge, startling onlookers.

entry: POKENAME其实是两只宝可梦，由不明力量连在一起。遇到威胁时，双方相互旋转摩擦，蓄足劲后放出储存的庞大能量攻击。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME is actually two Pokémon held together by an unknown source. When threatened they will both begin spinning against each other to build up enough friction to release massive stored up energy attacks.

entry: 轮子般的脚让它时速最高可达六十英里。但多数时候，它只悠悠前进，节省体力。
author: staghorn
source: It can use its wheel-like feet to reach speeds of up to sixty miles per hour. Most of the time, however, it moves at a leisurely pace in order to conserve energy.

entry: 两只车轮球融合，让它更加稳当，速度也更快。可换来这些好处，也牺牲了几分灵活。
author: soup1900
source: It's a Whirlipede that fused with itself, giving it more stability and speed. However, it sacrificed some of its maneuverability for these boosts.

entry: 中央的大个子，是群体首领，四周的小个子负责载着它移动，模样就像一辆车。
author: soup1900
source: The big one in the middle is the leader of the pack. The small ones around it carry it around. They move around similarly to a car.

entry: POKENAME安静地待在林间，与环境相融。若受惊扰，就会猛冲过去，用黑暗能量诅咒入侵者。
author: kriznick
source: POKENAME remain still and serene in their groves, blending into the environment. If disturbed, they rush forward to curse intruders with dark energy.

entry: 连崎岖不平的路，POKENAME也能滚过去。因此，在举办宝可梦拉力赛的地方，格外受欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can even roll over uneven terrain. There are places where Pokémon rally races are held, where POKENAME is particularly popular.

entry: POKENAME体内的毒素，能从全身孔隙释放。哪怕只碰一下，也会中毒，痛苦难忍。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME produces toxins in its body, which it can release through pores all over its body. Just touching it leads to painful poisoning.

entry: 它贴在墙上，监看闯入者。一有动静，便飞扑而下，咬住对方，注入致命毒液。
author: skymaster426
source: It sticks to walls to keep an eye out for intruders. Whenever any enters, it flies down and bites any parts of their bodies, injecting a fatal poison.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会斩伤、毒害一切闯入者。即使敌人逃出领地，也会追击不休，直到将其杀死。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, slicing and poisoning any and all invaders. Even those who flee its territory are continuously pursued until slain.

entry: POKENAME栖居森林，身上刺目的颜色，便是对闯入者的警告。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME resides in forests. Its harsh colors are a warning to trespassers.

entry: 它夜里飞过森林，双眼如雷达般搜寻。POKENAME一发现猎物，就从远处射出麻痹的毒。
author: chorb33
source: It flies through forests at night, its eyes acting like a radar. If POKENAME spots prey, it shoots it over long distances with a paralyzing poison.

entry: 古老经文称POKENAME为虫中之神，相信它能用威猛的长嚎，号令蝗群。
author: gurguro
source: Ancient scripture declares POKENAME to be a god amongst insects, commanding locusts with its mighty howl.

entry: 它比普通的宝宝暴龙更加成熟，外貌也更接近1亿年前的样子。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It is more mature than a normal Tyrunt. It also looks more similar to how it looked 100 million years ago.

entry: POKENAME独自狩猎，敢追逐体型是自身五倍的猎物。骨质大颚强劲，足以把猎物肢体撕开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary hunters and will go after prey five times larger than itself. Their bony jaws are strong enough to rip its prey limb from limb.

entry: POKENAME曾因高超的武艺备受尊崇。它的利爪像镰刀盔的双镰一样锋利，出拳则像战槌龙的冲锋一样有力。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was once revered for its martial prowess. Its claws are sharp as a Kabutops's scythe, and its blows as powerful as a Rampardos's charge.

entry: 它们是背负整个生态系统的庞然巨兽。为了满足巨大的养分需求，常把丰饶的森林，糟蹋得一片狼藉。
author: bobsterbot
source: Titanic beasts with ecosystems on their backs. To satiate their heavy need, they often ravage forests for the abundance of nutrients within them.

entry: 它用强爪掘进硬土，藏入地下，伪装成石造物。猎物一来，便突然破土而出，将其吞食。
author: chorb33
source: It digs itself into hard soil with its strong claws and masquerades as a stone structure in order to shoot out of the ground to eat its prey.

entry: 这种巨大、鲨鱼般的宝可梦，早已被认为灭绝。不过，一些记者相信，POKENAME仍活在深海沟底。
author: nellnast42
source: A massive shark-like Pokémon long thought to be extinct. However, some journalists believe POKENAME still reside deep in ocean trenches.

entry: 它常被误认成掉进焦油坑的怪颚龙。猎物存进焦油状的身体后，会花上一周慢慢消化。
author: celio_0230
source: This Pokémon is commonly mistaken for a Tyrantrum that fell into a tar pit. It stores prey within its tar-like body, digesting them over the course of a week.

entry: POKENAME每年大部分时间都在休眠，只有冬季才会醒来。它愿将毛毯分给更小的宝可梦，替它们挡住寒冷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hibernate throughout most of the year, only awakening during the winter months. It will share its furry blanket with other smaller Pokémon to keep them out of the cold.

entry: POKENAME创造的酷寒环境，很适合其他冰宝可梦。壳中甚至住着整座雪童子村落，受它保护。
author: thropp
source: The frigid environment POKENAME creates is ideal for its fellow Ice Pokémon. Its shell houses a village of Snorunt, protecting them from harm.

entry: 尾根的冰晶显示POKENAME的健康状态。蓝色越深，说明体内温度调节得越好。
author: melodydelune
source: The icy crystal formed at the base of POKENAME's tail indicates its current health. The deeper blue in color it is, the better its internal temperature is being regulated.

entry: POKENAME适于严寒，冰柱般的毒刺一碰就能冻住猎物。冷空气能保持尖刺锋利，又不致融化，因此它格外喜欢寒冷。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME thrives in frigid climates, its icicle-like stingers capable of freezing prey on contact. It prefers the cold, as the freezing air keeps its stingers sharp and prevents them from melting.

entry: POKENAME吊在冰洞顶端，静候猎物。翅膀与脸上包着锐利的冰，连坚硬岩石也能劈开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hang from the roof of frozen caves waiting for prey. Their wings and faces are encased in ice so sharp it can cleave through hard stone.

entry: 冰洞顶端聚成礁群的POKENAME，看起来就像成簇冰柱。可得小心：一碰到珊瑚渗出的卤水，就会被冻结，当作猎物。这里没有好坏星，让POKENAME得以繁盛。
author: wormspawn
source: Reefs of POKENAME on the roofs of icy caves resemble clusters of icicles. Be warned: anything that touches the brine secreted from their coral will be frozen and taken as prey. The lack of Mareanie in this habitat has allowed POKENAME to thrive.

entry: 一些训练家会为冰球比赛专门培育POKENAME，“石英冰冻光束”队便是如此。它能灵巧运用球杆般的附肢，掌控冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: Some Trainers breed POKENAME for hockey, such as those in the Indigo Ice Beams. It uses its dexterous hockey-stick appendages to control the puck.

entry: 它冻结空气中的水分，扬起晶莹的细雪，再披上冰甲。有些训练家专门培育体形更流畅的POKENAME，用来打冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.

entry: 它冻结空气中的水分，扬起晶莹的细雪，再披上冰甲。有些训练家专门培育体形更流畅的POKENAME，用来打冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.

entry: POKENAME覆着触之冰冷的铠甲，一碰就能把人冻住。全身锋利的冰刺，却又很容易折断。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is covered with cool-to-the-touch armor that instantly freezes all who touch it. The razor-sharp icicles all along its body are very brittle.

entry: POKENAME的身体本身就是盾。它冻结空气中的水分制成剑，与天敌及猎物决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's body is the shield. It freezes the moisture in the air to form a sword which it uses to duel predators and prey.

entry: 为实现飞翔的梦想，POKENAME将背上的水分冻成翅膀。飞行时，嘴里还会喷出冰。
author: darkweavile428
source: In order to realize its dream of flying, POKENAME froze the moisture on its back into the shape of wings. It spouts ice from its mouth as it flies.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: POKENAME一察觉生命迹象，就会引发寒冰爆炸，冻结附近的一切。它不断追逐目标，直到整片区域全都冰封。
author: mistershaokahn
source: When POKENAME detects signs of life, it triggers an icy explosion that freezes everything nearby. It relentlessly pursues its target until the area is completely frozen.

entry: 它的外貌与超级冰鬼护极为相似。断裂的下颌，让它不断从口中喷出暴风雪。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega Glalie. Its broken jaw causes it to spew endless blizzards from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME全身与双翼覆着厚雪，足以缓冲物理打击。它在积雪的树上筑巢，借雪色隐藏身形。
author: mistymagius
source: A layer of thick snow coats POKENAME's body and wings which is thick enough to dampen physical hits. It creates its nest in snowy trees to camouflage itself amongst the snow.

entry: POKENAME曾是“石英冰冻光束”队的吉祥物，可它缺乏鲜明个性，最终被冰人偶取代。
author: t.i.a.
source: The former mascot of the Indigo Ice Beams. POKENAME's lack of attitude made it obsolete when Glamime replaced it.

entry: 队友常把它头上的饰物，误认成冰球。若比赛里突然多了个球，多半就是从POKENAME身上来的。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Its teammates often mistake the charm on its head for a hockey puck. If there's ever multiple pucks in a game, it's likely one came from a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME全心投入团队，能花数小时规划战术与阵容。POKENAME外表虽冷，对伙伴却十分支持。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is extremely dedicated to its group, planning strategies and roster composition for hours on end. Despite its cold exterior, POKENAME is very supportive of its companions.

entry: 缩进壳里时，它看起来像一颗足球。千万别不小心踢到POKENAME。
author: soup1900
source: When withdrawn into its shell, it has a similar look to that of a soccer ball. It is imperative to not accidentally kick POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常现身雾气浓重的寒地。它所居的水域里，能找到好几具冻住的潜水者遗体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually sighted in colder regions with large amounts of fog. The frozen bodies of several divers can be found in POKENAME's waters.

entry: 心跳越快，能放出的电力便越多；心跳越慢，吐出的冰息便越寒冷。
author: darkweavile428
source: The higher its heart rate, the more electrical energy it's able to output. The lower its heart rate, the colder its icy breath is.

entry: POKENAME一感到危险，就会唤起强烈的暴风雪。POKENAME十分珍视朋友与训练家。
author: jona_hehe
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it will summon a powerful blizzard. POKENAME cares deeply for its friends and Trainer.

entry: 獠牙由零度以下的坚冰构成，强韧如钢。POKENAME通常住在既危险，又寒冷的冰窟。
author: soup1900
source: Its tusks are made of subzero ice that is as strong as steel. POKENAME usually resides in icy caves where it is both treacherous and cold.

entry: POKENAME喷出寒息，将猎物冻在原地捕获。过去，冰封北地的猎人身旁常有POKENAME相伴。
author: pendragonic
source: POKENAME hunt their prey by freezing them in place with their breath. In the past, hunters in the frozen north would often be accompanied by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME优雅地滑游冰冷水域，也常仔细梳理背上的飘带。
author: xephyr
source: It glides through icy waters gracefully. POKENAME grooms the ribbon on its back often.

entry: POKENAME被视为苔原上最危险的宝可梦之一。它经常喷出水柱，让水柱在原地冻结，封锁区域，阻挡威胁。
author: pendragonic
source: POKENAME is considered one of the most dangerous Pokémon of the tundra. It will often fire jets of water that freeze in place to block off areas and ward off threats.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME高速自转，既能产生超能力，也能用飞叶风暴，将来犯者赶跑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can rotate rapidly on its own axis to generate psychic powers or to send attackers fleeing with Leaf Storm.

entry: POKENAME多生活在浅水与河岸。虽住在水里，肌肉却软弱无力，很容易就被水流冲走。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME is mostly found in shallow water and riverbanks. While it does live in the water, its muscles are so weak that it can easily be washed away.

entry: POKENAME既能变成宝可梦，也能变成植物。可身上总飘出甜香，轻易就露了馅。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME can transform into both Pokémon and plants. It constantly emits a sweet aroma that reveals its disguise.

entry: 它将身体半埋土中，只露出叶片晒太阳，因此常被误认成杂草。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon partially digs itself into the dirt, only exposing its leaves to let them bathe in the sunlight. Because of this, they often get mistaken for weeds.

entry: 背上的杂草一直无人修整，已经长得硕大无比。沐浴月光时，它的力量还会更强。
author: soup1900
source: The weeds on its back have been left untouched, allowing them to grow large in size. It is more powerful when in the moonlight.

entry: 它是人类的天敌。人一被困进植物般的大嘴，巨口便会猛然合下。
author: theheroict
source: This Pokémon is a natural predator for humans. The large plant-mouth it has will bite down when a human is trapped inside.

entry: 白天，POKENAME穿入地下，躲开日晒，只让叶片留在地面。受惊时会从面具孔洞射出坚果，击中就能使对方麻痹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME phase into the ground during the day to hide their bodies from the sun, leaving only their leaves above the surface. If they're startled, they will shoot nuts from the holes in their masks that can paralyze anyone they hit.

entry: 白天，POKENAME像木桩一样扎在土里。唯有月光洒下，这根手杖才会自行拔地而起，悬浮在半空。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stakes in the ground during the daytime. The staff only uproots itself and hovers above the ground under the moonlight.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶子在月光下生长，能随心操纵植物与火焰。
author: darkweavile428
source: The leaves on POKENAME's body grow in the moonlight. It has the power to control both plant life and fire at will.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，难以离地，只好在林地上爬行。它一天最多要吃500磅叶子，若仍不饱，连体型较大的虫宝可梦也会吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME crawls on the forest floor since it struggles to get its hefty body off the ground. It has to eat up to 500 pounds of leaves a day and will even eat larger bug Pokémon if it's still hungry.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光成长，用这份能量起舞，却可能让四周的草枯死。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME grow by absorbing moonlight. This energy fuels its dance, which can cause grass around it to die.

entry: POKENAME往体内塞入大量叶子。叶片腐烂后，身体就会渗出恶臭的液体，碰触便会中毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stuffs large amounts of leaves inside of its body. As the leaves begin to decay, its body leaks an incredibly foul liquid that is toxic to the touch.

entry: POKENAME模样虽然不讨喜，性情却很温顺。白天躲避天敌，夜里再靠月光进行光合作用。
author: ethewriter
source: Despite their off-putting appearance, POKENAME are docile. They hide from predators in the day and photosynthesize using the moon at night.

entry: 手中那根“棍子”，其实是好几片长草叶团成的。谁敢割掉它的草，就会遭到反击。
author: soup1900
source: The stick it carries is actually multiple blades of tall grass wadded together. It fights against anyone who tries to mow down its grass.

entry: 它胆怯地藏在栗子般坚固的壳里，只有独处才肯露面。活动太少又不通风，让POKENAME经常迟钝无力。
author: mistymagius
source: This timid Pokémon hides in its tough, chestnut-like shell, only revealing itself when it is alone. Because of this, POKENAME is often sluggish due to limited activity and poor air circulation.

entry: POKENAME用妩媚的舞步与天生的美貌，引其他宝可梦听命。它先骗敌人共舞，再用双翼将其烧尽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses their seductive dance moves and natural beauty to coax other Pokémon into doing its bidding. It tricks its enemies into dancing with it before incinerating them with its wings.

entry: 迷人的舞姿来自刻苦练习。最好别打扰它们训练，惹恼了，可会被踩脚趾。
author: quote.lass
source: Their mesmerizing dances are the result of intense practice. It's best not to interrupt their training; they've been know to stomp toes when annoyed.

entry: POKENAME常照料受伤的鸟类。遇险时，便在自己与病号周围，卷起小小的火焰旋涡。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often are found tending to injured birds. It will create a small Fire Spin around itself and its patients when in danger.

entry: 它起舞时，会掀起一道道火浪。若没有六只脚，这套舞步，根本学不来。
author: .flipside3
source: It creates waves of fire when it dances. Its style of dancing is impossible to replicate without six feet.

entry: POKENAME既被尊为创造者，也被敬畏为毁灭者。起舞时卷起的火焰，却不会伤到同伴。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME is venerated as both a creator and destroyer. The flames it whips up while dancing do not burn its allies.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在挥着丝网绒球跳舞。若有人不喜欢这舞，它可能就让对方中毒，或挨一记电。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is almost always dancing with its webbed pom-poms. If someone dislikes its dancing, it may poison or electrify them.

entry: 这只开朗的厚皮宝可梦，最爱逗大家开心。POKENAME虽然温顺，真遇上敌人，也毫不犹豫地挥起绒球，给对方狠狠一记电击。
author: thropp
source: This cheerful pachyderm loves to make others smile. Although docile, POKENAME is not afraid to use its pom-pom to give its enemies a nasty shock.

entry: POKENAME爱拿柔软的尾巴玩，顽皮地用头顶它，迸出小电火花。春天，常能见到它们成群起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to play with their soft tail, playfully headbutting it and producing small sparks. Groups of these Pokémon can be seen dancing together during the springtime.

entry: 宝可梦全能竞技赛的裁判发现，POKENAME会借助欢呼声，通过心灵感应指挥训练家，引发了一场丑闻。如今，它们已被禁止进入竞技巨蛋。
author: quote.lass
source: A scandal occurred when Pokéathlon judges learned POKENAME were directing their Trainers telepathically via cheers. They're now banned from the dome.

entry: POKENAME的动作，既点燃队友的斗志，也震撼对手的心。摇起绒球，电力便一点点积蓄起来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME electrifies its teammates' spirits and opponents' hearts with its moves. It shakes its pom-pom to build up its electric charge.

entry: 它想用绒球拼出“艳压全场”的英文口号，可惜偏偏有阅读障碍。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Its pompoms are meant to spell "SLAY". Unfortunately, it is dyslexic.

entry: 它用身上的毛，拂去自己的忧愁，再把负面能量传给来犯的天敌，让对方不敢轻易下手。
author: alliveir
source: It uses the hairs on its body to brush its worries away. It expels the negative energy by passing it onto hostile predators, making them think twice.

entry: 阿罗拉常能看到POKENAME迎接游客。它还能借超能力，让旅人对接下来的行程，更加兴奋。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often seen greeting tourists in Alola. It can use psychic powers to make travelers more excited for their trip.

entry: 激烈的舞蹈，能改变天气。它们只用动作交流，可谁都能看懂其中的意思。
author: quote.lass
source: Their intense dances can change the weather. They communicate exclusively through movement, but no one struggles to understand them.

entry: POKENAME被视为长久爱情的象征。据说，两只POKENAME若舞得天衣无缝，它们的训练家便能相爱一生。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is cherished as a symbol of enduring love. It is said that if two POKENAME dance in perfect harmony, it signifies a lifelong romance between their Trainers.

entry: 起舞时，它会放出催眠波，减轻疼痛、安抚情绪，因此常与医生结伴。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: While dancing, it produces hypnotic waves that reduce pain and induce calm, which is why they are a frequent companion of doctors.

entry: POKENAME采集紫色花蜜酿蜜时，会撒下剧毒粉尘。吸入后幸存的人，常说自己曾见到灵魂，甚至与之交谈。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME scatters highly toxic dust as it gathers purple nectar to make honey. Survivors of inhaling this dust often claim they saw or spoke with spirits.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的羽毛比雌性更大、更鲜艳。它们一同起舞，要与远古世界再度相连。
author: mistymagius
source: Male POKENAME have larger and more vibrant feathers than the females. They dance together to reunite themselves with the ancient world.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，飘带优雅流动，形成舒缓的气场。不得安息的亡魂，也能因此平静下来。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's ribbons flow gracefully as it runs, forming a soothing aura. Restless spirits of the dead are calmed by it.

entry: POKENAME自尊心强，训练又有素。它们组成的表演团，早已成为城都各地节庆、茶馆与精致花园的常客。
author: quote.lass
source: Proud and disciplined, performing troupes of POKENAME have become mainstays in festivals, tea houses, and elaborate gardens across Johto.

entry: POKENAME起舞，会扭曲周围生物的感知。受害者眼前，便满是万花筒般的色彩，常因此陷入疯狂。
author: fenragon
source: When POKENAME dances, it warps the perception of those around it. Its victims see a kaleidoscope of colors, which often causes bouts of madness.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈猛烈而富于破坏性。手臂与尾巴挥甩，掀起劲风，让尘土绕着身体旋上天空。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's dancing is violent and destructive. With lashes of its tail and arms, it creates a whipping wind, dust spiraling around it into the air.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在月光下与亡灵共舞。据说，看过舞蹈的人到了清晨，便只能随风移动或起舞。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: During the night, POKENAME dances with spirits of the dead under the moonlight. It's said that come morning, those who viewed its dance find themselves only able to move or dance with the wind.

entry: POKENAME热爱音乐，会逼乐手一直播到天明。谁若拒绝，或撑不下去，就会遭它的幽火诅咒。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME loves music and will force musicians to continue playing until dawn. Musicians that refuse or fail are cursed by its eerie flames.

entry: 它在暴风雪中现身，用亡者的迷人幻影引诱受害者。POKENAME出没的地方，失踪案格外多。
author: rawthorn
source: It appears during blizzards, using alluring visions of the dead to attract their victims. Regions POKENAME inhabit have high cases of missing persons.

entry: 坐在POKENAME的枝条下，训练家便能与亡者交流。紫色花朵常被当作魔法物品贩卖，据说能让人再见已故亲友。
author: mistymagius
source: Sitting underneath POKENAME's branches allows Trainers to communicate with the dead. Its purple flowers are often sold as magical items to allow people to see their lost loved ones.

entry: 这种毒种子宝可梦，靠垃圾腐烂后形成的土壤进食、生长。为了四处寻找更多食物，它长出了能用四足行走的身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This poisonous bulb Pokémon feeds and grows on soil created by decomposed trash. It has grown a quadrupedal body to move around and obtain more food.

entry: POKENAME常在最讨厌融合体排行榜上位居第二。许多相处过的训练家都说：“已经够臭了，居然还能更笨。”
author: gooeygamer69
source: POKENAME regularly ranks as the second-most disliked Pokémon fusion. Many Trainers that have spent tie with this Pokémon describe it as "somehow even more dim than it is stinky".

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡城市，收集沿途垃圾。若见有人乱扔，就会动怒，上前攻击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME can typically be found wandering cities at night, collecting trash they find. If one sees a person littering, they become hostile and attack.

entry: 据说，POKENAME被垃圾之灵附身。因为遭人丢弃，如今满心怨恨，想向人类复仇。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by the spirit of garbage, vengeful towards humans for having been thrown away.

entry: POKENAME总带着烧塑料的味道，住在大城市，靠餐馆后面的垃圾箱觅食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME always smell like burning plastic. They live in large cities, and feed off dumpsters behind restaurants.

entry: POKENAME是环保人士的噩梦，会用压实的垃圾筑坝，污染河流。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An environmentalist's nightmare, POKENAME creates dams made of packed garbage which poison rivers.

entry: POKENAME用沾满口香糖的黏爪，捉住毫无防备的猎物，常躲在暗巷与垃圾箱里。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME uses its sticky, gum-covered claws to grab unsuspecting prey. It is known to hide in dark alleyways and dumpsters.

entry: 它带着恶臭，漂在市区。教育节目常把它当作“可爱”的城市污染象征。
author: staghorn
source: It floats around urban areas, accompanied by a foul odor. Educational shows often use them as a "cute" representation of urban pollution.

entry: 埋在填埋场下的颚之化石，能被复原成POKENAME。它生前最爱吃的，是臭泥一种早已灭绝的近亲。
author: mrpeach774
source: When a Jaw Fossil is found buried beneath a landfill, it can be resurrected into a POKENAME. Its favorite food was a now extinct cousin of Grimer.

entry: POKENAME的大颚，连最难处理的垃圾也能轻易撕开。吃过最爱的食物，还会放出数百万年不曾出现的毒气。
author: mrpeach774
source: A POKENAME's jaws easily tear through the toughest garbage. After eating its favorite meal, it releases toxic gases not seen for millions of years.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: chorb33
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: chorb33
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: 它总能夺得最讨厌融合体的称号。POKENAME经常发怒，一生气就滑行在居住的城市里，朝倒霉路人喷洒垃圾。
author: gooeygamer69
source: This Pokémon always wins the title of most-disliked fusion. When angry, which is quite often, POKENAME glides through the city in which it lives while spraying trash at unlucky pedestrians.

entry: POKENAME到填埋场寻找废布，给自己做衣服。在它看来，土豆袋这样朴素的装扮，才最好看。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME searches landfills for discarded cloth to dress itself in. It believes it looks best in simple things like potato sacks.

entry: POKENAME敌意强、力量又大，十分难驯。训练家若没做好准备，就可能被垃圾堆与毒泥淹没。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a hard-to-tame fusion thanks to its hostility and power. Unprepared Trainers find themselves buried under trash hoards and toxic sludge.

entry: 有人打趣说，这种融合体，不过是一个垃圾袋，封住了108股臭味。发怒时，还会散出有毒蒸气。
author: ohok3441
source: It has been joked that this fusion is 108 bad smells bound within a trash bag. It wafts toxic vapor in the air when angry.

entry: 它追着垃圾运输船撞，直到船沉。若不阻止，单是一只POKENAME，就能让整座港口无法居住。
author: staghorn
source: It hunts down garbage-carrying boats and rams them until they sink. Even a single POKENAME can render a harbor uninhabitable if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME偷来垃圾桶盖，保护身体内部。后来黏得太牢，索性站在桶盖边缘，把它当轮子滚。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has stolen a dustbin lid to protect its insides. It is now so firmly stuck to it that it can stand on the edge and use it as a wheel.

entry: 皮肤能察觉极微弱的振动，让POKENAME在漆黑海底，也能发现数千米深处的猎物。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME senses even the faintest vibrations through its skin. This enables it to detect prey many thousands of meters deep in the pitch-black ocean.

entry: POKENAME能张大颚，吞下比自己还大的猎物。不过，它只挑那些无法从体内伤害自己的目标。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME can stretch its jaws and consume prey larger than its body. It only targets prey that is incapable of damaging it from within.

entry: 这只POKENAME拥有整群鱼的力量与凶性，会率领小鱼群，贪婪地四处肆虐。
author: serversizeme
source: This POKENAME has the strength and aggression of a whole school. It will lead swarms of smaller fry on a voracious rampage.

entry: POKENAME是水边凶猛的猎手，双颚迅如闪电，攻击极其猛烈。水面只露出头冠，游客游泳时得格外留意。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is a fierce predator found near bodies of water, known for its lightning-fast jaws and ferocious attacks. Only its crest is visible above the water surface, so tourists are advised to watch for it while swimming.

entry: 猎物还未见到POKENAME，就被臭气熏走。POKENAME只好改在水底觅食，结果却变得更臭。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME's stench drives away its prey before they can even see them. This caused POKENAME to become bottom feeders in the bodies of water, which in turn makes them stink even more.

entry: POKENAME好斗，想让谁都听它使唤。锋利的牙齿，连大型树果的厚皮，也能轻松切开。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive and will try to bully anyone into doing its bidding. Its sharp teeth can cut through the thick skin of large Berries.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，常为猎物相互争斗。POKENAME专捕大型鱼宝可梦，用利喙与尖爪凶狠袭击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly territorial and will constantly fight with each other over their prey. POKENAME prey on larger fish Pokémon, brutally attacking them with their sharp beak and talons.

entry: POKENAME常在海上骚扰船只，可最终并不会伤人。据说，过去曾有海盗跟随POKENAME航行。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME is usually seen in the ocean, harassing ships but ultimately not harming anyone. It's said pirates followed POKENAME in the past.

entry: POKENAME能制造吸力，将方圆一公里内的一切吸入。只需短短几周，就能灭尽数公里海域中的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.

entry: POKENAME能制造吸力，将方圆一公里内的一切吸入。只需短短几周，就能灭尽数公里海域中的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.

entry: 它定期浮上海面吸气，储进体内。身躯虽粗壮，只需喷出储气，便能迅速转向。
author: chorb33
source: It regularly fills up with air by swimming to the surface. Despite its chunky physique, it can quickly change direction by expelling the stored air.

entry: 刀刃般的鳍，切石如切奶油。甚至曾有人见过，单只个体就把暴鲤龙、吼鲸王这样的巨兽，切成碎片。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Its blade-like fins can cut stone like butter. Some have been seen cutting the likes of Gyarados and Wailord to pieces by themselves.

entry: POKENAME飞过海面，若发现大鱼群，便放出强劲声波，瞬间击倒大半。为抢夺猎物，也会与其他POKENAME激烈交战。
author: mistymagius
source: If it sees a large school of fish while it's flying over the ocean, POKENAME will fire a powerful sound wave that instantly takes out most of the school. It will fiercely fight other POKENAME over their prey.

entry: 这只宝可梦柔软亲人，据说毛绒绒的脑袋里，什么念头也没有。可谁需要慰藉、关爱与保护，它都愿意陪伴。
author: rooboid
source: This soft and cuddly Pokémon is said to have no thoughts inside its plush head. It provides comfort, love and protection to those who need it.

entry: 它们栖息在参差海岸外最寒冷的海中。如今主要以船只为猎物，掀起巨浪或漩涡，将船拖沉海底。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Found in the coldest of seas just off the shores of jagged coasts. They have learned to prey mostly on ships these days, creating giant tidal waves or whirlpools to sink them to the depths of the sea.

entry: 这只双足飞龙般的宝可梦经常战斗，身上留下独特伤痕。POKENAME由水构成的双翼与尾巴滚烫无比。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This wyvern-like Pokémon is often in fights, resulting in unique scarring. POKENAME's water-based wings and tail are scaldingly hot.

entry: 它只捕食心生恐惧的对象。宝可梦一害怕地游走，POKENAME就会追捕；若猎物毫不退缩，它反而会不情愿地离开。
author: teatedtiten
source: It only feasts on those that are afraid, so when a Pokémon fearfully swims away from it, POKENAME will catch them.  However, they begrudgingly retreat if potential prey stand its ground.

entry: POKENAME的毒烟会侵蚀牙齿。若久未吃到新鲜食物，只需几周，原本坚硬的牙就会变得黏软滴落。它们还常违抗训练家，很难教好。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME's toxic fumes make their teeth degrade, turning from rock hard to slimy and drippy in a matter of weeks if they haven't eaten fresh meals in a while. They are tough to train, as they tend to disobey their Trainer.

entry: 森林深处能听见POKENAME的歌声，将人引向湖泊或河流。跟随歌声而去的人，往往再也不会出现。在POKENAME栖息的水底，常能发现骸骨。
author: riverbandage
source: People can hear the songs of POKENAME deep in the forest that lead to lakes or rivers. If followed, it is expected to never see the person again. Skeletons can often be found where the POKENAME reside at the bottom.

entry: POKENAME沿路行走，点燃植物，常引发森林大火。它借此除去衰老或垂死的草木，让新的生命重生。
author: riverbandage
source: Forest fires are often started by POKENAME, setting plant-life ablaze as they walk along pathways. This is in order for new life to start anew and get rid of the old or dying.

entry: POKENAME尽心守护森林，抵御亡灵侵入。据传，它守护的，仍是几个世纪前巡行过的那片猎场。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME diligently protects forests from spiritual invaders. It is rumored to protect the same hunting grounds it patrolled centuries ago.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是灵界的守门者。若在野外遇见POKENAME，或许就意味着，你的阳寿将尽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is said to be a guardian to the spirit world. If you spot POKENAME in the wild, your time may be almost up.

entry: POKENAME用树皮制作面具，戴上吓人。越常成功吓到别人的个体，似乎就越早进化。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME make masks out of tree bark that they wear to spook others. Those who have high success rates in scaring others seem to evolve earlier.

entry: 古代文明中，在树林迷失的孩子可能化作小木灵归来。它们带着所崇敬宝可梦的木雕，寻找家的感觉，举止与能力则像天然鸟。
author: arcul
source: Children from past civilizations lost in the woods may return as Phantump. They carry carvings of revered Pokémon to feel at home, embodying Xatu's behavior and abilities.

entry: POKENAME装成树木，等别的宝可梦靠近，就牢牢附上去，强行与对方交朋友。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME latch onto Pokémon while camouflaging in the trees. It will then become friends with them, forcefully.

entry: 它们常与由月亮伊布融合而成的小伊布一起聚居，到处捣蛋。与这位同伴不同，POKENAME在黎明时分更为活跃。
author: riverbandage
source: Along side with Phantreons, this set is often seen making colonies together causing mischief wherever they go. The POKENAME tend to be more active during dawn unlike their counterpart.

entry: POKENAME常与小伊布结伴，两种宝可梦一起小打小闹。POKENAME在黄昏更活跃，独处时的恶作剧却会致命得多。
author: riverbandage
source: Seen with Phantpeons, this duo of Pokémon are often causing minor mischief together. The POKENAME are more active at dusk with being quite more lethal with pranks when alone.

entry: 传说POKENAME是赫拉克罗斯的灵魂。它生前冲向大树，却卡在其中无法脱身，最终死去。
author: incognito1234
source: Legends say that POKENAME is the spirit of a Heracross who perished when it charged into a tree and got stuck, never to escape.

entry: POKENAME常在烧毁的森林觅食，分解旧物，回馈大地。它们通常只在野火过后的灰烬中现身。
author: riverbandage
source: Often found scavenging in burnt forests, POKENAME give back to the earth by decomposing the old. They tend to only come out after a wildfire in the burnt ashes.

entry: 暴风雪一来，它们便会出现。据说POKENAME是旅途中死于风雪的人所化。
author: riverbandage
source: When a blizzard comes, these Pokémon come out. POKENAME are said to be the dead that died in blizzards while travelling along the path.

entry: 它喜欢林中那些旁人听来毛骨悚然的声音。可若在家中见到人类，却会害怕。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon loves hearing noises most find unsettling while in the forest. It becomes scared when it sees humans within its home.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间的闹鬼森林起舞。它一动，诡异的风便随之而来。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME loves to dance at night within haunted forests. When it dances, eerie winds move with it.

entry: 一只附身于树桩的大牙狸。它仍啃食木头磨牙，连自己的身体也不放过。
author: jacobtmm
source: A Bidoof that has possessed a tree stump. It still gnaws on wood, even itself, to whittle down its teeth.

entry: POKENAME聚在濒死的森林，以腐烂植物为食，夺走所剩的生命力。POKENAME对任何打扰家园的对象，都怀有天生的敌意。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME are known to gather in dying forests, where they feed off rotting plants and steal whatever life is left. POKENAME are inherently hostile to anyone who disturbs their home.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着一名死在林中的伐木工人的灵魂。它仍像生前一样，痴迷地砍个不停。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by a lumberjack who died in the forest. It obsessively fells trees as it did while alive.

entry: POKENAME由受困孩子渴望回家的情绪凝成。它们寻找迷路的孩子，带其回家。可POKENAME承载着那些终未归家者的心情，始终深深悲伤。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME are formed by the emotions of trapped children who long to return home. They seek out lost children and, upon finding them, guide them home. POKENAME are filled with a deep sadness, as they carry the emotions of those who never made it home.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: 每条尾巴都代表一个死在林中的孩子的灵魂，因此毛发也染成了黑色。
author: toxicrown
source: Each tail on this Pokémon represents the soul of a child that died in the woods. Because of this, its fur has been blackened.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 它混在树木间伪装，再突然动起来，吓人一跳。恐惧与紧张，便是POKENAME的食粮。
author: dodoowner_
source: It tries to frighten people by camouflaging in the trees, then suddenly moving. POKENAME feed on fear and nervousness.

entry: POKENAME结出的果实，据说含有少许灵力，花岩怪与耿鬼，都很爱吃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME bear fruits that are said to contain small amounts of spiritual energy inside. Spiritomb and Gengar love to eat it.

entry: 据说POKENAME是林中迷失孩子的灵魂，常聚在空地玩耍。它们用木头制作乐器与面具，组成小乐队，还邀请人们加入。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to be spirits of children lost in the woods, POKENAME often gather together to play in forest clearings. They fashion instruments and masks out of wood, creating a little band and inviting people to join in.

entry: POKENAME收集枝条生起小火，引导迷失的灵魂穿过森林。火一熄，POKENAME便如风中落叶般消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather branches for kindling, creating small fires to guide lost souls through the forest. When the fires go out, POKENAME disappear like leaves on the wind.

entry: POKENAME攀在树侧，守望进入森林的人。发现迷路者，就会隐在暗处清出道路，免得对方遭受与自己相同的命运。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Clinging to the sides of trees, a POKENAME will keep watch over those that enter its forest. If it spots someone that's lost, it will clear the path from the shadows, saving them from sharing its fate.

entry: POKENAME原是一尊多年前雕成、长满草木的忠犬卡蒂狗像。如今一个迷失孩子的亡魂住进了里面。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME was once an overgrown statue of a loyal Growlithe, carved many years ago. It is now the home of a lost child's soul.

entry: 它在遭砍伐的林地游荡，见到伐木工就出拳。高山步道旁也常能见到它，伪装成树桩。
author: markusknight
source: Wandering around cut-down forests, it punches any lumberjacks it sees. It's also often seen around high mountain trails, disguising as tree stumps.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄登山者。它将幽灵般的身体扎入地下，震动大地，让树木倒向不幸惹怒它的人。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME likes to prank hikers. It plunges its ghastly body into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and trees to fall down on those unfortunate enough to anger it.

entry: 它游荡在极古老的森林，寻找巨大的倒木树干，作为新住处。它守护这些古林，会诅咒入侵者，或全速冲过去攻击。
author: markusknight
source: It is said to wander around very old forests, seeking new trunks from enormous fallen trees to live in. It guards these ancient forests, bringing curses or rushing at full speed at anyone that trespasses.

entry: POKENAME装成灌木，静静等待猎物。有东西经过，就一把捉住，让其消失。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME quietly hides disguised as a bush as it waits for prey. When something passes by, it catches it and makes it disappear.

entry: 野生POKENAME有强烈的亲子本能，常照料幼小的小木灵，直到它们足够强，能够独立生存。
author: phantom640
source: Due to this fusion's parental instincts, wild POKENAME often care for young Phantump until they're strong enough to survive on their own.

entry: POKENAME模仿伊布或幼童的哭声，将人引入密林。它虽只想找玩伴，却有时会不慎诅咒想一起玩的人。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME lures people deep into its woods by mimicking the cries of an eevee or small child. Though it only seeks a playmate, it sometimes mistakenly curses those it tries to play with.

entry: POKENAME会淹死一切靠近居住水域的人，连其他宝可梦也不放过。唯独派拉斯与派拉斯特例外。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME will drown anyone that comes near the body of water that it resides in. It has even been known to even drown other Pokémon that come to close. The only exception is Paras and Parasect.

entry: POKENAME十分敏感，也极具攻击性。它能透过树皮般的毛发，迸出短促的10000伏电流，像射出尖刺一样，发电攻击。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME tend to be highly aggressive and sensitive. Through the bark-made fur, it can produce a 10,000-volt charge in small bursts that can be ejected as like quills from the fur to attack.

entry: 普通火伊布能将体温升至华氏1,650度，POKENAME却承受不了。POKENAME常因发怒，不慎让体温过高，反把自己点燃。
author: riverbandage
source: While typical Flareon can heat their body up to 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit, POKENAME are unable to handle that temperature. POKENAME tend to catch themselves on fire in their own anger by unintentionally rising their body temperature too high.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: thropp
source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME常为迷失森林的宝可梦指路。不过，若对方由人类饲养，却鲜少能再与训练家重聚。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME often guide stray Pokémon that have lost their way in the forest. However, if these Pokémon belong to humans, they are rarely reunited with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能降低体温，让自身树皮裂成碎片，拿来投射攻击。若没有用掉，碎片便会脱落，再被它吃回去，重新补入身体。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME have the ability to lower their body temperature, which allows them to splinter their own bark and use it as a projectile. If not used, the splinters will break off and be consumed by the Pokémon in order to add them back to their body.

entry: POKENAME穿林起舞时，会唤起不祥的风，吹动身上叶片与它一同舞蹈。
author: toxicrown
source: As it dances through the forest, POKENAME causes ominous winds to flow. These winds help the leaves on its body to dance with it.

entry: 这只宝可梦能凭手杖掌控森林。它借此远远守护孩子，帮助他们避开残酷的命运。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon's staff allows it control over the forest. It uses this to help children from a distance, so that they don't meet a cruel fate.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为“森林守护者”。它保护无力自保的生物，把林中的小宝可梦，当成自己的孩子。
author: toxicrown
source: Known to many as the Forest Guardian, POKENAME protects those who can't protect themselves. It treats young forest Pokémon like its children.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: thropp
source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME以利爪吸走敌人的生命力，遇到危险则埋入地下躲避。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME uses its claws to absorb the life force of its opponent. It buries itself to hide from danger.

entry: 森林遭到毁坏后，人们开始看见野生POKENAME四处潜行。只要被认定有害于领地，便会遭它无情攻击。
author: endersalasa
source: As forests are demolished, people notice wild POKENAME prowling around. They relentlessly attack anyone it deems harmful to its territory.

entry: 它看守并庇护赖以为家的森林，格外爱护走失的孩子，无论人类还是宝可梦。
author: staghorn
source: It acts as a warden and guardian spirit for the forest it calls home. It's particularly protective of lost children, regardless of if they are human or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是森林的行刑者，专找伤害森林的人，用那有生命的木刃，毫不留情地处决。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is the forest's executioner. It seeks out people who harm the forest and shows no mercy towards them with its living wood blade.

entry: 它的叶片与外皮，总与家乡森林里某一棵树相同。那棵树一受威胁，它便现身，将来犯者赶走。
author: staghorn
source: Its leaves and hide always match that of a tree somewhere within its home forest. If that tree is threatened, it will appear to drive the threat away.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，在安全距离外，观察登山者。若有人意图伤害林木，它就抓住对方，变成一棵树。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in forests and watches hikers from a safe distance. If someone tries to harm the forest, it catches them and turns them into a tree.

entry: POKENAME常袭击、扰乱伐木作业，被人当作森林的守护灵。其实，它们单纯讨厌重型机械的声音。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME are often thought to be guardian spirits of the forest, as they frequently attack and disrupt logging operations. In truth, they simply hate the sound of heavy machinery.

entry: POKENAME飞过林梢，侦察威胁。谁伤害森林，便会被它无情追击，直到彻底消灭。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME flies over the skies of forests to scout for threats. Whoever harms its forest will be attacked mercilessly until they are eradicated.

entry: POKENAME保护森林，抵御伤林者。它的火焰，永远不会熄灭。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME protects forests from those who harm them. Its flame never goes out.

entry: 许多砍毁森林的人，临终前最后看见的，就是POKENAME。它几乎不必移动，就能让自然听从意志。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is often the last sight of those who are causing a forest to shrink in size. It is able to bend nature to its will, despite barely moving.

entry: 民间传说里，它是守护自然的传奇存在。人类与宝可梦，都常在它脚下，留下敬献的供品。
author: captainzscourge
source: This Pokémon is the legendary guardian of nature, according to folklore. There is often tribute left at its feet, from people and Pokémon alike.

entry: 它不经意分泌的毒蜜，会污染附近的水。虽然鲜少主动攻击，许多宝可梦，却仍因此遭殃。
author: chorb33
source: It contaminates the water around it with a passively secreted, poisonous honey. Although it rarely attacks, many different Pokémon fall victim to it.

entry: POKENAME在日光下，快乐地扭来扭去，似乎还会分泌黏稠甜汁，引来各种虫宝可梦。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME wiggles and jiggles happily in the sun. It seems to secrete a thick, sweet ooze that attracts all manner of Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴产生的黏液对其他生物有毒，它自己却觉得美味极了。若舔食太久，行为就会变得反常，难以预料。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME's tail produces a sticky liquid that's toxic to others but seems incredibly delicious to itself. When they suck on the liquid too long, they get erratic and unpredictable.

entry: 这根手杖能喷出黏稠、有毒的蜜，让对手晕头转向。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This staff can expel a sticky, noxious honey that can disorientate opponents.

entry: 往往还未看见POKENAME，就先闻到了臭味。皮肤分泌的恶臭毒液会吸引虫属性宝可梦，成为它的主要食物。
author: rakunk
source: You're likely to smell POKENAME before you see it, as it secretes a foul-smelling, poisonous liquid through its skin. This odor attracts Bug-type Pokémon, which it uses as its main source of food.

entry: POKENAME以特殊频率探测地下最深100英尺处的化石残骸，拿来当铠甲。古生物学家常到POKENAME密集的地方寻找化石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses special frequencies to find fossilized remains up to 100 feet underground which it then uses as armor. Paleontologists usually search in areas where lots of POKENAME can be found.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不离开洞穴，睡觉时常缠在钟乳石上。突然的巨响一传来，POKENAME就会惊慌飞走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost never seen outside of their caves, usually seen wrapped around stalactites as they sleep. Any sudden loud noise and POKENAME will fly away in a panic.

entry: 它在洞顶结网，白天大多在那里睡觉。蛛网结构会干扰超音蝠的回声定位，让它们直接飞进掌中。
author: mistymagius
source: It builds its webs on the ceiling of caves where it sleeps for most of the day. The web's structure messes with Zubat's echolocation, causing them to fly directly into its grasp.

entry: POKENAME在屋顶间跳跃，找孩子恶作剧，吓人取乐。灵活的尾巴还会顺手偷走路人的东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leaps between rooftops, looking for children to playfully scare them for their amusement. It nicks random items from passersby with its flexible tail.

entry: 即使在最嘈杂的夜晚，巢穴附近仍能隐约听见POKENAME高亢的哀号。民间传说，若听见后忽觉背脊发凉，你便成了它接下来要害的人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's loud high-pitched wails can be faintly heard even on the loudest of nights from near its den. Folktales say that if you feel shivers down your spine after hearing its cry, you're one of its next victims.

entry: 以POKENAME的体型而言，鳞片却坚韧得能挡住落下的钟乳石。它静伏洞底等待进化，几乎不需食物或水。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its size, POKENAME's scales are tough enough to resist falling stalactites. It waits silently on the cave floor, barely ever needing food or water while it waits for evolution.

entry: 进入POKENAME栖息的洞穴得小心。谁若打扰它们，可能挨上猛烈的电击。
author: sottiwotti
source: Be careful when entering caves where POKENAME reside, as they might voilently shock people who disturb them.

entry: POKENAME酷爱水果，够得着什么树果就抓什么。可贪食让身体太重，离不开地面，翅膀也就几乎没用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME absolutely adores fruit and will eagerly grab any berries it can get its claws on. Their wings are basically useless as, due to their gluttony, they are too heavy to get off the ground.

entry: POKENAME在峭壁打洞栖息，用非凡的听觉，在漆黑洞中寻找同类，也能找到崖壁高处的巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are cliff-dwelling burrowing Pokémon. They use their exceptional hearing to find one another in their pitch-black burrows and to locate nests high up in the cliffsides.

entry: POKENAME虽然会飞，空中动作却很笨拙，平日更爱待在地下。尖刺对次声波敏感，让它们能借高亢的叫声，在地下找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though capable of flight, POKENAME are clumsy in the air and prefer to spend most of their time underground. Their spines are sensitive to infrasonic waves, allowing them to locate one another with high-pitched shrieks while underground.

entry: POKENAME攀附洞顶，发出电磁波，探测周围岩石的金属元素，却几乎不曾离开那个位置。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME attach themselves to the roofs of caves while emitting electromagnetic waves trying to detect metallic elements in the rocks around them. However, they barely ever move from this position.

entry: POKENAME近视，靠回声定位穿行洞穴。它找到松动的石块就咬，搜寻其中富含的矿物充饥。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is short-sighted and will instead use echolocation to traverse the cave system in which it lives. It tends to chomp on any loose rocks it can find, looking for rich minerals to feed on.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖洞，以回声寻找小宝石吞食。若宝石太大，双颚咬不碎，就带回藏处妥善收好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tunnels underground, using echolocation to look for small jewels for it to eat. If it finds a gemstone that is too big for its jaws to crush, it will bring it back to its hoard for safekeeping.

entry: POKENAME白天大多藏在洞里，夜间才现身。遇险时，后面的头会发出震耳尖啸，听得太久，甚至会震破耳膜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in caves for most of the day, only revealing itself at night. When in danger, its back head releases a deafening screech loud enough to burst eardrums if exposed for too long.

entry: 据推测，POKENAME已生存数十万年。大耳朵能察觉10英里之外的天敌，翅膀却最多只能撑着飞一分钟。
author: mistymagius
source: Theorized to have lived for hundreds of thousands of years, POKENAME uses its large ears to detect predators over 10 miles away. Its wings are only able to keep it aloft for a minute at most.

entry: POKENAME扁平的脸很适合反射声波，方便回声定位。它们性情温顺，只有防御也不管用时，才会出手攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flat face is excellent at reflecting sound waves which makes echolocation easy for it. They are quite docile Pokémon, only ever attacking if its defensive prowess fails.

entry: POKENAME最初是很久以前，一位裁缝的作品。后来遭人弃置，里面的幽灵，便想要复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME was originally made by a tailor long ago. It was eventually abandoned, and the spirit inside wants revenge.

entry: 浓密的毛发能感知最细微的震动，让POKENAME闭眼也能清楚掌握周围。它只栖息在最幽暗的洞穴群。
author: mistymagius
source: Its thick fur can sense even the slightest of vibrations which allow POKENAME to clearly see its surrounding even with its eyes closed. It only resides in the darkest of cave systems.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏欲睡，每天倒挂树枝最多22小时。只有原来的树不再结果，才会飞往新树。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are in a constant state of drowsiness, hanging upside down on tree branches for up to 22 hours a day. They are only seen flying to a new tree when their old tree stops producing berries.

entry: 这些穴居宝可梦胆子很小，稍有危险就会溜走。它们啃食富含金属的岩石，维持金属毛发的光洁与坚韧。
author: mistymagius
source: These cave-dwelling Pokémon are quite timid and will scuttle away at any sign of danger. They will nibble on metal-rich rocks to keep their metallic fur nice and strong.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅沙下，等候猎物。感知沙中的细微震动，就能判断目标何时进入攻击范围。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sit just underneath the sand, waiting for prey to come by. By detecting small vibrations in the sand, it can tell when its prey will be in striking range.

entry: 长期生活在漆黑洞穴，让POKENAME视力不佳，听觉却极其精准。任何声响都可能令它逃跑，或迎面冲来，狠狠撞上一记头槌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight but very precise hearing due to living in pitch-black caves. Any sort of sound will either cause it to flee or charge head on with a powerful headbutt.

entry: 万圣节之夜，POKENAME会出来寻找幼童，引诱他们。受到威胁时，会发出似乎只让成人痛苦的高频噪声。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen on Halloween nights, looking for young children to lure in. When threatened it will produce a high-frequency noise that only seems to be painful to adults.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎轻如空气，能轻松随风漂游。身上的灰棉絮常被用作隔音材料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is almost as light as air, allowing it to float effortlessly along the breeze. The grey cotton on its body is commonly used as a sound-dampening material.

entry: POKENAME不断随电能振动，声响在20英尺外也能听见。它能用双翼将声音集中，轰出震耳欲聋的声波。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly vibrating with electrical energy, creating a sound loud enough to be heard from 20 feet away. It can concentrate this sound into deafening blasts by using its wings.

entry: 中空的獠牙能吸取所吃树果的汁液。它对声音极其敏感，太吵便会变得凶暴。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tusks are hollow and are able to draw the fluids out of the berries it eats. It is very sensitive to sounds and will turn aggressive if things get too loud.

entry: POKENAME中空的胸腔能发出强劲声波，足以震碎石墙。传闻，许多早期声学器具都是受POKENAME启发而造。
author: mistymagius
source: The hollow cavity in POKENAME's chest can produce sound waves powerful enough to pulverize a stone wall. There are rumors that POKENAME was the inspiration for many early acoustic devices.

entry: POKENAME用精准的回声定位，只挑最美的宝石装饰自己。古代城塞前，还能见到守卫般的POKENAME雕像。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME searches for only the most beautiful gemstones to adorn itself with using its highly accurate echolocation. Statues of POKENAME can be seen guarding ancient citadels.

entry: POKENAME住在冰洞，用黑色毛发保暖。它们成群与悬垂的冰柱共鸣，奏出独特的小曲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in frozen caves, using their black fur to keep themselves warm in the cold. Groups of these Pokémon can be seen resonating frequencies with hanging icicles to create a unique little tune.

entry: 据说POKENAME能夺走一切生物的发声能力，让整座城镇陷入死寂。传闻只要被POKENAME听见，就会立刻失声。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to be able to extract the sound-making capabilities of any living thing, leaving entire towns dead silent. The tales say if POKENAME can hear you, you will be silenced immediately.

entry: POKENAME每次使用声音能力，黏软的身体就会振动。它黏在洞顶等猎物，再放出音波冲击，将其暂时震晕。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's slimy body vibrates anytime it uses its sonic abilities. It sticks itself to the top of caves waiting for prey, then blasts them with a sonic shockwave, stunning its prey temporarily.

entry: POKENAME的双翼足以轻松将它带离地面，只是撑不了太久。强壮的手臂则能单手提起一名成人。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their size, POKENAME's wings can easily get off the ground, just not for long periods of time. Its powerful arms allow it to carry an adult human with just one hand.

entry: 传说，只要POKENAME在附近，就能听见被它埋葬的受害者尖叫。身体由独特的紫色沙粒构成，在富人间十分珍贵。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that the screams of the victims it has buried can be heard anytime a POKENAME is around. Its body is made of a unique purple sand that is highly treasured amongst the wealthy.

entry: POKENAME通常住在湿洞，靠其中的真菌生存。POKENAME虽看不见，背上耳朵状的蘑菇却能让它随时察觉四周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually found in damp caves, thriving on the fungi that grow there. Despite being blind, POKENAME are constantly aware of its surroundings due to the ear-like mushrooms on its back.

entry: POKENAME能像雷达般凭声音追踪物体，是很受欢迎的旅伴。但野生POKENAME若成群无人约束，就会闹出不小的骚动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular travelling companions for their radar-like ability to track objects through sound. However, swarms of wild POKENAME can cause quite the ruckus if left unchecked.

entry: 别看这副模样，POKENAME最爱水果！谁给它好吃的，它便忠心相待，还能带迷路的矿工与探险者，走出暗洞。
author: captainzscourge
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME loves fruit! It's loyal to anyone who gives it a treat, and can help lost miners and explorers out of dark caves.

entry: 它们靠超声波，在暗洞中飞快穿行，常被探险者误认为传说中的异兽。
author: captainzscourge
source: These Pokémon move swiftly through dark caverns with its ultrasonic capabilities. They're often mistaken for legendary creatures by explorers.

entry: 这些闹腾的宝可梦会从楼上跃下，尝试飞行。耳朵朝地面放出强劲声波，借此托住身体。
author: mistymagius
source: These rambunctious Pokémon can be seen leaping off buildings in an attempt to fly. They will use their ears to blast high-pressure sound waves into the ground to keep themselves aloft.

entry: POKENAME歌唱得不怎么样，却总对着麦克风唱个不停，声音放大到超过140分贝，连附近的窗玻璃都震碎了。
author: mistymagius
source: Even though its singing is not that great, POKENAME will constantly sing into its microphone, amplifying its voice to over 140 decibels which ends up shattering any windows within its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME出生时太重，飞不起来，因此用回声寻找轻质岩石，重建身体。不过，这也会让它变得更脆弱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses echolocation to search for lightweight rocks to rebuild its body with because at birth their body is too heavy to fly. However, this does mean it becomes more fragile in the process.

entry: 扬声器般的耳朵奏出甜美的曲子，仿佛儿时的摇篮曲，让猎物沉睡，再吞食其梦。受POKENAME侵扰后，常会出现短暂失眠。
author: mistymagius
source: Its speaker-like ears play a sweet melody similar to childhood lullabies that lulls its victims into a deep sleep, then feeds on their dreams. Victims of POKENAME often experience short-lasting insomnia.

entry: 尖刺撞上物体会发出巨响。它狩猎时在半空高速翻滚，四处射刺，再凭回声判断猎物的位置。
author: celio_0230
source: This Pokémon's spikes are capable of emitting a loud noise on impact. While hunting, it will rapidly roll in midair, launching spikes everywhere to echolocate their prey's location.

entry: POKENAME飞起来不如其他飞行宝可梦优雅，主要在夜间捕猎。听觉敏锐又擅长挖掘，必要时能追着猎物钻入洞穴，深入地下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Not as graceful in the air as other flying Pokémon, POKENAME mostly hunts at night. It uses its sharp hearing to track prey down and is adept at digging, enabling it to chase prey Pokémon into burrows and underground if needed.

entry: POKENAME脚上的声波装置，能在踢击时将敌人震飞，也能帮它跳得更高。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME use sonic emitters on their feet to send foes flying when they kick at them. They also use these emitters to amplify their jumps.

entry: 它放出响亮的音乐，诱来幽灵宝可梦，吞作食物。据说，POKENAME音乐的频率，只有亡魂听得见。
author: yoshimon
source: It plays loud music to attract Ghost Pokémon to consume. The music POKENAME produces is said to be at frequencies only spirits can hear.

entry: 偶尔能见到POKENAME率领一大群驹刀小兵。它们向POKENAME学会了发出超声波、亮刃跃入空中，比普通驹刀小兵更加危险。
author: beatdoof
source: On rare occasions, POKENAME can be seen leading a large pack of Pawniard. They are more dangerous than regular Pawniard because they learned from POKENAME how to emit ultrasonic waves and leap through the sky with their blades ready.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋最漆黑的深处。先用回声定位找到猎物，再唱海妖般的歌将其引来，以声波出击。
author: jordanx27
source: POKENAME live in the darkest depths of the sea. It uses echolocation to detect its prey, lures it in with a siren song, then strike with sonic waves.

entry: POKENAME能从身体播放音乐，因此很受城市与派对欢迎。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME has the ability to project music from its body. It is popular in cities and at parties for this reason.

entry: 自从融合后，POKENAME便迷上了电子音乐。它随身带着一台手提音响，盼着把这份热爱分享给全世界。
author: nellnast42
source: Since Fusion, POKENAME has become enamored by electronic music. It carries around a boombox, hoping to share its passion with the world.

entry: POKENAME将舌头当作乐器，能发出高达200分贝的声音。若一直使用这种能力，就会失聪，直到解除融合才恢复。
author: celio_0230
source: By using its tongue as a instrument, POKENAME can reach sounds up to 200 decibels. Constant use of its abilities will cause it to go deaf until unfused.

entry: POKENAME刺耳的咆哮声位居野外最响之列，常让敌我双方都受惊。传说，它能将声音凝聚于四拳，不必碰触，就能震碎山岳。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME's cacophonous roars are some of the loudest in the wild, often frightening friend and foe alike. Stories say this Pokémon can condense sound into its four fists and shatter mountains without physically touching them.

entry: 它带来的音乐，明明响得很，却很容易让人听着入睡，即使原本毫无倦意，也不例外。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: The music that this fusion brings with it is really loud, but it is very easy to fall asleep to it, even when you are not tired.

entry: POKENAME颈部与尾巴的毛，柔软细腻，很受孩子喜爱。它又友好得很，跟谁都容易交上朋友。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Children love POKENAME because of the soft, delicate fur on its neck and tail. It is extremely friendly, making friends with anyone very easily.

entry: 它能改变云尾的密度，借此漂在空中。不过，这项本领，尚未完全掌握。
author: staghorn
source: It can change the density of its cloud-like tail, allowing it to float through the air. It has not yet learned to fully control this ability.

entry: POKENAME头上的绒毛，比最好的丝还柔软，因此，人们常把POKENAME当枕头。
author: blazerxz
source: The fluff on POKENAME's head is softer than the finest silk. Because of this, people like using POKENAME as pillows.

entry: POKENAME用柔软毛发，安慰身边的伙伴。性情友善，又爱陪人玩，是备受喜爱的伴侣。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME uses its soft fur to comfort those around it. It is very friendly and loves playing with people, making it a beloved companion.

entry: POKENAME身上看似毛发的，其实是一缕缕云，能让身体足够轻，跃上高空。高山之巅，常能看见它们在崖壁间蹦跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: What looks like body fur is actually wisps of cloud that POKENAME uses to help make itself light enough to leap high in the air. They can be found high up in mountaintops bounding across cliff faces.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩，喜欢为人类与宝可梦唱歌跳舞，也很享受演出时，收获的目光。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is very playful, and it enjoys singing and dancing for both people and Pokémon. It enjoys the attention it receives from its performances.

entry: 云朵般的手臂压缩内部空气，就能打出毁灭性的重拳。战斗太激烈时，手臂会变暗，甚至放出小闪电。
author: markusknight
source: Their cloudy arms can send a devastating punch by compressing the air in them. When they fight too intensively, the arms turn darker and can even release small bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，摸着却柔软极了。它爱在天上奔跑，从一朵云，跃向另一朵云。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's fire is extremely soft to the touch. It likes to gallop in the sky, prancing from cloud to cloud.

entry: POKENAME友善又爱交际，常陪成群的青绵鸟穿越平原，既作伴，也让它们在云朵般的象鼻中歇息。
author: cpnquacken
source: An extremely friendly and sociable Pokémon. POKENAME tend to travel across the plains with flocks of Swablu, giving them company and a place to rest within its cloudy trunk.

entry: POKENAME的云里，盛着牛奶般的液体，滋味比普通大奶罐的奶还新鲜。身上的斑纹，有时也会发亮。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME's clouds hold milk-like liquid that tastes fresher than average Miltank milk. The markings on its body seem to glow sometimes.

entry: POKENAME开朗友好，喜欢把自己产的蛋，分给朋友。煮熟后，蛋质轻盈蓬松，却没什么味道。
author: almightyonion
source: A joyful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME loves to share the eggs it lays with its friends. When cooked, the eggs are light and airy, but lack flavor.

entry: POKENAME悠悠飘过丛林上空的蓝天。谁若伤害林中的动物，它就会张口喷出火球。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME drifts serenely through the blue sky above jungles. It will launch fireballs from its mouth at anyone who is harming the jungle's fauna.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，只有几道彩虹相近出现时，才比较常见。难得一见的身影，让许多人相信，它就是传说中彩虹尽头的宝藏。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: It is said POKENAME are incredibly rare, only frequently appearing when multiple rainbows form close together. Their scarcity has led many people to believe that this Pokémon is the fabled treasure at the end of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME连大气最细微的变化，也能感知。它的出现，常预示当地将有猛烈雷暴。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME can sense even the slightest atmospheric changes. Its presence signifies a severe thunderstorm in the area.

entry: 身体轻如空气，随风任意起舞，无忧无虑。芭蕾舞者也从POKENAME优雅的飘带中，汲取舞蹈灵感。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is as light as air, it whimsically dances along wind currents without a care in the world. Ballerinas have taken inspiration from POKENAME's graceful ribbons in their dances.

entry: 它取来遗失、遭弃的毛绒玩具填充物，用来装扮自己。谁若往伪装下面偷看，就会沉沉睡去。
author: almightyonion
source: It takes the stuffing from lost and thrown-away plushes to use in its disguise. Any who peek under its disguise will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME飘游空中，任何靠近的小宝可梦都会被咬。它其实颇温顺，不攻击比自己大的对象。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will drift through the sky, biting any small Pokémon that approaches. It is actually quite docile and won't attack anything larger than it.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合，竟成了完全由云构成的身体。模样似乎很像，遥远地区某种现象带来的形态。
author: jackjirachi
source: This self-fusion of POKENAME is made purely out of clouds. It seems to resemble a certain form caused by a phenomenon in a faraway region.

entry: 民间传说里，这样的宝可梦会在来世，迎接你的到来。它的旋律，能让每只宝可梦安定下来。
author: dodoowner_
source: Folktales say a Pokémon like this will greet you in the afterlife. Its melodies can calm each and every Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一边飞，一边唱，把云当作舞台。旋律温柔，让听见的生物，都能得到慰藉。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME loves to sing as it flies through the sky. It uses the clouds as a stage, singing a song that comforts all who hear its tune.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头，总爱一起唱歌。可想唱得和谐，倒是极难得的事。
author: serversizeme
source: The three heads of POKENAME are often together in song. However, it's a rare occurrence for all of them to harmonize.

entry: 一只POKENAME就能操纵方圆两千英里内的所有云朵，借这魔法隐藏自己，躲避捕食者。
author: gurguro
source: A single POKENAME is able to control every cloud within a two thousand mile radius. They use this magic to hide themselves from predators.

entry: POKENAME体内分泌的黏液，略带酸性，黏得出奇，十分难洗掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a viscous slime from inside its body. The slime is slightly acidic and incredibly hard to wash off.

entry: POKENAME爱与训练家玩捉迷藏，躲的位置总有巧思。可一路留下的黏液，又让它轻易被找着。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to play hide-and-seek with its Trainer. Although the trail of goo it leaves behind makes it easy to find, it has creative hiding spots.

entry: 它们群居生活，彼此保湿、降温，用体液交流。可体液不能用得太多，否则自己就会干掉。
author: soup1900
source: They live in groups to keep each other moist and cool. It uses its bodily fluids to communicate, but it can't use too much of it or it'll dry up.

entry: POKENAME体表黏液导电性极强，周围总有微弱电场。它们控制不精，常一激动想亲热，就电到训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
