source: Coated in highly conductive slime, POKENAME are constantly surrounded by weak electrical fields. They lack fine control over these fields and often shock their Trainers in their eagerness to show affection.

entry: POKENAME性情十分温顺，常让水宝可梦靠近，吃背上分泌的黏液。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME is a very docile Pokémon. It is often spotted letting Water types eat the slime that's produced on its back.

entry: POKENAME最爱下雨，身上的细鳞会吸收水分，再把水变成黏稠液体。
author: clawshdi
source: POKENAME love the rain. They soak up moisture through the small scales on their body, later transforming that liquid into a slimy substance.

entry: POKENAME很想打架，奈何身体黏软脆弱，几乎维持不住，只好折中，专挑湿淋淋的宝可梦交手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wants to fight, but can barely contain its weak, slimy composition. It compromises by exclusively fighting wet Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME分泌的易燃油很适合烹饪与取暖，最长能连续燃烧一周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body secretes a flammable oil that is very useful in cooking and heating. The oil can burn for up to a week without interruption.

entry: POKENAME住在浑浊的泥沼，将凝胶身体压入泥下，静候猎物。随后鼓起身体，从藏处弹出，伸展双颚，整只吞下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwell within murky bogs, squishing their gelatinous bodies beneath the mire to lie in wait for prey. They puff up their bodies to launch themselves from their hiding spots, extending their jaws to swallow their prey whole.

entry: POKENAME用凝固的黏液造出头盔，保护自己跳崖试飞。好在身体像凝胶，角度偏了也能缓冲撞击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create a protective helmet out of solidified mucus to help protect them as they launch off of cliffs in attempts to fly. Luckily, their bodies are rather gelatinous, helping them to cushion the blow if their angle is off.

entry: 双翼由颊囊分泌的黏性物质构成。食谱一不合适，就会飞不起来，因此饲养费用相当高。
author: staghorn
source: Its wings are made up of slime and mucus secreted from its cheek pouches. Feeding it the wrong diet will make it unable to fly, so it's a rather expensive Pokémon to take care of.

entry: 它把腐蚀性黏液，吐向猎物，好更容易吃下。也有人拿这种黏液，清理生锈的金属。
author: kittyluv090
source: It spits corrosive slime on its prey, making it easier to eat. Some people use this substance for cleaning rusted metal.

entry: POKENAME把黏液聚在颈间，用来隔热。这些黏液，还能帮助入睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME collects slime around its neck and uses it as protection against heat. This slime also has properties that facilitate sleep.

entry: POKENAME在囊袋里生成黏液球，送给喜欢的训练家。黏液常用于高档防晒霜，其实相当值钱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produce slimeballs in its pouch that it gives out to Trainers it likes. The slime is actually quite valuable as it is commonly used in high quality sunscreens.

entry: POKENAME爪上产生胶状毒液，能制服猎物。但毒液太稠，POKENAME有时很难将其注入。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claws produce a glue-like poison which it uses to incapacitate its prey. However, POKENAME can have difficulty injecting the poison due to its thickness.

entry: 这些可怕宝可梦的身体渗出致命毒液，覆满铁颚。矿工若在地下深处遇见它们，可得小心。
author: mistymagius
source: The bodies of these monstrous Pokémon seep a deadly poison that coats their iron jaws. Miners should be afraid of encountering these Pokémon while mining deep underground.

entry: 在坚硬的壳内，POKENAME把收集来的叶子与树皮，加工成浓稠的胶。遇上天敌，便用胶将其黏在原地，趁机逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: Inside its tough shell, POKENAME produces a thick glue-like paste from the leaves and bark it likes to collect. It uses the glue to stop predators in their tracks, allowing it to escape.

entry: POKENAME的金属爪上覆着多种腐蚀物，被抓伤十分危险。它们头脑简单，只想着吃饭与睡觉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its metallic talons are coated with many corrosive chemicals that make POKENAME a dangerous Pokémon to be scratched by. They are simple-minded Pokémon who only desire food and sleep.

entry: POKENAME滚动时留下滑黏液，常将追兵弄得晕头转向。它们爱玩，喜欢陪孩子嬉戏，尤其喜欢被揉肚子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leave a slippery slime as it rolls that often disorient its pursuers. They are quite playful Pokémon and love to play with children. They especially love belly rubs.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会吐出强酸，足以把人腐蚀得只剩白骨。有人推测，POKENAME原本可能是某种外星生物的茧。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME spits a strong acid that is strong enough to melt anyone straight to the bone. Some people have theorized that POKENAME was originally some sort of alien cocoon.

entry: 核事故后，常有这些宝可梦的目击记录。黏软的身体能挤过细缝，因此巢穴也极其狭窄。
author: mistymagius
source: Sightings of these Pokémon are common after nuclear accidents. Their dens are incredibly narrow since their viscous bodies allow them to squeeze through tight gaps.

entry: 有人推测POKENAME来自天外。双臂喷出的绿色酸液，几乎能熔掉一切。灵敏的触角还能感知50英尺外的其他生物。
author: mistymagius
source: Theorized to be an extra-terrestrial being, POKENAME fires an acidic green liquid from its arms that can melt just about anything. Its sensitive antennae are able to sense other creatures over 50 feet away.

entry: POKENAME以强酸溶穿坚岩，寻找稀有矿物为食。它们极其好斗，谁来打扰，就想咬谁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses a strong acid to melt through solid rock in search of rare minerals to eat. They are very aggressive Pokémon and will attempt to bite anyone who disturbs them.

entry: POKENAME身上的木夹固定着柔软的身体，免得散开。绿色黏液性质似油，有人推测它能成为极佳的能源。
author: mistymagius
source: The wooden clamps on POKENAME's body keep its soft body from falling apart. The green slime it produces acts similar to oil and is theorized to be an amazing energy source.

entry: POKENAME体表覆着橡胶般的物质，抵抗物理攻击的本领出奇强。胶层难吃的味道，也让其他宝可梦不愿攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a rubber-like substance that is oddly resistant to physical attacks. The unpleasant taste of the rubber discourages other Pokémon from attacking it.

entry: POKENAME有三个强劲的头，几乎什么都能毁掉。好在它安静又爱好和平。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME has three powerful heads that can destroy almost anything. Fortunately, this Pokémon is very quiet and peaceful.

entry: 深洞生活让POKENAME视力不佳，总拿头撞到周围的东西。好在身体柔软，不易受物理损伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight due to living in deep cave systems, which is why it will constantly headbutt its surroundings. Luckily, its soft body is resistant to physical injury.

entry: POKENAME的壳由大囊构成，里面装着酸性黏液。一被刺破，就会喷出。它们几乎不离开巢穴，耐心等待进化。
author: mistymagius
source: The large sacs that make up POKENAME's shell are filled with an acidic slime which sprays out if these sacs are punctured. They almost never move from their dens, waiting patiently for evolution.

entry: 獠牙上覆着强酸性的绿色黏液，让POKENAME几乎无物不切。哪怕只是轻轻擦过，也可能危及生命。
author: mistymagius
source: The green slime that coats its tusks is extremely acidic. This allows for POKENAME to slice through basically anything. Even the slightest graze from these tusks can be life-threatening.

entry: POKENAME靠黏软的身体附在洞壁。虽然没牙，仍会咬住猎物，用腐蚀性唾液将其溶化，再由POKENAME吸食干净。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sticks itself to cave walls using its gooey body. Despite its lack of teeth, it will bite into its prey, using its corrosive saliva to melt them until POKENAME can slurp them up.

entry: POKENAME颈边的泡沫黏性极强，连最大的宝可梦也能当场黏住。它们十分友善，喜欢得到人类的疼爱。
author: mistymagius
source: The foam around POKENAME's neck is extremely sticky and can stop even the largest of Pokémon in their tracks. They are very friendly and adore human affection.

entry: 它们淘气又爱耍花招，用翼上黏液迷惑敌人、拖慢动作，甚至遮住视线。滑溜的身体，也让它们轻松逃离天敌。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon like to play dirty, using the slime on their wings to disorient, slow down, or even blind their opponents. Their slippery bodies allow them to escape predators with ease.

entry: POKENAME用弹性外壳保护柔软娇弱的身体，任何飞来物都能弹开。想快些移动，就缩起四肢，如足球般滚行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects its soft, delicate body with its elastic shell, which allows any projectiles to bounce off of it. To get around quickly, it will tuck in its limbs and roll around like a soccer ball.

entry: 它贪玩地带着吹泡泡棒，逗孩子开心。吹出的泡泡软软的，却很结实。
author: busilisk
source: This playful Pokémon carries a bubble wand, which it uses to entertain children. The bubbles it creates are squishy but durable.

entry: POKENAME站进巨坑或山谷，放出大量黏液，最终，便形成一座供自己居住的黏液湖。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME will produce massive amounts of goop while standing in a large crater or valley. The result is a lake of slime that becomes their home.

entry: POKENAME对人类与宝可梦都极其友善，却格外护着训练家。任何想伤害主人的对象，都会成为它试图摧毁的目标。
author: jennybean
source: POKENAME are known to be extremely friendly towards people and Pokémon. However, they are extremely protective of their Trainers, and will attempt to destroy anyone who tries to harm them.

entry: 颈间黏稠的褶边，可用来制药。有野生宝可梦急需治疗时，它甚至会主动喂对方黏液。
author: zeeroooo
source: The goo frill around its neck can be used to make potions. Sometimes it will even feed wild Pokémon its goo if they need immediate medical help.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，是一种黏性聚合物。兴奋时，不只会困住敌人，连同伴也可能被黏住。不过，交给好厨师烤过，滋味也很不错。
author: greystorm101
source: POKENAME's goo is a sticky polymer that can trap foes and even allies when excited. It's also delicious when roasted by a great chef.

entry: 据说，古人曾将POKENAME用作烟雾弹。它们偏爱用脆石裹身，让气体能排出，免得积在体内引爆。
author: frokachu
source: Thought to have been used as smoke bombs in ancient times, POKENAME prefer brittle rocks to coat their body, so that their gases don't get trapped and cause them to explode.

entry: 人们能在杂草丛生的遗迹里发现随意滚动的POKENAME。它身上苔藓中突出的“石头”，其实是外壳极硬的甜树果。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME can be found haphazardly rolling through overgrown ruins. The rocks protruding from the moss growing on them are actually sweet berries with extremely hard shells.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在小心维持平衡，好让全身各部件聚在一起。头顶的岩石像声呐，能探知风的变化，帮助它随时调整姿态。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME spend most of their time maintaining the delicate balancing act of keeping all of their parts together. They use the rock on the top of their heads like sonar to detect changes in the wind and adapt to them to stay balanced.

entry: POKENAME严守各地草木蔓生的遗迹。它们缓步巡逻领地，始终高度戒备，七只眼睛各自扫视四周。
author: hummusishome
source: Overgrown ruins across the region are ferociously guarded by POKENAME. They lumber through their territory on constant high alert, scanning the area with each of their seven eyes.

entry: 它们产生的气体极易燃烧，温度接近摄氏1400度。POKENAME整天坐着烧气，直到最终进化。
author: hummusishome
source: The gas they create is highly flammable and burns at close to 1400 degrees Celsius. POKENAME sit around burning this gas all day until they eventually evolve.

entry: POKENAME一移动，背上排列的石头就会开裂，放出极易燃烧的气体。受威胁时，它们会主动将气体点燃。
author: hummusishome
source: As POKENAME move, cracks form in the stones lining their backs, releasing highly flammable gas. They ignite this gas voluntarily when threatened.

entry: POKENAME外壳的特殊气孔，会排出体内产生的易燃废气。气体究竟由什么化学成分构成，仍不得而知。
author: hummusishome
source: Specialized vents in the outer shells of POKENAME expel the flammable gas they produce as a waste product. The true chemical composition of this gas is still unknown.

entry: POKENAME缓缓巡行古代遗迹，用石灰石修补身体。因为每走一步，身体都会渐渐磨成细沙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen slowly patrolling ancient ruins, using the limestone to rebuild its body. This is because as it moves, its body slowly grinds down to a fine sand.

entry: 刀刃用来切开岩石。若POKENAME身体有部位崩落，这些石料，便能拿来修补。
author: .flipside3
source: Its blades are used to cut through rock. POKENAME uses this rock to repair itself if parts of it break off.

entry: POKENAME嵌进裸露的岩层，在同一处待上几个月，吸取周围养分。待得足够久后，就会冲破头顶堆积的石块，常因此引发山崩。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME embed themselves into rocky outcroppings and spend months in one spot absorbing nutrients around them. Once they've spent enough time in one place, they break through the rocks that have accumulated above them, often causing rockslides.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，偶尔仍能在野外发现。人们相信，它们是朽木妖的木身，石化而来。
author: cristata
source: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.

entry: 这种融合体，最初发现于积雪苔原。POKENAME放出的闪电，不留灼伤，反在皮肤上结出片片冰。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion was first discovered in a snowy tundra. POKENAME emits lightning that leaves patches of ice on the skin instead of burns.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方放出强力闪电，所到之处，留下厚厚冰层。这特性，近来引起了科学家兴趣。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits strong lightning in all directions, leaving behind thick layers of ice. This property has recently aroused the interest of scientists.

entry: 训练家把铁甲蛹遗弃在霜抹山，才形成这种天然融合体。它梦想着进化，再回来复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: This natural fusion occured when a Trainer abandoned a Metapod in the Glaseado Mountains. It dreams of evolving and getting revenge.

entry: POKENAME冰翼扬起的飞雪，会先使敌人入睡，几分钟后再将其冻住。这是登山者命丧雪峰最常见的原因之一。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME's glacial wings produce flurries that will put opponents to sleep, then freeze them after a few minutes. This is one of the most common ways hikers pass away on snowy peaks.

entry: POKENAME的身体由奇异的物质构成，即使比冰点低上几百度，仍柔软得能随意变形。任何东西一碰到这团黏液，就会瞬间冻结。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange substance that somehow stays soft and malleable even hundreds of degrees below freezing. Anything that comes in contact with the slime will freeze instantly.

entry: POKENAME再生能力惊人，只要头还在，整个身体都能长得完好如初。身上的绿球是浓缩化学物质，无物不溶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have amazing regenerative abilities; as long as its head remains, it can grow its body back good as new. The green orbs on its body are a concentrated chemical that can melt through anything.

entry: 背后的花朵，几秒内便能冻住附近的一切。北极光升起时，常能看到成群POKENAME，躺在光幕下面休息。
author: skymaster426
source: The flower on its back can freeze anything near it within seconds. When the aurora borealis starts, groups of POKENAME can be sighted resting below.

entry: 据报道，POKENAME现身之地，便能看见极光。身体虽像覆冰的玻璃，却比多数金属更坚固。
author: pepperthepirate
source: It is reported that, where POKENAME appears, an aurora can be seen. Though its body resembles iced over glass, it is stronger than most metals.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自宇宙最寒冷的深处，体温仅略高于绝对零度。它会残酷地以寒冰之力，熄灭一切找到的热源。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have come from the coldest depths of space, POKENAME's body temperature is only barely above absolute zero. It will brutally snuff out any source of heat it can find with its icy powers.

entry: POKENAME的火焰无声而酷寒，因此不会熔化冰质身体。谁一靠得太近，它便消失。
author: aurange
source: The flames POKENAME produces are silent and freezing cold. As a result, they do not cause its icy body to melt. It vanishes if anyone comes too close.

entry: 实验室里的一场意外，让周围的冰，获得生命。一声咆哮，就能令山中暴雪，持续数周。
author: skymaster426
source: The surrounding ice has been brought to life via a freak accident in a lab. It can cause a blizzard on mountains for weeks with a single roar.

entry: POKENAME成群漂在极地水中，吞噬眼前的一切。构成身体的冰始终锐利，强韧得足以击碎巨石。
author: mistymagius
source: Schools of POKENAME float in arctic waters devouring anything in sight. The ice that makes up its body always stays sharp and is strong enough to shatter boulders.

entry: 融合中的基因错误破坏了它的核心。如今竟同时结冻、融化，形成矛盾的状态。
author: skymaster426
source: A genetic error in the fusion process corrupted the core of this Pokémon. It is paradoxically freezing and melting at the same time.

entry: POKENAME是真正的英雄，能随心重塑身体。它与另外九只宝可梦组队，用各自的力量守护世界。
author: ethewriter
source: A true hero, POKENAME can reform its body at will. It works with a team of nine other Pokémon, protecting the world with their powers.

entry: POKENAME体温低于摄氏零下100度，身上的火却始终燃烧。此现象，至今尚未经过研究。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME's body temperature is below -100 degrees Celsius, the fire on its body burns continuously. This phenomenon has not yet been studied.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为大岩蛇的地区形态。直到科学家发现，两者身体的原子结构完全不同，这看法才改变。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME were once considered a regional form of Onix. However, this changed when scientists discovered that its body has a completely different atomic structure.

entry: POKENAME友善得很，可模样令人不安，大多数人依然害怕，远远避开。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon but because of its unsettling appearance most people fear and avoid it entirely.

entry: 裸露皮肤碰上冰冷的金属身体，就会黏住。POKENAME的声响会损坏现代设备，尤其导航系统，因此海上贸易航线禁止它出现。
author: sontyp
source: Bare skin touching the freezing metal of its body sticks. The sounds POKENAME makes can damage modern technology and especially navigational systems, so it's prohibited along naval trade routes.

entry: 这种融合体强得惊人，咬合力之大，连钻石都能咬碎。
author: famerman2
source: This fusion is extremely strong. It can bite with enough force to crush diamonds.

entry: 两种宝可梦彼此不相容，让融合体融化，行动艰难。可它似乎毫不在意，仍拖着壳，慢慢往前走。
author: ohok3441
source: Due to the incompatibility of both Pokémon, this fusion is melted and struggles to move. It seems unbothered and continues to drag along its shell.

entry: POKENAME移动起来，几乎快如闪电。可动作不够协调，跑着跑着，就可能撞上东西。
author: famerman2
source: POKENAME can move nearly as fast as lightning. However, it is not very coordinated and can run into things while doing so.

entry: POKENAME纯为战争而造，力量毫无拘束，也不带怜悯。POKENAME眼中朱红的光，宛如双刃，能刺穿迷雾。
author: rooboid
source: Built only for war, POKENAME boast unfettered, callous strength. The vermillion glow of POKENAME's eyes can cut through the fog like two sabres.

entry: 科学家创造POKENAME，想造一件坚不可摧的新型强力武器。机械化的兵装，也让POKENAME足以击败任何敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.

entry: 古代文明造出的机械巨蛇，原为保护创造者，却最终失控，反成了毁灭他们的祸首。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A mechanical serpent built by an ancient civilization. Though originally created to protect them, it went rogue and became their destroyer.

entry: 科学家高估了自己的融合本领，才产生POKENAME。它比普通金属更容易生锈，徘徊在废弃神殿附近。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the result of scientists overestimating their fusion capabilities. It rusts faster than normal metal and wanders around abandoned temples.

entry: POKENAME虽沉重，动作却灵巧得惊人。即使高速移动，炮管射出的光束，也能准确命中。
author: famerman2
source: POKENAME is shockingly agile for its weight. It can accurately fire beams out of its cannon even at high speeds.

entry: 它强壮又坚韧，常被富裕训练家用来护宅。机械化的双眼与尾巴一齐搜寻，便无人能逃过。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: A strong and resilient fusion often used to defend the homes of wealthy Trainers. With the help of its cybernetic eyes and tail, no one can escape it.

entry: POKENAME所到之处，机器腐蚀、金属生锈。核心虽然满是锈蚀腐败，任何攻击却都划不伤。
author: celio_0230
source: Wherever POKENAME treads, machinery corrodes and metals rust. Its metal core, despite being covered in rust and decay, is unable to be scratched by any attack.

entry: POKENAME假扮成沼泽植物的花。有人靠近，便先撒出大量剧毒花粉，再赶紧逃走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME likes to disguise itself as the flower of a swamp plants. Anyone approaching it is bombarded with highly toxic pollen before it flees.

entry: POKENAME浮在沼泽表面，以甜香引来虫宝可梦，再用花粉，让对方麻痹。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME floats on the surface of bogs. It emits a sweet scent to attract bug Pokémon, which it then paralyzes using pollen.

entry: 它身上气味刺鼻，走过时，就能让一些人类与宝可梦，当场昏倒。
author: theheroict
source: The scent given off by this Pokémon is pungent. It causes some Pokémon and humans to faint when it walks by.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密丛林，清晨穿行树冠，白天便静止休息。头顶大花能从远处引来虫属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in lush jungles, moving through the canopy in the mornings and settling in place during the day. The large flowers on their heads draw in bug Pokémon from great distances.

entry: POKENAME游荡丛林，培育真菌。分泌物是这些菌类的绝佳肥料，对植物、人类与其他宝可梦却有剧毒。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME wanders the jungles growing fungi. Its secretions act as a great fertilizer for said fungi, but they are incredibly toxic to plants, people, and other Pokémon.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME会袭击村庄。白天若看见它，就意味着不久会遭到伏击。
author: codewolfie
source: In ancient times, POKENAME would ravage villages. Seeing one during the day signified an ambush in the near future.

entry: 这根手杖会放出黄色的花粉云，效力强得足以让人麻痹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This staff emits a clouds of yellow pollen that is so potent it can cause paralysis.

entry: 身上的大花，散出安抚心神的香气，让任何靠近的生物，都渐渐平静。
author: melodydelune
source: The large flowers on its body emit a calming aroma that pacifies anyone that comes near.

entry: 据说，它会在雨后漆黑的夜里出现。甜腻的花粉能让人类与宝可梦瞬间入眠。
author: busilisk
source: It is said to appear during dark nights after rain. Its cloying pollen can put people and Pokémon to sleep instantly.

entry: 羽毛沾满剧毒、刺人的花粉。一激动，便拍起双翅，让令人窒息的粉尘，充斥四周。
author: staghorn
source: Its feathers are saturated with toxic, stinging pollen. When agitated, it flaps its wings and chokes its surroundings with its suffocating powder.

entry: 这只大花宝可梦，花瓣长得太盛，几乎动不了身，便用花粉诱来其他宝可梦，照顾自己。
author: theheroict
source: A large flower Pokémon overgrown with petals. It can barely move, but uses pollen to lure Pokémon in to care for it.

entry: 它用欺人的旋律迷住毫无戒心的宝可梦，再借花粉催眠，强迫对方失神地替自己收集食物。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: It captivates unassuming Pokémon with its deceitful melody. Using its pollen, it hypnotizes and forces the Pokémon to mindlessly gather food for it.

entry: POKENAME脸上微笑，心里却怒火翻腾。越是暴怒，POKENAME越会撒毒花粉，偏偏又会引发POKENAME自己的过敏，让它更加火大。
author: darkweavile428
source: Despite POKENAME's smiling face, it is seething with rage on the inside. When it is especially angry, POKENAME will begin spreading poisonous pollen. This pollen also triggers POKENAME's allergies, which serves to make it even angrier.

entry: 它气息芳香，快乐地飘来飘去，把愉悦的芬芳，传给四周，因此十分受欢迎。
author: theheroict
source: A Pokémon with a pleasant scent. It happily floats around spreading joy with the pleasant fragrant. It's very popular as a result.

entry: 很久以前，奈克洛兹玛吸收一只顽皮雷弹，形成了POKENAME。上半球是光之能量，下半球则为暗能量。
author: the_smirker
source: Long ago, a Necrozma absorbed an Electrode, creating POKENAME. Its upper hemisphere is light energy, while the lower hemisphere is dark energy.

entry: POKENAME的双眼很怕光。头盔会吸收日光，替眼睛挡住阳光，可也遮去了不少视线。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's eyes are sensitive to light. Its helmet shields its eyes from sunlight by absorbing it, but it also obscures its vision.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之波奈克洛兹玛”。融合后的超能力，足以让整片海洋，从中分开。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Wave Necrozma. With its combined psychic powers, it is able to cause the ocean itself to split apart.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之热奈克洛兹玛”。吸收凤王体内的热量后，POKENAME能放出世上最炽热的火焰之一。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Heat Necrozma. By absorbing the heat within Ho-Oh, POKENAME can create some of the hottest flames in existence.

entry: 据说，光明与黑暗，正由这只宝可梦创造。消耗了大半光能，身体也已黯淡下来。
author: soup1900
source: It is said that this Pokémon was responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Its body has darkened due to using most of its light energy.

entry: 它穿行各个世界，吞尽所有光芒。许多世界因此沉入永夜，最终走向灭亡。
author: soup1900
source: It traverses through various realms, devouring all the light there is. This has caused many worlds to plunge into eternal darkness and eventually die.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: POKENAME将本体藏在究极空间，用超能力打开究极之洞。谁靠得太近，就会遭到密集的斩击。
author: munchyaxolotls
source: POKENAME hides its body in Ultra Space, using its psychic energy to create ultra wormholes. Those who wander too close are bombarded with slashes.

entry: 凭掌控空间的力量，POKENAME能让自己的光，现于宇宙任何一处。光突然亮起时，宛如超新星爆发。
author: blazerxz
source: With its control over space, POKENAME can make its light appear anywhere in the universe. The sudden appearance of its light is akin to a supernova.

entry: 炮击之后，会留下名为“究极之洞”的奇异通道。这门炮，正是靠光能充能。
author: soup1900
source: The blasts from its cannon are known to leave behind strange portals called Ultra Wormholes. It charges this cannon using light energy.

entry: POKENAME靠阳光维生。能量不足时，会等到下一次日食，再偷偷补充。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME survives off of the light the sun emanates. When it is running low, it will wait until the next solar eclipse to charge up in secret.

entry: POKENAME用超能力搜寻洞中稀有宝石，吞食以获养分。有时太饿，也会攻击游荡的小碎钻。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME uses its psychic prowess to find rare gems in caves, it consumes these gems for nutrients. Occasionally, its hunger will lead it to attack wandering Carbink.

entry: 据说，POKENAME原是异世界的孩子，意外来到这条时间线，还能运用人类无法掌控的黑魔法。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are said to have been otherworldly children, accidentally transported to this timeline. They're said to harness dark magic we cannot control.

entry: POKENAME粉红色的身体并非实体，而是纯粹能量，仅靠构成其形体的黑晶约束在内。
author: ethewriter
source: The pink body of POKENAME is not actually physical. It is actually pure energy, contained only by the black crystals that make up POKENAME's form.

entry: POKENAME穿越虫洞，为歌声寻找新的听众。据说，连宇宙最遥远的角落，也能听见它的旋律。
author: darkclawxxdeath
source: POKENAME travels through wormholes, seeking new audiences for its songs. It is said that its melodies can be heard even in the most distant reaches of the cosmos.

entry: 若听见铁器拖过瓷砖地面的声响，就快逃。一旦被POKENAME抓住，就太迟了。
author: inksans201x
source: If you hear the sound of iron being dragged against tile floors, run away immediately. If POKENAME catches you, it's too late.

entry: POKENAME危险至极，想靠近就得千万小心，最好干脆别去！它的火焰比太阳还热，脾气，也是如此。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is very dangerous; proceed with caution or don't proceed at all! Its flames are hotter than the sun, as is its temper.

entry: POKENAME体内塞满茸茸羊般带静电的绒毛。它虽爱玩，皮肤却常撑裂，训练家得小心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is stuffed to the brim with electrostatic wool similar to that of a Flaaffy. Despite its playful nature, its skin often tears open, so Trainers should be cautious.

entry: POKENAME除了“咪——普”，几乎不说别的话。有些科学家猜测，它可能来自另一个维度。
author: krune
source: POKENAME do not say much, aside from "MEEP". Some scientists theorize that it came from a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME看着像儿童玩具剑，可谁想把它拿起，哪怕轻轻挥上一下，也可能致命。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME may look like a children's toy sword, but a weak swing towards anyone who attempts to pick it up can be lethal.

entry: POKENAME模样像软枕头，力气却大得足以撞倒树木。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resemble soft pillows. However, they are strong enough to knock down trees.

entry: POKENAME凶猛易怒。幸好，牙和爪都是毛毡做的，真伤起谁来，也没多大威力。
author: thisisabruh_moment
source: POKENAME is ferocious and quick to anger. Fortunately for its would-be victims, its teeth and claws are made of felt so it can't do much damage.

entry: 可爱的模样让对手低估实力。以POKENAME为造型的毛绒玩具，常卖得供不应求。
author: markusknight
source: Its adorable appearance makes opponents underestimate its power. Plushies depicting POKENAME are known to be sold with huge demand.

entry: POKENAME身体软得像毯子，常被用来帮助孩子入睡，有时也作为礼物送给新生儿。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is commonly used in sleep therapy for children and is sometimes gifted to newborns. This is due to its incredibly soft, blanket-like body.

entry: POKENAME爱玩的毛线球，覆着一层薄金。若有人想拿走线球，POKENAME就拼命扑打，将它夺回来。
author: gp423
source: The ball of yarn that POKENAME plays with has a thin gold coating. If you try to take this yarn, POKENAME will thrash at you to get it back.

entry: POKENAME一心渴望打拳。可偏偏没有拳头，求而不得，只好一直又怒又恼。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME has an incredible need to get into fistfights. However, lacking fists, it cannot fulfill this need and become endlessly angry and frustrated.

entry: POKENAME的手已无法使用，尾巴便长得强劲，包办过去作为穿着熊时的大多数事情。原本阴森的孔洞也被缝起，不再那么骇人。
author: glacierwing
source: No longer having usable hands, POKENAME's tail has grown strong enough to perform most tasks it did as a Bewear. Its spectral hole has been stitched over, reducing its once-daunting presence.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，毛发却比钢铁更坚韧。它只攻击作恶者，绝不伤害无辜的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its cutesy appearance, POKENAME's fur is tougher than steel. It will only attack wrongdoers and will never harm innocent Pokémon.

entry: 有人一靠近，它便容易胡乱挥打。力道之大，能把对手打飞到很远。
author: .flipside3
source: It has a tendency to flail wildly if approached. The force of its blows can launch opponents very far away.

entry: 海藻的灵魂蔓延到沉船的炮弹与黑火药桶上。如今POKENAME飘来飘去，稍一碰触就会爆炸。
author: chorb33
source: The soul of seaweed overgrew the cannonballs and black powder barrels of a sunken ship. Now, POKENAME floats around and detonates at the merest touch.

entry: 沉船墓场里，POKENAME的数量格外多。可那些船究竟有多少，是它们弄沉的，仍不得而知。
author: chorb33
source: A particularly large number of POKENAME can be found at ship graveyards. The extent to which they are responsible for the sinking of ships is unknown.

entry: POKENAME是人类制造的失败实验品，被扔进海中，盼从此遗忘。怨灵却从水中归来，寻求复仇。
author: nellnast42
source: A failed experiment of human engineering, POKENAME was cast into the sea to be forgotten. Instead, its vengeful spirit rose from the waters to seek revenge.

entry: POKENAME起初看似无害，却会不由自主地吸走照料者的生命力。即使POKENAME因此孤独又满怀怨怼，脸上仍带着微笑。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though seemingly harmless at first, POKENAME will unwillingly drain the life-force of those who care for it. Even though this leads to POKENAME living lives of loneliness and resentment, they smile nonetheless.

entry: 它们是早已去世的善良灯塔看守人的化身。迷航的水手，有时会在深夜得到POKENAME指引。
author: schwaus
source: These Pokémon are the manifestations of goodhearted lighthouse keepers that have long passed. Lost sailors are sometimes guided by POKENAME in the dead of night.

entry: 尾巴上的锚令POKENAME无法自由行动。不过在战斗中，却能当作强劲的连枷挥舞。
author: ohok3441
source: The anchor in POKENAME's tail makes it unable to move freely. However, it is used in battle as a powerful flail.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的船，与时光一样古老。勾魂眼总想偷船中的圆珠，也让POKENAME与它们成了冤家。
author: drip_capybara
source: The ship on the back of POKENAME is said to be as old as time. POKENAME has a rivalry with Sableye as they try to steal the orb in the ship.

entry: POKENAME住在古老沉船，守着前主人生前积攒的宝藏。它会凶猛奋战，直至最后。
author: kermitcermet
source: Living in old sunken ships, POKENAME protects the treasure their previous master amassed in life. This Pokémon fights fiercely to the very end.

entry: POKENAME诞生自大型邮轮沉入海中的吊灯。泡海太久，钢铁早已锈成了坚实的一团。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is born from sunken chandeliers on large cruise ships. Its steel rusted solid after all the time in the ocean.

entry: 贪婪的钥圈儿，曾像海盗一样搜宝，最终为追逐海底财宝而死，被破破舵轮占据身体。如今成了POKENAME，只能漫无目的地漂流。
author: slowforest
source: Once a greedy swashbuckler, Klefki met its end chasing treasures in the deep sea, where Dhelmise seized its body. Now POKENAME, it drifts aimlessly.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓行，捡来锈蚀废金属打造铠甲。受威胁时便猛然挥锚，力道足以碎骨。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME slowly walk along the seafloor, gathering rusted scrap metal to build its armor. When threated they will swing its anchor with enough force to shatter bone.

entry: POKENAME戴着旧潜水头盔护身，在海底找食物。据说，谁想拿下头盔，便会遭到诅咒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME use old diving helmets as protection as they search the ocean floor for food. It is said to curse anyone who tries to remove the helmet.

entry: POKENAME在雾夜走出海洋，能在岸边游荡数日，最后却必须潜回水下，为中空的身体灌满海水。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME emerge from the ocean on misty nights. They can wander the coast for days, but must eventually return beneath the waves to refill their hollow bodies with sea water.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾属于很久以前的一位名船长。谁敢从船长室偷走受诅咒的财宝，就会遭它们攻击。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are said to have belonged to a famous captain from long ago. They attack any who dare to steal their cursed treasure from the captain's room.

entry: 海盗船员的亡魂，与沉船融为一体，形成了它。据说，海上看见这只宝可梦，是不幸将至的预兆。
author: sonicdestroyer12
source: This Pokémon was formed when the souls of a pirate crew united with their sunken ship. Seeing it at sea is said to be an omen of ill fortune.

entry: 据说POKENAME原是一艘海上失踪船只的船首像。它漂泊海洋，舵轮无目的地转着，寻找新的船员。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is rumored to be the figurehead of a ship lost at sea, its ship's wheel spinning aimlessly as it drifts the ocean, searching for a crew.

entry: 深受船员喜爱的沉船残骸获得灵魂，得以重游大海。POKENAME看似随意漂流，其实始终在寻找迷失的灵魂，加入自己的船队。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The wreckage of a sunken ship, beloved by its crew, gained a soul so that it may roam the seas once again. POKENAME appears to drift aimlessly, but it's actually on a constant search for lost souls to join its crew.

entry: 老水手故事里，POKENAME曾率领一群贪婪宝可梦。可它们后来叛变，反将POKENAME沉入大洋深处。
author: chorb33
source: An old sailor's tale tells of POKENAME leading a band of rapacious Pokémon. However, they mutinied and sank POKENAME to the depths of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，很少挪动。有人见过大钳蟹把它当成住处，试着往身体里钻。
author: jokerswild
source: Found on the sea floor, POKENAME rarely move. Krabby have been spotted trying to enter these Pokémon, mistaking them for shelter.

entry: 人们害怕POKENAME惑人的歌声，将它拴到锚上，扔进大海。可水手们说，时至今日，仍能听见它唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: People feared POKENAME's alluring voice, so they chained it to an anchor and tossed it into the sea. Sailors claim they can still hear it to this day.

entry: 据说POKENAME载着渴望永世征服七海的海盗之魂。老船长们说，附近若有财宝，受诅咒的硬币就会发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of pirates seeking eternal conquest across the seven seas. Tales from old captains claim its cursed coin gleams when it detects nearby treasure.

entry: POKENAME用海藻般的长肢捕捉猎物，罗盘似的双眼，则能追踪任何目标。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses its long, seaweed-like limbs to capture prey. It can track anything using its compass eyes.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦拖进大水域，吸走生命力。身体则由生锈的锚与海藻组成。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME drags other Pokémon into large bodies of water, stealing their life force. Its body is made of rusted anchors and seaweed.

entry: 据说POKENAME出没于冰盖附近的沉船，对海上迷途之人而言，是不祥的征兆。
author: murmarine
source: Said to haunt ship wrecks near ice sheets, POKENAME are rumored to be bad omens for those lost at sea.

entry: POKENAME捕猎高效，无声滑过猎物上方，伸出触手注毒。目标倒下后，POKENAME便绕回，用爪抓走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are efficient hunters, gliding silently over their prey and extending their tentacles to inject them with venom. Once the prey is down, POKENAME will loop back around, carrying them away with its claws.

entry: 每只POKENAME都坚信，自己是最漂亮的小公主。没错，它们每一只都是。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are all convinced that they are the prettiest little princess. They are all correct.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺带着致命剧毒，打斗也不择手段。开战前，还会摇晃毒囊。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's spikes are lethally poisonous, and it fights dirty. It shakes the poison in its sack right before a fight.

entry: 鲜亮的硬壳，是给天敌看的警告。可倒刺里的毒，还没成熟到能真正发挥效用。
author: xephyr
source: The vibrancy of its hard shell is meant to ward off predators. However, the poison in its barbs has not matured into an effective toxin yet.

entry: POKENAME见到会动的东西，就会攻击，连同族也不放过。这种融合体，对珊瑚礁危害极大。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME will attack anything that moves, including others of the same species. This fusion wrecks havoc on coral reefs.

entry: 融合给了POKENAME惊人的超能力，可它只把力量，用来恐吓当地的太阳珊瑚群。
author: nellnast42
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME incredible psychic powers. However, it only uses these abilities to terrorize local Corsola populations.

entry: POKENAME气味诱人，却带着毒。即使毒气让人痛苦不堪，许多宝可梦仍不顾一切，寻香而来。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME have an alluring yet toxic scent. Despite the excruciating pain from the fumes, many Pokémon will still blindly seek it out.

entry: 毒液让受害者对光极其敏感。即使服了解药，它发出的光，也仍会引起偏头痛。
author: staghorn
source: Its poison makes its victims extremely sensitive to light. Even if the victim takes an antidote, the light it emits will still give them migraines.

entry: POKENAME剧毒，却相对温顺。哪怕被尖刺轻轻扎一下，也可能立刻休克。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are highly poisonous, but are relatively docile. Getting poked by one of its thorns even slightly can immediately send someone into shock.

entry: POKENAME潜行海底，装成无害的海洋生物，轻易便能靠近毫无防备的太阳珊瑚群。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME skulks across the ocean floor, disguised as a harmless sea creature. This lets it easily sneak up on unsuspecting Corsola populations.

entry: 它耐心躲在带刺的拱壳下面。太阳珊瑚一游过，壳便打开，POKENAME射出致命毒弹。
author: nellnast42
source: It waits patiently sheltered under its spiky dome. When Corsola swim by, the dome opens up, and POKENAME fires off a lethal toxic bullet.

entry: POKENAME高速撞向对手。虽然没法施展常规摔角技巧，仍能靠撞击与诡计，把敌人赶出擂台。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME barrels into foes at high speeds. While it cannot rely on standard wrestling techniques, it can still knock and trick foes out of the ring.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，放出的肾上腺素云能激起战意。战况越激烈，它们喝彩越响，释放的烟雾也越多。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME release clouds of adrenaline that will motivate people to fight. The more dynamic the battle, the louder they cheer and the more smog they release.

entry: POKENAME总是精神满满，尽力跳高，练习飞行。它们常想从上方冲撞同伴，结果却互相弹开，一起飞远。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME bounce as high as they can to try and practice flying. They often try to tackle each other from above, but only end up bouncing off each other and flying away.

entry: POKENAME现身节庆与游行，以活力感染众人。青少年常特地找POKENAME，让派对闹得更欢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME appears during festivals and parades, invigorating everyone with a lively spirit. Teenagers often go hunting for POKENAME to make their parties even more wild.

entry: POKENAME个头不大，力气却大得惊人，连更大的对手也能摔。第二颗头仿佛自行行动，会猛地撞向敌人。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME is remarkably strong for its size, capable of wrestling bigger foes. Its second head seems to act on its own and bodily slams into foes.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀般的爪，打出凶猛一击，只要命中，便有要害之威。可惜，准头实在很差。
author: nellnast42
source: With its scythe-like claws, POKENAME's savage blows are guaranteed to pack a critical punch. However, these attacks are very inaccurate.

entry: POKENAME以采集的食物为赌注，彼此摔跤。输家往往比起挨饿，更在乎自尊受挫。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME will compete in wrestling matches with one another, putting the food they have gathered on the line. The losers often care more about their bruised egos than going hungry.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: POKENAME飞越大地，搜寻对手。谁看起来比自己更强，POKENAME就毫不留情地攻过去。
author: gurguro
source: It searches for opponents while soaring across the lands. If a POKENAME sees something that looks stronger than it, it will attack mercilessly.

entry: 弹射器般的后腿，让它一跃能超过身长的50倍。擒拿本领极佳，连体型大数倍的宝可梦，也能掀翻抛出。
author: staghorn
source: It can jump over 50 times its body length thanks to its catapult-like back legs. It is an extremely capable grappler and can flip and throw Pokémon several times its size.

entry: POKENAME总想引人注目，鼓起身体，发出昂扬战吼，宣告准备决战。谁若看表演看睡着，就会挨上一阵毛绒拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Always seeking attention, POKENAME inflate themselves before releasing triumphant battle cries to declare they're ready for a showdown. If anyone falls asleep during a POKENAME's performance, they will be met with a flurry of plush fists.

entry: POKENAME精通场面功夫，先鼓胀浮空，再用猛烈的飞踢击倒敌人。它们对安排战斗的喜爱，几乎不亚于亲自上阵。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Masters of spectacle, POKENAME inflate themselves to lift into the air before delivering devastating drop kicks to their opponents. They enjoy organizing battles almost as much as the battles themselves.

entry: 它出手迅猛，招式又诡诈。有些训练家，反而觉得看这套战法，十分有趣。
author: .flipside3
source: It attacks with vicious speed and deceptive tactics. Some Trainers consider its tactics interesting to watch.

entry: POKENAME通常是摔角鹰人群的首领，骄傲地伸展强翼，鼓起肌肉。它爱使出夸张的空中动作炫耀力量，登场也必须华丽。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is usually the leader among groups of Hawlucha, flexing its powerful wings and bulging muscles with pride. It performs dramatic aerial moves, showing off its strength while still loving a flashy entrance.

entry: POKENAME精于攀树，在树间跳跃，寻找强敌。最爱飞到树冠上方，再以背摔将对手砸向地面。
author: mistymagius
source: Expert tree climbers, POKENAME leap from tree to tree looking for strong opponents to fight. Its favorite move is to fly high above the treetops and then suplex its opponent into the ground.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，不爱主动出手。可哪只宝可梦一碰它，就会挨上一记足以折骨的背摔。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are normally meek and passive. Any Pokémon that so much as touches one, though, will be hit by a bone-breaking suplex.

entry: POKENAME采用了更讲究身手的战斗方式——舞蹈。起舞时会掀起风刃，伤害对手。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME has embraced a more acrobatic style of fighting, Dance. When it dances, it whips up blades of wind to hurt its opponents.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让尖刺暂时脱离身体，射向敌人，再将尖刺飘回身边。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to temporarily detach spikes from its body and fire them at opponents before causing them to float back to it again.

entry: 若在沙漠中看见野生POKENAME，就能确定附近有绿洲。它的花朵越大，那片绿洲也就越美。
author: cristata
source: If you see a wild POKENAME in the desert, you can be sure there's an oasis nearby. The bigger its flower, the more beautiful its oasis is sure to be.

entry: POKENAME的身体会滴出湿润的汁液，借此在地面上滑行。不过，饮用这种汁液会引起消化不良。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body drips a moist sap, allowing it to slide along the ground. Drinking the sap, however, will cause digestive problems.

entry: POKENAME皮肤吸水性极强，靠沙漠稀少的雨水就能生存。攻击猎物时，身体最远能伸展15英尺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's skin is very absorbent, allowing it to survive on the little rain the desert provides. They can stretch up to 15 feet when striking their prey.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然亲其他宝可梦一口。可嘴巴粗糙又带刺，多数宝可梦都宁愿离POKENAME远些。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME loves to give other Pokémon a surprise smooch. Since its mouth is rough and thorny, most Pokémon prefer to keep their distance from POKENAME.

entry: 有些登山者将吓人的POKENAME错当普通仙人掌，毫无戒备地靠近，结果严重烧伤。
author: chorb33
source: Some hikers have suffered nasty burns because they mistook the frightening POKENAME for a normal cactus and approached it without caution.

entry: 几只POKENAME会在夜间聚在一起练习某种舞蹈。一旦失去平衡，就会哭着退开。
author: pokopish
source: Multiple POKENAME come together at night to practice a sort of dance. It cries and retreats if caught off balance.

entry: POKENAME依靠魔法的力量汲取养分，可以一直不喝水。虽然体形娇小，但浑身的刺让其他生物不敢招惹它。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME can survive indefinitely without water, drawing nutrients from magical sources instead. Though tiny, it is left alone due to its spines.

entry: 在空旷辽阔的沙漠中，POKENAME能尽情起舞，抒发情感。若发现有人偷看，就会把对方扎得满身是刺。
author: hellaluyeah
source: In the vast emptiness of the desert, POKENAME has room to dance emotionally. If it spots someone watching, it will leave the voyeur with many pricks.

entry: POKENAME的肉质饱含清洁可饮用的水。口渴的捕食者靠近时，它就会脱落背上的球体，趁机逃走。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's flesh is saturated with clean, drinkable water. When a thirsty predator nears, it detaches the spheres on its back and makes its getaway.

entry: POKENAME把水储存在棒状的身体结构中。除了用它敲打目标，还会发射身上的刺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stores water in its club-like structure. It shoots off its thorns in addition to bludgeoning its victims.

entry: 白色的毛发，其实是一根根纤细而极锋利的尖刺。它喷出的火，足以把沙子熔成玻璃，再用玻璃加固尖刺。
author: staghorn
source: Its white fur is composed of thin but extremely sharp spines. The fire it produces is hot enough to melt desert sand into glass, which it uses to reinforce its spines.

entry: POKENAME头上的果子本身无毒，有毒的是POKENAME的黏性汁液。因此，必须彻底去除污染，果实才能食用。
author: mistymagius
source: The fruit on POKENAME's head isn't naturally poisonous, but POKENAME's sticky sap is. Because of this, the fruit needs to be thoroughly decontaminated before it can be eaten.

entry: POKENAME只生长在富含金属的沙地，身体出奇地致密坚韧。常被人尊为古老力量的先兆。
author: quant9690
source: Only growing in sandy areas heavy with metals, POKENAME are surprisingly dense and resilient. They are often revered as heralds of an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠游荡歌唱，带刺的身体有节奏地摇动，为急促的歌声加上沙沙伴奏。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME roams through deserts singing. It shakes its thorny body rhythmically to add rattling noises to its rapid singing.

entry: POKENAME已经适应了沙漠生活，如今栖息在宽大的地洞里，不再住在树上。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have adapted to live in deserts, and now live in large burrows instead of trees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找更大的仙人掌，作为身体的一节。为了争夺巨大的仙人掌，同类之间常常打起来。
author: gurguro
source: A POKENAME is always looking for bigger cacti to use as segments for its body. Members of the species often fight over large cacti.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙漠躲避酷热。小猎物一来，就跃出，用尖刺紧紧攀住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME buries itself in the desert sand to protect itself from the heat. When small prey comes along, it hops out and clings to it with its spines.

entry: 严酷沙漠的生活，让身体保存了大量水分。不知为何，这似乎也会产生庞大电力，科学家至今难以解释。
author: sontyp
source: Because it lives in harsh deserts, its body conserves large amounts of water. Somehow this seems to generate large amounts of electricity, a phenomenon scientists still struggle to find an explanation for.

entry: 会静止不动地进行光合作用、节省能量，数十年不喝水也能存活。POKENAME会成群在夜间迁徙。
author: capwolfbane
source: It can last several decades without water, laying still to photosynthesize and conserve energy. Bands of POKENAME migrate at night.

entry: POKENAME完全由草构成，吞下的活物都会直接穿过身体。它真正的养分来自受害者的恐惧。
author: retrocrow
source: Being made entirely out of grass, all living things that POKENAME eats go right through it. They instead get their nutrients from the victim's fear.

entry: 饥渴驱使它捕食一切能装进体内的东西。旅人可以把食物或水扔进它体内，趁机迅速逃走。
author: quant9690
source: Hunger and thirst have driven this Pokémon to hunt whatever can fit inside of its body. Travelers can throw water or food into it and quickly escape.

entry: POKENAME振翅一次，就能掀起猛烈沙暴。风中气温接近华氏200度，足以对付任何想袭来的沙漠天敌。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME can kick up a raging sandstorm with a single flap of its wings. The air inside these sandstorms can reach temperatures of nearly 200°F - more than enough to deal with any would-be desert predators.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊在沙漠昏暗的沙丘间，几乎对什么都漠不关心。无论发生何事，也不作反应，只沿自己的路走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.

entry: POKENAME满怀遗憾，无法安息，留在这个世界上。它们会一直依附着自己的躯壳，直到躯壳消散。
author: quant9690
source: Unable to pass on and full of regret, POKENAME linger in this world. They will stay attached to their husk until it fades away.

entry: 许多人和宝可梦误将POKENAME当成无害的稻草人，因靠得太近而丧命。
author: fenragon
source: Many people and Pokémon alike have lost their lives by getting too close to a POKENAME which they mistook for a harmless scarecrow.

entry: 猛烈的沙尘暴完全吓不倒POKENAME。它们反而经常聚集起来，在炙热的狂风中起舞。
author: quant9690
source: Brutal sandstorms do not phase POKENAME at all. On the contrary, they often go to gather together and dance within the blistering winds.

entry: 白天会一动不动地站着，以免皮肤中的水分被烈日蒸干。夜间则用锋利的爪子撕碎猎物。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It stands completely still at day so it doesn't lose moisture in its skin to the sun. At night, it uses its razor-sharp claws to tear apart prey.

entry: POKENAME出没的沙漠一到夜间就会变得极度寒冷，足以危及生命。谁也不知道它们白天去了哪里。
author: staghorn
source: The deserts where POKENAME are found get dangerously cold at night. Nobody knows where they go during the daytime.

entry: 在沙漠中行走时，可能会遭到突然从地下冒出的POKENAME伏击。它会将尖刺混着沙子射向目标。
author: fenragon
source: When walking in the desert, you might get ambushed by a POKENAME suddenly sprouting from the ground. It attacks by shooting a mix of thorns and sand.

entry: POKENAME从沙漠的烈日中汲取热能，为火焰攻击提供能量。体内的沙子能保护仙人掌身躯不被烧着。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will draw heat energy from the harsh desert sun to fuel its fiery attacks. The sand within its body keeps its cactus body from burning.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中游荡，寻找训练家并送给对方一枚摆锤。到了夜里，这件小饰品会让收下它的人永远沉睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of Trainers, to whom it gives a pendulum. Come night, the trinket will make the recipient fall asleep forever.

entry: POKENAME会用沙子捏出大针蜂，吓退海滩上的水属性宝可梦。然而，这反而常常引来大型鸟宝可梦的袭击。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME forms a Beedrill out of sand to ward off beach-dwelling water types. However, this often results in it being attacked by large bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的背上会自然生成熔融的玻璃。吹制玻璃和安装玻璃的工匠常在店里养一只。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME naturally generate molten glass on their backs. Glassblowers and glaziers often keep a POKENAME in their shop.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: POKENAME经过后可能会留下玻璃碎片。曾有报告称，一位训练家的宝可梦在与它相遇后，一条肢体被玻璃包住了。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME may leave glass shards in its wake. It was reported that a Trainer's Pokémon once had a limb encased in glass after an encounter.

entry: 核心与腿部由硬沙构成。组成外壳的沙子经常脱落，因此需要不断补充。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Its core and legs are made of hardened sand. The sand that makes up its shell falls off frequently, so it has to place more.

entry: POKENAME十分珍惜自己的铲子，因为它承载着遥远而令人怀念的往事。喜欢堆建金字塔。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME treasures its shovel greatly, for it holds nostalgic memories long passed. It loves to build pyramids.

entry: POKENAME藏在阳光明媚的海滩沙地中收集光能。谁想偷走它的铲子，它就会从沙中扑出发动攻击。
author: mikk09
source: POKENAME hides in the sand of a sunny beach, collecting light. POKENAME will lunge out of the sand to attack anyone that tries to steal its shovels.

entry: 介于沙丘娃与噬沙堡爷之间的形态。十分喜爱头上的铲子。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: An in-between of Sandygast and Palossand. It's very fond of the shovel on its head.

entry: 据说POKENAME由迷失海滩的卡蒂狗化成，会找幼童玩耍、挖洞，帮忙筑沙堡。可与POKENAME玩过的孩子，大多从此不知所终。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be a Growlithe that became lost on the beach, POKENAME will approach young children to play, digging holes or helping to build sandcastles. However, most children who play with a POKENAME are never seen again.

entry: 它伏在沙滩下，准备突袭宝可梦，吸取生命力。但多数时候，却因无聊而睡着，或干脆忘了自己在等猎物。
author: staghorn
source: It lurks in the sand of beaches, ready to ambush Pokémon and drain their life force. Most of the time, however, it gets bored, falls asleep, or forgets that it was waiting for prey.

entry: 在沙滩休息时若忽感困倦，可得当心，或许是POKENAME在作祟。等目标熟睡，它就从下方陷开沙坑，将人困进沙墓。
author: staghorn
source: If you feel yourself becoming drowsy while relaxing on a sandy beach, be careful; it may be due to a POKENAME's influence. Once its target is fast asleep, it will open a sinkhole below them and trap them in a sandy tomb.

entry: POKENAME常在复杂机器的程序里制造异常，成了所有程序员的头号敌人。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME is often found creating abnormalities in the code of complex machines. It has become enemy number one of all programmers.

entry: POKENAME会散播寄生在身上的冬虫夏草菌的孢子，隔空吸取猎物体内的养分。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME spreads the spores of its parasitic tochukaso mushrooms to remotely absorb nutrients from its prey.

entry: 这种蘑菇进化出了制造尸体供自己食用的本领。会将刀刃插进地下藏好，等受害者走近。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This mushroom species evolved to create corpses for it to feed on. It sheathes in the ground to hide its blade from oncoming victims.

entry: POKENAME的形态简单而小巧，能将刀刃收进地下，伪装成普通蘑菇，同时用眼睛观察四周。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's simple, diminutive design allows it to sheath in the ground and disguise as an ordinary mushroom while watching out with its eye.

entry: 行走时会挥动缎带，将孢子散播到周围。以腐殖物和堆肥土壤为食。
author: melodydelune
source: They use their ribbons to spread to the spores around as they walk. Their diet consists of mulch and compost soil.

entry: 这只宝可梦四处窜行，随时准备攻击眼前的一切。遭它咬伤，就会感染真菌，连心智也被一点点侵蚀。
author: theheroict
source: A Pokémon that scuttles about, ready to attack anything it sees. Its bite spreads a fungal infection that consumes the minds of its prey.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME身上的蘑菇是寄生物。研究却表明，蘑菇能帮它从吃下的电力中获取更多能量。
author: kitarchen
source: Many assume the mushrooms on POKENAME are parasitic. However, research has revealed they are used to acquire more energy from the electricity it eats.

entry: 派拉斯的虫体与蘑菇完美共生时，就会长成巨大的体形。大脑中的菌丝让它迅速成长。
author: .realthree
source: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. It grows quickly as a result of the mycelium in its brain.

entry: 在丛林中遇见POKENAME时，要避开它的目光。它会凶狠地抓挠任何与它对视的人。
author: .realthree
source: If you encounter a POKENAME while travelling through the jungle, avert your eyes. It claws ferociously at anyone who makes eye contact with it.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在不流动的水域，依靠大雨将孢子传播到更远的地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME only lives in stagnant water. It relies on heavy rain to be able to spread its spores further.

entry: 聚集在POKENAME层层甲壳之间的藻类腐烂后，会成为寄居真菌的食物。
author: .realthree
source: The algae that gathers between POKENAME's layered shells decomposes and becomes food for the fungus living in it.

entry: POKENAME经常不顾一切地冲撞敌人，结果可能撞掉部分身体，只好等待沙子重新聚拢成形。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME often charge foes recklessly. This can cause it to lose parts of its body, requiring it to then wait for the sand to re-form.

entry: POKENAME用沙子塑造出大针蜂模样的宝可梦，足以吓退除最强者以外的飞行宝可梦。夜间经常与音波龙冲突。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME forms a Pokémon resembling Beedrill out of sand to ward off all but the strongest flying Pokémon. It often clashes with Noivern at night.

entry: 有种广为流传的说法认为，POKENAME曾是海滩的王者，后来被水属性宝可梦推翻，至今仍在伺机复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: A popular theory claims that POKENAME were once kings of the beach. They were since overthrown by Water types, and seek vengeance to this day.

entry: POKENAME是当之无愧的堆沙堡冠军。每次比赛它都会破坏别人的沙堡，至于这与夺冠有没有关系，就不好说了。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the undisputed champion of sandcastle building. This may or may not be due to it sabotaging the other sandcastles every competition.

entry: POKENAME花上多年筑成沙塔，会以狂怒捍卫。塔里埋着的骨头，属于那些曾想夺走它家园的人。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: After spending years building its sand tower, POKENAME will protect it with immense fury. Inside the tower are the bones of those who have tried to take its home.

entry: 体内猛烈的幽焰，将POKENAME部分沙身熔成玻璃。独特的构造让POKENAME的光芒照得极远，连最深的夜色也能穿透。
author: rakunk
source: The intense spectral flames within POKENAME's body have fused portions of its sandy form into glass. This unique body shape has allowed POKENAME to shine from across great distances, cutting through even the darkest nights.

entry: POKENAME通常由葬身流沙的孩子变成。据说它们会故意制造沙坑，拉更多人一起受苦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually children who have died due to quicksand. They are said to purposely create sand traps so more humans can suffer with them.

entry: POKENAME操纵了整片海滩的居民，把自己建成一座宏伟的城塞。再以此为据点，在大陆上肆意作恶。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME has controlled the population of an entire beach to erect itself as a grand citadel. From here, it enacts its evil whims on the mainland.

entry: 在极寒的雪峰筑巢，那里冷得让大多数生物无法承受。偶尔有登山者报告看见POKENAME虹彩般的翅膀。
author: carameldog
source: It nests on snowy peaks where it's much too frigid for most. The sight of POKENAME's iridescent wings is occasionally reported by mountain climbers.

entry: 喜欢用颚咬碎大块的冰，也因此为其他宝可梦疏通了水道。
author: capwolfbane
source: It enjoys crushing large chunks of ice with its jaws. This behaviour also clears waterways for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不习惯与好斗或领地意识强的宝可梦共处，于是躲在草丛中避开冲突、寻找食物。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME are not used to living with aggressive or territorial Pokémon, so they resort to hiding in grasses to avoid conflict and foraging for food.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，POKENAME会在树上仰望夜空。北极光一出现，POKENAME体内潜藏的超能力便会苏醒。
author: mistymagius
source: On cold winter nights, POKENAME can be seen in the trees staring up into the night sky. When the northern lights appear in the sky, a latent psychic power awakens within POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽然不喜欢冲突，却会奋力自卫。与进化前相比，它的信心和力量都大有增长。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME dislikes conflict but will protect itself fiercely as its confidence and strength have grown much in comparison to its previous evolution.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME曾试着偷走无人看守的巢中的蛋，却常因背帆散发的鲜艳色彩而被发现。
author: darkweavile428
source: In ancient times, POKENAME attempted to steal eggs from unguarded nests, but often got caught due to the bright colors emitted by its sails.

entry: 冰雪龙的基因让POKENAME的身体过于庞大沉重，令它很不舒服。它大多时候都躺在雪里，一副生无可恋的样子。
author: theeggoverlord
source: The Amaura genes in POKENAME cause its body to be uncomfortably big and heavy for it. It spends most of its time lying in snow, as if done with life.

entry: 有人发现POKENAME潜到600米以下。深处光线稀少，它们便靠发光的头冠，避免迷失方向。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME have been found diving at depths of over 600 meters. Because there is so little light at those depths, they use their luminescent crests to keep from getting lost.

entry: 据说，北极光最亮时，POKENAME会出现在雪丘，顶着绚烂天空优雅转圈。看见它们聚集，被认为能带来好运。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME are said to appear when the northern lights shine at their brightest, twirling gracefully beneath the vibrant skies atop snowy hills. Seeing a gathering of these Pokémon is considered good luck.

entry: POKENAME起舞时会扬起冰雪。羽毛将阳光折射成粉、蓝、黄、紫色的光束。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME kick up snow and ice as they dance. Their feathers refract sunlight into beams of pink, blue, yellow and purple.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区，身体几乎冻结。分泌的黏液冰冷刺骨，千万不能毫无防护地触碰。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME's body is nearly frozen due to living in a cold climate. The slime it produces is freezing cold; never touch one without protection.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液呈酸性，冰冷刺骨。据说徒手触碰造成的伤势，永远也无法完全痊愈。
author: sand_coffin
source: The goo POKENAME produces is acidic and freezing cold. Anyone who touches it barehanded is said to never fully recover from their injuries.

entry: POKENAME栖息在山顶，分泌的黏液温度低于零度。即使做好防护，触摸它也可能冻伤。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME inhabits mountain peaks, producing goo that reaches subzero temperatures. Even with protection, touching this Pokémon can cause frostbite.

entry: 在冰冷多雾的环境中，会凭鲜艳的鳍辨认其他POKENAME的动向。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its brightly colored fins to keep track of other POKENAME in icy, foggy conditions.

entry: POKENAME通常性情温顺，不喜欢打斗。受威胁时却能造出冰墙自保，还能将敌人封在冰中。
author: goldegummybear
source: Usually very docile, POKENAME dislike fighting. However, when threatened, they can create walls of ice to protect themselves and encase enemies.

entry: POKENAME只在寒冷的冬夜现身。额头的水晶能从极光中汲取能量，供给潜藏的超能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have only been seen on cold winter nights. It uses the crystal on its forehead to draw energy from auroras to fuel its latent psychic powers.

entry: 学会与如今的宝可梦共处后，POKENAME的领地意识更强了。不过，只要有可能，还是会避免冲突。
author: goldegummybear
source: Having learned to coexist with the Pokémon of today, POKENAME have grown more territorial. However, they still avoid conflict whenever possible.

entry: 耀眼的外形令许多训练家着迷，然而只需用力一振翅，就会掀起阵阵寒风，冻结沿途的一切。
author: goldegummybear
source: Its dazzling appearance captivates many Trainers, but one strong flap of its wings causes gusts of frosty winds that freeze everything in their path.

entry: POKENAME曾在冰河时代的酷寒中繁盛，也能适应现代气候。背火呈现人眼无法尽见的色彩，释放的能量与北极光相同。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME used to thrive in the freezing temperatures of the ice age, but can adapt well to modern climates. The fire on its back produces more colors than the human eye can perceive and emits the same energies as the northern lights.

entry: 宽大美丽的双翼，让它与荧光鱼竞争“海中狩猎凤蝶”的称号。不过比起水中，人们更常见它在空中滑翔。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: Its large, beautiful wings are have caused it to rival Finneon for the title of 'Beautifly of the sea'. However, it's more often seen gliding through the air than in the water.

entry: POKENAME自古以来就成群狩猎。会包围猎物，再从菱形晶体中发出冲击，将其冻结。
author: darkweavile428
source: Hunting in packs since ancient times, POKENAME surround their prey and freeze it with blasts from their diamond-shaped crystals.

entry: POKENAME会在极光出现时聚集，在空中闪耀。这时，它们的魔法闪耀与极光束威力都会增强。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME gather during auroras, shining brightly in the air. At these times, their Dazzling Gleams and Aurora Beams are amplified in power.

entry: POKENAME只在新月时现身，身上的光会为迷途者指引方向。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will only appear during new moons. Its light serves as a guide for those who have lost their way.

entry: 最初从冰中发现POKENAME时，人们估计它已被困100年。证据表明，这期间大脑仍在发育。
author: incognito1234
source: When POKENAME was first found in ice, it was estimated to have been trapped for 100 years. Evidence shows its brain still developed during this time.

entry: 会疾驰着穿越森林与湖泊，冻结沿途的一切。古代的描绘中，它横渡大海，将整片浪涛化作寒冰。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon races across forests and lakes, freezing everything in its path. Ancient depictions show it crossing the sea, turning whole waves to ice.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用羊毛裹住别人，亲昵依偎。但毛中尖锐的石块可能会不小心伤到对方。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME love to cuddle people in their wool, but the jagged stones in their coats can cause them to accidentally hurt those they snuggle with.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮里藏着许多小石子般坚硬的尖刺。尖刺带有使人麻木的毒素，战斗时，它会通过摩擦对手来下毒。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME carries many hard, pebble-like quills within its fur. These quills carry a numbing toxin, which it uses in combat by rubbing up against the opponent.

entry: POKENAME勇猛地保护训练家，如同忠心的护卫犬。只要察觉威胁，全身倒刺就会齐齐竖起，准备迎敌护主。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME protects its Trainer with fierce bravery, much like a loyal guard dog. If it senses a threat, all of its barbs bristle up at once as it prepares to protect its Trainer.

entry: 会在岩石上刻出深深的划痕来标记领地。POKENAME经验越丰富，獠牙上的划痕与缺口也越多。
author: soup1900
source: They mark their territory by leaving deep cuts into rocks. The more experience POKENAME has, the more scratched and chipped its tusks are.

entry: 无论追捕猎物还是巡视领地，POKENAME的三颗头总在争吵不休与默契配合之间来回转变。
author: kitarchen
source: The three heads of POKENAME are constantly in a flux between bickering and uncanny coordination as they hunt down prey or patrol their territory.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善，探索、玩耍和自卫时却天生习惯用咬的。因此，训练时需要十分用心。
author: cristata
source: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: 全身坚硬如基岩，触碰就会中毒。战斗时，坚不可破的头与沉重尾巴交替出击，攻势连绵不绝。
author: celio_0230
source: Its entire body is as hard as bedrock, and toxic to the touch. It alternates between using its unbreakable head and its heavy tail to continuously deliver strikes when fighting.

entry: POKENAME是真正的凶兽，鲜少有谁敢争领地。深夜一声长嚎，多数宝可梦都会惊醒，逃离附近。
author: frokachu
source: A truly savage beast that has few contenders for territory. When a POKENAME howls in the dead of night, most Pokémon will wake and flee the area.

entry: POKENAME经常骗家长带孩子来听自己的演唱会，随后在台上大声飙脏话，还毫无愧疚。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often trick parents into bringing their children to its concerts, where they scream curse words and don't feel guilty about it.

entry: POKENAME是速度最快的捕食者之一，轻松就能跑过任何对手。曾被发现以追逐猎物直至其筋疲力尽为乐。
author: crypticanexe
source: One of the fastest predators, POKENAME easily outraces any opponent. It's been known to chase prey to exhaustion as a form of entertainment.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然现身，吓训练家一跳。训练家越享受这些恶作剧，POKENAME就越尊重对方。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME likes to play pranks on its Trainer, usually with jumpscares.  The more the Trainer enjoys its pranks, the more POKENAME respects them.

entry: POKENAME拍翼奏出美妙旋律。成群POKENAME常伴着自己的音乐，欢快起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a beautiful melody as it beats its wings. Swarms of POKENAME can be seen joyfully dancing to their own music.

entry: POKENAME歌唱时，会重新长出能奏响旋律的护身鬃毛。唱得越多，鬃毛就越大。
author: gurguro
source: When POKENAME sing their song, they regenerate their melodic mane, which protects them. The more they sing, the larger their mane.

entry: POKENAME由裹满黏液的触手组成。拨动触手，便能奏出竖琴般舒缓的旋律。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of a collection of slime-coated tentacles. It will strum its tentacles to create a soothing melody similar to that of a harp.

entry: POKENAME常像偶像团体一样合唱，吸引来热爱它们音乐的忠实追随者。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME often sing in groups similar to idols. Because of this, they gain devoted followers who enjoy listening to their music.

entry: POKENAME已精通歌声形态的歌舞，诸般艺术皆能熟练施展，如今甚至能演奏过去、现在与未来的旋律。
author: jackjirachi
source: Having mastered the Aria styles of song and dance, POKENAME has become fully proficient in all of its arts. It is now capable of preforming melodies from the past, present, and even the future.

entry: 少数目击者表示，发光的电子音箱会放大它的歌声。除此之外，关于POKENAME仍所知甚少。
author: jackjirachi
source: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, its songs are amplified by its glowing electronic speakers. Little else is known about POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用镰刃奏出小提琴般的优美乐曲。艳丽绿瓣也能充当临时乐器，声音还颇为悦耳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME plays beautiful melodies on its sickles, similar to a violin. Its gorgeous green petals can be used as makeshift instruments and even sound quite pleasant.

entry: 即使藏在地下，它也会大声歌唱。那些神秘歌声，却曾被错怪是幽灵作祟。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon sings loudly, even while hidden underground. These mysterious songs have been erroneously blamed on ghosts.

entry: 所有宝可梦都期待着POKENAME的演出。即使最疲惫的听众，也能从它的音乐中恢复精神。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME's performance is something all Pokémon look forward to. Hearing its music can energize even the most exhausted listeners.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: jackjirachi
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: jackjirachi
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 锋利的新月形角具有与月之石相似的性质。心情好时，会让训练家做能预知未来的梦。
author: axolotlhunter
source: Its sharp, crescent-shaped horns possess similar properties to moonstone. When happy, it provides prophetic dreams to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀会自行发光，夜间很容易被发现。曾遭偷猎者过度捕猎，如今大多生活在人工饲养的环境中。
author: dodoowner_
source: Since POKENAME's wings are bioluminescent, they are easy to spot at night. They were overhunted by poachers, and are now mostly kept in captivity.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会成为出色的猎手。过后，附近的鬼斯和哭哭面具便会多起来。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME becomes a skillful hunter on full-moon nights. After those days, Gastly and Yamask are abundant.

entry: POKENAME夜里现身，为孩子带来好梦。常受噩梦困扰的人，会养着它，借摇篮曲般的甜美叫声安睡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in the night to bring children good dreams. People with frequent nightmares keep this Pokémon to help them sleep with their sweet lullaby-like cries.

entry: POKENAME会将附近的巨石带入自己的小小轨道，让它们像卫星一样绕着自己旋转。必要时也能重新放出巨石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME brings nearby boulders into its own small orbit, where they revolve around it as satellites. If necessary, it can re-release them.

entry: POKENAME能借月光之力使用复生祈祷。光环剥落的碎屑是珍贵的星尘。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME can use Revival Blessing with the power of the moonlight. It's halo shredded is a precious stardust.

entry: 它神出鬼没，会向饱受夜间惊惧的人现身，据说此后便能护其远离噩梦。月光下，POKENAME的铠甲几乎能挡住大多数攻击，力量也能迅速恢复。
author: evilgammon
source: This elusive Pokémon appears to people plagued with night terrors, and is said to shield them from bad dreams thereafter. In the light of the moon, POKENAME's armor is near impervious to most attacks, and is able to recover its strength rapidly.

entry: POKENAME乘着圆环飞驰，探索太空。身上的火焰由气体与星尘组成。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME zips around on its ring, exploring space. Its flame is made of gases and stardust.

entry: POKENAME在月球的洞穴中数量众多。虽会洒出美丽的星尘，但若不进化，就永远看不到自己的杰作。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is abundant in caves on the moon. Although it emits a beautiful stardust, if it doesn't evolve, it'll never be able to see its work.

entry: 盯着POKENAME的嘴看，就会立刻睡着。它喜欢做梦者的鲜血，随后便会吸取对方的生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: Staring into POKENAME's mouth will immediately make you fall asleep. It then sucks your life force, as it loves the blood of those that are dreaming.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，新月形的双翼会合成一个完美的圆环。传说若四只步调一致地起舞，所有见证者都会一生好运。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME's crescent wings form a perfect ring while it dances. Legends say that if four POKENAME dance in sync, all witnesses will be forever lucky.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: chorb33
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: chorb33
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: POKENAME总是一副舒舒服服的样子。光是待在那里，就能安抚最愤怒的宝可梦，让它们入睡。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is always comfy. It's so comfy that its simple presence can calm the most enraged Pokémon and put them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME总张着嘴睡觉，口中展现出壮丽的群星。附近的宝可梦一连看上数小时，也不会厌倦。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME always sleeps with its mouth open, revealing a magnificent star show. Nearby Pokémon can watch it for hours on end without getting bored.

entry: POKENAME缓缓起舞，唱着催人入梦的迷人摇篮曲。观看演出的对象会陷入沉睡。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME dances in a slow rhythm as it sings its hypnotically enchanting lullaby. Those who watch its performance will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身保护做梦者，使其免受噩梦侵扰。目击者很少能记住那些梦，因此人们对它知之甚少。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to appear to protect dreamers from nightmares. Little is known about this Pokémon, as few witnesses of it could remember said dreams.

entry: 曾有人在满月下观察到几只带着发光圆环的POKENAME。它们悬浮在池塘与河流上空，将水向上吸成水柱。
author: chorb33
source: A few POKENAME with glowing rings have been observed hovering over ponds and rivers under a full moon, drawing water upwards into pillars.

entry: POKENAME的各个球体都有很强的引力，悬浮在水面上方时会吸起水流，掀起波浪。
author: chorb33
source: Because its individual spheres have a strong gravitational pull, POKENAME attracts water when it hovers above the surface, causing waves.

entry: 它曾住在史前海岸，以钻石般的牙咬穿菊石兽、化石盔等宝可梦的外壳。
author: staghorn
source: It once lived on prehistoric coasts, using its diamond-like teeth to bite through the shells of Omanyte, Kabuto, and similar Pokémon.

entry: 跳舞时，花瓣彼此摩擦，发出磨牙般的声音。据说这舞蹈，是唤醒海中某种存在的仪式。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: When it dances, its petals rub together and make a sound like gnashing teeth. It's said that their dance is a ritual to awaken something in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME对自己的外貌很没自信，会攻击一切比自己漂亮的对象，常常因此引发混乱。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME are very insecure about their looks and will assault anything that looks prettier than them. This frequently results in chaos.

entry: 雄性POKENAME遇到雌性时，会缓缓摆动鳍来吸引对方。一旦结为伴侣，就会相守终生。
author: zeeroooo
source: When a male POKENAME encounters a female, it will wave its fins in a slow motion to impress her. These Pokémon mate for life when bonded.

entry: 据说死后仍不肯移开自恋目光的灵魂，会在彼岸变成POKENAME。若打断它照镜子欣赏自己，就会勃然大怒。
author: milchik
source: The spirits of the most narcissistic of people who can't tear their gazes from themselves even after death are thought to become this Pokémon in the afterlife. POKENAME will get furious if distracted from admiring itself in the mirror.

entry: 控制派拉斯特的寄生者，为寻找更好的宿主，感染了魔墙人偶。获得超能力后，它几乎能骗过任何训练家或宝可梦，使其成为后代的下一任宿主。
author: ogriphor
source: Attempting to find a more suitable host, the parasite controlling Parasect has infected a Mr. Mime. Now armed with psychic abilities, it can trick nearly any Trainer or Pokémon into becoming the next host to its offspring.

entry: 它的蘑菇会吸收大量水分，并用孢子污染水体。有POKENAME出没的水域污染极为严重，饮用其中的水会产生强烈幻觉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its mushrooms absorb large amounts of water to infect it with its spores. Waters where POKENAME can be found are incredibly contaminated and consumption can cause severe hallucinations.

entry: 腹部生长的蘑菇可以采摘，带着浓郁的奶香，被厨师们视为上等食材。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: The mushrooms growing on its belly can be harvested. They have a milky yet hearty flavor and are regarded as high quality ingredients by chefs.

entry: 腹袋里的蘑菇操控POKENAME的宿主体，改变脑内化学状态，让它始终幸福满足、温顺听命。究竟是共生还是寄生，争议很大。
author: sontyp
source: The mushroom in its belly pouch mentally controls POKENAME's host body, keeping it docile by inducing a constant state of happy contentment in its brain chemistry. Whether this is symbiosis or parasitism is heavily discussed.

entry: 沙奈朵遭派拉斯特伏击，沦为空壳与寄生宿主。据说为了护主，它不惜牺牲自己，也不惜牺牲其他所有宝可梦。
author: ogriphor
source: After Gardevoir was ambushed by a Parasect, it became a husk of its former self, becoming the host for the parasite. It is said that it would not only give its life to protect its Trainer, but also the life of any and all Pokémon.

entry: 大量纤细的菌丝控制着它的四肢，也将肢体维系在一起。它看不见，对声音极度敏感，还讨厌阳光。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Multitudes of thin fungus control its limbs and keep them attached. It is blind and hypersensitive to sound. It also hates sunlight.

entry: POKENAME似乎受背上的蘑菇群控制。呼出的孢子效果强劲，连狂怒的龙都能安抚。
author: manidrake
source: POKENAME appears to be controlled by the patch of mushrooms growing on its back. It breathes potent spores capable of soothing even raging dragons.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会在大型宗教集会上现身。它一旦出现，附近所有派拉斯都会被迫进化。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will rarely appear during large religious gatherings. When POKENAME does appear, every Paras in its vicinity is forced into evolution.

entry: 独特的生理结构让POKENAME既能独自在森林狩猎，也能用菌盖附着并控制宿主。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's unique physiology allows it to hunt in the forest independently or attach and control a host with its mushroom cap.

entry: POKENAME融入阴影，头上真菌控制身体，留在黑暗中吞食无防备的猎物。锐爪，便于它悄然偷袭。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME blends into the shadows, the fungus on its head controlling it to stay in the dark and feed on unsuspecting prey. Its sharp claws allows it to strike stealthily from the darkness.

entry: POKENAME身体安抚心绪的特性，让它与蘑菇形成了共生关系。双方都能从中获得养分与保护。
author: melodydelune
source: The calming nature of POKENAME's body has led it and the mushroom to form a symbiotic relationship where they both gain nutrients and protection.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗湿穴，以遍布的孢子标记领地。孢子中提取的毒物，还能制成致命毒素。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME lives in dark, damp caves which it infests with spores to mark its territory. The poison extracted from its spores can be used to create a deadly toxin.

entry: POKENAME的孢子造成噩梦般幻觉，对受害者真实得可怕。夜里，它还会爬上天花板，散布恐惧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spores cause nightmarish hallucinations that feel incredibly real to its victims. It appears in the night, crawling on the ceiling to inflict terror.

entry: POKENAME藏在诅咒娃娃外壳内，从内部操纵它。天冷时动作僵硬，会暴露这副躯壳并非真正的诅咒娃娃。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: POKENAME takes cover inside its Banette shell and controls it from within. In cold weather, its stiff movements will give it away as a fake.

entry: 据说来自遥远的真菌宇宙。会拖着沉重的步伐四处行走，用双手刺穿猎物，还会结网捕捉更多猎物食用。
author: theheroict
source: Said to be from a far-away fungal universe, it trudges around and stabs prey with its hands. It spins webs to trap additional prey to consume.

entry: POKENAME是首个有记录的真菌感染如此巨大宿主的案例。可惜，宿主的体形限制了它的行动能力。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the first recorded case of a fungus infecting a specimen this large. Unfortunately, the size of the host limits this creature's mobility.

entry: 失去了控火能力，取而代之的是释放浓烈气味孢子的本领。奇怪的是，孢子闻起来像烧焦的蘑菇。
author: patch_bros
source: It has swapped its pyrokinetic abilities for the ability to give off powerful smelling spores. Oddly enough, the spores smell like burnt mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME看起来虽然美味，却十分凶猛。极少有人能咬上一口，而吃到的人最后都食物中毒了。
author: patch_bros
source: It may look delicious, but POKENAME is highly aggressive. Very few have managed to grab a bite, but those who have ended up getting food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞地爬来爬去，毫无意识地沿途撒下孢子。有时，它的酸性口水会滴到下方的孢子上，让孢子失去活性。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME slowly scuttle about, thoughtlessly dropping spores in its path. Sometimes its acidic drool will land on the spores below them, rendering them useless.

entry: 蘑菇接管了POKENAME的意识，增强了它的超能力。它的孢子具有致幻效果。
author: mistymagius
source: The mushroom has taken over POKENAME's mind, amplifying its psychic powers. POKENAME's spores have hallucinogenic properties.

entry: POKENAME分为两个不同的个体。其中一颗头已完全受孢子控制，另一颗也正逐渐沦陷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME is separated into two different entities. One head is entirely controlled by spores, and the other is slowly succumbing.

entry: 传说POKENAME双翼由纯光构成，什么都能切开。它飞过黑夜，将四周照得如同白昼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are said to be made of pure light, allowing it to slice through anything. It flies through the night, illuminating the dark as if it was day.

entry: 头角几乎无物不斩。若真遇到斩不开的，散出的热量仍能将其熔化。
author: incognito1234
source: The horn on its head is able to cut through just about anything. If for some reason it cannot, the heat it radiates will still melt it.

entry: 强光沐浴整片丛林，让草木茂密强壮。它独自静坐，滋养赖以栖居的森林。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its intense light bathes the whole jungle, allowing it to grow thick and strong. It sits in solitary, feeding its home jungle.

entry: 挣脱棱晶牢笼后，POKENAME用歌声肆虐破坏。据说死于其歌，是世上最美的死法。
author: galactakiller
source: Now unleashed from its prismatic prison, POKENAME will wreak havoc through its songs. It is said to be the most beautiful death one could receive.

entry: 开战前，POKENAME用长鞭般的缎带抽地，威吓对手。训练家却说，这是祈求必胜的战前仪式，不过并未证实。
author: teatedtiten
source: When entering a battle, POKENAME will crack its whip-like ribbons on the ground to intimidate its opponent. Its Trainers instead say this is a pre-fighting ritual to ensure victory, though this is unproven.

entry: 传说POKENAME降临，便预示安宁未来。古老习俗称，危急时敲响祭铃，与其鳞片鸣响共振，就能将它召来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends claim that the arrival of POKENAME is a sign of a peaceful future. Ancient traditions say that ringing ritual bells will resonate with the clanging of POKENAME's scales and summon it in times of need.

entry: POKENAME蜷成车轮，高速滚行。摆尾、抖鳞调整方向，沿途金属鸣声嘈杂不绝。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to curl themselves up into a wheel to roll at incredible speeds. They rattle their scales and swing their tails to steer, creating a cacophony of clanging as they travel.

entry: POKENAME自豪又欢快，领军打仗与主持庆典，都一样热情。不同节奏的鳞片鸣响，宣告开战或庆祝的开始。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
