source: POKENAME are very prideful and joyful creatures, leading battles and festivals with the same passion. They will clang their scales together in different rhythms to signal the start of war or celebration.

entry: 它凶悍且破坏力强，却只吃草属性宝可梦。吞下的宝可梦的气味，会从花瓣散入空气。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though this Pokémon is fierce and destructive, it only feasts on Grass-type Pokémon. Its petals permeate the air with scents of the Pokémon it ingests.

entry: POKENAME住在树果丛中，既得保护，又不愁食物，从出生起就很少离家。因此下半身长什么样，科学家至今仍在争论。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME lives in berry bushes for protection and a steady food source, rarely leaving its home since birth. As a result, scientists are still debating what its lower half looks like.

entry: POKENAME散发强大气场，据说水晶尾巴内蕴藏着远古力量。它是纯洁的化身。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME emits a powerful aura, and it's rumored to contain ancient strength within its crystal tails. It embodies purity.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，吃富碳岩石，强化晶体铠甲。可甲层太厚，POKENAME又会难以行动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves, eating the carbon-rich rock to help strengthen its crystalline armor. However, if the armor gets too thick, POKENAME starts to have difficulty moving around.

entry: POKENAME变换形态时，迅速长出晶体，再利用体内反射的阳光，射出一道道光束。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME rapidly produces crystals upon shifting form. It shoots beams of light from the sun rays reflecting within its body.

entry: POKENAME住在普通陆路到不了的水下洞穴。巨钳狠狠一夹，便能阻止勾魂眼靠近；面对更大的寻宝者，也绝不手软。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME live in underwater caverns inaccessible by normal land routes. Firm pinches from their claws dissuade Sableye from getting too close, and they won't hesitate to do the same to larger treasure-hunters.

entry: POKENAME看起来与巴大蝶几乎一模一样，却具有剧毒。
author: staghorn
source: Though they look nearly identical to Butterfree, POKENAME is highly toxic.

entry: 光秃秃的腹部会分泌黏甜的液体，吸引并困住小虫。POKENAME便懒洋洋地将它们捡来吃掉。
author: pokepower
source: Its bald stomach secretes a sticky and sweet goo. Small insects are attracted and get trapped, which POKENAME picks off and eat as it lazes.

entry: POKENAME毛发上的毒粉影响心智，使其发狂。它会拿到什么就用什么，造出各种古怪装置。
author: mistymagius
source: The poisonous dust from POKENAME's hair negatively affects its mind, causing it to go mad. It can be seen making odd contraptions out of anything it can get its hands on.

entry: POKENAME会缠住猎物，却不将其勒紧。它会用毛中的粉末闷住猎物，使对方无力反抗。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME wraps up prey, but doesn't constrict them. It instead uses the powder in its fur to smother its prey, rendering them vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME的壳上长满浓密扎人的毛。夜间会喷出毒气，推动自己前进。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in dense, prickly fur. At night, it propels itself with poisonous gas.

entry: POKENAME浓密的皮毛让它能在寒冷环境中生存。冰河时期，大多虫属性宝可梦因严寒而灭绝，它是当时罕见的宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's furry coat lets it survive in cold environments. This was a rare Pokémon during the Ice Age, as most Bug types died out from the cold.

entry: 眼睛如雷达般搜寻小虫与其他猎物。会用缎带挖出蛴螬。
author: melodydelune
source: Their eyes act as radars, scanning for small bugs and prey to to eat. Their ribbons allow them to dig up grubs.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影里，与昆虫和虫属性宝可梦共处。进食时抛下伪装，显露骇人真形，将猎物整个吞下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME lives in the shadows, with insects and Bug-type Pokémon. It throws off its disguise and unveils its horrendous form to eat its prey whole.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，以惊人的速度滚走。蓬松的皮毛像安全气囊般缓冲碰撞，避免自己受伤。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can curl up and roll away, reaching surprising speeds. Their fluffy fur cushions collisions like an airbag so that it does not injure itself.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: 无论坡度多陡，POKENAME都能爬上去。遭到飞行宝可梦袭击时，会直接落下，用厚毛缓冲坠地的冲击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb any slope, no matter how steep. If it is attacked by a flying Pokémon, it can drop down and cushion the fall with its thick fur.

entry: POKENAME藏住身体，等猎物擦过覆有黏稠甜腻毒素的叶片，便突然跳出咬住。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME hide their bodies and wait for prey to brush by their leaves, which are covered in a sticky, cloying toxin. Then, they pop out and bite.

entry: 没有证据表明它的身体除了硬毛之外还含有别的东西。连X射线也无法穿透浓密的毛。
author: pokepower
source: There's no evidence its body is made of anything except stiff hairs. Even x-rays can't penetrate the dense fur.

entry: POKENAME卸下身上铠甲，将其打造成直接作战的武器。新钉头锤虽沉重，POKENAME却灵巧善谋，击击精准。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shed the armor from their bodies in favor of fashioning it into a weapon to use directly in battle. Despite the bulk of their new mace, POKENAME are dexterous and calculating, always landing precise blows.

entry: POKENAME穿行火山之间，从盘旋升起的烈焰中现身。它号令周围一切火，乘风滑翔时闪耀橙金光彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Traveling between volcanoes, POKENAME appears within a rising spiral of flame. It commands all flames around it, shining in vibrant hues of orange and gold as it glides along the wind.

entry: POKENAME像流动道场，教呱呱泡蛙与妙蛙种子一系的融合体学习忍术。若里面的学员受威胁，POKENAME便急转背上水手里剑，射出刀刃般锐利的水滴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME acts as a sort of traveling dojo for Froasaur, helping to teach them the art of ninjutsu. If anyone threatens the Froasaur inside, the POKENAME will rapidly spin the water shuriken on its back and launch razor-sharp droplets.

entry: POKENAME在山里试着用磁力吸煤。可煤不带磁性，只吸来大堆别的矿物。于是POKENAME改与矿工交换，拿矿物换煤。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends its time in the mountains attempting to use its magnetism to gather coal. Unfortunately, coal is not magnetic, and it ends up with loads of other minerals instead. POKENAME then trades these minerals with miners in exchange for coal.

entry: POKENAME温顺却强大，能制造最高摄氏650度的巨大热浪。岩石身体浸入熔岩储能，再由宝石放出亮光，据说能治愈百病。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME is a docile, yet powerful Pokémon capable of producing vast heat waves up to 650° Celsius. They store energy by submerging their rocky bodies in lava, then expel it through their gemstones as gleaming light that is said to cure any illness.

entry: 细看才发现，POKENAME微微浮在地面之上。研究者认为，是为了掩饰短腿行动无力、速度至多只能爬行的事实。
author: ohok3441
source: On close inspection, POKENAME appears to float just above the ground. Researchers believe it is to cover up the fact that their tiny legs lack the locomotion to get anywhere faster than a crawl.

entry: POKENAME身旁常跟着一小群毛球。毛球们轮流坐进它的育儿袋里。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are usually accompanied by small swarms of Venonat. The Venonat take turns riding in the POKENAME's pouch.

entry: POKENAME似乎会被彼此脸上发出的光吸引。每晚聚在一起，全神贯注地互相凝望，看得如痴如醉。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are seemingly attracted to the glowing light of their own faces. They gather nightly to gaze intently at one another, completely entranced.

entry: POKENAME眼睛多，对光与太阳格外敏感。为避开光照，体型再大，也适应了地下生活。
author: patch
source: Due to its many eyes, POKENAME is hypersensitive to light and the sun. To remedy this, it has adapted to living underground despite its massive size.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时会迅速振翅，散播毒鳞粉。它不懂得控制自己的力量，经常伤到小型宝可梦。
author: sand_coffin
source: When POKENAME gets excited, it rapidly flaps its wings, spreading poisonous scales. Unaware of its strength, it often harms smaller Pokémon.

entry: 巨大的翅膀会洒下带着大量毒粉的鳞片。城市的明亮灯光经常将它引入人类聚居地。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large wings release scales that are full of toxic dust. It is often lured into civilization by the bright lights of cities.

entry: POKENAME过于沉重，翅膀已无法带它飞行，转而用来释放有毒且能致幻的花粉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to fly with its wings. Instead, it uses them to exude poisonous and hallucinogenic pollen.

entry: POKENAME的毒鳞只要碰到皮肤，毒就会迅速渗入大脑，使人失去知觉。幸好，它只在夜里活动。
author: darkweavile428
source: If any of POKENAME's poisonous scales touch your skin, the poison will quickly seep into your brain and make you unconscious. Thankfully, it is only active at night.

entry: POKENAME在树果树间嬉戏，洒下帮助树木生长的粉末。粉末也能安抚心绪，用于治疗失眠与焦虑。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME frolics among Berry trees, sprinkling powder which helps them grow. Its powder's soothing properties are used to treat insomnia and anxiety.

entry: POKENAME仿佛由融化的棉花糖组成，零碎物品一碰就黏住。身体还滚烫，若停得太久，自己就会烧起来。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body seems to be made of melted marshmallows, with any loose items getting stuck to it. POKENAME is also extremely hot, and its own body will start to burn if stationary for too long.

entry: 这只宝可梦胃口大得惊人，什么都想吃。已有多起报告称，POKENAME袭击训练家，连精灵球在内的补给都吃得精光，让人无以维生。
author: jackster
source: A gluttonous Pokémon with a massive appetite for everything. There have been numerous reports of attacks where POKENAME eat Trainers' supplies clean, including Poké Balls, leaving them with nothing to survive.

entry: POKENAME平时住森林，却会到附近城镇捕猎。藏起身体，只露尾巴，以蛋糕甜香引来小宝可梦，再猛扑过去。
author: _antiblitzyt
source: Though usually living in forests, POKENAME heads to nearby towns to hunt for food. Hiding all but its tail, it lures small Pokémon with the sweet, cake-like smell, then pounces on them.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜在溪池中漂浮休眠，看起来与周围睡莲叶几乎无异。背叶吃下有毒，可用来抵御天敌。
author: theartemis1
source: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.

entry: POKENAME是远古人造宝可梦，受命保护人类。传说它们所做却恰恰相反，逼得最强术士将它们封进石像。
author: eminemace
source: POKENAME are man-made Pokémon created a long time ago, ordered to protect humans. Legends state that they did the complete opposite, forcing the best sorcerers to trap them in a stone statue.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始悬空，只有睡眠或受威胁时，才偶尔再钻进地下。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非被挖来的泥土盖住。
author: krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark, unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: 背上的喇叭能发出足以震碎巨石的声波。可POKENAME十分友善，常与其他宝可梦结队游行。
author: mistymagius
source: The trumpets on its back are able to produce sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter boulders. Despite this, POKENAME are very friendly and can be seen parading around with other Pokémon.

entry: 它会用布满尖刺的种子吓退敌人，让对方不敢轻易攻击。随后，再用自身产生的易燃毒液反击。
author: soup1900
source: Its enemies don't like to attack it, since it uses its thorny bulb as a deterrant. It then uses the flammable toxin it creates to counterattack.

entry: 哭泣时，戴着的头骨会冒黑烟。据说毛是世上最软的，可谁碰了都会严重灼伤。
author: sautomagically
source: When it cries, black smoke puffs out from the skull it wears. Rumors say its fur is the softest thing in the world, but anyone who touches it will end up with a nasty burn.

entry: 小小的身体几乎容不下内心怒火。每叫一声，就喷出一道烈焰。
author: ozydamians
source: Its small body can hardly contain the rage that burns within. It spouts jets of fire with every chirp.

entry: POKENAME将燃烧的尾巴弯到头顶，驱退天敌。它们领地意识极强，谁惹怒它，就想烧谁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME arcs its flaming tail over its head to ward off predators. They are very territorial and will try to burn anyone that aggravates it.

entry: POKENAME烧出只有从空中才能看清的火线，标记领地。愚蠢地跨过神秘灰痕的人，可能遭到来自头顶的致命袭击。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME marks its territory by burning a fire line that can only be seen from the sky. A fool who steps across a mysterious trail of ash is likely to face death from above.

entry: 它化作蓝白火球，以超越声音的速度划过天际。等听见POKENAME尖锐的叫声，猎物早已被利爪贯穿。
author: ozydamians
source: Faster than sound, it blazes across the sky as a blue-white ball of flame. By the time POKENAME's shrill cry is heard, its prey has already been skewered by deadly talons.

entry: 背上的仙人掌开始开花了。谁想采摘这株仙人掌，都会迎来一份火辣辣的“惊喜”。
author: soup1900
source: The cactus that is on its back has started to bloom. Anyone who tries to harvest this cactus will be met with a fiery surprise.

entry: 随着花苞开始绽放，POKENAME能把太阳能转化为火焰的燃料。它也能直接喷出这种有腐蚀性的燃料，攻击敌人。
author: benevolent
source: With its bulb beginning to bloom, POKENAME can convert solar power into fuel for its flames. It can also spray this corrosive fuel to attack its foes.

entry: 尾焰消耗大量能量，迫使它不停找食物。发现可吃的东西，就会凶猛扑击，以灼热鳞片缠紧，再用毒牙咬下。
author: baverbrugge
source: The flame on its tail consumes a lot of energy, so it is constantly searching for prey. When it spots something edible it strikes aggressively, constricting with burning scales and biting with venomous fangs.

entry: 它好斗暴躁，一心要当领地的顶级猎手。POKENAME受威胁时会昂身，颈膜如风箱鼓起，大声嘶鸣，牙间噼啪跳着刺鼻的火焰。
author: baverbrugge
source: An aggressive and ornery Pokémon that wants to be the apex predator in its territory. When feeling threatened, POKENAME will rear up, its hood expanding like a bellows, and hiss loudly, acrid flames crackling between its fangs.

entry: POKENAME口袋里冒出的火，温度恰好适合煎炸。它一心想精进厨艺，常会请其他宝可梦品尝。
author: leshii
source: The fire coming from POKENAME's pocket burns at the perfect temperature for frying. Fiercely determined to improve, POKENAME often feed other Pokémon.

entry: 宽阔的翅膀能借助尾巴升起的热气，让POKENAME轻松浮在空中。被它蜇伤后，灼痛会持续数天。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME can stay afloat with little effort, as its broad wings catch the hot air rising from its tail. A sting from this Pokémon will burn for days.

entry: 背上的仙人掌一直被火烧着，究竟如何生长至今不明。其中含有多种毒素，不能食用。
author: soup1900
source: It is unknown how the cactus on its back could even grow since it is constantly set ablaze. The cactus contains many toxins that render it inedible.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME自尊心很强，会与群体中的其他成员竞争。领地争夺战中落败的一方，必须永远离开族群。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a strong ego and competes with other members of its group. Whoever loses a territorial battle must leave the group forever.

entry: 这把怨灵附身的战镐一挥就能瞬间熔穿铠甲与血肉，是披甲敌人的克星。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This haunted war pick instantly melts through armor and flesh in one swing, making it the bane of armored foes.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，火焰会裹住整片刀刃；平静时则缩小成一簇火苗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames engulf its whole blade when it is angry, but dwindles to a single flame when it's calm.

entry: POKENAME是这一进化家族中最凶猛的，愤怒咆哮时会迸出火花。
author: supersonicloki
source: As the most ferocious of its family, POKENAME creates sparks when it roars in anger.

entry: 感知训练家陷入困境时，会迅速焦躁起来。焦躁时，火焰温度会升至平时的近两倍。
author: melodydelune
source: It becomes agitated quickly if it senses its Trainer is in distress. When agitated, its flames burn nearly twice as hot.

entry: 会烧毁遗弃自己的主人所有的玩具，以此复仇。拉开脸上的拉链就能喷火。
author: soup1900
source: It exacts its revenge on the owner who disowned it by burning down all of their toys. It breathes fire by opening the zipper on its face.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来气冲冲的，却极力保护亲近的对象，经常挡在训练家与危险之间。
author: supersonicloki
source: Despite its angry appearance; POKENAME is extremely protective of those close to it, often walking between its Trainer and any threat.

entry: 兴奋时，尾巴上的火焰会变成平时的两倍大。总在寻找对手较量，即使落败也乐在其中。
author: soup1900
source: The flame on its tail doubles in size when it gets excited. It constantly seeks for opponents to fight with and has fun doing so, even if it loses.

entry: 迷路的矿工会循着远处微弱的火光，盼着找到地面。可那是POKENAME，正引着他们走向地下更深处。
author: robosoup
source: Lost miners will follow a distant glimmer of torchlight hoping to find the surface, but POKENAME is leading them astray, deeper into the earth.

entry: 融合能量唤醒了它的龙之基因。性情极为残忍，会将看见的任何人烧成灰烬，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has awakened its draconic genes. It is extremely ruthless and will incinerate anyone it sees, including its own Trainer.

entry: 不服管束的POKENAME会在光天化日下扑向旅人抢劫。它们总因傲慢而招惹打不过的对手，最终自食其果。
author: robosoup
source: Unruly POKENAME will pounce on travelers to rob them in broad daylight. Their arrogance is their downfall, as they pick fights they cannot win.

entry: 先用巨尾猛击对手，再凶狠地将其焚毁。没有翅膀，行动缓慢，走起路来常重重跺脚。
author: soup1900
source: It slams its large tail onto opponents before viciously incinerating them. Due to its lack of wings, it moves slowly and often stomps while walking.

entry: 背甲上燃烧着熊熊烈火，因此露营者常把POKENAME当作篝火。
author: soup1900
source: The back of its shell sports a huge fire. Because of this, POKENAME is often used by campers as a campfire.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以壳为轴旋转，卷起利爪与火焰的旋风。POKENAME背壳的焦痕，正是历经战斗的骄傲印记。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spin themselves on their shell during battle, creating a whirlwind of claws and fire to attack. The burn marks around the back of a POKENAME's shell is a sign of pride after many battles.

entry: 背上有两具喷火器，通常只喷出近距离的火焰。愤怒时，火焰却能喷出十多英尺远。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon has two flamethrowers on its back that expel short-range flames. When angered, though, the flames can reach a distance of over ten feet.

entry: POKENAME经常造访海滩与港口，能用沙子和泥土造出交通工具。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is often seen visiting beaches and ports. It is capable of making vehicles out of sand and dirt.

entry: 都市传说称，把耳朵贴向地面，就能听见POKENAME在隧道里唱歌。
author: rakunk
source: Urban legend states that if you hold your ear towards the ground, you can hear POKENAME singing from inside its tunnels.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在黑暗的隧道中穿行，从毫无戒心的猎物背后突然钻出伏击。说不定此刻，它就在你们中间。
author: xenophacilus
source: It is said that POKENAME goes around dark tunnels in order to ambush and pop up behind unsuspecting prey. It may currently be among you right now.

entry: POKENAME能察觉并挖出附近埋着的东西，仿佛找到了宝藏。建议训练家别带它靠近墓地。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME detects and digs up nearby buried objects as if it were treasure. It's recommended that Trainers keep their POKENAME away from graveyards.

entry: POKENAME看起来像卡在土里，让人想把它拔出来。可一旦有人想握住它，它便会沉进地下更深处躲开。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's appearance of being wedged in the dirt beckons one to pick it up, but it evades would-be wielders by sinking further into the ground.

entry: 它钻出地面时，会收集岩石遮护敏感的身体，免遭日晒。水晶角战斗的力道太强，让人推测地下还藏着大得多的身体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It gathers rocks as it emerges from the ground to protect its sensitive body from the sun. The strength it carries while fighting with its crystalline horns leads people to theorize it has a much larger body underground.

entry: POKENAME在地下一码深处挖洞，以植物根部为食。农民拔出新鲜蔬菜时，才发现上面缺了几口。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME burrows a yard underground, eating the roots of plants. Farmers have pulled up fresh vegetables only to find bite marks taken out of them.

entry: POKENAME爱探索无人涉足的洞穴，每到一处，都取一块石头添进石质花朵。红色护目镜能挡住沙土，保护眼睛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to go spelunking in unexplored caves and will collect a single rock from there to add to its rocky flowers. Its red-tinted visor protects its eyes from sand and dirt.

entry: POKENAME深居地下，只有察觉到愿意实现的心愿才现身。若有人为私欲强行挖出POKENAME，就会化为水晶，深埋洞中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwells deep within the ground, only emerging when it observes a wish it desires to grant. If someone attempts to dig up POKENAME for selfish reasons, they will be turned to crystal and entombed deep within a cavern.

entry: 双颚一开一合，便将周围沙子搅成猛烈漩涡，使谁也无法将它从沙里挖出。
author: staghorn
source: By opening and closing its jaws, it churns the sand around it into a raging whirlpool. This makes it impossible to extract it from its surroundings.

entry: 科学家最近发现，POKENAME会用大眼睛看清暗道。据说，歌声能让它们在地下远距离交流。
author: rakunk
source: Scientists have recently discovered POKENAME uses its large eyes to see inside dark tunnels. It is said they sing in order to communicate to one another from long distances underground.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋进地下，只露出岩石般的鳍。它们以鳍凿开石头，挤过窄缝进入洞中，想独自安静歇息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ground with only their rocky fins exposed. They use these fins to carve through rocks, slipping into narrow cracks to get into caves to try and get some rest in private.

entry: 寒冷地区，见到POKENAME被视为好运，因为它擅长翻松冻土。农家的孩子会玩起搭小屋的游戏，吸引它来。
author: wormspawn
source: Spotting a POKENAME is considered good luck in cold regions because it is especially equipped to till soil enveloped in permafrost. Farmers' children make a game of building small shelters to attract them.

entry: 双臂旋转着掘地，速度最高可达每小时40英里。若地面挖不进去，就只能慢慢摇摆着走。
author: staghorn
source: It can dig rapidly by spinning its arms, reaching speeds of up to 40 miles per hour. If it can't dig into the terrain, it is forced to waddle slowly.

entry: POKENAME全由沙子构成，成了一群地鼠的家。这究竟是共生，还是寄生，仍不清楚。
author: serversizeme
source: Due to being made completely of sand, POKENAME became the home to a colony of Diglett. It is unknown if this is a symbiotic or parasitic relationship.

entry: POKENAME住在幽深寒冷的洞中，吃挖来的宝石与矿物。虽常与勾魂眼交手，有时也会合力觅食，平分财宝。
author: teatedtiten
source: Found in deep and cold caverns, POKENAME feast on gemstones and minerals they dig up. Though they have bouts with Sableye, they will sometimes work together to find food and split their treasures.

entry: POKENAME常在南瓜田附近挖洞，翻出肥沃土壤。农人若想摸它，就会被头上藤蔓抽打。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found near pumpkin patches, tunneling through the ground to create fertile soil. It will whip farmers with the vine on its head if they try to touch it.

entry: 人们常以为看见了地鼠藏在地下的身体，其实那是POKENAME。它会掘地，将猎物拖入土中。
author: ayutac
source: People often think that they saw the body of a Diglett, though it was, in fact, a POKENAME. This Pokémon can burrow, and it pulls its prey under the earth.

entry: 据说许多地鼠聚在一起时，有时会造出守卫来保护洞穴。不过，守卫获得生命的原理仍不明。
author: fuade
source: It's said many Diglett coming together sometimes build guardians to protect their burrows. The mechanism through which it gained life is unknown.

entry: POKENAME总把脚藏在地下，需要时随时钻走。有时拿的大葱太大，却会在挖洞时卡住。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME always keep their feet underground, ready to burrow when needed. Sometimes it gets stuck while digging if the leek it's holding is too big.

entry: POKENAME借异界之力，在岩间开出小窗，观察感兴趣的人，或打声招呼。奇怪的是，从另一面看，窗子却全无踪迹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel an otherworldly power to make little windows between rocks that they use to observe or greet people they take an interest in. Strangely, these windows are completely invisible when viewed from the other side.

entry: POKENAME全身的电气石能收存多余电力，如发电机般蓄能。进入战斗，它便震碎部分晶体，解除限制，全力出战。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tourmaline along POKENAME's body helps it contain any excess electricity, building up energy as a sort of generator. When it enters battle, it will shatter off fragments of crystal to remove its limiters and fight at full force.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，爱将宝石送给喜欢的对象。不过得保持距离，POKENAME抱得太有力，连岩石也能压成钻石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very affectionate and loves to give its jewels to anyone it likes. Just keep your distance, as POKENAME's hugs are powerful enough to compress rocks into diamonds.

entry: POKENAME天性亲热，相信不断关心与送上耀眼礼物，最能让人觉得自己特别。它常花训练家的钱买礼物，还不明白主人为何生气。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME is very affectionate by nature, believing that constant attention and flashy gifts are the best way to make someone feel special. It often uses its Trainers' money to purchase these gifts, not understanding when they get upset.

entry: POKENAME借宝石反光，将自己装成钻石，实际上宝石全是朱砂。矿工若靠得太近，POKENAME会故意打碎多余宝石，释放液态汞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME reflect light off of their jewels in order to disguise themselves as diamonds. In reality, their gems are made of cinnabar. If a miner gets too close, POKENAME will purposefully shatter spare gems to release liquid mercury.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始离地悬浮，很少再钻回地下，除非睡觉或感到威胁。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非蒙上挖出的泥土。
author: krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: 进化后，它们继续各司其职，磨炼技艺。工匠借新工作台改进工具，让挖掘者有更先进的铲子，猎手也得到更好的武器。
author: doodledoo
source: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.

entry: 进化后，它们继续各司其职，磨炼技艺。工匠借新工作台改进工具，让挖掘者有更先进的铲子，猎手也得到更好的武器。
author: doodledoo
source: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.

entry: POKENAME因为进化后秃了头而一直惊愕不已。担心被发现时，会慌张地扭动臀部。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME are in constant shock due to becoming bald upon evolving. It moves its hips in panic over being found.

entry: POKENAME仅用沙子、泥土和岩石，就能造出交通工具与武器。没人知道它究竟如何做到。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of sand, dirt, and rock. No one is sure how they manage to do it.

entry: 这个POKENAME亚种能完全用海底的材料制造交通工具与武器。性情十分凶猛。
author: neonriser
source: This subspecies of POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of materials from the seafloor. It's known to be very aggressive.

entry: 坚盾剑怪将三地鼠吸入剑中，形成了POKENAME。能用剑刃操纵地面，在地下迅速穿行。
author: jackjirachi
source: Aegislash absorbed Dugtrio into its swords, forming POKENAME. It manipulates the ground with its blades, allowing for swift underground travel.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头想法完全一致，因此挖隧道时配合得天衣无缝。
author: melodydelune
source: The three heads of POKENAME all think exactly alike, allowing it perfect coordination while digging tunnels.

entry: POKENAME总梦想着钱。训练家逗它玩、抱着它时，它会趁机偷走对方身上一切能偷的东西。
author: zombieshinx_
source: POKENAME is constantly dreaming about money. When Trainers play with and cuddle this Pokémon It steals everything they can from them.

entry: POKENAME善于变成贵重物件，一动不动待上数小时。轻信的买家常等到回家，才发现买来的巨大金珠竟是POKENAME。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME are known to shapeshift into valuable objects and stay motionless for hours. Gullible shoppers often find out the Big Nuggets they bought are POKENAME only after they bring them home.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，常受人追捧，却通常黏着更吓人的宝可梦，寻求保护。
author: inksans201x
source: While it's often sought out for its cuteness, POKENAME typically sticks to more menacing Pokémon for protection.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚，追起亮物与美食却很敏捷。POKENAME白天大多补眠，准备夜里寻宝觅食，也爱趴在亮晶晶的藏品上睡觉。
author: mbavenger64
source: Despite its rotund body, POKENAME moves swiftly when chasing shiny things and delicious food. POKENAME spends most of its daytime napping for late-night treasure or food hunting and also loves napping on top of its shiny objects.

entry: 会经常洗澡，保持身体光亮。POKENAME若看上了别人手中的东西，就会一直大声哭闹，直到如愿以偿。
author: lazyarcanist
source: It bathes regularly to keep its body shiny. If POKENAME covets something you have, it will cry loudly until it gets what it wants.

entry: POKENAME以喜爱昂贵的颜料和材料著称。有些罪犯会利用它们绘制赝品，再高价售出。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are known for their love for expensive paints and materials. Some criminals use them to paint counterfeits to sell for high prices.

entry: 黄金本来太重太软，不适合做剑刃，但它能够自行修复。还能探测宝藏，一发现就会明显兴奋起来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Gold would normally be too heavy and soft for a sword blade, but it's able to repair itself. It can detect treasure, its presence visibly exciting it.

entry: POKENAME迷恋闪亮的东西。想收服它的训练家只要送上亮晶晶的礼物，就能轻松与它交好。
author: melodydelune
source: Fascinated by shiny objects, POKENAME can be easily befriended by prospective Trainers by offering it something that sparkles.

entry: POKENAME用硬币与尾巴的亮光，引来黑暗鸦等毫无防备的鸟宝可梦。对方一近，便猛扑捉住，拖回巢中充饥。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses the sharp glare of its coin and tail to lure unsuspecting bird Pokémon like Murkrow. Once they approach, it pounces and drags them back to its den as prey.

entry: POKENAME美丽的金玫瑰很受富人欢迎。可POKENAME自私极了，绝不许人碰自己的花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is popular among the wealthy due to its beautiful golden roses. However, POKENAME is a very selfish Pokémon and will never let anyone touch its roses.

entry: 据说，野外遇见POKENAME象征好运。可谁若得寸进尺，想碰硬币，立刻就会挨电。
author: alumed
source: Finding a POKENAME in the wild is said to be a sign of good fortune, though it is quick to shock any that press their luck and try to touch its coin.

entry: POKENAME见到摄像机，就会跑到镜头前糟蹋披萨。什么都不肯认真对待，实在是个麻烦。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found destroying pizzas in front of any cameras it can find. It is unable to take anything seriously, making it a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME若觉得有人要拿走自己想要的闪亮物件，就会不停抓挠对方。可这股盲目的怒气往往让它失去那件宝贝。
author: pokepower
source: If POKENAME thinks someone will take a shiny object it wants, it will scratch them relentlessly. This blind fury usually leads to losing the object.

entry: 毛发浓密蓬松，常被用于制作冬衣。也是寒冷地区很受欢迎的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: Its fur is very dense and fluffy, which is why it is often used for winter clothing. It is also a popular companion in cold regions.

entry: POKENAME有这般体格，却十分爱玩。训练需要极大耐心，最后才能得到忠实的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is very playful. A Trainer needs a lot of patience to train it, but will be rewarded with a loyal companion in the end.

entry: POKENAME狩猎技艺极高，以变身近乎完美地隐藏，等飞行宝可梦落地歇脚，再突然扑出。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME are incredibly proficient hunters, using their transformation abilities to hide almost perfectly, then pouncing on flying Pokémon when they land to rest.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME既能充当精心锻造的宝剑，也能充当寻宝探测器，具体取决于剑柄上猫老大头部的心情。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a finely forged sword as well as treasure detector, determined by the mood of the Persian head pommel.

entry: 这只POKENAME曾由一位传奇寻宝者持用。据说那位探险家能够听懂它的话，与它交谈。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME was once wielded by a legendary treasure hunter. The explorer was said to have been able to verbally communicate and understand it.

entry: POKENAME有许多仰慕者。不过，想收服它的训练家要注意，它对谁亲近可是说变就变。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has many admirers, though prospective Trainers should be warned it is fickle about who it shows it's affection to.

entry: POKENAME真把自己当成了国王，会试图统治同一区域内的其他宝可梦。
author: snugglessam
source: POKENAME thinks of itself as king in a literal sense and will attempt to rule over other Pokémon living in the same area.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME看见亮物便兴奋，想也不想就拿走。有时连自己的金爪，也会看得入迷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets extremely excited over shiny objects and will take anything shiny without a second thought. It will sometimes even get mesmerized by its own golden claws.

entry: POKENAME擅长潜行，常伏击小型猎物或偷取食物。柔软的脚掌让它跑动时悄无声息。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are known for stealth, often seen ambushing small prey or stealing food. Their soft paws let them scamper about silently.

entry: POKENAME以小群体共同生活。胡须最华丽的一只就是首领，所有成员都毫无例外地认可它。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME live together in small packs. The one with the most magnificent beard is the leader, who is accepted by every pack member without exception.

entry: POKENAME极其骄傲，只听老练训练家的话。可一旦认可，也愿为对方冒生命危险。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an extremely proud Pokémon that only obeys experienced Trainers. However, it would even risk its life for one.

entry: 能治好POKENAME头痛的，只有长在背上种子里的药草，可它自己偏偏够不到。因此，它常跟在训练家身后，盼着有人帮它缓解疼痛。
author: rakunk
source: The only cure for POKENAME's headaches is the herbs growing on its bulb, which it is unable to reach on its own. As a result, it often follows Trainers with the hope they will help ease its pain.

entry: POKENAME常见于公园池塘，接受游客喂食。若POKENAME等着吃，你却不喂，它的力量可能让你事后头痛欲裂。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly found in parks and ponds, where they are fed by visitors. If you don't feed a POKENAME when it expects to be fed, you may develop a splitting headache afterward due to its abilities.

entry: 不建议尝一口POKENAME。它不仅难吃，哪怕只啃下一点点，也会引发剧烈的偏头痛。
author: patch_bros
source: It is recommended that no one take a bite out of POKENAME. Not only does it taste horrible, but even the smallest nibble can cause intense migraines.

entry: POKENAME几乎时刻受偏头痛折磨。一尖叫，背上孔洞就冒出大泡泡。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is in near constant pain with migraines. As it screams, large bubbles emerge from holes on its back.

entry: 用六片翅膀游泳，用两只巨爪牢牢抓住猎物。长期头痛若达到顶点，可能会展现奇异的力量。
author: the_fireplace
source: It swims using six wings, and grips its prey firmly between its two large claws. If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers.

entry: POKENAME常预见村落受灾，便赶去救助。可预知引发的头痛，反激起超能力，往往造成原本想阻止的破坏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME often have visions of disasters striking a village and rush in to try and help. However, the headaches that come from their visions set off their psychic powers, often causing the destruction they sought to prevent.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直头痛。建议想饲养它的训练家常备舒缓的音乐，营造没有压力的环境。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME suffers from near-constant headaches. Prospective Trainers are advised to keep therapeutic music around and create a stress-free environment.

entry: 据说POKENAME能以超能力抬起整个海洋。可频繁的头痛总在它充分发挥前，就打乱了专注。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME could lift the entire ocean using its psychic power. However, it experiences frequent headaches that disrupt its focus before it can properly display its power.

entry: POKENAME长得不平衡，常侧倒在地。等压力积到足够大，就能用念力把自己扶正。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Due to its lopsided appearance, POKENAME frequently falls on its side. It is able to right itself using psychokinesis once it becomes stressed enough.

entry: POKENAME是舞者，却从没有实际跳舞的记录。平日懒洋洋的，据说经常头痛。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are dancers, but have never actually been recorded dancing. They laze around and often are said to have headaches.

entry: 会收集人们投进喷泉、水井与池塘的硬币。额头上的硬币靠潜藏的念力固定着。
author: staghorn
source: It collects coins that are dropped into fountains, wells, and ponds. The coin on its forehead stays attached via its latent telekinetic powers.

entry: 超能力不再让它头痛，因此，性情也平和了许多。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It no longer receives headaches from its psychic powers. It is much calmer as a result.

entry: POKENAME以层层脂肪为傲，气色最佳的个体会成为族群首领。天性温顺，喜欢拥抱。
author: megaban
source: POKENAME's layers of fat are its pride. The most optimal complexion decides the pack's leader. POKENAME are docile in nature and like hugs.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖岸。坚韧的外骨骼、锋利的爪子与强壮的尾巴，让它轻松捕猎、自卫。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME lives on the shores of lakes. Its tough exoskeleton, sharp claws, and strong tail allow it to easily hunt for prey and defend itself.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME在湖中游泳。会用念力与巨爪惩罚污染家园的家伙。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME is often seen swimming in lakes. It uses its telekinetic powers and enormous claws to punish those who pollute its home.

entry: POKENAME靠带蹼的脚掌游泳，在栖息的湖泊与缓流河中优雅穿行。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses its webbed paws to swim gracefully around the lakes and slow-moving rivers that make up its habitat.

entry: POKENAME能潜入水中。双眼清楚看见水上水下，双翼也演化成了极佳的鳍。
author: sonic3knuckles
source: POKENAME are capable of submerging their bodies underwater. Their eyes allow them to see above and under the surface rather clearly, and their wings are adapted to serve perfectly as fins.

entry: POKENAME很善泳。POKENAME开心时，尾巴的泡泡慢慢冒出，发怒时却会猛烈喷涌。
author: krune
source: A POKENAME is an adept swimmer. The bubbles on its tail calmly emerge when POKENAME is happy and burst out when it is enraged.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: POKENAME能在陆地或水中行动，却很少走得快、游得快。超能力让它与尾巴上的可达贝配合得天衣无缝，想打它一个措手不及，可不容易。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can move on dry land or in the water, though they are rarely able to walk or swim quickly. Their psychic powers allow them to be in perfect harmony with the Psyder on the tail, so catching them off-guard is quite difficult.

entry: POKENAME接受完全进化的火花训练。它拼命锻炼，希望有朝一日能打败对方。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are trained by fully evolved Primesaur. POKENAME trains furiously, hoping to one day beat them.

entry: POKENAME极为凶暴危险，会四处飞行，袭击人类和宝可梦，因此很难训练。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is an extremely violent and dangerous Pokémon. It flies around attacking people and Pokémon, which makes it very hard to train.

entry: POKENAME背上萌出的花苞，代表训练开始见效。看到花苞后，它们会更有动力坚持锻炼。
author: codewolfie
source: The flower that starts to bud on POKENAME's back is a sign that their training is paying off. The sight of this bud motivates them to keep training.

entry: 谁闯进领地，它就会咬住对方并注入毒液。越是愤怒，毒性就越强。
author: skymaster426
source: It lashes out at anyone who enters its territory by biting and injecting the target with its venom. The angrier it grows, the more potent the venom.

entry: POKENAME被宠坏了，稍不如意就大发脾气，很少主动向训练家示好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very spoiled Pokémon and will throw temper tantrums any time it doesn't get its way. It very rarely shows outward affection towards its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME小巧有活力，满身绒毛。它凭敏捷动作与灵敏感官突袭对手，有时还会藏进高草，施以毒击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a small, energetic Pokémon covered in fuzzy fur. It uses its swift movements and keen senses to strike and surprise opponents, sometimes launching toxic strikes while hiding in tall grass.

entry: POKENAME脾气急躁，既用手臂攻击，也用手臂移动。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME has a short temper. It uses its arms as both its means of attacking and moving.

entry: 随着斗志日盛，POKENAME的花朵外长出一道钢箍。钢箍坚不可摧，据说恰如POKENAME不屈的意志。
author: codewolfie
source: As POKENAME's fighting spirit grew, It developed a steel band around its bloom. The band is unbreakable, and said to resemble POKENAME's spirit.

entry: 会推倒树木砸向敌人。愤怒时，只需几秒就能啃断树干。
author: staghorn
source: It brings down trees on top of its foes. When angered, it can gnaw through a tree's trunk in seconds.

entry: 融合终于让POKENAME平静下来。可惜，融合带来的失明又让它很恼火，脾气依旧有些急躁。
author: patch_bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to finally calm down. Unfortunately, it is very annoyed by its newfound blindness and is still somewhat irritable.

entry: POKENAME会训练年幼的猴种子战斗。若被徒弟击败，便会退休，由徒弟成为新的师父。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME trains young Mansaur to fight. If beaten by its apprentice, the apprentice becomes the new teacher, and POKENAME retires.

entry: POKENAME怒火升温，加热体内空气，让自己飘飞。太平静便会掉下来，可这又惹怒了POKENAME，因此从不落地太久。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's red-hot temper heats up the air inside it, which provides enough lift for it to fly. It loses its ability to float if it becomes too calm; since this enrages the POKENAME, it never remains grounded for long.

entry: 族群中最强的POKENAME会用众多肢体，同时迎战其他所有成员。首领会独占群体找到的一切食物。
author: al_chimera
source: The strongest POKENAME in a pack will fight every other member at once with its many limbs. The leader of the pack hoards any food the pack acquires.

entry: 凭嗅觉就能轻松找到同类。追踪时会摇摆臀部，路过人们身边时还常常致意。
author: houndrys.
source: Thanks to its sense of smell, it can easily find others of its kind. It sways its hips while tracking and often salutes people while passing by.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的小小幼犬宝可梦，火焰比太阳还热。忠诚与嗅觉都强得惊人。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny, floating puppy Pokémon, and its flames are hotter than the sun. It has an insane sense of loyalty and smell.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的幼犬宝可梦，用意念操纵火焰。友善而忠诚，为了训练家什么都愿意做。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a floating puppy Pokémon. It can control fire with its mind. It is very friendly and loyal, and it will do anything for its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME好奇得什么都要用嘴探一探，出了名地难养。训练家既要留意，也要耐心，否则无尽好奇可能惹出意外的乱子。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously difficult to raise due to its curious nature and instinct to investigate everything using its mouth. Trainers must be vigilant and patient, as its relentless curiosity can cause unintended chaos if not properly managed.

entry: 古人将POKENAME描绘成忠诚的伙伴。如今，谁迷失在它栖息的遗迹，它便会悄悄指引。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME is a depiction of a loyal companion to ancient people. It will subtly guide those who end up lost in the ruins it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME会在喜欢的东西上留下火热的吻痕。它讨厌脏，一弄脏就会尽快把自己清理干净。
author: houndrys.
source: When POKENAME finds something it enjoys, it leaves a firey kiss mark on it. It hates being dirty and will clean itself up as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME只让自己认可的高尚英雄持用。若察觉别有用心者的恶意，就会燃起自身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME allows itself to be wielded by those it considers to be a noble hero, but lights itself ablaze when it senses evil intent in another.

entry: POKENAME是普通人最爱养的宠物之一，对主人极为忠诚。
author: melodydelune
source: One of the most popular pets among non-Trainers, POKENAME are extremely loyal and faithful to their owners.

entry: POKENAME忠诚护主，温暖又蓬松，是受欢迎的伙伴与吉祥物。它们常控制不好力道，好在软绒身体通常能免去重伤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are fiercely loyal and protective, their warmth and fluffiness making them popular companions and mascots. They often have some trouble controlling their own strength, but their plushiness usually keeps anyone from getting too hurt.

entry: 会装作小狗，向人类讨取食物与住处。但最终总会露出昆虫般的动作和习性，往往把人吓得发毛。
author: pokepower
source: It acts like a puppy to get food and shelter from humans. Its insectoid movement and behavior is eventually noticed, which usually creeps people out.

entry: 人们自古就敬畏POKENAME在熔岩中迅速奔跑的身姿。威风凛凛的皮毛下，是极为坚韧的皮肤。
author: darkweavile428
source: People have long revered the sight of POKENAME running swiftly through lava. Beneath its majestic fur is extremely tough hide.

entry: 古籍记载，它曾与人们同行，带来繁荣和温暖。一个飞吻之后，就会掀起烈焰风暴。
author: houndrys.
source: Ancient texts tell that it walked along people, granting them prosperity and warmth. If it blows a kiss, a storm of fire will follow.

entry: POKENAME从双翼喷出烈焰推进，时速最高180英里，用强劲的角贯穿敌人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME propels itself by shooting intense flames from its wings. It can fly up to 180 mph, impaling its opponents with its powerful horn.

entry: 身手敏捷，走到哪里都常以滚动前进。一口气能滚过6,000多英里，无需休息。
author: melodydelune
source: This nimble Pokémon can often be seen rolling around wherever it goes. It can roll for over 6,000 miles without needing to break.

entry: 某些文化对POKENAME崇拜极深，科学家因此长期拿不准它是否真实存在。据说，仁君诞生前，它便会到来，为土地带来和平。
author: rakunk
source: For a long time, scientists were unsure if POKENAME actually existed due to its prominent worship in some cultures. They are said to arrive before the birth of a benevolent ruler to bring peace to the lands.

entry: 虽然笨拙，据说却能打动最冰冷的心。以超能力包裹的飞吻，能让任何人都感到愉快。
author: houndrys.
source: Despite being clumsy, it's said to inspire even the coldest heart. By blowing a kiss veiled in psychic power, it brings a pleasant feeling to anyone.

entry: POKENAME被尊为传说中的来世守护者。据说，它会引领逝者的灵魂，前往灵界。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is revered as a legendary guardian of the afterlife. It is said that it guides those who have passed away into the spiritual realm.

entry: 成群POKENAME不止一次被错认成火山喷发。它们如火山碎屑流般冲过干地，以利爪、烈火与尘土裹住不幸的猎物。
author: frink202
source: A pack of POKENAME has on more than one occasion been confused for a volcanic eruption. They surge across dry environments like pyroclastic flows, enveloping any unfortunate prey they find in a flurry of claws, flames and dust.

entry: 忠诚的POKENAME时速能超过250英里。据说一直在寻找与自己失散的英雄。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The loyal POKENAME can travel more than 250 miles per hour. It's said to search for a hero who was separated from it.

entry: 古代传说里，有位战士速度眩目、怒火炽烈。有学者认为，那是现代融合出现前，POKENAME最早的记载。
author: phantom640
source: Ancient tales told of a legendary warrior who would fight with blinding speed and blazing fury. Some scholars believe these tales to be early records of POKENAME, long before modern-day fusion.

entry: POKENAME来自远东，自古以来就因忠诚和亲人的天性备受贵族与王室珍视。
author: melodydelune
source: Hailing from the far east, POKENAME has been prized since ancient times by regals and royalty for its loyalty and loving nature.

entry: POKENAME守在家门，尽职挡住一切入侵者，因此深受屋主喜爱。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME will settle on the front doors of houses, and dutifully protect them from any would-be intruders. As such, they're beloved by homeowners.

entry: POKENAME高速飞过沙漠，猛烈振翅掀起热浪。
author: mistershaokahn
source: POKENAME flies at a high speed through deserts, generating heat waves by violently flapping its wings.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。性情亲人，也聪明得出奇。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME is a popular first Pokémon for kids. It's very loving and surprisingly intelligent.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。相伴珍爱多年后，条纹也许会褪色，爱却永不消退。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular first Pokémon for kids. After being cherished for many years, their stripes may fade, however, that love never will.

entry: 战斗时，体内火焰回应POKENAME的决心，让体温急升，出拳更猛更快。但若不控制，也可能过热。
author: glacierwing
source: During combat, POKENAME's body temperature rises rapidly, the flame inside its body reacting to the Pokémon's determination. This raises the intensity and speed of its punches, but this can lead to overheating if not managed.

entry: POKENAME藏在火山岩间，等猎物游过，就喷火烤熟。可被老练厨师料理后，POKENAME自己也是受欢迎的佳肴，据说肉质鲜嫩多汁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst volcanic rock, waiting for its prey to swim by before cooking them with a blast of fire. When prepared by an experienced chef POKENAME is considered a popular delicacy with their meat being described as juicy and tender.

entry: 每逢它一年一度的迁徙，人们便举办庆典。它喜欢在灼热的烟火中起舞，否则就会焚烧城镇取乐。
author: robosoup
source: Festivals are held on its annual migration, for it loves dancing amongst the hot fireworks, and would otherwise burn towns for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME的两种融合成分同步完成了超级进化，能一直维持这种形态。破坏欲极为强烈。
author: robosoup
source: Both halves of POKENAME have mega-evolved in synchrony, and it can hold this form indefinitely. It has a great urge to destroy.

entry: 它高飞在寒冷稀薄的空气中。养鸟人传说，POKENAME若在地上待得太久，羽毛就会起火。
author: ozydamians
source: It flies high above the ground where the air is cold and thin. A birdkeeper legend says if POKENAME spends too much time on the ground, its feathers burst into flame.

entry: 目力比最强的望远镜还精准。从数英里高空，它会撒下炽热的火点，如雨般降落。
author: ozydamians
source: Its eyes are more powerful and precise than even the strongest telescope. From miles above, it rains down superheated motes of fire.

entry: 它产生足够的热量与空气，让训练家即使身处太空边缘，也能安然无恙。从遥远下方看，POKENAME很像传说的宝可梦。
author: ozydamians
source: It generates enough heat and air to safely insulate its Trainer even at the edge of space. From far below, you might mistake POKENAME for a legendary Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖息在长有仙人掌的稀树草原。人们常采下它背上的仙人掌，做成美味的炸条。
author: soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME can be found in savannah biomes where cacti grow. The cactus on its back is often harvested to make delicious cactus fries.

entry: 一被POKENAME缠住，就不可能逃出硫磺烈焰。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: Once a POKENAME wraps its body around a foe, escaping its sulfuric flames becomes an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME是个急性子的厨师。强烈情绪会让育儿袋里的火焰增强，因此厨艺虽好，却常在压力下把菜烧糊。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME is a hotheaded chef, but the fire in its pouch intensifies with strong emotions. Despite its skill, it frequently burns dishes when stressed.

entry: POKENAME的焰爪切油轮船壳，如切黄油般容易。目标若太远，就常朝对方投掷熔融的碎屑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flaming claws are hot enough to slice through a tanker hull like butter. If its target is too far away however, it has a tendency to throw molten debris at its target.

entry: POKENAME夜间栖息在城堡塔顶，能听见数英里外闯入者的动静，因此很受王室喜爱。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME roosts atop castle towers at night, and can hear interlopers from miles away. This makes them a favorite companion of royalty.

entry: 长出新翅膀后，POKENAME便不再玩泥巴了。如今，它的目光已投向云端。
author: shocktopus1717
source: With its new wings, POKENAME has abandoned its habit of playing in mud. It has its eyes set on the clouds now.

entry: POKENAME的火焰会随感知到的周围人的意图而增强。一旦察觉威胁，便会猛烈蹿起。
author: final_courtesy
source: The flames on POKENAME intensify in response to the detected intentions of people nearby. The flames surge fiercely when a threat is perceived.

entry: 时速可达惊人的1,000英里。不过，飞过后难免留下余烬，有时会引发野火。
author: skymaster426
source: Its speed reaches a blistering 1,000 mph. However, it can't help but leave embers in its wake, sometimes causing wildfires where it flies.

entry: POKENAME在空中翱翔，向下方毫无防备的受害者洒下燃烧的酸液，宛如飞翔的酸液火山，自己却浑然不知造成了多少破坏。
author: benevolent
source: Oblivious to the wreckage it causes, POKENAME soars through the air, spewing flaming acid onto its unwitting victims below like a flying acid volcano.

entry: POKENAME会到处寻找强敌。虽然个头小，却对自己的力量极为自豪。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will go around looking for tough opponents. Despite its small stature, it is very proud of its power.

entry: POKENAME看起来可爱，却能喷出超过1800度的火焰。只要信任训练家，就会不惜一切代价保护对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME looks cute, but can spit out flames at over 1800 degrees. If it trusts its Trainer, it will protect them at all costs.

entry: POKENAME毫不留情地捍卫领地，将火与水在巨口中混合，喷出滚烫的蒸汽。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME defends its territory without mercy. It combines fire and water in its maw to spew boiling hot steam.

entry: 身体极为坚固，还能传导热量。POKENAME会飞起加热身体，再将对手从空中狠狠撞落。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is extremely robust and conducts heat. POKENAME flies up, heats up and then rams its opponent out of the air to hit them hard.

entry: 研究者怀疑，POKENAME必须不断喷火维持“剑刃”，这样的持续消耗让它脾气火爆。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers suspect POKENAME gets its fiery temper from the strain of constantly breathing fire to form its "blade", a constant cycle.

entry: 据说，这柄传说中的战镐，附着巨龙之魂，一挥之下，便能熔穿整支军队。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This legendary war pick is said to be possessed by the spirit of a dragon and have the ability to melt through armies in one fell swoop.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时周身缠绕雷电与火焰，是当地森林火灾和停电的主要原因之一。
author: supersonicloki
source: Cloaked in lightning and flame as it runs, POKENAME is a leading cause of forest fires and power outages in the region.

entry: POKENAME的力量源于与训练家的羁绊。感情越深，火焰就燃烧得越猛烈。
author: melodydelune
source: The source POKENAME's power is the bond with its Trainer. The closer it is bonded to its Trainer, the more intensely its fire burns.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME体内一度平息的暴戾再次涌起。它唤出的地狱之火，预示着对手即将前往彼岸。
author: final_courtesy
source: Violence once sated rages anew inside POKENAME. The infernal flames conjured by POKENAME herald an opponent's impending passage to the world beyond.

entry: POKENAME面对怯懦狡诈的敌人时凶猛不屈。找到合意的伙伴后，金环就会发出灿烂的光芒。
author: final_courtesy
source: POKENAME is ferocious and unyielding towards cowardly, deceitful foes. Its gold rings give off a brilliant glow when it has found a favorable partner.

entry: 莱希拉姆的力量，唤醒了喷火龙潜藏的强大本领。POKENAME身体释放的热量，足以熔化雷吉艾斯，直至蒸发。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: The power of Reshiram has awoken a latent strength in Charizard. The amount of heat POKENAME's body can exert is enough to melt a Regice until it evaporates.

entry: 绰号“岩浆王”，能让地面沸腾。有人将它误认成丰缘的传说宝可梦。
author: pokepower
source: Nicknamed the "Magma King," it can make the ground boil. Some have mistaken it for a legendary Pokémon from the Hoenn region.

entry: 据说POKENAME精通相反的冰火之力，能同时冻伤、烧伤敌人，带来极端痛苦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is said to have a mastery in the contrasting elements of fire and ice. It can use its powers to freeze and burn opponents simultaneously, inflicting extreme pain upon them.

entry: 嘴上的拉链将强烈的火焰封在体内。它不敢轻易拉开，因为喷出的烈焰强得难以控制。
author: skymaster426
source: The zipper on its mouth contains a powerful blaze within its body. It hesitates to unzip its mouth, because the blast is uncontrollably powerful.

entry: POKENAME被愤怒灵魂附身，四处寻找强敌。它常使人陷入催眠般的恍惚，很难挑战。火焰则让人想到它的前世。
author: dahappycute
source: Possessed by an enraged spirit, POKENAME wanders in search of strong opponents. It often induces hypnotic trances, making challenging it difficult. Its flame is reminiscent of its former life.

entry: POKENAME叫得凶，其实没那么爱咬人。它常躺在营地尚未熄灭的火堆里——不过，食物可千万别放在外面！
author: supersonicloki
source: With a bark worse than its bite; POKENAME is usually found laying in smoldering fires at local campsites. Make sure not to leave any food out!

entry: POKENAME寻找族群时常引起骚动。它会展示力量，却往往给当地居民带来灾难。
author: supersonicloki
source: When searching for a pack, POKENAME often causes a commotion. It shows displays of strength that often result in disaster for the locals.

entry: 翼展是身体大小的六倍。体形小巧、重量轻盈，让它能飞得比喷火龙还高。
author: soup1900
source: Its wingspan is six times the size of its body. It can fly even higher than Charizard thanks to its small size and low weight.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，身后冰火交织，形成美丽光迹。夜里看见时，常被错认成彗星。
author: shocktopus1717
source: As POKENAME soars through the sky, beautiful trails of fire and ice shimmer behind it. When seen at night, it is often mistaken for a comet.

entry: 半夜，POKENAME飞过洞穴与森林，寻找对手。燃烧的鬃毛发出的光，也是引诱猎物的诱饵。
author: al_chimera
source: In the middle of the night, POKENAME flies through caves and forests in search of opponents. The light from its flaming mane serves as bait for prey.

entry: 生性好斗，喜欢将其他飞行生物撞落。比起向上飞，更偏爱向下滑翔攻击敌人。
author: soup1900
source: It is aggressive and loves to knock other flying creatures out of the sky. It prefers to glide down to attack its foes rather than fly up.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。它喷出的火焰温度能够超过华氏10,000度。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its flames can reach temperatures of over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAMEX极为相似，最爱贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪发动攻击。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME X. It loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 虽然长得像超级POKENAMEX，它却保留着普通POKENAME的配色。战斗时，喜欢贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪出击。
author: soup1900
source: While it looks similar to Mega POKENAME X, it maintains the colors of normal POKENAME. It prefers to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 它兼具两种超级进化形态与超极巨化形态的特征。一声咆哮，周围便会迸起炽烈的蓝色火焰。
author: soup1900
source: It has the features of both its Mega forms and of its Gigantamax form. Its roar causes intense blue flames to burst all around it.

entry: 它的外貌近似超级POKENAMEY。速度极快，掠过夜空时，宛如一颗流星。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance resembles that of Mega POKENAME Y. Its speed makes it look like a shooting star during the night.

entry: 它有着超级POKENAMEY的外貌，配色与火焰却来自超级POKENAMEX。有人推测，这其实是两个形态融合的结果。
author: soup1900
source: While its appearance is that of Mega POKENAME Y, it has the color and flames of Mega POKENAME X. Some theorize it's actually both fused together.

entry: 小巧流线型的身体让飞行速度发挥到极致。POKENAME能从口中猛烈喷出火焰。
author: soup1900
source: Its small, aerodynamic body allows it to maximize its flight speed. POKENAME powerfully spits flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME尾端的毛发分叉，护着其中的火焰。常参与艰苦战斗，让壳上留着许多抓痕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will have split hairs on the end of its tail to house the flame it has there. It will often have many scratches on its shell due to partaking in many tough battles.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找垃圾吃，身体会熔化沿途的一切。喷出的烟雾能使任何吸入的训练家失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body melts everything in its path as it searches garbage to eat. The smoke it emits can incapacitate any Trainer that breathes it.

entry: 尾巴上的喷火器像军用武器，能喷出燃烧的液体。液体可在物体表面反弹，将火焰送进视线不及的地方。
author: soup1900
source: The flamethrower on its tail, like a military one, spits a flaming liquid that can bounce off surfaces to project the fire into unseen places.

entry: 脆弱的脑外覆着透明薄膜，作为缓冲。可它爱用头撞敌人，仍总在头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: Its delicate brain is covered in a transparent film that acts as padding. Due to its tendency to headbutt its opponents, it is constantly suffering from headaches.

entry: 新长出的腿还很无力，无法奔跑，因此POKENAME的成长时期大多在水中度过。
author: melodydelune
source: Its newly grown legs are weak and prevent it from running. As a result, POKENAME spends the majority of its formative years in the water.

entry: 构成身体的黏液不断旋转，颜色会随最近吃下的食物而微微变化。
author: staghorn
source: The slime composing its body is constantly swirling. It subtly changes color based on its most recent meal.

entry: POKENAME用核心的螺旋纹催眠对手。旋转会让它头晕，如今只能用超能力浮空。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME uses the swirl on its core to hypnotise opponents. It now has to float using its psychic powers because spinning would make it dizzy.

entry: POKENAME轻轻转动缎带，就能让对手入睡。剑刃始终油润光滑。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can gently twirl its ribbon around to put its opponent to sleep. Its blade is always slick and well-oiled.

entry: 皮肤一干燥，健康状况就会恶化。想饲养它的训练家应每隔几天替它保湿，让皮毛保持光亮健康。
author: melodydelune
source: Its health deteriorates when its skin dries out. Prospective Trainers should moisturize them every few days to keep their coats shiny and healthy.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅水下，只让眼状花纹露出，威吓捕食者。受惊扰时，便向来敌喷水，趁隙逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides just below the water surface, keeping its eye patterns above the water to deter predators. If disturbed, it will shoot a small jet of water at its attacker, letting it escape.

entry: 嘴内无尽的虚空不通往任何地方。进入者都会消失，再也不见踪影。
author: theheroict
source: The endless void within its mouth leads to nowhere. Any who enter disappear, never to be seen again.

entry: 缎带状附肢弹性十足，让POKENAME能以音速挥拳。
author: melodydelune
source: The springy elasticity of its ribbon-like appendages allows POKENAME to throw punches at mach speeds.

entry: 生活在湖边，喜爱游泳。周围漂浮着看似蛋的气泡，但这只是伪装，它们其实用于防御。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This fusion lives near lakes where it likes to swim. Around it float bubbles that resemble eggs, but this is a ruse, as they are used for defense.

entry: POKENAME受到挑衅时，能不停地吐出滚烫的气泡洪流，连巨石也能化为粉尘。
author: mistershaokahn
source: When provoked, POKENAME is capable of spitting out a torrent of boiling bubbles without pause. These are able to reduce huge boulders to dust.

entry: POKENAME爱坐在瀑布下磨炼耐力。无论战斗还是游泳，肌肉都从不疲倦。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME prefer to train their endurance by sitting beneath a waterfall. Their muscles never grow tired from fighting or swimming.

entry: 训练家常发现POKENAME睡在树上，但它始终警觉地留意周围。
author: serversizeme
source: Trainers often find POKENAME sleeping in trees. However, it is always keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME能看见数秒后的未来，预判敌人动作。加上闪电般的速度，POKENAME几乎什么招式都能躲开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can see a few seconds into the future, allowing it to predict its opponent's moves. Alongside its lightning-quick speed, POKENAME is able to dodge almost any attack.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，先装作四足行走，再突然直立、飘起来，吓唬猎人和登山者。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is quite the playful creature. It pretends to walk on all fours and then float while on its hind legs to scare hunters and hikers.

entry: POKENAME让自造的毒液悬空，练习超能力。可常常练着练着睡着，忘了自己练到哪一步。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME practice their psychic powers by levitating the poison they create. Unfortunately, they often fall asleep during their training, causing them to lose track of where they were at in their progress.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡18小时。打盹时会用缎带状触角缠住信赖的对象。
author: melodydelune
source: Sleeping for up to 18 hours a day, POKENAME will cling onto those they trust with their ribbon-like feelers as they snooze.

entry: POKENAME先用超能力引来猎物，再放电攻击。若引来的宝可梦太大，就会装成沙子躲起来。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME lures prey with its psychic powers, then zaps it. If the lured Pokémon is too big, it pretends to be sand to hide.

entry: POKENAME重攻轻守，以武艺与超能力压倒敌人，为求更强，从不停止修行。
author: daemonkill22
source: Favoring attack over defense, POKENAME uses both its fighting and psychic abilities to overwhelm its opponent. Its training never ceases as it strives to become even stronger.

entry: POKENAME重守轻攻，在战斗中谋划，追求强大。它以超能力读懂敌人，每招都以完美的反击应对。
author: daemonkill22
source: Favoring defense over attack, POKENAME aims to grow strong by strategizing during battle. It uses its psychic ability to read its opponents, reacting to their moves with the perfect counter.

entry: 随身的勺子常被咬坏，必须经常更换。会用意念抬起重物，拿到藏在下方的食物储备。
author: robosoup
source: The spoon it carries gets chewed up, and must be frequently replaced. It lifts heavy objects with its mind to get into food stores hidden beneath.

entry: 有些POKENAME会让勺子浮在空中，以免自己把它咬碎。虽然可能削弱攻击，却能锻炼精神耐力。
author: robosoup
source: Some POKENAME keep their spoons afloat, to avoid chewing them to pieces. This might weaken their attacks, but it does help them build mental stamina.

entry: POKENAME不倦地锻炼身心。精神修行让它能用超能力掰弯汤匙，身体却依旧脆弱。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME trains tirelessly to grow its physical and mental strength. Its mental training allows it to bend spoons with psychic power, but it remains physically frail.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的铲子施展超能力，能探测周围十英里范围内的水源。
author: melodydelune
source: By channeling its psychic abilities through the shovel it carries, POKENAME can detect water within a ten-mile radius of it.

entry: POKENAME振动时发出的阿尔法波，会不由自主地使人头痛，让电子设备故障。勺子甚至能反射部分攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vibrations emit alpha waves that passively induce headaches and cause malfunctions in technology. Its spoon can even reflect some attacks.

entry: 通过缎带状触角施展超能力。想养好它，就得让它好奇的头脑保持忙碌，它才会开心。
author: melodydelune
source: It channels its psychic abilities through its ribbon-like feelers. Prospective Trainers need to keep their curious minds busy to keep them happy.

entry: POKENAME用强韧的藤蔓握着两把勺子。勺上涂有特殊毒素，会让敌人病得很重。
author: cipher
source: POKENAME holds a pair of spoons in the grips of its strong vines. The spoons are coated with a special poison that can make its foe extremely ill.

entry: 大脑过度发育，让头变得又大又圆。滚动时会用超能力将自己抬离地面。
author: soup1900
source: Its brain has gotten so big that its head has become large and round. When rolling about, it uses its psychic powers to lift itself off the ground.

entry: POKENAME以庞大超能力与压倒性力量，自认已登顶峰。出手毫不留情，连踢与超能力齐发，转眼击败敌人。
author: daemonkill22
source: With massive psychic ability and overwhelming power, POKENAME believes it has become the strongest of all. It fights without mercy, defeating its opponents in moments with a flurry of kicks and a psychic barrage.

entry: POKENAME精通战术，敌人未动便已预见。强大的超能力与体力，让每次来袭都变成自己的机会。
author: daemonkill22
source: A master combat strategist, POKENAME reads its opponents' moves before they are made. It uses its immense psychic and physical power to turn every attack against it into an opportunity for itself.

entry: 背上的花苞开始绽放，届时会释放病毒毒素，再用超能力勺子将其引向敌人。
author: cipher
source: The flower bud on its back has begun to blossom. When it does, it will release a viral toxin that will be directed at foes with its psychic spoons.

entry: 虽然智商很高，却懒得变色，甚至懒得走路。不过有需要时，POKENAME可以彻底隐身。
author: t.i.a.
source: Despite its high IQ, this Pokémon is too lazy to change its colors or even walk. POKENAME, however, can become completely invisible if needed.

entry: 胡地的念力与路卡利欧的波导融合，让POKENAME的灵魂也有了实体。野生POKENAME只要不受挑衅，便不会主动攻击。
author: hypersonic06
source: The fusion of Alakazam's telekinesis and Lucario's aura lead to POKENAME's very soul gaining a physical form. Wild POKENAME do not attack unprovoked.

entry: POKENAME生来便知道过去与未来的所有灾难，被称为“末日的预兆”。
author: moginar
source: POKENAME are born with knowledge of every catastrophe, past and future. They are known as the Harbingers of Doom.

entry: 据说POKENAME背上的冰淇淋，是世上最好吃的甜点。可惜，尝过的人无一例外，都得了剧烈偏头痛。
author: patch
source: The ice cream on POKENAME's back is said to be the best-tasting dessert in the world. Unfortunately, every person who has tasted it ends up with an intense migraine.

entry: POKENAME警惕心强，又不愿沟通，因此无法测出智商。不过，小小的身体已展现出高超的超能力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's defensive attitude and lack of communication means its IQ can't be tested, but it displays psychic mastery with its diminutive form.

entry: 圆润的餐具内，蕴含着人类无法理解的智慧。简单的形态让POKENAME能完全专注于自己的能力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Within this rounded cutlery lies intelligence unfathomable to the human mind. Its simple form allows POKENAME to focus completely on its powers.

entry: 记忆力超群，连出生时的事都记得。执行任务归来的士兵发现，POKENAME依然认得自己。
author: melodydelune
source: Its superb memory lets it remember all the way up to its birth. Soldiers who have been deployed have returned to find that POKENAME remembers them.

entry: 有理论认为，它快速弯曲又复原勺子，是在向传说中的固拉多与盖欧卡发送信号。
author: vaporvenator
source: It is theorized that the rapid bending and reformation of its spoons send signals to the legendary Groudon and Kyogre.

entry: 像指挥飞行编队一样操纵勺子。勺子包围敌人，让超能力与声波攻击反复回响，威力增强。
author: pokepower
source: It directs its spoons like a flying squadron. They surround foes, allowing psychic and sonic attacks to reverberate and intensify.

entry: POKENAME的超能力已臻巅峰。它展现的神迹，令见者既敬且惧。
author: cipher
source: Having achieved the height of its psionic abilities, POKENAME is capable of feats of psychic prowess that both awe and terrify those who witness them.

entry: 超能力与结实的身体让它能吸收并反射冲击，出色的记忆力则帮助它在地下辨认方向。
author: mistershaokahn
source: Its psychic powers and sturdy body let it absorb and reflect shocks, while its exceptional memory helps it navigate underground.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直在锻炼，却依旧没多少肌肉。会把自己举得动的最大隆隆石融合体放进育儿袋，自豪地展示。
author: the_fireplace
source: Despite its near-constant training, POKENAME lacks significant muscle mass. It proudly shows off the largest Graveler fusion it can lift in its pouch.

entry: POKENAME常成群玩耍，一起练武，互相较量力气。
author: krune
source: Often playing in packs, POKENAME can be seen practising martial arts and competing in tests of strength with each other.

entry: 进化后，奔跑快得多，拳力却没有进一步增强。尾巴较弱，只用来作诱饵。
author: krune
source: Having evolved, it has a much higher running speed, but it has not further developed its punching strength. The tail just acts as a decoy and is relatively weak.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不停活动，自如切换多种武术。它最爱以踢腿为主的流派，尤其喜欢跆拳道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME remains constantly in motion during battle, switching fluidly between multiple different styles of martial arts. Its preferred fighting styles are usually those focused on kicks, Taekwondo is a particular favorite.

entry: 它是个爱练拳的小斗士，总打着池水，自豪地绷起小鳍。POKENAME随时愿意切磋，常挑战大得多的宝可梦。
author: thepandasharky
source: A little fighter that loves to practice its punches by hitting the water in ponds, flexing its tiny flippers with pride. POKENAME is always ready for a spar, often trying to fight Pokémon much bigger than itself.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME被一位拳师的灵魂附身。它常在街头，找凶暴的不法之徒打架。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be possessed by the spirit of a fist fighter. It picks fights with violent outlaws on the streets.

entry: 肌肉发达，常在冰冻苔原上组成拉雪橇的队伍。相互交缠的缎带让它们联系紧密。
author: melodydelune
source: These muscular Pokémon are often used in frozen tundras as a sled team. Interlocking their ribbons allows these Pokémon to form a tight bond.

entry: POKENAME举巨石练肌肉，可同类太像石头，常常举错。被举的POKENAME倒不在意，很乐意帮伙伴长力气。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME train their muscles by lifting up boulders. However, they often end up lifting others of their kind due to their close resemblance to rocks. POKENAME rarely minds though, since they're happy to help others build muscle.

entry: POKENAME整天锻炼上身。可下身太小，偶尔会失衡翻倒。
author: krune
source: POKENAME spends all day exercising its upper body. Its small lower body sometimes causes it to tilt over.

entry: POKENAME时速最高60公里，拳力胜过最好的拳击手。人类已懂得别惹它。尾巴却不强，只是诱饵。
author: krune
source: POKENAME can run at a top speed of 60 km/h, and its punches are stronger than those of the best boxers. Humans have learned to not anger this mighty Pokémon. The tail does not hold much strength and is simply a decoy.

entry: POKENAME爱挺着健美肌肉昂首走路，也爱在湖边砸巨石，试试力气。它骄傲自负，常在旁人面前绷紧肌肉炫耀。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME loves strutting around with a proud stance and toned muscles, it loves to test its strength by cracking boulders near lakes. It is a Pokémon with a lot of pride and ego, often seen flexing and showing off in front of others.

entry: POKENAME能轻松搬运重物，因此常参与建筑工作。工作能锻炼身体，它们很喜欢。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are often used in construction for their ability to carry heavy objects with ease. They enjoy the work due to the exercise they get from it.

entry: POKENAME看起来总在建造东西，却从未发现过它造出的建筑。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME always appears to be making something. However, no structures made by this Pokémon have been found.

entry: 会先用强壮的手臂攻击，再躲进像大内裤一样的东西下面。那其实只是蘑菇，却带着一种独特的气味。
author: robosoup
source: It attacks with powerful arms, then appears to hide under huge underpants. This is really just a mushroom, but it bears a distinctive odor.

entry: 三颗头不断互相头槌，锻炼战斗本领。中间的头会操纵另外两个头，对敌人拳打啃咬。
author: skymaster426
source: The three heads constantly headbutt one another to train for battle. The middle head uses the other two to punch and bite at opponents.

entry: 四条手臂让POKENAME更易平衡巨大的上身与小小的下身。腰带大小标明地位，较大的那条属于首领。
author: krune
source: With four arms, POKENAME can more easily balance its massive upper body against its tiny lower body. The size of its belt symbolises its place in the hierachy, with the bigger one belonging to the leader.

entry: POKENAME平时多用六肢行走，面对强敌时则以后腿站起，用强壮的手臂战斗。
author: darkweavile428
source: Though it's usually seen walking on all sixes, POKENAME will stand on its hind legs and use its powerful arms to fight against tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成灯神，却不会替人实现愿望。谁若向它许愿，就会被揍一顿，随后它便消失。
author: jokerswild
source: Though they're often mistaken for genies, POKENAME will not grant you wishes. If you try to ask for a wish, it will beat you up and then disappear.

entry: 它以惊人的力量与威势掌控战场，金属般的强鳍打出粉碎重击，举止间尽是王者的自信。
author: thepandasharky
source: This formidable warrior dominates the battlefield with its impressive strength and commanding presence. With powerful metal-like fins, it delivers crushing blows while exuding an aura of regal confidence.

entry: POKENAME缎带上肌肉的力量，是本已强健的双腿的两倍以上。一拳便能打碎钻石。
author: melodydelune
source: The muscles on the ribbons of POKENAME are over twice the strength of its already powerful legs. A single punch from POKENAME can shatter diamonds.

entry: 庞大的体形下还藏着更惊人的力量。只要有机会，POKENAME能举起整个世界的重量。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: Its colossal size harbors even greater strength. Were it given the opportunity, POKENAME could lift the weight of the entire world.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找新挑战，锻炼较小的头。各部位力量与外观不平衡，似乎让它十分苦恼。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME is constantly looking for new challenges to strengthen its smaller heads with. Imbalances in its different body parts' strength and looks seem to distress it.

entry: 曾有人看见POKENAME用毒液覆满大型船只。播放音乐能使它平静下来，跟着节拍拍手。
author: larryloud55
source: POKENAME has been seen covering large ships in poison. It is calmed when music is played, as it claps along to the beat.

entry: POKENAME用根状尾巴捕捉虫宝可梦，抓住后，POKENAME便施以强烈电击，将其制服。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME uses its root-like tail to capture bug Pokémon. Once its prey is in its grasp, POKENAME incapacitates them with a strong electric shock.

entry: POKENAME生活在大片珊瑚礁中，嘴能产生强大吸力，将从上方游过的一切直接吸入。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.

entry: POKENAME缓慢地爬过水底，用嘴吸入附近的小型宝可梦。在水中与陆地上都能生存。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME crawls slowly across the bottom and sucks up small, nearby Pokémon with its mouth. It can survive in water as well as on land.

entry: POKENAME嘴里渗出的液体能溶解铁，却溶解不了组成自身剑刃的铁。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME leaks a fluid from its mouth that can melt iron, though the iron that makes up its blade won't melt.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓缠住猎物，将其拖进满是腐蚀液的嘴里。
author: melodydelune
source: When capturing prey, POKENAME will wrap its vines around them and pull them into its mouth, which contains a corrosive fluid.

entry: 用细韧的手臂将身体固定在不稳的地形上。人们见过它攀在悬崖、高树，甚至大型草属性宝可梦身上。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its wiry arms to anchor itself in uncertain terrain. They have been found clinging to cliffs, tall trees, and even large Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: chorb33
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: chorb33
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: POKENAME用嘴产生吸力，如黑洞般吞入周围一切。谁也不知道吞下的东西最终去了哪里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction with its mouth to pull everything surrounding it in like a black hole. No one knows where the consumed material ends up.

entry: 背上形成了一个种子般的泡泡。下雨时会吸收雨滴，让泡泡长大。
author: soup1900
source: It formed a bubble on its back that looks similar to a seed. When it rains, it will soak up the raindrops to grow the bubble.

entry: POKENAME一看到飞行属性宝可梦，就会缩进壳里。会不停地吃藻类，丝毫没有停下的打算。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it spots any Flying-type Pokémon. It will endlessly eat algae, with no intention of stopping.

entry: POKENAME在生日派对上很受欢迎。可以像沙滩球一样被拍来拍去，还会一边吹泡泡，而弹跳又有助于吹出更多泡泡。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually loved at birthday parties. It can be bounced around like a beach ball while blowing bubbles, which helps it create more.

entry: POKENAME受攻击，就振翅扬沙，缩进壳里。若对方还不罢休，POKENAME便喷水反击。
author: darkweavile428
source: When attacked, POKENAME will flap its wings to kick up sand, then proceed to hide in its shell. If the attacker persists, POKENAME will fight back by squirting water.

entry: POKENAME一旦与同伴走散，就会立刻缩进壳里，直到重新找到同类，才肯出来。
author: darkweavile428
source: If a POKENAME becomes separated from its group, it will immediately withdraw into its shell and won't come out until it is reunited with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME控制不好电力，入水时常不慎电到鱼宝可梦，随后羞愧地躲进壳里。
author: darkweavile428
source: Due to its poor control over its electricity, POKENAME will often accidently shock fish Pokémon whenever it enters the water. Afterwards it will hide in its shell in shame.

entry: POKENAME的壳便于快速游泳，捕食鱼宝可梦。它又不断繁衍，定居之处的鱼群往往迅速减少。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's shell allows it to swim quickly in the water and catch fish Pokémon. Since it continuously produces offspring, the fish Pokémon population in areas where POKENAME settles quickly decrease.

entry: POKENAME栖在小树，用壳状头盔朝附近树果喷水。可POKENAME自己又讨厌沾湿，什么水域都躲着。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME perch on small trees, firing jets of water at nearby berries with its shell-like helmet. Despite this, POKENAME hates being wet and will stay away from any body of water.

entry: 背上的泡泡不知为何长成了花苞。即使将新长的叶子完全浸入水中，也不会将其淹死。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its back has somehow grown into a bud. It is able to fully submerge the leaves it grew without drowning them.

entry: 雨季常能看见POKENAME，开心地踏水洼、在雨中跳舞。孩子般的顽皮，让它们很受小学生欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are frequently seen during the rainy season, gleefully jumping in puddles and dancing in the rain. They are popular amongst school children with their child-like whimsy.

entry: 为支撑沉重的壳，POKENAME的后腿变得强健。慢悠悠的性情让它很受老人欢迎。
author: shocktopus1717
source: To support its heavy shell, POKENAME's back legs have toughened. Its slow demeanor makes it quite popular among the elderly.

entry: POKENAME被认为十分可爱。不过，训练家仍要小心，因为它还不懂得控制自己的力量。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME is considered a very cute Pokémon. However, Trainers should be cautious, as it doesn't know its own strength yet.

entry: POKENAME是一把贪玩的剑。剑刃由静止却未冻结的水构成，还能将水化作水柱射出。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a playful sword with a blade made of still but unfrozen water which it shoots out in streams.

entry: 坚硬的壳让POKENAME能借水流迅速前进。想减速时，就会将缎带卷起来。
author: melodydelune
source: The hardened shell of POKENAME allows currents to propel this Pokémon at vast speeds. It slows itself down in water by coiling its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME虽然害羞，却能与训练家建立深厚羁绊。有种迷信认为，摸摸它的六条尾巴就会带来好运。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is shy, but can form a deep bond with its Trainer. There is a superstition that touching its six tails brings good luck.

entry: POKENAME身体底部有壳，充进空气当浮具，再用尾巴划水前进。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME has a shell on the bottom of its body, which it fills with air and uses as a flotation device. It then uses its tail as a paddle to move through the water.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时，会竖起并蓬松所有尾巴，威吓对手。趁对方分神，通常就会逃走。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME is attacked, it raises its many tails and puffs them up to intimidate its opponent. If the opponent is distracted, it usually flees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在浅滩自保。若被踩到，便会张开大嘴，喷出强劲水流反击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME like to hide on shallow beaches for protection. If stepped on, they will retaliate with a large blast of water from their gaping maw.

entry: 尾巴上的泡泡已变得不易破裂。手指能射出滚烫气泡，碰到皮肤就会严重灼伤。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its tail has grown resistant to popping. It fires scorching hot bubbles from its fingers that badly singe the skin on contact.

entry: 它朝壳喷水，便能快速转起来，甚至在池面弹跳。POKENAME觉得有趣，还会比试谁去得最远。
author: frokachu
source: By shooting water at its shell, it can begin to spin quickly and even skip along the ponds it resides in. POKENAME do this for fun, and challenge others to see who can go the farthest.

entry: POKENAME以小队共同生活，彼此极为忠诚。曾有报告称，它们会在猛烈的火灾中协助消防员。
author: kames
source: Known to live in squads, POKENAME are incredibly loyal to each other. POKENAME are reported to help firefighters during scorching fires.

entry: 五只时髦的杰尼龟，因热爱墨镜而聚在一起。即使战斗，也会优先保护墨镜。
author: fr34kuency
source: A quintet of stylish Squirtle held together by their love for sunglasses. During battle, they prioritize the safety of their sunglasses.

entry: POKENAME既没普通卡咪龟的耳朵，也没那条大尾巴，游泳常失去平衡。因此，再次进化前，训练家通常不带它去宽阔水域。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often has a hard time balancing itself while swimming due to the lack of ears and the big tail a normal Wartortle would have. As such, Trainers often avoid bringing this Pokémon to large bodies of water until it evolves again.

entry: POKENAME靠水压从炮管里射出杰尼龟，让它们能在平时够不到的高处灭火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses water pressure to fire Squirtle from its cannons. This allows the Squirtle to put out fires in high places they normally cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME会把脸埋进枝叶里自卫。电力由叶子的光合作用产生。
author: melodydelune
source: As a self-defense mechanism, POKENAME will bury its face into its leafage. Its electricity is produced by the photosynthesis of its leaves.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带的河流附近，能像投石器般射出强酸，分解任何物质。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in tropical areas near rivers. It can shoot incredibly strong acid like a catapult, which can decompose any material.

entry: 长长的脖子能让头朝向不同角度，将酸液射到数公里外，误差仅几米。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its long neck, it can orient its head at different angles to shoot acid over several kilometers with an accuracy of just a few meters.

entry: 藤蔓像刀具，会切开大得无法入口的食物。分泌的液体能溶解一切接触到的东西。
author: melodydelune
