source: Its vines act as cutters to slice food too large to pull into its mouth. The fluids it produces dissolve anything it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME通常躺着不动，被当成普通植物。自身毒素不断让它们头昏、困倦。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME are usually found lying still and often mistaken for regular plants. They are constantly disoriented and drowsy from their own toxins.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑浊的热带河流中，从水下伏击猎物。旱季则爬到树冠，从上方狩猎。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME lives in murky tropical rivers, ambushing prey from below. During the dry season, it ascends to the canopy and hunts prey from above.

entry: POKENAME觅食时倒飞，方便捞起猎物。可猎得太久，自己也会头晕。
author: frokachu
source: When locating prey, POKENAME fly upside down to better scoop them up. When hunting for too long, they end up getting dizzy.

entry: 这次融合反而让它更笨了。大食花似乎无法好好代替大舌贝。
author: dodoowner_
source: Fusion, in this case, has made the fusion more dumb. Victreebel doesn't seem to work as a replacement for Shellder.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的液体香甜且极黏。饥饿时，会将其涂在树上，把树变成捕虫陷阱。
author: mykoloth
source: The fluid on POKENAME's tail has a sweet aroma and is incredibly sticky. When hungry, it marks trees with it, turning them into insect traps.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，等下一位受害者。一旦开始吞咽，胃酸几乎无物不溶，再挣扎也逃不掉。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME hangs on trees, awaiting its next victim. Once it starts swallowing, its stomach acid dissolves almost anything; attempting escape is futile.

entry: 叶片上的霜能保护POKENAME，减少战斗中的损伤。天气温暖时，便会开始枯萎。
author: ohok3441
source: The frost on POKENAME's leaves protects it from damage in battle. It will begin wilting in warm weather.

entry: 用尾巴上的毒树果引诱猎物。POKENAME平时没有饰品，但训练家们开始在冬季为它装扮。
author: ohok3441
source: It uses the poisonous Berries on its tail to lure in prey. POKENAME normally lacks accessories, but Trainers have begun decorating it during winter.

entry: POKENAME出手极准，锐利的鞭状尾巴刺向敌人弱处，从不落空。
author: easpordz
source: A POKENAME is extremely accurate with its strikes. With its sharp whip-like tail, it pierces any weak point of its target without fail.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: 用蜂蜜的甜香引来猎物，再猛扑上去。会将猎物整只吞下，用强酸溶解。
author: melodydelune
source: It lures its prey in with the sweet smell of honey and then pounces on them. They swallow their prey whole and dissolve it in their strong acids.

entry: 融合赋予了它速度与敏捷，成为可怕的猎手。捕到猎物后，会用颈部的爪子拖进嘴里。
author: pizzarcato
source: Fusion has given it the speed and agility to become a fearsome hunter. When it catches prey, it drags them into its mouth using the claws on its neck.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴遮着嘴，沿河漂流。香甜的唾液会将小型宝可梦诱进巨口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME float along rivers covering its mouth with its tail. It lures smaller Pokémon into its gaping maw with its sweet, scented saliva.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的开口散发出难以抗拒的香气。猎物一靠近，就会施展强大的黑暗魔法，将其击倒。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sprays an irresistible scent from the opening on its head. If prey gets too close, it unleashes powerful dark magic to strike them down.

entry: 一只玛瑙水母控制了超梦，形成POKENAME。超能力惊人，却不知为何比普通超梦更加阴险。
author: krune
source: A Tentacool that has taken control over a Mewtwo, POKENAME has amazing psychic abilities but is somehow more sinister than a regular Mewtwo.

entry: POKENAME有两个大脑，或许还有两份意识。哪一方主导，科学家也不清楚。
author: krune
source: POKENAME has two brains and possibly two minds. Scientists are unsure which one is the dominant mind.

entry: 燃烧的触手能灼烧金属，穿过木头更是轻而易举。即使在水下，火焰也依旧明亮。
author: krune
source: Its flaming tentacles can singe metal and phase through wood like butter. Its fire burns brightly, even underwater.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧的触手灼伤敌人，使其失去行动能力。额头的水晶即使被取下，也保留着元素性质。
author: krune
source: POKENAME uses flaming tentacles to sear foes, leaving them incapacitated. The crystal on its forehead holds elemental properties, even when removed.

entry: POKENAME有些笨拙，待在海面附近，浅潜捕猎。鼓起的头能当浮具，还能膨胀，迅速浮出水面，或吓唬来敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A somewhat clumsy aquatic Pokémon, POKENAME stays near the sea's surface and performs shallow dives for its prey. Its bulbous head acts as a float and can expand to rapidly surface or intimidate threats.

entry: 野生POKENAME藏在海底岩群，几乎难以察觉。它只有一对触手与弱酸，总缩在壳里，等待养分或小猎物靠近孔口。
author: lutrax
source: A wild POKENAME is hardly noticed among rock formations under the sea. Since it only has a pair of tentacles and weak acid, it stays hidden within its shell at all times, waiting for any nutrients or smaller prey to approach its holes.

entry: 它喷出背部红腺中储藏的酸水。曾有渔船想捕捉它，结果船壳被蚀出了洞。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It shoots jets of acidic water stored in the red gland on its back. Fishing boats that dared try to catch it have been found with holes in their hull.

entry: POKENAME伸出触手般的护手，缠住目标，再将坚硬的带毒水刃刺入对方体内。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME clings to its target by reaching out with its tentacle-like guard. It then plunges its poisonous, hard water blade into its victim.

entry: POKENAME体内装的不是内脏系统，而是水。腹部宝石能放出安抚的能量，连盛怒者也能平静。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's body is filled with water rather than internal systems. The gem on its belly lets it release a calming energy that can soothe even the most enraged.

entry: 这只喵喵正被玛瑙水母控制心智，外形会随受控时间长短而变化。
author: krune
source: This Meowth is being mind-controlled by a Tentacool. Its shape depends on how long the Tentacool has controlled it.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在海面上方，用触手抓取小鱼宝可梦。尽管如此，从未有人观察到它吃东西。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME floats above the ocean to grab small fish Pokémon with its tentacles. Despite this, it has never been observed eating anything.

entry: 它掌握庞大的超能力，用以自卫。传说，只需一个念头，就能掀起巨大海啸。
author: schwaus
source: It controls an immense amount of psychic energy, which it uses to protect itself. Legends say it can cause massive tsunamis with a single thought.

entry: POKENAME完美藏进彩色珊瑚，悄悄观察四周。猎物一近，POKENAME便从每个壳孔伸出触手，迅速捉住，以强酸溶化。
author: lutrax
source: POKENAME perfectly camouflages itself amongst colourful corals, silently scanning its surroundings unnoticed. When prey draw near, POKENAME releases tentacles from every hole in its shell to quickly grab and melt them using a powerful acid.

entry: POKENAME有80根触手，能仔细除草、照料植物，也会攻击任何想砍树的人。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME has 80 tentacles, which it uses to carefully tend to plants by weeding them. They are also used to attack anyone who tries to fell a tree.

entry: POKENAME背上的红色球体内养着微型生态缸。80条触手卷成简单的腿，让它能在陆地行走。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME keeps a miniature terrarium within the red orbs on its back. Its 80 tentacles coil into rudimentary legs, allowing it to walk on land.

entry: POKENAME有80条触手。还没人能在被凶狠的剑刃刺穿之前，挣脱其中一条以上。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: No person has freed themself from more than one of POKENAME's 80 tentacles before being skewered on its brutal blade.

entry: 组成进化前形态的三只宝可梦融合在一起，形成了一只巨大的水母宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: The three Pokémon that make up its pre-evolution have fused together, creating one large jellyfish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会在被丢进海里的容器和箱子中安家。它能弹射出众多触手捕捉猎物。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME makes its home in containers and boxes dumped into the ocean. It will catch its prey by launching its many tentacles.

entry: POKENAME是从最深海渊被放逐的隐者。歌声满是骗人的许诺，被引去的人，鲜有好下场。
author: galactakiller
source: POKENAME is a recluse, exiled from the deepest depths. Its songs are full of deceiving promises, and getting lured by it rarely ends well.

entry: POKENAME身体厚重，无法飞行，转而用强壮的手臂攀上悬崖与树木。
author: schierke
source: Due to its robust body, POKENAME is unable to fly. Instead, it uses its strong arms to pull itself up cliffs and trees.

entry: POKENAME的毛粗糙如砂纸。挤在一起睡觉时，经常被误认成小片岩石。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME's fur is rough like sandpaper. When they sleep huddled together, they often are mistaken for small rock formations.

entry: 皮肤坚如岩石，少有天敌。越是年老，砖块般的纹样越粗糙模糊，最后与普通石头无异。
author: staghorn
source: It has few predators thanks to its rock-hard hide. As it grows older, the brick-shaped pattern on its skin grows rougher and loses definition until it's indistinguishable from stone.

entry: POKENAME交替使用手臂和镐攀山。广为流传的传说称，它被一位死去矮人的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Alternating between arm and pick, POKENAME scales mountains. Popular legend says it is possessed by the spirit of a deceased dwarf.

entry: 野生POKENAME会互相冲撞，较量谁的身体最坚固。胜出者便成为族群首领。
author: melodydelune
source: In nature, packs of POKENAME will tackle each other to prove whose body is sturdiest. The one that comes out on top becomes the leader of the pack.

entry: POKENAME用耳朵最多能扛起25吨的重量。看着凶，内心却十分善良。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to carry up to 25 tons of weight using their ears. It looks mean, but it has a heart of gold.

entry: 据说古人会把成群POKENAME推下山坡，下注比快，作为娱乐。如今，POKENAME仍以速度自豪，只有修补体裂时才慢下来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is believed that in ancient times, people would roll groups of POKENAME down hills for entertainment, placing bets on which is faster. To this day, POKENAME pride themselves on their speed, only slowing down to mend the cracks in their bodies.

entry: POKENAME用双臂保持平衡、调整方向，施展强踢。伸长的四肢也能助它攀崖，一脚就能碎岩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME primarily use their arms to balance and direct themselves while performing powerful kicks. They extend their limbs to help them scale cliffs, kicking hard enough to shatter rock.

entry: POKENAME能让拳套硬得超过岩石。它们仔细击开洞壁，开辟新道，救出塌方中受困的人与宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to harden the gloves on their fists to be harder than rock. They carefully punch out sections of cave walls to create new tunnels and free people or Pokémon from cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME舌头极敏感，甚至得包进石中保护。每只POKENAME选的石料不同，方便品尝各自喜爱的矿物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tongues of POKENAME are very sensitive, to the point where they encase them in rocks for protection. Different POKENAME use different types of rocks in this process to enjoy their favorite minerals.

entry: POKENAME难以靠鼓胀离地，便改用吃下的岩石分解出的粉尘喷射推进，让自己悬空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME struggle to inflate themselves enough to lift off the ground. They instead release dust broken down from the rocks they eat to act as propulsion to suspend themselves in the air.

entry: POKENAME大吃矿物丰富的食物，维持岩石身躯。常睡在山顶，有时梦中就滚下山去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME gorges on mineral-rich foods to maintain its rocky composition. It sleeps on the top of mountains, sometimes tumbling down in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME以钩爪扎进崖壁，迅速轻松地攀山。它们滑翔在崖边，尾巴缓摇，等着挖出矿石充饥。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their claws as hooks to dig into the sides of cliffs, quickly and effortlessly scaling mountainsides. They glide around the cliffside with their tails swaying slowly, waiting to dig up ore deposits for their meals.

entry: POKENAME形成于温泉附近的岩层。随着成长与战斗，岩石外层逐渐剥落，显露出内部的宝石。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME forms in rock deposits near hot springs. As it ages and battles, its rocky outer layer crumbles away, revealing the gemstone underneath.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近，用背臂收集熔岩，制成铠甲。它们生性爱玩，跳进岩浆扑腾，仿佛只是在玩水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live near volcanoes where they use the arms on their backs to gather molten rocks to make into armor. They're rather playful by nature, leaping and splashing around lava as if it was water.

entry: 双臂能投巨石、投敌人，也能投自己，这正是它最爱的出行方式。可巨石做的外鞘，让落地总不太优雅。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its arms can hurl boulders, opponents, or itself; its preferred mode of travel. The boulders it sheaths into ensure its landings are not graceful.

entry: 为了维持庞大结实的身体，它每天最多要吃一吨岩石。它似乎最喜欢那些长满苔藓的石头。
author: melodydelune
source: To maintain its bulk and sturdy body, it will eat up to a ton of rocks on a daily basis. Its favorite rocks seem to be those covered in moss.

entry: POKENAME用大牙磨碎岩石，取出其中矿物。飞行时撒下剩余石粉，迷住敌人与领地入侵者的双眼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large teeth to break through rocks in order to grind them into dust and gather minerals from within. They scatter the leftover dust as they fly, blinding opponents or intruders to their territory.

entry: POKENAME用搜集的矿物制作汤匙，集中超能力。主要借此比较各种矿物，探查周围洞穴的构成。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion spoons out of minerals they gather in order to focus their psychic powers. They primarily use these powers to compare various minerals and see the composition of caves around them.

entry: POKENAME常被当成普通隆隆石，主要区别却是没有脚。新长的第二对手臂，总垂在身旁，仿佛连自己也没发现。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Commonly mistaken for regular Graveler, the main distinction of a POKENAME is its lack of feet. It almost always keeps its newly developed second pair of arms by its side, as if it doesn't even realize it has them.

entry: POKENAME进化前，会拢来石头保护身体。常犹豫该用哪对手臂，好像正在决定更喜欢哪一双。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather rocks around themselves to protect their bodies as they prepare for evolution. They often seem confused on which set of arms to use, as if trying to decide which one they prefer.

entry: POKENAME虽有磁力，却更爱把磁铁当钝锤。它们高速原地转动，反复敲打敌人，还用磁力来回拉扯。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their magnetic powers, POKENAME prefer to use the magnets they carry as blunt maces. They rapidly spin in place, smacking their opponents repeatedly while pulling them back and forth with their magnets.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下洞窟底部的岩石，只为补充筑巢石料才出来。它们捏碎石头，将粉尘撒进水中，让矿物帮助生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Burrowing into rocks at the bottom of underground caves, POKENAME only surface to gather more rocks for their shelters. They crush rocks into dust in their grip then release the dust into the water to fill it with minerals that will help them grow.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: 在矿井深处发现的神秘宝可梦。几乎一动不动，但有些训练家坚称，听过POKENAME核心传来铃声。
author: fenragon
source: This enigmatic Pokémon was found deep within a mine. It is largely inert, but some Trainers swear they can hear chimes coming from POKENAME's core.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: 科学家开发POKENAME，为山区施肥、收割庄稼。一些无法驯服的个体却逃了出去，如今正破坏当地生态。
author: leviath
source: Scientists developed POKENAME for fertilizing and crop harvesting in mountainous regions. Some untamable specimens managed to set themselves free and now cause havoc in local ecosystems.

entry: 它披上能找到的最好岩石，如穿王者礼服。换下的石头，则会送给一个幼崽。
author: staghorn
source: It clads itself in the highest-quality rocks it can find, wearing them like royal regalia. When it replaces a rock, it gifts the rock being replaced to one of its young.

entry: POKENAME会开采并藏起能找到的最坚硬的石头，当作武器。人类无论用什么手持工具，都无法将其敲裂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mines and stashes the toughest stones it can find to use as weapons. These stones can't be cracked by humans with any handheld equipment.

entry: POKENAME翻碎整山，寻找最硬的岩石，重建石质鳞片。暴走时，会如陨石般俯冲砸地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shred through entire mountains looking for the toughest rocks to rebuild their rock-like scales. In a rampage, they will divebomb into the ground with the force of a meteorite.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮会硬化、崩碎，成为富含养分的土壤，帮助植物生长，因此很受园丁欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are popular among gardeners for their shedded skin, which hardens and crumbles, becoming a nutrient-rich soil for plant growth.

entry: POKENAME偏爱海底火山喷口，很少接近表层。一旦现身，或许就是洪水来临的预兆。
author: kitarchen
source: It is rare to see POKENAME near the surface as they prefer to reside near underwater volcanic vents. If seen, it could be an early sign of a flood coming.

entry: POKENAME身上的尖刺，由软玉构成。它用坚实的身体凿开洞穴，吃下里面的矿物，帮助POKENAME的尖刺生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spines along a POKENAME's body are composed of nephrite jade. POKENAME will use their sturdy bodies to carve out spots to burrow within caves, eating the minerals inside to help grow their spines.

entry: POKENAME浮在浅水，用带电触手麻痹猎物。大风暴后，海滩上常能见到成群POKENAME被冲上岸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in shallow waters, using its electrified tentacles to paralyze its prey. Schools of POKENAME can be seen washed up on the beach after large storms.

entry: 走到哪里，哪里就能感到震动与降温。岩石般的鳞片摸起来冰冷。
author: houndrys.
source: Wherever this Pokémon walks, a quake can be felt, along with a drop in temperature. Its rocky scales are cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME被送进太空后，便会变成这副形态。POKENAME身上形成的行星，似乎可以居住。
author: rkmaster25367
source: When POKENAME is propelled into space, it assumes this form. The planet formed on POKENAME's body appears habitable.

entry: 会嵌进岩石地面，咬住踩到它的对象。三颗头很少能达成一致。
author: kittyluv090
source: It embeds itself into rocky terrain and bites those who step on it. Its three heads rarely agree on anything.

entry: 巨石身体与三个头虽重，POKENAME仍能快得危险。可一旦太快，就可能绊倒，挟巨大破坏力滚撞四周。
author: sontyp
source: Despite the weight of its boulder-like body and three heads, POKENAME can become dangerously fast. Once it accumulates too much speed, however, it may stumble and roll into its surroundings with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME将树果储存在体内，定期烘烤。过程中产生的含酒精蒸馏液，能用于酿制各种酒。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stores Berries in its body, which it regularly roasts. The process produces an alcoholic distillate that is used for various liquors.

entry: 它们在草原挖出精巧的洞穴。干季却可能引起野火，扰乱环境。
author: schwaus
source: They create elaborate burrows in grasslands. During dry seasons they have been known to disrupt the environment by causing wildfires.

entry: POKENAME以臂与头上的火焰自卫，在敌人眼前晃动，分散注意。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME use the fire growing on their arms and head to defend themselves, flashing it into any attackers' eyes to distract them.

entry: 一台烈焰机器。POKENAME用推进器手臂加速，速度能远远超过飞机。
author: rkmaster2637
source: A fiery machine. POKENAME can accelerate to speeds far beyond planes with its thruster arms.

entry: 它常被当作儿童玩具。谁握着缰绳，都能像骑真小马般骑行，但也得先与它建立感情。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Often mistaken for a kids' toy, anyone who holds its reins can ride it like a real pony, but similarly must develop a relationship with it first.

entry: 火焰既用于攻击，也用于撤退。它会借喷火的反作用力，将自己推出战场。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its flames double as both a method of attack and an exit strategy, launching itself away from battle with expulsion force from its flames.

entry: POKENAME跳得高、跑得快，是出色的放牧帮手。唯有它信任的人，触碰鬃毛时才不会被灼伤。
author: melodydelune
source: Due to their high jumping and fast running, POKENAME are excellent herding Pokémon. Only those it trusts can touch its mane without burning.

entry: POKENAME以善跑闻名，只有自己的进化形能胜过它。飞奔而过时，火焰令人惊叹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are famous for being amazing runners, only being beaten out by its evolution. Its flames are astonishing as it zips past you.

entry: 壳内烈火将其加热至高炉般的温度，因此POKENAME很受陶艺家欢迎，常成为他们的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: The fires that rage in its shell heat it up to the temperature of a blast furnace. This makes POKENAME a popular partner Pokémon for potters.

entry: POKENAME难以控制熊熊烈火，因此常独自待在远离人类和宝可梦的地方。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME struggles to contain its blazing flames. Because of this, it is often found secluded away from both people and Pokémon.

entry: 身体不断燃烧，身后留下厚厚的灰烬。同时又再生得极快，让火焰永不熄灭。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is constantly burning, leaving a thick trail of ash behind it. At the same time, its body regenerates so quickly that it never goes out.

entry: POKENAME常出现在山火现场附近，有理论认为许多山火正是它们造成的。不过，火灾也为新生命的繁盛腾出了空间。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are often seen near the site of bushfires, and theorized to cause many of them. However, these fires clear the way for new life to flourish.

entry: POKENAME奔过开阔平原，沿途留下一道火痕。燃烧的鬃毛，正象征着它不屈的斗志，与战场上无可比拟的敏捷。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME runs across open plains, leaving flaming trails in its wake. Its fiery mane symbolizes its unwavering spirit and unmatched agility in battle.

entry: 身体虽沉重，记录中的最高时速仍达45英里。金属长年受火烧灼，逐渐变得能够吸热。
author: houndrys.
source: Despite its heavy body, it's been recorded to reach a top speed of 45 mph. The constant fire on the metals have made them heat absorbant.

entry: POKENAME极为懒惰，常睡在田野里。遭到攻击就起身跑到别处，继续休息。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is extremely lazy, so it's seen sleeping in the fields. When attacked, it gets up and runs away to a place where it can continue to rest.

entry: POKENAME群体中跑得最快的一只就是首领。它们争强好胜，谁看起来比自己快，就要和谁赛跑。
author: melodydelune
source: In herds of POKENAME, the fastest runner is the leader of the herd. They are very competitive and will race anything that they see as faster.

entry: 会与其他POKENAME比谁挖的陷坑最多。又会在坑之间飞奔，赶在掉进去的猎物逃脱前将其抓住。
author: soup1900
source: It races other POKENAME to see who can dig the most pit traps. It races from pit to pit to catch any prey that has fallen in before they can escape.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“水雷”，渔民将它钓起时就会爆炸。即使老练的钓手，也不敢在它的栖息地大意垂钓。
author: melodydelune
source: Often called "The Sea Mine," POKENAME is known to explode when reeled in by fishermen. Even veteran anglers are cautious about fishing in its habitat.

entry: 体内气体会让POKENAME麻木、懒散，却也常被用作医疗程序中优良的麻醉剂。
author: mistymagius
source: It produces a gas from inside its body that causes POKENAME to become numb and lethargic. The gas is commonly used as an excellent anesthetic for medical procedures.

entry: POKENAME大半生都在饱餐后休眠。毒唾液碰到什么都能伤害，借此吓退天敌。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives in a post-meal hibernation. They deter predators by secreting a toxic drool that causes harm to anything that touches it.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是一道美味。它们常因想吃自己的尾巴而将其咬断，也是当地动作最慢的宝可梦之一。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME tails are a delicacy. They are known to dock their own tails by trying to eat them and are named one of the region's slowest Pokémon.

entry: 很多人说POKENAME不太聪明。不过，也有报告称，曾见它使用简单工具获取食物。
author: kitarchen
source: Many have claimed that POKENAME are not very smart. However, reports have been made of POKENAME being spotted using basic tools to acquire food.

entry: POKENAME懒又不聪明，曾被见到不去找食物，反吃自己尾巴。好在肢体能完全再生，不会留下长久的伤害。
author: sontyp
source: Lazy and not terribly intelligent, POKENAME have been observed trying to eat their own tails instead of gathering food. Since their limbs regenerate fully, there is no lasting damage from this behavior.

entry: 用众多缎带状触角捕鱼。触角即使断掉也会很快再生，POKENAME并不会感到疼痛。
author: melodydelune
source: It uses its multitude of ribbonlike feelers to fish. If their ribbons break off, they will regrow quickly, and POKENAME will feel no pain.

entry: 它把多条尾巴垂进水中钓猎，常能见到POKENAME身上同时挂着好几份收获。
author: holgast
source: It dangles its many tails into the water to catch prey. It's not uncommon to see a POKENAME with several catches hanging from it.

entry: 背甲顶部向上隆起，形成一个孔洞，看起来像洋葱。能从洞里喷出间歇泉般的水柱。
author: soup1900
source: The top of its shell rises upwards and forms a hole on top, causing it to resemble an onion. It can eject water from that hole like a geyser.

entry: POKENAME白鬃由超热蒸汽构成，一碰就会造成二度烫伤。精巧的耳朵，还能感知气压与湿度变化。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME white mane is made of super-hot water vapor that will cause second-degree burns on contact. Its delicate ears are able to sense differences in air pressure and humidity.

entry: POKENAME的花苞能像间歇泉一样喷水。其他宝可梦常会跑到下面冲凉，就像夏日里在洒水器下嬉戏。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's bulb is known to work like a geyser. Other Pokémon are known to run under it, like a sprinkler on a summer day.

entry: POKENAME一怒，角中就喷出猛烈的污水。水含剧毒，哪怕只碰到皮肤也危险。
author: roundabout_robin
source: When angered, POKENAME's horn releases a strong torrent of tainted water. This water is horribly poisonous, and can prove dangerous even with simple contact with skin.

entry: POKENAME经常清洁、打理毛发。通常不会战斗，除非对手“攻击”了它的毛。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME are often seen cleaning and maintaining their fur. They do not usually engage in battle unless their fur has been "attacked" by the opponent.

entry: 常在海底悠闲休息。它的背上住着许多宝可梦，因为弱小的宝可梦在它身边很有安全感。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's seen lazing around on the ocean floor. Its back is home to many Pokémon, as weak Pokémon feel protected with it around.

entry: POKENAME是一把优雅的剑，战斗时轻旋回舞。喜欢与看起来强悍的对手决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is an elegant blade that twirls and spins in combat. It enjoys dueling tough-looking opponents.

entry: 在水中以尾巴为舵，用耳朵辨别水流方向。
author: melodydelune
source: It uses its tail in water to act as a rudder and its ears to detect the directions of currents.

entry: POKENAME越年长，六条尾巴的颜色就越深。游泳时还能卷起再松开尾巴，得到一点推力。
author: chorb33
source: The older POKENAME gets, the darker its six tails become. It can also wind and release them while swimming to get a little boost.

entry: POKENAME往壳里充气浮海，用尾巴与耳羽作帆。自己力气不够游动，便随风而行。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME floats on the ocean by filling its shell with air. It uses its tail and ear plumes as sails. It lacks enough power to swim on its own, so it follows the winds.

entry: 据说POKENAME能活数千年，因此象征健康，常被用作纹章图案。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is said to be able to live for several thousand years. For this reason, it symbolizes health and is a popular motif for coats of arms.

entry: 进化后，性子认真了。仍像先前那样，能向壳喷水，在水上弹跳，却只在必要时才用。
author: frokachu
source: It developed a more serious attitude after evolving. Like its previous form, it can skip along water by shooting water at its shell but does so only when necessary.

entry: 壳里留着大块空腔，可收进尾巴。尾巴如螺旋桨转动，就能将自己推进出去。
author: frokachu
source: Its shell has a large empty area for its tail to go into. It can launch itself by spinning its tail like a propeller.

entry: POKENAME头上的盔甲，像古代人形生物化石中见过的头盔，让它拥有惊人的速度与敏捷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: The helmet on POKENAME's head resembles a helmet seen in an ancient humanoid fossil. It grants POKENAME immense speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME脑活动极低，有时会不慎电到自己，也似乎没察觉耳边有生物在啃咬。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME has very low brain activity, sometimes shocking itself on accident. It doesn't seem to be aware of the creature nibbling on its ear.

entry: POKENAME脑袋空空，却有着非凡的超能力。战斗时，它会把尾巴当鱼雷射出去，再用念力指引方向。
author: teatedtiten
source: With not a thought in its mind, POKENAME still possesses remarkable psychic energy. As means of attack, POKENAME shoots their tail like a torpedo and directs it using its powers.

entry: 偶尔啃啃甜甜圈般的尾巴，却不真正吃下什么，令博士们想不通它如何获取养分。
author: teatedtiten
source: It occasionally nibbles on its donut-like tail, though does not consume anything.  Because of this, professors are stumped as to how it gains nutrients.

entry: POKENAME若失去大舌贝，只会留下原本惊人智力的一小部分。即便如此，仍比多数宝可梦聪明得多。
author: staghorn
source: When a POKENAME loses its Shellder, it retains only a fraction of its great intelligence. Even so, it is far smarter than most other Pokémon.

entry: 尾巴自有意识，会咬POKENAME的尾巴，指挥前进方向。它常吃角金鱼与莲叶童子。
author: schwaus
source: Its tail has a mind of its own, biting POKENAME's tail to change its direction. It often feasts on Goldeen and Lotad.

entry: 附在下身的大舌贝，极大改善POKENAME的平衡与动作，连科学家也怀疑，究竟谁在指挥谁。游泳的POKENAME曾被误认成人鱼。
author: sontyp
source: The Shellder attached to a POKENAME's lower body increases its balance and motor skills so drastically that scientists speculate which of the two is actually in charge. Swimming POKENAME have been mistaken for mermaids in the past.

entry: 有些呆呆兽迟钝到身上长出了藤蔓。大舌贝咬住尾巴时，身体仍会发生同样的反应，变成POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Some Slowpoke are so sedate, vines grow on them. Their body still reacts in the same way when a Shellder bites their tail, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: 视力差，脑筋又不灵，让POKENAME几乎总在迷糊。它们常跌进河，成群顺流漂走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost always confused, due to its lack of sight and underwhelming intelligence. They will often fall into rivers and groups of POKENAME can be seen floating downstream.

entry: POKENAME平时动作迟缓，但尾巴上的大舌贝一咬紧，就会让它肾上腺素骤增，行动比平时更快。
author: melodydelune
source: Though usually slow, if the Shellder on POKENAME's tail bites down they will gain a burst of adrenaline to act faster than normal.

entry: 附在POKENAME身上的大舌贝总是欣喜陶醉，因为它吸食的甜汁不是来自一条尾巴，而是整整三条。
author: gp423
source: The Shellder attached to POKENAME is in a constant state of euphoria. This is because it is ingesting the sweet ooze from not one but three tails.

entry: POKENAME尾焰自有意识，会烧本体，催它活动。本体虽然痛，却依然对战斗没多大兴趣。
author: mistymagius
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail has a mind of its own, which will try to burn the main body to get it moving. Despite being in a lot of pain, the main body isn't that interested in combat.

entry: 大舌贝一直受POKENAME的火焰烧灼，却凭着一股倔劲死不松口，硬是忍了下来。
author: rakanadyo
source: Shellder is constantly burned by POKENAME's flame. However, it hangs on and endures through sheer stubbornness.

entry: POKENAME以磁铁辨方向，游荡工厂之间，寻找创造自己的设计师——它的“母亲”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Using its magnet to navigate, POKENAME wanders factory to factory in search for its "mother", the designer who created it.

entry: 它借身体的磁极相斥踢腿。若没踢好，四肢反会相互吸住，动弹不得。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its polarized body to throw kicks via magnetic repulsion. If it flubs a kick, its limbs will attract to each other, leaving it helpless.

entry: POKENAME太重，非得靠磁力才飞得起来。幼年POKENAME还没练熟，有时会跌出巢，得小心送回安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are too heavy to fly without magnetic powers. Sometimes, young POKENAME that haven't mastered magnetism are found fallen from their nests and should be carefully returned to safety.

entry: POKENAME爱往城里聚，沿电线筑巢。数量一多，集中磁场就干扰电流，造成城市停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to urban areas, often nesting along powerlines. Large populations can cause blackouts in cities as the concentrated magnetic fields disrupt the flow of electricity.

entry: 巨大的磁铁剑刃能吸来数英尺外的金属。吸力极强，会将金属宝可梦和披甲者拉来刺穿。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its large magnet blade can attract metal to it from several feet away. The pull is so strong, it skewers metal Pokémon and those wearing armor.

entry: 组成身体的铁球如电池，储存着多余电力。最爱的食物包括电池和冰箱贴。
author: melodydelune
source: The iron balls that make up its body act as batteries to store its excess power. Their favorite foods include batteries and fridge magnets.

entry: 头上的叶子其实是条状锂箔。沾水后会剧烈反应，释放出危险的大量能量。
author: gp423
source: The leaves on its head are actually strips of lithium foil. If exposed to water, these leaves react violently and release dangerous amounts of energy.

entry: POKENAME以磁爪抓住彼此。空旷田野上，常能看见环成圈的POKENAME，试着产生电力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME clings to each other using their magnetic claws. Rings of POKENAME can be seen in open fields trying to generate electrical power.

entry: 生活在海中的奇异金属宝可梦。会用磁铁吸住船只，借船快速移动。
author: theheroict
source: A strange, metallic Pokémon that can be found under the waves. It uses magnets to hang on to ships for quick transport.

entry: POKENAME的黏液身体带磁性，能慢慢沿金属物体向上爬。若不慎吸来别的东西，就会用磁铁将其斥开。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's slimy body is magnetic, allowing it to slowly move up metal objects. Its magnets repel any objects it inadvertently attracts.

entry: 磁性黏液难以穿透，因此POKENAME遇险时会用它包住眼睛。常见于废料场或工厂。
author: chorb33
source: Its magnetic slime is difficult to penetrate, allowing POKENAME to encase its eye if in danger. It is often found in scrap yards or factories.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在发电厂吸电，还用磁爪收集废金属，拿作剑矛等武器。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME gather around power plants to siphon off their electricity. They use their magnetic claws to collect scrap metal to use as a form of weaponry such as swords or spears.

entry: 这些宝可梦生来就是手足，如今形影不离。飞行、吃饭，连睡觉都在一起。
author: dodoowner_
source: These Pokémon were born as siblings and are now inseparable. They fly together, eat together, and even sleep together.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，建巢高效，能留更多时间育幼。可偏爱用电线做材料，数量多的城市因此大受困扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With three heads, POKENAME are efficient at constructing dwellings and can devote more time to raising their young. Unfortunately, their preferred building material is electrical wire, causing major issues in cities where they are abundant.

entry: 被另外三只同类吸引过去后，POKENAME发生了进化。背上虽顶着灯泡，脑袋可没因此变得更“亮”。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME evolved because it got pulled towards three others of its kind. Even with the lightbulb on their backs, they aren't very bright.

entry: 身体部件形状不规则，让POKENAME不停旋转。转动造成的晕动症常令它头昏眼花。
author: staghorn
source: The irregular shape of POKENAME's body components means it is constantly spinning. They are often dazed due to the resulting motion sickness.

entry: POKENAME就像有意识的搭电线，会夹住想充电的东西，再用尾巴从附近物体抽取电力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Acting as a sort of sentient jumper cable, POKENAME clamp onto things they want charged and use their tail to drain power from objects nearby.

entry: 野生POKENAME捉弄其他宝可梦的视频，因顽皮天性而在网上走红。不知为何，它们尤其爱拿电属性宝可梦开玩笑。
author: klgb76
source: Because of their mischievous nature, videos of wild POKENAME pranking other Pokémons became very popular on the internet. For some unknown reason, it seems Electric-type Pokémons are their favourite victims.

entry: POKENAME长得像帕底亚一位知名主播，因此很受那位主播的粉丝欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: Resembling the look of a popular streamer from Paldea, POKENAME has become a popular among fans of the streamer.

entry: POKENAME以小磁怪般的拳头，与其他POKENAME比试拳击。拳头最远能伸到20英尺，射程长，很占优势。
author: teatedtiten
source: Using their Magnemite-like fists, POKENAME engage in boxing matches with other POKENAME. Because they can reach up to 20 feet, they take advantage of their long range.

entry: 小磁性突起如传感器，寻找适合撒孢子的地方。POKENAME聚得太多，还能改变当地磁场。
author: frokachu
source: The small magnetic protrusions act as sensors that identify good places to spread spores. A high presence of POKENAME can alter magnetic fields in the area.

entry: POKENAME磁性极强，会吸来附近所有金属，慢慢分解并从中获取能量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is strongly magnetic and attracts everything metallic in its vicinity to slowly decompose it and generate energy from it.

entry: 为大葱找到了完美的烹饪搭配后，POKENAME诞生了。它活得痛苦，却很美味，再也感受不到快乐。
author: rooboid
source: Having found the perfect culinary companion to its leek, POKENAME is born. This Pokémon lives in pain, albeit delicious pain, and no longer feels joy.

entry: POKENAME成群躺地，以尾巴模仿草丛窸窣，吓跑小型天敌。
author: holgast
source: A troop of POKENAME will lie on the ground and use their tails to simulate rustling grass, frightening away small predators.

entry: 即使是宝可梦，也很少能用肉眼看见POKENAME。它会制造小冰柱，再从那根中空的长葱中射向猎物。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME is rarely seen with the naked eye, even by Pokémon. It produces small icicles that it fires at prey from its long, hollow leek.

entry: POKENAME酷似一部被遗忘的儿童节目的主角。用爪围住眼睛，就能看得极远。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME resembles the main character from a forgotten children's show. It can see great distances by cupping its paws around its eyes.

entry: POKENAME寻找配得上自己的剑士持用，随时愿意来一场公平的决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME seeks a worthy swordfighter to wield it. It is always up for a fair duel.

entry: POKENAME知道自己是根好棍子，十分自豪，总想以决斗证明这一点。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is filled with pride knowing it is a good stick, always eager to prove it with a duel.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，最喜欢和训练家玩抛接游戏。用的是孵化后不久得到的那根茎秆。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is playful in nature. Its favorite game to play with its Trainer is fetch. It uses the stalk that it received with shortly after hatching.

entry: POKENAME是让大葱长到巨大之后，才将其采收的大葱鸭。它用精神能量，操纵这副植物身体。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME are Farfetch'd that have let their leeks grow to gargantuan size before harvesting them. They control the plant body with spiritual energy.

entry: 它头顶的球茎不断抽出嫩绿的新芽。虽然看起来像可食用的植物，这些新芽却带有剧毒。
author: staghorn
source: The bulbs on its head are constantly sprouting with new, green growth. Though these growths resemble edible plants, they are extremely toxic.

entry: POKENAME很会配合，与善待它的训练家相处融洽。还爱替人叼取东西，仿佛天生就会。
author: frokachu
source: A very cooperative Pokémon, POKENAME get along well with good Trainers. They love fetching things for others as well, and seem to do so instinctually.

entry: POKENAME携带的蔬菜致密沉重，少有好吃的。
author: staghorn
source: The vegetables POKENAME carry are dense and heavy, and are rarley good to eat.

entry: POKENAME的鸟身与植物身，看似独立生物，实际却由群体生物操纵，共用一份意识。究竟怎么做到，仍无人明白。
author: holgast
source: While they appear to be separate, distinct organisms, both the bird and plant body of POKENAME are one mind, controlled by a colonial organism. It is unknown precisely how they accomplish this.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的铠甲，换下了大多数大葱鸭拥有的翅膀，抵挡众多天敌。睡觉时，它会紧紧合拢外壳，护住柔软的身体与珍贵的棍杖。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME have traded the wings that most Farfetch'd possess for resilient armor that stymies their many predators. They sleep with their shells clamped shut, protecting their soft bodies and precious sticks.

entry: POKENAME友好又热心，两个头合力解决难题，从未有人见过它们争吵打架。
author: frokachu
source: Incredibly friendly and helpful, POKENAME will try to solve problems with its two heads. No one has ever seen the heads disagree or fight with one another.

entry: 两个头为猎物自私地争斗，抢夺进食的权利。久而久之，常获胜的那个长得异常硕大，另一个则逐渐萎缩。
author: sk372
source: The two heads selfishly fight over any captured prey, battling for the right to eat their spoils. Over time, one will grow oversized as it consistently wins these fights for food, while the other slowly withers away.

entry: POKENAME的两个猪鼻子都嗅觉敏锐。即使极为寒冷，农民也能请它嗅寻松露。
author: dodoowner_
source: Both of POKENAME's pig noses have a keen sense of smell. Farmers use it to sniff out truffles in the coldest conditions.

entry: 两颗头的大脑几乎一模一样，很少争吵。唯一的例外，就是争抢训练家的抚摸。
author: melodydelune
source: Its two heads contain nearly identical brains. The heads rarely ever fight, with one exception being over pets from their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱春天的个体，飞羽会呈黄褐色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be tan if it prefers spring.

entry: POKENAME的主头能控制前两条腿，其他两颗头却各只能控制一条。后面的头觉得这很不公平。
author: dodoowner_
source: The main head of POKENAME gets to control the front two legs, while the other two heads only get one leg. The back heads think this is very unfair.

entry: 描绘POKENAME的古代图像，比基因之楔的发明还早。它能发出响亮怒吼，却更爱用小画拼成近似文字的排列，彼此交流。
author: sontyp
source: Ancient depictions of POKENAME predate the invention of DNA splicers. It's capable of loud, angry noises, but prefers to communicate via small paintings it assembles in a way that resembles writing.

entry: 为得到训练家夸奖，三颗头会合作执行复杂计划。若其中一颗得到抚摸，另外两颗就会吃醋。
author: melodydelune
source: Seeking its Trainer's praise, its three heads execute complex plans between them. When one is being petted, the other two heads will be jealous.

entry: 只能离地飘起一点点。底部长出的头会一路拖着，擦过泥土。
author: capwolfbane
source: It barely floats off the ground. The head sprouting from its bottom gets pulled along through the dirt.

entry: POKENAME靠尾羽飞行，令科学家十分困惑。毕竟按所有航空学法则，它都不该飞得起来。
author: krune
source: POKENAME flies using its tail feathers. Scientists are baffled by this, as according to all laws of aviation, a POKENAME should not be able to fly.

entry: 极软的羽毛，让POKENAME在极地水中也很暖。小角摸着冰冷，可用来驱退天敌。
author: mistymagius
source: Its incredibly soft feathers keep POKENAME warm while swimming in arctic waters. Its small horn is cold to the touch, which it uses to deter predators.

entry: 它偏爱寒地。训练家可摸鼻子检查健康：若不冰凉，就该立刻送往宝可梦中心。
author: melodydelune
source: It prefers colder climates. Trainers should check its health to see if its nose is cold; if not, it should be brought to a Pokémon Center immediately.

entry: POKENAME潜在海边浅水，只让眼睛露在沙上。猎物游近，就以强颚向上猛扑，试着拖进洞穴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks in the shallows of the ocean, keeping just its eyes above the sand. When prey swims close enough, they launch upward with their powerful jaws and attempt to drag it into their burrows.

entry: 这只小海狮凭灰色斑点与额头宝石便很容易辨认，已熟练掌握冰属性招式。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: This Seel can easily be spotted via its grey spots and the gem on its forehead. It has mastered Ice-type moves.

entry: POKENAME美丽的纹样与配色，近来成了时尚界的新宠。富人间甚至流行办整场以它为主题的秀。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has recently become a large icon in the fashion world for its beautiful patterns and coloring. Entire shows dedicated to this Pokémon have recently become trendy among the wealthy.

entry: 性情友善，游荡在冰冷环境中，几乎会帮助所有有需要的对象。但只要碰到冰冠，就会瞬间冻结。
author: pokepower
source: A friendly Pokémon that helps almost anyone in need as it wanders icy environments. If you touch its ice crown, you'll be frozen in an instant.

entry: POKENAME的歌声传遍冻原，迷惑猎物靠近。速度与力量足以压倒猎物，也能击败竞争者。
author: patch
source: POKENAME's songs can be heard all across the tundra, enchanting its prey to move closer. Its speed and power are more than enough to overwhelm its prey, as well as its competition.

entry: 十分保护喜欢的人。关于POKENAME引领水手穿越寒冷风暴的故事有很多。
author: geminib
source: It's very protective of people it's fond of. There are many stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through frigid storms.

entry: 极光构成的缎带触感冰冷。身体越健康，缎带的色彩就越鲜明。
author: melodydelune
source: The aurora that makes up its ribbons is cold to the touch. The better its health, the more vividly these ribbons appear.

entry: POKENAME体力惊人。会将制服的猎物夹在腋下，带到海滩吃掉，再晒太阳。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME boasts tremendous physical strength. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to the beach, then sunbathes after its meal.

entry: 热时将热能存进体内，到酷寒地区再拿来保暖。若存得过多，POKENAME就跳起高难又迷人的舞，释放能量。
author: hello_i_exist
source: It stores thermal energy in its body when its hot, then uses that energy to keep itself warm in freezing-cold areas. However, if it stores too much energy, POKENAME will release it by performing difficult yet mesmerizing dances.

entry: POKENAME很会潜水。常从结冰的海崖上一跃而下，从上方突袭猎物。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are extremely capable divers. They're often seen leaping from icy sea cliffs, surprising their prey from above.

entry: POKENAME常试着将黏软的肢体变成各种形状，有些变完后就再也变不回原样。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are often seen trying to morph their gooey limbs into different shapes. Some are unable to return to their original shape afterwards.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME是城都地区入侵性极强的物种。黏液会污染植物，使其迅速死亡。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a highly invasive species in the Johto region. Its goo can contaminate plants and quickly kill them.

entry: POKENAME的污泥完全来自受污染海洋的淤泥。数量过多，通常就意味着污染正在加剧。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's grime is strictly made up of ooze from polluted oceans. Overpopulation of POKENAME usually means pollution is worsening.

entry: POKENAME身上寄生着嗜肉的捕蝇草，因臭气熏天，很少有训练家饲养。背上的捕蝇草有自己的意志。
author: rooboid
source: Host to a flesh-hungry fly trap, POKENAME is rarely raised by Trainers because of its putrid smell. The fly trap on its back acts on its own volition.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在垃圾桶与垃圾箱旁逗留。垃圾吃得越多，颈部的宝石就越亮。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around trash cans and dumpsters. The gems around their neck glow brighter the more garbage they eat.

entry: POKENAME会和破破袋助手一起打理下水道，刷去污垢，将废物打包。城里的居民忍受它臭烘烘的礼物，换来了格外干净的管道。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME tidies up sewer systems, scrubbing grime and packaging waste with its Trubbish assistant. The residents of its home city endure its smelly gifts in exchange for exceptionally clean pipes.

entry: 据说，一只魔尼尼掉进毒泥坑后没有死去，反而与污泥融合，变成了POKENAME。
author: roundabout_robin
source: It is said that POKENAME was created when a Mime Jr. fell into a pit of toxic sludge. Instead of dying, it fused with it, creating this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的身体只是黏稠毒污泥的宿主。污泥会操纵身体大吃特吃，为进化做准备。
author: rooboid
source: The body of POKENAME is merely a host to the viscous, toxic sludge upon it. The sludge steers the body to eat voraciously to prepare it for evolution.

entry: 污染的剑刃划出的伤口必会严重感染。若近战不奏效，就会甩出一块恶臭的剑穗攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A wound from its polluted blade is sure to cause a nasty infection. When melee combat doesn't do, it throws a chunk of its putrid tassel instead.

entry: POKENAME在污水处理厂帮助去除污染物。吃下有害物质后，只留下无菌的水。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are used in sewage treatment plants to help remove pollutants. They eat the hazardous material, leaving behind only sterile water.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时缩在钢盔里。一察觉危险，便朝它认定的威胁射出裹着毒泥的钢刺。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME hide in their steel helmets while they sleep. When they sense danger, they will fire steel spikes coated in toxic sludge at the perceived threat.

entry: 几片扁平的身体由浓稠毒液黏在一起。POKENAME虽看着像煎饼，可千万别吃。
author: tad
source: Its body is composed of several flat segments joined together by a thick, toxic goo. Though POKENAME looks like pancakes, eating it is not advised.

entry: POKENAME生于毒泥与工业废水，对人类充满敌意。研究者发现，孕育它们的污泥毒性越强，它们就越快发动攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Born of toxic sludge and industrial discharge, POKENAME are aggressive and hostile toward humans. Researchers have observed that the more poisonous the sludge they arise from, the quicker they are to attack.

entry: 嘴里的螺旋由黑白污泥组成。即使POKENAME被打昏，也会缓缓旋转、搏动。
author: staghorn
source: The spiral in its mouth is made of black and white sludge. It slowly spins and pulses even when the POKENAME is knocked unconscious.

entry: POKENAME以有毒的碱性液体涂身，抵御捕食者。不过，它会避开磁性附肢，以免干扰磁性。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a toxic, alkaline fluid to ward off predators. They keep this fluid away from their magnetic appendages, however, so that their magnetic properties aren't disturbed.

entry: POKENAME游动时会释放毒素，污染水体。毒素又能孕育出臭鱼，待臭鱼进化，便再次重复这个循环。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME swims around, it emits a toxin that pollutes the water. These toxins can create Grichou, which then evolve to repeat the cycle.

entry: 节日期间，POKENAME会巡视排污系统，检查损坏与失修之处。它用条带状黏垢堵住漏口，或以会爆炸的垃圾炸开堵塞。
author: ozydamians
source: During the holidays, POKENAME inspects the sewage system for damage and neglect. It patches up leaks with ribbons of sticky grime, or clears blockages with explosive garbage.

entry: POKENAME看着像小卡比兽，其实只是变成了它的模样，借此欺骗想照顾自己的人。
author: rooboid
source: Though it resembles the body of a Munchlax, POKENAME has merely morphed to imitate its form, enabling it to deceive those who attempt to care for it.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温暖潮湿的环境，常化作一摊液体伏在丛林中。任何踩进去的东西都会被吞掉。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Preferring a warm and humid environment, POKENAME will sit as a puddle in the jungle. Anything that steps into this puddle will be consumed.

entry: 这只残忍的宝可梦爱把对手埋进毒泥里。相传，下半身那张嘴会低声诉说你的未来。
author: altius
source: This cruel Pokémon likes to bury its opponents under poisonous mud. According to legend, the mouth on its lower body can whisper your future.

entry: 这种宝可梦会用超能力操纵大量污泥。不同于其他臭臭泥变种，它带着淡淡的棉花糖香；研究者至今没能弄清原因。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: This Pokémon is commonly known to manipulate large amounts of sludge using its psychic power. Unlike other variants of Muk, this Pokémon smells faintly of cotton candy; researchers have been unable to determine the reason for this.

entry: POKENAME用超能力控制裹住身体的黏液，既能使其硬化为护层，也能分出一部分，赋予生命，化作听命于自己的仆从。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to control the ooze that envelops its body. It can harden this ooze into a protective coating or even animate some of it into a separate minion to do its bidding.

entry: POKENAME虽然外形如此，天性却极为友善。可惜，回抱它并不是个好主意。
author: rooboid
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is incredibly friendly by nature. Sadly, returning POKENAME's hugs is ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME能以快得惊人的速度挥爪，但裹住下半身的污泥拖慢了它的移动。
author: rooboid
source: While it is capable of swiftly clawing at its foes at breakneck speed, the sludge engrossing the lower half of POKENAME hinders its movement speed.

entry: POKENAME力量强横，外貌可怖，令人生畏。黏稠的皮肤能化成任何形状，无论是伸出的援手，还是剃刀般锋利的刃。
author: rooboid
source: Feared for its relentless power and ghastly looks, POKENAME can morph its viscous skin into any shape, be that a helping hand or a razor-sharp blade.

entry: 近年垃圾填埋场会请POKENAME清理垃圾，任何腐烂物或污染物都吃。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has been employed in recent years by landfills to clean up the garbage; they will eat anything that has rotted or is a pollutant.

entry: 吸收了太多污染物，让POKENAME的身体结构严重失衡。只有尾巴还保持原样。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME has absorbed so much contamination that its body suffers from disproportionate anatomy. Only its tails remain unchanged.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME长出果实般的突起，引诱猎物。这些突起与黏合身体的黏液一样有毒。
author: tad
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME develops fruit-like protrusions to attract prey. These protrusions are just as toxic as the goo holding its body together.

entry: 以背甲上的迫击炮发射种子炸弹而闻名。越是成长，射得就越远、越准。
author: soup1900
source: It is famously known to fire a Seed Bomb from the mortar on its shell. The more it grows, the farther and more accurate these shots will become.

entry: 它其实由一只小小的水箭龟操控，靠喷射水流轰击敌人，也借此敏捷移动，身手如战斗机飞行员般娴熟。
author: pokepower
source: It is really controlled by a tiny Blastoise. Using jets of water to bombard foes and move with incredible agility, it's as skilled as a fighter pilot.

entry: 水上乐园里，常能看到POKENAME为孩子们表演。背上的袋子里，藏着各式各样的戏水花招。
author: patch
source: POKENAME can be seen performing for children at water parks. The sack on its back is filled with all sorts of water-themed party tricks.

entry: 会巡视领地，用大量水流轰击不服管束的宝可梦。与拉普拉斯不同，谁想骑到它背上，它就会发狂。
author: pokepower
source: It patrols its territory, blasting any unruly Pokémon with a deluge of water. Unlike Lapras, it goes berserk if anything tries to ride on its back.

entry: POKENAME将超能力注入炮管，射出受念力驱动的强劲水炮。它也能以意念控水，掀起波浪击倒对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its cannons, launching powerful telekinetic water blasts. It can control water with its mind, forming waves to strike down opponents.

entry: 即使高速移动，它也能从背甲上的炮管精准射出水流。军队会用它们代替攻击型无人机。
author: soup1900
source: It can accurately fire water jets from the cannon on its shell while moving extremely fast. They are utilized in the military in place of attack drones.

entry: 从两根触角喷出高压水柱，贯穿猎物。两股水流合一，能制造时速超过60英里的洋流。
author: soup1900
source: It fires high-pressure water jets from its two antennae to puncture its prey. Combining these two blasts can create ocean currents of over 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME的炮管在水中如催眠般摇摆，吸引游过的好奇宝可梦。等猎物靠近，便猛射强劲水柱，打个措手不及。
author: cartoonhostage
source: POKENAME's cannons sway hypnotically in the water, drawing the attention of curious Pokémon swimming by. When they get close enough, it blasts its unsuspecting prey with powerful beams of water.

entry: 口中的炮管水力惊人，可POKENAME身体太脆弱，开炮后反而被震得倒飞出去。有些POKENAME索性借此赶路。
author: imaginaryneon
source: The cannon in its mouth fires water at exceptional power. However, POKENAME is so frail that it flies backwards afterwards, leading to some POKENAME using it as a means of travel.

entry: 背部迫击炮射出的种子炸弹能在半空爆出缤纷色彩。人们用它制作美丽的烟火表演。
author: soup1900
source: The Seed Bomb it fires from the mortar on its back can explode midair, creating a colorful boom. People use it to create beautiful fireworks shows.

entry: POKENAME的两个头会沟通，精确攻击1000码外的目标。有时也会被两种视角弄得头晕。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME has two heads that communicate to launch accurate attacks from over 1000 yards away. Sometimes it gets dizzy from the two viewpoints.

entry: POKENAME转动身体时，会踢起一道小水墙，力道足以掀倒成年人。水让地面湿滑，也使POKENAME转得更快。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME spins its body, it kicks up a small wall of water with enough force to topple a fully grown person. The water creates a slippery surface that allows for POKENAME to spin even faster.

entry: POKENAME的战斗常像牛仔对峙般一对一决斗。它时常与章鱼桶结怨。
author: teatedtiten
source: When POKENAME battle, they usually engage in duels reminiscent of cowboy standoffs. It frequently has feuds with Octillery.

entry: POKENAME的炮能发射石块与水。受威胁时就缩进壳内，用尾巴当重锤。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME is capable of shooting rocks and water from its cannons. When it feels threatened, it will hide in its shell and use its tail as a mace.

entry: POKENAME的硬壳其实由干泥组成。它能敲碎壳片，当作弹片高速射出，连壶壶的壳都能打凹。
author: shocktopus1717
source: The hard material comprising POKENAME's shell is actually dried mud. It can smash pieces of the shell into shrapnel and fire them at speeds that could dent a Shuckle's shell.

entry: 它从背上的两门大炮中发射种子，种在自己够不到的高处。它能将种子炸弹射到30,000英尺以外。
author: soup1900
source: It launches seeds from the two cannons on its back to plant them in high places it cannot reach. It can fire Seed Bombs over 30,000 feet.

entry: 巨颚如今成了水炮，因此POKENAME很受消防员欢迎。
author: mossybanana
source: Its jaws now function as a water cannon. As a result, POKENAME is a favorite amongst firefighters.

entry: 传说中的枪剑，据说被海难中沉没的海盗王附身。会击沉船只，迫使别人遭遇相同命运。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A legendary gun-sword said to be possessed by a shipwrecked, sunken pirate lord. It sinks ships to make others face its fate too.

entry: 缎带演化出了喷射高压水流的本领，水流强到足以击穿坚石。
author: melodydelune
source: Its ribbons have adapted to spout highly pressurized bursts of water. These ribbons can fire water hard enough to tear through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME会朝来袭威胁开炮，射出水流和尖石。心理学家发现，它不喜欢自己的蓝色鳞片，因为那会让它想起盖欧卡。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME fires water as well as pointy rocks out of its cannons at incoming threats. Psychologists found out that this Pokémon doesn't like its blue colored scales, because they remind it of Kyogre.

entry: POKENAME喷水的压力极强，能将自己反推数米。它喜欢用这种特别的方式逃跑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can shoot water with such pressure that it propels itself back many meters. It likes to use this as an unconventional escape method.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便用自身融合的遗传物质造出一队微型船员，负责操炮、装填。POKENAME常跟随船只，保护它们免遭凶暴宝可梦袭击。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME, lacking any limbs, creates a miniature crew from its fused genetic material to man and reload its cannons. POKENAME often follow boats, protecting them from more aggressive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME利用压强达每平方英寸200磅的喷水推进，在空中疾驰。据说，如果毫无预兆地下起雨来，就说明附近有POKENAME。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME blasts across the sky with its 200-PSI water jets. When it starts raining without warning, it is said that a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，尾巴老是把东西点着。接着便用水炮灭火，可通常又喷得太多。
author: incognito1234
source: A clumsy Pokémon, POKENAME constantly sets fire to things with its tail. It then uses its cannons to put out the fire, usually using too much water.

entry: POKENAME很容易发怒，稍受挑衅便敌意大起，朝惹恼自己的家伙喷出滚烫蒸汽。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME angers easily, becoming hostile at even the slightest provocation. It will then blast the agitator with scalding steam from its cannons.

entry: 它会从炮管中喷出滚烫的蒸汽。这些蒸汽能造成4度烧伤，烧穿皮肤，甚至危及生命。
author: soup1900
source: It ejects scalding steam from its cannons. This steam can cause 4th-degree burns, meaning it'll burn through your skin and potentially kill you.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的炮管变得更加灵活，便于瞄准。如今，水炮不仅威力更强，也打得更准。
author: skymaster426
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME more flexible cannons with which to aim. Its water blasts have increased in power, as well as precision.

entry: POKENAME的炮实际上由背上的大舌贝控制，因此射击极准，毫无死角。
author: voxposs
source: POKENAME's cannons are actually controlled by Shellder on its back. As a result, it's able to shoot extremely accurately and have no blind spots.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今它的甲壳坚不可摧，连炮火也无法伤害它。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its shell is now indestructible; not even cannon fire can harm it.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAME极为相似。背上巨大的炮管，让它像一辆长了腿的坦克。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME. The large cannon on its back makes it look like a tank with legs.

entry: 它长得像超极巨化POKENAME。壳上足足有31门炮，会朝敌人不停地倾泻炮火。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is similar to that of Gigantamax POKENAME. It has 31 cannons on its shell that it barrages endlessly against its foes.

entry: 脸上坚硬的壳能挡住大部分伤害。战斗时会合上壳，一头撞向敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: The hardened shell on its face will protect it from most damage. When they fight, they will close their shells and charge head first into foes.

entry: POKENAME能在贝壳般的花苞里孕育珍珠，每周最多5颗。它极爱护珍珠，谁敢偷，就挥动花苞朝谁打去。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can produce pearls in its shell-like bud, making up to 5 pearls a week. It is very protective of its pearls and will swing its bud at anyone that tries to steal them.

entry: 外壳是一顶轻巧又坚固的头盔。它靠舌头感知气流，在漆黑洞穴中辨路。
author: staghorn
source: Its shell serves as a lightweight yet durable helmet. It uses its tongue to sense air currents and navigate through dark caves.

entry: POKENAME其实不会游泳，只能漫步海底，寻找小型软体动物吃。头上的角带毒，能让受害者浑身发抖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can't actually swim, so it wanders the seafloor looking for small mollusks to eat. The horns on its head contain poison, which can cause shivering in its victims.

entry: POKENAME生活在沿海沼泽。一旦翻倒，就用舌头把自己撑回原位。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME live in swampy areas along the coastline. They use their tongue to reposition themselves if they fall over.

entry: 它会从嘴和铠甲上的突起喷出灼热蒸汽，攻击敌人。POKENAME独来独往，性情凶暴，平时不愿受打扰，一旦被惹怒，便会战斗不休。
author: frokachu
source: This Pokémon shoots burning hot steam at enemies from its mouth and the protrusions in its armor. Solitary but violent, POKENAME prefers to be left alone but will fight relentlessly if provoked.

entry: POKENAME在陆地受威胁时，会脱下触角上串着的珍珠。只需几天，珍珠就会重新长出。
author: melodydelune
source: When threatened on land, POKENAME will shed the pearls strung along its feelers; its pearls will be replaced in only a matter of a few days.

entry: 聪明狡猾，偏爱潜行而非正面猛攻。若看见冰锥仿佛凭空接连射来，多半就是它干的。
author: jaycielantern
source: A clever, sneaky fusion that favors stealth over full frontal assault. Blame it if you witness a barrage of Icicle Spears seemingly from nowhere.

entry: 遭亵渎尸体的灵魂附上了挖出它的卡拉卡拉，以骨头为武器。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The spirit of a desecrated body possesses the Cubone who dug it up and wields its bone as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME会产生气态氯化钾，从头部、嘴和尾巴排出。紫色的火焰便由此而来。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME produces a gaseous form of potassium chloride that is expelled from its head, mouth, and tail. This is what causes its purple-colored fire.

entry: 大人常对孩子说，POKENAME就是从前乱玩电源插座的小孩变的。当然，这话完全没有事实依据。
author: enemyphase
source: Children are often told that POKENAME were once kids that played with electrical sockets. Of course, there's no actual truth to this whatsoever.

entry: 据说，POKENAME舍弃肉身，化为超能力能量，借此超越死亡。它变得更加强大，守护之心也更盛。
author: skymaster426
source: Supposedly surpassing death, POKENAME has given up its body to turn into psychic energy, making it much more powerful and protective.

entry: POKENAME的“剑刃”由气体构成，看似无害。一旦渗入血肉，就会从内部使其中毒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's "blade" may seem harmless as it is made of gas, but once it permeates flesh, it poisons it from the inside.

entry: 会出现在宠物刚刚离世的人家中。虽然身体由气体构成，训练家却说，它卧在膝上时依然能感觉到。
author: melodydelune
source: It appears in the homes of people whose pets have recently passed. Despite being made of gas, Trainers say they feel it when it lays on their laps.

entry: 这只宝可梦几乎没有重量，快得不可思议。它在天空四处寻找可吓唬的对象，移动时一声不响。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon is unfathomably fast because it is nearly weightless. It scours the skies in search of a victim to scare, as it can move without making a single sound.

entry: POKENAME喜欢捉弄人。突然出现在视线中，又迅速消失，把人吓一跳，纳闷它究竟去了哪里。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to prank people. It appears in someone's sight and then quickly vanishes, scaring the person and making them wonder where it went.

entry: POKENAME在高空漂浮，翅膀由极薄的雾气构成。身体如此轻盈，POKENAME常被高空急流吹散，散落到世界各地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Drifting high in the atmosphere, the wings of POKENAME are composed of a very thin mist. As light as their bodies are, POKENAME are often dispersed by the jet stream and can be found all over the world.

entry: POKENAME爱渗进老建筑的裂缝，因而恶名在外。据接触过它气体的人说，会看见令人不安的幻象。
author: busilisk
source: POKENAME is notorious for seeping into the cracks of old buildings. People exposed to its gases have reported unsettling hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮物品。会躲进废弃建筑避开强风，在外人看来像诡异闪烁的光点。
author: essie
source: POKENAME adore collecting shiny objects. They will hide from strong winds in abandoned buildings, looking to outsiders like eerie, flickering lights.

entry: POKENAME平静时，散出的雾触感清凉。战斗时温度升高，能够灼伤对手。
author: ohok3441
source: When calm, the mist POKENAME produces is cool to the touch. In battle, it rises in temperature to burn opponents.

entry: POKENAME极为记仇，永远不会忘记伤害过自己的面孔。得罪它的人，会被拖进坟墓。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is incredibly vengeful, never forgetting the faces of those who hurt it. It'll drag people who've wronged it to their grave.

entry: 身体结构不稳定，让它连站直都勉强。有人见过POKENAME成群聚在废弃之地，一些最古老的恐怖故事便由此而来。
author: leeto64
source: Due to its unstable anatomy, it can barely stay upright. Sightings of POKENAME swarming abandoned areas inspired some of the oldest horror stories.

entry: POKENAME几乎连身体的轮廓都维持不住。它移动时，所经之处几乎一切都会被整团污泥吞没。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME is barely able to keep any semblance of form in its body. As it moves, pratically anything will be engulfed whole in its mass of sludge.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME源于古老诅咒，据说会将人类变成它们的同类。
author: pokebio
source: There are ancient tomes stating POKENAME originate from ancient curses. They are said to turn humans into their kind.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影中，寻找能被自己催眠的人。成功后就吸取睡者的灵魂，增强自身力量。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows and looks for people it can put to sleep. When its successful, it will absorb the sleeper's soul to increase its power.

entry: POKENAME能在星界操纵四肢，踢出从肉体角度看几乎不可能的招式。
author: entomoxie
source: With control of their limbs across the astral plane, POKENAME can launch kicks that otherwise seem physically impossible.

entry: 这只拉达曾是某人队伍中的战斗主力。死后葬在紫苑镇，却又从墓中归来。
author: theheroict
source: A Raticate that was once a key battler in someone's party. It came to its end and was buried in Lavender Town, where it came back from the grave.

entry: POKENAME像个孩子，常假装寻求安慰，骗训练家握住自己的手。接着便给对方一记无伤大雅的电击，咯咯笑着跑开。
author: enemyphase
source: Childlike in demeanor, POKENAME often trick Trainers into holding their hand under the guise of seeking comfort. They then administer a harmless electric shock and run away chortling.

entry: 外貌虽令人不安，性情却十分亲人。可惜，舔一下就可能让训练家麻痹。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon, despite its unnerving appearance, is very affectionate. Unfortunately, its licks have been known to paralyze its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用九条幽灵尾巴制造幻象，欺骗人类与宝可梦。据说，它潜伏在暗林里，顽皮地等待吓唬毫无戒心的对象。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME uses its nine ghostly tails to create illusions that deceive both people and Pokémon. It is said to lurk in dark forests, mischievously waiting to scare unsuspecting victims.

entry: 三只一组行动，寻找目标并吸取能量。据说三只POKENAME关系足够亲密时，就会进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They work in groups of three to find a target and drain their energy. When three POKENAME become very close, it is thought an evolution will occur.

entry: 比一团积尘还轻，因此跑得飞快。常四处捉弄训练家，却从不让人看见罪魁祸首。
author: dodoowner_
source: This fusion is a quick runner, as it weighs less than a dust bunny. It usually runs around pulling pranks on Trainers, who never see the culprit.

entry: POKENAME靠不祥的能量支撑身体直立。有人认为，它们是死于极度污秽环境之人的亡魂。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME use ominous energy to keep their bodies upright. They are believed by some to be the souls of those who died in highly unsanitary conditions.

entry: POKENAME虽然迟缓，却是可怕的猎手，什么都想吸收。若看见水里伸出鬼手，立刻逃走。
author: leeto64
source: Despite being sluggish, POKENAME is a terrifying hunter that tries to absorb anything. If you see ghostly hands in the water, run away immediately.

entry: POKENAME的水之利爪能轻松切开钢铁。它在幽暗深处悄然狩猎，一旦锁定猎物，便没有什么能阻止它追击。
author: rotcivosk
source: POKENAME's water claws can easily cut through steel. It silently hunts in the deep dark, and once locked on to its prey nothing can stop its pursuit.

entry: POKENAME能随心所欲地把炮管移到任何位置。本是惊人的提升，可惜炮击的威力却很弱。
author: patch
source: POKENAME has the capability to freely move its cannons anywhere it wants. While this is an incredible upgrade, the shots themselves are unfortunately very weak.

entry: POKENAME藏进路灯，吸干电力，让灯泡熄灭。等人爬上梯子换灯泡时，它就突然蹿出来，把对方推下梯子。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME hide within streetlights and drain their energy entirely, causing the bulb to go out. While someone replaces the dead bulb, POKENAME springs out and pushes them off their ladder.

entry: POKENAME的身体由骨骼化石、灵质与投射的幻象组成。根据各自独特的组成，便能区分个体。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is made up of fossilized bone, ectoplasm and projected illusions. Individuals can be identified by their particular compositions.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿人们的影子恶作剧。但遇见山中迷途者，便会领着对方回家。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME loves playing pranks on people by mimicking their shadows, but if it encounters someone lost in the mountains, it will guide them home.

entry: 被称为“行走的鬼火”，会跟人回家，夺走生命。吞噬灵魂后，火焰便燃成深紫色。
author: skymaster426
source: It is known as "The Walking Wisp", following people home to steal their life away. When it consumes a soul, Its flames burn a deep purple.

entry: 据说POKENAME脑中尽是最卑劣、邪恶、恐怖的念头。若有足够力量，它就会毁灭世界。
author: retrocrow
source: It is said that only the most putrid, evil, and horrific thoughts go through POKENAME 's mind. If it had the power to, it would end the world.

entry: POKENAME虽然颜色鲜艳，却擅长在阴影中潜行。夜间在城市游荡，捉弄居民。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its vibrant colors, POKENAME is a master at sneaking through the shadows. It roams around cities at night, pranking civilians.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在南瓜田里，让背上的花苞发光，再配上诡异的嚎叫，吓唬孩子。孩子们的恐惧，正是它的食粮。
author: rytthigar
source: POKENAME loves to scare children by hiding in pumpkin patches and making the bulb on its back glow, accompanied by strange howling. It feeds on the children's fright.

entry: 实验赋予了它惊人的速度与知识。会凭这些本领环游世界，尽可能体验一切。
author: skymaster426
source: Experimentation has granted this Pokémon extreme speed and knowledge. It uses these gifts to travel the world and experience all it can.

entry: POKENAME常把尾巴插进大酒店的发电机，让整栋楼闹起灵异事件，直到自己被抓，或酒店倒闭才罢休。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME often plug their tails into the generators of large hotels and cause paranormal events throughout the building. They do this until they are caught, or the building goes out of business.

entry: POKENAME借空壳作掩护，四处作恶。若看见像脱壳忍者蜕壳的东西泛着诡异粉光，千万别靠近。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the an empty shell as an asset for its misdeeds. If you see what appears to be a Shedinja shell with an eerie pink glow, do not approach it.

entry: POKENAME背上的葫芦能脱离身体，像幽灵般四处飞掠，既用来侦察猎物，也会在夜里飞进人家。
author: rytthigar
source: The gourd on POKENAME's back can detach and swoop around like a ghost. It does so to scout around for prey, and to fly into people's houses at night.

entry: 生性狡猾，喜欢制造混乱。常以扒窃取乐，不合眼缘的东西就直接扔掉。
author: 8xviktor
source: This deceitful Pokémon has an affinity for causing chaos. It often pickpockets people for fun and throws away any item that doesn't catch its eye.

entry: 深夜若感到寒意，就快跑到最近的亮处，留意阴影。也许是POKENAME来索取你的生命力了。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: If you feel a chill in the dead of night, run into the nearest light and watch for shadows. It may be a POKENAME coming to claim your life force.

entry: 据说被POKENAME双翼劈成两半的对象，灵魂也会被摧毁，无法前往来世，彻底消失。
author: vaporvenator
source: It's said those split in two by the wings of POKENAME have their souls eviscerated, denying them an afterlife and erasing them entirely.

entry: 与训练家同行时，喜欢藏在对方的影子里。被幽灵手臂碰到，会感到强烈寒意。
author: melodydelune
source: When walking with its Trainer, it prefers to hide in their shadow. If you are touched by its ghostly arms, you will experience a strong chill.

entry: 午夜时分，POKENAME会俯冲抓走猎物，带往不明之处。这时，云会遮住月亮。
author: skymaster426
source: At midnight, POKENAME swoops down to snatch up prey to take them to somewhere unknown. Clouds cover the moon when this happens.

entry: POKENAME常想躲进训练家或其他宝可梦的影子，可身体太烫，很难不被察觉。若POKENAME这样跟着自己的训练家，多半意味着彼此感情很好。
author: toast_licker_500
source: POKENAME often tries to lurk in the shadows of Trainers or other Pokémon, but its scorching hot body makes it hard to be discrete. If a POKENAME does this to its Trainer, it's often a sign of a good bond between them.

entry: POKENAME躲在阴影里，用长翅膀给别人挠痒痒。可咯咯笑声总会暴露它的位置。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: POKENAME uses its long wings to tickle others from the shadows. Its giggles gives it away.

entry: 这只恶魔般的宝可梦在阴暗潮湿处附近狩猎。有部著名电影中，POKENAME模仿困在输水隧道里的哭泣女子，引人靠近。
author: leeto64
source: This devilish Pokémon hunts near damp, dark areas. A famous movie features POKENAME mimicking a crying lady stuck in a water tunnel to lure humans in.

entry: 它被称为“下水道恶魔”，凶恶可怖，单凭一己之力便将整套排污系统霸为领地，制造种种恐怖事件。
author: leeto64
source: Known as "The Sewer's Devil", this fearsome creature singularly dominates entire sewage systems as their territories, causing all sorts of terror.

entry: POKENAME由最邪恶的灵魂构成，吞食恶念，转化为致命毒素，供自身成长。
author: fr34kuency
source: A body made up of the most evil spirits, POKENAME feasts on evil desires and transforms them into a lethal poison which it uses to grow.

entry: POKENAME思念母亲，于是凿出一顶形似母亲的石盔戴上。靠它便能在地下钻行。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Missing its mother, POKENAME chiseled and wears a stone helmet in their likeness. With it, it can burrow through the ground.

entry: POKENAME用超能力在地下钻行，寻找作为食物的各种岩石。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME will burrow through the ground, seeking the various rocks that make up its diet.

entry: POKENAME不停在地下钻行，连睡觉也不例外。灵敏的磁铁让它不迷路，吃下矿物则能强化身体。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME constantly burrow into the  ground even when asleep. It has a sensitive magnet to not lose its way. It consumes minerals to toughen its body.

entry: POKENAME一边啃穿地层，一边摄取矿物，让外皮变坚韧。在附近筑巢时，建筑物也会消失。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME chew their way through the ground consuming minerals, toughening its hide. Buildings disappear when it nests nearby.

entry: 会在城堡墙壁上伪装成石像鬼。与真正的石像鬼不同，它不会吐水，这正是认出POKENAME的线索。
author: chorb33
source: It disguises itself on castle walls as a gargoyle . Unlike other gargoyles, it doesn't spit water, which helps indicate that it's really POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用大角掘地，也会蜷成球滚动。滚动时伸角撞击下方地面，就能转向，或将自己弹向别处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large horns to help them dig into the ground. They curl up into balls and roll around, steering or launching different directions by extending their horns and striking the ground beneath them.

entry: 尾巴极为强健，能将POKENAME弹上数米高空。虽身体沉重，仍能长距离滑翔。
author: chorb33
source: Its tail is extremely strong. This allows POKENAME to launch itself many meters into the air, then glide for long distances despite its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME跃上半空，蜷成球，用岩刺撞击敌人。它们收集岩石，不停打磨尖刺，还会在洞穴里开凿隧道，寻找最坚硬的石头，用来锻炼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap into the air and curl into balls to attack with their rocky spines. They gather rocks to sharpen their spines, constantly working to polish and refine them, carving out tunnels in caves to find the sturdiest stones to train with.

entry: POKENAME钻穿山体，寻找更坚硬的石头加固剑刃，过程中也会将剑刃磨得更锋利。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME drills through mountains in search of tougher stone to harden its blade. Doing so also sharpens it in the process.

entry: 寻找最硬的石头时，POKENAME会逐渐变得致密、暗沉，宛如缟玛瑙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In search of the toughest stone, POKENAME condenses and darkens to resemble onyx.

entry: 身体上的晶体最为坚硬。会用晶体撞击敌人，突破大多数防御。
author: melodydelune
source: The crystals on its body are the hardest points; it will attack by hitting its enemies with them, piercing most enemy defenses.

entry: 有记载称，POKENAME曾是古代文明的守护者。它虽笨重，一击却足以摧毁整座宫殿。
author: chorb33
source: There are reports that POKENAME served as a guardian for ancient civilizations. It is cumbersome, but its strikes can bring down entire palaces.

entry: 遗迹中常有人发现停止活动的POKENAME。传说，有些考古学家误将它们激活，竟被它们的凝视石化。
author: chorb33
source: Time and again, deactivated POKENAME are found in ruins. Rumour has it that some archaeologists were petrified by their stare when they accidentally activated them.

entry: 用獠牙啃食岩石与岩石属性宝可梦，抽取其中的矿石和矿物。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its fangs to feed on rocks and Rock-type Pokémon, draining them of ores and minerals.

entry: POKENAME的两个头共用身体与胃，却自私贪吃，宁愿争抢一丁点食物，也不肯各自吃一份更丰盛的餐点。
author: sk372
source: Despite sharing the same body and stomach, the two heads of POKENAME are selfishly greedy. They often fight over a single morsel rather than eat two separate, more filling meals.

entry: POKENAME会变出舒适的床和枕头等幻象道具，诱人入睡，好吃掉梦境。谁不肯上床睡觉，它就扇谁一巴掌。
author: frokachu
source: By creating illusionary props like comfy beds and pillows, POKENAME can lull others to sleep so it can eat their dreams. It slaps anyone who refuses to go to bed.

entry: 据说，POKENAME很擅长帮助反复做噩梦的人。只要站到POKENAME面前，它就能变成噩梦中的对象，让许多人逐渐面对夜间的恐惧，重获安眠。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are said to be excellent when helping those with recurring nightmares. Standing in front of POKENAME allows them to transform into the subject of the bad dream. This has helped many come to terms with night terrors and find peaceful sleep.

entry: 长鼻能闻出其他宝可梦的梦。靠这种感知，即使在漆黑的水下洞穴中也能辨路。
author: snescontroller
source: Its trunk can smell the dreams of other Pokémon. It uses this sense to navigate underwater caves in pitch darkness.

entry: POKENAME以繁复的求偶仪式闻名。每对伴侣都有独特的舞蹈，还会收集心爱的食物与小饰物，在中央堆好。仪式若成功，这堆东西竟会变成一颗蛋！
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are known for their intricate mating rituals. Each dance performed is unique to the mating pair and involves gathering favourite foods and baubles to be placed in a central pile. If the ritual is successful, the pile transforms into an egg!

entry: 有人见过POKENAME吞食熟睡的沃特拉及周围宝可梦的梦境。它在水中游动，让附近的宝可梦都惶恐不安。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has been spotted eating the dreams of sleeping Worterra and Pokémon around it. It swims around, causing terror to every Pokémon around it.

entry: 被POKENAME的剑刃轻轻划伤，就会睡着。它随后将缎带搭在受害者脸上，吃掉对方的梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A tiny cut from POKENAME's blade can put its opponent to sleep. Then it will place its ribbon on its victims face to eat their dreams.

entry: POKENAME常被请来帮助受噩梦困扰的人。它吃掉恶梦，让人安稳入睡。
author: melodydelune
source: Often used to help those suffering from nightmares, POKENAME feasts on the bad dreams, leaving them with restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME鼾声不断，睡在旁边出了名地难熬。更糟的是，它常学会自己溜出精灵球，偏爱直接趴在训练家脸上睡。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are prolific snorers and are notoriously difficult to sleep near. This is unfortunate, as they often learn to escape their Poké Ball, preferring to sleep directly on their Trainer's face.

entry: POKENAME住在深谷，以过路冒险者的梦为食。筑巢时，专找附近营地旅人珍爱的纪念物，但原主已把这些东西忘得一干二净。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in deep chasms and feed on wandering adventurers' dreams. When constructing their nests, they specifically locate sentimental items from travelers occupying nearby campsites. These items are forgotten entirely by the previous owner.

entry: POKENAME住在最深最暗的洞穴，吞食熟睡宝可梦的梦，还会趁人不备袭击。睡觉时，它们倒吊着，长鼻子轻轻颤动。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in the deepest and darkest caves. They feed on sleeping Pokémon's dreams and attack when least expected. Their long noses quiver when they sleep, dangling upside down.

entry: POKENAME极其珍视自己的摆锤。若拿到一枚偷来的摆锤，可要准备好被追捕——珍宝找不回来，它们绝不会罢休。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME revere their pendulums with the utmost respect. If you come into possession of a stolen one prepare to be hunted as they will not stop until they are reunited with their precious object.

entry: 据说用POKENAME的毛填枕头，就会做美梦。它用翅膀迷惑捕食者，分散对方注意。
author: griddle
source: A POKENAME's fur is said to bring good dreams to those who stuff it in their pillow. It uses its wings to mesmerize and distract predators.

entry: 还是催眠新手，喜欢把别人弄睡着来恶作剧。可催眠效果很弱，几分钟便会消退。
author: jackythewannabe
source: A novice hypnotist, it pranks others by putting them to sleep. Its trances are so weak that they wear off in mere minutes.

entry: 这只巨鼻生物会凭灵敏嗅觉闻疗愈熏香。深深吸一口，既让头脑清明，也让鼻子通畅。
author: xenophacilus
source: This massive-snouted creature uses its superior nose to smell healing incense. By breathing in deeply, it clears both its mind and its nose.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐的鼻子嗅探潜意识，寻找能做出优质梦境的对象。再用摆锤催眠，吸入他们的梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sniffs outs the subconscious of quality dreamers using its sharp nose. It then puts them to sleep with its pendulum and inhales their dreams.

entry: POKENAME会在医院帮助病人入睡。摆锤挥动得越久，患者睡得也越久。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is used in hospitals to help put patients to sleep; the longer they swing their pendulums, the longer the patients remain asleep.

entry: 摆锤用于近身搏斗，而非催眠。另一只手臂上的蓝花会释放气味，催眠虚弱的猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: It uses the pendulums for physical combat rather than hypnosis. The blue flower on its other arm releases a scent used for hypnotizing weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME战斗时毫不留情。先用长触手抓住对手，再用摆锤使其入睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is merciless during a fight. It grabs its opponent with one of its long tentacles then uses its pendulum to put it to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用电磁力让闪亮小硬币浮空，借此迷惑更大的宝可梦，让对方载着自己并提供保护。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME use electromagnetism to levitate small, shiny coins. They use these coins to enchant larger Pokémon into giving them rides and protection.

entry: 战斗时，一只手抓住对手，两只手用摆锤催眠，最后一只手负责挥拳。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: During a fight, it uses one hand to grab its opponent, two hands to hypnotize it with its pendulums, and the last hand to throw punches at it.

entry: POKENAME催眠本领高强，却总集中不了精神，常一不小心，把自己和训练家都哄睡了。
author: autoregenesis
source: POKENAME are powerful hypnotists. However, their lack of focus means they are prone to accidentally putting themselves and their Trainers to sleep.

entry: POKENAME是催眠大师，用嘴里的螺旋引来食物，随后毫不犹豫地吞下。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is a master hypnotist. It uses the spirals in its mouth to lure food in, then devours them without a second thought.

entry: 精通催眠。挥动双摆锤时，甚至能控制传说宝可梦的心智。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This creature is a master of hypnosis. By swinging its dual pendulums, it is able to control the minds of even legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME沿着海底疾行，啪嗒合钳，警告天敌。出击时迅速倾斜身体，再用双臂撑住身子，重新立起。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scuttle along the seafloor, snapping their claws as warnings to predators. They quickly tilt their bodies to strike with their claws, using their arms to catch themselves and push back up onto their feet.

entry: POKENAME将柄埋入沙中，看起来像一只被丢弃的钳子。缎带一察觉动静，斧头便会翻起，斩杀受害者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When POKENAME buries its shaft in the sand, it appears to be just a discarded claw. Alerted by its ribbon, the axe flips to execute its victim.

entry: POKENAME喷出气泡，折射自身的光影，制造幻象，融入周围。若有人靠得太近，看穿伪装，它便举钳示警。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the spray of bubbles from their body to reflect light off of themselves, creating mirages to blend into their surroundings. If anyone gets close enough to see through the mirage, POKENAME will ready their claws as a warning.

entry: 头上的钳子是绝佳武器。受威胁时，会用头猛撞目标，再用钳子夹住敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: The pincers on its head make excellent weapons. When threatened, it will bash its head into targets and clamp its pincers onto foes.

entry: POKENAME以悦耳歌声，将受害者诱进自己在沙中挖的洞。歌声的声波只会引来最美味的猎物。
author: mrpeach774
source: POKENAME uses its melodic voice to lure its victims into holes it digs in the sand. The sound waves of its singing voice lure only the tastiest prey.

entry: POKENAME按催眠的节奏吹泡泡，引诱毫无戒心的目标走进巢穴，巢穴通常位于黑暗洞窟中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME blows bubbles in a hypnotizing rhythm. In this way, it lures unwary targets into its lair, which is often located in dark caves.

entry: 巨大的斧头让POKENAME不再适用原先的狩猎方式。如今一记挥斩，就能劈开行动迟缓、甲壳厚实的猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's overgrown axe head also means it's outgrown its previous hunting method. It can now cleave slow, well-armored victims in one fell swoop.

entry: 会在海滩上空飞行，寻找食物。体形让捕猎不便，因此演化出能从两侧伸出的钳子，方便从空中狩猎。
author: patch_bros
source: It flies around beaches looking for food. Its size makes hunting difficult, so it has adapted its claws to extend from its sides to hunt from the sky.

entry: 尾巴上的巨钳威力惊人，但也十分沉重。因此，它靠密集气泡构成的肢体维持平衡。
author: melodydelune
source: The claw on its tail is incredibly powerful. However, due to the weight of its claw, it relies on dense limbs made of bubbles to keep itself balanced.

entry: POKENAME优美的音色能引来体型有自己两倍大的猎物。它会用巨大的钳子，夹碎比自己更大的敌人。
author: mrpeach774
source: The timbre of POKENAME's voice lures in prey twice its size. It uses its oversized claw to crush foes larger than it.

entry: 为免巨钳吓跑猎物，POKENAME会先用摆锤催眠。钳子与巨颚连最硬的铠甲都能夹碎。
author: chorb33
source: To avoid scaring off prey with its fearsome claws, POKENAME hypnotizes them with its pendulum. Its claws and jaws can crack even the toughest armor.
